title: 通玄妙论·无鬼无气：占官无鬼功名难就，卦中纵有贵人终为贵而无位；官鬼宜静不宜动

rule.yi: 求官的卦里不能没有官鬼：没有官鬼，功名难成，卦里纵然有贵人，也只是有贵人而没有位子。官鬼这一爻宜安静不宜发动：带着吉神动是福，加上凶煞动是祸。
rule.en: A divination for office must not lack the Pressure line: without it name and rank are hard to achieve, and even with a Noble in the hexagram one is a noble without a post. The Pressure line should be still and not moving: moving with an auspicious spirit it is a blessing, moving with a baleful one it is a calamity.

note.yi: 同一段的下文还讲到占身、占婚、求财、占宅、占病、占失脱没有官鬼是什么样，那几件不是事业，没有收；求财无鬼那一句里「主在他人手下趁财」是给人做事挣钱的意思，放在求财域。这里的「功名」是求官职、求名位。
note.en: The rest of the passage says what it means to lack the Pressure line when divining for one's person, marriage, wealth, the house, illness and lost goods; those are not career matters and are not included. In the line on seeking wealth, "making money under someone else's hand" means working for another and belongs to the wealth domain. "Name and rank" here means seeking an official post and standing.

yi: 官鬼这一爻，
看不见形状，却有它的用处；
卦里不可以没有它，
宜安静，不宜发动。
带着吉神发动，
也能成为福；
加上凶煞发动，
没有不成为祸殃的。
en: As for the Pressure line,
it has no shape yet has its use;
in a hexagram it must not be missing,
and it should be still, not moving.
Moving with an auspicious spirit,
it can also be a blessing;
moving with a baleful spirit,
it never fails to be a calamity.

yi: 占求官的时候，卦里没有官鬼，
功名难以成就；
卦里纵然有贵人，
到头来也只是有贵人而没有位子。
en: In divining for office, when there is no Pressure line,
name and rank are hard to achieve;
even if the hexagram holds a Noble,
he is in the end a noble without a post.

title: 通玄妙论·绝处逢生·占官：父母绝处逢生，文书虽有阻节，终有贵人主张，其事必成

rule.yi: 求官时遇到父母爻绝处逢生（它落在日辰的绝地，又得动爻来生）：文书上虽然有阻滞卡节，终究有贵人替你做主，事情必成。
rule.en: In divining for office, if the Resource line meets life in the place of extinction (it falls where the Day extinguishes it but a moving line gives it life): though the documents meet delays and hold-ups, a noble will in the end take charge and the matter will surely succeed.

note.yi: 这一段后面接着讲占讼、出行（那两件放在官非、出行域）。「绝处逢生」的做法见第一个引文：用爻落在绝地，有动爻来生才算。
note.en: The passage goes on to lawsuits and travel, which belong to the lawsuit and travel domains. How "life in extinction" works is in the first quotation: the Subject line falls in a place of extinction and a moving line must give it life.

zh: 且如申日占卦，遇用爻属木，木见申则绝，木爻无用矣。
若得水爻发动来相生，木爻仍复有用。
譬人当困穷之际，得遇贵人扶持，必有寒谷回春之象，此乃是绝处逢生也。
yi: 比如申日占卦，用爻属木，木到申上就是绝地，这个木爻就没有用了。
如果有水爻发动来生它，木爻又有了用处。
就像人在穷困的时候，遇到贵人扶持，一定有寒谷回春的景象，这就叫绝处逢生。
en: Suppose a divination on a Shen day in which the Subject line belongs to Wood: Wood meets extinction at Shen, and the Wood line is of no use.
If a Water line moves to give it life, the Wood line is useful again.
It is like a person in hardship who meets a noble and is helped: surely there is the look of spring returning to a cold valley; this is what is meant by life from the place of extinction.

if the Resource line finds life in extinction,

a noble will in the end take charge,
the matter will surely succeed.

title: 通玄妙论·合处逢冲·占官遇官鬼文书暗冲尚有反复变动；谋事遇之必因人阻滞将成而有变

rule.yi: 合处逢冲（卦本来相合，却被日辰冲了）：求官时官鬼、文书被暗中冲着，事里还有反复和变动；谋事遇到这样，一定因为别人而受阻，眼看要成又有变。
rule.en: A clash at a place of combination (a hexagram of combination that is clashed by the Day): in divining for office, if the Pressure line and the documents are clashed in secret, the matter still has reversals and changes; in planning a matter, meeting this means being held up by someone, and just as it is about to succeed there is a change.

note.yi: 同一段还讲占婚、占财，以及占讼与病「喜遇合处逢冲」（合则事必成，逢冲灾必散），那几件放在别的问题域。「官鬼文书暗冲」是官鬼和文书（父母）这两爻被日辰暗冲，书里没有展开，译文照字面。
note.en: The same passage goes on to marriage and wealth, and says that lawsuits and illness are glad to meet a clash at a place of combination (combination means the matter surely succeeds, a clash means the calamity disperses); those go to other domains. "The Pressure line and the documents clashed in secret" means the Pressure and Resource lines are clashed by the Day without moving; the book does not expand on it and the translation follows the words.

zh: 世应相生，六爻相合，吉无不利，乃事事可成之象也。
却在子日占得，子冲应上午、害世上未，此乃合处逢冲也。
yi: 比如占到雷地豫卦。
世应相生，六爻相合，吉利没有不顺的，是事事都能成的卦象。
却是在子日占到的，子冲应爻上的午、害世爻上的未，这就是合处逢冲。
en: Suppose one gets the hexagram Thunder over Earth, Yu.
The Self and Other give each other life and the six lines combine; all is auspicious and nothing unfavourable, the sign of every matter being achievable.
But if it is got on a Zi day, Zi clashes the Wu on the Other line and harms the Wei on the Self line: this is a clash at a place of combination.

en: In divining for office, when the Pressure line and the documents are clashed in secret,

title: 通玄妙论·随官入墓·求官遇之事体难成，虽成终不能振，若入杀墓更为大凶

rule.yi: 随官入墓是身、世或本命跟着官鬼入了墓。求官遇到它，事情难成，就算成了也振作不起来；入的如果是杀墓（丁未、戊戌），就更是大凶。
rule.en: Following Pressure into the tomb means the Body, the Self or one's birth year follows the Pressure line into its tomb. In seeking office, meeting it makes the matter hard to achieve, and even if achieved one cannot rise; if it enters a killing tomb (Ding-Wei or Wu-Xu) it is greatly inauspicious.

note.yi: 这一段的例子是：丑日占得雷水解，身和鬼同在五爻是身随鬼入墓；未日占得山天大畜，世在二爻属木是世随鬼入墓；未日寅生人占得地雷复、卯生人占得火泽睽，本命在鬼爻是命随鬼入墓（这几个例子没有收）。虎易注说这里的「身」是世身，不是卦身，那是今人的注，这里不收。后面讲占身、占婚、占产、占讼、求财、出行、家宅、占病各遇此如何，放在别的问题域。
note.en: The examples in the passage are: a Chou day with Water over Thunder, Jie, where the Body and Pressure are both on the fifth line, is the Body following Pressure into the tomb; a Wei day with Mountain over Heaven, Daxu, where the Self is on the second line and is Wood, is the Self following it; a Wei day with Earth over Thunder, Fu, for someone born in Yin, or Fire over Marsh, Kui, for someone born in Mao, where the birth year falls on the Pressure line, is the birth year following it (these examples are not quoted). Hu Yi's note says the "body" here is the Self-body and not the hexagram Body; that is a modern note and is not quoted. What follows on one's person, marriage, childbirth, lawsuits, wealth, travel, the house and illness goes to other domains.

zh: 随官入墓，其目有三：有身随鬼入墓，有世随鬼入墓，有命随鬼入墓。
yi: 随官入墓有三种：有身爻跟着官鬼入墓的，有世爻跟着官鬼入墓的，有本命跟着官鬼入墓的。
en: Following Pressure into the tomb has three kinds: the Body following the Pressure line into the tomb, the Self following it, or one's birth year following it.

title: 通玄妙论·逢冲暗动·求官遇之，吉则有无心之机会，凶则阴中有人损害

rule.yi: 安静的爻被日辰冲到，叫暗动，有吉有凶。求官遇到暗动：吉的话有意想不到的机会，凶的话暗中有人损害。
rule.en: A still line clashed by the Day is said to move in secret, and it may be auspicious or inauspicious. In seeking office, meeting this: if auspicious there is a chance one did not seek; if inauspicious someone harms one in secret.

note.yi: 这一段后面接着讲占婚、占产、占讼、失脱、求财、行人、家宅、占病遇暗动各如何，放在别的问题域。
note.en: The passage goes on to marriage, childbirth, lawsuits, lost goods, wealth, travellers, the house and illness; those go to other domains.

zh: 且如六爻安静，不遇冲则不动。
暗动者，有吉有凶，各有所用，不可一概而论。
若遇凶煞暗动，伤身克世，件件皆非所宜。
吉神暗动，合世生身，事事无不为吉。
余推其义，暗者必非明也，乃阴私潜伏也。
福来而不知，祸来而未觉。
爻吉则暗中有补，爻凶则暗中有伤。
yi: 比如六爻都安静，没有遇到冲，就不会动。
如果日辰来冲它，就叫暗动。
暗动有吉有凶，各有各的用处，不能一概而论。
如果是凶煞暗动，伤到卦身、克到世爻，件件都不适宜。
吉神暗动，合着世爻、生着卦身，事事没有不吉的。
我推究它的意思：暗，一定不是明，是阴暗私下、潜伏着的。
福来了不知道，祸来了也没察觉。
爻吉，暗中有补益；爻凶，暗中有损伤。
en: Suppose the six lines are still: unless clashed they do not move.
If the Day clashes a line, it is called a secret movement.
A secret movement may be auspicious or inauspicious, each with its own use; it cannot be judged by one rule.
If a baleful spirit moves in secret, harming the Body and controlling the Self, nothing is fitting.
If an auspicious spirit moves in secret, combining with the Self and giving life to the Body, every matter is auspicious.
I infer its meaning: "in secret" is surely not "in the open"; it is hidden and private, lying in wait.
Fortune comes and one does not know; misfortune comes and one has not noticed.
If the line is auspicious there is help in secret; if it is inauspicious there is harm in secret.

title: 通玄妙论·六亲取用·官鬼与父母：官鬼克我、凶多福少，畏子孙恃妻财，宜静不宜动；父母遇财伤本体、逢鬼增光辉

rule.yi: 官鬼是克我的爻，凶的地方多、福的地方少，怕子孙、靠妻财，动起来克兄弟、生扶父母；卦里虽然凶，却不能没有它，宜静不宜动。父母是生我的爻，遇到财爻就伤到自己的根本，碰到官鬼就增添光辉。
rule.en: The Pressure line is the line that controls me: it is more often ill than a blessing; it fears Output and relies on Wealth; moving, it harms Peer and gives life and support to Resource; though it is ill in a hexagram it must not be missing, and is best still and not moving. The Resource line is the line that gives me life: meeting Wealth it harms its own substance, meeting Pressure it gains in lustre.

note.yi: 官鬼这一爻在求官里是用神，「官鬼」本来是克我的爻，所以这里讲的是它的一般性质，不是专讲求官；求官时的取用见黄金策仕宦章。官鬼一条后面接着讲占身命、占婚姻为夫，那几件不是事业，没有收。
note.en: In a divination for office the Pressure line is the Subject, but it is by nature the line that controls me, so this passage gives its general character and is not specifically about seeking office; how it is used in seeking office is in the Huangjin Ce chapter on official posts. After this the passage goes on to the reading of one's person and of marriage (Pressure as husband), which are not career matters and are not included.

yi: 克我的爻叫官鬼。
大体上是凶的地方多，
福的地方少。
它所怕的是福德（子孙），
它所依靠的是妻财。
动起来就克伤兄弟，
生助扶持父母。
然而在卦里，它虽然凶，却不可以没有，
只是宜静不宜动罢了。
en: The line that controls me is called Pressure.
On the whole it is ill in more respects,
and a blessing in fewer.
What it fears is Output;
what it relies on is Wealth.
Moving, it harms Peer
and gives life and support to Resource.
Yet though it is ill in a hexagram it must not be missing,
only it should be still and not moving.

yi: 生我的爻叫父母。
它能成凶，
也能成吉，
各有各的用处。
遇到财爻，就会伤到它自己的根本；
碰到官鬼，就增添光辉。
en: The line that gives me life is called Resource.
It can be ill,
and it can be auspicious,
each with its own use.
Meeting Wealth, it harms its own substance;
meeting Pressure, it gains in lustre.

title: 断易总论·公用以官鬼为尊：父母辅佐官鬼、子孙辅佐妻财；私用妻财为主、公用官鬼为尊，最忌动摇大宜安静；兴讼求名须凭官鬼

rule.yi: 父母帮着官鬼，子孙帮着妻财；私事用妻财做主，公事用官鬼为尊，官鬼最怕乱动、最适宜安静。要打官司、求功名，必须凭官鬼。
rule.en: Resource assists Pressure, and Output assists Wealth. For private matters Wealth is the chief; for public matters Pressure is the honoured one, which above all fears moving about and is best still. To start a suit or to seek fame one must depend on Pressure.

note.yi: 「公用」「私用」是公事、私事：求官、官司是公事，取官鬼；求财、买卖是私事，取妻财。「兴讼求名」和上一句「散官治病，全赖子孙」是一对，那一句讲疾病，放在疾病域（LY.ILL.BSQS.22）。
note.en: "Public use" and "private use" mean public and private matters: seeking office and lawsuits are public and take Pressure; seeking wealth and trade are private and take Wealth. "Start a suit or seek fame" is paired with the previous line, "to disperse official matters and cure illness rely wholly on Output", which is about illness and is in the illness domain (LY.ILL.BSQS.22).

yi: 父母爻辅佐官鬼，
子孙爻辅佐妻财。
父母和官鬼同气相求，
子孙和妻财同声相应。
私事用妻财做主，
公事用官鬼为尊。
最怕乱动，
最适宜安静。
en: Resource assists Pressure,
Output assists Wealth.
Resource and Pressure seek each other as of one breath,
Output and Wealth answer each other as of one voice.
For private matters Wealth is the chief,
for public matters Pressure is the honoured one.
What is most feared is its moving about;
what suits it best is stillness.

yi: 要打官司、求功名，
必须凭官鬼。
en: To start a suit or seek fame,
one must depend on Pressure.

title: 断易总论·财官若遇生扶谋望并无阻滞；用官忌子孙持世；子孙兴发求官应举枉劳心

rule.yi: 求官时，财爻、官鬼如果得到生扶，谋划的事没有阻滞；卦身和世爻没有救助，做的事一定彼此背离。用官鬼做用神的，忌子孙持世；子孙兴旺发动，求官、应举都是白费心。
rule.en: In seeking office, if Wealth and Pressure are given life and support, plans meet no obstruction; if the Body and the Self have no rescue or help, what one does will surely run to discord. When Pressure is the Subject, Output holding the Self is feared; if Output flourishes and moves, seeking office or taking the examinations is a waste of effort.

note.yi: 「财官若遇生扶」里的财是妻财、官是官鬼（原文写作「财官」）；「参商」是参星和商星，此出彼没，比喻彼此背离。同一行里「兄弟动摇，买婢求财空费力」是求财，放在求财域。「应举」是考试，这一条同时属考试域。「用官忌子孙持世」是说官鬼做用神时怕子孙持世，因为子孙克官鬼。
note.en: "Wealth and Pressure" are the Wealth and Pressure lines (the text writes them as "wealth-official"); "Shen and Shang" are two stars that never appear together, a figure for people at odds. In the same line, "if Peer moves, buying a maid or seeking wealth is wasted effort" concerns seeking wealth and is in the wealth domain. "Taking the examinations" is also an examination matter, so this entry belongs to the examination domain as well. "When Pressure is the Subject, Output holding the Self is feared" is because Output controls Pressure.

yi: 用官鬼做用神的，忌子孙持世；
求财的，忌兄弟临身。
en: When Pressure is the Subject, Output holding the Self is feared;
in seeking wealth, Peer on the Body is feared.

yi: 财爻、官鬼如果得到生扶，
谋划和指望的事没有阻滞。
卦身和世爻如果没有救助，
所做的事一定彼此背离、合不到一起。
en: If Wealth and Pressure are given life and support,
plans and hopes meet no obstruction.
If the Body and the Self have no rescue or help,
what one does will surely run to discord and not come together.

yi: 子孙兴旺发动，
求官、应举都是白费心思。
en: If Output flourishes and moves,
seeking office or taking the examinations is a waste of effort.

title: 断易总论·伏神：用官宜伏父母，官伏子孙用官必无成就，用官伏兄怕阻隔之挠

rule.yi: 用官鬼做用神，最好它伏在父母爻下；官鬼伏在子孙爻下，就一定没有成就；伏在兄弟爻下，怕有阻隔的阻挠。用父母做用神伏在妻财下都是祸患。
rule.en: When Pressure is the Subject, it does best hidden under Resource; hidden under Output, it will have no accomplishment; hidden under Peer, one fears the hindrance of obstruction. When Resource is the Subject, hidden under Wealth is all trouble.

note.yi: 伏神是卦里没有出现的六亲，伏在本宫首卦的某一爻（飞神）下面；飞神生伏神为得长生，所以官伏在父母下是「宜」（父母生官鬼），伏在子孙下是克（子孙克官鬼）。「用官」是拿官鬼当用神。这一段里用财的几句是求财，同在这里是因为它们和用官的句子连着，没有拆开。
note.en: A hidden line is a relation that does not appear in the hexagram and lies under some line (the flying line) of the home palace's first hexagram; when the flying line gives life to the hidden line it is well placed, so Pressure hidden under Resource is "fitting" (Resource gives life to Pressure) while hidden under Output is controlled (Output controls Pressure). "Using the official" means taking Pressure as the Subject. The lines on wealth in this passage are about seeking wealth and are kept here because they run on from the lines on Pressure and are not separated.

yi: 用官鬼做用神，宜它伏在父母爻下；
用妻财做用神，宜它伏在子孙爻下。
官鬼伏在子孙爻下，
用官鬼做用神就一定没有成就。
妻财伏在父母爻下，
用妻财做用神就要损伤一半。
用妻财做用神而伏在官鬼爻下，
怕有侵吞藏匿的搅扰。
用官鬼做用神而伏在兄弟爻下，
怕有阻隔的阻挠。
用父母做用神而伏在妻财爻下，都是祸患；
用妻财做用神而伏在兄弟爻下，总不合用。
en: When Pressure is the Subject it does well hidden under Resource;
when Wealth is the Subject it does well hidden under Output.
Pressure hidden under Output
means that when Pressure is the Subject there will be no accomplishment.
Wealth hidden under Resource
means that when Wealth is the Subject half is lost and harmed.
When Wealth is the Subject and is hidden under Pressure,
one fears the trouble of embezzlement and concealment.
When Pressure is the Subject and is hidden under Peer,
one fears the hindrance of obstruction.
When Resource is the Subject and is hidden under Wealth, it is all trouble;
when Wealth is the Subject and is hidden under Peer, it is never of use.

title: 断易总论·月建临于用爻，求官必定迁高职

rule.yi: 月建落在用爻上，求官一定升到高的职位。
rule.en: When the Month falls on the Subject line, one seeking office will surely be promoted to a high post.

note.yi: 「用爻」就是用神，求官时是官鬼；月建临它就是官鬼临月建（旺而有力）。「迁高职」是升到更高的职位。这一行的下一句「月破临于用爻，作事无成病不痊」放在疾病域（LY.ILL.BSQS.22）。仕宦章里「官鬼临月建」的说法见 LY.CAREER.HJC 各条和阐奥歌章。
note.en: The "Subject line" is the Subject, which in seeking office is the Pressure line; the Month falling on it means Pressure standing on the Month, strong and powerful. "Promoted to a high post" means rising to a higher office. The next line, "if the Month-break falls on the Subject line, nothing done comes to completion and illness is not cured", is in the illness domain (LY.ILL.BSQS.22).

yi: 月建落在用爻上，
求官一定升到高的职位。
en: When the Month falls on the Subject line,
one seeking office will surely be promoted to a high post.

title: 断易通玄赋·禄马最为良（旧注：有禄马爻临世应，求官可进，名利俱成）

rule.yi: 有禄、有马的爻落在世爻或应爻上，求官可以进，名和利都能成。禄是日干的禄所在的地支（甲禄在寅、乙禄在卯），马是日支三合的驿马所在的地支（申子辰马在寅）。
rule.en: When a line that is the Emolument or the Horse stands on the Self or Other line, one seeking office can advance and both name and profit are achieved. The Emolument is the branch where the day-stem has its Emolument (Jia at Yin, Yi at Mao); the Horse is the branch of the Post Horse of the day's three-harmony group (Shen-Zi-Chen has its horse at Yin).

note.yi: 「禄」是天元禄（日干在哪个地支有禄），「马」是驿马（三合局的第一位的冲位：申子辰马居寅）。书里说禄马全篇歌诀见后面的神杀章，就是卜筮大全末尾的神煞歌例（见 LY.CAREER.BSQS 神煞各条）。旧注只说求官，这两个神煞的一般用法见神煞歌例。「看六爻卦还是要以用神为主」是虎易评注，不收。
note.en: The "Emolument" is the Heavenly Emolument (the branch where the day-stem has its Emolument) and the "Horse" is the Post Horse (the branch that clashes the first of the three-harmony group: Shen-Zi-Chen has its horse at Yin). The book says the full verses on the Emolument and Horse are in the later chapter on spirit-stars, which is the Spirit-Star Verses at the end of the Bushi Daquan (see the spirit-star entries in this chapter). The old note speaks only of seeking office. The remark that the reading should still rest on the Subject is Hu Yi's commentary and is not quoted.

yi: 禄和马最好。
en: The Emolument and the Horse are the best.

zh: 假如甲日有寅爻，则是禄也。
申子辰日有寅爻，则是马也。
若有此爻临世应，求官可进，名利俱成。
yi: 比如甲日，卦里有寅爻，这就是禄。
就是说甲的禄在寅，乙的禄在卯。
申子辰日，卦里有寅爻，这就是马。
就是说申子辰的马在寅。
如果有这样的爻临在世爻或应爻上，求官可以进，名和利都成。
en: For example, on a Jia day a Yin line is the Emolument.
That is, Jia has its Emolument at Yin and Yi at Mao.
On a Shen, Zi or Chen day a Yin line is the Horse.
That is, the horse of Shen-Zi-Chen is at Yin.
If such a line stands on the Self or Other line, one seeking office can advance, and both name and profit are achieved.

title: 断易通玄赋·父母爻兴旺，为官至侯王（旧注：印旺主大贵）

rule.yi: 父母爻兴旺，做官能做到侯王；旧注说，印（父母）旺，主有大贵。
rule.en: If the Resource line flourishes, one who holds office rises to marquis or prince; the old note says that when the Seal (Resource) is strong, great nobility is indicated.

note.yi: 「印」是印绶，也就是父母爻（文书、印信），官印旺就是父母旺。同一联前半「占宅青龙旺，豪富冠一乡」是占宅，放在家宅。后面的虎易评注说这两句旧注太简略，那是今人的话，不收。
note.en: The "Seal" is the seal of office, that is, the Resource line (documents and seals); a strong seal means a strong Resource line. The first half of the couplet, "in divining the house, a strong Azure Dragon makes one rich above all in the village", is about the house and goes to the house domain. The later remark by Hu Yi that these notes are too brief is modern commentary and is not quoted.

zh: 父母爻兴旺，为官至侯王。
yi: 父母爻兴旺，做官能做到侯王。
en: If the Resource line flourishes, one who holds office rises to marquis or prince.

hits.text: 父母爻兴旺，为官至侯王
父母爻兴旺，为官至侯王
父母爻兴旺，为官至侯王

yi: 印旺，主有大贵。
en: When the Seal is strong, great nobility is indicated.

title: 占进职升官：先看父母发动，其次看官鬼；父鬼旺相才有份，兄财子动是空欢喜

rule.yi: 占进职、升官，先看父母爻发动，其次看官鬼；父母和官鬼旺相兴盛，这事才有你的份；兄弟、妻财、子孙发动，只是白欢喜一场。
rule.en: To divine advance in post or promotion in rank, look first for Resource moving and then at Pressure; where Resource and Pressure are strong and flourishing there is a share for you, and where Peer, Wealth or Output moves the joy is in vain.

yi: 凡是占进职、升官，
先看父母发动，官鬼排在其次；
父母、官鬼旺相兴盛，才有你的份；
兄弟、妻财、子孙发动，只是白欢喜。
en: In divining advance in post or promotion in rank,
look first at Resource moving, with Pressure next;
when Resource and Pressure are strong and flourishing there must be a share for you;
if Peer, Wealth or Output moves, the joy is for nothing.

title: 求官而官鬼落在初爻（吏位）来克世身：主将来是廉察慈惠的贤官

rule.yi: 求官时，初爻代表吏；官鬼落在初爻、来克世身，说明这人将来是廉明、慈惠、贤明的官员。
rule.en: In seeking office the first line stands for the clerk; Pressure on the first line, coming to control the self, marks one who will be an upright, merciful and discerning official.

yi: 求官时，官鬼落在吏位（初爻）来克身，是贤官之象；
en: In seeking office, Pressure on the clerk line (the first) and controlling the self is the sign of a worthy official;

zh: 初爻是吏，若鬼临初爻，来克本身，却主为廉察慈惠贤明官员也。
yi: 初爻是吏，若官鬼落在初爻、来克本人，就主他是廉察、慈惠、贤明的官员。
en: The first line is the clerk; if Pressure falls on the first line and comes to control the man himself, it marks an official who is upright, kind and wise.

title: 驿马扶身或临官位，官职必迁；世应与驿马相合，求官大利

rule.yi: 驿马去扶助世身，或者落在官位上，一定升迁；世、应和驿马相合，求官大吉大利。
rule.en: The Post Horse supporting the self, or standing on the seat of office, means promotion for sure; Self and Other combining with the Post Horse is greatly favourable for seeking office.

yi: 驿马前来扶助，官职就会迁动。
en: With the Post Horse lending support, the post is moved up.

zh: 若驿马扶身，或临官位，定主升迁也。
yi: 若是驿马扶助世身，或者落在官位上，一定主升迁。
en: If the Post Horse supports the self, or stands on the seat of office, it surely means promotion.

yi: 世、应和驿马相合，是吉；
en: Self and Other combining with the Post Horse is auspicious;

zh: 世应与驿马合，求官大利也。
yi: 世、应与驿马相合，求官大有利。
en: Self and Other combining with the Post Horse is greatly favourable for seeking office.

title: 坎离二卦宜冬三月，震巽二卦应在申酉年（官星旺）

rule.yi: 占得坎、离二卦，宜在冬季三个月（坎阳离阴，水火相济）；占得震、巽二卦，应在申、酉年——震、巽属木，得申、酉的金作官，官星旺。
rule.en: With the two trigrams Kan and Li, the three winter months suit (Kan is yang and Li is yin, water and fire balancing each other); with Zhen and Xun, look to the years of Shen and You, for Zhen and Xun are Wood and the Metal of Shen and You gives them a strong official.

note.yi: 原文只说「坎离二卦」「震巽」，没说是整个卦、内卦还是外卦；旧注也只解释了为什么是冬天、为什么是申酉年，没有解释这一点，本库不替它补。
note.en: The verse says only 'the two trigrams Kan and Li' and 'Zhen and Xun', without saying whether the whole hexagram, the inner trigram or the outer one is meant; the note explains why winter and why the years Shen and You but not this, and it is not supplied here.

yi: 坎、离二卦，宜在冬天三个月；
en: the two trigrams Kan and Li: the three months of winter;

zh: 坎阳离阴，水火既济，宜于冬三月也。
yi: 坎是阳、离是阴，水火相济，所以宜在冬天三个月。
en: Kan is yang and Li is yin, water and fire balance each other, so the three winter months suit.

yi: 震、巽二卦，明白知道应在申、酉年。
en: Zhen and Xun: know plainly that it falls in the years of Shen and You.

zh: 震巽木，得申酉金，官旺也。
yi: 震、巽属木，得到申、酉的金，官星就旺。
en: Zhen and Xun are Wood; getting the Metal of Shen and You, the official is strong.

title: 坎、咸、复三卦，求官主心中狐疑不定

rule.yi: 占得坎、咸、复这三个卦，求官的人心里疑惑、犹豫不决。
rule.en: With the hexagrams Kan, Xian or Fu, the seeker of office is left in doubt and hesitation.

yi: 坎、咸、复这三卦，一定是狐疑不决。
en: Kan, Xian and Fu: it is settled that there is doubt and hesitation.

yi: 这三个卦主心中疑惑。
en: These three hexagrams point to doubt in the mind.

title: 申酉辰戌持世为吉；当官遇禄好施为（申酉持世兼得禄最吉）

rule.yi: 申、酉、辰、戌的爻持世是吉；做官又遇上禄，正好施展；其中申、酉持世又得禄，最吉。
rule.en: The branches Shen, You, Chen and Xu holding the Self are auspicious; taking office and meeting the Emolument gives room to act; Shen or You holding the Self and getting the Emolument is the most auspicious.

yi: 申、酉、辰、戌持世是吉，
做官又遇到禄，好施展作为。
en: Shen, You, Chen and Xu holding the Self is auspicious;
taking office and meeting the Emolument, there is room to act well.

zh: 申酉持世及得禄，最吉也。
yi: 申、酉持世，再得到禄，最吉。
en: Shen or You holding the Self and also getting the Emolument is the most auspicious.

title: 官鬼临身世、卦爻旺相才是得官的真兆；驿马空亡徒费力，卦遭胎没枉劳神

rule.yi: 官鬼落在卦身或世爻上、卦里各爻旺相，才是真的得官，可喜；驿马落空亡，白费力气；卦遇胎、没，白白劳神。
rule.en: Pressure standing on the Body or the Self, with the lines of the hexagram thriving, is the true sign of getting the office and is cause for joy; the Post Horse Void means effort spent for nothing; a hexagram meeting Embryo or Sunk means wearying the mind in vain.

note.yi: 胎、没是八卦随节气轮转的八个状态（旺、相、胎、没、死、囚、休、废）里的两个，这里的旧注只举了立春后的一例。大易断例卜筮元龟目说「胎没二卦，春巽离，夏坤兑，秋乾坎，冬艮震」，春天是巽、离，和旧注的例子相合。
note.en: Embryo and Sunk are two of the eight states through which the trigrams turn with the solar terms (thriving, mutual, embryo, sunk, dead, trapped, resting, abandoned); the note here gives only one example, after the Beginning of Spring. The Dayi Duanli says 'the two trigrams of embryo and sunk: in spring Xun and Li, in summer Kun and Dui, in autumn Qian and Kan, in winter Gen and Zhen', which agrees with the note's example for spring.

yi: 官鬼落在身、世上，得到官才是真的；
卦里的爻旺相，是欢喜的事。
驿马空亡，白费力气；
卦遇胎、没，白白劳神。
en: Pressure on the Body or the Self, and the office is truly gained;
the lines of the hexagram strong and thriving, there is cause for joy.
the Post Horse Void, effort is spent for nothing;
the hexagram meeting Embryo or Sunk, the mind is wearied in vain.

zh: 立春后巽胎离没，若得家人卦之类是也。
yi: 若是卦遇到胎、没，必定白白劳神。
立春之后，巽是胎、离是没，如果得到家人卦这一类，就是这种情形。
en: If the hexagram meets Embryo or Sunk, it surely means wearing the mind in vain.
After the Beginning of Spring, Xun is Embryo and Li is Sunk; getting a hexagram such as Jiaren is a case of it.

title: 旺爻克应不良，应入墓忧死亡；世爻受克遭贬谪，世克他爻倍俸粮

rule.yi: 旺相的爻去克应，不好；应入墓的时候，要担心有人死亡；世爻被克，遭贬谪、责罚；世爻去克别的爻，俸禄加倍。
rule.en: A strong line controlling the Other is not good; when the Other enters its tomb, beware of death; the Self being controlled brings demotion and banishment, and the Self controlling another line doubles one's pay.

note.yi: 原文没有说在求官里「应」代表谁（上司、君、还是对方），旧注也只解释了后两句；本库照字面译，不补主语。
note.en: The text does not say whom the Other stands for in seeking office (a superior, the sovereign, or the other party), and the note explains only the last two lines; it is translated literally and no subject is supplied.

yi: 旺相的爻克应，是不好的；
应入墓的时候，要担心死亡；
世爻被克，会遭贬谪；
如果世爻去克别的爻，俸禄加倍。
en: A strong line controlling the Other is not good;
when the Other enters its tomb, worry about death;
the Self line being controlled, one is demoted and exiled;
if the Self controls another line, the salary is doubled.

zh: 世受克，遭贬罚，世克他爻，主倍得俸粮。
yi: 世爻受克，遭贬谪责罚；世爻克他爻，主俸禄加倍。
en: The Self being controlled brings demotion and punishment; the Self controlling another line means the salary is doubled.

title: 初爻（人吏）空亡难立脚；内外卦纯阴名不扬

rule.yi: 初爻是人吏，落空亡，即使做官清正，吏员没力量，谁替他奉行，所以难以立足；内外卦全是阴，阴柔立不起来，怎么振作？所以名声不扬。
rule.en: The first line is the clerk; if it falls Void, even an upright official has clerks without strength to carry out his orders, like a tree without branches, and it is hard to stand firm; if the inner and outer trigrams are both wholly yin, the soft cannot stand up and the name is not spread abroad.

yi: 吏爻落空亡，难以立足；
en: the clerk line Void, it is hard to find a footing;

zh: 初为人吏爻，若值空亡，纵使为官清正，吏人无气，谁与奉行？
yi: 初爻是人吏爻，若落空亡，即使为官清正，吏员没有力量，谁来替他奉行？
好比树没有枝，所以难以立足。
en: The first line is the clerk line; if it falls Void, even if the official is upright and clean, the clerks have no strength, and who will carry out his orders?
It is like a tree without branches, so it is hard to stand.

yi: 内外卦都是纯阴，名声不扬。
en: Inner and outer wholly yin, the name is not made known.

zh: 阴柔不立之象，若内外卦俱阴，安能振作？
yi: 阴柔立不起来的象，如果内外卦都是阴，怎么能振作？
所以名声不扬。
en: A sign of softness that cannot stand: if the inner and outer trigrams are both yin, how can one rouse oneself?
Hence the name is not spread abroad.

title: 子孙克鬼无官禄、福德动反不昌、子孙持世必隳官：子孙发动是求官大忌

rule.yi: 子孙爻克伤官鬼，就没有官禄；福德（子孙）爻发动，反而不昌盛；子孙持世、子孙发动，是求官的大忌，一定落到毁官的地步。
rule.en: Output controlling Pressure leaves no official emolument; with the Output line stirring there is on the contrary no flourishing; Output holding the Self, or moving, is the great taboo in seeking office and surely ruins the post.

yi: 子孙爻克官鬼，就没有官禄；
福德爻发动，反而不昌盛。
en: Output controlling Pressure, there is no official emolument;
with the Output line stirring, on the contrary there is no flourishing.

zh: 子动克伤官鬼，故不昌也。
yi: 子孙发动，克伤官鬼，所以不昌盛。
en: Output moving damages Pressure, so there is no flourishing.

yi: 子孙持世，一定毁掉官职。
en: Output holding the Self surely wrecks the post.

zh: 子动，乃求官大忌，必至隳坏也。
yi: 子孙发动，是求官的大忌，一定到毁坏的地步。
en: Output moving is the great taboo in seeking office, and it will surely come to ruin.

title: 卦克世身则职位不安；身克人吏则吏皆退避、百忧聚集

rule.yi: 卦（宫）所属的五行去克世爻和身位，职位不得安稳；身、世去克初爻（人吏），吏员都躲避退让，各样事业都有忧患聚集的征兆。
rule.en: If the element the hexagram belongs to controls the Self line and the Body place, the post cannot be held in peace; if Body and Self control the first line, the clerk, all the clerks draw back, and anxieties gather over every undertaking.

yi: 卦克世、身，职位不安；
en: the hexagram controlling the Self and the Body, the post is not secure;

zh: 若卦身所属，克世爻并身位，定主不能安职。
如乾宫遁卦，本属金，遇世属火是也。
yi: 若是卦身所属的五行，克了世爻和身的位置，一定主不能安于职位。
比如乾宫的遁卦，本来属金，遇到世爻属火，就是这样。
en: If the element the Body of the hexagram belongs to controls the Self line and the place of the Body, it surely means one cannot rest secure in the post.
For example the hexagram Dun in the palace of Qian belongs to Metal, and meeting a Self line that is Fire is such a case.

yi: 身去克人吏，百样忧愁聚到一起。
en: the Body controlling the clerk, a hundred anxieties gather together.

zh: 太刚则折，若身世克初人吏爻，定主吏皆退避。
凡百事业，主有忧攒之兆。
yi: 太刚就会折断，如果身、世去克初爻的人吏爻，一定主吏员都退避。
各样事业，都主有忧患聚集的兆头。
en: What is too hard breaks; if Body and Self control the first line, the clerk line, it surely means all the clerks draw back.
In all undertakings it gives a sign of anxieties gathering.

title: 白虎动时惊恐至

rule.yi: 白虎爻旺相发动，惊恐的事马上就到。
rule.en: With the White Tiger line strong and moving, fright and alarm arrive at once.

yi: 白虎发动的时候，惊恐就来了；
en: When the White Tiger moves, fright and alarm come;

zh: 若白虎旺动，惊恐立至也。
yi: 如果白虎旺相发动，惊恐立刻就到。
en: If the White Tiger is strong and moving, fright and alarm come at once.

title: 问文官武职，求官必须用唐符、国印：按太岁年支取——寅申年巳亥、巳亥年寅申、子午年卯酉、卯酉年子午、辰戌年丑未、丑未年辰戌

rule.yi: 不论文官武职，求官都要看唐符、国印。按年支取：寅、申年，巳是唐符、亥是国印（旧注）；巳、亥年取寅、申；子、午年取卯、酉；卯、酉年取子、午；辰、戌年取丑、未；丑、未年取辰、戌。旧注说「以下类推」，这里按此读成每一对里前一支是唐符、后一支是国印。
rule.en: Whether it is a civil or a military post, in seeking office one must look to Tangfu and the State Seal. By the year branch: in the years Yin and Shen, Si is the Tangfu and Hai the State Seal (the note); in Si and Hai years take Yin and Shen; in Zi and Wu years, Mao and You; in Mao and You years, Zi and Wu; in Chen and Xu years, Chou and Wei; in Chou and Wei years, Chen and Xu. The note says the rest follow by analogy, which is read here as the first branch of each pair being the Tangfu and the second the State Seal.

yi: 若是问文官和武职，
唐符、国印是求得确实答案的地方。
en: If the question is a civil post or a military one,
Tangfu and the State Seal are where the sure answer is found.

zh: 唐符国印，求官必须用之。
yi: 唐符、国印，求官必须用上。
en: Tangfu and the State Seal: in seeking office they must be used.

yi: 寅、申年，取巳、亥。
en: In the years Yin and Shen, it is Si and Hai;

zh: 寅申之年，巳为唐符，亥为国印，以下类推。
yi: 寅、申年，巳是唐符，亥是国印，以下依此类推。
en: In the years Yin and Shen, Si is the Tangfu and Hai the State Seal; the rest follow by analogy.

yi: 巳、亥年，到寅、申里找。
子、午年，到卯、酉里求；
卯、酉年，子、午出现。
辰、戌年，在丑、未的方位；
丑、未年，在辰、戌。
en: In the years Si and Hai, look among Yin and Shen.
In the years Zi and Wu, seek among Mao and You;
in the years Mao and You, Zi and Wu appear.
In the years Chen and Xu, it is in the place of Chou and Wei;
in the years Chou and Wei, it is in Chen and Xu.

title: 官鬼临唐符国印最佳，可作朝中辅翼；符印二爻发动，诏书立至；宜静而动必升迁，宜动而静多掩抑

rule.yi: 官鬼落在唐符、国印上最好，日后可在朝中做辅佐；唐符、国印这两爻在上卦发动，一定符印到手，不久随诏书起用；「宜静而动必升迁，宜动而静多掩抑」。
rule.en: Pressure standing on the Tangfu or the State Seal is the best, one who will serve as a support at court; when these two lines move in the upper trigram the tally and seal are surely in hand and one will soon be raised by imperial edict; 'what should be still but moves will surely rise; what should move but stays still is mostly held down'.

note.yi: 「宜静而动」「宜动而静」没有交代是哪一爻，旧注也没有解释，本库不替它补主语。「就多符印两爻权」的「就多」疑是「就中」之误（断易天机的同一句作「就中苻印两爻推」），这里按旧注的解释读成「再用符、印两爻推」。
note.en: 'What should be still but moves' and 'what should move but stays still' do not say which line, and the note does not explain, so no subject is supplied here. The 'jiu duo' of 'jiu duo fu yin liang yao quan' looks like a slip for 'jiu zhong' (the same line in the Duanyi Tianji reads 'from among these, reckon the two lines tally and seal'), and it is read here as 'reckon from the two lines tally and seal', following the note.

yi: 官鬼落在唐符、国印上，最好，
可以在朝中做辅佐。
该静的偏动，必定升迁；
该动的偏静，多半被压住。
en: Pressure standing on the Tangfu or the State Seal is the best,
one who will serve as a support at court.
What should be still but moves will surely rise in post;
what should move but stays still is mostly held down.

yi: 再看唐符、国印两爻来推。
en: Then reckon from the two lines, Tangfu and State Seal.

zh: 更以唐符国印二爻推之，若果上卦发动，定主符印入手。
yi: 再用唐符、国印两爻来推：如果上卦里发动，一定是符、印到手。
符、印这两爻关系重大，所以再说一遍。
en: Reckon further from the two lines, Tangfu and State Seal: if they move in the upper trigram, the tally and seal will surely come into one's hand.
These two lines carry great weight, so they are mentioned again.

yi: 早晚会随着诏书起用。
en: Sooner or later one will be raised on the strength of an imperial edict.

yi: 符、印既然发动，诏书立刻就到。
en: Once the tally and seal move, the edict arrives at once.

title: 巽动指东与南，乾位交重出西北（任所方位；原文未说由哪一爻动）

rule.yi: 巽象发动时，方位在东和南；乾位上有动爻，出在西北。
rule.en: With Xun stirring the direction is east and south; with moving lines in the Qian place it goes out to the northwest.

note.yi: 旧注对这两句没有解释：没说是官鬼落在巽、乾，还是别的爻动，也没说指任所、出行还是别的。这里只照字面译方位，不补。
note.en: The note gives no explanation of these two lines: it does not say whether it is Pressure falling in Xun or Qian or some other line moving, nor whether it means the post, travel or something else. Only the directions are translated literally and nothing is added.

yi: 巽象发动的时候，是东方和南方；
乾位上有动爻，出在西北。
en: When the Xun image stirs, it is the east and the south;
with moving lines in the Qian place, it goes out to the northwest.

title: 君臣世应上下交：世为君、应为臣，上为君、下为臣，上下相生则君臣相得；世应相生而奉命训练出行，往则必建功

rule.yi: 世是君、应是臣，上卦是君、下卦是臣；如果上下相生，君臣唱和，满堂和气；卦中世、应相生，又有奉命去训练士卒的差事，去了必定建功。
rule.en: The Self is the lord and the Other the minister, the upper trigram the lord and the lower the minister; if upper and lower generate each other, lord and ministers answer one another in song and the whole hall is in warm accord; when Self and Other generate each other and there is an order to go and drill troops, going will surely win merit.

yi: 君臣、世应、上下相交，
en: Lord and minister, Self and Other, upper and lower, meeting each other,

zh: 世为君、应为臣，上为君、下为臣。
若上下相生，主君臣赓歌，嘘沸一堂也。
yi: 世是君、应是臣，上面是君、下面是臣。
如果上下相生，主君臣相互唱和，满堂和气融融。
en: The Self is the lord and the Other the minister; the upper is the lord and the lower the minister.
If upper and lower generate each other, it means lord and ministers answer each other in song and the whole hall is in a warm stir.

yi: 训练的差事适宜前往，可以兴起功绩。
en: for a training mission it is fitting to go, and merit will arise.

zh: 遇卦中世应相生，有命训练之行，往之，必建功也。
yi: 练，就是训练士卒。
遇到卦中世、应相生，有奉命训练的差事，前往就一定建功。
en: 'Lian' means drilling the soldiers.
When Self and Other generate each other in the hexagram and there is an order to go and drill troops, going there will surely win merit.

title: 卦内作何官：火为文章喉舌（翰苑）、土为守令、水为江滨巡守、金带兵刑生杀权、木主工科建创；官爵大小随动爻衰旺

rule.yi: 要知道卦里是做什么官，先仔细看身：火是文章、喉舌之位（翰林一类）；土是守、令（修治城垒）；水是江边巡守的职事；金带兵、刑和生杀之权；木主工科，管建造创设；官爵大小都随动爻的休囚旺相来说。
rule.en: To know what office the hexagram holds, first look carefully at the Body: Fire is the place of letters and of the throat and tongue of the court (an office of the Hanlin kind); Earth is the prefect or magistrate (repairing city walls); Water is a patrol-and-guard post along rivers and shores; Metal carries soldiers, punishments and the power of life and death; Wood governs the works section, in charge of building and founding; and the rank, high or low, follows whether the moving line is thriving or weak.

yi: 要知道卦里做什么官，
先到「身」里仔细看；
火是文章、喉舌的位置，
en: To know what office the hexagram holds,
first look carefully into the Body;
Fire is the place of letters and of the throat and tongue,

zh: 火乃文明之象，故主翰苑之官。
yi: 火是文明的象，所以主翰林院的官。
en: Fire is the image of civilization and brightness, so it stands for an office of the Hanlin Academy.

yi: 土是守、令，渐渐在那里盘桓。
en: Earth is the prefect and the magistrate, who little by little tarries there.

yi: 盘桓，就是修治城垒。
土爻持世，所以应这个职务。）
en: 'Panhuan' means repairing and building city walls and ramparts.
With an Earth line holding the Self, it answers to this post.)

yi: 水是江边巡守的职事，
金带着兵、刑和生杀的权力，
木主工科，管建造创设，
官职大小，都随爻的衰旺来说。
en: Water is the post of patrol and guard along the rivers and shores,
Metal carries the soldiers, the punishments and the power of life and death,
Wood governs the works section, in charge of building and founding,
and whether the post is large or small is said by the weakness or strength of the line.

zh: 随动爻之休囚旺相，而定其官爵之尊卑也。
yi: 随动爻的休囚旺相，来定官爵的尊卑。
en: The rank, high or low, is fixed by whether the moving line is at rest, trapped, strong or thriving.

title: 喜神驿马临官鬼：荐举的文书一封接一封，知己多

rule.yi: 喜神、驿马落在官鬼上，荐举的文书一封接一封，知己很多。
rule.en: With the Joy spirit and the Post Horse on Pressure, recommending letters come one after another and those who know you are many.

yi: 喜神、驿马落在官鬼上，
荐举的文书一封又一封，有知己。
en: The Joy spirit and the Post Horse on Pressure,
recommending letters follow one another, and there are those who know you.

zh: 因有喜神驿马临于官鬼，故美削重重，得知己之多也。
yi: 美削，就是用纸笺举荐。
因为有喜神、驿马落在官鬼上，所以举荐的文书一封接一封，得到的知己多。
en: 'Meixiao' means recommending by letters on paper.
Because the Joy spirit and the Post Horse are on Pressure, the letters of recommendation come one after another and the friends who know you are many.

title: 卦无太岁只升迁，太岁与世爻、身位相合则入朝见天子

rule.yi: 太岁上卦，主入朝；卦里没有太岁，只能迁调；太岁与世爻合、与身位合，主入朝觐见天子。
rule.en: With Tai Sui in the hexagram there is entry to court; without Tai Sui one can only be moved or promoted; Tai Sui combining with the Self line and with the Body place means going into court and seeing the Son of Heaven.

yi: 卦里没有太岁，只能升迁；
en: With no Tai Sui in the hexagram, only promotion;

zh: 太岁上卦，则主入朝，若无，但能迁改。
yi: 太岁上卦，就主入朝；如果没有，只能迁调改任。
en: With Tai Sui in the hexagram it means entering court; without it, one can only be transferred or moved.

yi: 太岁相合的时候，能见天子。
en: when Tai Sui combines, one sees the Son of Heaven.

zh: 太岁若与世爻合，身位合，主入朝而见天子也。
yi: 太岁如果与世爻相合、与身位相合，主入朝而见到天子。
en: If Tai Sui combines with the Self line and with the place of the Body, it means entering court and seeing the Son of Heaven.

title: 再得雷火杀重重（逢动）：大吉，名位将至王公；雷火杀有两种起法，旧注并存

rule.yi: 卦里再得雷火杀、重重叠叠，又逢发动，是大吉的征兆，眼看名位将到王公。旧注给了雷火杀的起法，但前后有两种说法并存。
rule.en: If the hexagram further gets the Thunder-Fire baleful spirit, layer upon layer, and it moves, it is a sign of great fortune, and soon rank and position reach prince and duke. The note gives the method for finding the Thunder-Fire spirit, but two accounts of it stand side by side.

note.yi: 旧注里同时给了两套雷火杀的起法：第一句按「寅、亥、申、巳」四孟轮转一周；第三句又说「正月起寅，二月丑，逆数十二位」。两套到二月就对不上（一个是亥，一个是丑）。「即时冲破为天后」一句也没有解释。本库照录，不裁定。
note.en: The note gives two accounts of how to find the Thunder-Fire spirit side by side: the first sentence runs through the four Meng branches Yin, Hai, Shen and Si in one circuit, while the third says 'begin at Yin in the first month, Chou in the second, counting backwards through the twelve places'. The two part company already at the second month (Hai in one, Chou in the other), and the sentence 'once clashed and broken it becomes Tianhou' is not explained. It is recorded as it stands and not adjudicated.

yi: 再得到雷火杀，重重叠叠，
en: And if one further gets the Thunder-Fire baleful spirit, layer upon layer,

zh: 雷火寅猪申巳求，四孟从之遍一周。
即时冲破为天后，便见求官驿马流。
其法正月起寅，二月丑，逆数十二位是也。
不欲赘言，故以四孟提起。
遇动，大吉之兆，应如下文：
yi: 雷火要在寅、亥、申、巳里找，四孟之支依次轮转，绕满一周。
一旦立刻被冲破，就成了天后，便能看到求官的驿马流动。
它的算法：正月起寅，二月是丑，逆着数遍十二位就是。
不想啰嗦，所以只拿四孟来提纲。
遇到发动，是大吉的征兆，应验的情形如下文：
en: Look for the Thunder-Fire among Yin, Hai, Shen and Si, going through the four Meng branches in turn until one full circuit is made.
Once it is at once clashed and broken it becomes Tianhou, and one then sees the Post Horse of the seeker of office flow on.
Its method: begin at Yin in the first month, Chou in the second, and count backwards through the twelve places.
Not wishing to say more than needed, only the four Meng are raised as the head.
When it moves, it is a sign of great fortune, and the result is as in the text that follows:

yi: 眼看着名位就到王公。
en: soon rank and position reach prince and duke.

title: 天乙贵人再来相合：不止自己享禄，子孙代代为官受封赠（旧注的天乙贵人按月份取巳申亥寅轮转）

rule.yi: 天乙贵人再来相合，不只自己享俸禄，而且世世代代都能做官、受封赠。旧注里的天乙贵人按月份取：正月在巳、二月在申、三月在亥、四月在寅，五、九月仍在巳，往后三位轮转；逢动一定吉，子孙代代做公卿。
rule.en: If the Tianyi Noble further combines, one enjoys the emolument oneself and, generation after generation, holds office and receives imperial honours. The note finds the Tianyi Noble by the month: Si in the first month, Shen in the second, Hai in the third, Yin in the fourth, Si again in the fifth and ninth, the three places turning on after that; if it moves it is surely auspicious, and descendants will be dukes and ministers generation after generation.

dispute.yi: 旧注里的天乙贵人按月份取（巳申亥寅轮转），而卜筮大全另一处、卜筮正宗、增删卜易、易林补遗等讲的天乙贵人都是按日干取：甲戊（庚）牛羊、乙己鼠猴、丙丁猪鸡、壬癸兔蛇、庚辛（六辛）马虎。两种起法不同，本库各照原书录，不裁定。
dispute.en: The note here finds the Tianyi Noble by the month (turning through Si, Shen, Hai, Yin), while elsewhere in the Bushi Daquan itself, and in the Bushi Zhengzong, the Zengshan Buyi and the Yilin Buyi, the Tianyi Noble is found by the day stem: Jia and Wu (and Geng) ox and sheep, Yi and Ji rat and monkey, Bing and Ding pig and rooster, Ren and Gui hare and snake, Geng and Xin (or the six Xin) horse and tiger. The two methods differ; each is recorded as its book gives it and neither is adjudicated.

note.yi: 「天纲」在这里没有交代是谁；断易天机的今人注读作袁天纲。本库照字面译成 Tiangang，不替它定。
note.en: 'Tiangang' is not identified here; a modern note in the Duanyi Tianji reads it as Yuan Tiangang. It is rendered literally as Tiangang and nothing is decided.

yi: 天乙贵人再来相合，
en: And if the Tianyi Noble further combines,

zh: 天乙贵人：正月在巳二月申，三月在亥四月寅。
五九依然居巳上，未月至丑三位轮。
若还遇动定为吉，子孙代代作公卿。
其法只以巳申亥寅四位，周而复始轮行十二位，正月巳，二月申，余仿此。
yi: 天乙贵人：正月在巳，二月在申，三月在亥，四月在寅。
五月、九月依然居在巳上，从未月到丑月是三位轮转。
如果还逢发动，一定是吉，子孙代代做公卿。
它的算法只用巳、申、亥、寅四个位置，周而复始轮行十二位：正月巳，二月申，其余依此类推。
en: The Tianyi Noble: Si in the first month, Shen in the second, Hai in the third, Yin in the fourth.
In the fifth and ninth months it again stands at Si, and from the Wei month to the Chou month the three places turn in turn.
If it also meets movement it is surely auspicious, and descendants will be dukes and ministers generation after generation.
Its method uses only the four places Si, Shen, Hai and Yin, going round and round through the twelve places: Si in the first month, Shen in the second, and the rest likewise.

yi: 世世代代做官，受朝廷的赠封。
en: generation after generation holding office and receiving imperial honours.

zh: 雷火贵人既合，非惟己身享禄，主代代受封赠也。
yi: 雷火、贵人既然相合，不只是自己享俸禄，主世世代代受封赠。
en: With the Thunder-Fire spirit and the Noble combined, not only does one enjoy the emolument oneself, it means honours received generation after generation.

yi: 这是天纲的玄妙诀窍，
劝你仔细抽绎，不要匆忙。
en: This is the profound secret of Tiangang,
I urge you to unravel it carefully and not in haste.

title: 筮国家占天子：卦从本宫、世爻取，本宫为国、世为君；初民二士三大夫、四公侯五君六宗庙社稷神；六爻各要生合旺相，一位不得其所则一国不宁

rule.yi: 占国家、占天子，从卦的本宫和世爻上取：本宫是国，世是君；本宫和世旺相比和，得圣明之主。六爻各有所主：初是民、二是士、三是大夫、四是公侯、五是君、六是宗庙社稷神；动静刚柔各要得当；六爻都要生合旺相，只要有一位不得其所，整个国家就不安宁。
rule.en: To divine for the state or the Son of Heaven, take from the palace of the hexagram and from the Self: the palace is the state and the Self is the lord, and when they are strong and in accord there is a sage ruler. The six lines each stand for a rank: the first the common people, the second the scholars, the third the grandees, the fourth the dukes and marquises, the fifth the lord, the sixth the ancestral temple and the altars of land and grain; moving or still, hard or soft, each should be in its right place; the six lines should all be generated, combined and strong, and if a single place is not where it should be, the whole country is unsettled.

yi: 如果占国家、占天子，
卦要从本宫、世上取；
本宫是国，世是君，
en: If one divines for the state or for the Son of Heaven,
the hexagram is to be taken from its palace and from the Self;
the palace is the state and the Self is the lord,

zh: 本宫者，看所占之卦，在何宫即为国，世爻即为君王也。
yi: 本宫，就是看所占的卦在哪个宫，那个宫就是国；世爻就是君王。
en: The palace: look at which palace the divined hexagram is in, and that palace is the state; the Self line is the lord and king.

yi: 旺相比和，得到圣明之主。
初是民，二是士，三是大夫，
四是公侯，君在第五；
六是宗庙和社稷之神，
动静刚柔，都要各得其所。
en: Strong and in accord, one gets a sage ruler.
The first is the people, the second the scholars, the third the grandees,
the fourth the dukes and marquises, the lord in the fifth;
the sixth is the ancestral temple and the gods of land and grain;
moving or still, hard or soft, each should be in its right place.

zh: 六爻各要生合旺相，苟一位不得其所，则一国不宁矣。
yi: 六爻各自要生合旺相，假如有一位不得其所，整个国家就不得安宁了。
en: Each of the six lines must be generated, combined and strong; if a single place is not where it should be, the whole country is not at peace.

title: 国事占大杀为灾：金主兵、水动主洪水之灾、土动主修治城垒；震离坎兑四方见应在边方、坤艮宫中事未宁；六爻不动卦无杀则天下太平

rule.yi: 国事占里，大杀是灾星：金主兵戈，水动主洪水之灾，土动主有修治城垒（或攻城）的事；大杀见于震、离、坎、兑四宫，应在边远的地方；见于坤、艮宫，国内的事情还没安宁；六爻不动、卦里没有杀，天下人民歌唱太平。
rule.en: In divining affairs of state the Great Baleful spirit brings calamity: Metal rules weapons, Water moving means flood, Earth moving means the repair of city walls (or the assault on a city); when it appears in the four palaces Zhen, Li, Kan and Dui, it falls on the border regions; in the palaces Kun and Gen affairs at home are not yet settled; with the six lines still and no baleful spirit in the hexagram, the people of the world sing of peace.

yi: 大杀是灾，金主兵戈，
en: The Great Baleful spirit is calamity, and Metal rules weapons,

zh: 大杀：正戌、二巳、三午、四未、五寅、六卯、七辰、八亥、九子、十丑、十一申、十二酉是也。
yi: 大杀：正月在戌，二月在巳，三月在午，四月在未，五月在寅，六月在卯，七月在辰，八月在亥，九月在子，十月在丑，十一月在申，十二月在酉。
en: The Great Baleful spirit: Xu in the first month, Si in the second, Wu in the third, Wei in the fourth, Yin in the fifth, Mao in the sixth, Chen in the seventh, Hai in the eighth, Zi in the ninth, Chou in the tenth, Shen in the eleventh, You in the twelfth.

yi: 水是昏垫（水淹），土是攻城。
en: Water is flooding and submerging, Earth is the assault on a city.

zh: 水动主有洪水之灾，土动主有修治城垒之事。
yi: 水动，主有洪水的灾；土动，主有修治城垒的事。
en: Water moving means the calamity of flood; Earth moving means the repair of city walls and ramparts.

yi: 震、离、坎、兑四个方位见到，
en: Seen in the four quarters Zhen, Li, Kan and Dui,

zh: 若遇此四宫，应在边方也。
yi: 如果遇到这四个宫，应在边远的地方。
en: If it meets these four palaces, it falls on the border regions.

yi: 坤、艮宫中，事情还没有安宁。
六爻不动，卦里没有杀，
天下人民歌唱太平。
en: in the palaces Kun and Gen, affairs are not yet settled.
With the six lines still and no baleful spirit in the hexagram,
the people of the world sing of peace.

title: 出兵交战：子孙宜强，鬼旺则彼赢我亡；财为草粮兄莫克、父为旌帜忌摇扬

rule.yi: 出兵交战，子孙要强；官鬼旺，对方赢、我必败亡；财是粮草，不要被兄弟克；父母是旌旗，忌讳摇动飘扬。
rule.en: In sending out troops to battle, Output should be strong; if Pressure is strong the other side wins and we are surely lost; Wealth is the fodder and grain and should not be controlled by Peer; Resource is the banner and standard and should not be shaken and flying.

yi: 出兵交战，子孙应当强；
官鬼旺，他赢，我必定败亡。
财是粮草，兄弟不要来克；
父母是旌旗，忌讳摇动飘扬。
en: In sending out troops to battle, Output should be strong;
if Pressure is strong, he wins and we are surely lost.
Wealth is the fodder and grain, which Peer should not control;
Resource is the banner and standard, which should not be shaken and flying.

title: 水爻带鬼来克我须防劫寨攻营；有气无气断输赢：世为我将、应为彼军、日辰为我卒、官鬼为彼兵，我克他胜、他克我负；财兴克父斩将夺旌、兄弟交重夺粮劫草

rule.yi: 水爻带着官鬼来克我，要防备劫寨和攻营；还要看有气没气，才能断兵机的输赢。决胜负，以世、应、日辰、官星来论：世是我方将领，应是对方军队，日辰是我方士卒，官鬼是对方兵；我克他，我胜；他克我，我负。财动克父，必定斩将夺旗；兄弟交重发动，必定夺粮劫草。
rule.en: A Water line carrying Pressure and coming to control us: guard against the raiding of the camp and the assault on the encampment; then see whether there is qi or none, and only then judge the winning or losing of the military affair. To decide victory, reckon by the Self, the Other, the Day and the star of office: the Self is our general, the Other is their army, the Day is our soldiers, Pressure is their troops; if we control them, we win; if they control us, we lose. If Wealth rises and controls Resource, the general is surely cut down and the banner seized; if Peer moves, grain is surely seized and fodder raided.

yi: 水爻带着官鬼来克我，
必须防备劫寨和攻营。
再看有气、没有气，
才能断兵机的输与赢。
en: A Water line carrying Pressure and coming to control me,
one must guard against the raiding of the camp and the assault on the encampment.
Then see whether there is qi or none,
and only then judge the winning and losing of the military affair.

zh: 若决胜负，以世应日辰官星论之。
世为我将，应为彼军，日辰为我卒，官鬼为彼兵。
若财兴克父，必斩将夺旌。
yi: 要决定胜负，以世、应、日辰、官星来论。
世是我方将领，应是对方军队，日辰是我方士卒，官鬼是对方的兵。
我克他，我胜。
他克我，我败。
若是财动克父，必定斩将夺旗。
兄弟交重发动，必定夺粮劫草。
en: To decide victory or defeat, reckon by the Self, the Other, the Day and the star of office.
The Self is our general, the Other is their army, the Day is our soldiers, and Pressure is their troops.
If we control them, we win.
If they control us, we lose.
If Wealth rises and controls Resource, the general is surely cut down and the banner seized.
If Peer moves, grain is surely seized and fodder raided.

title: 羽士缁流占：身安世静最先；身爻克世可谋用、世应比和自然乐；世克身当退守、财克世好求缘；六爻不动为清福、一位交重事变迁

rule.yi: 道士、僧人来问占：身安稳、世安静最要紧；身爻克世，可以去谋划；世、应比和，自然安乐；世去克身，应当退守；财来克世，适合去求缘；六爻不动是清福；有一位交重发动，事情就有变迁。
rule.en: For Taoist priests and monks asking by divination: the Body at ease and the Self still comes first; the Body line controlling the Self, one may plan and act; Self and Other in accord, ease comes of itself; the Self controlling the Body, one should withdraw and hold; Wealth coming to control the Self, it is good to seek alms; the six lines still is pure blessing; one line moving means change in the matter.

yi: 道士、僧人来问占，
身安稳、世安静，最要紧；
身爻克世，可以谋划行事；
世、应比和，自然安乐。
世若克身，应当退守；
财来克世，适合去求缘。
六爻不动，是清福；
有一位交重发动，事情就有变迁。
en: Taoist priests and black-robed monks coming to ask by divination:
the Body at ease and the Self still comes first;
the Body line controlling the Self, one may plan and act;
Self and Other in accord, ease comes of itself.
If the Self controls the Body, one should withdraw and hold;
Wealth coming to control the Self is good for seeking alms.
With the six lines still it is pure blessing;
one line moving, the matter changes.

title: 僧道占：财旺宜收布施、鬼交偏好谒官员；财空注疏徒劳力、鬼旺营谋枉费钱

rule.yi: 财旺，正适合收布施；官鬼发动，偏适合去谒见官员；财落空，注解经疏是白费力气；官鬼旺，营谋是白费钱。
rule.en: Wealth thriving is just right for receiving alms; Pressure moving is especially good for calling on officials; Wealth void, annotating the scriptures is wasted labour; Pressure strong, scheming is money wasted.

yi: 财旺，正适合收取布施；
官鬼发动，偏适合去谒见官员。
en: Wealth thriving is just right for receiving alms;
Pressure moving is especially good for calling on officials.

yi: 财落空，注解经疏是白费力气；
官鬼旺，谋求营运是白白费钱。
en: Wealth void, annotating the scriptures is wasted labour;
Pressure strong, scheming and managing is money wasted.

title: 僧道占：世临白虎官司绕、身遇勾陈心事缠；勾陈带杀遭魔障、玄武临财被贼冤；兄弟勾陈同位动谨防法眷外勾连

rule.yi: 世临白虎，官司缠绕；身遇勾陈，心事牵缠；勾陈带杀，会遭魔障；玄武临财，被盗贼冤害；兄弟和勾陈同在一位发动，要提防同门法眷在外面勾结牵连。
rule.en: The Self on the White Tiger, lawsuits dog one; the Body meeting Hook Earth, worries entangle the heart; Hook Earth carrying a baleful spirit meets demonic obstruction; the Dark Tortoise on Wealth, one is wronged by thieves; Peer and Hook Earth moving together in the same place, beware of Dharma kin colluding with outsiders.

yi: 世临白虎，官司缠绕；
身遇勾陈，心事牵缠。
en: The Self on the White Tiger, lawsuits dog one;
the Body meeting Hook Earth, worries entangle the heart.

yi: 勾陈带杀，遭到魔障；
玄武临财，被盗贼冤害。
兄弟和勾陈同在一位发动，
要谨防同门法眷在外面勾结牵连。
en: Hook Earth carrying a baleful spirit meets demonic obstruction;
the Dark Tortoise on Wealth, one is wronged by thieves.
Peer and Hook Earth moving together in the same place,
beware of Dharma kin colluding and entangling you from outside.

title: 僧道占：父母克身师接引、青龙持世贵周全；贵临父母师通圣、福德龙交弟子贤；父母重重身受克断然身被俗家牵

rule.yi: 父母克身，有师父接引；青龙持世，有贵人周全；贵人落在父母上，师父通达圣道；福德、青龙交动，弟子贤能；父母重重叠叠、身受克，断定是被俗家牵累。
rule.en: Resource controlling the Body, a master receives and leads one on; the Azure Dragon holding the Self, a patron sees one through; the Noble on Resource, the master is versed in the sacred; Output and the Dragon moving together, the disciples are worthy; Resource upon Resource and the Body controlled, it is certain one is dragged back by one's lay family.

yi: 父母克身，有师父来接引；
青龙持世，有贵人周全。
en: Resource controlling the Body, a master receives and leads one on;
the Azure Dragon holding the Self, a patron sees one through.

yi: 贵人落在父母上，师父通达圣道；
福德、青龙交动，弟子贤能。
父母重重叠叠、身受克，
断定是身被俗家牵累。
en: the Noble on Resource, the master is versed in the sacred;
Output and the Dragon moving together, the disciples are worthy.
Resource upon Resource while the Body is controlled,
it is certain one is dragged back by one's lay family.

title: 僧道占：乱动坐关为大忌、八纯好参玄、艮坤栖岩壑、离巽隐市廛；龙虎交驰宜访道、坎离辐辏好安禅；游魂带杀休云水、一世休囚莫置田

rule.yi: 爻乱动而去坐关（闭关），是大忌；八纯卦倒好去参玄；艮、坤只能栖身岩穴山谷；离、巽适合隐居市井；龙虎交驰，适合访道；坎、离汇聚，适合安心坐禅；游魂卦带杀，别去云游；一世卦遇休囚，不要置买田产。
rule.en: With lines moving in disorder, going into retreat is the great taboo; an Eight-Pure hexagram is on the contrary good for studying the mysteries; Gen and Kun suit only a dwelling among crags and ravines; Li and Xun suit hiding in the marketplace; the Dragon and Tiger racing against each other suit seeking the Way; Kan and Li converging suit settling into meditation; a Wandering Soul hexagram with a baleful spirit, do not go wandering like cloud and water; a First-Generation hexagram resting or trapped, do not buy fields.

note.yi: 「一世」原文没有展开；这里按「一世卦」（世在初爻）读，也可能指世这一爻本身休囚，本库不裁定。
note.en: 'Yi shi' is not expanded in the text; it is read here as a First-Generation hexagram (the Self on the first line), though it could mean the Self line itself being at rest or trapped, and this is not decided.

yi: 爻乱动而去坐关，是大忌；
八纯卦，倒好去参玄。
艮、坤只能栖身岩穴山谷；
离、巽偏适合隐居市井。
en: With lines moving in disorder, going into retreat is the great taboo;
an Eight-Pure hexagram is on the contrary good for studying the mysteries.
Gen and Kun suit only a dwelling among crags and ravines;
Li and Xun are better for hiding in the marketplace.

yi: 龙虎交驰，适合访道；
坎、离汇聚，适合安心坐禅。
游魂卦带杀，不要云游；
一世卦休囚，不要置买田产。
en: With the Dragon and Tiger racing against each other, it suits seeking the Way;
with Kan and Li converging, it suits settling into meditation.
A Wandering Soul hexagram with a baleful spirit, do not go wandering like cloud and water;
a First-Generation hexagram resting or trapped, do not buy fields.

title: 僧道占：子动妻交还俗汉；忽然负结、财身动免不了填还俗债；世应不和身妄动，了身达命待驴年

rule.yi: 子孙发动、妻财交动，是要还俗的人；忽然有负债纠结、财和身一起发动，免不了去偿还俗世的债和冤；世、应不和、身又乱动，想了身达命要等到驴年（也就是永远等不到）。
rule.en: Output moving with Wealth also moving: a man who will return to lay life; if suddenly there is a debt-knot and Wealth and the Body move, one cannot avoid paying back worldly debts and grievances; with Self and Other at odds and the Body moving wildly, to finish with the body and reach one's destiny one must wait for the Year of the Donkey (that is, for ever).

note.yi: 「负结」原文难解，这里按上下文读作「负债纠结」；「驴年」的十二支里没有驴，意思是永远等不到。
note.en: 'Fu jie' is hard to read in the text and is taken from the context as 'debts and entanglement'; there is no donkey among the twelve branches, so the 'Year of the Donkey' means never.

yi: 子孙发动、妻财交动，是要还俗的汉子；
en: Output moving and Wealth also moving: a man who will return to lay life;

yi: 忽然有负债纠结、财和身一起发动，
免不了要偿还俗世的债和冤。
世、应不和，身又乱动，
想了身达命，要等到驴年。
en: If suddenly there is a debt-knot and Wealth and the Body move,
one cannot avoid paying back worldly debts and grievances.
Self and Other at odds and the Body moving wildly,
to finish with the body and reach one's destiny, wait for the Year of the Donkey.

title: 僧道占成道之象：世空身旺为地行仙、身空不动头头是道、应旺无魔处处是禅；应偶世奇生合、神清身静寿绵绵

rule.yi: 世空、身旺，是地上的行仙；身空而不动，事事都是道；应旺而没有魔，处处都是禅；应落偶位、世落奇位，又生又合，精神清明、身体安静，寿命绵长。
rule.en: The Self void and the Body strong makes an earth-wandering immortal; the Body void and still, every single thing is the Way; the Other strong with no demon, Chan is everywhere; the Other on an even place and the Self on an odd one, generating and combining, the spirit clear and the body at peace, life is long.

yi: 世空、身旺，是地上的行仙；
身空而不动，事事都是道；
应旺而没有魔，处处都是禅；
应落偶位、世落奇位，又生又合，
精神清明、身体安静，寿命绵长。
en: the Self void and the Body strong, an earth-wandering immortal;
the Body void and still, every single thing is the Way;
the Other strong with no demon, Chan is everywhere;
the Other on an even place and the Self on an odd one, generating and combining,
the spirit clear and the body at peace, life is long.

title: 僧道占：木神太岁临身命即日逢神得正传；太岁火神加父母天边恩命定来宣

rule.yi: 木神、太岁落在身和命上，当天就遇上神人、得到真传；太岁、火神加在父母上，天边的恩命一定会来宣布。
rule.en: The Wood spirit and Tai Sui on the Body and one's fate: on that very day one meets a divine person and receives the true transmission; Tai Sui and the Fire spirit added to Resource: a favour commanded from the edge of heaven will surely be proclaimed.

note.yi: 最后两句（「问予末后天机事，拈笔书将一个缘」）是全章的收尾，不是判语。
note.en: The last two lines ('if you ask me about this last matter of heaven's secret, I take up my brush and write down a single yuan') close the whole chapter and are not a judgment.

yi: 木神、太岁落在身和命上，
当天就遇上神人，得到真传。
太岁、火神加在父母上，
天边的恩命一定会来宣布。
问我最后这件天机之事，
我拈起笔来，写下一个缘字。
en: The Wood spirit and Tai Sui on the Body and one's fate,
on that very day one meets a divine person and receives the true transmission.
Tai Sui and the Fire spirit added to Resource,
a favour commanded from the edge of heaven will surely be proclaimed.
If you ask me about this last matter of heaven's secret,
I take up my brush and write down a single word, yuan (affinity).

title: 鬼谷辨爻法·占仕宦：初爻吏人、二爻曹官、三爻长官、四爻监司、五爻朝仕、六爻执政

rule.yi: 占仕宦，按鬼谷子的爻位法：初爻是吏人，二爻是曹官，三爻是长官，四爻是监司，五爻是朝仕（在朝的官），六爻是执政。
rule.en: In divining official careers, by the Guigu line-position method the first line is the clerk, the second the bureau officer, the third the head of the office, the fourth the supervising commissioner, the fifth the court official and the sixth the minister in power.

zh: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
吏人曹官长官监司朝仕执政
yi: 鬼谷子的爻位法
从初爻数到六爻，依次是：
吏员、曹司官、长官、监察司官、朝官、执政大臣
en: The Guigu method of the line positions
The first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth lines are in order:
clerk, bureau officer, head of office, supervising commissioner, court official, minister in power

hits.text: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻

title: 丘寺丞易鉴歌（一）：求官鬼吏克身为贤官；驿马扶身官职迁；坎离宜冬三月、震巽应申酉年；世应与驿马相合吉；坎咸复卦主狐疑；申酉辰戌持世吉

rule.yi: 求官时，官鬼落在吏位（初爻）来克身，是贤官之象；驿马相扶，官职迁动；坎、离二卦宜在冬天三个月，震、巽二卦应在申、酉年；世、应和驿马相合是吉；坎、咸、复三卦主狐疑；申、酉、辰、戌持世是吉，做官又遇到禄，好施展作为。
rule.en: In seeking office, Pressure on the clerk line (the first) and controlling the self is the sign of a worthy official; the Post Horse lending support, the post is moved up; the two trigrams Kan and Li suit the three winter months and Zhen and Xun the years of Shen and You; Self and Other combining with the Post Horse is auspicious; the hexagrams Kan, Xian and Fu bring doubt and hesitation; Shen, You, Chen and Xu holding the Self is auspicious, and taking office and meeting the Emolument gives room to act well.

note.yi: 这一首和卜筮大全阐奥歌章仕宦章是同一首歌诀，这一段的字句基本相同；断易天机把它归在「丘寺丞易鉴歌」名下，卜筮大全归在阐奥歌章名下，作者的归属两书不同。断易天机里的数字注号（1）到（10）是整理时编的。
note.en: This is the same song as the chapter on official careers in the Chan'ao Ge of the Bushi Daquan, and in this stretch the wording is nearly the same; the Duanyi Tianji assigns it to the 'Qiu Sicheng Song of the Yi Mirror' and the Bushi Daquan to the Chan'ao Ge, so the two books differ on its authorship. The numbered notes (1) to (10) in the Duanyi Tianji were numbered in editing.

yi: 求官时，官鬼落在吏位（初爻）来克身，是贤官之象；
驿马前来扶助，官职就会迁动。
坎、离二卦，宜在冬天三个月；
震、巽二卦，明白知道应在申、酉年。
世、应和驿马相合，是吉；
坎、咸、复这三卦，一定是狐疑不决。
申、酉、辰、戌持世是吉，
做官又遇到禄，好施展作为。
en: In seeking office, Pressure on the clerk line (the first) and controlling the self is the sign of a worthy official;
With the Post Horse lending support, the post is moved up.
the two trigrams Kan and Li: the three months of winter;
Zhen and Xun: know plainly that it falls in the years of Shen and You.
Self and Other combining with the Post Horse is auspicious;
Kan, Xian and Fu: it is settled that there is doubt and hesitation.
Shen, You, Chen and Xu holding the Self is auspicious;
taking office and meeting the Emolument, there is room to act well.

zh: （1）初爻为吏，若兼鬼来克本身，却主为贤明官员也。
yi: （1）初爻是吏，如果兼有官鬼来克本人，就主他是贤明的官员。
en: (1) The first line is the clerk; if Pressure also comes to control the man himself, it marks a worthy and discerning official.

title: 丘寺丞易鉴歌（二）：鬼临身世、卦爻旺相得官真而欢欣；驿马空亡徒费力、卦遭胎没枉劳神；旺爻克应不良、应入墓忧死亡；世爻受克遭贬谪、若克他人倍俸粮

rule.yi: 官鬼落在身、世上，卦里各爻旺相，得官是真，欢喜；驿马落空亡，白费力气；卦遇胎、没，白白劳神。旺相的爻克应，不好；应入墓的时候，要担心死亡；世爻被克，会遭贬谪；如果世爻去克别人，俸禄加倍。
rule.en: Pressure on the Body or the Self with the lines of the hexagram strong and thriving, the office is truly gained and there is joy; the Post Horse Void, effort is spent for nothing; the hexagram meeting Embryo or Sunk, the mind is wearied in vain. A strong line controlling the Other is not good; when the Other enters its tomb, worry about death; the Self line being controlled, one is demoted and exiled; if the Self controls others, the salary is doubled.

note.yi: 卜筮大全本作「卦爻旺相为欢欣」「若克他爻倍俸粮」，断易天机本作「卦爻旺相甚欢欣」「若克他人倍俸粮」，意思没有差别。
note.en: The Bushi Daquan text reads 'the lines strong, there is joy' and 'if it controls another line, the salary is doubled'; the Duanyi Tianji text reads 'the lines strong, great joy' and 'if it controls others, the salary is doubled'; the sense is the same.

yi: 官鬼落在身、世上，得到官才是真的；
卦里各爻旺相，十分欢欣；
驿马空亡，白费力气；
卦遇胎、没，白白劳神。
en: Pressure on the Body or the Self, and the office is truly gained;
the lines of the hexagram strong and thriving, great joy;
the Post Horse Void, effort is spent for nothing;
the hexagram meeting Embryo or Sunk, the mind is wearied in vain.

zh: 如立春后巽胎离没，得家人卦是也。
yi: （2）如果卦遇到胎、没，必定白白劳神。
比如立春之后，巽是胎、离是没，得到家人卦就是这种情形。
en: (2) If the hexagram meets Embryo or Sunk, it surely means wearing the mind in vain.
For example after the Beginning of Spring, Xun is Embryo and Li is Sunk, and getting the hexagram Jiaren is such a case.

yi: 旺相的爻克应，是不好的；
应入墓的时候，要担心死亡；
世爻被克，会遭贬谪；
如果克了别人，俸禄加倍。
en: A strong line controlling the Other is not good;
when the Other enters its tomb, worry about death;
the Self line being controlled, one is demoted and exiled;
if it controls others, the salary is doubled.

title: 丘寺丞易鉴歌（三）：人吏（初爻）空亡难立脚；内外纯阴名不扬；子爻克鬼无官禄、福德爻惊（动）岂吉昌；卦克世身职不安、身克人吏百忧攒；白虎动时惊恐至；子孙持世必堕官

rule.yi: 初爻是吏，落空亡，即使官员清正，吏员没力量，难以立足；内外卦全是阴，名声不扬；子孙爻克官鬼，就没有官禄；福德（子孙）爻惊动，哪里还会吉昌；卦克世、身，职位不安；身去克初爻的吏，吏员都畏惧躲避，百样忧愁聚集；白虎动时惊恐就到；子孙持世，必定掉官。
rule.en: The first line is the clerk, and if it falls Void, even if the official is upright the clerks have no strength and it is hard to find a footing; with inner and outer trigrams wholly yin, the name is not made known; Output controlling Pressure, there is no official emolument; with the Output line startled into moving, how could there be fortune; the hexagram controlling the Self and the Body, the post is not secure; the Body controlling the first line, the clerk, all the clerks shrink away in fear and a hundred anxieties gather; when the White Tiger moves, fright and alarm come; Output holding the Self surely drops the office.

note.yi: 卜筮大全本作「福德爻交反不昌」「子孙持世必隳官」，断易天机本作「福德爻惊岂吉昌」「子孙持世必堕官」：「惊」，注文说就是「动」；「隳」「堕」都是毁掉的意思。「有成忧攒之兆」的「成」疑是「忧」的衍字，这里按「有忧攒之兆」译。
note.en: The Bushi Daquan text reads 'with the Output line moving there is on the contrary no flourishing' and 'Output holding the Self surely ruins the post'; the Duanyi Tianji text reads 'with the Output line startled, how could there be fortune' and 'Output holding the Self surely drops the office'; the note says 'startled' means 'moves', and the two words for ruin and drop both mean to lose the post. The 'cheng' in 'a sign of anxieties becoming gathered' looks like a stray character and is translated as 'a sign of anxieties gathering'.

yi: 吏爻落空亡，难以立足；
内外卦都是纯阴，名声不扬。
en: the clerk line Void, it is hard to find a footing;
Inner and outer wholly yin, the name is not made known.

zh: （3）初爻为人吏，若空亡，纵官员清正，吏人无气，谁与奉行，所以难立脚也。
yi: （3）初爻是人吏，如果空亡，纵然官员清正，吏员没有力量，谁来替他奉行，所以难以立足。
en: (3) The first line is the clerk; if it is Void, even if the official is upright the clerks have no strength and who will carry out his orders, so it is hard to find a footing.

yi: 子孙爻克官鬼，就没有官禄；
福德爻惊动，哪里还会吉昌？
en: Output controlling Pressure, there is no official emolument;
with the Output line startled into moving, how could there be fortune?

zh: 若遇子孙爻发动，求官定不利。
yi: （4）惊，就是动。
如果遇到子孙爻发动，求官一定不利。
en: (4) 'Jing' (startled) means to move.
If Output moves, seeking office is surely unfavourable.

yi: 卦克世、身，职位不安；
身去克人吏，百样忧愁聚到一起。
en: the hexagram controlling the Self and the Body, the post is not secure;
the Body controlling the clerk, a hundred anxieties gather together.

zh: （5）若身、世克初爻人吏，定主吏皆畏避，有成忧攒之兆。
yi: （5）如果身、世克初爻的人吏，一定主吏员都畏惧躲避，有忧患聚集的兆头。
en: (5) If the Body and Self control the first line, the clerk, it surely means the clerks all shrink away in fear, a sign of anxieties gathering.

yi: 白虎发动的时候，惊恐就来了；
子孙持世，必定掉官。
en: When the White Tiger moves, fright and alarm come;
Output holding the Self surely drops the office.

title: 丘寺丞易鉴歌（四）：问文官武职，求官用唐苻、国印——寅申年巳亥、巳亥年寅申、子午年卯酉、卯酉年子午、辰戌年丑未、丑未年辰戌；鬼临符印最佳，宜静而动必左迁（卜筮大全作升迁）、宜动而静多掩抑

rule.yi: 不论文官武职，求官要看唐符、国印：寅、申年看巳、亥，巳、亥年看寅、申，子、午年看卯、酉，卯、酉年看子、午，辰、戌年看丑、未，丑、未年看辰、戌。注文说：寅、申年遇到巳、亥爻发动、旺相，是吉；巳、亥年遇到寅、申爻发动、旺相，是吉。官鬼落在符、印上最好，可以做朝廷的辅佐；「宜静而动必左迁，宜动而静多掩抑」。
rule.en: Whether it is a civil or a military post, in seeking office look to Tangfu and the State Seal: in the years Yin and Shen look to Si and Hai, in Si and Hai years to Yin and Shen, in Zi and Wu years to Mao and You, in Mao and You years to Zi and Wu, in Chen and Xu years to Chou and Wei, in Chou and Wei years to Chen and Xu. The notes say: in the years Yin and Shen, if the Si or Hai line moves and is strong, it is auspicious; in the years Si and Hai, if the Yin or Shen line moves and is strong, it is auspicious. Pressure standing on the tally and the seal is best, one who will serve as a support at court; 'what should be still but moves will surely be demoted; what should move but stays still is mostly held down'.

dispute.yi: 卜筮大全本作「宜静而动必升迁」，断易天机本作「宜静而动必左迁」：「升迁」是升官，「左迁」是降职，意思正相反。两本都没有交代「宜静」「宜动」指哪一爻，所以无法靠上下文裁定。另外，卜筮大全的旧注把巳、亥读成唐符、国印本身，断易天机的注则说巳、亥爻要发动、旺相才吉，两处的读法也不完全一样。本库各照原书录，不裁定。
dispute.en: The Bushi Daquan text reads 'what should be still but moves will surely rise in post', the Duanyi Tianji text 'will surely be demoted': the first is promotion and the second demotion, exactly opposite. Neither book says which line 'should be still' or 'should move', so the context cannot decide it. In addition the note in the Bushi Daquan reads Si and Hai as the Tangfu and the State Seal themselves, while the note here says that the Si or Hai line must move and be strong to be auspicious, so the two do not read it quite alike. Each is recorded as its book gives it and neither is adjudicated.

yi: 若是问文官和武职，
唐符、国印是求得确实答案的地方。
寅、申年，取巳、亥。
en: If the question is a civil post or a military one,
Tangfu and the State Seal are where the sure answer is found.
In the years Yin and Shen, it is Si and Hai;

zh: （6）寅、申之年，遇巳、亥爻发动，旺相吉。
yi: （6）寅、申年，遇到巳、亥爻发动，旺相就吉。
en: (6) In the years Yin and Shen, if the Si or Hai line moves and is strong, it is auspicious.

yi: 巳、亥年，到寅、申里找。
en: In the years Si and Hai, look among Yin and Shen.

zh: （7）巳、亥之年，遇寅、申爻发动，旺相吉。
yi: （7）巳、亥年，遇到寅、申爻发动，旺相就吉。
en: (7) In the years Si and Hai, if the Yin or Shen line moves and is strong, it is auspicious.

yi: 子、午年，到卯、酉里求；
卯、酉年，子、午出现。
辰、戌年，在丑、未的方位；
丑、未年，在辰、戌。
en: In the years Zi and Wu, seek among Mao and You;
in the years Mao and You, Zi and Wu appear.
In the years Chen and Xu, it is in the place of Chou and Wei;
in the years Chou and Wei, it is in Chen and Xu.

yi: 官鬼落在唐符、国印上，最好，
可以做朝廷的辅佐，
该静的偏动，必定降职外调；
该动的偏静，多半被压住。
en: Pressure standing on the Tangfu or the State Seal is the best,
one who will serve as a support at court,
what should be still but moves will surely be demoted;
what should move but stays still is mostly held down.

title: 丘寺丞易鉴歌（五）：乾位交重出西北，练行宜往兴功绩——世应相生而有命训练之行，则宜往有利的方位必然立功

rule.yi: 乾位上有动爻，出在西北；训练出行适宜前往，可以兴起功绩。遇到卦中世、应相生，有奉命训练兵马的差事，就适宜前往有利的方位，必然立功。
rule.en: With moving lines in the Qian place it goes out to the northwest; for a training mission it is fitting to go, and merit will arise. When Self and Other generate each other in the hexagram and there is an order to drill troops and horses, it is fitting to go toward the favourable direction, and merit will surely be won.

note.yi: 卜筮大全本在「乾位交重出西北」前面还有「巽象摇时东与南」一句，在后面还有「君臣世应上下交」一句，断易天机本都没有；注文也多出「则宜往有利的方位」。
note.en: The Bushi Daquan text has before 'moving lines in the Qian place go out to the northwest' the line 'when the Xun image stirs, the east and the south', and after it the line 'lord and minister, Self and Other, upper and lower meeting', neither of which is in the Duanyi Tianji text; the note here also adds 'it is fitting to go toward the favourable direction'.

yi: 乾位上有动爻，出在西北。
训练的差事适宜前往，可以兴起功绩。
en: with moving lines in the Qian place, it goes out to the northwest.
for a training mission it is fitting to go, and merit will arise.

zh: 遇卦中世应相生，有命训练之行，则宜往有利的方位，必然立功也。
yi: （8）练，就是训练兵马。
遇到卦中世、应相生，有奉命训练的差事，就适宜前往有利的方位，必然立功。
en: (8) 'Lian' means drilling troops and horses.
When Self and Other generate each other in the hexagram and there is an order to go and drill troops, it is fitting to go toward the favourable direction, and merit will surely be won.

title: 丘寺丞易鉴歌（六）：欲知卦内作何官，先向身中仔细看——火为文章喉舌位、土为守令、水为排岸监司职、金代兵刑有重权、木为工部及作院，小大皆随旺相言

rule.yi: 要知道卦里是做什么官，先仔细看身：火是文章、喉舌的位置；土是守、令；水是排岸、监司一类的职事；金代表兵、刑，握有重权；木是工部和作院（军器作坊）；官职小大，都随爻的旺相来说。
rule.en: To know what office the hexagram holds, first look carefully at the Body: Fire is the place of letters and of the throat and tongue of the court; Earth is the prefect and the magistrate; Water is a post such as embankment supervisor or commissioner; Metal stands for soldiers and punishments and holds heavy power; Wood is the Ministry of Works and the arsenal; and whether the post is small or large is said according to strength.

note.yi: 卜筮大全本作「水是江滨巡守职，金带兵刑生杀权。木主工科司建创，大小皆随衰旺言」，字句不同，说的是同一类分法；卜筮大全的旧注还对「火」「土」两句作了解释，断易天机本没有。
note.en: The Bushi Daquan text reads 'Water is the post of patrol and guard along the rivers and shores; Metal carries soldiers, punishments and the power of life and death; Wood governs the works section, in charge of building and founding; large or small follows weakness or strength', different in words but the same kind of division; the note in the Bushi Daquan also explains the Fire and Earth lines, which the Duanyi Tianji text does not.

yi: 要知道卦里做什么官，
先到「身」里仔细看；
火是文章、喉舌的位置，
土是守、令，渐渐在那里盘桓。
水是排岸、监司一类的职事，
金代表兵、刑，握有重权。
木是工部和作院（军器作坊），
官职小大，都随爻的旺相来说，
en: To know what office the hexagram holds,
first look carefully into the Body;
Fire is the place of letters and of the throat and tongue,
Earth is the prefect and the magistrate, who little by little tarries there.
Water is a post such as embankment supervisor or commissioner,
Metal stands for soldiers and punishments and holds heavy power.
Wood is the Ministry of Works and the arsenal,
and whether the post is small or large, all is said according to strength,

title: 丘寺丞易鉴歌（七）：喜神驿马兼官鬼，美削重重见知己；就中苻印两爻推，早晚当随诏书起

rule.yi: 喜神、驿马兼有官鬼，荐举的文书一封又一封，被知己看重；再就这当中用唐符、国印两爻来推，早晚会随着诏书起用。
rule.en: With the Joy spirit and the Post Horse together with Pressure, recommending letters follow one another and one is valued by those who know one; then reckon from the two lines Tangfu and State Seal, and sooner or later one will be raised on the strength of an imperial edict.

note.yi: 「就中苻印两爻推」在卜筮大全本作「就多符印两爻权」；断易天机本的「就中」读得通，正好印证卜筮大全本的「就多」是「就中」之误。美削，卜筮大全的旧注作「举纸笺」，这里作「举纸版」。
note.en: The line 'jiu zhong fu yin liang yao tui' reads in the Bushi Daquan text 'jiu duo fu yin liang yao quan'; the 'jiu zhong' (among these) of the Duanyi Tianji text makes sense and confirms that the 'jiu duo' of the Bushi Daquan text is a slip for it. For 'meixiao' the note in the Bushi Daquan says 'recommending by paper letters' and this one 'by paper tablets'.

yi: 喜神、驿马兼有官鬼，
荐举的文书一封又一封，被知己看重。
就在这当中用唐符、国印两爻来推，
早晚会随着诏书起用。
en: the Joy spirit and the Post Horse together with Pressure,
recommending letters follow one another, and one is valued by those who know one.
from among these, reckon from the two lines Tangfu and State Seal,
Sooner or later one will be raised on the strength of an imperial edict.

yi: （9）美削，就是用纸版举荐。
重重，是说它多。
知己，是说被人看重。
en: (9) 'Meixiao' means recommending by paper tablets.
'Layer upon layer' says that they are many.
'Those who know one' means being valued by others.

title: 丘寺丞易鉴歌（八）：卦无太岁只移官，太岁合时见天子

rule.yi: 卦里没有太岁，只是移官调动；太岁相合的时候，能见天子。
rule.en: With no Tai Sui in the hexagram, only a transfer of office; when Tai Sui combines, one sees the Son of Heaven.

note.yi: 卜筮大全本作「卦无太岁只升迁」，而它自己的旧注却说「若无，但能迁改」；「迁改」和断易天机本的「只移官」相合，所以「升迁」很可能是「移官」的另一种写法或误写。
note.en: The Bushi Daquan text reads 'with no Tai Sui in the hexagram, only promotion', yet its own note says 'if there is none, one can only be moved or changed'; 'moved or changed' agrees with the 'only a transfer of office' of the Duanyi Tianji text, so 'promotion' is very likely another way of writing or a slip for 'transfer'.

yi: 卦里没有太岁，只是移官调动；
太岁相合的时候，能见天子。
en: with no Tai Sui in the hexagram, only a transfer of office;
when Tai Sui combines, one sees the Son of Heaven.

title: 丘寺丞易鉴歌（九）：更得雷火杀重重，名位至王公；天乙贵人更相合，代代为官受赠封；注：鬼谷子雷火杀例——正月起寅、二月起丑、三月起子……逆数十二位

rule.yi: 卦里再得雷火杀、重重叠叠，眼看名位将到王公；天乙贵人再来相合，世世代代做官、受封赠。这是天纲玄妙的法门，请你仔细抽绎，不要匆忙。注文给了鬼谷子的雷火杀例：雷火在寅、亥、申、巳里找；它的算法是正月起寅、二月起丑、三月起子、四月起亥、五月起戌、六月起酉、七月起申、八月起未、九月起午、十月起巳、十一月起辰、十二月起卯，逆数十二位。
rule.en: If the hexagram further gets the Thunder-Fire baleful spirit, layer upon layer, soon rank and position reach prince and duke; if the Tianyi Noble further combines, one holds office and receives imperial honours generation after generation. This is the profound method of Tiangang, and I ask you to unravel it carefully and not in haste. The note gives the Guigu-zi rule for the Thunder-Fire spirit: look for it among Yin, Hai, Shen and Si; its method is Yin in the first month, Chou in the second, Zi in the third, Hai in the fourth, Xu in the fifth, You in the sixth, Shen in the seventh, Wei in the eighth, Wu in the ninth, Si in the tenth, Chen in the eleventh and Mao in the twelfth, counting backwards through the twelve places.

note.yi: 这条注把雷火杀的起法完整写了出来（逆数十二位，正月寅、二月丑……十二月卯）；它和卜筮大全旧注里「正月起寅，二月丑，逆数十二位」是同一种起法，说明旧注前面按「寅亥申巳」四孟轮转的那一句与它不是一套。诗里这一句，卜筮大全作「四孟从之遍一周」，断易天机作「四孟先知惊恐忧」。这一本也没有给天乙贵人的起法（卜筮大全旧注按月份取巳申亥寅）。「请君绎」缺一个字，卜筮大全作「劝君紬绎」。
note.en: This note writes out the method for the Thunder-Fire spirit in full (counting backwards: Yin in the first month, Chou in the second, down to Mao in the twelfth); it is the same method as the 'begin at Yin in the first month, Chou in the second, counting backwards through the twelve places' of the note in the Bushi Daquan, which shows that the earlier sentence there, running through the four Meng branches Yin, Hai, Shen and Si, is not the same scheme. This line of the song reads in the Bushi Daquan 'follow the four Meng until a full circuit is made' and in the Duanyi Tianji 'among the four Meng first know of fright and worry'. This book also gives no method for the Tianyi Noble (the note in the Bushi Daquan finds it by the month through Si, Shen, Hai, Yin). 'Qing jun yi' lacks a character, which the Bushi Daquan has in 'quan jun chouyi'.

yi: 再得到雷火杀，重重叠叠，
眼看着名位就到王公。
天乙贵人再来相合，
世世代代做官，受朝廷的赠封。
这是天纲玄妙的法门，
请你抽绎一番，不要匆忙。
en: And if one further gets the Thunder-Fire baleful spirit, layer upon layer,
soon rank and position reach prince and duke.
And if the Tianyi Noble further combines,
generation after generation holding office and receiving imperial honours.
This is the profound method of Tiangang,
I ask you to unravel it and not in haste.

zh: （10）鬼谷子雷火杀例云：雷火寅猪申巳求，四孟先知惊恐忧，即时冲破回天后，便见求官驿马头。
其法为：正月起寅，二月起丑，三月起子，四月起亥，五月起戌，六月起酉，七月起申，八月起未，九月起午，十月起巳，十一月起辰，十二月起卯，逆数十二位是也。
yi: （10）鬼谷子的雷火杀例说：雷火要在寅、亥、申、巳里找，四孟之中先要知道有惊恐忧虑；一旦立刻冲破，就回到天后，便能看到求官驿马的起头。
它的算法是：正月起寅，二月起丑，三月起子，四月起亥，五月起戌，六月起酉，七月起申，八月起未，九月起午，十月起巳，十一月起辰，十二月起卯，就是逆数十二位。
en: (10) The Guigu-zi's rule for the Thunder-Fire baleful spirit says: look for the Thunder-Fire among Yin, Hai, Shen and Si; among the four Meng first know of fright and worry; as soon as it is clashed and broken it returns to Tianhou, and one sees the head of the seeker's Post Horse.

Its method: begin at Yin in the first month, Chou in the second, Zi in the third, Hai in the fourth, Xu in the fifth, You in the sixth, Shen in the seventh, Wei in the eighth, Wu in the ninth, Si in the tenth, Chen in the eleventh, Mao in the twelfth, which is counting backwards through the twelve places.

title: 卜筮元龟·求官总断：抑身扶世求官得，天驿相生允不刻，更逢鬼旺讵相疑（例：二月坤之升卦）

rule.yi: 求官，压住身、扶助世就能得官；天驿互相生扶，允许不用拖延；再逢官鬼旺相，哪里还有怀疑——例如二月占得坤之升卦。
rule.en: In seeking office, with the Body held down and the Self supported the office is gained; with the Heavenly Post mutually generating, it is promised there will be no delay; and with Pressure also strong how could there be doubt — as for example in the second month the hexagram Kun changing to Sheng.

note.yi: 「抑身扶世」没说是哪一爻压住身、哪一爻扶世；「天驿」没有解释，可能指天喜、驿马，这里照字面译成 Heavenly Post；「允不刻」的「不刻」也没有解释，这里读作「不拖延」，不确定。「卜筮元龟」是断易天机转引的书名。
note.en: The text does not say which line holds down the Body or supports the Self; 'tianyi' is not explained and may mean the Joy star and the Post Horse, and it is rendered literally as Heavenly Post; the 'bu ke' of 'it is promised not to be ...' is not explained either and is read here as 'no delay', which is uncertain. 'Bushi Yuangui' is the name of a book quoted by the Duanyi Tianji.

yi: 压住身、扶助世，求官就能得到；
天驿互相生扶，允许不用拖延；
再逢官鬼旺相，哪里还有怀疑；
二月占得坤之升卦就是这样。
en: with the Body held down and the Self supported, the office is gained;
with the Heavenly Post mutually generating, it is promised there will be no delay;
and meeting a strong Pressure besides, how could there be doubt;
in the second month the hexagram Kun changing to Sheng is such a case.

title: 卜筮元龟·占求官是何时：扶鬼以为期；鬼值火时应急速、如临水日事将迟

rule.yi: 问求官在什么时候，答：以扶助官鬼的时候作为期限；官鬼值火的时候，应验得快；如果碰上水的日子，事情就迟。
rule.en: Asked when the office will come, the answer is: take the time that supports Pressure as the term; when Pressure meets a Fire time the answer is quick, and if it meets a Water day the matter will be slow.

yi: 有人占问（求官）是在什么时候，
回答说：以扶助官鬼的时候作为期限；
官鬼值火的时候，应验得快；
如果碰上水的日子，事情就将迟缓。
en: If someone asks when it will be,
the answer is: take the time that supports Pressure as the term;
when Pressure meets a Fire time the answer is quick;
if it meets a Water day, the matter will be slow.

title: 卜筮元龟·求官不成之象：官鬼空亡及冲破，世应俱值尤难拟；官爻带杀克身凶，纵得官而复返止（例：正月损之临，上九寅爻带杀阴）

rule.yi: 官鬼落空亡或被冲破，世、应又都遇上这种情形，尤其难以指望；官爻带杀克身，是凶，纵然得到官也会反过来中止。例子：假定正月占得损之临，上九的寅爻带阴杀，举这一爻作为定例，不必再久久思量。
rule.en: With Pressure Void or clashed and broken, and the Self and the Other both meeting the same, it is all the harder to count on; with the Pressure line carrying a baleful spirit and controlling the self it is bad, and even if the office is gained it will turn back and stop. For example, suppose in the first month the hexagram Sun changing to Lin, with the top line, a nine, Yin carrying a yin baleful spirit: take this one line as the fixed example, and there is no need to ponder longer.

yi: 官鬼落空亡以及被冲破，
世、应又都遇上这种情形，尤其难以指望；
官爻带杀克身，是凶；
纵然得到官，也会反过来中止。
假定正月占得损之临，
上九的寅爻带阴杀，
举这一爻作为定例，
哪里还需要再久久思量。
en: Pressure Void or clashed and broken,
with the Self and the Other both meeting the same, it is all the harder to count on;
the Pressure line carrying a baleful spirit and controlling the self is bad;
even if the office is gained it will turn back and stop.
suppose in the first month the hexagram Sun changing to Lin,
with the top line, a nine, Yin carrying a yin baleful spirit,
take this one line as the fixed example,
what need is there to ponder for long.

title: 卜筮元龟·占何年何月得官：有爻持鬼即为时，如无则取官鬼生旺之时，旺相疾速休囚迟；先看本宫旺为正

rule.yi: 要知道得官的年、月、日期：有爻持着官鬼，就以那一爻的时间为期；没有这样的爻，就取官鬼得生、得旺的时候；旺相就快，休囚就迟。先看本宫，以旺的为正，比如震取春分，其余照此类推。
rule.en: To know the year, month and term when the office is gained: if a line carries Pressure, that line's time is the term; if there is none, take the time when Pressure is born or strong; strong, it is quick, and at rest or trapped, slow. First look at the palace of the hexagram, taking the strong as the standard, for Zhen for example the Spring Equinox, and the rest likewise.

note.yi: 「震则春分余可并」的「并」没有解释，这里读作「照此类推」，不确定。
note.en: The 'bing' (join) of 'Zhen then the Spring Equinox, the rest can be joined' is not explained and is read here as 'likewise', which is uncertain.

yi: 占问哪一年哪一月得官，（卜筮元龟）说：
要知道得官的年、月、日期，
有爻持着官鬼，就以那一爻的时间为期；
如果没有这样的爻，就取官鬼得生、得旺的时候；
旺相就快，休囚就迟。
先看本宫，以旺的为正，
比如震就取春分，其余的可以照此合并（类推）。
en: On divining in which year and month the office is gained, it says:
To know the year, month and term when the office is gained,
if a line carries Pressure, that line's time is the term;
if there is none, take the time when Pressure is born or strong;
strong, it is quick; at rest or trapped, it is slow.
First look at the palace of the hexagram, taking the strong as the standard,
for Zhen for example the Spring Equinox, and the rest can be joined to it in the same way.

title: 卜筮元龟·占迁官日月期：例——得纯乾，日月为寅，戌土持世，官鬼爻午火生旺，断正月、五月得无疑

rule.yi: 占迁官（调任升迁）的日月期限，举例：占得纯乾卦，日月是寅，戌土持世，官鬼爻午火得生、旺相，断定正月、五月得官调动，没有疑问。
rule.en: For the day and month of a transfer of office, an example: with the hexagram pure Qian, the day and month at Yin, Xu Earth holding the Self, and the Pressure line Wu Fire born and strong, one judges that the first and fifth months will bring the transfer, without doubt.

yi: 占迁官（调任升迁），（卜筮元龟）说：
凡是占迁官的日月期限，
比如得到纯乾卦，
日月是寅，
戌土持世，
官鬼爻午火得生、旺相，
断定正月、五月得官调动，没有疑问。
