en: On divining a transfer of office, it says:
For the day and month of a transfer of office,
for example if the hexagram is pure Qian,
with the day and month at Yin,
Xu Earth holding the Self,
and the Pressure line Wu Fire born and strong,
one judges that the first and fifth months will bring the transfer, without doubt.

title: 卜筮元龟·占加官：看两鬼，一鬼持卦身，太岁与鬼并、月建与鬼并；注：官鬼持世或持卦身求官可中、有职者可加官（例：升卦）

rule.yi: 占加官（加官进爵），看两个官鬼：一个鬼来持卦身，太岁和鬼并在一起，月建和鬼并在一起（原文「基阁」「外基」难解）。注文说：卦中官鬼爻持世或持卦身，求官可以中选，已有职位的人还可能升官；比如升卦，两个官都是酉金，临月卦身，世爻丑土是金的墓库，是有职位的人可以加官的兆头。
rule.en: In divining the adding of office, look at two Pressure lines: one Pressure line comes to hold the Body of the hexagram, Tai Sui joins with Pressure, and the Month joins with Pressure (the 'jige' and 'outer ji' of the text are unclear). The note says: if the Pressure line in the hexagram holds the Self or holds the Body, one seeking office can be selected, and one who already has a post may be promoted; for example in the hexagram Sheng the two Pressure lines are You Metal standing on the monthly Body, and the Self line Chou Earth is the tomb of Metal, a sign that one with a post can be given more office.

note.yi: 「基阁」「外基」原文难解，疑有误字，这里照字面译，不补。
note.en: The 'jige' and 'outer ji' of the text are hard to read and probably contain wrong characters; they are translated literally and nothing is supplied.

zh: 一鬼来持卦身耳（1）太岁鬼并基阁加，
yi: 占加官（加官进爵），（卜筮元龟）说：
凡是占加官，看两个官鬼，
一个鬼来持卦身（1），太岁和鬼并在一起，「基阁」加上；
月建和鬼并在一起，「外基」了。
en: On divining the adding of office, it says:
In divining the adding of office, look at two Pressure lines,
one Pressure line coming to hold the Body of the hexagram (1), Tai Sui joined with Pressure, the 'jige' added;
the Month joined with Pressure, 'outer ji' indeed.

zh: （1）卦中官鬼爻持世或持卦身，求官可中，有职者还可能升官。
如升卦，卦中两官为酉金，临月卦身，世爻丑土为金之墓库，是有职可加官之兆也。
yi: （1）卦中官鬼爻持世或持卦身，求官可以中选，已有职位的人还可能升官。
比如升卦，卦中两个官都是酉金，临月卦身，世爻丑土是金的墓库，是有职位的人可以加官的兆头。
en: (1) If the Pressure line in the hexagram holds the Self or holds the Body, one seeking office can be selected, and one who already has a post may be promoted.

For example in the hexagram Sheng, the two Pressure lines are You Metal, standing on the monthly Body, and the Self line Chou Earth is the tomb of Metal, which is a sign that one with a post can be given more office.

title: 卜筮元龟·占官高卑及何方赴任：卦看生旺定高低，旺相名高官贵、休囚位劣徒劳；一二三世咫尺、四五六世千里；官鬼在乾则西北；注：鬼爻逢长生帝旺官职高、逢衰病死墓绝官职卑

rule.yi: 要知道任所的好坏和官职的高低，看卦的生旺来定分寸：旺相，名声高、官尊贵；休囚，位置低劣，更是白劳。一、二、三世卦，说是咫尺之近；四、五、六世卦，是千里之外的驿程；若问注定在哪里做官，官鬼爻落在乾，就是去西北。注文说：鬼爻逢长生、帝旺，官职高；逢衰、病、死、墓、绝，官职卑。
rule.en: To know whether the post is good or bad and whether it is high or low, look at the strength of the hexagram to settle the degree: strong, the name is high and the office honoured; at rest or trapped, the position is poor and effort is all the more in vain. The First, Second and Third Generations are said to be a hand-span away, the Fourth, Fifth and Sixth a post-road of a thousand li; if one asks where one is destined to hold office, with the Pressure line in Qian one goes to the northwest. The note says: if the Pressure line meets the Birth or Peak stage the post is high, and if it meets Decline, Sickness, Death, Tomb or Extinction the post is low.

zh: 占官高卑及何方赴任云：
yi: 占官位的高低、以及到什么方位赴任，（卜筮元龟）说：
要知道任所的好坏和官职的高低，
就看卦的生旺来定它的分寸；
旺相，名声高、官也尊贵；
休囚，地位低劣，更是白劳。
一、二、三世卦，说是咫尺之近；
四、五、六世卦，是千里之外的驿程；
若问注定在哪里做官，
官鬼爻落在乾，就是去西北任职。
en: On divining the height of the post and in which direction one takes up office, it says:
To know whether the post is good or bad and whether it is high or low,
look at the strength of the hexagram to settle its degree;
strong, the name is high and the office honoured;
at rest or trapped, the position is poor and effort is all the more in vain.
the First, Second and Third Generations are said to be a hand-span away;
the Fourth, Fifth and Sixth are a post-road of a thousand li;
if one asks where one is destined to hold office,
with the Pressure line in Qian, one goes to the northwest to take up the post.

zh: 逢衰、病、死、墓、绝者，官职卑。
yi: （2）鬼爻逢长生、帝旺的，官职高；
逢衰、病、死、墓、绝的，官职卑。
en: (2) If the Pressure line meets the Birth or Peak stage, the post is high;
if it meets Decline, Sickness, Death, Tomb or Extinction, the post is low.

title: 卜筮元龟·占官得替否：若无鬼爻官得替，亦得去无留滞，子爻发动亦如之，财动必依此计

rule.yi: 占官员能否得到接替（卸任）：如果没有官鬼爻，官就能得到接替，也就能离去、没有滞留；子孙爻发动也是这样；财动，也一定照这个算。
rule.en: On divining whether an official will be replaced: if there is no Pressure line, the official will be replaced and can go without being held back; Output moving is the same, and with Wealth moving it is sure to be reckoned in the same way.

yi: 占官员能否得到替代（卸任），（卜筮元龟）说：
如果没有官鬼爻，官就能得到接替，
也就得以离去，没有滞留；
子孙爻发动也是这样；
财动，一定也照这个算。
en: On divining whether an official will be replaced, it says:
If there is no Pressure line, the official will be replaced,
and can go, without being held back;
Output moving is the same;
with Wealth moving, it is sure to be reckoned in the same way.

title: 卜筮元龟·占现任官得多少时：子动克官官位失，财发印亡忧禄秩；欲知失位多少时，退度在二三月日；注：财爻发动克父母则可能追缴印绶

rule.yi: 占现任官还能做多久：子孙动克官鬼，官位就丢；财发动、印（父母）亡，要担忧俸禄品秩；要知道丢官位要多久，退度在二、三个月或日子。注文说：子孙爻动克官鬼，有失官位的兆头；财爻发动克父母，可能被追缴印绶。
rule.en: On divining how long a serving official can remain: Output moving and controlling Pressure, the post is lost; with Wealth moving and the seal lost, worry for the salary and rank; to know how long until the post is lost, the retreating degree is in two or three months or days. The note says: Output moving and controlling Pressure is a sign of losing the post; Wealth moving and controlling Resource may lead to the seal and ribbon being recalled.

note.yi: 「退度」原文没有解释；后面占居官安否的注（5）说「得度为安，退度为失」，可以参看。
note.en: 'Retreating degree' is not explained; the note (5) under the divination of whether an official in post is secure says 'gaining the degree is secure, the retreating degree is loss', which can be compared.

yi: 占现任官还能做多久，（卜筮元龟）说：
子孙动克官鬼，官位就丢；
财发动、印（父母）亡，要担忧俸禄品秩；
要知道丢官位要多久，
退度在二、三个月或日子。
en: On divining how long a serving official can remain, it says:
Output moving and controlling Pressure, the post is lost;
with Wealth moving and the seal lost, worry for the salary and rank;
to know how long until the post is lost,
the retreating degree is in two or three months or days.

zh: （3）子孙爻动克官鬼，有失官位之兆。
财爻发动克父母，则可能追缴印绶。
yi: （3）子孙爻动克官鬼，有失官位的兆头。
财爻发动克父母，则可能被追缴印绶。
en: (3) Output moving and controlling Pressure is a sign of losing the post.
Wealth moving and controlling Resource may lead to the seal and ribbon being recalled.

title: 卜筮元龟·占居官有疾病否：卦变为囚死乡居官身病至衰亡；无气带杀终有祸、更值空亡必有丧；鬼动逢休废地则退位终无位；胎没并之世自微、加刑杀为衰

rule.yi: 占在任的官有没有疾病：卦变成囚、死之地，在任的人身体有病以至衰亡；无气又带杀，终究有祸，再遇上空亡必有丧事；官鬼发动而遇休、废之地，这个人退位后终究没有官位；胎、没再并上，世就自然衰微，再加刑、杀，就是衰败。
rule.en: On divining whether an official in post will fall ill: when the hexagram changes into a trapped or dead place the one in office falls ill, even to decline and death; without qi and carrying a baleful spirit there is in the end calamity, and meeting Void as well there is surely a death; if Pressure moves and meets a place of rest or abandonment, the man leaves his post and in the end has none; with Embryo and Sunk joined to it the Self is naturally weak, and with punishment and baleful spirits added it is decline.

yi: 占在任的官有没有疾病，（卜筮元龟）说：
凡是卦变成囚、死之地，
在任的人身体有病，以至衰亡；
无气又带杀，终究有祸；
再遇上空亡，必有丧事。
官鬼发动，如果遇到休、废之地，
这个人退位后终究没有官位；
胎、没再并上，世就自然衰微；
再加上刑、杀，就是衰败了。
en: On divining whether an official in post will fall ill, it says:
Whenever the hexagram changes into a trapped or dead place,
the one in office falls ill, even to decline and death;
without qi and carrying a baleful spirit, there is in the end calamity;
meeting Void as well, there is surely a death.
If Pressure moves and meets a place of rest or abandonment,
the man leaves his post and in the end has none;
with Embryo and Sunk joined to it, the Self is naturally weak;
with punishment and baleful spirits added, it is decline indeed.

title: 卜筮元龟·占求官任所有无：父母爻为诰牒、任官之处是其财；财落空亡无任所，空持诰牒意徘徊；父母被危诰身破、财爻被破任官危；岁月之冲须重说、日辰之克可轻挂

rule.yi: 占求官有没有任所：父母爻是诰牒（任命书），任官的地方就是它的财；财落空亡，就没有任所，空握着诰牒、心意徘徊；父母被危，诰身就破；财爻被破，任官就危险；岁月的冲要加重来说，日辰的克可以看轻。注文举例：甲辰旬占得乾宫卦，甲寅为财，甲辰旬里寅、卯空，财落空亡，表示没有俸禄、没有任职之处。
rule.en: On divining whether one seeking office will have a post to go to: the Resource line is the patent of appointment, and the place of the post is its Wealth; with Wealth fallen Void there is no post, and holding the patent in vain one's mind wavers; with Resource endangered the patent is spoiled; with the Wealth line broken, taking office is perilous; a clash by the year or the month is to be weighed heavily and a control by the Day can be taken lightly. The note gives an example: if a hexagram of the Qian palace is cast in the Jiachen decade, Jiayin is Wealth, and in the Jiachen decade Yin and Mao are void, so Wealth falls Void, which shows no salary and nowhere to take office.

note.yi: 「诰身」应指任命的告身文书，原文没有解释，这里照字面译作 patent。
note.en: 'Gaoshen' presumably means the written patent of appointment; the text does not explain it, and it is rendered as 'patent'.

yi: 占求官有没有任所，（卜筮元龟）说：
父母爻是诰牒（任命书），
任官的地方就是它的财；
财落空亡，就没有任所；
空握着诰牒，心意徘徊不定（4）。
父母被危，诰身（任命文书）就破；
财爻被破，任官就危险；
岁月的冲要加重来说；
日辰的克可以看轻。
en: On divining whether one seeking office will have a post to go to, it says:
the Resource line is the patent of appointment,
and the place of the post is its Wealth;
with Wealth fallen Void there is no post;
holding the patent in vain, one's mind wavers (4).
with Resource endangered, the patent is spoiled;
with the Wealth line broken, taking office is perilous;
a clash by the year or the month is to be weighed heavily;
a control by the Day can be taken lightly.

zh: （4）如甲辰旬卜得乾宫卦，甲寅为财，甲辰旬中寅卯空，财落空亡，则表示无俸禄，无处任职也。
yi: （4）比如甲辰旬占得乾宫卦，甲寅为财，甲辰旬中寅、卯空，财落空亡，就表示没有俸禄、没有任职之处。
en: (4) For example if a hexagram of the Qian palace is cast in the Jiachen decade, Jiayin is Wealth, and in the Jiachen decade Yin and Mao are void, so that Wealth falls Void, which shows no salary and nowhere to take office.

title: 卜筮元龟·占居官安否：世宫为官应为民；子爻来克鬼则在位彷徨忧退位；旺相相生六位安、居官无事吏民欢；财动必忧亡失位；休囚墓杀细推看

rule.yi: 占在任的官安不安：世宫是官，应是百姓；主首、监临，世就是自身；如果有子孙爻来克官鬼，在位的人心神彷徨，担忧退位；旺相相生，六位都安，居官平安无事、吏民欢喜；财动，必定担忧丢失官位；遇休囚、墓、杀，要仔细推看。注文说：父母爻是主首，月卦是自己的身；得度就安，退度就失。
rule.en: On divining whether an official in post is secure: the Self palace is the official and the Other is the people; for the headman and the overseer the Self is oneself; if Output comes to control Pressure, the one in post is uneasy and worries about leaving his place; strong and generating one another, all six places are secure, the official in post is without trouble and clerks and people are glad; with Wealth moving one is sure to worry about losing the post; meeting rest, trapped, tomb or baleful spirits, reckon with care. The note says: the Resource line is the headman and the monthly hexagram is oneself; gaining the degree is secure and the retreating degree is loss.

yi: 占在任的官安不安，（卜筮元龟）说：
世宫是官，应是百姓；
主首、监临，世就是自身（5）；
如果有子孙爻来克官鬼，
在位的人心神彷徨，担忧退位；
旺相相生，六位都安，
居官平安无事，吏民欢喜；
财动，必定担忧丢失官位；
休囚、墓、杀，要仔细推看。
en: On divining whether an official in post is secure, it says:
the Self palace is the official and the Other is the people;
for the headman and the overseer, the Self is oneself (5);
if Output comes to control Pressure,
the one in post is uneasy and worries about leaving his place;
strong and generating one another, all six places are secure,
the official in post is without trouble and clerks and people are glad;
with Wealth moving, one is sure to worry about losing the post;
at rest, trapped, in a tomb or with a baleful spirit, reckon with care.

zh: 人得进度为安，退度为失。
yi: （5）父母爻是主首，月卦是自己的身。
人得进度就安，退度就失。
en: (5) The Resource line is the headman, and the monthly hexagram is oneself.
If one gains the advancing degree one is secure; the retreating degree means loss.

title: 洞林秘诀·求官（一）：驿马、龙德与青龙最旺加迁禄位荣；飞伏六爻宜细取、须知四直用心攻；更须印绶并诸德，生旺值时必显通（例：道明占剥之晋，癸酉无期、丙子逢）

rule.yi: 驿马、龙德和青龙，最旺的时候，加官升迁、禄位荣耀；飞、伏的六爻要细细取用，要知道四直，得用心去研究；还要有印绶和各种德神，逢生旺、值时，必定显达亨通。例：从前道明占得剥之晋卦，癸酉（日）无望，丙子（日）才遇上。
rule.en: The Post Horse, Dragon Virtue and the Azure Dragon, at their strongest, bring promotion and glory of emolument and rank; the six lines, flying and hidden, should be taken with care, and one must study the four rulers closely; besides, with the seal and ribbon and the various Virtues, meeting birth and strength at the right time one is sure to rise to prominence. For example, in the past Daoming got the hexagram Bo changing to Jin, with no prospect on Guiyou and meeting it on Bingzi.

note.yi: 「洞林秘诀」是断易天机转引的书名。「龙德」是一颗神煞，这里没有解释；「道明」应是人名。
note.en: 'Dongling Mijue' is the name of a book quoted by the Duanyi Tianji. 'Dragon Virtue' is a spirit-star that is not explained here, and 'Daoming' is presumably a personal name.

yi: 驿马、龙德和青龙，
最旺的时候，加官升迁，禄位荣耀；
飞、伏的六爻要细细取用；
要知道四直，得用心去研究。
还要有印绶和各种德神，
逢生旺、值时，必定显达亨通；
从前道明占得剥之晋卦，
癸酉（日）无望，丙子（日）才遇上。
en: The Post Horse, Dragon Virtue and the Azure Dragon,
at their strongest, bring promotion and glory of emolument and rank;
the six lines, flying and hidden, should be taken with care;
know that the four rulers are to be studied closely.
and besides, the seal and ribbon together with the various Virtues,
meeting birth and strength at the right time, one is sure to rise to prominence;
in the past Daoming got the hexagram Bo changing to Jin,
with no prospect on Guiyou and meeting it on Bingzi.

title: 洞林秘诀·求官（二）：鬼爻旺相无刑克、遇扶持则高显得；杀神与世动克官则凶、虚费身心求不获

rule.yi: 官鬼爻旺相、没有刑克，如果再遇扶持，就能得高位显达；杀神和世发动来克官，是凶，白费身心、求不到。
rule.en: With the Pressure line strong and not punished or controlled, if it also meets support, high and distinguished rank is gained; a baleful spirit and the Self moving to control Pressure is bad, and body and mind are spent in vain and it is not obtained.

yi: 官鬼爻旺相、没有刑克，
如果再遇扶持，就能得高位显达；
杀神和世发动来克官，是凶；
白费身心，求不到。
en: With the Pressure line strong and not punished or controlled,
if it also meets support, high and distinguished rank is gained;
a baleful spirit and the Self moving to control Pressure is bad;
body and mind are spent in vain and it is not obtained.

title: 洞林秘诀·求官（三）：太岁求官常赴诏；太岁与官爻并于九五或持世有威声；更得印绶相符合，圣人常挂记君名

rule.yi: 太岁（扶）求官，常常赴诏入朝；如果太岁在宫来，得台省之力；太岁和官爻并在九五，或者持世，有威名声势；再得印绶相符合，圣人常常挂念记着你的名字。注文说：官爻有气，遇升印卦利武职、升阳卦利文官；官鬼爻和印绶相生相扶，就是得地；如果杀神和世爻发动克官鬼，白劳一场、空手而返；太岁动扶官，主赴诏。太岁在九五与官爻并，或者持世，这人威名显赫；再得印绶相辅，君王时常记挂他。
rule.en: With Tai Sui supporting one seeking office, one is often summoned to court by edict; if Tai Sui comes in the palace, one gets the help of the censorate and secretariat; with Tai Sui and the Pressure line joined on the fifth line, or holding the Self, one has authority and fame; and if the seal and ribbon are also in accord, the sage ruler often keeps your name in mind. The notes say: with the Pressure line having qi, meeting a 'rising seal' hexagram favours military office and a 'rising yang' hexagram civil office; the Pressure line and the seal and ribbon generating and supporting each other is being well placed; if a baleful spirit and the Self line move to control Pressure, one labours in vain and returns empty-handed; Tai Sui moving to support the Pressure line means going to court on summons. Tai Sui on the fifth line together with the Pressure line, or holding the Self, makes the man famous and eminent, and with the seal and ribbon also helping, the sovereign often keeps him in mind.

note.yi: 「升印卦」「升阳卦」注文没有解释，这里照字面译；「太岁在宫来台省力」的「宫」没有说是哪一宫，也不补。
note.en: 'Rising seal hexagram' and 'rising yang hexagram' are not explained in the note and are translated literally; the 'palace' of 'Tai Sui comes in the palace' is not said to be which palace, and nothing is supplied.

yi: 太岁（扶）求官，常常赴诏入朝；
如果太岁在宫来，得台省之力（1）；
太岁和官爻并在九五，
或者持世，有威名声势；
再得印绶相符合，
圣人常常挂念记着你的名字（2）。
en: Tai Sui supporting one seeking office, one is often summoned to court by edict;
if Tai Sui comes in the palace, one gets the help of the censorate and secretariat (1);
with Tai Sui and the Pressure line joined on the fifth line,
or holding the Self, one has authority and fame;
and if the seal and ribbon are also in accord,
the sage ruler often keeps your name in mind (2).

zh: (1)官爻有气，遇升印卦，利武职，升阳卦，利文官。
官鬼爻和印绶相生相扶，即得地也。
如杀神和世爻动克鬼，空劳枉返不遂意也。
yi: （1）官爻有气，遇到升印卦，利于武职；升阳卦，利于文官。
官鬼爻和印绶互相生扶，就是得地。
如果杀神和世爻发动克官鬼，白劳一场、空手而返，不能如意。
太岁发动扶助官爻，主赴诏入朝。
en: (1) With the Pressure line having qi, meeting a 'rising seal' hexagram favours military office; a 'rising yang' hexagram favours civil office.
The Pressure line and the seal and ribbon generating and supporting each other is being well placed.
If a baleful spirit and the Self line move to control Pressure, one labours in vain and returns empty-handed, not as one wishes.
If Tai Sui moves to support the Pressure line, it means going to court on summons.

zh: (2)太岁在九五与官爻并，或者持世，此人威名显赫。
更得印绶相辅，主君王时常记挂此人。
yi: （2）太岁在九五与官爻并在一起，或者持世，这个人威名显赫。
再得印绶相辅，主君王时常记挂这个人。
en: (2) If Tai Sui is on the fifth line together with the Pressure line, or holds the Self, the man is famous and eminent.
If the seal and ribbon also help, the sovereign often keeps this man in mind.

title: 洞林秘诀·求官（四）：官爻在内任所近、在外须还远地差；太岁与官并入内或居九五则步金阶

rule.yi: 官爻在内卦，任所就近；在外卦，就要被差到远地。太岁和官并在一爻、进入内卦，或者居在九五，就能踏上金阶（入朝）。
rule.en: With the Pressure line inside, the post is near; outside, one is sure to be sent to a distant place. With Tai Sui and Pressure joined on one line and entering the inner part, or standing on the fifth line, one steps up the golden stairs.

yi: 官爻在内卦，任所就近；
在外卦，就要被差到远地。
太岁和官并在一爻、进入内卦，
或者居在九五，就能踏上金阶。
en: With the Pressure line inside, the post is near;
outside, one is sure to be sent to a distant place.
with Tai Sui and Pressure joined on one line and entering the inner part,
or standing on the fifth line, one steps up the golden stairs.

title: 洞林秘诀·求官（五）：求官官鬼是官科，子动求官节节嗟；父母发为印绶，财爻发动破官科；空亡入鬼忧空返，劫杀逢官奈失何

rule.yi: 求官，官鬼是官科；子孙动，求官步步叹息。父母发动的时候是印绶；财爻发动，破了官科。空亡落在鬼上，怕空手而回；劫杀遇上官，失官又能怎么办。
rule.en: In seeking office Pressure is the official department; with Output moving, seeking office is a matter of sighs at every step. When Resource moves it is the seal and ribbon; when the Wealth line moves it breaks the official department. Void falling on Pressure, fear returning empty-handed; the Robbery Killing meeting the office, what can be done about the loss.

yi: 求官，官鬼是官科（官的门类）；
子孙动，求官步步叹息。
父母发动的时候是印绶；
财爻发动，破了官科；
空亡落在鬼上，怕空手而回；
劫杀遇上官，失官又能怎么办。
en: In seeking office, Pressure is the official department;
with Output moving, seeking office is a matter of sighs at every step.
when Resource moves it is the seal and ribbon;
when the Wealth line moves it breaks the official department;
Void falling on Pressure, fear returning empty-handed;
the Robbery Killing meeting the office, what can be done about the loss.

title: 洞林秘诀·求官（六）：杀在官中来克世，人因官鬼损身多；官临旺相如高山岭，位入休囚如浅水河

rule.yi: 杀在官鬼里来克世，人因为官鬼而损身的很多；官临旺相，如高山峻岭；位入休囚，如浅水之河。
rule.en: A baleful spirit within the Pressure line coming to control the Self: many are those who lose themselves through Pressure; Pressure on a strong place is like high mountains and ridges, and in a place at rest or trapped like a shallow stream.

yi: 杀在官鬼里来克世，
人因为官鬼而损身的很多；
官临旺相，如高山峻岭；
位入休囚，如浅水之河。
en: A baleful spirit within the Pressure line coming to control the Self,
many are those who lose themselves through Pressure;
Pressure on a strong place is like high mountains and ridges;
in a place at rest or trapped, like a shallow stream.

title: 洞林秘诀·求官（七）：印绶临龙飞上位，求之速得不蹉跎

rule.yi: 印绶落在青龙上，飞上高位，求官很快就能得到，不会蹉跎。
rule.en: With the seal and ribbon on the Dragon, one flies up to a high place, and the office is soon gained, without delay.

yi: 印绶临在龙上，飞上高位；
求官很快得到，不会蹉跎。
en: the seal and ribbon on the Dragon fly up to a high place;
seek it and it is soon gained, without delay.

title: 火珠林·求官：要官鬼有气旺相，印绶（父母）不带空亡；忌子孙发动，并忌父母与官鬼落空

rule.yi: 求官，官鬼要有气、旺相，印绶（父母爻）不带空亡；忌讳子孙发动，也忌父母和官鬼落空。
rule.en: In seeking office, Pressure must have qi and be strong and the seal and ribbon (the Resource line) must not carry Void; Output moving is to be avoided, and so are Resource and Pressure falling void.

note.yi: 「火珠林」是断易天机转引的书名，这一条在火珠林里的相同意思见 HZL.01、HZL.02。
note.en: 'Huozhulin' is the name of a book quoted by the Duanyi Tianji; the same sense in the Huozhulin itself is in HZL.01 and HZL.02.

yi: 官鬼要有气、旺相，
并且印绶不带空亡；
印绶，就是父母爻。
忌讳子孙发动，
以及父母和官鬼落空。
en: Pressure must have qi and be strong,
and the seal and ribbon must not carry Void;
the seal and ribbon are the Resource line.
Output moving is to be avoided,
as well as Resource and Pressure falling void.

title: 孙膑总断歌：始须论天喜，次看贵人方，三合百事吉，禄马最为良

rule.yi: 断卦一开始先看天喜，其次看贵人所在，三合则百事都吉，禄、马最好。
rule.en: In judging a hexagram first look at the Joy star, next at where the Noble is; three-harmony makes all things auspicious, and the Emolument and the Horse are the best.

note.yi: 这首总断歌是各种问题通用的；求官只是其中一用。歌后面括注的说明里混着今人的话，本库只引歌诀。
note.en: This general song serves every kind of question and seeking office is only one use of it. The parenthetical explanations after the song are mixed with a modern editor's words, so only the song itself is quoted.

yi: 开头先要看天喜，
其次看贵人所在的方位，
三合，百事都吉；
禄、马最好。
en: First one must look at the Joy star (Tianxi),
next look at where the Noble is,
three-harmony: all things are auspicious;
the Emolument and the Horse are the best.

title: 孙膑总断歌：父母爻兴旺，为官至侯王（测官，父母爻又为印，印旺主大贵）

rule.yi: 测官，父母爻兴旺，做官能做到侯王；父母爻又是印，印旺主大贵。
rule.en: In judging office, with the Resource line flourishing one holds office up to marquis and prince; Resource is also the seal, and a strong seal means great honour.

yi: 父母爻兴旺，
做官能做到侯王。
en: With the Resource line flourishing,
one holds office up to marquis and prince.

zh: （测官，父母爻又为印，印旺主大贵。）
yi: （测官的时候，父母爻同时又是印，印旺就主大贵。）
en: (In judging office, the Resource line is also the seal, and a strong seal means great honour.)

title: 鬼谷辨爻法·占趋谒：初乡贵、二县贵、三州贵、四朝贵、五内贵、六大贵

rule.yi: 占趋谒（拜谒贵人），按鬼谷子的爻位法：初爻是乡里的贵人，二爻是县里的贵人，三爻是州里的贵人，四爻是朝中的贵人，五爻是内廷的贵人，六爻是大贵人。
rule.en: In divining a call on a noble, by the Guigu line-position method the first line is the noble of the township, the second the noble of the county, the third the noble of the prefecture, the fourth the noble of the court, the fifth the noble of the inner court and the sixth the great noble.

zh: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
乡贵县贵州贵朝贵内贵大贵
yi: 鬼谷子的爻位法
从初爻数到六爻，依次是：
乡里的贵人、县里的贵人、州里的贵人、朝廷的贵人、内廷的贵人、大贵人
en: The Guigu method of the line positions
The first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth lines are in order:
noble of the township, of the county, of the prefecture, of the court, of the inner court, great noble

hits.text: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻

title: 周公断趋谒歌（一）：欲参高贵把爻详（按鬼谷子爻位法），内外相生喜倍常，遇青龙发动主吉庆，遇白虎发动主适当

rule.yi: 想去参见高贵的人，要把爻位仔细推详（按鬼谷子爻位法推：如贵人落在初爻，宜谒乡里的贵人）；内、外卦相生，喜事加倍；如果遇到青龙发动，主有吉庆；如果遇到白虎发动，主拜谒适当。
rule.en: To call on a person of high rank, examine the lines closely (by the Guigu line-position method: if the noble stands on the first line it is fitting to call on a noble of the township); inner and outer generating each other, joy is doubled; if the Azure Dragon moves there is good fortune; if the White Tiger moves, the call is fitting.

note.yi: 白虎一般主凶，这里却说白虎发动「很当」「趋谒适当」，是原文的说法，本库照录，不改。数字注号（1）到（10）是整理时编的。
note.en: The White Tiger generally stands for ill, yet here it is said that the White Tiger moving is 'very fitting' for a call, as the text has it; it is recorded as it stands and not altered. The numbered notes (1) to (10) were numbered in editing.

yi: 想去参见高贵的人，要把爻位仔细推详（1）；
内外相生，喜事比寻常加倍（2）；
如果遇到青龙，吉庆就飞来（3）；
如果逢到白虎发动，很恰当（4）。
en: To call on a person of high rank, examine the lines closely (1);
inner and outer generating each other, joy is more than usual (2);
if one meets the Azure Dragon, good fortune comes flying (3);
if the White Tiger is met moving, it is very fitting (4).

zh: (1)若要拜谒贵人，以鬼谷子爻位法推之。
如贵人临初爻，宜谒乡贵之类。
yi: （1）若要拜谒贵人，用鬼谷子的爻位法来推。
比如贵人落在初爻，就宜去拜谒乡里的贵人，其余类推。
en: (1) To call on a noble, reckon by the Guigu line-position method.
For example if the Noble stands on the first line, it is fitting to call on a noble of the township, and so on.

zh: (2)若得内外卦相生，则主遇贵有喜也。
yi: （2）如果得内、外卦相生，就主见到贵人有喜事。
en: (2) If the inner and outer trigrams generate each other, it means joy in meeting the noble.

yi: （3）如果值青龙发动，主有吉庆。
en: (3) If the Azure Dragon moves, there is good fortune.

yi: （4）如果值白虎发动，主拜谒适当。
en: (4) If the White Tiger moves, the call is fitting.

title: 周公断趋谒歌（二）：和同爱子翩翩起（世应相合、子孙发动吉利），屯滞嫌官冉冉扬（官鬼发动主困顿难行），外卦是阳兼被克，门前趋谒见凄惶

rule.yi: 世应和同、子孙（爱子）发动，轻快地兴起，主吉利；屯滞，最嫌官鬼慢慢扬起（发动），主困顿难行；外卦是阳又被内卦所克（如既济这一类），到门前拜谒，只见凄惶而归。
rule.en: With Self and Other in harmony and the beloved son (Output) moving, one rises lightly and gaily, which is auspicious; stagnation: Pressure slowly rising (moving) is disliked and means being stuck and hard to proceed; with the outer trigram yang and also controlled by the inner (as in a hexagram such as Jiji), at the door where one calls one meets only dismay and goes home in distress.

note.yi: 「爱子」没有解释，注（5）说的是子孙爻，这里按子孙读。注（7）说「外卦属阳克内卦」，正文却说「外卦是阳兼被克」，一个是克内卦，一个是被克，两处不一致，本库照录，不改。
note.en: 'Beloved son' is not explained, and note (5) speaks of the Output line, so it is read as Output. Note (7) says 'the outer trigram being yang controls the inner trigram' while the verse says 'the outer trigram is yang and also controlled', one having it control and the other be controlled; the two do not agree and are recorded as they stand.

yi: 世应和同、子孙（爱子）发动，轻快地兴起（5）；
屯滞，嫌官鬼慢慢扬起（发动）（6）；
外卦是阳、又被克（7），
到门前拜谒，只见凄惶（8）。
en: with Self and Other in harmony and the beloved son moving, one rises lightly and gaily (5);
stagnation: Pressure slowly rising is disliked (6);
the outer trigram yang and also controlled (7),
at the door where one calls, one meets only dismay (8).

zh: (5)世应相合，子孙爻发动，主吉利。
yi: （5）世、应相合，子孙爻发动，主吉利。
en: (5) If Self and Other combine and the Output line moves, it is auspicious.

yi: （6）如果官鬼爻发动，主困顿难行。
en: (6) If the Pressure line moves, it means being stuck and hard to proceed.

zh: (7)外卦属阳克内卦，如既济卦之类。
yi: （7）外卦属阳而克内卦，比如既济卦这一类。
en: (7) The outer trigram being yang and controlling the inner trigram, as in a hexagram such as Jiji.

zh: (8)若如上受克，主趋谒会凄惶而归。
yi: （8）如果像上面这样受克，主拜谒会凄惶而归。
en: (8) If it is controlled as above, the call will end in dismay and a return.

title: 周公断趋谒歌（三）：喜神驿马兼财禄，若动应知大吉昌（天喜、驿马、财爻、禄四者发动，谒贵如意并有获财之吉）

rule.yi: 喜神、驿马兼有财、禄，如果发动，就知道大吉昌：天喜、驿马、财爻和禄这四样发动，谒见贵人如意，并且有得财的吉利。
rule.en: With the Joy spirit and the Post Horse together with Wealth and the Emolument, if they move, know that it is greatly auspicious: if the Joy star, the Post Horse, the Wealth line and the Emolument, these four, move, the call on the noble goes as one wishes and there is also the good fortune of gaining wealth.

yi: 喜神、驿马兼有财、禄（9），
如果发动，就知道大吉昌（10）。
en: the Joy spirit and the Post Horse together with Wealth and the Emolument (9),
if they move, know that it is greatly auspicious (10).

yi: （9）如果得到天喜、驿马，又有财爻和禄。
en: (9) If one gets the Joy star and the Post Horse together with the Wealth line and the Emolument.

zh: (10)以上四者发动，主谒贵如意，并有获财之吉。
yi: （10）以上四者发动，主谒见贵人如意，并有得财的吉利。
en: (10) If these four move, the call on the noble goes as one wishes, and there is the good fortune of gaining wealth.

title: 卜筮元龟·趋谒（一）：贞悔相生吉、内外相凌凶且伤；世克应则群长怒、更相鬼爻为不祥

rule.yi: 拜谒，内卦（贞）和外卦（悔）相生，吉利恰当；内外互相欺凌（相克、相冲），凶而且受伤；世克应，是众位尊长发怒，再加官鬼爻，就不祥。
rule.en: In a call, the inner trigram (zhen) and the outer (hui) generating each other is fitting and auspicious; inner and outer bullying each other (controlling or clashing) is bad and brings harm; the Self controlling the Other means the elders are angry, and with the Pressure line besides it is inauspicious.

note.yi: 「卜筮元龟」是断易天机转引的书名；「贞」是内卦、「悔」是外卦。
note.en: 'Bushi Yuangui' is the name of a book quoted by the Duanyi Tianji; 'zhen' is the inner trigram and 'hui' the outer.

yi: 内卦（贞）和外卦（悔）相生，吉利恰当；
内外互相欺凌，凶而且有伤（1）；
世克应，是说众位尊长发怒；
再加上官鬼爻，就不祥（2）。
en: The inner trigram (zhen) and the outer (hui) generating each other is fitting and auspicious;
inner and outer bullying each other is bad and brings harm (1);
the Self controlling the Other means the elders are angry;
and with the Pressure line besides, it is inauspicious (2).

zh: 内外卦相克、冲，凶且受伤害。
yi: （1）内卦和外卦相生，是吉利的。
内外卦相克、相冲，凶而且受伤害。
en: (1) Inner and outer trigrams generating each other is auspicious.
Inner and outer trigrams controlling or clashing with each other is bad and one is harmed.

zh: 若世克应或克官鬼，皆不利。
yi: （2）应、用和卦身，是所要去的地方的象。
如果世克应，或者克官鬼，都不利。
后面照此类推。
en: (2) The Other, the Subject and the Body of the hexagram stand for the place one is going to.
If the Self controls the Other or controls Pressure, it is unfavourable.
Later cases follow this.

title: 卜筮元龟·趋谒（二）：悔克贞则君主念、亦忧谗言之刑害；贞克悔为伤主心，俯仰唯须自卑钦

rule.yi: 悔（外卦）克贞（内卦），是说主人惦念你，但也要担忧谗言带来的刑害；贞克悔，是伤了主人的心，进退俯仰只须自己谦卑恭敬。注文说：终究不如相生好。
rule.en: The outer trigram controlling the inner means the host is thinking of you, but worry too about punishment and harm through slander; the inner controlling the outer means one has hurt the host's heart, and in every bearing one must humble oneself and show respect. The note says: in the end it is not as good as mutual generation.

yi: 悔（外卦）克贞（内卦），是说主人惦念你；
也要担忧刑害，来自谗言（3）；
贞（内卦）克悔（外卦），是伤了主人的心；
进退俯仰，只须自己谦卑敬重。
en: the outer trigram controlling the inner means the host is thinking of you;
but worry too about punishment and harm through slander (3);
the inner trigram controlling the outer means one has hurt the host's heart;
in every bearing one must humble oneself and show respect.

yi: （3）终究不如相生好。
en: (3) In the end it is not as good as mutual generation.

title: 卜筮元龟·趋谒（三）：应克世则君主爱；内外相生吉最；世应比和吉无凶；官鬼旺身乐无碍

rule.yi: 应克世，是说主人喜爱你；内外相生，吉利最好；世、应比和，有吉无凶；官鬼旺、身（卦身）旺，欢乐无阻碍。注文说：内外相生、世应比和、官鬼生世爻，都是吉利。
rule.en: The Other controlling the Self means the host is fond of you; inner and outer generating each other is the best auspice; Self and Other in accord is auspicious without ill; with Pressure strong and the Body strong, joy is without obstruction. The note says: inner and outer generating each other, Self and Other in accord, and Pressure generating the Self line are all auspicious.

yi: 应克世，是说主人喜爱你；
内外相生，吉利最好；
世、应比和，有吉无凶；
官鬼旺、身旺，欢乐无阻碍（4）。
en: the Other controlling the Self means the host is fond of you;
inner and outer generating each other is the best auspice;
Self and Other in accord, auspicious without ill;
with Pressure strong and the Body strong, joy is without obstruction (4).

zh: （4）内外相生，世应比和，官鬼生世爻，都为吉利。
yi: （4）内外相生，世、应比和，官鬼生世爻，都是吉利。
en: (4) Inner and outer generating each other, Self and Other in accord, and Pressure generating the Self line are all auspicious.

title: 卜筮元龟·占得见贵人否：欲见贵人占月卦（卦身），官鬼生身尤益；卦若无身又无鬼则欲见临行必止；官鬼落空亡则终不得见

rule.yi: 要见贵人，看月卦（月的卦身）：卦里有着落，就能相见；占卦要见到官鬼爻，官鬼生身更有益；卦里如果没有身、又没有鬼，想去见人临出发一定又作罢；卦中官鬼落空亡，终究见不到。注文举例：假如正月占得泰卦，月令寅和卦身上的官鬼寅并在一起，就是和那个人平等相交。
rule.en: To see a noble, look at the monthly hexagram and its Body: if the hexagram has a footing in it one can meet; in divining one must see the Pressure line, and Pressure generating the Body is all the more helpful; if the hexagram has no Body and no Pressure, one who wishes to go and see will surely stop again as he sets out; if Pressure in the hexagram falls Void, in the end one cannot see him. The note gives an example: suppose in the first month one gets the hexagram Tai, and the month branch Yin joins the Pressure Yin on the Body of the hexagram: one meets that person as an equal.

note.yi: 「卦底有着」没有解释，这里读作「卦里有着落」，不确定；注（5）的例子说的是月令与卦身官鬼相并。
note.en: 'The foot of the hexagram has it' is not explained and is read here as 'the hexagram has a footing', which is uncertain; the example in note (5) speaks of the month branch joining the Pressure line on the Body.

yi: 占问能不能见到贵人，（卜筮元龟）说：
要见贵人，占月卦（月的卦身）；
卦底有着落，就能相见（5）；
占卦要见到官鬼爻，
官鬼生身更有益、更相宜。
卦里如果没有身、又没有鬼，
想去见人，临出发一定又作罢；
卦中官鬼落空亡，
那么终究不必费心打算了（6）。
en: On divining whether one will see the noble, it says:
to see a noble, divine the monthly hexagram;
if the foot of the hexagram has something to land on, one can meet (5);
in divining the hexagram one must see the Pressure line,
and Pressure generating the Body is all the more helpful and fitting.
If the hexagram has no Body and no Pressure,
one who wishes to go and see will surely stop again as he sets out;
if Pressure in the hexagram falls Void,
then in the end there is no need to trouble to plan (6).

zh: （5）假令正月得泰卦，月令寅与卦身官鬼寅并，与其人平交也。
yi: （5）假如正月占得泰卦，月令寅和卦身上的官鬼寅并在一起，就是和那个人平等相交。
en: (5) Suppose in the first month one gets the hexagram Tai, and the month branch Yin joins the Pressure Yin on the Body of the hexagram: one meets that person as an equal.

yi: （6）终究见不到。
en: (6) In the end one cannot see him.

title: 卜筮元龟·占见常人或喜怒：内阳外阴相见美、容貌如嗔心中喜；阳爻动他出外游、阴爻动在家；外阴内阳九五相承吉昌；内阴外阳不相见；注：内为心外为貌、阴主不见阳主见、阴主喜阳主嗔

rule.yi: 占见平常人是喜是怒：内卦阳、外卦阴，相见美好，容貌像是嗔怒、心里却欢喜；阳爻动，是他出外游走，阴爻动，是他在家里；外卦阴、内卦见阳，九五相承，求见吉昌；内阴外阳，见不到面，即使见到，他嗔怒、在外面有伴。注文说：内卦是心，外卦是貌；阴主见不到、阳主见得到；阴主喜、阳主嗔；外卦阴主近、能相见，外卦阳主远、见不到；外阳内阴主不吉，见了也不相喜。
rule.en: On divining whether an ordinary person will be glad or angry on being seen: inner yang and outer yin, the meeting is fair, the face looks angry but the heart is glad; a yang line moving says he has gone out roaming, a yin line moving says he is at home; the outer trigram yin and the inner yang, with the fifth line yang on top, the call is auspicious; inner yin and outer yang, one does not meet, and even if they meet he is angry and has company outside. The notes say: the inner is the heart and the outer the countenance; yin means not meeting, yang means meeting; yin means gladness, yang means anger; outer yin means near and one can meet, outer yang means far and one cannot; outer yang with inner yin means ill luck, and even if they meet they do not take to each other.

note.yi: 「虽见哪嗔外作伴」的「哪」原文难解（疑是「那」），这里按「他嗔怒、在外有伴」译，不确定。
note.en: The 'na' of 'though they meet, he is angry (na chen) and has company outside' is hard to read (perhaps a slip for another character), and it is translated as 'he is angry and has company outside', which is uncertain.

yi: 占见平常人是喜是怒，（卜筮元龟）说：
内卦阳、外卦阴，相见美好；
容貌像是嗔怒，心里却欢喜（7）；
阳爻动，说是他出外游走；
阴爻动，说是他在家里。
外卦见阴、内卦见阳，
九五相承，求见吉昌（8）；
内阴外阳，见不到面；
即使见到，他也嗔怒，在外面有伴（9）。
en: On divining whether an ordinary person will be glad or angry on being seen, it says:
inner yang and outer yin, the meeting is fair;
the face looks angry but the heart is glad (7);
a yang line moving says he has gone out roaming;
a yin line moving says he is at home.
The outer trigram showing yin and the inner showing yang,
with the fifth line yang on top, the call is auspicious (8);
inner yin and outer yang, one does not meet;
even if they meet, he is angry and has company outside (9).

yi: （7）内卦是心，外卦是貌。
阴主见不到，阳主见得到。
阴主欢喜，阳主嗔怒。
en: (7) The inner is the heart and the outer is the countenance.
Yin means not meeting, yang means meeting.
Yin means gladness, yang means anger.

yi: （8）外卦阴，主近，能够相见。
外卦阳，主远，见不到。
en: (8) With the outer trigram yin it means near, and one can meet.
With the outer trigram yang it means far, and one cannot meet.

zh: （9）外阳内阴，主不吉，若见也不相喜。
yi: （9）外阳内阴，主不吉，即使见面也不相喜欢。
en: (9) Outer yang and inner yin means ill luck, and even if they meet they do not take to each other.

title: 卜筮元龟·占献书：旺相相生皆敏，休废不和终不允；一阴复一阳上下相生亦顺；内外俱阳应生世吉庆；阴居休囚刑杀并、相克防忧滞；外阳听顺阴不从；纯阳相生喜听、纯阴相凌似诈聋

rule.yi: 占进献书信、奏章：旺相、相生，都主顺利敏捷；休废、不和，终究不被应允；一阴又一阳、上下相生，也算相顺；内外都是阳、应生世，吉庆无疑；阴居休囚、刑杀并见、相克，要防忧愁滞碍；外卦阳，他听从，阴，他不从；有气相生就好，无气就凶；纯阳相生，他欢喜就听从；纯阴相凌，他像是装聋。注文逐条解释了阴阳相生为顺、相克为逆，以及应生世、父母爻是书信等。
rule.en: On divining the presenting of a letter or memorial: strong and generating one another, all go swiftly and smoothly; at rest or abandoned and at odds, in the end it is not granted; a yin and then a yang, upper and lower generating each other, it is also in accord; with inner and outer both yang and the Other generating the Self, good fortune is beyond doubt; yin in a place at rest or trapped with punishment and baleful spirits together, and mutual control, guard against worry and obstruction; the outer trigram yang, he listens and complies, yin, he does not follow; with qi and generating it is good, without qi bad; pure yang generating, he is glad and listens; pure yin bullying, he seems to feign deafness. The notes explain item by item that yin and yang generating each other is accord and controlling each other is opposition, that the Other generating the Self, and that the Resource line is the letter.

note.yi: 「献书」是向贵人进献书信、奏章。注（10）里「按：经云」以下的话，原文没有交代是谁的按语，照录。
note.en: 'Presenting a letter' is the offering of a letter or memorial to a noble. In note (10) the words after 'a comment' are not attributed to anyone in the text and are recorded as they stand.

yi: 占进献书信、奏章，（卜筮元龟）说：
旺相、相生，都主敏捷顺利；
休废、不和，终究不被应允；
如果得到一阴又一阳，
上下相生，也算相顺（10）。
内外都是阳、应生世，
吉庆无疑，不用再记挂（11）；
阴居于休囚，刑、杀并见，
相克，要防备到忧愁滞碍（12）。
外卦阳，他听从顺应；阴，他不从；
有气相生就好，无气就凶（13）；
纯阳相生，他欢喜就听从；
纯阴相凌，好像装聋（14）。
en: On divining the presenting of a letter or memorial, it says:
strong and generating one another, all go swiftly and smoothly;
at rest or abandoned and at odds, in the end it is not granted;
if one gets a yin and then a yang,
upper and lower generating each other, it is also in accord (10).
with inner and outer both yang and the Other generating the Self,
good fortune is beyond doubt and needs no worry (11);
with yin in a place at rest or trapped and punishment and baleful spirits together,
and mutual control, guard against worry and obstruction (12).
the outer trigram yang, he listens and complies; yin, he does not follow;
with qi and generating it is good, without qi it is bad (13);
pure yang generating, he is glad and listens;
pure yin bullying, he seems to feign deafness (14).

zh: （10）阴阳相生为顺，如恒泰之类是也。
阴阳相克为逆，未济之类是也。
按：经云：上阴即逆不乐顺。
yi: （10）阴阳相生为顺，像恒、泰这一类就是。
阴阳相克为逆，未济这一类就是。
按：经上说：上面是阴就是逆，不乐顺。
临、小过这一类就是。
en: (10) Yin and yang generating each other is accord, as in hexagrams such as Heng and Tai.
Yin and yang controlling each other is opposition, as in hexagrams such as Weiji.
A comment: the classic says that yin on top is opposition and does not take pleasure in accord.
Hexagrams such as Lin and Xiaoguo are of this kind.

zh: 应爻父母爻为书信，父母化鬼欲求官职，父母化兄欲进身求名财之事。
但父母为吉神，并之则吉也。
yi: （11）比如讼、中孚这一类，是应生世。
应爻、父母爻是书信，父母化鬼想求官职，父母化兄想进身求名财之事。
但父母是吉神，并上它就吉。
其余照此类推。
en: (11) Hexagrams such as Song and Zhongfu are cases of the Other generating the Self.

The Other line and the Resource line are the letter; Resource turning into Pressure means wanting to seek office, and Resource turning into Peer means wanting to advance oneself and seek fame and wealth.
But Resource is an auspicious spirit, and joining it is auspicious.
The rest follow this.

zh: 世居纯阴，休囚无气，并带刑杀，受克大凶。
yi: （12）纯阴发怒，纯阳欢喜。
世落在纯阴里，又休囚无气，还带着刑、杀，再受克，大凶。
书启申事，不得其意。
en: (12) Pure yin means anger, pure yang means gladness.
With the Self in pure yin, at rest or trapped without qi, carrying punishment and baleful spirits and controlled, it is very bad.
A letter or petition stating one's case will not get what it wants.

zh: 外阴如有气相生内亦吉，例如卜得家人卦是也。
yi: （13）内卦是身，外卦是君。
外卦阴如果有气相生，内卦也吉，比如占得家人卦就是。
外卦阴如果无气也凶。
还要仔细详察。
en: (13) The inner trigram is oneself and the outer trigram is the lord.
If the outer trigram is yin and has qi and generates, the inner is auspicious too, as in the hexagram Jiaren.
If the outer trigram is yin and has no qi it is also bad.
Examine it further with care.

yi: （14）纯阳相生，有气是喜；
纯阴无气、相克，是怒。
en: (14) Pure yang generating with qi is gladness;
pure yin without qi and controlling is anger.

title: 卜筮元龟·占欲见人可出不可出：阴兴之时得阴卦宜见小人、阳生之后得阳卦宜见士贤；阴卦遇阳时灭没出则被小人害、阳卦遇阴不顺出亦难同君子爱

rule.yi: 占想去见人该不该出门：阴气兴起的时候得阴卦，适宜见小人；阳气生起之后得阳卦，适宜见士人、贤者；阴卦遇上阳的时节就灭没，出门会被小人所害；阳卦遇上阴的时节不顺，出门也难得到君子的喜爱。注文说：夏至后阴气生，得阴卦是小人得时；冬至后阳气生，得阳卦是君子得时；得时则吉，失时则凶。
rule.en: On divining whether one who wishes to see someone may go out or not: when yin rises and one gets a yin hexagram it suits seeing petty people; after yang is born and one gets a yang hexagram it suits seeing scholars and the worthy; a yin hexagram meeting a yang season is extinguished, and going out one will be harmed by petty people; a yang hexagram meeting a yin season is not in accord, and going out one will hardly win the regard of the gentleman. The notes say: after the Summer Solstice yin qi is born, and getting a yin hexagram is the petty person's time; after the Winter Solstice yang qi is born, and getting a yang hexagram is the gentleman's time; in its time it is auspicious, out of its time it is bad.

zh: 占欲见人可出不可出云：
yi: 占想去见人该不该出门，（卜筮元龟）说：
阴气兴起的时候得阴卦，
相见的法则，适宜见小人（15）；
阳气生起之后得阳卦，
这时才适宜见士人、贤者（16）。
阴卦遇上阳的时节，就灭没；
出门就会被小人所害（17）；
阳卦遇上阴的时节不顺，
出门也难得到君子的喜爱（18）。
en: On divining whether one who wishes to see someone may go out or not, it says:
When yin rises and one gets a yin hexagram,
the rule for meeting is to see petty people (15);
after yang is born and one gets a yang hexagram,
this is the time to see scholars and the worthy (16).
a yin hexagram meeting a yang season is extinguished;
going out one will be harmed by petty people (17);
a yang hexagram meeting a yin season is not in accord,
and going out one will hardly win the regard of the gentleman (18).

zh: （15）夏至后阴气生，卜得阴卦，是小人得其时也。
yi: （15）夏至之后阴气生起，占得阴卦，是小人得时。
en: (15) After the Summer Solstice yin qi is born, and getting a yin hexagram is the petty person's time.

zh: （16）冬至后阳气生，卜得阳卦，是君子得其时也。
yi: （16）冬至之后阳气生起，占得阳卦，是君子得时。
得时就吉，失时就凶。
en: (16) After the Winter Solstice yang qi is born, and getting a yang hexagram is the gentleman's time.
In its time it is auspicious, out of its time it is bad.

zh: （17）阴卦遇阳时为灭没，出门易被小人之害。
yi: （17）阴卦遇上阳的时节是灭没，出门容易被小人所害。
en: (17) A yin hexagram meeting a yang season is extinguished, and going out one is easily harmed by petty people.

zh: （18）阳卦遇阴时也不顺，出门也难得和君子相见，相投。
yi: （18）阳卦遇上阴的时节也不顺，出门也难和君子相见、相投。
en: (18) A yang hexagram meeting a yin season is also not in accord, and going out it is hard to meet and get on with the gentleman.

title: 洞林秘诀·参谒（一）：先看卦名，爻动利生成，相扶相合见终美、有气如心；只忌世内克应外，其余皆可望相迎；阴爻旺相利见武、阳爻升旺见文人

rule.yi: 参见拜谒，先要看卦名；稍遇爻动，利于生成；相扶相合，见面终究美好；有气，就如心遂意。只忌世在内卦克应在外卦，其余都可以指望受到迎接；阴爻旺相，利于见武职的人；阳爻升旺，利于见文人。注文说：世爻克应爻、内卦克外卦，都不利相见；应生世、外克内，则他欢喜、盼我去求；阴爻旺相利见武职和平辈，阳爻旺相利见文职和尊长。
rule.en: In calling on someone, first look at the name of the hexagram; a little movement of a line favours bringing it about; with mutual support and combination the meeting is in the end fair, and with qi it goes as the heart wishes. Only avoid the Self in the inner trigram controlling the Other in the outer; all the rest can hope to be welcomed; a strong yin line favours seeing military men and a rising, strong yang line favours seeing literati. The notes say: the Self line controlling the Other line, or the inner trigram controlling the outer, is unfavourable for meeting; if the Other generates the Self or the outer controls the inner, he is glad and hopes I will come and ask; a strong yin line favours seeing military officials and equals, a strong yang line civil officials and elders.

note.yi: 「洞林秘诀」「海底眼」都是断易天机转引的书名。
note.en: 'Dongling Mijue' and 'Haidi Yan' are names of books quoted by the Duanyi Tianji.

yi: 参见拜谒，先要看卦名；
稍微遇到爻动，利于生成；
相扶相合，见面终究美好；
有气，就如心所愿、称心遂意。
只忌讳世在内卦克应在外卦，
其余都可以指望受到迎接（1）；
阴爻旺相，利于见武职的人；
阳爻升旺，利于见文人（2）。
en: In calling on someone, first look at the name of the hexagram;
a little movement of a line favours bringing it about;
with mutual support and combination, the meeting is in the end fair;
with qi, it goes as the heart wishes and to one's liking.
Only avoid the Self in the inner trigram controlling the Other in the outer,
all the rest can hope to be welcomed (1);
a strong yin line favours seeing military men;
a rising and strong yang line favours seeing literati (2).

zh: (1)世爻克应爻，内卦克外卦，都不利相见。
应生世，外克内，则他相喜，望我来求。
yi: （1）世爻克应爻，内卦克外卦，都不利相见。
应生世，外克内，则他相喜，盼我来求。
en: (1) The Self line controlling the Other line, or the inner trigram controlling the outer, is unfavourable for meeting.
If the Other generates the Self, or the outer controls the inner, then he is glad and hopes I will come and ask.

zh: 阳爻旺相，利见文职之人，以及尊长之类。
yi: （2）阴爻旺相，利于见武职的人；
以及平辈的朋友。
阳爻旺相，利于见文职的人，以及尊长一类。
en: (2) A strong yin line favours seeing military men;
and friends of the same generation.
a strong yang line favours seeing civil officials, and elders and the like.

title: 洞林秘诀·参谒（二）：世应本宫内外旺则不怕旬中空亡、纵然初到未见即时会遇；望财须有官鬼、伏神卦有亦强；休囚之卦宜休望、喜神动助亦寻常；休囚空亡休准拟、旺杀伤身返有伤；生合扶而不旺寻常相见正忠良

rule.yi: 世、应、本宫、内外卦都旺，就不怕旬中碰上空亡，纵然刚到的时候没能见到，不久也会遇上，很相当；指望得财，必须有官鬼，伏神在卦里也算强；休囚的卦就不要指望，有喜神发动相助也不过寻常；休囚、空亡，不要打算；旺的杀伤身，反而受伤；生合扶助的卦如果不旺，寻常相见，见到的正是忠良之人。
rule.en: With the Self, the Other, the palace and the inner and outer trigrams all strong, one need not fear meeting Void within the decade, and even if on first arriving one cannot see him, one will soon meet and it is very fitting; hoping for wealth, there must be Pressure, and a hidden spirit present in the hexagram is also strong; a hexagram at rest or trapped, give up hope, and with the Joy spirit moving to help it is still only ordinary; at rest, trapped or Void, do not plan on it; a strong baleful spirit injuring the self brings injury instead; a hexagram generated, combined and supported but not strong, one meets as usual and the one met is just a loyal and good man.

yi: 世、应、本宫、内外卦都旺，
就不怕旬中碰上空亡；
纵然刚到的时候没能见到，
不久就会遇上，很相当。
指望得财，必须有官鬼；
伏神在卦里有，也算强；
休囚的卦，就不要指望；
有喜神发动相助，也不过寻常。
休囚、空亡，不要打算；
旺的杀伤身，反而受伤；
生合扶助的卦如果不旺，
寻常相见，见到的正是忠良之人。
en: With the Self, the Other, the palace and the inner and outer trigrams all strong,
one need not fear meeting Void within the decade;
even if on first arriving one cannot see him,
one will soon meet, and it is very fitting.
hoping for wealth, there must be Pressure;
a hidden spirit present in the hexagram is also strong;
a hexagram at rest or trapped, give up hope;
with the Joy spirit moving to help, it is still only ordinary.
at rest, trapped or Void, do not plan on it;
a strong baleful spirit injuring the self brings injury instead;
a hexagram generated, combined and supported but not strong,
one meets as usual, and the one met is just a loyal and good man.

title: 海底眼·谒人：须问谒何人；世应坐鬼枉劳心；用爻出现不乘土、往见必不在家；以外卦取，外阳可见外阴不见，阴化阳宜再见阳化阴公已出；忌外卦独发伏藏，应动皆不见；一看财爻旺相出现忌发动，见官看官爻，忌世应坐鬼

rule.yi: 拜谒人，要问拜谒的是谁；世、应坐着官鬼，白费心思；用爻出现却不乘土，去见他必定不在家。又说：凡拜谒人，以外卦来取：外卦阳，可以见到，外卦阴，见不到；阴化阳，宜再次去见，阳化阴，人已经出去了；外卦要出现，他才在家；忌讳外卦单独发动或伏藏，应爻发动，都见不到；第一看财爻，旺相、出现，忌讳发动；要见官员，看官爻；忌讳世、应坐着鬼。
rule.en: In calling on someone, ask whom one is calling on; with the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure, one wearies the mind in vain; the Subject line appearing but not riding Earth, going to see him, he is surely not at home. It also says: in calling on anyone, take it from the outer trigram: outer yang, one can see him, outer yin, one cannot; yin turning into yang, it suits seeing him again, yang turning into yin, he has already gone out; the outer trigram must appear for him to be at home; avoid the outer trigram moving alone or hidden, and with the Other moving in all cases one cannot see him; first look at the Wealth line, strong and appearing, and it should not move; to see an official, look at the Pressure line; avoid the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure.

yi: 拜谒人，要问拜谒的是什么人；
世、应坐着官鬼，白费心思；
用爻出现、却不乘土，
去见他，一定不在家里。
en: In calling on someone, ask whom one is calling on;
with the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure, one wearies the mind in vain;
the Subject line appearing but not riding Earth,
going to see him, he is surely not at home.

yi: 它又说：
凡是拜谒人，
以外卦来取，
外卦阳，可以见到；
外卦阴，见不到。
阴化阳，宜再次去见；
阳化阴，人已经出去了。
要外卦出现，
他才在家。
忌讳外卦单独发动、或伏藏；
应爻发动，都见不到。
第一看财爻，
要强旺而且显现，
忌讳发动。
要见官员，看官爻；
拜谒人，要问拜谒的是谁。
忌讳世、应坐着鬼。
en: It also says:
In calling on anyone,
take it from the outer trigram,
outer yang, one can see him;
outer yin, one cannot.
yin turning into yang, it suits seeing him again;
yang turning into yin, he has already gone out.
The outer trigram must appear,
and then he is at home.
avoid the outer trigram moving alone or hidden;
with the Other moving, in all cases one cannot see him.
First look at the Wealth line,
it must be strong and appearing,
it should not move.
to see an official, look at the Pressure line;
in calling on someone, ask whom one is calling on.
avoid the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure.

title: 鬼谷辨爻法·占求事：初心事、二身事、三家事、四人事、五官事、六国事

rule.yi: 占求事（谋事），按鬼谷子的爻位法：初爻是心里的事，二爻是自身的事，三爻是家里的事，四爻是人事往来，五爻是官府的事，六爻是国家的事。
rule.en: In divining an undertaking, by the Guigu line-position method the first line is the matter of the heart, the second a personal matter, the third a household matter, the fourth dealings with people, the fifth a matter of the officials and the sixth a matter of the state.

zh: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
心事身事家事人事官事国事
yi: 鬼谷子的爻位法
从初爻数到六爻，依次是：
心里的事、自身的事、家里的事、人事往来、官府的事、国家的事
en: The Guigu method of the line positions
The first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth lines are in order:
matter of the heart, personal matter, household matter, dealings with people, matter of officials, matter of the state

hits.text: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
心事身事家事人事官事国事

title: 杜氏占求事歌：求事先看内卦，内刚柔克外所求通；内爻无气哪能共、世应空亡身心不同；内外相生俱有气事皆成就荷天公

rule.yi: 谋事，先看内卦：是阳卦还是阴卦；内卦克外卦，所求就通，外卦克内卦，难成；内卦的爻无气，即使外卦旺相，也不能共事、所求终不遂心；世、应空亡，身与心相违，与人谋事也难称意；内外卦相生、又都有气，事情都成就，像得到天公的庇佑。
rule.en: In planning a matter, first look at the inner trigram, whether it is a yang trigram or a yin one; if the inner controls the outer, what is sought goes through, and if the outer controls the inner it is hard to accomplish; if the lines of the inner trigram have no qi, then even if the outer is strong one cannot work together and what is sought is in the end not as one wishes; with the Self and the Other Void, body and heart are at odds, and in planning a matter with others it is hard to get what one wants; with inner and outer generating each other and both with qi, all matters are accomplished, as if blessed by Heaven.

note.yi: 「求事」指谋求办成一件事，不限于求官。「杜氏」是这首歌的作者，断易天机没有交代是谁。
note.en: 'Seeking a matter' means working to get a thing done and is not limited to seeking office. 'Master Du' is named as the author of the song, and the Duanyi Tianji does not say who he is.

yi: 求事先看内卦里的情形（1）；
内卦的刚柔去克外卦，所求就通（2）；
内卦的爻无气，哪里能共事（3）；
落空的地方，身与心也不一致（4）。
内外相生，又都有气（5），
事情都成就，承蒙天公庇佑（6）。
en: In seeking a matter, first look into the inner trigram (1);
if its hardness or softness controls the outer, what is sought goes through (2);
if the inner lines have no qi, how can one work together (3);
in a void place, body and heart too are not as one (4).
inner and outer generating each other and both with qi (5),
all matters are accomplished, thanks to the blessing of Heaven (6).

zh: （1）求事当先看内卦，是阳卦还是阴卦。。
yi: （1）求事应当先看内卦，是阳卦还是阴卦。
en: (1) In seeking a matter one should first look at the inner trigram, whether it is a yang trigram or a yin one.

zh: 若外卦克内卦，则主难成。
yi: （2）如果内卦克外卦，所求就能成；
如果外卦克内卦，就主难成。
en: (2) If the inner trigram controls the outer, what is sought can be accomplished;
if the outer trigram controls the inner, it means hard to accomplish.

zh: （3）若内卦无气，即使外卦旺相，所求终不能遂心。
yi: （3）如果内卦无气，即使外卦旺相，所求终究不能遂心。
en: (3) If the inner trigram has no qi, then even if the outer trigram is strong, what is sought cannot in the end be as one wishes.

zh: （4）若世应空亡，主身与心违，与人谋事，也难如心称意。
yi: （4）如果世、应空亡，主身与心相违，与人谋事，也难如心称意。
en: (4) If the Self and the Other are Void, body and heart are at odds, and in planning a matter with others it is hard to get what one wants.

yi: （5）内外卦相生，有气就吉利。
如风水涣卦这一类就是。
en: (5) Inner and outer trigrams generating each other with qi is auspicious.
The hexagram Huan (wind over water) and the like are of this kind.

yi: （6）谋事成就，好像得到天公的庇佑。
en: (6) A planned matter is accomplished as if blessed by Heaven.

title: 经验云·出行谒贵及寻人：兄鬼交重不可亲，子旺财明须吉利，父兴既去又回程

rule.yi: 出行、谒见贵人以及寻人：兄、鬼交重发动，不可亲近；子孙旺、财爻明，一定吉利；父母兴动，即使去了也会又回来。
rule.en: For travelling, calling on a noble, or looking for someone: with Peer and Pressure moving heavily one cannot get close; with Output strong and Wealth clear it is surely auspicious; with Resource rising, one who has gone will come back again.

note.yi: 「经验云」是断易天机引来的一条经验语，没有交代出处。
note.en: 'Jingyan yun' (experience says) is an empirical saying cited in the Duanyi Tianji without a source.

yi: 出行、谒见贵人以及寻人，
兄、鬼交重发动，不可亲近；
子孙旺、财爻明，一定吉利；
父母兴动，即使去了也会又回来。
en: For travelling, calling on a noble, or looking for someone,
with Peer and Pressure moving heavily, one cannot get close;
with Output strong and Wealth clear, it is surely auspicious;
with Resource rising, one who has gone will come back again.

title: 朝廷国事总纲：以世爻为主、应象为佐，六合子旺为吉、六冲杀动为凶；国泰民安全资文武匡襄；欲知宗社安危须审易爻而较量

rule.yi: 占朝廷国事，以世爻为主，应爻为辅；六合、子孙旺相的是吉，六冲、凶煞发动的是凶。国家太平、百姓安宁，靠文臣武将的匡正辅佐；想知道宗庙社稷的安危，须要审察易爻来衡量。
rule.en: In divining the affairs of the court and state, take the Self as the chief and the Other image as the aid; a six-combine and a thriving Output are auspicious, a six-clash and a moving baleful spirit are ominous. A state at peace and a people secure depend on the correction and aid of civil and military ministers; to know the safety or danger of the ancestral temple and altars, one must examine the lines of the Yi and weigh them.

note.yi: 小标是这一章的取法：世爻为主、应爻为辅。第二、三句的「冶」应是「治」（第二条解里写作「而致冶也」），译文按「治」译。「宗社乃宗庙社稷六朝延治则安」的「六朝」文意不顺，疑是「历朝」之误，译文按「历朝」译。「六合子旺」「六冲杀动」里的六合、六冲指卦的六合、六冲（见术语表）。
note.en: The subtitle gives the method of the chapter: the Self as chief, the Other as aid. In the explanation the 'ye' of 'zhi zhi ye' is presumably 'zhi', to govern, and the translation reads 'govern'. 'Liu chao yan zhi ze an' in the explanation of 'zongshe' does not run smoothly, and 'liu chao' is presumably a miswriting of 'li chao', successive dynasties, and the translation reads it so. 'Six-combine' and 'six-clash' in the subtitle are the hexagram patterns (see the glossary).

zh: 以世爻为主，应象为佐，六合子旺为吉，六冲杀动为凶。
yi: 以世爻为主，应象为佐，六合、子孙旺为吉，六冲、杀动为凶。
en: Take the Self as the chief and the Other image as the aid; a six-combine and a thriving Output are auspicious, a six-clash and a moving baleful spirit are ominous.

zh: 国泰民安，共际唐虞之化育，
河清海晏，全资文武之匡襄。
yi: 国家太平、百姓安宁，正逢唐尧虞舜那样的教化；
黄河水清、海面平静，全靠文臣武将的匡正辅佐。
en: The state at peace and the people secure, meeting the transforming influence of Tang and Yu;
the Yellow River clear and the sea calm, all depend on the aid and correction of civil and military ministers.

zh: 云国之宁靖，民之太平，幸生尧舜之世，沾其化育。
而黄河澄清，海波宁息，皆藉文臣武将之力匡扶而致冶也。
yi: 说的是国家安宁、百姓太平，有幸生在尧舜那样的时代，沾受他们的教化。
而黄河水清、海浪平息，都是借文臣武将的力量匡正扶持，才达到治理。
en: It means that the state is calm and the people at peace, and that one is fortunate to be born in the age of Yao and Shun and to share in their transforming influence.
And that the Yellow River runs clear and the waves of the sea are still is all through the strength of civil and military ministers who correct and support, and so bring about good government.

zh: 欲知宗社之安危，须审易爻而较量。
yi: 想知道宗庙社稷的安危，须要审察易爻来衡量。
en: To know the safety or danger of the ancestral temple and altars, one must examine the lines of the Yi and weigh them.

zh: 宗社乃宗庙社稷六朝延治则安，乱则危，审析易理爻辞，而可剖决吉凶也。
yi: 宗社就是宗庙社稷：国家（历朝）延续得治理好就安稳，混乱就危险；审察剖析易理爻辞，就能判断吉凶。
en: 'Zongshe' is the ancestral temple and altars of grain and soil: if the dynasty continues well governed it is secure, and if in disorder it is in danger; by examining and analysing the principles and line texts of the Yi, one can decide good and ill.

title: 朝廷国事：亲宫为邦国大忌空亡、本卦作朝堂最宜旺相；本卦是所占之卦名、亲宫是本宫之卦，皆宜旺相兴隆，大忌空亡墓绝

rule.yi: 亲宫（本宫）当作邦国，最忌空亡；本卦当作朝堂，最适宜旺相。本卦是所占得的那一卦的卦名，亲宫是本宫之卦，所以都当作邦国、朝堂，都适宜旺相兴隆，最忌空亡、墓、绝。
rule.en: The home palace is taken as the state, and Void is most to be avoided; the original hexagram is taken as the court hall, and thriving is best. The original hexagram is the name of the hexagram cast, and the home palace is the hexagram of the palace to which it belongs; so both are taken as the state and the court, both should be thriving and flourishing, and Void, tomb and extinction are most to be avoided.

note.yi: 「亲宫」书里的解释是「本宫之卦」，即占得的卦所属的那一宫（八宫之一）；这一章里的「亲宫」「本宫」是同一个意思。「旺相」是这一宫（的五行）当令得气。与易隐朝廷占「世爻所居之卦为国」（YY.32）是两种取法：易隐取世爻所在的那一个单卦，这里取整个本宫和整个本卦。
note.en: 'Qingong' is explained in the book as 'the hexagram of the home palace', that is the palace of the eight to which the hexagram cast belongs; in this chapter 'qingong' and 'home palace' mean the same. 'Thriving' means that the element of this palace is in season and has qi. This is a different way of taking it from the 'trigram in which the Self sits is the state' of the Yi Yin court divination (YY.32): the Yi Yin takes the one trigram holding the Self, and this takes the whole home palace and the whole original hexagram.

yi: 亲宫（本宫）当作邦国，最忌空亡；
本卦当作朝堂，最适宜旺相。
en: The home palace is taken as the state, and Void is most to be avoided;
the original hexagram is taken as the court hall, and thriving is best.

zh: 本卦者，乃所占之卦名，亲宫者，乃本宫之卦也，故为邦国朝堂，皆宜旺相兴隆；
yi: 本卦是所占得的那一卦的卦名，亲宫是本宫之卦，所以（它们）当作邦国、朝堂，都适宜旺相兴隆；
最忌空亡、墓、绝。
en: The original hexagram is the name of the hexagram cast, and the home palace is the hexagram of the palace to which it belongs; so they are taken as the state and the court, and both should be thriving and flourishing;
Void, tomb and extinction are most to be avoided.

title: 朝廷国事：初爻属黎元吉曜当权培国本，二爻为士子文昌得令焕文章

rule.yi: 初爻是百姓，吉星当权就能培固国家的根本；二爻是士人，文昌得令，文章就焕发光彩。初爻的百姓是国家的根本，喜欢临吉星；二爻的士人属文明，喜欢值文昌。
rule.en: The first line is the common people; if an auspicious star holds power, the root of the state is nurtured. The second line is the scholars; if Wenchang is in season, their writings shine. The people of the first line are the root of the state and like to sit on an auspicious star; the scholars of the second line belong to civilization and like to meet Wenchang.

note.yi: 初爻为民、二爻为士，与易隐朝廷占的分配（初民、二士，YY.31）相同。文昌是一颗主文运的神煞。
note.en: The first line as the people and the second as the scholars is the same assignment as in the Yi Yin court divination (the first the people, the second the scholars, YY.31). Wenchang is a spirit-star of literary fortune.

zh: 初属黎元，吉曜当权培国本；
二为士子，文昌得令焕文章。
yi: 初爻属于百姓，吉星当权，就能培固国家的根本；
二爻是士人，文昌得令，文章就焕发光彩。
en: The first line belongs to the common people; if an auspicious star holds power, it nurtures the root of the state;
the second line is the scholars; if Wenchang is in season, their writings shine.

zh: 初民为邦本，欣临吉曜，二士属文明，喜值文昌。
yi: 初爻的百姓是国家的根本，喜欢临吉星；二爻的士人属文明，喜欢值文昌。
en: The common people of the first line are the root of the state and like to sit on an auspicious star; the scholars of the second line belong to civilization and like to meet Wenchang.

title: 朝廷国事：喜聚三垣——天喜值二爻则守令贤能如龚遂；贵临四位——贵人星临四爻则卿相公侯政绩过郭子仪

rule.yi: 喜神聚在三垣，郡守县令的贤能可比渤海的龚遂：喜，就是天喜，如果值在二爻，郡守、县令的贤能就和汉代的龚遂一样，龚遂做渤海太守时，教化百姓卖掉刀剑去买耕牛。贵人临在四爻，公侯的功绩超过汾阳王：贵，就是贵人星，如果临在四爻，卿相公侯的政绩就超过唐代的郭子仪，他以文武全才辅佐肃宗收复西京，立下中兴的伟绩，受封汾阳王。
rule.en: If Joy gathers at the Three Enclosures, the worth of prefects and magistrates equals Gong Sui of Bohai: 'Joy' is the Heavenly Joy, and if it sits on the second line the ability of prefects and magistrates is like that of Gong Sui of Han, who as prefect of Bohai taught the people to sell their swords and buy oxen. If the Noble sits on the fourth line, the achievements of dukes and marquises surpass the Prince of Fenyang: 'the Noble' is the Noble star, and if it sits on the fourth line the governing record of ministers and marquises exceeds that of Guo Ziyi of the Tang, who with his gifts in both letters and arms helped Emperor Suzong recover the western capital, achieved the great work of the restoration, and was enfeoffed Prince of Fenyang.

note.yi: 「三垣」是紫微垣、太微垣、天市垣三个星区；这一联只说「喜聚三垣」，解里只解释了喜是天喜、值二爻，没有再解释三垣，译文照字面。「固守邑令」疑是「郡守邑令」之误，译文按「郡守、县令」译；「过子唐之郭令公子仪」疑是「过于唐之郭令公子仪」，译文按此译。龚遂是汉宣帝时的渤海太守，郭子仪是唐代名将、封汾阳王，这两个典故书里自己写了出来。
note.en: 'The Three Enclosures' are the three star regions Ziwei, Taiwei and Tianshi; the couplet says only 'Joy gathers at the Three Enclosures', and the explanation only explains that Joy is Heavenly Joy sitting on the second line, and does not explain the Three Enclosures further; the translation follows the letter. 'Gu shou yi ling' is presumably a miswriting of 'jun shou yi ling', and the translation reads 'prefects and magistrates'; 'guo zi Tang zhi Guo ling gong Ziyi' is presumably 'guo yu Tang zhi Guo ling gong Ziyi', surpassing the Tang Duke Guo Ziyi, and is translated so. Gong Sui was prefect of Bohai under Emperor Xuan of the Han, and Guo Ziyi was a famous Tang general enfeoffed Prince of Fenyang; the book writes out both allusions itself.

zh: 喜聚三垣，守令贤齐于渤海。
yi: 喜神聚在三垣，郡守县令的贤能可比渤海（的龚遂）。
en: If Joy gathers at the Three Enclosures, the worth of prefects and magistrates equals that of Gong Sui of Bohai.

zh: 喜者，天喜是也，若值二爻，则固守邑令贤能同于汉之龚遂也。
昔龚为渤海太守，化民卖刀买牛故云。
yi: 喜，就是天喜；如果值在二爻，郡守、县令的贤能就和汉代的龚遂一样。
从前龚遂做渤海太守，教化百姓卖掉刀剑去买耕牛，所以这样说。
en: 'Joy' is the Heavenly Joy; if it sits on the second line, the ability of prefects and magistrates is like that of Gong Sui of Han.
Formerly Gong Sui as prefect of Bohai taught the people to sell their swords and buy oxen, and that is why it is said so.

zh: 贵临四位，公侯绩迈于汾阳。
yi: 贵人临在四爻，公侯的功绩超过汾阳（郭子仪）。
en: If the Noble sits on the fourth line, the achievements of dukes and marquises surpass the Prince of Fenyang (Guo Ziyi).

zh: 贵者，贵人星也，若临四爻，则卿相公侯之政绩过子唐之郭令公子仪，郭以文武全才辅佐肃宗克复西京，中兴伟绩，赐爵汾阳王故云。
yi: 贵，就是贵人星；如果临在四爻，卿相公侯的政绩就超过唐代的郭令公子仪；郭子仪以文武全才辅佐肃宗收复西京，立下中兴的伟绩，受封汾阳王，所以这样说。
en: 'The Noble' is the Noble star; if it sits on the fourth line, the governing record of ministers and marquises exceeds that of the Tang Duke Guo Ziyi, who with his gifts in both letters and arms helped Emperor Suzong recover the western capital, achieved the great work of the restoration, and was enfeoffed Prince of Fenyang, and that is why it is said so.

title: 朝廷国事：福德司权则君子进小人退（福德即子孙，用爻值之正人在位邪佞潜踪）；青龙当道则干戈偃息文教丕兴

rule.yi: 福德（子孙）当权，君子被进用、小人退下：福德就是子孙，用爻值在子孙上，正直的人在位，邪佞的人隐藏踪迹。青龙当道，战事止息，文教大兴。
rule.en: If Fortune Virtue holds power, gentlemen advance and petty men retire: Fortune Virtue is Output, and if the Subject line sits on it, upright men are in office and the crafty and flattering hide their traces. If the Azure Dragon holds the road, arms are laid down and culture and teaching flourish.

note.yi: 「干戈偃息」是兵器收起、战事停止；「丕兴」是大兴。这一联后面书里没有解说。
note.en: 'Gan ge yan xi' is weapons put away and war stopped; 'pi xing' is flourishing greatly. The book gives no explanation after this couplet.

zh: 福德司权，君子进而小人退。
yi: 福德当权，君子进用、小人退下。
en: If Fortune Virtue, that is Output, holds power, gentlemen advance and petty men retire.

zh: 福德者，即子孙，用爻值之则正人在位，邪佞潜踪。
yi: 福德就是子孙，用爻值在它上面，正直的人在位，邪佞的人隐藏踪迹。
en: Fortune Virtue is Output; if the Subject line sits on it, upright men are in office and the crafty and flattering hide their traces.

zh: 青龙当道，干戈偃息文教丕兴。
yi: 青龙当道，战事止息，文教大兴。
en: If the Azure Dragon holds the road, arms are laid down and culture and teaching flourish.

title: 朝廷国事：圣主躬占以世爻安帝座，臣民间卜以五爻为天子

rule.yi: 君主自己占，用世爻来安放帝座；臣民代占，还是用五爻来定君王。当今皇帝亲自占的，以世爻安帝座；臣民推占的，仍以五爻为天子；各有各的道理，断然不会出错。
rule.en: When the sovereign divines for himself, set the throne by the Self line; when ministers and commoners divine on his behalf, fix the ruler by the fifth line. When the present emperor divines in person, the throne is set by the Self; when ministers and commoners divine for him, the fifth line is still taken as the Son of Heaven; each has its principle, and there will surely be no error.

note.yi: 这一条与易隐朝廷占总述（YY.31）的「主上自占以世爻为用，臣庶代卜以五爻为用」完全一致。「间卜」的「间」字义不明，疑是「闻」或「代」，译文按「代占」译。
note.en: This entry agrees exactly with the Yi Yin court overview (YY.31): 'when the sovereign divines himself, take the Self as the Subject; when ministers and commoners divine on his behalf, take the fifth line as the Subject'. The character 'jian' in 'jian bu' is unclear and is presumably 'wen' or 'dai', and the translation reads 'divine on his behalf'.

zh: 圣主躬占，当以世爻安帝座；
臣民间卜，还将五位定君王。
yi: 圣明的君主亲自占，当以世爻安放帝座；
臣民代占，还是用五爻来定君王。
en: When the wise sovereign divines in person, the throne is set by the Self line;
when ministers and commoners divine on his behalf, the ruler is still fixed by the fifth line.

zh: 云当今躬卜者，当以世爻而安帝座。
臣庶推占，仍以五爻而为天子，各得具理断无外误。
yi: 说的是当今亲自占卜的，当以世爻来安放帝座。
臣民推占的，仍以五爻为天子，各有各的道理，断然不会出错。
en: It means that one who in the present age divines in person should set the throne by the Self line.
Ministers and commoners who divine on his behalf still take the fifth line as the Son of Heaven; each has its principle, and there will surely be no error.

title: 朝廷国事：不临克害刑冲则升平四海、值生扶拱合则玉帛万方（用爻不犯克害刑冲决主四海承平万民乐业，卦内相生相合若拱若扶则殊方绝域皆来朝贡）

rule.yi: 用爻不遇克、害、刑、冲，天下升平；遇到生、扶、拱、合，四方都来献玉帛。克害刑冲各有另章的起例；用爻不犯这些的，必定是四海承平、万民乐业；卦内相生相合、有拱有扶的，连远方绝域也都来朝贡。
rule.en: If the Subject line does not meet control, harm, punishment or clash, the realm is in peace; if it meets generation, support, flanking or combination, all quarters bring jade and silk. The rules for control, harm, punishment and clash are set out in other chapters; if the Subject line is not hit by them, the four seas are at peace and the people content in their work; if within the hexagram there is generation and combination, flanking and support, even distant lands and remote regions come to pay tribute.

note.yi: 「拱」是两个爻夹着另一个爻（拱夹）。「玉帛」是诸侯朝会的礼物。「用爻」是这一联里没有写出、解里补出的主语。
note.en: 'Gong', flanking, is two lines holding another between them. 'Jade and silk' are the gifts of the feudal lords at a court assembly. The subject, the Subject line, is not written in the couplet and is supplied by the explanation.

zh: 不临克害刑冲，升平四海。
如值生扶拱合，玉帛万方。
yi: 用爻不遇克、害、刑、冲，天下升平；
如果遇到生、扶、拱、合，四方都来献玉帛。
en: If the Subject line does not meet control, harm, punishment or clash, the realm is in peace;
if it meets generation, support, flanking or combination, all quarters bring jade and silk.

zh: 克害刑冲，别章各有起例，若用爻不犯者，决主四海承平，万民乐业。
卦内相生相合，若拱若扶者，则殊方绝域皆来朝贡也。
yi: 克、害、刑、冲，别的章里各有起例；如果用爻没有犯这些，必定是四海承平、万民乐业。
卦内相生相合，有拱有扶的，远方绝域都来朝贡。
en: Control, harm, punishment and clash each have their rules in other chapters; if the Subject line is not hit by them, the four seas are surely at peace and the people content in their work.
If within the hexagram there is generation and combination, flanking and support, distant lands and remote regions all come to pay tribute.

title: 朝廷国事：宗庙管上爻安静则邦家巩固（比和安静则皇图如磐石）；岁星（太岁）关世旺相则国祚绵长

rule.yi: 宗庙由上爻掌管：上爻安静，国家就稳固。宗庙专管社稷，得到比和、安静，国家的版图就像磐石一样安稳。岁星（太岁）关系到世爻、光芒旺相的，国祚就绵长：岁星就是太岁，关系到治乱，光芒旺相；如果这样，国祚就久远无疆。
rule.en: The ancestral temple is governed by the top line: if it is still, the state is firm. The ancestral temple governs the altars of the state alone, and if it is in harmony and still, the realm is as secure as a rock. If the Year Star (Tai Sui) is linked with the Self and shines thriving, the dynasty's span is long: the Year Star is Tai Sui, it bears on order and disorder and shines thriving; if so, the dynasty lasts long without limit.

note.yi: 「岁星关世连」字面不太顺，按解里的「关乎治乱」译成「关系到世爻」；「安静」是上爻不发动。「比和安静」见 YY.39 一类的「比和」用法。太岁是当年的地支（见术语表）。
note.en: 'Sui xing guan shi lian' does not read smoothly by the letter, and following the explanation's 'bears on order and disorder' it is translated as 'is linked with the Self'; 'still' means that the top line does not move. Tai Sui is the branch of the current year (see the glossary).

zh: 宗庙管上爻，安静，则邦家巩固。
yi: 宗庙由上爻掌管，安静的话，国家就稳固。
en: The ancestral temple is governed by the top line; if it is still, the state is firm.

zh: 宗庙者，专主社稷，若得比和安静，则皇图巩盘石之安。
yi: 宗庙专管社稷，如果得到比和、安静，国家的版图就像磐石一样安稳。
en: The ancestral temple governs the altars of the state alone, and if it is in harmony and still, the realm is as secure as a rock.

zh: 岁星关世连，光芒则国祚绵长。
yi: 岁星关系到世爻，光芒旺相的话，国祚就绵长。
en: If the Year Star is linked with the Self and shines thriving, the dynasty's span is long.

zh: 岁星，即太岁也，关乎治乱光芒旺相也，若然值此，则国祚久远无疆也。
yi: 岁星就是太岁，关系到治乱，光芒旺相；如果值在这里，国祚就久远无疆。
en: The Year Star is Tai Sui; it bears on order and disorder and shines thriving; if it sits here, the dynasty lasts long without limit.

title: 朝廷国事：木位遇长生则前星焕彩（木爻属东方为青宫太子之象）；金官逢制陷则逆节潜藏（金爻属西方主兵革，鬼杀为叛逆之人，制服或随空亡墓绝则不久潜消）

rule.yi: 木爻遇到长生，前星（太子星）焕发光彩：木爻属东方，是青宫太子之象，前星也是太子之星，「焕彩」是说他得位，如果遇到长生又有气，他的德泽就广被而长久。金爻的官鬼逢到克制、陷落，就知道叛逆之人潜藏着：金爻属西方，主兵革之象，官鬼和凶煞是叛逆的人，如果被制服，或者随着空亡、墓、绝，不久就潜消。
rule.en: If a Wood line meets Birth, the Front Star (the heir's star) shines: Wood belongs to the east and is the image of the Azure Palace and the heir apparent; the Front Star is also the star of the heir; 'shines' says that he has his place, and if it meets Birth and has qi, his virtue spreads widely and lasts. If a Metal Pressure line meets restraint or sinks, then know that rebels lie hidden: Metal belongs to the west and is the image of war; Pressure and baleful spirits are the rebels, and if they are subdued, or follow Void, tomb or extinction, they soon vanish in secret.

note.yi: 第一联的原文是「木位遇长生，会购买关星焕彩」，「会购买关」是传抄的错字，按解里「前星者，亦太子之星，焕彩」应是「前星焕彩」，译文按「前星焕彩」译。「德被长生」字面不顺，译作「德泽广被而长久」。「青宫」是太子的东宫（见 YY.38）。「逆节」是叛逆的行为。
note.en: The text of the first couplet reads 'mu wei yu changsheng, hui gou mai guan xing huan cai'; 'hui gou mai guan' is a miscopy, and following the explanation, 'the Front Star is also the star of the heir; shines', it should be 'qian xing huan cai', and the translation reads 'the Front Star shines'. 'De bei changsheng' does not run smoothly by the letter and is rendered 'his virtue spreads widely and lasts'. The 'Azure Palace' is the heir apparent's Eastern Palace (see YY.38). 'Nijie' is rebellious conduct.

zh: 木位遇长生，会购买关星焕彩。
yi: 木爻遇到长生，前星（太子星）焕发光彩。
en: If a Wood line meets Birth, the Front Star shines.

zh: 木爻属东方，为青宫太子之象，前星者，亦太子之星，焕彩，言其得位，如遇长生有气，则德被长生。
yi: 木爻属东方，是青宫太子之象，前星也是太子之星；「焕彩」是说他得位，如果遇到长生又有气，他的德泽就广被而长久。
en: Wood belongs to the east and is the image of the Azure Palace and the heir apparent; the Front Star is also the star of the heir; 'shines' says that he has his place, and if it meets Birth and has qi, his virtue spreads widely and lasts.

zh: 金官逢制陷，乃知逆节潜藏。
yi: 金爻的官鬼逢到克制、陷落，就知道叛逆之人潜藏着。
en: If a Metal Pressure line meets restraint or sinks, then know that rebels lie hidden.

zh: 金爻属西方，主兵革之象，鬼杀为叛逆之人，如有制服或随空亡墓绝，则不久潜消耳。
yi: 金爻属西方，主兵革之象，官鬼和凶煞是叛逆的人，如果被制服，或者随着空亡、墓、绝，不久就潜消。
en: Metal belongs to the west and is the image of war; Pressure and baleful spirits are the rebels, and if they are subdued, or follow Void, tomb or extinction, they soon vanish in secret.

title: 朝廷国事：粮饷论妻财休临败绝（妻财为粮饷，兴隆则国本克盈，衰败则京储匮乏）；城池看父母莫变刑伤（父母为城池，旺相则金汤之固，刑伤则有残缺之虞）

rule.yi: 粮饷看妻财，不要临败、绝：妻财是粮饷，兴旺则国家的根本充盈，衰败则京城的储备匮乏。城池看父母，不要变出刑伤：父母是城池，旺相则城池固若金汤，遇刑伤就有残缺的忧患。
rule.en: Provisions are judged by Wealth, which must not sit on spent or extinct: Wealth is the grain and pay, and if it flourishes the root of the state is full, and if it is spent the capital's stores run short. The city walls are judged by Resource, which must not change into punishment or injury: Resource is the walls and moats, and if it is thriving they are as firm as walls of metal and moats of boiling water, and if punished or injured there is the worry of breaches.

note.yi: 「金汤」是金属的城、滚水的护城河，比喻极其坚固。这两联和易隐朝廷占的城池（YY.40）、帑藏（YY.41）取法相同：父母为城池，妻财为国库粮饷。
note.en: 'Jintang' are walls of metal and a moat of boiling water, an image of extreme firmness. These two couplets take the same view as the walls (YY.40) and treasury (YY.41) in the Yi Yin court divination: Resource is the city walls, and Wealth the state treasury and provisions.

yi: 粮饷看妻财，不要临在败、绝。
en: Provisions are judged by Wealth, which must not sit on spent or extinct.

zh: 妻财为粮饷，兴隆则国本克盈，衰败则京储匮乏。
yi: 妻财是粮饷，兴旺则国家的根本充盈，衰败则京城的储备匮乏。
en: Wealth is the grain and pay; if it flourishes the root of the state is full, and if it is spent the capital's stores run short.

yi: 城池看父母，不要变出刑伤。
en: The city walls are judged by Resource, which must not change into punishment or injury.

zh: 父母为城池旺相则有金汤之固，刑伤宁无残缺之虞。
yi: 父母是城池，旺相则城池固若金汤，遇到刑伤，岂能没有残缺的忧患。
en: Resource is the walls and moats; if it is thriving they are as firm as walls of metal and moats of boiling water, and if it meets punishment or injury, how can there not be the worry of breaches.

title: 朝廷国事结语：祸福攸关于大象，吉凶不离五行衰旺；筮者当察其衰旺、变通活泼、相机而断

rule.yi: 祸福关系在大象，要变通地洞察细微；吉凶离不开五行，要剖析精研衰旺。人能推究事物、获得知识，报应比影子、回声还快。祸福吉凶所关，易的大象离不开卦的五行，千姿百态哪里能都说尽？筮者应当审察五行的衰旺，自然要变通灵活，相机判断，没有不灵验的，就像回声应着声音。
rule.en: Fortune and misfortune turn on the great image, and one must adapt and perceive the faintest signs; good and ill do not leave the five elements, and one must analyse and study their strength and weakness. If a man can investigate things and gain knowledge, retribution is faster than shadow or echo. What fortune and misfortune turn on is that the great image of the Yi does not leave the five elements of the hexagram; of the thousand shapes and ten thousand states, how can all be told? The diviner should examine their strength and weakness and naturally adapt and be flexible, judging as the occasion offers, and there will be none that fail to prove true, as an echo answers a sound.

note.yi: 结语三联在书里没有标点（「祸福攸关于大象变通洞烛机微」），按对仗读成「祸福攸关于大象，变通洞烛机微」「吉凶不离于五行，剖精研衰旺」。「格物致知」出自《大学》，是推究事物、获得知识；「悉战」疑是「悉载」，译文按「说尽」译。
note.en: The three closing couplets are unpunctuated in the book ('huofu youguan yu daxiang biantong dongzhu jiwei'), and by their parallelism are read as 'fortune and misfortune turn on the great image; adapt and perceive the faintest signs' and 'good and ill do not leave the five elements; analyse and study strength and weakness'. 'Gewu zhizhi' is from the Daxue, investigating things to gain knowledge; 'xi zhan' is presumably 'xi zai', to record fully, and the translation reads 'tell all'.

zh: 祸福攸关于大象变通洞烛机微。
吉凶不离于五行剖精研衰旺。
人能格物致知，报应捷于影响。
yi: 祸福关系在大象，要变通地洞察细微。
吉凶离不开五行，要剖析精研衰旺。
人能推究事物、获得知识，报应比影子、回声还快。
en: Fortune and misfortune turn on the great image, and one must adapt and perceive the faintest signs.
Good and ill do not leave the five elements, and one must analyse and study their strength and weakness.
If a man can investigate things and gain knowledge, retribution is faster than shadow or echo.

zh: 祸福吉凶关系，易之大象不离卦之五行，千态万状焉能悉战？
筮者当察其衰旺，自宜变通活泼，相机而断，无有不验，若响之应声也。
yi: 祸福吉凶所关，易的大象离不开卦的五行，千姿百态哪里能都说尽？
筮者应当审察五行的衰旺，自然要变通灵活，相机判断，没有不灵验的，就像回声应着声音。
en: What fortune and misfortune turn on is that the great image of the Yi does not leave the five elements of the hexagram; of the thousand shapes and ten thousand states, how can all be told?
The diviner should examine their strength and weakness and naturally adapt and be flexible, judging as the occasion offers, and there will be none that fail to prove true, as an echo answers a sound.

title: 出师征伐总纲：以世应为主、福德为凭；折杀执俘全凭勇略，观时制变各用机谋；传受三略六韬、八门九遁，虽识奇门之胜负，还凭易卦之吉凶

rule.yi: 出师征伐，以世爻、应爻为主，福德（子孙）为凭据。杀敌擒俘全凭勇气谋略，观察时机、应付变化各用机智谋划，传自黄石公、姜太公的《三略》《六韬》，诸葛孔明推演的八门九遁；虽然知道奇门的胜负，还要凭易卦的吉凶来断。
rule.en: In sending out troops and campaigning, take the Self and the Other as the chief and Fortune Virtue (Output) as the ground. Killing the enemy and taking prisoners rest wholly on courage and strategy, and watching the moment and mastering change each use wit and planning; the Three Strategies and the Six Secret Teachings handed down from Huang Shigong and Jiang Taigong and the Eight Gates and Nine Escapes spread out by Zhuge Kongming are known, but though one may know the victories and defeats of Qimen, one still relies on the good and ill of the hexagram.

note.yi: 小标「以世应为主，福德为凭」是这一章的取法：世爻、应爻定彼己，子孙（福德）是兵将。第二句「三略者，黄遁全上略」的「黄遁全」文字有误，按文意是黄石公。第一联里「全」字在「全凭勇略」的前面，书里没有标点，译文按语气分成三组。「韬略」是兵法。这一章的头一联就把易卦和奇门并提，后面各条也常常两门并用。
note.en: The subtitle, 'the Self and the Other as chief, Fortune Virtue as the ground', gives the method of this chapter: the Self and the Other fix them and us, and Output (Fortune Virtue) is the troops and generals. The 'Huang Dun Quan' in the second sentence is a miswriting, and by sense is Huang Shigong. The couplets of the verse are unpunctuated in the book and are divided here into three groups by their rhythm. 'Taolue' is the art of war. The very first couplet of this chapter names the hexagram and Qimen together, and the entries after it often use the two together.

yi: 以世应为主，福德为凭。
en: Take the Self and the Other as the chief, and Fortune Virtue (Output) as the ground.

zh: 折杀执俘全凭勇略，观时制变各用机谋，
传受黄姜之三略六韬，布演孔明之八门九遁，
虽识奇门之胜负，还凭易卦之吉凶。
yi: 杀敌擒俘全凭勇气谋略，观察时机、应付变化各用机智谋划，
传自黄石公、姜太公的《三略》《六韬》，诸葛孔明推演的八门九遁，
虽然知道奇门的胜负，还要凭易卦的吉凶。
en: Killing the enemy and taking prisoners rest wholly on courage and strategy, and watching the moment and mastering change each use wit and planning;
the Three Strategies and the Six Secret Teachings are handed down from Huang and Jiang, and the Eight Gates and Nine Escapes are spread out by Zhuge Kongming;
though one may know the victories and defeats of Qimen, one still relies on the good and ill of the hexagram.

zh: 彼我命将出师，各用谋臣参赞，故先贤授韬略之然国师布遁奇之阵，神策异谋决使全胜也。
yi: 敌我双方任命将帅出兵，各自用谋臣参谋辅佐，所以先贤传授韬略，国师布置遁甲奇门之阵，神妙的策略、奇特的谋划，必使全胜。
en: Both sides appoint commanders and send out troops, each using counsellors to advise and assist, and so the worthies of old passed down the strategies, and the state preceptor lays out the formations of Dunjia and Qimen, whose marvellous plans and unusual schemes are meant to secure total victory.

zh: 三略者，黄遁全上略、中略、下略也。
姜子牙六韬者，文韬、武韬、龙韬、虎韬、豹韬、犬韬也。
八门者，休生伤杜景死惊开是也。
九遁者，乃阳数九遁阴数九遁也。
yi: 《三略》，就是黄（石公）的上略、中略、下略。
姜子牙的《六韬》，就是文韬、武韬、龙韬、虎韬、豹韬、犬韬。
八门，就是休、生、伤、杜、景、死、惊、开。
九遁，就是阳数的九遁和阴数的九遁。
en: The Three Strategies are the Upper, Middle and Lower Strategies of Huang (Shigong).
Jiang Ziya's Six Secret Teachings are the Civil, Martial, Dragon, Tiger, Leopard and Hound Teachings.
The Eight Gates are the Rest, Life, Harm, Block, Scene, Death, Fright and Open gates.
The Nine Escapes are the nine escapes of the yang numbers and the nine escapes of the yin numbers.

title: 出师征伐：为什么奇门与易卦并用——运筹决胜、一失祸大；奇者三奇乙丙丁、门者八门、九星配合；独用奇门则彼此皆知同从吉门岂得并胜；太乙统宗天之数、奇门遁甲地之数、大六壬神人之数，总归八卦不离五行；易卦上应天时下通人事

rule.yi: 为什么奇门要和易卦并用：在帷幄中运筹、在千里外决胜，功成名就就在史册上留给后世；如果有勇无谋、见识浅短，一着失误，小则陷身失职，大则国破家亡，祸患就从这里开始。所以说，虽然知道奇门的胜负，还要评断易卦的吉凶。奇是三奇乙、丙、丁；门是八门，各配八卦方位，但并非固定，有超神、接气的起例，每时改换，再与九星配合来定吉凶；九星是天心、天柱属金，天冲、天辅属木，天蓬属水，天英属火，天芮、天禽、天任属土。决断交战胜负，奇门、易卦两样都要精通。只用奇门，如果彼此都知道、双方都从吉门进兵，难道能一起获胜吗？何况奇门以接气、超神为主，前后难评，差之毫厘就谬以千里。此外还有太乙统宗是天之数，奇门遁甲是地之数，大六壬是神人之数，这几种数总归于八卦，各种变化不离五行；军中虽用这些数，哪比得上易卦把衰旺动静生克看得清清楚楚，不但推断军务的一个方面，而且能指点万民的趋避。易卦上应天时、下通人事，彰明往事、察知未来，开物成务、验证休咎存亡的机微，衡量判断的人必须精细详审，才不会有差错。
rule.en: Why Qimen is used together with the hexagram. Planning within the tent and deciding victory a thousand miles off, one who succeeds and wins fame leaves a record in the annals for later ages; but with courage and no wit, and shallow knowledge, a single slip means at the least personal ruin and loss of post, and at the most the fall of the state and ruin of the house, and calamity begins from there. So it is said: though one may know the victories and defeats of Qimen, one still judges the good and ill of the hexagram. The Wonders are the three Wonders Yi, Bing and Ding; the gates are the Eight Gates, each matched with a trigram direction, but not fixed, for there are the rules of leaping the spirit and joining the qi, and they change with every hour, and are then combined with the nine stars to fix good and ill; the nine stars are Tianxin and Tianzhu in Metal, Tianchong and Tianfu in Wood, Tianpeng in Water, Tianying in Fire, and Tianrui, Tianqin and Tianren in Earth. To decide the victory or defeat of a battle one must be expert in both Qimen and the hexagram. If one uses Qimen alone and both sides know it and both advance by auspicious gates, how can both win? Besides, Qimen depends on joining the qi and leaping the spirit, which is hard to judge forwards and backwards, and a hair's breadth of error becomes a thousand miles. Besides these there are the Taiyi Tongzong, the number of Heaven, Qimen Dunjia, the number of Earth, and the Da Liu Ren, the number of spirits and men; these numbers all return to the eight trigrams, and all changes do not leave the five elements; though the army uses these numbers, how do they compare with the hexagram, which sees plainly strength and weakness, motion and stillness, generation and control, and can not only work out one side of military affairs but also point the way for the myriad people to seek or avoid. The hexagram answers above to the seasons of Heaven and below reaches human affairs, shows the past and discerns the future, opens things and completes affairs, and tests the springs of good and ill and survival and loss; one who weighs and judges must be fine and thorough, and only then will there be no error.

note.yi: 这一段是《易林补遗》对奇门、太乙、大六壬的背景介绍，放在这一章里是为了说明为什么征战要易卦与奇门并用；奇门的详细规则，留给奇门遁甲那一门的专书。「量编浅」的「编」疑是「褊」（狭小），「谬之千里」前一句断在「差之毫厘？」的问号处，文意是「差之毫厘，谬以千里」，译文接起来；「二数总归八卦」的「二数」疑是「三数」（上面讲了太乙、奇门、大六壬三种），译文写成「这几种数」。「曾如」是「何如」。「超神接气」是奇门遁甲起局时的两种置闰办法，书里没有解释。
note.en: This passage is the Yilin Buyi's background on Qimen, Taiyi and Da Liu Ren, and it is placed in this chapter to explain why war divination uses the hexagram and Qimen together; the detailed rules of Qimen are left to the books of the Qimen Dunjia art. The 'bian' of 'liang bian qian' is presumably 'bian', narrow; the sentence is cut at the question mark of 'a hair's breadth off?', and the sense is 'a hair's breadth off, a thousand miles astray', which the translation joins; the 'two numbers' of 'the two numbers all return to the eight trigrams' is presumably 'three numbers' (the passage has named Taiyi, Qimen and Da Liu Ren), and the translation writes 'these numbers'.
