If thriving, it is surely a fierce, wise and brave bandit.
If it moves it cannot be withstood, so how could ill spirits be added to move with it?
The ill spirits are Robbery, the Great Baleful Spirit and the Lost Spirit.
Their setting out is noted earlier.
If Pressure moves and colludes with the baleful spirits to control the Body and Self, the enemy is surely rampant and my army suffers heavy losses.

title: 出师征伐：杀陷鬼摇虽凶不振，官空煞动纵乱勿忧；鬼煞并兴兵马云屯成大战，官凶俱绝干戈顿息庆清平；最忌鬼煞二神，煞空绝鬼动难成大害，官空绝煞兴无重祸，鬼煞俱动鬼随煞势煞趋鬼威大肆鏖战，克世冲世必被刑戮，官煞二神衰静或空绝方是弓藏胄解太平之世

rule.yi: 煞陷落、官鬼摇动，虽然凶也振作不起来；官鬼落空、煞发动，纵然有乱也不必忧虑。官鬼和煞同时兴起，兵马云集，成为大战；官鬼和凶煞都绝，战事顿时止息，庆贺太平。征战的爻里，最忌官鬼和煞两个神：如果煞神空、绝，官鬼纵然发动，也难成大害；如果官鬼逢空、绝，各煞虽然兴旺，也没有重大的祸害；如果官鬼和煞都发动，官鬼就随着煞的势头，煞趋附官鬼的威势，云集聚拢、大肆苦战；或者克世、冲世的，必被刑杀，不轻；如果官鬼和煞两个神衰弱而又安静，或者空或者绝，才是弓箭收起、盔甲解下的太平之世。
rule.en: If the baleful spirit sinks and Pressure stirs, though ominous it cannot rally; if Pressure is Void and the baleful spirit moves, even if there is disorder there is no need to worry. If Pressure and the baleful spirit rise together, horses and men gather like clouds and it becomes a great battle; if Pressure and the ill spirits are both extinct, arms are suddenly stilled and one celebrates peace. In the lines of war, what is most feared is the two spirits Pressure and the baleful spirit: if the baleful spirit is Void or extinct, even though Pressure moves it can hardly do great harm; if Pressure meets Void or extinction, though the baleful spirits flourish there is no heavy disaster; if Pressure and the baleful spirit both move, Pressure follows the baleful spirit's momentum and the baleful spirit joins Pressure's might, they gather like clouds and fight a bitter battle on a large scale; if they control or clash with the Self, one is surely punished and slain, and not lightly; if both Pressure and the baleful spirit are weak and still, or Void or extinct, only then is it an age of peace with bows put away and helmets removed.

note.yi: 「曦聚」疑是「蚁聚」（像蚂蚁一样聚拢），「胃解」疑是「胄解」（盔甲解下），「太乎这世」疑是「太平之世」，译文按这样的读法译；原文几处笔误，大意清楚。这一联与易隐征战占「鬼衰静敌胆怯、鬼旺动敌势盛」「鬼空者敌必灭」（YY.62）一类。
note.en: 'Xi ju' is presumably 'yi ju', swarming like ants, 'wei jie' is presumably 'zhou jie', helmets removed, and 'tai hu zhe shi' is presumably 'taiping zhi shi', an age of peace, and the translation reads them so; the text has several slips of the pen but its general sense is clear. This couplet is of the kind of 'Pressure weak and still, the enemy is timid; Pressure thriving and moving, the enemy's force is strong' and 'Pressure Void, the enemy is destroyed' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.62).

zh: 杀陷鬼摇虽凶不振，官空煞动纵乱勿忧。
鬼煞并兴，兵马云屯成大战。
官凶俱绝，干戈顿息庆清平。
yi: 煞陷落、官鬼摇动，虽然凶也振作不起来；官鬼落空、煞发动，纵然有乱也不必忧虑。
官鬼和煞同时兴起，兵马云集，成为大战；
官鬼和凶煞都绝，战事顿时止息，庆贺太平。
en: If the baleful spirit sinks and Pressure stirs, though ominous it cannot rally; if Pressure is Void and the baleful spirit moves, even if there is disorder there is no need to worry.
If Pressure and the baleful spirit rise together, horses and men gather like clouds and it becomes a great battle;
if Pressure and the ill spirits are both extinct, arms are suddenly stilled and one celebrates peace.

zh: 征战爻中，最忌鬼煞二神，若煞神空绝，官鬼纵然发动，难成大害。
若官逢空绝，各煞虽是兴隆亦无重祸。
若鬼煞俱动，则鬼随煞势煞趋鬼威，云屯曦聚大肆鏖战。
或克世冲世者，必被刑戮不轻。
若得官煞二神衰而又静、或空或绝者，方是弓藏胃解太乎这世矣！
yi: 征战的爻里，最忌官鬼和煞两个神：如果煞神空、绝，官鬼纵然发动，也难成大害。
如果官鬼逢空、绝，各煞虽然兴旺，也没有重大的祸害。
如果官鬼和煞都发动，官鬼就随着煞的势头，煞趋附官鬼的威势，云集聚拢，大肆苦战。
或者克世、冲世的，必被刑杀，不轻。
如果官鬼和煞两个神衰弱而又安静，或者空或者绝，才是弓箭收起、盔甲解下的太平之世！
en: In the lines of war, what is most feared is the two spirits Pressure and the baleful spirit: if the baleful spirit is Void or extinct, even though Pressure moves it can hardly do great harm.
If Pressure meets Void or extinction, though the baleful spirits flourish there is no heavy disaster.

If Pressure and the baleful spirit both move, Pressure follows the baleful spirit's momentum and the baleful spirit joins Pressure's might, they gather like clouds and fight a bitter battle on a large scale.
If they control or clash with the Self, one is surely punished and slain, and not lightly.
If both Pressure and the baleful spirit are weak and still, or Void or extinct, only then is it an age of peace with bows put away and helmets removed!

title: 出师征伐：鬼煞克身吾兵难敌，交重伐应彼寇易诛；鬼煞二神来克世吾兵大伤，鬼煞静衰克旺世旺不受克无大害，鬼煞旺相克衰世旺能克衰吾兵大被伐戮，鬼煞旺动克应彼已受制易剿伐

rule.yi: 官鬼和煞克身，我军难以抵敌；重叠发动去伐应爻，对方的贼寇容易诛灭。鬼是官鬼，煞是大煞、劫煞之类。官鬼和煞两个神如果来克世爻，我军大受损伤；如果官鬼和煞安静而又衰弱，来克旺相的世爻，是旺相不受克，料想没有大害；官鬼和煞旺相而克衰弱的世爻，这是旺相能克衰弱，我军大被讨伐杀戮；如果官鬼和煞旺相发动克应爻，对方已经受制，容易剿伐。
rule.en: If Pressure and the baleful spirit control the Body, my army can hardly stand against them; if they move in double to attack the Other, the enemy bandits are easily destroyed. 'Gui' is Pressure, and 'sha' is the great baleful spirit, Robbery and the like. If the two spirits Pressure and the baleful spirit come to control the Self, my army is badly injured; if Pressure and the baleful spirit are still and weak and come to control a thriving Self, a thriving line is not controlled and no great harm is expected; if Pressure and the baleful spirit are thriving and control a weak Self, this is the thriving controlling the weak, and my army is greatly attacked and slaughtered; if Pressure and the baleful spirit are thriving and moving and control the Other, the enemy is already restrained and easily destroyed.

note.yi: 「旺不受克」是「旺相的爻不受衰弱的爻所克」，这是五行生克里的通例。这一条与 EL.36、EL.37 连着读：官鬼与煞合起来看克世还是克应。
note.en: 'The thriving is not controlled' is the general rule in the generation and control of the elements that a thriving line is not controlled by a weak one. This entry reads on from EL.36 and EL.37: Pressure and the baleful spirit are looked at together for whether they control the Self or the Other.

yi: 鬼煞克身，我军难以抵敌；
重叠发动去伐应爻，对方的贼寇容易诛灭。
en: If Pressure and the baleful spirit control the Body, my army can hardly stand against them;
if they move in double to attack the Other, the enemy bandits are easily destroyed.

zh: 鬼煞二神若来克世，吾兵大伤。
若鬼煞静而又衰来克旺世者，是旺不受克，料无大害。
鬼煞旺相而克衰世者，此为旺能克衰，吾兵大被伐戮。
若鬼煞旺动克应者，彼已受制易以剿伐。
yi: 鬼是官鬼。
煞是大煞、劫煞之类。
官鬼和煞两个神如果来克世爻，我军大受损伤。
如果官鬼和煞安静而又衰弱，来克旺相的世爻，是旺相不受克，料想没有大害。
官鬼和煞旺相而克衰弱的世爻，这是旺相能克衰弱，我军大被讨伐杀戮。
如果官鬼和煞旺相发动克应爻，对方已经受制，容易剿伐。
en: 'Gui' is Pressure.
'Sha' is the great baleful spirit, Robbery and the like.
If the two spirits Pressure and the baleful spirit come to control the Self, my army is badly injured.
If Pressure and the baleful spirit are still and weak and come to control a thriving Self, a thriving line is not controlled and no great harm is expected.
If Pressure and the baleful spirit are thriving and control a weak Self, this is the thriving controlling the weak, and my army is greatly attacked and slaughtered.
If Pressure and the baleful spirit are thriving and moving and control the Other, the enemy is already restrained and easily destroyed.

title: 出师征伐：细究何爻克应、再查那象伤官，用此奇方妙计自然剿恶锄强；鬼空惟取应、应陷可从官；行兵之法须求克应伤官，应受伤彼遭屠戮，鬼披克贼必生擒；火爻临应或鬼须求水制火用黑旗为号并临水战；鬼空亡评应象，应落陷看官爻

rule.yi: 细究是哪一爻克应爻，再查哪一个象伤官鬼；用这种奇方妙计，自然剿灭凶恶、锄除强梁。官鬼落空，只取应爻；应爻陷落，可以从官鬼（入手）。要懂得行兵的办法，必须找出克应爻、伤官鬼的爻：应爻如果受伤，对方就遭屠戮；官鬼如果被克，贼必定生擒。比如火爻临在应爻或官鬼上，须找水来制火，用黑旗为号，并且临水作战，自然得胜，其余的照这样推。官鬼如果空亡，就评断应象；应爻如果落陷，必须看官爻。
rule.en: Examine closely which line controls the Other, and then see which image injures Pressure; with this marvellous method and clever plan, one naturally destroys the evil and weeds out the strong. If Pressure is Void, take only the Other; if the Other is sunk, one can start from Pressure. To know the method of moving troops, one must find the line that controls the Other and injures Pressure: if the Other is injured, the enemy is slaughtered; if Pressure is controlled, the bandits are surely taken alive. For example, if a Fire line sits on the Other or on Pressure, one must seek Water to control the Fire, use black flags as the signal and fight beside water, and one naturally wins; the rest follow this. If Pressure is Void, judge the Other image; if the Other is sunk, one must look at the Pressure line.

note.yi: 「披克」是被克；「奇方」是出奇的办法。「用黑旗为号」是水属黑色的取象。这一条与易隐征战占里「应空取鬼为用」（YY.54）一类：对方的将（应）和兵（官鬼）互为补位。
note.en: 'Pi ke' is being controlled; 'qi fang' is an unusual method. 'Using black flags as the signal' takes the image that Water is black. This entry is of the kind of 'if the Other is Void take Pressure as the Subject' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.54): the enemy's general (the Other) and troops (Pressure) stand in for each other.

zh: 细究何爻克应，再查那象伤官。
用此奇方妙计，自然剿恶锄强。
鬼空惟取应，应陷可从官。
yi: 细究是哪一爻克应爻，再查哪一个象伤官鬼；
用这种奇方妙计，自然剿灭凶恶、锄除强梁。
官鬼落空只取应爻，应爻陷落可以从官鬼（入手）。
en: Examine closely which line controls the Other, and then see which image injures Pressure;
with this marvellous method and clever plan, one naturally destroys the evil and weeds out the strong.
If Pressure is Void, take only the Other; if the Other is sunk, one can start from Pressure.

zh: 要识行兵之法，须求克应伤官，应若受伤，彼遭屠戮。
且如火爻临应或临鬼，须求水来制火，用黑旗为号，并临水战，自然得胜也，余皆仿此。
yi: 要懂得行兵的办法，必须找出克应爻、伤官鬼的爻：应爻如果受伤，对方就遭屠戮。
官鬼如果被克，贼必定生擒。
比如火爻临在应爻或官鬼上，须找水来制火，用黑旗为号，并且临水作战，自然得胜，其余的照这样推。
官鬼如果空亡，就评断应象。
应爻如果落陷，必须看官爻。
en: To know the method of moving troops, one must find the line that controls the Other and injures Pressure: if the Other is injured, the enemy is slaughtered.
If Pressure is controlled, the bandits are surely taken alive.

For example, if a Fire line sits on the Other or on Pressure, one must seek Water to control the Fire, use black flags as the signal and fight beside water, and one naturally wins; the rest follow this.
If Pressure is Void, judge the Other image.
If the Other is sunk, one must look at the Pressure line.

title: 出师征伐：子爻旺鬼爻休鬼虽克我我无忧，应爻强世爻弱世纵伤他他难伐，世遇生扶子象旺则将勇兵骁，应遭克破鬼爻空则贼衰寇退；子能制鬼，子旺官休则彼先已被制岂能克世；应旺世衰虽克应彼猖獗难取胜（旺不受克）；日辰月将生世合世旺子扶助则我兵精粮足决胜千里；应衰受克受冲官鬼空亡彼必丧胆倒戈拔寨而逃

rule.yi: 子孙爻旺相、官鬼爻休囚，官鬼虽然克我，我也无忧；应爻强、世爻弱，世爻纵然伤他，他也难被讨伐；世爻遇到生扶、子孙象旺相，就是将领勇敢、兵卒骁勇；应爻遭到克破、官鬼爻落空，就是贼衰寇退。子孙能制官鬼：如果子孙旺相、官鬼休囚，对方先已被制住，哪里能克世爻呢？就像大盗正想打劫别人，已经被官府搜捕擒获，哪有工夫行劫，我还忧虑什么呢？如果应爻旺相、世爻衰弱，虽然克应爻，无奈对方猖獗，难以取胜，「旺不受克」说的正是这个。如果日辰、月将生世、合世，旺相的子孙又来扶助，就是我兵精良、粮草充足、机谋深远、声势浩大，决胜千里；如果应衰弱受克受冲，官鬼又落空亡，对方必定丧胆、倒戈、拔寨逃走。
rule.en: If the Output line is thriving and the Pressure line resting, though Pressure controls me I have nothing to fear; if the Other is strong and the Self weak, though the Self injures them, they are hard to attack; if the Self meets generation and support and the Output image is thriving, the commander is brave and the troops valiant; if the Other is controlled and broken and the Pressure line Void, the bandits decline and withdraw. Output can control Pressure: if Output is thriving and Pressure resting, the enemy has first been restrained, so how can it control the Self? It is like a great robber who is about to rob someone and has already been seized by the officers, so how has he time to rob, and what have I to fear? If the Other is thriving and the Self weak, though the Self controls the Other, the enemy is rampant and hard to beat, and 'the thriving is not controlled' says exactly this. If the Day and the Month General generate or combine with the Self, and a thriving Output also comes to support, my troops are well trained, grain is plentiful, plans are deep and strength great, and victory is decided a thousand miles away; if the Other is weak and controlled and clashed, and Pressure also falls into Void, the enemy will surely lose heart, turn their spears, pull up their stockades and flee.

note.yi: 「月将」是太阳所在的月份地支（神煞，不是月建）；「倒戈」是掉转兵器、反过来攻自己人。第一首四联的头两联是「子旺鬼休，鬼克我也无忧」和「应强世弱，世伤他也难伐」，解里正好对应到「子能制鬼」和「旺不受克」两个道理。第二个比喻在书里被断行隔开（「被官捕搜擒」在上一行末，「何暇行劫」在下一行首），这里连起来读。
note.en: The 'Month General' is the branch of the month in which the sun stands (a spirit-star, not the Month branch); 'dao ge' is turning one's weapons round and attacking one's own side. The first two couplets of the four are 'Output thriving, Pressure resting, though Pressure controls me I have no worry' and 'the Other strong, the Self weak, though the Self injures them they are hard to attack', and the explanation answers them with the two principles 'Output can control Pressure' and 'the thriving is not controlled'. The second simile is split by a line break in the book ('seized by the officers' at the end of one line and 'how has he time to rob' at the start of the next) and is read here joined up.

zh: 子爻旺鬼爻休，鬼虽克我我无忧。
应爻强世爻弱，世纵伤他他难伐。
世遇生扶子象旺，则将勇兵骁。
应遭克破鬼爻空，则贼衰寇退。
yi: 子孙爻旺相、官鬼爻休囚，官鬼虽然克我，我也无忧；
应爻强、世爻弱，世爻纵然伤他，他也难被讨伐；
世爻遇到生扶、子孙象旺相，就是将领勇敢、兵卒骁勇；
应爻遭到克破、官鬼爻落空，就是贼衰寇退。
en: If the Output line is thriving and the Pressure line resting, though Pressure controls me I have nothing to fear;
if the Other is strong and the Self weak, though the Self injures them, they are hard to attack;
if the Self meets generation and support and the Output image is thriving, the commander is brave and the troops valiant;
if the Other is controlled and broken and the Pressure line Void, the bandits decline and withdraw.

zh: 子能制鬼，若子孙旺官鬼休，则彼先已被制，岂能克世乎？
譬诸剧盗正欲劫人已被官捕搜擒，何暇行劫，我何忧哉？
如应爻旺世爻衰然虽克应，奈彼猖獗难以取胜，旺不受克，正此之谓也。
若日辰月将生世合世，旺子又来扶助，则我兵精粮足机深势大决胜千里。
若应衰受克受冲官鬼又落空亡，彼必丧胆倒戈拔寨而逃遁矣！
yi: 子孙能制官鬼：如果子孙旺相、官鬼休囚，对方先已被制住，哪里能克世爻呢？
就像大盗正想打劫别人，已经被官府搜捕擒获，哪有工夫行劫，我还忧虑什么呢？
如果应爻旺相、世爻衰弱，虽然克应爻，无奈对方猖獗，难以取胜，「旺不受克」说的正是这个。
如果日辰、月将生世、合世，旺相的子孙又来扶助，就是我兵精良、粮草充足、机谋深远、声势浩大，决胜千里。
如果应衰弱受克受冲，官鬼又落空亡，对方必定丧胆、倒戈、拔寨逃走！
en: Output can control Pressure: if Output is thriving and Pressure resting, the enemy has first been restrained, so how can it control the Self?
It is like a great robber who is about to rob someone and has already been seized by the officers, so how has he time to rob, and what have I to fear?
If the Other is thriving and the Self weak, though the Self controls the Other, the enemy is rampant and hard to beat, and 'the thriving is not controlled' says exactly this.

If the Day and the Month General generate or combine with the Self, and a thriving Output also comes to support, my troops are well trained, grain is plentiful, plans are deep and strength great, and victory is decided a thousand miles away.
If the Other is weak and controlled and clashed, and Pressure also falls into Void, the enemy will surely lose heart, turn their spears, pull up their stockades and flee!

title: 出师征伐：金为兵甲值官兴旺防战斗，土作城池临鬼发动干戈；兵戈铠甲皆用金，临官鬼或旺或动彼必坚甲利刃谋奇策出其不意；土旺于四季分四隅又作城垣台堡，鬼带土发则干戈扰扰弥山漫野

rule.yi: 金是兵甲，金值官鬼兴旺，要防战斗；土当城池，土临官鬼发动，就动起干戈。兵器铠甲都用金来造，如果金临官鬼，或者旺相、或者发动，对方必定甲坚刃利（与众不同），谋划奇策、出其不意地猛然冲突，不要小看；土旺在四季，分布四个角落，又作城墙、台堡，如果官鬼带土发动，就干戈扰攘，漫山遍野，无地不有。
rule.en: Metal is arms and armour, and if Metal meets a flourishing Pressure, guard against fighting; Earth is the city walls, and if Earth sits on Pressure and moves, spears and shields are raised. Weapons and armour are all made of Metal, and if Metal sits on Pressure and is thriving or moving, the enemy surely has strong armour and sharp blades, unlike the common, and plans unusual strategies to charge suddenly and unexpectedly, which must not be made light of; Earth is thriving in the four seasons and spread over the four corners, and also serves as city walls, terraces and forts, and if Pressure carries Earth and moves, spears and shields are in turmoil, covering the hills and spreading over the fields, with no place free of them.

note.yi: 第二联「临鬼发遁动干戈」的「遁」是衍字或误字，译文按「临官鬼发动、动起干戈」译。「墟然」疑是「忽然」（或「虚然」），译作「猛然」。「干戈」是兵器，代指战争。这一条与易隐征战占「五行」里的金（兵甲）、土（炮石城池）（YY.66、YY.65）取象相同。
note.en: In the second couplet 'lin gui fa dun dong ganqe' the 'dun' is a superfluous or miswritten character, and the translation reads 'sits on Pressure and moves, spears and shields are raised'. 'Xu ran' is presumably 'hu ran', suddenly (or 'xu ran'), and is translated 'suddenly'. 'Ganqe' are weapons, standing for war. This entry takes the same images as Metal (arms and armour) and Earth (catapult stones and city walls) in the 'five elements' section of the Yi Yin war divination (YY.66, YY.65).

zh: 金为兵甲，值官兴旺防战斗。
土作城池，临鬼发遁动干戈。
yi: 金是兵甲，金值官鬼兴旺，要防战斗；
土当城池，土临官鬼发动，就动起干戈。
en: Metal is arms and armour, and if Metal meets a flourishing Pressure, guard against fighting;
Earth is the city walls, and if Earth sits on Pressure and moves, spears and shields are raised.

zh: 夫兵戈铠甲，皆用金以造，若临官鬼、或旺、或动，彼必坚甲利刃异。
谋奇策出其不意墟然冲突，勿为小观。
夫土者，旺于四季，列分四隅，又作城垣台堡，若鬼带土发则干戈扰扰，弥山漫野无地无之。
yi: 兵器铠甲都用金来造，如果金临官鬼，或者旺相、或者发动，对方必定甲坚刃利（与众不同）。
（对方）谋划奇策、出其不意地猛然冲突，不要小看。
土旺在四季，分布四个角落，又作城墙、台堡，如果官鬼带土发动，就干戈扰攘，漫山遍野，无地不有。
en: Weapons and armour are all made of Metal, and if Metal sits on Pressure and is thriving or moving, the enemy surely has strong armour and sharp blades, unlike the common.
They plan unusual strategies to charge suddenly and unexpectedly, which must not be made light of.

Earth is thriving in the four seasons and spread over the four corners, and also serves as city walls, terraces and forts, and if Pressure carries Earth and moves, spears and shields are in turmoil, covering the hills and spreading over the fields, with no place free of them.

title: 出师征伐：密密刀枪为金宫之空动，飘飘旗帜因火父之旺冲；刀剑属金又属官鬼，值空亡又逢发动必振扬，金空则鸣刀枪光耀日金鼓振轰雷营寨重重提防有备；旌旗以父母为用爻又属离火，旺相更遇日冲火发则焰，黄幡豹尾彩帜麒麟飘摇号令严明军机整肃

rule.yi: 密密的刀枪，是金宫空而发动；飘飘的旗帜，是因为火的父爻旺相逢冲。刀剑本属金，又属官鬼，如果值空亡又逢发动，必定振扬，所以经书说「金空则鸣」，必是刀枪光芒耀日、金鼓声震如雷，营寨密密重重是提防有备的缘故。旌旗以父母爻为用爻，又属离火，如果旺相，更遇日辰冲，所以日冲火发就有焰，必是黄幡悬着豹尾、彩旗上写着麒麟，飘飘摇摇，引导军队、行阵，号令严明，军机整肃。
rule.en: Dense blades and spears are Metal palace Void and moving; fluttering banners are the Fire Resource line thriving and clashed. Swords and blades belong to Metal, and also to Pressure, and if they meet Void and also move they surely rise up, so the classic says 'Metal Void rings', and surely the blades and spears flash against the sun, the gongs and drums shake like thunder, and the camps are dense and layered out of watchfulness and readiness. The banners take the Resource line as the Subject line and also belong to Li Fire, and if it is thriving and also meets the Day's clash, then when the Day clashes Fire moves there is flame, and surely yellow pennants hang with leopard tails and bright flags are written with the qilin, fluttering and waving, leading the army and the lines, orders strict and clear and military secrets well guarded.

note.yi: 「金空则鸣」是「金空则鸣，金实则不鸣」的老话：金爻落空，就像空的钟一敲就响。「豹尾」「麒麟」是旌旗上的图案，「黄幡豹尾」是古代军中的旗饰。「营衡寨」疑是「营栅寨」，不影响大意。这一条与 EL.30 的旌旗合着读，与易隐征战占「父旺外动彼兴兵」等（YY.57）不同的是这里只说金、火两爻的外在景象。
note.en: 'Metal Void rings' is from the old saying 'Metal Void rings, Metal full does not ring': a Metal line that is Void is like an empty bell, which rings when struck. The 'leopard tail' and the 'qilin' are designs on the banners, and 'yellow pennant and leopard tail' is an old flag decoration of armies. 'Ying heng zhai' is presumably 'ying zha zhai', camps and stockades, which does not affect the general sense. This entry is read together with the banners of EL.30, and differs from 'Resource thriving and moving outside, the enemy raises troops' and the like in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.57) in speaking only of the outward scenes of the Metal and Fire lines.

zh: 密密刀枪为金宫之空动，
飘飘旗帜，因火父之旺冲。
yi: 密密的刀枪，是金宫空而发动；
飘飘的旗帜，是因为火父爻旺相逢冲。
en: Dense blades and spears are Metal palace Void and moving;
fluttering banners are the Fire Resource line thriving and clashed.

zh: 刀剑本属金，又属官鬼，若值空亡又逢发动，是必振扬也，故经云金。
空则鸣，必是刀枪光耀日，金鼓振轰雷，密密重重营衡寨乃提防有备耳。
旌旗，父母为之用爻，又属离火，若值旺相更遇日冲，故日火发则焰，乃是黄幡悬豹尾彩帜书麒麟飘飘摇摇道军引陈号令严明，军机整肃耳。
yi: 刀剑本属金，又属官鬼，如果值空亡又逢发动，必定振扬，所以经书说「金」。
（金）空则鸣，必是刀枪光芒耀日、金鼓声震如雷，营寨密密重重是提防有备的缘故。
旌旗以父母爻为用爻，又属离火，如果旺相，更遇日辰冲，所以日冲火发就有焰，必是黄幡悬着豹尾、彩旗上写着麒麟，飘飘摇摇，引导军队、行阵，号令严明，军机整肃。
en: Swords and blades belong to Metal, and also to Pressure, and if they meet Void and also move they surely rise up, so the classic says 'Metal'.
Void it rings: surely the blades and spears flash against the sun, the gongs and drums shake like thunder, and the camps are dense and layered out of watchfulness and readiness.

The banners take the Resource line as the Subject line and also belong to Li Fire, and if it is thriving and also meets the Day's clash, then when the Day clashes Fire moves there is flame, and surely yellow pennants hang with leopard tails and bright flags are written with the qilin, fluttering and waving, leading the army and the lines, orders strict and clear and military secrets well guarded.

title: 出师征伐：水乃江河木为舟楫，二爻皆旺水战偏宜，两象并伤乘航欠利；水旺则盈绝则竭，木隆则船大衰则舟楫绝则无舟；二爻旺而又发万事齐备利用操舟，衰而又绝难以觅渡

rule.yi: 水是江河，木是舟楫；两爻都旺相，水战特别适宜；两象都受伤，乘船渡水不利。水是江海的源流，木是舟船的根本，水战各有各的用处：水旺则满，水绝则竭；木旺则船大，木衰则只有小舟，木绝则没有船；两爻旺相又发动，万事齐备，利于操舟；如果两爻衰弱又绝，一切都不成，难以找到渡口了！
rule.en: Water is rivers and Wood is boats and oars; if both lines are thriving, a naval battle is especially fit; if both images are injured, going by boat is unfavourable. Water is the source and flow of rivers and seas, and Wood is the root of boats, each having its use in a naval battle: thriving Water is full, extinct Water dries up; thriving Wood means big boats, weak Wood only small boats, extinct Wood no boat; if both lines are thriving and also move, everything is ready and it is favourable to handle boats; if both lines are weak and also extinct, nothing succeeds and it is hard to find a crossing!

note.yi: 「雨像并伤」的「雨像」是「二象」（水、木两象）之误。这一条与易隐征战占「五行」里的木（舟）、水（泉）（YY.63、YY.67）取象相同，但这里只说水木旺衰与水战的关系，没有船的各部分。
note.en: 'Yu xiang bing shang' has 'yu xiang' for 'er xiang', the two images (Water and Wood). This entry takes the same images as Wood (boats) and Water (springs) in the 'five elements' section of the Yi Yin war divination (YY.63, YY.67), but speaks only of the strength of Water and Wood in relation to naval battle, without the parts of the boat.

yi: 水是江河，木是舟楫；
两爻都旺相，水战特别适宜；
两象都受伤，乘船渡水不利。
en: Water is rivers and Wood is boats and oars;
if both lines are thriving, a naval battle is especially fit;
if both images are injured, going by boat is unfavourable.

zh: 水为江海源流，木作舟船之本，水战各有所用，若水旺则盈，水绝则竭。
木隆则船大，木衰则舟楫，木绝则无舟。
二爻旺而又发，万事齐备利用操舟。
若二爻衰而又绝，凡物无成难以觅渡矣！
yi: 水是江海的源流，木是舟船的根本，水战各有各的用处：水旺则满，水绝则竭。
木旺则船大，木衰则只有小舟，木绝则没有船。
两爻旺相又发动，万事齐备，利于操舟。
如果两爻衰弱又绝，一切都不成，难以找到渡口了！
en: Water is the source and flow of rivers and seas, and Wood is the root of boats, each having its use in a naval battle: thriving Water is full, extinct Water dries up.
Thriving Wood means big boats, weak Wood only small boats, extinct Wood no boat.
If both lines are thriving and also move, everything is ready and it is favourable to handle boats.
If both lines are weak and also extinct, nothing succeeds and it is hard to find a crossing!

title: 出师征伐：火多营寨土是城垣，此象兴隆最宜陆战，其爻空绝不利出征；营垒以火为用城台赖土生成，火空营险土空城陷，二爻旺相动冲可使西域沙漠之胜，衰休空绝必有华容小道之危

rule.yi: 火多是营寨，土是城墙，这两个象兴旺，最宜陆战；这两爻空、绝，不利出征。营垒以火为用，城台靠土生成：火空则营寨危险，土空则城池陷落；两爻如果值旺相、动、冲，可以取得西域沙漠（那样的）胜利；（两象）如果遇到衰、休、空、绝，必有华容小道（曹操败走）那样的危险。
rule.en: Fire is mostly the camp and Earth is the city wall; if these two images flourish, they are most fit for a land battle; if these two lines are Void or extinct, it is not favourable to set out. Camps and ramparts take Fire as the Subject, and city terraces rely on Earth for their making: if Fire is Void the camp is in danger, if Earth is Void the city falls; if the two lines meet thriving, moving and clashing, one can win a victory such as that in the western deserts; if they meet weak, resting, Void or extinct, there will surely be danger like that of the small road at Huarong.

note.yi: 「华容小道」是《三国演义》里曹操赤壁战败后败走华容道的故事；「西域沙漠之胜」书里没有说是哪一场战役，译文照字面。「雨象」又是「二象」之误（火、土两象）。这一条与易隐征战占「五行」里的火（营寨）、土（城池）（YY.64、YY.65）取象相同。
note.en: 'The small road at Huarong' is the story, in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, of Cao Cao fleeing by the Huarong road after his defeat at Red Cliff; the book does not say which campaign 'the victory in the western deserts' is, and the translation follows the letter. 'Yu xiang' is again a slip for 'er xiang', the two images (Fire and Earth). This entry takes the same images as Fire (camps) and Earth (city walls) in the 'five elements' section of the Yi Yin war divination (YY.64, YY.65).

yi: 火多是营寨，土是城墙，
这两个象兴旺，最宜陆战；
这两爻空、绝，不利出征。
en: Fire is mostly the camp and Earth is the city wall;
if these two images flourish, they are most fit for a land battle;
if these two lines are Void or extinct, it is not favourable to set out.

zh: 营垒以火为用，城台赖土生成，火空营险，土空成陷，二爻若值旺相动冲，可使西域沙漠之胜、雨象若遇衰休空绝、必有华容小道之危。
yi: 营垒以火为用，城台靠土生成：火空则营寨危险，土空则城池陷落；两爻如果值旺相、动、冲，可以取得西域沙漠（那样的）胜利；（两象）如果遇到衰、休、空、绝，必有华容小道（曹操败走）那样的危险。
en: Camps and ramparts take Fire as the Subject, and city terraces rely on Earth for their making: if Fire is Void the camp is in danger, if Earth is Void the city falls; if the two lines meet thriving, moving and clashing, one can win a victory such as that in the western deserts; if they meet weak, resting, Void or extinct, there will surely be danger like that of the small road at Huarong.

title: 出师征伐：火鬼伤身须防劫寨，土官克世恐堕陷坑；官鬼带火克世须慎火攻而劫寨，鬼杀以土伤世恐防堕堑之危

rule.yi: 火爻官鬼伤身，须防劫寨；土爻官鬼克世，恐怕掉进陷坑。官鬼带火克世的，须慎防火攻、劫寨；官鬼和煞以土伤世的，恐怕有掉进壕沟的危险。
rule.en: If a Fire Pressure line injures the Body, guard against a raid on the stockade; if an Earth Pressure line controls the Self, one may fall into a pit. If Pressure carrying Fire controls the Self, one must take care against attack by fire and a raid on the stockade; if Pressure and a baleful spirit injure the Self by Earth, there may be the danger of falling into a trench.

note.yi: 「危矶」疑是「危机」，译作「危险」。这一条与易隐征战占「火鬼伤世防劫营」「阴土鬼…防陷阱」（YY.64、YY.65）取同一件事。
note.en: 'Wei ji' is presumably 'weiji', danger. This entry takes up the same matter as 'a Fire Pressure line injures the Self, guard against a raid on the camp' and 'a yin Earth Pressure line ... guard against pits' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.64, YY.65).

yi: 火爻官鬼伤身，须防劫寨；
土爻官鬼克世，恐怕掉进陷坑。
en: If a Fire Pressure line injures the Body, guard against a raid on the stockade;
if an Earth Pressure line controls the Self, one may fall into a pit.

zh: 官鬼带火克世者，须慎火攻而劫寨。
鬼杀以土伤世者，恐防堕堑之危矶。
yi: 官鬼带火克世的，须慎防火攻、劫寨。
官鬼和煞以土伤世的，恐怕有掉进壕沟的危险。
en: If Pressure carrying Fire controls the Self, one must take care against attack by fire and a raid on the stockade.
If Pressure and a baleful spirit injure the Self by Earth, there may be the danger of falling into a trench.

title: 出师征伐：火动则利迁营寨，父空则宜改旌旗；火发动则变化故营寨利迁移，被刑冲或加玄武兄弟必遭侵劫急宜迁改；旌旗以父为用，值旬空月破必然损伤急须改换

rule.yi: 火发动，利于迁移营寨；父爻落空，宜改换旌旗。军营以火为用，火如果发动，动就是变化，所以营寨利于迁移才吉；如果被刑、冲，或者加玄武、加兄弟，必遭侵劫，急宜迁改。旌旗以父爻为用，如果值旬空、月破，必然损伤，急须改换。
rule.en: If Fire moves, it favours moving the camp; if the Resource line is Void, it is fit to change the banners. The army camp takes Fire as the Subject, and if Fire moves, moving means change, so it is auspicious to move the camp; if it is punished or clashed, or the Dark Tortoise or Peer is added, the camp will surely be raided, and it should be moved and changed urgently. The banners take the Resource line as the Subject, and if it meets decade Void or Month-break they are surely damaged and must be changed urgently.

note.yi: 这一条与易隐征战占「火动利迁营」「父被刑害克破宜改旗帜」（YY.64、YY.58）取同一件事。
note.en: This entry takes up the same matter as 'if Fire moves, it favours moving camp' and 'if Resource is punished, harmed, controlled or broken, it is fit to change the banners' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.64, YY.58).

yi: 火发动，利于迁移营寨；
父爻落空，宜改换旌旗。
en: If Fire moves, it favours moving the camp;
if the Resource line is Void, it is fit to change the banners.

zh: 军营以火为用，火若发动，动则变化，故营寨必利迁移为吉，若被刑冲、或加玄武、或加兄弟，必遭侵劫，急宜迁改。
若值旬空月破必然损伤，急须改换。
yi: 军营以火为用，火如果发动，动就是变化，所以营寨利于迁移才吉；如果被刑、冲，或者加玄武、加兄弟，必遭侵劫，急宜迁改。
旌旗以父爻为用。
如果值旬空、月破，必然损伤，急须改换。
en: The army camp takes Fire as the Subject, and if Fire moves, moving means change, so it is auspicious to move the camp; if it is punished or clashed, or the Dark Tortoise or Peer is added, the camp will surely be raided, and it should be moved and changed urgently.
The banners take the Resource line as the Subject.
If it meets decade Void or Month-break, they are surely damaged and must be changed urgently.

title: 出师征伐：土官动克世爻他兴炮石，火鬼发伤身象彼用火攻；官鬼兴隆带土克世须防擂木炮石来攻，鬼动加火同克世必举火烧屯旺则太甚衰则稍可

rule.yi: 土爻官鬼发动克世爻，对方兴用炮石；火爻官鬼发动伤身象，对方用火攻。官鬼兴旺带土来克世的，须防对方制备擂木、炮石来攻；如果官鬼发动、加火一起克世，他必定举火烧营，旺相则太厉害，衰弱则稍微好一些。
rule.en: If an Earth Pressure line moves and controls the Self, the enemy uses catapult stones; if a Fire Pressure line moves and injures the Body image, they attack by fire. If Pressure is flourishing and carries Earth to control the Self, one must guard against their preparing rolling logs and catapult stones to attack; if Pressure moves and, with Fire added, controls the Self together, they will surely raise fire and burn the camp, and if it is thriving it is very serious and if weak it is somewhat better.

note.yi: 「擂木」是从高处滚下砸人的原木。这一条与 EL.45 连着读，也和易隐征战占「阳土鬼旺动…防炮石」（YY.65）取同一件事。
note.en: 'Leimu' are logs rolled down from a height to smash people. This entry reads on from EL.45 and also takes up the same matter as 'a yang Earth Pressure line thriving and moving ... guard against catapult stones' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.65).

zh: 土官动克世爻，他兴炮石。
火鬼发伤身象，彼用火攻
yi: 土爻官鬼发动克世爻，对方兴用炮石；
火爻官鬼发动伤身象，对方用火攻。
en: If an Earth Pressure line moves and controls the Self, the enemy uses catapult stones;
if a Fire Pressure line moves and injures the Body image, they attack by fire.

zh: 官鬼兴隆带土来克世者，须防彼制擂木炮石来攻。
若鬼动加火同来克世者，他必举火烧屯，旺则太甚，衰则稍可。
yi: 官鬼兴旺带土来克世的，须防对方制备擂木、炮石来攻。
如果官鬼发动、加火一起克世，他必定举火烧营，旺相则太厉害，衰弱则稍微好一些。
en: If Pressure is flourishing and carries Earth to control the Self, one must guard against their preparing rolling logs and catapult stones to attack.
If Pressure moves and, with Fire added, controls the Self together, they will surely raise fire and burn the camp, and if it is thriving it is very serious and if weak it is somewhat better.

title: 出师征伐：鬼藏世下克世爻切虑自兵谋主，子伏身中合应象谨离我将降夷；世下伏鬼克世则家兵杀主，世旺鬼衰奸心已蓄无隙可乘、世衰鬼旺则逆节潜谋乘虚而入（张飞受范疆之刺）；世下伏子合应则军心已离各怀去意，世衰应旺他国强我军弱（匈奴迫李陵之降）；日辰生子又加雀虎必被阴谮阳唆背义从仇

rule.yi: 官鬼藏在世爻下面克世爻，切记忧虑自己的兵谋害主将；子孙伏在身爻中合应象，当心离开我的将领、投降夷人。世爻下面伏着官鬼、而又克世爻的，就是家兵杀主：如果世旺鬼衰，奸心已经存着、无隙可乘；世衰鬼旺，则叛逆潜谋，乘虚而入，所以张飞受到范疆的刺杀。如果世爻下面伏着子孙而合应爻，就是军心已经离散，各怀去意；如果世衰应旺，就是他国强横、我军卑弱，所以匈奴逼迫李陵投降。如果日辰生子孙，又加朱雀、白虎临在上面，必定被人暗中进谗、公开唆使，背弃道义、投靠仇人。
rule.en: If Pressure lies hidden under the Self and controls the Self, take care to worry about one's own troops plotting against the commander; if Output lies hidden in the Body and combines with the Other image, beware of the generals leaving me and surrendering to the foreigners. If a Pressure line lies hidden under the Self and also controls the Self, it is household troops killing their master: if the Self is thriving and Pressure weak, treacherous thoughts have been stored but no gap is open; if the Self is weak and Pressure thriving, the rebellion plots in secret and enters where there is a gap, as Zhang Fei was stabbed by Fan Jiang. If Output lies hidden under the Self and combines with the Other, the hearts of the army have already left and each harbours thoughts of leaving; if the Self is weak and the Other thriving, the other state is strong and my army low, as the Xiongnu forced Li Ling to surrender. If the Day generates Output and the Vermilion Bird and White Tiger sit on it, one will surely be slandered in secret and incited in the open, betraying righteousness and following the enemy.

note.yi: 「范疆」就是刺杀张飞的范疆、张达（《三国志》作范强、张达），「李陵」是汉武帝时兵败降匈奴的将领；这两个典故书里自己写出，和黄金策征战「子化官爻克世，张飞遭范张之诛」「外宫子动化绝爻，李陵所以降虏」（HJC.110、HJC.105）用的是同一批。「雀虎」是朱雀、白虎的省称；「背羲」是「背义」。「夷」是外族。
note.en: 'Fan Jiang' is Fan Jiang, who with Zhang Da assassinated Zhang Fei (the Records of the Three Kingdoms writes Fan Qiang and Zhang Da), and 'Li Ling' is the general of Emperor Wu of the Han who was defeated and surrendered to the Xiongnu; the book writes out both allusions itself, and they are the same pair that the Huangjin Ce uses in 'Output turns into the Pressure line and controls the Self, Zhang Fei suffers the execution by Fan and Zhang' and 'Output moves in the outer palace and turns into an extinct line, which is why Li Ling surrendered to the captors' (HJC.110, HJC.105). 'Que hu' is an abbreviation for the Vermilion Bird and the White Tiger; 'bei xi' is 'bei yi', betraying righteousness. 'Yi' is the foreign peoples.

zh: 鬼藏世下克世爻，切虑自兵谋主。
子伏身中合应象，谨离我将降夷。
yi: 官鬼藏在世爻下面克世爻，切记忧虑自己的兵谋害主将；
子孙伏在身爻中合应象，当心离开我的将领、投降夷人。
en: If Pressure lies hidden under the Self and controls the Self, take care to worry about one's own troops plotting against the commander;
if Output lies hidden in the Body and combines with the Other image, beware of the generals leaving me and surrendering to the foreigners.

zh: 世下之伏鬼而克世者，则家兵杀主。
若世旺鬼衰，奸心已蓄无隙可乘，世衰鬼旺，则逆节潜谋，乘虚而入，故张飞受范疆之刺。
若世下之伏子而合应者，则军心已离，各怀去意。
如世衰应旺，则他国强梁我军卑弱，故匈奴迫李陵之降。
若日辰生子又加雀虎临之，必被阴谮阳唆，背羲从仇耳。
yi: 世爻下面伏着官鬼、而又克世爻的，就是家兵杀主。
如果世旺鬼衰，奸心已经存着、无隙可乘；世衰鬼旺，则叛逆潜谋，乘虚而入，所以张飞受到范疆的刺杀。
如果世爻下面伏着子孙而合应爻，就是军心已经离散，各怀去意。
如果世衰应旺，就是他国强横、我军卑弱，所以匈奴逼迫李陵投降。
如果日辰生子孙，又加朱雀、白虎临在上面，必定被人暗中进谗、公开唆使，背弃道义、投靠仇人。
en: If a Pressure line lies hidden under the Self and also controls the Self, it is household troops killing their master.

If the Self is thriving and Pressure weak, treacherous thoughts have been stored but no gap is open; if the Self is weak and Pressure thriving, the rebellion plots in secret and enters where there is a gap, as Zhang Fei was stabbed by Fan Jiang.
If Output lies hidden under the Self and combines with the Other, the hearts of the army have already left and each harbours thoughts of leaving.
If the Self is weak and the Other thriving, the other state is strong and my army low, as the Xiongnu forced Li Ling to surrender.
If the Day generates Output and the Vermilion Bird and White Tiger sit on it, one will surely be slandered in secret and incited in the open, betraying righteousness and following the enemy.

title: 出师征伐：内外鬼兴伤世祸由内应外通，前后子旺生身利在前攻后击；内官乃己之人外鬼为彼之兵，发动克世则己人纠合他人内应外合，世旺鬼衰难以伤克，世变子或鬼变子则鬼受制无大害，本卦子孙旺而生世先攻后取全功，内官旺相外鬼兴隆则彼此相抗难断胜负

rule.yi: 内外两个官鬼兴起伤世爻，祸患由内应外通而起；前后（内外）的子孙旺相生身，利于前攻后击。内卦的官鬼是自己人，外卦的官鬼是对方的兵：如果发动而克世爻，祸患出自自己人勾结外人，这就是内应外合的残害；如果世旺鬼衰，虽然发动也难以伤克；如果世爻变子孙或官鬼变子孙，就是官鬼受制，谋划不会决裂，没有夭折的祸害，经书说「有人制鬼，鬼动何妨」；本卦子孙之卦，子孙旺相而生世爻的，先攻后取，顺着心意行军，都获得全功；如果内卦的官鬼旺相、外卦的官鬼兴旺，就彼此对抗，难以判断胜负。
rule.en: If Pressure rises both inside and outside and injures the Self, the disaster comes from collusion between inside and outside; if Output is thriving before and behind and generates the Body, it favours attacking in front and striking behind. The inner Pressure is one's own men and the outer Pressure is the enemy's troops: if they move and control the Self, the disaster is one's own men joining others, which is the injury of inside and outside in collusion; if the Self is thriving and Pressure weak, though they move it is hard for them to injure or control; if the Self turns into Output or Pressure turns into Output, Pressure is restrained, the plot does not break out and there is no untimely harm, as the classic says 'if someone restrains Pressure, what harm is there in its moving'; if in the original hexagram Output is thriving and generates the Self, one attacks first and takes after, and moving troops as one wishes one gains complete success; if the inner Pressure is thriving and the outer Pressure flourishing, they resist each other and it is hard to judge victory.

note.yi: 「内官」「外鬼」是内卦的官鬼和外卦的官鬼。「有人制鬼，鬼动何妨」是引的另一句经书，与黄金策「官化兄反、子孙制鬼」一类同义，书里没有说出处。「内应外合」是内外勾结。第一联「前后子旺」的「前后」按解里应是内外；译文写成「前后（内外）」。这一条与易隐征战占「内外两鬼动克世者，防内应外合」（YY.56）相同。
note.en: 'Inner official' and 'outer Pressure' are the Pressure lines of the inner and of the outer trigram. 'If someone restrains Pressure, what harm is there in its moving' is quoted from another classic that the book does not name, and has the same sense as 'Output restrains Pressure' sayings in the Huangjin Ce. 'Nei ying wai he' is inside and outside colluding. The 'front and back' of 'Output thriving before and behind' should be inside and outside by the explanation, and the translation writes 'before and behind (inside and outside)'. This entry is the same as 'if Pressure in both the inner and outer trigram moves to control the Self, guard against collusion between inside and outside' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.56).

zh: 内外鬼兴伤世，祸由内应外通。
前后子旺生身，利在前攻后击。
yi: 内外两个官鬼兴起伤世爻，祸患由内应外通而起；
前后（内外）的子孙旺相生身，利于前攻后击。
en: If Pressure rises both inside and outside and injures the Self, the disaster comes from collusion between inside and outside;
if Output is thriving before and behind and generates the Body, it favours attacking in front and striking behind.

zh: 内官乃己之人，外鬼为彼之兵。
若逢发动，而克世者，祸从己人纠合他人，是为内应外合残害。
若世旺鬼衰，虽然发动难以伤克。
若世变子或鬼变子，乃鬼受制，则谋无决裂，是无夭害，经云有人制鬼，鬼动何妨。
本卦子孙之卦子孙旺而生世者，先攻后取顺意行军皆获全功。
若内官旺相外鬼兴隆，则彼此相抗，难以胜断也。
yi: 内卦的官鬼是自己人，外卦的官鬼是对方的兵。
如果发动而克世爻，祸患出自自己人勾结外人，这就是内应外合的残害。
如果世旺鬼衰，虽然发动也难以伤克。
如果世变子孙或官鬼变子孙，就是官鬼受制，谋划不会决裂，没有夭折的祸害，经书说「有人制鬼，鬼动何妨」。
本卦子孙之卦，子孙旺相而生世爻的，先攻后取，顺着心意行军，都获得全功。
如果内卦的官鬼旺相、外卦的官鬼兴旺，就彼此对抗，难以判断胜负。
en: The inner Pressure is one's own men and the outer Pressure is the enemy's troops.
If they move and control the Self, the disaster is one's own men joining others, which is the injury of inside and outside in collusion.
If the Self is thriving and Pressure weak, though they move it is hard for them to injure or control.

If the Self turns into Output or Pressure turns into Output, Pressure is restrained, the plot does not break out and there is no untimely harm, as the classic says 'if someone restrains Pressure, what harm is there in its moving'.
If in the original hexagram Output is thriving and generates the Self, one attacks first and takes after, and moving troops as one wishes one gains complete success.
If the inner Pressure is thriving and the outer Pressure flourishing, they resist each other and it is hard to judge victory.

title: 出师征伐：鬼架长生帝旺寇兴世乱之时，官居墓库空亡国泰民安之象；内外无鬼盗兵不来，世应俱空战征已绝；战征以世为主将子作兵卒、以应为彼官鬼为贼，官鬼值长生帝旺则盗寇纵横，卦中内外无官或逢墓绝世应皆空则干戈偃息国泰民安

rule.yi: 官鬼乘着长生、帝旺，是贼寇兴起、世道大乱的时候；官鬼落在墓库、空亡，是国泰民安的景象；内外都没有官鬼，盗兵不来；世爻、应爻都空，战事已经断绝。战征的事，以世爻为主将，子孙当兵卒；以应爻为对方，官鬼为贼：如果官鬼值在长生、帝旺的位置，就盗寇纵横、西夷肆虐；如果卦中内外没有官鬼，或者逢墓、绝，世、应都空，就干戈止息，国泰民安了。
rule.en: If Pressure rides Birth or Emperor's Peak, it is a time of bandits rising and the world in disorder; if Pressure sits in the tomb or in Void, it is the image of a state at peace and a people secure; if there is no Pressure inside or outside, bandit troops do not come; if the Self and Other are both Void, war has ceased. In matters of war and campaign, the Self is the commander and Output is the soldiers; the Other is the enemy and Pressure is the bandits: if Pressure sits in the position of Birth or Emperor's Peak, bandits run wild and the western barbarians rage; if the hexagram has no Pressure inside or outside, or it meets tomb or extinction, and the Self and Other are both Void, arms are laid down and the state is at peace and the people secure.

note.yi: 「酉夷」疑是「西夷」，「干戈眼偃息」的「眼」疑是「顿」，译文按「西夷」「干戈止息」译。「架」是乘、骑。这一条与易隐征战占「官鬼旺动敌势盛」「内外无鬼敌必遁去」「世应俱空两将休兵」（YY.62、YY.54）取同一类断语。
note.en: 'You yi' is presumably 'xi yi', the western barbarians, and the 'yan' of 'ganqe yan yanxi' is presumably 'dun', suddenly; the translation reads 'the western barbarians' and 'arms are laid down'. 'Jia' is to ride. This entry takes the same kind of judgment as 'Pressure thriving and moving, the enemy's force is strong', 'no Pressure inside or outside, the enemy surely slips away' and 'the Self and Other both Void, the two commanders rest their troops' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.62, YY.54).

zh: 鬼架长生帝旺，寇兴世乱之时。
官居墓库空亡，国泰民安之象。
yi: 官鬼乘着长生、帝旺，是贼寇兴起、世道大乱的时候；
官鬼落在墓库、空亡，是国泰民安的景象；
内外都没有官鬼，盗兵不来；
世爻、应爻都空，战事已经断绝。
en: If Pressure rides Birth or Emperor's Peak, it is a time of bandits rising and the world in disorder;
if Pressure sits in the tomb or in Void, it is the image of a state at peace and a people secure;
if there is no Pressure inside or outside, bandit troops do not come;
if the Self and Other are both Void, war has ceased.

zh: 如战征之事，以世为主将，子作兵卒。
以应为彼，官鬼为贼，如官鬼值长生帝旺之乡，则盗寇纵横，酉夷肆虐，若卦中内外无官、或逢墓绝、世应皆空，则干戈眼偃息，国泰民安矣！
yi: 战征的事，以世爻为主将，子孙当兵卒。
以应爻为对方，官鬼为贼：如果官鬼值在长生、帝旺的位置，就盗寇纵横、西夷肆虐；如果卦中内外没有官鬼，或者逢墓、绝，世、应都空，就干戈止息，国泰民安了！
en: In matters of war and campaign, the Self is the commander and Output is the soldiers.

The Other is the enemy and Pressure is the bandits: if Pressure sits in the position of Birth or Emperor's Peak, bandits run wild and the western barbarians rage; if the hexagram has no Pressure inside or outside, or it meets tomb or extinction, and the Self and Other are both Void, arms are laid down and the state is at peace and the people secure!

title: 出师征伐结语：胜败我先知匪伊测度，吉凶神已告据理推详

rule.yi: 胜负我先知道，不是靠揣测；吉凶神明已经告知，要依据道理推究详察。
rule.en: Victory or defeat I know beforehand, and it is not by guesswork; good and ill the spirits have already told, and one should work them out by principle.

note.yi: 这是出师征伐章的结语，后面没有解说；「匪伊」是「不是」。
note.en: This is the closing couplet of the chapter on sending out troops and campaigning, and the book gives no explanation after it; 'fei yi' is 'not'.

yi: 胜负我先知道，不是靠揣测；
吉凶神明已经告知，要依据道理推究详察。
en: Victory or defeat I know beforehand, and it is not by guesswork;
good and ill the spirits have already told, and one should work them out by principle.

title: 求馆开设：以世应为主、财福为凭；觅馆招贤怕世空，应空岂得遇东翁，父空书馆终非美，才陷修仪甚不丰，世应不空须有望，变成冲散定无终；世为自己、应为东家、父为书馆、子为书生、财为束修、鬼为荐馆之人、兄乃同胞之士，逢空各有所缺

rule.yi: 求馆（谋求教书的馆席），以世爻、应爻为主，以妻财、子孙为凭据。求馆、受聘最怕世爻落空，应爻落空就遇不到东家；父爻落空，这个馆终究不是好馆；财爻陷入空亡，束修（馆金）很不丰厚。世爻、应爻都不落空，就必定有希望；如果变成冲散，就一定做不长久。六亲各取一象：世是自己，应是东家，父是书馆，子是书生，财是束修，鬼是荐馆的人，兄是同胞之士。落空各有所缺：世空遇不到尊重、听从自己的人，应空没有东家接纳，父空难遇好馆，财空束修菲薄，子空学生不多，鬼空无人举荐，兄空无人来争，身空住处不安；其余的空还可以稍微放过，只要世应不空，终究有希望。
rule.en: In seeking a school post, take the Self and the Other as the chief and Wealth and Output as the ground. To seek a post and be engaged, the Self falling Void is the thing most to be feared, and if the Other is Void one cannot meet the host; if Resource is Void the school is in the end no fine one; if Wealth is sunk into Void the fee is very meagre. If neither the Self nor the Other is Void there must be hope; if it changes into a scattering clash there will surely be no lasting end. The six kin each take one image: the Self is oneself, the Other the host, Resource the school, Output the pupils, Wealth the fee, Pressure the one who recommends a post, Peer the men of one's own kind. A Void in each leaves something lacking: if the Self is Void one meets no one who honours and follows one, if the Other is Void there is no host to take one in, if Resource is Void it is hard to meet a good post, if Wealth is Void the fee is slight, if Output is Void the pupils are few, if Pressure is Void no one recommends one, if Peer is Void no one competes, and if the Body is Void the place one lives is unsettled; the other Voids may be set aside somewhat, and if the Self and the Other are not Void there will in the end be hope.

note.yi: 「图书馆」是谋求书馆（教书的馆席），不是今天说的图书馆；「东翁」「东家」是聘请塾师的主人；「束修」是学生送给老师的酬金，这里指馆金；「荐馆之人」是介绍你去这个馆的人。诀里「才陷修仪」的「才」疑是「财」，解里「财空修体轻微」的「修体」疑是「修仪」，译文按「财」「修仪」译；「诸空稍可推」的「推」按「放过」译。「兄乃同胞之士」从后面「兄空无人抢夺」看，指来争这个馆的同行。这一条的六亲取象与黄金策求馆（HJC.29 起）、易隐觅馆占（YY.79）是同一套：世自己、应东家、父书馆、子学生、财馆金、鬼荐馆人、兄谋占者。
note.en: 'Tu shuguan' means to plan for a school post (a tutor's place) and not a library as the words mean today; 'dongweng' and 'dongjia' are the master who engages a tutor, 'shuxiu' is the fee that pupils give a teacher, here the pay of the post, and 'the one who recommends one to a post' is the person who introduces one to it. The 'cai' of 'cai xian xiuyi' in the verse is presumably 'cai', Wealth, and the 'xiuti' of 'cai kong xiuti qingwei' in the explanation is presumably 'xiuyi', the fee; the translation reads them so, and the 'tui' of 'zhu kong shao ke tui' is read as 'set aside'. From 'if Peer is Void no one competes for the post' later on, 'the men of one's own kind' means those in the same line who compete for the post. The kin images here are the same set as in the Huangjin Ce on seeking a post (from HJC.29) and in the Yi Yin divination for seeking a post (YY.79): the Self is oneself, the Other the host, Resource the school, Output the pupils, Wealth the pay, Pressure the one who recommends, Peer the one who schemes to take it.

yi: 以世爻、应爻为主要看的，以妻财、子孙（财福）为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Other as the chief to be looked at, and Wealth and Output as the ground.

zh: 觅馆招贤怕世空。应空岂得遇东翁，
父空书馆终非美，才陷修仪甚不丰，
世应不空须有望，变成冲散定无终，
无官之卦休寻访，无馆之年为六冲。
yi: 寻觅馆席、受聘为师，最怕世爻落空；应爻落空，怎么能遇到东家？
父爻落空，这个馆终究不是好馆；财爻陷入空亡，束修（馆金）很不丰厚。
世爻、应爻都不落空，就必定有希望；如果变成冲散，就一定做不长久。
没有官鬼的卦，就不要去寻访；没有馆席的年份，卦是六冲。
en: In seeking a post and being engaged as a worthy tutor, the Self falling Void is the thing to fear; if the Other is Void, how can one meet the host?
If Resource is Void, the school is in the end no fine one; if Wealth is sunk into Void, the fee is very meagre.
If neither the Self nor the Other is Void there must be hope; if it changes into a scattering clash there will surely be no lasting end.
A hexagram with no Pressure line, do not go seeking; the year with no post is the six-clash.

zh: 凡图书馆，世为自己，应为东家，父为书馆，子为书生，财为束修，鬼为荐馆之人，兄乃同胞之士，世空不遇尊从，应空无东纳。
父空难逢美馆，财空修体轻微。
子空门弟不多，鬼空无人举荐，兄空无人抢夺，身空居处不安，诸空稍可推，得世应不空终须有望。
yi: 凡是谋求书馆的，世爻代表自己，应爻代表东家，父爻代表书馆，子孙代表学生，妻财代表束修，官鬼代表荐馆的人，兄弟是同胞之士；世爻落空，遇不到尊重、听从自己的人；应爻落空，就没有东家接纳。
父爻落空，难遇好馆；财爻落空，束修轻微。
子孙落空，学生不多；官鬼落空，无人举荐；兄弟落空，无人来争抢；卦身落空，住的地方不安稳；其余各空还可以稍微放过，只要世应不空，终究有希望。
en: Whenever one plans for a school post, the Self is oneself, the Other is the host, Resource is the school, Output is the pupils, Wealth is the fee, Pressure is the one who recommends one to the post, and Peer is the men of one's own kind; if the Self is Void one meets no one who honours and follows one, and if the Other is Void there is no host to take one in.
If Resource is Void it is hard to meet a good post; if Wealth is Void the fee is slight.

If Output is Void the pupils are not many; if Pressure is Void no one recommends one; if Peer is Void no one competes for the post; if the Body is Void the place where one lives is unsettled; the other Voids may be set aside somewhat, and if the Self and the Other are not Void there will in the end be hope.

title: 求馆开设：凡值六冲之卦或无官鬼定无馆也；如合处逢冲或变出六冲虽见成就其年定主不终；游魂迁改它图吉、归魂乃旧胜西东；问迁更游魂大利、占守旧反要归魂

rule.yi: 凡是遇到六冲的卦，或者卦里没有官鬼，一定没有馆席；合的地方遇到冲，或者变出六冲，即使看着已经成了，那一年也一定做不到头。游魂卦，改换去别处另谋是吉；归魂卦，是守着旧馆，胜过东奔西走。所以问迁移更换的，游魂卦大为有利；占守旧馆的，反倒要归魂卦。
rule.en: Whenever the hexagram is a six-clash, or there is no Pressure line in it, there will surely be no post; if where there is a combination it meets a clash, or it changes out a six-clash, then even if the post seems to be settled, that year it will surely not last to the end. With a Wandering Soul hexagram, to move and change and plan for another post is auspicious; a Returning Soul hexagram is for the old post, better than going east and west. So for asking about moving to a change, a Wandering Soul is greatly favourable; for divining about keeping the old post, a Returning Soul is on the contrary what is wanted.

note.yi: 「游魂」「归魂」是八宫卦里每宫的第七卦和第八卦（见术语表）。「迁改它图」是改换去别处另谋，「西东」是东奔西走，这里指换馆奔走。「合处逢冲」按文意是本来成合的地方遇到冲，「变出六冲」是变卦成了六冲卦，书里没有再解释。这一条与易隐觅馆占「游魂宜别图，归魂宜仍旧」「六冲无馆、六合有馆」（YY.80）取同一个关系；「游魂」「归魂」只管换不换馆，不管成不成，成不成要看别的爻。
note.en: 'Wandering Soul' and 'Returning Soul' are the seventh and eighth hexagrams of each of the eight palaces (see the glossary). 'Qian gai ta tu' is to change and plan for another post elsewhere, and 'xi dong' is running east and west, here the running about of changing posts. 'Where there is a combination it meets a clash' is, by the sense, a place that was a combination meeting a clash, and 'changes out a six-clash' is the changed hexagram being a six-clash hexagram; the book does not explain them further. This entry takes the same relations as 'a Wandering Soul suits planning elsewhere, a Returning Soul suits keeping to the old' and 'a six-clash has no post, a six-combine has a post' in the Yi Yin divination for seeking a post (YY.80); the Wandering Soul and Returning Soul decide only whether one changes posts and not whether one succeeds, which is read from the other lines.

zh: 凡值六冲之卦或无官鬼定无馆也。
如合处逢冲或变出六冲，虽见成就，其年定主不终。
yi: 凡是遇到六冲的卦，或者卦里没有官鬼，一定没有馆席。
如果合的地方遇到冲，或者变出六冲，即使看着已经成了，那一年也一定做不到头。
en: Whenever the hexagram is a six-clash, or has no Pressure line, there will surely be no post.
If where there is a combination it meets a clash, or it changes out a six-clash, then even if it seems to be settled, that year it will surely not last to the end.

zh: 游魂迁改它图吉，归魂乃旧胜西东，
yi: 游魂卦，改换去别处另谋是吉；归魂卦，是守着旧馆，胜过东奔西走。
en: With a Wandering Soul hexagram, to move and change and plan for another post is auspicious; a Returning Soul hexagram is for the old post, which is better than going east and west.

zh: 问迁更、游魂大利，占守旧，反要归魂，
yi: 问迁移更换的，游魂卦大为有利；占守旧馆的，反倒要归魂卦。
en: For asking about moving to a change, a Wandering Soul hexagram is greatly favourable; for divining about keeping to the old post, on the contrary a Returning Soul hexagram is wanted.

title: 求馆开设：那日扶持生合世便教宾主两相逢；要知那日成关还详父母——卦中无父但逢值日方在，有父爻旺求墓合之时，衰取旺生之日，又看何日生世、空世亦可成关

rule.yi: 要知道哪一天定下这个馆，要细看父母爻：卦里有父爻而且旺相，取它入墓、逢合的时候；父爻衰弱，取它旺相、得生的日子；卦里没有父爻，要等到它当值的那一天才算在。还要看哪一天生世爻，世爻落空的也可以在那一天成。到了扶助、生合世爻的那一天，宾（师）主（东家）两方就会相见。
rule.en: To know on which day the engagement is settled, one must look closely at Resource: if Resource is in the hexagram and thriving, take the time when it enters the tomb or meets a combination; if it is weak, take the day when it thrives or is generated; if it is not in the hexagram, it is present only when the day on which it is on duty comes. Look also for the day that generates the Self; even a Void Self can then be settled. On the day that aids, generates or combines with the Self, guest and host come to meet each other.

note.yi: 「成关」的「关」应是关书（聘请塾师的聘书），「成关」就是把聘定下来；书里没有解释，这里按这个意思译。「卦中无父，但逢值日方在」按字面译：卦里没有父爻，要等到它当值的日子才算在；书里没有说「当值」按什么取，这里不加解释。「求墓合之时」的「墓」是父爻的墓库，「合」是与父爻相合的地支（见术语表）。末句「空世亦可成关」字面是世爻落空也能成；前面说世空遇不到尊从，这里说的是逢到生世的日子仍可成就，两处并不相冲。这一条与易隐觅馆占「关约何日来」（YY.81）取同一个法：旺则墓合日、衰则生旺日、无父则值日，又看生合世之日。
note.en: The 'guan' of 'cheng guan' is presumably the 'guanshu', the letter of engagement by which a tutor is hired, and 'cheng guan' is the engagement being settled; the book does not explain it, and the translation takes it so. 'If there is no Resource in the hexagram, it is present only when the day on which it is on duty comes' is translated literally: the book does not say by what the 'duty' is reckoned, and nothing is added here. In 'qiu mu he zhi shi' the 'tomb' is the tomb of the Resource line and the 'combination' is the branch that combines with it (see the glossary). The last sentence, 'a Void Self too can settle the engagement', literally says that a Void Self can still be settled; earlier it said that a Void Self meets no one who honours and follows one, and what is said here is that on a day that generates the Self it can still be accomplished, so the two places do not clash. This entry takes the same method as 'on what day the engagement comes' in the Yi Yin divination for seeking a post (YY.81): a thriving line by the tomb or combination day, a weak one by a generating or thriving day, a missing one by its duty day, and also the day that generates or combines with the Self.

zh: 那日扶持生合世，便教宾主两相逢。
yi: 到了扶助、生、合世爻的那一天，就会让宾（师）主（东家）两方相见。
en: On the day that aids, generates or combines with the Self, guest and host are made to meet each other.

zh: 要知那日成关，还详父母。
卦中无父，但逢值日方在。
如有父爻旺，求墓合之时。
衰取旺生之日，又看何日生世、空世亦可成关。
yi: 要知道是哪一天定下这个馆，还要细看父母爻。
卦中没有父爻的，要等到它当值的日子才算在。
如果有父爻而且旺相，就要找它入墓、逢合的时候。
父爻衰弱的，取它旺相、得生的日子；又要看哪一天生世爻；世爻落空的，也可以成就这个馆。
en: To know on which day the engagement is settled, one must still look closely at Resource.
If there is no Resource in the hexagram, it is present only when the day on which it is on duty comes.
If Resource is present and thriving, look for the time when it enters the tomb or meets a combination.
If it is weak, take the day when it thrives or is generated; look also for the day that generates the Self; even with the Self Void the engagement can be settled.

title: 仕宦升迁：以官爻为主、世象为凭；官职升迁子莫刚，唯求官鬼动为良，值生值旺当迁转，临陷临空且守常；子乃忌神不宜发动，官为主象最利交重，若临生旺定主高升，如值空亡未能迁转

rule.yi: 占官职升迁，以官爻为主，以世爻为凭据。子孙是官鬼的忌神，不宜刚旺发动；只求官鬼发动才好。官鬼得生、得旺，就该迁转升调；官鬼落陷、落空，就暂且守着原职、照常。官鬼是主象，最有利的是它发动；如果临生旺，一定主高升；如果遇到空亡，就不能迁转。
rule.en: In divining promotion in office, take the Pressure line as the chief and the Self image as the ground. Output is the Adversary of Pressure and must not be strong or move; one asks only that Pressure move, which is good. If Pressure is generated or thriving, one should expect to be promoted and transferred; if Pressure is sunk or Void, for the time being one keeps to the usual and holds one's post. Pressure is the chief image and is most favoured when it moves; if it meets generation or thriving, it surely means a high promotion; if it meets Void, there will be no promotion or transfer.

note.yi: 这一章把「升」写作「陛」（「高陛」「平陛」「陛迁」等），应是「升」的误写，译文一律按「升」译。「子莫刚」的「刚」是强旺、发动有力。「交重」是卦里发动爻的记号（「重」是老阳、「交」是老阴，都是会变的爻），这里泛指爻发动。「迁转」是官员的升迁调转。「临陷」的「陷」是落入空亡、墓绝一类的凶地，书里没有细说。这一条与黄金策「兴隆官鬼，定居一品之尊」「子若交重，当虑剥官削职」（HJC.02、HJC.03）和增删卜易升选候补（ZS.01、ZS.02）取同一个关系：官鬼为主，子孙为忌。
note.en: In this chapter 'sheng', to rise, is written 'bi' ('gao bi', 'ping bi', 'bi qian' and so on), which is presumably a miswriting of 'sheng', and the translation reads 'promotion' throughout. The 'gang' of 'zi mo gang' is strong and moving with force. 'Jiaozhong' are the marks of moving lines in a hexagram ('zhong' is old yang and 'jiao' old yin, both lines that change), and here mean a line moving in general. 'Qianzhuan' is the promotion and transfer of officials. The 'xian' of 'lin xian' is a fall into a bad place such as Void, tomb or extinction, and the book does not go into it. This entry takes the same relation as 'a flourishing Pressure settles one in the first rank' and 'if Output moves, beware of being stripped of office' in the Huangjin Ce (HJC.02, HJC.03) and as the Zengshan Buyi on promotion and selection (ZS.01, ZS.02): Pressure is the chief and Output the Adversary.

yi: 以官爻为主要看的，以世爻为凭据。
en: Take the Pressure line as the chief to be looked at, and the Self image as the ground.

zh: 官职升迁子莫刚，唯求官鬼动为良，
yi: 官职升迁，子孙爻不要刚强；只求官鬼发动才好。
官鬼得生、得旺，就该迁转升调。
官鬼落陷、落空，就暂且守着原职、照常。
en: For promotion in office, Output must not be strong; one asks only that Pressure move, which is good.
If Pressure is generated or thriving, one should expect to be promoted and transferred.
If Pressure is sunk or Void, for the time being one keeps to the usual and holds one's post.

zh: 凡占升迁，须评官鬼，子乃忌神，不宜发动，官为主象，最利交重，若临生旺，定主高陛。
yi: 凡是占升迁，必须评断官鬼：子孙是官鬼的忌神，不宜发动；官鬼是主象，最有利的是它发动；如果临生旺，一定主高升。
如果遇到空亡，就不能迁转。
en: In divining promotion one must judge Pressure: Output is the Adversary of Pressure and ought not to move; Pressure is the chief image and is most favoured when it moves; if it meets generation or thriving, it surely means a high promotion.
If it meets Void, one cannot be promoted or transferred.

title: 仕宦升迁：鬼化子字忧调降、官连财位沐恩光；官化子孙非降即调，卦中财子动亦然，若还财子同兴转助官爻又不降调，官若化财平升品级，官化进气官爻又主重超美职

rule.yi: 官鬼化成子孙，就要担忧被调、被降；官鬼连着财位（化成财），就沐浴恩光。具体说：官鬼化成子孙，不是降职就是调走，卦里财爻、子孙发动也是这样；但如果财爻、子孙一起发动，转过来帮助官爻，就又不降不调；官鬼化成财爻，是在原品级上平升；官爻化成进气的官爻，又主连升、超升到好的职位。
rule.en: If Pressure changes into Output, fear being transferred or demoted; if Pressure is joined to the Wealth place, one bathes in the glow of favour. In detail: if Pressure changes into Output it is either demotion or transfer, and the same if Wealth and Output move in the hexagram; but if Wealth and Output move together and turn to aid the Pressure line, there is then no demotion or transfer; if Pressure changes into Wealth, one is raised on a level in grade; if Pressure changes into an advancing-qi Pressure line, it again means a double promotion to a fine post.

note.yi: 「官连财位」按解里的「官若化财」译，指官鬼变成财爻。「平陛品级」的「平」疑是在原来的品级上升，即不加品级的平升；「重超」是连升、越级升；「进气」是进神（见术语表）。财爻、子孙一起发动转助官爻就不降调：按五行相生，子孙生财、财生官，子孙的力量经财爻传给官鬼，它就不再是克官的忌神——这是据五行相生推的，书里没有明说。这一条与易隐官禄占「官化财平升」（YY.22）、增删卜易「化进神加官晋爵」（ZS.15）是同一类断语。
note.en: 'Guan lian cai wei' is translated after 'if Pressure changes into Wealth' in the explanation, and means Pressure changing into the Wealth line. The 'ping' of 'ping sheng pinji' is presumably a rise on the same grade, that is a level promotion with no grade added; 'chong chao' is repeated or over-ranked promotion; 'jin qi' is an advancing spirit (see the glossary). That Wealth and Output moving together and turning to aid Pressure means no demotion is read by the generation of the five elements: Output generates Wealth and Wealth generates Pressure, so the force of Output passes through Wealth to Pressure and Output is no longer the Adversary that controls the star of office; this is inferred from five-element generation and the book does not say it. This entry is the same kind of judgment as 'Pressure changes into Wealth, level promotion' in the Yi Yin divination for official salary and rank (YY.22) and 'changing into an advancing spirit adds office and rank' in the Zengshan Buyi (ZS.15).

zh: 鬼化子字忧调降，官连财位沐恩光。
yi: 官鬼化成子孙，就要担忧被调、被降；官鬼连着财位，就沐浴恩光。
en: If Pressure changes into Output, fear being transferred or demoted; if Pressure is joined to the Wealth place, one bathes in the glow of favour.

zh: 官化子孙，非降即调，卦中财子动亦然。
若还财子同兴转助官爻，又不降调，官若化财平陛品级，官化进气官爻，又主重超美职。
yi: 官鬼化成子孙，不是降职就是调走，卦里财爻、子孙发动也是这样。
如果财爻、子孙一起发动，转过来帮助官爻，就又不降不调；官鬼如果化成财爻，是在原品级上平升；官爻化成进气的官爻，又主连升、超升到好的职位。
en: If Pressure changes into Output, it is either demotion or transfer, and the same if Wealth and Output move in the hexagram.

If Wealth and Output move together and turn to aid the Pressure line, there is then no demotion or transfer; if Pressure changes into Wealth, one is raised on a level in grade; if Pressure changes into an advancing-qi Pressure line, it again means a double promotion to a fine post.

title: 仕宦升迁：财之福象加爵禄、妻变兄爻减俸粮；妻财为俸禄，财化子孙加衔赐禄，变成兄弟罢俸减粮

rule.yi: 妻财是俸禄：财爻化成福象（子孙），就加官衔、赐俸禄；财爻变成兄爻（兄弟），就罢俸、减粮。
rule.en: Wealth is the salary: if Wealth changes into the fortune image, Output, rank is added and pay is granted; if Wealth changes into a Peer line, salary is stopped and grain is cut.

note.yi: 这一条与黄金策「兄如发动，须防减俸除粮」（HJC.04）、易隐官禄占「财化福加俸秩；财化兄罚俸粮」（YY.19）同取妻财为俸禄，财爻向子孙变是添、向兄弟变是减。
note.en: This entry, like 'if Peer moves, beware of reduced salary and cut grain' in the Huangjin Ce (HJC.04) and 'Wealth changes into Output, rank and pay are added; Wealth changes into Peer, salary is fined' in the Yi Yin divination for official salary and rank (YY.19), takes Wealth as the salary: a Wealth line changing toward Output adds and changing toward Peer subtracts.

zh: 财之福象加爵禄，妻变兄爻减俸粮，
yi: 财爻变出福象，加官爵、加俸禄；妻财变成兄爻，减少俸粮。
en: If Wealth turns into the fortune image, rank and pay are increased; if Wealth changes into a Peer line, salary and grain are reduced.

zh: 妻财为俸禄，财化子孙加衔赐禄，变成兄弟罢俸减粮。
yi: 妻财是俸禄：财爻化成子孙，加官衔、赐俸禄；变成兄弟，罢俸、减粮。
en: Wealth is the salary: if Wealth changes into Output, rank is added and pay is granted; if it changes into Peer, salary is stopped and grain is cut.

title: 仕宦升迁：卦得归魂还复任、游魂迁转在他方；若卜归魂还当复任，归魂化归魂理应致仕，如遇游魂官又旺者必升别省，游魂化游魂升后再升远处

rule.yi: 卦得归魂，是回来再任原职；卦得游魂，是迁转到别的地方去。具体说：卜得归魂，还会恢复原任；归魂化成归魂，按理应当退休（致仕）；遇到游魂而官又旺相的，必定升到别的省；游魂化成游魂，升了之后再升到远处。
rule.en: A Returning Soul hexagram means returning to the former post; a Wandering Soul means being moved and transferred elsewhere. In detail: if a Returning Soul is cast, one will return to the former post; a Returning Soul changing into a Returning Soul means that by right one should retire from office; if one meets a Wandering Soul and the star of office is again thriving, one is surely raised to another province; a Wandering Soul changing into a Wandering Soul means being promoted and then promoted again to a far place.

note.yi: 「游魂」「归魂」是八宫卦里每宫的第七、第八卦（见术语表）。「复任」是回到原来的任上，「致仕」是退休。归魂变归魂「理应致仕」，与易隐官禄占「游魂化归魂宜致仕」（YY.20）一样落在「归」字上，但前提不同：那里是游魂变归魂，这里是归魂变归魂。
note.en: 'Wandering Soul' and 'Returning Soul' are the seventh and eighth hexagrams of each of the eight palaces (see the glossary). 'Fu ren' is returning to one's former post and 'zhi shi' is retiring from office. That a Returning Soul changing into a Returning Soul 'by right should retire' falls on the word 'return' just as 'a Wandering Soul changing into a Returning Soul suits retiring' does in the Yi Yin divination for official salary and rank (YY.20), but the starting point differs: there a Wandering Soul changes into a Returning Soul, here a Returning Soul changes into a Returning Soul.

zh: 卦得归魂还复任，游魂迁转在他方。
yi: 卦得归魂，是回来再任原职；游魂，是迁转到别的地方去。
en: If the hexagram is a Returning Soul, one returns to the former post; a Wandering Soul means being moved and transferred to another place.

zh: 若卜归魂，还当复任，归魂化归魂，理应致仕，如遇游魂官又旺者，必陛别省。
游魂化游魂，陛后再陛远处。
yi: 如果卜得归魂，还会恢复原任；归魂化成归魂，按理应当退休；如果遇到游魂而官又旺相的，必定升到别的省去。
游魂化成游魂，升了之后再升到远处。
en: If a Returning Soul is cast, one will return to the former post; if a Returning Soul changes into a Returning Soul, by right one should retire from office; if one meets a Wandering Soul and the star of office is again thriving, one is surely raised to another province.
If a Wandering Soul changes into a Wandering Soul, after being raised one is raised again to a far place.

title: 仕宦升迁：世空未得高升任、财动还须佐帝皇；世爻为自身本官，自卜当察世爻、世若空亡未能迁转，他人代卜又不取世爻为主专看官爻、若得财动生官自然显达

rule.yi: 世爻是自己本人的官职：自己占卜，要察看世爻，世爻落空，就不能升迁；替别人占卜，就不取世爻为主，专看官爻，如果得到财爻发动生官爻，自然显达，能去辅佐帝王。
rule.en: The Self line is one's own post: in divining for oneself, look at the Self line, and if the Self is Void one cannot be promoted or transferred; in divining on behalf of another, do not take the Self as the chief but look only at the Pressure line, and if Wealth moves to generate Pressure, one naturally rises to eminence and goes on to assist the sovereign.

note.yi: 「本官」是自己现任的官职。「他人代卜」书里没有说明代的是谁；按文意是替别人占他的升迁，世爻不再是被问的人，所以改看官爻——这是据文意的读法。这一条与黄金策「世动逢空，官居不久」（HJC.08）同看世爻：自占看世爻。
note.en: 'Benguan' is the post one now holds. The book does not say who is divining 'on behalf of another'; by the sense it is divining another person's promotion, so the Self is no longer the person asked about and the Pressure line is looked at instead; this is a reading from the sense. This entry looks at the Self as the Huangjin Ce does in 'if the Self moves and meets Void, one does not stay long in office' (HJC.08): in divining for oneself, look at the Self.

zh: 世空未得高升任，财动还须佐帝皇，
yi: 世爻落空，就得不到高升的官职；财爻发动，还要去辅佐帝王。
en: If the Self is Void one does not get a high post; if Wealth moves, one will go on to assist the emperor.

zh: 世爻为自身本官，自卜当察世爻，世若空亡未能迁转。
他人代卜，又不取世爻为主，专看官爻，若得财动生官，自然显达。
yi: 世爻是自己本人的官职，自己占卜，就该察看世爻；世爻如果空亡，就不能迁转。
别人代为占卜，就不取世爻为主，专看官爻；如果得到财爻发动生官爻，自然显达。
en: The Self line is one's own post; in divining for oneself one should examine the Self line, and if the Self is Void, one cannot be promoted or transferred.
If another divines on one's behalf, the Self is not taken as the chief; look only at the Pressure line, and if Wealth moves to generate Pressure, one naturally rises to eminence.

title: 仕宦升迁：鬼变退神宜致仕、化居墓绝早还乡；鬼爻若化退气或变入墓绝之中，莫望升迁，远归田里

rule.yi: 官鬼变成退神，适宜退休（致仕）；变入墓、绝，就早早回乡。官鬼爻如果化成退气，或者变入墓、绝之中，就不要指望升迁，只能远远地回到乡里。
rule.en: If Pressure changes into a retreating spirit it is fitting to retire from office; if it changes into tomb or extinction, one returns home early. If the Pressure line changes into a retreating qi, or changes into tomb or extinction, do not hope for promotion, but go far away and return to the countryside.

note.yi: 「退气」就是退神（见术语表）：变爻往后退一步。「致仕」是退休，「田里」是乡里、田园。这一条与易隐官禄占「游魂化归魂宜致仕」（YY.20）和增删卜易「官化退、休致须宜化退」（ZS.47）说的是同一个去向：官爻往后退，人就退。
note.en: 'Tui qi' is the retreating spirit (see the glossary): the changed line takes a step back. 'Zhi shi' is retiring from office and 'tianli' is the countryside and the fields. This entry points the same way as 'a Wandering Soul changing into a Returning Soul suits retiring' in the Yi Yin divination for official salary and rank (YY.20) and as 'for resigning from office, a changing into a retreating spirit is wanted' in the Zengshan Buyi (ZS.47): when the star of office steps back, the man retires.

zh: 鬼变退神宜致仕，化居墓绝早还乡。
yi: 官鬼变成退神，适宜退休；化到墓、绝的位置，就早点回乡。
en: If Pressure changes into a retreating spirit it is fitting to retire from office; if it changes into tomb or extinction, return home early.

zh: 鬼爻若化退气或变入墓绝之中，莫望陛迁，远归田里。
yi: 官鬼爻如果化成退气，或者变入墓、绝之中，就不要指望升迁，只能远远地回到乡里。
en: If the Pressure line changes into a retreating qi, or changes into tomb or extinction, do not hope for promotion, but go far away and return to the countryside.

title: 仕宦升迁：欲知何月官升处、遇值逢生喜报祥；欲决何时迁转，推评官鬼旺衰——旺则高升在近，衰则待生旺之期；若六爻无鬼，查那月临官，便知迁升决矣

rule.yi: 要知道官职在哪个月升，遇到官爻当值、得生的月份，就有喜报。要断定什么时候迁转，就推断官鬼的旺衰：官鬼旺相，高升就在眼前；衰弱，就等它得生、旺相的时候。如果六爻里没有官鬼，再查哪个月临到官，就能知道升迁的决断了。
rule.en: To know in which month one is promoted, when the line meets its own month or the month that generates it, joyful news is reported. To decide when the promotion or transfer will come, weigh the strength of Pressure: if it is thriving, the high promotion is near at hand; if weak, wait for the time when it is generated or thriving. If there is no Pressure among the six lines, then check which month falls on the star of office, and one will know the decision of the promotion.

note.yi: 「官陛处」的「陛」是「升」。「高承升在尔」按字面不顺，「尔」疑是「迩」（近），译作「高升就在近前」；「承」不译。「那月临官」按文意是官爻（官星）当值的那个月，书里没有细说。这一条与易隐官禄占「候选（二）·何日得官」（YY.08）取同一个法：官旺者看当值或合的年月日，官衰者看生旺的时候，官伏藏者看临值的时候。
note.en: The 'bi' of 'guan bi chu' is 'sheng', to rise. 'Gao cheng sheng zai er' does not run smoothly as written, and 'er' is presumably 'er', near, so it is translated 'the high promotion is near at hand'; 'cheng' is left untranslated. 'The month falls on the star of office' is, by the sense, the month in which the line of the star of office is on duty, which the book does not go into. This entry takes the same method as 'on what day one gets office' in the Yi Yin divination on awaiting selection (YY.08): for a thriving star of office look at the year, month or day on duty or in combination, for a weak one at the time it is generated or thriving, and for a hidden one at the time it comes on duty.

zh: 欲知何月官陛处，遇值逢生喜报祥。
yi: 要知道官职在哪个月升，遇到（官爻）当值、得生的月份，就有喜报吉祥。
en: To know in which month the official is raised, when the line meets its own month or the month that generates it, joyful news and good omens are reported.

zh: 欲决何时迁转，推评官鬼旺衰，旺则高承升在尔，衰则待生旺之期。
若六爻无鬼，后查那月临官，便知迁陛决矣！
yi: 想断定什么时候迁转，就推断官鬼的旺衰：旺相，高升就在眼前；衰弱，就等它得生、旺相的时期。
如果六爻里没有官鬼，再查哪个月临到官，就能知道升迁的决断了！
en: To decide when the promotion or transfer will come, weigh the strength of Pressure: if it is thriving, the high promotion is near at hand; if weak, wait for the time when it is generated or thriving.
If there is no Pressure among the six lines, then check which month falls on the star of office, and one will know the decision of the promotion!

title: 袭求武弁总纲：以官爻为主、世象为凭；动业赞皇猷鹰扬渭水、簪缨绳祖武虎拜枫宸；大凡袭爵承官皆沐君恩祖荫，欲识利名显晦远凭卦象推详

rule.yi: 占承袭爵位、谋求武职，以官爻为主，以世爻为凭据。承袭爵位、接任官职，都是沾受君王的恩典和祖先的荫庇；想知道利和名是显达还是暗淡，要靠卦象去推详。
rule.en: In divining about inheriting a title or seeking a military rank, take the Pressure line as the chief and the Self image as the ground. Inheriting a title and succeeding to an office are all through the sovereign's grace and the shade of one's ancestors; to know whether gain and name will be bright or dim, one must work it out from the images of the hexagram.

note.yi: 「鹰扬渭水」用的是吕尚（姜太公）在渭水边遇周文王、后来在牧野《诗经》称他「维师尚父，时维鹰扬」的典故；「虎拜」用的是《诗经》「虎拜稽首」，召虎受命后叩拜周王；「枫宸」指宫廷。「绳租武」的「租」是「祖」的误写，「绳祖武」是继承祖先的足迹；「祖阴」是「祖荫」，祖先的庇荫。「弁」是武弁，指武官。这一章讲的是承袭武爵和谋求武职两件事，取法与前面的仕宦升迁章一样：官爻为主、世爻为凭。
note.en: 'Yingyang Weishui' alludes to Lü Shang (the Grand Duke Jiang), who met King Wen by the Wei river and of whom the Book of Odes says 'the Grand Teacher Shangfu, here the eagle soaring'; 'hu bai' alludes to the Odes' 'the tiger bows and touches his head to the ground', Shao Hu bowing to the Zhou king after receiving his charge; 'fengchen', the Maple Court, is the imperial court. The 'zu' of 'sheng zu wu' is written with the character for 'rent' and is a miswriting of the character for 'ancestor': 'to follow the ancestors' footsteps'; the 'yin' of 'zu yin' is written with the character for 'yin and yang' and is a miswriting of 'yin', shade or protection, the shelter of ancestors. 'Bian' in the chapter title is a military officer. The chapter deals with two things, inheriting a military title and seeking a military post, and takes the same method as the preceding chapter on official promotion: the Pressure line as chief and the Self line as ground.

yi: 以官爻为主要看的，以世爻为凭据。
en: Take the Pressure line as the chief to be looked at, and the Self image as the ground.

yi: 建立功业，辅佐皇上的谋略，像在渭水边鹰扬奋起的吕尚；
世代簪缨的官宦子弟，继承祖先的武功，像虎臣那样在枫宸（宫廷）叩拜君王。
en: Doing deeds to assist the sovereign's plans, like the eagle soaring at the Wei river;
the sons of capped and tasselled officials follow in the footsteps of their ancestors' martial deeds, and bow like tiger-vassals in the Maple Court.

zh: 大凡袭爵承官，皆沐君恩祖阴，欲识利名显晦，远凭卦象推详。
yi: 凡是承袭爵位、接任官职，都沾受君王的恩典和祖先的荫庇；要知道利和名是显达还是暗淡，须靠卦象从远处推详。
en: Whenever one inherits a title or succeeds to an office, it is all through the sovereign's grace and the shade of one's ancestors; to know whether gain and name will be bright or dim, one must rely on the images of the hexagram and reckon it out in detail from afar.

title: 袭求武弁：献策请缨父象要兴财忌动；献策论者专看文书，父旺必然高中、父空岂得成名，父若不空又嫌财动

rule.yi: 向朝廷献策、自请从军，要看父母爻：父爻旺相，一定高中；父爻落空，怎么能成名？父爻即使不空，还忌讳财爻发动。
rule.en: To submit a plan to the court and volunteer for service, look at Resource: if Resource is thriving, one will surely pass high; if Resource is Void, how can one make a name? Even if Resource is not Void, one still dislikes Wealth moving.

note.yi: 「请缨」出自终军「愿受长缨，必羁南越王而致之阙下」，是自请出征；「献策」是向朝廷上策论。武职这条路上献策请缨看文书爻（父母爻），因为文书就是策论、章奏。财爻忌动，是因为财克父（五行相克），书里没有明说。「高中」是考中高第。
note.en: 'Qingying', to ask for the tassel, comes from Zhong Jun's 'I wish to receive a long tassel and surely bind the king of Southern Yue and bring him to the palace', and means volunteering for a campaign; 'xiance' is presenting a policy memorial to the court. On this path to a military post, presenting a plan and volunteering is read from the document line, Resource, because the document is the memorial and the policy paper. That Wealth must not move is because Wealth controls Resource (five-element control); the book does not say so. 'Gao zhong' is passing with a high place.

zh: 献策请缨，父象要兴财忌动。
yi: 献策、请缨，父爻之象要兴旺，财爻忌发动。
en: To submit a plan and ask for the tassel, the image of Resource must flourish and Wealth must not move.

zh: 献策论者，专看文书，父旺必然高中，父空，岂得成名？
yi: 献策、论事的人，专看文书爻：父爻旺相，一定高中；父爻落空，怎么能成名？
父爻如果不空，又嫌财爻发动。
en: For those who present plans and discuss policy, look especially at the document line: if Resource is thriving, one will surely pass high; if Resource is Void, how can one make a name?
If Resource is not Void, one still dislikes Wealth moving.

title: 袭求武弁：从戎比试世爻喜旺应宜衰；若交锋者又凭世应——世旺应衰他必弱、世衰应旺彼当强，世克应则大胜、应克世则难赢

rule.yi: 从军、比试武艺，世爻喜欢旺相，应爻适宜衰弱。如果是临阵交锋，又凭世、应：世旺应衰，对方一定弱；世衰应旺，对方就强；世克应是大胜，应克世就难以取胜。
rule.en: For joining the army or a military trial, the Self line likes to be thriving and the Other should be weak. For those who cross swords in battle, rely again on the Self and the Other: if the Self is thriving and the Other weak, the other side is surely weak; if the Self is weak and the Other thriving, the other side is strong; if the Self controls the Other it is a great victory, and if the Other controls the Self it is hard to win.

note.yi: 「又凭」在上一行末，「世应」在下一行首，这里连起来读。「交锋」是两军交战。这一条与易隐征战占「世为我帅应为彼将；世旺应衰宜攻、世衰应旺宜守；世克应可战」（YY.54）、黄金策征战「观世应之旺衰，以决两家之胜负」（HJC.86）取同一个关系：世为己方，应为对方。
note.en: 'You ping' is at the end of the previous line and 'shi ying' at the start of the next, and they are read joined up here. 'Jiaofeng' is two armies meeting in battle. This entry takes the same relation as 'the Self is my commander and the Other the enemy general; with the Self thriving and the Other weak, attack; with the Self weak and the Other thriving, defend; if the Self controls the Other, one can fight' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.54) and 'watch the strength of the Self and the Other to decide the victory of the two houses' in the Huangjin Ce (HJC.86): the Self is one's own side and the Other the opposing side.

zh: 从戎比试，世爻喜旺应宜衰。
yi: 从军、比试，世爻喜欢旺相，应爻适宜衰弱。
en: For joining the army or a military trial, the Self line likes to be thriving and the Other should be weak.

zh: 若交锋者，又凭世应，世旺应衰他必弱，世衰应旺彼当强。
世克应则大胜，应克世则难赢。
yi: 如果是交锋（临阵交战）的，又凭世、应：世旺应衰，对方一定弱；世衰应旺，对方就强。
世爻克制应爻，就是大胜；应爻克制世爻，就难以取胜。
en: For those who cross swords in battle, rely again on the Self and the Other: if the Self is thriving and the Other weak, the other side is surely weak; if the Self is weak and the Other thriving, the other side is strong.
If the Self controls the Other it is a great victory; if the Other controls the Self it is hard to win.

title: 袭求武弁：受荫袭封喜遇贵乘禄马、买官进爵喜逢龙聚财官；所忌者六冲世陷空徒费力，所喜者六合官兴财旺总如心；军中占袭职民间卜官各忌世空官空六冲之卦，得官与世旺定显威风，官世带青龙贵人及卦逢六合威福更加

rule.yi: 靠祖荫承袭封爵，喜欢遇到贵人乘着禄、马；捐买官职、进升爵位，喜欢遇到青龙聚着财爻、官爻。所忌讳的是六冲、世爻落陷落空，白费力气；所喜欢的是六合、官鬼兴旺、财爻旺相，事事称心。军中占承袭职位、民间卜官职，各自都忌世爻空、官空和六冲的卦；如果官与世都旺相，一定显出威风；官爻或世爻带青龙、贵人，以及卦遇六合，威势和福分更加增添。
rule.en: To inherit a title by ancestral privilege, one is glad to meet the Noble riding on the Emolument and the Horse; to buy an office and advance in rank, one is glad to meet the Dragon gathering Wealth and the star of office. What is feared is a six-clash with the Self sunk or Void, which is wasted effort; what is welcomed is a six-combine with Pressure flourishing and Wealth thriving, everything as one wishes. In the army divining for inheriting a post, or among the people divining for office, each fears the Self Void, the star of office Void, and a six-clash hexagram; if the star of office and the Self are both thriving, one will surely show authority; if the Pressure line or the Self line carries the Azure Dragon or the Noble, or the hexagram meets a six-combine, authority and fortune are further increased.

note.yi: 「受荫」是靠祖先的功劳取得封爵；「买官进爵」是捐纳。「恢逢」疑是「喜逢」（上一联是「喜遇」），译作「喜欢遇到」。「贵乘禄马」是贵人、禄、驿马这几样同时遇上（见术语表）。「官空」的「官」是官鬼。「六合」「六冲」指卦的六合、六冲。这一条与易隐官禄占「何官」一组里的「世持官贵禄马」（YY.03、YY.04）取同一类象。
note.en: 'Shou yin' is obtaining a title through the merit of one's ancestors; 'mai guan jin jue' is buying office and rank by contribution. The 'hui' of 'hui feng' is presumably 'xi', glad (the couplet before has 'xi yu'), and is translated 'glad to meet'. 'Gui cheng lu ma' is the Noble, the Emolument and the Post Horse met together (see the glossary). The 'guan' of 'guan kong' is Pressure. 'Six-combine' and 'six-clash' are the hexagram patterns. This entry takes the same kind of image as 'the Self holds the Noble, Emolument and Horse' in the 'which office' group of the Yi Yin divination on official salary (YY.03, YY.04).

zh: 受荫袭封，喜遇贵乘禄马。
买官进爵，恢逢龙聚财官。
所忌者六冲世陷空徒费力，
所喜者六合官兴财旺总如心。
yi: 靠祖荫承袭封爵，喜欢遇到贵人乘着禄、马；
捐买官职、进升爵位，喜欢遇到青龙聚着财爻、官爻。
所忌讳的是六冲、世爻落陷落空，白费力气；
所喜欢的是六合、官鬼兴旺、财爻旺相，总是称心如意。
en: To inherit a title by ancestral privilege, one is glad to meet the Noble riding on the Emolument and the Horse;
to buy an office and advance in rank, one is glad to meet the Dragon gathering Wealth and the star of office.
What is feared is a six-clash with the Self sunk or Void, which is wasted effort;
what is welcomed is a six-combine with Pressure flourishing and Wealth thriving, everything as one wishes.

zh: 军中占袭职，民间卜官，各忌世空官空、六冲之卦，若得官与世旺，定显威风。
官爻或世爻若带青龙贵人、及卦逢六合，威福更加。
yi: 军中占承袭职位、民间卜官职，各自都忌讳世爻空、官空和六冲的卦；如果官与世都旺相，一定显出威风。
官爻或者世爻如果带青龙、贵人，以及卦遇六合，威势和福分更加增添。
en: In the army divining for inheriting a post, or among the people divining for office, each fears the Self Void, the star of office Void, and a six-clash hexagram; if the star of office and the Self are both thriving, one will surely show authority.
If the Pressure line or the Self line carries the Azure Dragon or the Noble, or the hexagram meets a six-combine, authority and fortune are further increased.

title: 袭求武弁：鬼在酉申耀武扬威膺世禄、官临乾兑攘夷发夏树奇功；官爻或世爻如临乾兑卦中或在酉申爻内俱当名振华夷

rule.yi: 官鬼在酉爻、申爻，显耀武功、扬起威风，享受世袭的俸禄；官爻落在乾卦、兑卦，抵御外族、振奋华夏，树立非凡的功劳。官爻或者世爻如果落在乾、兑卦中，或者在酉、申爻上，都会名声震动华夏和外族。
rule.en: If Pressure is on a You or Shen line, one displays martial prowess and raises one's awe, and receives a hereditary emolument; if the star of office is in the Qian or Dui trigram, one drives out the barbarians, raises up the Hua-Xia, and sets up extraordinary merit. If the Pressure line or the Self line falls in the Qian or Dui trigram, or is on a You or Shen line, in every case one's name shakes both the Chinese and the barbarians.

note.yi: 酉、申属金，乾、兑也属金；金主兵刃，所以取武职要看它们（黄金策征战「金为刀箭」，HJC.111）。「世禄」是世代承袭的俸禄。「攘夷发夏」的「发夏」疑是「发扬华夏」，译作「振奋华夏」；「华夷」是华夏和外族。
note.en: You and Shen belong to Metal, and Qian and Dui also belong to Metal; Metal governs blades and weapons, which is why they are looked at for military posts (the Huangjin Ce on campaigns says 'Metal is knife and arrow', HJC.111). 'Shi lu' is an emolument handed down from generation to generation. The 'fa xia' of 'rang yi fa xia' is presumably 'fayang Huaxia', to bring glory to the Chinese, and is translated 'raises up the Hua-Xia'; 'hua yi' is the Chinese and the barbarians.

zh: 鬼在酉申，耀武扬威膺世禄。
官临乾兑，攘夷发夏树奇功。
yi: 官鬼在酉爻、申爻，显耀武功、扬起威风，享受世袭的俸禄；
官爻落在乾卦、兑卦，抵御外族、振奋华夏，树立非凡的功劳。
en: If Pressure is on a You or Shen line, one displays martial prowess and raises one's awe, and receives a hereditary emolument;
if the star of office is in the Qian or Dui trigram, one drives out the barbarians, raises up the Hua-Xia, and sets up extraordinary merit.

zh: 官爻或世爻如临乾兑卦中，或在酉申爻内，俱当名振华夷。
yi: 官爻或者世爻如果落在乾、兑卦中，或者在酉、申爻上，都会名声震动华夏和外族。
en: If the Pressure line or the Self line falls in the Qian or Dui trigram, or is on a You or Shen line, in every case one's name shakes both the Chinese and the barbarians.

title: 袭求武弁：内外卦得兴隆则功高誉远、世旺逢生勇冠三军蒙上赏、官兴得助爵尊一品沐殊恩、身遇岁君生合战征场内作高魁；武职行中得内外卦兴隆世应旺相势压旁疆，世旺再逢太岁或日辰月建生扶者勇冠三军

rule.yi: 武职之中，内卦、外卦都兴旺，功劳就高、名誉就远；世爻旺相又逢生，勇冠三军、蒙受上司的赏赐；官爻兴旺又得帮助，爵位尊到一品、沐浴特殊的恩典；卦身遇到太岁生合，在战场上拔得头魁。内外卦兴旺、世应旺相，威势一定压倒邻近的疆界；世旺再遇太岁，或者日辰、月建生扶的，勇冠三军。
rule.en: Among military posts, if the inner and outer trigrams are both flourishing, merit is high and fame far; if the Self is thriving and is generated, one's courage tops the three armies and one receives the superior's reward; if the star of office flourishes and gains aid, one's rank is of the first grade and one bathes in special favour; if the Body meets generation or combination from Tai Sui, one becomes the top man in the field of war. With the inner and outer trigrams flourishing and the Self and the Other thriving, one's power will surely overawe the neighbouring borders; if the Self is thriving and also meets Tai Sui, or the Day and the Month generate and support it, one's courage tops the three armies.

note.yi: 这一首诀有五联，这一条取其中好的三联和解里前两句，坏的两联放在下一条（EL.68）。「身」是卦身（见术语表），「岁君」是太岁。「戈戟」「三军」是军队。「魁」是第一名。「内外卦」是内卦（下卦）和外卦（上卦）。这一条与易隐征战占「世持虎福旺相决胜千里，加日辰生扶百战百胜」（YY.55）是同一类断语。
note.en: This verse has five couplets; this entry takes the three auspicious ones and the first two sentences of the explanation, and the two ominous couplets are in the next entry (EL.68). 'Shen' is the Body of the hexagram (see the glossary), and 'suijun' is Tai Sui. 'Sanjun' is the armies. 'Kui' is the first place. The 'inner and outer trigrams' are the inner (lower) and outer (upper) trigrams. This entry is the same kind of judgment as 'the Self holds the Tiger and Output, thriving, decides victory a thousand miles away; with the Day generating and supporting it, a hundred battles, a hundred victories' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.55).

zh: 内外卦得兴隆，则功高誉远。
yi: 内卦、外卦都兴旺，功劳就高、名誉就远。
en: If the inner and outer trigrams are flourishing, then merit is high and fame travels far.

zh: 世旺逢生，勇冠三军蒙上赏，官兴得助爵尊一品沐殊恩。
yi: 世爻旺相又逢生，勇气冠绝三军、蒙受上司的赏赐；官爻兴旺又得帮助，爵位尊到一品、沐浴特殊的恩典。
en: If the Self is thriving and meets generation, one's courage tops the three armies and receives the superior's reward; if the star of office flourishes and gains aid, one's rank is of the first grade and one bathes in special favour.

zh: 身遇岁君生合，战征场内作高魁。
yi: 卦身遇到太岁生合，在战场上拔得头魁。
en: If the Body meets generation or combination from Tai Sui, in the field of war one becomes the top man.

zh: 武职行中，若得内卦外卦兴隆，世爻应爻旺相，定然势压旁疆。
世旺再逢太岁，或日辰月建生扶者，勇冠三军。
yi: 在武职之中，如果内卦、外卦兴旺，世爻、应爻旺相，威势一定压倒邻近的疆界。
世爻旺相，又遇太岁，或者日辰、月建生扶它的，勇冠三军。
en: Among the military posts, if the inner and outer trigrams are flourishing and the Self and the Other lines are thriving, one's power will surely overawe the neighbouring borders.
If the Self is thriving and also meets Tai Sui, or the Day and the Month generate and support it, one's courage tops the three armies.

title: 袭求武弁：身世爻当衰弱则力怯机疏、世逢日月克冲戈戟最为下辈；世若休囚卦不旺相当推无力无能，又被日辰月建冲克世爻者提拔全无反遭弹劾，其中又看官爻旺则声名显赫空则劾削兵权

rule.yi: 身爻、世爻衰弱，就力量怯弱、机会稀少；世爻遇到日、月克制或冲，在拿戈戟的人当中也是最下等的。世爻如果休囚、卦又不旺相，就该断为没有力量、没有才能；又被日辰、月建冲克世爻的，完全没有提拔，反而遭到弹劾，哪里能在军队中出名？这中间还要看官爻：旺相就声名显赫，落空就被弹劾、削去兵权。
rule.en: If the Body and Self lines are weak, one's strength is timid and one's chances sparse; if the Self meets control or clash from the Day and the Month, even among bearers of spear and halberd one is of the lowest rank. If the Self is at rest or imprisoned and the hexagram is not thriving, one should be judged as without strength or ability; if the Self line is again clashed or controlled by the Day and the Month, there is no advancement at all and on the contrary impeachment, so how could one win fame in the ranks?
