Among these, look also at the Pressure line: if it is thriving, fame is eminent; if it is Void, one is impeached and stripped of military power.

note.yi: 「休囚」是休、囚两种不得令的状态（见术语表）。「戈戟最为下辈」是拿戈戟的兵卒里也是最低的一等。「劾削兵权」是被弹劾、削去兵权。这一条与增删卜易防参劾「身衰鬼克，贬责凌呵」（ZS.41）、黄金策仕宦「日辰冲克，定然诽谤之多招」（HJC.12）取同一个关系：日月冲克世爻，有祸。
note.en: 'Xiu qiu' are the two states of 'at rest' and 'imprisoned', both out of season (see the glossary). 'Ge ji zui wei xia bei' is the lowest grade even among the soldiers who carry spears and halberds. 'Hexue bingquan' is being impeached and stripped of military power. This entry takes the same relation as 'a weak Self controlled by Pressure brings demotion and rebuke' in the Zengshan Buyi on guarding against impeachment (ZS.41) and 'if the Day clashes or controls, there will surely be much slander' in the Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.12): the Day and Month clashing or controlling the Self line means trouble.

zh: 身世爻当衰弱，则力怯机疏。
yi: 身爻、世爻衰弱，就力量怯弱、机会稀少。
en: If the Body and Self lines are weak, then one's strength is timid and one's chances sparse.

zh: 世逢日月克冲，戈戟最为下辈。
yi: 世爻遇到日、月克制或冲，拿戈戟的人当中也是最下等的。
en: If the Self meets control or clash from the Day and the Month, even among bearers of spear and halberd one is of the lowest rank.

zh: 世若休囚，卦不旺相，当推无力无能。
又被日辰月建冲克世爻者，提拔全无，反遭弹劾，岂得驰名于军伍？
其中又看官爻，旺则声名显赫，空则劾削兵权。
yi: 世爻如果休囚，卦又不旺相，就该断为没有力量、没有才能。
又被日辰、月建冲克世爻的，完全没有提拔，反而遭到弹劾，哪里能在军队中出名？
这中间还要看官爻：旺相就声名显赫，落空就被弹劾、削去兵权。
en: If the Self is at rest or imprisoned and the hexagram is not thriving, one should be judged as without strength or ability.
If the Self line is again clashed or controlled by the Day and the Month, there is no advancement at all and on the contrary impeachment, so how could one win fame in the ranks?
Among these, look also at the Pressure line: if it is thriving, fame is eminent; if it is Void, one is impeached and stripped of military power.

title: 袭求武弁：世带青龙名驰朝野、官居白虎威振华夷；青龙为大贵之星、白虎乃兵权之煞，此二兽若得临世临官定主威扬海内

rule.yi: 世爻带青龙，名声传遍朝廷和民间；官爻坐着白虎，威势震动华夏和外族。青龙是大贵的星，白虎是兵权的煞，这两兽如果能临在世爻上、官爻上，一定主威名传扬海内。
rule.en: If the Self carries the Azure Dragon, one's name runs through court and countryside; if the star of office sits on the White Tiger, one's might shakes the Chinese and the barbarians. The Azure Dragon is the star of great nobility and the White Tiger is the baleful spirit of military power; if these two beasts come to the Self or to the star of office, one's might will surely spread throughout the land.

note.yi: 「二兽」是青龙、白虎。白虎在别的断法里多是凶煞（黄金策、易隐里常见），这里因为问的是武职，把它看作兵权之煞，与青龙并取；这是这一章的取法，不是白虎的通例。「海内」是天下。
note.en: The 'two beasts' are the Azure Dragon and the White Tiger. In other methods the White Tiger is mostly a baleful spirit (as often seen in the Huangjin Ce and the Yi Yin), but since the question here is about a military post it is taken as the baleful spirit of military power and is taken together with the Azure Dragon; this is the method of this chapter and not the general rule for the White Tiger. 'Hainei' is all under heaven.

yi: 世爻带青龙，名声传遍朝廷和民间；
官爻坐着白虎，威势震动华夏和外族。
en: If the Self carries the Azure Dragon, one's name runs through court and countryside;
if the star of office sits on the White Tiger, one's might shakes the Chinese and the barbarians.

zh: 青龙为大贵之星，白虎乃兵权之煞，此二兽若得临世临官，定主威扬海内。
yi: 青龙是大贵的星，白虎是兵权的煞，这两兽如果能临在世爻上、官爻上，一定主威名传扬海内。
en: The Azure Dragon is the star of great nobility and the White Tiger is the baleful spirit of military power; if these two beasts come to the Self or to the star of office, one's might will surely spread throughout the land.

title: 袭求武弁：子动伤官难遂参谋之策、财兴助鬼能成赞尽之功、鬼变福乡循降调、官之财地渐升迁；鬼为官职最嫌子动来伤，偏喜财兴助鬼，官变子孙非降即调，鬼之财象迭迭高升

rule.yi: 子孙发动伤克官爻，难以实现参谋的计策；财爻兴旺帮助官鬼，能成就辅佐到底的功劳。官鬼变到福乡（子孙），就顺着降职、调动；官爻变到财地（财爻），就渐渐升迁。官鬼是官职，最怕子孙发动来伤它，偏偏喜欢财爻兴旺帮助官鬼；官鬼变成子孙，不是降职就是调走；官鬼变成财的象，就一再高升。细细玩味占易道理的玄妙精微，就可以断定武官的吉凶。
rule.en: If Output moves to hurt the star of office, it is hard to carry out one's counsel as a staff adviser; if Wealth flourishes and aids Pressure, one can accomplish the merit of assisting to the end. If Pressure changes into the fortune quarter, Output, it follows that one is demoted or transferred; if the star of office changes into the Wealth ground, one is gradually promoted. Pressure is the official post, and it most dislikes Output moving to hurt it but particularly likes Wealth flourishing to aid it; if Pressure changes into Output, it is either demotion or transfer; if Pressure changes into the Wealth image, one is promoted again and again. By savouring the subtle principles of the Yi divination, one can decide the good and ill of a military officer.

note.yi: 「福乡」是子孙（福神）所在，「财地」是财爻所在。「赞尽之功」书里就是这几个字，按字面译作「辅佐到底的功劳」。「戎官」是武官。末句是全章的结语。这一条与前面仕宦升迁章「官化子孙非降即调」「官若化财平升品级」（EL.56）是同一类断语，这里换到武职上。
note.en: 'Fuxiang', the fortune quarter, is where Output (the fortune spirit) stands, and 'caidi', the Wealth ground, is where the Wealth line stands. 'Zanjin zhi gong' is exactly these characters in the book and is translated literally as 'the merit of assisting to the end'. 'Rongguan' is a military officer. The last sentence is the closing line of the whole chapter. This entry is the same kind of judgment as 'if Pressure changes into Output it is demotion or transfer' and 'if Pressure changes into Wealth, a level promotion' in the preceding chapter on official promotion (EL.56), here moved to military posts.

zh: 子动伤官，难遂参谋之策。
财兴助鬼，能成赞尽之功。
鬼变福乡循降调，官之财地渐陛迁。
yi: 子孙发动伤克官爻，难以实现参谋的计策；
财爻兴旺帮助官鬼，能成就辅佐到底的功劳。
官鬼变到福乡，顺着就是降职、调动；官爻变到财地，渐渐升迁。
en: If Output moves to hurt the star of office, it is hard to carry out one's counsel as a staff adviser;
if Wealth flourishes and aids Pressure, one can accomplish the merit of assisting to the end.
If Pressure changes into the fortune quarter, it follows that one is demoted or transferred; if the star of office changes into the Wealth ground, one is gradually promoted.

zh: 鬼为官职，最嫌子动来伤，偏喜财兴助鬼，官变子孙，非降即调。
玩占易理玄微，可决戎官之休咎。
yi: 官鬼是官职，最怕子孙发动来伤它，偏偏喜欢财爻兴旺帮助官鬼；官鬼变成子孙，不是降职就是调走。
官鬼变成财的象，就一再高升。
细细玩味占易道理的玄妙精微，就可以断定武官的吉凶。
en: Pressure is the official post, and it most dislikes Output moving to hurt it but particularly likes Wealth flourishing to aid it; if Pressure changes into Output, it is either demotion or transfer.
If Pressure changes into the Wealth image, one is promoted again and again.
By savouring the subtle principles of the Yi divination, one can decide the good and ill of a military officer.

title: 援监纳吏总纲：以官爻为主、财象为凭；援监纳吏并一应奉例纳银求官者皆把世爻与官爻为主俱不宜空，空则不成纵成不久；世值旬空非久远、福神静旺永无殃；子孙虽为福德亦不可动动则伤官，又不可无无则少利

rule.yi: 援监、纳吏，以及一切依照成例交银买官的，以官爻为主，以财爻为凭据，又都把世爻和官爻当主要来看，两个都不适宜落空：落空就办不成，即使办成也不长久。世爻落在旬空，不能长久；福神（子孙）安静而旺相，永远没有祸患。子孙虽然是福德，也不可以发动，一动就伤克官爻；也不可以没有，没有就少得利益。
rule.en: In purchasing a place in the Academy, purchasing a clerkship, and every case of buying office by paying silver according to the statute, take the Pressure line as the chief and the Wealth image as the ground, with the Self line and the Pressure line as the principal things, and neither should be Void: if Void it does not succeed, and even if it succeeds it does not last. If the Self falls on the ten-day Void it will not be long-lasting; if Output, the fortune spirit, is quiet and thriving there is never any calamity. Output, though it is Fortune Virtue, must not move, for if it moves it hurts the star of office; and it must not be absent, for without it there is little profit.

note.yi: 「援监」是援例捐监，即捐钱取得国子监生的资格；「纳吏」是捐钱买一个吏的名额；「奉例纳银」是依照朝廷的捐纳成例交银。「旬空」是该旬里落空的两个地支（见术语表）。「福神」「福德」都是子孙。第一段解末尾两句（「身世之爻，若被鬼来冲克……决主名成利就」）和后面诀下解的头两句文字相同，是书里重复排印的，只在下一条引一处。这一条与增删卜易「援例」一组（ZS.22 起）取同一个关系：财、官、世三样缺一不可。
note.en: 'Yuanjian' is entering the Imperial Academy by contribution, that is obtaining the standing of an Academy student by paying; 'naji' is buying a place as a clerk; 'feng li na yin' is paying silver by the statute of contributions. 'Xunkong' is the two branches that fall Void in that ten-day week (see the glossary). 'Fushen' and 'fude' are both Output. The last two sentences of the first explanation ('If the Body and Self lines are clashed or controlled by Pressure ... one will surely win name and profit') are the same words as the first two sentences of the explanation after the next verse; the book prints them twice, and they are quoted only once, in the next entry. This entry takes the same relation as the 'contribution' group of the Zengshan Buyi (from ZS.22): of Wealth, the star of office and the Self, none can be lacking.

yi: 以官爻为主要看的，以财爻为凭据。
en: Take the Pressure line as the chief to be looked at, and the Wealth image as the ground.

zh: 世值旬空非久远，福神静旺永无殃。
yi: 世爻落在旬空，就不能长久；福神安静而旺相，就永远没有祸患。
en: If the Self falls on the ten-day Void it will not be long-lasting; if Output, the fortune spirit, is quiet and thriving there is never any calamity.

zh: 援监纳吏并一应奉例纳银求官者，皆把世爻与官爻为主，俱不宜空。
子孙虽为福德，亦不可动，动则伤官。
yi: 援监、纳吏，以及一切依照成例交银求官的，都以世爻和官爻为主，两个都不适宜落空。
落空就办不成，即使办成也不会长久。
子孙虽然是福德，也不可以发动，一动就伤克官爻。
也不可以没有，没有就少得利益。
en: For purchasing a place in the Academy, purchasing a clerkship, and every case of seeking office by paying silver according to the statute, the Self line and the Pressure line are taken as the chief, and neither should be Void.
If Void it does not succeed, and even if it succeeds it does not last.
Output, though it is Fortune Virtue, must not move either, for if it moves it hurts the star of office.
Nor must it be absent, for without it there is little profit.

title: 援监纳吏：鬼克身爻遭责罚、财生世象必荣昌；身世之爻若被鬼来冲克反受其殃，如得鬼爻持世再加财动来生决主名成利就

rule.yi: 官鬼克制身爻，就遭责罚；财爻生世爻，就一定荣昌。身爻、世爻这两爻，如果被官鬼来冲克，反而受它的祸害；如果官鬼爻持世，再加上财爻发动来生它，一定名成利就。
rule.en: If Pressure controls the Body line one suffers reproof and punishment; if Wealth generates the Self image one will surely prosper. As for the Body and Self lines, if Pressure comes to clash or control them, one suffers its calamity instead; if the Pressure line holds the Self and Wealth moves to generate it, one will surely win name and profit.

note.yi: 「身世之爻」是身爻（卦身）和世爻。官鬼本来是求官的用神，克世身又要受责罚，书里要分的是：官鬼冲克世身是祸，官鬼持世而财爻来生是福。第一段解末尾的两句与这里解的第二、三句文字相同，是书里重复排印的。这一条与黄金策仕宦「鬼杀伤身」（HJC.13）取同一个关系，官鬼旺、财爻发动来生，与增删卜易「妻摇鬼旺，定然执王拜丹墀」（ZS.23）相合。
note.en: 'Shen shi zhi yao' is the Body line (the Body of the hexagram) and the Self line. Pressure is the Subject for seeking office, yet when it controls the Self or Body one suffers reproof, and what the book is distinguishing is this: Pressure clashing or controlling the Self or Body is calamity, while Pressure holding the Self with Wealth generating it is fortune. The two sentences at the end of the first explanation are the same words as the second and third sentences of the explanation here, which the book prints twice. This entry takes the same relation as 'a baleful Pressure injuring the Body' in the Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.13), and Pressure thriving with Wealth moving to generate it agrees with 'when Wealth sways and Pressure thrives, one will surely bow at the vermilion steps of the court' in the Zengshan Buyi (ZS.23).

zh: 鬼克身爻遭责罚，财生世象必荣昌，
yi: 官鬼克制身爻，就遭责罚；财爻生世爻，就一定荣昌。
en: If Pressure controls the Body line one suffers reproof and punishment; if Wealth generates the Self image one will surely prosper.

zh: 若被鬼来冲克，反受其殃。
如得鬼爻持世，再加财动来生，决主名成利就。
yi: 身爻和世爻这两条爻：
如果被官鬼来冲、来克，反而受它的祸害。
如果官鬼爻持世，再加上财爻发动来生它，一定主名成利就。
en: As for the Body and Self lines:
if Pressure comes to clash or control them, one suffers its calamity instead.
If the Pressure line holds the Self and Wealth moves to generate it, one will surely win name and profit.

title: 援监纳吏：夫化子孙难出仕、妻之兄弟利源伤；官爻若化子孙又难出仕，妻财如变兄弟或卦中兄爻发动不惟无所得反主亏伤

rule.yi: 官（夫）爻化成子孙，就难以出来做官；妻财变成兄弟，财路就被伤。官爻如果化成子孙，又难出仕；妻财如果变成兄弟，或者卦中兄爻发动，不但没有所得，反而主亏损受伤。
rule.en: If the husband line, Pressure, changes into Output, it is hard to come out into office; if Wealth, the wife, changes into Peer, the source of profit is hurt. If the Pressure line changes into Output it is again hard to come out into office; if Wealth changes into Peer, or a Peer line moves in the hexagram, one gains nothing, and on the contrary suffers loss and injury.

note.yi: 诀里的「夫」按解里的「官爻」译：六亲里官鬼是夫、妻财是妻，诀把两个放成一对，解里就写成「官爻」「妻财」。「利源」是财路。这一条与前面仕宦升迁「官化子孙非降即调」（EL.56）、「财化兄弟减俸粮」（EL.57）取同一个关系。
note.en: The 'fu', husband, in the verse is translated after 'the Pressure line' in the explanation: among the six kin Pressure is the husband and Wealth the wife, and the verse puts the two as a pair, while the explanation writes them as 'the Pressure line' and 'Wealth'. 'Liyuan' is the source of profit. This entry takes the same relations as 'if Pressure changes into Output it is demotion or transfer' (EL.56) and 'Wealth changing into Peer cuts salary and grain' (EL.57) in the preceding chapter on official promotion.

zh: 夫化子孙难出仕，妻之兄弟利源伤。
yi: 官（夫）化成子孙，就难以出来做官；妻财变成兄弟，财路就被伤。
en: If the husband line, Pressure, changes into Output, it is hard to come out into office; if Wealth, the wife, changes into Peer, the source of profit is hurt.

zh: 官爻若化子孙，又难出仕。
妻财如变兄弟、或卦中兄爻发动，不惟无所得，反主亏伤。
yi: 官爻如果化成子孙，又难以出来做官。
妻财如果变成兄弟，或者卦中兄爻发动，不但没有所得，反而主亏损受伤。
en: If the Pressure line changes into Output, it is again hard to come out into office.
If Wealth changes into Peer, or a Peer line moves in the hexagram, one gains nothing, and on the contrary suffers loss and injury.

title: 援监纳吏：买官纳吏选阴阳、僧道医官共审详；僧官道官阴阳官医官使典等类皆宜鬼旺财兴，爻中有鬼无财有名无实，有财无鬼名利皆虚

rule.yi: 买官、纳吏、选阴阳官，以及僧官、道官、医官，都要仔细审察；僧官、道官、阴阳官、医官、使典这一类，都适宜官鬼旺相、财爻兴旺；爻里有官鬼没有财，有名无实；有财爻没有官鬼，名和利都落空。
rule.en: Buying office, buying a clerkship, being selected as a Yin-Yang official, and the monk, Daoist and medical officials, are all to be examined in detail; for monk-officials, Daoist officials, Yin-Yang officials, medical officials, clerks and the like, it is fitting that Pressure be thriving and Wealth flourishing; if there is Pressure among the lines but no Wealth, there is a name without substance; if there is Wealth but no Pressure, both name and profit are empty.

note.yi: 「阴阳官」是地方上掌管阴阳（天文历数、选择吉日）的小官；「僧官」「道官」是管僧、道的官；「医官」是医学的官；「使典」是衙门里办事的差役、典吏一类。这几类都是靠捐纳或选授得来的小官职，所以要官鬼（名）和财爻（利）两样都在。这一条与黄金策仕宦「僧道医官，岂可文书发动」（HJC.27）、增删卜易「僧官医官·亦喜官文发动」（ZS.53）说的是同一类人，但取法不同：那两处看子孙，这里看官鬼和财。
note.en: 'Yin-Yang official' is a minor local official in charge of yin and yang (the calendar and astronomy, and the choice of lucky days); 'monk-officials' and 'Daoist officials' are the officials who supervise monks and Daoists; 'medical official' is an official of medicine; 'shidian' are the runners and clerks who do the work in a yamen. These are all minor posts obtained by contribution or selection, so both Pressure (the name) and Wealth (the profit) must be present. This entry speaks of the same kinds of men as 'for monk, Daoist and medical officials, how could the document move' in the Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.27) and 'monk-officials and medical officials also like the star of office and the document to move' in the Zengshan Buyi (ZS.53), but takes a different method: those two look at Output, and this one looks at Pressure and Wealth.

zh: 买官纳吏选阴阳，僧道医官共审详，
yi: 买官、纳吏、选阴阳官，僧道医官，都要仔细审察。
en: Buying office, buying a clerkship, being selected as a Yin-Yang official, and the monk, Daoist and medical officials, are all to be examined in detail.

zh: 僧官、道官、阴阳官、医官、使典等类，皆宜鬼旺财兴。
爻中有鬼无财，有名无实。
yi: 僧官、道官、阴阳官、医官、使典这一类，都适宜官鬼旺相、财爻兴旺。
卦爻里有官鬼没有财爻，有名无实。
有财爻没有官鬼，名和利都是空的。
en: For monk-officials, Daoist officials, Yin-Yang officials, medical officials, clerks of the establishment and the like, it is fitting that Pressure be thriving and Wealth flourishing.
If there is Pressure among the lines but no Wealth, there is a name without substance.
If there is Wealth but no Pressure, both name and profit are empty.

title: 援监纳吏：吏典财官宜旺相、贡生父鬼忌空亡、太学父兴官旺处定显声名播四方；论恩贡选贡岁贡监生等类，虽用官爻再凭父母，此二象俱不可空，若得父官有气定然名播京都

rule.yi: 吏典，财爻、官爻适宜旺相；贡生，父爻、官鬼最忌空亡；入太学，父爻兴旺、官爻旺相的地方，一定声名显扬、传遍四方。恩贡、选贡、岁贡、监生这一类，虽然用的是官爻，还要凭父母爻，这两个象都不可落空；如果父爻、官爻有气，一定名传京城。
rule.en: For a clerk of the establishment, Wealth and the star of office should be thriving; for a tribute student, Resource and Pressure must avoid Void; for the Imperial Academy, where Resource flourishes and the star of office is thriving, fame will surely be made manifest and spread in all quarters. For the grace tribute, selected tribute, annual tribute, Academy students and the like, though the Pressure line is the one used, one must rely also on Resource, and these two images must not be Void; if Resource and the star of office have qi, the name will surely be known throughout the capital.

note.yi: 「吏典」是衙门里的书吏；「贡生」是从地方学校选送到国子监的生员，有恩贡、选贡、岁贡等名目；「太学」「监生」是国子监的学生。所以援监就是捐钱取得监生的资格。这里三种身份分别取象：吏典取财、官，贡生取父、鬼，太学取父、官；解里把贡生、监生合起来说，只说官爻加父母。
note.en: 'Lidian' are the clerks of a yamen; 'gongsheng' are students sent up from the local schools to the Imperial Academy, under the names of grace tribute, selected tribute, annual tribute and so on; 'taixue' and 'jiansheng' are the students of the Imperial Academy. So 'yuanjian' is obtaining the standing of an Academy student by paying. The three kinds of standing here each take their own image: the clerk takes Wealth and the star of office, the tribute student Resource and Pressure, and the Academy student Resource and the star of office; the explanation speaks of the tribute students and Academy students together and says only the Pressure line with Resource.

zh: 吏典财官宜旺相，贡生父鬼忌空亡，
太学父兴官旺处，定显声名播四方。
yi: 吏典，财爻、官爻适宜旺相；贡生，父爻、官鬼最忌空亡；
入太学，父爻兴旺、官爻旺相的地方，一定声名显扬、传遍四方。
en: For a clerk of the establishment, Wealth and the star of office should be thriving; for a tribute student, Resource and Pressure must avoid Void;
for the Imperial Academy, where Resource flourishes and the star of office is thriving, fame will surely be made manifest and spread in all quarters.

zh: 又论恩贡、选贡、岁贡、监生等类，虽用官爻，再凭父母，此二象俱不可空，若得父官有气，定然名播京都。
yi: 再说恩贡、选贡、岁贡、监生这一类，虽然用的是官爻，还要凭父母爻，这两个象都不可落空；如果父爻、官爻有气，一定名传京城。
en: As for the grace tribute, selected tribute, annual tribute, Academy students and the like, though the Pressure line is the one used, one must rely also on Resource, and these two images must not be Void; if Resource and the star of office have qi, the name will surely be known throughout the capital.

title: 选缺参房总纲：以官爻为主、世象为凭；官员选缺及吏典参房皆把官爻及世详，此二象内如有一爻犯月破旬空者官不能得此缺吏不能参此房；应动兄兴冲克世，世纵不空若被应动克世或兄弟动来克世必有同袍抢夺

rule.yi: 官员选缺、吏典参房，都以官爻和世爻为主来细看：这两个象里只要有一个遇到月破或旬空，官员就得不到这个缺，吏就不能参这个房。世爻即使不空，如果被发动的应爻、或发动的兄弟克了世爻，一定有同僚来抢夺，要提防兄弟兴旺、竞争激烈。
rule.en: For an official selected to a vacancy and a clerk joining a section, take the Pressure line and the Self line as the chief and examine them in detail: if either of these two images falls in Month-break or the ten-day Void, the official cannot obtain the vacancy and the clerk cannot join the section. Even if the Self is not Void, if the Other moves to control the Self, or Peer moves to control the Self, there will surely be colleagues scrambling for it, and one must be on guard against Peer flourishing and the competition being strong.

note.yi: 「选缺」是候选的官员被选派到一个空缺的官职上；「参房」是吏典进入衙门里的某一房（吏、户、礼、兵、刑、工等房）当差。「月破」是被月建冲破的爻，「旬空」是落在旬空的爻（见术语表）。「同胞」「同袍」都指同辈、同僚，也就是来争这个缺的人（兄弟爻）。「应动克世」书里连写，这里按「应爻发动而克世」读。这一条与黄金策求馆「兄兴临应，决多同类侵谋」（HJC.37）取同一个关系：兄弟发动，有同行来争。
note.en: 'Xuan que' is a candidate official being appointed to a vacant post, and 'can fang' is a clerk entering one of the sections of a yamen (the Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice or Works section and so on) to work. 'Month-break' is a line broken by the clash of the Month, and 'ten-day Void' is a line falling on the Void of its ten-day week (see the glossary). 'Tongbao' and 'tongpao' both mean fellows and colleagues, that is the people who compete for the vacancy (the Peer line). 'Ying dong ke shi' is written run together in the book and is read here as 'the Other moves and controls the Self'. This entry takes the same relation as 'if Peer flourishes and rests on the Other, many of one's own kind will scheme to take it' in the Huangjin Ce on seeking a school post (HJC.37): when Peer moves, people in the same line come to compete.

yi: 以官爻为主要看的，以世爻为凭据。
en: Take the Pressure line as the chief to be looked at, and the Self image as the ground.

zh: 官员选缺及吏典参房，皆把官爻及世详，
应动兄兴冲克世，同胞扰阻却提防。
yi: 官员选缺、吏典参房，都要拿官爻和世爻来细看；
应爻发动、兄弟兴旺，冲克世爻的，要提防同辈的人来骚扰、阻碍。
en: For officials selected to a vacancy and clerks joining a section, the Pressure line and the Self are examined in detail;
if the Other moves or Peer flourishes and clashes with or controls the Self, beware of the disturbance and obstruction of one's fellows.

zh: 官僚选缺及吏典参房，皆把官爻与世爻为主，此二象内如有一爻犯月破旬空者，官不能得此缺，吏不能参此房。
世纵不空，若被应动克世、或兄弟动来克世，必有同袍抢夺，却要提防兄兴，竞争强。
yi: 官僚选缺和吏典参房，都以官爻和世爻为主；这两个象里如果有一个犯月破或旬空，官员就得不到这个缺，吏就不能参这个房。
世爻即使不空，如果被发动的应爻克世、或者兄弟发动来克世，一定有同僚来抢夺，更要提防兄弟兴旺、竞争激烈。
en: For officials selected to a vacancy and clerks joining a section, the Pressure line and the Self line are taken as the chief; if one of these two images falls in Month-break or the ten-day Void, the official cannot obtain this vacancy and the clerk cannot join this section.

Even if the Self is not Void, if the Other moves to control the Self, or Peer moves to control the Self, there will surely be colleagues scrambling for it, and one must be on guard against Peer flourishing and the competition being strong.

title: 选缺参房：世爻若遇空冲绝费尽勤劳怎得昌，不遇六冲官有气稳膺美秩姓名扬；世若变为绝地或被日主来冲或卜六冲之卦纵去谋为决难成就，世象不空官爻不陷、应与兄爻纵动不来克世所求必遂并不更张

rule.yi: 世爻如果遇到空、冲、绝，费尽辛勤劳苦，又怎么能兴旺？不遇六冲、官有气，就稳稳地得到好的官位，姓名远扬。世爻如果变到绝地，或者被日辰来冲，或者卜得六冲的卦，即使去谋求，也一定难以成功；世爻不空、官爻不陷，应爻和兄爻即使发动，只要不来克世，所求的一定遂意，也不会更改。
rule.en: If the Self meets Void, clash or extinction, however much toil one spends, how can one prosper? If one does not meet a six-clash and the star of office has qi, one will securely receive a fine rank and one's name will be known. If the Self changes into a place of extinction, or is clashed by the Day, or the hexagram cast is a six-clash, then even if one goes about scheming it will surely be hard to succeed; if the Self image is not Void and the Pressure line is not sunk, then even if the Other and the Peer line move, as long as they do not come to control the Self, what one seeks will surely be attained and there will be no change.

note.yi: 「美秩」是好的官职；「日主」是日辰；「逐」疑是「遂」，「所求必逐」译作「所求必遂」；「并不更张」是不会再更改。这一条是上一条（EL.76）的另一面：世爻自己空冲绝、卦是六冲，和应动、兄动来克世，是两类不同的阻碍。
note.en: 'Meizhi' is a fine official rank; 'rizhu' is the Day; the 'zhu' of 'suo qiu bi zhu' is presumably 'sui', to be fulfilled, and it is translated 'what one seeks will surely be attained'; 'bing bu gengzhang' is that there will be no further change. This entry is the other side of the previous one (EL.76): the Self itself being Void, clashed or extinct, and the hexagram being a six-clash, are one kind of obstacle, and the Other or Peer moving to control the Self is another.

zh: 世爻若遇空冲绝，费尽勤劳怎得昌，
不遇六冲官有气，稳膺美秩姓名扬。
yi: 世爻如果遇到空、冲、绝，费尽辛勤劳苦，又怎么能兴旺？
不遇六冲、官有气，就稳稳地得到好的官位，姓名远扬。
en: If the Self meets Void, clash or extinction, however much toil one spends, how can one prosper?
If one does not meet a six-clash and the star of office has qi, one will securely receive a fine rank and one's name will be known.

zh: 世若变为绝地、或被日主来冲、或卜六冲之卦，纵去谋为，决难成就。
世象不空官爻不陷、应与兄爻纵动、不来克世，所求必逐，并不更张。
yi: 世爻如果变到绝地，或者被日辰来冲，或者卜得六冲的卦，即使去谋求，也一定难以成功。
世爻不空、官爻不陷，应爻和兄爻即使发动，只要不来克世，所求的一定遂意，也不会更改。
en: If the Self changes into a place of extinction, or is clashed by the Day, or the hexagram cast is a six-clash, then even if one goes about scheming it will surely be hard to succeed.

If the Self image is not Void and the Pressure line is not sunk, then even if the Other and the Peer line move, as long as they do not come to control the Self, what one seeks will surely be attained and there will be no change.

title: 选缺参房：参房获利宜财旺鬼象休来克世、选缺求名愁福德随官入墓恐遭殃；论参房者与选缺不同，得官与财旺定然所得非常，鬼克世身难逃罪责；论选缺者亦要官兴最嫌子动，鬼克世身不须畏忌，但遇随官入墓恐罹灾患

rule.yi: 参房求利，适宜财爻旺相，官鬼之象不要来克世爻；选缺求名，怕的是福德（子孙）发动，以及随着官爻入墓，恐怕遭殃。参房和选缺看法不同：参房如果官和财都旺相，所得一定不寻常，官鬼克世身，难逃罪责；选缺也要官爻兴旺，最嫌子孙发动，官鬼克世身反而不必畏忌；只是遇到随官入墓，恐怕遭灾患。
rule.en: For joining a section and seeking gain, Wealth should be thriving and the Pressure image must not come to control the Self; for selection to a vacancy and seeking a name, what is dreaded is Output, the fortune virtue, moving, and following the star of office into the tomb, for fear of calamity. Judging joining a section differs from judging a selection to a vacancy: for joining a section, if the star of office and Wealth are both thriving, what is gained will surely be extraordinary, and if Pressure controls the Self or the Body one cannot escape blame; for a selection to a vacancy the star of office must also flourish and Output moving is most disliked, whereas Pressure controlling the Self or the Body need not be feared; but if one meets following the star of office into the tomb, calamity is to be feared.

note.yi: 「罪贵」疑是「罪责」，译作「罪责」。「世身」是世爻和卦身（见术语表）。「福德」是子孙。「随官入墓」是世爻跟着官爻一起入墓，增删卜易对它另有说法（ZS.06：古以随官入墓为凶，作者屡试后改说世旺者反升）。参房与选缺要分开看：参房是吏进衙门做事，看财；选缺是官员得缺，看官，所以官鬼克世身，一个是祸，一个不必畏忌——这是据本条上下文读出来的，书里没有另说缘故。
note.en: The 'gui' of 'zui gui' is presumably 'ze', blame, and it is translated 'blame'. 'Shi shen' is the Self line and the Body of the hexagram (see the glossary). 'Fude' is Output. 'Following the star of office into the tomb' is the Self line entering the tomb together with the Pressure line, and the Zengshan Buyi has a different account of it (ZS.06: the old view took following the star of office into the tomb as ominous, but the author after many trials said that a thriving Self on the contrary rises). Joining a section and selection to a vacancy are to be looked at separately: joining a section is a clerk entering a yamen to work and looks at Wealth, while selection to a vacancy is an official obtaining a post and looks at the star of office, so Pressure controlling the Self or Body is calamity for one and need not be feared for the other; this is read from the context of this entry, and the book gives no other reason.

zh: 参房获利宜财旺，鬼象休来克世方，
选缺求名愁福德，随官入墓恐遭殃。
yi: 参房求利，适宜财爻旺相，官鬼之象不要来克世爻；
选缺求名，怕的是福德（子孙）发动；随着官爻入墓，恐怕要遭殃。
en: For joining a section and seeking gain, Wealth should be thriving, and the Pressure image must not come to control the Self;
for selection to a vacancy and seeking a name, what is dreaded is Output, the fortune virtue; to follow the star of office into the tomb is to risk calamity.

zh: 论参房者，与选缺不同，若得官与财旺，定然所得非常。
鬼克世身难逃罪贵，论选缺者，亦要官兴，最嫌子动，鬼克世身，不须畏忌。
但遇随官入墓，恐罹灾患。
yi: 论参房和选缺不同：参房如果官和财都旺相，所得一定不寻常。
官鬼克制世身，就难逃罪责；论选缺的，也要官爻兴旺，最嫌子孙发动，官鬼克制世身，反而不必畏忌。
只是遇到随官入墓，恐怕要遭灾患。
en: To judge joining a section is different from judging a selection to a vacancy: if the star of office and Wealth are both thriving, what is gained will surely be extraordinary.

If Pressure controls the Self or the Body one cannot escape blame; for a selection to a vacancy the star of office must also flourish and Output moving is most disliked, whereas Pressure controlling the Self or the Body need not be feared.
But if one meets following the star of office into the tomb, calamity is to be feared.

title: 官员荐奖总纲：推荐以官文为主、旌奖以财鬼为凭；官吏贤能望宪台之荐奖、黎民良善赖邑宰之旌扬；所喜者鬼旺龙兴，所忌者世空子动；凡占奖荐各要官爻旺相青龙得地，大忌世值空亡子孙发动

rule.yi: 占推荐，以官爻、文书爻为主；占旌奖（表彰奖励），以财爻、官鬼为凭据。官吏贤能，盼望上司宪台的荐举嘉奖；百姓善良，依靠县令的旌表褒扬。所喜欢的是官鬼旺相、青龙兴旺；所忌讳的是世爻落空、子孙发动。凡是占嘉奖、荐举，都要官爻旺相、青龙得位，最忌世爻落在空亡、子孙发动。
rule.en: For a recommendation, take the Pressure line and the document line as the chief; for a commendation or award, take Wealth and Pressure as the ground. Officials who are worthy and able look to the supervising authorities for recommendation and award; common people who are good depend on the county magistrate for commendation and praise. What is welcomed is Pressure thriving and the Dragon flourishing; what is feared is the Self Void and Output moving. In every divination about award or recommendation, the Pressure line should be thriving and the Azure Dragon in its place, and what is most feared is the Self falling on Void and Output moving.

note.yi: 小标里的「官文」是官爻和文书爻（父母），「财鬼」是财爻和官鬼。「宪台」是上级的监察、巡抚、按察一类官署；「邑宰」是县令；「旌扬」是旌表、褒扬。「奖荐」是荐举嘉奖。诀里的「龙」是青龙。这一章看荐举和奖励两件事：荐举看官和文书，奖励看财和官。
note.en: 'Guanwen' in the subtitle is the Pressure line and the document line (Resource), and 'caigui' is Wealth and Pressure. 'Xiantai' is the supervisory offices of higher level such as the censors, governors and provincial judges; 'yizai' is the county magistrate; 'jingyang' is official commendation and praise. 'Jiangjian' is recommendation and award. The 'Dragon' in the verse is the Azure Dragon. The chapter looks at two things, recommendation and award: recommendation looks at the star of office and the document, award at Wealth and the star of office.

zh: 推荐以官文为主，旌奖以财鬼为凭。
yi: 推荐以官爻、文书爻为主要看的，旌奖以财爻、官鬼为凭据。
en: For recommendation take the Pressure and document lines as the chief to be looked at, and for commendation take Wealth and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 官吏贤能，望宪台之荐奖；
黎民良善，赖邑宰之旌扬。
yi: 官吏贤明有才干，盼望宪台（上司）的荐举和嘉奖；
百姓善良，依靠县令的旌表褒扬。
所喜欢的，是官鬼旺相、青龙兴旺。
所忌讳的，是世爻落空、子孙发动。
en: Officials who are worthy and able look to the supervising authorities for recommendation and award;
common people who are good depend on the county magistrate for commendation and praise.
What is welcomed is Pressure thriving and the Dragon flourishing.
What is feared is the Self Void and Output moving.

zh: 凡占奖荐，各要官爻旺相，青龙得地，大忌世值空亡，子孙发动。
yi: 凡是占嘉奖、荐举，各自都要官爻旺相、青龙得位，最忌世爻落在空亡、子孙发动。
en: In every divination about award or recommendation, the Pressure line should be thriving and the Azure Dragon in its place, and what is most feared is the Self falling on Void and Output moving.

title: 官员荐奖：臣沐君恩必得岁君生世；欲求恩宠须看五爻为天子、太岁为朝廷，此二象内若得一爻生世或生官便沾天泽，如值空亡恩先莫望从，不值空如来克世伤官原不为福

rule.yi: 臣子蒙受君王的恩典，必须得到岁君（太岁）来生世爻。要求恩宠，要看五爻是天子、太岁是朝廷：这两个象里如果有一个来生世爻或者生官爻，就沾到天子和朝廷所给的恩泽；如果落在空亡，就不要指望得到恩宠；不落空而来克世爻、伤克官爻的，本来就不是福。
rule.en: A minister who receives the sovereign's favour must have Tai Sui, the sovereign of the year, generating the Self. To seek favour, look at the fifth line as the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui as the court: if either of these two images generates the Self or generates the star of office, one shares in the grace given by the Son of Heaven and the court; if it falls on Void, do not hope for favour; if it is not Void but comes to control the Self or to hurt the star of office, it was never a blessing.

note.yi: 「五爻为天子」是第五爻代表君王，「太岁为朝廷」是太岁代表朝廷，与黄金策国朝「九五逢阳，当遇仁明之主」（HJC.65）、「太岁为君」（HJC.64）同取。「岁君」就是太岁。「天泽」是上天的恩泽，这里指天子的恩典。「恩先莫望从」文字疑有误，按文意译作「不要指望得到恩宠」。
note.en: 'The fifth line is the Son of Heaven' is the fifth line standing for the sovereign, and 'Tai Sui is the court' is Tai Sui standing for the court, taken as in 'the ninth-fifth meeting yang, one meets a benevolent and enlightened sovereign' (HJC.65) and 'Tai Sui is the sovereign' (HJC.64) in the Huangjin Ce on the state. 'Suijun' is Tai Sui. 'Tianze' is the bounty of heaven and here means the favour of the Son of Heaven. 'En xian mo wang cong' looks corrupt in its characters and is translated by the sense as 'do not hope for favour'.

zh: 臣沐君恩，必得岁君生世。
yi: 臣子蒙受君王的恩典，必须得到岁君（太岁）来生世爻。
en: A minister bathed in the sovereign's favour must have Tai Sui, the sovereign of the year, generating the Self.

zh: 欲求恩宠，须看五爻为天子，太岁为朝廷，此二象内若得一爻生世或生官，便沾天泽天子与朝廷之位。
如值空亡，恩先莫望从，不值空如来克世伤官，原不为福。
yi: 想求得恩宠，要看五爻是天子、太岁是朝廷；这两个象里如果有一个来生世爻或者生官爻，就沾到天子、朝廷的位置所给的恩泽。
如果落在空亡，就不要指望得到恩宠；不落空而来克世爻、伤克官爻的，本来就不是福。
en: To seek favour, one must look at the fifth line as the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui as the court; if either of these two images generates the Self or generates the star of office, one shares in the heavenly grace of the positions of the Son of Heaven and the court.
If it falls on Void, do not hope for favour; if it is not Void but comes to control the Self or hurt the star of office, it was never a blessing.

title: 官员荐奖：下叨上荐须求外鬼扶身；如占举荐专看外卦官爻，外象如无内官可用、内鬼再空不须谋望，不论内外卦中若有官来生身生世决叨提拔之恩

rule.yi: 下级要承蒙上级的荐举，要求外卦的官鬼来扶持卦身。占荐举，专看外卦的官爻；外卦没有，内卦的官爻也可以用；内卦的官鬼再落空，就不必谋求指望；不论内卦外卦，卦中如果有官爻来生卦身、生世爻，一定承蒙提拔的恩典。
rule.en: A subordinate who is to receive a recommendation from above must seek the outer Pressure line to support the Body. In divining for a recommendation, look only at the Pressure line in the outer trigram; if the outer trigram has none, the inner star of office can be used; if the inner Pressure too is Void, there is no need to scheme and hope; whether inner or outer, if the hexagram has a star of office that generates the Body or the Self, one will surely receive the grace of being raised.

note.yi: 「叨」是承受（多用作谦辞）。「外鬼」是外卦的官鬼。这一条与易隐官禄占「官贵旺动生合世目下蒙荐」（YY.17）、黄金策求馆「鬼动合身，须得贵人推荐」（HJC.36）取同一个关系：官鬼来生合世身，有人荐举。
note.en: 'Tao' is receiving (mostly used as a modest word). 'Waigui' is the Pressure line of the outer trigram. This entry takes the same relation as 'if the star of office and the Noble are thriving and moving and generate or combine with the Self, one is recommended at once' in the Yi Yin divination on official salary (YY.17) and 'if Pressure moves and combines with the Body, one must have a noble recommend one' in the Huangjin Ce on seeking a school post (HJC.36): Pressure generating or combining with the Self or Body means that someone recommends one.

zh: 下叨上荐，须求外鬼扶身。
yi: 下级承受上级的荐举，要求外卦的官鬼来扶持卦身。
en: A subordinate receiving a recommendation from above must seek the outer Pressure line to support the Body.

zh: 如占举荐，专看外卦官爻。
外象如无，内官可用，内鬼再空，不须谋望。
不论内外，卦中若有官来生身生世，决叨提拔之恩。
yi: 如果占荐举，专看外卦的官爻。
外卦如果没有，内卦的官爻可以用；内卦的官鬼再落空，就不必谋求指望。
不论内卦外卦，卦中如果有官爻来生卦身、生世爻，一定承蒙提拔的恩典。
en: If divining for a recommendation, look only at the Pressure line in the outer trigram.
If the outer image has none, the inner star of office can be used; if the inner Pressure too is Void, there is no need to scheme and hope.
Whether inner or outer, if the hexagram has a star of office that generates the Body or the Self, one will surely receive the grace of being raised.

title: 官员荐奖：卦有二官六部重推重举、爻无一鬼三司不奖不褒；如得旺官迭见又来生合世爻必得重重之荐，六爻内如无鬼者定无推举之官

rule.yi: 卦里有两个官爻，六部就一再推荐、一再举用；爻里一个官鬼也没有，三司就不奖励也不褒扬。如果旺相的官爻接连出现，又来生合世爻，一定得到一重又一重的荐举；六爻里如果没有官鬼，一定没有推举的官员。
rule.en: If the hexagram has two stars of office, the Six Boards recommend and raise one again and again; if the lines have not even one Pressure, the Three Offices neither commend nor praise. If thriving stars of office appear one after another and come to generate or combine with the Self line, one will surely receive recommendation upon recommendation; if there is no Pressure among the six lines, there is surely no official to recommend one.

note.yi: 「六部」是朝廷的吏、户、礼、兵、刑、工六部；「三司」是省一级的布政使司、按察使司、都指挥使司。「卦有二官六部」「爻无一鬼三司」书里没有展开，这里按字面对仗译：有两个官，六部再三推荐；一个官鬼也没有，三司都不奖励。
note.en: 'Liubu', the Six Boards, are the Boards of Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice and Works at court; 'sansi', the Three Offices, are the provincial commissions for administration, for judicial matters and for military command. The book does not unfold 'the hexagram has two stars of office, the Six Boards' and 'the lines have not one Pressure, the Three Offices', and they are translated here literally as a matched pair: with two stars of office the Six Boards recommend again and again; with not one Pressure the Three Offices do not commend.

zh: 卦有二官六部，重推重举。
爻无一鬼三司，不奖不褒。
yi: 卦里有两个官爻，六部就一再推荐、一再举用。
爻里一个官鬼也没有，三司就不奖励也不褒扬。
en: If the hexagram has two stars of office, the Six Boards recommend and raise one again and again.
If the lines have not even one Pressure, the Three Offices neither commend nor praise.

zh: 如得旺官迭见又来生合世爻，必得重重之荐。
六爻内如无鬼者，定无推举之官。
yi: 如果旺相的官爻接连出现，又来生合世爻，一定得到一重又一重的荐举。
六爻里如果没有官鬼，一定没有推举的官员。
en: If thriving stars of office appear one after another and come to generate or combine with the Self line, one will surely receive recommendation upon recommendation.
If there is no Pressure among the six lines, there is surely no official to recommend one.

title: 官员荐奖：推举得官父旺动稳望高迁奖劳、若财鬼衰空虚图给赏；推荐者若得官父两全便为佳兆二中欠一未得稳成，奖励者虽用官爻又宜财旺、财鬼如空定无奖勤给赏之美

rule.yi: 推举时，官爻、父爻旺相发动，稳稳地盼得高升、奖励功劳；如果财爻、官鬼衰弱落空，想谋求赏赐也是白费。具体说：推荐的，官爻、父爻两样齐全才是好兆头，两样缺一，就不能稳稳办成；论奖励的，虽然用官爻，还适宜财爻旺相；财爻、官鬼如果落空，就一定没有奖励勤劳、给予赏赐的美事。
rule.en: For a recommendation, if the star of office and Resource are thriving and moving, one can securely hope for high promotion and an award for service; if Wealth and Pressure are weak or Void, to plan for a reward is vain. In detail: for a recommendation, to have both the star of office and Resource is a good omen, and if one of the two is lacking it is not securely accomplished; for an award, though the Pressure line is the one used, Wealth should also be thriving, and if Wealth and Pressure are Void there will surely be no fine thing like an award for diligence and the granting of a reward.

note.yi: 「奖动者」疑是「奖勤者」（后一句有「奖勤给赏」），译作「论奖励的」。「官父」是官爻和父母爻，「财鬼」是财爻和官鬼。「高迁」是高升。小标说推荐看官文、旌奖看财鬼，这一条把两样合起来说：推荐要官父齐，奖励要财官俱旺。
note.en: 'Jiang dong zhe' is presumably 'jiang qin zhe', for the next sentence has 'award for diligence and granting of reward', and it is translated 'for an award'. 'Guanfu' is the Pressure line and the Resource line, 'caigui' is Wealth and Pressure. 'Gaoqian' is high promotion. The subtitle said that recommendation looks at the star of office and the document and commendation at Wealth and Pressure, and this entry puts the two together: a recommendation needs both the star of office and Resource, and an award needs Wealth and the star of office both thriving.

zh: 推举得官父旺动，稳望高迁奖劳。
yi: 推举时得官爻、父爻旺相发动，稳稳地盼得高升、奖励功劳；
如果财爻、官鬼衰弱落空，想谋求赏赐也是白费。
en: For a recommendation, if the star of office and Resource are thriving and moving, one can securely hope for high promotion and an award for service;
if Wealth and Pressure are weak or Void, to plan for a reward is vain.

zh: 推荐者若得官父两全，便为佳兆。
奖动者虽用官爻，又宜财旺。
财鬼如空，定无奖勤给赏之美也。
yi: 推荐的，如果官爻、父爻两样齐全，就是好兆头。
两样当中缺一样，就不能稳稳办成。
论奖励的，虽然用官爻，还适宜财爻旺相。
财爻、官鬼如果落空，一定没有奖励勤劳、给予赏赐的美事。
en: For a recommendation, if both the star of office and Resource are present, it is a good omen.
If one of the two is lacking, it is not securely accomplished.
For an award, though the Pressure line is the one used, Wealth should also be thriving.
If Wealth and Pressure are Void, there will surely be no fine thing like an award for diligence and the granting of a reward.

title: 官员荐奖：鬼化子爻荐贤未听、官之财象奖励能从；荐与奖皆以官为主旺者来速衰则来迟，动化子孙虽荐未能听信，财来助鬼奖得如心

rule.yi: 官鬼化成子孙爻，推荐贤能就不被听从；官爻变成财的象，奖励就能被应允。荐举和奖励，都以官爻为主：旺的来得快，衰的来得迟；官爻发动化成子孙，即使有人推荐也不被听信；财爻来帮助官鬼，奖励就能如愿。
rule.en: If Pressure changes into an Output line, the recommendation of the worthy is not heeded; if the star of office changes into the Wealth image, the award can be granted. Both recommendation and award take the star of office as the chief: if it is thriving it comes quickly, if weak it comes late; if it moves and changes into Output, even if one is recommended it is not heeded and believed; if Wealth comes to aid Pressure, the award is obtained as one wishes.

note.yi: 「荐贤」是荐举贤能。这一条与前面仕宦升迁「官化子孙非降即调」「官若化财平升品级」（EL.56）取同一个关系，这里换到荐举、奖励上：官变子孙是失，官变财是得。
note.en: 'Jianxian' is recommending the worthy. This entry takes the same relation as 'if Pressure changes into Output it is demotion or transfer' and 'if Pressure changes into Wealth, a level promotion' (EL.56) in the earlier chapter on official promotion, here moved to recommendation and award: Pressure changing into Output is a loss and Pressure changing into Wealth is a gain.

yi: 官鬼化成子孙爻，推荐贤能就不被听从。
官爻变成财的象，奖励就能被应允。
en: If Pressure changes into an Output line, the recommendation of the worthy is not heeded.
If the star of office changes into the Wealth image, the award can be granted.

zh: 荐与奖，皆以官为主，旺者来速，衰则来迟。
动化子孙，虽荐未能听信。
yi: 荐举和奖励，都以官爻为主：旺的来得快，衰的来得迟。
官爻发动化成子孙，即使有人推荐也不被听信。
财爻来帮助官鬼，奖励就能如愿。
en: Both recommendation and award take the star of office as the chief: if it is thriving it comes quickly, if weak it comes late.
If it moves and changes into Output, even if one is recommended it is not heeded and believed.
If Wealth comes to aid Pressure, the award is obtained as one wishes.

title: 官员荐奖：如卜官凭但愿文书逢旺气、若占到日远寻父母遇生方；又附占文凭到日须看父母之爻候临生临旺之期此凭决到，卦无父须待父爻值日方得凭来，父若衰而又空纵然等候而未至

rule.yi: 占官凭（官员的委任凭据），只要文书爻逢上旺相的气；占凭据哪一天到，要远远去找父母爻遇上生它的时候。另外附带占文凭到的日子，要看父母爻，等它临到生、旺的时候，这份凭据一定到；卦里没有父爻，要等到父爻当值的日子，凭据才会来；父爻如果衰弱又落空，即使等候，凭据也还没有到。
rule.en: To divine about the official credentials, the document line need only meet a thriving qi; to divine on what day they arrive, look far for Resource meeting the time that generates it. Also appended: for the day the credentials arrive, look at the Resource line and wait for the time when it meets generation or thriving, and the credentials will surely arrive; if there is no Resource in the hexagram, one must wait for the day when the Resource line is on duty, and only then will the credentials come; if Resource is weak and also Void, even if one waits the credentials have not arrived.

note.yi: 「官凭」是官员到任的凭证（委任文凭）。「但原文书」的「原」疑是「愿」，译作「只要文书逢旺气」，不论怎么读，要的都是文书爻旺相。解里「此凭决到卦无父」书里没有断句，这里按文意断作「此凭决到；卦无父，须待父爻值日，方得凭来」。「值日」与求馆章「卦中无父，但逢值日方在」（EL.54）同，书里没有说按什么取。这一条与易隐官禄占「领凭」（YY.10）取同一类法：都以父母爻（文书）为用，看它的生旺和当值之日。
note.en: 'Guanping' is the credentials with which an official takes up his post (the letter of appointment). The 'yuan' of 'dan yuan wenshu' is presumably 'yuan', to wish, and it is translated 'the document line need only meet a thriving qi'; whichever way it is read, what is wanted is the document line thriving. In the explanation 'ci ping jue dao gua wu fu' has no punctuation in the book, and it is broken here by the sense as 'the credentials will surely arrive; if there is no Resource in the hexagram, one must wait for the day when Resource is on duty, and then the credentials will come'. 'Zhiri', the duty day, is the same as in 'if there is no Resource in the hexagram, it is present only when its duty day comes' in the chapter on seeking a school post (EL.54), and the book does not say by what it is reckoned. This entry takes the same kind of method as the 'receiving the credentials' section of the Yi Yin divination on official salary (YY.10): in both, Resource (the document) is the Subject and its thriving and its duty day are looked at.

zh: 如卜官凭，但原文书逢旺气。
若占到日，远寻父母遇生方。
yi: 如果卜官凭（委任的凭据），只要文书爻逢上旺相的气。
如果占凭据哪一天到，要远远去找父母爻遇上生它的时候。
en: To divine about the official credentials, the document line need only meet a thriving qi.
To divine on what day they arrive, look far for Resource meeting the time that generates it.

zh: 又附占文凭到日，须看父母之爻，候临生临旺之期，此凭决到卦无父，须待父爻值日，方得凭来。
父若衰而又空，纵然等候而未至。
yi: 又附带占文凭哪一天到，要看父母爻，等它临到生、旺的时候，这份凭据一定到；卦里没有父爻，要等到父爻当值的日子，凭据才会来。
父爻如果衰弱又落空，即使等候，凭据也还没有到。
en: Also appended: for the day the credentials arrive, look at the Resource line and wait for the time when it meets generation or thriving, and the credentials will surely arrive; if there is no Resource in the hexagram, one must wait for the day when the Resource line is on duty, and only then will the credentials come.
If Resource is weak and also Void, even if one waits the credentials have not arrived.

title: 官员荐奖：欲求坊扁方光辉必藉官爻之旺相，世空绝望、子动难谋、财动还须嘱托、鬼空不必祈求；凡求牌坊扁额光辉门闾先看官爻次推世象二者若有一空始终绝望，子孙动亦不能求，财动生官谋为遂意

rule.yi: 想求得牌坊、匾额来光耀门庭，必须凭官爻旺相。世爻落空就绝望，子孙发动就难谋求，财爻发动还要托人嘱托，官鬼落空就不必祈求了。凡是求牌坊、匾额来光耀门庭的，先看官爻，再推世爻；这两个只要有一个落空，始终没有指望；子孙发动，也求不到；财爻发动去生官爻，谋求就遂心如意。
rule.en: To seek an honorific archway or plaque that will bring glory to one's door, one must rely on the Pressure line being thriving. If the Self is Void there is no hope, if Output moves it is hard to arrange, if Wealth moves one must still entrust the matter to someone, and if Pressure is Void there is no need to pray for it. In every seeking of an archway or plaque to bring glory to one's gate, look first at the Pressure line and then reckon the Self image; if either of the two is Void, there is no hope to the end; if Output moves, it cannot be obtained either; if Wealth moves to generate the star of office, the scheming turns out as one wishes.

note.yi: 「坊扁」是牌坊和匾额，「光辉门闾」是光耀门庭；官府给牌坊匾额是一种表彰，所以看官爻。「嘱托」是托人关照。诀里「财动还须嘱托」和解里「财动生官，谋为遂意」并不冲突：财动生官是成事的路子，但事要有人去办。
note.en: 'Fangbian' are the honorific archway and the plaque, and 'guanghui menlü' is bringing glory to one's gate; an archway or plaque given by the authorities is a kind of commendation, so the Pressure line is looked at. 'Zhutuo' is entrusting a matter to someone. The verse's 'if Wealth moves one must still entrust the matter to someone' and the explanation's 'if Wealth moves to generate the star of office, the scheming turns out as one wishes' do not clash: Wealth moving to generate the star of office is the road by which the matter is done, but someone must be sent to see to it.

zh: 欲求坊扁方光辉，必藉官爻之旺相。
yi: 想求得牌坊、匾额才光耀门庭，必须凭官爻旺相。
世爻落空，就绝望了。
子孙发动，就难以谋求；
财爻发动，还要托人嘱托；
官鬼落空，就不必祈求了。
en: To seek an archway or plaque that will bring glory to one's door, one must rely on the Pressure line being thriving.
If the Self is Void there is no hope.
If Output moves it is hard to arrange;
if Wealth moves one must still entrust the matter to someone;
if Pressure is Void there is no need to pray for it.

zh: 凡求牌坊扁额光辉门闾，先看官爻，次推世象，二者若有一空，始终绝望。
yi: 凡是求牌坊、匾额来光耀门庭的，先看官爻，再推世爻；这两个如果有一个落空，始终没有指望。
子孙发动，也求不到。
财爻发动去生官爻，谋求就遂心如意。
en: In every seeking of an archway or plaque to bring glory to one's gate, look first at the Pressure line and then reckon the Self image; if either of the two is Void, there is no hope to the end.
If Output moves, it cannot be obtained either.
If Wealth moves to generate the star of office, the scheming turns out as one wishes.

title: 官员荐奖：六合则心怀喜悦、六冲则面染忧愁；如求扎帖又看文书反嫌财动，父鬼财空允能给发，不拘扁贴皆忌六冲

rule.yi: 六合的卦，心里喜悦；六冲的卦，脸上带着忧愁。如果求扎帖（官府的帖文），又要看文书爻，反而嫌财爻发动；父爻、官鬼在而财爻落空，就准许发给；不论匾额还是帖文，都忌讳六冲。
rule.en: With a six-combine the heart is glad; with a six-clash the face is clouded with sorrow. If one seeks an official warrant, look also at the document line, and on the contrary dislike Wealth moving; with Resource and Pressure present and Wealth Void, it is allowed and can be issued; whether plaque or warrant, a six-clash is feared in all.

note.yi: 「扎帖」是官府发给的帖文（札帖），求的是一张批准的文书，所以看文书爻；文书爻怕财克，所以反嫌财动。「父鬼财空」书里连写，按上一句「反嫌财动」读作父、鬼在而财空；若读成三样都空，就与「允能给发」不合。「扁贴」是匾额和帖文。
note.en: 'Zhatie' is a written warrant issued by the authorities (a 'zhatie' of the yamen); what is sought is an approving document, so the document line is looked at, and the document line fears being controlled by Wealth, which is why Wealth moving is disliked. 'Fu gui cai kong' is written run together in the book and is read, after the previous sentence's 'on the contrary dislike Wealth moving', as Resource and Pressure present and Wealth Void; if it were read as all three Void it would not agree with 'it is allowed and can be issued'. 'Bian tie' is the plaque and the warrant.

yi: 卦是六合，心里喜悦；
卦是六冲，脸上带着忧愁。
en: With a six-combine the heart is glad;
with a six-clash the face is clouded with sorrow.

zh: 如求扎帖，又看文书，反嫌财动。
yi: 如果求扎帖（官府的帖文），又要看文书爻，反而嫌财爻发动。
父爻、官鬼在而财爻落空，就准许发给。
不论匾额还是帖文，都忌讳六冲。
en: If one seeks an official warrant, look also at the document line, and on the contrary dislike Wealth moving.
With Resource and Pressure present and Wealth Void, it is allowed and can be issued.
Whether plaque or warrant, a six-clash is feared in all.

title: 官员荐奖结语：上察官情之喜怒皆由四象之兴衰，下推人事之亲疏不出两仪之变化

rule.yi: 往上察看官府的喜怒，全由四象的兴衰决定；往下推究人事的亲疏，不出两仪的变化。
rule.en: Observing above the pleasure or anger of the officials all depends on the rise and fall of the four images; reckoning below the closeness or distance of human affairs does not go beyond the changes of the two modes.

note.yi: 这是官员荐奖章的结语，后面没有解说。「四象」「两仪」书里没有说指的是什么，这里只按字面译，不加解释。
note.en: This is the closing couplet of the chapter on the recommendation and commendation of officials, and the book gives no explanation after it. The book does not say what the 'four images' and the 'two modes' are, and they are translated literally here without comment.

zh: 上察官情之喜怒，皆由四象之兴衰。
下推人事之亲疏，不出两仪之变化。
yi: 向上察看官府的喜怒，全由四象的兴衰决定。
向下推究人事的亲疏，不会超出两仪的变化。
en: Observing above the pleasure or anger of the officials, it all depends on the rise and fall of the four images.
Reckoning below the closeness or distance in human affairs, it does not go beyond the changes of the two modes.

title: 上书奏对：以太岁五爻为主、文书官鬼为凭；启奏君王看五爻，生身合命宠应叨，岁君克世龙颜怒，月将生官品爵高；五爻为天子、太岁为君王，一爻生合身世所奏如心，冲克身世恐犯天威休陈情因，官不空破又得日月生扶者必然破格超升

rule.yi: 上书、启奏，以太岁和五爻为主，以文书爻、官鬼为凭据。启奏君王要看五爻：五爻是天子，太岁是君王，这两者只要有一个生合身爻、世爻，所奏的就如愿，得到宠遇；五爻和太岁如果来冲克身爻、世爻，恐怕触犯天威，就不要陈述情由；岁君克世爻，君王龙颜震怒；月将生官爻，官品爵位就高。另外，官爻多半是自己的本职：不落旬空、月破，又得日月生扶的，一定破格超升。
rule.en: For submitting a memorial, take Tai Sui and the fifth line as the chief, and the document and Pressure as the ground. To memorialise the sovereign look at the fifth line: the fifth line is the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui is the sovereign, and if either of the two generates or combines with the Body or the Self, what is memorialised goes as one wishes and one receives favour; if the fifth line and Tai Sui come to clash or control the Body and the Self, one fears offending the majesty of Heaven and should not present the circumstances; if Tai Sui controls the Self the dragon countenance is angry, and if the Month General generates the star of office, rank and title are high. Also, the star of office mostly stands for one's own post: if it does not fall on the ten-day Void or Month-break and is further generated and supported by the Day and the Month, one is surely promoted beyond the regulations.

note.yi: 章名「上书咎奏」的「咎」疑有误，按本章内容（启奏、上本）译作「上书奏本」。「五爻为天子」「太岁为君王」与前面求恩宠一条同取（EL.80，黄金策国朝 HJC.64、HJC.65）。「龙颜」是君王的面容，「天威」是君王的威严。「月将」书里没有解释，按文意是月令（月建）的力量；六壬里的月将是另一回事，这里不用。「破格超升」是不按常规、越级升官。「生身合命」的「命」按解里「生合身世」读作世爻。末句「五爻为天子之爻」是解里对前面的重申。
note.en: The 'jiu' of the chapter title 'shang shu jiu zou' looks wrong, and by the content of the chapter (memorialising and submitting a petition) it is translated 'submitting letters and memorials'. 'The fifth line is the Son of Heaven' and 'Tai Sui is the sovereign' are taken as in the earlier entry on seeking favour (EL.80, and HJC.64 and HJC.65 in the Huangjin Ce on the state). 'Longyan', the dragon countenance, is the sovereign's face, and 'tianwei' is the majesty of Heaven. 'Yuejiang' is not explained in the book, and by the sense it is the force of the month (the Month); the month general of the Da Liu Ren is another matter and is not used here. 'Po ge chao sheng' is being promoted out of the usual order and over rank. The 'ming' of 'sheng shen he ming' is read as the Self by the explanation's 'generates or combines with the Body or the Self'. The last sentence, 'the fifth line is the line of the Son of Heaven', is the explanation restating what went before.

zh: 以太岁五爻为主，文书官鬼为凭。
yi: 以太岁、五爻为主要看的，以文书、官鬼为凭据。
en: Take Tai Sui and the fifth line as the chief to be looked at, and the document and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 启奏君王看五爻，生身合命宠应叨，
yi: 启奏君王要看五爻：五爻生身爻、合命（世）爻，宠遇就会到来；
岁君克制世爻，君王龙颜震怒；
月将生助官爻，官品爵位就高。
en: To memorialise the sovereign look at the fifth line: if it generates the Body and combines with the Self, the 'fate' line, favour is sure to be received;
if Tai Sui controls the Self, the dragon countenance is angry;
if the Month General generates the star of office, rank and title are high.

zh: 启奏者须看五爻为天子，太岁为君王，此二者如有一爻生合身世，所奏如心。
五爻与太岁如来冲克身世，恐犯天威，休陈情因。
又论官多为本职，不值旬空月破，更得日月生扶者，必然破格超陛。
yi: 启奏的人，必须把五爻看作天子、太岁看作君王；这两者里如果有一个生合身爻、世爻，所奏的就如愿。
五爻和太岁如果来冲克身爻、世爻，恐怕触犯天威，就不要陈述情由。
又论官爻，多半是自己的本职；不落旬空、月破，更得日月生扶的，一定破格超升。
五爻就是代表天子的爻。
en: One who memorialises must take the fifth line as the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui as the sovereign; if either of the two generates or combines with the Body or the Self, what is memorialised goes as one wishes.
If the fifth line and Tai Sui come to clash or control the Body and the Self, one fears offending the majesty of Heaven, and should not present the circumstances.

Also, the star of office mostly stands for one's own post; if it does not fall on the ten-day Void or Month-break and is further generated and supported by the Day and the Month, one will surely be promoted beyond the regulations.
The fifth line is the line of the Son of Heaven.

title: 上书奏对：进拜表章兼上本，父旺官兴御笔标，亦忌六冲财子动，次愁印绶化财爻，更嫌鬼象之为福，父绝官空莫进朝；拜表上本启奏皆同，若得父旺官兴定蒙准奏，若犯六冲、财摇子动、父变妻财、官之福、父绝官空一节者莫奏朝廷，纵奏徒费心机难迎圣意

rule.yi: 递表章、上奏本，父爻旺相、官爻兴旺，就会得到御笔批准。也忌讳六冲、财爻和子孙发动；其次怕印绶（父母）变成财爻，更嫌官鬼变成福神（子孙）；父爻绝、官爻空，就不要进朝。拜表、上本、启奏都是同一个取法：父旺官兴，一定蒙准奏；如果遇到六冲，或者财摇子动、或者父变妻财、或者官变福神、或者父绝官空，这几条里只要犯了一条，就不要奏朝廷；即使奏了，也白费心机，难以合君王的心意。
rule.en: In presenting a memorial and submitting a petition, if Resource is thriving and the star of office flourishes, the imperial brush will mark it for approval. Also fear a six-clash and Wealth and Output moving; next worry the seal line changing into the Wealth line; still more dislike the Pressure image changing into Output; with Resource extinct and the star of office Void, do not go to court. Presenting a memorial, submitting a petition and memorialising all take the same method: if Resource is thriving and the star of office flourishes, the memorial will surely be approved; if it meets a six-clash, or Wealth sways and Output moves, or Resource changes into Wealth, or the star of office changes into Output, or Resource is extinct and the star of office Void, then if even one of these points is violated, do not memorialise the court; even if one does, it is a waste of effort and hardly meets the sovereign's wish.

note.yi: 「表章」「奏本」都是呈给君王的文书；「御笔标」是皇帝用笔批示。「印绶」是父母爻（文书、印）。「官之福」是官变成福神（子孙）。这一条与增删卜易上书（ZS.28 起）取同一类象：父母（文书）旺、官旺为吉；财动克文书、子动伤官为凶。
note.en: 'Biaozhang' and 'zouben' are both documents presented to the sovereign; 'yubi biao' is the emperor marking approval with his brush. 'Yinshou', the seal line, is the Resource line (the document and the seal). 'Guan zhi fu' is the star of office changing into the fortune spirit (Output). This entry takes the same kind of images as the Zengshan Buyi on submitting letters (from ZS.28): Resource (the document) thriving and the star of office thriving are auspicious; Wealth moving to control the document and Output moving to hurt the star of office are ominous.

zh: 进拜表章兼上本，父旺官兴御笔标，
亦忌六冲财子动，次愁印绶化财爻，
更嫌鬼象之为福，父绝官空莫进朝。
yi: 递送表章、上呈奏本，父爻旺相、官爻兴旺，就会得到御笔批准；
也忌讳六冲、财爻和子孙发动，其次怕印绶（父母）变成财爻；
更嫌官鬼变成福神（子孙）；父爻绝、官爻空，就不要进朝。
en: In presenting a memorial and submitting a petition, if Resource is thriving and the star of office flourishes, the imperial brush will mark it for approval;
also fear a six-clash and Wealth and Output moving, and next worry the seal line changing into the Wealth line;
still more dislike the Pressure image changing into Output; with Resource extinct and the star of office Void, do not go to court.

zh: 拜表上本启奏皆同，若得父旺官兴，定蒙准奏。
若值六冲，或财摇子动、或父变妻财、或官之福、或父绝官空，以上数端，如犯一节者，莫奏朝廷，纵奏，徒费心机，难迎圣意。
yi: 拜表、上本、启奏都是一样的取法；如果父爻旺相、官爻兴旺，一定蒙准奏。
如果遇到六冲，或者财摇子动、或者父变妻财、或者官变福神、或者父绝官空，这几条里如果犯了一条，就不要奏朝廷；即使奏了，也白费心机，难以合君王的心意。
en: Presenting a memorial, submitting a petition and memorialising are all the same; if Resource is thriving and the star of office flourishes, the memorial will surely be approved.

If it meets a six-clash, or Wealth sways and Output moves, or Resource changes into Wealth, or the star of office changes into Output, or Resource is extinct and the star of office Void, then if even one of these points is violated, do not memorialise the court; even if one does, it is a waste of effort and hardly meets the sovereign's wish.

title: 朝天面旨：以太岁五爻为主、官鬼世象为凭；面君官旺世无伤折槛廷诤也不妨，太岁五爻冲克世休趋殿陛惹天殃；面君者先推世象次察官爻，二爻旺相不空又不受君爻冲克则并无玷剥，世爻若被天子之爻冲克朝必遭殃守静为上

rule.yi: 朝见君王，以太岁和五爻为主，以官鬼、世爻为凭据。面君时官爻旺相、世爻没有受伤，就是折断栏杆、在朝廷上直言力谏也无妨；太岁、五爻如果冲克世爻，就不要趋步到殿前去招来天灾。面君的人，先推世爻，再察官爻：这两爻如果旺相、不落空亡，又不受君王之爻冲克，去见天子就没有污损伤害；世爻如果被天子之爻冲克，上朝一定遭殃，以安静守着为上。
rule.en: For an audience with the sovereign, take Tai Sui and the fifth line as the chief, and Pressure and the Self image as the ground. If the star of office is thriving and the Self is unhurt, even breaking the balustrade in a remonstrance at court is no matter; if Tai Sui or the fifth line clashes with or controls the Self, do not hasten to the palace steps to bring on a heavenly calamity. One who is to see the sovereign should first reckon the Self image and then examine the Pressure line: if these two lines are thriving, not on Void, and not clashed or controlled by the sovereign's line, then going before the Son of Heaven there will be no blemish or harm; if the Self line is clashed or controlled by the Son of Heaven's line, going to court will surely bring calamity, and keeping quiet is best.

note.yi: 「折槛」用的是汉朝朱云在殿上直谏、攀折殿槛（栏杆）的典故；「廷诤」是在朝廷上直言劝谏；「殿陛」是宫殿的台阶。「在去天天并无玷剥」文字有误，疑是「此去天颜并无玷剥」，译作「去见天子就没有污损、伤害」。「君爻」是五爻（天子之爻）。「守静」是不去、不动。这一条与增删卜易上书「子动临身，力能折槛」（ZS.33）同用「折槛」一典，但那一条看的是子孙，这里看官爻和世爻。
note.en: 'Zhe jian' alludes to Zhu Yun of the Han, who remonstrated in the hall and clung to the balustrade until it broke; 'tingzheng' is remonstrating plainly at court; 'dianbi' are the steps of the palace. 'Zai qu tian tian bing wu dian bo' is corrupt in its characters and is presumably 'ci qu tianyan bing wu dian bo', translated 'going before the Son of Heaven there will be no blemish or harm'. 'Junyao', the sovereign's line, is the fifth line (the line of the Son of Heaven). 'Shoujing' is not going and not acting. This entry uses the same allusion of 'breaking the balustrade' as 'if Output moves on the Body, one has the strength to break the balustrade' in the Zengshan Buyi on submitting letters (ZS.33), but that entry looks at Output and this one looks at the Pressure line and the Self.

zh: 以太岁五爻为主，官鬼世象为凭。
yi: 以太岁、五爻为主要看的，以官鬼、世爻为凭据。
en: Take Tai Sui and the fifth line as the chief to be looked at, and Pressure and the Self image as the ground.

zh: 面君官旺世无伤，折槛廷诤也不妨，
太岁五爻冲克世，休趋殿陛惹天殃。
yi: 面见君王，官爻旺相、世爻没有受伤，就是折断栏杆在朝廷上直言力谏也无妨；
太岁、五爻冲克世爻，就不要趋步到殿前去招来天灾。
en: In an audience with the sovereign, if the star of office is thriving and the Self is unhurt, even breaking the balustrade in a remonstrance at court is no matter;
if Tai Sui or the fifth line clashes with or controls the Self, do not hasten to the palace steps to bring on a heavenly calamity.

zh: 面君者，先推世象，次察官爻，此二爻如临旺相，不值空亡，又不受君爻冲克，在去天天并无玷剥。
世爻若被天子之爻冲克者，朝必遭殃，守静为上。
yi: 面君的人，先推世爻，再察官爻；这两爻如果旺相、不落空亡，又不受君王之爻冲克，去见天子就没有污损、伤害。
世爻如果被天子之爻冲克，上朝一定遭殃，以安静守着为上。
en: One who is to see the sovereign should first reckon the Self image and then examine the Pressure line; if these two lines are thriving, not on Void, and not clashed or controlled by the sovereign's line, then going before the Son of Heaven there will be no blemish or harm.
If the Self line is clashed or controlled by the Son of Heaven's line, going to court will surely bring calamity, and keeping quiet is best.

title: 朝天面旨：日辰月建生身吉、克世伤官尽不祥，卦值晋升蒙上宠、爻成屯蹇岂为强；世爻与官爻纵值休囚得日月或动爻生助或变出生扶皆为佳兆，朝王卜得火地晋、地风升皆吉，水雷屯、水山蹇皆为难遇者必凶

rule.yi: 日辰、月建生助身爻是吉，克世爻、伤官爻就都不祥；卦遇晋、升，蒙受君上的恩宠；爻成屯、蹇，哪里谈得上强？世爻和官爻即使逢休囚，只要得到日月或动爻生助，或者变出生扶它们的爻，都是好兆；如果动爻和日月伤官爻、伤世爻，都按凶来推。朝见君王卜得火地晋，晋是臣子遇见君王的象；又取地风升，升是往前、往上走，所以这两卦都吉；如果卜得水雷屯、水山蹇两卦，都是艰难，遇到的一定凶。
rule.en: If the Day and the Month generate the Body it is auspicious; if they control the Self or hurt the star of office, all is inauspicious. If the hexagram is Jin or Sheng, one receives the sovereign's favour; if the lines make Zhun or Jian, how could it be strong? Even if the Self line and the Pressure line are resting or imprisoned, if they get generation and aid from the Day and the Month or a moving line, or change out a line that generates and supports them, it is all a good omen; if a moving line and the Day and Month hurt the star of office or the Self, all is judged ominous. If in going to see the king one casts Jin, Fire over Earth, Jin is the image of a minister meeting his sovereign; Sheng, Earth over Wind, is also taken, for Sheng is advancing and going up, so these two hexagrams are both auspicious. If one casts Zhun, Water over Thunder, or Jian, Water over Mountain, both mean difficulty, and whoever meets them will surely have ill.

dispute.yi: 这里说卜得屯、蹇两卦「皆为难也，遇者必凶」；增删卜易引了古人「晋、升为吉，屯、蹇为凶」的说法后，野鹤（ZS.07）说晋、升也要世爻得地，屯、蹇两卦只要世爻旺相就没有妨碍，他有一次世爻旺相占到屯卦，照样越级升迁。也就是说：这里把卦名当作断语，增删卜易把卦名放在世爻旺衰的后面。
dispute.en: This entry says that casting Zhun or Jian 'both mean difficulty, and whoever meets them will surely have ill'; the Zengshan Buyi quotes the ancients' 'Jin and Sheng are auspicious, Zhun and Jian ominous' and then the Old Man of Yehe (ZS.07) says that Jin and Sheng also need the Self to be well placed, that for Zhun and Jian there is no harm so long as the Self is thriving, and that once he got Zhun with a thriving Self and was promoted beyond rank all the same. That is, this entry takes the hexagram name as a verdict, while the Zengshan Buyi puts the hexagram name behind the strength of the Self.

note.yi: 「火地晋」「地风升」「水雷屯」「水山蹇」是《周易》的卦名，这里按卦名取义：晋是前进，升是上升，屯、蹇是艰难。解里先说世爻、官爻的旺衰生克，最后才说卦名。「休囚」见术语表。「动爻与日月伤官伤世」书里连写，这里按「动爻和日月来伤官爻、伤世爻」读。
note.en: 'Huo di Jin', 'Di feng Sheng', 'Shui lei Zhun' and 'Shui shan Jian' are hexagram names of the Book of Changes, taken here by the meaning of the name: Jin is advancing, Sheng is rising, Zhun and Jian are difficulty. The explanation first speaks of the strength, generation and control of the Self and Pressure and only afterwards of the hexagram names. 'Resting or imprisoned' is in the glossary. 'Dong yao yu ri yue shang guan shang shi' is run together in the book and is read here as 'a moving line and the Day and Month come to hurt the star of office and the Self'.

zh: 日辰月建生身吉，克世伤官尽不祥，
卦值晋升蒙上宠，爻成屯蹇岂为强。
yi: 日辰、月建生助身爻是吉，克世爻、伤官爻就都不祥；
卦遇晋、升，蒙受君上的恩宠；爻成屯、蹇，哪里谈得上强？
en: If the Day and the Month generate the Body it is auspicious; if they control the Self or hurt the star of office, all is inauspicious;
if the hexagram is Jin or Sheng, one receives the sovereign's favour; if the lines make Zhun or Jian, how could it be strong?

zh: 世爻与官爻纵值休囚，得日月或动爻生助、或变出生扶，皆为佳兆，若动爻与日月伤官伤世，俱作凶推，朝王卜得火地晋，晋者以臣遇君之象。
又取地风升，升者，进而上也，故此二卦皆吉。
若卜水雷屯、水山蹇二卦，皆为难也，遇者必凶。
yi: 世爻和官爻即使逢休囚，得到日月或动爻生助，或者变出生扶它们的爻，都是好兆；如果动爻和日月伤官爻、伤世爻，都按凶来推。朝见君王卜得火地晋，晋是臣子遇见君王的象。
又取地风升，升是往前、往上走，所以这两卦都吉。
如果卜得水雷屯、水山蹇两卦，都是艰难，遇到的一定凶。
en: Even if the Self line and the Pressure line are resting or imprisoned, if they get generation and aid from the Day and the Month or a moving line, or change out a line that generates and supports them, it is all a good omen; if a moving line and the Day and Month hurt the star of office or the Self, all is judged ominous. If in going to see the king one casts Jin, Fire over Earth, Jin is the image of a minister meeting his sovereign.
Sheng, Earth over Wind, is also taken, for 'sheng' is advancing and going up, so these two hexagrams are both auspicious.
If one casts Zhun, Water over Thunder, or Jian, Water over Mountain, both mean difficulty, and whoever meets them will surely have ill.

title: 朝天面旨：逢冲莫去朝天子、遇合应来奏帝皇，无鬼不能沾雨露、世空岂得受恩光；六冲之象切莫朝天，六合之爻理宜面圣，爻虽攒合卦中无鬼或值空乡渥恩莫望，卦纵有官世居陷地还嗟运蹇岂沐天恩

rule.yi: 逢到冲，不要去朝见天子；遇到合，就该来奏对皇帝；没有官鬼，就沾不到雨露（恩泽）；世爻落空，怎能蒙受恩光？具体说：六冲的卦象，千万不要去朝见天子；六合的爻象，按理适宜面见圣上；爻象虽然聚合，但卦中没有官鬼，或者落在空乡，就不要指望丰厚的恩典；卦里即使有官爻，世爻落在陷地，也只能叹运气艰难，怎么谈得上沐浴天恩？
rule.en: Meeting a clash, do not go to court the Son of Heaven; meeting a combination, it is fitting to come and memorialise the emperor; with no Pressure one cannot share in the rain and dew of favour; with the Self Void how can one receive the glow of grace? In detail: with a six-clash image, on no account go to court; with a six-combine line, it is proper to meet the sage sovereign; even if the lines gather in combination, if the hexagram has no Pressure or it falls on empty ground, do not hope for rich favour; even if the hexagram has a star of office, if the Self sits in a pit one can still only lament one's hard fortune, and how could one bathe in heaven's favour?

note.yi: 「六冲」「六合」指卦的六冲、六合（见术语表）。「攒合」是聚合，「空乡」是空亡之地，「渥恩」是优厚的恩典。「世居陷地」的「陷」与前面仕宦升迁「临陷临空」同，是落入空、墓、绝一类凶地，书里没有细说。这一条与黄金策仕宦「奏陈谏诤，那堪太岁刑冲」（HJC.26）取同一类忌：冲克是朝见君王的大忌。
note.en: 'Six-clash' and 'six-combine' are the hexagram patterns (see the glossary). 'Cuanhe' is gathering in combination, 'kongxiang' is the ground of Void, and 'wo'en' is rich favour. The 'xian' of 'shi ju xian di' is the same as in 'lin xian lin kong' in the earlier chapter on official promotion, a fall into a bad place such as Void, tomb or extinction, and the book does not go into it. This entry takes the same taboo as 'for memorials and remonstrance, how can one bear Tai Sui's punishment and clash' in the Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.26): clash and control are the great taboo for seeing the sovereign.

zh: 逢冲莫去朝天子，遇合应来奏帝皇，
无鬼不能沾雨露，世空岂得受恩光。
yi: 逢到冲，不要去朝见天子；遇到合，就该来奏对皇帝；
没有官鬼，就沾不到雨露（恩泽）；世爻落空，怎能蒙受恩光？
en: Meeting a clash, do not go to court the Son of Heaven; meeting a combination, it is fitting to come and memorialise the emperor;
with no Pressure one cannot share in the rain and dew of favour; with the Self Void how can one receive the glow of grace?

zh: 爻虽攒合，卦中无鬼或值空乡，渥恩莫望。
卦纵有官，世居陷地，还嗟运蹇，岂沐天恩。
yi: 六冲的卦象，千万不要去朝见天子。
六合的爻象，按理适宜面见圣上。
爻象虽然聚合，但卦中没有官鬼，或者落在空乡，就不要指望丰厚的恩典。
卦里即使有官爻，世爻落在陷地，也只能叹运气艰难，怎么谈得上沐浴天恩？
en: With a six-clash image, on no account go to court.
With a six-combine line, it is proper to meet the sage sovereign.
Even if the lines gather in combination, if the hexagram has no Pressure or it falls on empty ground, do not hope for rich favour.
Even if the hexagram has a star of office, if the Self sits in a pit one can still only lament one's hard fortune, and how could one bathe in heaven's favour?

title: 恩封诰命总纲：以文书为主、官鬼为凭；欲知紫诰赠何人，卦内还须分六亲——父作皇封世作己，官为吏部五为君，更将太岁为天子，乾卦当称帝王尊，君位怕临空与绝，五爻忌克世和身；凡占诰命父母为用爻，不绝不空终须有望

rule.yi: 占恩封诰命，以文书爻为主，以官鬼为凭据。想知道诰命要赠给谁，卦里要分六亲：父爻当作皇帝的封诰，世爻是自己，官爻是吏部，五爻是君王，再把太岁当作天子，乾卦应当称作帝王的尊位；君位怕落空和绝，五爻忌克制世爻和身爻。凡是占诰命，父母爻是用爻，不绝不空，终究有指望；又看世爻是自己、官爻是吏部、五爻是天子、太岁是朝廷，都不要落空亡；代表君位的爻，千万不要伤身、克世；乾卦也代表君王，不论内卦外卦得到这个象的，一定受到恩封。
rule.en: In divining about an honorific patent, take the document as the chief and Pressure as the ground. To know on whom the imperial patent will be conferred, one must distinguish the six kin in the hexagram: Resource is taken as the imperial patent, the Self is oneself, the star of office is the Board of Personnel, the fifth line is the sovereign, and Tai Sui is further taken as the Son of Heaven; the Qian hexagram is called the honoured emperor; the sovereign's position fears Void and extinction, and the fifth line must not control the Self and the Body. In every divination about a patent, Resource is the Subject line, and if it is not extinct and not Void there must in the end be hope; look also at the Self as oneself, the star of office as the Board of Personnel, the fifth line as the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui as the court, none of which may be Void; the line of the sovereign's position must on no account hurt the Body or control the Self; the Qian hexagram also stands for the sovereign, and whoever gets this image, inner or outer, will surely receive the conferment.

note.yi: 「诰命」是皇帝授予官员及其亲属的封赠文书，「紫诰」是用紫泥封的诏书；「史部」的「史」是「吏」的误写，译作「吏部」，管官员任免的部。「皇封」是皇帝的封诰。「乾卦」是乾，天和君的象。「五爻为天子，太岁为朝廷」与上书、面君两章同取（EL.89、EL.91）。「用爻」就是用神：这里是父母爻。
note.en: 'Gaoming' is the document by which the emperor confers titles on officials and their kin, and 'zigao', the purple patent, is an edict sealed with purple clay; the 'shi' of 'shi bu' is a miswriting of 'li', and it is translated 'Board of Personnel', the board in charge of appointing and dismissing officials. 'Huangfeng' is the emperor's patent of enfeoffment. 'The Qian hexagram' is Qian, the image of heaven and the sovereign. 'The fifth line is the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui is the court' is taken as in the chapters on submitting memorials and on an audience (EL.89, EL.91). 'Yongyao', the Subject line, is the Subject: here the Resource line.

yi: 以文书为主要看的，以官鬼为凭据。
en: Take the document as the chief to be looked at, and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 欲知紫诰赠何人，卦内还须分六亲，
父作皇封世作己，官为史部五为君，
更将太岁为天子，乾卦当称帝王尊，
君位怕临空与绝，五爻忌克世和身。
yi: 想知道紫诰（皇帝的诏书）要赠给什么人，卦里还要分六亲；
父爻当作皇帝的封诰，世爻当作自己，官爻是吏部，五爻是君；
再把太岁当作天子，乾卦应当称作帝王的尊位；
君位怕落在空亡和绝，五爻忌克制世爻和身爻。
en: To know on whom the imperial patent will be conferred, one must still distinguish the six kin in the hexagram;
Resource is taken as the imperial patent and the Self as oneself, the star of office is the Board of Personnel and the fifth line is the sovereign;
and Tai Sui is further taken as the Son of Heaven, and the Qian hexagram is to be called the honoured emperor;
the sovereign's position fears Void and extinction, and the fifth line must not control the Self and the Body.

zh: 凡占诰命，父母为用爻，不绝不空，终须有望。
又看世为自己，官为吏部，五爻为天子，太岁为朝廷，皆莫空亡。
君位之爻，切莫伤身克世。
乾卦又为君王，或内或外得此象者，必受恩封。
yi: 凡是占诰命，父母爻是用爻，不绝不空，终究有指望。
又看世爻是自己、官爻是吏部、五爻是天子、太岁是朝廷，都不要落空亡。
代表君位的爻，千万不要伤身爻、克世爻。
乾卦也代表君王，不论内卦外卦得到这个象的，一定受到恩封。
en: In every divination about a patent, Resource is the Subject line, and if it is not extinct and not Void there must in the end be hope.
Look also at the Self as oneself, the star of office as the Board of Personnel, the fifth line as the Son of Heaven and Tai Sui as the court, none of which may be Void.
The line of the sovereign's position must on no account hurt the Body or control the Self.
The Qian hexagram also stands for the sovereign, and whoever gets this image, inner or outer, will surely receive the conferment.

title: 恩封诰命：君爻生合何爻处便见天恩赐那人——财象遇生封妻室、子爻逢合荫儿孙、世身若得君相合品级加增作大臣；五爻与太岁生合父母必赠椿萱，生合财爻必封妻室，生扶福德当荫儿孙，生合世身再加官爻旺相自当品职高升

rule.yi: 君爻生合哪一爻，就看到天恩赐给那个人：财爻遇生，封赠妻子；子爻逢合，荫及儿孙；世爻、身爻如果与君爻相合，品级加增，做到大臣。具体说：五爻和太岁生合父母爻，一定赠封父母（椿萱）；生合财爻，一定封赠妻室；生扶福德（子孙），应当荫及儿孙；生合世爻、身爻，再加官爻旺相，自然品级职位高升。
rule.en: Wherever the sovereign's line generates or combines, there one sees heaven's favour conferred on that person: if the Wealth image meets generation, the wife is enfeoffed; if the Output line meets combination, descendants receive privilege; if the Self or Body is combined with the sovereign's line, one's rank is increased and one becomes a great minister. In detail: if the fifth line and Tai Sui generate or combine with Resource, the parents will surely be honoured with a title; if they generate or combine with Wealth, the wife will surely be enfeoffed; if they generate and support Output, the fortune virtue, descendants should receive privilege; if they generate or combine with the Self or Body and the Pressure line is further thriving, one's rank and post will naturally be raised high.

note.yi: 「椿萱」是父母（椿指父、萱指母）。「荫儿孙」是朝廷凭官员的品级给子孙入学、授官的恩典。「封妻室」是封赠妻子为诰命夫人。「君相合」的「君相」疑是「君象」，指五爻、太岁这些代表君王的象。这一条与易隐官禄占「太岁五爻生合父母椿萱受赠；生合妻财室人受诰；生合子孙儿孙得荫」（YY.18）是同一套：君爻生合哪一个六亲，恩典就落在哪一个人身上。
note.en: 'Chunxuan' is the parents ('chun' for the father, 'xuan' for the mother). 'Yin er sun' is the privilege by which the court gives descendants a place in the school or an office according to the official's rank. 'Feng qishi' is the wife being given a patent as a titled lady. The 'xiang' of 'jun xiang he' is presumably 'xiang', image, the images that stand for the sovereign such as the fifth line and Tai Sui. This entry is the same set as 'Tai Sui and the fifth line generate or combine with Resource, the parents are honoured; with Wealth, the wife receives a patent; with Output, the children receive privilege' in the Yi Yin divination on official salary (YY.18): whichever of the six kin the sovereign's line generates or combines with, the favour falls on that person.

zh: 君爻生合何爻处，便见天恩赐那人。
世身若得君相合，品级加增作大臣。
yi: 君爻生合在哪一爻上，就看到天恩赐给那个人；
财爻遇生，就封赠妻子；
子爻逢合，就荫及儿孙；
世爻、身爻如果与君爻相合，品级加增，做到大臣。
en: Wherever the sovereign's line generates or combines, there one sees heaven's favour conferred on that person;
if the Wealth image meets generation, the wife is enfeoffed;
if the Output line meets combination, descendants receive privilege;
if the Self or Body is combined with the sovereign's line, one's rank is increased and one becomes a great minister.

zh: 五爻与太岁生合父母，必赠椿萱。
生合世身再加官爻旺相，自当品职高陛。
yi: 五爻和太岁生合父母爻，一定赠封父母。
生合财爻，一定封赠妻室。
生扶福德（子孙），应当荫及儿孙。
生合世爻、身爻，再加官爻旺相，自然品级职位高升。
en: If the fifth line and Tai Sui generate or combine with Resource, the parents will surely be honoured with a title.
If they generate or combine with Wealth, the wife will surely be enfeoffed.
If they generate and support Output, descendants should receive privilege.
If they generate or combine with the Self or Body and the Pressure line is further thriving, one's rank and post will naturally be raised high.

title: 恩封诰命：鬼发父兴迎诰命、父空财动绝皇恩，官鬼休囚宜嘱托、文书破绝莫劳心，来召来宣同此例、去朝去奏照其因；卦内官父两旺定沐洪恩，父若空亡难迎诰命，妻财独发克制文书难沾雨露，鬼值休囚夤缘为美父临空绝枉使机谋，君来宣召臣去朝天皆喜君爻生世，官旺为佳各忌帝位克身鬼空不吉

rule.yi: 官鬼发动、父爻兴旺，就迎来诰命；父爻落空、财爻发动，就断绝皇恩；官鬼休囚，适宜托人嘱托；文书（父母）被破、被绝，就不要费心。被召、被宣同这个取法；去朝见、去上奏，按它的缘由来断。卦里官爻、父爻都旺，一定沐浴洪恩；父爻如果空亡，难迎诰命；妻财独自发动、克制文书，难沾雨露；官鬼休囚，托人走门路为好；父爻临空、绝，白费机谋。君王来宣召、臣子去朝见，都喜欢君爻生世爻；官爻旺相为好，各自都忌帝位克制身爻，官鬼落空不吉。
rule.en: If Pressure moves and Resource flourishes, one welcomes the patent; if Resource is Void and Wealth moves, the sovereign's favour is cut off; if Pressure is resting or imprisoned it is fitting to entrust the matter to someone; if the document is broken or extinct, do not trouble your heart; being summoned or called follows this same rule, and going to court or memorialising follows its causes. If in the hexagram the star of office and Resource are both thriving, one will surely bathe in great favour; if Resource is Void, it is hard to receive the patent; if Wealth moves alone and controls the document, it is hard to share in the rain and dew of favour; if Pressure is resting or imprisoned, going through connections is best; if Resource is Void or extinct, scheming is in vain. Whether the sovereign summons or the minister goes to court, in all cases it is welcome for the sovereign's line to generate the Self; a thriving star of office is good, in each case the throne's position controlling the Body is feared, and Pressure Void is ominous.

note.yi: 「寅绿」疑是「夤缘」（攀附门路、通过关系），与诀里「官鬼休囚宜嘱托」是同一个意思，译作「托人走门路」。「迎诰命」是迎接诰命，「宣召」是君王召见，「洪恩」是大恩。「帝位克身」是五爻（君位）克制身爻。诀里「来召来宣同此例，去朝去奏照其因」是说召见、朝奏两类事，取法与诰命相同。
note.en: The 'yin lü' of 'yin lü wei mei' is presumably 'yinyuan', climbing by connections or working through relationships, which is the same sense as the verse's 'if Pressure is resting or imprisoned, it is fitting to entrust the matter to someone', and it is translated 'going through connections'. 'Ying gaoming' is receiving the patent, 'xuanzhao' is the sovereign summoning one, and 'hong en' is great favour. 'Diwei ke shen' is the fifth line (the sovereign's position) controlling the Body. The verse's 'being summoned or called follows this same rule, and going to court or memorialising follows its causes' says that being summoned and going to court or memorialise are two kinds of matter that take the same method as the patent.

zh: 鬼发父兴迎诰命，父空财动绝皇恩，
官鬼休囚宜嘱托，文书破绝莫劳心，
来召来宣同此例，去朝去奏照其因。
yi: 官鬼发动、父爻兴旺，就迎来诰命；父爻落空、财爻发动，就断绝皇恩；
官鬼休囚，适宜托人嘱托；文书（父母）被破、被绝，就不要费心；
被召、被宣同这个取法，去朝见、去上奏按它的缘由来断。
en: If Pressure moves and Resource flourishes, one welcomes the patent; if Resource is Void and Wealth moves, the sovereign's favour is cut off;
if Pressure is resting or imprisoned it is fitting to entrust the matter to someone; if the document is broken or extinct, do not trouble your heart;
being summoned or called follows this same rule, and going to court or memorialising follows its causes.

zh: 卦内官父两旺，定沐洪恩。
妻财独发，克制文书，难沾雨露。
鬼值休囚，寅绿为美，父临空绝，枉使机谋。
君来宣召，臣去朝天，皆喜君爻生世。
官旺为佳，各忌帝位克身，鬼空不吉。
yi: 卦里官爻、父爻都旺相，一定沐浴洪恩。
父爻如果空亡，就难以迎来诰命。
妻财独自发动、克制文书爻，就难以沾到雨露（恩泽）。
官鬼落在休囚，托人走门路（夤缘）为好；父爻临空、绝，白费机谋。
君王来宣召、臣子去朝见，都喜欢君爻生世爻。
官爻旺相为好，各自都忌帝位克制身爻，官鬼落空不吉。
en: If in the hexagram the star of office and Resource are both thriving, one will surely bathe in great favour.
If Resource is Void, it is hard to receive the patent.
If Wealth moves alone and controls the document, it is hard to share in the rain and dew of favour.
If Pressure is resting or imprisoned, going through connections is best; if Resource is Void or extinct, scheming is in vain.
Whether the sovereign summons or the minister goes to court, in all cases it is welcome for the sovereign's line to generate the Self.
A thriving star of office is good; in each case the throne's position controlling the Body is feared, and Pressure Void is ominous.

title: 文书消息：以文书为主、官鬼为凭；官印文书宜父动，民修票约忌财兴，财临身世徒书契，用不空亡准此情；凡论文书票约取父母为用爻，旺则有成空则无用，财爻为动或值世身空劳纸笔枉费神思

rule.yi: 论文书、消息，以文书爻为主，以官鬼为凭据。官府的印信文书，适宜父爻发动；民间立的票据契约，忌讳财爻兴旺；财爻临在身爻、世爻上，书契就白写；用爻不落空亡，就按这个情形断。凡是论文书、票据、契约，取父母爻为用爻：旺相就有成，落空就无用；财爻发动，或者世爻、身爻落空，就白费纸笔、枉费心思。
rule.en: In judging documents and tidings, take the document as the chief and Pressure as the ground. For official seals and documents it is fitting that Resource move; for bills and contracts drawn up by the people, avoid Wealth flourishing; if Wealth sits on the Body or the Self, the writing of the deed is in vain; if the Subject is not Void, hold to this situation. In judging documents, bills and contracts, take Resource as the Subject line: if thriving it succeeds, if Void it is useless; if the Wealth line moves, or the Self or Body is Void, the paper and brush are toiled for in vain and thought is wasted.

note.yi: 「票约」是票据和契约，「书契」是写下来的契约文书，「官印文书」是官府盖印的文书。「周不空亡准此情」的「周」疑是「用」（用神，这里是父母爻），译作「用爻不落空亡」。这一条与易隐文书占「文书占·公私之辨与成否」（YY.71）取同一个关系：都以父母为用，公家的文书看官旺，私下的契约看财怕克父。
note.en: 'Piaoyue' are bills and contracts, 'shuqi' are the written contract documents, and 'guanyin wenshu' are documents sealed by the authorities. The 'zhou' of 'zhou bu kongwang zhun ci qing' is presumably 'yong', the Subject (here the Resource line), and it is translated 'if the Subject is not Void'. This entry takes the same relation as 'public and private divinations and success' in the Yi Yin divination on documents (YY.71): both take Resource as the Subject, and for the document of the state one looks at the star of office thriving, for a private contract one fears Wealth controlling Resource.

yi: 以文书为主要看的，以官鬼为凭据。
en: Take the document as the chief to be looked at, and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 官印文书宜父动，民修票约忌财兴，
yi: 官府的印信文书，适宜父爻发动；民间立的票据契约，忌讳财爻兴旺；
财爻临在身爻、世爻上，书契就白写了。
用爻不落空亡，就按这个情形断。
en: For official seals and documents it is fitting that Resource move; for bills and contracts drawn up by the people, avoid Wealth flourishing;
if Wealth sits on the Body or the Self, the writing of the deed is in vain.
If the Subject is not Void, hold to this situation.

zh: 凡论文书票约，取父母为用爻，旺则有成，空则无用，财爻为动或值世身空，劳纸笔枉费神思。
yi: 凡是论文书、票据、契约，取父母爻为用爻：旺相就有成，落空就无用；财爻发动，或者世爻、身爻落空，就白费纸笔、枉费心思。
en: In judging documents, bills and contracts, take Resource as the Subject line: if thriving it succeeds, if Void it is useless; if the Wealth line moves, or the Self or Body is Void, the paper and brush are toiled for in vain and thought is wasted.

title: 文书消息：鬼是元神空不就、财为忌客动难成，父之冲克真为假、母变生扶却信凭；卦无官鬼或落空亡皆主不就，妻爻发动契必难成，财动官亦动反能成契，父母若被日月冲破或化绝化空此契不能见信于人，父母若遇生扶或变为有气此书纵假而可为真

rule.yi: 官鬼是元神，落空就办不成；财是忌神，发动就难成；父爻被冲克，真的也成了假的；父母爻变出生扶它的爻，就有信凭。具体说：卦里没有官鬼，或者官鬼落空亡，都主办不成；妻爻发动，契约必定难成；财动官也动，反而能成契约；父母爻如果被日月冲破，或者化绝、化空，这份契约不能取信于人；父母爻如果遇到生扶，或者变成有气，这份文书即使是假的也可以当真。
rule.en: Pressure is the Support, and if Void it does not succeed; Wealth is the Adversary, and if it moves it is hard to accomplish; if Resource is clashed or controlled, the genuine turns false; if Resource changes and is generated and supported, it gains credence. In detail: if the hexagram has no Pressure or it falls on Void, all mean it will not succeed; if the wife line, Wealth, moves, the contract will surely be hard to complete; if Wealth moves and the star of office also moves, on the contrary the contract can be completed; if Resource is clashed or broken by the Day or Month, or changes into extinction or Void, this contract cannot be believed by others; if Resource meets generation and support, or changes into something with qi, then even if this document is false it can be taken as true.

note.yi: 「元神」是生用神的爻，「忌客」按文意是忌神（见术语表）：这里用神是父母（文书），官鬼生父母所以是元神，财克父母所以是忌神。「母」是父母爻。末两句「父之冲克真为假，母变生扶却信凭」「此书纵假而可为真」书里就是这样说的：文书取不取信于人，看父母爻的旺衰生克；这里照字面译，不替它加解释。
note.en: 'Yuanshen', the Support, is the line that generates the Subject, and 'jike', the Adversary guest, is by the sense the Adversary (see the glossary): here the Subject is Resource (the document), so Pressure, which generates Resource, is the Support, and Wealth, which controls Resource, is the Adversary. 'Mu', mother, is the Resource line. The last two statements, 'if Resource is clashed or controlled, the genuine turns false; if Resource changes and is generated and supported, it gains credence' and 'even if this document is false it can be taken as true', are exactly what the book says: whether a document is believed depends on the strength, generation and control of the Resource line; it is translated literally here, with no explanation added.

zh: 鬼是元神空不就，财为忌客动难成，
父之冲克真为假，母变生扶却信凭。
yi: 官鬼是元神，落空就办不成；财是忌神，发动就难成；
父爻被冲克，真的也成了假的；父母爻变出生扶它的爻，反而有信凭。
en: Pressure is the Support, and if Void it does not succeed; Wealth is the Adversary, and if it moves it is hard to accomplish;
if Resource is clashed or controlled, the genuine turns false; if Resource changes and is generated and supported, it gains credence.

zh: 卦无官鬼或落空亡，皆主不就。
父母若被日月冲破、或化绝化空，此契不能见信于人。
父母若遇生扶、或变为有气，此书纵假而可为真也。
yi: 卦里没有官鬼，或者官鬼落空亡，都主办不成。
妻爻（财爻）发动，契约必定难成。
财爻发动、官爻也发动，反而能成契约。
父母爻如果被日月冲破，或者化绝、化空，这份契约不能取信于人。
父母爻如果遇到生扶，或者变成有气，这份文书即使是假的也可以当作真的。
en: If the hexagram has no Pressure or it falls on Void, all mean it will not succeed.
