If the wife line, Wealth, moves, the contract will surely be hard to complete.
If Wealth moves and the star of office also moves, on the contrary the contract can be completed.
If Resource is clashed or broken by the Day or Month, or changes into extinction or Void, this contract cannot be believed by others.
If Resource meets generation and support, or changes into something with qi, then even if this document is false it can be taken as true.

title: 趋谒贵人：以世应为主、外卦月卦为凭；外卦原来是用爻，兴隆出现得相交，无身无鬼皆非遇；凡去谒贵最嫌外卦空亡，外卦出现旺相人必相逢，外三爻皆动定有变更，一二爻动亦不如此论、又要取卦身与鬼官之爻，如缺一神又不遇

rule.yi: 去谒见贵人，以世爻、应爻为主，以外卦、月卦为凭据。外卦本来就是用爻：兴旺并且出现，就能相会；没有卦身、没有官鬼，都见不到。凡是去谒见贵人，最嫌外卦空亡；外卦出现而且旺相，人一定能见到；如果外卦三个爻都动，一定有变更；一、二个爻动，不这样论，还要取卦身和官鬼之爻，缺了其中一个，又见不到。
rule.en: In going to call on a noble, take the Self and the Other as the chief, and the outer trigram and the month hexagram as the ground. The outer trigram is originally the Subject line: if it flourishes and appears, one gets to meet; with no Body and no Pressure, one does not meet. In every call on a noble, what is most disliked is the outer trigram falling on Void; if the outer trigram appears and is thriving, one will surely meet the person; if all three lines of the outer trigram move, there will surely be a change; if one or two lines move, it is not judged so, but one must also take the Body and the Pressure line, and if one of these is lacking, one again does not meet.

note.yi: 谒见贵人时，外卦代表被拜见的一方（按本章后文「内为主，外为宾」）。「月卦」书里没有解释，本章别处也没有再用，这里按字面译作「月卦」。「无身无鬼皆非遇」的「身」是卦身（见术语表）。「外三爻皆动，定有变更」是说外卦三爻齐动，所见的人或事有变，书里没有展开。「鬼官」是官鬼。这一条与易隐谒贵占「外卦与应爻官爻属阴在家、属阳出外」「动者难见空者不见」（YY.74、YY.75）取同一个象：外卦、应爻是被拜见的人。
note.en: In calling on a noble, the outer trigram stands for the party who is visited (by the chapter's later 'the inner is the host and the outer is the guest'). The book does not explain 'yuegua', the month hexagram, and the chapter does not use it again, so it is translated literally. The 'body' of 'with no Body and no Pressure one does not meet' is the Body of the hexagram (see the glossary). 'If all three lines of the outer trigram move there will surely be a change' says that when the three lines of the outer trigram all move, the person or the matter seen changes, and the book does not go into it. 'Guiguan' is Pressure. This entry takes the same image as 'the outer trigram and the Pressure line of the Other, if yin he is at home and if yang he is out' and 'if it moves he is hard to see, if Void he is not seen' in the Yi Yin divination on calling on a noble (YY.74, YY.75): the outer trigram and the Other are the person who is visited.

zh: 以世应为主，外卦月卦为凭。
yi: 以世爻、应爻为主要看的，以外卦、月卦为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Other as the chief to be looked at, and the outer trigram and the month hexagram as the ground.

zh: 外卦原来是用爻，兴隆出现得相交，无身无鬼皆非遇，
yi: 外卦本来就是用爻，兴旺而且出现，就能相会；没有卦身、没有官鬼，都不能遇到；
en: The outer trigram is originally the Subject line; if it flourishes and appears, one gets to meet; with no Body and no Pressure, in neither case does one meet;

zh: 凡去谒贵，最嫌外卦空亡，若得外卦出现旺相，人必相逢。
如外三爻皆动，定有变更。
一二爻动，亦不如此论，又要取卦身与鬼官之爻，如缺一神又不遇也。
yi: 凡是去谒见贵人，最嫌外卦空亡；如果外卦出现而且旺相，人一定相逢。
如果外卦三个爻都动，一定有变更。
一、二个爻动的，也不这样论，还要取卦身和官鬼之爻；缺了其中一个，又见不到。
en: In every call on a noble, what is most disliked is the outer trigram falling on Void; if the outer trigram appears and is thriving, one will surely meet the person.
If all three lines of the outer trigram move, there will surely be a change.
If one or two lines move, it is not judged so; one must also take the Body and the Pressure line, and if one of these is lacking, one again does not meet.

title: 趋谒贵人：主若伤宾情据抛；复看世为主应为宾、内为主外为宾，内外世应相生比和、应克世外克内皆主相逢得意，惟独世克应与内克外主反触宾纵然相见亦不相投

rule.yi: 主人如果伤了宾，情意就丢开了。再看世爻是主、应爻是宾，内卦是主、外卦是宾：内外卦、世应相生，或者比和，或者应克世、外克内，都主相逢称心；唯独世克应、内克外，主方反而冒犯宾方，即使见面，也不相投。
rule.en: If the host injures the guest, the feeling is thrown away. Look also at the Self as the host and the Other as the guest, and the inner as the host and the outer as the guest: if the inner and outer trigrams or the Self and the Other generate each other, or are in accord, or the Other controls the Self, or the outer controls the inner, in every case it means meeting to one's satisfaction; only if the Self controls the Other, or the inner controls the outer, does the host on the contrary offend the guest, and even if they meet they will not get on.

note.yi: 「应为实」「外为实」的「实」疑是「宾」（诀里写「主若伤宾」，解末也写「触宾」），译作「宾」。这里的「主」是去拜访的一方（世、内），「宾」是被拜访的一方（应、外）。书里不说「应克世、外克内」为什么反而得意、「世克应、内克外」为什么反而触宾，只列了结果。
note.en: The 'shi' of 'ying wei shi' and 'wai wei shi' is presumably 'bin', guest (the verse says 'if the host injures the guest' and the end of the explanation says 'offends the guest'), and it is translated 'guest'. The 'host' here is the party who goes to call (the Self, the inner) and the 'guest' is the party who is called on (the Other, the outer). The book does not say why 'the Other controls the Self, the outer controls the inner' should on the contrary be satisfactory and 'the Self controls the Other, the inner controls the outer' should on the contrary offend the guest, and gives only the results.

yi: 主方如果伤了宾方，情谊就被抛开了。
en: If the host injures the guest, the feeling is thrown away.

zh: 如遇内外世应相生、或比和、或应克世、外克内，皆主相逢得意也。
惟独世克应与内克外，主反触宾，纵然相见亦不相投。
yi: 再看世爻是主，应爻是宾。
又以内卦为主，外卦为宾。
如果遇到内外卦、世应相生，或者比和，或者应克世、外克内，都主相逢称意。
只有世克应和内克外，主方反而冒犯宾方，即使见面也不相投。
en: Look again at the Self as the host and the Other as the guest.
And take the inner as the host and the outer as the guest.

If the inner and outer trigrams or the Self and the Other generate each other, or are in accord, or the Other controls the Self, or the outer controls the inner, in every case it means meeting to one's satisfaction.
Only if the Self controls the Other, or the inner controls the outer, does the host on the contrary offend the guest, and even if they meet they will not get on.

title: 趋谒贵人：世临空地难成事、应落空亡白费劳，望客喜逢三合卦、见宾怕遇六冲爻；趋谒之事世应与官鬼皆莫空亡三者如有一空决不相得，纵不逢空若值六冲决无美意，若得三合六合之卦自然宾主相谐，应象交重谓人不遇

rule.yi: 世爻落在空地，事难成；应爻落到空亡，白费辛劳。拜访客人，喜欢遇到三合的卦；会见宾客，怕遇到六冲的爻。趋谒的事，世、应和官鬼都不要落空亡，这三个里如果有一个落空，一定彼此不合；即使不遇空，如果遇到六冲，也一定没有好意；如果得到三合、六合的卦，宾主自然和谐；如果应象又发动，就说是人不遇。
rule.en: If the Self falls on empty ground the matter is hard to accomplish; if the Other falls on Void the toil is wasted. In calling on a visitor one is glad to meet a three-harmony hexagram; in meeting a guest one fears a six-clash line. In a call on a noble, the Self, the Other and Pressure must none be Void; if one of the three is Void, the two will surely not agree; even if none is Void, if there is a six-clash there will surely be no good will; if the hexagram is a three-harmony or a six-combine, guest and host are naturally in accord; if the Other image moves as well, it is said that the person is not met.

note.yi: 「望客」「见宾」都是去拜访。「三合」是三合局，「六合」「六冲」是卦的六合、六冲（见术语表）。「应象交重」是应爻发动（「交重」是动爻的记号）；「谓人不遇」是说要见的人不在、见不到。这一条与易隐谒贵占「动者难见，空者不见；……六合见，六冲不见」（YY.75）取同一类象。
note.en: 'Wangke' and 'jianbin' both mean going to call. 'Three-harmony' is the three-harmony formation, and 'six-combine' and 'six-clash' are the hexagram patterns (see the glossary). 'Ying xiang jiaozhong' is the Other line moving ('jiaozhong' is the mark of a moving line); 'wei ren bu yu' says that the person to be seen is not in and cannot be seen. This entry takes the same kind of images as 'if it moves he is hard to see, if Void he is not seen; ... with a six-combine one sees him, with a six-clash one does not' in the Yi Yin divination on calling on a noble (YY.75).

zh: 世临空地难成事，应落空亡白费劳。
望客喜逢三合卦，见宾怕遇六冲爻。
yi: 世爻落在空地，事情难成；应爻落到空亡，白费辛劳。
拜访客人，喜欢遇到三合的卦；会见宾客，怕遇到六冲的爻。
en: If the Self falls on empty ground the matter is hard to accomplish; if the Other falls on Void the toil is wasted.
In calling on a visitor one is glad to meet a three-harmony hexagram; in meeting a guest one fears a six-clash line.

zh: 趋谒之事，世应与官鬼皆莫空亡，三者如有一空，决不相得，纵不逢空，若值六冲，决无美意。
若得三合六合之卦，自然宾主相谐，若还应象交重，谓人不遇。
yi: 趋谒的事，世、应和官鬼都不要落空亡，这三个里如果有一个落空，一定彼此不合；即使不遇空，如果遇到六冲，也一定没有好意。
如果得到三合、六合的卦，宾主自然和谐；如果应象又发动，就说是人不遇。
en: In a call on a noble, the Self, the Other and Pressure must none be Void; if one of the three is Void, the two will surely not agree; even if none is Void, if it meets a six-clash there will surely be no good will.
If the hexagram is a three-harmony or a six-combine, guest and host are naturally in accord; if the Other image moves as well, it is said that the person is not met.

title: 趋谒贵人：如求书贴忧财发偏宜父母值重交，或去解非并脱讼子孙爻动祸殃消，若还觅利抽丰者财官两旺乐滔滔；求文取帖送书递柬不宜父母空亡更忌妻财发动，解词息讼反宜官鬼休囚又怕应来伤世，假公济私或抽丰利己须财官两旺切嫌兄弟交重

rule.yi: 去求书信、帖文，忧的是财爻发动，偏宜父母爻发动；去排解是非、脱出官司，子孙爻动，祸殃就消；求利、打抽丰，财爻、官爻两旺，就乐得很。具体说：去求文、取帖，以及送书、递柬，不适宜父母爻空亡，更忌妻财发动；想排解词讼、平息官司，反而适宜官鬼休囚，又怕应爻来伤世爻；遇到子孙持世或发动，祸一定消散；如果借公事来成全私情、或者打抽丰对自己有利，必须财、官两旺，切忌兄弟发动。
rule.en: If one seeks a letter or a note, one worries about Wealth moving and it is fitting for Resource to move; if one goes to settle a dispute or escape a lawsuit, when the Output line moves calamity is dispelled; if one seeks gain by drawing a rich man's bounty, Wealth and the star of office both thriving make one overflow with joy. In detail: in going to ask for a text or take a note, and in sending a letter or handing in a card, it is not fitting for Resource to be Void, and still more Wealth moving is avoided; if one wants to clear up a dispute and stop a lawsuit, it is on the contrary fitting for Pressure to be resting or imprisoned, and one fears the Other coming to hurt the Self; if Output holds the Self or moves, the calamity will surely vanish; if one makes use of a public affair to serve a private feeling, or draws a bounty for one's own benefit, Wealth and the star of office must both be thriving, and Peer moving is by all means to be avoided.

note.yi: 「书贴」是书信、帖文；「解非脱讼」是排解是非、脱出官司；「打抽丰」是去拜访有钱有势的人，求他资助；「递柬」是递送名帖。「祸必触消」的「触」疑是「顿」，译作「一定消散」。解词息讼时官鬼休囚反而好。这一条与易隐谒贵占「所求不同用神不同」（YY.77）取同一个法：求书恳荐以父母为用，息讼以子孙为用，各看各的。
note.en: 'Shutie' are letters and notes; 'jiefei tuosong' is settling a dispute and getting out of a lawsuit; 'da chou feng' is calling on a rich and powerful man to ask for his help; 'dijian' is handing in a visiting card. The 'chu' of 'huo bi chu xiao' is presumably 'dun', at once, and it is translated 'will surely vanish'. In clearing up a dispute and stopping a lawsuit, Pressure being resting or imprisoned is on the contrary good. This entry takes the same method as 'what is sought differs, the Subject differs' in the Yi Yin divination on calling on a noble (YY.77): for asking for a letter of recommendation Resource is the Subject, for stopping a lawsuit Output is the Subject, and each is looked at on its own.

zh: 如求书贴忧财发，偏宜父母值重交，
或去解非并脱讼，子孙爻动祸殃消。
若还觅利抽丰者，财官两旺乐滔滔。
yi: 如果去求书信、帖文，忧的是财爻发动，偏偏适宜父母爻发动；
或者去排解是非、脱出官司，子孙爻动，祸殃就消；
如果是求利、打抽丰，财爻、官爻两旺，就乐得很。
en: If one seeks a letter or a note, one worries about Wealth moving and it is fitting for Resource to move;
if one goes to settle a dispute or escape a lawsuit, when the Output line moves calamity is dispelled;
if one seeks gain by drawing a rich man's bounty, Wealth and the star of office both thriving make one overflow with joy.

zh: 但去求文取帖及送书递柬，不宜父母空亡，更忌妻财发动，如要解词息讼，反宜官鬼休囚，又怕应来伤世。
若遇子孙持世或发动，祸必触消。
如去假公事以济私情，或抽丰而利己者，须得财官两旺，切嫌兄弟交重。
yi: 只要是去求文、取帖，以及送书、递柬，不适宜父母爻空亡，更忌妻财发动；如果要排解词讼、平息官司，反而适宜官鬼休囚，又怕应爻来伤世爻。
如果遇到子孙持世或发动，祸一定消散。
如果是借公事来成全私情，或者打抽丰对自己有利，必须财、官两旺，切忌兄弟发动。
en: For going to ask for a text or take a note, and for sending a letter or handing in a card, it is not fitting for Resource to be Void, and still more Wealth moving is avoided; if one wants to clear up a dispute and stop a lawsuit, it is on the contrary fitting for Pressure to be resting or imprisoned, and one fears the Other coming to hurt the Self.
If Output holds the Self or moves, the calamity will surely vanish.

If one makes use of a public affair to serve a private feeling, or draws a bounty for one's own benefit, Wealth and the star of office must both be thriving, and Peer moving is by all means to be avoided.

title: 谋望成事总纲：以世应为主、内外为凭；成事须将世应查，世为本主应为他，空冲破绝临其世凡去谋为莫起牙，冲破绝空居应位他心不合枉嗟呀；凡成事体一应谋为皆取世应为主，或世或应如临绝地或犯旬空月破日冲皆难成就，次将内卦为谋事之人不宜空破，如临旺相定主亨通，再得内克外卦或内外相生比和俱为美

rule.yi: 谋求成事，以世爻、应爻为主，以内卦、外卦为凭据。要成事，必须查世、应：世是本主（自己），应是他人；空、冲、破、绝临到世爻，凡是去谋求，就不要动手；冲、破、绝、空落在应位，对方的心思不合，白白叹息。凡是成事办事、一切谋求，都取世、应为主：不论世还是应，如果落在绝地，或者犯旬空、月破、日冲，都难成就。其次把内卦当作谋事的人，不适宜空、破；如果旺相，一定亨通；再得到内克外卦，或者内外相生以及比和，都是美好的。
rule.en: In scheming to accomplish an affair, take the Self and the Other as the chief and the inner and outer trigrams as the ground. To accomplish an affair one must examine the Self and the Other: the Self is the principal and the Other is the other party; if Void, clash, break or extinction sits on the Self, do not set about scheming; if clash, break, extinction or Void is in the Other's place, the other party's mind does not agree and one sighs in vain. In every business and every scheme, take the Self and the Other as the chief: if either the Self or the Other falls on a place of extinction, or runs into the ten-day Void, Month-break or the Day's clash, it is hard to accomplish. Next, take the inner trigram as the one who schemes the affair, which should not be Void or broken; if it meets thriving it surely means success; if in addition the inner controls the outer trigram, or the inner and outer generate each other or are in accord, all is fine.

note.yi: 「谋望成事」讲托人、找门路把一件事办成，不限哪一类。「本主」是自己。「莫起牙」的「牙」疑是「芽」，「起芽」是开头、动手，译作「不要动手」。「嗟呀」是叹息。「旬空」「月破」见术语表。这一条与易隐谋望占「可否成败」（YY.83、YY.84）取同一个法：以世应为主，内卦为谋事之人。
note.en: 'Mouwang chengshi' is getting a matter done by asking others and finding ways in, and is not limited to one kind of matter. 'Benzhu' is oneself. The 'ya' of 'mo qi ya' is presumably 'ya', a sprout, and 'to put out a sprout' is to begin and set about it, so it is translated 'do not set about scheming'. 'Jieya' is sighing. 'Ten-day Void' and 'Month-break' are in the glossary. This entry takes the same method as 'whether it can be done and whether it succeeds' in the Yi Yin divination on scheming (YY.83, YY.84): the Self and the Other are the chief and the inner trigram is the one who schemes the affair.

yi: 以世爻、应爻为主要看的，以内卦、外卦为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Other as the chief to be looked at, and the inner and outer trigrams as the ground.

zh: 成事须将世应查，世为本主应为他，
空冲破绝临其世，凡去谋为莫起牙，
冲破绝空居应位，他心不合枉嗟呀。
yi: 要成事，必须查世、应：世是本主（自己），应是他人；
空、冲、破、绝临到世爻，凡是去谋求，就不要动手；
冲、破、绝、空落在应位，对方的心思不合，白白叹息。
en: To accomplish an affair one must examine the Self and the Other: the Self is the principal and the Other is the other party;
if Void, clash, break or extinction sits on the Self, do not set about scheming;
if clash, break, extinction or Void is in the Other's place, the other party's mind does not agree and one sighs in vain.

zh: 凡成事体一应谋为，皆取世应为主，或世或应，如临绝地或犯旬空月破日冲，皆难成就。
次将内卦为谋事之人，不宜空破。
如临旺相，定主亨通，再得内克外卦，或内外相生及比和俱为美也。
yi: 凡是成事办事、一切谋求，都取世、应为主；不论是世还是应，如果落在绝地，或者犯旬空、月破、日冲，都难成就。
其次把内卦当作谋事的人，不适宜空、破。
如果内卦旺相，一定亨通；再得到内克外卦，或者内外相生以及比和，都是美好的。
en: In every business and every scheme, take the Self and the Other as the chief: if either the Self or the Other falls on a place of extinction, or runs into the ten-day Void, Month-break or the Day's clash, it is hard to accomplish.
Next, take the inner trigram as the one who schemes the affair, which should not be Void or broken.
If it meets thriving it surely means success; if in addition the inner controls the outer trigram, or the inner and outer generate each other or are in accord, all is fine.

title: 谋望成事：六冲爻象难谐就、卦内无官事必差、世应若逢日辰合任君不愿也堪夸；六冲之卦事决不成，合处逢冲成后复退，鬼若空亡及不上卦皆不就，世应二爻自相会合或得日辰合世合应纵若心中不欲也得允成

rule.yi: 六冲的爻象难以谐成，卦里没有官爻，事一定出差错；世应如果逢日辰来合，任凭你不愿意也值得夸赞。六冲的卦，事一定不成；合的地方遇到冲，成了之后还会退回；官鬼如果空亡或者不上卦，都办不成；世、应二爻自相会合，或者得到日辰来合世、合应，即使心里不想，也能得到允准办成。
rule.en: A six-clash image is hard to bring to harmony, and with no star of office in the hexagram the affair is sure to go wrong; if the Self and the Other meet a combination from the Day, even if you do not wish it, it is worth praising. With a six-clash hexagram the affair will surely not succeed; if where there is a combination it meets a clash, after it succeeds it falls back again; if Pressure is Void or not in the hexagram, in neither case does it succeed; if the Self and the Other lines combine with each other, or the Day combines with the Self or the Other, even if one does not wish it in one's heart, it will be granted and accomplished.

note.yi: 「合处逢冲，成后复退」与求馆章「如合处逢冲或变出六冲，虽见成就，其年定主不终」（EL.53）取同一个关系。「任君不愿」「心中不欲」书里没有说是谁心里不愿，这里按字面译。
note.en: 'Where there is a combination it meets a clash, after it succeeds it falls back' takes the same relation as 'if where there is a combination it meets a clash, or it changes out a six-clash, then even if it seems settled that year it will not last' in the chapter on seeking a school post (EL.53). The book does not say whose heart it is that is unwilling in 'even if you do not wish it' and 'even if one does not wish it in one's heart', and it is translated literally.

zh: 六冲爻象难谐就，卦内无官事必差，
世应若逢日辰合，任君不愿也堪夸。
yi: 六冲的爻象难以谐成，卦内没有官爻，事一定出差错；
世应如果逢上日辰来合，任凭你不愿意也值得夸赞。
en: A six-clash image is hard to bring to harmony, and with no star of office in the hexagram the affair is sure to go wrong;
if the Self and the Other meet a combination from the Day, even if you do not wish it, it is worth praising.

zh: 鬼若空亡及不上卦，皆不就也。
世应二爻自相会合，或得日辰合世合应，纵若心中不欲，也得允成。
yi: 六冲的卦，事一定不成。
合的地方遇到冲，成了之后还会退回。
官鬼如果空亡或者不上卦，都办不成。
世、应二爻自相会合，或者得到日辰来合世、合应，即使心里不想，也能得到允准办成。
en: With a six-clash hexagram the affair will surely not succeed.
If where there is a combination it meets a clash, after it succeeds it falls back again.
If Pressure is Void or not in the hexagram, in neither case does it succeed.
If the Self and the Other lines combine with each other, or the Day combines with the Self or the Other, even if one does not wish it in one's heart, it will be granted and accomplished.

title: 谋望成事：陛官迁职兼兴讼官鬼交重名倍加、觅利还须财旺相、求书必得父光华，兄爻独发般般忌、子象兴隆事事佳；官中谋望所断如前复喜官爻旺相独忌子摇，谋利息财忌空亡、斡文书不宜财动卦如无父终不能成，诸般谋事各嫌兄弟交重惟子动无不为佳功名独忌

rule.yi: 升官迁职、兴讼，官鬼发动，名声更添；求利，还要财爻旺相；求书信，必须父爻有光彩；兄爻独自发动，样样都忌；子孙兴旺，事事都好。在官府里谋求的，断法同前，又喜官爻旺相，唯独忌讳子孙发动。谋求利息钱财，忌讳财空亡；如果是办理文书，不适宜财爻发动；卦里如果没有父爻，终究不能成。各种谋事，都嫌兄弟发动；只有子孙发动没有不好的，唯独功名一项忌讳。
rule.en: For promotion and transfer in office, and for starting a lawsuit, if Pressure moves one's name is doubled; for seeking profit, Wealth must also be thriving; for seeking a letter, Resource must be bright; if the Peer line moves alone, everything is taboo; if Output flourishes, everything is good. For scheming in official business the judgment is as before, and one is again glad for the Pressure line to be thriving and alone fears Output moving. In scheming for interest and wealth, Void is to be avoided for Wealth; if one is managing a document, Wealth moving is not fitting; and if the hexagram has no Resource it cannot in the end succeed. In every kind of scheming, Peer moving is disliked; only Output moving is never anything but good, and for fame and office alone is it a taboo.

note.yi: 「陛官迁职」的「陛」是「升」（见仕宦升迁章）。「斡文书」的「斡」是转、办理。「父光华」是父爻有光彩，即旺相不受伤。子孙发动是各种谋事的吉兆，唯独功名、官职一项忌讳——这与前面仕宦升迁章「官职升迁子莫刚」（EL.55）是一回事：官职功名最忌子孙。
note.en: The 'bi' of 'bi guan qian zhi' is 'sheng', to rise (see the chapter on official promotion). The 'wo' of 'wo wenshu' is to turn and to manage. 'Fu guanghua' is Resource having lustre, that is thriving and unhurt. Output moving is an auspicious sign for every kind of scheming, and only for fame and office is it a taboo, which is the same thing as 'for promotion in office Output must not be strong' in the earlier chapter on official promotion (EL.55): office and fame most fear Output.

zh: 陛官迁职兼兴讼，官鬼交重名倍加，
觅利还须财旺相，求书必得父光华。
兄爻独发般般忌，子象兴隆事事佳。
yi: 升官迁职、兴讼，官鬼发动，名声更添；
求利，还要财爻旺相；求书信，必须父爻有光彩。
兄爻独自发动，样样都忌；子孙兴旺，事事都好。
en: For promotion and transfer in office, and for starting a lawsuit, if Pressure moves one's name is doubled;
for seeking profit, Wealth must also be thriving; for seeking a letter, Resource must be bright.
if the Peer line moves alone, everything is taboo; if Output flourishes, everything is good.

zh: 官中谋望所断如前，复喜官爻旺相，独忌子摇。
如谋利息财忌空亡，若斡文书，不宜财动。
诸般谋事，各嫌兄弟交重，惟子动无不为佳，功名独忌。
yi: 在官府里谋求的，断法同前，又喜官爻旺相，唯独忌讳子孙发动。
如果是谋求利息钱财，财爻忌空亡；如果是办理文书，不适宜财爻发动。
卦里如果没有父爻，终究不能成。
各种谋事，都嫌兄弟发动；只有子孙发动没有不好的，唯独功名一项忌讳。
en: For scheming in official business the judgment is as before, and one is again glad for the Pressure line to be thriving and alone fears Output moving.
In scheming for interest and wealth, Void is to be avoided for Wealth; if one is managing a document, Wealth moving is not fitting.
If the hexagram has no Resource, it cannot in the end succeed.
In every kind of scheming, Peer moving is disliked; only Output moving is never anything but good, and for fame and office alone is it a taboo.

chapter: 谋差顶役(第四十章,章名在原文中缺失)
title: 谋差顶役：以官爻为主、世象为凭；书辩捕兵民皂卒谋差顶役世爻详，各忌六冲官害世、皆宜财鬼旺为强；一应衙门生意顶役谋差若遇六冲决难成就纵成不久，官鬼若伤身世终遭罪责难逃，得财官两旺其中定见兴家

rule.yi: 谋差使、顶替衙门的役，以官爻为主，以世爻为凭据。书办、捕快、兵、民壮、皂隶、差役这些人谋差顶役，要细看世爻；都忌六冲、官爻害世爻，都适宜财爻、官鬼旺相才强。凡是衙门里的差事、生意、顶役、谋差，如果遇到六冲，一定难以成就，即使成了也不长久；官鬼如果伤了身爻、世爻，终究遭到罪责，难以逃脱；得到财、官两旺在其中，一定见到兴家。
rule.en: In seeking a commission or taking over a post in a yamen's service, take the Pressure line as the chief and the Self image as the ground. For clerks, scribes, constables, soldiers, militiamen, lictors and runners seeking a commission or taking over a service, examine the Self line in detail; all fear a six-clash and the star of office harming the Self, and all are fitly strong when Wealth and Pressure are thriving. For every job in a yamen, whether a livelihood, taking over a service or seeking a commission, if it meets a six-clash it will surely be hard to accomplish, and even if it is accomplished it will not last; if Pressure injures the Body or the Self, one will in the end be blamed and punished and cannot escape; if Wealth and the star of office are both thriving within it, one will surely see the household prosper.

note.yi: 这三章（第四十至四十二章）的章名在书里缺失，只留下小标；它们处在第三十九章（谋望成事）和第四十三章（除名脱役）之间，这里推定为第四十、四十一、四十二章，章名按内容拟：谋差顶役、户役、帮户。「书辩」疑是「书办」（衙门里的文书），「皂卒」是皂隶、差役，「顶役」是顶替别人的差役名额，「谋差」是谋求一个差使，「衙门生意」是在衙门里谋生的行当。「兴家」是家道兴旺。
note.en: The titles of these three chapters (Chapters 40 to 42) are missing in the book and only the subtitles remain; as they lie between Chapter 39 (scheming and accomplishing affairs) and Chapter 43 (removal from the rolls and release from service), they are taken here as Chapters 40, 41 and 42, with titles supplied from the content: seeking a commission or taking over a service post, household service, and sharing a household's service. 'Shu bian' is presumably 'shuban', clerks of a yamen; 'zaozu' are the lictors and runners; 'ding yi' is taking over another man's place in the service; 'mou chai' is seeking a commission; 'yamen shengyi' is a line of livelihood in a yamen. 'Xingjia' is the household prospering.

yi: 以官爻为主要看的，以世爻为凭据。
en: Take the Pressure line as the chief to be looked at, and the Self image as the ground.

zh: 书辩捕兵民皂卒，谋差顶役世爻详，
各忌六冲官害世，皆宜财鬼旺为强。
yi: 书办、捕快、兵、民壮、皂隶、差役，谋差使、顶替役位，要细看世爻；
都忌六冲、官爻害世；都适宜财爻、官鬼旺相才强。
en: For clerks, scribes, constables, soldiers, militiamen, lictors and runners, in seeking a commission or taking over a service, the Self line is examined in detail;
all fear a six-clash and the star of office harming the Self, and all are fitly strong when Wealth and Pressure are thriving.

zh: 一应衙门生意顶役谋差，若遇六冲决难成就，纵成不久。
官鬼若伤身世，终遭罪责难逃，得财官两旺其中，定见兴家。
yi: 凡是衙门里的生意、顶役、谋差，如果遇到六冲，一定难以成就，即使成了也不长久。
官鬼如果伤了身爻、世爻，终究遭到罪责，难以逃脱；得到财、官两旺在其中，一定见到兴家。
en: For every job in a yamen, whether a livelihood, taking over a service or seeking a commission, if it meets a six-clash it will surely be hard to accomplish, and even if it is accomplished it will not last.

If Pressure injures the Body or the Self, one will in the end be blamed and punished and cannot escape; if Wealth and the star of office are both thriving within it, one will surely see the household prosper.

chapter: 谋差顶役(第四十章,章名在原文中缺失)
title: 谋差顶役：更愁身命随官墓、世坐空亡谁赞襄，无鬼莫来谋此役、官临身世却宜当；身世本命随官入墓祸不可当，世值空亡焉能久远，卦中无鬼所作不成纵成始终无益，若得官临身世本命又遇生扶宜充此役

rule.yi: 更怕身、命随着官爻入墓，世爻坐空亡，谁来帮助？没有官鬼，就不要来谋这份役；官爻临在身爻、世爻上，却适宜担当。具体说：身爻、世爻、本命随着官爻入墓，祸就挡不住；世爻落在空亡，哪能长久？卦中没有官鬼，所做的不成，即使成了也始终无益；如果官爻临在身爻、世爻上，本命又遇到生扶，就适宜充任这份役。
rule.en: Still more fear the Body and the fate following the star of office into the tomb, and with the Self sitting on Void who will assist? With no Pressure do not come to seek this service; with the star of office on the Body or the Self it is on the contrary fitting to take it up. In detail: if the Body, the Self and the native fate follow the star of office into the tomb, the calamity cannot be withstood; if the Self falls on Void, how can it last long? If the hexagram has no Pressure, what one does will not succeed, and even if it succeeds it is of no benefit from first to last; if the star of office rests on the Body or the Self and the native fate meets generation and support, it is fitting to fill this service.

note.yi: 「身命」「本命」按常例是身爻、世爻和问卜人的本命（出生年的地支）；书里没有再解释。「随官入墓」增删卜易另有说法（ZS.06）。「赞襄」是帮助。这一条与黄金策仕宦「官爻隐伏，莫思爵位升迁」（HJC.06）、「身空无救，命尽当危」（HJC.09）取同一类象：官爻不出现、世身落空都不成。
note.en: 'Shenming' and 'benming' are, by the usual practice, the Body and the Self lines and the native fate of the person asking (the branch of his birth year); the book does not explain them further. 'Following the star of office into the tomb' has another account in the Zengshan Buyi (ZS.06). 'Zanxiang' is helping. This entry takes the same kind of images as 'if the star of office lies hidden, do not think of rank and promotion' (HJC.06) and 'a Void Body without rescue means life is exhausted and in danger' (HJC.09) in the Huangjin Ce on official careers: with the star of office not appearing and the Self or Body Void, nothing comes of it.

zh: 更愁身命随官墓，世坐空亡谁赞襄，
无鬼莫来谋此役，官临身世却宜当。
yi: 更怕身、命随着官爻入墓，世爻坐空亡，谁来帮助？
没有官鬼，就不要来谋这份役；官临在身爻、世爻上，却适宜担当。
en: Still more fear the Body and the fate following the star of office into the tomb, and with the Self sitting on Void who will assist?
With no Pressure do not come to seek this service; with the star of office on the Body or the Self it is on the contrary fitting to take it up.

zh: 但若身世本命随官入墓，祸不可当。
卦中无鬼，所作不成，纵若成之，始终无益。
若得官临身世，本命又遇生扶，宜充此役。
yi: 但如果身爻、世爻、本命随着官爻入墓，祸就挡不住。
世爻落在空亡，哪能长久？
卦中没有官鬼，所做的不成；即使成了，也始终无益。
如果官爻临在身爻、世爻上，本命又遇到生扶，就适宜充任这份役。
en: But if the Body, the Self and the native fate follow the star of office into the tomb, the calamity cannot be withstood.
If the Self falls on Void, how can it last long?
If the hexagram has no Pressure, what one does will not succeed, and even if it succeeds it is of no benefit from first to last.
If the star of office rests on the Body or the Self and the native fate meets generation and support, it is fitting to fill this service.

chapter: 谋差顶役(第四十章,章名在原文中缺失)
title: 谋差顶役：财空鬼弱兄爻动但得虚名利不昌、世不逢冲官不绝差成役就乐欢肠；财落空中官居衰地事虽见就必主无财，卦中纵有衰财或逢兄动亦不为祥，世象不冲不破官爻不绝不空便言谋中得成求财得利

rule.yi: 财爻落空、官鬼衰弱、兄爻发动，只得到虚名，利益不旺；世爻不遇冲、官爻不绝，差使办成、役位到手，心里欢喜。财爻落在空中、官爻居衰地，事情虽看似成了，一定没有钱财；卦中即使有衰弱的财爻，或者遇到兄动，也不吉祥；世爻不冲不破、官爻不绝不空，就可以说谋求能成、求财得利。
rule.en: With Wealth Void, Pressure weak and the Peer line moving, one gets only an empty name and profit does not flourish; if the Self does not meet a clash and the star of office is not extinct, the commission is won and the service is taken up, and the heart is glad. If Wealth falls into Void and the star of office sits in a weak place, then although the matter seems to be accomplished there will surely be no money; even if there is a weak Wealth line in the hexagram, or Peer moves, it is not auspicious; if the Self image is not clashed or broken and the Pressure line is not extinct or Void, one may say that the scheme will succeed and that seeking wealth will bring gain.

note.yi: 这一条是谋差顶役一章的收尾：要有名（官）也要有利（财），财空鬼弱兄动是「有名无利」。「欢肠」是心里欢喜。
note.en: This entry closes the chapter on seeking a commission: one needs both name (the star of office) and profit (Wealth), and Wealth Void, Pressure weak and Peer moving is 'a name without profit'. 'Huanchang' is a glad heart.

zh: 财空鬼弱兄爻动，但得虚名利不昌，
世不逢冲官不绝，差成役就乐欢肠。
yi: 财爻落空、官鬼衰弱、兄爻发动，只得到虚名，利益不旺；
世爻不遇冲、官爻不绝，差使办成、役位到手，心里欢喜。
en: With Wealth Void, Pressure weak and the Peer line moving, one gets only an empty name and profit does not flourish;
if the Self does not meet a clash and the star of office is not extinct, the commission is won and the service is taken up, and the heart is glad.

zh: 财落空中官居衰地，事虽见就，必主无财，卦中纵有衰财或逢兄动，亦不为祥。
世象不冲不破，官爻不绝不空，便言谋中得成，求财得利。
yi: 财爻落在空中、官爻居衰地，事情虽看似成了，一定没有钱财；卦中即使有衰弱的财爻，或者遇到兄动，也不吉祥。
世爻不冲不破、官爻不绝不空，就可以说谋求能成、求财得利。
en: If Wealth falls into Void and the star of office sits in a weak place, then although the matter seems to be accomplished there will surely be no money; even if there is a weak Wealth line in the hexagram, or Peer moves, it is not auspicious.
If the Self image is not clashed or broken and the Pressure line is not extinct or Void, one may say that the scheme will succeed and that seeking wealth will bring gain.

chapter: 户役(第四十一章,章名在原文中缺失)
title: 户役轻重：以官鬼为主、生克为凭；民当户役有轻重之不同，卦出官爻取旺衰之可验；官旺则役重、官衰则役轻，克世则厚而非薄、伤身则重而不轻，带青龙而吉、加白虎而凶；或空或绝皆主无忧，鬼纵休囚克世还当繁重，官虽旺相生世赔费还轻，值青龙终无责罚临白虎必犯官刑

rule.yi: 百姓承当户役，有轻重的不同；卦里出现的官爻，看它的旺衰就可以验证。官爻居于旺相，役一定高大强劲；休囚，才细小；官克世爻，役厚而不薄；伤身爻，役重而不轻；带青龙是吉，加白虎是凶。要知道户役的轻重，必须看官爻的衰旺：旺就重大，衰就轻微；或者落空，或者入绝，都主没有忧虑；官鬼即使休囚，如果克世，还是繁重；官爻虽然旺相，但生世爻，赔费还轻；值青龙，终究没有责罚；临白虎，必定触犯官刑。
rule.en: The people bear household services of lighter and heavier kinds, and the Pressure line that appears in the hexagram can be tested by its strength or weakness. If it is in a thriving place the service will certainly be high and strong; if it is resting or imprisoned it is small and fine; if it controls the Self the service is thick and not thin; if it hurts the Body it is heavy and not light; carrying the Azure Dragon it is called auspicious, and adding the White Tiger it is called ominous. To know whether the household service is light or heavy, look at the strength of the Pressure line: if thriving it is heavy and large, if weak it is light and slight; if Void or extinct, in either case there is nothing to worry about; even if Pressure is resting or imprisoned, if it controls the Self the burden will still be heavy; even if the star of office is thriving, if it generates the Self the cost of making up shortfalls is still light; on the Azure Dragon there is in the end no blame or punishment, and on the White Tiger one will surely run into official punishment.

note.yi: 「户役」是民户承当的徭役，应指里甲、粮长、解户一类（明代的户役）；「解户」是押送钱粮解往官府的户，「赔」是赔补短欠。章名在书里缺，按内容拟为「户役」（见谋差顶役一条的说明）。这一章与前面各章不同：官鬼在这里就是役，旺则役重、衰则役轻，「重」「轻」说的是负担，不是吉凶；青龙带吉、白虎带凶才说吉凶。「细小」「高强」是役的大小轻重。
note.en: 'Huyi', household service, is the corvée borne by a household, and presumably means the kind of service of the neighbourhood-and-tithing system, grain captains and conveyor households (household service under the Ming); 'jiehu' is a household that conveys money and grain to the authorities, and 'pei' is making up a shortfall. The chapter title is missing in the book and is supplied as 'household service' from the content (see the note to the entry on seeking a commission). This chapter differs from the earlier ones: Pressure here is the service itself, so when thriving the service is heavy and when weak it is light; 'heavy' and 'light' speak of the burden and not of good or ill, and it is the Azure Dragon and the White Tiger that carry good and ill. 'Xixiao' and 'gaoqiang' are the size and weight of the service.

yi: 以官鬼为主要看的，以生克为凭据。
en: Take Pressure as the chief to be looked at, and generation and control as the ground.

zh: 民当户役有轻重之不同，卦出官爻取旺衰之可验。
凡居旺相必高强，若得休囚方细小，
克世则厚而非薄，伤身则重而不轻。
带青龙而道吉，加白虎以言凶。
yi: 百姓承当户役，有轻重的不同；卦里出现的官爻，看它的旺衰就可以验证。
官爻居于旺相，役一定高大强劲；如果休囚，才细小；
官爻克世，役厚而不薄；伤身，役重而不轻。
带青龙，就说吉；加白虎，就说凶。
en: The people bear household services of lighter and heavier kinds, and the Pressure line that appears in the hexagram can be tested by its strength or weakness.
If it is in a thriving place the service will certainly be high and strong; if it is resting or imprisoned it is small and fine;
if it controls the Self the service is thick and not thin; if it hurts the Body it is heavy and not light.
carrying the Azure Dragon it is called auspicious, and adding the White Tiger it is called ominous.

zh: 要知户役轻重，须看官爻衰旺，旺则重大，衰则轻微。
鬼纵休囚，克世还当繁重。
官虽旺相，生世赔费还轻。
值青龙终无责罚，临白虎必犯官刑。
yi: 要知道户役的轻重，必须看官爻的衰旺：旺就重大，衰就轻微。
或者落空，或者入绝，都主没有忧虑。
官鬼即使休囚，如果克世，还是繁重。
官爻虽然旺相，如果生世，赔费还轻。
值青龙，终究没有责罚；临白虎，必定触犯官刑。
en: To know whether the household service is light or heavy, look at the strength of the Pressure line: if thriving it is heavy and large, if weak it is light and slight.
If Void or extinct, in either case there is nothing to worry about.
Even if Pressure is resting or imprisoned, if it controls the Self the burden will still be heavy.
Even if the star of office is thriving, if it generates the Self the cost of making up shortfalls is still light.
On the Azure Dragon there is in the end no blame or punishment; on the White Tiger one will surely run into official punishment.

chapter: 户役(第四十一章,章名在原文中缺失)
title: 户役轻重：月建临官应佥魁首、日辰克鬼当审轻微，官爻值世估高名、福德加身登下榜；官临月建至重之差，鬼值世爻次重之役，鬼逢日月克伤轻徭可必，子孙世或发动其户亦轻

rule.yi: 月建临在官爻上，应被派作魁首（最重的役）；日辰克官鬼，应审定为轻微。官爻值世，估定是高名（高等户，役重）；福德加身，登下榜（下等户，役轻）。具体说：官临月建，是最重的差；鬼值世爻，是次重的役；官鬼遇到日月克伤，役轻是可以断定的；子孙持世或者发动，这个户也轻。
rule.en: If the Month rests on the star of office, one should be assigned as the headman; if the Day controls Pressure, one should judge it light and slight. If the Pressure line holds the Self, one is reckoned of high name; if Output, the fortune virtue, is added to the Body, one ascends the lower roll. In detail: the star of office on the Month is the heaviest commission; Pressure on the Self line is the next heaviest service; if Pressure meets the control and injury of the Day and the Month, lightness can be affirmed; if Output holds the Self or moves, the household too is light.

note.yi: 「魁首」是户役里最重的一名（如里长、粮长之首），「佥」是佥派、派定。「估高名」「登下榜」按文意是被定在高等户、下等户：官爻值世是高等户（役重），福德加身是下等户（役轻）；「榜」是户等的名册。「轻摇」疑是「轻徭」，徭役轻。这一条只取诀的前四句和解的前四句，后面的变化（子化官、官化子、兄弟动等）在下一条（EL.111）。
note.en: 'Kuishou', the headman, is the heaviest single place in the household services (such as the head of the tithing or the head of the grain captains), and 'qian' is to assign and to appoint. 'Gu gaoming' and 'deng xiabang' are by the sense being placed among households of high and low grade: the Pressure line holding the Self is a household of high grade (heavy service), and Output added to the Body is a household of low grade (light service); 'bang' is the register of household grades. The 'yao' of 'qing yao' is presumably 'yao', corvée, so 'light corvée'. This entry takes only the first four clauses of the verse and the first four sentences of the explanation; the changes that follow (Output into Pressure, Pressure into Output, Peer moving and so on) are in the next entry (EL.111).

zh: 月建临官应佥魁首，日辰克鬼当审轻微。
官爻值世估高名，福德加身登下榜，
yi: 月建临在官爻上，应被派作魁首；日辰克官鬼，应审定为轻微。
官爻值世，估定是高名；福德加在身上，就登下榜。
en: If the Month rests on the star of office, one should be assigned as the headman; if the Day controls Pressure, one should judge it light and slight.
If the Pressure line holds the Self, one is reckoned of high name; if Output, the fortune virtue, is added to the Body, one ascends the lower roll.

zh: 鬼逢日月克伤，轻摇可必。
子孙世或发动，其户亦轻。
yi: 官临月建，是最重的差。
鬼值世爻，是次重的役。
官鬼遇到日月克伤，役轻是可以断定的。
子孙持世或者发动，这个户也轻。
en: The star of office on the Month is the heaviest commission.
Pressure on the Self line is the next heaviest service.
If Pressure meets the control and injury of the Day and the Month, lightness can be affirmed.
If Output holds the Self or moves, the household too is light.

chapter: 户役(第四十一章,章名在原文中缺失)
title: 户役轻重：子化官则将轻作重、官化子则改祸成祥，兄弟动时多破费、子孙旺处少亏伤，用爻强弱端详解户浅深预定；子变官爻解轻赔赊，鬼之子象役大赔微，兄弟发动或持世上定多赔赊，子孙旺相或值身爻费财稍可

rule.yi: 子孙化成官，就把轻变成重；官化成子孙，就转祸为祥。兄弟发动时，多破费；子孙旺相处，少亏损。要细看用爻的强弱，解户的深浅就预先定了。具体说：子孙变成官爻，解运看着轻，赔补赊欠却有；官鬼变成子孙的象，役大、赔补却小；兄弟发动或者持世，一定多赔补、多赊欠；子孙旺相或者临在身爻上，花费钱财还算可以。
rule.en: If Output changes into the star of office, light is made heavy; if the star of office changes into Output, calamity is turned to fortune. When Peer moves there is much expense; where Output thrives there is little loss. Examine the strength of the Subject line, and the depth or shallowness of the conveyor household's burden is settled in advance. In detail: if Output changes into the Pressure line, the conveyance is light but there are shortfalls and arrears; if Pressure changes into the Output image, the service is great but the shortfall is slight; if Peer moves or rests on the Self, there will surely be many shortfalls and arrears; if Output is thriving or rests on the Body line, the cost in wealth is somewhat tolerable.

note.yi: 「赔赊」是赔补、赊欠（解户押运钱粮，短少的要自己赔补）。「子变官爻，解轻赔赊」「鬼之子象，役大赔微」与诀里「子化官则将轻作重」「官化子则改祸成祥」放在一起读：子化官是外面看着轻、赔补却多，官化子是役虽大、赔补却小；这是按文意的读法，书里没有再解释。「用爻」是官鬼（这一章以官鬼为主）。
note.en: 'Peishe' is making up shortfalls and arrears (a conveyor household that carries money and grain must make up what falls short out of its own pocket). 'If Output changes into the Pressure line, the conveyance is light but there are shortfalls and arrears' and 'if Pressure changes into the Output image, the service is great but the shortfall is slight' are read together with the verse's 'if Output changes into the star of office, light is made heavy' and 'if the star of office changes into Output, calamity is turned to fortune': Output into Pressure looks light on the outside but the shortfalls are many, and Pressure into Output is a great service but with a small shortfall; this is a reading by the sense and the book does not explain it further. 'Yongyao', the Subject line, is Pressure (the chief of this chapter).

zh: 子化官则将轻作重，官化子则改祸成祥，
兄弟动时多破费，子孙旺处少亏伤。
用爻强弱端详，解户浅深预定。
yi: 子孙化成官，就把轻变成重；官化成子孙，就转祸为祥；
兄弟发动时，多破费；子孙旺相处，少亏损。
用爻的强弱要细细审详，解户（押运钱粮的户）役的深浅就预先定了。
en: If Output changes into the star of office, light is made heavy; if the star of office changes into Output, calamity is turned to fortune;
when Peer moves there is much expense; where Output thrives there is little loss.
Examine the strength of the Subject line, and the depth or shallowness of the conveyor household's burden is settled in advance.

zh: 兄弟发动或持世上，定多赔赊。
子孙旺相或值身爻，费财稍可。
yi: 子孙变成官爻，解运看着轻，赔补赊欠却有。
官鬼变成子孙的象，役大、赔补却小。
兄弟发动或者持世，一定多赔补、多赊欠。
子孙旺相或者临在身爻上，花费钱财还算可以。
en: If Output changes into the Pressure line, the conveyance is light but there are shortfalls and arrears.
If Pressure changes into the Output image, the service is great but the shortfall is slight.
If Peer moves or rests on the Self, there will surely be many shortfalls and arrears.
If Output is thriving or rests on the Body line, the cost in wealth is somewhat tolerable.

chapter: 帮户(第四十二章,章名在原文中缺失)
title: 帮户贴役：以世应为主、官鬼为凭；将役扳人忌应空，六冲无鬼彼难从，应爻克世他无咎，鬼落空亡讼若风；欲求帮户须观应与官爻，应若空亡师来帮贴，世遭应克无力扳他，若卜六冲决难遂意、如无官鬼岂得扳人，鬼象临空临绝官心无主无为

rule.yi: 要把自己的役扳到别人身上（求帮户），以世爻、应爻为主，以官鬼为凭据。把役扳给别人，忌讳应爻落空；六冲又没有官鬼，对方难以服从；应爻克世爻，他没有过错；官鬼落空亡，官司就像风一样（落空）。想求得帮户，必须看应爻和官爻：应爻如果空亡，「师来帮贴」；世爻被应爻克制，没有力量去扳他；如果卜得六冲，一定难以遂意；没有官鬼，怎么能扳到人？官鬼的象临空、临绝，官的心里没有主意，不会有作为。
rule.en: To shift a service onto others and so seek help from another household, take the Self and the Other as the chief and Pressure as the ground. In passing the service on to another, the Other being Void is to be avoided; with a six-clash and no Pressure the other party finds it hard to comply; if the Other controls the Self, he is not at fault; if Pressure falls on Void, the lawsuit is like the wind. To seek a helper household one must look at the Other and the Pressure line: if the Other is Void, 'the master comes to help with a subsidy'; if the Self is controlled by the Other, one has no strength to drag him in; if a six-clash is cast it will surely be hard to achieve one's wish; with no Pressure how can one drag another in? If the Pressure image meets Void or extinction, the official's mind has no direction and he does nothing.

note.yi: 「帮户」是协助承担户役的户，「帮贴」「津贴」是补贴费用；「将役扳人」是把役扳到别人身上，让他一起分担。「扳」是攀扯、扳累。「师来帮贴」文字疑有误，按上下文（前面「应空」是忌）似应是没有人来帮贴；这里按字面译。「讼若风」按文意是官司落空、没有结果，书里没有展开。「官心无主」的「官」是承办的官。
note.en: 'Banghu' is a household that helps to bear a household's service, and 'bangtie' and 'jintie' are subsidising the expense; 'jiang yi ban ren' is dragging another person into the service so that he shares it. 'Ban' is to pull in and to saddle. 'Shi lai bangtie' looks wrong in its characters, and by the context (the earlier 'the Other Void' is a taboo) it should presumably mean that no one comes to help with a subsidy; it is translated literally here. 'Song ruo feng' is by the sense a lawsuit coming to nothing, and the book does not go into it. The 'guan' of 'guan xin wu zhu' is the official who handles the matter.

yi: 以世爻、应爻为主要看的，以官鬼为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Other as the chief to be looked at, and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 将役扳人忌应空，六冲无鬼彼难从，
应爻克世他无咎，鬼落空亡讼若风。
yi: 把役扳到别人身上，忌讳应爻落空；六冲又没有官鬼，对方难以服从；
应爻克世爻，他没有过错；官鬼落空亡，官司就像风一样。
en: In passing the service on to another, the Other being Void is to be avoided; with a six-clash and no Pressure the other party finds it hard to comply;
if the Other controls the Self, he is not at fault; if Pressure falls on Void, the lawsuit is like the wind.

zh: 欲求帮户，须观应与官爻，应若空亡，师来帮贴。
若卜六冲决难遂意，如无官鬼岂得扳人？
鬼象临空临绝，官心无主无为。
yi: 想求得帮户，必须看应爻和官爻；应爻如果空亡，「师来帮贴」。
世爻被应爻克制，就没有力量去扳他。
如果卜得六冲，一定难以遂意；如果没有官鬼，怎么能扳到人？
官鬼的象临到空、绝，官的心里没有主意，不会有所作为。
en: To seek a helper household one must look at the Other and the Pressure line: if the Other is Void, 'the master comes to help with a subsidy'.
If the Self is controlled by the Other, one has no strength to drag him in.
If a six-clash is cast it will surely be hard to achieve one's wish; with no Pressure how can one drag another in?
If the Pressure image meets Void or extinction, the official's mind has no direction and he does nothing.

chapter: 帮户(第四十二章,章名在原文中缺失)
title: 帮户贴役：应被世伤官鬼克决能扳累获全功，卦爻生合妻财旺定来贴费两和同，应上临官临月破斯人受责受其凶；世克应爻或官伤应位必是如心，世应相生相合财逢生旺之乡不必官扳自然津贴，官爻值应或应临月破者官必佥帮违选遭责

rule.yi: 应爻被世爻伤、被官鬼克，一定能把役扳累过去，获得全功；卦爻相生相合、妻财旺相，一定来贴补费用，双方和同；应爻上临官爻、临月破，这个人受责、遭凶。世克应爻，或者官伤应位，必定如意；世应相生相合、财爻逢生旺之乡，不必官府来扳，自然来津贴；官爻值应、或者应临月破的，官府一定佥派帮户，违背选定的就遭责罚。
rule.en: If the Other is hurt by the Self and controlled by Pressure, one can surely drag the service onto the other and gain complete success; if the lines generate and combine and Wealth is thriving, they will surely come with a subsidy for the expenses and both sides will be in accord; if the Other rests on the star of office or on Month-break, that man is reproved and meets ill. If the Self controls the Other line, or the star of office hurts the Other's place, it will surely be as one wishes; if the Self and the Other generate and combine with each other and Wealth meets a place of generation and thriving, there is no need for the officials to drag anyone in, and a subsidy comes of itself; if the Pressure line is on the Other, or the Other rests on Month-break, the officials will surely assign helper households, and whoever goes against the selection is reproved.

note.yi: 「扳累」是把累赘攀扯到别人身上；「贴费」是补贴费用。「斯人」指应（被扳的一方）：解里「官爻值应或应临月破者，官必佥帮违选遭责」说的是同一件事，「违选」按文意是违背官府的选定。「官伤应位」「官必佥帮」书里没有展开。
note.en: 'Banlei' is saddling another with a burden; 'tiefei' is subsidising the expense. 'Siren', that man, is the Other (the party who is dragged in): the explanation's 'if the Pressure line is on the Other or the Other rests on Month-break, the officials will surely assign helper households and whoever goes against the selection is reproved' speaks of the same thing, and 'wei xuan' is by the sense going against the authorities' selection. 'The star of office hurts the Other's place' and 'the officials will surely assign helpers' are not unfolded in the book.

zh: 应被世伤官鬼克，决能扳累获全功，
卦爻生合妻财旺，定来贴费两和同。
应上临官临月破，斯人受责受其凶。
yi: 应爻被世爻伤、被官鬼克，一定能把役扳累过去，获得全功；
卦爻相生相合、妻财旺相，一定来贴补费用，双方和同；
应爻上临官爻、临月破，这个人受责、遭凶。
en: If the Other is hurt by the Self and controlled by Pressure, one can surely drag the service onto the other and gain complete success;
if the lines generate and combine and Wealth is thriving, they will surely come with a subsidy for the expenses and both sides will be in accord;
if the Other rests on the star of office or on Month-break, that man is reproved and meets ill.

zh: 世克应爻或官伤应位，必是如心。
世应相生相合、财逢生旺之乡不必官扳，自然津贴。
官爻值应或应临月破者，官必佥帮违选遭责。
yi: 世克应爻，或者官伤应位，必定如意。
世应相生相合、财爻逢生旺之乡，不必官府来扳，自然来津贴。
官爻值应、或者应临月破的，官府一定佥派帮户，违背选定的就遭责罚。
en: If the Self controls the Other line, or the star of office hurts the Other's place, it will surely be as one wishes.

If the Self and the Other generate and combine with each other and Wealth meets a place of generation and thriving, there is no need for the officials to drag anyone in, and a subsidy comes of itself.
If the Pressure line is on the Other, or the Other rests on Month-break, the officials will surely assign helper households, and whoever goes against the selection is reproved.

title: 除名脱役：以子孙为主、世象为凭；官爻克世兼临世用尽机谋脱不成，卦得六冲应脱役，子孙在世定除名；凡求脱役专看官爻，官如克世临世欲退其役难以推开，若得六冲或子孙持世或子孙交重皆主役去名消

rule.yi: 求脱役（解除差役），以子孙为主，以世爻为凭据。官爻克世爻、又临在世爻上，用尽机谋也脱不成；卦得六冲，应该能脱役；子孙在世爻上，一定除名。凡是求脱役，专看官爻：官如果克世、临世，想退掉这份役，难以推开；如果得到六冲，或者子孙持世，或者子孙发动，都主役免名消。
rule.en: In seeking release from service, take Output as the chief and the Self image as the ground. If the Pressure line controls the Self and also rests on the Self, however much scheming one uses one cannot get free; if the hexagram is a six-clash, one should be freed from the service; if Output is on the Self, one will surely be struck from the rolls. In every seeking of release from service, look especially at the Pressure line: if it controls the Self or rests on the Self, it is hard to push off the service one wants to leave; if one gets a six-clash, or Output holds the Self, or Output moves, in every case the service goes and the name is cleared.

note.yi: 「脱役」是摆脱差役，「除名」是从役籍里除去名字。章名在书里写了两次，头一次写作「除吊脱役」，「吊」是「名」的误写。「推开」是推脱开。「交重」是动爻的记号，泛指爻发动。这一章要看子孙，与前面谋差顶役（要官爻）正好相反：要脱役，官爻是缠住你的，子孙才是解脱的。
note.en: 'Tuoyi' is getting free of a service and 'chuming' is having one's name removed from the service roll. The chapter title is written twice in the book, the first time as 'chudiao tuoyi', where the 'diao' is a miswriting of 'ming'. 'Tuikai' is pushing off. 'Jiaozhong' is the mark of a moving line and here means a line moving in general. This chapter looks at Output, which is exactly the opposite of the earlier chapter on seeking a commission (which wanted the Pressure line): to be released from a service, the Pressure line is what holds one fast and Output is what frees one.

yi: 以子孙为主要看的，以世爻为凭据。
en: Take Output as the chief to be looked at, and the Self image as the ground.

zh: 官爻克世兼临世，用尽机谋脱不成，
卦得六冲应脱役，子孙在世定除名。
yi: 官爻克制世爻，又临在世爻上，用尽机谋也脱不成；
卦得六冲，应该能脱役；子孙在世爻上，一定除名。
en: If the Pressure line controls the Self and also rests on the Self, however much scheming one uses one cannot get free;
if the hexagram is a six-clash, one should be freed from the service; if Output is on the Self, one will surely be struck from the rolls.

zh: 凡求脱役，专看官爻，官如克世临世，欲退其役难以推开。
若得六冲或子孙持世，或子孙交重，皆主役去名消。
yi: 凡是求脱役，专看官爻：官如果克世、临世，想退掉这份役，难以推开。
如果得到六冲，或者子孙持世，或者子孙发动，都主役免名消。
en: In every seeking of release from service, look especially at the Pressure line: if it controls the Self or rests on the Self, it is hard to push off the service one wants to leave.
If one gets a six-clash, or Output holds the Self, or Output moves, in every case the service goes and the name is cleared.

title: 除名脱役：世空自退无忧虑、应陷他非上籍丁，世应俱空官又动傍人顶役两无刑；世值空亡自当解散，应值空亡他难顶替，世应皆空官又动者自能解脱，彼不克当必有傍人代役已免其忧

rule.yi: 世爻落空，自己就能退役，没有忧虑；应爻落陷，别人就不能上籍当丁；世应都空而官又发动，旁人顶役，两边都没有刑害。世爻值空亡，自然解散；应爻值空亡，他难以顶替；世、应都空、官又发动的，自己能解脱；他担当不了，一定有旁人代役，自己就免了忧虑。
rule.en: If the Self is Void one retires of oneself and has no worry; if the Other is sunk, the other man cannot be entered on the rolls as an able-bodied adult; if the Self and the Other are both Void and the star of office moves, another man takes over the service and neither side is punished. If the Self falls on Void, one is naturally released; if the Other falls on Void, he can hardly take one's place; if the Self and the Other are both Void and the star of office moves, one can free oneself; if he cannot bear it, another man will stand in for the service, and one is free of the worry.

note.yi: 「上籍丁」是登记入役籍的成年男丁。「顶役」「代役」都是由别人顶替服役。「傍人」是旁人。「已免其忧」的「已」疑是「己」，译作「自己免了忧虑」。
note.en: 'Shang ji ding' is an adult male entered on the service roll. 'Dingyi' and 'daiyi' both mean another man serving in one's place. 'Bangren' is another person. The 'yi' of 'yi mian qi you' is presumably 'ji', oneself, and it is translated 'one is free of the worry'.

zh: 世空自退无忧虑，应陷他非上籍丁，
世应俱空官又动，傍人顶役两无刑。
yi: 世爻落空，自己就能退役，没有忧虑；应爻落陷，他人就不能上籍当丁；
世应都空而官又发动，旁人顶役，两边都没有刑害。
en: If the Self is Void one retires of oneself and has no worry; if the Other is sunk, the other man cannot be entered on the rolls as an able-bodied adult;
if the Self and the Other are both Void and the star of office moves, another man takes over the service and neither side is punished.

zh: 世值空亡，自当解散，应值空亡，他难顶替。
世应皆空官又动者，自能解脱。
彼不克当，必有傍人代役，已免其忧。
yi: 世爻值空亡，自然解散；应爻值空亡，他难以顶替。
世、应都空、官又发动的，自己能解脱。
他担当不了，一定有旁人代役，自己就免了忧虑。
en: If the Self falls on Void, one is naturally released; if the Other falls on Void, he can hardly take one's place.
If the Self and the Other are both Void and the star of office moves, one can free oneself.
If he cannot bear it, another man will stand in for the service, and one is free of the worry.

title: 除名脱役：鬼爻立应兼伤彼他必承当永不更、鬼若兴隆财迭发还须自己入公庭；官爻临应兼克应皆主他人代役，官临旺动又不伤他况遭财动生官定难脱也，官爻纵动如来生助世爻反有益我之情必然得脱

rule.yi: 官鬼爻立在应爻上、又伤克对方，他必定承担下来，永不更改；官鬼如果兴旺、财爻接连发动，还须自己进公堂。官爻临在应爻上又克应爻，都主他人代役；官爻临旺相发动、又不伤他，何况遇到财爻发动来生官爻，一定难脱；官爻即使发动，如果来生助世爻，反而有益于我，必定得脱。
rule.en: If the Pressure line stands on the Other and also hurts him, he will surely take it on and it will never change; if Pressure flourishes and Wealth moves one after another, one must still go oneself into the public court. If the Pressure line rests on the Other and controls it, in every case another man takes over the service; if the star of office is thriving and moving and does not hurt him, and still more if Wealth moves to generate the star of office, release is surely hard; even if the Pressure line moves, if it comes to generate and aid the Self line, it is on the contrary of benefit to me and I will surely get free.

note.yi: 「立应」是立在应爻上；「公庭」是官府的公堂，「入公庭」是自己到官府去服役。「伤彼」是伤克对方（应）。诀里「鬼爻立应兼伤彼，他必承当永不更」说的是对方把役顶下来，与解里「官爻临应兼克应，皆主他人代役」是一回事；「鬼若兴隆财迭发」与解里「官临旺动……况遭财动生官，定难脱也」也是一回事。「官爻纵动，如来生助世爻」是官爻的力量转过来生世，反而有利，是解里在「官临旺动」之外补的一条例外。这是全章和「谋差顶役」至「脱役」各章的收尾。
note.en: 'Liying' is standing on the Other line; 'gongting' is the public court of the authorities, and 'ru gongting' is going oneself to the authorities to serve. 'Shangbi' is hurting the other party (the Other). The verse's 'if the Pressure line stands on the Other and also hurts him, he will surely take it on and it will never change' says that the other party takes the service over, which is the same as the explanation's 'if the Pressure line rests on the Other and controls it, in every case another man takes over the service'; and 'if Pressure flourishes and Wealth moves one after another' is likewise the same as the explanation's 'if the star of office is thriving and moving ... and still more if Wealth moves to generate the star of office, release is surely hard'. 'Even if the Pressure line moves, if it comes to generate and aid the Self line' is the force of the Pressure line turning to generate the Self, which on the contrary helps, and is an exception that the explanation adds beside 'the star of office thriving and moving'. This closes the chapter and the run of chapters from seeking a commission to release from service.

zh: 鬼爻立应兼伤彼，他必承当永不更，
鬼若兴隆财迭发，还须自己入公庭。
yi: 官鬼爻立在应爻上，又伤克对方，他必定承担下来，永不更改；
官鬼如果兴旺、财爻接连发动，还须自己进公堂。
en: If the Pressure line stands on the Other and also hurts him, he will surely take it on and it will never change;
if Pressure flourishes and Wealth moves one after another, one must still go oneself into the public court.

zh: 官爻临应兼克应，皆主他人代役。
官临旺动又不伤他，况遭财动生官，定难脱也。
官爻纵动，如来生助世爻，反有益我之情，必然得脱。
yi: 官爻临在应爻上、又克应爻，都主他人代役。
官爻临旺相发动、又不伤他，何况又遇到财爻发动来生官爻，一定难脱。
官爻即使发动，如果来生助世爻，反而有益于我，必定得脱。
en: If the Pressure line rests on the Other and controls it, in every case another man takes over the service.
If the star of office is thriving and moving and does not hurt him, and still more if Wealth moves to generate the star of office, release is surely hard.
Even if the Pressure line moves, if it comes to generate and aid the Self line, it is on the contrary of benefit to me and I will surely get free.

chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
title: 鬻身投主总纲：以世应为主、父母为凭；命运乖违必致鬻身延岁月、年时饥馑还须投主度晨昏，要决平生之事当寻持世之爻，不破不冲百年可辅、落空落陷一载难从；鬻身者出乎不得已须择良善之主，世爻旺相生扶可以聊生，世落空亡或值日冲月破虽暂时安置终身落寞终是不久

rule.yi: 要卖身投靠主人（鬻身投主），以世爻、应爻为主，以父母爻为凭据。命运不顺，必定要卖身来延续岁月；年成饥荒，还得投靠主人来度过早晚。要决断一生的事，应当寻找持世的爻：不破不冲，一百年都可以得到辅助；落空落陷，一年也难以相从。卖身投主的人是出于不得已，必须选择良善的主人：世爻旺相、得到生扶，可以勉强过活；世爻落空亡，或者遇到日冲、月破，虽然是暂时安顿，毕竟一生落寞，即使勉强维持，终究不久。
rule.en: In selling oneself into service under a master, take the Self and the Other as the chief and Resource as the ground. When one's fate runs against one, one must sell oneself to prolong one's days; in a famine year one must still take a master to get through morning and evening. To decide the affairs of a lifetime, one should seek the line that holds the Self: if it is neither broken nor clashed, a hundred years can be aided; if it falls to Void or into a pit, it is hard to follow even for one year. Those who sell themselves do so out of necessity and must choose a good and kind master: if the Self line is thriving and supported one can eke out a living; if the Self falls on Void, or meets the Day's clash or Month-break, then although one is temporarily settled, in the end one is desolate all one's life, and even if one makes do it will not last.

note.yi: 「鬻身投主」是把自己卖给主人做奴仆、投靠主人过活。这一章问的是卖身投靠主人，所以世爻是自己，应爻、父母爻是主人（后文「应为主象」「父为主世为我」）。「良善之生」的「生」疑是「主」，译作「良善的主人」。「落陷」是落入空、墓、绝一类凶地（见前）。「聊生」是勉强过活。「日冲」是日辰冲世，「月破」是月建冲破。
note.en: 'Yushen touzhu' is selling oneself to a master as a servant and attaching oneself to a master to live. The chapter asks about selling oneself into a master's service, so the Self is oneself and the Other and Resource are the master (by the later 'the Other is the image of the master' and 'Resource is the master and the Self is me'). The 'sheng' of 'liangshan zhi sheng' is presumably 'zhu', master, and it is translated 'a good and kind master'. 'Falling into a pit' is falling into a bad place such as Void, tomb or extinction (see earlier). 'Liaosheng' is making a bare living. 'Day clash' is the Day clashing the Self, and 'Month-break' is the Month breaking it.

yi: 以世爻、应爻为主要看的，以父母爻为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Other as the chief to be looked at, and Resource as the ground.

zh: 命运乖违，必致鬻身延岁月。年时饥馑，还须投主度晨昏。
要决平生之事，当寻持世之爻。
yi: 命运不顺，必定要卖身来延续岁月；年成饥荒，还得投靠主人来度过早晚。
要决断一生的事，应当寻找持世的爻。
（持世之爻）不破不冲，一百年都可以得到辅助；
（持世之爻）落空落陷，一年也难以相从。
en: When one's fate runs against one, one must sell oneself to prolong one's days; in a famine year one must still take a master to get through morning and evening.
To decide the affairs of a lifetime, one should seek the line that holds the Self.
If it is neither broken nor clashed, a hundred years can be aided;
if it falls to Void or into a pit, it is hard to follow even for one year.

zh: 鬻身者，出乎不得已，须择良善之生，若得世爻旺相生扶，可以聊生，若世落空亡或值日冲月破，虽是暂时安置，毕竟终身落寞，纵然勉强，终是不久者耳。
yi: 卖身的人，是出于不得已，必须选择良善的主人；如果世爻旺相、得到生扶，可以勉强过活；如果世爻落空亡，或者遇到日冲、月破，虽然是暂时安顿，毕竟一生落寞，即使勉强维持，终究不久。
en: Those who sell themselves do so out of necessity and must choose a good and kind master; if the Self line is thriving and supported one can eke out a living; if the Self falls on Void, or meets the Day's clash or Month-break, then although one is temporarily settled, in the end one is desolate all one's life, and even if one makes do it will not last.

chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
title: 鬻身投主：鬼立世中殃有缠身之扰、空临应上主无顾己之情；为祸为灾无非官鬼，若来持世则灾生祸扰，应为主象若值空绝只可苟延岁月是无作养厚情

rule.yi: 官鬼立在世爻上，灾殃缠身、多受烦扰；空亡临在应爻上，主人没有照顾自己的情意。招祸招灾的，无非是官鬼；如果它来持世，就灾生祸扰。应爻是主人的象，如果遇到空、绝，只能苟延岁月，没有养育厚待的情分。
rule.en: If Pressure stands on the Self, calamity entangles one's person with trouble; if Void rests on the Other, the master has no feeling of caring for oneself. What brings misfortune and disaster is nothing but Pressure, and if it comes to hold the Self then disaster arises and misfortune troubles one; the Other is the image of the master, and if it meets Void or extinction one can only drag out one's days, for there is no generous feeling of nurture.

note.yi: 「缠身之扰」是灾祸缠在身上。「作养」是养育、提携。官鬼在这一章是灾祸之象（「为祸为灾，无非官鬼」），不是官职，与前面求官各章里官鬼是用神、是官职不同。
note.en: 'Chanshen zhi rao' is calamity clinging to one's person. 'Zuoyang' is nurture and support. In this chapter Pressure is the image of calamity ('what brings misfortune and disaster is nothing but Pressure') and not an official post, which differs from the earlier chapters on seeking office where Pressure is the Subject and the official post.

zh: 鬼立世中，殃有缠身之扰。
空临应上，主无顾己之情。
yi: 官鬼立在世爻中，灾殃有缠身的烦扰；
空亡临在应爻上，主人没有照顾自己的情意。
en: If Pressure stands on the Self, calamity entangles one's person with trouble;
if Void rests on the Other, the master has no feeling of caring for oneself.

zh: 为祸为灾，无非官鬼，若来持世，则灾生祸扰。
应为主象，若值空绝，只可苟延岁月，是无作养厚情。
yi: 招祸招灾的，无非是官鬼；如果它来持世，就灾生祸扰。
应爻是主人的象，如果遇到空、绝，只能苟延岁月，是没有养育厚待的情分。
en: What brings misfortune and disaster is nothing but Pressure, and if it comes to hold the Self then disaster arises and misfortune troubles one.
The Other is the image of the master, and if it meets Void or extinction one can only drag out one's days, for there is no generous feeling of nurture.

chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
title: 鬻身投主：父母生身蒙上辈维持之宠、弟兄克世被同人谤陷之忧；父母乃是主家长上之尊，生身生世者常垂青目之盼，兄弟乃同辈之俦倘来克世则彼肆嫉妨之谋

rule.yi: 父母爻生身，蒙受上辈的维持和宠爱；兄弟克世，有被同辈诽谤陷害的忧虑。父母爻是主人家里的长辈尊者，如果生身、生世，常常被青眼相看；兄弟是同辈的伙伴，如果来克世，他们就放肆地谋划嫉妒、妨碍。
rule.en: If Resource generates the Body, one receives the favour of support from one's elders; if Peer controls the Self, one has the worry of being slandered and trapped by one's fellows. Resource is the honoured elder of the master's household, and if it generates the Body or the Self, one is constantly looked on with a favourable eye; Peer are fellows of one's own rank, and if it comes to control the Self, they give free rein to jealous plots to hinder one.

note.yi: 「上辈」「长上」是主人家里的长辈。「同人」「同辈之俦」是同为仆役的人。「青目」是青眼，表示好感。「谤陷」是诽谤陷害。
note.en: 'Shangbei' and 'zhangshang' are the elders of the master's household. 'Tongren' and 'tongbei zhi chou' are those who are servants like oneself. 'Qingmu' is the green eye, a look of good will. 'Bangxian' is slandering and entrapping.

zh: 父母生身，蒙上辈维持之宠。
弟兄克世，被同人谤陷之忧。
yi: 父母爻生身，蒙受上辈的维持和宠爱；
弟兄克世，有被同辈诽谤陷害的忧虑。
en: If Resource generates the Body, one receives the favour of support from one's elders;
if Peer controls the Self, one has the worry of being slandered and trapped by one's fellows.

zh: 父母乃是主家长上之尊，若生身生世者，常垂青目之盼。
兄弟乃同辈之俦，倘来克世，则彼肆嫉妨之谋。
yi: 父母爻是主人家里的长辈尊者，如果生身、生世，常常被青眼相看。
兄弟是同辈的伙伴，如果来克世，他们就放肆地谋划嫉妒、妨碍。
en: Resource is the honoured elder of the master's household, and if it generates the Body or the Self, one is constantly looked on with a favourable eye.
Peer are fellows of one's own rank, and if it comes to control the Self, they give free rein to jealous plots to hinder one.

chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
title: 鬻身投主：世冲父位主仆无缘、财合身官起居有利；父为主世为我不可相戕，若值冲克似为无缘不合难以相利，财为衣禄若得生合世爻则衣禄无亏利资有望

rule.yi: 世爻冲了父爻的位置，主仆没有缘分；财爻与身爻、官爻相合，日常起居有利。父爻是主人、世爻是我，不可互相伤害；如果遇到冲克，就像没有缘分、合不来，难以互相得利；财爻是衣食俸禄，如果生合世爻，衣禄就没有亏缺，利益资财有指望。
rule.en: If the Self clashes with Resource's position, master and servant have no affinity; if Wealth combines with the Body and the star of office, daily life is favourable. Resource is the master and the Self is me, and they must not injure each other; if they meet clash or control, it is as if there were no affinity and no accord, and it is hard to profit one another; Wealth is clothing and pay, and if it generates or combines with the Self line, clothing and pay will not be lacking and profit and funds can be hoped for.

note.yi: 「相戕」是互相伤害。「起居」是日常生活。「衣禄」是衣食和俸给。这一条的取象：父为主人、世为自己、财为衣禄。
note.en: 'Xiangqiang' is injuring each other. 'Qiju' is daily life. 'Yilu' is clothing and pay. The images taken here: Resource is the master, the Self is oneself, Wealth is clothing and pay.

yi: 世爻冲了父爻的位置，主仆没有缘分；
财爻与身爻、官爻相合，日常起居有利。
en: If the Self clashes with Resource's position, master and servant have no affinity;
if Wealth combines with the Body and the star of office, daily life is favourable.

zh: 父为主世为我，不可相戕，若值冲克，似为无缘不合难以相利。
财为衣禄，若得生合世爻，则衣禄无亏利资有望。
yi: 父爻是主人、世爻是我，不可互相伤害；如果遇到冲克，就像没有缘分、合不来，难以互相得利。
财爻是衣食俸禄，如果生合世爻，衣禄就没有亏缺，利益资财有指望。
en: Resource is the master and the Self is me, and they must not injure each other; if they meet clash or control, it is as if there were no affinity and no accord, and it is hard to profit one another.
Wealth is clothing and pay, and if it generates or combines with the Self line, clothing and pay will not be lacking and profit and funds can be hoped for.

chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
title: 鬻身投主：子旺财明多积蓄、兄兴鬼发染灾非；子动生财财因子助乃积蓄丰余津津不竭，鬼同兄发鬼耗官灾乃灾生财散件件不实

rule.yi: 子孙旺相、财爻分明，积蓄就多；兄爻兴旺、官鬼发动，就染上灾祸是非。子孙发动生财，财得子孙相助，就是积蓄丰余、源源不断；官鬼和兄爻一起发动，官鬼耗损、招官灾，就是灾祸生起、钱财散去，件件都不踏实。
rule.en: If Output is thriving and Wealth is clear, there are many savings; if Peer flourishes and Pressure moves, one is stained with calamity and wrangling. If Output moves to generate Wealth, with Wealth aided by Output, it means abundant savings flowing unceasingly; if Pressure and Peer move together, Pressure wastes substance and brings official disaster, so calamity arises and wealth scatters, and nothing proves solid.

note.yi: 诀里「史兴鬼发」的「史」疑是「兄」（解里写「鬼同兄发」），译作「兄兴鬼发」。「津津不竭」是源源不断。「官灾」是官司、官府之灾。
note.en: The 'shi' of 'shi xing gui fa' in the verse is presumably 'xiong', Peer (the explanation writes 'Pressure and Peer move together'), and it is translated 'Peer flourishes and Pressure moves'. 'Jinjin bu jie' is flowing without end. 'Guanzai' is official disaster, a lawsuit or a calamity from the authorities.

yi: 子孙旺相、财爻分明，积蓄就多；
兄爻兴旺、官鬼发动，就染上灾祸是非。
en: If Output is thriving and Wealth is clear, there are many savings;
if Peer flourishes and Pressure moves, one is stained with calamity and wrangling.

zh: 子动生财，财因子助，乃积蓄丰余津津不竭。
鬼同兄发鬼耗官灾，乃灾生财散，件件不实耳。
yi: 子孙发动生财，财因子孙相助，就是积蓄丰余、源源不断。
官鬼和兄爻一起发动，官鬼耗损、招官灾，就是灾祸生起、钱财散去，件件都不踏实。
en: If Output moves to generate Wealth, with Wealth aided by Output, it means abundant savings flowing unceasingly.
If Pressure and Peer move together, Pressure wastes substance and brings official disaster, so calamity arises and wealth scatters, and nothing proves solid.

chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
title: 鬻身投主：鬼动并日辰伤世身受天殃、父兴同应位合财室遭主玷；卦中最忌者官鬼也，若发动又同日辰克世者须防不测之灾，若父爻并应爻合财者则主婢淫混

rule.yi: 官鬼发动、并同日辰一起伤克世爻、身爻，会遭天降的灾殃；父爻兴旺、与应位一起合财爻（妻室），会遭主人玷污。卦中最忌的是官鬼：如果它发动、又同日辰一起克世，须防不测的灾祸。财就是妻：如果父爻和应爻一起合财爻，就是主人和婢女淫乱混杂。
rule.en: If Pressure moves and, together with the Day, hurts the Self or the Body, one suffers a calamity sent by heaven; if Resource flourishes and, together with the Other's position, combines with Wealth, the wife line, one suffers dishonour from the master. What is most feared in the hexagram is Pressure: if it moves and, together with the Day, controls the Self, one must guard against an unforeseen disaster. Wealth is the wife: if the Resource line and the Other line together combine with Wealth, it means lewd mixing between the master and the maidservant.

note.yi: 「遭主玷」「主婢淫混」讲的是主人与家里妇女（财爻代表的妻室、婢女）之间的不端行为；书里只此一句，没有展开。官鬼在这一章是灾祸之象。「同日辰」是跟日辰一道。
note.en: 'Zao zhu dian' and 'zhu bi yin hun' speak of improper conduct between the master and the women of the household (the wife and maidservants whom the Wealth line stands for); the book says only this and does not go into it. Pressure in this chapter is the image of calamity. 'Tong richen' is together with the Day.

zh: 鬼动并日辰伤世身，受天殃。
父兴同应位合财室，遭主玷。
yi: 官鬼发动、并同日辰一起伤克世爻、身爻，会遭天降的灾殃；
父爻兴旺、与应位一起合财爻（妻室），会遭主人玷污。
en: If Pressure moves and, together with the Day, hurts the Self or the Body, one suffers a calamity sent by heaven;
if Resource flourishes and, together with the Other's position, combines with Wealth, the wife line, one suffers dishonour from the master.

zh: 若发动又同日辰克世者，须防不测之灾。
若父爻并应爻合财者，则主婢淫混。
yi: 卦中最忌的，是官鬼。
如果它发动、又同日辰一起克世，须防不测的灾祸。
财就是妻。
如果父爻和应爻一起合财爻，就是主人和婢女淫乱混杂。
en: What is most feared in the hexagram is Pressure.
If it moves and, together with the Day, controls the Self, one must guard against an unforeseen disaster.
Wealth is the wife.
If the Resource line and the Other line together combine with Wealth, it means lewd mixing between the master and the maidservant.

chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
title: 鬻身投主：多是多非盖为动爻临朱雀、常来常往皆因主象值游魂；朱雀主口舌若值动爻则终朝咭聒寝食不宁，游魂为游荡若卜此卦乃流荡忘返萍踪浪迹之徒；再推之卦之合冲方决始终之遐迩，之卦者变卦也细辨其中之冲合可断终身之吉凶

rule.yi: 多是多非，是因为动爻临朱雀；常来常往，是因为主人的象值游魂。朱雀主口舌，如果值动爻，就整天被吵闹、睡吃不安；游魂是游荡，如果卜得这个卦，就是流荡忘返、萍踪浪迹的人。再推之卦（变卦）的合冲，才能决断这件事从头到尾是远是近；「之卦」就是变卦，细细辨别其中的冲合，可以断一生的吉凶。
rule.en: Many quarrels and much wrangling are because a moving line sits on the Vermilion Bird; constant coming and going is because the master image falls on a Wandering Soul. The Vermilion Bird governs wrangling, and if it falls on a moving line one is clamoured at all day long and neither sleep nor food is in peace; the Wandering Soul is wandering, and if this hexagram is cast one is a drifter who wanders and forgets to return, like duckweed's trace and a wave's track. Then reckon the combination or clash in the changed hexagram, and only then decide how far or near it is from beginning to end; the 'zhi gua' is the changed hexagram, and by carefully distinguishing the clash and combination in it one can judge the good or ill of one's whole life.

note.yi: 「咭聒」是吵闹。「萍踪浪迹」是像浮萍、浪花一样没有定处。「之卦」是变卦（发动的爻变出来的卦）。「游魂」是八宫卦里每宫的第七卦（见术语表）。「主象值游魂」是应、父等代表主人的象落在游魂卦上，书里没有细说。「始终之遐迩」是从头到尾是远是近（时间的久暂）。这是鬻身投主一章的收尾。
note.en: 'Jigua' is clamour. 'Pingzong langji' is having no fixed place, like duckweed and the foam of the waves. 'Zhigua' is the changed hexagram (the hexagram that the moving lines turn into). 'Wandering Soul' is the seventh hexagram of each of the eight palaces (see the glossary). 'The master image falls on a Wandering Soul' is the images that stand for the master, such as the Other and Resource, falling on a Wandering Soul hexagram, and the book does not go into it. 'Shizhong zhi xia'er' is how far or near from beginning to end, meaning how long or short in time. This closes the chapter on selling oneself into service.

zh: 多是多非，盖为动爻临朱雀。
常来常往，皆因主象值游魂。
yi: 多是多非，是因为动爻临朱雀；
常来常往，都因为主人的象值游魂。
en: Many quarrels and much wrangling are because a moving line sits on the Vermilion Bird;
constant coming and going is because the master image falls on a Wandering Soul.

zh: 朱雀主口舌，若值动爻，则终朝咭聒寝食不宁。
游魂为游荡，若卜此卦，乃流荡忘返萍踪浪迹之徒耳。
yi: 朱雀主口舌，如果值动爻，就整天被吵闹，睡吃不安。
游魂是游荡，如果卜得这个卦，就是流荡忘返、萍踪浪迹的人。
en: The Vermilion Bird governs wrangling, and if it falls on a moving line one is clamoured at all day long and neither sleep nor food is in peace.
The Wandering Soul is wandering, and if this hexagram is cast one is a drifter who wanders and forgets to return, like duckweed's trace and a wave's track.

zh: 再推之卦之合冲，方决始终之遐迩。
yi: 再推之卦的合冲，才能决断这件事从头到尾是远是近。
en: Then reckon the combination or clash in the changed hexagram, and only then decide how far or near it is from beginning to end.

zh: 细辨其中之冲合，可断终身之吉凶耳。
yi: 「之卦」就是变卦。
细细辨别其中的冲合，就可以断一生的吉凶。
en: The 'zhi gua' is the changed hexagram.
By carefully distinguishing the clash and combination in it one can judge the good or ill of one's whole life.

chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
title: 投充兵卒总纲：以世身为主、财福为凭；投兵须把世爻详，逢旺逢生去必昌，若遇旬空无对敌，如逢月破丧他乡；凡占投充兵者世以为用，得日辰生世或世旺相则功成利厚力加体康，若值旬空则无人对敌，若逢月破则大有刑伤大不吉利

rule.yi: 投军当兵，以世爻、身爻为主，以财爻、子孙（福）为凭据。投兵必须细看世爻：逢旺、逢生，去了必定兴旺；如果遇到旬空，就没有对手可打；如果逢月破，就死在他乡。凡是占投充当兵的，以世爻为用，只要得到日辰生世、或者世旺相，就功成利厚、力量增加、身体康健；如果值旬空，就没有人对敌；如果逢月破，就大有刑伤，非常不吉利。
rule.en: In enlisting as a soldier, take the Self and the Body as the chief and Wealth and Output as the ground. In joining the army one must examine the Self line in detail: if it meets thriving or generation, going will surely bring prosperity; if it meets the ten-day Void, there is no enemy to face; if it meets Month-break, one dies in a foreign land. In every divination about enlisting as a soldier, the Self is the Subject: if the Day generates the Self or the Self is thriving, one's service is accomplished, the profit is great, one's strength increases and one's body is hale; if it falls on the ten-day Void there is no one to oppose; if it meets Month-break there is much punishment and injury and it is greatly inauspicious.

note.yi: 「投充」是应募、投身，「投充兵」就是投军当兵。「世身」是世爻和卦身。「德旬空」的「德」疑是「值」，译作「值旬空」。「旬空无对敌」是没有对手可以交战，书里没有说这是好是坏，这里只照字面译。「丧他乡」是死在外乡。这是书中事业各章的最后一章。
note.en: 'Touchong' is volunteering and committing oneself, and 'touchong bing' is joining the army as a soldier. 'Shishen' is the Self line and the Body of the hexagram. The 'de' of 'de xunkong' is presumably 'zhi', to fall on, and it is translated 'falls on the ten-day Void'. 'Xunkong wu duidi' is having no opponent to fight; the book does not say whether this is good or bad and it is translated literally. 'Sang taxiang' is dying in a foreign land. This is the last of the book's chapters on a career.

yi: 以世爻、身爻为主要看的，以财爻、子孙（福）为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Body as the chief to be looked at, and Wealth and Output as the ground.

zh: 投兵须把世爻详，逢旺逢生去必昌，
若遇旬空无对敌，如逢月破丧他乡。
yi: 投军必须细看世爻：逢旺、逢生，去了必定兴旺；
如果遇到旬空，就没有对手可打；如果逢月破，就死在他乡。
en: In joining the army one must examine the Self line in detail: if it meets thriving or generation, going will surely bring prosperity;
if it meets the ten-day Void, there is no enemy to face; if it meets Month-break, one dies in a foreign land.

zh: 凡占投充兵者，世以为用，但得日辰生世或世旺相，则功成利厚力加体康，若德旬空，则无人对敌。
若逢月破，则大有刑伤，大不吉利。
yi: 凡是占投充当兵的，以世爻为用，只要得到日辰生世、或者世旺相，就功成利厚、力量增加、身体康健；如果值旬空，就没有人对敌。
如果逢月破，就大有刑伤，非常不吉利。
en: In every divination about enlisting as a soldier, the Self is the Subject: if the Day generates the Self or the Self is thriving, one's service is accomplished, the profit is great, one's strength increases and one's body is hale; if it falls on the ten-day Void there is no one to oppose.
If it meets Month-break there is much punishment and injury and it is greatly inauspicious.

chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
title: 投充兵卒：随官入墓身遭厄、助鬼伤身命受殃；随军出战所忌者官也，临世临身临命而入墓者名曰随鬼入墓必有丧亡之凶难，鬼宜安静若逢财动能助鬼兴又伤身世者名曰助鬼伤身决主身陷命倾难归乡井

rule.yi: 世爻随着官爻入墓，身遭厄难；助官鬼伤身，性命受殃。随军出战，所忌的是官爻。如果官爻临在世爻、身爻、命爻上而入墓，叫做随鬼入墓，必定有丧亡的凶难；官鬼适宜安静，如果遇到财爻发动、能帮助官鬼兴旺，又伤克身爻、世爻，叫做助鬼伤身，一定主身陷险地、性命倾覆，难以回到家乡。
rule.en: If the Self follows the star of office into the tomb, one's person meets disaster; if one helps Pressure to injure the Body, one's life suffers calamity. In going out to battle with the army, what is feared is the star of office. If it rests on the Self, the Body or the fate line and enters the tomb, it is called following Pressure into the tomb, and there will surely be the misfortune of death; Pressure is best quiet, and if Wealth moves and can help Pressure to flourish, and also injures the Body or the Self, it is called helping Pressure to injure the Body, and it surely means that one's person falls into danger, one's life is overturned, and it is hard to return to one's native village.

note.yi: 「随官入墓」「助鬼伤身」增删卜易对它们另有说法（ZS.06）：古人当作凶，作者说世旺的反而升官；那是问升选，这里是随军出战，问的事不同，取法也不同，这里一律以官鬼为大忌。「临命」的「命」按文意是本命。「乡井」是家乡。
note.en: 'Following the star of office into the tomb' and 'helping Pressure to injure the Body' have another account in the Zengshan Buyi (ZS.06): the ancients took them as ominous, and the author said that a thriving Self on the contrary rises; that was asking about promotion and selection, while here it is going out to battle with the army, so the matter asked differs and so does the method, and here Pressure is throughout the great taboo. The 'fate' of 'lin ming' is by the sense the native fate. 'Xiangjing' is one's native place.

zh: 随官入墓身遭厄，助鬼伤身命受殃。
yi: 世爻随着官爻入墓，身遭厄难；助官鬼伤身，性命受殃。
en: If the Self follows the star of office into the tomb, one's person meets disaster; if one helps Pressure to injure the Body, one's life suffers calamity.

zh: 若临世临身临命而入墓者，名曰随鬼入墓，必有丧亡之凶难。
鬼宜安静，若逢财动能助鬼兴，又伤身世者，名曰助鬼伤身，决主身陷命倾，难归乡井。
yi: 随军出战，所忌的是官爻。
如果官爻临在世爻、身爻、命爻上而入墓，叫做随鬼入墓，必定有丧亡的凶难。
官鬼适宜安静；如果遇到财爻发动、能帮助官鬼兴旺，又伤克身爻、世爻，叫做助鬼伤身，一定主身陷险地、性命倾覆，难以回到家乡。
en: In going out to battle with the army, what is feared is the star of office.
If it rests on the Self, the Body or the fate line and enters the tomb, it is called following Pressure into the tomb, and there will surely be the misfortune of death.

Pressure is best quiet, and if Wealth moves and can help Pressure to flourish, and also injures the Body or the Self, it is called helping Pressure to injure the Body, and it surely means that one's person falls into danger, one's life is overturned, and it is hard to return to one's native village.

chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
title: 投充兵卒：官鬼若还冲克世不如不去反为良；军旅之忌惟以官鬼，若来冲世不过被彼克伐未决输赢，若来克世大有刑伤乃未沾利禄先遭戕戮，不如安分且守故乡

rule.yi: 官鬼如果冲克世爻，不如不去，反而是好。军旅的忌讳，只在官鬼：它来冲世，不过是被对方克伐，还没有决出输赢；它如果来克世，大有刑伤，就是还没有沾到利禄，就先遭杀戮；不如安守本分，暂且守着故乡。
rule.en: If Pressure clashes with or controls the Self, it is better not to go, which is on the contrary good. The taboo of the army is nothing but Pressure: if it comes to clash with the Self, one is merely attacked by the other side and victory or defeat is not yet decided; if it comes to control the Self, there is much punishment and injury, and before one has shared in any pay or rank one is struck down; it is better to keep to one's lot and hold one's native place for now.

note.yi: 诀里「曾如不去反为良」的「曾如」按文意是「不如」，译作「不如不去」。「选遭戕戮」的「选」疑是「先」，译作「先遭杀戮」。这一条与前面一条（EL.125）取同一个关系：官鬼是随军出战的大忌。
note.en: The 'zeng ru' of 'zeng ru bu qu fan wei liang' in the verse is by the sense 'bu ru', better not, and it is translated 'it is better not to go'. The 'xuan' of 'xuan zao qianglu' is presumably 'xian', first, and it is translated 'before one has shared in any pay or rank one is struck down'. This entry takes the same relation as the previous one (EL.125): Pressure is the great taboo of going out to battle with the army.

zh: 官鬼若还冲克世，曾如不去反为良。
yi: 官鬼如果冲克世爻，不如不去，反而是好。
en: If Pressure clashes with or controls the Self, it is better not to go, which is on the contrary good.

zh: 军旅之忌，惟以官鬼，若来冲世，不过被彼克伐，未决输赢。
若来克世，大有刑伤，乃未沾利禄，选遭戕戮。
yi: 军旅的忌讳，只在官鬼；它来冲世，不过是被对方克伐，还没有决出输赢。
它如果来克世，大有刑伤，就是还没有沾到利禄，就先遭杀戮。
不如安守本分，暂且守着故乡。
en: The taboo of the army is nothing but Pressure: if it comes to clash with the Self, one is merely attacked by the other side and victory or defeat is not yet decided.
If it comes to control the Self, there is much punishment and injury, and before one has shared in any pay or rank one is struck down.
It is better to keep to one's lot and hold one's native place for now.

chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
title: 投充兵卒：土官克世遭坑陷、金鬼冲身刀箭伤、水鬼定然逢波险、火官必主犯红光、木爻值鬼多刑责，福德交重最吉祥；克世之官大凶之象须分五属可以拒避，子孙为和解之神须得一发则万祸自消

rule.yi: 土属的官克世，遭坑陷；金属的官鬼冲身，被刀箭所伤；水属的官鬼，一定遇到风波险阻；火属的官，必主触犯火光；木爻值官鬼，多有刑责；福德（子孙）发动，最吉祥。克世的官是大凶之象，必须分它属于五行中的哪一类，才可以躲避：官鬼属土，要防对方挖陷坑，又要防疾病；金属的官鬼，忌讳锋利的刀箭，也防跌扑；水属的官鬼，必然设下背水的计谋，又被风波险阻；火属的官鬼，只要逃火患，又要顾虑营屯被烧的劫难；木属的官鬼，会有鞭打杖责之刑。子孙是和解之神，只要发动一次，万般祸患自然消散。
rule.en: If an Earth star of office controls the Self, one falls into a pit-trap; if a Metal Pressure clashes with the Body, one is hurt by knife and arrow; if a Water Pressure, one will surely meet the danger of waves; if a Fire star of office, one will surely run into the red glare; if a Wood line holds Pressure, there are many beatings and punishments; Output, the fortune virtue, moving is most auspicious. The star of office that controls the Self is an image of great ill, and one must tell which of the five kinds it belongs to in order to ward it off: if Pressure is of Earth, guard against the other side digging a trap-pit for one to fall into, and against illness; a Metal Pressure fears sharp blades and arrows, and one must guard against falls; a Water Pressure surely sets a back-to-the-river stratagem, and one is also blocked by wind and waves; with a Fire Pressure one need only flee the danger of fire and also fear the calamity of the camp being burned; a Wood Pressure brings the punishment of whip and cane. Output is the spirit of reconciliation, and if it moves even once, ten thousand calamities melt away of themselves.

note.yi: 「五属」是官鬼所属的五行。「坑陷」是陷阱。「红光」是火光，指火灾。「背水之略」是背水结阵、没有退路的战法，用的是韩信背水一战的典故。「烧屯」是烧营寨、屯粮之所。「鞭朴」是鞭打杖责。这一条与易隐征战占「五行」一组（YY.63 起：木为舟楫、火营寨、土炮石、金刀刃、水水泉）取同一类五行取象，但这里是按官鬼所属的五行看灾：土陷坑、金刀箭、水波险、火火患、木鞭朴。「和解之神」是能化解凶的神，即子孙（福神）。
note.en: 'Five kinds' are the five elements to which Pressure belongs. 'Kengxian' is a pit-trap. 'Hongguang' is the red glare, meaning fire. 'Beishui zhi lüe' is the stratagem of drawing up with the back to the water with no way to retreat, and alludes to Han Xin's battle with his back to the river. 'Shaotun' is burning the camp and the place where grain is stored. 'Bianpu' is the whip and cane. This entry takes the same kind of five-element images as the 'five elements' group of the Yi Yin war divination (from YY.63: Wood is boats, Fire is the camp, Earth is catapult stones, Metal is blades, Water is water and springs), but here the disaster is read by the element of Pressure: Earth the pit, Metal blade and arrow, Water the danger of waves, Fire the fire, Wood the whip and cane. 'The spirit of reconciliation' is the spirit that can dissolve ill, that is Output (the fortune spirit).

zh: 土官克世遭坑陷，金鬼冲身刀箭伤，
水鬼定然逢波险，火官必主犯红光，
木爻值鬼多刑责，福德交重最吉祥。
yi: 土属的官克世，遭坑陷；金属的官鬼冲身，被刀箭所伤；
水属的官鬼，一定遇到风波险阻；火属的官，必主触犯火光；
木爻值官鬼，多有刑责；福德发动，最吉祥。
en: If an Earth star of office controls the Self, one falls into a pit-trap; if a Metal Pressure clashes with the Body, one is hurt by knife and arrow;
if a Water Pressure, one will surely meet the danger of waves; if a Fire star of office, one will surely run into the red glare;
if a Wood line holds Pressure, there are many beatings and punishments; Output, the fortune virtue, moving is most auspicious.

zh: 克世之官，大凶之象，须分五属可以拒避，如鬼属土，防彼掘陷坑入，又防疾病。
金鬼忌伊利锋刀箭，及防跌蹼。
水鬼必设背水之略，又被风波险阻。
火鬼唯逃火患，又虑烧屯之劫。
子孙为和解之神，须得一发，则万祸自消矣！
yi: 克世的官是大凶之象，必须分它属于五行中的哪一类，才可以躲避：官鬼属土，要防对方挖陷坑，又要防疾病。
金属的官鬼，忌讳锋利的刀箭，也要防跌扑。
水属的官鬼，必然设下背水的计谋，又被风波险阻。
火属的官鬼，只要逃火患，又要顾虑营屯被烧的劫难。
木属的官鬼，会有鞭打杖责之刑。
子孙是和解之神，只要发动一次，万般祸患自然消散！
en: The star of office that controls the Self is an image of great ill, and one must tell which of the five kinds it belongs to in order to ward it off: if Pressure is of Earth, guard against the other side digging a trap-pit for one to fall into, and against illness.
A Metal Pressure fears sharp blades and arrows, and one must guard against falls.
A Water Pressure surely sets a back-to-the-river stratagem, and one is also blocked by wind and waves.
With a Fire Pressure one need only flee the danger of fire and also fear the calamity of the camp being burned.
A Wood Pressure brings the punishment of whip and cane.
Output is the spirit of reconciliation, and if it moves even once, ten thousand calamities melt away of themselves!

chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
title: 投充兵卒：世去克他宜出战、应来克我莫登场；世为我应为彼，若世克应爻则战必胜彼，应若克世彼必多能

rule.yi: 世爻去克对方，适宜出战；应爻来克我，不要登场。世爻是我，应爻是对方：如果世克应爻，打仗必定胜过对方；应如果克世，对方一定很有本事。
rule.en: If the Self goes to control the other, it is fitting to go out and fight; if the Other comes to control me, do not enter the field. The Self is me and the Other is the enemy: if the Self controls the Other line, one will surely beat the other in battle; if the Other controls the Self, he is surely very able.

note.yi: 这一条和前面的「官鬼是随军出战的大忌」是两层：官鬼看自己会不会遭难，世应看这一仗能不能胜。与出师征伐章（EL.12 起）、易隐征战占「世克应可战、应克世宜守防贼」（YY.54）和本书前面「世克应则大胜，应克世则难赢」（EL.64）取同一个关系。
note.en: This entry and the earlier 'Pressure is the great taboo of going out to battle' are two layers: Pressure shows whether one will meet disaster, and the Self and the Other show whether this battle can be won. It takes the same relation as the chapter on sending out troops (from EL.12), 'if the Self controls the Other one can fight, if the Other controls the Self defend and guard against bandits' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.54), and 'if the Self controls the Other it is a great victory, if the Other controls the Self it is hard to win' earlier in this book (EL.64).

zh: 世去克他宜出战，应来克我莫登场。
yi: 世爻去克对方，适宜出战；应爻来克我，不要登场。
en: If the Self goes to control the other, it is fitting to go out and fight; if the Other comes to control me, do not enter the field.

zh: 世为我，应为彼，若世克应爻，则战必胜彼。
yi: 世爻是我，应爻是对方；如果世克应爻，就一定战胜对方。
应爻如果克世，对方一定很有本事。
en: The Self is me and the Other is the enemy: if the Self controls the Other line, one will surely beat the other in battle.
If the Other controls the Self, he is surely very able.

chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
title: 投充兵卒：财旺饷资加倍得、兄兴诚恐灭兵粮；财乃口粮旺相则丰余休囚则不敷，兄为耗祟安静则可发动则有扣除之患

rule.yi: 财旺相，饷银资助成倍得到；兄爻兴旺，实在怕兵粮被灭掉。财是口粮，旺相就丰足有余，休囚就不够；兄是耗损的祸祟，安静就可以，发动就有被克扣的忧患。
rule.en: If Wealth is thriving, pay and supplies are gained doubled; if Peer flourishes, one truly fears the soldier's rations being wiped out.
