Wealth is the ration, which when thriving is abundant and when resting or imprisoned is not enough; Peer is the baleful drain, and if quiet it is tolerable, and if it moves there is the trouble of deductions.

note.yi: 「饷」是军饷，「口粮」是口粮、兵粮。「耗祟」是耗损钱粮的祸祟。「扣除」是克扣。这一条与易隐征战占「财旺相粮草丰足……内兄动克财」（YY.59）、黄金策征战「财为粮草之本根，兄乃伏兵之形势」（HJC.88）取同一类象：财是粮饷，兄劫财。
note.en: 'Xiang' is military pay, and 'kouliang' is rations and soldiers' grain. 'Haosui' is the baleful drain that wastes money and grain. 'Kouchu' is deducting and skimming. This entry takes the same kind of image as 'Wealth thriving, provisions are abundant ... the inner Peer moves to control Wealth' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.59) and 'Wealth is the root of provisions and Peer is the shape of an ambush' in the Huangjin Ce on campaigns (HJC.88): Wealth is pay and grain, and Peer robs Wealth.

zh: 财旺饷资加倍得，兄兴诚恐灭兵粮。
yi: 财旺相，饷银资助成倍得到；兄爻兴旺，实在怕兵粮被灭掉。
en: If Wealth is thriving, pay and supplies are gained doubled; if Peer flourishes, one truly fears the soldier's rations being wiped out.

zh: 财乃口粮，旺相则丰余，休囚则不敷，兄为耗祟，安静则可。
yi: 财是口粮，旺相就丰足有余，休囚就不够；兄是耗损的祸祟，安静就可以。
发动，就有被克扣的忧患。
en: Wealth is the ration, which when thriving is abundant and when resting or imprisoned is not enough; Peer is the baleful drain, and if quiet it is tolerable.
If it moves, there is the trouble of deductions.

chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
title: 投充兵卒：官爻持世无冲克必作先锋佐帝皇；官爻最宜持世又宜安静旺相则有奇能美爵，若值冲克必有奸佞窃夺功权之祸

rule.yi: 官爻持世、没有冲克，必定做先锋，辅佐帝王。官爻最适宜持世，又适宜安静旺相，这样就有奇特的才能和美好的爵位；如果遇到冲克，必有奸佞之人窃夺功劳权柄的祸患。
rule.en: If the Pressure line holds the Self with no clash or control, one will surely be a vanguard and assist the sovereign. The Pressure line is best holding the Self, and also best quiet and thriving, and then one has rare ability and a fine rank; if it meets clash or control, there will surely be the misfortune of treacherous men stealing one's merit and power.

note.yi: 这一条说官爻持世是吉：投军这件事里，官鬼既是随军出战的大忌（EL.125、EL.126），又是持世作先锋、有爵位的吉象。两处不冲突：忌的是官鬼冲克世、随官入墓、助鬼伤身，喜的是官爻持世、安静旺相、不受冲克。这是投充兵卒一章的收尾。
note.en: This entry says that the Pressure line holding the Self is auspicious: in joining the army, Pressure is both the great taboo of going out to battle (EL.125, EL.126) and the auspicious image of holding the Self as a vanguard and winning rank. The two do not clash: what is feared is Pressure clashing with or controlling the Self, following the star of office into the tomb, and helping Pressure to injure the Body; what is welcomed is the Pressure line holding the Self, quiet and thriving, and not clashed or controlled. This closes the chapter on enlisting as a soldier.

zh: 官爻持世无冲克，必作先锋佐帝皇。
yi: 官爻持世、没有冲克，必定做先锋，辅佐帝王。
en: If the Pressure line holds the Self with no clash or control, one will surely be a vanguard and assist the sovereign.

zh: 官爻最宜持世，又宜安静旺相，则有奇能美爵。
若值冲克，必有奸佞窃夺功权之祸。
yi: 官爻最适宜持世，又适宜安静旺相，就有奇特的才能和美好的爵位。
如果遇到冲克，必有奸佞窃夺功劳权柄的祸患。
en: The Pressure line is best holding the Self, and also best quiet and thriving, and then one has rare ability and a fine rank.
If it meets clash or control, there will surely be the misfortune of treacherous men stealing one's merit and power.

title: 用人藏否：以用爻为主、应象为凭；凡用他人应上寻、家亲各有用爻分，日冲月破空亡者临在斯爻永不亨；用人行事、请人代劳、招人作生涯、托付图利，用外人以应爻为主，占亲戚以用象为凭；用爻遇日辰冲月建破或落旬空皆主不成纵成无力又不久远切莫用之

rule.yi: 用人，以用爻为主，以应象为凭据。凡是用别人，就在应爻上找；亲属各有各的用爻划分；日冲、月破、空亡落在这个爻上，就永远不亨通。凡是用人办事，或者请人代自己劳作，或者招人做生意，或者托付别人图利益，如果用的是外人，以应爻为主；如果是亲戚，以用象为凭据。用爻如果遇到日辰冲、月建破，或者落旬空，都主不成；即使成了，也没有力量，又不长久，千万不要用这个人。
rule.en: In employing a man, take the Subject line as the chief and the Other image as the ground. In employing an outsider, look to the Other; for one's own kin, each has a Subject line to itself; if the Day's clash, Month-break or Void sits on this line, it never prospers. Whenever one employs a man to act, or asks a man to labour in one's place, or takes on a man for a business, or entrusts something to another for gain, if one employs an outsider the Other line is the chief; if it is a relative, the Subject image is the ground. If the Subject line meets the Day's clash, the Month's break, or falls on the ten-day Void, in every case it does not succeed, and even if it succeeds it has no strength and does not last, so by no means employ him.

note.yi: 「用人」是雇用、托付别人办事。「藏否」就是「臧否」，好坏。「家亲各有用爻分」是用亲属时按六亲各取那一爻。「斯爻」是这一爻。这一章看的是被用的这个人：外人取应爻，亲属取他那个六亲的爻。
note.en: 'Yong ren' is employing and entrusting a man with an affair. 'Zangpi' is written 'cang fou' and means good and bad. 'Jiaqin ge you yongyao fen' is that in employing a relative, each of the six kin takes its own line. 'Siyao' is this line. This chapter looks at the man who is employed: for an outsider, the Other line; for a relative, the line of his own kin.

yi: 以用爻为主要看的，以应象为凭据。
en: Take the Subject line as the chief to be looked at, and the Other image as the ground.

zh: 凡用他人应上寻，家亲各有用爻分，
日冲月破空亡者，临在斯爻永不亨。
yi: 凡是用别人，就在应爻上找；亲属各有各的用爻划分；
日冲、月破、空亡落在这个爻上，就永远不亨通。
en: In employing an outsider, look to the Other; for one's own kin, each has a Subject line to itself;
if the Day's clash, Month-break or Void sits on this line, it never prospers.

zh: 凡若用人行事、或请人代己之劳、或招人而作生涯、或托付而图利益，如用他人，以应爻为主。
用爻若遇日辰冲、月建破、或落旬空者，皆主不成，纵成无力又不久远，切莫用之。
yi: 凡是用人办事，或者请人代自己劳作，或者招人做生意，或者托付别人图利益，如果用的是外人，以应爻为主。
如果是占亲戚，就以用象为凭据。
用爻如果遇到日辰冲、月建破，或者落旬空，都主不成；即使成了，也没有力量，又不长久，千万不要用这个人。
en: Whenever one employs a man to act, or asks a man to labour in one's place, or takes on a man for a business, or entrusts something to another for gain, if one employs an outsider the Other line is the chief.
If it is about a relative, the Subject image is the ground.

If the Subject line meets the Day's clash, the Month's break, or falls on the ten-day Void, in every case it does not succeed, and even if it succeeds it has no strength and does not last, so by no means employ him.

title: 用人藏否：用遇绝乡终不美、世遭用克却无情、六冲反目非宾主、用变刑伤力必轻；用爻临绝又无生助者此人定主无能，用来克世者实怀欺主之心彼非仗义之人，卜六冲之卦终成反目，用爻虽有气而变克制之乡或墓绝人必先勤后惰事当有始无终

rule.yi: 用爻遇到绝乡，终究不好；世爻被用爻所克，却是无情；六冲就反目、不成宾主；用爻变出刑伤，力量一定轻。用爻临绝又没有生扶，这个人一定没有能耐；用爻来克世，实在怀着欺骗主人的心，他不是仗义的人；卜得六冲的卦，终究反目，怎么能和谐？卦上用爻虽然有气，但变成克制它的地方、或者变入墓、绝，这个人必定先勤后惰，事情当是有始无终。
rule.en: If the Subject meets a place of extinction it is in the end not good; if the Self is controlled by the Subject, it is without feeling; with a six-clash they fall out and are not host and guest; if the Subject changes into punishment and injury, its strength is surely slight. If the Subject line is in extinction and has no generation or support, the man is surely incapable; if the Subject comes to control the Self, he truly harbours a mind to cheat his master and is not a man of loyalty and justice; if a six-clash hexagram is cast, they end by falling out, and how can there be harmony? Even if the Subject line in the hexagram has qi, if it changes into a place that controls it or into tomb or extinction, the man will surely be diligent at first and idle later, and the affair will have a beginning but no end.

note.yi: 「绝乡」是绝地。「世遭用克却无情」是世爻被用爻所克。「仗义之人」是讲义气、可靠的人。「之墓绝」的「之」是变入。这一条与前一条（EL.131）合起来，是用人的两面：用爻不被冲破空绝是可用，用爻临绝、克世、六冲、变克都是不可用。
note.en: 'Juexiang' is a place of extinction. 'Shi zao yong ke que wuqing' is the Self line controlled by the Subject line. 'Zhangyi zhi ren' is a man of loyalty and justice, one who can be relied on. The 'zhi' of 'zhi mu jue' is changing into. This entry and the previous one (EL.131) together are the two sides of employing a man: a Subject line that is not clashed, broken, Void or extinct can be employed, while a Subject line in extinction, controlling the Self, in a six-clash or changing into control cannot.

zh: 用遇绝乡终不美，世遭用克却无情，
六冲反目非宾主，用变刑伤力必轻。
yi: 用爻遇到绝乡，终究不好；世爻被用爻所克，却是无情；
六冲就反目、不成宾主；用爻变出刑伤，力量一定轻。
en: If the Subject meets a place of extinction it is in the end not good; if the Self is controlled by the Subject, it is without feeling;
with a six-clash they fall out and are not host and guest; if the Subject changes into punishment and injury, its strength is surely slight.

zh: 倘若用爻临绝又无生助者，此人定主无能。
用来克世者，实怀欺主之心，彼非仗义之人。
若卜六冲之卦，终成反目，岂得和谐？
卦上用爻虽然有气，变成克制之乡或之墓绝，人必先勤后惰，事当有始无终。
yi: 如果用爻临绝、又没有生助，这个人一定没有能耐。
用爻来克世，实在怀着欺骗主人的心，他不是仗义的人。
如果卜得六冲的卦，终究反目，怎么能和谐？
卦上用爻虽然有气，但变成克制它的地方、或者变入墓、绝，这个人必定先勤后惰，事情当是有始无终。
en: If the Subject line is in extinction and has no generation or support, the man is surely incapable.
If the Subject comes to control the Self, he truly harbours a mind to cheat his master and is not a man of loyalty and justice.
If a six-clash hexagram is cast, they end by falling out, and how can there be harmony?

Even if the Subject line in the hexagram has qi, if it changes into a place that controls it or into tomb or extinction, the man will surely be diligent at first and idle later, and the affair will have a beginning but no end.

title: 用人藏否：以上七般发不犯方言和悦又多能，若还世得他扶助必受渠恩事有成；应爻并用爻不遇日冲月破空亡死绝又不克世又不变出冲伤、本卦之卦皆非六冲，便曰宾主相投用之有力，用爻若来生世合世者赖以维持周旋吾事

rule.yi: 以上七样都不犯，才可说他和悦又多能；如果世爻又得他的扶助，必定受他的恩，事情成功。应爻和用爻，不遇日冲、月破、空亡、死绝，又不克世，又不变出冲伤，本卦和之卦都不是六冲，就叫做宾主相投，用他有力；用爻如果来生世、合世，就靠他维持，替我周旋办事。
rule.en: If none of these seven things is violated, one may say he is amiable and very capable; if the Self also gets his support, one will surely receive his kindness and the affair will succeed. If the Other line and the Subject line do not meet the Day's clash, Month-break, Void, death or extinction, and do not control the Self, and do not change out a clash or injury, and neither the original nor the changed hexagram is a six-clash, it is called host and guest in accord, and the man is strong to employ; if the Subject line comes to generate or combine with the Self, one relies on him to hold things up and he manages my affairs for me.

note.yi: 「七般」按解里列出的是：日冲、月破、空亡、死绝、克世、变出冲伤、六冲。「本卦兴之卦」疑是「本卦与之卦」，「赖以难持」疑是「赖以维持」，按文意译。「周旋」是替我张罗办事。「宾主」在这里是用人的人和被用的人。
note.en: The 'seven things' are, by what the explanation lists: the Day's clash, Month-break, Void, death or extinction, controlling the Self, changing out a clash or injury, and a six-clash. The 'xing' of 'ben gua xing zhi gua' is presumably 'yu', and 'ben gua yu zhi gua' is 'the original hexagram and the changed hexagram'; 'lai yi nan chi' is presumably 'lai yi weichi', relying on him to hold up; they are translated by the sense. 'Zhouxuan' is bustling about on my behalf. 'Host and guest' here are the man who employs and the man who is employed.

zh: 以上七般发不犯，方言和悦又多能，
若还世得他扶助，必受渠恩事有成。
yi: 以上七样都不犯，才可说他和悦又多能；
如果世爻又得他的扶助，必定受他的恩，事情成功。
en: If none of these seven things is violated, one may say he is amiable and very capable;
if the Self also gets his support, one will surely receive his kindness and the affair will succeed.

zh: 应爻并用爻，不遇日冲、月破、空亡、死绝、又不克世、又不变出冲伤，本卦兴之卦皆非六冲便曰宾主相投，用之有力。
用爻若来生世合世者，赖以难持，周旋吾事。
yi: 应爻和用爻，不遇日冲、月破、空亡、死绝，又不克世，又不变出冲伤，本卦和之卦都不是六冲，就叫做宾主相投，用他有力。
用爻如果来生世、合世，就靠他维持，替我周旋办事。
en: If the Other line and the Subject line do not meet the Day's clash, Month-break, Void, death or extinction, and do not control the Self, and do not change out a clash or injury, and neither the original nor the changed hexagram is a six-clash, it is called host and guest in accord, and the man is strong to employ.
If the Subject line comes to generate or combine with the Self, one relies on him to hold things up and he manages my affairs for me.

title: 仗托人力总纲：以应爻为主、不遇绝空冲破为佳；佥解京差包完粮税、代出公庭、央邻里之谋为、浼亲朋之所作，事赖他成，前列人之事情皆附卦之应象；粮从产出差徭之重、山长水远人怯丁单，不无亲属之托须情故旧之央，诸般仗托皆看应爻

rule.yi: 要仗托别人出力，以应爻为主，以应爻不遇绝、空、冲、破为好。被派解送钱粮到京的差使，常有人包办完纳粮税；在县里当差，常有人替自己出公庭；或者央求邻里替自己谋划，或者请亲朋替自己做事，承受他们的庇佑，事情靠他们办成。前面列出的这些人的事情，都附在卦的应象上。粮从产业出，好像有差徭的重担；产业卖了、粮税还在，更多力役的征调；或者山长水远路途遥远，或者人胆小、丁口单薄，不能没有亲属的托付，必须央求旧交的情面；事情有万般祸患，要靠卦来一决；一切仗托别人的事，都看应爻。
rule.en: In relying on other people's strength, take the Other line as the chief and it is best if it meets no extinction, Void, clash or break. When one is assigned a commission to convey grain and money to the capital, there is often someone who contracts to complete the grain and taxes; when one is on duty in the county, there is often someone who goes to the public court in one's place; or one asks the neighbours to scheme on one's behalf, or begs relatives and friends to act in one's place, receiving their protection, so that the matter is accomplished through them. The affairs of the people listed above are all attached to the Other image of the hexagram. The grain comes out of the property and there seems to be the weight of service and corvée; if the property has gone but the grain tax remains, there are still more levies of labour; or the mountains are long and the waters far, a distant journey, or the man is timid and the adults of the household few and weak; one cannot but entrust the matter to relatives and must entreat old friends for their kindness; the matter has ten thousand troubles and the hexagram must settle it; in all kinds of relying on others, look at the Other line.

note.yi: 「佥解京差」是被佥派去押解钱粮到京师的差使（解户之役，见前面户役一条）；「包完」是包办完成；「代出公庭」是替人到官府去应役。「粮从产出似有差徭之重，产去粮存尚多力役之征」讲的是田产已卖、粮税还留在名下，所以差徭反而更重。「仗枉」疑是「仗托」。「情故旧之央」的「情」是情面。「审」（「每有包完粮税审」）字义不顺，书里就是这个字，这里不译。这一章问的是靠别人出力办差役、办事，所以看应爻；和前面户役、帮户各章（EL.109 起）是同一类差役。
note.en: 'Qian jie jing chai' is the commission, to which one is assigned, of conveying money and grain to the capital (the service of a conveyor household, see the earlier entry on household service); 'baowan' is contracting to complete; 'dai chu gongting' is going to the authorities' court to serve in another's place. 'Grain comes out of the property and there seems to be the weight of service; if the property has gone but the grain tax remains, there are still more levies of labour' speaks of land that has been sold while the grain tax stays in the seller's name, so that the service is on the contrary heavier. 'Zhang wang' is presumably 'zhang tuo', relying on and entrusting. The 'qing' of 'qing gujiu zhi yang' is feeling and favour. The character 'shen' in 'mei you baowan liangshui shen' does not make sense and is exactly what the book has; it is not translated here. This chapter asks about relying on others' strength for service and for affairs, so the Other line is looked at; it is the same kind of service as the earlier chapters on household service and on sharing a household's burden (from EL.109).

zh: 以应爻为主，不遇绝空冲破为佳。
yi: 以应爻为主要看的，不遇绝、空、冲、破为好。
en: Take the Other line as the chief to be looked at, and it is best if it meets no extinction, Void, clash or break.

zh: 佥解京差，每有包完粮税审，当县役常多代出公庭，或央邻里之谋为，或浼亲朋之所作身，叨彼佑，事赖他成。
前列人之事情，皆附卦之应象。
yi: 被派解送钱粮到京的差使，常有人包办完纳粮税；在县里当差，常有人替自己出公庭；或者央求邻里替自己谋划，或者请亲朋替自己做事，承受他们的庇佑，事情靠他们办成。
前面列出的这些人的事情，都附在卦的应象上。
en: When one is assigned a commission to convey grain and money to the capital, there is often someone who contracts to complete the grain and taxes; when one is on duty in the county, there is often someone who goes to the public court in one's place; or one asks the neighbours to scheme on one's behalf, or begs relatives and friends to act in one's place, receiving their protection, so that the matter is accomplished through them.
The affairs of the people listed above are all attached to the Other image of the hexagram.

zh: 粮从产出似有差徭之重，产去粮存尚多力役之征，或山长水远之迢遥，或人怯丁单之薄弱，不无亲属之托，须情故旧之央，事有万殃，卦须一决，诸般仗枉，皆看应爻。
yi: 粮从产业出，好像有差徭的重担；产业卖了、粮税还在，更多力役的征调；或者山长水远路途遥远，或者人胆小、丁口单薄，不能没有亲属的托付，必须央求旧交的情面；事情有万般祸患，要靠卦来一决；一切仗托别人的事，都看应爻。
en: The grain comes out of the property and there seems to be the weight of service and corvée; if the property has gone but the grain tax remains, there are still more levies of labour; or the mountains are long and the waters far, a distant journey, or the man is timid and the adults of the household few and weak; one cannot but entrust the matter to relatives and must entreat old friends for their kindness; the matter has ten thousand troubles and the hexagram must settle it; in all kinds of relying on others, look at the Other line.

title: 仗托人力：应动应冲此客有更有变、应空应破其人无力无能，最嫌世受应伤更忌内遭外克；应值交重或逢冲动仗彼终须改变，应值旬空或临月破托人决不始终，若应克世或外伤内卦皆主其心不善不得误用

rule.yi: 应爻动、应爻被冲，这个被托的人有更改、有变化；应爻空、应爻破，这个人无力无能；最嫌世爻受应爻伤，更忌内卦被外卦克。应爻发动、或者逢冲而动，仗他办事终究要改变；应爻落旬空、或临月破，托人办事决不能有始有终；如果应克世，或者外卦伤内卦，都主他心地不善，不可误用。
rule.en: If the Other moves or is clashed, the man entrusted has changes and alterations; if the Other is Void or broken, the man has no strength or ability; what is most disliked is the Self being hurt by the Other, and still more the inner being controlled by the outer. If the Other moves or meets a clash that sets it moving, relying on him will in the end bring a change; if the Other falls on the ten-day Void or meets Month-break, the man entrusted will surely not see it through from start to finish; if the Other controls the Self, or the outer hurts the inner trigram, in every case his heart is not good and one must not employ him by mistake.

note.yi: 「应值交重」的「交重」是动爻的记号，这里指应爻发动（见前）。「客」是被托的人。「不得误用」是不要错用了这个人。这一条与前面用人藏否（EL.132）「用来克世者，实怀欺主之心」取同一个关系：被托的人克世，就是心不善。
note.en: 'Jiaozhong' in 'ying zhi jiaozhong' is the mark of a moving line and here means the Other line moving (see earlier). 'Ke', the guest, is the man entrusted. 'Bu de wu yong' is not employing this man by mistake. This entry takes the same relation as 'if the Subject comes to control the Self, he truly harbours a mind to cheat his master' in the earlier chapter on employing a man (EL.132): a man entrusted who controls the Self has a heart that is not good.

zh: 应动应冲，此客有更有变；
应空应破，其人无力无能。
最嫌世受应伤，更忌内遭外克。
yi: 应爻动、应爻被冲，这个被托的人有更改、有变化；
应爻空、应爻破，这个人无力无能。
最嫌世爻受应爻伤，更忌内卦被外卦克。
en: If the Other moves or is clashed, this person has changes and alterations;
if the Other is Void or broken, the person has no strength or ability.
what is most disliked is the Self being hurt by the Other, and still more the inner being controlled by the outer.

zh: 应值交重或逢冲动，仗彼终须改变。
应值旬空或临月破，托人决不始终。
若应克世，或外伤内卦，皆主其心不善，不得误用也。
yi: 应爻发动、或者逢冲而动，仗他办事终究要改变。
应爻落在旬空、或临月破，托人办事决不能有始有终。
如果应克世，或者外卦伤内卦，都主他心地不善，不可误用。
en: If the Other moves or meets a clash that sets it moving, relying on him will in the end bring a change.
If the Other falls on the ten-day Void or meets Month-break, the man entrusted will surely not see it through from start to finish.
If the Other controls the Self, or the outer hurts the inner trigram, in every case his heart is not good and one must not employ him by mistake.

title: 仗托人力：财福生身而有益、见官克世以亏财，六冲则意乱无恒岂谐岂就、六合则心平有信能始能终；妻财子孙发动生助世爻终须有益，若见兄弟官鬼交重克冲世象岂不遭伤，六冲作事无成又无信实，六合所谋遂意更有始终

rule.yi: 财爻、福神生身，有益处；见官爻克世，就亏损钱财。六冲就心意混乱、没有恒心，哪里能和谐、哪里能成；六合就心平气和、有信用，能有始有终。妻财、子孙发动，生助世爻，终究有益；如果见兄弟、官鬼发动，冲克世象，怎么不受伤？六冲，作事不成，又没有信实；六合，所谋遂意，更有始有终。
rule.en: If Wealth and Output generate the Body, it is beneficial; if the star of office controls the Self, it costs wealth. With a six-clash the mind is confused and there is no constancy, so how could it be in harmony and how could it be accomplished; with a six-combine the heart is calm and there is good faith, so it can both begin and end. If Wealth and Output move and generate and aid the Self line, in the end it is beneficial; if Peer and Pressure are seen moving and clashing with or controlling the Self image, how could one not be hurt? With a six-clash, what is undertaken does not succeed and there is no good faith; with a six-combine, what is schemed turns out as one wishes and moreover there is a beginning and an end.

note.yi: 「又夫信实」的「夫」疑是「无」（「又无信实」），译作「没有信实」。「福」是福神（子孙）。这是仗托人力一章的主体：六冲六合定能不能有始有终，财子生世则有益，兄鬼克世则受伤。与求馆章「凡值六冲之卦或无官鬼定无馆也」（EL.53）、谋望成事章「六冲之卦，事决不成」（EL.104）同取六冲不成的断法。
note.en: The 'fu' of 'you fu xinshi' is presumably 'wu', and 'you wu xinshi' is translated 'there is no good faith'. 'Fu' is the fortune spirit (Output). This is the main body of the chapter on relying on others: a six-clash or a six-combine settles whether there is a beginning and an end, Wealth and Output generating the Self is beneficial, and Peer and Pressure controlling the Self is injurious. It takes the same judgment that a six-clash does not succeed as 'with a six-clash hexagram there is surely no post' in the chapter on seeking a school post (EL.53) and 'with a six-clash hexagram the affair will surely not succeed' in the chapter on scheming (EL.104).

zh: 财福生身而有益，见官克世以亏财。
六冲则意乱无恒，岂谐岂就；
六合则心平有信，能始能终。
yi: 财爻、福神生身，有益处；见官爻克世，就亏损钱财。
六冲就心意混乱、没有恒心，哪里能和谐、哪里能成；
六合就心平气和、有信用，能有始有终。
en: If Wealth and Output generate the Body, it is beneficial; if the star of office controls the Self, it costs wealth.
with a six-clash the mind is confused and there is no constancy, so how could it be in harmony and how could it be accomplished;
with a six-combine the heart is calm and there is good faith, so it can both begin and end.

zh: 妻财子孙发动，生助世爻，终须有益，若见兄弟官鬼交重克冲世象，岂不遭伤？
六冲作事无成，又夫信实。
六合所谋遂意，更有始终。
yi: 妻财、子孙发动，生助世爻，终究有益；如果见兄弟、官鬼发动，冲克世象，怎么不受伤？
六冲，作事不成，又没有信实。
六合，所谋遂意，更有始有终。
en: If Wealth and Output move and generate and aid the Self line, in the end it is beneficial; if Peer and Pressure are seen moving and clashing with or controlling the Self image, how could one not be hurt?
With a six-clash, what is undertaken does not succeed and there is no good faith.
With a six-combine, what is schemed turns out as one wishes and moreover there is a beginning and an end.

title: 仗托人力结语：诸般之重托惟凭一卦之端详，百里倾心千金重托全凭一诺之寄皆系六爻之定

rule.yi: 各种重大的托付，只凭一卦的细细审详；百里之外倾心相托、千金的重托，全凭一句承诺的寄托，都系于六爻的断定。
rule.en: For every kind of weighty entrusting, one relies only on the careful examination of one hexagram; a heart given from a hundred li away and a thousand pieces of gold entrusted, depending wholly on one man's promise, all hang on the verdict of the six lines.

note.yi: 这是仗托人力一章的结语，后面没有解说。「一诺」是一句承诺；「百里」是百里之外。
note.en: This is the closing of the chapter on relying on others' strength, and the book gives no explanation after it. 'Yi nuo' is one promise; 'bai li' is a hundred li away.

zh: 但若诸般之重托，惟凭一卦之端详。
yi: 但凡各种重大的托付，只凭一卦的细细审详。
en: For every kind of weighty entrusting, one relies only on the careful examination of one hexagram.

zh: 百里倾心千金重托，全凭一诺之寄，皆系六爻之定。
yi: 百里之外倾心相托、千金的重托，全凭一句承诺的寄托，都系于六爻的断定。
en: A heart given from a hundred li away and a thousand pieces of gold entrusted, depending wholly on one man's promise, all hang on the verdict of the six lines.

title: 更名顶籍：以世爻为主、官鬼为凭；欲顶他人籍与名六冲定见叹吁声、世空世破咸非就、官绝官亡尽不成；凡改姓名及顶他人户籍主不成

rule.yi: 想顶替别人的户籍和姓名，以世爻为主，以官鬼为凭据：遇到六冲，一定听到叹息声；世爻空、世爻破，都办不成；官爻绝、官爻亡，全都不成。凡是改换姓名、顶替别人户籍的，主不成。
rule.en: In wanting to take over another's register and name, take the Self line as the chief and Pressure as the ground: with a six-clash one will surely hear sighs; if the Self is Void or broken, in neither case is it accomplished; if the star of office is extinct or lost, it all fails. Changing one's name and taking over another's household register is judged not to succeed.

note.yi: 章名在书里出现两次，头一次写作「更吊顶籍」，「吊」是「名」的误写。「顶籍」是顶替别人的户籍（名册上的名额）；「叹吁」是叹息。「凡改姓名及顶他人户籍主不成」这一句紧接在讲不成的诀后面，按上下文是对前面那几种情形的总结，书里没有写出条件，这里照字面译。这一章与谋差顶役（EL.106 起）是一类：不是顶一个役位，而是顶别人的名、籍和营业。
note.en: The chapter title is written twice in the book, the first time as 'geng diao ding ji', where the 'diao' is a miswriting of 'ming'. 'Ding ji' is taking over another's household register (a place on the roll); 'tanxu' is sighing. The sentence 'changing one's name and taking over another's household register is judged not to succeed' follows straight after the verse about failure and is by the context a summary of the cases just given; the book states no condition and it is translated literally. This chapter is of a kind with the chapters on seeking a commission and taking over a service (from EL.106): not taking over a service post but taking over another's name, register and business.

yi: 以世爻为主要看的，以官鬼为凭据。
en: Take the Self line as the chief to be looked at, and Pressure as the ground.

zh: 欲顶他人籍与名，六冲定见叹吁声，
世空世破咸非就，官绝官亡尽不成。
yi: 想顶替别人的户籍和姓名，遇到六冲，一定听到叹息声；
世爻空、世爻破，都办不成；官爻绝、官爻亡，全都不成。
en: If one wants to take over another's register and name, a six-clash will surely bring sighs;
if the Self is Void or broken, in neither case is it accomplished; if the star of office is extinct or lost, it all fails.

zh: 凡改姓名及顶他人户籍主不成。
yi: 凡是改换姓名、顶替别人户籍的，主不成。
en: Changing one's name and taking over another's household register is judged not to succeed.

title: 更名顶籍：更此官名宜鬼旺、顶其店业要财兴，兄临雀动伤身世犹恐傍人举斗争，世不空冲官不陷事当圆就永无更；在官顶补姓名尤要官爻旺相又不可鬼克世身，顶人艺业还求财象兴隆不拘公私更改兄爻独发难成，纵然乱动兄带朱雀克世或应带朱雀克世必有傍人举首争夺，世爻兴官爻不空冲破绝事事皆成

rule.yi: 顶补官名（官职），适宜官鬼旺相；顶替别人的店铺产业，要财爻兴旺。兄爻临朱雀发动，伤克身爻、世爻，还怕旁人出来争斗；世爻不空不冲、官不落陷，事情当可圆成，永不更改。在官府顶补姓名，尤其要官爻旺相，又不可官鬼克世爻、身爻；顶替别人的手艺行业，还要财象兴隆；不论公家还是私人的更改，兄爻独发就难成；即使乱动，如果兄爻带朱雀发动来克世，或者应爻带朱雀来克世，必有旁人出头争夺；世爻兴旺、官爻都不空、不冲、不破、不绝，事事都成。
rule.en: To take over an official name, it is fitting for Pressure to be thriving; to take over another's shop and business, Wealth must flourish. If Peer on the Vermilion Bird moves and hurts the Body or the Self, one still fears bystanders rising to contend; if the Self is neither Void nor clashed and the star of office is not sunk, the matter will be fully accomplished and never changed. In taking over a name in an official post, it is especially necessary for the Pressure line to be thriving, and Pressure must not control the Self or the Body; in taking over another's craft or trade, one still wants the Wealth image to flourish; whether the change is public or private, if the Peer line moves alone it is hard to accomplish; even if lines move in confusion, if Peer carrying the Vermilion Bird moves to control the Self, or the Other carrying the Vermilion Bird comes to control the Self, there will surely be bystanders who come forward to contend; if the Self is thriving and the Pressure line is not Void, clashed, broken or extinct, everything succeeds.

note.yi: 「顶补」是顶替补缺；「艺业」是手艺行业；「店业」是店铺产业；「举首」是出头；「傍人」是旁人。「更此官名」按解里「在官顶补姓名」读，指顶补官府里的名额。这一条的取法和谋差顶役（EL.106 起）一样：官爻旺相、财爻兴旺是吉，兄爻带朱雀来克世是旁人来争。
note.en: 'Dingbu' is taking over a place to fill a vacancy; 'yiye' is a craft or trade; 'dianye' is a shop and its business; 'jushou' is coming forward; 'bangren' is bystanders. 'Geng ci guan ming' is read by the explanation's 'taking over a name in an official post' and means taking over a place on the roll in an office. The method here is the same as in the chapters on seeking a commission (from EL.106): the Pressure line thriving and Wealth flourishing are auspicious, and Peer carrying the Vermilion Bird coming to control the Self is bystanders coming to contend.

zh: 更此官名宜鬼旺，顶其店业要财兴。
兄临雀动伤身世，犹恐傍人举斗争。
世不空冲官不陷，事当圆就永无更。
yi: 顶补官名（官职），适宜官鬼旺相；顶替别人的店铺产业，要财爻兴旺。
兄爻临朱雀发动，伤克身爻、世爻，还怕旁人出来争斗；
世爻不空不冲、官不落陷，事情当可圆成，永不更改。
en: To take over an official name, it is fitting for Pressure to be thriving; to take over another's shop and business, Wealth must flourish.
If Peer on the Vermilion Bird moves and hurts the Body or the Self, one still fears bystanders rising to contend;
if the Self is neither Void nor clashed and the star of office is not sunk, the matter will be fully accomplished and never changed.

zh: 在官顶补姓名，尤要官爻旺相，又不可鬼克世身。
顶人艺业，还求财象兴隆，不拘公私更改，兄爻独发难成。
纵然乱动，兄带朱雀动来克世，或应带朱雀来克世者，必有傍人举首争夺成非，世爻兴官爻若皆不空冲破绝，事事皆成无谋不遂。
yi: 在官府顶补姓名，尤其要官爻旺相，又不可官鬼克世爻、身爻。
顶替别人的手艺行业，还要财象兴隆；不论公家还是私人的更改，兄爻独发就难成。
即使乱动，如果兄爻带朱雀发动来克世，或者应爻带朱雀来克世，必有旁人出头争夺；世爻兴旺、官爻都不空、不冲、不破、不绝，事事都成。
en: In taking over a name in an official post, it is especially necessary for the Pressure line to be thriving, and Pressure must not control the Self or the Body.
In taking over another's craft or trade, one still wants the Wealth image to flourish; whether the change is public or private, if the Peer line moves alone it is hard to accomplish.

Even if lines move in confusion, if Peer carrying the Vermilion Bird moves to control the Self, or the Other carrying the Vermilion Bird comes to control the Self, there will surely be bystanders who come forward to contend; if the Self is thriving and the Pressure line is not Void, clashed, broken or extinct, everything succeeds.

title: 平生学艺总纲：以妻财为主、世应为凭；业无大小贤愚岂不从师，事有败成去就还须问卜；凡习三教之流师同伯叔，椿萱旺相法必训详，逢旺相或来合世生身者必获全传；习诸般技艺先观兄弟次看应爻，此二象若一空亡便无承受

rule.yi: 学艺（学一门手艺、行业），以妻财为主，以世爻、应爻为凭据。行业没有大小、贤愚之分，哪能不拜师；事情有败有成、有去有留，还须占卜。凡是学三教一类的，师父如同伯叔：如果椿萱（父母爻）旺相，教法必定讲解详细；如果逢旺相，或者来合世、生身，必定得到全传。学各种技艺，先看兄弟爻，再看应爻，这两个象如果有一个空亡，就没有所承受。
rule.en: In learning a craft or art, take Wealth as the chief and the Self and the Other as the ground. No trade is great or small, wise or foolish, yet how can one not follow a teacher; matters have failure and success, leaving and staying, and one must still consult the oracle. In learning among the Three Teachings, the teacher is like an uncle: if Resource, the parents, is thriving, the method will surely be taught in detail; if it meets thriving, or comes to combine with the Self or generate the Body, one will surely receive the whole transmission. In learning the various crafts, look first at Peer and then at the Other line; if either of these two images is Void, there is nothing to be received.

note.yi: 「三教之流」是儒、释、道三教的学问和行当。「椿萱」是父母。「法必训详父田」文字有误，「父田」不通，这里按「法必训详」译，不译「父田」。「全传」是完整的传授。这一章问的是终身学一门手艺、行业（「平生学艺」），所以要拜师，取妻财为主；后面的五经定肄、求师训迪讲的是读书应考，是另一件事。
note.en: 'Sanjiao zhi liu' is the learning and callings of the three teachings of Confucians, Buddhists and Daoists. 'Chunxuan' is the parents. 'Fa bi xunxiang futian' is corrupt in its characters and 'futian' makes no sense, so it is translated as 'the method will surely be taught in detail' and 'futian' is left untranslated. 'Quanchuan' is the complete transmission. This chapter asks about learning a craft or trade for one's whole life, so one must follow a teacher and Wealth is taken as the chief; the following chapters on settling on one of the five Classics and on seeking a teacher to instruct are about studying for examinations, which is another matter.

yi: 以妻财为主要看的，以世爻、应爻为凭据。
en: Take Wealth as the chief to be looked at, and the Self and the Other as the ground.

zh: 业无大小贤愚，岂不从师；
事有败成去就，还须问卜。
yi: 行业没有大小、贤愚之分，哪能不拜师；
事情有败有成、有去有留，还须占卜。
en: No trade is great or small, wise or foolish, yet how can one not follow a teacher;
matters have failure and success, leaving and staying, and one must still consult the oracle.

zh: 凡习三教之流师同伯叔，如得椿萱旺相，法必训详父田，如逢旺相或来合世生身者，必获全传。
或习诸般技艺，先观兄弟次看应爻，此二象若一空亡便无承受。
yi: 凡是学三教一类的，师父如同伯叔；如果椿萱（父母爻）旺相，教法必定讲解详细；如果逢旺相，或者来合世、生身，必定得到全传。
或者学各种技艺，先看兄弟爻，再看应爻，这两个象如果有一个空亡，就没有所承受。
en: In learning among the Three Teachings the teacher is like an uncle; if Resource, the parents, is thriving, the method will surely be taught in detail; if it meets thriving, or comes to combine with the Self or generate the Body, one will surely receive the whole transmission.
In learning the various crafts, look first at Peer and then at the Other line; if either of these two images is Void, there is nothing to be received.

title: 平生学艺：金银铜钱之工值乾兑酉申而最吉，竹木芦藤之匠得震巽寅卯以为佳，造贩鱼盐酒醋利入坎宫，裁成袖绢绫罗喜临离象，采石樵山须见艮、土工泥作要逢坤

rule.yi: 做金、银、铜、钱的工匠，遇到乾、兑、酉、申最吉；做竹、木、芦、藤的匠人，得到震、巽、寅、卯为好；制造、贩卖鱼、盐、酒、醋，利益进入坎宫；裁制衣袖、绢帛、绫罗的，喜欢遇到离象；采石、上山砍柴，须见艮；做土工、泥作，要逢坤。
rule.en: For metalworkers in gold, silver, copper and coin, meeting Qian, Dui, You and Shen is the most auspicious; for craftsmen in bamboo, wood, reed and rattan, getting Zhen, Xun, Yin and Mao is good; in making and selling fish, salt, wine and vinegar, profit enters the Kan palace; for cutting garments and silks, one is glad to meet the Li image; for quarrying stone and cutting wood on the mountain one must see Gen; for earthwork and plastering one must meet Kun.

note.yi: 这一联把行业对到卦宫：金属工匠对乾、兑和酉、申，竹木匠对震、巽和寅、卯，鱼盐酒醋对坎，裁缝绫罗对离，采石樵山对艮，土工泥作对坤。书里没有说缘故：金、木、水、土几项是按五行对的，裁缝对离书里没有解释。「造败鱼盐酒醋」的「败」疑是「贩」，译作「制造贩卖」；「樵山」是上山砍柴。这一联后面没有解说。
note.en: This couplet matches trades to the palaces: metalworkers to Qian and Dui and You and Shen, bamboo and wood craftsmen to Zhen and Xun and Yin and Mao, fish, salt, wine and vinegar to Kan, tailoring and silks to Li, quarrying and woodcutting to Gen, earthwork and plastering to Kun. The book does not give the reason: the metal, wood, water and earth items go by the five elements, and the book does not explain tailoring going with Li. The 'bai' of 'zao bai yu yan jiu cu' is presumably 'fan', to trade, and it is translated 'making and selling'; 'qiaoshan' is going up the mountain to cut wood. No explanation follows this couplet.

zh: 金银铜钱之工，值乾兑酉申而最吉。
竹木芦藤之匠，得震巽寅卯以为佳。
造败鱼盐酒醋，利入坎宫。
裁成袖绢绫罗，喜临离象，
采石樵山须见艮，土工泥作要逢坤！
yi: 做金、银、铜、钱的工匠，遇到乾、兑、酉、申最吉；
做竹、木、芦、藤的匠人，得到震、巽、寅、卯为好；
制造、贩卖鱼、盐、酒、醋，利益进入坎宫；
裁制衣袖、绢帛、绫罗的，喜欢遇到离象；
采石、上山砍柴，须见艮；做土工、泥作，要逢坤！
en: For metalworkers in gold, silver, copper and coin, meeting Qian, Dui, You and Shen is the most auspicious;
for craftsmen in bamboo, wood, reed and rattan, getting Zhen, Xun, Yin and Mao is good;
in making and selling fish, salt, wine and vinegar, profit enters the Kan palace;
for cutting garments and silks, one is glad to meet the Li image;
for quarrying stone and cutting wood on the mountain one must see Gen; for earthwork and plastering one must meet Kun!

title: 平生学艺：将本营生子动财明终发达、空拳技艺财摇鬼旺必兴家，身佐官僚世怕鬼爻冲克、名开行次身宜福德生扶；凡人习业各有所分，将本者财为主象子作元神，空拳者官是用爻财为助主，若在官人役虽宜官鬼兴隆冲克世身大忌，牙行生理最要子孙旺则广招千里空则门可罗雀，卦中虽有子孙应若逢空亦无客至

rule.yi: 靠本钱做生意谋生的，子孙发动、财爻分明，终究发达；靠空手手艺谋生的，财爻发动、官鬼旺相，必定兴家；给官僚当助手的，世爻怕官鬼爻冲克；在行会里开名头的，身爻适宜福德生扶。凡人学业各有各的分别：靠本钱的，财是主象，子孙是元神；空手的，官是用爻，财爻帮助主象；如果是在官府当差役的，虽然适宜官鬼兴旺，但官鬼冲克世身是大忌；牙行生意，最要子孙旺：旺就能广招千里的客人，空就门可罗雀；卦中虽然有子孙，应爻如果逢空，也没有客人上门。
rule.en: Those who live by trade with capital will in the end prosper if Output moves and Wealth is clear; those who live by bare-handed skill will surely make the household prosper if Wealth sways and Pressure is thriving; for one who serves as an assistant to officials, the Self fears the Pressure line clashing with or controlling it; for one who opens his name in a trade guild, the Body should be generated and supported by Output, the fortune virtue. In learning a business each person has his own division: for those with capital, Wealth is the chief image and Output the Support; for those with bare hands, the star of office is the Subject line and Wealth aids the chief image; if one serves as a runner in an office, though it is fitting for Pressure to flourish, Pressure clashing with or controlling the Self or the Body is the great taboo; in the brokerage trade, Output thriving is what matters most: if thriving one draws guests from a thousand miles, and if Void the gate is empty enough to net sparrows; even if there is Output in the hexagram, if the Other meets Void no customer comes.

note.yi: 「将本」是拿本钱做生意，「空拳」是空手（靠手艺）。「身佐官僚」是在官员身边做佐助；「名开行次」是在行会里挂名开业；「牙行」是替买卖双方说合、抽佣的行当（经纪）。「郑在官人役」的「郑」疑是「若」，「门纲雀罹」疑是「门网雀罗」，即门可罗雀，按文意译。「元神」是生用神的爻（见术语表）：这里财是主象，生财的子孙是元神。
note.en: 'Jiang ben' is doing business with capital, and 'kongquan' is bare-handed (living by a skill). 'Shen zuo guanliao' is serving as an assistant beside officials; 'ming kai hangci' is hanging out one's name and opening business in a trade guild; 'yahang' is the brokerage trade of bringing buyer and seller together for a commission. The 'zheng' of 'zheng zai guan ren yi' is presumably 'ruo', if, and 'men gang que li' is presumably 'men wang que luo', a gate where sparrows can be netted, that is a deserted door, translated by the sense. 'Yuanshen', the Support, is the line that generates the Subject (see the glossary): here Wealth is the chief image and Output, which generates Wealth, is the Support.

zh: 将本营生，子动财明终发达，
空拳技艺，财摇鬼旺必兴家。
身佐官僚，世怕鬼爻冲克。
名开行次，身宜福德生扶。
yi: 靠本钱做生意谋生的，子孙发动、财爻分明，终究发达；
靠空手手艺谋生的，财爻发动、官鬼旺相，必定兴家；
给官僚当助手的，世爻怕官鬼爻冲克；
在行会里开名头的，身爻适宜福德生扶。
en: Those who live by trade with capital will in the end prosper if Output moves and Wealth is clear;
those who live by bare-handed skill will surely make the household prosper if Wealth sways and Pressure is thriving;
for one who serves as an assistant to officials, the Self fears the Pressure line clashing with or controlling it;
for one who opens his name in a trade guild, the Body should be generated and supported by Output, the fortune virtue.

zh: 凡人习业，各有所分，将本者，财为主象，子作元神。
空拳者，官是用爻，财为助主，郑在官人役，虽宜官鬼兴隆，冲克世身大忌。
牙行生理，最要子孙旺则广招千里，空则门纲雀罹。
卦中虽有子孙，应若逢空，亦无客至。
yi: 凡人学业，各有各的分别：靠本钱的，财是主象，子孙是元神。
空手的，官是用爻，财爻帮助主象；如果是在官府当差役的，虽然适宜官鬼兴旺，但官鬼冲克世身是大忌。
牙行生意，最要子孙旺：旺就能广招千里的客人，空就门可罗雀。
卦中虽然有子孙，应爻如果逢空，也没有客人上门。
en: In learning a business each person has his own division: for those with capital, Wealth is the chief image and Output is the Support.

For those with bare hands, the star of office is the Subject line and Wealth aids the chief image; if one serves as a runner in an office, though it is fitting for Pressure to flourish, Pressure clashing with or controlling the Self or the Body is the great taboo.
In the brokerage trade, Output thriving is what matters most: if thriving one draws guests from a thousand miles, and if Void the gate is empty enough to net sparrows.
Even if there is Output in the hexagram, if the Other meets Void no customer comes.

title: 平生学艺：凡习经书父须生旺、若求官职鬼莫空无、祝巫大利官兴僧道惟宜子旺；习儒业者父母为用，求功名者官鬼为用，祝巫迎神召将照马关亡之类亦用官爻，僧道之流子孙为用，凡用爻皆宜旺相各忌空亡；诸般道术一应生涯皆把财为衣禄养命之源兼推子乃福神发家之主，诸般艺业皆宜财神兴隆财若空亡利资必绝望

rule.yi: 学经书，父爻必须生旺；求官职，官鬼不可空无；祝巫大利官爻兴旺，僧道只适宜子孙旺。学儒业的，父母爻是用爻；求功名的，官鬼是用爻；祝巫一类，迎神召将、照马、关亡之类，也用官爻；只有僧道一流，以子孙为用。凡是用爻都适宜旺相，各自忌空亡：旺就事事有成，空就样样不成。各种道术、一切生计，都把财当作衣食俸禄、养命的源头，并且要推子孙是福神、发家的主；各种艺业，都适宜财神（财爻）兴隆；财如果空亡，利润资财一定没有指望了。
rule.en: In studying the classics, Resource must be thriving; in seeking office, Pressure must not be empty; for diviner-priests and shamans it is greatly favourable for the star of office to flourish, and for monks and Daoists only Output thriving is fitting. For the scholarly calling, Resource is the Subject line; for those seeking fame and office, Pressure is the Subject; for shamans, those who greet gods and summon generals, 'look at the horse' and 'close the gate on the dead' and the like, the Pressure line is also used; only for the monks and Daoists is Output the Subject. Every Subject line should be thriving and each fears Void: if thriving everything succeeds, and if Void nothing is accomplished. For every kind of Daoist art and every livelihood, Wealth is taken as the source of food, clothing, pay and the sustaining of life, and Output must also be reckoned as the fortune spirit and the master of making a household prosper; in every kind of art and trade it is fitting for Wealth to flourish, and if Wealth is Void, profit and funds are surely without hope.

note.yi: 「祝巫」是祝由、巫术一类的行当；「照马」「关亡」是民间神道里的两种法事，书里没有细说。「儒业」是读书应试的业。这一条是看行业取什么用神：儒业取父母，功名取官鬼，祝巫取官爻，僧道取子孙，其余一切生计取财。僧道取子孙与黄金策「僧道医官，岂可文书发动」（HJC.27）、增删卜易僧官医官（ZS.53）说的是同一个取法。
note.en: 'Zhuwu' is the callings of invocation and healing by charms and of shamanism; 'zhaoma' and 'guanwang' are two kinds of rite of the folk religion, and the book does not go into them. 'Ruye' is the calling of studying for examinations. This entry looks at what Subject each calling takes: the scholarly calling takes Resource, fame and office take Pressure, shamans take the Pressure line, monks and Daoists take Output, and every other livelihood takes Wealth. That monks and Daoists take Output is the same method as 'for monk, Daoist and medical officials, how could the document move' in the Huangjin Ce (HJC.27) and the Zengshan Buyi on monk-officials and medical officials (ZS.53).

zh: 祝巫大利官兴，僧道惟宜子旺。
yi: 学经书，父爻必须生旺；
求官职，官鬼不可空无；
祝巫大利官爻兴旺，僧道只适宜子孙旺。
en: In studying the classics, Resource must be thriving;
in seeking office, Pressure must not be empty;
for diviner-priests and shamans it is greatly favourable for the star of office to flourish, and for monks and Daoists only Output thriving is fitting.

zh: 祝巫者，迎神召将照马关亡之类，亦用官爻。
凡用爻皆宜值旺相，各忌空亡，旺则事事有成，空则般般不就。
诸般道术一应生涯，皆把财为衣禄养命之源兼推子乃福神发家之主。
yi: 学儒业的，父母爻是用爻。
求功名的，官鬼是用爻。
祝巫一类，迎神召将、照马、关亡之类，也用官爻。
只有僧道一流，以子孙为用。
凡是用爻都适宜旺相，各自忌空亡：旺就事事有成，空就样样不成。
各种道术、一切生计，都把财当作衣食俸禄、养命的源头，并且要推子孙是福神、发家的主。
en: For the scholarly calling, Resource is the Subject line.
For those seeking fame and office, Pressure is the Subject.
For shamans, those who greet gods and summon generals, 'look at the horse' and 'close the gate on the dead' and the like, the Pressure line is also used.
Only for the monks and Daoists is Output the Subject.
Every Subject line should be thriving and each fears Void: if thriving everything succeeds, and if Void nothing is accomplished.

For every kind of Daoist art and every livelihood, Wealth is taken as the source of food, clothing, pay and the sustaining of life, and Output must also be reckoned as the fortune spirit and the master of making a household prosper.

zh: 诸般艺业，皆宜财神兴隆。
财若空亡，利资必绝望矣！
yi: 各种艺业，都适宜财神（财爻）兴隆。
财如果空亡，利润资财一定没有指望了！
en: In every kind of art and trade it is fitting for Wealth to flourish.
If Wealth is Void, profit and funds are surely without hope!

title: 平生学艺：无鬼必无头无绪、游魂必游去游回，世犯旬空自有更张之意、应遭月破师无传授之心，蹇遇六冲彼我无情难习业、幸逢六合师徒相得却成功；一应徒师习业不宜卦内无官鬼，世为己应为师皆不可值旬空月破又不宜六冲，世应不空又遇六合定主师徒相得事必成功；欲择明师未知曲直当占易卦便见虚真

rule.yi: 没有官鬼，必定没有头绪；游魂，必定游去游回。世爻犯旬空，自己有改弦更张的意思；应爻遭月破，师父没有传授的心。不幸遇到六冲，彼此无情，难以学业；幸而逢六合，师徒相得，反倒成功。凡是徒弟向师父学业，不适宜卦内没有官鬼；如果逢空，事情没有头绪；卦值游魂，往返不定；又看世爻是自己、应爻是师父，都不可值旬空、月破，又不适宜卦值六冲；世应如果不空亡，又遇到爻逢六合，一定主师徒相得、事必成功。想选择明师，不知道曲直好坏，应当占一个易卦，就能看到真假。
rule.en: With no Pressure there is surely no clue to the matter, and a Wandering Soul surely means going off and returning; if the Self falls on the ten-day Void one is inclined to change one's course, and if the Other meets Month-break the teacher has no heart to pass on his teaching; meeting a six-clash is unlucky, for the two have no feeling for each other and it is hard to learn the trade; luckily meeting a six-combine, master and pupil suit each other and succeed. For all pupils learning under masters, it is not fitting for the hexagram to have no Pressure line in it; if it meets Void, the matter has no clue; if the hexagram falls on a Wandering Soul, one goes back and forth and nothing is settled; look also at the Self as oneself and the Other as the teacher, neither of which may fall on the ten-day Void or Month-break, and it is also unfitting for the hexagram to be a six-clash; if the Self and the Other are not Void and the lines also meet a six-combine, master and pupil will surely suit each other and the matter will surely succeed. To choose a bright teacher when one does not know the crooked from the straight, one should divine a hexagram, and the false and true will be seen at once.

note.yi: 「游魂」是八宫卦里每宫的第七卦（见术语表）。「更张」是改变做法。「蹇」在这里是不幸、运气艰难（与下句的「幸」相对），不是蹇卦。「徒师习业」是徒弟跟师父学业；「明师」是高明的师父。这一章后半讲的是学手艺时的师徒关系，与前面几条（EL.140 起）合起来，是学艺从选行业、取用神到选师父的整个过程。
note.en: 'Wandering Soul' is the seventh hexagram of each of the eight palaces (see the glossary). 'Gengzhang' is changing one's way of doing things. 'Jian' here is ill luck and a hard fortune (set against the 'luckily' of the next line) and is not the Jian hexagram. 'Tushi xiye' is a pupil learning under a master, and 'mingshi' is a brilliant teacher. The second half of this chapter speaks of the relation of master and pupil in learning a trade, and together with the earlier entries (from EL.140) it is the whole course of learning a craft, from choosing a trade and the Subject to choosing a master.

zh: 无鬼必无头无绪，游魂必游去游回。
世犯旬空，自有更张之意。
应遭月破，师无传授之心。
蹇遇六冲，彼我无情难习业。
幸逢六合，师徒相得却成功。
yi: 没有官鬼，必定没有头绪；游魂，必定游去游回。
世爻犯旬空，自己有改弦更张的意思；
应爻遭月破，师父没有传授的心。
不幸遇到六冲，彼此无情，难以学业；
幸而逢六合，师徒相得，反倒成功。
en: With no Pressure there is surely no clue to the matter, and a Wandering Soul surely means going off and returning.
If the Self falls on the ten-day Void, one is inclined to change one's course;
if the Other meets Month-break, the teacher has no heart to pass on his teaching.
Meeting a six-clash is unlucky, for the two have no feeling for each other and it is hard to learn the trade;
luckily meeting a six-combine, master and pupil suit each other and succeed.

zh: 一应徒师习业，不宜卦内无官鬼。
若逢空，事无头绪，卦值游魂，往返不定。
又看世为己应为师，皆不可值旬空月破，又不宜卦值六冲。
世应若不空亡，又遇爻逢六合，定主师徒相得事必成功。
yi: 凡是徒弟向师父学业，不适宜卦内没有官鬼。
如果逢空，事情没有头绪；卦值游魂，往返不定。
又看世爻是自己、应爻是师父，都不可值旬空、月破，又不适宜卦值六冲。
世应如果不空亡，又遇到爻逢六合，一定主师徒相得、事必成功。
en: For all pupils learning under masters, it is not fitting for the hexagram to have no Pressure line in it.
If it meets Void, the matter has no clue; if the hexagram falls on a Wandering Soul, one goes back and forth and nothing is settled.
Look also at the Self as oneself and the Other as the teacher, neither of which may fall on the ten-day Void or Month-break, and it is also unfitting for the hexagram to be a six-clash.
If the Self and the Other are not Void and the lines also meet a six-combine, master and pupil will surely suit each other and the matter will surely succeed.

zh: 欲择明师，未知曲直，当占易卦，便见虚真。
yi: 想选择明师，不知道曲直好坏，应当占一个易卦，就能看到真假。
en: To choose a bright teacher when one does not know the crooked from the straight, one should divine a hexagram, and the false and true will be seen at once.

title: 六亲属类·父母主文书吏、印绶、官职事业、图籍号令、差劄条敕；官鬼主君主、职清、公庭

rule.yi: 父母爻代表尊长、文书、吏员，印绶、衣服、轿车船，契约、本事，还有文章、印绶、官职事业、图籍号令、差遣的札子和条文敕令；官鬼爻代表神邪、疾病、鬼祟、盗贼，失物、输赢、灾祸，还有君主、职位清要、公庭。
rule.en: The Resource line stands for elders, documents and clerks, the seal and ribbon, clothing, sedan chairs, carts and boats, contracts and skills, and also essays, the seal and ribbon, office and career, maps and registers, orders and commands, dispatch notes, regulations and decrees; the Pressure line stands for spirits and evil, illness, hauntings and thieves, lost things, winning and losing and disaster, and also the sovereign, clear and weighty posts, and the public court.

note.yi: 这是一份各类事物归属六亲的名目表，各问题通用；这里只引和官职有关的几句，其余几行（财、福、兄）见求财、婚姻等篇。海底眼另有一段「此尾五句应在官鬼上，未知是否，存考」的小注，不引。
note.en: This is a general list assigning things to the six relations, common to every kind of question; only the lines bearing on office are quoted here, and the other lines (Wealth, Output, Peer) are in the chapters on wealth, marriage and so on. The Haidi Yan also has a small note saying that the last five phrases may belong to Pressure but this is uncertain and kept for study, which is not quoted.

yi: 父母（爻）是尊长、文书、吏员，
印绶、衣服、轿、车、船，
契约、本事，操心用力，
天地、坟墓、房屋、田园。
en: Resource is elders, documents and clerks,
the seal and ribbon, clothing, sedan chairs, carts and boats,
contracts and skills, taxing the mind and strength,
heaven and earth, graves, houses, fields and gardens.

yi: 文章、印绶，
官职、事业，
图籍、号令，
差遣的札子、条文敕令。
en: essays and the seal and ribbon,
office and career,
maps and registers, orders and commands,
dispatch notes, regulations and decrees.

yi: 官鬼（爻）主神邪、疾病、鬼祟、盗贼，
失物、输赢、灾祸、梦、忧愁，
电闪、主人、厅堂殿宇一类，
沟渠、牢狱、臀尻，制住自身的忧愁。
en: Pressure stands for spirits and evil, illness, hauntings and thieves,
lost things, winning and losing, disaster, dreams and worry,
lightning, the master, halls and palaces and the like,
ditches, prisons, the buttocks, and the worry of being held in check.

yi: 官鬼（爻）事发，
（象征）君主、清要的职位，
en: When the Pressure line's matter arises,
it stands for the sovereign and clear and weighty posts,

yi: 公庭、东面的道路，
en: the public court, the road to the east,

title: 冲克官鬼：官鬼被冲克即主求官，又关诉讼、走失、盗贼，不要一例看

rule.yi: 官鬼爻被冲克，就是（占）求官，还有诉讼的事暗中相关，又可能是走失、盗贼，不要把爻里的情形当成一个例子来看。
rule.en: The Pressure line clashed and controlled means the seeking of office, and a lawsuit is hiddenly connected, or perhaps something strayed or lost and thieves; do not read what is in the line as a single case.

yi: 冲克官鬼（这一条）：
官鬼被冲克，就是（占）求官，
还有诉讼的事暗中相关，
又可能是走失、还有盗贼，
不要把爻里的情形当成一个例子来看。
en: Clash and control on Pressure:
Pressure clashed and controlled is the seeking of office,
and a lawsuit is hiddenly connected,
or perhaps something strayed or lost, and thieves,
do not read what is in the line as a single case.

title: 应举章·赴诏面君宜官鬼出现、鬼墓发动不须推；除迁以鬼爻持世（鬼发或临鬼墓不吉）；求职请判在任宜鬼爻静、鬼发或动子出有替

rule.yi: 赴诏、面见君主，宜官鬼出现；官鬼的墓发动，不必再推。除迁（任命调迁），以官鬼爻持世为宜，官鬼发动、或落在鬼墓上，就不吉利。求职、请求考核评定，在任的人宜官鬼爻安静；官鬼发动，或子孙发动出来，就有人接替。
rule.en: For going to court on summons or seeing the sovereign, it is fitting that Pressure appear; the tomb of Pressure moving needs no further reckoning. For appointment and transfer it is right that the Pressure line hold the Self, and if Pressure moves or stands on the tomb of Pressure it is not auspicious. For seeking a post or an appraisal, one in office should have the Pressure line still; if Pressure moves, or Output moves out, there is a replacement.

note.yi: 这三句在「应举」一段里，但说的是做官的人：赴诏、除迁、求职请判、在任，不是考试。第三句和火珠林占科举之前「求职请判」一段（HZL.02）是同一句话。「鬼墓发动不须推」没有说为什么不用再推，按字面译。
note.en: These three passages stand in the section on taking the examination but speak of men holding office: going on summons, appointment and transfer, seeking a post or appraisal, and being in office, not of examinations. The third is the same sentence as the 'seeking a post or appraisal' passage in the Huozhulin (HZL.02). 'The tomb of Pressure moving needs no further reckoning' does not say why, and is translated literally.

yi: 赴诏、面见君主的殿堂，
宜官鬼出现；
官鬼的墓发动，不必再推。
en: Going on summons, to see the sovereign in the hall,
it is fitting that Pressure appear;
the tomb of Pressure moving needs no further reckoning.

yi: 除迁（任命调迁），以官鬼爻持世为宜；
官鬼如果发动，
或者落在鬼墓上，
就不吉利。
en: For appointment and transfer it is right that the Pressure line hold the Self;
if Pressure moves,
or stands on the tomb of Pressure,
it is not auspicious.

yi: 求职、请求考核评定，
在任的人宜官鬼爻安静；
官鬼发动，或者子孙发动出来，
就有人接替。
en: To seek a post or ask for an appraisal,
one in office should have the Pressure line still;
if Pressure moves, or Output moves out,
there is a replacement.

title: 文书章·见贵求谋问立身：文书不动及时辰，财动文书空费力，子动伤官事不亨；事见两爻须再觅、官多宛转恐艰难，最要日辰生合出则知音处处得前程

rule.yi: 拜见贵人、求谋、问立身：文书（父母）不动、又赶上时辰，可成；财动，文书白费力；子孙动，伤了官鬼，事情不亨通。事情现出两个爻，要再去找；官多，辗转曲折，恐怕艰难；最要紧的是日辰生合它、让它出来，那就处处遇到知音、得到前程。
rule.en: For calling on a noble, scheming for a post and asking about establishing oneself: with the documents (Resource) still and in step with the time it can be done; Wealth moving, the documents are spent in vain; Output moving injures Pressure and the matter does not go through. If the matter shows two lines, seek again; with many Pressure lines it winds and turns and may be hard; what matters most is that the Day generates or combines and brings it out, and then one finds those who know one everywhere and a future.

yi: 拜见贵人、求谋、问立身处世，
文书（父母）不动、又赶上时辰，
财动，文书白费力气；
子孙动，伤了官鬼，事情不亨通。
en: To call on a noble, to scheme for a post, to ask how to establish oneself,
the documents (Resource) still and in step with the time,
Wealth moving, the documents are spent in vain;
Output moving injures Pressure and the matter does not go through.

yi: 它又说：
事情现出两个爻，要再去找；
官多，辗转曲折，恐怕艰难；
最要紧的是日辰生合它、让它出来，
那就处处遇到知音、得到前程。
en: It says again:
if the matter shows two lines, seek again;
with many Pressure lines it winds and turns and may be hard;
what matters most is that the Day generates or combines and brings it out,
and then one finds those who know one everywhere and a future.

title: 文书章：六爻中只一爻动最忌兄弟动；文书与贵人原无亦难成，出现有气亦怕空亡；求官与文书要旺相持世有成；应爻不克事体分明；乾兑坎宫谋事不一；见官用动其人多出

rule.yi: 六爻中如果只有一爻动，最忌讳兄弟爻动，事情不实在、难成。如果文书和贵人在卦中原本没有，也难成；出现了、有气，也怕空亡——所说的动爻急得像火攻，急着落入空亡。求官和文书，要旺相、持世才有成。应爻不受克，事体就分明；乾、兑、坎宫，谋事不专一；见官员，用爻发动，那人多半出门，叫也是白叫。
rule.en: If only one line moves among the six, what is most to be avoided is Peer moving: the matter is not real and is hard to accomplish. If the documents and the Noble are originally absent from the hexagram, it is also hard to accomplish; if they appear and have qi they still fear Void, as is said, a moving line is urgent like an attack by fire, hurrying into Void. For seeking office and documents, they must be strong and hold the Self to succeed. If the Other line is not controlled, the matter is clear; in the palaces Qian, Dui and Kan the planning is not single-minded; in seeing an official, if the Subject line moves, the man has mostly gone out, and calling for him is in vain.

yi: 如果六爻之中，
只有一爻发动，
最忌讳兄弟爻动，
事情不实在，难以成功。
en: If among the six lines
only one line moves,
what is most to be avoided is Peer moving,
the matter is not real and is hard to accomplish.

zh: 若文书与贵人卦中原无事，
yi: 如果文书和贵人在卦中原本没有这回事，
也难成功。
出现了、有气，
也怕空亡，
所说的动爻急得像火攻，
急着落入空亡。
求官和文书，
要旺相、持世才有成。
en: If the documents and the Noble are originally absent from the hexagram,
it is also hard to accomplish.
if they appear and have qi,
they still fear Void,
as is said, a moving line is urgent like an attack by fire,
hurrying into Void.
For seeking office and documents,
they must be strong and hold the Self to succeed.

yi: 应爻不受克，
事体就分明；
乾、兑、坎宫，
谋事不专一。
见官员，用爻发动，
那人多半出门，叫也是白叫。
en: If the Other line is not controlled,
the matter is clear;
in the palaces Qian, Dui and Kan,
the planning is not single-minded.
in seeing an official, if the Subject line moves,
the man has mostly gone out, and calling for him is in vain.

title: 谒见：谒人须问谒何人，世应作鬼枉劳心，用爻出现不乘旺往见必不在家；世应坐鬼彼此疑心，用爻衰弱我何籍焉

rule.yi: 拜谒人，要问拜谒的是谁；世、应作鬼，白费心思；用爻出现却不乘旺，去见他必定不在家。世、应坐着官鬼，双方互相猜疑；如果用爻衰弱了，我还能凭靠什么呢？
rule.en: In calling on someone, ask whom one is calling on; with the Self or the Other as Pressure one wearies the mind in vain; the Subject line appearing but not riding strength, going to see him, he is surely not at home. With the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure, each suspects the other; with the Subject line weak, on what could I rely?

dispute.yi: 断易天机转引的这首（「海底眼云」），第一二句作「世应坐鬼枉劳心」，第三句作「用爻出现不乘土」；这里作「世应作鬼」「用爻出现不乘旺」。「坐」「作」一字之差关系不大，但「不乘土」和「不乘旺」差得远：前者说用爻没有落在土爻上，后者说用爻没有得旺。两本都没有解释，本库各照原书录，不裁定。
dispute.en: The poem as quoted in the Duanyi Tianji ('the Eye at the Bottom of the Sea says') has 'the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure, the mind wearied in vain' in its first two lines and 'the Subject line appearing but not riding Earth' in the third, while here it reads 'the Self or the Other as Pressure' and 'not riding strength'. The one-word difference between 'sit' and 'be' matters little, but 'not riding Earth' and 'not riding strength' are far apart: the first says the Subject line does not stand on an Earth line, the second that it has not gained strength. Neither book explains it, and each is recorded as its book gives it, without adjudication.

yi: 拜谒人，要问拜谒的是什么人；
世、应作了鬼，白费心思；
用爻出现却不乘旺，
去见他，一定不在家里。
en: In calling on someone, ask whom one is calling on;
with the Self or the Other as Pressure, one wearies the mind in vain;
the Subject line appearing but not riding strength,
going to see him, he is surely not at home.

yi: 世、应坐着官鬼，
双方互相猜疑；
如果用爻衰弱了，
我还能凭靠什么呢？
en: With the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure,
each suspects the other;
if the Subject line is weak,
on what could I rely?

title: 六亲爻动·求官谒贵：子动谒贵求官休进用（主用被伤）、守旧当占可自然；妻财动克文书应举求官总是虚；官鬼动更改动谋皆不行

rule.yi: 子孙发动，谒见贵人、求官不要进取（主用爻被伤），守旧倒还可以顺其自然；妻财发动克了文书，应举、求官总是落空（文书受伤）；官鬼发动，更改、动谋都不行（鬼动，所以受阻隔）。
rule.en: With Output moving, do not press forward in calling on a noble or seeking office (the Subject line is injured), and holding to the old can be left to take its course; with Wealth moving and controlling the documents, taking the examination or seeking office is all empty (the documents are injured); with Pressure moving, neither changes nor schemes will do (Pressure moving brings obstruction).

note.yi: 「守旧当占可自然」意思不清，这里按「守着旧的、就此占问，可顺其自然」译，不确定。这一段是各问题通用的歌，每句括号里的小注是原书的。
note.en: 'Hold to the old, in such a divination it is natural' is unclear in sense and is translated as 'holding to the old, in such a divination it can be left to take its course', which is uncertain. This is a song common to all kinds of questions, and the small notes in brackets after each line are the book's own.

zh: 谒贵求官休进用（主用被伤），
yi: 谒见贵人、求官，不要进取（主用爻被伤）；
守着旧的、就这样占问，倒可以顺其自然。
en: calling on a noble or seeking office, do not press forward (the Subject line is injured);
holding to the old, in such a divination it can be left to take its course.

zh: 妻财发用克文书（财能克文），
应举求官总是虚（文书受伤），
yi: 妻财发动，克了文书（财能克文），
应举、求官总是落空（文书受伤），
en: Wealth moving and controlling the documents (Wealth can control the documents),
taking the examination or seeking office is all empty (the documents are injured),

zh: 更改动谋皆不行（鬼动阻隔）。
yi: 更改、动谋都不行（鬼动，所以受阻隔）。
en: neither changes nor schemes will do (Pressure moving brings obstruction).

title: 六亲爻变·官化官见贵求官事尽难（有名无实）、官化文书官未顺

rule.yi: 官化官，病没有安好；拜见贵人、求官，事事都难（有名无实）；官化文书，官运还不顺（官位高过文书，文书就难）；纵然忧愁、疾病，也还算吉。
rule.en: Pressure turning into Pressure, the illness is not yet settled; in calling on a noble or seeking office everything is hard (name without substance); Pressure turning into the documents, the office does not yet go smoothly (with Pressure ahead of the documents, the documents are hard); even so, worry and illness are still auspicious.

zh: 官化官兮病未安（谓之化去），
见贵求官事尽难（有名无实），
官化文书官未顺（官超文难），
纵能忧病还为吉（病凶亦吉）。
yi: 官化官，病就没有安好（小注：这叫化去）；
拜见贵人、求官，事事都难（小注：有名无实）；
官化文书，官运还不顺（小注：官位高过文书，文书就难）；
纵使忧愁、疾病，也还算吉（小注：病凶也吉）。
en: Pressure turning into Pressure, the illness is not yet settled (note: this is called turning away);
in calling on a noble or seeking office everything is hard (note: name without substance);
Pressure turning into the documents, the office does not yet go smoothly (note: with Pressure ahead of the documents, the documents are hard);
even so, worry and illness are still auspicious (note: a grave illness is also auspicious).

title: 六亲爻变·父化：父化同人多口舌、同求婉转须重叠；父化财交易利、家长不宁求事拙；父化官家误失、求官必得近高职、卦无父母事无头、休囚空费力

rule.yi: 父化同人，多有口舌；一起求谋，要曲折婉转、重重叠叠（纵然成了也要重新更改）；父化财，做买卖有利（先难后易），家里长辈不安宁、求事笨拙（化成财克了父）；父化官，家里有耽误、有失（化成鬼，不适宜），求官必定得到靠近高位的职务（官、父两个月），卦里没有父母，事情没有头绪（父母是总体），再在休囚，白费力气（父母衰，后来劳苦）。
rule.en: Resource turning into a companion (Peer), there is much quarrelling; seeking together, it winds and turns and must be layered (even if it succeeds it must be changed again); Resource turning into Wealth, trading is profitable (hard first, then easy), but the elders of the house are unsettled and seeking a matter goes clumsily (turning into Wealth controls Resource); Resource turning into Pressure, the household suffers delay and loss (turning into Pressure is unsuitable), and seeking office one is sure to get a post near a high one (the two months of Pressure and Resource); with no Resource in the hexagram the matter has no head (Resource is the whole body), and if it is also at rest or trapped, effort is spent in vain (Resource weak, labour afterwards).

note.yi: 「官父两月」小注没有解释，这里照字面译作「官、父两个月」，可能指官鬼、父母爻所值的月份，不确定。「父化同人」的「同人」，小注说是「化兄」，按兄弟译。「虎易注：此篇各节明显错乱」，海底眼这一整段原书就有今人标出的错乱，这几句的先后读起来也有跳跃。
note.en: The small note 'the two months of Pressure and Resource' is not explained and is translated literally; it may mean the months ruled by the Pressure and Resource lines, which is uncertain. For 'Resource turning into a companion', the small note says 'turning into Peer', and it is translated as Peer. A modern editor remarks of this part of the Haidi Yan that its sections are plainly in disorder, and these lines too read with jumps.

zh: 父化同人多口舌（化兄是非），
同求婉转须重叠（纵成重更），
父化财兮交易利（先难后易），
家长不宁求事拙（化财克父）。
父化官兮家悮失（化鬼不宜），
求官必得近高职（官父两月），
卦无父母事无头（父为统体），
更在休囚空费力（父衰后劳）。
yi: 父化同人，多有口舌（小注：化兄，就有是非）；
一起求谋，要曲折婉转、重重叠叠（小注：纵然成了也要重新更改）；
父化财，做买卖有利（小注：先难后易）；
家里长辈不安宁，求事笨拙（小注：化成财克了父）。
父化官，家里有耽误、有失（小注：化成鬼，不适宜）；
求官必定得到靠近高位的职务（小注：官、父两个月）；
卦里没有父母，事情没有头绪（小注：父母是总体）；
再在休囚，白费力气（小注：父母衰，后来劳苦）。
en: Resource turning into a companion, there is much quarrelling (note: turning into Peer brings disputes);
seeking together, it winds and turns and must be layered (note: even if it succeeds it must be changed again);
Resource turning into Wealth, trading is profitable (note: hard first, then easy);
the elders of the house are unsettled and seeking a matter goes clumsily (note: turning into Wealth controls Resource).
Resource turning into Pressure, the household suffers delay and loss (note: turning into Pressure is unsuitable);
seeking office one is sure to get a post near a high one (note: the two months of Pressure and Resource);
with no Resource in the hexagram the matter has no head (note: Resource is the whole body);
and if it is also at rest or trapped, effort is spent in vain (note: Resource weak, labour afterwards).

title: 六亲爻变·谋托：官化兄朋友诈、安托人心不似初；官化财财自得；官中无鬼难谋事、官员不见事空虚；托用人情不一心（托人不宜）

rule.yi: 官化兄，朋友有欺诈，安心托付的人心思已不像当初；官化财，钱财自然得到，赌博、抽签拈阄总不如意；官员里没有官鬼，难以谋事，官员不出现，事情落空；托人情办事，人不一条心（不适宜托人）。
rule.en: Pressure turning into Peer, friends are deceitful and the one trusted with a favour no longer has the heart he had at first; Pressure turning into Wealth, money comes of itself, but gambling and drawing lots are never as one wishes; with no Pressure in the office, planning a matter is hard, and with the official not appearing the matter is empty; relying on favours, hearts are not as one (it is not suitable to entrust it to others).

zh: 官化兄兮朋友诈（鬼兄诓诈），
官化财兮财自得（财能生官），
赌博抽拈总不如（件件不宜）。
官中无鬼难谋事（无鬼不成），
官员不见事空虚（见官无主）。
yi: 官化兄，朋友有欺诈（小注：鬼和兄都主诓骗欺诈）；
安心托付的人，心思已不像当初（小注：同上）；
官化财，钱财自然得到（小注：财能生官）；
赌博、抽签拈阄，总不如意（小注：件件都不适宜）。
官员里没有官鬼，难以谋事（小注：没有鬼就不成）；
官员不出现，事情落空（小注：见官没有主心骨）。
en: Pressure turning into Peer, friends are deceitful (note: Pressure and Peer both mean cheating and deceit);
the one trusted with a favour no longer has the heart he had at first (note: as above);
Pressure turning into Wealth, money comes of itself (note: Wealth can generate Pressure);
gambling and drawing lots are never as one wishes (note: none of them is suitable).
with no Pressure in the office, planning a matter is hard (note: without Pressure it cannot succeed);
with the official not appearing, the matter is empty (note: in seeing an official there is no master).

zh: 托用人情不一心（托人不宜）。
yi: 托人情办事，人不一条心（小注：不适宜托人）。
en: relying on favours, hearts are not as one (note: it is not suitable to entrust it to others).

title: 六神爻动·朱雀白虎：朱雀交重文印旺、杀神相并徒劳功、持水临空却利公；白虎交重惊怪事、求官临鬼反丰隆（虎官利名）

rule.yi: 朱雀交重发动，文书印绶旺（朱雀属火）；和杀神并在一起，就白劳功夫（并上凶神就没有文）；是非口舌都由此而来；持水、临空，反而有利于公事。白虎交重，是惊恐怪异之事（白虎属金）；求官时临在官鬼上，反而丰盛隆盛（虎与官有利于名）。
rule.en: With the Vermilion Bird moving heavily, the documents and the seal and ribbon are strong (the Vermilion Bird belongs to Fire); joined with a baleful spirit, the labour is spent in vain (joined to an ill spirit there are no documents); quarrels and gossip all come from this; holding Water or standing in the void, it is on the contrary favourable to public business. With the White Tiger moving heavily it is fright and strange things (the White Tiger belongs to Metal); in seeking office, standing on Pressure, it brings abundance and prosperity on the contrary (the Tiger and Pressure favour a name).

note.yi: 白虎一般主凶，这里却说白虎交重、临官鬼时求官反而「丰隆」，是原文的说法，本库照录，不改；周易尚占里有同一句（「求官临鬼反丰隆」）。
note.en: The White Tiger generally stands for ill, yet here the White Tiger moving heavily on Pressure is said on the contrary to bring 'abundance' in seeking office, as the text has it; it is recorded as it stands and not altered, and the same line is in the Zhouyi Shangzhan ('seeking office on Pressure brings abundance on the contrary').

zh: 朱雀交重文印旺（朱雀属火）杀神相并谩劳功（并凶无文），
是非口舌皆因此（多主口舌），
持水临空却利公（临太空吉）。
yi: 朱雀交重发动，文书印绶旺（小注：朱雀属火），和杀神并在一起，就白劳功夫（小注：并上凶神就没有文），
是非口舌都由此而来（小注：多主口舌）；
持水、临空，反而有利于公事（小注：临太空为吉）。
en: the Vermilion Bird moving heavily, the documents and the seal and ribbon are strong (note: the Vermilion Bird belongs to Fire), joined with a baleful spirit, the labour is spent in vain (note: joined to an ill spirit there are no documents),
quarrels and gossip all come from this (note: it mostly means quarrels);
holding Water or standing in the void, it is on the contrary favourable to public business (note: standing in great void is auspicious).

zh: 白虎交重惊怪事（白虎属金），
求官临鬼反丰隆（虎官利名），
yi: 白虎交重，是惊恐怪异之事（小注：白虎属金）；
求官时临在官鬼上，反而丰盛隆盛（小注：虎与官有利于名）。
en: the White Tiger moving heavily, it is fright and strange things (note: the White Tiger belongs to Metal);
in seeking office, standing on Pressure, it brings abundance and prosperity on the contrary (note: the Tiger and Pressure favour a name).

title: 仕宦·旺相妻财，必得千钟之粟（旧注：未仕不要财爻、已仕要见财爻；财旺俸禄多，财空财伏未得俸禄，财动逢冲减俸，冲财刑世官有停俸罢职之患）

rule.yi: 占做官，妻财就是俸禄。还没做官而求功名的人，不要财爻；已经做官的人，要见财爻，因为有爵位就有俸禄，没有没俸禄就能做官的。妻财旺相，俸禄一定多；休囚就微薄；卦里没有财或财落空亡，还没有俸禄；财动遇冲，任职以后会因事减俸；日辰月建冲财、又刑害世爻和官爻，恐怕有停发俸禄、罢职的祸患。
rule.en: In divining an office, Wealth is the salary. For one not yet in office who is seeking a name, Wealth is not wanted; for one already in office, Wealth is wanted, since where there is rank there is a stipend, and no one gets an office with no pay. When Wealth is thriving the salary is surely large; resting or trapped, it is meagre; if there is no Wealth in the hexagram or it falls Void, no salary has yet been received; if Wealth moves and meets a clash, the salary is cut after taking up the post, on account of some matter; and if the Day or the Month clashes Wealth while also punishing or harming the Self and Pressure, there may be the calamity of salary being stopped and dismissal from office.

note.yi: 这一首的前两句「为国求贤，治国之本；致身辅相，禄养为先」是章首的引语，不是判断；卜筮正宗写作「治民为本」。「千钟之粟」的「钟」是古时量粮的单位，「千钟」是说俸禄很多。「未仕求名，不要财爻」是说还没做官的人求功名时，财爻反而不要（财克父母，妨文书），这和黄金策求名章「财若交重，休望青钱之中选」是同一个道理（求名章在「考试」一域）；已经做官的就要有财，因为官有俸禄。「禄养」是靠俸禄养身养家。卜筮正宗把「兴隆官鬼」那一联的注和这一联的注写在一起，所以王洪绪这一段的后两句（官鬼旺相、发动生合世爻）分到 LY.CAREER.HJC.02。
note.en: The two opening lines of this entry, 'seeking worthies for the state is the root of governing it; giving oneself to assist the sovereign and his ministers, with the salary that sustains one coming first', are a preface and not a judgement; the Bushi Zhengzong writes 'the root of governing the people'. A 'zhong' is an ancient measure of grain, and 'a thousand zhong' means a large salary. 'For one not yet in office who is seeking a name, Wealth is not wanted' says that for someone not yet in office seeking a name, Wealth on the contrary is not wanted (Wealth controls Resource and harms the documents), the same reasoning as 'if Wealth moves heavily, do not hope to be chosen for the blue coins' in the chapter on seeking a name of this book (that chapter belongs to the domain of examinations); for one already in office there must be Wealth, since an office carries a stipend. 'The salary that sustains' is living and keeping a household on the stipend. The Bushi Zhengzong runs the comment on the couplet 'with Pressure flourishing' together with the comment on this couplet, so the last two sentences of Wang Hongxu's passage (Pressure thriving; moving to generate or combine with the Self) are placed in LY.CAREER.HJC.02.

yi: 为国家求贤才，是治国的根本；
献身辅佐君王和宰相，以俸禄养身为先。
妻财旺相，一定能得到千钟的俸米；
en: Seeking worthies for the state is the root of governing it;
to give oneself to assist the sovereign and his ministers, with the salary that sustains one coming first.
when Wealth is thriving, one will surely obtain a thousand zhong of grain;

if Wealth moves and meets a clash, the salary is cut on account of some matter;
if the Day or the Month clashes Wealth while also punishing or harming the Self and Pressure, there may be the calamity of salary being stopped and dismissal from office.

title: 仕宦·兴隆官鬼，定居一品之尊（旧注：鬼为官爵，旺相官高爵大、休囚死绝官小职卑；发动生合世爻、得月日生扶必有升擢；安静被克害无声名）

rule.yi: 官鬼代表官职和爵位：旺相有气，官高爵大；休囚死绝，官小职卑；发动去生合世爻，或者得到月建、日辰的生扶，一定有升迁提拔，名声远播京城；安静不动而被月建、日辰克害，或者被世爻刑冲克害，一定没有声名威望。
rule.en: Pressure stands for office and rank: thriving and with breath, the office is high and the rank great; resting, trapped, dead or in extinction, the office is small and the post low; moving to generate or combine with the Self, or generated and supported by the Month or the Day, there will surely be promotion and the name spreads far to the capital; still, and controlled or harmed by the Month or the Day, or punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by the Self, there will surely be no fame or standing.

note.yi: 「一品」是官阶里最高的一级，「定居一品之尊」是形容官鬼旺相时最好的情形，不是说一定做到一品。「声名闻望」是名声和威望。旧注说的「升擢，远播都下」，卜筮正宗改成「荐擢」（有人举荐提拔），意思略有不同：旧注是升迁加名声远传，王洪绪这里强调的是被举荐。
note.en: 'The first rank' is the highest grade of office, and 'one will surely hold the honoured place of the first rank' describes the best case when Pressure is thriving, and does not say that one will certainly reach the first rank. 'Fame and standing' is name and reputation. Where the old commentary says 'promotion, and the name spreads far to the capital', the Bushi Zhengzong changes it to 'recommendation and promotion' (someone recommends and raises one), a slightly different sense: the old commentary has promotion and a far-spreading name, and Wang Hongxu stresses being recommended.

zh: 兴隆官鬼，定居一品之尊。
yi: 官鬼兴隆旺盛，一定居于一品的尊位。
en: When Pressure is flourishing, one will surely hold the honoured place of the first rank.

resting, trapped, dead or in extinction, the office is small and the post low.

yi: 官鬼旺相的，官位高、爵位大；休囚死绝的，官位小、职务低。
如果发动生合世爻，得到月建、日辰生扶，一定有人举荐提拔。

title: 仕宦·子若交重，当虑剥官削职（旧注：子孙是伤官之杀，发动则所谋不遂；未仕不能除选、已仕有夺官褫职之祸，鬼爻无气必至除名落籍）

rule.yi: 子孙是伤官的煞，最喜欢它空亡墓绝，尤其适宜安静受制才吉。它如果在卦里发动，所谋的事必不遂意：没做官的得不到除授选用，已经做官的有被夺官革职的祸患；官鬼再无气，必定被除名、削去官籍，不只是贬责降罚。
rule.en: Output is the killer that harms office. It is best when Void, in a tomb or in extinction, and above all fitting when still and held in check. If it moves in the hexagram, what is planned will surely go against one's wish: one not yet in office cannot be appointed or selected, and one already in office has the calamity of being deprived of office and stripped of post; and if Pressure has no breath as well, one will surely be struck from the roll and removed from the register of office, which is more than being rebuked and demoted.

note.yi: 「除选」是朝廷任命、选用官员；「褫职」是革职；「落籍」是从官籍上除去。这里和占病、占财的说法反过来：占财、占病子孙都是吉神，占官却是「伤官之杀」，因为子孙克官鬼。同样的道理见黄金策求名章「福如发动，难期金榜之题名」（在「考试」一域）。
note.en: 'Appointment and selection' is the court appointing and choosing officers, 'stripped of post' is dismissal, and 'removed from the register' is being struck from the roll of officers. This is the reverse of divining illness or wealth, where Output is a lucky spirit, whereas in divining an office it is 'the killer that harms office', because Output controls Pressure. The same reasoning is in the chapter on seeking a name, 'if Output moves, do not hope to be listed on the golden roll' (that chapter belongs to the domain of examinations).

title: 仕宦·兄如发动，须防减俸除粮（旧注：兄弟是劫财之神，发动费财多招诽谤；与子孙同发或化子孙必有除粮减俸，持世临身皆不利）

rule.yi: 兄弟是劫财的神。它空亡、不上卦，或者临死绝而安静，就吉；如果发动，免不了花费钱财、招来诽谤，俸禄也不称心；再和子孙一起发动，或者就化成子孙，必有被除粮、减俸的事；持世、临身都不利。
rule.en: Peer is the spirit that robs wealth. If it is Void, absent from the hexagram, or in death or extinction and still, it is auspicious; if it moves, there is bound to be spending of money and slander, and the salary will not be to one's liking; if it moves together with Output, or turns directly into Output, there will surely be grain struck off and salary cut; holding the Self or settling on the Body is in every case unfavourable.

The preceding entry, LY.CAREER.HJC.01, says that a moving Wealth meeting a clash cuts the salary, and this one says that a moving Peer cuts it: in one Wealth is clashed and in the other Peer robs Wealth, both speak of the salary being cut, and the book does not say which is the heavier.

title: 仕宦·父母空亡，休望差除宣敕（旧注：父母为印绶文书诰牒宣敕，持太岁生合世爻有朝廷宣召，加月建是敕制或上司奖励；冲空化空多不实，衰静空亡无宣敕、卦无父母休望迁选）

rule.yi: 父母爻是印绶、文书、诰牒、宣敕、奏疏、表章，卦里不能没有它，宜旺不宜衰，扶助世爻最吉。它持太岁、有气、生合世爻，主有朝廷的宣召；再加月建，多是敕令制命和上司的奖励；最怕冲、空、化空，那就多半不实；衰弱安静又空亡，必定没有宣敕，也没有差遣任命；卦里没有父母，别指望迁升选用。
rule.en: Resource is the seal and ribbon, documents, patents, imperial edicts, memorials and petitions. It cannot be missing from the hexagram, should be thriving and not weak, and supporting the Self is the most auspicious. If it holds the Tai Sui with breath and generates or combines with the Self, there will be a summons from the court; with the Month added, it is mostly an edict or a commendation from superiors; what is most feared is a clash, Void or turning into Void, and then it is mostly unreal; if weak, still and Void, there will surely be no edict and no appointment; if Resource is not in the hexagram, do not hope for promotion or selection.

note.yi: 「印缓」是「印绶」（官印和系印的丝带）的误写，卜筮大全的原文就是这样写的，译文按「印绶」读。「宣敕」是皇帝的诏命，「诰牒」是授官的文书，「差除」是差遣、任命。这一条是说做官的「文书」：没有父母就没有任命、没有升迁。
note.en: 'Seal and ribbon' in the Bushi Daquan is written with a wrong character for 'ribbon' (the original prints it that way), and the translation reads 'seal and ribbon'. 'Edict' is an imperial decree, 'patent' is the document conferring office, and 'posting and appointment' is being sent out on a commission or being appointed. This entry is about the 'documents' of an official career: with no Resource there is no appointment and no promotion.

zh: 父母空亡，休望差除宣敕；
yi: 父母爻空亡，别指望得到差遣、任命和宣敕；
en: If Resource is Void, do not hope for a posting, an appointment or an imperial edict;

If the Month is added, it is mostly an edict and a commendation from superiors and the like.
What is most feared is a clash, Void or turning into Void, and then it is mostly unreal.

若持太岁有气，生合世爻，主有朝廷宣召，如加月建，乃上司奖励之类；
yi: 父母爻是印绶、文书、诰牒、宣敕、奏书、表章，卦中不能没有，宜旺不宜衰，扶助世爻最吉。

if Void, do not hope for it.

title: 仕宦·官爻隐伏，莫思爵位升迁（旧注：官爻临持身世或生合世爻不受月日冲克必称意；不上卦、落空亡、墓绝无气、受克制皆不如意，世身冲克亦凶）

rule.yi: 官爻是占官的象。它临持身世，或者来生合世爻，又不受月建、日辰冲克，凡有谋求必然称心；如果不上卦，或者落空亡，或者虽然出现却墓绝无气、受克制，都不如意；世爻、身爻被冲克，也凶。
rule.en: Pressure is the image in divining an office. If it settles on the Body or the Self, or comes to generate or combine with the Self, and is not clashed or controlled by the Month or the Day, whatever is sought will surely turn out to one's liking; if it is absent from the hexagram or falls Void, or even though it appears is in a tomb or extinction and without breath, or controlled, nothing will be as one wishes; a clash or control on the Self or the Body is also ominous.

note.yi: 这一条是「占官」的基本判据：官爻（官鬼）是用神，看它在不在、有没有气、被不被冲克，再看它和世身的关系。旧注把不如意的几种情形都列出来（不上卦、落空亡、墓绝无气、受克制），王洪绪只写了吉的一半。
note.en: This entry is the basic criterion of 'divining an office': the Pressure line is the Subject, and one sees whether it is present, whether it has breath, whether it is clashed or controlled, and then its relation to the Self and the Body. The old commentary lists the ways it can go wrong (absent from the hexagram, Void, in a tomb or extinction without breath, controlled), and Wang Hongxu writes only the auspicious half.

zh: 官爻隐伏，莫思爵位升迁。
yi: 官爻隐伏不现，就别想爵位升迁。
en: If Pressure lies hidden and does not appear, do not think of rank and promotion.

zh: 若得临持身世，或来生合世爻，不受月建日辰冲克者，凡有谋望，必然称意。
若不上卦，或落空亡，虽出现墓绝无气，及受克制，皆不如意。

如果它临持身世，或者来生合世爻，不受月建、日辰冲克，凡有谋求，必然称心。
如果不上卦，或者落空亡，即使出现而墓绝无气，以及受到克制，都不如意。
世爻、身爻被冲克，也凶。
en: Pressure is the image in divining an office.

If it settles on the Body or the Self, or comes to generate or combine with the Self, and is not clashed or controlled by the Month or the Day, whatever is sought will surely turn out to one's liking.
If it is absent from the hexagram or falls Void, or even if it appears but is in a tomb or extinction and without breath, or is controlled, nothing will be as one wishes.
A clash or control on the Self or the Body is also ominous.

zh: 官爻临持身世，或动来生合世爻，不受月建日辰冲克者，凡有谋望，必能称意。
yi: 官爻临持身世，或者动来生合世爻，不受月建、日辰冲克的，凡有谋求，必能称心。
en: If Pressure settles on the Body or the Self, or moves to generate or combine with the Self, and is not clashed or controlled by the Month or the Day, whatever is sought will surely turn out to one's liking.

title: 仕宦·月建生身当际风云之会，岁君合世必承雨露之恩（旧注：太岁为君、月建为执政之官，生合世身必有好处，冲克世身必遭贬谪；月建扶出官爻世爻是风宪之职，太岁加父母扶出官鬼及世爻必有天恩）

rule.yi: 太岁是君主的象，月建是执政的官。它们如果生合世爻、身爻，必有好处；只怕冲克世身，必定遭到贬谪。月建扶出官爻、世爻，必是风宪的职位；太岁加在父母上、扶出官鬼和世爻的，必有天恩，再得日辰在生旺之地更好；衰绝、遇空就没有用。
rule.en: The Tai Sui is the image of the sovereign, and the Month is the officer who holds government. If they generate or combine with the Self or the Body, there will surely be benefit; what is feared is that they clash or control the Self or the Body, and then one will surely be demoted and exiled. If the Month supports Pressure or the Self, it is surely a post in the censorate; if the Tai Sui is added to Resource and supports Pressure and the Self, there will surely be the Emperor's favour, better still if the Day then stands in a thriving place; if weak, in extinction or Void, it is of no use.

note.yi: 「风云之会」是君臣相遇、得志的时候，「雨露之恩」是君主的恩泽。「风宪」是负责监察、执法的官署（御史台、按察司一类）。这一联里「太岁」是君、「月建」是执政的官，也就是做官的人头上的两层上司，所以放在「贵人」这一题下。「贬谪」是降职并外放。注里「月建扶出官爻世爻者必是风宪之职」「太岁加父母扶出官鬼及世爻者必有天恩」两句，是占某一类官的象，见 LY.CAREER.HJC.19 以下几条。
note.en: 'The gathering of wind and cloud' is the time when a ruler and his minister meet and the minister achieves his aim, and 'the favour of rain and dew' is the sovereign's grace. 'The censorate' is the office that supervises and enforces the law (the Censorate, the Surveillance Commission and the like). In this couplet the Tai Sui is the sovereign and the Month the officer who holds government, that is, the two levels of superiors above an official, and so the entry is placed under 'patrons and superiors'. The two sentences in the commentary 'if the Month supports Pressure or the Self, it is surely a post in the censorate' and 'if the Tai Sui is added to Resource and supports Pressure and the Self, there will surely be the Emperor's favour' say what kind of post, which are taken up again in the entries from LY.CAREER.HJC.19 onwards.

zh: 月建生身，当际风云之会；
岁君合世，必承雨露之恩。
yi: 月建生身，正逢风云际会；
岁君合世，必然承受雨露的恩泽。
en: When the Month generates the Body, one meets the gathering of wind and cloud;
when the Tai Sui (the Year Lord) combines with the Self, one will surely receive the favour of rain and dew.
