if the Tai Sui is added to Resource and supports Pressure and the Self, there will surely be the Emperor's favour, and better still if it is thriving.

title: 仕宦·世动逢空，官居不久（旧注：未任世动必无京官牧守、出巡之职反顺利；已任遇之居官不久，日辰动爻相冲必不久任政事）

rule.yi: 世爻发动又遇空亡：没做官的，卦中世爻发动，必定得不到京官、牧守一类的职位，不过如果是出巡的职位，反而顺利；已经做官的遇到这种情形，居官不久，再遇日辰、动爻相冲，必定不能长久任职理政。
rule.en: If the Self moves and meets Void: for one not yet in office, with the Self moving in the hexagram, one will surely get no post as a capital official or a governor or magistrate, though if it is a post of touring and inspecting it goes smoothly on the contrary; for one already in office, meeting this means one will not stay long in office, and if the Day or a moving line also clashes it, one will surely not hold the post and govern for long.

note.yi: 「牧守」是牧民之官，即州郡的长官；「京官」是在京城任职的官。「出巡」是出外巡视的差使（见 LY.CAREER.HJC.23）。这里的两种读法：旧注说出巡的职位「反为顺利」（没分已任未任），王洪绪说「反利己任」，「己」按上下文是「已」的误写，译作「有利于已经任职的」；两家差一点：旧注是出巡这类差使世动逢空都顺，王洪绪限在已经任职的人身上。
note.en: 'Governor or magistrate' is the officer who shepherds the people, that is, the head of a prefecture or commandery, and 'capital official' is one holding office in the capital. 'Touring and inspecting' is a commission to go out on a tour of inspection (see LY.CAREER.HJC.23). The two commentators read the last point a little differently: the old commentary says that a post of touring 'goes smoothly on the contrary' (without distinguishing already in office from not yet), while Wang Hongxu writes 'is on the contrary favourable to the one in office', where the printed character for 'in office' is a misprint of the similar character 'already' and is translated 'one already in office'; the old commentary says that for this kind of commission the Self moving into Void goes smoothly in general, and Wang Hongxu confines it to the person already in office.

yi: 世爻发动又遇空亡，做官居位不久；
en: If the Self moves and meets Void, one will not stay long in office;

zh: 未任：卦中世动，必无京官牧守；
若是出巡之职，反为顺利。
更遇日辰动爻相冲，必不久任政事。
yi: 没做官的：卦中世爻发动，必定得不到京官、牧守一类的职位；
如果是出巡的职位，反而顺利。
已经做官的：遇到这种情形，居官不久。
再遇到日辰、动爻相冲，必定不能长久任职理政。
en: For one not yet in office: if the Self moves in the hexagram, one will surely get no post as a capital official or a governor or magistrate;
if it is a post of touring and inspecting, it goes smoothly on the contrary.
For one already in office: meeting this, one will not stay long in office.
If the Day or a moving line also clashes it, one will surely not hold the post and govern for long.

zh: 若是出巡之职，世动逢空反利己任；
遇日辰动爻相冲，必不久任政事。
yi: 如果是出巡的职位，世爻发动逢空反而有利于已经任职的；
遇到日辰、动爻相冲，必定不能长久任职理政。
en: If it is a post of touring and inspecting, the Self moving into Void is on the contrary favourable to one already in office;
if the Day or a moving line clashes it, one will surely not hold the post and govern for long.

title: 仕宦·身空无救，命尽当危（旧注：世爻无故自空，不拘已任未任必有大难甚至死亡，求谋干事则不成）

rule.yi: 世爻无缘无故自己落空亡又没有救助，不管已经任职还是没有任职，必有大难，甚至死亡；想谋求办事的，主不成。
rule.en: If the Self falls Void by itself without cause and there is no rescue, whether one is already in office or not, there will surely be a great calamity, even death; and if one wants to seek or manage something, it will not succeed.

note.yi: 「无故自空」是指世爻落空亡，而日辰、月建、动爻都没有伤克它（不是因为被伤克而空）。这个说法在黄金策总断千金赋里就是「无故勿空」，两家读法相反，见 LY.ILL.HJC.151：旧注说无故自空是大凶，王洪绪说旧注把意思弄反了。这里的旧注和王洪绪都取「大凶」的读法，没有分歧。
note.en: 'Void by itself without cause' means the Self falls into Void while the Day, the Month and the moving lines have not injured it (it is not Void because it was injured). This is the line 'without cause, do not be Void' in the Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements, which the two commentators read in opposite ways, see LY.ILL.HJC.151: the old commentary says that Void without cause is greatly ominous, and Wang Hongxu says the old commentary has the sense backwards. Here the old commentary and Wang Hongxu both take the 'greatly ominous' reading, and there is no disagreement.

yi: 世爻空亡又得不到救助，命数将尽，就有危险。
en: When the Self is Void with no rescue, one's life is spent and in danger.

zh: 世爻无故自空，不拘已任未任，必有大难，甚至死亡。
若欲求谋干事，则主不成。
yi: 世爻无缘无故自己落空，不管已经任职还是没有任职，必有大难，甚至死亡。
如果想谋求办事，就主不成。
en: If the Self falls Void by itself without cause, whether already in office or not, there will surely be a great calamity, even death.
If one wants to seek or manage something, it will not succeed.

zh: 世临无救之空，不拘已任未任，必有大难甚至死亡；
若欲求谋干事，则主不成。
yi: 世爻临着无救的空亡，不管已经任职还是没有任职，必有大难，甚至死亡；
如果想谋求办事，就主不成。
en: If the Self rests on a Void with no rescue, whether already in office or not, there will surely be a great calamity, even death;
if one wants to seek or manage something, it will not succeed.

title: 仕宦·鬼化福冲当代职（旧注：出巡官宜鬼动、牧守官宜鬼静；鬼动化子必有别官代职；子动化鬼先难后易；官福皆动亦主有官替代）

rule.yi: 出巡的官，适合官鬼发动；牧守一类的官，适合官鬼安静。如果官鬼发动、化出子孙，必有别的官员来代理职务，不然也会被别人抢在前面；子孙发动化出官鬼，就是先难后易，或者先凶后吉；官鬼和子孙都发动，也主有官员来接替。
rule.en: For an officer on tour, it is fitting that Pressure moves; for a governor or magistrate, it is fitting that Pressure is still. If Pressure moves and turns into Output, another officer will surely come to take over the post, or one is otherwise forestalled by someone else; if Output moves and turns into Pressure, it is hard first and easy later, or ominous first and fortunate later; if both Pressure and Output move, it likewise means an officer comes to replace one.

note.yi: 经文的「福冲」是说官鬼动化出子孙（福）、又被冲；「当代职」是「会有人来替代」。出巡官与牧守官对官鬼动静的要求相反：出巡是外出差使，官鬼动才有事可办；牧守是坐镇一地，官鬼静才稳。同一个判据又见 LY.CAREER.HJC.22（牧守）和 LY.CAREER.HJC.23（出巡）。
note.en: 'Turns into Output and is clashed' in the verse means Pressure moving and turning into Output (the 'blessing' line) and then being clashed, and 'another takes over the post' means that someone will come to replace one. An officer on tour and a governor or magistrate need opposite things of Pressure: touring is a commission outside, where Pressure must move for there to be business to do, and a magistrate is posted in one place, where Pressure must be still for the post to be steady. The same criteria are met again in LY.CAREER.HJC.22 (governing) and LY.CAREER.HJC.23 (touring).

yi: 官鬼发动化出子孙又遇冲，会有别的官员来代理职务；
en: When Pressure moves, turns into Output and is clashed, another officer will come to take over the post;

zh: 若鬼动化子，必有别官代职。
子动化鬼，则先难后易，或先凶后吉。
官福皆动，亦主有官替代。
yi: 出巡的官，适合官鬼发动；
牧守一类的官，适合官鬼安静。
如果官鬼发动化出子孙，必有别的官员来代理职务。
不然，也会被别人抢在前头。
子孙发动化出官鬼，就是先难后易，或者先凶后吉。
官鬼和子孙都发动，也主有官员来接替。
en: For an officer on tour, it is fitting that Pressure moves;
for a governor or magistrate, it is fitting that Pressure is still.
If Pressure moves and turns into Output, another officer will surely come to take over the post.
Otherwise one is also forestalled by someone else.
If Output moves and turns into Pressure, it is hard first and easy later, or ominous first and fortunate later.
If both Pressure and Output move, it likewise means an officer comes to replace one.

zh: 出巡官宜鬼爻发动，牧守官宜官爻安静，若鬼动化子，必有别官代替。
yi: 出巡的官适合官鬼发动，牧守的官适合官爻安静，如果官鬼发动化出子孙，必有别的官员来代替。
en: An officer on tour should have Pressure moving and a governor or magistrate should have Pressure still, and if Pressure moves and turns into Output, another officer will surely come to take his place.

title: 仕宦·财临虎动必丁忧（旧注：占官不可无财亦不可发动；鬼有气得财动扶起须用财谋干方得升迁；父衰财临白虎旺动必有丁忧）

rule.yi: 占官，不能没有财爻，也不能让它发动。如果官鬼有气，又得到财爻发动来扶起，就必须用钱财去谋求打点，才能升迁；如果父母衰弱，又遇到这一爻加临白虎旺相发动，必有丁忧（为父母守丧）的事；财化子孙、子孙化财，或财临世发动，或子孙发动而父母无故自己空亡的，都主丁忧。
rule.en: In divining an office, Wealth cannot be missing, nor should it move. If Pressure has breath and is raised up by a moving Wealth, one must use money to seek and arrange it before one is promoted; if Resource is weak and this line, settled on the White Tiger, moves in strength, there will surely be a mourning for a parent; and if Wealth turns into Output, or Output into Wealth, or Wealth settles on the Self and moves, or Output moves while Resource falls Void by itself without cause, in all these cases there will be mourning.

note.yi: 「丁忧」是官员遭遇父母丧事，要离职守孝（通常二十七个月）。财克父母（文书），所以财动、父母衰是丁忧的象。「用财谋干」是花钱打点，书里没有说怎么打点。卜筮大全旧注说的是「财临虎动」（财爻临白虎发动），卜筮正宗把经文改成「财临福动」（财爻临子孙发动），可是它的注里仍写「加临白虎旺动」；「福」像是「虎」的误写，或是另有传本，书里没有说明，译文按卜筮大全的「虎」读。王洪绪把「忧丁」和旧注的「丁忧」是同一个词（丁忧）的两种写法。另有「官鬼有气得财动扶起」一句，卜筮正宗改写为「鬼爻无气而得财动扶起」：旧注说鬼有气、财动扶起，王洪绪说鬼无气、财动扶起，一个是锦上添花，一个是雪中送炭，但结论都是要用钱谋干。
note.en: 'Mourning' is the official's leave from post to observe mourning (usually twenty-seven months) on the death of a parent. Wealth controls Resource (the documents), so Wealth moving while Resource is weak is the sign of mourning. 'Use money to seek and arrange' means spending money to smooth the way, and the book does not say how. The old commentary of the Bushi Daquan says 'Wealth settled on the Tiger moves' (Wealth on the White Tiger moving), while the Bushi Zhengzong changes the verse to 'Wealth settled on Output moves', yet its commentary still says 'settled on the White Tiger and moving in strength'; the character printed 'Output' looks like a miswriting of 'Tiger', or there was another transmitted text, and the book does not say, and the translation follows the 'Tiger' of the Bushi Daquan. In one sentence the old commentary says 'if Pressure has breath and is raised up by a moving Wealth' and Wang Hongxu says 'if Pressure has no breath and is raised up by a moving Wealth': one adds flowers to brocade and the other sends charcoal in the snow, but both conclude that money must be used.

yi: 财爻临着白虎发动，必定有丁忧（守丧）；
en: When Wealth settles on the Tiger and moves, there will surely be a mourning for a parent;

zh: 凡占官，不可无财，亦不可发动。
若鬼爻有气，而得财动扶起，必须用财谋干，方得升迁。
若父母衰弱，而遇此爻加临白虎旺动者，必有丁忧之事。
财化子，子化财，或财临世动，或子动而父母无故自空者，皆主丁忧。
yi: 凡是占官，不能没有财爻，也不能让它发动。
如果官鬼有气，又得到财爻发动来扶起，就必须用钱财去谋求打点，才能升迁。
如果父母衰弱，又遇到这一爻加临白虎旺相发动，必有丁忧的事。
财化子孙，子孙化财，或者财临世爻发动，或者子孙发动而父母无故自己空亡的，都主丁忧。
en: In divining an office, Wealth cannot be missing, nor should it move.
If Pressure has breath and is raised up by a moving Wealth, one must use money to seek and arrange it before one is promoted.
If Resource is weak and this line, settled on the White Tiger, moves in strength, there will surely be a mourning.

If Wealth turns into Output, or Output into Wealth, or Wealth settles on the Self and moves, or Output moves while Resource falls Void by itself without cause, in all these cases there will be mourning.

zh: 凡占官不可无财，亦不可发动，若鬼爻无气而得财动扶起，必须用财谋干，方得升迁；
若父母衰弱，而遇此爻加临白虎旺动者，必有忧丁之事。
yi: 凡占官不可没有财，也不可发动，如果官鬼无气而得财爻发动扶起，必须用财谋求，才能升迁；
如果父母衰弱，而遇到这一爻加临白虎旺相发动的，必有忧丁的事。
en: In divining an office, Wealth must not be missing nor may it move, and if Pressure has no breath and is raised up by a moving Wealth, one must seek by means of money before one is promoted;
if Resource is weak and this line, settled on the White Tiger, moves in strength, there will surely be a mourning.

title: 仕宦·日辰冲克，定然诽谤之多招（旧注：日辰刑冲克世必招诽谤，依五类推：带兄弟贪贿赂或征科太急、带财无调度、带子孙嗜酒好游、带父母事繁剧、带官鬼酷刑或同僚不和；世临月建则无害）

rule.yi: 日辰刑冲克世爻，必定招来诽谤，按带的是哪一类六亲来推：带兄弟是因为贪贿赂或者征税太急，带财爻是因为调度无方或者赋税收不起来，带子孙是嗜酒好游、疏于政事，带父母是事务繁重料理不过来，带官鬼是酷刑或者同僚不和。以上都招诽谤，声名不能振作；如果世爻临月建，即使有诽谤也不能为害。
rule.en: If the Day punishes, clashes or controls the Self, slander will surely be invited, and one infers by which relation it carries: with Peer it is because of greed for bribes or collecting taxes too hastily, with Wealth because of poor management or revenue that cannot be raised, with Output because of fondness for wine and wandering and neglect of government, with Resource because affairs are heavy and cannot be managed, with Pressure because of harsh punishments or discord among colleagues. All of these invite slander and one's reputation cannot rise; but if the Self rests on the Month, even though there is slander it cannot do harm.

dispute.yi: 「带兄弟」那一类，两家说得不一样：旧注说带兄弟是贪图贿赂、征税太急，而把「嗜酒好游，疏于政事」归给子孙；王洪绪却说带兄弟是「贪酒好游，疏于政事」，而且他只列了兄弟、父母、官鬼三类，没有提财爻和子孙。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: On what carrying Peer means, the two commentators differ: the old commentary says that with Peer it is greed for bribes and over-hasty tax collecting and gives 'fondness for wine and wandering and neglect of government' to Output, while Wang Hongxu says that with Peer it is 'greed for drink and wandering and neglect of the business of government', and lists only three kinds, Peer, Resource and Pressure, saying nothing of Wealth or Output. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 「依五类推之」的「五类」是五种六亲（兄弟、财、子孙、父母、官鬼）。「征科」是征收赋税，「调度」是筹措调配钱粮。这一联是「日辰克世」的一个具体判据，和 LY.CAREER.HJC.15（太岁加刑）是同一类：都是上面的人（日辰、太岁）压到世爻上，招来的是诽谤、贬责。
note.en: 'The five kinds' in 'infer by the five kinds' are the five relations (Peer, Wealth, Output, Resource and Pressure). 'Collecting taxes' is levying taxes and 'management' is raising and allotting money and grain. This couplet is one concrete criterion under 'the Day controls the Self', of the same kind as LY.CAREER.HJC.15 (the Tai Sui with punishment added): in both something above (the Day, the Tai Sui) presses on the Self and what it brings is slander and rebuke.

zh: 日辰冲克，定然诽谤之多招；
yi: 日辰冲克世爻，一定会招来很多诽谤；
en: When the Day clashes or controls the Self, there will surely be much slander;

hits.text: 日辰冲克，定然诽谤之多招
日辰冲克，定然诽谤之多招

zh: 日辰刑冲克世，必招诽谤。
如带兄弟，因贪贿赂，或征科太急。
带财爻，因无调度，或财赋不起。
带子孙，嗜酒好游，怠于政事。
带父母，因事繁剧，不能料理。
带官鬼，非酷刑，则同僚不和。
以上皆招诽谤，声名必不能振。
若得世临月建，虽有诽谤，不能为害。
yi: 日辰刑冲克世爻，必定招来诽谤。
按五类来推。
如果带兄弟，是因为贪图贿赂，或者征收赋税太急。
带财爻，是因为没有调度，或者财赋收不起来。
带子孙，是嗜酒好游，疏于政事。
带父母，是因为事务繁重，料理不过来。
带官鬼，不是酷刑，就是同僚不和。
以上都是招来诽谤，声名一定不能振作。
如果世爻临月建，即使有诽谤，也不能为害。
en: If the Day punishes, clashes or controls the Self, slander will surely be invited.
Infer by the five kinds.
If it carries Peer, it is because of greed for bribes or collecting taxes too hastily.
If it carries Wealth, it is because of poor management, or because revenue cannot be raised.
If it carries Output, it is fondness for wine and wandering and neglect of the business of government.
If it carries Resource, it is because affairs are heavy and cannot be managed.
If it carries Pressure, it is either harsh punishments or discord among colleagues.
All the above invite slander, and one's reputation surely cannot rise.
If the Self rests on the Month, even though there is slander it cannot do harm.

zh: 日辰刑冲克世，必遭诽谤。
依五类推之，如带兄弟，因贪酒好游怠于政事；
带父母，因政事繁剧不能料理；
带官鬼，非酷刑则同僚不协。
若世临月建，虽有诽谤不能为害。
yi: 日辰刑冲克世爻，必遭诽谤。
按五类来推，比如带兄弟，是因为贪酒好游、疏于政事；
带父母，是因为政事繁重，料理不过来；
带官鬼，不是酷刑，就是同僚不协。
如果世爻临月建，即使有诽谤也不能为害。
en: If the Day punishes, clashes or controls the Self, one will surely suffer slander.
Infer by the five kinds: for instance, if it carries Peer, it is because of greed for drink and wandering and neglect of the business of government;
if it carries Resource, it is because the business of government is heavy and cannot be managed;
if it carries Pressure, it is either harsh punishments or discord among colleagues.
If the Self rests on the Month, even though there is slander it cannot do harm.

title: 仕宦·鬼杀伤身，因见灾殃之不免（旧注：官鬼发动生合世爻是用神、伤克世爻是鬼杀；以化出六亲断：化子贬谪、化财阴人之祸、化兄失财、化父忧小口；不然自身有灾病，世空避则无妨）

rule.yi: 官鬼发动，生合世爻的是用神，伤克世爻的是鬼煞。用神扶助世爻，必有进取；鬼煞伤到世身，必有凶祸。按它化出的六亲来断：化出子孙有被贬谪的忧虑，化出财有女人带来的祸患，化出兄弟主失财，化出父母要忧虑小孩；如果都不是这样，自己一定有灾病，得世爻空亡躲开才不妨。
rule.en: When Pressure moves, if it generates or combines with the Self it is the Subject, and if it harms or controls the Self it is a killer. When the Subject supports the Self there will surely be advancement; when a killer harms the Self and the Body there will surely be misfortune. Judge by the relation it turns into: into Output, the worry of being demoted and exiled; into Wealth, the calamity of a woman; into Peer, loss of wealth; into Resource, worry for the children; and if it is none of these, one will surely have calamity or illness oneself, and it is harmless only if the Self is Void and so avoids it.

note.yi: 这一联把官鬼分成两种：生合世爻的是「用神」（帮你的官），伤克世爻的是「鬼煞」（害你的鬼）。「阴人之祸」是女人带来的祸患，「小口」是小孩。旧注多出的「按化出的六亲断」「自身决有灾病」，王洪绪没有写。「得世爻空避不妨」是说世爻空亡时，鬼煞伤不到它，所以无妨；这和 LY.CAREER.HJC.09「身空无救」不矛盾：那里是世爻「无故自空」而且没有救，指的是命数，这里是用空亡躲避鬼煞。
note.en: This couplet divides Pressure into two kinds: the one that generates or combines with the Self is the 'Subject' (the official who helps you), and the one that injures or controls the Self is the 'killer' (the ghost that harms you). 'The calamity of a woman' is trouble brought by a woman, and 'the children' are the little ones. The old commentary has the additional 'judge by the relation it turns into' and 'one will surely have calamity or illness oneself', which Wang Hongxu does not write. 'Harmless if the Self is Void and so avoids it' says that when the Self is Void the killer cannot injure it, so it is harmless; this does not contradict LY.CAREER.HJC.09 ('the Body Void with no rescue'), where the Self falls Void by itself without cause and without rescue, which is about one's fate, whereas here Void is used to evade a killer.

zh: 鬼杀伤身，因见灾殃之不免。
yi: 官鬼成了鬼煞来伤世身，就免不了遇到灾殃。
en: When Pressure becomes a killer and harms the Self and the Body, calamity cannot be avoided.

hits.text: 鬼煞伤身，因见灾殃之不免
鬼杀伤身，因见灾殃之不免

zh: 官鬼发动，生合世爻为用神，伤克世爻为鬼杀。
如化子有贬谪之忧，化财有阴人之祸，化兄主失财，化父忧小口类。
以上不然，则自身决有灾病，得世爻空避不妨。
yi: 官鬼发动，生合世爻的是用神，伤克世爻的是鬼煞。
用神扶助世爻，必有进取；
鬼煞伤到世身，必有凶祸。
按它化出的六亲来断。
如果化出子孙，有被贬谪的忧虑，化出财，有女人带来的祸患，化出兄弟，主失财，化出父母，忧虑小孩一类。
以上都不是这样的话，那么自身一定有灾病，得世爻空亡躲开才不妨。
en: When Pressure moves, if it generates or combines with the Self it is the Subject, and if it harms or controls the Self it is a killer.
When the Subject supports the Self there will surely be advancement;
when a killer harms the Self and the Body there will surely be misfortune.
Judge by the relation it turns into.
If it turns into Output, there is the worry of being demoted and exiled; into Wealth, the calamity of a woman; into Peer, loss of wealth; into Resource, worry for the children and the like.
If it is none of these, then one will surely have calamity or illness oneself, and it is harmless only if the Self is Void and so avoids it.

zh: 官鬼动来生合世者为用神，如动来克伤世爻者为鬼煞。
生扶合世，必有进取之兆，刑冲克世，必有凶祸。
yi: 官鬼动来生合世爻的是用神，如果动来克伤世爻的就是鬼煞。
生扶合世，必有进取的预兆，刑冲克世，必有凶祸。
en: If Pressure moves to generate or combine with the Self it is the Subject, and if it moves to injure or control the Self it is a killer.
If it generates, supports or combines with the Self, there will surely be a sign of advancement, and if it punishes, clashes or controls the Self, there will surely be misfortune.

title: 仕宦·兄爻化鬼无情，同僚不协（旧注：兄弟为僚属之官，鬼动化兄冲克世爻或兄化鬼刑冲克害、兄带三刑六害伤世主同僚不和；世克兄爻是我欺他而不和）

rule.yi: 兄弟是僚属，也就是同僚、下属一类的官。卦中官鬼发动、化出兄弟，冲克世爻，主同僚不和；或者兄弟化出官鬼而刑冲克害，或者兄弟带三刑六害伤害世爻，也都是这样；世爻克兄弟，是我欺负他，因而不和。
rule.en: Peer stands for the officers of one's staff, that is, colleagues and subordinates. If in the hexagram Pressure moves and turns into Peer and clashes or controls the Self, it means discord among colleagues; or if Peer turns into Pressure and punishes, clashes, controls or harms, or if Peer carries the three punishments or the six harms and injures the Self, it is the same; if the Self controls Peer, it is I who bully him, and so there is discord.

note.yi: 经文写的是「兄爻化鬼」（兄弟变官鬼），旧注解释时先说「鬼动化出兄弟」（官鬼变兄弟），再说「兄弟化鬼」，两个方向都讲；王洪绪只讲了「鬼动化出兄弟」一个方向。两个方向书里都当成同僚不和的象。「僚属」是同署办事的官员和下属。「三刑六害」是地支之间的刑和害（寅巳申三刑、子卯相刑等），这里只说兄弟带它们伤世爻。
note.en: The verse reads 'Peer turns into Pressure', but in explaining it the old commentary first says 'Pressure moves and turns into Peer' and then 'Peer turns into Pressure', covering both directions, while Wang Hongxu speaks only of 'Pressure moves and turns into Peer'; both directions are taken in the books as signs of discord among colleagues. 'Staff' means officers and subordinates who work in the same office. 'The three punishments and the six harms' are the punishments and harms among the branches (Yin, Si and Shen, Zi and Mao and so on), and here Peer is only said to carry them and injure the Self.

zh: 兄爻化鬼无情，同僚不协；
yi: 兄弟爻化出官鬼而无情，同僚就不和协；
en: When Peer turns into Pressure without feeling, colleagues are not in accord;

hits.text: 兄爻化鬼无情，同僚不协
兄爻化鬼无情，同僚不协

zh: 卦中鬼动，化出兄弟，冲克世爻，主同僚不和。
或兄带三刑六害伤世，皆然。
世克兄爻，是我欺他，而不和也。
yi: 兄弟是僚属的官。
卦中官鬼发动，化出兄弟，冲克世爻，主同僚不和。
或者兄弟化出官鬼，刑冲克害；
或者兄弟带三刑六害伤害世爻，都是这样。
世爻克兄弟，是我欺负他，因而不和。
en: Peer stands for the officers of one's staff and fellow officials.
If in the hexagram Pressure moves and turns into Peer and clashes or controls the Self, it means discord among colleagues.
Or if Peer turns into Pressure and punishes, clashes, controls or harms;
or if Peer carries the three punishments or the six harms and injures the Self, it is the same.
If the Self controls Peer, it is I who bully him, and so there is discord.

zh: 兄弟为僚属，卦中鬼动化出兄弟冲克世爻，主同僚不和，或兄弟刑害伤世皆然；
yi: 兄弟是僚属，卦中官鬼发动、化出兄弟，冲克世爻，主同僚不和，或者兄弟刑害伤世的都是这样；
世爻克兄弟，是我欺负他。
en: Peer stands for the staff; if in the hexagram Pressure moves and turns into Peer and clashes or controls the Self, it means discord among colleagues, and so too if Peer punishes or harms and injures the Self;
if the Self controls Peer, it is I who bully him.

title: 仕宦·太岁加刑不顺，贬责难逃（旧注：太岁动伤世爻必遭贬责，加刑害虎蛇有锁拿之辱，世入墓必受囚系，得动爻日辰救或可无事，化出子孙罪终不免，月建同看）

rule.yi: 太岁出现、发动伤克世爻，必定遭到贬责；再加上刑、害、白虎、螣蛇等煞，必有被锁拿擒捕的耻辱；世爻入墓，必受囚禁，得到动爻、日辰来救，或者可以无事；但怕化出子孙，罪终究免不了。月建也照这样看。
rule.en: If the Tai Sui appears and moves to injure or control the Self, one will surely be demoted and rebuked; if punishment, harm, the White Tiger, the Coiling Snake and other killers are added, there will surely be the disgrace of being chained and seized; if the Self enters a tomb, one will surely be imprisoned, and if a moving line or the Day comes to the rescue one may perhaps come to no harm; but if it turns into Output, the offence cannot in the end be escaped. The Month is looked at in the same way.

note.yi: 卜筮大全经文写「贬责难逃」，卜筮正宗写「贬谪难逃」（「责」是责罚，「谪」是贬官并外放）。「虎蛇」是白虎、螣蛇两个六神；旧注里的「锁扭」，王洪绪写作「锁拘」，是锁拿拘禁。世爻「入墓」的意思是世爻落在墓库里，被困住，所以主囚系。这一条和 LY.CAREER.HJC.12（日辰冲克）一起，讲的是太岁、日辰这样的「上面」压到世爻上。
note.en: The verse is 'demotion and rebuke are hard to escape' in the Bushi Daquan and 'demotion and exile are hard to escape' in the Bushi Zhengzong (the one is rebuke and punishment, the other is being demoted and sent away). 'The Tiger and the Snake' are the two spirits, the White Tiger and the Coiling Snake; the old commentary's 'chained' is written 'chained and held' by Wang Hongxu, being chained and confined. 'The Self enters a tomb' means the Self falls into a tomb and is shut in, hence imprisonment. With LY.CAREER.HJC.12 (the Day clashes or controls) this entry speaks of 'those above', the Tai Sui and the Day, pressing on the Self.

zh: 太岁加刑不顺，贬责难逃。
yi: 太岁加上刑害而不顺，贬责就难以逃脱。
en: When the Tai Sui has punishment added and is unfavourable, demotion and rebuke are hard to escape.

hits.text: 太岁加刑不顺，贬谪难逃
太岁加刑不顺，贬责难逃

zh: 太岁出现，动伤世爻，必遭贬责。
更加刑害虎蛇等杀，必有锁扭擒拿之辱。
世爻入墓，必受囚系，得动爻日辰有救，庶几无事。
但怕化出子孙，罪终不免。
yi: 太岁出现，发动去伤克世爻，必定遭到贬责。
再加上刑、害、虎、蛇等煞，必有被锁拿擒捕的耻辱。
世爻入墓，必定被囚禁，得到动爻、日辰来救，或者可以没事。
但怕化出子孙，罪终究免不了。
月建同样看。
en: If the Tai Sui appears and moves to injure or control the Self, one will surely be demoted and rebuked.
If punishment, harm, the Tiger, the Snake and other killers are added, there will surely be the disgrace of being chained and seized.
If the Self enters a tomb, one will surely be imprisoned, and if a moving line or the Day comes to the rescue, one may perhaps come to no harm.
But if it turns into Output, the offence cannot in the end be escaped.
Look at the Month in the same way.

zh: 太岁动伤世爻，必遭贬谪，更加刑害虎蛇，必有锁拘擒拿之辱。
yi: 太岁发动伤克世爻，必定遭到贬谪，再加上刑害、白虎、螣蛇，必有被锁拿擒获的耻辱。
en: If the Tai Sui moves to injure or control the Self, one will surely be demoted and exiled, and if punishment, harm, the Tiger and the Snake are added, there will surely be the disgrace of being chained and seized.

title: 仕宦·卦静世空，退休之兆；身空杀动，避祸之征（旧注：世空未任无选期；已任六爻安静月日岁君无伤是休官改政；鬼发动被月日岁君伤克是避祸脱灾；卦静日冲欲归不放、杀动日合欲避不能）

rule.yi: 卦静而世爻空亡，是退休的兆头；身爻空亡而煞发动，是躲避祸事的征兆。世爻空亡，没做官的没有选用的日期；已经做官的，如果六爻安静、月建日辰太岁没有伤它，就是休官改任的象；如果官鬼发动、被月建日辰太岁伤克，是躲避祸患、脱离灾难的兆头；卦静而日辰冲，想回家却被留住；煞动而日辰合，想躲避却躲不开。
rule.en: A still hexagram with the Self Void is a sign of retirement; the Body Void and a killer moving is a sign of avoiding misfortune. When the Self is Void, one not yet in office has no date of selection; for one already in office, if the six lines are still and the Month, the Day and the Tai Sui do not injure it, it is the image of retiring from office and changing post; if Pressure moves and the Month, the Day or the Tai Sui injures or controls it, it is a sign of avoiding misfortune and escaping calamity; if the hexagram is still and the Day clashes, one wants to go home but is not let go; if a killer moves and the Day combines, one wants to escape but cannot.

note.yi: 「休官改政」是辞去官职、改作别的事；「选期」是官员待选、等候授职的日期；「杀动」的「杀」是官鬼发动成了煞。这一联讲的是世爻空亡的两种相反的象：官静无伤，是平安退休；官动被克，是躲开祸事。旧注多讲了两句「卦静日冲，欲归而不放；杀动日合，欲避而不能」，是说想退却被日辰留住、想躲却被日辰合住，王洪绪没有这两句。
note.en: 'Retire from office and change post' is resigning the office and doing something else; 'date of selection' is the date on which an officer waiting for a post is chosen and given it; the 'killer' of 'a killer moving' is Pressure moving and turning into a killer. This couplet speaks of two opposite images of a Void Self: Pressure still and unharmed is a peaceful retirement, and Pressure moving and controlled is an escape from misfortune. The old commentary has two further sentences, 'if the hexagram is still and the Day clashes, one wants to go home but is not let go; if a killer moves and the Day combines, one wants to escape but cannot', meaning that one wishes to retire but is held by the Day, or wishes to flee but is combined by the Day, and Wang Hongxu does not have these two.

yi: 卦静而世爻空亡，是退休的兆头；
身爻空亡而煞发动，是躲避祸事的征兆。
en: A still hexagram with the Self Void is a sign of retirement;
the Body Void and a killer moving is a sign of avoiding misfortune.

zh: 凡遇世爻空亡，未任未有选期。
已任若六爻安静，月日岁君无伤而遇之，乃是休官改政之象。
若鬼爻发动，月日岁君伤克而遇之者，是避祸脱灾之兆。
yi: 凡是遇到世爻空亡，没做官的没有选用的日期。
已经做官的，如果六爻安静，月建、日辰、太岁都没有伤它而遇到这种情形，就是休官改任的象。
如果官鬼发动，被月建、日辰、太岁伤克而遇到这种情形，是躲避祸患、脱离灾难的兆头。
卦静而日辰冲，想回家却被留住；
煞发动而日辰合，想躲避却躲不开。
en: Whenever the Self is Void, one not yet in office has no date of selection.
For one already in office, if the six lines are still and the Month, the Day and the Tai Sui do not injure it and yet he meets this, it is the image of retiring from office and changing post.
If Pressure moves and the Month, the Day or the Tai Sui injures or controls it and one meets this, it is a sign of avoiding misfortune and escaping calamity.
If the hexagram is still and the Day clashes, one wants to go home but is not let go;
if a killer moves and the Day combines, one wants to escape but cannot.

zh: 已任世爻空亡，若六爻安静，日月岁君未伤，乃是休官之象；
若动鬼同日月岁君伤克世爻者，如世爻旬空，急宜避之，可免祸也。
yi: 已经任职的世爻空亡，如果六爻安静，日月岁君没有伤它，就是休官的象；
如果官鬼发动，同日月岁君一起伤克世爻，而世爻旬空的，急忙躲避，可以免去祸患。
en: If one already in office has the Self Void and the six lines are still and the Day, the Month and the Tai Sui do not injure it, it is the image of resigning from office;

if a moving Pressure together with the Day, the Month or the Tai Sui injures or controls the Self, and the Self is Void in the ten-day cycle, one should quickly avoid it, and the misfortune can be escaped.

title: 仕宦·身边伏鬼若非空，头上乌纱终不脱（旧注：遇凶兆，鬼临身持世或本宫鬼伏世下虽见责罚官职犹在；不临持身世、不伏世下或伏而遇空亡者必革官为民）

rule.yi: 遇到凶兆的时候，如果官鬼爻临身持世，或者本宫的官鬼伏在世爻下面，虽然被责罚，官职还在；如果不临身持世，也不伏在世爻下面，或者虽然伏着仍遇到空亡，必定被革去官带贬为平民，不只是责罚而已。
rule.en: When an ominous sign appears, if Pressure settles on the Body or holds the Self, or the home palace's Pressure lies hidden under the Self, then although one is blamed and punished, the office remains; if it neither settles on the Body nor holds the Self, nor lies hidden under the Self, or lies hidden but still meets Void, one will surely be stripped of the official belt and reduced to a commoner, which is more than blame and punishment.

note.yi: 「乌纱」是官员戴的乌纱帽，「头上乌纱终不脱」是说官位保得住；「革官带为民」是革去官带、降为平民。这一联是「官鬼」在凶兆里的作用：有官鬼护着世身，就是被责罚也不丢官；官鬼不在世身上，就会丢官。它和 LY.CAREER.HJC.03（子孙发动剥官）、LY.CAREER.HJC.15（太岁加刑）是同一件事的另一面：那两条讲祸怎么来，这一条讲官位保不保得住。
note.en: 'The black gauze cap' is the cap an official wears, and 'the black gauze cap will in the end not come off' says that the post is kept; 'stripped of the official belt and reduced to a commoner' is being deprived of the belt of office and reduced to a commoner. This couplet is about the part Pressure plays in an ominous sign: with Pressure guarding the Self and the Body, one does not lose office even if blamed and punished, and with Pressure not on the Self or the Body one loses it. It is the other face of LY.CAREER.HJC.03 (Output moving strips the office) and LY.CAREER.HJC.15 (the Tai Sui with punishment added): those two say how the misfortune comes, and this one says whether the post is kept.

zh: 身边伏鬼若非空，头上乌纱终不脱。
yi: 官鬼伏在身边，只要不是空亡，头上的乌纱帽终究不会脱掉。
en: If Pressure lies hidden beside the Self and is not Void, the black gauze cap will in the end not come off one's head.

hits.text: 身边伏鬼若非空，头上乌纱终不脱
身边伏鬼若非空，头上乌纱不脱

zh: 凡遇凶兆，或得鬼爻临身持世，或本宫鬼伏世下，虽见责罚，官职犹在。
若不临持身世，或不伏于世下，或虽伏仍遇空亡者，必革官带为民，非止罪责。
yi: 凡是遇到凶兆，如果官鬼爻临身持世，或者本宫的官鬼伏在世爻下面，虽然被责罚，官职还在。
如果不临身持世，或者不伏在世爻下面，或者虽然伏着仍遇到空亡的，必定被革去官带贬为平民，不只是责罚而已。
en: When an ominous sign appears, if Pressure settles on the Body or holds the Self, or the home palace's Pressure lies hidden under the Self, then although one is blamed and punished, the office remains.

If it neither settles on the Body nor holds the Self, or does not lie hidden under the Self, or lies hidden but still meets Void, one will surely be stripped of the official belt and reduced to a commoner, which is more than blame and punishment.

zh: 或得鬼爻临身持世，或本宫鬼伏世下，虽见责罚，官职犹在；
若不临持身世，或不伏于世下，或虽伏仍遇空亡者，必遭黜革。
yi: 如果官鬼爻临身持世，或者本宫的官鬼伏在世爻下面，虽然被责罚，官职还在；
如果不临身持世，或者不伏在世爻下面，或者虽然伏着仍遇到空亡的，必定遭到罢免。
en: If Pressure settles on the Body or holds the Self, or the home palace's Pressure lies hidden under the Self, then although one is blamed and punished, the office remains;
if it neither settles on the Body nor holds the Self, nor lies hidden under the Self, or lies hidden but still meets Void, one will surely be dismissed.

title: 仕宦·财空鬼动，声名振而囊箧空虚（旧注：官鬼动生合世无冲克则声名闻望；财爻生扶合助有气不空则既会做官又会赚钱、内实贪赂外不丧名；财空伏死绝则声名有而贿赂无）

rule.yi: 官鬼发动，来生合世爻，日辰、月建、动爻的变化又没有冲克它的，做官必定有声名威望；再得到财爻生扶合助、有气不空，就既会做官又会赚钱，内里实际贪图贿赂，外面不丧失名声；如果财爻空亡、伏藏或者临死绝，就是声名虽有，贿赂却没有。
rule.en: If Pressure moves to generate or combine with the Self and the changes of the Day, the Month and the moving lines do not clash or control it, one will surely have fame and standing in office; if Wealth also generates, supports and helps it, with breath and not Void, one both knows how to hold office and how to make money, taking bribes within while not losing one's name without; if Wealth is Void, hidden, or in death or extinction, one has the fame but not the bribes.

note.yi: 经文题目说的是「财空鬼动」，即财爻空亡而官鬼发动：有名无利。旧注、王洪绪的注都是顺着「官动有名」再看财的有无，所以「内实贪赂，外不丧名」是说财有气时的情形（官贪而有名），不是说书劝人如此，只是描写这种卦象。「囊箧」是口袋和箱子，「囊箧空虚」是没钱。王洪绪把旧注的「财爻或空或伏、或临死绝」改成「世爻空伏，财爻死绝」，多了世爻这一条。
note.en: The verse speaks of 'Wealth Void and Pressure moving', that is, fame without profit. Both commentaries go from 'Pressure moving gives fame' and then look at whether there is Wealth, so 'taking bribes within while not losing one's name without' describes the case where Wealth has breath (an official who takes bribes and yet has a name), and is not the book recommending it, only describing this kind of hexagram. 'Purse and chest' are the bag and the box, and 'the purse is empty' means there is no money. Wang Hongxu changes the old commentary's 'Wealth Void or hidden, or in death or extinction' into 'the Self Void or hidden and Wealth in death or extinction', adding the Self.

zh: 财空鬼动，声名振而囊箧空虚。
yi: 财爻空亡而官鬼发动，名声远扬而口袋空空。
en: With Wealth Void and Pressure moving, one's name resounds but one's purse is empty.

hits.text: 财空鬼动，声名震而囊箧空虚
财空鬼动，声名振而囊箧空虚

zh: 凡得官鬼动来生合世爻，日月动变，又无冲克者，为官必有声名闻望。
更得财爻生扶合助，有气不空，则既会做官，又会赚钱；
若财爻或空或伏，或临死绝，则主声名虽有，贿赂却无也。
yi: 凡是官鬼发动，来生合世爻，日辰、月建、动爻的变化又没有冲克它的，做官必定有声名威望。
再得到财爻生扶合助，有气不空，就既会做官，又会赚钱；
内里实际贪图贿赂，外面不丧失名声。
如果财爻或空或伏，或者临死绝，就是声名虽有，贿赂却没有。
en: Whenever Pressure moves to generate or combine with the Self and the changes of the Day, the Month and the moving lines do not clash or control it, one will surely have fame and standing in office.
If Wealth also generates, supports and helps it, with breath and not Void, one both knows how to hold office and how to make money;
within, one in fact takes bribes, without, one does not lose one's name.
If Wealth is Void or hidden, or in death or extinction, one has the fame but no bribes.

zh: 凡官动生合世爻，日月动爻又无冲克者，为官必有声名闻望；
更得财爻生扶合助，则内实贪赂，外不丧名；
若世爻空伏，财爻死绝，声名虽有，贿赂却无也。
yi: 凡是官鬼发动生合世爻，日辰、月建、动爻又没有冲克的，做官必定有声名威望；
再得到财爻生扶合助，就是内里实际贪图贿赂，外面不丧失名声；
如果世爻空亡或伏藏，财爻死绝，就是声名虽有，贿赂却没有。
en: Whenever Pressure moves to generate or combine with the Self and the Day, the Month and the moving lines do not clash or control it, one will surely have fame and standing in office;
if Wealth also generates, supports and helps it, one takes bribes within and does not lose one's name without;
if the Self is Void or hidden and Wealth is in death or extinction, one has the fame but no bribes.

title: 仕宦·官旺父衰，职任高而衙门冷落（旧注：父母旺相衙门大、休囚衙门小；官旺父衰是冷落闲静衙门；官衰父旺职卑而在大衙门；官父俱衰职卑衙小）

rule.yi: 父母旺相，衙门一定大；休囚，衙门一定小。官鬼旺而父母衰，不是小去处，而是冷落清闲的衙门，因为官旺所以职位高；官鬼衰而父母旺，职位虽然卑微，却在大衙门里办事；官和父都衰，职位低、衙门小，必定不是风宪之地。
rule.en: If Resource is thriving, the office is surely large; if resting or trapped, the office is surely small. With Pressure thriving and Resource weak, it is not a small place but a cold and quiet office, the post being high because Pressure is thriving; with Pressure weak and Resource thriving, the post, though lowly, is in a large office; with both Pressure and Resource weak, the post is low and the office small, and it is surely not a place in the censorate.

note.yi: 这一联用「父母」看衙门的大小（父母是文书、衙署），用「官鬼」看职位的高低，两个轴分开看。「衙门」是官署；「冷落」是不热闹、没有多少人办事的衙门。旧注多出「官衰父旺」一句（职卑而在大衙门），王洪绪没有。
note.en: This couplet reads the size of the office from Resource (Resource is the documents and the yamen) and the height of the post from Pressure, two axes looked at separately. 'Yamen' is a government office, and 'cold' means one that is not busy, with not many people at work. The old commentary has the additional case 'Pressure weak and Resource thriving' (a lowly post in a large office), which Wang Hongxu does not have.

zh: 官旺父衰，职任高而衙门冷落。
yi: 官鬼旺而父母衰，职位高而衙门冷落。
en: With Pressure thriving and Resource weak, the post is high but the office is cold and quiet.

hits.text: 官旺父衰，职任高而衙门冷落
官旺父衰，职任高而衙门冷落

zh: 若官旺父衰，又非小去处，乃是冷落闲静衙门。
官衰父旺，则主职虽卑微，却在大衙门中治政。
官父俱衰，职卑衙小，必非风宪之地。
yi: 父母旺相，衙门一定大；
休囚，衙门一定小。
如果官旺父衰，又不是小去处，而是冷落清闲的衙门。
因为官旺就职位高，所以如此。
官衰父旺，就主职位虽然卑微，却在大衙门里办事。
官和父都衰，职位低、衙门小，必定不是风宪之地。
en: If Resource is thriving, the office is surely large;
if resting or trapped, the office is surely small.
If Pressure is thriving and Resource weak, it is not a small place either but a cold and quiet office.
For when Pressure is thriving the post is high, and so it is.
If Pressure is weak and Resource thriving, the post, though lowly, is in a large office.
If both Pressure and Resource are weak, the post is low and the office small, and it is surely not a place in the censorate.

zh: 父母旺相衙门必大，休囚则衙门必小。
若官旺父衰，又非小职，乃闲静冷落衙门；
yi: 父母旺相，衙门一定大，休囚，衙门一定小。
如果官旺父衰，又不是小职位，而是清闲冷落的衙门；
官和父都衰，职位低、衙门小。
en: If Resource is thriving, the office is surely large; if resting or trapped, the office is surely small.
If Pressure is thriving and Resource weak, it is not a small post either but a quiet and cold office;
if both Pressure and Resource are weak, the post is low and the office small.

title: 仕宦·职居风宪，皆因月值官爻（旧注：官鬼旺相不临月建定非风宪；临月建又扶出世爻决是风宪之任必非府县官；带刑爻多是镇守边陲、掌兵权或居刑部；在外是司刑之职）

rule.yi: 官鬼旺相而不临月建，一定不是风宪的职位；如果临月建，又得到扶助而出现在世爻上，一定是风宪的任命，必不是府县的官，再在日辰的生旺之地，更是风宪；如果带刑爻，多是镇守边陲的职位，或者掌握兵权，或者在刑部，在外地也是主管刑狱的职位。
rule.en: If Pressure is thriving but does not rest on the Month, it is surely not a post in the censorate; if it rests on the Month and is supported so as to appear on the Self, it is surely an appointment in the censorate and not an officer of a prefecture or county, all the more if it also stands in a thriving place of the Day; if it carries a punishment line, it is mostly a post guarding the frontier, or holding military power, or in the Board of Punishments, and outside the capital a post in charge of punishments.

note.yi: 「风宪」是监察、执法的官署（御史、按察使一类），「刑部」是掌管刑狱的部，「镇守边陲」是驻守边疆。旧注写「府县官」，王洪绪写「州县之官」，是同一类的地方官。王洪绪把旧注的「带刑爻」改成「带白虎刑爻」，并且只说「镇守边陲，职掌兵权」，没有旧注那两个出路（刑部、在外司刑）。这一联和 LY.CAREER.HJC.07 里「月建扶出官爻世爻者必是风宪之职」是同一个判据，在那里是顺带提到，这里是专门讲职位的类别。
note.en: 'The censorate' is the office that supervises and enforces the law (censors and surveillance commissioners), 'the Board of Punishments' is the ministry in charge of punishments, and 'guarding the frontier' is being stationed on the border. The old commentary writes 'an officer of a prefecture or county' and Wang Hongxu 'an officer of a department or county', local officers of the same kind. Wang Hongxu changes the old commentary's 'a punishment line' into 'the White Tiger or a punishment line' and says only 'guarding the frontier and holding military power', without the old commentary's other two outcomes (the Board of Punishments, and punishments outside). The criterion 'if the Month supports Pressure or the Self, it is surely a post in the censorate' is also in LY.CAREER.HJC.07, where it comes up in passing, and here the couplet speaks directly of what kind of post it is.

yi: 职位居于风宪，都是因为月建值官爻；
en: That the post is in the censorate is because the Month holds the Pressure line;

如果带刑爻，多是镇守边陲的职位，或者掌握兵权，或者在刑部。

If it rests on the Month and is supported so as to appear on the Self, it is surely an appointment in the censorate and not an officer of a prefecture or county.
If it also stands in a thriving place of the Day, it is all the more the censorate.
If it carries a punishment line, it is mostly a post guarding the frontier, or holding military power, or in the Board of Punishments.
Outside the capital it is also a post in charge of punishments.

如带白虎刑爻，主镇守边陲，职掌兵权。

if it rests on the Month and is supported so as to appear on the Self, it is surely an appointment in the censorate and not an officer of a prefecture or county;
if it carries the White Tiger or a punishment line, it means guarding the frontier and holding military power.

title: 仕宦·官在贰司，只为鬼临旁位（旧注：鬼在世应爻上或带月建日辰是掌印正官，被世合或在旁爻是佐贰之职；六爻无鬼而动爻化出者亦然；王洪绪：官临子午卯酉是正任、寅申巳亥是佐二、辰戌丑未是杂职）

rule.yi: 旧注说：官鬼在世爻、应爻上，或者带月建、日辰的，必是掌印的正官；如果被世爻合住，或者在旁边的爻上，就是佐贰的职位；六爻没有官鬼而动爻化出官鬼的，也是这样。王洪绪说：官鬼临子午卯酉是正任的官，临寅申巳亥是佐贰的职官，临辰戌丑未是杂职官；如果临月建、日辰，就是掌印的官。
rule.en: The old commentary says: if Pressure is on the Self or the Other, or carries the Month or the Day, it is surely the principal officer who holds the seal; if it is combined by the Self or is on a side line, it is a post as an assistant; and if there is no Pressure among the six lines but a moving line turns into Pressure, it is the same. Wang Hongxu says: Pressure on Zi, Wu, Mao and You is a principal officer, on Yin, Shen, Si and Hai an assistant post, and on Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei a miscellaneous post; and if it rests on the Month or the Day, it is the officer who holds the seal.

dispute.yi: 两家判断「正官还是佐贰」的标准不一样：旧注看官鬼在卦里的位置（在世应爻上或带月建日辰是正官，被世爻合住或在旁爻是佐贰）；王洪绪看官鬼所临的地支（四仲子午卯酉是正官，四孟寅申巳亥是佐贰，四季辰戌丑未是杂职），再加上带月建日辰是掌印官。两个标准在同一个卦里可能给出相反的结果，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The two commentators use different criteria for 'principal officer or assistant': the old commentary looks at the position of Pressure in the hexagram (on the Self or the Other, or carrying the Month or the Day, a principal officer; combined by the Self or on a side line, an assistant), while Wang Hongxu looks at the branch it rests on (the four cardinal branches Zi, Wu, Mao and You, a principal officer; the four initial branches Yin, Shen, Si and Hai, an assistant; the four closing branches Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, a miscellaneous post), and adds that one carrying the Month or the Day is the officer who holds the seal. The two criteria may give opposite results in the same hexagram, and the books do not decide.

note.yi: 「贰司」是副职的衙司，「佐贰」是副职官（同知、通判一类的辅佐），「杂职」是不入流的杂项官职（典史、巡检一类），「掌印」是主管官署印信的正官。经文只说「鬼临旁位」，所以旧注讲位置；王洪绪的地支标准书里没有说理由。
note.en: 'A secondary office' is the office of a deputy, 'assistant' is a deputy officer (an assistant prefect or sub-prefect and the like), 'miscellaneous post' is a lesser, unranked post (a jail warden or a patrol inspector and the like), and 'holds the seal' is the principal officer in charge of the office's seal. The verse says only 'Pressure sits in a side line', so the old commentary speaks of position; the book gives no reason for Wang Hongxu's criterion by branch.

zh: 官在贰司，只为鬼临旁位。
yi: 官员在副职的衙司，只是因为官鬼临在旁边的爻位上。
en: That the officer is in a secondary office is only because Pressure sits in a side line.

en: If Pressure is on the Self or the Other, or carries the Month or the Day, it is surely the principal officer who holds the seal.
If it is combined by the Self or is on a side line, it is a post as an assistant.
If there is no Pressure among the six lines but a moving line turns into Pressure, it is the same.

en: Pressure on Zi, Wu, Mao and You is a principal officer; on Yin, Shen, Si and Hai it is an assistant post; on Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei it is a miscellaneous post; and if it rests on the Month or the Day, it is the officer who holds the seal.

title: 仕宦·抚绥百姓，兄动则难化愚顽（旧注：牧民要财旺不动、父母扶而不空是丰地富方，财空绝父受制则地瘠民贫；父动临世政繁剧；兄持世财赋不起；日带兄冲克世下属弄法；兄旁爻动冲克顽民难治；兄化子子化兄刑克世身有下民讼我；世应冲克与乡宦不睦）

rule.yi: 担任牧民的职位，要财爻旺而不动，父母爻扶助而不空，必是富庶的好地方；财爻空绝、父爻受制，就是地瘠民贫；父母发动临世，政务必定繁重；兄弟持世，赋税征不起来；日辰带兄弟冲克世爻，手下人必定舞文弄法，败坏我的政事；兄弟在旁边的爻上发动来冲克，顽劣的百姓难治；兄弟化子孙、子孙化兄弟而刑克世身，恐怕有百姓告我；世应冲克，和乡绅也多不和睦。
rule.en: In a post that shepherds the people, Wealth should be thriving and not moving and Resource should support and not be Void, and then it is surely a rich and prosperous place; if Wealth is Void or in extinction and Resource is controlled, the land is barren and the people poor; if Resource moves and settles on the Self, the business of government will surely be heavy; if Peer holds the Self, taxes cannot be raised; if the Day carries Peer and clashes or controls the Self, the underlings will surely twist the law and ruin my government; if Peer moves on a side line and comes to clash or control, the unruly people are hard to govern; if Peer turns into Output or Output into Peer and punishes or controls the Self or the Body, there may be the sign of the people bringing a suit against me; and if the Self and the Other clash or control each other, there is also much discord with the local gentry.

note.yi: 「牧民」是治民（像牧人管牲畜，指州县的地方官），「愚顽」是愚昧顽劣的人，「舞文弄法」是玩弄文字、歪曲法令（衙门里胥吏常做的事），「乡宦」是在乡的退职官员、乡绅。这一联是任所里看地方好坏的一组判据：财、父看地方的肥瘠和政务的繁简，兄弟看赋税、下属和百姓。王洪绪写「地脊」，「脊」是「瘠」的误写；「贫民难冶」的「冶」是「治」的误写。王洪绪没有旧注后面几句（下属弄法、顽民难治、下民讼我、与乡宦不睦）。
note.en: 'Shepherding the people' is governing the people like a herdsman with livestock, meaning a local officer of a prefecture or county; 'the stubborn' are the ignorant and unruly; 'twist the law' is playing with words and bending the statutes, as clerks in a yamen often did; and 'local gentry' are retired officials living in their home districts and the gentry. This couplet is a group of criteria in 'in office' for judging a place: Wealth and Resource show how rich the land is and how heavy the government, and Peer shows taxes, underlings and the people. Wang Hongxu writes 'the land is thin' with a misprinted character for 'barren', and 'the poor are hard to rule' with a misprinted character for 'govern'. Wang Hongxu does not have the old commentary's last sentences (underlings twisting the law, unruly people hard to govern, the people suing me, discord with the gentry).

if Peer holds the Self, taxes cannot be raised, or the poor people are hard to govern.

title: 仕宦·巡察四方，路空则多忧惊险（旧注：钦差出巡、封王采木皆怕世应逢空；路爻空主途中惊险；世在五爻自空须防身死于外；世在五爻动及游魂卦世动是出巡之职）

rule.yi: 钦差出巡，或者奉命去封王、采木，都怕世爻、应爻遇空；如果是路爻空亡的卦，主途中惊险；世爻在五爻而自己空亡，须提防死在外面，有冲克就不会这样；世在五爻发动，以及游魂卦世爻发动的，都是出巡的职位。
rule.en: For one sent by imperial commission on a tour, or to invest a prince or to gather timber, a Void Self or Other is much feared; if it is a hexagram with the road line Void, there will be danger and fright on the way; if the Self is on the fifth line and Void by itself, beware of dying abroad, though with a clash or control it is not so; and when the Self on the fifth line moves, or the Self moves in a Wandering-Soul hexagram, it is a post of touring.

note.yi: 「钦差」是皇帝派出的差使，「封王」是奉命去册封藩王，「采木」是奉命去采办皇家用的木材，这些都是远行的差使。「路爻」书里这里没有解释。「游魂卦」是八宫卦里第七个卦（游魂）。第五爻在这里像是「出外」的位置，所以世在五爻是出巡的象，这和 LY.CAREER.HJC.08（世动逢空，出巡之职反为顺利）说的出巡不同：那里是世动逢空对出巡有利，这里是世应逢空怕出事，两条一起看：官位上世动逢空，出巡一类的差使反而顺；但差使走在路上时，世应逢空、路爻空要防惊险。
note.en: 'Imperial commission' is a mission sent by the emperor, 'to invest a prince' is going on the emperor's order to confer the title on a feudal prince, and 'to gather timber' is going on order to procure timber for the court, all of them missions to a far place. The book does not explain 'the road line' here. A 'Wandering-Soul hexagram' is the seventh hexagram of the eight palaces (the Wandering Soul). The fifth line here looks like the place of 'going out', so the Self on the fifth line is a sign of touring, which differs from what LY.CAREER.HJC.08 ('the Self moves and meets Void: for a post of touring it goes smoothly on the contrary') says of touring: there the Self moving into Void favours touring, and here the Self and the Other going Void is feared as bringing trouble; the two are to be read together: in a matter of rank, the Self moving into Void is on the contrary smooth for a mission of touring, but when the mission is on the road, a Void Self and Other or a Void road line must be guarded against for danger.

yi: 巡视查察四方，路爻空亡就多有忧虑惊险；
en: On a tour of inspection of the four quarters, if the road line is Void there will be much worry and danger;

title: 仕宦·出征剿捕，福德兴而寇贼歼亡（旧注：将帅平居卜问不宜子孙发动主降调贬责、不宜应动克世；岁君月建冲动官鬼或世爻有敕命征讨；临敌卜问喜子孙发动必成剿捕之功；官鬼当贼寇论，世克应亦吉）

rule.yi: 担任将帅或征讨之官的人，平时占问，不适宜子孙发动，主有降职调任、贬责，也不适宜应爻发动克世爻，主有意想不到的变故；太岁、月建冲动官鬼或世爻，主有敕命征讨的事。如果临阵对敌占问，就喜欢子孙发动，必成剿捕的功绩，再得到太岁、月建生合，还有升赏；这时官鬼不当作爵位，要当作贼寇来论，世克应也吉。
rule.en: For one holding the post of commander or an officer of punitive expeditions, in divining in ordinary times it is not fitting that Output moves, which means demotion, transfer and rebuke, nor that the Other moves and controls the Self, which means an unforeseen change; if the Tai Sui or the Month clashes Pressure or the Self into motion, there will be an imperial order for a punitive expedition. If the divination is made facing the enemy, it is welcome that Output moves, and one will surely achieve merit in suppressing the bandits, and if the Tai Sui and the Month also generate or combine, there will be promotion and reward as well; Pressure is then not taken as rank but as the bandits, and the Self controlling the Other is also auspicious.

note.yi: 这一联要分两种问法：平时问（还没有开战，问自己的仕途）和临阵问（敌人当前，问这一仗）。平时问，子孙是「伤官之杀」，发动就降调贬责；临阵问，子孙是「克鬼」的神（官鬼这时是贼寇），发动就能灭贼。所以同一个子孙发动，平时凶、临阵吉，这和 LY.CAREER.HJC.03（子孙发动剥官削职）不矛盾，是用神换了：官鬼不再是你的官，而是你的敌人。「敕命征讨」是皇帝下令出兵，「剿捕」是围剿捕捉。
note.en: This couplet must be read for two kinds of question: in ordinary times (no war has begun, and one asks about one's own career) and facing the enemy (the enemy is before one, and one asks about this battle). In ordinary times Output is 'the killer that harms office', and moving brings demotion and rebuke; facing the enemy Output is the spirit that controls Pressure (which is then the bandits), and moving can wipe them out. So the same moving Output is ominous in ordinary times and auspicious facing the enemy, which does not contradict LY.CAREER.HJC.03 (Output moving strips the office): the Subject has changed, and Pressure is no longer your office but your enemy. 'An imperial order for a punitive expedition' is the emperor ordering out the army, and 'suppress' is surrounding and seizing.

en: In going out to campaign and wipe out bandits, when Output flourishes the robbers are destroyed;

title: 仕宦·镇守边陲，卦爻静而华夷安泰（旧注：镇守不拘文武皆宜六爻安静，世应生合比和日辰月建不冲克则安然无警，世应空亡亦吉；官鬼发动世应冲克必多侵扰）

rule.yi: 镇守一方，不论文官武职，都适宜六爻安静；世应生合比和，日辰月建不互相冲克，就能安睡在边庭，安然没有警报，世应空亡也吉；如果遇到官鬼发动、世应冲克，必定多有侵扰，要通变着断。
rule.en: In guarding a region, whether in a civil or military post, it is fitting that the six lines are still; if the Self and the Other generate, combine or are in harmony and the Day and the Month do not clash or control each other, one sleeps soundly at the border, at ease and without alarm, and the Self and the Other Void is also auspicious; if Pressure moves and the Self and the Other clash or control each other, there will surely be many incursions, and one should judge flexibly.

note.yi: 「华夷」是中原和边地的民族，「安泰」是平安。「鼾睡边庭」是说在边疆睡得安稳，不用戒备。「世应空亡亦吉」只有旧注写了：世应都空，双方都不动，边境无事。这一联讲的是「守」，和上一联 LY.CAREER.HJC.24 的「攻」（出征剿捕）正好相反：守要静，攻要动。旧注结尾「宜通变断之」、王洪绪「用宜通变推之」，都是提醒不要死守这条。
note.en: 'The Chinese and the border peoples' are the peoples of the heartland and of the border lands, and 'at peace' is peace and safety. 'Sleeps soundly at the border' says one sleeps easily on the frontier without having to be on guard. 'The Self and the Other Void is also auspicious' is only in the old commentary: when both the Self and the Other are Void, neither side moves and there is nothing on the border. This couplet speaks of 'defending', the very opposite of the preceding couplet, LY.CAREER.HJC.24, on 'attacking' (campaigning and suppressing bandits): defending wants stillness, and attacking wants movement. The old commentary's closing 'judge it flexibly' and Wang Hongxu's 'in use it should be inferred flexibly' both warn against holding to this rule rigidly.

en: In guarding the frontier, when the hexagram and its lines are still, the Chinese and the border peoples are at peace.

In use it should be inferred flexibly.

title: 仕宦·奏陈谏诤，那堪太岁刑冲（旧注：奏对陈疏上章谏诤赴召面君皆忌动爻冲克太岁亦忌刑克世爻；太岁月建生合世爻必见详允，冲克须防不测之祸；岁君衰静不带刑害虎蛇不见取用非大害；动空化空虚惊；有制伏冲散合住必得大臣申救；应动冲克世更防人奏劾）

rule.yi: 上奏陈情、进呈奏章、上书、进谏，以及奉召面君这类事，都忌讳动爻冲克太岁，也忌讳世爻被刑克；如果太岁、月建生合世爻，必定得到详细审议并获准；一旦遇到冲克，须提防意外的祸患；太岁衰弱安静又不带刑、害、白虎、螣蛇，只是不被采用，没有大害；动爻空亡或化空，也只是虚惊；有制伏、冲散、合住的，必有大臣出来申救；应爻发动冲克世爻，更要提防有人上奏弹劾。
rule.en: For anything such as a memorial in audience, presenting a petition, submitting a written report, remonstrating, or going to an audience with the sovereign at his summons, it is feared that a moving line clashes or controls the Tai Sui, and also that the Self is punished or controlled; if the Tai Sui or the Month generates or combines with the Self, it will surely be examined in detail and approved; once a clash or control comes, beware of an unforeseen misfortune; if the Tai Sui is weak and still and carries no punishment, harm, White Tiger or Coiling Snake, one is only not adopted and there is no great harm; if the moving line is Void or turns into Void, it is only a false alarm; if there is something that subdues, clashes away or combines it, a high minister will surely come forward to plead and rescue; and if the Other moves and clashes or controls the Self, beware all the more of someone submitting an impeachment.

note.yi: 「奏对」是面奏回答皇帝，「陈疏」「上章」是上书，「谏诤」是进言规劝，「赴召面君」是奉召去见皇帝，「申救」是出面陈说、营救，「奏劾」是上奏弹劾。旧注「亦忌刑克世爻」没有说谁刑克世爻，王洪绪补明是「太岁刑克世爻」。旧注比王洪绪多出的几句（太岁衰静不带刑害虎蛇只是不被采用、动空化空是虚惊、有制伏冲散合住有大臣申救、应动冲克世防人弹劾），是在「冲克」这个凶象上分轻重：太岁衰静无煞只是不被采纳，有煞才是祸；动爻空或化空是虚惊；有人制住冲克的爻，就有大臣出来救。这一联是「面君」类事的判据，所以放在「国朝」一题下。
note.en: 'Audience' is replying to the emperor in person, 'a petition' and 'a written report' are writing to the throne, 'remonstrating' is offering advice and admonition, 'going to an audience at his summons' is being summoned to see the emperor, 'plead and rescue' is coming forward to speak and save, and 'impeachment' is submitting a memorial of impeachment. The old commentary's 'it is also feared that the Self is punished or controlled' does not say by whom, and Wang Hongxu makes it clear that it is 'the Tai Sui punishing or controlling the Self'. The extra sentences of the old commentary (the Tai Sui weak and still with no punishment, harm, Tiger or Snake is only not being adopted; a moving line Void or turning into Void is a false alarm; with something that subdues, clashes away or combines it, a minister pleads and rescues; the Other moving and clashing the Self, beware impeachment) grade the ominous sign of clash or control by weight: the Tai Sui weak and still without killers is only not being adopted, and only with killers is there misfortune; the moving line Void or turned Void is a false alarm; and when something holds in check the line that clashes or controls, a minister comes out to rescue. This couplet is the criterion for matters of facing the sovereign, hence it is placed under 'the court and the state'.

title: 仕宦·僧道医官，岂可文书发动（旧注：僧道医官及阴阳官皆要子孙出现有气不空，父母发动必有灾悔；父带岁月日非身有灾病乃外来祸；子孙自空亦有大难，然子孙只宜安静、官鬼不宜空伏；王洪绪：僧道医官以子孙为用，父动则伤、用药不灵）

rule.yi: 僧官、道官、医官和阴阳官，都要子孙出现、有气不空才吉。父母发动，必有灾祸悔恨；父母带太岁、月建、日辰，就不是自身有灾病，而是外来的祸；子孙自己空亡，也有大难；但子孙只适宜安静，官鬼不适宜空伏，两样都要顾到，要仔细。王洪绪说：僧官、道官、医官都以子孙为用，父母发动就伤害他们，用药不灵，反而不好。
rule.en: Monk-officials, Daoist officials, physician-officials and officials of yin-yang divination all need Output to appear, with breath and not Void, to be auspicious. If Resource moves, there will surely be calamity and regret; if Resource carries the Tai Sui, the Month or the Day, it is not calamity or illness in oneself but a misfortune from outside; if Output is Void by itself, there is also a great calamity; but Output should only be still and Pressure should not be Void or hidden, and both must be satisfied, with care. Wang Hongxu says: monk-officials, Daoist officials and physician-officials all take Output as the Subject, and if Resource moves it injures them, medicines do not work and on the contrary it is bad.

note.yi: 「僧官、道官」是管理僧道的官（僧纲、道纪一类），「医官」是太医院、医学的官，「阴阳官」是管天文、历数、风水的官。这几种官都是以子孙为用神：子孙是福德，也是僧道医药的象（见疾病域 LY.ILL.HDY.13 子孙是医药僧道）。父母是文书，发动就克子孙，所以不宜。旧注里的「官鬼不宜空伏」是说子孙虽好，也不能没有官鬼，因为这毕竟是占官。王洪绪只讲子孙为用、父动则伤。
note.en: 'Monk-officials and Daoist officials' are the officials who manage monks and Daoists (the Buddhist and the Daoist registrars), 'physician-officials' are officials of the Imperial Academy of Medicine and the medical offices, and 'officials of yin-yang divination' are those in charge of astronomy, the calendar and geomancy. For all of these kinds of officials Output is the Subject: Output is the blessing, and it is also the image of monks, Daoists, physicians and medicine (see in the domain of illness LY.ILL.HDY.13, Output is medicine, monks and Daoists). Resource is the documents, and moving it controls Output, which is why it is unsuitable. The old commentary's 'Pressure should not be Void or hidden' says that however good Output is, Pressure cannot be missing either, since this is after all divining an office. Wang Hongxu says only that Output is the Subject and that Resource moving injures it.

title: 仕宦·但随职分以推详，可识仕途之否泰（全章结语：按所任之职推断，才看得出仕途的顺逆）

rule.yi: 占仕宦，要按所任的职位和职分来推断，才能看出仕途的顺逆。这是仕宦章的结语：前面各联是按官职的种类分的（风宪、牧民、将帅、出巡、谏官、僧道医官），用的时候先判断问的是哪一类职位，再取相应的一联。
rule.en: In divining official posts, one must infer according to the post held and its duties, and then the smoothness or blockage of an official career can be known. This is the closing line of the chapter on holding office: the couplets before it are divided by the kind of office (censorate, shepherding the people, commander, touring, remonstrance, monk, Daoist and physician officials), and in use one first judges what kind of post is being asked about and then takes the corresponding couplet.

note.yi: 「职分」是官职和它的职责；「否泰」是否（不通）和泰（通）两个卦，指不顺和顺利。卜筮大全和卜筮正宗这一句字句相同。这一章里的各联，有的是通用的（财、官、父、子、兄在仕宦里的意思，见 LY.CAREER.HJC.01 至 HJC.06），有的是专讲某一类职位的（HJC.19 至 HJC.27），结语是提醒这一点。
note.en: 'The duties of the post' are the office and what it is charged with, and 'smoothness or blockage' are the two hexagrams Pi (blocked) and Tai (open), meaning unfavourable and favourable. The Bushi Daquan and the Bushi Zhengzong have this line in identical words. Some couplets of this chapter are general (what Wealth, Pressure, Resource, Output and Peer mean in holding office, see LY.CAREER.HJC.01 to HJC.06) and some speak of one kind of post (HJC.19 to HJC.27), and the closing line reminds one of this.

zh: 但随职分以推详，可识仕途之否泰。
yi: 只要顺着所任的职位和职分来推断，就能看出仕途的顺逆。
en: Only follow the duties of the post held in inferring, and the smoothness or blockage of an official career can be known.

title: 求馆·世为西席，如逢父母必明经（旧注：占书馆以世爻为西席之位；世临父其先生必明经，世在乾坤离三宫亦然；临官带贵或本宫官伏世下多是秀才）

rule.yi: 占书馆（去当塾师），以世爻代表西席，也就是教书的先生。世爻临父母，这位先生一定是通晓经书的人；世在乾、坤、离三宫也是这样；世临官爻又带贵人，或者本宫的官鬼伏在世爻下面，多半是秀才。
rule.en: In divining a school post, the Self stands for the tutor's seat, that is, the teacher. If the Self rests on Resource, the teacher is surely versed in the classics, and so too if the Self is in the Qian, Kun or Li palace; if it rests on Pressure with a noble, or the home palace's Pressure lies hidden under the Self, he is mostly a licentiate.

note.yi: 「西席」是塾师的座位（古时宾客坐西，主人坐东，所以请来教书的先生叫「西席」），这一章因此用「世」代表先生，「应」代表聘请他的「东家」。「明经」本是汉代的科目，这里指通晓经书的人；「秀才」是生员。章首三句是引语，不是判断：「程风」指程颢、程颐两兄弟讲学的风气，「贾粟之盈仓」是说像商人囤积粮食那样装满仓库，「笔耕」是靠教书、写文章谋生。卜筮正宗写「秀长」，「长」是「才」的误写。
note.en: 'The tutor's seat' is the seat of the schoolmaster (in old etiquette the guest sat in the west and the host in the east, so the teacher invited to teach was called 'the west seat'), and this chapter therefore takes the Self for the teacher and the Other for the 'host family' that engages him. 'Versed in the classics' was originally a Han examination subject and here means a man who has mastered the classics; a 'licentiate' is a district-school student. The first three sentences of the chapter are a preface and not a judgement: 'the Cheng school' is the manner of teaching of the brothers Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi, 'stored grain filling the granary like a merchant's' means a granary filled as a merchant fills his, and 'earning one's living by the pen' is making a living by teaching and writing. The Bushi Zhengzong writes 'licentiate' with a misprinted second character.

zh: 学得明师，可继程风于满座；
师非良馆，难期贾粟之盈仓。
yi: 跟明师学习，可以承继程氏讲学的风范，座无虚席；
老师若没有好的书馆，就难指望束修像商人囤粮那样装满仓库；
所以想靠笔耕谋生，先要用蓍草占筮。
en: Learning under a bright teacher, one can carry on the manner of the Cheng school, with every seat filled;
if the teacher has no good school, it is hard to hope for stored grain filling the granary like a merchant's;
so whoever wishes to earn his living by the pen should first consult the yarrow stalks.

title: 求馆·应乃东家，若遇官爻须作吏（旧注：应爻为东家主人；临官是官吏户役人家，加白虎有病人，加玄武与盗贼往来；临父母加勾陈种田、朱雀读书、白虎宰杀、螣蛇工艺；临子属金僧道作主；临财无官妇人作主、有官富贵、财化财财化子做买卖；临兄弟平常人家、加朱雀赌博）

rule.yi: 占馆，应爻代表聘请先生的东家，看应爻临什么来断这家人：临官爻，是官吏、户役人家（加白虎有病人，加玄武与盗贼往来）；临父母，加勾陈是种田人家，加朱雀是读书人家，加白虎是宰杀人家，加螣蛇是工艺人家；临子孙属金，是僧道作主；临财爻在阴宫阴爻又没有官鬼的，是妇人作主，有官鬼就是富贵人家，财化财、财化子是做买卖的人家，被月建日辰动爻制伏的是奴仆作主；临兄弟，是平常人家，加朱雀是赌博人家。
rule.en: In divining a school post, the Other stands for the host family that engages the teacher, and one judges the household from what the Other rests on: on Pressure, an official's or clerk's household (with the White Tiger, a sick person; with the Dark Tortoise, dealings with thieves); on Resource, a farming household with Hook Earth, a scholars' household with the Vermilion Bird, a slaughterers' household with the White Tiger, a craftsmen's household with the Coiling Snake; on Output belonging to Metal, a monk or Daoist is the master; on Wealth in a yin palace and on a yin line with no Pressure, a woman is the master, with Pressure a rich and noble household, with Wealth turning into Wealth or Output a trading household, and if subdued by the Month, the Day or a moving line, a servant is the master; on Peer, an ordinary household, with the Vermilion Bird a gambling household.

note.yi: 这一联是用「应爻临什么」来断东家是什么人家：六亲定行当（官是官吏、父是耕读、子孙属金是僧道、财是买卖或妇人、兄弟是平常人），六神再细分（勾陈种田、朱雀读书、白虎宰杀、螣蛇工艺、玄武盗贼或打猎）。「户役」是承担差役的户；「孝服在身」是家里有丧事。旧注比王洪绪多出的部分：玄武的盗贼、子孙加朱雀玄武的打猎、财有官鬼是富贵人家以及被制伏是奴仆作主、兄弟一类（平常人家、赌博、兄弟姊妹家、朋友邻里家）。王洪绪把旧注的「财爻有官是富贵人家」改成「应临官又举贵人，是富贵人家」，条件不同：旧注是应临财、卦里有官鬼，王洪绪是应临官爻又有贵人。
note.en: This couplet judges what kind of household the host is by 'what the Other rests on': the six relations fix the trade (Pressure an official or clerk, Resource farming and scholarship, Output belonging to Metal a monk or Daoist, Wealth trade or a woman, Peer an ordinary person) and the six spirits subdivide it (Hook Earth farming, the Vermilion Bird scholarship, the White Tiger slaughter, the Coiling Snake crafts, the Dark Tortoise thieves or hunting). 'A household with corvée duty' is a household bearing service duties; 'in mourning dress' means there is a death in the family. What the old commentary has beyond Wang Hongxu: the Dark Tortoise and thieves, Output with the Vermilion Bird and the Dark Tortoise as hunters, Wealth with Pressure as a rich and noble household, being subdued as a servant being the master, and the Peer sort (ordinary household, gambling, the home of brothers and sisters, the home of friends and neighbours). Wang Hongxu changes the old commentary's 'Wealth with Pressure is a rich and noble household' into 'the Other rests on Pressure and a noble also appears is a rich and noble household', with a different condition: in the old commentary the Other rests on Wealth and there is Pressure in the hexagram, and in Wang Hongxu the Other rests on Pressure and there is a noble.

yi: 应爻是东家，如果遇到官爻，是官吏人家。
en: The Other is the host family, and if it meets Pressure, it is an official's household.

with the Vermilion Bird and the Dark Tortoise, a hunting family;
otherwise it is the younger generation.

If the Other rests on Peer, it is an ordinary household;
with the Vermilion Bird, a gambling family;
if it belongs to the home palace, the home of brothers and sisters;

with the White Tiger, a family of slaughterers;
with the Coiling Snake, a family of craftsmen.

if the Other rests on Wealth in a yin palace and on a yin line and there is no Pressure in the hexagram, a woman is surely the master;
if the Other rests on Pressure and a noble also appears, it is a rich and noble household;
Wealth turning into Wealth or into Output is a trading household.

title: 求馆·临官兮少壮、休囚则贫乏之家；墓库兮高年、旺相则富豪之主（旧注：应临临官帝旺主人强壮、临墓库是高年；五行无气家贫乏、旺相家富厚、重加财福巨富；德性以五类六神参断）

rule.yi: 应爻临临官、帝旺，主人必定年壮强盛，临墓库必是高龄；应爻的五行没有气，他家贫乏，旺相就富厚，再加上财爻、子孙，必然是巨富；他的品德性情，要按五类和六神一起参断。
rule.en: If the Other rests on the Official-Post or Peak stage, the master is surely in his prime and strong, and if on a tomb he is surely advanced in years; if the element of the Other has no breath, his family is poor, if thriving, rich, and with Wealth and Output added he is surely enormously rich; his character is to be judged by the five relations and the six spirits together.

note.yi: 「临官」「帝旺」是十二长生里的两个阶段（临官是壮年成人，帝旺是最盛），「墓库」是入墓的阶段（衰老）。这一联用十二长生的阶段看东家的年龄，用五行旺衰看家境。王洪绪写「临财福必然富贵」，旧注是「重加财福，必然巨富」：旧注要财福重叠才说巨富，王洪绪只要临财福就说富贵，程度略有不同。
note.en: 'Official-Post' and 'Peak' are two stages of the twelve life stages (Official-Post is a man grown and in his prime, Peak is the fullest), and 'tomb' is the stage of entering the tomb (old age). This couplet reads the master's age from the life stage and the circumstances of the family from the element's strength. Wang Hongxu writes 'with Wealth and Output he is surely rich and noble' while the old commentary says 'with Wealth and Output piled on, he is surely enormously rich': the old commentary needs Wealth and Output doubled before it says enormously rich, and Wang Hongxu says rich and noble at once for being on Wealth and Output, a slightly different degree.
