title: 求馆·值土火空无父母，逢金水绝少儿孙（旧注：卦中六亲即人六亲，两人系于一卦以相生之理定：应属土则火是父母、属金则水是子孙；火旺空冲空动空父母不全、衰空无父母；带官鬼贵、兄弟好赌、财贸易、子孙慈善；在应宫者为彼六亲、在世宫者为我六亲）

rule.yi: 一个卦里系着两个人时，两人的六亲要用相生的道理来定：占馆以应为东家，应爻属土，火生土，不论卦里有没有火、也不论是哪一类六亲，都当作他的父母；应爻属金，金生水，水就当作他的子孙。火爻旺而空、冲空、动空，父母不全，衰而空就没有父母；火化火有两重父母；带官鬼旺相是贵，衰是病，带兄弟是好赌、无廉耻，带财是做买卖，带子孙是慈善。不能把六爻总起来看，在应宫的爻是对方的六亲，在世宫的爻是我的六亲。
rule.en: When two persons are tied to one hexagram, their relations are fixed by the principle of generation: in divining a school post the Other is the host, and if the Other belongs to Earth, Fire generates Earth, and whether or not there is Fire in the hexagram and whatever relation it is, it is taken as his parents; if the Other belongs to Metal, Metal generates Water, and Water is taken as his children. If the Fire line is thriving but Void, clashed Void or moved Void, his parents are not both alive, and if weak and Void he has no parents; Fire turning into Fire means two sets of parents; carrying Pressure that is thriving means nobility, weak, illness; carrying Peer means gambling and shamelessness; carrying Wealth means trade; carrying Output means kindness. The six lines are not to be looked at all together: lines in the Other's palace are the other's relations, and lines in the Self's palace are all my relations.

dispute.yi: 两家用什么五行来定「父母」「子孙」，说法不一样：旧注看应爻的五行（应属土，火是他的父母；应属金，水是他的子孙），不管卦里有没有这个爻，也不论它是哪一类六亲；王洪绪看的是卦的宫（卦得坤宫属土，看火爻；卦得乾、兑宫属金，看水爻），而且要「水又绝于飞爻或绝于日辰」才说无子孙。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The two commentators differ on which element fixes the 'parents' and the 'children': the old commentary looks at the element of the Other (if the Other belongs to Earth, Fire is his parents, and if it belongs to Metal, Water is his children), whether or not that line is in the hexagram and whatever relation it is; Wang Hongxu looks at the palace of the hexagram (a hexagram of the Kun palace, belonging to Earth, looks at the Fire line, and one of the Qian or Dui palace, belonging to Metal, looks at the Water line), and says there are no children only if Water is also 'in extinction at the flying line or at the Day'. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这一联讲的是「人」的六亲和「卦」的六亲不是一回事：卦里的父母、子孙等是对「我」说的；要看对方（东家）的父母子孙，得按对方自己的五行，从生的关系重新定。旧注的例子：应属土，火生土，所以火就是东家的父母；应属金，金生水，所以水是东家的子孙。「飞爻」是卦的爻（显现的爻），「飞神」「伏神」见术语表。这条是整本书里少见的、把「两个人系在一个卦上」讲清楚的地方。
note.en: This couplet says that the relations of the 'person' are not the same as the relations of the 'hexagram': Resource, Output and the others in the hexagram are said relative to 'me'; to see the host's parents and children one must refix them from the host's own element by the relation of generation. The old commentary's example: if the Other belongs to Earth, Fire generates Earth, so Fire is the host's parents; if the Other belongs to Metal, Metal generates Water, so Water is the host's children. 'The flying line' is the line of the hexagram (the visible line); see the glossary for 'flying line' and 'hidden line'. This is one of the few places in the book that makes clear how two persons can be tied to one hexagram.

yi: 应是土而火空，没有父母；
应是金而水绝，缺少儿孙。
en: With Earth and Fire Void, there are no parents;
with Metal and Water in extinction, there are few sons and grandsons.

zh: 然有两人系于一卦者，则彼此六亲宜不同矣。
应爻属土，火能生土，不拘卦中有无，亦不拘是财官父子，皆作父母断，生我者故也。
应爻属金，金能生水，不拘卦中有无，亦不拘财官父兄，皆作子孙断，我生故也。
如火爻旺空、冲空、动空，主父母不全，衰空必无父母。
带官鬼旺，以贵断，衰以病言。
带兄弟，其父好赌博，无廉耻，欠学问。
带财爻，其父不富厚，则业贸易。
带子孙，其父则甚慈善，慷慨有为。
但不可以六爻总看，当以在应宫者为彼六亲，在世宫者皆我六亲也。
一宫三爻，只余二爻，此宫不现者，不可遂断为有无，惟空亡乃是真无也。
其贵贱寿夭，性情容貌，依常例推之。
他如兄弟妻妾子息，亦仿此推之。
yi: 卦中的六亲，就是人的六亲。
但是有两个人系在一个卦上的，他们的六亲就应该不同了。
又应该用什么来定呢？
不过是相生的道理而已。
就拿占馆来说，以应爻为东家。
应爻属土，火能生土，不论卦中有没有火，也不论它是财、官、父、子哪一类，都当作父母来断，因为是生我的。
应爻属金，金能生水，不论卦中有没有水，也不论它是财、官、父、兄哪一类，都当作子孙来断，因为是我所生的。
如果火爻旺相而空、冲空、动空，主父母不全，衰弱而空必定没有父母。
火化出火，是有两重父母。
带官鬼旺相，按贵人来断，衰弱就说有病。
带兄弟，他的父亲好赌博，没有廉耻，欠缺学问。
带财爻，他的父亲不富厚，就是做买卖。
带子孙，他的父亲就很慈善，慷慨有为。
其余的都照这样推。
但是不能把六爻总起来看，应当以在应宫里的爻作为对方的六亲，在世宫里的爻都是我的六亲。
一宫三爻，只剩两爻，这一宫不出现的，不能就断为有无，只有空亡才是真正没有。
他的贵贱、寿夭、性情、容貌，依照平常的办法来推。
其他如兄弟、妻妾、子女，也照这样推。
en: The six relations in the hexagram are a person's six relations.
But when two persons are tied to one hexagram, their relations must differ.
By what, then, are they to be fixed?
It is nothing more than the principle of generation.
Take divining a school post: the Other is the master of the household.

If the Other belongs to Earth, then since Fire generates Earth, whether or not Fire is in the hexagram, and whatever relation it is, Wealth, Pressure, Resource or Output, it is judged as his parents, because it is what generates him.

If the Other belongs to Metal, then since Metal generates Water, whether or not Water is in the hexagram, and whatever relation it is, Wealth, Pressure, Resource or Peer, it is judged as his children, because it is what he generates.
If a Fire line is thriving but Void, clashed Void or moved Void, his parents are not both alive, and if weak and Void he surely has no parents.
Fire turning into Fire means two sets of parents.
If it carries Pressure that is thriving, judge by nobility, and if weak, say there is illness.
If it carries Peer, his father is fond of gambling, shameless and lacking in learning.
If it carries Wealth, his father is not rich, or is in trade.
If it carries Output, his father is very kind-hearted, generous and capable.
The rest are inferred in the same way.
But the six lines are not to be looked at all together: the lines in the Other's palace are taken as the other's relations, and the lines in the Self's palace are all my relations.
A palace has three lines, with only two left over, and when one of this palace does not appear, one cannot at once judge it present or absent; only Void is truly absent.
His nobility or lowliness, long or short life, temperament and looks are inferred by the usual methods.
Others such as brothers, wives and concubines, and children are likewise inferred in this way.

zh: 卦得坤属土，如火爻旺空、动空、冲空，主父母不全，衰空必无父母。
若卦得乾兑属金，如无水爻，水又绝于飞爻或绝于日辰，则主无子孙。
yi: 卦得坤属土，如果火爻旺相而空、动空、冲空，主父母不全，衰弱而空必定没有父母。
如果卦得乾、兑属金，如果没有水爻，水又绝在飞爻或者绝在日辰，就主没有子孙。
其余都照这样推。
en: If the hexagram obtained is Kun, belonging to Earth, and a Fire line is thriving but Void, moved Void or clashed Void, his parents are not both alive, and if weak and Void he surely has no parents.
If the hexagram obtained is Qian or Dui, belonging to Metal, and there is no Water line, or Water is in extinction at the flying line or at the Day, he has no children.
The rest are inferred in the same way.

title: 求馆·不拱不和，决定主宾不协；相生相合，必然情意相投（旧注：世应刑冲克害日后宾主不合，兄官发动大凶；生合比和情意相投；生而化克始和终不和、冲而化合始疏后密；世与子宜生合则师弟恩义兼尽，冲克则多不睦）

rule.yi: 世应两爻刑冲克害，日后宾主一定不合，再加上兄弟、官鬼发动，是大凶的兆头；世应生合比和，情意必定相投；生而化出克，开始和睦、最后不和；冲而化出合，开始疏远、后来亲密；世爻和子孙也适宜生合，师生之间就恩义兼尽，见到冲克也多不睦。
rule.en: If the Self and the Other punish, clash, control or harm each other, the guest and host will surely be at odds in time, and if Peer and Pressure also move it is a greatly ominous sign; if the Self and the Other generate, combine or are in harmony, their feelings will surely be congenial; generation turning into control is harmonious at the start and not at the end; a clash turning into a combination is distant at first and close afterwards; it is also fitting that the Self and Output generate or combine, and then the teacher and his pupils fulfil both kindness and duty, while with a clash or control they are mostly not on good terms.

dispute.yi: 师生的关系看哪一爻和子孙的关系，两家说法不一样：旧注说「世与子亦宜生合」（世爻是先生，子孙是学生，先生和学生要合）；王洪绪却写「应与子孙生合」（应爻和子孙）。「应」是东家，「世」是先生，按这一章的体例师生关系应是世和子孙，王洪绪的「应」像是误写，但书里没有说明。
dispute.en: The two commentators differ over which line is paired with Output for the relation of teacher and pupils: the old commentary says 'it is also fitting that the Self and Output generate or combine' (the Self is the teacher and Output the pupils, so teacher and pupils should be in accord), while Wang Hongxu writes 'the Other and Output generate or combine' (the Other and Output). The Other is the host and the Self is the teacher, and by the plan of this chapter the relation of teacher and pupils should be the Self and Output, so Wang Hongxu's 'the Other' looks like a misprint, but the book does not say.

note.yi: 「拱」是两爻夹住中间一爻（这里泛指相合相助）；「宾主」是先生（宾）和东家（主）。这一联讲先生（世）和东家（应）是否合得来，「生而化克、冲而化合」是说一开始的关系会在变爻上反过来，这是通用的判据，在别的章节里也常见。
note.en: 'Flank' is two lines holding a middle line between them (here used loosely for combining and helping each other); 'guest and host' are the teacher (guest) and the host family (host). This couplet is about whether the teacher (the Self) and the host (the Other) get on, and 'generation turning into control, a clash turning into a combination' says the relation at the start is reversed in the changed line, a general criterion that is also often met in other chapters.

zh: 不拱不和，决定主宾不协；
相生相合，必然情意相投。
yi: 不相拱合、不相和睦，一定是主人和宾客不协调；
相生相合，情意必定相投。
en: If they neither flank nor harmonise with each other, host and guest are surely not in accord;
if they generate and combine with each other, their feelings will surely be congenial.

hits.text: 不拱不和，决定主宾不协
相生相合，必然情意相投
不拱不和，决定主宾不协
相生相合，必然情意相投

zh: 世应二爻刑冲克害，异日宾主不合。
加以兄官发动，大凶之兆。
若得生合比和，情意必然相投。
世与子亦宜生合，则师弟间恩义兼尽。
yi: 世、应两爻刑冲克害，日后宾主不合。
再加上兄弟、官鬼发动，是大凶的兆头。
如果得到生合比和，情意必定相投。
生而化克，开始和睦、最后不和；
冲而化合，开始疏远、后来亲密。
世爻和子孙也适宜生合，那么师生之间恩义兼尽。
如果见到冲克，也多半不和睦。
en: If the Self and the Other punish, clash, control or harm each other, the guest and host will in time be at odds.
If Peer and Pressure also move, it is a greatly ominous sign.
If they generate, combine or are in harmony, their feelings will surely be congenial.
Generation turning into control: harmonious at the start, not at the end;
a clash turning into a combination: distant at first and close afterwards.
It is also fitting that the Self and Output generate or combine, and then the teacher and his pupils fulfil both kindness and duty.
If clash or control is seen, they are likewise mostly not on good terms.

zh: 世应刑冲克害，异日宾主不和；
若得生合比和，情意相投；
应与子孙生合，师徒则多恩义，若见冲克多不睦也。
yi: 世应刑冲克害，日后宾主不和；
如果得到生合比和，情意相投；
生而化克，开始和睦、最后不和睦；
冲而化合，开始疏远、后来亲密。
应爻和子孙生合，师生之间就多恩义，如果见到冲克，多半不和睦。
en: If the Self and the Other punish, clash, control or harm each other, the guest and host will in time be at odds;
if they generate, combine or are in harmony, their feelings are congenial;
generation turning into control is harmonious at the start and not at the end;
a clash turning into a combination is distant at first and close afterwards.
If the Other and Output generate or combine, the teacher and his pupils have much kindness and duty between them, and if clash or control is seen they are mostly not on good terms.

title: 求馆·财作束修，不宜化弟（旧注：以妻财为束修，旺相多、休囚少；以生成数推斤两，生旺倍、绝死半，阳宫生数、阴宫成数；兄弟发动或财化兄束修不尽入己；财无气得生扶则束修虽少节礼周备）

rule.yi: 占馆以妻财为束修（学费）。财旺相就多，休囚就少；要知道有多少，用生成数来推，生旺加倍，绝死减半，在阳宫用生数，在阴宫用成数；只怕兄弟发动或者财化出兄弟，束修不能都归自己，必有人抽成分用，不然就有名无实；财爻无气而遇月建日辰动爻生扶的，束修虽然不多，四季节礼反而周全。
rule.en: In divining a school post, Wealth is the tuition fee. If thriving it is much, and if resting or trapped, little; to know how much, infer by the generating and completing numbers, doubled if in birth or thriving and halved if in extinction or death, using the generating number in a yang palace and the completing number in a yin palace; what is feared is Peer moving or Wealth turning into Peer, and then the fee does not all go to oneself, someone takes a share, or it is in name only; if Wealth has no breath but is generated or supported by the Month, the Day or a moving line, the fee, though not large, is made up for by gifts at the four seasons' festivals.

note.yi: 「束修」本是十条干肉，古时拜师的见面礼，后来指学费、塾师的薪金。「生数、成数」是河图的数：一二三四五是生数（水一、火二、木三、金四、土五），六七八九十是成数（水六、火七、木八、金九、土十）；旧注的意思是，按财爻的五行取数，阳宫用生数、阴宫用成数，旺相再加倍、衰绝减半，来估计束修的多少。这个算法书里没有给例子，也没有说单位。旧注最后一句引《易》的「天一地二……」，原文只写到「生也」，像是没写全，译文按字面。「抽分」是从里面抽取一份。
note.en: 'Tuition fee' was originally ten strips of dried meat, the gift of first meeting a teacher in old times, and later meant tuition and the schoolmaster's pay. 'The generating and completing numbers' are the numbers of the River Diagram: one to five are the generating numbers (Water one, Fire two, Wood three, Metal four, Earth five) and six to ten the completing numbers (Water six, Fire seven, Wood eight, Metal nine, Earth ten); the old commentary means that one takes the number from the element of the Wealth line, the generating number in a yang palace and the completing number in a yin palace, doubled if thriving and halved if in extinction, to estimate the fee, and the book gives no example of this calculation nor the unit. The old commentary's last sentence quotes the Changes, 'Heaven one, Earth two ...', and the original stops at 'generation', as if not written out in full, and the translation follows the letter. 'Take a share' is drawing off a portion.

yi: 妻财是束修，不适合化出兄弟；
en: Wealth is the tuition fee, and it is not fitting for it to turn into Peer;

zh: 要知斤两，以生成数推之，生旺倍加，绝死减半。
在阳宫以生数断，在阴宫以成数断。
今人但言水一、火二、木三、金四、土五，而不言六七八九十，是举其生数，而遗其成数也。
独怕兄弟发动，或财化兄，主束修不皆入己，必有人抽分费用。
不然，则有名无实，亦不能尽取之也。
财爻无气，而遇月建日辰动爻生扶者，束修虽不多，四季节礼反周备也。
易云：天一地二，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天九地十，生也。
yi: 占馆，以妻财为束修。
旺相就多，休囚就少。
要知道有多少斤两，用生成数来推，生旺加倍，绝死减半。
在阳宫用生数断，在阴宫用成数断。
现在的人只说水一、火二、木三、金四、土五，而不说六七八九十，是只举了生数而漏掉了成数。
只怕兄弟发动，或者财化出兄弟，主束修不能都归自己，必有人抽成、分去费用。
不然，就是有名无实，也不能全部拿到。
财爻无气，却遇到月建、日辰、动爻生扶的，束修虽然不多，四季的节礼反而周全。
《易》说：天一地二，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天九地十，这是生。
en: In divining a school post, Wealth is the tuition fee.
If thriving it is much, if resting or trapped, little.
To know the weight, infer by the generating and completing numbers: doubled if in birth or thriving, halved if in extinction or death.
In a yang palace judge by the generating number, in a yin palace by the completing number.
People now say only Water one, Fire two, Wood three, Metal four, Earth five, and not six, seven, eight, nine and ten, which cites the generating numbers and omits the completing numbers.
What is feared is Peer moving or Wealth turning into Peer, which means the fee does not all go to oneself and someone takes a share or a cut.
Otherwise it is in name only and cannot be taken in full.
If Wealth has no breath but is generated or supported by the Month, the Day or a moving line, the fee, though not large, is made up for by gifts at the four seasons' festivals.
The Changes say: Heaven one, Earth two, Heaven three, Earth four, Heaven five, Earth six, Heaven seven, Earth eight, Heaven nine, Earth ten: this is generation.

zh: 占馆以财爻为束修，独怕兄弟发动或财爻化兄，主束修有名无实。
财爻无气，而遇日辰动爻生扶拱合者，束修虽则不多，而四季节礼则周备也。
yi: 占馆以财爻为束修，只怕兄弟发动或者财爻化出兄弟，主束修有名无实。
财爻无气，而遇到日辰、动爻生扶拱合的，束修虽然不多，而四季的节礼却周全。
en: In divining a school post Wealth is the tuition fee, and what is feared is Peer moving or Wealth turning into Peer, which means the fee is in name only.
If Wealth has no breath but is generated, supported, flanked or combined by the Day or a moving line, the fee, though not large, is made up for by gifts at the four seasons' festivals.

title: 求馆·父为书馆，岂可逢空（旧注：占馆不以父母为师、当作书馆论；旺相有好馆，无父或落空必无书馆；占其年有无全要此爻出现有气；应来生合世自有人请，世生合应及父须自去访求；无父而动爻化出有人推荐，父化父有两处书馆，本宫化他宫由近及远）

rule.yi: 占馆不把父母当作老师，要当作书馆来看。父母旺相有气，就有好书馆；卦里没有父母或者落空，必定没有书馆，事情也难成。占那一年有没有书馆，全要这一爻出现、有气不空；应爻来生合世爻，自然有人来聘请，世爻生合应爻和父爻，就必须自己去访求；卦里没有父母而动爻化出父母的，意想不到有人推荐；父化父必有两处书馆；本宫化入他宫由近及远，他宫化入本宫从外到内。
rule.en: In divining a school post, Resource is not taken as the teacher but as the school itself. If Resource is thriving and has breath, there is a good school; if there is no Resource in the hexagram or it falls Void, there will surely be no school and the matter is hard to bring about. To divine whether there will be a school that year everything depends on this line appearing with breath and not Void; if the Other comes to generate or combine with the Self, someone naturally comes to engage one, and if the Self generates or combines with the Other and with Resource, one must go and seek on one's own; if there is no Resource in the hexagram but a moving line turns into it, someone unexpectedly recommends one; Resource turning into Resource means two schools; from the home palace into another palace is from near to far, and from another palace into the home palace is from outside to inside.

note.yi: 在这一章里「父母」不是老师（老师是世爻），而是「书馆」本身（馆舍、学馆）。这和占考试、占文书时父母是文书、功名的用法不同。「由近及远」「由外入内」是用本宫、他宫来看书馆的方位：变出在本宫是近处，变到他宫是远处。旧注比王洪绪多讲了：占那一年有没有书馆要看这一爻出现、有人聘请和自己去访求的区别、父化父有两馆。
note.en: In this chapter 'Resource' is not the teacher (the teacher is the Self) but the 'school' itself (the school building, the schoolhouse). This differs from the usage in examinations and documents, where Resource is documents and the degree. 'From near to far' and 'from outside to inside' use the home palace and other palaces to see where the school is: changing within the home palace is near, and changing into another palace is far. The old commentary says more than Wang Hongxu: to divine whether there will be a school that year one looks for this line to appear; the difference between being engaged and going to seek oneself; and Resource turning into Resource meaning two schools.

yi: 父母爻是书馆，怎么可以遇到空亡。
en: Resource is the school, and how can it meet Void.

zh: 占馆，不可以父母为师，当作书馆论之。
卦无父或落空，必无书馆，事亦难成。
若占其年书馆有无，全要此爻出现，有气不空，必然有得。
更得应来生合世爻，自有人来延请；
世爻生合应爻，及父爻，必须自去访求，无人相请。
卦无父，而动爻有化出者，不意中有人推荐也。
若父化父，必有两处书馆，卦有两爻亦然。
馆有定期，而遇父化父，馆必两处。
本宫化入他宫，由近及远；
他宫化入本宫，自外以入内也。
yi: 占馆，不能把父母当作老师，要当作书馆来看。
旺相有气，就有好的书馆。
卦里没有父母或者落空，必定没有书馆，事情也难成。
如果占那一年有没有书馆，全靠这一爻出现、有气不空，必定有馆。
再得到应爻来生合世爻，自然有人来聘请；
世爻生合应爻和父爻，就必须自己去访求，没有人来请。
卦里没有父母，而动爻有化出的，是意想不到有人推荐。
如果父化父，必有两处书馆，卦里有两个父爻也是这样。
馆有定期，而遇到父化父，馆必定是两处。
从本宫变到他宫，是由近处到远处；
他宫化入本宫，从外到内。
en: In divining a school post, Resource is not to be taken as the teacher but as the school itself.
If thriving and with breath, there is a good school.
If there is no Resource in the hexagram or it falls Void, there will surely be no school, and the matter is hard to bring about.
If one divines whether there will be a school that year, everything depends on this line appearing with breath and not Void, and then there will surely be one.
If the Other also comes to generate or combine with the Self, someone naturally comes to engage one;
if the Self generates or combines with the Other and with Resource, one must go and seek on one's own, and no one will come to engage one.
If there is no Resource in the hexagram but a moving line turns into it, someone unexpectedly recommends one.
If Resource turns into Resource, there will surely be two schools, and likewise if there are two Resource lines in the hexagram.
When the school has a fixed term and Resource turns into Resource, the schools are surely two.
From the home palace into another palace, from near to far;
from another palace into the home palace, from outside to inside.

zh: 占馆以父母爻为馆，旺相则有好馆。
卦无父或落空，必无书馆，事亦难成。
yi: 占馆以父母爻为书馆，旺相就有好馆。
卦里没有父母或者落空，必定没有书馆，事情也难成。
en: In divining a school post Resource is the school, and if thriving there is a good school.
If there is no Resource in the hexagram or it falls Void, there will surely be no school, and the matter is hard to bring about.

title: 求馆·鬼动合身，须得贵人推荐（旧注：官鬼发动当有间阻；来生合世身则其馆必得贵人推荐而后可成；应如克世、父或落空虽荐不成）

rule.yi: 官鬼发动，应当有阻隔；但如果它来生合世爻、身爻，又主这个馆必得贵人推荐才能成；应爻如果克世，或者父母落空，即使有人推荐也不成。
rule.en: If Pressure moves there will be obstruction; but if it comes to generate or combine with the Self or the Body, it also means the school can be had only with a noble's recommendation; if the Other controls the Self, or Resource is Void, then even with a recommendation it does not come through.

note.yi: 这一联的「官鬼」同时有两面：发动就有阻隔（鬼是阻碍），但生合世身时又是「贵人」（鬼是官，官是推荐人）。书里没有说怎么分清它是阻碍还是贵人，只说要看它和世身的关系：生合是推荐，克世是阻。这和 LY.CAREER.HJC.06（官爻临持身世是称意）是同一个道理。
note.en: In this couplet Pressure has two faces at once: moving, it obstructs (Pressure is the obstacle), but generating or combining with the Self and the Body it is the 'noble' (Pressure is an official, and an official is the one who recommends). The book does not say how to tell whether it is an obstacle or a noble, only that one looks at its relation to the Self and the Body: generating or combining is recommendation, and controlling the Self is obstruction. This is the same principle as LY.CAREER.HJC.06 (Pressure resting on the Self or the Body is to one's liking).

zh: 鬼动合身，须得贵人推荐；
yi: 官鬼发动而合到世身上，须得有贵人推荐；
en: If Pressure moves and combines with the Self and the Body, a noble's recommendation is needed;

hits.text: 鬼动合身，须得贵人推荐

zh: 然来生合世身，又主其馆必得贵人推荐，而后可成；
应如克世，父或落空，虽荐不成。

但如果它来生合世爻、身爻，又主这个馆必得贵人推荐，然后才能成；
应爻如果克世，父母或者落空，即使有人推荐也不成。
en: If Pressure moves, there will be obstruction.
But if it comes to generate or combine with the Self or the Body, it also means the school will be had only with a noble's recommendation, and then it can come through;
if the Other controls the Self, or Resource is Void, then even with a recommendation it does not come through.

zh: 官鬼发动当有间阻，若来生合世身，必得贵人推荐可成。
yi: 官鬼发动应当有阻隔，如果来生合世爻、身爻，必得到贵人推荐才能成。
en: If Pressure moves there should be obstruction, and if it comes to generate or combine with the Self or the Body, one must have a noble's recommendation for it to come through.

title: 求馆·兄兴临应，决多同类侵谋（旧注：应持兄动必有同道争谋其馆，兄临卦身亦然；间爻动冲克世则有人破说其事难成）

rule.yi: 占学馆，应爻持兄弟发动，必有同行的人来争谋这个馆，兄弟临卦身也是这样；如果在间爻上发动、冲克世爻，就主有人从中说坏话，事情难成。
rule.en: In divining a school post, if the Other holds Peer and it moves, there will surely be fellow teachers contending for the post, and likewise if Peer rests on the Body; if it moves on a between line and clashes or controls the Self, it means someone undermines it by talk, and the matter is hard to bring about.

note.yi: 「同道之人」是同行，也就是同样想谋这个馆的先生。兄弟在占财时是劫财的竞争者，在占馆时是同行的竞争者，是同一个象。「破说」是从中说坏话、把事说破。「间爻」是世应之间的爻。
note.en: 'Fellow teachers' are people of the same trade, that is, other teachers who also wish for this post. Peer is the rival that robs wealth in divining wealth and the rival of the same trade in divining a school post, the same image. 'Undermines it by talk' is speaking ill from the side and breaking the matter up. 'A between line' is a line between the Self and the Other.

zh: 兄兴临应，决多同类侵谋。
yi: 兄弟兴旺临在应上，必定多有同类的人来侵夺谋取。
en: When Peer flourishes and rests on the Other, there will surely be many of the same kind coming to encroach and scheme for it.

en: In divining a school, if the Other holds Peer and it moves, there will surely be fellow teachers contending for this post;
likewise if Peer rests on the Body.
If it moves on a between line and clashes or controls the Self, it means someone undermines it by talk, and the matter is hard to bring about.

zh: 凡应持兄动，必有同道之人争谋其馆，兄临卦身亦然；
若在间爻动来冲克世爻，主有人破说也。
yi: 凡是应持兄弟发动，必有同行的人争谋这个馆，兄弟临卦身也是这样；
如果在间爻上发动来冲克世爻，主有人说破。
en: Whenever the Other holds Peer and it moves, there will surely be fellow teachers contending for the post, and likewise if Peer rests on the Body;
if it moves on a between line and comes to clash or control the Self, someone breaks it up by talk.

title: 求馆·官如藏伏，应无督集之人（旧注：官鬼能生父母，占馆以此爻为纠率子弟之人；不出现或落空必无人聚生徒成学馆又无人推荐；空而逢冲、伏而提起须央浼其人方肯出来）

rule.yi: 官鬼能生扶父母，所以占馆以官鬼这一爻代表招集率领学生的人。官鬼不出现或者落空，必定没有人聚集学生来成学馆，事情难成，也没有人推荐；如果空而逢冲、伏而被提起，必须央求那个人，他才肯出来招集。
rule.en: Pressure can generate and support Resource, so in divining a school post the Pressure line stands for the person who gathers and leads the pupils. If Pressure does not appear or falls Void, there will surely be no one to gather pupils to make up a school, the matter is hard to bring about, and no one will recommend one; if it is Void and meets a clash, or is hidden and drawn up, one must beg that person before he is willing to come forward and gather them.

note.yi: 这一章里的官鬼有两个用处：发动合身是「贵人推荐」（LY.CAREER.HJC.36），不动而在卦是「招集学生的人」（这一条）。「纠率子弟」是召集并带领学生。「央浼」是恳求。
note.en: In this chapter Pressure has two uses: moving and combining with the Body is 'a noble's recommendation' (LY.CAREER.HJC.36), and present in the hexagram and not moving it is 'the person who gathers the pupils' (this entry). 'Gather and lead' is calling the pupils together and leading them. 'Beg' is entreating.

zh: 官如藏伏，应无督集之人；
yi: 官鬼如果隐伏，应当没有招集学生的人；
en: If Pressure lies hidden, there will be no one to gather the pupils;

若不出现，或落空，必主无人聚集生徒，以成学馆。
其事难成，又主无人推荐。
若空而逢冲，伏而提起，必须央浼其人，方许出来纠集。

如果它不出现，或者落空，必主没有人聚集学生来成学馆。
这事难成，又主没有人推荐。
如果空而逢冲，伏而被提起，必须央求那个人，才肯出来招集。
en: Pressure can generate and support Resource, so in divining a school post this line is the person who gathers and leads the pupils.
If it does not appear or falls Void, there will surely be no one to gather pupils to make up a school.
The matter is hard to bring about, and no one will recommend one.
If it is Void and meets a clash, or hidden and drawn up, one must beg that person before he is willing to come forward and gather them.

zh: 鬼能生扶父母，故占馆以此爻为纠率子弟之人。
皆不出现，或出现旬空，主无人聚生徒以成学馆也。
yi: 官鬼能生扶父母，所以占馆以这一爻作为纠合率领子弟的人。
如果都不出现，或者出现而旬空，主没有人聚集学生来成学馆。
en: Pressure can generate and support Resource, so in divining a school post this line is the person who gathers and leads the pupils.
If neither appears, or one appears but is Void in the ten-day cycle, there will be no one to gather pupils to make up a school.

title: 求馆·应若空亡，未有招延之主（旧注：应空无人延请，父不出现或落空必难成；应动空化空是假言作主；父临身或动来生合世身大吉馆易成；应空鬼动宜自开馆、鬼空伏应生合宜自招致）

rule.yi: 应爻空亡，没有人来聘请；再如果父母不出现或者落空，必定难成；应爻动空、化空，是说空话、假装作主，不然也不能把事做完。父母临身，或者动爻来生合世身，是大吉的兆头，这个馆容易成；有这种象而应空、官鬼动，虽然有招集学生的人，却没有聘请的主人，适合自己开馆；官鬼空伏而应来生合，虽然有聘请的人家，却没有招集学生的人，适合自己去招来学生。
rule.en: If the Other is Void, no one comes to engage one; if Resource also does not appear or falls Void, the matter will surely be hard to bring about; if the Other moves into Void or turns into Void, he only says it in words and pretends to be the master, and otherwise the matter is not seen through to the end. If Resource rests on the Body, or a moving line comes to generate or combine with the Self or the Body, it is a greatly auspicious sign and the school comes easily; with this image but the Other Void and Pressure moving, though there is someone to gather pupils there is no master to engage one, and it is fitting to open a school oneself; if Pressure is Void and hidden while the Other comes to generate or combine, though there is a household that would engage one there is no one to gather pupils, and it is fitting to draw in pupils oneself.

note.yi: 这一联把「应」（聘请的人）、「官鬼」（招集学生的人）、「父母」（书馆）三样放在一起：缺哪样，就要自己补哪样（没有人聘请就自己开馆，没有人招集学生就自己招）。「招延」是招聘、聘请，「延请」同义。旧注后面两段（「父母临身……」「有此象而应空鬼动……」）王洪绪没有写。
note.en: This couplet puts three things together: the Other (the one who engages), Pressure (the one who gathers pupils) and Resource (the school), and what is missing one must make up oneself (open a school oneself if no one engages one, draw in pupils oneself if no one gathers them). 'Engage' and 'invite' are synonyms. The last two paragraphs of the old commentary ('Resource rests on the Body ...' and 'with this image but the Other Void and Pressure moving ...') are not in Wang Hongxu.

zh: 应若空亡，未有招延之主。
yi: 应爻如果空亡，就没有聘请的主人。
en: If the Other is Void, there is no master to engage one.

hits.text: 应若空亡，未有招贤之主
应若空亡，未有招延之主

凡遇父母临身，或遇动来生合世身，大吉之兆，主其馆易成。
有此象而应空鬼动，虽有纠集之人，而无招延之主，宜自开馆。
若鬼爻空伏，而应来生合，虽有延请之家，而无纠集之人，宜有招致。

不然，也主不能把事做完。

如果官鬼空伏，而应爻来生合，虽然有聘请的人家，却没有招集学生的人，适合自己去招来学生。
en: If the Other is Void, no one comes to engage one.
If Resource also does not appear or falls Void, the matter will surely be hard to bring about.
If the Other moves into Void or turns into Void, he only says it in words and pretends to be the master.
Otherwise the matter will not be seen through to the end.
If Resource rests on the Body, or a moving line comes to generate or combine with the Self or the Body, it is a greatly auspicious sign and the school comes easily.
If one has this image but the Other is Void and Pressure moves, though there is someone to gather pupils there is no master to engage one, and it is fitting to open a school oneself.

If Pressure is Void and hidden while the Other comes to generate or combine, though there is a household that would engage one there is no one to gather pupils, and it is fitting to draw in pupils oneself.

zh: 应爻空亡无人延请，更若父不出现或落空，必难成就；
应爻动空化空，是假言作主也。
yi: 应爻空亡没有人聘请，再如果父母不出现或者落空，必定难成；
应爻动空、化空，是说空话、假装作主。
en: If the Other is Void no one engages one, and if Resource also does not appear or falls Void, the matter will surely be hard to bring about;
if the Other moves into Void or turns into Void, he only says it in words and pretends to be the master.

title: 求馆·动象临财，难称意（旧注：文书为占馆用神，遇财动则被克坏，未成者不能成、已成者不遂意；世身日月皆忌临财；父持月建或临生旺庶亦可成）

rule.yi: 文书（父母）是占馆的用神，遇到财爻发动就被克坏：没成的不能成，已经成的也不称意；世爻、身爻、日辰、月建都忌讳临着财爻；如果父母持月建，或者临在生旺之地，或许还能成。
rule.en: Resource, the document, is the Subject in divining a school post, and if Wealth moves it is controlled and spoiled: what has not yet come about cannot, and what has come about is not to one's liking; the Self, the Body, the Day and the Month all dislike resting on Wealth; if Resource holds the Month or rests in a place of birth or thriving, it may perhaps still come through.

note.yi: 这一联和 LY.CAREER.HJC.01 是一个道理的两面：仕宦里要有财（俸禄），求馆里财动克父（文书）就坏事。这一章里的「父母」是书馆（见 LY.CAREER.HJC.35），所以财克父，就是财克了书馆。「用神」在这里指父母爻（书馆）。王洪绪这一行里同时写了「动象临财」和「空爻持世」两联的注，这一条取前一联。
note.en: This couplet and LY.CAREER.HJC.01 are two faces of one principle: in holding office one must have Wealth (the salary), and in a school post Wealth moving to control Resource (the document) spoils the matter. In this chapter 'Resource' is the school (see LY.CAREER.HJC.35), so Wealth controlling Resource is Wealth controlling the school. 'The Subject' here means the Resource line (the school). Wang Hongxu's line carries the comments on both couplets 'a moving sign meets Wealth' and 'a Void line holds the Self', and this entry takes the former.

yi: 动的象遇上财爻，就难以称意；
en: A moving sign that meets Wealth is hard to be satisfied with;

zh: 若得父持月建，或临生旺，庶亦可成。
yi: 文书是占馆的用神。
如果遇到财爻发动，就被克坏。
没成的，不能成；
已经成的，不称心意。
世爻、身爻、日辰、月建都忌讳临着财爻。
如果父母持月建，或者临在生旺之地，或许也能成。
en: Resource, the document, is the Subject in divining a school post.
If Wealth moves, it is controlled and spoiled.
What has not come about cannot come about;
what has come about is not to one's liking.
The Self, the Body, the Day and the Month all dislike resting on Wealth.
If Resource holds the Month, or rests in a place of birth or thriving, it may perhaps still come through.

zh: 文书为占馆用神，若遇财动则被克坏，未成者不能成，已成者不能遂意。
yi: 文书是占馆的用神，如果遇到财动就被克坏，没成的不能成，已经成的不能称心。
en: Resource, the document, is the Subject in divining a school post, and if Wealth moves it is controlled and spoiled; what has not come about cannot, and what has come about cannot be to one's liking.

title: 求馆·空爻持世，岂如心（旧注：父母出现、应来生合而世空，非馆不成乃自不上前或成而不去；应不生合父母重叠世空是有别馆；无故自空必不成、成亦不如意）

rule.yi: 卦里父母出现、应爻来生合，而世爻空亡的，不是馆不成，是自己不肯上前，或者虽然成了却不去；应爻不生合、父母重叠而世爻空亡的，是另有别的馆，所以不成这一个；世爻无缘无故自己空亡，必定不能成，即使成了也终究不如意。
rule.en: If Resource appears in the hexagram and the Other comes to generate or combine while the Self is Void, it is not that the school will not come about but that one does not step forward oneself, or that even if it comes about one does not go; if the Other does not generate or combine, Resource is doubled and the Self is Void, there is another school, and so this one does not come about; if the Self falls Void by itself without cause, it will surely not come about, and even if it does it is in the end not as one wishes.

dispute.yi: 同一个象（父母出现、应来生合、世爻空亡），旧注把原因讲清楚：是自己不肯去，或者另有别的馆；王洪绪只写「求馆不成」，没有讲这是为什么。这不是说两家判断不同，是旧注比王洪绪多了一层理由，按旧注读，「不成」不是外面不给，而是自己不去。
dispute.en: For the same image (Resource appears, the Other comes to generate or combine, the Self is Void), the old commentary makes the reason clear: one does not wish to go oneself, or there is another school; Wang Hongxu writes only 'the school is not obtained' without saying why. The two do not judge differently, but the old commentary gives a further reason, and read by it, 'not coming about' is not that the outside refuses but that one does not go oneself.

note.yi: 「无故自空」的读法见 LY.CAREER.HJC.09 和 LY.ILL.HJC.151。「应来生合」是东家愿意聘请，「世爻空亡」是自己这一头空，所以不是别人不请，是自己没有去。
note.en: For how to read 'Void by itself without cause' see LY.CAREER.HJC.09 and LY.ILL.HJC.151. 'The Other comes to generate or combine' means the host is willing to engage one, and 'the Self is Void' means one's own side is empty, so it is not that others do not engage one but that one does not go oneself.

yi: 空亡的爻持世，哪里还能称心。
en: With a Void line holding the Self, how can one be satisfied.

zh: 卦中父母出现，应来生合，而世爻空亡者，非馆不成，乃是自不上前，或虽成不去也。
应不生合，父母重叠，而世爻空亡者，为有别馆，故不成此事。
无故自空，必不可成，虽成终不如意。
yi: 卦里父母出现，应爻来生合，而世爻空亡的，不是馆不成，而是自己不上前，或者即使成了也不去。
应爻不生合，父母重叠，而世爻空亡的，是有别的馆，所以不成这个事。
世爻无缘无故自己空亡，必定不能成，即使成了，终究不如意。
en: If Resource appears in the hexagram and the Other comes to generate or combine while the Self is Void, it is not that the school will not come about but that one does not step forward oneself, or that even if it comes about one does not go.
If the Other does not generate or combine, Resource is doubled and the Self is Void, there is another school, and so this matter does not come about.
If the Self falls Void by itself without cause, it will surely not come about, and even if it does it is in the end not as one wishes.

zh: 卦中父母出现，应来生合，而世爻空亡者，求馆不成。
yi: 卦中父母出现，应爻来生合，而世爻空亡的，求馆不成。
en: If Resource appears in the hexagram and the Other comes to generate or combine while the Self is Void, the school is not obtained.

title: 求馆·身位受伤，虽成不利（旧注：世身被月建日辰动爻刑克虽有可成之象日后亦不称意；鬼爻刑克有官非疾病类）

rule.yi: 世爻、身爻被月建、日辰、动爻刑克，虽然有可成的象，日后也不称心；如果是官鬼爻刑克，会有官非、疾病之类的事。
rule.en: If the Self and the Body are punished or controlled by the Month, the Day or a moving line, then though there is the image of its coming about, it will not be to one's liking later; if it is Pressure that punishes or controls, there will be lawsuits, illness and the like.

note.yi: 这一条是「成了以后」的风险：事成了，但世身受伤，日后不如意；官鬼刑克世身，还会招来官司和疾病。王洪绪没有区分是什么爻刑克，一概说日后有官非疾病。
note.en: This entry is a risk 'after it has come about': the matter is obtained but the Self and the Body are injured and things go ill later; and if Pressure punishes or controls the Self and the Body, lawsuits and illness are also drawn in. Wang Hongxu does not distinguish by which line is doing the punishing and controlling, and says in all cases that lawsuits and illness come later.

yi: 世身受到伤害，即使成了也不利；
en: If the Self and the Body are injured, even if it comes about it is unfavourable;

zh: 世身被月建日辰动爻刑克，虽有可成之象，日后亦不称意。
如鬼爻刑克，有官非疾病类。
yi: 世爻、身爻被月建、日辰、动爻刑克，虽然有可成的象，日后也不称心。
如果是官鬼爻刑克，有官非、疾病之类的事。
en: If the Self and the Body are punished or controlled by the Month, the Day or a moving line, then though there is the image of its coming about, it will not be to one's liking later.
If it is Pressure that punishes or controls, there will be lawsuits, illness and the like.

zh: 世身被月建、日辰、动爻刑克，虽成而日后有官非疾病。
yi: 世身被月建、日辰、动爻刑克，虽然成了，日后有官非、疾病。
en: If the Self and the Body are punished or controlled by the Month, the Day or a moving line, then though it comes about there will be lawsuits and illness later.

title: 求馆·间爻有动，纵吉难成（旧注：间爻动则事多阻隔，故难成）

rule.yi: 间爻（世应之间的爻）发动，事情多有阻隔，纵然卦象吉也难成。
rule.en: If a between line (a line between the Self and the Other) moves, the matter is often obstructed, and even if the hexagram is auspicious it is hard to bring about.

note.yi: 「间爻」是世爻和应爻之间的爻，在求馆里就是先生和东家之间的人（中人、荐馆人）。间爻动，是中间的人插了手，所以多阻隔。这个判据在别的章里也常见，如占婚的「间爻」（见 LY.MARRY 一带）。
note.en: 'A between line' is a line between the Self and the Other, and in a school post it is the person between the teacher and the host (the go-between, the one who recommends). When it moves, the go-between has stepped in, and so there is obstruction. This criterion is common in other chapters too, as with the 'between lines' in divining marriage (see around LY.MARRY).

yi: 间爻发动，纵然吉也难成。
en: If a between line moves, then even if it is auspicious it is hard to bring about.

zh: 间爻动，事多阻隔，故难成。
yi: 间爻发动，事情多半有阻隔，所以难成。
en: When a between line moves, the matter is often obstructed, and so it is hard to bring about.

zh: 间爻动克，事多阻隔，故难成也。
yi: 间爻发动来克，事情多有阻隔，所以难成。
en: A between line moving to control the matter is often obstructed, and so it is hard to bring about.

title: 求馆·鬼或化兄，备礼先酬乎荐馆（旧注：鬼爻动出兄弟必得礼物先酬荐馆之人则可成；兄临世身亦主先费财物；兄临应上是东家好利必得礼仪馈送而后可成）

rule.yi: 官鬼发动化出兄弟，必须拿出礼物先酬谢推荐馆的人，才能成；兄弟临世身，也主要先花费财物；兄弟临在应爻上，是东家好利，必须有礼品馈送，然后才能成。
rule.en: If Pressure moves and turns into Peer, one must give gifts first to repay the person who recommended one to the school, and then it can come through; Peer resting on the Self or the Body likewise means that one must first spend money and goods; if Peer rests on the Other, the host is fond of profit, and gifts must be sent before it can come through.

note.yi: 兄弟是劫财的神，在求馆里就是「要花钱」：鬼（荐馆人）化兄弟，要先谢荐馆人；兄弟临世身，自己先破费；兄弟临应，东家好利要礼。王洪绪只写了前两种，没有写兄弟临应的一种。
note.en: Peer is the spirit that robs wealth, and in a school post it means 'money must be spent': Pressure (the one who recommends) turning into Peer means the recommender must be thanked first; Peer on the Self or the Body means one spends first; Peer on the Other means the host is fond of profit and wants gifts. Wang Hongxu writes only the first two and not the case of Peer on the Other.

en: If Pressure turns into Peer, one must prepare gifts and first repay the one who recommended one to the school;

title: 求馆·世如变鬼，央人转荐于东家（旧注：鬼爻出现而世又化鬼须再得推荐乃成；卦无官而动爻化出者初无人荐亦待央人荐之；鬼化鬼父化父反复难成）

rule.yi: 官鬼爻出现而世爻又化出官鬼的，必须再得到推荐才能成；卦里没有官鬼而动爻化出官鬼的，当初没有人推荐，也必须等央求人去推荐才能成；官鬼化官鬼、父母化父母，又主反复难成。
rule.en: If Pressure appears and the Self also turns into Pressure, one must obtain a further recommendation before it can come through; if there is no Pressure in the hexagram but a moving line turns into Pressure, no one recommended one at first and one must wait for someone to be begged to recommend one before it can come through; if Pressure turns into Pressure or Resource into Resource, it also means going back and forth and being hard to bring about.

note.yi: 「转荐」是荐馆人再向东家转荐一次，等于多一层中间人。旧注最后一句「鬼化鬼、父化父，又主反复难成」（和 LY.CAREER.HJC.35 里「父化父有两处书馆」不同，那里是吉），王洪绪没有。
note.en: 'Recommend again' means the recommender passes one on to the host a second time, one more level of go-between. The old commentary's last sentence, 'Pressure turning into Pressure or Resource into Resource also means going back and forth and being hard to bring about' (different from 'Resource turning into Resource means two schools' in LY.CAREER.HJC.35, where it is favourable), is not in Wang Hongxu.

en: If the Self turns into Pressure, one must beg someone to recommend one again to the host.

title: 求馆·世无生合，谩看白眼之纷纷（旧注：应不克世、父母不空、兄鬼不动而月日动爻并不生合世，其事可成，但主人不钦敬皆以白眼待之）

rule.yi: 应爻不克世爻，父母不空，兄弟、官鬼不发动，而月建、日辰、动爻都不生合世爻的，这个事可以成，只是主人不敬重，都用白眼对待。
rule.en: If the Other does not control the Self, Resource is not Void, Peer and Pressure do not move, and the Month, the Day and the moving lines do not generate or combine with the Self, the matter can come about, only the master does not respect one and treats one with disdain.

note.yi: 「白眼」是用白眼看人，表示轻视（阮籍青白眼的典故）。这一条说的是：事能成，但没有人扶（日月动爻不生合世），所以在东家那里不受重视。王洪绪加了「纵成」二字，更强调这是成了之后的待遇。
note.en: 'White eyes' is looking at someone with the whites of one's eyes, showing contempt (from the story of Ruan Ji and his green and white eyes). This entry says that the matter can come about but, with no one to prop one up (the Day, the Month and the moving lines do not generate or combine with the Self), one is not valued by the host. Wang Hongxu adds 'even if it comes about', stressing that this is the treatment after it has come about.

zh: 世无生合，谩看白眼之纷纷；
yi: 世爻没有人来生合，只能徒然看着人们翻白眼的纷纷景象；
en: With no one to generate or combine with the Self, one can only look on at the crowds of white-eyed disdain;

title: 求馆·福或兴隆，会见青矜之济济（旧注：占馆以福爻为门生，旺相多、休囚少；空亡不上卦未必其家子弟；子化子生徒必多；带杀动来克世日后恐有操戈入室者）

rule.yi: 占馆以子孙爻代表门生（学生）：旺相就多，休囚就少；空亡、不上卦，虽是这家人作主，未必是他家的子弟；子孙化出子孙，学生必定多；带煞发动来克世爻，日后恐怕有动手作乱、入室反目的人。
rule.en: In divining a school post, Output stands for the pupils: if thriving there are many, if resting or trapped, few; if it is Void or absent from the hexagram, though this household is the master the pupils are not necessarily the sons of that family; Output turning into Output means many pupils; if it carries a killer and moves to control the Self, there may later be one who takes up arms and turns on his master within the room.

note.yi: 「青矜」（青衿）是读书人穿的青领的衣服，这里指学生。「操戈入室」是动手作乱、反目成仇（「入室操戈」是说反过来用老师教的东西来对付老师）。注意：在仕宦里，子孙是「伤官之杀」（LY.CAREER.HJC.03），在求馆里，子孙是门生，是吉神。这一章里子孙只吉不凶，书里这一章里的子孙是「学生」。
note.en: 'Blue collar' is the blue-collared dress that students wear, here meaning pupils. 'Take up arms and enter the room' is rising in violence and turning into enemies (it also means using what the teacher taught against the teacher). Note that in holding office Output is 'the killer that harms office' (LY.CAREER.HJC.03), whereas in a school post Output is the pupils, a lucky spirit; in this chapter Output is simply the 'students'.

zh: 福或兴隆，会见青矜之济济。
yi: 子孙如果兴旺，就会看到一群群青衿弟子济济一堂。
en: If Output flourishes, one will see rows upon rows of blue-collared pupils.

title: 求馆·衰逢扶起，日加鼓箧之徒（旧注：子孙旺相却被日辰动爻刑克，生徒始多日后渐减；子孙休囚得日辰动爻生合扶起，始虽不多开馆后日渐增进）

rule.yi: 子孙旺相却被日辰、动爻刑克，学生开始时虽然很多聚集在馆，日后渐渐减少；子孙休囚却被日辰、动爻生合扶起，开始时虽然不多，开馆后日渐增加。

note.yi: 「鼓箧」是古时入学的仪式（击鼓召集学生、打开书箱），这里指学生入学。旧注说的是两种相反的走势：先盛后衰（旺而被克）和先少后多（衰而被扶）；王洪绪只写了后一种。「开馆」是开始办馆。
note.en: 'Open their book-boxes at the drum' is an old school ceremony (a drum is struck to summon the pupils and the book-boxes are opened), here meaning pupils entering school. The old commentary gives two opposite courses: many first and then few (thriving but controlled) and few first and then many (weak but raised up); Wang Hongxu writes only the second. 'Open the school' means start running the school.

en: If Output is weak but is raised up, the pupils who open their book-boxes at the drum grow in number day by day;

title: 求馆·动遇冲开，时减执经之子（旧注：子孙动被日辰动爻冲散其徒必有背师而去；被世冲散是先生叱退其徒；子孙动变空亡弟子半途而废是歇学非叛去）

rule.yi: 子孙爻发动，本来是吉兆，如果被日辰、动爻冲散，他的学生必定有背弃老师而去的；如果被世爻冲散，是先生呵斥退了学生，不是弟子自己背弃老师；子孙动而变出空亡，弟子中有半途而废的，那是歇学，不是叛离。
rule.en: If the Output line moves, it is of itself an auspicious sign, but if it is clashed apart by the Day or a moving line, some of his pupils will surely turn their backs on him and leave; if it is clashed apart by the Self, it is the teacher who scolds his pupils away, and not the disciples who abandon their teacher; if Output moves and changes into Void, some of the disciples give up halfway, which is leaving off study and not defection.

note.yi: 这一联分三种走法：被日辰动爻冲散（学生背师）、被世冲散（先生赶走学生）、动变空亡（学生中途歇学），区别在于谁的责任。「执经」是拿着经书受业（指学生）。王洪绪只写了前两种。
note.en: This couplet separates three courses by who is at fault: clashed apart by the Day or a moving line (the pupils turn on the teacher), clashed apart by the Self (the teacher drives the pupils off), and moving into Void (the pupils break off their studies halfway). 'Carry the classics' is going to study with the classics in hand (meaning pupils). Wang Hongxu writes only the first two.

If it is clashed apart by the Self, it is the teacher who scolds his pupils away, and not the disciples who abandon their teacher.
If Output moves and changes into Void, then some of the disciples give up halfway, which is leaving off study and not defection.

en: If the Output line moves and is clashed apart by the Day or a moving line, his pupils will surely turn their backs on him and leave;

title: 求馆·逢龙则俊秀聪明，遇虎则刚强顽劣（旧注：子临青龙其徒聪明俊秀，更逢月日生合又临金水必有颖悟非常之子；临白虎多顽劣不驯，发动性野难教训；青龙必有礼貌，白虎必不尽礼）

rule.yi: 子孙临青龙，他的学生必然聪明俊秀，再遇月建、日辰生合、又临金、水爻的，必有颖悟非常的孩子；临白虎，就多是顽劣不驯的，发动则性情粗野，难以教训；遇到青龙，必定有礼貌，遇到白虎，必定不尽礼。
rule.en: If Output rests on the Azure Dragon, his pupils are surely clever and handsome, and if the Month or the Day also generates or combines with it and it rests on a Metal or Water line, there will surely be an exceptionally quick-witted child; if it rests on the White Tiger, they are mostly unruly and untamed, and if it moves their nature is wild and hard to teach; with the Azure Dragon they are surely courteous, and with the White Tiger they surely fall short in manners.

note.yi: 这一联用六神看学生的性情：青龙是喜庆、文雅，所以学生聪明有礼；白虎是刚猛，所以学生顽劣、不守礼。「金、水」在这里是聪明灵敏的五行（金白水智）。
note.en: This couplet reads the pupils' temper from the six spirits: the Azure Dragon is joy and refinement, so the pupils are clever and polite; the White Tiger is fierceness, so the pupils are unruly and ill-mannered. 'Metal and Water' here are the elements of quickness and cleverness.

en: Meeting the Azure Dragon, they are handsome and clever; meeting the White Tiger, they are headstrong and unruly.

title: 求馆·阳卦阳爻居养位，座前有刘恕之神童；阴宫阴象化财爻，帐后列马融之女乐（旧注：子孙在阳宫阳爻临胎养及金水旺相不空有扶者，其徒有出类拔萃；在阴宫阴爻又化财必有女儿受学，不化财而在兑宫亦有女徒）

rule.yi: 子孙在阳宫阳爻，又临胎、养以及金、水两爻，旺相不空，有扶助的，他的学生必有出类拔萃的，像刘恕那样的神童在门下；如果在阴宫阴爻，又化出财爻的，必有女孩来受学，不化出财爻而在兑宫的，也有女学生。
rule.en: If Output is in a yang palace on a yang line and rests on the Embryo or Nurture stage or on a Metal or Water line, thriving and not Void and supported, there will surely be an outstanding pupil among them, a child prodigy like Liu Shu at the door; if it is in a yin palace on a yin line and also turns into Wealth, there will surely be girls who come to study, and if it does not turn into Wealth but is in the Dui palace, there are also girl pupils.

note.yi: 「刘恕」是宋代以博学著称的人（从小聪颖，十三岁就通经史），「马融」是东汉经学家，讲学时帐后常有女乐，所以用来比有女学生；这里的「女乐」是借典故说「有女徒」，不是说真的有歌女。「胎、养」是十二长生里的两个阶段（胎、养是幼小的阶段），所以「居养位」是说子孙爻落在幼小的阶段，正好对应「神童」。王洪绪没有写胎养、不化财而在兑宫这几句。
note.en: 'Liu Shu' was a man of the Song famed for his learning (clever from childhood and master of the classics and histories at thirteen), and 'Ma Rong' was a classicist of the Eastern Han who had women musicians behind the curtain when he lectured, so he is used for having girl pupils; the 'women musicians' here borrow the story to say 'there are girl pupils' and do not mean singing girls. 'Embryo' and 'Nurture' are two stages of the twelve life stages (the stages of the very young), so 'in the Nurture stage' means the Output line falls in a stage of youth, which fits a 'child prodigy'. Wang Hongxu does not write the Embryo and Nurture stages or the case of not turning into Wealth but being in the Dui palace.

title: 求馆·两福自冲，鬼谷值孙膑庞涓之弟子；子孙皆合，伊川遇杨时游酢之门生（旧注：卦有两爻子孙俱动相冲弟子多不合、加白虎螣蛇数有争斗、来伤世必责及先生；二爻俱生合世爻则门生自尽弟子之礼必不轻背其师）

rule.yi: 卦里有两个子孙爻，都发动而相冲，弟子之间必定多有不合，再加白虎、螣蛇，时常有争斗，如果来伤世爻，必定连累到先生；如果两个爻都来生合世爻，门生就自己尽弟子的礼，尊师重道，必定不会轻易背弃老师。
rule.en: If the hexagram has two Output lines and both move and clash with each other, there will surely be much discord among the disciples, with the White Tiger and the Coiling Snake added there are often fights, and if they come to injure the Self it will surely reach the teacher; if both lines come to generate or combine with the Self, the pupils will fulfil the duty of disciples on their own, respect their teacher and value what is handed down, and will surely not lightly turn their backs on him.

note.yi: 经文借了两对师生：鬼谷子的弟子孙膑、庞涓后来成了仇敌，程颐（伊川）的弟子杨时、游酢「程门立雪」，以尊师著称。孙膑、庞涓、杨时、游酢书里没有展开，这里只是用来比弟子之间不合和相合。
note.en: The verse borrows two pairs of teachers and pupils: Guiguzi's disciples Sun Bin and Pang Juan later became enemies, and Cheng Yi's (Yichuan's) disciples Yang Shi and You Zuo, of the story of 'standing in the snow at Cheng's gate', were known for respect to their teacher. The book does not expand on Sun Bin, Pang Juan, Yang Shi or You Zuo, and they are used only as images for discord and accord among disciples.

rule.en: To collect the tuition fee, Wealth is the main line. If Wealth does not appear, whatever line it lies hidden under, collecting is hard work, and one must beg friends to go along and ask for it, and then it may perhaps be had, for a hidden line must be drawn up by the Month, the Day or a moving line, like a flying line, before it can come out and act; if Wealth appears and is thriving, and the Month, the Day and the moving lines do not injure or control it, there will be no shortfall; if Wealth appears but is controlled, or in extinction, Void or in a tomb, nothing is as one wishes.

note.yi: 「维持」是帮忙撑持。伏神要「提起」才能起作用（月建日辰动爻把它冲、生、合起来），这是通用的规矩，在别的章里也常见。卜筮正宗没有 LY.CAREER.HJC.56 那一联的经文，王洪绪这一段把「出现不伤」那一联的意思也包括了。
note.en: 'Help' is helping to prop up. A hidden line must be 'drawn up' (clashed, generated or combined up by the Month, the Day or a moving line) before it can act, a general rule that is also often met in other chapters. The Bushi Zhengzong does not carry the verse of the couplet in LY.CAREER.HJC.56, and Wang Hongxu's passage here also covers the sense of the couplet 'appearing and not injured'.

zh: 如索束修，可把妻财推究；
若居伏地，还求朋友维持。
yi: 如果要讨取束修，可以从妻财来推究；
如果它处在伏藏的地方，还要求朋友出面维持。
en: If the tuition fee is to be collected, look into Wealth;
if it lies hidden, one must still ask friends to help.

If it does not appear, whatever line it lies hidden under, collecting is hard work.
One must beg friends to go along and ask for it, and then it may perhaps be had.
For whatever lies hidden must have the Month, the Day or a moving line draw up the hidden line, like a flying line, before it can come out and act, and that is why.

zh: 凡占取索束修，得财爻出现旺相，月建日辰动爻不来伤克，则不欠缺；
若财出现被克，或绝或空或墓，主皆不遂意也。
yi: 凡占讨取束修，得到财爻出现旺相，月建、日辰、动爻不来伤克，就不会欠缺；
如果财爻出现却被克，或者绝、或者空、或者入墓，主都不如意。
en: In divining the collecting of the tuition fee, if Wealth appears and is thriving, and the Month, the Day and the moving lines do not come to injure or control it, there will be no shortfall;
if Wealth appears but is controlled, or in extinction, or Void, or in a tomb, nothing is as one wishes.

title: 求馆·出现不伤，旺相生身，名曰吉；入空无救，休囚化绝，号为凶（旧注：占束修财爻出现旺相不空、月日动爻不带兄弟伤克则不缺欠，财生世合世大吉；财被克劫、居绝地、空亡、变死墓绝皆不遂意；世持兄克尤难取讨；子孙旺动亦好）

rule.yi: 占束修，财爻出现、旺相不空，月建、日辰、动爻又不带兄弟来伤克，就不缺欠，再得财爻生世、合世，是大吉的兆头；如果财爻虽然出现，却被克被劫，或处在绝地，或空亡，或变出死、墓、绝的爻，都不如意；世爻临着兄弟来克财，尤其难讨；得子孙旺相发动，也好。
rule.en: In divining the tuition fee, if Wealth appears, thriving and not Void, and the Month, the Day and the moving lines do not carry Peer to injure or control it, there is no shortfall, and if Wealth also generates or combines with the Self it is a greatly auspicious sign; if Wealth appears but is controlled or robbed, or stands in a place of extinction, or is Void, or turns into a line of death, tomb or extinction, nothing is as one wishes; if the Self rests on Peer and it controls Wealth, collecting is especially hard; and if Output is thriving and moves, that is also good.

note.yi: 这一联的经文是求馆章收尾处对「吉凶」的总括（出现不伤旺相是吉、空无救休囚化绝是凶）；卜筮正宗没有这一联，它的相应意思并在 LY.CAREER.HJC.55 的王洪绪一段里。旧注「世持兄克，尤难取讨」是说世爻临着兄弟而兄弟又克财，不是说世克兄弟。
note.en: The verse is a summary of good and ill at the end of the chapter's account of the tuition fee (appearing, uninjured and thriving is auspicious; Void, unrescued, resting or turning into extinction is ominous); the Bushi Zhengzong does not have this couplet, and its sense is in Wang Hongxu's passage in LY.CAREER.HJC.55. The old commentary's 'the Self holds Peer and it controls Wealth, collecting is especially hard' means the Self rests on Peer and Peer controls Wealth, not that the Self controls Peer.

title: 求馆·变出父爻，书债必然偿货物（旧注：财动化父或父动化财，束修必无金银宝物，多是货物准折，有名无实；兄弟更动杂货物亦不尽得）

rule.yi: 财爻发动化出父母，或者父母发动化出财，束修一定没有金银财宝，多半是用货物折价，是有名无实的象；卦里兄弟再发动，连杂货物也不能全部得到。
rule.en: If Wealth moves and turns into Resource, or Resource moves and turns into Wealth, the fee will surely not be in gold and silver but mostly in goods taken at a set value, the image of name without substance; if Peer also moves in the hexagram, even the miscellaneous goods cannot all be had.

title: 求馆·身空应空财福空，必成虚度（旧注：占束修卦身应爻及子孙妻财或空或不上卦则束修无得，财为用神、身为事主、应为诸生父兄、子孙生财之神今皆空休）

rule.yi: 占束修，遇到卦身、应爻，以及子孙、妻财，有的空亡或者不上卦，束修就拿不到，因为财是用神，身是事主，应是学生的父兄，子孙又是生财的神，现在都空、都休囚，怎么能拿到呢，所以白白虚度。
rule.en: In divining the fee, if the Body, the Other, Output and Wealth are Void or absent from the hexagram, the fee will not be obtained, for Wealth is the Subject, the Body is the one the matter belongs to, the Other is the pupils' fathers and brothers, and Output is the spirit that generates Wealth, and now all are Void and resting, how can it be obtained, and so the time is spent in vain.

rule.yi: 月建、日辰、动爻、变爻等爻，都来刑克世爻的，占馆一定不能成；占束修，恐怕被学生的父兄呵责，应该谨慎。王洪绪说得更重：占馆有意想不到的凶险。

dispute.yi: 同一个象（月日动变都来刑克世爻），旧注说的是「占馆必不可成」，再说占束修会被学生父兄呵责；王洪绪说的是「占馆有不测之凶」。旧注是事成不成的问题，王洪绪是祸患大小的问题，他把结果说得更重，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: For the same image (the Month, the Day and the moving and changed lines all punish or control the Self) the old commentary says 'the school post cannot come about' and then that in divining the fee one will be scolded by the pupils' fathers and brothers, and Wang Hongxu says 'in divining a school post there is an unforeseen ill'. The old commentary is about whether it comes about, and Wang Hongxu about how great the misfortune is, and he puts the result more heavily; the books do not decide.

title: 求馆·子连父合，因学而才思加焉（旧注：世衰绝无气而子孙动化、父母生扶合起世爻，先生才学本不赡而因教训子弟才思日进；有财动则不然；王洪绪：子弟之才日加进益）

rule.yi: 占学馆，世爻如果衰绝无气，而遇到子孙发动变化、父母生扶、合起世爻的，主先生的才学本来不够丰富，因为教导子弟，他的才思日渐进益；卦里有财爻发动，就不是这样。
rule.en: In divining a school, if the Self is weak and in extinction without breath, but Output moves and changes and Resource generates and supports and combines the Self up, it means the teacher's learning was not at first abundant, but through teaching the youngsters his talent and thought advance day by day; if a Wealth line moves in the hexagram, it is not so.

dispute.yi: 进益的是谁，两家说法不一样：旧注说是先生（「先生才学本不克赡，因教训子弟而其才思日加进益」，教学相长）；王洪绪说是子弟（「主子弟之才日加进益也」）。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: On who is the one who advances, the two commentators differ: the old commentary says it is the teacher ('the teacher's learning was not at first abundant, and through teaching the youngsters his talent and thought advance day by day', teaching and learning growing together), and Wang Hongxu says it is the pupils ('the pupils' talent advances day by day'). The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这是求馆章的最后一联：前面都是讲能不能得到馆、束修多少，最后一联讲的是做了这份差事之后人会怎么样。「教学相长」的意思见旧注。
note.en: This is the last couplet of the chapter on a school post: the earlier ones speak of whether one gets the post and how much the fee is, and the last speaks of what becomes of the person after doing the work. For 'teaching and learning grow together' see the old commentary.

title: 国朝·君恕则臣忠，共济明良之会；国泰则民乐，当推祸福之原；国之治乱兴衰，卦理推详剖决（总论）

rule.yi: 占国家的兴衰，是把整个卦当作国运来读。国家有始有终，必有兴有废；国君宽厚，臣子就忠心；国家太平，百姓就安乐；这些祸福的来由，都可以用卦理推到根上、剖开判决。哪一爻代表什么，见下一条。
rule.en: A question about the fortunes of a state reads the whole hexagram as the fortune of the realm. A state has a beginning and an end and must rise and fall; when the ruler is forgiving the ministers are loyal, and when the state is at peace the people are happy; the source of such blessings and disasters can be traced and decided by the principles of the hexagram. Which line stands for what is in the next rule.

note.yi: 国朝章从这里开头、到这里收尾，中间二十多联都是拿具体的历史人物来讲卦象，用法见下面各条。
note.en: The chapter on the state opens and closes with these lines; the twenty-odd couplets between them use particular historical figures to teach the images, as the entries that follow show.

zh: 君恕则臣忠，共济明良之会；
国泰则民乐，当推祸福之原。
虽天地尚知其始终，况国家岂能无兴废？
yi: 国君宽恕体恤，臣子就忠心，君臣共同成就明君与良臣相遇的盛会；
国家太平，百姓就安乐，要推究的就是祸福产生的根源。
连天地尚且知道有它的开始和终结，何况一个国家，怎么可能没有兴盛和衰亡？
en: When the ruler is forgiving the ministers are loyal, and together they bring about the meeting of a bright ruler and good ministers;
when the state is at peace the people are happy, and what is to be traced is the source of disaster and fortune.
Even heaven and earth are known to have a beginning and an end, so how could a state be without rise and fall?

title: 国朝·本宫旺相，周文王创八百年之基；大象休囚，秦始皇遗二世主之祸（旧注：本宫为国爻，太岁为君、岁合为后、月建为臣、日建为东宫、子孙为黎庶、父爻为国；本宫旺相国祚长，休囚而大象又凶则速亡）

rule.yi: 占国运，先分派各爻：本宫是国爻，太岁是君，和太岁相合的是后，月建是臣，日建是东宫（太子），子孙是百姓，父爻是国家。开国时占得本宫旺相，国运绵长，像周文王那样子孙享国八百年；本宫休囚、整个卦象又凶，国运短促，像秦始皇那样到二世就亡国。
rule.en: To ask about the fortune of a state, first assign the lines: the home palace is the line of the state, Tai Sui is the ruler, the branch combining with Tai Sui is the empress, the Month is the minister, the Day is the Eastern Palace (the crown prince), Output is the common people and Resource is the realm. If a state is being founded and the home palace comes out thriving or strong, its fortune is long, as with King Wen of Zhou, whose descendants held the realm for eight hundred years; if the home palace is resting or trapped and the whole image is also bad, its fortune is short, as with the First Emperor of Qin, whose state was lost with the second reign.

note.yi: 卜筮正宗把这段分派写成「如臣卜」（臣子占国朝），并在后面「年伤弱世」一联说「以下指言国君自卜」，把这一章分成臣子占国运和国君自占两种占法；卜筮大全的旧注没有这样标明。
note.en: The Bu Shi Zheng Zong writes this assignment as what applies 'when a minister casts', and at the couplet 'the year injures a weak Self' it says 'what follows speaks of the ruler casting for himself', so that it divides the chapter into a minister asking about the realm and the ruler asking about himself; the old commentary in the Bu Shi Da Quan does not mark this.

zh: 本宫旺相，周文王创八百年之基；
大象休囚，秦始皇遗二世主之祸。
yi: 本宫旺相，就像周文王创下了八百年的基业；
整个卦象休囚，就像秦始皇留下了二世皇帝覆亡的祸患。
en: If the home palace is thriving or strong, it is like King Wen of Zhou founding a base of eight hundred years;
if the whole image is resting or trapped, it is like the First Emperor of Qin leaving behind the disaster of the Second Emperor.

title: 国朝·九五逢阳，当遇仁明之主；四爻值福，必多忠义之臣（旧注：五爻为君位，逢阳象又遇青龙财福是仁明之君；四爻为臣位，子孙旺相克世是敢谏之臣，兄鬼生合世爻是阿谀佞臣）

rule.yi: 第五爻是君位：逢到阳象，又遇到青龙、妻财、子孙，是仁慈英明的君主；世爻临阳象、带吉神也一样。第四爻是臣位：子孙旺相、克世爻，是敢于直言进谏的臣子；兄弟、官鬼生合世爻，是阿谀奉承的佞臣。
rule.en: The fifth line is the ruler's seat: if it meets a yang image and also meets the Azure Dragon, Wealth and Output, the ruler is benevolent and enlightened, and so it is if the Self sits in a yang image with auspicious spirits. The fourth line is the ministers' seat: if Output is thriving or strong and controls the Self, the minister dares to remonstrate plainly; if a Peer or Pressure line generates or combines with the Self, he is a flattering and treacherous minister.

note.en: The conditions differ: the old commentary requires Output to be thriving and to control the Self, and the Peer or Pressure line to generate or combine with the Self; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong says only that the fourth line 'meets a thriving Output' or 'meets Peer or Pressure', and does not mention controlling or combining with the Self.

zh: 九五逢阳，当遇仁明之主；

en: If the fifth line meets yang, one will meet a benevolent and enlightened ruler;
if the fourth line meets the lucky star of Output, there will surely be many loyal and righteous ministers.

zh: 本宫衰死，更遇太岁所克，其年国有乱亡之兆。

其曲有玉树后庭花，临春乐等，大略皆美诸嫔妃之容色。
君臣酣歌，自夕达旦，以此为常。
故曰：玉树后庭花欲谢也。
yi: 本宫衰弱死绝，又遇到太岁来克，这一年国家有动乱灭亡的征兆。
从前陈朝将要灭亡的时候，陈后主让众妃嫔，连同歌女乐伎和游侠宾客，一起作诗，互相赠答。
挑出其中最艳丽的诗句，配上新曲；
选了一千多名宫女，学着歌唱，分成几部轮流演奏。
那些曲子有《玉树后庭花》《临春乐》等，大致都是赞美各位妃嫔的容貌姿色。
君臣尽兴唱歌饮酒，从晚上到天亮，一直这样成了常事。

所以说：《玉树后庭花》将要凋谢了。
en: If the home palace is weak or dead and meets control from Tai Sui, the state shows signs of disorder and ruin that year.
Long ago, when Chen was about to fall, its last ruler had his consorts, together with the singing women and the wandering gallant guests, compose poems together and exchange them with one another.
They picked the most gorgeous of the verses and set them to new tunes;
they chose over a thousand palace women to learn and sing them, and the groups performed in turn.
Among the pieces were 'Jade Trees and Flowers of the Rear Court' and 'Linchun Le', which in the main all praised the beauty of the consorts.
Ruler and ministers sang and drank to their heart's content from evening until dawn, and made it a habit.
Later Chen was destroyed by Sui.
That is why it says: 'Jade Trees and Flowers of the Rear Court' is about to fade.

zh: 本宫衰弱遇太岁克，国有乱亡之兆。

title: 国朝·年伤弱世，鼎湖龙去不多时（旧注：太岁刑冲克害世爻主国君疾病或内难将作，世爻又衰弱必有君崩之忧）

en: If the year injures a weak Self, the dragon departs from Ding Lake before long.

title: 国朝·世临沐浴合妻财，夫差恋西施而亡国（旧注：世临沐浴，或财爻应爻带沐浴动克合世，必是国君好色；如夫差恋西施拒子胥之谏，后为越王勾践所灭）

rule.yi: 世爻落在沐浴上，或者妻财爻、应爻带着沐浴发动、来克合世爻，多半是国君好色，就像夫差迷恋西施、拒不听伍子胥的劝谏，后来被越王勾践灭掉。
rule.en: If the Self sits on Bathing, or the Wealth line or the Other line carries Bathing, moves, and controls or combines with the Self, the ruler is surely fond of women, like Fuchai who doted on Xishi, refused the remonstrance of Zixu, and was later destroyed by Goujian, King of Yue.

zh: 世临沐浴合妻财，夫差恋西施而亡国；
yi: 世爻落在沐浴上、又合妻财，就像夫差迷恋西施而亡国；
en: If the Self sits on Bathing and combines with the Wealth line, it is like Fuchai who doted on Xishi and lost his state;

hits.text: 世临沐浴合妻财，夫差恋西施而亡国
世临沐浴合妻财，夫差恋西施而亡国

zh: 世临沐浴，或财爻、应爻带沐浴动，克合世爻，必是国君好色。
如夫差恋西施美，拒子胥谏，后为越王勾践所灭。
yi: 世爻落在沐浴上，或者财爻、应爻带着沐浴发动，来克、合世爻，必定是国君好色。
就像夫差迷恋西施的美貌，拒绝伍子胥的劝谏，后来被越王勾践灭掉。
en: If the Self sits on Bathing, or the Wealth line or the Other line carries Bathing and moves to control or combine with the Self, the ruler is surely fond of women.
It is like Fuchai who doted on the beauty of Xishi, rejected the remonstrance of Zixu, and was later destroyed by Goujian, King of Yue.

zh: 如世临沐浴合财爻、应爻或沐浴动克合世，必是好色，如夫差恋西施之美，为越所灭。
yi: （以上）都是指国君自己占卜。
例如世爻落在沐浴上，合财爻、应爻，或者沐浴发动来克合世爻，必定是好色，就像夫差迷恋西施的美貌，被越灭掉。
en: All of this speaks of the ruler casting for himself.

For example, if the Self sits on Bathing and combines with the Wealth line or the Other line, or Bathing moves to control or combine with the Self, he is surely fond of women, like Fuchai who doted on the beauty of Xishi and was destroyed by Yue.

title: 国朝·应带咸池临九五，武后革唐命而为周（旧注：应爻为皇后，带咸池其后必淫，更居九五是后居尊位，如吕后临朝；再旺动刑冲克害世爻、世或空亡，则如武后废中宗革唐为周）

rule.yi: 应爻是皇后。应爻带咸池，皇后一定不检点；又落在第五爻，就是皇后居于至尊之位，像汉朝的吕后临朝称制；如果它再旺相发动、刑冲克害世爻，世爻又逢空亡，就像唐朝的武后废掉中宗、降为庐陵王，改唐为周。
rule.en: The Other line is the empress. If it carries Xianchi, the empress is sure to be licentious; if it also sits in the fifth place, the empress holds the seat of honour, like Empress Lü of Han presiding at court and issuing edicts; if it is also thriving and moving, and punishes, clashes with, controls or harms the Self, while the Self may be Void, it is like Empress Wu of Tang, who deposed Emperor Zhongzong, made him Prince of Luling, and turned the Tang mandate into Zhou.

note.yi: 两处条件不同：旧注要应爻再旺相发动、刑冲克害世爻，并说「世或空亡」；卜筮正宗只说应爻居九五尊位、克世，没有提世爻落空。
note.en: The conditions differ: the old commentary adds that the Other line is thriving and moving and punishes, clashes with, controls or harms the Self, and says 'the Self may be Void'; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong says only that the Other line sits in the honoured fifth place and controls the Self, and does not mention the Self being Void.

zh: 应带咸池临九五，武后革唐命而为周。
yi: 应爻带着咸池，又落在九五，就像武后改变了唐的国运、改唐为周。
en: If the Other line carries Xianchi and sits in the fifth place, it is like Empress Wu who changed the mandate of Tang and made it Zhou.

hits.text: 应带咸池临九五，武后革唐命而为周
应带咸池临九五，武后革唐命而为周

zh: 更居九五，乃是后居尊位。
更有旺动，刑冲克害世爻，世或空亡，必如唐武后废中宗为庐陵王，革唐命为周。
yi: 应爻是皇后的位置。
如果带着咸池，那位皇后必定淫乱。
再落在九五，就是皇后居于至尊之位。
就像汉朝的吕后，临朝执政、代行皇帝的号令。
如果它再旺相发动，刑、冲、克、害世爻，世爻又落空亡，必定像唐朝的武后那样，废掉中宗、降为庐陵王，改唐的国运为周。
en: The Other line is the empress's place.
If it carries Xianchi, the empress is sure to be licentious.
If it also sits in the fifth place, the empress holds the seat of honour.
It is like Empress Lü of Han, who presided at court and issued edicts in the ruler's place.

If it is also thriving and moving, and punishes, clashes with, controls or harms the Self, and the Self may be Void, it is surely like Empress Wu of Tang, who deposed Emperor Zhongzong, made him Prince of Luling, and changed the Tang mandate into Zhou.

zh: 君自卜以应爻为皇后，若带咸池，其后必淫，更居九五尊位克世，如唐武后废中宗为庐陵王，革唐命为周。
yi: 国君自己占卜时，以应爻为皇后，如果带着咸池，那位皇后必定淫乱，再落在九五的尊位又来克世，就像唐朝的武后废掉中宗、降为庐陵王，改唐的国运为周。
en: When the ruler casts for himself, take the Other line as the empress; if it carries Xianchi the empress is sure to be licentious, and if it also sits in the honoured seat of the fifth place and controls the Self, it is like Empress Wu of Tang, who deposed Zhongzong, made him Prince of Luling, and changed the Tang mandate into Zhou.

title: 国朝·游魂遇空，虞舜南巡不返（旧注：游魂卦主国君迁都游荡巡狩；再加凶杀克世，或世动入死墓空绝，则如虞舜南巡崩于苍梧之野）

rule.yi: 国君自占得游魂卦，是迁都、四处巡游的象，像周穆王巡游天下；如果再带凶煞克世，或世爻发动、变入死、墓、空、绝，就像虞舜南巡，死在苍梧的野外，一去不回。
rule.en: When the ruler casts for himself, a Wandering Soul hexagram is the image of moving the capital and touring the realm, like King Mu of Zhou who toured the whole land; if a baleful spirit is added that controls the Self, or the Self moves into death, tomb, Void or extinction, it is like Shun of Yu, who went south on a tour and died in the wilds of Cangwu, never to return.

note.yi: 旧注把游魂卦读作「迁都游荡巡狩之象」，只是一个象；卜筮正宗读作「不宜迁都巡狩」，是一条忌讳。两处说法的轻重不完全一样。
note.en: The old commentary reads a Wandering Soul hexagram as 'the image of moving the capital, wandering and touring', which is only an image; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong reads it as 'not fit for moving the capital or touring', which is a prohibition. The weight is not quite the same.

zh: 游魂遇空，虞舜南巡不返；
yi: 游魂卦遇到空，就像虞舜南巡一去不回；
en: If a Wandering Soul hexagram meets Void, it is like Shun of Yu who went south on a tour and never returned;

hits.text: 游魂遇空，虞舜南巡不返
游魂遇空，虞舜南巡不返

zh: 卦遇游魂，主国君迁都游荡巡狩之象。
如周穆王巡狩游行天下。
若加凶杀克世，或世动入死墓空绝，则如虞舜南巡，崩于苍梧之野。
yi: 卦遇到游魂，主国君迁都、四处游荡巡视的象。
就像周穆王巡视出游天下。
如果再加上凶煞来克世，或者世爻发动变入死、墓、空、绝，就像虞舜南巡，死在苍梧的原野上。
en: If the hexagram is a Wandering Soul hexagram, it is the image of the ruler moving the capital and wandering about on tours of inspection.
It is like King Mu of Zhou who toured the whole land.
If a baleful spirit is added that controls the Self, or the Self moves into death, tomb, Void or extinction, it is like Shun of Yu who went south on a tour and died in the wilds of Cangwu.

zh: 卦遇游魂不宜迁都巡狩，若加凶煞克世，或世爻动化墓绝，如虞舜南巡崩于苍梧之野。
yi: 卦遇到游魂，不适合迁都、巡视；如果再加凶煞来克世，或者世爻发动变入墓、绝，就像虞舜南巡，死在苍梧的原野上。
en: If the hexagram is a Wandering Soul hexagram it is not fit to move the capital or go on a tour; if a baleful spirit is added that controls the Self, or the Self line moves and turns into tomb or extinction, it is like Shun of Yu who went south on a tour and died in the wilds of Cangwu.

title: 国朝·归魂带煞，始皇返国亡身（旧注：归魂卦遇凶神恶杀动克世身，如始皇求仙海上，返国崩于沙丘之野）

rule.yi: 国君自占得归魂卦，又遇凶神恶煞发动来克世爻或卦身，就像秦始皇到海上求仙，回国后死在沙丘。
rule.en: When the ruler casts for himself, a Returning Soul hexagram that meets baleful spirits moving to control the Self or the Body is like the First Emperor of Qin, who sought immortals by the sea and died at Shaqiu after returning to his state.

note.yi: 旧注要「凶神恶杀」发动克世身；卜筮正宗只说「遇动爻克世身」，没有说凶神恶煞。「世身」按世爻与卦身两者读。
note.en: The old commentary requires baleful spirits moving to control the Self and Body; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong says only 'meets a moving line that controls the Self and Body', without baleful spirits. 'Self and Body' is read as the Self line and the Body together.

zh: 归魂带煞，始皇返国亡身。
yi: 归魂卦带着凶煞，就像秦始皇回到国都途中丧了命。
en: If a Returning Soul hexagram carries a baleful spirit, it is like the First Emperor who returned to his state and lost his life.

hits.text: 归魂带煞，始皇返国亡身
归魂带煞，始皇返国亡身

zh: 若归魂卦，遇凶神恶杀，动克世身，如始皇求仙海上，返国崩于沙丘之野。
yi: 如果是归魂卦，遇到凶神恶煞发动来克世爻或卦身，就像秦始皇在海上求仙，回国后死在沙丘的原野上。
en: If it is a Returning Soul hexagram and meets baleful spirits that move and control the Self or the Body, it is like the First Emperor who sought immortals by the sea and died in the wilds of Shaqiu after returning to his state.

zh: 若归魂卦遇动爻克世身，如始皇求仙海上，返国崩于沙丘。
yi: 如果是归魂卦，遇到动爻克世爻或卦身，就像秦始皇在海上求仙，回国后死在沙丘。
en: If it is a Returning Soul hexagram and meets a moving line that controls the Self or the Body, it is like the First Emperor who sought immortals by the sea and died at Shaqiu after returning to his state.

title: 国朝·子发逢空，张子房起归山之计（旧注：子孙为臣，逢空动或四爻臣位空动，更被世爻克害，是君欲害臣、臣欲避君，如张良托辟谷弃职从赤松子游）

rule.yi: 子孙是臣。子孙逢空发动，或者第四爻（臣位）落空而动、又被世爻克害，是国君想害臣子、臣子想躲开国君，就像张良借口辟谷、辞去官职，跟随赤松子出游。
rule.en: Output is the minister. If Output meets Void and moves, or the fourth line, the ministers' seat, is Void and moves and is also controlled and harmed by the Self, the ruler wants to harm the minister and the minister wants to avoid the ruler, like Zhang Liang, who pleaded fasting from grain, gave up office and went roaming with Chi Songzi.

note.yi: 子孙有两种：本宫的子孙是太子（见「日辰拱扶子位」一联），别的宫的子孙是臣。卜筮正宗在这一联明说「他宫子孙为臣」；卜筮大全旧注这里只写「子孙为臣」，到「日辰拱扶子位」才分他宫与本宫。
note.en: Output comes in two kinds: the Output of the home palace is the crown prince (see the couplet 'the Day supports Output's place'), and the Output of another palace is the minister. The Bu Shi Zheng Zong says so outright here, 'the Output of another palace is the minister'; the old commentary in the Bu Shi Da Quan writes only 'Output is the minister' here and draws the line between another palace and the home palace at 'the Day supports Output's place'.

zh: 子发逢空，张子房起归山之计；
yi: 子孙发动逢到空，就像张子房起了退隐归山的打算；
en: If Output moves and meets Void, it is like Zhang Zifang forming the plan to retire to the hills;

hits.text: 子发逢空，张子房起归山之计
子发逢空，张子房起归山之计

zh: 若逢空动，或四爻臣位空动，更被世爻克害，必是君欲害臣，臣欲避君。
如汉张良，托为辟谷，弃职从赤松子游也。
yi: 子孙是臣子。
如果逢空发动，或者第四爻臣位空动，又被世爻克害，必定是国君想害臣子，臣子想躲开国君。
就像汉朝的张良，假托辟谷不食，放弃官职跟随赤松子出游。
en: Output is the minister.

If it meets Void and moves, or the fourth line, the ministers' seat, is Void and moves, and is also controlled and harmed by the Self, the ruler surely wants to harm the minister and the minister wants to avoid the ruler.
It is like Zhang Liang of Han, who gave fasting from grain as his pretext, abandoned his post and went roaming with Chi Songzi.

zh: 他宫子孙为臣，若逢空动被世克害，必是君欲害臣，如汉张良弃职从赤松子游也。
yi: 别的宫的子孙是臣子，如果逢空发动、被世克害，必定是国君想害臣子，就像汉朝张良弃官跟随赤松子出游。
en: The Output of another palace is the minister; if it meets Void and moves and is controlled and harmed by the Self, the ruler surely wants to harm the minister, like Zhang Liang of Han who gave up office and went roaming with Chi Songzi.

title: 国朝·将星被害，岳武穆抱吁天之冤（旧注：将星看日支，临财子必忠良智勇之将，值官鬼白虎强悍，临父是老将、遇兄庸常；将星持鬼克世如曹操桓温篡位，被动爻克害如岳飞遇秦桧）

rule.yi: 将星按占卦那天的地支来找，例如寅、午、戌日占，午爻就是将星。将星临妻财、子孙，必是忠良有智勇的将领；值官鬼、白虎，是强悍的将领；临父母爻，是年老的将领；遇兄弟，不过是平庸的将领。将星持官鬼来克害世爻，就像曹操、桓温挟天子以令诸侯，往往篡位自立；将星被动爻或第四爻动来克害，就像岳飞遇到秦桧这样的权奸而被害死。
rule.en: Find the General star from the day branch: on a Yin, Wu or Xu day, the Wu line is the General star, and so on for the others. A General star on Wealth or Output means a loyal, able, wise and brave general; meeting Pressure or the White Tiger, a fierce and stubborn one; on Resource, an old general; meeting Peer, no more than a commonplace one. If the General star holds Pressure and controls and harms the Self, it is like Cao Cao and Huan Wen, who held the emperor and gave orders to the lords and mostly ended by usurping the throne; if the General star is controlled and harmed by a moving line, or by a moving fourth line, it is like Yue Fei of Song, who was killed by the harm of the powerful and treacherous Qin Hui.

note.yi: 将星持鬼克世的结果，旧注举曹操、桓温挟天子篡位；卜筮正宗收成「恐有造谋之变」，没有举人名。被克害那一句，旧注还多一个「被四爻动克」。
note.en: For a General star holding Pressure and controlling the Self, the old commentary gives Cao Cao and Huan Wen holding the emperor and usurping; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong boils it down to 'there may be an upheaval of plotting' with no names. For the harmed General star, the old commentary adds 'or controlled by a moving fourth line'.

zh: 将星被害，岳武穆抱吁天之冤。
yi: 将星被克害，就像岳武穆含着向天呼冤的冤屈。
en: If the General star is harmed, it is like Yue Wumu who bore a grievance he could only cry out to heaven.

hits.text: 将星被害，岳武穆抱吁天之冤
将星被害，岳武穆抱吁天之冤

zh: 将星，如寅午戌日卜，午爻为将星是。
若将星临财子，必得忠良智勇之将。
将星值官鬼白虎，必强悍之将。
若将星持鬼，克害世爻，必如曹操桓温，挟天子以令诸侯，多致篡位自立。
若将星被动爻克害，或被四爻动克，必如宋岳飞，遇秦桧权奸之害而死也。
yi: 将星，比如在寅、午、戌日占卜，午爻就是将星。
其余的依此类推。
如果将星临在妻财、子孙上，必定得到忠良而有智有勇的将领。
将星遇到官鬼、白虎，必定是强悍的将领。
如果临在父爻上，必定是年老的将领；
遇到兄弟，不过是平庸寻常的将领。
如果将星持着官鬼，克害世爻，必定像曹操、桓温那样，挟持天子来号令诸侯，多半导致篡位自立。
如果将星被动爻克害，或者被第四爻发动来克，必定像宋朝的岳飞，遇到秦桧这样的权奸迫害而死。
en: As for the General star, if the cast is made on a Yin, Wu or Xu day, the Wu line is the General star.
The rest follow by analogy.
If the General star is on Wealth or Output, one will surely get a loyal, good, wise and brave general.
If the General star meets Pressure or the White Tiger, he is surely a fierce and stubborn general.
If it is on Resource, he is surely an old general;
if it meets Peer, he is no more than a commonplace general.

If the General star holds Pressure and controls and harms the Self, it is surely like Cao Cao and Huan Wen, who held the emperor to command the lords and mostly ended by usurping the throne and setting themselves up.

If the General star is controlled and harmed by a moving line, or controlled by a moving fourth line, it is surely like Yue Fei of Song, who was killed by the harm of the powerful and treacherous Qin Hui.

zh: 将星，寅午戌日卜，午爻为将星，其余类推。
若将星临财子，必得忠职智勇，值官鬼白虎，必强悍之将。
若将星持鬼克害世爻，恐有造谋之变；
若将星被动爻克害，如岳武穆遇秦桧之害也。
yi: 将星是这样找的：寅、午、戌日占卜，午爻就是将星，其余依此类推。
如果将星临在妻财、子孙上，必定得到尽忠职守、有智有勇的将领；遇到官鬼、白虎，必定是强悍的将领。
如果将星持着官鬼，克害世爻，恐怕会有图谋作乱的变故；
如果将星被动爻克害，就像岳武穆遇到秦桧的陷害。
en: As for the General star, on a Yin, Wu or Xu day the Wu line is the General star, and the rest follow by analogy.

If the General star is on Wealth or Output, one will surely get a general who is loyal to his duty, wise and brave; if it meets Pressure or the White Tiger, he is surely a fierce and stubborn general.
If the General star holds Pressure and controls and harms the Self, there may be an upheaval of plotting and scheming;
if the General star is controlled and harmed by a moving line, it is like Yue Wumu meeting the harm of Qin Hui.

title: 国朝·应旺生合世爻，圣主得椒房之助（旧注：应爻为皇后，旺相生合世爻又临财福，皇后美貌智略、天性慈仁，能规君过、导君以善，如汉马后、宋宣仁）

rule.yi: 应爻是皇后。应爻旺相、生合世爻，又临妻财或子孙，皇后相貌美、有智谋、天性仁慈，能规劝国君的过失，引导国君向善，像汉朝的马皇后、宋朝的宣仁皇后。
rule.en: The Other line is the empress. If the Other line is thriving or strong, generates or combines with the Self, and sits on Wealth or Output, the empress is beautiful, wise and kind by nature, and can correct the ruler's faults and lead him to the good, like Empress Ma of Han and Empress Xuanren of Song.

note.yi: 宋朝那位皇后，卜筮大全的旧注写「宜仁」，卜筮正宗写「宣仁」；译文按「宣仁」读（宋朝被称作「女中尧舜」的宣仁太后）。

en: The Other line is the empress's place.

The empress's chambers had pepper plastered on the walls, to drive away evil influences.
Hence the name Pepper Chamber.

title: 国朝·日辰拱扶子位，东宫摄天子之权（旧注：他宫子孙旺相又得日辰生扶、世值胎养空绝，主幼主在位、大臣摄政，如周公辅成王；本宫子孙生旺得日辰扶助，国君将传位，太子当国）

rule.yi: 本宫的子孙（太子）被第四爻冲、克、刑、害，必定被进谗的臣子诽谤；世爻克本宫的子孙，子孙又落入死、墓、空、绝，太子遭谗言陷害，就像唐玄宗听信李林甫的谗言，把太子瑛、鄂王瑶、光王琚都废为平民，后来又赐死在城东驿。
rule.en: If the Output of the home palace (the crown prince) is clashed, controlled, punished or harmed by the fourth line, he is surely slandered by treacherous ministers; if the Self controls the Output of the home palace and that Output also falls into death, tomb, Void or extinction, the crown prince meets slander and is harmed, like Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, who trusted Li Linfu's slander, demoted Crown Prince Ying, Prince E (Yao) and Prince Guang (Ju) to commoners and later granted them death at the Chengdong post station.

if Fire is thriving and generates the Self or Body, the camp set up will surely rest in a place of advantage.

title: 征战·父母兴持，主帅无宽仁之德；子孙得地，将军有决胜之才（旧注：父母持世动，主帅不恤士卒、上下离心，带兄弟凶神须防自变；子孙持世身旺动，将军必决胜千里外）

rule.yi: 父母爻持世发动，主帅不体恤士兵，上下离心，如果又带着兄弟或凶神，要防备内部自己生变；子孙持世、旺相发动，将军一定能在千里之外决定胜负。
rule.en: If Resource holds the Self and moves, the commander has no kindness for his soldiers and high and low are of different minds, and if it also carries Peer or a baleful spirit one must guard against a change from within; if Output holds the Self and is thriving and moves, the general will surely decide the victory from a thousand li away.

note.yi: 旧注说「带兄弟凶神」，卜筮正宗说「带兄弟官鬼」。
note.en: The old commentary says 'carrying Peer or a baleful spirit'; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong says 'carrying Peer or Pressure'.

zh: 父母兴持，主帅无宽仁之德；
子孙得地，将军有决胜之才。
yi: 父母爻兴旺而持世，主帅没有宽厚仁爱的德行；
子孙得地，将军就有决胜的才能。
en: If Resource is thriving and holds the Self, the commander lacks the virtue of leniency and kindness;
if Output gains its ground, the general has the talent to decide the battle.

title: 征战·水爻克子子孙强，韩信背水阵而陈余被斩（旧注：卦中水爻动、世持水爻、或水爻动克伤子孙，若子孙旺相得日月生扶或子孙旺动，可效韩信背水战，死中求生反胜）

rule.yi: 卦中水爻发动，或者世爻持着水爻，或者水爻发动克伤子孙，只要子孙旺相、得到月建日辰生扶，或者子孙旺相发动，就可以效法韩信背水列阵，在绝境里求生，反而取胜。
rule.en: If a Water line moves in the hexagram, or the Self holds a Water line, or a Water line moves and controls and injures Output, then so long as Output is thriving or strong and is generated and supported by the Month and Day, or Output is thriving and moves, one may follow Han Xin's battle with the river at his back, seeking life in the midst of death, and win instead.

note.yi: 旧注列了水爻动、世持水爻、动出水爻克子孙三种情形，并要子孙旺相或旺动；卜筮正宗压缩成两种，要「子孙亦动」。
note.en: The old commentary lists three cases: a Water line moving, the Self holding Water, and a moving line turning into Water that controls Output, with Output thriving or thriving and moving; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong compresses them into two and requires 'Output also moving'.

en: If Water controls Output and Output is strong, it is like Han Xin drawing up his army with the river at his back and Chen Yu being cut down;

title: 征战·阴象持兄兄克应，李愬雪夜走而元济遭擒（旧注：兄为伏兵，内象旺动克应是我伏兵、克世是他伏兵；兄在阳象宜日间伏、在阴象宜夜间伏，如李愬雪夜衔枚直捣蔡城擒吴元济）

rule.yi: 兄弟是伏兵。兄弟在内卦旺相发动、克应爻，是我方设伏；克世爻，是对方设伏。兄弟在阳象适合白天设伏，在阴象适合夜里设伏，就像唐宪宗时李愬雪夜衔枚疾行，直捣蔡州城，擒住了吴元济。
rule.en: Peer is the ambush. If Peer in the inner trigram is thriving and moves and controls the Other, it is our ambush; if it controls the Self, it is the enemy's. If Peer is in a yang image the ambush is fit for the day and in a yin image for the night, like Li Su in the reign of Emperor Xianzong of Tang, who marched through a snowy night with his men holding sticks in their mouths for silence, struck straight at the city of Cai and captured Wu Yuanji.

note.yi: 旧注把李愬写成「李朔」，卜筮正宗写对了。
note.en: The old commentary writes Li Su as 'Li Shuo', and the Bu Shi Zheng Zong writes it correctly.

zh: 阴象持兄兄克应，李愬雪夜走而元济遭擒。
yi: 兄弟在阴象上、克制应爻，就像李愬雪夜行军而吴元济被擒。
en: If Peer sits in a yin image and controls the Other, it is like Li Su's march on a snowy night and the capture of Yuanji.

title: 征战·世持子而被伤，可效周亚夫坚壁不战（旧注：世持子孙则将有才能可克敌，若父动克则宜固守避其锋、不利速战；如汉景帝时七国反，周亚夫屯细柳，中夜军惊坚卧不起，深沟高垒数日乃定，遂破七国之兵）

rule.yi: 世爻持着子孙，将领有才能，可以克敌；但如果被父母发动来克，就应当固守营垒、避开敌人的锋芒，不利于速战，就像汉景帝时七国造反，周亚夫驻军细柳，半夜军营受惊他也卧着不起，深沟高垒，几天后营里安定下来，终于击破了七国的军队。
rule.en: If the Self holds Output, the general has the ability to defeat the enemy; but if Resource moves to control it, one should hold the fort and avoid the enemy's edge, and a quick battle is not favourable, as when the seven states rebelled under Emperor Jing of Han and Zhou Yafu camped at Xiliu and lay still when the camp was alarmed at midnight, kept his ditches deep and his ramparts high, and after some days the camp settled and in the end he broke the armies of the seven states.

note.yi: 旧注说克它的是「父动克」，卜筮正宗说「被动克」，没有指明是父爻。
note.en: The old commentary says the controller is 'Resource moving to control'; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong says only 'controlled by a moving line' and does not name Resource.

zh: 世持子而被伤，可效周亚夫坚壁不战；
yi: 世爻持着子孙却被克伤，可以效法周亚夫坚守壁垒、不出战；
en: If the Self holds Output but is injured, one may follow Zhou Yafu, who held his ramparts and would not fight;

title: 征战·应临官而遭克，当如司马懿固垒休兵（旧注：应持官鬼旺相则彼将才能、我难与敌，卦有子孙发动终不能大胜；如司马懿自料不如孔明，甘受巾帼之辱，坚垒不战）

title: 征战·卦有众官临旺子，谢玄以八千之兵而破秦（旧注：卦有官鬼、父母虽多而安静休囚，子孙虽少而当权旺动，是寡胜众之象，如晋谢玄刘牢之以八千兵渡江破秦王苻坚九十万众）

rule.yi: 卦里官鬼、父母虽然多，却安静休囚；子孙虽然少，却当令旺相而发动，这是以少胜多的象，就像晋朝的谢玄、刘牢之，以八千兵马渡江，击破秦王苻坚的九十万大军。
rule.en: If the hexagram has many Pressure and Resource lines that are still and resting or trapped, while Output is few but holds the season and is thriving and moving, it is the image of the few overcoming the many, like Xie Xuan and Liu Laozhi of Jin, who crossed the river with eight thousand men and broke the nine hundred thousand of Fu Jian, King of Qin.

note.yi: 人名写法不同：旧注作「刘牢之」「符坚」，卜筮正宗作「刘牢」「苻坚」；译文按通行写法。
note.en: The names are written differently: the old commentary has 'Liu Laozhi' and a variant character for 'Fu', the Bu Shi Zheng Zong has 'Liu Lao' and the usual 'Fu'; the translation follows the common forms.

en: If the hexagram has many Pressure lines while Output is thriving, it is like Xie Xuan who with eight thousand soldiers broke Qin.

title: 征战·两子合世扶身，李郭同心而兴唐室（旧注：子孙为将、世为国君，卦有两子旺动生扶世身，主国有二将合谋胜敌，如唐李光弼、郭子仪同心忠义，终能靖乱复兴唐室）

rule.yi: 子孙是将，世爻是国君。卦里有两个子孙旺相发动，生扶世爻或世身，主国家有两位将领合谋战胜敌人，就像唐朝的李光弼、郭子仪，两人同心，以忠义自勉，终于平定叛乱，复兴了唐朝。
rule.en: Output is the general and the Self is the ruler. If the hexagram has two Output lines that are thriving and moving and generate or support the Self, the state has two generals who plot together to overcome the enemy, like Li Guangbi and Guo Ziyi of Tang, who were of one heart, urged themselves on with loyalty and righteousness, and in the end put down the rebellion and restored the house of Tang.

note.yi: 卜筮正宗把「李光弼」写成「李弼」，少了一个字。
note.en: The Bu Shi Zheng Zong writes 'Li Guangbi' as 'Li Bi', one character short.
