title: 征战·二福刑冲化绝，钟邓互隙而丧身家（旧注：两个子孙生旺变动相冲相刑、两化入死墓绝空，虽胜敌将必争权夺宠互相残害，如晋钟会邓艾平蜀后嫌隙互生，自相屠戮，身家俱丧）

rule.yi: 两个子孙爻生旺发动，互相冲、刑，又都变入死、墓、绝、空，虽然能战胜敌将，但必定争权夺宠、互相残害，就像晋朝的钟会、邓艾带兵平定蜀国，蜀国平定之后彼此生出嫌隙，以致自相残杀，身家都丧。
rule.en: If two Output lines are thriving and moving, clash with and punish each other, and both turn into death, tomb, extinction or Void, then though they may overcome the enemy's generals they will surely struggle for power and favour and harm each other, like Zhong Hui and Deng Ai of Jin, who led troops to subdue Shu and, when Shu was settled, fell into mutual suspicion, until they killed each other and lost both their persons and their families.

note.yi: 书里写「晋钟会、邓艾」；钟会、邓艾平蜀（公元 263 年）时的国家是魏，晋是三年后才建立的，译文照书写作晋朝。旧注还写了两个子孙「相冲相刑」，卜筮正宗没有这一层。
note.en: The books write 'Zhong Hui and Deng Ai of Jin'; when they subdued Shu (263 CE) the state was Wei and Jin was founded three years later, but the translation follows the books and says Jin. The old commentary also has the two Output lines clashing with and punishing each other; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong has no such clause.

zh: 二福刑冲化绝，钟邓互隙而丧身家。
yi: 两个福神相刑相冲又变成绝爻，就像钟会、邓艾互相结下嫌隙而丧了身家。
en: If the two Output lines punish and clash with each other and turn into extinction, it is like Zhong and Deng falling out and losing both their persons and their families.

title: 征战·子化死爻，曹操丧师于赤壁（旧注：子孙为我军卒，动入死墓空绝败，应又克世，或鬼父动伤身世，必致三军丧命、损兵折将；如曹操夸水军八十万众袭吴，为周瑜黄盖火攻所败）

rule.yi: 子孙是我方的士兵。子孙发动变入死、墓、空、绝、败，应爻又来克世爻，或者官鬼、父母发动伤克世身，必定三军丧命、损兵折将，就像曹操夸耀水军八十万，乘势袭击吴国，被周瑜、黄盖的火攻打败。
rule.en: Output is our soldiers. If Output moves into death, tomb, Void, extinction or defeat, and the Other also controls the Self, or Pressure or Resource moves and injures the Self or Body, the three armies will surely lose their lives and the troops and officers be lost, like Cao Cao, who boasted of eight hundred thousand marines, attacked Wu in the same breath, and was beaten by the fire attack of Zhou Yu and Huang Gai.

en: If Output turns into a dead line, it is like Cao Cao losing his army at Red Cliff;

title: 征战·世逢绝地，项羽自刎于乌江（旧注：世为一国之君、三军之帅，宜旺相克应为吉，若被应爻刑冲克害而世又休囚，或动入死墓空绝，主将必不利；如项羽百战百胜而一朝兵散，羞见江东父老自刎乌江）

rule.yi: 世爻是一国之君、三军之帅，最好旺相、克住应爻才吉；如果被应爻刑、冲、克、害，世爻又休囚，或者发动变入死、墓、空、绝，主将必然不利，就像项羽百战百胜，一朝兵败星散，羞于去见江东父老，在乌江自刎。
rule.en: The Self is the ruler of a state and the commander of the three armies; it is best thriving or strong and controlling the Other. If it is punished, clashed with, controlled or harmed by the Other, and the Self is also resting or trapped, or moves into death, tomb, Void or extinction, the chief commander is surely in trouble, like Xiang Yu, who won a hundred battles in a hundred, yet in one morning his troops scattered and, ashamed to face the elders east of the river, he cut his own throat at Wu River.

zh: 世逢绝地，项羽自刎于乌江。
yi: 世爻遇到绝地，就像项羽在乌江自刎。
en: If the Self meets a place of extinction, it is like Xiang Yu cutting his own throat at Wu River.

title: 征战·火官持世，汉高祖遇平城之围（旧注：火爻带鬼则贼寨必近，火鬼持世须防困围；子孙旺动虽被围亦得胜如田单下齐城，子衰官旺必致困围如汉高祖被匈奴围于平城七日乃解）

rule.yi: 火爻带着官鬼，敌人的营寨一定很近；火鬼持世，要防被围困。这时如果子孙旺相发动，即使被围也能得胜，像田单下齐城；如果子孙衰弱、官鬼旺相，必定陷入围困，像汉高祖被匈奴围在平城，七天才解围。
rule.en: If a Fire line carries Pressure, the enemy's stockade is surely near; if a Fire Pressure line holds the Self, guard against being besieged. Then if Output is thriving and moves, one wins even when besieged, like Tian Dan's taking of the cities of Qi; if Output is weak and Pressure is thriving, one is surely besieged, like the founder of Han, whom the Xiongnu surrounded at Pingcheng until the siege was lifted after seven days.

note.yi: 旧注只写「如田单之下齐城」；田单是被燕军围在即墨、反而打败燕军的齐国将领，正合「虽被围得胜」。
note.en: The old commentary writes only 'like Tian Dan's taking of the cities of Qi'; Tian Dan was a Qi general besieged at Jimo by the army of Yan who turned round and beat it, which fits 'wins even when besieged'.

title: 征战·要识用兵之利器，五行卦象并推详；仁智勇器之将，岂越于此（旧注：土为炮石，金为刀箭，水木为舟，火为营寨；乾兑为刀，震巽为弓马，坤为野战；有克应之神宜用此器克敌，应爻官父在此象克世则反防敌用此器）

rule.yi: 要知道用兵该用什么器械，要把五行和卦象一起推究：土是炮石，金是刀箭，水、木是舟船，火是营寨；乾、兑是刀，震、巽是弓马，坤是野战之类。哪个象里有能克应爻的神，就适合用这种器械去克敌；应爻的官鬼或父母在这个象里克世爻，就要反过来防备敌人用这种器械。
rule.en: To know the sharp tools for war, work out the five elements and the hexagram images together: Earth is cannon-stones, Metal is blades and arrows, Water and Wood are boats, Fire is the camp; Qian and Dui are blades, Zhen and Xun are bows and horses, Kun is open-field fighting and the like. Where an image holds a spirit that controls the Other, it is fit to use that tool against the enemy; where the Other's Pressure or Resource in that image controls the Self, one must instead guard against the enemy using that tool.

note.yi: 旧注「震巽为弓马，火枪」，卜筮正宗写成「火为枪」，译文按卜筮正宗读作「火是枪」。
note.en: The old commentary has 'Zhen and Xun are bows and horses, fire lance'; the Bu Shi Zheng Zong writes 'Fire is the lance', and the translation reads it so.

title: 求进职·谋干事看世上有无文书：科举功名求进职皆取官多、旺相必得；凡占赴试、谒贵、面君、参官、到部谋干事，看世上有无文书——父母旺相可许、官爻旺相便吉、忌子孙持世；占赴任子孙持世或独发必不满任；看世上文书者，因专用官为主、用爻为辅

rule.yi: 科举功名，是为了求进职，都以官爻为主，旺相就一定得到。凡是占赴考、谒见贵人、面见君主、参谒官员、到部里谋办事情的，看世爻上有没有文书（父母爻）：父母旺相，可以允许；官爻旺相，就吉；忌子孙持世，不中。占赴任，子孙持世或独发，必定做不满任期。为什么要看世爻上有没有文书？因为这是专以官为主、用爻为辅，所以要父母在世爻上。
rule.en: Examinations and a name in office are for seeking advancement in post, and the Pressure line is taken as the main one in all of them; if it is thriving it is certainly obtained. In divining about going to an examination, calling on a great man, seeing the sovereign, attending an official, or going to a ministry to see to business, look at whether there is the document line, Resource, on the Self: if the Resource line is thriving, it may be granted; if the Pressure line is thriving, it is auspicious; Output holding the Self is feared, and it does not hit the mark. In divining about going to take up a post, if Output holds the Self or moves alone, one will surely not complete the term. Why look at whether there is Resource on the Self? Because this takes the official alone as the master and the Subject line as the aid, and so one wants Resource on the Self.

note.yi: 「求进职」是求升官取职。「赴试、谒贵、面君、参官、到部谋干事」是一串求上进的事：赴试归考试域，其余（谒见贵人、面君、参谒官员、到部门谋办事情）归事业。「文书」是父母爻。「世上」是世爻上。「专用官为主，用爻为辅」是说这类占问官爻是主角，所求的那件事的用爻只是辅助，所以文书（父母）要在世爻上扶持。「赴任」是上任。「不满任」是做不满一个任期。第三段末尾「以文书为主，要文书持世无刑克太岁贴身，必作状元」是专讲考中状元的，另收入考试域，这里不取。这一节同时是考试域的，该域另收。参看易林补遗趋谒贵人（EL.99–102）。
note.en: 'Qiu jin zhi' is seeking promotion and a post. 'Going to an examination, calling on a great man, seeing the sovereign, attending an official, going to a ministry to see to business' is a string of matters of seeking advancement: going to an examination belongs to Examinations, and the rest (calling on a great man, seeing the sovereign, attending an official, going to a department to see to business) belong to Career. 'Wenshu' is the Resource line. 'On the Self' is on the Self line. 'The official alone as the master and the Subject line as the aid' says that in this kind of divination the Pressure line is the principal and the Subject line of the matter sought is only the aid, so Resource must support from the Self. 'Fu ren' is taking up a post, and 'bu man ren' is not completing a term. The sentence at the end of the third section, 'taking Resource as the master, one wants Resource to hold the Self, with no punishment or control and the Tai Sui attached to the body, and one will surely be the top graduate', speaks only of coming first in the examination, is taken under Examinations and not here. This section is also one for Examinations, which takes it separately. See the Yilin Buyi on calling on the great (EL.99-102).

title: 求职请判与在任、谋干事通则：求职请判宜官鬼出现忌动发、在任宜鬼静鬼发有动子动有替；六爻只有一爻动最吉、兄动事不实难成、现有气可速成怕落空；官与文书俱旺相亦要持世方可成、应不克事体分明；乾兑坎宫谋事不一，见官用动其人多出见亦生嗔

rule.yi: 求职、请上司批判，宜官鬼出现，忌发动；已在任的，宜鬼静，鬼发动就有变动，子动就有人来替。如果六爻中只有一爻动，最吉。兄动，事情不实在，难成。如果（用爻）出现而有气，可以很快成，怕落空。易说：动爻急如火。其次，是文书和贵人出现。但如果卦中本来没有、或不入卦、或落空，那件事就难。官和文书都旺相，也要持世才可以成。应又不克世，事情就清楚。乾、兑、坎宫，谋事不专一；见官爻发动，那个人多半外出，见了也生气。
rule.en: In seeking a post or asking a superior for a ruling, it is right for Pressure to appear and wrong for it to move; for one in office, it is right for Pressure to be still, Pressure moving means a change, and Output moving means someone to take his place. If only one of the six lines moves, it is most auspicious. If Peer moves, the matter is not solid and is hard to accomplish. If it appears and has force, it can be accomplished quickly, but fear Void. The Yi says: a moving line is urgent as fire. Next come the document line and the Noble appearing. But if the hexagram originally lacks it, or it does not enter the hexagram, or it is Void, the matter is hard. If Pressure and Resource are both strong, they must also hold the Self before it can be accomplished. If the Other does not control the Self either, the matter stands clear. In the palaces of Qian, Dui and Kan, the scheming is not single-minded; when Pressure is seen moving, the man is mostly out, and if one sees him he flares up in anger.

note.yi: 「请判」是请上司批判、批示。「宜官鬼出现、忌动发」是求职请批时官鬼要出现、不要发动，否则事情生变；「在任宜鬼静」是已在任时官鬼要静，「鬼发有动」是鬼一发动就有变动，「子动有替」是子孙动就有人来接替。后面一组是谋干事的通则：六爻只有一爻动最吉（目标集中），兄动不实，用爻有气可速成（「易云动爻急如火」是引《易》），怕落空；文书、贵人出现是次一等的好；原本没有、不入卦、落空，事难；官和文书都旺相，还要持世才成；应不克世，事情才清楚。最后一句「乾兑坎宫……」是说这几宫谋事不专一，官爻发动则所要见的人多外出、见了也发怒；书里没有再展开。
note.en: 'Qingpan' is asking a superior for a ruling or an instruction. 'It is right for Pressure to appear and wrong for it to move' is that in seeking a post and asking for a ruling Pressure should appear and not move, otherwise the matter changes; 'for one in office, it is right for Pressure to be still' is that for one already in office Pressure should be still; 'Pressure moving means a change' is that as soon as Pressure moves there is a change; 'Output moving means someone to take his place' is Output moving meaning that someone will succeed him. The group after it is a general rule for seeking business: only one line of the six moving is most auspicious (the aim is concentrated), Peer moving is not solid, a Subject line with force can succeed quickly ('the Yi says a moving line is urgent as fire' quotes the Yi) but fears Void; the document line and the Noble appearing are second best; if originally absent, not in the hexagram, or Void, the matter is hard; if Pressure and Resource are both strong, they must also hold the Self to succeed; the Other not controlling the Self, the matter is clear. The last sentence, 'in the palaces of Qian, Dui and Kan ...', says that in these palaces the scheming is not single-minded, and with Pressure moving the man one wants to see is mostly out and angry when seen; the book does not expand on it.

title: 占谒贵（一）：官鬼为主、世我应彼、世应相生得遇和喜；以外卦取——外阳爻可见外阴爻不见、阴鬼阳世再见阳鬼阴世已外出、出现在家忌外卦独发、伏藏应动皆不见

rule.yi: 占谒见贵人，以官鬼为主，世是我、应是他：世应相生，就能遇到和气喜悦。凡占谒贵，以外卦来取：外卦阳爻，见得到；外卦阴爻，见不到。阴的鬼遇阳的世，再来相见；阳的鬼遇阴的世，他已经外出。（用爻）出现，是在家；忌外卦独发。伏藏、应动，都见不到。
rule.en: In divining about calling on a great man, Pressure is the master; the Self is me and the Other is he: if the Self and the Other generate each other, one meets with harmony and pleasure. In all divinations about calling on a great man, take it from the outer trigram: a yang line in the outer trigram means he can be seen, a yin line in the outer trigram means he cannot. With a yin Pressure line and a yang Self, one will see him later; with a yang Pressure line and a yin Self, he has already gone out. If it appears, he is at home; the outer trigram moving alone is feared. If it is hidden, or the Other moves, he is not seen in either case.

note.yi: 「谒贵」是去拜见有地位的人。「以外卦取」是用外卦（对方、外面）来看对方的情形，外卦阳爻是显出、阴爻是隐没。「阴鬼阳世再见，阳鬼阴世已外出」按文意是鬼属阴、世属阳时，他此刻不在、要再来；鬼属阳、世属阴时，他已经出门了。「出现在家」是用爻出现在卦里表示对方在家；「伏藏应动，皆不见」是用爻伏藏、或应爻发动，都见不到。这一节是火珠林里最简的谒贵断法，与易林补遗趋谒贵人（EL.99–102）、易隐谒贵占的见否（YY.74–YY.75）对着看。
note.en: 'Yegui' is going to call on a person of standing. 'Taking it from the outer trigram' is using the outer trigram (the other side, the outside) to see the other side's situation: a yang line in the outer trigram shows, a yin line hides. 'With a yin Pressure line and a yang Self, one will see him later; with a yang Pressure line and a yin Self, he has already gone out', by the sense: when Pressure is yin and the Self yang, he is not in just now and one must come again; when Pressure is yang and the Self yin, he has already gone out. 'If it appears, he is at home' is the Subject line appearing in the hexagram meaning that the other side is at home; 'if hidden, or the Other moves, he is not seen' is the Subject line hidden, or the Other line moving, in either case one does not see him. This section is the simplest method of calling on a great man in the Huozhulin; read against the Yilin Buyi on calling on the great (EL.99-102) and the Yi Yin on calling on the great, whether one is seen (YY.74-75).

If it is hidden, or the Other moves, he is not seen in either case.

title: 占谒贵（二）：看财爻旺相出现忌动、用官则看官爻忌世应坐鬼，又须问见何人以用爻为主；谒见用支出现旺相不动在家、空冲散不在

rule.yi: （为求财去谒见）看财爻旺相、出现，忌讳它动；（要见的是官员，用官）就看官爻，忌世、应坐鬼；又必须问清要见的是什么人，以那个人的用爻为主。谒见的时候，用爻的地支出现、旺相、不动，他在家；如果空、冲、散，他不在。
rule.en: (For one who calls to seek money) look at the Wealth line thriving and showing, and fear it moving; (if the one to be seen is an official, so that Pressure is used) look at the Pressure line, and fear the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure; and one must also ask whom one is to see, and the Subject line of that man is the master. In calling on him, if the branch of the Subject line appears, is thriving and does not move, he is at home; if it is Void, clashed or scattered, he is not in.

note.yi: 「看财爻旺相出现，忌动用官」这一句书里没有写明主语，按文意：去谒见是为求财（或有求于对方）时，看财爻旺相、出现、不动；若所求的是官员（用官），就改看官爻，忌世、应坐在鬼上（世或应带官鬼，表示被官鬼压着）。「又须问见何人，看用爻为主」是还要问清要见的是谁（父亲、兄弟、官员……），取那个人对应的爻为用爻。「用支出现旺相不动，在家」是用爻的地支在卦里出现、旺相、不动，对方在家；「空、冲、散，不在」是用爻空、被冲、散，对方不在。这一句的括号里的解释是按文意补的，书里原文没有写「为求财」。
note.en: The sentence 'look at the Wealth line thriving and showing, and fear it moving; ... Pressure' has no subject written out in the book, and by the sense: when one calls to seek money (or to ask something of the other), look at the Wealth line thriving, showing and not moving; if what is sought is an official (so that Pressure is used), look instead at the Pressure line, and fear the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure (the Self or Other carrying Pressure, showing one is pressed by Pressure). 'One must also ask whom one is to see, and the Subject line is the master' is that one must also be clear whom one is to see (father, brother, official ...), and take the line corresponding to that man as the Subject line. 'The branch of the Subject appears, thriving and not moving: at home' is the Subject line's branch appearing in the hexagram, thriving and not moving, so the other side is at home; 'Void, clashed, scattered: not in' is the Subject line Void, clashed or scattered, so the other side is not in. The explanation in brackets is supplied by the sense, and the original does not write 'to seek money'.

zh: 看财爻旺相出现，忌动用官，看官爻，忌世应坐鬼，又须问见何人，看用爻为主。
谒见，用支出现旺相不动，在家；
yi: （为求财去谒见）看财爻旺相、出现，忌讳它动；（要见的是官员）就看官爻，忌世、应坐鬼；又必须问清要见的是什么人，以那个人的用爻为主。
谒见的时候，用爻的地支出现、旺相、不动，他在家；
如果空、冲、散，他不在。
en: (For one who calls to seek money) look at the Wealth line thriving and showing, and fear it moving; (if the one to be seen is an official) look at the Pressure line, and fear the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure; and one must also ask whom one is to see, and the Subject line of that man is the master.
In calling on him, if the branch of the Subject line appears, is thriving and does not move, he is at home;
if it is Void, clashed or scattered, he is not in.

title: 占谒贵（三）：世应相生合则吉相克必凶；世克应或克用爻皆致怨之象当俯仰小心；应克世或用爻克世皆愿见亦忧刑、应用相克不及相生；卦有身相见更看用爻、用爻生身尤好；卦无身又无用爻或用爻空亡终不见

rule.yi: 世应相生、相合就吉，相克必然凶。世克应，或克用爻，都是招致怨恨之象，应当处处小心。应克世，或用爻克世，（他）都愿意见，但也担忧（受）刑责。应和用爻相克，不如相生。卦有身，见面时更要看用爻，用爻生身尤其好；卦无身，又无用爻，或者用爻空亡，终究见不到。
rule.en: If the Self and the Other generate or combine with each other it is auspicious, and if they control each other it is surely ominous. The Self controlling the Other, or controlling the Subject line, are all signs of drawing resentment, and one should be careful in every move. The Other controlling the Self, or the Subject line controlling the Self, he is willing to see one, but there is also the worry of punishment. The Other and the Subject line controlling each other is not as good as generating each other. If the hexagram has a Body, in the meeting one looks further at the Subject line, and the Subject line generating the Body is especially good; if the hexagram has no Body and no Subject line, or the Subject line is Void, one is never seen.

note.yi: 「致怨」是招来怨恨，「俯仰小心」是一举一动都小心。「应克世」「用爻克世」是对方克我：对方愿意见，但因为克我，仍担心受到责罚（「忧刑」）。「应用相克不及相生」是对方的应爻和他的用爻之间，相生比相克好。「卦有身」是卦里有卦身（见术语表），相见时还要看用爻，用爻生卦身尤其好；「卦无身又无用爻」是卦身和用爻都没有，或用爻空亡，就终究见不到。这一节与易林补遗趋谒贵人的世应内外（EL.100）、世空应空（EL.101）对着看。
note.en: 'Zhiyuan' is drawing resentment, and 'fuyang xiaoxin' is being careful in every movement. 'The Other controlling the Self' and 'the Subject line controlling the Self' are the other side controlling me: the other side is willing to see me, but because he controls me there is still the worry of reproof ('worry of punishment'). 'The Other and the Subject line controlling each other is not as good as generating each other' is that between the Other line and his Subject line, generation is better than control. 'The hexagram has a Body' is the hexagram having a hexagram Body (see the glossary), in the meeting one looks further at the Subject line, and the Subject line generating the hexagram Body is especially good; 'the hexagram has no Body and no Subject line' is neither the Body nor the Subject line being present, or the Subject line being Void, and one is never seen. Read this section against the Self and the Other, inner and outer, in the Yilin Buyi on calling on the great (EL.100) and against the Self Void and the Other Void (EL.101).

zh: 世应相生合则吉，相克必凶。
世克应，或克用爻、皆致怨之象。
应克世、或用爻克世，皆愿见，亦忧刑。
卦有身，相见更看用爻，用爻生身尤好；
卦无身又无用爻，或用爻空亡，终不见。
yi: 世应相生、相合就吉，相克必然凶。
世克应，或者克用爻，都是招致怨恨之象。
应当处处小心。
应克世，或者用爻克世，他都愿意见，但也担忧受刑责。
应和用爻相克，不如相生。
卦有身，见面时更要看用爻，用爻生身尤其好；
卦无身，又无用爻，或者用爻空亡，终究见不到。
en: If the Self and the Other generate or combine with each other it is auspicious, and if they control each other it is surely ominous.
The Self controlling the Other, or controlling the Subject line, are all signs of drawing resentment.
One should be careful in every move.
The Other controlling the Self, or the Subject line controlling the Self, he is willing to see one, but there is also the worry of punishment.
The Other and the Subject line controlling each other is not as good as generating each other.
If the hexagram has a Body, in the meeting one looks further at the Subject line, and the Subject line generating the Body is especially good;
if the hexagram has no Body and no Subject line, or the Subject line is Void, one is never seen.

title: 占朝国（一）：世应相得则君臣用心、六位无克则万国咸宁；世为帝王、应为功臣、本宫为都；内外比和旺相则天生圣主；金兵戈忌动、土城垒宜安、水泛滥、火炎晴、木风恶、吉神为瑞；震离坎兑四方、艮坤中土

rule.yi: 占朝廷、国家，世应相得，君臣就同心用力；六位没有相克，万国都安宁。世是帝王，应是功臣，本宫是都城。内外卦比和、旺相，是天生圣明的君主，刚柔动静有常规，大地出奇才；最宜吉神，切忌大煞。金是兵戈，忌动；土是城垒，宜安；水是泛滥，火是炎热晴天，木爻是恶风；吉神是祥瑞。震、离、坎、兑是四方，艮、坤两卦是中土。
rule.en: In divining about the court and the state, if the Self and the Other are in accord, ruler and ministers are of one mind; if none of the six places controls another, all the states are at peace. The Self is the sovereign, the Other is the meritorious minister, and the home palace is the capital. If the inner and outer trigrams are in accord and strong, Heaven has produced a sage ruler, firmness and softness, movement and stillness keep their constancy, and the earth brings forth rare talents; auspicious spirits are most suitable, and great baleful stars are strictly to be avoided. Metal is arms and the spear, and it must not move; Earth is the city wall and rampart, and it should be at peace; Water is flooding, Fire is blazing heat, the Wood line is wicked wind; auspicious spirits are good omens. Zhen, Li, Kan and Dui are the four quarters, and the two trigrams Gen and Kun are the central earth.

note.yi: 「朝国」是朝廷和国家。「世为帝王，应为功臣，本宫为都」是把卦里的位置配成国家的位置：世是君、应是臣、本宫是京都。「六位无克」是六爻之间没有互相克。「内外比和旺相」是内外卦五行和睦、都旺相。「吉神」「大杀」是神煞。「金为兵戈……木爻风恶」是各行主的国家大事：金主兵、土主城、水主水灾、火主旱热、木主风。「震离坎兑为四方」是震东、离南、坎北、兑西，「艮坤二卦为中土」是艮（东北）、坤（西南）居中。这一节与本书国事（YM.01 起）、易林补遗朝廷国事（EL.01 起）、易隐朝廷占（YY.31–YY.37）取同一类：世应、五爻、各爻位对应君臣百姓，金木水火土对应兵、工、水、旱。
note.en: 'Chaoguo' is the court and the state. 'The Self is the sovereign, the Other is the meritorious minister, the home palace is the capital' matches the positions in the hexagram to the positions of a state: the Self is the ruler, the Other the minister, and the home palace the capital. 'None of the six places controls another' is no line among the six controlling another. 'Inner and outer in accord and strong' is the phases of the inner and outer trigrams being at peace and both strong. 'Auspicious spirits' and 'great baleful stars' are spirit-stars. 'Metal is arms ... the Wood line is wicked wind' lists the great affairs of state each phase governs: Metal governs the military, Earth city walls, Water floods, Fire heat and drought, Wood wind. 'Zhen, Li, Kan and Dui are the four quarters' is Zhen east, Li south, Kan north, Dui west, and 'Gen and Kun are the central earth' is Gen (north-east) and Kun (south-west) taken as the middle. This section is of a kind with the affairs of state in this book (from YM.01), the Yilin Buyi on the affairs of the court (from EL.01) and the Yi Yin on the court: the Self and the Other, the fifth line and each line position correspond to ruler, ministers and people, and the five phases correspond to the military, public works, floods and drought.

zh: 世为帝王，应为功臣，本宫为都。
内外比和、旺相，天生圣主，刚柔动静有常，地出奇材，最宜吉神，切忌大杀。
金为兵戈忌动，土为城垒宜安，水为泛滥，火为炎晴，木爻风恶，吉神为瑞。
震离坎兑为四方，艮坤二卦为中土。
yi: 占朝廷、国家，世应相得，君臣就同心用力；
六位没有相克，万国都安宁。
世是帝王，应是功臣，本宫是都城。
内外卦比和、旺相，是天生圣明的君主，刚柔动静有常规，大地出奇才；最宜吉神，切忌大煞。
金是兵戈，忌动；土是城垒，宜安；水是泛滥，火是炎热晴天，木爻是恶风；吉神是祥瑞。
震、离、坎、兑是四方，艮、坤两卦是中土。
en: In divining about the court and the state, if the Self and the Other are in accord, ruler and ministers are of one mind;
if none of the six places controls another, all the states are at peace.
The Self is the sovereign, the Other is the meritorious minister, and the home palace is the capital.

If the inner and outer trigrams are in accord and strong, Heaven has produced a sage ruler, firmness and softness, movement and stillness keep their constancy, and the earth brings forth rare talents; auspicious spirits are most suitable, and great baleful stars are strictly to be avoided.

Metal is arms and the spear, and it must not move; Earth is the city wall and rampart, and it should be at peace; Water is flooding, Fire is blazing heat, the Wood line is wicked wind; auspicious spirits are good omens.
Zhen, Li, Kan and Dui are the four quarters, and the two trigrams Gen and Kun are the central earth.

title: 占朝国（二）：五爻为至尊——加吉神太岁仁慈之主、带杀白虎暴虐之君、与吉神生合必亲贤任能远佞去奸；初爻安静吉神持世生世万民悦服；二爻为侍臣、四爻会吉神克世生世必上忠君下安黎庶

rule.yi: 五爻是至尊，加上吉神、太岁，是仁慈的君主；带煞、白虎，是暴虐的君主；（五爻）与吉神生合，必定亲近贤人、任用能人，远离佞臣、去除奸邪。初爻安静，吉神持世或生世，万民心悦诚服。本象的二爻是侍臣，带吉神，左右必定得到贤人；加凶煞的，多是奸邪谄佞。四爻会合吉神，克世或生世，必定向上忠于君主，向下安定百姓。
rule.en: The fifth line is the supreme one; with an auspicious spirit and the Tai Sui added, he is a benevolent ruler; carrying a baleful star and the White Tiger, he is a tyrannical ruler; if it generates and combines with an auspicious spirit, he will surely draw near the worthy and employ the able, keep far from flatterers and dismiss the treacherous. If the first line is still and an auspicious spirit holds or generates the Self, the people are all pleased and submit. In the image, the second line is the attending minister; with an auspicious spirit, he will surely have worthy men about him; with a baleful star added, they are mostly treacherous and flattering. If the fourth line meets an auspicious spirit and controls or generates the Self, he will be loyal to the sovereign above and bring peace to the common people below.

note.yi: 「至尊」是君主。五爻在卦里是君位，「加吉神太岁」是五爻带吉神、又带当年太岁，为仁慈之君；「带杀白虎」是带凶煞和白虎，为暴虐之君。「亲贤任能，远佞去奸」是亲近贤人、任用能人，疏远奸佞。「万民悦服」是百姓心悦诚服。「侍臣」是君主身边的臣子，本书（YM.01、YM.50）里也以二爻为大臣、近臣。「吉神」「凶杀」是神煞。四爻是近君之位，会吉神又克世或生世，上忠下安。这一节是把爻位配成君臣百姓的细则，可与易冒功名章按六爻辨官位的高卑（YM.50）对着看：五爻是君、二爻是大臣、四爻近君之臣。
note.en: 'Zhizun' is the sovereign. The fifth line is the sovereign's place in a hexagram; 'with an auspicious spirit and the Tai Sui added' is the fifth line carrying an auspicious spirit and also the Tai Sui of the year, a benevolent ruler; 'carrying a baleful star and the White Tiger' is carrying a baleful star and the White Tiger, a tyrannical ruler. 'Qin xian ren neng, yuan ning qu jian' is drawing near the worthy and employing the able, keeping away from the flatterers and the treacherous. 'Wan min yue fu' is the people submitting gladly. 'Shichen' is the ministers beside the sovereign, and in this book (YM.01, YM.50) the second line is likewise the great minister or near minister. 'Auspicious spirits' and 'baleful stars' are spirit-stars. The fourth line is the place near the sovereign, and meeting an auspicious spirit while controlling or generating the Self is loyalty above and peace below. This section is the detailed rule that matches the line positions to ruler, ministers and people, and can be read against the way the chapter on fame and office in the Yimao tells the height of a post by the six lines (YM.50): the fifth line is the sovereign, the second a great minister, and the fourth a minister near the sovereign.

zh: 五爻为至尊，加吉神太岁，仁慈之主也。
与吉神生合，必亲贤任能，远佞去奸。
初爻安静，吉神持世或生世，万民悦服。
本象二爻为侍臣，带吉神左右必得贤人，加凶杀者，多奸邪便佞。
四爻会吉神克世生世，必上忠君，下安黎庶。
yi: 五爻是至尊，加上吉神、太岁，是仁慈的君主。
带煞、白虎，是暴虐的君主。
（五爻）与吉神生合，必定亲近贤人、任用能人，远离佞臣、去除奸邪。
初爻安静，吉神持世或生世，万民心悦诚服。
本象的二爻是侍臣，带吉神，左右必定得到贤人；加凶煞的，多是奸邪谄佞。
四爻会合吉神，克世或生世，必定向上忠于君主，向下安定百姓。
en: The fifth line is the supreme one; with an auspicious spirit and the Tai Sui added, he is a benevolent ruler.
Carrying a baleful star and the White Tiger, he is a tyrannical ruler.
If it generates and combines with an auspicious spirit, he will surely draw near the worthy and employ the able, keep far from flatterers and dismiss the treacherous.
If the first line is still and an auspicious spirit holds or generates the Self, the people are all pleased and submit.
In the image, the second line is the attending minister; with an auspicious spirit, he will surely have worthy men about him; with a baleful star added, they are mostly treacherous and flattering.
If the fourth line meets an auspicious spirit and controls or generates the Self, he will be loyal to the sovereign above and bring peace to the common people below.

title: 占朝国（三）：子孙为储君郡主、宜旺相不空，大杀动刑冲克则有废立之患；子孙在初爻动克三爻或世者士庶上书直言、二爻动才德舌辨之臣入上封事、三爻动贤能诸侯诣门直谏、四爻动近臣尽忠死诤

rule.yi: 子孙是储君、郡主，宜旺相不空；如果大煞发动、刑冲克它，恐怕有废立的祸患。子孙在初爻动，克三爻或克世的，有士人百姓上书直言利害；在二爻动，必有有才有德、口才好的臣子进呈密封奏事；在三爻动，有贤能的诸侯到门前直言劝谏；在四爻动（「艾」疑是「爻」之误），身边近臣必定尽忠、冒死直谏。
rule.en: Output is the crown prince and the princesses; it should be strong and not Void; if a great baleful star moves to punish, clash or control it, I fear there is the trouble of deposition and installation. If Output on the first line moves to control the third line or the Self, scholars and commoners submit memorials speaking directly on benefit and harm; moving on the second line, there will be ministers of talent and virtue and a ready tongue who present sealed memorials; moving on the third line, a worthy and able lord comes to the gate to remonstrate frankly; moving on the fourth line (the 'ai' is presumably a slip for 'yao', line), the courtiers at his side will surely be wholly loyal and remonstrate at the risk of death.

note.yi: 「储君」是太子，「郡主」是亲王之女。子孙在这里是君主的后嗣一类，所以宜旺相、不空，怕大煞发动来刑冲克它，有『废立』（废太子、另立）之患。「士庶民」是读书人和百姓，「上书直言利害」是上书说出国事的利弊，「上封事」是进呈密封的奏章，「诸侯」是分封各地的诸侯，「直谏」是直言劝谏，「尽忠死诤」是尽忠并不惜死地劝谏。原文「贤能诸侯谓门直谏」的「谓门」疑是「诣门」（到门前）之误，「在四艾动」的「艾」是「爻」之误，这里按文意译。这一节讲的是子孙在各个爻位发动，各会引出哪一类人向君主进言。
note.en: 'Chujun' is the crown prince, and 'junzhu' is a prince's daughter. Output here is the sovereign's heir and the like, so it should be strong and not Void, and a great baleful star moving to punish, clash or control it brings the trouble of 'deposition and installation' (deposing the crown prince and setting up another). 'Shi shu min' are scholars and commoners; 'shangshu zhiyan lihai' is submitting a memorial that states plainly the benefits and harms of state affairs; 'shang fengshi' is presenting a sealed memorial; 'zhuhou' are the lords enfeoffed in the regions; 'zhijian' is frank remonstrance; and 'jin zhong si zheng' is being wholly loyal and remonstrating at the risk of death. The 'wei men' of 'xian neng zhuhou wei men zhijian' is presumably a slip for 'yi men' (go to the gate), and the 'ai' of 'zai si ai dong' is a slip for 'yao' (line); both are translated by the sense. This section says which kind of person will speak to the sovereign when Output moves on each line position.

zh: 子孙为储君郡主，宜旺相不空，若大杀动刑冲克，恐有废立之患。
子孙在初爻动克三爻或世者，士庶民有上书直言利害；
在二爻动，必有才德舌辨之臣入上封事；
在三爻动，有贤能诸侯谓门直谏；
在四艾动，左右近臣必尽忠死诤也。
yi: 子孙是储君、郡主，宜旺相不空；如果大煞发动、刑冲克它，恐怕有废立的祸患。
子孙在初爻动，克三爻或克世的，有士人百姓上书直言利害；
在二爻动，必有有才有德、口才好的臣子进呈密封奏事；
在三爻动，有贤能的诸侯到门前直言劝谏；
在四爻动，身边近臣必定尽忠、冒死直谏。
en: Output is the crown prince and the princesses; it should be strong and not Void; if a great baleful star moves to punish, clash or control it, I fear there is the trouble of deposition and installation.
If Output on the first line moves to control the third line or the Self, scholars and commoners submit memorials speaking directly on benefit and harm;
moving on the second line, there will be ministers of talent and virtue and a ready tongue who present sealed memorials;
moving on the third line, a worthy and able lord comes to the gate to remonstrate frankly;
moving on the fourth line, the courtiers at his side will surely be wholly loyal and remonstrate at the risk of death.

title: 占征战（一）：出兵交战鬼贼财粮、鬼旺彼胜子旺我强；以鬼为彼贼、以子为我军，子孙旺相必获全胜、出现宜先伏藏宜后；鬼父旺相或独发或持世身大败；六爻安静世旺克应必胜

rule.yi: 出兵交战，鬼是敌人（贼），财是粮草；鬼旺，敌人胜；子旺，我方强。以鬼为对方的贼寇，以子为我军；子孙旺相，必定获得全胜；（子孙）出现，宜先出战，伏藏，宜后出战；卦内凡是鬼、父旺相，或者独发，或者持世、持身，是大败之兆。如果六爻安静，世旺、克应，必胜。
rule.en: In sending out troops to give battle, Pressure is the enemy and Wealth is the provisions; when Pressure is thriving the enemy wins, and when Output is thriving I am strong. Take Pressure as the bandits on the other side and Output as my army; with Output thriving, one is sure to win entirely; if it appears it is right to go first, and if it is hidden it is right to go after; within the hexagram, if Pressure and Resource are thriving, or move alone, or hold the Self or the Body, it is a sign of great defeat. If the six lines are still, and the Self is thriving and controls the Other, one will surely win.

note.yi: 「鬼贼财粮」是鬼为贼（敌人），财为粮。「彼」是对方，「我」是自己这一边。「出现宜先，伏藏宜后」是子孙在卦里出现的宜先出战，伏藏的宜后出战。「内凡鬼父旺相或是独发，或持世身，大败之兆」是官鬼、父母旺相，或官鬼独发，或持世、持身，都是大败之兆。这一节是征战占的总纲：胜负看官鬼和子孙的旺衰，以及世应的强弱。与易隐征战占的彼己（YY.54–56）、易林补遗出师征伐（EL.12 起）、本书军机（YM.11 起）对着看：都是『世我应彼、子兵鬼寇』这一套。
note.en: 'Gui zei cai liang' is Pressure as the bandits (the enemy) and Wealth as the grain. 'Bi' is the other side, and 'wo' is oneself, my side. 'If it appears it is right to go first, if hidden after' is that Output appearing in the hexagram means going first to battle, and hidden means going after. 'Nei fan gui fu wangxiang huo shi du fa, huo chi shi shen, da bai zhi zhao' is Pressure and Resource thriving, or Pressure moving alone, or holding the Self or the Body, in each case a sign of great defeat. This section is the general rule for divining war: victory and defeat are seen by the strength and weakness of Pressure and Output, and by the strength of the Self and the Other. Read against the 'we and they' of the Yi Yin on war (YY.54-56), the Yilin Buyi on sending out troops (from EL.12) and the military chapter of this book (from YM.11): all use the same set of 'the Self is me, the Other is they; Output is the troops, Pressure the bandits'.

zh: 以鬼为彼贼，以子为我军，子孙旺相，必获全胜，出现宜先，伏藏宜后，内凡鬼父旺相或是独发，或持世身，大败之兆。
若六爻安静世旺克应，必胜。
yi: 出兵交战，鬼是敌人，财是粮草；
鬼旺，敌人胜；子旺，我方强。
以鬼为对方的贼寇，以子为我军；子孙旺相，必定获得全胜；（子孙）出现，宜先出战，伏藏，宜后出战；卦内凡是鬼、父旺相，或者独发，或者持世、持身，是大败之兆。
如果六爻安静，世旺、克应，必胜。
en: In sending out troops to give battle, Pressure is the enemy and Wealth is the provisions;
when Pressure is thriving the enemy wins, and when Output is thriving I am strong.

Take Pressure as the bandits on the other side and Output as my army; with Output thriving, one is sure to win entirely; if it appears it is right to go first, and if it is hidden it is right to go after; within the hexagram, if Pressure and Resource are thriving, or move alone, or hold the Self or the Body, it is a sign of great defeat.
If the six lines are still, and the Self is thriving and controls the Other, one will surely win.

title: 占征战（二）：父母为城池壕寨雄旗、子孙为兵将军马、兄弟为辕门惊恐伏兵、官鬼为敌兵刀剑；世应空亡主和、世空我军弱、应空征兵退、世爻被鬼冲克我军不利、兄弟独发凶；鬼去爻中而兄弟化出官鬼合世爻身主有奸人在军中、世下伏鬼亦然

rule.yi: 父母是城池、壕沟营寨、大旗；子孙是兵、将、军、马；兄弟是辕门、惊恐、伏兵；官鬼是敌兵和刀剑。世应空亡，主议和；世空，我军弱；应空，来攻的兵退；世爻被官鬼冲克，我军不利；兄弟独自发动，是凶。鬼不在爻中，兄弟化出官鬼来合世爻或身，主有奸细在军中；世下伏着鬼，也是这样。
rule.en: Resource is the city, the moat and stockade, and the great banner; Output is the soldiers, generals, army and horses; Peer is the camp gate, alarms and ambush troops; Pressure is the enemy soldiers and their swords. If the Self and the Other are both Void, it means peace; the Self Void, my army is weak; the Other Void, the troops marching against me withdraw; the Self line clashed or controlled by Pressure, my army is at a disadvantage; Peer moving alone is ominous. If Pressure is absent from the lines, and Peer changes into Pressure that combines with the Self line or the Body, it means a traitor in the army; with Pressure hidden under the Self it is the same.

note.yi: 「壕寨」是壕沟和营寨，「雄旗」是大旗，「辕门」是军营的大门（军门），「惊恐」是惊慌恐惧，「伏兵」是设伏的兵。六亲配军中的人与物：父母是城池营寨旗号，子孙是兵将，兄弟是军门、惊慌和伏兵，官鬼是敌兵刀剑。「世应空亡，主和」是世应都空，战事议和；「世空我军弱，应空征兵退」是世空我弱，应空则来攻的兵退。「鬼去爻中」按文意是官鬼不在卦里（「去」是不在）；「合世爻身」是合世爻或身；兄弟变出官鬼来合我，等于有奸细（内奸）混在军中。「世下伏鬼亦然」是官鬼伏在世爻下面，也是同样。这一节与易隐征战占的六亲（YY.57–59）、本书军机的六亲分工（YM.26）对着看，三书取象大体相近。
note.en: 'Haozhai' is the moat and the stockade, 'xiongqi' is the great banner, 'yuanmen' is the great gate of a camp (the army gate), 'jingkong' is alarm and fright, and 'fubing' is troops set in ambush. The six relations are matched to the people and things of an army: Resource is the city, stockade and banners, Output is the soldiers and generals, Peer is the army gate, alarms and ambush troops, and Pressure is the enemy soldiers and their swords. 'The Self and the Other Void, it means peace' is both the Self and the Other Void, and the war moves to peace talks; 'the Self Void, my army is weak; the Other Void, the troops marching against me withdraw' is the Self Void and my side weak, and the Other Void and the troops that come to attack withdraw. 'Gui qu yao zhong' is by the sense Pressure absent from the hexagram ('qu' is not there); 'combines with the Self line or the Body'; Peer changing into Pressure that combines with me is the same as a traitor (an inside agent) mixed into the army. 'With Pressure hidden under the Self it is the same' is Pressure hidden under the Self line, likewise. Read this section against the six relations in the Yi Yin on war (YY.57-59) and the division of the six relations in the military chapter of this book (YM.26); the three books take much the same images.

zh: 世爻被鬼冲克，我军不利；
鬼去爻中，兄弟化出官鬼来合世爻身，主有奸人在军中，世下伏鬼亦然。
yi: 父母是城池、壕沟营寨、大旗；
子孙是兵、将、军、马；
兄弟是辕门、惊恐、伏兵；
官鬼是敌兵和刀剑。
世应空亡，主议和；
世空，我军弱；
应空，来攻的兵退；
世爻被官鬼冲克，我军不利；
兄弟独自发动，是凶。
鬼不在爻中，兄弟化出官鬼来合世爻或身，主有奸细在军中；世下伏着鬼，也是这样。
en: Resource is the city, the moat and stockade, and the great banner;
Output is the soldiers, generals, army and horses;
Peer is the camp gate, alarms and ambush troops;
Pressure is the enemy soldiers and their swords.
If the Self and the Other are both Void, it means peace;
the Self Void, my army is weak;
the Other Void, the troops marching against me withdraw;
the Self line clashed or controlled by Pressure, my army is at a disadvantage;
Peer moving alone is ominous.
If Pressure is absent from the lines, and Peer changes into Pressure that combines with the Self line or the Body, it means a traitor in the army; with Pressure hidden under the Self it is the same.

title: 占征战（三）：变爻冲克子孙损名将、冲克财爻或财持世落空粮受困、刑克父母战船城寨有失指挥号令不宜、冲克官爻彼贼必败；动火刑克父母火烧宫室、火冲克财火焚粮草；财有仓库近子近我军近父近壕堑近鬼近贼所；父母塞位方

rule.yi: 凡是变爻冲克子孙，主损伤名将。冲克财爻，以及财持世又落空，主粮食受困。刑克父母，主战船、城寨有损失，指挥号令大为不宜。冲克官爻，对方的贼寇必败。凡是卦中动火（火爻发动）刑父母、克父母，必然火烧宫室；火冲克财，主火烧粮草。又，财有仓库（财的所在）：靠近子的，就近我军；靠近父的，就近壕堑；靠近鬼的，就近敌人所在。又，父母堵塞的方位，比如在坤宫就是西南方。
rule.en: Whenever a changed line clashes with or controls Output, it means a famous general is lost. Clashing with or controlling the Wealth line, or Wealth holding the Self and falling Void, means the provisions are in trouble. Punishing or controlling Resource means loss of warships, city and stockade, and command and orders are greatly unsuitable. Clashing with or controlling the Pressure line, the enemy bandits are sure to lose. Whenever in the hexagram a moving Fire line punishes or controls Resource, there will surely be fire burning the halls; Fire clashing with or controlling Wealth means fire burns the provisions. Also, Wealth has storehouses: near Output, they are near my army; near Resource, near the trenches; near Pressure, near the enemy's place. Also, the direction in which Resource stands as the barrier, as in the palace of Kun it is the south-west.

note.yi: 「变爻冲克子孙」是变出来的爻冲克子孙，损名将；「冲克财爻」「财持世落空」是粮草受困；「刑克父母」是战船城寨有失；「冲克官爻」是敌人必败。「动火刑父母、克父母」是火爻发动去刑克父母，烧宫室；「火冲克财」是烧粮草。「财有仓库」是财爻（粮草）所在的方位也有仓库，按它靠近哪一类爻来定在谁那边：近子在我军、近父在壕堑、近鬼在敌处。「父母塞位方，如坤宫西南方也」按文意是父母（城池）所堵塞的位置，取它所在的宫的方位，如在坤宫就是西南。这一节是征战占里的具体征兆，与易隐征战占的各条（YY.57–YY.70）对着看。
note.en: 'A changed line clashes with or controls Output' is the line that is changed out clashing with or controlling Output, losing a famous general; 'clashing with or controlling the Wealth line' and 'Wealth holding the Self and falling Void' are the provisions in trouble; 'punishing or controlling Resource' is loss of warships, city and stockade; 'clashing with or controlling the Pressure line' is the enemy being sure to lose. 'A moving Fire line punishes or controls Resource' is a Fire line moving to punish or control Resource and burn the halls; 'Fire clashing with or controlling Wealth' is burning the provisions. 'Wealth has storehouses' is that the direction where the Wealth line (the provisions) stands also has storehouses, and which side they are on is fixed by which kind of line it is near: near Output they are at my army, near Resource at the trenches, near Pressure at the enemy's place. 'Fu mu sai wei fang, ru Kun gong xi nan fang ye', by the sense, is the position where Resource (the city) blocks, taking the direction of the palace it stands in, as Kun is south-west. This section gives the concrete omens in divining war; read against each entry in the Yi Yin on war (YY.57-YY.70).

zh: 凡变爻冲克子孙，主损名将。
冲克财爻，并财持世落空，主粮受困。
刑克父母，主战船城寨有失，指挥号令大不宜。
凡卦中动火刑父母、克父母，必然火烧宫室，火冲克财，主火焚粮草。
又，财有仓库，如近子近我军，近父近壕堑，近鬼近贼所。
又父母塞位方，如坤宫西南方也。
yi: 凡是变爻冲克子孙，主损伤名将。
冲克财爻，以及财持世又落空，主粮食受困。
刑克父母，主战船、城寨有损失，指挥号令大为不宜。
冲克官爻，对方的贼寇必败。
凡是卦中动火（火爻发动）刑父母、克父母，必然火烧宫室；火冲克财，主火烧粮草。
又，财有仓库：靠近子的，就近我军；靠近父的，就近壕堑；靠近鬼的，就近敌人所在。
又，父母堵塞的方位，比如在坤宫就是西南方。
en: Whenever a changed line clashes with or controls Output, it means a famous general is lost.
Clashing with or controlling the Wealth line, or Wealth holding the Self and falling Void, means the provisions are in trouble.
Punishing or controlling Resource means loss of warships, city and stockade, and command and orders are greatly unsuitable.
Clashing with or controlling the Pressure line, the enemy bandits are sure to lose.
Whenever in the hexagram a moving Fire line punishes or controls Resource, there will surely be fire burning the halls; Fire clashing with or controlling Wealth means fire burns the provisions.
Also, Wealth has storehouses: near Output, they are near my army; near Resource, near the trenches; near Pressure, near the enemy's place.
Also, the direction in which Resource stands as the barrier, as in the palace of Kun it is the south-west.

title: 有子万事足、无官一身轻；谋望利名先要鬼爻旺相，斟量宣敕但观父母兴衰：官鬼是用爻宜旺不宜衰，宣敕看父母最宜旺相扶世不加凶杀

rule.yi: 求官，官鬼爻是用爻，宜旺不宜衰，喜欢日辰扶持拱卫，怕刑、害、克、冲；宣敕（任命的诏书）看父母爻，卦中不可没有，最好旺相、扶助世爻、不加凶杀；若被刑冲，根基不正；加临大耗，要多花钱财。太岁、月建旺的，多半是「宣」；贵人、禄、马同在一处的，不过是「敕」；虽有吉神却散漫不当权的，无非是吏员的文书。冲世凶，生世吉；只要不落空亡，再辛苦费力，终归能成。
rule.en: In seeking office the Pressure line is the Subject line and should be strong, not weak; it likes the Day to support and gather round it and fears punishment, harm, control and clash. The proclamation and decree are read from Resource, which cannot be missing from the hexagram and is best strong, supporting the Self and with no baleful spirit added; if it is punished or clashed the footing is not sound, and if Great Loss is added much money will be spent. If Tai Sui and the Month are strong it is mostly a 'proclamation'; if the Noble, the Emolument and the Horse share one place it is no more than a 'decree'; if there are auspicious spirits but they are scattered and without authority it is no more than a clerk's papers. A clash on the Self is bad and a generating of the Self is good; so long as it does not fall Void, however hard and wearing the labour, it will in the end be accomplished.

note.yi: 「仪俨侃称」是宋代窦禹钧五个儿子（仪、俨、侃、偁、僖）的名字，他们相继登科，这是个典故；注文没有解释。「冲世凶，生克世吉」卜筮大全本如此，断易天机本作「生世吉」，并多出「若冲则为仇人所害，克者事不相容，刑者势不两立」一句；这两处另引在后面。
note.en: 'Yi Yan Kan Cheng' are the names of the five sons of Dou Yujun of the Song (Yi, Yan, Kan, Cheng and Xi), who passed the examinations one after another; it is an allusion and the commentary does not explain it. The Bushi Daquan text reads 'a clash on the Self is bad; generating or controlling the Self is good', while the Duanyi Tianji text reads 'generating the Self is good' and adds the sentence 'if it is clashed one is harmed by an enemy; if controlled the matter cannot be accommodated; if punished the two cannot stand together'; both are quoted after it.

zh: 有子万事足，当如仪俨侃称喜；
无官一身轻，谁佐禹汤及文武。
欲作大廷之宰辅，须凭易卦以推详。
yi: 有儿子就万事满足，该像仪、俨、侃、称那样令人欢喜；
没有官做一身轻松，可那样谁去辅佐禹、汤、文王、武王呢？
想做朝廷里的宰辅，就要凭易卦来推详。
en: With a son all is enough; one should rejoice as with Yi, Yan, Kan and Cheng;
without office the body is light, but then who would assist Yu, Tang, King Wen and King Wu?
to become a chief minister of the great court, one must rely on the hexagrams of the Yi to reckon in detail.

hits.text: 有子万事足，当如仪俨侃称喜
无官一身轻，谁佐禹汤及文武
欲作大廷之宰辅，须凭易卦以推详
有子万事足，当如仪俨侃称喜
无官一身轻，谁佐禹汤及文武
欲作大廷之宰辅，须凭易卦以推详

yi: 谋求名利，
先要官鬼爻旺相；
要斟酌宣、敕（任命的诏书），
只看父母爻的兴衰。
en: In scheming for profit and name,
first the Pressure line must be strong;
to weigh the proclamation and the decree,
look only at whether Resource thrives or declines.

zh: 喜日辰扶拱，怕刑害克冲。
卦中不可无，最宜旺相扶世，不加凶杀则吉。
yi: 凡是占求官，官鬼爻是用爻。
宜旺相，不宜衰弱。
喜欢日辰扶持拱卫，怕刑、害、克、冲。
宣敕，就是父母爻。
它在卦中不可以没有，最好旺相、扶助世爻，不加凶杀就吉。
如果被刑、冲，根基就不正；
加临大耗，要多花钱财。
en: In every divination for office, the Pressure line is the Subject line.
It should be strong and not weak.
It likes the Day to support and gather round it, and fears punishment, harm, control and clash.
The proclamation and decree are Resource.
It cannot be missing from the hexagram, and is best strong and supporting the Self, auspicious if no baleful spirit is added.
If it is punished or clashed, the footing is not sound;
if Great Loss is added, much money will be spent.

zh: 若太岁月建旺者，多是宣也。
若贵人禄马同乡，不过是敕也。
若虽有吉神，散漫而不当权者，无过是吏掾文书。
若不落空亡，纵有艰辛费力，终当成就。
yi: 如果太岁、月建旺相，多半是「宣」。
如果贵人、禄、马同在一处，不过是「敕」。
如果虽有吉神，却散漫而不当权，不过是吏员的文书。
冲世是凶，生世、克世是吉。
只要不落空亡，即使辛苦费力，最终也该成就。
en: If Tai Sui and the Month are strong, it is mostly a 'proclamation'.
If the Noble, the Emolument and the Horse share one place, it is no more than a 'decree'.
If there are auspicious spirits but they are scattered and without authority, it is no more than a clerk's paperwork.
A clash on the Self is bad; generating or controlling the Self is good.
So long as it does not fall Void, however hard and wearing the labour, it will in the end be accomplished.

zh: 若冲则为仇人所害，克者事不相容，刑者势不两立。
yi: 如果遇冲，就是被仇人所害；遇克，事情不能相容；遇刑，势不两立。
en: If it is clashed, one is harmed by an enemy; if controlled, the matter cannot be accommodated; if punished, the two cannot stand together.

zh: 冲世凶，生世吉，若不落空亡，纵有艰辛费力，终当成就。）
yi: 冲世是凶，生世是吉；只要不落空亡，即使辛苦费力，最终也该成就。
en: A clash on the Self is bad and generating the Self is good; so long as it does not fall Void, however hard and wearing the labour, it will in the end be accomplished.

title: 印绶旺则职守弥高、官鬼衰则声名卑小：父母官鬼乃占官之根本缺一则事难成；二者生旺官职高大、休囚职分卑小；父强鬼弱则冷衙门；遇进神声名益大、逢退神减前任政声

rule.yi: 印绶（父母）旺，职位就高；官鬼衰，名声就卑小。父母、官鬼是占官的根本，缺一个事情就难成；两个都逢生逢旺，官职必然高大，休囚则只是卑小的职分；父母强旺而官鬼无气，职位虽平平，身处的是清静冷淡的衙门，没有威光权柄；遇进神，名声更大；逢退神，必减损前任的政声。
rule.en: With the seal and ribbon (Resource) strong the post held is high; with Pressure weak the name is humble and small. Resource and Pressure are the root of divining for office, and lacking either the matter is hard to accomplish; if both meet birth or strength the post is surely high and great, and if they are at rest or trapped it is only a humble station; if Resource is strong but Pressure has no qi, the rank may be ordinary but one sits in a quiet, cold office without glory or authority; meeting an Advancing spirit the name grows greater, meeting a Retreating spirit it will surely lessen the reputation for government of the previous post.

yi: 印绶（父母）旺，职位就更高；
官鬼衰，名声就卑小。
en: With the seal and ribbon strong, the post held is all the higher;
with Pressure weak, the name and standing are humble and small.

zh: 父母官鬼，乃占官之根本，缺一则事难成。
二者若逢生旺，必然官职高大；
若值休囚，只是卑小职分。
若父母强旺，而官鬼无气，职虽平等，身居镇静冷淡衙门，无威耀权柄。
如逢退神，必减前任政声。
yi: 父母和官鬼，是占官的根本，缺一个事情就难成。
两者如果逢生逢旺，官职必然高大；
如果值休囚，只是卑小的职分。
如果父母强旺而官鬼无气，职位虽然平平，身处的是清静冷淡的衙门，没有威光和权柄。
如果遇到进神，名声更大；
如果逢到退神，必定减损前任的政声。
这里只举大纲，后面照此推。
en: Resource and Pressure are the root of divining for office; lacking either, the matter is hard to accomplish.
If both meet birth or strength, the post is surely high and great;
if they are at rest or trapped, it is only a humble and petty station.
If Resource is strong but Pressure has no qi, the rank may be ordinary but one sits in a quiet, cold office, without glory or authority.
If it meets an Advancing spirit, the name grows greater;
if it meets a Retreating spirit, it will surely lessen the reputation for government of the previous post.
This gives only the outline; what follows is reckoned in the same way.

yi: 要知道品级秩位，
不要厌倦地仔细推详。
en: To know the grade and rank,
do not tire of reckoning in detail.

zh: 以上两节，只言大体，精妙之理，具陈于后。
yi: 以上两节，只讲大概，精妙的道理，都在后面陈述。
en: The two sections above speak only of the broad outline; the subtle principles are all set out below.

title: 禄马扶身，万里风云际会：禄以旺位为禄（甲禄在寅，在临官帝旺之处），马为驿马；禄马临身世或官鬼父母、动来生扶身世大吉，唾手成名；大忌空亡与刑害

rule.yi: 禄、马扶助自身，万里风云际会。禄是以旺位为禄（如甲的禄在寅，在临官、帝旺的地方），比喻人长大后食禄；马是驿马，落在身、世，或官鬼、父母上，以及发动来生扶身、世，是大吉，唾手成名的象；最忌空亡和刑、害。
rule.en: With the Emolument and the Horse supporting the self there is a meeting of wind and cloud across ten thousand li. The Emolument takes strength as the Emolument (for Jia it is at Yin, at the Office and Peak stages), likening a person grown up and eating a salary; the Horse is the Post Horse, and standing on the Body or the Self, or on Pressure or Resource, or moving to generate or support the Body and Self, it is greatly auspicious, the image of making a name as easily as spitting into one's palms; Void and punishment or harm are the great taboos.

note.yi: 卜筮大全本说「马居申，乃长生」，断易天机本没有「乃长生」三个字。
note.en: The Bushi Daquan text says 'the horse is at Shen, a Birth place'; the Duanyi Tianji text lacks the words 'a Birth place'.

yi: 禄、马扶助自身，
万里风云，际遇会合；
en: With the Emolument and the Horse supporting the self,
wind and cloud meet across ten thousand li;

zh: 譬之人生一世，幼壮老死也。
于长生为学堂：甲乙生亥，丙丁生寅，戊己壬癸生申，庚辛生巳，皆学堂。
以旺为禄：则甲禄在寅之类。
在临官帝旺之处，喻人之长而食禄也。
yi: 禄，指十干五行的禄位。
好比人的一生：幼年、壮年、老年、死亡。
在长生的位置是学堂：甲乙长生在亥，丙丁在寅，戊己壬癸在申，庚辛在巳，都是学堂。
比喻人幼年求学。
以旺位为禄：比如甲的禄在寅。
在临官、帝旺的地方，比喻人长大后食禄。
en: The Emolument: that of the ten stems and the five phases.
It is like a person's lifetime: youth, prime, old age and death.
At the Birth stage is the study hall: Jia and Yi are born at Hai, Bing and Ding at Yin, Wu, Ji, Ren and Gui at Shen, and Geng and Xin at Si; all are study halls.
It likens the learning of a person's childhood.
Strength is taken as the Emolument: for example the Emolument of Jia is at Yin, and so on.
At the Office and Peak stages, it likens a person grown up and eating a salary.

zh: 如寅午戌马居申，乃长生，谓之驿马。
若临身世，或临官鬼父母，及动来生扶身世，乃大吉，唾手成名之象。
yi: 马，就是驿马。
比如寅午戌的马在申，是长生之地，称为驿马。
如果落在身、世上，或落在官鬼、父母上，以及发动来生扶身、世，是大吉，是唾手成名的象。
最忌空亡和刑、害。
en: The Horse is the Post Horse.
For example for Yin, Wu and Xu the horse is at Shen, a Birth place, and is called the Post Horse.

If it stands on the Body or the Self, or on Pressure or Resource, or moves to generate or support the Body and Self, it is greatly auspicious, the image of making a name as easily as spitting into one's palms.
Void and punishment or harm are the great taboos.

zh: 如寅午戌马居申，谓之驿马。
yi: 比如寅午戌的马在申，称为驿马。
en: For example for Yin, Wu and Xu the horse is at Shen, and is called the Post Horse.

title: 贵人持世，九天雨露承恩：贵人有天乙贵人、福星贵人二种，宜旺相怕刑冲；临官鬼及文书主官职高迁必登相位；福贵持世主人有福德、一生见险无虞

rule.yi: 贵人持世，承受九天雨露般的恩泽。贵人有两种：天乙贵人和福星贵人，宜旺相，怕刑、冲；落在官鬼和文书上，主官职高升、必登相位；福星、贵人持世，这人有福德，一生遇险不用忧虑，临到凶事也无祸咎。
rule.en: With the Noble holding the Self one receives favour like the rain and dew of the ninth heaven. There are two kinds of Noble, the Tianyi Noble and the Fortune-star Noble; it should be strong and fears punishment and clash; standing on Pressure or on the documents it means a high promotion and surely a seat as chancellor; with the Fortune star or the Noble holding the Self the person has blessing and virtue, meets danger all his life without anxiety and meets calamity without fault.

yi: 贵人持世，
九重天的雨露（皇恩）降下来，承受恩泽。
en: With the Noble holding the Self,
the rain and dew of the ninth heaven fall, and one receives favour.

zh: 贵人有二：有天乙贵人，有福星贵人。
若临官鬼及文书，主官职高迁，必登相位。
福贵持世，主人有福德，一生见险无虞，临凶无咎也。
yi: 贵人有两种：有天乙贵人，有福星贵人。
宜旺相，怕刑、冲。
如果落在官鬼和文书上，主官职高升，必登相位。
福星、贵人持世，主这个人有福德，一生遇险没有忧虑，临到凶事也没有祸咎。
en: There are two kinds of Noble: the Tianyi Noble and the Fortune-star Noble.
It should be strong and fears punishment and clash.
If it stands on Pressure or on the documents, it means a high promotion and surely a seat as chancellor.
With the Fortune star or the Noble holding the Self, the person has blessing and virtue; all his life he meets danger without anxiety and faces calamity without fault.

title: 青龙动则事业易成、朱雀空而文书难就：青龙为吉庆福德之喜神（年建、月建、日建），发动必加官进禄、与天马并立有升腾之喜，不宜落空；朱雀为占官用爻，宜旺不宜衰，空亡则文书难成、被刑克则文书伤坏

rule.yi: 青龙发动，事业容易成；朱雀落空，文书难成。青龙是吉庆福德的喜神，有年建、月建、日建三种，发动必定加官进禄，与天马并立自有升腾进益之喜，不宜落空，落空只是空欢喜；朱雀是占官的用爻，宜旺不宜衰，见空亡文书必难成，被刑克文书必遭伤坏。
rule.en: When the Azure Dragon moves the undertaking is easily accomplished; when the Vermilion Bird is void the documents are hard to complete. The Azure Dragon is the spirit of joy of auspicious celebration, blessing and virtue, of three kinds, that of the year, of the Month and of the day; moving, it surely adds rank and emolument, and standing together with the Heavenly Horse there is the joy of rising and gain; it must not fall void, for then it is only empty joy. The Vermilion Bird is the Subject line in divining for office and should be strong and not weak; seen Void the documents are sure to be hard to complete, and punished or controlled they are sure to be spoiled.

yi: 青龙发动，事业就容易成；
朱雀落空，文书就难成。
en: When the Azure Dragon moves, the undertaking is easily accomplished;
when the Vermilion Bird is void, the documents are hard to complete.

zh: 青龙者：吉庆福德之喜神，其动有三：年建青龙、月建青龙、日建青龙。
与天马并立，自有升腾进益之喜。
若得兴隆，事事称心，吉无不利。
朱雀：占官之用爻，宜旺不宜衰。
若见空亡，文书必难成就。
或被刑克，文书必遭伤坏。
yi: 青龙，是吉庆福德的喜神，它的发动有三种：年建的青龙、月建的青龙、日建的青龙。
如果见到发动，必定加官进禄。
和天马并立，自然有升腾进益的喜事。
不宜落空，落空必主空欢喜。
如果得到兴隆，事事称心，吉利无有不顺。
朱雀，是占官的用爻，宜旺不宜衰。
如果见空亡，文书必定难成。
或者被刑克，文书必定受伤损坏。
en: The Azure Dragon is the spirit of joy of auspicious celebration, blessing and virtue; its moving is of three kinds: the Azure Dragon of the year, of the Month and of the day.
If it is seen moving, one surely gains rank and emolument.
Standing together with the Heavenly Horse, there is naturally the joy of rising and gain.
It must not fall void; if void it surely means empty joy.
If it flourishes, everything goes to one's heart's content and all is auspicious and favourable.
The Vermilion Bird is the Subject line in divining for office and should be strong, not weak.
If it is seen Void, the documents are sure to be hard to complete.
Or if it is punished or controlled, the documents are sure to be spoiled.

title: 子孙发动，纵然在任也休官：子孙乃剥官之神，发动则虽在任所亦当休致，求仕者不必言

rule.yi: 子孙发动，即使已在任上也要休官；子孙是剥官的神，一发动，虽在任所也该休致，求仕的人就更不用说了。
rule.en: With Output moving, even one already in office will be dismissed; Output is the spirit that strips office, and if it moves even one at his post should retire, to say nothing of one seeking office.

zh: 子孙发动，纵然在任也休官；
yi: 子孙发动，纵然在任上也要休官；
en: With Output moving, even one in office will be dismissed;

hits.text: 子孙发动，纵然在任也休官
子孙发动，纵然在任也休官

zh: 若发动，虽在任所，亦当休致。
yi: 子孙，是剥官的神。
如果发动，即使在任所，也该休致。
那求仕的人，就不用说了。
en: Output is the spirit that strips office.
If it moves, even one at his post should retire.
As for one seeking office, there is no need to say.

title: 劫杀交重，当见承恩方损己：官鬼临劫杀发动，必因官损命（劫杀者五行混浊之神，阴气尤毒者谓之杀）

rule.yi: 劫杀交重发动，正当受恩的时候反而损伤自己；官鬼落在劫杀上发动，必定因为做官而损命。劫杀见后面神杀章；它是五行混浊的神，阴气特别毒的叫做杀，遇到都不是吉兆。
rule.en: With the Robbery Killing moving heavily, just when one is to receive favour one is harmed; if Pressure stands on it and moves, one is sure to lose one's life through office. The Robbery Killing is dealt with in the later chapter on baleful spirits; it is a spirit of the five phases muddied and turbid, yin qi that is especially poisonous being called a 'killing', and meeting it is never an auspicious sign.

note.yi: 卜筮大全本作「损已」，应是「损己」之误（断易天机本作「损己」），这里按「损己」译。后三句是断易天机本多出来的注。
note.en: The Bushi Daquan text writes 'harm oneself' with a wrong character (the one for 'already' in place of the one for 'oneself'); the Duanyi Tianji text has it right, and it is translated as 'harm oneself'. The last three sentences are an extra note found only in the Duanyi Tianji text.

zh: 劫杀交重，当见承恩方损已。
yi: 劫杀交重发动，正当受恩的时候反而损伤自己。
en: With the Robbery Killing moving heavily, just when one is to receive favour one is harmed.

hits.text: 劫杀交重，当见承恩方损
劫杀交重，当见承恩方损

zh: 若官鬼临之发动，必因官损命。
yi: 劫杀，见后面神杀章。
如果官鬼落在它上面发动，必定因为做官而损命。
en: The Robbery Killing: see the later chapter on baleful spirits.
If Pressure stands on it and moves, one is sure to lose one's life through office.

zh: 又云：阴气尤毒者，谓之杀也。
yi: 劫杀，是五行混浊的神。
又说：阴气特别毒的，叫做杀。
占卜的人遇到它，都不是吉兆。
en: The Robbery Killing is a spirit of the five phases muddied and turbid.
Another saying: where yin qi is especially poisonous it is called a 'killing'.
In divination, meeting it is never an auspicious sign.

title: 妻财持世诰牒岂得如心、兄弟扶身俸禄安能称意：妻财持世克文书纵成不如意；兄弟为克剥之神俸资必非厚

rule.yi: 妻财持世，任命的文书哪能称心？兄弟扶身，俸禄哪能称意？妻财持世克了文书（父母），就算成了也不如意；兄弟是克剥的神，俸禄必定不丰厚。
rule.en: With Wealth holding the Self, how can the patent of appointment go as one wishes? With Peer supporting the self, how can the salary be as one wishes? Wealth holding the Self and controlling the documents (Resource) means that even if it succeeds it is not as one wishes; Peer is the spirit that strips and takes, so the salary will surely not be generous.

note.yi: 断易天机本多出「凡占官，文书克我则吉，我克文书则凶」一句，又把「纵成，不如意」写成「纵使成就，文辞亦不如意」。
note.en: The Duanyi Tianji text adds the sentence 'in every divination for office, if the documents control me it is auspicious, and if I control the documents it is bad', and writes 'even if it succeeds, it is not as one wishes' as 'even if it succeeds, the wording too is not as one wishes'.

zh: 妻财持世，诰牒岂得如心？
兄弟扶身，俸禄安能称意？
yi: 妻财持世，诰牒（任命的文书）哪能称心？
兄弟扶身，俸禄怎能称意？
en: With Wealth holding the Self, how can the patent of appointment go as one wishes?
With Peer supporting the self, how can the salary be as one wishes?

hits.text: 妻财持世，诰牒岂得如心
兄弟扶身，俸禄安能称意
妻财持世，诰牒岂得如心
兄弟扶身，俸禄安能称意

zh: 妻财持世克文书，纵成，不如意。
兄弟为克剥之神，俸资必非厚也。
yi: 妻财持世克文书，就算成了，也不如意。
兄弟是克剥的神，俸禄必定不丰厚。
en: Wealth holding the Self and controlling the documents (Resource): even if it succeeds, it is not as one wishes.
Peer is the spirit that strips and takes, so the salary will surely not be generous.

zh: 凡占官，文书克我则吉，我克文书则凶。
妻财持世克文书，纵使成就，文辞亦不如意。
yi: 凡是占官，文书克我就吉，我克文书就凶。
妻财持世克文书，即使成就，文辞也不如意。
en: In every divination for office, if the documents control me it is auspicious, and if I control the documents it is bad.
With Wealth holding the Self and controlling the documents, even if it succeeds, the wording too is not as one wishes.

title: 父化父文书不实、官化官事体翻腾

rule.yi: 父母化父母，文书是虚的、不实在；官鬼化官鬼，事情翻腾反复。
rule.en: Resource turning into Resource, the documents are hollow and not solid; Pressure turning into Pressure, the matter churns and reverses.

yi: 父化父，文书虚而不实；
官化官，事情翻腾反复。
en: Resource turning into Resource, the documents are not real;
Pressure turning into Pressure, the matter is tossed over and over.

zh: 父化父，文书虚而不实也。
官化官，事体翻腾反复也。
yi: 父母是文书。
父化父，文书是虚的、不实在。
官化官，事情翻腾反复。
en: Resource stands for the documents.
Resource turning into Resource: the documents are hollow and not solid.
Pressure turning into Pressure: the matter churns and reverses.

title: 卦中两父两官，必是鸳鸯求仕：必有两意此失彼得；前鬼旺后鬼空只宜守旧不可改谋，前鬼衰后鬼旺宜舍旧图新，前后皆旺所求遂意

rule.yi: 卦里有两个父母、两个官鬼，一定是「鸳鸯求仕」：心里有两个打算，是此失彼得的兆头。前面的官鬼旺、后面的官鬼空，只宜守旧，不可改谋；前面的衰而后面的旺，宜舍旧图新；前后都旺，所求遂意。
rule.en: With two Resource lines and two Pressure lines in the hexagram it is surely 'mandarin ducks seeking office': there are two intentions, a sign of losing here and gaining there. If the former Pressure is strong and the latter void, one should only hold to the old and not change the plan; if the former is weak and the latter strong, give up the old and plan for the new; if both are strong, what is sought is attained as wished.

yi: 卦中有两个父、两个官，
必是「鸳鸯求仕」。
en: With two Resource lines and two Pressure lines in the hexagram,
it is surely 'mandarin ducks seeking office'.

zh: 卦中遇之，必有两意干事，此失彼得之兆，此乃鸳鸯求仕。
若前鬼旺后鬼空，只宜守旧，不可改谋；
前鬼衰而后鬼旺，宜舍旧图新；
yi: 卦中遇到这种情形，一定是有两个心思在办事，是此失彼得的兆头，这就叫鸳鸯求仕。
如果前面的官鬼旺、后面的官鬼空，只宜守旧，不可改谋；
前面的鬼衰而后面的鬼旺，宜舍旧图新；
前后都旺，所求遂意。
en: Meeting this in the hexagram, one surely has two intentions in the matter, a sign of losing here and gaining there; this is 'mandarin ducks seeking office'.
If the former Pressure is strong and the latter void, one should only hold to the old and not change the plan;
if the former is weak and the latter strong, give up the old and plan for the new;
if both are strong, what is sought is attained as wished.

title: 爻上月德月建，须逢獬豸为冠：月德月建皆清正吉神，加临贵人扶持官鬼及世爻必非州县之官而是风宪之职；更看目下衰旺断擢官赴任；不忌凶杀，逢杀则威风凛凛

rule.yi: 爻上有月德、月建，必定戴上獬豸冠（监察执法之冠）。月德、月建都是清正的吉神，各种杀都不敢抬头看；若加在贵人上、扶持官鬼和世爻，必定不是州县的官，而是风宪（监察）的职位；再看眼下的衰旺，就能断他升官赴任；这种情形不忌凶杀，遇杀反而威风凛凛、一举一动惊人、掌权轰轰烈烈。
rule.en: With the Month Virtue and the Month on the line one will surely wear the Xiezhi cap (the cap of the censor and judge). The Month Virtue and the Month are both upright auspicious spirits at which no baleful spirit dares look up; added to the Noble and supporting Pressure and the Self line, it is surely not a post in a prefecture or county but a censorate office; look then at the present strength or weakness to judge his promotion and taking up the post; here baleful spirits are not feared, and meeting one makes one awe-inspiring, every move startling and one's wielding of power resounding.

note.yi: 「目下」断易天机本作「日下」。獬豸是传说中能分辨曲直的异兽，獬豸冠是执法监察官戴的冠。
note.en: The Duanyi Tianji text has 'ri xia' (the day) for 'mu xia' (at present). The Xiezhi is the legendary beast that tells right from wrong, and the Xiezhi cap is the cap worn by officers of law and censorship.

yi: 爻上有月德、月建，
必定戴上獬豸冠（监察执法之冠）。
en: With the Month Virtue and the Month on the line,
one will surely wear the Xiezhi cap (the cap of the censor and judge).

zh: 月德、月建，皆清正之吉神，诸杀莫敢仰视。
若见加临贵人，扶持官鬼及世爻，必非州县之官，乃风宪之职。
更看目下衰旺，便可断其擢官赴任。
此又不忌凶杀，逢杀，则威风凛凛，动止惊人，操权轰烈。
yi: 月德、月建都是清正的吉神，各种杀都不敢抬头看。
如果见它们加在贵人上，扶持官鬼和世爻，必定不是州县的官，而是风宪（监察）的职位。
再看眼下的衰旺，就可以断他升官赴任。
这种情形又不忌凶杀，遇到杀，反而威风凛凛，一举一动惊人，掌权轰轰烈烈。
en: The Month Virtue and the Month are both upright auspicious spirits, at which no baleful spirit dares look up.
If they are seen added to the Noble and supporting Pressure and the Self line, it is surely not a post in a prefecture or county but a censorate office.
Then look at the present strength or weakness, and one can judge his promotion and taking up the post.
In this case baleful spirits are not feared either; meeting a baleful spirit, one is awe-inspiring, every move startles, and one wields power resoundingly.

zh: 更看日下衰旺，便可断其擢官赴任。
yi: 再看日下的衰旺，就可以断他升官赴任。
en: Then look at the day's present strength or weakness, and one can judge his promotion and taking up the post.

title: 太岁动则在任有除、劫杀空则逢凶无咎：太岁为地杀之主宰诸神不敢当；值青龙月建加临父母官鬼发动，虽居任所又当升擢美职；加劫杀则当贬责；落空亡逢凶无咎

rule.yi: 太岁发动，在任的人就有任命、调动；劫杀落空，遇凶也没有祸咎。太岁是地杀的主宰，各神都不敢当它；如果碰上青龙、月建，加在父母、官鬼上发动，即使已在任所，也该升迁到好职位；如果加劫杀，就该受贬责；如果落空亡，遇凶也无咎。
rule.en: When Tai Sui moves, one in office gets an appointment or transfer; when the Robbery Killing is void, meeting calamity brings no fault. Tai Sui is the master of the earthly baleful spirits, which no spirit dares withstand; if it meets the Azure Dragon and the Month, added to Resource and Pressure and moving, even one already at his post will be promoted to a fine office; if the Robbery Killing is added, one is to be demoted and reprimanded; if it falls Void, meeting calamity brings no fault.

note.yi: 卜筮大全本作「加临父母官鬼」「贬责」，断易天机本作「加临父官」「贬谪」。
note.en: The Bushi Daquan text reads 'added to Resource and Pressure' and 'demoted and reprimanded'; the Duanyi Tianji text reads 'added to father and official' and 'banished'.

yi: 太岁发动，在任的人就有任命、调动；
劫杀落空，遇凶也没有祸咎。
en: When Tai Sui moves, one in office gets an appointment or transfer;
when the Robbery Killing is void, meeting calamity brings no fault.

zh: 太岁，地杀之主宰，诸神不敢当。
若值青龙月建，加临父母官鬼发动，虽见居任所，又当升擢美职也。
yi: 太岁，是地上各杀的主宰，各神都不敢当它。
如果碰上青龙、月建，加在父母、官鬼上发动，即使已在任所，也该升迁到好职位。
如果加上劫杀，就该受贬责；
如果落空亡，遇凶也没有祸咎。
en: Tai Sui is the master of the earthly baleful spirits, which no spirit dares withstand.
If it meets the Azure Dragon and the Month, added to Resource and Pressure and moving, even one already at his post will be promoted to a fine office.
If the Robbery Killing is added, one is to be demoted and reprimanded;
if it falls Void, meeting calamity brings no fault.

zh: 若值青龙、月建，加临父官发动，虽见居任所，又当升擢美职也。
yi: 如果碰上青龙、月建，加在父、官上发动，即使已在任所，也该升迁到好职位。
如果加上劫杀，就该贬谪。
en: If it meets the Azure Dragon and the Month, added to Resource and Pressure and moving, even one already at his post will be promoted to a fine office.
If the Robbery Killing is added, one is to be banished.

title: 鬼爻持世应知到任把权、印绶扶身必定临庭掌案：持世扶身为卦之主宰，用爻加临主到任把权、临庭掌案

rule.yi: 官鬼爻持世，应当知道到任后要掌权；印绶（父母）扶身，必定临堂掌管案牍。官鬼持世、印绶扶身是卦的主宰，再有用爻加在上面，一定到任把权、临堂掌案。
rule.en: With the Pressure line holding the Self, know that on taking up the post one will hold power; with the seal and ribbon (Resource) supporting the self, one will surely sit in court and take charge of the cases. Pressure holding the Self and the seal supporting the self are the masters of the hexagram, and if the Subject line is added to them one surely takes power on taking up the post and presides in court over the cases.

note.yi: 卜筮大全本这条注只说「持世扶身，卦之主宰」，没点明是谁持世扶身；断易天机本补成「鬼爻持世，印绶扶身，卦之主宰」，与赋文对上。
note.en: The Bushi Daquan note says only 'holding the Self and supporting the self are the masters of the hexagram' without saying who holds and supports; the Duanyi Tianji text fills it out as 'the Pressure line holding the Self and the seal supporting the self', matching the rhapsody.

zh: 鬼爻持世，应知到任把权；
印绶扶身，必定临庭掌案。
yi: 官鬼爻持世，应当知道到任后要把权；
印绶扶身，必定临堂掌管案牍。
en: With the Pressure line holding the Self, know that on taking up the post one will hold power;
with the seal and ribbon supporting the self, one will surely sit in court and take charge of the cases.

hits.text: 鬼爻持世，应知到任把权
印绶扶身，必定临庭掌案
鬼爻持世应知到任把权
印绶扶身必定临庭掌案

zh: 若见用爻加临，定主到任把权，临庭掌案也。
yi: 持世、扶身，是卦的主宰。
如果见用爻加在上面，一定主到任把权、临堂掌案。
en: Holding the Self and supporting the self are the masters of the hexagram.
If the Subject line is seen added to them, it surely means taking power on taking up the post and presiding in court over the cases.

zh: 鬼爻持世，印绶扶身，卦之主宰。
yi: 官鬼爻持世、印绶扶身，是卦的主宰。
en: The Pressure line holding the Self and the seal and ribbon supporting the self are the masters of the hexagram.

title: 卦无父母终无所任之邦、爻隐妻财未得养廉之俸：父母为任所之地，不出现或落空恐无所任之处；妻财隐伏及落空养廉之俸未足

rule.yi: 卦里没有父母，终究没有可任职的地方；妻财隐伏不现，还拿不到养廉的俸禄。父母是任所所在的地方，不出现或落空，恐怕没有任职之处；妻财隐伏或落空，养廉的俸禄就不够。
rule.en: With no Resource in the hexagram there is in the end no place to take up office; with the Wealth line hidden one does not yet get the stipend that fosters integrity. Resource is the place of the post, and if it does not appear or falls void there may be nowhere to take office; with Wealth hidden or void the stipend that fosters integrity is not enough.

zh: 卦无父母，终无所任之邦；
爻隐妻财，未得养廉之俸。
yi: 卦里没有父母，终究没有可任职的地方；
妻财隐伏不现，还拿不到养廉的俸禄。
en: With no Resource in the hexagram, in the end there is no place to take up office;
with the Wealth line hidden, one does not yet get the stipend that fosters integrity.

hits.text: 卦无父母，终无所任之邦
爻隐妻财，未得养廉之俸
卦无父母，终无所任之邦
爻隐妻财，未得养廉之俸

zh: 若不出现，或落空，恐无所任之处。
妻财隐伏及落空，养廉之俸未足也。
yi: 父母是任所所在的地方。
如果不出现，或者落空，恐怕没有任职的地方。
妻财隐伏以及落空，养廉的俸禄就不够。
en: Resource is the place of the post.
If it does not appear, or falls void, there may be no place to take up office.
With Wealth hidden or void, the stipend that fosters integrity is not enough.

title: 一世二世任所非遥、五世八纯仕途远涉：一二三世在内卦故非遥，四五八纯在外卦故远涉

rule.yi: 一世、二世卦，任所不远；五世卦、八纯卦，仕途要远行。一、二、三世的世爻在内卦，所以说不远；四、五、八纯在外卦，所以说要远行。
rule.en: In a First- or Second-Generation hexagram the post is not far; in a Fifth-Generation or Eight-Pure hexagram the career takes one far. The First, Second and Third Generations are in the inner trigram, so it is said not to be far; the Fourth, Fifth and Eight-Pure are in the outer trigram, so it is said one travels far.

yi: 一世、二世卦，任所不远；
五世卦、八纯卦，仕途要远行。
en: In a First- or Second-Generation hexagram, the post is not far;
in a Fifth-Generation or Eight-Pure hexagram, the career takes one far.

zh: 一、二、三世在内卦，故曰非遥；
四、五、八纯在外卦，故曰远涉也。
yi: 一世、二世、三世在内卦，所以说不远；
四世、五世、八纯在外卦，所以说要远行。
en: The First, Second and Third Generations are in the inner trigram, so it is said not to be far;
the Fourth, Fifth and Eight-Pure are in the outer trigram, so it is said one travels far.

title: 要识宦情好恶须凭卦象推详：隔手来占要知本官为人及形貌性情，但将鬼爻论之，看在何宫论其形体并六兽之形貌

rule.yi: 要认识做官人的性情好恶，必须凭卦象仔细推详。托别人来占、要知道这位官员的为人、形貌、性情，只把官鬼爻来论：看它在哪一宫，论他的形体，再合上六兽的形貌，性情就清清楚楚。
rule.en: To know an official's likes and dislikes one must reckon in detail from the hexagram image. If the question is asked through another's hand and one wants to know the official's character, appearance and temper, reckon only from the Pressure line: see in which palace it lies, reckon his build, and together with the looks of the six beasts his nature can be seen clearly.

yi: 要认识做官人的性情好恶，
必须凭卦象仔细推详。
en: To know an official's likes and dislikes,
one must reckon in detail from the hexagram image.

zh: 假如隔手来占，要知本官为人，及形貌性情，但将鬼爻论之。
看在何宫，论其形体，并六兽之形貌，情性了然可见。
yi: 假如是隔手（托别人）来占，要知道这位本官的为人和形貌性情，只把官鬼爻来论。
看它在哪一宫，论他的形体，再合上六兽的形貌，性情就清清楚楚能看出来。
精微的道理列在后面。
en: If one asks through another's hand and wants to know the character, appearance and temper of the official himself, reckon only from the Pressure line.
See in which palace it lies and reckon his build, together with the looks of the six beasts, and his nature can be seen clearly.
The deeper meanings are listed below.

title: 世在离宫眼露聪明性急、身居乾象面圆正大仁慈：离属火为目，乾属金为首

rule.yi: 世在离宫，这人眼睛外露、聪明、性急；身在乾象，这人脸圆、正大、仁慈。离属火，为目；乾属金，为首；各取它的形体和德性来说。
rule.en: With the Self in the palace of Li the man's eyes show, he is clever and quick-tempered; with the Body in the Qian image his face is round and he is upright and magnanimous and benevolent. Li belongs to Fire and is the eye; Qian belongs to Metal and is the head; each is taken by its bodily form and its virtue.

zh: 世在离宫，眼露聪明性急；
身居乾象，面圆正大仁慈。
yi: 世在离宫，眼睛外露、聪明、性急；
身在乾象，脸圆、正大、仁慈。
en: With the Self in the palace of Li, the eyes show, the man is clever and quick-tempered;
with the Body in the Qian image, the face is round, he is upright and magnanimous and benevolent.

hits.text: 世在离宫，眼露聪明性急
身居乾象，面圆正大仁慈
世在离宫，眼露聪明性急
身居乾象，面圆正大仁慈

zh: 离属火为目，乾属金为首，各取其体德而言之也。
yi: 离属火，为目；乾属金，为首；各取它的形体和德性来说。
en: Li belongs to Fire and is the eye; Qian belongs to Metal and is the head; each is taken by its bodily form and its virtue.

title: 金为武职之官掌生杀之重柄、火乃文章之士探礼义之根源：金有断制之义故取为武职，火乃文明之象必职司儒业

rule.yi: 金是武职的官，掌握生杀的大权；火是文章之士，探求礼义的根源。金有决断制裁的意思，所以取为武职；火是文明的象，必定职掌儒业。
rule.en: Metal is the military officer, holding the heavy handle of life and death; Fire is the man of letters, who probes the source of ritual and righteousness. Metal has the sense of judging and restraining, so it is taken for military office; Fire is the image of civilization and brightness, so the office is surely over the Confucian scholarly profession.

zh: 金为武职之官，掌生杀之重柄；
火乃文章之士，探礼义之根源。
yi: 金是武职的官，掌握生杀的大权；
火是文章之士，探求礼义的根源。
en: Metal is the military officer, holding the heavy handle of life and death;
Fire is the man of letters, who probes the source of ritual and righteousness.

hits.text: 金为武职之官，掌生杀之重柄
火乃文章之士，探礼义之根源
金为武职之官，掌生杀之重柄
火乃文章之士，探礼义之根源

zh: 金有断制之义，故取为武职；
火乃文明之象，必职司儒业。
yi: 金有决断制裁的意思，所以取为武职；
火是文明的象，必定职掌儒业。
en: Metal has the sense of judging and restraining, so it is taken for military office;
Fire is the image of civilization and brightness, so the office is surely over the Confucian scholarly profession.

title: 五爻为天子，近亲贤而远去奸邪：占国家以本宫为国、世为君，又云五爻为天子；带财福青龙贵人为仁君，临太岁月建勾陈为守正之君，加大杀白虎为暴虐之君，带咸池为淫乱之君，加劫杀居位不久；与吉神相生合必亲贤，动克凶神必远小人；与凶杀相生合则奸佞相辅

rule.yi: 占国家，以本宫为国、世为君；又说五爻是天子。五爻带财、福、青龙、贵人的，是仁君；临太岁、月建、勾陈的，威震天下，是守正之君；加大杀、白虎的，是暴虐之君；带咸池的，是淫乱之君；加劫杀的，在位不久。五爻与吉神相生相合，必能亲近贤者；吉神来克它，必有贤臣辅佐；它动而克凶神，必能远小人、去奸邪。若与凶杀相生相合，或凶杀发动来克，辅佐的宰相就不得其人，都是奸佞在辅佐，君爻纵然遇上吉神，也不能去掉奸佞。
rule.en: In divining for the state, the palace of the hexagram is the state and the Self is the lord; it is also said that the fifth line is the Son of Heaven. A fifth line carrying Wealth, Output, the Azure Dragon or the Noble is a benevolent lord; on Tai Sui, the Month or Hook Earth it shakes the world and is a lord who keeps to the right; with the Great Baleful Spirit or the White Tiger it is a tyrant; with Xianchi, a debauched lord; with the Robbery Killing, a lord who will not hold his seat long. If it is generated or combined by auspicious spirits it will surely draw near the worthy; if an auspicious spirit comes to control it, there will be worthy ministers to assist; if it moves and controls a baleful spirit it will surely keep the petty at a distance and remove the wicked. If it is generated or combined by baleful spirits, or baleful spirits move to control it, the chancellors are the wrong men and all are flatterers assisting, and even if the lord's line meets an auspicious spirit it cannot remove the flatterers.

yi: 五爻是天子，
他亲近贤人而远远去掉奸邪；
en: The fifth line is the Son of Heaven;
he draws near the worthy and puts the wicked far away;

zh: 凡占国家：以本宫为国，世为君。
yi: 凡是占国家：以本宫为国，世为君。
又说：五爻是天子。
en: In every divination for the state: the palace of the hexagram is the state and the Self is the lord.
It is also said: the fifth line is the Son of Heaven.

zh: 若带财福、青龙、贵人者，仁君也。
临太岁、月建、勾陈者，威震天下，守正之君。
yi: 如果带着财、福、青龙、贵人，是仁君。
落在太岁、月建、勾陈上的，威震天下，是守正之君。
加大杀、白虎的，是暴虐之君。
带咸池的，是淫乱之君。
加劫杀的，在位不久。
en: If it carries Wealth, Output, the Azure Dragon or the Noble, he is a benevolent lord.
If it stands on Tai Sui, the Month or Hook Earth, he shakes the world and is a lord who keeps to the right.
With the Great Baleful Spirit or the White Tiger added, he is a tyrant.
Carrying Xianchi, he is a debauched lord.
With the Robbery Killing added, he will not hold his seat long.

zh: 若与吉神相生相合，必能亲近贤者。
若吉神来克，必有贤臣相辅。
若动克凶神，必能远小人，去奸邪。
yi: 如果与吉神相生相合，必能亲近贤者。
如果吉神来克它，必有贤臣辅佐。
如果它动而克凶神，必能远离小人、去除奸邪。
en: If it is generated or combined by auspicious spirits, he will surely draw near the worthy.
If an auspicious spirit comes to control it, there will surely be worthy ministers to assist.
If it moves and controls a baleful spirit, he will surely keep the petty at a distance and remove the wicked.

zh: 或与凶杀相生相合，及凶杀动来相克，辅相不得其人，皆奸佞相辅。
君爻纵遇吉神，亦不能去奸佞。
yi: 或者与凶杀相生相合，以及凶杀发动来克它，辅佐的宰相就不得其人，都是奸佞在辅佐。
君爻纵然遇上吉神，也不能去掉奸佞。
en: Or if it is generated or combined by baleful spirits, or baleful spirits move to control it, the chancellors are the wrong men, and all are flatterers assisting.
Even if the lord's line meets an auspicious spirit, it cannot remove the flatterers.

title: 四位列公侯，上忠君而下安黎庶：三公九卿皆在四爻；临吉神旺相克世为敢言敢谏之臣，加鬼杀旺相克世为欺君僭上之辈；四爻与世相生为阿谀之臣；四爻动生初爻有忧民之心、初爻生四爻民有仰慕、四爻加凶杀克初爻民受无辜之害、初爻动克四爻民视如仇；四爻生合二爻能招贤纳士，生克三爻能任用百官

rule.yi: 三公九卿的位置都在四爻。四爻临吉神、旺相而克世，是敢言敢谏的社稷之臣；加鬼、杀、旺相而克世，是欺君僭上、蒙蔽君主把持权柄的人；世值吉神，大概没有大害。四爻与世相生，是阿谀奉承的臣子，纵然带吉神也不能规谏君主的过错，带凶神也害不了君主的正道。四爻动生初爻，必有忧虑百姓之心；初爻生四爻，百姓有仰慕之意；四爻加凶杀克初爻，百姓受无辜之害；初爻发动克四爻，百姓看他如同仇敌。四爻生合二爻，必能招揽贤人、接纳士人；二爻生四爻，士人有景仰羡慕之心；四爻生克三爻，必能任用百官、进用贤人罢退不肖之人。
rule.en: The places of the Three Councillors and the Nine Ministers are all on the fourth line. If it stands on an auspicious spirit, strong, and controls the Self, he is a pillar of the state who dares to speak and to remonstrate; if Pressure and baleful spirits are added, strong, and it controls the Self, he is one who deceives the lord, oversteps, keeps his master in the dark and seizes power; if the Self is on an auspicious spirit there is probably no great harm. If the fourth line and the Self generate each other, he is a flattering minister, who even with an auspicious spirit cannot admonish the lord's faults or set right his errors, and with a baleful spirit cannot damage the lord's uprightness or ruin his virtue. The fourth line moving to generate the first, he surely has a heart that grieves for the people; the first generating the fourth, the people look up to him; the fourth with a baleful spirit controlling the first, the people suffer undeserved harm; the first moving to control the fourth, the people regard him as a bitter enemy. The fourth generating or combining the second, he can surely call in the worthy and receive scholars; the second generating the fourth, the scholars admire him; the fourth generating or controlling the third, he can surely employ the hundred officials, advancing the worthy and dismissing the unworthy.

yi: 四爻列为公侯，
对上忠于君，对下安定百姓。
en: The fourth place is ranked among dukes and marquises,
loyal to the lord above and bringing peace to the people below.

zh: 三公九卿之位，皆在四爻。
若临吉神旺相克世，乃是敢言敢谏，社稷之臣也。
若加鬼杀旺相克世，乃是欺君僭上，昧主把权之辈也。
四爻若与世相生，阿谀之臣也；
纵带吉神，亦不能规君之过，正君之失；
带凶神，亦不能害君之正，丧君之德。
yi: 三公九卿的位置，都在四爻。
如果临吉神、旺相而克世，是敢直言敢规谏、社稷之臣。
如果加鬼、杀、旺相而克世，是欺君僭上、蒙蔽君主而把持权柄的一类人。
如果世值吉神，大概没有大害。
四爻如果与世相生，是阿谀奉承的臣子；
纵然带吉神，也不能规谏君主的过错、纠正君主的失误；
带凶神，也害不了君主的正道、败不了君主的德。
en: The places of the Three Councillors and the Nine Ministers are all on the fourth line.
If it stands on an auspicious spirit, strong, and controls the Self, he is one who dares to speak and remonstrate, a pillar of the state.
If Pressure and baleful spirits are added, strong, and it controls the Self, he is of those who deceive the lord, overstep their place, keep their master in the dark and seize power.
If the Self is on an auspicious spirit, there is probably no great harm.
If the fourth line and the Self generate each other, he is a flattering minister;
even with an auspicious spirit he cannot admonish the lord's faults or set right his errors;
and with a baleful spirit he cannot damage the lord's uprightness or ruin his virtue.

zh: 四爻动生初爻，必有忧民之心；
初爻生四爻，民有仰慕之意。
四爻加凶杀克初爻，民受无辜之害；
初爻动克四爻，民视之如仇仇。
yi: 四爻发动生初爻，必有忧虑百姓之心；
初爻生四爻，百姓有仰慕之意。
四爻加凶杀克初爻，百姓受无辜的伤害；
初爻发动克四爻，百姓看他如同仇敌。
en: The fourth line moving to generate the first, he surely has a heart that grieves for the people;
the first generating the fourth, the people look up to him in admiration.
The fourth with a baleful spirit controlling the first, the people suffer undeserved harm;
the first moving to control the fourth, the people regard him as a bitter enemy.

zh: 四爻生合二爻，必能招贤纳士；
二爻生四爻，士有景羡之心。
四爻生克三爻，必能任用百官，进贤退不肖。
以上细心详察，无不应验。
yi: 四爻生合二爻，必能招揽贤人、接纳士人；
二爻生四爻，士人有景仰羡慕之心。
四爻生克三爻，必能任用百官，进用贤人、罢退不肖之人。
以上要细心详察，没有不应验的。
en: The fourth generating or combining the second, he can surely call in the worthy and receive scholars;
the second generating the fourth, the scholars look up to him with admiration.
The fourth generating or controlling the third, he can surely employ the hundred officials, advancing the worthy and dismissing the unworthy.
Examine the above with care and detail, and none fails to be confirmed.

title: 子孙临大杀，秦扶苏中赵相之谋：占国家以子孙为国嗣，得日辰扶合或动爻相生或临月建旺相及加青龙贵人则东宫已立他日登位无改易；子孙带咸池非正宫所生；福德临劫杀大杀恐有变易；更被四爻伤克必有赵高谋扶苏之事；卦无子孙无国嗣

rule.yi: 占国家，以子孙为国家的继承人。子孙得日辰扶助相合，或动爻来生它，或落在月建上旺相，以及加青龙、贵人，如果东宫（太子）已立，将来要登宝位，就不会再有更改；子孙带咸池，不是正宫所生；福德落在劫杀、大杀上，恐怕有变更，再被四爻伤克，必有赵高谋害扶苏那样的事；卦里没有子孙，就没有国家的继承人。
rule.en: In divining for the state, Output stands for the heir to the state. If Output gets support and combination from the Day, or a moving line generates it, or it stands on the Month and is strong, or the Azure Dragon or the Noble is added, then if the Eastern Palace (the crown prince) has already been established, when he is due to ascend the throne there will be no further change; if Output carries Xianchi, he is not born of the principal consort; if Output stands on the Robbery Killing or the Great Baleful Spirit there may be a change, and if it is further injured and controlled by the fourth line there will surely be a matter like Zhao Gao's plot against Fusu; if there is no Output in the hexagram, there is no heir to the state.

title: 君位合咸池，唐玄宗受杨妃之祸：世爻五爻带咸池玄武则上必荒淫；卦有咸池而被君爻克则虽有西施之美无害国政；应爻加咸池飞入五爻旺相兼世爻空亡必有武氏乱唐之患；加吉神天下庶几安定更带凶神四海必乱；君位合咸池带杀旺相必有女祸

rule.yi: 世爻和五爻如果带咸池、玄武，在上的君主必定荒淫；卦里有咸池却被君爻克住，虽有西施那样的美人，也无害于国政；应爻加咸池、飞入五爻旺相，又加上世爻空亡，必有像武氏乱唐那样的祸患，以后必定见到女主治理天下。再加吉神，天下大概可以安定，再带凶神，四海必乱。君位如果合咸池、带杀、旺相，必有女祸，就像唐皇与杨贵妃的故事。
rule.en: If the Self line and the fifth line carry Xianchi and the Dark Tortoise, the ruler above is sure to be dissolute; if the hexagram has Xianchi but it is controlled by the lord's line, then though there is a beauty like Xishi it does no harm to the government; if the Other line carries Xianchi and flies into the fifth line, strong, and the Self line is also Void, there will surely be the calamity of a Lady Wu throwing Tang into disorder, and later a female ruler will surely rule the world. If an auspicious spirit is added the world will perhaps be at peace, and if a baleful spirit is added the four seas are sure to be in disorder. If the lord's place combines with Xianchi and carries a baleful spirit, strong, there is sure to be calamity through a woman, like the story of the Tang emperor and Yang Guifei.

title: 福神克世，重观折槛之朱云：子孙发动伤克世爻主有直臣奏事如朱云折槛，与日辰相生合上必允其奏、刑冲则龙颜大怒终遭贬责；子孙临太岁月建动克四爻而生五爻、子孙旺日必有御史劾权臣；四爻鬼杀旺相不受克须防有变

rule.yi: 福神（子孙）克世，又见到折槛直谏的朱云。子孙发动、伤克世爻，主有正直的大臣上奏，很像朱云折槛的风骨；若与日辰相生相合，上面一定准他的奏章；与日辰刑冲，皇帝大怒，终究遭到贬责。子孙落在太岁、月建上，发动克四爻、生五爻，在子孙旺的日子，必有御史弹劾权臣；四爻的鬼、杀旺相而不受克，要防备有变。
rule.en: Output controlling the Self, one sees again Zhu Yun who broke the railing. If Output moves and injures and controls the Self line, there is an upright minister presenting a memorial, much like Zhu Yun breaking the railing; if it is generated or combined by the Day, the sovereign will surely grant the memorial, and if it is punished or clashed by the Day the dragon countenance is greatly angered and he is in the end demoted and reprimanded. If Output stands on Tai Sui or the Month and moves to control the fourth line and generate the fifth, on a day when Output is strong there will surely be a censor impeaching a powerful minister; if the fourth line's ghost and baleful spirit are strong and not controlled, guard against a change.

note.yi: 朱云是汉成帝时的直臣，当面弹劾权贵，被拖下殿时攀住殿槛，槛折；「折槛」就是这个典故，注文没有解释。
note.en: Zhu Yun was an upright minister under Emperor Cheng of Han who impeached a powerful man to his face and, as he was dragged from the hall, clung to the railing until it broke; 'breaking the railing' is that allusion, and the commentary does not explain it.

en: Output controlling the Self, one sees again Zhu Yun who broke the railing;
