title: 将曜加刑，再睹登坛之韩信：寅午戌午、巳酉丑酉、申子辰子、亥卯未卯为将星；将星加白虎羊刃生世必得强将，带贵人青龙生世得忠良之将，加劫杀动来克世须防弑君之祸（此爻将星名为刺客）；以上三节皆在旺相年月日可见

rule.yi: 将星加刑，再看到登坛拜将的韩信。将星：寅午戌的将星是午，巳酉丑是酉，申子辰是子，亥卯未是卯。将星加白虎、羊刃而生世，必得强将；带贵人、青龙而生世，会得忠良的将领；加劫杀、发动来克世，要防弑君之祸，这样的将星爻名叫刺客。以上三节，都在旺相的年、月、日可以看到应验。
rule.en: The General star with punishment added: one sees again Han Xin ascending the altar. The General star: for Yin, Wu and Xu it is Wu; for Si, You and Chou, You; for Shen, Zi and Chen, Zi; for Hai, Mao and Wei, Mao. If the General star carries the White Tiger or the Goat Blade and generates the Self, a strong general is sure to be found; if it carries the Noble or the Azure Dragon and generates the Self, a loyal and good general is to be had; if it carries the Robbery Killing and moves to control the Self, guard against the calamity of regicide, and such a General-star line is called an assassin. The three sections above can all be seen in strong years, months and days.

title: 金爻带鬼一方有兵革之兴、土位逢凶四海尽干戈之难：大杀临金鬼旺动必兴兵革，土鬼带杀发动旺相四海皆乱；有杀无鬼克世亦凶、有鬼无杀虽凶弗咎；有神制杀鬼动无妨；鬼空杀旺纵乱无成、鬼旺杀空虽凶无害；鬼带劫杀或化兄弟为劫财之贼、加玄武为阴私暗害之贼；蛇虎不动不为急迫；以生旺克害何方断方向

rule.yi: 大杀落在金鬼上、旺而发动，必起兵革，世去克它大概无大事，它克世必凶；土鬼带杀、发动旺相，四海皆乱，克世必有攻城的贼寇。卦中有杀无鬼，克世也凶；有鬼无杀，虽凶无咎；有神制住杀，鬼动也无妨；鬼位休囚，财兴有害；鬼空杀旺，纵乱也成不了；鬼旺杀空，虽凶无害。鬼带劫杀、或化为兄弟，不过是劫财的盗贼；加玄武，是暗中阴私加害的贼；卦中螣蛇、白虎不动，纵有大杀也不急迫；若官鬼和恶杀一起发动，实在是大害；再看生旺克害落在哪个方位，才可决断。
rule.en: A Metal Pressure line carrying a baleful spirit: war breaks out in one quarter; an Earth place meeting ill: weapons and spears everywhere under heaven. If the Great Baleful Spirit stands on a Metal Pressure line that is strong and moving, war is sure to break out; if the Self controls it there is probably no great matter, and if it controls the Self it is surely bad. If an Earth Pressure line carries a baleful spirit and is strong and moving, the four seas are all in chaos, and controlling the Self there will surely be bandits assaulting cities. If the hexagram has a baleful spirit but no Pressure, controlling the Self is also bad; with Pressure but no baleful spirit, though bad it brings no fault; if a spirit restrains the baleful spirit, a moving Pressure line does no harm; if the Pressure place is at rest or trapped, a thriving Wealth line does harm; with Pressure void and the baleful spirit strong, even a revolt does not succeed; with Pressure strong and the baleful spirit void, though bad it does no harm. If Pressure carries the Robbery Killing, or turns into Peer, it is no more than robbers who rob for wealth; if the Dark Tortoise is added, they are secret and covert harming bandits; if the Snake and the Tiger in the hexagram do not move, even with the Great Baleful Spirit it is not urgent; if Pressure and a vicious baleful spirit move together it is truly a great harm; then see in which direction the generation, strength, control and harm fall, and only then can one decide.

If Pressure carries the Robbery Killing, or turns into Peer, it is no more than robbers who rob for wealth;
if the Dark Tortoise is added, they are secret and covert harming bandits.
If the Coiling Snake and the White Tiger in the hexagram do not move, even with the Great Baleful Spirit it is not urgent.
If Pressure and a vicious baleful spirit move together, it is truly a great harm.
Then see in which direction the generation, strength, control and harm fall, and only then can one decide.

title: 以遏寇贼，全凭将帅专征：世为我将、应为彼帅，又以子孙为我将及先锋；子孙得地旺相将军必胜；加青龙为忠良之将、加白虎为勇悍威猛之将；持世虽有鬼无伤、旺相发动决胜千里、日辰扶拱百战百胜；所嫌父母发动不可当其锋，入墓无气虽动无伤

rule.yi: 要遏止寇贼，全靠将帅专意出征。世是我方将领，应是对方统帅；又说子孙是我方将领和先锋。子孙得地、旺相，将军必胜；加青龙，是忠良的将领；加白虎，是勇悍威猛的将领；子孙持世，虽有鬼也无伤害；旺相发动，决胜千里之外；再得日辰扶持拱卫，有百战百胜之功。所嫌的是父母发动，即使有子孙也抵挡不了它的锋芒；若入墓、无气，虽动也无伤。
rule.en: To check bandits and raiders one relies wholly on a commander going out on campaign. The Self is our general and the Other their commander; another saying is that Output is our general and our vanguard. If Output is well placed and strong the general is sure to win; with the Azure Dragon added he is a loyal and good general, with the White Tiger a brave, fierce and mighty one; with Output holding the Self, even if Pressure is present there is no harm; strong and moving, victory is decided a thousand li away; and if the Day supports and gathers round it there is the merit of a hundred battles and a hundred victories. What is disliked is Resource moving, whose edge even Output cannot withstand; if it enters its tomb and has no qi, though it moves it does no harm.

zh: 以遏寇贼，全凭将帅专征；
yi: 要遏止寇贼，全凭将帅专意出征；
en: To check bandits and raiders, one relies wholly on a commander going out on campaign;

hits.text: 以遏寇贼，全凭将帅专征

zh: 又云：以子孙为我将，及先锋。
子孙得地旺相，将军必胜。
若加白虎，乃勇悍威猛之将。
若得持世，虽有鬼亦无伤害；
若得旺相发动，决胜千里。
更日辰扶拱，有百战百胜之功。
yi: 以世为我方的将领，应为对方的统帅。
又说：以子孙为我方的将领以及先锋。
子孙得地、旺相，将军必胜。
如果加青龙，是忠良的将领；
如果加白虎，是勇悍威猛的将领。
如果得以持世，虽然有鬼也没有伤害；
如果得旺相又发动，决胜千里之外。
再得日辰扶持拱卫，有百战百胜的功勋。
所嫌的，是父母发动；
即使有子孙，也抵挡不了它的锋芒。
如果入墓、无气，虽动也无伤。
en: The Self is our general and the Other is their commander.
Another saying: Output is our general and our vanguard.
If Output is well placed and strong, the general is sure to win.
If the Azure Dragon is added, he is a loyal and good general;
if the White Tiger is added, he is a brave, fierce and mighty general.
If it holds the Self, even if Pressure is present there is no harm;
if it is strong and moving, victory is decided a thousand li away.
And if the Day supports and gathers round it, there is the merit of a hundred battles and a hundred victories.
What is disliked is Resource moving;
even with Output one cannot withstand its edge.
If it enters its tomb and has no qi, though it moves it does no harm.

title: 要决输赢，先察世辰相克：专征伐以世为我、应为彼；世克应我胜、应克世彼胜；世墓宜坚壁自守；世旺应入墓彼必折人丁；世空我有难、应空彼有伤；世在阴宫不宜先动、世在阳象不利后兴；世动克应我必进、应动克世他欲来；鬼爻克世他胜我、克应他欲退；鬼持世须防围困；金火持世应两家流血；世应比和皆旺两强敌手；世应相生合将帅有允和之心

rule.yi: 要决定输赢，先看世和日辰相克的情形。专意出征讨伐，以世为我方、应为对方：世克应，我胜；应克世，对方胜；世入墓，只宜坚壁自守，不可妄动；世旺相、应入墓，对方必折损人丁；世空，我方有难；应空，对方有伤；世在阴宫，不宜先动；世在阳象，不利于后发；世动克应，我方必进；应动克世，对方要来攻；官鬼爻克世，对方胜我；官鬼爻克应，对方要退；鬼持世，要防被围困；金、火持世或应，两家流血交战；世、应比和而都旺相，是两强对手，胜败不能立刻定下，只能凭各自的所长来断；世、应相生相合，将帅有答应议和之心，士卒没有攻战之意。
rule.en: To decide victory or defeat, first examine how the Self and the Day control each other. In an expedition of conquest the Self is us and the Other is them: if the Self controls the Other we win, if the Other controls the Self they win; with the Self in its tomb one should only hold the walls firm and guard oneself and not move rashly; with the Self strong and the Other entering its tomb they are sure to lose men; the Self void, we are in difficulty, the Other void, they are wounded; with the Self in a yin palace one should not move first, with the Self in a yang image it is not favourable to rise later; the Self moving and controlling the Other, we are sure to advance, the Other moving and controlling the Self, they mean to come; the Pressure line controlling the Self, they beat us, controlling the Other, they wish to retreat; with Pressure holding the Self guard against being besieged; with Metal or Fire holding the Self or the Other both sides shed blood in the fight; if the Self and the Other are in accord and both strong they are two strong rivals, and victory and defeat cannot yet be decided, so judge only by what each is best at; if the Self and the Other generate and combine, the commanders are minded to agree to peace and the soldiers have no intention to attack.

note.yi: 「先察世辰相克」的「辰」原文没有展开，这里按上下文读作日辰；后面的注文讲的是世应相克。
note.en: The 'chen' of 'first examine the control between the Self and chen' is not expanded in the text and is read from the context as the Day; the commentary that follows speaks of the Self and the Other controlling each other.

zh: 要决输赢，先察世辰相克。
yi: 要决定输赢，先看世与日辰相克的情形。
en: To decide victory or defeat, first examine how the Self and the Day control each other.

hits.text: 要决输赢，先察世辰相克

zh: 凡专征伐：以世为我，应为彼。
世墓，只宜坚壁自守，不可妄动。
若世旺相，应入墓，彼必折人丁。
世空我有难，应空彼有伤。
金火持世应，两家流血交征。
世应比和皆旺相，此两强敌手，胜败未可决，但以所长断之。
世应相生相合，将帅有允和之心，士卒无攻战之意。
yi: 凡是专意出征讨伐：以世为我方，应为对方。
世克应，我胜；
应克世，对方胜。
世入墓，只宜坚壁自守，不可妄动。
如果世旺相、应入墓，对方必折损人丁。
世空，我方有难；应空，对方有伤。
世落在阴宫，不适宜先动手；
世在阳象，不利于后发。
世动克应，我方必进；
应动克世，对方要来攻。
官鬼爻克世，对方胜我；
官鬼爻克应，对方要退。
鬼持世，要防被围困。
金、火持世或应，两家流血交战。
世、应比和而都旺相，这是两强对手，胜败不能立刻定下，只能凭各自的所长来断。
世、应相生相合，将帅有答应议和之心，士卒没有攻战之意。
en: In every expedition of conquest: the Self is us and the Other is them.
If the Self controls the Other, we win;
if the Other controls the Self, they win.
If the Self is in its tomb, one should only hold the walls firm and guard oneself and not move rashly.
If the Self is strong and the Other enters its tomb, they are sure to lose men.
The Self void, we are in difficulty; the Other void, they are wounded.
With the Self in a yin palace one should not move first;
with the Self in a yang image it is not favourable to rise later.
If the Self moves and controls the Other, we are sure to advance;
if the Other moves and controls the Self, they mean to come.
If the Pressure line controls the Self, they beat us;
if the Pressure line controls the Other, they wish to retreat.
With Pressure holding the Self, guard against being besieged.
With Metal or Fire holding the Self or the Other, both sides shed blood in the fight.
If the Self and the Other are in accord and both strong, these are two strong rivals, and victory and defeat cannot yet be decided; judge only by what each is best at.
If the Self and the Other generate and combine, the commanders are minded to agree to peace and the soldiers have no intention to attack.

title: 妻财发动当成易帜之功、兄弟交重须御夺粮之患：父母为旗帜，旺相发动必然兴兵，内动我欲兴兵外动他行军马，克世欲来侵我、克应他必自退；父母不动妻财动当有夺旗易帜之事，财内动克外之父母我夺彼旗、财外动克内之父母彼夺我旗；财为粮草，无财必绝粮、财空粮欲缺、财无气粮不多、财动送粮与贼；兄弟交重须防劫粮夺草

rule.yi: 妻财发动，该成夺旗易帜之功；兄弟交重，要防夺粮的祸患。父母是旗帜，旺相发动必然兴兵：在内卦动，是我方要兴兵；在外卦动，是对方行军出马；克世，是要来侵犯我；克应，是回头的旌旗，对方必自行退兵。父母不动而妻财动，该有夺旗易帜的事：财在内动克外面的父母，我方必夺对方的旌旗；妻财在外动克里面的父母，对方将夺我方的旗旌。财是粮草：卦里没有财必断粮，财空粮食将要缺乏，财无气粮食不多，财动是把粮食送给贼寇；若兄弟交重，要防备劫粮夺草。
rule.en: With Wealth moving, the merit of seizing the banners and changing the standards is to be achieved; with Peer moving heavily, one must guard against the trouble of grain being seized. Resource is the banner; strong and moving it surely means troops are raised: moving inside, we wish to raise troops; moving outside, they send out their army and horses; controlling the Self, they mean to invade us; controlling the Other, it is a banner turned back, and they will surely withdraw of themselves. If Resource does not move and Wealth moves, there will be the seizing of banners and changing of standards: Wealth moving inside and controlling Resource outside, we shall surely seize their banners; Wealth moving outside and controlling Resource inside, they will seize ours. Wealth is the grain and fodder: with no Wealth in the hexagram the grain is sure to be cut off; with Wealth void grain is about to run short; with Wealth lacking qi there is not much grain; with Wealth moving, grain is sent to the enemy; and if Peer moves heavily, guard against the raiding of grain and seizing of fodder.

zh: 妻财发动，当成易帜之功；
兄弟交重，须御夺粮之患。
yi: 妻财发动，该成夺旗易帜的功劳；
兄弟交重，要防抵夺粮的祸患。
en: With Wealth moving, the merit of seizing the banners and changing the standards is to be achieved;
with Peer moving heavily, one must guard against the trouble of grain being seized.

hits.text: 妻财发动，当成易帜之功
兄弟交重，须御夺粮之患

zh: 克应，乃回头之旌帜，他必自退。
yi: 父母是旗帜。
旺相发动，必定兴兵。
如果在内动，是我方要兴兵；
在外动，是对方行军出马。
克世，是要来侵犯我；
克应，是回头的旌旗，对方必定自己退兵。
en: Resource is the banner.
Strong and moving, it surely means troops are raised.
If it moves inside, we wish to raise troops;
if it moves outside, they send out their army and horses.
If it controls the Self, they mean to invade us;
if it controls the Other, it is a banner turned back, and they will surely withdraw of themselves.

zh: 凡父母不动妻财动，当有夺旗易帜之事。
财在内动，克外之父母，我必夺彼之旌旗；
妻财外动，克内之父母，彼将夺我旗旌。
yi: 凡是父母不动、妻财动，该有夺旗易帜的事。
财在内动，克外面的父母，我方必夺对方的旌旗；
妻财在外动，克里面的父母，对方将夺我方的旗旌。
en: Whenever Resource does not move and Wealth moves, there will be the seizing of banners and changing of standards.
If Wealth moves inside and controls Resource outside, we shall surely seize their banners;
if Wealth moves outside and controls Resource inside, they will seize our banners.

zh: 若兄弟交重，须防劫粮夺草。
yi: 财是粮草。
卦里如果没有财，必定断粮；
财空，粮食将要缺乏；
财无气，粮食不多；
财动，是把粮食送给贼寇。
如果兄弟交重，要防备劫粮夺草。
en: Wealth is the grain and fodder.
If the hexagram has no Wealth, the grain is sure to be cut off;
with Wealth void, grain is about to run short;
with Wealth lacking qi, there is not much grain;
with Wealth moving, grain is sent to the enemy.
If Peer moves heavily, guard against the raiding of grain and seizing of fodder.

title: 听轰雷之战鼓，金爻发动逢空；看如雨之炮砖，土位交重逢旺：土为炮石旺相临未上发动方可言，带大杀必遭伤害、遇退神防自损；金空则鸣动处逢冲愈鸣，发动必然金鼓轰雷须防战斗；金爻发动不空亡刀刃森森明似雪，内动我器械备具外动彼兵刃整齐；金爻发动逢刑克兵甲虽坚不损人、金爻无气逢刑克甲胄干戈不整齐

rule.yi: 要听战鼓如轰雷，就看金爻发动逢空；要看炮石砖块如雨，就看土位交重逢旺。土是炮石，要旺相、落在未上发动，才可以这样说；带大杀，必遭伤害；遇退神，要防自损。金空就鸣，发动之处逢冲鸣得更厉害；发动，必然金鼓轰雷，要防战斗。金爻发动而不空亡，刀刃森森明亮如雪；内卦动，我方器械齐备；外卦动，对方兵刃整齐。金爻发动逢刑克，兵甲虽坚却伤不了人；金爻无气又逢刑克，甲胄干戈不整齐。
rule.en: To hear war drums like rolling thunder, look for the Metal line moving and meeting the void; to see cannon stones and bricks like rain, look for the Earth place moving heavily and meeting strength. Earth is the catapult stone, and only when it is strong and moves while standing on Wei can this be said; if it carries the Great Baleful Spirit one is sure to suffer harm; if it meets a Retreating spirit, guard against harming oneself. Metal rings when void, and rings all the more where it moves and meets a clash; if it moves, gongs and drums are sure to thunder, and one must guard against fighting. A Metal line moving and not Void: blades gleam in rows, bright as snow; moving inside, our weapons are fully equipped; moving outside, their blades are in good order. A Metal line moving and meeting punishment or control: the arms and armour, though sturdy, injure no one; a Metal line without qi and meeting punishment or control: helmets, armour and halberds are not in order.

zh: 听轰雷之战鼓，金爻发动逢空；
看如雨之炮砖，土位交重逢旺。
yi: 要听战鼓如轰雷，就看金爻发动逢空；
要看炮石砖块如雨，就看土位交重逢旺。
en: To hear war drums like rolling thunder: the Metal line moving and meeting the void;
to see cannon stones and bricks like rain: the Earth place moving heavily and meeting strength.

hits.text: 听轰雷之战鼓，金爻发动逢空
看如雨之炮砖，土位交重逢旺

zh: 土为炮石，旺相临未上发动，方可言之。
金空则鸣，动处逢冲愈鸣。
若发动，必然金鼓轰雷，须防战斗。
金爻发动不空亡，刀刃森森明似雪。
金爻发动逢刑克，兵甲虽坚不损人；
金爻无气逢刑克，甲胄干戈不整齐。
以上细细搜求，自然有准。
yi: 土是炮石，旺相、落在未上发动，才可以这样说。
如果带大杀，必定遭受伤害；
如果遇到退神，要防自己受损。
金落空就会响，发动之处逢冲则响得更厉害。
如果发动，必然金鼓如轰雷，要防备战斗。
金爻发动而不空亡，刀刃森森，明亮如雪。
在内卦动，我方器械齐备；
在外卦动，对方兵刃整齐。
金爻发动逢刑克，兵甲虽然坚固却伤不了人；
金爻无气又逢刑克，甲胄干戈不整齐。
以上要细细搜求，自然有准。
en: Earth is the catapult stone; only when it is strong and moves while standing on Wei can this be said.
If it carries the Great Baleful Spirit, one is sure to suffer harm;
if it meets a Retreating spirit, guard against harming oneself.
Metal rings when it is void, and rings all the more where it moves and meets a clash.
If it moves, gongs and drums are sure to thunder, and one must guard against fighting.
A Metal line moving and not Void: blades gleam in rows, bright as snow.
Moving in the inner trigram, our weapons are fully equipped;
moving in the outer, their blades are in good order.
A Metal line moving and meeting punishment or control: the arms and armour, though sturdy, injure no one;
a Metal line without qi and meeting punishment or control: helmets, armour and halberds are not in order.
Search through the above in fine detail and it will naturally prove accurate.

title: 木乃济川之舟楫：征战不免登山涉水，无舟船之便五月安可渡泸；以木为舟楫，发动旺相必有济川之利，木爻受冲舟必破漏、受克船车难行；卦无水爻恐无水、木爻逢空必无船、木爻带鬼乃贼船

rule.yi: 木是渡河的舟船桨楫。征战免不了登山涉水，没有舟船的方便，五月怎么能渡泸水？占这件事以木为舟楫：发动、旺相，必有渡河之利；木爻受冲，船必破漏；木爻受克，船车难行；卦里没有水爻，恐怕没有水；木爻逢空，必定没有船；木爻带鬼，是贼船。
rule.en: Wood is the boat and oar for crossing the river. Campaigns cannot avoid climbing mountains and wading rivers, and without boats how could one cross the Lu River in the fifth month? In this divination Wood is the boat and oar: moving and strong, it surely brings the advantage of crossing the river; if the Wood line is clashed the boat is sure to be broken and leaking; if controlled, boats and carts are hard to move; with no Water line in the hexagram there may be no water; a Wood line meeting the void means surely no boat; a Wood line carrying Pressure is a bandits' boat.

note.yi: 「五月渡泸」是诸葛亮五月渡泸水南征的典故，注文没有解释；「舟揖」是「舟楫」之误。
note.en: 'Crossing the Lu in the fifth month' alludes to Zhuge Liang's southern campaign across the Lu River in the fifth month, which the commentary does not explain; the text writes the character for 'to bow' where the character for 'oar' is meant.

yi: 木是渡河的舟船桨楫，
en: Wood is the boat and oar for crossing the river,

zh: 征战不免登山涉水，若无舟船之便，五月安可渡泸？
yi: 征战免不了登山涉水，如果没有舟船的方便，五月里怎么能渡过泸水？
en: Campaigns cannot avoid climbing mountains and wading rivers; without the convenience of boats, how could one cross the Lu River in the fifth month?

zh: 发动旺相，必有济川之利。
卦无水爻恐无水，木爻逢空必无船，木爻带鬼乃贼船。
yi: 凡是占这件事：以木为舟楫。
发动、旺相，必有渡河之利。
木爻受冲，船必破漏；
木爻被克，船和车都难以通行。
卦里没有水爻，恐怕没有水；木爻逢空，必定没有船；木爻带鬼，是贼船。
en: In divining it: Wood is the boat and oar.
Moving and strong, it surely brings the advantage of crossing the river.
If the Wood line is clashed, the boat is sure to be broken and leaking;
if the Wood line is controlled, boats and carts are hard to move.
With no Water line in the hexagram there may be no water; a Wood line meeting the void means surely no boat; a Wood line carrying Pressure is a bandits' boat.

title: 火为系马之军营：凡战于野不免安营下寨，虽处山谷之险亦宜卜其吉凶；以世为主将、火爻为营寨，与世爻相生合其地得利、相克冲不吉；火爻带鬼贼寨必相近；火爻旺相宜宽阔无气宜小结构；苍屏云水爻带鬼来克我须防劫寨攻营，有气无气方断输赢，火爻旺相水无气纵克世亦无伤

rule.yi: 火是系马驻军的营寨。在野外作战免不了安营下寨，即使处在山谷的险要之地，也该占卜它的吉凶。占这件事以世为主将、火爻为营寨：与世爻相生相合，那个地方得利；与世爻相克相冲，不吉；火爻带鬼，贼寇的营寨必定靠近；火爻旺相，宜扎得宽阔；无气，宜小规模结营。苍屏说：水爻带着官鬼来克我，要防劫寨和攻营，再看有气还是无气，才能斟酌说败还是赢；假如火爻旺相、水爻无气，纵然来克世也没有伤害。
rule.en: Fire is the camp where horses are tethered and the army stays. In fighting in the open one cannot avoid pitching camp and setting up a stockade, and even in the peril of mountain valleys one should divine its good or ill fortune. In this divination the Self is the commanding general and the Fire line is the camp: if it generates or combines with the Self line the place is advantageous, and if it controls or clashes with the Self line it is not auspicious; if the Fire line carries Pressure, the bandits' stockade is sure to be near; a strong Fire line suits a broad camp, and without qi a small layout. Cangping says: a Water line carrying Pressure and coming to control me, guard against the raiding of the camp and the assault on the encampment; then see whether there is qi or none, and only then can one weigh and speak of defeat or victory; suppose the Fire line is strong and the Water line has no qi: even if it comes to control the Self there is no harm.

note.yi: 「苍屏云」引的四句，就是阐奥歌国事章（三）里「水爻带鬼来克我……」那一首的原话，两处只差个别字。
note.en: The lines quoted from 'Cangping' are the same as the verse beginning 'a Water line carrying Pressure and coming to control me' in the third song of the Chan'ao Ge chapter on affairs of state, differing only in a few characters.

yi: 火是系马驻军的营寨。
en: Fire is the camp where horses are tethered and the army stays.

zh: 凡战于野，不免安营下寨，虽处山谷之险，亦宜卜其吉凶。
yi: 凡是在野外作战，免不了安营下寨，即使处在山谷的险要之地，也该占卜它的吉凶。
en: In fighting in the open one cannot avoid pitching camp and setting up a stockade, and even in the peril of mountain valleys one should divine its good or ill fortune.

zh: 凡占：以世为主将，火爻为营寨。
与世爻相生相合，其地得利；
火爻若带鬼，贼寨必相近。
火爻旺相宜宽阔，无气，宜小结构。
yi: 凡是占这件事：以世为主将，火爻为营寨。
与世爻相生相合，那个地方得利；
与世爻相克相冲，是不吉利的。
火爻如果带鬼，贼寇的营寨必定靠近。
火爻旺相，宜扎得宽阔；无气，宜小规模结营。
en: In divining it: the Self is the commanding general and the Fire line is the camp.
If it generates or combines with the Self line, the place is advantageous;
if it controls or clashes with the Self line, it is not auspicious.
If the Fire line carries Pressure, the bandits' stockade is sure to be near.
A Fire line that is strong suits a broad camp; without qi, a small layout.

zh: 苍屏云：“水爻带鬼来克我，须防劫寨及攻营，却看有气并无气，方可斟量道败赢”。
假如火爻旺相水无气，纵来克世亦无伤。
yi: 苍屏说：「水爻带着官鬼来克我，要防劫寨和攻营，再看有气还是无气，才能斟酌说败还是赢」。
假如火爻旺相、水爻无气，纵然来克世也没有伤害。
en: Cangping says: 'A Water line carrying Pressure and coming to control me: guard against the raiding of the camp and the assault on the encampment; then see whether there is qi or none, and only then can one weigh and speak of defeat or victory.'
Suppose the Fire line is strong and the Water line has no qi: even if it comes to control the Self there is no harm.

title: 父加虎杀外兴，莫纵军兵来出阵：子孙为我兵卒、官鬼为彼贼徒，子衰兵卒怯鬼旺贼军强，鬼空他必灭子旺我必昌；怕父母带白虎外动必克子孙宜守不宜战；父母持世动主将不能养士卒上下相离，带凶神须防自变；亡神杀正月从亥起顺行

rule.yi: 父母加白虎、杀，在外卦兴起，不要放纵军兵出阵。子孙是我方兵卒，官鬼是对方贼徒：子衰兵卒怯懦，鬼旺贼军强大；鬼空他必覆灭，子旺我必昌盛。怕的是父母带白虎在外卦动，必克子孙，宜守不宜战，战必伤军卒。父母若持世发动，主将不能抚养士卒，上下离散，心里没有相安之道；若带凶神，要防内部生变。亡神杀，正月从亥起顺着排；劫杀见后面。
rule.en: Resource carrying the Tiger and a baleful spirit and rising in the outer trigram: do not let the troops go out to the battle line. Output is our soldiers and Pressure is the enemy's bandits: with Output weak the soldiers are timid, with Pressure strong the enemy army is mighty; with Pressure void they are sure to be destroyed, with Output strong we are sure to prosper. What is feared is Resource carrying the White Tiger and moving outside, which surely controls Output; it is right to defend and not to fight, for fighting surely wounds the troops. If Resource holds the Self and moves, the commanding general cannot nurture his troops, high and low drift apart and hearts have no way to rest easy together; if a baleful spirit is carried, guard against a change from within. The Lost Spirit baleful spirit: begin at Hai in the first month and run forward in order; the Robbery Killing is given later.

title: 鬼带劫亡内动，须防奸细暗临城：鬼带二杀于内动须防奸细在城池之内；若被世克须探事情不至漏泄；世爻无气鬼杀旺军机透漏祸终来；内外鬼爻俱发动克世必有内应外合之患子动必无妨；鬼爻不带杀为害亦不凶

rule.yi: 官鬼带劫杀、亡神在内卦发动，要防奸细暗中混进城来。官鬼带两种杀在内发动，要防城池之内有奸细之人；若被世克，要去探听情况，不至于泄漏；世爻无气而鬼、杀旺，军机泄漏，祸终究要来；内外的鬼爻都发动克世，必有内应外合的祸患，子孙动就一定无妨；鬼爻不带杀，为害也不凶。
rule.en: Pressure carrying the Robbery and Lost-Spirit killings and moving inside: guard against spies secretly entering the city. If Pressure carries the two baleful spirits and moves inside, guard against spies within the city; if it is controlled by the Self, one must scout out the situation so that nothing leaks; if the Self line has no qi and Pressure and the baleful spirits are strong, military secrets leak and in the end disaster comes; if the Pressure lines inside and outside both move and control the Self, there is sure to be the trouble of insiders answering outsiders, and if Output moves it is surely harmless; if the Pressure line carries no baleful spirit its harm is not fierce either.

zh: 鬼带劫亡内动，须防奸细暗临城。
yi: 官鬼带劫杀、亡神在内卦发动，要防奸细暗中混进城来。

title: 若逢暗动伤身，须遇阴谋刺客：鬼爻暗动更加劫杀大杀刑克世爻主将须防刺客；卦内得子孙发动来救刺客必被擒（如燕太子丹使荆轲刺秦王）；日辰冲动伏鬼伤飞爻须防手下有人谋己；卦中无救祸将及身；鬼旺日决见应验

rule.yi: 如果遇到暗动伤身，就要遇上阴谋刺客。凡是鬼爻暗动，又加劫杀、大杀，刑克世爻，主将要防刺客；卦内如果有子孙发动来救，刺客一定被擒，好比燕太子丹派荆轲刺秦王这一类事；如果日辰冲动、伏着的鬼伤了飞爻，要防自己手下有人谋害自己；卦中没有救助，祸将及身；在鬼旺的日子，一定应验。
rule.en: If one meets a hidden stirring that harms the self, one will meet a plotting assassin. Whenever the Pressure line moves in secret, with the Robbery Killing and the Great Baleful Spirit added and punishing or controlling the Self line, the commanding general must guard against assassins; if Output in the hexagram moves to rescue, the assassin is surely caught, like the matter of Crown Prince Dan of Yan sending Jing Ke to stab the King of Qin; if the Day clashes and moves and the hidden Pressure injures the flying line, guard against someone among one's own men plotting against one; if there is no rescue in the hexagram, calamity is about to reach one; on a day when Pressure is strong it will surely be confirmed.

就要遇上阴谋刺客。

one will meet a plotting assassin.

title: 虎蛇皆动，正当离乱之时；世应俱空，宜见升平之乐：大杀动加白虎螣蛇必大乱卒难休息；大杀当胎养长生位乃丧乱发萌之时、在临官帝旺之地正当大乱过此渐息、当墓绝位将次太平；已经历的离乱，要知何年最甚何年稍息依长生法断；六爻无鬼卦无杀世应俱空即太平

rule.yi: 白虎、螣蛇都动，正是离乱的时候；世、应都空，适宜见到升平的安乐。大杀如果发动，加白虎、螣蛇，必是大乱，一时难以平息；大杀落在胎、养、长生的位置上，是丧乱刚刚萌发的时候；在临官、帝旺的地方，正当大乱，过了这个阶段才渐渐平息；落在墓、绝的位置上，将要太平。离乱已经过去的，要知道哪一年最厉害、哪一年稍稍平息，依长生法来断。六爻没有鬼、卦里没有杀，世、应都空，就是太平。
rule.en: With the Tiger and the Snake both moving it is just the time of dispersal and disorder; with the Self and the Other both void it suits seeing the joy of peaceful times. If the Great Baleful Spirit moves and the White Tiger and the Coiling Snake are added, it is surely great disorder, hard to quiet soon; if the Great Baleful Spirit falls on the Embryo, Nurture or Birth stage it is the time when calamity and disorder are just sprouting; if it is at the Office or Peak stage it is just the height of disorder, which then gradually subsides; if it falls on the Tomb or Extinction stage peace is coming. For a disorder already passed, to know in which year it was at its worst and in which it eased a little, judge by the method of the Birth stages. With no Pressure among the six lines and no baleful spirit in the hexagram, and the Self and the Other both void, there is peace.

zh: 虎蛇皆动，正当离乱之时；

title: 国事总则：为国之要必以进忠良、故福爻不可失，必以退奸宄、故鬼象不可动；凡国占皆喜福临而恶鬼动

rule.yi: 占国事，要义是进用忠良、为万民造福，所以福爻（子孙）不能失；要退去奸邪、除去四海的疾患，所以鬼象（官鬼）不能动。凡是占国事，都喜欢福神临到、厌恶官鬼发动，这是占国事的大象。本章细讲迁都、建庙、择后、立储、改制、享国各问。
rule.en: In divining about the state, the essential is to advance the loyal and good and to bring blessing to the myriad people, so the fortune line, Output, must not be lost; one must also remove the treacherous and rid the four seas of their sickness, so the Pressure image must not move. In every divination about the state one is glad to see the fortune spirit arrive and dislikes Pressure moving, and this is the great image of such divinations. The chapter treats in detail the questions of moving the capital, building a temple, choosing an empress, naming an heir, changing the institutions, and how long the dynasty will last.

note.yi: 「福爻」是子孙（福神），「鬼象」是官鬼之象（见术语表）。「奸宄」是奸邪作乱的人。这一章把国事的好坏归在两件事上：福神在不在、官鬼动不动，后面各条是它的展开。
note.en: 'Fuyao', the fortune line, is Output (the fortune spirit), and 'guixiang', the Pressure image, is the image of Pressure (see the glossary). 'Jiangui' are the treacherous who stir up disorder. The chapter puts the good or ill of the state on two things, whether the fortune spirit is present and whether Pressure moves, and the entries that follow unfold this.

zh: 内详迁都、建庙、择后、立储、改制、享国诸问
yi: 本章细讲迁都、建庙、择后、立储、改制、享国各问。
en: This chapter treats in detail the questions of moving the capital, building a temple, choosing an empress, naming an heir, changing the institutions, and how long the dynasty will last.

zh: 为国之要，必以进忠良，为万民之福，故福爻不可失也；
必以退奸宄，去四海之疾，故鬼象不可动也。
yi: 治国的要义，必定是进用忠良，为万民造福，所以福爻不可失；
必定要退去奸邪，除去四海的疾患，所以鬼象不可动。
en: The essential of governing a state is surely to advance the loyal and good and to bring blessing to the myriad people, and so the fortune line, Output, must not be lost;
one must also drive out the treacherous and rid the four seas of their sickness, and so the Pressure image must not move.

zh: 凡国占皆喜福临，而恶鬼动，此其大象也。
yi: 凡是占国事，都喜欢福神临到，厌恶官鬼发动，这是大象。
en: In every divination about the state one is glad to see the fortune spirit arrive and dislikes Pressure moving; this is the great image.

title: 国事：内为邦畿、外为人民，卦宫安旺而国祚长、爻象合和而宗社久；冲莫见于正之、合莫被于破害，则天下和平国家奠安；次观旺衰动静合冲

rule.yi: 内卦是国都和邦畿，外卦是人民；卦宫安稳旺相，国运就长；爻象和合，宗庙社稷就长久。冲不要出现在正卦和之卦（本卦和变卦）里，合不要被破、被害，这样天下就和平，国家就安定了。接着还要再看旺衰、动静、合冲。
rule.en: The inner trigram is the capital and its domain and the outer is the people: if the palace of the hexagram is secure and thriving the dynasty is long, and if the lines combine harmoniously the ancestral temple and altars last long. If clash does not appear in the original or the changed hexagram, and a combination is not broken or harmed, the world is at peace and the state is secure. Next look at strength and weakness, movement and stillness, combination and clash.

note.yi: 「邦畿」是国都周围的王畿之地。「国祚」是国运，「宗社」是宗庙社稷。「正之」是正卦（本卦）和之卦（变卦）；「冲莫见于正之」是本卦、变卦里都不要出现冲（见术语表）。这一条与易林补遗朝廷国事「亲宫为邦国大忌空亡、本卦作朝堂最宜旺相」（EL.02）取同一个象：卦的整体代表国。
note.en: 'Bangji' is the royal domain around the capital. 'Guozuo' is the fortune of the dynasty and 'zongshe' is the ancestral temple and altars. 'Zheng zhi' is the original hexagram and the changed hexagram; 'clash must not appear in the original or the changed hexagram' means that neither is to show a clash (see the glossary). This entry takes the same image as 'the home palace is taken as the state, Void most to be avoided; the original hexagram is taken as the court hall, thriving best' in the Yilin Buyi chapter on court and state affairs (EL.02): the hexagram as a whole stands for the state.

zh: 是以内为邦畿，外为人民，
卦宫安旺而国祚长，爻象合和而宗社久；
冲莫见于正之，合莫被于破害，则天下和平，而国家奠安矣。
yi: 所以内卦是国都邦畿，外卦是人民；
卦宫安稳旺相，国运就长；爻象和合，宗庙社稷就长久；
冲不要出现在正卦、之卦里，合不要被破、被害，这样天下就和平，国家就安定了。
en: So the inner trigram is the capital and its domain and the outer trigram is the people;
if the palace of the hexagram is secure and thriving the dynasty is long, and if the lines combine harmoniously the ancestral temple and altars last long;
if clash does not appear in the original or the changed hexagram, and a combination is not broken or harmed, then the world is at peace and the state is secure.

yi: 接着再看旺衰、动静、合冲。
en: Next look at strength and weakness, movement and stillness, combination and clash.

title: 国事：皇帝亲占以世爻为主象宜临日月生扶、臣下筮国以九五当尊位忌随墓空破；亲占应合世者后德著于樛木，臣占二持福者母仪冠于掖庭

rule.yi: 皇帝亲自占卜，以世爻为主象，适宜得到日月的生扶；臣下为国占卜，以九五爻当作尊位，忌讳随墓、空、破。皇帝亲占而应爻合世的，皇后的德行像樛木那样昭著；臣下占卜而二爻持福神的，皇后的母仪在后宫居首。臣下占卜，以五爻为君、二爻为后，所以这样说。
rule.en: When the emperor divines in person, the Self line is the chief image and it is fitting for the Day and Month to generate and support it; when a minister divines for the state, the ninth-fifth line is the honoured position and following into the tomb, Void and break are to be avoided. If the emperor divines in person and the Other combines with the Self, the empress's virtue shines like that of the drooping tree; if a minister divines and the second line holds the fortune spirit, the empress's model of motherhood heads the harem. A minister divining takes the fifth line as the sovereign and the second as the empress, hence what is said.

note.yi: 「皇陛」疑是「皇帝」。「九五」是第五爻，代表君位。「樛木」是《诗经·周南》里称颂后妃德行（能惠及下人）的篇名；「掖庭」是后宫。「世爻为主象」是皇帝自己占，世就是皇帝本人。这一条与易林补遗「五爻为天子、太岁为朝廷」（EL.80）和黄金策国朝「九五逢阳，当遇仁明之主」（HJC.65）同取五爻为君。
note.en: 'Huangbi' is presumably 'huangdi', emperor. 'Jiuwu', the ninth-fifth, is the fifth line, which stands for the sovereign's position. 'Jiumu', the drooping tree, is the title of an ode in the Book of Odes that praises the virtue of a queen who is gracious to those beneath her; 'yeting' is the inner palace. 'The Self line is the chief image' means that when the emperor divines for himself the Self is the emperor in person. This entry takes the fifth line as the sovereign, as 'the fifth line is the Son of Heaven, Tai Sui is the court' in the Yilin Buyi (EL.80) and 'the ninth-fifth meeting yang, one meets a benevolent and enlightened sovereign' in the Huangjin Ce on the state (HJC.65) do.

zh: 皇陛亲占，以世爻为主象，宜临日月生扶；
臣下筮国，以九五当尊位，忌随墓空破。
亲占而应合世者，后德著于樛木；
臣占而二持福者，母仪冠于掖庭。
yi: 皇帝亲自占卜，以世爻为主象，适宜得到日、月的生扶；
臣下为国占卜，以九五爻当作尊位，忌讳随墓、空、破。
皇帝亲占而应爻合世的，皇后的德行像樛木那样昭著；
臣下占卜而二爻持福神的，皇后的母仪在后宫居首。
en: When the emperor divines in person, the Self line is the chief image, and it is fitting for it to meet generation and support from the Day and Month;
when a minister divines for the state, the ninth-fifth line is the honoured position, and following into the tomb, Void and break are to be avoided.
If the emperor divines in person and the Other combines with the Self, the empress's virtue shines like that of the drooping tree;
if a minister divines and the second line holds the fortune spirit, the empress's model of motherhood heads the harem.

zh: 臣子占五为君，二为后，故云。
yi: 臣下占卜，以五爻为君、二爻为后，所以这样说。
en: A minister divining takes the fifth line as the sovereign and the second as the empress, hence what is said.

title: 国事：初为国本、二为士人、三乃万方之守牧、四为九州之屏藩、上为宗庙之爻，俱恶鬼而喜福、喜安旺而恶动摇；鬼为国之患又为巨寇，福为国之储又为良臣，财为国之赋又为阍寺，兄弟为国之聚敛又为宗支，父母为山川城郭又为诏令

rule.yi: 推爻位：初爻是国本，二爻是士人，三爻是各地的守牧（地方长官），四爻是九州的屏藩，上爻是宗庙之爻；都厌恶官鬼、喜欢福神，喜欢安稳旺相、厌恶动摇。推六亲：官鬼是国家的祸患，又是大盗；福神是国家的储君，又是良臣；妻财是国家的赋税，又是宦官；兄弟是国家的聚敛，又是宗室；父母是山川城郭，又是诏令。看它们临在什么位置、属于哪一宫，比如官鬼发动在乾宫，西北有事；福神临在三爻，地方守牧得人，等等。
rule.en: Reckoning by the line positions: the first line is the root of the state, the second the scholars, the third the governors of all the regions, the fourth the screens and bulwarks of the nine provinces, and the top line the line of the ancestral temple; all dislike Pressure and like the fortune spirit, like quiet and thriving and dislike moving and shaking. Reckoning by the six kin: Pressure is the plague of the state and also a great bandit; Output, the fortune spirit, is the heir of the state and also a good minister; Wealth is the revenue of the state and also the palace gatekeepers; Peer is the state's levying and hoarding and also the imperial clan; Resource is the mountains, rivers and city walls and also the edicts and orders. Look at where they sit and what palace they belong to: for example, if Pressure moves in the Qian palace there is trouble in the north-west, and if the fortune spirit sits on the third line the governors are well chosen, and the like.

note.yi: 「守牧」是地方长官，「屏藩」是拱卫朝廷的藩镇，「阍寺」是守宫门的宦官，「宗支」是皇室宗亲的各支，「聚敛」是征收搜刮，「诏令」是皇帝的诏书命令。这一条的取象与易隐朝廷占的「分官」（YY.43、YY.44）、黄金策国朝的爻位（HJC.65）同一套：初民、二士、三守牧、四公卿、五君、上宗庙。
note.en: 'Shoumu' are the local governors, 'pingfan' are the border governors who guard the court, 'hunshi' are the eunuchs who keep the palace gate, 'zongzhi' are the branches of the imperial clan, 'juilian' is levying and extorting, and 'zhaoling' are the emperor's edicts and orders. The images here are the same set as the 'division of officials' in the Yi Yin divination on the court (YY.43, YY.44) and the line positions in the Huangjin Ce on the state (HJC.65): the first the common people, the second scholars, the third governors, the fourth ministers, the fifth the sovereign, the top the ancestral temple.

zh: 俱恶鬼而喜福，喜安旺而恶动摇。
鬼者，国之患也，又为巨寇；
福者，国之储也，又为良臣；
财者，国之赋也，又为阍寺；
兄弟者，国之聚敛也，又为宗支；
父母者，山川城郭也，又为诏令。
yi: 推爻位：初爻是国本，
二爻是士人，
三爻是各地的守牧（地方长官），
四爻是九州的屏藩，
上爻是宗庙之爻，
都厌恶官鬼、喜欢福神，喜欢安稳旺相、厌恶动摇。
推究六亲：
官鬼是国家的祸患，又是大盗；
福神是国家的储君，又是良臣；
妻财是国家的赋税，又是宦官；
兄弟是国家的聚敛，又是宗室；
父母是山川城郭，又是诏令。
en: Reckoning by the line positions: the first line is the root of the state,
the second the scholars,
the third the governors of all the regions,
the fourth the screens and bulwarks of the nine provinces,
and the top line the line of the ancestral temple;
all dislike Pressure and like the fortune spirit, like quiet and thriving and dislike moving and shaking.
Reckoning by the six kin:
Pressure is the plague of the state and also a great bandit;
Output, the fortune spirit, is the heir of the state and also a good minister;
Wealth is the revenue of the state and also the palace gatekeepers;
Peer is the state's levying and hoarding and also the imperial clan;
Resource is the mountains, rivers and city walls and also the edicts and orders.

zh: 观其所临所属，如鬼动乾宫，西北有事，福临三位，守牧得人之类。
yi: 看它们所临的位置、所属的宫：比如官鬼发动在乾宫，西北有事；福神临在三爻，地方守牧得人，等等。
en: Look at where they sit and what palace they belong to: for example, if Pressure moves in the Qian palace there is trouble in the north-west, and if the fortune spirit sits on the third line the governors are well chosen, and the like.

title: 国事：鬼空内而无内衅、鬼发外而有外攘，近五防佞臣、附三戒酷吏、患在二而士横、患在初而民困；虎官不发于金乡则无干戈、武鬼不扬于水地则无泛潦，火鬼螣蛇岁忧火患、土官朱雀年虑蝗灾；凡鬼发内外何宫何位何属皆宜慎之

rule.yi: 官鬼在内卦落空，就没有内乱；官鬼在外卦发动，就有外患要抵御；官鬼靠近五爻，要防佞臣；依附三爻，要戒酷吏；祸患在二爻，是士人横行；祸患在初爻，是百姓困苦。白虎官如果不在金乡发动，就没有战事；玄武官如果不在水地张扬，就没有水涝；火属官鬼带螣蛇，当年忧火灾；土官带朱雀，当年虑蝗灾。凡是官鬼发动，在内还是在外、哪一宫、哪一位、属于哪一类，都应当谨慎；整饬弊端要防奸邪，朝廷的谋划应当预先。
rule.en: If Pressure is Void in the inner trigram there is no disorder within; if Pressure moves in the outer trigram there are outside enemies to repel; if Pressure is near the fifth line guard against treacherous ministers; if it attaches to the third line beware of cruel officials; if the trouble is on the second line the scholars run riot, and if on the first line the people are in distress. If a White Tiger Pressure does not move in a Metal palace there is no war; if a Dark Tortoise Pressure does not show itself on watery ground there is no flooding; a Fire Pressure with the Coiling Snake means anxiety about fire in the year, and an Earth star of office with the Vermilion Bird means worry about a plague of locusts. Wherever Pressure moves, inside or outside, in which palace, in which position and of which element, one should be careful; in setting right abuses guard against treachery, and the court's planning should be done in advance.

note.yi: 「近五而防佞（？）臣」的「佞」字书里自己标了问号，是传抄者对这个字没有把握；文意是官鬼靠近君位（五爻）要防奸臣，译作「佞臣」。「内衅」是内部的变乱，「外攘」是对外抵御，「干戈」是战事，「泛潦」是水涝，「干蛊」是整饬前人留下的弊端（《易》蛊卦「干父之蛊」）。「金乡」「水地」是金、水所属的宫位。「虎官」「武鬼」是白虎、玄武上的官鬼。「庙算」是朝廷的谋划。
note.en: The book itself puts a question mark after the character 'ning' in 'jin wu er fang ning(?) chen', showing that the copyist was not sure of it; by the sense, Pressure near the sovereign's position (the fifth line) means guarding against treacherous ministers, and it is translated so. 'Neixin' is disorder within, 'waixiang' is repelling enemies from outside, 'gange' is war, 'fanlao' is flooding, and 'gan gu' is setting right the abuses left by one's predecessors (from the Gu hexagram of the Book of Changes, 'setting right the father's decay'). 'Jinxiang' and 'shuidi' are the palaces that Metal and Water belong to. 'Huguan' and 'wugui' are Pressure on the White Tiger and the Dark Tortoise. 'Miaosuan' is the court's planning.

zh: 虎官不发于金乡，则无干戈，
武鬼不扬于水地，则无泛潦；
yi: 官鬼在内卦落空，就没有内乱；
官鬼在外卦发动，就有外患要抵御；
官鬼靠近五爻，要防佞臣；
依附三爻，要戒酷吏；
祸患在二爻，是士人横行；
祸患在初爻，是百姓困苦。
白虎官如果不在金乡发动，就没有战事；
玄武官如果不在水地张扬，就没有水涝；
火属官鬼带螣蛇，当年忧火灾；
土官带朱雀，当年虑蝗灾。
en: If Pressure is Void in the inner trigram there is no disorder within;
if Pressure moves in the outer trigram there are outside enemies to repel;
if Pressure is near the fifth line guard against treacherous ministers;
if it attaches to the third line beware of cruel officials;
if the trouble is on the second line the scholars run riot;
if on the first line the people are in distress.
If a White Tiger Pressure does not move in a Metal palace there is no war;
if a Dark Tortoise Pressure does not show itself on watery ground there is no flooding;
a Fire Pressure with the Coiling Snake means anxiety about fire in the year,
and an Earth star of office with the Vermilion Bird means worry about a plague of locusts.

zh: 凡鬼发内外、何宫、何位、何属，皆宜慎之，干蛊防奸，庙算当豫也。
yi: 凡是官鬼发动，在内还是在外、哪一宫、哪一位、属于哪一类，都应当谨慎；整饬弊端要防奸邪，朝廷的谋划应当预先。
en: Wherever Pressure moves, inside or outside, in which palace, in which position and of which element, one should be careful; in setting right abuses guard against treachery, and the court's planning should be done in advance.

title: 国事：子孙遇木而旺相岁稔桑麻、妻财遇土而兴隆年丰田野、父母值巳午而见当启文明；子在青龙文士彬彬、子临白虎武功烈烈，动朱雀善弹劾之章、摇元武懿宫闱之德，勾陈得田畯之喜、螣蛇籍使臣之力

rule.yi: 子孙遇木而旺相，当年桑麻丰收；妻财遇土而兴隆，当年田野丰收；父母爻值巳、午而出现，当开启文明。子孙在青龙，文士彬彬有礼；子孙临白虎，武功烈烈；动在朱雀，善于弹劾的奏章；摇在玄武，美在宫闱的德行；勾陈得田官的喜庆，螣蛇靠使臣的力量。凡是福神临在五行、六亲、六神上，都是吉祥的应验，所以福神摇在玄武，也是后宫的美事。
rule.en: If Output meets Wood and thrives, the year's mulberry and hemp are plentiful; if Wealth meets Earth and flourishes, the fields yield well in the year; if Resource falls on Si or Wu and appears, civilisation is opened up. If Output is on the Azure Dragon, the scholars are refined; if Output is on the White Tiger, military exploits blaze; moving on the Vermilion Bird, good memorials of impeachment; swaying on the Dark Tortoise, fine virtue in the inner palace; on Hook Earth it enjoys the delight of the field officers, and on the Coiling Snake it relies on the strength of envoys. Wherever the fortune spirit rests, on the five elements, the six kin or the six spirits, it is an auspicious response, so the fortune spirit swaying on the Dark Tortoise is also a fine thing for the inner palace.

note.yi: 「稔」是丰熟。「田畯」是管田事的官（《诗经》里的田官）。「弹劾」是监察官的检举。「宫闱」是后宫。「元武」就是玄武。这一条是福神（子孙）落在五行、六神上的象：木主桑麻，土主田野，青龙文、白虎武、朱雀言官、玄武后宫、勾陈农事、螣蛇使臣。「巳午」是火，「父母值巳午」取的是火为文明。
note.en: 'Ren' is ripening. 'Tianjun' is the official in charge of the fields (the field officer of the Book of Odes). 'Tanhe' is impeachment by the censors. 'Gongwei' is the inner palace. 'Yuanwu' is the Dark Tortoise. This entry gives the images of the fortune spirit (Output) falling on the five elements and the six spirits: Wood governs mulberry and hemp, Earth the fields, the Azure Dragon the civil, the White Tiger the military, the Vermilion Bird the censors, the Dark Tortoise the inner palace, Hook Earth farming, the Coiling Snake envoys. 'Si and Wu' are Fire, and Resource on Si or Wu takes Fire as civilisation.

zh: 子孙遇木而旺相，岁稔桑麻，
妻财遇土而兴隆，年丰田野，
父母值巳午而见，当启文明；
yi: 子孙遇到木而旺相，当年桑麻丰收；
妻财遇到土而兴隆，当年田野丰收；
父母爻值巳、午而出现，当开启文明；
子孙在青龙，就文士彬彬有礼；
子孙临白虎，就武功烈烈；
（子孙）动在朱雀，善于弹劾的奏章；
摇在玄武，美在宫闱的德行；
（福神）在勾陈，得田官的喜庆，
在螣蛇，靠使臣的力量。
en: If Output meets Wood and thrives, the year's mulberry and hemp are plentiful;
if Wealth meets Earth and flourishes, the fields yield well in the year;
if Resource falls on Si or Wu and appears, civilisation is opened up;
if Output is on the Azure Dragon, the scholars are refined;
if Output is on the White Tiger, military exploits blaze;
moving on the Vermilion Bird, good memorials of impeachment;
swaying on the Dark Tortoise, fine virtue in the inner palace;
on Hook Earth it enjoys the delight of the field officers,
and on the Coiling Snake it relies on the strength of envoys.

zh: 凡福临五行六亲六神，俱是祯应，故福摇元武，亦为后宫之美。
yi: 凡是福神临在五行、六亲、六神上，都是吉祥的应验，所以福神摇在玄武，也是后宫的美事。
en: Wherever the fortune spirit rests, on the five elements, the six kin or the six spirits, it is an auspicious response, so the fortune spirit swaying on the Dark Tortoise is also a fine thing for the inner palace.

title: 国事：问迁都犹迁居、当以外旺为凭、鬼兴为忌；问建庙犹奉灵、当以三冲六坏鬼动鬼疾鬼克为忌；迁都建庙皆忌贞冲悔冲合处逢冲，太庙不可破散、太灵不可鬼动鬼空鬼散及鬼克世

rule.yi: 问迁都，如同迁居：以外卦旺相为凭据，官鬼兴旺是忌。问建庙，如同供奉神灵：以三冲、六坏、鬼动、鬼疾、鬼克为忌。迁都、建庙，都忌贞冲、悔冲、合处逢冲这几种情形。六爻是太庙所属，所以不可破散；官鬼是太灵（祖先神灵），所以不可鬼动、鬼空、鬼散，以及鬼克世。
rule.en: For moving the capital, which is like moving house, the outer being thriving is the ground and Pressure flourishing is the taboo; for building a temple, which is like enshrining the spirits, the taboos are the three clashes, the six breakages, and Pressure moving, being sick or controlling. In moving the capital and building a temple, the taboos are the clash of the original hexagram, the clash of the changed hexagram, and a combination meeting a clash. The six lines belong to the great temple, so it must not be broken or scattered; Pressure is the great spirit, so Pressure must not move, be Void or scatter, nor control the Self.

note.yi: 「贞冲」「悔冲」是本卦（贞）、变卦（悔）是六冲卦；「合处逢冲」是本来相合的地方遇到冲；注里列的这三种就是正文的「三冲」（见术语表）。「六坏」书里这一处没有列出。「奉灵」是供奉神灵，「太庙」是帝王的宗庙，「太灵」是祖先的神灵。这一条与易林补遗朝廷国事里的忌六冲（EL.01）取同一类忌：国是一个整体，冲散就是国破。
note.en: 'Zhenchong' and 'huichong' are the original hexagram (zhen) and the changed hexagram (hui) being a six-clash hexagram; 'hechu fengchong' is a place that was a combination meeting a clash; these three listed in the note are the 'three clashes' of the main text (see the glossary). The 'six breakages' are not listed here in the book. 'Fengling' is enshrining the spirits, 'taimiao' is the emperor's ancestral temple, and 'tailing' is the spirits of the ancestors. This entry takes the same kind of taboo as the six-clash in the Yilin Buyi chapter on court and state affairs (EL.01): the state is a whole, and a clash that scatters it is the state broken.

zh: 如问迁都，犹迁居也，当以外旺为凭，鬼兴为忌。
如问建庙，犹奉灵也，当以三冲六坏鬼动鬼疾鬼克为忌。
yi: 如果问迁都，如同迁居，应当以外卦旺相为凭据，官鬼兴旺是忌；
如果问建庙，如同供奉神灵，应当以三冲、六坏、鬼动、鬼疾、鬼克为忌。
en: If one asks about moving the capital, it is like moving house, and the outer being thriving is the ground, with Pressure flourishing a taboo;
if one asks about building a temple, it is like enshrining the spirits, and the taboos are the three clashes, the six breakages, and Pressure moving, being sick or controlling.

zh: 迁都建庙，皆忌贞冲、悔冲、合处逢冲之例。
六爻太庙所属，故不可破散，
鬼为太灵，故不可鬼动、鬼空、鬼散，及鬼克世也。
yi: 迁都、建庙，都忌贞冲、悔冲、合处逢冲这几种情形。
六爻是太庙所属，所以不可破散；
官鬼是太灵（祖先神灵），所以不可鬼动、鬼空、鬼散，以及鬼克世。
en: In moving the capital and building a temple, the taboos are the cases of the clash of the original hexagram, the clash of the changed hexagram, and a combination meeting a clash.
The six lines belong to the great temple, and so it must not be broken or scattered;
Pressure is the great spirit, and so Pressure must not move, be Void or scatter, nor control the Self.

title: 国事：择后犹婚姻、财在何宫当应何所；立储喜子孙跨于日月、改制忧官鬼发于强梁

rule.yi: 选皇后如同婚姻：财爻在哪一宫，就应在哪个地方的女子。如果财在中间的爻，应得晋地的女子；财在内卦，应在本乡。立储君，喜欢子孙跨在日、月上；改制，忧虑官鬼在强横的位置上发动。
rule.en: Choosing an empress is like a marriage: in whichever palace Wealth lies, the match corresponds to that place. If Wealth is in a middle line, the match should be a woman of Jin; if Wealth is in the inner trigram, it should correspond to the home district. In naming an heir one is glad for Output to straddle the Day and Month; in changing the institutions one worries about Pressure moving in the place of the violent and overbearing.

note.yi: 「择后」是选立皇后，「立储」是确立太子，「改制」是改革制度。「中爻」「晋女」书里没有说明，这里照字面译，「晋」疑指晋地。「跨于日月」「发于强梁」书里没有解释，按字面是子孙同时受日、月扶助、官鬼在强横的位置发动。择后看财与婚姻章同（见本书婚姻部分），立储看子孙与易隐朝廷占「青宫：以子孙为用」（YY.38）、黄金策国朝「日辰拱扶子位」（HJC.75）同。
note.en: 'Zehou' is choosing and installing an empress, 'lichu' is establishing the crown prince, and 'gaizhi' is reforming the institutions. The book does not explain 'zhong yao' and 'Jin nü', which are translated literally, and 'Jin' is presumably the land of Jin. 'Kua yu riyue' and 'fa yu qiangliang' are not explained in the book and by the letter are Output being supported by both the Day and Month and Pressure moving in a violent and overbearing place. Choosing an empress looks at Wealth as in the chapter on marriage (see the marriage part of this library), and naming an heir looks at Output as in 'the Crown Prince: take Output as the Subject' in the Yi Yin divination on the court (YY.38) and 'the Day generating and supporting Output's place' in the Huangjin Ce on the state (HJC.75).

zh: 择后犹婚姻也，财在何宫，当应何所。
yi: 选皇后如同婚姻，财爻在哪一宫，就应在哪个地方的女子。
en: Choosing an empress is like a marriage: in whichever palace Wealth lies, the match corresponds to that place.

zh: 如财在中爻，当得晋女，财在内卦，当应本乡。
yi: 如果财在中间的爻，应得晋地的女子；财在内卦，应在本乡。
en: If Wealth is in a middle line, the match should be a woman of Jin; if Wealth is in the inner trigram, it should correspond to the home district.

zh: 立储喜子孙跨于日月，改制忧官鬼发于强梁。
yi: 立储君，喜欢子孙跨在日、月上；改制，忧虑官鬼在强横的位置上发动。
en: In naming an heir one is glad for Output to straddle the Day and Month; in changing the institutions one worries about Pressure moving in the place of the violent and overbearing.

title: 国事：占享国几何以岁为纪，有岁则一位一元、再之亦一位一元，然必考其本宫之旺衰、鬼象之动静方可推而定；岁司年历国祚，如己亥年得丁亥太岁有六元之运，又以内卦参之、鬼动权之方可推

rule.yi: 占国运能延续多久，以太岁为纪年：有太岁就是一位一元，再有也是一位一元；但必须考察本宫的旺衰、官鬼之象的动静，才能推定。太岁管年历国运：比如己亥年，得丁亥太岁，有六元的运数，还要用内卦参看，以官鬼发动来权衡，才可以推。
rule.en: To divine how long the dynasty will last, take the Year as the reckoning: if the Tai Sui is present it is one position, one cycle; with another it is again one position, one cycle; but one must still examine the strength or weakness of the home palace and the movement or stillness of the Pressure image before it can be reckoned and settled. The Year governs the calendar and the dynasty's fortune: for example, in a Jihai year, getting the Dinghai Tai Sui, there is a destiny of six cycles, and one also consults the inner trigram and weighs it by Pressure moving, and only then can it be reckoned.

note.yi: 「享国」是在位、国运延续的年数。「一位一元」「六元之运」书里没有说明怎么算（「元」像是一个计年的单位），这里照字面译，不替它加解释；注里「己亥年」「丁亥太岁」的对应关系书里也没有展开。这一条与易隐朝廷占「卜世卜年」（YY.49）是同一问，但算法不同，不可混用。
note.en: 'Xiangguo' is the number of years a dynasty holds the throne and its fortune lasts. How 'one position, one cycle' and 'a destiny of six cycles' are counted is not explained in the book ('yuan' looks like a unit for counting years), so it is translated literally with no explanation added, and the book does not unfold how the 'Jihai year' and 'Dinghai Tai Sui' of the note correspond. This entry asks the same question as 'counting the reigns and the years' in the Yi Yin divination on the court (YY.49), but the method of counting differs and the two must not be mixed.

zh: 若占享国几何，以岁为纪，有岁则一位一元，再之亦一位一元，然必考其本宫之旺衰、鬼象之动静，方可推而定也。
yi: 如果占国运能延续多久，以太岁为纪年：有太岁就是一位一元，再有也是一位一元；但必须考察本宫的旺衰、官鬼之象的动静，才能推定。
en: To divine how long the dynasty will last, take the Year as the reckoning: if the Tai Sui is present it is one position, one cycle; with another it is again one position, one cycle; but one must still examine the strength or weakness of the home palace and the movement or stillness of the Pressure image before it can be reckoned and settled.

zh: 岁司年历国祚，如己亥年，得丁亥太岁，有六元之运，又以内卦参之，鬼动权之，方可推也。
yi: 太岁管年历国运：比如己亥年，得丁亥太岁，有六元的运数，还要用内卦参看，以官鬼发动来权衡，才可以推。
en: The Year governs the calendar and the dynasty's fortune: for example, in a Jihai year, getting the Dinghai Tai Sui, there is a destiny of six cycles, and one also consults the inner trigram and weighs it by Pressure moving, and only then can it be reckoned.

title: 国事结语：以正得国、以德守国者常，以力得国、以暴守国者不常；天命之矣宁俟筮哉；天授之学者仁知、人授之学者象数，安能以人授之学测天命之微，唯述旧闻以备昭格，占者慎之

rule.yi: 听先贤说过：以正道得国、以德行守国的，国运常久；以武力得国、以暴虐守国的，不能长久。这是天命注定的，哪里还要等占筮？而且天所授的学问是仁与智，人所授的学问是象数，怎么能用人教的学问去测度天命的精微？这里只是转述旧时的见闻，以备昭示之用，占的人要谨慎。
rule.en: I have heard the worthies of old say: those who gain the state by what is right and keep it by virtue endure; those who gain the state by force and keep it by violence do not endure. It is decreed by Heaven, so why wait for the yarrow stalks? Moreover, what Heaven teaches is benevolence and wisdom, and what men teach is images and numbers; how can one use what men have taught to fathom the subtlety of Heaven's decree? I merely relate what was heard of old, to be ready for clear manifestation; let the diviner take care.

note.yi: 这是国事章的结语。作者在这里说：得国守国靠的是德行，天命不是占筮能完全测度的，章中所讲只是转述旧说，占的人要谨慎。「昭格」是明白昭示、神明降临，这里指占卜的显示。「知」同「智」。
note.en: This is the closing of the chapter on state affairs. The author says here that gaining and keeping a state depends on virtue, that Heaven's decree cannot be fully fathomed by divination, that what the chapter says is only the relaying of old views, and that the diviner should take care. 'Zhaoge' is clear manifestation and the descent of the spirits, here meaning what divination reveals. 'Zhi' is the same as 'zhi', wisdom.

zh: 以正得国，以德守国者常；
以力得国，以暴守国者不常。
yi: 听先贤说过：
以正道得到国家、用德行守住国家的，国运常久；
靠武力得国、靠暴虐守国的，不能长久。
这是天命注定的，哪里还要等占筮呢？
en: I have heard the worthies of old say:
those who gain the state by what is right and keep it by virtue endure;
those who gain the state by force and keep it by violence do not endure.
It is decreed by Heaven, so why wait for the yarrow stalks?

zh: 且天授之学者仁知，人授之学者象数，
安能以人授之学，测天命之微？
唯述旧闻，以备昭格，占者慎之。
yi: 而且，天所授的学问是仁与智，人所授的学问是象数；
怎么能用人教的学问，去测度天命的精微？
只是转述旧时的见闻，以备明白昭示之用，占卜的人要谨慎。
en: Moreover, what Heaven teaches is benevolence and wisdom, and what men teach is images and numbers;
how can one use what men have taught to fathom the subtlety of Heaven's decree?
I merely relate what was heard of old, to be ready for clear manifestation; let the diviner take care.

title: 军机总纲：国事莫大于用兵，出师之要先分彼我、专以世应为凭；统论安攘以福鬼而断——世为我应为敌、喜世强而制应，福为兵鬼为寇、宜旺而克官；世克应则胜、应克世则负、比和则胜负相等，世坏虽克应亦曳甲而归、应坏虽克世亦夺旗而返

rule.yi: 国事再大，没有比用兵更大的，古代圣王对它很慎重：是尽人力来应天功，也曾用蓍草来谋划（对外之事）。出师的要点，是先分清彼此，形成主客，专以世应为凭据。统论安内攘外，就用福神和官鬼来断：世是我、应是敌，喜欢世强而制住应；福是兵、鬼是寇，宜福旺而克住官鬼，朝廷谋划的胜负在这里就看得出来了。兵占先看世应：世克应就胜，应克世就负，世应比和就胜负相等；世生应的，我方怯弱；应生世的，对方退让。再看子孙是我的兵，旺相发动就勇往直前，休囚空破就不能奋进；官鬼是对方的贼寇，旺相就强横，休囚就溃散。如果世坏，即使克应、动子孙，也只能抛甲而归；如果应坏，即使克世、动官鬼，也夺旗而返。
rule.en: Of all affairs of state none is greater than the use of troops, and the sage kings of old were careful about it: one exhausts what men can do to answer Heaven's work, and has also consulted the stalks when planning matters outside. The essential in sending out troops is first to distinguish them from us, to form host and guest, and to rely wholly on the Self and the Other. In judging both pacification and repelling, decide by Output and Pressure: the Self is me and the Other is the enemy, and one is glad for the Self to be strong and to control the Other; Output is the troops and Pressure is the bandits, and it is fitting for Output to be thriving and to control Pressure, and the court's planning of victory and defeat is seen in this. In divining about the army, first look at the Self and the Other: if the Self controls the Other one wins, if the Other controls the Self one loses, and if the Self and the Other are in accord, victory and defeat are even; if the Self generates the Other, my side is timid; if the Other generates the Self, the other side gives way. Then look at Output as my troops: if thriving and moving they press bravely forward, if resting, imprisoned, Void or broken they cannot press on; Pressure is the other side's bandits: if thriving they are violent and overbearing, if resting or imprisoned they are routed. If the Self is damaged, even if one controls the Other and moves Output one can only drag one's armour and come home; if the Other is damaged, even if it controls the Self and one moves Pressure, one still seizes their banner and returns.

note.yi: 「安攘」是安内攘外。「作外」是处理对外的事。「庙算」是朝廷的谋划。「胜岁等」疑是「胜负等」；「休囚空破则不摒（？）」的「摒」字书里自己标了问号，疑是「不振」，按文意译作「不能奋进」。「曵甲」是拖着甲胄，形容败退。这一条与易林补遗出师征伐「世应」一组（EL.12 起）、易隐征战占「彼己」（YY.54）、黄金策「观世应之旺衰」（HJC.86）取同一套：世是我、应是彼、子孙是兵、官鬼是敌。
note.en: 'Anrang' is pacifying within and repelling without. 'Zuo wai' is handling external affairs. 'Miaosuan' is the court's planning. 'Sheng sui deng' is presumably 'sheng fu deng', victory and defeat even; the 'bing' of 'xiuqiu kong po ze bu bing(?)' carries a question mark in the book itself and is presumably 'zhen', and by the sense it is translated 'cannot press on'. 'Yejia' is dragging one's armour, describing a retreat in defeat. This entry takes the same set as the Self and Other group in the Yilin Buyi on sending out troops (from EL.12), the 'we and they' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.54), and 'watch the strength of the Self and the Other' in the Huangjin Ce (HJC.86): the Self is me, the Other is the enemy, Output is the troops and Pressure is the enemy.

zh: 内详立营、攻守、水陆迟速、遣将用计、拜将、用间，问守、问战、问款、问降时日，防守、防刺、行刺、内应、火攻、因粮讨战沿剿，求援、求济、救援、守城、敌来被困等问
yi: 本章细讲立营、攻守、水陆迟速、遣将用计、拜将、用间，问守、问战、问款、问降的时日，防守、防刺、行刺、内应、火攻、因粮讨战沿剿，求援、求济、救援、守城、敌来被困等问。
en: This chapter treats in detail setting up camp, attack and defence, the speed of land and water movement, sending out commanders and using stratagems, appointing a general, using spies, the times for asking about defence, battle, truce and surrender, defence, guarding against assassins, carrying out assassination, inside collaborators, attack by fire, taking provisions and fighting along the way, asking for relief and aid, rescue, defending a city, and the enemy coming and one being besieged.

zh: 国事之大，莫大于用兵，古圣王慎之，盖尽人力以应天功，亦尝谋于蓍而作外也。
出师之要，先分彼我，形成主客，专以世应为凭。
统论安攘，则以福鬼而断，世为我，应为敌，喜世强而制应；
福为兵，鬼为寇，宜于旺而克官，庙算胜负于是见矣。
yi: 国事再大，没有比用兵更大的，古代圣王对它很慎重：是尽人力来应天功，也曾用蓍草来谋划对外之事。
出师的要点，先分清彼此，形成主客，专以世应为凭据。
统论安内攘外，就用福神和官鬼来断：世是我，应是敌，喜欢世强而制住应；
福是兵，鬼是寇，宜福旺而克住官鬼，朝廷谋划的胜负在这里就看得出来了。
en: Of all affairs of state none is greater than the use of troops, and the sage kings of old were careful about it: one exhausts what men can do to answer Heaven's work, and has also consulted the stalks when planning matters outside.
The essential in sending out troops is first to distinguish them from us, to form host and guest, and to rely wholly on the Self and the Other.
In judging both pacification and repelling, decide by Output and Pressure: the Self is me and the Other is the enemy, and one is glad for the Self to be strong and to control the Other;
Output is the troops and Pressure is the bandits, and it is fitting for Output to be thriving and to control Pressure, and the court's planning of victory and defeat is seen in this.

zh: 兵占先观世应，世克应则胜，应克世则负，世应比和则胜岁等；
世生应者我怯，应生世者彼让。
复考子孙为我兵，旺相发动则勇往，休囚空破则不摒（？）；
鬼为彼贼，旺相强梁，休囚披靡。
如世坏，虽克应动子孙，亦曵甲而归；
若应坏，虽克世动官鬼，亦夺旗而返。
yi: 兵占先看世应：世克应就胜，应克世就负，世应比和就胜负相等；
世生应的，我方怯弱；应生世的，对方退让。
再看子孙是我的兵，旺相发动就勇往直前，休囚空破就不能奋进；
官鬼是对方的贼寇，旺相就强横，休囚就溃散。
如果世坏，即使克应、动子孙，也只能抛甲而归；
如果应坏，即使克世、动官鬼，也夺旗而返。
en: In divining about the army, first look at the Self and the Other: if the Self controls the Other one wins, if the Other controls the Self one loses, and if the Self and the Other are in accord, victory and defeat are even;
if the Self generates the Other, my side is timid; if the Other generates the Self, the other side gives way.
Then look at Output as my troops: if thriving and moving they press bravely forward, if resting, imprisoned, Void or broken they cannot press on;
Pressure is the other side's bandits: if thriving they are violent and overbearing, if resting or imprisoned they are routed.
If the Self is damaged, even if one controls the Other and moves Output one can only drag one's armour and come home;
if the Other is damaged, even if it controls the Self and one moves Pressure, one still seizes their banner and returns.

title: 军机：问立营下寨安危凭鬼，内外毋墓绝反伏空破犯则麾幕不安、两象毋冲击犯则将士离心不可次舍；筮兵次舍最忌鬼摇恐为敌人劫掠、最恶内卦犯疾及六冲上下乖离

rule.yi: 问立营下寨，安危凭官鬼来断：内外卦不要入墓、绝、反吟、伏吟、空、破，犯了就军帐不安；内外两象不要冲击，犯了就将士离心，不可驻扎。占兵驻扎，最忌官鬼发动，恐怕被敌人劫掠；最厌内卦犯疾，以及六冲，上下乖离。
rule.en: In asking about setting up camp, safety or danger is judged by Pressure: the inner and outer must not meet tomb, extinction, Reversed Chant, Hidden Chant, Void or break, for if they do the commander's tent is uneasy; the two images must not clash, for if they do officers and men are at odds and the troops cannot be quartered. In divining about the quartering of troops, Pressure moving is most to be avoided, for fear of raiding by the enemy, and what is most disliked is the inner trigram being sick, and a six-clash, with high and low estranged.

note.yi: 「麾幕」是主帅的军帐。「墓绝反伏空破」里的「反伏」是反吟、伏吟（见术语表）。「次舍」是军队驻扎。「内卦犯疾」是内卦带病（旺衰上有伤），书里没有细说。
note.en: 'Huimu' is the commander's tent. The 'fanfu' of 'mu jue fan fu kong po' is Reversed Chant and Hidden Chant (see the glossary). 'Cishe' is the quartering of an army. 'The inner trigram being sick' is the inner trigram being ill (damaged in strength), which the book does not go into.

zh: 如问立营下寨，安危凭鬼，
而内外毋墓绝反伏空破，犯则麾幕不安；
两象毋冲击，犯则将士离心，不可次舍。
yi: 如果问立营下寨，安危凭官鬼来断，
而内外卦不要入墓、绝、反吟、伏吟、空、破，犯了就军帐不安；
内外两象不要冲击，犯了就将士离心，不可驻扎。
en: If one asks about setting up camp, safety or danger is judged by Pressure,
and the inner and outer must not meet tomb, extinction, Reversed Chant, Hidden Chant, Void or break, for if they do the commander's tent is uneasy;
the two images must not clash, for if they do officers and men are at odds and the troops cannot be quartered.

zh: 筮兵次舍，最忌鬼摇，恐为敌人劫掠。
最恶内卦犯疾，及六冲，上下乖离。
yi: 占兵驻扎，最忌官鬼发动，恐怕被敌人劫掠；
最厌内卦犯疾，以及六冲，上下乖离。
en: In divining about the quartering of troops, Pressure moving is most to be avoided, for fear of raiding by the enemy;
what is most disliked is the inner trigram being sick, and a six-clash, with high and low estranged.

title: 军机：问城攻守、兵行水陆、战利迟速、遣将用计皆以世应占之，朝廷拜将及择人用间乃三军大任必仁勇达变当以宾应辨；六占皆论胜负忌世坏及应克世、随官入墓助鬼伤身主覆军之败，用间类于嘱托应爻空破散绝则机谋泄漏、应爻克冲世位乃反奸之徒

rule.yi: 问攻守城池、兵走水路还是陆路、作战的利钝快慢，以及遣将用计，志在必胜，都以世应来占。如果朝廷拜将，以及选人用间，这是三军的大任，必须仁、勇、通达应变，应当用宾位的应来辨别。以上六种占问，都是论胜负，只忌世坏和应克世，而随官入墓、助鬼伤身，主有覆军的失败。只有用间不同，类似嘱托：应爻空、破、散、绝，机谋就泄漏；应爻克冲世位，就是反间叛奸的人。君王用蓍草任命将领，也像用间的办法。古来用兵，没有比求将更大的，没有比用间更难的：或者内部结为骨肉，或者情谊兼有师友，所以用宾位的应。
rule.en: In asking about attacking or defending a city, whether the troops go by water or land, the speed and advantage of a battle, and sending out commanders and using stratagems, with the aim of certain victory, all are divined by the Self and the Other. If the court appoints a general, or a man is chosen to act as a spy, this is the great charge of the three armies, and he must be benevolent, brave and flexible; it should be judged by the Other, the guest's position. In these six kinds of question, victory and defeat are discussed, and only the Self being damaged and the Other controlling the Self are feared, while following the star of office into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body mean the defeat of the army. Only using spies is different, being like entrusting a task: if the Other is Void, broken, scattered or extinct, the scheme leaks out; if the Other clashes with or controls the Self's place, he is a man who turns traitor. When the sovereign appoints a general by the stalks, it is also like the method of using spies. In the use of troops of old, nothing was greater than seeking a general and nothing harder than using spies: either one binds them as kin from within, or the feeling is that of teacher and friend, and so the Other, the guest's position, is used.

note.yi: 「宾应」是应爻，在这里它是被用的将、被用的间，处在宾的位置。「用间」是派间谍、离间敌人。「君蓍任将」是君王用占筮来选将。「随官入墓、助鬼伤身」见增删卜易对它们的另一说法（ZS.06）；这里是军事占，取凶。这一条与易林补遗出师征伐里「用间」「择将」的取法（EL.12 起）和黄金策「将福官之强弱」（HJC.86）取同一类象。
note.en: 'Bin ying', the guest Other, is the Other line, which here is the general or spy who is employed, in the guest's position. 'Yongjian' is sending spies and sowing dissension in the enemy. 'Jun shi ren jiang' is the sovereign choosing a general by divination. 'Following the star of office into the tomb' and 'helping Pressure to injure the Body' have another account in the Zengshan Buyi (ZS.06); here, in a military divination, they are taken as ominous. This entry takes the same kind of images as the choosing of generals and use of spies in the Yilin Buyi on sending out troops (from EL.12) and 'weigh the strength of Output and the star of office' in the Huangjin Ce (HJC.86).

zh: 问城攻守，兵行水陆，战利迟速，及遣将用计，意在必胜，皆以世应占之。
若朝廷拜将，及择人用间者，乃三军之大任，必仁勇达变，当以宾应辨也。
yi: 问攻守城池、兵走水路还是陆路、作战的利钝快慢，以及遣将用计，志在必胜，都以世应来占。
如果朝廷拜将，以及选人用间，这是三军的大任，必须仁、勇、通达应变，应当用宾位的应来辨别。
en: In asking about attacking or defending a city, whether the troops go by water or land, the speed and advantage of a battle, and sending out commanders and using stratagems, with the aim of certain victory, all are divined by the Self and the Other.

If the court appoints a general, or a man is chosen to act as a spy, this is the great charge of the three armies, and he must be benevolent, brave and flexible; it should be judged by the Other, the guest's position.

zh: 六占皆论胜负，惟忌世坏及应克世，而随官入墓、助鬼伤身，主有覆军之败。
惟用间不同，类于嘱托，应爻空破散绝，机谋泄漏；应爻克冲世位，乃反奸之徒。
君蓍任将，亦如用间之法。
盖古之用兵，莫大于求将，莫难于用间，或内结骨肉，或谊兼师友，故用宾应也。
yi: 以上六种占问，都是论胜负，只忌世坏和应克世，而随官入墓、助鬼伤身，主有覆军的失败。
只有用间不同，类似嘱托：应爻空、破、散、绝，机谋就泄漏；应爻克冲世位，就是反间叛奸的人。
君王用蓍草任命将领，也像用间的办法。
古来用兵，没有比求将更大的，没有比用间更难的：或者内部结为骨肉，或者情谊兼有师友，所以用宾位的应。
en: In these six kinds of question, victory and defeat are discussed, and only the Self being damaged and the Other controlling the Self are feared, while following the star of office into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body mean the defeat of the army.

Only using spies is different, being like entrusting a task: if the Other is Void, broken, scattered or extinct, the scheme leaks out; if the Other clashes with or controls the Self's place, he is a man who turns traitor.
When the sovereign appoints a general by the stalks, it is also like the method of using spies.

In the use of troops of old, nothing was greater than seeking a general and nothing harder than using spies: either one binds them as kin from within, or the feeling is that of teacher and friend, and so the Other, the guest's position, is used.

title: 军机：问守问战以胜负分彼我、问款问降以忠奸察应爻，时日利战得时而我利、防守无虞鬼动而来侵、应克世为蚕食；得应坏世克应则成百战百胜之功、世坏应克世则忍三战三怯之耻，敌降于己己款于敌皆察应爻真伪忌应克世，卜日时如秋时用兵则利金爻持世、亥日出师则利火爻属应

rule.yi: 问守、问战，要以胜负分清彼此；问款（议和）、问降，要以忠奸来察看应爻。时日利于战，得时就对我有利；防守没有忧虑，官鬼一动就有来侵犯的。应克世是蚕食。得到应坏、世克应，就成百战百胜的功劳；世坏、应克世，就要忍受三战三怯的耻辱。敌人降于我，或我向敌人议和，都要察看应爻的真假，忌讳应克世。如果是卜日时的占：比如秋天用兵，就利于金爻持世；亥日出师，就利于火爻属应。
rule.en: In asking about defence and about battle, distinguish the two sides by victory and defeat; in asking about truce and surrender, examine the Other line by loyalty or treachery. If the day and hour favour battle, getting the right time benefits me; if defence is free from worry, Pressure moving means an invader is coming; the Other controlling the Self is nibbling away like a silkworm. If the Other is broken and the Self controls the Other, the merit of a hundred battles and a hundred victories is accomplished; if the Self is damaged and the Other controls the Self, one must bear the shame of three battles and three times of cowardice. When an enemy surrenders to me, or I seek a truce with an enemy, in both cases one examines whether the Other is true or false, and the Other controlling the Self is taboo. In divining the day and hour, for example if one uses troops in autumn it is favourable for a Metal line to hold the Self, and if one sends out the army on a Hai day it is favourable for a Fire line to belong to the Other.

note.yi: 「款」是议和、投诚。「蚕食」是一点一点吞掉。「三战三怯」是屡战屡怯（《史记》里曹沫三战三北的意思）。「秋时用兵利金爻持世」是秋属金，「亥日出师利火爻属应」是亥属水、水克火，火属应就是对方属火而被克，书里没有解释这一层，按五行读出来的。这一条与易隐征战占「方向」（YY.53）、黄金策「观世应之旺衰」（HJC.86）取同一个关系：世克应胜、应克世负。
note.en: 'Kuan' is seeking peace and offering submission. 'Cansi' is eating away bit by bit like a silkworm. 'Three battles and three times of cowardice' is being timid again and again in battle (in the sense of Cao Mo's three defeats in the Shiji). That 'in autumn a Metal line holding the Self is favourable' is because autumn belongs to Metal; 'on a Hai day a Fire line belonging to the Other is favourable' is because Hai is Water and Water controls Fire, so with Fire on the Other the other side is of Fire and is controlled; the book does not explain this layer, and it is read by the five elements. This entry takes the same relation as the 'direction' section of the Yi Yin war divination (YY.53) and 'watch the strength of the Self and the Other' in the Huangjin Ce (HJC.86): the Self controlling the Other wins, the Other controlling the Self loses.

zh: 问守问战，当以胜负分彼我；
问款问降，当以忠奸察应爻。
防守无虞，鬼动而来侵。应克世为蚕食也。
yi: 问守、问战，要以胜负分清彼此；
问款、问降，要以忠奸来察看应爻。
时日利于战，得时就对我有利；
防守没有忧虑，官鬼一动就有来侵犯的。应克世是蚕食。
en: In asking about defence and about battle, distinguish the two sides by victory and defeat;
in asking about truce and surrender, examine the Other line by loyalty or treachery.
If the day and hour favour battle, getting the right time benefits me;
if defence is free from worry, Pressure moving means an invader is coming; the Other controlling the Self is nibbling away like a silkworm.

zh: 得应坏世克应，则成百战百胜之功，世坏应克世，则忍三战三怯之耻。
敌降于己，己款于敌，皆察应爻真伪，忌应克世。
若卜日时之占，如用兵于秋时，则利金爻持世，出师于亥日，则利火爻属应也。
yi: 得到应坏、世克应，就成百战百胜的功劳；世坏、应克世，就要忍受三战三怯的耻辱。
敌人降于我，或我向敌人议和，都要察看应爻的真假，忌讳应克世。
如果是卜日时的占：比如秋天用兵，就利于金爻持世；亥日出师，就利于火爻属应。
en: If the Other is broken and the Self controls the Other, the merit of a hundred battles and a hundred victories is accomplished; if the Self is damaged and the Other controls the Self, one must bear the shame of three battles and three times of cowardice.
When an enemy surrenders to me, or I seek a truce with an enemy, in both cases one examines whether the Other is true or false, and the Other controlling the Self is taboo.

In divining the day and hour, for example if one uses troops in autumn it is favourable for a Metal line to hold the Self, and if one sends out the army on a Hai day it is favourable for a Fire line to belong to the Other.

title: 军机：防刺以鬼为刺客恶其动、行刺以应为所刺好其疾；若随墓助伤防刺大凶、鬼动鬼克世亦凶惟空破为吉，行刺应坏敌人数尽可以得志，或世坏随墓助伤敌人虽灭我亦随亡，或鬼兴而世旺敌虽刺我我数未终，吉内藏凶凶中有吉辨之

rule.yi: 防备刺客，以官鬼为刺客，厌恶它发动；去行刺，以应为被刺的人，喜欢它有疾（坏）。如果随墓、助伤，防刺就大凶；官鬼动、官鬼克世也凶，只有空、破才是吉。行刺时应坏，敌人命数尽了，可以得志；或者世坏、随墓助伤，敌人虽然灭了，我也跟着亡；或者官鬼兴旺而世旺，敌人虽然来刺我，我的命数还没有终结。吉里藏着凶，凶中有吉，要分辨。
rule.en: In guarding against assassins, Pressure is the assassin and its moving is disliked; in carrying out an assassination, the Other is the man to be stabbed and it is liked to be sick. If one follows into the tomb or helps Pressure to injure, guarding against an assassin is greatly ominous; Pressure moving, or Pressure controlling the Self, is also ominous, and only Void or break is auspicious. In carrying out an assassination, if the Other is damaged the enemy's number is used up and one can achieve one's aim; or if the Self is damaged and follows into the tomb or helps Pressure to injure, although the enemy is wiped out, I too die with him; or if Pressure flourishes and the Self is thriving, although the enemy strikes at me my number is not yet at its end. Ill lies hidden within good, and good within ill, so one must tell them apart.

note.yi: 「刺」「剌」在书里混用，都是行刺。「数」是命数、气数。「防刺」是防备被刺，「行刺」是我方去刺敌。这一条与易隐征战占「鬼暗动加大杀劫杀刑刃克世防刺客，遇福动必擒」（YY.56）取同一类象：官鬼暗动克世是刺客来；福神动能擒拿。
note.en: 'Ci' and 'la' are used interchangeably in the book, both meaning assassination. 'Shu' is one's allotted number, one's allotted span. 'Fang ci' is guarding against being stabbed, and 'xing ci' is my side going to stab the enemy. This entry takes the same kind of image as 'if Pressure moves hidden with great baleful spirits, Robbery and the blade controlling the Self, guard against an assassin, and if Output moves he is surely seized' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.56): Pressure moving in the dark and controlling the Self is the assassin coming, and Output moving can seize him.

zh: 防刺鬼为刺客也，恶其动；
行剌应为所剌也，好其疾。
yi: 防备刺客，以官鬼为刺客，厌恶它发动；
去行刺，以应为被刺的人，喜欢它有疾（坏）。
en: In guarding against assassins, Pressure is the assassin and its moving is disliked;
in carrying out an assassination, the Other is the man to be stabbed and it is liked to be sick.

zh: 若随墓助伤，防剌大凶，鬼动鬼克世亦凶，惟空破为吉。
行剌应坏敌人数尽，可以得志，或世坏随墓助伤，敌人虽灭，我亦随亡，或鬼兴而世旺，敌虽剌我，我数未终也。
吉内藏凶，凶中有吉，辨之。
yi: 如果随墓、助伤，防刺就大凶；官鬼动、官鬼克世也凶，只有空、破才是吉。
行刺时应坏，敌人命数尽了，可以得志；或者世坏、随墓助伤，敌人虽然灭了，我也跟着亡；或者官鬼兴旺而世旺，敌人虽然来刺我，我的命数还没有终结。
吉里藏着凶，凶中有吉，要分辨。
en: If one follows into the tomb or helps Pressure to injure, guarding against an assassin is greatly ominous; Pressure moving, or Pressure controlling the Self, is also ominous, and only Void or break is auspicious.

In carrying out an assassination, if the Other is damaged the enemy's number is used up and one can achieve one's aim; or if the Self is damaged and follows into the tomb or helps Pressure to injure, although the enemy is wiped out, I too die with him; or if Pressure flourishes and the Self is thriving, although the enemy strikes at me my number is not yet at its end.
Ill lies hidden within good, and good within ill, so one must tell them apart.

title: 军机：用应如用间、用火如用计、鬼动则谋败；因粮于敌截饷于途、财旺则计得；内应可任法如用间但不可鬼动则功未成而先败，用火法如用计务在胜负然水火为民害之大者亦忌鬼动或谋泄流祸

rule.yi: 用内应，如同用间；用火攻，如同用计；官鬼一动，谋划就败了。取粮于敌、截敌军粮饷于途中，财爻旺相，计谋就得手。内应可以委任，办法如同用间，只是不可官鬼发动，发动就功劳未成而先败；用火的办法如同用计，务求取胜，但水、火是百姓最大的祸害，也忌官鬼发动，否则谋划泄漏、祸患流布。
rule.en: Using an inside collaborator is like using a spy, and using fire is like using a stratagem; if Pressure moves, the scheme fails. In taking provisions from the enemy and intercepting the pay and grain on the road, if Wealth is thriving the plan succeeds. An inside collaborator can be appointed, and the method is like that of using spies, but Pressure must not move, for if it does the merit is not yet won and one is first defeated; the method of using fire is like that of a stratagem, and one must aim at victory, but water and fire are the greatest harms to the people, and Pressure moving is also to be avoided, otherwise the scheme leaks out and calamity spreads.

note.yi: 「应」在这里是内应（敌方内部接应我们的人）。「因粮」是就地取粮，「截饷」是中途截取敌人的粮饷。「用火如用计」是火攻要有周密的计谋。「水火为民害之大者」是水淹、火攻会连累百姓。书里这一条用的是同一个官鬼动忌：谋密则成，鬼动则泄。
note.en: 'Ying' here is the inside collaborator (a man inside the enemy camp who responds to us). 'Yinliang' is taking grain on the spot, and 'jiexiang' is intercepting the enemy's pay and grain on the way. 'Using fire is like using a stratagem' is that an attack by fire needs a careful stratagem. 'Water and fire are the greatest harms to the people' is that flooding and attack by fire fall on the common people. This entry uses the same taboo of Pressure moving: if the plan is secret it succeeds, and if Pressure moves it leaks.

zh: 用应如用间，用火如用计，鬼动则谋败焉。
因粮于敌，截饷于途，财旺则计得焉。
yi: 用内应如同用间，用火攻如同用计，官鬼一动，谋划就败了。
取粮于敌、截敌军粮饷于途中，财爻旺相，计谋就得手。
en: Using an inside collaborator is like using a spy, and using fire is like using a stratagem; if Pressure moves, the scheme fails.
In taking provisions from the enemy and intercepting the pay and grain on the road, if Wealth is thriving the plan succeeds.

zh: 内应可任，法如用间，但不可鬼动，则功未成而先败；
用火法如用计，务在胜负，然水火为民害之大者，亦忌鬼动，或谋泄流祸。
yi: 内应可以委任，办法如同用间，只是不可官鬼发动，发动就功劳未成而先败；
用火的办法如同用计，务求取胜，但水、火是百姓最大的祸害，也忌官鬼发动，否则谋划泄漏、祸患流布。
en: An inside collaborator can be appointed, and the method is like that of using spies, but Pressure must not move, for if it does the merit is not yet won and one is first defeated;

the method of using fire is like that of a stratagem, and one must aim at victory, but water and fire are the greatest harms to the people, and Pressure moving is also to be avoided, otherwise the scheme leaks out and calamity spreads.

title: 军机：寇有地而用应、寇无地而用鬼；两军对迎法世应之克生、四野剿除度鬼福之强弱；若据城郭成两军之势则考世应生克虚实以为胜负，如流寇无定必四向剿灭则论福鬼强弱

rule.yi: 敌寇有据点的，用应来看；敌寇没有据点的，用官鬼来看。所以两军对阵，按世应的相克相生来断；四野围剿，则衡量官鬼和福神的强弱。如果敌人占据城郭，形成两军对阵之势，就考察世应的生克虚实来断胜负；如果是流窜无定的流寇，必须四面围剿消灭，就论福神与官鬼的强弱。
rule.en: If the bandits hold a base, look at the Other; if they have no base, look at Pressure. So when two armies face each other, follow the generation and control of the Self and the Other; when the countryside is being swept clean on all sides, weigh the strength of Pressure and Output. If the enemy holds a walled city and forms the posture of two armies, examine the generation, control, emptiness and fullness of the Self and the Other to decide victory and defeat; if they are roving bandits with no fixed place and must be wiped out from all four directions, then discuss the strength of Output and Pressure.

note.yi: 「寇有地」是有城郭、据点的敌人，「流寇」是到处流窜没有固定地盘的敌人。「福鬼」是福神（子孙）和官鬼。这一条与黄金策征战「世持子而被伤」「应临官而遭克」（HJC.93、HJC.94）取不同的看法：那里是看世应，这里按敌人有没有据点，分用世应、福鬼。
note.en: 'Kou you di' is an enemy that has a walled city or a base, and 'liukou' are roving bandits with no fixed ground. 'Fugui' is the fortune spirit (Output) and Pressure. This entry takes a different view from 'if the Self holds Output but is injured' and 'if the Other rests on the star of office and is controlled' in the Huangjin Ce on campaigns (HJC.93, HJC.94): there the Self and the Other are looked at, and here one uses the Self and the Other or Output and Pressure according to whether the enemy has a base.

zh: 盖或寇有地而用应，寇无地而用鬼。
是以两军对迎，法世应之克生，四野剿除，度鬼福之强弱也。
yi: 敌寇有据点的，用应来看；敌寇没有据点的，用官鬼来看。
所以两军对阵，按世应的相克相生来断；四野围剿，则衡量官鬼和福神的强弱。
en: If the bandits hold a base, look at the Other; if they have no base, look at Pressure.
So when two armies face each other, follow the generation and control of the Self and the Other; when the countryside is being swept clean on all sides, weigh the strength of Pressure and Output.

zh: 若据城郭，成两军之势，则考世应生克虚实以为胜负。
如流寇无定，必四向剿灭之，则论福鬼强弱。
yi: 如果敌人占据城郭，形成两军对阵之势，就考察世应的生克虚实来断胜负；
如果是流窜无定的流寇，必须四面围剿消灭，就论福神与官鬼的强弱。
en: If the enemy holds a walled city and forms the posture of two armies, examine the generation, control, emptiness and fullness of the Self and the Other to decide victory and defeat;
if they are roving bandits with no fixed place and must be wiped out from all four directions, then discuss the strength of Output and Pressure.

title: 军机：飞檄求援应疾则不援克世则不轨，上书求济六冲五疑君象冲克世爻则不允济，同仇相援则如用师；应空破散则无周急之情，应克世爻非惟不援尚有他奸，五爻空破散绝谓之五疑盖五爻为君克冲世爻恐逆耳不允，彼困我救断如用师

rule.yi: 发檄文求救兵，应爻有疾（坏）就不救，应克世就是不轨。上书求济，卦是六冲、五疑，君象冲克世爻，就不允济。同仇相援，就如同用兵来断。应爻空、破、散，就没有周济急难的情意；应克世爻，不只是不救援，还有别的奸谋。五爻空、破、散、绝，叫做五疑，因为五爻是君，冲克世爻，恐怕逆耳不被允准。对方有困难、我去救援，断法如同用兵。
rule.en: In sending a dispatch by fast courier to ask for relief troops, if the Other is sick no help comes, and if it controls the Self it is disloyal. In petitioning in writing for aid, with a six-clash and the five doubts, if the sovereign image clashes with or controls the Self line, the aid is not granted. Mutual help between those who share a hatred is judged like using troops. If the Other is Void, broken or scattered, there is no feeling for relieving distress; if the Other line controls the Self, there is not only no help but some other treachery. If the fifth line is Void, broken, scattered or extinct, it is called the five doubts, because the fifth line is the sovereign and if it clashes with or controls the Self line, I fear what I say jars on his ear and is not granted. If the other side is in difficulty and I go to its rescue, it is judged like using troops.

note.yi: 「飞檄」是紧急的檄文，「求济」是请求接济。「周急」是救济急难。「五疑」书里自己解释：五爻空、破、散、绝。「不轨」是不守本分、有二心。「同仇相援」是有共同敌人的两方互相救援，「彼困我救」是对方有难我去救，都按用兵断。
note.en: 'Feixi' is an urgent dispatch, and 'qiuji' is asking for aid. 'Zhouji' is relieving distress. The 'five doubts' are explained by the book itself: the fifth line Void, broken, scattered or extinct. 'Bugui' is not keeping to one's place and having a divided heart. 'Tongchou xiangyuan' is two sides with a common enemy helping each other, and 'bi kun wo jiu' is going to the rescue of the other side in difficulty, and both are judged like using troops.

zh: 飞檄求援，应疾则为不援，克世则为不轨。
上书求济，六冲五疑，君象冲克世爻，则不允济。
yi: 发檄文求救兵，应爻有疾（坏）就不救，应克世就是不轨。
上书求济，卦是六冲、五疑，君象冲克世爻，就不允济。
同仇相援，就如同用兵来断。
en: In sending a dispatch by fast courier to ask for relief troops, if the Other is sick no help comes, and if it controls the Self it is disloyal.
In petitioning in writing for aid, with a six-clash and the five doubts, if the sovereign image clashes with or controls the Self line, the aid is not granted.
Mutual help between those who share a hatred is judged like using troops.

zh: 应空破散，则无周急之情；应克世爻，非惟不援，尚有他奸也。
五爻空破散绝，谓之五疑，盖五爻为君，克冲世爻，恐逆耳不允。
yi: 应爻空、破、散，就没有周济急难的情意；应克世爻，不只是不救援，还有别的奸谋。
五爻空、破、散、绝，叫做五疑，因为五爻是君，冲克世爻，恐怕逆耳不被允准。
对方有困难、我去救援，断法如同用兵。
en: If the Other is Void, broken or scattered, there is no feeling for relieving distress; if the Other line controls the Self, there is not only no help but some other treachery.

If the fifth line is Void, broken, scattered or extinct, it is called the five doubts, because the fifth line is the sovereign and if it clashes with or controls the Self line, I fear what I say jars on his ear and is not granted.
If the other side is in difficulty and I go to its rescue, it is judged like using troops.

title: 军机：筮城虑破鬼动鬼克则危、筮敌来期应克应动则速、筮军被困世墓世伤则凶；若患破城不拘父母反专官鬼发动克世则危

rule.yi: 占城池，担心被攻破，官鬼动、官鬼克世就危险；占敌人来的日期，应克应、应动就快；占军队被围困，世入墓、世受伤就凶。如果担心城被攻破，不用看父母，反而专看官鬼：官鬼发动克世就危险。
rule.en: In divining about a city, if one fears it will be broken, Pressure moving or Pressure controlling the Self is dangerous; in divining the date the enemy will come, the Other controlling or the Other moving means quickly; in divining about an army that has been besieged, the Self entering the tomb or being injured is ominous. If one fears a city will be broken, one does not look at Resource but looks only at Pressure: Pressure moving and controlling the Self is dangerous.

note.yi: 「筮城虑破」是占一座城守不守得住。「应克应动则速」按文意是应爻克世、应爻发动，敌人来得快（「应克应」疑为「应克世」之误，书里就是这几个字，这里按「应克世、应动」译）。城池平常以父母为城（见易隐朝廷占城池 YY.40），这里反而专看官鬼，因为是怕城破、官鬼就是攻城的敌人。
note.en: 'Shi cheng lu po' is divining whether a city can be held. 'Ying ke ying dong ze su' is by the sense the Other controlling the Self and the Other moving, and the enemy comes quickly (the 'ying ke ying' is presumably a miswriting of 'ying ke shi', the Other controlling the Self; the book has just these characters and it is translated here as 'the Other controls the Self, the Other moves'). A city is ordinarily taken as Resource (see the divination on the city in the Yi Yin divination on the court, YY.40), but here Pressure alone is looked at, because one fears the city being broken and Pressure is the enemy attacking it.

zh: 筮城虑破，鬼动鬼克则危。
筮敌来期，应克应动则速。
筮军被困，世墓世伤则凶也。
yi: 占城池，担心被攻破，官鬼动、官鬼克世就危险；
占敌人来的日期，应克应、应动就快；
占军队被围困，世入墓、世受伤就凶。
en: In divining about a city, if one fears it will be broken, Pressure moving or Pressure controlling the Self is dangerous;
in divining the date the enemy will come, the Other controlling or the Other moving means quickly;
in divining about an army that has been besieged, the Self entering the tomb or being injured is ominous.

zh: 若患破城，不拘父母，反专官鬼，发动克世则危。
yi: 如果担心城被攻破，不用看父母，反而专看官鬼：官鬼发动克世就危险。
en: If one fears a city will be broken, one does not look at Resource but looks only at Pressure: Pressure moving and controlling the Self is dangerous.

title: 军机：兵法虽不一而象理只有一个——主帅（世）空则中军折、贼首（应）空则敌人逃；生我之动爻喜有援兵、克我之动爻恶其助敌；彼虽败而不能胜是因有生、己虽伤而不能害是因有扶；全盛而衰指动冲、将靡而起指绝处逢生

rule.yi: 兵法各家说法不一，但象和理只有一个：主帅（世）空，中军就折；贼首（应）空，敌人就逃。生我的动爻，喜它是来援的兵；克我的动爻，厌它是帮敌人的。还有一种：对方虽败而打不垮他，是因为他有生扶；我方虽伤而伤不到根本，是因为我有扶持。全盛而转衰，将倒而复起，进退反复，全看爻神的动静。
rule.en: The arts of war differ from school to school, but the image and the principle are one: if the commander (the Self) is Void the centre army is broken, and if the bandit chief (the Other) is Void the enemy flees. A moving line that generates me is welcome, being relief troops; one that controls me is hated, for it helps the enemy. There is also the case where the other side, though beaten, cannot be overcome, because it has generation, and where I, though hurt, am not harmed, because I have support.
