Fully thriving and then declining, about to fall and then rising, advancing and retreating back and forth: it all depends on the stirring and stilling of the lines.

note.yi: 「中军」是主帅所在的主力。「主帅空而中军折」是世空则主帅这一边折损。「全盛而衰」「将靡而起」书里自己注作「动冲」「绝生」，字面是：旺的爻动了遇冲而转衰，将倒的爻在绝处逢生而重起。「存乎神」的「神」指爻神的动静变化。这一条和总纲（YM.11）配套：世是主帅、应是贼首。
note.en: 'Zhongjun' is the main body where the commander is; 'the commander Void and the centre army broken' means that when the Self is Void, the commander's side suffers loss. 'Fully thriving yet declining' and 'about to fall yet rising' are glossed by the book itself as 'moving and clashing' and 'extinction and generation'; read literally, a thriving line moves, meets a clash and declines, while a line about to fall is generated in extinction and rises again. The 'spirit' in 'it lies in the spirit' is the stirring and stilling of the lines. This unit goes with the general statement (YM.11): the Self is the commander and the Other is the bandit chief.

zh: 凡主帅空而中军折，贼首空而敌人逃。
生我之动爻，喜有援兵，克我之动爻，恶其助敌。
犹有彼虽败而不能胜彼，谓其有生也，己虽伤而不能害己，谓我有扶也。
全盛而衰，将靡而起，进退反复，存乎神尔。
yi: 所以兵法各家不一，象和理却没有两样。
凡是主帅空，中军就折；贼首空，敌人就逃。
生我的动爻，喜欢有援兵；克我的动爻，厌恶它帮助敌人。
还有对方虽败而打不垮他，是说他有生扶；我方虽伤而伤不到根本，是说我有扶持。
全盛却衰，将倒却起，进退反复，全在爻神的变化。
en: So the arts of war are not one, yet the image and the principle are not two.
Whenever the commander is Void the centre army is broken, and when the bandit chief is Void the enemy flees.
A moving line that generates me is welcome, for there are relief troops; a moving line that controls me is hated, for it helps the enemy.
There is also the case where the other side, though beaten, cannot be overcome, which means he has generation; and where I, though hurt, am not harmed, which means I have support.
Fully thriving yet declining, about to fall yet rising, advancing and retreating back and forth: it all lies in the spirit of the lines.

yi: 主帅说的是世，贼首说的是应；
全盛而衰，指的是动冲（爻动而遇冲）；
将靡而起，指的是绝处逢生。
en: The commander means the Self, the bandit chief means the Other;
'fully thriving yet declining' refers to moving and clashing (a line that moves and meets a clash);
'about to fall yet rising' refers to being generated in extinction.

title: 军机：官鬼（敌）有五不可——不可得时势恐害成、不可遇长生恐难灭、不可临胎养恐方兴、不可暗动兼伏鬼克世恐谋刺、不可上下（内外）克世恐内应外通

rule.yi: 官鬼是敌，有五件事不可：不可得时得势，怕它妨害成功；不可遇长生，怕它难以消灭；不可临胎、养，怕它正在兴起；不可暗动，再兼伏着的鬼克世，怕它谋划行刺；不可内外卦都有鬼克世，怕它内应外通。
rule.en: Pressure is the enemy, and there are five things it must not do: it must not obtain season and momentum, for fear it harms the success; it must not meet Birth, for fear it is hard to destroy; it must not stand at Foetus or Nourishment, for fear it is just rising; it must not move in secret, nor, with a hidden Pressure line, control the Self, for fear of a plot to stab; and it must not control the Self from both the inner and the outer trigram, for fear of collusion between inside and outside.

note.yi: 「得时势」是当令有力。「长生」「胎」「养」是十二长生里的位置：长生是刚生出来，胎和养是还在孕育，都是正在起来的意思，所以鬼落在这些位上，敌人还在长。「暗动」是静爻被冲起（见术语表的冲）。「伏鬼」是卦里没有官鬼、伏在别的爻下。「谋刺」是谋划行刺。书里自注：「上下鬼克世」就是内外卦都有鬼。与易隐征战占的鬼动一组（YY.54）、本章防刺行刺（YM.15）合着看。
note.en: 'Obtaining season and momentum' is being in season and having force. Birth, Foetus and Nourishment are places in the twelve stages of life: Birth is just being born, and Foetus and Nourishment are still being conceived and nursed, all meaning that something is just beginning to rise, so Pressure standing in these places means the enemy is still growing. 'Moving in secret' is a still line being clashed into motion (see the glossary entry on clash). A 'hidden Pressure line' is one absent from the hexagram and hidden under another line. A 'plot to stab' is planning an assassination. The book's own gloss says 'Pressure above and below controlling the Self' means Pressure in both the inner and outer trigrams. Read together with the group on Pressure moving in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.54) and with guarding against and carrying out assassination in this chapter (YM.15).

zh: 惟鬼不可得时势，恐其害成，
不可暗动，兼伏鬼克世，恐其谋剌，
不可上下克世，恐其内应外通。
yi: 只有鬼不可得时得势，恐怕它妨害成功；
不可遇长生，恐怕它难以消灭；
不可临胎、养，恐怕它正在兴起；
不可暗动，再兼伏着的鬼克世，恐怕它谋划行刺；
不可上下都克世，恐怕它内应外通。
en: Only Pressure must not obtain season and momentum, for fear it harms the success;
it must not meet Birth, for fear it is hard to destroy;
it must not stand at Foetus or Nourishment, for fear it is just rising;
it must not move in secret, nor, together with a hidden Pressure line, control the Self, for fear of a plot to stab;
it must not control the Self above and below, for fear of collusion between inside and outside.

zh: 上下鬼克世，即内外鬼也。
yi: 上下鬼克世，就是内外卦都有鬼。
en: Pressure above and below controlling the Self means Pressure in both the inner and the outer trigram.

title: 军机：要知贼人布何策、用何兵、进何道，都验五行八卦消息——鬼动内防间谋、发外虑野战；鬼动乾宫伏兵于庙、官兴巽卦匿从于林；坤鬼戒纳降、震鬼不当却叛、艮忌冈陵之困、离忧市井之攻、兑毋信其说口、坎毋听其诱语（鬼之所现即敌之所谋）

rule.yi: 要看贼人布的什么策、用什么兵、走哪条路，我又该怎样应对、怎样克制、怎样夺取，全凭验五行八卦的消息。所以官鬼动在内卦，防间谋；发在外卦，虑野战；动在乾宫，伏兵在庙里；兴在巽卦，藏匿的随从在林中；坤宫的鬼，戒备受降；震宫的鬼，不该当作叛军已退；艮宫忌被困在冈陵；离宫忧市井受攻；兑宫不要信他的说辞；坎宫不要听他的诱语。书里自注：鬼显现之处，就是敌人谋划之处：坤是顺，鬼动则降不是真降；震是振，鬼摇则退下的叛军必变；兑是口、是悦，则说话必诈；坎是耳、是陷，则卑下的言辞必有谋。其余类推。
rule.en: To see what plan the bandits lay, what troops they use, what road they advance by, and how I shall answer, control and take them, one tests it all by the news of the five phases and the eight trigrams. So Pressure moving in the inner trigram, guard against spies and schemes; Pressure issuing in the outer trigram, take thought for a battle in the field; Pressure moving in the palace of Qian, troops lie in ambush in the temple; Pressure rising in the trigram Xun, followers lie hidden in the woods; Pressure in Kun, be on guard against accepting surrender; Pressure in Zhen, do not take the rebels as having withdrawn; Gen, beware of being trapped on hills and mounds; Li, fear an attack in the market towns; Dui, do not believe their talk; Kan, do not listen to their enticing words. The book's own gloss: where Pressure appears is what the enemy is planning. Kun is yielding, so when Pressure moves their surrender is not a real surrender; Zhen is shaking, so when Pressure sways the rebels who stood down will surely change; Dui is mouth and delight, so the talk must be deceit; Kan is ear and pit, so humble words must hide a scheme. The rest follows by analogy.

note.yi: 「间谋」是敌方派来的内线。「伏兵于庙」「匿从于林」的庙、林，是敌人把兵藏在庙里、藏在林里。「纳降」是接受投降。「却叛」书里没有注；按它自己的注（「却叛必变」）读作叛军说已经撤了、停了，靠不住，不当作已退。「冈陵」是山冈土丘，「市井」是街市城镇。八卦的象是本章通用的：乾老、坤顺、震动、巽入、坎陷、离丽、艮止、兑悦。这一条是整章里把『鬼落在哪一宫』读成『敌人在谋什么』的一条，下一条（YM.23）接着讲五行八卦的取义。
note.en: 'Jianmou' is an inside agent sent by the enemy. The temple and woods of 'ambush in the temple' and 'followers hidden in the woods' are where the enemy hides his troops. 'Naxiang' is accepting surrender. The book does not gloss 'quepan'; following its own note ('the rebels who stood down will surely change') it is read as rebels saying they have withdrawn or stopped, which cannot be relied on, so they are not to be taken as having withdrawn. 'Gangling' is hills and mounds, and 'shijing' is markets and towns. The images of the eight trigrams are those used throughout the chapter: Qian is aged, Kun yielding, Zhen moving, Xun entering, Kan a pit, Li clinging, Gen stopping, Dui delight. This is the entry in the chapter that reads 'which palace the Pressure stands in' as 'what the enemy is planning'; the next entry (YM.23) goes on to the meanings of the five phases and the eight trigrams.

zh: 欲视贼人之布何策，用何兵，进何道，
我将何以应之，何以克之，何以取之，
俱验五行八卦消息而已。
故鬼动内而防间谋，鬼发外而虑野战，
yi: 要看贼人布的是什么策略、用的什么兵、走哪条路，
我又将怎样应对、怎样克制、怎样夺取，
全凭验五行八卦的消息罢了。
所以官鬼动在内就防间谋，发在外就虑野战；
鬼动乾宫，伏兵在庙；
官兴巽卦，藏匿的随从在林中；
坤宫的鬼，是要戒备受降；
震宫的鬼，不该当作叛军已退；
艮宫忌被困在冈陵；
离宫忧市井受攻；
兑宫不要信他的说辞；
坎宫不要听他的诱语。
en: To see what plan the bandits lay, what troops they use, what road they advance by,
and how I shall answer them, how control them, how take them,
one simply tests it all by the news of the five phases and the eight trigrams.
So Pressure moving within, guard against spies and schemes; Pressure issuing without, take thought for a battle in the field;
Pressure moving in the palace of Qian, troops lie in ambush in the temple;
Pressure rising in the trigram Xun, followers lie hidden in the woods;
Pressure in Kun, be on guard against accepting surrender;
Pressure in Zhen, one should not take the rebels as having withdrawn;
in Gen, beware of being trapped on hills and mounds;
in Li, fear an attack in the market towns;
in Dui, do not believe their talk;
in Kan, do not listen to their enticing words.

zh: 此言八卦取象，盖鬼之所现，即敌之所谋，
兑为口、为悦，则说言必诈，
坎为耳、为陷，则卑辞必谋也。
yi: 这是说八卦取象：鬼显现之处，就是敌人谋划之处。
坤是顺，鬼动则降不是真降；
震是振，鬼摇则退下的叛军必变；
兑是口、是悦，则说话必诈；
坎是耳、是陷，则卑下的言辞必有谋。
其余类推。
en: This speaks of taking images from the eight trigrams: where Pressure appears is what the enemy is planning.
Kun is yielding, so when Pressure moves their surrender is not a real surrender;
Zhen is shaking, so when Pressure sways the rebels who stood down will surely change;
Dui is mouth and delight, so the talk must be deceit;
Kan is ear and pit, so humble words must hide a scheme.
The rest follows by analogy.

title: 军机：鬼动于五行八卦各有所谋——火鬼动非劫寨而谋纵火、水鬼动非水淹而计囊沙，金为流矢之凶、木为胶舟之诈、土（款）为平原之战；起于离从南来、发于坎从北犯、艮坤敌出山阜、震巽寇自丰木；乾以老弱骗军士之心、兑以子女惑兵卒之志；取象取义全凭深心测度官鬼情形

rule.yi: 火鬼动，不是劫寨，是谋划放火；水鬼动，不是水淹，是计谋用沙袋壅水；金是流矢之凶，木是胶舟之诈，「款」（疑是土）是平原之战；起于离的从南边来，发于坎的从北边犯；艮、坤的敌人出自山冈土阜，震、巽的寇从茂盛的树林里来；乾是用老弱来骗我军士的心，兑是用子女来惑我兵卒的志。取象取义，全凭用心去测度官鬼的情形。
rule.en: Fire Pressure moving is not a raid on the camp but a plan to set fires; Water Pressure moving is not a flood but a scheme of sandbags; Metal is the harm of flying arrows, Wood the deceit of a boat held fast, and 'Kuan' (presumably Earth) a battle on the open plain; what rises in Li comes from the south, what issues from Kan attacks from the north; with Gen and Kun the enemy comes out of hills and mounds, with Zhen and Xun the raiders come out of thick woods; Qian uses the old and weak to deceive my soldiers' hearts, and Dui uses sons and daughters to confuse my troops' will. Taking the image and taking the meaning all depends on gauging, with a deep mind, the condition of Pressure.

note.yi: 「款为平原之战」的「款」疑是「土」之误：前面是火、水、金、木，到这里正该轮到土，书里下面的注也写「土有坑陷」。「囊沙」是用沙袋壅水（拦水断水，再放水），是水路的计谋。「流矢」是乱飞的箭。「胶舟」字面是船被胶住、搁浅动弹不得，书里没有细说，按字面译，当是用舟船设的诈。「山阜」是土山，「丰木」是丰茂的树木。「子女」字面是儿女；兑是少女，按卦象理解为用年轻女子。「起于离而南来」是鬼起在离宫，敌从南方来；「发于坎而北犯」是鬼发在坎宫，敌从北面来。
note.en: The 'kuan' of 'kuan is a battle on the open plain' is presumably a slip for Earth: Fire, Water, Metal and Wood have come before, and it is Earth's turn, and the note below the text also says 'Earth has pits and traps'. 'Nangsha' is damming water with sandbags (blocking or cutting off water and then releasing it), a scheme on the water. 'Liuzhi' is a stray arrow. 'Jiaozhou' is literally a boat held fast by glue, stranded and unable to move; the book does not explain it, so it is translated literally, and it presumably means a deceit worked with boats. 'Shanfu' is an earth hill, and 'fengmu' is thick, lush trees. 'Zinü' is literally sons and daughters; Dui is the youngest girl, and by the image it is understood as using young women. 'Rising in Li and coming from the south' is Pressure rising in the palace of Li with the enemy coming from the south; 'issuing in Kan and attacking from the north' is Pressure issuing in the palace of Kan with the enemy coming from the north.

zh: 火鬼动，非劫寨而谋于纵火，
水鬼动，非水淹而计于囊沙；
金为流矢之凶，木为胶舟之诈，款为平原之战；
起于离而南来，发于坎而北犯；
艮坤敌出于山阜，震巽寇自于丰木；
乾以老弱骗吾军士之心，
兑以子女惑吾兵卒之志也。
yi: 火鬼动，不是劫寨而是谋划放火；
水鬼动，不是水淹而是计在沙袋；
金是流矢的凶，木是胶舟的诈，款是平原的战；
起于离的从南边来，发于坎的从北边犯；
艮、坤的敌人出自山冈土阜，震、巽的寇来自丰茂的树林；
乾是用老弱来骗我军士的心，
兑是用子女来惑我兵卒的志。
en: When Fire Pressure moves, it is not a raid on the camp but a plan to set fires;
when Water Pressure moves, it is not a flood but a scheme of sandbags;
Metal is the harm of flying arrows, Wood is the deceit of a boat held fast, and 'Kuan' is a battle on the open plain;
what rises in Li comes from the south, what issues from Kan attacks from the north;
with Gen and Kun the enemy comes out of hills and mounds, with Zhen and Xun the raiders come from thick woods;
Qian uses the old and weak to deceive my soldiers' hearts,
and Dui uses sons and daughters to confuse my troops' will.

zh: 或云木有生兵，土有坑陷。
夫敌进退布策，惟深心测度官鬼情形，取象取义，可得之矣。
yi: 这是再说八卦和五行的取义，
也有人说木有生兵，土有坑陷。
敌人进退布策，只有深心测度官鬼的情形，取象取义，才能得到。
en: This speaks again of the meanings of the eight trigrams and the five phases;
some say that Wood has fresh troops and Earth has pits and traps.
As for the enemy's advance and retreat and the plans he lays, they can be got only by gauging, with a deep mind, the condition of Pressure and taking its image and meaning.

title: 军机：子孙（福神）动于五行各有胜法——动水利水战、动火利火攻，土以炮石胜、金以弓矢胜、木以舟车胜

rule.yi: 子孙动在水，利于水战；福神动在火，利于火攻；属土的靠炮石取胜，属金的靠弓箭取胜，属木的靠舟车取胜。
rule.en: Output moving in Water favours a battle on the water; Output, the fortune spirit, moving in Fire favours an attack by fire; Earth wins by catapult stones, Metal wins by bow and arrow, Wood wins by boats and carts.

note.yi: 上一条（YM.22–23）讲官鬼（敌）落在哪一行哪一宫、敌在谋什么；这一条反过来讲子孙（我的兵）落在哪一行、我用什么取胜。「炮石」是古代的抛石机。「舟车」是船和车，木行主它们。
note.en: The previous entries (YM.22–23) speak of which phase and palace Pressure (the enemy) is in and what the enemy is planning; this entry turns it round and speaks of which phase Output (my troops) is in and by what I win. 'Paoshi' is the ancient stone-throwing engine. 'Zhouche' is boats and carts, which the Wood phase governs.

zh: 土以炮石胜，金以弓矢胜，木以舟车胜也。
yi: 子孙动在水，就利于水战；
福神动在火，就利于火攻；
土靠炮石取胜，金靠弓箭取胜，木靠舟车取胜。
en: Output moving in Water favours a battle on the water;
Output, the fortune spirit, moving in Fire favours an attack by fire;
Earth wins by catapult stones, Metal wins by bow and arrow, Wood wins by boats and carts.

title: 军机：子孙（福）发动于八卦各有取胜之法——坤宫屯兵相助、震卦壮士来归，乾为丈人良谋、艮为少年秘计，坎当外示其弱、离当内示其虚、兑当饰以卑词、巽当勇于趋进，皆发子孙而取胜

rule.yi: 子孙动在坤宫，有屯驻的兵来相助；福神兴在震卦，有壮士来归；乾是老成人的良谋，艮是少年的秘计；坎宫应当对外示弱，离宫应当对内示虚，兑宫应当用卑下的言辞来修饰，巽宫应当勇于进取。这些都是子孙发动才能取胜。
rule.en: Output moving in the palace of Kun, stationed troops come to help; Output rising in the trigram Zhen, brave men come over to me; Qian is the good plan of an elder, Gen the secret scheme of a youth; in Kan one should show weakness outwardly, in Li one should show emptiness inwardly, in Dui one should dress up one's words humbly, in Xun one should be bold in pressing forward. All of these win when Output moves.

note.yi: 「丈人」是老成的长者（乾为老父）。「餙」是「饰」的异体，「餙以卑词」是用谦卑的言辞包装、掩饰自己。「示其弱」「示其虚」是对敌人装作弱、装作虚，引他来。坤宫、震卦、乾、艮、坎、离、兑、巽各给一个方略，是本章把八卦象义用在『我这一边』的一条，和上面讲敌人的（YM.22–23）对着读。书里自注：兵占里福神（子孙）临到都吉，属什么五行、落在什么宫，各按象去推。
note.en: 'Zhangren' is a seasoned elder (Qian is the aged father). 'Shi' is a variant of 'shi', to dress up, and 'dress up with humble words' is to wrap and disguise oneself in humble speech. 'Showing weakness' and 'showing emptiness' are pretending to the enemy to be weak or empty so as to draw him on. Each of Kun, Zhen, Qian, Gen, Kan, Li, Dui and Xun gets a plan; this is the entry in the chapter that uses the images of the eight trigrams on 'my side', to be read against the entries above on the enemy (YM.22–23). The book's own gloss: in a military divination Output arriving is always auspicious, and which phase it belongs to and which palace it stands in is worked out by the image.

zh: 乾为丈人之良谋，艮为少年之秘计，
坎当外示其弱，离当内示其虚，
兑当餙以卑词，巽当勇于趋进，
yi: 子孙动在坤宫，有屯驻的兵来相助；
福兴在震卦，有壮士来归；
乾是老成人的良谋，艮是少年的秘计；
坎应当对外示弱，离应当对内示虚；
兑应当用卑下的言辞来修饰，巽应当勇于进取；
这些都是发动子孙而取胜的。
en: Output moving in the palace of Kun, stationed troops come to help;
Output rising in the trigram Zhen, brave men come over to me;
Qian is the good plan of an elder, Gen is the secret scheme of a youth;
in Kan one should show weakness outwardly, in Li one should show emptiness inwardly;
in Dui one should dress up one's words humbly, in Xun one should be bold in pressing forward;
all of these come from Output moving, and so win.

zh: 或属五行，或现何宫，各以象推。
yi: 兵占里福神临到，都是吉，
或属哪一行，或落在哪一宫，各按象来推。
en: In a military divination, when Output arrives it is always auspicious;
whether it belongs to some phase or appears in some palace, each is worked out by its image.

title: 军机：六亲在兵占的分工——父母为彼我之机关（计策、军师）、妻财为彼我之兵甲、弟兄为彼我之埋伏、鬼为贼众、子为将士，再考生克衰旺以分美恶

rule.yi: 父母是彼此双方的机关（计策，也是军师），妻财是双方的兵器甲胄，弟兄是双方的埋伏，鬼是贼众，子是将士；再考察生克衰旺，来分辨好坏。
rule.en: Resource is the machinery of both sides (the plans, and also the army's counsellor), Wealth is the weapons and armour of both sides, Peer is the ambush of both sides, Pressure is the bandit host and Output is the officers and men; then one examines generation, control, decline and thriving to tell the fine from the bad.

dispute.yi: 和易隐征战占的六亲分法（YY.57）比较：父母是军师、兄弟是埋伏、官鬼是敌人，两书一致；分歧在另外两亲——易隐以妻财为粮草、以子孙为先锋，易冒以妻财为兵器甲胄、以子孙为将士。粮草和兵甲都算『物』，先锋和将士都算『人』，所以只是取象的粗细不同；但断粮草缺不缺时，按易隐看妻财，按易冒看的是兵器甲胄，不能把两本书的说法混着用。
dispute.en: Compared with the division of the six kin in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.57): Resource as counsellor, Peer as ambush and Pressure as enemy agree in the two books; the difference is in the other two kin, where the Yi Yin takes Wealth as provisions and Output as the vanguard, while the Yimao takes Wealth as weapons and armour and Output as officers and men. Provisions and arms both count as things, and vanguard and officers both count as people, so it is only a difference in the fineness of the image; but in judging whether provisions run short, the Yi Yin looks at Wealth for grain and the Yimao for weapons and armour, and the two books' sayings should not be mixed.

note.yi: 「机关」是机要、计谋。「兵甲」是兵器和甲胄，和官鬼（贼众）、子孙（将士）分开：子孙是人，妻财是物。「埋伏」是设伏的兵。「彼我」是双方各有一份，所以同一类爻在我是我的，在敌是敌的，看它落在世这一边还是应这一边。书里自注：父母既是计策也是军师。
note.en: 'Jiguan' is key machinery and planning. 'Bingjia' is weapons and armour, kept apart from Pressure (the bandit host) and Output (the officers and men): Output is people, Wealth is things. 'Maifu' is troops set in ambush. 'Both sides' means each side has a share, so the same kind of line is mine when it falls on my side and the enemy's when it falls on his, according to whether it stands on the Self side or the Other side. The book's own gloss: Resource is both the plan and the counsellor.

zh: 考生克衰旺以分美恶也。
yi: 不过，父母是彼我双方的机关，
妻财是彼我双方的兵器甲胄，
弟兄是彼我双方的埋伏，
鬼是贼众，子是将士，
要考察生克衰旺，来分辨好坏。
en: However, Resource is the machinery of both sides,
Wealth is the weapons and armour of both sides,
Peer is the ambush of both sides,
Pressure is the bandit host, Output is the officers and men,
and one examines generation, control, decline and thriving to tell the fine from the bad.

yi: 兵占里六亲的分法就是这样：
父母是计策，也是军师。
en: This is how the six relations are divided in a military divination:
Resource is the plan, and is also the army's counsellor.

title: 军机：鬼临吉神纵吉而不吉、福居凶煞纵凶而不凶；子化官者叛、官化子者降，飞伏官随减随起、内外子屡战屡捷；阳为正兵阴为奇兵、以子孙官鬼别其利；合则结冲则绝、静应守动应攻

rule.yi: 所以鬼（官鬼）临在吉神上，即使是吉也不吉；福（子孙）落在凶煞上，即使是凶也不凶。还有：子孙化官鬼的，是叛变；官鬼化子孙的，是投降；官鬼伏在飞爻下的，随灭随起；内外卦都有子孙的，屡战屡捷。阳是正兵，阴是奇兵，用子孙、官鬼来分辨它们的利弊。合就是结，冲就是绝；静就该守，动就该攻。
rule.en: So when Pressure stands on an auspicious spirit it is not auspicious even though it seems so, and when Output sits on an evil star it is not ominous even though it seems so. Moreover, Output turning into Pressure is mutiny, and Pressure turning into Output is surrender; Pressure hidden beneath a flying line wanes as it rises and rises as it wanes, and Output in both inner and outer trigram means repeated battles and repeated victories. Yang is the regular troops and yin the irregular troops, and Output and Pressure tell where the advantage lies. Combining is binding and clashing is severing; when still, one should hold, and when moving, one should attack.

note.yi: 「子化官者叛，官化子者降」：子孙是我的兵，变成官鬼，是兵变成了敌，所以叛；官鬼是敌，变成子孙，是敌变成了兵，所以降。「飞伏官」是官鬼伏在飞爻下面；「随减随起」是刚消下去又起来，反复。「正兵」是正面交战的兵，「奇兵」是出奇制胜的兵。「静应守，动应攻」的「应」在这里按「该」读（静就该守、动就该攻）；若把它读成应爻（应静则守、应动则攻：对方静就是守、动就是攻），也讲得通，书里没有注明。「合则结」指合住、结盟，「冲则绝」指冲开、断绝。
note.en: 'Output turning into Pressure is mutiny, Pressure turning into Output is surrender': Output is my troops, and turning into Pressure it is troops turned enemy, hence mutiny; Pressure is the enemy, and turning into Output it is the enemy turned troops, hence surrender. 'Hidden Pressure beneath a flying line' is Pressure hidden under a flying line; 'wanes as it rises' is rising just after dying down, back and forth. 'Zhengbing' is troops that fight face to face, and 'qibing' is troops that win by surprise. The 'ying' of 'still should hold, moving should attack' is read here as 'should'; read as the Other line (when the Other is still it holds, when it moves it attacks, speaking of the enemy) it also makes sense, and the book does not say which. 'Combining is binding' is being held fast or allied, and 'clashing is severing' is being clashed apart or cut off.

zh: 是以鬼临吉神，纵吉而不吉，
且有子化官者叛，官化子者降，
飞伏官而随减随起，内外子而屡战屡捷。
阳为正兵，阴为奇兵，子孙官鬼以别其利也。
yi: 所以鬼临吉神，即使吉也不吉；
福居凶煞，即使凶也不凶。
还有子化官的是叛，官化子的是降，
官鬼飞伏的随减随起，内外卦都有子的屡战屡捷。
阳是正兵，阴是奇兵，用子孙、官鬼来分辨它们的利弊。
合就是结，冲就是绝；
静就该守，动就该攻。
en: So when Pressure stands on an auspicious spirit, even if it seems auspicious it is not;
when Output sits on an evil star, even if it seems ominous it is not.
Moreover, Output turning into Pressure is mutiny, and Pressure turning into Output is surrender;
Pressure hidden beneath a flying line wanes as it rises and rises as it wanes, and Output in both inner and outer trigram means repeated battles and repeated victories.
Yang is the regular troops and yin the irregular troops, and Output and Pressure tell where the advantage lies.
Combining is binding and clashing is severing;
when still, one should hold; when moving, one should attack.

title: 军机结语：决策在人而成谋在天——蓍草所从的是鬼神之情，喜直而恶曲、辅仁而伐暴，占者要以此为鉴

rule.yi: 常说决策在人，成谋在天。蓍草所顺从的，是鬼神的情意：喜欢直而厌恶曲，辅助仁者而讨伐暴者。占的人要以此为鉴。
rule.en: It is often said that decisions rest with men and the success of schemes with Heaven. What the stalks follow is the feeling of the spirits: they like the straight and dislike the crooked, they aid the benevolent and strike down the violent. Let the diviner take this as a mirror.

note.yi: 「常问」按文意读作「常说」。这一句是整章的收尾，不是判断规则：兵占问的是胜负，可『人谋』在人、『成谋』在天，占卦跟着鬼神的情意走，而鬼神的情意是偏向直、仁的一边。所以占出『能胜』并不等于可以逞暴，占出不利也不等于必败；这和易冒其他章末的劝诫是一个口气。
note.en: 'Changwen' is read by the sense as 'often said'. This line closes the whole chapter and is not a rule of judgment: a military divination asks about victory and defeat, yet the planning is with men and the success of the scheme is with Heaven, so the divination follows the feeling of the spirits, and that feeling leans to the straight and the benevolent. So a divination of 'one can win' does not license violence, and an unfavourable one does not mean certain defeat; this is of one tone with the closing admonitions of other chapters of the Yimao.

zh: 常问决策在人，成谋在天。
盖筮蓍之从，鬼神之情，喜直而恶曲，辅仁而伐暴，
yi: 常说决策在人，成谋在天。
蓍草所顺从的，是鬼神的情意：喜欢直而厌恶曲，辅助仁者而讨伐暴者，
占的人要以此为鉴。
en: It is often said that decision lies with men, and the success of a scheme with Heaven.
What the stalks follow is the feeling of the spirits: they like the straight and dislike the crooked, they aid the benevolent and strike down the violent;
let the diviner take this as a mirror.

title: 卜馆总纲：问馆有无成否，喜六合生世、恶三冲应空；本章十三问——何地、何时、就馆、开馆、附学、代馆、辞馆、荐馆、攘馆、选刻、卜徒、幕馆、商馆

rule.yi: 问馆（教书的馆席）有没有、成不成，喜六合、喜生世，恶三冲、恶应空。本章分十三问：在什么地方、什么时候、就馆、开馆、附学、代馆、辞馆、荐馆、攘馆、选文刻书、卜徒、幕馆、商馆。
rule.en: In asking whether a teaching post exists and whether it will come off, Six-Combine and generation of the Self are welcome, while the three clashes and a Void Other are hated. The chapter takes thirteen questions in turn: where, when, taking up a post, opening a school, pupils coming to attach themselves, standing in for another, resigning, recommending, snatching a post, choosing texts for cutting, divining a disciple, a secretary's post, and a merchant's post.

note.yi: 「馆」是教书的馆席，也就是请先生的聘约。「就馆」是应聘上任，「开馆」是自己设帐招生，「附学」是学生来附读（下文「问附来者」），「代馆」是替人坐席，「辞馆」是辞去，「荐馆」是荐人去，「攘馆」是被人谋夺馆席，「选刻」是选文刻书，「卜徒」是看收的徒弟，「幕馆」是衙门里的幕友，「商馆」是在商家、富豪处共事。这一章的馆是私塾先生、幕友、商家账房一类的聘职，按职业归入事业；上一章末尾（L1350–1352）讲学生附学、延师、访师的那一半是读书求学，另归考试。「三冲」是贞冲（本卦六冲）、悔冲（变卦六冲）、合处逢冲这三种（见 YM.07 的注）。
note.en: 'Guan' is the teaching post, that is, the engagement of a teacher. 'Jiuguan' is taking up an engagement, 'kaiguan' is setting up a school oneself, 'fuxue' is pupils coming to attach themselves (the text below, 'asking about those who come to attach'), 'daiguan' is standing in for another, 'ciguan' is resigning, 'jianguan' is recommending someone, 'rangguan' is the post being plotted against and snatched, 'xuanke' is choosing texts and cutting blocks, 'butu' is looking at the disciples taken on, 'muguan' is a secretary in a government office, and 'shangguan' is working in the house of a merchant or rich man. The posts in this chapter are those of a village-school teacher, a secretary and a merchant's accountant, and are placed under Career by occupation; the other half, at the end of the previous chapter (L1350–1352), about pupils attaching themselves, hiring a teacher and seeking a teacher, is about study and belongs under Examinations. The 'three clashes' are the original hexagram being a six-clash, the changed hexagram being a six-clash, and a combination meeting a clash (see the note to YM.07).

yi: 问馆有没有、成不成，
喜六合、生世，
恶三冲、应空。
en: In asking whether a post exists and whether it will come off,
Six-Combine and generation of the Self are welcome,
the three clashes and a Void Other are hated.

zh: 内详何地、何时、就馆、开馆、附学、代馆、辞馆、荐馆、攘馆、选刻、卜徒、幕馆、商馆十三问
yi: 里面详述：在何地、何时、就馆、开馆、附学、代馆、辞馆、荐馆、攘馆、选刻、卜徒、幕馆、商馆，共十三问。
en: Within are treated in detail the thirteen questions: where, when, taking up a post, opening a school, attaching pupils, standing in for another, resigning, recommending, snatching a post, choosing and cutting texts, divining a disciple, a secretary's post, a merchant's post.

title: 卜馆·问馆何地：以应为方——坎兑近水、震巽入林、坤艮山野、离城市、乾大都灵宫；应居父母诗书礼乐之家、官鬼仕宦史胥之宅、妻财商贾、兄弟同侪、子孙清闲道德之门；阴阳分男女之延、内外分远近之请、游魂归魂分本土他境；六神分景色、诸星为人事

rule.yi: 问馆在什么地方，以应爻为方位：应在坎、兑宫，近水；在震、巽，入林；在坤、艮，是山野；在离，是城市；在乾，是大都会或灵宫（神庙）。应落在父母，是诗书礼乐之家；落在官鬼，是做官的、书吏衙役的住宅；落在妻财是商贾，落在兄弟是同辈同行，落在子孙就是清闲讲道德的门第。用阴阳分是男是女来聘，用内外分是远是近来请，用游魂、归魂分本地还是他乡；用六神看四周的景色，用诸星看人事。应带青龙，馆在长林丰草之间；带玄武，在水边池旁；带朱雀，在闹市或有炊烟的村子；带白虎，在荒僻的乡下；带勾陈，近田野旧坟；带螣蛇，依在来往的工匠、舟车一带。贵人是做官的，驿马是经商的，华盖是出家人，天财是商贩，天猪是屠户，其余照这样类推。
rule.en: In asking where the post is, the Other gives the direction: the Other in Kan or Dui is near water, in Zhen or Xun it goes into woods, in Kun or Gen it is mountain wilds, in Li it is a town, and in Qian it is a great city or a hall of the spirits (a temple). The Other on Resource is a house of poetry, books, rites and music; on Pressure, the residence of officials, clerks and runners; on Wealth, merchants; on Peer, one's fellows of the same trade; on Output, a quiet, leisured house of morals and the Way. Yin and yang tell whether a man or a woman engages me, inner and outer whether the invitation is near or far, Wandering Soul and Returning Soul whether it is home ground or another region; the six spirits give the scenery around and the stars give the human affairs. The Other with the Azure Dragon: the place is among long woods and thick grass; the Dark Tortoise: a house by water, beside a pond; the Vermilion Bird: a busy market or a smoky village; the White Tiger: a barren, remote countryside; Hook Earth: near fields and old graves; the Coiling Snake: by the traffic of craftsmen, boats and carts. The Noble is an official, the Post Horse a merchant, the Canopy a monk, Heavenly Wealth a trader, the Heavenly Boar a butcher, and the rest are sought by analogy.

note.yi: 「史胥」就是吏胥，书吏和衙役。「灵宫」是供神的宫观。「男女之延」是聘他的是男主人还是女主人；「远近之请」是请他的地方远还是近。游魂主迁徙、归魂主回原处，所以拿来分本乡他乡（和 EL.53「游魂迁改它图吉、归魂乃旧胜西东」是同一个意思）。「景色」是馆舍周围的光景。「天财」「天猪」是神煞名，书里没有列出怎么取，按字面译。这一条是把应爻当作东家来看的一整套取象，与黄金策求馆「应乃东家，若遇官爻须作吏」（HJC.30）同类，易冒比它多了方位和六神、神煞一层。
note.en: 'Shixu' is 'lixu', clerks and runners. 'Lingong' is a hall for the worship of spirits. 'Engaged by man or woman' is whether it is the master or the mistress of the house who engages him; 'far or near invitation' is whether the place that invites him is far or near. Wandering Soul stands for moving about and Returning Soul for going back to the original place, so they are used to tell home ground from other regions (the same idea as in EL.53, 'Wandering Soul: another scheme is good; Returning Soul: the old post is better than east or west'). 'Scenery' is the view around the schoolroom. 'Heavenly Wealth' and 'Heavenly Boar' are names of spirit-stars, and the book does not list how they are taken, so they are translated literally. This entry is a whole set of images that treats the Other as the master of the house, of a kind with 'the Other is the master of the house, and if it meets the Pressure line he must be an official' in the Huangjin Ce on seeking a post (HJC.30), the Yimao adding a layer of direction, the six spirits and the spirit-stars.

zh: 在坎兑而近水，在震巽而入林，在坤艮为山野，在离为城市，在乾为大都灵宫也。
应居父母，则诗书礼乐之家，
应居官鬼，则仕宦史胥之宅，
居妻财为商贾，居兄弟为同侪，居子孙则清闲道德之门也。
以阴阳而分男女之延，以内外而分远近之请，
以游魂归魂而分本土他境，
以六神分景色，诸星为人事也。
yi: 问馆在什么地方，以应爻为方位：
应在坎、兑宫就近水，在震、巽宫就入林，在坤、艮宫是山野，在离宫是城市，在乾宫是大都会或灵宫。
应落在父母，是诗书礼乐之家；
应落在官鬼，是做官的、书吏衙役的住宅；
落在妻财是商贾，落在兄弟是同辈同行，落在子孙就是清闲讲道德的门第。
用阴阳分是男是女来聘，用内外分是远是近来请，
用游魂、归魂分是本地还是他乡，
用六神看四周的景色，用诸星看人事。
en: In asking where the post is, the Other gives the direction:
the Other in Kan or Dui is near water, in Zhen or Xun it goes into woods, in Kun or Gen it is mountain wilds, in Li it is a town, and in Qian it is a great city or a hall of the spirits.
the Other on Resource is a house of poetry, books, rites and music;
the Other on Pressure is the residence of officials, clerks and runners;
on Wealth it is merchants, on Peer it is one's fellows of the same trade, and on Output it is a quiet, leisured house of morals and the Way.
Yin and yang tell whether a man or a woman engages me, inner and outer tell whether the invitation is near or far,
Wandering Soul and Returning Soul tell whether it is home ground or another region,
the six spirits give the scenery around, and the stars give the human affairs.

zh: 应带青龙，其地在长林丰草，
螣蛇依于往来工艺舟车也。
贵人为宦，驿马为商，华盖为僧，天财为贾，天猪为屠，
yi: 应带青龙，馆在长林丰草之间；
带玄武，他家在水边池旁；
带朱雀，是闹市和有炊烟的村子；
带白虎，是荒僻的乡下；
带勾陈，近田野旧坟；
带螣蛇，依在来往的工匠、舟车一带。
贵人是做官的，驿马是经商的，华盖是出家人，天财是商贩，天猪是屠户，
其余照这样类推。
en: The Other with the Azure Dragon: the place is among long woods and thick grass;
with the Dark Tortoise, his house is by water, beside a pond;
with the Vermilion Bird, it is a busy market or a smoky village;
with the White Tiger, a barren, remote countryside;
with Hook Earth, near fields and old graves;
with the Coiling Snake, by the traffic of craftsmen, boats and carts.
The Noble is an official, the Post Horse a merchant, the Canopy a monk, Heavenly Wealth a trader, the Heavenly Boar a butcher,
and the rest are sought by analogy.

title: 卜馆·问得馆何时：实世、生世、合世之日就是它的日期

rule.yi: 问什么时候能得到馆，看填实世爻（世爻落空时）、生世、合世的日子，那就是它的日期。
rule.en: In asking when a post will be obtained, the days that fill the Self, generate the Self or combine with the Self are its date.

note.yi: 「实世」按文意是填实世爻：世落空时，逢到把它填实的日子叫实；「生世」「合世」是生它、合它的日子。书里只有这一句，没有展开。易林补遗求馆（EL.54）和易隐觅馆占（YY.81）把它细讲了：以父母为用，按旺衰取日。
note.en: 'Shishi' is, by the sense, filling the Self line: when the Self is Void, a day that meets and fills it is called 'real'; 'generating the Self' and 'combining with the Self' are days that generate or combine with it. The book has only this sentence and does not expand on it. The Yilin Buyi on seeking a post (EL.54) and the Yi Yin divination of a post (YY.81) treat it in detail: Resource is the Subject, and the day is taken by thriving or declining.

yi: 问什么时候能得到馆，
实世、生世、合世的日子，
就是它的日期。
en: In asking when the post will be obtained,
the days that fill the Self, generate the Self or combine with the Self
are its date.

title: 卜馆·就馆之吉：三冲则砚席难终、财陷则束修未腆、应空无尊道之志、克世有慢师之嫌、应破散绝有怠学之心，唯六合财旺应生为吉；馆定之后随墓助伤不可犯、世用空破散绝不可遇、官鬼不可动，动则以五行八宫六神诸星详之，游魂不久三冲不定

rule.yi: 已经聘定，问去就馆吉不吉：三冲，教席难以做满；财陷，酬金不丰；应空，东家没有尊师重道的志向；应克世，有怠慢先生的嫌疑；应破、散、绝，有懈怠学业的心；只有六合、财旺、应生世才是吉。馆已经定了，要问我在那里能不能身安心定：随墓、助伤不可犯；世用空、破、散、绝不可遇；官鬼不可动；动了就用五行、八宫、六神、诸星细看。游魂主不长久，三冲主不安定。
rule.en: Once the engagement is made, in asking whether taking up the post is auspicious: the three clashes, and the seat at the inkstone is hard to keep to the end; Wealth fallen, and the tuition gift is not generous; the Other Void, and the family has no will to honour the teacher and the Way; the Other controlling the Self, and there is a suspicion of slighting the teacher; the Other broken, scattered or extinct, and there is a heart of idleness about study; only Six-Combine, thriving Wealth and the Other generating the Self are auspicious. The post is settled; in asking whether I shall be at ease in body and settled in mind there, following into the tomb and helping the injury must not be committed, the Self or the Subject Void, broken, scattered or extinct must not be met, and Pressure must not move; if it moves, examine it by the five phases, the eight palaces, the six spirits and the stars. Wandering Soul does not last, and the three clashes are unsettled.

note.yi: 「砚席」是教书的席位，「束修」是给先生的酬金，「未腆」是不丰厚。「就馆」是应聘上任。「随墓助伤」书里没有再注，是前几章反复出现的忌：随着官鬼入墓、帮着官鬼伤世（见 YM.13）。「世用」是世爻和用神。「游魂不久」是游魂主变动不长久。书里的注自己说明那三组（八宫、五行诸星、六神）都只是大略举例：八宫取象，艮是少男，所以祸由童仆起，兑是少女，所以话从妇女生，乾坤是老父老母，所以防老人，震巽是长男长女，所以防小工匠，坎主盗、离主火；五行金主丧、火主是非、土主病、水主失、木主折；诸星里咸池主淫、天贼主盗、官符主讼、驿马主迁；六神里龙主酒、虎主兵丧。「趄咨」疑是「趑趄咨嗟」（迟疑叹息），「遁闷」是退缩郁闷。「官鬼动」的忌点原文只说「鬼静无戒，鬼动有忌」，后面的举例是各宫各神各自带来的具体事。
note.en: 'Yanxi' is the seat of a teacher, 'shuxiu' is the tuition gift to the teacher, and 'weitian' is not generous. 'Jiuguan' is taking up an engagement. The book does not gloss 'following into the tomb and helping the injury', which is a taboo recurring in earlier chapters: following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Self (see YM.13). 'Self or Subject' is the Self line and the Subject. 'Wandering Soul does not last' is that Wandering Soul means change and no lasting. The note in the book says itself that the three groups (the eight palaces, the five phases with the stars, and the six spirits) are only rough listings: by the images of the eight palaces, Gen is the youngest son, so trouble starts from young servants, Dui is the youngest daughter, so talk comes from women, Qian and Kun are the old father and mother, so guard against old people, Zhen and Xun are the eldest son and daughter, so guard against petty craftsmen, Kan governs thieves and Li governs fire; of the five phases Metal governs mourning, Fire disputes, Earth illness, Water loss and Wood breakage; among the stars the Peach Blossom governs lewdness, the Heavenly Thief theft, the Official Charge lawsuits and the Post Horse moving away; among the six spirits the Dragon governs wine and the Tiger soldiers and mourning. 'Quzi' is presumably 'zijuzi jie', hesitating and sighing, and 'dunmen' is shrinking back in gloom. For Pressure moving, the main text says only 'Pressure still, nothing to guard against; Pressure moving, there is something to avoid', and the examples after are the particular troubles each palace and each spirit brings.

zh: 三冲则砚席难终，财陷则束修未腆，
应空无尊道之志，克世有慢师之嫌，应破散绝有怠学之心，
馆已定矣，如我处而身安心定乎，
世用空破散绝，不可遇也，
动则以五行八宫、六神诸星详之。
yi: 已经聘定，问去就馆的吉凶：
三冲，教席就难以做满；财陷，酬金就不丰厚；
应空，没有尊师重道的志向；应克世，有怠慢先生的嫌疑；应破、散、绝，有懈怠学业的心；
只有六合、财旺、应生世才是吉。
馆已经定了，要问我在那里能不能身安心定：
随墓、助伤，不可犯；
世用空、破、散、绝，不可遇；
官鬼不可动；
动了，就用五行、八宫、六神、诸星细看。
游魂主不长久，三冲主不安定。
en: Once the engagement is made, in asking whether taking up the post is auspicious:
the three clashes, and the seat at the inkstone is hard to keep to the end; Wealth fallen, and the tuition gift is not generous;

the Other Void, and there is no will to honour the teacher and the Way; the Other controlling the Self, and there is a suspicion of slighting the teacher; the Other broken, scattered or extinct, and there is a heart of idleness about study;
only Six-Combine, thriving Wealth and the Other generating the Self are auspicious.
The post is settled; in asking whether I shall be at ease in body and settled in mind there:
following into the tomb and helping the injury must not be committed;
the Self or the Subject Void, broken, scattered or extinct must not be met;
Pressure must not move;
if it moves, examine it by the five phases, the eight palaces, the six spirits and the stars.
Wandering Soul does not last, and the three clashes are unsettled.

zh: 艮由童仆产祸，兑由妇女生言，乾坤防老翁妪之憎，震巽慎小工技之谗，
坎惊盗，离惊火，八宫之约举也。
金丧，火非，土病，水失，木折，
咸池淫，天贼盗，官符讼，驿马迁，
yi: 鬼静就没有要戒备的，鬼动就有所忌：
艮宫是由童仆惹出祸，兑宫是由妇女生出闲话，乾、坤宫要防老翁老妇的憎恶，震、巽宫要慎防小工匠的谗言，
坎宫惊盗，离宫惊火，这是八宫的大略举例。
金主丧，火主是非，土主病，水主失，木主折；
咸池主淫，天贼主盗，官符主讼，驿马主迁。
这是五行和诸星的大略举例。
六神也是这样：玄武主遗失，
朱雀主毁谤，
青龙因嗜酒坏事，
白虎因兵、丧失利，
勾陈迟疑叹息、退缩郁闷，
螣蛇浮躁惊惶。
en: When Pressure is still there is nothing to guard against, when it moves there is something to avoid:
Gen, trouble starts from young servants; Dui, gossip comes from women; with Qian and Kun guard against the hatred of old men and old women; with Zhen and Xun beware of the slander of petty craftsmen;
Kan, alarm of thieves; Li, alarm of fire. This is a rough listing of the eight palaces.
Metal means mourning, Fire means disputes, Earth means illness, Water means loss, Wood means breakage;
the Peach Blossom means lewdness, the Heavenly Thief means theft, the Official Charge means lawsuits, and the Post Horse means moving away.
This is a rough listing of the five phases and the stars.
It is the same with the six spirits: the Dark Tortoise means losses,
the Vermilion Bird means slander,
the Azure Dragon spoils matters through fondness for wine,
the White Tiger loses advantage through soldiers and mourning,
Hook Earth means hesitation and sighing, withdrawal and gloom,
the Coiling Snake means restlessness and alarm.

title: 卜馆·设帐、附学、代席、辞馆：设帐应空则负笈无徒、财虚则馆谷不盛；问附来者同设帐、问代席者同成馆；辞馆以应为主人，应克世则主不从虽六冲不能解、应空散破绝则不遂虽游魂不可辞，惟应实及不克世者可以去

rule.yi: 设帐（开馆）会不会有人来跟着学：应空，就没有背着书箱来的学徒；财虚，馆谷（教书的酬金）就不丰盛。问学生来附读的，和设帐一样断；问代人坐席的，和成馆一样断。占辞馆，以应为主人：应克世，主人不依从；应空、散、破、绝，事情做不成；主人不依从，即使六冲也解不开；事情做不成，即使游魂又怎么辞得掉？只有应爻实（不空）、又不克世的，才可以离开。
rule.en: In asking whether, on opening a school, anyone will come to study: the Other Void, and no pupils come carrying their book-chests; Wealth empty, and the stipend for the post is not rich. In asking about pupils who come to attach themselves, judge as for opening a school; in asking about standing in for another, judge as for a post that comes off. In divining about resigning from a post, the Other is the master: the Other controlling the Self, and the master does not comply; the Other Void, scattered, broken or extinct, and it does not go through; when the master does not comply, even a six-clash cannot dissolve it; when it does not go through, even Wandering Soul, how can one resign? Only when the Other is solid and does not control the Self may one leave.

note.yi: 「设帐」是开馆教书，「负笈」是背着书箱（来求学），「馆榖」就是馆谷，指教书的酬金口粮。「附来者」是带着孩子来附在这个馆里读书的人。「代席」是替人坐馆。「主不遂」的「遂」是事情顺遂成就，这里指辞馆这件事做不成。辞馆本来是『世想走』，看的是东家肯不肯放：应克世是东家不依，应空散破绝是这件事落不了地，这两种情形即使卦是六冲（该散）、游魂（该迁），也走不成。「六冲」在别处主散，这里是反说：再散的卦，主人不依也解不开。
note.en: 'Shezhang' is opening a school to teach, 'fuji' is carrying a book-chest (to come to study), and 'guangu' is the stipend of grain for the teacher. 'Those who come to attach' are those who bring a child to read at this school. 'Daixi' is sitting in for another at his post. The 'sui' of 'the master does not sui' is a matter going through to success, here the resignation not getting done. Resigning is the Self wishing to leave, and what is looked at is whether the master will let go: the Other controlling the Self is the master not complying, and the Other Void, scattered, broken or extinct is the matter failing to land, so even in a six-clash (which should break up) or Wandering Soul (which should move on) one cannot get away. 'Six-clash' elsewhere means dispersal, and here it is put the other way: however scattering the hexagram, if the master does not comply it cannot be undone.

zh: 应空则负笈无徒，财虚则馆榖不盛。
应克世而不从，应空散破绝而不遂；
主不从虽六冲不能解，主不遂虽游魂安可辞，
惟应实及不克世者，可以去也。
yi: 设帐（开馆），会不会有人来跟着学？
应空，就没有背着书箱来的学徒；财虚，馆谷就不丰盛。
问学生来附读的，和设帐一样断。
问代人坐席的，和成馆一样断。
如果占辞馆，以应为主人，
应克世，主人不依从；应空、散、破、绝，事情做不成；
主人不依从，即使六冲也解不开；事情做不成，即使游魂又怎么辞得掉？
只有应实、又不克世的，才可以离开。
en: In opening a school, will anyone come to study?
If the Other is Void, no pupils come carrying their book-chests; if Wealth is empty, the stipend for the post is not rich.
In asking about those who come to attach themselves, judge as for opening a school.
In asking about standing in for another, judge as for a post that comes off.
In divining about resigning from a post, the Other is the master:
if the Other controls the Self, the master does not comply; if the Other is Void, scattered, broken or extinct, it does not go through;
when the master does not comply, even a six-clash cannot dissolve it; when it does not go through, even with Wandering Soul, how can one resign?
Only when the Other is solid and does not control the Self may one leave.

title: 卜馆·荐馆与攘馆：荐馆类于仗托，贞冲应坏则不力、克世则不忠；攘馆犹于夺婚，应破散空则彼谋不遂、克世则为其所夺

rule.yi: 占荐馆（托人推荐馆席），类似仗托（托人办事）：本卦六冲、应坏，他就不出力；应克世，他就不忠。占攘馆（有人谋夺馆席），如同占夺婚：应破、散、空，他的图谋不成；应克世，就被他夺走。
rule.en: In divining about recommending someone to a post it is like entrusting a matter to someone: if the original hexagram is a six-clash and the Other is damaged, he does not exert himself; if the Other controls the Self, he is not loyal. In divining about snatching a post it is like snatching a marriage: if the Other is broken, scattered or Void, his scheme does not succeed; if the Other controls the Self, one is robbed of it by him.

note.yi: 「荐馆」是托人把我（或别人）荐进某个馆，「仗托」是仗着别人去办（见 EL.134 起的仗托人力）。「贞冲」是本卦（贞）是六冲卦。「攘馆」按下面「彼谋不遂」读，是有人图谋夺我的馆；书里只用「犹于夺婚」一句交代，夺婚的断法见婚姻域。「克世而为其所夺」是应爻克世，我反而被夺了去。
note.en: 'Jianguan' is getting someone to recommend me (or another) into a post, and 'zhangtuo' is relying on another to see to it (see the entrustment of human help from EL.134). 'Zhenchong' is the original hexagram (zhen) being a six-clash hexagram. 'Rangguan', read by 'his scheme does not succeed' below, is someone plotting to snatch my post; the book gives it only the sentence 'as with snatching a marriage', and the method of snatching a marriage is in the Marriage domain. 'Controlling the Self and being robbed by him' is the Other line controlling the Self, so that I am the one robbed.

zh: 贞冲应坏则不力，克世则不忠。
应破散空，彼谋不遂，克世而为其所夺也。
yi: 占荐馆，类似仗托，
本卦六冲、应坏，他就不出力；应克世，他就不忠。
占攘馆，如同夺婚，
应破、散、空，他的图谋不成；应克世，就被他夺走。
en: In divining about recommending to a post, it is like entrusting a matter,
if the original hexagram is a six-clash and the Other is damaged he does not exert himself; if the Other controls the Self, he is not loyal.
In divining about snatching a post, it is like snatching a marriage:
if the Other is broken, scattered or Void, his scheme does not succeed; if it controls the Self, one is robbed of it by him.

title: 卜馆·选文刻书与卜徒好恶：选文刻书名用父母、利用妻财；卜徒三教用子孙、百工用应象，执贽之后分、束修未行则皆从应象；应克世其人矫罔、应空破散其人下劣、三冲无恒心、财空无礼币

rule.yi: 问选文刻书，用神有两个：求名用父母，求利用妻财。卜徒弟的好坏，用神也是两个：儒、释、道三教的师徒情谊同父子，所以用子孙；百工是为谋利学的，所以凭应象。不过执贽（行了拜师礼）之后，才有用子孙还是用应象的分别；束修还没送，就都从应象，这是三教、百工相同的。应克世，这个人矫饰欺罔；应空、破、散，这个人下劣；三冲，没有恒心；财空，没有礼金礼物。
rule.en: In asking about choosing texts and cutting blocks, the Subject is of two kinds: for fame Resource is used, for profit Wealth. In divining whether a disciple is good or bad the Subject is also of two kinds: the three teachings, Confucian, Buddhist and Daoist, have a bond of teacher and pupil like father and son, so Output is used; the hundred crafts are learned for gain, so the Other image is relied on. But it is after the formal presenting of gifts that there is the division between Output and the Other image; before the tuition gift is offered, all follow the Other image, and in this the three teachings and the hundred crafts are the same. The Other controlling the Self, and the person is deceitful; the Other Void, broken or scattered, and the person is base; the three clashes, and he has no constancy; Wealth Void, and he has no gift of money or goods.

note.yi: 「选文刻书」是选编文章、刻版印行，「名用父母」是为名声，父母是文书；「利用妻财」是为卖书得利。「三教」是儒释道，「百工」是各行手艺。「执贽」是学生向老师行拜师礼、送上见面礼；「束修」是一束干肉，后来指学生送给先生的酬金，「未行」是还没送。「应象」是用应爻来看这个人。这一条是『收徒』这一边：前面是我被人聘，这里是我收人做徒弟。「矫罔」是矫饰欺骗。「礼币」是礼金礼物。
note.en: 'Xuanwen keshu' is compiling essays and cutting blocks to print them, and 'fame uses Resource' is because Resource is documents, for the sake of reputation; 'profit uses Wealth' is for the gain from selling the books. The 'three teachings' are Confucianism, Buddhism and Daoism, and the 'hundred crafts' are the trades of every line. 'Zhizhi' is a pupil's formal ceremony of becoming a disciple and the first gift to the teacher; 'shuxiu' is a bundle of dried meat, later the fee a pupil gives his teacher, and 'not yet offered' is not yet given. 'The Other image' is using the Other line to look at this person. This entry is the side of taking disciples: earlier I am the one engaged, and here I am taking on someone as a disciple. 'Jiaowang' is deceit and false show. 'Libi' is gifts of money and goods.

zh: 有问选文刻书，其用有二：
三教谊同父子，故用子孙；
百工业以求利，故凭应象；
然执贽之后，有子孙应象之分，
束修未行，则皆从应象，此三教百工同也；
应克世而其人矫罔，应空破散而其人下劣，三冲而无恒心，财空而无礼币。
yi: 有人问选文刻书，用神有两个：
求名用父母，求利用妻财。
卜徒弟的好坏，用神也有两个：
三教的师徒情谊同于父子，所以用子孙；
百工是为谋利学业，所以凭应象。
不过行了拜师礼（执贽）之后，才有用子孙还是用应象的分别；
束修还没送，就都从应象，这是三教、百工相同的。
应克世，这个人矫饰欺罔；应空、破、散，这个人下劣；三冲，没有恒心；财空，没有礼金礼物。
en: If one asks about choosing texts and cutting blocks, the Subject is of two kinds:
for fame Resource is used, for profit Wealth.
In divining whether a disciple is good or bad, the Subject is also of two kinds:
the three teachings have a bond of teacher and pupil like father and son, so Output is used;
the hundred crafts are learned for gain, so the Other image is relied on.
But after the formal presenting of gifts there is the division between using Output and using the Other image;
before the tuition gift is offered, all follow the Other image, and in this the three teachings and the hundred crafts are the same.

The Other controlling the Self, and the person is deceitful; the Other Void, broken or scattered, and the person is base; the three clashes, and he has no constancy; Wealth Void, and he has no gift of money or goods.

title: 卜馆·幕馆、商馆与遇于何地：筮馆于衙幕及同业于富豪，看财官世应，喜其生合、忌彼空冲；筮遇于何地不取应而取财，财生之方、财动之宫乃可图，财属五行为其象，再参六神诸星

rule.yi: 占在衙门里做幕友，以及和富豪同业共事，看财、官、世、应，喜它们生、合，忌它们空、冲。占在什么地方遇到馆，就不取应爻，而取财：财长生的方位、财动所在的宫，才是可以去图谋的；财属哪一行，就是它的象。再参看六神、诸星。财动按宫来论，如财动在乾宫，宜往西北去；财静按长生来论，如财属金爻（金长生在巳，在东南），利涉东南；妻财临水，遇鱼盐一类的行业、江海之滨；妻财临木，遇花果的行当、山林之处；土是田野，火是城市，金是玉石；玄武主水、青龙主木，白虎主兵，朱雀主市，螣蛇主商，勾陈主医；天医主医使，华盖主僧从，都用财来考察。接受人家的聘请，以世应为先；替人家办事，以财利为务。
rule.en: In divining about a post as a secretary in a government office, or about working in the same trade as a rich man, look at Wealth, Pressure, the Self and the Other: it is good for them to generate and combine, and bad for them to be Void and clashed. In divining where one will meet a post, one does not take the Other line but takes Wealth: the quarter where Wealth is born and the palace where Wealth moves are where one can make plans, and the phase Wealth belongs to is its image. Then consult the six spirits and the stars. When Wealth moves, judge by the palace: if Wealth moves in the palace of Qian, go to the north-west; when Wealth is still, judge by Birth: if Wealth is a Metal line (Metal is born at Si, in the south-east), the south-east is favourable. Wealth on Water meets trades of fish and salt and the shores of river and sea; Wealth on Wood meets the flower-and-fruit trade and the mountain forest; Earth looks for fields, Fire for towns, Metal for jade and stone; the Dark Tortoise is water, the Azure Dragon is wood, the White Tiger is soldiers, the Vermilion Bird is markets, the Coiling Snake is merchants and Hook Earth is doctors; the Heavenly Doctor is physicians and messengers, the Canopy is monks and followers; all are examined by Wealth. In accepting a person's invitation the Self and the Other come first; in serving a person's affairs, Wealth and profit are the business.

note.yi: 「衙幕」是衙门里的幕友（师爷），「同业于富豪」是在富商豪门的行当里共事，这两样就是章首十三问里的「幕馆」「商馆」。「遇于何地」是在哪个地方能遇到馆。「则不以应而财」一句，「而」字下原文疑脱一字（当是「取」或「以」），按文意译作「不取应而取财」。「财生之方」按文意是财的长生所在的方位，「财动之宫」是财爻动在哪一宫、那一宫所主的方位：动用宫、静用生，这就是注里「财动论宫、财静论生」。书里的例子：财动乾宫，乾在西北，宜趋西北；财是金爻，金长生在巳，巳在东南，所以利涉东南。「武水龙木，虎兵雀市，蛇商勾医」是六神各配一个行业；「天医医使，华盖僧从」是两个神煞。收尾「纳人之请，世应为先，服人之事，财利为务」是总括：被人聘用看世应，替人办事看财利。
note.en: 'Yamu' is a secretary in a government office, and 'working in the same trade as a rich man' is working in the line of a rich merchant's or magnate's house; these two are the 'muguan' and 'shangguan' of the thirteen questions at the head of the chapter. 'Yu yu hedi' is where one can meet a post. In the sentence 'ze bu yi ying er cai' a character seems to be missing below 'er' (presumably 'qu' or 'yi'), and by the sense it is translated 'does not take the Other but takes Wealth'. 'The quarter where Wealth is born', by the sense, is the quarter of Wealth's Birth, and 'the palace Wealth moves in' is the direction governed by the palace in which the Wealth line moves: for a moving line the palace is used, for a still one Birth, which is what the note means by 'Wealth moving, judge by the palace; Wealth still, judge by Birth'. The examples in the book: Wealth moving in Qian, which is in the north-west, one should go north-west; Wealth a Metal line, Metal being born at Si, which is in the south-east, so crossing to the south-east is favourable. 'Wu shui long mu, hu bing que shi, she shang gou yi' gives each of the six spirits a trade; 'tian yi yi shi, hua gai seng cong' are two spirit-stars. The closing 'in accepting a person's invitation the Self and the Other come first, in serving a person's affairs Wealth and profit are the business' sums it up: when engaged by someone, look at the Self and the Other; when working for someone, look at Wealth and profit.

zh: 若筮馆于衙幕，及同业于富豪，
财官世应，喜其生合，忌彼空冲。
财生之方，财动之宫，乃可图也，
yi: 如果占在衙门里做幕友，以及和富豪同业共事，
看财、官、世、应，喜它们生、合，忌它们空、冲。
如果占在什么地方遇到馆，
就不取应而取财，
财长生的方位、财动所在的宫，才是可以去图谋的，
财属哪一行，就是它的象。
再参看六神、诸星。
en: In divining about a post as a secretary in a government office, or about working in the same trade as a rich man,
look at Wealth, Pressure, the Self and the Other: it is good for them to generate and combine, and bad for them to be Void and clashed.
In divining where one will meet a post,
one does not take the Other but takes Wealth,
the quarter where Wealth is born and the palace where Wealth moves are where one can make plans,
and the phase Wealth belongs to is its image.
Then consult the six spirits and the stars.

zh: 财动论宫，如财动乾宫，宜趋西北；
财静论生，如财属金爻，利涉东南；
妻财临水，遇鱼盐之业、江海之滨，
妻财临木，遇花果之行、山林之所，
土觅田野，火觅城市，金觅玉石；
武水龙木，虎兵雀市，蛇商勾医；
天医医使，华盖僧从，皆以财考也。
纳人之请，世应为先，服人之事，财利为务。
yi: 财动按宫来论，如财动在乾宫，宜往西北去；
财静按长生来论，如财属金爻，利涉东南；
妻财临水，遇鱼盐一类的行业、江海之滨；
妻财临木，遇花果的行当、山林之处；
土是田野，火是城市，金是玉石；
玄武主水，青龙主木，白虎主兵，朱雀主市，螣蛇主商，勾陈主医；
天医主医使，华盖主僧从，都用财来考察。
接受人家的聘请，以世应为先；替人家办事，以财利为务。
en: When Wealth moves, judge by the palace: if Wealth moves in the palace of Qian, one should go to the north-west;
when Wealth is still, judge by Birth: if Wealth is a Metal line, crossing to the south-east is favourable;
Wealth on Water meets trades of fish and salt and the shores of river and sea;
Wealth on Wood meets the flower-and-fruit trade and mountain forest;
Earth looks for fields, Fire for towns, Metal for jade and stone;
the Dark Tortoise is water, the Azure Dragon is wood, the White Tiger is soldiers, the Vermilion Bird is markets, the Coiling Snake is merchants, and Hook Earth is doctors;
the Heavenly Doctor is physicians and messengers, the Canopy is monks and followers, and all are examined by Wealth.
In accepting a person's invitation the Self and the Other come first; in serving a person's affairs, Wealth and profit are the business.

title: 请荫请封：戒五爻之伤世及官鬼之克身；父为玉牒不可破空、世是谋躬不可虚陷；为父母子妻代求则世空不忌

rule.yi: 请荫（请求让子孙凭父祖的官阶得官）、请封（请求给父母妻室封赠诰命），要戒备五爻伤世，以及官鬼克身。父爻是玉牒（封荫的凭据），不可破、空；世是为自身谋划的，不可虚、陷。如果是替父母、子、妻求的，世空就不忌。
rule.en: In asking for hereditary privilege (a descendant entering office on the strength of a forefather's rank) or for the conferment of titles (honours for parents and wife), guard against the fifth line harming the Self and against Pressure controlling the Body. The Resource line is the jade register (the document on which such grants rest), and must not be broken or Void; the Self is the one who plans for himself, and must not be empty or fallen. If it is sought on behalf of parents, sons or wife, the Self being Void is not feared.

note.yi: 「请荫」是请求让子孙凭父祖的官阶得到官职，「请封」是请求给父母、妻室封赠诰命（恩封诰命另见易林补遗 EL.94 起）。「五爻」是君位，五爻伤世是君上不予恩典。「玉牒」本是皇室的谱牒，这里指封荫所凭的文书，所以以父爻为玉牒。「谋躬」是为自身谋划。书里自注：替父母、子、妻求时，世空不忌，因为这时世不是为自己求。这一章前半（L1375–1389）讲求名、发案、廷试、武试，那些归考试；从「请荫请封」起讲的是官职荣典，归事业。
note.en: 'Qing yin' is asking that a descendant obtain office on the strength of a forefather's rank, and 'qing feng' is asking for the conferment of titles on parents and wife (conferment of titles is also treated in the Yilin Buyi from EL.94). The 'fifth line' is the sovereign's place, and the fifth line harming the Self is the sovereign withholding his favour. 'Yupie' was the imperial genealogy, and here it means the document on which such grants rest, so the Resource line is taken as the jade register. 'Mougong' is planning for oneself. The book's own gloss: when it is sought for parents, sons or wife, the Self being Void is not feared, because then the Self is not seeking for himself. The first half of this chapter (L1375–1389) deals with seeking a name, the posting of results, the palace examination and the military examination, and belongs under Examinations; from 'asking for hereditary privilege and conferment' on it is about official honours and belongs under Career.

zh: 请荫请封，戒五爻之伤世，及官鬼之克身。
yi: 请荫、请封，要戒备五爻伤世，以及官鬼克身。
父爻是玉牒，不可破、空；
世是为自身谋划的，不可虚、陷。
en: In asking for hereditary privilege or the conferment of titles, guard against the fifth line harming the Self, and against Pressure controlling the Body.
The Resource line is the jade register, and must not be broken or Void;
the Self is the one who plans for himself, and must not be empty or fallen.

zh: 如为父母子妻，则世空不忌。
yi: 如果是替父母、子、妻求的，那么世空就不忌。
en: If it is sought on behalf of parents, sons or wife, then the Self being Void is not feared.

title: 投麾效力与入伍从军：投麾贞冲鬼动不录、官爻空破散绝不用，为名官旺为佳、为利财官并重，世不可病官不可克；入伍从军以身命为要，世象强良则冒锋镝成功、官爻旺相则拔行伍拜爵，官克世助伤随墓弗宜见

rule.yi: 投到将帅麾下效力：本卦六冲、鬼动，就不被录用；官爻空、破、散、绝，就不被任用；为名，官旺才好；为利，财、官并重；世不可病，官不可被克。入伍从军，以身体性命为要：世象强而好，冒着锋镝也能成功；官爻旺相，从行伍中被提拔、拜爵；官爻克世、助伤随墓，都不宜见到。
rule.en: In going to serve under a commander's banner: if the original hexagram is a six-clash or Pressure moves, one is not taken on; if the Pressure line is Void, broken, scattered or extinct, one is not employed; for the sake of a name, thriving Pressure is good; for profit, Wealth and Pressure count equally; the Self must not be sick, and Pressure must not be controlled. In enlisting in the ranks, body and life are what matter: if the Self image is strong and good, one braves blades and arrows and succeeds; if the Pressure line is thriving, one is raised from the ranks and granted rank; the Pressure line controlling the Self, helping the injury and following into the tomb should not be seen.

note.yi: 「投麾」是投到将帅的麾（军旗）下效力。「贞冲」是本卦（贞）是六冲卦。「鬼动则不录」的「鬼」就是官鬼：要被录用，官鬼要静、要旺，动了反而不稳。「锋镝」是刀锋和箭头，「行伍」是军队的队列，「拜爵」是授予爵位。「助伤随墓」是帮着官鬼伤世、跟着官鬼入墓，与本章军机的「随官入墓、助鬼伤身」（YM.13）同一类忌。和易林补遗袭求武弁（EL.62 起）、黄金策仕宦的出征剿捕（HJC.24）可对着看。
note.en: 'Touhui' is going to serve under the 'hui', the banner, of a commander. 'Zhenchong' is the original hexagram (zhen) being a six-clash hexagram. The 'gui' of 'Pressure moving is not taken on' is the Pressure line: to be taken on, Pressure should be still and thriving, and moving it is unsteady. 'Fengdi' is blade and arrowhead, 'hangwu' is the ranks of an army, and 'baijue' is being granted a title of rank. 'Helping the injury and following into the tomb' is helping Pressure to injure the Self and following Pressure into the tomb, the same taboo as 'following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body' in the military chapter (YM.13). Compare the Yilin Buyi on seeking military office (from EL.62) and the Huangjin Ce on marching out to subdue (HJC.24).

zh: 贞冲鬼动则不录，官爻空破散绝则不用，
为名则官旺为佳，为利则财官并重，
世象强良，冒锋镝而成功，
官爻旺相，拔行伍而拜爵，
官爻克世、助伤随墓，弗宜见之。
yi: 投到将帅麾下效力，
本卦六冲、鬼动，就不被录用；官爻空、破、散、绝，就不被任用；
为名，官旺才好；为利，财、官并重；
世不可病，官不可被克。
入伍从军，以身体性命为要：
世象强而好，冒着锋镝也能成功；
官爻旺相，从行伍中被提拔、拜爵；
官爻克世、助伤随墓，都不宜见到。
en: In going to serve under a commander's banner,
if the original hexagram is a six-clash or Pressure moves, one is not taken on; if the Pressure line is Void, broken, scattered or extinct, one is not employed;
for the sake of a name, thriving Pressure is good; for profit, Wealth and Pressure count equally;
the Self must not be sick, and Pressure must not be controlled.
In enlisting in the ranks, body and life are what matter:
if the Self image is strong and good, one braves blades and arrows and succeeds;
if the Pressure line is thriving, one is raised from the ranks and granted rank;
the Pressure line controlling the Self, helping the injury and following into the tomb should not be seen.

title: 署篆委镇：筮成类谋差、筮利同服役；世应空、贞合冲及官病皆不可，官坏财虚徒劳驰骤，官来克世虑衅生

rule.yi: 代理印信、受委派镇守的人，占成不成，类似谋差使；世应空、本卦合处逢冲，以及官爻有病，都不可。占有没有利，和服役相同：官坏、财虚，只是白费奔走；官来克世，还要担心（此处一字不清）生出事端。
rule.en: For one acting with the seal or commissioned to a garrison, divining whether it comes off is like seeking a commission; the Self and the Other Void, a combination in the original hexagram being clashed, and Pressure being sick are all unacceptable. Divining about profit is the same as for serving in a duty: with Pressure damaged and Wealth empty one only wears oneself out galloping about; if Pressure comes to control the Self, one must also fear that (one character is unclear) strife arises.

note.yi: 「署篆」是代理印信，暂代某官的职务；「委镇」是被委派去镇守一处。「谋差」「服役」是前面谋差顶役（EL.106 起）里的两种占：谋差是求差使，服役是当差。「贞合冲」按文意是本卦里本来合住的，又被冲。「驰骤」是奔走。「且虑？衅生」里的「？」是书里自己标的存疑字，按文意译作「还要担心（此处一字不清）生出事端」。
note.en: 'Shuzhuan' is acting with the seal, standing in for an official for a time, and 'weizhen' is being commissioned to hold a post as garrison. 'Seeking a commission' and 'serving in a duty' are the two divinations in the earlier entries on seeking a commission and taking a runner's place (from EL.106): seeking a commission is asking for the post, and serving is doing the duty. 'Zhen he chong', by the sense, is a combination in the original hexagram that is then clashed. 'Chizhou' is running about. The '?' in 'qie lu ? xin sheng' is a doubtful character marked by the book itself, and by the sense it is translated 'one must also fear that (one character is unclear) strife arises'.

zh: 署篆委镇者，筮成类谋差，
世应空、贞合冲，及官不可病，
yi: 代理印信、受委镇守的人，占成不成，类似谋差使；
世应空、本卦合处逢冲，以及官有病，都不可；
占有没有利，和服役相同：官坏、财虚，
只是白费奔走；
官来克世，还要担心（此处一字不清）生出事端。
en: For one acting with the seal or commissioned to a garrison, divining whether it comes off is like seeking a commission;
the Self and the Other Void, a combination in the original hexagram being clashed, and Pressure being sick are all unacceptable;
divining about profit is the same as for serving in a duty: with Pressure damaged and Wealth empty,
one only wears oneself out galloping about;
if Pressure comes to control the Self, one must also fear that (one character is unclear) strife arises.

title: 仕途大象：已食禄于朝而筮仕途，皆以官为用神，喜居日月旺相、生扶拱合，忌破空散绝（空失职、破败事、绝解任、散削籍）；子孙动防公议、兄弟发减俸粮；官临长生帝旺临官则宦途远达升迁、衰墓死绝则官道否；进神升爵、退神降级；泄气动而元神静则升信杳然、元神发而用象摇则迁音乃至

rule.yi: 已经在朝廷食禄的人占仕途，都以官为用神：喜它在日、月上，人们仰仗它的照临；喜它旺相，像万物沾到及时雨；喜它逢生、扶、拱、合，如同倚着长城奔驰在康庄大道上；忌它逢破、空、散、绝——空就失职，破就败事，绝就解任，散就削籍。子孙动，要防公议，按衰旺定轻重；兄弟发，要减俸粮，按喜忌说吉凶。官临长生，知道宦途远大通达；逢帝旺、临官，知道仕路有升迁；逢衰、墓、死、绝，知道官道不通；进神就升爵升阶，退神就降禄降级。变墓绝而动爻得生扶、被日月克而动爻变生，都是安稳之象。泄气的爻动而元神静，升迁的消息杳无；元神发动、用象摇动，调迁的音信就到了。
rule.en: Having already eaten the Son of Heaven's salary, in divining the official career one takes Pressure as the Subject throughout: it is good when it sits on the Day or the Month, for people look up to its shining down; good when it is thriving or strong, like things receiving the timely rain; good when it meets generation, support, enclosing and combination, like leaning on a great wall while racing along a broad highway; bad when it meets broken, Void, scattered or extinct: Void loses office, broken ruins affairs, extinct dissolves the post, scattered strikes the name from the rolls. Output moving, guard against public criticism, and tell heavy from light by decline and thriving; Peer issuing cuts the salary grain, and good or ill is told by what is welcome and what is feared. Pressure at Birth, one knows the official road will go far and clear; at Peak or at Taking Office, one knows there will be promotion; at decline, tomb, death or extinction, one knows the official way is blocked; Advancing means rank and grade go up, Retreating means salary and grade go down. Changing into tomb or extinction while the moving line is generated and supported, or being controlled by the Day and Month while the moving line changes into generation, are all signs of safety. If the line that drains it moves while its Support is still, news of promotion is faint; if the Support issues and the image of the Subject stirs, word of a transfer arrives.

note.yi: 「食禄于天家」是在朝廷领俸禄，也就是已经在官位上的人（和未仕求官的相对）。「日月」是日辰、月建。「照临」是日月照下来，这里指官爻受到日、月的临照。「拱」是两爻夹拱出中间一位。「康庄」是四通八达的大路。「削籍」是除名。「公议」是舆论和同僚的议论，「罚俸」是扣俸禄；「傣粮」疑是「俸粮」之误。「长生」「帝旺」「临官」是十二长生里的位置（临官是第四位，不是指官爻）；「进神」「退神」见术语表。「泄气动」按五行生克是泄官鬼之气的爻动：官鬼生父母，所以是父母爻（书里没有点明）；「元神」是生官鬼的妻财。注里「子乃官之忌神」是说子孙克官鬼，子旺官衰官就受祸；「官得三象贪生」按文意是：子孙动本来克官，但它动了要去生妻财、妻财又生官，子孙『贪生』而忘了克，官反得生，所以大吉；「三象」书里没有再注，这里按字面译。这一条与黄金策仕宦的总则（HJC.01、HJC.02）、易林补遗仕宦升迁（EL.55 起）取同一套：官鬼是官，妻财是俸，子孙伤官，兄弟减俸。
note.en: 'Shilu yu tianjia' is receiving salary from the imperial house, that is, someone already in office (as opposed to one not yet in office who seeks it). 'Day and Month' are the Day branch and the Month branch. 'Zhaolin' is the Day and Month shining down, here the Pressure line receiving the shining of the Day and Month. 'Gong' is two lines enclosing the one between them. 'Kangzhuang' is a broad road open in every direction. 'Xueji' is being struck from the register. 'Gongyi' is public opinion and the criticism of colleagues, and 'fafeng' is a fine of salary; 'tiliang' is presumably a slip for 'fengliang', salary grain. Birth, Peak and Taking Office are places in the twelve stages of life (Taking Office is the fourth, and does not mean the Pressure line); Advancing and Retreating are in the glossary. 'The line that drains it moves', by the generating and controlling of the phases, is the line that drains Pressure moving: Pressure generates Resource, so it is the Resource line (the book does not say so); the 'Support' is Wealth, which generates Pressure. The note's 'Output is the Adversary of Pressure' says that Output controls Pressure, and when Output is thriving and Pressure weak Pressure suffers harm; 'Pressure obtains the three images coveting generation' is, by the sense: Output moving would control Pressure, but it moves to generate Wealth and Wealth in turn generates Pressure, so Output 'covets generating' and forgets to control, Pressure is instead generated, and it is greatly auspicious; the book does not gloss the 'three images', and it is translated by the letter. This entry takes the same set as the general principles of the Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.01, HJC.02) and the Yilin Buyi on promotion (from EL.55): Pressure is the office, Wealth is the salary, Output injures the office, Peer cuts the salary.

zh: 既食禄于天家，而筮仕途，皆以官为用神，
喜居日月，人仰照临，喜居旺相，物沾时雨，
喜值生扶拱合，如倚长城而驰康庄，
忌值破空散绝，空则失职，破则败事，绝则解任，散则削籍矣。
子孙动而防公议，别衰旺以定重轻，
兄弟发而减傣粮，分喜忌以言凶吉。
长生官而知宦境之远达，帝旺临官而知仕路之升迁，
衰墓死绝，而知官道之否，
进神则升爵升阶，退神则降禄降级。
变墓绝而动生扶，日月克而动变生，皆为安象。
泄气动而元神静，升信杳然，
元神发而用象摇，迁音乃至。
yi: 已经在朝廷食禄的人占仕途，都以官为用神；
喜它居日、月，人们仰仗它的照临；喜它居旺相，像万物沾到及时雨；
喜它逢生、扶、拱、合，如同倚着长城奔驰在康庄大道上；
忌它逢破、空、散、绝：空就失职，破就败事，绝就解任，散就削籍。
子孙动，要防公议，按衰旺定轻重；
兄弟发，要减俸粮，按喜忌说吉凶。
官临长生，知道宦途远大通达；逢帝旺、临官，知道仕路有升迁；
逢衰、墓、死、绝，知道官道不通；
进神就升爵升阶，退神就降禄降级。
变入墓、绝而动爻得生扶，被日月克而动爻变生，都是安稳之象。
泄气的爻动而元神静，升迁的消息杳无；
元神发动而用象摇动，调迁的音信就到了。
en: Having already eaten the Son of Heaven's salary, in divining the official career one takes Pressure as the Subject throughout;
it is good when it sits on the Day or the Month, for people look up to its shining down; good when it is thriving or strong, like things receiving the timely rain;
good when it meets generation, support, enclosing and combination, like leaning on a great wall while racing along a broad highway;
bad when it meets broken, Void, scattered or extinct: Void loses office, broken ruins affairs, extinct dissolves the post, scattered strikes the name from the rolls.
When Output moves, guard against public criticism, and tell heavy from light by decline and thriving;
when Peer issues, the salary grain is cut, and good or ill is told by what is welcome and what is feared.
With Pressure at Birth, one knows the official road will go far and clear; at Peak or at Taking Office, one knows there will be promotion on the road of service;
at decline, tomb, death or extinction, one knows the official way is blocked;
Advancing means rank and grade go up, Retreating means salary and grade go down.
Changing into tomb or extinction while the moving line is generated and supported, or being controlled by the Day and Month while the moving line changes into generation, are all signs of safety.
If the line that drains it moves while its Support is still, news of promotion is faint;
if the Support issues and the image of the Subject stirs, word of a transfer arrives.

zh: 子乃官之忌神，动则克官，
兄弟非官鬼所忌，但嫌克官之元神，应见罚傣降级之忧。
爻得官鬼独旺，不用元神，亦当顺利升擢。
卦中或遇子财皆动，官得三象贪生，反属大吉。
yi: 子是官的忌神，动了就克官；
如果官旺子衰，或许有小过失；
如果子旺官衰，就要受它的祸。
兄弟并不是官鬼所忌，但嫌它克官的元神，应当有罚俸降级的忧虑。
爻里官鬼独旺，不用元神，也该顺利升擢。
卦里如果子孙、妻财都动，官得到三象贪生，反而是大吉。
en: Output is the Adversary of Pressure, and when it moves it controls Pressure;
if Pressure is thriving and Output weak, there may be a small fault;
if Output is thriving and Pressure weak, one suffers its harm.
Peer is not what Pressure fears, but it is disliked for controlling the Support of Pressure, and one may expect the worry of a fine of salary or a drop in grade.
If among the lines Pressure alone is thriving, there is no need for its Support, and one should still be promoted smoothly.
If in the hexagram Output and Wealth both move, and Pressure obtains the 'three images' coveting generation, it is on the contrary greatly auspicious.

title: 仕途自占世爻不可空（空则当升未迁、有位无司、在任居闲、带罪立功，他占不拘）；随官入墓助鬼伤身为宦所忌；六合六冲非所忌，冲而旺相淹三月、合而休囚滞五年；晋升为吉屯蹇为凶亦不可遗

rule.yi: 自己占的，世爻不可空：空了，就是该升而没有迁、有位而无职司、在任而闲居、带着罪而立功；替别人占就不是这样。随官入墓、助鬼伤身，是仕宦所忌的，不论衰旺都凶。六合、六冲不是仕宦所忌的：冲而旺相，只是三个月的耽搁；合而休囚，就是五年的停滞。还有晋、升两卦为吉，屯、蹇两卦为凶，也不可遗漏。
rule.en: In divining for oneself the Self line must not be Void: if it is Void, one who should be promoted is not moved, one holds rank without office, is in post but idle, or serves to atone while under a charge; for another it is not so. Following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body are what an official career fears, and whether weak or thriving they are ominous. Six-Combine and six-clash are not what an official career fears: if clashed but thriving, it is only a delay of three months; if combined but resting or imprisoned, it is a stagnation of five years. Moreover, Jin and Sheng are auspicious and Zhun and Jian are ominous, and these must not be left out either.

dispute.yi: 这一条把晋、升、屯、蹇四个卦象直接当作断语，注里还说「无论官鬼」，和易林补遗朝天面旨（EL.92）一样；增删卜易野鹤（ZS.07）的看法不同：晋、升也要世爻得地，屯、蹇只要世爻旺相就没有妨碍。也就是说：易冒、易林补遗把卦名放在前面，野鹤把卦名放在世爻旺衰的后面。
dispute.en: This entry takes the four images Jin, Sheng, Zhun and Jian directly as verdicts, and its note adds 'regardless of Pressure', as does the Yilin Buyi on the audience at court (EL.92); the Zengshan Buyi of Yehe (ZS.07) differs: Jin and Sheng also need the Self to be well placed, while Zhun and Jian do no harm so long as the Self is thriving. That is: the Yimao and the Yilin Buyi put the hexagram name first, while Yehe puts the hexagram name behind the strength of the Self.

note.yi: 「自占世爻」是为自己占，世爻代表自己；「他占则否」是替别人占，世空不算数。「有位而无司」是有官位而没有职掌，「带罪立功」是身上有处分、立了功才免。「淹」是久留不动。「随官入墓、助鬼伤身」是官鬼入墓、再帮官鬼伤自己（见 YM.13）。「六合六冲，非仕宦之所忌」是说仕途不以合冲为凶：冲了只是耽搁三个月，合而休囚是停滞五年，耽搁的长短由旺衰定。「晋」「升」「屯」「蹇」是四个卦名：晋是前进，升是上升，屯、蹇是艰难。和易林补遗仕宦升迁的世空一条（EL.59）、黄金策的世动逢空（HJC.08）可对照。
note.en: 'Divining for oneself the Self line' is divining for oneself, the Self line standing for oneself; 'for another it is not so' is that when divining for another a Void Self does not count. 'Holding rank without office' is having an official place but no charge, and 'serving to atone' is being under a penalty that is lifted only on achieving merit. 'Yan' is being kept long without moving. 'Following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body' is Pressure entering the tomb and then helping Pressure to injure oneself (see YM.13). 'Six-Combine and six-clash are not what an official career fears' says that in an official career combining and clashing are not taken as ominous: clashed it is only a delay of three months, combined but resting it is a stagnation of five years, and the length of the delay is set by strength. Jin, Sheng, Zhun and Jian are four hexagram names: Jin is advance, Sheng is rising, and Zhun and Jian are hardship. Compare the entry on the Self Void in the Yilin Buyi on promotion (EL.59) and the Huangjin Ce on the Self moving into Void (HJC.08).

zh: 空则当升而未迁，有位而无司，在任而居闲，带罪而立功也，
随官入墓，助鬼伤身，仕宦之所忌也，
六合六冲，非仕宦之所忌，
犹有晋升为吉，屯蹇为凶，亦不可遗也。
yi: 自己占的，世爻不可空；
空了，就是该升而没有迁、有位而无职司、在任而闲居、带着罪而立功。
替别人占就不是这样。
随官入墓、助鬼伤身，是仕宦所忌的，
不论衰旺都凶。
六合、六冲不是仕宦所忌的：
冲而旺相，只是三个月的耽搁；
合而休囚，就是五年的停滞。
还有晋、升两卦为吉，屯、蹇两卦为凶，也不可遗漏。
en: In divining for oneself the Self line must not be Void;
if it is Void, one who should be promoted is not moved, one holds rank without office, is in post but idle, or serves to atone while under a charge.
For another it is not so.
Following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body are what an official career fears,
and whether weak or thriving they are ominous.
Six-Combine and six-clash are not what an official career fears:
if clashed but thriving, it is only a delay of three months;
if combined but resting or imprisoned, it is a stagnation of five years.
Moreover, Jin and Sheng are auspicious and Zhun and Jian are ominous, and these must not be left out either.

zh: 凡占晋升屯蹇四象，值言吉凶，
yi: 凡是占到晋、升、屯、蹇这四个卦象，遇到了就说吉凶，
不论官鬼怎样。
en: Whenever one divines and gets one of the four images Jin, Sheng, Zhun and Jian, one speaks of good or ill by them,
regardless of Pressure.

title: 问升迁：日月之官则超迁、旺相之官则平升、休囚之官则未转；旺相而动尤速、休囚而静更迟；遇空失望、遇破阻谋、遇散枉求、遇绝难始、遇世空则占不遂；官伏得助亦升、子动得日月亦升、冲合得交重亦升、随助得旺相亦升；专看官爻，代占不忌世空

rule.yi: 问升迁：占得官爻在日、月上，就是越级升迁；得到旺相的官，就是按常规升；得到休囚的官，就是还没转动。旺相又动，尤其快；休囚又静，更迟。遇空就失望，遇破就阻碍图谋，遇散就白求，遇绝就难开始，遇世空，这一占就不会如愿。不要说官伏就不升，得到生助也升；不要说子动就不升，得日月相助也升；不要说被冲被合就不升，有动爻也升；不要说随墓助伤就不升，得旺相也升。只看官爻；替别人占，就不忌世空。
rule.en: In asking about promotion: if one gets the Pressure line on the Day or the Month, it is promotion over the heads of others; if one gets thriving, strong Pressure, it is promotion in the ordinary course; if one gets resting, imprisoned Pressure, there is not yet a move. Thriving and moving is especially fast; resting and still is slower still. Meeting Void, one is disappointed; meeting broken, the plan is obstructed; meeting scattered, the seeking is in vain; meeting extinct, it is hard to begin; and with the Self Void the divination does not come to pass. Do not say that Pressure hidden means no promotion: with help it is promoted too; do not say that Output moving means none: with the Day and Month it is promoted too; do not say that being clashed or combined means none: with a moving line it is promoted too; do not say that following into the tomb and helping the injury means none: with thriving strength it is promoted too. Look only at the Pressure line; in divining for another, the Self being Void is not feared.

note.yi: 「日月之官」是官爻的地支正是当日（日辰）或当月（月建）的地支，书里说这样是「超迁」（越级提拔）；旺相的官是「平升」（按资格依次升）；休囚的官是「未转」（还没轮到）。「枉求」是白求。「交重」是动爻。「毋谓……亦升」四句是反着说：官伏、子动、冲合、随助本来都是不利的信号，但只要另有日月、动爻或旺相相救，仍然会升；可见这四样不是一票否决。「随助」是「随墓助伤」的缩写。书里自注：只看官爻；替别人占，世空不忌（因为世不代表占的人自己）。和易林补遗仕宦升迁（EL.55）、易隐升迁（YY.21）、黄金策的官爻隐伏（HJC.06）可对着看。
note.en: 'Pressure on the Day or the Month' is a Pressure line whose branch is just the branch of the day or the month, which the book says gives 'chaoqian', promotion over the heads of others; thriving Pressure is 'pingsheng', promotion in the ordinary course by seniority; resting, imprisoned Pressure is 'weizhuan', not yet turned, its turn not come. 'Wangqiu' is seeking in vain. 'Jiaozhong' is a moving line. The four sentences 'do not say ... it is promoted too' are put the other way round: Pressure hidden, Output moving, clash or combination, and following into the tomb and helping the injury are all unfavourable signs, but so long as the Day and Month, a moving line or thriving strength comes to the rescue, one is still promoted, so these four are not a single-vote veto. 'Suizhu' is short for 'following into the tomb and helping the injury'. The book's own gloss: look only at the Pressure line; in divining for another, the Self being Void is not feared (because the Self does not stand for the diviner himself). Compare the Yilin Buyi on promotion (EL.55), the Yi Yin on promotion (YY.21) and the Huangjin Ce on Pressure hidden (HJC.06).

zh: 问升迁，卜得日月之官，则超迁也，
旺相而动尤速也，休囚而静更迟也。
遇空失望，遇破阻谋，遇散枉求，遇绝难始，遇世空而弗遂其占也。
yi: 问升迁：占得官爻在日、月上，就是越级升迁；
得到旺相的官，就是按常规升；
得到休囚的官，就是还没转动。
旺相又动，尤其快；休囚又静，更迟。
遇空就失望，遇破就阻碍图谋，遇散就白求，遇绝就难开始，遇世空，这一占就不会如愿。
不要说官伏就不升，得到生助也升；
不要说子动就不升，得日月相助也升；
不要说被冲被合就不升，有动爻也升；
不要说随墓助伤就不升，得旺相也升。
en: In asking about promotion, if one gets Pressure on the Day or the Month, it is promotion over the heads of others;
if one gets thriving, strong Pressure, it is promotion in the ordinary course;
if one gets resting, imprisoned Pressure, there is not yet a move.
Thriving and moving is especially fast; resting and still is slower still.

Meeting Void, one is disappointed; meeting broken, the plan is obstructed; meeting scattered, the seeking is in vain; meeting extinct, it is hard to begin; and with the Self Void the divination does not come to pass.
Do not say that Pressure hidden means no promotion: with help it is promoted too;
do not say that Output moving means none: with the Day and Month it is promoted too;
do not say that being clashed or combined means none: with a moving line it is promoted too;
do not say that following into the tomb and helping the injury means none: with thriving strength it is promoted too.

yi: 只看官爻；
替别人占，就不忌世空。
en: Look only at the Pressure line;
in divining for another, the Self being Void is not feared.

title: 升何时：值月为法，逢生旺则会推、遇扶助则高擢；再筮是期世实官崇；两官一强一弱以弱者值月为期，一官必求值月，长生临官有气亦可升、生助之月亦然，而以值月为最、长生次之

rule.yi: 它什么时候升？以官爻自己的月份（值月）为法：逢生旺就会被会推（联名推举），遇扶助就高升。再占确切的日期：世爻实、官爻崇旺，就不是别的日子，就是那一天。如果有两个官爻、一强一弱，那个弱的值月就升，例如亥月壬戌日占调迁得丰卦，到季冬才升。只有一个官爻，一定要求它值月，可以占验；官在长生、临官而有气，也可以升迁，生它、助它的月份也一样，但都不如值月最好，长生次之。
rule.en: When will the promotion come? The rule is to take the month in which the Pressure line is on duty (its own month): meeting generation and thriving, one is put forward by joint recommendation; meeting support, one is raised high. To divine again for the exact date: when the Self is solid and Pressure exalted, it is no other day, but that very one. If there are two Pressure lines, one strong and one weak, the promotion comes when the weak one meets its month; for example in a Hai month on a Ren-Xu day, divining about a transfer, one got Feng, and the promotion came only in the last month of winter. With a single Pressure line one must seek its own month, and it can then be tested; if it is at Birth or Taking Office with force, one can also be promoted, and the months that generate and support it are the same, but none is as good as its own month, with Birth second.

note.yi: 「值月」是官爻的地支正是某个月的地支（如官是丑，丑月就是它的值月），一般解作『这个爻当值的月份』。「会推」是会同推举（明清高级官员由大臣联名推举），「高擢」是高升。「是期」是确切的期日，书里把『升何时』定到月、『是期』定到日。「世实官崇」按文意：世爻不空（实）、官爻崇旺，到了这一天就应。书里自注的例子：亥月壬戌日，得丰卦，丰卦里有戌、丑两个官爻；弱的丑官值月（季冬十二月）才升。「长生」「临官」是十二长生的位置。和易林补遗仕宦升迁的「欲知何月官升」（EL.61）、易隐升迁的应期（YY.08）可对着看。
note.en: 'Zhiyue' is a month whose branch is the very branch of the line (if the Pressure line is Chou, the Chou month is its own month), usually explained as 'the month in which this line is on duty'. 'Huitui' is joint recommendation (under the Ming and Qing, senior officials were put forward by senior ministers acting together), and 'gaozhuo' is being raised high. 'Shiqi' is the exact date: the book fixes 'when the promotion comes' to the month and 'the exact date' to the day. 'The Self solid and Pressure exalted', by the sense: the Self line not Void (solid) and Pressure exalted and thriving, so that on that day it comes about. The book's own example: a Hai month and a Ren-Xu day, getting Feng, which has two Pressure lines, Xu and Chou; the weak Chou line was promoted when it met its month, the last month of winter, the twelfth. Birth and Taking Office are places in the twelve stages of life. Compare 'to know in which month the official is promoted' in the Yilin Buyi on promotion (EL.61) and the timing in the Yi Yin on promotion (YY.08).

zh: 逢生旺而会推，遇扶助而高擢。
yi: 它什么时候升？以（官爻的）值月为法，
逢到生旺就会被会推，遇到扶助就高升。
再占确切的日期：
世爻实、官爻崇旺，就不是别的日子。
en: When will the promotion come? The rule is the month in which the line is on duty,
meeting generation and thriving, one is put forward by joint recommendation; meeting support, one is raised high.
To divine again for the exact date:
when the Self is solid and Pressure exalted, it is no other day.

zh: 如两官一强一弱，其弱值月则升，
如亥建壬戌日，占迁得丰，季冬始升是也。
一官必求值月，可以占验，
如长生临官，得官有气，亦可升迁，
而不若值月为最，长生次之。
yi: 比如有两个官爻，一强一弱，那个弱的值月就升；
例如亥月壬戌日，占调迁得丰卦，到季冬才升就是这样。
只有一个官爻，一定要求它值月，才可以占验；
如果在长生、临官，官有气，也可以升迁；
生它、助它的月份也一样，
但都不如值月最好，长生次之。
en: For example, if there are two Pressure lines, one strong and one weak, one is promoted when the weak one meets its month;
for example, in a Hai month on a Ren-Xu day, divining about a transfer, one got Feng, and the promotion came only in the last month of winter.
With a single Pressure line one must seek its own month, and it can then be tested;
if it is at Birth or at Taking Office, so that Pressure has force, one can also be promoted;
the months that generate and support it are the same,
but none is as good as its own month, which is best, with Birth second.

title: 升何方：以官爻所属五行为法——金官升任西土、木官治事东方、水官齐民北海、土官秉政中央、火官为化南隅；不拘官爻衰旺及十二支神，大略以五行分之多验（戌月戊申日占得革，丑官东北未官西南，后擢河南中土）

rule.yi: 升到哪个方向，以官爻所属的五行为法：属金，该到西方上任；属木，该在东方治事；属水，该在北海一带治民；属土，该在中央执政；属火，该在南方一隅施行教化。不论官爻的衰旺，也不论十二支神所主的方位，大略按五行来分，多半应验。例如戌月戊申日占升到哪个方向，得革卦；若按地支说，丑官在东北、未官在西南，后来升到了河南中土。
rule.en: As to which direction one will be promoted to, the rule is the phase to which the Pressure line belongs: if Metal, one should take up office in the west; if Wood, one should govern in the east; if Water, one should rule the people by the northern sea; if Earth, one should hold the government in the centre; if Fire, one should carry out the transforming teaching in a corner of the south. Whether the Pressure line is strong or weak, and the directions governed by the twelve branch spirits, do not matter; dividing by the five phases in rough outline is mostly confirmed. For example, in a Xu month on a Wu-Shen day, divining in which direction one would be promoted, one got Ge; going by the branches, a Chou Pressure line is north-east and a Wei one south-west, and later one was promoted to the central earth, Henan.

note.yi: 「升任」「治事」「齐民」「秉政」「为化」是各行官的取向：金主肃杀所以西、木主生发所以东、水在北、土居中、火在南。「北海」是北方，「南隅」是南方一角。「齐民」是治理百姓。书里自注的例子：戌月戊申日得革卦，革卦里官鬼是丑土和未土，按地支丑在东北、未在西南，但应验的却是土行主中央——升到河南（中土），可见按五行比按地支准，这也是书里说「大略以五行分之多验」的依据。独发的情形看下一条（YM.45），一世官、一伏官看 YM.46。
note.en: 'Shengren', 'zhishi', 'qimin', 'bingzheng' and 'weihua' are the leanings of the officials of each phase: Metal governs the severe and the killing and so is west, Wood governs the growing and so is east, Water is north, Earth is the centre, and Fire is south. 'Beihai' is the north, and 'nanyu' is a corner of the south. 'Qimin' is governing the people. The book's own example: in a Xu month on a Wu-Shen day, getting Ge, whose Pressure lines are Chou Earth and Wei Earth, by the branches Chou is north-east and Wei is south-west, but what was confirmed was the Earth phase governing the centre, a promotion to Henan (the central earth), which shows that the phases are more accurate than the branches, and is the basis of the book's 'dividing roughly by the five phases is mostly confirmed'. The case of a Pressure line moving alone is in the next entry (YM.45), and a Pressure line on the Self or a hidden one in YM.46.

zh: 属火而当为化于南隅也。
yi: 升到哪个方向，以官所属的五行为法：
属金，该到西方上任；
属木，该在东方治事；
属水，该在北海一带治民；
属土，该在中央执政；
属火，该在南方一隅施行教化。
en: As to which direction one will be promoted to, the rule is the phase to which the Pressure line belongs:
if Metal, one should take up office in the west;
if Wood, one should govern in the east;
if Water, one should rule the people by the northern sea;
if Earth, one should hold the government in the centre;
if Fire, one should carry out the transforming teaching in a corner of the south.

zh: 不拘官爻衰旺，及十二支神，大略以五行分之多验，
如戌建戊申日，占何方得革，
