则以丑官东北，未官西南，
yi: 不论官爻的衰旺，也不论十二支神所主的方位，大略按五行来分，多半应验。
例如戌月戊申日，占升到哪个方向得革卦，
若按地支来说，
丑官在东北，未官在西南，
后来升到了河南中土；
其他照这样仿推。
en: Whether the Pressure line is strong or weak, and the directions governed by the twelve branch spirits, do not matter; dividing by the five phases in rough outline is mostly confirmed.
For example, in a Xu month on a Wu-Shen day, divining in which direction one would be promoted, one got Ge,
going by the branches,
a Chou Pressure line is north-east and a Wei one south-west,
and later one was promoted to the central earth, Henan;
the rest are inferred in the same way.

title: 升何方（独发）：官爻独发则论宫——离宫关南柱石、坎卦塞北屏藩、巽东南兴教化、乾西北立功名、兑当陇蜀、震偏齐鲁、艮行辽蓟之漠、坤来秦晋之疆；独发以八宫断方、其余以五行断地利，举天下而言不拘乡任

rule.yi: 官爻单独发动，就按它所在的宫来论方位：独发在离宫，是关南的柱石；单动在坎卦，是塞北的屏藩；在巽，在东南兴教化；在乾，在西北立功名；兑当陇蜀，震偏齐鲁，艮往辽蓟的沙漠，坤到秦晋的疆土。凡独发，用八宫来断方位；其他的情形用五行来断地利；这是就天下而言，不拘泥于本乡、本任。
rule.en: When the Pressure line moves alone, direction is discussed by the palace it is in: moving alone in the palace of Li, one is a pillar south of the passes; moving alone in Kan, a screen and bulwark north of the frontier; in Xun, one spreads teaching in the south-east; in Qian, one makes one's name in the north-west; Dui corresponds to Long and Shu, Zhen leans to Qi and Lu, Gen goes to the deserts of Liao and Ji, and Kun comes to the borders of Qin and Jin. When a line moves alone, one judges the direction by the eight palaces; in other cases one judges the lie of the land by the five phases; this speaks of the whole realm, and is not tied to the home district or the present post.

note.yi: 「关南」「塞北」是关隘之南、边塞之北，「柱石」「屏藩」是撑国家的柱石和护卫的藩篱。「陇蜀」是甘肃、四川，「齐鲁」是山东，「辽蓟」是辽东和蓟州一带，「秦晋」是陕西、山西。八宫的方位是后天八卦：离南、坎北、巽东南、乾西北、兑西、震东、艮东北、坤西南，再配各地的古名。「独发」是卦里只有这一个官爻在动。书里自注：独发用八宫断方位、其余情形（上一条 YM.44）用五行，而且这是就全国而言，不拘泥于原籍或现任所在。
note.en: 'Guannan' and 'saibei' are south of the passes and north of the frontier, and 'zhushi' and 'pingfan' are the pillar that holds up the state and the screen that guards it. 'Long and Shu' are Gansu and Sichuan, 'Qi and Lu' is Shandong, 'Liao and Ji' are Liaodong and the region of Jizhou, and 'Qin and Jin' are Shaanxi and Shanxi. The directions of the eight palaces are those of the later-heaven arrangement: Li south, Kan north, Xun south-east, Qian north-west, Dui west, Zhen east, Gen north-east, Kun south-west, with the old names of the regions assigned to them. 'Moving alone' is when this is the only Pressure line moving in the hexagram. The book's own gloss: for a line moving alone use the eight palaces for direction, in other cases (the previous entry, YM.44) use the five phases, and it speaks of the whole country and is not tied to the home registry or the present post.

zh: 其在巽也，兴教化于东南，
其在乾也，立功名于西北。
艮行辽蓟之漠，坤来秦晋之疆也。
yi: 如果官爻独发在离宫，是关南的柱石；
单动在坎卦，是塞北的屏藩；
在巽，在东南兴教化；
在乾，在西北立功名；
兑对应陇、蜀，震偏向齐、鲁，
艮往辽蓟的沙漠，坤来秦晋的疆土。
en: If the Pressure line moves alone in the palace of Li, one is a pillar south of the passes;
moving alone in Kan, a screen and bulwark north of the frontier;
in Xun, one spreads teaching in the south-east;
in Qian, one makes one's name in the north-west;
Dui corresponds to Long and Shu, Zhen leans to Qi and Lu,
Gen goes to the deserts of Liao and Ji, and Kun comes to the borders of Qin and Jin.

zh: 凡独发，则以八宫断方数，
其他则以五行断地利也，
举天下而言之，弗拘乡、任。
yi: 凡是独发，就用八宫来断方位；
其他的情形就用五行来断地利；
这是就天下而言，不拘泥于本乡、本任。
en: Whenever a line moves alone, one judges the direction by the eight palaces;
in other cases one judges the lie of the land by the five phases;
this speaks of the whole realm, and is not tied to the home district or the present post.

title: 升何方（一世官、一伏官）：一世官以禽宿（演禽二十八宿）定分野、一伏官以飞神定地方，占官而不占世、既仕以官为象不执世；例：亥月戊寅日得同人亥官居世京房降宿危星后擢齐地，酉月乙巳日得颐丙戌世伏酉官后擢西北

rule.yi: 只有一个官爻、又落在世爻上的，用演禽二十八宿的所属来定分野；只有一个官爻、伏藏着的，用它上面的飞神来定地方。不过这是占官，不是占世；已经做官的，以官爻为象，不拘泥于世。例如亥月戊寅日卜升到哪个方向，得同人卦，亥官居世，京房降宿是危星，后来升到齐地的分野；又如酉月乙巳日得颐卦，丙戌世下伏着酉官，后来升到西北。
rule.en: When there is a single Pressure line and it sits on the Self, the assignment of the twenty-eight mansions of the Yanqin system is used to fix the field-allocation; when there is a single Pressure line and it is hidden, the flying line above it is used to fix the place. But this is divining the Pressure line, not the Self; for one already in office the Pressure line is the image, and one does not hold to the Self. For example, in a Hai month on a Wu-Yin day, divining which direction one would be promoted, one got Tongren, with a Hai Pressure line on the Self, and the mansion that Jing Fang assigns to it is Wei, and later one was promoted to the field-allocation of Qi; or in a You month on a Yi-Si day one got Yi, with a hidden You Pressure line under the Bing-Xu Self, and later one was promoted to the north-west.

note.yi: 「演禽」是一种按二十八宿推断吉凶的术数，「禽宿」是二十八宿各配一禽（如危月燕、斗木獬）；「京房降宿」是京房把六十四卦的每一爻配到二十八宿上的那一套，「危星」是危宿；「分野」是天上星宿对应地上的区域，危宿对应的是齐地（山东一带）。「飞神」是伏神上面那一爻（见术语表）。书里的两个例子：同人卦里亥官居世（亥水官落在世上），按京房降宿落在危宿，所以应在齐地；颐卦里卦中没有官，要去看伏官（酉）上面的飞神，即世爻丙戌，戌是西北，所以后来升到西北（注里写的伏官是「己酉」，本卦纳甲里这一爻是酉金，这里按原文译）。「然占官而不占世也」是说这套法子取的是官爻，不是世爻本身的地支。和易隐官禄占的任所（YY.12）取分野的办法可对着看：那边是用世爻的地支定分野。
note.en: 'Yanqin' is a method of divination that judges fortune by the twenty-eight mansions, and the 'mansion animals' are the animal paired with each of the twenty-eight mansions (as the Wei mansion is the swallow and the Dou mansion the xie-beast); 'the mansion Jing Fang assigns' is the scheme by which Jing Fang paired each line of the sixty-four hexagrams with the twenty-eight mansions, and 'Wei' is the Wei mansion; the 'field-allocation' is the region on earth that corresponds to a star-mansion in heaven, and the region the Wei mansion corresponds to is Qi (the Shandong area). The 'flying line' is the line above a hidden line (see the glossary). The two examples in the book: in Tongren, the Hai Pressure line sits on the Self (a Hai Water Pressure line on the Self), and by Jing Fang's assignment it falls on the Wei mansion, so it corresponds to Qi; in Yi there is no Pressure line in the hexagram, so one looks at the flying line above the hidden Pressure line (You), which is the Self line Bing-Xu, Xu being north-west, so one was later promoted to the north-west (the note writes the hidden Pressure line as 'Ji-You', and in the hexagram's line assignment this line is You Metal, and it is translated here as the text has it). 'But this is divining the Pressure line, not the Self' says that this method takes the Pressure line and not the branch of the Self line itself. Compare the way the Yi Yin on the place of the post (YY.12) takes the field-allocation: there the branch of the Self line fixes it.

zh: 一世官则以禽宿为分野，
一伏官则以飞神为地方，
既仕以官为象，而不执世。
yi: 只有一个官爻、又落在世爻上的，用禽宿来定分野；
只有一个官爻、伏藏着的，用飞神来定地方；
不过这是占官，不是占世。
已经做官的，以官爻为象，不拘泥于世。
en: When there is a single Pressure line and it sits on the Self, the mansions are used to fix the field-allocation;
when there is a single hidden Pressure line, the flying line is used to fix the place;
but this is divining the Pressure line, not the Self;
for one already in office the Pressure line is the image, and one does not hold to the Self.

zh: 卦中一爻官鬼复居世上，当用演禽二十八宿分属、何处、禄仕是也，
如亥建戊寅日，卜升方得同人，亥官居世，京房降宿危星，后擢齐地分野。
卦内无官，当求伏官之上飞神，以为任所是也，
如酉建乙巳日，占升方得颐，丙戌世伏己酉官，后擢西北，余仿此。
yi: 卦中有一个官鬼又居在世爻上，应当用演禽二十八宿的所属来看在哪一处、做什么官，
例如亥月戊寅日，卜升到哪个方向得同人卦，亥官居世，京房降宿是危星，后来升到齐地的分野。
卦里没有官，应当求伏官上面的飞神，把它当作任所，
例如酉月乙巳日占升到哪个方向得颐卦，丙戌世下伏着己酉官，后来升到西北，其余仿此。
en: When in the hexagram a single Pressure line also sits on the Self, one should use the assignment of the twenty-eight mansions of the Yanqin system to see which place and which salaried post it is,

for example, in a Hai month on a Wu-Yin day, divining which direction one would be promoted, one got Tongren, with a Hai Pressure line on the Self, the mansion Jing Fang assigns being Wei, and later one was promoted to the field-allocation of Qi.
When there is no Pressure line in the hexagram, one should seek the flying line above the hidden Pressure line and take it as the place of the post,

for example, in a You month on a Yi-Si day, divining which direction one would be promoted, one got Yi, with a hidden Ji-You Pressure line under the Bing-Xu Self, and later one was promoted to the north-west; the rest are inferred in the same way.

title: 升何方（远近）：归魂屡复旧任、游魂尝履新途；六冲官伏藏则远、六合官出现则近；内近地外远方、初爻接壤六爻边鄙；一官以内外分远近、两官以卦象分遐迩

rule.yi: 归魂卦，常常回到旧任；游魂卦，常常走上新路。六冲而官伏藏，就远；六合而官出现，就近。内卦是近处，外卦是远方；初爻在接壤的近处，六爻在边远之地。卦中只有一个官爻，在内卦为近、在外卦为远，初爻近、六爻远，其余爻照这样类推；若有内外两个官爻，就看卦：游魂、六冲、官伏藏，应在远；归魂、六合、官出现，应在近。因为一个官爻以内外分远近，两个官爻以卦象分远近。
rule.en: A Returning Soul hexagram often goes back to the old post; a Wandering Soul hexagram often walks a new road. A six-clash with Pressure hidden is far; a six-combine with Pressure showing is near. The inner trigram is near, the outer far; the first line borders on the near, the sixth is the remote frontier. When there is only one Pressure line in the hexagram, in the inner trigram it is near and in the outer far, the first line near and the sixth far, the other lines by analogy; if there are two Pressure lines, inner and outer, one looks at the hexagram: Wandering Soul, a six-clash and Pressure hidden answer far; Returning Soul, a six-combine and Pressure showing answer near. For one Pressure line distance is divided by inner and outer; for two Pressure lines it is divided by the image of the hexagram.

note.yi: 「归魂」「游魂」是八宫卦序里的两个卦（第八个归魂、第七个游魂）：游魂主迁动、归魂主回返，所以归魂常复旧任、游魂常换新地方。「履新途」是走上新的路。「六冲伏藏则远，六合出现则近」：冲散、隐藏主远，合聚、显现主近。「接壤」是和本地相连，「边鄙」是边远。「遐迩」是远近。书里自注：只有一个官爻按内外、爻位定远近；两个官爻内外分不出，就改看卦象（游魂、六冲、伏藏则远，归魂、六合、出现则近）。内外卦和初六爻位的远近，与易隐官禄占任所（YY.11）「世在一二位近、三四位远、五六位更远」是同一个意思。
note.en: 'Returning Soul' and 'Wandering Soul' are two hexagrams in the order of the eight palaces (the eighth is Returning Soul, the seventh Wandering Soul): Wandering Soul governs shifting and Returning Soul going back, so Returning Soul often resumes the old post and Wandering Soul often changes to a new place. 'Walking a new road' is setting out on a new road. 'A six-clash with Pressure hidden is far, a six-combine with Pressure showing is near': scattering and hiding mean far, gathering and showing mean near. 'Jierang' is bordering on one's home place and 'bianbi' is the remote frontier. 'Xia er' is far and near. The book's own gloss: with only one Pressure line distance is fixed by inner and outer and by the line position; with two Pressure lines, where inner and outer cannot tell, one looks at the image of the hexagram instead (Wandering Soul, six-clash and hidden: far; Returning Soul, six-combine and showing: near). The distance by inner and outer trigram and by the first to sixth line is the same idea as 'the Self in the first or second place is near, in the third or fourth far, in the fifth or sixth farther still' in the Yi Yin on the place of the post (YY.11).

zh: 归魂屡复旧任，游魂尝履新途。
六冲伏藏则远，六合出现则近，
内近地而外远方，初接壤而六边鄙也。
yi: 归魂卦常常回到旧任，游魂卦常常走上新路。
六冲而官伏藏就远，六合而官出现就近，
内卦是近处，外卦是远方，初爻在接壤的近处，六爻在边远之地。
en: A Returning Soul hexagram often goes back to the old post; a Wandering Soul hexagram often walks a new road.
A six-clash with Pressure hidden is far, a six-combine with Pressure showing is near,
the inner trigram is near and the outer far, the first line borders on the near and the sixth is the remote frontier.

zh: 凡卦中只一官爻，在内为近，在外为远，
初爻近，六爻远，余爻类推之。
若遇内外两官，则考其卦，
游魂六冲伏藏应远，归魂六合出现应近。
盖一官以内外分远近，两官以卦象分遐迩。
yi: 凡是卦中只有一个官爻，在内卦为近，在外卦为远，
初爻近，六爻远，其余爻照这样类推。
如果遇到内外两个官爻，就看它的卦：
游魂、六冲、官伏藏，应在远；归魂、六合、官出现，应在近。
因为一个官爻以内外分远近，两个官爻以卦象分远近。
en: Whenever there is only one Pressure line in the hexagram, in the inner trigram it is near, in the outer far,
the first line near, the sixth far, the other lines by analogy.
If one meets two Pressure lines, inner and outer, one looks at the hexagram:
Wandering Soul, a six-clash and Pressure hidden answer far; Returning Soul, a six-combine and Pressure showing answer near.
For one Pressure line distance is divided by inner and outer; for two Pressure lines it is divided by the image of the hexagram.

title: 问能否得某地、某官：有指一地而筮，贞冲合冲、官坏世空则非食禄之方；筮考选升调得某官，世实官旺则为应拜之职；考职选官、升任调缺、指是地是官同此法

rule.yi: 有指定一个地方来占，问能不能得到这个地方：本卦六冲、合处逢冲、官坏世空，就不是食禄的地方。占考选、升调，问能不能得到某个官职：世爻实、官旺，就是应当拜受的职位。考职选官、升任调缺，或者指定哪个地方、哪个官来占，都用这个办法。
rule.en: If one points to a particular place and divines whether one will get that place: if the original hexagram is a six-clash, a combination is clashed, Pressure is damaged and the Self is Void, it is not a place to draw salary. If one divines about selection by examination, promotion or transfer and asks whether one will get a certain office: when the Self is solid and Pressure thriving, it is the post one is due to be appointed to. Taking a post by examination, selecting an official, being promoted into or transferred to a vacancy, or pointing to a certain place or a certain office, are all divined by this same method.

note.yi: 「食禄之方」是能领俸禄的地方，也就是任所。「贞冲合冲」是本卦（贞）是六冲、以及合处逢冲，这是三冲里的两种（见 YM.07 的注）。「应拜之职」是该受任命的职位。这一条是『指名问』：升迁（YM.42）问的是升不升，这里问的是是不是这个地、这个官，所以要世实官旺、不犯冲坏。和易隐官禄占的任所、候选（YY.07、YY.11）可对着看。
note.en: 'Shilu zhi fang' is a place where one can draw salary, that is, the place of the post. 'Zhenchong hechong' is the original hexagram (zhen) being a six-clash and a combination meeting a clash, two of the three clashes (see the note to YM.07). 'Ying bai zhi zhi' is the post one is due to be appointed to. This entry is 'asking by name': promotion (YM.42) asks whether one is promoted, and here the question is whether it is this place or this office, so the Self must be solid and Pressure thriving, with no clash or damage. Compare the place of the post and the candidacy in the Yi Yin on official careers (YY.07, YY.11).

zh: 有指而筮得是地乎，贞冲合冲、官坏世空，则非食禄之方。
有卜考选升调，而筮得是官乎，世实官旺，则为应拜之职。
yi: 有人指定一个地方来占，问能不能得到这个地方：本卦六冲、合处逢冲、官坏世空，就不是食禄的地方；
有人占考选、升调，问能不能得到某个官职：世爻实、官旺，就是应当拜受的职位。
en: If one points to a particular place and divines whether one will get it: if the original hexagram is a six-clash, a combination is clashed, Pressure is damaged and the Self is Void, it is not a place to draw salary;

if one divines about selection by examination, promotion or transfer and asks whether one will get a certain office: when the Self is solid and Pressure thriving, it is the post one is due to be appointed to.

zh: 或指是地是官，而筮同此法。
yi: 考职选官、升任调缺，
或者指定哪个地方、哪个官来占，也都用这个办法。
en: Taking a post by examination, selecting an official, being promoted into or transferred to a vacancy,
or pointing to a certain place or a certain office and divining about it, are all divined by this same method.

title: 概占当得何官：专察官爻，以八卦别其属之部曹——乾天官（冢宰）管禁内杂职厩马、坎冬官（司空）管河漕台谏水利、艮阍寺管晨门防卫狱禁矿藏宝库钱局、震春官（宗伯）管东宫师傅试务宗庙礼乐文章、巽天使管上林与奉命四方之上差、离夏官（司马）管耳目纠弹修史、坤地官（司徒）管农事疆场社稷母后内臣、兑秋官（司寇）管言语刑罚章疏上膳

rule.yi: 总的占该得什么官，专门察看官爻，用八卦分它属于哪个部曹：乾是天官（古称冢宰），管朝廷禁内的杂职、厩马；坎是冬官（古称司空），管总河、总漕之务和台谏，属天下水利的官；艮是阍寺，管晨门的官吏、防御守卫的僚属、治狱禁，属矿藏、宝库、钱局一类；震是春官（古称宗伯），是太子东宫的师傅，或总试、总裁，以及管宗庙祭祀、礼乐文章的官；巽是天使，以及管上林苑、奉命向四方宣布的上差的僚佐；离是夏官（古称司马），专管耳目之权、纠弹之事，又一说是端门的辅臣、修史的文明之官；坤是地官（古称司徒），管天下农事，是有土之官，担疆场社稷之任，是皇太后的内臣；兑是秋官（古称司寇），管言语、主刑罚、通章疏、主皇上膳食之事。
rule.en: To divine in general what office one will get, look only at the Pressure line, and tell by the eight trigrams the department it belongs to: Qian is the Heavenly Office (anciently called the Grand Steward), governing miscellaneous posts within the forbidden palace and the stable horses; Kan is the Winter Office (anciently the Minister of Works), governing the affairs of the river-conservancy and grain-transport directorates and the censors and remonstrators, officials of the waterworks of the realm; Gen is the palace gatekeeper, governing the officers of the dawn gate, the officials of defence and guard, the management of prisons, and things like mines, treasuries and mints; Zhen is the Spring Office (anciently the Elder of the Ancestral Temple), the tutors of the Crown Prince's Eastern Palace, or chief examiners and chief compilers, and the officials who manage the ancestral temples, sacrifices, rites, music and letters; Xun is the Heavenly Envoy, and those who manage the Shanglin park and the assistants of senior envoys sent with orders to the four quarters; Li is the Summer Office (anciently the Marshal), governing the power of ears and eyes and the work of impeachment, or also the supporting ministers of the Duan Gate and the civilised office of compiling histories; Kun is the Earth Office (anciently the Minister of the Multitude), governing the farming of the realm, officials with land, who carry the charge of the borders and the altars of the state, and the inner servants of the Empress Dowager; Dui is the Autumn Office (anciently the Minister of Crime), governing speech, in charge of punishments, passing memorials, and having the charge of the sovereign's meals.

note.yi: 天官、地官、春官、夏官、秋官、冬官是《周礼》的六官（冢宰、司徒、宗伯、司马、司寇、司空），后世分别相当于吏部、户部、礼部、兵部、刑部、工部。八卦配六官：乾配天官、坤配地官、震配春官、离配夏官、兑配秋官、坎配冬官，艮和巽另配阍寺（守门的）和天使（奉使的）。「木天」是翰林院的别称。「总河」「总漕」是总督河道、总督漕运。「台谏」是御史和谏官。「阍寺」是守宫门的官，「晨门」是清晨守城门的。「钱局」是铸钱的局。「东宫」是太子居处。「上林」是皇家的上林苑。「上差」是上司派出的差官。「端门」是宫殿的正南门。「一」在这类注里是「又一说」的意思（下面 YM.50 同）。「司台谏」的「司」按文意是管。这一条与易隐官禄占的何官（YY.03–YY.06）取同一类：先按官爻定官，再按所在宫、五行、爻位和六神细分。
note.en: The Heavenly, Earth, Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter Offices are the six offices of the Rites of Zhou (the Grand Steward, the Minister of the Multitude, the Elder of the Ancestral Temple, the Marshal, the Minister of Crime and the Minister of Works), which later correspond to the Boards of Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Punishments and Works. The eight trigrams are matched to the six offices: Qian to the Heavenly Office, Kun to the Earth Office, Zhen to the Spring Office, Li to the Summer Office, Dui to the Autumn Office and Kan to the Winter Office, while Gen and Xun are matched separately to the palace gatekeepers (those who keep the gates) and the Heavenly Envoy (those sent on missions). 'Wood heaven' is a name for the Hanlin Academy. 'Zonghe' and 'zongcao' are the governors-general of river conservancy and of grain transport. 'Taijian' are the censors and remonstrators. 'Hunsi' are the officials who guard the palace gates, and 'chenmen' are those who keep the city gate at dawn. 'Qianju' is the mint. 'Donggong' is where the Crown Prince lives. 'Shanglin' is the imperial Shanglin park. 'Shangchai' is an envoy sent out by a superior. 'Duanmen' is the main south gate of a palace. 'Yi', in notes of this kind, means 'another view' (the same in YM.50 below). The 'si' of 'si taijian' is read by the sense as 'govern'. This entry is of a kind with 'which office' in the Yi Yin on official careers (YY.03–YY.06): first fix the office by the Pressure line, then divide it more finely by palace, phase, line position and the six spirits.

zh: 以八卦而别其属之部曹。
yi: 总的占该得什么官，
专门察看官爻，
用八卦来分它属于哪个部曹。
en: To divine in general what office one will get,
look only at the Pressure line,
and tell by the eight trigrams the department it belongs to.

zh: 乾为天官，古称冢宰，木天之臣，属朝廷禁内杂职，及厩马之司。
坎为冬官，古称司空，总河总漕之务，司台谏，属天下之水利者。
艮为阍寺，司晨门之吏，防御备卫之僚，治狱禁，属矿藏宝库钱局之类也。
震为春官，古称宗伯，师傅太子东宫，或总试总裁，及司宗庙祭祀礼乐文章之官也。
巽为天使，及司上林，奉命申四方者，上差之僚佐也。
离为夏官，古称司马，专耳目之权、纠弹之事，一为端门之辅，修史之文明也。
坤为地官，古称司徒，司天下农事，有土之官也，疆场社稷之任，母后之内臣尔。
兑为秋官，古称司寇，司言语，职刑罚，通章疏，主上膳之事也。
yi: 乾是天官，古称冢宰，是木天之臣，属朝廷禁内的杂职，以及厩马之司；
坎是冬官，古称司空，管总河、总漕之务，管台谏，属天下水利的官；
艮是阍寺，管晨门的官吏、防御守卫的僚属，治狱禁，属矿藏、宝库、钱局一类；
震是春官，古称宗伯，是太子东宫的师傅，或总试、总裁，以及管宗庙祭祀、礼乐文章的官；
巽是天使，以及管上林苑、奉命向四方宣布的上差的僚佐；
离是夏官，古称司马，专管耳目之权、纠弹之事，又一说是端门的辅臣，修史的文明之官；
坤是地官，古称司徒，管天下农事，是有土之官，担疆场社稷之任，是皇太后的内臣；
兑是秋官，古称司寇，管言语，主刑罚，通章疏，主皇上膳食之事。
en: Qian is the Heavenly Office, anciently called the Grand Steward, a minister of the 'wood heaven' (the Hanlin), belonging to the miscellaneous posts within the forbidden palace and the bureau of stable horses;

Kan is the Winter Office, anciently the Minister of Works, governing the affairs of the river-conservancy and grain-transport directorates, governing the censors and remonstrators, an official of the waterworks of the realm;
Gen is the palace gatekeeper, governing the officers of the dawn gate and the officials of defence and guard, managing prisons, and belonging to things like mines, treasuries and mints;

Zhen is the Spring Office, anciently the Elder of the Ancestral Temple, the tutors of the Crown Prince's Eastern Palace, or chief examiners and chief compilers, and the officials who manage the ancestral temples, sacrifices, rites, music and letters;
Xun is the Heavenly Envoy, and those who manage the Shanglin park and the assistants of the senior envoys sent with orders to the four quarters;

Li is the Summer Office, anciently the Marshal, governing the power of ears and eyes and the work of impeachment, or also a supporting minister of the Duan Gate, the civilised office of compiling histories;

Kun is the Earth Office, anciently the Minister of the Multitude, governing the farming of the realm, an official with land, who carries the charge of the borders and the altars of the state, and an inner servant of the Empress Dowager;
Dui is the Autumn Office, anciently the Minister of Crime, governing speech, in charge of punishments, passing memorials, and having the charge of the sovereign's meals.

title: 概占何官（六爻位）：以六爻辨位之高卑——官在初爻为散缺（或本乡官守）、二爻为县邑（或谏议大臣相国学士）、三爻为守牧（或三司首领及大衙门随从）、四爻为司道（或九卿六曹近君之臣）、五爻君象惟代天巡狩与钦差者当之、六爻为贵戚之乡及宗庙功勋高尚辅相之臣；武途封职其义相类

rule.yi: 用六爻来分辨官位的高低：官爻在初爻，是散缺（闲散的缺额），或是本乡的官守；在二爻，是县邑，或是谏议大臣、相国学士；在三爻，是守牧（知府、知州一类），或是三司的首领，以及大衙门里随从的官；在四爻，是司道，或是九卿六曹，以及近君的臣子；五爻是君象，不是臣子所居，只有代天巡狩的官和奉钦命的钦差才当得起；六爻是贵戚之乡，以及宗庙功勋之臣、高尚之士、辅相王府的官、四围的股肱。武途的封职，意义相类似。
rule.en: By the six lines one tells the height or lowness of the rank: the Pressure line in the first line is a scattered vacancy (an idle post), or an official guard of his home district; in the second line, a county or town, or a remonstrating minister, a chief minister or academician; in the third line, a prefect or governor, or the head of the Three Offices, and officials attending in a great yamen; in the fourth line, a commissioner or circuit intendant, or the Nine Ministers and the Six Boards, and ministers near the sovereign; the fifth is the sovereign's image and not where a subject dwells, and only an official who makes tours of inspection in Heaven's stead or one sent by imperial command can fill it; the sixth line is the home of the noble kin, and of ministers of merit to the ancestral temple, men of lofty virtue, officials who assist a prince's household, and the limbs and trunk on all four sides. For appointments on the military path the meaning is similar.

note.yi: 「散缺」是闲散的缺；「守牧」是知府、知州一类的地方长官（「守」是太守，「牧」是州牧）；「司道」是布政使、按察使一类的司和各道的道员；「三司」是明代的布政使司、按察使司、都指挥使司；「九卿六曹」是朝廷的九卿和六部。「代天巡狩」是代天子巡视各地。「钦差」是奉皇帝之命外出办事的官。「贵戚之乡」是皇亲国戚居的位置。「武途封职」是武官一路的封授。每一爻后面的「一为」都是「又一说」。这一条和易隐官禄占的分爻（YY.02，鬼谷把执政、朝仕、监司、长官、曹官、吏人对应到六爻）是同一类办法，两家的对应并不完全一样，这里按易冒自己的说法。
note.en: 'Sanque' is an idle vacancy; 'shoumu' is a local head such as a prefect or a department magistrate ('shou' is a governor, 'mu' is a provincial shepherd); 'sidao' is the provincial commissioners such as the financial and judicial commissioners, and the intendants of circuits; 'the Three Offices' are the Ming provincial administration, surveillance and military commissions; 'the Nine Ministers and Six Boards' are the nine ministers of the court and the six ministries. 'Making a tour of inspection in Heaven's stead' is making a tour of the regions on the Son of Heaven's behalf. 'Qinchai' is an official sent out on the emperor's order to do a task. 'Home of the noble kin' is the place where the imperial relatives live. 'Appointments on the military path' is the conferring of posts along the military track. The 'yi wei' after each line is 'another view'. This entry is of a kind with the division by line in the Yi Yin on official careers (YY.02, where Guiguzi matches the ruler, court official, circuit supervisor, head official, bureau official and clerk to the six lines), and the two schools' correspondences are not wholly alike; here the Yimao's own saying is followed.

zh: 以六爻而辨其位之高卑。
yi: 用六爻来分辨他官位的高低。
en: By the six lines one tells the height or lowness of his rank.

zh: 凡官在初爻为散缺，一为本乡官守。
在二爻为县邑，一为谏议大臣、相国学士。
在三爻为守牧，一为三司首领，及大衙门随从之官。
在四爻为司道，一为九卿六曹，及近君之臣也。
五乃君象，非臣所居，惟代天巡狩之官，及钦命钦差者当之。
六爻为贵戚之乡，及宗庙功勳之臣、高尚之士、辅相王府之官、四围之股肱也。
yi: 凡是官爻在初爻，是散缺，或是本乡的官守；
在二爻，是县邑，或是谏议大臣、相国学士；
在三爻，是守牧，或是三司的首领，以及大衙门里随从的官；
在四爻，是司道，或是九卿六曹，以及近君的臣子；
五是君象，不是臣子所居，只有代天巡狩的官，以及奉钦命的钦差才当得起；
六爻是贵戚之乡，以及宗庙功勋之臣、高尚之士、辅相王府的官、四围的股肱；
武途的封职，意义相类似。
en: Whenever the Pressure line is in the first line, it is a scattered vacancy, or an official guard of his home district;
in the second line, a county or town, or a remonstrating minister, a chief minister or academician;
in the third line, a prefect or governor, or the head of the Three Offices, and officials attending in a great yamen;
in the fourth line, a commissioner or circuit intendant, or the Nine Ministers and the Six Boards, and ministers near the sovereign;
the fifth is the sovereign's image and not where a subject dwells, and only an official who makes tours of inspection in Heaven's stead or one sent by imperial command can fill it;

the sixth line is the home of the noble kin, and of ministers of merit to the ancestral temple, men of lofty virtue, officials who assist a prince's household, and the limbs and trunk on all four sides;
for appointments on the military path, the meaning is similar.

title: 概占何官（五行职掌）：以五行分其官之职掌——金官司兵事或执刑衡、木官司工务礼乐苑囿车舆舟楫及桑麻制造、水官司江淮河海及水利盐务税饷漕储、火官司文章参劾祭祀及冶铸喉舌之权、土官司土地农田社稷边疆及陵寝屯守之柄

rule.yi: 用五行来分这个官的职掌：金官必管兵事，或执掌刑罚法度；木官必管工务、礼乐、苑囿、车舆舟楫，以及桑麻、制造之事；水官必管江淮河海，以及水利盐务、税饷漕储；火官必管文章、弹劾、祭祀，以及冶铸、喉舌的权柄；土官必管土地农田、社稷边疆，以及陵寝、屯守的权柄。
rule.en: By the five phases one divides the duties of the office: a Metal official must govern military affairs, or hold the scales of punishment; a Wood official must govern public works, rites and music, parks, carriages and boats, and the affairs of mulberry, hemp and manufacture; a Water official must govern the rivers, the Huai, the Yellow River and the seas, and waterworks, the salt administration, tax and army supplies, and grain transport; a Fire official must govern letters, impeachment and sacrifice, and the powers of smelting and casting and of being the sovereign's mouthpiece; an Earth official must govern land and farmland, the altars of the state and the borders, and the powers over imperial tombs and garrison farms.

note.yi: 「刑衡」是刑罚的轻重衡量，即执法。「苑囿」是皇家园林。「车舆舟楫」是车和船。「桑麻」是农桑。「江淮河海」是长江、淮河、黄河、海。「盐务」是盐政，「税饷」是税收和军饷，「漕储」是漕运和仓储。「参劾」是弹劾。「冶铸」是冶炼铸造。「喉舌」是替君主传达政令的权。「陵寝」是帝王陵墓。「屯守」是屯田和守卫。这一条和黄金策仕宦的取象（HJC.20）、易隐官禄占的分爻、何官里按五行定部门的一条（YY.05）可对着看，各家配的行业不尽相同。
note.en: 'Xingheng' is the weighing of the lightness or heaviness of punishments, that is, enforcing the law. 'Yuanyou' are the imperial gardens. 'Chejuzhouji' are carriages and boats. 'Sangma' are farming and sericulture. 'Jianghuaihehai' are the Yangtze, the Huai, the Yellow River and the sea. 'Yanwu' is salt administration, 'shuixiang' is taxes and army pay, and 'caochu' is grain transport and granaries. 'Canhe' is impeachment. 'Yezhu' is smelting and casting. 'Houshe' is the power of conveying the ruler's orders. 'Lingqin' are imperial tombs. 'Tunshou' is garrison farming and guarding. This entry can be read against the images in the Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.20) and the entry in the Yi Yin that fixes the department by phase (YY.05); the trades each school assigns are not entirely the same.

zh: 以五行而分其官之职掌。
yi: 用五行来分这个官的职掌。
en: By the five phases one divides the duties of the office.

zh: 凡金官必司兵事，或执刑衡。
木官必司工务、礼乐苑囿、车舆舟楫，及桑麻、制造之事。
水官必司江淮河海，及水利盐务、税饷漕储。
火官必司文章、参劾、祭祀，及冶铸、喉舌之权。
土官必司土地农田、社稷边疆，及陵寝、屯守之柄也。
yi: 凡金官必管兵事，或执掌刑罚法度；
木官必管工务、礼乐、苑囿、车舆舟楫，以及桑麻、制造之事；
水官必管江淮河海，以及水利盐务、税饷漕储；
火官必管文章、弹劾、祭祀，以及冶铸、喉舌的权柄；
土官必管土地农田、社稷边疆，以及陵寝、屯守的权柄。
en: A Metal official must govern military affairs, or hold the scales of punishment;
a Wood official must govern public works, rites and music, parks, carriages and boats, and the affairs of mulberry, hemp and manufacture;
a Water official must govern the rivers, the Huai, the Yellow River and the seas, and waterworks, the salt administration, tax and army supplies, and grain transport;
a Fire official must govern letters, impeachment and sacrifice, and the powers of smelting and casting and of being the sovereign's mouthpiece;
an Earth official must govern land and farmland, the altars of the state and the borders, and the powers over imperial tombs and garrison farms.

title: 概占何官（六神诸星）：以六神参考其官之政事——青龙清耀文章诗赋清华之府、朱雀剖断谏议言路、勾陈田土劝农治寇一方之牧、螣蛇传宣驰骤差遣、白虎威武掌生杀军旅刑罚之宰、元武水利司捕司谋；文昌翰林、官符有司、天马钦差、天狱禁吏，斗木獬巡方、尾火虎兵权、星日马圣传之司、亢金龙文章之相；大抵五行六爻八宫为经、六神诸星为纬

rule.yi: 用六神和诸星（「诸监」疑是「诸星」之误）来参看这个官的政务：青龙，政务清明显耀，是文章诗赋、清华的官署；朱雀，政务是剖断，谏议善恶，折辨是非，是言路之官；勾陈，政务在田土，兴教劝农，治寇保民，是一方的牧守；螣蛇，政务是传宣，往来奔走，上下体察，是差遣之利；白虎，政务是威武，掌生杀之权，秉军旅之事，是刑罚的主宰；元武，政务是水利，是司捕、司谋之象。文昌是翰林，官符是有司，天马是钦差，天狱是禁吏；斗木獬是巡方之官，尾火虎是兵权之主，星日马是圣传之司，亢金龙是文章之相。大抵以五行、六爻、八宫为经，以六神、诸星为纬来参看。
rule.en: By the six spirits and the various stars ('jian' here is presumably a slip for 'xing', stars) one consults the government business of the office: with the Azure Dragon the government is clear and bright, the offices of letters, poetry and distinguished rank; with the Vermilion Bird the government is judging, remonstrating on good and evil, deciding right and wrong, an official of the channels of speech; with Hook Earth the government is in land and soil, promoting teaching and urging farming, quelling bandits and protecting the people, a shepherd of one region; with the Coiling Snake the government is relaying proclamations, going to and fro at speed, looking into things high and low, the advantage of commissions; with the White Tiger the government is awesome force, holding the power of life and death, in charge of military affairs, the master of punishments; with the Dark Tortoise the government is waterworks, the image of arresting and of planning. The Literary Star is the Hanlin, the Official Charge is the competent department, the Heavenly Horse is the imperial envoy, the Heavenly Prison is the prison officer; the Dipper Wood Xie-beast is an official who tours the regions, the Tail Fire Tiger is the master of military power, the Star Sun Horse is the office of transmitting the imperial word, the Neck Metal Dragon is the minister of letters. In general the five phases, the six lines and the eight palaces are the warp, and the six spirits and the various stars the weft that is consulted along with them.

note.yi: 「清华」是清贵显要（「清花」疑是「清华」之误）。「言路」是进言的途径，指谏官御史。「牧」是州牧、地方长官。「传宣」是传达宣布诏令，「差遣」是奉派出差。「文昌」「官符」「天马」「天狱」是神煞名；「斗木獬」「尾火虎」「星日马」「亢金龙」是二十八宿（斗宿木獬、尾宿火虎、星宿日马、亢宿金龙）。「圣传之司」书里没有展开，下面接「星日为马」，当是管传递诏命的驿传一类（存疑）。「六神诸监」的「监」，按下面注文「六神诸星」当是「星」之误。「经」「纬」是织布的纵线和横线：五行、六爻、八宫是定官的主线，六神、诸星是补充。六神的本来取象见术语表；这里是把它们取到官职的政务上。
note.en: 'Qinghua' is pure and eminent in rank ('qinghua' written with another character is presumably a slip for it). 'Yanlu' is the channel for presenting counsel, meaning remonstrating officials and censors. 'Mu' is a provincial governor, a local head. 'Chuanxuan' is conveying and proclaiming imperial orders, and 'chaiqian' is being sent out on a commission. 'Wenchang', 'guanfu', 'tianma' and 'tianyu' are names of spirit-stars; 'Dou Mu Xie', 'Wei Huo Hu', 'Xing Ri Ma' and 'Kang Jin Long' are four of the twenty-eight mansions (the Dipper mansion, Wood, the xie-beast; the Tail mansion, Fire, the tiger; the Star mansion, Sun, the horse; the Neck mansion, Metal, the dragon). The book does not expand on 'shengchuan zhi si'; it is followed by 'Star Sun is the horse', and it is presumably the postal relay that carries imperial orders (doubtful). The 'jian' of 'liushen zhu jian' is by the note below, 'six spirits and various stars', presumably a slip for 'xing'. 'Jing' and 'wei' are the warp and weft threads of a weave: the five phases, six lines and eight palaces are the main thread that fixes the office, and the six spirits and stars supplement it. The original images of the six spirits are in the glossary; here they are taken onto the government business of an office.

zh: 以六神诸监，而参考其官之政事。
yi: 用六神和诸星（「诸监」疑是「诸星」之误），来参看这个官的政务。
en: By the six spirits and the various stars ('jian' here is presumably a slip for 'xing', stars) one consults the government business of the office.

zh: 青龙则其政清耀，文章诗赋清花之府也。
朱雀则其政剖断，谏议善恶，折辨是非，言路之官也。
勾陈则其政田土，兴教劝农，治寇保民，一方之牧也。
螣蛇则其政传宣，往来驰骤，浮沉体察，差遣之利也。
白虎则其政威武，掌生杀之权，秉军旅之事，刑罚之宰也。
元武则其政水利，司捕司谋之象也。
文昌为翰林，官符为有司，天马为钦差，天狱为禁吏，
大抵五行六爻八宫为经，六神诸星为纬以参之。
yi: 青龙，政务清明显耀，是文章诗赋、清华的官署；
朱雀，政务是剖断，谏议善恶，折辨是非，是言路之官；
勾陈，政务在田土，兴教劝农，治寇保民，是一方的牧守；
螣蛇，政务是传宣，往来奔走，上下体察，是差遣之利；
白虎，政务是威武，掌生杀之权，秉军旅之事，是刑罚的主宰；
元武，政务是水利，是司捕、司谋之象。
文昌是翰林，官符是有司，天马是钦差，天狱是禁吏；
斗木獬是巡方之官，
尾火虎是兵权之主，
星日马是圣传之司，
亢金龙是文章之相。
大抵以五行、六爻、八宫为经，以六神、诸星为纬来参看。
en: With the Azure Dragon the government is clear and bright, the offices of letters, poetry and distinguished rank;
with the Vermilion Bird the government is judging, remonstrating on good and evil, deciding right and wrong, an official of the channels of speech;
with Hook Earth the government is in land and soil, promoting teaching and urging farming, quelling bandits and protecting the people, a shepherd of one region;
with the Coiling Snake the government is relaying proclamations, going to and fro at speed, looking into things high and low, the advantage of commissions;
with the White Tiger the government is awesome force, holding the power of life and death, in charge of military affairs, the master of punishments;
with the Dark Tortoise the government is waterworks, the image of arresting and of planning.
The Literary Star is the Hanlin, the Official Charge is the competent department, the Heavenly Horse is the imperial envoy, the Heavenly Prison is the prison officer;
the Dipper Wood Xie-beast is an official who tours the regions,
the Tail Fire Tiger is the master of military power,
the Star Sun Horse is the office of transmitting the imperial word,
the Neck Metal Dragon is the minister of letters.
In general the five phases, the six lines and the eight palaces are the warp, and the six spirits and the various stars the weft that is consulted along with them.

title: 概占何官（总括）：日月象之、世应度之、君臣位之；官爻独发论宫、一位论爻位、两现求所属、俱无考伏与变（伏占飞神、变占八宫）；官临日月建非社稷之臣即直节科道、持世为正印临应为左右、五爻为君二爻为大臣；虽代有更名理不远

rule.yi: 日、月来象征它，世、应来度量它，君、臣来定它的位置。所以官爻独发的论宫，官爻只有一位的论爻位，官爻两现的求它所属，都没有的就考伏和变：伏的占飞神，变的占八宫。伏、变的办法也可以分出位置和所属。要知道当世的官守，用象去求，即使各代名称有更改，道理相差不远。官临日辰月建，不是社稷之臣，一定是直节的科道官；官爻持世是正印，临应是左右辅佐之职；五爻是君，不是御史就是当宠幸之臣；二爻是大臣，是宰相，是国家的仪表。卦里没有官鬼，就求伏下的飞神，用位和所属来分辨；卦有动象，就求所变的官爻，用八宫来区别。
rule.en: The Day and Month image it, the Self and the Other measure it, ruler and minister fix its place. So when the Pressure line moves alone one discusses the palace; when there is only one Pressure line one discusses the line position; when two Pressure lines show one seeks the department they belong to; when there is none one examines the hidden and the changed: for a hidden one one divines the flying line, for a changed one the eight palaces; this method of hidden and changed lines can also separate out the place and the department. To know the offices of the present age, one seeks them by the image, and though the names have been changed from age to age, the principle is not far off. When Pressure sits on the Day or Month branch, if he is not a minister of the altars of the state, he is surely an upright censor or supervising official; the Pressure line on the Self is the principal seal, and on the Other it is a post at the side, an assistant; the fifth line is the sovereign, and if not a censor he is a minister favoured by the throne; the second line is a great minister, a chief minister, the model of the state. If there is no Pressure line in the hexagram, one seeks the flying line above the hidden one and tells it by position and department; if there is a moving image, one seeks the Pressure line it changes into and tells it by the eight palaces.

note.yi: 这一条是 YM.49–52 的总括：先看官爻在卦里的情形（独发、只有一位、两现、全无），再决定用哪一把尺：宫、爻位、所属、伏神的飞神、变出的八宫。「社稷之臣」是关系国家安危的重臣，「直节」是刚直有节操，「科道」是六科给事中和各道监察御史。「正印」是掌印的正官，「左右之职」是辅佐之职。「宠幸之臣」是受君主宠信的近臣。「伏变这法」的「这」疑是「之」之误，按文意译作「伏、变的办法」。「代有更名」是历代官名有改变，用象求就不受名称变化影响。注里「官临日月建」里的「月建」是当月的月建（见术语表）。
note.en: This entry sums up YM.49–52: first look at how the Pressure line stands in the hexagram (moving alone, only one, two showing, none), then decide which ruler to use: the palace, the line position, the department, the flying line of a hidden one, or the eight palaces of a changed one. 'Shejizhichen' is a leading minister on whom the safety of the state depends, 'zhijie' is upright and of principle, and 'kedao' are the supervising secretaries of the six departments and the censors of the circuits. 'Zhengyin' is the principal official who holds the seal, and 'zuoyouzhizhi' is a post of assistance. 'Chongxingzhichen' is a close minister favoured by the sovereign. The 'zhe' of 'fu bian zhe fa' is presumably a slip for 'zhi', and by the sense it is translated 'the method of hidden and changed lines'. 'Dai you geng ming' is that official titles have changed from age to age, and seeking by the image is not affected by the change of names. The 'Month' of 'Pressure sits on the Day or Month branch' in the note is the Month branch of the current month (see the glossary).

zh: 日月以像之，世应以度之，君臣以位之，
是故独发论宫，一爻论位，
伏变这法，亦可离位属也。
欲知当世之官守，以象求之，虽代有更名，理不远矣。
yi: 日、月来象征它，世、应来度量它，君、臣来定它的位置。
所以官爻独发的论宫，官爻只有一位的论爻位，
官爻两现的求它所属，
都没有的就考伏和变：
伏的占飞神，变的占八宫。
伏、变的办法也可以分出位置和所属。
要知道当世的官守，用象去求，即使各代名称有更改，道理相差不远。
en: The Day and Month image it, the Self and the Other measure it, ruler and minister fix its place.
So when the Pressure line moves alone one discusses the palace; when there is only one Pressure line one discusses the line position;
when two Pressure lines show one seeks the department they belong to;
when there is none one examines the hidden and the changed:
for a hidden one one divines the flying line, for a changed one the eight palaces;
this method of hidden and changed lines can also separate out the place and the department.
To know the offices of the present age, one seeks them by the image, and though the names have been changed from age to age, the principle is not far off.

zh: 凡官临日月建，若非社稷之臣，定是直节科道之官。
官爻持世为正印，临应为左右之职。
五爻为君，非御史而当宠幸之臣；二爻为大臣，为宰相，而为国家之仪表。
卦无官鬼，则求伏上飞神，以位属辨之，
卦有动象，则求所变官爻，以八宫别之。
yi: 凡是官临日辰月建，不是社稷之臣，一定是直节的科道官；
官爻持世是正印，临应是左右的辅佐之职；
五爻是君，不是御史就是当宠幸之臣；二爻是大臣，是宰相，是国家的仪表。
官爻独发，只论八宫；
官爻只有一位，只论六爻；
官爻两现，只论所属；
卦里没有官鬼，就求伏下的飞神，用位和所属来分辨；
卦有动象，就求所变的官爻，用八宫来区别。
en: Whenever Pressure sits on the Day or the Month branch, if he is not a minister of the altars of the state, he is surely an upright censor or supervising official;
the Pressure line on the Self is the principal seal, and on the Other it is a post at the side, an assistant;
the fifth line is the sovereign, and if not a censor he is a minister favoured by the throne; the second line is a great minister, a chief minister, the model of the state.
When the Pressure line moves alone, only the eight palaces are discussed;
when there is only one Pressure line, only the six lines are discussed;
when two Pressure lines show, only the department they belong to is discussed;
when there is no Pressure line in the hexagram, one seeks the flying line above the hidden one and tells it by position and department;
when there is a moving image, one seeks the Pressure line it changes into and tells it by the eight palaces.

title: 补官起服、援例纳粟与图差代役、选缺参房：补官起服援例纳粟戒世空而反遁；图差代役选缺参房问成则冲不利谋、世不利空、官不利坏，问财不利财虚，问辱不利官克世

rule.yi: 补授官职、服满起复、依例捐纳的，要戒备世空，反而退缩不成。图差使、代役、选缺、参房，问成不成：冲不利图谋，世不利空，官不利坏；问财，就不利财虚；问受辱，就不利官克世。
rule.en: For being appointed to a vacant post, being recalled after mourning, or buying office by precedent, beware of the Self being Void, for one will on the contrary draw back. For seeking a commission, taking another's place in a duty, selecting a vacancy or entering the clerks' office, in asking whether it comes off: clash is unfavourable to the plan, Void is unfavourable to the Self, damage is unfavourable to Pressure; in asking about money, empty Wealth is unfavourable; in asking about disgrace, it is unfavourable for Pressure to control the Self.

note.yi: 「补官」是补授官职（补缺），「起服」是守丧期满起用（起复），「援例纳粟」是依成例捐纳、出钱买官。「图差」是谋差使，「代役」是顶替差役，「选缺」是选官补缺，「参房」是吏员入衙门房科当差（这几样见易林补遗选缺参房 EL.76–78、谋差顶役 EL.106–108）。「反遁」的「遁」按文意是动词，退缩落空，不是遁卦。「问辱」是问会不会受辱，也就是受责罚。这一条把几种求职的小占问合在一起，断法都落在常见的几个忌上：冲、世空、官坏、财虚、官克世。
note.en: 'Bu guan' is being appointed to a post, filling a vacancy; 'qifu' is being recalled to office when the period of mourning is over; 'yuanli nasu' is buying office by contribution under a standing precedent. 'Tuchai' is seeking a commission, 'daiyi' is taking the place of a runner, 'xuanque' is selecting an official to fill a vacancy, and 'canfang' is a clerk entering a department of a yamen to serve (these are in the Yilin Buyi on selecting vacancies, EL.76-78, and on seeking commissions, EL.106-108). The 'dun' of 'fan dun' is by the sense a verb, drawing back and coming to nothing, and is not the hexagram Dun. 'Wen ru' is asking whether one will suffer disgrace, that is, reproof or penalty. This entry puts together several small divinations about seeking a post, and judges them by the familiar taboos: clash, a Void Self, damaged Pressure, empty Wealth, Pressure controlling the Self.

zh: 补官起服、援例纳粟，戒世空而反遁也。
图差代役、选缺参房，问成乎，
冲不利谋也，世不利空也，官不利坏也，
yi: 补授官职、服满起复、依例捐纳的，要戒备世空，反而退缩不成。
图差使、代役、选缺、参房，问成不成：
冲不利图谋，世不利空，官不利坏；
问财，就不利财虚；
问受辱，就不利官克世。
en: For being appointed to a vacant post, being recalled after mourning, or buying office by precedent, beware of the Self being Void, for one will on the contrary draw back.
For seeking a commission, taking another's place in a duty, selecting a vacancy or entering the clerks' office, in asking whether it comes off:
clash is unfavourable to the plan, Void is unfavourable to the Self, damage is unfavourable to Pressure;
in asking about money, empty Wealth is unfavourable;
in asking about disgrace, it is unfavourable for Pressure to control the Self.

title: 久任与履任身安：筮久任三冲游魂则不久、官坏罢职、世空解组、官克世参谪；筮履任身安随墓助伤则及任乃病、世破鬼发则临政抱灾；久任以官为官、身安以官为病，妙在变

rule.yi: 占能不能久任：三冲、游魂就不长久；官坏就罢职；世空就解印离任；官克世就被参劾、贬谪。占到任后身体平安与否：随墓、助伤，就是一到任就生病；世破、鬼发，就是临政时抱灾祸。占久任，以官爻为官职本身；占身安，以官爻为病；占卜取用爻，妙处在于变通。
rule.en: In divining whether one will keep the post long: the three clashes or Wandering Soul mean it will not last; Pressure damaged means dismissal; the Self Void means laying down the seal and leaving the post; Pressure controlling the Self means impeachment and demotion. In divining whether one will be safe in body on taking up the post: following into the tomb and helping the injury means falling ill on arriving at the post; the Self broken and Pressure moving means bearing calamity while in charge of government. For a long tenure the Pressure line is taken as the office itself; for bodily safety it is taken as illness; in divining, the wonder of using a line lies in the change.

note.yi: 「久任」是长久任职，「履任」是到任，「身安」是到任后自身平安。「三冲」（见 YM.07 注）是冲散，「游魂」是迁动，都主不长久。「罢职」是革职，「解组」是解下印绶、卸任，「参谪」是被参劾、谪贬。「及任乃病」是一到任就生病。注里「久任以官为官，身安以官为病」：同一个官爻，占久任取它作官职（官坏就罢），占身安取它作病（鬼发就是病灾）；「妙在变尔」书里没有再展开，「变」字这里按文意读作变通，取什么要看所占的事。和黄金策仕宦的世动逢空（HJC.08）、卦静世空（HJC.16）、易隐官禄占在任（YY.14–YY.20）对着看。
note.en: 'Jiuren' is holding a post for a long time, 'lüren' is taking up the post, and 'shen an' is one's own safety after taking up the post. The 'three clashes' (see the note to YM.07) are clash and scatter and 'Wandering Soul' is shifting, both meaning it does not last. 'Bazhi' is dismissal, 'jiezu' is untying the seal-ribbon and leaving the post, and 'canzhe' is being impeached and demoted. 'Ji ren nai bing' is falling ill on arriving at the post. In the note 'for long tenure take Pressure as the office, for bodily safety take Pressure as illness': the same Pressure line is taken as the office when divining about tenure (damaged Pressure means dismissal), and as illness when divining about safety (Pressure issuing means a sickness); 'miao zai bian er' is not expanded in the book, and 'bian' is read here by the sense as adapting, what is taken depending on what is asked. Compare the Huangjin Ce on the Self moving into Void (HJC.08) and the still hexagram with a Void Self (HJC.16), and the Yi Yin on being in office (YY.14-YY.20).

zh: 或筮久任乎，三冲游魂则不久，
yi: 占能不能久任：三冲、游魂就不长久；
官坏就罢职；
世空就解印离任；
官克世就被参劾、贬谪。
占到任后身体平安与否：
随墓、助伤，就是一到任就生病；
世破、鬼发，就是临政时抱灾祸。
en: In divining whether one will keep the post long: the three clashes or Wandering Soul mean it will not last;
Pressure damaged means dismissal;
the Self Void means laying down the seal and leaving the post;
Pressure controlling the Self means impeachment and demotion.
In divining whether one will be safe in body on taking up the post:
following into the tomb and helping the injury means falling ill on arriving at the post;
the Self broken and Pressure moving means bearing calamity while in charge of government.

zh: 久任以官为官，身安以官为病，
yi: 久任以官爻为官职本身，身安以官爻为病；
占卜取用爻，妙处在于变通。
en: For a long tenure the Pressure line is taken as the office itself, for bodily safety it is taken as illness;
in divining, the wonder of using a line lies in the change.

title: 求荐奖与谪官开复：官文破坏恐荐贤不力、鬼象克世虑奖饰非真、世值空亡求荣不遂望擢难迁；谪官开复同此推；民间坊匾旌表冠带衣巾乡贤乡饮同类

rule.yi: 求荐举、嘉奖，而遇到官爻、文书破坏，恐怕荐贤的人不出力；鬼象克世，担心嘉奖不是真心实意；世遇空亡，求荣不成，盼升也难迁。被贬谪的官员请求开复（恢复官职），也同此推断。民间的牌坊匾额、旌表、冠带、衣巾、乡贤、乡饮等事，也属同类。
rule.en: In seeking recommendation or commendation, if Pressure and Resource (the document line) are broken and damaged, one fears that those who recommend the worthy do not exert themselves; if the Pressure image controls the Self, one fears the commendation is not genuine; if the Self meets Void, seeking honour does not succeed and hoping for promotion one cannot move. For a demoted official asking to be reinstated, judge in the same way. Memorial arches and tablets in the villages, commendation, caps and sashes, scholars' robes, the shrine of local worthies, and the village drinking ceremony are of the same kind.

note.yi: 「荐奖」是被上司荐举、嘉奖；「官文」是官爻和文书（父母爻）；「奖餙」的「餙」是「饰」，奖饰就是褒奖的话；「开复」是被贬谪的官员请求恢复官职。「坊匾」是牌坊匾额，「旌表」是朝廷表彰，「冠带」是赐冠带的荣典，「衣巾」是生员的衣巾，「乡贤」是入乡贤祠，「乡饮」是乡饮酒礼里被推为宾介。这些民间荣典占法同荐奖。与易林补遗官员荐奖（EL.79–88）对着看：那一章有更细的断法。
note.en: 'Jianjiang' is being recommended and commended by a superior; 'guanwen' is the Pressure line and the document line (the Resource line); the 'shi' of 'jiangshi' is the variant for 'to adorn', so 'jiangshi' is words of praise; 'kaifu' is a demoted official asking to be restored to office. 'Fangbian' is memorial arches and tablets, 'jingbiao' is imperial commendation, 'guandai' is the honour of being granted cap and sash, 'yijin' is the robe and cap of a licentiate, 'xiangxian' is entering the shrine of local worthies, and 'xiangyin' is being named a guest of honour at the village drinking ceremony. These village honours are divined in the same way as recommendation. Read against the Yilin Buyi on recommendation of officials (EL.79-88), which has finer judgments.

zh: 求荐奖，而遇官文破坏，恐荐贤之不力，
鬼象克世，虑奖餙之非真。
世值空亡，求荣不遂，望擢难迁。
yi: 求荐举、嘉奖，而遇到官爻、文书破坏，恐怕荐贤的人不出力；
鬼象克世，担心嘉奖不是真心实意；
世遇空亡，求荣不成，盼升也难迁。
被贬谪的官员请求开复，也同此推断。
en: In seeking recommendation or commendation, if Pressure and Resource (the document line) are broken and damaged, one fears that those who recommend the worthy do not exert themselves;
if the Pressure image controls the Self, one fears the commendation is not genuine;
if the Self meets Void, seeking honour does not succeed and hoping for promotion one cannot move.
For a demoted official asking to be reinstated, judge in the same way.

zh: 民间坊匾、旌表、冠带、衣巾、乡贤、乡饮等事同类。
yi: 民间的牌坊匾额、旌表、冠带、衣巾、乡贤、乡饮等事，也属同类。
en: Memorial arches and tablets in the villages, commendation, caps and sashes, scholars' robes, the shrine of local worthies, and the village drinking ceremony are of the same kind.

title: 面圣上书、叩阍献策与条陈于将相：不可遇遁；见六冲则上下睽隔、受五克（五爻克世）则披君逆鳞、五位伤（五爻空破绝散）则忠言逆耳；条陈于将相喜官兴而忌克世

rule.yi: 面见皇上上书、叩阍陈情献策，不可遇到遁卦。见六冲，就上下隔阂；受五爻的克，就触犯君主的逆鳞；五位受伤，就忠言逆耳。如果是向将相逐条陈述意见，喜官旺而忌克世。
rule.en: In presenting a memorial to the sovereign in person, or knocking at the palace gate to offer a plan, the hexagram Dun must not be met. Meeting a six-clash, high and low are estranged; suffering the control of the fifth line, one touches the reversed scale on the sovereign's throat; the fifth place being injured, loyal words grate on the ear. If one is presenting views item by item to a general or chief minister, thriving Pressure is welcome and controlling the Self is feared.

note.yi: 「面圣上书」是当面向皇上呈递奏章，「叩阍」是到宫门叩击喊冤、陈情，「献策」是进献谋略，「条陈」是向将相逐条陈述意见。「遁不可遇」按文意是遁卦（天山遁，是退避的象）不可遇，与书里别处「得遁而不进」同类，是按卦名取义的忌。「睽隔」是隔阂。「逆鳞」是传说龙喉下倒生的鳞，触到它龙必怒，比喻触犯君主的忌讳。「忠言逆耳」是忠言不被听从。书里自注：五克是五爻克世，五位伤是五爻空、破、绝、散。和易林补遗朝天面旨（EL.91–93）、黄金策仕宦的奏陈谏诤（HJC.26）对着看。
note.en: 'Mian sheng shang shu' is presenting a memorial to the sovereign face to face, 'kouhun' is knocking at the palace gate to complain of a wrong or plead one's case, 'xiance' is offering a plan, and 'tiaochen' is presenting views item by item to a general or minister. 'Dun bu ke yu', by the sense, is that the hexagram Dun (Retreat, the image of withdrawing) must not be met, of a kind with 'getting Dun, no advance' elsewhere in the book, a taboo taken from the name of the hexagram. 'Kuige' is estrangement. 'Nilin' is the scale growing the wrong way beneath a dragon's throat, which makes the dragon furious when touched, a figure for offending the sovereign's taboos. 'Loyal words grate on the ear' is loyal words not being heeded. The book's own gloss: 'five controls' is the fifth line controlling the Self, and 'fifth place injured' is the fifth line Void, broken, extinct or scattered. Read against the Yilin Buyi on the audience at court (EL.91-93) and the Huangjin Ce on memorials and remonstrances (HJC.26).

zh: 面圣上书，叩阍献策，遁不可遇也。
见六冲而上下睽隔，受五克而披君逆鳞，五位伤而忠言逆耳。
若条陈于将相，喜官兴而忌克世也。
yi: 面见皇上上书、叩阍陈情献策，不可遇到遁卦。
见六冲，就上下隔阂；受五爻的克，就触犯君主的逆鳞；五位受伤，就忠言逆耳。
如果是向将相逐条陈述意见，喜官旺而忌克世。
en: In presenting a memorial to the sovereign in person, or knocking at the palace gate to offer a plan, the hexagram Dun must not be met.

Meeting a six-clash, high and low are estranged; suffering the control of the fifth line, one touches the reversed scale on the sovereign's throat; the fifth place being injured, loyal words grate on the ear.
If one is presenting views item by item to a general or chief minister, thriving Pressure is welcome and controlling the Self is feared.

zh: 五位，谓五爻空破绝散也。
yi: 五克就是五爻克世，
五位受伤，就是五爻空、破、绝、散。
en: 'Five controls' means the fifth line controlling the Self,
and 'the fifth place injured' means the fifth line Void, broken, extinct or scattered.

title: 在任防参罚与离任虑后患：在任而防参罚则恶子动而好官兴、世空则离任；离任而虑后患则好子动而恶官兴、世空则无事

rule.yi: 在任上防被参劾、处罚的，厌子孙动而喜官旺，世空就是要离任；离任后担心留下后患的，喜子孙动而厌官旺，世空就没有事。
rule.en: For one in office guarding against impeachment and penalty, Output moving is hated and Pressure rising is welcome, and the Self Void means leaving the post; for one who has left office and fears trouble afterwards, Output moving is welcome and Pressure rising is hated, and the Self Void means no trouble.

note.yi: 「参罚」是被上司参劾、处罚。「恶」是厌，「好」是喜：在任上怕被参，所以厌子孙动（子孙克官、伤官）而喜官旺；离任之后怕被追究后患，反过来喜子孙动（子孙克官，官不来追）而厌官旺。「世空则离任」「世空则无事」是同一个世空在两种处境下的不同结果：在任时世空就是要离开，离任后世空就是没有事。这一条是同一组爻神在『在任』和『离任』两个处境下取向相反的例子；黄金策仕宦的子孙交重（HJC.03）只讲了在任的一面。
note.en: 'Canfa' is being impeached and penalised by a superior. 'E' is dislike and 'hao' is liking: in office one fears impeachment, so Output moving (Output controls Pressure and injures the office) is hated and thriving Pressure welcome; after leaving office one fears being called to account for what is left behind, and the other way round Output moving (Output controls Pressure, so the office does not come after one) is welcome and thriving Pressure is hated. 'The Self Void means leaving the post' and 'the Self Void means no trouble' are different results of the same Void Self in two situations: while in office a Void Self means leaving, and after leaving it means nothing happens. This entry is an example of the same set of lines leaning opposite ways in the two situations of being in office and having left; the Huangjin Ce on Output moving (HJC.03) speaks only of the in-office side.

zh: 夫在任而防参罚，恶子动而好官兴，世空则离任。
离任而虑后患，好子动而恶官兴，世空则无事。
yi: 在任上防被参劾、处罚的，厌子动而喜官旺，世空就是要离任；
离任后担心留下后患的，喜子动而厌官旺，世空就没有事。
en: For one in office guarding against impeachment and penalty, Output moving is hated and Pressure rising is welcome, and the Self Void means leaving the post;
for one who has left office and fears trouble afterwards, Output moving is welcome and Pressure rising is hated, and the Self Void means no trouble.

title: 大计与告养：大计求官鬼无瑕、世爻有气，官临日月生扶定膺卓异廉能之选、子孙动有降职之忧、兄弟摇有罚俸之议、兼逢官破致仕还乡；养亲告病休官若官克世被恶、官爻破绝空散、世随墓助伤则辞不得去

rule.yi: 问大计（定期考核官员），要官鬼没有瑕疵，要世爻有气；官临日、月又得生扶，必定被选在卓异、廉能的一等；子孙动，就有降职的忧虑；兄弟摇动，就有罚俸的议论；再遇官破，就致仕还乡。为奉养双亲请假、告病辞官：如果官克世而被厌恶，官爻破、绝、空、散，谁能明白你高蹈归隐的心怀；世象随墓、助伤，反而被世俗的尘缘束缚。
rule.en: In asking about the grand evaluation of officials, one wants Pressure without flaw and the Self line with force; if Pressure sits on the Day or Month and is generated and supported, one will surely be chosen among the outstanding, upright and capable; Output moving, there is the worry of demotion; Peer stirring, there is talk of a fine of salary; and if Pressure is also broken, one retires and goes home. In asking leave to support one's parents or retiring on grounds of illness: if Pressure controls the Self and one is disliked, and the Pressure line is broken, extinct, Void or scattered, who will understand a heart set on lofty retreat; if the Self image follows into the tomb and helps the injury, one is instead bound by the dust of the world.

note.yi: 「大计」是明清对官员的定期考核（三年一次的外官大计，京官则是京察）。「卓意」疑是「卓异」之误：卓异是考绩最优，「廉能」是廉洁能干。「罚傣」的「傣」是「俸」之误，罚俸是扣俸禄。「致仕还乡」是退休回家。「养亲给假」是请假奉养双亲，「告病休官」是以病为由辞官。「高蹈」是远走高飞、归隐不仕，「高蹈之怀」就是想辞官归隐的心；「风尘之缚」是被世俗尘缘束缚，这里指走不脱。书里的断法：大计要官鬼无瑕、世爻有气，子孙动、兄弟摇都不利，官破则退休；辞官的占问反过来，官克世、官爻破绝空散、世随墓助伤，都是辞不掉。和易隐官禄占的官职退复（YY.28）、在任（YY.20）对着看。
note.en: 'Daji' is the periodic evaluation of officials under the Ming and Qing (the triennial evaluation of provincial officials, and for officials in the capital the capital review). 'Zhuoyi' written 'zhuoyi' with another character is presumably a slip for 'zhuoyi', outstanding: the best in the evaluation; 'lianneng' is honest and able. The 'dai' of 'fadai' is a slip for 'feng', salary, so 'fafeng' is a fine of salary. 'Zhishi huanxiang' is retiring and going home. 'Yangqin gejia' is asking leave to support one's parents, and 'gaobing xiuguan' is resigning on grounds of illness. 'Gaodao' is flying far away and living in retirement without office, so 'gaodao zhi huai' is the wish to resign and retire; 'fengchen zhi fu' is being bound by worldly ties, here meaning one cannot get away. The book's judgments: the grand evaluation wants Pressure without flaw and the Self line with force; Output moving and Peer stirring are both unfavourable; broken Pressure means retirement; resigning is the other way round, and Pressure controlling the Self, the Pressure line broken, extinct, Void or scattered, and the Self following into the tomb and helping the injury all mean one cannot resign. Read against the Yi Yin on dismissal and reinstatement (YY.28) and on being in office (YY.20).

zh: 大计之问，求官鬼之无瑕，索世爻之有气，
官临日月生扶，定膺卓意廉能之选，
若官克世而被恶，官爻破绝空散，谁明高蹈之怀，
世象随墓助伤，反受风尘之缚。
yi: 问大计，要官鬼没有瑕疵，要世爻有气；
官临日月又得生扶，必定被选在卓异、廉能的一等；
子孙动，就有降职的忧虑；
兄弟摇动，就有罚俸的议论；
再遇官破，就致仕还乡。
为奉养双亲请假、告病辞官：
如果官克世而被厌恶，官爻破、绝、空、散，谁能明白你高蹈归隐的心怀；
世象随墓、助伤，反而被世俗的尘缘束缚。
en: In asking about the grand evaluation, one wants Pressure without flaw and the Self line with force;
if Pressure sits on the Day or Month and is generated and supported, one will surely be chosen among the outstanding, upright and capable;
when Output moves, there is the worry of demotion;
when Peer stirs, there is talk of a fine of salary;
and if Pressure is also broken, one retires and goes home.
In asking leave to support one's parents or retiring on grounds of illness:
if Pressure controls the Self and one is disliked, and the Pressure line is broken, extinct, Void or scattered, who will understand a heart set on lofty retreat;
if the Self image follows into the tomb and helps the injury, one is instead bound by the dust of the world.

title: 任乱地求身安与任危邦求爵显：任乱地随墓助伤世穷鬼发非祥；任危邦官隆世实则吉；治河防决忌鬼动鬼克、抽税征商忌应空财坏、考卷有瑕用父母、征徭无用妻财，志此用此志彼用彼

rule.yi: 到乱地去任官而求身平安，随墓、助伤、世穷、鬼发，都不吉祥；到危邦去任官而求爵位显赫，官旺、世实，就吉。例如治河防决口，忌鬼动、鬼克；抽税征商，忌应空、财坏；考卷有瑕疵，用父母；征徭役，不用妻财；占的人志在这件就用这个爻，志在那件就用那个爻。
rule.en: Taking office in a disordered region and seeking personal safety, following into the tomb, helping the injury, the Self at its end and Pressure moving are all inauspicious; taking office in a perilous state and seeking a distinguished title, thriving Pressure and a solid Self are auspicious. For example, in managing a river and guarding against a breach, Pressure moving or controlling is to be avoided; in levying taxes on merchants, a Void Other and damaged Wealth are to be avoided; a flaw in the examination papers uses Resource, and levying labour service does not use Wealth; where the diviner's aim lies, that line is used, and if the aim is elsewhere, the other line is used.

note.yi: 「乱地」是政局混乱的地方，「危邦」是危险的国家。「世穷」按文意是世爻无气、到了尽头。注里的几个例子：治河防决口怕鬼动、鬼克；抽税征商怕应空、财坏；考卷有瑕疵要用父母（父母主文书、考卷）；征徭役不用妻财（徭役出的是人力，不是钱）。总的原则是『占的人志在哪一件，就取哪一个爻』：同一个官职，所问的事不同，用爻也不同。和黄金策仕宦的抚绥百姓（HJC.22）、巡察四方（HJC.23）对着看。
note.en: 'Luandi' is a place where public order has broken down, and 'weibang' is a perilous state. 'Shiqiong', by the sense, is the Self line without force, come to its end. The examples in the note: in managing a river against a breach one fears Pressure moving or controlling; in levying taxes on merchants one fears a Void Other and damaged Wealth; a flaw in the examination papers uses Resource (Resource governs documents and papers); levying labour service does not use Wealth (labour service pays in manpower, not money). The general principle is 'where the diviner's aim lies, that line is taken': for the same office, the line used differs with what is asked. Read against the Huangjin Ce on pacifying the people (HJC.22) and on touring and inspecting the regions (HJC.23).

zh: 任乱地而求身安，随墓助伤、世穷鬼发非祥，
任危邦而求爵显，官隆世实则吉。
yi: 到乱地去任官而求身平安，随墓、助伤、世穷、鬼发，都不吉祥；
到危邦去任官而求爵位显赫，官旺、世实，就吉。
en: Taking office in a disordered region and seeking personal safety, following into the tomb, helping the injury, the Self at its end and Pressure moving are all inauspicious;
taking office in a perilous state and seeking a distinguished title, thriving Pressure and a solid Self are auspicious.

zh: 设如治河防决，忌鬼动鬼克，
考卷有瑕用父母，征徭无用妻财，
在占者志此用此，志彼用彼也。
yi: 例如治河防决口，忌鬼动、鬼克；
抽税征商，忌应空、财坏；
考卷有瑕疵，用父母；征徭役，不用妻财；
占的人志在这件就用这个爻，志在那件就用那个爻。
en: For example, in managing a river and guarding against a breach, Pressure moving or controlling is to be avoided;
in levying taxes on merchants, a Void Other and damaged Wealth are to be avoided;
a flaw in the examination papers uses Resource, and levying labour service does not use Wealth;
where the diviner's aim lies, that line is used, and if the aim is elsewhere, the other line is used.

title: 公揭参疏、交代、官来与觅人代署：公揭参疏犹词讼，先占上意从违、次考应爻生克；何时交代以官鬼墓绝、子孙生值为期；何时官来不拘士庶僚役以官鬼生旺为实；觅人代署应空则谁代之，或从官或从人，用爻当晰

rule.yi: 凡是公开揭发、参劾上疏的事，就像词讼一样：先占上面的意思是依从还是违背，再看应爻的生克。问什么时候交代（与继任人交接）：以官鬼入墓、入绝，子孙生旺值日（月）为期。问什么时候新官来：不论是读书人、百姓、官员、衙役，都以官鬼生旺为应验。找人代理署事：应空，谁来代他？或者从官（爵位）看，或者从人（那个人）看，用爻应当分清。
rule.en: A public denunciation or impeaching memorial is like a lawsuit: first divine whether the higher authority will comply or go against it, then examine the generating and controlling of the Other line. When will the handover be: the date is set by Pressure entering the tomb or extinction and Output being born or on duty. When will the new official come: whatever sort of person, scholar, commoner, official or runner, it is confirmed by Pressure being generated and thriving. In seeking someone to act in the post: if the Other is Void, who will stand in for him? Either look from the office (its rank) or from the man, and the line to use should be made clear.

note.yi: 「公揭」是公开的揭帖，「参疏」是参劾的奏疏，这一类像打官司（词讼），所以先看上意、再看应爻。「上意从违」是上面的意思是依从还是违背。「交代」是前后任官员交接。「官来」是继任的官什么时候到。「代署」是找人代理（署理）这个官职。「士庶僚役」是读书人、百姓、官员、衙役，不论哪一类人来接任，都以官鬼生旺为应验。书里自注：「官来」问的是那个官位（爵），「人代」问的是那个人，用爻要分得这样细。「交代」的应期取官鬼入墓绝（旧官的运尽）和子孙生旺（新的接替）：这与易隐官禄占的替代（YY.24）用官逢死墓绝日代、子旺动即时可代是同一类。
note.en: 'Gongjie' is a public placard of accusation, and 'canshu' is a memorial of impeachment; this kind of matter is like a lawsuit, so one first looks at the higher authority's mind and then at the Other line. 'Shangyi congwei' is whether the higher authority will comply or go against it. 'Jiaodai' is the handover between the outgoing and incoming officials. 'Guan lai' is when the successor arrives. 'Daishu' is finding someone to act in the post. 'Shishu liaoyi' are scholars, commoners, officials and runners: whichever sort of man comes to take over, it is confirmed by Pressure being generated and thriving. The book's own gloss: 'the official comes' asks about the rank of that post, and 'someone stands in' asks about that man, and the line to use is distinguished this finely. The timing of the handover takes Pressure entering the tomb or extinction (the old official's luck exhausted) and Output being born or thriving (the successor), the same kind as 'Pressure meeting a day of death, tomb or extinction takes over; Output thriving and moving can take over at once' in the Yi Yin on replacement (YY.24).

zh: 凡公揭参疏，犹词讼也，先占上意从违，次考应爻生克。
何时交代，官鬼墓绝、子孙生值以为期；
何时官来，毋拘士庶僚役，官鬼生旺以为实。
觅人代署，应空谁为代之，或从官，或从人，用爻当晰也。
yi: 凡是公开揭发、参劾上疏的事，就像词讼一样：先占上面的意思是依从还是违背，再看应爻的生克。
问什么时候交代：以官鬼入墓、入绝，子孙生旺值日为期；
问什么时候新官来：不论是读书人、百姓、官员、衙役，以官鬼生旺为应验。
找人代理署事：应空，谁来代他？或者从官看，或者从人看，用爻应当分清。
en: A public denunciation or impeaching memorial is like a lawsuit: first divine whether the higher authority will comply or go against it, then examine the generating and controlling of the Other line.
When will the handover be: the date is set by Pressure entering the tomb or extinction and Output being born or on duty;
when will the new official come: whatever sort of person, scholar, commoner, official or runner, it is confirmed by Pressure being generated and thriving.
In seeking someone to act in the post: if the Other is Void, who will stand in for him? Either look from the office or from the man, and the line to use should be made clear.

yi: 问官来，指的是那个官位的爵；
问人代，指的是那个人；
用爻要细到这个地步。
en: 'The official's coming' refers to the rank of that post;
'someone standing in' refers to that man;
the line to use must be distinguished as finely as this.

title: 杂职（太医、僧纲、道纪）：所喜惟官旺财备，所戒乃鬼克世空及随墓助伤；凡占杂职皆同此

rule.yi: 太医、僧纲（僧官）、道纪（道官），所喜的只是官旺、财备；所戒的是鬼克世、世空，以及随墓助伤。凡是占杂职，都和这个相同。
rule.en: For court physicians, Buddhist registrars and Daoist registrars, what is welcome is only thriving Pressure and ready Wealth; what is to be guarded against is Pressure controlling the Self, the Self Void, and following into the tomb and helping the injury. All divinations about miscellaneous posts are the same as this.

dispute.yi: 这一条以官旺财备为喜，和易林补遗援监纳吏（EL.74）同：僧官、道官、阴阳官、医官宜鬼旺财兴。黄金策仕宦（HJC.27）却以子孙为僧官、道官、医官的用神，父母发动反而有灾悔，王洪绪也这样说。两边取的象不同：易冒、易林补遗按『官职』取象（有官有俸）；黄金策按『行业』取象（僧道医药主子孙）。
dispute.en: This entry takes thriving Pressure and ready Wealth as what is welcome, as does the Yilin Buyi on buying office and entering the clerks (EL.74): Buddhist officials, Daoist officials, officials of yin and yang, and medical officials should have thriving Pressure and rising Wealth. The Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.27) instead takes Output as the Subject of monastic, Daoist and medical officials, and has Resource moving cause disaster and regret, and Wang Hongxu says the same. The two sides take different images: the Yimao and the Yilin Buyi take it by the image of the office (an office with salary); the Huangjin Ce takes it by the image of the trade (monks, Daoists and medicine belong to Output).

note.yi: 「太医」是宫廷、官府的医官，「僧纲」是管理僧众的僧官（僧纲司），「道纪」是管理道士的道官（道纪司）。「杂职」是不入流的小官。「官旺财备」是官爻旺相、财爻齐备（有官有俸）。「随助」是「随墓助伤」的缩写。原文这一句末尾有一个多出来的「）」，这里去掉。书里自注：凡占杂职都按这个。
note.en: 'Taiyi' is a medical officer of the court or a government office, 'senggang' is the Buddhist official who supervises the monks (the Sengguang bureau), and 'daoji' is the Daoist official who supervises the Daoists (the Daoji bureau). 'Zazhi' is a petty post outside the nine ranks. 'Guanwang caibei' is the Pressure line thriving and the Wealth line complete (an office with salary). 'Suizhu' is short for 'following into the tomb and helping the injury'. The original sentence has an extra closing bracket at its end, which is dropped here. The book's own gloss: all divinations about miscellaneous posts follow this.

yi: 太医、管僧人的僧纲、管道士的道纪，
所喜的只是官旺、财备；
所戒的是鬼克世、世空，
以及随墓助伤。
en: For court physicians, Buddhist registrars and Daoist registrars,
what is welcome is only thriving Pressure and ready Wealth;
what is to be guarded against is Pressure controlling the Self, the Self Void,
and following into the tomb and helping the injury.

yi: 凡是占杂职，都和这个相同。
en: All divinations about miscellaneous posts are the same as this.

title: 衙门裁革、公议短长与国务行止：裁革止察官爻（官旺则不裁）、公议短长惟求鬼象（鬼破则中止）、国务行止专从五位（兴革损益得君命为行止、五爻克世则不行）

rule.yi: 衙门裁撤革除，只察看官爻；公议的短长，只求鬼象；国家政务行止，专从五位。官旺就不裁；公议将要实行的事，鬼破就中止；兴办、革除、减少、增加，以得到君命才行，五爻克世，就不能行。
rule.en: Whether a government office is abolished, one looks only at the Pressure line; whether public opinion carries or fails, one seeks only the Pressure image; whether a state affair goes ahead or stops, one follows only the fifth place. Thriving Pressure means it is not abolished; of a matter public opinion is about to carry out, broken Pressure stops it; to set up, abolish, reduce or increase anything, it goes ahead only if the sovereign's order is obtained, and if the fifth line controls the Self, it does not go.

note.yi: 「裁革」是衙门被裁撤革除，「公议」是公众（朝野）的议论，「国务」是国家政务。「五位」是五爻（君位）。书里自注：官旺则不裁；公议要实行的事，鬼破则中止；兴、革、损、益（兴办、革除、减少、增加）要得到君命才行得通，五爻克世就行不通。这一条是功名章的结尾，从个人的官职转到了衙门和国家的事；和本书国事章（YM.01 起）、易林补遗朝廷国事（EL.01 起）对着看。
note.en: 'Caige' is a government office being cut and abolished, 'gongyi' is the discussion of the public (court and country), and 'guowu' is the business of the state. 'Wuwei' is the fifth line (the sovereign's place). The book's own gloss: thriving Pressure means it is not cut; of a matter public opinion is about to carry out, broken Pressure stops it; to set up, abolish, reduce or increase anything one must obtain the sovereign's order for it to go through, and the fifth line controlling the Self means it does not. This entry is the end of the chapter on fame and office, turning from a person's own post to the affairs of the offices and the state; read against the chapter on affairs of state in this book (from YM.01) and the Yilin Buyi on the affairs of the court (from EL.01).

yi: 衙门裁撤革除，只察看官爻；
公议的短长，只求鬼象；
国家政务的行止，专从五位。
en: Whether a government office is abolished, one looks only at the Pressure line;
whether public opinion carries or fails, one seeks only the Pressure image;
whether a state affair goes ahead or stops, one follows only the fifth place.

zh: 公议将行之事，鬼破则中止。
兴革损益，得君命为行止，五爻克世，则不行也。
yi: 官旺就不裁。
公议将要实行的事，鬼破就中止。
兴办、革除、减少、增加，以得到君命为行止，五爻克世，就不能行。
en: Thriving Pressure means it is not abolished.
Of a matter public opinion is about to carry out, broken Pressure stops it.
To set up, abolish, reduce or increase anything, it goes ahead only if the sovereign's order is obtained, and if the fifth line controls the Self, it does not go.

title: 用人总纲：古之治国莫难于知人，知人善任而庶事有济，营家治生者亦然；任仆以财为用、任人以应为尊，三冲则鲜克有终、克世则中怀不利

rule.yi: 古代治国的人，没有比识人更难的：认得清人又用得对，各种事情才办得成，何况是经营家业、谋生的人呢？任用仆人以财爻为用，任用一般的人以应爻为尊；三冲，很少能有始有终；应克世，心里怀着对我不利的念头。
rule.en: Of those who governed a state in antiquity, nothing was harder than knowing men: if one knows men and employs them well, all affairs are carried through, and how much more for one who runs a household and makes a living? To employ a servant the Wealth line is the Subject, and to employ anyone else the Other line is honoured; with the three clashes it is rare to see a thing through to the end, and with the Other controlling the Self he bears in his heart what is not to my advantage.

note.yi: 「知人善任」是认得清人、又用得对。「任仆以财为用」是用仆人取妻财爻，「任人以应为尊」是用一般的人取应爻。「三冲」（见 YM.07 注）是散、是变，所以很少有始有终；「克世则中怀不利」是应克世，他心里存着对我不利的念头。这一章的『用人』是雇用、任用仆人、帮手、伙计，和上一章讲的做官任职不是一回事，归事业里的差役一类。与易林补遗用人藏否（EL.131–133）对着看。
note.en: 'Zhiren shanren' is knowing men clearly and employing them rightly. 'Employing a servant takes Wealth as the Subject' is taking the Wealth line for a servant, and 'for anyone else the Other is honoured' is taking the Other line for ordinary people. The 'three clashes' (see the note to YM.07) are scattering and changing, hence it is rare to see a thing through; 'controlling the Self, he bears in his heart what is not to my advantage' is the Other controlling the Self, so that he carries in his heart a thought against me. The 'employing people' of this chapter is hiring and employing servants, helpers and hands, which is not the same as holding office as in the previous chapter, and belongs to the runners-and-servants group in Career. Read against the Yilin Buyi on employing people and whether they hide (EL.131-133).

zh: 古之治国者，莫难于知人，
任仆以财为用，任人以应为尊，
三冲则鲜克有终，克世则中怀不利。
yi: 古代治国的人，没有比识人更难的：
认得清人又用得对，各种事情才办得成，
何况是经营家业、谋生的人呢？
任用仆人以财为用，任用一般的人以应为尊；
三冲，很少能有始有终；应克世，心里怀着对我不利的念头。
en: Of those who governed a state in antiquity, nothing was harder than knowing men:
if one knows men and employs them well, all affairs are carried through,
and how much more for one who runs a household and makes a living?
To employ a servant the Wealth line is taken as the Subject, and to employ anyone else the Other line is honoured;
with the three clashes it is rare to see a thing through to the end, and with the Other controlling the Self he bears in his heart what is not to my advantage.

title: 用人·任人取爻：任长以父、任幼以子、任士以福、任臣以应；生世为忠良、克世为奸恶，空则无能或不为我力、散则无心或不从我用、破不一向、绝不先劳、纵生世不得其力；任文以父、任贾以财、任畜牧以子孙、任交游以兄弟，应象皆不可病；应为根本艺为枝叶

rule.yi: 任用年长的用父爻，任用年幼的用子爻，任用读书人用福爻，任用臣属用应爻，依他所担的任来取用爻。生世的是忠良，克世的是奸恶；空就无能，或者不为我出力；散就无心，或者不听我用；破就不一心向着我，绝就不肯先出力，纵然生世也得不到他的力。任用文人用父爻，任用商人用财爻，任用养牲畜的用子孙，任用交游往来的用兄弟，而应象都不可有病。因为应是根本，技艺是枝叶，应空、应破，即使父爻旺，也做不成文事。
rule.en: For employing an elder, use the father line; for a youth, the child line; for a scholar, the Output line; for a subordinate, the Other line: the line is taken according to the charge he is given. One that generates the Self is loyal and good, one that controls the Self is treacherous and wicked; Void means incapable, or not exerting himself for me; scattered means no heart, or not following my use; broken means not wholly turned toward me; extinct means not willing to labour first, and even if it generates the Self one does not get his strength. For a literary man use the Resource line, for a merchant the Wealth line, for a herdsman the Output line, and for a man of social contacts the Peer line, and in all of these the Other image must not be sick. For the Other is the root and the skill is the branches and leaves: if the Other is Void or broken, even with a thriving Resource line he cannot do literary work.

note.yi: 「任长」是用年长的人，「任幼」是用年幼的，「任士」是用读书人，「任臣」是用臣属、属下；「福」是福神，即子孙。「忠良」「奸恶」是好坏。「不为我力」是不为我出力，「不一向」是不一心向着我，「不先劳」是不肯先出力。「文」是文事，「贾」是商人，「畜牧」是养牲畜的人，「交游」是交际往来的人。「应为根本，艺为枝叶」是说应爻是这个人本身，他的才艺只是枝叶，所以应空、应破时，即使父母旺（有文才），人也成不了文事。这一条是用爻的选法（按所用的人取爻）再加上生、克、空、散、破、绝对这个人的品性、出力的判断。
note.en: 'Renzhang' is employing an older person, 'renyou' a younger, 'renshi' a scholar, and 'renchen' a subordinate or underling; 'fu' is the fortune spirit, that is, Output. 'Zhongliang' and 'jian'e' are good and bad. 'Bu wei wo li' is not exerting himself for me, 'bu yi xiang' is not wholly turning toward me, and 'bu xian lao' is not being willing to labour first. 'Wen' is literary work, 'gu' is a merchant, 'xumu' is one who raises livestock, and 'jiaoyou' is one who keeps social company. 'The Other is the root and skill is the branches and leaves' says that the Other line is the man himself, and his skills are only branches and leaves, so when the Other is Void or broken, even if Resource is thriving (he has the literary talent) the man cannot do literary work. This entry is both the way of choosing the line (taking the line according to the man employed) and the judging of the man's character and effort by generation, control, Void, scattered, broken and extinct.

zh: 任长以父，任幼以子，任士以福，任臣以应，
以生世为忠良，克世为奸恶，
破不一向，绝不先劳也，纵生世而不得其力。
任文以父，任贾以财，任畜牧以子孙，任交游以兄弟，
盖应为根本，艺为枝叶，应空破，虽父旺而不文。
yi: 任用年长的用父爻，任用年幼的用子爻，任用读书人用福爻，任用臣属用应爻，
依他所担的任来取用爻。
生世的是忠良，克世的是奸恶；
空就无能，或者不为我出力；
散就无心，或者不听我用；
破就不一心向着我，绝就不肯先出力，纵然生世也得不到他的力。
任用文人用父爻，任用商人用财爻，任用养牲畜的用子孙，任用交游往来的用兄弟，
而应象都不可有病。
因为应是根本，技艺是枝叶，应空、应破，即使父爻旺，也做不成文事。
en: For employing an elder use the father line, for a youth the child line, for a scholar the Output line, for a subordinate the Other line,
the line being taken according to the charge he is given.
One that generates the Self is loyal and good, one that controls the Self is treacherous and wicked;
Void means incapable, or not exerting himself for me;
scattered means no heart, or not following my use;
broken means not wholly turned toward me, extinct means not willing to labour first, and even if it generates the Self one does not get his strength.
For a literary man use the Resource line, for a merchant the Wealth line, for a herdsman the Output line, and for a man of social contacts the Peer line,
and in all of these the Other image must not be sick.
For the Other is the root and the skill is the branches and leaves: if the Other is Void or broken, even with a thriving Resource line he cannot do literary work.

title: 用人·六亲推人：父母为才能、弟兄为诡诈、子孙为善良、妻财为术技、官鬼为强梁；先忠后佞者子化官、先奸后义者鬼化财，必因生克而后言吉凶

rule.yi: 六亲推一个人的品性：父母是才能，弟兄是诡诈，子孙是善良，妻财是术技，官鬼是强梁。先忠后佞的，是子化官；先奸后义的，是鬼化财。必须依据生克，之后才说吉凶。
rule.en: The six relations judge a man's character: Resource is talent, Peer is trickery, Output is goodness, Wealth is skill and craft, and Pressure is the bully. One who is first loyal and then flattering is Output turning into Pressure; one who is first treacherous and then righteous is Pressure turning into Wealth. One must go by generation and control before speaking of good or ill.

note.yi: 「才能」「诡诈」「善良」「术技」「强梁」是六亲配给人的品性：父母主才能，弟兄（兄弟）主诡诈，子孙主善良，妻财主术技（手艺），官鬼主强梁（强横不驯）。「先忠后佞者，子化官」：子孙（善良）变成官鬼（强梁），先忠后佞；「先奸后义者，鬼化财」：官鬼变成妻财，先奸后义。书里自注：必须依据生克才说吉凶——也就是六亲配的品性，还要看它生世还是克世才定好坏。
note.en: 'Talent', 'trickery', 'goodness', 'skill' and 'the bully' are the characters the six relations are assigned: Resource governs talent, Peer trickery, Output goodness, Wealth skill and craft, and Pressure the bully (forceful and unruly). 'First loyal then flattering is Output turning into Pressure': Output (goodness) turns into Pressure (the bully), first loyal and then flattering; 'first treacherous then righteous is Pressure turning into Wealth': Pressure turns into Wealth, first treacherous and then righteous. The book's own gloss: one must go by generation and control before speaking of good or ill, that is, the character assigned to a relation must also be looked at by whether it generates or controls the Self before good or bad is fixed.

yi: 六亲推人的品性：父母是才能，
弟兄是诡诈，
子孙是善良，
妻财是术技，
官鬼是强梁。
先忠后佞的，是子化官；
先奸后义的，是鬼化财。
en: The six relations judge a man's character: Resource is talent,
Peer is trickery,
Output is goodness,
Wealth is skill and craft,
and Pressure is the bully.
One who is first loyal and then flattering is Output turning into Pressure;
one who is first treacherous and then righteous is Pressure turning into Wealth.

yi: 必须依据生克，之后才说吉凶。
en: One must go by generation and control before speaking of good or ill.

title: 用人·六神推人：青龙生世得弹铗之贤、克世惟藏刀之诈；白虎生世刚而直、克世勇而暴；朱雀生世辩而忠、克世佞而奸；玄武生世智而敏、克世巧而贼；螣蛇生克分损益之虚浮、勾陈克生分善不善之迟滞；若来生世虽凶亦吉、来克世虽吉为凶

rule.yi: 六神推人：带青龙而生世，就得到弹铗那样的贤人；随青龙而克世，就只有藏刀的诈。白虎生世的，刚而直；白虎克世的，勇而暴。朱雀生世的，能辩而忠；朱雀克世的，佞而奸。玄武生世的，智而敏；玄武克世的，巧而贼。螣蛇的生、克，分出他对我的损益是真是虚；勾陈的克、生，分出他善不善是否迟钝滞涩。如果来生世，虽然（神）凶也吉；如果来克世，虽然（神）吉也成凶。
rule.en: The six spirits judge a man: with the Azure Dragon and generating the Self, one gets a worthy like the man who strikes his sword-hilt; following the Azure Dragon and controlling the Self, there is only the deceit of the hidden blade. The White Tiger generating the Self is firm and straight, the White Tiger controlling the Self is bold and violent. The Vermilion Bird generating the Self is eloquent and loyal, the Vermilion Bird controlling the Self is glib and treacherous. The Dark Tortoise generating the Self is wise and quick, the Dark Tortoise controlling the Self is cunning and thievish. The Coiling Snake's generating and controlling tell whether the gain or loss to me is real or empty; Hook Earth's controlling and generating tell whether his goodness or lack of it is sluggish and stuck. If one comes to generate the Self, even if ominous it is auspicious; if one comes to control the Self, even if auspicious it becomes ominous.

note.yi: 「弹铗之贤」用的是冯谖弹剑的典故（战国时孟尝君的门客冯谖，倚柱弹他的剑柄唱歌要求待遇，后来为孟尝君经营「三窟」），指有才、不轻易屈从的贤客。「藏刀之诈」是笑里藏刀。「虎」「雀」「武」是白虎、朱雀、玄武（原文写作「元武」）。「损益之虚浮」「善不善之迟滞」书里没有展开，按文意：螣蛇主虚浮，所以它的生克辨的是他对我的损益是真是虚；勾陈主迟滞，所以它的克生辨的是他的善不善是不是迟钝。书里自注：来生世的，神本身即使凶也吉；来克世的，神本身即使吉也凶——生克对我的关系，比六神本来的吉凶更要紧。六神的本义见术语表。
note.en: 'The worthy who strikes his sword-hilt' alludes to Feng Xuan striking his sword (in the Warring States period Feng Xuan, a retainer of Lord Mengchang, leant against a pillar, struck the hilt of his sword and sang to ask for better treatment, and later made 'three burrows' for Lord Mengchang), meaning a retainer of talent who does not bow easily. 'The deceit of the hidden blade' is the knife behind the smile. 'Tiger', 'bird' and 'tortoise' are the White Tiger, the Vermilion Bird and the Dark Tortoise (written in the text with another character for 'xuan'). 'The emptiness and flightiness of gain and loss' and 'the sluggishness of the good and the not good' are not expanded in the book; by the sense, the Coiling Snake governs emptiness and flightiness, so its generating and controlling tell whether the gain or loss to me is real or empty, and Hook Earth governs delay and stagnation, so its controlling and generating tell whether his goodness is slow. The book's own gloss: one that comes to generate the Self, even if the spirit itself is ominous, is auspicious; one that comes to control the Self, even if the spirit itself is auspicious, is ominous: the relation of generation and control to me matters more than the spirit's own luck. The original meanings of the six spirits are in the glossary.

zh: 带青龙而生，则得弹铗之贤，
随青龙而克，则惟藏刀之诈。
螣蛇生克，分损益之虚浮，
勾陈克生，分善不善之迟滞也。
yi: 六神推人：
带青龙而生世，就得到弹铗那样的贤人；
随青龙而克世，就只有藏刀的诈。
白虎生世的，刚而直；
白虎克世的，勇而暴。
朱雀生世的，能辩而忠；
朱雀克世的，佞而奸。
玄武生世的，智而敏；
玄武克世的，巧而贼。
螣蛇的生、克，分出他对我的损益是真是虚；
勾陈的克、生，分出他善不善是否迟钝滞涩。
en: The six spirits judge a man:
with the Azure Dragon and generating the Self, one gets a worthy like the man who strikes his sword-hilt;
following the Azure Dragon and controlling the Self, there is only the deceit of the hidden blade.
The White Tiger generating the Self is firm and straight,
the White Tiger controlling the Self is bold and violent.
The Vermilion Bird generating the Self is eloquent and loyal,
the Vermilion Bird controlling the Self is glib and treacherous.
The Dark Tortoise generating the Self is wise and quick,
the Dark Tortoise controlling the Self is cunning and thievish.
The Coiling Snake's generating and controlling tell whether the gain or loss to me is real or empty;
Hook Earth's controlling and generating tell whether his goodness or lack of it is sluggish and stuck.

yi: 如果来生世，虽然神凶也吉；
如果来克世，虽然神吉也成凶。
en: If one comes to generate the Self, even if the spirit is ominous it is auspicious;
if one comes to control the Self, even if the spirit is auspicious it becomes ominous.

title: 用人·八宫五行星煞推人：用爻独发论八宫（乾刚健/骄恣、坤柔顺/阿逢、震正直/暴戾、巽伶俐/风从、坎智巧/奸险、离明识/浮躁、艮笃实/疑滞、兑和悦/谄佞），五行六神诸星论用爻所值（水智/贼、火急/纵、木慈/懦、金刚毅/强横、土敦信/愚蠢；驿马勤趋走/数往来、天财善生息/善贪攘、官符长智谋/长讼斗、咸池能工技/溺酒色）；生世有益于己为贤、克世有损于己为不肖

rule.yi: 用爻动在八宫，就察八宫的性情；坐在五行，就推五行的性质；星煞详细看，衰旺仔细考，这个人是贤还是不肖，就可以借蓍草得知。八宫只论用爻单独发动：乾，生世是刚健，克世是骄恣；坤，生世是柔顺，克世是阿谀逢迎；震，生世是正直，克世是暴戾；巽，生世是伶俐，克世是随风倒；坎，生世是智巧，克世是奸险；离，生世是明白识事，克世是浮躁；艮，生世是笃实，克世是疑滞；兑，生世是和悦，克世是谄媚奸佞。五行、六神、诸星只论用爻所落的：水之贤叫智，不肖叫贼；火之贤叫急，不肖叫纵；木之贤叫慈，不肖叫懦；金之贤叫刚毅，不肖叫强横；土之贤叫敦信，不肖叫愚蠢。驿马生世，勤于奔走，克世，频繁来往；天财生世，善于生息，克世，善于贪占；官符生世，长于智谋，克世，长于讼斗；咸池生世，能于工技，克世，沉溺酒色。生世则对自己有益而是贤，克世则对自己有损而是不肖。
rule.en: When the Subject line moves in an eight-palace trigram, one examines the nature of that palace; when it sits in a phase, one infers the character of the phase; the stars and spirit-stars are examined in detail and strength and weakness carefully weighed, and whether a man is worthy or unworthy can be learned by the stalks.
