The eight palaces are discussed only when the Subject line moves alone: Qian, generating the Self is firm and strong, controlling the Self is arrogant and wilful; Kun, generating the Self is gentle and yielding, controlling the Self is fawning; Zhen, generating the Self is upright, controlling the Self is violent and perverse; Xun, generating the Self is clever, controlling the Self is going with the wind; Kan, generating the Self is shrewd and skilful, controlling the Self is treacherous and dangerous; Li, generating the Self is clear-sighted, controlling the Self is flighty and rash; Gen, generating the Self is solid and honest, controlling the Self is suspicious and stuck; Dui, generating the Self is harmonious and pleasant, controlling the Self is flattering and glib. The phases, the six spirits and the stars are discussed only by where the Subject line stands: Water, as worthy called wisdom, as unworthy called thievery; Fire, as worthy called ardour, as unworthy called licence; Wood, as worthy called kindness, as unworthy called weakness; Metal, as worthy called firmness, as unworthy called brutality; Earth, as worthy called steadfast good faith, as unworthy called stupidity. The Post Horse generating the Self is diligent in running about, controlling it is coming and going often; Heavenly Wealth generating is good at making money breed, controlling it is good at grabbing; the Official Charge generating is strong in wit and plans, controlling it is strong in lawsuits and quarrels; the Peach Blossom generating is able in crafts, controlling it is sunk in wine and women. Generating the Self, it benefits oneself and he is worthy; controlling the Self, it harms oneself and he is unworthy.

note.yi: 「八宫专论独发」是只有用爻单独发动时才论八宫；五行、六神、诸星则只论用爻所落的。八宫的性格：乾刚健（过则骄恣）、坤柔顺（过则阿逢）、震正直（过则暴戾）、巽伶俐（过则风从）、坎智巧（过则奸险）、离明识（过则浮躁）、艮笃实（过则疑滞）、兑和悦（过则谄佞）；每一宫都是生世取它的好处，克世取它的过。「风从」是随风倒、没有定见。五行各有贤与不肖两面。「驿马」「天财」「官符」「咸池」是神煞：驿马主奔走、天财主生息、官符主智谋讼斗、咸池主工技酒色。总原则：生世对我有益就是贤，克世对我有损就是不肖。原文这一大段注的末尾没有收尾的「）」，这里照原文取到「不肖」为止。
note.en: 'The eight palaces are discussed only for a line moving alone' means that the eight palaces are discussed only when the Subject line moves by itself; the phases, the six spirits and the stars are discussed only by where the Subject line stands. The characters of the eight palaces: Qian is firm and strong (overdone, arrogant), Kun gentle and yielding (overdone, fawning), Zhen upright (overdone, violent), Xun clever (overdone, going with the wind), Kan shrewd (overdone, treacherous), Li clear-sighted (overdone, flighty), Gen solid (overdone, stuck), Dui pleasant (overdone, flattering); in each palace generating the Self takes its good side and controlling the Self takes its excess. 'Fengcong' is falling with the wind, without settled views. Each phase has a worthy and an unworthy side. The Post Horse, Heavenly Wealth, the Official Charge and the Peach Blossom are spirit-stars: the Post Horse governs running about, Heavenly Wealth governs breeding money, the Official Charge governs wit and plans and lawsuits, and the Peach Blossom governs crafts, wine and women. The general principle: generating the Self benefits me and he is worthy, controlling the Self harms me and he is unworthy. The long note in the original has no closing bracket at its end, and here it is taken as in the original up to 'unworthy'.

zh: 动于八宫，则察八宫之情，
坐于五行，则推五行之性，
则人之贤不肖，可藉蓍而得也。
yi: 用爻动在八宫，就察八宫的性情；
坐在五行，就推五行的性质；
星煞详细看，衰旺仔细考，
这个人是贤还是不肖，就可以借蓍草得知。
en: When the Subject line moves in an eight-palace trigram, one examines the nature of that palace;
when it sits in a phase, one infers the character of the phase;
the stars and spirit-stars are examined in detail and strength and weakness carefully weighed,
and whether a man is worthy or unworthy can be learned by the stalks.

zh: 八宫专论独发，五行六神诸星，惟论用爻所值，
如动于乾，生世为刚健，克世为骄恣；
发于坤，生世为柔顺，克世为阿逢；
在震，生世为正直，克世为暴戾；
在巽，生世为伶俐，克世为风从；
在坎，生世为智巧，克世为奸险；
在离，生世为明识，克世为浮燥；
在艮，生世为笃实，克世为疑滞；
在兑，生世为和悦，克世为谄侫。
水之为贤曰智，为不肖曰贼；
火之为贤曰急，为不肖曰纵；
木之为贤曰慈，为不肖曰懦；
金之为贤曰刚毅，为不肖曰强横；
土之为贤曰敦信，为不肖曰愚蠢也。
驿马之生也，勤于趋走，克也，数于往来；
天财之生也，善于生息，克也，善于贪攘；
官符之生也，长于智谋，克也，长于讼斗；
咸池之生也，能于工技，克也，溺于酒色。
生世，则有益于己而为贤，克世，则有损于己而为不肖。
yi: 八宫只论用爻单独发动，五行、六神、诸星只论用爻所落的：
如动在乾，生世是刚健，克世是骄恣；
发在坤，生世是柔顺，克世是阿谀逢迎；
在震，生世是正直，克世是暴戾；
在巽，生世是伶俐，克世是随风倒；
在坎，生世是智巧，克世是奸险；
在离，生世是明白识事，克世是浮躁；
在艮，生世是笃实，克世是疑滞；
在兑，生世是和悦，克世是谄媚奸佞。
水之贤叫智，不肖叫贼；
火之贤叫急，不肖叫纵；
木之贤叫慈，不肖叫懦；
金之贤叫刚毅，不肖叫强横；
土之贤叫敦信，不肖叫愚蠢。
驿马生世，勤于奔走，克世，频繁来往；
天财生世，善于生息，克世，善于贪占；
官符生世，长于智谋，克世，长于讼斗；
咸池生世，能于工技，克世，沉溺酒色。
生世则对自己有益而是贤，克世则对自己有损而是不肖。
en: The eight palaces are discussed only when the Subject line moves alone, and the phases, the six spirits and the stars only by where the Subject line stands:
if it moves in Qian, generating the Self is firm and strong, controlling the Self is arrogant and wilful;
issuing in Kun, generating the Self is gentle and yielding, controlling the Self is fawning;
in Zhen, generating the Self is upright, controlling the Self is violent and perverse;
in Xun, generating the Self is clever, controlling the Self is going with the wind;
in Kan, generating the Self is shrewd and skilful, controlling the Self is treacherous and dangerous;
in Li, generating the Self is clear-sighted, controlling the Self is flighty and rash;
in Gen, generating the Self is solid and honest, controlling the Self is suspicious and stuck;
in Dui, generating the Self is harmonious and pleasant, controlling the Self is flattering and glib.
Water, as worthy called wisdom, as unworthy called thievery;
Fire, as worthy called ardour, as unworthy called licence;
Wood, as worthy called kindness, as unworthy called weakness;
Metal, as worthy called firmness, as unworthy called brutality;
Earth, as worthy called steadfast good faith, as unworthy called stupidity.
The Post Horse generating the Self is diligent in running about, controlling it is coming and going often;
Heavenly Wealth generating is good at making money breed, controlling it is good at grabbing;
the Official Charge generating is strong in wit and plans, controlling it is strong in lawsuits and quarrels;
the Peach Blossom generating is able in crafts, controlling it is sunk in wine and women.
Generating the Self, it benefits oneself and he is worthy; controlling the Self, it harms oneself and he is unworthy.

title: 收雇：三冲不久；收仆以财为用神——财神空则身从心不向、破散则轻疾病重丧亡、绝衰则不得其用、旺而生合世身则手足奉腹心、旺而克冲世则干仆加弱主；未收占臧否止忌三冲财病虽克不嫌、已收占去留亦忌三冲财动克世当去

rule.yi: 凡是占收雇，三冲就不长久。收仆是为了备驱使差遣的人，以财为用神：所以财神空，人虽然跟着我，心却不向着我；财神破、散，轻则疾病、重则丧亡；财神绝、衰，用他不上；财神旺而生合世身的，这是手足来奉养腹心；财神旺而克冲世的，这是干练的仆人欺凌软弱的主人。所以未收时占好坏，只忌三冲、财有病，即使克（世）也不嫌；已经收了占去留，也忌三冲、财动，克世就该让他走。
rule.en: In all divinations about taking on and hiring, the three clashes do not last. Taking on a servant is to have someone to be driven and sent about, and Wealth is the Subject: so with the Wealth spirit Void, the man follows in person but his heart is not toward me; with the Wealth spirit broken or scattered, there is illness at the lightest and death at the worst; with the Wealth spirit extinct or weak, one cannot use him; with the Wealth spirit thriving and generating or combining with the Self, this is hands and feet serving heart and belly; with the Wealth spirit thriving and controlling or clashing with the Self, this is a capable servant bullying a weak master. So when divining before taking him on whether he is good or bad, one fears only the three clashes and a sick Wealth, and even controlling is not objected to; when divining after taking him on whether he will go or stay, one also fears the three clashes and Wealth moving, and when it controls the Self he should go.

note.yi: 「收雇」是收用仆人、雇工，「驱役之使」是供驱使差遣的人。「财神」是妻财爻。「手足奉腹心」是手足供养腹心，比喻仆人尽心奉主；「干仆加弱主」是能干的仆人欺凌软弱的主人。「臧否」是好坏。「三冲」见 YM.07 注。「虽克不嫌」是还没收的时候财克世也不算坏；「克世当去」是已经收了的，财克世就该让他走。书里自注：未收之时，财弱生世看着吉却不吉，财强克世看着凶却不凶；已收之后问忠奸去留，克世就是辜负自己，生世才是尽心——不能拿『吉神』的名义去说克世不凶。章首目录列的是雇工、请人、去恶、防夺、防非、防病六问。与易林补遗用人藏否（EL.131–133）对着看。
note.en: 'Shougu' is taking on servants and hired hands, and 'quyi zhi shi' is those who are driven and sent about. 'The Wealth spirit' is the Wealth line. 'Hands and feet serving heart and belly' means a servant serving his master with all his heart; 'a capable servant bullying a weak master' is just that. 'Zangpi' is good or bad. For the 'three clashes' see the note to YM.07. 'Even controlling is not objected to' means that before he is taken on, Wealth controlling the Self is not counted as bad; 'when it controls the Self he should go' means that once he is taken on, Wealth controlling the Self means he should be let go. The book's own gloss: before he is taken on, weak Wealth generating the Self looks auspicious but is not, and strong Wealth controlling the Self looks ominous but is not; after he is taken on, in asking about loyalty or treachery and going or staying, controlling the Self is failing oneself and generating the Self is serving with all his heart, and one cannot use the name of an 'auspicious spirit' to say that controlling the Self is not ominous. The index at the head of the chapter lists six questions: hiring labour, engaging a person, getting rid of a bad one, guarding against being robbed of him, against slander, and against illness. Read against the Yilin Buyi on employing people and whether they hide (EL.131-133).

zh: 收仆备驱役之使，财为用神，
是以财神空，身虽从而心不向，
财神破散，轻疾病而重丧亡，
财神旺而生合世身者，此手足以奉腹心，
财神旺而克冲世者，此干仆而加弱主。
故未收而占臧否，止忌三冲财病，虽克不嫌；
已收而占去留，亦忌三冲财动，克世当去。
yi: 凡是占收雇，三冲就不长久。
收仆是为了备驱使差遣的人，以财为用神：
所以财神空，人虽然跟着我，心却不向着我；
财神破、散，轻则疾病、重则丧亡；
财神绝、衰，用他不上；
财神旺而生合世身的，这是手足来奉养腹心；
财神旺而克冲世的，这是干练的仆人欺凌软弱的主人。
所以未收时占好坏，只忌三冲、财有病，即使克世也不嫌；
已经收了占去留，也忌三冲、财动，克世就该让他走。
en: In all divinations about taking on and hiring, the three clashes do not last.
Taking on a servant is to have someone to be driven and sent about, and Wealth is the Subject:
so with the Wealth spirit Void, the man follows in person but his heart is not toward me;
with the Wealth spirit broken or scattered, there is illness at the lightest and death at the worst;
with the Wealth spirit extinct or weak, one cannot use him;
with the Wealth spirit thriving and generating or combining with the Self, this is hands and feet serving heart and belly;
with the Wealth spirit thriving and controlling or clashing with the Self, this is a capable servant bullying a weak master.
So when divining before taking him on whether he is good or bad, one fears only the three clashes and a sick Wealth, and even controlling the Self is not objected to;
when divining after taking him on whether he will go or stay, one also fears the three clashes and Wealth moving, and when it controls the Self he should go.

zh: 克世则负己，生世则尽公，
岂能执吉神克世不凶乎？
yi: 没有收的时候，
财疲弱而生世，吉也不吉；
财强健而克世，凶也不凶。
已经收了之后，
如果问忠奸、去留，
克世就是辜负自己，生世就是尽心为主；
怎么能抓着『吉神』克世就说不凶呢？
en: Before he is taken on,
if Wealth is weak and generates the Self, it is auspicious yet not auspicious;
if Wealth is strong and controls the Self, it is ominous yet not ominous.
After he has been taken on,
if one asks about loyalty or treachery, going or staying,
controlling the Self is failing oneself, and generating the Self is serving with all his heart;
how can one hold on to an 'auspicious spirit' controlling the Self and say it is not ominous?

zh: 内详雇工、请人、去恶、防夺、防非、防病诸问
yi: 里面详述雇工、请人、去恶、防夺、防非、防病这几问。
en: Within are treated in detail the questions of hiring labour, engaging a person, getting rid of a bad one, guarding against being robbed of him, against slander, and against illness.

title: 收雇·察性情：专于用象——金刚火强水智木仁土信；青龙能文朱雀能言白虎暴戾元武奸勾陈迟钝螣蛇浮；八宫辨之诸星配之（用爻独发：乾志高坤性顺震直巽奸坎暗离明艮讷兑佞，角蛟志尾虎性奎狼心星骥德）

rule.yi: 察他的性情，专看用象：金刚、火强、水智、木仁、土信。青龙能文，朱雀能言，白虎暴戾而玄武奸诈，勾陈迟钝而螣蛇浮躁。用八宫来辨别，用诸星来配合。这是用爻独发时来论的：在乾志向高，在坤性顺，震直、巽奸，坎暗、离明，艮讷、兑佞；角宿有蛟龙之志，尾宿有虎性，奎宿有狼心，星宿有骏马的德性。随生克衰旺来说吉凶。
rule.en: To examine his nature, look only at the Subject image: Metal firm, Fire strong, Water wise, Wood kind, Earth faithful. The Azure Dragon is able in letters, the Vermilion Bird is able in speech, the White Tiger is violent and perverse and the Dark Tortoise is treacherous, Hook Earth is slow and dull and the Coiling Snake is flighty. Tell it by the eight palaces and match it with the stars. This is for a Subject line moving alone: in Qian the ambition is high, in Kun the nature is yielding; Zhen is straight, Xun is crafty; Kan is dark, Li is bright; Gen is slow of speech, Dui is flattering. The Horn mansion has the dragon's will, the Tail mansion the tiger's nature, the Legs mansion the wolf's heart, and the Star mansion the virtue of the steed. Good or ill is told by generation, control, strength and weakness.

note.yi: 「用象」是用神（这里指财爻或应爻，看所问是仆还是人）的象。「元武」是玄武。「角」「尾」「奎」「星」是二十八宿：角木蛟、尾火虎、奎木狼、星日马，这里取它们的禽兽性情（「骥德」是良马的德性）。「艮讷兑佞」是艮主讷（不善言辞）、兑主佞（巧言）。「八宫辨之，诸星配之」是先按八宫、再配神煞二十八宿；书里自注：这是用爻独发时的论法。性情的取象与上一章用人（YM.68）用的是同一套，这里多了二十八宿。
note.en: 'The Subject image' is the image of the Subject (here the Wealth line or the Other line, according to whether it is a servant or an ordinary person who is asked about). 'Yuanwu' is the Dark Tortoise. 'Horn', 'Tail', 'Legs' and 'Star' are four of the twenty-eight mansions: the Horn mansion Wood, the dragon; the Tail mansion Fire, the tiger; the Legs mansion Wood, the wolf; the Star mansion Sun, the horse; here their animal natures are taken ('the virtue of the steed' is the virtue of a good horse). 'Gen is slow of speech, Dui is flattering' is Gen governing slowness of speech and Dui governing glib talk. 'Tell it by the eight palaces and match it with the stars' is first by the eight palaces, then matching the spirit-stars and the twenty-eight mansions; the book's own gloss: this is the method for a Subject line moving alone. The images of nature are of the same set as in the previous chapter on employing people (YM.68), with the twenty-eight mansions added here.

zh: 金刚、火强、水智、木仁、土信也。
白虎暴戾而元武奸，勾陈迟钝而螣蛇浮也。
yi: 察他的性情，专看用象：
金刚、火强、水智、木仁、土信。
青龙擅长文章，朱雀擅长言辞，
白虎暴戾而玄武奸诈，勾陈迟钝而螣蛇浮躁。
用八宫来辨别，用诸星来配合。
en: To examine his nature, look only at the Subject image:
Metal firm, Fire strong, Water wise, Wood kind, Earth faithful.
The Azure Dragon is able in letters, the Vermilion Bird is able in speech,
the White Tiger is violent and perverse and the Dark Tortoise is treacherous, Hook Earth is slow and dull and the Coiling Snake is flighty.
Tell it by the eight palaces and match it with the stars.

zh: 震直巽奸，坎暗离明，艮讷兑侫也。
角有蛟志，尾有虎性，奎有狼心，星有骥德也。
yi: 这是用爻独发时来论的：
在乾志向高，在坤性顺，
震直、巽奸，坎暗、离明，艮讷、兑佞；
角宿有蛟龙之志，尾宿有虎性，奎宿有狼心，星宿有骏马的德性。
随生克衰旺来说吉凶。
en: This is for a Subject line moving alone:
in Qian the ambition is high, in Kun the nature is yielding;
Zhen is straight, Xun is crafty; Kan is dark, Li is bright; Gen is slow of speech, Dui is flattering.
The Horn mansion has the dragon's will, the Tail mansion the tiger's nature, the Legs mansion the wolf's heart, and the Star mansion the virtue of the steed.
Good or ill is told by generation, control, strength and weakness.

title: 收雇·游魂归魂与世间：游魂用空有逃亡之变、归魂用破有回赎之嫌；二父二官事系两头、三刑三破身有四体之灾（三破谓岁月日之破）；世空我疑、间动防阻

rule.yi: 游魂卦而用爻空，就有逃亡的变故；归魂卦而用爻破，就有被回赎（被人赎回去）的嫌疑。卦里有两个父、两个官，事情可能两头牵系；三刑、三破，自身常有四体的灾。世空，是我自己疑惑；间爻动，要防阻隔。三破，说的是岁破、月破、日破。
rule.en: With a Wandering Soul hexagram and the Subject line Void, there is a change of flight and absconding; with a Returning Soul hexagram and the Subject line broken, there is the suspicion of being redeemed and taken back. If the hexagram has two Resource lines and two Pressure lines, the matter may be tied at both ends; with three punishments or three breaks the person often has a calamity of the limbs. The Self Void means I am in doubt; a between line moving means guard against obstruction. The 'three breaks' are the break of the year, of the month and of the day.

note.yi: 「游魂」主迁动、「归魂」主回返：游魂卦而用爻空，这个人容易走掉（逃亡）；归魂卦而用爻破，容易被他家里赎回去。「回赎」是（被他的家人）赎回。「二父二官」是卦里有两个父母、两个官鬼。「两头之系」是事情牵连两头。「三刑」是刑，「三破」书里自注：岁破、月破、日破。「四体之灾」是身体的灾。「间动」是间爻动，主阻隔。这一条是雇工、仆人会不会逃、会不会被赎、会不会牵连的预兆。
note.en: 'Wandering Soul' governs shifting and 'Returning Soul' going back: with a Wandering Soul hexagram and a Void Subject line the man easily slips away (absconds); with a Returning Soul hexagram and a broken Subject line he is easily redeemed and taken back by his family. 'Huishu' is being redeemed (by his family). 'Two Resource and two Pressure lines' is two Resource lines and two Pressure lines in the hexagram. 'Tied at both ends' is the matter involving both sides. 'Three punishments' is punishment, and for the 'three breaks' the book's own gloss is the break of the year, the month and the day. 'A calamity of the limbs' is a bodily calamity. 'A between line moving' is a between line moving, which means obstruction. This entry is the sign of whether a hired hand or servant will flee, be redeemed or be drawn into trouble.

zh: 游魂用空者，则有逃亡之变，
归魂用破者，则有回赎之嫌。
二父二官，事或两头之系，
三刑三破，身常四体之灾。
yi: 游魂卦而用爻空，就有逃亡的变故；
归魂卦而用爻破，就有被回赎的嫌疑。
卦里有两个父、两个官，事情可能两头牵系；
三刑、三破，自身常有四体的灾。
世空，是我自己疑惑；间爻动，要防阻隔。
en: With a Wandering Soul hexagram and the Subject line Void, there is a change of flight and absconding;
with a Returning Soul hexagram and the Subject line broken, there is the suspicion of being redeemed and taken back.
If the hexagram has two Resource lines and two Pressure lines, the matter may be tied at both ends;
with three punishments or three breaks the person often has a calamity of the limbs.
The Self Void means I am in doubt; a between line moving means guard against obstruction.

yi: 三破，说的是岁破、月破、日破。
en: The 'three breaks' are the break of the year, of the month and of the day.

title: 雇工：雇倩人工以应为用神——应破绝不能美其终、应空散不能谋其始、三冲无定、克世无良；倩蚕织之妇从财（财不可坏）、雇倩从应（应不可病）；应来克世恐害吾事，合冲变冲不可久留、八纯六冲不可暂用

rule.yi: 雇请人工（雇工），就以应为用神：应破、绝，就不能善终；应空、散，就不能开好头；三冲，没有定准；克世，没有良善。雇请养蚕织布的妇女，妇女按财取：财不可坏；雇请（别的）按应取：应不可有病。应来克世，恐怕妨害我的事；合处逢冲、变出冲，不可久留；八纯卦、六冲卦，连暂时用也不可。
rule.en: In hiring labour, the Other is the Subject: the Other broken or extinct, and it cannot end well; the Other Void or scattered, and it cannot get a good start; the three clashes, and there is nothing settled; controlling the Self, and there is no goodness. In hiring a woman who raises silkworms and weaves, a woman is taken by Wealth, and Wealth must not be damaged; hiring is otherwise by the Other, and the Other must not be sick. If the Other comes to control the Self, I fear it harms my affairs; a combination meeting a clash, or a changed clash, means he must not be kept long; a pure hexagram of eight or a six-clash, he must not be used even briefly.

note.yi: 「雇倩」是雇请，「人工」是雇工、工匠。「美其终」是善终，「谋其始」是开好头。「蚕织之妇」是养蚕织布的妇女，她们靠做工得钱，所以取财，不取应。「合冲变冲」是合处逢冲、变出六冲（三冲里的两种，见 YM.07 注）。「八纯」是八纯卦（乾、坤、震、巽、坎、离、艮、兑各自的本宫卦，上下同卦，多是六冲）。「不可暂用」是连暂时用一下也不行。这一条用应当雇工的用神，和上面收仆用财（YM.69）分开：仆人是家里的人，取财；外面雇来的人工，取应。
note.en: 'Guqian' is hiring, and 'rengong' is hired labour and craftsmen. 'Mei qi zhong' is a good end, and 'mou qi shi' is a good beginning. 'Can zhi zhi fu' is a woman who raises silkworms and weaves; they earn money by their work, so Wealth is taken and not the Other. 'Hechong bianchong' is a combination meeting a clash and a changed six-clash (two of the three clashes, see the note to YM.07). 'Ba chun' is the pure hexagrams of the eight (the home hexagram of each of Qian, Kun, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Li, Gen and Dui, with the same trigram above and below, mostly a six-clash). 'Not to be used even briefly' is that even using him for a short time will not do. This entry takes the Other as the Subject for hired labour, to be kept apart from taking on a servant by Wealth (YM.69): a servant is one of the household and is taken by Wealth, while labour hired from outside is taken by the Other.

zh: 应破绝则不能美其终，应空散而不能谋其始，
yi: 雇请人工，就以应为用神：
应破、绝，就不能善终；应空、散，就不能开好头；
三冲，没有定准；克世，没有良善。
en: In hiring labour, the Other is the Subject:
the Other broken or extinct, and it cannot end well; the Other Void or scattered, and it cannot get a good start;
the three clashes, and there is nothing settled; controlling the Self, and there is no goodness.

yi: 雇请养蚕织布的妇女，妇女按财取：
财不可坏；
雇请（别的）按应取，应不可有病。
应来克世，恐怕妨害我的事；
合处逢冲、变出冲，不可久留；
八纯卦、六冲卦，连暂时用也不可。
en: In hiring a woman who raises silkworms and weaves, a woman is taken by Wealth:
Wealth must not be damaged;
hiring is otherwise by the Other, and the Other must not be sick.
If the Other comes to control the Self, I fear it harms my affairs;
a combination meeting a clash, or a changed clash, means he must not be kept long;
a pure hexagram of eight or a six-clash, he must not be used even briefly.

title: 雇工·去来与防夺、防非、防病：欲其去应克世而不去、欲其来应受阻而弗来；人可信矣防被夺——应克世而被争；人可用矣防是非——官动官克而被讼；人可用矣防病——命墓、应坏、鬼动而患病

rule.yi: 想要他走，应克世，他就不走；想要他来，应受阻，他就不来。这个人可以信任了，会不会被人夺走？应克世，就被人争。这个人可以用了，会不会遭受是非？官动、官克，就被告。这个人可以用了，会不会生病？命墓、应坏、鬼动，就患病。
rule.en: If one wants him to go, with the Other controlling the Self he does not go; if one wants him to come, with the Other obstructed he does not come. The man can be trusted: will he not be taken from me? With the Other controlling the Self, he is fought over. The man can be used: will he not meet with slander and trouble? With Pressure moving and Pressure controlling, he is sued. The man can be used: will he not fall ill? With the life line in the tomb, the Other damaged and Pressure moving, he falls ill.

note.yi: 「去」「来」是问他走不走、来不来。「不为夺乎」是问会不会被别人夺走。「不受非乎」是问会不会遭是非。「官动官克而被讼」是官鬼发动克世，就被告上官府。「命墓」是世爻（命）入墓。「人可信矣」「人可用矣」是三个问法的开头：前一个防被夺，后两个防是非、防病，就是章首目录里的「防夺」「防非」「防病」三问。
note.en: 'Qu' and 'lai' are asking whether he will go or come. 'Bu wei duo hu' asks whether he will be taken away by others. 'Bu shou fei hu' asks whether he will meet with slander and trouble. 'Pressure moving and Pressure controlling, and he is sued' is Pressure moving to control the Self, so that he is taken to court. 'The life line in the tomb' is the Self line (the life) entering the tomb. 'The man can be trusted' and 'the man can be used' open three kinds of question: the first guards against being robbed of him, the other two against slander and against illness, which are the three questions 'guarding against being robbed', 'against slander' and 'against illness' in the index at the head of the chapter.

zh: 人可信矣，不为夺乎，应克世而被争；
人可用矣，不受非乎，官动官克而被讼；
人可用矣，不有病乎，命墓、应坏、鬼动而患病。
yi: 想要他走，应克世，他就不走；
想要他来，应受阻，他就不来。
这个人可以信任了，会不会被人夺走？应克世，就被人争。
这个人可以用了，会不会遭受是非？官动、官克，就被告。
这个人可以用了，会不会生病？命墓、应坏、鬼动，就患病。
en: If one wants him to go, with the Other controlling the Self he does not go;
if one wants him to come, with the Other obstructed he does not come.
The man can be trusted: will he not be taken from me? With the Other controlling the Self, he is fought over.
The man can be used: will he not meet with slander and trouble? With Pressure moving and Pressure controlling, he is sued.
The man can be used: will he not fall ill? With the life line in the tomb, the Other damaged and Pressure moving, he falls ill.

title: 丁产·立户成丁、置业归产：止畏征科之累，官鬼为徭役不可动不可克（动烦而克累）、不可随墓助伤（有飞差突派），惟鬼静福兴而安居乐业

rule.yi: 立户头成年丁、置办产业入册，说到底只是怕征收赋税的牵累，所以官鬼是徭役：不可动、不可克（动就烦，克就累）；不可随墓、助伤（随墓助伤就有飞来的差役、突然的摊派）；只有鬼静、福兴，才能安居乐业。
rule.en: Establishing a household and registering adult males, acquiring property and entering it on the rolls are in the end only out of fear of the burden of tax-levying; so Pressure is the corvée, and it must not move or be controlled (moving means vexation, being controlled means burden); it must not follow into the tomb or help the injury (following and helping bring sudden duties and abrupt levies); only with Pressure still and Output rising does one live in peace and enjoy one's work.

note.yi: 「立户成丁」是立户头、把成年男子（丁）登记入册，「置业归产」是置办产业、把产业登记归户，「征科」是征收赋税，「徭役」是官府摊派的劳役，「飞差突派」是突然飞来的差役和临时的摊派。章首目录里：「寄户」是把户口寄在别人名下，「投图」是投入某个里图（明代基层户籍的册籍单位），「归甲」是归入甲（十户为甲），「清漏」是清查漏报的丁产，「交纳」是缴纳钱粮，「散派」是摊派，「违限」是逾期。这一章讲户籍、赋役这套官府制度里的占问，和下一章户役（YM.77 起）是一对：这里管丁产户籍，下一章管差役。官鬼在这里仍是『官府加给的负担』。
note.en: 'Lihu chengding' is setting up a household head and entering the adult males (ding) on the register, 'zhiye guichan' is acquiring property and entering it under the household, 'zhengke' is levying taxes, 'yaoyi' is labour service assigned by the government, and 'feichai tupai' is sudden duties that fly in and ad hoc levies. In the index at the head of the chapter: 'jihu' is lodging one's household registration under another's name, 'toutu' is joining a 'tu' (a unit of the rural registers under the Ming), 'guijia' is being returned to a 'jia' (ten households), 'qinglou' is clearing omitted males and holdings, 'jiaona' is paying in grain and money, 'sanpai' is apportioning, and 'weixian' is missing the deadline. This chapter deals with divinations within the system of household registration and levies, and is a pair with the next chapter on service (from YM.77): this one governs the registration of households and holdings, the next governs duties. Pressure here is still 'the burden the government lays on one'.

zh: 故官鬼为徭役，不可动、不可克，动烦而克累也；
不可随墓助伤，随助有飞差突派也。
惟鬼静福兴，而安居乐业。
yi: 立户头成丁，置办产业入册，
只是怕征收赋税的牵累；
所以官鬼是徭役，不可动、不可克：动就烦，克就累；
不可随墓、助伤，随墓助伤就有飞来的差役、突然的摊派；
只有鬼静、福兴，才能安居乐业。
en: To establish a household and register the adult males, to acquire property and enter it on the rolls,
is only out of fear of the burden of tax-levying;
so Pressure is the corvée, and it must not move or be controlled: moving means vexation, being controlled means burden;
it must not follow into the tomb or help the injury, for following and helping bring sudden duties and abrupt levies;
only with Pressure still and Output rising does one live in peace and enjoy one's work.

zh: 内详寄户、投图、归甲、清漏、交纳、散派、违限诸问
yi: 里面详述寄户、投图、归甲、清漏、交纳、散派、违限这几问。
en: Within are treated in detail the questions of lodging a household, joining a registry, returning to the tithing, clearing omissions, paying in, apportioning and missing the deadline.

title: 丁产·寄户、投图与分丁产、收回图甲、清漏粮赋：寄户投图专察应象——应空不容、克世多累、世空无成、三冲不久；分丁产收回图甲清漏粮赋皆以助伤随墓为恶、鬼动克世为凶

rule.yi: 占寄户（把户口寄在别人名下）、投图（投入某个里图），专看应象：应空，对方不容；克世，多有牵累；世空，成不了；三冲，不长久。至于分丁产、收回图甲、清漏粮赋，都以助伤、随墓为恶，鬼动克世为凶。
rule.en: In divining about lodging a household or joining a registry one looks only at the Other image: the Other Void, he will not take one in; controlling the Self, there are many burdens; the Self Void, it will not come off; the three clashes, it will not last. As for dividing the males and property, taking back the registry and tithing, and clearing omitted grain and levies, all take helping the injury and following into the tomb as bad, and Pressure moving to control the Self as ominous.

note.yi: 「寄户」是把户口寄在别人的户名下，「投图」是投入某个里图（「图」是里甲制里按里编的册籍单位，各地叫法不一）。「不容」是对方不肯接纳。「分丁产」是把人丁和产业分开，「收回图甲」是收回原来的册籍归属，「清漏粮赋」是清查漏报、漏纳的钱粮赋税。「三冲」见 YM.07 注。「助伤随墓」就是「随墓助伤」。这一条的头两种（寄户、投图）是求别人接纳，所以看应；后三种（分丁产、收回图甲、清漏）是和官府的清理，所以怕官鬼。
note.en: 'Jihu' is lodging one's household under another's household name, and 'toutu' is joining a 'tu' (a unit of the registers compiled by 'li' under the 'lijia' system, called differently in different places). 'Burong' is the other side refusing to receive one. 'Fen ding chan' is separating the males from the property, 'shouhui tujia' is taking back the former attribution in the registers, and 'qinglou liangfu' is auditing omitted or unpaid grain and levies. For the 'three clashes' see the note to YM.07. 'Zhu shang sui mu' is 'following into the tomb and helping the injury'. The first two divinations here (lodging a household and joining a registry) ask another to receive one, so look at the Other; the last three (dividing males and property, taking back the registry, clearing omissions) are settlements with the authorities, so Pressure is feared.

zh: 应空不容，克世多累，世空无成，三冲不久。
并分丁产，收回图甲，清漏粮赋，
皆以助伤随墓为恶，鬼动克世为凶。
yi: 或者占寄户，或者占投图，
专看应象：
应空，对方不容；克世，多有牵累；世空，成不了；三冲，不长久。
至于分丁产、收回图甲、清漏粮赋，
都以助伤、随墓为恶，鬼动克世为凶。
en: Whether one divines about lodging a household or about joining a registry,
one looks only at the Other image:
the Other Void, he will not take one in; controlling the Self, there are many burdens; the Self Void, it will not come off; the three clashes, it will not last.
As for dividing the males and property, taking back the registry and tithing, and clearing omitted grain and levies,
all take helping the injury and following into the tomb as bad, and Pressure moving to control the Self as ominous.

title: 丁产·交纳、散派、违限：交纳易乎官克世则难、散派难乎世克应则易、违限安乎鬼动官克则危

rule.yi: 交纳（缴纳钱粮）容易吗？官克世，就难；散派（摊派）难吗？世克应，就容易；违限（逾期）安稳吗？鬼动、官克，就危险。
rule.en: Is paying in easy? With Pressure controlling the Self it is hard. Is apportioning hard? With the Self controlling the Other it is easy. Is missing the deadline safe? With Pressure moving and Pressure controlling, it is dangerous.

note.yi: 「交纳」是缴纳钱粮，「散派」是官府把赋役分摊给下面的人，「违限」是错过规定的期限。「官克世而难」：官克世是官府压住我，所以缴纳难；「世克应而易」：世克应是我压得住对方，所以摊派容易。按文意，交纳时我是被派的一方，摊派时我是派人的一方（收粮的里长、粮长一类），所以同一个官爻、世应，在这两问里的好坏方向不同，要看清自己站在哪一边。
note.en: 'Jiaona' is paying in grain and money, 'sanpai' is the government apportioning levies and services among those below, and 'weixian' is missing the prescribed deadline. 'Pressure controlling the Self, so hard': Pressure controlling the Self is the authorities pressing on me, so paying in is hard; 'the Self controlling the Other, so easy': the Self controlling the Other is my being able to press on the other side, so apportioning is easy. By the sense, in paying in I am the one assigned, and in apportioning I am the one assigning (a village head or grain chief who collects the grain), so the same Pressure line and Self and Other have a different direction of good and bad in these two questions, and one must see on which side one stands.

zh: 交纳易乎，官克世而难也，
散派难乎，世克应而易也，
违限安乎，鬼动官克而危也。
yi: 交纳容易吗？官克世，就难；
散派难吗？世克应，就容易；
违限安稳吗？鬼动、官克，就危险。
en: Is paying in easy? With Pressure controlling the Self it is hard;
is apportioning hard? With the Self controlling the Other it is easy;
is missing the deadline safe? With Pressure moving and Pressure controlling, it is dangerous.

title: 户役总纲：役有我求之役、官派之役、有利之役、不利之役，皆役于官，故喜忌皆用官爻；求而有利者以役为利则财旺官备为吉、官坏克世为凶

rule.yi: 役有不同：有我自己求的役，有官府派的役，有有利的役，有不利的役，都是替官府当役。所以喜忌都用官爻：求而有利的，以役为利，就以财旺、官备为吉，以官坏、克世为凶。
rule.en: Service differs: there is service one seeks oneself, service the authorities assign, service that pays, and service that does not, all of it service to the authorities. So what is welcome and what is feared are all taken from the Pressure line: for service one seeks and which pays, taking the service as the profit, thriving Wealth and a complete Pressure line are auspicious, and damaged Pressure and Pressure controlling the Self are ominous.

note.yi: 「役」是官府摊派的差役、徭役。「我求之役」是自己谋求的差使（如衙门里的差事），「官派之役」是官府强派的徭役，「有利之役」「不利之役」是有油水的和白当的。「财旺官备」是财爻旺、官爻齐备（有官有俸）。这一章是易林补遗户役（EL.109 起）、帮户（EL.112 起）、除名脱役（EL.114 起）的同类，用爻也是官鬼。章首目录：谋差、顶役、脱役、助役、卸役、讼役、避役、防患八问。
note.en: 'Yi' is service, duties and corvée assigned by the government. 'Service one seeks oneself' is a duty one seeks (such as a post in a yamen), 'service the authorities assign' is corvée forced by the government, and 'service that pays' and 'service that does not' are those with perquisites and those done for nothing. 'Thriving Wealth and a complete Pressure line' is the Wealth line thriving and the Pressure line complete (an office with salary). This chapter is of a kind with the Yilin Buyi on service (from EL.109), on helping households (from EL.112) and on being struck off and freed from duty (from EL.114), and the line used is likewise Pressure. The index at the head of the chapter lists eight questions: seeking a duty, taking another's place, being freed from a duty, getting help, unloading, litigating, avoiding, and guarding against trouble.

zh: 有我求之役，有官派之役，
故喜忌皆用官爻，求而有利者以役为利，
则财旺官备为吉，以官坏克世为凶。
yi: 役有不同：
有我自己求的役，有官府派的役，
有有利的役，有不利的役，
都是替官府当役。
所以喜忌都用官爻：求而有利的，以役为利，
就以财旺、官备为吉，以官坏、克世为凶。
en: Service differs:
there is service one seeks oneself, service the authorities assign,
service that pays, and service that does not,
all of it service to the authorities.
So what is welcome and what is feared are all taken from the Pressure line: for service one seeks and which pays, the service is taken as the profit,
and thriving Wealth with a complete Pressure line is auspicious, damaged Pressure and Pressure controlling the Self are ominous.

zh: 内详谋差、顶役、脱役、助役、卸役、讼役、避役、防患诸问
yi: 里面详述谋差、顶役、脱役、助役、卸役、讼役、避役、防患这几问。
en: Within are treated in detail the questions of seeking a duty, taking another's place in a duty, being freed from a duty, getting help with a duty, unloading a duty, litigating about a duty, avoiding a duty, and guarding against trouble.

title: 户役·盐漕河赋之差与吏胥吏卒：官能荣之故官不可空、官能辱之故官不可克、官能利之故财不可无；随官入墓助鬼伤身为公门之大忌

rule.yi: 凡是盐、漕、河、赋这些差使，以及吏胥、吏卒一类的人：官能使他荣，所以官不可空；官能使他辱，所以官不可被克；官能使他得利，所以财不可没有。随官入墓、助鬼伤身，是公门的大忌。
rule.en: For duties connected with salt, grain transport, river works and taxes, and for clerks, runners and attendants: the official can bring him honour, so Pressure must not be Void; the official can bring him disgrace, so Pressure must not be controlled; the official can bring him profit, so Wealth must not be absent. Following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body are the great taboos of the public offices.

note.yi: 「盐漕河赋之差」是盐政、漕运、河工、赋税方面的差使，「吏胥吏卒之辈」是书吏、衙役一类。「官能荣之」是官（官爻）能使他荣耀，所以官不可空；「官能辱之」是官能使他受辱，所以官不可被克；「官能利之」是官能使他得利，所以财不可没有（没有财，有官也没有俸）。「随官入墓，助鬼伤身」是公门的大忌，和本卷军机（YM.13）、功名（YM.41）里的是同一条。
note.en: 'Yan cao he fu zhi chai' are duties in the salt administration, grain transport, river works and taxation, and 'lixu lizu zhi bei' are clerks, runners and the like. 'The official can bring him honour' is the official (the Pressure line) being able to bring him glory, so Pressure must not be Void; 'can bring him disgrace' is that the official can make him suffer disgrace, so Pressure must not be controlled; 'can bring him profit' is that the official can make him gain, so Wealth must not be absent (without Wealth, even with an office there is no salary). 'Following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body' is the great taboo of the public offices, the same one as in the military chapter (YM.13) and the chapter on fame and office (YM.41) of this book.

zh: 凡盐漕河赋之差，吏胥吏卒之辈，
官能荣之，故官不可空也，
官能辱之，故官不可克也，
官能利之，故财不可无也。
随官入墓，助鬼伤身，为公门之大忌焉。
yi: 凡是盐、漕、河、赋这些差使，以及吏胥、吏卒一类的人：
官能使他荣，所以官不可空；
官能使他辱，所以官不可被克；
官能使他得利，所以财不可没有。
随官入墓、助鬼伤身，是公门的大忌。
en: For duties connected with salt, grain transport, river works and taxes, and for clerks, runners and attendants:
the official can bring him honour, so Pressure must not be Void;
the official can bring him disgrace, so Pressure must not be controlled;
the official can bring him profit, so Wealth must not be absent.
Following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body are the great taboos of the public offices.

title: 户役·谋差与顶役：谋差贞冲合冲世空官失不就；顶役世空应空贞冲合冲官失不偕

rule.yi: 占谋差使能不能成：本卦六冲、合处逢冲、世空、官失（官爻失去），就是不成。顶替差役能不能成：世空、应空、本卦六冲、合处逢冲、官失，就是合不到一起、办不成。
rule.en: In divining whether a bid for a duty will come off: the original hexagram clashed, a combination clashed, the Self Void, or Pressure lost, mean it does not come off. Whether taking another's place in a duty will come off: the Self Void, the Other Void, the original hexagram clashed, a combination clashed, or Pressure lost, mean the two do not tally and it cannot be done.

note.yi: 「谋差」是谋求差使，「顶役」是顶替别人的差役（两样另见易林补遗谋差顶役 EL.106–108）。「贞冲」是本卦（贞）是六冲卦，「合冲」是合处逢冲，是三冲里的两种（见 YM.07 注）。「官失」是官爻失去（不上卦、落空或被破）。「不偕」是不能相合、不能一同成事：顶役要两边（我和被顶替的人）合得上才成，所以世、应都不能空。
note.en: 'Moucai' is seeking a duty, and 'dingyi' is taking another's place in a duty (the two are also treated in the Yilin Buyi on seeking a commission and taking a place, EL.106-108). 'Zhenchong' is the original hexagram (zhen) being a six-clash hexagram, and 'hechong' is a combination meeting a clash, two of the three clashes (see the note to YM.07). 'Guanshi' is the Pressure line being lost (absent from the hexagram, Void or broken). 'Buxie' is not tallying and not accomplishing the matter together: taking another's place needs the two sides (myself and the man replaced) to fit, so neither the Self nor the Other may be Void.

zh: 筮谋差之成，贞冲、合冲、世空、官失，为不就也。
顶役之成，世空、应空、贞冲、合冲、官失，而不偕也。
yi: 占谋差使能不能成：本卦六冲、合处逢冲、世空、官失，就是不成。
顶替差役能不能成：世空、应空、本卦六冲、合处逢冲、官失，就是合不到一起。
en: In divining whether a bid for a duty will come off: the original hexagram clashed, a combination clashed, the Self Void, or Pressure lost, mean it does not come off.
Whether taking another's place in a duty will come off: the Self Void, the Other Void, the original hexagram clashed, a combination clashed, or Pressure lost, mean the two do not tally.

title: 户役·问役轻重：派而不利者以役为害；官克世则役加、官持日月旺相则役必多徭必苛、休囚则少、空散则免、破分动静（动有静无）；随墓助伤亦应大凶、得逢空破反为得免

rule.yi: 被摊派而不利的，以役为害。所以问役的轻重：官克世，役就加重；官持日辰、月建而旺相，役必多、徭必苛；休囚就少，空、散就免。破要分动静：动就有役，静就无役；随墓助伤，也应当大凶，但遇到空、破，反而得免。
rule.en: When one is assigned a duty to one's disadvantage, the duty is a harm. So in asking whether the duty is light or heavy: Pressure controlling the Self, the duty is increased; Pressure holding the Day or Month and thriving, the duty is sure to be many and the corvée harsh; resting or imprisoned, it is little; Void or scattered, it is escaped. Broken is divided into moving and still: moving, there is duty; still, there is none; following into the tomb and helping the injury should also be greatly ominous, but meeting Void or broken one escapes instead.

note.yi: 「派而不利者」是被摊派而没有好处的差役。「役加」是役加重。「徭」是徭役。「官持日月旺相」是官爻临日辰或月建又旺相，力量最大，所以役最多最苛。「破分动静」按文意：官爻破的时候，动的还有役，静的就没有；书里没有再展开。「随墓助伤……得逢空破，反为得免」是说平时的大忌，在躲役的占问里反而变成好事：官入墓、官落空破，差役就摊不到我。这一条里『忌』和『喜』因所问是『求役』还是『躲役』而反过来，总的原则在本章末尾（YM.84）的「用神无执一」。
note.en: 'Pai er bu li zhe' is a duty assigned with no benefit. 'Yijia' is the duty becoming heavier. 'Yao' is corvée. 'Pressure holding the Day or Month and thriving' is the Pressure line on the Day or Month branch and thriving, its force being greatest, so that the duty is the most and the harshest. 'Broken is divided into moving and still', by the sense: when the Pressure line is broken, if it is moving there is still duty, and if still there is none; the book does not expand on it. 'Following into the tomb and helping the injury ... meeting Void or broken one escapes instead' says that what is a great taboo in ordinary times becomes a good thing in a divination about avoiding a duty: Pressure entering the tomb or falling into Void or broken means the duty is not assigned to me. In this entry what is feared and what is welcomed are reversed according to whether the question is seeking or avoiding service; the general principle is in 'the Subject is not held to one' at the end of this chapter (YM.84).

zh: 是以问役轻重，官克世而役加，官持日月旺相，役必多、徭必苛也，
破分动静，动有而静无也；
随墓助伤，亦应大凶，得逢空破，反为得免。
yi: 被摊派而不利的，以役为害，
所以问役的轻重：官克世，役就加重；官持日辰、月建而旺相，役必多、徭必苛；
休囚就少，空、散就免。
破要分动静：动就有役，静就无役；
随墓、助伤，也应当大凶，但遇到空、破，反而得免。
en: When one is assigned a duty to one's disadvantage, the duty is a harm,

so in asking whether the duty is light or heavy: Pressure controlling the Self, the duty is increased; Pressure holding the Day or Month and thriving, the duty is sure to be many and the corvée harsh;
resting or imprisoned, it is little; Void or scattered, it is escaped.
broken is divided into moving and still: moving, there is duty; still, there is none;
following into the tomb and helping the injury should also be greatly ominous, but meeting Void or broken one escapes instead.

title: 户役·脱役除名：官克则不宥、官空破散则嫌释我无主、官临旺相则忌制我方疆，故官不可克、不可极、不可没（极谓极旺、没谓失没）；补遗云官鬼克身难脱役、子孙持世易除名

rule.yi: 脱役、除名：官克（世），就不被宽宥；官空、破、散，又嫌没有主事的人放我；官临旺相，又忌它制住我的范围。所以凡是官，不可被克，不可太旺（极），不可失去（没）。「极」是极旺，「没」是失没。补遗说：官鬼克身，难脱役；子孙持世，易除名。
rule.en: For being freed from duty and struck off the rolls: Pressure controlling the Self, one is not pardoned; Pressure Void, broken or scattered, one fears that there is no one in charge to release me; Pressure thriving, one fears it holds my bounds in check. So Pressure must not be controlled, must not be extreme, and must not be lost. 'Extreme' is extremely thriving, and 'lost' is vanished. The Buyi says: when Pressure controls the Body, it is hard to be freed from duty; when Output holds the Self, it is easy to be struck off.

note.yi: 「脱役」是免掉差役，「除名」是把名字从役册上除去。「不宥」是不被宽宥。「释我无主」是没有主事的官放我走。「制我方疆」是限制我的范围。官既不能克（压着我）、也不能极旺（管得太严）、也不能失没（无人放我），这是脱役的『既要有官、又不能太强』的要求。书里自注引「补遗」（易林补遗除名脱役 EL.114）：官鬼克身难脱役，子孙持世易除名，与这里的「官不可克」一致。
note.en: 'Tuoyi' is being exempted from duty, and 'chuming' is having one's name struck from the register of service. 'Buyou' is not being pardoned. 'Shi wo wu zhu' is that there is no official in charge to let me go. 'Zhi wo fangjiang' is restricting my bounds. Pressure must not control (press on me), must not be extremely thriving (govern too strictly) and must not be lost (no one to release me), which is the requirement for being freed from duty that there must be an official and he must not be too strong. The book's own note quotes the 'Buyi' (the Yilin Buyi on being struck off and freed from duty, EL.114): Pressure controlling the Body makes it hard to be freed from duty, and Output holding the Self makes it easy to be struck off, in agreement with 'Pressure must not control' here.

zh: 故凡官不可克、不可极、不可没也。
yi: 脱役、除名：官克（世），就不被宽宥；
官空、破、散，又嫌没有主事的人放我；
官临旺相，又忌它制住我的范围。
所以凡是官，不可被克，不可太旺（极），不可失去（没）。
en: For being freed from duty and struck off the rolls: Pressure controlling the Self, one is not pardoned;
Pressure Void, broken or scattered, one fears that there is no one in charge to release me;
Pressure thriving, one fears it holds my bounds in check.
So Pressure must not be controlled, must not be extreme, and must not be lost.

zh: 官鬼克身难脱役，子孙持世易除名。
yi: 「极」是极旺，
「没」是失没。
易林补遗说：
官鬼克身，难脱役；子孙持世，易除名。
en: 'Extreme' is extremely thriving,
and 'lost' is vanished.
The Buyi says:
when Pressure controls the Body, it is hard to be freed from duty; when Output holds the Self, it is easy to be struck off.

title: 户役·助役、卸役、讼官：求人助役须应生世、应空破散者无助；觅人卸役须世克应、应空官克者无门；讼官得理忌官克世、官空破散者无益；公以官而私以应（私处求应生、公断戒官克）

rule.yi: 如果求人帮助服役，须应生世，如应空、破、散的就得不到帮助；如果找人替我卸役，须世克应，如应空、官克的就无门；如果为役告官而求得理，官克世不适宜，如官空、破、散的就无益。因为公事看官，私事看应。口诀说：私下求人要应生世，公断要戒官克世；应空谁来怜惜，应克谁来出力。
rule.en: If one asks someone to help with a duty, the Other must generate the Self, and if the Other is Void, broken or scattered there is no help; if one looks for someone to unload a duty for me, the Self must control the Other, and if the Other is Void or Pressure controls, there is no door; if one sues the official over the duty and wants to be in the right, Pressure controlling the Self is unsuitable, and if Pressure is Void, broken or scattered it is no use. For public matters are seen by Pressure and private matters by the Other. The verse says: in a private plea, one needs the Other to generate the Self; in a public judgment, beware of Pressure controlling it; if the Other is Void, who will pity one; if the Other controls, who will exert himself.

note.yi: 「助役」是求别人帮我分担差役，「卸役」是找人替我卸掉差役，「讼官」是为役的事和官府打官司。「应生世」是对方生我，才肯帮；「世克应」是我压得住对方，才卸得掉；「官克世」不利于打官司，因为官是公断的一方。「盖公以官，而私以应」是总括：公事（官府的事）看官爻，私事（求人的事）看应爻。书里自注是一首四句的口诀：私下求人看应生世，公断要戒官克世；应空谁来怜惜我，应克世谁来出力。
note.en: 'Zhuyi' is asking someone to share a duty with me, 'xieyi' is finding someone to take a duty off me, and 'songguan' is going to law against the officials over a duty. 'The Other generating the Self' is the other side generating me, which is when he is willing to help; 'the Self controlling the Other' is my being able to press on the other side, which is when the duty can be unloaded; 'Pressure controlling the Self' is bad for a lawsuit, because the official is the side that judges. 'Public matters are seen by Pressure and private matters by the Other' is the summing up: public matters (the government's affairs) are seen by the Pressure line, and private matters (asking someone) by the Other line. The book's own note is a four-line verse: in a private plea look for the Other generating the Self, in a public judgment beware of Pressure controlling the Self; if the Other is Void who will pity me, if the Other controls the Self who will exert himself.

zh: 若求人助役，须应生世，如应空破散者无助。
若觅人卸役，须世克应，如应空官克者无门。
若讼官得理，克世非宜，如官空破散者无益。
yi: 如果求人帮助服役，须应生世，如应空、破、散的就得不到帮助；
如果找人替我卸役，须世克应，如应空、官克的就无门；
如果为役告官而求得理，官克世不适宜，如官空、破、散的就无益。
因为公事看官，私事看应。
en: If one asks someone to help with a duty, the Other must generate the Self, and if the Other is Void, broken or scattered there is no help;
if one looks for someone to unload a duty for me, the Self must control the Other, and if the Other is Void or Pressure controls, there is no door;
if one sues the official over the duty and wants to be in the right, Pressure controlling the Self is unsuitable, and if Pressure is Void, broken or scattered it is no use.
For public matters are seen by Pressure and private matters by the Other.

zh: 私处求应生，公断戒官克，
应空谁相怜，应克孰为力。
yi: 私下求人要应生世，公断要戒官克世；
应空谁来怜惜，应克谁来出力。
en: In a private plea, one needs the Other to generate the Self; in a public judgment, beware of Pressure controlling it;
if the Other is Void, who will pity one; if the Other controls, who will exert himself.

title: 户役·避役与当役防患：卜潜踪避役鬼旺则役来、鬼克世则捕我；卜当役防患官动官克则多累、唯卦静而子动为吉；避役防患皆喜子忌官

rule.yi: 占躲起来逃避差役吗？鬼旺，差役就来；鬼克世，就来抓我了。占当差防备出事吗？官动、官克，就多牵累；只有卦静而子动，才是这两种占的吉。避役、防患，都喜子、忌官。
rule.en: In divining about hiding one's tracks to avoid a duty: with Pressure thriving the duty comes; with Pressure controlling the Self, they come to arrest me. In divining about serving a duty and guarding against trouble: with Pressure moving and Pressure controlling there are many entanglements; only with the hexagram still and Output moving are the two divinations auspicious. Avoiding service and guarding against trouble both welcome Output and fear Pressure.

note.yi: 「潜踪避役」是躲起来逃避差役，「当役防患」是已经当差、防备出事。「鬼旺则役来」是官鬼旺，差役就找上门；「鬼克世则捕我矣」是鬼克世，官府就来抓我。「卦静而子动」是卦里其他爻都静、只有子孙动：子孙克官鬼，官鬼受制，差役就不来、出事也少。书里自注：避役、防患都喜子孙、忌官鬼。这一条与易隐官禄占的避祸（YY.20）、黄金策仕宦的卦静世空（HJC.16）对着看。
note.en: 'Qianzong biyi' is hiding one's tracks to avoid a duty, and 'dangyi fanghuan' is already serving a duty and guarding against trouble. 'With Pressure thriving the duty comes' is that when Pressure is thriving the duty comes looking for one; 'with Pressure controlling the Self, they come to arrest me' is the authorities coming to seize me. 'The hexagram still and Output moving' is every other line being still and only Output moving: Output controls Pressure, Pressure is held in check, and the duty does not come and there is little trouble. The book's own note: avoiding service and guarding against trouble both welcome Output and fear Pressure. Read against the Yi Yin on avoiding trouble in the divination of office (YY.20) and the Huangjin Ce on a still hexagram with a Void Self (HJC.16).

zh: 卜潜踪避役乎，鬼旺则役来，鬼克世则捕我矣。
卜当役防患乎，官动官克则多累矣，唯卦静而子动，二占之吉也。
yi: 占躲起来逃避差役吗？鬼旺，差役就来；鬼克世，就来抓我了。
占当差防备出事吗？官动、官克，就多牵累；只有卦静而子动，才是这两种占的吉。
en: In divining about hiding one's tracks to avoid a duty: with Pressure thriving the duty comes; with Pressure controlling the Self, they come to arrest me.

In divining about serving a duty and guarding against trouble: with Pressure moving and Pressure controlling there are many entanglements; only with the hexagram still and Output moving are the two divinations auspicious.

yi: 避役、防患，都喜子、忌官。
en: Avoiding service and guarding against trouble both welcome Output and fear Pressure.

title: 户役·总括：役而趋利好财官、役而免害恶鬼旺及动官克世；避役喜失其鬼、谋役脱役不喜失其鬼，用神无执一（谋役脱役无鬼难为主）

rule.yi: 大抵当役而求利的，喜财、官；当役而求免害的，厌鬼旺，以及官动、官克世。避役的喜欢失去鬼，谋役、脱役的却不喜欢失去鬼。用神不要死守一个爻。谋役、脱役，没有鬼就难以做主。
rule.en: Broadly, for one who serves a duty to seek profit, Wealth and Pressure are welcome; for one who serves a duty and seeks to escape harm, Pressure thriving is hated, and so are Pressure moving and Pressure controlling the Self. In avoiding a duty it is welcome for Pressure to be lost; in seeking a duty or being freed from one it is not welcome for Pressure to be lost. The Subject is not held to one line. In seeking a duty or being freed from one, without Pressure it is hard to take charge.

note.yi: 「趋利好财官」是求利的，喜财、官；「免害恶鬼旺」是躲祸的，厌官鬼旺；所以同样是役，求役和躲役对官鬼的取舍相反。「避役而喜失其鬼」是避役时官鬼不上卦或落空是好事；「谋役脱役而不喜失其鬼」是谋役、脱役时要靠官爻做主，没有官爻就办不成（书里自注：无鬼难为主）。「用神无执一」是用神不能死守一个爻，要按所问的是求还是躲来取：这是整章（户役、丁产）的总纲。与易林补遗户役各节（EL.109–116）对着看。
note.en: 'Qu li hao cai guan' is, for those seeking profit, Wealth and Pressure being welcome; 'mian hai wu gui wang' is, for those escaping trouble, Pressure thriving being hated; so for the same duty, seeking it and avoiding it take opposite views of Pressure. 'In avoiding a duty it is welcome for Pressure to be lost' is that when avoiding a duty, Pressure absent from the hexagram or Void is a good thing; 'in seeking a duty or being freed from one it is not welcome for Pressure to be lost' is that in seeking a duty or being freed from one the Pressure line must take charge, and without it nothing can be done (the book's own gloss: without Pressure it is hard to take charge). 'The Subject is not held to one' is that the Subject cannot be held to one line but is taken according to whether the question is seeking or avoiding: this is the general principle of the whole chapter (service, and households and holdings). Read against the sections of the Yilin Buyi on service (EL.109-116).

zh: 大抵役而趋利好财官，役而免害恶鬼旺，及动官克世。
谋役脱役，而不喜失其鬼，
yi: 大抵当役而求利的，喜财、官；当役而求免害的，厌鬼旺，以及官动、官克世。
避役的喜欢失去鬼，
谋役、脱役的却不喜欢失去鬼。
用神不要死守一个爻。
en: Broadly, for one who serves a duty to seek profit, Wealth and Pressure are welcome; for one who serves a duty and seeks to escape harm, Pressure thriving is hated, and so are Pressure moving and Pressure controlling the Self.
In avoiding a duty it is welcome for Pressure to be lost;
in seeking a duty or being freed from one it is not welcome for Pressure to be lost.
The Subject is not held to one line.

zh: 谋役脱役，无鬼难为主焉。
yi: 谋役、脱役，没有鬼就难以做主。
en: In seeking a duty or being freed from one, without Pressure it is hard to take charge.

title: 营谋·谋事五忌：谋事在人营求不一皆物交物而成，故六冲则不交、合而冲则将交而散、应空散则彼心不附、世空散则我意先慵、官鬼失而谋无主；唯世应破绝犹得其半（破绝有形空散无迹）

rule.yi: 谋事在人，营求的办法不一，都是物与物相交才成。所以六冲就交不到一起；合处逢冲，就将要交合却又（此处疑脱一字，当是「散」）；应空、散，对方的心就不依附；世空、散，我自己的意思先懒了；只有世应破、绝，还能得到一半；官鬼失去，谋事就没有主。这是五种忌。
rule.en: Scheming rests with men; the ways of seeking are not one, and all of them are accomplished by one thing meeting another. So with a six-clash they do not meet; with a combination clashed, they are about to join and then (a character seems lost here, presumably 'come apart'); with the Other Void or scattered, his heart does not attach to me; with the Self Void or scattered, my own will first turns slack; only with the Self and the Other broken or extinct is half still obtained; with Pressure lost, the scheme has no master. These are the five taboos.

note.yi: 「谋事在人」是谋事要靠人去做，「营求」是经营求取，「物交物」是事物和事物相交、两边凑到一起才成。「六冲则不交」是六冲（散）就凑不到一起；「合而冲」是合处逢冲（见 YM.07 注）。「则将交而」后面原文疑脱一字，当是「散」，按文意译作「将要交合却又散开」。「应空散则彼心不附」是应是对方，应空、散就是对方没有心；「世空散则我意先慵」是世是自己，世空、散就是自己先懒了。「世应破绝，犹得其半」：破、绝是有形的，力量残存，所以还能成一半；空、散是没影的，所以是忌。「官鬼失而谋无主」是官鬼是谋事的主，没有它事无主持（见 YM.88）。五忌就是：六冲、合冲、应空散、世空散、官鬼失。这一章是营谋（谋求一件事）与嘱托（托人办事），和易隐谋望占（YY.82–88）、易林补遗谋望成事（EL.103 起）取同一类，章首「内附嘱托」就是嘱托也在这里。
note.en: 'Moushi zai ren' is that scheming has to be done by men, 'yingqiu' is managing and seeking, and 'wu jiao wu' is one thing meeting another, so that the two sides come together and it succeeds. 'With a six-clash they do not meet' is that a six-clash (scattering) cannot bring them together; 'a combination clashed' is a combination meeting a clash (see the note to YM.07). Below 'ze jiang jiao er' the original seems to lack a character, presumably 'san', scatter, and by the sense it is translated 'about to join and then comes apart'. 'The Other Void or scattered, his heart does not attach to me' is that the Other is the other side, and the Other Void or scattered means he has no heart for it; 'the Self Void or scattered, my own will first turns slack' is that the Self is myself, and the Self Void or scattered means I am the first to go slack. 'The Self and the Other broken or extinct, half is still obtained': broken and extinct have a form, some force remains, so half can still be had; Void and scattered leave no trace, so they are taboo. 'Pressure lost, the scheme has no master' is that Pressure is the master of a scheme, and without it the matter has no one to run it (see YM.88). The five taboos are: a six-clash, a combination clashed, the Other Void or scattered, the Self Void or scattered, and Pressure lost. This chapter is about scheming (seeking something) and entrusting (asking someone to act for one), of a kind with the Yi Yin on scheming and hope (YY.82-88) and the Yilin Buyi on accomplishing a scheme (from EL.103); 'attached: entrusting' at the head of the chapter means entrusting is treated here too.

zh: 夫谋事在人，营求不一，皆物交物而成也。
官鬼失而谋无主，此五者之忌也。
yi: 谋事在人，营求的办法不一，都是物与物相交才成。
所以六冲就交不到一起；
合处逢冲，就将要交合却又（此处疑脱一字，当是「散」）；
应空、散，对方的心就不依附；
世空、散，我自己的意思先懒了；
只有世应破、绝，还能得到一半；
官鬼失去，谋事就没有主，这是五种忌。
en: Scheming rests with men; the ways of seeking are not one, and all of them are accomplished by one thing meeting another.
So with a six-clash they do not meet;
with a combination clashed, they are about to join and then (a character seems lost here, presumably 'come apart');
with the Other Void or scattered, his heart does not attach to me;
with the Self Void or scattered, my own will first turns slack;
only with the Self and the Other broken or extinct is half still obtained;
with Pressure lost, the scheme has no master. These are the five taboos.

yi: 破、绝是有形的，空、散是没影的。
en: Broken and extinct have a form; Void and scattered leave no trace.

yi: 本章里面附有嘱托一类的占问。
en: This chapter has attached to it divinations about entrusting a matter to another.

title: 营谋·成否与吉凶：自力可成莫观其应、因人成事莫观其世；止问成否但忌空冲、兼问吉凶并求用旺；谋文用父、谋利用财、释患用子（占己谋不论应、占彼谋不论世；问成占谋、问吉凶占用）

rule.yi: 所以靠自己的力量能办成的，不用看应；靠别人才能成的事，不用看世。只问成不成，只忌空、冲；兼问吉凶，就要同时求用神旺。谋文书（功名）用父，谋利用财，解除祸患用子。占自己谋的事不论应，占别人谋的事不论世；问成不成看谋（世应、冲空），问吉凶看用（用神）。
rule.en: So for what can be done by one's own strength, one need not look at the Other; for what is done through others, one need not look at the Self. If one asks only whether it comes off, one fears only Void and clash; if one also asks about good and ill, one must also seek the Subject thriving. For documents (a name) use the father line, for profit use Wealth, and for relieving trouble use Output. In divining a scheme of one's own, the Other is not discussed; in divining another's scheme, the Self is not discussed; asking whether it comes off one looks at the scheme (Self, Other, clash, Void), asking about good and ill one looks at the Subject.

note.yi: 「自力可成」是靠自己的力量能办成的事，不用看应；「因人成事」是靠别人才办成的事，不用看世。「止问成否」是只问成不成，「兼问吉凶」是还要问好坏。「谋文用父」是谋文书、功名用父母，「谋利用财」是谋利用妻财，「释患用子」是解除祸患用子孙（子孙克官鬼）。「用旺」是用神旺相。书里自注：占自己谋的事不论应、占别人谋的事不论世；问成不成看谋（世应、冲空），问吉凶看用（用神）。这一条把『成不成』和『好不好』分成两件事：前者看世应的空冲，后者看用神的旺衰。与易隐谋望占的可否成败（YY.83–YY.85）对着看。
note.en: 'Zili ke cheng' is what can be done by one's own strength, so one need not look at the Other; 'yin ren cheng shi' is what is done only through others, so one need not look at the Self. 'Zhi wen cheng fou' is asking only whether it comes off, and 'jian wen jixiong' is also asking about good and ill. 'For documents use the father line' is using Resource for documents and a name, 'for profit use Wealth' is using the Wealth line, and 'for relieving trouble use Output' is using Output (Output controls Pressure). 'Yong wang' is the Subject thriving. The book's own gloss: in divining a scheme of one's own the Other is not discussed, and in divining another's scheme the Self is not discussed; asking whether it comes off one looks at the scheme (the Self and the Other, clash and Void), and asking about good and ill one looks at the Subject. This entry separates 'whether it comes off' from 'whether it is good' as two things: the first is seen by the Void and clash of the Self and the Other, the second by the strength of the Subject. Read against the question of what can and cannot be done in the Yi Yin on scheming (YY.83-85).

zh: 谋文用父，谋利用财，释患用子。
yi: 所以靠自己的力量能办成的，不用看应；
靠别人才能成的事，不用看世。
只问成不成，只忌空、冲；
兼问吉凶，就要同时求用神旺。
谋文书用父，谋利用财，解除祸患用子。
en: So for what can be done by one's own strength, one need not look at the Other;
for what is done through others, one need not look at the Self.
If one asks only whether it comes off, one fears only Void and clash;
if one also asks about good and ill, one must also seek the Subject thriving.
For documents use the father line, for profit use Wealth, and for relieving trouble use Output.

zh: 占己谋不论应，占彼谋不论世。
yi: 占自己谋的事不论应，占别人谋的事不论世；
问成不成看谋，问吉凶看用。
en: In divining a scheme of one's own, the Other is not discussed; in divining another's scheme, the Self is not discussed;
asking whether it comes off one looks at the scheme, asking about good and ill one looks at the Subject.

title: 营谋·筮嘱托：随所用神（或官、或应、或六亲）皆忌空（空则不力）、忌破（破则无功）、忌六冲克世（疑阻生衅）、随墓助鬼（不利公廷）；旺衰分力之大小、合冲定情之向背、化进勇于事化退倦于行；五行六神断情性不主吉凶

rule.yi: 占嘱托（托人办事），随所取的用神：或者用官，或者用应，或者用六亲，都忌空，空就不出力；都忌破，破就没有功效；都忌六冲克世，那就生疑、受阻、生出嫌隙；随墓、助鬼，就不利于公堂。旺衰来分他出力的大小，合冲来定他情意的向背，化进就勇于办事，化退就倦于行动；五行、六神用来断他的性情，但不要拿它来主断吉凶。金坚直，木从容，水曲折，火燥烈，土诚信；龙和，虎勇，雀再三，武婉转，勾端实，蛇缠绵——这是五行、六神按生旺说的，空、破就反过来。
rule.en: In divining about entrusting a matter to another, one follows the Subject taken: whether Pressure, or the Other, or one of the six relations, all fear Void, and Void means he does not exert himself; all fear broken, and broken means no achievement; all fear a six-clash controlling the Self, which breeds suspicion, obstruction and quarrel; following into the tomb and helping Pressure is unfavourable at the public court. Strength and weakness tell how much force he has; combination and clash fix whether his feeling is toward or against me; changing into an advance means he is bold in the matter, changing into a retreat means he tires of acting; the five phases and the six spirits are used to judge his temper, but one does not make them the master of good and ill. Metal is firm and straight, Wood is easygoing, Water is roundabout, Fire is fierce and hasty, Earth is sincere and faithful; the Azure Dragon is mild, the White Tiger bold, the Vermilion Bird says it again and again, the Dark Tortoise is indirect, Hook Earth is upright and solid, the Coiling Snake clings; this is said of the phases and the six spirits when they are strong, and Void or broken turns it round.

note.yi: 「嘱托」是托人办事。「随所用神」是按所托的人取用神：所托的是官，就用官爻；所托的是一般的人，就用应；所托的是亲人，就用相应的六亲。「忌空」「忌破」「忌六冲克世」是对这位受托的人的三个忌；「随墓助鬼，不利公廷」是涉及官司公事时的忌。「化进」「化退」是用神化进、化退（进神、退神，见术语表）。「雀再三」是朱雀反复叮咛、话多；「武婉转」是玄武说话绕弯子；「勾端实」是勾陈端正厚实；「蛇缠绵」是螣蛇缠缠绵绵；「龙和」是青龙温和，「虎勇」是白虎勇悍。书里自注：这些性情是按五行、六神生旺来说的，空、破时反过来。「然勿主吉凶也」是五行六神只断性情，吉凶不由它定，由生克旺衰定。与易林补遗仗托人力（EL.134–137）对着看，那边也是应爻为主、嫌空冲破。
note.en: 'Zhutuo' is entrusting a matter to another. 'Following the Subject taken' is taking the Subject according to whom the matter is entrusted to: if it is an official, the Pressure line is used; if an ordinary person, the Other; if a relative, the corresponding one of the six relations. 'Fears Void', 'fears broken' and 'fears a six-clash controlling the Self' are the three taboos concerning the person who is entrusted; 'following into the tomb and helping Pressure is unfavourable at the public court' is the taboo when a lawsuit or public business is involved. 'Changing into an advance' and 'changing into a retreat' are the Subject changing into an Advancing or Retreating spirit (see the glossary). 'The Vermilion Bird says it again and again' is the Vermilion Bird urging repeatedly and saying much; 'the Dark Tortoise is indirect' is the Dark Tortoise speaking in roundabout ways; 'Hook Earth is upright and solid' is Hook Earth being straight and substantial; 'the Coiling Snake clings' is the Coiling Snake clinging on; 'the Azure Dragon is mild' is the Azure Dragon gentle, and 'the White Tiger is bold' is the White Tiger brave and fierce. The book's own gloss: these natures are said of the phases and six spirits when strong, and when Void or broken it is the other way round. 'But do not make them master good and ill' is that the phases and the six spirits judge only temper, and good and ill are not fixed by them but by generation, control, strength and weakness. Read against the Yilin Buyi on relying on others' help (EL.134-137), where the Other line is also the master and Void, clash and broken are feared.

zh: 或用官，或用应，或用六亲，
皆忌六冲克世，则疑阻生衅，
旺衰以分其力之大小，合冲以定其情之向背，
化进则勇于事，化退则倦于行，
五行六神以断其情性，然勿主吉凶也。
yi: 占嘱托的，随所取的用神：
或者用官，或者用应，或者用六亲，
都忌空，空就不出力；
都忌破，破就没有功效；
都忌六冲克世，那就生疑、受阻、生出嫌隙；
随墓、助鬼，就不利于公堂。
旺衰来分他出力的大小，合冲来定他情意的向背，
化进就勇于办事，化退就倦于行动；
五行、六神用来断他的性情，但不要拿它来主断吉凶。
en: In divining about entrusting a matter to another, one follows the Subject taken:
whether Pressure, or the Other, or one of the six relations,
all fear Void, and Void means he does not exert himself;
all fear broken, and broken means no achievement;
all fear a six-clash controlling the Self, which breeds suspicion, obstruction and quarrel;
following into the tomb and helping Pressure is unfavourable at the public court.
Strength and weakness tell how much force he has; combination and clash fix whether his feeling is toward or against me;
changing into an advance means he is bold in the matter, changing into a retreat means he tires of acting;
the five phases and the six spirits are used to judge his temper, but one does not make them the master of good and ill.

zh: 金坚直，木从容，水曲折，火燥烈，土诚信，
龙和，虎勇，雀再三，武婉转，勾端实，蛇缠绵，
此五行六神从生旺言也，空破反之。
yi: 金坚直，木从容，水曲折，火燥烈，土诚信；
龙和，虎勇，雀再三，武婉转，勾端实，蛇缠绵；
这是五行、六神按生旺说的，空、破就反过来。
en: Metal is firm and straight, Wood is easygoing, Water is roundabout, Fire is fierce and hasty, Earth is sincere and faithful;
the Azure Dragon is mild, the White Tiger bold, the Vermilion Bird says it again and again, the Dark Tortoise is indirect, Hook Earth is upright and solid, the Coiling Snake clings;
this is said of the phases and the six spirits when they are strong, and Void or broken turns it round.

title: 营谋·来去、求己求人与谋之主：谋事之来者谋望并求用神、谋事之去者谋望而不求用神；求于己者世、求于人者应；有交忌冲、无交不忌冲；官鬼乃谋之主俱不可失

rule.yi: 凡是谋事要「来」的（要得到什么），办法是谋望，再同时求用神；谋事要「去」的（要摆脱什么），办法是谋望而不求用神。求于自己的看世，求于别人的看应；有交接的忌冲，没有交接的不忌冲；只有官鬼是谋事的主，都不可失去。
rule.en: For a scheme in which something is to 'come' (something is to be gained), the method is the scheme and hope, and also seeking the Subject; for a scheme in which something is to 'go' (something is to be shaken off), the method is the scheme and hope without seeking the Subject. What is sought from oneself is seen by the Self, what is sought from others by the Other; where there is a meeting, clash is feared, and where there is no meeting, clash is not feared; only Pressure is the master of the scheme, and neither may be lost.

note.yi: 「谋事之来者」按文意是要得到点什么（来我这边）的谋事，「谋事之去者」是要摆脱、除去点什么（从我这边去）的谋事，后者像「释患」那样，不求用神。「谋望」就是谋求和盼望（见易隐谋望占 YY.82）。「有交」是事情需要和对方交接、会面、合作，冲就把交接冲散，所以忌；「无交」是不需要交接，冲就无关紧要。「官鬼乃谋之主」是官鬼在谋事里是主持的一方（掌权、批准的人），所以不能失去。这一条与 YM.85 的「官鬼失而谋无主」是同一个意思。
note.en: 'A scheme that comes' is by the sense a scheme to gain something (to come to my side), and 'a scheme that goes' is a scheme to shake off or get rid of something (to go from my side), the latter being like relieving trouble, where the Subject is not sought. 'Mouwang' is scheming and hoping (see the Yi Yin on scheming and hope, YY.82). 'Where there is a meeting' is a matter that needs meeting, joining or co-operating with the other side, where a clash scatters the meeting and so is feared; 'where there is no meeting' is where no meeting is needed, and a clash is of no consequence. 'Pressure is the master of the scheme' is that in a scheme Pressure is the side that presides (the one who holds power and approves), so it must not be lost. This entry says the same as 'with Pressure lost, the scheme has no master' in YM.85.

zh: 盖凡谋事之来者，法以谋望而并求用神，
谋事之去者，法以谋望而不求用神。
求于己者世，求于人者应，
惟官鬼乃谋之主也，俱不可失焉。
yi: 凡是谋事要「来」的，办法是谋望，再同时求用神；
谋事要「去」的，办法是谋望而不求用神。
求于自己的看世，求于别人的看应；
有交接的忌冲，没有交接的不忌冲；
只有官鬼是谋事的主，都不可失去。
en: For a scheme in which something is to 'come', the method is the scheme and hope, and also seeking the Subject;
for a scheme in which something is to 'go', the method is the scheme and hope without seeking the Subject.
What is sought from oneself is seen by the Self, what is sought from others by the Other;
where there is a meeting, clash is feared, and where there is no meeting, clash is not feared;
only Pressure is the master of the scheme, and neither may be lost.

title: 营谋·嘱托的体与用：专问嘱托重体、专问所谋重用，问嘱托而兼求用神者体用两全事无不吉；嘱托体病虽用得位无成；本占为得不可贰

rule.yi: 凡是专问嘱托的，重体；专问所谋的事的，重用；问嘱托而又兼求用神的，体用两全，事情没有不吉的。然而嘱托的体有病，即使用神得位也不成。所以以眼前这一占为得，不可有二心。
rule.en: When one asks only about the entrusting, the body counts for most; when one asks only about the matter schemed for, the use counts for most; when one asks about the entrusting and also seeks the Subject, with body and use both whole, there is no matter that is not auspicious. But if the body of the entrusting is sick, even if the Subject is well placed it does not come off. So the divination at hand is what is to be taken, and one must not be of two minds.

note.yi: 「体」是受托的这个人所对应的爻（他肯不肯出力），「用」是所谋的这件事的用神（谋文用父、谋利用财等，见 YM.86）。「专问嘱托则重体」是只问托人这件事，看托的那个人；「专问所谋则重用」是只问事情本身，看用神；两样都问，就体用两全才吉。「嘱托体病，虽用得位无成」是托的人有病（空、破、克世等），事情的用神再好也成不了：人靠不住，事就落空。「本占为得，不可贰」是以所占的这一件为准，不要同时拿两件事去凑。
note.en: The 'body' is the line that corresponds to the person entrusted (whether he is willing to exert himself), and the 'use' is the Subject of the matter schemed for (documents by the father line, profit by Wealth, and so on, see YM.86). 'Asking only about the entrusting counts the body' is asking only the matter of entrusting someone, looking at the person entrusted; 'asking only about the matter schemed for counts the use' is asking only about the matter itself, looking at the Subject; if both are asked, it is auspicious only when body and use are both whole. 'If the body of the entrusting is sick, even if the Subject is well placed it does not come off' is that if the person entrusted is ailing (Void, broken, controlling the Self and so on), however good the Subject of the matter, it cannot come off: if the man cannot be relied on, the matter comes to nothing. 'The divination at hand is what is to be taken, and one must not be of two minds' is to go by the one matter divined and not to piece two matters together at once.

zh: 盖凡专问嘱托则重体，专问所谋则重用，
问嘱托而兼求用神者，体用两全，事无不吉。
然嘱托体病，虽用得位无成。
yi: 凡是专问嘱托的，重体；专问所谋的事的，重用；
问嘱托而又兼求用神的，体用两全，事情没有不吉的。
然而嘱托的体有病，即使用神得位也不成。
所以以眼前这一占为得，不可有二心。
en: When one asks only about the entrusting, the body counts for most; when one asks only about the matter schemed for, the use counts for most;
when one asks about the entrusting and also seeks the Subject, with body and use both whole, there is no matter that is not auspicious.
But if the body of the entrusting is sick, even if the Subject is well placed it does not come off.
So the divination at hand is what is to be taken, and one must not be of two minds.

title: 道业总纲：孔孟之道五伦为体、经世为用，困亨夷险各尽其道无须筮；弃家入道、拔俗修真、爱网难除、至人难遇，然道有道缘业有业障亦常于筮而得之（割爱离尘何用筮？所处安危、择师邪正亦赖圣贤告我）；本章七问：择师传法、主持纲纪、募缘法会、斋戒

rule.yi: 孔孟之道，以五伦为体、以经世为用；困与亨、夷与险，各有各的尽道之法，何必占筮。如果是弃家入道、超拔流俗、修行求真，爱欲的网难除，得道的人难遇，这自然是大丈夫的事，哪里同于世俗人的占筮？然而道有道缘，业有业障，也常常靠占筮得知。割断爱欲、离开尘世，一念之间就是万年，哪里用得着占筮？然而所处的安危、择师的邪正，也仍要靠圣贤告诉我。本章分七问：择师、传法、主持、纲纪、募缘、法会、斋戒。
rule.en: The Way of Confucius and Mencius takes the five human relations as its body and ordering the world as its use; in hardship and success, ease and danger, each has its own way of exhausting what is right, and why should one divine? But for one who leaves home to enter the Way, rises above the common run and practises to find the truth, the net of love is hard to cut, and a perfected man is hard to meet; this is of course the affair of a great man, and how could it be the same as the divining of the ordinary world? Yet the Way has its affinity for the Way, and the vocation has its karmic obstruction, and these too can often be learned by divining. Cutting off love and leaving the dust, one thought is ten thousand years, and what use is divining? Yet the safety or danger of where one lives, and whether the teacher one chooses is straight or crooked, one still relies on the sages to tell me. The chapter takes seven questions: choosing a teacher, transmitting the teaching, being abbot, being in the administration, soliciting donations, ritual assemblies and fasting.

note.yi: 「五伦」是君臣、父子、夫妇、兄弟、朋友。「经世」是治理世事。「至人」是修养到极处的人，「拔俗修真」是超脱流俗、修行求真。「爱网」是情爱的牵缠。「道缘」是和道的缘分，「业障」是前世所造的业带来的障碍。书里自注：割爱离尘的人，一念就是万年，用不着占；但所处的安危、选师的邪正，还要靠占告诉我。这一章讲的是出家修行的人（佛、道两家）的职业和处境，按职业归入事业；和世俗官职不同的是，它的用神多取世爻和福神。章首列的七问是择师、传法、主持、纲纪、募缘、法会、斋戒。
note.en: The 'five relations' are ruler and minister, father and son, husband and wife, elder and younger brother, and friend. 'Jingshi' is managing worldly affairs. A 'perfected man' is one cultivated to the utmost, and 'rising above the common run and practising to find the truth' is escaping the vulgar and cultivating the truth. The 'net of love' is the entanglement of affection. 'Affinity for the Way' is the karmic affinity with the Way, and 'karmic obstruction' is the hindrance brought by karma made in earlier lives. The book's own note: for one who has cut off love and left the dust, one thought is ten thousand years and there is no need to divine; but the safety of where one lives and whether the teacher chosen is straight or crooked still have to be told by divination. This chapter deals with the occupation and circumstances of those who have left home to practise (Buddhist and Daoist), and is placed under Career by occupation; unlike the worldly office, its Subject is mostly the Self line and the fortune spirit. The seven questions listed at the head of the chapter are choosing a teacher, transmitting the teaching, being abbot, being in the administration, soliciting donations, ritual assemblies and fasting.

zh: 孔孟之道，以五伦为体，以经世为用，
困亨夷险，有各尽之道，何以筮为。
若弃家入道，拔俗修真，爱网难除，
至人难遇，自是大丈夫事，岂同流俗人之筮？
然道有道缘，业有业障，亦常于筮而得之。
yi: 孔孟之道，以五伦为体，以经世为用；
困与亨、夷与险，各有各的尽道之法，何必占筮。
如果是弃家入道，超拔流俗、修行求真，爱欲的网难除，
得道的人难遇，这自然是大丈夫的事，哪里同于世俗人的占筮？
然而道有道缘，业有业障，也常常靠占筮得知。
en: The Way of Confucius and Mencius takes the five human relations as its body and ordering the world as its use;
in hardship and success, ease and danger, each has its own way of exhausting what is right, and why should one divine?
But for one who leaves home to enter the Way, rises above the common run and practises to find the truth, the net of love is hard to cut,
and a perfected man is hard to meet; this is of course the affair of a great man, and how could it be the same as the divining of the ordinary world?
Yet the Way has its affinity for the Way, and the vocation has its karmic obstruction, and these too can often be learned by divining.

zh: 割爱离尘，一念万年，何用筮耶？
然所处安危，择师邪正，亦赖圣贤告我。
yi: 割断爱欲、离开尘世，一念之间就是万年，哪里用得着占筮？
然而所处的安危，择师的邪正，也仍要靠圣贤告诉我。
en: Cutting off love and leaving the dust, one thought is ten thousand years, and what use is divining?
Yet the safety or danger of where one lives, and whether the teacher one chooses is straight or crooked, one still relies on the sages to tell me.

zh: 内详择师传法、主持纲纪、募缘法会、斋戒七问
yi: 里面详述择师传法、主持纲纪、募缘法会、斋戒七问。
en: Within are treated in detail seven questions: choosing a teacher and transmitting the teaching, being abbot and in the administration, soliciting donations and ritual assemblies, and fasting.

title: 道业·道缘与业缘：道缘福神、业缘系爻；子孙持世道成、官鬼交重障重；世不可病——病于破则多疾多灾修落傍门、病于散绝则自暴自弃心慵半路、随墓助伤则身陷泥犁、世生世旺则心开日月之光；专忌鬼动及世爻破散绝为三戒、世动亦主不宁

rule.yi: 什么叫道缘？福神就是。什么叫业缘？系爻就是。所以子孙持世，道就成；官鬼交重，障就重。而世不可有病：病在破，多病多灾，修行落入傍门；病在散、绝，自暴自弃，半路上心里懒散；随墓、助伤，则身陷泥犁（地狱）之地；世被生、世旺，则心里打开日月的光明。这是它的大象。专忌鬼动，以及世爻破、散、绝，这是三戒；世动也主不安宁。
rule.en: What is called the affinity for the Way? The fortune spirit, Output, is it. What is called karmic affinity? The binding line is it. So with Output on the Self the Way is accomplished; with Pressure moving and doubled the obstruction is heavy. And the Self must not be sick: sick by being broken, there are many illnesses and calamities and the practice falls into side paths; sick by being scattered or extinct, one gives oneself up and the heart goes slack halfway; following into the tomb and helping the injury, the body sinks into the pit of hell; with the Self generated and thriving, the heart opens to the light of sun and moon. This is its great image. Moving Pressure is above all feared, and the Self line broken, scattered or extinct, are the three warnings; the Self moving also means unrest.

note.yi: 「道缘」是修道的缘分，取福神（子孙）；「业缘」是业力的牵缠，取系爻（捆住人的爻，按下文是官鬼）；「障」是业障。「傍门」是旁门左道，「泥犁」是地狱（梵语 niraya），「日月之光」是智慧的光明。「病于破」「病于散绝」是世爻破、散、绝三种伤，各有各的后果：破是身体多灾，散绝是意志消沉。书里自注：专忌鬼动，以及世爻破、散、绝，是三戒；世动也主不宁。这一条是整章的总纲：道成与否看福神和世爻，障碍看官鬼，所以后面各问都先看世、福、鬼。
note.en: 'Daoyuan' is the affinity for cultivating the Way, taken from the fortune spirit (Output); 'yeyuan' is the entanglement of karmic force, taken from the binding line (the line that binds a man, which by the text below is Pressure); 'zhang' is karmic obstruction. 'Pangmen' is a side door, a heterodox way, 'niri' is hell (Sanskrit niraya), and 'the light of sun and moon' is the light of wisdom. 'Sick by being broken' and 'sick by being scattered or extinct' are three kinds of injury to the Self line, each with its consequence: broken means a body with many calamities, scattered or extinct means a sunken will. The book's own note: moving Pressure above all, and the Self line broken, scattered or extinct, are the three warnings; the Self moving also means unrest. This entry is the general principle of the whole chapter: whether the Way is accomplished is seen by the fortune spirit and the Self line, and obstruction by Pressure, so every later question first looks at the Self, Output and Pressure.

zh: 故子孙持世而道成，官鬼交重而障重。
而世不可病也，病于破，多疾多灾，修落傍门；
病于散绝，自暴自弃，心慵半路；
随墓助伤，则身陷泥犁之地。
世生世旺，则心开日月之光，此其大象也。
yi: 什么叫道缘？福神就是。
什么叫业缘？系爻就是，
所以子孙持世，道就成；官鬼交重，障就重。
而世不可有病：病在破，多病多灾，修行落入傍门；
病在散、绝，自暴自弃，半路上心里懒散；
随墓、助伤，则身陷泥犁之地；
世被生、世旺，则心里打开日月的光明，这是它的大象。
en: What is called the affinity for the Way? The fortune spirit, Output, is it.
What is called karmic affinity? The binding line is it,
so with Output on the Self the Way is accomplished; with Pressure moving and doubled the obstruction is heavy.
And the Self must not be sick: sick by being broken, there are many illnesses and calamities and the practice falls into side paths;
sick by being scattered or extinct, one gives oneself up and the heart goes slack halfway;
following into the tomb and helping the injury, the body sinks into the pit of hell;
with the Self generated and thriving, the heart opens to the light of sun and moon; this is its great image.

yi: 专忌鬼动，
以及世爻破、散、绝，这是三戒；
世动也主不安宁。
en: Moving Pressure is above all feared,
and the Self line broken, scattered or extinct, are the three warnings;
the Self moving also means unrest.

title: 道业·世空三冲的喜恶：出家而三冲世空为超然物外如孤鹤横空、求道而三冲世空为尘务撄心如困鱼失水；卜出世三冲解网世空无挂碍、卜入道则空无成

rule.yi: 然而世空有喜与恶的分别，三冲有宜与忌的分别：出家而三冲、世空，是超然物外，像孤鹤横空；求道而三冲、世空，是尘世杂务缠心，像困鱼失水。占出世，三冲是解开（俗世的）网，世空是没有牵挂；若占入道，那么空就成不了。
rule.en: Yet the Self Void has a distinction of welcome and unwelcome, and the three clashes a distinction of suitable and unsuitable: for one leaving home, the three clashes and the Self Void are being detached from the world, like a lone crane crossing the sky; for one seeking the Way, the three clashes and the Self Void are worldly business tangling the heart, like a trapped fish out of water. In divining about leaving the world, the three clashes are undoing the net and the Self Void is having nothing hanging on one's mind; if one divines about entering the Way, then Void means it does not come off.

note.yi: 「三冲」（见 YM.07 注）是冲散、断开；对出家（离开俗世）的人，冲散俗缘是好事，所以宜；对要修行的人（还在俗世里求道），冲散会把修行也断掉，所以忌。「世空」同样：离俗的人世空是无牵无挂，求道的人世空是心里空了、无从落脚。「撄心」是扰乱心神。「出世」是出家离俗，「入道」是进入修行。书里自注把这两种问法分开：卜出世，三冲是解网，世空是无挂碍；卜入道，空就无成。同一个卦象，问的是『出去』还是『进来』，喜恶相反。
note.en: The 'three clashes' (see the note to YM.07) are scattering and cutting apart; for one leaving the world (leaving the secular), scattering the worldly ties is a good thing and so suitable; for one who is to practise (still seeking the Way in the world), scattering will cut off the practice too and so is unsuitable. The 'Self Void' is the same: for one leaving the secular it is having nothing hanging on one's mind, and for one seeking the Way it is the heart gone empty with nowhere to rest. 'Yingxin' is disturbing the mind. 'Chushi' is leaving home and the secular, and 'rudao' is entering practice. The book's own note keeps the two ways of asking apart: divining about leaving the world, the three clashes are undoing the net and the Self Void is having nothing on one's mind; divining about entering the Way, Void means it does not come off. For the same image, whether one asks about 'going out' or 'coming in', welcome and unwelcome are opposite.

zh: 然世空有喜恶之辨也，三冲有宜忌之分也，
出家而三冲世空，为超然物外，如孤鹤横空。
求道而三冲世空为尘务撄心，如困鱼失水。
yi: 然而世空有喜与恶的分别，三冲有宜与忌的分别：
出家而三冲、世空，是超然物外，像孤鹤横空；
求道而三冲、世空，是尘世杂务缠心，像困鱼失水。
en: Yet the Self Void has a distinction of welcome and unwelcome, and the three clashes a distinction of suitable and unsuitable:
for one leaving home, the three clashes and the Self Void are being detached from the world, like a lone crane crossing the sky;
for one seeking the Way, the three clashes and the Self Void are worldly business tangling the heart, like a trapped fish out of water.

zh: 三冲谓解网，世空谓无挂碍，
yi: 占卜出世（出家），
三冲是解开（俗世的）网，世空是没有牵挂；
若占入道，那么空就成不了。
en: In divining about leaving the world,
the three clashes are undoing the net, and the Self Void is having nothing hanging on one's mind;
if one divines about entering the Way, then Void means it does not come off.

title: 道业·何年道成与何地法隆：世临日月之期道成、世临生合之地法隆；乱动非清修之象、游魂无戒定之心（道业成身专凭世位，世病乱动游魂俱忌）

rule.yi: 哪一年道成？世临日、月的时期。哪个地方法事兴隆？世临生合的地方。卦象乱动，不是清修之象；游魂，没有戒定（守戒、入定）的心。道业成就自身，专凭世的位置；世病、乱动、游魂，都忌。
rule.en: In which year is the Way accomplished? In the period when the Self is on the Day or the Month. In which place does the teaching flourish? In the place where the Self meets generation and combination. A hexagram of disorderly movement is not the image of pure practice; Wandering Soul has no heart of precepts and meditation. The monastic vocation making the man depends wholly on the position of the Self; a sick Self, disorderly movement and Wandering Soul are all feared.

note.yi: 「道成」是修道有成，「法隆」是弘法兴盛。「世临日月之期」是世爻所属的地支正逢当年、当月（日、月）的时候；「世临生合之地」是世爻得生、得合的方位。「乱动」是卦里动爻多而乱；「游魂」是游魂卦，主游荡不定。「戒定」是佛家的戒和定（守戒律、入禅定）。书里自注：道业成就一个人，专看世爻的位置，世病、乱动、游魂都是忌。这是本章里讲应期和地点的一条，与 YM.94 的『刻期取证』相配。
note.en: 'Daocheng' is succeeding in cultivating the Way, and 'falong' is the teaching flourishing. 'The Self on the Day or the Month' is the branch of the Self line meeting the branch of the year or the month (day or month); 'the place where the Self meets generation and combination' is the direction where the Self line is generated and combined. 'Disorderly movement' is a hexagram with many moving lines and in disorder; 'Wandering Soul' is a Wandering Soul hexagram, which means drifting without settling. 'Jieding' is the Buddhist precepts and concentration (keeping the rules and entering meditation). The book's own note: the vocation making the man depends wholly on the position of the Self line, and a sick Self, disorderly movement and Wandering Soul are all feared. This entry deals with timing and place in this chapter, and goes with 'fixing a date for realisation' in YM.94.

zh: 何年道成，世临日月之期。
何地法隆，世临生合之地，
乱动非清修之象，游魂无戒定之心。
yi: 哪一年道成？世临日、月的时期。
哪个地方法事兴隆？世临生合的地方。
卦象乱动，不是清修之象；游魂，没有戒定的心。
en: In which year is the Way accomplished? In the period when the Self is on the Day or the Month.
In which place does the teaching flourish? In the place where the Self meets generation and combination.
A hexagram of disorderly movement is not the image of pure practice; Wandering Soul has no heart of precepts and meditation.

yi: 道业成就自身，专凭世的位置；
世病、乱动、游魂，都忌。
en: The monastic vocation making the man depends wholly on the position of the Self;
a sick Self, disorderly movement and Wandering Soul are all feared.

title: 道业·刻期取证、指日还丹：世空无成、六冲多阻、世病则九仞井弃、鬼发则一丈魔高，唯世旺福兴而丹成悟彻（止问求道，世空世病六冲鬼动为四戒）

rule.yi: 限定日期取证（证道）、指日还丹（炼丹成功）：世空就无成，六冲就多阻碍，世病就像掘井九仞而放弃，鬼发就是魔高一丈；只有世旺、福兴，才丹成悟彻。只问求道，世空、世病、六冲、鬼动，这是四戒。
rule.en: For fixing a date for attaining realisation and counting the days to the return of the elixir: the Self Void, and nothing comes of it; a six-clash, and there are many obstructions; a sick Self, and it is digging a well nine fathoms deep and giving it up; Pressure issuing, and the devil stands ten feet high; only with the Self thriving and Output rising is the elixir completed and the realisation thorough. In asking only about seeking the Way, the Self Void, the Self sick, a six-clash and Pressure moving are the four warnings.

note.yi: 「刻期」是限定日期，「取证」是修行证道（得到证悟），「指日还丹」是指着日子炼成还丹（道家内丹的成功）。「九仞井弃」出自「掘井九仞而不及泉，犹为弃井也」，是功亏一篑；「一丈魔高」是「道高一尺、魔高一丈」，修行越深障碍越大。「丹成悟彻」是丹炼成、悟透彻。书里自注：只问求道的时候，世空、世病、六冲、鬼动是四个要戒的。与 YM.91 的三戒对着看，这里多了一个六冲。
note.en: 'Keqi' is fixing a date, 'quzheng' is attaining realisation in practice, and 'zhiri huandan' is counting the days to the completion of the returned elixir (success in Daoist inner alchemy).
