'Digging a well nine fathoms deep and giving it up' comes from 'digging a well nine fathoms and not reaching water is still an abandoned well', failing for want of the last basket of earth; 'the devil stands ten feet high' is 'the Way is a foot high, the devil is ten feet high', the deeper the practice the greater the obstacle. 'Dancheng wuche' is the elixir completed and the realisation thorough. The book's own note: when asking only about seeking the Way, the Self Void, the Self sick, a six-clash and Pressure moving are the four to be warned against. Read against the three warnings of YM.91; here a six-clash is added.

zh: 世空则无成，六冲则多阻，
世病则九仞井弃，鬼发则一丈魔高。
唯世旺福兴，而丹成悟徹。
yi: 限定日期取证，指日还丹，
世空就无成，六冲就多阻碍，
世病就像掘井九仞而放弃，鬼发就是魔高一丈；
只有世旺、福兴，才丹成悟彻。
en: For fixing a date for attaining realisation and counting the days to the return of the elixir,
the Self Void, and nothing comes of it; a six-clash, and there are many obstructions;
a sick Self, and it is digging a well nine fathoms deep and giving it up; Pressure issuing, and the devil stands ten feet high;
only with the Self thriving and Output rising is the elixir completed and the realisation thorough.

zh: 世空、世病、六冲、鬼动为四戒。
yi: 只问求道，
世空、世病、六冲、鬼动，这是四戒。
en: In asking only about seeking the Way,
the Self Void, the Self sick, a six-clash and Pressure moving are the four warnings.

title: 道业·择师、受徒传法与云游：择师同延师占——父临日月为名师、世空恐吾不能受教；受徒传法同继嗣——子逢生旺为法器、命墓恐彼不能传持；云游同出行而有访道求利之别

rule.yi: 所以择师，同（延）师占：父临日辰、月建，是名师；世空，恐怕我不能受教。收徒传法，同继嗣占：子逢生旺，是法器（可造之材）；命墓，恐怕他不能传持（继承）。云游同出行占，但有访道和求利的区别，各自兼用相应的象。
rule.en: So choosing a teacher is divined like hiring a teacher: the father line on the Day or Month is a famous teacher; the Self Void, I fear I cannot be taught. Taking disciples and transmitting the teaching is divined like continuing a line of descent: the child line meeting generation and thriving is a vessel of the Dharma (a promising disciple); the life line in the tomb, I fear he cannot carry it on and transmit it. Wandering as a cloud is divined like travelling, but there is a difference between seeking the Way and seeking profit, and each also uses its corresponding image.

note.yi: 「择师」是选老师（同延师占，见本书延师章），「受徒传法」是收徒弟、传授道法（同继嗣，即过继、立嗣），「云游」是僧道四处游方。「名师」是有名的好老师，「法器」是可以承载佛法、承继衣钵的人才。「命墓」是世爻（命）入墓。「传持」是传承并持守。这一条是把道业的几问分别比到世俗已有的占法上去：择师比延师，收徒比继嗣，云游比出行。比到别的占法，就用那一边的断法。
note.en: 'Zeshi' is choosing a teacher (divined like hiring a teacher, see the chapter on hiring a teacher in this book), 'shoutu chuanfa' is taking disciples and handing on the teaching (like continuing a line of descent, that is adoption and establishing an heir), and 'yunyou' is a monk or Daoist wandering from place to place. 'Mingshi' is a famous good teacher, and 'faqi' is a person who can carry the Dharma and inherit the robe and bowl. 'The life line in the tomb' is the Self line (the life) entering the tomb. 'Chuanchi' is handing on and keeping. This entry matches each question of the monastic vocation to a divination already known in the worldly sphere: choosing a teacher to hiring a teacher, taking disciples to continuing a line of descent, wandering to travelling. Once matched to another divination, the judgments of that side are used.

zh: 父临日月为名师，世空恐吾不能受教。
子逢生旺为法器，命墓恐彼不能传持。
yi: 所以择师，同（延）师占：
父临日辰、月建，是名师；世空，恐怕我不能受教。
收徒传法，同继嗣占：
子逢生旺，是法器；命墓，恐怕他不能传持。
en: So choosing a teacher is divined like hiring a teacher:
the father line on the Day or Month is a famous teacher; the Self Void, I fear I cannot be taught.
Taking disciples and transmitting the teaching is divined like continuing a line of descent:
the child line meeting generation and thriving is a vessel of the Dharma; the life line in the tomb, I fear he cannot carry it on and transmit it.

yi: 云游同出行占，
但有访道和求利的区别，
各自兼用相应的象。
en: Wandering as a cloud is divined like travelling,
but there is a difference between seeking the Way and seeking profit,
and each also uses its corresponding image.

title: 道业·住持、纲纪、募缘、法会：应缘倡道多名利之求；住持如占宅（三冲鬼动当退）、纲纪如筮仕（世空官坏无成）、募缘同求财（应空财陷徒往）、法会如设馆（应空鬼动多损）

rule.yi: 此后再往前走，顺应因缘倡导道法，就多有名利的追求了。住持（主持寺观）如占宅：三冲、鬼动，就该退；纲纪（寺观的管事）如筮仕：世空、官坏，就无成；募缘（化缘募捐）同求财：应空、财陷，就白去一趟；法会如设馆：应空、鬼动，就多有损失。
rule.en: Beyond this, to go along with the occasion and promote the Way brings many pursuits of fame and profit. Being abbot (presiding over a temple) is like divining about a house: the three clashes and Pressure moving mean one should withdraw; holding an administrative post is like divining about taking office: the Self Void and Pressure damaged mean nothing comes of it; soliciting donations is the same as seeking wealth: the Other Void and Wealth fallen mean the trip is in vain; a ritual assembly is like opening a school: the Other Void and Pressure moving mean many losses.

note.yi: 「应缘倡道」是顺应因缘出来倡导、弘扬道法。「住持」是主持一座寺观，「纲纪」是寺观里管事务和纪律的执事，「募缘」是向信众化缘募捐，「法会」是做法事、办法会。书里把它们分别比到世俗的占法上：住持比占宅（宅卜，见家宅各章），纲纪比筮仕（本章 YM.40 起），募缘比求财，法会比设馆（卜馆章 YM.29 起）。「三冲鬼动而当退」是住持要退位的征兆；「世空官坏而无成」是纲纪的位子谋不成；「应空财陷而徒往」是化缘白跑一趟；「应空鬼动而多损」是法会办起来多有损耗。
note.en: 'Yingyuan changdao' is going along with the occasion to come forward and promote the Way. 'Zhuchi' is presiding over a temple or monastery, 'gangji' is the executive who looks after affairs and discipline in a temple, 'muyuan' is soliciting alms and donations from believers, and 'fahui' is performing rites and holding assemblies. The book matches each to a worldly divination: being abbot to divining about a house (house divination, see the chapters on dwellings), administrative posts to divining about taking office (from YM.40 of this book), soliciting donations to seeking wealth, and the ritual assembly to opening a school (from YM.29, the chapter on a teaching post). 'The three clashes and Pressure moving, one should withdraw' is the sign that an abbot must step down; 'the Self Void and Pressure damaged, nothing comes of it' is that the administrative seat cannot be got; 'the Other Void and Wealth fallen, the trip is in vain' is the begging trip made for nothing; 'the Other Void and Pressure moving, many losses' is the assembly costing much once it is held.

zh: 过此以往，应缘倡道，遂多名利之求矣。
住持如占宅也，三冲鬼动而当退。
纲纪如筮仕也，世空官坏而无成。
募缘同求财也，应空财陷而徒往。
法会如设馆也，应空鬼动而多损。
yi: 此后再往前走，顺应因缘倡导道法，就多有名利的追求了。
住持如占宅：三冲、鬼动，就该退；
纲纪如筮仕：世空、官坏，就无成；
募缘同求财：应空、财陷，就白去一趟；
法会如设馆：应空、鬼动，就多有损失。
en: Beyond this, to go along with the occasion and promote the Way brings many pursuits of fame and profit.
Being abbot is like divining about a house: the three clashes and Pressure moving mean one should withdraw;
holding an administrative post is like divining about taking office: the Self Void and Pressure damaged mean nothing comes of it;
soliciting donations is the same as seeking wealth: the Other Void and Wealth fallen mean the trip is in vain;
a ritual assembly is like opening a school: the Other Void and Pressure moving mean many losses.

title: 道业·持斋戒：专务用神、自占以世为本，用旺鬼静则始终不渝、三冲用坏则半途改辙；若筮开斋破戒当无吉占、世坏鬼动尤凶

rule.yi: 占持斋戒（守斋持戒），专取用神；自己占的以世为本。用旺、鬼静，就始终不变；三冲、用坏，就半路改辙。如果占开斋破戒，不会有吉占；世坏、鬼动尤其凶，只能戒（不要做）罢了。
rule.en: In divining about keeping the fast and the precepts, one attends only to the Subject; in divining for oneself the Self is the base. With the Subject thriving and Pressure still, one does not change from beginning to end; with the three clashes and the Subject damaged, one changes course halfway. If one divines about breaking the fast and the precepts, there will be no auspicious divination; a damaged Self and Pressure moving are especially ominous, and all one can do is refrain.

note.yi: 「斋戒」是素食守斋、持守戒律，「开斋破戒」是中途吃荤、破坏戒律。「专务用神」是专看用神；「自占以世为本」是自己占就以世爻为本位。「始终不渝」是始终不变，「半途改辙」是半路改变做法。书里自注：占开斋破戒，不会有吉占，世坏、鬼动更凶，只能劝戒。这一条的「用神」没有说是哪一爻，按全章的思路是福神（子孙，见 YM.91 道缘）和世爻，按文意理解。
note.en: 'Zhaijie' is keeping a vegetarian fast and keeping the precepts, and 'kaizhai pojie' is breaking the fast and breaking the precepts partway. 'Zhuanwu yongshen' is attending solely to the Subject; 'zizhan yi shi wei ben' is that when divining for oneself the Self line is the base. 'Shizhong buyu' is not changing from beginning to end, and 'bantu gaizhe' is changing one's course halfway. The book's own note: divining about breaking the fast and the precepts there will be no auspicious divination, a damaged Self and Pressure moving are worse, and all one can do is advise refraining. The 'Subject' in this entry is not said to be any particular line; by the thought of the whole chapter it is the fortune spirit (Output, see 'affinity for the Way' in YM.91) and the Self line, taken by the sense.

zh: 自占以世为本，用旺鬼静则始终不渝，
yi: 占持斋戒，专取用神；
自己占的以世为本，用旺、鬼静，就始终不变；
三冲、用坏，就半路改辙。
en: In divining about keeping the fast and the precepts, one attends only to the Subject;
in divining for oneself the Self is the base, and with the Subject thriving and Pressure still, one does not change from beginning to end;
with the three clashes and the Subject damaged, one changes course halfway.

zh: 若筮开斋破戒，当无吉占，
世坏鬼动尤凶，戒之而已。
yi: 如果占开斋破戒，不会有吉占；
世坏、鬼动尤其凶，只能戒（不要做）罢了。
en: If one divines about breaking the fast and the precepts, there will be no auspicious divination;
a damaged Self and Pressure moving are especially ominous, and all one can do is refrain.

title: 道业·金木释道与卦之升降：西方属金肃杀故释氏像之（乾兑申酉，金爻乾兑之宫福动吉鬼动凶）、东方属木化育故道宗像之（震巽寅卯，木爻震巽之宫官动为恶子动为善）；卦有升降之爻——世居升爻可入圣谓之成、世居降爻不能越凡谓之败，无病则吉有病则凶

rule.yi: 金木，是释（佛）、道；升降，是成败。西方属金，是肃杀之地，所以用释氏来象征它；况且佛从西边来，当属乾、兑、申、酉，所以金爻以及乾、兑之宫，福动就吉，鬼动就凶。东方属木，是化育之所，所以用道宗来象征它；况且道行于东土，当属震、巽、寅、卯，所以木爻以及震、巽之宫，官动是恶，子动是善。卦有升降之爻：如八月得升卦，则世是升爻；八月得泰卦，则世是降爻，这是秋分后四阴升而三阳降的缘由。世居升爻，可以入圣，叫做成；世居降爻，不能超越凡俗，叫做败；然而无病就吉，有病就凶。
rule.en: Metal and Wood are the Buddhists and the Daoists; ascent and descent are success and failure. The west belongs to Metal, a place of austerity and killing, so the Buddhist is imaged by it; and since the Buddha came from the west, it belongs to Qian, Dui, Shen and You, so for a Metal line and the palaces of Qian and Dui, Output moving is auspicious and Pressure moving is ominous. The east belongs to Wood, a place of transformation and nurture, so the Daoist school is imaged by it; and since the Way goes in the eastern land, it belongs to Zhen, Xun, Yin and Mao, so for a Wood line and the palaces of Zhen and Xun, Pressure moving is bad and Output moving is good. A hexagram has lines of ascent and descent: if one gets Sheng in the eighth month, the Self is a line of ascent; if one gets Tai in the eighth month, the Self is a line of descent, which is why after the autumn equinox four yin rise and three yang fall. The Self on an ascending line may enter sagehood, and this is called success; the Self on a descending line cannot rise above the ordinary, and this is called failure; but without sickness it is auspicious, and with sickness ominous.

note.yi: 「释氏」是佛家（释迦牟尼），「道宗」是道家。西方属金、肃杀，象佛；东方属木、化育，象道，是从方位、五行立论，不是评价两家高下。「乾兑申酉」是金的卦宫和地支（乾兑属金，申酉属金），「震巽寅卯」是木的卦宫和地支。「福动则吉，鬼动则凶」「官动为恶，子动为善」是说无论释道，福神（子孙）动都是好、官鬼动都是坏。「卦有升降之爻」按文意是卦里有些爻是升、有些是降：书里举例，八月得升卦，世是升爻；八月得泰卦，世是降爻，理由是『秋分后四阴升而三阳降』（秋分之后阴气渐长，阳气渐消）。世居升爻是向上走（可入圣，叫成），世居降爻是向下走（越不过凡俗，叫败）；但世爻无病才吉，有病仍凶。这里的升降论法比较晦，书里没有展开，按字面译。
note.en: 'Shishi' is the Buddhist school (Sakyamuni) and 'daozong' is the Daoist school. The west belongs to Metal and austerity, which images the Buddha; the east belongs to Wood and nurture, which images the Way: the argument is from direction and phase and is not a judgment of the worth of the two schools. 'Qian, Dui, Shen and You' are the palaces and branches of Metal (Qian and Dui belong to Metal, and Shen and You belong to Metal), and 'Zhen, Xun, Yin and Mao' are the palaces and branches of Wood. 'Output moving is auspicious, Pressure moving is ominous' and 'Pressure moving is bad, Output moving is good' say that in either school Output (the fortune spirit) moving is good and Pressure moving is bad. 'A hexagram has lines of ascent and descent', by the sense, is that some lines in a hexagram ascend and some descend: the book's example is that getting Sheng in the eighth month makes the Self a line of ascent, and getting Tai in the eighth month makes the Self a line of descent, the reason given being that 'after the autumn equinox four yin rise and three yang fall' (after the equinox the yin force grows and the yang force wanes). The Self on an ascending line goes upward (may enter sagehood, called success), and on a descending line goes downward (cannot surpass the ordinary, called failure); but the Self line must be without sickness for it to be auspicious, and with sickness it is still ominous. This account of ascent and descent is rather obscure, the book does not expand on it, and it is translated by the letter.

yi: 金木，是释（佛）、道；
升降，是成败。
en: Metal and Wood are the Buddhists and the Daoists;
ascent and descent are success and failure.

zh: 西方属金，乃肃杀之地，故以释氏像之，
况自西来，当属乾兑申酉，
所以金爻及乾兑之宫，福动则吉，鬼动则凶。
东方属木，乃化育之所，故以道宗像之，
且行东土，当属震巽寅卯，
故以木爻及震巽之宫，官动为恶，子动为善也。
卦有升降之爻，如八月得升，则世是升爻，
八月得泰，则世是降爻，秋分后四阴升而三阳降之由也。
世居升爻，可以入圣谓之成，
世居降爻，不能越凡谓之败，
yi: 西方属金，是肃杀之地，所以用释氏来象征它；
况且佛从西边来，当属乾、兑、申、酉，
所以金爻以及乾、兑之宫，福动就吉，鬼动就凶。
东方属木，是化育之所，所以用道宗来象征它；
况且道行于东土，当属震、巽、寅、卯，
所以木爻以及震、巽之宫，官动是恶，子动是善。
卦有升降之爻：如八月得升卦，则世是升爻；
八月得泰卦，则世是降爻，这是秋分后四阴升而三阳降的缘由。
世居升爻，可以入圣，叫做成；
世居降爻，不能超越凡俗，叫做败；
然而无病就吉，有病就凶。
en: The west belongs to Metal, a place of austerity and killing, so the Buddhist is imaged by it;
and since the Buddha came from the west, it belongs to Qian, Dui, Shen and You,
so for a Metal line and the palaces of Qian and Dui, Output moving is auspicious and Pressure moving is ominous.
The east belongs to Wood, a place of transformation and nurture, so the Daoist school is imaged by it;
and since the Way goes in the eastern land, it belongs to Zhen, Xun, Yin and Mao,
so for a Wood line and the palaces of Zhen and Xun, Pressure moving is bad and Output moving is good.
A hexagram has lines of ascent and descent: if one gets Sheng in the eighth month, the Self is a line of ascent;
if one gets Tai in the eighth month, the Self is a line of descent, which is why after the autumn equinox four yin rise and three yang fall.
The Self on an ascending line may enter sagehood, and this is called success;
the Self on a descending line cannot rise above the ordinary, and this is called failure;
but without sickness it is auspicious, and with sickness ominous.

title: 道业·六亲所主：子官善恶、父母摇得典策之誉、兄弟动犯贪嗔之戒、妻财发有萦家之心；子孙动夙有善根福德徒众、官鬼动原有恶孽灾障调达之扰、父母吉动得名誉凶动法嗣聚散、弟兄吉动遇良朋但清苦凶动贪嗔之累、妻财吉动道供盈余凶动妇女缠绊

rule.yi: 子（孙）、官（鬼），是善与恶；父母动，得典籍策书的名誉；兄弟动，犯贪嗔的戒；妻财发，有牵挂家室的心。子孙动，前世就有善根，或者因缘福德深厚，或者有高贤徒众侍奉；官鬼动，原本有恶业，或者灾障缠身，或者调达（提婆达多那样的）搅扰；父母带吉神动，我的书文以后得名誉，带凶神动，主法嗣多聚多散；弟兄吉动，当遇良朋善友，但道风清苦，凶动，常有贪嗔的牵累；妻财吉动，道场供养有盈余，凶动，有妇女缠绊。
rule.en: Output and Pressure are good and evil; Resource moving gains the name of scripture and learning; Peer moving breaks the precept against greed and anger; Wealth issuing brings a heart that clings to home. Output moving means one had roots of goodness from the past, or great karmic merit, or the service of eminent worthies and disciples; Pressure moving means one had evil karma originally, or entanglement by calamity and hindrance, or the harassment of a Devadatta; Resource moving with an auspicious spirit, my writings later win renown, with an ominous spirit, the heirs of the teaching gather and scatter much; Peer moving auspiciously, one will meet good friends but the way of life is austere, ominously, there is often the entanglement of greed and anger; Wealth moving auspiciously, the offerings to the place of practice have a surplus, ominously, women entangle.

note.yi: 「子官」是子孙和官鬼，「善恶」是它们代表的善和恶。「典策」是典籍、策书，「父母摇而得典策之誉」是父母爻动、得经书著述的名声。「贪嗔」是佛家说的三毒里的贪和嗔。「萦家」是牵挂家室。注里「夙有善恨」疑是「夙有善根」：前世种下的善根。「因缘福德」是因缘和福报，「高贤徒众」是德高的贤人和众弟子。「恶孽」是恶业，「灾障」是灾难和障碍，「调达」是提婆达多（释迦的堂弟，屡屡破坏僧团的人），泛指搅扰修行的人。「法嗣」是承继道法的弟子，「聚散」是来了又走。「道风」是修道的风气，「清苦」是清贫刻苦。「道供」是道场得到的供养。这一条是把六亲分别配到修道人的处境：子孙是福报，官鬼是业障，父母是名声，兄弟是同道与贪嗔，妻财是供养与家缘。
note.en: 'Zi guan' is Output and Pressure, and 'good and evil' is the good and the evil they stand for. 'Diance' is scriptures and books, and 'Resource moving gains the name of scripture and learning' is that when the Resource line moves one gets the name of writings on the sutras. 'Tanchen' is greed and anger, two of the three poisons of the Buddhists. 'Yingjia' is clinging to home. The 'shan hen' of the note is presumably a slip for 'shan gen', roots of goodness: good roots planted in an earlier life. 'Yinyuan fude' is karmic affinity and the reward of merit, and 'gaoxian tuzhong' is eminent worthies and the host of disciples. 'E'nie' is evil karma, 'zaizhang' is calamity and obstruction, and 'Tiaoda' is Devadatta (the Buddha's cousin, who repeatedly tried to split the order), standing in general for those who disturb the practice. 'Fasi' is a disciple who inherits the teaching, and 'jusan' is coming and then going. 'Daofeng' is the style of the practice, and 'qingku' is poor and hard. 'Daogong' is the offerings the place of practice receives. This entry assigns the six relations to the circumstances of one who practises: Output is the reward of merit, Pressure is karmic hindrance, Resource is fame, Peer is fellow-seekers and greed and anger, and Wealth is offerings and ties to the household.

yi: 子（孙）、官（鬼），是善与恶；
父母动，得典籍策书的名誉；
兄弟动，犯贪嗔的戒；
妻财发，有牵挂家室的心。
en: Output and Pressure are good and evil;
Resource moving gains the name of scripture and learning;
Peer moving breaks the precept against greed and anger;
Wealth issuing brings a heart that clings to home.

zh: 子孙动，夙有善恨，或因缘福德之隆，或高贤徒众之侍。
官鬼动，原有恶孽，或灾障之缠，或调达之扰。
父母带吉神动，则我书文后得名誉；带凶神动，主法嗣多聚散也。
弟兄吉动，当遇良朋善友，但道风清苦；凶动，常多贪嗔之累。
妻财吉动，道供盈余；凶动，妇女缠绊。
yi: 子孙动，前世就有善根（「善恨」疑为「善根」），或者因缘福德深厚，或者有高贤徒众侍奉；
官鬼动，原本有恶业，或者灾障缠身，或者调达那样的搅扰；
父母带吉神动，我的书文以后得名誉，带凶神动，主法嗣多聚多散；
弟兄吉动，当遇良朋善友，但道风清苦，凶动，常有贪嗔的牵累；
妻财吉动，道场供养有盈余，凶动，有妇女缠绊。
en: Output moving means one had roots of goodness from the past, or great karmic merit, or the service of eminent worthies and disciples;
Pressure moving means one had evil karma originally, or entanglement by calamity and hindrance, or the harassment of a Devadatta;
Resource moving with an auspicious spirit, my writings later win renown, with an ominous spirit, the heirs of the teaching gather and scatter much;
Peer moving auspiciously, one will meet good friends but the way of life is austere, ominously, there is often the entanglement of greed and anger;
Wealth moving auspiciously, the offerings to the place of practice have a surplus, ominously, women entangle.

title: 道业·六神所主：螣蛇尘障不除、勾陈夙缘不断、白虎元武灾盗之由、朱雀青龙才名之士，必因鬼动而云凶、福动而云吉（如朱雀摇鬼为是非、动福为名誉）

rule.yi: 螣蛇，是尘世的障碍不除；勾陈，是旧缘不断；白虎、元武，是灾祸盗贼的由头；朱雀、青龙，是有才有名的人；大概必须因鬼动才说凶，福动才说吉。例如朱雀带着摇动的鬼，是是非；朱雀动福，是名誉，之类。
rule.en: The Coiling Snake means the hindrances of the dust of the world are not removed; Hook Earth means old ties are not cut; the White Tiger and the Dark Tortoise are the cause of calamity and theft; the Vermilion Bird and the Azure Dragon are men of talent and name; generally one says ominous only because Pressure moves, and auspicious only because Output moves. For example, the Vermilion Bird with a moving Pressure is disputes; the Vermilion Bird with Output moving is renown, and so on.

note.yi: 「尘障」是尘世的障碍，「夙缘」是前世留下的缘分。「元武」是玄武。「灾盗之由」是灾祸、盗贼的由头，「才名之士」是有才华、有名望的人。「必因鬼动而云凶，福动而云吉」是六神自己的吉凶，要等鬼动或福动才算数：六神只是底色，说凶说吉由动的是鬼还是福来定。书里自注的例子：朱雀带动的鬼是是非口舌，朱雀动福是名誉。六神的本义见术语表，这里是把它们取到修道人的处境上。
note.en: 'Chenzhang' is the hindrances of the dust of the world, and 'suyuan' is the ties left from earlier lives. 'Yuanwu' is the Dark Tortoise. 'The cause of calamity and theft' is the source of calamity and thieves, and 'men of talent and name' are people of talent and reputation. 'One says ominous only because Pressure moves, and auspicious only because Output moves' is that the luck of the six spirits themselves counts only when Pressure or Output moves: the six spirits are only the ground colour, and whether one speaks of ominous or auspicious is fixed by whether it is Pressure or Output that moves. The book's own example: the Vermilion Bird with a moving Pressure is disputes and talk, and the Vermilion Bird with Output moving is renown. The original meanings of the six spirits are in the glossary; here they are taken onto the circumstances of one who practises.

zh: 螣蛇尘障不除，勾陈夙缘不断，
白虎元武，灾盗之由，朱雀青龙，才名之士，
盖必因鬼动而云凶，福动而云吉也。
yi: 螣蛇，是尘世的障碍不除；勾陈，是旧缘不断；
白虎、元武，是灾祸盗贼的由头；朱雀、青龙，是有才有名的人；
大概必须因鬼动才说凶，福动才说吉。
en: The Coiling Snake means the hindrances of the dust of the world are not removed; Hook Earth means old ties are not cut;
the White Tiger and the Dark Tortoise are the cause of calamity and theft; the Vermilion Bird and the Azure Dragon are men of talent and name;
generally one says ominous only because Pressure moves, and auspicious only because Output moves.

zh: 如朱雀摇鬼为是非，动福为名誉之类。
yi: 例如朱雀带着摇动的鬼，是是非；朱雀动福，是名誉，之类。
en: For example, the Vermilion Bird with a moving Pressure is disputes; the Vermilion Bird with Output moving is renown, and so on.

title: 道业·修行吉占与圣学：惟得复咸艮无妄而安宁者为修行之吉占；孔孟之学几成功名之捷径、自姚江而后道风渺然，若有豪杰继绝学明圣道亦以此章占；四卦专释心学不拘福鬼冲合直言其吉（安静则然变动复非）；圣学无求道故道业止详二氏三教道同占同

rule.yi: 只有得到复、咸、艮、无妄而安宁的，是修行的吉占。孔孟之学几乎成了功名的捷径，自姚江（王阳明）以后，道风渺茫；如果有豪杰之士起来继承绝学、阐明圣道，也用这一章来占。复、咸、艮、无妄这几个卦，专门解释心学；大抵儒释道三教必以正心为根，占修行得到这几个卦的，不拘福神、鬼、冲合，直接说吉；但安静时才如此，变动了就不是了。圣学没有『求道』一说，所以道业只详述佛道二家；三教之道相同，占法也相同。
rule.en: Only getting Fu, Xian, Gen or Wuwang and being at peace is an auspicious divination for practice. The learning of Confucius and Mencius has almost become a short cut to fame and office, and since Yaojiang (Wang Yangming) the manner of the Way has grown faint; if there are heroic men who rise up to continue the lost learning and make clear the sages' Way, they too divine by this chapter. The hexagrams Fu, Xian, Gen and Wuwang are devoted to the learning of the heart; in general the three teachings all take rectifying the heart as the root, and one who divines about practice and gets these hexagrams, whatever the fortune spirit, Pressure, clash and combination, is simply told that it is auspicious; but this holds only when still, and if moving it is not so again. The sages' learning has no 'seeking the Way', so the monastic vocation treats only the two schools in detail; the three teachings are the same in the Way and the same in divining.

note.yi: 「复」「咸」「艮」「无妄」是四个卦名：复是回返本心，咸是感应，艮是止，无妄是不妄动，都有『返回本心、静止』的意思，所以书里说这四卦『专释心学』（「四易」按文意是这四个卦）。「姚江」是王阳明（余姚人，姚江学派），「绝学」是失传的学问，「圣道」是圣人的道。「正心」是端正心思（《大学》语）。「福鬼冲合」是福神、官鬼、冲、合这些平常用的断法，这四卦不拘这些，直接断吉，但只限卦静的时候，变动了就按平常的断法。「圣学无求道者」是儒家圣学里没有『出家求道』这回事，所以这一章只讲佛、道两家；三教（儒释道）之道相同，占法也相同。这一条是道业章的收尾，和章首（YM.90）的『孔孟之道无须筮』前后呼应。
note.en: Fu, Xian, Gen and Wuwang are four hexagram names: Fu is returning to the original heart, Xian is response, Gen is stopping, Wuwang is not acting rashly, all with the sense of 'return to the original heart and be still', so the book says these four are 'devoted to the learning of the heart' ('the four changes' by the sense is these four hexagrams). 'Yaojiang' is Wang Yangming (a man of Yuyao, the Yaojiang school), 'juexue' is learning that has been lost, and 'shengdao' is the sages' Way. 'Zhengxin' is rectifying the heart (a phrase of the Great Learning). 'Fortune spirit, Pressure, clash and combination' are the ordinary methods of judgment; these four hexagrams are not tied to them and are directly called auspicious, but only when the hexagram is still, and if moving the ordinary judgment is used. 'The sages' learning has no seeking the Way' is that in the Confucian sages' learning there is no 'leaving home to seek the Way', so this chapter speaks only of the Buddhist and Daoist schools; the three teachings (Confucian, Buddhist, Daoist) are the same in the Way and the same in divining. This entry closes the chapter and answers the head of the chapter (YM.90), 'the Way of Confucius and Mencius needs no divining'.

zh: 惟得复咸艮无妄而安宁者，修行之吉占也。
孔孟之学，几成功名之捷径，自姚江而后，
道风妙然，若有豪豪杰之士，起继绝学明圣道，亦以此章占之。
yi: 只有得到复、咸、艮、无妄而安宁的，是修行的吉占。
孔孟之学几乎成了功名的捷径，自姚江以后，
道风渺茫；如果有豪杰之士起来继承绝学、阐明圣道，也用这一章来占。
en: Only getting Fu, Xian, Gen or Wuwang and being at peace is an auspicious divination for practice.
The learning of Confucius and Mencius has almost become a short cut to fame and office, and since Yaojiang,
the manner of the Way has grown faint; if there are heroic men who rise up to continue the lost learning and make clear the sages' Way, they too divine by this chapter.

zh: 四易专释心学，大抵三教必以正心为根，
筮修行得此者，不拘福鬼冲合，直言其吉也，
然安静如之变动复非尔。
圣学无求道者，故道业止详二氏，三教道同占同也。
yi: 这几个卦专门解释心学，大抵三教必以正心为根，
占修行得到这几个卦的，不拘福神、鬼、冲合，直接说吉；
但安静时才如此，变动了就不是了。
圣学没有求道一说，所以道业只详述佛道二家，三教之道相同，占法也相同。
en: These hexagrams are devoted to the learning of the heart; in general the three teachings all take rectifying the heart as the root,
and one who divines about practice and gets these hexagrams, whatever the fortune spirit, Pressure, clash and combination, is simply told that it is auspicious;
but this holds only when still, and if moving it is not so again.
The sages' learning has no 'seeking the Way', so the monastic vocation treats only the two schools in detail; the three teachings are the same in the Way and the same in divining.

title: 官鬼的名与用：或曰阳为官阴为鬼、旺为官衰为鬼、官鬼为系爻制爻；大凡喜之为官、恶之为鬼，名异而用同，卦不应无亦不宜动（官鬼不必以旺衰阴阳分，用则为官忌则为鬼，官亦可凶鬼亦可吉）

rule.yi: 有人说阳是官、阴是鬼；又说旺是官、衰是鬼；又说官鬼是「系」爻、是「制」爻。大凡喜欢它的叫官，厌恶它的叫鬼；用在阳的一面就是官，用在阴的一面就是鬼：名称不同而用法相同。卦里不该没有它，也不宜发动。官鬼不必按旺衰、阴阳来分：只要取它来用就是官，忌它就是鬼；然而官也可能凶，鬼也可能吉。
rule.en: Some say that yang is the official and yin is the demon; some say that thriving is the official and weak is the demon; some say that Pressure is the 'binding' line and the 'controlling' line. In general what one welcomes is called the official and what one dislikes is called the demon; used on the yang side it is the official, used on the yin side it is the demon: the names differ but the use is the same. The hexagram should not lack it, and it should not move. Pressure need not be told apart by strength and weakness or by yin and yang: if it is taken for use it is the official, and if it is feared it is the demon; yet the official may be ominous, and the demon may be auspicious.

note.yi: 「官」和「鬼」是同一个爻（官鬼，克我的那一类）的两个名字：本书的办法不按旺衰或阴阳去分，只看当下是取它来用、还是忌它：要它出力（求官、求名）时叫官，怕它为祸（疾病、官司）时叫鬼，所以书里有时写官、有时写鬼。「系爻」是拴住人的爻，「制爻」是管制人的爻（书里没有再解释）；原文「官鬼为系（击？）爻」里的「击？」是书里自己标的存疑字。「卦不应无，亦不宜动」是官鬼在卦里既不该没有，也不宜发动。这一条是读本书里「官」「鬼」两字的钥匙，和 YM.40 的「以官为用神」、YM.41 的「随官入墓、助鬼伤身」对着看。
note.en: 'Guan' and 'gui' are two names of one line (Pressure, the kind that controls me): the book's method does not tell them apart by strength or yin and yang, but only by whether it is being taken for use or feared at the moment: when one wants it to exert itself (seeking office or a name) it is called the official, and when one fears it as a source of harm (illness, lawsuits) it is called the demon, so the book sometimes writes 'guan' and sometimes 'gui'. The 'binding line' is the line that ties a man down, and the 'controlling line' is the line that regulates a man (the book does not explain further); the 'ji?' in the original 'guan gui wei xi (ji?) yao' is a doubtful character marked by the book itself. 'The hexagram should not lack it, and it should not move' is that Pressure should be neither absent from the hexagram nor moving. This entry is the key to reading the two words 'guan' and 'gui' in this book, to be read against 'taking Pressure as the Subject' in YM.40 and 'following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body' in YM.41.

zh: 又曰官鬼为系（击？）爻，为制爻，
大凡喜之为官，恶之为鬼，
用之阳则官，用之阴则鬼，
yi: 有人说阳是官，阴是鬼；
又说旺是官，衰是鬼；
又说官鬼是「系」爻（原文此处标有存疑字）、是「制」爻。
大凡喜欢它的叫官，厌恶它的叫鬼；
用在阳的一面就是官，用在阴的一面就是鬼：
名称不同而用法相同。
卦里不该没有它，也不宜发动。
en: Some say that yang is the official and yin is the demon;
some say that thriving is the official and weak is the demon;
some say that Pressure is the 'binding' line (a doubtful character is marked here in the original) and the 'controlling' line.
In general what one welcomes is called the official and what one dislikes is called the demon;
used on the yang side it is the official, used on the yin side it is the demon:
the names differ but the use is the same.
The hexagram should not lack it, and it should not move.

zh: 官鬼不必以旺衰阴阳分，但用则为官，
yi: 官鬼不必按旺衰、阴阳来分：只要取它来用就是官，
忌它就是鬼；
然而官也可能凶，鬼也可能吉。
en: Pressure need not be told apart by strength and weakness or by yin and yang: if it is taken for use it is the official,
and if it is feared it is the demon;
yet the official may be ominous, and the demon may be auspicious.

title: 官鬼者事之主、祸之端：出入行藏贵静勿动、兴词构难畏其动而即成；凡防害及身喜其无鬼、求事益己利在有官

rule.yi: 所以官鬼是事情的主，也是祸的起头；出入行藏，贵在静而不动；兴词、构难（打官司、制造灾难），怕它一动就成。大凡防备伤害到自身的，喜欢它没有鬼；求事来对自己有益的，利在有官。要请学的人自己分辨。
rule.en: So Pressure is the master of a matter and also the beginning of calamity; in going out and in, going abroad and hiding, it is valued still and not moving; in bringing a suit or contriving a difficulty, one fears that once it moves the thing is done. In general, in guarding against harm to oneself, it is welcome for there to be no Pressure; in seeking a matter to one's own advantage, the benefit lies in having the official. Let the student distinguish them.

note.yi: 「事之主」是官鬼是事情的主持者（批准、裁定的一方），「祸之端」是灾祸的起头。「出入行藏」是出门、藏身这类行动。「兴词构难」是打官司、制造灾难。书里的意思：凡是想防备伤害的占问（出入、藏身、防讼），官鬼静才好，动了就一触即发；凡是想求事对自己有益的占问（求官、求名、求事），利在有官。「学者辩之」是请学的人自己分辨这两头。这与 YM.102 的『喜之为官、恶之为鬼』是同一个意思：同一个官鬼，要看这件事是要它还是怕它。
note.en: 'Shi zhi zhu' is that Pressure is the one who presides over a matter (the side that approves and decides), and 'huo zhi duan' is the beginning of calamity. 'Chu ru xing cang' is acts such as going out and hiding. 'Xingci gounan' is going to law and contriving a difficulty. The sense of the book: in every divination in which one wants to guard against harm (going out and in, hiding, guarding against a suit), Pressure is good when still, and once it moves the thing is sprung; in every divination in which one wants a matter to one's own advantage (seeking office, a name, a matter), the benefit lies in having the official. 'Xuezhe bian zhi' asks the student to tell the two sides apart himself. This is the same idea as 'what is welcome is called the official, what is disliked the demon' in YM.102: with the same Pressure line, one must see whether in this matter one wants it or fears it.

zh: 故官鬼者，事之主也，祸之端也，
出入行藏，贵乎静而勿动，
兴词构难，畏其动而即成。
盖凡防害及身，喜其无鬼，
yi: 所以官鬼是事情的主，也是祸的起头；
出入行藏，贵在静而不动；
兴词、构难，怕它一动就成。
大凡防备伤害到自身的，喜欢它没有鬼；
求事来对自己有益的，利在有官。
要请学的人自己分辨。
en: So Pressure is the master of a matter and also the beginning of calamity;
in going out and in, going abroad and hiding, it is valued still and not moving;
in bringing a suit or contriving a difficulty, one fears that once it moves the thing is done.
In general, in guarding against harm to oneself, it is welcome for there to be no Pressure;
in seeking a matter to one's own advantage, the benefit lies in having the official.
Let the student distinguish them.

title: 无鬼章·功名无鬼：功名无鬼则进取无成、升迁未遂（此言用鬼，鬼不宜无）

rule.yi: 功名没有官鬼（官鬼不上卦），进取就没有成就，升迁也不能如愿。这是说取官鬼为用的占问，官鬼不宜没有。
rule.en: In seeking a name and office with no Pressure line in the hexagram, advancement comes to nothing and promotion is not achieved. This speaks of divinations in which Pressure is taken as the Subject, and Pressure should not be absent.

note.yi: 「功名无鬼」是占功名时官鬼不上卦（官鬼是功名的用神，见 YM.40）。「进取无成」是想进取没有成就，「升迁未遂」是想升迁不能如愿。书里自注：这是说取鬼（官鬼）为用的占问，鬼不宜没有。「无」要分真无和伏藏：同一章稍前（L550）说，卦中虽然没有、但伏在世爻或动爻之下，或者变出来临在日辰月建之上，就「无犹不无」，所以这里说的是官鬼既不上卦、又没有伏变的真无。同一句里还有身命、家宅、谋望无鬼的断法，分属别的问题域，这里只收功名的一半。和 YM.42 的「毋谓官伏，得助亦升」对着看。
note.en: 'Gongming wu gui' is Pressure being absent from the hexagram when divining about a name and office (Pressure is the Subject of fame and office, see YM.40). 'Jinqu wu cheng' is that advancement comes to nothing, and 'shengqian wei sui' is that promotion is not achieved. The book's own gloss: this speaks of divinations in which Pressure is taken as the Subject, and Pressure should not be absent. 'Absent' must be told apart as truly absent and hidden: slightly earlier in the same chapter (L550) it says that though it is not in the hexagram, if it is hidden under the Self line or a moving line, or if it changes out and sits on the Day or Month branch, then 'absent is as if not absent', so what is meant here is Pressure truly absent, neither in the hexagram nor hidden or changed. The same sentence also has judgments for no Pressure in a person's fate, the household and scheming, which belong to other domains, and only the half about fame and office is taken here. Read against 'do not say Pressure hidden means no promotion: with help it is promoted too' in YM.42.

yi: 功名没有官鬼，
进取就没有成就，
升迁也不能如愿；
en: In seeking a name and office with no Pressure line,
advancement comes to nothing
and promotion is not achieved;

yi: 这是说取官鬼为用的占问，官鬼不宜没有。
en: This speaks of divinations in which Pressure is taken as the Subject, and Pressure should not be absent.

title: 身法·看二身（功名仕宦）：先宜无病，然后以六亲六神星杀详之；功名仕宦喜文书、官鬼、青龙、朱雀、贵人临之，子孙、勾陈为忌

rule.yi: 凡看（卦身、世身）二身，先要没有病，然后用六亲、六神、星煞来详看；功名仕宦，喜欢文书、官鬼、青龙、朱雀、贵人临在身上，而子孙、勾陈是忌。
rule.en: In looking at the two bodies, they should first be free of sickness, and only then are the six relations, the six spirits and the stars examined in detail; for fame and office, it is welcome for Resource, Pressure, the Azure Dragon, the Vermilion Bird and the Noble to rest on the body, and Output and Hook Earth are taboo.

note.yi: 「二身」是卦身（由卦立，又叫月卦）和世身（由世立，看身居哪一爻），见本书身法章（L198 起）。「文书」是父母爻，「贵人」是神煞。这一句在身法章里是分类总说各类占问对身的喜忌：功名仕宦、财利经营、狱讼、忧患四类。事业取的是第一类：功名仕宦喜文书、官鬼、青龙、朱雀、贵人临在身上，忌子孙、勾陈。子孙克官鬼、勾陈主迟滞，所以是忌（按象义推，书里没有说理由）。「先宜无病」是身本身要没有病（空、破、动冲等，见身法章前文）。其余三类（财利、狱讼、忧患）分属求财、官非、风险各域，这里不收。
note.en: The 'two bodies' are the hexagram body (set by the hexagram, also called the month hexagram) and the Self body (set by the Self, by which line the body sits on), see the chapter on the two bodies in this book (from L198). 'Wenshu' is the Resource line, and the 'Noble' is a spirit-star. In the chapter on the two bodies this sentence lists by class what each kind of question welcomes and fears in the body: fame and office, profit and business, lawsuits, and worries. Career takes the first class: for fame and office the Resource line, Pressure, the Azure Dragon, the Vermilion Bird and the Noble resting on the body are welcome, and Output and Hook Earth are feared. Output controls Pressure and Hook Earth governs delay, so they are taboo (inferred from the images, the book gives no reason). 'It should first be free of sickness' is that the body itself should be free of sickness (Void, broken, moving and clashed, and so on, see the earlier part of that chapter). The other three classes (profit, lawsuits, worries) belong to Wealth, Lawsuits and Risk and are not taken here.

zh: 然后以六亲六神星杀详之，
喜文书官鬼青龙朱雀贵人临之，
yi: 凡看二身，
先要没有病，
然后用六亲、六神、星煞来详看；
功名仕宦，
喜欢文书、官鬼、青龙、朱雀、贵人临在身上，
而子孙、勾陈是忌。
en: In looking at the two bodies,
they should first be free of sickness,
and only then are the six relations, the six spirits and the stars examined in detail;
for fame and office,
it is welcome for Resource, Pressure, the Azure Dragon, the Vermilion Bird and the Noble to rest on the body,
and Output and Hook Earth are taboo.

title: 岁君·太岁与仕宦、上疏请封：仕宦则职崇台阁、词讼则事渎宪司；事干朝廷喜太岁生合世爻、忌冲克身象（上疏面圣请封皆喜太岁生合世爻则上合君心、太岁冲身象则忧严谴）

rule.yi: 太岁值福或值鬼的年份：身命有福神持世，一生平安快乐；家宅有鬼会合，岁月多艰难；仕宦，官职高到台阁；词讼，事情惊动宪司。事情关系朝廷，喜太岁生合世爻，忌冲克身象。凡是上疏、面圣、请封等事，都喜太岁生合世爻，就上合君心；太岁冲身象，就担忧受严厉的谴责。
rule.en: When the Tai Sui sits on Output or on Pressure: for a person's fate, with the fortune spirit holding the Self one's whole life is peaceful and happy; for the household, with Pressure joining, the months and years are hard; for an official career, the post rises to the cabinet; for a lawsuit, the matter reaches the censorate. For a matter that concerns the court, it is welcome for the Tai Sui to generate or combine with the Self line, and it is feared for it to clash or control the body image. For memorials to the throne, audience with the sovereign, and asking for conferment of titles, it is always welcome for the Tai Sui to generate or combine with the Self line, which accords above with the sovereign's heart; the Tai Sui clashing the body image is a cause to fear severe censure.

note.yi: 「太岁」是当年的地支（岁君）。这一句接在太岁值福、值鬼之后（「值福」是太岁临在子孙上，「值鬼」是临在官鬼上），分说几类占问受到的影响：「身命福持而生平安乐」是身命占里福神持世、一生平安快乐，「家宅鬼会而岁月迍邅」是家宅占里官鬼会合、岁月多艰难，这两样另属身命、家宅各域；「仕宦则职崇台阁」是官职高到台阁（中枢），「词讼则事渎宪司」是官司惊动了宪司（监察、司法的衙门）。「事干朝廷」是事情关系朝廷，这时要太岁生合世爻、忌太岁冲克身象。书里自注：上疏、面圣、请封这类事，都喜太岁生合世爻，就上合君心；太岁冲身象，就忧严谴。与易林补遗朝天面旨（EL.91–93）、本书上书（YM.57）、黄金策仕宦的月建生身（HJC.07）对着看。
note.en: 'Taisui' is the branch of the current year (the Year Lord). This sentence follows the Tai Sui sitting on Output or on Pressure ('sitting on Output' is the Tai Sui resting on the Output line, 'sitting on Pressure' is resting on the Pressure line), and says how several kinds of divination are affected: 'with the fortune spirit holding the Self one's whole life is peaceful and happy' is Output holding the Self in a divination about a person's fate, one's whole life peaceful and happy, and 'with Pressure joining, the months and years are hard' is Pressure joining in a divination about the household, the months and years hard, these two belonging to the domains of personal fate and the household; 'the post rises to the cabinet' is the office rising to the cabinet (the centre of government), and 'the matter reaches the censorate' is the lawsuit stirring up the censorate (the supervising and judicial offices). 'Shi gan chaoting' is a matter that concerns the court, in which it is welcome for the Tai Sui to generate or combine with the Self line and feared for it to clash or control the body image. The book's own gloss: memorials, audience with the sovereign and asking for titles are all welcome with the Tai Sui generating or combining with the Self, which accords above with the sovereign's heart, and the Tai Sui clashing the body image is a cause to fear severe censure. Read against the Yilin Buyi on the audience at court (EL.91-93), the memorials in this book (YM.57) and the Month generating the body in the Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.07).

zh: 仕宦则职崇台阁，词讼则事渎宪司，
事干朝廷，喜生合世爻，忌冲克身象。
yi: 身命有福神持世，一生平安快乐；
家宅有鬼会合，岁月多艰难；
仕宦，官职高到台阁；词讼，事情惊动宪司。
事情关系朝廷，喜太岁生合世爻，忌冲克身象。
en: for a person's fate, with the fortune spirit holding the Self one's whole life is peaceful and happy;
for the household, with Pressure joining, the months and years are hard;
for an official career, the post rises to the cabinet; for a lawsuit, the matter reaches the censorate.
For a matter that concerns the court, it is welcome for the Tai Sui to generate or combine with the Self line, and it is feared for it to clash or control the body image.

zh: 凡上疏面圣请封等事，皆喜太岁生合世爻，
yi: 凡是上疏、面圣、请封等事，都喜太岁生合世爻，
就上合君心；
太岁冲身象，就担忧受严厉的谴责。
en: For memorials to the throne, audience with the sovereign, and asking for conferment of titles, it is always welcome for the Tai Sui to generate or combine with the Self line,
which accords above with the sovereign's heart;
the Tai Sui clashing the body image is a cause to fear severe censure.

title: 随墓章·各占之害：求官履仕途而不反、出行登平道而遭屯、行人病于他乡、产妇厄于暗室、公役有桎梏之辱、兴造有妨犯之凶、偷关逾险而蹈网罗、出族谋差而受羁绁（随墓统忌，兴造偷逾空破稍可）

rule.yi: （随墓的害处）求官的人走上仕途，就回不来了；出行的人走在平路上却遇到屯难；行人病在他乡，产妇厄在暗室；当差的有枷锁之辱，兴造的有触犯妨碍之凶；偷关越险的陷入罗网，离开宗族谋差使的受羁绊。随墓是通忌；如果是兴造、偷关逾险，空、破还稍微可以。
rule.en: (The harm of following into the tomb:) one who seeks office walks the official road and does not return; one who travels walks on a level road and meets trouble; the traveller falls ill in a strange land, the woman in childbirth is in distress in a dark room; the runner suffers the disgrace of fetters, the builder meets the ill-omen of offence; one who slips past a pass and crosses a danger falls into the net, and one who leaves his clan to seek a post is bound. Following into the tomb is a taboo in all cases; but for building and for slipping past a pass and crossing a danger, Void or broken is somewhat tolerable.

note.yi: 「求官履仕途而不反」按文意是求官的人走上仕途就回不来、陷在里面（「反」读作返回），和后面「出行登平道而遭屯」（走平路遇到难）同是『随墓』的害。「公役有桎梏之辱」是当差的受枷锁之辱，「兴造」是兴建、营造，「妨犯」是触犯禁忌，「偷关逾险」是偷越关隘、翻越险阻，「出族」是离开宗族，「羁绁」是羁绊束缚。「随墓」（世爻或用神随着官鬼入墓）是本书里的大忌（见 YM.41），这一条列出了各类占问里它带来的害，前两样和后一样（求官、公役、谋差）属事业，其余分属出行、疾病、官非等域，这里整句收，以免拆开。书里自注：随墓是通忌；如果是兴造、偷关逾险，空、破还稍微可以。
note.en: 'Qiuguan lü shitu er bu fan' is, by the sense, one who seeks office walking the official road and not being able to come back, caught in it ('fan' is read as return), the same harm of 'following into the tomb' as 'walks on a level road and meets trouble' that follows. 'Gongyi you zhigu zhi ru' is a runner suffering the disgrace of fetters, 'xingzao' is building and construction, 'fangfan' is offending a taboo, 'tou guan yu xian' is slipping past a pass and crossing a danger, 'chu zu' is leaving one's clan, and 'jixie' is being bound by ties. 'Following into the tomb' (the Self line or the Subject following Pressure into the tomb) is a great taboo in this book (see YM.41), and this entry lists the harm it brings in each kind of divination: the first, the fifth and the last (seeking office, runners, seeking a post) belong to Career, and the others belong to Travel, Illness, Lawsuits and other domains; the whole sentence is taken so as not to split it. The book's own gloss: following into the tomb is a taboo in all cases; but for building and for slipping past a pass and crossing a danger, Void or broken is somewhat tolerable.

zh: 求官履仕途而不反，出行登平道而遭屯，
行人病于他乡，产妇厄于暗室，
公役有桎梏之辱，兴造有妨犯之凶，
偷关逾险而蹈网罗，出族谋差而受羁绁。
yi: 求官的人走上仕途，就回不来了；出行的人走在平路上却遇到屯难；
行人病在他乡，产妇厄在暗室；
当差的有枷锁之辱，兴造的有触犯妨碍之凶；
偷关越险的陷入罗网，离开宗族谋差使的受羁绊。
en: one who seeks office walks the official road and does not return; one who travels walks on a level road and meets trouble;
the traveller falls ill in a strange land, the woman in childbirth is in distress in a dark room;
the runner suffers the disgrace of fetters, the builder meets the ill-omen of offence;
one who slips past a pass and crosses a danger falls into the net, and one who leaves his clan to seek a post is bound.

yi: 随墓是通忌；
如果是兴造、偷关逾险，空、破还稍微可以。
en: Following into the tomb is a taboo in all cases;
but for building and for slipping past a pass and crossing a danger, Void or broken is somewhat tolerable.

title: 诸星·天马：天马即乾马、正月午始循环行之，此星惟利升迁之卜（正月用乾四爻、二月五爻申；正七午、二八申、三九戌、四十子、五十一寅、六十二辰）

rule.yi: 天马，就是乾马，正月起在午，循环着走；这颗星只利于升迁的占问。正月用乾卦四爻为天马，二月用五爻（申），依次循环使用。口诀说：正月、七月在午，二月、八月在申，三月、九月在戌，四月、十月在子，五月、十一月在寅，六月、十二月在辰。
rule.en: The Heavenly Horse is the horse of Qian; it starts at Wu in the first month and goes round in turn; this star is of benefit only in divinations about promotion. In the first month the fourth line of Qian is taken as the Heavenly Horse, in the second month the fifth line, Shen, and so on in turn. The formula says: first and seventh months at Wu, second and eighth at Shen, third and ninth at Xu, fourth and tenth at Zi, fifth and eleventh at Yin, sixth and twelfth at Chen.

note.yi: 「天马」是神煞，「即乾马」是乾卦象马（乾为马）。「正月午始，循环行之」是从正月起在午，以后逐月循环。书里自注给了推法：正月用乾卦四爻（壬午）为天马，二月用五爻（壬申），以后循环；口诀的意思是正月、七月在午，二月、八月在申，三月、九月在戌，四月、十月在子，五月、十一月在寅，六月、十二月在辰（每两个月一组，相差两位）。「惟利升迁之卜」是这颗星只对升迁有利。驿马是另一颗星（主行人、出行），和天马不同（原文在这句之后紧接着讲驿马）。这里只收天马和它的推法。注文里接下去还有「天马文人用上，丧病者嗔」等句，是天马在文人、丧病中的用法，不属事业，没有收。
note.en: 'Tianma' is a spirit-star, and 'ji Qian ma' is that the Qian trigram has the horse as its image (Qian is the horse). 'Starts at Wu in the first month and goes round in turn' is that from the first month it stands at Wu and then goes round month by month. The book's own note gives the way to find it: in the first month the fourth line of Qian (Ren-Wu) is taken as the Heavenly Horse, in the second month the fifth line (Ren-Shen), and so on in turn; the formula means first and seventh months at Wu, second and eighth at Shen, third and ninth at Xu, fourth and tenth at Zi, fifth and eleventh at Yin, sixth and twelfth at Chen (each group of two months, two places apart). 'Of benefit only in divinations about promotion' is that this star is favourable only to promotion. The Post Horse is another star (governing travellers and travelling) and differs from the Heavenly Horse (the original goes on to speak of the Post Horse right after this sentence). Only the Heavenly Horse and the way to find it are taken here. The note goes on with 'the Heavenly Horse is used above by literary men, and those in mourning or ill are angry' and so on, which are uses of the Heavenly Horse for literary men and for mourning and illness, not Career, and are not taken.

yi: 天马，就是乾马，
正月起在午，循环着走；
这颗星只利于升迁的占问。
en: The Heavenly Horse is the horse of Qian;
it starts at Wu in the first month and goes round in turn;
this star is of benefit only in divinations about promotion.

zh: 正月用乾四爻为天马，二月五爻申，循环用之。
正七还骑马，二八向猴申，
三九须从犬，四十鼠相侵，
五十一当寅上，六十二定归辰。
yi: 正月用乾卦四爻为天马，二月用五爻（申），依次循环使用。
口诀说：
正月、七月还骑马（午），二月、八月向猴（申），
三月、九月须从狗（戌），四月、十月鼠（子）相侵，
五月、十一月当在寅上，六月、十二月定归辰。
en: In the first month the fourth line of Qian is taken as the Heavenly Horse, in the second month the fifth line, Shen, and so on in turn.
The formula says:
first and seventh months, back on the horse (Wu); second and eighth, toward the monkey (Shen);
third and ninth, follow the dog (Xu); fourth and tenth, the rat (Zi) intrudes;
fifth and eleventh, it falls on Yin; sixth and twelfth, it settles at Chen.

title: 出行求事于升迁：出行而筮求事者亦察用爻——求事于升迁则考诸官鬼而毋世空（科第考文书、寻访考用爻、货利考财象，盖专于事而不专于出行）

rule.yi: 于是占出去求事的，也察看用爻：求事于科第，就考察文书；求事于升迁，就考察官鬼，而不要世空；求事于寻访，考察用爻；求事于货利，考察财象；这是专就事来占，而不专就出行来占。
rule.en: So in divining about going out to seek something, one also examines the Subject line: for seeking something in the examinations, one examines the document line; for seeking something in promotion, one examines Pressure, and the Self must not be Void; for seeking something by searching and visiting, one examines the Subject line; for seeking something in goods and profit, one examines the Wealth image; this goes by the matter and not by the travelling.

note.yi: 「求事」是出门去求一件事。「文书」是父母爻，「财象」是财爻。这一句里四种事分属四个域：科第归考试，升迁归事业，寻访（找人、找物）归失物或行人，货利归求财；这里整句收，以免拆开，而升迁一条是事业的：出门求升迁，要看官鬼，不要世空，与 YM.42 的「专考官爻」「世空则占不遂」一致。「盖耑于事而不耑于出行也」（「耑」同「专」）是说这类占问要按所求的那件事取用爻，不按出行取。与出行章后面的求事各节对着看。
note.en: 'Qiushi' is going out to seek a matter. 'Wenshu' is the document line (the Resource line), and the 'Wealth image' is the Wealth line. The four matters in this sentence belong to four domains: the examinations to Examinations, promotion to Career, searching and visiting (looking for a person or a thing) to Lost Things or Travellers, and goods and profit to Wealth; the whole sentence is taken here so as not to split it, and the promotion clause is the one that belongs to Career: going out to seek promotion, one looks at Pressure and the Self must not be Void, which agrees with 'look only at the Pressure line' and 'with the Self Void the divination does not come to pass' in YM.42. 'Gai zhuan yu shi er bu zhuan yu chuxing ye' ('zhuan' here is the same as the usual 'zhuan') says that such divinations take the line by the matter sought and not by the travelling. Read against the later sections on seeking matters in the chapter on travelling.

zh: 于是而筮求事者，亦察用爻，
求事于科第，则考诸文书；
求事于升迁，则考诸官鬼，而毋世空也；
盖耑于事而不耑于出行也。
yi: 于是占出去求事的，也察看用爻：
求事于科第，就考察文书；
求事于升迁，就考察官鬼，而不要世空；
求事于寻访，考察用爻；
求事于货利，考察财象，
这是专就事来占，而不专就出行来占。
en: So in divining about going out to seek something, one also examines the Subject line:
for seeking something in the examinations, one examines the document line;
for seeking something in promotion, one examines Pressure, and the Self must not be Void;
for seeking something by searching and visiting, one examines the Subject line;
for seeking something in goods and profit, one examines the Wealth image;
this goes by the matter and not by the travelling.

title: 治筑·官吏奉差治河：大官奉敕、小官奉命、吏民奉差，官爻不可病并冲克世位；官吏因河工而筮利钝反以官为重——官旺世实则纪录升荐、官伤世空及随墓助伤则罪戾降责

rule.yi: 如果是大官奉敕命、小官奉上司之命、吏民奉派出差，官爻不可有病，并且不可冲克世位。如果是官吏因河工（治河工程）占利不利，就反过来以官为重：官旺、世实，就被记功、升荐；官伤、世空，以及随墓、助伤，就有罪过、降责。
rule.en: If a great official acts on an imperial edict, a lesser official on an order, or clerks and commoners on an assignment, the Pressure line must not be sick, nor clash with or control the Self's place. If an official or clerk asks about gain or loss in connection with river works, then on the contrary Pressure counts for most: with Pressure thriving and the Self solid, he is recorded for merit and recommended for promotion; with Pressure injured and the Self Void, and following into the tomb and helping the injury, there is guilt and demotion.

note.yi: 「治筑」是治河筑堤一类的工程，「河工」是治河工程。治筑章前面讲的是堤岸能不能修成（用父母为用，不属事业域）；这几句讲的是被派去办这件事的人：大官奉勅、小官奉命、吏民奉差，官爻不可病、不可冲克世；官吏因河工占利钝（得失），这时反过来以官爻为重——官旺世实则被记功、升荐，官伤、世空、随墓助伤则获罪降责。「奉勅」是奉皇帝的敕命，「奉差」是奉派差使。「纪录」是记功。「罪戾」是罪过。与易林补遗谋差顶役（EL.106–108）、黄金策仕宦的巡察四方（HJC.23）对着看。
note.en: 'Zhizhu' is works such as managing a river and building embankments, and 'hegong' is river works. The earlier part of the chapter on building and repair speaks of whether the embankments can be completed (taking Resource as the Subject, which is not Career); these sentences speak of the people sent to carry it out: a great official on an imperial edict, a lesser one on an order, clerks and commoners on an assignment, for whom the Pressure line must not be sick and must not clash with or control the Self; and for an official or clerk asking about gain and loss in connection with river works, Pressure then counts for most the other way round: with Pressure thriving and the Self solid he is recorded for merit and recommended, and with Pressure injured, the Self Void, and following into the tomb and helping the injury he is found guilty and demoted. 'Fengchi' is acting on an imperial edict, and 'fengchai' is acting on an assignment. 'Jilu' is recording merit. 'Zuili' is guilt. Read against the Yilin Buyi on seeking a commission and taking a place (EL.106-108) and the Huangjin Ce on touring and inspecting the regions (HJC.23).

zh: 若大官奉勅、小官奉命、吏民奉差，
yi: 如果是大官奉敕命、小官奉上司之命、吏民奉派出差，
官爻不可有病，
并且不可冲克世位。
en: If a great official acts on an imperial edict, a lesser official on an order, or clerks and commoners on an assignment,
the Pressure line must not be sick,
nor clash with or control the Self's place.

zh: 若官吏因河工而筮利钝，则反以官为重，
官伤世空，及随墓助伤，则罪戾降责。
yi: 如果是官吏因河工占利不利，就反过来以官为重：
官旺、世实，就被记功、升荐；
官伤、世空，以及随墓、助伤，就有罪过、降责。
en: If an official or clerk asks about gain or loss in connection with river works, then on the contrary Pressure counts for most:
with Pressure thriving and the Self solid, he is recorded for merit and recommended for promotion;
with Pressure injured and the Self Void, and following into the tomb and helping the injury, there is guilt and demotion.

title: 治筑·民夫苦役：民夫苦役筮吉凶以官为忌——旺动克世则劳苦无期、命墓助伤则忧虞不测；忧妨犯及苦徭役者皆以鬼为忌象、旺动克世及随助而凶

rule.yi: 如果是民夫服苦役占吉凶，就以官为忌：官旺动克世，劳苦没有尽头；命墓、助伤，忧虑难测。如果担忧触犯妨碍，以及受苦于徭役的，都以鬼为忌象：旺动克世，以及随墓助伤，就凶。
rule.en: If a labourer in hard service divines about good and ill, Pressure is the taboo: Pressure thriving, moving and controlling the Self, the toil has no end; the life in the tomb and helping the injury, there is fear of the unforeseen. If one worries about offending and obstruction, and for those who suffer under labour service, Pressure is the taboo image in all cases: thriving, moving and controlling the Self, and following into the tomb and helping the injury, are ominous.

note.yi: 「民夫苦役」是被征去服苦役的民夫。「旺动克世」是官鬼旺相、发动、克世；「劳苦无期」是辛苦没有尽头；「命墓助伤」是世爻（命）入墓、并助官鬼伤世；「忧虞不测」是忧虑难以预料的祸事。「忧妨犯」是担忧触犯禁忌或遭妨碍，「徭役」是官府摊派的劳役。这两处都是以官鬼为忌：受役的人希望官鬼静、弱、不克世（与 YM.80 的问役轻重、YM.84 的『役而免害恶鬼旺』同一个意思）。同一章里的修塘修坪、治水兴营等工程则以父为用爻，不属事业域，没有收。
note.en: 'Minfu kuyi' is the labourers conscripted for hard service. 'Thriving, moving and controlling the Self' is Pressure thriving, moving and controlling the Self; 'toil without end' is hardship that does not end; 'the life in the tomb and helping the injury' is the Self line (the life) entering the tomb and also helping Pressure to injure the Self; 'fear of the unforeseen' is anxiety about a calamity that cannot be foreseen. 'Worrying about offending and obstruction' is worrying about offending a taboo or meeting obstruction, and 'yaoyi' is labour service assigned by the government. In both places Pressure is the taboo: one who serves hopes Pressure will be still, weak and not controlling the Self (the same idea as asking how heavy the duty is in YM.80 and 'for one who serves a duty to escape harm, Pressure thriving is hated' in YM.84). The works in the same chapter, such as repairing ponds and embankments, controlling water and building fortifications, take the father line as the Subject, are not Career, and are not taken.

zh: 若民夫苦役而筮吉凶，则以官为忌，
yi: 如果是民夫服苦役占吉凶，就以官为忌：
官旺动克世，劳苦没有尽头；
命墓、助伤，忧虑难测。
en: If a labourer in hard service divines about good and ill, Pressure is the taboo:
Pressure thriving, moving and controlling the Self, the toil has no end;
the life in the tomb and helping the injury, there is fear of the unforeseen.

yi: 如果担忧触犯妨碍，以及受苦于徭役的，
都以鬼为忌象：
旺动克世，以及随墓助伤，就凶。
en: If one worries about offending and obstruction, and for those who suffer under labour service,
Pressure is the taboo image in all cases:
thriving, moving and controlling the Self, and following into the tomb and helping the injury, are ominous.

title: 治筑·差委雇工：凡筮差委雇工皆以应为用，应旺实则有成、克世则无良、六冲则难成

rule.yi: 凡是占差委、雇工，都以应为用：应旺实，就有成；克世，就不良善；六冲，就难成。
rule.en: In all divinations about commissioned workmen and hired labour, the Other is the Subject: with the Other thriving and solid it comes off; controlling the Self, it is not good; a six-clash, it is hard to accomplish.

note.yi: 「差委」是被官府差遣、委派的人工，「雇工」是出钱雇来的工。以应为用，是因为这两种都是『别人替我（或替官府）做事』，做事的人是对方。「应旺实」是应爻旺相又不空，「克世则无良」是应克世就不是良善。「六冲」按本书的说法是冲散、不成。这一条和本卷收雇章的雇倩人工（YM.72）是同一个断法：雇工以应为用神，应破绝、空散、三冲、克世都不成。
note.en: 'Chaiwei' is workmen dispatched and commissioned by the government, and 'gugong' is labour hired for pay. The Other is taken as the Subject because in both cases it is 'another person doing the work for me (or for the government)', and the one who does it is the other side. 'The Other thriving and solid' is the Other line thriving and not Void, and 'controlling the Self, it is not good' is the Other controlling the Self and not being good. A 'six-clash', in the book's sense, is scattering and failure. This entry is the same judgment as hiring labour in the chapter on taking on and hiring in this book (YM.72): hired labour takes the Other as the Subject, and the Other broken or extinct, Void or scattered, the three clashes and controlling the Self all do not come off.

zh: 凡筮差委雇工，皆以应为用，
应旺实则有成，克世则无良，六冲则难成也。
yi: 凡是占差委、雇工，都以应为用：
应旺实，就有成；克世，就不良善；六冲，就难成。
en: In all divinations about commissioned workmen and hired labour, the Other is the Subject:
with the Other thriving and solid it comes off; controlling the Self, it is not good; a six-clash, it is hard to accomplish.

title: 官禄占总述（游南子）：未仕占何官、何月选、何日领凭、任所何方；既仕占赴任吉凶、在任休咎、何日升除、何时替代；官之贫廉、失职、补任、丁制、起复为附占

rule.yi: 官禄占分两种情形：还没做官的，占将做什么官、哪个月选官、哪天领到凭证、任所在哪个方向；已经做官的，占赴任的吉凶、在任上的顺逆、哪天升迁任命、什么时候被人替代。至于做官是贫还是廉，以及失去职位、补缺任职、遭父母之丧、起复，是官禄占附带的占问。
rule.en: The divination of office and salary has two cases. For one not yet in office: what office he will take, in which month he will be selected, on what day he will receive his credentials, and in which direction the post lies. For one already in office: the good or ill of his journey to the post, how his term goes, on what day he will be promoted or appointed, and when he will be replaced. Whether an official is poor or incorruptible, and losing a post, being given a post to fill, mourning for a parent and being recalled to office, are subsidiary questions of this divination.

note.yi: 「丁制」就是丁忧，遭父母之丧；「起复」是服丧或革职之后重新起用。本章后面的小节正是按这个提纲排的：何官、候选、领凭、任所、赴任、在任、升迁、替代、贪廉、官职退复、丁忧起复。
note.en: 'Dingzhi' is Dingyou, mourning for a parent's death, and 'qifu' is being called back to office after mourning or dismissal. The sections of this chapter follow just this outline: what office, awaiting selection, collecting credentials, the post, going to the post, in office, promotion, replacement, greed and integrity, loss and recovery of office, mourning and recall.

zh: 游南子曰官禄之占，其未仕也。
占其仕为何官，选在何月，领凭于何日，任所在何方也，其既仕也。
占其赴任之吉凶，在任之休咎，升除于何日，替代于何时也。
若乃为官之贫廉，与夫为官而失职，而补任，而丁制，而起复，亦官禄之附占也。
yi: 游南子说：官禄的占问，先说还没有做官的时候。
占他将做什么官，选官在哪个月，哪一天领到凭证，任所在哪个方向；再说已经做了官的时候。
占他赴任的吉凶，在任上的顺逆，哪一天升迁任命，什么时候被人替代。
至于做官是贫是廉，以及做官而失去职位、补缺任职、遭父母之丧（丁制）、起复，也是官禄的附带占问。
en: Master Younan says: on the divination of office and salary, first the case where one is not yet in office.
divine what office he will hold, in which month he will be selected, on what day he will receive his credentials, and in which direction the post lies; then the case where he is already in office.
divine the good or ill of his journey to the post, the fortunes of his term, on what day he will be promoted or appointed, and when he will be replaced.

As for whether an official is poor or incorruptible, and losing a post, being given a post to fill, mourning for a parent and being recalled to office, these too are subsidiary questions of office and salary.

title: 官禄占·鬼谷分爻：执政、朝仕、监司、长官、曹官、吏人，看所占是何官职，就在对应的爻上取用、断吉凶

rule.yi: 断官职用鬼谷分爻：六爻各配一类官，依次是执政、朝仕、监司、长官、曹官、吏人；看所占的是哪一类官，就在对应的那一爻上取用，来断吉凶。
rule.en: To judge an office use Guigu's division of the lines: the six lines are matched with six kinds of official, in order the ruling minister, the court official, the supervising commissioner, the head of an office, the departmental officer and the clerk; see which kind of official is being asked about, take the matching line, and judge good or ill from it.

note.yi: 表里六个名目没有写各是哪一爻；按这部书别处的鬼谷分爻表（如疾病占、贸易占）都是从上爻写到初爻，这里也照从上到下读，即上爻执政、五爻朝仕、四爻监司、三爻长官、二爻曹官、初爻吏人。这是读法，不是书里明写的。
note.en: The table does not say which line each of the six names belongs to. The other Guigu tables of this book (for illness and for trade) are written from the top line down to the first, and this one is read the same way: the top line the ruling minister, the fifth the court official, the fourth the supervising commissioner, the third the head of an office, the second the departmental officer and the first the clerk. This is a way of reading it and not something the book states.

zh: 执政朝仕监司长官曹官吏人
但看所占是何官职，各于分爻取用，断其吉凶也。
yi: 鬼谷分爻（表）：
执政、朝仕（朝官）、监司、长官、曹官、吏人。
只看所占的是什么官职，就在对应的爻上取用，来断吉凶。
en: Guigu's division of the lines (table):
the ruling minister, the court official, the supervising commissioner, the head of an office, the departmental officer, the clerk.
Just see what office is being asked about, take the matching line for it, and judge good or ill from that.

title: 官禄占·何官（一）：四直贵马聚身世更德合相扶在官印阳爻者宰辅，加刑刃大杀出将入相；太岁五爻生合世身朝仕，冲克外任；内卦动外任外卦动朝仕；阳宫阳爻文职阴宫阴爻武弁；世持岁破朝仕六部、外任布按都司；持月建巡方安抚，持日建郡邑之宰

rule.yi: 断是什么官：四直、贵人、驿马聚在身爻、世爻上，又有德神、合神相扶，落在官星、印星的阳爻上，必是宰相之位；再加刑、刃、大杀，是出将入相；再加太岁或五爻生合，必荣获赐宴。太岁与五爻生合世身，是在朝为官；冲克世身，是外任；世爻、官爻在内卦发动是外任，在外卦发动是朝官（五爻是君位，四爻六爻都挨近君位）。官星、贵人持世，在阳宫阳爻的是文职，在阴宫阴爻的是武官。世爻持岁破，在朝是六部等大衙门，外任是布政司、按察司、都司；持月建，是巡方、安抚、行人这类；持日建，是郡县的长官。
rule.en: To tell what office it is: if the four rulers, the Noble and the Horse gather on the Body and Self lines, and Virtue and combination also support them, and they sit on a yang line of the star of office and seal, it is surely the post of chief minister; with the punishing blade and great baleful spirits added, one goes out as a general and comes in as chancellor; with Tai Sui or the fifth line generating or combining, he is surely honoured with a gift of banquet. If Tai Sui and the fifth line generate or combine with the Self and Body, it is an official at court; if they clash with or control the Self and Body, a post outside; if the Self or the Pressure line moves in the inner trigram it is a post outside, and in the outer trigram a court official (the fifth is the ruler's seat, and the fourth and sixth are both near the ruler). If the star of office and the Noble hold the Self in a yang palace and on a yang line it is a civil post, and in a yin palace and on a yin line a military officer. If the Self holds the Year-break, at court it is in the great offices such as the Six Ministries, and outside it is in the provincial administration, judicial or military commissions; holding the Month it is an inspecting commissioner, a pacification commissioner or an envoy; holding the Day it is the head of a prefecture or county.

note.yi: 几处文字可疑，译文只按字面意思译：「后荫前卦也」文意不通；「六部通都在大也」应是指六部和通政、都察、大理这样的大衙门，译文只写成「六部和其他大衙门」；「风岁破取重臣」里的「风」字像是衍字。「阿衡」是商代伊尹的官名，后来指宰相；「鼎昧」应是「鼎鼐」（调和羹汤的鼎），比喻宰相调和国政。「布按都司」是明代省一级的布政使司、按察使司和都指挥使司。
note.en: Several places are doubtful and are translated only by the letter: 'the later shades the earlier hexagram' makes no sense; 'Six Ministries, Tong, Du, in the great' presumably points to the Six Ministries and great offices such as the Office of Transmission, the Censorate and the Court of Judicial Review, but is rendered only as 'the Six Ministries and the other great offices'; the character 'wind' in 'wind Year-break takes' looks superfluous. 'Aheng' is the title of Yi Yin of the Shang, later used for the chief minister, and 'dingmei' is presumably 'dingnai', the cauldron for blending broth, an image for the chancellor harmonizing the government. 'Bu-an-dusi' are the provincial administration, surveillance and military commissions of the Ming.

zh: 凡四直贵马聚于身世爻，更德合相扶，在官印阳爻者，必职在阿衡助和鼎昧也。
加刑刃大杀者，出将入相也。
加太岁或五爻生合之者，必荣膺燕赐，后荫前卦也。
又太岁与五爻生合世身者，朝仕也。
世爻官爻在内卦动者，外任也。
官贵持世，在阳宫阳爻者，文职。
世持岁破者朝仕，则六部通都在大也。
(太岁为天子，风岁破取重臣遥对天子之象)。
世持月建者，巡方安抚行人也。
世持日建者，郡邑之宰也。
yi: 凡是四直、贵人、驿马聚在身爻、世爻上，又有德神、合神相扶，落在官星、印星的阳爻上的，官职必定是宰相之位，辅佐调和鼎鼐。
再加刑、刃、大杀的，是出将入相。
再加太岁或五爻来生合它的，必定荣耀地得到赐宴，后来的荫庇前面的卦。
又，太岁与五爻生合世身的，是在朝为官。
冲克世身的，是外任。
世爻、官爻在内卦发动的，是外任。
在外卦发动的，是在朝为官。
（五爻是君位，四爻、六爻都挨近君位。）
官星、贵人持世，在阳宫阳爻的，是文职。
在阴宫阴爻的，是武官。
世爻持岁破的，在朝为官，就是六部和其他京城的大衙门。
外任就是布政使司、按察使司、都指挥使司。
（太岁是天子，岁破取的是重臣远远对着天子的象。）
世爻持月建的，是巡方、安抚、行人这类官。
（取四季循环巡行的象。）
世爻持日建的，是郡县的长官。
（取早晚庇护百姓的象。）
en: Whenever the four rulers, the Noble and the Horse gather on the Body and Self lines, and Virtue and combination also support them, and they sit on a yang line of the star of office and seal, the post is surely that of chief minister, helping to blend the broth in the cauldron.
If the punishing blade and great baleful spirits are added, one goes out as a general and comes in as chancellor.
If Tai Sui or the fifth line is added to generate or combine with it, he is surely honoured with a gift of banquet, and the later shades the earlier hexagram.
Again, if Tai Sui and the fifth line generate or combine with the Self and Body, it is an official at court.
If they clash with or control the Self and Body, it is a post outside.
If the Self or the Pressure line moves in the inner trigram, it is a post outside.
If it moves in the outer trigram, it is an official at court.
(The fifth is the ruler's seat, and the fourth and sixth are both near the ruler.)
If the star of office and the Noble hold the Self in a yang palace and on a yang line, it is a civil post.
In a yin palace and on a yin line, it is a military officer.
If the Self holds the Year-break, an official at court, it is in the Six Ministries and the other great offices of the capital.
A post outside is in the provincial administration, judicial or military commissions.
(Tai Sui is the Son of Heaven, and the Year-break takes the image of a great minister facing the Son of Heaven from afar.)
If the Self holds the Month, it is an inspecting commissioner, a pacification commissioner or an envoy.
(It takes the image of the four seasons going round in a cycle.)
If the Self holds the Day, it is the head of a prefecture or county.
(It takes the image of sheltering the people morning and evening.)

title: 官禄占·何官（二）：世持官贵禄马又得岁月文书生合是威权风宪之职；世持官印旺相而旁爻带贵人禄马来扶者只是正官不风宪

rule.yi: 世爻持官星、贵人、禄、驿马，又得太岁、月建、文书来生合，是有威权的监察之职（风宪）；世爻持官星、印星而旺相，但是靠旁边的爻带着贵人、禄、驿马来扶助的，只是正官，不是风宪。
rule.en: If the Self holds the star of office, the Noble, Emolument and the Horse, and Tai Sui, the Month and the document also generate or combine with it, it is a post of authority in the censorate; if the Self holds the star of office and seal and is thriving, but it is a side line carrying the Noble, Emolument and the Horse that supports it, he is only a regular official and not in the censorate.

zh: 世持官贵禄马，又得岁月文书来生合，威权风宪之职也。
世持官印旺相，而旁爻带贵人禄马来扶者，但为正官，而不风宪也。
yi: 世爻持官星、贵人、禄、驿马，又得太岁、月建、文书来生合，是有威权的风宪（监察）之职。
世爻持官星、印星而旺相，但是旁边的爻带着贵人、禄、驿马来扶助的，只是正官，不是风宪。
en: If the Self holds the star of office, the Noble, Emolument and the Horse, and is also generated or combined by Tai Sui, the Month and the document, it is a post of authority in the censorate.

If the Self holds the star of office and seal and is thriving, but it is a side line carrying the Noble, Emolument and the Horse that supports it, he is only a regular official and not in the censorate.

title: 官禄占·何官（三）：世持官贵禄马不空刑克破，按所在爻的五行定部门——金：司马司寇大理(旺)、尚宝武选车驾职方武库(衰)、外任总制抚按总兵；木：司空(旺)营缮虞衡(衰)、外任关津主税；水：家宰(旺)文选稽勋验封都水(衰)、外任盐漕河道；火：宗伯翰林(旺)中书(衰)、加雀科道、午爻司马、外任文昌驿马月建督学；上爻：司农京兆巡城仓院、外任方伯屯田

rule.yi: 世爻持官星、贵人、禄、驿马，不落空、不被刑克破，再按它所在爻的五行定部门：金爻旺相，京官是兵部尚书、刑部尚书、大理寺和都察院中丞，衰弱的是尚宝司和兵部的武选、车驾、职方、武库各司郎官，武职是五军都督府和锦衣卫，外任旺相的是总制、巡抚、按察、观察、总兵，衰弱的是恤刑、司理、参将游击、把总；木爻旺相，京官是工部尚书，衰弱的是营缮司、虞衡司，外任旺相的是关津主税，衰弱的是税课、茶水之职；水爻旺相，京官是吏部尚书，衰弱的是文选、稽勋、验封、都水各司郎官，外任旺相的是盐政、漕运、河道、操江，衰弱的是水利、盐运、粮运之职；火爻旺相，京官是礼部尚书、詹事府、学士、国子监祭酒司业、太常寺、翰林这类官，衰弱的是中书，旺相又加朱雀的是科道官，衰弱的是鸿胪寺，在午爻上的旺相是兵部尚书、衰弱的是苑马寺，外任带文昌、驿马、又加月建的，不是主考官，必是督学官，衰弱的是学官和炉冶坑场之职；上爻旺相，京官是户部、京兆尹、巡城御史、仓场院，加青龙德神的是光禄寺，外任旺相的是布政使、屯田督运督粮，衰弱的是知府、知县和开矿、采石、垦荒的差使。
rule.en: When the Self holds the star of office, the Noble, Emolument and the Horse, and is not Void, punished, controlled or broken, the department is fixed by the element of the line it sits on. On a Metal line, thriving: a capital official is the Minister of War, the Minister of Justice, or the head of the Court of Judicial Review or a vice censor-in-chief; weak: the Seal Office and the directors of the bureaus of the Ministry of War, and for the military the Five Commissions and the Embroidered-Uniform Guard; serving outside, thriving: a governor-general, governor, judicial commissioner, intendant or regional commander; weak: a commissioner for mercy in punishments, a judicial clerk, a deputy or flying column commander, a company captain. On a Wood line, thriving: the Minister of Works; weak: the Yingshan and Yuheng bureaus; outside, thriving: a customs and tax master; weak: a post for taxes and the tea and water duties. On a Water line, thriving: the Minister of Personnel; weak: the directors of the Wenxuan, Jixun, Yanfeng and Dushui bureaus; outside, thriving: salt, grain transport, river works or the river patrol; weak: a post for water conservancy, salt transport or grain transport. On a Fire line, thriving: the Minister of Rites, the Supervisorate of the Heir, a scholar, the Imperial Academy, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices or the Hanlin Academy; weak: a secretary of the Secretariat; thriving with the Vermilion Bird added: a supervising secretary or censor; weak: the Court of State Ceremonial; on the Wu line, thriving: the Minister of War, weak: the Pasturage Court; outside, carrying the Wenchang star, the Post Horse and the Month: not an examiner but surely an education commissioner; weak: a school instructor or a post in the furnaces, smelting works and mines. On the top line, thriving: a capital official is the Minister of Revenue, the governor of the capital prefecture, the city-patrol censor or the granary office, and with the Dragon and Virtue added, the Court of Banqueting; outside, thriving: a provincial administration commissioner or an officer of military farms, transport and grain; weak: a prefect, a county magistrate, or an envoy to open mines, quarry stone or clear land.

note.yi: 这一条的官名都是明代的官署和职务，书里没有解释，译文按通行的叫法对译，个别地方不一定准：「大理中丞」应是大理寺和都察院的长官；「尚宝乡武选车驾职方武库郎」里的「乡」像是衍字；「五府衣使」按文意译作五军都督府和锦衣卫；「家宰」按文意是吏部尚书（冢宰）。「文昌」是一颗主文运的星煞。「午爻」指地支为午的那一爻。
note.en: The titles in this entry are Ming offices and posts that the book does not explain, and the translation renders them by the usual names; a few may not be exact: 'Dali zhongcheng' is presumably the heads of the Court of Judicial Review and the Censorate; the character 'xiang' in the string of bureau names looks superfluous; 'wufu yishi' is rendered by sense as the Five Commissions and the Embroidered-Uniform Guard; 'jiazai' is by sense the Minister of Personnel (the chief steward). 'Wenchang' is a spirit-star of literary fortune, and 'the Wu line' means the line whose branch is Wu.

zh: 又世持官贵禄马，不空刑克破者，其在金爻旺相，京官则司马司寇大理中丞也。
衰则尚宝乡武选车驾职方武库郎也，武则五府衣使也。
在外任者，旺则总制抚按，观察，总兵也，衰则恤刑司理，参游，把总也。
木爻旺相京官则司空，衰则营缮，虞衡司也，在外任者，旺则关津主税，衰亦税课茶水之职也。
水爻旺相京官则家宰也。
衰则文选稽勋封验都水郎也。
在外任者，旺则盐漕河道操江也。
衰则水利盐运粮运之职也。
火爻旺相京官则宗伯宫詹学士司成司业太常翰林之官也，衰则中书也。
在午爻者，旺则司马，衰亦苑马也。
在外任者，带文昌驿马加月建者，非典试之官，必督学之官也。
衰则文学炉冶坑场之职也。
上爻旺相，京官则司农京兆巡城仓院也，加龙德则光禄也。
在外任者，旺则方伯，屯田督运督粮也。
衰则郡守邑宰开矿取石垦辟之使也。
yi: 又，世爻持官星、贵人、禄、驿马，不落空、不被刑克破的，如果在金爻上而旺相，京官就是兵部、刑部尚书和大理寺、都察院的中丞这类。
衰弱的，是尚宝司和兵部武选、车驾、职方、武库各司的郎官，武职就是五军都督府和锦衣卫这类。
在外任职的，旺相的是总制、巡抚、按察使、观察、总兵，衰弱的是恤刑、司理、参将游击、把总。
木爻旺相的，京官是工部尚书；衰弱的是营缮司、虞衡司；在外任职的，旺相的是关津主税，衰弱的也是税课、茶水这类职务。
水爻旺相的，京官是吏部尚书。
（取其选拔衡量像水一样公平的意思。）
衰弱的是文选、稽勋、验封、都水各司的郎官。
在外任职的，旺相的是盐政、漕运、河道、操江。
衰弱的是水利、盐运、粮运这类职务。
火爻旺相的，京官是礼部尚书、詹事府、学士、国子监祭酒司业、太常寺、翰林这类官；衰弱的是中书。
旺相又加朱雀的，是科道官。
衰弱的是鸿胪寺。
在午爻上的，旺相的是兵部尚书，衰弱的也是苑马寺。
在外任职的，带文昌、驿马、又加月建的，不是主持考试的官，一定是督学官。
衰弱的是学官和炉冶、坑场这类职务。
上爻旺相的，京官是户部、京兆尹、巡城御史、仓场院这类，加青龙、德神的是光禄寺。
在外任职的，旺相的是布政使、屯田、督运、督粮。
衰弱的是知府、知县，或开矿、采石、垦荒的差使。
en: Again, if the Self holds the star of office, the Noble, Emolument and the Horse, and is not Void, punished, controlled or broken, and it sits on a Metal line and is thriving, a capital official is the Minister of War, the Minister of Justice, or the head of the Court of Judicial Review or a vice censor-in-chief.
If weak, it is the Seal Office and the directors of the Wuxuan, Chejia, Zhifang and Wuku bureaus of the Ministry of War, and for the military the Five Commissions and the Embroidered-Uniform Guard.

Serving outside, thriving, he is a governor-general, governor, judicial commissioner, intendant or regional commander; weak, a commissioner for mercy in punishments, a judicial clerk, a deputy or flying column commander, or a company captain.

On a Wood line thriving, a capital official is the Minister of Works; weak, the Yingshan or Yuheng bureaus; serving outside, thriving, a customs-house and tax master, and weak, also a post for taxes and the tea and water duties.
On a Water line thriving, a capital official is the Minister of Personnel.
(It takes the sense of weighing and selecting as level as water.)
Weak, the directors of the Wenxuan, Jixun, Yanfeng and Dushui bureaus.
Serving outside, thriving, he is in charge of salt, grain transport, river works or the river patrol.
Weak, a post for water conservancy, salt transport or grain transport.

On a Fire line thriving, a capital official is the Minister of Rites, an official of the Supervisorate of the Heir, a scholar, the Chancellor or Vice-Chancellor of the Imperial Academy, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices or the Hanlin Academy; weak, a secretary of the Secretariat.
Thriving and with the Vermilion Bird added, a supervising secretary or censor.
Weak, the Court of State Ceremonial.
On a Wu line, thriving is the Minister of War, and weak is the Pasturage Court.
One serving outside who carries the Wenchang star and the Post Horse and the Month is, if not an examiner, surely an education commissioner.
Weak, a school instructor or a post in the furnaces, smelting works and mines.

On the top line thriving, a capital official is the Minister of Revenue, the governor of the capital prefecture, the city-patrol censor or the granary office, and with the Dragon and Virtue added, the Court of Banqueting.
Serving outside, thriving, a provincial administration commissioner, or an officer of military farms, transport or grain.
Weak, a prefect, a county magistrate, or an envoy to open mines, quarry stone or clear land.

title: 官禄占·何官（四）：世持官贵禄而无印绶是佐贰；世持衰官得日辰动财生合或伏财化财是仓场府库驿典之官；世持官印而无财非正选而差委之官；官衰印旺是署印官

rule.yi: 世爻持官星、贵人、禄而没有印绶（父母），是佐贰官；世爻持衰弱的官星，得到日辰、动爻的财来生合，或者财伏藏、化出财的，是管仓场、府库、驿站这类的官；世爻持官星、印星而没有财的，不是正式选授的官，而是差遣委任的官（筮诀说，卦里若没有财，必定不是正式选授）；官星衰弱、印星旺相的，是代理掌印的官。
rule.en: If the Self holds the star of office, the Noble and Emolument but has no seal and ribbon (Resource), it is an assistant official; if the Self holds a weak star of office and Wealth from the Day or a moving line generates or combines with it, or Wealth lies hidden or turns into Wealth, it is an official of the granaries, treasuries, post stations and the like; if the Self holds the star of office and seal but has no Wealth, it is not a regularly selected official but one dispatched or commissioned (the Divination Secret says: if the hexagram has no Wealth, it is surely not a regular selection); if the star of office is weak and the seal thriving, he is an acting seal-holder.

zh: 世持官贵禄而无印绶者，佐贰也。
世持衰官得日辰动财来生合，或伏财化财者，仓场府库驿典之官也。
世持官印，而无财者，非正选而差委之官也。
yi: 世爻持官星、贵人、禄而没有印绶的，是佐贰官。
世爻持衰弱的官星，得到日辰、动爻的财来生合，或者财伏藏、化出财的，是管仓场、府库、驿站这类的官。
世爻持官星、印星而没有财的，不是正式选授的官，而是差遣委任的官。
（筮诀说：卦里如果没有财，一定不是正式选授。）
官星衰弱、印星旺相的，是代理掌印的官。
en: If the Self holds the star of office, the Noble and Emolument but has no seal and ribbon, it is an assistant official.

If the Self holds a weak star of office and Wealth from the Day or a moving line generates or combines with it, or Wealth lies hidden or turns into Wealth, it is an official of the granaries, treasuries, post stations and the like.
If the Self holds the star of office and seal but has no Wealth, it is not a regularly selected official but one dispatched or commissioned.
(The Divination Secret says: if the hexagram has no Wealth, it is surely not a regular selection.)
If the star of office is weak and the seal thriving, he is an acting seal-holder.

title: 官禄占·候选（一）：官临身世与财爻独发，或世官加书贵带龙雀动，或岁月带官印生合世身者得选；世下伏官伏驿马印绶迟选；卦无官印、身世空绝、子孙持世独发不得选；鬼化鬼反覆，鬼动财空选司无力；身世随鬼入墓选不成

rule.yi: 候选（等待选官）——能选上：官星临在身爻、世爻上，财爻单独发动；或者世爻、官星加文书、贵人，带青龙或朱雀发动；或者太岁、月建带着官星、印星来生合世身。选得迟：官星伏在世爻下，或伏着驿马、印绶。选在下等：世爻持官星、贵人遇升爻，但休囚受克。选不上：卦里没有官星、印星，或它们空绝，或身爻世爻空绝，或子孙持世旺动、子孙单独发动；官鬼变官鬼，事情多反复；官鬼发动而财空绝，选官的衙门没有力量；官星入绝但逢生，事虽有阻挠，终得贵人之力而成；身爻世爻随官鬼入墓，选不成，成了也不如意；遇丁未、戊戌二杀之墓，即使选了官、到了任，也要带着亲人回乡；官鬼带亡神劫杀大杀克世身，选了官也不得赴任；有官星而无父母，或父母空死墓绝胎，没有任所。
rule.en: Awaiting selection. Selected: the star of office sits on the Body or the Self and the Wealth line alone moves; or the Self and the star of office carry the document and the Noble and move with the Azure Dragon or the Vermilion Bird; or Tai Sui and the Month carry the star of office and seal and generate or combine with the Self and Body. Late selection: the star of office or the Post Horse or seal lies hidden under the Self. A low selection: the Self holds the star of office and the Noble on a promotion line but is resting or trapped and controlled. Not selected: the hexagram has no star of office or seal, or they are Void or extinct, or the Body and Self are Void or extinct, or Output holds the Self and is thriving and moving, or Output alone moves. Pressure turning into Pressure: the matter goes back and forth; Pressure moves while Wealth is Void or extinct: the selecting office has no power; the star of office extinct but meeting generation: the matter meets obstruction but is in the end achieved through a patron's help; the Body and Self following Pressure into the tomb: the selection fails, and if it succeeds it is not as wished; meeting the tombs of the two baleful spirits Dingwei and Wuxu: though selected and arrived at the post, he travels home with his kin; Pressure carrying the Lost Spirit, Robbery and great baleful spirits and controlling the Self and Body: though selected he cannot go to his post; the star of office present but no Resource, or Resource Void, dead, in tomb, extinct or in the womb stage: there is no post.

note.yi: 几处字面可疑，译文只按字面意思译：「旅亲回乡」疑是「旅榇回乡」（扶柩回乡）；「丁未戊戌二杀墓」书里没有解释是哪两个杀；「方催选陪点」按字面译。「选」是明清的铨选，按资格抽签选授官缺。三个附断例都是《易隐》官禄占后面的附断例，这里放在最相关的一条下。
note.en: A few places are doubtful and are translated only by the letter: 'travelling home with kin' is presumably 'travelling home with the coffin' (escorting a coffin home); the book does not say which two baleful spirits the 'tombs of the two killers Dingwei and Wuxu' belong to; and 'just urging the selection and accompanying the roll-call' is rendered literally. 'Xuan' is the Ming and Qing selection by which vacant posts were allotted by lot according to qualification. The three examples are from the examples appended to the end of this chapter of the Yi Yin and are placed here under the entry they illustrate most.

zh: 官临身世，与财爻独发，或世官加书贵，带龙雀动，或岁月带官印生合世身者，选也。
世下伏官，或伏驿马印绶者，迟选。
世持官贵值升爻，而休囚受克者，下选。
世加夜贵带龙雀动者，方催选陪点也。
卦无官印，与官印空绝，或身世空绝，或子持世旺动，或子孙独发者，俱不得选也。
鬼动而财空绝者，选司无力也。
官绝逢生者，事虽有沮，终得贵人力而成也。
身世随鬼入墓者选不成，成亦不如意也。
若值丁未戊戌二杀墓者，虽选官到任，而旅亲回乡也。
鬼带亡劫大杀克世身者，虽选官而不得赴任也。
卦有官无父，或父值空死墓绝胎者，无在所也。
yi: 官星临在身爻、世爻上，与财爻单独发动，或者世爻、官星加上文书、贵人，带着青龙或朱雀发动，或者太岁、月建带着官星、印星来生合世身的，能被选上。
世爻下面伏着官星，或者伏着驿马、印绶的，选得迟。
世爻持官星、贵人，遇到升爻，但休囚又受克的，选在下等。
世爻加夜贵人、带青龙或朱雀发动的，正是催着选官、陪着点名的时候。
卦里没有官星、印星，或者官星、印星落空入绝，或者身爻、世爻落空入绝，或者子孙持世旺相发动，或者子孙单独发动的，都选不上。
官鬼变官鬼的，事情多有反复。
官鬼发动而财落空入绝的，负责选官的衙门没有力量。
官星入绝但逢生的，事情虽然有阻挠，最终得到贵人的力量而成。
身爻、世爻随官鬼入墓的，选不成，即使成了也不如意。
如果遇到丁未、戊戌两个杀的墓，虽然选了官、到了任，也要带着亲人回乡。
官鬼带亡神、劫杀等大杀去克世身的，虽然选了官，也不能赴任。
卦里有官星而没有父母，或者父母遇空、死、墓、绝、胎的，没有任所。
en: If the star of office sits on the Body or the Self and the Wealth line alone moves, or the Self and the star of office carry the document and the Noble and move with the Azure Dragon or the Vermilion Bird, or Tai Sui and the Month carry the star of office and seal and generate or combine with the Self and Body, one will be selected.
If the star of office lies hidden under the Self, or the Post Horse or seal lies hidden there, the selection is late.
If the Self holds the star of office and the Noble on a promotion line but is resting or trapped and controlled, the selection is a low one.
If the Self carries the night Noble and moves with the Dragon or the Bird, it is just the time when the selection is being pressed and one is called in company.

If the hexagram has no star of office or seal, or they are Void or extinct, or the Body and Self are Void or extinct, or Output holds the Self and is thriving and moving, or Output alone moves, none of these is selected.
If Pressure turns into Pressure, the matter goes back and forth.
If Pressure moves while Wealth is Void or extinct, the selecting office has no power.
If the star of office is extinct but meets generation, the matter meets obstruction but is in the end achieved through the help of a patron.
If the Body and Self follow Pressure into the tomb, the selection fails, and if it succeeds it is not as wished.
If one meets the tombs of the two baleful spirits Dingwei and Wuxu, then though he is selected and reaches his post, he travels home with his kin.
If Pressure carries the Lost Spirit, Robbery and great baleful spirits and controls the Self and Body, then though he is selected he cannot go to his post.
If the hexagram has the star of office but no Resource, or Resource meets Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, there is no post to go to.

zh: 己丑年壬申月甲子旬乙丑日，占求官，得震之豫。
此卦己事不成，代占则成也。
但费心力多用财耳，盖子水动化未土，文书受伤，又应财亦克文书，所云克我者，他来就我易，我克者，我去就他难也。
所喜日辰丑土，冲未合子，子水又长生于月建申中，故只损心神，行财贿，终必成也。
若夫世爻旬空，丑日又刑之，己事必不可成也。
yi: 己丑年壬申月，甲子旬乙丑日，占求官，得震卦变豫卦。
这个卦，自己的事不成，别人代占就成。
但是要多费心力、多花钱财，因为子水发动化出未土，文书受伤，又有应爻的财也克文书；所谓「克我的，他来就我容易；我克的，我去就他难」，就是这个道理。
幸好日辰丑土，冲未土、合子水，子水又在月建申中长生，所以只是耗费心神、行贿花钱，最终一定成。
至于自己的事，世爻落旬空，丑日又刑它，必定不能成。
en: In the Jichou year, Renshen month, Jiazi decade, on a Yichou day, a divination on seeking office gave Zhen changing into Yu.
In this hexagram one's own business fails, but when divined on one's behalf by another it succeeds.

But it will take much effort and money, because Zi Water moves and turns into Wei Earth and the document is injured, and the Wealth of the Other line also controls the document; as the saying goes, 'what controls me, he comes to me easily; what I control, I go to him with difficulty'.

Fortunately the Day, Chou Earth, clashes with Wei Earth and combines with Zi Water, and Zi Water is also born in the Month Shen, so it only costs mental effort and money in bribes, and in the end it will surely succeed.
As for one's own business, the Self falls in Void and the Chou day also punishes it, so it surely cannot succeed.

zh: 己丑年丙子月甲子旬丁卯日，占求官，得睽之归妹。
本官寅宫，动合世下戌兄，所托贵人得力，父母属火，文书难立时空，得日辰生扶，必可成也，但本宫午火自刑，求仕文书，字眼必有踈驳处。
得旁爻卯官相生，又得官府主张成就，本宫寅官，又伏傍爻巳火文书下，必另有贵人保举，或别经勘验，方得完备，乃经两三衙门之事也。
毕竟火空无气，须待立春后官现，方准。
官动六爻，地方远，外离化震，必选东方也。
yi: 己丑年丙子月，甲子旬丁卯日，占求官，得睽卦变归妹卦。
本宫寅木官星发动，合住世爻下面的戌土兄弟，所托的贵人得力；父母爻属火，文书难以立住，时值落空，得到日辰生扶，必定能成；但是本宫的午火自刑，求官的文书，字眼上必有疏漏被驳的地方。
得到旁边的卯木官星相生，又得到官府主张成全；本宫的寅木官星，又伏在旁边巳火文书下面，必定另有贵人保举，或者另外经过勘验，才能完备，这是要经过两三个衙门的事。
毕竟火落空无气，必须等立春以后官星出现，才批准。
立夏以后文书旺相，才算完备。
官星在六爻发动，地方远；外卦离化震，必选在东方。
en: In the Jichou year, Bingzi month, Jiazi decade, on a Dingmao day, a divination on seeking office gave Kui changing into Guimei.
