The Yin Wood star of office of the home palace moves and combines with the Xu Earth Peer line under the Self, so the patron entrusted has real strength; the Resource line is Fire and the document is hard to establish because it is Void at the time, but with generation and support from the Day it can surely succeed; but the home palace's Wu Fire punishes itself, so the document seeking office will surely have rough spots in its wording that get queried.

With the side Mao Wood star of office generating it and the authorities also pushing it through, and the home palace's Yin Wood star of office lying hidden under the side Si Fire document, there will surely be another patron to recommend him, or another inspection, before it is complete; it is a matter that goes through two or three offices.
In the end Fire is Void and without breath, and one must wait until after the start of spring when the star of office appears before it is approved.
After the start of summer the document thrives and then it is complete.
The star of office moves in the sixth line, so the place is far; the outer trigram Li turns into Zhen, so it will surely be selected in the east.

zh: 庚寅年辛巳月甲申旬壬辰日，占求官，得需卦安静。
本宫巳火文书，临月建，伏在官鬼之下，又巳火生世丁丑土，求官必得。
所嫌旁爻申金持世，与月建六合来克官，日辰又生之，主暂时阻节，终是夏金逢时空，不能为祸。
本宫卯木官，伏辰土兄弟下，日辰又是兄弟，为劫财之神，无旁爻寅鬼与本宫巳父相刑，乃所掌官吏，有求索之意，若与之贿，事必谐矣。
yi: 庚寅年辛巳月，甲申旬壬辰日，占求官，得需卦，没有动爻。
本宫巳火文书，临在月建上，伏在官鬼下面，又巳火生世爻丁丑土，求官必定得到。
所嫌的是旁边的申金持世，与月建六合、来克官星，日辰又生它，主暂时有阻碍；但终究是夏天的金遇到时令空，不能成祸。
本宫的卯木官星，伏在辰土兄弟下面，日辰又是兄弟，是劫财之神；没有旁边的寅鬼与本宫的巳父相刑；这是主管的官吏，有索求的意思，如果给他送贿赂，事情必定顺利。
en: In the Gengyin year, Xinsi month, Jiashen decade, on a Renchen day, a divination on seeking office gave Xu with no moving line.
The Si Fire document of the home palace sits on the Month and lies hidden under Pressure, and Si Fire also generates the Self, Dingchou Earth, so the office will surely be had.

What is disliked is that the side Shen Metal holds the Self and combines with the Month to control the star of office, and the Day also generates it, so there is a temporary obstruction; but in the end it is summer Metal meeting an empty season and cannot make misfortune.

The Mao Wood star of office of the home palace lies hidden under Chen Earth Peer, and the Day is also Peer, a spirit that robs wealth; there is no side Yin Pressure line to punish the home palace's Si Resource; this is the official in charge, who has the sense of demanding something, and if he is given a bribe, the matter will surely go smoothly.

title: 官禄占·候选（二）：何日得官——官旺动者远以值年合月、近以值月合日为期，官旺静者以冲动之年月日，官伏藏者以临值之年月日；官临火动选速，水动选迟

rule.yi: 想知道哪一天得官：官星旺相发动的，远的以它当值的年、合它的月为期，近的以当值的月、合它的日为期；官星旺相而安静的，以冲动它的年、月、日为期；官星伏藏的，以它当值的年、月、日为期；官星临火发动，选得快，临水发动，选得慢。
rule.en: To know on what day one gets office: if the star of office is thriving and moving, a distant date is set by the year it rules and the month that combines with it, and a near date by the month it rules and the day that combines with it; if it is thriving but still, the date is the year, month or day that clashes it into motion; if it lies hidden, the date is the year, month or day in which it rules; if the star of office moves on Fire the selection is quick, and if on Water, slow.

zh: 欲知何日得官，官旺动者，远则以值年合月为期，近则以值月合日为期也。
官旺静者，以冲动之年月日为期也。
官伏藏者，以临值之年月日为期也。
官临火动，选速，水动选迟也。
yi: 想知道哪一天得官，官星旺相发动的，远的以它当值的年、合它的月为期，近的以当值的月、合它的日为期。
官星旺相而安静的，以冲动它的年、月、日为期。
官星伏藏的，以它当值的年、月、日为期。
官星临火发动的，选得快，临水发动的，选得慢。
en: To know on what day one gets office: if the star of office is thriving and moving, a distant date is set by the year it rules and the month that combines with it, and a near date by the month it rules and the day that combines with it.
If the star of office is thriving but still, the date is the year, month or day that clashes it into motion.
If the star of office lies hidden, the date is the year, month or day in which it rules.
If the star of office moves on Fire, the selection is quick; if it moves on Water, the selection is slow.

zh: 己丑年癸酉月甲子旬丁酉日，婿占岳翁，在京选官否，得晋之噬嗑。
此卦父临岁破，巳官旬空，又初爻动化福来伤官，木宫午官伏酉兄之下，火死于酉，且月日冲动卯财，克伏下辰土父母，戌土父母，虽伏巳官下受生，奈巳火空亡，土又败于酉也，毫无生气，故今岁恐选不成，待次年庚寅，火官长生，正月可选，五月可到任也。
yi: 己丑年癸酉月，甲子旬丁酉日，女婿占岳父，在京城能不能选上官，得晋卦变噬嗑卦。
这个卦，父母临岁破，巳火官星落旬空，又初爻发动化出福神来伤官星；木宫的午火官星伏在酉金兄弟下面，火在酉死，而且月、日冲动卯木财，克伏在下面的辰土父母、戌土父母，虽然伏在巳火官星下面受生，无奈巳火空亡，土又在酉败，毫无生气，所以今年恐怕选不成，等到明年庚寅年，火官星长生，正月可以选上，五月可以到任。
en: In the Jichou year, Guiyou month, Jiazi decade, on a Dingyou day, a son-in-law divined for his father-in-law on whether he would be selected for office in the capital, and got Jin changing into Shihe.

In this hexagram Resource sits on the Year-break, the Si Fire star of office is Void, and the first line moves and turns into Output to injure the star of office; the Wu Fire star of office of the Wood palace lies hidden under the You Metal Peer line, and Fire is dead in You; moreover the Month and Day clash the Mao Wood Wealth line into motion, which controls the Chen Earth and Xu Earth Resource lines hidden below; though they lie hidden under the Si star of office and are generated, Si Fire is Void and Earth is spent in You, so there is no life at all; therefore I fear that this year the selection will not succeed; wait for next year, Gengyin, when the Fire star of office is born, and he can be selected in the first month and reach his post in the fifth month.

zh: 庚寅年辛巳月甲子旬丁酉日，占求官，得乾之离。
二五爻辞，俱有利见大人本吉，但六冲化六冲，又寅财动克文书中，兄动多阻隔，目下不成。
直待辰戌印绶年可求，午火官鬼年，可得官也。
yi: 庚寅年辛巳月，甲子旬丁酉日，占求官，得乾卦变离卦。
二爻、五爻的爻辞，都有「利见大人」，本来是吉的；但是六冲卦变六冲卦，又有寅木财发动克文书，兄弟发动多阻隔，眼下不成。
要等到辰年、戌年（印绶之年）才可以去求，午火官鬼之年才能得官。
en: In the Gengyin year, Xinsi month, Jiazi decade, on a Dingyou day, a divination on seeking office gave Qian changing into Li.

The line texts of the second and fifth lines both say 'it is fitting to see the great man', which is auspicious in itself; but a Six-Clash hexagram turns into a Six-Clash hexagram, and the Yin Wood Wealth line moves to control the document, and a moving Peer line brings many obstructions, so it will not succeed for now.
One must wait for a Chen or Xu year, the years of the seal, to seek it, and the year of Wu Fire Pressure to obtain office.

title: 官禄占·候选（三）：按卦宫定选官的节气——艮立春后、震春分后、巽立夏后、离夏至后、坤立秋后、兑秋分后、乾立冬后、坎冬至后

rule.yi: 再看卦宫来定选官的节气：卦宫是艮的，立春以后选；震，春分以后；巽，立夏以后；离，夏至以后；坤，立秋以后；兑，秋分以后；乾，立冬以后；坎，冬至以后。
rule.en: Look also at the palace of the hexagram to fix the solar term of the selection: if the palace is Gen, the selection comes after the start of spring; Zhen, after the spring equinox; Xun, after the start of summer; Li, after the summer solstice; Kun, after the start of autumn; Dui, after the autumn equinox; Qian, after the start of winter; Kan, after the winter solstice.

zh: 又看卦宫，宫居艮，立春后选。
yi: 再看卦宫：卦宫是艮的，立春以后选。
卦宫是震的，春分以后选。
卦宫是巽的，立夏以后选。
卦宫是离的，夏至以后选。
卦宫是坤的，立秋以后选。
卦宫是兑的，秋分以后选。
卦宫是乾的，立冬以后选。
卦宫是坎的，冬至以后选。
en: Look also at the palace of the hexagram: if the palace is Gen, the selection comes after the start of spring.
If the palace is Zhen, after the spring equinox.
If the palace is Xun, after the start of summer.
If the palace is Li, after the summer solstice.
If the palace is Kun, after the start of autumn.
If the palace is Dui, after the autumn equinox.
If the palace is Qian, after the start of winter.
If the palace is Kan, after the winter solstice.

title: 官禄占·领凭：以文书为用，旺则墓日可领、衰则生旺日可领、伏藏则临值之日领；卦无父或父临空死墓绝胎候久而不得；父化父文凭不实

rule.yi: 领凭证：以文书（父母）为用神。文书旺相，到它入墓的日子可以领；衰弱，到它生旺的日子可以领；伏藏，到它当值的日子领。卦里没有父母，或者父母临空、死、墓、绝、胎，等很久也领不到；父母变出父母，文凭不实在。
rule.en: Collecting the credentials: the document line is the Subject. If it is thriving, the credentials can be collected on the day it enters the tomb; if weak, on a day of its birth or strength; if hidden, on the day in which it rules. If the hexagram has no Resource line, or Resource sits on Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, one waits long and does not get them; if Resource turns into Resource, the credentials are not genuine.

zh: 旺则墓日可领，衰则生旺日可领，伏藏则临值之日领也。
卦无父，与父临空死墓绝胎者，候久而不得也。
又父化父者，文凭不实也。
yi: 以文书（父母）为用神。
旺相的，到它入墓的日子可以领；衰弱的，到它生旺的日子可以领；伏藏的，到它当值的日子领。
卦里没有父母，或者父母临在空、死、墓、绝、胎上的，等很久也得不到。
又，父母变出父母的，文凭不实在。
en: The document line is the Subject.
If it is thriving, the credentials can be collected on the day it enters the tomb; if weak, on a day of its birth or strength; if hidden, on the day in which it rules.
If the hexagram has no Resource line, or Resource sits on Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, one waits long and does not get them.
Again, if Resource turns into Resource, the credentials are not genuine.

title: 官禄占·任所（一）：世在一二位近、三四位远、五六位更远；六合卦近、六冲卦远

rule.yi: 任所的远近：世爻在一、二位的近，三、四位的远，五、六位的更远；六合卦近，六冲卦远。
rule.en: The distance of the post: if the Self is in the first or second place it is near, in the third or fourth far, and in the fifth or sixth farther still; a Six-Combine hexagram is near and a Six-Clash hexagram far.

zh: 一二世者近，三四世者远，五六世者愈远也。
yi: 世爻在一、二位的，任所近；在三、四位的，远；在五、六位的，更远。
六合卦近，六冲卦远。
en: If the Self is in the first or second place the post is near; in the third or fourth, far; in the fifth or sixth, farther still.
A Six-Combine hexagram is near, and a Six-Clash hexagram far.

title: 官禄占·任所（二）：按世爻所属地支定任所的分野——子山东济南等五府；丑南京应天等府、浙江、江西、福建、广东诸府；寅北京顺天等府与辽东；卯南京徐州淮安；辰山东兖州；巳湖广、四川夔州、贵州、广东廉州、广西诸府；午河南河南南阳、湖广郧阳襄阳德安；未陕西、甘肃、四川、云南、贵州诸府；申山西太原平阳等；酉北直真定顺德、山西大同；戌南京凤阳庐州与徐州；亥河南开封等与北直大名

rule.yi: 任所在什么地方，按世爻所属的地支和星宿分野来定：世属子，是坎宫、女宿虚宿危宿三宿的分野，今山东济南等五府；世属丑，是艮宫、牛宿斗宿的分野，今南京的应天、扬州等府，浙江、江西、福建、广东诸府；世属寅，是艮宫、尾宿箕宿的分野，今北京顺天等府和辽东沈阳；世属卯，是震宫、氐房心三宿的分野，今南京徐州、淮安；世属辰，是巽宫、角亢二宿的分野，今山东兖州府；世属巳，是巽宫、翼轸二宿的分野，今湖广诸府、四川夔州府、贵州铜仁黎平、广东廉州、广西诸府；世属午，是离宫、柳星张三宿的分野，今河南河南府、南阳府和湖广郧阳、襄阳、德安三府；世属未，是坤宫、井鬼二宿的分野，今陕西、甘肃、四川、云南、贵州的诸府州；世属申，是坤宫、毕觜参三宿的分野，今山西太原、平阳等地；世属酉，是兑宫、胃昴二宿的分野，今北直真定、顺德二府和山西大同府；世属戌，是乾宫、奎娄二宿的分野，今南京凤阳、庐州二府和徐州；世属亥，是乾宫、室壁二宿的分野，今河南开封、彰德、卫辉、怀庆、汝宁等府和北直大名府。
rule.en: The region of the post is fixed by the branch the Self belongs to and the allotted lunar mansions: Zi is the Kan palace and the mansions Nü, Xu and Wei, today five prefectures of Shandong; Chou is the Gen palace and the mansions Niu and Dou, today the prefectures of the southern capital region such as Yingtian and Yangzhou and those of Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong; Yin is the Gen palace and the mansions Wei (Tail) and Ji, today the prefectures of Beijing such as Shuntian, with Liaodong and Shenyang; Mao is the Zhen palace and the mansions Di, Fang and Xin, today Xuzhou and Huai'an in the southern capital region; Chen is the Xun palace and the mansions Jiao and Kang, today Yanzhou prefecture in Shandong; Si is the Xun palace and the mansions Yi and Zhen, today the prefectures of Huguang, Kuizhou in Sichuan, Tongren and Liping in Guizhou, Lianzhou in Guangdong and the prefectures of Guangxi; Wu is the Li palace and the mansions Liu, Xing and Zhang, today Henan and Nanyang prefectures in Henan and Yunyang, Xiangyang and De'an in Huguang; Wei is the Kun palace and the mansions Jing and Gui, today the prefectures and departments of Shaanxi, Gansu, Sichuan, Yunnan and Guizhou; Shen is the Kun palace and the mansions Bi, Zi and Shen, today Taiyuan, Pingyang and other places in Shanxi; You is the Dui palace and the mansions Wei (Stomach) and Mao, today Zhending and Shunde in the northern metropolitan region and Datong prefecture in Shanxi; Xu is the Qian palace and the mansions Kui and Lou, today Fengyang and Luzhou in the southern capital region and Xuzhou; Hai is the Qian palace and the mansions Shi and Bi, today Kaifeng, Zhangde, Weihui, Huaiqing and Runing in Henan and Daming prefecture in the northern metropolitan region.

note.yi: 这是明代的府州名，按分野（把天上二十八宿对应地上区域）排的。原文有几处地名和星宿名像是形近误字，译文照原文拼写，不改：卫州（浙江的一府，应是衢州）、河涧（应是河间）、氏（应是氐宿）、虁州（夔州）、卢州（一处在四川，一处在南京，应分别是泸州和庐州）、卯州、渣州、胃昂（应是胃昴）、室璧（应是室壁）。「北直」是北直隶，「南京」指南直隶。
note.en: These are Ming prefecture and department names arranged by 'fenye', the matching of the twenty-eight lunar mansions in the sky to regions of the earth. Several place and mansion names in the text look like miscopied look-alike characters, and the translation follows the spelling in the text without emending: Weizhou (a Zhejiang prefecture, presumably Quzhou), Hejian, 'Shi' for the mansion Di, Kuizhou, Luzhou (once in Sichuan and once in the southern capital region, presumably Luzhou and Luzhou with different characters), Maozhou, Zhazhou, 'Ang' for the mansion Mao and 'Bi' for the mansion Bi (Wall). 'Beizhi' is the northern metropolitan region and 'Nanjing' the southern one.

zh: 世属子，则坎宫女虚危三宿之分野。
今山东济南、东昌、青州、登州、莱州五府之地也。
世属丑，则艮宫牛斗二宿之分野，今南京应天扬州、徽州、宁国池州、太平、安庆、苏州、松江、常州、镇江等府，与浙江杭州、嘉兴、湖州、宁波、绍兴、台州、金华、卫州、严州、温州、处州等府，与江西南昌、瑞州、饶州、抚州、建昌、吉安、南安、临江、赣州、南康、九江、广信等府，与福建福州、泉州、兴化、福宁州、邵武、延平、建宁、汀州、漳州等府，及广东广州、南雄、惠州、潮州、肇庆、高州、琼州之地也。
世属寅，则艮宫尾箕二宿分野，今北京顺天、昌平、永平、保定、河涧等府，与辽东、沈阳等处地也。
世属卯，则震宫氏房心三宿之分野，今南京徐州、淮安之地也。
世属辰，则巽宫角亢二宿之分野，今山东兗州府之地也。
世属巳，则巽宫翼轸二宿之分野，今湖广荆州、岳州、长沙、宝庆、辰州、常德衡州、永州、武昌、黄州、承天等府，与四川虁州府、贵州、铜仁、黎平府、广东廉州府、广西桂林、梧州、浔州、南宁太平、思明、柳州、庆远、思恩、镇安等府之地也。
世属午，则离宫柳星张三宿之分野，今河南河南府、南阳府、湖广郧阳、襄阳、德安三府之地也。
世属未，则坤宫井鬼二宿之分野，今陕西西安、汉中、凤翔、平凉、临洮、巩昌、庆阳、延安等府，甘州、潼关、榆林、宁夏、甘肃等处，与四川成都、龙安、顺庆、保宁、重庆、叙州、马湖等府，卢州、嘉定州、卯州、眉州、雅州等处，与云南云南府、临安、广西、楚雄、姚安、武定、景东、顺宁、大理、蒙化、永宁、永昌等府，北胜州、云州、丽江府、鹤庆府与贵州、贵阳、都匀思州、石阡铜仁等府之地也。
世属申，则坤宫毕觜参三宿之分野，今山西太原、平阳、潞安府、沁州、泽州、汾州、渣州之地也。
世属酉，则兑宫，胃昂二宿之分野，今北直真定、顺德二府，山西大同府之地也。
世属戌，则乾宫奎娄二宿之分野，今南京凤阳、卢州二府，徐州之地也。
世属亥，则乾宫室璧二宿之分野，今河南开封、彰德、卫辉、怀庆、汝宁等府与北直大名府之地也。
yi: 世爻属子，就是坎宫、女宿虚宿危宿三个星宿的分野。
现在是山东济南、东昌、青州、登州、莱州五个府的地方。

世爻属丑，就是艮宫、牛宿斗宿两个星宿的分野，现在是南京的应天、扬州、徽州、宁国、池州、太平、安庆、苏州、松江、常州、镇江等府，和浙江的杭州、嘉兴、湖州、宁波、绍兴、台州、金华、卫州、严州、温州、处州等府，和江西的南昌、瑞州、饶州、抚州、建昌、吉安、南安、临江、赣州、南康、九江、广信等府，和福建的福州、泉州、兴化、福宁州、邵武、延平、建宁、汀州、漳州等府，以及广东的广州、南雄、惠州、潮州、肇庆、高州、琼州的地方。
世爻属寅，就是艮宫、尾宿箕宿两个星宿的分野，现在是北京的顺天、昌平、永平、保定、河涧等府，和辽东、沈阳等处的地方。
世爻属卯，就是震宫、氐宿房宿心宿三个星宿的分野，现在是南京的徐州、淮安的地方。
世爻属辰，就是巽宫、角宿亢宿两个星宿的分野，现在是山东兖州府的地方。
世爻属巳，就是巽宫、翼宿轸宿两个星宿的分野，现在是湖广的荆州、岳州、长沙、宝庆、辰州、常德、衡州、永州、武昌、黄州、承天等府，和四川的夔州府，贵州、铜仁、黎平府，广东的廉州府，广西的桂林、梧州、浔州、南宁、太平、思明、柳州、庆远、思恩、镇安等府的地方。
世爻属午，就是离宫、柳宿星宿张宿三个星宿的分野，现在是河南的河南府、南阳府，和湖广的郧阳、襄阳、德安三府的地方。
世爻属未，就是坤宫、井宿鬼宿两个星宿的分野，现在是陕西的西安、汉中、凤翔、平凉、临洮、巩昌、庆阳、延安等府，甘州、潼关、榆林、宁夏、甘肃等处，和四川的成都、龙安、顺庆、保宁、重庆、叙州、马湖等府，卢州、嘉定州、卯州、眉州、雅州等处，和云南的云南府、临安、广西、楚雄、姚安、武定、景东、顺宁、大理、蒙化、永宁、永昌等府，北胜州、云州、丽江府、鹤庆府，和贵州的贵阳、都匀、思州、石阡、铜仁等府的地方。
世爻属申，就是坤宫、毕宿觜宿参宿三个星宿的分野，现在是山西的太原、平阳、潞安府、沁州、泽州、汾州、渣州的地方。
世爻属酉，就是兑宫、胃宿昴宿两个星宿的分野，现在是北直隶的真定、顺德二府，和山西的大同府的地方。
世爻属戌，就是乾宫、奎宿娄宿两个星宿的分野，现在是南京的凤阳、卢州二府，和徐州的地方。
世爻属亥，就是乾宫、室宿壁宿两个星宿的分野，现在是河南的开封、彰德、卫辉、怀庆、汝宁等府，和北直隶大名府的地方。
en: If the Self belongs to Zi, it is the Kan palace and the allotted region of the three lunar mansions Nü, Xu and Wei.
That is, today, the land of the five prefectures Jinan, Dongchang, Qingzhou, Dengzhou and Laizhou in Shandong.

If the Self belongs to Chou, it is the Gen palace and the allotted region of the two lunar mansions Niu and Dou, that is, today, the prefectures of the southern capital region Yingtian, Yangzhou, Huizhou, Ningguo, Chizhou, Taiping, Anqing, Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou and Zhenjiang, and in Zhejiang the prefectures Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Huzhou, Ningbo, Shaoxing, Taizhou, Jinhua, Weizhou, Yanzhou, Wenzhou and Chuzhou, and in Jiangxi the prefectures Nanchang, Ruizhou, Raozhou, Fuzhou, Jianchang, Ji'an, Nan'an, Linjiang, Ganzhou, Nankang, Jiujiang and Guangxin, and in Fujian the prefectures Fuzhou, Quanzhou, Xinghua, Funing department, Shaowu, Yanping, Jianning, Tingzhou and Zhangzhou, and in Guangdong the lands of Guangzhou, Nanxiong, Huizhou, Chaozhou, Zhaoqing, Gaozhou and Qiongzhou.

If the Self belongs to Yin, it is the Gen palace and the region of the two lunar mansions Wei (Tail) and Ji, that is, today, the prefectures of the northern capital Shuntian, Changping, Yongping, Baoding and Hejian, and the lands of Liaodong, Shenyang and elsewhere.
If the Self belongs to Mao, it is the Zhen palace and the region of the three lunar mansions Di, Fang and Xin, that is, today, the land of Xuzhou and Huai'an in the southern capital region.
If the Self belongs to Chen, it is the Xun palace and the region of the two lunar mansions Jiao and Kang, that is, today, the land of Yanzhou prefecture in Shandong.

If the Self belongs to Si, it is the Xun palace and the region of the two lunar mansions Yi and Zhen, that is, today, the prefectures of Huguang Jingzhou, Yuezhou, Changsha, Baoqing, Chenzhou, Changde, Hengzhou, Yongzhou, Wuchang, Huangzhou and Chengtian; Kuizhou prefecture in Sichuan; Guizhou, Tongren and Liping prefecture; Lianzhou prefecture in Guangdong; and in Guangxi the prefectures Guilin, Wuzhou, Xunzhou, Nanning, Taiping, Siming, Liuzhou, Qingyuan, Si'en and Zhen'an.

If the Self belongs to Wu, it is the Li palace and the region of the three lunar mansions Liu, Xing and Zhang, that is, today, Henan prefecture and Nanyang prefecture in Henan, and the three prefectures Yunyang, Xiangyang and De'an in Huguang.

If the Self belongs to Wei, it is the Kun palace and the region of the two lunar mansions Jing and Gui, that is, today, in Shaanxi the prefectures Xi'an, Hanzhong, Fengxiang, Pingliang, Lintao, Gongchang, Qingyang and Yan'an, and Ganzhou, Tongguan, Yulin, Ningxia, Gansu and other places; in Sichuan the prefectures Chengdu, Long'an, Shunqing, Baoning, Chongqing, Xuzhou and Mahu, and Luzhou, Jiadingzhou, Maozhou, Meizhou, Yazhou and other places; in Yunnan the prefectures Yunnan, Lin'an, Guangxi, Chuxiong, Yao'an, Wuding, Jingdong, Shunning, Dali, Menghua, Yongning and Yongchang, and Beishengzhou, Yunzhou, Lijiang prefecture and Heqing prefecture; and in Guizhou the prefectures Guiyang, Duyun, Sizhou, Shiqian and Tongren.

If the Self belongs to Shen, it is the Kun palace and the region of the three lunar mansions Bi, Zi and Shen, that is, today, in Shanxi the lands of Taiyuan, Pingyang, Lu'an prefecture, Qinzhou, Zezhou, Fenzhou and Zhazhou.

If the Self belongs to You, it is the Dui palace and the region of the two lunar mansions Wei (Stomach) and Mao, that is, today, the two prefectures Zhending and Shunde in the northern metropolitan region and Datong prefecture in Shanxi.

If the Self belongs to Xu, it is the Qian palace and the region of the two lunar mansions Kui and Lou, that is, today, the two prefectures Fengyang and Luzhou in the southern capital region, and the land of Xuzhou.

If the Self belongs to Hai, it is the Qian palace and the region of the two lunar mansions Shi and Bi, that is, today, the prefectures Kaifeng, Zhangde, Weihui, Huaiqing and Runing in Henan and Daming prefecture in the northern metropolitan region.

title: 官禄占·赴任：分爻值旺相而逢生合者吉，遇鬼值空而被刑害克破者必有灾难；世为官、应为任所：世克应道途无阻，应克世到任不利，世生应因官耗损，应生世因官进益；世空必有灾难，陆行忧跌扑舟行忧风浪

rule.yi: 赴任：对应的那一爻旺相又逢生合的，吉；遇上官鬼、落空，又被刑、害、克、破的，必有灾难。又，世爻是做官的人，应爻是任所：世克应，路上没有阻碍；应克世，到任不利；世生应，因为做官而耗损；应生世，因为做官而得益。世爻落空必有灾难：走陆路担心跌伤，走水路担心风浪；如果是旺相的空，只是生病而已，或者得到日辰、动爻来冲克，才大概能免于灾咎。
rule.en: Going to the post: the matching line is auspicious when it is thriving and meets generation or combination; if it meets Pressure and is Void, and is punished, harmed, controlled or broken, there will surely be disaster. Again, the Self is the official and the Other is the post: if the Self controls the Other the road is unobstructed; if the Other controls the Self, taking up the post is unfavourable; if the Self generates the Other, one is drained because of the office; if the Other generates the Self, one gains because of the office. A Void Self means disaster: going by land fear a fall, by water fear wind and waves; if it is a thriving Void it is only illness, or if the Day or a moving line comes to clash with or control it one may perhaps escape blame.

note.yi: 表里的名目是「任所、道路、宾师车马、家眷伴侣行李」，书里没有写各是哪一爻，读法同 YY.02：从上爻写到初爻。「宾师」是随行的幕宾和师爷。
note.en: The items in the table are 'the post, the road, guests and teachers with carts and horses, family and companions and baggage', and the book does not say which line each belongs to; it is read as in YY.02, from the top line down to the first. 'Binshi' are the guests and secretaries who accompany the official.

zh: 任所道路宾师车马家眷伴侣行李
分爻值旺相而逢生合者吉，遇鬼值空，而被刑害克破者，必有灾难也。
陆行忧跌扑，舟行忧风浪。
若旺空，惟病而已，或得日辰动爻来冲克，庶几免咎也。
yi: 鬼谷分爻（表）：
任所、道路、宾师车马、家眷伴侣行李。
对应的那一爻旺相又逢到生合的，吉；遇上官鬼、落空，又被刑、害、克、破的，必定有灾难。
又，世爻是做官的人，应爻是任所。
世克应，路上没有阻碍。
应爻克世爻，到任上不顺利。
世生应，因为做官而耗损。
应生世，因为做官而得益。
世爻落空，必有灾难。
走陆路担心跌伤，走水路担心风浪。
如果是旺相的空，只是生病而已；或者得到日辰、动爻来冲克，才大概能免于灾咎。
en: Guigu's division of the lines (table):
the post, the road, guests and teachers with carts and horses, family and companions and baggage.

The matching line is auspicious when it is thriving and meets generation or combination; if it meets Pressure and is Void, and is punished, harmed, controlled or broken, there will surely be disaster.
Again, the Self is the official and the Other is the post.
If the Self controls the Other, the road is unobstructed.
If the Other controls the Self, taking up the post is unfavourable.
If the Self generates the Other, one is drained because of the office.
If the Other generates the Self, one gains because of the office.
If the Self is Void, there will surely be disaster.
Going by land, fear a fall; going by water, fear wind and waves.
If it is a thriving Void it is only illness, or if the Day or a moving line comes to clash with or control it, one may perhaps escape blame.

title: 官禄占·在任（一）：官加贵禄临扶身世到任操权；父加贵马临扶身世临庭掌印；官加龙贵在阳宫阳爻旺相政声籍甚

rule.yi: 在任，到任之后的权势和声望：官星带贵人、禄，临到并扶助身爻、世爻的，到任就掌实权；印星带贵人、驿马，临到并扶助身爻、世爻的，上堂就掌印；官星带青龙、贵人，落在阳宫的阳爻上又旺相的，政绩的名声很大。
rule.en: In office, power and repute after taking up the post. If the star of office carrying the Noble and Emolument comes to the Body and Self and supports them, he holds real power on taking up the post; if the seal line carrying the Noble and the Horse does so, he holds the seal when he takes his seat; if the star of office carrying the Dragon and the Noble sits on a yang line in a yang palace and is thriving, his name for government is great.

note.yi: 这一节开头的「官」「父」都是单字，按上一章的用法译成官星、印星（印绶，即父母爻）；「贵」是贵人，「禄」「马」是禄神、驿马，「龙」是青龙，都是神煞。「籍甚」是名声很大。
note.en: The single characters 'official' and 'father' at the head of this passage are rendered, as in the previous chapter, as the star of office and the seal line (the seal and ribbon, that is the Resource line); 'Noble' is the Noble, 'Emolument' and 'Horse' are the Emolument spirit and the Post Horse, and 'Dragon' is the Azure Dragon, all spirit-stars. 'Jijia' means a great name.

zh: 官加贵禄临扶身世者，到任操权也。
父加贵马临扶身世者，临庭掌印也。
官加龙贵，在阳宫阳爻旺相者，政声籍甚也。
yi: 官星带着贵人、禄，临到并扶助身爻、世爻的，到任之后掌有实权。
印星带着贵人、驿马，临到并扶助身爻、世爻的，上堂就掌印。
官星带着青龙、贵人，在阳宫的阳爻上又旺相的，政绩的名声很大。
en: If the star of office carrying the Noble and Emolument comes to the Body and Self and supports them, he holds real power on taking up the post.
If the seal line carrying the Noble and the Horse comes to the Body and Self and supports them, when he takes his seat in the hall he holds the seal.
If the star of office carrying the Dragon and the Noble is on a yang line in a yang palace and thriving, his name for government is great.

title: 官禄占·在任（二）：父受伤财空绝地瘠民贫；父身动兄世动政繁赋缺；日并兄动伤世吏多舞文；兄化子孙克世民多梗化

rule.yi: 在任，任所的民情和属吏：印星受伤而财爻落空、绝的，任所地瘠民贫；印星、身爻发动，而兄爻、世爻也发动的，政事繁杂而赋税不足；日辰合着发动的兄爻伤世爻的，属吏多半舞文弄法；兄爻变出子孙来克世爻的，百姓多半顽梗，不服教化。
rule.en: In office, the people and the clerks of the post. If the seal line is injured and Wealth is Void or extinct, the land is barren and the people poor; if the seal line and the Body move, and the Peer line and the Self also move, government business is heavy and taxes fall short; if the Day joins a moving Peer line in injuring the Self, the clerks mostly twist the written law; if a Peer line turns into Output and that controls the Self, the people are mostly stubborn and refuse to be reformed.

note.yi: 「舞文」是玩弄法令文书，「梗化」是顽固不服从教化。第一句里「父」是单字，这里按上一条译成印星；印星受伤可以读作官府的庇护不足，但书里没有解释，译文不加。
note.en: 'Wuwen' is twisting laws and documents, and 'genghua' is stubbornly refusing reform. The single character 'father' in the first sentence is rendered as the seal line, as in the previous entry; an injured seal line could be read as too little protection from the government, but the book does not explain it, and the translation adds nothing.

zh: 父受伤而财空绝者，地瘠民贫也。
父身动而兄世动者，政繁赋缺也。
日并兄动伤世者，吏多舞文也。
兄化子孙克世者，民多梗化也。
yi: 印星受伤，而财爻落空、绝的，任所地瘠民贫。
印星、身爻发动，而兄爻、世爻也发动的，政事繁杂而赋税不足。
日辰合着发动的兄爻一起伤世爻的，属吏多半舞文弄法。
兄爻变出子孙来克世爻的，百姓多半顽梗，不服教化。
en: If the seal line is injured and Wealth is Void or extinct, the land is barren and the people poor.
If the seal line and the Body move, and the Peer line and the Self also move, government business is heavy and taxes fall short.
If the Day joins a moving Peer line in injuring the Self, the clerks mostly twist the written law.
If a Peer line turns into Output and that controls the Self, the people are mostly stubborn and refuse to be reformed.

title: 官禄占·在任（三）：道路爻空巡方使者多惊；子孙旺动剿捕官奏凯；太岁伤官朝仕必黜；月日生世外任可升

rule.yi: 在任，差使和升黜：道路这一爻落空，出外巡视的使者多受惊吓；子孙旺相发动，负责剿捕的官员奏报凯旋；太岁伤官星，在朝为官的必被罢黜；月建、日辰生世爻，外任的官可以升迁。
rule.en: In office, commissions, promotion and dismissal. If the road line is Void, the envoy touring his district is often alarmed; if Output is thriving and moving, the officer in charge of suppressing bandits reports victory; if Tai Sui injures the star of office, an official at court is surely dismissed; if the Month and Day generate the Self, an official in a post outside can be promoted.

note.yi: 「道路」是上一章鬼谷分爻表里的名目之一，书里没有写是哪一爻（见 YY.13）。「巡方」是出外巡视地方的差使，「奏凯」是奏报得胜。「朝仕」是在朝廷任职的官，「外任」是在京城以外任职。
note.en: 'The road' is one of the names in the Guigu table of the previous chapter, and the book does not say which line it is (see YY.13). 'Xunfang' is the commission of touring the districts, and 'zoukai' is reporting a victory. 'Chaoshi' is an official serving at court and 'waiten' is serving outside the capital.

zh: 道路爻空，巡方之使多惊。
子孙旺动，剿捕之官奏凯。
yi: 道路这一爻落空，出外巡视的使者多受惊吓。
子孙旺相发动，负责剿捕的官员奏报凯旋。
太岁伤官星，在朝为官的必被罢黜。
月建、日辰生世爻，外任的官可以升迁。
en: If the road line is Void, the envoy touring his district is often alarmed.
If Output is thriving and moving, the officer in charge of suppressing bandits reports victory.
If Tai Sui injures the star of office, an official at court will surely be dismissed.
If the Month and Day generate the Self, an official in a post outside can be promoted.

title: 官禄占·在任（四）：官化财非奖则荐；官贵旺动生合世目下蒙荐；岁月带父旺动朝有宣勅；太岁五爻动生合世征召入朝；官世临五爻或太岁得父动生合名书御榻；三传加财动生合世受赐赍

rule.yi: 在任，荐举、宣敕和征召：官星变出财爻，不是受嘉奖就是被荐举；官星、贵人旺相发动、来生合世爻的，眼前就蒙人荐举；太岁、月建带着印星旺相发动的，朝廷有宣读的敕命；太岁与五爻发动、来生合世爻的，被征召入朝；官爻、世爻临在五爻或太岁上，又得印星发动来生合的，名字上了御榻；三传带着财爻发动、来生合世爻的，受赏赐。
rule.en: In office, recommendation, edicts and summons. If the star of office turns into Wealth, he is either commended or recommended; if the star of office and the Noble are thriving and moving and generate or combine with the Self, he is recommended right away; if Tai Sui and the Month carry the seal line, thriving and moving, an edict is proclaimed at court; if Tai Sui and the fifth line move to generate or combine with the Self, he is summoned to court; if the Pressure line and the Self sit on the fifth line or on Tai Sui and a moving seal line generates or combines with them, his name is written on the imperial couch; if the three rulers carrying Wealth move to generate or combine with the Self, he receives gifts.

note.yi: 「名书御榻」按字面译：名字写在御座旁，大概是说皇帝亲自留意、记下了他的名字。「宣勅」是宣读皇帝的敕命，「赐赍」是赏赐财物。三传在这部书里是太岁、月建、日辰（见术语表），不是大六壬的三传。
note.en: 'Ming shu yu ta' is translated by the letter: the name is written beside the imperial seat, presumably meaning that the emperor himself has noted his name. 'Xuan chi' is the proclamation of an imperial order and 'cixi' is a bestowal of goods. The three rulers in this book are Tai Sui, the Month and the Day (see the glossary), and not the three transmissions of Da Liu Ren.

zh: 官贵旺动生合世者，目下蒙荐也。
岁月带父旺动者，朝有宣勅也。
太岁与五爻动来生合世者，徵召入朝也。
官爻世爻临五爻或临太岁，得父动来生合者，名书御榻也。
三传加财动生合世者，受赐赍也。
yi: 官星变出财爻，不是受嘉奖，就是被荐举。
官星、贵人旺相发动，来生合世爻的，眼前就蒙人荐举。
太岁、月建带着印星旺相发动的，朝廷有宣读的敕命。
太岁与五爻发动，来生合世爻的，被征召入朝。
官爻、世爻临在五爻上或太岁上，又得印星发动来生合的，名字写上了御榻。
三传（太岁、月建、日辰）带着财爻发动，来生合世爻的，受到赏赐。
en: If the star of office turns into Wealth, he is either commended or recommended.
If the star of office and the Noble are thriving and moving and generate or combine with the Self, he is recommended right away.
If Tai Sui and the Month carry the seal line, thriving and moving, an imperial edict is proclaimed at court.
If Tai Sui and the fifth line move to generate or combine with the Self, he is summoned to court.
If the Pressure line and the Self line sit on the fifth line or on Tai Sui and a moving seal line generates or combines with them, his name is written on the imperial couch.
If the three rulers carrying Wealth move to generate or combine with the Self, he receives gifts of reward.

title: 官禄占·在任（五）：太岁五爻生合父母椿萱受赠；生合妻财室人受诰；生合子孙儿孙得荫；生合官鬼祖妣恩荣

rule.yi: 在任，封赠：太岁与五爻生合哪一亲的爻，哪一亲就受恩典：生合父母爻，父母受封赠；生合妻财，妻子受诰命；生合子孙，儿孙得到荫庇；生合官鬼，已故的祖母得恩荣。
rule.en: In office, honours conferred on kin. Whichever kin line Tai Sui and the fifth line generate or combine with, those kin receive the favour: if Resource, his parents receive honorary titles; if Wealth, his wife receives an imperial patent; if Output, his sons and grandsons gain hereditary privilege; if Pressure, his late grandmother receives the grace of honours.

note.yi: 「椿萱」是父亲和母亲（椿指父、萱指母）；「诰」是皇帝封赠官员及其亲属的诏令，「荫」是官员的子孙凭父祖的官位得到入仕或入学的资格。后三句省了主语，承上一句，仍是太岁与五爻。「祖妣」字面是已故的祖母。
note.en: 'Chunxuan' means the father and the mother ('chun' for the father and 'xuan' for the mother); 'gao' is the imperial decree by which an official and his kin are given titles, and 'yin' is the privilege by which an official's descendants enter service or school on the strength of the rank of a father or grandfather. The last three sentences leave out the subject, following on from the previous one, and it is still Tai Sui and the fifth line. 'Zubi' is literally a deceased grandmother.

zh: 太岁与五爻生合父母，椿萱受赠。
yi: 太岁与五爻来生合父母爻，父母受到封赠。
（太岁与五爻）生合妻财，妻子受诰命。
（太岁与五爻）生合子孙，儿孙得到荫庇。
（太岁与五爻）生合官鬼，祖妣（已故的祖母）得到恩荣。
en: If Tai Sui and the fifth line generate or combine with Resource, his parents receive honorary titles.
If they generate or combine with Wealth, his wife receives an imperial patent.
If they generate or combine with Output, his sons and grandsons gain hereditary privilege.
If they generate or combine with Pressure, his late grandmother receives the grace of honours.

title: 官禄占·在任（六）：财化福加俸秩；财化兄罚俸粮；月日刑害克破官世或贵官动伤身世被人弹劾；官父逢空死墓绝胎、刑害克破或动化福空死墓绝胎刑害克破俱降职；世官空动将失职；官化退神

rule.yi: 在任，俸禄、弹劾和降职：财爻变出子孙，加俸加秩；财爻变出兄爻，被罚俸禄钱粮；月建、日辰刑、害、克、破官爻、世爻，或者贵人、官星发动伤身爻、世爻的，被人弹劾；官星、印星遇到空、死、墓、绝、胎，或被刑、害、克、破，或者发动变出子孙、变成空、死、墓、绝、胎、变成刑、害、克、破的，都降职；世爻、官星落空而发动的，将要失去职位；官星变成退神（括号里是退神的四个干支）。
rule.en: In office, salary, impeachment and demotion. If Wealth turns into Output, his salary and rank are raised; if Wealth turns into a Peer line, his salary and grain are docked; if the Month and Day punish, harm, control or break the Pressure line or the Self line, or the Noble and star of office move to injure the Body and Self, he is impeached; if the star of office and the seal meet Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, or are punished, harmed, controlled or broken, or move and turn into Output, or into Void, death, tomb, extinction, the womb stage, punishment, harm, control or breaking, he is demoted; if the Self and the star of office are Void and moving, he is about to lose his post; the star of office turning into a Retreating spirit is also listed, followed in brackets by the four ganzhi of the Retreating spirit.

note.yi: 「福」是福神（子孙），「官化退神」后面的括号（丁丑、丁未、壬辰、壬戌）是退神的干支：《卜筮全书》写「退神者，壬戌、壬辰、丁丑、丁未」，《断易天机》也写「丁丑、丁未、壬辰、壬戌，四者为退神」，和这里一致。这一句在书里只写了条件、没有写结果，和前后句一起列在失职之后，译文照录，不替它补结论。附断例是《易隐》官禄占末尾的一例，放在最相关的这一条下。「季空」书里没有解释，按字面是当季的空。「官不蒞事」是官员不能到任办事。
note.en: 'Fu' is the fortune spirit (Output), and the bracket after 'the star of office turns into a Retreating spirit', (Dingchou, Dingwei, Renchen, Renxu), gives the ganzhi of the Retreating spirit: the Bushi Quanshu writes 'the Retreating spirit is Renxu, Renchen, Dingchou and Dingwei', and the Duanyi Tianji also writes 'Dingchou, Dingwei, Renchen, Renxu, these four are the Retreating spirit', in agreement with this. The sentence gives only a condition and no result in the book, and stands with the sentences before and after it after the loss of a post; the translation records it and does not supply a conclusion. The example is one of those appended at the end of this chapter of the Yi Yin, and is placed under the entry it illustrates most. 'Jikong' is not explained in the book and is read literally as the Void of the season. 'Guan bu li shi' means the official cannot take up his duties.

zh: 月日刑害克破官爻世爻，或贵官动伤身世者，被人弹劾也。
官父逢空死墓绝胎，与被刑害克破，或官父动化福，化空死墓绝胎，或化刑害克破者，俱降职也。
yi: 财爻变出福神（子孙），增加俸禄品秩。
财爻变出兄爻，被罚俸禄钱粮。
月建、日辰刑、害、克、破官爻、世爻，或者贵人、官星发动伤身爻、世爻的，被人弹劾。
官星、印星遇到空、死、墓、绝、胎，以及被刑、害、克、破，或者官星、印星发动变出福神，变成空、死、墓、绝、胎，或变成刑、害、克、破的，都是降职。
世爻、官星落空而发动的，将要失去职位。
官星变成退神。
（丁丑、丁未、壬辰、壬戌。）
en: If Wealth turns into Output, the fortune spirit, his salary and rank are raised.
If Wealth turns into a Peer line, his salary and grain are docked.
If the Month and Day punish, harm, control or break the Pressure line or the Self line, or the Noble and star of office move to injure the Body and Self, he is impeached by others.

If the star of office and the seal meet Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, or are punished, harmed, controlled or broken, or if they move and turn into Output, the fortune spirit, or turn into Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, or into punishment, harm, control or breaking, in every case he is demoted.
If the Self and the star of office are Void and moving, he is about to lose his post.
If the star of office turns into a Retreating spirit.
(Dingchou, Dingwei, Renchen, Renxu.)

zh: 庚寅年庚辰月甲戌旬戊寅日，占为官安否，得剥之观。
本宫午官，伏墓戌土下，午为自刑，傍爻子动冲官伤官，必曾冒犯官长，官不蒞事。
本宫父母，又值旬空季空，此因文书不明，而忤上台也，问之果然。
yi: 庚寅年庚辰月，甲戌旬戊寅日，占做官平安与否，得剥卦变观卦。
本宫的午火官星，伏在墓库戌土下面，午又是自刑；旁边的子水发动，冲官星、伤官星，必定曾经冒犯上司，官不能理事。
本宫的父母爻，又遇旬空、季空，这是因为文书不清，得罪了上级衙门；问他，果然如此。
en: In the Gengyin year, Gengchen month, Jiaxu decade, on a Wuyin day, a divination on whether his tenure of office was safe gave Bo changing into Guan.

The Wu Fire star of office of the home palace lies hidden under Xu Earth, its tomb, and Wu punishes itself; the side Zi Water line moves, clashing with and injuring the star of office, so he must have offended his superior, and the official does not attend to affairs.
The Resource line of the home palace also falls in the decade Void and the seasonal Void; this is because his documents were unclear and he offended the higher office; asked, it was indeed so.

title: 官禄占·在任（七）：游魂化归魂宜致仕；世空杀动宜避罪；世持官加大杀动、鬼带亡劫动伤衰世、世身命爻俱空死墓绝者皆死于任所

rule.yi: 在任，退休、避罪和死在任上：游魂卦变归魂卦的，适宜退休（致仕）；世爻落空、凶煞发动的，适宜避罪；世爻持官星加大杀发动，或者官鬼带亡神、劫杀发动伤到衰弱的世爻，或者世爻、身爻、命爻都遇空、死、墓、绝的，都会死在任所。
rule.en: In office, retirement, evading a charge and dying at one's post. If a Wandering Soul hexagram turns into a Returning Soul hexagram, it is fitting to retire from office; if the Self is Void and a baleful spirit moves, it is fitting to evade a charge; if the Self holds the star of office and a great baleful spirit is added and moves, or Pressure carrying the Lost Spirit and Robbery moves to injure a weak Self, or the Self line, the Body line and the Life line are all Void, dead, in tomb or extinct, in every case he dies at his post.

dispute.yi: 「世空杀动」宜避罪，是黄金策仕宦章「身空杀动，避祸之征」（HJC.16）一路的说法；增删卜易（ZS.43）明说这样断不对：忌神发动而世爻落空，等到世爻出空的月份日子，必定遭它的害，怎么能避开。易隐这里没有给理由，也没有提出空的那一天。
dispute.en: 'The Self Void and a baleful spirit moving: evade a charge' is the same line of saying as the Huangjin Ce's 'Body Void and baleful spirit moving, a sign of avoiding misfortune' (HJC.16); the Zengshan Buyi (ZS.43) says plainly that this is wrong to judge so: when the Adversary moves and the Self is Void, the month or day when the Self leaves Void will surely bring its harm, so how could one avoid it. The Yi Yin gives no reason here and does not mention the day of leaving Void.

note.yi: 「致仕」是官员退休，「避罪」是躲开罪责。「大杀」「亡劫」是神煞的统称和简称（亡神、劫杀）。「命爻」书里没有说是哪一爻。游魂、归魂是八宫卦的两种位置（定义见术语表）。附断例的卦「归妹之泰」，书里说午化入戌、丑化入辰，译文照字面译，没有重排卦核对。
note.en: 'Zhishi' is an official's retirement and 'bizui' is avoiding blame. 'Great baleful spirit' and 'Wangjie' are a general name and an abbreviation for spirit-stars (the Lost Spirit and Robbery). The book does not say which line is the 'Life line'. The Wandering Soul and Returning Soul are two positions among the hexagrams of the eight palaces (defined in the glossary). For the example hexagram 'Guimei to Tai' the book says that Wu turns into Xu and Chou into Chen; the translation follows the letter and has not recast the hexagram to check.

zh: 游魂化归魂者，宜致仕也。
世持官，加大杀动，或鬼带亡劫动伤衰世，或世爻身爻命爻俱空死墓绝者，皆死于任所也。
yi: 游魂卦变归魂卦的，适宜退休致仕。
世爻落空、凶煞发动的，适宜避罪。
世爻持官星，加上大杀发动，或者官鬼带着亡神、劫杀发动，伤到衰弱的世爻，或者世爻、身爻、命爻都遇空、死、墓、绝的，都死在任所。
en: If a Wandering Soul hexagram turns into a Returning Soul hexagram, it is fitting to retire from office.
If the Self is Void and a baleful spirit moves, it is fitting to evade a charge.

If the Self holds the star of office and a great baleful spirit is added and moves, or Pressure carrying the Lost Spirit and Robbery moves to injure a weak Self, or the Self line, the Body line and the Life line are all Void, dead, in tomb or extinct, in every case he dies at his post.

zh: 庚寅年壬午月甲戌日，占在任安否，得归妹之泰。
午得化入戌墓，丑印化入辰墓，主灾死，惟致仕可免也。
yi: 庚寅年壬午月，甲戌日，占在任上平安与否，得归妹卦变泰卦。
午火变入戌墓，丑土的印星变入辰墓，主有灾祸甚至死亡，只有退休才能免。
en: In the Gengyin year, Renwu month, on a Jiaxu day, a divination on whether his tenure in office was safe gave Guimei changing into Tai.
Wu Fire turns into its tomb at Xu, and the Chou Earth seal turns into its tomb at Chen, which means disaster or even death, and only retiring from office can avoid it.

title: 官禄占·升迁（一）：世为臣应为君；世应生合比和者升；世生应我求进，应生世人荐举；应冲克世外除，应生合世内除

rule.yi: 升迁，世应论君臣：世爻是臣子，应爻是君上；世爻、应爻相生、相合、比和的，升迁；世爻生应爻，是我自己谋求进用，应爻生世爻，是别人荐举我；应爻冲克世爻，是外放任命，应爻生合世爻，是在京内任命。
rule.en: Promotion, the Self and the Other as subject and ruler. The Self is the subject and the Other is the ruler; if the Self and the Other generate, combine or are in harmony, he is promoted; if the Self generates the Other, it is I who seek advancement, and if the Other generates the Self, others recommend me; if the Other clashes with or controls the Self, he is appointed outside, and if the Other generates or combines with the Self, he is appointed within the capital.

note.yi: 「外除」是任命到京城以外的职位，「内除」是任命到京城之内的职位。第三句里的「人」译作别人，指有人在上面推荐我，和应爻是君上不是一回事。
note.en: 'Waichu' is appointment to a post outside the capital and 'neichu' is appointment to a post within it. 'Ren' in the third sentence is rendered as 'others', meaning that someone above recommends me, which is not the same as the Other line being the ruler.

zh: 世生应我求进，应生世人荐举。
应冲克世外除，应生合世内除也。
yi: 世爻是臣子，应爻是君上。
世爻、应爻相生、相合、比和的，升迁。
世爻生应爻，是我自己谋求进用；应爻生世爻，是别人荐举我。
应爻冲克世爻，是外放任命（外除）；应爻生合世爻，是在京内任命（内除）。
en: The Self is the subject and the Other is the ruler.
If the Self and the Other generate, combine or are in harmony, he is promoted.
If the Self generates the Other, it is I who seek advancement; if the Other generates the Self, others recommend me.
If the Other clashes with or controls the Self, he is appointed outside; if the Other generates or combines with the Self, he is appointed within the capital.

title: 官禄占·升迁（二）：世官旺动、财子同动、财独发、岁月生扶身世、官临唐符国印动、鬼加雀带雷火杀动者升；官化财平升；鬼化鬼逢进神超迁；逢退神调简；归魂官旺静复任；游魂官旺动远升；两父两官旺动鸳鸯求仕

rule.yi: 升迁的格局：世爻、官星旺相发动的，升；财爻、子孙一起发动的，升；财爻单独发动的，升；太岁、月建生扶身爻、世爻的，升；官星临唐符、国印而发动的，升；官鬼带朱雀、带雷火杀发动的，升；官星变财爻的，平稳而升；官鬼变官鬼遇到进神的，越级升迁；遇到退神的，调到事务简单的缺；归魂卦、官爻旺相安静的，必定复任；游魂卦、官爻旺相发动的，必定升到远处；游魂变游魂的，升了再升，而且在远处；卦里有两个父爻、两个官爻旺相发动的，是鸳鸯求仕。
rule.en: The patterns of promotion. If the Self and the star of office are thriving and moving, he is promoted; if Wealth and Output move together, he is promoted; if Wealth moves alone, he is promoted; if Tai Sui and the Month generate or support the Body and Self, he is promoted; if the star of office sits on Tangfu or the State Seal and moves, he is promoted; if Pressure with the Bird and the Thunder-Fire spirit moves, he is promoted; if the star of office turns into Wealth, he is promoted smoothly; if Pressure turns into Pressure and meets an Advancing spirit, he is promoted beyond his rank; if it meets a Retreating spirit, he is transferred to an easier post; in a Returning Soul hexagram with the Pressure line thriving and still, he returns to his post; in a Wandering Soul hexagram with the Pressure line thriving and moving, he is promoted far away; if a Wandering Soul turns into a Wandering Soul, he is promoted and then promoted again, in a distant place; if the hexagram has two seal lines and two star-of-office lines thriving and moving, it is 'mandarin ducks seeking office'.

note.yi: 这一句里有几处书里没有解释：「唐符」「国印」「雷火杀」是神煞；进神后面括号里的甲子、甲午、己卯、己酉是进神的干支：《卜筮全书》写「进神者，甲子、甲午、己卯、己酉」，和这里一致；「调简」按字面是调到简缺，即事务少的职位；「鸳鸯求仕」没有解释，按字面是成双地求官，译文不替它加意思。「复任」是回到原来的职位。
note.en: A few things in this passage are not explained in the book: 'Tangfu', 'the State Seal' and 'Thunder-Fire' are spirit-stars; the Jiazi, Jiawu, Jimao and Jiyou in brackets after the Advancing spirit are the ganzhi of the Advancing spirit: the Bushi Quanshu writes 'the Advancing spirit is Jiazi, Jiawu, Jimao and Jiyou', in agreement with this; 'tiaojian' is by the letter a transfer to a light post, that is one with few duties; 'mandarin ducks seeking office' has no explanation and by the letter means seeking office in a pair, and the translation does not add a sense to it. 'Furen' is returning to one's former post.

zh: 世官旺动者升，财子同动者升，财爻独发者升，岁月生扶身世者升，官临唐符国印动者升，鬼加雀带雷火杀动者升，官化财者平升，鬼化鬼逢进神(甲子甲午己卯己酉)则超迁。
归魂卦，官爻旺静者必复任。
游魂卦，官爻旺动者，必远升。
游魂化游魂，升后再升，远处也。
卦有两父两官旺动者，鸳鸯求仕也。
yi: 世爻、官星旺相发动的，升；财爻、子孙一起发动的，升；财爻单独发动的，升；太岁、月建生扶身爻、世爻的，升；官星临唐符、国印发动的，升；官鬼带朱雀、带雷火杀发动的，升；官星变财爻的，平稳而升；官鬼变官鬼遇到进神（甲子、甲午、己卯、己酉）的，越级升迁。
遇到退神，则调到事务简单的缺。
归魂卦，官爻旺相安静的，必定复任。
游魂卦，官爻旺相发动的，必定升到远处。
游魂卦变游魂卦，升了之后再升，而且在远处。
卦里有两个父爻、两个官爻旺相发动的，是鸳鸯求仕。
en: If the Self and the star of office are thriving and moving, he is promoted; if Wealth and Output move together, he is promoted; if the Wealth line moves alone, he is promoted; if Tai Sui and the Month generate or support the Body and Self, he is promoted; if the star of office sits on Tangfu or the State Seal and moves, he is promoted; if Pressure with the Bird and the Thunder-Fire spirit moves, he is promoted; if the star of office turns into Wealth, he is promoted smoothly; if Pressure turns into Pressure and meets an Advancing spirit (Jiazi, Jiawu, Jimao, Jiyou), he is promoted beyond his rank.
If it meets a Retreating spirit, he is transferred to an easier post.
In a Returning Soul hexagram, if the Pressure line is thriving and still, he surely returns to his post.
In a Wandering Soul hexagram, if the Pressure line is thriving and moving, he is surely promoted to a distant place.
If a Wandering Soul hexagram turns into a Wandering Soul hexagram, he is promoted and then promoted again, in a distant place.
If the hexagram has two seal lines and two star-of-office lines, thriving and moving, it is 'mandarin ducks seeking office'.

hits.text: 游魂化游魂，陛后再陛远处

title: 官禄占·升迁（三）：内旺外衰宜守旧；内衰外旺宜图新；内外俱旺彼此如意；雀临门户爻动吉报至；世空官空、官爻安静伏藏、身动刑岁月者皆不升

rule.yi: 升迁，守旧还是图新，以及不升的情形：内卦旺相、外卦衰弱，适宜守着旧职；内卦衰弱、外卦旺相，适宜谋求新职；内外都旺相，两头都称心；朱雀临在门户爻上发动的，喜报到来；世爻落空、官星落空，或者官爻安静伏藏，以及身爻发动、刑到太岁月建的，都不升迁。
rule.en: Promotion, keeping the old post or seeking a new one, and when there is no promotion. If the inside is thriving and the outside weak, it is fitting to keep the old post; if the inside is weak and the outside thriving, it is fitting to seek a new post; if both are thriving, either way goes as wished; if the Bird sits on the door-and-gate line and it moves, good news arrives; if the Self is Void and the star of office is Void, or the Pressure line is still and hidden, or the Body moves to punish Tai Sui and the Month, in every case he is not promoted.

note.yi: 「内」「外」指内卦和外卦。「门户爻」书里没有说是哪一爻，译文不替它定。
note.en: 'Inside' and 'outside' mean the inner and outer trigrams. The book does not say which line is the 'door-and-gate line', and the translation does not fix it.

zh: 雀临门户爻动者，吉报至也。
若世空官空或官爻安静伏藏，与身动刑岁月者，皆不升也。
yi: 内卦旺相、外卦衰弱的，适宜守着旧职。
内卦衰弱、外卦旺相的，适宜谋求新职。
内外都旺相，守旧、谋新两头都称心。
朱雀临在门户爻上而发动的，喜报到来。
如果世爻落空、官星落空，或者官爻安静伏藏，以及身爻发动、刑到太岁月建的，都不升迁。
en: If the inside is thriving and the outside weak, it is fitting to keep the old post.
If the inside is weak and the outside thriving, it is fitting to seek a new post.
If inside and outside are both thriving, either way goes as wished.
If the Bird sits on the door-and-gate line and it moves, good news arrives.
If the Self is Void and the star of office is Void, or the Pressure line is still and hidden, or the Body moves to punish Tai Sui and the Month, in every case he is not promoted.

title: 官禄占·替代：官旺者官逢死墓绝日代；子旺动者即时可代；卦无官者绝日可代；外卦阳者代速阴者替迟；占代官来者以应爻生旺世爻墓绝之日或官爻生旺月日为期

rule.yi: 被人替代：官星旺相的，到官星遇死、墓、绝的日子被人替代；子孙旺相发动的，立刻就可以被替代；卦里没有官星的，到官星绝的日子可以被替代；外卦是阳的，替代得快，是阴的，替代得慢。占接替自己的官员什么时候来，以应爻生旺、世爻入墓入绝的日子为期，或者以官爻生旺的月、日为期。
rule.en: Replacement. If the star of office is thriving, he is replaced on the day when it meets death, tomb or extinction; if Output is thriving and moving, he can be replaced at once; if the hexagram has no star of office, he can be replaced on the day of its extinction; if the outer trigram is yang the replacement is quick and if yin, slow. To divine when the official who will take over comes, take as the term the day when the Other is born or thriving and the Self goes into tomb or extinction, or the month or day when the Pressure line is born or thriving.

note.yi: 最后一句「以应爻生旺世爻墓绝之日为期」可以读成应爻生旺、世爻墓绝两件事同日，也可以读成两个日子，书里没有断开，译文保留原样。
note.en: In the last sentence, 'the day when the Other is born or thriving and the Self goes into tomb or extinction' can be read either as two events falling on the same day or as two alternative days; the book does not separate them, and the translation keeps it as written.

zh: 官旺者，官逢死墓绝日代也。
外卦阳者代速，阴者替迟也。
占代官来者，以应爻生旺世爻墓绝之日为期，或官爻生旺月日为期也。
yi: 官星旺相的，到官星遇死、墓、绝的日子被人替代。
子孙旺相发动的，立刻就可以被替代。
卦里没有官星的，到官星绝的日子可以被替代。
外卦是阳的，替代得快；是阴的，替代得慢。
占接替自己的官员什么时候来，以应爻生旺、世爻入墓入绝的日子为期，或者以官爻生旺的月、日为期。
en: If the star of office is thriving, he is replaced on the day when the star of office meets death, tomb or extinction.
If Output is thriving and moving, he can be replaced at once.
If the hexagram has no star of office, he can be replaced on the day of its extinction.
If the outer trigram is yang the replacement is quick; if it is yin the replacement is slow.

To divine when the official who will take over comes, take as the term the day when the Other is born or thriving and the Self goes into tomb or extinction, or the month or day when the Pressure line is born or thriving.

title: 官禄占·贪廉（一）：官印皆旺财爻不见者廉；世持兄旺动者贪；世下伏兄化兄者贪

rule.yi: 为官贪还是廉：官星、印星都旺相，财爻不出现的，清廉；世爻持兄爻、旺相发动的，贪；世爻下伏着兄爻、又变成兄爻的，贪。
rule.en: Greed or integrity in office. If the star of office and the seal are both thriving and the Wealth line does not appear, he is incorruptible; if the Self holds a Peer line that is thriving and moving, he is greedy; if a Peer line lies hidden under the Self and turns into a Peer line, he is greedy.

zh: 官印皆旺，财爻不见者廉。
yi: 官星、印星都旺相，财爻不出现的，清廉。
世爻持兄爻，旺相发动的，贪。
世爻下伏着兄爻、又变成兄爻的，贪。
en: If the star of office and the seal are both thriving and the Wealth line does not appear, he is incorruptible.
If the Self holds a Peer line that is thriving and moving, he is greedy.
If a Peer line lies hidden under the Self and turns into a Peer line, he is greedy.

title: 官禄占·贪廉（二）：世持虎鬼加刑刃劫杀动者酷；世持鬼加玄武咸池荒芜四废杀动者罢软；世持虎鬼加雷火卒暴杀动者浮躁；世加天解天赦喝散动者昭雪滞狱

rule.yi: 为官的品性：世爻持白虎、官鬼，再加刑、刃、劫杀发动的，酷；世爻持官鬼，再加玄武、咸池、荒芜、四废杀发动的，疲软无能；世爻持白虎、官鬼，再加雷火、卒暴杀发动的，浮躁；世爻带天解、天赦、喝散发动的，能为积压的冤狱昭雪。
rule.en: The character of the official. If the Self holds the Tiger and Pressure and the punishing, blade and Robbery spirits are added and move, he is cruel; if the Self holds Pressure and the Dark Tortoise, Xianchi, Huangwu and the Four Wastes baleful spirits are added and move, he is feeble and soft; if the Self holds the Tiger and Pressure and the Thunder-Fire and Sudden-Violence baleful spirits are added and move, he is rash and restless; if the Self carries Tianjie, Tianshe and Hesan and they move, he clears and redresses cases long held up in prison.

note.yi: 第一句「刑刃劫杀」分在两行里，中间被断行隔开（「加刑刃」在上一行末，「劫杀动者」在下一行首），这里连起来读。「罢软」的「罢」读作疲。天解、天赦、喝散、荒芜、四废、卒暴、咸池等都是神煞，书里没有逐个解释，译文只音译或按字面译。「滞狱」是拖着没有判决的案子。
note.en: In the first sentence 'xing ren jie sha' is split across two lines, 'adding the punishment and blade' at the end of the earlier line and 'Robbery moving' at the start of the next, and is read here joined up. In 'ruan' of 'baruan', the character 'ba' is read as 'pi', weary. Tianjie, Tianshe, Hesan, Huangwu, the Four Wastes, Cubao, Xianchi and the others are spirit-stars that the book does not explain one by one, and the translation only gives their sounds or translates them by the letter. 'Zhiyu' is a case dragging on without judgment.

zh: 世持虎鬼，加刑刃劫杀动者，酷也。
世持鬼，加玄武咸池荒芜四废杀动者，罢软也。
世持虎鬼，加雷火卒暴杀动者，浮躁也。
世加天解天赦喝散动者，昭雪滞狱也。
yi: 世爻持白虎、官鬼，再加刑、刃、劫杀发动的，酷。
世爻持官鬼，再加玄武、咸池、荒芜、四废杀发动的，疲软无能。
世爻持白虎、官鬼，再加雷火、卒暴杀发动的，浮躁。
世爻带天解、天赦、喝散发动的，能为积压的冤狱昭雪。
en: If the Self holds the Tiger and Pressure and the punishing, blade and Robbery spirits are added and move, he is cruel.
If the Self holds Pressure and the Dark Tortoise, Xianchi, Huangwu and the Four Wastes baleful spirits are added and move, he is feeble and soft.
If the Self holds the Tiger and Pressure and the Thunder-Fire and Sudden-Violence baleful spirits are added and move, he is rash and restless.
If the Self carries Tianjie, Tianshe and Hesan and they move, he clears and redresses cases long held up in prison.

title: 官禄占·贪廉（三）：财空鬼旺廉名振而囊槖空；父空官旺爵位高而琴鹤随；父母为行李；初爻为吏民，初爻克官克世主贤明，世官克初主苛刻，生初主慈爱

rule.yi: 清名与属吏：财爻落空、官鬼旺相的，清廉的名声很响，而口袋是空的；父爻落空、官星旺相的，爵位高，身边只有琴和鹤相随；父母爻是行李。初爻代表属吏和百姓：初爻克官星、克世爻的，主这个官贤明，属吏百姓亲近他；世爻、官爻克初爻的，主这个官苛刻，属吏百姓畏惧躲避他；生初爻的，主这个官慈爱属吏百姓。
rule.en: A clean name, and the clerks and people. If Wealth is Void and Pressure thriving, his name for incorruptibility rings out while his purse is empty; if the seal line is Void and the star of office thriving, his rank is high while only the zither and the crane follow him; the Resource line is the baggage. The first line stands for clerks and people: if the first line controls the star of office or the Self, he is wise and enlightened and the clerks and people are close to him; if the Self line or the Pressure line controls the first line, he is harsh and the clerks and people fear and avoid him; if it generates the first line, he is kind and loving towards them.

note.yi: 「琴鹤」用的是宋代赵抃只带一张琴、一只鹤去赴任的典故，比喻做官清廉；「囊槖」是口袋。「父空官旺」的父单字，按上面的用法译成印星；括号里的「父母为行李」是说父母爻代表行李（见 YY.13 赴任的分爻）。最后一句的主语省了，承上一句，是世爻、官爻。
note.en: 'Qin he' is the allusion to Zhao Bian of the Song, who went to his post taking only one zither and one crane, an image of an incorruptible official; 'nangtuo' is a bag. The single character 'father' in 'father Void, official thriving' is rendered as the seal line as above; the bracket 'the Resource line is baggage' says that the Resource line stands for baggage (see the division of lines for going to the post in YY.13). The subject of the last sentence is left out, following on from the previous one, and is the Self line and the Pressure line.

zh: 财空鬼旺者，廉名振而囊槖空也。
父空官旺者，爵位高而琴鹤随也。
又初爻为吏民，初爻克官克世者，主贤明，吏民亲迩也。
世爻官爻克初者，主苛刻，吏民畏避。
生初爻者，主慈爱吏民也。
yi: 财爻落空、官鬼旺相的，清廉的名声很响，而口袋是空的。
父爻落空、官星旺相的，爵位高，而身边只有琴和鹤相随。
（父母爻是行李。）
又，初爻代表属吏和百姓；初爻克官星、克世爻的，主这个官贤明，属吏和百姓亲近他。
世爻、官爻克初爻的，主这个官苛刻，属吏和百姓畏惧躲避他。
生初爻的，主这个官慈爱属吏和百姓。
en: If Wealth is Void and Pressure is thriving, his name for incorruptibility rings out while his purse is empty.
If the seal line is Void and the star of office thriving, his rank is high while only the zither and the crane follow him.
(The Resource line stands for baggage.)
Again, the first line stands for clerks and people; if the first line controls the star of office or the Self, it means he is wise and enlightened, and the clerks and people are close to him.
If the Self line or the Pressure line controls the first line, he is harsh, and the clerks and people fear and avoid him.
If it generates the first line, he is kind and loving towards the clerks and people.

title: 官禄占·官职退复（一）：子旺动父休空官墓绝必退职；欲知退职岁时以卦身为主，从卦身数到占卜之月，数几位失职几月

rule.yi: 官职退复，失去职位：子孙旺相发动，父爻休囚落空，官星入墓入绝的，必定退职。想知道哪年哪月退职，只以卦身为主：从卦身所在的地支顺数到占卜的那个月，数过几个位置，就失职几个月——丑月占得噬嗑，卦身在戌，戌、亥、子，三位，失职三个月；午月占得艮，卦身在巳，一位，一个月；辰月占得蛊，卦身在寅，两位，两个月。其余照这样推。
rule.en: Loss and recovery of office, losing the post. If Output is thriving and moving, the seal line is resting and Void, and the star of office is in tomb or extinct, he surely loses his post. To know the year and time of losing it, take the hexagram Body as the main thing: count from the branch where the Body lies to the month of the divination, and the number of places passed is the number of months of the post lost. In a Chou month, getting Shihe with the Body at Xu: Xu, Hai, Zi, three places, the post is lost for three months; in a Wu month, getting Gen with the Body at Si: one place, one month; in a Chen month, getting Gu with the Body at Yin: two places, two months. The rest follow this.

note.yi: 三个例子数的都是从卦身的地支顺着地支次序数到占卜月的地支：戌、亥、子、丑（过三位），巳、午（过一位），寅、卯、辰（过两位）。这三个卦身也和通行的起法相符：噬嗑世在五爻、阴世从午起，数到五爻是戌；艮世在上爻、阳世从子起，数到上爻是巳；蛊世在三爻、阳世从子起，数到三爻是寅。「退度」的「退」是退职的退，不是倒着数。
note.en: In all three examples the count runs forward along the order of the branches from the branch of the Body to the branch of the month of the divination: Xu, Hai, Zi, Chou (three places passed), Si, Wu (one place), Yin, Mao, Chen (two places). The three Bodies also agree with the usual way of finding it: in Shihe the Self is on the fifth line and a yin Self counts from Wu, which reaches Xu at the fifth; in Gen the Self is on the top line and a yang Self counts from Zi, which reaches Si at the top; in Gu the Self is on the third line and a yang Self counts from Zi, which reaches Yin at the third. The 'retreat' of 'retreating through places' is the retreat of retiring from office and not counting backwards.

zh: 子旺动，父休空，官墓绝者，必退职也。
欲知退职岁时，但以卦身为主。
如丑月来卜，得噬嗑卦，身在戌也，则戌亥子，退度三位，乃失职三月也。
又如午月来卜，得艮卦，身在巳也。
退度一位，乃失职一月也。
又如辰月来卜，得蛊卦，身在寅也，退度二位，乃失职二月也。
yi: 子孙旺相发动，父爻休囚落空，官星入墓入绝的，必定退职。
想知道退职的年月，只以卦身为主。
比如丑月来占，得噬嗑卦，卦身在戌，那么戌、亥、子，退过三个位置，是失职三个月。
又比如午月来占，得艮卦，卦身在巳。
退过一个位置，是失职一个月。
又比如辰月来占，得蛊卦，卦身在寅，退过两个位置，是失职两个月。
（其余照这样推。）
en: If Output is thriving and moving, the seal line is resting and Void, and the star of office is in tomb or extinct, he surely loses his post.
To know the year and time of losing the post, take the hexagram Body as the main thing.
For example, if one divines in a Chou month and gets Shihe, with the Body at Xu, then Xu, Hai, Zi: retreating through three places means the post is lost for three months.
Again, if one divines in a Wu month and gets Gen, the Body is at Si.
Retreating one place means the post is lost for one month.
Again, if one divines in a Chen month and gets Gu, with the Body at Yin, retreating through two places means the post is lost for two months.
(The rest follow this.)

title: 官禄占·官职退复（二）：官遇三传生扶必起复；世下伏官伏印马必官印临值之年月日起官；官父持身世旺静必冲动官印之年月日起官；旁爻带贵马旺动生官印得贵人提拔；旁爻兄弟带亡劫隔神刑冲官印必有匪人相隔

rule.yi: 起复，重新起用：官星遇到三传（太岁、月建、日辰）生扶的，必定起复；世爻下伏着官星，或伏着印星、驿马的，必定在官星、印星当值的年月日起复；官星、印星持身爻、世爻，旺相安静的，必定在冲动官星、印星的年月日起复；旁边的爻带贵人、驿马，旺相发动，来生身爻、世爻上的官星、印星的，必得贵人提拔，在相生的年月日起复；旁边的兄弟爻旺相发动，带亡神、劫杀、隔神来刑、冲、克、害身爻、世爻上的官星、印星的，必有小人从中阻隔、坏事。
rule.en: Being recalled to office. If the star of office meets generation and support from the three rulers, he is surely recalled; if the star of office lies hidden under the Self, or the seal and the Horse lie hidden, he is recalled in the year, month or day when the star of office and seal rule; if the star of office and seal hold the Body and Self, thriving and still, he is recalled in the year, month or day that clashes them into motion; if a side line carrying the Noble and the Horse is thriving and moving and generates the star of office and seal on the Body and Self, he gets a patron's promotion and is recalled in the year, month or day of generation; if a side Peer line is thriving and moving, carrying the Lost Spirit, Robbery and the obstructing spirit, and punishes, clashes, controls or harms the star of office and seal on the Body and Self, there will surely be bad men who stand between and spoil the matter.

note.yi: 附断例是《易隐》官禄占末尾的一例，放在最相关的这一条下；书里没有说占的是哪一年的什么日子，只说「是月是日」，接的是前一例庚寅年壬午月甲戌日。「隔神」是神煞的一种，书里没有解释。第四、五句里「相生之年月日」承上一句，是旁边的贵人、驿马生到官星、印星的年月日。
note.en: The example is one of those appended at the end of this chapter of the Yi Yin, and is placed under the entry it illustrates most; the book does not give the year or day of the divination, saying only 'that month, that day', following on the previous example of the Gengyin year, Renwu month, Jiaxu day. 'Geshen' is a kind of spirit-star that the book does not explain. In the fourth and fifth sentences 'the year, month or day of generation' follows on from the previous sentence, and is the year, month or day in which the side Noble and Post Horse generate the star of office and seal.

zh: 又官遇三传生扶者，必起复也。
世下伏官，与伏印马者，必官印临值之年月日起官也。
官父持身世旺静者，必冲动官印之年月日起官也。
旁爻带贵马旺动来生身世上官印者，必得贵人提拔。
以相生之年月日起官也。
若旁爻兄弟旺动，带亡劫隔神来刑冲克害身世上官印者，必有匪人相隔坏事也。
yi: 又，官星遇到三传（太岁、月建、日辰）生扶的，必定起复。
世爻下伏着官星，以及伏着印星、驿马的，必定在官星、印星当值的年月日起复做官。
官星、印星持身爻、世爻，旺相安静的，必定在冲动官星、印星的年月日起复做官。
旁边的爻带着贵人、驿马，旺相发动，来生身爻、世爻上的官星、印星的，必定得到贵人提拔。
以相生的年月日起复做官。
如果旁边的兄弟爻旺相发动，带着亡神、劫杀、隔神，来刑、冲、克、害身爻、世爻上的官星、印星，必有小人从中阻隔、坏事。
en: Again, if the star of office meets generation and support from the three rulers, he is surely recalled to office.
If the star of office lies hidden under the Self, or the seal and the Horse lie hidden, he is surely recalled to office in the year, month or day when the star of office and seal rule.
If the star of office and the seal hold the Body and Self and are thriving and still, he is surely recalled in the year, month or day that clashes the star of office and seal into motion.
If a side line carrying the Noble and the Horse is thriving and moving and generates the star of office and seal on the Body and Self, he surely gets a patron's promotion.
He is recalled to office in the year, month or day of generation.

But if a side Peer line is thriving and moving, carrying the Lost Spirit, Robbery and the obstructing spirit, and comes to punish, clash, control or harm the star of office and seal on the Body and Self, there will surely be bad men who stand between and spoil the matter.

zh: 是月是日有占起官者，得剥之晋。
世临子水，伏申金，金生水为印绶。
又寅年午月戌日，马聚于申，世下伏印马，后必起官。
但嫌本宫午官伏戌墓下，须待壬辰年冲开戌墓，透出午官，又辰年与世爻飞伏申子三合，故其年上寅月，可用财求谋，官生在寅也。
丙午月得官，官旺于午也。
近则未月到任，远则戌月到任也。
土为印绶，未与午官六合，戌与午官三合也。
yi: 这个月这一天有人占起复做官，得剥卦变晋卦。
世爻临子水，伏着申金，金生水，是印绶。
又是寅年、午月、戌日，驿马聚在申，世爻下面伏着印星和驿马，后来必定起复做官。
但是嫌本宫的午火官星伏在戌墓下面，必须等到壬辰年冲开戌墓，透出午火官星；而且辰年与世爻的飞神子水、伏神申金三合，所以那一年到寅月，可以用钱财去谋求，官星生在寅。
丙午月得到官职，官星在午旺。
近的话是未月到任，远的话是戌月到任。
土是印绶，未与午官星六合，戌与午官星三合。
en: In that month and on that day someone divined on being recalled to office and got Bo changing into Jin.
The Self sits on Zi Water, with Shen Metal hidden, and Metal generates Water, so it is the seal and ribbon.
It is also a Yin year, Wu month and Xu day, and the Horse gathers at Shen, and the seal and the Horse lie hidden under the Self, so he will surely be recalled to office later.

But what is disliked is that the Wu Fire star of office of the home palace lies hidden under the Xu tomb; he must wait for the Renchen year, when the Xu tomb is clashed open and the Wu Fire star of office comes out; moreover the Chen year forms a three-harmony with the flying Zi Water and the hidden Shen Metal of the Self line, so in that year by the Yin month he can use money to seek it, since the star of office is born in Yin.
He gets the office in the Bingwu month, since the star of office is thriving in Wu.
Nearer, he takes up his post in the Wei month; further off, in the Xu month.
Earth is the seal and ribbon, and Wei forms a six-combination with the Wu star of office, and Xu forms a three-harmony with it.

title: 官禄占·丁忧起复：财带白衣杀或财加虎杀会月建动刑克父母阳丁父艰阴丁母艰；二爻五爻带白衣杀旺动伤世克官二母忧五父忧；后遇生合官印之年月起复

rule.yi: 丁忧起复，遭父母之丧和重新起用：财爻带白衣杀，或财爻加白虎杀，又会合月建，发动来刑克父母爻的，阳爻是遭父亲的丧，阴爻是遭母亲的丧；二爻、五爻（二爻是母，五爻是父）带白衣杀旺相发动，伤世爻、克官星的，二爻是母亲的丧事，五爻是父亲的丧事；后来遇到生合官星、印星的年月，必定起复，或者官星、印星生旺的年月起复做官。
rule.en: Mourning and recall. If the Wealth line carries the White Garment baleful spirit, or Wealth carries the Tiger spirit and meets the Month, and moves to punish or control the Resource line, then if it is yang he is in mourning for his father and if yin for his mother; if the second or fifth line (the second is the mother and the fifth the father) carries the White Garment spirit, thriving and moving, and injures the Self and controls the star of office, the second line means mourning for the mother and the fifth line mourning for the father; later, in the year or month that generates or combines with the star of office and seal, he is surely recalled, or in the year or month when the star of office and seal are born or thriving he is recalled to office.

note.yi: 「丁忧」「丁父艰」「丁母艰」都是遭父母之丧，官员须去职回家守丧（「丁制」，见 YY.01）；「白衣杀」是主孝服的神煞。「阳丁父艰，阴丁母艰」是看被刑克的那一爻是阳还是阴。
note.en: 'Dingyou', 'ding fu jian' and 'ding mu jian' all mean mourning for a parent, when an official must leave his post and go home to keep mourning ('dingzhi', see YY.01); 'White Garment' is the spirit-star that signifies mourning dress. 'Yang for the father's mourning, yin for the mother's' depends on whether the line being punished or controlled is yang or yin.

zh: 凡财爻带白衣杀，或财加虎杀，会月建动来刑克父母爻者，阳丁父艰，阴丁母艰也。
又二爻五爻(二为母五为父)带白衣杀旺动伤世克官者，二爻则母忧，五爻则父忧也。
后遇生合官印之年月必起复，或官印生旺之年月起官也。
yi: 凡是财爻带着白衣杀，或者财爻加白虎杀，又会合月建，发动来刑克父母爻的，阳爻是遭父亲的丧，阴爻是遭母亲的丧。
又，二爻、五爻（二爻是母，五爻是父）带着白衣杀，旺相发动，伤世爻、克官星的，二爻是母亲的丧事，五爻是父亲的丧事。
后来遇到生合官星、印星的年月，必定起复；或者官星、印星生旺的年月，起复做官。
en: Whenever the Wealth line carries the White Garment baleful spirit, or Wealth carries the Tiger spirit and meets the Month, and moves to punish or control the Resource line, then if it is yang he is in mourning for his father and if yin for his mother.

Again, if the second or fifth line (the second is the mother and the fifth the father) carries the White Garment baleful spirit, thriving and moving, and injures the Self and controls the star of office, the second line means mourning for the mother and the fifth line mourning for the father.

Later, in the year or month that generates or combines with the star of office and seal, he is surely recalled; or in the year or month when the star of office and seal are born or thriving, he is recalled to office.

title: 朝廷占总述（游南子）：占朝廷与臣庶异，以世爻所居之卦为国；世爻五爻为君，应爻二爻为后；子孙国储，妻财妃嫔帑藏，父母城池，兄弟劫神，官鬼奸贼；初民二士三大夫四公卿五天子六宗庙；卜世卜年另有一法

rule.yi: 占朝廷的事和占臣子百姓自己的事不同：以世爻所在的那个单卦当作国家；世爻和五爻都是君主，君主自己占取世爻为用神，臣子百姓代他占取五爻；应爻和二爻是皇后；子孙是储君，妻财是妃嫔也是国库，父母是城池，兄弟是劫神，官鬼是奸贼；初爻是百姓，二爻是士人，三爻是大夫，四爻是公卿，五爻是天子，六爻是宗庙朝廷。察看各爻的生克旺衰，国家的利弊兴衰就看得清清楚楚；至于占国家传几世、延续几年，另有一种方法。
rule.en: Divining for the court differs from divining for ministers and commoners: the trigram in which the Self line sits stands for the state; the Self and the fifth line are both the ruler, and when the ruler divines for himself the Self is taken as the Subject, while ministers and commoners divining on his behalf take the fifth line; the Other line and the second line are the empress; Output is the heir apparent, Wealth is the consorts and also the treasury, Resource is the city walls and moats, Peer is the robber spirit, and Pressure is the traitors and bandits; the first line is the common people, the second the scholars, the third the great officers, the fourth the ministers of state, the fifth the Son of Heaven, and the sixth the ancestral temple and court. Look at the generation, control, strength and weakness of each line and the gains and losses and rise and fall of the state are as clear as the palm of one's hand; as for divining how many reigns or years the dynasty will last, there is another method.

note.yi: 「单卦」是三爻卦，指内卦或外卦，世爻在哪个三爻里，哪个就是国（见 YY.32）。「劫神」是主夺取、劫掠的凶神。「用神」是占问时被拿来看这件事成败的那个爻。这一节是整个朝廷占的纲，后面各小节都是按这里的分配来断。
note.en: A 'single trigram' is a trigram of three lines, the inner or the outer trigram: whichever trigram holds the Self line is the state (see YY.32). The 'robber spirit' is the baleful spirit of seizing and plundering. The 'Subject' is the line taken as the matter asked about. This section is the outline of the whole divination for the court, and the sections after it judge by the assignments made here.

zh: 以世爻所居之卦为国也。
世爻为君，五爻亦为君也。
主上自占，以世爻为用，臣庶代卜，以五爻为用也。
子孙为国储，妻财为妃嫔，亦为帑藏。
父母为城池，兄弟为劫神，官鬼为奸贼也。
又初爻民，二爻士，三爻大夫，四爻公卿，五爻天子，六爻宗庙朝廷也。
察各爻之生克旺衰，而国家之利弊兴替已了若指掌也。
若乃卜世卜年，又自有一法焉。
yi: 游南子说。
占朝廷的事，和占臣子百姓自己的事不同。
以世爻所在的那个单卦当作国家。
世爻是君主，五爻也是君主。
君主自己占，以世爻为用神；臣子百姓代他占，以五爻为用神。
应爻是皇后，二爻也是皇后。
子孙是储君，妻财是妃嫔，也是国库。
父母是城池，兄弟是劫神，官鬼是奸贼。
又，初爻是百姓，二爻是士人，三爻是大夫，四爻是公卿，五爻是天子，六爻是宗庙朝廷。
察看各爻的生克旺衰，国家的利弊兴衰就清楚得像看自己的手掌。
至于占国家传几世、延续几年，又另有一种方法。
en: Master Younan says.
Divining for the court is different from divining for ministers and commoners.
The trigram in which the Self line sits is taken as the state.
The Self line is the ruler, and the fifth line is also the ruler.
When the sovereign divines for himself he takes the Self line as the Subject; when ministers and commoners divine on his behalf, they take the fifth line as the Subject.
The Other line is the empress, and the second line is also the empress.
Output is the heir apparent; Wealth is the consorts, and also the treasury.
Resource is the city walls and moats, Peer is the robber spirit, and Pressure is the traitors and bandits.

Again, the first line is the common people, the second the scholars, the third the great officers, the fourth the ministers of state, the fifth the Son of Heaven, and the sixth the ancestral temple and court.
Look at the generation, control, strength and weakness of each line, and the gains and losses and rise and fall of the state are as clear as the palm of one's hand.
As for divining how many reigns or years the dynasty will last, there is yet another method.

title: 朝廷占·大象（一）：世爻所居之卦为国——旺相国治天下平，胎没次之，死囚休废国祚陵夷；空亡巡游无度；冲破疆围不固；刑克奸宄窃发；受害臣庶离心；岁生旺宫国运炎隆，岁克衰卦宗社将倾

rule.yi: 大象，国运的总势：世爻所在的那个单卦就是国家。它旺相，国家治理得好，天下太平；胎、没次一等；死、囚、休、废，国运就衰落下去。它落空亡，君主巡游没有节制；被冲破，疆界不稳固；被刑克，奸邪作乱的人暗中起事；受害，臣子百姓离心。太岁生旺这一宫，国运炽盛；太岁克制衰弱的卦，国家的宗庙社稷将要倾覆。
rule.en: The great image, the general trend of the state's fortune. The trigram in which the Self line sits is the state. If it is thriving, the state is well governed and the world at peace; the stages Tai and Mo come next; if it is dead, imprisoned, resting or abandoned, the dynasty declines. If it falls into Void, the sovereign tours without restraint; if it is clashed or broken, the borders are not secure; if it is punished or controlled, treacherous rebels rise in secret; if it is harmed, ministers and commoners lose heart. If Tai Sui generates a thriving palace, the state's fortune is blazing; if Tai Sui controls a weak trigram, the ancestral temple and altars of the state are about to fall.

note.yi: 「旺相胎没死囚休废」是单卦随季节的八种状态，书里没有逐一解释（征战占「方向」把八个卦在八个节气里的状态逐项列了出来，见 YY.51），译文把前四个当作由好到差的顺序，后四个当作衰败。第八句「岁生旺官」的「官」，和后面「旺宫」对照应是「宫」字抄错，译文按「宫」译；第九句「岁克衰卦」正是同一对仗。「宗社」是宗庙和社稷，代指国家。
note.en: The eight states, thriving, assisting, Tai, Mo, dead, imprisoned, resting and abandoned, are the states of a trigram through the seasons; the book does not explain each (the 'direction' section of the divination of war sets out the state of each of the eight trigrams in the eight solar terms, see YY.51), and the translation takes the first four as a descent from good to poor and the last four as decline. In the eighth sentence the character for 'official' in 'thriving official' is, compared with 'thriving palace' later on, presumably a miscopy for 'palace', and the translation follows 'palace'; the ninth sentence, 'Tai Sui controls a weak trigram', is the same pair. 'Zongshe' is the ancestral temple and the altars of soil and grain, standing for the state.

zh: 旺相，则国治，而天下平也。
胎没次之，死囚休废，则国祚陵夷也。
岁生旺官者，国运炎隆也。
岁克衰卦者，宗社将倾也。
yi: 世爻所在的那个单卦就是国家。
旺相，国家就治理得好，天下太平。
胎、没次一等；死、囚、休、废，国运就衰落下去。
落空亡，君主就巡游没有节制。
被冲、被破，疆界就不稳固。
被刑、被克，奸邪作乱的人就暗中起事。
受害，臣子百姓就离心。
太岁生旺这一宫的，国运炽盛。
太岁克制衰弱的卦的，宗庙社稷将要倾覆。
en: The trigram in which the Self line sits is the state.
If it is thriving, the state is well governed and the world is at peace.
The stages Tai and Mo come next; if it is dead, imprisoned, resting or abandoned, the dynasty declines.
If it falls into Void, the sovereign tours without restraint.
If it is clashed or broken, the borders are not secure.
If it is punished or controlled, treacherous rebels rise in secret.
If it is harmed, ministers and commoners lose heart.
If Tai Sui generates a thriving palace, the state's fortune is blazing.
If Tai Sui controls a weak trigram, the ancestral temple and altars are about to fall.

title: 朝廷占·大象（二）：鬼带亡劫在内卦动防奸细，暗动伤身世有阴谋；金鬼带大杀临旺宫动兵革兴，水洪浸，火旱魃，木稼穑痒，土疫疠；鬼空动虽凶无害

rule.yi: 大象，灾变：官鬼带亡神、劫杀，在内卦发动的，要提防奸细；官鬼带亡神、劫杀，暗中发动而伤身爻、世爻的，有阴谋。金爻的官鬼带大杀，临在旺相的宫里发动，兵祸起；水爻的，有洪水浸泡之灾；火爻的，旱魃肆虐；木爻的，庄稼受害；土爻的，瘟疫流行。官鬼落空而发动的，虽然凶也没有大害。
rule.en: The great image, disasters and upheavals. If Pressure carrying the Lost Spirit and Robbery moves in the inner trigram, beware of spies; if Pressure carrying the Lost Spirit and Robbery moves secretly to injure the Body and Self, there is a plot. If a Metal Pressure line carrying a great baleful spirit sits in a thriving palace and moves, war arises; if Water, flood disaster; if Fire, the drought demon rages; if Wood, the crops are blighted; if Earth, pestilence breaks out. If Pressure is Void and moves, though it is ominous it does no harm.

note.yi: 第十一句「临旺官动」的「官」和后四句的「旺宫」对照，应是「宫」字抄错，译文按「宫」译。「旱魃」是传说中造成旱灾的鬼怪。「稼穑痒」的「痒」字面是发痒，疑是「恙」（病害）之误，译文按庄稼受害译。「亡劫」是亡神和劫杀（见 YY.20）。
note.en: In the eleventh sentence the character for 'official' in 'thriving official' is, compared with 'thriving palace' in the four sentences after it, presumably a miscopy for 'palace', and the translation follows 'palace'. 'Hanba' is the legendary demon that brings drought. In 'jiase yang', 'yang' literally means itchy and is presumably a miswriting of 'yang', sickness and harm, so the crops being blighted is what is translated. 'Wangjie' is the Lost Spirit and Robbery (see YY.20).

zh: 鬼带亡劫在内卦动者，防奸细也。
鬼带亡劫，暗动伤身世者，有阴谋也。
金鬼带大杀，临旺官动者，兵革兴也。
水鬼带大杀，临旺宫动者，洪浸灾也。
火鬼带大杀，临旺宫动者，旱魃虐也。
木鬼带大杀，临旺宫动者，稼穑痒也。
土鬼带大杀，临旺宫动者，疫疠作也。
yi: 官鬼带亡神、劫杀，在内卦发动的，要提防奸细。
官鬼带亡神、劫杀，暗中发动而伤身爻、世爻的，有阴谋。
金爻的官鬼带大杀，临在旺相的宫里发动的，兵祸兴起。
水爻的官鬼带大杀，临在旺相的宫里发动的，有洪水浸泡之灾。
火爻的官鬼带大杀，临在旺相的宫里发动的，旱魃肆虐。
木爻的官鬼带大杀，临在旺相的宫里发动的，庄稼受害。
土爻的官鬼带大杀，临在旺相的宫里发动的，瘟疫流行。
官鬼落空而发动的，虽然凶也没有大害。
en: If Pressure carrying the Lost Spirit and Robbery moves in the inner trigram, beware of spies.
If Pressure carrying the Lost Spirit and Robbery moves secretly to injure the Body and Self, there is a plot.
If a Metal Pressure line carrying a great baleful spirit sits in a thriving palace and moves, war arises.
If a Water Pressure line carrying a great baleful spirit sits in a thriving palace and moves, there is the disaster of flood.
If a Fire Pressure line carrying a great baleful spirit sits in a thriving palace and moves, the drought demon rages.
If a Wood Pressure line carrying a great baleful spirit sits in a thriving palace and moves, the crops are blighted.
If an Earth Pressure line carrying a great baleful spirit sits in a thriving palace and moves, pestilence breaks out.
If Pressure is Void and moves, though it is ominous it does no harm.

title: 朝廷占·大象（三）：欲知何方以八卦定；鬼杀值胎养长生乱方始，临官帝旺乱正炽，死墓绝乱将止；离动化坎北狩，兑动化震东迁，坎动化离南渡，震动化兑西征；逢六合安静太平，逢六冲乱动多变故

rule.yi: 大象，方位、祸乱的阶段和迁徙：想知道事情在哪个方向，用八卦来定。官鬼和凶煞值胎、养、长生，祸乱刚开始；值临官、帝旺，祸乱正炽盛；值死、墓、绝，祸乱将要平息。离卦发动变坎卦，君主将要北狩；兑卦发动变震卦，想往东迁；坎卦发动变离卦，想往南渡；震卦发动变兑卦，必定西征。卦遇六合，安静的太平；遇六冲、乱动的，变故很多。
rule.en: The great image, direction, the stage of the disorder, and moving the court. To know in which direction, fix it by the eight trigrams. If Pressure and a baleful spirit are in the stages of Tai, Yang or Birth, the disorder is just beginning; in Official Post or Emperor's Peak, the disorder is at its height; in death, tomb or extinction, the disorder is about to cease. Li moving and turning into Kan: the sovereign will go on a northern hunt; Dui moving and turning into Zhen: he thinks of moving east; Kan moving and turning into Li: he wishes to cross to the south; Zhen moving and turning into Dui: he will surely march west. If the hexagram is a six-combine and still, there is peace; if it meets the six-clash and moves wildly, there are many upheavals.

note.yi: 「北狩」是天子被迫离开京城、出走或被掳往北方的委婉说法（宋徽宗、钦宗和明英宗都被说成北狩）；「南渡」是朝廷迁往南方；「东迁」「西征」按字面。四句是按八卦方位配的：离在南、坎在北、兑在西、震在东，变成的那一卦所在的方位，就是去的方向。这个读法是书里没有明写的，译文只照字面译四句。「胎养长生」「临官帝旺」是十二长生的位置，「六合」「六冲」指卦的六合、六冲（见术语表）。
note.en: 'Beishou', the northern hunt, is the euphemism for the Son of Heaven being driven out of the capital, fleeing or being carried off to the north (the Huizong and Qinzong emperors of the Song and the Yingzong emperor of the Ming are all said to have gone on a northern hunt); 'nandu' is the court crossing to the south; 'eastward move' and 'westward march' are by the letter. The four sentences are matched with the directions of the eight trigrams: Li is south, Kan north, Dui west and Zhen east, and the direction of the trigram it changes into is the direction he goes. This reading is not written out in the book, and the translation follows only the letter of the four sentences. 'Tai, Yang, Birth' and 'Official Post, Emperor's Peak' are positions of the twelve stages, and 'six-combine' and 'six-clash' are the hexagram patterns (see the glossary).

zh: 欲知何方，以八卦定之也。
又鬼杀值胎养长生者，乱方始也。
值临官帝旺者，乱正炽也。
卦逢六合，安静者太平，逢六冲乱动者，则多变故也。
yi: 想知道事情在哪个方向，用八卦来定。
又，官鬼和凶煞值胎、养、长生的，祸乱刚开始。
值临官、帝旺的，祸乱正炽盛。
值死、墓、绝的，祸乱将要平息。
离卦发动变坎卦，君主将要北狩。
兑卦发动变震卦，想往东迁。
坎卦发动变离卦，想往南渡。
震卦发动变兑卦，必定西征。
卦遇六合，安静的太平；遇六冲、乱动的，变故很多。
en: To know in which direction, fix it by the eight trigrams.
Again, if Pressure and a baleful spirit are in the stages of Tai, Yang or Birth, the disorder is just beginning.
If they are in Official Post or Emperor's Peak, the disorder is at its height.
If they are in death, tomb or extinction, the disorder is about to cease.
Li moving and turning into Kan: the sovereign will go on a northern hunt.
Dui moving and turning into Zhen: he thinks of moving east.
Kan moving and turning into Li: he wishes to cross to the south.
Zhen moving and turning into Dui: he will surely march west.
If the hexagram is a six-combine and still, there is peace; if it meets the six-clash and moves wildly, there are many upheavals.

title: 朝廷占·国君（一）：世与五爻旺相居阳宫阳爻者明君，旺静福主，带龙喜德合福贵动者仁主，加刑杀威震臣邻，带虎鬼大杀刑刃旺动暴虐，带玄武咸池动荒淫，带兄耗羊刃动多靡，带虎鬼死符病符动倦勤，休囚被太岁冲克随鬼入墓殂落不久

rule.yi: 国君的品性和寿数：世爻与五爻旺相，又在阳宫的阳爻上的，是明君；旺相而安静的，是有福的君主；带青龙、喜神、德神、合神、福、贵人而发动的，是仁君；加上刑杀，威严震动臣下和邻国；带白虎、官鬼、大杀、刑、刃，旺相发动的，暴虐无道，肆意诛杀夷灭；带玄武、咸池发动的，荒淫无度；带兄爻、耗神、羊刃发动的，多奢靡而不节制；带白虎、官鬼、死符、病符发动的，身体常常倦怠，懒于政事；休囚，又被太岁冲克，以及随着官鬼入墓的，不久就驾崩。
rule.en: The character and span of the sovereign. If the Self and the fifth line are thriving and sit on a yang line in a yang palace, he is a wise ruler; if thriving and still, a fortunate ruler; if they carry the Dragon, Joy, Virtue, Combination, Fortune and the Noble and move, a benevolent ruler; with punishing baleful spirits added, his majesty shakes ministers and neighbours; if they carry the Tiger, Pressure, a great baleful spirit, punishment and the blade, thriving and moving, he is cruel and lawless and gives free rein to executions and exterminations; if they carry the Dark Tortoise and Xianchi and move, he is dissolute without limit; if they carry a Peer line, the Waste spirit and the Goat Blade and move, he is extravagant and without restraint; if they carry the Tiger, Pressure, the Death Tally and the Illness Tally and move, he is often in poor health and tired of government; if they are resting or trapped and are clashed or controlled by Tai Sui, or follow Pressure into the tomb, he will not last long.

note.yi: 「福主」按字面是有福的君主；「倦勤」是厌倦、懒于政事；「殂落」是死亡，用于君主就是驾崩。喜、德、合、福、贵、耗、死符、病符、羊刃、大杀都是神煞，书里没有逐个解释。
note.en: 'Fuzhu' is by the letter a fortunate ruler; 'juanqin' is being tired of and slack in government; 'culuo' is death, which for a sovereign means demise. Joy, Virtue, Combination, Fortune, the Noble, the Waste spirit, the Death Tally, the Illness Tally, the Goat Blade and the great baleful spirits are all spirit-stars that the book does not explain one by one.

zh: 世与五爻旺相，居阳宫阳爻者，明君。
旺静则福主也，带龙喜德合福贵动者，仁主。
加刑杀则威震臣邻也，带虎鬼大杀刑刃旺动者暴虐不道肆情诛夷也。
带玄武咸池动者，荒淫无度也。
带兄耗羊刃动者，多靡不节也。
带虎鬼死符病符动者，体常倦勤也。
休囚而被太岁冲克，与随鬼入墓者，殂落不久也。
yi: 世爻与五爻旺相，又在阳宫的阳爻上的，是明君。
旺相而安静的，是有福的君主；带青龙、喜神、德神、合神、福、贵人而发动的，是仁君。
加上刑杀，威严震动臣下和邻国；带白虎、官鬼、大杀、刑、刃，旺相发动的，暴虐无道，肆意诛杀夷灭。
带玄武、咸池发动的，荒淫无度。
带兄爻、耗神、羊刃发动的，多奢靡而不节制。
带白虎、官鬼、死符、病符发动的，身体常常倦怠，懒于政事。
休囚，又被太岁冲克，以及随着官鬼入墓的，不久就驾崩。
en: If the Self and the fifth line are thriving and sit on a yang line in a yang palace, he is a wise ruler.
If they are thriving and still, he is a fortunate ruler; if they carry the Dragon, Joy, Virtue, Combination, Fortune and the Noble and move, he is a benevolent ruler.

With punishing baleful spirits added, his majesty shakes ministers and neighbours; if they carry the Tiger, Pressure, a great baleful spirit, punishment and the blade, thriving and moving, he is cruel and lawless and gives free rein to executions and exterminations.
If they carry the Dark Tortoise and Xianchi and move, he is dissolute without limit.
If they carry a Peer line, the Waste spirit and the Goat Blade and move, he is extravagant and without restraint.
If they carry the Tiger, Pressure, the Death Tally and the Illness Tally and move, he is often in poor health and tired of government.
If they are resting or trapped and are clashed or controlled by Tai Sui, or follow Pressure into the tomb, he will not last long.

title: 朝廷占·国君（二）：土鬼旺动伤世贼攻城；财带阴贵大杀动伤世五爻妇寺专权；父带禄贵大杀动伤世五爻勋戚尾大不掉；兄带阴贵大杀动伤世五爻贵戚骄恣；子带华盖大杀动伤世五爻妖僧方士蛊惑君心

rule.yi: 国君身边的祸患：土爻的官鬼旺相发动、伤世爻的，贼寇攻城；财爻带阴贵人、大杀发动，伤世爻、五爻的，后宫妇人和宦官专权，蛀蚀国家；父爻带禄、贵人、大杀发动，伤世爻、五爻的，功臣外戚尾大不掉；兄爻带阴贵人、大杀发动，伤世爻、五爻的，皇亲国戚倚仗恩宠骄横放纵；子孙爻带华盖、大杀发动，伤世爻、五爻的，妖僧和方士蛊惑君主的心。
rule.en: Dangers about the sovereign. If an Earth Pressure line is thriving and moving and injures the Self, bandits attack the city; if the Wealth line carrying the Yin Noble and a great baleful spirit moves to injure the Self and the fifth line, women of the palace and eunuchs seize power and eat away at the state; if the Resource line carrying Emolument, the Noble and a great baleful spirit does so, the meritorious ministers and imperial in-laws become too big to control; if the Peer line carrying the Yin Noble and a great baleful spirit does so, the imperial kin presume on favour and are arrogant and unbridled; if the Output line carrying Canopy and a great baleful spirit does so, evil monks and alchemists bewitch the sovereign's mind.

note.yi: 「妇寺」是后宫的妇人和寺人（宦官）；「勋戚」是功臣和外戚；「尾大不悼」的「悼」疑是「掉」（尾大不掉），译文按「掉」译；「方士」是炼丹求仙的术士；「阴贵」是阴贵人，「华盖」是一颗主孤高、宗教的神煞，书里没有解释。
note.en: 'Fusi' is the women of the palace and the 'si', the eunuchs; 'xunqi' is the meritorious ministers and the imperial in-laws; in 'weida budao' the character 'dao', grief, is presumably a miswriting of 'diao', to swing, in the saying 'the tail too big to wag', and the translation follows it; 'fangshi' are the magicians who make elixirs and seek immortality; 'Yin Noble' is the yin form of the Noble, and 'Canopy' is a spirit-star of aloofness and religion that the book does not explain.

zh: 土鬼旺动伤世者，贼攻城也。
财带阴贵大杀动伤世爻五爻者，妇寺专权蠹国也。
父带禄贵大杀，动伤世爻五爻者，勋戚尾大不悼也。
兄带阴贵大杀，动伤世爻五爻者，贵戚怙宠骄恣也。
子带华盖大杀，动伤世爻五爻者，妖僧方士蛊惑君心也。
yi: 土爻的官鬼旺相发动、伤世爻的，贼寇攻城。
财爻带阴贵人、大杀发动，伤世爻、五爻的，后宫妇人和宦官专权，蛀蚀国家。
父爻带禄、贵人、大杀发动，伤世爻、五爻的，功臣外戚尾大不掉。
兄爻带阴贵人、大杀发动，伤世爻、五爻的，皇亲国戚倚仗恩宠骄横放纵。
子孙爻带华盖、大杀发动，伤世爻、五爻的，妖僧和方士蛊惑君主的心。
en: If an Earth Pressure line is thriving and moving and injures the Self, bandits attack the city.
If the Wealth line carrying the Yin Noble and a great baleful spirit moves to injure the Self line and the fifth line, women of the palace and eunuchs seize power and eat away at the state.

If the Resource line carrying Emolument, the Noble and a great baleful spirit moves to injure the Self line and the fifth line, the meritorious ministers and imperial in-laws become too big to control.
If the Peer line carrying the Yin Noble and a great baleful spirit moves to injure the Self line and the fifth line, the imperial kin presume on favour and are arrogant and unbridled.
If the Output line carrying Canopy and a great baleful spirit moves to injure the Self line and the fifth line, evil monks and alchemists bewitch the sovereign's mind.

title: 朝廷占·后妃：应爻二爻与世爻五爻生合比和好逑；应克世二克五脱环进规；带龙喜德合福贵旺相女中尧舜；带玄武咸池艳妻煽处；带父母旺相攻书史；带子孙旺相繁螽斯；子动生财能逮下；应居五爻阳位加太岁紫微华盖贵马旺相聚一爻垂帘听政

rule.yi: 后妃：应爻、二爻与世爻、五爻相生、相合、比和的，是好配偶；应爻克世爻，二爻克五爻的，皇后摘下环佩进言规劝；应爻、二爻带青龙、喜神、德神、合神、福、贵人，旺相的，是女中的尧舜；带玄武、咸池的，是艳妻煽动祸乱当权的格局；带父母爻旺相的，专攻书史；带子孙爻旺相的，像螽斯一样子孙众多；子孙爻发动生财爻的，能恩惠及下；应爻落在五爻的阳位上，又加太岁、紫微、华盖、贵人、驿马，旺相，都聚在一爻的，垂帘听政。
rule.en: Consort and empress.
