The parts of the boat: the Azure Dragon is the rudder, on the left; the White Tiger is the mast, sail and anchor chain, on the right; Hook Earth is the flat base and gangplank, the middle hold; the Coiling Snake is the cables; the Vermilion Bird is the smoke and stove, at the bow; the Dark Tortoise is the scull-heads and wave-guard, at the stern. Thriving, the boat is new; resting or trapped, old; Void, there is none; clashed, it leaks; punished, harmed or controlled, or if Wood holds a moving Pressure line, or Pressure lies hidden under Wood, it is surely damaged. Earth Pressure hidden under it, the boat runs into the shallows; Fire Pressure, it dries and splits; Metal Pressure, the nail holes are damaged. Again, Wood carrying Pressure is the enemy's boat.

note.yi: 船的各部分和六神的配法，书里只列了名目，没有解释：「平基」「挠头」「后稍（艄）」按字面译成 flat base、scull-heads、stern；「舟湊浅」的「湊」疑是「搁」（搁浅），译文按搁浅译。「舟楫」是船和桨。
note.en: The book only lists the parts of the boat and their assignment to the six spirits without explaining them: 'pingji', 'naotou' and 'hou shao' are translated by the letter as the flat base, the scull-heads and the stern; in 'zhou cou qian' the 'cou' is presumably 'ge', so that it is running aground, and the translation reads 'runs into the shallows'. 'Zhouji' is boats and oars.

zh: 木为舟楫，火为营寨，土为炮石，金为刀刃，水为水泉也。
白虎为樯帆锚链，为右也。
勾陈为平基跳板，为中仓也。
玄武为挠头挡浪，为后稍也。
旺相新，休囚旧，空则无，冲则破漏，受刑害克，及木持动鬼，与木下伏鬼者，必损伤也。
yi: 木是舟船，火是营寨，土是炮石，金是刀刃，水是水源和泉水。
木爻旺相发动，利于水军。
木旺，船大。
木衰，船小。
木落空、绝，没有船。
又，青龙是船舵，在左边。
白虎是桅杆、帆和锚链，在右边。
勾陈是平基、跳板，在中舱。
螣蛇是缆索。
朱雀是烟灶，在船头。
玄武是挠头、挡浪，在船尾。
旺相，船新；休囚，船旧；落空，没有；被冲，破漏；受刑、害、克，以及木爻持发动的官鬼、木爻下伏着官鬼的，必定损伤。
木下伏着土爻官鬼的，船搁浅。
伏着火爻官鬼的，船干燥开裂。
伏着金爻官鬼的，钉眼的地方损坏。
又，木爻带官鬼的，是贼船。
en: Wood is boats and oars, Fire is the camp, Earth is catapult stones, Metal is blades, and Water is springs.
If Wood is thriving and moving, it favours the navy.
Thriving Wood means a big boat.
Weak Wood means a small boat.
Void or extinct Wood means no boat.
Again, the Azure Dragon is the rudder, on the left.
The White Tiger is the mast, sail and anchor chain, on the right.
Hook Earth is the flat base and gangplank, the middle hold.
The Coiling Snake is the cables.
The Vermilion Bird is the smoke and stove, at the bow.
The Dark Tortoise is the scull-heads and wave-guard, at the stern.

Thriving, the boat is new; resting or trapped, old; Void, there is none; clashed, it leaks; punished, harmed or controlled, or if Wood holds a moving Pressure line, or Pressure lies hidden under Wood, it is surely damaged.
If an Earth Pressure line lies hidden under Wood, the boat runs into the shallows.
If a Fire Pressure line, the boat dries and splits.
If a Metal Pressure line, the nail holes are damaged.
Again, Wood carrying Pressure is the enemy's boat.

title: 征战占·五行（二）：火动生合世立营得地利，冲克刑害世失地利；火鬼持世动被贼围，贴世贼寨近；火旺营大衰营小，空危险，绝无出路；火动利迁营；火鬼伤世防劫营；加龙贼左来、加虎右来、雀前来、武后来、勾蛇四隅来

rule.yi: 火看营寨：火爻发动生合世爻，立营得地利；发动冲、克、刑、害世爻，立营失地利。火爻官鬼持世发动的，被贼围困；火爻官鬼贴近世爻的，贼寨离得近。火旺，营大；火衰，营小；火落空，营危险；火绝，没有出路；火发动，利于迁营；火爻官鬼伤世爻，防劫营。加青龙，贼从左边来；加白虎，从右边来；朱雀从前面来；玄武从后面来；勾陈、螣蛇从四个角落来。
rule.en: Fire and the camp. If Fire moves to generate or combine with the Self, setting up camp gains the advantage of ground; if it moves to clash with, control, punish or harm the Self, the camp loses the advantage of ground. If a Fire Pressure line holds the Self and moves, one is besieged by bandits; if a Fire Pressure line is next to the Self, the bandits' camp is near. Thriving Fire means a big camp, weak Fire a small camp; Void Fire means a camp in danger; extinct Fire means no way out; if Fire moves, it favours moving camp; if a Fire Pressure line injures the Self, guard against a raid on the camp. With the Azure Dragon added, the bandits come from the left; with the White Tiger, from the right; the Bird, from the front; the Tortoise, from behind; Hook Earth and the Snake, from the four corners.

note.yi: 最后一句「雀前来，武后来，勾蛇，四隅来也」是承上两句「加龙」「加虎」的写法，所以译文把朱雀、玄武、勾陈、螣蛇也当作「加」在火鬼上的神。「贴世」按字面是紧贴着世爻（相邻）。
note.en: The last sentence, 'the Bird comes from the front, the Tortoise from behind, Hook and Snake from the four corners', follows the form of the two sentences before, 'with the Dragon' and 'with the Tiger', and the translation therefore takes the Vermilion Bird, the Dark Tortoise, Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake also as spirits added to the Fire Pressure line. 'Tie shi' is by the letter pressed against the Self, adjoining it.

zh: 火动生合世者，立营得地利也。
火动冲克刑害世者，立营失地利也。
火鬼持世动者，被贼围也。
火鬼贴世者，贼寨相近也。
雀前来，武后来，勾蛇，四隅来也。
yi: 火爻发动生合世爻的，立营得地利。
火爻发动冲、克、刑、害世爻的，立营失地利。
火爻官鬼持世爻发动的，被贼围困。
火爻官鬼贴近世爻的，贼寨离得近。
火旺，营大。
火衰，营小。
火落空，营危险。
火绝，没有出路。
火发动，利于迁营。
火爻官鬼伤世爻，防劫营。
加青龙，贼从左边来。
加白虎，贼从右边来。
朱雀从前面来，玄武从后面来，勾陈、螣蛇从四个角落来。
en: If Fire moves to generate or combine with the Self, setting up camp gains the advantage of ground.
If Fire moves to clash with, control, punish or harm the Self, the camp loses the advantage of ground.
If a Fire Pressure line holds the Self and moves, one is besieged by bandits.
If a Fire Pressure line is next to the Self, the bandits' camp is near.
Thriving Fire means a big camp.
Weak Fire means a small camp.
Void Fire means a camp in danger.
Extinct Fire means no way out.
If Fire moves, it favours moving camp.
If a Fire Pressure line injures the Self, guard against a raid on the camp.
With the Azure Dragon added, the bandits come from the left.
With the White Tiger added, they come from the right.
The Bird comes from the front, the Tortoise from behind, Hook Earth and the Snake from the four corners.

title: 征战占·五行（三）：阳土鬼旺动带大杀刑害克冲世防炮石；阴土鬼旺动带阴杀防陷阱；世爻子爻临阳土伤应伤鬼利用炮石、临阴土利用机井；当于应爻鬼爻死墓绝胎之右设伏

rule.yi: 土看炮石和陷阱：阳土爻的官鬼旺相发动，带大杀来刑、害、克、冲世爻的，防炮石；阴土爻的官鬼旺相发动，带阴杀来冲、刑、克、害世爻的，防陷阱。世爻、子孙爻临阳土而伤应爻、伤官鬼的，利于使用炮石；临阴土而伤应爻与官鬼的，利于使用机关陷阱。应当在应爻、官鬼爻死、墓、绝、胎的右侧设下伏兵。
rule.en: Earth, catapult stones and pits. If a yang Earth Pressure line is thriving and moving, with a great baleful spirit, and comes to punish, harm, control or clash with the Self, guard against catapult stones; if a yin Earth Pressure line is thriving and moving, with a yin baleful spirit, and comes to clash with, punish, control or harm the Self, guard against pits. If the Self and Output sit on yang Earth and injure the Other and Pressure, it is favourable to use catapult stones; if on yin Earth and injuring the Other and Pressure, favourable to use mechanisms and pitfalls. One should set an ambush to the right of where the Other and Pressure lines are in death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage.

note.yi: 「陷井」即陷阱。「阴杀」书里没有解释，是阴性的凶煞；「右」是五个方位里的哪一边，书里没有说是相对于谁，译文照字面译。
note.en: 'Xian jing' is a pit trap. 'Yin baleful spirit' is not explained in the book and is a yin-natured baleful spirit; the book does not say to whose right 'the right' is, and the translation follows the letter.

zh: 阳土鬼旺动，带大杀来刑害克冲世者，防炮石也。
阴土鬼旺动，带阴杀来冲刑克害世者，防陷井也。
世爻子爻临阳土，伤应伤鬼者，利用炮石也。
临阴土，伤应与鬼者，利用机井也。
当于应爻鬼爻死墓绝胎之右设伏也。
yi: 阳土爻的官鬼旺相发动，带大杀来刑、害、克、冲世爻的，防炮石。
阴土爻的官鬼旺相发动，带阴杀来冲、刑、克、害世爻的，防陷阱。
世爻、子孙爻临阳土，伤应爻、伤官鬼的，利于使用炮石。
临阴土，伤应爻与官鬼的，利于使用机关陷阱。
应当在应爻、官鬼爻死、墓、绝、胎的右侧设下伏兵。
en: If a yang Earth Pressure line is thriving and moving, with a great baleful spirit, and comes to punish, harm, control or clash with the Self, guard against catapult stones.
If a yin Earth Pressure line is thriving and moving, with a yin baleful spirit, and comes to clash with, punish, control or harm the Self, guard against pits.
If the Self and Output sit on yang Earth and injure the Other and Pressure, it is favourable to use catapult stones.
If on yin Earth and injuring the Other and Pressure, it is favourable to use mechanisms and pitfalls.
One should set an ambush to the right of where the Other and Pressure lines are in death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage.

title: 征战占·五行（四）：金旺兵甲新加龙雀虎光明耀日，金衰兵甲旧加勾蛇武钝敝；金胎墓弓橐戈戢；金动将战斗，金动带刑刃战必伤人，金空动征鼓齐鸣兵刃既接

rule.yi: 金看兵甲：金爻旺相，兵器铠甲新，加青龙、朱雀、白虎的，光亮耀眼；金爻衰弱，兵甲旧，加勾陈、螣蛇、玄武的，钝坏没有光彩；金临胎、墓，弓入囊、戈收起（休兵）；金发动，将要打仗；金发动带刑、刃的，打起来必定伤人；金落空而发动，战鼓齐鸣，兵刃已经相接。
rule.en: Metal and arms. If Metal is thriving, weapons and armour are new, and with the Azure Dragon, the Bird or the Tiger added they are bright and dazzling; if Metal is weak, arms and armour are old, and with Hook Earth, the Snake or the Tortoise added they are blunt, worn and colourless; Metal on Tai or tomb, bows are put in their cases and spears put away; if Metal moves, a battle is about to be fought; if Metal moves carrying punishment and the blade, the fight will surely wound men; if Metal is Void and moves, war drums sound together and blades have already met.

note.yi: 「龙雀虎」「勾蛇武」是青龙、朱雀、白虎和勾陈、螣蛇、玄武的省称，前一组好、后一组坏。「弓橐戈戢」出自《诗·时迈》「载戢干戈，载櫜弓矢」，意思是收起兵器、不再用兵。
note.en: 'Long que hu' and 'gou she wu' are abbreviations for the Azure Dragon, the Vermilion Bird and the White Tiger and for Hook Earth, the Coiling Snake and the Dark Tortoise, the first group good and the second bad. 'Gong tuo ge ji' comes from the Odes, 'Shi mai', 'they put away shield and spear, they sheathe bow and arrow', meaning that the weapons are put away and the army rests.

zh: 加龙雀虎者，光明耀日也。
加勾蛇武者，钝敝无色也。
金动带刑刃，战必伤人也。
金空动，征鼓齐鸣，兵刃既接也。
yi: 金爻旺相，兵器铠甲新。
加青龙、朱雀、白虎的，光亮耀眼。
金爻衰弱，兵甲旧。
加勾陈、螣蛇、玄武的，钝坏没有光彩。
金临胎、墓，弓入囊、戈收起（休兵）。
金发动，将要打仗。
金发动而带刑、刃的，打起来必定伤人。
金落空而发动，战鼓齐鸣，兵刃已经相接。
en: If Metal is thriving, weapons and armour are new.
With the Azure Dragon, the Bird or the Tiger added, they are bright and dazzling.
If Metal is weak, arms and armour are old.
With Hook Earth, the Snake or the Tortoise added, they are blunt, worn and colourless.
Metal on Tai or tomb: bows are put in their cases and spears put away.
If Metal moves, a battle is about to be fought.
If Metal moves carrying punishment and the blade, the fight will surely wound men.
If Metal is Void and moves, war drums sound together and blades have already met.

title: 征战占·五行（五）：水旺则盈衰绝则竭；申爻旺动有水，以八卦定方；初爻旺动有井，以十二支定方（申爻水源，初爻为井）；初爻庚子水屋下有井、甲子水门前有井；初木动树下有井；初值土水浊，值火井干，土空有一池

rule.yi: 水看水源和井：水旺相，水就满；衰、绝，水就干。申爻旺相发动的，有水，方位用八卦来定；初爻旺相发动的，有井，方位用十二地支来定（申爻是水源，初爻是井）。初爻是庚子水的，屋下有井；是甲子水的，门前有井。初爻是木爻发动的，树下有井；初爻值土，水浑浊；值火，井干；初爻是土爻落空的，有一个池塘。
rule.en: Water, springs and wells. If Water is thriving it is full; if weak or extinct, it runs dry. If the Shen line is thriving and moving, there is water, its direction fixed by the eight trigrams; if the first line is thriving and moving, there is a well, its direction fixed by the twelve branches (the Shen line is the source of water and the first line is the well). If the first line is Gengzi Water, there is a well under the house; if Jiazi Water, there is a well in front of the gate. If the first line is Wood and moves, there is a well beneath a tree; if the first line is on Earth, the water is muddy; on Fire, the well is dry; if the first line is Earth and Void, there is a pond.

note.yi: 第三、四句在书里被句号切成「申爻旺动者，有水。以八卦定其何方，初爻旺动者，有井。以十二支神定其何方也」，按文意应读成「申爻旺动，有水，以八卦定其方；初爻旺动，有井，以十二支神定其方」，译文照这个读法把括号补在句首。「初爻庚子水」「甲子水」是初爻的干支再加上子的五行（水），书里没有解释，译文照字面。
note.en: In the book the third and fourth sentences are cut by full stops as 'the Shen line thriving and moving, there is water. Fix its direction by the eight trigrams; the first line thriving and moving, there is a well. Fix its direction by the twelve branch spirits', and by sense they should be read as 'the Shen line thriving and moving, there is water, its direction fixed by the eight trigrams; the first line thriving and moving, there is a well, its direction fixed by the twelve branch spirits'; the translation follows this reading and supplies the bracketed words at the head of each sentence. 'The first line Gengzi Water' and 'Jiazi Water' are the stem-branch of the first line followed by the element of Zi (Water), which the book does not explain, and the translation follows the letter.

zh: 以八卦定其何方，初爻旺动者，有井。
以十二支神定其何方也(申爻水源，初爻为井)。
yi: 水旺相，水就满；衰、绝，水就干。
申爻旺相发动的，有水。
（水的）方位用八卦来定；初爻旺相发动的，有井。
（井的）方位用十二地支来定。（申爻是水源，初爻是井。）
初爻是庚子水的，屋下有井。
是甲子水的，门前有井。
初爻是木爻发动的，树下有井。
初爻值土，水浑浊。
值火，井干。
初爻是土爻落空的，有一个池塘。
en: If Water is thriving it is full; if weak or extinct, it runs dry.
If the Shen line is thriving and moving, there is water.
Its direction is fixed by the eight trigrams; if the first line is thriving and moving, there is a well.
Its direction is fixed by the twelve branches. (The Shen line is the source of water and the first line is the well.)
If the first line is Gengzi Water, there is a well under the house.
If it is Jiazi Water, there is a well in front of the gate.
If the first line is Wood and moves, there is a well beneath a tree.
If the first line is on Earth, the water is muddy.
On Fire, the well is dry.
If the first line is Earth and Void, there is a pond.

title: 征战占·五行（六）：水鬼旺动克世敌将灌水；水子旺动克应我可囊沙或用背水阵；阴水兄旺动克应渡冰踏雪夜晦擒贼

rule.yi: 水用于战：水爻的官鬼旺相发动、克世爻的，敌将会灌水淹我；水爻的子孙旺相发动、克应爻的，我可以用沙袋壅水，或者背水列阵；阴水爻的兄弟旺相发动、克应爻的，可以渡冰踏雪，在夜里晦暗时擒贼。
rule.en: Water in battle. If a Water Pressure line is thriving and moving and controls the Self, the enemy general will flood me; if a Water Output line is thriving and moving and controls the Other, I can use sandbags or draw up with the water behind me; if a yin Water Peer line is thriving and moving and controls the Other, one can cross the ice and tread the snow and seize the bandits on a dark night.

note.yi: 「囊沙」「背水阵」见 YY.55 的注。书里「水鬼旺动克世」没有说克世的是官鬼本身还是水，译文按水爻的官鬼译。
note.en: 'Nang sha' and the 'water-behind formation' are explained in the note to YY.55. 'Water Pressure thriving and moving controls the Self' does not say whether it is the Pressure line itself or Water that controls, and the translation reads it as the Pressure line of Water.

zh: 水鬼旺动克世者，敌将灌水也。
水子旺动克应者，我可囊沙也，或用背水阵也。
阴水兄旺动克应者，渡冰踏雪，夜晦擒贼也。
yi: 水爻的官鬼旺相发动、克世爻的，敌将会灌水淹我。
水爻的子孙旺相发动、克应爻的，我可以用沙袋壅水，或者背水列阵。
阴水爻的兄弟旺相发动、克应爻的，可以渡冰踏雪，在夜里晦暗时擒贼。
en: If a Water Pressure line is thriving and moving and controls the Self, the enemy general will flood me.
If a Water Output line is thriving and moving and controls the Other, I can use sandbags or draw up with the water behind me.
If a yin Water Peer line is thriving and moving and controls the Other, one can cross the ice and tread the snow and seize the bandits on a dark night.

title: 征战占·日辰（一）：日辰为我兵——生合世子则士卒用命，冲克世子则兵骄难制，世子克日辰则上不惜下；加龙德喜神动将帅御下严肃；日辰克应克鬼我兵胜，应鬼克日辰敌兵强

rule.yi: 日辰看我方的兵：日辰代表我方的兵。日辰生合世爻、子孙爻的，士卒听命效力；冲克世爻、子孙爻的，兵骄横难以管束；世爻、子孙爻克日辰的，上面的人不爱惜下面的人；日辰加青龙、德神、喜神而发动的，将帅统御部下严肃；日辰克应爻、克官鬼的，我方兵胜；应爻、官鬼克日辰的，敌兵强。
rule.en: The Day and my troops. The Day stands for my soldiers. If the Day generates or combines with the Self or Output, the soldiers obey orders and serve; if it clashes with or controls the Self or Output, the troops are proud and hard to rein in; if the Self or Output controls the Day, those above do not spare those below; if the Day adds the Azure Dragon, Virtue and Joy and moves, the commander governs his men with strictness and dignity; if the Day controls the Other and Pressure, my troops win; if the Other or Pressure controls the Day, the enemy troops are strong.

note.yi: 「淑慝」是善和恶（见 YY.50）。「用命」是听从命令效力。
note.en: 'Shu te' is good and evil (see YY.50). 'Yongming' is serving by obeying orders.

zh: 日辰为我兵也，日辰生合世爻子爻者，士卒用命也。
冲克世爻子爻者，兵骄难制也。
世爻子爻克日辰者，上不惜下也。
加龙德喜神动者，将帅御下严肃也。
日辰克应克鬼者，我兵胜也。
应爻鬼爻，克日辰者，敌兵强也。
yi: 日辰代表我方的兵，日辰生合世爻、子孙爻的，士卒听命效力。
冲克世爻、子孙爻的，兵骄横难以管束。
世爻、子孙爻克日辰的，上面的人不爱惜下面的人。
日辰加青龙、德神、喜神而发动的，将帅统御部下严肃。
日辰克应爻、克官鬼的，我方兵胜。
应爻、官鬼爻克日辰的，敌兵强。
en: The Day stands for my soldiers, and if the Day generates or combines with the Self or Output, the soldiers obey orders and serve.
If it clashes with or controls the Self or Output, the troops are proud and hard to rein in.
If the Self or Output controls the Day, those above do not spare those below.
If the Day adds the Azure Dragon, Virtue and Joy and moves, the commander governs his men with strictness and dignity.
If the Day controls the Other and Pressure, my troops win.
If the Other or the Pressure line controls the Day, the enemy troops are strong.

title: 征战占·日辰（二）：日加龙动生世——内卦兵守纪律、外卦作止听令；日加雀喜动善间谍，加雀鬼动逢空内造言外探听无实；日加勾土鬼动内阻令外退缩；日加蛇鬼动内诡谲外兴妖；日加虎鬼动内偏强外轻敌偾事；日加武鬼动内属垣窃听外攫功利己；加天贼天盗劫杀旺动克世内窃符盗印外掠妇劫财

rule.yi: 日辰加六神，看我方兵的品性（在内卦是营内，在外卦是出征在外）：日辰加青龙发动、生世爻的，在内卦，兵守纪律，在外卦，行动停止都听号令；日辰加朱雀、喜神发动的，善用间谍；加朱雀、官鬼发动又逢空的，在内造谣生谤，在外打探的情报不实；日辰加勾陈、土爻官鬼发动的，在内阻挠号令不遵从，在外退缩不前进；加螣蛇、官鬼发动的，在内诡诈多端，在外兴妖惑众；加白虎、官鬼发动的，在内偏强难驯，在外轻敌坏事；加玄武、官鬼发动的，在内隔墙偷听，在外抢功图利；加玄武、官鬼，带天贼、天盗、劫杀旺相发动、克世爻的，在内偷窃符印，在外掠夺妇女财物。
rule.en: The Day carrying the six spirits, reading the character of my troops (inside means within the camp, outside means on campaign). If the Day carries the Azure Dragon, moves and generates the Self, then inside the troops keep discipline, and outside they stop and go at command; if the Day carries the Bird and Joy and moves, spies are used well; if it carries the Bird and Pressure, moves and meets Void, then inside they spread rumours and slander, and outside the intelligence gathered is untrue; if the Day carries Hook Earth and an Earth Pressure line and moves, inside they obstruct orders and do not comply, and outside they shrink back and do not advance; with the Snake and Pressure, inside they are crafty in many ways and outside they raise evil and delude the crowd; with the Tiger and Pressure, inside they are headstrong and hard to tame, and outside they despise the enemy and spoil the matter; with the Tortoise and Pressure, inside they listen at the wall and eavesdrop, and outside they grab credit for private gain; with the Tortoise and Pressure, carrying Tianzei, Tiandao and Robbery, thriving and moving and controlling the Self, inside they steal the tally and seal, and outside they plunder women and goods.

note.yi: 「在内」「在外」在前两句里写作内卦、外卦，后面几句省了「卦」字，译文同样按内卦、外卦理解，并在规则里解释成营内、出征在外；这是读法，不是书里明写的。「雀」「勾」「蛇」「虎」「武」是朱雀、勾陈、螣蛇、白虎、玄武的省称。「瞩垣」疑是「属垣」（「有耳属垣」，墙外有耳），译文按隔墙偷听译。「偾事」是把事情搞坏。「符印」是调兵的凭证和官印。「加日雀鬼」的「日」是承前的日辰。天贼、天盗是神煞。
note.en: In the first two sentences 'inside' and 'outside' are written as the inner and outer trigrams, and the later sentences drop the word 'trigram'; the translation reads them the same way, and the rule explains them as inside the camp and on campaign, which is a way of reading it and not something the book writes out. 'Que', 'gou', 'she', 'hu' and 'wu' are abbreviations for the Vermilion Bird, Hook Earth, the Coiling Snake, the White Tiger and the Dark Tortoise. 'Zhu yuan' is presumably 'shu yuan', 'ears against the wall', and the translation reads it as eavesdropping through a wall. 'Fenshi' is spoiling a matter. 'Fuyin' is the tally for mobilizing troops and the official seal. The 'Day' in 'adding Day, Bird, Pressure' continues the Day from before. Tianzei and Tiandao are spirit-stars.

zh: 日加龙动生世者，在内卦，则兵守纪律。
日加雀喜动者，善间谍也。
加日雀鬼动逢空者，在内则造言兴谤。
日加勾土鬼动者，在内，则阻令不遵。
日加蛇鬼动者，在内，则诡谲多端。
日加虎鬼动者，在内，则偏强难驯。
日加武鬼动者，在内，则瞩垣窃听。
日加武鬼，带天贼天盗劫杀旺动克世者，内则窃符盗印，外则掠妇劫财也。
yi: 日辰加青龙发动、生世爻的，在内卦，士兵遵守纪律。
在外卦，行动停止都听号令。
日辰加朱雀、喜神发动的，善用间谍。
日辰加朱雀、官鬼发动又逢空的，在内造谣生谤。
在外，打探来的情报不实。
日辰加勾陈、土爻官鬼发动的，在内阻挠号令、不遵从。
在外，退缩不前进。
日辰加螣蛇、官鬼发动的，在内诡诈多端。
在外，兴妖惑众。
日辰加白虎、官鬼发动的，在内偏强难驯。
在外，轻敌坏事。
日辰加玄武、官鬼发动的，在内隔墙偷听。
在外，抢功图利。
日辰加玄武、官鬼，带天贼、天盗、劫杀旺相发动、克世爻的，在内偷窃符印，在外掠夺妇女财物。
en: If the Day carries the Azure Dragon, moves and generates the Self, in the inner trigram the soldiers keep discipline.
In the outer trigram, they stop and go at command.
If the Day carries the Vermilion Bird and Joy and moves, spies are used well.
If the Day carries the Bird and Pressure, moves and meets Void, inside they spread rumours and slander.
Outside, the intelligence gathered is untrue.
If the Day carries Hook Earth and an Earth Pressure line and moves, inside they obstruct orders and do not comply.
Outside, they shrink back and do not advance.
If the Day carries the Snake and Pressure and moves, inside they are crafty in many ways.
Outside, they raise evil and delude the crowd.
If the Day carries the Tiger and Pressure and moves, inside they are headstrong and hard to tame.
Outside, they despise the enemy and spoil the matter.
If the Day carries the Tortoise and Pressure and moves, inside they listen at the wall and eavesdrop.
Outside, they grab credit for private gain.

If the Day carries the Tortoise and Pressure, with Tianzei, Tiandao and Robbery, thriving and moving and controlling the Self, inside they steal the tally and seal, and outside they plunder women and goods.

title: 文书占·公私之辨与成否（游南子）：虽俱以父母为用，公占以官旺为助，私占以子旺为助；三传刑害克破父母不成；卦无官父或官父临空绝化空绝非不发则遗失；父值墓胎、化墓胎、加勾土旺动必阻滞；在官占文凭诰敕公文差札身世坐禄马贵官印或三传值官印动生合身世必得；商占盐引钞文私居占契券田贴父旺动生合世身而财子旺静者有；应空绝墓胎、世持财加武动者无

rule.yi: 文书的占问，有公事和私事的分别：虽然都以父母爻为用神，但公事占以官星旺相为助，私事占以子孙旺相为助。三传（太岁、月建、日辰）刑、害、克、破父母爻的，不成；卦里没有官星、父爻，或官星、父爻临空、绝，以及化成空、绝的，不是发不下来，就是遗失；父爻值墓、胎，以及化成墓、胎，或者加勾陈、土爻而旺相发动的，必定被阻滞耽搁拖延月日。在官的人占文凭、诰敕、公文、差委的札付，只要身爻、世爻坐着禄、驿马、贵人、官星、印绶，或者三传值官星、印星发动来生合身爻、世爻的，必定可以得到。为经商占盐引、钞文，以及居家占契券、田地凭帖，只要父母爻旺相发动生合世爻、身爻，而财爻、子孙旺相安静的，有；应爻空、绝、墓、胎，以及世爻持财爻加玄武发动的，没有（财爻克文书，玄武克朱雀）。
rule.en: Documents differ between public and private matters: though Resource is the Subject in both, in a public matter the star of office being thriving helps, and in a private matter Output being thriving helps. If the three rulers punish, harm, control or break Resource, it does not come about; if the hexagram has no star of office or seal line, or they sit on Void or extinction or turn into Void or extinction, it is either not issued or lost; if the seal line meets tomb or womb, or turns into tomb or womb, or carries Hook Earth and an Earth line and is thriving and moving, it will surely be blocked and delayed for months and days. For one in office divining credentials, imperial edicts, official letters and orders of appointment, if the Body and Self sit on Emolument, the Horse, the Noble, the star of office and the seal and ribbon, or the three rulers on the star of office and seal move to generate or combine with the Body and Self, they can surely be had. For a merchant divining salt vouchers and notes of credit, or a householder divining contracts, deeds and land certificates, if the Resource line is thriving and moving and generates or combines with the Self and Body while Wealth and Output are thriving and still, there will be one; if the Other is Void, extinct, in tomb or in womb, or the Self holds Wealth with the Dark Tortoise added and moving, there will be none (Wealth controls the document and the Dark Tortoise controls the Vermilion Bird).

note.yi: 两个例子都是《易隐》文书占末尾附的断例，放在最相关的这一条下。第二例里有几处字面对不上通行的说法，译文都照字面：「月辰巳火六合」按字面是月建辰和巳火，而申的六合只有巳，辰与申是申子辰的半三合；「又犯月破」按通行的月破（月建所冲的支）庚辰月破的是戌，不是亥，这里大概是说亥水被月建辰土克破；「病于岁建寅，申墓于月建辰，申绝于日建巳」说的是亥水兄弟（受托的人）：水病在寅、墓在辰、绝在巳，「申」是借申来指水长生之位。「三传」是太岁、月建、日辰（见术语表）。
note.en: Both examples are appended at the end of this chapter on documents in the Yi Yin, and are placed under the entry they illustrate most. In the second example several wordings do not match the usual way of speaking, and the translation follows the letter: 'six-combination with the Month Chen and Si Fire' is by the letter the Month Chen and Si Fire, whereas Shen's six-combination is only Si, and Chen and Shen are a half three-harmony of Shen, Zi and Chen; 'also suffers Month-break' by the usual Month-break (the branch the Month clashes) would be Xu in a Gengchen month and not Hai, and here it presumably means that Hai Water is controlled and broken by the Month Chen Earth; 'ill at the Year Yin, Shen in tomb at the Month Chen, Shen extinct in the Day Si' speaks of the Hai Water Peer line (the man entrusted): Water is ill at Yin, in tomb at Chen and extinct at Si, and 'Shen' is used for the position where Water is born. The 'three rulers' are Tai Sui, the Month and the Day (see the glossary).

zh: 游南子曰，文书之占，有公私之辨焉。
虽俱以父母为用，然公占则以官旺为助，私占则以子旺为助也。
三传刑害克破父母者，不成。
卦无官父或官父临空绝，与化空绝者，非不发，则遗失。
父值墓胎，与化墓胎，或加勾土旺动者，必阻滞耽隔逗留月日也。
若乃在官而占，文凭诰勅，与夫公文差劄者，但身世坐禄马贵官印绶，或三传值官印动来生合身世者，必可得也。
为商而占盐引钞文，与私居而占契券田贴者，但父母旺动生合世身，而财子旺静者，有也。
应爻空绝墓胎，与世持财加武动者，无也。
yi: 游南子说：占文书，有公事和私事的分别。
虽然都以父母爻为用神，但公事占以官星旺相为助，私事占以子孙旺相为助。
三传（太岁、月建、日辰）刑、害、克、破父母爻的，不成。
卦里没有官星、父爻，或者官星、父爻临空、绝，以及化成空、绝的，不是发不下来，就是遗失。
父爻值墓、胎，以及化成墓、胎，或者加勾陈、土爻而旺相发动的，必定被阻滞、耽搁、拖延月日。
如果是在官的人占文凭、诰敕，以及公文、差委的札付，只要身爻、世爻坐着禄、驿马、贵人、官星、印绶，或者三传值官星、印星发动来生合身爻、世爻的，必定可以得到。
为经商占盐引、钞文，和居家占契约、田地凭帖的，只要父母爻旺相发动生合世爻、身爻，而财爻、子孙旺相安静的，有。
应爻空、绝、墓、胎，以及世爻持财爻加玄武发动的，没有。
（财爻克文书，玄武克朱雀。）
en: Master Younan says: in divining documents there is a distinction between public and private.
Though in both Resource is taken as the Subject, for a public matter the star of office being thriving helps, and for a private matter Output being thriving helps.
If the three rulers punish, harm, control or break Resource, it does not come about.
If the hexagram has no star of office or seal line, or they sit on Void or extinction, or turn into Void or extinction, it is either not issued or lost.

If the seal line meets tomb or womb, or turns into tomb or womb, or carries Hook Earth and an Earth line and is thriving and moving, it will surely be blocked, delayed and held up for months and days.

For one in office divining credentials, imperial edicts, official letters and orders of appointment, if the Body and Self sit on Emolument, the Horse, the Noble, the star of office and the seal and ribbon, or the three rulers on the star of office and seal move to generate or combine with the Body and Self, they can surely be had.

For a merchant divining salt vouchers and notes of credit, or a householder divining contracts, deeds and land certificates, if the Resource line is thriving and moving and generates or combines with the Self and Body while Wealth and Output are thriving and still, there will be one.
If the Other is Void, extinct, in tomb or in womb, or the Self holds Wealth with the Dark Tortoise added and moving, there will be none.
(Wealth controls the document, and the Dark Tortoise controls the Vermilion Bird.)

zh: 庚寅年戊寅月乙卯日，代占求文书，得剥之观。
傍爻巳官临应，受岁月日生，人多云吉，终是被岁月刑巳，又世上旁爻子动伤官，本宫辰戌文书，皆值时空，三传克之，且世应相克，人事不和，决主徒劳无成也。
yi: 庚寅年戊寅月乙卯日，替人占求文书，得剥卦变观卦。
旁边的巳火官星临在应爻上，受太岁、月建、日辰相生，人们多说吉，但终究是巳被太岁、月建刑；又世爻上旁边的子水发动，伤官星；本宫的辰土、戌土文书，都值当时的空，被三传克它；而且世爻、应爻相克，人事不和，断定白费力气、没有结果。
en: In the Gengyin year, Wuyin month, on a Yimao day, someone divined for another on seeking a document and got Bo changing into Guan.

The side Si Fire star of office sits on the Other and is generated by the Year, Month and Day, and people mostly called it auspicious, but in the end Si is punished by the Year and Month; also the side Zi Water line on the Self moves and injures the star of office; the Chen and Xu Earth documents of the home palace both fall in the Void of the time and are controlled by the three rulers; and the Self and Other control each other and the human side is not in harmony, so it was judged to be wasted effort without result.

zh: 庚寅年庚辰月己巳日，占托人求文书，得丰之复。
主文书却在，其人必死也。
缘申金文书，与月辰巳火六合，而动爻亥水兄弟，化入辰墓，又犯月破，况病于岁建寅，申墓于月建辰，申绝于日建巳中，故知其必死也。
yi: 庚寅年庚辰月己巳日，占托人求文书，得丰卦变复卦。
主文书倒还在，但受托的那个人必死。
因为申金文书，和月建辰、巳火六合，而发动的亥水兄弟，变入辰墓，又犯月破，何况病在太岁寅，申（水）墓在月建辰，申（水）绝在日建巳中，所以知道他必死。
en: In the Gengyin year, Gengchen month, on a Jisi day, a divination on entrusting someone to seek a document got Feng changing into Fu.
It meant that the document would still be there, but the man entrusted would surely die.

Because the Shen Metal document forms a six-combination with the Month Chen and Si Fire, while the moving Hai Water Peer line turns into its tomb at Chen and also suffers Month-break, and moreover it is ill at the Year Yin, Shen (Water) is in tomb at the Month Chen and extinct in the Day Si, so it was known that he would surely die.

title: 文书占·何时可得：旺则待入墓之月日，衰则候生旺之月日，旺动则逢合之月日，旺静则冲动之月日，伏藏则文书临值之月日

rule.yi: 问文书什么时候可以拿到：文书爻旺相的，等它入墓的月日；衰弱的，等它生旺的月日；旺相发动的，等逢合的月日；旺相安静的，等冲动它的月日；文书爻伏藏的，等文书当值的月日才能得到。
rule.en: To ask when a document can be had: if the document line is thriving, wait for the month or day it enters tomb; if weak, wait for the month or day it is born or thriving; if thriving and moving, the month or day it meets a combination; if thriving and still, the month or day that clashes it into motion; if the document line lies hidden, it is had in the month or day in which the document rules.

note.yi: 例子是文书占末尾附的断例。「文收」疑是「文书」，译文按文书译。「水胎于午」是水在十二长生里胎在午。第三例的「日占」是白天占，「寅年」没有写干支。
note.en: The examples are those appended at the end of the divination of documents. 'Wen shou' is presumably 'wenshu', document, and the translation reads it as the document. 'Water is in the womb at Wu' is Water's womb stage at Wu among the twelve stages. In the third example 'ri zhan' is a divination by day, and the 'Yin year' is given without its stem.

zh: 至问文书何时可得者，旺则待入墓之月日，衰则候生旺之月日，旺动则逢合之月日，旺静则冲动之月日也。
若文书伏藏者，待文书临值之月日得也。
yi: 至于问文书什么时候可以拿到：文书爻旺相的，等它入墓的月日；衰弱的，等它生旺的月日；旺相发动的，等逢合的月日；旺相安静的，等冲动它的月日。
如果文书爻伏藏的，等文书当值的月日才能得到。
en: To ask when a document can be had: if the document line is thriving, wait for the month or day it enters tomb; if weak, wait for the month or day it is born or thriving; if thriving and moving, the month or day it meets a combination; if thriving and still, the month or day that clashes it into motion.
If the document line lies hidden, it is had in the month or day in which the document rules.

zh: 庚寅年甲申月庚辰日，求占文书，得升之小过。
二爻亥水文书，动化午火子孙，水胎于午，是为文收化入胎爻，乃小墓也，主事难成。
却喜申月旺生，文书化胎不能为害，后于子日成就，盖文书旺于子，且冲破午胎也。
yi: 庚寅年甲申月庚辰日，占求文书，得升卦变小过卦。
二爻亥水文书，发动变成午火子孙，水胎在午，这是文书变入胎爻，是小墓，主事情难成。
却喜申月旺相相生，文书变胎不能为害；后来在子日办成，因为文书在子旺相，并且冲破午胎。
en: In the Gengyin year, Jiashen month, on a Gengchen day, a divination on seeking a document got Sheng changing into Xiaoguo.

The Hai Water document of the second line moves and turns into Wu Fire Output; Water is in the womb stage at Wu, so the document turns into the womb line, which is a small tomb and means the matter is hard to complete.

But happily the Shen month is thriving and generates it, so the document turning into the womb cannot do harm; later it was settled on a Zi day, because the document is thriving at Zi and also clashes and breaks the Wu womb.

zh: 寅年丁亥月丁酉日，日占托人求文书，得大壮安静。
主本月可成，出月则不成也。
盖世持午火文书，生本宫世下丑土，应上飞神，子与世下丑合，应下伏神未，与世上午合，故可成也。
若出月，则十一月建子，并动应爻，冲脱文书，所以不成也。
yi: 寅年丁亥月丁酉日，白天占托人求文书，得大壮卦，没有动爻。
主本月可以办成，出了本月就不成。
因为世爻持午火文书，生本宫世爻下的丑土，应爻上的飞神子，与世爻下的丑相合，应爻下的伏神未，与世爻上的午相合，所以可以办成。
如果出了本月，到十一月建子，并发动应爻，冲脱文书，所以不成。
en: In a Yin year, Dinghai month, on a Dingyou day, a divination by day on entrusting someone to seek a document got Dazhuang with no moving line.
It meant that it could be settled this month, and not after the month is out.

Because the Self holds the Wu Fire document and generates the Chou Earth under the Self in the home palace; the flying spirit Zi on the Other combines with the Chou under the Self, and the hidden spirit Wei under the Other combines with the Wu on the Self, so it can be settled.
If the month is out, in the eleventh month the Month is Zi, and together with the moving Other line it clashes away and drains the document, so it does not succeed.

title: 谒贵占总述（游南子）与鬼谷分爻：人之谒贵必有所求所托，始恐不得见，见恐不如所请；看所谒之贵是何分爻，旺动生合身世者往必得见见必如请，伏藏空死墓绝胎而刑害克冲世身者往必不见见必不遂

rule.yi: 拜谒显贵的占问：人去拜谒显贵，必定有所求、有所托，起初担心见不到，见到了又担心他不照所请求的办，所以不能不占。看所拜谒的那位贵人是哪一爻（大贵、中贵、朝贵、州郡、省贵、县贵、乡贵），这一爻出现、旺相发动、生合身爻、世爻的，去了必定见得到，见了必定如我所请；如果伏藏、空、死、墓、绝、胎，又刑、害、克、冲世爻、身爻的，去了必定见不到，见了必定不遂我的求。
rule.en: Divining a call on a noble. A man calling on a noble surely has something to ask and something to entrust, and at first fears he will not be seen, and once seen fears the noble will not do as asked, so one cannot do without a divination. Look at which line the noble called on is (the great noble, the middle noble, the court noble, prefecture and commandery, the provincial noble, the county noble, the village noble): if this line appears, thriving and moving, and generates or combines with the Body and Self, going he will surely be seen and once seen it will surely be as I ask; if it lies hidden or is Void, dead, in tomb, extinct or in womb, and punishes, harms, controls or clashes with the Self and Body, going he will surely not be seen and if seen it will surely not fulfil my request.

note.yi: 鬼谷分爻表里的名目是「大贵、中贵、朝贵、州郡、省贵、县贵、乡贵」，书里没有写各是哪一爻，也没有写到底是六个还是七个，读法同 YY.02：从上爻写到初爻。「中贵」在明代常指宫中有权势的宦官，这里也可能只是「中等的贵人」，书里没有说明，译文照字面。
note.en: The names in the Guigu table are 'the great noble, the middle noble, the court noble, the prefecture and commandery, the provincial noble, the county noble, the village noble'; the book does not say which line each is, nor whether there are six or seven, and it is read as in YY.02, from the top line down to the first. 'Zhonggui' in the Ming often meant the powerful eunuchs of the palace, though here it may be only 'a noble of middle rank'; the book does not explain, and the translation follows the letter.

zh: 游南子曰，人之谒贵，必有所求，必有所托也，故始焉恐其不得见也。
见矣，恐其不如所请也，是不可以无占也。
yi: 游南子说：人去拜谒显贵，必定有所求、有所托，所以起初担心见不到他。
见到了，又担心他不照所请求的办，所以不能不占。
en: Master Younan says: a man calling on a noble surely has something to ask and something to entrust, and so at first he fears he will not be seen.
Once seen, he fears the noble will not do as asked, and so one cannot do without a divination.

zh: 占者，但看所谒之贵，是何分爻出现，旺动生合身世者，往必得见，见必如吾所请也。
如逢伏藏空死墓绝胎，而刑害克冲世身者，往必不见，见必不遂吾求也。
yi: 鬼谷分爻（表）：
大贵、中贵、朝贵，
州郡、省贵、县贵，
乡贵。
占的人，只看所拜谒的那位贵人，是哪一爻出现，旺相发动、生合身爻、世爻的，去了必定见得到，见了必定如我所请。
如果遇到伏藏、空、死、墓、绝、胎，又刑、害、克、冲世爻、身爻的，去了必定见不到，见了必定不遂我的求。
en: Guigu's division of the lines (table):
the great noble, the middle noble, the court noble,
the prefecture and commandery, the provincial noble, the county noble,
the village noble.

The diviner has only to look at which line the noble called on is: if it appears, thriving and moving, and generates or combines with the Body and Self, going he will surely be seen and once seen it will surely be as I ask.

If it lies hidden or is Void, dead, in tomb, extinct or in womb, and punishes, harms, controls or clashes with the Self and Body, going he will surely not be seen and if seen it will surely not fulfil my request.

title: 谒贵占·见否（一）：外卦与应爻官爻属阴在家、属阳出外；阳变阴外方回、阴变阳方出外；应爻官爻出现在家、伏藏不在

rule.yi: 见不见得到，先看他在不在家：外卦和应爻、官爻属阴的，他在家；属阳的，他出外；阳变阴的，刚从外地回来；阴变阳的，刚要出外。应爻、官爻出现的，在家；伏藏的，不在。
rule.en: Whether he can be seen, first whether he is at home. If the outer trigram and the Other and Pressure lines are yin, he is at home; if yang, he is out; yang changing into yin, he has just returned from elsewhere; yin changing into yang, he is just going out. If the Other and Pressure lines appear, he is at home; if they lie hidden, he is not in.

note.yi: 这一段的前四句里「外方回」「方出外」的「方」是刚刚。书里这一行被断行隔开（「方出外」在上一行末、「也」在下一行首），这里连起来读。
note.en: In the first four sentences the 'fang' of 'fang chu wai' is 'just now'. This passage is split by a line break in the book ('just going out' at the end of one line and 'ye' at the start of the next), and is read here joined up.

zh: 外卦与应爻官爻属阴者，在家也。
应爻官爻出现者，在家也。
yi: 外卦和应爻、官爻属阴的，他在家。
属阳的，他出外。
阳变阴的，刚从外地回来。
阴变阳的，刚要出外。
应爻、官爻出现的，在家。
伏藏的，不在。
en: If the outer trigram and the Other and Pressure lines are yin, he is at home.
If they are yang, he is out.
Yang changing into yin: he has just returned from elsewhere.
Yin changing into yang: he is just going out.
If the Other and Pressure lines appear, he is at home.
If they lie hidden, he is not in.

title: 谒贵占·见否（二）：动者难见空者不见；空而旺过旬乃见；出现旺动而不带土不见；阴化阳见而遇、阳化阴再见而拒；六合见六冲不见；卦无身或无鬼或世应俱空世应俱鬼不必往；世应内外官鬼生合比和待应爻官爻生世合世之日或生旺之日见

rule.yi: 见得到见不到：官星发动的，难见；落空的，见不到；空而旺相的，过了这一旬才见得到；出现、旺相发动而不带土爻的，见不到；阴爻变阳爻的，见到而且被接待；阳爻变阴爻的，第二次去见时被拒绝。占得六合的，见得到；占得六冲的，见不到。卦里没有身爻，或没有官鬼，或世、应都落空，世、应都是官鬼的，不必去见。凡世、应、内外卦的官鬼相生相合比和的，等应爻、官爻生世爻、合世爻的日子可以见到，或者应爻、官爻生旺的日子见面。
rule.en: Whether he is seen. If the star of office is moving, he is hard to see; if Void, he is not seen; if Void but thriving, he is seen only after the decade is past; if it appears, thriving and moving, without carrying Earth, he is not seen; a yin line changing into yang: seen and received; a yang line changing into yin: refused on the second visit. If the divination is a six-combine, he is seen; if a six-clash, not. If the hexagram has no Body, or no Pressure, or the Self and Other are both Void, or the Self and Other are both Pressure, there is no need to go. Whenever the Pressure lines of the Self, the Other, and the inner and outer trigrams generate, combine or are in harmony, wait for a day when the Other or the Pressure line generates or combines with the Self, or a day when the Other or the Pressure line is born or thriving, to meet him.

note.yi: 第一句「动者难见，空者不见」的主语省了，承上一段是应爻、官爻，译文写成官星。「而见而遇」按字面是见了并且遇到（被接待）。「六合」「六冲」指卦的六合、六冲（见术语表）；「卦无身」的身指卦身，书里没有说是不是上卦。
note.en: The subject of the first sentence, 'moving, hard to see; Void, not seen', is left out, following on from the previous passage on the Other and Pressure lines, and the translation writes it as the star of office. 'Er jian er yu' is by the letter 'seen and met', that is received. 'Six-combine' and 'six-clash' are the hexagram patterns (see the glossary); the 'Body' of 'the hexagram has no Body' is the hexagram Body, and the book does not say whether it needs to be on the board.

zh: 出现旺动而不带土者，不见也。
阳爻化阴者，再见而拒也。
占六合者见，六冲者不见也。
卦无身，或无鬼，或世应俱空，世应俱鬼者，不必往见也。
凡世应内外官鬼，生合比和者，待应爻官爻生世合世之日可见，或应爻官爻生旺之日相见也。
yi: 官星发动的，难见；落空的，见不到。
空而旺相的，过了这一旬才见得到。
出现、旺相发动而不带土爻的，见不到。
阴爻变阳爻的，见到而且被接待。
阳爻变阴爻的，第二次去见时被拒绝。
占得六合的，见得到；占得六冲的，见不到。
卦里没有身爻，或没有官鬼，或世、应都落空，世、应都是官鬼的，不必去见。
凡世、应、内外卦的官鬼相生、相合、比和的，等应爻、官爻生世爻、合世爻的日子可以见到，或者应爻、官爻生旺的日子见面。
en: If the star of office is moving, he is hard to see; if Void, he is not seen.
If Void but thriving, he is seen only after the decade is past.
If it appears, thriving and moving, without carrying Earth, he is not seen.
A yin line changing into yang: he is seen and received.
A yang line changing into yin: he is refused on the second visit.
If the divination is a six-combine, he is seen; if a six-clash, he is not.
If the hexagram has no Body line, or no Pressure, or the Self and Other are both Void, or the Self and Other are both Pressure, there is no need to go and see him.

Whenever the Pressure lines of the Self, the Other, and the inner and outer trigrams generate, combine or are in harmony, he can be seen on a day when the Other or the Pressure line generates or combines with the Self, or met on a day when the Other or the Pressure line is born or thriving.

title: 谒贵占·相见喜怒：外卦与应爻官爻生合世身内卦见而悦，刑害克冲世身内卦见而嗔；应官虽生合而变爻刑害克冲先悦后嗔，先刑害而变来生合先怒后善；应官受日辰动爻刑害克破或化死墓绝胎彼有灾病；加龙和蔼多情、雀多言易怒、勾率直无文、蛇多疑寡信、虎狠毒无恩、武狡诈多端

rule.yi: 见面时他是喜是怒：外卦和应爻、官爻，生合世爻、身爻和内卦的，见面时他高兴；刑、害、克、冲世爻、身爻和内卦的，见面时他恼怒。应爻、官爻虽然生合身爻、世爻，而变爻刑、害、克、冲的，先高兴后恼怒；先刑、害、克、冲身爻、世爻，而变爻来生合的，先恼怒后和善。应爻、官爻受日辰、动爻刑、害、克、破，或变成死、墓、绝、胎的，他有灾病祸事。加青龙发动的，和气多情；加朱雀发动的，话多易怒；加勾陈发动的，直率没有文采；加螣蛇发动的，多疑少信；加白虎发动的，狠毒没有恩情；加玄武发动的，狡诈多端。
rule.en: Whether he is pleased or angry at the meeting. If the outer trigram and the Other and Pressure lines generate or combine with the Self, Body and inner trigram, he is pleased at the meeting; if they punish, harm, control or clash with the Self, Body and inner trigram, he is angry. If the Other and Pressure lines generate or combine with the Body and Self but the changed line punishes, harms, controls or clashes with them, he is pleased first and angry after; if they first punish, harm, control or clash with the Body and Self and the changed line comes to generate or combine, he is angry first and kind after. If the Other and Pressure lines are punished, harmed, controlled or broken by the Day or a moving line, or turn into death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, he has illness or disaster. With the Azure Dragon moving, he is genial and warm; with the Bird, talkative and quick to anger; with Hook Earth, blunt and unrefined; with the Snake, suspicious and little trusting; with the Tiger, fierce and without kindness; with the Dark Tortoise, deceitful in many ways.

zh: 外卦与应爻官爻，生合世身内卦者，见而悦也。
刑害克冲世身内卦者，见而嗔也。
应爻官爻虽生合身世，而变爻刑害克冲者，先悦后嗔也。
先刑害克冲身世，而变来生合者，先怒后善也。
应爻官爻受日辰动爻刑害克破，或化死墓绝胎者，彼有灾病祸事也。
yi: 外卦和应爻、官爻，生合世爻、身爻和内卦的，见面时他高兴。
刑、害、克、冲世爻、身爻和内卦的，见面时他恼怒。
应爻、官爻虽然生合身爻、世爻，而变爻刑、害、克、冲的，先高兴后恼怒。
先刑、害、克、冲身爻、世爻，而变爻来生合的，先恼怒后和善。
应爻、官爻受日辰、动爻刑、害、克、破，或变成死、墓、绝、胎的，他有灾病祸事。
加青龙发动的，和气多情。
加朱雀发动的，话多易怒。
加勾陈发动的，直率没有文采。
加螣蛇发动的，多疑少信。
加白虎发动的，狠毒没有恩情。
加玄武发动的，狡诈多端。
en: If the outer trigram and the Other and Pressure lines generate or combine with the Self, Body and inner trigram, he is pleased at the meeting.
If they punish, harm, control or clash with the Self, Body and inner trigram, he is angry at the meeting.
If the Other and Pressure lines generate or combine with the Body and Self but the changed line punishes, harms, controls or clashes with them, he is pleased first and angry after.
If they first punish, harm, control or clash with the Body and Self and the changed line comes to generate or combine, he is angry first and kind after.
If the Other and Pressure lines are punished, harmed, controlled or broken by the Day or a moving line, or turn into death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, he has illness or disaster.
With the Azure Dragon added and moving, he is genial and warm.
With the Bird, he is talkative and quick to anger.
With Hook Earth, he is blunt and unrefined.
With the Snake, he is suspicious and little trusting.
With the Tiger, he is fierce and without kindness.
With the Dark Tortoise, he is deceitful in many ways.

title: 谒贵占·所求不同用神不同：夤援兴讼上书献策以官鬼为用（旺动生合世身吉，空死墓绝胎无力，动刑害克冲不允，加虎杀反遭罪谪）；息讼释罪以子孙为用；求书恳荐以父母为用（旺动生合身世有，空死墓绝胎无，刑害克破有若无）；财持世旺动、财独发求必不得

rule.yi: 所求的事不同，取的用神也不同：为攀援求助、打官司，以及上书献策而去谒见贵人的，以官鬼为用神——官鬼旺相发动、生合世爻、身爻的，吉；官鬼逢空、死、墓、绝、胎的，没有力量；官鬼发动来刑、害、克、冲身爻、世爻的，不允；加白虎、凶煞来伤的，不但不允，反而遭到罪责贬谪。为平息官司、开脱罪名而谒见贵人的，以子孙为用神——应爻持子孙旺相发动，带喝散、解神生合世爻的，或者世爻持子孙，或者月建、日辰是子孙来生合世爻的，吉；应爻上的子孙逢空、死、墓、绝、胎，或被刑、害、克、冲的，没有力量。为求书信、恳求荐举而谒见贵人的，以父母为用神——官鬼旺相发动、生合父爻，以及父爻旺相发动、生合身爻、世爻的，有；父爻逢空、死、墓、绝、胎的，没有；父爻被刑、害、克、破的，有也像没有一样。财爻持世旺相发动，以及财爻单独发动的，所求必定得不到，得到也没有力量。
rule.en: What is asked decides the Subject. For one calling on a noble to scheme for help, to sue, or to present a memorial with proposals, take Pressure as the Subject: if Pressure is thriving and moving and generates or combines with the Self and Body, it is auspicious; if Pressure meets Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, it has no strength; if Pressure moves to punish, harm, control or clash with the Body and Self, it is not granted; with the Tiger and a baleful spirit coming to injure, not only is it not granted, but he is instead blamed and demoted. For one calling on a noble to end a lawsuit and clear a charge, take Output as the Subject: if the Other holds Output, thriving and moving, with Hesan and Jiexie generating or combining with the Self, or the Self holds Output, or the Month or Day is Output coming to generate or combine with the Self, it is auspicious; if Output on the Other meets Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, or is punished, harmed, controlled or clashed, it has no strength. For one calling on a noble to ask for a letter or beg for a recommendation, take Resource as the Subject: if Pressure is thriving and moving and generates or combines with Resource, or Resource is thriving and moving and generates or combines with the Body and Self, there will be one; if Resource meets Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, there will be none; if Resource is punished, harmed, controlled or broken, it is as if there were none though there is. If Wealth holds the Self and is thriving and moving, or if the Wealth line alone moves, what is asked will surely not be had, and if had it will have no force.

note.yi: 「寅援」即「夤缘」，攀附权贵、借助关系；「罪谪」是治罪和贬官。「喝散」「解神」是神煞，书里没有解释，译文只音译。「世持子孙」「月日是子孙」按字面译。
note.en: 'Yinyuan' is 'yinyuan', climbing up through connections with the powerful; 'zuizhe' is punishment and demotion. Hesan and Jiexie are spirit-stars that the book does not explain, and the translation only gives their sounds. 'The Self holds Output' and 'the Month or Day is Output' are by the letter.

zh: 凡寅援与兴讼，及上书献策而谒贵者，以官鬼为用也。
鬼爻旺动生合世身者，吉也。
鬼逢空死墓绝胎者，无力也。
鬼动来刑害克冲身世者，不允也。
加虎杀来伤者，非惟不允，反遭罪谪也。
为息讼释罪，而谒贵者，子孙为用也。
应爻持子旺动，带喝散解神生合世者，或世持子孙，或月日是子孙来生合世者，吉也。
应爻子孙逢空死墓绝胎，或被刑害克冲者，无力也。
为求书恳荐，而谒贵者，以父母为用也。
鬼旺动生合父，与父旺动生合身世者，有也。
父逢空死墓绝胎者，无也。
父被刑害克破者，有而若无也。
财持世旺动，与财爻独发者，求必不得，得亦无力也。
yi: 凡是为了攀援求助、打官司，以及上书献策而去谒见贵人的，以官鬼为用神。
官鬼旺相发动、生合世爻、身爻的，吉。
官鬼逢空、死、墓、绝、胎的，没有力量。
官鬼发动来刑、害、克、冲身爻、世爻的，不允。
加白虎、凶煞来伤的，不但不允，反而遭到罪责贬谪。
为平息官司、开脱罪名而谒见贵人的，以子孙为用神。
应爻持子孙旺相发动，带喝散、解神生合世爻的，或者世爻持子孙，或者月建、日辰是子孙来生合世爻的，吉。
应爻上的子孙逢空、死、墓、绝、胎，或被刑、害、克、冲的，没有力量。
为求书信、恳求荐举而谒见贵人的，以父母为用神。
官鬼旺相发动、生合父爻，以及父爻旺相发动、生合身爻、世爻的，有。
父爻逢空、死、墓、绝、胎的，没有。
父爻被刑、害、克、破的，有也像没有一样。
财爻持世旺相发动，以及财爻单独发动的，所求必定得不到，得到也没有力量。
en: Whenever one calls on a noble to scheme for help, to sue, or to present a memorial with proposals, take Pressure as the Subject.
If Pressure is thriving and moving and generates or combines with the Self and Body, it is auspicious.
If Pressure meets Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, it has no strength.
If Pressure moves to punish, harm, control or clash with the Body and Self, it is not granted.
With the Tiger and a baleful spirit coming to injure, not only is it not granted, but he is instead blamed and demoted.
For one calling on a noble to end a lawsuit and clear a charge, take Output as the Subject.

If the Other holds Output, thriving and moving, with Hesan and Jiexie generating or combining with the Self, or the Self holds Output, or the Month or Day is Output coming to generate or combine with the Self, it is auspicious.
If Output on the Other meets Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, or is punished, harmed, controlled or clashed, it has no strength.
For one calling on a noble to ask for a letter or beg for a recommendation, take Resource as the Subject.
If Pressure is thriving and moving and generates or combines with Resource, or Resource is thriving and moving and generates or combines with the Body and Self, there will be one.
If Resource meets Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, there will be none.
If Resource is punished, harmed, controlled or broken, it is as if there were none though there is.
If Wealth holds the Self and is thriving and moving, or if the Wealth line alone moves, what is asked will surely not be had, and if had it will have no force.

title: 谒贵占·馈送：有馈送而谒贵以应爻为用；应逢空死墓绝胎人不遇、遇亦不投；财带退神动、财动化退神物不纳；应财旺动生合世馈薄答厚；应动刑害克冲世而间爻又动被间情疏

rule.yi: 带着礼物去谒见贵人：以应爻为用神。应爻逢空、死、墓、绝、胎的，人遇不到，遇到了也不投合；财爻带退神发动，以及财爻发动变成退神的，礼物不被收纳；应爻的财旺相发动、生合世爻的，送得薄而回报厚；应爻发动刑、害、克、冲世爻，而间爻又发动的，被人从中挑拨而情分疏远。
rule.en: Calling on a noble with a gift. Take the Other as the Subject. If the Other meets Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, the man is not met, and if met he does not take to the visitor; if Wealth carries the Retreating spirit and moves, or Wealth moves and turns into a Retreating spirit, the gift is not accepted; if the Wealth of the Other is thriving and moving and generates or combines with the Self, the gift is slight and the return generous; if the Other moves to punish, harm, control or clash with the Self and a line between also moves, someone comes between them and the feeling cools.

note.yi: 「财带退神动」后面的括号（丁丑、丁未、壬辰、壬戌）是退神的干支，《卜筮全书》写「退神者，壬戌、壬辰、丁丑、丁未」（见 YY.19）；所以这句的两半说的是两件事：财爻自己带着退神的干支发动，和财爻发动后变成退神。「间爻」是世爻和应爻之间的爻（见术语表）。
note.en: The bracket after 'Wealth carrying the Retreating spirit and moving', (Dingchou, Dingwei, Renchen, Renxu), gives the ganzhi of the Retreating spirit; the Bushi Quanshu writes 'the Retreating spirit is Renxu, Renchen, Dingchou and Dingwei' (see YY.19). The two halves of the sentence therefore speak of two things: Wealth itself carrying a Retreating ganzhi and moving, and Wealth moving and then turning into a Retreating spirit. 'A line between' is a line between the Self and the Other (see the glossary).

zh: 有馈送而谒贵者，以应爻为用也。
应逢空死墓绝胎者，人不遇遇亦不投也。
财带退神动，(丁丑丁未壬辰壬戌)，与财动化退神者，物不纳也。
应财旺动生合世者，馈薄而答厚也。
应动刑害克冲世，而间爻又动者，被间而情踈也。
yi: 带着礼物去谒见贵人的，以应爻为用神。
应爻逢空、死、墓、绝、胎的，人遇不到，遇到了也不投合。
财爻带退神发动（丁丑、丁未、壬辰、壬戌），以及财爻发动变成退神的，礼物不被收纳。
应爻的财旺相发动、生合世爻的，送得薄而回报厚。
应爻发动刑、害、克、冲世爻，而间爻又发动的，被人从中挑拨而情分疏远。
en: For one calling on a noble with a gift, take the Other as the Subject.
If the Other meets Void, death, tomb, extinction or the womb stage, the man is not met, and if met he does not take to the visitor.
If Wealth carries the Retreating spirit (Dingchou, Dingwei, Renchen, Renxu) and moves, or Wealth moves and turns into a Retreating spirit, the gift is not accepted.
If the Wealth of the Other is thriving and moving and generates or combines with the Self, the gift is slight and the return generous.
If the Other moves to punish, harm, control or clash with the Self and a line between also moves, someone comes between them and the feeling cools.

title: 觅馆占·六亲取象：世为己、应为东主，父为书馆、子为生徒、财为束修、鬼为荐人、兄为谋夺之人；世应父空绝无馆，父值墓胎无好馆，财空墓绝胎修薄，子空墓绝胎徒少，鬼空墓绝胎无荐人，兄空墓绝胎无谋夺人

rule.yi: 觅馆（找教书的馆），六亲的取象：世爻是自己，应爻是东家；父爻是书馆，子孙是学生，财爻是束修（馆金），官鬼是推荐人，兄弟是谋夺（这个馆）的人。世爻、应爻、父爻落空、绝的，没有馆；父爻值墓、胎，没有好馆；财爻空、墓、绝、胎的，束修菲薄；子孙空、墓、绝、胎的，学生少；官鬼空、墓、绝、胎的，没有推荐人；兄弟空、墓、绝、胎的，没有人来谋夺。
rule.en: Seeking a teaching post, the images of the six kin. The Self is oneself and the Other is the host; the Resource line is the schoolroom, Output the pupils, Wealth the fee, Pressure the one who recommends, and Peer the one who schemes to take the post. If the Self, the Other and the Resource line are Void or extinct, there is no post; if Resource meets tomb or womb, there is no good post; if Wealth is Void, in tomb, extinct or in womb, the fee is slight; if Output is Void, in tomb, extinct or in womb, the pupils are few; if Pressure is Void, in tomb, extinct or in womb, there is no one to recommend; if Peer is Void, in tomb, extinct or in womb, there is no one to scheme for the post.

note.yi: 「修」「脩」都是束脩，即教书先生的酬金。这一节的取象和黄金策求馆章（HJC.29–38）几乎相同，只是黄金策以世爻为西席、应爻为东家，这里世爻是「己」。「东修」按字面是东家给的束修。
note.en: 'Xiu' and 'xiu' are both the tuition fee, the teacher's pay. The images in this section are nearly the same as those in the Huangjin Ce chapter on seeking a teaching post (HJC.29-38), the difference being that the Huangjin Ce takes the Self as the teacher's seat and the Other as the host, while here the Self is 'oneself'. 'Dongxiu' is by the letter the fee given by the host.

zh: 世爻应爻父爻空绝者，无馆。
兄空墓绝胎者，无谋夺人也。
yi: 世爻是自己，应爻是东家。
父爻是书馆，子孙是学生。
财爻是束修（馆金），官鬼是推荐人。
兄弟是谋夺（这个馆）的人。
世爻、应爻、父爻落空、绝的，没有馆。
父爻值墓、胎，没有好馆。
财爻空、墓、绝、胎的，束修菲薄。
子孙空、墓、绝、胎的，学生少。
官鬼空、墓、绝、胎的，没有推荐人。
兄弟空、墓、绝、胎的，没有人来谋夺。
en: The Self is oneself and the Other is the host.
The Resource line is the schoolroom and Output is the pupils.
Wealth is the fee, and Pressure is the one who recommends.
Peer is the one who schemes to take the post.
If the Self, the Other and the Resource line are Void or extinct, there is no post.
If Resource meets tomb or womb, there is no good post.
If Wealth is Void, in tomb, extinct or in womb, the fee is slight.
If Output is Void, in tomb, extinct or in womb, the pupils are few.
If Pressure is Void, in tomb, extinct or in womb, there is no one to recommend.
If Peer is Void, in tomb, extinct or in womb, there is no one to scheme for the post.

title: 觅馆占·卦象与进退：游魂宜别图，归魂宜仍旧；六冲无馆、六合有馆，合逢冲被人破，合变冲初允终拒；官加贵三合世应贵人荐；兄动克世有人争夺；财动化兄荐人分修；世动化鬼央人转荐；鬼动化兄先索谢仪；子合逢冲聚而复散；子衰得助徒少后增

rule.yi: 觅馆，卦象和进退：游魂卦，宜另作打算；归魂卦，宜仍留旧馆；六冲卦没有馆，六合卦有馆；六合卦遇冲的，被人破坏；六合变六冲的，起初应承、最后拒绝。官星加贵人三合世爻、应爻的，有贵人推荐；兄弟发动克世爻的，有人争夺；财爻发动变兄弟的，推荐的人要分走束修；世爻发动变官鬼的，要央求别人转荐；官鬼发动变兄弟的，推荐人先索要谢礼；子孙爻合而遇冲的，学生聚了又散；子孙衰弱而得到帮助的，学生起初少、后来增多。
rule.en: Seeking a teaching post, the hexagram and advance or retreat. In a Wandering Soul hexagram it is fit to look elsewhere; in a Returning Soul hexagram, to stay in the old post; a six-clash hexagram has no post and a six-combine hexagram has one; a six-combine meeting a clash is broken by someone; a six-combine changing into a clash is agreed at first and refused in the end. If the star of office with the Noble forms a three-harmony with the Self and Other, a patron recommends; if Peer moves to control the Self, someone contends for the post; if Wealth moves and turns into Peer, the one who recommends takes a share of the fee; if the Self moves and turns into Pressure, one must ask another to pass it on; if Pressure moves and turns into Peer, the recommender first demands a gift of thanks; if Output combines and meets a clash, the pupils gather and then scatter; if Output is weak but helped, the pupils are few at first and grow later.

note.yi: 第五句「合变冲者，初尤而终拒也」的「尤」疑是「允」，译文按「起初应承」译。「凂人」是央求别人。「合」在这里指六合卦，「合逢冲」是六合卦被日月或动爻冲，「合变冲」是六合卦变成六冲卦。「官加贵三合世应」按字面是官星加贵人，与世、应形成三合。
note.en: In the fifth sentence the 'you' of 'chu you er zhong ju' is presumably 'yun', agree, and the translation reads 'agreed at first'. 'Mei ren' is begging another. 'Combine' here means a six-combine hexagram: 'combine meeting a clash' is a six-combine hexagram clashed by the Month, Day or a moving line, and 'combine changing into a clash' is a six-combine turning into a six-clash. 'The star of office with the Noble in a three-harmony with the Self and Other' is by the letter the star of office carrying the Noble and forming a three-harmony with the Self and Other.

zh: 六冲卦无馆，六合卦有馆。
合变冲者，初尤而终拒也。
官加贵三合世应者，贵人荐也。
子衰得助者，徒少后增也。
yi: 游魂卦，宜另作打算。
归魂卦，宜仍留旧馆。
六冲卦没有馆，六合卦有馆。
六合卦遇冲的，被人破坏。
六合变六冲的，起初应承、最后拒绝。
官星加贵人三合世爻、应爻的，有贵人推荐。
兄弟发动克世爻的，有人争夺。
财爻发动变兄弟的，推荐的人要分走束修。
世爻发动变官鬼的，要央求别人转荐。
官鬼发动变兄弟的，推荐人先索要谢礼。
子孙爻合而遇冲的，学生聚了又散。
子孙衰弱而得到帮助的，学生起初少、后来增多。
en: In a Wandering Soul hexagram it is fit to look elsewhere.
In a Returning Soul hexagram, it is fit to stay in the old post.
A six-clash hexagram has no post and a six-combine hexagram has one.
A six-combine meeting a clash is broken by someone.
A six-combine changing into a clash is agreed at first and refused in the end.
If the star of office with the Noble forms a three-harmony with the Self and Other, a patron recommends.
If Peer moves to control the Self, someone contends for the post.
If Wealth moves and turns into Peer, the one who recommends takes a share of the fee.
If the Self moves and turns into Pressure, one must ask another to pass the recommendation on.
If Pressure moves and turns into Peer, the recommender first demands a gift of thanks.
If Output combines and meets a clash, the pupils gather and then scatter.
If Output is weak but helped, the pupils are few at first and grow later.

title: 觅馆占·关约何日来：以父母为用；卦无父死值之日来，父旺合日来，父衰生旺日来，父空墓逢冲之日来；又父生世合世之日亦可成关得关

rule.yi: 想知道聘书（关约）什么时候来：以父母爻为用神。卦里没有父爻的，在（父爻）死、当值的日子来；父母爻旺相的，在合它的日子来；衰弱的，在它生旺的日子来；空、墓的，在冲它的日子来。又，父母爻生世爻、合世爻的日子，也可以成关、得到聘约。
rule.en: To know when the engagement (contract) will come: take Resource as the Subject. If the hexagram has no Resource line, it comes on the day it dies and rules; if Resource is thriving, on the day that combines with it; if weak, on the day it is born or thriving; if Void or in tomb, on the day that clashes with it. Again, on the day Resource generates or combines with the Self, the engagement can also be made and obtained.

note.yi: 「关约」是聘请教书先生的聘书（关书）。「成关得关」是定下聘约、得到聘约。第二句「死值之日」书里没有解释，按字面是父爻在十二长生里「死」而又当值的日子，疑是「伏值」之误（无父即伏藏，待它当值的日子来，和 YY.72 文书伏藏「待文书临值之月日」同理），译文照字面译。
note.en: 'Guanyue' is the engagement letter (guanshu) hiring a private teacher. 'Cheng guan de guan' is settling and obtaining the engagement. The 'day of death and ruling' in the second sentence is not explained in the book; by the letter it is a day on which the Resource line is in its 'death' stage and also rules, and it is presumably a slip for 'hidden and ruling' (with no Resource line it lies hidden and waits for the day it rules, as for a hidden document in YY.72, 'wait for the month or day when the document rules'); the translation follows the letter.

zh: 欲知关约之来，以父母为用也。
又父母生世合世之日，亦可成关得关也。
yi: 想知道聘书（关约）什么时候来，以父母爻为用神。
卦里没有父爻的，在（父爻）死、当值的日子来。
父母爻旺相的，在合它的日子来。
父母爻衰弱的，在它生旺的日子来。
父母爻空、墓的，在冲它的日子来。
又，父母爻生世爻、合世爻的日子，也可以成关、得到聘约。
en: To know when the engagement contract will come, take Resource as the Subject.
If the hexagram has no Resource line, it comes on the day when it dies and rules.
If Resource is thriving, it comes on the day that combines with it.
If Resource is weak, it comes on the day when it is born or thriving.
If Resource is Void or in tomb, it comes on the day that clashes with it.
Again, on the day Resource generates or combines with the Self, the engagement can also be made and obtained.

title: 谋望占总述（游南子）与鬼谷分爻：欲为而不敢遽为则有谋，欲得而不可必得则有望；先占可否、再占成败、三占迟速；分爻国事官事人事家事身事心事

rule.yi: 谋望占总述：想做一件事又不敢马上去做，就有了谋；想得到又不能一定得到，就有了望。所以先占它行不行，既然行了，再占它成不成，既然成了，再占它是快是慢，大致就是这些。分爻是：国事、官事、人事、家事、身事、心事。
rule.en: Overview of divining a scheme. When one wants to do a thing and does not dare to do it at once, there is a scheme; when one wants to get a thing and cannot be sure of getting it, there is a hope. So first divine whether it is feasible; once feasible, whether it will succeed; once successful, whether it will be slow or fast; that is the general outline. The division of the lines: affairs of state, official affairs, affairs of others, family affairs, personal affairs and affairs of the heart.

note.yi: 表里六个名目没有写各是哪一爻，读法同 YY.02：从上爻写到初爻，即上爻国事、五爻官事、四爻人事、三爻家事、二爻身事、初爻心事。这是读法，不是书里明写的。第三、四句在书里各自成句，但意思连着前一句，译文用分号接起来。
note.en: The table does not say which line each of the six names belongs to, and it is read as in YY.02, from the top line down to the first: the top line affairs of state, the fifth official affairs, the fourth affairs of others, the third family affairs, the second personal affairs and the first affairs of the heart. This is a way of reading it and not something the book writes out. The third and fourth sentences stand each alone in the book but their sense runs on from the previous one, and the translation joins them with semicolons.

zh: 游南子曰，凡人欲为而不敢遽为，则有谋。
欲得而不可必得，则有望。
故始焉占其可否，既可矣。
yi: 游南子说：人想做一件事又不敢马上去做，就有了谋。
想得到又不能一定得到，就有了望。
所以起初先占它行不行，既然行了，
再占它成不成，既然成了，
再占它是快是慢，大致就是这些。
en: Master Younan says: when a man wants to do a thing and does not dare to do it at once, there is a scheme.
When he wants to get a thing and cannot be sure of getting it, there is a hope.
So first divine whether it is feasible; once it is feasible,
divine whether it will succeed; once it has succeeded,
divine whether it will be slow or fast; that is the general outline.

zh: 国事官事人事家事身事心事
yi: 鬼谷分爻（表）：
国事、官事、人事、家事、身事、心事。
en: Guigu's division of the lines (table):
affairs of state, official affairs, affairs of others, family affairs, personal affairs, affairs of the heart.

hits.text: 国事心事官事家事身事人事

title: 谋望占·可否成败（一）：以世应为主，内卦为谋事之人；内克外、世克应、外应生内世、内外世应俱旺相比和，事可图易就；月日合世应心虽不欲亦允成；间动鬼动生合世应得人劝成；谋官官旺生合世身而子衰静成、谋财财旺而兄衰静成、谋文书父旺而财衰静成；凡事嫌兄动，并贵禄生世则为吹嘘之人；凡事喜福动，求名忌之

rule.yi: 谋事能不能成，以世爻、应爻为主，内卦是谋事的人。内卦克外卦、世爻克应爻，外卦、应爻生内卦、世爻，或者内外卦、世应都旺相比和的，事情可以谋，谋也容易成；月建、日辰合世、应的，对方心里虽然不愿意，也会答应成全；间爻、官鬼发动生合世、应的，有人劝说成全。谋官，逢官星旺相生合世身、子孙衰弱安静的，成；谋财，逢财爻旺相生合世身、兄弟衰弱安静的，成；谋文书，逢父爻旺相生合世身、财爻衰弱安静的，成。凡事都嫌兄弟发动，但如果兄弟带着贵人、禄一起生世爻，就是替你吹嘘推荐的人；凡事都喜欢福神发动，求名（功名）却忌讳它。这是可谋而成的占。
rule.en: Whether a scheme can succeed takes the Self and Other as the chief, and the inner trigram is the man who schemes. If the inner controls the outer, the Self controls the Other, the outer and the Other generate the inner and Self, or the inner and outer and the Self and Other are all thriving and in harmony, the matter can be planned and is easily done; if the Month and Day combine with the Self and Other, though the other side is unwilling at heart he will agree and see it through; if a line between or Pressure moves to generate or combine with the Self and Other, someone persuades him to see it through. Scheming for office, if the star of office is thriving and generates or combines with the Self and Body while Output is weak and still, it succeeds; scheming for wealth, if Wealth is thriving and generates or combines with the Self and Body while Peer is weak and still, it succeeds; scheming for a document, if Resource is thriving and generates or combines with the Self and Body while Wealth is weak and still, it succeeds. In everything a moving Peer line is disliked, but if it carries the Noble and Emolument and generates the Self, it is one who talks you up and recommends you; in everything the fortune spirit moving is liked, but in seeking fame it is avoided. This is the pattern of a scheme that can be planned and will succeed.

note.yi: 「世身」是世爻和身爻，「内外世应」按字面是内卦、外卦、世爻、应爻。「吹嘘」是替人说好话、推荐。「福动」是子孙（福神）发动；求名忌子孙是因为子孙克官（见 HJC.03）。
note.en: 'Shishen' is the Self and the Body line; 'inner, outer, Self, Other' is by the letter the inner trigram, the outer trigram, the Self and the Other. 'Chuixu' is speaking well of someone, recommending him. 'The fortune spirit moves' is Output moving; Output is avoided in seeking fame because Output controls the star of office (see HJC.03).

zh: 内克外，世克应，外应生内世者，内外世应俱旺相比和者，事可图，图亦易就。
月日合世应，心虽不欲，亦得允成。
间动鬼动生合世应，得人劝成。
谋官逢官旺生合世身，而子衰静者成。
谋财逢财旺生合世身，而兄衰静者成。
谋文书，逢父旺生合世身，而财衰静者成。
凡事皆嫌兄动，若并贵禄生世，又为吹嘘之人。
凡事皆喜福动，求名则忌之，此可谋而成之占也。
yi: 以世爻、应爻为主。
内卦是谋事的人。
内卦克外卦，世爻克应爻，外卦、应爻生内卦、世爻的，内外卦、世应都旺相比和的，事情可以谋，谋也容易成。
月建、日辰合世、应的，对方心里虽然不愿意，也会答应成全。
间爻、官鬼发动生合世、应的，有人劝说成全。
谋官，逢官星旺相生合世身、子孙衰弱安静的，成。
谋财，逢财爻旺相生合世身、兄弟衰弱安静的，成。
谋文书，逢父爻旺相生合世身、财爻衰弱安静的，成。
凡事都嫌兄弟发动；但如果兄弟带着贵人、禄一起生世爻，就是替你吹嘘推荐的人。
凡事都喜欢福神发动，求名（功名）却忌讳它；这是可谋而成的占。
en: Take the Self and Other as the chief.
The inner trigram is the man who schemes.

If the inner controls the outer, the Self controls the Other, the outer and the Other generate the inner and Self, or the inner and outer and the Self and Other are all thriving and in harmony, the matter can be planned and is easily done.
If the Month and Day combine with the Self and Other, though the other side is unwilling at heart he will agree and see it through.
If a line between or Pressure moves to generate or combine with the Self and Other, someone persuades him to see it through.
Scheming for office, if the star of office is thriving and generates or combines with the Self and Body while Output is weak and still, it succeeds.
Scheming for wealth, if Wealth is thriving and generates or combines with the Self and Body while Peer is weak and still, it succeeds.
Scheming for a document, if Resource is thriving and generates or combines with the Self and Body while Wealth is weak and still, it succeeds.
In everything a moving Peer line is disliked; but if it carries the Noble and Emolument and generates the Self, it is one who talks you up and recommends you.
In everything the fortune spirit moving is liked, but in seeking fame it is avoided; this is the pattern of a scheme that can be planned and will succeed.

title: 谋望占·可否成败（二）：内外世应身爻逢空死墓绝胎被刑害克破、卦六冲、世应俱动、外克内应克世、鬼兄临间爻带隔神退神退悔杀动，俱不可谋；合中犯刑害克破恩中变怨成而后毁；用神不上卦或空绝（求官无官爻、求财求文书无财印爻）谋不成；卦中无官及官空绝诸事不成；卦中无鬼伏谋事父动费力成

rule.yi: 不可谋、难成的占：内外卦、世爻、应爻、身爻，逢空、死、墓、绝、胎，被刑、害、克、破的，或者卦是六冲，或者世、应都发动，或者外卦克内卦、应爻克世爻，或者官鬼、兄弟临在间爻、带隔神、退神、退悔杀发动的，都不可谋，谋也不成。又，合中犯了刑、害、克、破的，事情多半恩中生怨，成了之后又毁，虽然是自己的事，也被旁人阻隔。又，用神不上卦的（比如求官而卦里没有官爻、官爻空绝；求财、求文书而没有财爻、印爻，或财爻、印爻空绝），都谋不成。又凡是卦里没有官星，以及官星逢空、绝的，诸事不成。所以经书说：卦中没有官鬼、伏着的谋事，父爻发动，终究要费力才成。这是不可谋而难成的占。
rule.en: The pattern of a scheme that cannot be planned and is hard to complete. If the inner and outer trigrams, the Self, Other and Body meet Void, death, tomb, extinction or womb and are punished, harmed, controlled or broken, or the hexagram is a six-clash, or the Self and Other both move, or the outer controls the inner and the Other controls the Self, or Pressure or Peer sits on a line between carrying the obstructing spirit, the Retreating spirit or the regret baleful spirit and moves, none can be planned, and if planned will not succeed. Again, if within a combination there is punishment, harm, control or breaking, the matter often turns from favour to resentment, and is spoiled after succeeding, and though it is one's own matter it is blocked by others. Again, if the Subject does not appear on the board (as when seeking office there is no Pressure line, or Pressure is Void or extinct; seeking wealth or a document, there is no Wealth or seal line, or they are Void or extinct), the scheme will not succeed. Again, when the hexagram has no star of office, or the star of office is Void or extinct, nothing succeeds. So the classic says: if there is no Pressure in the hexagram and it lies hidden, in a scheme, with the Resource line moving, it is in the end completed only with effort. This is the pattern of a scheme that cannot be planned and is hard to complete.

note.yi: 「隔神」「退悔杀」是神煞，书里没有解释，译文照字面。「经曰」引的是另一部经书，书里没有说是哪一部，所以这句译文照字面，不指认出处；「卦中无鬼伏谋事」这句字面不太通，译文按「卦中没有官鬼，而官鬼伏藏时谋事」译。「用神」是占问时被拿来看这件事成败的那个爻。
note.en: 'Geshen' (the obstructing spirit) and 'tuihui sha' (the regret baleful spirit) are spirit-stars that the book does not explain, and the translation follows the letter. 'The classic says' quotes another classic, and the book does not say which, so the translation follows the letter and does not identify the source; the line 'gua zhong wu gui fu mou shi' does not run smoothly by the letter, and the translation reads it as 'when there is no Pressure in the hexagram and it lies hidden, in a scheme'. The 'Subject' is the line taken as the matter asked about.

zh: 若内外世应身爻，逢空死墓绝胎，被刑害克破者，或卦六冲者，或世应俱动者，或外克内，应克世者，或鬼兄临间爻带隔神退神退悔杀动者，俱不可谋，谋亦不成。
又合中犯刑害克破者，事多恩中变怨，成而后毁，虽是已事，亦被旁人阻隔。
又用神不上卦者，如求官无官爻，或官爻空绝。
求财，求文书，无财印爻，或财印爻空绝，俱谋不成也。
又凡卦中无官，与官逢空绝者，诸事不成。
故经曰，卦中无鬼伏谋事，父动终当费力成也。
此不可谋而难成之占也。
yi: 如果内外卦、世爻、应爻、身爻，逢空、死、墓、绝、胎，被刑、害、克、破的，或者卦是六冲，或者世、应都发动，或者外卦克内卦、应爻克世爻的，或者官鬼、兄弟临在间爻、带隔神、退神、退悔杀发动的，都不可谋，谋也不成。
又，合中犯了刑、害、克、破的，事情多半恩中生怨，成了之后又毁，虽然是自己的事，也被旁人阻隔。
又，用神不上卦的，比如求官而卦里没有官爻，或官爻空、绝；
求财、求文书，没有财爻、印爻，或财爻、印爻空、绝，都谋不成。
又凡是卦里没有官星，以及官星逢空、绝的，诸事不成。
所以经书说：卦中没有官鬼、伏着的谋事，父爻发动，终究要费力才成。
这是不可谋而难成的占。
en: If the inner and outer trigrams, the Self, Other and Body meet Void, death, tomb, extinction or womb and are punished, harmed, controlled or broken, or the hexagram is a six-clash, or the Self and Other both move, or the outer controls the inner and the Other controls the Self, or Pressure or Peer sits on a line between carrying the obstructing spirit, the Retreating spirit or the regret baleful spirit and moves, none can be planned, and if planned will not succeed.

Again, if within a combination there is punishment, harm, control or breaking, the matter often turns from favour to resentment, and is spoiled after succeeding, and though it is one's own matter it is blocked by others.
Again, if the Subject does not appear on the board, as when seeking office there is no Pressure line, or the Pressure line is Void or extinct;
seeking wealth or a document, there is no Wealth or seal line, or they are Void or extinct, the scheme will not succeed.
Again, when the hexagram has no star of office, or the star of office meets Void or extinction, nothing succeeds.
So the classic says: if there is no Pressure in the hexagram and it lies hidden, in a scheme, with the Resource line moving, it is in the end completed only with effort.
This is the pattern of a scheme that cannot be planned and is hard to complete.

title: 谋望占·可否成败（三）：内外纯阳用爻旺相出现宜公不宜私，内外纯阴用爻休囚伏藏宜私不宜公；内生外世生应我去求人，外生内应生世人来就我；主卦冲变卦合、动克世变生世先难后易，主卦合变卦冲、动合世变刑世先易后难

rule.yi: 谋事的几种格局：内外卦纯阳、用爻旺相出现的，适宜公事，不适宜私事；内外卦纯阴、用爻休囚伏藏的，适宜私事，不适宜公事。内卦生外卦、世爻生应爻，是我去求人；外卦生内卦、应爻生世爻，是人来就我。本卦冲而变卦合、发动克世爻而变出来生世爻的，先难后易；本卦合而变卦冲、发动合世爻而变出来刑世爻的，先易后难。
rule.en: Some patterns in a scheme. If the inner and outer trigrams are pure yang and the Subject line is thriving and appears, it is fit for a public matter and not a private one; if the inner and outer are pure yin and the Subject line is resting or trapped and hidden, it is fit for a private matter and not a public one. If the inner generates the outer and the Self generates the Other, I go to ask others; if the outer generates the inner and the Other generates the Self, others come to me. If the original hexagram clashes and the changed hexagram combines, or a moving line controls the Self and changes into one that generates the Self, it is hard at first and easy after; if the original hexagram combines and the changed hexagram clashes, or a moving line combines with the Self and changes into one that punishes the Self, it is easy at first and hard after.

note.yi: 「宜公不宜私」「宜私不宜公」是看这件事该走公家的路还是私人的路：纯阳、用爻出现，是公开、光明的事；纯阴、用爻伏藏，是私下、隐秘的事。这一句书里没有解释理由，译文只照字面译。
note.en: 'Fit for the public and not the private' and 'fit for the private and not the public' ask whether the matter should take an official road or a private one: pure yang with the Subject line appearing is an open and bright matter, and pure yin with the Subject line hidden is a private and hidden one. The book gives no reason for this sentence, and the translation follows only the letter.

zh: 然有宜公而不宜私者，内外纯阳，用爻旺相出现也。
有宜私而不宜公者，内外纯阴，用爻休囚伏藏也。
内生外，世生应，我去求人也。
外生内，应生世，人来就我也。
主卦冲而变卦合，动克世而变生世，先难后易也。
主卦合而变卦冲，动合世而变刑世，先易后难也。
yi: 然而有适宜公事、不适宜私事的：内外卦纯阳，用爻旺相出现。
有适宜私事、不适宜公事的：内外卦纯阴，用爻休囚伏藏。
内卦生外卦、世爻生应爻，是我去求人。
外卦生内卦、应爻生世爻，是人来就我。
本卦冲而变卦合，发动克世爻而变出来生世爻的，先难后易。
本卦合而变卦冲，发动合世爻而变出来刑世爻的，先易后难。
en: Yet there is a pattern fit for a public matter and not a private one: the inner and outer trigrams are pure yang, and the Subject line is thriving and appears.
There is a pattern fit for a private matter and not a public one: the inner and outer trigrams are pure yin, and the Subject line is resting or trapped and hidden.
If the inner generates the outer and the Self generates the Other, I go to ask others.
If the outer generates the inner and the Other generates the Self, others come to me.
If the original hexagram clashes and the changed hexagram combines, or a moving line controls the Self and changes into one that generates the Self, it is hard at first and easy after.
If the original hexagram combines and the changed hexagram clashes, or a moving line combines with the Self and changes into one that punishes the Self, it is easy at first and hard after.

title: 谋望占·可否成败（四）：成败于何人以六亲定——本宫内卦至亲、本宫外卦远亲、他宫内卦邻里、他宫外卦远方人，鬼加贵缙绅否则牙人保人媒人，八卦定其方；托人图事外人看应、家亲看用爻，应爻用爻犯日破月破旬空及空死墓绝胎无能赞襄，生旺化空死墓绝胎有始无终，冲克刑害世必怀欺，六冲终反目，虎损害蛇心变勾愚钝武诈欺雀多诳语，惟旺相带龙喜成神生合世身者赖其扶持

rule.yi: 想知道事情成败在哪个人身上，就用六亲来定：本宫的内卦，是至亲；本宫的外卦，是远亲；他宫的内卦，是邻里；他宫的外卦，是远方的人；官鬼加贵人，是缙绅，否则是牙人、保人、媒人；想知道是哪个方向的人，用八卦来定。又有托人办事的，外人看应爻，亲人看用爻。凡应爻、用爻犯日破、月破、旬空的，都主受托的人没有能力帮忙，空、死、墓、绝、胎也一样；生旺而变成空、死、墓、绝、胎的，必有始无终；冲、克、刑、害世爻的，受托的人必定怀着欺骗，难以托付；六冲的卦，终究反目成仇。白虎发动的，损害；螣蛇发动的，变心；勾陈发动的，愚钝；玄武发动的，欺诈；朱雀旺相落空而发动的，多说谎话。只有旺相、带青龙、喜神、成神，发动来生合世爻、身爻的，才靠他扶持把事办成。
rule.en: To know through whom the matter succeeds or fails, fix it by the six kin: the inner trigram of the home palace is the nearest kin; the outer trigram of the home palace, distant kin; the inner trigram of another palace, neighbours; the outer trigram of another palace, men from afar; Pressure with the Noble is gentry, otherwise a broker, a guarantor or a go-between; the direction is fixed by the eight trigrams. If one entrusts someone with the matter, outsiders are seen through the Other and kin through the Subject line. Whenever the Other or the Subject line suffers Day-break, Month-break or decade Void, the man entrusted has no ability to help, and so too for Void, death, tomb, extinction and womb; if thriving and turning into Void, death, tomb, extinction or womb, there is a beginning without an end; if the Self is clashed, controlled, punished or harmed, the man entrusted surely harbours deceit and cannot be relied on; a six-clash hexagram ends in a falling out. If the Tiger moves, he does harm; the Snake, his heart changes; Hook Earth, he is dull; the Dark Tortoise, he cheats; the Bird thriving and Void and moving, he tells many lies. Only if he is thriving and carries the Dragon, Joy and the Completion spirit and moves to generate or combine with the Self and Body does one rely on his support to get the matter done.

note.yi: 「本宫」「他宫」指占得的这一卦所属的宫和别的宫（本宫是用爻或世爻所在的宫，书里没有展开，译文照字面）。「缙绅」是做官的人和乡绅；「牙人」是经纪，「保人」是担保的人，「媒人」是中间说合的人。「赞襄」是帮助。日破是被日辰冲的爻。「成神」书里没有解释，是神煞。「雀旺空动」按字面是朱雀旺相、落空、而发动。
note.en: 'Home palace' and 'another palace' mean the palace to which the hexagram cast belongs and other palaces (the book does not spell out whose palace the home palace is, and the translation follows the letter). 'Jinshen' are officials and country gentry; 'yaren' are brokers, 'baoren' guarantors, and 'meiren' go-betweens. 'Zanxiang' is helping. Day-break is a line clashed by the Day. 'Chengshen' (the Completion spirit) is a spirit-star that the book does not explain. 'Que wang kong dong' is by the letter the Vermilion Bird thriving, Void, and moving.

zh: 欲知事成败于何人，则以六亲定之。
鬼加贵，缙绅也，否则牙人保人媒人也。
欲知何方人，以八卦定之。
又有托人图事者，外人看应，家亲看用爻。
凡应爻用爻犯日破月破旬空者，皆主无能赞勷，空死墓绝胎亦然。
若生旺化空死墓绝胎，必有始无终。
冲克刑害世者，必怀欺难托。
虎动者损害，蛇动者心变，勾动者愚钝，武动者，诈欺，雀旺空动者，多诳语。
惟旺相带龙喜成神，动来生合世身者，则赖其扶持以成事也。
yi: 想知道事情成败在哪个人身上，就用六亲来定。
本宫的内卦，是至亲。
本宫的外卦，是远亲。
他宫的内卦，是邻里。
他宫的外卦，是远方的人。
官鬼加贵人，是缙绅，否则是牙人、保人、媒人。
想知道是哪个方向的人，用八卦来定。
又有托人办事的，外人看应爻，亲人看用爻。
凡应爻、用爻犯日破、月破、旬空的，都主受托的人没有能力帮忙，空、死、墓、绝、胎也一样。
生旺而变成空、死、墓、绝、胎的，必有始无终。
冲、克、刑、害世爻的，受托的人必定怀着欺骗，难以托付。
六冲的卦，终究反目成仇。
白虎发动的，损害；螣蛇发动的，变心；勾陈发动的，愚钝；玄武发动的，欺诈；朱雀旺相落空而发动的，多说谎话。
只有旺相、带青龙、喜神、成神，发动来生合世爻、身爻的，才靠他扶持把事办成。
en: To know through whom the matter succeeds or fails, fix it by the six kin.
The inner trigram of the home palace is the nearest kin.
The outer trigram of the home palace is distant kin.
The inner trigram of another palace is neighbours.
The outer trigram of another palace is men from afar.
Pressure with the Noble is gentry, otherwise a broker, a guarantor or a go-between.
To know from which direction the man comes, fix it by the eight trigrams.
Again, if one entrusts someone with the matter, outsiders are seen through the Other and kin through the Subject line.
Whenever the Other or the Subject line suffers Day-break, Month-break or decade Void, the man entrusted has no ability to help, and so too for Void, death, tomb, extinction and womb.
If thriving and turning into Void, death, tomb, extinction or womb, there is a beginning without an end.
If the Self is clashed, controlled, punished or harmed, the man entrusted surely harbours deceit and cannot be relied on.
A six-clash hexagram ends in a falling out.
If the Tiger moves, he does harm; the Snake, his heart changes; Hook Earth, he is dull; the Dark Tortoise, he cheats; the Bird thriving and Void and moving, he tells many lies.
Only if he is thriving and carries the Dragon, Joy and the Completion spirit and moves to generate or combine with the Self and Body does one rely on his support to get the matter done.

title: 谋望占·可否成败（五）：托贵人图事——官贵受刑害克破不可告贵人事；官贵刑冲克害身世爻求情难蒙许诺后被搀越有始无终反有所费；毕法赋：书占得夜贵曰脱气凡事被贵人掇赚

rule.yi: 托贵人办事：只要官星、贵人受刑、害、克、破，就不可以向贵人求事，因为贵人自己受克制，不能成就我。如果官星、贵人刑、冲、克、害身爻、世爻的，求情难得许诺，后来被别人插队抢先，有始无终，反而要花费钱财。《毕法赋》说：凡是书占得夜贵人，叫作脱气，凡事被贵人哄骗；这是谋望可否成败的附带占断。
rule.en: Entrusting a noble with the matter. If the star of office and the Noble are punished, harmed, controlled or broken, one must not ask the noble for the matter, because the noble himself is under restraint and cannot see me through. If the star of office and the Noble punish, clash with, control or harm the Body and Self, a plea is hard to get granted, and later someone else jumps ahead, so it begins and does not end, and one even spends money for it. The Bifa Fu says: when a document divination gets the night Noble, it is called a drained breath, and in everything one is cajoled and cheated by the noble; this is an appended judgment on whether a scheme can and will succeed.

note.yi: 「搀越」是插进来越过；「掇赚」是哄骗、诓骗。「夜贵」是夜间的贵人（贵人有昼夜两位），「脱气」书里没有解释，按字面是被泄掉了气。《毕法赋》这句是引的另一部书，书里没有说它的上下文，译文照字面。
note.en: 'Chanyue' is cutting in and getting ahead; 'duozhuan' is cajoling and cheating. 'Night Noble' is the night one of the two Nobles (the Noble has a day and a night one), and 'tuoqi' is not explained in the book and means by the letter that the breath is drained away. The sentence from the Bifa Fu is quoted from another book, and the book does not give its context; the translation follows the letter.

zh: 又有托贵人图事者，但官贵受刑害克破，不可告贵人事，缘贵人自受克制，不能成就我也。
如官贵刑冲克害身世爻者，求情难蒙许诺，后被别人搀越，有始无终，反有所费也。
毕法赋曰，凡书占得夜贵，曰脱气，凡事被贵人掇赚也，此谋望可否成败之附占也。
yi: 又有托贵人办事的，只要官星、贵人受刑、害、克、破，就不可以向贵人求事，因为贵人自己受克制，不能成就我。
如果官星、贵人刑、冲、克、害身爻、世爻的，求情难得许诺，后来被别人插队抢先，有始无终，反而要花费钱财。
《毕法赋》说：凡是书占得夜贵人，叫作脱气，凡事被贵人哄骗；这是谋望可否成败的附带占断。
en: Again, one who entrusts a noble with the matter, if the star of office and the Noble are punished, harmed, controlled or broken, must not ask the noble for the matter, because the noble himself is under restraint and cannot see me through.

If the star of office and the Noble punish, clash with, control or harm the Body and Self, a plea is hard to get granted, and later someone else jumps ahead, so it begins and does not end, and one even spends money for it.

The Bifa Fu says: when a document divination gets the night Noble, it is called a drained breath, and in everything one is cajoled and cheated by the noble; this is an appended judgment on whether a scheme can and will succeed.

title: 谋望占·迟速：以用爻为主；动速静迟，旺相出现速、囚死伏藏迟；阳变阴速、阴变阳迟；动临震巽速、临坎艮迟；用临卯酉速、辰戌迟；初二爻动速、三四犹豫、五动迟、六动更迟；用临太岁不出一年、月将不出一月、日辰本日、日建本时；尹逢头断法

rule.yi: 快慢：以用爻为主。发动的快，安静的慢；旺相、出现的快，囚、死、伏藏的慢；阳变阴的快，阴变阳的慢；发动临在震、巽的快，临在坎、艮的慢；用爻临卯、酉的快（卯酉是日月出入的门户），临辰、戌的慢（辰戌是天罗地网，是天涯海角）；初爻、二爻发动的快，三爻、四爻发动的犹豫迟疑，五爻发动的慢，六爻发动的更慢。用爻临太岁，不出一年；临月将，不出一月；临日辰，就在当日；临日建，就在当时。尹逢头的断法说：用爻旺相，还要等入墓的日子来定；用爻休囚，在生旺的日子应当成；用爻伏藏，只看用爻当值的日子；发动而被合住的，等冲它的日辰。
rule.en: Slow or fast. Take the Subject line as the chief. Moving is quick, still is slow; thriving and appearing is quick, imprisoned, dead and hidden is slow; yang changing into yin is quick, yin changing into yang is slow; moving on Zhen or Xun is quick, on Kan or Gen is slow; the Subject on Mao or You is quick (Mao and You are the gates of sun and moon), on Chen or Xu is slow (Chen and Xu are the net of heaven and the snare of earth, the ends of the earth); a first or second line moving is quick, a third or fourth moving hesitates and delays, a fifth moving is slow, and a sixth moving slower still. If the Subject sits on Tai Sui, it is within a year; on the Month General, within a month; on the Day, that same day; on the Day branch, that very hour. The Chuan Yin Feng method of judgment says: if the Subject is thriving, fix it by the day it enters tomb; if resting, it should be done on the day it is born or thriving; if hidden, look only at the day the Subject rules; if moving and held by a combination, wait for the day that clashes it.

note.yi: 「月将」是太阳所在的月份地支（神煞，不是月建），「日建」是当日的地支，书里没有解释；「天罗地网」是辰、戌两个位置，「天涯海角」比喻远。「尹逢头」是一位断卦的人，书里没有说他是谁，「断法」这里是他的断语。第五、六句的括号小注是对前一句「卯酉」「辰戌」的说明。「动临震巽速」按字面是发动的爻落在震、巽两个卦里。
note.en: The 'Month General' is the branch of the month in which the sun stands (a spirit-star, not the Month branch), and the 'Day branch' is the branch of the day; the book does not explain them. 'The net of heaven and the snare of earth' are the two positions Chen and Xu, and 'the ends of the earth' is an image of far away. 'Yin Fengtou' is a diviner, and the book does not say who he was; his 'method of judgment' here is his saying. The bracketed notes in the fifth and sixth sentences explain 'Mao and You' and 'Chen and Xu' of the sentence before. 'Moving on Zhen or Xun' is by the letter the moving line falling in the Zhen or Xun trigram.

zh: 动速静迟，旺相出现速，囚死伏藏迟。
动临震巽速，动临坎艮迟。
(卯酉为日月之门户)，用临辰戌迟。
(辰戌为天罗地网，为天涯海角)。
初二爻动速，三四爻动，犹豫迟疑。
尹逢头断法曰，用旺还须墓日定，用休生旺日当成，用伏但看用值日，动逢合住待冲辰。
yi: 以用爻为主。
发动的快，安静的慢；旺相、出现的快，囚、死、伏藏的慢。
阳变阴的快，阴变阳的慢。
发动临在震、巽的快，临在坎、艮的慢。
用爻临卯、酉的快。
（卯酉是日月出入的门户。）用爻临辰、戌的慢。
（辰戌是天罗地网，是天涯海角。）
初爻、二爻发动的快，三爻、四爻发动的，犹豫迟疑。
五爻发动的慢，六爻发动的更慢。
用爻临太岁，不出一年。
用爻临月将，不出一月。
用爻临日辰，就在当日。
临日建，就在当时。
尹逢头的断法说：用爻旺相，还要等入墓的日子来定；用爻休囚，在生旺的日子应当成；用爻伏藏，只看用爻当值的日子；发动而被合住的，等冲它的日辰。
en: Take the Subject line as the chief.
Moving is quick, still is slow; thriving and appearing is quick, imprisoned, dead and hidden is slow.
Yang changing into yin is quick, yin changing into yang is slow.
Moving on Zhen or Xun is quick, on Kan or Gen is slow.
The Subject on Mao or You is quick.
(Mao and You are the gates of sun and moon.) The Subject on Chen or Xu is slow.
(Chen and Xu are the net of heaven and the snare of earth, the ends of the earth.)
A first or second line moving is quick; a third or fourth moving hesitates and delays.
A fifth line moving is slow, and a sixth moving slower still.
If the Subject sits on Tai Sui, it is within a year.
If it sits on the Month General, it is within a month.
If it sits on the Day, it is that same day.
If it sits on the Day branch, it is that very hour.

The Chuan Yin Feng method of judgment says: if the Subject is thriving, fix it by the day it enters tomb; if resting, it should be done on the day it is born or thriving; if hidden, look only at the day the Subject rules; if moving and held by a combination, wait for the day that clashes it.

title: 升选候补·官爵荣身，须宜持世；养廉财禄，最喜生身（旺官持世，日月动爻作官星生合世爻，或世动化官生世，皆吉；财动生官得美缺，官临日月必超迁）

rule.yi: 占升选补缺，官星要旺相、持世，妻财要来生身：旺相的官星持世，或者日月、动爻作官星来生合世爻，或者世爻发动变出官星来生世，都是吉兆；妻财发动生官星，能得到好缺；官星临在日月上，必定越级升迁。
rule.en: In a question about promotion or appointment the star of office should be thriving and hold the Self, and Wealth should generate the Body: a thriving star of office holding the Self, or the Day, the Month or a moving line acting as the star of office to generate or combine with the Self, or the Self moving and turning into the star of office to generate the Self, are all auspicious; Wealth moving to generate the star of office wins a fine post; the star of office on the Day or Month means promotion beyond one's rank.

zh: 旺官持世，及日月动爻作官星生合世爻，或世动化官生世，皆为吉兆。
又曰：“财动生官得美缺，官临日月必超迁。”
yi: 官职爵位要使自身荣耀，官星应当持世；
靠清廉养身的俸禄钱财，最喜欢来生扶自身。
旺相的官星持世，以及日月、动爻作官星来生合世爻，或者世爻发动变出官星来生世，都是吉兆。
又说：「财发动生官星，能得到好缺；官星临在日月上，必定越级升迁。」
