en: For office and rank to bring honour to oneself, the star of office should hold the Self;
for the salary that keeps an official honest, nothing is better than that it generate the Body.

A thriving star of office holding the Self, or the Day, the Month or a moving line acting as the star of office to generate or combine with the Self, or the Self moving and turning into the star of office to generate the Self, are all auspicious signs.
It also says: 'When Wealth moves to generate the star of office one gets a fine post; when the star of office sits on the Day or Month one is surely promoted beyond one's rank.'

title: 升选候补·子孙持世，休望荣取；官位破空，勿思升选（子孙持世或动于卦中，升选无期；官临空绝墓破，及动而变凶，补升尚早）

rule.yi: 子孙持世，或者在卦中发动，升迁选官没有指望；官星落在空、绝、墓、破上，或者发动变出凶爻，补缺升迁还早得很。
rule.en: If Output holds the Self or moves in the hexagram, promotion and selection have no hope; if the star of office falls on Void, extinction, tomb or break, or moves and turns into a bad line, it is still early for an appointment or promotion.

zh: 子孙持世，或动于卦中，升选无期；
官临空绝墓破，及动而变凶，补升尚早。
yi: 子孙持世，别指望得到荣耀的官职；
官位被破、落空，不要想升迁选官。
子孙持世，或者在卦中发动，升迁选官没有日期；
官星临在空、绝、墓、破上，以及发动变出凶爻，补缺升迁还早得很。
en: If Output holds the Self, do not hope for an honourable post;
if the office position is broken or Void, do not think of promotion or selection.
if Output holds the Self, or moves in the hexagram, promotion and selection have no date;
if the star of office falls on Void, extinction, tomb or break, or moves and turns into a bad line, it is still early for an appointment or promotion.

title: 升选候补·雨露承恩，名中逢合（世与官星三合官局、财局，或局生世、世在局中，或官星持世与日月动爻相合，得六合卦及动变六合，皆主承恩之日；书中例：官局生应不生世，此缺不得）

rule.yi: 世爻与官星三合成官局或财局，或者这个局生世爻，或者世爻在局中，或者官星持世、又与日月动爻相合，得到六合卦，以及发动变成六合卦的，都是得到皇恩的日子。但如果官局生的是应爻、不是世爻，这叫「出现无情」，这个缺得不到。
rule.en: If the Self and the star of office form a three-harmony Pressure frame or Wealth frame, or the frame generates the Self, or the Self is within the frame, or the star of office holds the Self and combines with the Day, the Month or a moving line, or one gets a Six-Combine hexagram or a hexagram that moves into Six-Combine, it is the day of receiving the ruler's favour. But if the Pressure frame generates the Other and not the Self, this is called 'appearing but without feeling', and the post cannot be had.

note.yi: 「出现无情」书里只用在这个例子上，没有另外解释；按断语的意思，是官局出现了，却不生世、去生了应爻。
note.en: The book uses 'appearing but without feeling' only in this example and does not explain it elsewhere; from the judgment, it means that the Pressure frame appears but does not generate the Self and instead generates the Other.

zh: 世与官星三合官局、财局，或局生世、或世在局中，或官星持世与日月动爻相合，得逢六合卦，及动变六合者，皆主承恩之日。
yi: 像雨露一样承受皇恩，要在功名里逢到合。
世爻与官星三合成官局、财局，或者这个局生世爻，或者世爻在局中，或者官星持世、与日月动爻相合，得到六合卦，以及发动变成六合卦的，都主得到皇恩的日子。
en: To receive favour like rain and dew, one must meet a combination in the matter of rank.

If the Self and the star of office form a three-harmony Pressure frame or Wealth frame, or the frame generates the Self, or the Self is within the frame, or the star of office holds the Self and combines with the Day, the Month or a moving line, or one gets a Six-Combine hexagram or a hexagram that moves into Six-Combine, all mean the day of receiving favour.

zh: 如：申月乙亥日(旬空：辰巳)，占缺得否？
yi: 例如：申月乙亥日（旬空：辰、巳），占这个缺能不能得到？
得到井卦变节卦。
en: For example: in the Shen month on a Yihai day (void: Chen and Si), a divination on whether he would get a vacant post;
the hexagram was Jing changing into Jie.

zh: 断曰：内卦巳酉丑合成官局，不生世而生应，正所谓“出现无情”也，此缺不得。
yi: 断语说：内卦巳、酉、丑合成官局，不生世爻而生应爻，正是所谓「出现无情」，这个缺得不到。
他问：为什么得不到？
我说：官星生的是应爻，怎么能得到？
后来果然另选了别人。
en: The judgment said: the inner trigram Si, You and Chou combines into a Pressure frame, which does not generate the Self but generates the Other, which is just what is meant by 'appearing but without feeling', and this post cannot be had.
He asked: why can it not be had?
I said: the star of office generates the Other, so how could he get it?
In the end someone else was indeed chosen.

title: 升选候补·风云未际，冲上逢冲（世官不旺又得六冲，或官被日月冲，或六冲变冲，元神衰静、泄气爻摇，问升选无期；世动官化进神，升迁在即）

rule.yi: 时机未到的征兆：世爻、官星都不旺，又得六冲卦，或者官星被日月相冲，或者六冲变六冲；元神衰弱安静，或者泄元神之气的爻发动，问升选就没有日期。反过来，世爻发动、官星变成进神，升迁就在眼前；世爻发动或变吉，或禄、马、贵人临世，或官星发动变吉、生合世爻，都可以收拾行装等着。
rule.en: Signs that the moment has not come: the Self and the star of office are not thriving and the hexagram is Six-Clash, or the star of office is clashed by the Day or Month, or a Six-Clash hexagram turns into Six-Clash; or the Support is weak and still, or the line that drains it moves, and then promotion has no date. The reverse: if the Self moves and the star of office turns into an Advancing line, promotion is at hand; if the Self moves, or turns auspicious, or Emolument, the Horse and a Noble sit on the Self, or the star of office moves, turns auspicious and generates or combines with the Self, one may pack one's bags and wait.

zh: 世官不旺，又得六冲，或官被日月相冲，或六冲变冲，乃风云未际之时。
元神衰静，泄气爻摇，问升选则无期。
如官爻属木，水爻衰而不动，火爻发动是也。
世爻发动，官化进神，望荣升而在即。
世爻发动，或动而化吉，或禄马贵人临世，及官动化吉生合世爻，皆可束装以待。
yi: 风云际会的时机还没到，是冲上又逢冲。
世爻和官星都不旺，又得到六冲卦，或者官星被日月相冲，或者六冲卦变六冲卦，就是风云际会的时机还没到的时候。
元神衰弱安静，或者泄气的爻在动，问升选就没有日期。
比如官爻属木，水爻衰弱而不动，火爻发动，就是这种情形。
其余的依此类推。
世爻发动，官星变成进神，盼望的荣升就在眼前。
世爻发动，或者发动变吉，或者禄、马、贵人临世，以及官星发动变吉、生合世爻，都可以收拾行装等着。
en: The moment of wind and cloud has not yet come: a clash upon a clash.

If the Self and the star of office are not thriving and one gets a Six-Clash hexagram, or the star of office is clashed by the Day or Month, or a Six-Clash hexagram turns into Six-Clash, it is a time when the moment of wind and cloud has not yet come.
If the Support is weak and still, or the line that drains it is moving, then for promotion and selection there is no date.
For example, the Pressure line is Wood, the Water line is weak and does not move, and the Fire line moves: that is the case.
The rest follow by analogy.
If the Self moves and the star of office turns into an Advancing line, the longed-for promotion is at hand.

If the Self moves, or moves and turns auspicious, or Emolument, the Horse or a Noble sits on the Self, or the star of office moves, turns auspicious and generates or combines with the Self, one may pack one's bags and wait.

title: 升选候补·世官破而休望，世福空而亦升（世临月破纵官星持世亦不能升；子孙持世值旬空亦不当升，但占两三日之内者许必得，因子孙未出空、不克官；书中例三个）

rule.yi: 世爻或官星被破就不要指望，世爻上的子孙落空却也能升。世爻落在月破上，即使官星持世也升不了，还要防别的变故；子孙持世又遇旬空，也不该升。但如果占的是两三天之内的事，可以答应一定得到，因为子孙还没有出空、没有克官星。作者占过三个人，都得了官，得官后随即死了。
rule.en: If the Self or the star of office is broken, give up hope; if the Self sits on an Output line that is Void, one is promoted all the same. If the Self is Month-broken, one cannot be promoted even when the star of office holds the Self, and one must guard against other changes; if Output holds the Self and meets Void, one should not be promoted either. But if the question concerns the next two or three days, one may grant that it will surely be had, since Output has not yet left the Void and does not yet control the star of office. The author divined for three men; all got office, and all died soon after getting it.

note.yi: 「世福空而亦升」按注文的意思是：世爻持子孙又落旬空，一般不该升，只有占两三天之内的事才许得，因为子孙没出空就克不了官。「前卦点差」「又悟前占卦之差」是说第一例让他看出了自己断错的地方，后两例才断准。
note.en: 'The Self on a Void Output line is promoted all the same' means, by the note, that when the Self holds Output and it falls in Void one is generally not due for promotion, and may be granted it only for a question of two or three days, since Output cannot control the star of office while it has not left the Void. 'The former hexagram pointed out the error' and 'also realized the error of the earlier divination' mean that the first example showed him where his own judgment had been wrong, and he judged the next two correctly.

zh: 世官破而休望，世福空而亦升。
世临月破，纵官星持世，亦不能升，而犹防他变。
子孙持世值旬空，亦不当升。
若占两三日之内者，许之必得，其故由子孙尚未出空，不克官也。
余占过三人，俱皆得官，得后随死。
yi: 世爻和官星被破就不要指望，世爻上的福神落空却也能升。
世爻落在月破上，即使官星持世，也不能升迁，而且还要防备别的变故。
子孙持世而遇旬空，也不该升。
如果占的是两三天之内的事，可以答应他一定得到，原因是子孙还没有出空，没有克官星。
我占过三个人，都得了官，得官之后随即死了。
en: If the Self and the star of office are broken, give up hope; if the Self sits on an Output line that is Void, one is promoted all the same.
If the Self sits in Month-break, even if the star of office holds the Self one cannot be promoted, and one must still guard against other changes.
If Output holds the Self and meets Void, one should not be promoted either.
If the question is about the next two or three days, one may grant that he will surely get it, because Output has not yet left the Void and so does not control the star of office.
I have divined for three men, all of whom got office and all of whom died soon after getting it.

zh: 如：申月戊寅日(旬空：申酉)，占得差否？
yi: 例如：申月戊寅日（旬空：申、酉），占能不能得到差事？
得到夬卦。
en: For example: in the Shen month on a Wuyin day (void: Shen and You), a divination on whether he would get a commission;
the hexagram was Guai.

zh: 岂知不出三日得差，行至中途而死。
寻其故，盖三日之内而得差者，子孙未出空也；
yi: 子孙持世，这个差事得不到；
世爻落空，也得不到。
哪知道不出三天就得了差事，走到半路上死了。
追究它的缘故，三天之内得到差事，是因为子孙还没有出空；
半路上死，是因为世爻落空。
en: Output holds the Self, so this commission cannot be had;
the Self is Void, so it cannot be had either.
Who would have thought that within three days he got the commission, and died on the road halfway there.
Looking for the reason: getting the commission within three days was because Output had not yet left the Void;
dying on the road was because the Self was Void.

zh: 又：寅月庚辰日(旬空：申酉)，占得缺否？
yi: 又例：寅月庚辰日（旬空：申、酉），占能不能得缺？
得到需卦。
en: Another: in the Yin month on a Gengchen day (void: Shen and You), a divination on whether he would get a post;
the hexagram was Xu.

zh: 子孙持世遇旬空，与前卦同，亦是只在三两日命下之事。
又悟前占卦之差，余竟许之，果得缺，不出两月而亡。
yi: 子孙持世、遇旬空，和前一个卦相同，也是只在三两天内命令就下来的事。
又因为看出了前一次占断的差错，我就答应他能得，结果果然得了缺，不到两个月就死了。
en: Output holds the Self and meets Void, the same as the previous hexagram, so again the order will come down within two or three days.
Having also seen where the earlier judgment went wrong, I granted it, and he did get the post, but died in less than two months.

zh: 又：辰月丁丑日(旬空：申酉)，占起用，已列名矣，得“渐之观”
yi: 又例：辰月丁丑日（旬空：申、酉），占起用，已经列了名，得到渐卦变观卦。
en: Another: in the Chen month on a Dingchou day (void: Shen and You), a divination on reinstatement, his name already being listed, gave Jian changing into Guan.

zh: 此与前二卦大同小异，前二卦子孙持世遇旬空，未曾发动，此卦动而变官，况亦系两三日内事，子孙尚未出空，竟许必得。
果得起用，行六日而家内子死，抵任八阅月而疾终。
身死子亡者，乃是世与子孙同变鬼也。
余于后二卦之得验者，实因前卦点差，时刻留心故耳！
今人占过即忘，何由精奥。
yi: 这个卦和前面两个卦大同小异：前两个卦子孙持世、遇旬空，没有发动，这个卦是发动后变出官星，何况也是两三天之内的事，子孙还没有出空，我就答应他一定得到。
结果果然得到起用，上路六天后家里的儿子死了，到任八个月后他自己病故。
自己死、儿子也死，是因为世爻和子孙一起变成了官鬼。
我在后面两个卦能断准，实在是因为前一个卦让我发现了差错，时刻留心的缘故！
现在的人占过就忘，哪能精通其中的奥妙。
en: This hexagram is much the same as the two before, with small differences: in the previous two Output held the Self and met Void without moving, while in this one it moves and turns into the star of office; moreover it too concerned the next two or three days, and Output had not yet left the Void, so I granted that he would surely get it.
He did get reinstated; six days after setting out his son at home died, and eight months after he took up his post he himself died of illness.
That he and his son both died was because the Self and Output both turned into Pressure.
That I judged the latter two hexagrams correctly was really because the former hexagram showed me my error and I kept it constantly in mind!
People today forget as soon as they have divined, so how could they master its depths?

title: 升选候补·随官入墓，世旺者官升；助鬼伤身，身衰者祸至（古以随官入墓、助鬼伤世为凶，作者屡试：世旺反升、世衰不吉，助鬼伤身而元神同动者官必升，世休囚必有祸）

rule.yi: 古人把「随官入墓」「助鬼伤世」一概当凶，作者多次试验，结果是：世爻旺相的反而升官；世爻衰弱的不吉；助鬼伤身而元神同时发动的，官职必定升；世爻如果休囚，必有灾祸。
rule.en: The ancients took 'following the star of office into the tomb' and 'helping Pressure to injure the Self' as ominous without exception; the author tested it many times and found: where the Self is thriving the man is promoted instead; where the Self is weak it is not auspicious; where one helps Pressure to injure the Body but the Support moves at the same time, the office is surely raised; if the Self is resting or trapped, disaster is sure to come.

dispute.yi: 古人把「随官入墓」「助鬼伤世」都当作凶；增删卜易说自己多次试验，世爻旺的反而升官，元神同时发动的官必升，只有世爻休囚才有祸。这是作者对古说的修正，不是两本书的分歧。
dispute.en: The ancients took 'following the star of office into the tomb' and 'helping Pressure to injure the Self' as ominous; the Zeng Shan Bu Yi says that after many tests the man whose Self was thriving was promoted instead, that where the Support moves at the same time the office is surely raised, and that only a resting or trapped Self brings disaster. This is the author's correction of the old teaching, not a disagreement between two books.

note.yi: 原文第二个例子的月份写作「戍月」，应是「戌月」，译文按戌月。
note.en: The second example gives the month as 'Shu' in the text, which should be 'Xu'; the translation reads the Xu month.

zh: 古以随官入墓、助鬼伤世，皆以为凶。
助鬼伤身，元神同动者，其官必升；
yi: 随着官星入墓，世爻旺相的，官职升迁。
帮助官鬼来伤害自身，自身衰弱的，灾祸就到。
古人认为随官入墓、助鬼伤世，都是凶。
我多次试验，世爻旺相的，竟然都升了；
世爻衰弱的，不吉；
助鬼伤身，但元神同时发动的，他的官职必定升；
世爻如果休囚，必定有灾祸到来。
en: If the Self follows the star of office into the tomb and the Self is thriving, the office is raised.
If one helps Pressure to injure the Body and the Body is weak, disaster arrives.
The ancients took following the star of office into the tomb, and helping Pressure to injure the Self, both as ominous.
I tested it many times: where the Self was thriving, the man was promoted;
where the Self was weak, it was not auspicious;
where one helps Pressure to injure the Body but the Support moves at the same time, his office will surely be raised;
if the Self is resting or trapped, disaster will surely come.

zh: 如：寅月乙未日(旬空：辰巳)，占升，得“比之观”
yi: 例如：寅月乙未日（旬空：辰、巳），占升官，得到比卦变观卦。
en: For example: in the Yin month on a Yiwei day (void: Chen and Si), a divination on promotion gave Bi changing into Guan.

zh: 卯木旺官持世，子水财动相生，虽曰墓于未日，幸世爻得助，无妨，果升于亥月。
yi: 卯木旺相的官星持世，子水财爻发动来生它，虽然说在未日入墓，幸好世爻得到帮助，没有妨碍，结果在亥月升了官。
en: The Mao Wood star of office is thriving and holds the Self, and the Zi Water Wealth line moves to generate it; though it is said to enter the tomb on the Wei day, the Self is fortunately helped, so there is no harm, and he was indeed promoted in the Hai month.

zh: 又如：戍月辛酉日(旬空：子丑)，占何月补官？
yi: 又例：戌月辛酉日（旬空：子、丑），占哪个月补官？
得到蹇卦变需卦。
en: Another: in the Xu month on a Xinyou day (void: Zi and Chou), a divination on which month he would be given an office;
the hexagram was Jian changing into Xu.

zh: 寅木财爻生助午火之鬼，火鬼克世，乃为助鬼伤身，幸辰土生申金，午火贪生忘克，今年冬月必升。
应冬月者，辰土化子水空亡，至十一月则不空矣。
yi: 寅木财爻生助午火官鬼，火官鬼克世爻，这就是助鬼伤身；幸好辰土生申金，午火贪着去生而忘了去克，所以今年冬月必定升官。
结果果然在冬月升了官。
应在冬月，是因为辰土变成子水，而子水落空亡，到十一月就不空了。
en: The Yin Wood Wealth line generates and helps the Wu Fire Pressure line, and the Fire Pressure line controls the Self, which is helping Pressure to injure the Body; fortunately Chen Earth generates Shen Metal, and Wu Fire, greedy to generate, forgets to control, so he will surely be promoted this winter month.
He was indeed promoted in the winter month.
It came due in the winter month because Chen Earth turned into Zi Water, which was Void, and in the eleventh month it is no longer Void.

title: 升选候补·野鹤：古以晋、升为吉，屯、蹇为凶，晋升也要世爻得地，屯蹇世旺无妨

rule.yi: 看升选不能只看卦名：古人以晋、升两卦为吉，屯、蹇两卦为凶；野鹤说晋、升两卦确实屡次应验，但也要世爻得地，世爻失陷也不吉；屯、蹇两卦，只要世爻旺相就没有妨碍，他有一次世爻旺相占到屯卦，照样越级升迁。
rule.en: Promotion cannot be read from the hexagram name alone: the ancients took Jin and Sheng as auspicious and Zhun and Jian as ominous; the Old Man of Yehe says Jin and Sheng have indeed proved right many times, but the Self must also be well placed, and a Self that is lost or sunk is not auspicious; for Zhun and Jian there is no harm so long as the Self is thriving, and once he got Zhun with a thriving Self and was promoted beyond rank all the same.

note.yi: 「前篇亥月丙寅日之占验」指本书前面求名各章里的一个例子，不在本章，这里没有收。
note.en: 'The divination of the Hai month on a Bingyin day in the earlier section' refers to an example in the earlier chapters of the book on seeking a name, not in this chapter, and it is not collected here.

zh: 野鹤曰：古以晋、升为吉，屯、蹇为凶，余于晋升二卦，果得屡验，亦要世爻得地，若失陷，亦不为吉。
屯蹇二卦，世爻旺者何妨。
前篇亥月丙寅日之占验，世爻旺者，竟得超升，岂非屯卦耶？
yi: 野鹤说：古人认为晋、升两卦吉，屯、蹇两卦凶；我对晋、升两卦，确实屡次应验，但也要世爻得地，如果世爻失陷，也不吉。
屯、蹇两卦，世爻旺相的有什么妨碍。
前一篇亥月丙寅日的占验，世爻旺相，竟然得了越级升迁，那不就是屯卦吗？
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: the ancients took Jin and Sheng as auspicious and Zhun and Jian as ominous; for Jin and Sheng I have indeed found them confirmed many times, but the Self must also be well placed, and if it is lost or sunk, they are not auspicious either.
For Zhun and Jian, what harm is there if the Self is thriving?
In the divination of the Hai month on a Bingyin day in the earlier section the Self was thriving and he was promoted beyond rank after all; was that not the Zhun hexagram?

title: 升迁何方·官金而应西土，木官必应东方，水北火南，土升中土（野鹤：此古法也，验过的有出入：木官应山东亦有应广东，金官应山西亦有江西、广西，又有以住处分东西南北）

rule.yi: 按官星的五行断去哪个方位上任：金官应西，木官应东，水应北，火应南，土官升到中土。野鹤说这是古法，他验证过的有出入：木官应在山东，也有应在广东的；金官应在山西，也有应在江西、广西的；还有按所住的地方来分东西南北的。
rule.en: To judge in which direction the post lies from the element of the star of office: a Metal one is due in the west, a Wood one in the east, Water in the north, Fire in the south, and an Earth one is promoted to the central land. The Old Man of Yehe says this is the old method and that what he has confirmed does not quite agree: a Wood star of office is due in Shandong, but sometimes in Guangdong; a Metal one in Shanxi, but sometimes in Jiangxi or Guangxi; and sometimes the directions are divided according to the place where one lives.

zh: 官金而应西土，木官必应东方，水北火南，土升中土。
yi: 官星属金，就应在西方；官星属木，必定应在东方；水应北方，火应南方，土官就升在中土。
en: If the star of office is Metal it is due in the west; a Wood star of office is due in the east; Water north, Fire south; an Earth one is promoted to the central land.

zh: 余之得验：木官而应山东，亦有应广东者；
金官应山西，亦有江西、广西者；
又有以住处而分东西南北者。
yi: 野鹤说：这是古法。
我验证过的：木官应在山东，也有应在广东的；
金官应在山西，也有应在江西、广西的；
又有按所住的地方来分东西南北的。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: this is the old method.
What I have found confirmed: a Wood star of office is due in Shandong, but sometimes in Guangdong;
a Metal one in Shanxi, but sometimes in Jiangxi or Guangxi;
and sometimes the directions are divided according to the place where one lives.

zh: 如：未月己巳日(旬空：戌亥)，在京师占地方，得“归妹之解”
yi: 例如：未月己巳日（旬空：戌、亥），在京城占赴任的地方，得到归妹卦变解卦。
en: For example: in the Wei month on a Jisi day (void: Xu and Hai), a divination in the capital on where he would be posted gave Guimei changing into Jie.

zh: 彼时有山东、真定两缺，此卦巳火官星，许得真定。
余曰：巳火官星乃南方也，真定乃都门之南故耳。
yi: 当时有山东、真定两个缺，这个卦是巳火官星，答应他能得真定。
他问：为什么？
我说：巳火官星属南方，真定在京城的南面。
结果得了真定。
en: At the time there were two posts, Shandong and Zhending; in this hexagram the star of office is Si Fire, and I granted that he would get Zhending.
He asked: why?
I said: the Si Fire star of office is the south, and Zhending lies south of the capital.
He did get Zhending.

title: 升迁何方·初爻为内地，五六为边方（野鹤：世与官星都在初爻为应内地；世在五、官在六，或相反，或官星持世同在五六爻为应边方；在二三四爻仍以五行决之）

rule.yi: 看是内地还是边远：初爻代表内地，五爻、六爻代表边远地方。野鹤解释：「应在初爻」是世爻和官星都在初爻；「应在五、六爻」是世在五爻官在六爻，或世在六爻官在五爻，或官星持世、一起在五、六爻上；如果在二、三、四爻，仍然按五行来决断。
rule.en: To tell whether the post is inland or on the frontier: the first line is the inner land and the fifth and sixth lines are the frontier. The Old Man of Yehe explains: 'due in the first line' means the Self and the star of office are both in the first line; 'due in the fifth or sixth line' means the Self is in the fifth line and the star of office in the sixth, or the Self in the sixth and the star of office in the fifth, or the star of office holds the Self and both are in the fifth or sixth line; if they are in the second, third or fourth line, one still decides by the five elements.

note.yi: 两个例子的卦名后面，原文还紧接着卦宫的标题（「巽宫：山风蛊（归魂）」「震宫：震为雷（六冲）」），是排盘的格式，这里只引到卦名。
note.en: After the hexagram names in the two examples the text runs straight on into the palace headings of the charts ('Xun palace: Mountain over Wind, Gu (Returning Soul)' and 'Zhen palace: Thunder, Zhen (Six-Clash)'), which are chart formatting, and only the hexagram names are quoted here.

zh: 初爻为内地，五六为边方。
yi: 初爻代表内地，五爻、六爻代表边远地方。
en: The first line is the inner land, and the fifth and sixth lines are the frontier.

zh: 野鹤曰：应初爻者，世与官星皆在初爻者是也；
应五六爻者，或世在五爻、官在六爻，或世在六爻，官在五爻，或官星持世，同在五六爻上是也。
若在二、三、四爻，仍以五行决之。
yi: 野鹤说：应在初爻，指世爻和官星都在初爻；
应在五、六爻，指世在五爻、官在六爻，或者世在六爻、官在五爻，或者官星持世、一起在五、六爻上；
如果在二、三、四爻，仍然按五行来决断。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: 'due in the first line' means the Self and the star of office are both in the first line;

'due in the fifth or sixth line' means the Self is in the fifth line and the star of office in the sixth, or the Self in the sixth and the star of office in the fifth, or the star of office holds the Self and both are in the fifth or sixth line;
if they are in the second, third or fourth line, one still decides by the five elements.

zh: 如：丑月癸亥日(旬空：子丑)，占升于何方？
yi: 例如：丑月癸亥日（旬空：子、丑），占升到哪个方位？
得到蛊卦。
en: For example: in the Chou month on a Guihai day (void: Zi and Chou), a divination on in which direction he would be posted;
the hexagram was Gu.

zh: 此卦酉官持世，许任西方。
yi: 这个卦酉金官星持世，答应他任职在西方。
到第二年，到了日子被选上。
en: In this hexagram the You Metal star of office holds the Self, and I granted that he would hold office in the west.
In the following year, when the time came, he was selected.

zh: 又于：寅月甲戌日(旬空：申酉)，占升何地？
yi: 又例：寅月甲戌日（旬空：申、酉），占升到什么地方？
得到震卦。
en: Another: in the Yin month on a Jiaxu day (void: Shen and You), a divination on to what place he would be promoted;
the hexagram was Zhen.

zh: 余犹律前卦酉金持世曾许西方，今此卦仍是金官，西方必矣，但世在六爻，必是边缺。
yi: 我仍然依照前一个卦酉金持世曾答应他在西方的例子，这个卦仍然是金官，西方是肯定的，但世爻在六爻，一定是边远的缺。
他说：有庆阳。
我说：就是这个缺。
结果升到了庆阳。
en: I still followed the previous hexagram, in which the You Metal on the Self had been granted as the west; in this one the star of office is again Metal, so the west is certain, but the Self is in the sixth line, so it must be a frontier post.
He said: there is Qingyang.
I said: that is the post.
He was indeed promoted to Qingyang.

title: 升迁何方·野鹤：问地方不如指其缺而问（此缺我得否？我得词林、部属、科道、正印否？官星持世、官动生合世、三合官局生世皆必得；世空世破、官破官空、子孙持世或发动、官临应爻、官局生应皆不得）

rule.yi: 占升选，与其问「升到哪个方向」，不如指明具体的缺来问：这个缺我能得吗？我能进翰林吗？我能做部属吗？我能做科道官吗？我能做正印官吗？官星持世、官星发动生合世爻、三合官局生世，都主必得；世爻落空落破、官星落破落空、子孙持世、子孙发动、官星临在应爻上、三合官局生应爻，都主得不到。指明了缺就已经知道在哪里，不必多此一举。
rule.en: In a question about promotion, rather than asking 'in which direction', it is better to name the post and ask: can I get this post? Can I enter the Hanlin Academy? Can I get a post in a ministry? Can I become a supervising censor? Can I become the chief official holding the seal? If the star of office holds the Self, or the star of office moves to generate or combine with the Self, or a three-harmony Pressure frame generates the Self, it will surely be had; if the Self is Void or broken, the star of office is broken or Void, Output holds the Self, Output moves, the star of office sits on the Other, or a three-harmony Pressure frame generates the Other, it will not be had. Once the post is named its place is already known, and the extra step is unnecessary.

note.yi: 词林、部属、科道、正印是清朝官的类别：词林是翰林院，部属是各部的属官，科道是六科给事中和各道监察御史，正印是主官（掌印的正职）。书里没有逐个解释，这里是按通行的意思注的。原文这一段最后还有一句「今人测占工作调动，职务升迁何方亦可仿此」，是今人加的话，不收。
note.en: Cilin, bushu, kedao and zhengyin are categories of official in the Qing: the Hanlin Academy, the subordinate officials of the ministries, the supervising secretaries and investigating censors, and the chief officials who hold the seal. The book does not explain them one by one; this is the usual sense. The paragraph ends in the text with a sentence 'for people today who divine job transfers and the direction of promotion the same method may be followed', which is a modern editor's addition and is not quoted.

zh: 野鹤曰：大概问其地方，虽则有验，然不如指其地而问之，此缺我得否？
如官星持世者、官动生合世爻者、三合官局而生世者，皆主必得；
世空世破、官破官空、子孙持世、子孙发动、官临应爻、三合官局而生应爻，皆主不得。
野鹤曰：指其缺而问之，不失为便捷之法。
指其缺即已知其缺在何方，而不必多此一举也。
yi: 野鹤说：大致问是哪个地方，虽然也有应验，但不如指明那个地方来问：这个缺我能得吗？
我能进翰林院吗？
我能做部属吗？
我能做科道官吗？
我能做正印官吗？
像官星持世的、官星发动生合世爻的、三合成官局而生世的，都主必得；
世爻落空落破、官星落破落空、子孙持世、子孙发动、官星临在应爻上、三合成官局而生应爻的，都主得不到。
野鹤说：指明那个缺来问，不失为一个简便快捷的办法。
指明了那个缺，就已经知道那个缺在哪个方位，不必再多此一举。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: asking in general which place does sometimes prove right, but it is better to name the place and ask: can I get this post?
Can I enter the Hanlin Academy?
Can I get a post in one of the ministries?
Can I become a supervising censor?
Can I become the chief official holding the seal?
Where the star of office holds the Self, or the star of office moves to generate or combine with the Self, or a three-harmony Pressure frame generates the Self, all mean it will surely be had;

where the Self is Void or broken, the star of office is broken or Void, Output holds the Self, Output moves, the star of office sits on the Other, or a three-harmony Pressure frame generates the Other, all mean it will not be had.
The Old Man of Yehe says: naming the post and asking is not a bad quick method.
Once the post is named the place of the post is already known, and there is no need for the extra step.

title: 在任吉凶·官旺财兴，仕途显赫；子摇兄动，减俸休官（官旺遇生扶或动化吉、世旺财旺，兵民颂德；官临日月生合世，近君异宠、大位超升、外任卓异；兄持世或动，破财罚俸；子孙持世或动，有削职之忧）

rule.yi: 在任吉凶：官星旺相、妻财兴旺，仕途显赫。官星旺相又得生扶，或发动变吉，世旺财旺，或财发动生世，官民称颂，宦途平稳；官星临日月生合世爻，或三合官局生合世爻，或官星持世又得日月生扶、太岁五爻相生合，在君主身边的特别受宠，居高位的不久越级升迁，外任的被评为卓异。反过来，兄弟持世或发动，不是破财就是罚俸；子孙持世或在动爻中，有被剥官削职的忧虑，只有官星休囚而有扶、子孙发动而被制住时，才不过降级。
rule.en: How one fares in office: with the star of office thriving and Wealth flourishing, the official career is brilliant. If the star of office is thriving and gets generation and support, or moves and turns auspicious, with the Self and Wealth thriving or Wealth moving to generate the Self, soldiers and people praise his virtue and the sea of officialdom is calm; if the star of office sits on the Day or Month and generates or combines with the Self, or a three-harmony Pressure frame generates or combines with the Self, or the star of office holds the Self and the Day and Month generate and support it with Tai Sui or the fifth line generating and combining, then one near the ruler receives uncommon favour, one in high office is soon promoted beyond rank, and one serving outside is rated outstanding. The reverse: if Peer holds the Self or moves, there is either a loss of goods or a fine of salary; if Output holds the Self or is among the moving lines, there is cause to fear being stripped of office and rank, and only when the star of office is resting or trapped but supported and Output moves but is restrained does it come to no more than a demotion.

zh: 官旺遇生扶，或动而化吉，世旺财旺，或财动生世，皆主兵民颂德，宦海无波。
官临日月，生合世爻，三合官局生合世爻，或官星持世，日月生扶，岁五又相生合，近君者，必蒙异宠。
兄弟持世，兄爻发动，若非破耗财物，定然罚俸除粮；
子孙持世，及子动爻中，有剥官削职之忧。
倘得官星休囚而有扶，子孙发动而有制，降级而已。
yi: 官星旺相、妻财兴旺，仕途显赫；
子孙摇动、兄弟发动，减俸、罢官。
官星旺相又遇生扶，或者发动变吉，世爻旺相、财旺相，或者财发动生世，都主兵士百姓称颂他的德政，宦途风平浪静。
官星临在日月上，生合世爻，或者三合官局生合世爻，或者官星持世、有日月生扶，太岁、五爻又来相生相合，在君主身边的人，必定蒙受特别的恩宠。
居高位的，不久就越级升迁；
在外任职的，必定被评为卓异（政绩特别突出）。
兄弟持世，兄爻发动，如果不是破财耗财，必定是罚俸、扣除俸粮；
子孙持世，以及子孙在动爻之中，有被剥夺官职的忧虑。
倘若官星休囚但有生扶，子孙发动但有制伏，不过是降级罢了。
en: With the star of office thriving and Wealth flourishing, the official career is brilliant;
with Output swaying and Peer moving, there is a cut in salary or removal from office.

If the star of office is thriving and gets generation and support, or moves and turns auspicious, or the Self and Wealth are both thriving, or Wealth moves to generate the Self, then soldiers and people praise his virtue and the sea of officialdom is calm.

If the star of office sits on the Day or Month and generates or combines with the Self, or a three-harmony Pressure frame generates or combines with the Self, or the star of office holds the Self with the Day and Month generating and supporting it and Tai Sui or the fifth line also generating and combining, then one who is near the ruler will surely receive uncommon favour.
one in high office will soon be promoted beyond his rank;
one serving outside will surely be rated outstanding.
If Peer holds the Self and a Peer line moves, then unless it is a loss and waste of goods, there will surely be a fine of salary and a cut of grain pay;
if Output holds the Self, or is among the moving lines, there is cause to fear being stripped of office and rank.
If the star of office is resting or trapped but is supported, and Output moves but is restrained, it comes to no more than a demotion.

title: 在任吉凶·官旺兄兴，清风两袖；父发鬼旺，雨露三加（兄动虽耗财减俸，官星旺相则是为官清正、非义不取，非无财；旺父临世官动临岁五或日月生扶，外任蒙上官推荐，近君大位三赐荣加）

rule.yi: 官星旺相而兄爻发动，不一定是坏事：兄爻发动虽然是耗财、减俸的神，但不必拘泥；官星旺相的话，那是做官清正、不义之财不取，并不是没有财；官星旺相而财落空破，也这样断。旺相的父母爻临世，官星发动临在太岁、五爻上，或有日月生扶，外任的必得上司推荐，在君主身边和居高位的，恩赐荣誉一再加身。
rule.en: A moving Peer line with a thriving star of office is not necessarily bad: a moving Peer line is indeed a spirit that wastes money and cuts salary, but one need not cling to that; when the star of office is thriving, it means an upright official who takes nothing unrighteous, not one who has no wealth; the same judgment holds when the star of office is thriving and Wealth is Void or broken. If a thriving Resource line holds the Self and the star of office moves on Tai Sui or the fifth line, or the Day and Month generate and support it, an official serving outside will surely be recommended by his superiors, and those near the ruler and in high office receive honours again and again.

zh: 兄动，虽为耗财减俸之神，然亦不必泥之。
若得官星旺相，乃是为官清正，非义不取也，非无财也。
官星旺相，财临空破者，亦同此断。
旺父临世，官动临岁五，或日月生扶，外任者，必蒙上官推荐；
近君及大位者，三赐荣加。
yi: 官星旺相、兄弟兴旺，为官清廉，两袖清风；
父母发动、官鬼旺相，恩泽像雨露一样一再加身。
兄爻发动，虽然是耗财、减俸的神，但也不必拘泥。
如果官星旺相，那是做官清正，不义之财不取，并不是没有财。
官星旺相，而财落空落破的，也照这样断。
旺相的父母爻临世，官星发动临在太岁、五爻上，或者有日月生扶，外任的人，必定得到上司的推荐；
在君主身边的和居高位的，恩赐荣誉一再加身。
en: With the star of office thriving and Peer flourishing, one is an upright official with two sleeves of clean wind;
with Resource moving and Pressure thriving, favours like rain and dew are added three times over.
A moving Peer line is indeed a spirit that wastes money and cuts salary, yet one need not cling to that.
If the star of office is thriving, it means the official is upright and takes nothing unrighteous, not that he has no wealth.
If the star of office is thriving and Wealth falls in Void or break, the same judgment holds.

If a thriving Resource line holds the Self and the star of office moves on Tai Sui or the fifth line, or the Day and Month generate and support it, one serving outside will surely be recommended by his superiors;
for those near the ruler and those in high office, honours are bestowed again and again.

title: 在任吉凶·兄鬼安宁，地方少事（兄鬼乱动于卦中，旱涝兵荒，地方不宁之兆）

rule.yi: 兄弟、官鬼安静，管辖的地方上事情少；兄弟、官鬼在卦中乱动，是旱涝、兵荒，地方不安宁的征兆。
rule.en: When Peer and Pressure are still, the district under one's charge has few troubles; when Peer and Pressure move in disorder in the hexagram, it is a sign of drought, flood, war and famine, and of a district at unrest.

zh: 兄鬼若乱动于卦中，旱涝兵荒，地方不宁之兆。
yi: 兄、鬼安静，地方上事情少。
兄、鬼如果在卦中乱动，是旱灾、水灾、兵祸、饥荒，地方不安宁的征兆。
en: When Peer and Pressure are still, the district has few troubles.
If Peer and Pressure move in disorder in the hexagram, it is a sign of drought, flood, war and famine, and of a district at unrest.

title: 在任吉凶·日月冲克，诽谤多招（日月克官或克世、朱雀螣蛇克世而世休囚，得祸不浅；世旺有敕多是非须检点；官鬼克世世旺官衰亦主诽谤；世衰鬼旺临蛇雀必挂弹章）

rule.yi: 日月来冲克，在任上多招诽谤：日月克官星或克世爻，或者朱雀、螣蛇克世而世爻休囚，招来的祸不小；世爻旺相、有敕命的，也多招是非，要检点、勤勉谨慎处理政事，以免过失；官鬼克世爻，但世旺官衰的，也主有诽谤；世爻衰弱、官鬼旺相，如果又临螣蛇、朱雀，必定被弹劾。
rule.en: When the Day and Month clash with or control, slander is much invited in office: if the Day and Month control the star of office or the Self, or the Vermilion Bird or the Coiling Snake controls the Self while the Self is resting or trapped, the misfortune is not slight; if the Self is thriving and one holds an imperial edict there is still much gossip and trouble, so one should be careful and diligent and prudent in affairs of government to avoid fault; if Pressure controls the Self though the Self is thriving and Pressure is weak, there is slander too; if the Self is weak and Pressure thriving and it also sits on the Coiling Snake or the Vermilion Bird, one will surely be named in an impeachment.

zh: 日月克官，或克世爻，及朱雀、螣蛇克世、世爻休囚者，得祸不浅；
世爻旺相有敕者，多招是非，须宜检点，政事勤慎，以免愆尤；
官鬼克世、世旺官衰者，亦主诽谤；
世衰鬼旺，若临蛇雀，必挂弹章。
yi: 日月冲克，多招来诽谤。
日月克官星，或者克世爻，以及朱雀、螣蛇克世、世爻休囚的，招来的祸不小；
世爻旺相、有敕命（得朝廷任命）的，也多招是非，应当检点，处理政事勤勉谨慎，以免过失和罪责；
官鬼克世爻，但世爻旺相、官鬼衰弱的，也主有诽谤；
世爻衰弱、官鬼旺相，如果又临螣蛇、朱雀，必定被挂上弹劾的奏章。
en: If the Day and Month clash with or control, slander is much invited.
If the Day and Month control the star of office or control the Self, or the Vermilion Bird or the Coiling Snake controls the Self and the Self is resting or trapped, the misfortune is not slight;
if the Self is thriving and one holds an imperial edict, there is still much gossip and trouble, so one should be careful, diligent and prudent in affairs of government to avoid faults and blame;
if Pressure controls the Self, though the Self is thriving and Pressure is weak, there is slander too;
if the Self is weak and Pressure thriving, and it also sits on the Coiling Snake or the Vermilion Bird, one will surely be named in an impeachment memorial.

title: 在任吉凶·化进神，冲变合，加官晋爵（世旺官化进神、官旺世化进神、世官得地财化进神，皆进爵之征）

rule.yi: 在任时，变出进神，或冲变成合，都是加官晋爵的征兆：世爻旺相、官星变进神；官星旺相、世爻变进神；世爻与官星都得地、财爻变进神。
rule.en: In office, turning into an Advancing line, or a clash turning into a combination, are signs of added office and higher rank: the Self thriving and the star of office turning into an Advancing line; the star of office thriving and the Self turning into an Advancing line; or the Self and the star of office both well placed and Wealth turning into an Advancing line.

zh: 化进神，冲变合，加官晋爵。
及世官得地，财化进神者，皆进爵之征也。
yi: 变出进神，冲变成合，加官晋爵。
世爻旺相，官星变进神；
官星旺相，世爻变进神；
以及世爻、官星都得地，财爻变进神的，都是晋升爵位的征兆。
en: Turning into an Advancing line, or a clash turning into a combination, brings added office and a higher rank.
The Self thriving and the star of office turning into an Advancing line;
the star of office thriving and the Self turning into an Advancing line;
or the Self and the star of office both well placed with Wealth turning into an Advancing line: all are signs of a higher rank.

title: 在任吉凶·爻反吟，入三墓，反复昏庸（卦得反吟，世官旺相必升，世官衰必降罚，世官被冲克有不测之祸；世休囚被克化墓入墓立见灾非，世有气化墓入墓不过昏聩）

rule.yi: 爻遇反吟或入三墓，主反复不定、昏庸糊涂。卦得反吟：世爻、官爻旺相，一定升迁；世爻、官星衰弱，必遭降职处罚，降后还要焦虑；世爻或官星被冲被克，有想不到的灾祸。世爻休囚被克、变墓或入墓，立刻见到灾祸是非；世爻有气而变墓、入墓，不过是糊里糊涂、昏聩罢了。
rule.en: Lines in Reversed Chant, or entering the three tombs, mean going back and forth, muddle and dullness. If the hexagram gets Reversed Chant: with the Self and the Pressure line thriving one is surely promoted; with the Self and the star of office weak one is demoted and punished and anxious after the demotion; if the Self or the star of office is clashed or controlled, there is unforeseen calamity. If the Self is resting or trapped and controlled, turns into the tomb or enters the tomb, disaster and trouble appear at once; if the Self has strength and turns into the tomb or enters the tomb, it is no more than being hazy and befuddled.

zh: 爻反吟，入三墓，反复昏庸。
卦得反吟，虽是身动不宁，若得世与官爻旺相，一定升迁；
若世与官星衰者，必遭降罚，降后还虑焦灼；
惟畏世官被冲被克者，定有不测之祸。
世爻休囚被克、化墓、入墓者，立见灾非；
世爻有气、化墓、入墓者，朦胧昏聩而已。
yi: 爻遇反吟，入了三墓，反复不定，昏庸糊涂。
卦得反吟，虽然是人要变动、不安宁，但如果世爻与官爻旺相，一定升迁；
如果世爻与官星衰弱，必定遭到降职处罚，降职之后还要担心焦虑；
只怕世爻、官星被冲被克，必定有想不到的灾祸。
世爻休囚被克、变入墓、入墓的，立刻看到灾祸是非；
世爻有气、变入墓、入墓的，不过是糊里糊涂、昏聩罢了。
en: Lines in Reversed Chant, or entering the three tombs, mean going back and forth, muddle and dullness.
If the hexagram gets Reversed Chant, though the person is unsettled and on the move, if the Self and the Pressure line are thriving he will surely be promoted;
if the Self and the star of office are weak he will surely be demoted and punished, and after the demotion there is still anxiety;
what is feared above all is the Self and the star of office being clashed or controlled, for there will surely be unforeseen calamity.
if the Self is resting or trapped and controlled, turns into the tomb or enters the tomb, disaster and trouble appear at once;
if the Self has strength and turns into the tomb or enters the tomb, it is no more than being hazy and befuddled.

title: 在任吉凶·世破鬼空，居官不久；身衰化鬼，命尽当危（世破世空官破官空在任不能多日；世衰动而化鬼或化回头克，须防寿命不牢）

rule.yi: 世爻被破、官鬼落空，当官不会长久；世爻或官星被破、落空，在任上待不了几天；世爻衰弱发动变出官鬼，以及变出回头克的，要防备寿命不牢靠。
rule.en: If the Self is broken and Pressure is Void, one will not hold office long; if the Self or the star of office is broken or Void, one cannot stay long in the post; if a weak Self moves and turns into Pressure, or into a returning control, guard against a life that is not firm.

zh: 世破世空、官破官空，在任不能多日，世衰动而化鬼，及化回头克者，须防寿命不坚牢。
yi: 世爻被破、官鬼落空，当官不会长久；
身体衰弱又变出官鬼，寿命将尽，当心危险。
世爻被破、世爻落空、官星被破、官星落空，在任上待不了几天，世爻衰弱发动变出官鬼，以及变出回头克的，要防备寿命不牢靠。
en: If the Self is broken and Pressure is Void, one will not hold office long;
if the Body is weak and turns into Pressure, life is running out and there is danger.

If the Self is broken or Void, or the star of office is broken or Void, one cannot stay long in the post; if a weak Self moves and turns into Pressure, or into a returning control, guard against a life that is not firm.

title: 在任吉凶·世化官而遇官，政权多摄（世旺化出官星生合比助得权摄之济，化出官星刑克世反受权摄之害，化出官星泄世气因权摄赔累，官星持世旺又动出官星拱扶亦主多摄）

rule.yi: 世爻变出官星又遇官星，多代理职务：世爻旺相，变出的官星生合、比助世爻，代理有益；变出的官星刑克世爻，代理反受其害；变出的官星泄世爻之气，代理要赔钱受累；官星持世旺相、爻中又发动出官星来拱扶、比合，也主多次代理政务。
rule.en: If the Self turns into the star of office and meets the star of office again, one often takes charge of the administration in an acting capacity: if the Self is thriving and the star of office it turns into generates, combines with or helps the Self, acting in a post benefits one; if the star of office it turns into punishes or controls the Self, acting in a post brings harm instead; if it drains the Self's strength, one loses money and is burdened by acting; if the star of office holds the Self and is thriving and another star of office moves in the lines to hold up, help or combine with it, one also often takes charge in an acting capacity.

note.yi: 「权摄」按这一章的用法，是暂时代理别人的职务；书里没有另外解释。
note.en: 'Quanshe' in this chapter's usage means temporarily taking over another man's post; the book does not explain it separately.

zh: 世化官而遇官，政权多摄。
世爻旺相，化出官星生合、比助世爻者，得权摄之济；
世爻旺相，化出官星刑世、克世者，反受权摄之害；
化出官星泄世爻之气者，因权摄以赔累；
官星持世而旺，爻中又动出官星拱扶、比合者，亦主政权多摄。
yi: 世爻变出官星又遇到官星，多次代理政务。
世爻旺相，变出的官星生合、比助世爻的，能得到代理职务的好处；
世爻旺相，变出的官星刑世、克世的，反而受到代理职务之害；
变出的官星泄世爻之气的，因为代理职务而赔钱受累；
官星持世而且旺相，爻中又发动出官星来拱扶、比合的，也主多次代理政务。
en: If the Self turns into the star of office and meets the star of office again, one often takes charge of the administration in an acting capacity.
If the Self is thriving and the star of office it turns into generates, combines with or helps the Self, one benefits from acting in a post;
if the Self is thriving but the star of office it turns into punishes or controls the Self, one instead suffers harm from acting in a post;
if the star of office it turns into drains the Self's strength, one loses money and is burdened because of acting in a post;
if the star of office holds the Self and is thriving, and another star of office moves in the lines to hold up, help or combine with it, one also often takes charge in an acting capacity.

title: 在任吉凶·世临官而遇马，差遣烦劳（官星持世，明动暗动加临驿马必有差遣；日月动爻作财生扶，差中得利；兄爻发动日月动爻刑克世，辛苦赔财；盼差遣者世动即有差）

rule.yi: 世爻临官星又遇驿马，会有差遣，烦劳辛苦：官星持世，明动、暗动又加临驿马的，必定有差遣；日月、动爻作财来生扶的，在差遣中能得到利益；卦中兄爻发动，日月、动爻刑克世爻的，辛苦还要赔钱；心里盼着得到差遣的人，不用等驿马加临，只要世爻发动就有差遣了。
rule.en: If the Self sits on the star of office and meets the Post Horse, there will be commissions and toil: if the star of office holds the Self and moves openly or in secret upon the Post Horse, there will surely be a commission; if the Day, Month or a moving line acts as Wealth and generates or supports it, one profits from the commission; if a Peer line moves in the hexagram and the Day, Month or a moving line punishes or controls the Self, one toils and loses money as well; for one who hopes in his heart for a commission, there is no need to wait for the Post Horse, for as soon as the Self moves there is a commission.

zh: 世临官而遇马，差遣烦劳。
官星持世，明动暗动加临驿马者，必有差遣；
日月动爻作财而生扶者，差中得利；
卦中兄爻发动，日月动爻刑克世爻者，辛苦赔财。
心有望于差遣者，不待驿马加临，但遇世动即有差矣。
yi: 世爻临官星又遇驿马，会有差遣，烦劳辛苦。
官星持世，明动、暗动又加临驿马的，必定有差遣；
日月、动爻作财爻来生扶的，在差遣中能得到利益；
卦中兄爻发动，日月、动爻刑克世爻的，辛苦还要赔钱。
心里盼望得到差遣的人，不用等驿马加临，只要遇到世爻发动就有差遣了。
en: If the Self sits on the star of office and meets the Post Horse, there will be commissions and toil.
If the star of office holds the Self and moves openly or in secret upon the Post Horse, there will surely be a commission;
if the Day, Month or a moving line acts as Wealth and generates or supports it, one profits from the commission;
if a Peer line moves in the hexagram and the Day, Month or a moving line punishes or controls the Self, one toils and loses money as well.
For one who hopes in his heart for a commission, there is no need to wait for the Post Horse to come: as soon as the Self moves, there is a commission.

title: 在任吉凶·官合龙兴，恩命至（青龙官星持世，或世临日月，或日月动爻生合世，或世临岁五或岁五生合世，或世官三合，皆吉；大位皇恩特用，平位加级超升）

rule.yi: 官星相合、青龙兴旺，恩命就到了：青龙官星持世，或世爻临日月，或日月、动爻生合世爻，或世爻临太岁、五爻，或太岁、五爻生合世爻，或世爻与官星三合，都是吉兆；居高位的蒙皇上特别重用，职位一般的加级越级升迁。
rule.en: When the star of office combines and the Dragon flourishes, a gracious order arrives: the star of office on the Azure Dragon holding the Self, or the Self on the Day or Month, or the Day, Month or a moving line generating or combining with the Self, or the Self on Tai Sui or the fifth line, or Tai Sui or the fifth line generating or combining with the Self, or the Self and the star of office in three-harmony, are all auspicious signs; for one in high office the emperor's favour brings a special employment, and for one in an ordinary post a rise in grade and promotion beyond rank.

zh: 青龙官星持世，或世临日月，或日月动爻生合世爻，或世临岁五之爻，或岁五生合世爻，或世官三合，皆为吉兆。
yi: 官星相合、青龙兴旺，恩命就到了。
青龙官星持世，或者世爻临在日月上，或者日月、动爻生合世爻，或者世爻临在太岁、五爻上，或者太岁、五爻生合世爻，或者世爻与官星三合，都是吉兆。
居高位的，蒙皇上特别重用；
职位一般的，加级越级升迁。
en: When the star of office combines and the Dragon flourishes, a gracious order arrives.

If the star of office on the Azure Dragon holds the Self, or the Self sits on the Day or Month, or the Day, Month or a moving line generates or combines with the Self, or the Self sits on Tai Sui or the fifth line, or Tai Sui or the fifth line generates or combines with the Self, or the Self and the star of office form a three-harmony, all are auspicious signs.
for one in high office, the emperor's favour brings a special employment;
for one in an ordinary post, a rise in grade and promotion beyond rank.

title: 在任吉凶·财临虎动，讣音来（财爻持世或卦中财动，或父母爻休囚空破，家有尊亲勿以财断，须防孝服；书中例两个：颐之噬嗑，八月丁艰；中孚之损，六月火灾、闻讣）

rule.yi: 财爻持世，或者卦中财爻发动，或者父母爻休囚、落空、被破的，如果家里有尊长亲人，不要只当财来断，要防备孝服（父母之丧）。
rule.en: If the Wealth line holds the Self or moves in the hexagram, or the Resource line is resting or trapped, Void or broken, then if one has elders and parents, do not judge it as wealth alone, but guard against mourning dress (the death of a parent).

note.yi: 「丁艰」是遭父母之丧；「回禄」是火神，指火灾。「科月」书里没有解释，译文按字面读作考试的月份。
note.en: 'Dingjian' is the mourning for a parent's death, and 'Huilu' is the fire god, here meaning a fire. The book does not explain 'the month of the examinations', and the translation reads it literally.

zh: 财爻持世及卦中财动，或父母爻休囚空破者，若有尊亲，切勿以财断之，须防孝服。
yi: 财爻临白虎而发动，会有讣告传来。
财爻持世以及卦中财动，或者父母爻休囚、落空、被破的，如果有尊长亲人，千万不要用财来断，要防备孝服。
en: When Wealth sits on the White Tiger and moves, news of a death arrives.

If the Wealth line holds the Self or moves in the hexagram, or the Resource line is resting or trapped, Void or broken, then if one has elders and parents, do not judge it as wealth, but guard against mourning dress.

zh: 如：寅月壬午日(旬空：申酉)，占在任平安否？
yi: 例如：寅月壬午日（旬空：申、酉），占在任上平安不平安？
得到颐卦变噬嗑卦。
en: For example: in the Yin month on a Renwu day (void: Shen and You), a divination on whether his term in office would be safe;
the hexagram was Yi changing into Shihe.

zh: 有人出此卦而问余曰：“今岁占在任之流年，世爻变鬼，我甚忧之。”
余曰：世爻戌土，虽则休囚，得午火生之，自身无碍，须防孝服。
彼曰：财非临虎，如何主孝服？
余曰：不然，午日冲动子水父母，被戌土财爻之克，世化官空，八九月必见。
yi: 有人拿出这个卦来问我：「今年占在任上的流年，世爻变出官鬼，我很担忧。」
我说：世爻是戌土，虽然休囚，但有午火生它，你自己没有妨碍，要防备孝服。
他说：财爻没有临白虎，怎么会主孝服？
我说：不是这样，午日冲动了子水父母爻，又被戌土财爻所克，世爻变出的官星落空，八、九月必定应验。
结果到八月遭了父母之丧（丁艰）。
en: Someone showed me this hexagram and asked: 'I divined for the fortunes of this year in office, and the Self has turned into Pressure; it worries me greatly.'
I said: the Self is Xu Earth, which though resting or trapped is generated by Wu Fire, so you yourself are not harmed, but guard against mourning dress.
He said: Wealth does not sit on the White Tiger, so how can it mean mourning dress?

I said: not so; the Wu day clashes into motion the Zi Water Resource line, which is then controlled by the Xu Earth Wealth line, and the star of office the Self turns into is Void, so it will surely appear in the eighth or ninth month.
And in the eighth month he did suffer the death of a parent.

zh: 又如：辰月己丑日(旬空：午未)，占在任吉凶，得“中孚之损”
yi: 又例：辰月己丑日（旬空：午、未），占在任上的吉凶，得到中孚卦变损卦。
en: Another: in the Chen month on a Jichou day (void: Wu and Wei), a divination on his fortunes in office gave Zhongfu changing into Sun.

zh: 官鬼克世，幸而不动，在任可保无凶。
但不宜兄爻持世，丑日冲动，今冬身必动摇，身动则耗费不小。
余曰：火被水伤，冬令须防孝服，恐因此而动也。
不意六月公署遭回禄，科月闻讣音。
回禄者，兄爻持世暗动破财；
伤父者，巳火父化子水克也。
yi: 官鬼克世爻，幸好不发动，在任上可以保证没有凶险。
但是兄爻持世不好，丑日冲动了它，今年冬天自身必定动摇，身动的话耗费不小。
他问：因为什么事而动？
我说：火被水伤，冬天要防备孝服，恐怕是因为这个而动。
没想到六月官署遭了火灾，考试的月份听到了讣告。
火灾，是因为兄爻持世暗动破财；
伤到父亲，是因为巳火父母爻变出子水来克。
en: Pressure controls the Self but fortunately does not move, so one is safe from ill in the post.
But a Peer line holding the Self is unfavourable, and the Chou day clashes it into motion, so this winter one is sure to be unsettled, and being unsettled costs a good deal.
He asked: what will cause the move?
I said: Fire is injured by Water, so in winter guard against mourning dress; it is probably for this that you will be unsettled.
Unexpectedly in the sixth month the government office suffered a fire, and in the month of the examinations news of a death came.
The fire was because the Peer line held the Self and moved in secret, wasting money;
the harm to the father was because Si Fire the Resource line turned into Zi Water, which controls it.

title: 援例·财旺官空，且自堆金于白屋（财旺世旺而官临月破旬空，或被日月冲克、动而变凶，官如朽木枯枝，有旺财也生不起，终是白屋富翁，难食王家天禄）

rule.yi: 用钱买官（援例）：妻财旺相、世爻旺相，但官星落在月破、旬空上，或被日月冲克，以及发动变凶，官星像朽木枯枝，有再旺相的财也生不起它，到头来只是个有钱的平民，吃不上国家的俸禄。
rule.en: Buying office by precedent: if Wealth and the Self are thriving but the star of office falls in Month-break or Void, or is clashed or controlled by the Day or Month, or moves and turns bad, the star of office is like a rotten log and a dry branch: though Wealth is thriving it cannot raise it, and in the end one is only a rich man in a commoner's house who cannot eat the heavenly salary of the royal house.

note.yi: 「援例」是按成例出钱捐官（捐纳）；书里没有另外解释，这里是按标题「凡用财图名者同此」和内容读的。
note.en: 'Yuanli' is buying office or rank with money under established precedent; the book does not explain it separately, and this is how it reads from the heading 'the same for all who use money to seek a name' and from the content.

zh: 财旺官空，且自堆金于白屋。
财旺世旺，而官临月破旬空，或被日月冲克，及动而变凶，官如朽木枯枝，虽有旺相之财，生之不起，终属白屋之富翁，难食王家之天禄。
yi: 财旺相而官星落空，只能自己在平民的白屋里堆金子。
财旺相、世爻旺相，但官星临在月破、旬空上，或者被日月冲克，以及发动变凶，官星就像朽木枯枝，虽然有旺相的妻财，也生不起来，终究只是平民之家的富翁，难以享用王家的俸禄。
en: With Wealth thriving but the star of office Void, one can only pile up gold in a white-roofed house (a commoner's home).

If Wealth and the Self are thriving but the star of office falls in Month-break or Void, or is clashed or controlled by the Day or Month, or moves and turns bad, the star of office is like a rotten log and a dry branch: though there is thriving Wealth it cannot raise it, and in the end one is only a rich man in a commoner's house, who cannot eat the heavenly salary of the royal house.

title: 援例·妻摇鬼旺，定然执王拜丹墀（世、官星、财星三者不可一陷：财官旺而世陷，得官无福安享；官世旺而财陷，有例无财；书中例：豫之否，财动生官世临月破，名成而身丧；困之兑，世休囚动变鬼，次年得噎疾而终）

rule.yi: 援例捐官，世爻、官星、财星这三样不能有一样失陷：妻财、官星都旺而世爻失陷，终究得了官也没有福气安享；官星、世爻都旺而财星失陷，是有例可援却没有钱。
rule.en: In buying office by precedent, of the Self, the star of office and the star of Wealth, not one may be lost: if Wealth and the star of office are both thriving but the Self is lost, one may in the end get office but has no fortune to enjoy it in peace; if the star of office and the Self are both thriving but the star of Wealth is lost, there is a precedent to appeal to but no money.

note.yi: 「执王拜丹墀」原文如此，意思是上殿朝拜、得官；「王」字可能是「玉」（手执玉圭）的误字，译文只按意思译。「捐复」是出钱捐纳恢复官职。
note.en: 'Holding the king and bowing at the vermilion steps' is how the text reads and means bowing at court and gaining office; the character 'king' may be a slip for 'jade' (holding the jade tablet), and the translation follows the sense only. 'Juanfu' is buying reinstatement in office with money.

zh: 妻摇鬼旺，定然执王拜丹墀。
世与官星、财星，三者不可一陷，若财官两旺，而世爻失陷者，终使得官，无福安享；
若官世两旺，财星失陷者，乃有例无财。
yi: 妻财摇动、官鬼旺相，必定能上殿朝拜、得官。
世爻、官星、财星这三样不能有一样失陷；如果财、官都旺，而世爻失陷，终究得了官，也没有福气安享；
如果官星、世爻都旺，而财星失陷，就是有例可援而没有钱。
en: When Wealth sways and Pressure thrives, one will surely bow at the vermilion steps of the court.

Of the Self, the star of office and the star of Wealth, not one may be lost: if Wealth and the star of office are both thriving but the Self is lost, one may in the end get office but has no fortune to enjoy it in peace;
if the star of office and the Self are both thriving but the star of Wealth is lost, there is a precedent to appeal to but no money.

zh: 如：丑月乙卯日(旬空：子丑)，占援例，得“豫之否”
yi: 例如：丑月乙卯日（旬空：子、丑），占援例，得到豫卦变否卦。
en: For example: in the Chou month on a Yimao day (void: Zi and Chou), a divination on buying office by precedent gave Yu changing into Pi.

zh: 财动生官，不宜世临月破，破而被克，有官不能享也。
后竟纳之，名成而身丧矣。
yi: 财爻发动生官星，不宜世爻临月破，被破又被克，有了官也不能享用。
后来他竟然还是捐纳了，功名成了，人却死了。
en: Wealth moves to generate the star of office, but it is not good for the Self to sit in Month-break; broken and also controlled, one has the office but cannot enjoy it.
Afterwards he went ahead and made the payment; the rank was gained but he himself died.

zh: 又如：戌月癸丑日(旬空：寅卯)，占捐复，得“困之兑”
yi: 又例：戌月癸丑日（旬空：寅、卯），占捐复，得到困卦变兑卦。
en: Another: in the Xu month on a Guichou day (void: Yin and Mao), a divination on buying reinstatement gave Kun changing into Dui.

zh: 世爻休囚，动而变鬼，不可行也。
余曰：明年秋令甚低，名成亦不能出仕。
果捐复，至次年正月得噎疾，七月而终。
yi: 世爻休囚，发动变出官鬼，不可以去办。
他不听。
我说：明年秋天时令很低，功名成了也不能出来做官。
他果然捐复，到第二年正月得了噎病，七月就去世了。
en: The Self is resting or trapped and moves into Pressure, so it should not be done.
He would not listen.
I said: next year's autumn is very low, so even if the rank is gained you will not be able to take up office.
He did buy the reinstatement; in the first month of the next year he fell ill with a choking disease and died in the seventh month.

title: 援例·财静子飞空用意（子孙持世，财爻动不动皆不可行；财临空破亦不可行；子财官同动又可行，因子动生财、财动生官）

rule.yi: 援例捐官，子孙持世，不管财爻动不动，都不可以去办；财爻落空落破，也不可以去办；但子孙、财、官一起发动又可以去办，因为子孙动生财、财动生官。
rule.en: In buying office by precedent, if Output holds the Self, whether or not the Wealth line moves it should not be done; if Wealth falls in Void or break, it should not be done either; but if Output, Wealth and the star of office all move together, it may be done, because Output moves to generate Wealth and Wealth moves to generate the star of office.

zh: 子孙持世，财爻动与不动，皆不可行；
子财官同动者，又可行之，其故以子动生财，财动以生官也。
yi: 财爻安静而子孙飞动，用意落空。
子孙持世，财爻动不动，都不可以去办；
财爻临空、临破，也不可以去办。
子孙、财、官一起发动的，又可以去办，原因是子孙动生财、财动生官。
en: If Wealth is still while Output flies, the intent is spent in vain.
If Output holds the Self, whether or not the Wealth line moves it should not be done;
if Wealth falls in Void or break, it should not be done either.
If Output, Wealth and the star of office all move together, it may be done, because Output moves to generate Wealth and Wealth moves to generate the star of office.

title: 援例·兄兴财动枉劳心（兄弟持世或兄发动，破耗之神，枉费其财名终不就，与官同动则可行；野鹤：官星不动而兄持世、兄父发动、财持世化兄，百无一成）

rule.yi: 援例捐官，兄弟爻持世，或者兄爻发动，是破耗的神，白花钱财，功名终究不成；如果和官星一起发动，又可以去办，因为官鬼能制住兄弟。野鹤说：卦中官星不动，只要遇到兄弟持世、兄爻和父母爻发动、以及财爻持世变出兄弟，百件里没有一件成，即使成了也必有别的缘故，到头来没有地方吃俸禄。
rule.en: In buying office by precedent, if the Peer line holds the Self or a Peer line moves, it is a spirit of waste and loss: the money is spent for nothing and the rank is never gained; if it moves together with the star of office it may be done, since Pressure restrains Peer. The Old Man of Yehe says: if the star of office does not move in the hexagram, and Peer holds the Self, or Peer and Resource lines move, or the Wealth line holds the Self and turns into Peer, not one in a hundred succeeds, and even if it succeeds there will surely be some other cause, and in the end one has no place to eat a salary.

zh: 兄弟爻持世，或兄爻发动，乃是破耗之神，枉费其财，名终不就。
若与官同动者，又可行之，以鬼而制兄也。
yi: 兄弟兴旺、财爻发动，白白劳心。
兄弟爻持世，或者兄爻发动，是破耗的神，白白花了钱财，功名终究不成。
如果和官星一起发动，又可以去办，因为官鬼可以制住兄弟。
en: With Peer flourishing and Wealth moving, one wears out one's heart for nothing.
If the Peer line holds the Self, or a Peer line moves, it is a spirit of waste and loss: the money is spent for nothing, and the rank is never gained.
If it moves together with the star of office, it may be done, since Pressure restrains Peer.

zh: 野鹤曰：卦中官星不动，但遇兄弟持世、兄父发动，及财爻持世化兄，百无一成，即使成后，必有他故，终食禄无地也。
yi: 野鹤说：卦中官星不动，只要遇到兄弟持世、兄爻和父母爻发动，以及财爻持世变出兄弟，百件里没有一件成；即使成了之后，也必有别的缘故，终究没有地方吃俸禄。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: if the star of office does not move in the hexagram, and Peer holds the Self, or Peer and Resource lines move, or the Wealth line holds the Self and turns into Peer, not one in a hundred succeeds, and even if it succeeds there will surely be some other cause, and one will in the end have no place to eat a salary.

title: 投麾效用·官宜旺相不宜空破休囚，世与财忌刑冲克坏（世、官、财哪个失陷或动变凶各有其害；官持世财相生、官世临日月、世动化吉，封拜可期；觉子：先识来人之意，未见用而问收用与否，则官星是收用之官）

rule.yi: 投军效用：官星要旺相，不能落空、被破、休囚；妻财和世爻两个爻，怕遇到刑、冲、克、坏。世爻与官星都要旺相又变出吉象，财是俸禄的供养，哪能让日月来刑冲？世爻失陷或发动变凶，自身尤其难保；官星失陷或发动变凶，难许成名；财爻失陷或发动变凶，缺粮没有俸禄，官星再旺也像厨房没有烟火。只喜欢官星持世、有财发动生它、财爻持世、官星发动与它相合，或官星与世爻临日月，以及太岁、月建、日辰相生，或世爻发动变吉，将来封官拜将可以期待。觉子说：要先识得来占的人的用意，为名利而问的这样断；如果问的是还没被任用时能不能被收用，官星就是收用他的那个官，官星来生合世爻的必收，官爻克世爻、或落空落破的不录用。
rule.en: On joining the colours: the star of office should be thriving and must not be Void, broken, or resting or trapped, and the Wealth line and the Self line fear punishment, clash, control and ruin. The Self and the star of office should both be thriving and turn into auspicious lines, and Wealth is the support of the salary, so how could the Day and Month punish or clash with it? If the Self is lost or moves and turns bad, one's own safety is all the harder to keep; if the star of office is lost or moves and turns bad, a name is hard to promise; if the Wealth line is lost or moves and turns bad, there is no grain and no salary, and even if the star of office is thriving no smoke rises from the kitchen stove. What is welcomed is the star of office holding the Self with moving Wealth generating it, the Wealth line holding the Self, the star of office moving to combine with it, the star of office and the Self sitting on the Day or Month, Tai Sui, the Month and the Day generating each other, or the Self moving and turning auspicious: then investiture and the rank of general may be hoped for. Juezi says: first understand the intent of the person who comes; for one asking for rank and profit this is how to judge; if he asks whether, not yet employed, he can be taken on, the star of office is the officer who takes him on: if it comes to generate or combine with the Self he will surely be taken on, and if the Pressure line controls the Self or is Void or broken he will not be enrolled.

note.yi: 这一段没有标说话人，放在「增删卜易正文」里；「投麾效用」是投到将帅麾下、效力从军。
note.en: This passage does not mark a speaker and is placed under the main text of the Zeng Shan Bu Yi; 'touhui xiaoyong' is going to serve under a commander's banner.

zh: 官宜旺相，不宜空破休囚，财世两爻，怕见刑冲克坏。
世与官星，皆宜旺而化吉，财为禄养，岂宜日月刑冲？
世爻失陷，及动而变凶，身尤难保。
官星失陷，及动而变凶，难许成名。
财爻失陷，及动而变凶，乏粮无禄，即使官旺，厨灶无烟。
惟喜官星持世，财动相生、财爻持世、官动相合，或官世临乎日月，及岁月日建相生，或世动化吉，将来封拜可期，岂惟百夫长而已耶。
yi: 官星要旺相，不能落空、被破、休囚；妻财和世爻两个爻，怕遇到刑、冲、克、坏。
世爻与官星，都应当旺相又变出吉象；财是俸禄的供养，哪能让日月来刑冲？
世爻失陷，以及发动变凶，自身尤其难保。
官星失陷，以及发动变凶，难以答应他成名。
财爻失陷，以及发动变凶，缺粮没有俸禄，即使官星旺相，厨房灶上也没有烟火。
只喜欢官星持世，有发动的财来生它、财爻持世、官星发动与它相合，或者官星和世爻临在日月上，以及太岁、月建、日辰相生，或者世爻发动变吉，将来封官拜将可以期待，哪里只是做个百夫长而已呢。
en: The star of office should be thriving and must not be Void, broken, or resting or trapped; the Wealth line and the Self line fear punishment, clash, control and ruin.
The Self and the star of office should both be thriving and turn into auspicious lines; Wealth is the support of the salary, so how could the Day and Month punish or clash with it?
If the Self is lost or moves and turns bad, one's own safety is all the harder to keep.
If the star of office is lost or moves and turns bad, it is hard to promise a name.
If the Wealth line is lost or moves and turns bad, there is no grain and no salary, and even if the star of office is thriving, no smoke rises from the kitchen stove.

What is welcomed is the star of office holding the Self with moving Wealth generating it, or the Wealth line holding the Self, or the star of office moving to combine with it, or the star of office and the Self sitting on the Day or Month, or Tai Sui, the Month and the Day generating each other, or the Self moving and turning auspicious: then investiture and the rank of general may be hoped for, and not only the leader of a hundred men.

zh: 觉子曰：以此断者，虽无不验，但要识来人之意。
彼若以名利而问，以此而决者是也。
如若未见用，占问可能收用否？
官爻克世，及空破者，不录。
如不知此诀，竟以此官星断为彼人自己之功名者，如天远也。
yi: 觉子说：用这个办法断，虽然没有不应验的，但要识得来占的人的用意。
他如果是为名利来问，用这个办法判断就对了。
如果还没有被任用，占问能不能被收用呢？
那就又要以官星为收用他的官；
官星来生合世爻的，一定收用；
官爻克世爻，以及落空落破的，不录用。
如果不知道这个诀窍，竟然把这个官星断成他本人自己的功名，就差得像天那么远了。
en: Juezi says: judged this way it never fails to come true, but one must understand the intent of the person who comes.
If he asks for rank and profit, to decide by this is right.
But if he has not yet been employed and asks whether he can be taken on?
then the star of office stands for the officer who takes him on;
if the star of office comes to generate or combine with the Self, he will surely be taken on;
if the Pressure line controls the Self, or is Void or broken, he will not be enrolled.
One who does not know this secret and judges this star of office as the man's own rank is as far from the truth as heaven is far.

title: 署印谋差·财与官星不可有一而不旺，子孙兄弟不可有一而动摇；世陷财空不如守己，官空世破且让他人；衰世随鬼入墓、世动化克化鬼、子孙兄弟持世，自投罗网

rule.yi: 谋署理印务、谋差事：财星和官星不能有一个不旺相，子孙和兄弟不能有一个发动摇动；世爻失陷、财落空，不如守住自己；官星落空、世爻被破，暂且让给别人；用钱去谋的，和援例一样推断。衰弱的世爻随官鬼入墓，世爻发动变克、变鬼，子孙或兄弟持世，这时去谋署印、营求差事，是自己投进罗网。
rule.en: On seeking to act in a seal-holding post or to scheme for a commission: of the star of Wealth and the star of office neither may fail to be thriving, and of Output and Peer neither may move or sway; if the Self is lost and Wealth is Void, it is better to keep to oneself; if the star of office is Void and the Self is broken, let others have it for now; for one who seeks it with money, judge as for buying office by precedent. If a weak Self follows Pressure into the tomb, or the Self moves and turns into a control or into Pressure, or Output or Peer holds the Self, then seeking to act in a seal-holding post or to scheme for a commission is walking into the net oneself.

note.yi: 「署印」是暂时代理掌印的官（署理）；「营差」是营求差遣。书里没有另外解释，这里按字面和上下文读。
note.en: 'Shuyin' is temporarily acting as the official who holds the seal, and 'yingchai' is scheming for a commission; the book does not explain them, and they are read here from the letter and the context.

zh: 财与官星，不可有一而不旺；
子孙兄弟，不可有一而动摇。
用财而图者，与援例同推。
yi: 财星和官星，不能有一个不旺相；
子孙和兄弟，不能有一个发动摇动。
世爻失陷、财落空，不如守住自己；
官星落空、世爻被破，暂且让给别人。
用钱去谋的，和援例一样推断。
en: Of the star of Wealth and the star of office, neither may fail to be thriving;
of Output and Peer, neither may move or sway.
If the Self is lost and Wealth is Void, it is better to keep to oneself;
if the star of office is Void and the Self is broken, let others have it for now.
For one who seeks it with money, judge as for buying office by precedent.

zh: 衰世随鬼入墓，世动化克化鬼，子孙兄弟持世，谋署营差，自投罗网。
yi: 衰弱的世爻随官鬼入墓，世爻发动变克、变鬼，子孙或兄弟持世，去谋署理印务、营求差事，是自己投进罗网。
en: If a weak Self follows Pressure into the tomb, or the Self moves and turns into a control or into Pressure, or Output or Peer holds the Self, then seeking to act in a seal-holding post or to scheme for a commission is walking into the net oneself.

chapter: 面圣、上书、叩阍、献策、条陈、劾奏章
title: 上书·旺父持世，宜日月岁五以维持（父母为文书奏章，持世合世奏必见准，再得岁五日月动爻生合，见用无疑）

rule.yi: 上书奏事，父母爻就是文书、奏章：旺相的父母爻持世、合世，奏章必定被批准；再得到太岁、五爻和日月、动爻来生合的，被采用无疑。
rule.en: In submitting a memorial the Resource line is the document and the memorial: if a thriving Resource line holds or combines with the Self, the memorial will surely be approved, and if Tai Sui, the fifth line, the Day, the Month or a moving line also generates or combines with it, it will be adopted without doubt.

zh: 旺父持世，宜日月岁五以维持。
父母为文书、奏章，持世、合世，奏必见准，再得岁五及日月动爻生合者，见用无疑。
yi: 旺相的父母爻持世，适合有日月、太岁、五爻来扶持。
父母爻是文书、奏章，持世、合世，奏章必定被批准；再得到太岁、五爻和日月、动爻来生合的，被采用无疑。
en: A thriving Resource line holding the Self does well with the Day, the Month, Tai Sui or the fifth line to sustain it.

The Resource line is documents and memorials: if it holds or combines with the Self, the memorial will surely be approved, and if Tai Sui, the fifth line, the Day, the Month or a moving line also generates or combines with it, it will be adopted without doubt.

chapter: 面圣、上书、叩阍、献策、条陈、劾奏章
title: 上书·兄弟临身，喜父母化吉而拱合（兄弟持世，日月生之，或世、父母动而化吉，或世化父以生世，皆得喜动龙颜、因文见用）

rule.yi: 兄弟临身时，喜欢父母爻变吉并来拱合：兄弟持世，有日月生它，或者世爻、父母爻发动变吉，或者世爻变出父母爻来生世，都能使皇上龙颜大悦，因为奏章被采用。
rule.en: If Peer sits on the Body, it is good that the Resource line turns auspicious and holds up and combines: if Peer holds the Self and the Day and Month generate it, or the Self or the Resource line moves and turns auspicious, or the Self turns into Resource to generate the Self, all of these please the dragon countenance, and one is employed because of the document.

zh: 兄弟临身，喜父母化吉而拱合。
兄弟持世，日月生之，或世爻、父母爻动而化吉，或世化父以生世，以上皆得喜动龙颜，因文见用。
yi: 兄弟临身，喜欢父母爻变吉并来拱合。
兄弟持世，有日月生它，或者世爻、父母爻发动变吉，或者世爻变出父母爻来生世，以上都能使皇上龙颜大悦，因为奏章被采用。
en: If Peer sits on the Body, it is good that Resource turns auspicious and holds up and combines.

If Peer holds the Self and the Day and Month generate it, or the Self or the Resource line moves and turns auspicious, or the Self turns into Resource to generate the Self, all of these please the dragon countenance, and one is employed because of the document.

chapter: 面圣、上书、叩阍、献策、条陈、劾奏章
title: 上书·财爻持世破文书（财爻持世或发动，克破文书，无益之奏；父母持世、财官同动则喜，因财动生官、官动生世）

rule.yi: 财爻持世或发动，会克破文书，是没有益处的奏章；但如果父母持世，财和官一起发动，又是好的，因为财动生官、官动生世。
rule.en: If the Wealth line holds the Self or moves, it controls and breaks the document, and the memorial is of no use; but if Resource holds the Self and Wealth and the star of office move together, that is good again, because Wealth moves to generate the star of office and the star of office moves to generate the Self.

zh: 财爻持世、财爻发动，克破文书，无益之奏。
倘得父母持世，财官同动者而又喜之，其故以财动而生官，官动而生世也。
yi: 财爻持世会破坏文书。
财爻持世、财爻发动，克破文书，是没有益处的奏章。
如果父母持世，财和官一起发动的，又是好的，原因是财动生官、官动生世。
en: A Wealth line holding the Self breaks the document.
If the Wealth line holds the Self or moves, it controls and breaks the document, and the memorial is of no use.
If Resource holds the Self and Wealth and the star of office move together, that is good again, because Wealth moves to generate the star of office and the star of office moves to generate the Self.

chapter: 面圣、上书、叩阍、献策、条陈、劾奏章
title: 上书·子福临身防降罚（子孙克官，有职之官陈奏忌见，持世或发动轻则降罚重则休官；无职之人看来人之念：为求名者见之不成名，恐其有祸者见之必无祸）

rule.yi: 上书陈奏时子孙持世或发动：子孙是克官星的神，有官职的人上奏陈事，不宜见到它，轻的降职受罚，重的罢官；没有官职的人要看来占者心里的念头：本来是为了求功名的，见子孙必定不成名；担心会有祸患的，见子孙必定没有祸。
rule.en: When Output holds the Self or moves in a memorial: Output is the spirit that controls the star of office, and for an official with a post who submits a memorial it is not good to see it: at the lightest there is demotion and punishment, at the worst dismissal; for a man without office one must look at the thought of the one who comes: if he does this in order to seek a name, seeing Output means he will surely not gain a name; if he fears that it may bring him misfortune, seeing Output means there will surely be none.

zh: 子孙为克官之神，有职之官而陈奏者，不宜见之，或持世，或发动，轻则降罚，重则休官。
无职之人而陈奏者，有两论，须察来人之念；
彼行此事，原为求名者，见之必不成名；
彼行此事，恐其有祸者，见之必无祸。
yi: 子孙和福神临身，要防备降职受罚。
子孙是克官星的神，有官职的人上奏陈事，不宜见到它，不论持世还是发动，轻的降职受罚，重的罢官。
没有官职的人上奏陈事，有两种论法，要看来占的人心里的念头；
他做这件事，本来是为了求功名的，见到它必定不成名；
他做这件事，担心会有祸患的，见到它必定没有祸。
en: With Output and the lucky spirit on the Body, guard against demotion and punishment.

Output is the spirit that controls the star of office; for an official with a post who submits a memorial, it is not good to see it, whether it holds the Self or moves: at the lightest there is demotion and punishment, at the worst dismissal from office.
For a man without office who submits a memorial there are two ways of judging, and one must look at the thought of the one who comes;
if he does this in order to seek a name, seeing it means he will surely not gain a name;
if he does this fearing that it may bring him misfortune, seeing it means there will surely be none.

chapter: 面圣、上书、叩阍、献策、条陈、劾奏章
title: 上书·世临空破，难以回天（世临旬空月破、临绝化绝、入三墓，不蒙见准宜早知机；世动变凶或岁五日月动爻冲克世，不惟难回天且防不测）

rule.yi: 上书时世爻临空、临破，难以挽回圣意：世爻临旬空、月破，以及临绝、变绝、入三墓的，得不到批准，应当早点察觉时机；世爻发动变凶，或者太岁、五爻、日月、动爻冲克世爻的，不但难以挽回，而且要防备想不到的祸患。
rule.en: In a memorial, if the Self falls on Void or break, it is hard to turn heaven round: if the Self falls on Void or Month-break, or on extinction or turns into extinction, or enters the three tombs, the request will not be approved, and one should read the moment early; if the Self moves and turns bad, or Tai Sui, the fifth line, the Day, the Month or a moving line clashes with or controls the Self, it is not only hard to turn heaven round but one must guard against unforeseen misfortune.

zh: 世临旬空、月破，及临绝、化绝，及入三墓者，不蒙见准，宜早知机。
世动变凶，或岁五日月动爻冲克世爻者，不惟难以回天，且防不测之祸。
yi: 世爻临空、临破，难以挽回圣意。
世爻临旬空、月破，以及临绝、变绝，以及入三墓的，得不到批准，应当早点察觉时机。
世爻发动变凶，或者太岁、五爻、日月、动爻冲克世爻的，不但难以挽回，而且要防备想不到的祸患。
en: If the Self falls on Void or break, it is hard to turn heaven round.
If the Self falls on Void or Month-break, or on extinction or turns into extinction, or enters the three tombs, the request will not be approved, and one should read the moment early.

If the Self moves and turns bad, or Tai Sui, the fifth line, the Day, the Month or a moving line clashes with or controls the Self, it is not only hard to turn heaven round but one must guard against unforeseen misfortune.

chapter: 面圣、上书、叩阍、献策、条陈、劾奏章
title: 上书·子动临身，力能折槛（野鹤：有职之官陈奏忌子动，但条陈将相、诤谏君非这类事则以子孙为福神，反喜子孙持世，面折庭诤可保无祸；古以子发乾宫为吉，非也；书中例：旅卦，劾奏权奸，果蒙准行）

rule.yi: 条陈将相、诤谏君过、弹劾奸臣这类事，和一般的奏事不一样：这里子孙要当福神用，所以反而喜欢子孙持世，即使当面诤谏也可以保证没有祸。但有官职的人如果只是为了保全功名，子孙发动时千万不要去做。古人以子孙在乾宫发动为吉，是不对的，子孙是制住官鬼的福神，没有听说只在乾宫才是福神。
rule.en: For proposals about the generals and chancellors, remonstrance against the ruler's faults and the impeachment of a treacherous minister, the rule differs from ordinary memorials: here Output is used as the lucky spirit, so Output holding the Self is welcome instead, and even if one contends to the ruler's face one can be sure of no misfortune. But an official who only wants to preserve his rank must not do it when Output moves. The ancients took Output moving in the Qian palace as auspicious, which is wrong: Output is the lucky spirit that restrains Pressure, and it has never been heard that it is so only in the Qian palace.

note.yi: 「折槛」是汉朝朱云当面直谏、攀折殿槛的典故，书里没有讲，译文是按通行的意思注的。前一条（ZS.31）说有官职的人上奏忌见子孙，这一条说子孙持世反吉，野鹤自己的解释是：要看事情的大小。
note.en: 'Breaking the railing' alludes to Zhu Yun of Han, who remonstrated to the emperor's face and clung to and broke the palace railing; the book does not tell it, and the translation gives the usual sense. The previous entry (ZS.31) says an official with a post should not see Output in a memorial and this one says Output holding the Self is good instead; the Old Man's own explanation is that it depends on the size of the matter.

yi: 子孙发动临身，有力量像朱云那样折断殿槛、直言进谏。
en: With Output moving on the Body, one has the strength to break the railing.

zh: 野鹤曰：或疑前说子动克官，不宜见之，此喜子孙持世者，何也？
殊不知须看事之大小耳。
有职之官，行此事者，预料此事，设不准行，定然革职。
子孙者，即为克官之神也。
欲保全功名，子孙发动，切勿行之。
倘若条陈将相，诤谏君非，若得准行，名垂青史；
此处则以子孙为福神矣，所以反喜子孙持世，即使面折庭诤，可保无祸。
古以子发乾宫为吉，非也。
夫子孙为制鬼之福神，未闻独在乾宫而为福神也。
yi: 野鹤说：有人怀疑，前面说子孙发动克官星，不宜见到它，这里却喜欢子孙持世，是为什么？
殊不知要看事情的大小。
有官职的人做这件事，事先就料到，如果不批准施行，必定革职。
子孙，就是克官星的神。
想要保全功名，子孙发动的时候，千万不要去做。
如果是向将相条陈、直言劝谏君主的过失，若得到批准施行，名垂青史；
如果不被批准，祸患落到自己身上。
这里就以子孙为福神了，所以反而喜欢子孙持世，即使当面折服、在朝廷上直言争谏，也可以保证没有祸。
古人以子孙在乾宫发动为吉，是不对的。
子孙是制住官鬼的福神，没有听说只在乾宫才是福神。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: someone may doubt it: earlier it was said that a moving Output controls the star of office and is not welcome, yet here Output holding the Self is welcome; why?
It is not understood that one must look at the size of the matter.
An official with a post who does this foresees that if it is not approved he will certainly be dismissed.
Output is the spirit that controls the star of office.
If one wants to preserve one's rank, when Output moves one must not do it.
But if one submits a proposal about the generals and chancellors, or remonstrates against the ruler's faults, then if it is approved and carried out, one's name goes down in history;
if it is not approved, misfortune falls on oneself.
Here Output is taken as the lucky spirit, so Output holding the Self is welcome instead, and even if one confronts the ruler to his face and contends in court, one can be sure of no misfortune.
The ancients took Output moving in the Qian palace as auspicious, which is wrong.
Output is the lucky spirit that restrains Pressure; it has never been heard that it is the lucky spirit only in the Qian palace.

zh: 如：巳年巳月丁卯日(旬空：戌亥)，占劾奏，得“旅卦”
yi: 例如：巳年巳月丁卯日（旬空：戌、亥），占弹劾上奏，得到旅卦。
en: For example: in a Si year, Si month, on a Dingmao day (void: Xu and Hai), a divination on impeaching a minister gave Lü.

zh: 占者问曰：我欲劾奏权奸，恐其根固，反受其害，尔详此卦何如？
余曰：彼虽根深蒂固，今已坏矣。
余曰：应爻酉金，长生于巳年巳月，岂非根固耶？
今被岁月克之、卯日冲之，有伤无救，所以知其权势自此衰矣。
余曰：子孙持世，何害之有？
yi: 来占的人问：我想弹劾权奸，担心他根基牢固，反而被他所害，请你详细看看这个卦怎么样？
我说：他虽然根深蒂固，现在已经坏了。
问：凭什么知道？
我说：应爻是酉金，在巳年巳月长生，难道不是根基牢固吗？
现在被太岁、月建克它，又被卯日冲它，只有伤害没有救助，所以知道他的权势从此衰落了。
又问：我有没有害处？
我说：子孙持世，有什么害处？
结果果然被批准施行，奸臣的势力大败。
en: The man who came to divine asked: I wish to impeach a powerful and treacherous minister, but fear his roots are firm and I shall be harmed instead; please examine this hexagram carefully, how is it?
I said: though his roots are deep and firm, they are now spoiled.
He asked: how do you know?
I said: the Other line is You Metal, which is born in a Si year and Si month; is that not firm roots?
But now the year and the month control it and the Mao day clashes it, with injury and no rescue, so I know his power will decline from now on.
He asked again: will I be harmed?
I said: Output holds the Self, so what harm could there be?
And indeed it was approved and carried out, and the treacherous faction was utterly defeated.

chapter: 面圣、上书、叩阍、献策、条陈、劾奏章
title: 上书·最忌官爻克世，犹嫌助鬼伤身（官鬼克世已兆凶，再加财动助鬼祸难免；世变鬼、回头克、随鬼入墓、反吟、卦变绝、世被冲克者，事非重大急宜止之）

rule.yi: 上书最忌官爻克世爻，也嫌弃帮助官鬼伤害自身：官鬼克世已经预兆凶象，再加上财发动来帮助官鬼的，灾祸难免；世爻变出官鬼、变出回头克、随官鬼入墓、卦得反吟、卦变成绝、世爻被冲克的，事情如果不是重大的，要赶紧停止。
rule.en: In a memorial what is most to be avoided is the Pressure line controlling the Self, and also disliked is helping Pressure to injure the Body: when Pressure controls the Self it already foretells ill, and if Wealth also moves to help Pressure the misfortune cannot be avoided; if the Self turns into Pressure, or into a returning control, or follows Pressure into the tomb, or the hexagram gets Reversed Chant or changes into extinction, or the Self is clashed or controlled, unless the matter is grave it should be stopped at once.

zh: 最忌官爻克世，犹嫌助鬼伤身。
官鬼克世，已兆凶征，再加财动而助鬼者，其祸难免。
世爻变鬼，动化回头之克，随鬼入墓，卦得反吟，卦变绝，世被冲克者，事非重大，急宜止之。
yi: 最忌讳官爻克世爻，也嫌弃帮助官鬼伤害自身。
官鬼克世，已经预兆凶象，再加上财发动来帮助官鬼的，灾祸难以避免。
世爻变出官鬼，发动变出回头克，随官鬼入墓，卦得反吟，卦变成绝，世爻被冲克的，事情如果不是重大的，要赶紧停止。
en: Most to be avoided is the Pressure line controlling the Self, and also disliked is helping Pressure to injure the Body.
When Pressure controls the Self it already foretells ill, and if Wealth also moves to help Pressure, the misfortune cannot be avoided.

If the Self turns into Pressure, or moves into a returning control, follows Pressure into the tomb, the hexagram gets Reversed Chant or changes into extinction, or the Self is clashed or controlled, unless the matter is grave it should be stopped at once.

chapter: 面圣、上书、叩阍、献策、条陈、劾奏章
title: 上书·岁五生身防受制，六爻恍惚且休行（太岁生世必须在卦爻里出现才算；五爻生世为吉也防受克空衰破绝，有生名无生实；书中例：中孚之损，巳火生世而受克，此书宜止，后果不准行；野鹤：有益于国之事不必占，可此可彼之事须世与父爻无伤、岁五日月相生才可行）

rule.yi: 太岁生世必须在卦爻里出现才算数，不在卦爻中就生不了世；五爻生世当作吉的，也要防它受克、落空、衰弱、被破、入绝，有生的名义没有生的实际；六爻恍惚不定就不要上书。野鹤说：真有益于国的事，舍身为国也不辞，不必占卜；事情可做可不做之间的，必须世爻与父爻都没有刑冲克破，而且太岁、五爻、日月相生，才可以做；爻中乱动、用神元神非旺非衰、克多生少的，就应当停止。
rule.en: For Tai Sui to generate the Self it must appear among the lines, and if it is not among the lines it cannot generate the Self; taking the fifth line generating the Self as auspicious, one must also guard against its being controlled, Void, weak, broken or extinct, which would give the name of generation and not the substance; if the six lines are vague and unsettled, do not submit the memorial. The Old Man of Yehe says: if the matter truly benefits the state one gives oneself for the country and refuses nothing, and there is no need of divination; for a matter that could go either way, it may be done only if the Self and the Resource line are free of punishment, clash, control and break and Tai Sui, the fifth line, the Day and the Month generate them; if the lines move in disorder, the Subject and Support are neither thriving nor weak, or controls outnumber generations, it should be stopped.

zh: 岁五生身防受制，六爻恍惚且休行。
太岁生世，必要入爻，不在爻中，不能生世。
如今岁子年，须看卦中有子爻者是也。
至以五爻生世为吉者，亦防受克及空衰破绝，有生之名而无生之实。
yi: 太岁、五爻生身，要防备受制；六爻恍惚不定，暂且不要行动。
太岁生世爻，必须进入卦爻中，不在爻中，就不能生世。
比如今年是子年，必须看卦中有子爻的才是。
至于把五爻生世当作吉的，也要防备它受克以及落空、衰弱、被破、绝，有生的名义而没有生的实际。
en: If Tai Sui or the fifth line generates the Body, guard against being restrained; if the six lines are vague and unsettled, do not act for now.
For Tai Sui to generate the Self it must be in the lines; if it is not among the lines it cannot generate the Self.
For example, if this year is a Zi year, one must see whether the hexagram has a Zi line.

As for taking the fifth line generating the Self as auspicious, one must guard against its being controlled, or Void, weak, broken or extinct, which would give the name of generation and not the substance.

zh: 如：申月戊辰日(旬空：戌亥)，占上书，得“中孚之损”
yi: 例如：申月戊辰日（旬空：戌、亥），占上书，得到中孚卦变损卦。
en: For example: in the Shen month on a Wuchen day (void: Xu and Hai), a divination on submitting a memorial gave Zhongfu changing into Sun.

zh: 断曰：五位巳火生世，吉矣！
而不宜巳火受克，此书宜止。
余曰：巳火虽则不能生世，而卦中幸无克世之爻，利与害皆无也。
后此人上书，惟不准行而已。
yi: 断语说：五爻的巳火生世爻，是吉的！
但是巳火不宜受克，这个上书应当停止。
问：有没有害处？
我说：巳火虽然不能生世，但卦中幸好没有克世的爻，利和害都没有。
后来这个人上书，只是没有被批准施行罢了。
en: The judgment said: Si Fire in the fifth place generates the Self, which is auspicious!
But Si Fire should not be controlled, and this memorial should be stopped.
He asked: will there be harm?
I said: though Si Fire cannot generate the Self, fortunately there is no line in the hexagram that controls the Self, so there is neither gain nor harm.
Afterwards this man submitted the memorial, and it was merely not approved.

zh: 野鹤曰：凡上书劾奏，果有兴利除害，有益于国者，舍身而为国，虽赴汤蹈火而不辞，何用占卜？
如果事无关系，或因忿而抱不平、或以直而报怨，事在两可之间者，必得世与父爻皆无刑冲克破，及岁五日月相生，方可行之。
倘爻中乱动，而用神元神非旺非衰，或克多生少，六爻恍惚者，即宜止之，言出祸随，得不慎乎？
yi: 野鹤说：凡是上书弹劾，如果真是兴利除害、有益于国家的事，舍身为国，赴汤蹈火也不推辞，何必占卜？
如果事情没有重大关系，或者因为愤恨而抱不平，或者以正直为名而报私怨，事情在可做可不做之间的，必须世爻与父爻都没有刑、冲、克、破，以及太岁、五爻、日月相生，才可以去做。
如果爻中乱动，而用神、元神非旺非衰，或者克多生少，六爻恍惚不定的，就应当停止，话一出口祸患就跟着来，怎能不谨慎呢？
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: whenever one submits a memorial or impeachment, if it truly promotes benefit and removes harm and is of use to the state, one gives oneself for the country and refuses nothing even in boiling water and fire, so what need of divination?

If the matter is of no consequence, or one is moved by anger to take up an injustice, or repays a grudge in the name of uprightness, a matter that could go either way, it may be done only if the Self and the Resource line are free of punishment, clash, control and break, and Tai Sui, the fifth line, the Day and the Month generate them.

If the lines move in disorder, and the Subject and the Support are neither thriving nor weak, or controls outnumber generations, or the six lines are vague and unsettled, one should stop; once the words are out misfortune follows, so how could one not be careful?

chapter: 面圣、上书、叩阍、献策、条陈、劾奏章
title: 上书·父旺官生，叨蒙赠爵；旺官持世，平步青云（旺父持世官动生之，旺官持世日月生之：官则官上加官，士则身登台阁，平人立见平步登云；野鹤：断卦最重来人之一念，借上书作阶梯求名者，官旺文不旺亦可许封官，因文乃敲门瓦）

rule.yi: 上书求赠爵封官：父母旺相、官星生它，或者旺相的官星持世，或者旺相的父母持世、官星发动生它，或者旺官持世、有日月生它，做官的就官上加官，读书人就位至台阁，平民得到这个卦，立刻平步青云。野鹤说：断卦最看重的是来占的人心里的那个念头；借上书当阶梯来求功名的人，官星旺相而文书不旺，也可以答应他得到赠官封职，因为他本来的念头是为了得官，文书只是敲门砖，所以看重官星而不看重父母。
rule.en: On submitting a memorial to win a bestowed rank or office: if Resource is thriving and the star of office generates it, or a thriving star of office holds the Self, or a thriving Resource holds the Self and the star of office moves to generate it, or a thriving star of office holds the Self and the Day and Month generate it, an official gets office added to office, a scholar reaches the high ministries, and a commoner who gets it at once climbs to the clouds. The Old Man of Yehe says: the most important thing in judging a hexagram is the one thought of the person who comes; for one who uses a memorial as a ladder to seek a name, if the star of office is thriving though the document is not, one may still grant that he will be given a post and title, because his first thought was to gain office and the document is only the tile to knock at the door, so the star of office is weighed and not Resource.

zh: 平人得者，立见平步登云。
yi: 父母旺相、官星生它，能蒙受赠予爵位；
旺相的官星持世，平步青云。
旺相的父母持世，官星发动去生它；
旺相的官星持世，有日月生它；
做官的就官上加官；
读书人就位至台阁；
平民得到的，立刻就能平步登云。
en: With Resource thriving and the star of office generating it, one is favoured with a bestowed rank;
a thriving star of office holding the Self means a smooth climb to the clouds.
A thriving Resource line holds the Self and the star of office moves to generate it;
a thriving star of office holds the Self and the Day and Month generate it;
for an official it is office added to office;
for a scholar it is to reach the high ministries;
for a commoner who gets it, he immediately climbs to the clouds.

zh: 野鹤曰：断卦者，最重来人之一念。
有为父母自身而雪怨者；
有为保全人己之功名者；
有为免自己之赔累，或辨下属之赔累者；
夫士民上书，虽则亦有忠心为国者，然亦有借作阶梯而求名者，倘得官旺而文不旺，亦可许之赠职封官，其故盖因彼之初念原为得官，文乃敲门之瓦耳，所以重官而不重父。
yi: 野鹤说：断卦的人，最看重的是来占的人心里的那一个念头。
这件事有为别人也为自己的；
有为父母、为自己洗雪冤屈的；
有为保全别人和自己功名的；
有为财利而做的；
有为了免除自己的赔累，或为下属辩明赔累的；
这类事本来很多，要靠人灵活变通。
士人百姓上书，虽然也有忠心为国的，但也有借此作为阶梯来求功名的；如果得到官星旺相而文书不旺，也可以答应他得到赠官封职，原因是他最初的念头本来是为了得官，文书只是敲门的砖瓦，所以看重官星而不看重父母爻。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: for one who judges hexagrams, the most important thing is the single thought of the person who comes.
In this undertaking some act for others and for themselves;
some to clear a grievance for their parents or themselves;
some to preserve their own and others' rank;
some for gain;
some to be spared their own liabilities or to explain their subordinates' liabilities;
There are many such kinds, and it is for the man to adapt.

Scholars and commoners who submit memorials include some who are loyal to the state, but also some who use it as a ladder to seek a name; if the star of office is thriving though the document is not thriving, one may grant that he will be given a post and title, because his first thought was to gain office and the document was only the tile to knock at the door, so the star of office is weighed and not Resource.

chapter: 面圣、上书、叩阍、献策、条陈、劾奏章
title: 上书·我念为名，忌子孙之发动；我念为名，忌兄弟而临身（书中例：大壮之夬，父母持世文书极旺而子动伤官，名坏；讼之履，旺文生世而兄弟持世，奏上而钱财终破）

rule.yi: 为求功名而上书，忌讳子孙发动，忌讳兄弟临身：父母持世、文书再旺，只要子孙一动伤官，为名的人文书旺也没用；旺相的文书生世、但兄弟持世，上司的奏章可以上去，自己的钱财终究要破，销账不准。
rule.en: When one submits a memorial to seek a name, Output moving is to be avoided and Peer on the Body is to be avoided: if Resource holds the Self and the document is extremely thriving, once Output moves to injure the star of office a thriving document is of no use to one who seeks a name; if a thriving document generates the Self but Peer holds the Self, the superior's memorial goes up but one's own money is bound to be lost and the write-off is not approved.

zh: 我念为名，忌子孙之发动；
我念为名，忌兄弟而临身。
yi: 我的念头是为了求功名，忌讳子孙发动；
我的念头是为了求功名，忌讳兄弟临身。
en: If my thought is for a name, Output moving is to be avoided;
if my thought is for a name, Peer on the Body is to be avoided.

zh: 如：午月丙辰日(旬空：子丑)，出具文伸枉，保全功名，得“大壮之夬”
yi: 例如：午月丙辰日（旬空：子、丑），占出具文书申冤、保全功名，得到大壮卦变夬卦。
en: For example: in the Wu month on a Bingchen day (void: Zi and Chou), a divination on filing a document to redress a wrong and preserve his rank gave Dazhuang changing into Guai.

zh: 父母持世，月建文书极旺，但不宜子动伤官，七八月申金得令之秋，功名坏矣！
果蒙上台题保，未蒙准行，八月削职，此乃为名者，文旺亦属无益。
yi: 父母持世，月建这个文书非常旺，但是不宜子孙发动伤官，七、八月申金得令的秋天，功名就坏了！
结果上司题请保全他，但没有得到批准施行，八月被削职，这就是为求名的人，文书旺相也没有益处。
en: Resource holds the Self and the Month, as the document, is extremely thriving, but Output moving to injure the star of office is unwelcome, and in the autumn of the seventh and eighth months when Shen Metal holds the season, his rank would be ruined!

In the end the superior petitioned to preserve him but it was not approved and carried out, and in the eighth month he was stripped of office: for one whose thought is a name, a thriving document is of no use either.

zh: 又如：卯月辛丑日(旬空：辰巳)，占具文辨患开销，得“讼之履”
yi: 又例：卯月辛丑日（旬空：辰、巳），占出具文书辨明祸患、销账开脱，得到讼卦变履卦。
