en: Another: in the Mao month on a Xinchou day (void: Chen and Si), a divination on filing a document to explain a trouble and have the account cleared gave Song changing into Lü.

zh: 旺文虽则生世，不宜兄弟持世，上司之章奏定行，我财终是要破，后题请，不准开销。
yi: 旺相的文书虽然生世，但兄弟持世不好，上司的奏章一定会上去，但我的钱财终究要被破，后来题请，没有批准销账。
en: A thriving document does generate the Self, but Peer holding the Self is unwelcome; the superior's memorial would surely go up, but my money was bound to be lost, and afterwards the petition was not approved to write off the account.

chapter: 防参劾、虑大计、及已有事尚未结案者章
title: 防参劾·世旺官旺，忧心冰解；旺官持世，喜映双眉（世与官星旺相，再得日月动爻生扶、世官临日月、动而变吉，防参劾、已参未结案、虑大计者皆无忧，且蒙卓异；书中例：丰之旅，被参而保本随至）

rule.yi: 防备被参劾、担心大计考核、案子还没结的人：世爻与官星都旺相，再有日月、动爻生扶，或者世爻、官爻临在日月上，或者发动变吉，就没有什么可忧虑的：防参劾的无忧，已被参劾而未结案的无忧，担心大计的不但无忧，还一定被评为卓异；凡是旺相的官星持世，也同样推断。
rule.en: For one who guards against impeachment, fears the great evaluation, or has a case not yet closed: if the Self and the star of office are both thriving, and the Day, Month or a moving line also generates and supports them, or the Self or the Pressure line sits on the Day or Month, or they move and turn auspicious, there is nothing to fear: one guarding against impeachment has nothing to fear, one already impeached whose case is not closed has nothing to fear, and one who fears the great evaluation not only has nothing to fear but will surely be rated outstanding; whenever a thriving star of office holds the Self, judge in the same way.

note.yi: 「参劾」是被言官弹劾；「大计」「计典」是定期考核官员政绩的制度。书里没有解释，这里按通行的意思注。
note.en: 'Canhe' is being impeached by the censors, and 'daji' and 'jidian' are the periodic evaluation of officials' performance; the book does not explain them, and they are glossed here in the usual sense.

zh: 世旺官旺，忧心冰解，旺官持世，喜映双眉。
世与官星旺相，何虑何忧？
再得日月动爻生扶，或得世爻、官爻临于日月，及动而变吉，防参劾者何虑？
已参而未结案者无忧，虑大计者，不且无忧，定蒙卓异。
凡得旺官持世，亦同此推。
yi: 世爻旺相、官星旺相，忧愁的心就像冰一样化解；旺相的官星持世，喜气映在双眉上。
世爻与官星都旺相，有什么可忧虑的？
再得到日月、动爻生扶，或者世爻、官爻临在日月上，以及发动变吉，防备被参劾的人有什么可虑？
已经被参劾但还没结案的人没有忧虑，担心大计的人，不但没有忧虑，一定会被评为卓异。
凡是得到旺相的官星持世，也同样推断。
en: With the Self thriving and the star of office thriving, the heart's worry melts like ice; a thriving star of office holding the Self brings joy to both brows.
If the Self and the star of office are thriving, what is there to fear or worry about?

If the Day, Month or a moving line also generates and supports them, or the Self or the Pressure line sits on the Day or Month, or they move and turn auspicious, what has one to fear who is guarding against impeachment?
One already impeached whose case is not yet closed has nothing to fear, and one who fears the great evaluation not only has nothing to fear but will surely be rated outstanding.
Whenever a thriving star of office holds the Self, judge in the same way.

zh: 如：未月戊申日(旬空：寅卯)，占因迟误军粮，已被参劾，得“丰之旅”
yi: 例如：未月戊申日（旬空：寅、卯），占因为耽误了军粮已被参劾的事，得到丰卦变旅卦。
en: For example: in the Wei month on a Wushen day (void: Yin and Mao), a divination for one already impeached for delaying army grain gave Feng changing into Lü.

zh: 断曰：世临日建，月建生之，动出戌宫又来相生，官爵无恙。
彼不以为然，岂知因获奇功，保本随至，功名仍复保全。
或曰：卯木子孙发动，如何不克官？
余曰：木绝于申，所以有救。
yi: 断语说：世爻临在日辰上，月建生它，发动变出的戌土又来相生，官位爵禄没有妨碍。
他不以为然，哪知道因为立了奇功，保举的奏章随后就到了，功名仍然保全了。
有人问：卯木子孙发动，怎么不克官星？
我说：木在申上绝，所以有救。
en: The judgment said: the Self sits on the Day branch and the Month generates it, and the Xu branch it moves out to generates it again, so rank and title are untouched.
He did not think so, but then through winning an unusual merit the memorial recommending him arrived soon after, and his rank was preserved all the same.
Someone asked: the Mao Wood Output line moves, so how does it not control the star of office?
I said: Wood is extinct in Shen, so there is rescue.

chapter: 防参劾、虑大计、及已有事尚未结案者章
title: 防参劾·福世孙摇身化子，官空鬼破变爻克（子孙持世、子孙动于卦中、世动化子孙，官破官空，及动而化回头之克，皆主罢职休官；书中例：旅之明夷，不信易数者果落职）

rule.yi: 子孙持世、子孙在卦中发动、世爻发动变出子孙，官星被破或落空，以及发动变出回头克，都主被罢职、休官。
rule.en: If Output holds the Self, or Output moves in the hexagram, or the Self moves and turns into Output, or the star of office is broken or Void, or it moves and turns into a returning control, all mean dismissal and removal from office.

zh: 福世孙摇身化子，官空鬼破变爻克。
子孙持世、子孙动于卦中、世动化子孙、，官破官空，及动而化回头之克，皆主罢职休官。
yi: 福神持世、子孙摇动、自身又变出子孙，官星落空、官鬼被破，变出的爻来克。
子孙持世、子孙在卦中发动、世爻发动变出子孙，官星被破或落空，以及发动变出回头克，都主被罢职、休官。
en: With Output on the Self and Output swaying, and the Body turning into Output; the star of office Void and Pressure broken, with a changed line that controls.

If Output holds the Self, or Output moves in the hexagram, or the Self moves and turns into Output, or the star of office is broken or Void, or it moves and turns into a returning control, all mean dismissal and removal from office.

zh: 如：寅月丁巳日(旬空：子丑)，占虑计典，得“旅之明夷”
yi: 例如：寅月丁巳日（旬空：子、丑），占担心大计考核的事，得到旅卦变明夷卦。
en: For example: in the Yin month on a Dingsi day (void: Zi and Chou), a divination on fear of the great evaluation gave Lü changing into Mingyi.

zh: 此公素行不检，颇藉势要，生平不信易数。
偶占之，余断曰：子孙持世，虽化回头之克，世亦受克，所以外卦巳酉丑纵成金局以生伏神之官，亦无用矣。
yi: 这位先生平日行为不检点，很依仗权势，一辈子不信易数。
偶然占了一卦，我断道：子孙持世，虽然变出回头克，世爻也受克，所以外卦巳、酉、丑纵然合成金局去生伏神里的官星，也没有用了。
结果被罢了职。
en: This gentleman was ordinarily careless in his conduct, relied much on powerful connections, and all his life did not believe in the Yi numbers.

He divined once by chance, and I judged: Output holds the Self, and though it turns into a returning control the Self is controlled as well, so even if Si, You and Chou in the outer trigram form a Metal frame to generate the star of office in the hidden line, it is of no use.
He was indeed dismissed.

chapter: 防参劾、虑大计、及已有事尚未结案者章
title: 防参劾·子动财空，减禄罚俸（兄弟持世或发动、财破财空、财动化凶，官爻旺相罚俸而已，官失陷则利名俱丧）

rule.yi: 被参劾的情形：子孙发动、财落空，减俸、罚俸；兄弟持世或发动，或者财被破、财落空，以及财发动变凶，如果官爻旺相，不过罚俸而已；官星如果失陷，那么利益和功名都丧失了。
rule.en: In the case of impeachment: with Output moving and Wealth Void, there is a cut in salary and a fine; if Peer holds the Self or moves, or Wealth is broken or Void, or Wealth moves and turns bad, then if the Pressure line is thriving it comes to no more than a fine; if the star of office is lost, both gain and rank are lost.

zh: 兄弟持世，兄弟发动，或财破财空，及财动化凶，倘得官爻旺相，罚俸而已；
官若失陷，则利名俱丧也。
yi: 子孙发动、财落空，减俸、罚俸。
兄弟持世、兄弟发动，或者财被破、财落空，以及财发动变凶，如果官爻旺相，不过罚俸而已；
官星如果失陷，那么利益和功名都丧失了。
en: With Output moving and Wealth Void, there is a cut in salary and a fine.
If Peer holds the Self or Peer moves, or Wealth is broken or Void, or Wealth moves and turns bad, then if the Pressure line is thriving it comes to no more than a fine;
if the star of office is lost, then both gain and rank are lost.

chapter: 防参劾、虑大计、及已有事尚未结案者章
title: 防参劾·身衰鬼克，贬责凌呵（世衰无生扶，又有岁五日月动爻刑冲克世，或官动克世、世随鬼入墓、世动化鬼化克、虎蛇刑克世，轻则贬罚重则刑狱；轻重看世爻有救无救）

rule.yi: 世爻衰弱、官鬼来克，遭贬责、受凌辱。世爻衰弱又得不到生扶，又有太岁、五爻、日月、动爻刑冲克世，或者官星发动克世，或者世爻随官鬼入墓，世爻发动变鬼、变克，以及白虎、螣蛇刑克世爻的，轻的贬官受罚，重的坐牢。轻重要看世爻有没有救：世爻有救，是轻的；世爻休囚又被刑伤冲克，是重的。
rule.en: With the Self weak and Pressure controlling it, there is demotion, reproof and abuse. If the Self is weak and gets no generation or support, and Tai Sui, the fifth line, the Day, the Month or a moving line punishes, clashes with or controls the Self, or the star of office moves to control the Self, or the Self follows Pressure into the tomb, or the Self moves and turns into Pressure or into a control, or the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake punishes or controls the Self, then at the lightest there is demotion and punishment, at the worst prison. Light or heavy depends on whether the Self has a rescue: it is light when the Self has a rescue, and heavy when the Self is resting or trapped and is also punished, injured, clashed or controlled.

zh: 世衰不遇生扶，又有岁五日月动爻刑冲克世，或官动克世，或世随鬼入墓，世动化鬼、化克，及虎蛇刑克世爻者，轻则贬罚，重则刑狱。
余曰：轻者，乃世爻之有救也；
重者，乃世爻休囚，又被刑伤冲克也。
yi: 世身衰弱、官鬼来克，遭到贬责、凌辱和呵斥。
世爻衰弱又遇不到生扶，又有太岁、五爻、日月、动爻刑冲克世，或者官星发动克世，或者世爻随官鬼入墓，世爻发动变鬼、变克，以及白虎、螣蛇刑克世爻的，轻的贬官受罚，重的坐牢。
有人问：怎么分轻重？
我说：轻的，是世爻有救；
重的，是世爻休囚，又被刑伤冲克。
en: With the Body weak and Pressure controlling it, there is demotion, reproof and abuse.

If the Self is weak and gets no generation or support, and Tai Sui, the fifth line, the Day, the Month or a moving line punishes, clashes with or controls the Self, or the star of office moves to control the Self, or the Self follows Pressure into the tomb, or the Self moves and turns into Pressure or into a control, or the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake punishes or controls the Self, then at the lightest there is demotion and punishment, at the worst prison.
Someone asked: how does one tell light from heavy?
I said: it is light when the Self has a rescue;
it is heavy when the Self is resting or trapped and is also punished, injured, clashed or controlled.

chapter: 防参劾、虑大计、及已有事尚未结案者章
title: 防参劾·世静世空官又陷，终须林下作闲人（世空是退休之兆，官又空破休囚者削职无疑）

rule.yi: 世爻安静又落空，官星又失陷，终究要回到山林做个闲人：世爻落空是退休的征兆，官星又落空、被破、休囚的，削职无疑。
rule.en: If the Self is still and Void and the star of office is also lost, one must in the end go back to the woods as an idle man: a Void Self is a sign of retirement, and if the star of office is also Void, broken, or resting or trapped, dismissal is certain.

zh: 世静世空官又陷，终须林下作闲人。
世空者，退休之兆，官又空破休囚者，削职无疑。
yi: 世爻安静又落空，官星又失陷，终究要回到山林做个闲人。
世爻落空，是退休的征兆；官星又落空、被破、休囚的，削职无疑。
en: If the Self is still and Void and the star of office is also lost, one must in the end go back to the woods as an idle man.
A Void Self is a sign of retirement; if the star of office is also Void, broken, or resting or trapped, dismissal is certain.

chapter: 防参劾、虑大计、及已有事尚未结案者章
title: 防参劾·世陷逢生，煞兴何碍（古说「身空煞动，避祸之征」作者以为非：忌神动而世空，待世出空之月日必遭其害，何能避；唯世空逢元神动而相生，忌神动亦无碍）

rule.yi: 世爻失陷但遇到生扶，凶煞兴旺也没有妨碍。古人有「身空煞动是避祸的征兆」的说法，增删卜易认为不对：忌神在卦中发动，世爻落空，等到世爻出空的月份日子，必定遭它的害，怎么能避开？只有世爻落空而遇到元神发动来生它，卦中即使有忌神发动也没有妨碍，因为等到世爻出空那天，忌神反而去生元神，元神再生世爻。
rule.en: If the Self is lost but meets generation, there is no harm even when baleful spirits flourish. The ancients said 'a Void Body and a moving baleful spirit are a sign of avoiding disaster', which the Zeng Shan Bu Yi holds to be wrong: when the Adversary moves in the hexagram and the Self is Void, in the month or on the day the Self leaves the Void it will surely be harmed, so how could it avoid it? Only when the Self is Void and meets the Support moving to generate it is there no harm even though the Adversary moves, because by the day the Self leaves the Void the Adversary instead generates the Support and the Support generates the Self.

dispute.yi: 黄金策仕宦章说「身空杀动，避祸之征」（LY.CAREER.HJC.16），旧注解作鬼发动被月日岁君伤克，是避祸脱灾；增删卜易引了「身空煞动，避祸之征」，明说「余以为非也」，理由是世爻出空之日必遭其害。
dispute.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on holding office says 'a Void Body and a moving baleful spirit are a sign of avoiding disaster' (LY.CAREER.HJC.16), and the old commentary explains it as Pressure moving and being injured and controlled by the Month, Day and Tai Sui, which is escaping disaster; the Zeng Shan Bu Yi quotes 'a Void Body and a moving baleful spirit are a sign of avoiding disaster' and says outright 'I think it is wrong', its reason being that on the day the Self leaves the Void it will surely be harmed.

zh: 古有：身空煞动，避祸之征，余以为非也。
盖忌神动于卦中，世爻空者，待世爻出空之月日，必遭其害，何能避之？
惟世空逢元神动而相生，卦中虽有忌神发动亦无碍矣，以其待世爻出空之日，忌神反生元神而生世也。
yi: 世爻失陷但遇到生扶，凶煞兴旺又有什么妨碍。
古人有「身空煞动，避祸的征兆」的说法，我认为不对。
因为忌神在卦中发动，世爻落空的，等到世爻出空的月份日子，必定遭它的害，怎么能避开？
只有世爻落空而遇到元神发动来生它的，卦中即使有忌神发动也没有妨碍，因为等世爻出空的那天，忌神反而去生元神、元神再生世爻。
en: If the Self is lost but meets generation, what harm is there if baleful spirits flourish?
The ancients said 'a Void Body and a moving baleful spirit are a sign of avoiding disaster', which I think is wrong.
For when the Adversary moves in the hexagram and the Self is Void, once the month or day comes in which the Self leaves the Void it will surely be harmed, so how could it avoid it?

Only when the Self is Void and meets the Support moving to generate it is there no harm even though the Adversary moves in the hexagram, because by the day the Self leaves the Void the Adversary instead generates the Support and the Support generates the Self.

chapter: 防参劾、虑大计、及已有事尚未结案者章
title: 防参劾·官隆世陷，身辱官存（凶兆中官爻持世或官伏世下而旺，虽见责罚官职犹存；野鹤：世遇五爻之克，官旺生合世或旺官持世，虽辱仍有官；书中例：井之中孚，世空逢日冲暗动，官局生应，位已属他人，后果调换）

rule.yi: 官星兴旺而世爻失陷，自身受辱但官位还在：凡是遇到凶兆，如果官爻持世，或者官星伏在世爻下面而且旺相，虽然受到责罚，官职还保留（古说：身边伏鬼若不落空，官职还在）。野鹤说：世爻被五爻所克，只要官星旺相、生合世爻，或者旺相的官星持世，虽然遭到羞辱，仍然会有官职。
rule.en: With the star of office flourishing and the Self lost, one is humiliated but keeps the office: whenever an ill omen comes, if the Pressure line holds the Self, or the star of office lies hidden under the Self and is thriving, one is censured and punished but the office remains (the old saying: if Pressure lies hidden beside the Body and is not Void, the office remains). The Old Man of Yehe says: if the Self is controlled by the fifth line but the star of office is thriving and generates or combines with the Self, or a thriving star of office holds the Self, one meets disgrace but still has office.

zh: 古有：身边伏鬼若非空，官职犹在。
谓凡遇凶兆，若得官爻持世，或官伏世下而旺，虽见责罚，而官职犹存。
yi: 官星兴旺而世爻失陷，自身受辱但官位还在。
古人有「身边伏着官鬼，如果不落空，官职还在」的说法。
意思是凡是遇到凶兆，如果官爻持世，或者官星伏在世爻下面而且旺相，虽然受到责罚，官职还保留。
en: With the star of office flourishing and the Self lost, one is humiliated but keeps the office.
The ancients said: 'if Pressure lies hidden beside the Body and is not Void, the office remains.'
It means that whenever an ill omen comes, if the Pressure line holds the Self, or the star of office lies hidden under the Self and is thriving, one is censured and punished but the office remains.

zh: 野鹤曰：世遇五爻之克，若得官旺生合世爻，及旺官持世，虽则逢辱，仍复有官。
yi: 野鹤说：世爻被五爻所克，如果官星旺相生合世爻，以及旺相的官星持世，虽然遭到羞辱，仍然会有官职。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: if the Self is controlled by the fifth line, but the star of office is thriving and generates or combines with the Self, or a thriving star of office holds the Self, one meets disgrace but still has office.

zh: 如：丑月戊辰日(旬空：戌亥)，占防参劾，得“井之中孚”
yi: 例如：丑月戊辰日（旬空：戌、亥），占防备参劾，得到井卦变中孚卦。
en: For example: in the Chou month on a Wuchen day (void: Xu and Hai), a divination on guarding against impeachment gave Jing changing into Zhongfu.

zh: 断曰：此卦甚奇，世空而逢日冲不为空矣，世不受克而暗动，虽无参论，恐要离任。
彼曰：既无参论，如何离任？
余曰：世爻暗兴，必主动摇，且内卦巳酉丑合成官局以生应爻，故知此位已属他人矣。
后因裁他处之缺，上司题留他处之官顶此公之位，换此公回京另补，此亦少经见之事甚矣，知几者神哉！
yi: 断语说：这个卦很奇特，世爻落空但遇到日辰冲，就不算空了，世爻不受克却暗动，虽然没有被参劾的议论，恐怕要离任。
他说：既然没有被参劾的议论，怎么会离任？
我说：世爻暗中兴起，必定主有动摇，而且内卦巳、酉、丑合成官局去生应爻，所以知道这个位置已经属于别人了。
后来因为裁撤了别处的缺，上司题请把别处的官留下来顶这位先生的职位，让这位先生回京另外补缺，这也是很少见到的事，能知道机微的人真神啊！
en: The judgment said: this hexagram is most unusual; the Self is Void but meets a clash from the Day and so is no longer Void; it is not controlled yet moves in secret, so though there is no talk of impeachment, I fear he must leave his post.
He said: if there is no talk of impeachment, how can I leave my post?

I said: the Self stirs in secret, which surely means a shake-up, and moreover the inner trigram Si, You and Chou combines into a Pressure frame to generate the Other, so I knew the post already belonged to another.

Later, because a post elsewhere was abolished, the superior petitioned to keep the officer of that post to take this gentleman's place and sent this gentleman back to the capital to be given another post; this too is a very rare thing, and how divine are those who know the signs!

chapter: 防参劾、虑大计、及已有事尚未结案者章
title: 防参劾·身实官陷，位去身安（世旺不受伤克，官破官空或被刑冲克害或动变凶，官禄虽失而身不受伤）

rule.yi: 自身实在、官星失陷，官位丢了但人平安：世爻旺相、不受伤克，而官星被破、落空，或被刑冲克害，或发动变凶，官职俸禄虽然丢了，人不会受伤害。
rule.en: With the Body solid and the star of office lost, the post goes but the person is safe: if the Self is thriving and not injured or controlled, while the star of office is broken or Void, or punished, clashed, controlled or harmed, or moves and turns bad, the office and salary are lost but the person is not harmed.

zh: 世爻旺相不受伤克，官破官空，及被刑冲克害，或动而变凶者，官禄虽失，身不逢伤。
yi: 自身实在、官星失陷，官位丢了但人平安。
世爻旺相不受伤克，官星被破、落空，以及被刑冲克害，或者发动变凶的，官职俸禄虽然丢了，人不会受伤害。
en: With the Body solid and the star of office lost, the post goes but the person is safe.

If the Self is thriving and not injured or controlled, while the star of office is broken or Void, or punished, clashed, controlled or harmed, or moves and turns bad, the office and salary are lost but the person is not harmed.

title: 养亲告病辞官·子世子兴，必能遂愿；官克官也，总不如心（子孙持世或发动，无官之累，能遂偷闲；官星持世或官动克世合世，难脱利名缰锁）

rule.yi: 养亲、告病、辞官：子孙持世、子孙发动，就没有官职的牵累，必定能如愿偷闲；官星持世，以及官星发动克世、合世的，难以摆脱名利的缰绳和锁链。
rule.en: To care for a parent, take sick leave or resign: if Output holds the Self or Output moves, there is no burden of office and one will surely get the leisure one wants; if the star of office holds the Self, or the star of office moves to control or combine with the Self, one can hardly break free from the reins and chains of rank and profit.

note.yi: 「官克官也」原文如此，字面不通；后一句注文把它讲成「官星持世、官动克世合世」，译文照字面译，不另改字。
note.en: 'Pressure controls Pressure' is how the text reads and it does not make sense literally; the following note explains it as 'the star of office holds the Self, or moves to control or combine with the Self', and the translation follows the letter without emending.

zh: 子孙持世，子孙发动，乃无官之累，必能遂我偷闲。
若官星持世、及官动克世合世者，难脱利名缰锁。
yi: 子孙持世、子孙兴旺，必定能如愿；
官星克官，总归不称心。
子孙持世、子孙发动，就是没有官职的牵累，必定能遂我偷闲的心愿。
如果官星持世，以及官星发动克世、合世的，难以摆脱名利的缰绳和锁链。
en: With Output on the Self and flourishing, one will surely get one's wish;
Pressure controlling the office, it never goes as one wishes.
If Output holds the Self or Output moves, there is no burden of office, and one will surely get the leisure one wants.
If the star of office holds the Self, or the star of office moves to control or combine with the Self, one can hardly break free from the reins and chains of rank and profit.

title: 养亲告病辞官·告假不忌反吟，休致须宜化退（告病养亲是暂归，得反吟应将来再任故不忌；辞官不宜反吟，得伏吟必不能行；官化退、世化退告假辞官皆遂意；世与官化进神则王事羁身难歇手）

rule.yi: 告假、告病、奉养父母是暂时回去的事，得反吟卦不忌讳（应了将来还会再任职）；辞官的人不宜见反吟，得伏吟一定走不成；官星或世爻变退神，告假、辞官都能如意；世爻与官星变进神，公事缠身，难以歇手。
rule.en: Taking leave, sick leave and caring for a parent are temporary returns home, and a Reversed Chant hexagram is not feared (it means one will take office again); for one resigning Reversed Chant is not suitable, and with Hidden Chant one surely cannot go; if the star of office or the Self turns into a Retreating line, leave and resignation are both granted as wished; if the Self and the star of office turn into Advancing lines, state business holds one fast and it is hard to stop.

note.yi: 「留台」书里没有解释；译文照字面保留。反吟、伏吟的定义见术语表。
note.en: The book does not explain 'Liutai', and the translation keeps it as it stands. Reversed Chant and Hidden Chant are defined in the glossary.

zh: 告假不忌反吟，休致须宜化退。
告病及养亲，乃暂归之事，得反吟卦者，乃应将来再任，故不忌之。
惟辞官者，不宜见之，非目下屡辞不获，乃将来远入畱台；
官化退，世爻化退，告假辞官，皆得遂意。
世与官星而化进神者，王事羁身，难以歇手。
yi: 告假不忌讳反吟，告老退休必须变退神。
告病和奉养父母，是暂时回去的事，得反吟卦的，是应了将来还会再任职，所以不忌讳。
只有辞官的人，不宜见到它，不是眼前屡次请辞都不获准，就是将来远远地进入留台；
如果得到伏吟，一定走不成。
官星变退神、世爻变退神，告假、辞官，都能如意。
世爻与官星变进神的，公事缠身，难以歇手。
en: For taking leave Reversed Chant is not feared; for retirement a change into a Retreating line is needed.
Taking leave for illness or to care for a parent is a temporary return home, and one who gets a Reversed Chant hexagram will take office again in future, so it is not feared.
Only for one resigning is it not suitable to see it: either repeated resignations are not granted now, or in future one will go far off into the Liutai;
if one gets Hidden Chant, one surely cannot go.
If the star of office turns into a Retreating line, or the Self turns into a Retreating line, leave and resignation are both granted as wished.
If the Self and the star of office turn into Advancing lines, state business holds one fast and it is hard to stop.

chapter: 修陵修河，一切营造公务防患章
title: 营造公务防患·福摇子动无忧，鬼克兄冲有患（子孙持世或动于卦中，事无忧虑有始有终；官鬼克世受累，兄克兄动赔财，鬼兄持世同推）

rule.yi: 修陵修河等营造公务防患：福神摇动、子孙发动没有忧虑，官鬼克、兄弟冲就有祸患；子孙持世或在卦中发动，事情没有忧虑，有始有终；官鬼克世会受累，兄弟克世、发动会赔钱，官鬼、兄弟持世的也同样推断。
rule.en: Guarding against trouble in works such as repairing tombs and rivers: with the lucky spirit swaying and Output moving there is nothing to worry about, and with Pressure controlling and Peer clashing there is trouble; if Output holds the Self or moves in the hexagram, the matter has nothing to worry about and has a beginning and an end; if Pressure controls the Self one is burdened, if Peer controls the Self or moves one loses money, and the same judgment holds when Pressure or Peer holds the Self.

zh: 福摇子动无忧，鬼克兄冲有患。
子孙持世，子动卦中，事无忧虑，有始有终。
官鬼克世而受累，兄克兄动而赔财，鬼兄持世者同推。
yi: 福神摇动、子孙发动没有忧虑，官鬼克、兄弟冲就有祸患。
子孙持世、子孙在卦中发动，事情没有忧虑，有始有终。
官鬼克世会受累，兄弟克世、发动会赔钱，官鬼、兄弟持世的也同样推断。
en: With the lucky spirit swaying and Output moving there is nothing to worry about, and with Pressure controlling and Peer clashing there is trouble.
If Output holds the Self or moves in the hexagram, the matter has nothing to worry about and has a beginning and an end.
If Pressure controls the Self one is burdened, if Peer controls the Self or moves one loses money, and the same judgment holds when Pressure or Peer holds the Self.

chapter: 修陵修河，一切营造公务防患章
title: 营造公务防患·父世官生，因公加爵（父母持世，官星动而生合世爻，必因公事加官）

rule.yi: 父母持世，官星发动生合世爻，必定因为办公事而加官。
rule.en: If Resource holds the Self and the star of office moves to generate or combine with the Self, one will surely gain office through public business.

zh: 父母持世，官星动而生合世爻者，必因公事加官。
yi: 父母持世、官星来生，因为办公事而加官晋爵。
父母持世，官星发动生合世爻的，必定因为公事加官。
en: With Resource on the Self and the star of office generating it, one gains rank through public service.
If Resource holds the Self and the star of office moves to generate or combine with the Self, one will surely gain office through public business.

chapter: 修陵修河，一切营造公务防患章
title: 营造公务防患·财兴官旺，利获名荣（旺官持世财动相生，因公得利、远许名荣；旺财持世、世动化财生世同断）

rule.yi: 财兴旺、官星旺相，既得利益又得荣名：旺相的官星持世，财发动来生它，不但因公事获利，还将得到名誉荣耀；旺相的财持世，或者世爻发动变出财来生世，也同样断。
rule.en: With Wealth flourishing and the star of office thriving, one wins both gain and honour: if a thriving star of office holds the Self and Wealth moves to generate it, one not only gains from public business but will in due time win honour; the same judgment holds when a thriving Wealth line holds the Self, or the Self moves and turns into Wealth to generate the Self.

zh: 旺官持世，财动相生，不惟因公得利，远许名荣。
旺财持世，世动化财生世，皆同此断。
yi: 财兴旺、官星旺相，获得利益和名誉。
旺相的官星持世，财发动来生它，不但因公事获利，还将得到名誉荣耀。
旺相的财持世，世爻发动变出财来生世的，都同样断。
en: With Wealth flourishing and the star of office thriving, one wins both gain and honour.
If a thriving star of office holds the Self and Wealth moves to generate it, one not only gains from public business but will in due time win honour.
The same judgment holds when a thriving Wealth line holds the Self, or the Self moves and turns into Wealth to generate the Self.

chapter: 修陵修河，一切营造公务防患章
title: 营造公务防患·六冲不久，六合坚牢（工程以父爻为用神，用神不旺或受冲克又得六冲卦必不坚久，化冲亦然；世休囚被克将来遭害；父旺得六合卦永远坚牢）

rule.yi: 看工程牢不牢：工程都以父爻为用神；用神不旺，或者受冲克，又得六冲卦的，必定不坚固长久，变冲的也一样；还要看世爻旺不旺，世爻如果休囚被克，将来终究要遭它的害；只有父爻旺相、又得六合卦的，才永远坚固牢靠。
rule.en: To tell whether a work will be firm: in construction the Resource line is always the Subject; if the Subject is not thriving, or is clashed or controlled, and the hexagram is also Six-Clash, the work will surely not be firm and lasting, and so also when it turns into a clash; one must also see whether the Self is thriving, for if the Self is resting or trapped and controlled one will in the end suffer harm from it; only when the Resource line is thriving and the hexagram is also Six-Combine will it be firm and secure for ever.

note.yi: 这一条看的是工程本身牢不牢（父爻为用神），上面几条看的是办这件公务的人自己吉凶。
note.en: This entry judges whether the work itself is sound (the Resource line as the Subject); the entries above judge the fortune of the man who handles the public business.

zh: 工程皆以父爻为用神，用神不旺，或受冲克，又得六冲卦者，必不坚久，化冲者亦然。
又看世爻旺否，世若休囚被克，将来终遭其害，惟喜父爻旺相，又得六合卦者，永远坚牢。
yi: 六冲卦不长久，六合卦坚固牢靠。
工程都以父爻为用神，用神不旺，或者受冲克，又得六冲卦的，必定不坚固长久，变冲的也一样。
还要看世爻旺不旺，世爻如果休囚被克，将来终究要遭它的害；只喜欢父爻旺相，又得六合卦的，永远坚固牢靠。
en: A Six-Clash hexagram does not last; a Six-Combine hexagram is firm and secure.

In construction works the Resource line is always the Subject; if the Subject is not thriving, or is clashed or controlled, and the hexagram is also Six-Clash, the work will surely not be firm and lasting, and so also when it turns into a clash.

One must also see whether the Self is thriving: if the Self is resting or trapped and controlled, one will in the end suffer harm from it; only when the Resource line is thriving and the hexagram is also Six-Combine will it be firm and secure for ever.

chapter: 修陵修河，一切营造公务防患章
title: 营造公务防患·野鹤：初入工程防患宜子孙动，已见疏虞防患则子动伤官；觉子：初入工程兄动虑赔财，已见疏虞兄兴防罚俸

rule.yi: 占公务防患要分两个阶段：刚开始进入工程而防备祸患的，适合子孙动摇，子孙发动就没有忧虑；如果已经出现了疏漏失误而防备祸患的，必然是在为功名担忧，子孙发动反而伤官星，怎么能说子孙动就没有忧虑呢。觉子补充：刚开始进入工程，兄弟发动要担心赔钱；已经出现疏漏，兄弟兴旺要防备罚俸。
rule.en: In divining public business and guarding against trouble one must tell two stages apart: for one who has just begun a works project and guards against trouble, Output swaying is good, for when Output moves there is nothing to worry about; but for one who has already seen a lapse and guards against trouble, he is surely anxious for his rank, and Output moving then injures the star of office, so how could it be said that when Output moves there is nothing to worry about? Juezi adds: at the start of a works project, when Peer moves one fears losing money; once a lapse has appeared, when Peer flourishes guard against a fine of salary.

zh: 野鹤曰：凡占公务，初入工程而防患者，宜子孙动摇，子动无忧。
倘若已见疏虞而防患者，必有功名之虑矣，子动则伤官也。
yi: 野鹤说：凡是占公务，刚开始进入工程而防备祸患的，适合子孙动摇，子孙发动就没有忧虑。
如果已经出现了疏漏失误而防备祸患的，必然是在为功名担忧，子孙发动就会伤官星。
怎么能说子孙发动就没有忧虑呢？
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: in divining public business, one who has just begun a works project and guards against trouble does well with Output swaying, for when Output moves there is nothing to worry about.
But one who has already seen a lapse and guards against trouble is surely anxious for his rank, and when Output moves it injures the star of office.
How could it be said that when Output moves there is nothing to worry about?

zh: 觉子曰：初入工程，兄动则虑赔财；
已见疏虞，兄兴则防罚俸。
yi: 觉子说：刚开始进入工程，兄弟发动就要担心赔钱；
已经出现疏漏，兄弟兴旺就要防备罚俸。
en: Juezi says: at the start of a works project, when Peer moves one fears losing money;
once a lapse has appeared, when Peer flourishes guard against a fine of salary.

chapter: 僧官、道纪、医官、杂职、阴阳等官章
title: 僧官医官·亦喜官文发动（旧文谓僧道医官占功名以子孙为用神、不宜父动，作者以为非：他人占僧道医以子孙为用神，自占功名仍看官爻；官星持世或父母持世得旺官生，名必成；阴阳杂职嫌子动；书中例：屯之既济，子孙持世官临应，果退职）

rule.yi: 僧官、道纪、医官、杂职、阴阳等官：别人占僧人、道士、医生，以子孙为用神，子孙旺相则道业高强，父母兴旺则平庸愚笨、懦弱；他们自己占自己的道术，也以子孙为用神，子孙旺相能降伏鬼神。但他们自己占功名时，子孙发动就克官星了，不能再当用神，应当仍然看官爻：官星持世，或日月动爻来生，或父母持世、有旺相的官星来生，功名必定成；子孙发动或子孙持世，一定不成名；阴阳官和各种杂职官尤其嫌子孙发动；其余的和普通人求名同样断。
rule.en: Monastic, Daoist, medical, minor and yin-yang officials: when another person divines about a monk, Daoist or doctor, Output is the Subject, and if Output is thriving his practice is high and strong, if Resource flourishes he is mediocre, dull and timid; when they divine about their own art, Output is again the Subject, and a thriving Output can subdue ghosts and spirits. But when they divine about their own rank, a moving Output controls the star of office and can no longer be the Subject, so one must still look at the Pressure line: if the star of office holds the Self, or the Day, Month or a moving line generates it, or Resource holds the Self and a thriving star of office generates it, the rank will surely be made; if Output moves or holds the Self, the name will surely not be made; yin-yang officials and all minor posts especially dislike a moving Output; otherwise judge as for an ordinary man seeking a name.

dispute.yi: 黄金策仕宦章讲僧道医官「岂可文书发动」，旧注解作僧道医官的功名以子孙为用神、父母发动克子孙必有灾悔（LY.CAREER.HJC.27）；增删卜易引了这句旧文，说「余以为非也」，并且主张自占功名时看官爻、不看子孙。
dispute.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on holding office says of monastic, Daoist and medical officials 'how can the document move', and the old commentary explains it as: their rank takes Output as the Subject, and a moving Resource that controls Output surely brings misfortune and regret (LY.CAREER.HJC.27); the Zeng Shan Bu Yi quotes this old text and says 'I think this is wrong', holding that when they divine about their own rank one looks at the Pressure line and not at Output.

note.yi: 「僧官、道纪、医官、阴阳」是明清官署里管僧道、医、阴阳的官职；书里没有解释。「鬼服龙降」是说道术高强、能降伏鬼神。
note.en: Monastic officials, Daoist registrars, medical officials and yin-yang officials were the officers who administered monks, Daoists, medicine and divination in the Ming and Qing offices; the book does not explain them. 'Ghosts submit and dragons are tamed' says that the art is high and can subdue ghosts and spirits.

zh: 僧官医官，亦喜官文发动。
谓僧道医官之占功名，以子孙为用神，不宜父动而克子也？
若他人占僧道医人，则以子孙为用神；
若僧道医家自占道术，亦以子孙为用神，子孙旺相，鬼服龙降。
今自占功名，子动则克官矣，如何反为用耶？
官星持世，或日月动爻以相生；
父母持世，或得旺官而相生，其名必成。
阴阳杂职，俱以子动为嫌。
子孙动、子孙持世，皆许必不成名，余则以俗家求名同断。
yi: 僧官、医官，也喜欢官星和文书（父母）发动。
旧文说：怎么可以文书发动。
是说僧道医官占功名，以子孙为用神，不宜父母发动而克子孙吗？
我认为不对。
如果是别人占僧人、道士、医生，就以子孙为用神；
子孙旺相，道业高深强盛；
父母兴旺，平庸愚笨、懦弱。
如果是僧道医家自己占自己的道术，也以子孙为用神，子孙旺相，能降伏鬼、降服龙。
现在是自己占功名，子孙发动就克官星了，怎么反而当用神呢？
应当仍然看官爻。
官星持世，或者日月、动爻来相生；
父母持世，或者有旺相的官星来相生，他的名位必定能成。
阴阳官和各种杂职官，都嫌子孙发动。
子孙发动、子孙持世，都可以断定一定不成名；其余的就和俗家（普通人）求名一样断。
en: Monastic officials and medical officials also welcome the star of office and the document moving.
The old text says: how can the document move?
It means that for monks, Daoists and medical officials asking about rank, Output is the Subject and it is not good for Resource to move and control Output?
I think this is wrong.
If another person divines about a monk, Daoist or doctor, then Output is the Subject;
if Output is thriving, his practice is high and strong;
if Resource flourishes, he is mediocre, dull and timid.
If a monk, Daoist or physician divines about his own art, Output is again the Subject, and if Output is thriving he can subdue ghosts and tame dragons.
But now when he divines about his own rank, a moving Output controls the star of office, so how can it be taken as the Subject instead?
One should still look at the Pressure line.
The star of office holds the Self, or the Day, Month or a moving line generates it;
or Resource holds the Self, or a thriving star of office generates it: then his rank will surely be achieved.
For yin-yang officials and other minor posts, a moving Output is always disliked.
If Output moves or Output holds the Self, one may judge that the name will surely not be made; otherwise judge as for a layman seeking a name.

zh: 如：丑月丙辰日(旬空：子丑)，僧官因官事，恐革退僧官而卜之，得“屯之既济”
yi: 例如：丑月丙辰日（旬空：子、丑），一位僧官因为官府的事，担心被革去僧官的职位而占卜，得到屯卦变既济卦。
en: For example: in the Chou month on a Bingchen day (void: Zi and Chou), a monastic official, fearing to be stripped of his office because of a legal affair, divined and got Zhun changing into Jiji.

zh: 子孙持世，克官之神，官又临于应爻，此官已属他人矣。
yi: 子孙持世，是克官星的神，官星又临在应爻上，这个官职已经属于别人了。
后来果然被革去了职位。
en: Output holds the Self and is the spirit that controls the star of office, and the star of office sits on the Other, so this office already belongs to another.
He was indeed removed from his post.

title: 功名到何品级·水一、火二、木三、金四、土五，官临火者二品，官星属水一品之尊（野鹤：古法不够用，改用指占：我能公侯将相否、一品否、鼎甲否；旺官临日月指日可期，官破刑冲终身失望，子孙持世止渴望梅，官动生身探囊取物；书中例：小过官至佥事，节之蹇世变辰官应辰年鼎甲）

rule.yi: 断官能做到几品：古法按五行的成数，水一、火二、木三、金四、土五，官星临在火上官位二品，官星属水是一品的尊位。野鹤说这个古法不够用：水只有一个数，官位到公侯的怎么确定？官分九品，数只到五，六品、七品的怎么确定？他的办法是指明了去占：我能做公侯将相吗？我能做一品大员吗？我能中鼎甲吗？旺相的官星临日月，指日可待；官星被破或被刑冲，终身失望；子孙持世，就像望梅止渴；官星发动生身，恰似探囊取物。问鼎甲这类具体的事，要另占一卦指明了问：古人以蹇卦为不吉，他只看用神，世临巳火、卯月生申日合、青龙持世，中鼎甲无疑；世爻变出辰土之官，应在辰年，后来果然在甲辰科殿试得传胪第一。
rule.en: To judge to what grade an official will rise: the old method uses the numbers of the five elements, Water one, Fire two, Wood three, Metal four, Earth five, so that a star of office on Fire gives the second grade and a Water star of office the honoured first grade. The Old Man of Yehe says this old method is not enough: Water has only the number one, so how is the rank of dukes and marquises to be fixed? There are nine grades of office and the numbers stop at five, so how are the sixth and seventh to be fixed? His method is to name the matter and divine: can I become a duke, marquis, general or chancellor? Can I become a first-grade minister? Can I take a place among the top three? A thriving star of office on the Day or Month can be expected any day; if the star of office is broken, punished or clashed, one is disappointed for life; if Output holds the Self, it is like quenching thirst by gazing at plums; if the star of office moves to generate the Body, it is as easy as taking something from a bag. For a concrete matter such as the top three, another hexagram is cast with the matter named: the ancients took Jian as ominous, and he looked only at the Subject, where the Self on Si Fire generated by the Mao month and combined by the Shen day with the Azure Dragon holding the Self left no doubt of a top place; the Self turned into the Chen Earth star of office, so it fell in a Chen year, and at the palace examination of the Jiachen session he did come first at the announcement.

note.yi: 「方面」「佥事」「方伯」「开府」都是明清官职或提法，书里没有解释：方面是一省或一方的大员，佥事是按察司的属官，方伯是布政使，开府是出任总督巡抚、自立官署。「鼎甲」是殿试一甲三名（状元、榜眼、探花），「传胪」是殿试后二甲头名的唱名传呼。这里都是按通行的意思注。最后这个例子也讲科举，放在考试域里会再引到。
note.en: 'Fangmian', 'qianshi', 'fangbo' and 'kaifu' are Ming and Qing offices and terms that the book does not explain: a regional post is a senior office for a province or region, a qianshi is a subordinate of the provincial judicial commission, a fangbo is a provincial administration commissioner, and kaifu is to take up a governor-generalship or governorship with one's own office; 'dingjia' is the top three places of the palace examination (the first, second and third of the first class), and 'chuanlu' is the announcement of the head of the second class after it. They are all glossed here in the usual sense. The last example is also about the examinations and will be cited again in the examinations domain.

zh: 水一、火二、木三、金四、土五，官临火者，官居二品，官星属水，一品之尊。
yi: 水是一、火是二、木是三、金是四、土是五，官星临在火上的，官位在二品；官星属水的，是一品的尊位。
en: Water is one, Fire two, Wood three, Metal four, Earth five; if the star of office sits on Fire, the rank is second grade; if the star of office is Water, it is the honoured first grade.

zh: 但水止一数，位至公侯者，何以定之？
官设九品，数止于五、六、七品者，何以定之？
余有指占之法在，我能公侯将相否？
子孙持世，犹如止渴望梅；
官动生身，恰似探囊取物。
yi: 野鹤说：上面是古法。
但是水只有一个数，官位到公侯的，怎么确定？
官分九品，而数只到五，那么六品、七品的，怎么确定？
我有指明了去占的办法在：我能做公侯将相吗？
我能做一品大员吗？
旺相的官星临在日月上，指日可待；
官星被破以及被刑冲，终身失望；
子孙持世，就像望梅止渴；
官星发动生身，恰似探囊取物。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: the above is the old method.
But Water has only the number one, so how is one to fix the rank of those who reach duke or marquis?
There are nine grades of office, yet the numbers stop at five, so how is one to fix the sixth and seventh grades?
I have the method of divining by naming the matter: can I become a duke, marquis, general or chancellor?
Can I become a minister of the first grade?
If a thriving star of office sits on the Day or Month, it can be expected any day now;
if the star of office is broken, punished or clashed, one is disappointed for life;
if Output holds the Self, it is like quenching thirst by gazing at plums;
if the star of office moves to generate the Body, it is as easy as taking something from a bag.

zh: 如：巳月乙卯日（旬空：子丑）曾有邑宰，问将来官至方面否？
yi: 例如：巳月乙卯日（旬空：子、丑），曾有一位县令来问，将来官能做到方面大员吗？
占得雷山小过卦：
en: For example: in the Si month on a Yimao day (void: Zi and Chou), a former district magistrate asked whether he would one day rise to a regional post;
he got the hexagram Xiaoguo:

zh: 午火官星持世，后果官至佥事。
yi: 午火官星持世，后来果然官做到佥事。
en: The Wu Fire star of office holds the Self, and he did indeed rise to the post of assistant commissioner.

zh: 又有子月乙亥日，官至方伯，问将来能于开府否？
连占三卦，子孙持世，后果降调而归。
yi: 又有一位在子月乙亥日来占的，官做到方伯，问将来能不能开府？
连续占了三个卦，都是子孙持世，后来果然降职调离回了家。
en: Another, in the Zi month on a Yihai day, had risen to provincial commissioner and asked whether he would ever head a provincial government;
he divined three hexagrams in a row, all with Output holding the Self, and in the end he was indeed demoted, transferred and went home.

zh: 又因占会试，许之必中，又问：能鼎甲否？
yi: 又因为占会试，答应他一定考中，他又问：能中鼎甲吗？
我说：必须再占一卦：
en: Then, having divined about the metropolitan examination and been granted that he would pass, he asked: can I take a place among the top three?
I said: another hexagram must be cast:

zh: 于：卯月甲申日(旬空：午未)，得“节之蹇”
yi: 于是在卯月甲申日（旬空：午、未），得到节卦变蹇卦。
en: So in the Mao month on a Jiashen day (void: Wu and Wei) he got Jie changing into Jian.

zh: 断曰：古以蹇为不吉，余惟重用神。
此卦世临巳火，卯月生之，申日合之。
青龙持世，中鼎甲而无疑。
余曰：世爻变出辰土之官，乃辰年之鼎甲也。
我少年得一预兆，亦应辰年。
场毕即回，至甲辰科殿试，果得首唱传胪。
所以此教人指其事而占者，无不验也。
何必谆谆执古法而猜之。
yi: 断语说：古人认为蹇卦不吉，我只看重用神。
这个卦世爻临巳火，卯月生它，申日合它。
青龙持世，中鼎甲是没有疑问的。
但不是这一科的鼎甲。
他说：为什么？
我说：世爻变出辰土的官星，是辰年的鼎甲。
他说：这个数暗合我的机缘。
我少年时得到一个预兆，也应在辰年。
考完就回去了，到甲辰科殿试，果然得了第一个唱名的传胪。
所以我教人指明那件事来占，没有不应验的。
何必再三再四地死守古法去猜测。
en: The judgment said: the ancients took Jian as ominous; I look only at the Subject.
In this hexagram the Self sits on Si Fire, which the Mao month generates and the Shen day combines with.
The Azure Dragon holds the Self, so there is no doubt that he will take a place among the top three.
But it is not this session's top three.
The gentleman asked: why?
I said: the Self turns into the Chen Earth star of office, so it will be the top three of a Chen year.
He said: this reckoning quietly matches my own secret.
In my youth I received an omen that also pointed to a Chen year.
When the examination was over he went home, and at the palace examination of the Jiachen session he did indeed come first at the 'chuanlu' announcement.
That is why I teach people to name the matter when they divine, for it never fails.
Why insist again and again on the old methods and guess?

title: 子占父功名·父旺官动相生皆许成名，财克父、子动伤官、父官变凶、日月克官克父、父官衰墓破绝皆主无益（书中例：涣之夬，寅年起用、终于未年；观之涣，父在京候补，未土父持世巳官生之，补四川）

rule.yi: 儿子占父亲的功名：父母旺相、官星发动相生，或日月作官星来生父母，或父母旺相变出官星，或父母、官星发动变吉，都可以答应成名；财克父母、子孙发动伤官星、父母和官星发动变凶、日月克官星克父母，或者父爻、官爻衰弱入墓被破入绝，都主没有益处。
rule.en: A son divining about his father's career: if Resource is thriving and the star of office moves to generate it, or the Day or Month acts as the star of office and generates Resource, or a thriving Resource turns into the star of office, or Resource and the star of office move and turn auspicious, he may be granted a name; if Wealth controls Resource, Output moves to injure the star of office, Resource and the star of office move and turn bad, the Day or Month controls the star of office and Resource, or the Resource line or the Pressure line is weak, in tomb, broken or extinct, all mean no gain.

note.yi: 「起用」是被重新任用；「候补」是等候补缺。原文这一章在两个例子之间有一段今人的评语（「居士评」），不收。
note.en: 'Qiyong' is being given a post again and 'houbu' is waiting for a vacancy. Between the two examples this chapter has a modern comment ('the lay scholar's comment'), which is not quoted.

zh: 父旺官动相生，日月作官星而生父母，父旺化官，父官动而化吉，皆许成名。
财克父、子动伤官、父官动而变凶、日月克官克父，或父爻、官爻衰墓破绝，皆主无益。
yi: 父母旺相、官星发动相生，日月作官星来生父母，父母旺相变出官星，父母和官星发动变吉，都可以答应成名。
财克父母、子孙发动伤官星、父母和官星发动变凶、日月克官星克父母，或者父爻、官爻衰弱入墓被破入绝，都主没有益处。
en: If Resource is thriving and the star of office moves to generate it, or the Day or Month acts as the star of office and generates Resource, or a thriving Resource turns into the star of office, or Resource and the star of office move and turn auspicious, all mean he may be granted a name.

If Wealth controls Resource, Output moves to injure the star of office, Resource and the star of office move and turn bad, the Day or Month controls the star of office and Resource, or the Resource line or the Pressure line is weak, in tomb, broken or extinct, all mean no gain.

zh: 如：卯月壬辰日(旬空：午未)，占父何时起用，得“涣之夬”
yi: 例如：卯月壬辰日（旬空：午、未），占父亲什么时候被起用，得到涣卦变夬卦。
en: For example: in the Mao month on a Renchen day (void: Wu and Wei), a divination on when his father would be reinstated gave Huan changing into Guai.

zh: 内卦寅木父母旺而化出子水之官，许寅年起用。
果应于寅年，仍以原品起用，后终于未年。
又以此卦悟出初爻寅木父母，寅年而起用，上爻卯木父母动化未墓，墓于未年。
占时未墓爻空，谓之“空墓以待”，所以终于实墓之年。
又因用神重叠，逢墓库以收藏也。
yi: 内卦的寅木父母爻旺相，并且变出子水的官星，答应他寅年被起用。
果然应在寅年，仍然按原来的品级起用，后来在未年去世。
又从这个卦悟出：初爻寅木父母爻，在寅年起用；上爻卯木父母爻发动变入未土墓，墓在未年。
占的时候未土墓爻落空，这叫「空墓以待」，所以终于填实墓的那一年。
又因为用神重叠，遇到墓库就被收藏了。
en: The Yin Wood Resource line in the inner trigram is thriving and turns into the Zi Water star of office, so I granted that he would be reinstated in a Yin year.
It came true in the Yin year, and he was reinstated at his former grade, and later died in a Wei year.

From this hexagram I also understood: the Yin Wood Resource line in the first place is reinstated in a Yin year, while the Mao Wood Resource line in the top place moves and turns into the tomb of Wei Earth, so the tomb falls in a Wei year.
At the time of the cast the Wei Earth tomb line was Void, which is called 'the Void tomb waiting', so it ended in the year the tomb was filled.
Also, because the Subject was doubled, meeting the tomb it was stored away.

zh: 又如：辰月戊申日(旬空：寅卯)，占父在京候补，得“观之涣”
yi: 又例：辰月戊申日（旬空：寅、卯），占父亲在京城候补的事，得到观卦变涣卦。
en: Another: in the Chen month on a Wushen day (void: Yin and Mao), a divination on his father waiting in the capital for a post gave Guan changing into Huan.

zh: 未土父母持世，巳火官动生之，许即得缺。
巳月归里赴任，巳火生世之故耳。
yi: 未土父母持世，巳火官星发动去生它，答应他立刻得缺。
果然补在四川。
巳月回乡赴任，是巳火生世的缘故。
en: Wei Earth Resource holds the Self and the Si Fire star of office moves to generate it, so I granted that he would get a post at once.
He was indeed given a post in Sichuan.
He returned to his home district and took up his post in the Si month, because Si Fire generates the Self.

title: 子占父功名·李我平：问何时问何地须分占，据一卦兼断时地之谬；八宫、二十八宿、禄定方、游魂远归魂近，《易冒》以五行六神八宫为经诸星为纬，可说不可行

rule.yi: 占升迁，问什么时候和问什么地方，必须分开占；凭一个卦兼着断，假如官星是申金，必定七月升迁，按分野申是西方晋地，难道七月升迁的缺就一定在西方？这是古法的荒谬。又有按八宫来定的（如离南坎北），有用二十八宿定分野的，有用禄来定方位的，有说游魂卦远、归魂卦近的，都靠不住。《易冒》以五行、六神、八宫为经，众星为纬，可以讲但不能行：五行、八宫、二十八宿还算近理，如果用六神再加星煞，丁日占得恒卦，酉金官星持世，必掌兵权；六神得螣蛇，螣蛇是奔走差遣的吏；丁日以酉为文昌，文昌是翰林院；按这个方法断，就成了又掌兵权、又在翰林、又听差遣的人了，岂不是胡说。
rule.en: In divining about promotion, when it comes and where it is must be divined separately; judging both from one hexagram, suppose the star of office is Shen Metal, one would be promoted in the seventh month, and by the division of regions Shen is the land of Jin in the west, but does a promotion in the seventh month have to be a post in the west? This is the absurdity of the old method. Then there is fixing it by the eight palaces (such as Li south and Kan north), or by the twenty-eight lunar mansions, or by the Emolument, or saying a Wandering Soul hexagram is far and a Returning Soul hexagram near, none of which can be relied on. The Yi Mao takes the five elements, the six spirits and the eight palaces as the warp and the stars as the weft, which can be talked about but cannot be practised: the five elements, the eight palaces and the twenty-eight mansions are rather more reasonable, but if the six spirits are joined with the stars and baleful spirits, then on a Ding day with Heng and the You Metal star of office holding the Self he must hold military power; the spirit is the Coiling Snake, an official who runs on commissions; on a Ding day You is the Wenchang star, which is the Hanlin Academy; by this method he would be a man who holds military power, sits in the Hanlin and awaits commissions all at once, and is that not idle talk?

note.yi: 「分野」是把天上的星宿对应地上的区域；「文昌」是一颗神煞星，主文才。这里的「禄」指神煞里的禄。书里没有解释，这里按通行的意思注。
note.en: 'Fenye' is matching the lunar mansions in the sky to regions of the earth, and 'Wenchang' is a spirit-star of literary talent; the 'Emolument' here is the Emolument spirit-star. The book does not explain them, and they are glossed here in the usual sense.

zh: 李我平曰：问何时，问何地，须要分占。
若据一卦而兼断，假令官值申金，必升于七月。
论分野，则申乃西晋之地，岂七月之升迁必西方之缺耶？
又以八宫，如离南坎北之类；
又以二十八宿，以定分野。
又云食禄于此土，以禄定方；
《易冒》以五行六神八宫为经，诸星为纬以参之，此可说而不可行也。
夫五行八宫及二十八宿，优为近理。
若以六神而兼星煞，使丁日占得“雷风恒”卦，酉官持世，必掌兵权；
神得螣蛇，蛇乃驰驱差遣之吏；
丁以酉为文昌，文昌为翰苑。
以彼法而断，酉官为经，螣蛇、文昌为纬，定是掌兵权之翰苑、听差遣之词林矣！
yi: 李我平说：问什么时候，问什么地方，必须分开占。
如果凭一个卦兼着断，假如官星是申金，必定在七月升迁。
论分野，申是西方晋地，难道七月升迁的缺就一定是西方的缺吗？
这是古法的荒谬。
又有按八宫来定的，比如离南坎北这类；
又有用二十八宿来确定分野的。
又说在这块土地上食俸禄，用禄来定方位；
又说游魂卦远而归魂卦近。
《易冒》以五行、六神、八宫为经，众星为纬来参照，这种说法可以讲但不能行。
五行、八宫以及二十八宿，还算比较合理。
如果用六神再加上星煞，假使丁日占得雷风恒卦，酉金官星持世，必定掌握兵权；
六神得螣蛇，螣蛇是奔走差遣的吏员；
丁日以酉为文昌，文昌就是翰林院。
按他们的方法断，酉金官星是经，螣蛇、文昌是纬，必定是掌握兵权的翰林、听候差遣的词林了！
难道不是胡说吗。
en: Li Woping says: asking when and asking where must be divined separately.
If one judges both from one hexagram, suppose the star of office is Shen Metal, one would be promoted in the seventh month.
By the division of the sky into regions, Shen is the land of Jin in the west, but does a promotion in the seventh month have to be a post in the west?
This is the absurdity of the old method.
Then there is judging by the eight palaces, such as Li south and Kan north;
or fixing the regions by the twenty-eight lunar mansions.
or saying that one eats a salary in a certain land, and fixing the direction by the Emolument;
or saying a Wandering Soul hexagram is far and a Returning Soul hexagram near.
The Yi Mao takes the five elements, the six spirits and the eight palaces as the warp and the stars as the weft to compare, which can be talked about but cannot be practised.
The five elements, the eight palaces and the twenty-eight mansions are rather more reasonable.

But if the six spirits are joined with the stars and baleful spirits, then if on a Ding day one gets Heng, Thunder over Wind, with the You Metal star of office holding the Self, he must hold military power;
the spirit is the Coiling Snake, and the Snake is an official who runs on commissions;
On a Ding day You is the Wenchang star, and Wenchang is the Hanlin Academy.

Judging by their method, with the You Metal star of office as the warp and the Coiling Snake and Wenchang as the weft, he must be a Hanlin man holding military power and a Cilin man awaiting commissions!
Is that not idle talk?

title: 八卦断例·求官吉：姤「求官官荣」、观「求官为上」、渐「求官渐升」、鼎「求官十全」、家人「谒贵求官获福无量」

rule.yi: 占求官时，遇到姤卦（求官，官位荣耀）、观卦（求官最好）、渐卦（求官渐渐升迁）、鼎卦（求官十全）、家人卦（谒见贵人、求官，获福无量），都是求官有利。
rule.en: In seeking office, meeting the hexagram Gou ('seeking office: the office is glorious'), Guan ('seeking office: the best'), Jian ('seeking office: gradual promotion'), Ding ('seeking office: complete in all ten parts') or Jiaren ('calling on nobles and seeking office, one wins blessing beyond measure') is favourable to seeking office.

yi: 媾（姤），就是相遇。
谋事一定会有所遇。
求官，官位荣耀。
求财，财能如愿。
病人难得平安。
婚姻，不要娶。
占问出门在外的人，
的确还在路上。
en: Gou (Meeting) means to meet.
Any plan is sure to meet with an encounter.
Seeking office: the office is glorious.
Seeking wealth: the wealth comes as wished.
The sick will find it hard to be at peace.
Marriage: do not take the bride.
As for divining about a traveller,
he is indeed on the road.

yi: 观，就是观望。
凡事都有指望。
田蚕有进益。
家宅兴旺。
占婚事，最合适。
求官，最好。
钱财聚拢，病痊愈。
得福无量。
en: Guan (Viewing) means looking out.
All matters hold hope.
Fields and silkworms bring gain.
The household flourishes.
Asking about marriage: most fitting.
Seeking office: the best.
Wealth gathers and the illness is cured.
Blessing is won beyond measure.

yi: 渐，就是渐进。
田蚕有进益。
求官，慢慢升。
求财，慢慢得。
病，慢慢安稳。
官司慢慢化解。
一切所占的事，
循序渐进就大吉。
en: Jian (Gradual Progress) means advancing step by step.
Fields and silkworms bring gain.
Seeking office: gradual promotion.
Seeking wealth: gained gradually.
Illness: it gradually settles.
Lawsuits are gradually resolved.
In every matter divined,
gradual progress is greatly auspicious.

yi: 鼎，就是器物。
是烹煮饮食的器具。
求官十全十美。
生财百倍。
自身吉利，住宅荣耀。
婚事成，病有利。
求事要托人，
却要仔细。
en: Ding (the Cauldron) means a vessel.
It is a vessel for cooking.
Seeking office: complete in all ten parts.
Making wealth a hundredfold.
The person is fortunate and the dwelling flourishes.
Marriage is made and illness fares well.
Seeking a matter: entrust it to someone,
but be careful.

yi: 风火家人这一卦，
是成家的象。
婚姻和合。
人丁和财运兴旺。
病和官司都无忧。
田蚕有指望。
拜见贵人、求官，
得福无量。
en: Wind over Fire, Jiaren (the Household),
is the image of founding a household.
Marriage is in harmony.
People and wealth flourish.
Neither illness nor lawsuit brings worry.
Fields and silkworms hold promise.
Calling on nobles and seeking office,
one wins blessing beyond measure.

title: 八卦断例·升迁加官：乾「占官转职」、晋「进必有升」、大畜「加官转职」、中孚「官贵升迁」、损「官旺财兴」

rule.yi: 占官职、升迁，遇到乾卦（占官转职）、晋卦（进必有升）、大畜卦（加官转职）、中孚卦（官贵升迁）、损卦（官旺财兴），都主官职有转迁、升进。
rule.en: In divining office and promotion, meeting the hexagram Qian ('asking about office: a change of post'), Jin ('advancing surely brings promotion'), Daxu ('promotion and transfer of post'), Zhongfu ('officials and nobles are promoted') or Sun ('office flourishes and wealth rises') all point to a change or advance of post.

yi: 乾，就是刚健。
做事适合专一。
家里人口平安健康。
田地和养蚕有进益。
问病，能得平安。
占官职，会转任调职。
所谋划的事一定成功。
所求的都能得到。
en: Qian (Heaven) means strength.
In affairs, single-mindedness suits.
The household is at peace and in health.
Fields and silkworms bring gain.
Asking about illness: safety is gained.
Asking about office: a change of post.
What is planned will surely succeed.
All that is sought is obtained.

yi: 晋，就是前进。
进就一定有升。
求进身一定如愿。
进取的事有成。
在外的人还没到。
官司不明朗。
病人难痊愈。
财运平平，只是稍微平顺一点。
en: Jin (Advance) means to go forward.
Advancing surely brings promotion.
Advancing oneself will surely be achieved.
Ventures that advance succeed.
The traveller has not yet arrived.
A lawsuit is unclear.
The sick will find it hard to recover.
Wealth is level, only slightly so.

yi: 畜，就是聚。
人和财都得益。
喜事进门，忧愁散去。
加官进职，转任。
田地成熟，蚕丝收成。
婚事成，病痊脱。
事事亨通。
样样大吉。
en: Xu (Great Accumulation) means gathering.
People and wealth both profit.
Joy enters and worry scatters.
Promotion and transfer of post.
Fields ripen and silkworms are harvested.
Marriage is made and the illness drops away.
Every matter goes through.
Everything is greatly auspicious.

yi: 中孚，就是诚信。
两相对应，中间是实的。
虚和实相通。
凡动没有不吉的。
官员贵人升迁。
田蚕有进益。
忧愁散去，喜事生出。
灾消福聚。
en: Zhongfu (Inner Truth) means good faith.
The two aspects have a solid middle.
Empty and full are connected.
No movement fails to be auspicious.
Officials and nobles are promoted.
Fields and silkworms bring gain.
Worry scatters and joy arises.
Calamity vanishes and blessing gathers.

yi: 损，就是减损。
自身和住宅平平。
婚事成，病痊愈。
官运旺，财运兴。
人口增益。
家宅有利，守正。
不宜打官司。
不利出行。
en: Sun (Decrease) means decrease.
The person and dwelling are middling.
Marriage is made and the illness is cured.
Office flourishes and wealth rises.
The household members increase.
The household is favourable and upright.
Lawsuits do not suit.
Travel is unfavourable.

title: 八卦断例·官贵相应：丰「利官利贵」、豫「贵喜官荣」、升「见贵得贵、求名得名」、随「官贵随顺」、巽「利官利贵」、无妄「官贵文书重重进益」、离「官贵有喜」、同人「贵官俱遂」、复「利贵利官」、临「财官并吉」、夬「贵官成遂」、比「官贵旺相」

rule.yi: 占官、见贵人，遇到丰、豫、升、随、巽、无妄、离、同人、复、临、夬、比这十二个卦，官职和贵人都顺遂有利：见贵得贵、求名得名、官贵随顺、官贵有喜、贵官俱遂。
rule.en: In divining office and calling on nobles, meeting any of the twelve hexagrams Feng, Yu, Sheng, Sui, Xun, Wuwang, Li, Tongren, Fu, Lin, Guai and Bi, office and nobles alike go smoothly and favourably: seeing a noble one gains the noble, seeking fame one gains fame, officials and nobles comply, officials and nobles have joy, nobles and office are both fulfilled.

yi: 丰，就是大。
利于求官，利于见贵人。
婚姻能成。
在外的人一定到。
怀孕，生女孩。
病人沉重拖延。
凡是占家宅，
一半明朗，一半昏暗。
en: Feng (Abundance) means great.
Favourable to office and favourable to nobles.
Marriage is achieved.
The traveller will surely arrive.
Pregnancy: a girl is born.
The sick one is weighed down and lingering.
In all divining of the household,
it is half bright and half dim.

yi: 豫，就是喜悦。
顺着理而动就喜悦。
贵人欢喜，官职荣耀。
自身平安，钱财聚拢。
病人得到平安。
在外的人在路上。
一切作为，
有贤良的朋友相助。
en: Yu (Delight) means delight.
Moving in accord brings delight.
Nobles are pleased and office is glorious.
The person is safe and wealth gathers.
The sick gain peace.
The traveller is on the road.
In all one does,
worthy friends help.

yi: 升，就是上升。
小的积聚成大的成就。
见贵人，得贵人相助。
求名，得名。
婚姻和合。
官司和平。
求谋运作。
最利于向南远行。
en: Sheng (Ascent) means rising.
Small gatherings grow into a great achievement.
Seeing a noble, one gains the noble.
Seeking fame, one gains fame.
Marriage is in harmony.
A lawsuit is settled in peace.
Seeking and scheming are put to work.
Most favourable to go south.

yi: 随，就是跟从。
阴一定跟从阳。
官员贵人顺从。
财禄荣昌。
婚姻和睦。
疾病平安康复。
凡是占自身和命运，
福寿没有边际。
en: Sui (Following) means following.
Yin must follow yang.
Officials and nobles comply.
Wealth and salary flourish.
Marriage is harmonious.
Illness is eased and health returns.
In all divining of the person and fate,
blessing and long life are without limit.

yi: 巽，就是顺。
顺着时势行事。
利于财、利于婚。
利于官、利于贵人。
自身安泰，官司和解。
田有收成，蚕如愿。
只有占病人，
是金神作祟。
en: Xun (Wind) means compliance.
Act in accord with the time.
Favourable to wealth and to marriage.
Favourable to office and to nobles.
The person is at ease and a lawsuit is settled.
Fields give harvest and silkworms thrive.
Only in divining a sick person:
a Metal spirit is the curse.

yi: 无妄，就是真实。
凡事要按实际。
一动就有灾祸。
守旧大吉。
病痊愈，官司和解。
田有收成，钱财积聚。
官贵、文书，
层层进益。
en: Wuwang (Without Falsehood) means truthfulness.
In all matters follow what is real.
Moving brings calamity and blight.
Keeping to the old is supremely auspicious.
The illness is cured and the lawsuit settled.
Fields give harvest and wealth accumulates.
Office, nobles, documents:
gain upon gain.

yi: 离，就是附丽。
凡事分明。
不宜占住宅。
婚事和官司九成能成。
怀孕得双胎，蚕收一半。
病重，财轻。
官员贵人有喜。
最利于在外的人。
en: Li (Fire) means clinging.
All matters are clear.
Divining the dwelling does not suit.
Marriage and lawsuit: nine parts in ten succeed.
Pregnancy: twins; silkworms: half.
Illness is heavy and wealth is light.
Officials and nobles have joy.
Most favourable to the traveller.

yi: 同人，就是相同。
同心同意。
婚事和怀孕都成。
贵人和官职都如愿。
田地收获十成。
钱财收获百倍。
出入、行止、隐藏，
所求的都到。
en: Tongren (Fellowship) means being alike.
Of one heart and one mind.
Marriage and pregnancy both succeed.
Nobles and office are both fulfilled.
Fields yield in full.
Wealth is gathered a hundredfold.
In going out and coming in, in acting and withdrawing,
all that is sought arrives.

yi: 复，就是返回。
七天就回来。
钱财荣昌。
田里庄稼大熟。
失去的会归还。
官司和睦。
利于贵人，利于官。
适合养蚕，忌讳养牲畜。
en: Fu (Return) means returning.
In seven days it returns.
Money flourishes.
Crops in the fields ripen greatly.
What was lost is returned.
A lawsuit is reconciled.
Favourable to nobles and favourable to office.
Silkworms suit; livestock is to be avoided.

yi: 临，就是大。
克制自己，面对别人。
适合占家宅。
利于问婚姻。
财、官都吉。
谋划指望，与同辈同步。
怀孕，生男孩。
病，遇到鬼神作祟的侵扰。
en: Lin (Approach) means great.
Master oneself to face others.
Suits divining the household.
Favourable to asking about marriage.
Wealth and office are both auspicious.
Plans and hopes are in step with one's peers.
Pregnancy: a boy is born.
Illness meets the encroachment of a curse.

yi: 夬，就是决断。
有决断的心志。
交易称心。
生财如意。
婚事和怀孕吉利昌盛。
贵人和官职如愿。
病和官司拖延。
文书迟缓阻滞。
en: Guai (Resolution) means decision.
There is a resolute will.
Deals please.
Making wealth is as wished.
Marriage and pregnancy are auspicious and prosperous.
Nobles and office are achieved.
Illness and lawsuit are delayed.
Documents are slow and stuck.

yi: 比，就是辅助。
阴来辅助阳。
官员贵人旺相。
自身和住宅平安健康。
官司和病解散。
婚姻吉祥。
一切谋划运作，
和顺才光明。
en: Bi (Union) means support.
Yin comes to support yang.
Officials and nobles are thriving and strong.
The person and dwelling are safe and sound.
Lawsuit and illness are dissolved.
Marriage is auspicious.
In all one plans and works,
harmony and accord bring brightness.

title: 八卦断例·吉凶参半：屯「见贵求官先难后易」、师「求官虽吉、见贵遭嗔」、井「求官谒贵（不宜妄为、藏器待时）」

rule.yi: 遇到屯卦，见贵人、求官先难后易；遇到师卦，求官虽吉，见贵人却会遭到嗔怪；遇到井卦，不宜妄动，求官谒贵要藏好器具等待时机。
rule.en: Meeting the hexagram Zhun, in seeing a noble and seeking office it is first hard, then easy; meeting Shi, seeking office is auspicious but seeing a noble draws his anger; meeting Jing, rash action does not suit, and in seeking office and calling on nobles one should keep the tools hidden and wait for the time.

note.yi: 井卦那一行里「求官谒贵」后面没有断语，同一行的前后是「不宜妄为」「藏器待时」，这里按整行的口气读成要等待时机，不确定。
note.en: In the line for Jing nothing follows 'seeking office, calling on nobles', and the same line has 'rash action does not suit' before it and 'keep the tools hidden and wait for the time' after it, so it is read here as meaning to wait for the time, which is uncertain.

yi: 屯，就是艰难。
本来有亨通的意思。
眼下还伸展不开。
到头来一定能如愿。
一切经营谋划，
全都迟缓阻滞。
拜见贵人、求官，
先难后易。
en: Zhun (Difficulty) means hardship.
At root it carries the sense of success.
For now it cannot yet unfold.
In the end it will surely be achieved.
All undertakings
are slow and held up.
Seeing a noble, seeking office:
first hard, then easy.

yi: 师，就是众。
占自身不利。
求官虽然吉，
但见贵人会遭嗔怪。
不要占财帛。
不要问行人。
病人痊愈得迟。
家宅有灾祸困顿。
en: Shi (the Army) means the multitude.
Divining about oneself is unfavourable.
Seeking office is auspicious,
but seeing a noble draws his anger.
Do not divine about wealth.
Do not ask about the traveller.
The sick recover late.
The household has calamity and hardship.

yi: 井，就是静。
不宜乱作为。
求官、拜见贵人，
问病，拖延迟缓。
田蚕得一半。
在外的人没有回来。
占婚事，阻滞。
把本事藏起来，等待时机。
en: Jing (the Well) means stillness.
Rash action does not suit.
Seeking office, calling on nobles:
Asking about illness: delay and slowness.
Fields and silkworms yield half.
The traveller has not returned.
Asking about marriage: obstruction and delay.
Keep the tools hidden and wait for the time.

title: 八卦断例·求官不利：履「莫问官方」、大过「求官不达」、蹇「官贵艰难」、归妹「贵官休问」、小过「官阻病忧」、坤「功名特远」

rule.yi: 遇到履卦（莫问官方）、大过卦（求官不达）、蹇卦（官贵艰难）、归妹卦（贵官休问）、小过卦（官阻病忧）、坤卦（功名特远），求官不利，要安分守常。
rule.en: Meeting the hexagram Lü ('do not ask about official business'), Daguo ('seeking office does not succeed'), Jian ('officials and nobles are hard to reach'), Guimei ('do not ask about nobles or office'), Xiaoguo ('office is blocked and illness is a worry') or Kun ('fame and rank are especially distant'), seeking office is unfavourable and one should keep to one's lot.

yi: 履，就是礼。
用柔去踩刚。
危险之中有救。
险处没有妨碍。
不要占疾病。
不要问官府的事。
一切谋划运作，
开头谨慎，经营才昌盛。
en: Lü (Treading) means ritual propriety.
The soft treads on the hard.
In danger there is rescue.
In a perilous place there is no harm.
Do not divine illness.
Do not ask about official business.
In all one plans and works,
be careful at the start and the venture will prosper.

yi: 过，就是过分。
刚强过了中。
行船受阻。
涉险没有功效。
求官不能达成。
问消息，难以通达。
安于平常，守本分，
或许能免除灾凶。
en: Guo (Great Excess) means excess.
Hardness goes past the middle.
Travel by boat meets obstruction.
Wading into danger yields no merit.
Seeking office does not succeed.
Asking for news: it is hard to get through.
Rest in the ordinary and keep to one's lot,
and one may perhaps escape calamity and ill-fortune.

yi: 蹇，就是艰难。
凡事蹇滞迟钝。
官员贵人艰难。
出行不要问。
不要占自身和钱财。
不要占婚姻、怀孕。
怎样才能走出险境？
守常安分。
en: Jian (Obstruction) means hardship.
All matters are halting and dull.
Officials and nobles are hard to reach.
Do not ask about travel.
Do not divine the person or wealth.
Do not divine marriage or pregnancy.
How is one to come out of danger?
Hold to the usual and keep to one's lot.

yi: 归妹，就是出嫁。
是女子出嫁的象。
官司不明朗。
贵人和官职不要问。
自身与住宅少有忧虑。
婚姻最好。
守着就合适。
动就不妥当。
en: Guimei (the Marrying Maiden) means a girl going home to marry.
It is the image of a girl being married.
A lawsuit is unclear.
Do not ask about nobles or office.
The person and dwelling have little worry.
Marriage is the best.
To hold still suits.
To move does not fit.

yi: 小过，就是小有过越。
所过之处不远。
自身与住宅有小灾。
交易，钱财很少。
官路受阻，病有忧。
怀孕有惊，婚事免了。
凡是所占的一切，
全都浅浅薄薄。
en: Xiaoguo (Small Excess) means a small excess.
What is passed over is not far.
The person and dwelling have a small calamity.
Trade: wealth is scant.
Office is blocked and illness is a worry.
Pregnancy has a fright; marriage is to be avoided.
In all that is divined,
all is thin and shallow.

yi: 坤，就是地。
厚厚地承载，没有边界。
家宅都顺。
婚事和怀孕才好。
田蚕一半吉。
钱财荣昌。
功名特别遥远。
它的道就光明。
en: Kun (Earth) means the earth.
It carries thickly, without limit.
The household is smooth throughout.
Marriage and pregnancy are good.
Fields and silkworms are half auspicious.
Money flourishes.
Fame and rank are especially distant.
Its way is then bright.

title: 六亲断例·持世：官鬼持世必得官（官化官为禄、求官宜疾速、化子必伤官）；子孙持世谒贵求官反不亨；父母持世旺相文书喜信通（化鬼身迁举）

rule.yi: 官鬼持世，必定得官，文书、印信两样一起看；官化官是得禄，求官宜赶快；化财，占病凶；化父，文书相随；化子，必伤官；化兄，家里不和。子孙持世是福神，事成忧散，占胎问病重重吉利，谒见贵人、求官反而不亨通。父母持世及身宫，旺相，文书、喜信通达；父母化父母，文书一定应许；化子添人口；化鬼，自身得迁升荐举；化财，住宅长忧；兄弟，要从本身去取。
rule.en: With Pressure holding the Self one is sure to get office, and the documents and the seal are looked at together; Pressure turning into Pressure is gaining emolument, and in seeking office one should be swift; turning into Wealth, in illness it is bad; turning into Resource, the documents follow one after another; turning into Output, it surely injures office; turning into Peer, the household is not harmonious. Output holding the Self is the spirit of blessing: matters succeed and worries scatter, and in pregnancy and illness it is good upon good, but in calling on a noble or seeking office it does not go through. With Resource holding the Self and the palace of the Body, strong, documents and glad news go through; Resource turning into Resource, the documents are sure to be granted; turning into Output, people are added; turning into Pressure, one is promoted and recommended; turning into Wealth, the dwelling long worries; for Peer, take it from oneself.

note.yi: 「化父文书逐」的「逐」没有解释，这里读作「文书相随而来」，不确定；「兄弟本身取」也没有解释，按字面译。这三行各问题通用，这里按次序把官鬼持世、子孙持世、父母持世三行都收了。
note.en: 'Turning into Resource, the documents chase' does not explain the 'chase', and it is read here as 'the documents follow one after another', which is uncertain; 'Peer, take it from oneself' is not explained either and is translated literally. These three lines serve every kind of question, and the lines for Pressure, Output and Resource holding the Self are all taken here in order.

yi: 官鬼持世，必定得官；
文书、印信两样一起看；
占婚姻、问疾病，都会犯凶；
破宅、伤财，自身不荣。
官化官，是得禄；
求官宜赶快；
化成财，占病凶；
化成父，文书相随而来；
化成子，必伤官；
化成兄，家里不和睦。
en: Pressure holding the Self, one is sure to get office;
look at the documents and the seal together;
for marriage and illness, both run into ill;
the dwelling is broken, wealth hurt and the self not flourishing.
Pressure turning into Pressure is gaining emolument;
in seeking office, be swift;
turning into Wealth, in illness it is bad;
turning into Resource, the documents follow one after another;
turning into Output, it surely injures office;
turning into Peer, the household is not harmonious.

yi: 子孙持世，是福神；
事成，忧愁散去，谷和财荣盛；
占胎、问病，重重吉利；
谒见贵人、求官，反而不亨通。
子孙化子孙，
人情两边都称心；
化成父，田蚕旺；
化成财，加倍荣盛；
化成鬼，担忧生产、疾病；
兄弟，必定相争。
en: Output holding the Self is the spirit of blessing;
matters succeed, worries scatter, grain and wealth flourish;
for pregnancy and illness, good upon good;
for calling on a noble or seeking office, on the contrary it does not go through.
Output turning into Output,
human feeling pleases both sides;
turning into Resource, fields and silkworms thrive;
turning into Wealth, doubly flourishing;
turning into Pressure, worry for childbirth and illness;
Peer, the brothers, will surely quarrel.

yi: 父母持世以及身宫，
旺相，文书、喜信通达；
田宅、禾苗都遂意；
占自身、问疾病，却成凶。
父母化父母，
文书一定应许；
化成子，添进人口；
化成鬼，自身得迁升荐举；
化成财，住宅长久忧愁；
兄弟，要从本身去取。
en: Resource holding the Self and the palace of the Body,
strong, documents and glad news go through;
fields, houses and crops all as one wishes;
but for the self and for illness it turns ill.
Resource turning into Resource,
the documents are sure to be granted;
turning into Output, people are added;
turning into Pressure, one is promoted and recommended;
turning into Wealth, the dwelling long worries;
Peer: take it from oneself.

title: 六神断例·青龙发动万事通进财进禄；朱雀交重文印旺、杀神相并徒劳功；白虎交重惊怪事、求官临鬼反丰隆

rule.yi: 青龙发动，万事通达，进财进禄，临在凶上、遇杀都无妨碍，只忌落在金上和落空；朱雀交重，文书印绶旺，和杀神并在一起就白劳功夫，是非口舌都由此而来，持水、临空反而有利于公事；白虎交重，是惊恐怪异之事，持金、世上带杀妨碍人口，求官时临在官鬼上，反而丰盛隆盛。
rule.en: With the Azure Dragon moving, all matters go through and wealth and emolument come in, and standing on ill or meeting a baleful spirit it meets no obstruction, only avoid its standing on Metal or falling void; with the Vermilion Bird moving heavily the documents and the seal and ribbon are strong, joined with a baleful spirit the labour is spent in vain, quarrels and gossip all come from this, and holding Water or standing in the void it is on the contrary favourable to public business; with the White Tiger moving heavily it is fright and strange things, holding Metal with a baleful spirit on the Self harms the household, and in seeking office, standing on Pressure, it brings abundance and prosperity on the contrary.

note.yi: 这三首和海底眼「六神爻动」里的青龙、朱雀、白虎三首是同一首诗，字句基本相同（海底眼多出每句后面的小注）。白虎一般主凶，这里说求官临鬼反而「丰隆」，照原文录。
note.en: These three are the same poems as the Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird and White Tiger poems in the Haidi Yan's 'The six spirits moving', nearly word for word (the Haidi Yan adds a small note after each line). The White Tiger generally stands for ill, yet here it is said that in seeking office, on Pressure, it brings abundance on the contrary, as the text has it.

yi: 青龙发动，万事通达；
进财进禄，福气无穷；
临在凶上、遇杀，都没有妨碍；
只忌讳落在金上和落空。
en: With the Azure Dragon moving, all matters go through;
wealth and emolument come in and blessing has no end;
standing on ill or meeting a baleful spirit, there is no obstruction;
only avoid its standing on Metal and falling void.

yi: 朱雀交重，文书印绶旺；
和杀神并在一起，白劳功夫；
是非口舌都因此而起；
持水、临空，反而有利于公事。
en: With the Vermilion Bird moving heavily, the documents and the seal and ribbon are strong;
joined with a baleful spirit, labour is spent in vain;
quarrels and gossip all come from this;
holding Water or standing in the void, it is on the contrary favourable to public business.

yi: 白虎交重，是惊恐怪异之事；
求官时临在官鬼上，反而丰盛隆盛；
持金、世上带杀，妨碍人口；
遇火再加空，就不一样了。
en: With the White Tiger moving heavily, it is fright and strange things;
in seeking office, standing on Pressure, it brings abundance and prosperity on the contrary;
holding Metal with a baleful spirit on the Self harms the household;
meeting Fire and Void, it is otherwise.

title: 天符、直符断例·官禄升迁：年建天符青龙木发动加官禄；月建为青龙外动禄财丰；月建前三为朱雀文书不待约、吉助有升迁、杀交遭系缚

rule.yi: 年建是天符（子年子爻动才断）：天符是青龙木时，发动，加官进禄，在外卦盗去资财，在内卦摇动，忧虑家眷。月建是直符：月建是青龙，动了就不与众相同，在内卦摇动，人口兴旺，在外卦动，禄和财丰厚；月建向前数第三位是朱雀，文书不用等约定，有吉神帮助，就有升迁，杀神交加，遭到拘系束缚。
rule.en: The Year branch is the Year Tally (judge when the line of the year branch moves, as in a Zi year with the Zi line moving): when the Year Tally is the Azure Dragon of Wood and moves, it adds office and emolument, outside wealth is stolen, and shaking inside there is worry for the family. The Month branch is the Month Tally: if the Month is the Azure Dragon, when it moves it is unlike the common run, shaking inside the household prospers, moving outside emolument and wealth are abundant; the third place ahead of the Month is the Vermilion Bird, the documents need not wait to be agreed, helped by auspicious spirits there is promotion, and with baleful spirits crossing one is bound and confined.

note.yi: 这里的「天符」是年建（年支），「直符」是月建，和卜筮大全阐奥歌章里的「唐符」「国印」（按年支取巳亥、寅申等）不是同一样东西。周易尚占自己说明了取法：子年子爻动、临青龙木神之类。
note.en: The 'Year Tally' here is the year branch and the 'Month Tally' the month branch, which is not the same thing as the 'Tangfu' and 'State Seal' of the Chan'ao Ge in the Bushi Daquan (taken by the year branch as Si and Hai, Yin and Shen and so on). The Zhouyi Shangzhan itself explains the method: in a Zi year with the Zi line moving and standing on the Wood spirit, the Azure Dragon, and so on.

zh: 年建为天符（子年子爻动方断。
yi: 年建是天符（子年子爻动才下断。
比如子年子爻动，
落在青龙木神上。）
en: The Year branch is the Year Tally (judged only when, in a Zi year, the Zi line moves.
For example, in a Zi year if the Zi line moves,
it is on the Wood spirit, the Azure Dragon.)

yi: 天符是青龙木时，
发动，加官进禄；
在外，盗去资财；
在内摇动，忧虑家眷。
en: When the Year Tally is the Azure Dragon of Wood,
moving, it adds office and emolument;
outside, wealth is stolen;
shaking inside, there is worry for the family.

yi: 月建是直符。
en: The Month branch is the Month Tally.

yi: 月建是青龙，
一动就不与众相同；
在内摇动，人口兴旺；
在外动，禄和财丰厚。
en: If the Month is the Azure Dragon,
when it moves it is unlike the common run;
shaking inside, the household prospers;
moving outside, emolument and wealth are abundant.

yi: 月建向前数第三位是朱雀，
文书不用等约定；
有吉神帮助，就有升迁；
杀神交加，遭到拘系束缚。
en: The third place ahead of the Month is the Vermilion Bird,
the documents need not wait to be agreed;
helped by auspicious spirits there is promotion;
with baleful spirits crossing, one is bound and confined.

title: 六亲章·玄武当官奸与盗、两重官鬼必忧丧；若占官府反为吉，福厚官高名誉扬

rule.yi: 玄武落在官鬼上，是奸和盗；两重官鬼，必有忧愁丧事；但如果占的是官府（的事），反而是吉：福气厚、官位高、名誉远扬。
rule.en: The Dark Tortoise on Pressure means treachery and theft, and two layers of Pressure bring worry and mourning; but if one divines about officialdom it is on the contrary auspicious: blessing thick, office high and fame spread.

note.yi: 这一句在「六亲章」里，前后讲的是家人、婚姻、讼事；「占官府」在这里指占做官、官场的事，不是占官司。
note.en: This line stands in the chapter on the six relations among lines about family, marriage and lawsuits; 'divining about officialdom' here means divining a career in office and not a lawsuit.

yi: 玄武当了官（落在官鬼上），是奸和盗；
两重官鬼，必有忧愁丧事；
如果占的是官府（的事），反而是吉；
福气厚、官位高、名誉远扬。
en: the Dark Tortoise on Pressure means treachery and theft;
two layers of Pressure bring worry and mourning;
but if one divines about officialdom it is on the contrary auspicious;
blessing thick, office high and fame spread.

title: 僧道章（周易尚占）·道士缁流问卜：身安世静最先；身爻克世可用、世应比和自然乐；世克身退守、财克世好求缘；六爻不动清福、一位交重事变迁；官鬼交好谒官员；世临白虎官司挠、身遇勾陈心事缠；父母克身师接引、青龙持世贵周全；勾陈带杀多魔障；兄弟勾陈同位动防法眷勾连；父母重重身受克被俗家牵；财空注疏徒劳、鬼旺营谋枉费钱

rule.yi: 道士、僧人来问卜：身安稳、世安静最要紧；身爻克世，可以信用；世、应比和，自然安乐；世去克身，当退守；财来克世，好求缘；六爻不动是清福，一位交重，事就变迁；财扶助世，能够施舍行利；官鬼交动，偏好去谒见官员；世临白虎，官司纠缠扰乱；身遇勾陈，心事牵缠；父母克身，有师父接引；青龙持世，有贵人周全；勾陈带杀，多有魔障；官鬼临在财上，被贼人冤害；兄弟和勾陈同位发动，谨防法眷在外勾连；贵人和父母交动，师父通达圣道；青龙并上子孙，徒弟贤能；父母重重、身受克，断定是被俗家牵累；财空，注解经疏徒劳力；鬼旺，谋求营运白费钱。
rule.en: For Taoist priests and monks asking by divination: the Body at ease and the Self still comes first; the Body line controlling the Self, one may be trusted and used; Self and Other in accord, ease comes of itself; the Self controlling the Body, one should withdraw and hold; Wealth coming to control the Self is good for seeking alms; the six lines still is pure blessing, one line moving means change; with Wealth supporting the Self one can dispense benefit; Pressure moving is especially good for calling on officials; the Self on the White Tiger, a lawsuit disturbs one; the Body meeting Hook Earth, worries entangle the heart; Resource controlling the Body, a master receives and leads one on; the Azure Dragon holding the Self, a patron sees one through; Hook Earth carrying a baleful spirit, there are many demonic obstructions; Pressure on Wealth, one is wronged by thieves; Peer and Hook Earth moving together in the same place, beware of Dharma kin colluding with outsiders; the Noble and Resource moving together, the master is versed in the sacred; the Dragon joined to Output, the disciples are worthy; Resource upon Resource and the Body controlled, it is certain one is dragged back by one's lay family; Wealth void, annotating the scriptures is wasted labour; Pressure strong, scheming is money wasted.

note.yi: 这一首和卜筮大全阐奥歌章的僧道章是同一首歌诀（后者有「羽士缁流来问占」），只有少数字句不同：「道士缁流来问卜」（「羽士缁流来问占」）；「堪谌用」（「堪谋用」，「谌」疑是「谋」之误）；「财扶世上能施利」（「财旺正宜收布施」，意思有出入：一说财扶世能施舍行利，一说财旺宜收布施）；「官司挠」（「官司绕」）；「多魔障」（「遭魔障」）；「官鬼临财被贼冤」（「玄武临财被贼冤」）；「贵交父母」「龙并子孙」（「贵临父母」「福德龙交」）。
note.en: This is the same song as the chapter on monks and Daoists in the Chan'ao Ge of the Bushi Daquan (which has 'Yushi zi liu lai wen zhan'), with only a few differences in wording: 'coming to ask by divination' for 'coming to ask by prognostication'; 'may be trusted and used' for 'may plan and act' (the 'chen' probably a slip for 'mou'); 'Wealth supporting the Self one can dispense benefit' for 'Wealth strong is just right for receiving alms', which differs in sense (one says Wealth supports the Self so one may give and benefit, the other that Wealth strong suits receiving alms); 'a lawsuit disturbs' for 'a lawsuit entangles'; 'many demonic obstructions' for 'meets demonic obstruction'; 'Pressure on Wealth, wronged by thieves' for 'the Dark Tortoise on Wealth, wronged by thieves'; and 'the Noble and Resource moving together', 'the Dragon joined to Output' for 'the Noble on Resource', 'Output and the Dragon moving together'.

yi: 道士、僧人来问卜，
身安稳、世安静，最要紧；
身爻克世，可以信用；
世、应比和，自然安乐。
en: Taoist priests and black-robed monks coming to ask by divination:
the Body at ease and the Self still comes first;
the Body line controlling the Self, one may be trusted and used;
Self and Other in accord, ease comes of itself.

yi: 世若克身，应当退守；
财来克世，适合去求缘。
六爻不动，是清福；
有一位交重发动，事情就有变迁。
en: If the Self controls the Body, one should withdraw and hold;
Wealth coming to control the Self is good for seeking alms.
With the six lines still it is pure blessing;
one line moving, the matter changes.

yi: 财扶助世，能够施舍行利；
官鬼发动，偏适合去谒见官员。
世临白虎，官司纠缠扰乱；
身遇勾陈，心事牵缠。
en: Wealth supporting the Self, one can dispense benefit;
Pressure moving is especially good for calling on officials.
the Self on the White Tiger, a lawsuit disturbs one;
the Body meeting Hook Earth, worries entangle the heart.

yi: 父母克身，有师父来接引；
青龙持世，有贵人周全。
勾陈带杀，多有魔障；
官鬼临在财上，被贼人冤害。
en: Resource controlling the Body, a master receives and leads one on;
the Azure Dragon holding the Self, a patron sees one through.
Hook Earth carrying a baleful spirit, there are many demonic obstructions;
Pressure on Wealth, one is wronged by thieves.

yi: 兄弟和勾陈同在一位发动，
要谨防同门法眷在外面勾结牵连。
贵人和父母交动，师父通达圣道；
青龙并上子孙，徒弟贤能。
en: Peer and Hook Earth moving together in the same place,
beware of Dharma kin colluding and entangling you from outside.
the Noble and Resource moving together, the master is versed in the sacred;
the Dragon joined to Output, the disciples are worthy.

yi: 父母重重叠叠、身受克，
断定是身被俗家牵累。
财落空，注解经疏是白费力气；
官鬼旺，谋求营运是白白费钱。
en: Resource upon Resource while the Body is controlled,
it is certain one is dragged back by one's lay family.
Wealth void, annotating the scriptures is wasted labour;
Pressure strong, scheming and managing is money wasted.

title: 僧道章（周易尚占）·乱动切须休入宝、八纯好参玄、艮坤栖岩谷、离巽隐市廛；龙虎交驰宜访道、坎离辐辏好安禅；游魂带杀休云水、一世休囚莫置田

rule.yi: 爻乱动，务必不要入宝；八纯卦倒好去参玄；艮、坤只好栖身岩穴山谷；离、巽偏适合隐居市井；龙虎交驰，适合访道；坎、离汇聚，适合安心坐禅；游魂卦带杀，别去云游；一世卦休囚，不要置买田产。
rule.en: With lines moving in disorder, by all means do not enter the 'treasure'; an Eight-Pure hexagram is on the contrary good for studying the mysteries; Gen and Kun are fit only for dwelling among crags and valleys; Li and Xun are better for hiding in the marketplace; the Dragon and Tiger racing against each other suit seeking the Way; Kan and Li converging suit settling into meditation; a Wandering Soul hexagram with a baleful spirit, do not go wandering like cloud and water; a First-Generation hexagram resting or trapped, do not buy fields.

note.yi: 「乱动切须休入宝」的「入宝」不可解，卜筮大全作「乱动坐关为大忌」，「入宝」疑是「入定」一类的误字，这里照字面译，不确定。「栖岩谷」卜筮大全作「栖岩壑」。
note.en: The 'enter the treasure' of 'with lines moving in disorder do not enter the treasure' cannot be made out; the Bushi Daquan reads 'with lines moving in disorder, going into retreat is the great taboo', and 'enter the treasure' looks like a wrong character for something like entering meditation, but it is translated literally and this is uncertain. 'Dwell among crags and valleys' reads in the Bushi Daquan 'among crags and ravines'.

yi: 爻乱动，务必不要入宝；
八纯卦，倒好去参玄。
艮、坤只好栖身岩穴山谷；
离、巽偏适合隐居市井。
en: with lines moving in disorder, by all means do not enter the 'treasure';
an Eight-Pure hexagram is on the contrary good for studying the mysteries.
Gen and Kun are fit only for dwelling among crags and valleys;
Li and Xun are better for hiding in the marketplace.

yi: 龙虎交驰，适合访道；
坎、离汇聚，适合安心坐禅。
游魂卦带杀，不要云游；
一世卦休囚，不要置买田产。
en: With the Dragon and Tiger racing against each other, it suits seeking the Way;
with Kan and Li converging, it suits settling into meditation.
A Wandering Soul hexagram with a baleful spirit, do not go wandering like cloud and water;
a First-Generation hexagram resting or trapped, do not buy fields.

title: 僧道章（周易尚占）·子动妻交还俗汉；世空身旺地行仙、身空不动头头道、应旺无魔处处禅；应偶世持生又合神清身静寿绵绵；负结财身动填还俗债；世应不和身妄动待驴年；本身太岁临身命即日逢神得正传；太岁火神加父母天边恩命定来宣

rule.yi: 子孙发动、妻财交动，是要还俗的汉子；世空、身旺，是地上的行仙；身空而不动，事事都是道；应旺而没有魔，处处都是禅；应落偶位、世持住，又生又合，精神清明、身体安静，寿命绵长；忽然有负债纠结、财和身一起发动，免不了去偿还俗世的债和冤；世、应不和、身又乱动，想了身达命要等到驴年（永远等不到）；本身、太岁落在身和命上，当天就遇上神人、得到真传；太岁、火神加在父母上，天边的恩命一定会来宣布。
rule.en: Output moving with Wealth also moving: a man who will return to lay life; the Self void and the Body strong makes an earth-wandering immortal; the Body void and still, every single thing is the Way; the Other strong with no demon, Chan is everywhere; the Other on an even place and the Self holding, generating and combining, the spirit clear and the body at peace, life is long; if suddenly there is a debt-knot and Wealth and the Body move, one cannot avoid paying back worldly debts and grievances; with Self and Other at odds and the Body moving wildly, to finish with the body and reach one's destiny one must wait for the Year of the Donkey; the person himself and Tai Sui on the Body and one's fate, on that very day one meets a divine person and receives the true transmission; Tai Sui and the Fire spirit added to Resource, a favour commanded from the edge of heaven will surely be proclaimed.

note.yi: 「应偶世持生又合」卜筮大全作「应偶世奇生又合」（一个「持」一个「奇」）；「本身太岁临身命」卜筮大全作「木神太岁临身命」；末句「拈起笔来画个圈」卜筮大全作「拈笔书将一个缘」。「负结」「驴年」的说明同阐奥歌章（CA.31）。
note.en: 'The Other on an even place and the Self holding' reads in the Bushi Daquan 'the Other on an even place and the Self on an odd one' (a 'hold' for an 'odd'); 'the person himself and Tai Sui on the Body and one's fate' reads there 'the Wood spirit and Tai Sui on the Body and one's fate'; and the last line 'I take up my brush and draw a circle' reads there 'I take up my brush and write down a single yuan'. The remarks on 'debt-knot' and 'the Year of the Donkey' are as for the Chan'ao Ge (CA.31).

yi: 子孙发动、妻财交动，是要还俗的汉子；
世空、身旺，是地上的行仙；
身空而不动，事事都是道；
应旺而没有魔，处处都是禅；
en: Output moving and Wealth also moving: a man who will return to lay life;
the Self void and the Body strong, an earth-wandering immortal;
the Body void and still, every single thing is the Way;
the Other strong with no demon, Chan is everywhere;

yi: 应落偶位、世持住，又生又合，
精神清明、身体安静，寿命绵长。
忽然有负债纠结、财和身一起发动，
免不了要偿还俗世的债和冤。
en: the Other on an even place and the Self holding, generating and combining,
the spirit clear and the body at peace, life is long.
If suddenly there is a debt-knot and Wealth and the Body move,
one cannot avoid paying back worldly debts and grievances.

yi: 世、应不和，身又乱动，
想了身达命，要等到驴年。
本身、太岁落在身和命上，
当天就遇上神人，得到真传。
en: Self and Other at odds and the Body moving wildly,
to finish with the body and reach one's destiny, wait for the Year of the Donkey.
the person himself and Tai Sui on the Body and one's fate,
on that very day one meets a divine person and receives the true transmission.

yi: 太岁、火神加在父母上，
天边的恩命一定会来宣布。
问我最后这件天机之事，
拈起笔来，画一个圈。
en: Tai Sui and the Fire spirit added to Resource,
a favour commanded from the edge of heaven will surely be proclaimed.
If you ask me about this last matter of heaven's secret,
I take up my brush and draw a circle.

title: 儒业章·功名仕途：青龙持世功名大、天喜同官道业亨、朱雀并财宜作馆；世应和身旺上书献策必成、日辰龙德生旺县宰州官力主盟；禄马贵人临月建公侯任责；朝君忌屯蹇、面圣宜晋升、天符持木高迁重任禄光荣

rule.yi: 青龙持世，功名大；天喜同官，道业亨通；朱雀并财，宜开馆；勾陈同鬼，不要出游。世、应既和睦、身又旺，上书献策必定能成；日辰、龙德都得生旺，县令、州官会出力相助。禄、马、贵人落在月建上，公侯担任重责，官职不轻；天符值土，应当没有阻碍；月建持金，必有惊恐。父母最宜逢六合，世、身切忌犯三刑；刑、杀克身又克世，会陷身受辱、耽误一生。朝见君主，不可遇上屯、蹇；面圣偏适宜见到晋、升；更何况天符持木德，高升、担重任，俸禄光荣。
rule.en: With the Azure Dragon holding the Self, fame and rank are great; with the Joy star together with the office, the Way and its work go through; the Vermilion Bird joined to Wealth suits opening a school; Hook Earth with Pressure, do not go travelling about. With the Self and the Other in accord and the Body strong as well, submitting a memorial or a plan is sure to be accomplished; with the Day and Dragon Virtue both born and strong, the county magistrate and prefect will lend their strength. With the Emolument, the Horse and the Noble standing on the Month, dukes and marquises bear heavy charge and the post is weighty; with the Year Tally on Earth there is probably no hindrance; with the Month holding Metal there is sure to be fright. Resource is best meeting the six combinations, and the Self and the Body must avoid the three punishments; punishment and baleful spirits controlling the Body and the Self, one falls into disgrace and ruins one's life. To attend the sovereign one must not meet Zhun or Jian; to face the sage ruler it suits meeting Jin or Sheng; and moreover the Year Tally holding Wood virtue, there is high promotion, heavy charge and glorious emolument.

note.yi: 儒业章前半（「凡占儒业究诸身……」到「青龙持世功名大」之前）讲读书、学业、功名，归考试一类，这里不收；从「青龙持世功名大」起，讲到上书、县宰州官、公侯任责、朝君面圣、高迁重任，是仕途，收在这里。「天符」是年建（见 ZSZ.08）。
note.en: The first part of the chapter on the scholar's calling (from 'in divining the scholar's calling, examine the Body' up to the line before 'with the Azure Dragon holding the Self, fame and rank are great') speaks of study, learning and examination success and is for the examination domain, not taken here; from 'with the Azure Dragon holding the Self' on it speaks of memorials, magistrates and prefects, dukes and marquises, attending and facing the sovereign and high promotion, which is a career in office and is taken here. The 'Year Tally' is the year branch (see ZSZ.08).

yi: 青龙持世，功名大；
天喜同官，道业亨通；
朱雀并财，宜开馆；
勾陈同鬼，不要出游行走。
en: With the Azure Dragon holding the Self, fame and rank are great;
with the Joy star together with the office, the Way and its work go through;
the Vermilion Bird joined to Wealth suits opening a school;
Hook Earth with Pressure, do not go travelling about.

yi: 世、应既然和睦、身又旺，
上书献策，必定能图谋成功；
日辰、龙德都得生旺，
县令、州官会出力主盟。
en: With the Self and the Other in accord and the Body strong as well,
submitting a memorial or a plan is sure to be accomplished;
with the Day and Dragon Virtue both born and strong,
