the county magistrate and prefect will lend their strength and take the lead.

yi: 禄、马、贵人落在月建上，
公侯担任重责，官职不轻；
天符值土，应当没有阻碍；
月建持金，必有惊恐。
en: With the Emolument, the Horse and the Noble standing on the Month,
dukes and marquises bear heavy charge and the post is weighty;
with the Year Tally on Earth there is probably no hindrance;
with the Month holding Metal there is sure to be fright.

yi: 父母最适宜遇上六合；
世、身切忌犯三刑；
刑、杀克身又克世，
就会陷身受辱，耽误一生。
en: Resource is best meeting the six combinations;
the Self and the Body must avoid the three punishments;
punishment and baleful spirits controlling the Body and the Self,
one falls into disgrace and ruins one's life.

yi: 朝见君主，不可遇上屯、蹇；
面见圣上偏适宜遇到晋、升；
更何况天符持木德，
高升、担重任，俸禄光荣。
en: To attend the sovereign one must not meet Zhun or Jian;
to face the sage ruler it suits meeting Jin or Sheng;
and moreover the Year Tally holding Wood virtue,
there is high promotion, heavy charge and glorious emolument.

title: 六位例·仕宦、占事、转官、僧道：六爻到初爻各主什么——仕宦（隐逸、王公、诸侯、大夫、士人、庶民）；占事（国事、心事、官事、家事、身事、人事）；转官（任所、宣命、差遣、保举、己身、解由）；僧道（祖师、师父、檀越、法眷、己身、徒弟）

rule.yi: 六位例按六爻到初爻的次序列各行：仕宦——六爻隐逸、五爻王公、四爻诸侯、三爻大夫、二爻士人、初爻庶民；占事——六爻国事、五爻心事、四爻官事、三爻家事、二爻身事、初爻人事；转官——六爻任所、五爻宣命、四爻差遣、三爻保举、二爻己身、初爻解由；僧道——六爻祖师、五爻师父、四爻檀越、三爻法眷、二爻己身、初爻徒弟。
rule.en: The table of the positions of the six lines lists each row in order from the sixth line down to the first: official careers: the sixth line the recluse, the fifth princes and dukes, the fourth feudal lords, the third grandees, the second scholars, the first commoners; matters divined: the sixth the state, the fifth the heart, the fourth officials, the third the household, the second oneself, the first dealings with people; transfer of office: the sixth the place of the post, the fifth the proclaimed commission, the fourth the assignment, the third the sponsorship, the second oneself, the first the discharge; monks and Daoists: the sixth the patriarch, the fifth the master, the fourth the donor, the third the Dharma kin, the second oneself, the first the disciple.

dispute.yi: 「占事」一行，周易尚占的六位例是：六爻国事、五爻心事、四爻官事、三爻家事、二爻身事、初爻人事；断易天机的「鬼谷辨爻法·占求事」是：初心事、二身事、三家事、四人事、五官事、六国事。国事（六）、家事（三）、身事（二）两处位置相同，心事、官事、人事的位置不同：心事一个在五爻、一个在初爻，官事一个在四爻、一个在五爻，人事一个在初爻、一个在四爻。两书都没有解释，本库各照原书录，不裁定。另外，「仕宦」一行是按王公、诸侯、大夫的等级排的，断易天机的「占仕宦」（初吏人、二曹官、三长官、四监司、五朝仕、六执政）是按官署的层级排的，是两种分法。
dispute.en: On the row for matters divined, the table of the Zhouyi Shangzhan reads: the sixth line the state, the fifth the heart, the fourth officials, the third the household, the second oneself, the first dealings with people; the Duanyi Tianji's 'Guigu method for divining an undertaking' reads: the first the heart, the second oneself, the third the household, the fourth dealings with people, the fifth officials, the sixth the state. The state (sixth), household (third) and oneself (second) stand in the same places, while the heart, officials and dealings with people differ: the heart is on the fifth in one and the first in the other, officials on the fourth in one and the fifth in the other, and dealings with people on the first in one and the fourth in the other. Neither book explains it, and each is recorded as it stands, without adjudication. The row for official careers is ordered by the rank of princes, dukes and grandees, while the Duanyi Tianji's 'divining official careers' (first clerk, second bureau officer, third head of office, fourth supervising commissioner, fifth court official, sixth minister in power) is ordered by the levels of the offices; these are two different schemes.

note.yi: 这是一张表，原书把每一行排成「标题 + 六格」，六格依次对应六爻、五爻、四爻、三爻、二爻、初爻（第一行「横看」给出了这个次序）。
note.en: This is a table, which the book sets out as a heading and six cells, the six cells corresponding in order to the sixth, fifth, fourth, third, second and first lines (the first row, 'read across', gives this order).

yi: 横着看
第六爻（最上）
第五爻
第四爻
第三爻
第二爻
第一爻（最下）
en: Read across:
the sixth line (top),
the fifth line,
the fourth,
the third,
the second,
the first (bottom).

yi: 仕途做官
隐居不仕的人
王和公
分封的诸侯
大夫（高级官员）
读书的士人
平民百姓
en: Official careers:
the recluse,
princes and dukes,
feudal lords,
grandees,
scholars,
commoners.

yi: 占问的事类
国家的事

title: 八卦法用例·君臣、人事、各业、寻访、转官：乾坤震巽坎离艮兑各主什么——君臣（王公、宰相、诸侯、大夫、公吏、士人、庶民、伶伦）；转官（朝廷、任所、差遣、宣命、印绶、保明、复任、解田）等

rule.yi: 八卦法用例里和事业有关的几行，按乾、坤、震、巽、坎、离、艮、兑的次序：君臣——王公、宰相、诸侯、大夫、公吏、士人、庶民、伶伦；人事——官事、家事、身事、公事、忧事、心事、闲事、喜事；各业——士、农、工、商、武、文、医、卜；寻访——贵人、主人、客人、行人、吏人、士人、商人、匠人；转官——朝廷、任所、差遣、宣命、印绶、保明、复任、解田。
rule.en: The rows of the 'uses of the eight trigrams' bearing on careers, in the order Qian, Kun, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Li, Gen, Dui: lord and ministers: prince and duke, chancellor, feudal lord, grandee, public clerk, scholar, commoner, musician; human affairs: officials, household, oneself, public business, worries, the heart, idle matters, joyful matters; trades: scholar, farmer, artisan, merchant, soldier, literary man, doctor, diviner; seeking and visiting: the noble, the host, the guest, the traveller, the clerk, the scholar, the merchant, the craftsman; transfer of office: the court, the place of the post, the assignment, the proclaimed commission, the seal and ribbon, the certification, reinstatement, discharge.

note.yi: 这是一张表，每一行是「标题 + 八格」，八格依次对应乾、坤、震、巽、坎、离、艮、兑。「转官」一行最后一格「解田」，六位例的「转官」行里相应的是「解由」（离任的文书），「解田」疑是「解由」之误。
note.en: This is a table, each row being a heading and eight cells corresponding in order to Qian, Kun, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Li, Gen and Dui. The last cell of the 'transfer of office' row, 'jietian', corresponds in the 'transfer of office' row of the table of the six positions to 'jieyou' (the certificate of discharge), and 'jietian' is probably a slip for it.

chapter: 十八论·一、用神分类定例
title: 十八论·用神分类定例：考试里要看的人和物各有各的用神——功名官府取官鬼，师长、文章、馆室取父母，门生取子孙，结盟同寅和知交朋友取兄弟

rule.yi: 考试这件事里，先要定下来看哪一爻：问功名（考中、做官），用神是官鬼爻；问老师、文章、奏章、读书的馆舍，用神是父母爻；问学生（门生），用神是子孙爻；问结拜兄弟、同僚和知交朋友，用神是兄弟爻。
rule.en: In an examination reading one first settles which line to watch: for success in the examinations and in office the Subject is the Pressure line; for a teacher, an essay, a memorial or the study hall the Subject is the Resource line; for pupils the Subject is the Output line; for sworn brothers, colleagues and close friends the Subject is the Peer line.

note.yi: 同一节原文还把嫂子、弟媳、妻妾、朋友的妻妾和仆婢、物价、钱财、珠宝、金银、仓库、钱粮、杂物、器皿和天晴都归给妻财爻，考试里用不上，这里没有收；妻财爻在考试里是父母（文章）的克神，见 LY.EXAM.HJC.17。
note.en: The same section also gives sisters-in-law, wives and concubines, the wives, concubines and servants of friends, prices, money, jewels, gold and silver, treasuries, stores, miscellaneous goods, utensils and clear weather to the Wealth line; none of this is used in examinations and it is not included. In an examination the Wealth line is the controller of the Resource line (the essay): see LY.EXAM.HJC.17.

zh: 凡占功名、官府、雷电、鬼神、丈夫、夫之兄弟同辈及夫之相与朋友，乱臣、盗贼、邪祟、忧疑、病症、尸首、逆风，俱以官鬼爻为用神。
yi: 凡是占问功名、官府、雷电、鬼神、丈夫、丈夫的同辈兄弟和丈夫相交的朋友，以及乱臣、盗贼、邪祟、忧虑疑难、病症、尸首、逆风，全都以官鬼爻为用神。
en: Whenever one asks about success in the examinations and in office, government offices, thunder and lightning, ghosts and spirits, a husband, the brothers of the husband's own generation and the friends he keeps, or about rebellious ministers, thieves and bandits, evil hauntings, worry and doubt, illness, a corpse or an adverse wind, the Pressure line is in every case the Subject.

zh: 凡占祖父母、父母、师长、家主、伯叔、姑姨，与我父母同辈与父母年若之亲友，及墙城、宅舍、舟车、衣服、雨具、求雨、细布、毡货、章奏、文章、馆室，俱以父母爻为用神。
yi: 凡是占问祖父母、父母、老师、一家之主、伯叔、姑姨，以及和我父母同辈、年纪和我父母相当的亲友，还有城墙、住宅、船车、衣服、雨具、求雨、细布、毡货、奏章、文章、馆舍，全都以父母爻为用神。
en: Whenever one asks about grandparents, parents, teachers, the head of the household, paternal uncles, aunts, and relatives and friends of my parents' own generation and age, or about city walls, dwellings, boats and carts, clothing, rain gear, praying for rain, fine cloth, felt goods, memorials to the throne, essays or a lodging hall, the Resource line is in every case the Subject.

zh: 凡占儿、女、孙、侄、女婿、门生、忠臣、良将、药材、僧、道、六畜、禽鸟、顺风、解忧避祸，及问天时日月星斗，俱以子孙爻为用神。
yi: 凡是占问儿子、女儿、孙辈、侄辈、女婿、门生、忠臣、良将、药材、僧人、道士、六畜、禽鸟、顺风、解忧避祸，以及问天气里的日月星斗，全都以子孙爻为用神。
en: Whenever one asks about sons, daughters, grandchildren, nephews and nieces, a son-in-law, disciples, loyal ministers, good generals, medicinal herbs, monks, Daoists, the six domestic animals, birds, a following wind, or dispelling worry and avoiding misfortune, or about the weather, the sun, moon, stars and constellations, the Output line is in every case the Subject.

zh: 凡占兄弟姊妹、姊妹丈夫、妻之兄弟、世兄弟、结盟同寅及知交朋友，俱以兄弟爻为用神。
yi: 凡是占问兄弟姊妹、姊妹的丈夫、妻子的兄弟、世交的兄弟、结盟的同僚和知交朋友，全都以兄弟爻为用神。
en: Whenever one asks about brothers and sisters, a sister's husband, a wife's brothers, brothers by old family ties, sworn colleagues and close friends, the Peer line is in every case the Subject.

chapter: 启蒙节要·四十六、六亲发动诀
title: 启蒙节要·六亲发动诀·父母发动：父动当头克子孙，士人科举登金榜

rule.yi: 父母爻（文书）发动，当头克制子孙时，读书人应科举能登上金榜。同一诀里还说，父母发动时，等远行的人、盼书信会有动静；打官司下状子，先把是非分清；失物、逃亡要靠告状评理才能了结。
rule.en: When the Resource line (the document line) moves and squarely controls Output, a scholar sitting the civil examinations is placed on the golden list. The same verse adds that with Resource moving, a traveller or a letter being waited for shows movement, a plaint filed in a lawsuit first sorts out right from wrong, and lost goods or a runaway have to be pleaded for in court.

note.yi: 这一诀中间三句（病人无药、婚姻子息、买卖劳心）说的是别的事，这里没有收。
note.en: The three lines in the middle of this verse (the sick without medicine, marriage and offspring, trade that wears out the mind) speak of other matters and are not included here.

yi: 父母爻发动，当头克制子孙，
en: Resource moving and squarely controlling Output,

yi: 等候远行的人、盼书信，都有动静；
说到官司，下状子，先把是非分清；
读书人应科举，登上金榜；
失物、逃亡，要靠告状评理。
en: for a traveller or a letter being waited for, there is movement;
in a lawsuit, when the plaint is filed, right and wrong are sorted out first;
a scholar sitting the civil examinations is placed on the golden list;
for lost goods or a runaway, one must plead the case in court.

chapter: 启蒙节要·四十六、六亲发动诀
title: 启蒙节要·六亲发动诀·子孙发动：子孙发动伤官鬼，谒贵求名休进用，劝君守分听乎天

rule.yi: 子孙爻发动，会伤官鬼；这时拜见贵人、求功名都不宜往前进取，诀劝人守住本分、听凭天意。同一诀里，子孙发动对别的事是吉的：病人求医就痊愈，出门人和做买卖的平安，婚姻美满，产妇生子好养，官司私下和解不到官府。
rule.en: When the Output line moves it wounds Pressure; then calling on a patron or seeking a title should not press forward, and the verse urges one to keep to one's lot and leave it to Heaven. The same verse treats a moving Output as good for other matters: the sick who seek a physician recover, travellers and traders are safe, a marriage is a happy one, a woman in labour bears a child easy to rear, and a lawsuit is settled privately without reaching the court.

note.yi: 诀的中间三句（病人求医、出门做买卖、婚姻）说的是别的事，这里没有收。
note.en: The three lines in the middle of this verse (the sick who seek a physician, travelling and trade, marriage) speak of other matters and are not included here.

yi: 子孙爻发动，伤了官鬼，
en: Output moving and wounding Pressure,

yi: 产妇临产，生下的孩子好养；
官司私下和解，不到官府；
拜见贵人、求功名，不要进取；
劝你守住本分，听凭天意。
en: a woman in childbirth bears a child easy to rear;
a lawsuit is settled privately and does not reach the court;
calling on a patron and seeking a title should not press forward;
I urge you to keep to your lot and leave it to Heaven.

chapter: 启蒙节要·四十六、六亲发动诀
title: 启蒙节要·六亲发动诀·财爻发动：财爻发动克文书，应举求名总是虚

rule.yi: 财爻发动，克住父母文书：应考、求名总是落空。同一诀里，财动对别的事是吉的：拿本钱经营大吉，亲戚婚姻如意。
rule.en: When the Wealth line moves and controls the document line, sitting the examinations and seeking a title all come to nothing. The same verse says a moving Wealth line is good elsewhere: trading with capital is greatly auspicious and marriages and family ties go as one wishes.

note.yi: 诀文说的是财克父母文书的一般情形。《黄金策》另讲了一种例外：父母爻空亡，而财爻发动生扶官鬼，侥幸可以成（LY.EXAM.HJC.24）。
note.en: The verse speaks of the usual case of Wealth controlling the Resource line (the document line). The Huangjin Ce gives one exception: when the Resource line is Void and the Wealth line moves to give life and support to Pressure, one may succeed by luck (LY.EXAM.HJC.24).

yi: 财爻发动，克住文书，
应考、求名，总是落空；
拿本钱去经营，大吉；
亲戚婚姻如意，快乐无忧。
en: The Wealth line moves and controls the document line:
sitting the examinations and seeking a title always come to nothing;
trading with capital is greatly auspicious;
marriages and family ties go as one wishes, glad and free of worry.

chapter: 启蒙节要·四十六、六亲发动诀
title: 启蒙节要·六亲发动诀·兄弟交重克财：应举夺标为忌客，官非阴贼耗钱财

rule.yi: 兄弟爻发动、克住财爻时：病人难好，灾还没有走；应举时，同来夺魁首的人是最要提防的客人；官司和暗中的盗贼会耗损钱财。
rule.en: When the Peer line moves and controls Wealth: the sick are hard to cure and the calamity has not left; in sitting the examinations, those who contend for the top place are the guests most to be avoided; and lawsuits and secret thieves waste money.

dispute.yi: 诀文把兄弟发动克财看成应举的大忌。《增删卜易》（LY.EXAM.ZS.28）却说兄爻持世或发动不是一概不吉：财、父两爻都动时，兄动制住财反而是喜；父、官两动时，喜兄弟持世。《黄金策》（LY.EXAM.HJC.18）和这句诀一致，把兄弟看成同经的竞争者，必夺魁首。
dispute.en: The verse makes a moving Peer line that controls Wealth a great taboo for sitting the examinations. The Zengshan Buyi (LY.EXAM.ZS.28) says that Peer holding the Self or moving is not ill throughout: when Wealth and Resource both move, Peer moving to control Wealth is on the contrary welcome, and when Resource and Pressure both move, Peer holding the Self is welcome. The Huangjin Ce (LY.EXAM.HJC.18) agrees with this verse in treating Peer as rivals who share one's classic and will snatch first place.

yi: 兄弟爻发动，克了财，
病人难好，灾还没有走；
应举时，夺魁的人是要忌的客人；
官司和暗中的盗贼，耗损钱财。
en: The Peer line moves and controls Wealth:
the sick are hard to cure and the calamity has not left;
in sitting the examinations, those who contend for the top place are the guests to be avoided;
lawsuits and secret thieves waste money.

chapter: 启蒙节要·三十三、诸爻持世诀
title: 启蒙节要·诸爻持世诀·考试三句：父母持世，官动财旺宜赴试；子孙持世，求名切忌；鬼爻持世，功名最喜世当权

rule.yi: 诸爻持世诀里和考试有关的三句：父母爻持世，官爻发动、财爻旺相，适合去赴考；子孙爻持世，求名最忌（子孙坐在世位上）；官鬼爻持世，别的事难安，只有求功名最喜欢世爻当权。
rule.en: Three lines of the verse on lines holding the Self bear on examinations: with Resource holding the Self, if Pressure moves and Wealth is strong it is a good time to go and sit the examination; with Output holding the Self, seeking a title above all should avoid it; with Pressure holding the Self, other matters are uneasy, but for success in the examinations the best thing is that the Self holds power.

note.yi: 诀文没有解释「官动财旺」为什么宜赴试；读的时候要和「财爻发动克文书，应举求名总是虚」（LY.EXAM.BSZZ.04）分开看：这里的前提是父母爻持世、官爻发动，那一句只说财动克文书。引文里夹着的求嗣、谋利、占身、失脱几句说的是别的事，因为引文要连着引、中间不能断，所以留在了里面。
note.en: The verse does not explain why Pressure moving and Wealth strong should be fit for sitting the examination. Read it apart from "Wealth moves and controls the document line, so sitting exams and seeking a title all come to nothing" (LY.EXAM.BSZZ.04): the premise here is Resource holding the Self with Pressure moving, whereas that line speaks only of Wealth moving against the document line. The clauses about heirs, profit, the body and loss that sit inside the quotations are other matters; they are kept because each quotation must run on without a gap.

yi: 父母爻持世，主身体劳碌，
求子嗣的，妾再多也难招来；
官爻发动、财爻旺相，宜去赴考；
财爻发动，谋利的不要心焦；
en: Resource holding the Self means toil of the body;
one seeking an heir will find it hard to draw one, however many concubines there are;
when Pressure moves and Wealth is strong, it is fit to go and sit the examination;
when Wealth moves, one seeking profit need not be anxious;

yi: 子孙爻持世，事情无忧，
只有求名，切忌它坐在当头的世位上；
en: Output holding the Self, matters are free of worry;
only in seeking a title must one avoid its sitting at the head;

yi: 官鬼爻持世，事情难安，
占自身，即使不生病也要遭官非；
财物时时担忧失脱；
求功名，最喜世爻当权。
en: Pressure holding the Self, matters are uneasy;
in divining for oneself, even without illness one meets an official suit;
goods and money are always at risk of loss;
but in seeking success in the examinations, the best thing is that the Self holds power.

chapter: 十八问答·第十问·进神喜忌
title: 十八问答·第十问·进神喜忌：吉神宜化进、忌神宜化退；进有三种（旺相乘势、休囚待时、逢空破冲合待期），退也有三种；例：乡试官星持世，第五爻官化进神，今秋中式、次年辰年联捷

rule.yi: 动爻变出来的神有进神、退神，吉凶要分喜忌：吉神喜欢化进神，忌神喜欢化退神。进有三种：旺相的趁势就进；休囚的等到得时才进；动爻或变爻有一个遇到空、破、冲、合的，等到填补、合住、冲开的时候才进。退也有三种：旺相的有日月或动爻生扶，占近期的事暂时不退；休囚的当时就退；动变爻有一个遇空破冲合的，等到那个时候填补、合冲了才退。书中例：申月癸卯日占乡试，得恒之大过卦，酉金官星持世，日辰冲而暗动，又得第五爻官化进神拱扶，断为不但今秋中举，来春也定占鳌头；结果登了乡榜，第二年辰年连中——「化进神」应在今秋，「联捷」应在辰年冲而逢合。
rule.en: The spirits that come out of a moving line when it changes are Advancing and Retreating spirits, and their luck divides into the welcome and the feared: an auspicious spirit is glad to change into an Advancing spirit, and an Adversary is glad to change into a Retreating spirit. There are three ways of advancing: a strong spirit advances by riding its momentum; a resting or trapped one advances by waiting for its season; and if the moving line or the changed line meets Void, break, clash or combination, it advances by waiting for the period that fills, combines or clashes it. There are also three ways of retreating: a strong spirit given life and support by the Day, the Month or a moving line does not retreat for the time being when a near matter is divined; a resting or trapped one retreats at once; and if the moving line or the changed line meets Void, break, clash or combination, it retreats when the period comes that fills, combines or clashes it. The case in the book: on a Gui-Mao day in the Shen month a man divined the provincial examination and got Heng changing to Daguo; the Pressure star in You Metal held the Self and was stirred in secret by the clash of the Day, and the fifth line's Pressure changing into an Advancing spirit supported it, so the judgement was that not only would he pass in the autumn but next spring he would surely take first place; he made the provincial list and succeeded again in the Chen year after: the change into an Advancing spirit answered in this autumn, and the consecutive success answered in the Chen year, a clash that meets a combination.

note.yi: 卦例的卦图（恒卦变大过卦的六爻排列）不收，只收卦图前后的文字。「折桂」指乡试中举（乡试在秋天，榜叫桂榜），「占鳌头」指在更高一级的考试里名列第一，「联捷」指一场接一场连续考中；这是科举里通行的说法，不是本书给的定义。
note.en: The case's hexagram diagram (the arrangement of the six lines of Heng changing to Daguo) is not included, only the text before and after it. "Breaking the laurel" means passing the provincial examination (held in autumn, with its list called the laurel list), "taking the head of the sea-turtle" means coming first in a higher round, and "consecutive success" means passing round after round in a row; these are common examination idioms, not definitions given in this book.

zh: 第十问：进退神乃动爻变出之神也，吉凶祸福有喜忌之分，何以论之？
答曰：吉神宜于化进，忌神宜于化退。
而进退之法有三：旺相者乘势而进一也；
动爻变爻有一而逢空破冲合者，待期填补合冲而进三也。
退神之法亦有三：旺相者或有日月动爻生扶，占近事暂时而不退者一也；
动爻变爻有一而逢空破冲合者，待期填补合冲而退三也。
yi: 第十问：进神、退神是动爻变出来的神，吉凶祸福有喜有忌之分，怎么论呢？
回答说：吉神宜于化进，忌神宜于化退。
进退的法则有三种：旺相的趁着势头进，是第一种；
休囚的等到得时才进，是第二种；
动爻、变爻有一个遇到空、破、冲、合的，等到填补、合住、冲开的时候才进，是第三种。
退神的法则也有三种：旺相的，有日月或动爻生扶，占近期的事暂时不退，是第一种；
休囚的当时就退，是第二种；
动爻、变爻有一个遇到空、破、冲、合的，等到填补、合住、冲开的时候才退，是第三种。
en: Question 10: the Advancing and Retreating spirits are the spirits that come out of a moving line when it changes; their luck and misfortune divide into the welcome and the feared; how are they judged?
Answer: an auspicious spirit is glad to change into an Advancing spirit, and an Adversary is glad to change into a Retreating spirit.
The ways of advancing and retreating are three; a strong spirit advances by riding its momentum, which is the first;
a resting or trapped one advances by waiting for its season, which is the second;
if either the moving line or the changed line meets Void, break, clash or combination, it advances by waiting for the period that fills, combines or clashes it, which is the third.

The ways of the Retreating spirit are also three: a strong one, given life and support by the Day, the Month or a moving line, does not retreat for the time being when a near matter is divined, which is the first;
a resting or trapped one retreats at once, which is the second;
if either the moving line or the changed line meets Void, break, clash or combination, it retreats when the period comes that fills, combines or clashes it, which is the third.

zh: 申月癸卯日占乡试，得恒之大过卦：
yi: 申月癸卯日占乡试，得恒卦变大过卦：
en: In the Shen month, on a Gui-Mao day, a man divined the provincial examination and got the hexagram Heng changing to Daguo:

zh: 断曰：酉金官星持世，日冲暗动，又得第五爻官化进神拱扶，不独金秋折桂，来春定占鳌头。
果登乡榜，即于次岁辰年联捷。
盖化进神者，今秋也，联捷者，辰年冲而逢合也。
yi: 断语：酉金官星持世，日辰冲而暗动，又得第五爻官爻化进神拱扶，不但金秋折桂，来春也一定占鳌头。
果然登上乡榜，第二年辰年连中进士。
因为化进神，应在今年秋天；连中，应在辰年冲而逢合。
en: Judgement: the Pressure star in You Metal holds the Self and is stirred in secret by the clash of the Day, and it gains the support of the fifth line, Pressure changing into an Advancing spirit; not only will he break the laurel in the golden autumn, but next spring he will surely take first place.
He indeed made the provincial list, and in the following year, the Chen year, he succeeded again in the next round.
For the change into an Advancing spirit answered in this autumn, and the consecutive success answered in the Chen year, a clash that meets a combination.

chapter: 十八问答·第十三问·六冲六合
title: 十八问答·第十三问·六冲六合：所恶宜冲、所好宜合；冲中逢合、合处逢冲分日辰与变爻；冲忌神合用神为去煞留恩，冲用神合忌神为留煞害命；例：会试未土持世，化出日辰午火官星生合，果中探花

rule.yi: 六冲、六合怎么断：人所厌恶的事宜冲，所喜欢的事宜合，只有占病要分近病、久病：近病遇冲就好、久病遇冲就死，六合则相反。六冲卦里，有日辰相合、变爻相合的，叫冲中逢合；六合卦里，有日辰相冲、变爻相冲的，叫合处逢冲。冲掉忌神、合住用神，叫去煞留恩，事事说吉；冲掉用神、合住忌神，叫留煞害命，件件皆凶。书中例：辰月庚午日占会试，得观卦变否卦，未土持世，变出的午火官星正是日辰，生着合着世爻，断为「鼎甲在掌」，结果中了探花。
rule.en: How the Six-Clash and Six-Combine hexagrams are judged: what a person hates is better clashed and what he likes is better combined, and only in divining illness is there the distinction between a recent and a long illness: a recent illness that meets a clash is cured, a long one dies, and with a combination it is the reverse. In a Six-Clash hexagram, if the Day or the changed line combines with it, it is called a clash meeting a combination; in a Six-Combine hexagram, if the Day or the changed line clashes with it, it is called a combination meeting a clash. If the Adversary is clashed and the Subject combined, it is called removing the baleful and keeping the gracious and every matter is called lucky; if the Subject is clashed and the Adversary combined, it is called keeping the baleful to harm life and every matter is ill. The case in the book: on a Geng-Wu day in the Chen month a man divined the metropolitan examination and got Guan changing to Pi; Wei Earth held the Self and changed out into the Wu Fire Pressure star, which is the Day itself, giving it life and combining with it, so the judgement was that the top three places lay in the palm of his hand, and he indeed passed as Tanhua.

note.yi: 卦例原文作「辰日庚午日占会试」，第一个「日」疑为「月」之误（辰月庚午日），译文按「辰月」翻；卦图不收。按通行说法，「鼎甲」是殿试一甲的前三名（状元、榜眼、探花），「探花」是第三名。功名里六冲、六合的取法，《黄金策》说六冲难成、六合易得（LY.EXAM.HJC.37），《增删卜易》补上了官、父、世要旺才行（LY.EXAM.ZS.36）。合处逢冲、冲中逢合三种分法，婚姻里的同一条见 LY.MARRY.BSZZ.02。
note.en: The case text reads "Chen day, Geng-Wu day"; the first "day" is probably a slip for "month" (a Geng-Wu day in the Chen month), and the translation follows that; the hexagram diagram is not included. By the usual reckoning the "top three" are the first three places of the palace examination (Zhuangyuan, Bangyan, Tanhua), and Tanhua is third. For examinations, the Huangjin Ce says a Six-Clash hexagram is hard to succeed and a Six-Combine one easy (LY.EXAM.HJC.37), and the Zengshan Buyi adds that Pressure, Resource and the Self must also be strong (LY.EXAM.ZS.36). The same threefold division of a combination meeting a clash is given for marriage at LY.MARRY.BSZZ.02.

zh: 第十三问，六冲六合何以断之？
答曰：人之所恶者宜冲，所好者宜合，唯占病有近病久病论。
近病逢冲即愈，久病逢冲即死，六合反是。
凡六冲卦，有日辰相合、变爻相合，谓之冲中逢合；
凡六合卦，有日辰相冲，变爻相冲，谓之合处逢冲。
如冲忌神合用神，名为去煞留恩，般般云吉；
冲用神合忌神，名为留煞害命，件件皆凶。
yi: 第十三问：六冲、六合怎么断？
回答说：人所厌恶的宜冲，所喜好的宜合；只有占病，要分近病和久病来论。
近病遇冲就好，久病遇冲就死，六合则相反。
凡六冲卦，有日辰相合、变爻相合的，叫冲中逢合；
凡六合卦，有日辰相冲、变爻相冲的，叫合处逢冲。
如果冲掉忌神、合住用神，名叫去煞留恩，事事说吉；
冲掉用神、合住忌神，名叫留煞害命，件件都凶。
en: Question 13: how are the Six-Clash and Six-Combine hexagrams to be judged?
Answer: what a person hates is better clashed and what he likes is better combined; only in divining illness is there the distinction between a recent and a long illness.
A recent illness that meets a clash is cured at once, a long illness that meets a clash dies, and with a combination it is the reverse.
In any Six-Clash hexagram, if the Day combines with it or the changed line combines with it, it is called a clash meeting a combination;
in any Six-Combine hexagram, if the Day clashes with it or the changed line clashes with it, it is called a combination meeting a clash.
If the Adversary is clashed and the Subject combined, it is called removing the baleful and keeping the gracious, and every matter is called lucky;
if the Subject is clashed and the Adversary combined, it is called keeping the baleful to harm life, and every matter is ill.

zh: 辰日庚午日占会试，得观之否卦：
yi: 辰月庚午日占会试，得观卦变否卦：
en: In the Chen month, on a Geng-Wu day, a man divined the metropolitan examination and got the hexagram Guan changing to Pi:

zh: 断曰：未土持世，化出日辰午火官星生合，鼎甲在掌。
yi: 断语：未土持世，变出日辰午火官星，生着合着世爻，鼎甲稳在手中。
果然中了探花。
en: Judgement: Wei Earth holds the Self and changes out into the Wu Fire Pressure star, which is the Day itself, giving it life and combining with it; the top three places lie in the palm of his hand.
He indeed passed as Tanhua.

chapter: 十八问答·第十八问·诚明不验
title: 十八问答·第十八问·诚明不验：占的人心诚、断的人精明仍有不验，缘故在占的人——事涉机密难对人说，或问的是这件、心里想的是那件；例：问家宅实为乡试功名（自己头场落榜、业师中第四名），十二岁的孩子被父命占功名实为父占子（父动克子而亡）

rule.yi: 占的人心诚、断的人精明，有时仍然不验，缘故在占的人，不在断的人：占的人的心意虽然诚，但有的事是机密，难对人说，或者问的是这件事，心里真正想的却是另一件事，所以才有不验。书中例一：申月乙亥日「占家宅」得井卦变节卦，断为应爻临父母、必有外姓长者同住，内卦合成鬼局、宅内不安，兄弟月破伏藏、兄弟家不利，对方一句句说没有，最后才说，占家宅其实是想和家里的老师一同去赴乡试；王洪绪说功名和家宅天远地隔，功名以官鬼为官星，家宅以鬼为祸害，既然占功名，你的功名不许，你的老师必定高中——官局生应、不来生世，叫出现无情，与你无干；后来到八月酉金实空之月，他自己头场就被贴出，他的老师中了第四名。例二：午月辛酉日占功名，得萃卦变遁卦，是一个十二岁的孩子，父亲命他占功名；若按孩子自占，官爻持世、夏火当令、未土父母爻是文章又化进神，功名有望，谁知是父亲叫孩子占，这个心意发自父亲的诚，所以是父占子，父母爻发动来克子孙，未月戌日孩子就去世了。
rule.en: When the one who divines is sincere and the one who judges is shrewd, the result is sometimes still not borne out, and the cause lies in the one who divines, not the one who judges: however sincere his intent, the matter may be a secret that is hard to tell anyone, or he asks about one thing while his mind is really on another, and so it fails to come true. First case: in the Shen month, on a Yi-Hai day, a man divined "the household" and got Jing changing to Jie; the judgement was that the Other line sat in the second line carrying Resource, so an elder of another surname must be living with them, that the inner trigram combined into a Pressure frame, so the house was uneasy, and that Peer was Month-broken and hidden, so the brothers' family was unlucky; he denied each point in turn and at last said that he had divined the household but really wanted to go to the provincial examination together with the tutor of his family; Wang Hongxu replied that examination success and the household are as far apart as heaven and earth, that for examination success Pressure is the official star while for the household Pressure is calamity, and that since it was examination success that was asked, his own was not promised and his tutor would surely pass high: the Pressure frame gave life to the Other and not to the Self, which is called appearing without feeling and has nothing to do with him; later, in the eighth month, when the Void You Metal was filled, he himself was struck off in the first session and his tutor passed as number four. Second case: in the Wu month, on a Xin-You day, a twelve-year-old boy, ordered by his father to divine his examination prospects, got Cui changing to Dun; judging it as the boy's own divination, Pressure held the Self, Fire was in command in summer and Wei Earth, the Resource line, was the essay and changed into an Advancing spirit, so success looked hopeful; but the father had told the son to divine, so the intent arose from the father's sincerity and it was the father divining for the son; Resource moved to control Output, and in the Wei month, on a Xu day, the boy died.

note.yi: 第十八问的问句原文作「亦有验」，依答语讲的是不验的缘故、以及标题「诚明不验」，应是「亦有不验」，译文按这个意思翻。例一、例二的卦图都不收；例二的原文开头连着卦图最后一行（「兄弟申金」），只取「此子十二岁」起的正文。例一最后一句「其业师中」后面接着的「式第四名」在下一行。
note.en: The question in question 18 reads "yet it is also borne out" in the text; since the answer speaks of why it is not borne out, and the heading is "sincere and shrewd, yet not borne out", it should read "also not borne out", and the translation follows that sense. The hexagram diagrams of both cases are not included; the text of the second case begins glued to the last line of its diagram ("Peer, Shen Metal"), and only the text from "this boy was twelve" is taken. In the first case the words "and passed as number four" follow on the next line after "his tutor passed".

zh: 第十八问：卜者心诚，断者精明，亦有验，何也？
答曰：此其故在卜者而不在断者，乃卜者之意虽诚，或密事难以语人，或问此而意别有在也，所以有不验之故耳。
yi: 第十八问：占的人心诚，断的人精明，也有不验的，为什么？
回答说：缘故在占的人，不在断的人，是占的人的心意虽然诚，有的是机密事难对人说，有的是问的是这件事，心意却别有所在，所以才有不验的缘故。
en: Question 18: the one who divines is sincere and the one who judges is shrewd, yet it is sometimes not borne out; why?

Answer: the cause lies in the one who divines and not in the one who judges: however sincere his intent, the matter may be a secret that is hard to tell anyone, or he asks about one thing while his mind is really elsewhere, and that is why it is not borne out.

zh: 申月乙亥日，占家宅得井之节卦：
yi: 申月乙亥日，占家宅，得井卦变节卦：
en: In the Shen month, on a Yi-Hai day, a man divined the household and got the hexagram Jing changing to Jie:

zh: 断曰：应居二爻，谓之应飞入宅，临父母，必有外姓长者同居。
内卦合成鬼局，宅内不安。
寅木兄弟月破伏藏，官局克之，或昆仲家不利。
彼曰：吾占家宅，即日欲同家业师乡试，实为功名耳。
予曰：功名与家宅天远地隔矣！
功名以官鬼为官星，家宅以鬼为祸害。
既占功名，兄之功名不许，令业师必高中也。
答曰：官局生应，不来生世，谓之出现无情，与我无干也。
后果至八月酉金实空之月，此人自己头场贴出，其业师中式第四名。
yi: 断语：应爻在第二爻，叫应飞入宅，临着父母，一定有外姓的长者同住。
他说：从来没有外人同住。
内卦的三爻合成了官鬼局，家宅里不得安宁。
他说：从来没有这样杂乱。
寅木兄弟月破、伏藏，又被官局克，也许兄弟一家不利。
他说：我占的是家宅，其实当天是想和家里的老师一同去赴乡试，实在是为功名。
我说：功名和家宅天远地隔！
求功名，官鬼爻是官星；占家宅，官鬼却是祸害。
既然占的是功名，您的功名是不许的，您的老师必定高中。
他说：怎么知道？
回答说：官局生应，不来生世，叫出现无情，与我无干。
后来果然到八月酉金填实空亡的月份，这个人自己头场被贴出，他的老师中了第四名。
en: Judgement: the Other line sits in the second line, which is called the Other flying into the house, and it carries Resource, so there must be an elder of another surname living together with you.
He said: no outsider has ever lodged with us.
The inner trigram combines into a Pressure frame, so the house is uneasy within.
He said: it has never been so disordered.
Yin Wood Peer is under a Month-break and hidden, and the Pressure frame controls it; perhaps the brothers' family is unlucky.
He said: I divined the household, but that very day I meant to go with my family tutor to the provincial examination; it was really for the examination title.
I said: examination success and the household are as far apart as heaven and earth!
For examination success Pressure is the official star, but for the household Pressure is calamity.
Since it is examination success you ask about, yours is not promised, and your tutor will surely pass with high rank.
He said: how do you know?
I answered: the Pressure frame gives life to the Other and does not come to give life to the Self; this is called appearing without feeling, and it has nothing to do with me.
Later, when the eighth month came, the month when the Void You Metal is filled, this man himself was struck off in the first session, and his tutor passed as number four.

zh: 午月辛酉日占功名，得萃之遁卦：
yi: 午月辛酉日占功名，得萃卦变遁卦：
en: In the Wu month, on a Xin-You day, a man divined for an examination title and got the hexagram Cui changing to Dun:

zh: 此子十二岁，乃父命其占名。
若以官爻持世，夏火当令，未土父母爻为文章，化进神功名有望。
岂知父叫子占，此心发于乃父之诚也，是父占子也。
卯木不能克父，则父动克子也。
yi: 这个孩子十二岁，是他的父亲命他占功名。
如果按官爻持世，夏天火当令，未土父母爻是文章，又化进神，功名有望。
谁知是父亲叫儿子占，这个心意发自父亲的诚心，是父亲占儿子。
卯木不能克父，就是父亲发动来克儿子。
未月戌日孩子就去世了。
en: This boy was twelve, and it was his father who ordered him to divine his examination prospects.
If it were judged as Pressure holding the Self, with Fire in command in summer, Wei Earth the Resource line being the essay, and changing into an Advancing spirit, success would look hopeful.
But the father told the son to divine, so the intent arose from the father's sincerity, and it was the father divining for the son.
Mao Wood cannot control the father, so it is the father moving that controls the son.
In the Wei month, on a Xu day, the boy died.

title: 总断千金赋·应位遭伤：占别人的事要看是什么名分——占师傅、家主、父友这类长辈用神是父母爻，不一概以应位论

rule.yi: 占别人的事，不能一概拿应爻当用神：交往疏远的人、没有尊卑名分的人，才以应爻代表他人；占师傅、一家之主、父亲的朋友这类长辈，用神是父母爻；占子孙的朋友，用神是子孙爻；占妻妾奴婢，用神是妻财爻。父亲的朋友、自己的朋友和子孙的朋友，虽然都是别人，要按老幼、称呼、名分来取用神，不能一概用应位断错。
rule.en: In divining another person's matter one must not always take the Other line as the Subject: it stands for the other person only when he is a distant acquaintance or has no rank of seniority; for a teacher, the head of a household or an older friend of one's father, the Subject is the Resource line; for the friend of one's descendants, the Output line; for wives, concubines, maids and servants, the Wealth line. A father's friend, one's own friend and the friend of one's descendants are all other people, but the Subject must be taken according to age, form of address and status, and one must not always misjudge by the Other position.

note.yi: 这一条取的是《总断千金赋》里「应位遭伤，不利他人之事」一句和王洪绪的注，和黄金策求师章（LY.EXAM.HJC.01）里「有尊卑名分者不看应爻，门人投师以父母爻为师长」说的是同一件事。注文最后一句讲的是占自己的事，放在一起没有拆开。
note.en: This takes the line "the Other position is injured, unfavourable to other people's matters" from the Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements together with Wang Hongxu's note; it says the same thing as the Huangjin Ce's seeking-a-teacher chapter (LY.EXAM.HJC.01), "where there is rank of seniority the Other line is not consulted, and a pupil going to a teacher takes the Resource line for the teacher". The last sentence of the note concerns one's own matters and is kept together without being split off.

yi: 应位受了伤，
对别人的事不利；
世爻受了制，
哪里适宜自己谋划？
en: The Other position is injured,
which is unfavourable to other people's matters;
the Self line is controlled,
how can one's own scheme be fit?

zh: 应位者，该当一个用神解说。
如占他人亦各有用神分别，或占交疏之人及无尊卑之人，是应为他人也；
倘占父友、家主、师傅辈，这是父母爻为用神了；
子孙之友，这是子孙爻为用神了，妻妾奴婢，这是妻财爻为用神了。
那父友、自友及子孙之友，虽是他人，当分别老幼称呼名份取用，不可一概以应位误断。
如卜损益自己之事，以世爻为自己也，世若受制，岂宜自己之谋乎？
yi: 应位这一爻，应当按一个用神来解说。
比如占别人的事，也各有各的用神，占交往疏远的人和没有尊卑名分的人，是以应爻代表他人；
如果占父亲的朋友、一家之主、师傅这类长辈，这是以父母爻为用神；
子孙的朋友，是以子孙爻为用神；妻妾奴婢，是以妻财爻为用神。
父亲的朋友、自己的朋友和子孙一辈的朋友，虽然是别人，要分别老幼、称呼、名分来取用神，不能一概用应位断错。
如果占的是对自己有损有益的事，世爻就是自己，世爻如果受制，哪里适宜自己谋划呢？
en: The Other position should be explained by taking it as a Subject.
For example, in divining about other people each has his own Subject: for a distant acquaintance or a person with no rank of seniority, the Other line stands for the other person;
if one divines for a father's friend, the head of a household or a teacher, the Subject is the Resource line;
for the friend of one's descendants the Subject is the Output line, and for wives, concubines, maids and servants the Subject is the Wealth line.

A father's friend, one's own friend and the friend of the Output generation (descendants), though other people, must be taken by distinguishing age, form of address and status, and one must not always misjudge by the Other position.
If one divines a matter that harms or benefits oneself, the Self line is oneself, and if the Self is controlled, how can one's own scheme be fit?

title: 求师·凡求师傅先究文章（文书既父母，父爻为书籍、为学馆、为学分）；用居弱地不范不模、若在旺乡可矜可式（有尊卑名分者不看应爻，门人投师以父母爻为师长）

rule.yi: 求老师先看文章（父母爻）：父母爻代表书籍、学馆和老师的学问。老师没有尊卑称呼的，以应爻为用神；有尊卑名分的，不看应爻，按名分论；学生占投师，不论老少，都以父母爻为师长。用神休囚，老师畏缩拘束，不能做楷模；旺相有气，魁梧雄伟，可敬可学。
rule.en: In seeking a teacher look first to the writing (the Resource line): the Resource line stands for the books, the school and the teacher's learning. If the teacher has no title of seniority, the Other line is the Subject; if he has a rank of seniority, the Other line is not looked at and one judges by the rank; when a pupil divines about taking a teacher, whether he is old or young the Resource line is the teacher. If the Subject is resting and trapped the teacher is timid and cramped and cannot be a model; if thriving and having breath he is tall and imposing and worthy of respect and imitation.

note.yi: 「应爻为用神」和「父母爻为师长」看起来是两种取法，书里的注把分界讲了：老师和你之间没有尊卑名分（比如请来的先生），看应爻；已经有师生名分、你去拜师，看父母爻。「学分」书里没有解释，从后面「学分欠通」（LY.EXAM.HJC.07）看是学问、学识的意思。
note.en: The two ways of fixing the Subject, the Other line and the Resource line, are separated by the commentary: where there is no rank of seniority between you and the man (such as a teacher you hire), look at the Other; where the teacher-pupil standing already exists and you go to take him as teacher, look at the Resource line. "The weight of learning" is not explained, but from "his learning is deficient" later (LY.EXAM.HJC.07) it means learning and scholarship.

yi: 出钱出饭、供养先生，
教养固然依靠严厉的师长，
明白善道、恢复本性，
启发全靠先觉的人。
凡是求师傅，
先要看文章（父母爻）
en: Giving money and meals to keep a teacher,
the bringing up depends on a strict master,
while to understand the good and return to one's first nature,
one relies wholly on one who has awakened first.
In seeking a teacher,
first look to the writing (the Resource line)

zh: 文书既父母，父爻为书籍，为学馆，为学分。
yi: 文书就是父母爻，父爻代表书籍、学馆、学问的分量。
en: The documents are the Resource line; the Resource line stands for books, the school and the weight of one's learning.

yi: 用神落在弱地，
必定不能做范做模（榜样）；
如果在旺乡，
就可敬可效法
en: If the Subject is in a weak place,
he is no pattern and no model;
if it is in a strong place,
he is worthy of respect and of imitation

zh: 所请之师，无尊卑称呼者，以应爻为用神也，如有尊卑名分，不可看应爻，当以名分论之。
如门人卜投师，不论老幼，皆以父母爻为师长。
如用神休囚，其师必然畏惧局促，不能为人之模范；
旺相有气，则魁梧雄伟，堪为学者矜式仪矣。
yi: 所请的老师，没有尊卑称呼的，以应爻为用神；如果有尊卑名分，不可以看应爻，要按名分来论。
如果是学生占投拜老师，不论老少，都以父母爻为师长。
如果用神休囚，那位老师必定畏缩拘束，不能做别人的模范；
旺相有气，就魁梧雄伟，足以做学者敬重效法的仪范。
en: For the teacher engaged, if there is no title of seniority, the Other line is taken as the Subject; if there is a rank of seniority, the Other line is not to be looked at, and one judges by the rank.
If a pupil divines about taking a teacher, whether old or young, the Resource line is taken as the teacher.
If the Subject is resting and trapped, the teacher is surely timid and cramped, and cannot be a model for others;
if it is thriving and has breath, he is tall and imposing and fit to be a pattern respected and followed by scholars.

title: 求师·临刑临害好施夏楚之威（带刑害白虎则师性暴少慈好笞挞）；逢岁逢身业擅束修之养（用爻卦身持太岁则专以严训为业、务得束修养家）

rule.yi: 用爻临刑、临害，老师爱用戒尺显威，带着刑害白虎的，性情暴躁少慈，必定爱打人，旺而动更甚；用爻逢太岁、逢卦身，老师以严格训导为业，一定要拿到束修来养家。
rule.en: If the Subject line stands on punishment or harm, the teacher loves to show his severity with the rod, and one carrying punishment, harm and the White Tiger is violent and short of kindness and surely loves to flog, the more so if strong and moving; if the Subject line meets Tai Sui or the Body, the teacher makes strict instruction his trade and must have the tuition fee to keep his family.

note.yi: 「夏楚」是「夏」和「楚」两种惩治学生的木条（楚是荆条）；「束修」是学生交给老师的学费（古时十条干肉为一束）。「逢岁逢身」的「岁」是太岁，「身」是卦身。
note.en: The "xia and chu" are the two kinds of rod used to punish pupils (chu is the thorn switch); the "tuition fee" is what pupils pay the teacher (anciently a bundle of ten strips of dried meat). The "year" in "meeting the year or the Body" is Tai Sui and the "body" is the hexagram Body.

yi: （用神）临刑、临害，
爱施行夏楚（戒尺）的威严
en: If the Subject stands on punishment or harm,
he loves to display the severity of the rod

zh: 夏楚，儆顽杖也，若带刑害白虎，其师性暴少慈，必好笞挞，旺动尤甚。
yi: 夏楚是用来警戒顽童的戒杖；如果（用爻）带着刑、害、白虎，那老师性情暴躁少慈，一定爱打人，旺而发动就更厉害。
en: The xiachu is the rod for warning unruly boys; if the line carries punishment, harm or the White Tiger, the teacher is violent and short of kindness and surely loves to flog, the more so if it is strong and moving.

yi: （用爻）逢太岁、逢卦身，
以收束修养家为业
en: If the Subject meets Tai Sui or the Body,
his trade is the tuition fee that keeps his family

zh: 用爻卦身或持太岁，其师专以严训为业，务得束修以养家者。
yi: 用爻、卦身或持太岁，这位老师专以严格训导为业，一定要拿到束修来养家。
en: If the Subject line, the Body or Tai Sui is held, the teacher makes strict instruction his trade and must have the tuition fee to keep his family.

title: 求师·兑金震巽杂学堪推、离火乾坤专经可断：父母爻落震巽艮坎兑五卦为杂学，落离乾坤三宫为专经

rule.yi: 推断老师是专治一经还是学问杂：父母爻落在震、巽、艮、坎、兑五卦里的，是杂学；落在离、乾、坤三宫里的，是专经。
rule.en: To judge whether a teacher specialises in one classic or has a miscellaneous learning: a Resource line in the five trigrams Zhen, Xun, Gen, Kan and Dui means miscellaneous learning; in the three palaces Li, Qian and Kun it means a single classic.

note.yi: 经文只点了兑、震巽、离、乾坤，注把它补全成五卦（震巽艮坎兑）对三宫（离乾坤）。「专经」是一生专治一部经，「杂学」是各样学问都涉及。
note.en: The verse names only Dui, Zhen-Xun, Li and Qian-Kun, and the commentary fills it out into five trigrams (Zhen, Xun, Gen, Kan, Dui) against three palaces (Li, Qian, Kun). A "single classic" is a lifelong specialisation in one classic and "miscellaneous learning" is a spread across many kinds of learning.

yi: 兑金、震巽（落在这些卦里），
可以推断他学的是杂学；
离火、乾、坤，
可以断定他专治一经
en: Dui Metal, Zhen and Xun:
one may infer a miscellaneous learning;
Li Fire, Qian and Kun:
one may judge a specialist in a single classic

zh: 凡推师之专经杂学者，当以父母在震、巽、艮、坎、兑五卦为杂学，离、乾、坤三宫为专经。
yi: 凡是推断老师是专治一经还是杂学的，应当以父母爻落在震、巽、艮、坎、兑五卦的为杂学，落在离、乾、坤三宫的为专经。
en: In judging whether a teacher is a specialist in one classic or of miscellaneous learning, take the Resource line in the five trigrams Zhen, Xun, Gen, Kan and Dui as miscellaneous learning, and in the three palaces Li, Qian and Kun as a single classic.

title: 求师·本象同乡在内则离家不远、他宫异地在外则隔属须遥（用象在本宫居外卦本处人而住远，在他宫居内卦外郡人而住近）；与世相生非亲则友（与世爻生合有亲道，不同宫者相识朋友）

rule.yi: 老师是哪里的人、住得远近：用神在本宫，是同乡，在内卦离家不远；在别宫，是异地人，在外卦就隔得很远；注补充：本宫而居外卦是本地人但住得远，他宫而居内卦是外郡人却住得近。用神和世相生，不是亲戚就是朋友：与世爻生合有亲谊，不同宫的是相识的朋友。
rule.en: Where the teacher is from and how far he lives: the Subject in its own palace means a fellow villager, and in the inner trigram he lives not far from home; in another palace he is from another place, and in the outer trigram he lives across a jurisdiction and far away; the commentary adds that in its own palace but in the outer trigram he is a local man who lives far, and in another palace but in the inner trigram he is from another prefecture but lives near. If the Subject and the Self give each other life he is a relative or a friend: giving life to or combining with the Self means kinship, and of a different palace an acquaintance and friend.

note.yi: 「隔属」是隔着一个行政辖区（府、县）。注讲的是经文的两种交叉情形，和经文一起看就是四种：本宫内卦（同乡近）、他宫外卦（异地远）、本宫外卦（同乡但住远）、他宫内卦（异乡但住近）。
note.en: A "jurisdiction" is an administrative district (a prefecture or county). The commentary gives the two crossed cases of the verse, which together make four: own palace and inner trigram (fellow villager, near), other palace and outer trigram (from elsewhere, far), own palace and outer trigram (fellow villager but lives far), other palace and inner trigram (from elsewhere but lives near).

yi: （用神）在本宫，是同乡人，
在内卦就离家不远；
在别的宫，是异地人，
在外卦就隔着辖区、相当远。
en: In its own palace, he is from the same village;
in the inner trigram he lives not far from home;
in another palace, he is from another place;
in the outer trigram he lives across a jurisdiction and far away.

zh: 用象在本宫而居外卦，是本处人，其住居必远；
在他宫而居内卦，是外郡人，其居住却近也。
yi: 用象在本宫但在外卦，是本地人，他的住处一定远；
在别的宫而在内卦，是外郡的人，他的住处却近。
en: If the Subject is in its own palace but in the outer trigram, he is a local man, and his home is surely far;
if in another palace but in the inner trigram, he is from another prefecture, and his home is near.

yi: （用神）和世相生，
不是亲戚就是朋友
en: If it gives life to the Self,
he is a relative or a friend

zh: 若与世爻不同宫者，是相识朋友。
yi: 和世爻生合，一定有亲戚关系；
如果和世爻不同宫，是相识的朋友。
en: If it gives life to or combines with the Self, there is surely kinship;
if it is not of the same palace as the Self, he is an acquaintance and friend.

title: 求师·与官交变不贵亦乐：用神化官爻则老师异日必贵，带白虎刑害则有病之人，持月建加青龙必有前程

rule.yi: 用神变出官爻，这位老师日后必定显贵；带着白虎、刑、害，就是有病的人；持月建又加青龙，必有好前程。
rule.en: If the Subject changes into the Pressure line the teacher will in time surely become eminent; if it carries the White Tiger, punishment or harm he is a sick man; if it holds the Month and has the Azure Dragon besides, he surely has a career before him.

yi: （用神）变出官爻，
就算不显贵也快乐
en: If it changes into the official star,
then if not eminent, at least he is content

zh: 用化官爻，其师异日必贵；
如白虎带刑害，则是有病之人；
如持月建更加青龙，必有前程在身。
yi: 用神变出官爻，这位老师日后必定显贵；
如果带着白虎、刑、害，就是有病的人；
如果持月建又加青龙，必定前程在身。
en: If the Subject changes into the Pressure line, the teacher will in time surely become eminent;
if it carries the White Tiger, punishment or harm, he is a sick man;
if it holds the Month and the Azure Dragon besides, he surely has a career ahead of him.

title: 求师·静合福爻喜遇循循之善诱、动加龙德怕逢凛凛之威严：用神与子孙作合最吉，师徒契合；父动克子孙加白虎刑害则师严毅方正难为子弟

rule.yi: 用神静而和子孙爻相合最吉，老师博文约礼、循循善诱，师徒投契；怕父爻动而克子孙，再加白虎、刑、害，老师就严厉刚毅、凛然不可犯，子弟难受。
rule.en: The Subject still and combining with the Output line is most auspicious: the teacher is learned and restrained and draws one on step by step, and teacher and pupil are in accord; what is feared is the Resource line moving and controlling Output, with the White Tiger, punishment and harm besides, when the teacher is stern, resolute and so awesome that one dare not offend him, and the pupils fare hard.

note.yi: 「龙德」是神煞里的龙德星（书里没有在这里解释），「博文约礼」出自《论语》，「循循善诱」是一步一步引导。
note.en: The "Dragon Virtue" is the Dragon Virtue spirit-star (the book does not explain it here); "learned and restrained" comes from the Analects, and "draws one on step by step" is leading a pupil on gradually.

yi: （用神）静而合福爻，
喜的是遇到循循善诱的老师；
动而加上龙德，
怕碰到凛然的威严
en: If it is still and combines with the Output line,
one is glad to meet a teacher who draws one on step by step;
if it moves and adds the Dragon Virtue,
one fears meeting a stern and awe-inspiring dignity

zh: 用神与子孙作合最吉，必能博文约礼，循循善诱，甚得为师之道，必主师徒契合。
唯怕父动则克子孙，更加白虎刑害，必然难为子弟，主其师严毅方正，凛然而不可少犯。
yi: 用神和子孙爻相合最吉，老师必定博文约礼、循循善诱，很得为师之道，主师徒契合。
只怕父爻动而克子孙，再加白虎、刑、害，必然让子弟难受，主这位老师严厉刚毅、方正，凛然不可稍有触犯。
en: The Subject combining with the Output line is most auspicious: the teacher will surely be learned and restrained and draw one on step by step, has much of the way of a teacher, and teacher and pupil are in accord.

What is feared is the Resource line moving and controlling Output, with the White Tiger, punishment and harm besides: it surely makes things hard for the pupils, and means the teacher is stern, resolute and upright, so awesome that one dare not offend him in the least.

title: 求师·父入墓中边孝先爱眠懒读（父爻入墓则师爱安逸、赖于教训、学分欠通，逢空化墓皆然；日辰冲破墓爻又主聪察）；文临身上李老聃博古通今（六爻无父必欠学问，静临卦身或居生旺之地才学非常）

rule.yi: 父爻入墓，老师爱安逸、懒于教训、学问欠通达，逢空、化墓也一样，日辰冲破墓爻则又聪明明察；文章（父爻）临在身上，老师博古通今；六爻里没有父爻，一定欠缺学问，静而临卦身或居生旺之地，才学非常。
rule.en: If the Resource line enters the tomb, the teacher loves ease, is lazy at teaching and admonishing and has deficient learning, and the same if it meets Void or changes into the tomb, though if the Day clashes and breaks the tomb line he is again sharp and observant; if the writing (the Resource line) stands on the Body, the teacher is learned in antiquity and versed in the present; if there is no Resource line among the six lines he surely lacks learning, and if it is still and stands on the Body or in a place of life or strength his talent and learning are extraordinary.

note.yi: 边孝先是汉代的边韶，据说白天睡觉，弟子笑他「边孝先，腹便便，懒读书，但欲眠」，他答「腹便便，五经笥，但欲眠，思经事」；李老聃是老子。书里只提名字作比喻，没有讲故事。
note.en: Bian Xiaoxian is Bian Shao of the Han, said to have napped by day, so that his disciples mocked him, "Bian Xiaoxian, big belly, lazy at reading, only wants to sleep"; Lao Dan is Laozi. The book uses the names only as comparisons and does not tell the stories.

yi: 父爻入墓，
（老师）像边孝先，爱睡觉、懒读书
en: If the Resource line enters the tomb,
he is like Bian Xiaoxian, fond of sleeping and lazy at reading

zh: 父爻入墓，其师唯爱安逸，赖于教训，学分欠通，逢空化墓皆然。
若日辰冲破墓爻，又主聪察。
yi: 父爻入墓，这位老师只爱安逸，懒于教导训诫，学问欠通达，遇空、变墓也都是这样。
如果日辰冲破墓爻，又主聪明明察。
en: If the Resource line enters the tomb, the teacher loves only ease, is lazy about teaching and admonishing, and his learning is deficient; the same holds if it meets Void or changes into the tomb.
If the Day clashes and breaks the tomb line, he is again sharp and observant.

yi: 文章（父爻）临在身上，
（老师）像李老聃，博古通今
en: If the writing stands on the Body,
he is like Lao Dan, learned in antiquity and versed in the present

zh: 凡求师，以父为师之才学，六爻无父必欠学问，若得静临卦身或居生旺之地，其师才学非常。
yi: 凡是求师，以父爻代表老师的才学，六爻里没有父爻，一定欠缺学问；如果静而临在卦身上，或者处在生旺之地，这位老师才学非同寻常。
en: In seeking a teacher, the Resource line stands for the teacher's talent and learning; if there is no Resource line among the six lines, he surely lacks learning; if it is still and stands on the Body, or is in a place of life or strength, the teacher's talent and learning are extraordinary.

title: 求师·母化子孙必主能诗能赋（父化福善作杂文，带刑害病败虽能作文多破绽，子带月建加青龙出口成章）；鬼连兄煞定然多诈多奸（兄动化鬼、鬼动化兄皆奸诈）；口是心非临空亡而发动（用爻宜静不宜动、宜旺不宜空）

rule.yi: 父爻化子孙，老师能诗能赋、善作杂文，带刑害病败的文章多破绽，子孙带月建加青龙则出口成章；兄动化鬼、鬼动化兄，老师多诈多奸，刑克世爻有是非口舌；用爻临空亡而发动，口是心非：动而空不诚实，静而空懒教训，化空也一样。
rule.en: If the Resource line changes into Output the teacher can write poems and rhapsodies and is good at miscellaneous prose, though if it carries punishment, harm, sickness or decay his writing is full of flaws, and if Output carries the Month and the Azure Dragon he speaks in finished prose; if Peer moves and changes into Pressure, or Pressure moves and changes into Peer, the teacher is deceitful and cunning, and punishing and controlling the Self means quarrels and gossip; if the Subject line stands on Void and moves, he says one thing and means another: moving and Void is insincere, still and Void is lazy at teaching, and the same if it changes into Void.

note.yi: 「福」是福神（子孙爻）。「小儿带来」是老师带着自己的小孩一起来。
note.en: The "spirit of blessing" is the Output line. "Bring a small child along" means the teacher brings his own young child with him.

yi: 父母爻化出子孙，
必定能作诗、能写赋
en: If Resource changes into Output,
he will be able to write both poems and rhapsodies

zh: 带刑害病败等爻，虽能作文，必多破绽。
子带月建又加青龙，必然出口成章；
与父作合，其师或有小儿带来。
yi: 父爻变福神，这位老师擅长写杂文；
带着刑、害、病、败等爻，虽然能作文，文章必定多破绽。
子孙带着月建又加青龙，必定出口成章；
和父爻相合，这位老师或许带着小孩来。
en: If Resource changes into the spirit of blessing, the teacher is good at miscellaneous prose;
if it carries lines of punishment, harm, sickness or decay, then though he can write, his writing will surely be full of flaws;
if Output carries the Month and the Azure Dragon, he will surely speak in finished prose;
if it combines with the Resource line, the teacher may bring a small child along.

yi: 官鬼连着兄弟煞，
一定多诈多奸
en: If Pressure joins the Peer baleful line,
he is surely full of deceit and cunning

zh: 凡遇兄动化鬼，鬼动化兄，皆主奸诈；
刑克世爻，必有是非口舌。
yi: 凡是遇到兄弟动化官鬼、官鬼动化兄弟，都主奸诈；
刑克世爻，一定有是非口舌。
en: Whenever Peer moves and changes into Pressure or Pressure moves and changes into Peer, it means deceit and cunning;
if it punishes and controls the Self, there will surely be quarrels and gossip.

yi: 嘴上说的和心里想的不一样，
是用爻临空亡而发动
en: He says one thing and means another,
when the Subject line stands on Void and moves

zh: 用爻宜静不宜动，宜旺不宜空，动空不诚实，静空懒教训，化空亦然。
yi: 用爻宜静不宜动，宜旺不宜空；动而空的不诚实，静而空的懒于教训，变空也是这样。
en: The Subject line should be still and not moving, strong and not Void; moving and Void means he is not sincere, still and Void means he is lazy at instruction, and the same if it changes into Void.

title: 求师·彼迁此请持世应而兴隆（世应俱动主有家延请，两爻俱空俱不成）；母值应而世生须知假馆（父临应上世动来生合，必馆他家而欲附学）；父在外而福合必是担囊（自占以世为徒、不看福爻，父兄占以子弟为徒、不看世爻；父在外卦他宫安静而子孙动去相会则游学他方）

rule.yi: 世、应都动，有人家来聘请；两爻都空，都不成。父爻临在应爻上、世爻动来生合它，老师在别人家设馆，自己想去附学。自己占以世爻为徒、不看福爻，父兄代占以子弟为徒、不看世爻；父爻在外卦又是别宫、安静，而子孙动去相会，必是到别处游学。
rule.en: If the Self and Other both move, some household will engage him; if both lines are Void, neither comes about. If the Resource line stands on the Other and the Self moves to give life to or combine with it, the teacher keeps his school at another's house and one wishes to attach oneself to it. When one divines for oneself the Self is the pupil and the Output line is not looked at; when a father or elder brother divines for him the son or younger brother is the pupil and the Self line is not looked at; if the Resource line is in the outer trigram, of another palace and still, and Output moves to meet it, he will surely go to study in another place.

note.yi: 「假馆」是借别人的馆舍；「担囊」是挑着行李出门游学。「福爻」是子孙爻（福神）。
note.en: "Borrowing a school" is using another man's school premises; "carrying one's bag" is setting out with one's luggage to study abroad. The "Output line" here is the line of blessing, Output.

yi: 他那边迁走、我这边来请，
（用神）持世应而兴旺
en: He moves on there and is invited here,
when the Subject holds the Self or the Other and flourishes

zh: 世应俱动，主有家延请，两爻俱空，必然俱不能成。
yi: 世应都动，主有人家来聘请；两爻都空，必定都不能成。
en: If the Self and Other both move, some household will engage him; if both lines are Void, neither will come about.

yi: 父母爻在应爻上而世爻来生它，
要知道是借别人的馆（附学）
en: If the Resource line is on the Other and the Self gives it life,
know that it means borrowing another's school (to study there)

zh: 父临应上，而世爻动来生合者，必馆于他家，而欲附学也。
yi: 父爻临在应爻上，而世爻动来生合它的，一定是在别人家设馆，而自己想去附学。
en: If the Resource line is on the Other and the Self moves to give life to or combine with it, he surely keeps his school at another's house, and one wishes to attach oneself to the study.

yi: 父爻在外卦而和福神相合，
一定是挑着行囊（出外游学）
en: If the Resource line is in the outer trigram and combines with Output,
it surely means carrying one's bag (going abroad to study)

zh: 凡卜求师，若子弟自占，以世为徒，不看福爻；
父兄来占，以子弟为徒，不看世爻。
若父在外卦，又系他宫，安静而子孙动去相会，必游学他方，担囊从事也。
yi: 凡是占求师，如果是子弟自己占，以世爻为徒弟，不看福爻；
如果是父兄来占，以子弟为徒弟，不看世爻。
如果父爻在外卦，又是别宫，安静，而子孙动去与它相会，一定是到别处游学，担着行囊从师。
en: In divining for a teacher, if the pupil divines for himself, the Self is the pupil and the Output line is not looked at;
if a father or elder brother divines, the son or younger brother is the pupil, and the Self line is not looked at.

If the Resource line is in the outer trigram and belongs to another palace and is still, while Output moves to meet it, he will surely go to study in another place, carrying his bag to serve a teacher.

title: 求师·鬼化文书克世则讼由乎学（鬼动化父母刑克世爻异日必争论，父化鬼爻或官爻皆动伤世亦然）

rule.yi: 官鬼变出文书（父母）来克世，会因学业上的事引出官司；官鬼动变父母刑克世爻，日后一定有争论；父爻变官鬼，或官爻都动来伤世，也一样。
rule.en: If Pressure changes into the document line and controls the Self, a lawsuit will arise from the schooling; if the Pressure line moves and changes into Resource and punishes and controls the Self, there will surely be dispute in future; the same if the Resource line changes into the Pressure line, or the Pressure lines all move and harm the Self.

yi: 官鬼变出文书（父母）来克世，
就会因学业而起官司
en: If Pressure turns into the document line and controls the Self,
a lawsuit arises from the schooling

zh: 鬼动若化出父母刑克世爻，异日必主争论；
父化鬼爻，或官爻皆动有伤世者，亦然。
yi: 官鬼动，如果变出父母爻刑克世爻，日后一定有争论；
父爻变官鬼爻，或者官爻都动而伤世的，也一样。
en: If Pressure moves and changes into the Resource line and punishes and controls the Self, there will surely be dispute in future;
the same if the Resource line changes into the Pressure line, or the Pressure lines all move and harm the Self.

title: 求师·月扶福德日生则青出于蓝：子孙有气不空又得月日动爻生合则学有进益，用爻反衰则弟子胜于师

rule.yi: 月建扶着子孙、日辰生它，学生青出于蓝：子孙爻要有气不空，又得月、日、动爻生合，学业才有进益；用爻反而衰，弟子反而胜过老师。
rule.en: If the Month supports Output and the Day gives it life, the pupil surpasses the master: the Output line must have breath and not be Void and be given life and combination by the Month, the Day or a moving line before study makes progress; if the Subject line is on the contrary weak, the pupil surpasses the teacher.

yi: 月建扶着福德（子孙）、日辰生它，
就会青出于蓝
en: If the Month supports Output and the Day gives it life,
the pupil will surpass the master

zh: 须得子孙有气不空，又遇月日动爻生合，则学有进益；
若用爻反衰，则弟子反胜于师，如青出于蓝也。
yi: 必须子孙爻有气、不空，又遇到月、日、动爻生合，学业才有进益；
如果用爻反而衰，那么弟子反而胜过老师，就像青出于蓝。
en: The Output line must have breath and not be Void, and also meet life and combination from the Month, the Day or a moving line, and then study makes progress;
if the Subject line is on the contrary weak, the pupil surpasses the teacher, like blue coming from indigo.

title: 求师·刑克同伤父子必罹其害、合生为助官鬼莫受其扶（父为子延师以世为自、子孙为儿、应为师；世与子孙皆受刑克日后父子遭害，官爻动来刑克世与子孙不可又加财动生合助之）

rule.yi: 父亲为儿子请老师，世爻是自己、子孙爻是儿子、应爻是老师：世和子孙都受刑克，日后父子都要遭害；官爻动来刑克世爻和子孙，不可再有财爻动来生合帮它。
rule.en: When a father engages a teacher to instruct his son, the Self is himself, the Output line the son and the Other the teacher: if the Self and Output are both punished and controlled, father and son will suffer harm later; if the Pressure line moves to punish and control the Self and Output, Wealth must not also move to give it life and combine and help it.

yi: 刑克一起伤到父子，
必定遭到它的害。
（财爻）合生是为了帮助官鬼，
不要接受它的扶助
en: If punishment and control injure father and son together,
they will surely suffer harm from it.
if combination and life-giving help Pressure,
do not accept its support

zh: 父卜延师训子，以世为自，以子孙为儿，以应为师。
如世与子孙皆受刑克，日后父子必遭其害。
如官爻动来刑克世爻子孙，不可又加财动生合助之。
yi: 父亲占请老师教训儿子，以世爻为自己，以子孙爻为儿子，以应爻为老师。
如果世爻和子孙都受刑克，日后父子一定遭受它的害。
如果官爻动来刑克世爻和子孙，不可以再有财爻动来生合帮助它。
en: When a father divines about engaging a teacher to instruct his son, the Self is himself, the Output line is the son, and the Other is the teacher.
If the Self and Output are both punished and controlled, father and son will surely suffer harm from it later.
If the Pressure line moves to punish and control the Self and Output, Wealth must not also move to give it life and combine and help it.

title: 求师·或击或冲父母逢之不久（父母要有气而不宜动变，动变伤克子孙必不能久）；或空或陷世身见之不成（世、应、身爻空亡冲克皆难成）

rule.yi: 父母爻被击被冲，老师做不长久：父母爻要有气，但不宜动变，动变就伤克子孙，必不能久；世爻、卦身遇空或陷，事不成：世、应、身爻空亡、被冲克，都是难成的象。
rule.en: If the Resource line is struck or clashed the teacher does not last: the Resource line must have breath but should not move or change, for moving or changing it harms and controls Output and it cannot last; if the Self or the Body meets Void or sinks, it does not come about: the Self, the Other and the Body line being Void, clashed or controlled are all signs of difficulty.

yi: （父母爻）或被击或被冲，
父母爻遇到这个就不会长久
en: Whether struck or clashed,
the Resource line that meets it will not last

zh: 父母虽要有气，然不宜动变，动变则伤克子孙，必不能久。
yi: 父母爻虽然要有气，但不宜动变，动变就伤克子孙，一定不能长久。
en: The Resource line must have breath, but should not move or change; if it moves or changes it harms and controls Output, and it surely cannot last.

yi: （世身）或空或陷，
世爻、卦身遇到这个就不成
en: Whether Void or sunk,
the Self or Body that meets it will not succeed

zh: 世应身爻空亡冲克，皆见难成之象。
yi: 世爻、应爻、卦身爻空亡、被冲克，都是难成的象。
en: The Self, the Other and the Body line being Void, clashed or controlled are all signs of difficulty in succeeding.

title: 求师·财化父爻妻族荐之于不日（有父母而本宫财爻化出一重则妻家荐师，兄弟化出则朋友荐；动爻是重已荐过、是交将荐来）；母藏福德僧家设帐于先年（父爻伏子孙下师前年设帐于僧房道观，伏世下乃旧师）

rule.yi: 财爻化出父爻，妻家的亲族不久会推荐老师：卦有父母、本宫财爻化出一「重」，妻家就再荐一位老师；兄弟爻化出，是朋友来荐；动爻是「重」的已经荐过，是「交」的将要荐来。父爻伏在子孙爻下，老师前年在僧房道观设馆；伏在世爻下，是旧时的老师。
rule.en: If Wealth changes into the Resource line the wife's kin will soon recommend a teacher: if the hexagram has a Resource line and a Wealth line of the home palace changes out one "chong", the wife's family will recommend another teacher, and if Peer changes out, a friend recommends one; if the moving line is a "chong" the recommendation has already been made, and if a "jiao" it is about to be made. If the Resource line lies hidden under Output, the teacher kept his school the year before last in a monks' cell or Taoist temple; if it lies hidden under the Self, he is a former teacher.

note.yi: 「重」「交」是起卦里的两种动爻：重是老阳（三个正面），交是老阴（三个反面）；「设帐」是开设私塾；「本宫财爻」是和卦同宫的财爻。书里没有说「化出一重」具体怎么看，这里按字面译。
note.en: "Chong" and "jiao" are the two kinds of moving line in casting: chong is the old yang (three heads) and jiao the old yin (three tails); "setting up the curtain" is opening a private school; the "Wealth line of the home palace" is the Wealth line of the same palace as the hexagram. The book does not say exactly how "changes out one chong" is read, and it is translated as written.

yi: 财爻化出父爻，
妻家的亲族不久就会推荐（一位老师）
en: If Wealth changes into the Resource line,
the wife's kin will soon recommend one

zh: 若卦有父母，遇本宫财爻有化出一重者，不日间妻家又荐一师来也；
yi: 如果卦里有父母爻，而本宫的财爻有变出一个「重」的，不几天妻家又会推荐一位老师来；
兄弟爻化出的，就是朋友来推荐。
动爻是重的，已经推荐过了；
动爻是交的，将要推荐来。
en: If the hexagram has a Resource line and the Wealth line of the home palace changes out a "chong" (an old-yang moving line), within a few days the wife's family will recommend another teacher;
if it is Peer that changes out, a friend recommends one.
if the moving line is a "chong", the recommendation has already been made;
if it is a "jiao" (an old-yin moving line), it is about to be made.

yi: 父母爻伏藏在福德（子孙）爻下，
（这位老师）前几年在僧家设馆
en: If the Resource line lies hidden under Output,
the teacher kept his school at a monk's house in an earlier year

zh: 如父爻伏在子孙爻下，其师必前年设帐于僧房道观；
yi: 如果父爻伏在子孙爻下，这位老师一定前年在僧房道观里设馆；
父爻伏在世爻下，是旧时的老师。
en: If the Resource line lies hidden under the Output line, the teacher surely kept his school the year before last in a monks' cell or Taoist temple;
if the Resource line lies hidden under the Self, he is a former teacher.

title: 求师·搜索六爻无过求理、思量万事莫贵读书：求师不专指道学之师，百工技艺拜僧道为师皆是；自占以世爻看学者，隔手来占须问是何人；师弟相生相合则吉相冲相克则凶

rule.yi: 求师不只指讲道学的老师，学百工技艺、拜僧人道士为师也都是；自己占，以世爻看学习的人；别人代占，要问是什么人，朋友兄弟就以兄弟爻为主；总要师弟相生相合才吉，相冲相克就凶。
rule.en: Seeking a teacher does not mean only a teacher of moral learning: learning a craft or skill, or taking a monk or Taoist as teacher, all count; when one divines for oneself, the learner is read from the Self line; when another divines on one's behalf one must ask who he is, and for a friend or brother Peer is the main line; in every case teacher and pupil giving life to and combining with each other is auspicious, and clashing and controlling each other inauspicious.

note.yi: 这一段说「师之主象，自占不以父母」，和第一条注里「门人卜投师，不论老幼，皆以父母爻为师长」看上去不一致，书里没有解释；这里照字面译，不替它调和。可能的读法是：拜僧道百工为师时，老师不以父母爻取，而以应爻或别的爻取，但原文没有明说。
note.en: This passage says "the main image of the teacher, when one divines for oneself, is not the Resource line", which seems at odds with the first commentary, "when a pupil divines about taking a teacher, whether old or young, the Resource line is the teacher"; the book does not explain, and it is translated as written without reconciling them. One possible reading is that for teachers of crafts, monks and Taoists the teacher is not taken from the Resource line but from the Other or another line, but the text does not say so.

yi: 搜寻六爻（的道理），
不过是求得其中的理；
思量万事，
没有比读书更可贵的
en: Search the six lines,
it is no more than seeking the principle in them;
ponder all affairs,
and nothing is more precious than study

zh: 凡求师，不可专指道学之师，如欲投学百工技艺及拜僧道为师类皆是。
但师之主象，自占不以父母；
而学者主象，自占当以世爻看之。
如隔手来占，须问是何人，如朋友兄弟则以兄弟为主之类。
皆要师弟相生相合则吉，相冲相克则凶。
yi: 凡是求师，不能只指讲道学的老师，想拜师学百工技艺以及拜僧人道士为师的，也都属于求师。
但是老师的主象，自己占时不用父母爻；
而学习者的主象，自己占时要用世爻来看。
如果是别人代占，必须问是什么人，比如朋友、兄弟就以兄弟爻为主，等等。
都要老师和弟子相生相合才吉，相冲相克就凶。
en: In seeking a teacher, one must not mean only a teacher of moral philosophy; wanting to learn a craft or skill, or taking a monk or Taoist as teacher, all count.
But the main image of the teacher, when one divines for oneself, is not the Resource line;
and the main image of the learner, when one divines for oneself, is to be read from the Self line.
If another person divines on one's behalf, one must ask who it is; for a friend or brother, Peer is the main line, and so on.
In every case, teacher and pupil giving life to and combining with each other is auspicious, and clashing and controlling each other is inauspicious.

title: 求名·父爻旺相其文掷地金声、鬼位兴隆家报泥金捷喜：凡占功名以父爻为文章、鬼为官职，二者一卦之主，伤一则不成

rule.yi: 占功名，父爻是文章，官鬼是官职，这两样是一卦的主体，伤了一样就不成；父爻旺相文章必好，官鬼得地功名有望，泥金报喜。
rule.en: In divining for fame and rank, the Resource line is the writing and Pressure the post; these two are the masters of the hexagram, and if either is harmed it will not succeed; with the Resource line thriving the writing is surely fine, and with Pressure well placed fame and rank are within hope and the gilt-ink news of joy comes.

note.yi: 「泥金」是用金粉写的捷报（旧时中举后把泥金帖子寄回家）；注特别说「不是拿鬼当音信」，是怕读的人把「鬼」当作报信的人。这一章是求名（应考成名）的总纲，下面各条逐联细讲。增删卜易的乡试会试章（LY.EXAM.ZS.27）是同一个意思的另一种写法。
note.en: "Gilt ink" is gold-powder ink used for the victory notice (after passing, a gilt-ink card was sent home); the commentary stresses that Pressure is not taken as a bearer of news, lest the reader think the word "ghost" stands for the messenger. This chapter opens the whole of seeking a name (taking examinations to win fame); the couplets below take it up one by one. The chapter of the Zengshan Buyi on the provincial and metropolitan examinations (LY.EXAM.ZS.27) says the same thing in other words.

yi: 读书读到五车，
本来就想把自己献身于朝廷；
胸藏万卷书的人，
怎肯甘心隐居在山丘田园？
想要辅佐国家，
应当仔细看易卦。
父爻旺相的话，
他的文章掷在地上有金石之声；
官鬼位兴隆的话，
家里会传来泥金报捷的喜讯
en: One who has read five cartloads of books
surely wishes to give himself to the court;
one who holds ten thousand volumes in his breast
is he willing to hide away in the hills and gardens?
To assist the state,
one must study the hexagram closely.
If the Resource line is thriving,
his writing rings like gold when thrown to the ground;
if the Pressure position is flourishing,
the news of victory in gilt ink comes to the home

zh: 凡占功名，以父爻为文章，鬼为官职，二者一卦之主，伤一则不成。
若父爻旺相，文章必佳，官鬼得地，功名有望，泥金报喜。
总言金榜题名，功成名就之意，非以鬼为音信也。
yi: 凡是占功名，以父爻为文章，官鬼为官职，这两个是一卦的主体，伤了一个就不成。
如果父爻旺相，文章必定好；官鬼得地，功名有望，泥金报喜。
这是总的说金榜题名、功成名就的意思，不是拿官鬼当作音信。
学的人要记住。
en: In divining for fame and rank, the Resource line is the writing and Pressure is the post; these two are the masters of the hexagram, and if either is harmed it will not succeed.
If the Resource line is thriving, the writing is surely fine; if Pressure is well placed, fame and rank are within hope and the gilt-ink news of joy comes.
This speaks in general of one's name on the Golden List and success in fame and rank, and does not take Pressure as news.
Students should remember it.

title: 求名·财若交重休望青钱之中选、福如发动难期金榜之题名：唯卜功名财福反为恶煞（财克父、子克鬼）；官爻持世得财动来生则财无忌，子孙固为忌客

rule.yi: 财爻发动，别指望被选中；福神（子孙）发动，难指望金榜题名。只有占功名时，财、福反而是恶煞，因为财克父、子孙克官鬼；官爻持世又得财爻动来生它，财就没有忌讳，子孙则本来就是忌客。
rule.en: If Wealth moves, do not hope to be chosen; if Output moves, it is hard to hope for one's name on the Golden List. Only in divining for fame and rank are Wealth and Output on the contrary baleful spirits, for Wealth controls Resource and Output controls Pressure; if the Pressure line holds the Self and Wealth moves to give it life, Wealth is no taboo, but Output is by nature the hostile guest.

note.yi: 「青钱中选」是说像「青钱学士」那样每试必中：唐代张鷟应试屡次得第一，人称「青钱学士」，这里只借来比喻考中。财克父（伤文章）、子孙克官鬼（伤功名），所以在求名里这两样都是忌；和占财时财、子孙为吉正好相反。官爻持世又有财来生，是财生官，所以财不忌。
note.en: "Chosen like the green coin" is a figure for passing every time: Zhang Zhuo of the Tang took first place over and over and was called the "green-coin scholar", and the book borrows it only as a figure for passing. Wealth controls Resource (harming the writing) and Output controls Pressure (harming rank), so in seeking a name both are taboos, which is the opposite of divining for wealth, where Wealth and Output are auspicious. With the Pressure line holding the Self and Wealth giving it life, Wealth gives life to Pressure, so Wealth is not taboo.

yi: 财爻如果交重（发动），
就别指望被选中（青钱中选）；
福神（子孙）如果发动，
就难指望金榜题名
en: If Wealth moves,
do not hope to be chosen like the "green coin";
if Output moves,
it is hard to hope for one's name on the Golden List

zh: 唯卜功名，以财福反为恶煞，盖财能克父，子能克鬼故也。
如官爻持世，若得财动来生，而财无忌也；
yi: 只有占功名，财爻和福神（子孙）反而是恶煞，因为财能克父、子孙能克官鬼。
如果官爻持世，又得财爻动来生它，那么财就没有忌讳；
子孙本来就是忌客。
en: Only in divining for fame and rank are Wealth and Output on the contrary baleful spirits, since Wealth can control Resource and Output can control Pressure.
If the Pressure line holds the Self and Wealth moves to give it life, then Wealth is no taboo;
Output is by nature the hostile guest.

title: 求名·兄弟同经乃夺标之恶客：求名见兄弟即是同治一经的人，发动或月建日辰俱带兄弟则同经者多，必夺我之标，纵大象可成名亦落后

rule.yi: 求名时见到兄弟爻，就是和自己同治一经的人；兄弟发动，或月建、日辰都带兄弟，同经的人多，必定夺走自己的魁首，纵然大局可成，名次也落后。
rule.en: Seeing the Peer line in seeking a name means men who study the same classic as oneself; if it moves, or the Month and the Day both carry Peer, there are many who share one's classic and they will surely snatch one's prize, and even if the overall picture can succeed one's rank falls behind.

dispute.yi: 这里（王洪绪注）说兄弟发动、或月建日辰带兄弟，同经者多，必夺其标。增删卜易（野鹤）却说：俗传兄弟爻兴难上榜、凡兄爻持世或动都断不吉，「殊不知有喜有忌」——财父同兴时喜兄动制财，父官两动时喜兄弟持世，兄弟持世临日月旺相再得官文两旺也能中式，只是不能夺魁（LY.EXAM.ZS.28）。两说在「兄弟夺魁」上一致，分歧在「兄弟是不是一概不吉」。
dispute.en: Here (Wang Hongxu's commentary) says that if Peer moves, or the Month and the Day carry Peer, there are many who share the classic and they will snatch the prize. The Zengshan Buyi (the Old Man of Yehe) says that common lore holds that if the Peer line flourishes it is hard to get on the list and that Peer holding the Self or moving is always ill, "not knowing that there are welcome cases and feared ones": when Wealth and Resource flourish together it is welcome that Peer moves to control Wealth, when Resource and Pressure both move it is welcome that Peer holds the Self, and with Peer holding the Self and standing on the Day or Month or thriving, and the official star and writing both strong, one can pass but cannot take first place (LY.EXAM.ZS.28). The two agree that Peer costs one first place; they differ on whether Peer is always ill.

yi: 兄弟爻（同类的人）同治一经，
是来夺魁首的恶客
en: Peer is one who studies the same classic,
the unwelcome guest who snatches the prize

zh: 同类者为兄弟，求名见之，乃是与我同经之人，如遇发动，或月建日辰俱带兄弟，则同经者多，必能夺我之标，纵大象可成，名亦落后。
yi: 同类的是兄弟爻；求名时见到它，就是和我同治一经的人；如果它发动，或者月建、日辰都带兄弟，那么同经的人多，必定能夺我的魁首，纵然大局可成，名次也落在后面。
en: Those of the same kind are Peer; seen in seeking a name, they are men who study the same classic as I; if it moves, or the Month and the Day both carry Peer, then there are many who share my classic and they will surely snatch my prize, and even if the overall picture can succeed, my rank falls behind.

title: 求名·日辰辅德实劝驾之良朋：父母官鬼无气得日辰扶起、克制恶煞仍有望；世爻衰静空亡得日辰生扶冲实，亲友资助盘费辅其前往求名

rule.yi: 父母爻、官鬼无气，得日辰扶起、克制恶煞，仍然有望，叫辅德；世爻衰、静、空亡，得日辰生扶或冲实，有亲友资助路费，帮他去应考求名。
rule.en: If the Resource and Pressure lines have no breath but the Day raises them up and restrains the baleful spirit, there is still hope, which is called supporting virtue; if the Self is weak, still and Void but the Day gives it life and support or clashes it solid, relatives and friends will help with the travelling expenses and aid his going to seek a name.

note.yi: 「冲实」是冲开落空的爻，让它实在起来（空遇冲则实）。「劝驾」是劝人出来应考、做官，这里指资助盘费的人。
note.en: "Clashed solid" is clashing a Void line so that it becomes real (a Void line that meets a clash is made real). "Urging one to set out" is urging a man to come forward for the examination or for office, here meaning the people who give money for the journey.

yi: 日辰辅助有德（扶起用爻），
实在是劝你出发赴考的好朋友
en: If the Day supports the virtuous line,
it is truly a good friend urging one to set out

zh: 如父母官鬼无气，若得日辰扶起，克制恶煞，仍旧有望，故曰辅德。
或世爻衰静空亡，得日辰生扶冲实，主有亲友资助盘费，辅其前往求名也。
yi: 如果父母爻、官鬼无气，若得日辰扶起、克制恶煞，仍然有望，所以叫辅德。
或者世爻衰而静、落空亡，得日辰生扶、冲实，主有亲友资助路费，帮助他前去求名。
en: If the Resource and Pressure lines have no breath but the Day raises them up and restrains the baleful spirit, there is still hope, which is why it is called supporting virtue.
Or if the Self is weak and still and Void but the Day gives it life and support or clashes it solid, relatives and friends will help with the travelling expenses and aid his going to seek a name.

title: 求名·两用相冲题目生疏而不熟：官爻为用爻喜合不喜冲，见官爻相冲主出题生涩不熟

rule.yi: 两个用爻互相冲，出的题目生僻不熟；官爻是用爻，喜合不喜冲，见官爻相冲，主出题生涩、不熟悉。
rule.en: If the two Subject lines clash each other, the topic set is strange and unfamiliar; the Pressure line is the Subject line and likes combination and not clash, and if two Pressure lines clash each other the topic set is obscure and unfamiliar.

note.yi: 「出题」是主考官出的试题；这是少数把卦象对到试题上的句子。
note.en: The "topic" is the question set by the examiner; this is one of the few lines that match the hexagram to the question paper.

yi: 两个用爻互相冲，
出的题目生僻而不熟悉
en: If the two Subject lines clash each other,
the topic set is strange and unfamiliar

zh: 以官爻为用爻，喜合而不喜冲，若见官爻相冲，主出题生涩不熟也。
yi: 以官爻为用爻，喜合不喜冲；如果见到官爻相冲，主出的题目生涩、不熟悉。
en: The Pressure line is the Subject line and likes combination and not clash; if two Pressure lines clash each other, the topic set is obscure and unfamiliar.

title: 求名·六爻竞发功名恍惚以难成：六爻皆喜安静，官鬼有气不空、月建日辰不伤克则吉；动则有变，变出之爻又有死墓绝空刑克为破败；乱动卦大概不吉

rule.yi: 六爻都争着发动，功名恍惚难成：六爻都喜安静，只要官鬼有气不空、月建日辰不来伤克就吉；凡动就有变，变出的爻又有死、墓、绝、空、刑、克的说法，都是破败，所以乱动的卦大概不吉。
rule.en: If all six lines contend to move, fame and rank are dim and hard to achieve: the six lines all like stillness, and as long as the Pressure line has breath and is not Void and the Month and Day do not come to harm or control it, it is auspicious; whatever moves changes, and the line it changes into is again judged by death, tomb, extinction, Void, punishment and control, all of which are ruin, so a hexagram of disordered movement is on the whole inauspicious.

note.yi: 增删卜易引过这一联（LY.EXAM.ZS.31），并补充自己的验证：占功名必中的，不是旺父生身就是旺官持世；没成的，不是子孙持世就是子孙财爻发动、世破世空或六爻乱动。
note.en: The Zengshan Buyi quotes this couplet (LY.EXAM.ZS.31) and adds its own findings: where one is sure to pass it is either a strong Resource line giving life to the Body or a strong Pressure line holding the Self; where one does not succeed it is Output holding the Self, or Output and Wealth moving, or the Self broken or Void, or the six lines moving in disorder.

yi: 六爻都争着发动，
功名恍惚不定，难以成就
en: If all six lines contend to move,
fame and rank are dim and hard to achieve

zh: 六爻皆喜安静，只要官鬼有气不空，月建日辰不来伤克，则吉；
凡动则有变，变出之爻又有死墓绝空刑克等论，皆为破败。
故凡乱动卦，其大概不吉可知矣。
yi: 六爻都喜欢安静，只要官鬼有气不空、月建日辰不来伤克，就吉；
凡是动就有变，变出的爻又有死、墓、绝、空、刑、克等说法，都是破败。
所以凡是乱动的卦，大概不吉就可以知道了。
en: All six lines like to be still; as long as the Pressure line has breath and is not Void and the Month and the Day do not come to harm or control it, it is auspicious;
Whatever moves changes, and the line it changes into is again judged by death, tomb, extinction, Void, punishment and control, all of which are ruin;
so in any hexagram of disordered movement, it can be known that on the whole it is inauspicious.

title: 求名·月克文书程式背而不中：父旺得动爻日辰生合文字字锦绣，妻财伤克必多破绽，月建冲克文必不中试官之程式

rule.yi: 月建克文书（父爻），文章违背程式，考不中：父爻旺又得动爻、日辰生合，文章字字锦绣；妻财伤克，必多破绽；月建冲克，文章必不合考官的程式。
rule.en: If the Month controls the document line, the essay goes against the model form and is not chosen: with the Resource line strong and given life and combination by a moving line or the Day, the essay is brocade in every word; if Wealth harms and controls it, there are many flaws; if the Month clashes and controls it, the essay will surely not fit the examiner's model form.

note.yi: 「程式」是科举文章的规定格式（八股）；增删卜易岁考科考章里讲文章好坏也是看父爻（LY.EXAM.ZS.18）。
note.en: The "model form" is the prescribed form of an examination essay (the eight-legged essay); the Zengshan Buyi chapter on the annual and qualifying examinations also judges the quality of the writing by the Resource line (LY.EXAM.ZS.18).

yi: 月建克文书（父母），
文章违背程式而考不中
en: If the Month controls the document line,
the essay goes against the model form and is not chosen

zh: 父旺而得动爻日辰生合，其文字字锦绣；
月建冲克，其文必不中试官之程式也。
yi: 父爻旺而又得动爻、日辰生合，他的文章字字锦绣；
妻财伤克，必定多有破绽；
月建冲克，他的文章必定不合考官的程式。
en: If the Resource line is strong and given life and combination by a moving line or the Day, his essay is brocade in every word;
if Wealth harms and controls it, there will surely be many flaws;
if the Month clashes and controls it, his essay will surely not fit the examiner's model form.

title: 求名·世伤官鬼仕途窒而不通：世乃求名之人，持官鬼或得官鬼生合则有望；临子孙则克制官鬼，仕途未通，徒去求谋无济

rule.yi: 世爻是求名的人：持官鬼或得官鬼生合，功名有望；世爻临子孙，就克制官鬼，仕途不通，白去求谋也没有用。
rule.en: The Self is the man seeking a name: if it holds Pressure or is given life or combination by Pressure, fame and rank are within hope; if it stands on Output it controls Pressure, the path of office is not open, and seeking and scheming in vain is of no avail.

yi: 世爻伤克官鬼，
仕途堵塞不通
en: If the Self harms Pressure,
the path of office is blocked

zh: 世乃求名之人，若持官鬼或得官鬼生合，功名有望；
若临子孙，则克制官鬼，是仕途未通，徒去求谋无济。
yi: 世爻是求名的人，如果持官鬼，或者得官鬼生合，功名有望；
如果临子孙，就克制官鬼，是仕途还没有通，白去求谋也没有用。
en: The Self is the man seeking a name; if it holds Pressure, or is given life or combined by Pressure, fame and rank are within hope;
if it stands on Output, then it controls Pressure, which means the path of office is not yet open and seeking and scheming in vain is of no avail.

title: 求名·妻财助鬼父爻空可图侥幸：父母空亡而财爻发动生扶官鬼侥幸可成；财官两动而父爻旬空反不宜用，父爻不空可望

rule.yi: 父母爻空亡，如果财爻发动来生扶官鬼，侥幸可以成；如果财、官两爻都动而父爻在旬空里，反而不宜用这个说法，父爻不空才有希望。
rule.en: If the Resource line is Void but the Wealth line moves to give life and support to Pressure, one may succeed by luck; if Wealth and Pressure both move and the Resource line is in the Void, this saying must not be used, and there is hope only if the Resource line is not Void.

note.yi: 这一联是上一联「财若交重」的例外：一般财克父，但父爻已经空了、文章靠不住时，反要借财去生官，所以说「可图侥幸」；注里又把这个例外收紧（财官两动而父旬空，又不宜）。
note.en: This couplet is an exception to the earlier "if Wealth moves": ordinarily Wealth controls Resource, but when the Resource line is already Void and the writing cannot be relied on, one borrows Wealth to give life to Pressure, hence "one may try for luck"; the commentary then tightens the exception (when Wealth and Pressure both move and the Resource line is in the Void it is again unsuitable).

yi: 妻财帮助官鬼、而父爻落空，
可以图个侥幸
en: If Wealth helps Pressure while the Resource line is Void,
one may try for luck

zh: 父母空亡，若得财爻发动生扶官鬼，侥幸可成；
若财官两动而父爻旬空，反不宜用，父爻不空可望。
yi: 父母爻空亡，如果财爻发动来生扶官鬼，侥幸可成；
如果财、官两爻都动而父爻旬空，反而不宜用这个说法，父爻不空才有希望。
en: If the Resource line is Void but the Wealth line moves to give life and support to Pressure, luck may bring success;
If Wealth and Pressure both move and the Resource line is in the Void, this saying must not be used; there is hope only if the Resource line is not Void.

title: 求名·福德变官身位合亦忝科名：正卦无官而子孙变出官鬼、与世身生合、文书有气，功名有望但不能高中

rule.yi: 本卦没有官鬼，如果子孙变出官鬼，和世爻、卦身生合，文书有气，功名有望，但不能高中。
rule.en: If the original hexagram has no Pressure but Output changes into Pressure and gives life to or combines with the Self and Body, and the document line has breath, fame and rank are within hope, but one cannot pass high.

yi: 福德（子孙）变出官爻，和世身相合，
也能勉强玷列科名
en: If Output changes into the official star and combines with the Self and Body,
one may also unworthily share the roll of fame

zh: 正卦无官，若得子孙变出官鬼，与世身生合，得文书有气，功名有望，但不能高中也。
yi: 本卦没有官鬼，如果子孙变出官鬼，和世爻、卦身生合，文书有气，功名有望，但不能高中。
en: If the original hexagram has no Pressure but Output changes into Pressure and gives life to or combines with the Self and Body, and the document line has breath, fame and rank are within hope, but one cannot pass high.

title: 求名·出现无情难遂青云之志：卦中官父不持临身世反临应爻，或发动反生他爻不来生合世身，或破坏墓绝，皆谓出现无情，虽在卦中与我无益

rule.yi: 官爻、父爻出现在卦中却无情：不持临身、世，反而临在应爻上，或者发动却去生别的爻、不来生合世爻和卦身，或者被破坏、入墓、逢绝，虽在卦中，对我没有益处，难遂青云之志。
rule.en: Present but without feeling: the Pressure and Resource lines are in the hexagram but do not hold or stand on the Body or Self and instead stand on the Other, or move but give life to another line and do not give life to or combine with the Self and Body, or are spoiled, in the tomb or extinct; though in the hexagram they do one no good, and it is hard to fulfil the ambition to rise to the clouds.

yi: 出现却无情，
难以实现青云之志
en: Present but without feeling,
it is hard to fulfil the ambition to rise to the clouds

zh: 卦中官父若不持临身世，反而临应爻，或发动而反生他爻，不来生合世身，或破坏墓绝，皆谓出现无情，虽在卦中，与我无益，所以难遂青云之志也。
yi: 卦中的官爻、父爻如果不持临身、世，反而临在应爻上，或者发动却去生别的爻，不来生合世爻和卦身，或者被破坏、入墓、逢绝，都叫出现无情；虽然在卦中，对我没有益处，所以难遂青云之志。
en: If the Pressure and Resource lines in the hexagram do not hold or stand on the Body or Self but instead stand on the Other, or move but give life to another line and do not come to give life to or combine with the Self and Body, or are spoiled, in the tomb or extinct, it is called present but without feeling; though they are in the hexagram they do me no good, which is why it is hard to fulfil the ambition to rise to the clouds.

title: 求名·伏藏有用终辞白屋之人：官爻不现，观其所伏何处，如得有用之官爻，元值年当辞白屋

rule.yi: 官爻不出现，看它伏在哪里；如果是有用的官爻，到它自己地支值年的那一年，就会告别平民的白屋。
rule.en: If the Pressure line does not appear, look where it lies hidden; if it is a useful Pressure line, in the year of its own branch one will leave the white cottage.

note.yi: 「元值年」书里没有解释，从上下文看是这个官爻自己的地支轮到当年（流年）的那一年，译文按此译。
note.en: The book does not explain the "year of its own branch"; from the context it is the year in which the branch of that Pressure line comes round as the year, and the translation reads it so.

yi: 伏藏的爻有用，
终究是能告别白屋的人
en: A hidden line that is of use
makes a man who in the end leaves the white cottage

zh: 官爻不现，但观其所伏何处，如得有用之官爻，元值年当辞白屋矣。
yi: 官爻不出现，只要看它伏在哪里，如果得到有用的官爻，元值年就会告别白屋。
en: If the Pressure line does not appear, look only where it lies hidden; if one gets a useful Pressure line, in the year of its own branch one will leave the white cottage.

title: 求名·月建克身当被责、财如生世必帮粮：月建在身爻发动刑克世而官爻失时必遭杖责；官爻持世而财爻发动生合世必有帮粮之喜

rule.yi: 月建在身爻上、发动刑克世爻，而官爻失时，必遭杖责；卦中官爻持世、财爻发动生合世爻，必有得帮粮的喜事。
rule.en: If the Month is on the Body line and moves to punish and control the Self while the Pressure line is out of season, one will surely be caned; if the Pressure line holds the Self in the hexagram and the Wealth line moves to give life to and combine with the Self, there will surely be the joy of a grain allowance.

note.yi: 「帮粮」是廪生之外官府另给的补助口粮（增删卜易岁考章里「优等帮粮」是同一件事，LY.EXAM.ZS.18）。「失时」是爻没有得月令（休囚）。
note.en: A "grain allowance" is the supplementary ration the government gave in addition to the stipend (the "excellent grade with a grain allowance" in the Zengshan Buyi chapter on the annual examination is the same thing, LY.EXAM.ZS.18).
