"Out of season" means the line has not got the month's command (it is resting or trapped).

yi: 月建克卦身，就会被责罚；
财爻如果生世，必有帮粮（的好处）
en: If the Month controls the Body, one will be reproved;
if Wealth gives life to the Self, one will surely get the grain allowance

zh: 月建若在身爻，发动刑克世爻，而官爻失时者，必遭杖责；
卦中官爻持世，而财爻发动生合世爻者，必有帮粮之喜。
yi: 月建如果在身爻上，发动刑克世爻，而官爻又失时（无气）的，必定遭杖责；
卦中官爻持世，而财爻发动生合世爻的，必有得帮粮的喜事。
en: If the Month is on the Body line and moves to punish and control the Self while the Pressure line is out of season, one will surely be caned;
if the Pressure line holds the Self in the hexagram and the Wealth line moves to give life to and combine with the Self, there will surely be the joy of a grain allowance.

title: 求名·父官三合相逢连科及第：卦有三合会成官局必连科及第，会成父局亦吉

rule.yi: 父爻、官星三合相遇，接连考中：卦中三合会成官局，必定接连及第，会成父局也吉。
rule.en: If the Resource line and the official star meet in a three-harmony one passes in successive examinations: a three-harmony forming a Pressure frame in the hexagram means one will surely pass in successive examinations, and forming a Resource frame is also auspicious.

yi: 父爻、官星三合相遇，
接连考中
en: If the Resource line and the official star meet in a three-harmony,
one passes in successive examinations

zh: 卦有三合会成官局者，必主连科及第，会成父局亦吉。
yi: 卦中有三合会成官局的，必主接连科举及第，会成父局也吉。
en: If the hexagram has a three-harmony forming a Pressure frame, one will surely pass in successive examinations; forming a Resource frame is also auspicious.

title: 求名·龙虎二爻俱动一举成名：青龙白虎俱在卦中动来生合世爻必中魁选，持官父或持身世尤妙

rule.yi: 青龙、白虎两爻都动，一考就成名：两样都在卦中、动来生合世爻，必定中魁选；若又持官爻、父爻或持身、世就更好。
rule.en: If the Azure Dragon and White Tiger lines both move, one makes a name at a single stroke: if both are in the hexagram and move to give life to or combine with the Self, one will surely be chosen at the head, and it is better still if they hold the official star or Resource, or hold the Body or Self.

note.yi: 通常白虎是凶神，这里青龙白虎「俱动生合世爻」却是吉：因为它们是六神，吉凶要看它们生合的是什么爻。
note.en: The White Tiger is ordinarily a baleful spirit, but here the Azure Dragon and White Tiger moving "to give life to and combine with the Self" are auspicious: as six-spirit lines, their good or ill depends on which line they give life to and combine with.

yi: 青龙、白虎两爻都动，
一考就成名
en: If the Azure Dragon and White Tiger lines both move,
one makes a name at a single stroke

zh: 青龙白虎俱在卦中，动来生合世爻，必中魁选；
若持官父或持身世尤妙。
yi: 青龙、白虎都在卦中，动来生合世爻，必中魁选；
如果（青龙、白虎）持官爻、父爻或者持身、世就更好。
en: If the Azure Dragon and White Tiger are both in the hexagram and move to give life to or combine with the Self, one will surely be chosen at the head;
it is better still if they hold the official star or Resource, or hold the Body or Self.

title: 求名·杀化生身之鬼恐发青衣：以子孙为煞，乘旺发动必遭斥退；得化鬼爻生世终不脱白，无过降青衣；卦有财动合住子孙可用资财谋旧职

rule.yi: 子孙是求名的煞，趁旺发动必被斥退；如果变出官鬼来生世，终究不至于被削成白身，最多降为青衣；卦中有财动来合住子孙，可以用钱财去谋求保住旧职。
rule.en: Output is the baleful spirit in seeking a name, and if it moves while strong one is surely dismissed; if it changes into a Pressure line that gives life to the Self, one is in the end not stripped to a commoner and at worst demoted to the blue gown; if Wealth moves in the hexagram and combines with Output and holds it, one may use money to try to keep one's former post.

note.yi: 「脱白」「青衣」书里没有解释；这一联讲的是已经有功名（生员）的人遇到子孙发动被斥退的情形，「脱白」译作「被削成白身」、「青衣」译作「降为青衣（较低的身份）」是按上下文（斥退—不脱白—降青衣）读出来的，只供参考。
note.en: The book does not explain "stripped to white" or "the blue gown"; this couplet concerns one who already has a degree (a licentiate) and is dismissed when Output moves, and "stripped to a commoner" and "demoted to the blue gown (a lower standing)" are read from the context (dismissed, not stripped, demoted), for reference only.

yi: 煞神（子孙）变出生身的官鬼，
恐怕被打发成青衣
en: If the baleful spirit changes into a Pressure line that gives life to the Body,
one fears being sent down to the blue gown

zh: 以子孙为煞，乘旺发动必遭斥退，若得化鬼爻生世，终不脱白，无过降青衣而已。
卦有财动合住子孙，可用资财谋能干旧职。
yi: 以子孙为煞，趁旺发动必定被斥退；如果得变出官鬼爻来生世，终究不会被削去身份，不过降为青衣罢了。
如果卦中有财爻动来合住子孙，可以用钱财去谋求保住旧职。
en: Taking Output as the baleful spirit, if it moves while strong he will surely be expelled; if a Pressure line it changes into gives life to the Self, he will in the end not be stripped to a commoner, and at worst is only demoted to the blue gown.
If Wealth moves in the hexagram and combines with Output and holds it, one may use money to try to keep one's former post.

title: 求名·岁加有气之官终登黄甲：太岁最喜有情，临鬼爻是人臣面君之象，更得生旺有气必然名姓高标

rule.yi: 太岁加在有气的官爻上，终究登上黄甲：太岁最喜有情，临官鬼爻是臣子面见君主的象，再得生旺有气，名姓必然高高标榜。
rule.en: If Tai Sui is added to a Pressure line that has breath, one will in the end enter the Yellow List: Tai Sui most wants to be favourable, standing on the Pressure line is the image of a minister before his sovereign, and if it is further given life and strength and has breath, one's name will surely be set high.

yi: 太岁加在有气的官爻上，
终究登上黄甲
en: If Tai Sui is added to a Pressure line that has breath,
one will in the end enter the Yellow List

zh: 太岁之爻最喜有情，若临鬼爻，是人臣面君之象，更得生旺有气，必然名姓高标。
yi: 太岁这一爻最喜欢有情，如果临官鬼爻，是臣子面见君主的象，再得生旺有气，必定名姓高标。
en: The Tai Sui line most wants to be favourable; if it stands on the Pressure line, it is the image of a minister before his sovereign, and if it is further given life and strength and has breath, one's name will surely be set high.

title: 求名·病阻试期无故空临于世位：动爻日辰来伤世爻而世爻落空大凶，试前占去不成，强去终不利，轻则病重则死

rule.yi: 无缘无故病倒耽误考期，是空亡临在世位：动爻、日辰来伤世爻而世爻又落空，是大凶的象；考试前占，说去不成，勉强去终归不利，轻的生病，重的死亡。
rule.en: Being blocked from the examination by illness for no reason is Void standing on the Self's position: a moving line or the Day harming the Self while the Self falls Void is a sign of great ill; if divined before the examination that going will not come about, going by force is in the end unfavourable, lightly it is illness and heavily death.

yi: 无缘无故病倒、耽误考期，
是因为空亡临在世爻的位置上
en: If one is blocked from the examination date by illness for no reason,
it is because Void stands on the position of the Self

zh: 动爻日辰来伤世爻，而世爻落空，大凶之象。
试前占去不成，强去终不利，轻则病，重则死。
yi: 动爻、日辰来伤世爻，而世爻又落空，是大凶的象。
考试前占，说去不成，勉强去终归不利，轻的生病，重的死亡。
en: If a moving line or the Day comes to harm the Self and the Self falls Void, it is a sign of great ill.
If divined before the examination that going will not come about, going by force is in the end unfavourable, lightly it is illness and heavily death.

title: 求名·喜添场屋有情龙合于身爻：大象既吉更得青龙动生合世身，不但名成，必然别有喜事；空动则出空之月日见喜

rule.yi: 大局已吉，再得青龙动来生合世爻和卦身，不但成名，必定另有喜事；如果是空而动，出空的月、日有喜。
rule.en: If the overall figure is already auspicious and the Azure Dragon moves to give life to and combine with the Self and Body, not only will one win a name but there will surely be other joy besides; if it is Void and moving, the joy comes in the month or day it leaves the Void.

note.yi: 「场屋」是考场里一间间的号舍；「空动」是落空而又发动，应期在出空（出旬）的月日。
note.en: "Examination cells" are the numbered cubicles in the examination hall; "Void and moving" is a line that is Void and also moving, whose time is the month or day it leaves the Void (leaves the ten-day period).

yi: 喜上加喜，考场里也有情，
青龙合在身爻上
en: A further joy: the examination cells show feeling,
if the Azure Dragon combines with the Body line

zh: 若大象既吉，更得龙动生合世身，不但名成，必然别有喜事；
yi: 如果大的格局已经吉，再得青龙动来生合世爻和卦身，不但成名，必定另有喜事；
如果是空而动，出空的月、日见喜。
en: If the overall figure is already auspicious and the Azure Dragon moves to give life to and combine with the Self and Body, not only will one win a name but there will surely be other joy besides;
if it is Void and moving, the joy comes in the month or day it leaves the Void.

title: 求名·财伏逢空行粮必乏：六爻无财、伏财又居空地，必乏行粮盘缠

rule.yi: 财爻伏藏又逢空，路上的口粮必定不足：六爻里没有财爻，伏着的财又落在空地，必定缺少行粮、盘缠。
rule.en: If Wealth lies hidden and meets Void, the travelling provisions will surely run short: with no Wealth among the six lines and the hidden Wealth in a Void place, provisions and travelling expenses will surely fall short.

yi: 财爻伏藏又逢空，
路上的口粮必定不足
en: If Wealth lies hidden and meets Void,
the travelling provisions will surely run short

zh: 六爻无财，伏财又居空地，必乏行粮，盘缠欠缺。
yi: 六爻里没有财爻，伏着的财又落在空地，必定缺少行粮，盘缠不足。
en: If there is no Wealth among the six lines and the hidden Wealth is in a Void place, provisions will surely run short and the travelling expenses fall short.

title: 求名·身兴变鬼来试方成：卦遇不成之兆，而身、世爻变出官鬼有气、父母不坏，下帷可中（来年再考才成）

rule.yi: 卦里有不成的兆头，但卦身、世爻变出有气的官鬼、父母爻又没有坏，闭门苦读（下帷）可以考中，要等下一次考试才成。
rule.en: If the hexagram shows a sign of failure but the Body or Self line changes into a Pressure line that has breath and the Resource line is not spoiled, one may pass by shutting oneself away to study, and success comes only on the next sitting.

note.yi: 「下帷」是放下帷幕闭门读书（汉代董仲舒下帷讲诵）。「来试方成」是这一科不中，下一次才成。增删卜易也引过「身兴变鬼，来试方成」（LY.EXAM.ZS.40），说这类讲卦身的旧说它试过不灵，只在世爻上灵验。
note.en: "Lowering the curtain" is shutting oneself away to study (from Dong Zhongshu of the Han, who taught behind a lowered curtain). "Success on the next sitting" means failing this time and succeeding the next. The Zengshan Buyi also quotes "the Body flourishes and changes into Pressure, success comes only on the next sitting" (LY.EXAM.ZS.40) and says that of these old sayings about the Body it found them inaccurate and true only of the Self line.

yi: 卦身兴旺变出官鬼，
要到下一回考试才成
en: If the Body flourishes and changes into Pressure,
success comes only on the next sitting

zh: 卦遇不成之兆，而得身世爻变官鬼有气，而父母不坏者，下帷可中也。
yi: 卦遇到不成的兆头，而得到身爻、世爻变出官鬼有气，父母爻又没有坏的，闭门读书（下帷）就可以考中。
en: If the hexagram shows a sign of failure but the Body or Self line changes into a Pressure line that has breath, and the Resource line is not spoiled, one may pass by shutting oneself away to study.

title: 求名·卦值六冲此去难题雁塔、爻逢六合这回必占鳌头：占功名得六冲卦必难成，得六合卦必易得

rule.yi: 占功名，得六冲卦一定难成，得六合卦一定容易得到。
rule.en: In divining for fame and rank, a Six-Clash hexagram is surely hard to achieve and a Six-Combine hexagram surely easy to gain.

dispute.yi: 这里（王洪绪注）断得很干脆：得六冲卦必难成，得六合卦必易得。增删卜易（野鹤）不赞成一刀切：六冲卦只要官、父、世爻都旺，不必再占，竟断必发；欠旺的另占一卦再断；六合卦也要官、父、世都得地，有一个失陷又无生扶，六合也没有益处（LY.EXAM.ZS.36）。野鹤还记了旧注「卦逢六冲，冲之即散」，说他见过六冲而世、父皆旺的卦应了高中。
dispute.en: Here (Wang Hongxu's commentary) judges flatly: a Six-Clash is surely hard to achieve and a Six-Combine surely easy to gain. The Zengshan Buyi (the Old Man of Yehe) does not accept a blanket rule: a Six-Clash hexagram in which the official star, Resource and Self are all strong needs no second divination and one judges outright that one will succeed; one lacking in strength should be divined again; a Six-Combine also needs the official star, Resource and Self all well placed, and if one is lost with no life or support even a Six-Combine is of no use (LY.EXAM.ZS.36). The Old Man of Yehe also records the old note, "a hexagram meeting a Six-Clash is scattered by the clash", and says he has seen a Six-Clash with the Self and Resource both strong come out in a high pass.

yi: 卦遇上六冲，
这一去难以在雁塔题名；
爻遇上六合，
这一回一定夺得鳌头
en: If the hexagram is a Six-Clash,
this time it is hard to inscribe one's name at the Wild Goose Pagoda;
if the lines meet a Six-Combine,
this time one will surely take the head of the turtle

zh: 占功名，得六冲卦必难成，得六合卦必易得也。
yi: 占功名，得六冲卦一定难成，得六合卦一定容易得到。
en: In divining for fame and rank, a Six-Clash hexagram is surely hard to achieve and a Six-Combine hexagram surely easy to gain.

title: 求名·父旺官衰可惜刘蒉之下第、父衰官旺堪嗟张奭之登科：父母官鬼皆宜有力无损；父旺而官空亡或不上卦文好不能中式，父衰而官旺动扶起文书文平亦可成名

rule.yi: 父母爻、官鬼都宜有力而没有损伤才可成功名：父爻旺相而官鬼空亡或不上卦，文字再好也不能中式；父爻衰弱而官爻旺动、扶起文书，文字平常也可许他成名。
rule.en: The Resource and Pressure lines should both be strong and unharmed for fame and rank to be achieved: with the Resource line thriving but Pressure Void or absent from the hexagram, however fine the writing one cannot pass; with the Resource line weak but the Pressure line strong and moving and raising the document line up, one may be granted a name even if the writing is ordinary.

note.yi: 刘蒉、张奭是唐代的两位应试者（书里只提名字、没有讲故事）：一个文章好却落第，一个文章平常却登科，正对着「父旺官衰」「父衰官旺」。增删卜易乡试会试章有同一对意思（「父旺官衰，终须下第」「父衰官旺，堪许登科」，LY.EXAM.ZS.37、38）。
note.en: Liu Fen and Zhang Shi were two Tang examination candidates (the book gives only the names and tells no stories): one failed with fine writing and the other passed with ordinary writing, matching "Resource strong, Pressure weak" and "Resource weak, Pressure strong". The Zengshan Buyi chapter on the provincial and metropolitan examinations has the same pair ("with Resource strong and the official star weak one fails in the end", "with Resource weak and the official star strong one may be granted success", LY.EXAM.ZS.37 and 38).

yi: 父爻旺、官星衰，
可惜，像刘蒉那样落第；
父爻衰、官星旺，
可叹，像张奭那样登科
en: With Resource strong and Pressure weak,
it is a pity, as with Liu Fen, who failed;
with Resource weak and Pressure strong,
it is worth a sigh, as with Zhang Shi, who passed

zh: 父母官鬼皆宜有力无损，功名可成。
若父母爻旺相，官鬼空亡，或不上卦，文字虽好不能中式，如刘蒉之锦绣文章，竟不登第；
若父爻衰弱，得官爻旺动扶起文书，文字虽平常，可许成名，如张奭之文章，虽欠精美，反登高第也。
yi: 父母爻、官鬼都宜有力量而没有损伤，功名才可成。
如果父母爻旺相，官鬼空亡或不上卦，文字虽然好也不能中式，就像刘蒉的锦绣文章，竟然没有登第；
如果父爻衰弱，得官爻旺而动，扶起文书，文字虽然平常，可以许他成名，就像张奭的文章，虽然欠精美，反而登了高第。
en: The Resource and Pressure lines should both be strong and unharmed, and then fame and rank can be achieved.
If the Resource line is thriving but Pressure is Void or absent from the hexagram, however fine the writing one cannot pass, like Liu Fen's brocade essays, which failed to win him the degree;

If the Resource line is weak but the Pressure line is strong and moving and raises the document line up, though the writing is ordinary one may be granted a name, like Zhang Shi's essay, which lacked polish yet won a high place.

title: 求名·应合日生必资鹗荐、动伤日克还守鸡窗：父官化绝名必不成；应爻、动爻或月建日辰扶起官鬼，必须浼人推荐或用财资求才可成

rule.yi: 应爻来合、日辰来生，必靠推荐；动爻受伤、被日辰克，还得守着鸡窗读书。父爻、官星变绝，名必不成；如果应爻、动爻或月建、日辰扶起官鬼，必须托人推荐，或者用钱财去求才可成。
rule.en: If the Other combines and the Day gives life, one will surely rely on a recommendation; if the moving line is harmed and the Day controls it, one must go on keeping to the chicken window. If the Resource line or the official star changes into extinction, the name will surely not be made; if the Other line, a moving line, the Month or the Day raises the Pressure line up, one must ask someone to recommend one or use money to seek it, and then it can succeed.

note.yi: 这一联增删卜易（乡试会试章）引过并各自讲了喜忌（LY.EXAM.ZS.38、39）。「浼人」是请托别人；「用财资求」是花钱去谋求。
note.en: The Zengshan Buyi (chapter on the provincial and metropolitan examinations) quotes this couplet and discusses each half (LY.EXAM.ZS.38 and 39). "Asking a man" is entrusting the matter to someone; "using money to seek it" is spending money to try for it.

yi: 应爻来合、日辰来生，必定靠推荐，
动爻受伤、日辰克它，还得守着鸡窗读书
en: If the Other combines and the Day gives life, one will surely rely on a recommendation,
if the moving line is harmed and the Day controls it, one must go on keeping to the chicken window

zh: 父官化绝，名必不成，若应爻、动爻或月建日辰扶起官鬼，必须浼人推荐，或用财资求可成。
yi: 父爻、官星变绝，名必不成；如果应爻、动爻或月建、日辰扶起官鬼，必须托人推荐，或者用钱财资助去求才可成。
en: If the Resource line or the official star changes into extinction, the name will surely not be made; if the Other line, a moving line, the Month or the Day raises the Pressure line up, one must ask someone to recommend one, or use money to help in seeking it, and then it can succeed.

title: 求名·世动化空用旺则豹变翻成蝴蝶：必中之卦世爻发动变入墓绝，恐成名之后不能享福；游魂卦死于途中、归魂卦到家而死，墓绝爻本太岁逾年而死

rule.yi: 本是必中的卦，但世爻发动变入墓、绝，恐怕成名之后不能享福；游魂卦的死在路上，归魂卦的到家才死，入墓绝的爻就是太岁的，过一年就死。
rule.en: If one has a hexagram of sure success but the Self moves and changes into the tomb or extinction, one fears that after winning the name one cannot enjoy the blessing; with a Wandering Soul hexagram one dies on the road, with a Returning Soul hexagram one dies on reaching home, and if the line that enters the tomb or extinction is Tai Sui itself, one dies after a year.

dispute.yi: 这里（王洪绪注）把「世动化空（入墓绝）」读作成名后不得享福。增删卜易（觉子）引同一联时指出：旧说都是就卦身讲的，野鹤试过不灵，只验于世爻；并举例世爻午火官星化出丑土、官文两旺而丑父旬空，午年入场、丑年中了甲榜——「化空者必应实空之年」，并没有成蝴蝶梦（LY.EXAM.ZS.40）。
dispute.en: Here (Wang Hongxu's commentary) reads "the Self moves into Void (tomb or extinction)" as one winning a name but being unable to enjoy it. The Zengshan Buyi (Juezi), quoting the same couplet, points out that the old sayings all speak of the Body, that the Old Man of Yehe found them inaccurate and true only of the Self line, and gives an example in which the Self, Wu Fire the official star, changed into the Chou Earth writing with the official star and writing both strong and the Chou Resource line in the Void, entered the examination in a Wu year and passed in a Chou year: "a change into Void is answered in the year that fills the Void", and it did not turn into a butterfly dream (LY.EXAM.ZS.40).

note.yi: 「游魂」「归魂」是八宫卦里的两种卦（每宫第七、第八卦），游魂主漂泊、归魂主回家。这一联的「豹变」是君子像豹那样变化（比喻考中后的飞黄腾达）。
note.en: A "Wandering Soul" and a "Returning Soul" are two kinds of hexagram in the eight palaces (the seventh and eighth of each palace), the first meaning drifting and the second coming home. The "leopard's change" is the gentleman changing like a leopard (a figure for rising after passing).

yi: 世爻动而变空、用神旺，
豹变（的好事）反而成了蝴蝶梦
en: If the Self moves and changes into Void while the Subject is strong,
the leopard's change turns instead into a butterfly dream

zh: 若得必中之卦，如遇世爻发动变入墓绝，恐成名之后不能享福。
游魂死于途中，归魂卦到家而死，墓绝爻本太岁，逾年而死也。
yi: 如果得的是必中的卦，但遇到世爻发动变入墓、绝，恐怕成名之后不能享福。
游魂卦（的人）死在路上，归魂卦（的人）到家才死，入墓、入绝的爻如果就是太岁，过了一年就会死。
en: If one has obtained a hexagram of sure success but the Self moves and changes into the tomb or extinction, one fears that after winning the name one cannot enjoy the blessing.

With a Wandering Soul hexagram one dies on the road, with a Returning Soul hexagram one dies on reaching home, and if the line that enters the tomb or extinction is Tai Sui itself, one dies after a year.

title: 求名·身官化鬼月扶则鹏程连步蟾宫：卦身为事体功名尤宜见之怕临财福；官爻临之必有成望，发动化官爻得月建生合必连科及第

rule.yi: 卦身或官爻变出官鬼又有月建扶助，接连登科：卦身是事情的体，占功名尤其宜见到它，怕它临财、福；官爻临在它上面必有成功的希望，若发动变出官爻又得月建生合，必主连科及第。
rule.en: If the Body or the official star changes into Pressure with the Month's support, one passes in succession: the Body is the substance of the matter, and in divining for fame and rank it is especially welcome to see it and one fears it standing on Wealth or Output; with the Pressure line on it there is surely hope of success, and if it moves and changes into the Pressure line and the Month gives life to and combines with it, one will surely pass in successive examinations.

dispute.yi: 这里（王洪绪注）认为卦身得官爻临、发动化官爻又有月建生合就必连科及第。增删卜易（觉子）举了一个卦：巳为卦身，世爻变出子水官星，又得月建生合，正合这一说，却没有连捷，反而因变出的鬼回头克世，后来客死途中——结论是这类讲卦身的旧说「试不验，惟验于世爻」（LY.EXAM.ZS.40）。
dispute.en: Here (Wang Hongxu's commentary) holds that a Body stood on by the Pressure line, or moving and changing into the Pressure line with the Month giving life and combining, will surely pass in successive examinations. The Zengshan Buyi (Juezi) gives a hexagram in which Si was the Body, the Self changed into the Zi Water official star and the Month gave life and combined, exactly as this saying has it, yet the man did not pass in succession and, because the ghost he changed into turned back to control the Self, died on the road later; the conclusion is that of such old sayings about the Body "when tried they were not accurate, and hold true only of the Self line" (LY.EXAM.ZS.40).

note.yi: 「蟾宫」是月宫，旧时以「蟾宫折桂」比喻考中；「鹏程」是大鹏飞行的路程，比喻前程远大。
note.en: The "Toad Palace" is the moon palace, and "breaking a laurel in the Toad Palace" was the figure for passing the examination; the "roc's flight" is the course of the great roc, a figure for a great future.

yi: 卦身、官星变出官鬼又有月建扶助，
就像鹏鸟程程高升，接连登步蟾宫
en: If the Body or official star changes into Pressure with the Month's support,
it is like the roc rising stage after stage, going on step by step in the Toad Palace

zh: 卦身为事体，功名尤宜见之，怕临财福。
如得官爻临之，必有成望，更若发动化官爻，而得月建生合者，必主连科及第。
yi: 卦身是事情的体，占功名尤其宜见到它，怕它临财、福。
如果有官爻临在它上面，必有成功的希望；再如果发动变出官爻，而得月建生合，必主连科及第。
en: The Body is the substance of the matter; in divining for fame and rank it is especially welcome to see it, and one fears it standing on Wealth or Output.

If the Pressure line stands on it there is surely hope of success; and if it moves and changes into the Pressure line and the Month gives life to and combines with it, one will surely pass in successive examinations.

title: 求名·更详本主之爻神方论其人之命运：本主者本人之主爻，自占以世爻论，子侄看子孙爻，此爻最怕伤克变坏

rule.yi: 再要看本主的爻神，才能论这个人的命运：本主是本人的主爻，自己占以世爻论，子侄占看子孙爻等，这一爻最怕被伤克、变坏。
rule.en: Study further the line that is the principal of the person, and then one may judge his fortune: the principal is the person's own chief line, which for oneself is the Self, and for a son or nephew the Output line, and so on; this line most fears being harmed, controlled or changed for the worse.

note.yi: 这一联是整章的收束：前面讲官、父，这里提醒：占的是谁（自己、子侄），就要看谁的主爻，不能只看官父。「本主」就是本人。
note.en: This couplet closes the chapter: the earlier lines speak of Pressure and Resource, and this reminds one that whoever it is that is divined for (oneself, a son or nephew), that person's own chief line must be looked at, and one cannot look only at Pressure and Resource. The "principal" is the person himself.

yi: 再详看本主的爻神，
才能论这个人的命运
en: Study further the line that is the principal,
and then judge that man's fortune

zh: 本主者，本人之主爻也，自占以世爻论，如子侄看子孙爻类，此爻最怕伤克变坏。
yi: 本主，就是本人的主爻：自己占以世爻来论，比如子侄看子孙爻等，这一爻最怕被伤克、变坏。
这样搜寻，吉凶自然就会应验。
en: The principal is the person's own chief line: for oneself it is taken as the Self, and for a son or nephew one looks at the Output line, and so on; this line most fears being harmed, controlled or changed for the worse.
Searching in this way, the auspicious and inauspicious will answer of themselves.

title: 学业章·儒业：世爻、父母爻同旺，日月动爻相生，必成大器；财动卦中青灯不久，子孙持世皓首无成

rule.yi: 学儒业的人，世爻和父母爻都旺，日月、动爻再来生扶，将来一定成大器；反过来，财爻在卦中发动，读书会半途而废，子孙爻持世或发动，一辈子成不了功名。
rule.en: For one studying the scholar's career: if the Self and Resource lines are both strong and the Day, the Month and the moving lines add support, he will surely become a great vessel; the other way round, if Wealth moves in the hexagram he will give up study halfway, and if Output holds the Self or moves he will not win fame and rank in his whole life.

note.yi: 「王家储器」是为朝廷储备的人才；「青灯」是夜里读书的灯；「财动克文章」里的文章就是父母爻（父母爻管文书、文章）。这一章后面的[乾按]是今人按语，不收。
note.en: "A vessel stored up for the royal house" is a talent kept in reserve for the court; the "green lamp" is the lamp one studies by at night; the "writing" that Wealth controls is the Resource line (Resource governs documents and compositions). The "[Qian's note]" at the end of the chapter is a modern comment and is not quoted.

zh: 儒业者，父母世爻同旺，终须变化成龙，日月动爻相生，定是王家储器。
世爻、父母爻皆宜旺相，或动而变吉，或父母持世，日月动爻生合世爻，攀龙附凤，指日可期。
财动克文章，读书中道而废；
子动无官之象，皓首必不成功名。
yi: 学儒业的人，父母爻和世爻都旺，终究会变化成龙；日月、动爻再来相生，一定是朝廷储备的人才。
世爻、父母爻都宜旺相，或者发动变出吉象，或者父母爻持世、日月和动爻生合世爻，那就是攀龙附凤，指日可待。
财爻在卦中发动，青灯苦读的日子不会长；
子孙爻持世，白了头也没有成就。
财动克了文章（父母），读书半途而废；
子孙动，就没有官星的象，白了头也成不了功名。
en: For one who studies the scholar's career, if the Resource and Self lines are both strong, he will in the end transform into a dragon; and if the Day, the Month and the moving lines give them life, he is surely a vessel stored up for the royal house.

The Self and Resource lines should both be thriving, or move and change into an auspicious line, or the Resource line should hold the Self with the Day, the Month and the moving lines giving life to or combining with the Self; then he will cling to the dragon and the phoenix, a matter of days.
If Wealth moves in the hexagram, the green lamp will not burn long;
if the Output line holds the Self, one grows white-haired with nothing achieved.
if Wealth moves and controls the writing (the Resource line), one gives up study halfway;
if Output moves there is no sign of the official star, and even in white hair one will not achieve fame and rank.

title: 学业章·九流、百工：财兴官旺则道重人钦，兄动世衰则有毁无誉；百工以财为用神、子孙为元神，最忌兄爻持世；天师驱邪治鬼之家反以子孙持世为吉（觉子）

rule.yi: 学九流技艺要财爻兴旺、官爻旺相；学百工手艺以财爻为用神、子孙爻为元神，最忌兄弟持世或旺而发动；觉子补充：天师、驱邪治鬼的、师巫和医家，反而要子孙持世或发动才吉，因为靠子孙制鬼。
rule.en: For learning the nine schools of skill, Wealth should be thriving and Pressure strong; for learning a craft, Wealth is the Subject and Output the Support, and what is most feared is Peer holding the Self or being strong and moving; Juezi adds that for Heavenly Masters, exorcists, shamans and physicians, it is the other way round: Output holding the Self or moving is auspicious, since they control ghosts by Output.

note.yi: 九流是各种技艺、行当（书里没有列名单），百工是各行手艺人。觉子这一条是纠正「九流皆以官鬼为吉」：靠制服鬼神吃饭的人，官鬼是他要制的东西，所以反以子孙为吉。「余以求财章同断」的「余」是野鹤老人。
note.en: The "nine schools" are the various skills and trades (the book gives no list) and the "hundred crafts" are the manual trades. Juezi's remark corrects the claim that Pressure is auspicious for all the nine schools: for those who live by subduing ghosts and spirits, Pressure is what they are to subdue, so Output is auspicious for them instead. The "I" in "I judge them together by the chapter on seeking wealth" is the Old Man of Yehe.

zh: 九流者，财兴官旺，道重人钦；
财持世、官持世，财官世爻皆宜得地；
兄动卦中，兄爻持世，只可糊口，难许成家。
yi: 学九流技艺的，财爻兴旺、官爻旺相，所学的道就受人看重、人人佩服；
兄弟动而世爻衰，只有诋毁、没有赞誉。
财爻持世也好，官爻持世也好，财、官、世爻都要得地；
兄弟在卦中发动，或者兄弟爻持世，只能勉强糊口，难以成家立业。
en: For the nine schools, with Wealth thriving and Pressure strong, one's way is valued and people admire one;
if Peer moves and the Self is weak, there is censure and no praise.
Whether Wealth or Pressure holds the Self, Wealth, Pressure and the Self line should all be well placed;
if Peer moves in the hexagram, or the Peer line holds the Self, one can only just make a living and can hardly set up a household.

zh: 觉子曰：古以九流皆以官鬼为吉，殊不知天师家，及驱邪治鬼家、师巫医家，必以子孙持世及子孙发动为吉，盖皆以子旺能于治鬼也。
yi: 觉子说：古人以九流都以官鬼为吉，却不知道天师一类的，以及驱邪治鬼的、师巫和医家，必须以子孙持世以及子孙发动为吉，因为这些人都靠子孙旺，才能治服鬼。
en: Juezi says: the ancients took Pressure as the auspicious line for all nine schools, not knowing that for Heavenly Masters, exorcists who drive out evil and subdue ghosts, and shamans and physicians, it must be Output holding the Self and Output moving that is auspicious, because all of them can control ghosts only when Output is strong.

zh: 百工皆以财为用神，子孙为元神，最忌兄爻持世，及兄爻旺动者，劳碌终身。
yi: 各种工匠都以财爻为用神、子孙爻为元神，最忌兄弟爻持世，以及兄弟爻旺而发动，会劳碌一生。
我用求财章的断法一并来断。
en: For all the crafts, Wealth is the Subject and Output is the Support; what is most feared is the Peer line holding the Self, or the Peer line strong and moving, and one toils all one's life.
I judge them together by the rules of the chapter on seeking wealth.

title: 学业章·世爻忌空破墓绝休囚；世休囚又随鬼入墓、受冲克、动化鬼化绝化克，不唯学业难成还防不测

rule.yi: 学业上世爻最怕落空、受破、入墓、逢绝或休囚，否则诸事无成；世爻休囚，又跟着官鬼入墓，或被日月、动爻冲克，或发动变官鬼、变绝、变克，不但学业难成，还要提防意外。
rule.en: In study the Self line most fears being Void, broken, in the tomb, extinct, or resting and trapped, or nothing will succeed; if the Self is resting and trapped and moreover follows Pressure into the tomb, or is clashed and controlled by the Day, the Month or a moving line, or moves and changes into Pressure, extinction or control, then not only will study be hard to complete but one must guard against the unforeseen.

note.yi: 「随鬼入墓」指世爻跟着官鬼一起入墓，通玄妙论讲过它的三种（LY.CAREER.BSQS.04）。「不测」是意外、不测之祸，书里没有说具体是什么。
note.en: "Following Pressure into the tomb" means the Self follows the Pressure line into the tomb, the three kinds of which are given in the Tongxuan Miaolun (LY.CAREER.BSQS.04). "The unforeseen" is an unexpected misfortune; the book does not say what.

zh: 以上皆不宜世爻空破墓绝休囚，诸事无成。
世若休囚，而又随鬼入墓，及受日月动爻冲克，或动而化鬼、化绝、化克者，不唯学业难成，还防不测。
yi: 以上各种，都不适宜世爻落空、受破、入墓、逢绝或休囚，否则诸事无成。
世爻如果休囚，而且又跟着官鬼入了墓，以及被日月、动爻冲克，或者发动变成官鬼、变绝、变克的，不但学业难成，还要提防意外。
en: In all the above, the Self line must not be Void, broken, in the tomb, extinct, or resting and trapped, or nothing will succeed.

If the Self is resting and trapped, and moreover follows Pressure into the tomb, or is clashed and controlled by the Day, the Month or a moving line, or moves and changes into Pressure, extinction or control, then not only will study be hard to complete but one must guard against the unforeseen.

title: 治经章·占习何经：金作春秋、木作毛诗、水作书经、火为礼记、土为易经，须指定一经祷告「我习此经何如」，再看卦象（觉子）

rule.yi: 占自己该学哪一部经，不能笼统地问：要把五行对五经（金春秋、木毛诗、水书经、火礼记、土易经），指定其中一部，向神祷告说「我学这部经怎么样」，再看得到的卦象决定可不可以。
rule.en: In divining which classic one should take up, one must not ask in general: match the five phases to the five classics (Metal the Spring and Autumn Annals, Wood the Songs, Water the Documents, Fire the Rites, Earth the Changes), name one of them and pray to the spirits, saying "How will it go if I study this classic?", and then decide from the hexagram obtained whether it can be done.

note.yi: 五经在科举里要选一部「本经」专治。这一条是说：占卦时就要点名问哪一部，不要问「我学经怎么样」。原文第二句句末是问号，照录；意思是「看卦象来决定可不可以」。后面的[乾按]不收。
note.en: Under the examination system one chose one of the five classics as one's own to specialise in. This says that in divining one should name the classic in the question and not ask "how will studying a classic go". The second sentence ends in a question mark in the text, which is kept; it means "decide from the hexagram whether it can be done". The [Qian's note] after the chapter is not quoted.

zh: 觉子曰：占以金作春秋、木作毛诗、水作书经、火为礼记、土为易经，占者不可概问，须指定一经祈于神曰：“我习此经何如？”
后视所得之卦象而决其可否？
yi: 觉子说：占的时候，把金当作春秋，木当作毛诗，水当作书经，火当作礼记，土当作易经；占的人不能笼统地问，要指定一部经，向神祷告说：「我学这部经怎么样？」
然后看所得的卦象，来决定可不可以？
这样才不会出错。
en: Juezi says: in divining, take Metal as the Spring and Autumn Annals, Wood as the Songs, Water as the Documents, Fire as the Rites and Earth as the Changes; the one divining must not ask in general, but name one classic and pray to the spirits, saying, "How will it go if I study this classic?"
Then look at the hexagram obtained and decide whether it can be done.
Only so will there be no mistake.

title: 治经章·文旺官兴王家栋梁，世空子动蓬荜寒儒；吉象各举，凶象宜另习一经再诚心卜（附例：酉月丙子日占本经，改经再占，果于子科中魁）

rule.yi: 占所学的经：文章（父母）旺、官星兴旺是国家栋梁；世爻落空、子孙动是寒士。官持世而父动相生，或父母持世、官动相生、日月生世、世动化吉，都是飞腾之兆；世空世破、动变凶、子孙财爻持世、父母官鬼空破，宜另学一部经，诚心再占一次。
rule.en: Divining the classic one studies: with the writing (Resource) strong and the official star thriving one is a pillar of the realm; with the Self Void and Output moving one is a poor scholar. Pressure holding the Self with Resource moving to give it life, or Resource holding the Self with Pressure moving to give life, or the Day or Month giving life to the Self, or the Self moving into an auspicious line, are all signs of soaring; if the Self is Void or broken, or moves into ill, or Output or Wealth holds the Self, or Resource and Pressure are Void or broken, one should study another classic and divine again with sincerity.

note.yi: 这一条的例子是三个卦连着：第一卦「益之观」断为官旺合世但文章被回头克，宜改经；第二卦占易经「天火同人」，旺官持世却父爻临月破，还要再改；第三卦占书经「丰之离」，旺父持世、官动生之，只因子日冲午火，等下科壬子年冲去午火就应。「官持世、父动相生」后面的括注「疑为父持世、官动相生」是整理本里的校语（书里没有标是谁写的），照录。后面的[乾按]不收。
note.en: The example is three hexagrams in a row: the first, "Yi changing to Guan", is judged as a strong Pressure line combining with the Self but with the writing controlled by a line turning back on it, so one should change classic; the second, for the Changes, "Heaven over Fire, Tongren", has a strong Pressure line holding the Self but the Resource line on the Month-break, so one must change again; the third, for the Documents, "Feng changing to Li", has a strong Resource line holding the Self with Pressure moving to give it life, and the only fault is that the Zi day clashes Wu Fire, which is cleared in the next examination in the Ren-Zi year. The bracketed remark "probably Resource holding the Self and Pressure moving to give life" after "Pressure holding the Self, Resource moving to give life" is a correction in the edited text (the book does not say who wrote it) and is kept. The [Qian's note] after it is not quoted.

zh: 官持世、父动相生，（疑为父持世、官动相生。）
或日月临父母生世，或官爻旺相，父爻持世，及世爻动而化吉，皆主飞腾变化之兆。
世空世破，及动而变凶，或子孙财爻持世，父母官鬼空破，须宜另习一经，虔诚再卜。
yi: 文章（父母）旺、官星兴旺，是国家的栋梁；
世爻落空、子孙发动，是蓬门草屋里的寒士。
官爻持世、父爻发动来相生，（疑是父母持世、官爻发动相生。）
或者日月临在父母爻上来生世，或者官爻旺相、父爻持世，以及世爻发动变出吉象，都主有飞黄腾达、变化的预兆。
世爻落空、被破，以及发动变凶，或者子孙、财爻持世，父母、官鬼落空被破，最好另学一部经，诚心再占。
en: With the writing strong and the official star thriving, one is a pillar of the royal house;
with the Self Void and Output moving, one is a poor scholar in a hut of weeds.
With Pressure holding the Self and the Resource line moving to give it life, (probably it should read: Resource holding the Self and Pressure moving to give life.)

Or the Day or the Month stands on the Resource line and gives life to the Self, or the Pressure line is thriving and the Resource line holds the Self, or the Self line moves and changes into an auspicious line: all are signs of soaring and transformation.

If the Self is Void or broken, or moves and changes into an ill line, or Output or Wealth holds the Self, or Resource and Pressure are Void or broken, it is best to study another classic and divine again with sincerity.

zh: 如：酉月丙子日(旬空：申酉)，占本经能发否？
yi: 例如：酉月丙子日（旬空：申、酉），占本经能不能发达？
得「益之观」
en: For example: on a Bing-Zi day in the You month (Void: Shen and You), divining whether one's own classic would bring success?
I obtained "Yi changing to Guan".

zh: 断曰：卦中旺官合世，不宜初爻、朱雀子水文章，皆被未土回头之克，宜于改经。
余曰：古法有之，余占不验，意欲何经，再占一卦。
yi: 断：卦中旺官合世，不宜初爻、朱雀子水文章，都被未土回头之克，宜于改经。
他问：改学哪一部经？
我说：古法有这个说法，但我占了不灵验；你想学哪一部经，再占一卦。
就占易经，得「天火同人」
en: Verdict: the strong Pressure line combines with the Self in the hexagram, but the writing, the Zi Water of the first line with the Vermilion Bird, is controlled by Wei Earth turning back on it, so it is better to change classic.
He asked: which classic should I change to?
I said: the old method has this, but when I divine by it it is not accurate; whichever classic you want, divine once more.
He divined for the Changes and obtained "Heaven over Fire, Tongren".

zh: 旺官持世，虽以为吉，但父临月破，还当再更。
yi: 旺官持世，虽然以为是吉，但父爻临月破，还应当再改。
又占书经，得「丰之离」
en: The strong Pressure line holds the Self, which would be taken as auspicious, but the Resource line stands on the Month-break and one should change again.
He then divined for the Documents and obtained "Feng changing to Li".

zh: 旺父持世，官动生之，只因今日子日，冲动午火伤金，此经相宜，下科壬子，冲去午火，管许高发。
yi: 旺父持世，官动生它，只因今天是子日，冲动午火伤了金，这部经相宜，下一科壬子年，冲去午火，管保高中。
果然在子年一科中了魁首。
en: The strong Resource line holds the Self and the Pressure line moves to give it life; it is only because today is a Zi day that it clashes Wu Fire and harms Metal; this classic suits him, and in the next examination, in the Ren-Zi year, Wu Fire is clashed away, which guarantees high success.
He did indeed pass at the head in the Zi-year examination.

title: 延师章·父爻旺相就而正焉：延师以父母爻为用神，宜旺相、临日月、动而化吉；休囚空破墓绝、动而化凶则有素食之讥无师资之益

rule.yi: 请老师教学，以父母爻为用神：父母爻旺相、临日月、动而变吉，老师可做楷模；休囚、落空被破、入墓绝、动而变凶，老师徒有虚名，得不到益处。
rule.en: In engaging a teacher, the Resource line is the Subject: if it is thriving, stands on the Day or the Month, or moves and changes into an auspicious line, the teacher can be a model; if it is resting and trapped, Void or broken, in the tomb or extinct, or moves and changes into an ill line, he is a teacher in name only and there is no benefit.

note.yi: 「素食之讥」是「尸位素餐」的意思，白吃饭不做事；「师资之益」是从老师那里得到的帮助。
note.en: "Mocked as eating the bread of idleness" means drawing a salary and doing nothing; "the benefit of a teacher" is the help one gets from the teacher.

zh: 父母爻，既为师长，又为诗书。
延师受教，即以此爻为用神。
宜旺相，或临日月，及动而化吉，可式可矜。
如若休囚、空破、墓绝、及动而化凶，有素食之讥，无师资之益。
yi: 父爻旺相，就可以向他求教、得到匡正。
父母爻既代表老师，又代表诗书。
请老师来教，就以这一爻为用神。
宜旺相，或临日月，以及发动变出吉象，就可以做楷模、值得敬重。
如果休囚、落空被破、入墓或绝、以及发动变凶，就会被讥为白吃饭，得不到老师的益处。
en: If the Resource line is thriving, one may go to him and be set right.
The Resource line stands both for the teacher and for the books of poetry and history.
In engaging a teacher for instruction, take this line as the Subject.
It should be thriving, or stand on the Day or the Month, or move and change into an auspicious line; then he can be a model and be respected.
If it is resting and trapped, Void or broken, in a tomb or extinct, or moves and changes into an ill line, he is mocked as eating the bread of idleness, and there is no benefit from the teacher.

title: 延师章·世位相生博约善诱：父旺生合世则成人有德，克世而世得地则有责成之功，世休囚则受师尊之累

rule.yi: 世爻和父爻相生，老师博学守约、善于诱导；父旺生合世，能造就人又有德行；父克世但世爻得地，严教也能成才；世爻休囚，会受老师的拖累。
rule.en: When the Self and the Resource line give each other life, the teacher is learned, restrained and good at drawing one on; if the strong Resource line gives life to or combines with the Self he makes men of his pupils and is virtuous; if it controls the Self but the Self is well placed, his stern demands still bring results; if the Self is resting and trapped, one will be burdened by the teacher.

note.yi: 「博约」出自《论语》的「博我以文，约我以礼」，意思是学问广博又守规矩；「世位相生」指世爻和父爻（老师）互相生。
note.en: "Learned and restrained" comes from the Analects, "he broadened me with letters and restrained me with ritual", meaning broad learning together with discipline; "the Self and the teacher's line give each other life" means the Self and the Resource line (the teacher) give life to each other.

zh: 父旺生合世爻，成人有德；
若克世爻，而世爻得地者，有责成人之功。
世若休囚，必受师尊之累。
yi: 世爻和父爻相生，老师博学守约，善于诱导。
父旺生合世爻，能造就人、有德行；
如果克世爻，而世爻得地的，有严格责成而成就人的功劳。
世爻如果休囚，必定受老师的拖累。
en: When the Self and the teacher's line give each other life, the teacher is learned and restrained and skilled at drawing one on.
If the Resource line is strong and gives life to or combines with the Self, he makes men of his pupils and is virtuous;
if it controls the Self but the Self is well placed, he has the merit of making men through stern demands;
if the Self is resting and trapped, one will surely be burdened by the teacher.

title: 延师章·父入墓中懒于教训，财临世上懦弱不严

rule.yi: 父爻入墓或临绝，不是老师偷安懒惰，就是老师不肯教；财爻持世，是我克了父爻，不是老师教得不严，就是老师怕被我欺凌。
rule.en: If the Resource line enters the tomb or rests on extinction, then unless the teacher is idly seeking ease he will not teach; if Wealth holds the Self, I control the Resource line, and if the teacher is not strict it is because he fears being bullied by me.

note.yi: 「三墓」指五行入墓的三种（火墓戌、金墓丑、木墓未，水土墓辰）；书里没有在这里列出。
note.en: The "three tombs" are the tombs of the five phases (Fire at Xu, Metal at Chou, Wood at Wei, Water and Earth at Chen); the book does not list them here.

zh: 父爻入三墓，及临绝者，若非偷安懒惰，定是师不授教。
财爻持世乃我克父母，若非师教不严，定是我师畏凌。
yi: 父爻入墓，老师懒于教导训诫。
父爻入了三墓，以及临在绝地的，如果不是老师偷安懒惰，就一定是老师不肯传授教导。
财爻临在世爻上，老师软弱不严厉。
财爻持世就是我克父母爻；如果不是老师教得不严，就一定是老师怕被我欺凌。
en: If the Resource line enters the tomb, the teacher is lazy about teaching and admonishing.
If the Resource line enters one of the three tombs, or rests on the extinction stage, then unless the teacher is idly seeking ease he surely will not teach.
If Wealth stands on the Self, the teacher is weak and not strict.
If the Wealth line holds the Self, it is I who control the Resource line; if the teacher is not strict, he is surely afraid of being bullied by me.

title: 延师章·鬼化文书克世则讼由乎学：鬼动化父母冲克世，日后必有争讼；纵有日月动爻制服也不宜，鬼动克世、世动变凶皆不宜从

rule.yi: 官鬼变成父母来冲克世爻，日后一定因学业上的事引出官司；就算日月、动爻能制住官鬼也不适宜，因为眼下制住了，日后官鬼逢生旺还是灾祸；凡官鬼动克世、世动变凶，都不宜跟这位老师学。
rule.en: If the Pressure line changes into Resource and clashes and controls the Self, a lawsuit will arise from the schooling in future; even if the Day, the Month or a moving line subdues Pressure it is unsuitable, for though it is held down for now, when Pressure later meets life and strength there will be calamity and trouble; whenever Pressure moves and controls the Self, or the Self moves into ill, it is unsuitable to follow this teacher.

note.yi: 「神兆机于动」是这一段的理由：神的先兆从动处显出来，所以被制住的鬼只是暂时按下，等它逢生旺会再起。官非的断法另见官非域。
note.en: "The spirits show their omen in what moves" is the reason given: the omen appears in what moves, so a Pressure line that is held down is only suppressed for the moment and will rise again when it meets life and strength. Rules on lawsuits are in the lawsuit domain.

zh: 鬼化文书克世，讼由乎学。
鬼动化父母，冲克世爻，异日必主争讼。
能使日月动爻制服鬼爻，也不相宜，此何故也？
目前虽可制服，他日鬼逢生旺，必见灾非。
不唯鬼动化父，但系鬼动克世，或世动变凶，皆不宜从。
yi: 官鬼变成文书来克世，会因为学业上的事引起官司。
官鬼发动变成父母，冲克世爻，将来一定有争讼。
即使有日月、动爻能制服鬼爻，也不相宜，这是什么缘故呢？
因为神在动处显出先兆。
眼前虽然可以制服，日后官鬼遇到生旺，一定出现灾祸是非。
不只是官鬼动变父母，凡是官鬼发动克世，或者世爻发动变凶，都不适宜跟这位老师学。
en: If Pressure turns into the document line and controls the Self, a lawsuit will arise from the schooling.
If the Pressure line moves and changes into Resource and clashes and controls the Self, there will surely be a quarrel and lawsuit in future.
Even if the Day, the Month or a moving line can subdue the Pressure line, it is still unfavourable; why is that?
Because the spirits show their omen in what moves.
Though it can be subdued for now, when Pressure meets life and strength later, calamity and trouble will surely appear.
Not only when Pressure moves and turns into Resource: whenever Pressure moves and controls the Self, or the Self moves and changes into an ill line, it is unsuitable to follow this teacher.

title: 延师章·月扶世爻日助生世则青出于蓝；动衰变旺先惰后勤、动旺变衰后怠；父化父殊经、化财多病、化鬼显贵之交、化兄贪财好利

rule.yi: 世爻旺相、父母持世或官星持世又得日月动爻生扶，学生必有长进、青出于蓝；父爻由衰变旺老师先惰后勤，由旺变衰老师后来懈怠；父化父教的经不同，化财多病，化官鬼是结交显贵的人，化兄弟是贪财好利的人。
rule.en: If the Self is thriving, or Resource or the official star holds the Self with the Day, the Month and moving lines giving life and support, the pupil will make progress and surpass the master; a Resource line moving from weak to strong means the teacher is lazy first then diligent, and from strong to weak, slack later; Resource turning into Resource, he teaches a different classic; into Wealth, he is often ill; into Pressure, he keeps company with the eminent; into Peer, he is greedy for money and profit.

note.yi: 原文「动旺变衰，后勤后怠」的「后勤」应是「先勤」之误（与前一句「先惰后勤」对仗，下面一条也说「父爻旺而化空破墓绝、化退神，皆主后怠」），译文按「先勤后怠」译。「殊经」是教的经和一般的不同，书里没有说是什么经。
note.en: In the line "moving from strong to weak, diligent later, slack later" the first "later" is a slip for "first" (it balances the line before, "lazy first, diligent later", and the next entry says that a strong Resource line changing into Void, break, tomb, extinction or a Retreating line indicates slackness later); the translation reads it as "first diligent, then slack". "A different classic" means the classic he teaches is not the usual one; the book does not say which.

zh: 月扶世爻，日助生世，青出于蓝。
yi: 月建扶着世爻、日辰帮着生世，学生能青出于蓝。
en: If the Month supports the Self line and the Day helps give it life, the pupil will surpass the master.

zh: 世爻旺相，或父母持世，或官星持世、日月动爻生扶，及世爻动而化吉，必有进益，青出于蓝。
yi: 世爻旺相，或者父母持世，或者官星持世、日月和动爻来生扶，以及世爻发动变出吉象，一定有长进，青出于蓝。
从衰的发动变旺，先懒后勤；
从旺的发动变衰，先勤后怠。
en: If the Self line is thriving, or Resource holds the Self, or the official star holds the Self with the Day, the Month and moving lines giving life and support, or the Self moves and changes into an auspicious line, there will surely be progress and the pupil will surpass the master.
Moving from weak to strong, first lazy then diligent;
moving from strong to weak, first diligent then slack.

zh: 父爻衰，而化生、化旺、化日月、化进神，皆主后勤；
父爻旺，而化空破墓绝、化退神，皆主后怠。
父化父而殊经，父化财而多病。
yi: 父爻衰，但变成长生、变旺、变成日月、变进神，都主老师后来勤勉；
父爻旺，却变空、变破、变墓、变绝、变退神，都主老师后来懈怠。
父爻变父爻，老师教的经和别人不同；父爻变财，老师多病。
父爻变官鬼，是和显贵交往的人；
父爻变兄弟，是贪财好利的人。
en: If the Resource line is weak but changes into Birth, into strength, into the Day or the Month, or into an Advancing line, all indicate that the teacher becomes diligent later;
if the Resource line is strong but changes into Void, break, tomb, extinction or a Retreating line, all indicate that he becomes slack later.
Resource turning into Resource: he teaches a different classic; Resource turning into Wealth: he is often ill.
Resource turning into Pressure: he is a man who keeps company with the eminent;
Resource turning into Peer: he is greedy for money and profit.
