title: 延师章·三合连年受教，六冲半载难留：世、父爻加日月成三合则情同父子受连年之教，卦得六冲或世克父、父克世则难收一岁之功

rule.yi: 世爻、父爻再加日月成三合，师生情同父子，会受连年教导；卦成六冲，或世爻克父爻、父爻克世爻，彼此不投缘，连一年的成效也难收到。
rule.en: If the Self and Resource lines together with the Day or the Month form a three-harmony, teacher and pupil are as close as father and son and he is taught year after year; if the hexagram is a Six-Clash, or the Self controls the Resource line or the Resource line controls the Self, they do not get on and even a year's result is hard to gain.

zh: 三合连年受教，六冲半载难留。
yi: 三合，连年受教；六冲，半年也难留住。
en: With a three-harmony one is taught year after year; with a Six-Clash not even half a year can be kept.

zh: 世与父爻，兼日月作三合者，情同父子，必受连年之教，门墙始终成就。
卦得六冲，或世克父爻，及父爻克世者，彼此不投，难收一岁之功。
yi: 世爻和父爻，再加日月构成三合的，师生情同父子，必定受连年的教导，门下始终有所成就。
卦成六冲，或者世爻克父爻，以及父爻克世爻的，彼此不投缘，难有一年的成效。
en: If the Self and Resource lines, together with the Day or the Month, form a three-harmony, teacher and pupil are close as father and son, he will surely be taught year after year, and his studies will be accomplished in the end.
If the hexagram is a Six-Clash, or the Self controls the Resource line or the Resource line controls the Self, they do not get on, and it is hard to gain even a year's result.

title: 延师章·为子延师：应为西席、世为东家，宜世应相生合；应生世我得益、应空破延之不来、应动他心有变、世空我意不专；父旺与子孙合名实兼收，父动伤子孙、子动化克不宜延、子动化鬼速谢辞（觉子；附例）

rule.yi: 为儿子请老师：应爻是老师、世爻是东家，宜世应相生相合，不宜相克相冲；应生世我得益，应空破请不来，应动他有变心，世空我自己心意不专。觉子补充：父爻旺又和子孙相合，名实都有；父动伤克子孙，有损无益；子孙动变克，不宜聘请；子孙动变官鬼，应赶快辞退。
rule.en: In engaging a teacher for one's son: the Other is the teacher and the Self is the host; the Self and Other should give life to and combine with each other and not control or clash; if the Other gives life to the Self I gain, if the Other is Void or broken he will not come, if the Other moves he has a change of mind, if the Self is Void my own mind is not set. Juezi adds: a strong Resource line combining with Output gains both name and substance; if Resource moves and harms Output there is harm and no gain; if Output moves and changes into control the man should not be engaged; if Output moves and changes into Pressure he should be thanked and dismissed quickly.

note.yi: 「西席」「东家」是旧时请私塾先生的说法：老师坐西席，主人是东家。这里主人是父亲，所以世爻是父亲（东家），儿子拜师时看子孙爻。前面「延师受教，以父母爻为用神」是自己拜师的取法；这一条是父亲为儿子请老师，多看世应，再加子孙爻。后面的[乾按]不收。
note.en: "The west seat" and "the host" are the old way of speaking of hiring a private-school teacher: the teacher sits in the west seat and the master of the house is the host. Here the master is the father, so the Self is the father; when the son takes a teacher, the Output line is also looked at. The earlier line, "in engaging a teacher for instruction take the Resource line as the Subject", is for a man taking a teacher himself; this one is for a father engaging a teacher for his son, so the Self and Other are looked at first, with the Output line added. The [Qian's note] after it is not quoted.

zh: 父为子而延师者，应为西席，世乃东家，宜世应相生相合，不宜相克相冲。
yi: 做父亲的为儿子请老师：应爻是西席（老师），世爻是东家，宜世应相生相合，不宜相克相冲。
应生世，我得到他的益处；
应爻落空被破，请他也请不来；
应爻动，他心里有变化；
世爻空，我自己心意不专。
en: A father engaging a teacher for his son: the Other is the guest in the west seat (the teacher) and the Self is the host; the Self and Other should give life to and combine with each other, and not control or clash with each other.
If the Other gives life to the Self, I gain from him;
if the Other is Void or broken, he will not come when invited;
if the Other moves, he has a change of mind;
if the Self is Void, my own mind is not set.

zh: 觉子曰：虽以世应为主，父爻必不可缺，父旺与子孙相合，名实兼收。
父动伤克子孙，无益有损；
yi: 觉子说：虽然以世应为主，父爻一定不可缺少；父爻旺又和子孙相合，名和实都得到。
父爻动而伤克子孙，没有益处反有损害；
子孙动而变克，不宜聘请；
子孙动而变官鬼，应当赶快谢绝辞退。
en: Juezi says: although the Self and Other are the main thing, the Resource line must not be missing; if it is strong and combines with Output, both name and substance are gained.
If the Resource line moves and harms Output, there is no benefit and harm instead;
if Output moves and changes into control, he should not be engaged;
if Output moves and changes into Pressure, he should be thanked and dismissed quickly.

zh: 如：寅月戊午日(旬空：子丑)，占子从师，得“旅之离”
yi: 例如：寅月戊午日（旬空：子、丑），占儿子拜师，得「旅之离」
en: For example: on a Wu-Wu day in the Yin month (Void: Zi and Chou), divining for a son taking a teacher, I obtained "Lü changing to Li".

zh: 不听，后因师责，逃至桥头，跌折左足。
yi: 子孙动而变克，不宜跟从他。
不听，后来因为老师责罚，逃到桥头，跌断了左脚。
en: Output moves and changes into control: it is unsuitable to follow him.
He did not heed it, and afterwards, because the teacher reproved him, he ran off to the bridge and broke his left foot in a fall.

title: 求名章·占小考须先占县考、再占府考、又占道考，都得吉卦才许榜上有名；内有一卦不吉，勿望道考成名（野鹤）

rule.yi: 占小考（县考、府考、道考这几关），神应近不应远，一卦吉只应在府县有名；所以要先占县考，再占府考，又占道考，三卦都吉才可以说榜上有名，有一卦不吉，就别指望道考成名。
rule.en: For the minor examinations (the county, prefecture and circuit examinations): the spirits answer what is near and not what is far, so one auspicious hexagram answers only for the name being on the county or prefecture list; one must divine the county examination first, then the prefecture, then the circuit, and only when all three are auspicious may one say the name will be on the list; if one of them is not auspicious, do not hope for fame at the circuit examination.

note.yi: 「小考」是科举里考秀才之前的考试：县考、府考、道考（道是提学道，管一省学政的官），考过才得进县学成生员。这一条是野鹤自己的说明，[乾按]说「若以一卦而断数考必大谬」，是今人按语，不收。
note.en: The "minor examinations" are the examinations before the one that makes a licentiate: the county, prefecture and circuit examinations (the circuit being the education intendant who ran the schools of a province); passing them lets one enter the county school and become a student. This is the Old Man of Yehe's own explanation; the [Qian's note] saying that judging several examinations by one hexagram is a great mistake is a modern comment and is not quoted.

zh: 野鹤曰：或问凡占小考，尝见卜得吉卦，后竟道考无名者，何也？
余曰：神每应近而不应远，已吉卦者，乃应府县之有名也，故凡占小考者，必须先占县考，再占府考，又占道考，俱得吉卦者，许之榜上有名。
内有一卦而不吉者，勿望道考而成名也。
yi: 野鹤说：有人问，凡是占小考，常常看到占得吉卦，后来竟然道考没有名字，这是为什么？
我说：神常常应近的、不应远的，已经得吉卦的，是应在府县有名；所以凡是占小考的，必须先占县考，再占府考，又占道考，都得吉卦的，才许他榜上有名。
其中有一卦不吉的，不要指望道考能成名。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: someone asked, "In divining for the minor examinations I have often seen an auspicious hexagram obtained and then the name still did not appear at the circuit examination; why is that?"

I said: the spirits usually answer what is near and not what is far; an auspicious hexagram already obtained answers that the name will be on the county and prefecture lists; so for the minor examinations one must first divine the county examination, then the prefecture examination, then the circuit examination, and only if all give auspicious hexagrams may one say that the name will be on the list.
If any one of them is not auspicious, do not hope for fame at the circuit examination.

title: 童试章·父旺官兴堪期首选、官衰父发亦论抡收；官星持世得日月动爻生合首选无疑；父爻持世得生合还要官星有气始许成名

rule.yi: 童试：父爻旺、官星兴，可期名列榜首；官衰而父爻发动，也算能被选中；官星持世，得日月动爻相生相合，首选没有疑问；父爻持世得生合，一定要官星有气，才许成名。
rule.en: In the youth examinations: with the Resource line strong and the official star thriving one may hope to be first; with the official star weak but the Resource line moving one is still counted as selected; with the official star holding the Self and the Day, the Month and moving lines giving it life and combining with it, being first is beyond doubt; with the Resource line holding the Self and given life and combination, the official star must also have breath before one may win a name.

note.yi: 「童试」是考秀才之前的各级考试（县试、府试、院试）；「首选」「抡收」是被选中、取中。官星就是官鬼。
note.en: The "youth examinations" are the examinations before the one that makes a licentiate; "chosen first" and "selected" mean being picked and admitted. The official star is the Pressure line.

zh: 父旺官兴，堪期首选，官衰父发，亦论抡收。
官星持世，得日月动爻相生相合，首选无疑。
父爻持世，得日月动爻生合者，必要官星有气，始许成名。
yi: 父爻旺、官星兴，可以期望名列榜首；官衰而父爻发动，也算能被选中。
官星持世，得到日月、动爻相生相合，名列榜首没有疑问。
父爻持世，得到日月、动爻生合的，一定要官星有气，才许成名。
en: With the Resource line strong and the official star thriving, one may hope to be chosen first; with the official star weak but the Resource line moving, one is still counted as selected.
If the official star holds the Self and the Day, the Month and the moving lines give it life and combine with it, being first on the list is beyond doubt.
If the Resource line holds the Self and the Day, the Month and moving lines give life to and combine with it, the official star must also have breath before one may win a name.

title: 童试章·子兴财发于卦中难游泮水；子动克官、财动克父、或持于世爻者皆不宜

rule.yi: 童试时子孙兴旺、财爻发动在卦中，难以入县学；子孙动克官星、财爻动克父爻，或者子孙、财爻持在世爻上，都不适宜。
rule.en: In the youth examinations, if Output flourishes and Wealth moves in the hexagram it is hard to enter the county school; Output moving and controlling Pressure, or Wealth moving and controlling Resource, or either of them holding the Self line, is unfavourable in every case.

note.yi: 「游泮水」是入县学成生员（旧时县学前有泮池，新生入学要行礼，叫「游泮」）。子孙克官星、财爻克父爻是考试里最忌的两种克：官星管功名，父爻管文章。
note.en: "Swimming in the Pan pond" is entering the county school and becoming a student (the county school had a ceremonial pond, and new students performed a rite there). Output controlling the official star and Wealth controlling the Resource line are the two most feared controls in examinations: the official star governs rank and the Resource line governs the writing.

zh: 子兴财发于卦中，难游泮水。
子动克官，财动克父，或持于世爻者，皆为不宜。
yi: 子孙兴旺、财爻发动在卦中，难以入县学。
子孙动克官，财爻动克父爻，或者持在世爻上的，都不适宜。
en: If Output flourishes and Wealth moves in the hexagram, it is hard to enter the county school.
Output moving and controlling Pressure, or Wealth moving and controlling the Resource line, or either holding the Self line, is unfavourable in every case.

title: 童试章·世破身空兼墓绝再奋芸窗；文旺遭伤收而复弃，冲中逢合弃而仍收；父母旺相化休囚空破墓绝、回头克或被冲克则始取终弃（附例：官星月破伏藏、飞神合破，择三月考之必取）

rule.yi: 世爻被破、卦身落空又入墓逢绝，不能遂愿，只好再苦读；文章旺却遭伤害，先收取后舍弃；父母爻旺相却变休囚、空破、墓绝、回头克或被冲克，是开始被取、最后被弃；世爻、父爻动而遇冲，若得日月动爻相合，叫冲中逢合，一定续取。
rule.en: With the Self broken, the Body Void and moreover in the tomb or extinct, one cannot fulfil one's aim and must work hard again at the study window; with the writing strong but harmed, one is taken and then cast aside; if the Resource line is thriving but changes into resting and trapped, Void or broken, tomb, extinction or a line that turns back to control it, or is clashed and controlled, one is taken at first and cast aside in the end; if the Self and Resource lines move and meet a clash but the Day, the Month or a moving line combines with them, this is a combination within a clash and one will surely be taken afterwards.

note.yi: 「冲中逢合」是被冲的爻又遇到来合它的日月或动爻，冲的力量被合化解。例子里说官星酉金月破又伏藏，辰土（飞神）和酉合（辰酉合），所以破而逢合，断为「在三月考之必取」。第 2 句里「再奋芸窗」「始取终弃」是榜上被取、后又被除名的情形。
note.en: A "combination within a clash" is a clashed line meeting a Day, Month or moving line that combines with it, the combination resolving the clash. In the example the official star You Metal is on the Month-break and hidden, and Chen Earth, its flying line, combines with You (Chen and You combine), so what is broken meets a combination, and the verdict is that if the examination is in the third month he will be taken. "Taken at first and cast aside in the end" is the case of being admitted and later struck from the list.

zh: 世破身空兼墓绝，再奋芸窗。
世爻空破墓绝，或被日月动爻冲克，及动而变凶者，不能遂志。
文旺遭伤，收而复弃，冲中逢合，弃而仍收。
父母旺相，若化休囚、空破、墓绝，化回头克，及被冲克者，始取终弃。
世与父爻，动而逢冲，若得日月动爻相合者，谓之冲中逢合，定获续取。
yi: 世爻被破、卦身落空，又兼入墓、逢绝，只好再发奋读书。
世爻落空、被破、入墓、逢绝，或者被日月、动爻冲克，以及发动变凶的，不能遂愿。
文章旺却遭伤害，先收取后又舍弃；冲中逢合，舍弃了还会再收取。
父母爻旺相，如果变成休囚、落空被破、入墓逢绝，变出回头克，以及被冲克的，开始被取、最终被弃。
世爻和父爻发动后遇冲，如果又得日月、动爻来合，叫做冲中逢合，一定能获得续取。
en: With the Self broken, the Body Void, and moreover in the tomb or extinct, one must work hard again at the study window.
If the Self is Void, broken, in the tomb or extinct, or is clashed and controlled by the Day, the Month or a moving line, or moves and changes into an ill line, one cannot fulfil one's aim.
If the writing is strong but harmed, one is taken in and then cast aside; with a combination found within a clash, one cast aside is taken in again.

If the Resource line is thriving but changes into resting and trapped, Void or broken, tomb or extinction, or into a line that turns back to control it, or is clashed and controlled, one is taken at first and cast aside in the end.

If the Self and Resource lines move and meet a clash, but the Day, the Month or a moving line combines with them, this is called a combination within a clash, and one will surely be taken in afterwards.

zh: 又如：卯月壬子日(旬空：寅卯)，占道考，得“风天小畜”
yi: 再如：卯月壬子日（旬空：寅、卯），占道考，得「风天小畜」
en: Another example: on a Ren-Zi day in the Mao month (Void: Yin and Mao), divining for the circuit examination, I obtained "Wind over Heaven, Xiaochu".

zh: 世子水父母临日建，旺文持世，佳作定然得意，但不宜酉金官星临月破，伏藏不露，幸得辰土作飞神，破而逢合，若在三月考之，必取。
yi: 世爻是子水，父母爻临日建，旺相的文章持世，佳作一定得意；只是不宜酉金官星临月破、又伏藏不现；幸好有辰土做飞神，破了又逢合，如果在三月考，必定录取。
果然考试在三月，被录取了。
en: The Self is Zi Water and the Resource line stands on the Day; a strong writing holds the Self and a fine essay will surely be admired; but it is unfortunate that the Pressure line of You Metal stands on the Month-break and lies hidden and unseen; luckily Chen Earth is its flying line, so what is broken meets a combination, and if the examination is held in the third month he will surely be taken.
The examination was indeed held in the third month and he was taken.

title: 童试章·父衰变旺愈出愈奇、文化退神日长日短：父衰动化旺、回头生、进神则后胜于前，皆不宜化退神；旺化退神前篇稍遂后劲不力，衰化退神窗下千日之长临场一日之短（附例）

rule.yi: 父爻衰而发动变旺、变回头生、变进神，文章越写越好，后胜于前；最不宜变退神：旺的变退神，前面顺利后劲不足；衰的变退神，以及变克、变空破墓绝、变回头克，是窗下千日用功、临场一日不济。
rule.en: If the Resource line is weak and moves to change into strength, into a line that turns back to give it life, or into an Advancing line, the writing grows better as it goes and the later is better than the earlier; a change into a Retreating line is what is most unwelcome: a strong line changing into a Retreating line goes well at first but lacks force later; a weak line changing into a Retreating line, or into control, or into Void, break, tomb or extinction, or into a line that turns back to control it, means a thousand days of work at the window and one day that falls short in the hall.

note.yi: 「进神」「退神」是同一五行往前、往后变（寅化卯是进，卯化寅是退）；「日长日短」书里自己解释为「窗下千日之长，临场一日之短」。「续案」是第一榜之后补取的名单。第二个例子在上一条（LY.EXAM.ZS.16）里。
note.en: An "Advancing" or "Retreating" line is the same phase changing forward or back (Yin turning into Mao is advancing, Mao into Yin retreating); the book itself explains "the days long, the day short" as "a thousand days at the window are long, one day in the hall falls short". The "supplementary list" is the list of those taken after the first posting. The second example is under the previous entry (LY.EXAM.ZS.16).

zh: 父衰，动而化旺，及化回头生、化进神，文章得意，后胜于前，皆不宜化退神。
旺化退神者，前篇稍遂，后劲不力；
衰化退神者，及化克、化空破墓绝，或化回头克者，窗下千日之长，临场一日之短。
yi: 父爻衰而变旺，文章越写越奇；
文章变成退神，平日用功的日子长，临场的那一天却短（不济）。
父爻衰，发动变旺，以及变回头生、变进神，文章得意，后面胜过前面，都不适宜变退神。
旺的变退神，前面的文章还算顺利，后劲不足；
衰的变退神，以及变克、变空破墓绝，或者变回头克的，是窗下千日之长、临场一日之短。
en: If the Resource line is weak and changes into strength, the more he writes the more striking it is;
if the writing turns into a Retreating line, the days of study are long but the day of the test falls short.

If the Resource line is weak and moves to change into strength, or into a line that turns back to give it life, or into an Advancing line, the writing is admired and the later is better than the earlier; in none of these should it change into a Retreating line.
A strong line changing into a Retreating line: the earlier essays go fairly well but the later force is weak;

a weak line changing into a Retreating line, or into control, or into Void, break, tomb or extinction, or into a line that turns back to control it: a thousand days at the window are long, one day in the hall falls short.

zh: 如：亥月丙戌日(旬空：午未)，占道考，得“丰之革”
yi: 例如：亥月丙戌日（旬空：午、未），占道考，得「丰之革」
en: For example: on a Bing-Xu day in the Hai month (Void: Wu and Wei), divining for the circuit examination, I obtained "Feng changing to Ge".

zh: 父母持世化进神，日建作官而生世，文章愈出愈奇，后胜于前，定然首取。
yi: 父母爻持世，变出进神，日建又做官星来生世，文章越写越奇，后面胜过前面，一定榜首录取。
后来果然取了案首。
en: The Resource line holds the Self and changes into an Advancing line, and the Day acts as the official star to give life to the Self; the writing grows more striking as it goes, the later better than the earlier, so he will surely be taken first.
Afterwards he was indeed taken at the head of the list.

zh: 又如：辰月丁巳日（旬空：子丑），占续案能取否？
yi: 再如：辰月丁巳日（旬空：子、丑），占续案能不能被取？
得「革之既济」
en: Another example: on a Ding-Si day in the Chen month (Void: Zi and Chou), divining whether one would be taken in the supplementary list?
I obtained "Ge changing to Jiji".

zh: 世爻亥水，月克日冲，幸化回头之生，续取无疑。
前说父衰变旺为吉，此其验也。
yi: 世爻是亥水，被月建克、日辰冲，幸好变出回头生它的爻，续取没有疑问。
果然续取了。
前面说父爻衰变旺为吉，这就是它的应验。
en: The Self is Hai Water, controlled by the Month and clashed by the Day, but luckily it changes into a line that turns back to give it life, so being taken in the supplementary list is beyond doubt.
He was indeed taken.
What I said earlier, that a weak Resource line changing to strength is auspicious, is proved here.

title: 岁考科考章·文宜旺相最忌休囚、官要生身不宜克世：父、世旺相又得生扶全无破绽定考超等，旺而逢生上等，有一遇刑冲又次之，世父同受克劣等无疑（野鹤、觉子；附例）

rule.yi: 岁考、科考按父爻和世爻的旺衰分等第：两爻旺相又得日月动爻生扶、全无破绽的考超等；旺而逢生上等；旺而无生、或相而遇扶、没有刑冲克破的次之；两爻有一个遇刑冲的又次之；世爻受克要受责罚，世爻父爻同受克必定劣等。野鹤说要变通，以六冲变冲、反吟伏吟、变克化绝为破绽；觉子说《易冒》以进神为上等、退神为下等，没有进退之神时就按旺衰定。
rule.en: In the annual and qualifying examinations the grade is set by how strong the Resource and Self lines are: both thriving and given life and support by the Day, the Month and moving lines, with no flaw at all, is the top grade; strong and meeting life is the upper grade; strong without life, or thriving and given support, with no punishment, clash, control or breaking, is next; one of the two meeting punishment or clash is lower still; if the Self is controlled one will be flogged, and if the Self and Resource are both controlled it is surely the lowest grade. The Old Man of Yehe says to be flexible, and takes a Six-Clash, a clash by change, a Reversed or Hidden Chant, or a change into control or extinction as flaws; Juezi says the Yi Mao takes an Advancing line as the upper grade and a Retreating line as the lower, and that when there is neither one decides by strength and weakness.

note.yi: 岁考是生员每年一次的考试，科考是应乡试前的资格考，按成绩分一二三…等；「超等」「上等」「平等」「劣等」是等第的叫法。「廪」是官给口粮的廪膳生，「帮粮」是优等另给的补贴口粮。「教刑」是教官的责罚。「父世」就是父爻和世爻。这一章后面的[乾按]不收。
note.en: The annual examination was held each year for licentiates, and the qualifying examination was the one that qualified a man to sit the provincial examination; results were graded first, second and so on, and "top", "upper", "middle" and "lowest" are names of grades. A "stipend student" received a government grain ration, and the "grain allowance" was an extra ration for the excellent. The "flogging" is the teacher's punishment. The "Resource and Self" is the Resource line and the Self line. The [Qian's note] at the end of the chapter is not quoted.

zh: 父与世爻旺相，又得日月动爻生扶，及动而化吉，全无破绽者，定考超等。
旺而无生，相而遇扶，无刑冲克破者，次之；
父母有一而遇刑冲者，又次之；
世爻受克，教刑不免，世父同受克者，劣等无疑。
yi: 文章（父母爻）宜旺相，最怕休囚；
官星要来生身，不适宜克世。
父爻和世爻旺相，又得到日月、动爻生扶，以及发动变吉，全无破绽的，一定考超等。
如果父爻、世爻旺而又逢生，是上等；
旺而没有生、相而得到扶助，没有刑、冲、克、破的，是次一等；
两爻（父母、世爻）里有一个遇到刑、冲的，再次一等；
世爻受克，会受到教官的责罚；世爻、父爻同时受克的，必定是劣等。
en: The writing (the Resource line) should be thriving and most fears being resting and trapped;
the official star should give life to the Body and must not control the Self.

If the Resource and Self lines are thriving, given life and support by the Day, the Month and moving lines, or move and change into auspicious lines, with no flaw at all, one will surely take the top grade.
If Resource and Self are strong and meet life, it is the upper grade;
strong but without life, or thriving and given support, with no punishment, clash, control or breaking, is the next grade;
if one of the two (Resource and Self) meets punishment or clash, the grade is lower still;
if the Self is controlled, a flogging by the teacher cannot be avoided; if the Self and Resource are both controlled, it is surely the lowest grade.

zh: 野鹤曰：此法是也，亦要人之通变。
观其父世两爻轻重而言之。
世父同旺，有生扶又无刑克者，全美之卦，卷之上上也。
以此挨次查之，或有生扶，而得六冲变冲、反吟伏吟、变克化绝，即是破绽。
父爻受克而无救，难免勾涂；
世爻受克而有扶，尚蒙姑恕。
yi: 野鹤说：这个方法是对的，也要人懂得变通。
要看父爻和世爻两爻的轻重来断。
世爻、父爻同旺，有生扶又没有刑克的，是完美的卦，卷子是上上等。
依此一级一级往下查，即使有生扶，但遇到六冲、变冲、反吟、伏吟、变克、化绝，就是破绽。
父爻受克又没有救，免不了被勾掉涂去；
世爻受克但有扶助，还能得到宽容。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: this method is right, but one also needs to be flexible.
Judge by the weight of the Resource and Self lines.
If the Self and Resource are both strong, with life and support and no punishment or control, it is a perfect hexagram, and the paper is of the very highest grade.
Check on down in this order; even if there is life and support, meeting a Six-Clash, a clash by change, a Reversed Chant, a Hidden Chant, a change into control or into extinction is a flaw.
If the Resource line is controlled with no rescue, the paper will not escape being struck through and crossed out;
if the Self is controlled but has support, one may still be forgiven.

zh: 觉子曰：此以父世之旺衰，而分等第者，是确论也。
假使卦无进退之神，何以定之？
yi: 觉子说：这是按父爻、世爻的旺衰来分等第，是确切的论断。
《易冒》说：卦得进神，考上等；
得退神，就考下等。
假如卦里没有进神、退神，又拿什么来定？
en: Juezi says: this divides the grades by the strength of the Resource and Self lines, and is a sound judgement.
The Yi Mao says: if the hexagram has an Advancing line, one takes the upper grade;
if it has a Retreating line, the lower grade.
But if the hexagram has neither an Advancing nor a Retreating line, by what is it decided?

zh: 如：申月乙巳日(旬空：寅卯)，占岁考，得“大过之鼎”
yi: 例如：申月乙巳日（旬空：寅、卯），占岁考，得「大过之鼎」
en: For example: on a Yi-Si day in the Shen month (Void: Yin and Mao), divining for the annual examination, I obtained "Daguo changing to Ding".

zh: 断曰：财动克父，乃不通变之论也，此卦乃亥水父爻持世，申月生之，文旺而身亦旺，巳日冲之为暗动，未土财爻虽动，喜其生助酉金。
酉官生世，名曰“接续相生”，一定篇篇锦绣，财生官旺，优等帮粮。
yi: 断：说「财动克父」，是不懂变通的说法；这一卦是亥水父爻持世，申月生它，文章旺、自身也旺，巳日冲它成了暗动，未土财爻虽然动，喜的是它去生助酉金。
酉金官星生世，叫做「接续相生」，一定篇篇锦绣；财生官旺，是优等、有帮粮。
果然取了一等，补上廪生。
en: Verdict: to say "Wealth moving controls Resource" is a view that does not understand adaptation; in this hexagram the Hai Water Resource line holds the Self, born by the Shen month, so the writing is strong and the man himself is strong; the Si day clashes it into a secret movement; and although the Wei Earth Wealth line moves, it is glad to give support to You Metal.

The You Metal official star gives life to the Self, which is called "giving life in succession"; every essay will surely be brocade; with Wealth giving life to a strong official star, it is an excellent grade with a grain allowance.
He was indeed taken in the first grade and made a stipend student.

title: 岁考科考章·六冲变冲或六爻乱动即使文旺世旺也只考平等；飞神无助身无克荣辱无施；伏藏旺相也遭伤赏罚并见（野鹤；附例：泰卦，巳午之火非文旺乃字佳）

rule.yi: 卦成六冲、变冲或六爻乱动，即使文章旺、世爻旺，也只考平等；文章衰受刑克、世爻休囚被克、变凶的，必定劣等；飞神得不到帮助、卦身不受克，无荣无辱；父爻出现、不旺不衰、没有生扶也没有克制、世爻不被冲克的，保得住平等；伏藏的爻即使旺相也遭伤，赏罚一起来。
rule.en: If the hexagram is a Six-Clash or changes into a clash, or the six lines move in disorder, then even with the writing strong and the Self strong one takes only the middle grade; with the writing weak and punished or controlled, or the Self resting and trapped and controlled, or changing into ill, it is surely the lowest grade; if the flying line gets no help and the Body is not controlled there is neither honour nor disgrace; if the Resource line appears, neither strong nor weak, with neither support nor control and the Self not clashed or controlled, the middle grade is assured; a hidden line, even though thriving, is harmed, and reward and punishment appear together.

note.yi: 「飞神无助身无克，荣辱无施」是说父爻没有得到生扶、也没有受克，不上不下，所以无赏无罚；「伏藏旺相也遭伤」是伏神旺相但飞神克它，所以赏罚并见。例子里巳火伏在寅木下、午火是月建，断语说「旺」本来该是文章好，结果是字好，所以野鹤说这样的卦存之为法而已。「宗师」是学官（提学）。
note.en: "If the flying line gets no help and the Body is not controlled, there is neither honour nor disgrace" means the Resource line is neither supported nor controlled, in the middle, so there is neither reward nor punishment; "a hidden line, though thriving, is harmed" is a hidden line that is strong but controlled by its flying line, so reward and punishment appear together. In the example Si Fire lies hidden under Yin Wood and Wu Fire is the Month; the verdict first took the strength to mean good writing, and it turned out to mean good handwriting, so the author keeps such a hexagram only as a model. The "examiner" is the school official (the education commissioner).

zh: 野鹤曰：大凡卦得六冲变冲，及六爻乱动者，设文旺世旺，还考平等，倘文衰受刑克，及世爻休囚被克，及变凶者，劣等无疑。
yi: 野鹤说：大凡卦得六冲、变冲，以及六爻乱动的，即使文章旺、世爻旺，也只考平等；如果文章衰、又受刑克，以及世爻休囚被克，以及变凶的，一定是劣等。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: in general, when the hexagram is a Six-Clash or changes into a clash, or the six lines all move in disorder, even if the writing is strong and the Self is strong one takes only the middle grade; and if the writing is weak and punished or controlled, or the Self is resting and trapped and controlled, or it changes into ill, it is surely the lowest grade.

zh: 飞神无助身无克，荣辱无施。
父爻出现，不旺不衰，虽无生扶，亦无克制，而世爻不被冲克者，可保平等。
yi: 飞神得不到帮助，卦身又没有受克，没有荣也没有辱。
父爻出现在卦中，不旺不衰，虽然没有生扶，也没有受克制，而且世爻不被冲克的，可以保住平等。
en: If the flying line gets no help and the Body is not controlled, there is neither honour nor disgrace.
If the Resource line appears in the hexagram, neither strong nor weak, with no life or support but also no control, and the Self is not clashed or controlled, the middle grade is assured.

zh: 伏藏旺相也遭伤，赏罚并见。
yi: 伏藏的爻即使旺相也遭到伤害，赏和罚会一起出现。
en: If a hidden line, even though thriving, is harmed, reward and punishment appear together.

zh: 如：午月乙卯日(旬空：子丑)，占岁考，得“地天泰卦”
yi: 例如：午月乙卯日（旬空：子、丑），占岁考，得「地天泰卦」
en: For example: on a Yi-Mao day in the Wu month (Void: Zi and Chou), divining for the annual examination, I obtained the hexagram Earth over Heaven, Tai.

zh: 午火月建为父母，而卦中之巳火伏藏于寅木之下，旺而又遇飞神之生，爻逢六合，堪称吉卦，独嫌日辰克世，未为全美。
发落之日，果宗师面叱，念字仿古帖，姑置三等。
后悟此巳午之火，非文旺也，乃字佳也，但此卦虽多逢，事确少见，存之为法。
yi: 午火是月建、做父母爻，而卦里的巳火伏藏在寅木之下，旺相，又得飞神来生，爻遇六合，可以称作吉卦，只嫌日辰克世，不算完美。
放榜发落那天，果然被学官当面训斥，又念及他的字是临仿古帖，姑且列在三等。
后来才悟到这巳午之火，不是说文章旺，而是说字写得好；不过这样的卦虽然常遇到，这样的事确实少见，留下来作个参考。
en: Wu Fire is the Month and acts as the Resource line, and the Si Fire in the hexagram lies hidden under Yin Wood, thriving and given life by its flying line, the lines meeting a Six-Combine; it may be called an auspicious hexagram, only that the Day controls the Self, so it is not perfect.

On the day the results were announced, the examiner indeed reproved him to his face but, taking into account that his writing followed an old copy-book model, placed him in the third grade for the time being.
Later I realized that this Si-Wu Fire did not mean strong writing but fine handwriting; though such a hexagram is often met, such a matter is truly rare, and I keep it as a model.

title: 岁考科考章·总括：父、世旺相遇生扶为上，略欠次之，刑伤有救又次之，刑伤无救而轻者又次之，世父被刑冲克破而重者劣等；善卜者通变而断（觉子）

rule.yi: 岁考科考的等第次序：父爻世爻旺相又得生扶最上；略有欠缺的次之；受刑伤但有救的又次之；受刑伤无救但程度轻的又次之；世、父被刑冲克破而且重的，必定劣等。会占的人要把吉凶和用神衰旺的轻重合起来，灵活变通地断。
rule.en: The order of grades in the annual and qualifying examinations: the Resource and Self lines thriving and given life and support is the top; one with a slight lack is next; one punished or harmed but with rescue is lower again; one punished or harmed with no rescue but lightly is lower again; if the Self and Resource are punished, clashed, controlled or broken, and badly, it is surely the lowest grade. One skilled at divining must weigh the signs together with how heavy or light the strength or weakness of the Subject is, and judge flexibly.

note.yi: 这是整章的总结，前几条的举例见 LY.EXAM.ZS.18、19。「用神」在这一章就是父爻和世爻。后面的[乾按]不收。
note.en: This sums up the chapter; the examples are under LY.EXAM.ZS.18 and 19. In this chapter the "Subject" is the Resource and Self lines. The [Qian's note] after it is not quoted.

zh: 觉子曰：以上总而言之，父与世爻旺相遇生扶为上，略有欠缺者次之；
刑伤无救而轻者又次之；
世父被刑冲克破而重者，劣等必矣。
善卜者，须以向之吉凶兼用神衰旺之轻重，通变而断之。
yi: 觉子说：以上总的说来，父爻和世爻旺相、又得生扶的为上等，略有欠缺的次一等；
受刑伤但有救的又次一等；
受刑伤没有救但程度轻的又次一等；
世爻、父爻被刑冲克破而且严重的，必定是劣等。
善于占卜的人，要把先前所说的吉凶，连同用神衰旺的轻重一起考虑，灵活变通地来断。
en: Juezi says: to sum up the above, the Resource and Self lines thriving and given life and support is the top; one with a slight lack is the next;
one that is punished or harmed but has rescue is lower again;
one that is punished or harmed with no rescue but only lightly is lower again;
one where the Self and Resource are punished, clashed, controlled or broken, and badly, is surely the lowest grade.
One skilled at divining must take the auspicious and inauspicious signs spoken of above together with how heavy or light the strength or weakness of the Subject is, and judge flexibly.

title: 占廪章·占廪以财爻为用神：财是文章（父母）的忌神，占岁考与问廪不可并在一卦，先占岁考、另卜一卦问廪；财爻持世或动而生世为吉，断同求财章（觉子）

rule.yi: 占廪（廪生的名额和官给口粮）以财爻为用神，而财是文章（父母爻）的忌神，所以不能把岁考和占廪放在一卦里问：先占岁考的吉凶，另外再卜一卦问廪；财爻持世，或动而生世为吉，断法同求财章。
rule.en: In divining for the stipend (a stipend place and the government ration) the Wealth line is the Subject, but Wealth is the adversary of the writing (the Resource line), so the annual examination and the stipend must not be asked in one hexagram: first divine the fortune of the annual examination, then divine another hexagram for the stipend; Wealth holding the Self, or moving to give life to the Self, is auspicious, and it is judged as in the chapter on seeking wealth.

note.yi: 「廪」是廪膳生，考岁考得一等才补；「占廪」是占能不能补上廪生的名额。财是文章的忌神（财克父），所以占考试时财是坏的，占廪时财却是用神，正反要分开占，书里叫「秘」。后面的[乾按]不收。
note.en: A "stipend student" was a licentiate who drew a government grain ration, appointed on a first-grade result in the annual examination; "divining for the stipend" is asking whether one will be given a place. Wealth is the adversary of the writing (Wealth controls Resource), so in an examination Wealth is bad, while in the stipend it is the Subject; the two must be divined separately, which the book calls the "secret". The [Qian's note] after it is not quoted.

zh: 觉子曰：占廪若不得其决，而望验者，未之有也。
盖占廪用财，财乃文章之忌神，不知其法，卜岁考而兼问廪，财爻若旺，父母受伤，财若休囚，如何得廪？
余有法焉，先占岁考之吉凶，另卜一卦而问廪，即其秘也。
yi: 觉子说：占廪生名额，如果不得其中的诀窍，却指望灵验，是没有的事。
因为占廪要用财，而财是文章（父母）的忌神；不知道这个办法，占岁考同时又问廪，财爻如果旺，父母受伤，财如果休囚，又怎么能得廪？
我有个办法：先占岁考的吉凶，另外再卜一卦来问廪，这就是它的秘诀。
en: Juezi says: in divining for the stipend, one who does not have the secret of it and yet hopes for accuracy has never been seen.

For in divining for the stipend Wealth is used, and Wealth is the adversary of the writing; if one does not know the method and asks about the annual examination and the stipend together, then if Wealth is strong the Resource line is harmed, and if Wealth is resting and trapped how can one obtain the stipend?
I have a method: first divine the fortune of the annual examination, then divine a separate hexagram to ask about the stipend; that is the secret.

zh: 廪以财爻为用神，财爻持世，或动而生世为吉，与求财章同断。
yi: 廪以财爻为用神，财爻持世，或者发动来生世为吉，按求财章的断法同断。
en: For the stipend the Wealth line is the Subject; Wealth holding the Self, or moving to give life to the Self, is auspicious, and it is judged as in the chapter on seeking wealth.

title: 占廪章·有廪而恐失者：忌兄弟持世、兄爻发动，财逢空破墓绝、动而变凶；官鬼兄爻克世轻则革粮重则追罚，三合兄局亦主革廪

rule.yi: 已有廪生名额而怕失去的，忌兄弟持世、兄弟爻发动，以及财爻逢空破墓绝、发动变凶，都会失去；官鬼或兄弟爻克世，轻的革去口粮，重的追罚；卦里三合成兄弟局，也主革去廪生。
rule.en: For one who already holds the stipend and fears losing it: Peer holding the Self, the Peer line moving, or Wealth meeting Void, break, tomb or extinction or moving into ill, all mean it will be lost; if Pressure or the Peer line controls the Self the lighter result is that the grain allowance is stopped and the heavier is a penalty with recovery; a three-harmony frame of Peer in the hexagram also means the stipend is revoked.

note.yi: 「革粮」是停发口粮，「追罚」是追回已领的粮并罚；「三合兄局」是卦中的爻合成兄弟五行的三合局。
note.en: "Stopped grain allowance" means the ration is cut off, and "penalty with recovery" means the grain already drawn is recovered and a fine imposed; a "three-harmony frame of Peer" is a three-harmony group in the hexagram of the Peer relation's phase.

zh: 有廪而恐失者，忌兄弟持世，兄爻发动，及财逢空破墓绝，动而变凶，皆有失也。
如官鬼兄爻克世者，轻则革粮，重则追罚，倘卦中三合兄局者，亦主革廪。
yi: 已有廪生名额而担心失去的，忌兄弟持世、兄弟爻发动，以及财爻逢空破墓绝、发动变凶，都会失去。
如果官鬼、兄弟爻克世，轻的革去口粮，重的追罚；如果卦中三合成兄弟局，也主革去廪生。
en: For one who holds the stipend and fears losing it, Peer holding the Self, the Peer line moving, or Wealth meeting Void, break, tomb or extinction, or moving and changing into ill, all mean it will be lost.

If Pressure or the Peer line controls the Self, the lighter result is that the grain allowance is stopped and the heavier is a penalty with recovery; if the hexagram forms a three-harmony frame of Peer, the stipend is also revoked.

title: 考遗才章·官爻持世生世则必蒙收，父母空破墓绝则不见用；世受克、空破墓绝、动化凶、子孙持世或动则不录；父母持世生世吉，休囚空破凶（凡告考同例）

rule.yi: 考遗才（补考漏掉的人）和告考：官爻持世或生世，一定被收录；父母爻空破墓绝，不会被用；世爻受克或空破墓绝、动变凶、子孙持世或子孙发动，都主不被录取；父母持世生世吉，休囚空破凶。
rule.en: For the supplementary examination (taking those who were missed) and for petitioning to sit an examination: the Pressure line holding or giving life to the Self means one will surely be admitted; the Resource line Void, broken, in the tomb or extinct means one will not be used; the Self controlled, or Void, broken, in the tomb or extinct, or moving into ill, or Output holding the Self or moving, all mean one will not be taken; the Resource line holding or giving life to the Self is auspicious, and resting and trapped, Void or broken is inauspicious.

note.yi: 「考遗才」是学官为没赶上考试的人再开的补考；「告考」是自己具呈请求准许应考，章名下注「凡告考同例」。「他不见用」的「他」是主考的人（书里没有明说）。后面的[乾按]不收。
note.en: The "supplementary examination" is a later examination the school official holds for those who missed the main one; "petitioning to sit" is submitting a petition to be allowed to sit, and the chapter title notes that the same rules apply. The "he" in "he will not be taken into use" is the examiner (the book does not say so). The [Qian's note] after it is not quoted.

zh: 官爻持世生世，我必蒙收；
父母空破墓绝，他不见用。
如世爻受克，及空破墓绝，或动而化凶，或子孙持世，或子孙动于卦中，皆主不录。
yi: 官爻持世或生世，我一定被收录；
父母爻空、破、入墓、逢绝，他不会被录用。
如果世爻受克，以及空、破、墓、绝，或者发动变凶，或者子孙持世，或者子孙在卦中发动，都主不被录取。
父母爻持世、生世的，都吉；
休囚、空破的，都凶。
en: If the Pressure line holds or gives life to the Self, I will surely be admitted;
if the Resource line is Void, broken, in the tomb or extinct, he will not be taken into use.
If the Self is controlled, or Void, broken, in the tomb or extinct, or moves and changes into ill, or Output holds the Self, or Output moves in the hexagram, all indicate he will not be taken.
Resource holding or giving life to the Self is auspicious in every case;
resting and trapped, Void or broken is inauspicious in every case.

title: 发案挂榜章·应期：父母为用神，衰者于生旺之日，旺而静者逢值逢冲之日，动而逢值逢合之日，空与入墓必待冲开，破与旬空须期填实

rule.yi: 占考试结果几时公布（发案、挂榜），以父母爻为用神：衰的，应在它得生、得旺的日子；旺而静的，应在值日或冲日；动的，应在值日或合日；落空和入墓的，要等冲开；被破和旬空的，要等填实。
rule.en: To divine when the result will be issued and the board posted, the Resource line is the Subject: if weak, it answers on the day that gives it life or strength; if strong and still, on the day of its own branch or the day that clashes it; if moving, on the day of its own branch or the day that combines with it; if Void or in the tomb, one must wait until it is clashed open; if broken or in the Void, one must wait until it is filled.

note.yi: 「发案」是考官公布取中的名单（案），「挂榜」是把榜张挂出来。「值」是爻的地支恰好是当日的地支；「填实」是等到落空的地支那一日。这一章后面的[乾按]不收。
note.en: "Issuing the list" is the examiner publishing the list of those taken, and "posting the board" is hanging the board up. "Meeting its own branch" is the day whose branch is the same as the line's branch; "filled" means waiting for the day whose branch is the one that is Void. The [Qian's note] after it is not quoted.

zh: 父母为用神，衰者，于生旺之日；
旺而静者，逢值逢冲之日；
yi: 以父母爻为用神，衰的，在它得生、得旺的日子应验；
旺而静的，在逢值、逢冲的日子；
动的，在逢值、逢合的日子；
落空和入墓的，一定要等冲开；
被破和旬空的，要等到填实。
en: The Resource line is the Subject; if weak, it is fulfilled on the day that gives it life or strength;
if strong and still, on the day when it is met by its own branch or clashed;
if moving, on the day when it is met by its own branch or combined;
if Void or in the tomb, one must wait until it is clashed open;
if broken or in the Void, one must wait until it is filled.

title: 发案挂榜章·心有忧惧者得子孙持世则值子孙之日发案；心有欢喜者得官星持世则逢官鬼之日挂榜（野鹤验得）

rule.yi: 心里忧虑害怕的，如果子孙持世，在子孙值日的那天发案；心里欢喜的，如果官星持世，在官鬼值日的那天挂榜。
rule.en: For one whose heart is anxious and fearful, if Output holds the Self, the list is issued on the day of Output; for one whose heart is glad, if the official star holds the Self, the board is posted on the day of Pressure.

note.yi: 「心有忧惧」「心有欢喜」是占的人当时的心情，书里没有再解释；这一条按字面译，是作者自己试出来的验法，与上一条按用神定应期的办法并用。
note.en: "The heart anxious and fearful" and "the heart glad" are the asker's mood at the time, which the book does not explain further; this is translated as written. It is a rule the author found by trial, used alongside the previous entry, which fixes the time by the Subject.

zh: 余又得验：心有忧惧者，若得子孙持世，值子孙之日而发案；
心有欢喜者，若得官星持世，逢官鬼之日而挂榜。
yi: 我又验证到：心里有忧虑、害怕的，如果得子孙持世，在子孙值日的那天发案；
心里欢喜的，如果得官星持世，在官鬼值日的那天挂榜。
en: I have also found by experience: for one whose heart is anxious and fearful, if Output holds the Self, the list is issued on the day of Output;
for one whose heart is glad, if the official star holds the Self, the board is posted on the day of Pressure.

title: 廷试章·官星为用父母次之：持世爻得日月岁生合定蒙首拔，官父世爻三合必受殊恩；世与官爻有一遇空破墓绝克害刑冲或动变凶为不祥，岁五官鬼冲克世为不测之灾（与会场兼断）

rule.yi: 廷试（殿试）以官星为用神，父母爻次之：持世爻得日、月、太岁生合的，一定被选拔为首；官、父、世三爻合成三合，必受特别恩宠；世爻和官爻有一个遇空破、墓绝、克害、刑冲或发动变凶，是不吉之兆；太岁作官鬼来冲克世爻，是意想不到的灾祸。
rule.en: In the palace examination the official star is the Subject and the Resource line comes second: the line holding the Self given life or combined by the Day, the Month and the Year means one will surely be raised first; the Pressure, Resource and Self lines forming a three-harmony means special favour; if either the Self or the Pressure line meets Void or break, tomb or extinction, control or harm, punishment or clash, or moves into ill, it is an ill omen; if the Year acts as Pressure and clashes and controls the Self, it is an unforeseen disaster.

note.yi: 「廷试」是皇帝在殿廷亲自主持的考试（殿试），章名下注「与会场兼断」，是说和会试一起看。原文「日月岁五」「岁五官鬼」的「岁五」不见于别处，从上下文看是太岁（「岁君」「岁王」之类），可能是「岁王」的误字；译文按太岁译，并保留原文字面在括注里。「首拔」是被首先选拔。后面的[乾按]不收。
note.en: The "palace examination" is the one the emperor himself presided over in the palace hall; the title notes that it is judged together with the metropolitan examination. The "sui wu" in "the Day, the Month and the sui wu" and "sui wu as Pressure" is not found elsewhere; from the context it is the Tai Sui (the Year Lord) and may be a slip for "sui wang"; the translation reads it as Tai Sui and keeps the literal reading in brackets. "Raised first" means selected first. The [Qian's note] after it is not quoted.

zh: 若持世爻，得日月岁五生合者，定蒙首拔；
官父世爻三合，必受殊恩。
世与官爻，有一而逢空破、墓绝、克害、刑冲，及动而变凶者，不祥之兆；
岁五官鬼冲克世爻者，不测之灾。
yi: 廷试以官星为用神，父母次之。
如果持世爻得到日、月、太岁（原文作「岁五」）生合的，一定蒙受首选的拔擢；
官爻、父爻、世爻成三合，必定受到特别的恩宠。
世爻和官爻，有一个遇到空破、墓绝、克害、刑冲，以及发动变凶的，是不吉祥的预兆；
太岁（原文作「岁五」）作官鬼来冲克世爻的，是意想不到的灾祸。
en: In the palace examination the official star is the Subject and Resource comes second.
If the line holding the Self is given life or combined by the Day, the Month and the Year (the text has "sui wu", probably Tai Sui), one will surely be raised first;
if the Pressure, Resource and Self lines form a three-harmony, one will surely receive special favour.
If either the Self or the Pressure line meets Void or break, tomb or extinction, control or harm, punishment or clash, or moves and changes into ill, it is an ill omen;
if the Year (the text has "sui wu") acts as Pressure and clashes and controls the Self, it is an unforeseen disaster.

title: 乡试会试章·父旺官兴姓标虎榜、父官持世旺相得生扶名登金榜；子摇财动名落孙山、子孙财爻持世或动则下第

rule.yi: 乡试、会试：父爻旺、官星兴，名上虎榜；父爻或官爻持世而旺相，或临日月，或得日月动爻生扶，或动而变吉，名登金榜。子孙动、财爻动，或子孙、财爻持世、在卦中发动，一定落第。
rule.en: In the provincial and metropolitan examinations: with the Resource line strong and the official star thriving one's name goes on the Tiger List; if the Resource or Pressure line holds the Self and is thriving, or stands on the Day or the Month, or is given life and support by the Day, the Month or a moving line, or moves and changes into an auspicious line, one's name appears on the Golden List. If Output stirs and Wealth moves, or Output or Wealth holds the Self or moves in the hexagram, one will surely fail.

note.yi: 「虎榜」「金榜」都是登科的榜；「名落孙山」是考不上（孙山是榜上最后一名，名字落在他后面就是没考上）。官星就是官鬼。这一章后面的[乾按]不收。
note.en: The "Tiger List" and "Golden List" are both lists of those who passed; "one's name falls below Sun Shan" means failing (Sun Shan was the last name on a list, and to fall below him is to miss it). The official star is the Pressure line. The [Qian's note] after the chapter is not quoted.

zh: 父官持世而旺相，或临日月，或日月动爻生扶，及动而变吉者，名登金榜。
yi: 父爻旺、官星兴，姓名标在虎榜上。
父爻或官爻持世而旺相，或者临日月，或者日月、动爻来生扶，以及发动变吉的，名字登上金榜。
en: With the Resource line strong and the official star thriving, one's name is put on the Tiger List.

If the Resource or Pressure line holds the Self and is thriving, or stands on the Day or the Month, or is given life and support by the Day, the Month or a moving line, or moves and changes into an auspicious line, one's name appears on the Golden List.

zh: 子孙财爻持世，及动于卦中，定然下第。
yi: 子孙摇动、财爻发动，名落孙山。
子孙、财爻持世，以及在卦中发动，一定落第。
en: With Output stirring and Wealth moving, one's name falls below Sun Shan, that is, one fails.
If Output or Wealth holds the Self, or moves in the hexagram, one will surely fail.

title: 乡试会试章·兄弟乃夺标之恶客：兄爻持世或动并非一概不吉，要分喜忌——财父同兴喜兄动制财，父官两动喜兄持世、父动生世；兄持世临日月旺相又官文两旺必能中式但不能夺魁（觉子：官鬼子孙同动…最怕兄兴）

rule.yi: 兄弟爻在考试里被叫做夺标的恶客，俗传兄爻持世或发动都不吉，其实有喜有忌：财爻、父爻同兴时喜兄动制财；父、官两动时喜兄弟持世、父动生世；兄弟持世临日月或旺相、官文两旺，必能中式，只是不能夺魁。觉子补充：官鬼、子孙同动，官旺得生扶、子孙衰弱被克，再有父动最好，最怕兄兴。
rule.en: The Peer line is called the unwelcome guest who snatches the prize; common lore says Peer holding the Self or moving is ill, but there are welcome cases and feared cases: when Wealth and Resource both flourish it is a joy that Peer moves to control Wealth; when Resource and Pressure both move it is welcome that Peer holds the Self and the moving Resource gives it life; with Peer holding the Self and standing on the Day or the Month or thriving, and the official star and the writing both strong, one will surely pass, but cannot take first place. Juezi adds: when Pressure and Output both move, with Pressure strong and given life and Output weak and controlled, a moving Resource line is best, and Peer flourishing is most to be feared.

note.yi: 「夺标」是夺取标的（夺魁）。这一条是说兄弟爻在求名里不是一概坏：兄弟克财，在财克父（财伤文章）的卦里，兄动恰好制住财，所以喜；父官两动生世时，兄弟持世也不碍。兄弟不能让人夺魁，因为它是同经之人（LY.EXAM.HJC 求名章「兄弟同经，乃夺标之恶客」）。
note.en: "Snatching the prize" is taking first place. The point is that Peer is not simply bad in seeking a name: Peer controls Wealth, so in a hexagram where Wealth is controlling Resource (Wealth harming the writing) a moving Peer is welcome because it holds Wealth down; when Resource and Pressure both move and give life to the Self, Peer holding the Self does no harm. Peer cannot make one take first place because it stands for rivals studying the same classic (see the Huangjin Ce chapter on seeking a name, LY.EXAM.HJC, "Peer of the same classic is the unwelcome guest who snatches the prize").

zh: 俗传兄弟爻兴难上榜，故凡兄爻持世，及动者，皆以不吉断，殊不知有喜有忌。
所喜者，卦中财父同兴，喜得兄动以制财也；
卦中父官两动者，又喜兄弟持世，父动以生世也；
兄弟持世，若临日月，或旺相，再得官文两旺；
或官动生父、父动生世，必能中式，但不能抡元而夺魁也，故以兄弟乃夺标之客。
yi: 兄弟爻是来夺魁首的恶客。
民间传说兄弟爻兴旺就难上榜，所以凡是兄爻持世以及发动的，都断为不吉，却不知道有的情形喜、有的情形忌。
所喜的情形是：卦中财爻和父爻同时兴旺，喜得兄弟发动来制住财爻；
卦中父爻、官爻两个都动的，又喜兄弟持世，因为父爻动可以生世；
兄弟持世，如果临日月，或者旺相，再得官星、文章（父母）两旺；
或者官爻动生父爻、父爻动生世爻，一定能中式，但是不能得第一名，所以说兄弟是夺标的客人。
en: Peer is the unwelcome guest who comes to snatch the prize.

Common lore says that if the Peer line flourishes it is hard to get on the list, so whenever the Peer line holds the Self or moves it is judged inauspicious, without knowing that there are cases for welcome and cases for dread.
What is welcome is this: when Wealth and Resource are both flourishing in the hexagram, it is a joy that Peer moves to control Wealth;
when the Resource and Pressure lines both move in the hexagram, it is again welcome that Peer holds the Self, since the moving Resource line gives life to the Self;
with Peer holding the Self, if it stands on the Day or the Month, or is thriving, and moreover the official star and the writing are both strong;

or the Pressure line moves to give life to the Resource line and the Resource line moves to give life to the Self, one can surely pass, but cannot take first place and the prize, which is why Peer is called the guest who snatches the prize.

zh: 觉子曰：卦中官鬼子孙同动，官临旺相遇生扶，子孙衰弱而被克，再宜父动，最怕兄兴。
yi: 觉子说：卦中官鬼和子孙同时发动，官鬼临旺相又得生扶，子孙衰弱又被克，再有父爻动就好，最怕兄弟兴旺。
en: Juezi says: when Pressure and Output both move in the hexagram, with Pressure thriving and given life and support and Output weak and controlled, it is further good if the Resource line moves, and Peer flourishing is most to be feared.

title: 乡试会试章·日月为制煞之将军：官星、父母、世爻有一被动爻克制或化回头克，得日月冲制克神亦许得意；官父有一伏藏，得日月冲制飞神提出伏神亦许高发；有一不旺得日月生扶亦同

rule.yi: 官星、父爻、世爻里有一个被动爻克制，或变成回头克，只要日月冲制了那个克它的神，也许能得意，所以日月叫制服恶煞的将军；世爻旺相而官爻、父爻有一个伏藏不现，日月冲制飞神、提出伏神，也许高中；三者有一个不旺，得日月生扶，同此。
rule.en: If one of the official star, the Resource line and the Self is controlled by a moving line or changes into a line that turns back to control it, one may still succeed provided the Day or the Month clashes and restrains the controlling spirit, which is why the Day and Month are called the generals who subdue baleful spirits; if the Self is thriving but one of the Pressure and Resource lines lies hidden, and the Day or the Month clashes and restrains the flying line and brings the hidden line out, one may pass high; if one of the three is not strong but the Day or the Month gives it life and support, the same applies.

note.yi: 「制煞」的「煞」是克用神的爻（这里是克官星、父爻、世爻的那个爻）；「提出伏神」是日月冲开飞神，让伏神露出来。
note.en: The "baleful spirit" is the line that controls the Subject (here the one that controls the official star, the Resource line or the Self); "bringing the hidden line out" is the Day or Month clashing the flying line open so the hidden line shows.

zh: 官星、父母、世爻，有一而被动爻克制，或化回头之克，若得日月冲制克神，亦许得意，故谓之制恶煞之将军。
又如世爻旺相，而官父两爻若有一而伏藏不现，倘得日月冲制飞神，提出伏神者，亦许高发。
又如官、父、世爻，有一而不旺者，若得日月生扶，亦同此例。
yi: 日月是制服凶煞的将军。
官星、父母、世爻，有一个被动爻克制，或者变成回头克，如果得日月来冲制那个克它的神，也许能得意，所以叫做制服恶煞的将军。
又如世爻旺相，而官爻、父爻两个里有一个伏藏不现，如果日月冲制飞神、把伏神提出来，也许能高中。
又如官爻、父爻、世爻有一个不旺的，如果得日月生扶，也是同样的道理。
en: The Day and the Month are the generals who subdue baleful spirits.

If one of the official star, the Resource line and the Self is controlled by a moving line or changes into a line that turns back to control it, but the Day or the Month clashes and restrains the controlling spirit, one may still succeed, which is why they are called the generals who subdue baleful spirits.

Again, if the Self is thriving but one of the Pressure and Resource lines lies hidden and does not appear, and the Day or the Month clashes and restrains the flying line and brings the hidden line out, one may pass high.
Again, if one of the Pressure, Resource and Self lines is not strong but the Day or the Month gives it life and support, the same applies.

title: 乡试会试章·三合无冲聘登甲第：官、父、世爻合成父局或官局而不遇日月冲破定许联登；合成兄局得日月生扶官星亦旺亦许得意；忌合成子孙局；合成财局虽不美亦有验吉者（附例：艮之益占会试）

rule.yi: 官、父、世三爻合成父局或官局，没有日月冲破，一定能连登；合成兄局而得日月生扶、官星也旺，也能得意；最忌合成子孙局；合成财局虽然不好，也有应验为吉的。
rule.en: If the Pressure, Resource and Self lines form a three-harmony frame of Resource or of Pressure and are not clashed or broken by the Day or the Month, one will surely rise in succession; a frame of Peer given life and support by the Day or the Month with the official star also strong may also succeed; a frame of Output is most to be feared; a frame of Wealth, though not good, has also proved auspicious in some cases.

note.yi: 「甲第」是榜上头等；「联登」是接连登科（乡试、会试连中）。「三合」指申子辰、亥卯未等三合成局，父局、官局、兄局、子孙局、财局是看合成的五行是哪一类六亲。例子里申日同卦里的子、辰会成申子辰水局，水是财，所以是财局。
note.en: The "first class" is the top tier on the list; "rise in succession" is passing one examination after another (provincial then metropolitan). A "three-harmony" is a group such as Shen-Zi-Chen or Hai-Mao-Wei, and a frame of Resource, Pressure, Peer, Output or Wealth is named by which relation the phase of the group is. In the example the Shen day joins the Zi and Chen lines of the hexagram into a Shen-Zi-Chen Water frame, and Water is Wealth, so it is a Wealth frame.

zh: 官、父、世爻，合成父局、官局，不遇日月冲破者，定许联登。
倘若合成兄局，得遇日月生扶，官星亦旺者，亦许得意。
惟忌合成子孙局者，不为吉也；
合成财局，虽不为美，然亦有验于吉者。
yi: 三合而没有冲，会被聘选登上甲第。
官、父、世爻合成父局或官局，没有遇到日月冲破的，一定准许连续登榜。
如果合成兄弟局，得到日月生扶，官星也旺的，也许能得意。
只忌合成子孙局的，不吉利；
合成财局，虽然不算好，但也有应验为吉的。
en: A three-harmony without a clash: one is summoned to the first class of the list.
If the Pressure, Resource and Self lines form a three-harmony frame of Resource or of Pressure and meet no clash or break from the Day or the Month, one will surely be allowed to rise in succession.
If they form a frame of Peer, given life and support by the Day or the Month, with the official star also strong, one may also succeed.
Only a frame of Output is to be feared, which is not auspicious;
a frame of Wealth, though not good, has also proved auspicious in some cases.

zh: 如：卯月甲申日(旬空：午未)，占会试，得“艮之益”
yi: 例如：卯月甲申日（旬空：午、未），占会试，得「艮之益」
en: For example: on a Jia-Shen day in the Mao month (Void: Wu and Wei), divining for the metropolitan examination, I obtained "Gen changing to Yi".

zh: 寅木旺官持世，申日冲之暗动，又得日辰会成财局，不惟不克世爻，反来生世，一定高捷。
yi: 寅木旺相的官星持世，申日冲它成了暗动，又得日辰会成财局，不但不克世爻，反而来生世，一定高中。
果然及第了。
en: The strong Pressure line of Yin Wood holds the Self; the Shen day clashes it into a secret movement; and since the Day also forms a Wealth frame, which not only does not control the Self but gives it life, one will surely pass high.
He did indeed pass.

title: 乡试会试章·六爻竟发空赴科场：占功名必中者卦象一成不是旺父生身就是旺官持世；无成者不是子孙持世，即是子孙财爻发动，或世破世空，或六爻乱动

rule.yi: 六爻都发动，白赶考场。占功名一定能中的卦，不是旺父生身，就是旺官持世；功名没成的，不是子孙持世，就是子孙、财爻发动，或者世破世空，或者六爻乱动。
rule.en: With all six lines moving one goes to the examination hall for nothing. A hexagram in which one is sure to pass is either a strong Resource line giving life to the Body or a strong Pressure line holding the Self; where one does not succeed it is either Output holding the Self, or Output and Wealth moving, or the Self broken or Void, or the six lines moving in disorder.

note.yi: 「旧系」指前人的旧说，这里引的是《黄金策》求名章里的「六爻竞发，功名恍惚以难成」（见 LY.EXAM.HJC 求名章）。「科场」是考场。
note.en: "The old text" is an earlier saying; what is quoted is the line from the Huangjin Ce chapter on seeking a name, "with all six lines contending to move, fame and rank are dim and hard to achieve" (see the Huangjin Ce entries, LY.EXAM.HJC). The "examination hall" is the place where the examination is held.

zh: 旧系：六爻竞发，功名恍惚以难成，此论是理。
余见占功名必中者，卦象一成，若非旺父生身，定是旺官持世。
功名若无成者，不是子孙持世，即是子孙财爻发动，或是世破世空，或是六爻乱动，功名必无成。
yi: 六爻都发动，白白赶考。
旧本写的是：「六爻竞发，功名恍惚以难成」，这个说法是有道理的。
我见到占功名必中的，卦象一成，不是旺父生身，就一定是旺官持世。
功名如果没有成的，不是子孙持世，就是子孙、财爻发动，或者是世爻破、世爻空，或者是六爻乱动，功名必定没有成。
en: With all six lines moving, one goes to the examination hall for nothing.
The old text reads, "with all six lines contending to move, fame and rank are dim and hard to achieve"; this view is reasonable.

In the cases I have seen of divining for fame where one was sure to pass, once the hexagram is formed, it is either a strong Resource line giving life to the Body or a strong Pressure line holding the Self.

Where fame and rank are not achieved, it is either Output holding the Self, or Output and Wealth moving, or the Self broken or Void, or the six lines moving in disorder; then fame will surely not be achieved.

title: 乡试会试章·出现无情难遂青云之志：父与官星虽出现，若不生合世、不持世或世空破亦无成；生合世而又被日月动爻冲坏亦作无情

rule.yi: 父爻和官星虽然出现在卦中，如果不生合世爻、不持世，或者世爻空破，也不成；生合世爻而又被日月、动爻冲坏，也算无情。
rule.en: Even if the Resource line and the official star appear in the hexagram, if they do not give life to or combine with the Self, or do not hold the Self, or the Self is Void or broken, it comes to nothing; if they give life to or combine with the Self but are then clashed and spoiled by the Day, the Month or a moving line, that too counts as being without feeling.

note.yi: 「出现无情」是黄金策求名章的句子（「出现无情，难遂青云之志」），这里是野鹤自己的解释：爻在卦里出现，却和世爻没有生合的关系，就和你没有关系。
note.en: "Present but without feeling" is a line of the Huangjin Ce chapter on seeking a name; what is given here is the Old Man of Yehe's own explanation: a line that appears in the hexagram but has no relation of life or combination with the Self has nothing to do with you.

zh: 出现无情，难遂青云之志。
父与官星虽则出现，若不生合世爻，或不持世，或世爻空破，亦属无成。
父与官星生合世爻，若又被日月动爻冲坏者，亦作无情之喻。
yi: 出现却无情，难以实现青云直上的志向。
父爻和官星虽然出现在卦中，如果不生合世爻，或者不持世，或者世爻空破，也属于不成。
父爻和官星生合世爻，如果又被日月、动爻冲坏的，也算是无情的比喻。
en: Present but without feeling: hard to fulfil the ambition to rise to the clouds.

Even if the Resource line and the official star appear in the hexagram, if they do not give life to or combine with the Self, or do not hold the Self, or the Self is Void or broken, it still comes to nothing.
If the Resource line and the official star give life to and combine with the Self but are then clashed and spoiled by the Day, the Month or a moving line, that too counts as being without feeling.

title: 乡试会试章·伏藏有用终辞白屋之人：官、父有一不现，须看伏神；伏而旺相，或得日月冲去飞神、生起伏神，必然中式

rule.yi: 官爻、父爻有一个不出现，要看它伏在哪里；伏神旺相，或者日月冲去飞神、生起伏神，必定中式。
rule.en: If one of the Pressure and Resource lines does not appear, look at where it lies hidden; if the hidden line is thriving, or the Day or the Month clashes away the flying line and gives life to the hidden line, one will surely pass.

note.yi: 「白屋」是平民住的房子，「辞白屋」是脱离平民身份、做官。伏神是卦里没有出现、藏在某一爻（飞神）下面的六亲。
note.en: A "white cottage" is a commoner's house, and "leaving the white cottage" is leaving the commoner's status to become an official. A hidden line is a relation that does not appear in the hexagram but lies under some line (the flying line).

zh: 伏藏有用，终辞白屋之人。
官父有一而不现，须看伏神。
若伏而旺相，或得日月冲去飞神，生起伏神，必然中式。
yi: 伏藏的爻有用，终究能告别平民的白屋。
官爻、父爻有一个不出现，要看它伏在哪里。
如果伏神旺相，或者得日月冲去飞神、生起伏神，必定中式。
en: A hidden line that is of use will in the end take leave of the common man's cottage.
If one of the Pressure and Resource lines does not appear, one must look to the hidden line.
If the hidden line is thriving, or the Day or the Month clashes away the flying line and gives life to the hidden line, one will surely pass.

title: 乡试会试章·太岁作官星终登黄甲：官临太岁动而生合世，是人臣面君之象，君臣契合联捷无疑；太岁必要入爻、发动、生合或持世才能这样说

rule.yi: 太岁是君主的爻，官星临太岁、发动来生合世爻，是臣子面见君主的象，主君臣契合，连捷无疑；但太岁一定要入卦成爻、也要发动、生合或持世爻，才能这样说。
rule.en: Tai Sui is the ruler's line; if the official star stands on Tai Sui and moves to give life to or combine with the Self, it is the image of a minister before his sovereign, which means ruler and minister are in accord and passing in succession is beyond doubt; but Tai Sui must enter the hexagram as a line, must also move, and must give life to, combine with or hold the Self before it can be spoken of in this way.

note.yi: 「黄甲」是进士榜（黄纸写的榜，榜上进士称甲）；太岁是当年的地支，平常不在卦里成爻，只有当年的地支恰好和卦中爻同支时才「入爻」。野鹤自己的按语把条件收得很紧，免得一见太岁就断吉。
note.en: The "Yellow List" is the list of successful candidates for the highest degree (written on yellow paper); Tai Sui is the branch of the current year and ordinarily is not a line of the hexagram, and it "enters a line" only when a line of the hexagram has the same branch as the year. The Old Man of Yehe's own note keeps the conditions tight so that one does not judge it auspicious at the mere sight of Tai Sui.

zh: 太岁，乃人君之爻，官临太岁，动而生合世爻，乃人臣面君之象，当主君臣契合，联捷无疑。
yi: 太岁做官星，终究登上黄甲。
太岁是人君之爻，官星临太岁，发动来生合世爻，是臣子面见君主的象，主君臣契合，连捷没有疑问。
en: If Tai Sui acts as the official star, one will in the end enter the Yellow List.

Tai Sui is the line of the ruler; if the official star stands on Tai Sui and moves to give life to or combine with the Self, it is the image of a minister before his sovereign, which means ruler and minister are in accord, and passing in succession is beyond doubt.

zh: 余按：太岁必要入爻，入爻亦要发动，生合世爻，或持世爻，始能如此说也。
yi: 我的按语：太岁一定要入卦中成爻，入了卦也要发动，生合世爻，或者持世爻，才能这样说。
en: My note: Tai Sui must enter the hexagram as a line, and having entered it must also move and give life to or combine with the Self line, or hold the Self, before it can be spoken of in this way.

title: 乡试会试章·日月冲克世且守青灯：官文虽旺而世休囚空破墓绝、动变凶、或被日月冲克，是我位已失，何以成名；求名原在我

rule.yi: 卦中官星、文章虽然旺，但世爻休囚、空破墓绝、发动变凶，或者被日月冲克，是自己的位子已经失了，怎么能成名？因为求名本来就取决于自己。
rule.en: Even if the official star and the writing are strong in the hexagram, if the Self is resting and trapped, Void or broken, in the tomb or extinct, moves into ill, or is clashed and controlled by the Day or the Month, one's own place is already lost and one cannot win a name, for seeking a name rests in the end on oneself.

note.yi: 这一条回应黄金策求名章「世伤官鬼，仕途窒而不通」一类的说法，强调世爻是求名的人自己，世爻坏了，官文再旺也没有用。
note.en: This answers lines of the Huangjin Ce chapter on seeking a name such as "if the Self harms Pressure the path of office is blocked": the Self is the man himself who seeks the name, and if the Self is spoiled, a strong official star and writing are of no use.

zh: 卦中官文虽旺，而世爻休囚、空破墓绝，及动而变凶，或日月冲克世爻者，是我位既失，何以成名？
yi: 日月冲克世，只好继续守着青灯（再读）。
卦中官星、文章虽然旺，但世爻休囚、空破墓绝，以及发动变凶，或者被日月冲克世爻，是我的位子已经失了，凭什么成名？
因为求名本来就取决于自己。
en: If the Day or the Month clashes and controls the Self, one must keep to the green lamp (and study on).

Even if the official star and the writing are strong in the hexagram, if the Self is resting and trapped, Void or broken, in the tomb or extinct, or moves and changes into ill, or is clashed and controlled by the Day or the Month, my own place is already lost; how can I win a name?
For seeking a name rests in the end on oneself.

title: 乡试会试章·卦遇六冲此去难题雁塔、爻逢六合这回必占鳌头：六冲而官、父、世皆旺不必再占竟决必发，欠旺须另占；六合也要官、父、世得地（野鹤；附例：兑卦再占临之师，果中式）

rule.yi: 占得六冲卦，难以题名；占得六合卦，必占鳌头。但要看实际：六冲而官、父、世都旺，不必再占，断必发；欠旺的，另占一卦，再得吉按吉断、得凶按凶断；六合卦也要官、父、世都得地，有一个失陷又没有生扶，六合也没有益处。
rule.en: A Six-Clash hexagram means it is hard to inscribe one's name; a Six-Combine hexagram means one will surely take first place. But it depends: if a Six-Clash has the official star, Resource and Self all strong, there is no need to divine again and one judges that one will succeed; if one is lacking in strength, divine again, and judge by the second hexagram, auspicious as auspicious and ill as ill; a Six-Combine hexagram also needs the official star, Resource and Self all well placed, and if one of them is lost with no life or support, even a Six-Combine is of no use.

note.yi: 这两句「卦遇六冲……爻逢六合……」本是黄金策求名章的句子。「雁塔题名」是唐代进士在大雁塔上题名，「占鳌头」是殿试第一名站在殿前石阶上鳌头的位置。旧注说六冲「冲之即散」，野鹤的看法是要看官、父、世旺不旺。这一条和 LY.EXAM.HJC 求名章同一联对看。
note.en: These two lines, "if the hexagram meets a Six-Clash ... if the lines meet a Six-Combine ...", come from the Huangjin Ce chapter on seeking a name. "Inscribing one's name at the Wild Goose Pagoda" is the Tang custom of successful candidates inscribing their names on the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, and "taking the turtle's head" is the first-place man standing on the carved turtle at the head of the palace steps. The old note says a Six-Clash "scatters at the clash"; the Old Man of Yehe's view is to look at whether the official star, Resource and Self are strong. Read together with the same couplet in the Huangjin Ce chapter on seeking a name (LY.EXAM.HJC).

zh: 卦遇六冲，此去难题雁塔；
爻逢六合，这回必占鳌头。
yi: 卦遇六冲，这一去难以在雁塔题名；
爻遇六合，这一回一定夺得第一名。
en: If the hexagram meets a Six-Clash, one will find it hard to inscribe one's name at the Wild Goose Pagoda;
if the lines meet a Six-Combine, this time one will surely take first place (the head of the turtle).
