yi: 子孙爻发动，伤克官鬼，
占病求医，人就痊愈。
en: With the Output line moving and injuring Pressure,
in divining illness and seeking a doctor one is cured at once.

yi: 官鬼爻发动，克兄弟，
婚姻没有成，生出迟滞疑虑；
病的起因是门庭里来了祸祟。
en: With the Pressure line moving and controlling Peer,
a marriage is not made and delay and doubt arise;
the cause of illness is misfortune and haunting coming from the gate and courtyard.

yi: 财爻发动，克文书，
应考、求名总是落空；
拿本钱经营是大吉，
亲事如意，快乐无忧；
出门在外的人将要动身，
产妇求神，容易分娩；
失物安安静静，还没有出家门，
病人是伤胃，更伤脾。
en: With the Wealth line moving and controlling documents,
sitting an examination or seeking fame all comes to nothing;
trading with capital is very fortunate,
a marriage connection is as wished, happy and free of worry;
the traveller away from home is about to move,
the woman in childbirth who prays to the spirits is easily delivered;
a lost thing is quiet and safe, it has not left the house,
and the sick person has harm to the stomach, and still more to the spleen.

yi: 兄弟爻交重，克了财，
病人难以痊愈，还没有脱离灾难。
en: With the Peer line moving and controlling Wealth,
the sick person is hard to cure and has not left misfortune.

chapter: 卜筮歌诀·二十六、六亲变化歌
title: 六亲变化歌·疾病：子孙化鬼忧病产；官鬼化财占病凶

rule.yi: 六亲变化歌里讲病的两句：子孙爻动，变出官鬼，担忧疾病和生产；官鬼爻动，变出财爻，占病主凶。
rule.en: The two lines on illness in the verse on what each relation turns into: when the Output line moves and turns into Pressure, worry over illness and childbirth; when the Pressure line moves and turns into Wealth, divining illness is ominous.

note.yi: 歌里每一句的格式是「甲化乙」：甲爻发动，变出乙爻（动是事情的开头，变是事情的结局）。全诀按「父母化」「子孙化」「官化」「妻财化」「兄弟化」一段一段排，这里只收有病的两段，整段带着。「化鬼忧病产」的「产」是生产。
note.en: Every line of the verse has the form 'A turns into B': line A moves and changes into line B (the moving line is the start of the matter, the changed line its end). The whole verse runs in stanzas on Resource, Output, Pressure, Wealth and Peer turning; only the two stanzas with illness in them are taken, each complete. In 'turning into Pressure, worry over illness and childbirth' the word rendered 'childbirth' is giving birth.

yi: 子孙爻化出子孙，
人和财两样都称心；
化出父母，田地蚕桑兴旺；
化出财，加倍荣盛；
化出官鬼，担忧疾病和生产；
化出兄弟，必定互相争夺。
en: Output turning into Output,
both people and money are as wished;
turning into Resource, fields and silkworms flourish;
turning into Wealth, doubly prosperous;
turning into Pressure, worry over illness and childbirth;
turning into Peer, there will surely be quarrelling between brothers.

yi: 官爻化出官爻，是得俸禄，
求官宜要快；
化出财，占病主凶；
化出父母，文书跟着来；
化出子孙，必定伤官；
化出兄弟，家里不和睦。
en: Pressure turning into Pressure is a salary,
in seeking office one should be quick;
turning into Wealth, divining illness is ominous;
turning into Resource, documents follow;
turning into Output, it is sure to harm the office;
turning into Peer, the household is not at peace.

chapter: 卜筮歌诀·二十七、六神歌断
title: 六神歌断·白虎：交重丧恶事、官司病患必成凶；持金坐世妨人口，遇火临空便不同

rule.yi: 六神歌断里的白虎一段：白虎爻交重，主丧事、恶事，官司和病患一定凶；白虎属金、坐在世爻上，妨害家里的人口；遇到火，或者落空，情形就不同了。
rule.en: The White Tiger stanza in the verse judging by the six spirits: with the White Tiger line moving, there is mourning and ill fortune, and lawsuits and illness are surely ominous; if it is Metal and sits on the Self line it harms the household members; if it meets Fire or falls Void, things are different.

note.yi: 这一段讲白虎爻发动。「持金」指白虎本身属金（白虎五行属金，见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.38）落在金爻上。末一句给了一个例外：遇火（火克金）或者白虎落了空亡，前面的凶就变了。六神歌断一共六段，每段一位神，这里只收白虎。
note.en: This stanza is about the White Tiger line moving. 'Holding Metal' means the White Tiger, which is itself Metal (see LY.ILL.DYTJ.38), falling on a Metal line. The last line gives an exception: if it meets Fire (Fire controls Metal) or the White Tiger is Void, the ill omen above changes. The verse has six stanzas, one for each spirit; only the White Tiger is taken here.

yi: 白虎爻交重，主丧事、恶事，
官司、病患一定是凶。
持金坐在世爻上，妨害人口，
遇到火，或者落空，情形就不同了。
en: With the White Tiger line moving, there is mourning and ill fortune,
and lawsuits and illness are surely ominous.
If it holds Metal and sits on the Self line, it harms the household members;
if it meets Fire or falls Void, things are different.

chapter: 卜筮歌诀·二十四、月建直符
title: 月建直符·白虎：对宫为白虎凡占当忌，外动有忧惊、内摇生疾苦

rule.yi: 月建直符里说：月建对宫的那一位是白虎，凡是占问都要避忌它；它在外卦发动主忧虑惊恐，在内卦发动生出疾病和痛苦。
rule.en: The verse on the Month as duty-star says: the palace opposite the Month is the White Tiger and is to be shunned in any divination; moving outside it means anxiety and fright, moving inside it brings illness and suffering.

note.yi: 月建直符是另一种排六神的办法：拿当月的月建作青龙，月建往前数三位是朱雀，往后数三位是玄武，月建对冲的那一宫（对宫）是白虎，再往后一位是勾陈，螣蛇从正月的辰起、每月逆行一位。歌里的「内」「外」指内卦、外卦。这里的「对宫」就是月建对冲的那个地支，也就是月破的位置；歌没有说这一点，是从前面几句的排法读出来的。原书在歌后加了一句小注：「正月寅爻动是也，主管一月之事」，说的是月建所在的那一爻发动，管这个月的事。
note.en: The Month as duty-star is another way of setting the six spirits: the Month branch of the current month is the Azure Dragon, three places ahead of it is the Vermilion Bird, three places behind is the Dark Tortoise, the palace opposite the Month branch (the clash) is the White Tiger, one place further back is Hook Earth, and the Coiling Snake starts from Chen in the first month and moves one place backward each month. 'Inside' and 'outside' in the verse are the inner and outer trigrams. Here 'the opposite palace' is the branch that clashes the Month, which is where the Month-break falls; the verse does not say so, and this is read from the way the earlier lines set things out. The original adds a small note after the verse: 'in the first month it is a moving Yin line, and it governs that month's affairs', meaning the line in the Month's place moves and governs the matters of that month.

yi: 对宫是白虎，
凡是占问都应当避忌它；
在外发动，有忧虑惊恐；
在内发动，生出疾病痛苦。
en: The opposite palace is the White Tiger,
to be shunned in any divination;
moving outside, there is anxiety and fright;
moving inside, it brings illness and suffering.

chapter: 卜筮歌诀·二十二、神杀断例
title: 神杀断例·病遇天医瘥

rule.yi: 神杀断例说：占病遇到天医，病会痊愈。
rule.en: The verse of examples on judging by spirit-stars says: in divining illness, meeting the Heavenly Physician, the illness is cured.

note.yi: 「瘥」是病愈。天医是一个神煞，按月定位（正月卯、二月亥……）；断易天机有完整的月表（LY.ILL.DYTJ.30、LY.ILL.DYTJ.34），卜筮全书的神煞歌例里也有（LY.ILL.BSQS.48）。这里只有一句结论，没有位置。同一句的下一句「囚因血忌刑」讲的是囚犯，不收。
note.en: 'Chai' means recovery from illness. The Heavenly Physician is a spirit-star set by month (Mao in the first month, Hai in the second, and so on); the Duanyi Tianji gives the full monthly table (LY.ILL.DYTJ.30, LY.ILL.DYTJ.34), and the verses on spirit-stars in the Bushi Quanshu have it too (LY.ILL.BSQS.48). Here there is only the conclusion, without the positions. The next line, 'a prisoner, because of the Blood Taboo, is punished', is about prisoners and is not taken.

yi: 占病遇到天医，病就痊愈，
en: In divining illness, meeting the Heavenly Physician, the illness is cured,

chapter: 卜筮歌诀·二十二、神杀断例
title: 神杀断例·四般休问病：三丘、五墓、飞帘、浴盆四煞不要问病

rule.yi: 神杀断例说：三丘、五墓、飞帘、浴盆这四样煞，不要拿来问病；占怀孕见了它们，也主忧虑惊恐。
rule.en: The verse of examples on judging by spirit-stars says: do not ask about illness when the Three Mounds, the Five Tombs, the Flying Curtain and the Bathing Basin are present; in divining a pregnancy too they bring worry and fright.

note.yi: 「四般」指前两句点名的四样：三丘、五墓、飞帘、浴盆。三丘五墓在断易天机里有按季节的取法（春丑、夏辰、秋未、冬戌是三丘，五墓从对宫取，LY.ILL.DYTJ.31），卜筮全书的神煞歌例里也有（LY.ILL.BSQS.52）。「飞帘」「浴盆」这里只点了名，没有给位置；周易尚占的神杀例给了浴盆的位置（春辰夏未秋戌冬丑，LY.ILL.ZSZ.01）。
note.en: 'The four kinds' are the four named in the first two lines: the Three Mounds, the Five Tombs, the Flying Curtain and the Bathing Basin. The Duanyi Tianji gives a seasonal way of finding the Three Mounds and Five Tombs (Chou in spring, Chen in summer, Wei in autumn and Xu in winter are the Three Mounds, and the Five Tombs are taken from the opposite palace, LY.ILL.DYTJ.31), and the verses on spirit-stars in the Bushi Quanshu have them as well (LY.ILL.BSQS.52). The Flying Curtain and the Bathing Basin are only named here without positions; the Zhouyi Shangzhan's table of spirit-stars gives the positions of the Bathing Basin (Chen in spring, Wei in summer, Xu in autumn, Chou in winter, LY.ILL.ZSZ.01).

yi: 三丘和五墓，
飞帘和浴盆。
这四样不要问病，
占怀孕也忧虑惊恐。
en: The Three Mounds together with the Five Tombs,
the Flying Curtain and the Bathing Basin:
of these four, do not ask about illness,
and in divining a pregnancy there is worry and fright too.

title: 禾苗田地章·六爻为田夫：六爻鬼克忧病疾

rule.yi: 占庄稼的歌里，第六爻代表种田的人，主灾祸；第六爻被官鬼克，担忧病疾。
rule.en: In the verse on crops, the sixth line stands for the farmer and means calamity; if Pressure controls the sixth line, there is worry over illness.

note.yi: 这是占耕种的歌（禾苗田地章第四首）。歌里爻位依次是：初爻田、二爻种、三爻主长、四爻苗秀、五爻禾（收成）、六爻田夫；每一爻被鬼克都各有一句，只有六爻这一句讲到病。「六爻鬼克」是说官鬼克第六爻（和前面「初爻鬼克田瘦瘠」的句式一样）。这条是爻位配人的一个例子：六爻配的是种田的人。
note.en: This is a verse on farming (the fourth poem of the chapter on crops and fields). Its positions run: the first line is the field, the second the seed, the third the growth, the fourth the fine seedlings, the fifth the grain (the harvest), the sixth the farmer; each line controlled by a ghost has its own sentence, and only the one on the sixth line mentions illness. 'A ghost controls the sixth line' means Pressure controls the sixth line, in the same pattern as 'a ghost controls the first line: the field is lean'. This is an example of a line position matched to a person: the sixth line is matched to the farmer.

yi: 第六爻是种田的人，主灾祸。
en: The sixth line is the farmer and means calamity.

yi: 第六爻被鬼克，担忧病疾。
en: With a ghost controlling the sixth line, there is worry over illness.

title: 住居宅第章·杀爻旺相官灾起、杀遇休囚疾病生（旧注：旺主官非，衰主疾病）

rule.yi: 占家宅的歌里说：杀爻旺相，官灾就起；杀爻遇到休囚，疾病就生。旧注：旺的杀主官非，衰的杀主疾病。
rule.en: The verse on dwellings says: when the killing line is strong, official calamity arises; when the killing line meets rest or confinement, illness arises. The old note: a strong killing spirit brings official trouble, a weak one brings illness.

note.yi: 这是占家宅（住居宅第章第二首）里的一联。歌里的「杀」，歌前面一句的旧注说是勾陈杀（鬼谷起勾陈杀例：正月起辰、二月卯，每月逆行一位；如正月占宅，辰爻动，就是杀旺，主官灾起），歌本身没有明说，译文照字面写「杀爻」。断易天机把勾陈杀列为占病忌发动的四杀之一（LY.ILL.DYTJ.33）。
note.en: This is a couplet in the verse on dwellings (the second poem of the chapter on dwellings and houses). The 'killing' line here is, according to the old note on the previous line, the Hook Earth killing (the Guigu method: begin at Chen in the first month and Mao in the second, moving back one place each month; if a house is divined in the first month and the Chen line moves, the killing is strong and official calamity arises), but the verse itself does not say so, and the translation keeps the literal 'killing line'. The Duanyi Tianji lists the Hook Earth killing among the four killings to avoid when divining illness (LY.ILL.DYTJ.33).

yi: 杀爻旺相，官灾就起；
en: When the killing line is strong, official calamity arises;

yi: 杀爻遇到休囚，疾病就生。
en: when the killing line meets rest or confinement, illness arises.

yi: 旺的杀主官非，
衰的杀主疾病。
en: A strong one brings official trouble,
a weak one brings illness.

title: 住居宅第章·财若动时妻有疾（旧注：妻宫有悔）；更值丧门暴病殂（旧注：丧门杀例，在内三爻发动，主其家必有暴病死）

rule.yi: 占家宅的歌里说：财爻发动，妻子有病；再遇丧门，暴病而死。旧注：丧门的取法是正月未、二月辰、三月丑、四月戌，四个位置轮着用到十二个月；丧门在内卦三爻发动，主这家一定有人暴病而死。
rule.en: The verse on dwellings says: when Wealth moves, the wife is ill; if the Mourning Gate is met as well, sudden illness and death. The old note: the Mourning Gate is placed at Wei in the first month, Chen in the second, Chou in the third and Xu in the fourth, the four places turning through the twelve months; if the Mourning Gate is in the inner three lines and moves, someone in the household is sure to die of a sudden illness.

note.yi: 这里讲病的两处都在占家宅（住居宅第章第二首）的歌里：「财若动时妻有疾」「更值丧门暴病殂」，后面各跟一条旧注。「悔」是易经里的小凶、小麻烦。丧门的位置按旧注，正月未、二月辰、三月丑、四月戌，每月退三位，四月之后又回到未（五月），所以「只此四位，轮十二月」是每四个月一轮；旧注只写了前四个月，五月起的轮换是按「轮十二月」读出来的。断易天机的神煞表里也有丧门（LY.ILL.DYTJ.35 的邻近各条），位置是另一种排法，见那边。
note.en: Both lines on illness here come from the verse on dwellings (the second poem of the chapter on dwellings and houses): 'when Wealth moves, the wife is ill' and 'the Mourning Gate as well: sudden illness and death', each followed by an old note. 'Regret' in the Yijing is a minor trouble. The old note places the Mourning Gate at Wei in the first month, Chen in the second, Chou in the third and Xu in the fourth, three places back each month, with the fifth month returning to Wei, so 'only these four places, turning through twelve months' means one turn every four months; the note writes out only the first four months, and the turning from the fifth month on is read from 'turning through twelve months'. The table of spirit-stars in the Duanyi Tianji also has the Mourning Gate, placed in another way, see there.

yi: 财若发动，妻子有病，
en: When Wealth moves, the wife is ill,

yi: 如果遇到妻财发动，
那么妻子这一宫有悔（不好的事）。
en: If the Wealth line moves,
then the wife's place has cause for regret.

yi: 更遇到丧门，暴病而死。
en: and if the Mourning Gate is met as well, sudden illness and death.

yi: 丧门杀的取法：
正月在未，
二月在辰，
三月在丑，
四月在戌。
只有这四个位置，
轮着用到十二个月。
如果这个杀在内卦三爻，
又发动起来，
主他家一定有人暴病而死。
en: The way to place the Mourning Gate killing:
the first month, Wei;
the second month, Chen;
the third month, Chou;
the fourth month, Xu.
Only these four places,
turning through the twelve months.
If this killing is in the inner three lines,
and moves,
then someone in the household is sure to die of a sudden illness.

title: 住居宅第章·阴化为阳忧女子、阳化为阴损丈夫（旧注：阴变阳女子疾，阳变阴丈夫灾）

rule.yi: 占家宅的歌里说：动爻从阴变阳，女子有忧（旧注：女子有病）；从阳变阴，损伤男子（旧注：男子有灾）。
rule.en: The verse on dwellings says: when a moving line turns from yin into yang, there is worry for the woman (the old note: the woman is ill); when it turns from yang into yin, the man is harmed (the old note: the man has calamity).

note.yi: 歌只说「忧」「损」，是笼统的担忧和损伤；夹在歌句中间的两条旧注把它写成「女子疾」「丈夫灾」，所以放在疾病域。「阴化为阳」是动爻本来是阴爻、变出来是阳爻，这里的「阴」「阳」指爻，不是卦。旧注「丈夫灾」里的灾不一定是病，译文照字面。断易通玄赋里有相近的一联（阳动男人滞、阴动女人殃，LY.ILL.BSQS.23），那一联讲的是动爻本身的阴阳，这一条讲的是变爻的阴阳，不要混。
note.en: The verse says only 'worry' and 'harm', a general worry and harm; the two old notes set between its lines put it as 'the woman is ill' and 'the man has calamity', which is why it is placed in the illness domain. 'A yin line turning into yang' means the moving line was a yin line and what it changes into is a yang line; 'yin' and 'yang' here refer to lines, not to hexagrams. The 'calamity' in the note 'the man has calamity' is not necessarily illness, and the translation keeps it literal. The Duanyi Tongxuan Fu has a related couplet (a yang line moving: the man is held up; a yin line moving: the woman has misfortune, LY.ILL.BSQS.23); that couplet is about the yin or yang of the moving line itself and this one about the yin or yang of the changed line, so they should not be mixed.

yi: 阴爻化成阳爻，女子有忧；
en: A yin line turning into yang, there is worry for the woman;

yi: 阴变阳，女子有病；
en: yin changing to yang, the woman is ill;

yi: 阳爻化成阴爻，损伤男子；
en: a yang line turning into yin, the man is harmed;

yi: 阳变阴，男子有灾。
en: yang changing to yin, the man has calamity.

title: 住居宅第章·子兴有喜没官非、更无灾病与盗贼；兄动耗财妻妾病

rule.yi: 占家宅的歌里说：子孙发动，有喜事，没有官非，也没有灾病和盗贼；兄弟发动，耗财，妻妾有病，是非和谋望又多阻隔。
rule.en: The verse on dwellings says: when Output moves, there is joy, no official trouble, and no calamity, illness or thieves either; when Peer moves, money is spent, the wife and concubines fall ill, and quarrels and plans meet many obstacles.

note.yi: 这是占家宅（住居宅第章第三首）里的两联。全歌先说「五事俱全不可克」（父母、兄弟、子孙、妻财、官鬼五类都要齐全、不被克），再按子、财、兄、父、鬼各一联讲各自发动的结果，这里只收有病的两联。
note.en: These are two couplets in the verse on dwellings (the third poem of the chapter on dwellings and houses). The whole poem first says 'all five kinds must be present and not controlled' (Resource, Peer, Output, Wealth and Pressure), then gives one couplet each for Output, Wealth, Peer, Resource and Pressure moving; only the two couplets with illness in them are taken.

yi: 子孙爻发动，有喜事，没有官非，
更没有灾病和盗贼。
en: When the Output line moves, there is joy and no official trouble,
and no calamity, illness or thieves either.

yi: 兄弟发动，耗财，妻妾有病，
是非和谋望多有阻隔。
en: When Peer moves, money is spent and the wife and concubines fall ill,
and quarrels and plans meet many obstacles.

title: 移徒章·朱雀又临官鬼位、克世兼持世：病遭危困、讼遭囚

rule.yi: 占迁居的歌里说：朱雀又临在官鬼爻上，官司口舌就有来由；再克世、又持世，生病会遇到危险困厄，打官司会被囚禁。
rule.en: The verse on moving house says: if the Vermilion Bird sits on a Pressure line, there is cause for lawsuits and quarrels; if it also controls and holds the Self line, illness meets danger and distress, and a lawsuit ends in imprisonment.

note.yi: 这是占迁居（移徒章第一首）里的一联，讲朱雀、官鬼、世爻三样凑在一起。「克世兼持世」是同一个神既克世爻又坐在世爻上，照字面写成「控制并占住」在汉语里说不通，译文写作「又克世、又持世」，保留歌里两个动作并列的样子。
note.en: This couplet is in the verse on moving house (the first poem of the chapter on moving), where the Vermilion Bird, Pressure and the Self line come together. 'Controls and holds the Self line' describes one spirit that both controls the Self line and sits on it; the translation keeps the two actions side by side as in the verse.

yi: 朱雀又临在官鬼位上，
官司口舌有来由。
再克世又持世，
生病遇到危险困厄，打官司遇到囚禁。
en: If the Vermilion Bird also sits on the Pressure position,
there is cause for lawsuits and quarrels.
and if it also controls and holds the Self line,
illness meets danger and distress, and a lawsuit meets imprisonment.

title: 六亲章·杀神朱雀同时并重病如何得起床；妻犯勾陈妻病殃

rule.yi: 六亲章里讲病的两处：父母爻带着杀神，又和朱雀同时并在一起，重病怎么还能起得了床；妻财犯了勾陈，妻子有病灾。
rule.en: Two places on illness in the chapter on the six relations: when the Resource line carries a killing spirit and is joined by the Vermilion Bird, how can a grave illness ever rise from bed; when Wealth offends Hook Earth, the wife has illness and misfortune.

note.yi: 这首六亲章是一段很长的歌，从父母一直讲到兄弟，这里只收和病有关的两处。「杀神朱雀同时并」里的杀神泛指凶煞，歌里没有点名；这一联接在讲父母爻的几句后面，所以译文按「父母爻带着杀神」读，歌没有明写主语。婚姻域收过第二处（LY.MARRY.BSQS.10）。
note.en: This poem on the six relations is long, running from Resource to Peer, and only the two places bearing on illness are taken here. The 'killing spirit' in 'a killing spirit and the Vermilion Bird together' is a general word for ill-omened stars and the verse names none; the couplet follows the lines on the Resource line, so the translation reads it as 'the Resource line carrying a killing spirit', though the verse does not write the subject. The second place was taken in the marriage domain (LY.MARRY.BSQS.10).

yi: 父母爻休囚，早早离开祖上；
有两重父母爻，过继到亲房。
杀神和朱雀同时并在一起，
重病怎么还能起得了床。
en: With the Resource line resting or confined, one leaves the ancestors early;
with two Resource lines, one passes into a relative's household.
When a killing spirit and the Vermilion Bird are together,
how can a grave illness ever rise from bed?

yi: 财爻临朱雀，妻子贤惠聪明；
妻财犯了勾陈，妻子有病灾。
en: Wealth on the Vermilion Bird: the wife is worthy and clever;
Wealth offending Hook Earth: the wife has illness and misfortune.

title: 行人章·鬼兄并发多应病，官化为官更不祥

rule.yi: 占行人的歌里说：官鬼爻和兄弟爻一起发动，多半应在行人生病；官鬼化出官鬼，更不吉祥。
rule.en: The verse on travellers says: when the Pressure line and the Peer line move together, it mostly points to the traveller falling ill; Pressure turning into Pressure is still more inauspicious.

note.yi: 这是占行人（外出的人）的歌里的一联，讲的是出门在外的人生病。「鬼兄」是官鬼和兄弟两爻。「官化为官」是官鬼发动、变出来又是官鬼。同一首歌的其余句子讲行人什么时候回、在路上有什么事，不收。
note.en: This couplet is in the verse on travellers (people away from home) and is about the traveller falling ill. 'Ghost and brother' means the Pressure and Peer lines. 'Official turning into official' is a Pressure line that moves and changes into Pressure again. The other lines of the same poem are about when the traveller returns and what befalls him on the road, and are not taken.

yi: 鬼爻和兄弟爻一起发动，多半应在生病，
官鬼化成官鬼，更不吉祥。
en: When Pressure and Peer move together, it mostly points to illness,
and Pressure turning into Pressure is still more inauspicious.

title: 行人章·附健否：旺相不入墓爻活、囚死空亡随水沫；卦爻不化入墓中皆平善，反之必死

rule.yi: 占行人是否平安的歌里说：行人的爻旺相、没有入墓就活，囚死、落空亡就像水沫一样散去；卦和爻不变化入墓，都平安稳当，反过来一定死，只好去招魂、办殡宫。
rule.en: The verse on whether a traveller is well says: if the traveller's line is strong and does not enter the tomb it lives; if it is confined, dead or Void it drifts away like foam on water; if the hexagram and lines do not change into a tomb, all is peaceful and secure; the reverse is certain death, and one can only go and call the soul and prepare the mourning hall.

note.yi: 这一首歌收在占行人一章末尾的「附：健否」，问的是出门在外的人是死是活，和占病的生死是同一类判断：看用爻旺不旺、入没入墓、落没落空。「殡宫」是停放灵柩的地方。这里的行人是一个不在场的人，他的病死判断和本域「他人病」「生死」两类相通。
note.en: This poem is the 'Appendix: whether he is well' at the end of the chapter on travellers and asks whether a person away from home is alive or dead; it is the same kind of judgement as life and death in an illness: whether the Subject line is strong, whether it enters a tomb, whether it is Void. A 'mourning hall' is where the coffin is kept. The traveller is someone not present, and the judgement of his illness or death is akin to the 'illness of others' and 'life and death' topics in this domain.

yi: 旺相，没有入墓，这一爻就活；
囚死、落空亡，就像水上的泡沫散去。
再看上卦下卦怎么样：
旺相又相生，行动就活泼泼的。
卦和爻不变化入墓，
都是平安顺遂，稳当兴隆；
反过来就一定死，不必指望，
只好去招魂、办殡宫了。
en: Strong and not entering the tomb, the line lives;
confined, dead or Void, it drifts away like foam on the water.
Then see how the upper and lower trigrams are:
thriving and generating each other, one moves about briskly.
If the hexagram and lines do not change into a tomb,
all is peaceful and smooth, secure and prosperous;
the reverse is certain death, with no hope,
and one can only go and call the soul and prepare the mourning hall.

title: 通玄妙论·逢冲暗动：占家宅暗动吉则暗中有补、凶则暗中有害；占病亦随其所遇之神而定其吉凶

rule.yi: 通玄妙论讲逢冲暗动，末一句是：占病也是随着所遇到的那位神，来定它的吉凶。
rule.en: The Tongxuan Miaolun on a line stirred by a clash ends with: in divining illness, too, good or ill is fixed by the spirit that is met.

note.yi: 「暗动」是静爻被日辰冲动（断易天机、卜筮大全这一节开头都有定义：六爻安静，不遇冲则不动，日辰相冲，名曰暗动）。「所遇之神」按上下文读是被冲动的那一爻是什么神，就按那一爻是吉还是凶来断，书里没有另外注。断易天机里同一节对占病写得具体（LY.ILL.DYTJ.28：吉则病人有默佑，凶则阴隙所致），卜筮大全这一本只有这一句概括，一本具体、一本笼统，不矛盾。这一句前面的家宅一联是同一节里的，一并带着，让「占病亦随」有所指。
note.en: A 'stirred' line is a still line set moving by the Day branch clashing it (both the Duanyi Tianji and the Bushi Daquan define it at the head of this section: if all six lines are still and there is no clash, nothing moves; if the Day clashes a line, it is called stirred). 'The spirit that is met' is read from the context as: whatever kind of line has been stirred, judge by whether that line is good or bad; the book gives no separate note. The same section in the Duanyi Tianji is more specific about illness (LY.ILL.DYTJ.28: if good, the sick person has a silent protector; if bad, it comes from a hidden crack), while this copy in the Bushi Daquan has only this general sentence; one is specific and the other general, and they do not conflict. The couplet on houses before this sentence belongs to the same section and is carried along so that 'in divining illness too' has something to refer to.

yi: 占家宅遇到暗动，
吉就暗中有补益，
福已经来了却不知道；
凶就暗中有伤害，
祸刚要萌生却没有察觉。
占病也是随着所遇到的那位神，
来定它的吉凶。
en: In divining a house, meeting a stirred line,
if good there is a hidden help,
fortune has already come and is not known;
if bad there is a hidden harm,
and misfortune is about to sprout and is not noticed.
In divining illness too, it goes by the spirit that is met,
and its good or ill is fixed.

title: 断易总论·疾病几句：散官治病全赖子孙；月破临于用爻作事无成病不痊；五墓临世临身问病一生九死

rule.yi: 断易总论里讲病的几句：要消散官事、医治疾病，全靠子孙；月破落在用爻上，做事没有结果，病不得痊愈；五墓落在世爻或卦身上，问病是一生九死。
rule.en: The lines on illness in the general discussion of Duanyi: to disperse official matters and to treat illness, rely wholly on Output; with the Month-break falling on the Subject line, nothing done comes to completion and the illness is not cured; with the Five Tombs on the Self line or the Body, in asking about illness it is nine deaths to one life.

note.yi: 「散官治病」按下一句「兴讼求名，须凭官鬼」对着读：兴讼求名要靠官鬼，散官治病要靠子孙（子孙克官鬼），所以「散官」是消散官事，不是指一个官职；这是按对句读出来的，书里没有注。「用爻」就是用神。「五墓」指什么书里没有当场讲：可能是五行的墓库（断易天机论墓一节，LY.ILL.DYTJ.23），也可能是三丘五墓杀里的五墓（LY.ILL.DYTJ.31），译文直写「五墓」。「一生九死」是九分死、一分生。同一段话在火珠林里也有（第 866 行）。
note.en: 'Disperse official matters and treat illness' is read against the next line, 'to start a suit or seek fame one must depend on Pressure': starting a suit or seeking fame relies on Pressure, and dispersing official matters or treating illness relies on Output (which controls Pressure), so 'disperse officials' means dissolving official trouble and not an official post; this is read from the parallel lines and the book gives no note. The 'Subject line' is the Subject. The book does not say on the spot what 'the Five Tombs' are: they may be the tombs of the five elements (the section on tombs in the Duanyi Tianji, LY.ILL.DYTJ.23) or the Five Tombs of the Three Mounds and Five Tombs killing (LY.ILL.DYTJ.31), and the translation writes 'the Five Tombs' as it stands. 'Nine deaths to one life' is nine parts death and one part life. The same passage is also in the Huozhu Lin (line 866).

yi: 要消散官事、医治疾病，
全靠子孙。
要打官司、求功名，
必须凭官鬼。
en: To disperse official matters and to treat illness,
rely wholly on Output.
To start a lawsuit or seek fame,
one must depend on Pressure.

yi: 月破落在用爻上，
做事没有结果，病不得痊愈。
en: With the Month-break falling on the Subject line,
nothing done comes to completion and the illness is not cured.

yi: 五墓落在世爻、落在卦身上，
问病，是一生九死。
en: With the Five Tombs falling on the Self line or the Body,
in asking about illness it is nine deaths to one life.

title: 断易通玄赋·阳动男人滞、阴动女人殃（旧注：问病事，阳爻发动主男人有病；阴爻动主女人有灾）

rule.yi: 断易通玄赋里说：阳爻动，男子受阻滞；阴爻动，女子有灾殃。火珠林的旧注讲得明白：问病的事，遇到阳爻发动，主男人有病；阴爻发动，主女人有灾。
rule.en: The Duanyi Tongxuan Fu says: when a yang line moves the man is held up; when a yin line moves the woman meets misfortune. The old note in the Huozhu Lin is explicit: in asking about illness, if a yang line moves, the man is ill; if a yin line moves, the woman has calamity.

note.yi: 这一联在卜筮大全里的旧注只写「阳爻动，主男人唉；阴爻动，主女人灾」，「唉」字照原文，按上下文该是「滞」或「疾」的误字，译文照字面写成「叹息」；火珠林本的旧注则明写「问病事」，所以放在疾病域。虎易的评注认为这两句可能转抄有误，应是「子动男人滞，兄动女人殃」（从夫妻生克上说），那是今人的评注，这里不收。另：这一条讲动爻本身的阴阳，和前面「阴化为阳」「阳化为阴」（LY.ILL.BSQS.15）讲的变爻阴阳不同。断易天机里也有同一联（第 2807 行，无旧注）。
note.en: In the Bushi Daquan the old note reads only 'a yang line moving means the man sighs; a yin line moving means the woman has calamity'; the character for 'sighs' is kept as in the text, which from the context should be a miswritten 'held up' or 'ill', and the translation renders it literally as 'sighs'; the old note in the Huozhu Lin says outright 'in asking about illness', which is why this is placed in the illness domain. Hu Yi's commentary holds that the two lines may have been miscopied and should read 'Output moves: the man is held up; Peer moves: the woman meets misfortune' (from the control relations of husband and wife); that is a modern commentary and is not quoted here. Note also that this entry is about the yin or yang of the moving line itself, unlike the 'yin turning into yang' and 'yang turning into yin' lines (LY.ILL.BSQS.15) which are about the changed line. The Duanyi Tianji also has the same couplet (line 2807, without an old note).

yi: 阳爻发动，男人受阻滞；
阴爻发动，女人有灾殃。
en: When a yang line moves, the man is held up;
when a yin line moves, the woman meets misfortune.

yi: 阳爻动，主男人叹息；
阴爻动，主女人有灾。
en: A yang line moving means the man sighs;
a yin line moving means the woman has calamity.

yi: 阳动男人滞。
en: A yang line moving: the man is held up.

zh: （问病事，如遇阳爻发动，主男人有病。）
yi: （问病事，如果遇到阳爻发动，主男人有病。）
en: (In asking about illness, if a yang line moves, it means the man is ill.)

yi: 阴动女人殃。
en: A yin line moving: the woman meets misfortune.

yi: （注：阴爻动，主女人有灾。）
en: (A yin line moving means the woman has calamity.)

title: 身命章·父母持世辛勤劳碌、兄弟持世疾病连绵

rule.yi: 阐幽精要的身命章说：父母爻持世，一生辛勤劳碌；兄弟爻持世，疾病连绵。
rule.en: The chapter on the person and life in the Chanyou Jingyao says: with Resource holding the Self line one toils and labours; with Peer holding the Self line, illness drags on.

note.yi: 这是阐幽精要里占身命（问一个人一生）一章里的一联，讲世爻上坐什么六亲，对这个人一生的影响。「疾病连绵」是病一个接一个，不是指某一场病；这一章是讲人的命，不是讲一次占病，所以放在本域的「总则」里。
note.en: This couplet is in the chapter of the Chanyou Jingyao on divining a person's life, and it says what the relation on the Self line does to a person over his lifetime. 'Illness drags on' means one illness after another, not one particular illness; the chapter is about a person's fate, not a single divination about illness, which is why it sits under 'principles' in this domain.

yi: 父母爻持世，
辛勤劳碌；
兄弟爻持世，
疾病连绵。
en: With Resource holding the Self line,
it is toil and labour;
with Peer holding the Self line,
illness drags on.

title: 家宅说·父母子孙俱旺老者安少者康；螣蛇白虎安静灾不生祸不作

rule.yi: 占家宅的一篇说：父母、子孙都旺，老人平安，年轻人康健；螣蛇、白虎安静，灾不生，祸不作。
rule.en: The essay on divining a house says: when Resource and Output are both strong, the old are at peace and the young are healthy; when the Coiling Snake and White Tiger are still, calamity does not arise and misfortune does not happen.

note.yi: 「老者安，少者康」是按父母代表老人、子孙代表年轻人读的，书里没有另注。螣蛇、白虎是主怪异、丧病的神，它们安静，灾祸就起不来。原文「鰧蛇」是「螣蛇」的异写。
note.en: 'The old at peace, the young healthy' is read with Resource standing for the old and Output for the young; the book gives no separate note. The Coiling Snake and White Tiger are the spirits of oddities and of mourning and illness, and when they are still calamity cannot arise. The original writes the snake with a variant character.

yi: 父母、子孙都旺，
老人平安，
年轻人康健；
en: When Resource and Output are both strong,
the old are at peace,
the young are healthy;

yi: 螣蛇、白虎安静，
灾难不会产生，
祸患不会发作。
en: with the Coiling Snake and White Tiger still,
calamity does not arise,
and misfortune does not happen.

title: 柳神经·鬼与病：心气病火鬼动、脾胃灾土鬼摇；青龙六位巽宫家有头风之疾、玄武初爻鬼动必生脚湿之人；初位杀空小儿难养、六爻木鬼老者中风、上透金爻终年眼暗、五爻火鬼痨瘵缠身

rule.yi: 柳神经里把鬼爻的五行、所在的位置和病挂在一起：火鬼动是心气病，土鬼摇是脾胃病；青龙在六位、巽宫，家里有头风；玄武在初爻、鬼动，生脚湿的人；初爻的杀落空，小孩难养；六爻木鬼，老人中风；上面透出金爻，终年眼暗；五爻火鬼，痨瘵缠身。
rule.en: The Liushen Jing ties the element of a ghost line, its place and an illness together: a Fire ghost moving is illness of the heart qi, an Earth ghost stirring is trouble of the spleen and stomach; the Azure Dragon in the sixth place and the Xun palace gives the household head-wind; the Dark Tortoise on the first line with the ghost moving gives someone with damp feet; a Void killing on the first place makes a small child hard to raise; a Wood ghost on the sixth line, an old person has a stroke; a Metal line showing through above, dim eyes all the year; a Fire ghost on the fifth line, consumption clings to the body.

note.yi: 柳神经是阐幽精要里占家宅的一篇，前后各联讲房屋、牲畜、神鬼，这里收的几联把鬼爻和病挂上：心气病配火鬼、脾胃灾配土鬼（本篇疾病论里也是这样，见 LY.ILL.BSQS.32、LY.ILL.BSQS.43）。「头风」是长年头痛；「脚湿」是脚上湿病（脚气一类）；「痨瘵」是肺痨；「中风」「眼暗」照字面。「初位杀空」「上透金爻」两处文意不全（杀是哪一种杀、金爻透在哪里），书里没有注，译文照字面。
note.en: The Liushen Jing is an essay on divining a house in the Chanyou Jingyao; its couplets run through buildings, livestock and spirits, and the ones taken here tie a ghost line to an illness: a heart-qi illness goes with a Fire ghost and trouble of the spleen and stomach with an Earth ghost (so also in this book's chapter on illness, see LY.ILL.BSQS.32 and LY.ILL.BSQS.43). 'Head-wind' is a long-standing headache; 'damp feet' is a damp disease of the feet (of the beriberi kind); 'consumption' is pulmonary consumption; 'stroke' and 'dim eyes' are literal. In 'a killing spirit Void in the first place' and 'a Metal line showing through above' the sense is incomplete (which killing spirit, and where the Metal line shows through); the book gives no note and the translation keeps to the letter.

yi: 心气的病，是火鬼发动；
脾胃的灾，是土鬼摇动。
en: Illness of the heart qi: a Fire ghost moves;
trouble of the spleen and stomach: an Earth ghost stirs.

yi: 青龙在六位、巽宫，
家里有头风的病；
玄武在初爻、鬼爻发动，
一定生出脚湿的人。
en: With the Azure Dragon in the sixth place and the Xun palace,
the household has head-wind (chronic headache);
with the Dark Tortoise on the first line and the ghost moving,
someone with damp feet is sure to appear.

yi: 初位杀空，
小孩难养；
六爻木鬼，
老人中风；
上面透出金爻，
终年眼睛昏暗；
五爻火鬼，
痨瘵缠身。
en: With a killing spirit Void in the first place,
a small child is hard to raise;
a Wood ghost on the sixth line,
an old person has a stroke;
a Metal line showing through above,
the eyes are dim all the year;
a Fire ghost on the fifth line,
consumption clings to the body.

title: 柳神经·家宅占家中有病人：父爻值墓家多疾病之人；火爻伏鬼定生目疾之人、水位隐官必有盲聋之辈；披头动要出疯癫、五鬼兴必生暗眼

rule.yi: 柳神经里讲家里会有什么样的病人：父爻落在墓上，家里多有生病的人；火爻下面伏着鬼，一定生出眼病的人；水位下面藏着官，一定有又瞎又聋的人；披头煞发动，要出疯癫的人；五鬼煞兴起，一定生出眼睛看不见的人。
rule.en: The Liushen Jing on what kind of sick person the household will have: with the Resource line on a tomb, the household has many sick people; with a ghost hidden under a Fire line, someone with an eye disease is sure to appear; with an officer hidden in the Water place, there will surely be people blind or deaf; when the Loosened Hair star moves, a mad person will appear; when the Five Ghosts rise, someone with darkened eyes is sure to be born.

note.yi: 「家多疾病之人」的人是家里的人；「生」是出现、生出来，不是生孩子。「水位隐官」是水爻下面伏着官鬼。「披头」「五鬼」是神煞名，位置见卜筮全书神煞歌例里的「驾后神煞」（披头五鬼，辰上起子逆行）。「暗眼」书里没有解释，可能是看不清，也可能是瞎，译文写作「眼睛看不清」。「父爻值墓，家多疾病之人」同一句在参玄赋里也有（LY.ILL.BSQS.28）。
note.en: 'The household has many sick people' means people of the household; 'appear' is to come into being, not to give birth. 'An officer hidden in the Water place' is a Pressure line hidden under a Water line. 'Loosened Hair' and 'Five Ghosts' are spirit-stars whose positions are given in the verses on spirit-stars in this book under 'the stars after the carriage' (the Loosened Hair and Five Ghosts start at Chen and count back from Zi). 'Darkened eyes' is not explained in the book and may mean dim sight or blindness; the translation says 'eyes that cannot see clearly'. The same sentence 'the Resource line on a tomb: the household has many sick people' also appears in the Canxuan Fu (LY.ILL.BSQS.28).

yi: 父爻落在墓上，
家里多有生病的人；
财位落空，
宅里住的是贫穷的人。
en: With the Resource line on a tomb,
the household has many sick people;
with the Wealth place Void,
the people who live in the house are poor.

yi: 火爻下面伏着鬼，
一定生出眼病的人；
水位下面藏着官，
一定有又瞎又聋的人。
en: With a ghost hidden under a Fire line,
someone with an eye disease is sure to appear;
with an officer hidden in the Water place,
there will surely be people blind or deaf.

yi: 披头煞发动，
要出疯癫的人；
五鬼煞兴起，
一定生出眼睛看不清的人。
en: When the Loosened Hair star moves,
a mad person will appear;
when the Five Ghosts rise,
someone with darkened eyes is sure to be born.

title: 参玄赋·家宅占的病句：父爻入墓家多疾病之人；兄克金财妻有病；日克火爻当生眼疾、日冲坎位定主耳聋

rule.yi: 参玄赋里讲家宅时提到病的几句：父爻入了墓，家里多有生病的人；兄爻克金财，妻子有病；日辰克火爻，要生眼病；日辰冲坎位，一定主耳聋。
rule.en: The lines on illness in the Canxuan Fu's discussion of a house: with the Resource line entering a tomb, the household has many sick people; with the brother line controlling a Metal Wealth line, the wife is ill; when the Day controls the Fire line, eye disease will arise; when the Day clashes the Kan place, deafness is sure.

note.yi: 参玄赋是阐幽精要里的一篇赋，占家宅。「兄克金财妻有病」的「兄」是兄爻（兄弟爻），「金财」是五行属金的妻财爻，妻子看财爻，所以是妻子有病；这一句后面接的「弟临火应友多非」讲朋友，不收。「日克火爻」「日冲坎位」的日是日辰。「宅有产亡之鬼」是宅里有难产而死的人的鬼魂，不是病，但和前半句同在一联，所以带着。
note.en: The Canxuan Fu is a fu in the Chanyou Jingyao, on divining a house. In 'the brother line controls a Metal Wealth line: the wife is ill' the brother line is the Peer line and the Metal Wealth line is the Wealth line of the Metal element; a wife is read from the Wealth line, so it is the wife who is ill; the next clause, about friends, is not taken. In 'the Day controls the Fire line' and 'the Day clashes the Kan place' the Day is the Day branch. 'The ghost of one who died in childbirth' is not illness, but it is in the same couplet as the first half and is carried with it.

yi: 父爻入了墓，
家里多有生病的人；
财位落空，
宅里有难产而死的鬼。
en: With the Resource line entering a tomb,
the household has many sick people;
with the Wealth place Void,
the house has the ghost of one who died in childbirth.

yi: 兄爻克金财，妻子有病，
en: With the brother line controlling a Metal Wealth line, the wife is ill,

yi: 日辰克火爻，
就要生眼病；
日辰冲坎位，
一定主耳聋。
en: When the Day controls the Fire line,
eye disease will arise;
when the Day clashes the Kan place,
deafness is sure.

title: 家宅秘诀·鬼墓临身常有阴人伏枕；阴鬼主阴司之病症、阳鬼为户役之官非

rule.yi: 家宅秘诀说：鬼爻的墓临在身上，常有女人卧病在床；阴爻的鬼主阴司作祟的病症，阳爻的鬼是户役方面的官非。
rule.en: The secret rules on the house say: with the ghost's tomb falling on the Body, there is often a woman lying ill in bed; a yin ghost means illnesses sent by the netherworld office, a yang ghost means official trouble over household duties.

note.yi: 「阴鬼」是阴爻上的官鬼，「阳鬼」是阳爻上的官鬼；「阴司」是阴间的官府，也就是鬼神，所以阴鬼主的病症是鬼神作祟一类。「户役」是户籍和差役。「鬼墓临身」的「身」是卦身还是自身，书里没有说，译文写作「身」。「阴人」通常指女人。
note.en: A 'yin ghost' is a Pressure line on a yin line and a 'yang ghost' one on a yang line; the 'netherworld office' is the office of the underworld, that is, spirits, so what a yin ghost brings is illness of the kind sent by spirits. 'Household duties' are household registration and corvée. Whether 'the Body' in 'the ghost's tomb falling on the Body' is the hexagram's Body or oneself is not said, and the translation writes 'the Body'. 'A yin person' ordinarily means a woman.

yi: 鬼墓临在身上，
常有女人卧病在床；
en: With the ghost's tomb falling on the Body,
there is often a woman lying ill in bed;

yi: 阴鬼主阴司的病症，
阳鬼是户役方面的官非。
en: A yin ghost means illnesses sent by the netherworld office,
a yang ghost means official trouble over household duties.

title: 搜精六爻·初爻克五爻宅长病、克二爻宅母危；六爻白虎带鬼旺灾病及公婆

rule.yi: 搜精六爻说：（初爻）克第五爻，是一家之长有病；克第二爻，是宅母有危险。第六爻，白虎带着鬼爻又旺，灾病牵连到祖父母。
rule.en: The essay on searching out the essence of the six lines says: [the first line] controlling the fifth line, the head of the household is ill; controlling the second line, the mistress of the house is in danger. On the sixth line, with the White Tiger carrying a strong ghost, calamity and illness reach the grandparents.

note.yi: 搜精六爻是阐幽精要里逐爻讲家宅的一篇：初爻是根基，二爻是宅母，三爻是门户，四爻是外户，五爻是家长，六爻是虚位、祖父母。「克五宅长病」没有写谁克，按上文（讲初爻）读是初爻克五爻；「公婆」按上一联「六爻为虚位，永为祖父婆」读作祖父母。这两处书里都没有另注。
note.en: The essay on searching out the essence of the six lines goes line by line through a house: the first line is the foundation, the second the mistress of the house, the third the gate and doors, the fourth the outer door, the fifth the head of the household, and the sixth the empty place and the grandparents. 'Controls the fifth: the head of the house is ill' does not say who controls; it is read from the context (the passage on the first line) as the first line controlling the fifth. 'The old man and old woman' is read as the grandparents from the earlier couplet 'the sixth line is the empty place and is always the grandparents'. The book gives no note on either point.

yi: （初爻）克第五爻，是一家之长有病；
克第二爻，是宅母有危险；
en: [The first line] controlling the fifth, the head of the household is ill;
controlling the second, the mistress of the house is in danger;

yi: 白虎带着鬼爻，又旺相，
灾病牵连到祖父母。
en: With the White Tiger carrying a strong ghost,
calamity and illness reach the grandparents.

title: 疾病论·总起：凡占疾病先祷上下神祇；问生死祸福须详得病之由、次告先贤之验

rule.yi: 疾病论一篇开头说：凡是占疾病，先向天神地祇祷告；去问生死祸福，要把得病的缘由问得详细，再告诉他前贤应验过的例子。
rule.en: The chapter on illness opens: in divining illness, first pray to the spirits above and below; in asking about life and death, calamity and fortune, the cause of the illness must be learned in detail, and then the confirmations of the former sages told.

note.yi: 这是疾病论头两句。「先祷上下神祇」是占病之前的礼仪：向天神地祇祷告。「得病之由」是病的来由，占之前要问清，后面讲神鬼、病因的各句都要靠它。「次告先贤之验」的主语书里没有写，这里按「把前人验过的例子告诉他」读。
note.en: These are the first two sentences of the chapter on illness. 'First pray to the spirits above and below' is the ritual before a divination about illness: a prayer to the spirits of heaven and earth. 'The cause of the illness' is how the illness came about, which must be asked before the divination, since the later lines on spirits and causes depend on it. The subject of 'next tell the confirmations of the former sages' is not written in the book, and it is read here as 'the examples confirmed by the ancients are told to him'.

yi: 凡是占疾病，
先向上下的神祇祷告。
en: In divining illness,
first pray to the spirits above and below.

yi: 去找卜卦的人，
想问生死祸福，
要详细问明得病的缘由，
然后再讲前贤应验过的例子。
en: In going to the diviner,
wishing to ask about life and death, calamity and fortune,
the cause of the illness must be learned in detail,
and next the confirmations of the former sages told.

title: 疾病论·五行与病位：金木动骨骼疼酸、水火兴皮肤寒热；丑未伤脾、戌辰破腹；土伏土爻生肿毒、金藏金位动心胞；妻在土兴呕吐；木下木多寒燠、水伏水多冷淋

rule.yi: 疾病论里按五行和地支配病：金、木动，骨骼疼酸；水、火兴，皮肤寒热；丑、未交重必伤脾；戌、辰发动是因为腹部的病；土伏在土爻下，生肿毒；金藏在金位，动心包；妻财在土上兴旺，呕吐；木下伏木、木多，忽冷忽热；水伏在水下、水多，冷淋。
rule.en: The chapter on illness matches illnesses to the five elements and branches: Metal or Wood moving, bones and joints ache; Water or Fire rising, the skin has chills and fever; Chou or Wei moving is sure to harm the spleen; Xu or Chen moving comes from trouble of the belly; Earth hidden under an Earth line gives swollen toxin; Metal hidden in a Metal place stirs the pericardium; Wealth on Earth and rising, vomiting; Wood under Wood, with much Wood, blowing hot and cold; Water hidden under Water, with much Water, cold strangury.

note.yi: 这几联把五行（金木水火土）或地支（丑未、戌辰）配上身体部位和症状。「破腹」字面是腹破，这里按腹泻、腹痛一类的肚腹病读，书里没有另注。「迟疑」讲的是官鬼临土发动的结果，字面不像症状，可能是病拖着不好，译文照字面写作「拖延迟疑」。「寒燠」是忽冷忽热，「冷淋」是小便涩痛而冷的淋病，「心胞」是心包。「土伏土爻」「木下木多」按字面是伏神五行同于飞神（或卦中某五行多）的意思。这一组和本书的五行论病歌（LY.ILL.BSQS.43）、柳神经的火鬼动心气病（LY.ILL.BSQS.26）配法大体相通。
note.en: These couplets match the five elements (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth) or branches (Chou and Wei, Xu and Chen) to parts of the body and to symptoms. 'Broken belly' is literally a belly that has burst, and is read here as an upset belly or pain of the abdomen; the book gives no note. 'Hesitation' is the result of a Pressure line on Earth moving; as a symptom it reads oddly and may mean the illness drags on, so the translation keeps it as 'delay and doubt'. 'Blowing hot and cold' is alternating cold and heat; 'cold strangury' is a strangury, a painful and dribbling urination, with cold; the 'pericardium' is the heart's envelope. 'Earth hidden under an Earth line' and 'Wood under Wood' mean, literally, a hidden line of the same element as the flying line (or much of one element in the hexagram). This group is in general akin to the verse on illness by the five elements in this book (LY.ILL.BSQS.43) and to the Liushen Jing's 'heart-qi illness: a Fire ghost moves' (LY.ILL.BSQS.26).

yi: 金、木发动，
骨头关节酸痛；
水、火兴旺，
皮肤发冷发热。
丑、未交重，必定伤脾；
戌、辰发动，是因为腹部的病。
en: With Metal or Wood moving,
the bones and joints ache;
with Water or Fire rising,
the skin has chills and fever.
With Chou or Wei moving, the spleen is sure to be harmed;
with Xu or Chen moving, it comes from trouble of the belly.

yi: 土伏在土爻下，生肿毒；
金藏在金位，动心包。
妻财在土上兴旺，呕吐；
官鬼临在土上发动，拖延迟疑；
木下伏木、木多，忽冷忽热；
水伏水下、水多，冷淋。
en: Earth hidden under an Earth line gives swollen toxin;
Metal hidden in a Metal place stirs the pericardium.
Wealth on Earth and rising, vomiting;
a Pressure line on Earth and moving, delay and doubt;
Wood hidden under Wood, with much Wood, blowing hot and cold;
Water hidden under Water, with much Water, cold strangury.

title: 疾病论·八卦鬼与病位：巽鬼股痛、震官足疾不瘳；离宫疮痍、火鬼心目之灾；兑官面病、坎鬼腹中灾；乾官头痛、坤鬼肚疼；坎水耳疾、艮土手灾

rule.yi: 疾病论里按八卦配病位：巽宫鬼爻兴旺，大腿痛；震宫官鬼旺动，脚病不愈；离宫旺相、内卦发动，是疮疡一类的病；火鬼休囚、外卦交重，是心和眼睛的灾；兑宫官鬼发动，是面部的病；坎宫鬼爻交重，是腹中的灾；乾宫官鬼旺相，是头痛；坤宫鬼爻兴旺，是肚子疼；坎卦水爻兴旺，只因为耳病；艮宫土爻发动，一定是手的灾。
rule.en: The chapter on illness matches the trigrams to the place of illness: the ghost of Xun thriving, pain in the thigh; the Pressure line of Zhen strong and moving, a disease of the foot that does not heal; Li strong and its inner lines moving, a disease of sores and wounds; a Fire ghost resting or confined with the outer lines moving, trouble of the heart and eyes; the Pressure line of Dui moving, illness of the face; a Kan ghost moving, trouble within the belly; the Pressure line of Qian strong, headache; the Kun ghost thriving, belly pain; the Water line of Kan rising, only an ear disease; the Earth line of Gen moving, sure to be trouble of the hand.

dispute.yi: 八卦各管身体哪一处，几处说法不同。疾病论这一段是「乾头、坤肚腹、坎耳（另一联又说腹中）、艮手、震足、巽股、离疮痍和心目、兑面」；卜筮元龟一段（LY.ILL.DYTJ.12）是「乾头、坤腹、坎耳、离目、兑口、艮手、震足、巽股」，和这一段在巽股、艮手上一致；孙膑断疾病歌（LY.ILL.DYTJ.03）是巽肠、艮手；阐奥歌章（LY.ILL.CA.02）是巽手、艮鼻。不同的地方有三处：兑，这里是面，别处是口；坎，这一段本身就有两说，一联说耳、一联说腹中；离，这里多了疮痍和心，别处只有目。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The books differ on which part of the body each trigram governs. This passage of the chapter on illness gives 'Qian the head, Kun the belly, Kan the ear (and in another couplet the inside of the belly), Gen the hand, Zhen the foot, Xun the thigh, Li sores and heart and eyes, Dui the face'. The Bushi Yuangui passage (LY.ILL.DYTJ.12) gives 'Qian the head, Kun the belly, Kan the ear, Li the eye, Dui the mouth, Gen the hand, Zhen the foot, Xun the thigh', which agrees with this passage on Xun the thigh and Gen the hand; Sun Bin's verse (LY.ILL.DYTJ.03) has Xun the intestines and Gen the hand; the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.02) has Xun the hand and Gen the nose. There are three places of difference: Dui is the face here and the mouth elsewhere; Kan has two readings within this one passage, the ear in one couplet and the inside of the belly in another; and Li has sores and the heart added here, where elsewhere there is only the eye. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这一段里的「官」是官鬼的简称（「兑官」「乾官」「震官」），「鬼」同指鬼爻。「乾官旺相因头痛」等句的主语是某一宫里的官鬼爻。「内爻发动」「外象交重」是内卦、外卦发动。「疮痍」是疮疡创伤。坎在这一段里出现两次，一次说腹中灾，一次说耳疾，书里没有解释哪一种对。
note.en: In this passage 'official' is a short form of Pressure ('the Dui official', 'the Qian official', 'the Zhen official'), and 'ghost' likewise means the ghost line. The subject of lines such as 'the Qian official strong: from headache' is the Pressure line in that palace. 'Inner lines moving' and 'outer image moving' are the inner and outer trigrams moving. 'Sores and wounds' means ulcers and injuries. Kan appears twice in this passage, once as trouble within the belly and once as an ear disease, and the book does not say which is right.

yi: 巽宫的鬼爻兴旺，
就是大腿痛；
震宫的官鬼旺相发动，
脚上的病不能痊愈。
en: With the ghost of the Xun palace thriving,
it is pain in the thigh;
with the Pressure line of the Zhen palace strong and moving,
a disease of the foot does not heal.

yi: 离宫旺相，
内卦发动，
是疮疡创伤一类的病；
火鬼休囚，
外卦交重，
是心和眼睛的灾。
en: With the Li palace strong,
and its inner lines moving,
it is a disease of sores and wounds;
with a Fire ghost resting or confined,
and the outer lines moving,
it is trouble of the heart and eyes.

yi: 兑宫的官鬼发动，是因为面部的病；
坎宫的鬼爻交重，是腹中的灾。
en: With the Pressure line of the Dui palace moving, it is from illness of the face;
with a Kan ghost moving, it is trouble within the belly.

yi: 乾宫的官鬼旺相，是因为头痛；
坤宫的鬼爻兴旺，是肚子疼。
坎卦水爻兴旺，只因为耳病；
艮宫土爻发动，一定是手的灾。
en: With the Pressure line of the Qian palace strong, it is from headache;
with the Kun ghost thriving, it is belly pain.
with the Water line of the Kan trigram rising, it is only from an ear disease;
with the Earth line of the Gen palace moving, it is sure to be trouble of the hand.

title: 疾病论·六神与病因：财逢玄武及咸池病为贪花因恋色、妻值青龙并日建患因耽酒伤身；勾陈临土木病因争地争田、螣蛇入火土灾逢惊怪；虎动临财因丧而得、龙兴遇鬼喜处染来

rule.yi: 疾病论里按六神看病因：财逢玄武和咸池，病是因为贪恋女色；妻财值青龙、又逢日建，病因是沉迷喝酒、伤了身体；金爻的兄发动，气喘；木鬼交重，身体疼痛；勾陈临在土爻或木爻上，病因是争地争田；螣蛇入了火爻土爻，灾是遇到惊吓怪异；白虎发动、临在财上，是因为办丧事得的病；青龙兴起、遇到鬼，是在喜庆的地方染上的。
rule.en: The chapter on illness reads the cause of an illness by the six spirits: Wealth meeting the Dark Tortoise and the Xianchi star, the illness comes from craving flowers and loving lust; Wealth on the Azure Dragon and also the Day branch, the illness comes from indulging in wine and harming the body; a Metal brother line moving, panting; a Wood ghost moving, bodily pain; Hook Earth on an Earth or Wood line, the illness comes from quarrelling over land and fields; the Coiling Snake entering a Fire or Earth line, the trouble comes from fright and strange things; the White Tiger moving and on Wealth, it is got from a funeral; the Azure Dragon rising and meeting a ghost, it is caught at a happy occasion.

note.yi: 这一段按「六神看病因」列了八种：玄武带财爻、咸池是色；青龙带妻财、日建是酒；金爻的兄发动是气喘；木鬼交重是身疼；勾陈临土木是争地争田；螣蛇入火土是惊怪；虎（白虎）动临财是丧事；龙（青龙）兴遇鬼是喜庆场合。各句的条件写得很省，只能照字面译。「日建」是日辰。「咸池」是一个神煞（桃花一类）。「贪花因恋色」里「花」指女色。末两联的「虎」「龙」是白虎、青龙的简称。
note.en: This passage lists eight causes read by the six spirits: the Dark Tortoise with Wealth and the Xianchi star is lust; the Azure Dragon with Wealth and the Day branch is wine; a moving Metal brother line is panting; a Wood ghost moving is bodily pain; Hook Earth on Earth or Wood is quarrelling over land and fields; the Coiling Snake in Fire or Earth is fright and strange things; the Tiger moving on Wealth is a funeral; the Dragon rising and meeting a ghost is a happy occasion. The conditions of each line are written very sparely, and can only be translated to the letter. 'The Day branch' is the Day. The 'Xianchi star' is a spirit-star (of the peach-blossom kind). In 'craving flowers' the 'flowers' are women. In the last two couplets 'Tiger' and 'Dragon' are short forms of the White Tiger and the Azure Dragon.

yi: 要用五行来论身体的各部位，
专靠六神来分辨疾病。
财爻遇到玄武和咸池，
病是因为贪恋女色得来的。
妻财值着青龙，又逢日建，
病患是因为沉迷喝酒、伤了身体。
金爻的兄发动，气喘；
木鬼交重，身体疼痛。
勾陈如果临在土爻或木爻上，
病因是争地争田。
螣蛇如果入了火爻土爻，
灾是遇到惊吓、遇到怪异。
白虎发动、临在财爻上，
是因为办丧事得的病；
青龙兴起、遇到鬼爻，
是在喜庆的地方染上的。
en: Use the five elements to discuss the parts of the body,
and rely on the six spirits alone to tell illnesses apart.
With Wealth meeting the Dark Tortoise and the Xianchi star,
the illness comes from craving flowers and loving lust.
With Wealth on the Azure Dragon and also the Day branch,
the illness comes from indulging in wine and harming the body.
a Metal brother line moving: panting;
a Wood ghost moving: bodily pain.
If Hook Earth sits on an Earth or Wood line,
the illness is from quarrelling over land and fields.
If the Coiling Snake enters a Fire or Earth line,
the trouble comes from meeting fright and meeting strange things.
With the White Tiger moving and on the Wealth line,
it is got from a funeral;
with the Azure Dragon rising and meeting a ghost,
it is caught at a happy occasion.

title: 疾病论·死生之兆(一)：财为禄命怕空亡；十死卦春忌需蒙、夏嫌观蛊、秋忧剥节、冬畏旅临；禄命随官难救、世身入墓难医；鬼入用爻当主死

rule.yi: 疾病论里看死生的一段：财爻是禄命，怕落空亡，伏着的是命爻，要防克害；先拿十死卦当凶，最凶的是用爻不上卦、又落空亡，有救的是福位（子孙）扶持得力；春天忌需、蒙，夏天嫌观、蛊，秋天忧剥、节，冬天怕旅、临；禄命随着官鬼，难救，世爻和身入了墓，难医；官鬼遇到大杀，怕伤身；鬼爻入了用爻，就主死。
rule.en: A passage of the chapter on illness on reading life and death: Wealth is the salary and fate and fears falling Void, and if it lies hidden the life line must be guarded from control and harm; first take the ten fatal hexagrams as ill-omened, the worst being a Subject line that is absent or Void, while what can be saved is when the Output place supports it with force; in spring avoid Xu and Meng, in summer dislike Guan and Gu, in autumn fear Bo and Jie, in winter dread Lu and Lin; with the fate line following the Pressure line, rescue is hard, and with the Self and the Body entering the tomb, treatment is hard; Pressure meeting a great killing, beware harm to the Body; a ghost entering the Subject line means death.

dispute.yi: 哪几个卦占病最凶，几本书的名单不同。这一段按季节给：春需、蒙，夏观、蛊，秋剥、节，冬旅、临；阐奥歌章第三首（LY.ILL.CA.03）是丰、蛊、困、明夷、夬、同人一例，加冬旅、春需、夏观、秋剥，和这一段在旅、需、观、剥四卦的季节上一致；卜筮元龟一段（LY.ILL.DYTJ.15）是丰、观、需、剥、节、旅、贲、明夷、蛊、夬、同人「十死分明」；天玄赋（LY.ILL.TXF.06）是明夷、观、贲、需、临（世身入墓）和大畜、丰、同、蛊、夬（财鬼俱兴）。蒙只有这一段有，临只有这一段和天玄赋有；另外这一段点名的只有八个卦，却称「十死卦」，名目和数目对不上。书里没有裁决。周易尚占和文王金钱课按卦名断病，和这一段点名的几个卦有出入：蒙，周易尚占说「却宜占病」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.06）；观，周易尚占说「财聚病痊」，文王金钱课说「占病即愈」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.02、WWJQ.03）；节，文王金钱课说「疾病口舌消除安」（LY.ILL.WWJQ.03）；临，周易尚占说「病犯崇侵」，文王金钱课补录部分说「疾病即痊」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.07、WWJQ.05）；蛊，周易尚占说病凶，和这一段一致（LY.ILL.ZSZ.05）。
dispute.en: The books differ on which hexagrams are the worst for illness. This passage gives them by season: Xu and Meng in spring, Guan and Gu in summer, Bo and Jie in autumn, Lu and Lin in winter. The Chan'ao Gezhang's third poem (LY.ILL.CA.03) gives Feng, Gu, Kun, Mingyi, Guai and Tongren together, plus Lu in winter, Xu in spring, Guan in summer and Bo in autumn, agreeing with this passage on the seasons of Lu, Xu, Guan and Bo; the Bushi Yuangui passage (LY.ILL.DYTJ.15) gives Feng, Guan, Xu, Bo, Jie, Lu, Bi, Mingyi, Gu, Guai and Tongren, 'the ten deaths are clear'; the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.06) gives Mingyi, Guan, Bi, Xu and Lin (the Self and Body entering the tomb) and Daxu, Feng, Tong, Gu and Guai (Wealth and Pressure both rising). Meng is found only in this passage, and Lin only in this passage and the Tianxuan Fu; moreover this passage names only eight hexagrams yet calls them 'the ten fatal hexagrams', so the name and the number do not match. The books do not decide. The Zhouyi Shangzhan and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke judge illness by the name of the hexagram, and differ from several hexagrams named in this passage: for Meng (Youthful Folly) the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'on the contrary fit for divining illness' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.06); for Guan the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'wealth gathers and the illness is cured' and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says 'divining illness, it is cured at once' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.02, WWJQ.03); for Jie the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says 'illness and quarrels are removed and all is at peace' (LY.ILL.WWJQ.03); for Lin the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the illness offends a curse that attacks' and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke, in its supplementary part, says 'the illness is cured at once' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.07, WWJQ.05); for Gu the Zhouyi Shangzhan says the illness is ominous, which agrees with this passage (LY.ILL.ZSZ.05).

note.yi: 这一段连着讲了三个层次：先是用神的安危（财为禄命、用爻不见与空亡、福位扶持），然后是十死卦按季节的忌，最后是墓和大杀（世身入墓、官逢大杀、鬼入用爻）。「禄命随官」是禄命爻随着官鬼（入墓）的意思，断易天机里有「随官入墓」一节可对照（LY.ILL.DYTJ.27）。「用爻」就是用神。
note.en: This passage runs through three layers: first the safety of the Subject (Wealth as salary and fate, the Subject line absent or Void, the Output place supporting it), then the seasonal taboos of the ten fatal hexagrams, and last the tomb and the great killing (the Self and Body entering the tomb, Pressure meeting a great killing, a ghost entering the Subject line). 'The salary-fate following the Pressure line' means the salary-fate line following the Pressure line (into the tomb), and the section on 'following Pressure into the tomb' in the Duanyi Tianji can be compared (LY.ILL.DYTJ.27). The 'Subject line' is the Subject.

yi: 财爻是禄命，怕落空亡；
伏藏的是命爻，要防克害。
先把十死卦当作凶，
不要拿它们和一般爻的吉去比。
最凶险的情形是，
用爻不上卦，和落空亡；
有救的情形是，
福位扶持、生助得力。
春天忌需、蒙，
夏天嫌观、蛊，
秋天忧剥、节，
冬天怕旅、临。
禄命跟着官鬼，难救；
世爻和身入了墓，难医。
官鬼遇到大杀，怕伤到身；
鬼爻入了用爻，就主死。
en: Wealth is the salary and fate, and fears falling Void;
if it lies hidden, the life line must be guarded from control and harm.
First take the ten fatal hexagrams as ill-omened,
and do not weigh them against the usual auspicious lines.
The worst is
when the Subject line is absent, or Void;
what can be saved is
when the Output place supports and strengthens it.
In spring avoid Xu and Meng,
in summer dislike Guan and Gu,
in autumn fear Bo and Jie,
in winter dread Lu and Lin.
With the fate line following the Pressure line, rescue is hard;
with the Self and the Body entering the tomb, treatment is hard.
Pressure meeting a great killing, beware of harm to the Body;
a ghost entering the Subject line means death.

title: 疾病论·死生之兆(二)：催尸之杀怕临病者之爻、春辰夏未秋戌冬丑兴还死；天转杀地转杀遇日辰旺相便言死处；春忌卯夏嫌午秋酉冬子；不论少年老年一命见阎君

rule.yi: 疾病论里接着讲死的征兆：要忌催尸杀，怕它落在病人的爻上；春天的辰、夏天的未最难当，秋天的戌、冬天的丑发动还是死；又嫌天转杀、地转杀，是最凶的神，再遇到日辰旺相，就可以说出死的地方；春天忌卯爻卯日，夏天嫌午位午爻，秋天的金爻、酉日最忌，冬天的子爻遇上子日；不论是白面少年，还是雪白鬓发的老人，家产再多，也总要拿一条命去见阎王。
rule.en: The chapter on illness goes on with the signs of death: one must avoid the Urging-the-Corpse killing and fear it falling on the sick person's line; Chen in spring and Wei in summer are the hardest to bear, and Xu in autumn and Chou in winter, rising, still mean death; also dislike the Heaven-Turning and Earth-Turning killings, the most ill-omened spirits, and if they meet a strong Day one may name the place of death; in spring avoid a Mao line and a Mao day, in summer a Wu place and Wu line, in autumn the Metal line and the You day, in winter a Zi line meeting a Zi day; whether a fair-faced youth or an old person with snow-white temples, however much wealth a family has, one must still go with one's life to see Lord Yama.

note.yi: 「催尸杀」「天转杀」「地转杀」是神煞名：催尸杀按春辰夏未秋戌冬丑取（和下面的句子对得上），天转杀、地转杀的位置这里没有给。「便言死处」的「死处」按字面是死的地方，也可能是死的时间，书里没有说。「秋金酉日」是秋天的金爻和酉日，两者都算。卜筮全书神煞歌例里另有「丧车杀」（LY.ILL.BSQS.53）和「沐浴杀」，位置也是春辰夏未秋戌冬丑一类的取法，可对照。
note.en: The 'Urging-the-Corpse', 'Heaven-Turning' and 'Earth-Turning' killings are spirit-stars: the Urging-the-Corpse killing is taken as Chen in spring, Wei in summer, Xu in autumn and Chou in winter (which matches the lines that follow), and the positions of the Heaven-Turning and Earth-Turning killings are not given here. 'The place of death' is literally where death happens, and may mean when; the book does not say. 'Autumn Metal You day' means the Metal line in autumn and the You day, and both count. The spirit-star verses of the Bushi Quanshu also have a 'Funeral Carriage killing' (LY.ILL.BSQS.53) and a 'Bathing killing', placed in the same way (Chen in spring, Wei in summer, Xu in autumn, Chou in winter), and can be compared.

yi: 要忌讳催尸杀，
怕它落在病人的爻上。
春天的辰、夏天的未最难当，
秋天的戌、冬天的丑，发动还是死。
又嫌天转杀、地转杀，
它们是最凶的神；
如果遇到日辰旺相，
就可以说出死的地方。
春天忌卯爻、卯日，
夏天嫌午位、午爻，
秋天的金爻、酉日最忌凶，
冬天子爻遇上子日。
不论是白面的少年人，
还是可惜的雪白鬓发的老人；
纵然家产超过百斗，
也总得拿一条命去见阎王。
en: One must avoid the Urging-the-Corpse killing,
and fear it falling on the sick person's line.
Chen in spring and Wei in summer are the hardest to bear,
and Xu in autumn and Chou in winter, rising, still mean death.
Also dislike the Heaven-Turning and Earth-Turning killings,
the most ill-omened spirits;
if they meet a strong Day,
one may then name the place of death.
In spring avoid a Mao line and a Mao day,
in summer dislike a Wu place and Wu line,
in autumn the Metal line and the You day are the most to be feared,
in winter a Zi line meeting a Zi day.
Never mind a fair-faced youth,
nor, sadly, an old person with snow-white temples;
even if the family's wealth exceeds a hundred measures of grain,
one must still go with one's life to see Lord Yama.

title: 疾病论·神鬼之由(一)：乾宫愿欠天庭、坤鬼动地府、艮鬼路神作祸、震宫克世狱司降灾；鬼临五位路头神、官在三爻家内崇；坎鬼溺水之魂、巽鬼悬梁之崇；坎宫船车之鬼、艮象路狱之魂

rule.yi: 疾病论里按八卦推是哪一路神鬼作祟：乾宫发动，是欠了天庭的愿；坤宫鬼爻兴旺，是冒犯了地府；艮宫鬼爻伤身，是路神作祸；震宫克世，是狱司降灾；鬼临在第五爻，是路头神；官鬼在第三爻，是家里作祟；坎宫鬼动，要求溺水之魂；巽宫鬼兴，要祭上吊之祟；坎宫交重是船车之鬼，艮象土爻发动是路上、狱中之魂。
rule.en: The chapter on illness works out from the trigrams which kind of spirit or ghost is at work: Qian moving, a vow owed to the Heavenly Court; Kun ghost thriving, it disturbs the Earth Prefecture; Gen ghost harming the person, a road spirit causing harm; Zhen controlling the Self line, a spirit of the prison sends down calamity; the ghost on the fifth place, the Road-Head spirit; Pressure on the third line, a haunting within the house; a Kan ghost moving, seek the soul of one drowned; a Xun ghost rising, sacrifice to the haunting of one who hanged himself from a beam; Kan moving is a ghost of boats and carts, a Gen Earth line moving is a soul of the road or the prison.

dispute.yi: 鬼爻落在哪一爻是什么神，几处说法不同。这一段是「五位路头神、三爻家内崇」；卜筮全书的六位取象表（LY.ILL.BSQS.02）是初爻井神、二爻司命、三爻家先、四爻土地、五爻社司、六爻天神，三爻家先和这里的「家内崇」相通，五爻则是社司，不是路头神。另两种排法见 LY.ILL.HZL.11 和 LY.ILL.EL.37。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The books differ on what spirit a ghost on each line stands for. This passage has 'the fifth place the Road-Head spirit, the third line a haunting within the house'; the table of the positions of the lines in the Bushi Quanshu (LY.ILL.BSQS.02) has the first line the well spirit, the second the Life-Governing Spirit, the third the family ancestors, the fourth the Earth God, the fifth the village altar spirit and the sixth the heavenly spirit; the third line, family ancestors, is akin to 'a haunting within the house' here, but the fifth line is the village altar spirit there and not the Road-Head spirit. Two other arrangements are in LY.ILL.HZL.11 and LY.ILL.EL.37. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这一段按「哪一宫（八卦）的鬼爻发动」来断是哪一类神鬼作祟：乾是天庭（欠了天上神的愿），坤是地府，艮是路神，震是狱司，坎是溺水的魂（也是船车的鬼），巽是上吊的鬼；按爻位断的只有「鬼临五位」「官在三爻」两处。「求七杀」的七杀是一颗凶星，「三司」是几个官署，书里没有解释，译文照字面；「动干地府」的「干」按冒犯、触犯读。这一段按八卦取神，和按爻位取神的表（LY.ILL.BSQS.02）是两条思路。
note.en: This passage judges which kind of spirit or ghost is at work from the palace (trigram) whose ghost line moves: Qian is the Heavenly Court (a vow owed to the gods above), Kun the Earth Prefecture, Gen a road spirit, Zhen a spirit of the prison, Kan the soul of one drowned (and a ghost of boats and carts), Xun the ghost of one who hanged himself; only 'the ghost on the fifth place' and 'Pressure on the third line' go by line position. 'Seek the Seven Killings' names a malign star, and the 'Three Offices' are several government offices; the book does not explain them and the translation keeps to the letter; the 'disturbs' in 'disturbs the Earth Prefecture' is read as offending or intruding on. This passage takes the spirit from the trigram, which is a different line of thought from the table that takes it from the line position (LY.ILL.BSQS.02).

yi: 要推求是哪路神鬼作祟，
就要知道天道、地道。
乾宫发动，
是欠了天庭的愿；
坤宫的鬼爻兴旺，
是冒犯了地府；
艮宫的鬼爻伤身，
是路神在作祸；
震宫克世，
是狱司降下灾祸。
鬼临在第五爻，是路头神；
官鬼在第三爻，是家里作祟。
en: To work out which spirit or ghost is at work,
one must know the way of heaven and the way of earth.
With the Qian palace moving,
it is a vow owed to the Heavenly Court;
with the Kun ghost thriving,
it disturbs the Earth Prefecture;
with the Gen ghost harming the person,
a road spirit is causing the harm;
with the Zhen palace controlling the Self line,
a spirit of the prison sends down calamity.
With the ghost on the fifth place, it is the Road-Head spirit;
with Pressure on the third line, it is a haunting within the house.

yi: 坎宫的鬼发动，
要求溺水而死的魂；
巽宫的鬼兴旺，
应当祭上吊而死者的作祟。
月破落在官鬼上，要求七杀；
日辰带着鬼爻，要告三司。
en: With the Kan ghost moving,
one must seek the soul of one who drowned;
with the Xun ghost rising,
the haunting of one who hanged himself from a beam is to be sacrificed to.
With the Month-break falling on Pressure, seek the Seven Killings;
with the Day carrying the ghost, petition the Three Offices.

zh: 坎宫本为交重，船车之鬼；
艮象土爻发动，路狱之魂。
yi: 坎宫本来交重，是船和车上的鬼；
艮象土爻发动，是路上、狱中的魂。
en: Kan moving as it stands is a ghost of boats and carts;
a Gen Earth line moving is a soul of the road or the prison.

title: 疾病论·神鬼之由(二)：日值贵官可告城隍、岁临官贵宜求五道家堂；兑象官兴急还口愿、火爻鬼动速祀灶君；离鬼休囚持世祈斗、乾鬼旺相克身告天神还素愿；衰官外动别宫来是外崇、休鬼内兴本宫动可辨家亲

rule.yi: 疾病论里接着按日、岁、五行和宫来断神鬼：日辰值着贵官，可以向当地的城隍祷告；太岁临官贵，宜求五道和家堂；兑象官鬼兴旺，赶紧还口愿；火爻鬼动，赶快祭灶君；离鬼休囚持世，要祈禳北斗；乾鬼旺相克身，宜向天神还素愿；衰官在外卦、从别宫来，是外来作祟；休鬼在内卦、本宫动，可以辨出是家亲。
rule.en: The chapter on illness goes on judging spirits by the Day, the Year, the elements and the palace: with the Day on the noble officer, one may petition the City God of the district; with the Year on the noble officer, it is fitting to beseech the Five Roads and the household shrine; with Pressure in the Dui image rising, hurry to repay a spoken vow; with a Fire ghost moving, quickly sacrifice to the Hearth Lord; a Li ghost resting or confined and holding the Self line, pray to the Dipper; a Qian ghost strong and controlling the Body, petition the heavenly spirits and repay a vegetarian vow; a weak Pressure line moving outside and coming from another palace is an outside haunting; a resting ghost rising inside and moving from the home palace can be identified as the family's own kin.

note.yi: 这一段里「日值贵官」「岁临官贵」的贵官、官贵是有贵人星的官鬼一类（书里没有展开）。「城隍」是城隍神，「五道」是五道神，「家堂」是家里供的神堂，「灶君」是灶神，「素愿」是许下的吃素、斋戒一类的愿，「口愿」是口头许的愿。「花穷」两字书里没有解释，译文只音译。「家亲」是家里已故的亲人的鬼魂。「衰官外动别宫来」「休鬼内兴本宫动」是用鬼爻的旺衰、内外、本宫来分外来的祟和家里的祟。
note.en: In this passage the 'noble officer' and 'officer noble' of 'the Day on the noble officer' and 'the Year on the officer noble' are a Pressure line carrying a noble star (the book does not go further). The 'City God' is the god of the city, the 'Five Roads' are the Five Road gods, the 'household shrine' is the shrine of spirits kept at home, the 'Hearth Lord' is the kitchen god, a 'vegetarian vow' is a vow of vegetarian fasting, and a 'spoken vow' is one made aloud. The two characters rendered 'Huaqiong' are not explained in the book and are only transliterated. 'The family's own kin' are the ghosts of deceased relatives of the household. 'A weak Pressure line moving outside from another palace' and 'a resting ghost rising inside and moving from the home palace' use the strength or weakness of the ghost line, inside or outside, and the home palace to tell a haunting from outside from a haunting of the household.

yi: 日辰值着贵官，
可以向当地的城隍祷告；
太岁临着官贵，
宜求五道和家堂。
兑象的官鬼兴旺，
赶紧还口头许的愿；
火爻的鬼发动，
赶快祭祀灶君。
en: With the Day on the noble officer,
one may petition the City God of the district;
with the Year on the noble officer,
it is fitting to beseech the Five Roads and the household shrine.
With Pressure in the Dui image rising,
hurry to repay a vow spoken aloud;
with a Fire ghost moving,
quickly sacrifice to the Hearth Lord.

yi: 离宫的鬼休囚、持世，
遇到这种情形，要祈禳北斗，还要向「花穷」祷告；
乾宫的鬼旺相、克身，
宜向天神祷告，还清素愿。
衰弱的官鬼在外卦发动、从别的宫来，
就说是外来的作祟；
休囚的鬼在内卦兴起、是本宫动的，
可以辨认是家亲。
en: With a Li ghost resting or confined and holding the Self line,
in such a case one must pray to the Dipper and offer prayers to Huaqiong;
with a Qian ghost strong and controlling the Body,
it is fitting to petition the heavenly spirits and repay a vegetarian vow.
A weak Pressure line moving outside and coming from another palace
is called an outside haunting;
a resting ghost rising inside and moving from the home palace
can be identified as the family's own kin.

title: 疾病论·神鬼之由(三)：应鬼克身逢外鬼、官爻生世是连亲；日辰冲发为无主、土位塞兴定有坟；土动死囚牢狱、火兴临没产亡；旺日看四时、休囚寻八节

rule.yi: 疾病论里最后几联讲神鬼：应爻的鬼克身，遇到的是外来的鬼；官爻生世爻，是连着亲戚的；被日辰冲动而发出来的，是无主的鬼；土位被堵塞又兴起，一定有坟；土爻动，是死在牢狱里的囚犯；火爻兴旺，是产亡的鬼；只要知道旺的日子，就看四季；细察休囚的日子，就找八节。
rule.en: The last couplets of the chapter on illness on spirits and ghosts: a ghost on the Other line controlling the Body is an outside ghost; a Pressure line generating the Self line is of kin connections; one stirred out by the Day's clash is a ghost without an owner; with the Earth place stopped up and rising, there is surely a grave; an Earth line moving is one who died as a prisoner in jail; a Fire line rising is one who died in childbirth; know the strong days and look to the four seasons, examine the resting and confined closely and seek the eight festivals.

note.yi: 「应鬼克身逢外鬼」的「应鬼」是应爻上的鬼，「外鬼」是外来的鬼。「官爻生世是连亲」的「连亲」是连着亲戚的鬼。「日辰冲发为无主」是说被日辰冲动、自己本来不动的鬼，是没有主人的鬼（游魂）。「土位塞兴」「火兴临没产亡」两处文意不全，「塞」按字面是堵塞，「临没」按字面是快要死，译文照字面，没有补。最后两句「旺日看四时，休囚寻八节」是说找神鬼作祟的时间：旺的日子看四季，休囚的日子找八节（立春、春分等八个节气）。
note.en: 'A ghost on the Other line controlling the Body: an outside ghost' is a ghost on the Other line, and the 'outside ghost' one from elsewhere. 'Pressure generating the Self line is kin connections' is a ghost connected to relatives. 'Stirred out by the Day's clash: without an owner' is a ghost that was not itself moving and is set moving by the Day's clash, a ghost with no master (a wandering soul). In 'the Earth place stopped up and rising' and 'Fire rising and on the point of death: a death in childbirth' the sense is incomplete; 'stopped up' is literally blocked and 'on the point of death' literally about to die, and the translation keeps to the letter without filling in. The last two lines, 'know the strong days and look to the four seasons, examine the resting and confined and seek the eight festivals', are about finding the time of the haunting: strong days by the four seasons, resting days by the eight festivals (the start of spring, the spring equinox and so on).

yi: 应爻上的鬼克身，遇到的是外来的鬼；
官鬼爻生世爻，是连着亲戚的。
被日辰冲动而发出来的，是无主的鬼；
土位堵塞又兴起，一定有坟。
土爻动，是死在牢狱里的囚犯；
火爻兴旺，是产妇死亡的鬼。
en: A ghost on the Other line controlling the Body: it is an outside ghost;
a Pressure line generating the Self line is of kin connections.
One stirred out by the Day's clash is a ghost without an owner;
with the Earth place stopped up and rising, there is surely a grave.
an Earth line moving: one who died as a prisoner in jail;
a Fire line rising: one who died in childbirth.

yi: 只要知道旺的日子，就看四季；
细细察看休囚，就找八节。
en: Only know the strong days and look to the four seasons;
examine the resting and confined closely and seek the eight festivals.

title: 疾病论·鬼的形貌：乾金之鬼白发老翁、坎鬼休囚耳聋鬼崇、艮鬼手瘫、震官脚疾、巽爻官发折腿腰跎、离象鬼兴眼昏目暗、坤土之鬼花苍母、兑金死鬼缺唇魂

rule.yi: 疾病论里按八卦说鬼的模样和它带来的病：乾金之鬼是白发老头；坎鬼休囚，是耳聋的鬼作祟；艮宫的鬼，手瘫；震宫的官鬼，脚有病；巽宫的官鬼发动，折腿、腰驼；离象的鬼兴旺，眼睛昏暗；坤土之鬼是花白头发的老母；兑金的死鬼是缺嘴唇的魂。
rule.en: The chapter on illness gives, by trigram, the look of the ghost and the illness it brings: the ghost of Qian Metal is a white-haired old man; a Kan ghost resting or confined is a deaf ghost haunting; a Gen ghost, a paralysed hand; the Pressure line of Zhen, disease of the foot; the Pressure line of Xun moving, a broken leg and a bent waist; a ghost rising in the Li image, dim and dark eyes; the ghost of Kun Earth is an old mother with mottled grey hair; the dead ghost of Dui Metal is the soul of one with a split lip.

note.yi: 这一段讲的是鬼的模样，同时也是它带来的病或伤：白发老翁、花苍母、缺唇魂是鬼的样子，手瘫、脚疾、折腿、眼昏目暗既可以读作鬼的模样，也可以读作病人的病，书里没有分开。「腰跎」的「跎」字读作驼背、腰弯，按字面译成「腰驼了」。这一段里艮手、震足、离目、坎耳和本篇前面的八卦配病位（LY.ILL.BSQS.33）一致，巽这里是腿和腰，和前面的「股」相近，见 LY.ILL.BSQS.33 的「打架」。
note.en: This passage gives the look of the ghost and, at the same time, the illness or injury it brings: the white-haired old man, the mottled grey mother and the soul with a split lip are how the ghost looks, while the paralysed hand, the foot disease, the broken leg and the dim and dark eyes can be read either as the look of the ghost or as the illness of the sick person, and the book does not separate them. The character rendered 'bent' in 'a bent waist' means stooped or bowed, and it is translated to the letter. In this passage Gen the hand, Zhen the foot, Li the eye and Kan the ear agree with the matching of the trigrams to places of illness earlier in the chapter (LY.ILL.BSQS.33); for Xun it gives the leg and the waist, which is close to the thigh there; see the dispute in LY.ILL.BSQS.33.

yi: 乾宫金爻的鬼，
是白发老头；
坎宫的鬼休囚，
是耳聋的鬼在作祟；
艮宫的鬼，手瘫；
震宫的官鬼，脚有病；
巽宫的官鬼发动，
折了腿，腰驼了；
离象的鬼兴旺，
眼睛昏暗看不清；
坤宫土爻的鬼，是花白头发的老母；
兑宫金爻的死鬼，是缺嘴唇的魂。
en: The ghost of Qian Metal
is a white-haired old man;
a Kan ghost resting or confined
is a deaf ghost haunting;
a Gen ghost: a paralysed hand;
the Pressure line of Zhen: disease of the foot;
with the Pressure line of Xun moving,
a broken leg and a bent waist;
with a ghost rising in the Li image,
the eyes are dim and dark;
the ghost of Kun Earth is an old mother with mottled grey hair;
the dead ghost of Dui Metal is the soul of one with a split lip.

title: 疾病论·家亲与愿：看祖宗叔伯推父母爻、姨母妻奴推财爻；白虎丧门亲座席、青龙天乙贵家亲；龙雀素愿、虎勾晕盟；雀虎入乾离只言拜愿烧香、勾陈临震巽便说愿心枷锁；鬼静生身吉、官兴克世告神凶

rule.yi: 疾病论里讲是哪一位亲人、哪一种愿：要看祖宗、叔伯，用父母爻推；要看姨母、妻子、奴仆，用财爻断；阳爻是男子，阴爻是女人；白虎、丧门，是亲人在座；青龙、天乙贵人，是尊贵的家亲；青龙、朱雀叫素愿，白虎、勾陈是晕盟；朱雀、白虎进乾、离动，只说拜愿烧香；勾陈临震、巽交重，就说愿心枷锁；鬼静、生身还是吉，官鬼兴动、克世，告神也凶。
rule.en: The chapter on illness on which kin and which vow: to see the ancestors and uncles, work it out from the Resource line; to see the aunt, wife or servants, judge by the Wealth line; a yang line is a man, a yin line a woman; the White Tiger and Mourning Gate are kin in their seats; the Azure Dragon and Heavenly Noble are honoured family kin; the Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird are called vegetarian vows, the White Tiger and Hook Earth are sure to be yun-meng oaths; the Vermilion Bird and White Tiger in Qian or Li and moving speak only of making vows and burning incense; Hook Earth on Zhen or Xun and moving speaks of the cangue and lock of a vow; a ghost still and generating the Body is still auspicious, Pressure rising and controlling the Self line is ominous even when one petitions the spirits.

note.yi: 「晕盟」照原文，字面是「晕」（头晕）的盟，从上下句看它和「素愿」相对，可能是「荤盟」（带荤腥的盟誓）的误字，书里没有说，译文只音译为「yun-meng 盟誓」。「天乙」是天乙贵人。「愿心枷锁」是许了愿没有还，被愿心锁住。「亲座席」按字面是亲人坐在席上，书里没有解释。「阳爻男子，阴爻女流」是说被推的亲人是男是女，按爻的阴阳分。
note.en: 'Yun-meng' is kept as written; literally it is an oath of 'dizziness', and from the lines before and after, where it stands opposite 'vegetarian vow', it may be a miswriting of 'meat oath' (an oath sworn with meat); the book does not say, and the translation only transliterates it as 'yun-meng oaths'. 'Heavenly Noble' is the Heavenly Noble star. 'The cangue and lock of a vow' is a vow made and not repaid, leaving one locked in by it. 'Kin in their seats' is literally relatives seated at the mat, and the book does not explain it. 'A yang line a man, a yin line a woman' says whether the kinsman being worked out is male or female, by the yin or yang of the line.

yi: 要看祖宗、叔伯，
要用父母爻来推详。
如果要求的是姨母、妻子、奴仆，
就用财爻来决断。
阳爻是男子，
阴爻是女人。
白虎、丧门，是亲人在座；
青龙、天乙贵人，是尊贵的家亲。
青龙、朱雀叫作素愿，
白虎、勾陈一定是晕盟。
朱雀、白虎进乾、离发动，
只说是拜愿、烧香；
勾陈临在震、巽而交重，
就说是愿心枷锁。
鬼爻安静、生身，还是吉；
官鬼兴动、克世，告神也凶。
en: To see the ancestors and uncles,
one must work it out from the Resource line.
To seek an aunt, wife or servants,
judge by the Wealth line.
A yang line is a man;
a yin line is a woman.
The White Tiger and Mourning Gate are kin in their seats;
the Azure Dragon and Heavenly Noble are honoured family kin.
The Azure Dragon and Vermilion Bird are called vegetarian vows,
the White Tiger and Hook Earth are sure to be yun-meng oaths.
With the Vermilion Bird and White Tiger in Qian or Li and moving,
it speaks only of making vows and burning incense;
with Hook Earth on Zhen or Xun and moving,
it speaks of the cangue and lock of a vow.
With the ghost still and generating the Body, it is still auspicious;
with Pressure rising and controlling the Self line, even petitioning the spirits is ominous.

title: 疾病论·医药：亦求子位同推、反作药爻以治；子旺福神得力、子衰扁鹊难医

rule.yi: 疾病论最后说医药：也要去求子孙的位置一起推，反过来把它当作药爻来治；子孙旺，福神就得力；子孙衰，连扁鹊也难医；还要深入详察整个卦象怎么样，察看吉凶休咎。
rule.en: The chapter on illness ends on medicine: also seek the Output place and work it out together, and in turn take it as the medicine line for treatment; if Output is strong the spirit of fortune is effective, if Output is weak even Bian Que finds it hard to cure; and examine deeply how the whole image stands, observing good and ill fortune.

note.yi: 子孙爻在占病里有两重身份：克官鬼（病），所以是「福神」；又是药，所以是「药爻」。这一段和断易天机的孙真人论医歌、洞林秘诀里「卦中子孙爻为药」是同一个说法（LY.ILL.DYTJ.45、LY.ILL.DYTJ.47）。扁鹊是战国时的名医。
note.en: In divining illness the Output line has two roles: it controls Pressure (the illness), which is why it is the 'spirit of fortune'; and it is the medicine, which is why it is the 'medicine line'. This passage says the same as Master Sun's song on doctors and the Dongling Mijue in the Duanyi Tianji, 'the Output line in the hexagram is the medicine' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.45, LY.ILL.DYTJ.47). Bian Que was a famous physician of the Warring States.

yi: 也要去求子孙的位置一起推，
反过来把它当作药爻来治病。
子孙旺，福神就得力；
子孙衰，连扁鹊也难医。
要深入详察整个卦象怎么样，
察看吉凶休咎。
en: Also seek the Output place and work it out together,
and in turn take it as the medicine line for treatment.
If Output is strong, the spirit of fortune is effective;
if Output is weak, even Bian Que finds it hard to cure.
Examine deeply how the whole image stands,
and observe good and ill fortune.

chapter: 阐幽精要·十二、五行论病歌
title: 五行论病歌：金鬼牙与头、更兼白虎血脓流；木鬼风疾头眩眼暗；水兴寒热多因疟、痢疾伤风；火鬼虚劳弱症眼疼；土鬼脾胃虚黄肿、间动膈病

rule.yi: 五行论病歌：金鬼兴隆，病在牙和头，再加白虎，血和脓流；木鬼发动是风病，头晕眼花；水兴是发冷发热，多半是疟疾，痢疾、伤风不容易治；火鬼是虚劳加上虚弱，眼睛疼痛也有来由；土鬼是脾胃虚、黄肿，间爻动要担心膈的病。
rule.en: The verse on illness by the five elements: a Metal ghost thriving, the teeth and the head, with the White Tiger as well, blood and pus flow; a Wood ghost moving, a wind illness, with dizziness and dim eyes; Water rising, chills and fever mostly from malaria, and dysentery and wind-damage are not easily treated; a Fire ghost, consumption and weakness, and eye pain has its cause too; an Earth ghost, weak spleen and stomach and yellow swelling, and if the between lines move, worry about a diaphragm illness.

dispute.yi: 五行的鬼各主什么病，几家说法不同。这一首是「金鬼牙与头（加白虎血脓）、木鬼风疾头眩眼暗、水寒热疟痢、火鬼虚劳眼痛、土鬼脾胃虚黄肿」；阐奥歌章（LY.ILL.CA.02）是水腰肾、金肺、火心经、木肝、土脾胃；卜筮元龟一段（LY.ILL.DYTJ.12）是木鬼身体疼痛、水土鬼痈肿、金鬼牙骨痛；同一本书的疾病论（LY.ILL.BSQS.32）是金木动骨骼疼酸、水火兴皮肤寒热、丑未伤脾。土配脾胃、金配牙，几家相近；火配心（阐奥歌章）、配虚劳眼痛（这一首）、配皮肤寒热（疾病论），木配肝（阐奥歌章）、配风疾头眩（这一首）、配身体疼痛（卜筮元龟），各不相同。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The books differ on what illness each element's ghost governs. This verse has 'Metal ghost teeth and head (with the White Tiger, blood and pus), Wood ghost wind illness, dizziness and dim eyes, Water chills and fever with malaria and dysentery, Fire ghost consumption and eye pain, Earth ghost weak spleen and stomach with yellow swelling'; the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.02) has Water the waist and kidneys, Metal the lungs, Fire the heart channel, Wood the liver, Earth the spleen and stomach; the Bushi Yuangui passage (LY.ILL.DYTJ.12) has a Wood ghost bodily pain, a Water or Earth ghost swollen abscesses, a Metal ghost pain in the teeth and bones; and the chapter on illness in the same book (LY.ILL.BSQS.32) has Metal or Wood moving, aching bones and joints, Water or Fire rising, chills and fever of the skin, Chou or Wei moving, harm to the spleen. Earth matched to the spleen and stomach and Metal to the teeth are close in several; Fire is matched to the heart (Chan'ao Gezhang), to consumption and eye pain (this verse) and to chills and fever of the skin (the chapter on illness), and Wood to the liver (Chan'ao Gezhang), to wind illness and dizziness (this verse) and to bodily pain (Bushi Yuangui), all different. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这是阐幽精要里一首十句的歌，每一句配一种五行的鬼爻和它主的病。「风疾」是风病，头晕、抽搐、中风一类；「虚劳」是体虚而劳损，近于痨病；「膈病」是胸膈的病，噎膈一类；「间动」是间爻（世应之间的爻）发动。书里的病名按字面译，括号里不加现代病名。
note.en: This is a ten-line verse in the Chanyou Jingyao, each line matching one element's ghost line to the illness it governs. 'Wind illness' is an illness of wind, dizziness, convulsions, strokes and the like; 'consumption' is deficiency and wasting, close to a consumptive illness; 'diaphragm illness' is illness of the chest and diaphragm, of the choking-obstruction kind; 'the between lines move' is the lines between the Self and Other lines moving. The names of illnesses are translated to the letter, without modern disease names added in brackets.

yi: 金鬼兴旺，病在牙和头，
再加白虎，血和脓流出来。
木鬼发动的时候，是风病一类，
头晕眼花，不知什么时候才好。
水鬼兴起，发冷发热，多半是疟疾；
痢疾、伤风不容易治。
火鬼，是虚劳加上虚弱的病，
眼睛疼痛也有它的来由。
土鬼，脾胃虚、黄肿；
间爻动，要担心膈的病。
en: A Metal ghost thriving: the teeth and the head;
with the White Tiger as well, blood and pus flow.
A Wood ghost moving: a wind illness;
dizziness and dim eyes, when will it end?
Water rising: chills and fever, mostly from malaria;
dysentery and wind-damage are not easily treated.
A Fire ghost: consumption and weakness;
eye pain has its cause too.
An Earth ghost: weak spleen and stomach, yellow swelling;
if the between lines move, worry about a diaphragm illness.

chapter: 阐幽精要·十三、六神论神鬼心决
title: 六神论神鬼心决：青龙观音三官、朱雀家堂灶君鬼为吐血劳怯、勾陈土地城隍鬼为痢疾蛊胀、螣蛇缢死汤火、白虎横死肚饱魂、玄武真武帝鬼作落水伤亡

rule.yi: 六神论神鬼心决是六首歌，每首一位神：青龙是善愿、观音、三官；朱雀是家堂、灶君，鬼为吐血和劳怯，目疾、伤亡也有缘故；勾陈是土地、城隍，鬼为痢疾和蛊胀，遇土爻是咽塞而死；螣蛇逢官缢死，孩童汤火受伤；白虎临太岁是大将军，横死伤亡；玄武是真武帝，鬼爻作祟断为落水伤亡。
rule.en: The verses on the six spirits and the heart-secret of spirits and ghosts are six songs, one for each spirit: the Azure Dragon is good vows, Guanyin and the Three Officials; the Vermilion Bird is the household shrine and the Hearth Lord, its ghost means spitting blood and consumptive weakness, and eye disease, injury and death have their cause in it; Hook Earth is the Earth God and the City God, its ghost means dysentery and swelling of the belly, and meeting an Earth line one dies of a blocked throat; the Coiling Snake meeting Pressure means death by hanging, and children are hurt by scalding and fire; the White Tiger on Tai Sui is the great general, with violent death and injury; the Dark Tortoise is the Emperor Zhenwu, and its ghost doing harm is judged a death by drowning.

note.yi: 这是六首歌，每首四句：前两句说这位神对应哪些神（青龙配观音、三官；朱雀配家堂、灶君；勾陈配土地、城隍；螣蛇配飞来土；白虎配太岁、大将军、五路神；玄武配真武帝），后两句说鬼爻加在这位神上时的病或死法。各句省得很，好几处字面读不出完整的意思（「断鬼产亡并带血」「遇鬼七杀金作三」「肚饱魂」「活法全凭智略推」），译文照字面，没有补。「蛊胀」是腹胀如鼓一类的病，「劳怯」是虚劳怯弱，「咽塞」是咽喉堵塞。原文「鰧蛇」是「螣蛇」的异写。
note.en: These are six songs of four lines each: the first two lines say which gods the spirit matches (the Azure Dragon Guanyin and the Three Officials; the Vermilion Bird the household shrine and the Hearth Lord; Hook Earth the Earth God and the City God; the Coiling Snake earth that has flown in; the White Tiger Tai Sui, the great general and the Five Road gods; the Dark Tortoise the Emperor Zhenwu), and the last two lines say what illness or manner of death a ghost line on this spirit gives. The lines are very terse and in several places the letter does not give a complete sense ('to judge the ghost: dead in childbirth, with blood', 'meeting a ghost, the Seven Killings and Metal, making three', 'the soul with a swollen belly', 'the living method rests wholly on wit'); the translation keeps to the letter without filling in. 'Swelling of the belly' is a drum-like bloating of the abdomen, 'consumptive weakness' is deficiency and feebleness, and 'blocked throat' is a blockage in the gullet. The original writes the snake with a variant character.

yi: 青龙是善愿，是观音，
上圣、三官，都是神；
断鬼，是产亡的、带血的鬼；
交重，必定是本堂的神鬼临到了。
en: The Azure Dragon is good vows, it is Guanyin,
the Supreme Sage and the Three Officials are all gods;
to judge the ghost: one dead in childbirth, with blood;
if moving, it is surely the household's own hall that has come.

yi: 朱雀是家堂和灶君，
花幡、香愿、素愿，都存在心里；
鬼爻是吐血加上劳怯的病，
眼病、伤亡也都有它的缘故。
en: The Vermilion Bird is the household shrine and the Hearth Lord,
flower banners, incense vows and vegetarian vows are kept in the heart;
as a ghost it means spitting blood and consumptive weakness,
and eye disease, injury and death all have their cause in it.

yi: 勾陈是土地和城隍，
土神一起断，也没有妨害；
鬼爻是痢疾加蛊胀，
遇到土爻，就知道是咽喉堵塞而死。
