en: Hook Earth is the Earth God and the City God,
judging the earth gods together does no harm;
as a ghost it means dysentery and swelling of the belly,
and meeting an Earth line, one knows it is death from a blocked throat.

yi: 螣蛇本来是飞来的土，
遇到鬼、七杀、金，三样合在一起；
逢到官鬼是上吊死，逢到火是劳怯，
孩童一定被汤火所伤。
en: The Coiling Snake is at root earth that has flown in,
meeting a ghost, the Seven Killings and Metal, the three making one;
meeting Pressure it is death by hanging, meeting Fire it is consumptive weakness,
and children are sure to be hurt by scalding and fire.

yi: 白虎临在太岁上，是大将军，
五路、伤司、五圣这些神；
经文、香信、家堂的愿；
横死、伤亡、肚子饱胀而死的魂。
en: The White Tiger on Tai Sui is the great general,
with the Five Roads, the Injuring Officer and the Five Sages;
vows of scripture, incense pledges and the household shrine;
souls of violent death, injury and death, and of death from a swollen belly.

yi: 玄武就叫作真武帝，
水仙、五圣，靠佛经祈祷；
鬼爻作祟，断为落水伤亡；
活的办法全凭智谋来推。
en: The Dark Tortoise is called the Emperor Zhenwu,
the water immortals and the Five Sages are prayed to by scripture;
a ghost doing harm is judged a death by drowning;
the living method rests wholly on wit and strategy.

chapter: 阐幽精要·十四、六神论神崇决
title: 六神论神崇决：青龙爻动旧年佛愿催讨、朱雀爻兴游方五鬼梦中口愿、勾陈爻动土地家堂灶王时疫五瘟、螣蛇爻发病缠身东厨土地家亲、白虎爻兴神前愿佛前香、玄武爻兴病患凶家中人物不和

rule.yi: 六神论神崇决也是六首歌，讲六神的爻发动时，病是哪一路神鬼、该向谁祭祀还愿：青龙爻动，是往年的佛愿在催讨，赶紧告东厨和祖先；朱雀爻兴，是游方的五鬼、梦中的口愿；勾陈爻动，是土地、家堂、灶王，时疫、五瘟要求祭祀；螣蛇爻发，病缠身，是东厨、土地、家亲和天曹的口愿；白虎爻兴，是神前的愿、佛前的香；玄武爻兴，病患凶，家里人彼此不和，要靠北阴求土地。
rule.en: The verses on the six spirits and the secret of haunting spirits are also six songs, saying, when the line of each spirit moves, which kind of spirit or ghost the illness comes from and to whom to sacrifice or repay a vow: the Azure Dragon line moving, a Buddhist vow of past years is pressing for repayment, hurry to tell the Eastern Kitchen and the ancestors; the Vermilion Bird line rising, wandering Five Ghosts and a vow spoken in a dream; Hook Earth moving, the Earth God, household shrine and Hearth King, with epidemics and the Five Plagues calling for sacrifice; the Coiling Snake line moving, illness clings to the body, from the Eastern Kitchen, the Earth God, family kin and a vow spoken to the Celestial Bureau; the White Tiger line rising, a vow before the gods and incense before the Buddha; the Dark Tortoise line rising, illness is ominous, the people of the household are at odds, and one must rely on the North Yin to beseech the Earth God.

note.yi: 这是六首歌，每首四句，按六神讲爻发动时的病和该祭祀的对象。青龙一首的第二句「得病先占问祸原」点出了这一组的用处：先占出病因，再决定向谁还愿、向谁祭祀。「黄泉」是阴间；「东厨」是灶神；「五瘟」是五种瘟疫（五瘟使者）；「天曹」是天官的衙门；「北阴」「北殿」是北方阴间的神（北阴是北方玄武之阴，北殿是阎罗殿一类），书里没有解释，译文照字面；「正照傍临本命星」是（鬼）照在本命星上、或靠近本命星，照字面。和前一组六神论神鬼心决（LY.ILL.BSQS.44）是姊妹篇：那一组讲每位神配哪些神鬼，这一组讲每位神爻发动时应向谁祭祀。
note.en: These are six songs of four lines each that set out, by the six spirits, the illness when that spirit's line moves and the one to whom to sacrifice. The second line of the Azure Dragon song, 'when one is ill, first divine and ask the origin of the harm', states the purpose of this set: first divine the cause of the illness, then decide to whom to repay a vow and to whom to sacrifice. The 'Yellow Springs' is the underworld; the 'Eastern Kitchen' is the kitchen god; the 'Five Plagues' are five kinds of epidemic (the Five Plague Envoys); the 'Celestial Bureau' is the office of the heavenly officials; the 'North Yin' and the 'Northern Hall' are spirits of the north and the underworld (the yin of the northern Dark Tortoise, and a hall of the Yama kind), which the book does not explain, and the translation keeps to the letter; 'directly shining on and close beside the natal star' is the ghost shining on, or near, the natal star, to the letter. This set is a sister to the preceding verses on the heart-secret of spirits and ghosts (LY.ILL.BSQS.44): that set says which gods each spirit matches, and this one to whom to sacrifice when each spirit's line moves.

yi: 青龙爻动，又及黄泉，
得了病，先占卜，问祸的根源；
是往年的佛愿在催着讨还，
赶紧告知东厨和祖先。
en: With the Azure Dragon line moving and reaching the Yellow Springs,
when one is ill, first divine and ask the origin of the harm;
it is a Buddhist vow of past years pressing for repayment,
hurry to tell the Eastern Kitchen and the ancestors.

yi: 朱雀爻兴起，祸不轻；
游方的五鬼立在门庭；
是梦里口头许的愿在催讨，
又正照、傍临本命星。
en: With the Vermilion Bird line rising, the harm is not light;
wandering Five Ghosts stand in the gate and courtyard;
it is a vow spoken in a dream pressing for repayment,
directly shining on and close beside the natal star.

yi: 勾陈爻动，祸难当；
是土地、家堂和灶王；
时疫、五瘟，要求祭祀；
家堂的踪迹被虫伤了。
en: With the Hook Earth line moving, the harm is hard to bear;
it is the Earth God, the household shrine and the Hearth King;
epidemics and the Five Plagues call for sacrifice;
the traces at the household shrine have been hurt by insects.

yi: 螣蛇爻发动，病缠身；
是东厨、土地和家亲；
是天曹的口头愿在催讨，
是非口舌，梦里受惊。
en: With the Coiling Snake line moving, illness clings to the body;
it is the Eastern Kitchen, the Earth God and family kin;
a vow spoken to the Celestial Bureau is pressing for repayment,
with quarrels and gossip and fright in dreams.

yi: 白虎爻兴，事不吉祥；
神前有愿，佛前有香；
福德、五道，要求祭祀；
土地、北殿，以及性情乖张的神。
en: With the White Tiger line rising, things are not auspicious;
there is a vow before the gods and incense before the Buddha;
the Spirit of Fortune and the Five Roads call for sacrifice;
the Earth God, the Northern Hall, and gods of perverse temper.

yi: 玄武爻兴，病患凶；
家里的人彼此不和；
赶紧靠北阴，求土地；
守护命的家亲就在其中。
en: With the Dark Tortoise line rising, illness is ominous;
the people in the household are at odds with one another;
hurry to rely on the North Yin and beseech the Earth God;
the family kin who guard one's life are among them.

title: 妖孽赋·震蛇鬼：酉冲刑、空中椅桌动闻声、桶箱作孽人丁病

rule.yi: 妖孽赋讲震宫螣蛇带鬼、遇酉冲刑时的怪异：空中的椅子桌子动，听得到声音，踢踏的响声像人在走；大蛇常出现，窑里的器具响得惊人；桶、箱作孽，家里的人生病。
rule.en: The Fu on monsters on the oddities when a Coiling Snake carrying a ghost in the Zhen palace is clashed and punished by You: chairs and tables move in the air and sounds are heard, a stamping sound like a person walking; a great snake often appears, and kiln wares clatter alarmingly; casks and chests do harm, and the people of the household fall ill.

note.yi: 妖孽赋按八卦讲螣蛇带鬼时出的怪异（乾、坎、艮、震、巽、离、坤、兑各一段），大多和病无关，这一段结尾的「桶箱作孽人丁病」明说家里人生病，所以收在这里。「蛇鬼」是螣蛇临在鬼爻上，「酉冲刑」是酉来冲刑（按前面「震」的位置：酉冲卯）。这一篇的标点是整理者（虎易）重新点的，译文按现有标点。
note.en: The Fu on monsters goes through the trigrams (Qian, Kan, Gen, Zhen, Xun, Li, Kun, Dui, one passage each) and tells the oddities when the Coiling Snake carries a ghost; most have nothing to do with illness, and this passage, whose last clause 'casks and chests do harm and the people of the household fall ill' says outright that people fall ill, is taken here. 'The snake ghost' is the Coiling Snake on the ghost line, and 'You clashing and punishing' is You coming to clash and punish (You clashes Mao, which is Zhen's place). The punctuation of this piece was redone by the modern editor (Hu Yi), and the translation follows the punctuation as it stands.

yi: 震宫螣蛇带鬼，
遇到酉来冲刑，
空中椅子桌子动，能听到声音，
踢踏的响声，
像人在走。
大蛇常常出现，
窑里的器具响得惊人，
桶、箱作孽，家里的人生病。
en: The Coiling Snake carrying a ghost in Zhen,
clashed and punished by You,
chairs and tables move in the air and sounds are heard,
a stamping sound,
like a person walking.
A great snake often appears,
kiln wares clatter alarmingly,
casks and chests do harm and the people of the household fall ill.

title: 搜鬼论·鬼在寅卯：寅鬼蛇虎作怪、人口有病患；卯鬼隔墙带血鬼、作灾母病床

rule.yi: 搜鬼论按十二地支列出鬼爻发动时所应的怪异：寅爻为鬼，蛇、虎来作怪，六畜见血、钱财亡失，家里人口有病患，要赶紧保平安；卯爻为鬼，是隔墙带着血的鬼，作灾，母亲卧病在床。
rule.en: The essay on searching out the ghost lists, by the twelve branches, what a moving ghost line answers: with Yin as the ghost, snakes and tigers come making trouble, livestock bleed and wealth is lost, the household has illness and one must quickly secure safety; with Mao as the ghost, it is a ghost with blood from across the wall, it makes calamity, and the mother lies ill in bed.

note.yi: 搜鬼论开头一句是「观鬼爻发动为实」——看的是发动的鬼爻，然后按子到亥十二支各列一条；这里只收和病有关的寅、卯两条，其余十条讲的是鼠咬屋、火灾、走失、牲畜、神庙等，不收。卯条的「作灾母病床」是作灾，母亲卧病在床；「破伞并橱柜」「及有死人床」是这个鬼附着的东西。
note.en: The essay begins with 'see the ghost line moving as real' (what is looked at is the moving ghost line) and then gives one entry for each branch from Zi to Hai; only the entries for Yin and Mao, which bear on illness, are taken here, and the other ten, on rats gnawing the house, fire, runaways, livestock and shrines, are not. In the Mao entry 'it makes calamity, the mother lies ill in bed' is calamity with the mother bedridden, and 'a broken umbrella and a cupboard' and 'a bed on which someone has died' are the things this ghost clings to.

yi: 寅爻为鬼：
蛇、虎来作怪，
六畜见血、钱财亡失，
家里人口有病患，
要赶紧保平安康健。
卯爻为鬼：
隔墙带着血的鬼，
作灾，母亲卧病在床，
破伞和橱柜，
以及死过人的床。
en: For Yin:
snakes and tigers come making trouble,
livestock bleed and wealth is lost,
the household has illness,
one must quickly secure safety and health.
For Mao:
a ghost with blood from across the wall,
it makes calamity, and the mother lies ill in bed,
a broken umbrella and a cupboard,
and a bed on which someone has died.

chapter: 阐幽精要·十九、神煞歌例·吉神
title: 神煞歌例·天医：占病遇此爻动虽凶有救；天医正卯二亥三丑四未五巳六卯七亥八丑九未十巳十一卯十二亥

rule.yi: 神煞歌例说：占病遇到天医这一爻，发动虽然凶，也有救。天医的位置按月取：正月卯、二月亥、三月丑、四月未、五月巳、六月卯、七月亥、八月丑、九月未、十月巳、十一月卯、十二月亥。
rule.en: The verses on spirit-stars say: in divining illness, meeting the Heavenly Physician line, even if it moves and is ominous there is rescue. The Heavenly Physician is placed by month: Mao in the first, Hai in the second, Chou in the third, Wei in the fourth, Si in the fifth, Mao in the sixth, Hai in the seventh, Chou in the eighth, Wei in the ninth, Si in the tenth, Mao in the eleventh and Hai in the twelfth.

note.yi: 这一首的十二个月位置和断易天机的天医月表一字不差（LY.ILL.DYTJ.30、LY.ILL.DYTJ.34）。结论的说法两本不同：断易天机说「病人有此爻上卦，必主名医下药有效」，卜筮全书说「占病遇此爻，动虽凶有救」，两处都是吉，只是卜筮全书连「动而为凶」时也说有救。「动虽凶有救」按字面读是这一爻发动虽然凶（或：遇到它发动虽有凶象），仍然有救，歌里没有细讲。
note.en: The positions for the twelve months are word for word those of the monthly table of the Heavenly Physician in the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.DYTJ.30, LY.ILL.DYTJ.34). The conclusion is worded differently in the two books: the Duanyi Tianji says 'a sick person who has this line in the hexagram will surely have a famous doctor whose medicine is effective', the Bushi Quanshu says 'in divining illness, meeting this line, even if it moves and is ominous there is rescue'; both are favourable, only the Bushi Quanshu says there is rescue even when it moves and is ominous. 'Even if it moves and is ominous there is rescue' is read to the letter as: even though this line moves ominously (or: even though meeting it moving has an ominous look), there is still rescue; the verse goes no further.

yi: 占病，遇到这一爻（天医），
发动虽然凶，也有救。
天医：正月在卯，二月在亥（猪），
三月随到丑，四月在未，
五月是巳（蛇），六月是卯（兔），七月居亥，
八月丑，九月未（羊），十月巳，
十一月再回到卯上，
十二月亥上作医人。
en: In divining illness, meeting this line (the Heavenly Physician),
even if it moves and is ominous there is rescue.
The Heavenly Physician: in the first month at Mao, in the second at Hai (the pig),
in the third month it follows to Chou, in the fourth it is found at Wei,
the fifth Si (the snake), the sixth Mao (the rabbit), the seventh it stays at Hai,
the eighth Chou, the ninth Wei (the sheep), the tenth it stays at Si,
the eleventh it comes again to Mao,
and in the twelfth month Hai acts as the physician.

chapter: 阐幽精要·十九、神煞歌例·吉神
title: 神煞歌例·解神：月解若值此辰官事散纵然重病也离身；日解戊癸鸡啼官事散病人无药不须忧；解脱神戊癸辰逢官讼消病人不必生忧虑

rule.yi: 神煞歌例里三个解神讲到病：月解神，遇到这个月的解神位，官事消散，纵然重病也会离开身体；日解神，戊、癸日逢酉，官事散，病人没有药也不用忧；解脱神，戊、癸日逢辰，官司消，病人不必忧虑。
rule.en: Three resolving spirits in the verses on spirit-stars bear on illness: the Month Resolution, on meeting the place of the month's Resolution, official business scatters and even a grave illness leaves the body; the Day Resolution, on Wu and Gui days meeting You, official business scatters and a sick person without medicine need not worry; the Release spirit, on Wu and Gui days meeting Chen, lawsuits dissolve and the sick person need not worry.

note.yi: 月解、日解、解脱神是「解神」一类，本义是解官事（官非、官讼），歌里顺带说到病人。月解神的位置和断易天机的月解表一样（申酉戌亥午未，LY.ILL.DYTJ.30），说法的结尾不同：断易天机是「病人有此解神，天医上卦即病愈」，卜筮全书是「若值此辰官事散，纵然重病也离身」。日解神的歌和断易天机一字不差（LY.ILL.DYTJ.30）。解脱神这一首断易天机里没有。「逢某支」「若值此辰」怎样才算遇上，歌里没有讲。
note.en: The Month Resolution, the Day Resolution and the Release spirit are 'resolving spirits', whose original use is to resolve official business (official trouble, lawsuits), and the verses mention the sick person in passing. The positions of the Month Resolution are those of the table in the Duanyi Tianji (Shen, You, Xu, Hai, Wu, Wei, LY.ILL.DYTJ.30), and the wording of the ending differs: the Duanyi Tianji has 'a sick person with this resolving spirit, with the Heavenly Physician in the hexagram, is cured at once', the Bushi Quanshu has 'if one meets this branch official business scatters, and even a grave illness leaves the body'. The verse of the Day Resolution is word for word that of the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.DYTJ.30). The verse of the Release spirit is not in the Duanyi Tianji. The verses do not say what counts as 'meeting a certain branch' or 'falling on this branch'.

yi: 月解：正月、二月起在申，
三月、四月仍然轮到酉上；
五月、六月从戌上走；
七月、八月能行到亥上停留；
九月、十月到午位；
子、丑两个月（十一月、十二月），未宫居尊；
如果遇到这个支，官事就散，
纵然是重病，也会离开身体。
en: The Month Resolution: in the first and second months it starts at Shen,
in the third and fourth it turns again to You;
in the fifth and sixth months it goes by Xu;
in the seventh and eighth it can go on to stay at Hai;
in the ninth and tenth months it comes to the Wu place;
in the two months of Zi and Chou (the eleventh and twelfth) the Wei palace holds the honoured place;
if one meets this branch, official business scatters,
and even a grave illness leaves the body.

yi: 日解：甲、己日逢巳（蛇），乙、庚日逢申（猴），
丙、辛日逢寅（虎），丁、壬日逢丑（牛），
戊、癸日逢酉（鸡），官事就散；
病人没有药也不用忧。
en: The Day Resolution: on Jia and Ji days it is Si (the snake), on Yi and Geng days Shen (the monkey),
on Bing and Xin days Yin (the tiger), on Ding and Ren days Chou (the ox),
on Wu and Gui days You (the rooster), and official business scatters;
a sick person without medicine need not worry.

yi: 解脱神：甲、己日在亥，乙、庚日在申，
丙、辛日在丑，丁、壬日在未，
戊、癸日逢辰，官司就消散，
病人不必生出忧虑。
en: The Release spirit: on Jia and Ji days at Hai, on Yi and Geng days at Shen,
on Bing and Xin days at Chou, on Ding and Ren days at Wei,
on Wu and Gui days meeting Chen, lawsuits dissolve,
and the sick person need not worry.

chapter: 阐幽精要·十九、神煞歌例·吉神
title: 神煞歌例·活曜星：六甲遇动则产、疾病遇动则痊；正卯二辰三巳四午五未六申七酉八戌九亥十子十一丑十二寅

rule.yi: 活曜星：怀孕遇它发动就生产，疾病遇它发动就痊愈；位置按月顺行：正月卯、二月辰、三月巳、四月午、五月未、六月申、七月酉、八月戌、九月亥、十月子、十一月丑、十二月寅。
rule.en: The Living Star: a pregnancy, when it moves, gives birth; an illness, when it moves, is cured; its place goes forward month by month: Mao in the first month, Chen in the second, Si in the third, Wu in the fourth, Wei in the fifth, Shen in the sixth, You in the seventh, Xu in the eighth, Hai in the ninth, Zi in the tenth, Chou in the eleventh and Yin in the twelfth.

note.yi: 活曜星是一颗吉星，位置从正月的卯起，每月顺行一位。「六甲」是怀孕（「身怀六甲」），「遇动」是这颗星所在的爻发动。这一颗星断易天机里没有。「则痊」的痊愈只是结论，歌里没有说病轻病重。
note.en: The Living Star is an auspicious star, placed from Mao in the first month and going forward one place each month. 'The Six Jia' is pregnancy ('carrying the six jia'), and 'when it moves' is the line where this star stands moving. This star is not in the Duanyi Tianji. 'Is cured' is only the conclusion, and the verse does not say whether the illness is light or grave.

yi: 怀孕遇到它发动，就生产；
疾病遇到它发动，就痊愈。
正月在卯，二月在辰，三月在巳；
四月在午，五月在未，六月在申；
七月在酉，八月在戌，九月在亥；
十月在子，十一月在丑，十二月在寅。
en: A pregnancy, when it moves, gives birth;
an illness, when it moves, is cured.
First month Mao, second Chen, third month Si;
fourth Wu, fifth Wei, sixth at Shen;
seventh You, eighth Xu, on Hai in the ninth;
tenth Zi, eleventh Chou, twelfth Yin.

chapter: 阐幽精要·十九、神煞歌例·凶神
title: 神煞歌例·岁前神煞：从太岁起顺轮十二位，三丧门主孝服、六死符、十一天狗吊客、十二病符切莫逢

rule.yi: 岁前神煞：十二个神煞都从太岁起，顺着一位一位轮下去：太岁、剑锋、伏尸同位，第二位太阳、天空，第三位丧门主孝服，第四位勾绞、贯索，第五位官符、五鬼，第六位死符、小耗，第七位栏干、大耗，第八位暴败、天厄，第九位飞廉、白虎，第十位福德、卷舌，第十一位天狗、吊客，第十二位病符，千万不要遇上。
rule.en: The stars before the Year: all twelve start from Tai Sui and go round forward place by place: Tai Sui, Sword Edge and Hidden Corpse in one place; second Great Yang and Heavenly Emptiness; third the Mourning Gate, meaning mourning dress; fourth Hook-Strangle and Cord-Through; fifth Official Tally and the Five Ghosts; sixth Death Tally and Small Loss; seventh Railing and Great Loss; eighth Sudden Ruin and Heavenly Distress; ninth Feilian and the White Tiger; tenth Fortune Virtue and the Curled Tongue; eleventh the Heavenly Dog and the Guest of Condolence; twelfth the Sickness Tally, which one must not meet.

dispute.yi: 十二位岁煞各家的名单不一样。卜筮全书的岁前神煞是：一太岁剑锋伏尸、二太阳天空、三丧门、四勾绞贯索、五官符五鬼、六死符小耗、七栏干大耗、八暴败天厄、九飞廉白虎、十福德卷舌、十一天狗吊客、十二病符；断易天机的「四利三元」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.50）是：一太岁、二太阳、三丧门、四太阴、五官符、六死符、七岁破、八龙德、九白虎、十福德、十一吊客、十二病符。第一、二、三、五、六、九、十、十一、十二位的主名两本一致；第四位（勾绞贯索对太阴）、第七位（栏干大耗对岁破）、第八位（暴败天厄对龙德）不同，而且卜筮全书每一位后面还并带了一两颗别的星。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The books' lists of the twelve year-stars differ. The stars before the Year in the Bushi Quanshu are: first Tai Sui with Sword Edge and Hidden Corpse, second Great Yang with Heavenly Emptiness, third Mourning Gate, fourth Hook-Strangle and Cord-Through, fifth Official Tally with the Five Ghosts, sixth Death Tally with Small Loss, seventh Railing with Great Loss, eighth Sudden Ruin and Heavenly Distress, ninth Feilian with the White Tiger, tenth Fortune Virtue with the Curled Tongue, eleventh the Heavenly Dog with the Guest of Condolence, twelfth Sickness Tally; the Duanyi Tianji's 'Four Gains and Three Origins' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.50) runs: first Tai Sui, second Great Yang, third Mourning Gate, fourth Great Yin, fifth Official Tally, sixth Death Tally, seventh Year-break, eighth Dragon Virtue, ninth White Tiger, tenth Fortune Virtue, eleventh Guest of Condolence, twelfth Sickness Tally. The principal names agree in the first, second, third, fifth, sixth, ninth, tenth, eleventh and twelfth places; the fourth (Hook-Strangle and Cord-Through against Great Yin), the seventh (Railing and Great Loss against Year-break) and the eighth (Sudden Ruin and Heavenly Distress against Dragon Virtue) differ, and the Bushi Quanshu joins one or two further stars to each place. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这十二位是流年神煞：子年时太岁、剑锋、伏尸在子，太阳、天空在丑，丧门在寅，依次往下，病符在亥。占病要看的是名字里带丧和病的几位：丧门（主孝服）、死符、吊客、病符（「切莫逢」），歌里只对这几位给了明白的话，其余几位只点名。原文「褔德」的褔是福的异写，这里的福德是一颗神煞，不是子孙爻。这一组里其余的神煞（天哭、四季小杀等）和本条的区别是：它们按月取，这一条按年取。
note.en: These twelve are year-stars: in a Zi year Tai Sui, Sword Edge and Hidden Corpse are at Zi, Great Yang and Heavenly Emptiness at Chou, the Mourning Gate at Yin, and so on, with the Sickness Tally at Hai. In divining illness the ones to look at are those with mourning and illness in their names: the Mourning Gate (mourning dress), the Death Tally, the Guest of Condolence and the Sickness Tally ('not to be met'); the verse speaks plainly only of these, and the rest are merely named. The 'Fortune' of 'Fortune Virtue' is written in a variant character in the original, and the Fortune Virtue here is a spirit-star, not the Output line. This entry differs from the other spirit-stars in this group (the Weeping, the small killing of the four seasons and so on) in being placed by the year, while those are placed by the month.

yi: 它们的取法都是从太岁上起。
比如子年，
就是子上为太岁，
同位的是剑锋、伏尸。
丑上是太阳、天空，
寅上是丧门，主孝服。
依次顺着轮下去，
转完一周又重新开始。
en: All are found by starting from Tai Sui.
For example in a Zi year,
Tai Sui is on Zi,
with the Sword Edge and Hidden Corpse.
Chou is Great Yang and Heavenly Emptiness,
Yin is the Mourning Gate, which means mourning dress.
It goes round one by one in order,
and starts again when the round is done.

yi: 太岁、剑锋、伏尸同在一位；
第二位是太阳和天空；
第三位是丧门，主孝服；
第四位是勾绞、贯索，凶；
第五位是官符和五鬼；
第六位是死符、小耗来攻；
第七位是栏干和大耗；
第八位是暴败、天厄；
第九位是飞廉和白虎；
第十位是福德，卷舌相随；
第十一位是天狗和吊客；
第十二位是病符，千万不要遇上。
en: Tai Sui, Sword Edge and Hidden Corpse are together;
the second is Great Yang and Heavenly Emptiness;
the third is the Mourning Gate, meaning mourning dress;
the fourth is Hook-Strangle and Cord-Through, ominous;
the fifth is the Official Tally and the Five Ghosts;
the sixth is the Death Tally and Small Loss attacking;
the seventh is the Railing and Great Loss;
the eighth is Sudden Ruin and Heavenly Distress;
the ninth is Feilian and the White Tiger;
the tenth is Fortune Virtue, with the Curled Tongue following;
the eleventh is the Heavenly Dog and the Guest of Condolence;
the twelfth is the Sickness Tally, which one must not meet.

chapter: 阐幽精要·十九、神煞歌例·凶神
title: 神煞歌例·占病大忌的煞：天哭杀、四季小杀、三丘五墓、勾陈杀(占病及讼)、白虎杀

rule.yi: 神煞歌例点明占病大忌的五个煞：天哭杀（正五九月羊、二六十月猴、三七十一月鸡、四八十二月犬）；四季小杀（春羊夏龙秋牛冬犬，临身命，轻灾也凶）；三丘五墓（春丑夏辰秋未冬戌为三丘，五墓取对宫，病人作福也难留）；勾陈杀（从辰逆行，占病及讼大忌）；白虎杀（从申顺行，占病大忌）。
rule.en: The verses on spirit-stars name five killings that are great taboos in divining illness: the Weeping killing (the sheep in the first, fifth and ninth months, the monkey in the second, sixth and tenth, the rooster in the third, seventh and eleventh, the dog in the fourth, eighth and twelfth); the small killing of the four seasons (the sheep in spring, the dragon in summer, the ox in autumn, the dog in winter; on the Body or the natal line even a light misfortune is ominous); the Three Mounds and Five Tombs (Chou in spring, Chen in summer, Wei in autumn, Xu in winter are the Three Mounds, the Five Tombs are taken from the opposite palace, and a sick person can hardly be kept even by making offerings); the Hook Earth killing (backward from Chen, a great taboo for illness and lawsuits); the White Tiger killing (forward from Shen, a great taboo for illness).

note.yi: 这五个煞各自的月位，和断易天机的一致：天哭杀和四季小杀（LY.ILL.DYTJ.33）、三丘五墓（LY.ILL.DYTJ.31）的位置一字不差（只差几个字的写法），勾陈杀从辰逆行同 LY.ILL.DYTJ.33 的一条，白虎杀从申顺行同占家宅一段的白虎杀例（正月起申、二月酉，见本书第 3577 行的旧注，火珠林第 1129 行也有）。卜筮全书对这五个煞都标了「占病大忌」或「占病忌之」（勾陈杀是「占病及讼大忌」），没有限定发动；断易天机则在勾陈杀、天哭杀、四季小杀下写「占病发动凶」或「占病忌发动」，三丘五墓下写「此占病忌」，勾陈杀、天哭杀、四季小杀这几条限定了要发动才凶。各煞的月位写成十二支是按歌里的生肖（羊=未、猴=申、鸡=酉、犬=戌、牛=丑、龙=辰、马=午、蛇=巳）换的。
note.en: The monthly positions of these five killings agree with the Duanyi Tianji: the Weeping and the small killing of the four seasons (LY.ILL.DYTJ.33) and the Three Mounds and Five Tombs (LY.ILL.DYTJ.31) are in the same positions (with a few characters written differently), the Hook Earth killing going backward from Chen is the same as the one in LY.ILL.DYTJ.33, and the White Tiger killing going forward from Shen is the same as the White Tiger killing in the passage on divining a house (Shen in the first month, You in the second, see the old note at line 3577 of this book; the Huozhu Lin, line 1129, has it too). The Bushi Quanshu marks all five killings 'a great taboo for illness' or 'to be avoided in illness' (the Hook Earth killing 'a great taboo for illness and lawsuits'), without limiting it to moving; the Duanyi Tianji writes 'in divining illness it is ominous if it moves' or 'in divining illness it must not move' under the Hook Earth killing, the Weeping and the small killing of the four seasons, and 'this is a taboo in divining illness' under the Three Mounds and Five Tombs, so in those three it limits the ill omen to the killing moving. The monthly positions are written as the twelve branches by turning the animals of the verses into branches (sheep Wei, monkey Shen, rooster You, dog Xu, ox Chou, dragon Chen, horse Wu, snake Si).

yi: 占病，大忌。
哭声：正月、五月、九月在羊（未），
二月、六月、十月在猴（申）的地方，
三月、七月、十一月是鸡（酉）在啼叫，
四月、八月、十二月是犬（戌）猖狂。
en: In divining illness, a great taboo.
The Weeping killing: in the first, fifth and ninth months it stays at the sheep (Wei),
in the second, sixth and tenth months in the land of the monkey (Shen),
in the third, seventh and eleventh months the rooster (You) crows,
in the fourth, eighth and twelfth months the dog (Xu) runs wild.

yi: 占病，忌它。
春天忌羊（未）、夏天忌龙（辰），
秋天牛（丑）、冬天犬（戌），哭了又哭；
卦里遇到这个，临在身和命上，
就是小灾也见凶。
en: In divining illness, avoid it.
In spring avoid the sheep (Wei), in summer the dragon (Chen),
in autumn the ox (Chou), in winter the dog (Xu), weeping upon weeping;
if the hexagram meets this, sitting on the Body and the natal line,
even a light misfortune turns ominous.

yi: 占病，大忌。
春天是丑、夏天是辰、秋天就是未，
冬天逢戌，这是三丘；
五墓却要取三丘的对宫，
病人就是作福也难留住。
en: In divining illness, a great taboo.
In spring Chou, in summer Chen, in autumn Wei,
in winter meeting Xu: these are the Three Mounds;
the Five Tombs are taken from the opposite palace;
the sick person, though he makes offerings for fortune, can hardly be kept.

yi: 从辰上起，
从正月起逆着轮。
占病和官司，大忌。
正月辰、二月卯、三月寅，
四月丑、五月子、六月亥一路走，
七月戌、八月酉、九月申位，
十月羊（未）、十一月马（午）、十二月蛇（巳）走。
en: It starts from Chen,
going backward from the first month.
A great taboo for illness and lawsuits.
First month Chen, second Mao, third month Yin,
fourth Chou, fifth Zi, sixth on the road to Hai,
seventh Xu, eighth You, ninth the Shen place,
tenth the sheep (Wei), eleventh the horse (Wu), twelfth the snake (Si) moves.

yi: 从申起，顺着轮。
占病，大忌。
正月申、二月酉、三月戌乡，
四月亥、五月子、六月丑伤，
七月寅、八月卯、九月辰上，
十月巳、十一月马（午）、十二月羊（未）。
en: It starts from Shen and goes forward.
In divining illness, a great taboo.
First month Shen, second You, third month the Xu land,
fourth Hai, fifth Zi, sixth Chou harms,
seventh Yin, eighth Mao, ninth on Chen,
tenth Si, eleventh the horse (Wu), twelfth the sheep (Wei).

chapter: 阐幽精要·十九、神煞歌例·凶神
title: 神煞歌例·占病见死的煞：墓门杀病人不死也伤财；丧车杀人来占病无他断、教君作急买棺材；沐浴杀发动病人亡

rule.yi: 神煞歌例里三个主病人死亡的煞：墓门杀，甲乙见金、丙丁见水、戊己见木、庚辛见火、壬癸见土，病人不死也伤财；丧车杀，春鸡夏鼠秋兔冬马，有人来占病，没有别的可断，劝你赶紧去买棺材；沐浴杀，春辰夏未秋戌冬丑，发动，病人死亡。
rule.en: Three killings in the verses on spirit-stars that mean a sick person's death: the Tomb Gate killing, Jia and Yi meeting Metal, Bing and Ding Water, Wu and Ji Wood, Geng and Xin Fire, Ren and Gui Earth: the sick person, if he does not die, at least loses money; the Mourning Cart killing, the rooster in spring, the rat in summer, the rabbit in autumn and the horse in winter: a person who comes to divine illness has nothing else to be judged, and I advise you to buy a coffin at once; the Bathing killing, Chen in spring, Wei in summer, Xu in autumn and Chou in winter: if it moves, the sick person dies.

dispute.yi: 丧车杀的四季位置，两本不一样。卜筮全书这一首是「春鸡夏鼠秋兔冬马」；断易天机（LY.ILL.DYTJ.32）是「春鸡夏鼠秋马冬羊」；春、夏两季一致，秋、冬不同。另外断易天机的旌旗杀（LY.ILL.DYTJ.33）是「春兔夏鼠秋鸡冬马」，和卜筮全书这一首的丧车只差春、秋两季的鸡兔互换。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The seasonal positions of the Mourning Cart differ between the two books. This verse in the Bushi Quanshu has 'the rooster in spring, the rat in summer, the rabbit in autumn, the horse in winter'; the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.DYTJ.32) has 'the rooster in spring, the rat in summer, the horse in autumn, the sheep in winter'; spring and summer agree, autumn and winter do not. Moreover the Banner killing of the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.DYTJ.33) has 'the rabbit in spring, the rat in summer, the rooster in autumn, the horse in winter', which differs from the Mourning Cart of this verse only in the rooster and rabbit swapped between spring and autumn. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 墓门杀的五句，每句的前一个字组是日干（甲乙、丙丁、戊己、庚辛、壬癸），后一个字是五行，对着的正好是克那一组日干的五行（木逢金、火逢水、土逢木、金逢火、水逢土），也就是各日干的官鬼；歌里没有这样说明，这是从字面排出来的。「哭哀哀」「孝服」是丧事的征兆。丧车杀的位置，按地支对冲推：春（卯）冲酉（鸡）、夏（午）冲子（鼠）、秋（酉）冲卯（兔）、冬（子）冲午（马），卜筮全书这一首正好是各季旺支的对冲，断易天机的秋冬两处不是；这是按地支推出来的，书里没有这样讲。「教君作急买棺材」是语气很重的一句，原文如此。沐浴杀的位置（春辰夏未秋戌冬丑）和本篇疾病论里催尸杀的位置一样（LY.ILL.BSQS.36），歌里没有说它们是不是同一个煞。
note.en: In each of the five lines on the Tomb Gate killing, the first group of characters is a pair of day stems (Jia and Yi, Bing and Ding, Wu and Ji, Geng and Xin, Ren and Gui) and the second is an element, and the element is exactly the one that controls that pair of stems (Wood meeting Metal, Fire meeting Water, Earth meeting Wood, Metal meeting Fire, Water meeting Earth), that is, the Pressure of each day stem; the verse does not say so and this is laid out from the letter. 'Mournful weeping' and 'mourning dress' are signs of a funeral. The positions of the Mourning Cart, reckoned by the clashes of the branches: spring (Mao) clashes You (the rooster), summer (Wu) clashes Zi (the rat), autumn (You) clashes Mao (the rabbit), winter (Zi) clashes Wu (the horse); this verse in the Bushi Quanshu is exactly the clash of each season's ruling branch, and the Duanyi Tianji's autumn and winter are not; this is reckoned from the branches and the book does not say it. 'I advise you to buy a coffin at once' is a very heavy sentence, as the original has it. The positions of the Bathing killing (Chen in spring, Wei in summer, Xu in autumn, Chou in winter) are the same as those of the Urging-the-Corpse killing in the chapter on illness in this book (LY.ILL.BSQS.36), and the verses do not say whether they are the same killing.

yi: 甲、乙见金，墓门打开；
丙、丁见水，哭得哀哀；
戊、己见木，要防灾厄；
庚、辛见火，丧服要来；
壬、癸见土，难以回避，
病人就是不死，也要伤财。
en: Jia and Yi meeting Metal, the gate of the tomb opens;
Bing and Ding meeting Water, there is mournful weeping;
Wu and Ji meeting Wood, beware of calamity;
Geng and Xin meeting Fire, mourning dress is coming;
Ren and Gui meeting Earth, it is hard to avoid,
and the sick person, if he does not die, at least loses money.

yi: 丧车：春天是鸡、夏天来的是鼠，
秋天是兔、冬天是马，好安排；
有人来占病，没有别的可断，
劝你赶紧去买棺材。
en: The Mourning Cart: in spring the rooster, in summer the rat comes,
in autumn the rabbit, in winter the horse, which is well arranged;
a person who comes to divine illness, there is nothing else to be judged,
I advise you to hurry and buy a coffin.

yi: 沐浴杀难当，
春天辰、夏天未是祸殃，
秋天戌、冬天丑就是它；
发动，病人就死亡。
en: The Bathing killing is hard to bear;
Chen in spring and Wei in summer bring harm,
Xu in autumn and Chou in winter are it;
if it moves, the sick person dies.

title: 搜精六爻·三爻：龙德贵人临添新喜，劫杀鬼相干弟兄疾病苦

rule.yi: 搜精六爻讲第三爻（门户）时说：龙德、贵人临在上面，添上新的喜事、生出新的门户；劫杀和鬼爻互相干犯，兄弟们疾病受苦。
rule.en: On the third line (the gate and doors) the essay on searching out the essence of the six lines says: with Dragon Virtue and the Noble on it, new joys are added and a new household arises; with the Robbery killing and the ghost interfering with each other, the brothers suffer from illness.

note.yi: 搜精六爻里第三爻是门户（「三爻为门户」），这一联是第三爻一段里的几联之一：龙德、贵人临它是添喜，劫杀和鬼爻相干，是家里的兄弟生病。「弟兄」指家里的兄弟（人），不是兄弟爻。「劫杀」是一个神煞。同一篇里初爻、二爻、五爻、六爻各有一条讲病（LY.ILL.BSQS.30）。
note.en: In the essay on searching out the essence of the six lines the third line is the gate and doors ('the third line is the gate and doors'), and this couplet is one of several in the passage on the third line: Dragon Virtue and the Noble on it add joy, and the Robbery killing interfering with the ghost line means the brothers of the house fall ill. 'The brothers' are the brothers of the household (persons), not the Peer line. The 'Robbery killing' is a spirit-star. The first, second, fifth and sixth lines each have an entry on illness in the same essay (LY.ILL.BSQS.30).

yi: 龙德、贵人临在三爻上，
添上新的喜事，生出新的门户；
劫杀和鬼爻互相干犯，
兄弟们疾病受苦。
en: With Dragon Virtue and the Noble on the third line,
new joys are added and a new household arises;
with the Robbery killing and the ghost interfering with each other,
the brothers suffer from illness.

title: 船家宅·螣蛇爻动主暴病之忧

rule.yi: 占船家（以船为家的人家）的一章里说：螣蛇爻发动，主有暴病的忧虑。
rule.en: The chapter on divining a boat household says: with the Coiling Snake line moving, there is worry of a sudden illness.

note.yi: 船家宅是占以船为家的人家的一章，按船的各个部位（船头、舵、桅杆、毛缆、橹蓬）和六神断吉凶。这一句只讲螣蛇发动主暴病之忧（「暴病」是来得急的病）；同一联的下半句讲朱雀、断桅之祸，不收。
note.en: The chapter on boat households is about divining the households that live on boats, and judges good and ill by the parts of the boat (the bow, the rudder, the mast, the cables, the sculling oar and awning) and the six spirits. This sentence says only that the Coiling Snake moving means worry of a sudden illness (a 'sudden illness' is one that comes on fast); the second half of the same couplet, on the Vermilion Bird and a broken mast, is not taken.

yi: 螣蛇爻发动，
主有暴病的忧虑；
en: With the Coiling Snake line moving,
there is worry of a sudden illness;

title: 易卦发蒙歌·克我者为鬼：如金宫见巳午火；凡疾病皆视此爻，知鬼神情状

rule.yi: 易卦发蒙歌说：克我的是鬼（官鬼）。自注说：凡是疾病，都看这一爻，从它知道鬼神的情状；比如金宫的卦，见到巳、午的火爻就是。
rule.en: The Yigua Fameng Ge says: what controls me is the ghost (Pressure). Its own note adds: in all illness look to this line, and from it know the state of the ghosts and spirits; in a Metal-palace hexagram, for instance, the Fire lines of Si and Wu are it.

note.yi: 「金宫」是属金的卦宫（乾宫、兑宫）；火克金，所以金宫卦里的巳、午火爻是克我者，也就是官鬼（「鬼」是六亲里的官鬼）。「知鬼神情状」只有这五个字，书里没有展开，按字面译；黄金策把官鬼说成得病根由、虚实、安危、鬼神情状都决于它（LY.ILL.HJC.49），说法相近。这首「易卦发蒙歌」每一句后面都有括号小注，书里没有标注者，是这部书自己的小注，不是今人的虎易注，所以这里引。
note.en: 'Metal palace' is a palace of the Metal phase (the Qian palace and the Dui palace); Fire controls Metal, so the Fire lines of Si and Wu in a Metal-palace hexagram are what controls me, that is, Pressure (the 'ghost' being Pressure among the six relations). 'Know the state of the ghosts and spirits' is only five characters in the book and is not expanded, and is translated literally; the Huangjin Ce says of Pressure that the cause, the strength or weakness, the safety or danger and the state of ghosts and spirits of the illness are all decided by it (LY.ILL.HJC.49), which is close. Every line of this 'Yigua Fameng Ge' has a bracketed small note after it, with no author named in the book, which is the book's own note and not the modern Hu Yi notes, and is therefore quoted.

yi: 克我的是鬼，
en: what controls me is the ghost,

yi: 比如金宫的卦，见到巳、午的火爻就是。
凡是疾病，都看这一爻，
从它知道鬼神的情状。
en: In a Metal-palace hexagram, the Fire lines of Si and Wu are it.
In all illness, look to this line,
and from it know the state of the ghosts and spirits.

title: 易卦发蒙歌·六亲各忧：父母爻动忧子孙；财爻动合杀忧父母病；比和为兄弟，此爻动忌妻妾疾病

rule.yi: 易卦发蒙歌的自注给了三条六亲发动时要担心的事：父母爻动，担心子孙；财爻动、又合上杀，担心父母生病；兄弟爻动，忌妻妾的疾病。
rule.en: The notes to the Yigua Fameng Ge give three things to worry about when a relation line moves: when the Resource line moves, worry for Output (the children); when the Wealth line moves and joins a killing, worry that the Resource (the parents) will fall ill; when the Peer line moves, the illness of wife and concubine is to be feared.

note.yi: 三条自注都是从五行相克来的：父母克子孙，财克父母，兄弟克财（也就是克妻妾）。例子都举金宫：土生金所以是父母，木是金所克所以是财，金同金所以是兄弟。「合杀」的杀书里没有指明是哪一种杀，按字面译成「joins a killing」。这几条在书里同一首歌诀里，和 LY.ILL.BSYG.09 讲的那一串（财动忧父母、父母动忧子孙……）是同一个道理，那一条更完整。
note.en: All three notes come from control among the five phases: Resource controls Output, Wealth controls Resource, Peer controls Wealth (that is, controls wife and concubine). The examples are all given in a Metal palace: Earth generates Metal so it is Resource, Wood is controlled by Metal so it is Wealth, Metal is the same as Metal so it is Peer. The killing of 'joins a killing' is not specified in the book as to which killing, and is rendered literally as 'joins a killing'. These notes are in the same song as the longer chain of LY.ILL.BSYG.09 (Wealth moves, worry for Resource; Resource moves, worry for Output ...), and are the same reasoning, which that entry gives more fully.

yi: 生我的是父母，
en: what generates me is Resource (the parents),

yi: 比如金宫的卦，见到土爻就是。
凡是卦里父母爻动，
要为子孙担忧。
en: In a Metal-palace hexagram, an Earth line is it.
when the Resource line in a hexagram moves,
worry for Output (the children).

yi: 我克的是财，
en: what I control is Wealth,

yi: 比如金宫的卦，见到木爻就是。
凡是占的时候，财爻动、又合上杀，
要担心父母生病。
en: In a Metal-palace hexagram, a Wood line is it.
In any divination, when the Wealth line moves and joins a killing,
worry that the Resource (the parents) will fall ill.

yi: 比和的是兄弟，
这是因为取的是同类。
en: what is level with me is Peer (the brothers),
because it is taken from the same kind.

yi: 比如金宫的卦，见到申、酉的爻，
这一爻动，
要忌妻妾生病。
en: In a Metal-palace hexagram, a line of Shen or You,
when this line moves,
the illness of wife and concubine is to be feared.

title: 易卦发蒙歌·六神自注：玄武动克身世应，主女多疾病、盗贼；勾陈动克身世应，主有疾病、官司、争田土屋宅山林；刑世应主坟墓不安

rule.yi: 易卦发蒙歌说六神的自注里有两条讲到病：玄武这个神，发动、克到身、世、应，主女的多有疾病、还有盗贼的事；勾陈这个神，发动、克到身、世、应，主有疾病、官司、争夺田土房屋山林的事，如果刑到世、应，主坟墓不安宁。
rule.en: Two of the notes on the six spirits in the Yigua Fameng Ge speak of illness: the Dark Tortoise spirit, when it moves and controls the Body, Self or Other, means much illness among women and matters of thieves; the Hook Earth spirit, when it moves and controls the Body, Self or Other, means illness, lawsuits and quarrels over fields, houses, hills and forests, and if it punishes the Self or Other, the graves are unquiet.

note.yi: 这两条自注都以「其神动克身世应」为条件：六神动了、又克到卦身、世或应，才断主某事。同一部书在月建六神吉凶一段的末尾（第 415 行）明说「右爻动或克世应断之，不动不克不断」。「主女多疾病」可读作「主女的多生病」，也可读作「主在女人那里多有疾病」，书里没有展开，译文取前一种说法。这一整首歌诀里别的六神（青龙、白虎、朱雀、螣蛇）的自注讲的是喜庆、丧服、口舌、怪梦，与病无关，没有收；白虎的病见 LY.ILL.BSYG.05。
note.en: Both notes take 'when this spirit moves and controls the Body, Self or Other' as the condition: the spirit must move and also control the Body, Self or Other before it is judged to mean such and such. The same book at the end of the passage on the omens of the spirits of the Month (line 415) says outright 'judge by a line to the right when it moves or controls the Self or Other; if it does not move or control, do not judge'. 'Much illness among women' can be read as 'women fall ill often' or as 'much illness on the women's side'; the book does not expand, and the translation takes the first. The notes on the other spirits in the same song (Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, Coiling Snake) speak of joy, mourning dress, quarrels and strange dreams and are not about illness, so are not taken; for the White Tiger's illness see LY.ILL.BSYG.05.

yi: 阴私的事，看玄武来验证，
en: for private and hidden matters, the Dark Tortoise is the test,

yi: 它属水，
冬天旺。
这个神发动、克到身、世、应时，
主女的多有疾病，
还有盗贼的事。
en: it belongs to Water,
flourishing in winter.
when this spirit moves and controls the Body, Self or Other,
it means much illness among women,
and matters of thieves.

yi: 勾陈管田土的事。
en: Hook Earth governs matters of land.

zh: 相争田土屋宅山林之事。
yi: 它属土，
四季都旺。
这个神发动、克到身、世、应时，
主有疾病，
还有官司，
还有争夺田土、房屋、山林的事。
如果刑到世、应，
主坟墓不安宁。
en: it belongs to Earth,
flourishing in all four seasons.
when this spirit moves and controls the Body, Self or Other,
it means illness,
lawsuits,
and quarrels over fields, houses, hills and forests.
and if it punishes the Self or Other,
the graves are unquiet.

title: 月建直符·破为白虎：月内有人疾，阴女阳男；子孙兄弟父母妻财并可预断；带杀同鬼主孝服

rule.yi: 月建直符这一段说：月破的那个位置是白虎，这个月里有人生病，阴是女的、阳是男的；子孙、兄弟、父母、妻财这几类亲人，都可以预先判断是谁；如果又带着杀、和鬼在一起，主孝服；在外象，是出远路的人的事。
rule.en: The passage on the on-duty spirit of the Month says: the break of the Month is the White Tiger, and within that month someone is ill, yin being a woman and yang a man; the relatives of the four kinds Output, Peer, Resource and Wealth can all be judged in advance; if it also carries a killing and sits with the ghost, it means mourning dress; in the outer image it concerns a traveller on a far road.

note.yi: 「破」是和月建相冲的那个地支：这一段前面有一张月建六神表（本库没有收表），白虎在正月是申、二月是酉……正好是月建寅、卯……的对冲，所以「破为白虎」就是月破那一位是白虎。「阴女阳男」按字面译，书里没有说阴阳是指爻还是别的；「子孙兄弟父母妻财并可预断之」是说生病的是哪一类亲人，可以按这四类六亲来断。「内象」「外象」书里没有解释。「若带杀同鬼」的「鬼」可以是官鬼，也可以是鬼神，书里没有标明。这一段前面讲月建青龙的一句（婚姻、添人进口）在 LY.MARRY.BSYG.03。
note.en: 'Break' is the branch that clashes with the Month: before this passage the book has a table of the six spirits by month (the table is not included in this library), in which the White Tiger is at Shen in the first month, You in the second and so on, exactly the clash of the Month branches Yin, Mao and so on, so 'the break is the White Tiger' means the place of the Month-break is the White Tiger. 'Yin is a woman, yang a man' is translated literally and the book does not say whether yin and yang refer to lines or something else; 'Output, Peer, Resource, Wealth can all be judged in advance' says that the relation of the person who is ill can be judged by these four of the six relations. 'Inner image' and 'outer image' are not explained in the book. The 'ghost' of 'sits with the ghost' could be Pressure or a ghost of the spirits, and the book does not say which. The line before this passage on the Azure Dragon of the Month (marriage, people added to the household) is in LY.MARRY.BSYG.03.

yi: 月破的位置是白虎，
这个月里有人生病，
阴是女的，阳是男的。
子孙、兄弟、父母、妻财，
都可以预先判断。
如果带着杀、又和鬼在一起，
主孝服。
在外象，是出远路的人的事。
en: the break is the White Tiger,
within the month someone is ill,
yin is a woman, yang a man.
Output, Peer, Resource, Wealth:
all can be judged in advance.
if it carries a killing and sits with the ghost,
it means mourning dress.
in the outer image it concerns a traveller on a far road.

title: 日六神内动·白虎内惊忧疾病：白虎是金神；落在水爻上，水为白虎入墓占疾大凶；两重入墓必见死亡；秋申酉爻上动旺相尤凶，休囚吉

rule.yi: 日六神内动的歌说：白虎在内卦发动，忧惊、疾病。自注说：白虎是金神；白虎也可以落在水爻上，这时水爻就是白虎，入了墓，占病大凶；例如庚、辛日得乾卦，甲子水爻动，变辛丑土，水墓在辰，白虎又是金神，叫两重入墓，必见死亡；白虎在秋天申、酉爻上动，旺相，更凶，休囚则吉。
rule.en: The song on the spirits of the Day moving within says: when the White Tiger moves in the inner trigram, there is worry, fright and illness. Its own note says: the White Tiger is the Metal spirit; it can also come on a Water line, and then the Water line is the White Tiger; if it enters the tomb, illness is greatly ominous; for example, on a Geng or Xin day, casting Qian, the Water line Jiazi moves and turns into Xinchou Earth, the Water tomb is at Chen, and since the White Tiger is also the Metal spirit, it is called entering the tomb twice, and death is sure to be seen; when the White Tiger moves on a Shen or You line in autumn it is thriving and strong and still more ominous, and when resting or trapped it is auspicious.

note.yi: 这是这部书自注里最长的一个病例。「是水为白虎」是说白虎这个神附在水爻上；白虎本来是金神，所以又叫「两重入墓」——按字面，是金神白虎、和它所附的水爻，两个都入了墓（水墓在辰）。例子里「内见巽」的「巽」书里没有解释，译文照字面。「秋申酉爻上动，为旺相尤凶，休囚吉」是说白虎旺的时候凶得更重，衰了反而吉；这是白虎自己的旺衰，不是病人的。断易天机里同一句歌诀（LY.ILL.DYTJ.38）后面只有今人的注号（1），没有这段自注。
note.en: This is the longest case on illness in this book's own notes. 'Water is the White Tiger' says that the spirit of the White Tiger is attached to a Water line; the White Tiger is by nature the Metal spirit, so it is also called 'entering the tomb twice' — literally, both the Metal spirit White Tiger and the Water line it is attached to enter the tomb (the Water tomb is at Chen). The 'Xun' of 'within is seen Xun' in the example is not explained in the book and is translated literally. 'Moving on a Shen or You line in autumn, thriving and strong and especially ominous; resting or trapped, auspicious' says that the White Tiger is more ominous when it is strong and, when it is weak, on the contrary auspicious; this is the strength of the White Tiger itself and not of the sick person. The same line of the song in the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.DYTJ.38) has after it only a modern note number (1) and not this note.

yi: 白虎在内卦发动，忧惊、疾病，
en: when the White Tiger moves within, worry, fright and illness,

zh: 或在水爻上来，是水为白虎，入墓，占疾大凶。
如庚辛日卜得乾卦，甲子水动，是水为白虎，化为辛丑土，内见巽，水墓在辰，又曰白虎金神，名两重入墓，必见死亡。
秋申酉爻上动，为旺相尤凶，休囚吉。
yi: 白虎是金神。
也可以落在水爻上，这时水爻就是白虎，入了墓，占病大凶。
例如庚、辛日卜得乾卦，甲子水爻动，这时水就是白虎，变成辛丑土，里面见到巽，水的墓在辰，又说白虎是金神，叫两重入墓，必然见到死亡。
别的都照这个类推。
在秋天申、酉爻上动，是旺相，尤其凶；休囚就吉。
en: The White Tiger is the Metal spirit.
It may also come on a Water line; then Water is the White Tiger, and if it enters the tomb, illness is greatly ominous.

For example, on a Geng or Xin day, casting Qian, the Water line Jiazi moves, so Water is the White Tiger, and turns into Xinchou Earth; within is seen Xun, and the Water tomb is at Chen; and since the White Tiger is also called the Metal spirit, it is called entering the tomb twice, and death is sure to be seen.
The rest follow this.
Moving on a Shen or You line in autumn, it is thriving and strong and especially ominous; resting or trapped, it is auspicious.

title: 日下大杀：甲乙亥、丙丁未、戊己戌、庚辛寅、壬癸巳；父母子孙逢此杀必悲号入内堂；此杀推占病忌，爻动方断

rule.yi: 日下大杀按日干排：甲乙日在亥（猪），丙丁日在未（羊），戊己日在戌（狗），庚辛日在寅（虎），壬癸日在巳（蛇）；父母、子孙遇到这个杀，必有悲伤号哭进到内堂。自注说：占病要忌这个杀，爻动了才断。
rule.en: The Great Killing under the Day is laid out by the Day stem: Hai (the pig) on Jia and Yi days, Wei (the sheep) on Bing and Ding days, Xu (the dog) on Wu and Ji days, Yin (the tiger) on Geng and Xin days, Si (the snake) on Ren and Gui days; if Resource or Output meets this killing, wailing and grief are sure to enter the inner hall. Its own note says: this killing is to be avoided in an illness divination, and is judged only when the line moves.

note.yi: 这一本的歌诀里没有「壬癸蛇为大杀方」那一句（卜筮全书、断易天机有），第五个日干（壬癸巳）是在自注里补出来的。五个日干的位置各书一致，但各书说的用处不同：卜筮全书的神煞歌例（第 10073 行起）只写「凡事忌之」；断易天机（第 323 行）写「父母兄弟并妻子，杀临杀动主悲伤」；易隐的日煞表（第 1023 行）写「占家宅凶百事不吉」；只有大易断例这里的自注点明「占病忌」。「兮」「处」是歌诀里的衬字。「悲号入内堂」是丧事的征兆。同一个歌诀前面的「杀阴」「大杀」（按月排的）是另外两个煞，讲的是亡殁、伤亡，没有提病，这里不收。
note.en: In this copy of the song the line 'Ren and Gui: the snake is the Great Killing' (found in the Bushi Quanshu and the Duanyi Tianji) is absent, and the fifth day stem (Ren and Gui: Si) is supplied in the note. The positions for the five day stems agree among the books, but the books name different uses: the verses of spirit-stars in the Bushi Quanshu (from line 10073) write only 'avoid it in everything'; the Duanyi Tianji (line 323) writes 'Resource, Peer and wife and children: where the killing arrives or moves, it means grief'; the table of day stars of the Yi Yin (line 1023) writes 'in divining the household, ominous, and nothing is auspicious'; only the note here in the Dayi Duanli makes plain 'avoid it in illness'. 'Xi' and 'chu' are filler words of the song. 'Wailing and grief entering the inner hall' is an omen of mourning. The 'Yin Killing' and 'Great Killing' laid out by month earlier in the same song are two other killings that speak of death and injury and make no mention of illness, and are not taken here.

yi: 日下的大杀要再详细推算：
甲、乙日是猪，丙、丁日是羊，
戊、己日是狗，庚、辛日是虎，
父母、子孙遇到这个杀，
必定有悲伤号哭进到内堂。
en: The Great Killing under the Day should be worked out in detail:
on Jia and Yi days the pig, on Bing and Ding days the sheep,
on Wu and Ji days the dog, on Geng and Xin days the tiger,
if Resource or Output meets this killing,
wailing and grief will surely enter the inner hall.

yi: 甲、乙日是亥，
丙、丁日是未，
戊、己日是戌，
庚、辛日是寅，
壬、癸日是巳。
这个杀，推占病时要忌，
爻动了才断。
en: Jia and Yi: Hai;
Bing and Ding: Wei;
Wu and Ji: Xu;
Geng and Xin: Yin;
Ren and Gui: Si.
This killing is to be avoided in reckoning an illness divination,
and is judged only when the line moves.

chapter: 六神门·推占来情休旺吉凶要决章
title: 推占来情·身居世上欲行游，鬼更当门官病忌：鬼在第三四爻是「当门」

rule.yi: 推占来情的歌里有一联：卦身在世爻上、想出门远行的时候，鬼又正好当门，官司、疾病都要忌。自注说，「当门」指鬼在第三、四爻。
rule.en: In the verses on reading the purpose of the asker there is a couplet: when the Body is on the Self line and one wants to go travelling, and the ghost stands at the door as well, official trouble and illness are to be feared. Its own note says that 'at the door' means the ghost is on the third or fourth line.

note.yi: 「官病忌」的「官」和「病」分开读：官司（或官事）和疾病，都是要忌的。这一联在断易天机里也有（第 502 行），那里的括号是今人的注。自注后面还讲了怎么找「身」（子午世身在初、丑未在二、寅申在三、卯酉在四、辰戌在五、巳亥在六）和另一种只取驿马的断法，那是找卦身的办法，不管病，这里不收。
note.en: The 'official' and 'illness' of 'official trouble and illness are to be feared' are read separately: lawsuits (or official affairs) and illness are both to be feared. This couplet is also in the Duanyi Tianji (line 502), where the brackets are the modern commentator's notes. After this the note goes on to explain how to find the 'Body' (Zi and Wu: Body on the first line, Chou and Wei the second, Yin and Shen the third, Mao and You the fourth, Chen and Xu the fifth, Si and Hai the sixth) and another way of judging by the Post Horse alone; those are ways of finding the Body, have nothing to do with illness, and are not taken here.

yi: 卦身落在世爻上，想出门远行，
鬼又正好当门，官司、疾病都要忌，
en: with the Body on the Self line, wishing to go travelling,
and the ghost stands at the door as well: official trouble and illness are to be feared,

yi: 鬼在第三、四爻就是。
en: The ghost is on the third or fourth line.

chapter: 六神门·推占来情休旺吉凶要决章
title: 推占来情·胎没怀胎犯鬼神：值胎、没二卦多是占孕病，鬼神为祟，或逃窜、失财；囚死之卦必占官司囚系、并犯疾厄及亲戚丧亡

rule.yi: 推占来情的歌说：胎、没两个卦（春天巽、离，夏天坤、兑，秋天乾、坎，冬天艮、震）出现，多半是占怀孕和病，是鬼神作祟，或者逃走、或者失财；凡是囚、死的卦，一定是占官司囚禁的事，并且犯到疾病灾厄和亲戚的丧亡。
rule.en: The verses on reading the purpose of the asker say: when the two hexagrams Embryo and Sunk appear (in spring Xun and Li, in summer Kun and Dui, in autumn Qian and Kan, in winter Gen and Zhen), it is mostly a divination of pregnancy or illness, with ghosts and spirits afflicting, or flight, or loss of wealth; a hexagram in the trapped or dead state is surely a divination of lawsuits and imprisonment, and runs into illness, calamity and the death of relatives.

note.yi: 「胎」「没」是八卦按季节排的旺相休囚的几个状态（这部书前面的八卦旺废表里有「旺相胎没死休囚废」），这里的「胎没二卦」是各季处在胎、没状态的两个卦：春是巽、离，夏是坤、兑，秋是乾、坎，冬是艮、震。「囚死之卦」是处在囚、死状态的卦。「疾厄」是疾病灾厄。「怀胎」译作「the pregnant」，书里没有说是谁的怀胎，按字面。
note.en: 'Embryo' and 'Sunk' are two of the states of the strength cycle of the eight trigrams by season (the table of the strength and weakness of the eight trigrams earlier in this book has 'thriving, strong, embryo, sunk, dead, resting, trapped, abandoned'); here 'the two hexagrams Embryo and Sunk' are the two trigrams that are in the embryo or sunk state in each season: Xun and Li in spring, Kun and Dui in summer, Qian and Kan in autumn, Gen and Zhen in winter. 'A hexagram in the trapped or dead state' is a trigram in those states. 'Illness and calamity' is the pair illness and misfortune. 'The pregnant' translates the word 'carrying an embryo', and the book does not say whose pregnancy, so it is literal.

yi: 胎、没两卦，怀胎的触犯鬼神，
有隐私、逃避、失财的人。
en: Embryo and Sunk: the pregnant offend ghosts and spirits,
there are secrets, flight, a person who loses wealth.

zh: 胎没二卦，春巽离，夏坤兑，秋乾坎，冬艮震。
yi: 胎、没两个卦：春天是巽、离，夏天是坤、兑，秋天是乾、坎，冬天是艮、震。
遇到的，多半是占怀孕和病，
是鬼神作祟，
或者逃走，
或者失财。
凡是囚、死的卦，
一定是占官司、囚禁的事，
并且犯到疾病灾厄和亲戚的丧亡。
en: The two hexagrams Embryo and Sunk: in spring Xun and Li, in summer Kun and Dui, in autumn Qian and Kan, in winter Gen and Zhen.
Those who meet them are mostly divining pregnancy or illness,
with ghosts and spirits afflicting,
or flight,
or loss of wealth.
A hexagram in the trapped or dead state
is surely a divination of lawsuits and imprisonment,
and runs into illness, calamity and the death of relatives.

chapter: 六神门·推占来情休旺吉凶要决章
title: 推占来情·身在财乡欲觅财，亦忧父母及妻灾：财动忧父母、父母动忧子孙、子孙动忧官事、官鬼动忧兄弟、兄弟动忧失财及妻妾；空亡带杀主丧亡

rule.yi: 推占来情的歌说：卦身在财的位置上、想求财，也要担心父母和妻子的灾，变进空亡奴婢会逃，要知道生死，占的是新来的事。自注说：财爻持世，或在别的爻上动，主妻妾有灾、要担心父母；落了空亡又带杀，主有丧亡的事；一串担忧是：财爻动担心父母，父母爻动担心子孙，子孙爻动担心官事，官鬼爻动担心兄弟，兄弟爻动担心失财和妻妾，这是取五行相克的道理。
rule.en: The verses on reading the purpose of the asker say: with the Body at the place of Wealth, wishing to seek wealth, one must also worry for the parents and for the wife's calamity; if it changes into Void, the servants run off; to know life and death, it is a divination of what has newly come. Its own note says: when the Wealth line holds the Self, or moves on another line, it means calamity for wife and concubine and worry for the parents; if it falls Void and carries a killing, it means a death; and the chain of worries is: when the Wealth line moves, worry for the Resource; when the Resource line moves, worry for Output; when the Output line moves, worry for official affairs; when the Pressure line moves, worry for Peer; when the Peer line moves, worry for loss of wealth and for wife and concubine; this takes the sense of control among the five phases.

note.yi: 这一条讲的是六亲发动时要担心谁，没有一个字说「病」，只说「忧」和「灾」；收在疾病域，是因为占病时代人占亲人（儿占父母、夫占妻）要用这套相克去看谁受累，而且歌里有「定知生死」一句。「父母爻动忧子孙」一类的串和 LY.ILL.BSYG.02 的几条自注一致，这里更完整。「忧官事」的「官事」是官司公事，不是官鬼。「奴婢走」是奴婢逃走。「占新来」的「新来」是新近来的事，按字面译。
note.en: This entry is about whom to worry for when a relation line moves, and does not say 'illness' in a single word, only 'worry' and 'calamity'; it is taken in the illness domain because in divining for a relative (a son for a parent, a husband for a wife) this chain of control is used to see who is burdened, and because the song has the phrase 'to know life and death for certain'. The chain 'when the Resource line moves, worry for Output' agrees with the notes of LY.ILL.BSYG.02, and is fuller here. The 'official affairs' of 'worry for official affairs' are lawsuits and public business and not the Pressure line. 'The servants run off' is servants fleeing. The 'newly come' of 'divining what has newly come' is what has recently arrived, and is literal.

yi: 卦身在财的位置上，想求财，
也要担心父母和妻子的灾，
变进空亡，奴婢会逃走，
要确定知道生死，占的是新来的事。
en: With the Body at the place of Wealth, wishing to seek wealth,
one must also worry for the Resource (the parents) and the wife's calamity;
if it changes into Void, the servants run off;
to know life and death for certain, it is a divination of what has newly come.

zh: 财爻持世，或在他爻动，主妻妾灾及忧父母。
兄弟爻动忧失财及妻妾。
yi: 财爻持世，或者在别的爻上动，主妻妾有灾，并要担心父母。
如果落了空亡又带杀，主有丧亡的事。
凡是财爻动，担心父母；
父母爻动，担心子孙；
子孙爻动，担心官事；
官鬼爻动，担心兄弟；
兄弟爻动，担心失财和妻妾。
这是取五行相克的道理。
en: When the Wealth line holds the Self, or moves on another line, it means calamity for wife and concubine and worry for the Resource (the parents).
If it falls Void and carries a killing, it means a death.
When the Wealth line moves, worry for the Resource (the parents);
when the Resource line moves, worry for Output (the children);
when the Output line moves, worry for official affairs;
when the Pressure line moves, worry for Peer (the brothers);
when the Peer line moves, worry for loss of wealth and for wife and concubine.
This takes the sense of control among the five phases.

chapter: 六神门·推占来情休旺吉凶要决章
title: 推占来情·世应日月破并刑，官灾盗贼死亡惊：世应居月破月刑、又来刑本日，定有官司盗贼死亡惊恐；洞林曰世应三刑并杀阴，十死一生

rule.yi: 推占来情的歌说：世、应碰上日、月的破和刑，有官灾、盗贼、死亡、惊恐；如果不是和人争讼的事，就有死亡、盗贼和哭泣的声音。自注说：凡是世、应落在月破、月刑上、又来刑到本日的，一定有官司、盗贼、死亡、惊恐；再看有没有刑杀。《洞林》说，世应三刑又并着杀阴，是十死一生。
rule.en: The verses on reading the purpose of the asker say: when the Self and the Other meet the break and punishment of the Day and Month, there is official calamity, thieves, death and fright; if it is not a matter of quarrelling with others, there are death, thieves and the sound of weeping. Its own note says: whenever the Self and Other sit in the Month-break or Month-punishment and also come to punish the day itself, there are surely lawsuits, thieves, death and fright; then look also for punishment and killing. The Dongling says: when the Self and Other meet the three punishments together with the Yin Killing, it is ten deaths to one life.

note.yi: 这一联讲的是世、应碰到凶的时候会有什么事，死亡只是其中一项，并不专指病；收在疾病域是因为它给了「十死一生」这个最重的断语，而这个断语在占病里最常被引。「洞林曰」引的是《洞林》（书名，书里没有说是哪个人的《洞林》）；「杀阴」大概就是前面（第 437 行自注）按月排的杀阴（正午、二巳、三辰……逐月下），这里书里没有指明。「月刑」是和月建相刑的地支。「亡贼哭泣声」的「亡贼」读作「死亡、盗贼」。「若不人与相争事」的「人与」是别人，书里字序如此，按字面。
note.en: This couplet is about what happens when the Self and Other meet ill omens, and death is only one item among them, not particular to illness; it is taken in the illness domain because it gives the heaviest verdict 'ten deaths to one life', which is most often quoted in divining illness. 'The Dongling says' quotes the Dongling (a book title; the book does not say whose Dongling); the 'Yin Killing' is probably the Yin Killing set by month spoken of earlier (the note at line 437: Wu in the first month, Si in the second, Chen in the third, going down by months), which the book does not specify here. 'Month-punishment' is the branch that punishes the Month branch. The 'death and thieves' of 'the sound of death and thieves and weeping' is read as 'death, thieves'. The 'person with' of 'if it is not a matter of quarrelling with others' is 'others', in the character order of the book, and is literal.

yi: 世、应碰上日破、月破和刑，
有官灾、盗贼、死亡、惊恐；
如果不是和人争讼的事，
就有死亡、盗贼、哭泣的声音。
en: When the Self and Other meet the Day-break, the Month-break and punishment,
there are official calamity, thieves, death and fright;
if it is not a matter of quarrelling with others,
there are death, thieves and the sound of weeping.

zh: 凡世应居月破月刑，来刑本日者，定有官司、盗贼、死亡、惊恐，
yi: 凡是世、应落在月破、月刑上，又来刑到本日的，一定有官司、盗贼、死亡、惊恐，
就是这个缘故。
或者是打官司、喧闹争吵的事，
或者是失财、孝服、悲哭的声音。
还要看有没有刑和杀，
《洞林》上说：
世、应遇三刑、又并着杀阴，
是十死一生。
en: Whenever the Self and Other sit in the Month-break or Month-punishment and also come to punish the day itself, there are surely lawsuits, thieves, death and fright,
for this reason.
or matters of public litigation and noisy dispute,
or loss of wealth, mourning dress, the sound of grief.
Look further for punishment and killing.
The Dongling says:
when the Self and Other meet the three punishments together with the Yin Killing,
it is ten deaths to one life.

chapter: 六神门·推占来情休旺吉凶要决章
title: 推占来情·应来克世人谋己，世动克应己谋人：克害之爻旺相带官鬼官符是公讼；克害之爻休囚带杀、死符，病即主病

rule.yi: 推占来情的歌说：应来克世，是别人谋我；世动克应，是我谋别人；旺相又生着官，会成阻碍；休囚又带着杀、鬼，就是互相侵犯。自注说：彼此相克相害，也要看爻的旺衰；克害的爻旺相、又带官鬼官符，是官司；克害的爻休囚、又带着杀和死符，病就是主病，也就是这件事主的是病。
rule.en: The verses on reading the purpose of the asker say: when the Other comes to control the Self, others are scheming against me; when the Self moves to control the Other, I am scheming against others; if strong and generating officials, it makes obstruction; if resting or trapped and carrying a killing and a ghost, they encroach on each other. Its own note says: where each controls and harms the other, one must also look at whether the line is strong or weak; if the line that controls and harms is thriving and strong and carries Pressure or the Official Tally, it is a lawsuit; if the line that controls and harms is resting or trapped and carries killings and the Death Tally, the illness is the main matter, that is, what it signals is illness.

note.yi: 「病即主病也」读作：克害的爻休囚、又带杀和死符的时候，这件事主的就是病。「旺相与生官作碍」的「官」书里没有说是官鬼还是官司，按字面译成「officials」。「应来克世人谋己」一联前半讲的是应克世、世克应，也是看「谁在谋谁」，后半才讲旺衰带杀，所以收一联四句，没有只取讲病的一句。
note.en: 'The illness is the main matter' is read as: when the line that controls and harms is resting or trapped and carries killings and the Death Tally, what the matter signals is illness. The 'official' of 'if strong and generating officials' is not said in the book to be Pressure or a lawsuit, and is rendered literally as 'officials'. The first half of the couplet 'when the Other comes to control the Self, others scheme against me' is about the Other controlling the Self and the Self controlling the Other, that is, who is scheming against whom, and only the second half about strength and killings, so the four lines of the couplet are taken and not only the line on illness.

yi: 应来克世，是别人谋我，
世动克应，是我谋别人，
旺相、又生着官，会成阻碍，
休囚、又带着杀和鬼，是互相侵犯。
en: when the Other comes to control the Self, others are scheming against me,
when the Self moves to control the Other, I am scheming against others,
if strong and generating officials, it makes obstruction,
if resting or trapped and carrying a killing and a ghost, they encroach on each other.

zh: 所言相克者，即相克相害也。
又彼此相克害，亦当视爻休旺。
如克害旺相，而带官鬼官符者，即公讼也。
如克害之爻休囚，带杀诸死符，病即主病也。
yi: 这里说的相克，就是相克、相害。
又彼此相克相害，也要看爻是休囚还是旺相。
如果克害的是旺相的，又带着官鬼、官符，就是官司。
如果克害的爻休囚，又带着杀和死符，病就是主病了。
en: What is called control here is control and harm.
Where each controls and harms the other, one must also look at whether the line is resting or strong.
If what controls and harms is thriving and strong and carries Pressure or the Official Tally, it is a lawsuit.
If the line that controls and harms is resting or trapped and carries killings and the Death Tally, the illness is the main matter.

title: 占痘疹先察用神旺衰、再究神的动静：用神被生扶拱合则痘长灵根，被克害刑冲则花遭毒雨；用神原神忌神仇神都要分清

rule.yi: 痘、痧、疮、疹是随着六气五行的流转一阵一阵流行的，想问平安还是危险，要凭易卦。先看用神是旺是衰，再考究各爻是动是静：用神被生、扶、拱、合，痘就长得有根；被克、害、刑、冲，花就遭到毒雨。凡占痘痧，一定要先分清用神、原神的衰旺，再考究忌神、仇神的动静。
rule.en: Pox, measles, sores and eruptions come and go with the turning of the six qi and the five phases; to ask whether it will be safe or dangerous one must rely on the hexagram. First look at whether the Subject is strong or weak, then at whether the lines move or are still: if the Subject is generated, supported, embraced or combined, the pox grows a living root; if it is controlled, harmed, punished or clashed, the flowers are struck by poison rain. In all divining of pox and measles one must first tell how strong or weak the Subject and the Support are, then examine how the Adversary and the enemy spirit move or stand still.

note.yi: 这一章是卜筮正宗新增的，不在《黄金策》原书里（卜筮大全和黄金策文件都没有）；赋文和注文的作者，书里没有分别写明，本库把赋文标作本文、把「——」后面的话标作王洪绪注。「痧」这里指跟痘一起流行的出疹的病，书里没有另外解释。「仇神」书里在《原忌仇神论》（卜筮正宗第 971 行）有解释：制克原神、生扶忌神的爻。
note.en: This chapter is an addition of the Bushi Zhengzong and is not in the original Huangjin Ce (neither the Bushi Daquan nor the Huangjin Ce file has it); the book does not say separately who wrote the verse and who the commentary, so the library marks the verse as the base text and what follows the dash as Wang Hongxu's commentary. 'Sha' here means the eruptive illness that spreads along with pox and is not otherwise explained. The 'enemy spirit' (chou shen) is explained in the book's essay on the Support, Adversary and enemy spirit (Bushi Zhengzong, line 971): the line that controls the Support and generates or supports the Adversary.

zh: 六气司天，寒暑灾祥之感应；
五行迭运，痘痧疮疹之流行。
先察用旺衰，次究神动静。
yi: 六气主宰着天时，寒暑灾祥是它的感应；
五行轮流运转，痘、痧、疮、疹因此流行。
要问平安还是危险，必须凭易卦。
先看用神是旺是衰，再考究各神是动是静。
被生、扶、拱、合，痘就长出有灵气的根；
被克、害、刑、冲，花就遭到毒雨。
en: The six qi rule the heavens, and cold and heat, calamity and omen are their response;
the five phases turn in succession, and pox, measles, sores and eruptions spread by them.
To ask whether it is safe or dangerous, one must rely on the hexagram of the Yi.
First look at whether the Subject is strong or weak, then look into whether the spirits move or are still.
Generated, supported, embraced and combined, the pox grows a living root;
controlled, harmed, punished and clashed, the flowers are struck by poison rain.

zh: 凡卜痘痧，必先分别用神原神衰旺，次究忌神仇神动静。
yi: 凡是占痘痧，一定要先分清用神、原神的衰旺，再考究忌神、仇神的动静。
en: In all divining of pox and measles, one must first tell how strong or weak the Subject and the Support are, then examine how the Adversary and the enemy spirit move or stand still.

title: 出花的是谁就按谁取用神：兄弟出花以兄弟爻为用神、父母爻为原神；子侄以子孙爻为用神、父动克子是凶；妻奴婢妾以财爻为用神、兄动克财不宜

rule.yi: 看是谁出花来取用神：兄弟出花，拿兄弟爻做用神、父母爻做原神，父母爻发动来生它就吉；子侄出花，拿子孙爻做用神，父母爻发动就克制子孙，是凶，而兄弟爻发动对子侄反而是好的；妻子、奴婢、妾出花，拿财爻做用神，兄弟爻发动克制财爻，也不合适。
rule.en: The Subject is taken by who is having the pox. For a brother, the Peer line is the Subject and the Resource line the Support, and if the Support moves and generates it, it is lucky. For a child or nephew, the Output line is the Subject, and if Resource moves it controls Output, which is unlucky, while a moving Peer is welcome; for a wife, servant, maid or concubine, the Wealth line is the Subject, and a moving Peer controls Wealth, which is likewise unsuitable.

dispute.yi: 用神取哪一爻：王洪绪按出花的是谁分开取，兄弟取兄弟爻、子侄取子孙爻、妻奴婢妾取财爻，官鬼爻则是痘花本身；增删卜易的野鹤把出花的几件事分开占，问什么时候出花拿鬼爻当用神（LY.ILL.ZS.19），问吉凶大体上全看子孙爻，不管来问的是谁（LY.ILL.ZS.21）。两家取用神的办法不一样，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Which line is the Subject: Wang Hongxu takes it by who has the pox — the Peer line for a brother, the Output line for a child or nephew, the Wealth line for a wife, servant, maid or concubine — and the Pressure line is the pox flowers themselves; the Old Man of Yehe in the Zengshan Buyi divides the matters of the pox into separate divinations, taking the Pressure line as the Subject for when the pox will come out (LY.ILL.ZS.19) and looking, on the whole, only at the Output line for fortune, whoever is asking (LY.ILL.ZS.21). The two differ on how the Subject is taken, and the books do not decide.

note.yi: 经文说的是「父动则护持乎兄弟」：父母爻发动，护着兄弟（生兄弟），这对占兄弟出花是好事，但父母爻克子孙，所以对儿孙不合适；兄弟发动克财，所以妻奴受难，而子孙不怕兄弟。
note.en: The verse says 'if Resource moves it protects the Peer': a moving Resource line generates Peer, which is good for a divination about a brother, but Resource controls Output, so it is unsuitable for children and grandchildren; a moving Peer controls Wealth, so wives and servants suffer, while Output has nothing to fear from Peer.

zh: 父动则护持乎兄弟，儿孙安得云宜；
兄兴则为难于妻奴，子侄喜其相遇。
yi: 父母爻发动，就护着兄弟，那么儿孙怎么能说合适呢；
兄弟爻兴旺，就为难妻子、奴婢，而子侄却喜欢碰到它。
en: If Resource moves, it protects and sustains the Peer, so how can it be called suitable for children and grandchildren;
if Peer rises, it makes trouble for wives and servants, while children and nephews are glad to meet it.

zh: 如卜兄弟出花，以兄弟爻为用神，父母爻为原神，动而生之则吉。
倘卜子侄，以子孙爻为用神，父动则克子是凶。
如卜妻奴婢妾，以财爻为用神，兄动则克财，亦不宜也。
凡卜子侄喜遇兄弟动也。
yi: 比如占兄弟出花，拿兄弟爻做用神，父母爻做原神，父母爻发动来生它，就吉。
如果占子侄，拿子孙爻做用神，父母爻发动就克制子孙，是凶。
如果占妻子、奴婢、妾，拿财爻做用神，兄弟爻发动就克制财爻，也不合适。
凡是占子侄，喜欢遇到兄弟爻发动。
en: For example, in divining a brother's pox, the Peer line is the Subject and the Resource line is the Support; if it moves and generates it, it is lucky.
If divining a child or nephew, the Output line is the Subject, and if Resource moves it controls Output, which is unlucky.
If divining a wife, servant, maid or concubine, the Wealth line is the Subject, and if Peer moves it controls Wealth, which is likewise unsuitable.
In all divining of a child or nephew, a moving Peer is welcome.

title: 最吉者官安用旺、最凶者鬼旺忌兴：官鬼为痘花，不宜伤损也不宜动；遇刑冲克害伏藏是险逆之症，用神旺相而官鬼安静得生扶拱合是顺症

rule.yi: 最吉的是官爻安静、用神旺相，最凶的是鬼爻旺相、忌神兴旺发动。官鬼就是痘花，不适合受到伤损，也不适合发动，动了恐怕会变坏；如果遇到刑、冲、克、害、伏藏这些象，是凶险不顺的症候，即使勉强出得起来，也难以善终；用神旺相、官鬼安静又得到生、扶、拱、合的，是顺症，不用忧虑。
rule.en: Most auspicious is Pressure at rest and the Subject strong; most ominous is Pressure strong and the Adversary rising. The Pressure line is the pox flowers themselves: it should not be harmed and should not move, for if it moves it may turn bad; if it meets punishment, clash, control, harm or hiding, it is a dangerous and adverse condition, and even if it barely erupts it is hard to bring to a good end; if the Subject is strong and the Pressure line is at rest and is generated, supported, embraced or combined, it is a favourable condition and there is nothing to fear.

note.yi: 经文的「官安用旺」「鬼旺忌兴」里，「官」「鬼」都是官鬼爻，「用」是用神，「忌」是忌神。「起发」是痘起出来、长起来，「收成」「收功」是痘出完、结好了。
note.en: In the verse's 'Pressure at rest and the Subject strong' and 'Pressure strong and the Adversary rising', 'guan' and 'gui' both mean the Pressure line, 'yong' the Subject and 'ji' the Adversary. 'Erupt' (qifa) is for the pox to come out and grow, and 'completion' (shoucheng, shougong) for the pox to run its course and heal.

zh: 最吉者官安用旺，最凶者鬼旺忌兴
yi: 最吉的是官爻安静、用神旺相，最凶的是鬼爻旺相、忌神兴旺发动。
en: Most auspicious is Pressure at rest and the Subject strong; most ominous is Pressure strong and the Adversary rising.

zh: 官鬼为痘花，不宜伤损，亦不宜动，动恐变坏；
如遇刑冲克害伏藏等象，是险逆之症也。
用神旺相，官鬼安静而得生扶拱合者，是顺症而无忧虑也。
yi: 官鬼就是痘花，不适合受到伤损，也不适合发动，动了恐怕会变坏；
如果遇到刑、冲、克、害、伏藏这些象，是凶险不顺的症候。
即使勉强出得起来，也难以善终。
用神旺相，官鬼安静又得到生、扶、拱、合的，是顺症，不用忧虑。
en: The Pressure line is the pox flowers; it should not be harmed, nor should it move, for if it moves it may turn bad;
if it meets punishment, clash, control, harm or hiding, it is a dangerous and adverse condition.
Even if it barely erupts, it is hard to bring to a good end.
If the Subject is strong and the Pressure line is at rest and is generated, supported, embraced or combined, it is a favourable condition and there is nothing to fear.

title: 用得长生百年之内保无虑：用神在日辰上长生、或变出长生，一生都无忧，眼下痘疹更不必虑

rule.yi: 用神在日辰上得长生，或者变出长生，即使一百年之内也没有忧虑，眼下的痘疹又何必担心。
rule.en: If the Subject is born at the Day, or changes into Birth, then even within a hundred years there is nothing to worry about, so why worry now about the pox.

note.yi: 「百年之内」是说一辈子，不是真的一百年。经文只说「用」，注写作「用神」。
note.en: 'Within a hundred years' means a whole lifetime, not literally a hundred years. The verse says only 'yong'; the commentary writes it out as the Subject.

zh: 用得长生，百年之内保无虑
yi: 用神得到长生，一百年之内都保证没有忧虑
en: If the Subject gains Birth, it is guaranteed there is no worry for a hundred years

zh: 用神长生于日辰或化长生者，虽百年之内无忧，目下何必虑之。
yi: 用神在日辰上长生，或者变出长生的，即使一百年之内也没有忧虑，眼下又何必担心呢。
en: If the Subject is born at the Day, or changes into Birth, then even within a hundred years there is nothing to worry about, so why worry now.

title: 原临死绝一月之外终有害：用神休囚受伤克又遇原神居死绝，旦夕难延；用神旺相而原神静逢死绝或动化伤克，眼下当令有效，出月退气仍有不测之害

rule.yi: 原神落在死、绝的地方，一个月之外终究有害处：用神休囚又受伤克，再遇上原神落在死、绝之处，一朝一夕都难拖延；用神出现又旺相，而原神安静地遇到死、绝，或者发动却变出伤克的，眼下当令虽然看得到收功，出了这个月、退了气，仍然有想不到的祸害。
rule.en: A Support that falls on Death or Extinction brings harm in the end after a month: if the Subject is resting or trapped and is also harmed and controlled, and the Support meets a place of Death or Extinction, it can hardly last from morning to evening; if the Subject is present and strong but the Support is still and meets Death or Extinction, or moves and changes into harm or control, then for now, in season, one may see it come to completion, but once the month is out and its force retreats there is still an unforeseen harm.

note.yi: 注里最后有「也也」两个字连着，是原文重复，译文按一个「也」。「得令」是当令、正在旺的月份里。
note.en: The commentary's last words have two 'ye' in a row, a repetition in the text, rendered as one. 'In season' (deling) means in the month when the line is in force.

zh: 原临死绝，一月之外终有害
yi: 原神落在死、绝上，一个月之外终究有害
en: A Support that falls on Death or Extinction will in the end bring harm after a month

zh: 如用神休囚再受伤克，又遇原神居于死绝之处，旦夕难延；
若用神出现旺相，而原神静逢死绝，或动化伤克者，目下得令虽见收功，出月退气仍有不测之害也也。
yi: 如果用神休囚，又受到伤克，再遇上原神落在死、绝的地方，一朝一夕都难以拖延；
如果用神出现又旺相，而原神安静地遇到死、绝，或者发动却变出伤克的，眼下当令虽然看得到收功，出了这个月气退了，仍然有想不到的祸害。
en: If the Subject is resting or trapped and is also harmed and controlled, and the Support meets a place of Death or Extinction, it can hardly last from morning to evening;

if the Subject is present and strong, but the Support is still and meets Death or Extinction, or moves and changes into harm or control, then for now, in season, one may see it come to completion, but once the month is out and its force retreats there is still an unforeseen harm.

title: 官强而痘难开朗、福旺则花必稀疏：官鬼为痘症宜静不宜动，静而衰痘稀、旺而动痘密；父母为痘花之主亦宜安静有气；福旺官衰则痘花稀朗好收功

rule.yi: 官爻强，痘就难以开朗；福神旺，花一定稀疏。官鬼爻是痘症本身，适合安静、不适合发动，动了就有变化；安静而衰的痘稀，旺而发动的痘密。父母爻是痘花的主，也适合安静有气，最忌讳发动后变出伤克。如果福神旺、官鬼衰，痘花一定稀疏明朗，一定能好好收功。
rule.en: If Pressure is strong the pox will hardly open up clear; if Output is strong the flowers will surely be sparse. The Pressure line is the pox itself; it should be at rest and not move, for if it moves there is change: at rest and weak the pox is sparse, strong and moving the pox is dense. The Resource line is the master of the pox flowers and should likewise be at rest and have force, and most dreaded is moving and changing into harm or control. If Output is strong and Pressure weak, the pox flowers are sure to be sparse and clear, and will surely come to a good completion.

note.yi: 「父神」注里没有解释，按上下文是父母爻（它生官鬼，所以说是痘花之主）。增删卜易的野鹤也说鬼爻旺相、临日月又有生扶花必稠密，空破休囚墓绝痘疏朗（LY.ILL.ZS.20），和这里「静而衰者痘稀，旺而动者痘密」一致；这里多了福神旺则花稀的一层。
note.en: 'Fu shen' is not explained in the commentary and by context is the Resource line (it generates Pressure, hence the master of the pox flowers). The Old Man of Yehe in the Zengshan Buyi also says that a strong Pressure line on the Day or Month with support brings dense flowers, and Void, broken, resting, trapped, entombed or extinct brings sparse pox (LY.ILL.ZS.20), which agrees with 'at rest and weak, sparse; strong and moving, dense' here; this adds the further point that strong Output makes the flowers sparse.

zh: 官强而痘难开朗，福旺则花必稀疏
yi: 官爻强，痘就难以开朗；福神旺，花一定稀疏
en: If Pressure is strong the pox will hardly open up clear; if Output is strong the flowers will surely be sparse

zh: 官鬼爻为痘症，宜静不宜动，动则有变。
静而衰者痘稀，旺而动者痘密。
父神为痘花之主，亦宜安静有气，最忌动化伤克；
若得福旺官衰，痘花定然稀朗，必好收功也。
yi: 官鬼爻是痘症，适合安静、不适合发动，动了就有变化。
安静而衰的痘稀，旺而发动的痘密。
父母爻是痘花的主，也适合安静有气，最忌讳发动后变出伤克；
如果福神旺、官爻衰，痘花一定稀疏明朗，一定能好好收功。
en: The Pressure line is the pox itself; it should be at rest and not move, and if it moves there is change.
If at rest and weak, the pox is sparse; if strong and moving, the pox is dense.
The Resource line is the master of the pox flowers and should also be at rest with force, and most dreaded is moving and changing into harm or control;
if Output is strong and Pressure weak, the pox flowers are sure to be sparse and clear, and will surely come to a good completion.

title: 墓库不宜临用：用神入墓库，痘初难起发，后来病人神志昏倦，难收功

rule.yi: 用神不适合落在墓库上：痘喜欢起发，发出来以后又喜欢人神志清楚；用神入了墓库，一开始难以起发，后来病人一定神志昏沉疲倦，主难以收功。
rule.en: The Subject should not sit in a tomb or storehouse: the pox likes to erupt, and once erupted likes the patient to be clear in spirit; if the Subject enters a tomb, at first it is hard for it to erupt, and later the patient is surely dull and drowsy in spirit, which means it is hard to bring to completion.

yi: 用神不适合落在墓库上
en: The Subject should not sit in a tomb or storehouse

zh: 痘喜起发，既发又喜神清，若用神入墓库，初难起发，后必神思昏倦，主难收功也。
yi: 痘喜欢起发，发出来以后又喜欢人神志清楚；如果用神入了墓库，开始就难起发，后来一定神志昏沉疲倦，主难以收功。
en: The pox likes to erupt, and once erupted it likes the patient to be clear in spirit; if the Subject enters a tomb, at first it is hard for it to erupt, and later the patient will surely be dull and drowsy, which means it is hard to bring to completion.

title: 休囚岂可持身：出花的人要体旺才易收功，用神休囚必是体弱，再无原神日月生扶，后来也有变

rule.yi: 出花的人要身体强旺才容易收功；用神休囚，一定是身体虚弱，再没有原神、日、月来生扶的，后来也会有变化。
rule.en: A person having the pox should be of strong body, and then it is easy to bring to completion; if the Subject is resting or trapped, the body is surely weak, and if in addition no Support, Day or Month generates or supports it, there will be change later on.

note.yi: 经文只有「休囚岂可持身」六个字，没有说是谁休囚；注把它解成用神休囚。
note.en: The verse is only the six characters 'how can resting or trapped hold the body' and does not say what is resting or trapped; the commentary takes it as the Subject.

yi: 休囚的爻，怎么可以持身呢
en: How can a resting or trapped line hold up the body

zh: 出花之人宜于体旺，则易收功，如用神休囚，必是体弱，再无原神日月生扶者，后亦有变。
yi: 出花的人适合身体强旺，这样就容易收功；如果用神休囚，一定是身体虚弱，再没有原神、日、月来生扶的，后来也会有变化。
en: A person having the pox should be of strong body, and then it is easy to bring to completion; if the Subject is resting or trapped, the body is surely weak, and if in addition no Support, Day or Month generates or supports it, there will be change later on.

title: 卦现官多防贼痘为害：官鬼不宜多，鬼多则痘分粗细，无子孙出现时痘密中恐夹有毒痘，名贼痘，不去则害一身痘

rule.yi: 卦里官爻出现得多，要防备贼痘为害：官鬼不适合多，鬼多的话痘就分粗和细；如果没有子孙出现，恐怕在密密的痘当中夹着有毒的痘，名叫贼痘，如果不把它除去，就会害了满身的痘。
rule.en: If many Pressure lines appear in the hexagram, guard against the harm of thief pox: there should not be many Pressure lines, and with many the pox divide into coarse and fine; if no Output appears, there may be poisonous pox among the dense ones, called thief pox, and if it is not removed it will spoil the pox over the whole body.

note.yi: 注里没有说怎样「去」贼痘，只说不去会害一身痘。「贼痘」是这一章自己的名目，书里其他地方没有再讲。
note.en: The commentary does not say how to remove a thief pox, only that if it is not removed it spoils the pox over the whole body. 'Thief pox' is this chapter's own term and the book does not treat it elsewhere.

zh: 卦现官多，防贼痘之为害
yi: 卦里官爻出现得多，要防备贼痘为害
en: If many Pressure lines appear in the hexagram, guard against the harm of thief pox

zh: 官鬼不宜多，鬼多则痘分粗细，如无子孙出现，恐痘密之中间有毒痘，其名曰贼痘，如不去之，则害一身痘矣。
yi: 官鬼不适合多，鬼多的话痘就分粗细；如果没有子孙出现，恐怕在密密的痘当中夹着有毒的痘，名叫贼痘，如果不把它除去，就会害了满身的痘。
en: There should not be many Pressure lines; with many, the pox divide into coarse and fine; if no Output appears, there may be poisonous pox among the dense ones, called thief pox, and if it is not removed it will spoil the pox over the whole body.

title: 爻临福众虑进补以招殃：子孙爻不宜多现，只要旺相有气；多现则不宜用补药、食补物，用补反有害

rule.yi: 卦里福神多，要担心进补反而招来祸殃：子孙爻不适合出现得多，只要旺相有气就行；如果出现得多，就不适合用补药、吃补的东西，用了补，反而恐怕有害。
rule.en: If many Output lines appear, beware that taking tonics may invite calamity: Output lines should not appear in numbers, and it is enough that one is strong and has force; if many appear, it is not suitable to use tonic medicines or eat tonic foods, and if tonics are used they may do harm instead.

zh: 爻临福众，虑进补以招殃
yi: 卦里福神多，要担心进补反而招来祸殃
en: If many Output lines appear, beware that taking tonics may invite calamity

zh: 子孙之爻不宜多现，只要旺相有气，如多现不宜用补药食补物，若用补反恐有害也。
yi: 子孙爻不适合出现得多，只要旺相有气就行；如果出现得多，就不适合用补药、吃补的东西，如果用补，反而恐怕有害。
en: Output lines should not appear in numbers; it is enough that one is strong and has force; if many appear, it is not suitable to use tonic medicines or eat tonic foods, and if tonics are used they may do harm instead.

title: 乱动皆非吉、伏吟亦是凶：各种卦都怕乱动，占卜都怕伏吟，痘花更不例外

rule.yi: 卦里乱动都不吉利，伏吟也是凶：各种卦都怕乱动，何况是痘花；凡是占卜都怕伏吟，难道只有痘症才怕吗。
rule.en: Lines moving in disorder are all inauspicious, and Hidden Chant is also ominous: every hexagram fears lines moving in disorder, let alone the pox flowers; all divining fears Hidden Chant, is it only so for pox?

note.yi: 这一条的注是两句反问，没有给新的判据，只是说明：乱动和伏吟是各种占都忌的，痘疹并不例外。
note.en: The commentary here is two rhetorical questions and gives no new criterion; it says only that disorderly movement and Hidden Chant are dreaded in every kind of divination and the pox is no exception.

zh: 乱动皆非吉，伏吟亦是凶
yi: 乱动都不吉，伏吟也是凶
en: Lines moving in disorder are all inauspicious, and Hidden Chant is also ominous

zh: 诸卦皆怕乱动，何况于痘花？
凡占皆畏伏吟，岂独痘症乎？
yi: 各种卦都怕乱动，何况是痘花？
凡是占卜都怕伏吟，难道只有痘症才怕吗？
en: Every hexagram fears lines moving in disorder, let alone the pox flowers.
In all divining Hidden Chant is feared; is it only so for pox?

title: 子孙发动当勿药而自痊、父母交重纵延医而难治：子孙发动而不遇日月动变伤克，用药立效，喻之不药也能好

rule.yi: 子孙发动，应当不用吃药自己就好；父母爻交重（发动），即使请医生也难以治好。具体说，子孙发动、没有遇到日、月、动爻、变爻的伤克，如果占用药，应当许他立刻见效，所以用「不吃药也能好」来比喻。
rule.en: If Output moves, one recovers of oneself without medicine; if Resource moves, then even calling a doctor it is hard to cure. Specifically, if Output moves and meets no harm or control from the Day, Month, moving or changed lines, then if one divines about taking medicine one may promise that it will take effect at once, so it is put as 'it can be cured without medicine'.

note.yi: 这一条对痘疹讲的「子孙发动」和增删卜易讲的「子孙持世发动服之立可解忧」（LY.ILL.ZS.37）、「子孙制鬼最喜旺相生扶」（LY.ILL.ZS.30）是同一个看法；「父母交重」难治，和增删卜易的「父爻持世妙药难调」（LY.ILL.ZS.32）也一致。「交重」就是发动。
note.en: What is said here of a moving Output line agrees with the Zengshan Buyi's 'Output on the Self position or moving, taking it gives immediate relief' (LY.ILL.ZS.37) and 'Output controlling Pressure most wants to be strong and supported' (LY.ILL.ZS.30); that a moving Resource line is hard to cure also agrees with the Zengshan Buyi's 'Resource holding Self: even wonderful medicine is hard to mix' (LY.ILL.ZS.32). 'Jiaozhong' simply means moving.

zh: 子孙发动，当勿药而自痊；
父母交重，纵延医而难治
yi: 子孙发动，应当不用吃药自己就好；
父母爻交重，即使请医生也难以治好
en: If Output moves, one recovers of oneself without medicine;
if Resource moves, then even calling a doctor it is hard to cure

zh: 如子孙发动，不遇日月动变伤克者，倘卜用药，当许立效，故喻之不药而能愈也。
yi: 如果子孙发动，没有遇到日、月、动爻、变爻的伤克，如果占用药，应当许他立刻见效，所以用「不吃药也能好」来比喻。
en: If Output moves and meets no harm or control from the Day, Month, moving or changed lines, then if one divines about taking medicine one may promise that it will take effect at once, so it is put as 'it can be cured without medicine'.

title: 财动卦中宜调脾胃：财爻主饮食，宜旺不宜空（空则不思饮食），宜静不宜动（动则生助官鬼）；恐多食伤脾胃，须调养

rule.yi: 财爻在卦中发动，适合调理脾胃：财爻代表饮食，适合旺、不适合空，空了就不想吃东西；适合安静、不适合发动，发动了就生助官鬼，恐怕因为吃得太多而伤了脾胃，所以要调养。
rule.en: If Wealth moves in the hexagram, it is right to regulate the spleen and stomach: Wealth stands for food and drink; it should be strong and not Void, for if Void the patient has no wish to eat; it should be at rest and not move, for if it moves it generates and helps Pressure, and for fear that eating too much will harm the spleen and stomach, it must be regulated and nourished.

yi: 财爻在卦中发动，适合调理脾胃
en: If Wealth moves in the hexagram, it is right to regulate the spleen and stomach

zh: 财为饮食，宜旺不宜空，空则不思饮食；
宜静不宜动，动则生助官鬼。
恐因多食而伤脾胃，故须调养。
yi: 财爻代表饮食，适合旺、不适合空，空了就不想吃东西；
适合安静、不适合发动，发动了就生助官鬼。
恐怕因为吃得太多而伤了脾胃，所以要调养。
en: Wealth stands for food and drink; it should be strong and not Void, for if Void the patient has no wish to eat;
it should be at rest and not move, for if it moves it generates and helps Pressure.
For fear that eating too much will harm the spleen and stomach, it must be regulated and nourished.

title: 兄兴象内须理胸怀：兄弟爻发动克财爻，主饮食少进或乏调理；在间爻宜宽胸理气，临朱雀必因生气而不思饮食

rule.yi: 兄弟爻在卦里兴起，要调理胸怀：财是用来调理的东西，兄是防气的神；如果遇到兄弟爻发动，就伤克财爻，主吃得少，或者缺少调理；如果落在间爻，适合宽胸理气；如果带朱雀，一定是生了气而不想吃东西。
rule.en: If Peer rises in the hexagram, the chest and mind must be regulated: Wealth is the thing for regulation and Peer is the spirit that guards against breath and temper; if the Peer line moves, it harms and controls the Wealth line, which means little food is taken or regulation is lacking; if it is on a between line, ease the chest and regulate the qi; if it carries the Vermilion Bird, the patient is surely angry and does not want to eat.

note.yi: 「兄为气防之神」注里没有再解释，按字面译作防气的神（兄弟克财，所以由它管吃与不吃的火气）。
note.en: 'Peer is the spirit that guards against breath' is not explained further in the commentary and is rendered literally (Peer controls Wealth, so it governs the temper that bears on eating and not eating).

yi: 兄弟爻在卦里兴起，要调理胸怀
en: If Peer rises in the hexagram, the chest and mind must be regulated

zh: 财为调理之物，兄为气防之神，如遇兄弟爻发动，则伤克财爻，主饮食少进或乏于调理。
如临朱雀，必感怒而不思饮食。
yi: 财是用来调理的东西，兄是防气的神，如果遇到兄弟爻发动，就伤克财爻，主吃得少，或者缺少调理。
如果落在间爻，适合宽胸理气；
如果带朱雀，一定是生了气而不想吃东西。
en: Wealth is the thing for regulation and Peer is the spirit that guards against breath and temper; if the Peer line moves, it harms and controls the Wealth line, which means little food is taken or regulation is lacking.
If it is on a between line, ease the chest and regulate the qi;
if it carries the Vermilion Bird, the patient is surely angry and does not want to eat.

title: 食口腹而增忧多为帮官伤世：财爻动生官鬼，又见官鬼动克世身主象，必因贪口腹增病，或未出痘前已停食

rule.yi: 贪吃口腹反而增加忧患，多半是帮了官爻、伤了世爻：财爻发动就生官鬼；如果卦中又见官鬼发动而克世爻、卦身、主象的，一定是因为贪吃而使病加重，或者没出痘之前就已经停食了。
