rule.en: Indulging the mouth and belly adds to the trouble, mostly because it helps Pressure and harms the Self: when the Wealth line moves it generates Pressure; if in the hexagram Pressure also moves and controls the Self, the Body or the main image, it is surely because of indulging the mouth and belly that the illness has grown worse, or the patient had already stopped eating before the pox came out.

note.yi: 注里的「世身主象」是三样东西：世爻、卦身、主象（主象就是用神所代表的那一象）。
note.en: The 'Self, Body and main image' of the commentary are three things: the Self line, the hexagram Body and the main image (the image that the Subject stands for).

zh: 食口腹而增忧，多为帮官伤世
yi: 贪吃口腹反而增加忧患，多半是帮了官爻、伤了世爻
en: Indulging the mouth and belly adds to the trouble, mostly because it helps Pressure and harms the Self

zh: 财爻发动则生官鬼，若卦中又见官鬼发动而克世身主象者，必因贪口腹以致增病，或未出痘之前已停食也。
yi: 财爻发动就生官鬼；如果卦中又见官鬼发动而克世爻、卦身、主象的，一定是因为贪吃而使病加重，或者没出痘之前就已经停食了。
en: When the Wealth line moves it generates Pressure; if in the hexagram Pressure also moves and controls the Self, the Body or the main image, it is surely because of indulging the mouth and belly that the illness has grown worse, or the patient had already stopped eating before the pox came out.

title: 爱滋味而进食定因助福生身：兄弟克财则不思饮食，子孙也动而生世身用象，叫助福生世，出痘的人起初不思食，因爱一味引开胃口才能进食

rule.yi: 爱某种味道才肯吃东西，一定是因为帮了福神、生了世身：兄弟爻本来克财，一发动就不想吃东西；如果子孙也发动，动来生世爻、卦身、用神的象，叫做助福生世，主出痘的人起初不想吃，因为爱吃某一种味道，把胃口引开了，才吃得下东西。
rule.en: Eating because one loves a certain flavour is surely because it helps Output and generates the Self and the Body: Peer by nature controls Wealth, and when it moves the patient has no wish to eat; if Output also moves and moves to generate the Self, the Body or the image of the Subject, this is called helping Output to generate the Self, and it means the person with the pox at first has no wish to eat, but because he loves one flavour his appetite is drawn open and only then can he take food.

zh: 爱滋味而进食，定因助福生身
yi: 爱某种味道才肯吃东西，一定是因为帮了福神、生了世身
en: Eating because one loves a certain flavour is surely because it helps Output and generates the Self and the Body

zh: 兄弟本是克财，动则不思饮食，若得子孙亦动，动来生世身用象者，谓之助福生世，主出痘之人初不思食，因爱一味引开胃口，始能进食也。
yi: 兄弟本来克财，发动了就不想吃东西；如果子孙也发动，动来生世爻、卦身、用神的象，叫做助福生世，主出痘的人起初不想吃，因为爱吃某一种味道，把胃口引开了，才吃得下东西。
en: Peer by nature controls Wealth, and when it moves the patient has no wish to eat; if Output also moves, and moves to generate the Self, the Body or the image of the Subject, this is called helping Output to generate the Self, and it means the person with the pox at first has no wish to eat, but because he loves one flavour his appetite is drawn open and only then can he take food.

title: 卦遇六冲难起发、爻逢六合好收功：占近病喜六冲（冲散灾殃），占痘症不然，花逢冲则败，如风雨侵花；六合卦或用神逢生合则易起发、好收功

rule.yi: 卦遇到六冲，痘难起发；爻逢到六合，痘好收功。占近病，喜欢遇到六冲，叫做冲散灾殃；只有占痘症不是这样，叫做花遇到冲就败，好比风雨侵袭花朵，开始难起发，后来也不能收功。如果遇到六合卦，或者用神逢到生、合，就容易起发，一定能好好收功。
rule.en: A hexagram meeting Six-Clash makes the pox hard to erupt; lines meeting Six-Combine bring a good completion. In divining a recent illness one is glad to meet Six-Clash, which is called clashing the calamity apart; only in divining pox is it not so, for it is said that a flower meeting a clash is ruined, like wind and rain attacking flowers: at first it hardly erupts, and later it does not come to completion. If it meets a Six-Combine hexagram, or the Subject meets generation or combination, it erupts easily and will surely come to a good completion.

note.yi: 注里「犹如妨雨侵花」的「妨雨」，按上下文应是「风雨」的误字，译作风雨；书里没有说明。增删卜易也说见花问吉凶忌六冲（LY.ILL.ZS.19），和这里一致；至于占近病遇六冲的好处，见增删卜易 LY.ILL.ZS.02。
note.en: In the commentary's 'like fang rain attacking flowers', 'fang rain' is by context a mis-written 'wind and rain' and is rendered so; the book does not say. The Zengshan Buyi also says that in asking the fortune of a pox already out a Six-Clash is to be avoided (LY.ILL.ZS.19), which agrees; for the benefit of a Six-Clash in a recent illness see LY.ILL.ZS.02 in the Zengshan Buyi.

zh: 卦遇六冲难起发，爻逢六合好收功
yi: 卦遇到六冲难起发，爻逢到六合好收功
en: A hexagram meeting Six-Clash hardly erupts; lines meeting Six-Combine come to a good completion

zh: 凡卜近病喜遇六冲，谓之冲散灾殃，唯卜痘症则不然，谓之花逢冲则败，犹如妨雨侵花，初难起发，后不收功。
如遇六合卦，或用神逢生合，则易起发定然，必好收功也。
yi: 凡是占近病喜欢遇到六冲，叫做冲散灾殃，只有占痘症不是这样，叫做花遇到冲就败，好比风雨侵袭花朵，开始难起发，后来不能收功。
如果遇到六合卦，或者用神逢到生、合，就容易起发，一定能好好收功。
en: In divining a recent illness one is glad to meet Six-Clash, which is called clashing the calamity apart; only in divining pox is it not so, for it is said that a flower meeting a clash is ruined, like wind and rain attacking flowers: at first it hardly erupts, and later it does not come to completion.
If it meets a Six-Combine hexagram, or the Subject meets generation or combination, it erupts easily and will surely come to a good completion.

title: 闷而不发皆缘用伏加伤、发而不浆只为官空增制：用神出现不受伤克大吉；用神伏藏又受伤克难过四五朝；官爻旬空月破又遇日辰动爻克害，七八朝内恐不上浆

rule.yi: 痘闷着发不出来，都是因为用神伏藏又受了伤；发出来却不灌浆，只是因为官爻落空又加受制。用神出现、没有遇到日月动爻的刑冲克害，是大吉的兆头；用神伏藏、又受日月动爻的刑冲克害，要提防这个痘，很难过四五天，这是屡次应验的；官爻旬空、月破，又遇日辰动爻的克害，痘虽然起发了，七八天之内恐怕不能灌浆，难以收功。
rule.en: The pox stifled and unable to erupt is all because the Subject is hidden and further harmed; erupted but not filling with fluid is only because Pressure is Void and further controlled. If the Subject appears and meets no punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, it is a very auspicious sign; if the Subject is hidden and is struck by punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, one must guard against this pox, and it is hard to get past four or five days, as has been proved again and again; if the Pressure line is Void or in Month-break and further meets control or harm from the Day or a moving line, then although the pox may erupt, within seven or eight days it may not fill with fluid, and it is hard to bring to completion.

note.yi: 「朝」是天，「四五朝」是四五天。「浆」「灌浆」是痘里长满浆水，是痘的一个阶段。注说「必是防痘」，意思含糊，按字面译作要提防这个痘。
note.en: 'Zhao' is a day, so 'four or five zhao' is four or five days. 'Fluid' (jiang) and 'filling with fluid' are the pox becoming full of fluid, a stage of the pox. The commentary's 'surely fang dou' is ambiguous and is rendered literally as guarding against this pox.

zh: 闷而不发，皆缘用伏加伤；
发而不浆，只为官空增制
yi: 闷着发不出来，都是因为用神伏藏又受了伤；
发出来却不灌浆，只是因为官爻落空又加受制
en: Stifled and unable to erupt, all is because the Subject is hidden and further harmed;
erupted but not filling with fluid, only because Pressure is Void and further controlled

zh: 用神出现，不遇日月动爻刑冲克害，是大吉之兆；
如用神伏藏，再受日月动爻刑冲克害者，必是防痘，难过四五朝者屡验。
如官爻旬空月破，又遇日辰动爻克害者，痘虽起发，在七八朝之内恐不上浆，难于收功也。
yi: 用神出现，没有遇到日、月、动爻的刑、冲、克、害，是大吉的兆头；
如果用神伏藏，又受到日、月、动爻的刑、冲、克、害，一定要提防这个痘，很难过四五天，这是屡次应验的。
如果官爻旬空、月破，又遇到日辰、动爻的克害，痘虽然起发了，七八天之内恐怕不能灌浆，难以收功。
要仔细推敲。
en: If the Subject appears and meets no punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, it is a very auspicious sign;

if the Subject is hidden and is further struck by punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, one must surely guard against this pox, and it is hard to get past four or five days, as has been proved again and again.

If the Pressure line is Void or in Month-break, and further meets control or harm from the Day or a moving line, then although the pox may erupt, within seven or eight days it may not fill with fluid, and it is hard to bring to completion.
It must be worked out carefully.

title: 原神若坏纵用现不祥、主象受伤得救护无碍：原神旬空或伏藏受伤、真空真破、化回头克，用神无根不吉；主象受伤而原神临月建日辰动爻救护，痘虽险可断不妨

rule.yi: 原神如果坏了，即使用神出现也不吉祥；主象受了伤，得到救护就没有妨碍。原神就是生用神的爻：原神旬空，或者伏藏又受伤克，主症状虚、身体弱，不补就不能起发，起发了也没有力气灌浆；原神遇到真空、真破，或者伏藏又受伤太过，或者变出回头克伤它，叫做原神受伤，用神没有根，怎么能得到生，不是吉祥的兆头。如果主象遇到伤克，而原神带着月建、日辰、动爻来救护，痘症虽然凶险，可以断定没有妨碍。
rule.en: If the Support is spoiled, then even if the Subject appears it is inauspicious; if the main image is wounded but gains rescue and protection, there is no obstruction. The Support is the line that generates the Subject: if it is Void, or hidden and struck by harm or control, the condition is one of emptiness and the body weak, so that without tonics it cannot erupt and once erupted has no strength to fill with fluid; if the Support meets true Void or true breaking, or is hidden and too badly wounded, or changes into a returning control that wounds it, this is called the Support wounded, the Subject has no root, and how can it be born? It is not an auspicious sign. If the main image meets harm or control but the Support, backed by the Month, the Day or a moving line, comes to rescue and protect it, then although the pox is dangerous, it may be judged that there is no obstruction.

note.yi: 注的第一句「若伏藏而夫伤克者」里的「夫」按上下文应是「受」或「又」之类的误字，译作「又受伤克」；书里没有说明。「真空、真破」是真正的旬空、月破（不是被冲开、被填实的假空假破），书里没有在这里另作解释。「主象」就是用神所代表的那一象。
note.en: In the commentary's first sentence, 'hidden and fu struck', the character 'fu' is by context a mis-written 'shou' or 'you' and is rendered 'hidden and further struck'; the book does not say. 'True Void, true breaking' are a real Void and Month-break (as against a false one that has been clashed open or filled), which the book does not explain here. The 'main image' is the image the Subject stands for.

zh: 原神若坏，纵用现兮不祥；
主象受伤，得救护兮无碍
yi: 原神如果坏了，即使用神出现也不吉祥；
主象受了伤，得到救护就没有妨碍
en: If the Support is spoiled, then even if the Subject appears it is inauspicious;
if the main image is wounded but gains rescue and protection, there is no obstruction

zh: 原神者，生用神之爻也，如原神旬空，若伏藏而夫伤克者，主症虚体弱，非补不能起发，既起发主发无力灌浆。
若原神值真空真破，或伏而受伤太过，或化回头克伤，谓之原神受伤，用神无根，焉能得生？
如主象逢伤克，而遇原神临月建日辰动爻救护者，痘症虽险，可断不妨。
yi: 原神就是生用神的爻，如果原神旬空，或者伏藏又受伤克，主症状虚弱、体质弱，不补就不能起发，起发了也没有力气灌浆。
如果原神遇到真空、真破，或者伏藏又受伤太过，或者变出回头克伤它，叫做原神受伤，用神没有根，怎么能得到生？
这不是吉祥的兆头。
如果主象遇到伤克，而原神带着月建、日辰、动爻来救护，痘症虽然凶险，可以断定没有妨碍。
学的人要懂得变通。
en: The Support is the line that generates the Subject; if the Support is Void, or hidden and struck by harm or control, the condition is one of emptiness and the body weak: without tonics it cannot erupt, and once erupted it has no strength to fill with fluid.

If the Support meets true Void or true breaking, or is hidden and too badly wounded, or changes into a returning control that wounds it, this is called the Support wounded, the Subject has no root, and how can it be born?
This is not an auspicious sign.

If the main image meets harm or control but the Support, backed by the Month, the Day or a moving line, comes to rescue and protect it, then although the pox is dangerous, it may be judged that there is no obstruction.
The student should be flexible.

title: 福鬼若值青龙方宜种痘：子孙爻或官鬼爻临青龙、不遇日月动爻刑冲克害，占种痘大吉；官爻旬空或伏藏、福神不值青龙，种了也出不来

rule.yi: 福神或鬼爻如果带青龙，才适合种痘：子孙爻带青龙，或者官鬼爻带青龙，没有遇到日、月、动爻的刑冲克害，占种痘是大吉的兆头；如果官爻旬空或者伏藏，福神又不带青龙，即使种了痘也出不来。
rule.en: Output or Pressure carrying the Azure Dragon means it is fit to inoculate: if the Output line carries the Azure Dragon, or the Pressure line carries the Azure Dragon, and meets no punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, then in divining about inoculation it is a very auspicious sign; if the Pressure line is Void or hidden and Output does not carry the Azure Dragon, then even if the pox is sown it will not come out.

note.yi: 「种痘」是把痘浆或痘痂接种到健康人身上，让他出一次轻的痘，以后不再得重的；「栽花」是它的雅称。注里「种豆」是「种痘」的误字。这是书里唯一讲种痘的一处。
note.en: 'Sowing the pox' (zhong dou) is inoculating a healthy person with pox matter so that he has a light case and does not get a severe one later; 'planting flowers' is its elegant name. The commentary's 'zhong dou' written with the bean character is a mis-write of the same. This is the only place in the book that treats inoculation.

zh: 福鬼若值青龙，方宜种痘
yi: 福神或鬼爻如果带青龙，才适合种痘
en: Output or Pressure carrying the Azure Dragon is what makes it fit to inoculate

zh: 或子孙爻临青龙，或官鬼爻临青龙，不遇日月动爻刑冲克害者，如卜种痘为大吉之兆；
如官爻旬空或伏藏，福神不值青龙，虽种豆亦不出也。
yi: 或者子孙爻带青龙，或者官鬼爻带青龙，没有遇到日、月、动爻的刑、冲、克、害，如果占种痘，是大吉的兆头；
如果官爻旬空或者伏藏，福神又不带青龙，即使种了痘也出不来。
en: Either the Output line carries the Azure Dragon or the Pressure line carries the Azure Dragon, and meets no punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines; if one divines about inoculation, it is a very auspicious sign;
if the Pressure line is Void or hidden and Output does not carry the Azure Dragon, then even if the pox is sown it will not come out.

title: 用煞如临白虎且慢栽花：用神或忌神带白虎，用神又受日月动爻刑冲克害，不宜种痘，恐反被害

rule.yi: 用神或者煞神如果带白虎，先别种痘。具体说，或者用神带白虎，或者忌神带白虎，用神又受到日、月、动爻的刑冲克害，不适合种痘，恐怕反而被害。
rule.en: If the Subject or the killing spirit carries the White Tiger, hold off sowing the pox for now. Specifically, either the Subject carries the White Tiger or the Adversary carries the White Tiger, and the Subject is struck by punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines: it is not suitable to inoculate, for fear of being harmed instead.

zh: 用煞如临白虎，且慢栽花
yi: 用神或者煞神如果带白虎，先别种痘
en: If the Subject or the killing spirit carries the White Tiger, hold off sowing the pox for now

zh: 或用神临白虎，或忌神临白虎，用神受日月动爻刑冲克害者，不宜种痘，恐反被害耳。
yi: 或者用神带白虎，或者忌神带白虎，用神又受到日、月、动爻的刑冲克害，不适合种痘，恐怕反而被害。
en: Either the Subject carries the White Tiger or the Adversary carries the White Tiger, and the Subject is struck by punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines: it is not suitable to inoculate, for fear of being harmed instead.

title: 玄武冲世冲身污妇冲魇而作变：玄武临财爻发动冲世身用象，是污妇冲魇致痘花变；玄武临应爻发动冲世身主象，是外人闯魇作变

rule.yi: 玄武冲世爻、冲卦身，是不洁的妇人冲撞魇魅，使痘起了变化。具体说，玄武带着财爻发动，来冲世爻、卦身、用神的象，是因为不洁的妇人冲撞魇魅，使痘花起了变化；玄武带着应爻发动，来冲世爻、卦身、主象，是被外人闯进来冲撞魇魅而起了变化。
rule.en: The Dark Tortoise clashing the Self and the Body means an unclean woman has clashed and cursed and made the pox change. Specifically, if the Dark Tortoise carries the Wealth line and it moves to clash the Self, the Body or the image of the Subject, it is because an unclean woman has clashed and cursed and caused the pox flowers to change; if the Dark Tortoise carries the Other line and it moves to clash the Self, the Body or the main image, an outsider has burst in and clashed and cursed and caused the change.

note.yi: 「污妇」是不洁的妇人，书里没有说指的是什么情形；「冲魇」是冲撞、魇魅，按字面译。这一条是把痘花的变化归给外来的人事，不是归给病人自己的身体。
note.en: An 'unclean woman' is not defined in the book; 'chong yan' is to clash and to curse, rendered literally. This entry attributes a change in the pox flowers to a person coming from outside, not to the patient's own body.

zh: 玄武冲世冲身，污妇冲魇而作变
yi: 玄武冲世爻、冲卦身，是不洁的妇人冲撞魇魅而使痘起了变化
en: The Dark Tortoise clashing the Self and the Body means an unclean woman has clashed and cursed and made the pox change

zh: 玄武临财爻动来冲世身用象者，主因污妇冲魇致痘花作变。
如玄武临应爻动来冲世身主象，被外人闯魇作变也。
yi: 玄武带着财爻发动，来冲世爻、卦身、用神的象，主因为不洁的妇人冲撞魇魅，使痘花起了变化。
如果玄武带着应爻发动，来冲世爻、卦身、主象，是被外人闯进来冲撞魇魅而起了变化。
en: If the Dark Tortoise carries the Wealth line and it moves to clash the Self, the Body or the image of the Subject, it is because an unclean woman has clashed and cursed and caused the pox flowers to change.
If the Dark Tortoise carries the Other line and it moves to clash the Self, the Body or the main image, an outsider has burst in and clashed and cursed and caused the change.

title: 白虎临官临用火毒甚而未清：白虎是血神，临官鬼或用神又遇日月动爻刑冲克害，不是生痰就是结毒；毒结的部位按宫论（乾头面、坤腹、震足、巽股、艮手、离目、坎耳、兑口）

rule.yi: 白虎带官爻或带用神，火毒很重而没有清干净。白虎是血神，如果带官鬼或带用神，又遇到日、月、动爻的刑冲克害，不是生痰，一定是毒结在体内；毒结的部位按宫来推：乾宫在头脸，坤宫在腹，震宫在脚，巽宫在大腿，艮宫在手，离宫在眼，坎宫在耳，兑宫在口。
rule.en: The White Tiger on Pressure or on the Subject means the fire poison is heavy and not yet cleared. The White Tiger is the blood spirit; if it sits on Pressure or on the Subject and meets punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, then if it is not phlegm being produced, it is surely poison lodged within; the place where the poison lodges is worked out by the palace: the Qian palace, the head and face; Kun, the belly; Zhen, the foot; Xun, the thigh; Gen, the hand; Li, the eye; Kan, the ear; Dui, the mouth.

note.yi: 这里兑宫是「口」，而下面 LY.ILL.BSZZ.25 里兑象是「面」，同一章里兑宫的部位有两说，见那一条。增删卜易也有按宫论花长在哪里的说法（LY.ILL.ZS.20：乾多生头、坤多腹、艮多手、兑多口、坎离上身、震巽下身），那里讲的是痘长在哪里，这里讲的是毒结在哪里。
note.en: Here the Dui palace is the 'mouth', while in LY.ILL.BSZZ.25 below the Dui image is the 'face'; the palace's place has two readings in the same chapter, see that entry. The Zengshan Buyi also places the flowers by palace (LY.ILL.ZS.20: Qian mostly on the head, Kun on the belly, Gen on the hands, Dui on the mouth, Kan and Li on the upper body, Zhen and Xun on the lower), but there it says where the pox will grow, and here where the poison lodges.

zh: 白虎临官临用，火毒甚而未清
yi: 白虎带官爻或带用神，火毒很重而没有清干净
en: The White Tiger on Pressure or on the Subject: the fire poison is heavy and not yet cleared

zh: 白虎是血神，如临官鬼或临用神，而遇日月动爻刑冲克害，若非生痰，定是结毒。
如在乾宫毒结头面，坤腹、震足、巽股、艮手、离目、坎耳、兑口等类推之。
yi: 白虎是血神，如果带官鬼或带用神，又遇到日、月、动爻的刑冲克害，不是生痰，一定是毒结在体内。
如果在乾宫，毒结在头脸；坤宫是腹，震宫是脚，巽宫是大腿，艮宫是手，离宫是眼睛，坎宫是耳朵，兑宫是口，照这样类推。
en: The White Tiger is the blood spirit; if it sits on Pressure or on the Subject and meets punishment, clash, control or harm from the Day, Month or moving lines, then if it is not phlegm being produced, it is surely poison lodged within.
In the Qian palace the poison lodges in the head and face; Kun is the belly, Zhen the foot, Xun the thigh, Gen the hand, Li the eye, Kan the ear, Dui the mouth, and so on by analogy.

title: 身上虎须向五行言带疾：卦身临福德吉神主无痘毒，临官鬼必有结毒成疾之处——金鬼肺经鼻孔生疮或耳疾、木鬼肝经两目或耳疾、水鬼肾经耳枯唇疾、火鬼心经舌焦目疾、土鬼脾经口如鱼口鼻梁疾；休囚见福神发动可用药愈，无福神克制加白虎是终身之疾

rule.yi: 卦身这一爻主出痘的人从头到尾的事：落在福德这个吉神上，没有痘毒；落在官鬼上，一定有毒结成病的地方，按官鬼的五行说会留下什么毛病：金鬼是肺经炎毒未消，鼻孔里生疮或右耳有毛病；木鬼是肝经火毒未消，两眼里出痘或右耳有毛病；水鬼是肾经火毒未消，两耳干枯，嘴唇有毛病；火鬼是心经火毒未消，舌头干焦，眼睛有毛病；土鬼是脾经火毒未清，嘴像鱼嘴，鼻梁有毛病。己土官鬼带着卦身的，如果休囚、又见福神发动，用药就能好；如果没有福神克制，反而加上白虎附着，就有损失，是终身的毛病。
rule.en: The Body line governs the whole course of the person with the pox from start to finish: if it sits on Output, the fortunate spirit, there is no pox poison; if it sits on Pressure, there is surely a place where poison lodges and becomes a lingering ailment, and by the element of Pressure it is worked out as follows: a Metal ghost, inflammatory poison of the lung channel not dispersed, with sores in the nostrils or an ailment of the right ear; Wood, fire poison of the liver channel not dispersed, pox within both eyes or an ailment of the right ear; Water, fire poison of the kidney channel not dispersed, both ears dry and withered and an ailment of the lips; Fire, fire poison of the heart channel not dispersed, a dry scorched tongue and an eye ailment; Earth, fire poison of the spleen channel not cleared, a mouth like a fish's mouth and an ailment at the bridge of the nose. If a Ji-Earth Pressure line sits on the Body and is resting or trapped, and Output is seen moving, medicine can cure it; if no Output controls it and the White Tiger clings to it instead, there is loss, and it is a lifelong ailment.

note.yi: 经文「身上虎须向五行言带疾」的「虎」是白虎；「带疾」是痘好了以后留下的毛病。注里金鬼和木鬼两处都写「右耳带疾」，书里没有解释。「己土」是阴土（丑未），注里单提它，没有说为什么。这一条讲的是病好以后留下什么，不是病重不重，后面 LY.ILL.BSZZ.25 讲同一个题目按八宫来推。
note.en: The 'tiger' in the verse's 'with the Tiger on the Body' is the White Tiger; 'lingering ailment' is what is left after the pox has healed. The commentary writes 'an ailment of the right ear' for both the Metal and the Wood ghost, which the book does not explain. 'Ji Earth' is yin Earth (Chou and Wei) and the commentary singles it out without saying why. This entry is about what remains after recovery, not how severe the illness is; LY.ILL.BSZZ.25 below treats the same subject by the eight palaces.

zh: 身上虎须向五行言带疾
yi: 身上有虎，要从五行来说会留下什么毛病
en: With the Tiger on the Body, speak by the five elements of what ailment will linger

zh: 大凡卦身一爻，主痘人始终之事，若临福德吉神，主无痘毒；
如临官鬼，必有结毒成疾之处。
如遇金鬼，系肺经炎毒未消，鼻孔内生疮或右耳带疾；
如临木鬼，系肝经火毒未消，主两目内出痘或右耳带疾。
如遇水鬼，系肾经火毒未消，主两耳干枯，嘴唇带疾；
如官鬼属火，系心经火毒未消，舌上干焦，主带目疾；
如官鬼属土，系脾经火毒未清，主口如鱼口，鼻梁带疾。
己土官鬼凡属临持卦身，如值休囚，见福神发动者用药可愈；
如无福神克制反加白虎附持，则有损失，乃终身之疾也。
yi: 大凡卦身这一爻，主出痘的人始终的事；如果落在福德这个吉神上，主没有痘毒；
如果落在官鬼上，一定有毒结成病的地方。
如果遇到金鬼，是肺经的炎毒没有消，鼻孔里生疮，或者右耳留下毛病；
如果落在木鬼上，是肝经的火毒没有消，主两眼里出痘，或者右耳留下毛病。
如果遇到水鬼，是肾经的火毒没有消，主两耳干枯，嘴唇留下毛病；
如果官鬼属火，是心经的火毒没有消，舌头干焦，主留下眼病；
如果官鬼属土，是脾经的火毒没有清，主嘴像鱼嘴，鼻梁留下毛病。
己土官鬼凡是带着卦身的，如果遇到休囚，又见福神发动的，用药就能好；
如果没有福神来克制，反而加上白虎附着，就有损失，是终身的毛病。
en: Generally the Body line governs the whole course of the person with the pox from start to finish; if it sits on Output, the fortunate spirit, there will be no pox poison;
if it sits on Pressure, there will surely be a place where poison lodges and becomes a lingering ailment.
If it meets a Metal ghost, the inflammatory poison of the lung channel has not dispersed, with sores inside the nostrils or a lingering ailment in the right ear;
if it sits on a Wood ghost, the fire poison of the liver channel has not dispersed, and pox comes out within both eyes or an ailment lingers in the right ear.
If it meets a Water ghost, the fire poison of the kidney channel has not dispersed, and both ears are dry and withered and an ailment lingers in the lips;
if the Pressure line is Fire, the fire poison of the heart channel has not dispersed, the tongue is dry and scorched, and an eye ailment lingers;
if the Pressure line is Earth, the fire poison of the spleen channel has not cleared, the mouth becomes like a fish's mouth and an ailment lingers at the bridge of the nose.
Whenever a Ji-Earth Pressure line sits on the Body, if it is resting or trapped and Output is seen moving, medicine can cure it;
if there is no Output to control it and the White Tiger is added instead and clings to it, there is loss, and it is a lifelong ailment.

title: 爻中煞当凭八卦论终身：白虎鬼居乾宫带疾在头、兑在面、震在足、巽在股、坎在耳、离在目、艮在手、坤在腹；福神克制则易医，加白虎持临是终身之疾

rule.yi: 爻里的煞，要凭八卦来论一生留下什么毛病：白虎、鬼在乾宫，毛病在头；在兑卦，在脸；在震卦，在脚；在巽卦，在大腿；在坎卦，在耳朵；在离卦，在眼睛；在艮卦，在手；在坤卦，在肚子。以上八个宫里所遇到的鬼爻，如果遇到福神克制，就容易医好；如果再加上白虎带着，就是终身的毛病。
rule.en: The killing spirit within the lines should be judged by the eight trigrams for the lifelong ailment: if the Tiger ghost sits in the Qian palace, the ailment lingers in the head; in the Dui image, in the face; in Zhen, in the foot; in Xun, in the thigh; in Kan, in the ear; in Li, in the eye; in Gen, in the hand; in Kun, in the belly. For the Pressure line in any of the eight palaces above, if Output meets and controls it, treatment easily cures it; if the White Tiger is added and sits on it, it is a lifelong ailment.

dispute.yi: 兑宫的部位，同一章里有两说：LY.ILL.BSZZ.23 说兑宫毒结在口，这一条说兑象带疾在面。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The place of the Dui palace has two readings in this one chapter: LY.ILL.BSZZ.23 says the poison lodges in the mouth in the Dui palace, and this entry says the ailment lingers in the face in the Dui image. The book does not decide.

note.yi: 这里的分布是乾头、兑面、震足、巽股、坎耳、离目、艮手、坤腹。增删卜易讲花长在哪里，说乾多生头、坤多腹、艮多手、兑多口、坎离上身、震巽下身（LY.ILL.ZS.20），大体和这里相近，只是那里讲的是痘长在哪里，这里讲的是好了以后留下什么。
note.en: The distribution here is Qian the head, Dui the face, Zhen the foot, Xun the thigh, Kan the ear, Li the eye, Gen the hand, Kun the belly. The Zengshan Buyi, on where the flowers grow, says Qian mostly the head, Kun the belly, Gen the hands, Dui the mouth, Kan and Li the upper body, Zhen and Xun the lower body (LY.ILL.ZS.20), which is broadly close, except that there it says where the pox grows and here what is left after recovery.

zh: 爻中煞当凭八卦论终身
yi: 爻里的煞，要凭八卦来论一生留下什么毛病
en: The killing spirit within the lines should be judged by the eight trigrams for the lifelong ailment

zh: 如虎鬼居乾宫，则带疾在头；
以上八宫所值鬼爻，如遇福神克制，则医治易愈，如再加白虎持临，乃终身之疾也。
yi: 如果白虎、鬼在乾宫，留下的毛病在头；
如果在兑卦，在脸；
如果在震卦，在脚；
如果在巽卦，在大腿；
如果在坎卦，在耳朵；
如果在离卦，在眼睛；
如果在艮卦，在手；
如果在坤卦，在肚子。
以上八个宫里所遇到的鬼爻，如果遇到福神克制，就容易医好；如果再加上白虎带着，就是终身的毛病。
学的人要按道理去推。
en: If the Tiger ghost sits in the Qian palace, the ailment lingers in the head;
if in the Dui image, in the face;
if in the Zhen trigram, in the foot;
if in the Xun trigram, in the thigh;
if in the Kan trigram, in the ear;
if in the Li trigram, in the eye;
if in the Gen trigram, in the hand;
if in the Kun trigram, in the belly.
For the Pressure line in any of the eight palaces above, if Output meets and controls it, treatment easily cures it; if the White Tiger is added and sits on it, it is a lifelong ailment.
The student should work it out by reason.

title: 金为肺腑增疼增嗽非宜、火属心经发疮发斑大忌：官鬼属金毒发肺部主身痛咳嗽须防鼻偏；官鬼属火毒发心经，起初防发斑、继防发疮及舌头宿硬；衰静者轻、旺动者重

rule.yi: 金对应肺腑，加重疼痛、加重咳嗽都不相宜；火属心经，发疮、发斑是大忌。具体说，官鬼属金，毒发在肺部，主身体作痛或咳嗽，要防鼻子歪偏；官鬼属火，毒发在心经，是火毒的症候，起初要防发斑，接着要防发疮和舌头长久僵硬。衰而静的轻，旺而动的更重。
rule.en: Metal is the lungs and viscera, and increased pain or increased cough is unfavourable; Fire belongs to the heart channel, and breaking out in sores or spots is a great taboo. Specifically, if the Pressure line is Metal, the poison breaks out in the lungs, bringing bodily pain or cough, and one must guard against a crooked nose; if the Pressure line is Fire, the poison breaks out in the heart channel and is a fire-poison condition; at first guard against spots, then against sores and a stiffened tongue that stays so. If weak and still it is light; if strong and moving it is heavier still.

zh: 金为肺腑，增疼增嗽非宜；
火属心经，发疮发斑大忌
yi: 金对应肺腑，加重疼痛、加重咳嗽都不相宜；
火属心经，发疮、发斑是大忌
en: Metal is the lungs and viscera, and increased pain or increased cough is unfavourable;
Fire belongs to the heart channel, and breaking out in sores or spots is a great taboo

zh: 官鬼属金，毒发肺部，主身体作痛或咳嗽，须防鼻偏；
如官鬼属火，毒发心经，乃火毒之症，起初防发斑，继之防发疮及舌头宿硬。
yi: 官鬼属金，毒发在肺部，主身体作痛或咳嗽，要防鼻子歪偏；
如果官鬼属火，毒发在心经，是火毒的症候，起初要防发斑，接着要防发疮和舌头长久僵硬。
衰而静的轻，旺而动的更重。
en: If the Pressure line is Metal, the poison breaks out in the lungs, bringing bodily pain or cough, and one must guard against a crooked nose;
if the Pressure line is Fire, the poison breaks out in the heart channel and is a fire-poison condition; at first guard against spots, then against sores and a stiffened tongue that stays so.
If weak and still it is light; if strong and moving it is heavier still.

title: 木鬼乃风邪未表、水宫而寒食尚停：官爻属木是风寒未表、肝经受毒，防呛喘发痒两目直视；官爻属水毒发肾经，防腰疼两耳焦干，尚有寒食停积发热宿浆

rule.yi: 木鬼是风邪还没有发散到表面，水宫则是寒凉的食物还停积着。官爻属木，一定是风寒没有发散出去，肝经受了毒，要防呛咳、气喘、发痒和两眼直瞪；官爻属水，毒发在肾经，要防腰疼和两耳焦干，还有寒凉的食物停积在里面，发热、浆水留着不化。
rule.en: A Wood ghost is a wind evil not yet expelled to the surface; in the Water palace cold food is still stagnant. If the Pressure line is Wood, it is surely because wind-cold has not been expelled and the liver channel has taken the poison, and one must guard against choking cough, wheezing, itching and a fixed stare of the eyes; if the Pressure line is Water, the poison breaks out in the kidney channel, and one must guard against lower-back pain and both ears becoming scorched and dry, and there is also cold food stagnant within, with fever and lingering fluid.

zh: 木鬼乃风邪未表，水宫而寒食尚停
yi: 木鬼是风邪还没有发散到表面，水宫则是寒凉的食物还停积着
en: A Wood ghost is a wind evil not yet expelled to the surface; in the Water palace cold food is still stagnant

zh: 木能生风，故主风邪，如官爻属木，必因未表风寒，肝经受毒，防呛喘发痒及两目直视；
如官爻属水，毒发肾经，防腰疼及两耳焦干，尚有寒食停积，发热宿浆。
yi: 木能生风，所以主风邪；如果官爻属木，一定是风寒没有发散出去，肝经受了毒，要防呛咳、气喘、发痒，以及两眼直瞪；
如果官爻属水，毒发在肾经，要防腰疼和两耳焦干，还有寒凉的食物停积在里面，发热、浆水留着不化。
en: Wood can produce wind, so it means wind evil; if the Pressure line is Wood, it is surely because wind-cold has not been expelled and the liver channel has taken the poison, and one must guard against choking cough, wheezing, itching and a fixed stare of the eyes;

if the Pressure line is Water, the poison breaks out in the kidney channel, and one must guard against lower-back pain and both ears becoming scorched and dry, and there is also cold food stagnant within, with fever and lingering fluid.

title: 麻面官乘四土、破碎遇三冲：官鬼临辰戌丑未四土，土属脾经，痘粗扁多密故云麻面，防口如鱼口；官爻遇年月日冲，灌浆后防破碎泄气

rule.yi: 麻面是官爻乘着辰、戌、丑、未这四个土，破碎是遇到三处冲。官鬼就是痘花，如果落在辰、戌、丑、未四个土上，土属脾经，主痘又粗又扁又多又密，所以叫麻面，要防嘴像鱼嘴；如果官爻遇到年、月、日（注里写「二建」）来冲，灌浆以后要防破碎、泄气。
rule.en: A pockmarked face is Pressure riding the four Earths, and breaking and shattering is meeting three clashes. The Pressure line is the pox flowers; if it sits on the four Earths, Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, Earth belongs to the spleen channel, and the pox are coarse, flat, many and dense, so it is called a pockmarked face, and one must guard against a mouth like a fish's mouth; if the Pressure line meets a clash from the Year, Month or Day (the commentary writes 'two rulers'), then after the fluid has filled one must guard against breaking apart and the leaking of qi.

note.yi: 经文说「遇三冲」，注写「年月日二建冲者」：年、月、日是三处，「二建」的「二」按上下文可能是「三」的误字，也可能指月建、日建两处，书里没有说明，译文照写。
note.en: The verse says 'meeting three clashes' and the commentary 'clashed by the two rulers of Year, Month and Day': the Year, Month and Day make three, so the 'two' of 'two rulers' may by context be a mis-write of 'three', or may mean the Month and Day rulers, which the book does not explain; the translation follows the text.

zh: 麻面官乘四土，破碎遇三冲
yi: 麻面是官爻乘着辰、戌、丑、未四个土，破碎是遇到三处冲
en: A pockmarked face is Pressure riding the four Earths, and breaking and shattering is meeting three clashes

zh: 官鬼为痘花，如临辰戌丑未四土，土属脾经，主痘粗扁多密，故云麻面，防口如鱼口；
如官爻遇年月日二建冲者，灌浆后防破碎泄气。
yi: 官鬼就是痘花，如果落在辰、戌、丑、未四个土上，土属脾经，主痘又粗又扁又多又密，所以叫麻面，要防嘴像鱼嘴；
如果官爻遇到年、月、日（注里写「二建」）来冲，灌浆以后要防破碎、泄气。
en: The Pressure line is the pox flowers; if it sits on the four Earths, Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, Earth belongs to the spleen channel, and the pox are coarse, flat, many and dense, so it is called a pockmarked face, and one must guard against a mouth like a fish's mouth;
if the Pressure line meets a clash from the Year, Month or Day (the commentary writes 'two rulers'), then after the fluid has filled one must guard against breaking apart and the leaking of qi.

title: 玄武主阴虚黑缩、勾陈应胀闷黄浮：玄武临官爻或忌神及阴虚之症，防缩浆黑陷；勾陈附鬼爻，主胀闷黄浮

rule.yi: 玄武主阴虚、痘色发黑收缩，勾陈应验为胀闷、面色发黄浮肿。玄武带官爻，或带忌神，以及阴虚的症候，要防浆水收缩、痘色发黑塌陷；勾陈如果附在鬼爻上，主胀闷、发黄、浮肿。
rule.en: The Dark Tortoise means yin deficiency, blackened and shrunken pox; the Hook Earth responds with swelling, oppression and a yellow, puffy look. If the Dark Tortoise sits on the Pressure line, or on the Adversary, or in a condition of yin deficiency, guard against the fluid shrinking and the pox turning black and sunken; if the Hook Earth clings to the Pressure line, it means swelling, oppression, yellowness and puffiness.

zh: 玄武主阴虚黑缩，勾陈应胀闷黄浮
yi: 玄武主阴虚、痘色发黑收缩，勾陈应验为胀闷、面色发黄浮肿
en: The Dark Tortoise means yin deficiency, blackened and shrunken pox; the Hook Earth responds with swelling, oppression and a yellow, puffy look

zh: 玄武临官爻，或临忌神及阴虚之症，防缩浆黑陷；
勾陈如附鬼爻，主胀闷黄浮。
yi: 玄武带官爻，或带忌神，以及阴虚的症候，要防浆水收缩、痘色发黑塌陷；
勾陈如果附在鬼爻上，主胀闷、发黄、浮肿。
en: If the Dark Tortoise sits on the Pressure line, or on the Adversary, or in a condition of yin deficiency, guard against the fluid shrinking and the pox turning black and sunken;
if the Hook Earth clings to the Pressure line, it means swelling, oppression, yellowness and puffiness.

title: 螣蛇木摆似惊风、朱雀火炎真血热：螣蛇临木爻官鬼，初起未见点时似惊风；官鬼属火又临朱雀，是血热火毒之症，须用大黄黄连清火泻毒，迟服则痘隐焦黑不能挽回

rule.yi: 螣蛇带木摆动像惊风，朱雀带火炽盛是真的血热。螣蛇带着木爻的官鬼，主刚开始还没见到痘点的时候，像是惊风；如果卦中官鬼属火，又带朱雀，是血热火毒的症候，必须用大黄、黄连这类药，一定要清火泻毒才能得救；如果服得迟，病势更猛，痘隐没下去、焦黑，没法挽回。
rule.en: The Coiling Snake with Wood swaying is like infantile convulsions; the Vermilion Bird with blazing Fire is truly blood heat. If the Coiling Snake sits on a Wood Pressure line, before the spots are yet seen at the beginning it seems like infantile convulsions; if in the hexagram the Pressure line is Fire and sits on the Vermilion Bird, it is a condition of blood heat and fire poison, and one must use rhubarb, coptis and the like: only by clearing fire and draining poison can there be rescue; if it is taken late the enemy is fiercer, the pox sink out of sight and turn scorched and black, and it cannot be retrieved.

note.yi: 「黄莲」是「黄连」的误字。「惊风」是小儿抽搐一类的急症。这一条说火鬼带朱雀要用大黄、黄连清火泻毒，而前面医药章有「火鬼旺宜大寒药」的说法（见 LY.ILL.HJC.82、LY.ILL.HJC.84），增删卜易的李我平驳「火鬼忌热水鬼忌寒」是拘泥（LY.ILL.ZS.40）；这一条是痘疹专门的用药，不是一般病的通则。
note.en: 'Huang lian' written with the lotus character is a mis-write of coptis. 'Jingfeng' is infantile convulsions and the like, an acute illness. This entry says a Fire Pressure line on the Vermilion Bird needs rhubarb and coptis to clear fire and drain poison, while the earlier chapter on medicine has the saying that a strong Fire ghost suits very cold medicines (see LY.ILL.HJC.82 and LY.ILL.HJC.84), and Li Woping in the Zengshan Buyi rejects 'Fire Pressure fears heat, Water Pressure fears cold' as rigid (LY.ILL.ZS.40); this entry is medicine specific to pox, not a general rule for illness.

zh: 螣蛇木摆似惊风，朱雀火炎真血热
yi: 螣蛇带木摆动像惊风，朱雀带火炽盛是真的血热
en: The Coiling Snake with Wood swaying is like infantile convulsions; the Vermilion Bird with blazing Fire is truly blood heat

zh: 螣蛇临木爻官鬼，主初起未见点时似乎惊风；
若卦中官鬼属火，又临朱雀，是血热火毒之症，须用大黄、黄莲等剂，必清火泻毒方能有救，如迟服则敌甚，痘隐焦黑，不能挽回也。
yi: 螣蛇带着木爻的官鬼，主刚开始还没见到痘点的时候，像是惊风；
如果卦中官鬼属火，又带朱雀，是血热火毒的症候，必须用大黄、黄连这类药，一定要清火泻毒才能得救；如果服得迟，病势更猛，痘隐没下去、焦黑，没法挽回。
en: If the Coiling Snake sits on a Wood Pressure line, before the spots are yet seen at the beginning it seems like infantile convulsions;

if in the hexagram the Pressure line is Fire and sits on the Vermilion Bird, it is a condition of blood heat and fire poison, and one must use rhubarb, coptis and the like: only by clearing fire and draining poison can there be rescue; if it is taken late the enemy is fiercer, the pox sink out of sight and turn scorched and black, and it cannot be retrieved.

title: 白虎同忌煞交重哭声将至：白虎临忌神发动克伤用神，又无原神持护，立见其危

rule.yi: 白虎和忌神、煞神一起交重（发动），哭声将要到来：白虎带着忌神发动，克伤用神，又没有原神来扶持保护的，马上就出现危险。
rule.en: The White Tiger together with the Adversary and killing spirits all moving means the sound of wailing is coming: if the White Tiger sits on the Adversary and it moves to control and wound the Subject, and there is no Support to hold and protect it, danger appears at once.

note.yi: 「哭声将至」是说要死人了；书里没有直接写死，本库照字面译。
note.en: 'The sound of wailing is coming' means a death is near; the book does not write the word death, and the library follows the text.

zh: 白虎同忌煞交重，哭声将至
yi: 白虎和忌神、煞神一起交重，哭声将要到来
en: The White Tiger together with the Adversary and killing spirits all moving: the sound of wailing is coming

zh: 白虎临忌神发动克伤用神，又无原神持护者，立见其危。
yi: 白虎带着忌神发动，克伤用神，又没有原神来扶持保护的，马上就出现危险。
en: If the White Tiger sits on the Adversary and it moves to control and wound the Subject, and there is no Support to hold and protect it, danger appears at once.

title: 青龙会恩星发动庆贺齐来：青龙临原神发动，生合用神，痘必收功

rule.yi: 青龙会合恩星发动，庆贺的人一起到来：青龙带着原神发动，生合用神，痘一定能收功。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon meeting the kindly star and moving means congratulations arrive together: if the Azure Dragon sits on the Support and it moves to generate and combine with the Subject, the pox will surely come to completion.

note.yi: 经文的「恩星」注里没有解释，从注文看就是原神。这一条和上一条（白虎同忌）是一对：一个是白虎带忌神，一个是青龙带原神。
note.en: The verse's 'kindly star' is not explained in the commentary and from the commentary it is the Support. This entry and the previous (the White Tiger with the Adversary) are a pair: one is the White Tiger on the Adversary, the other the Azure Dragon on the Support.

zh: 青龙会恩星发动，庆贺齐来
yi: 青龙会合恩星发动，庆贺的人一起到来
en: The Azure Dragon meeting the kindly star and moving: congratulations arrive together

zh: 青龙临原神发动，生合用神，痘必收功也。
yi: 青龙带着原神发动，生合用神，痘一定能收功。
en: If the Azure Dragon sits on the Support and it moves to generate and combine with the Subject, the pox will surely come to completion.

title: 定死活于五行生克之中、决轻重于六神临持之上：生死全凭五行生克的轻重，兼看六神，此节乃一章之大旨

rule.yi: 生死取决于五行生克之中，轻重取决于六神落在哪里、带在谁身上。生死全靠生克的轻重，再兼看六神，这一节是全章的大旨。
rule.en: Life and death are settled within the generating and controlling of the five phases, and light or heavy is decided by where the six spirits sit and what they hold. Life and death rest wholly on the weight of generating and controlling, together with a look at the six spirits; this passage is the main purpose of the whole chapter.

note.yi: 最后这一对句是全章的收尾，讲做父母的心事（儿孙还没出花时的忧虑，以及家里再富也要教导），不是断卦的规则。注文说的「六神」是螣蛇、朱雀、勾陈、白虎、青龙、玄武。
note.en: The last couplet closes the chapter and speaks of a parent's cares (the worry before the children have had the pox, and that however rich a household is it must still instruct); it is not a rule of judgment. The 'six spirits' of the commentary are the Coiling Snake, Vermilion Bird, Hook Earth, White Tiger, Azure Dragon and Dark Tortoise.

zh: 定死活于五行生克之中，决轻重于六神临持之上
yi: 生死取决于五行生克之中，轻重取决于六神落在哪里、带在谁身上
en: Life and death are settled within the generating and controlling of the five phases, and light or heavy is decided by where the six spirits sit and what they hold

zh: 生死全凭生克轻重，兼看六神，此节乃一章之大旨也。
yi: 生死全靠生克的轻重，再兼看六神，这一节是全章的大旨。
en: Life and death rest wholly on the weight of generating and controlling, together with a look at the six spirits; this passage is the main purpose of the whole chapter.

zh: 儿孙满目未出花，耽许多忧虑；
金玉满堂失教训，枉费尽心机。
yi: 儿孙满眼，都还没有出花，耽误了多少忧虑；
金玉满堂却缺了教导，白白费尽心机。
en: Children and grandchildren fill the eye and none has yet had the pox: much anxiety is spent;
a hall full of gold and jade but no instruction: all one's ingenuity wasted.

title: 何知章·亲人的病灾：父母疾（白虎临爻兼刑克）、父母殃（财爻发动煞神伤）、子孙疾（父母爻动相克）、子孙灾、小儿死（子孙空亡加白虎）、兄弟亡（用落空亡白虎伤）

rule.yi: 「何知」口诀里关于亲人病灾的六问：父母有病，是白虎临着（父母）这一爻，再加刑克；父母有灾殃，是财爻发动、煞神来伤；子孙有病，是父母爻发动来克制子孙；子孙有灾，卜筮大全说是白虎落到福德（子孙）上，卜筮正宗说是父母落到福德上；小孩要死，是子孙落空亡再加白虎；兄弟去世，是用神落空亡又被白虎所伤。
rule.en: Six questions of the 'how to know' rhyme about illness and calamity among kin. A parent is ill when the White Tiger sits on the (Resource) line together with punishment and control; a parent meets calamity when the Wealth line moves and a killing spirit wounds; a child is ill when the Resource line moves and controls Output; a child meets misfortune when, in the Bushi Daquan, the White Tiger arrives upon Output, or, in the Bushi Zhengzong, Resource arrives upon Output; a small child will die when Output is Void and the White Tiger is added; a brother dies when the Subject falls into Void and the White Tiger wounds it.

dispute.yi: 子孙有灾看什么：卜筮大全答「白虎当临福德来」，白虎落到子孙爻上；卜筮正宗答「父母当临福德来」，父母爻落到子孙爻上。两本一个说白虎、一个说父母，书里没有说哪个对（白虎是六神，父母是六亲，两条不是一回事）。
dispute.en: What to look at for a child's misfortune: the Bushi Daquan answers 'the White Tiger arrives upon Output', the White Tiger falling on the Output line; the Bushi Zhengzong answers 'Resource arrives upon Output', the Resource line falling on the Output line. One says the White Tiger and the other Resource, and the books do not say which is right (the White Tiger is one of the six spirits and Resource one of the six relations, so the two are not the same thing).

note.yi: 「何知章」一问一答，一共问了三四十件事（父母子孙的病、有没有子孙、讼事、财富、田地、屋宇、坟墓、六畜、口舌、盗贼……），都是一家的事；这里只收与病、死、鬼怪有关的。卜筮大全里它是「十六、何知章」，卜筮正宗里它在《赋文三篇》中；两本字句略有出入。「杀神」「煞神」是同一个字的两种写法。「用落空亡」的「用」是用神。
note.en: The 'how to know' rhyme asks and answers some thirty or forty things (illnesses of parents and children, whether there are children, lawsuits, wealth, land, houses, graves, livestock, quarrels, thieves and more), all affairs of a household; only those to do with illness, death and ghostly happenings are taken here. In the Bushi Daquan it is chapter 16, 'the how-to-know rhyme'; in the Bushi Zhengzong it is among the three rhapsodies; the two texts differ a little in wording. 'Sha' in the two forms of 'killing spirit' is one word written two ways. The 'yong' of 'yong falls into Void' is the Subject.

yi: 怎么知道这家的父母有病？
白虎临着（父母）这一爻，再加刑克；
怎么知道这家的父母有灾殃？
财爻发动，煞神来伤；
en: How can one know that a household's parents are ill?
The White Tiger sits on the line (the Resource line), together with punishment and control;
How can one know that a household's parents meet calamity?
the Wealth line moves and a killing spirit wounds;

yi: 怎么知道这家的子孙有病？
父母爻这个动爻来克制（子孙）；
怎么知道这家的子孙有灾？
父母落到福德（子孙）上来；
怎么知道这家的小孩会死？
子孙落空亡，再加白虎；
怎么知道这家的兄弟会死？
用神落空亡，又被白虎所伤；
en: How can one know that a household's children are ill?
the Resource line, a moving line, comes to control them;
How can one know that a household's children meet misfortune?
Resource arrives upon Output;
How can one know that a small child will die?
Output is Void and the White Tiger is added;
How can one know that a household's brother will die?
the Subject falls into Void and the White Tiger wounds it;

yi: 怎么知道这家的父母有病？
白虎临着（父母）这一爻，再加刑克。
怎么知道这家的父母有灾殃？
财爻发动，煞神来伤。
en: How can one know that a household's parents are ill?
The White Tiger sits on the line (the Resource line), together with punishment and control.
How can one know that a household's parents meet calamity?
The Wealth line moves and a killing spirit wounds.

yi: 怎么知道这家的子孙有病？
父母爻发动来克制（子孙）。
怎么知道这家的子孙有灾？
白虎落到福德（子孙）上来。
怎么知道这家的小孩会死？
子孙落空亡，再加白虎。
怎么知道这家的兄弟会死？
用神落空亡，又被白虎所伤。
en: How can one know that a household's children are ill?
The Resource line moves and comes to control them.
How can one know that a household's children meet misfortune?
The White Tiger arrives upon Output.
How can one know that a small child will die?
Output is Void and the White Tiger is added.
How can one know that a household's brother will die?
The Subject falls into Void and the White Tiger wounds it.

title: 何知章·痘疹病：螣蛇爻被火烧定（螣蛇入火）

rule.yi: 怎么知道这家有痘疹的病：螣蛇爻遇到火，被火烧着，就断定了。
rule.en: How to know that a household has the pox: the Coiling Snake line is burned by Fire, and that settles it.

note.yi: 「何知章」一问一答，一共问了三四十件事（父母子孙的病、有没有子孙、讼事、财富、田地、屋宇、坟墓、六畜、口舌、盗贼……），都是一家的事；这里只收与病、死、鬼怪有关的。卜筮大全里它是「十六、何知章」，卜筮正宗里它在《赋文三篇》中；两本字句略有出入。这一句口诀只说螣蛇遇火，没有说是螣蛇落在火爻上还是火爻克螣蛇的爻位；断易天机的《何知章》里有一句「鰧蛇入火火烧定，瘟气麻痘病」，是同一个意思，说得更明白（螣蛇落在火上）。
note.en: The 'how to know' rhyme asks and answers some thirty or forty things (illnesses of parents and children, whether there are children, lawsuits, wealth, land, houses, graves, livestock, quarrels, thieves and more), all affairs of a household; only those to do with illness, death and ghostly happenings are taken here. In the Bushi Daquan it is chapter 16, 'the how-to-know rhyme'; in the Bushi Zhengzong it is among the three rhapsodies; the two texts differ a little in wording. This line of the rhyme says only that the Coiling Snake meets Fire and does not say whether the Snake falls on a Fire line or a Fire line burns the Snake's place; the Duanyi Tianji's version of the rhyme has 'the Coiling Snake entering Fire, burned by fire: epidemic qi, measles and pox', the same meaning said more plainly (the Snake falls on Fire).

yi: 怎么知道这家有痘疹的病？
螣蛇爻被火烧着，就断定了；
en: How can one know that a household has the pox?
the Coiling Snake line is burned by Fire, and that settles it;

yi: 怎么知道这家有痘疹的病？
螣蛇爻被火烧着，就断定了。
en: How can one know that a household has the pox?
The Coiling Snake line is burned by Fire, and that settles it.

title: 何知章·病要死：卜筮正宗答用神无救又入墓；卜筮大全答身命世鬼入墓

rule.yi: 怎么知道这家有人病得要死：卜筮正宗说是用神没有救护又入了墓；卜筮大全说是身、命、世、鬼入了墓，照这样推断。
rule.en: How to know that someone in a household is ill unto death: the Bushi Zhengzong says the Subject has no rescue and enters a tomb; the Bushi Daquan says the Body, the destiny, the Self and the ghost enter a tomb, and one judges by that.

dispute.yi: 凭什么断病要死：卜筮正宗答「用神无救又入墓」，只看用神一爻；卜筮大全答「身命世鬼入墓推」，看身、命、世、鬼四样入墓。两本不一样，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: What decides that the illness is unto death: the Bushi Zhengzong answers 'the Subject has no rescue and enters a tomb', looking only at the Subject line; the Bushi Daquan answers 'the Body, the destiny, the Self and the ghost enter a tomb', looking at four things entering a tomb. The two texts differ and the books do not decide.

note.yi: 「何知章」一问一答，一共问了三四十件事（父母子孙的病、有没有子孙、讼事、财富、田地、屋宇、坟墓、六畜、口舌、盗贼……），都是一家的事；这里只收与病、死、鬼怪有关的。卜筮大全里它是「十六、何知章」，卜筮正宗里它在《赋文三篇》中；两本字句略有出入。「身命世鬼」的「身」按其他章的说法是卦身，「命」在这里没有再解释，按字面译作命。用神入墓的说法在增删卜易里有更多的讨论（LY.ILL.ZS.07：动墓绝、化墓绝须逢生旺）。
note.en: The 'how to know' rhyme asks and answers some thirty or forty things (illnesses of parents and children, whether there are children, lawsuits, wealth, land, houses, graves, livestock, quarrels, thieves and more), all affairs of a household; only those to do with illness, death and ghostly happenings are taken here. In the Bushi Daquan it is chapter 16, 'the how-to-know rhyme'; in the Bushi Zhengzong it is among the three rhapsodies; the two texts differ a little in wording. The 'Body' of 'Body, destiny, Self and ghost' is, by the other chapters' usage, the hexagram Body, and 'destiny' is not explained here and is rendered literally. The Subject entering a tomb is discussed at more length in the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.07: moving into or changing into a tomb or extinction needs generation and strength).

yi: 怎么知道这家有人病得要死？
用神没有救护，又入了墓；
en: How can one know that someone in a household is ill unto death?
the Subject has no rescue and enters a tomb;

yi: 怎么知道这家有人病得要死？
身、命、世、鬼入了墓，就这样推断。
en: How can one know that someone in a household is ill unto death?
If the Body, the destiny, the Self and the ghost enter a tomb, judge it so.

title: 何知章·怪与死：多梦寐（螣蛇带鬼持世）、出鬼怪（螣蛇白虎临门）、人投水（玄武入水煞临鬼）、有吊颈（螣蛇木鬼临世爻）、孝服来（白虎临鬼；大全作丧门吊客临鬼）

rule.yi: 怎么知道这家的人多做噩梦：螣蛇带着鬼来持世；出鬼怪：螣蛇、白虎临在门上；有人投水：玄武入水，煞神临在鬼上；有人上吊：螣蛇、木鬼落在世爻上；要有孝服（丧事）来：卜筮正宗说是白虎交重（发动）、排在鬼上，卜筮大全说是丧门、吊客两颗星排在鬼上。
rule.en: How to know that a household is troubled by dreams: the Coiling Snake carrying the ghost holds the Self position; that ghosts and strange things appear: the Coiling Snake and White Tiger sit at the door; that someone will throw himself into water: the Dark Tortoise enters Water and a killing spirit sits on the ghost; that someone will hang himself: the Coiling Snake and a Wood ghost sit on the Self line; that mourning dress will come: in the Bushi Zhengzong the White Tiger moves and is set upon the ghost, in the Bushi Daquan the stars Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence are set upon the ghost.

dispute.yi: 孝服来（有丧事）看什么：卜筮正宗答「交重白虎临鬼排」，白虎发动排在鬼爻上；卜筮大全答「丧门吊客临鬼排」，丧门、吊客两颗神煞排在鬼爻上。一个用六神白虎，一个用神煞丧门吊客，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: What tells that mourning is coming: the Bushi Zhengzong answers 'the White Tiger moving, set upon the ghost', the White Tiger of the six spirits moving on the Pressure line; the Bushi Daquan answers 'Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence set upon the ghost', two spirit-stars on the Pressure line. One uses the White Tiger among the six spirits and the other the spirit-stars Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence, and the books do not decide.

note.yi: 「何知章」一问一答，一共问了三四十件事（父母子孙的病、有没有子孙、讼事、财富、田地、屋宇、坟墓、六畜、口舌、盗贼……），都是一家的事；这里只收与病、死、鬼怪有关的。卜筮大全里它是「十六、何知章」，卜筮正宗里它在《赋文三篇》中；两本字句略有出入。「梦寐」是睡着做梦，这里是不好的梦；「吊颈」是上吊；「孝服」是丧服，指家里有丧事。丧门、吊客是两颗神煞，书里没有再解释。
note.en: The 'how to know' rhyme asks and answers some thirty or forty things (illnesses of parents and children, whether there are children, lawsuits, wealth, land, houses, graves, livestock, quarrels, thieves and more), all affairs of a household; only those to do with illness, death and ghostly happenings are taken here. In the Bushi Daquan it is chapter 16, 'the how-to-know rhyme'; in the Bushi Zhengzong it is among the three rhapsodies; the two texts differ a little in wording. 'Mengmei' is dreaming in sleep, here bad dreams; 'diaojing' is hanging oneself; 'mourning dress' (xiaofu) means a death in the family. Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence are two spirit-stars that the book does not explain further.

yi: 怎么知道这家的人多梦寐（做噩梦）？
螣蛇带着鬼来持世；
怎么知道这家出鬼怪？
螣蛇、白虎临在门上；
怎么知道这家有人投水？
玄武入水，煞神临在鬼上；
怎么知道这家有人上吊？
螣蛇、木鬼落在世爻上；
怎么知道这家会有孝服（丧事）来？
白虎交重（发动），排在鬼上；
en: How can one know that a household is troubled by dreams?
the Coiling Snake carrying the ghost holds the Self position;
How can one know that ghosts and strange things appear in a household?
the Coiling Snake and the White Tiger sit at the door;
How can one know that someone in a household will throw himself into water?
the Dark Tortoise enters Water and a killing spirit sits on the ghost;
How can one know that someone in a household will hang himself?
the Coiling Snake and a Wood ghost sit on the Self line;
How can one know that mourning dress will come to a household?
the White Tiger moving, set upon the ghost;

yi: 怎么知道这家的人多梦寐（做噩梦）？
螣蛇带着鬼来持世。
怎么知道这家出鬼怪？
螣蛇、白虎临在门上。
怎么知道这家有人投水？
玄武入水，煞神临在鬼上。
怎么知道这家有人上吊？
螣蛇、木鬼落在世爻上。
怎么知道这家会有孝服（丧事）来？
丧门、吊客两颗星排在鬼上。
en: How can one know that a household is troubled by dreams?
The Coiling Snake carrying the ghost holds the Self position.
How can one know that ghosts and strange things appear in a household?
The Coiling Snake and the White Tiger sit at the door.
How can one know that someone in a household will throw himself into water?
The Dark Tortoise enters Water and a killing spirit sits on the ghost.
How can one know that someone in a household will hang himself?
The Coiling Snake and a Wood ghost sit on the Self line.
How can one know that mourning dress will come to a household?
The stars Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence are set upon the ghost.

chapter: 阐奥歌章·二十二、疾病章
title: 疾病先将身命看：逢龙见子放心宽；妻财入命多沉重、官鬼临身更不堪；身犯勾陈凶有准、命加玄武瘥应难；螣蛇白虎忧丧事、身命空亡定入棺；金鬼值身伤骨节、水鬼血浓攒、火鬼疮痍恼、木鬼百骨酸、土鬼肿胀；杀刑加命命摧残

rule.yi: 疾病先要看身和命：遇到青龙、见到子孙，可以放心。妻财入了命，多半沉重；官鬼临在身上，更加不堪。身犯勾陈，凶是有准的；命上加了玄武，痊愈就难。螣蛇、白虎，忧的是丧事；身命落空亡，一定入棺。金鬼值身，伤骨节；身临水鬼，血液浓稠聚积；贴着身的火鬼，疮痍烦恼；木鬼在身宫，百骨酸痛；土鬼在身，身体肿胀；杀和刑加在命上，命被摧残。
rule.en: In illness first look at the Body and the natal line: meeting the Dragon and seeing Output, set the heart at ease. Wealth entering the natal line: mostly heavy; the Pressure line sitting on the Body: still worse. The Body offending Hook Earth: ill is certain; the natal line with the Dark Tortoise added: recovery is surely hard. The Coiling Snake and White Tiger: worry of a funeral; the Body and natal line Void: he will surely enter the coffin. A Metal ghost on the Body: injury to the bone joints; the Body on a Water ghost: blood thick and gathered; a Fire ghost close to the Body: the vexation of sores; a Wood ghost in the Body palace: all the bones ache; an Earth ghost on the Body: the body swells; a killing and punishment added to the natal line: life is ruined.

note.yi: 这一首（阐奥歌章疾病章第一首）很长，共十九联，这里分成三条：头七联（身命）在这一条，中间五联（五行脏腑、八卦部位）在 LY.ILL.CA.02，末六联（凶卦、化爻）在 LY.ILL.CA.03。「逢龙见子放心宽」的「龙」是青龙，「子」是子孙；「身」「命」是卦身和本命（病人的本命爻），本歌诀这样并称。「贴身火鬼」按字面译作「close to the Body」。「血浓攒」按「血液浓稠聚积」译，字面不确定。这一首在断易天机里也有，题作「孙膑断疾病歌」（见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.02 一带）。周易尚占的疾厄部（第 781–784 行）把这一首几乎原样收了一遍，字句有三处不同：「螣蛇」写作「腾蛇」（同一个神，字形不同）；「身临水鬼血浓攒」写作「身中水鬼血脓钻」（「脓」是脓，「浓」是浓稠；「钻」是往里钻，「攒」是聚积）；「木鬼身宫百骨酸」写作「木鬼身宫有骨酸」。
note.en: This first poem of the Chan'ao Gezhang's chapter on illness is very long, nineteen couplets, and is divided here into three entries: the first seven couplets (the Body and the natal line) in this entry, the middle five (the five phases and viscera, the trigrams and body parts) in LY.ILL.CA.02, and the last six (the ominous hexagrams, changing lines) in LY.ILL.CA.03. The 'Dragon' of 'meeting the Dragon and seeing Output' is the Azure Dragon, and 'Output' is the Output line; the 'Body' and 'natal line' are the hexagram's Body and the sick person's natal line, which the verse names together. 'A Fire ghost close to the Body' is rendered literally as 'close to the Body'. 'Xue nong zan' is translated as 'blood thick and gathered', the literal sense being uncertain. This poem is also in the Duanyi Tianji, titled 'Sun Bin's song on judging illness' (see LY.ILL.DYTJ.02 and around). The Zhouyi Shangzhan's section on illness and affliction (lines 781–784) takes this poem over almost word for word; the wording differs in three places: 'Coiling Snake' is written with a variant character for 'Coiling' (the same spirit); 'a Water ghost close to the Body, blood thick and gathered' is written 'a Water ghost within the Body, blood and pus boring in' ('pus' where the Bushi Daquan has 'thick', and 'boring in' where it has 'gathered'); and 'a Wood ghost in the Body palace, a hundred bones aching' is written 'a Wood ghost in the Body palace, the bones ache'.

yi: 疾病要先看身和命，
遇到青龙、见到子孙，放心宽慰。
妻财入了命，多半沉重；
官鬼临在身上，更加不堪。
身犯勾陈，凶是有准的；
命上加了玄武，痊愈就难。
螣蛇、白虎，忧的是丧事；
身命落了空亡，一定入棺。
金鬼值身，伤骨节；
身临水鬼，血液浓稠聚积；
贴身的火鬼，疮痍烦恼；
木鬼在身宫，百骨酸痛；
土鬼在身，身体肿胀；
杀和刑加在命上，命被摧残。
en: In illness first look at the Body and the natal line:
meeting the Dragon and seeing Output, set the heart at ease.
Wealth entering the natal line: mostly heavy;
the Pressure line sitting on the Body: still worse.
the Body offending Hook Earth: ill is certain;
the natal line with the Dark Tortoise added: recovery is surely hard.
the Coiling Snake and White Tiger: worry of a funeral;
the Body and natal line Void: he will surely enter the coffin.
A Metal ghost on the Body: injury to the bone joints;
the Body on a Water ghost: blood thick and gathered;
a Fire ghost close to the Body: the vexation of sores;
a Wood ghost in the Body palace: all the bones ache;
an Earth ghost on the Body: the body swells;
a killing and punishment added to the natal line: life is ruined.

chapter: 阐奥歌章·二十二、疾病章
title: 五行脏腑与八卦部位：水腰肾、金肺、火心经、木肝，土爻脾胃休逢杀；乾首坤腹巽手震足兑口艮鼻坎耳离目；一宫杀旺一般灾、子动龙兴保平复；虎鬼同兴应哭泣、龙孙并旺保平安

rule.yi: 水是腰和肾，金是肺，火主心经，木主肝；土爻是脾胃，不要遇上杀；发动、交重时要仔细看。虎和鬼一起兴动，应该哭泣；龙和子孙一起旺，保平安。乾是头，坤是腹，巽是手，震是足，兑是口，艮是鼻，坎主耳，离主目。哪一宫杀旺，就是那一处的灾；子孙动、青龙兴，保平复。
rule.en: Water is the waist and kidneys, Metal the lungs; Fire governs the heart channel, Wood the liver; the Earth line is the spleen and stomach and must not meet a killing; if it moves or crosses heavily, look carefully. The Tiger and the ghost rising together: there will surely be weeping; the Dragon and Output both strong: peace is assured. Qian is the head and Kun the belly, Xun the hands and Zhen the feet, Dui the mouth and Gen the nose, Kan governs the ears and Li the eyes. Where a killing is strong in one palace, the calamity is the same there; with Output moving and the Dragon rising, recovery is assured.

dispute.yi: 八卦各管身体哪一处，几处说法不同。阐奥歌章这一首（LY.ILL.CA.02）是「乾首、坤腹、巽手、震足、兑口、艮鼻、坎耳、离目」，巽是手、艮是鼻；断易天机的孙膑断疾病歌（见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.03）是「乾首、坤腹、坎耳、震足、巽肠、艮手、兑口、离目」，巽是肠、艮是手；断易天机的卜筮元龟一段（见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.12）是「乾头、坤腹、坎耳、离目、兑口、艮手、震足、巽股」，巽是股、艮是手；卜筮正宗的痘疹章（LY.ILL.BSZZ.23）也是「乾头面、坤腹、震足、巽股、艮手、离目、坎耳、兑口」。乾、坤、坎、离、兑、震六个卦几家一致，不同的只是巽（手、肠或股）和艮（鼻或手）。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Which part of the body each of the eight trigrams governs is put differently in several places. This poem of the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.02) has 'Qian the head, Kun the belly, Xun the hands, Zhen the feet, Dui the mouth, Gen the nose, Kan the ears, Li the eyes', with Xun the hands and Gen the nose; Sun Bin's song in the Duanyi Tianji (see LY.ILL.DYTJ.03) has 'Qian the head, Kun the belly, Kan the ears, Zhen the feet, Xun the bowels, Gen the hands, Dui the mouth, Li the eyes', with Xun the bowels and Gen the hands; the Bushi Yuangui passage in the Duanyi Tianji (see LY.ILL.DYTJ.12) has 'Qian the head, Kun the belly, Kan the ears, Li the eyes, Dui the mouth, Gen the hands, Zhen the feet, Xun the thighs', with Xun the thighs and Gen the hands; and the smallpox chapter of the Bushi Zhengzong (LY.ILL.BSZZ.23) likewise has 'Qian the head and face, Kun the belly, Zhen the feet, Xun the thighs, Gen the hands, Li the eyes, Kan the ears, Dui the mouth'. Six of the trigrams (Qian, Kun, Kan, Li, Dui, Zhen) are agreed; the difference is only in Xun (the hands, bowels or thighs) and Gen (the nose or the hands). The books do not settle it.

note.yi: 这是第一首的中间十二句：五行配脏腑（水腰肾、金肺、火心、木肝、土脾胃），八卦配部位，和虎鬼同兴、龙孙并旺的判语。「龙孙」是青龙和子孙。「虎鬼同兴」的「虎」是白虎。「土爻脾胃休逢杀」按字面译作「the Earth line is the spleen and stomach and must not meet a killing」。「一宫杀旺一般灾」按字面译，意思是杀在哪一个卦宫旺，就是那一个卦所管的部位遭灾。前面的「水为腰肾金为肺」和黄金策、易隐的五行脏腑大体同一说（LY.ILL.YY.11、HJC.16 一带），只是这里水是「腰肾」、火是「心经」，没有小肠。周易尚占的疾厄部（第 784–785 行）里这一段有三处字不同：「水为腰肾金为肺」写作「水为腰肾金属肺」，「火主心经木主肝」写作「火主心胸木主肝」，「土爻脾胃休逢杀」写作「土爻脾位休逢杀」（脾「位」，不是脾「胃」）；八卦配部位那四联两本完全相同。
note.en: These are the middle twelve lines of the first poem: the five phases matched with the viscera (Water the waist and kidneys, Metal the lungs, Fire the heart, Wood the liver, Earth the spleen and stomach), the eight trigrams matched with body parts, and the verdicts 'the Tiger and the ghost rising together' and 'the Dragon and Output both strong'. 'The Dragon and Output' are the Azure Dragon and the Output line. The 'Tiger' of 'the Tiger and the ghost rising together' is the White Tiger. 'The Earth line is the spleen and stomach and must not meet a killing' is rendered literally. 'Where a killing is strong in one palace, the calamity is the same' says that where a killing is strong in a given palace, the part that trigram governs meets calamity. The earlier 'Water the waist and kidneys, Metal the lungs' is broadly the same as the five phases and viscera of the Huangjin Ce and the Yi Yin (LY.ILL.YY.11, HJC.16 and around), only that here Water is 'waist and kidneys' and Fire 'the heart channel', without the small intestine. In the Zhouyi Shangzhan's section on illness and affliction (lines 784–785) this passage differs in three places: 'Water is the waist and kidneys, Metal the lungs' is written 'Water is the waist and kidneys, Metal belongs to the lungs'; 'Fire governs the heart channel, Wood the liver' is written 'Fire governs the heart and chest, Wood the liver'; and 'the Earth line is the spleen and stomach, do not meet a killing' is written 'the Earth line is the spleen position, do not meet a killing'. The four couplets matching the trigrams with body parts are identical in the two books.

yi: 水是腰和肾，金是肺，
火主心经，木主肝。
土爻是脾胃，不要遇上杀；
发动、交重，要仔细看。
虎和鬼一起兴动，应该哭泣；
龙和子孙一起旺，保平安。
乾是头啊坤是腹，
巽是手啊震是足，
兑是口啊艮是鼻，
坎主耳啊离主目。
哪一宫杀旺，就是同样的灾；
子动龙兴，保平复。
en: Water is the waist and kidneys, Metal the lungs;
Fire governs the heart channel, Wood the liver.
The Earth line is the spleen and stomach and must not meet a killing;
if it moves or crosses heavily, look carefully.
The Tiger and the ghost rising together: there will surely be weeping;
the Dragon and Output both strong: peace is assured.
Qian is the head and Kun the belly,
Xun the hands and Zhen the feet,
Dui the mouth and Gen the nose,
Kan governs the ears and Li the eyes.
Where a killing is strong in one palace, the calamity is the same there;
with Output moving and the Dragon rising, recovery is assured.

chapter: 阐奥歌章·二十二、疾病章
title: 凶卦与化爻：丰蛊困明夷夬同人一例推（冬旅春需、夏观秋剥并倾危）；六爻安静尤难瘥、杀鬼交重便莫医；财旺身空身必丧、官生命死命应衰；两重官鬼因劳复；鬼化兄病不宜、化财凶有准、化子瘥无疑

rule.yi: 丰、蛊、困、明夷，夬和同人，一样推断；冬天的旅、春天的需，都困重；夏天的观、秋天的剥，都倾危。六爻安静，尤其难痊；杀和鬼交重，就不要医。财旺而身空，身一定丧；官生而命死，命应衰。两重官鬼，是因劳累复发；鬼化为兄，病不宜；鬼化为财，凶有准；鬼爻化子，痊愈无疑。
rule.en: Feng together with Gu, Kun (Confinement) and Mingyi, and Guai and Tongren: reason the same for all; in winter Lü, in spring Xu: all are trapped and heavy; in summer Guan, in autumn Bo: all topple and are in danger. With the six lines still it is still harder to recover; with killing and ghost crossing heavily one cannot treat it. Wealth strong and the Body Void: the body will surely be lost; the Pressure line alive and the natal line dead: life is surely weak. Two Pressure lines: a relapse from overwork; a ghost changing into Peer: the illness is not favourable; a ghost changing into Wealth: ill is certain; a Pressure line changing into Output: recovery is beyond doubt.

dispute.yi: 哪几个卦占病最凶，几本书的名单不同。阐奥歌章这一首（LY.ILL.CA.03）是丰、蛊、困、明夷、夬、同人一例，冬旅、春需、夏观、秋剥；第四首（LY.ILL.CA.06）是明夷、蛊、夬、剥、丰、同，第五首是丰、观、需、节、旅、贲、临、明夷、蛊、夬、同人；天玄赋（LY.ILL.TXF.06）是明夷、观、贲、需、临（世身入墓）和大畜、丰、同、蛊、夬（财鬼俱兴）；断易天机的卜筮元龟一段（LY.ILL.DYTJ.15）是丰、观、需、剥、节、旅、贲、明夷、蛊、夬、同人「十死分明」。名单大同小异：丰、蛊、夬、同人、明夷几乎处处都在，观、需、贲、旅、剥、节、临、大畜则有的有、有的没有。书里没有裁决。周易尚占（LY.ILL.ZSZ.02 至 ZSZ.05）和文王金钱课（LY.ILL.WWJQ.03、WWJQ.05）也按卦名断病，和这个名单有出入：观，周易尚占说「财聚病痊」，文王金钱课说「占病即愈」「疾病皆除」；丰，文王金钱课说「疾病渐好」，周易尚占说「病人沉滞」；夬，周易尚占说「病讼迟延」，文王金钱课补录部分说「疾病除根」；蛊、困、明夷三卦，周易尚占也说病凶或「件件遭伤」，和这个名单一致（文王金钱课对这三卦没有讲病）。
dispute.en: Which hexagrams are worst in divining illness is listed differently by several books. This poem of the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.03) has Feng, Gu, Kun, Mingyi, Guai and Tongren alike, with Lü in winter, Xu in spring, Guan in summer and Bo in autumn; its fourth poem (LY.ILL.CA.06) has Mingyi, Gu, Guai, Bo, Feng and Tong, and its fifth Feng, Guan, Xu, Jie, Lü, Bi, Lin, Mingyi, Gu, Guai and Tongren; the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.06) has Mingyi, Guan, Bi, Xu and Lin (the Self and Body entering a tomb) and Daxu, Feng, Tong, Gu and Guai (Wealth and the ghost both rising); the Bushi Yuangui passage in the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.DYTJ.15) has Feng, Guan, Xu, Bo, Jie, Lü, Bi, Mingyi, Gu, Guai and Tongren, 'the ten deaths plain'. The lists are much alike with small differences: Feng, Gu, Guai, Tongren and Mingyi are almost everywhere, and Guan, Xu, Bi, Lü, Bo, Jie, Lin and Daxu are in some and not in others. The books do not settle it. The Zhouyi Shangzhan (LY.ILL.ZSZ.02 to ZSZ.05) and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke (LY.ILL.WWJQ.03, WWJQ.05) also judge illness by the name of the hexagram, and differ from this list: for Guan (Viewing) the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'wealth gathers and the illness is cured' and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says 'divining illness, it is cured at once' and 'illness all removed'; for Feng (Abundance) the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says 'the illness gradually gets better' and the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the sick are held fast'; for Guai (Breakthrough) the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'illness and lawsuit are delayed' and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke, in its supplementary part, says 'the illness is rooted out'; for Gu (Decay), Kun (Confinement) and Mingyi (Brightness Wounded) the Zhouyi Shangzhan also says the illness is ominous or 'every matter meets injury', which agrees with this list (the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says nothing of illness for these three).

note.yi: 这是第一首的末六联。「困」是困卦，按「Kun （Confinement）」译；「旅」「需」「观」「剥」是卦名，前面加季节：冬旅、春需、夏观、秋剥，是说这几个卦在这个季节占病特别凶（按季节各有一个卦）。「官生命死命应衰」文字费解，按字面译：官（鬼）在长生、命在死。「两重官鬼因劳复」的「劳复」是病愈后因劳累而复发（中医词）。「六爻安静尤难瘥」和天玄赋「卦爻安静，重为济世之人」（LY.ILL.TXF.14）、野鹤「六爻安静、卦吉可以调理」（LY.ILL.ZS.22）正好相反：这里说安静更难愈——三家说法不同，书里没有裁决。周易尚占的疾厄部（第 787–790 行）里这一段有两处字不同：「六爻安静尤难瘥」写作「六爻安静犹难瘥」（「犹」，不是「尤」，意思差不多，都是还更难愈）；「鬼化为财凶有准」写作「官化为财凶有定」（官和鬼在这里是同一个爻；「有定」「有准」都是说一定）。
note.en: These are the last six couplets of the first poem. 'Kun' is the hexagram Kun (Confinement); 'Lü', 'Xu', 'Guan' and 'Bo' are hexagram names, each given a season: Lü in winter, Xu in spring, Guan in summer, Bo in autumn, meaning that these hexagrams are especially ominous in divining illness in that season (one hexagram for each season). 'The Pressure line alive and the natal line dead' is hard to understand and is rendered literally: the Pressure line at Birth and the natal line at Death. The 'relapse' of 'two Pressure lines: a relapse from overwork' is illness returning through exertion after recovery (a term of Chinese medicine). 'With the six lines still it is still harder to recover' is exactly the opposite of the Tianxuan Fu's 'the hexagram and lines still, weighty is he who saves the world' (LY.ILL.TXF.14) and the Old Man of Yehe's 'six lines still and the hexagram auspicious, it can be treated by nursing' (LY.ILL.ZS.22): here it says that stillness makes recovery harder — the three differ, and the books do not settle it. In the Zhouyi Shangzhan's section on illness and affliction (lines 787–790) this passage differs in two places: 'with the six lines still it is still harder to recover' is written with a different word for 'still' (the sense is about the same: harder still to recover); and 'a ghost changing into Wealth: ill is certain' is written 'Pressure changing into Wealth: ill is fixed' (Pressure and ghost are the same line here; 'fixed' and 'certain' both say it is sure).

yi: 丰，加上蛊、困和明夷，
夬和同人，一样推断。
冬天的旅、春天的需，都困重；
夏天的观、秋天的剥，都倾危。
六爻安静，尤其难痊；
杀和鬼交重，就不要医了。
财旺而身空，身一定丧；
官生而命死，命应衰弱。
两重官鬼，是因劳累而复发；
鬼化为兄，病不适宜；
鬼化为财，凶是有准的；
鬼爻化为子，痊愈无疑。
en: Feng together with Gu, Kun (Confinement) and Mingyi,
and Guai and Tongren: reason the same for all.
in winter Lü, in spring Xu: all are trapped and heavy;
in summer Guan, in autumn Bo: all topple and are in danger.
With the six lines still it is still harder to recover;
with killing and ghost crossing heavily one cannot treat it.
Wealth strong and the Body Void: the body will surely be lost;
the Pressure line alive and the natal line dead: life is surely weak.
Two Pressure lines: a relapse from overwork;
a ghost changing into Peer: the illness is not favourable;
a ghost changing into Wealth: ill is certain;
a Pressure line changing into Output: recovery is beyond doubt.

chapter: 阐奥歌章·二十二、疾病章
title: 疾病歌(二)：凡占疾病先从卦中寻本命、仍看来者是何人（克者是何加世应）；福德持世鬼暂退、官旺之日又加进；卦中无鬼病难医、鬼旺财兴难保命；鬼杀临身五墓侵鬼神不应药无灵；一为五脏二皮肉三为体骨腰并足四肺心经五六头；游魂恍惚如神触、归魂渐向安

rule.yi: 凡是有人占疾病，先从卦里找本命，还要看来占的是什么人，克它的又是什么、加在世应上。福德持世，鬼暂时退去；官鬼旺相的日子又进一步。卦里没有鬼，病难医；鬼旺、财兴，难保命。鬼杀临在身上、又有五墓侵犯，鬼神不应验，药也无灵。第一爻是五脏，第二爻是皮肉，第三爻是体骨、腰和足；第四爻是肺和心经，第五、第六爻是头。游魂卦恍惚，像被神鬼触到；只有归魂卦，渐渐向安；吉凶我细细地为你嘱咐。
rule.en: If someone divines an illness, first look in the hexagram for the natal line, and still look at who has come, and what it is that controls, added to the Self and Other. Output holding the Self: the ghost retreats for a time; on a day when the Pressure line is strong it advances again. With no ghost in the hexagram the illness is hard to treat; with the ghost strong and Wealth rising life is hard to keep. A ghost-killing sitting on the Body with the Five Tombs invading: the ghosts and spirits do not respond and medicine has no effect. The first line is the five viscera, the second skin and flesh, the third body, bones, waist and feet; the fourth is the lungs and heart channel, the fifth and sixth the head. The Wandering Soul hexagram: dazed, as if touched by spirits; only the Returning Soul gradually turns to peace; good and ill I tell you in detail.

dispute.yi: 哪一爻管身体哪一处，几本书的说法差得很远。阐奥歌章这一首（LY.ILL.CA.04）是「一爻五脏、二爻皮肉、三爻体骨腰并足、四爻肺心经、五六爻头」，断易天机的孙膑断疾病歌（LY.ILL.DYTJ.03）同；断易天机卜筮元龟一段（见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.11）是「初爻两足、二爻双腿、三爻腰背、四爻心腹及肚肠、五爻肾脏、六爻头」；断易天机鬼谷辨爻法的表（LY.ILL.DYTJ.01）是「初足、二腿股、三腰、四脊、五心、六头」；易隐引鬼谷分爻（LY.ILL.YY.02）是「初爻足、二爻腿股、三爻肝肾、四爻脾脏、五爻心肺、六爻头脑」；卜筮大全卜筮全书歌诀里的六位取象表（见 LY.ILL.BSQS.01）疾病一行是「足、腿肢、（缺）、（缺）、心肺、头脑」。卜筮元龟、鬼谷辨爻法的表、易隐、六位表都是「初足、二腿、上头」，只有阐奥歌章和孙膑歌把初爻配成五脏、二爻配成皮肉。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Which line governs which part of the body is put very differently in several books. This poem of the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.04) has 'the first line the five viscera, the second skin and flesh, the third body, bones, waist and feet, the fourth lungs and heart channel, the fifth and sixth the head', and Sun Bin's song in the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.DYTJ.03) is the same; the Bushi Yuangui passage in the Duanyi Tianji (see LY.ILL.DYTJ.11) has 'the first line the two feet, the second both legs, the third waist and back, the fourth heart, belly and bowels, the fifth the kidneys, the sixth the head'; the table headed Guigu's method of telling the lines apart in the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.DYTJ.01) has 'first the feet, second the legs and thighs, third the waist, fourth the spine, fifth the heart, sixth the head'; the Yi Yin, quoting Guigu's division of the lines (LY.ILL.YY.02), has 'first the feet, second the legs and thighs, third liver and kidneys, fourth the spleen, fifth heart and lungs, sixth the head and brain'; and the table of the six positions in the verses of the Bushi Quanshu in the Buyi Daquan (see LY.ILL.BSQS.01) has for illness 'feet, legs and limbs, (missing), (missing), heart and lungs, head and brain'. The Bushi Yuangui, Guigu's table, the Yi Yin and the table of the six positions all run 'first line the feet, second the legs, top the head', and only the Chan'ao Gezhang and Sun Bin's song match the first line with the viscera and the second with skin and flesh. The books do not settle it.

note.yi: 这是第二首疾病歌，它在断易天机里作「孙膑断疾病歌」（从 LY.ILL.DYTJ.02 起到 LY.ILL.DYTJ.07，共六条），字句略有出入。「先从卦中寻本命」的「本命」是病人的本命爻（生年属相所在的爻）；「克者是何加世应」文字含混，按字面译。「福德持世鬼暂退，官旺之日又加进」是说子孙持世时鬼暂时退去，但官鬼旺相的日子又会进一步。「五墓」是五墓煞（春未、夏戌、秋丑、冬辰，见 LY.ILL.EL.51）。「游魂恍惚如神触」的「游魂」「归魂」是卦的名称（游魂卦、归魂卦），「恍惚」是神志不清。整首和易林补遗的「卦无用象」（LY.ILL.EL.10）、海底眼的「疾病」一节（LY.ILL.HDY.01）是同一类判据：先找本命、看来者何人、看鬼有无。
note.en: This is the second illness poem, which appears in the Duanyi Tianji as 'Sun Bin's song on judging illness' (six entries, LY.ILL.DYTJ.02 to LY.ILL.DYTJ.07), with slight differences in wording. The 'natal line' of 'first look in the hexagram for the natal line' is the sick person's natal line (the line where the birth animal falls); 'what it is that controls, added to the Self and Other' is loose in wording and is rendered literally. 'Output holding the Self, the ghost retreats for a time; on a day when the Pressure line is strong it advances again' says that when Output holds the Self the ghost retreats for a time, but on a day when the Pressure line is strong it advances again. The 'Five Tombs' is the Five Tombs killing (Wei in spring, Xu in summer, Chou in autumn, Chen in winter; see LY.ILL.EL.51). The 'Wandering Soul' and 'Returning Soul' of 'the Wandering Soul hexagram, dazed as if touched by spirits' are names of hexagrams (the Wandering Soul hexagram and the Returning Soul hexagram), and 'dazed' is clouded consciousness. The whole poem is on the same kind of criteria as the Yilin Buyi's 'when the hexagram has no Subject image' (LY.ILL.EL.10) and the Haidi Yan's section on illness (LY.ILL.HDY.01): first find the natal line, look at who has come, and look at whether there is a ghost.

yi: 凡是有人占疾病，
先从卦里找本命；
还要看来占的是什么人，
克它的是什么、加在世应上。
福德持世，鬼暂时退去；
官旺的日子又进一步。
卦里没有鬼，病难医；
鬼旺、财兴，难保命。
en: If someone divines an illness,
first look in the hexagram for the natal line;
and still look at who has come,
and what it is that controls, added to the Self and Other.
Output holding the Self: the ghost retreats for a time;
on a day when the Pressure line is strong it advances again.
With no ghost in the hexagram the illness is hard to treat;
with the ghost strong and Wealth rising life is hard to keep.

yi: 鬼杀临在身上，五墓侵犯，
鬼神不应验，药也无灵；
第一爻是五脏，第二爻是皮肉，
第三爻是体骨、腰和足；
en: A ghost-killing sitting on the Body with the Five Tombs invading:
the ghosts and spirits do not respond and medicine has no effect;
the first line is the five viscera, the second skin and flesh,
the third body, bones, waist and feet;

yi: 第四爻是肺和心经，第五、第六爻是头；
游魂卦恍惚，像被神鬼触到；
只有归魂卦，渐渐向安；
吉凶我细细地为你嘱咐。
en: the fourth is the lungs and heart channel, the fifth and sixth the head;
the Wandering Soul hexagram: dazed, as if touched by spirits;
only the Returning Soul gradually turns to peace;
good and ill I tell you in detail.

chapter: 阐奥歌章·二十二、疾病章
title: 占病先须问六亲：父母空亡防父母、财爻无气损妻身、子孙化鬼须遭死、兄弟杀临定不贞

rule.yi: 占病先要问是哪一层亲人，吉凶必须问清楚。父母爻空亡，要防父母；财爻无气，妻子受损；子孙化成鬼，必定遭死；兄弟爻上有杀，一定不吉。
rule.en: In divining illness first ask which of the relations it is; good and ill must be made clear. Resource Void: guard the parents; the Wealth line without qi: the wife is harmed; Output changing into a ghost will meet death; Peer with a killing sitting on it is surely not steadfast.

note.yi: 这是第三首。「父母空亡防父母，财爻无气损妻身」是说占哪一层亲人就看哪一层的爻（父母爻、财爻）有没有气，和天玄赋「杀临父母，当忧堂上之亲；空及妻财，灾虑闺中之妇」（LY.ILL.TXF.01）、易林补遗「谁爻化鬼谁人犯」（LY.ILL.EL.02）是同一个思路。「不贞」按字面译作「not steadfast」，意思是不吉利、靠不住。
note.en: This is the third poem. 'Resource Void: guard the parents; the Wealth line without qi: the wife is harmed' says that one looks at the line of the relation asked about (the Resource line, the Wealth line) to see whether it has qi, on the same line of thought as the Tianxuan Fu's 'a killing sitting on Resource, worry for the parents in the hall; Void reaching Wealth, fear calamity for the woman in the inner chamber' (LY.ILL.TXF.01) and the Yilin Buyi's 'whose line changes into a ghost, that person is struck' (LY.ILL.EL.02). 'Bu zhen' is rendered literally as 'not steadfast', and means not auspicious and not to be relied on.

yi: 占病先要问是哪一层亲人，
吉凶必须问得分明。
父母爻空亡，要防父母；
财爻无气，妻子受损；
子孙化为鬼，必定遭死；
兄弟爻上有杀，一定不吉。
en: In divining illness first ask which of the relations it is;
good and ill must be made clear.
Resource Void: guard the parents;
the Wealth line without qi: the wife is harmed;
Output changing into a ghost will meet death;
Peer with a killing sitting on it is surely not steadfast.

chapter: 阐奥歌章·二十二、疾病章
title: 占病凶卦二首：明夷蛊夬剥丰同六卦哪堪占病，财鬼二爻俱发动丧门吊客闹丛丛；丰观需节旅贲临明夷蛊夬及同人占病若逢此卦归家急急办前程

rule.yi: 明夷、蛊、夬、剥、丰、同（人）这六个卦，怎么经得起占病的凶；财、鬼两爻都发动，丧门、吊客热闹地聚在一起。丰、观、需、节、旅、贲、临，明夷、蛊、夬和同人，占病如果遇到这些卦，赶紧回家去办后事。
rule.en: Mingyi, Gu, Guai, Bo, Feng and Tong(ren): how can these six hexagrams bear the ill of divining illness; with Wealth and the ghost both moving, Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence crowd noisily together. Feng, Guan, Xu, Jie, Lü, Bi and Lin, Mingyi, Gu, Guai and Tongren: if in divining illness one meets these hexagrams, hurry home and make ready for what lies ahead.

dispute.yi: 周易尚占和文王金钱课按卦名断病，和第五首这个名单有出入：观，周易尚占说「财聚病痊」，文王金钱课说「占病即愈」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.02、WWJQ.03）；贲，周易尚占说「病安」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.03）；节，文王金钱课说「疾病口舌消除安」（LY.ILL.WWJQ.03）；丰，文王金钱课说「疾病渐好」，周易尚占说「病人沉滞」（LY.ILL.WWJQ.03、ZSZ.04）；夬，周易尚占说「病讼迟延」，文王金钱课补录部分说「疾病除根」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.04、WWJQ.05）；临，周易尚占说「病犯崇侵」，文王金钱课补录部分说「疾病即痊」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.07、WWJQ.05）；蛊、明夷，周易尚占不说吉，和名单一致（LY.ILL.ZSZ.05）；文王金钱课对这两卦没有讲病。
dispute.en: The Zhouyi Shangzhan and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke judge illness by the name of the hexagram and differ from the list of the fifth poem: for Guan the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'wealth gathers and the illness is cured' and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says 'divining illness, it is cured at once' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.02, WWJQ.03); for Bi (Adornment) the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the illness is settled' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.03); for Jie (Restraint) the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says 'illness and quarrels are removed and all is at peace' (LY.ILL.WWJQ.03); for Feng the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says 'the illness gradually gets better' and the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the sick are held fast' (LY.ILL.WWJQ.03, ZSZ.04); for Guai the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'illness and lawsuit are delayed' and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke, in its supplementary part, says 'the illness is rooted out' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.04, WWJQ.05); for Lin (Approach) the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the illness offends a curse that attacks' and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke, in its supplementary part, says 'the illness is cured at once' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.07, WWJQ.05); for Gu and Mingyi the Zhouyi Shangzhan speaks of no good fortune, which agrees with the list (LY.ILL.ZSZ.05), and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says nothing of illness for these two.

note.yi: 这是第四、五首。两首列的凶卦名单和第一首（LY.ILL.CA.03）、天玄赋（LY.ILL.TXF.06）不完全一样，名单的比较见 LY.ILL.CA.03 的「打架」一栏。「同」「节」「旅」「贲」「丰」等是卦名，「同」按上下文是同人。「丧门吊客闹丛丛」的「丛丛」是热闹聚在一起的样子。「归家急急办前程」的「办前程」按字面译作「make ready for what lies ahead」，意思是赶紧回家料理后事。
note.en: These are the fourth and fifth poems. The lists of ominous hexagrams in the two poems are not exactly the same as in the first poem (LY.ILL.CA.03) and the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.06); the comparison of the lists is in the 'dispute' field of LY.ILL.CA.03. 'Tong', 'Jie', 'Lü', 'Bi', 'Feng' and so on are hexagram names, and 'Tong' is Tongren from the context. The 'cong cong' of 'Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence crowd noisily' is a crowd gathering noisily. 'Ban qian cheng' in 'go home in haste and make ready for what lies ahead' is rendered literally as 'make ready for what lies ahead', meaning to hurry home and see to the funeral.

yi: 明夷、蛊、夬、剥、丰、同（人），
这六个卦怎么经得起占病的凶；
财、鬼两爻都发动，
丧门、吊客热闹地聚在一起。
en: Mingyi, Gu, Guai, Bo, Feng and Tong(ren):
how can these six hexagrams bear the ill of divining illness;
with Wealth and the ghost both moving,
Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence crowd noisily together.

yi: 丰、观、需、节、旅、贲、临，
明夷、蛊、夬和同人；
占病如果遇到这些卦，
赶紧回家去办后事。
en: Feng, Guan, Xu, Jie, Lü, Bi (Adornment), Lin,
Mingyi, Gu, Guai and Tongren:
if in divining illness one meets these hexagrams,
hurry home and make ready for what lies ahead.

chapter: 阐奥歌章·二十二、疾病章
title: 六亲占病六首：子占亲病（子要兴隆父要安、兄动缠绵、子兴财发入黄泉）；父占子病（兄兴子动死还生、鬼摇父动难保、财动病增）；夫问妻疾（财明子动便安然、鬼爻发动沉重、父发兄摇定断弦）；妻占夫病（鬼静财兴可放心、兄子交重恩义绝、父摇难愈）；兄弟占病（父兴兄静自安全、鬼摇财动黄泉客、子动留连数日）；奴婢疾病（鬼摇更连绵、财安子发无事、父动兄兴不得痊）

rule.yi: 子占父母的病：什么时候好？子孙要兴隆，父母要安。兄动，缠绵难脱体；子孙兴、财发，入黄泉。父占子病：兄兴、子动，死里逃生；鬼摇、父动，终究难保；财动，缠绵，病反增。夫问妻的病：财明、子动，便安然；鬼爻发动，还沉重；父发、兄摇，定断弦。妻占夫的病：鬼静、财兴，可以放心；兄、子交重，恩义断绝；父摇，难愈，病沉沉。兄弟来占病：父兴、兄静，自然安全；鬼摇、财动，黄泉客；子动，留连几日卧床。奴婢的病：鬼摇，病更连绵；财安、子发，没有别的事；父动、兄兴，不得痊愈。
rule.en: A son divining a parent's illness, when will it be cured? Output must thrive and Resource must be at peace; Peer moving, it drags on and is hard to shake off; Output rising and Wealth moving, it enters the Yellow Springs. A parent divining a child's illness: Peer rising and Output moving, one dies and yet lives; the ghost shaking and Resource moving, in the end he cannot be kept; Wealth moving, it drags on and the illness increases. A husband asking of his wife's illness: Wealth clear and Output moving, at once she is at ease; the Pressure line moving, it is still heavy; Resource issuing and Peer shaking, surely the string is cut. A wife divining her husband's illness: the ghost still and Wealth rising, one may set the heart at rest; Peer and Output crossing heavily, love and duty are cut; Resource shaking, hard to cure, the illness deep. Brothers coming to divine an illness: Resource rising and Peer still, of itself safe; the ghost shaking and Wealth moving, a guest of the Yellow Springs; Output moving, it lingers several days in bed. A servant's illness: the ghost shaking, the illness drags on the more; Wealth at peace and Output issuing, no other matter; Resource moving and Peer rising, no recovery.

dispute.yi: 子占父母病要哪一爻兴隆，两个抄本不同。阐奥歌章（LY.ILL.CA.07）是「子占亲病几时痊，子要兴隆父要安」——要子孙兴隆、父母安静；断易天机（见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.08）同一首作「鬼要兴隆父要安」——要官鬼兴隆、父母安静。「子孙旺」是医药有力、能制鬼，「官鬼兴隆」却是病重，前一种更合病理，后一种文字上可能是「子」字误作「鬼」，书里没有说明，这里只如实并列。
dispute.en: Which line must thrive when a son divines a parent's illness differs in the two copies. The Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.07) has 'a son divining a parent's illness, when will it be cured: Output must thrive and Resource must be at peace' — Output thriving and Resource at peace; the Duanyi Tianji (see LY.ILL.DYTJ.08) has the same poem as 'the ghost must thrive and Resource must be at peace' — the Pressure line thriving and Resource at peace. Output being strong means the medicine is effective and can control the ghost, while the Pressure line thriving means the illness is heavy: the first agrees better with the logic of illness, and the second may be a miswriting of 'ghost' for 'Output', which the book does not explain, and here the two are only set side by side.

note.yi: 这六首（第六到第十一首）是按病人和占卜人的关系分的六亲占病歌：子占父母、父占子、夫占妻、妻占夫、兄弟占、奴婢占。每首都是「哪一爻动、哪一爻静、哪一爻兴」几个组合的吉凶。「断弦」是妻子去世的委婉说法（琴弦断了）；「黄泉客」是死亡；「财明」是财爻明显出现；「恩义绝」是夫妻情义断绝（兄弟克财而说兄弟伤妻的说法，原文没有解释）。这六首在断易天机里作「经验论家人占病」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.08），文字略有出入（除了上面「打架」里那一处，还有「妻问夫病」等）。用爻表是：子占父母看父母、父占子看子孙、夫占妻看财、妻占夫看鬼（见 LY.ILL.TXF.01）。第十首「兄弟来占疾病缠」的「兄弟」是兄弟这个亲人，不是兄弟爻。
note.en: These six poems (the sixth to the eleventh) are poems for divining illness by relations, divided by the relation between the sick person and the diviner: a son about a parent, a parent about a child, a husband about a wife, a wife about a husband, a brother, and a servant. Each is the good or ill of a few combinations of 'which line moves, which stays still, which rises'. 'Duan xian' (the string cut) is a delicate way of saying the wife has died (a broken zither string); 'guest of the Yellow Springs' is death; 'Wealth clear' is the Wealth line clearly appearing; 'love and duty cut' is the bond between the couple cut off (the original does not explain why Peer and Output should cut a husband's love from his wife). In the Duanyi Tianji these six appear as 'verses from experience on divining illness by family members' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.08), with slight differences in wording (besides the one place in the 'dispute' above, also 'the wife asks of her husband's illness' and so on). The table of the Subject line: a son about a parent looks at Resource, a parent about a child at Output, a husband about a wife at Wealth, a wife about a husband at the ghost (see LY.ILL.TXF.01). The 'brothers' of the tenth poem, 'brothers come to divine an illness that clings', are brothers as relatives and not the Peer line.

yi: 子占父母的病，什么时候能好？
子孙要兴隆，父母要安静。
兄动，缠绵难脱体；
子孙兴、财发，入黄泉。
en: A son divining a parent's illness, when will it be cured?
Output must thrive and Resource must be at peace.
Peer moving, it drags on and is hard to shake off;
Output rising and Wealth moving, it enters the Yellow Springs.

yi: 子病，亲人来问卦灵不灵：
兄兴、子动，死里逃生；
鬼摇、父动，终究难保；
财动，缠绵，病反而增加。
en: A child ill, a parent comes to ask the hexagram:
Peer rising and Output moving, one dies and yet lives;
the ghost shaking and Resource moving, in the end he cannot be kept;
Wealth moving, it drags on and the illness increases.

yi: 丈夫问妻子的病被煎熬：
财明、子动，便安然；
鬼爻发动，还沉重；
父发、兄摇，一定断弦（妻亡）。
en: A husband asking of his wife's illness that torments her:
Wealth clear and Output moving, at once she is at ease;
the Pressure line moving, it is still heavy;
Resource issuing and Peer shaking, surely the string is cut (the wife dies).

yi: 妻子占丈夫的病，还不安宁：
鬼静、财兴，可以放心；
兄、子交重，恩义断绝；
父摇，难愈，病沉沉。
en: A wife divining her husband's illness, unsettled:
the ghost still and Wealth rising, one may set the heart at rest;
Peer and Output crossing heavily, love and duty are cut;
Resource shaking, hard to cure, the illness deep.

yi: 兄弟来占病缠身：
父兴、兄静，自然安全；
鬼摇、财动，是黄泉的客人；
子动，留连几日卧床。
en: When a brother comes to divine an illness that clings:
Resource rising and Peer still, of itself safe;
the ghost shaking and Wealth moving, a guest of the Yellow Springs;
Output moving, it lingers several days in bed.

yi: 奴婢缠绵于疾病：
鬼摇，病更连绵；
财安、子发，没有别的事；
父动、兄兴，不得痊愈。
en: A servant lingering in an illness that clings:
the ghost shaking, the illness drags on the more;
Wealth at peace and Output issuing, no other matter;
Resource moving and Peer rising, no recovery.

chapter: 阐奥歌章·二十三、医药章
title: 医药章(一)：子孙出现是医人、生世生身药必灵；两个子孙齐发动换医困厄即时平；子囚医拙、子旺医明；无子病人难服药、子空患者便归程；子孙值土宜丸散、火艾火蒸、木咬咀、金针刺、水汤药；青龙独发最为良、持世生身便离床；子孙同位发不须服药；鬼财安贴无忧虑、身世比和大吉祥；何日瘥：鬼衰身旺世生方

rule.yi: 子孙出现就是医生，生世、生身，药一定灵验。两个子孙一起发动，换医生，困厄立刻平息。子孙被囚，医生笨拙，没有功效；子孙旺，医生高明，有准绳。没有子孙，病人难服药；子孙空亡，患者就要归去了。子孙值土，宜丸散；值火，要用艾火熏蒸；遇木，用咬咀才对症；逢金，用针刺才保平安；子孙值水，宜汤药；有天喜扶持，妙不可言。青龙独发，最好；持世生身，便可离床；再有子孙同位发动，不必服药，保安康。鬼、财安贴，没有忧虑；身、世比和，大吉祥。想问病人哪一天痊愈？鬼衰、身旺、世生的时候。
