Water having its Long Life at Shen moves to generate it,
the Wood line is again of use.
like a person in hard straits
who meets a patron to support him,
there is surely the look of spring returning to a cold valley;
this is meeting life in a place of extinction.

yi: 占病时：
用爻和吉神在绝处逢生，
病将死而又活过来；
鬼爻和忌神在绝处逢生，
病快要好了却又发作。
en: Divining illness:
if the Subject line and a lucky spirit meet life in a place of extinction,
the illness about to end in death revives;
if the Pressure line and the Adversary meet life in a place of extinction,
the illness about to settle breaks out again.

title: 合处逢冲·占病：惟有占讼与病喜遇合处逢冲；合则事必成、逢冲灾必散、事将危而有救病欲死而复生；吉神合处不可冲、凶神合处喜逢冲

rule.yi: 合处逢冲：比如占得雷地豫卦，世应相生，六爻相合，吉，没有不利的，是事事可以成的样子；却是在子日占得，子冲应上的午、害世上的未，这就是合处逢冲。只有占官司和占病，喜欢遇到合处逢冲：合，事就一定成；逢冲，灾就一定散；事将危而有救，病欲死而复生。其余照这样类推。又说：吉神合的地方不可以冲，凶神合的地方喜欢逢冲。大概可以照这个断。
rule.en: A clash where there is a combination: for example, divining the hexagram Thunder over Earth, Yu: the Self and the Other generate each other, the six lines combine, lucky and nothing unfavourable, the image of every matter succeeding; but it is divined on a Zi day, and Zi clashes with the Wu on the Other line and harms the Wei on the Self line, which is meeting a clash where there is a combination. Only in divining a lawsuit and an illness is meeting a clash where there is a combination welcome: combining, the matter surely succeeds; meeting a clash, calamity surely scatters; a matter about to be in danger is rescued, an illness about to end in death revives. The rest follow this. It also says: where a lucky spirit combines it must not be clashed, and where a fierce spirit combines a clash is welcome. One may perhaps follow this judgement.

note.yi: 「合处逢冲」一章的总句是：吉事逢合本来好，若在合的地方遇冲，事情将成而破。占婚、占官、占财、谋事都是这样，只有占官司和占病是例外：那两样要的是灾散，逢冲正好。这一条是占病那一句：病快要死了逢冲就活。「子冲应上午、害世上未」是子日冲午、又害未（子未相害）。这一句和这本书的「逢冲」一章（LY.ILL.DYTJ.28）一起，是冲在病里的两面：合处逢冲救病，静爻遇日冲叫暗动，吉凶都有。另外，天玄赋的「月解交重灾渐退」（LY.ILL.TXF.05）也是把灾冲散一类。
note.en: The general statement of the chapter 'a clash where there is a combination' is that a lucky matter meeting a combination is good, but if it meets a clash in the place of the combination, the matter about to succeed is broken. It is so in divining marriage, office, wealth and planning a matter, and only in divining a lawsuit and an illness is it the exception: those two want calamity to scatter, and meeting a clash is just right. This entry is the sentence on illness: an illness about to end in death lives on meeting a clash. 'Zi clashes with the Wu on the Other line and harms the Wei on the Self line' is the Zi day clashing with Wu and also harming Wei (Zi and Wei harm each other). This sentence together with the chapter of this book on 'meeting a clash' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.28) gives the two sides of a clash in illness: a clash where there is a combination saves the illness, and a still line meeting a day clash is called a hidden movement, with both luck and ill. The Tianxuan Fu's 'when the Month resolves and the Day moves heavily calamity fades' (LY.ILL.TXF.05) is also of the kind that scatters calamity.

yi: 比如占到雷地豫卦。
世应相生，
六爻相合，
吉，没有不利的，
是事事可以成的样子。
却是在子日占到的，
子冲应爻上的午、又害世爻上的未，
这就是合处逢冲。
en: Suppose the divination gets the Yu hexagram, Thunder over Earth.
The Self and the Other generate each other,
the six lines combine,
lucky and nothing unfavourable,
the image of every matter succeeding.
But it is got on a Zi day,
and Zi clashes the Wu on the Other line and harms the Wei on the Self line;
this is 'meeting a clash where there was combination'.

zh: 事将危而有救、病欲死而复生。
yi: 只有占官司和占病，
喜欢遇到合处逢冲。
合，事就一定成；
逢冲，灾就一定散；
事将危而有救，病欲死而复生。
其余照这样类推。
书里又有一首说：
吉神合的地方不可以冲，
凶神合的地方喜欢逢冲。
大概可以照这个断。
en: Only in divining a lawsuit and an illness
is meeting a clash where there is a combination welcome.
Combining, the matter surely succeeds;
meeting a clash, calamity surely scatters;
a matter about to be in danger is rescued, an illness about to end in death revives.
The rest follow this.
The book also has another verse, which says:
where a lucky spirit combines it must not be clashed,
and where a fierce spirit combines a clash is welcome.
one may perhaps follow this judgement.

hits.text: 事将危而有救、病欲死而复生
事将危而有救、病欲死而复生

title: 随官入墓·占病：身随鬼入墓、世随鬼入墓、命随鬼入墓，不问占何事皆非吉兆；占病遇之十占九死

rule.yi: 随官入墓有三种：身随鬼入墓、世随鬼入墓、命随鬼入墓。以上三种墓，不问占什么事，都不是吉兆。占病遇到它，十占里有九个死。
rule.en: Following the ghost into a tomb has three kinds: the Body following the ghost into a tomb, the Self following the ghost into a tomb, and the natal line following the ghost into a tomb. These three tombs, whatever is divined, are none of them a lucky sign. Divining illness and meeting one, nine out of ten die.

note.yi: 「随官入墓」的三种（身、世、命随鬼入墓）在这本书里各有一个卦例（丑日占得雷水解卦、未日占得山天大畜、未日寅日生人占得地雷复……），例不收。这一条只收总句和占病的一句：「占病遇之，十占九死」。天玄赋的「入墓卦」（LY.ILL.TXF.06）说的是「世身随鬼入墓决不瘥」，这里多了「命随鬼入墓」（病人的本命爻随鬼入墓）。「命」是病人的本命爻，这一点和孙膑断疾病歌里「先从卦中寻本命」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.02）是同一个「命」。其余各事（占身、占婚、占产、求官、占讼、求财、出行、行人、家宅、移居、风水）的一句不在病的范围，不收。
note.en: Each of the three kinds of 'following the ghost into a tomb' (the Body, the Self and the natal line following the ghost into a tomb) has an example hexagram in this book (a Chou day divining Thunder over Water, Jie; a Wei day divining Mountain over Heaven, Daxu; a Wei day and a person born on a Yin day divining Earth over Thunder, Fu ...), and the examples are not taken. This entry takes only the general statement and the sentence on illness: 'divining illness and meeting it, nine out of ten die'. The Tianxuan Fu's 'hexagrams that enter tombs' (LY.ILL.TXF.06) says 'the Self and the Body following the ghost into a tomb surely does not recover', and here there is in addition 'the natal line following the ghost into a tomb' (the sick person's natal line following the ghost into a tomb). The 'natal line' is the sick person's natal line, the same 'natal line' as in 'first look in the hexagram for the natal line' in Sun Bin's song (LY.ILL.DYTJ.02). The sentences for the other matters (the person, marriage, childbirth, seeking office, lawsuit, wealth, travel, a traveller, the house, moving house, geomancy) are outside illness and are not taken.

yi: 跟着官鬼入墓，
它的名目有三种：
有卦身跟着鬼入墓，
有世爻跟着鬼入墓，
有本命跟着鬼入墓。
en: Following Pressure into the tomb
its kinds are three:
the Body following Pressure into the tomb,
the Self following Pressure into the tomb,
and the natal line following Pressure into the tomb.

yi: 以上三种入墓，
不管占什么事，
都不是吉兆。
en: Of these three tombs,
whatever is being divined,
none is an auspicious sign.

yi: 占病遇到它，
十占里有九个死。
en: Divining illness and meeting it,
nine out of ten die.

title: 逢冲暗动·占病：六爻安静不遇冲则不动、日辰相冲名曰暗动；凶煞暗动伤身克世百事不佳、吉神暗动合世生身事事吉；占病遇之吉则病人有默佑、凶则脉阴隙所致、病人不病须防暗有伤

rule.yi: 六爻安静，不遇到冲就不动；如果日辰来冲它，叫作暗动。暗动有吉有凶，各有各的用处，不可以一概而论：凶煞暗动、伤身克世，百事都不好；吉神暗动、合世生身，事事都吉。我推究它的意思：暗的一定不是明的，是阴私、潜藏的样子，福来了却不知道，祸来了却没有察觉；爻吉，暗中就有补益，爻凶，暗中就有伤害。占病遇到它：吉，就说病人有暗中的保佑；凶，就说是脉络里暗中的空隙造成的；病人若还没有发病，也要防暗中有伤。这一章宜细细玩味，就万无一失。
rule.en: When the six lines are still, they do not move unless they meet a clash; if the Day clashes with one, it is called a hidden movement. A hidden movement has luck and ill, each with its own use, and it cannot be judged all alike: a fierce killing moving hidden, injuring the Body and controlling the Self, is not good in all things; a lucky spirit moving hidden, combining with the Self and generating the Body, is lucky in everything. I work out its sense: what is hidden is surely not open, it is of the private and the concealed, fortune comes and one does not know it, calamity comes and one does not notice it; if the line is lucky there is help in secret, and if ominous there is injury in secret. Divining illness and meeting it: if lucky it is said the sick person has a silent protection; if ominous it is said to be caused by a hidden gap in the pulse; and if the sick person is not yet sick one must guard against a hidden injury. This chapter should be studied closely, and nothing will fail.

note.yi: 「暗动」是静爻遇日辰冲而动（见增删卜易的「暗动」）。这一章占婚、占产、占官、占讼、失脱、求财、出行、行人、家宅各有一句，这一条收占病那一句。「凶则言脉阴隙所致也」的「脉阴隙」意思读不确定，「阴隙」是暗中的缝隙，这里按「脉络里暗中的空隙」字面译；「病人不病须防暗有伤」的「病人不病」按「病人还没有发病」译，原文没有解释。「吉则言病人有默佑」的「默佑」是暗中的神佑。这一节和「合处逢冲」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.26）是冲在病里的两面。「（暗动）遇凶煞伤身克世」的「身」是卦身。
note.en: A 'hidden movement' is a still line moving on meeting a clash from the Day (see the Zengshan Buyi on hidden movement). This chapter has one sentence each for marriage, childbirth, office, lawsuit, losses, wealth, travel, a traveller and the house, and this entry takes the sentence on illness. The 'mai yin xi' of 'if ominous it is said to be caused by a hidden gap in the pulse' is not certain in sense; 'yin xi' is a hidden crack, and it is rendered literally as 'a hidden gap in the pulse'; 'the sick person not sick' of 'the sick person not sick must guard against a hidden injury' is rendered 'the sick person is not yet sick', and the original does not explain it. The 'silent protection' of 'if lucky it is said the sick person has a silent protection' is protection by a spirit in secret. This section and 'a clash where there is a combination' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.26) are the two sides of a clash in illness. The 'Body' of 'injuring the Body and controlling the Self' is the hexagram Body.

zh: 若遇凶煞暗动,伤身克世，
yi: 比如六爻安静，
不遇到冲就不动。
如果日辰来冲它，
叫作暗动。
暗动这个东西，
有吉有凶，
各有各的用处，
不可以一概而论。
如果遇到凶煞暗动，伤身克世，
百事都不好。
吉神暗动，
合世、生身，
事事没有不吉的。
我推究它的意思：
暗的一定不是明的，
是阴私、潜藏的样子；
福来了却不知道，
祸来了却没有察觉。
爻吉，暗中就有补益；
爻凶，暗中就有伤害。
en: Take a hexagram whose six lines are still:
not meeting a clash they do not move.
If the Day clashes with one,
it is called a hidden movement.
As for a hidden movement,
there is luck and there is ill,
each with its own use,
and it cannot be judged all alike.
If a fierce killing moves hidden, injuring the Body and controlling the Self,
in all things it is not good.
If a lucky spirit moves hidden,
combining with the Self and generating the Body,
everything is lucky.
I work out its sense:
what is hidden is surely not open,
it is of the private and the concealed;
fortune comes and one does not know it,
calamity comes and one does not notice it.
If the line is lucky there is help in secret;
if the line is ominous there is injury in secret.

hits.text: 若遇凶煞暗动，伤身克世
若遇凶煞暗动伤身克世

yi: 占病遇到它，
吉，就说病人有暗中的保佑；
凶，就说是脉络里暗中的空隙造成的；
病人若还没有发病，也要防暗中有伤。
这一章宜细细玩味，
就万无一失。
en: Divining illness and meeting it,
if lucky it is said the sick person has a silent protection;
if ominous it is said to be caused by a hidden gap in the pulse;
and if the sick person is not yet sick one must guard against a hidden injury.
This chapter should be studied closely,
and nothing will fail.

title: 助鬼伤身·占病：生助官鬼者不过妻财、妻财发动衰鬼变旺鬼；占病遇之占父母必致顷危、其余问病亦沉重缠绵卒难脱体、若作本名占或因财致病或房事过频乃大凶之兆；子孙发动解神来救庶可反凶成吉

rule.yi: 生助官鬼的，不过是妻财，不宜发动，动了衰鬼就变成旺鬼；旺鬼遇到它，势头更凶。比如申日占得离卦，鬼临应爻克世，本来不是好兆，再加妻财发动、生助鬼爻，凶更厉害，这就是助鬼伤身；凡是卦里鬼爻克身、世的，没有财，凶有限；若有两个财爻都动，祸就大凶。占病遇到它：若占的是父母，必定顷刻危险；其余人问病，也是沉重缠绵，一时难以脱身；若是替本人占，或是因财致病，或是房事过频，是大凶的兆。以上各种事，若有子孙发动、解神来救，或许可以反凶成吉、变祸为祥。
rule.en: What generates and helps the Pressure line is only Wealth, which should not move, for moving it turns a weak ghost into a strong ghost; a strong ghost meeting it, its force is fiercer still. For example, divining the hexagram Li on a Shen day, the ghost sits on the Other line and controls the Self, which is not a good sign to begin with, and Wealth moving in addition to generate and help the ghost line makes the ill fiercer still: this is helping the ghost to injure the Body; whenever the ghost line in a hexagram controls the Body or the Self, with no Wealth the ill is limited, and if two Wealth lines both move the calamity is greatly ominous. Divining illness and meeting it: if a parent (the Resource line) is divined for, it will surely bring peril in a moment; for other askers about illness it is also heavy and lingering, and hard to shake off in the end; if it is divined in one's own name, it may be illness brought on by wealth, or excess of sexual activity, and it is a sign of great ill. In all the above matters, if Output moves and a resolving spirit comes to rescue, it may be possible to turn ill into luck and calamity into fortune.

note.yi: 「助鬼伤身」是鬼爻克世或卦身、又有财爻发动生鬼，三样凑在一起。头一段是总句，和婚姻、求财、占官等一章（LY.MARRY.DYTJ.03 一带）相同；这一条收占病那一段。「占父母必致顷危」是因为财爻克父母、又生鬼；「其余问病亦是沉重缠绵」是别人的病也重；「若作本名占」是替自己占，「本名」是占的人自己；「或因财致病」是因财而得病（钱事劳心或财多招灾），「房事过频」是色欲。最后一句「子孙发动，解神来救」是说有子孙发动能克鬼、有解神来解，可以转祸为福；但子孙发动若同时有财爻发动生鬼，情形又不同，原文没有再展开。财爻发动生鬼、问病难愈，和火珠林「妻财独发，生鬼伤父；问病难瘳」（LY.ILL.HZL.18）、天玄赋的「鬼旺财兴难保命」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.02）是同一个道理。
note.en: 'Helping the ghost to injure the Body' is the ghost line controlling the Self or the Body, and a Wealth line moving to generate the ghost, the three together. The first passage is the general statement, the same as the chapters on marriage, wealth and office (around LY.MARRY.DYTJ.03); this entry takes the passage on illness. 'If a parent is divined for it will surely bring peril in a moment' is because Wealth controls Resource and also generates the ghost; 'for other askers about illness it is also heavy and lingering' is that another person's illness is heavy too; 'if it is divined in one's own name' is divining for oneself, the 'own name' being the diviner himself; 'illness brought on by wealth' is caught through money worries or through much wealth inviting calamity, and 'excess of sexual activity' is lust. The last sentence, 'Output moves and a resolving spirit comes to rescue', says that with Output moving to control the ghost and a resolving spirit to untie, calamity may be turned into fortune; but if, while Output moves, a Wealth line also moves to generate the ghost, the case is different, and the original does not go on to say so. Wealth moving to generate the ghost, so that an illness is hard to cure, is the same principle as the Huozhu Lin's 'Wealth moving alone generates the ghost and injures the father; asking about illness it is hard to cure' (LY.ILL.HZL.18) and the Duanyi Tianji's 'ghost strong and Wealth rising, life is hard to keep' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.02).

yi: 生助官鬼的，
不过是妻财，
它不宜发动，
一动，衰弱的鬼就变成旺鬼。
旺鬼遇到它，
势头更凶。
比如申日占得离卦，
鬼临应爻克世，
本来就不是好兆头；
再加上妻财发动，
生助鬼爻，
凶就更重了，
这就是助鬼伤身。
凡是卦中鬼爻克身世的，
没有财，
凶险有限；
如果有两个财都动，
那祸就大凶。
en: What generates and helps the Pressure line
is only Wealth,
It should not move,
for once it moves a weak Pressure becomes a strong one.
a strong ghost meeting it,
its force is fiercer still.
Take a divination made on a Shen day that gives the hexagram Li:
Pressure sits on the Other line and controls Self,
which is not a fine omen to begin with;
and if Wealth also moves,
generating and supporting the Pressure line,
the ill is all the worse:
this is helping Pressure to harm the person.
Whenever the Pressure line in a hexagram controls the Body or Self,
if there is no Wealth,
the ill is limited;
if there are two Wealth lines and both move,
the calamity is very great.

yi: 占病遇到它，
若占的是父母（父母爻），必定顷刻危险；
其余的人问病，
也是沉重缠绵，
一时难以脱身。
若是替本人占，
或是因财致病，
或是房事过频，
是大凶的兆。
以上各种事，
若有子孙发动、
解神来救，
或许可以反凶成吉，
变祸为祥。
en: Divining illness and meeting it,
if a parent (the Resource line) is divined for, it will surely bring peril in a moment;
for other askers about illness,
it is also heavy and lingering,
and hard to shake off in the end.
If it is divined in one's own name,
it may be illness brought on by wealth,
or excess of sexual activity,
and it is a sign of great ill.
In all the above matters,
if Output moves
and a resolving spirit comes to rescue,
it may be possible to turn ill into luck
and calamity into fortune.

chapter: 论神煞·吉神(十四月解、十五日解、十六天医)
title: 月解、日解、天医：病人有月解神天医上卦即病愈；日解戊癸鸡啼官事散、病人无药不须忧；天医正卯二亥…病人有此爻上卦必主名医下药有效

rule.yi: 月解：正月二月起在申，三月四月在酉，五月六月在戌，七月八月在亥，九月十月在午，子丑两月（十一月、十二月）在未。病人有这个解神，天医又上了卦，就病愈了。日解：甲己日逢巳（蛇），乙庚日逢申（猴），丙辛日逢寅（虎），丁壬日逢丑（牛），戊癸日逢酉（鸡），官事就散，病人没有药也不用忧。天医：正月在卯，二月亥，三月丑，四月未，五月巳，六月卯，七月亥，八月丑，九月未，十月巳，十一月卯，十二月亥。病人有这一爻上卦，必定有名医下药有效。
rule.en: The Month Resolution: in the first and second months it is at Shen, the third and fourth at You, the fifth and sixth at Xu, the seventh and eighth at Hai, the ninth and tenth at Wu, and in the two months of Zi and Chou (the eleventh and twelfth) at Wei. A sick person who has this resolving spirit, with the Heavenly Physician also in the hexagram, is cured at once. The Day Resolution: on Jia and Ji days it is Si (the snake), on Yi and Geng days Shen (the monkey), on Bing and Xin days Yin (the tiger), on Ding and Ren days Chou (the ox), on Wu and Gui days You (the rooster), and official business scatters, and a sick person without medicine need not worry. The Heavenly Physician: first month Mao, second Hai, third Chou, fourth Wei, fifth Si, sixth Mao, seventh Hai, eighth Chou, ninth Wei, tenth Si, eleventh Mao, twelfth Hai. A sick person who has this line in the hexagram will surely have a famous doctor whose medicine is effective.

note.yi: 月解的排法（正二申、三四酉、五六戌、七八亥、九十午、子丑未）和神煞月令表里的「地解」一行完全一样（LY.ILL.DYTJ.34），天医的排法和表里的「天医」一行也一样。两处的断语略有不同：这里说「病人有此解神，天医上卦即病愈」，表里说地解是「病者有此发动即安」。日解「甲己逢蛇乙庚猴……」是按日干取解神所在的地支（甲己取巳、乙庚取申、丙辛取寅、丁壬取丑、戊癸取酉），「官事散」是它对官事的作用，「病人无药不须忧」是对病人的作用。「天医上卦」是天医这个地支落在卦里的爻上。「病人有此爻上卦，必主名医下药有效也」和天玄赋的「月解交重灾渐退，天医发动便回生」（LY.ILL.TXF.05）是同一类说法。
note.en: The way the Month Resolution is laid out (first and second months Shen, third and fourth You, fifth and sixth Xu, seventh and eighth Hai, ninth and tenth Wu, Zi and Chou Wei) is exactly the same as the row 'Earth Resolution' in the table of spirits and killings by month (LY.ILL.DYTJ.34), and the way the Heavenly Physician is laid out is also the same as the row 'Heavenly Physician' in the table. The judgments differ slightly: here it says 'a sick person who has this resolving spirit, with the Heavenly Physician in the hexagram, is cured at once', and the table says of the Earth Resolution 'a sick person who has this moving is at once at ease'. The Day Resolution 'Jia and Ji meet the snake, Yi and Geng the monkey ...' takes the branch where the resolving spirit lies by the day stem (Jia and Ji take Si, Yi and Geng Shen, Bing and Xin Yin, Ding and Ren Chou, Wu and Gui You), and 'official business scatters' is its effect on official business and 'a sick person without medicine need not worry' its effect on a sick person. 'The Heavenly Physician in the hexagram' is the branch of the Heavenly Physician falling on a line of the hexagram. 'A sick person who has this line in the hexagram will surely have a famous doctor whose medicine is effective' is the same kind of saying as the Tianxuan Fu's 'when the Month resolves and the Day moves heavily calamity fades, when the Heavenly Physician moves he recovers at once' (LY.ILL.TXF.05).

yi: 月解：正月、二月起在申，
三月、四月仍在酉上；
五月、六月在戌上；
七月、八月行到亥上；
九月、十月到午位；
子丑两月（十一月、十二月）停在未宫。
病人有这个解神，
天医又上了卦，就病愈了。
en: The Month Resolution: in the first and second months it starts at Shen,
in the third and fourth it falls again on You;
in the fifth and sixth months it sits on Xu;
in the seventh and eighth it goes on to stay at Hai;
in the ninth and tenth months it comes to the Wu place;
in the two months of Zi and Chou (the eleventh and twelfth) it stops at the Wei palace.
A sick person who has this resolving spirit,
with the Heavenly Physician also in the hexagram, is cured at once.

yi: 日解：甲、己日逢巳（蛇），乙、庚日逢申（猴），
丙、辛日逢寅（虎），丁、壬日逢丑（牛），
戊、癸日逢酉（鸡），官事就散；
病人没有药也不用忧。
官事如果得旺相发动，就散了。
en: The Day Resolution: on Jia and Ji days it is Si (the snake), on Yi and Geng days Shen (the monkey),
on Bing and Xin days Yin (the tiger), on Ding and Ren days Chou (the ox),
on Wu and Gui days You (the rooster), and official business scatters;
a sick person without medicine need not worry.
Official business, if it is strong and moves, scatters at once.

yi: 天医：正月在卯，二月在亥（猪），
三月随到丑，四月在未，
五月是巳（蛇），六月是卯（兔），七月居亥，
八月丑，九月未（羊），十月巳，
十一月再回到卯上，
十二月亥上作医人。
病人有这一爻上卦，
必定有名医下药有效。
en: The Heavenly Physician: in the first month at Mao, in the second at Hai (the pig),
in the third month it follows to Chou, in the fourth it is found at Wei,
the fifth Si (the snake), the sixth Mao (the rabbit), the seventh it stays at Hai,
the eighth Chou, the ninth Wei (the sheep), the tenth it stays at Si,
the eleventh it comes again to Mao,
and in the twelfth month Hai acts as the physician.
A sick person who has this line in the hexagram
will surely have a famous doctor whose medicine is effective.

title: 三丘五墓杀：春丑夏辰秋未冬戌为三丘、却与五墓对宫取，病人作福也难留；此占病忌，或有吉神解救方免

rule.yi: 春天是丑、夏天是辰、秋天是未、冬天逢戌，这是三丘；五墓要取三丘的对宫。病人就是作福（祈福）也难留住。这是占病所忌，只有得吉神来解救才能免去。
rule.en: In spring Chou, in summer Chen, in autumn Wei and in winter meeting Xu: these are the Three Mounds; the Five Tombs are taken from the opposite palace. The sick person, though he makes offerings for fortune, can hardly be kept. This is a taboo in divining illness, and it is escaped only if a lucky spirit comes to rescue.

note.yi: 这首「三丘五墓杀」的头四句和卜筮大全、易林补遗（LY.ILL.EL.51）里的三丘五墓歌是同一首，后面两句「此占病忌，或有吉神解救方免」是这里加上的。三丘是春丑、夏辰、秋未、冬戌；五墓「对宫取」，也就是三丘的对冲：春未、夏戌、秋丑、冬辰（这个排法见 LY.ILL.EL.51）。「病人作福也难留」和天玄赋的「二杀俱动，病人作福也难留」（LY.ILL.TXF.08）是同一句。神煞月令表里也有「三丘」「五墓」两行（丑丑丑辰辰辰未未未戌戌戌；未未未戌戌戌丑丑丑辰辰辰），那两行的断语是「坟墓崩，隐为崇凶」「坟墓崩陷凶」，不是专说病，这里不收。
note.en: The first four lines of this 'Three Mounds and Five Tombs killing' are the same verse as the Three Mounds and Five Tombs verse in the Buyi Daquan and the Yilin Buyi (LY.ILL.EL.51), and the last two lines, 'this is a taboo in divining illness, and it is escaped only if a lucky spirit comes to rescue', are added here. The Three Mounds are Chou in spring, Chen in summer, Wei in autumn and Xu in winter; the Five Tombs are 'taken from the opposite palace', that is the clash of the Three Mounds: Wei in spring, Xu in summer, Chou in autumn and Chen in winter (for this layout see LY.ILL.EL.51). 'The sick person, though he makes offerings for fortune, can hardly be kept' is the same sentence as the Tianxuan Fu's 'when both killings move, even if the sick person makes offerings for fortune he can hardly be kept' (LY.ILL.TXF.08). The table of spirits and killings by month also has two rows 'Three Mounds' and 'Five Tombs' (Chou Chou Chou Chen Chen Chen Wei Wei Wei Xu Xu Xu; Wei Wei Wei Xu Xu Xu Chou Chou Chou Chen Chen Chen), and the judgments of those two rows are 'the tomb crumbles, hidden it is an ominous curse' and 'the tomb crumbles and sinks, ominous', which are not specially about illness and are not taken here.

yi: 春天是丑、夏天是辰、秋天就是未，
冬天逢戌，这是三丘；
五墓却要取三丘的对宫，
病人就是作福也难留住。
这是占病所忌，
或是有吉神来解救才能免去。
en: In spring Chou, in summer Chen, in autumn Wei,
in winter meeting Xu: these are the Three Mounds;
the Five Tombs are taken from the opposite palace;
the sick person, though he makes offerings for fortune, can hardly be kept.
This is a taboo in divining illness,
and it is escaped only if a lucky spirit comes to rescue.

title: 丧车杀：丧车春鸡夏鼠秋马冬羊、人来占病断兴去、讨钱火急买棺材

rule.yi: 丧车：春天是鸡、夏天是鼠，秋天是马、冬天是羊，好安排。有人来占病，断他是起身离去（去世）了，赶紧去讨钱、火速买棺材。
rule.en: The Mourning Cart: in spring it is the rooster, in summer the rat, in autumn the horse and in winter the sheep, which is well arranged. A person who comes to divine illness is judged to be setting off to leave; hurry to ask for money and buy a coffin in all haste.

note.yi: 丧车杀的四季排法是春酉（鸡）、夏子（鼠）、秋午（马）、冬未（羊）。「断兴去」的「兴去」读不确定，「兴」有起身的意思，这里按「起身离去」译，也就是去世；「讨钱火急买棺材」是说要赶紧去讨钱备棺材，是个凶极的断语。「好安排」按字面译，是说四季的排法好排。丧车这个名目也见天玄赋（「丧车」「丧服」「棺椁」，LY.ILL.HZL.03 的申为丧车）。
note.en: The four-season layout of the Mourning Cart killing is You (the rooster) in spring, Zi (the rat) in summer, Wu (the horse) in autumn and Wei (the sheep) in winter. The 'xing qu' of 'divined to be xing qu' is not certain; 'xing' has the sense of setting off, and it is rendered 'setting off to leave', that is, dying; 'hurry to ask for money and buy a coffin' says one must hurry to ask for money and prepare a coffin, an extremely ominous judgment. 'Well arranged' is rendered literally and says the layout by seasons is easy to arrange. The name Mourning Cart also appears in the Huozhu Lin (Shen as the mourning cart, LY.ILL.HZL.03).

yi: 丧车：春天来的是鸡、夏天来的是鼠，
秋天是马、冬天是羊，好安排；
有人来占病，断他是起身离去（去世）了，
赶紧去讨钱、火速买棺材。
en: The Mourning Cart: in spring it comes as the rooster, in summer as the rat,
in autumn the horse, in winter the sheep, which is well arranged;
a person who comes to divine illness is judged to be setting off to leave,
hurry to ask for money and buy a coffin in all haste.

title: 占病忌发动的四杀：勾陈杀（正月从辰逆行）占病发动凶；天哭杀占病征发动主大凶；四季小杀占病忌发动；旌旗杀占病忌发动

rule.yi: 勾陈杀：正月从辰起，逆行向卯，轮十二个位置；占病时它发动，凶。天哭杀：正五九月是羊（未）、二六十月是猴（申）、三七十一月是鸡（酉）、四八十二月是犬（戌）；若临在身、世上，就忧愁哭泣；占病时征兆发动，主大凶。四季小杀：春忌羊头（未）、夏是龙（辰）、秋牛（丑）、冬犬（戌）；占病忌它发动。旌旗杀：春兔（卯）、夏鼠（子）、秋鸡（酉）、冬马（午）；占病忌它发动。
rule.en: The Hook Earth killing: it starts from Chen in the first month and goes backward towards Mao, rotating through the twelve places; in divining illness, if it moves it is ominous. The Weeping killing: in the first, fifth and ninth months the sheep (Wei), in the second, sixth and tenth the monkey (Shen), in the third, seventh and eleventh the rooster (You), in the fourth, eighth and twelfth the dog (Xu); if it sits on the Body or the Self there is worry and weeping; in divining illness, if the sign moves it means great ill. The Small killing of the four seasons: in spring avoid the sheep's head (Wei), in summer the dragon (Chen), in autumn the ox (Chou), in winter the dog (Xu); in divining illness it must not move. The Banner killing: in spring the rabbit (Mao), in summer the rat (Zi), in autumn the rooster (You), in winter the horse (Wu); in divining illness it must not move.

note.yi: 这四杀的共同点是括号里的那一句「占病发动凶」「占病征发动主大凶」「占病忌发动」：它们平时（不占病）另有断语（天哭杀是哭泣、四季小杀和旌旗杀不专说病），只有占病时忌它们发动。「猴上真」的「上真」意思读不确定，这里按「是猴，很真切」字面译，原文没有解释。「逆行向卯轮十二位」是从正月的辰起每月倒退一位（二月卯、三月寅……），「向卯」是下一月落在卯。天哭杀的四组（正五九羊、二六十猴、三七十一鸡、四八十二犬）是每四个月一循环，在未、申、酉、戌。「若临身世忧哭泣，定知下泪泪沾襟」是说临身或世就要哭；占病时它发动，主大凶。「（占病忌发动）」是原文括号里的注。
note.en: What these four killings have in common is the sentence in brackets, 'in divining illness, if it moves it is ominous', 'in divining illness, if the sign moves it means great ill' and 'in divining illness it must not move': in ordinary use (when not divining illness) they have other judgments (the Weeping killing is weeping, and the Small killing of the four seasons and the Banner killing are not specially about illness), and only in divining illness is it taboo for them to move. The 'shang zhen' of 'the monkey shang zhen' is not certain in sense, and it is rendered literally as 'the monkey, a true one', and the original does not explain it. 'Goes backward towards Mao, rotating through the twelve places' is going back one place each month from Chen in the first month (Mao in the second, Yin in the third ...), and 'towards Mao' is that the next month falls on Mao. The four groups of the Weeping killing (first, fifth, ninth the sheep; second, sixth, tenth the monkey; third, seventh, eleventh the rooster; fourth, eighth, twelfth the dog) run in a cycle of four months through Wei, Shen, You and Xu. 'If it sits on the Body or the Self there is worry and weeping, surely tears fall and wet the lapel' says that sitting on the Body or the Self means weeping; in divining illness, if it moves it means great ill. The '(in divining illness it must not move)' is a note in brackets in the original.

zh: 逆行向卯轮十二位是也。
yi: 勾陈杀：正月从辰上起，
逆行，向卯，轮过十二个位置。
（占病时它发动，凶。）
en: The Hook Earth killing: it starts from Chen in the first month
and goes backward towards Mao, rotating through the twelve places.
(in divining illness, if it moves it is ominous.)

yi: 天哭杀：正月、五月、九月是羊（未）神，
二月、六月、十月是猴（申），很真切；
三月、七月、十一月是鸡（酉）鸣的地方，
四月、八月、十二月是犬（戌）吠的声音。
如果临在身、世上，就忧愁哭泣，
一定要落泪、泪湿衣襟。
占病时，征兆发动，
就主大凶。
en: The Weeping killing: in the first, fifth and ninth months the sheep spirit (Wei),
in the second, sixth and tenth months the monkey (Shen), a true one;
in the third, seventh and eleventh months where the rooster (You) crows,
in the fourth, eighth and twelfth months the sound of the dog (Xu) barking.
If it sits on the Body or the Self, there is worry and weeping,
surely tears fall and wet the lapel.
In divining illness, if the sign moves,
it means great ill.

yi: 四季小杀：春天忌羊头（未）、夏天是龙（辰），
秋天牛（丑）、冬天犬（戌），哭了又哭；
卦里有这个、临在身和命上，
就是求和、禳解，也主凶。
（占病忌它发动。）
en: The Small killing of the four seasons: in spring avoid the sheep's head (Wei), in summer the dragon (Chen),
in autumn the ox (Chou), in winter the dog (Xu), weeping upon weeping;
if the hexagram has this sitting on the Body and the natal line,
even reconciliation and ward-offs still mean ill.
(in divining illness it must not move.)

yi: 旌旗杀：春天是兔（卯），
夏天是鼠（子），
秋天是鸡（酉），
冬天是马（午）。
（占病忌它发动。）
en: The Banner killing: in spring the rabbit (Mao),
in summer the rat (Zi),
in autumn the rooster (You),
in winter the horse (Wu).
(in divining illness it must not move.)

title: 神煞月令表·吉神(天医、地解)：天医有此爻者疾病易愈；地解病者有此发动即安

rule.yi: 神煞月令表的吉神两行：天医（正月起卯、亥、丑、未、巳、卯、亥、丑、未、巳、卯、亥），卦里有这一爻的，疾病容易痊愈；地解（申、申、酉、酉、戌、戌、亥、亥、午、午、未、未），病人有这一爻发动，就安稳了。
rule.en: Two lucky rows of the table of spirits and killings by month: the Heavenly Physician (from the first month Mao, Hai, Chou, Wei, Si, Mao, Hai, Chou, Wei, Si, Mao, Hai): if this line is in the hexagram, an illness is easily cured; the Earth Resolution (Shen, Shen, You, You, Xu, Xu, Hai, Hai, Wu, Wu, Wei, Wei): for a sick person, if this moves, he is at once at ease.

note.yi: 这是《断易天机》「神煞月令表」（表头：神煞、月令一到十二、说明）里和病有关的两行吉神。每一行：第一格是名字，接着十二格是它在正月到十二月各落的地支，最后一格是断语。原表分吉神（天德、月德……）和凶神（岁杀、三丘……）两半，病的几行分散在其中。天医这一行的排法和前面「十六、天医」那首歌（LY.ILL.DYTJ.30）一样；地解这一行的排法和「十四、月解」的排法一样（正二申、三四酉、五六戌……），但断语不同：月解说「病人有此解神，天医上卦即病愈」，地解说「病者有此发动即安」。表里别的解神（天解「卦遇此爻恶事解散」、外解「遇此爻灾患消除」、天喜「官事消散」）没有专说病，不收。
note.en: These are the two lucky rows about illness in the 'table of spirits and killings by month' of the Duanyi Tianji (the head of the table: spirit or killing, month one to twelve, explanation). Each row has as its first cell the name, then twelve cells for the branch it falls on from the first to the twelfth month, and last the judgment. The original table is in two halves, lucky spirits (Heavenly Virtue, Month Virtue ...) and fierce spirits (Year Killing, Three Mounds ...), and the rows about illness are scattered through it. The layout of the Heavenly Physician row is the same as the song '16 Heavenly Physician' before it (LY.ILL.DYTJ.30); the layout of the Earth Resolution row is the same as that of '14 Month Resolution' (first and second Shen, third and fourth You, fifth and sixth Xu ...), but the judgment differs: the Month Resolution says 'a sick person who has this resolving spirit, with the Heavenly Physician in the hexagram, is cured at once', and the Earth Resolution says 'a sick person who has this moving is at once at ease'. The other resolving spirits in the table (Heavenly Resolution 'a hexagram meeting this line, ill matters are resolved and scatter', Outer Resolution 'meeting this line calamity is removed', Heavenly Joy 'official business dissolves') do not speak specially of illness and are not taken.

title: 神煞月令表·凶神(病)：岁杀病有官灾凶、飞杀卒病、阴杀阴谋病患、小杀小儿疾患、天杀疾病困厄同丧杀断、地杀疾病凶、天阴女人疾病凶、大月时行疾病凶

rule.yi: 神煞月令表里凶神的八行，断语都说到病：岁杀，病而有官灾，凶，月杀也这样断；飞杀，突然发病又有飞鸟，凶；阴杀，阴谋和病患，凶；小杀，小孩的疾病，凶；天杀，疾病困厄，凶，和丧杀一样断；地杀，疾病凶、恶而凶；天阴，女人的疾病，凶；大月，流行的疾病，凶。
rule.en: Eight fierce rows of the table of spirits and killings by month whose judgments speak of illness: the Year Killing, illness with official calamity, ominous, and the Month Killing is judged the same way; the Flying Killing, sudden illness and flying birds, ominous; the Yin Killing, secret schemes and illness, ominous; the Small Killing, illness of small children, ominous; the Heaven Killing, illness and distress, ominous, judged like the Mourning Killing; the Earth Killing, illness is ominous, vicious and ominous; Heaven Yin, illness of a woman, ominous; the Great Month, epidemic illness, ominous.

note.yi: 这八行的排法都是每月一个地支，一年十二月，有的三个月一循环（岁杀、天杀：丑戌未辰，四个一组），有的按顺序或逆序排下去（天阴子丑寅卯……、大月子丑寅卯……），有的隔位（飞杀酉子卯午、地杀辰戌丑未）。断语里「岁杀：病有官灾凶，月杀同断用」的「月杀」表里没有列出，原文没有解释，字面译。「天杀：疾病困厄，凶。同丧杀断」的「丧杀」是另一个杀（丧门一类），这里说天杀照丧杀断。「飞杀：卒病飞鸟凶」的「飞鸟」是飞鸟的凶象（飞鸟入宅一类），按字面译。这些行是「卦里这一爻上有这个杀，占病凶」的意思；占病时怎么用，断易天机在「占疾病」一章里没有再展开。这几个杀名（天杀、地杀、天阴……）和易林补遗的星煞值鬼一节（LY.ILL.EL.48 到 EL.52）里讲的不是同一批。
note.en: In these eight rows each month has one branch, over the twelve months of the year: some run in cycles of three months (the Year Killing and the Heaven Killing: Chou, Xu, Wei, Chen, in groups of four), some go on in order or in reverse (Heaven Yin: Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao ...; the Great Month: Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao ...), and some skip places (the Flying Killing: You, Zi, Mao, Wu; the Earth Killing: Chen, Xu, Chou, Wei). The 'Month Killing' of 'the Year Killing: illness with official calamity, ominous; the Month Killing is judged the same way' is not listed in the table, and the original does not explain it, and it is rendered literally. The 'Mourning Killing' of 'the Heaven Killing: illness and distress, ominous; judged like the Mourning Killing' is another killing (of the Mourning Gate kind), and here the Heaven Killing is judged like the Mourning Killing. The 'flying birds' of 'the Flying Killing: sudden illness and flying birds are ominous' is the ominous sign of flying birds (of the flying birds entering the house kind), rendered literally. These rows mean 'this killing on a line of the hexagram makes divining illness ominous'; how to use them in divining illness the Duanyi Tianji does not go on to say in its chapter on illness. These killing names (Heaven Killing, Earth Killing, Heaven Yin ...) are not the same batch as those in the Yilin Buyi's section on stars and killings on the ghost (LY.ILL.EL.48 to EL.52).

title: 神煞月令表·凶神(死与瘟病)：事气病必死丧凶、吊客病死忧疾凶、哭杀时行瘟病凶

rule.yi: 神煞月令表里凶神的三行：事气（正月起午、未、申、酉、戌、亥、子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳），病必死，丧事凶；吊客（辰、丑、戌、未循环），病人死亡、忧愁、疾病，凶；哭杀（巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥、子、丑、寅、卯、辰），流行的瘟病，凶。
rule.en: Three fierce rows of the table of spirits and killings by month: Affair Qi (from the first month Wu, Wei, Shen, You, Xu, Hai, Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao, Chen, Si): in illness surely dead, mourning is ominous; Guest of Condolence (Chen, Chou, Xu, Wei in a cycle): the sick person dies, worry and sickness, ominous; the Weeping Killing (Si, Wu, Wei, Shen, You, Xu, Hai, Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao, Chen): epidemic plague is ominous.

note.yi: 这三行的断语都说到死或瘟病：事气「病必死，丧凶」是最重的一句，吊客是病人死亡和忧愁，哭杀是时行的瘟病。「吊客」这一名和天玄赋里「丧门」「吊客」并提的说法（LY.ILL.TXF.04：「若临丧门、吊客、死符、丧车，持克用爻者，决主不起」）是同一个吊客。「哭杀」在表里的排法（巳午未申酉戌亥子丑寅卯辰）和前面「天哭杀」歌里的排法（正五九羊、二六十猴……，LY.ILL.DYTJ.33）不同，是两个杀。表里另有「大杀」「飞廉」「天丧」「大忌」等几行说到死亡，但都没有说病，这里不收。
note.en: The judgments of these three rows all speak of death or plague: Affair Qi, 'in illness surely dead, mourning is ominous', is the heaviest sentence, Guest of Condolence is the death and worry of the sick person, and the Weeping Killing is the plague of the season. The name 'Guest of Condolence' is the same Guest of Condolence as in the Tianxuan Fu's pairing of 'Mourning Gate' and 'Guest of Condolence' (LY.ILL.TXF.04: 'if it sits on the Mourning Gate, the Guest of Condolence, the Death Talisman or the Mourning Cart and controls the Subject line, it surely means he does not rise'). The layout of the 'Weeping Killing' in the table (Si, Wu, Wei, Shen, You, Xu, Hai, Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao, Chen) differs from that in the song of the 'Heavenly Weeping killing' (first, fifth, ninth the sheep, second, sixth, tenth the monkey ..., LY.ILL.DYTJ.33), and they are two killings. The table has other rows, 'Great Killing', 'Feilian', 'Heavenly Mourning' and 'Great Taboo', that speak of death but do not say illness, and they are not taken here.

title: 神煞月令表·血忌：不家针灸凶

rule.yi: 血忌（正月起丑、未、寅、申、卯、酉、辰、戌、巳、亥、午、子）：不可在家里针灸，凶。
rule.en: Blood Taboo (from the first month Chou, Wei, Yin, Shen, Mao, You, Chen, Xu, Si, Hai, Wu, Zi): no needling or moxibustion at home, ominous.

note.yi: 血忌按月排：正月丑、二月未、三月寅、四月申、五月卯、六月酉、七月辰、八月戌、九月巳、十月亥、十一月午、十二月子。「不家针灸凶」的「不家」读不确定，这里按「不可在家里（用针灸）」译；意思大概是血忌落在的月份、日子里，不要在家里做针灸放血这类会见血的治疗。这一行是这一章里唯一说到治疗方式的神煞。针灸的宜忌按鬼爻五行定的说法，见天玄赋（LY.ILL.TXF.13）和火珠林（LY.ILL.HZL.09）。
note.en: Blood Taboo is laid out by month: Chou in the first month, Wei in the second, Yin in the third, Shen in the fourth, Mao in the fifth, You in the sixth, Chen in the seventh, Xu in the eighth, Si in the ninth, Hai in the tenth, Wu in the eleventh, Zi in the twelfth. The 'bu jia' of 'bu jia zhen jiu xiong' is not certain, and here it is rendered 'no needling or moxibustion at home'; the sense is probably that in the months and days on which the Blood Taboo falls, one should not do at home the treatments that draw blood, such as needling and moxibustion. This row is the only spirit or killing in this chapter that speaks of a way of treatment. For the rules on what to use and avoid in needling and moxibustion by the phase of the ghost line see the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.13) and the Huozhu Lin (LY.ILL.HZL.09).

title: 六神与疾病：白虎属金持世及交重者为患病丧死破财；白虎内惊忧疾病；白虎临财损病忧；玄武入土家中有疾病；白虎空亡病无事

rule.yi: 白虎属金，兑旺乾相，旺在秋，属阴，是西方之神；它若持世和交重，是患病、丧死、破财，附在六爻上没有不凶的。日六神内动：白虎内动，惊而忧疾病。白虎临在财上，损害、病和忧愁。玄武入土，家中有疾病。白虎空亡，病没有事。
rule.en: The White Tiger belongs to Metal, strong in Dui and helped by Qian, strong in autumn, yin, and the spirit of the west; if it holds the Self or is crossed and heavy it means illness, mourning and death, and loss of wealth, and attached to the six lines it is never not ominous. The day spirit moving inside: the White Tiger moving inside frightens and worries about illness. The White Tiger on Wealth: harm, illness and worry. The Dark Tortoise entering Earth: illness in the house. The White Tiger Void: the illness comes to nothing.

note.yi: 这里从六神几处的歌里把说到病的句子集在一起。头一段（「白虎属金……」）是六神各自的性质：白虎属金、旺在秋、属阴、西方之神，持世或交重时是患病、丧死、破财；后四句是别处歌诀里的单句：「日六神内动」歌的「白虎内惊忧疾病」（其后的「（1）」是今人注号，不收）、「六神有气吉凶」歌的「白虎临财损病忧」、「六神彖象歌」的「玄武入土家中有疾病」、「六神空亡」歌的「白虎空亡病无事」。「附于六爻而无不凶也」是说白虎附在哪一爻上都凶。「白虎临财损病忧」的「病」是病，「忧」是忧愁，「损」是损害，这一句字面译。这几句和天玄赋「青龙得位终见安康、白虎伤身必成凶咎」（LY.ILL.TXF.04）、火珠林的白虎临父母（LY.ILL.HZL.08）是同一类。
note.en: Here the sentences that speak of illness are gathered from several of the six-spirit songs. The first passage ('The White Tiger belongs to Metal ...') is the nature of each of the six spirits: the White Tiger belongs to Metal, is strong in autumn, yin and the spirit of the west, and holding the Self or crossed and heavy means illness, mourning and death, and loss of wealth; the last four are single lines from other songs: 'the White Tiger moving inside frightens and worries about illness' from the song of the day spirits moving inside (the '(1)' after it is a modern annotation mark and is not quoted), 'the White Tiger on Wealth: harm, illness and worry' from the song on the six spirits having qi and being lucky or ill, 'the Dark Tortoise entering Earth: illness in the house' from the song of the images of the six spirits, and 'the White Tiger Void: the illness comes to nothing' from the song of the six spirits Void. 'Attached to the six lines it is never not ominous' says the White Tiger is ominous on whichever line it is attached to. In 'the White Tiger on Wealth: harm, illness and worry' the words are rendered literally. These lines are of the same kind as the Tianxuan Fu's 'the Azure Dragon in place finally sees health, the White Tiger injuring the Body surely becomes calamity' (LY.ILL.TXF.04) and the Huozhu Lin's 'the White Tiger sitting on Resource' (LY.ILL.HZL.08).

the spirit of the west.
If it holds the Self or is crossed and heavy,
it is illness,
it is mourning and death,

Attached to the six lines it is never not ominous.

title: 六亲用钤·疾病：占双亲父母为用爻宜旺不宜空；占子孙父母为恶杀宜静不宜动动则必死；子孙占病为医药当权发动病即安卦无其神服药无效；官鬼占兄弟为克杀旺相发动病必危；官鬼占身命逢凶必丧亡疾病

rule.yi: 父母爻的用处：占双亲的疾病，父母爻是用爻，宜旺不宜空，空就必危；占子孙，父母爻是恶杀，宜静不宜动，动就必死。子孙爻的用处：占病，子孙是医药，当权发动，病就安；卦里没有它，服药无效；占小孩和奴仆，子孙是用爻，不落空亡，终究没有大害。官鬼爻的用处：占兄弟的病，官鬼是克杀，旺相发动，病必危险；占身命，遇凶必定丧亡、疾病。
rule.en: The uses of the Resource line: divining the illness of the parents, the Resource line is the Subject line, and it should be strong and not Void, and Void means peril; divining children, the Resource line is an evil killing, and it should be still and not move, and moving means death. The uses of the Output line: divining illness, Output is the medicine, and if it holds power and moves the illness is at ease; if it is not in the hexagram, medicine has no effect; divining small children and servants, Output is the Subject line, and if it does not fall Void there is in the end no great harm. The uses of the Pressure line: divining a brother's illness, the Pressure line is the controlling killing, and if strong and moving the illness is surely dangerous; divining the person's fortune, meeting ill surely means death and illness.

note.yi: 这一节是《断易天机》「六亲用钤」里的几条，每一条是「占某事：某六亲是什么」的句式。头一条在「父母用」里：占双亲的病，父母爻就是用爻（病人），所以宜旺不宜空；占子孙（小孩）的病，父母爻（生我者）反而成了「恶杀」，动了就死。第二条在「子孙用」里：子孙爻在占病里是医药（和天玄赋的用爻表 LY.ILL.TXF.01 里「父占子看子」不同，那里是占子孙的病看子孙，这里说的是占病时子孙是医药），当权发动病就安，卦里没有子孙，服药无效。第三条在「官鬼用」里：占兄弟的病，官鬼是「克杀」（克兄弟的杀），旺相发动病必危。第四条是「官鬼用」里「占身命」一句后面括号里的注：遇吉进禄加官，逢凶丧亡疾病。原文里每条前面的「占某」是说占什么事，句里的「为」是「是」，我加在括号里的是补出的主语，不是原文有的词。「占兄弟」的「兄弟」是兄弟这个亲人，不是兄弟爻。
note.en: This section takes several entries from the 'uses of the six relations' of the Duanyi Tianji, each in the pattern 'divining such a matter: what such a relation is'. The first is in the 'uses of Resource': divining the illness of the parents, the Resource line is the Subject line (the sick person), so it should be strong and not Void; divining the illness of children, the Resource line (what generates me) becomes an 'evil killing' instead, and if it moves he dies. The second is in the 'uses of Output': the Output line in divining illness is the medicine (different from the table of the Subject line in the Tianxuan Fu, LY.ILL.TXF.01, 'a parent divining a child looks at Output', which is divining a child's illness by Output, while here it is that in divining illness Output is the medicine), and if it holds power and moves the illness is at ease, and if the hexagram has no Output taking medicine has no effect. The third is in the 'uses of the Pressure line': divining a brother's illness, the Pressure line is the 'controlling killing' (the killing that controls the brother), and if strong and moving the illness is surely dangerous. The fourth is the note in brackets after 'divining the person's fortune' in the 'uses of the Pressure line': meeting luck brings salary and office added, meeting ill means death and illness. In the original the 'divining such-and-such' before each entry says what matter is divined, and the 'wei' in the lines is 'is'; what I put in brackets are subjects supplied, not words in the original. The 'brother' of 'divining a brother' is a brother as a relative, not the Peer line.

title: 六亲用变·疾病：父动当头克子孙病人无药主沉昏、父化子纵然忧病反为吉；子孙发动伤官鬼占病求医身便痊、子化官占病忧疑；财爻发动病人伤脾腹胃虚；兄弟交重克财病人难愈、兄化官占病难医须见哭；官化官病未安、官鬼病困门庭祸祟来

rule.yi: 父母动而克子孙，病人没有药，主沉重昏迷；父母化子孙，宜退散，纵然忧病，反而是吉。子孙发动、伤克官鬼，占病求医，身体就痊愈；子孙化官鬼，要防祸患，占病的忧疑都不准。财爻发动，病人伤脾胃、腹胃虚。兄弟交重克财，病人难愈、没有离灾；兄化官，不要下状，占病难医、须见哭。官鬼发动：病困在门庭、祸祟来；官化官，病未安。
rule.en: The Resource line moving and controlling Output: the sick person has no medicine, and it means heaviness and stupor; Resource changing into Output: it is fit to retreat and scatter, and though there is worry about illness, it is on the contrary lucky. Output moving and injuring the Pressure line: in divining illness and seeking a doctor, the body is cured at once; Output changing into the Pressure line: guard against calamity, and the worries about illness are all off the mark. The Wealth line moving: the sick person injures the spleen and the belly and stomach are deficient. Peer crossing heavily and controlling Wealth: the sick person is hard to cure and has not left the calamity; Peer changing into the Pressure line: do not bring a suit, and divining illness it is hard to treat and weeping will be seen. The Pressure line moving: the illness is trapped at the gate, curses of calamity come; the Pressure line changing into the Pressure line: the illness is not yet at ease.

note.yi: 「用变」是每一类六亲（父母、子孙、妻财、兄弟、官鬼）发动、以及它们变成别的六亲时的断语，每一类有两首歌，这里只收说到病的句子。「父动当头克子孙，病人无药主沉昏」是父母爻发动克子孙（药）：没有药，病人昏沉；「子孙发动伤官鬼，占病求医身便痊」是子孙克鬼：治病有效。「财爻发动……病人伤脾腹胃虚」的「腹胃虚」原文如此，「财」（土）克水，所以「伤脾」这里按字面译，不作解释。「兄弟交重克了财，病人难愈未离灾」是兄弟克财（禄命），病人难愈。「兄化官兮休下状，占病难医须见哭」是兄弟化官鬼。「官鬼发动，病困门庭，祸祟来」是官鬼动：病困在门庭里。这些句子多与前面几章（孙膑歌的六亲、家人占病歌 LY.ILL.DYTJ.05、DYTJ.08）是同一个意思。父母、子孙的用变在求财里也有（LY.WEALTH.DYTJ.32 一带）。
note.en: 'Uses by change' are the judgments when each kind of relation (Resource, Output, Wealth, Peer, Pressure) moves and when it changes into another relation, with two songs for each kind, and here only the sentences that speak of illness are taken. 'The Resource line moving and controlling Output head on: the sick person has no medicine, heaviness and stupor' is Resource moving and controlling Output (the medicine): with no medicine the sick person is in a stupor; 'Output moving and injuring the Pressure line: in divining illness and seeking a doctor the body is cured at once' is Output controlling the ghost: the treatment is effective. In 'the Wealth line moving ... the sick person injures the spleen and the belly and stomach are deficient' the 'belly and stomach are deficient' is as in the original, and it is rendered literally with no explanation. 'Peer crossing heavily and controlling Wealth: the sick person is hard to cure and has not left the calamity' is Peer controlling Wealth (salary and life): the sick person is hard to cure. 'Peer changing into the Pressure line: do not bring a suit, divining illness it is hard to treat and weeping will be seen' is Peer changing into the Pressure line. 'The Pressure line moving, the illness trapped at the gate, curses of calamity come' is the Pressure line moving: the illness is trapped in the gate and courtyard. These sentences mostly agree with the earlier chapters (the six relations in Sun Bin's song and the verses on a family member, LY.ILL.DYTJ.05 and DYTJ.08). The uses by change of Resource and Output are also in the wealth domain (around LY.WEALTH.DYTJ.32).

title: 六亲类象·疾病与医药：福德类象有医药；官鬼独发主病灾、官鬼神邪病崇盗；冲克子孙爻来情为医药

rule.yi: 福德（子孙）所主的类象里，有缉捕、医药、闲人、鱼贩。官鬼是鬼爻，独发主病灾，是损失的兆；官鬼是神、邪、病、祟、盗。来情看冲克哪一爻：冲克子孙爻，是冲福瑞的物件和医药。
rule.en: Among the images governed by Output (Fortune-and-Virtue) are arrests, medicine, idlers and fishmongers. The Pressure line is the ghost line, and moving alone it means illness and calamity, a sign of loss; the Pressure line is gods, evil, illness, curses and thieves. The reason for the divination is looked at by which line is clashed or controlled: a clash on the Output line is a clash with lucky things and medicine.

note.yi: 这几处是《断易天机》里六亲各管哪些事物（类象）的歌，这里只收说到病或药的：子孙类里「缉捕医药闲鱼侩」有医药；官鬼类里头一行的括号说「独发主病灾」，歌里说「官鬼神邪病崇盗」；「来情章」里「冲克子孙爻：冲福瑞物及医药」是说占的人来占的缘由是冲克了子孙爻，他问的就是福瑞的东西和医药。「官鬼类」的括号（为鬼爻，独发主病灾，损失之兆）是原文里加在标题后面的说明。「闲鱼侩」的「鱼侩」是鱼贩（牙侩），字面译。这几句的意思和前面「子孙为医药、官鬼为病」的说法（LY.ILL.DYTJ.39、LY.ILL.HZL.06）是一回事。
note.en: These are songs in the Duanyi Tianji about which things (images) each of the six relations governs, and only the lines that speak of illness or medicine are taken: under Output 'arrests, medicine, idlers and fishmongers' has medicine; the first line of the Pressure line's section has in brackets 'moving alone it means illness and calamity', and the song has 'the Pressure line is gods, evil, illness, curses and thieves'; and in the 'chapter on the reason for the divination' 'a clash on the Output line: a clash with lucky things and medicine' says that the reason the person has come to divine is that the Output line has been clashed and controlled, and what he asks about is lucky things and medicine. The bracket in the Pressure line's section (the ghost line, moving alone it means illness and calamity, a sign of loss) is a note added after the heading in the original. The 'yu kuai' of 'idlers and fishmongers' is a fish broker, rendered literally. The sense of these lines is the same as the earlier sayings 'Output is the medicine and the Pressure line is the illness' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.39, LY.ILL.HZL.06).

yi: （福德所主的类象里）缉捕、医药、闲人、鱼贩，
en: (among the images governed by Output) arrests, medicine, idlers and fishmongers,

yi: （官鬼是鬼爻，
独发主病灾，
是损失的兆。）
en: (the Pressure line is the ghost line,
moving alone it means illness and calamity,
a sign of loss.)

yi: 官鬼是神、邪、病、祟、盗，
en: the Pressure line is gods, evil, illness, curses and thieves,

yi: 冲克子孙爻：
冲福瑞的物件和医药，
en: A clash on the Output line:
a clash with lucky things and medicine,

title: 期日章·占病应期：子孙生旺为病瘥、鬼爻墓旺病身危；药爻福德寻生旺、日辰遇着是神医

rule.yi: 看病愈的日子：子孙生旺的时候，病好；鬼爻入墓、旺的时候，病人危险。药爻（福德）要找它生旺的日子，遇到那个日辰，就是遇到神医。
rule.en: For the day of recovery from illness: when Output is born strong, the illness is cured; when the Pressure line enters a tomb or is strong, the sick person is in danger. For the medicine line (Output) look for the day on which it is born strong, and meeting that day is meeting a divine physician.

note.yi: 这是《期日章》这首歌里说到病的两联：歌里一联管一件事的应期，求财、六甲（怀孕生产）、行人、病、失物、婚姻、求官、公事、阴宅、医药、天气各一联。「子孙生旺为病瘥」是子孙爻长生或帝旺的日子病好；「鬼爻墓旺病身危」是鬼爻入墓或旺的日子病重。「药爻福德寻生旺，日辰遇着是神医」是药爻（子孙福德）生旺的日辰，医药有效，「神医」按字面译。歌后有今人写的「（3）」「（6）」注号，那几条注不收。这两联和孙膑歌的「福德持世鬼暂退」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.02）、火珠林「占疾病何日愈」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.18）里子孙福德临月日愈病是同一个道理。
note.en: These are the two couplets on illness in the song of the 'chapter on the day of the outcome': in the song each couplet governs the timing of one matter: wealth, the six jia (pregnancy and birth), a traveller, illness, lost things, marriage, seeking office, official business, a yin house (a grave), medicine and the weather one couplet each. 'When Output is born strong the illness is cured' is that the illness gets better on the day when the Output line is at Long Life or Emperor's Prime; 'when the Pressure line enters a tomb or is strong the sick person is in danger' is that the illness is heavy on the day when the Pressure line enters a tomb or is strong. 'For the medicine line (Output) look for the day on which it is born strong; meeting that day is meeting a divine physician' is the day branch on which the medicine line (Output) is born strong, when the medicine is effective, and 'divine physician' is rendered literally. After the song there are annotation marks such as '(3)' and '(6)' written by a modern hand, and those annotations are not quoted. These two couplets are the same principle as Sun Bin's song, 'Output holding the Self, the ghost retreats for a time' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.02), and the Huozhu Lin's 'on which day an illness will be cured' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.18), in which Output arriving on the month or day cures the illness.

yi: 子孙生旺的时候，病好；
鬼爻入墓、旺的时候，病人危险。
en: when Output is born strong, the illness is cured;
when the Pressure line enters a tomb or is strong, the sick person is in danger.

yi: 药爻（福德）要找它生旺的日子，
遇到那个日辰，就是遇到神医。
en: For the medicine line (Output) look for the day on which it is born strong,
and meeting that day is meeting a divine physician.

title: 何知章·疾病：螣蛇入火瘟气麻痘病、入金怕逢病半死、爻入水病来伤小口退一双；白虎临子孙位子孙今年忌、临财妻妾恐人灾殃、临父母父母切忌讳、临兄弟不久入泉乡；玄武牛猪空亡瘴死为瘟疫；有长病人八纯卦、有妻病身克财、重丧鬼化财、有长不安青龙入水患疮

rule.yi: 螣蛇入火，主瘟气、麻疹、痘疹的病；入金，怕遇上病得半死；若爻入水，病来伤人，小孩要退一双。白虎临在子孙位，子孙今年忌；临在财、妻妾位，恐怕有人灾殃；临在父母位，父母切忌；临在兄弟宫，不久入黄泉。玄武在牛、猪空亡处当着，瘴气死人成为瘟疫。有长期生病的人，是八纯卦；有妻子病，是身克财；重丧，是鬼化财；有长辈不安，是青龙入水、患疮；有聋人，是兑卦入乾。
rule.en: The Coiling Snake entering Fire: plague, measles and smallpox; entering Metal: one fears meeting an illness half deadly; if the line enters Water the illness comes to injure, and the children retreat by a pair. The White Tiger sitting on the Output place: Output must beware this year; on Wealth and the wife's or concubine's place: fear a calamity to a person; on Resource: the parents must beware; on Peer: before long he enters the Yellow Springs. The Dark Tortoise standing at Chou and Hai Void: miasma deaths become an epidemic. A long-standing sick person: a pure hexagram; a wife's illness: the Body controlling Wealth; a double mourning: the ghost changing into Wealth; an elder unwell: the Azure Dragon entering Water, with sores; a deaf person: Dui changing into Qian.

note.yi: 《何知章》是一首「怎么从卦里知道家里的事」的歌：每一句是「有某某，是某卦某爻」。这里只收说到病、瘟疫、丧的几处。第一联「鰧蛇入火火烧定，瘟气麻痘病」和「入金怕逢病半死……若爻入水病来伤，小口退一双」是螣蛇落在不同五行爻上的情形（火、金、水），原文里前后隔着说家宅、蛇伤、野兽的几句，不收；「入金怕逢病半死」的「入金」承上文「鰧蛇入」。「小口退一双」是小孩要走（死）一对，字面译。第二联是白虎临六亲位：临子孙位子孙忌、临财妻妾恐人灾殃、临父母父母忌讳、临兄弟不久入泉乡（入黄泉）。第三联「牛猪空亡玄武当，瘴死为瘟疫」是玄武在牛（丑）、猪（亥）空亡的位置上，瘴气死人成瘟疫。第四、五联是「怎么知道」的句子：「有长病人」是八纯卦，「有妻病」是身克财，「重丧」是鬼化财，「有长不安」是青龙入水患疮，「有聋人」是兑卦入乾。「有长病人，八纯卦也」和火珠林「凡得八纯游魂卦，病者决主沉重」（LY.ILL.HZL.05）是同一类。这一章的「有多事不成……」等几句不在病的范围，不收。
note.en: The 'chapter on how it is known' is a song on how to know from a hexagram the affairs of a family, and each line is 'there is such-and-such: it is such-and-such hexagram or line'. Here only the passages that speak of illness, plague and mourning are taken. The first couplet, 'the Coiling Snake entering Fire, fire is sure, plague, measles and smallpox' and 'entering Metal one fears meeting an illness half deadly ... if the line enters Water the illness comes to injure, the children retreat by a pair', is the Coiling Snake falling on lines of different phases (Fire, Metal, Water), and in the original the lines about the house, snake bites and wild beasts fall in between them and are not taken; the 'entering Metal' of 'entering Metal one fears meeting an illness half deadly' follows the earlier 'the Coiling Snake enters'. 'The children retreat by a pair' means a pair of children go (die), rendered literally. The second couplet is the White Tiger on the places of the six relations: on Output Output must beware, on Wealth and the wife's or concubine's place fear a calamity to a person, on Resource the parents must beware, on Peer before long he enters the Yellow Springs. The third couplet, 'the Dark Tortoise standing at Chou and Hai Void, miasma deaths are an epidemic', is the Dark Tortoise at the places of the ox (Chou) and the pig (Hai) Void, miasma killing people and becoming an epidemic. The fourth and fifth couplets are sentences of 'how it is known': 'a long-standing sick person' is a pure hexagram, 'a wife's illness' is the Body controlling Wealth, 'a double mourning' is the ghost changing into Wealth, 'an elder unwell' is the Azure Dragon entering Water with sores, and 'a deaf person' is Dui changing into Qian. 'A long-standing sick person: a pure hexagram' is of the same kind as the Huozhu Lin's 'whoever gets a pure or Wandering Soul hexagram, the sick person is surely heavy' (LY.ILL.HZL.05). The other lines of this chapter, 'many affairs not accomplished ...' and so on, are outside illness and are not taken.

zh: 鰧蛇入火火烧定，瘟气麻痘病。
yi: 螣蛇入火，主火烧一定，瘟气、麻疹、痘疹的病。
en: The Coiling Snake entering Fire: fire is sure, plague, measles and smallpox.

zh: 入金怕逢病半死，口舌重重至。若爻入水病来伤，小口退一双。
yi: （螣蛇）入金，怕遇上病得半死，口舌重重来；若爻入水，病来伤人，小孩要退一双。
en: entering Metal, one fears meeting an illness half deadly, and quarrels come thick; if the line enters Water the illness comes to injure, and the children retreat by a pair.

zh: 白虎若临子孙位，子孙今年忌。
忽若临财妻妾位，恐怕人灾殃。
白虎若临父母位，父母切忌讳。
白虎若临兄弟宫，不久入泉乡。
yi: 白虎若临在子孙位，子孙今年忌；
忽然临在财、妻妾位，恐怕有人灾殃；
白虎若临在父母位，父母切忌；
白虎若临在兄弟宫，不久入黄泉。
en: If the White Tiger sits on the Output place, Output must beware this year;
if suddenly on Wealth and the wife's or concubine's place, fear a calamity to a person;
if the White Tiger sits on the Resource place, the parents must beware;
if the White Tiger sits on the Peer palace, before long he enters the Yellow Springs.

zh: 牛猪空亡玄武当，瘴死为瘟疫。
yi: 牛、猪空亡处玄武当着，瘴气死人是瘟疫。
en: The Dark Tortoise standing at Chou and Hai Void: miasma deaths are an epidemic.

yi: 有长期生病的人，是八纯卦；
有妻子病，是身克财。
en: A long-standing sick person: a pure hexagram;
a wife's illness: the Body controlling Wealth.

zh: 有长不安，青龙入水患疮也。
yi: 重丧，是鬼化财；
有长辈不安，是青龙入水、患疮；
有聋人，是兑卦入乾。
en: A double mourning: the ghost changing into Wealth;
an elder unwell: the Azure Dragon entering Water, with sores;
a deaf person: Dui changing into Qian.

chapter: 占医药第三十五·鬼谷辨爻法
title: 鬼谷辨爻法·占医药：初爻针药、二爻酸药、三爻甘药、四爻苦药、五爻辛药、六爻医师

rule.yi: 鬼谷子辨爻法在占医药一章的表：初爻是针药，二爻是酸药，三爻是甘药，四爻是苦药，五爻是辛药，六爻是医师。
rule.en: Guigu's table of the lines for the chapter on doctors and medicine: the first line is needle medicine, the second sour medicine, the third sweet medicine, the fourth bitter medicine, the fifth pungent medicine and the sixth the physician.

note.yi: 这是占医药一章开头的一张三行的表，原书排成六列：第一行是「鬼谷辨爻法」这个标题，第二行是初爻到六爻，第三行是六个名目。按位置一格对一爻：初爻针药、二爻酸药、三爻甘药、四爻苦药、五爻辛药、六爻医师。「针药」是用针（针灸）的治法，「酸药」「甘药」「苦药」「辛药」是酸、甘、苦、辛四味的药，表里没有咸味；书里没有解释这六格为什么这样配。这张表的性质和占疾病一章开头的鬼谷辨爻法表（LY.ILL.DYTJ.01）一样，是把六个爻位配给这一章要看的东西。
note.en: This is a three-row table at the head of the chapter on doctors and medicine, laid out in the original as six columns: the first row is the heading 'Guigu's method of telling the lines apart', the second the first to sixth lines, and the third six names. Cell by cell by position: the first line needle medicine, the second sour medicine, the third sweet medicine, the fourth bitter medicine, the fifth pungent medicine, the sixth the physician. 'Needle medicine' is treatment with the needle (acupuncture), and 'sour', 'sweet', 'bitter' and 'pungent medicine' are medicines of the four tastes sour, sweet, bitter and pungent, with no salty taste in the table; the book does not explain why the six cells are matched so. This table is of the same kind as the table under Guigu's name at the head of the chapter on illness (LY.ILL.DYTJ.01), matching the six line positions to what the chapter is about.

zh: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
针药酸药甘药苦药辛药医师
yi: 鬼谷子辨别各爻的办法
初爻、二爻、三爻、四爻、五爻、六爻
针药、酸药、甘药、苦药、辛药、医师
en: Guigu's method of telling the lines apart
the first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth lines
needle medicine, sour medicine, sweet medicine, bitter medicine, pungent medicine, the physician

hits.text: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻

chapter: 占医药第三十五·孙真人论医歌
title: 孙真人论医歌：夫病欲医须卦静、爻须旺相子扶身；应爻及外为医者、内卦身爻是病人；医能克病人方治、病若克医药不灵；鬼爻持世人难保、吉杀加临获万全

rule.yi: 病人的病要医治，卦要安静，爻要旺相，子孙扶身；应爻和外卦是医生，内卦和身爻是病人；医生克病，病人才能治；病克医生，药不灵；鬼爻持世，人难保；吉杀加临，可获万全。
rule.en: When a man's illness is to be treated the hexagram must be still, the lines strong and Output supporting the Body; the Other line and the outer trigram are the doctor, the inner trigram and the Body line are the sick person; if the doctor controls the illness the person can be treated; if the illness controls the doctor the medicine is not effective; the Pressure line holding the Self, the person can hardly be kept; a lucky killing added, complete safety is gained.

note.yi: 孙真人是唐代的孙思邈。这首医药歌和阐奥歌章医药章的第二首（LY.ILL.CA.09）几乎一样，前四句（夫病欲医须卦静……内卦身爻是病人）和「鬼爻持世人难保」一字不差，只有三处不同：阐奥歌章是「医来克病人方愈」，这里是「医能克病人方治」；阐奥歌章是「吉曜加临大吉大利」，这里是「吉杀加临获万全」；「病若克医药不灵」两处相同。「吉杀」是带吉的神煞（指吉神吉煞），「获万全」是可得万全。原文孙真人这一首后面，断易天机没有再引注（今人有译文，不收）。这一首的医、病分法（应和外卦是医、内卦和世身是病人）和天玄赋（LY.ILL.TXF.12）是同一套。
note.en: Master Sun is Sun Simiao of the Tang. This song on medicine is almost the same as the second poem in the chapter on medicine in the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.09): the first four lines ('when a man's illness is to be treated the hexagram must be still ... the inner trigram and the Body line are the sick person') and 'the Pressure line holding the Self, the person can hardly be kept' are word for word the same, and there are only differences in a few lines: the Chan'ao Gezhang has 'if the doctor controls the illness the person is cured' where this has 'if the doctor is able to control the illness the person can be treated', and 'a lucky star added, greatly favourable' where this has 'a lucky killing added, complete safety is gained'; 'if the illness controls the doctor the medicine is not effective' is the same in both. 'A lucky killing' is a spirit or killing that brings luck, and 'complete safety is gained' is that complete safety can be had. After this poem of Master Sun the Duanyi Tianji cites no commentary (modern hands have added a translation, which is not quoted). The division of doctor and illness in this poem (the Other line and the outer trigram are the doctor, the inner trigram and the Self and Body are the sick person) is the same set as the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.12).

yi: 病人的病要医，卦要安静，
爻要旺相，子孙扶身；
应爻和外卦是医生，
内卦和身爻是病人。
医生能克病，病人才能治；
病如果克医生，药不灵；
鬼爻持世，人难保；
吉杀加临，可获万全。
en: When a man's illness is to be treated the hexagram must be still,
the line must be strong and Output support the Body;
the Other line and the outer trigram are the doctor;
the inner trigram and the Body line are the sick person.
if the doctor is able to control the illness the person can be treated;
if the illness controls the doctor the medicine is not effective;
The Pressure line holding the Self, the person can hardly be kept;
a lucky killing added, complete safety is gained.

chapter: 占医药第三十五·卜筮元龟
title: 卜筮元龟·占医人善恶：欲占医人善恶详无过贞悔可斟量；子爻在土宜丸药、水宜服汤、木青丸药、金火宜灸灼；子爻旺相好医人、无气杀冲还恶；卦无子爻何以遂、旺相相生药无崇、内外不和服药凶、更遇杀冲须早惧

rule.yi: 要占医生的好坏，要看得详细，不过是斟酌贞（内卦）和悔（外卦）。子爻在土，宜用丸药；若是水爻，宜服汤；子爻是木，宜青丸药；金、火两爻，宜灸灼。子爻旺相，是好医生；无气、遭杀冲，还是坏的。卦里没有子爻，怎么能遂心？旺相相生，药就没有祟；内外不和，服药凶；再遇到杀、冲，要早早警惕。
rule.en: To divine whether a doctor is good or bad, look in detail; it is no more than weighing the inner (zhen) and outer (hui) trigrams. If the Output line is on Earth, pills are fit; if it is Water, a decoction should be taken; if the Output line is Wood, green pills; if Metal or Fire, moxibustion and cautery are fit. If the Output line is strong the doctor is good; if it has no qi or meets a killing or clash he is still a bad one. With no Output line in the hexagram how can it be accomplished? Strong and generating each other, the medicine has no curse; with the inner and outer not in harmony taking medicine is ominous; and if meeting a killing or clash as well, one must be wary early.

dispute.yi: 用药按谁的五行选，几本书的做法不同。断易天机卜筮元龟这一首按子爻（药）的五行：子爻属土宜丸药、属水宜汤、属木宜青丸药、属金火宜灸灼；洞林秘诀（LY.ILL.DYTJ.47）说「药色五行自斟酌」，注也是按子孙爻的五行取药色；天玄赋注（LY.ILL.TXF.13）、火珠林（LY.ILL.HZL.09）、易隐（LY.ILL.YY.25）按鬼爻的五行：火鬼宜凉剂、水鬼宜温剂或丸药、木鬼宜针、金鬼宜灸、土鬼宜锉散。两个体系都在：一个看药本身（子孙）的五行，一个看病（鬼）的五行，并且结论不同（比如金爻：子爻属金宜灸灼，金鬼也宜灸，一致；水：子爻是水宜服汤，水鬼宜温剂或丸药，不一致）。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Whose phase to use in choosing medicine is done differently in different books. The Bushi Yuangui song of the Duanyi Tianji takes the phase of the Output line (the medicine): Output on Earth pills, Water a decoction, Wood green pills, Metal and Fire moxibustion and cautery; the Dongling Mijue (LY.ILL.DYTJ.47) says 'the colour of the medicine is for oneself to weigh by the five phases', taking the colour of the medicine also from the phase of the Output line; the commentary on the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.13), the Huozhu Lin (LY.ILL.HZL.09) and the Yi Yin (LY.ILL.YY.25) take the phase of the ghost line: a Fire ghost a cooling remedy, a Water ghost a warming remedy or pills, a Wood ghost the needle, a Metal ghost moxa, an Earth ghost cut-and-ground powders. Both systems are there: one looks at the phase of the medicine itself (Output), the other at the phase of the illness (the ghost), and their conclusions differ (for Metal, Output on Metal is fit for moxibustion and a Metal ghost is also fit for moxa, which agree; for Water, Output on Water is fit for a decoction and a Water ghost for a warming remedy or pills, which do not agree). The books do not settle it.

note.yi: 「贞悔」是内卦（贞）和外卦（悔），内卦是病人、外卦是医药，拿这两个来比。「子爻」是子孙爻，是药；这里按子爻所属的五行选药：子爻属土宜丸药、属水宜汤药、属木宜青色的丸药、属金或火宜灸灼。「药无崇」的「崇」按「祟」译（药里没有作祟的东西），字面译作 curse。「（1）」「（2）」「（3）」是今人加的注号，那几条注不收。这里的用药是按子孙爻的五行选，天玄赋、火珠林和易隐是按鬼爻的五行选（见「打架」）。
note.en: The 'zhen and hui' are the inner trigram (zhen) and the outer trigram (hui); the inner trigram is the sick person and the outer the medicine, and the two are compared. The 'Output line' is the Output line, the medicine; here the medicine is chosen by the phase the Output line belongs to: Output on Earth is fit for pills, on Water for a decoction, on Wood for green pills, on Metal or Fire for moxibustion and cautery. The 'chong' of 'the medicine has no chong' is rendered 'curse' as a miswriting of 'sui' (a curse), that there is nothing in the medicine that brings a curse. The '(1)', '(2)' and '(3)' are modern annotation marks and those annotations are not quoted. The use of medicine here is chosen by the phase of the Output line, and the Tianxuan Fu, the Huozhu Lin and the Yi Yin choose it by the phase of the ghost line (see the dispute).

yi: 要占医生的好坏，要看得详细，
不过是斟酌贞（内卦）和悔（外卦）；
子爻在土，宜用丸药；
若是水爻，宜服汤药。
子爻是木，宜青色的丸药；
金、火两种爻，宜用灸灼；
子爻旺相，是好医生；
无气、遭杀冲，还是坏的。
卦里没有子爻，怎么能遂心？
旺相相生，药就没有祟；
内外不和，服药凶；
再遇到杀、冲，要早早警惕。
en: To divine whether a doctor is good or bad, look in detail,
it is no more than weighing the inner (zhen) and outer (hui) trigrams;
if the Output line is on Earth, pills are fit;
if it is Water, a decoction should be taken.
if the Output line is Wood, green pills;
if Metal or Fire, moxibustion and cautery are fit;
if the Output line is strong the doctor is good;
if it has no qi or meets a killing or clash he is still a bad one.
with no Output line in the hexagram how can it be accomplished?
strong and generating each other, the medicine has no curse;
with the inner and outer not in harmony taking medicine is ominous;
and if meeting a killing or clash as well, one must be wary early.

chapter: 占医药第三十五·洞林秘诀
title: 洞林秘诀·占医药：卦中子孙爻为药、天医相助如扁鹊；应爻是医生、世爻是病人、病不克药总堪医；鬼爻持世不肯食先宜祀神后服药；病伏为鬼不除根

rule.yi: 卦里的子孙爻是药，有天医相助，像扁鹊一样；卦爻若旺相、伏神没有鬼，病得以除根，治好、安乐。要看医生，应爻就是；病人求医药，世爻来当；病不克药，总是可以医治；药的颜色按五行自己斟酌。鬼爻持世，不肯吃东西，或者过不了喉咙就吐，即使吃下去，病更加重，应当先祭祀神灵，后服药。病伏着成了鬼，不能除根，一时暂且收功，得个大概；再加上生克、杀神来推；病人所适宜的，全在医生。
rule.en: In the hexagram the Output line is the medicine, and with the Heavenly Physician helping it is like Bian Que; if the lines are strong and the hidden spirit has no ghost, the illness is rooted out, cured, and one is at ease. If one looks at the doctor, it is the Other line; the sick person seeking medicine, the Self line stands for him; if the illness does not control the medicine it can always be treated; the colour of the medicine is for oneself to weigh by the five phases. With the Pressure line holding the Self he will not take food, or it does not pass the throat and is vomited, and even if it is eaten the illness grows worse; one should first sacrifice to the spirits and then take medicine. With the illness hidden and turned into a ghost, it is not rooted out, for a time it gains merit briefly, roughly so; further work it out by generation, control and the killing spirits; what suits the illness is chosen entirely by the doctor.

note.yi: 这首洞林秘诀在占医药一章里，和占疾病一章里那一段洞林秘诀（LY.ILL.DYTJ.16）是同一部书的两首：那一首讲鬼、杀、刑克主灾疾，这一首讲医和药。「鬼爻持世不肯食……先宜祀神后服药」和那一首「鬼爻持世须求鬼，若逢服药进灾殃」是同一个意思：鬼爻持世，先要向神灵祈求，然后才服药。「病伏为鬼不除根」按「病爻下伏着鬼」读（病的爻下面伏着鬼爻，所以断不了根），字面译。最后一句「病撰所宜尽医者」读不确定，「撰」有选的意思，这里按「病人所适宜的（药），全在医生（去选）」字面译。「扁鹊」是战国时的名医。「（1）（2）（3）」是今人注号，那几条注不收。天医（天医相助如扁鹊）见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.30、DYTJ.34。药色按五行取，见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.46 的「打架」。
note.en: This Dongling Mijue in the chapter on doctors and medicine is a second poem from the same book as the passage of the Dongling Mijue in the chapter on illness (LY.ILL.DYTJ.16): that one speaks of the ghost, the killings, punishment and control bringing calamity and illness, and this one of the doctor and the medicine. 'The Pressure line holding the Self, he will not take food ... one should first sacrifice to the spirits and then take medicine' and the other one's 'the Pressure line holding the Self, one must seek the ghost, and if one then takes medicine it only advances calamity' are the same sense: with the Pressure line holding the Self one must first pray to the spirits, and only then take medicine. 'With the illness hidden and turned into a ghost, it is not rooted out' is read as a ghost line hidden under the line of the illness (so that the root cannot be cut), and is rendered literally. The last line, 'what suits the illness is chosen entirely by the doctor', is not certain, and 'zhuan' has the sense of choosing; it is rendered literally as 'what suits the illness (medicine) is chosen entirely by the doctor'. Bian Que was a famous physician of the Warring States. The '(1)', '(2)' and '(3)' are modern annotation marks and those annotations are not quoted. For the Heavenly Physician (the Heavenly Physician helping) see LY.ILL.DYTJ.30 and DYTJ.34. For the colour of the medicine taken by the five phases see the dispute in LY.ILL.DYTJ.46.

yi: 卦里的子孙爻是药，
有天医相助，像扁鹊一样；
卦爻如果旺相、伏神没有鬼，
病得以除根，治好、安乐。
如果要看医生，应爻就是；
病人求医药，世爻来当；
病不克药，总是可以医治；
药的颜色按五行自己斟酌。
鬼爻持世，病人不肯吃东西；
或者过不了喉咙就吐了；
即使吃下去，病更加重；
应当先祭祀神灵，后服药。
病伏着成了鬼，不能除根；
一时暂且收功，得个大概；
再加上生克、杀神来推；
病人所适宜的，全在医生。
en: In the hexagram the Output line is the medicine,
and with the Heavenly Physician helping it is like Bian Que;
if the lines are strong and the hidden spirit has no ghost,
the illness is rooted out, cured, and one is at ease.
If one looks at the doctor, it is the Other line;
the sick person seeking medicine, the Self line stands for him;
if the illness does not control the medicine it can always be treated;
the colour of the medicine is for oneself to weigh by the five phases.
the Pressure line holding the Self, he will not take food;
or it does not pass the throat and is vomited;
even if it is eaten the illness grows worse;
one should first sacrifice to the spirits and then take medicine.
with the illness hidden and turned into a ghost, it is not rooted out;
for a time it gains merit briefly, roughly so;
further work it out by generation, control and the killing spirits;
what suits the illness is chosen entirely by the doctor.

title: 占居官有疾病否：卦变为囚死乡居官身病至衰亡、无气带杀终有祸更值空亡必有丧；鬼动若逢休废地此身退位终无位、胎没并之世自微更加刑杀为衰

rule.yi: 占在任的官有没有疾病：凡是卦变到囚、死的地方，在任的官身上有病，以至衰亡；无气又带杀，终究有祸，再遇上空亡，必定有丧。鬼动，若逢到休、废的地方，这个人退位，终究没有官位；胎没并起来，世自己就衰微，再加刑、杀，就是衰败了。
rule.en: On whether an official in office has illness: whenever the hexagram changes into a place of trapped or dead, the official in office falls ill, even to decline and death; without qi and bearing a killing, in the end there is calamity, and meeting Void as well there is surely a death. The ghost moving, if it meets a place of resting or ruin, this person leaves office and in the end has no post; with Womb and Submerged joined, the Self itself is faint, and with punishment and killings added it is decline.

note.yi: 这首在占官一章的「占居官有疾病否」一题下，问的是在任的官会不会生病。「囚死乡」是囚、死两种状态所在的地方（旺相休囚死里的囚和死）；「卦变为囚死乡」是卦（或世爻）变到囚死的地方。「胎没」是什么书里没有说，「胎」和「没」是两个名目，这里字面译作 Womb and Submerged；「并之」是并在一起。这首歌前半是说身病，后半转到「退位无位」的官运上，所以放在一起收。这一首在同一书里出现两次（一次是歌诀，一次是今人译文里重复的标题），译文不收。前半的意思（状态衰败、又带杀、再遇空亡则死）和孙膑歌「卦变墓乡须丧命」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.07）、天玄赋的「入墓卦」（LY.ILL.TXF.06）是同一类。
note.en: This poem is under the heading 'divining whether an official in office has illness' in the chapter on divining office, and asks whether an official in office will fall ill. The 'place of trapped or dead' is the place where the two states of trapped and dead (of strong, helped, resting, trapped, dead) lie; 'the hexagram changing into a place of trapped or dead' is the hexagram (or the Self line) changing into a place of trapped or dead. What 'Womb and Submerged' is the book does not say, and 'tai' and 'mo' are two names, rendered literally as Womb and Submerged; 'bing zhi' is joined together. The first half of the poem speaks of illness of the body, and the second half turns to fortune in office, 'leaves office and has no post', and so they are taken together. This poem appears twice in the same book (once as the verse and once as a repeated heading in a modern translation), and the translation is not quoted. The sense of the first half (a state of decline, bearing a killing, and meeting Void as well means death) is of the same kind as Sun Bin's song, 'if the hexagram changes into the tomb quarter life will surely be lost' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.07), and the Tianxuan Fu's 'hexagrams that enter tombs' (LY.ILL.TXF.06).

yi: 占在任的官有没有疾病，歌诀说：
凡是卦变到囚、死的地方，
在任的官身上有病，以至衰亡；
无气又带着杀，终究有祸；
再遇上空亡，必定有丧。
鬼动，若逢到休、废的地方，
这个人退位，终究没有官位；
胎没并起来，世自己就衰微，
再加刑、杀，就是衰败。
en: On whether an official in office has illness it says:
Whenever the hexagram changes into a place of trapped or dead,
the official in office falls ill, even to decline and death;
without qi and bearing a killing, in the end there is calamity,
and meeting Void as well there is surely a death.
The ghost moving, if it meets a place of resting or ruin,
this person leaves office and in the end has no post;
with Womb and Submerged joined, the Self itself is faint,
and with punishment and killings added it is decline.

title: 总断歌·占病几句：父病嫌大杀；无鬼病难疗；鬼旺主发狂；请看考鬼历、祷谢得安康

rule.yi: 总断歌里说到病的几句：父亲有病，忌讳大杀；没有鬼，病难以治疗；鬼旺，主发狂；请看考察鬼历，祷告酬谢，得到安康。
rule.en: The lines of the song of general judgments that speak of illness: for a father's illness the Great Killing is disliked; with no ghost the illness is hard to treat; with the ghost strong it means madness; look up and examine the ghost calendar, pray and give thanks, and health and peace are gained.

note.yi: 这是断易天机里一首长的「总断歌」中说到病的几句，歌里每句后面的括号是今人加的注释（不收），所以这里每一句单独收一段。「大杀」是大杀（天哭杀一类的凶神，LY.ILL.DYTJ.33）。「鬼旺主发狂」的「发狂」是神志失常，和天玄赋「朱雀鬼：狂言乱语」（LY.ILL.TXF.03）、卜筮元龟「狂言乱语失精神」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.10）是同一类。「考鬼历」读不确定，字面是「察看鬼的历（历书）」，大概是查是哪一路鬼神、在哪一天作祟，再祷谢；「祷谢」是祷告和酬谢（还愿）。「无鬼病难疗」和「卦中无鬼病难医」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.02）是同一条。歌里「空亡母不长」一句不能确定是不是专说病，不收。
note.en: These are the lines that speak of illness in a long 'song of general judgments' in the Duanyi Tianji, and the brackets after each line in the song are notes added by a modern hand (not quoted), so here each line is taken as a passage of its own. The 'Great Killing' is a fierce spirit of the Weeping Killing kind (LY.ILL.DYTJ.33). 'With the ghost strong it means madness' has 'madness' as losing one's mind, of the same kind as the Tianxuan Fu's 'the Vermilion Bird ghost: raving and wild speech' (LY.ILL.TXF.03) and the Bushi Yuangui's 'raving and wild speech, losing the wits' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.10). 'Examining the ghost calendar' is not certain and is literally 'looking at and examining the ghost's calendar', probably checking which ghost or spirit brings the curse and on which day, and then praying and giving thanks; 'praying and giving thanks' is praying and thanking (redeeming a vow). 'With no ghost the illness is hard to treat' is the same entry as 'with no ghost in the hexagram the illness is hard to treat' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.02). The line in the song 'Void, the mother is not long-lived' cannot be taken to be specially about illness and is not taken.

yi: 父亲有病，忌讳大杀。
en: for a father's illness, the Great Killing is disliked.

yi: 没有鬼，病难以治疗。
en: with no ghost the illness is hard to treat.

yi: 鬼旺，主发狂。
en: with the ghost strong it means madness.

yi: 请看考察鬼历，
祷告酬谢，得到安康。
en: look up and examine the ghost calendar,
pray and give thanks, and health and peace are gained.

title: 四利三元(十二岁煞)：从年上起顺轮，一太岁二太阳三丧门四太阴五官符六死符七岁破八龙德九白虎十福德十一吊客十二病符

rule.yi: 断易天机在神煞月令表前列了一份十二位的流年神煞：从当年的年支（太岁）起，顺着数下去，依次是太岁、太阳、丧门、太阴、官符、死符、岁破、龙德、白虎、福德、吊客、病符。
rule.en: Before the monthly table of spirit-stars the Duanyi Tianji lists twelve year-stars: starting from the branch of the current year (Tai Sui) and counting forward, they are Tai Sui, Great Yang, Mourning Gate, Great Yin, Official Tally, Death Tally, Year-break, Dragon Virtue, White Tiger, Fortune Virtue, Guest of Condolence and Sickness Tally.

dispute.yi: 十二位岁煞各家的名单不一样。断易天机的「四利三元」是：一太岁、二太阳、三丧门、四太阴、五官符、六死符、七岁破、八龙德、九白虎、十福德、十一吊客、十二病符；卜筮全书的岁前神煞（LY.ILL.BSQS.51）是：一太岁剑锋伏尸、二太阳天空、三丧门、四勾绞贯索、五官符五鬼、六死符小耗、七栏干大耗、八暴败天厄、九飞廉白虎、十福德卷舌、十一天狗吊客、十二病符。第一、二、三、五、六、九、十、十一、十二位的主名两本一致；第四位（太阴对勾绞贯索）、第七位（岁破对栏干大耗）、第八位（龙德对暴败天厄）不同，而且卜筮全书每一位后面还并带了一两颗别的星。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The books' lists of the twelve year-stars differ. The Duanyi Tianji's 'Four Gains and Three Origins' runs: first Tai Sui, second Great Yang, third Mourning Gate, fourth Great Yin, fifth Official Tally, sixth Death Tally, seventh Year-break, eighth Dragon Virtue, ninth White Tiger, tenth Fortune Virtue, eleventh Guest of Condolence, twelfth Sickness Tally; the stars before the Year in the Bushi Quanshu (LY.ILL.BSQS.51) run: first Tai Sui with Sword Edge and Hidden Corpse, second Great Yang with Heavenly Emptiness, third Mourning Gate, fourth Hook-Strangle and Cord-Through, fifth Official Tally with the Five Ghosts, sixth Death Tally with Small Loss, seventh Railing with Great Loss, eighth Sudden Ruin and Heavenly Distress, ninth Feilian with the White Tiger, tenth Fortune Virtue with the Curled Tongue, eleventh the Heavenly Dog with the Guest of Condolence, twelfth Sickness Tally. The principal names agree in the first, second, third, fifth, sixth, ninth, tenth, eleventh and twelfth places; the fourth (Great Yin against Hook-Strangle and Cord-Through), the seventh (Year-break against Railing and Great Loss) and the eighth (Dragon Virtue against Sudden Ruin and Heavenly Distress) differ, and the Bushi Quanshu joins one or two further stars to each place. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这是神煞月令表前面的一行名单，题目「四利三元」书里没有解释；列的十二位是按年支顺数的流年神煞：子年时太岁在子、太阳在丑、丧门在寅，依次往下，病符在亥。书里没有说哪一位管病，丧门、死符、吊客、病符的名字里带着丧和病，卜筮全书的岁前神煞把「病符切莫逢」「丧门主孝服」写明了（LY.ILL.BSQS.51），所以收在这里。「十福德」的福德是一颗神煞，不是子孙爻。「见天玄赋家宅类」是书里的一句小注，指这十二位在天玄赋的家宅部分也讲到。原文「官苻」「死苻」「病苻」的苻是符的异写。
note.en: This is a line of names before the monthly table of spirit-stars, and the heading 'Four Gains and Three Origins' is not explained in the book; the twelve places are year-stars counted forward from the year branch: in a Zi year Tai Sui is at Zi, Great Yang at Chou, the Mourning Gate at Yin, and so on, with the Sickness Tally at Hai. The book does not say which place governs illness; the Mourning Gate, Death Tally, Guest of Condolence and Sickness Tally carry mourning and illness in their names, and the stars before the Year in the Bushi Quanshu say outright 'the Sickness Tally is not to be met' and 'the Mourning Gate means mourning dress' (LY.ILL.BSQS.51), which is why the list is taken here. The Fortune Virtue of 'the tenth is Fortune Virtue' is a spirit-star and not the Output line. 'See the household section of the Tianxuan Fu' is a small note in the book, pointing out that these twelve are also dealt with in the household part of the Tianxuan Fu. The original writes 'tally' in a variant character in 'Official Tally', 'Death Tally' and 'Sickness Tally'.

yi: 第一位是太岁，
第二位是太阳，
第三位是丧门，
第四位是太阴，
第五位是官符，
第六位是死符，
第七位是岁破，
第八位是龙德，
第九位是白虎，
第十位是福德，
第十一位是吊客，
第十二位是病符。
从年上起，
顺着轮。
（参见天玄赋家宅一类。）
en: the first is Tai Sui,
the second is Great Yang,
the third is the Mourning Gate,
the fourth is Great Yin,
the fifth is the Official Tally,
the sixth is the Death Tally,
the seventh is the Year-break,
the eighth is Dragon Virtue,
the ninth is the White Tiger,
the tenth is Fortune Virtue,
the eleventh is the Guest of Condolence,
the twelfth is the Sickness Tally.
It starts from the year
and goes round forward.
(See the household section of the Tianxuan Fu.)

title: 彭城密诀·空亡：病值空亡宜作福；久病空亡身不真(身下亡)；父母空亡忧病生；女值空亡忧病生

rule.yi: 彭城的密诀把空亡落在各处的后果编成了一首歌诀，其中管病的有这几句：病落了空亡，适合做福事（断易天机明写是「暴病」，卜筮大全和火珠林只写「病」）；久病落了空亡，断易天机写「身不真」，卜筮大全和火珠林写「身下亡」；父母爻落了空亡，要担心生病。断易天机另有一句「女值空亡忧病生」，另外两本没有。
rule.en: The secret verse of Pengcheng sets out, in a song, what follows when each thing falls Void. The lines that concern illness: when the illness falls Void it is fitting to perform blessing rites (the Duanyi Tianji says outright 'sudden illness'; the Bushi Daquan and the Huozhu Lin say only 'illness'); when a long illness falls Void, the Duanyi Tianji reads 'the body is not true' while the Bushi Daquan and the Huozhu Lin read 'the body goes down and is lost'; when Resource falls Void, worry that illness will arise. The Duanyi Tianji alone adds the line 'if a woman falls Void, worry that illness will arise'.

dispute.yi: 久病落了空亡，三本的写法不一样：断易天机写「身不真」，火珠林写「身下亡」，卜筮大全写「身【下亡】」（把「下亡」两个字加了方括号）。「不真」是说这个人（身）靠不住，「下亡」字面是人往下去、亡掉，凶险程度不一样，三本都没有解释。另外，易林补遗说「暴病逢空可救、久病逢空必死」（LY.ILL.EL.11）——更接近「下亡」那种读法；野鹤驳「主空无救不分近久」（LY.ILL.ZS.05）。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: For a long illness that falls Void the three books write differently: the Duanyi Tianji has 'the body is not true', the Huozhu Lin has 'the body goes down and is lost', and the Bushi Daquan has 'the body [goes down and is lost]' with the two characters for 'down and lost' put in square brackets. 'Not true' says the person cannot be relied on, whereas 'down and lost' literally says the person goes down and perishes; the severity differs, and none of the three explains it. The Yilin Buyi, besides, says 'a sudden illness meeting Void can be saved, a long illness meeting Void must die' (LY.ILL.EL.11), which is closer to the 'down and lost' reading, while the Old Man of Yehe rejects 'when the main line is Void there is no rescue, without distinguishing recent from long illness' (LY.ILL.ZS.05). The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这首「彭城密诀」是一首讲空亡的歌诀，原本每一句管一类事：男（子）落空亡忧远行、财落空亡难把捉、鬼落空亡官事停、妻落空亡、室女空亡外有情、宅落空亡急作福、兄弟空亡不得力、子孙空亡主伶仃；这里只收管病的几句，其余的属于别的问题域。三本的字句有几处出入，一并记在这里：一、第一句，断易天机写「男值空亡忧远行，女值空亡忧病生」，卜筮大全、火珠林写「子落空亡忧远行」，没有「女值」那一句；二、病那一句，断易天机写「暴病空亡宜作福」，另两本写「病值空亡宜作福」，它们下一句就是「久病」，所以这里的「病」多半是和久病对着说的新病、暴病，这是读法，不是书里写的；三、「妻值空亡」后面，卜筮大全写「妻有孕」，断易天机和火珠林写「妻有厄」；四、断易天机多出「被他空亡徒事缕，贼来不至空有声」两句；五、卜筮大全开头写「秘诀」，另两本写「密诀」（断易天机的括号里写成「密决」）。「作福」是做祈福还愿一类的事，「身不真」的「不真」书里没有解释，译文只照字面写成「靠不住」。断易天机里这一首歌诀是排在括号里的小注，卜筮大全里它是正文「诀云」后面的一段，火珠林里也在括号里；火珠林括号里那句「记住彭城关于空亡的密诀」是整理者的话，不收。卜筮大全这一段后面有虎易的评注，不收。
