螣蛇心惊，青龙则酒色过度
勾陈肿胀，朱雀则言语颠狂
虎有损伤，女子则血崩血晕
玄武忧郁，男人则阴症阴虚

zh: 螣蛇鬼：则坐卧不安，心神不定。
青龙鬼：则酒色过度，瘦弱无力。
勾陈鬼：饱满肿胀，脾胃不和。
朱雀鬼：狂言乱语，身热面赤。
白虎鬼：跌扑打斗，伤筋损骨；
女人则血崩血晕，产后诸症；
玄武鬼：色欲太过，忧闷在心；
盖玄武又暗昧之神，故也。
yi: 螣蛇鬼：坐也不安，躺也不安，心里定不下来。
青龙鬼：酒和女色过度，人瘦弱，没有力气。
勾陈鬼：肚腹饱胀，身体肿胀，脾胃不调和。
朱雀鬼：说狂话、乱话，身上发热，脸红。
白虎鬼：摔跤、扑倒、打架，伤到筋骨；
女人则是血崩血晕，和产后各种症候；
因为白虎是血神。
玄武鬼：贪恋色欲过度，忧愁郁闷积在心里；
在本宫就是阴虚；
化出子孙，男子一定阳痿；
因为玄武又是暗昧的神。
要变通着断。
en: Coiling Snake Pressure: unable to sit or lie at ease, the mind unsettled.
Azure Dragon Pressure: excess of wine and lust, thin and weak, without strength.
Hook Earth Pressure: fullness and swelling, Spleen and Stomach out of harmony.
Vermilion Bird Pressure: wild and confused talk, hot body and red face.
White Tiger Pressure: falls, blows and fights, harm to sinews and bones;
in a woman, flooding and blood-faintness and the various ailments after childbirth;
for the White Tiger is the spirit of blood.
Dark Tortoise Pressure: excess of lust, gloom pent in the heart;
in the home palace it means yin deficiency;
changing into Output, a man surely suffers impotence;
for the Dark Tortoise is also the spirit of the hidden and obscure.
Judge it flexibly.

zh: 螣蛇鬼则坐卧不安，心神不定；
青龙鬼则酒色过度，虚弱无力；
勾陈鬼胸满肿胀，脾胃不和；
朱雀鬼狂言乱语，身热面赤；
白虎鬼跌打气防，伤筋损骨，女人血崩血晕，产后诸症，盖白虎血神故也；
玄武鬼色欲太过，郁闷在心，在本宫主阴虚，化子孙男子阴症阴虚，盖玄武暗昧之神故也。
yi: 螣蛇鬼是坐卧不安，心神不定；
青龙鬼是酒色过度，虚弱无力；
勾陈鬼是胸满肿胀，脾胃不和；
朱雀鬼是狂言乱语，身热面赤；
白虎鬼是跌打损伤，伤筋损骨，女人血崩血晕、产后各种症候，因为白虎是血神；
玄武鬼是色欲太过，郁闷在心，在本宫主阴虚，化出子孙，男子是阴症阴虚，因为玄武是暗昧的神。
断的时候要变通。
en: Coiling Snake Pressure: unable to sit or lie at ease, the mind unsettled;
Azure Dragon Pressure: excess of wine and lust, weak and without strength;
Hook Earth Pressure: fullness in the chest and swelling, Spleen and Stomach out of harmony;
Vermilion Bird Pressure: wild talk, hot body and red face;
White Tiger Pressure: falls and blows, harm to sinews and bones, and in a woman flooding and blood-faintness and the ailments after childbirth, for the White Tiger is the spirit of blood;

Dark Tortoise Pressure: excess of lust, gloom pent in the heart; in the home palace yin deficiency; changing into Output, a man's yin syndrome and yin deficiency, for the Dark Tortoise is the spirit of the hidden and obscure.
Judge it flexibly.

title: 鬼伏卦中，病来莫觉：本宫鬼出现发动则得病之初就知根源；本宫无而他宫有是久伏在身今始发；都没有则隐然得病

rule.yi: 占病时，本宫的官鬼出现并且发动，得病之初就知道根由；本宫的官鬼不出现、而别的宫有官鬼出现，是病早就伏在身上，这一回因七情四气感冒才发出来；本宫和别的宫都没有官鬼，是不知不觉得的病，起初谁也说不出为什么。旧注又附了两组按卦名的忌讳：明夷、观、贲、需、临最忌世爻和身爻入墓；大畜、丰、同人、蛊、夬不要遇上财爻鬼爻一起兴旺。
rule.en: In divining illness: if the Pressure of the home palace appears and moves, the source is known as soon as the illness begins; if the home palace's Pressure does not appear but another palace's Pressure does, the illness has long lain hidden in the body and now breaks out through the seven emotions and the four airs; if neither the home palace nor another palace has Pressure, the illness was contracted unseen and at first no one can say why. The old commentary adds two groups of taboos by hexagram name: for Mingyi, Guan, Bi, Xu and Lin, beware above all of Self and Body entering the tomb; for Daxu, Feng, Tongren, Gu and Guai, do not meet Wealth and Pressure both stirring.

note.yi: 旧注最后两句按卦名给忌讳，没有说明理由，王洪绪没有收。「七情」是喜怒忧思悲恐惊，「四气」指寒热温凉（或风寒暑湿），书里没有说是哪一种，译文保留原词。
note.en: The last two sentences of the old commentary give taboos by hexagram name without reasons, and Wang Hongxu does not take them. The 'seven emotions' are joy, anger, worry, longing, grief, fear and fright, and the 'four airs' are cold, hot, warm and cool (or wind, cold, heat and damp); the book does not say which, and the translation keeps the original words.

yi: 官鬼伏在卦里，病来了却不知不觉；
en: Pressure hidden in the hexagram: the illness comes and is not noticed;

zh: 占病遇本宫鬼出现发动，得病初即晓根源。
若本宫官鬼不出现，而他宫官鬼出现者，有病必然久伏在身，今因七情四气感冒而发也。
若本宫他宫皆无官鬼，必隐然得病，初莫知何由也。
明夷、观、贲、需、临，切忌世身入墓；
大畜、丰、同人、蛊、夬，莫逢财鬼俱兴。
yi: 占病遇到本宫的鬼爻出现并且发动，得病的当初就知道根由。
如果本宫的官鬼不出现，而别的宫的官鬼出现，有病必定早就伏在身上，现在是因为七情四气感冒才发作。
如果本宫和别的宫都没有官鬼，一定是不知不觉得的病，起初不知道是为什么。
明夷、观、贲、需、临，最忌世爻和身爻入墓；
大畜、丰、同人、蛊、夬，不要遇到财爻鬼爻一起兴旺。
en: In divining illness, if the Pressure of the home palace appears and moves, the source is known as soon as the illness begins.

If the home palace's Pressure does not appear but another palace's Pressure does, the illness has surely long lain hidden in the body, and it breaks out now through the seven emotions and the four airs taking hold.
If neither the home palace nor another palace has Pressure, the illness was surely contracted unseen, and at first no one knows the reason.
For Mingyi, Guan, Bi, Xu and Lin, above all beware of Self and Body entering the tomb;
for Daxu, Feng, Tongren, Gu and Guai, do not meet Wealth and Pressure both stirring.

zh: 遇官鬼不出现必隐藏，得症不知何由；
yi: 遇到官鬼不出现，一定是隐藏着，得了病不知道是什么缘故；
en: If Pressure does not appear it is surely hidden, and the illness comes with no known reason;

title: 官藏世下，病起如前：官鬼伏在世爻下是旧病重发；伏鬼不伤用而用被世克则前轻今重，伏鬼伤用而用得世生则前重今轻

rule.yi: 本宫的官鬼伏在世爻下面，一定是旧病重新发作。如果伏着的鬼不伤用爻、用爻反而被世爻克，以前病轻、现在反倒沉重；如果伏着的鬼刑伤用爻、而用爻反而得到世爻的生扶，以前病重、现在轻。用爻要看问的是谁：比如占妻子的病就看财爻。
rule.en: If the home palace's Pressure is hidden beneath the Self line, it is surely an old illness breaking out again. If the hidden Pressure does not harm the Subject line but the Subject is controlled by Self, the illness was light before and is heavier now; if the hidden Pressure punishes and harms the Subject but the Subject is generated and supported by Self, it was heavy before and is lighter now. The Subject line depends on whom one asks about: for a wife's illness, for example, look at the Wealth line.

yi: 官鬼伏在世爻下面，病发得和从前一样。
en: Pressure hidden beneath Self: the illness starts up as before.

zh: 本宫鬼官伏在世下，必是旧病重发。
若伏鬼不伤用爻，而用爻反被世克者，前日病轻，今日反沉重。
如伏鬼刑伤用爻，而用爻反得世爻生扶者，前日病重，今日轻。
yi: 本宫的官鬼伏在世爻下面，一定是旧病重新发作。
如果伏着的鬼不伤用爻，而用爻反而被世爻克的，以前病轻，现在反倒沉重。
如果伏着的鬼刑伤用爻，而用爻反而得到世爻生扶的，以前病重，现在轻。
用爻：比如占妻子的病就看财爻，这一类。
en: If the home palace's Pressure is hidden beneath Self, it is surely an old illness breaking out again.
If the hidden Pressure does not harm the Subject line but the Subject is controlled by Self, the illness was light before and is heavier now.
If the hidden Pressure punishes and harms the Subject but the Subject is generated and supported by Self, the illness was heavy before and is lighter now.
The Subject line: for a wife's illness, for example, look at the Wealth line, and so on.

zh: 官鬼伏在世下，必是旧症复发。
yi: 官鬼伏在世爻下面，一定是旧病重新发作。
en: Pressure hidden beneath Self is surely an old illness returning.

title: 鬼伏六亲之下各有病因：伏财伤饥失饱、伏子酒色、伏父劳心、伏兄口舌争竞

rule.yi: 鬼伏在哪个六亲下面，就是怎么得的病：伏在妻财下，是饮食不节、饥饱失度，或者因为钱财、妇人得病；伏在子孙下，是喝酒过度、放纵房事，夏天露宿贪凉、冬天穿得太暖，或者吃多了养生炼丹的药；伏在父母下，是劳心劳力、忧虑伤神，或者因为动土修造、尊长得病；伏在兄弟下，是口舌争竞、停食生气，或者有人诅咒、因为赌钱争财得病。
rule.en: Which relative the Pressure is hidden beneath shows how the illness was got: beneath Wealth, eating without restraint and hunger and surfeit, or illness through money or a woman; beneath Output, too much drinking and unrestrained sexual indulgence, sleeping out in the cool in summer, dressing too warmly in winter, or too many drugs for nourishing and refining; beneath Resource, toil of mind and body and worry that harms the spirit, or breaking ground and building, or illness through an elder; beneath Peer, quarrels and rivalry, food stopped and anger felt, or a curse laid, or gambling and struggling for money.

note.yi: 旧注里「咒咀」是「咒诅」的另一种写法。「养精等药」「修炼」指道家炼丹养生的药物，书里没有具体说是哪几种。
note.en: 'Curse' is written in two ways in the old commentary. The 'drugs for refining and nourishing the vital essence' are the medicines of Daoist alchemy and self-cultivation, which the book does not specify.

zh: 若伏妻财，必是伤饥失饱；
如藏福德，必然酒醉耽淫。
父乃劳伤所致，兄为气食相侵。
yi: 如果伏在妻财下面，一定是饥一顿饱一顿伤了身；
如果藏在子孙下面，一定是喝醉了酒、沉迷女色。
伏在父母下是劳累所致，伏在兄弟下是脾气和饮食互相侵扰。
en: If hidden beneath Wealth, it is surely from going hungry and then overeating;
if hidden beneath Output, it is surely from drunkenness and lust.
Beneath Resource it comes from overwork; beneath Peer, from temper and food attacking one another.

hits.text: 若伏妻财，必是伤饥失饱
如藏福德，定然酒醉耽淫
父乃劳伤所致，兄为食气相侵
若伏妻财，必是伤饥失饱
如藏福德，必然酒醉耽淫
父乃劳伤所致，兄为气食相侵

zh: 鬼伏财下，必是饮食不节，伤饥失饱；
或因财物起因，或因妇人得病。
鬼伏子下，必是饮酒过度；
或过修炼养精等药所致。
鬼伏父下，必是劳心劳力，忧虑伤神。
或因动土修造，或因尊长得病。
鬼伏兄下，必是口舌争竞，停食感气；
或有咒咀，或因赌博争财得病。
yi: 鬼伏在财下，一定是饮食不节制，饥饱失度；
或者因为钱财起的因，或者因为妇人得病。
鬼伏在子下，一定是饮酒过度；
或者放纵房事。
夏天或者露天睡觉，贪凉风太多；
冬天或者太暖，皮衣丝绸穿得太多；
或者吃多了修炼养精一类的药。
鬼伏在父下，一定是劳心劳力，忧虑伤神。
或者因为动土修造，或者因为尊长得病。
鬼伏在兄下，一定是口舌争竞，停食生气；
或者有人诅咒，或者因为赌博争钱得病。
en: Pressure hidden beneath Wealth: surely eating without restraint, hunger followed by surfeit;
or the cause is money and goods, or the illness comes through a woman.
Pressure hidden beneath Output: surely too much drinking;
or unrestrained sexual indulgence.
In summer, perhaps sleeping in the open and taking too much cool wind;
in winter, perhaps harmed by too much warmth, wearing too many furs and silks;
or from taking too many drugs for refining and nourishing the vital essence.
Pressure hidden beneath Resource: surely toil of mind and body, worry that harms the spirit.
Or breaking ground and building, or the illness comes through an elder.
Pressure hidden beneath Peer: surely quarrels and rivalry, food stopped in the stomach and anger felt;
or a curse was laid, or the illness comes from gambling and struggling for money.

zh: 鬼伏财下，必是伤食，或因财物起因，或因妇女得病。
鬼伏子下，必是酒醉过渡，或恣行房事，夏或过于风凉，冬或多着裘帛，或过服补药所致。
鬼伏父下，必是劳心劳力，忧虑伤神，或因动土所致，或因尊长得病。
鬼伏兄下，必因口舌争竞，停食感气，或有咒诅得病。
yi: 鬼伏在财下，一定是伤了食，或者因为钱财起因，或者因为妇女得病。
鬼伏在子下，一定是酒醉过度，或者放纵房事，夏天太贪风凉，冬天穿得太多皮衣丝绸，或者补药吃多了。
鬼伏在父下，一定是劳心劳力，忧虑伤神，或者因为动土，或者因为尊长得病。
鬼伏在兄下，一定是口舌争竞，停食生气，或者有人诅咒得病。
en: Pressure hidden beneath Wealth: surely damage from food, or the cause is money and goods, or the illness comes through a woman.
Pressure hidden beneath Output: surely too much drunkenness, or unrestrained sexual indulgence, too much cool wind in summer, too many furs and silks in winter, or too many tonic drugs.
Pressure hidden beneath Resource: surely toil of mind and body, worry that harms the spirit, or breaking ground, or the illness comes through an elder.
Pressure hidden beneath Peer: surely quarrels and rivalry, food stopped in the stomach and anger felt, or a curse laid.

title: 官化官新旧两病，鬼化鬼迁变百端：官鬼化进神病增、化退神病减

rule.yi: 官鬼爻化出官鬼爻，是新旧两种病；鬼爻化出鬼爻，病情迁变，花样百出。旧注说：本宫官鬼还伏在别宫官鬼下面，是旧病，或者旧病没有谨慎、变出别的病，或者新旧两种病；鬼化鬼是病有进有退，或者变了症候，或者药石杂乱，或者忽冷忽热。王洪绪补充：官鬼化进神病加重，化退神病减轻。
rule.en: Pressure changing into Pressure means two illnesses, new and old; Pressure changing into Pressure shifts and changes in a hundred ways. The old commentary says: if the home palace's Pressure is still hidden beneath another palace's Pressure, it is an old illness, or through carelessness with the old illness another disease has grown from it, or it is two kinds of illness, new and old; Pressure changing into Pressure means the illness advances and retreats, or the syndrome changes, or the drugs and needles are muddled, or chills and fever are uncertain. Wang Hongxu adds: Pressure changing into an Advancing spirit, the illness grows; into a Retreating spirit, it lessens.

yi: 官鬼化出官鬼，是新旧两种病；
鬼爻化出鬼爻，病情迁变，花样百出。
en: Pressure changing into Pressure: two illnesses, new and old;
Pressure changing into Pressure: shifts and changes of a hundred kinds.

zh: 本宫官鬼，仍伏他宫官鬼之下，必是旧病；
或因旧病不谨，变生他症；
或有变症，或药石驳杂，或寒热不定。
yi: 本宫的官鬼，还伏在别宫官鬼的下面，一定是旧病；
或者因为旧病不谨慎，变生出别的病；
或者是新旧两种病。
如果遇到鬼化鬼，病就有进有退。
或者变了症候，或者用药杂乱，或者忽冷忽热不定。
en: If the home palace's Pressure is still hidden beneath another palace's Pressure, it is surely an old illness;
or, through carelessness with the old illness, another disease has grown out of it;
or it is two kinds of illness, new and old.
If Pressure changes into Pressure, the illness advances and retreats.
Perhaps a changed syndrome, or muddled drugs and needles, or chills and fever uncertain.

zh: 卦中现有官爻而又变出官爻，主新旧两病也。
又如官爻化进神则病增，或退神则病减。
yi: 卦中已有官爻、又变出官爻，主新旧两种病。
又如官爻化出进神，病加重；化出退神，病减轻。
en: If the hexagram has a Pressure line and also changes out a Pressure line, it means two illnesses, new and old.
Again, if Pressure changes into an Advancing spirit the illness grows, or into a Retreating spirit it lessens.

title: 鬼爻化出六亲各有得病之处：化父母在修造处（五爻水则途中遇雨）、化兄弟口舌伤食（三爻木则房中伤风）、化子孙寺院渔猎、化财伤食妻奴买卖

rule.yi: 鬼爻化出哪个六亲，就是在哪里、怎么得的病：化出父母，是在修造的地方得病，在五爻又属水，是在路上淋了雨；化出兄弟，是口舌呕气或者伤食，在三爻又属木，是在房里脱衣露体着了风寒；化出子孙，是在僧道寺院，或者打鱼打猎游戏时得的；化出财爻，多是伤食，或者因为妻子奴仆、买卖交易得病。六亲化出鬼爻，也照这样断。
rule.en: Which relative the Pressure line changes into shows where and how the illness was got: changing into Resource, it was got at a place of repair or building, and if it is on the fifth line and belongs to Water, it was got braving rain on the road; changing into Peer, it is from quarrels and vexation or harm by food, and if on the third line and Wood, from undressing and baring the body in the room and catching wind and cold; changing into Output, it was got at a temple of monks and Daoists, or while fishing, hunting and at play; changing into Wealth, it is mostly harm by food, or through wife or servants, or through buying and selling. Where a relative line changes into Pressure, judge in the same way.

zh: 化出文书在五爻，则途中遇雨；

title: 本宫为在家得病下必内伤，他卦为别处染灾上须外感：鬼在下三爻内伤、在上三爻外感或外科症，上下皆有鬼内伤兼外感

rule.en: Pressure in the home palace means the illness was got at home; Pressure in another palace or hexagram means it was caught elsewhere. Pressure in the lower three lines is surely a syndrome of inner damage, or else the illness is in the inside; Pressure in the outer palace and in the upper three lines is surely outer wind evil from without, or else a surgical syndrome; with Pressure both above and below it is inner damage together with outer contagion, and the syndrome is mixed.

another hexagram means it was caught elsewhere, and above it must be outer contagion.

title: 上实下空，夜轻日重：鬼在内卦夜重、在外卦日重，内外皆有鬼昼夜不轻；二鬼一旺一空或一动一静则分上下断日夜

title: 动生变克，暮热朝凉：动爻为始变爻为终，动爻生扶用爻而变爻刑克用爻则朝凉暮热、日轻夜重，动克变生反之

rule.yi: 占卦时动爻是开头、变爻是结尾。卦中动爻生扶用爻、而变爻刑克用爻，病一定早上凉快、晚上发热，或者白天轻夜里重；动爻克用爻、变爻生用爻，反过来断。鬼爻化出所喜的爻、所喜的爻化出鬼爻，也是这样。
rule.en: In every divination the moving line is the beginning and the changed line the end. If the moving line in the hexagram generates and supports the Subject while the changed line punishes and controls it, the illness is surely cool in the morning and hot in the evening, or light by day and heavy at night; if the moving line controls the Subject and the changed line generates it, judge the reverse. Where a Pressure line changes into a welcome line, or a welcome line changes into Pressure, it is the same.

note.en: The last sentence of the Bushi Zhengzong reads 'moving generating and changed controlling, judge the reverse of this', which repeats the case of the sentence before and does not follow; it is probably a slip for 'moving controlling and changed generating, judge the reverse' (the old commentary reads 'moving controlling, changed generating, judge the reverse'), and the translation follows the sense of the old commentary.

en: The moving line generates and the changed line controls: hot in the evening, cool in the morning.

if the moving line controls and the changed line generates, judge the reverse.
Where a Pressure line changes into a welcome line, or a welcome line changes into Pressure, it is the same.

title: 水化火火化水往来寒热：水旺火衰寒多热少，水伤火助则常热乍寒；坎宫火动内寒外热、离宫水动皮寒骨热，带日辰是疟疾

rule.yi: 卦里水爻动化火、火爻动化水，不论是不是鬼爻，只要冲犯世爻或主象的，都是忽冷忽热的症候；水、火两爻都动，也是这样。水旺火衰是冷多热少；水受伤、火得助，是常热而偶尔发冷。坎宫火动是里冷外热，离宫水动是皮冷骨热。再带上日辰，一定是疟疾。
rule.en: In the hexagram, a Water line moving and changing into Fire, or a Fire line changing into Water, whether or not it is the Pressure line, if it offends the Self line or the main image, is a syndrome of alternating chills and fever; if a Water line and a Fire line both move, it is the same. Water strong and Fire weak means more chill and less fever; Water harmed and Fire helped means constant heat with an occasional chill. Fire moving in the Kan palace is cold inside and hot outside; Water moving in the Li palace is cold skin and hot bones. If it also carries the Day, it is surely malaria.

note.yi: 卜筮正宗把「疟疾」写成「虐疾」，是同一个字的写法不同，译作疟疾（malaria）是按后世通行的说法；书里没有说明。

title: 上冲下下冲上，内外感伤：上下有鬼内外两感；内鬼动冲外鬼先伤后感，外鬼动冲内鬼先感后伤

rule.yi: 上下卦都有鬼，病一定是里外两处感受。两个鬼都动、或者都静，是一起受病；两个鬼互相冲，刚感受了邪就受了伤。内卦的鬼动来冲外卦的鬼，是先受伤后感邪；外卦的鬼动来冲内卦的鬼，是先感邪后受伤。要分轻重，用刑、合来断。
rule.en: With Pressure in both the upper and lower trigrams, the illness is surely a double contagion of inside and outside. Both Pressure lines moving, or both still, means falling ill together; two Pressure lines clashing each other means hardly is the evil felt than harm is done. If the inner Pressure moves and clashes the outer, it is first harm and then contagion; if the outer Pressure moves and clashes the inner, first contagion and then harm. To tell heavy from light, judge by punishment and combination.

dispute.yi: 两鬼互冲的结果，旧注和王洪绪相反。旧注说「适感而遂伤也」，刚感受了邪就受了伤；卜筮正宗写「适感而适愈也」，刚感受就好了。书里没有再解释，也没有别家的话可对。
dispute.en: The two disagree on what follows when two Pressure lines clash each other. The old commentary says 'hardly is the evil felt than harm is done', while the Bushi Zhengzong writes 'hardly is it felt than it is cured'. The book explains no further and there is no other voice to check against.

title: 火鬼冲财上临则呕逆多吐：火鬼动克外卦财爻必呕吐，重则反胃不食；财带螣蛇吐虫，财在间爻消渴易饥

rule.yi: 火的性子向上，财爻代表饮食。占病遇到火鬼动来克外卦的财爻，一定是呕吐，重的是反胃、吃不下饭。财爻带着螣蛇，吐出来的还带虫；财爻在间爻，是消渴、容易饿的症候。
rule.en: Fire's nature is to flare upward and Wealth stands for food and drink. In divining illness, a Fire Pressure moving to control the outer Wealth line is surely vomiting, and when heavy, a stomach that turns and cannot take food. If Wealth carries the Coiling Snake, worms are brought up as well; if Wealth is on the between line, it is the syndrome of thirst and quick hunger.

If Wealth carries the Coiling Snake, worms are brought up as well;
if Wealth is on the between line, it is the syndrome of thirst and quick hunger.

zh: 火性炎上，财为饮食，故占病遇火鬼动克外财，必是呕吐，重则反胃不食。
yi: 火的性子向上，财爻代表饮食，所以占病遇到火鬼动来克外卦的财爻，一定是呕吐，重的是反胃、不能进食。
en: Fire's nature is to flare upward and Wealth stands for food and drink, so in divining illness a Fire Pressure moving to control the outer Wealth line is surely vomiting, and when heavy, a stomach that turns and takes no food.

title: 水官化土回头克、落在内卦是小便不通：属阴则大便也不通，阴阳错配二便俱闭；内卦水克加白虎，阳爻尿血、阴爻泻血，带刑是痔漏

rule.yi: 水行的官鬼动了，变出土来回头克它，又落在本宫的内卦（下三爻）：小便不通；这一爻属阴，大便也不通；阳宫里是阴的象、阴宫里是阳的象，大小便都不通。内卦的水爻起克、又动、又加白虎：阳爻是尿血，阴爻是泻血（白虎是血神）；再带刑是痔漏。
rule.en: A Water Pressure line that moves and changes into Earth, which turns back to control it, and falls in the inner trigram of the home palace (the lower three lines): the urine is blocked; if the line is yin, the stool is blocked too; a yang palace with a yin image, or a yin palace with a yang image, blocks both. If the Water line in the inner trigram controls, moves and has the White Tiger added: a yang line means blood in the urine, a yin line bloody stool (the White Tiger is the spirit of blood); with punishment added it is piles and fistula.

dispute.yi: 水官化土在哪里才是小便不通：旧注说在「本宫内卦」（下三爻），王洪绪说在「本宫初爻」（最下面一爻）。范围一个宽一个窄，书里没有说哪个对。
dispute.en: Where a Water Pressure line changing into Earth means blocked urine: the old commentary says in the 'inner trigram of the home palace' (the lower three lines), Wang Hongxu says on the 'first line of the home palace' (the lowest line). One range is wide and one narrow, and the book does not say which is right.

note.yi: 「属阴」书里没有说属什么阴；按上下文是这一爻是阴爻（下一句的「阳爻、阴爻」说的也是这一爻）。「阳宫阴象，阴宫阳象」是宫的阴阳和这一爻的阴阳相反。「痔漏」是痔疮和肛瘘。「回头土克」是水鬼动出来的土反过来克它自己。
note.en: The book does not say what 'belonging to yin' refers to; from the context it is that the line is a yin line (the 'yang line, yin line' of the next sentence also speaks of this line). 'A yang palace with a yin image' means that the yin or yang of the palace is the opposite of the yin or yang of this line. 'Piles and fistula' are haemorrhoids and anal fistula. 'Earth turning back to control' means the Earth that the Water Pressure line moves out into controls that line in return.

zh: 水官化土，下值则小便不通。
yi: 水官化成土，落在下面（内卦），就是小便不通。
en: A Water Pressure line changing into Earth, sitting below, means the urine is blocked.

hits.text: 水官化土下直，则小便不通
水官化土，下值则小便不通

zh: 水官化出回头土克，在本宫内卦，是小便不通。
阳宫阴象，阴宫阳象，二便俱不通。
若内卦水克，动加白虎，阳爻是尿血，阴爻是泻血。
yi: 水官变出土来回头克它，又在本宫的内卦，是小便不通。
这一爻属阴，就是大便不通。
阳宫里是阴的象，阴宫里是阳的象，大小便都不通。
如果是内卦里的水爻起克，动了又加白虎，阳爻是尿血，阴爻是泻血。
因为白虎是血神。
再带着刑，就是痔漏。
en: When a Water Pressure line changes out into Earth that turns back to control it, and it lies in the inner trigram of the home palace, the urine is blocked.
If it is yin, the stool is blocked.
A yang palace with a yin image, or a yin palace with a yang image: neither urine nor stool passes.
If the Water in the inner trigram is the one controlling, and it moves with the White Tiger added: a yang line means blood in the urine, a yin line means bloody stool.
This is because the White Tiger is the spirit of blood.
With punishment added it is piles and fistula.

zh: 水官化出回头克，在本宫初爻是小便不通，属阴是大便不通；
阳宫阴象，阴宫阳象，二便俱不通。
若加白虎阳爻，是尿血，阴爻是泻血，白虎血神故也。
yi: 水官变出回头克它，落在本宫的初爻，是小便不通，这一爻属阴，是大便不通；
阳宫里是阴的象，阴宫里是阳的象，大小便都不通。
如果再加白虎，阳爻是尿血，阴爻是泻血，因为白虎是血神。
带着刑、害，是痔漏。
en: A Water Pressure line changing out into a returning control, on the first line of the home palace: the urine is blocked; if it is yin, the stool is blocked;
a yang palace with a yin image, or a yin palace with a yang image: neither urine nor stool passes.
If the White Tiger is added, a yang line means blood in the urine and a yin line bloody stool, because the White Tiger is the spirit of blood.
With punishment or harm added it is piles and fistula.

title: 鬼在兑宫病在口：金鬼化火或火化金鬼必患牙疔，不化火只是牙痛，金鬼逢冲牙必松动

rule.yi: 鬼爻在兑宫，病在口里。金鬼变出火、或者火爻变成金鬼，必生牙疔；没有变到火爻，只是牙痛。金鬼遇冲，牙一定松动。
rule.en: A Pressure line in the Dui palace puts the illness in the mouth. A Metal Pressure changing out into Fire, or a Fire line changing into a Metal Pressure, surely brings a tooth carbuncle; with no change into a Fire line it is only toothache. A Metal Pressure that meets a clash surely loosens the teeth.

note.yi: 旧注说「火」，王洪绪改说「忌神」：金的忌神是克它的火，说的是同一种变法。旧注的「金鬼逢冲」，王洪绪写成「静鬼逢冲」，限定在不动的鬼爻上。「牙疔」是牙龈上长的疔疮，小而硬、根深、来得急。经文的「火杀」，旧注解成「火」，即火爻。
note.en: Where the old commentary says 'Fire', Wang Hongxu says 'the Adversary': the Adversary of Metal is the Fire that controls it, so both speak of the same change. The old commentary's 'a Metal Pressure meeting a clash' becomes 'a still Pressure meeting a clash' in Wang Hongxu, which limits it to a Pressure line that does not move. A 'tooth carbuncle' is a boil on the gum, small, hard, deep-rooted and quick to come. The 'Fire killer' of the verse is explained by the old commentary as Fire, that is, a Fire line.

zh: 若患牙疔，兑鬼金连火杀；
yi: 如果患牙疔，是兑宫的鬼爻，金鬼连着火煞；
en: If one suffers a tooth carbuncle, it is a Pressure line in the Dui palace, a Metal Pressure joined to a Fire killer;

hits.text: 若患牙疔，兑鬼金连火杀

zh: 若金鬼化火，或火化金鬼，必患牙疔。
yi: 鬼在兑宫，病在口里。
如果金鬼变成火，或者火爻变成金鬼，一定生牙疔。
没有变到火爻，就只是牙痛。
金鬼遇上冲，牙一定松动。
en: Pressure in the Dui palace: the illness is in the mouth.
If a Metal Pressure changes into Fire, or a Fire line changes into a Metal Pressure, one surely gets a tooth carbuncle.
If it does not change into a Fire line, it is toothache.
A Metal Pressure meeting a clash: the teeth surely loosen.

zh: 鬼在兑宫，口中有病，若金鬼化忌神，或忌神化金鬼，必患牙疔，不化忌神则是齿痛。
yi: 鬼在兑宫，口里有病；如果金鬼变成忌神，或者忌神变成金鬼，一定生牙疔；没有变到忌神，就是牙痛。
静着的鬼遇上冲，牙一定松动。
en: Pressure in the Dui palace: there is illness in the mouth; if a Metal Pressure changes into the Adversary, or the Adversary changes into a Metal Pressure, one surely gets a tooth carbuncle; if it does not change into the Adversary, it is toothache.
A Pressure line that is still and meets a clash: the teeth surely loosen.

title: 鬼在震宫病在脚：加勾陈足肿、加白虎折伤，土鬼化木是脚气，木鬼酸麻、水鬼湿气、火鬼疮毒、金鬼骨节痛或刀伤

rule.yi: 鬼在震宫，病在脚上：加勾陈，脚一定肿；加白虎，一定摔断打伤、破损。土鬼变成木，得脚气；木鬼是酸痛麻木，水鬼是湿气，火鬼主疮毒，金鬼是踝、膝疼痛和骨头痛，或者被刀刃所伤。
rule.en: A Pressure line in the Zhen palace puts the illness in the foot: with Hook Earth added the foot surely swells, with the White Tiger it is surely broken, wounded or torn. An Earth Pressure changing into Wood is beriberi; a Wood Pressure is aching, soreness and numbness, a Water Pressure is damp, a Fire Pressure means sores and toxin, and a Metal Pressure is pain in the ankle joints, the knees and the bones, or a wound from a blade.

note.yi: 这里的「脚气」是旧医书说的脚气病，多指腿脚又肿又麻、软弱无力，不是今天说的脚癣。「脚骱」是踝关节（骱是骨节相接的地方）。震宫主脚，和 LY.ILL.HJC.04 里王洪绪的写法一致。
note.en: The 'jiaoqi' here is the old medical disease of that name, which mostly means legs and feet that are swollen and numb, weak and without strength, not what is now called athlete's foot. 'Jiaojie' is the ankle joint (a 'jie' is the place where bones meet). The Zhen palace governing the foot agrees with the way Wang Hongxu writes it in LY.ILL.HJC.04.

zh: 如生脚气，震宫土化木星。
yi: 如果生了脚气，是震宫的土鬼变成木。
en: If beriberi arises, it is an Earth Pressure in the Zhen palace changing into Wood.

hits.text: 如生脚气，震宫土化木星

en: Pressure in the Zhen palace: the illness is in the foot.

with the White Tiger added, it is surely broken, wounded or torn.
An Earth Pressure changing into Wood is beriberi.
A Wood Pressure is aching, soreness and numbness;
a Water Pressure is surely damp;

a Metal Pressure is pain in the ankle joints and knees and pain in the bones, or a wound from a blade.

yi: 鬼在震宫，病在脚上，加勾陈脚一定肿，加白虎一定摔断打伤、破损。
土鬼变木得脚气，木鬼是酸痛麻木，水鬼是湿气，火鬼一定生疮毒，金鬼是踝、膝疼痛，骨痛，或刀刃所伤一类。
en: Pressure in the Zhen palace: the illness is in the foot; with Hook Earth added the foot surely swells, with the White Tiger it is surely broken, wounded or torn.

An Earth Pressure changing into Wood is beriberi, a Wood Pressure is aching, soreness and numbness, a Water Pressure is damp, a Fire Pressure surely brings sores and toxin, and a Metal Pressure is pain in the ankle joints and knees, bone pain, or wounds of the blade kind.

title: 离宫鬼化水是痰火、乾宫鬼化木是头风；震鬼遇螣蛇发动是惊悸颠狂、逢冲有逾墙上屋之患；艮鬼逢火鬼是痈疽，变出土鬼是浮肿蛊胀

rule.yi: 离宫的鬼变成水（或水爻动变成鬼）是痰火的症候；乾宫的鬼变成木（或木爻动变成鬼）是头风、眩晕。震宫的鬼在外卦，不要按脚上的病断，可以说他坐卧不安、心神恍惚（震是主动的卦）；再加螣蛇发动，是癫狂、惊痫，小孩是惊风；遇冲有翻墙上屋的乱动之患。艮宫的鬼遇上火鬼，一定生痈疽；变出土鬼，可以说浮肿、蛊胀一类。其余照此类推。
rule.en: A Pressure line of the Li palace changing into Water (or a moving Water line changing into Pressure) is the syndrome of phlegm-fire; a Pressure line of the Qian palace changing into Wood (or a moving Wood line changing into Pressure) is headwind and dizziness. A Zhen Pressure line in the outer trigram is not judged as a foot illness: say the patient cannot sit or lie at ease and his mind wanders (Zhen governs movement); with the Coiling Snake added and moving it is mania and fright-epilepsy, in a child convulsions; meeting a clash there is the danger of climbing over walls and onto roofs. A Gen Pressure line meeting a Fire Pressure surely brings carbuncles; if an Earth Pressure changes out, one can speak of swelling and drum-like distension. The rest follows by analogy.

note.yi: 「痰火」是痰和火郁在一起的病，「头风」是反复发作的头痛，「蛊胀」是肚腹胀大如鼓的病，「踰墙上屋」是发狂时翻墙爬房的举动。旧注「震在外卦，勿依此断」的「此」没有写明，王洪绪写成「勿以脚断」，译文按他的写法理解。旧注「艮象为山，山高故也」放在「逢冲」和「更逢火鬼」之间，没有说它解释的是哪一句（前面的翻墙上屋，还是后面的痈疽）；王洪绪把这句删了。经文的「巳午」是火的两个地支，「交重」就是发动。
note.en: 'Phlegm-fire' is an illness in which phlegm and fire are bound together; 'headwind' is a headache that comes back again and again; 'gu distension' is a belly swollen like a drum; 'climbing over walls and onto roofs' is what a patient in a fit of madness does. The 'this' of the old commentary's 'if Zhen is in the outer trigram, do not judge by this' is not spelled out, and Wang Hongxu writes 'do not judge it as a foot illness'; the translation follows his wording. The old commentary puts 'the image of Gen is the mountain, because a mountain is high' between 'meeting a clash' and 'meeting a Fire Pressure as well' and does not say which of the two it explains (the climbing of walls and roofs before it, or the carbuncles after it); Wang Hongxu drops the sentence. Si and Wu in the verse are the two Fire branches, and 'jiaozhong' simply means moving.

zh: 鬼在离宫化水，痰火何疑；
官来乾象变木，头风有准。
震遇螣蛇仍发动，惊悸颠狂；
艮逢巳午又交重，痈疽疮毒。
yi: 鬼爻在离宫、变成水，是痰火，不用怀疑；
官鬼在乾卦的象里变成木，头风是准的。
震宫遇上螣蛇、又发动，是惊悸和癫狂；
艮宫遇上巳、午又发动，是痈疽和疮毒。
en: A Pressure line in the Li palace changing into Water: phlegm-fire, no doubt of it;
a Pressure line in the Qian image changing into Wood: headwind is certain.
Zhen meeting the Coiling Snake and still moving: fright, palpitations and mania;
Gen meeting Si and Wu and moving: carbuncles, deep abscesses, sores and toxin.

title: 卦内无财则饮食不纳：财主饮食，落空吃不下，不上卦不想吃；财动化官鬼病因酒食而得，财临身世或化财则病重也能食

rule.yi: 财爻管饮食。卦里没有财爻，吃不下东西：财爻落空，吃不下；不上卦，不想吃。财爻动而变成官鬼，这病一定是吃喝来的；财爻临在身爻、世爻上，或者变出财爻，病再重也还能吃。
rule.en: The Wealth line governs food and drink. With no Wealth in the hexagram, food and drink are not taken: if the Wealth line falls into Void, nothing goes down; if it is absent from the hexagram, he has no wish to eat. A Wealth line that moves and changes into Pressure means the illness came from drink and food; a Wealth line sitting on the Body or the Self line, or a change into a Wealth line, means that even in a heavy illness he can still eat.

note.yi: 经文的「卦内无财」，旧注分成两种：有财爻但落空（吃不下），和根本不上卦（不想吃）。「身世」是身爻和世爻。旧注的「动化官鬼」和「财临身世」两句，王洪绪没有收。
note.en: The verse's 'no Wealth in the hexagram' is split by the old commentary into two cases: a Wealth line that is there but Void (food is not taken) and one that is not in the hexagram at all (no wish to eat). 'Shen shi' is the Body line and the Self line. Wang Hongxu does not take the old commentary's two sentences on 'moving and changing into Pressure' and 'Wealth on the Body or Self line'.

yi: 卦里没有财爻，吃不下东西；
en: With no Wealth line in the hexagram, food and drink are not taken;

zh: 动化官鬼，其病必因酒饮食而得。
财临身世，或化财爻，虽病重亦能食。
yi: 财爻管饮食。
财爻动而变成官鬼，这病一定是因为喝酒、吃东西得的。
如果遇上空亡，吃不下东西。
如果不上卦，不想吃东西。
财爻临在身爻、世爻上，或者变出财爻，病再重也能吃。
en: Wealth governs food and drink.
If it moves and changes into Pressure, the illness was surely got through wine, drink and food.
If it meets Void, food and drink are not taken.
If it is absent from the hexagram, he has no thought of food or drink.
If Wealth sits on the Body or the Self line, or a Wealth line changes out, then even in a heavy illness he can eat.

zh: 财主饮食，若遇空亡，饮食不纳，若不上卦，不思饮食。
yi: 财爻管饮食，遇上空亡吃不下，不上卦就不想吃。
en: Wealth governs food and drink; if it meets Void, food and drink are not taken, and if it is absent from the hexagram, he has no thought of food or drink.

title: 世应之间是病人胸膈：鬼临其上则痞塞不通，金鬼胸肋骨痛、土鬼饱闷、木鬼心痒嘈杂、水鬼痰饮填塞、火鬼心痛；化财或财化鬼是宿食未消

rule.yi: 世爻和应爻中间的位置，是病人胸膈的地方。官鬼临在这里，胸膈一定堵闷不通：金鬼是胸肋骨头痛，土鬼是胀饱憋闷、不舒畅，木鬼是心里发痒、胃里嘈杂，水鬼是痰饮堵塞，火鬼多半是心口痛。如果变出财爻，或财爻变成鬼，一定是隔夜的食物没消化，弄得胸膈不舒服。
rule.en: The place between the Self and Other lines is where the patient's chest and diaphragm are. With a Pressure line on it the chest is surely stuffed and blocked: a Metal Pressure is pain in the ribs and chest bones, an Earth Pressure a full, oppressive feeling with no relief, a Wood Pressure an itching heart and a gnawing stomach, a Water Pressure phlegm and fluid choking it up, and a Fire Pressure mostly heart pain. If it changes into a Wealth line, or a Wealth line changes into Pressure, it is surely food from before left undigested, so that the chest and diaphragm are not at ease.

note.yi: 经文的「间」是世爻和应爻之间的两爻；旧注拿它当病人胸膈的位置。王洪绪这一句写成「病入胸膈处」，大概是「病人胸膈处」之误，译文按病人。旧注写「胸肋骨痛」，王洪绪写「胸隔骨痛」；旧注「土鬼」，王洪绪写作「土官」，是同一个意思。「嘈杂」是胃里烧灼、空空乱乱的不适，「痰饮」是体内水液积聚成痰、成饮。
note.en: The 'between' of the verse means the two lines between the Self and Other lines, and the old commentary takes them as the place of the patient's chest and diaphragm. Wang Hongxu writes 'where the illness enters the chest' here, which is probably a slip for 'where the patient's chest is', and the translation follows 'patient'. The old commentary writes 'pain in the ribs and chest bones' and Wang Hongxu 'pain in the chest bones', and where the old commentary has 'Earth Pressure' Wang Hongxu has 'Earth official'; both mean the same. 'Gnawing' (caoza) is a burning, empty, disordered discomfort in the stomach, and 'phlegm and fluid' (tanyin) is water in the body collecting as phlegm and as fluid.

yi: 间爻上有鬼，胸膈不舒畅。
en: With Pressure in the between lines, the chest and diaphragm are not at ease.

zh: 世应中间，即病人胸膈处也。

金鬼胸肋骨痛，土鬼饱闷不宽，木鬼心痒嘈杂，水鬼痰饮填塞，火鬼多是心痛。
若化财爻，或财爻化鬼，必是宿食未消，以致胸膈不利。

title: 鬼在死绝其病本轻，逢日辰动爻生扶是绝处逢生，病要好了又重、安而复作；财生鬼则因饮食或女色加重

rule.yi: 鬼爻落在死、绝的爻位上，病本来轻。遇到日辰或动爻来生扶，叫绝处逢生，病一定是先轻后重、快好了又犯。如果是财爻生鬼，一定是因为饮食使病加重，或者因为又和女人同房。
rule.en: A Pressure line on a death or extinction position means a light illness. When the Day or a moving line generates or supports it, this is called meeting life in a place of extinction, and the illness is surely light and then heavy again, settling and then flaring. If Wealth generates Pressure, the illness is surely made heavier by food and drink, or by being with a woman again.

note.yi: 「妇人重合」的「重合」字面是「再合」。财爻既管饮食，又是男人的妻和女人，旧注这一句按上下文读作又和女人同房；书里没有再解释。「财生鬼」这一句王洪绪没有收。
note.en: 'Chong he' in 'a woman, chong he' literally means 'coming together again'. Wealth governs food and drink and is also the wife and woman for a man, so the old commentary is read from the context as being with a woman again; the book does not explain it further. Wang Hongxu does not take the sentence on 'Wealth generating Pressure'.

zh: 鬼绝逢生，病体安而复作；
yi: 鬼爻在绝处逢到生，病体安稳了又发作；
en: A Pressure line meeting life where it was extinct: the body settles and then the illness starts again;

若财生鬼，必因饮食加重，或因妇人重合。
yi: 鬼落在死、绝的爻位上，这病一定轻。
遇到日辰或动爻来生扶，叫绝处逢生，这病一定是轻了又重，快好了又犯。
如果是财爻生鬼，一定是因为吃喝使病加重，或者因为又和女人同房。
就是这个缘故。
en: Pressure on a death or extinction position: the illness is surely light.

If it meets the Day or a moving line that generates or supports it, this is called meeting life in a place of extinction; the illness is surely light and then heavy again, on the point of settling and then flaring.
If Wealth generates Pressure, the illness is surely made heavier by food and drink, or by being with a woman again.
That is the reason.

zh: 官鬼逢绝，其病必轻，如遇生扶，谓之绝处逢生，其病必将复作。
yi: 官鬼逢绝，这病一定轻，如果再遇上生扶，叫绝处逢生，这病一定还要犯。
en: A Pressure line meeting extinction: the illness is surely light; if it then meets generation or support, this is called meeting life in a place of extinction, and the illness will surely flare again.

title: 世爻衰而入墓则神志昏沉：旺则懒动、衰则不言不语，怕明喜暗、不思食、爱眠懒起；再坐阴宫是阴症，用爻入墓同断

rule.yi: 世爻衰弱又落进墓里，病人昏沉困倦。世爻有气（旺相），不过是懒得动；衰弱就不说话：怕亮喜暗，不想吃东西，爱睡，怕起床，懒得睁眼。再坐在阴宫上，一定是阴症。用爻入墓也这样断；鬼爻持世入墓、鬼的墓临在用爻上，都照这个断。
rule.en: A weak Self line falling into the tomb makes the patient drowsy and clouded. If the Self line is strong and has force, he is only too listless to move; if it is weak, he does not speak: he shrinks from the light and likes the dark, has no wish to eat, loves to sleep, dreads getting up and is too listless even to open his eyes. If it also sits in a yin palace it is surely a yin syndrome. A Subject line entering the tomb is judged the same way; so are a Pressure line on the Self line entering the tomb and the tomb of Pressure falling on the Subject line.

note.yi: 两家末句列的情形不完全一样：旧注是「用爻入墓」「世鬼入墓」「鬼墓临用」，王洪绪是「用爻入墓」「鬼墓临用」「原神入墓」。旧注的「世鬼入墓」，按上下文读作鬼爻持世、又入墓。「阴症」是虚寒、精神萎靡一类的症候。
note.en: The two ends differ a little in the cases they list: the old commentary gives 'a Subject line entering the tomb', 'a Pressure line on the Self line entering the tomb' and 'the tomb of Pressure falling on the Subject line', Wang Hongxu 'a Subject line entering the tomb', 'the tomb of Pressure falling on the Subject line' and 'the Support entering the tomb'. The old commentary's 'shi gui ru mu' is read from the context as a Pressure line holding the Self line and entering the tomb. A 'yin syndrome' is one of cold and deficiency, with the spirits low.

zh: 世衰入墓，神思困而不清。
yi: 世爻衰弱、落进墓里，神志困倦不清醒。
en: A weak Self line entering the tomb: the mind is drowsy and unclear.

Pressure on the Self line entering the tomb, and the tomb of Pressure falling on the Subject line, are all judged by this.

用爻入墓、鬼墓临用、原神入墓，皆依此法断。
yi: 世爻入了墓，病人一定昏沉。

A Subject line entering the tomb, the tomb of Pressure falling on the Subject line, and the Support entering the tomb are all judged by this method.

title: 应爻带官鬼刑克合世：是探望亲友的病时缠染上的，鬼属土是时疫，用爻临应则病卧他家

rule.yi: 应爻上坐着官鬼，来刑、克、合世爻（王洪绪说是用爻），一定是因为探望亲友的病而被缠染上。鬼爻属土的，是流行的时疫。用爻临在应爻上，一定病倒在别人家里。
rule.en: When a Pressure line sits on the Other line and punishes, controls or combines with the Self line (Wang Hongxu says the Subject line), the illness was surely caught by entanglement through visiting a sick relative or friend. If the Pressure line is Earth, it is an epidemic of the season. If the Subject line sits on the Other line, the patient surely lies ill in someone else's house.

dispute.yi: 被应鬼刑克合的是哪一爻：旧注说是世爻，而且世爻要在发动的位置上；王洪绪说是用爻，没有发动这个条件。
dispute.en: Which line the Pressure on the Other line punishes, controls or combines with: the old commentary says the Self line, which must also be in a moving position; Wang Hongxu says the Subject line, without the condition of moving.

note.yi: 「合身」的「身」是本人，即下面说的世爻或用爻。「缠染」是被缠上、传染上。「时行瘟症」是当令流行的瘟病。
note.en: The 'body' of 'combining the body' is the person himself, that is, the Self or Subject line spoken of below. 'Entangled and infected' (chanran) means being caught and infected. 'Shixing wenzheng' is a pestilence going the rounds in the season.

zh: 应鬼合身，缠染他人之症；
yi: 应爻上的鬼合住了本人，是缠染了别人的病；
en: A Pressure line on the Other line combining with the person: the illness is caught by entanglement from someone else;

hits.text: 应鬼合身，缠染他人之症
应鬼合身，缠染他人之症

zh: 应临官鬼，刑克合世爻，而世爻在交重之位者，必因探访亲友病而缠染也。
yi: 应爻上坐着官鬼，来刑、克、合世爻，而世爻又在发动的位置上，一定是因为探望亲友的病而被缠染上。
鬼爻属土，是流行的时疫。
用爻临在应爻上，一定病倒在别人家里。
en: When a Pressure line sits on the Other line and punishes, controls or combines with the Self line, and the Self line is in a moving position, the illness was surely caught by entanglement through visiting a sick relative or friend.
If the Pressure line is Earth, it is an epidemic of the season.
If the Subject line sits on the Other line, the patient surely lies ill in another's house.

zh: 应临官鬼刑克合用爻，必因探访亲友病而缠染也。
用爻临应，必然病卧他家。
yi: 应爻上坐着官鬼，刑、克、合用爻，一定是因为探望亲友的病而缠染上。
鬼爻属土，是流行的瘟病；
用爻临在应爻上，一定病倒在别人家里。
en: When a Pressure line sits on the Other line and punishes, controls or combines with the Subject line, the illness was surely caught by entanglement through visiting a sick relative or friend.
if the Pressure line is Earth, it is a pestilence going the rounds;
if the Subject line sits on the Other line, the patient surely lies ill in another's house.

title: 官鬼持世本有旧病根，再伤用爻是旧病复发，否则难脱体，须保禳；卦身持鬼也是旧病

rule.yi: 官鬼爻持世，病本来有旧根；再伤到用爻，一定是旧病又犯。不然也难脱身，要靠祈禳保佑才吉。卦身上坐着鬼，也是旧病。
rule.en: When a Pressure line holds the Self line, the illness surely has an old root; if it also wounds the Subject line, it is an old illness breaking out again. Otherwise it is hard to shake off, and protective rites are needed to be lucky. A Pressure line on the hexagram Body is also an old illness.

note.yi: 「保禳」是祈祷禳解、求神保佑一类的仪式。旧注末尾「须用保禳则吉」，王洪绪没有收。
note.en: 'Baorang' is the kind of rite in which one prays, averts and asks the spirits for protection. Wang Hongxu does not take the old commentary's closing 'protective rites are needed to be lucky'.

zh: 世官伤用，重发旧日之灾。
yi: 世爻上的官鬼伤到用爻，重新发作的是往日的灾病。
en: A Pressure line on the Self line that wounds the Subject line: the trouble of former days breaks out again.

hits.text: 世官伤用，重发旧日之灾
世官伤用，重发旧日之灾

更伤用爻，必是旧病再发。

If it also wounds the Subject line, it is surely an old illness breaking out again.
Otherwise it is surely hard to shake off, and protective rites are needed to be lucky.
A Pressure line on the hexagram Body is also an old illness.

zh: 大抵官爻持世，必然原有病根，伤用必是旧病复发，否则必难脱体。
yi: 大体上官爻持世，一定原来有病根，伤到用爻一定是旧病复发，不然一定难以脱身。
卦身上坐着鬼，也是旧病。
en: In general, when a Pressure line holds the Self line, there is surely an old root of illness from before; wounding the Subject line, it is surely an old illness breaking out again; otherwise it is surely hard to shake off.
A Pressure line on the hexagram Body is also an old illness.

title: 用爻被哪一行克就伤哪一处：金克木肢体酸痛、木克土皮骨伤残、火为仇喘咳、水来害恍惚；卦中无鬼，看谁刑冲克害用爻

rule.yi: 卦里没有鬼爻，就看谁来刑、冲、克、害用爻来断。用爻被金伤，四肢一定酸痛；用爻遭木克，皮和骨一定伤残；火是仇敌，主喘咳的灾病；水来相害，主恍惚的症候。动的金克过来，木爻受伤，四肢关节酸痛；动的木克过来，土爻受制，皮肉伤损。其余照此类推。
rule.en: With no Pressure line in the hexagram, judge by whatever punishes, clashes, controls or harms the Subject line. A Subject line wounded by Metal: the limbs surely ache and are sore; controlled by Wood: skin and bones are surely injured and maimed; with Fire as the enemy, the trouble of panting and cough; with Water coming to harm, a dazed, wandering state. So when a moving Metal line controls, the Wood line is wounded and the limbs and joints ache; when a moving Wood line controls, the Earth line is held down and flesh and skin are injured. The rest follows by analogy.

note.yi: 经文只说「用受金伤」「主遭木克」「火为仇」「水来害」，没有写用爻本身是什么五行；旧注只解释了前两句（金克的是木爻，木克的是土爻）。「火为仇」「水来害」对应的是用爻为金被火克、用爻为火被水克，这是按五行相克推的，书里没有写出来。旧注说「皮肉伤损」，王洪绪写「皮骨伤损」；旧注「肢节」，王洪绪写「支节」。
note.en: The verse only says 'the Subject wounded by Metal', 'the Subject controlled by Wood', 'Fire as the enemy' and 'Water coming to harm', and does not say which element the Subject line itself is; the old commentary explains only the first two (what Metal controls is the Wood line, what Wood controls is the Earth line). That 'Fire as the enemy' and 'Water coming to harm' correspond to a Metal Subject controlled by Fire and a Fire Subject controlled by Water is reasoned from the controlling cycle of the five phases and is not written in the book. The old commentary says 'flesh and skin are injured' and Wang Hongxu 'skin and bones are injured'; the old commentary writes 'limb joints' with one character and Wang Hongxu with another.

zh: 用受金伤，肢体必然酸痛；
主遭木克，皮骨定见伤残。
yi: 用爻被金所伤，四肢一定酸痛；
用爻遭木克，皮和骨一定伤残。
火是仇敌，就是喘咳的灾病；
水来相害，就是恍惚的症候。
en: The Subject line wounded by Metal: the limbs surely ache and are sore;
the Subject line controlled by Wood: skin and bones are surely injured and maimed.
with Fire as the enemy, it is the trouble of panting and cough;
with Water coming to harm, it is the syndrome of a dazed, wandering mind.

如金动来克，则木爻受伤，肢节酸痛；
木动来克，则土爻受制，皮肉伤损。
yi: 卦里没有鬼爻，就拿刑、冲、克、害用爻的那一爻来断。
比如金爻动了来克，木爻就受伤，四肢关节酸痛；
木爻动了来克，土爻就受制，皮肉受伤损坏。
其余照这个类推。
en: If there is no Pressure line in the hexagram, judge by whatever line punishes, clashes, controls or harms the Subject line.
For example, if a Metal line moves and controls, the Wood line is wounded and the limbs and joints ache;
if a Wood line moves and controls, the Earth line is held down and flesh and skin are injured.
The rest can be reasoned by analogy.

zh: 如金动来克，则木爻受伤，支节酸痛；
木动来克，则土爻受制，皮骨伤损。
yi: 比如金爻动了来克，木爻就受伤，四肢关节酸痛；
木爻动了来克，土爻就受制，皮骨受伤损坏。
其余照这个类推。
en: For example, if a Metal line moves and controls, the Wood line is wounded and the limbs and joints ache;
if a Wood line moves and controls, the Earth line is held down and skin and bones are injured.
The rest can be reasoned by analogy.

title: 第三爻主腰：无故自空是腰软，旺相而空是腰痛，不空而遇动爻日辰官鬼冲克是闪腰，鬼在此爻也主腰痛

rule.yi: 第三爻管腰。第三爻无缘无故落空，是腰软；有缘故而空，或者旺相而空，是腰痛；不空，但遇到动爻、日辰、官鬼来克或冲它，是闪了腰的痛；动而空的也是这样。鬼爻就在第三爻上，也主腰痛。
rule.en: The third line is the waist. If the third line is Void of itself without cause, the waist is weak; if it is Void with a cause, or Void while strong, the waist hurts; if it is not Void but a moving line, the Day or a Pressure line controls or clashes it, it is a strained waist; a moving Void line is the same. A Pressure line on the third line also means waist pain.

note.yi: 旧注的「无故自空」「有故而空」书里没有说「故」指什么。王洪绪把前者写成「值旬空」，后者只留「旺相而空」。旧注末尾的「动空亦然」，王洪绪写成「动爻亦然」，一个说动而空，一个说动爻本身，大概是传抄中「空」「爻」两个字的差别。
note.en: The book does not say what the 'cause' of the old commentary's 'Void without cause' and 'Void with cause' is. Wang Hongxu writes the former as 'meets Void' and keeps only 'Void while strong' of the latter. The old commentary's closing 'a moving Void line is the same' is written by Wang Hongxu as 'a moving line is the same': one means moving and Void, the other the moving line itself, probably a difference of the two characters for 'Void' and 'line' in copying.

zh: 空及第三，此病须知腰软；
yi: 空亡落到第三爻，这个病要知道是腰软；
en: When Void reaches the third line, know that this illness is a weak waist;

hits.text: 空及第三，此病须知腰软
空及第三，此病须知腰软

zh: 第三爻无故自空，为腰软；
有故而空，或旺相而空，为腰痛；
不空，而遇动爻日辰官鬼克冲者，乃闪腰痛也；
yi: 第三爻无缘无故自己落空，是腰软；
有缘故而空，或者旺相而空，是腰痛；
不空，但遇到动爻、日辰、官鬼来克或冲它的，是闪了腰的痛；
动而空的也是这样。
鬼爻就在这一爻上的，也主腰痛。
en: If the third line is Void of itself without cause, the waist is weak;
if it is Void with a cause, or Void while strong, the waist hurts;
if it is not Void but meets a moving line, the Day or a Pressure line that controls or clashes it, it is a strained waist;
a moving Void line is the same.
A Pressure line on this line also means waist pain.

zh: 第三爻如值旬空，为腰软；
不空而遇动爻日辰官鬼冲克者，乃闪腰痛也，动爻亦然。
yi: 第三爻如果碰上旬空，是腰软；
或者旺相而空，是腰痛。
不空，但遇到动爻、日辰、官鬼来冲克的，是闪了腰的痛，动爻也是这样。
鬼爻就在这一爻上的，也主腰痛。
en: If the third line meets Void, the waist is weak;
or if it is Void while strong, the waist hurts.
If it is not Void but meets a moving line, the Day or a Pressure line that clashes or controls it, it is a strained waist, and a moving line is the same.
A Pressure line on this line also means waist pain.

title: 官鬼克到哪一处，那一处也有病：克上六头痛，克间爻或临间爻胸膈不利；被克之处和鬼所临之处都要看

rule.yi: 病不只在鬼爻所坐的地方，被鬼克到的地方也有病痛：克到最上面一爻（上六），主头痛；克到间爻，或者鬼坐在间爻上，主胸膈不舒服；忌神也一样。其余照此类推。
rule.en: The illness is not only where the Pressure line sits; the place it wounds also has pain. Controlling the top line brings headache; controlling a between line, or sitting on one, makes the chest and diaphragm uneasy; the Adversary does the same. The rest follows by analogy.

note.yi: 旧注开头的「上六」两个字是给经文「上六」注的名称（最上面一爻叫上六），下面从「大抵」起才是解释。王洪绪比旧注多两处：鬼「临」间爻也算，忌神也算。
note.en: The old commentary's opening 'shang liu' is a gloss on the verse's 'shang liu' (the top line is called the sixth at the top), and the explanation begins at 'in general'. Wang Hongxu goes beyond the old commentary in two places: a Pressure line 'sitting on' a between line also counts, and so does the Adversary.

zh: 官伤上六，斯人当主头疼。
yi: 官鬼伤到上六爻，这个人会头痛。
en: A Pressure line wounding the top line: this person will have a headache.

hits.text: 官伤上六，斯人当主头疼
官伤上六，斯人当主头疼

zh: 大抵不惟鬼爻临处受病，被伤之处亦有病痛。
yi: 指最上面的第六爻。
大体上不光是鬼爻所坐的地方受病，被它伤到的地方也有病痛。
比如克到上六，主头痛；
克到间爻，胸膈就不舒服。
其余照这个类推。
en: The top, sixth line.
In general, it is not only the place where the Pressure line sits that is ill: the place it wounds also has pain.
For instance, controlling the top line means headache;
controlling a between line, the chest and diaphragm are uneasy.
The rest can be reasoned by analogy.

zh: 不唯官鬼克伤上六而头疼，即如官鬼所临之处，亦有病也。
如官鬼克间爻，或临间爻，皆主胸膈不利，忌神亦然。
yi: 不只是官鬼克伤上六爻才头疼，官鬼所坐的地方，也有病。
比如官鬼克到间爻，或者坐在间爻上，都主胸膈不舒服，忌神也是这样。
其余照这个类推。
en: It is not only that a Pressure line controlling and wounding the top line brings headache: the place where a Pressure line sits also has illness.
For instance, if a Pressure line controls a between line or sits on one, the chest and diaphragm are uneasy, and the Adversary does the same.
The rest can be reasoned by analogy.

title: 财爻动在上卦主吐、动在下卦主泻：被合住则欲吐不吐、欲泻不泻，是呕逆恶心、里急后重

rule.yi: 财爻在卦中动：动在上卦，主呕吐；动在下卦，主腹泻。如果被合住，就想吐吐不出、想泻泻不出，像呕逆恶心、里急后重一类。
rule.en: When the Wealth line moves in the hexagram: moving in the upper trigram it means vomiting, and in the lower trigram diarrhoea. If it is held by a combination, he wants to vomit and cannot, wants to purge and cannot, as in retching and nausea, or urgency with straining at stool.

note.yi: 「里急后重」是肚子里急着要排、排的时候又觉得下坠不尽。旧注用它和呕逆恶心一起，说明被合住时那种「想而不出」的样子。这一条的上卦、下卦，按字面是外卦、内卦。
note.en: 'Urgency with straining' (liji houzhong) is a pressing need in the belly to go, with a feeling of sinking and incomplete passing when it does. The old commentary uses it along with retching and nausea to show the state of 'wanting and not managing' when the line is held by a combination. The upper and lower trigram of this entry are, in the letter, the outer and inner trigram.

yi: 财爻在卦中动，不是呕吐就是腹泻；
en: A Wealth line moving in the hexagram: if not vomiting, then diarrhoea;

zh: 若逢合住，则欲吐不吐，欲泻不泻；
如呕逆恶心，里急后重之例。
yi: 财爻在上卦动，主呕吐；
在下卦动，主腹泻。
如果遇上合住，就想吐吐不出，想泻泻不出；
就像呕逆恶心、里急后重这一类。
en: Wealth moving in the upper trigram means vomiting;
moving in the lower trigram, diarrhoea.
If it is held by a combination, he wants to vomit and cannot, wants to purge and cannot;
like retching and nausea, or urgency with straining at stool.

zh: 财爻动临上卦主吐，动临下卦主泻，若逢合住，则欲吐不吐、欲泻不泻。
yi: 财爻动在上卦主呕吐，动在下卦主腹泻，如果遇上合住，就想吐吐不出、想泻泻不出。
en: A Wealth line moving in the upper trigram means vomiting and in the lower trigram diarrhoea; if it is held by a combination, he wants to vomit and cannot, wants to purge and cannot.

title: 木爻兴旺在世爻上，不是发痒就是疼痛：寅木主痛，卯木主痒；又在本宫内卦是气不顺

rule.yi: 木爻旺在世爻上发动，病不是发痒就是发疼：寅木主痛，卯木主痒；如果又在本宫的内卦，还有气不顺的毛病。
rule.en: When a Wood line rises on the Self line, the illness is either itching or pain: a Yin Wood line means pain, a Mao Wood line itching; if it is also in the inner trigram of the home palace, the qi is not flowing smoothly.

note.yi: 旧注末尾「若在本宫内卦，又是气不顺也」，王洪绪没有收。
note.en: Wang Hongxu does not take the old commentary's closing 'if it is in the inner trigram of the home palace, the qi is also not flowing smoothly'.

yi: 木爻兴旺在世爻上，不是发痒就是疼痛。
en: Wood rising on the Self line: if not itching, then pain.

zh: 寅卯二爻属木，寅木主痛，卯木主痒，若在本宫内卦，又是气不顺也。
yi: 寅、卯两爻属木，寅木主疼痛，卯木主发痒；如果在本宫的内卦，又是气不顺。
en: The Yin and Mao lines belong to Wood: Yin Wood means pain, Mao Wood itching; if it is in the inner trigram of the home palace, the qi is also not flowing smoothly.

zh: 寅卯二爻属木，寅木主痛，卯主痒。
yi: 寅、卯两爻属木，寅木主痛，卯木主痒。
en: The Yin and Mao lines belong to Wood: Yin Wood means pain, Mao Wood itching.

title: 先看子孙：能克制官鬼，古人叫解神、又名福德，占病里就是医药；卦中无它则鬼无制伏、服药不效祷神不灵；要生旺有气，日辰动爻生扶则吉、冲坏则凶；占父母丈夫病不宜它发动

rule.yi: 断病先看子孙爻。子孙能克制官鬼这个凶煞，古人叫它解神，又叫福德，占病时它又是医药。卦里没有子孙，鬼就没有东西制伏，吃药没有效果，祷告求神也不灵。子孙要得令有力，不要衰弱、被困、死、绝；日辰、动爻来生它、扶它就吉，来冲它、破坏它就凶。替父母或丈夫占病，子孙不宜发动：动了会伤克夫星，又克伤父母爻的原神。
rule.en: In judging illness look first at Output. Output can control and restrain the Pressure killer; the ancients called it the relieving spirit and also Output-virtue, and in divining illness it is also the medicine. If there is no Output in the hexagram, Pressure has nothing to restrain it: medicine has no effect and prayer to the spirits is not answered. Output should be in season and have force, not resting, trapped, dead or extinct; if the Day or a moving line generates and supports it, it is lucky, and if they clash and spoil it, unlucky. In divining the illness of a parent or a husband, Output should not move: moving, it harms and controls the husband star and also harms the Support of the Resource line.

note.yi: 「解神」是能解除灾厄的神，子孙克官鬼，所以叫解神；「福德」是子孙的另一个名字。「生扶拱合」是帮用神的四种办法：生是五行相生，扶和拱是同一五行的两个地支互相帮衬（《卜筮正宗》在别处举的例子：亥扶子、子拱亥），合是二合、三合、六合。旧注的「官杀」「鬼杀」，王洪绪写作「鬼煞」，是同一个意思。王洪绪比旧注多说了一条：替父母或丈夫占病，子孙不宜发动。丈夫用官鬼，父母的原神也是官鬼（官鬼生父母），所以子孙一动就克到病人依靠的那一爻；旧注没有这个限定。「财鬼无制」，旧注只说「鬼无制伏」，王洪绪多了一个财。
note.en: The 'relieving spirit' is the spirit that can relieve disaster; Output controls Pressure, hence the name. 'Output-virtue' (fude) is another name for Output. 'Generating, supporting, embracing and combining' are four ways of helping the Subject: generating is the generation of the five phases; supporting and embracing are two branches of the same phase helping each other (the Bushi Zhengzong gives elsewhere the examples Hai supports Zi and Zi embraces Hai); combining is the two-combine, the three-combine and the six-combine. The old commentary's 'guan sha' and 'gui sha' are written 'gui sha' by Wang Hongxu, and mean the same. Wang Hongxu adds one thing to the old commentary: in divining the illness of a parent or a husband, Output should not move. A husband takes Pressure, and the Support of the Resource line is also Pressure (Pressure generates Resource), so a moving Output controls the very line the patient depends on; the old commentary has no such limit. Of 'Wealth and Pressure unrestrained' the old commentary says only 'Pressure has nothing to restrain it', and Wang Hongxu adds Wealth.

zh: 既明症候，当决安危，再把爻神搜索；
个中玄妙，重加参考，方穷就里之精微。
先看子孙，最喜生扶拱合；
yi: 已经弄明白了症候，就要判断安危，再去逐个搜查爻神；
其中的玄妙，要再三参考，才能穷尽里头的精微。
先看子孙爻，最喜欢有生、有扶、有拱、有合；
en: Having understood the symptoms, one must decide danger or safety, and then search out the line-spirits one by one;
the subtlety in it must be weighed again and again before its inner refinements are exhausted.
First look at Output: it most wants generating, supporting, embracing and combining;

hits.text: 既明症候，当决安危，再把爻神搜索
个中之玄妙，重加参考，方穷就里之精微

既明症候当决安危，再把爻神搜索
个中之玄妙，重加参考，方穷就里之精微
先看子孙，最喜生扶拱合

zh: 子孙能克制官杀，古人谓解神，又名福德，占病又为医药。
要生旺有气，不要休囚死绝。
日辰动爻生扶则吉，冲坏则凶。

卦里没有它，鬼就没有东西制伏。
主吃药没有效果，祷告求神也不灵。
所以要先看子孙。
它要得令有力，不要衰弱、被困、死、绝。
日辰、动爻来生它、扶它就吉，来冲它、破坏它就凶。
en: Output can control and restrain the Pressure killer; the ancients called it the relieving spirit and also Output-virtue, and in divining illness it is also the medicine.
If it is not in the hexagram, Pressure has nothing to restrain it.
It means medicine has no effect and prayer to the spirits is not answered.
So one should look at this first.
It should be in season and have force, and not be resting, trapped, dead or extinct.
If the Day or a moving line generates and supports it, it is lucky; if they clash and spoil it, unlucky.

zh: 子孙能克制鬼煞，古人谓解神，又名福德。
占病又为医药，卦中无此财鬼无制，服药无效验，祷神不灵，所以先宜看此。
推占父母丈夫病不宜子孙发动，动则伤克夫星，又克伤父母之原神也。
yi: 子孙能克制鬼煞，古人叫它解神，又叫福德。
占病时它又是医药，卦里没有它，财爻和鬼爻就没有东西制约，吃药没有效验，祷告求神也不灵，所以要先看它。
替父母或丈夫占病，不宜子孙发动：动了会伤克夫星，又会克伤父母爻的原神。
en: Output can control and restrain the Pressure killer; the ancients called it the relieving spirit and also Output-virtue.

In divining illness it is also the medicine; if it is not in the hexagram, Wealth and Pressure are unrestrained, medicine has no effect and prayer to the spirits is not answered, and so one should look at it first.

In divining the illness of a parent (the Resource line) or of a husband, Output should not move: moving, it harms and controls the husband star, and also harms and controls the Support of the Resource line.

title: 次看主象（就是用神）：怕遇克害刑冲；占夫以官为用神、占妻以财为用神；旧注另说自占以世为主、代占以应为主；得生扶必不至死

rule.yi: 再看主象，也就是用神，就是病人：占丈夫用官鬼，占妻子用妻财。旧注还说，自己占以世爻为主象，替别人占以应爻为主象。主象怕遇到刑、冲、克、害，那就是病人被病折磨；被克害的地方如果得到生扶（旧注：得世爻生合、旁边的爻扶持），一定不至于死。
rule.en: Next look at the main image, which is the Subject and stands for the patient: in divining a husband take Pressure, in divining a wife take Wealth. The old commentary adds that in a divination for oneself the Self line is the main image, and in a divination for another the Other line is. The main image fears meeting punishment, clash, control or harm, which is the patient being ground down by the illness; but if the place of harm is generated and supported (the old commentary: by the Self line generating or combining with it and the lines beside it supporting it), he will surely not die.

dispute.yi: 替别人占病时取哪一爻做主象：旧注在六亲取用（占夫看官、占妻看财）之外，又说「代占以应为主」；王洪绪只讲六亲取用，没有把应爻当主象。
dispute.en: Which line is the main image in a divination on behalf of another: besides taking the relation (Pressure for a husband, Wealth for a wife) the old commentary also says 'in a divination for another the Other line is the main image'; Wang Hongxu speaks only of taking the relation and does not make the Other line the main image.

note.yi: 「主象」就是「用神」，王洪绪直接说了这一点。前面 LY.ILL.HJC.32 说的子孙，是解神；这里的主象，是病人自己那一爻。
note.en: The 'main image' is the 'Subject', which Wang Hongxu says outright. The Output of LY.ILL.HJC.32 is the relieving spirit; the main image here is the line of the patient himself.

zh: 次观主象，怕逢克害刑冲。
yi: 接着看主象，怕遇到克、害、刑、冲。
en: Next look at the main image: it fears meeting control, harm, punishment or clash.

hits.text: 次观主象，怕逢克害刑冲
次观主象怕逢克害刑冲

zh: 刑冲克害，即病人受症候折磨，故怕见之。
若得世爻生合，旁爻扶持，必不至死。
yi: 主象就是病人。
比如占丈夫，拿官爻做主象；
占妻子，拿财爻做主象，这一类。
另外，自己占，拿世爻做主象；
替别人占，拿应爻做主象；
这也是主象。
刑、冲、克、害，就是病人被症候折磨，所以怕见到它们。
如果得到世爻来生、来合，旁边的爻来扶持，一定不至于死。
en: The main image is the patient.
For example, in divining a husband, the Pressure line is the main image;
in divining a wife, the Wealth line is the main image, and so on.
Again, in a divination for oneself, the Self line is the main image;
in a divination for another, the Other line is the main image;
these too are the main image.
Punishment, clash, control and harm mean the patient being ground down by the symptoms, so they are feared.
If it is generated or combined by the Self line and supported by the lines beside it, he will surely not die.

zh: 主象即用神也，如占夫以官为用神，占妻以财为用神类。
如遇刑冲克害，即病人受病磨折，故怕见之。
克害处若得生扶，必不至死。
yi: 主象就是用神，比如占丈夫拿官爻做用神，占妻子拿财爻做用神，这一类。
如果遇到刑、冲、克、害，就是病人被病磨折，所以怕见到。
被克害的地方如果得到生扶，一定不至于死。
en: The main image is the Subject: in divining a husband the Pressure line is the Subject, in divining a wife the Wealth line, and so on.
If it meets punishment, clash, control or harm, the patient is worn down by the illness, so these are feared.
If the place that is controlled and harmed is generated and supported, he will surely not die.

title: 世持鬼爻病纵轻而难疗：鬼持世必难脱体，大象纵轻也不易愈；用爻有气、子孙当权则眼前可医、日后必不断根

rule.en: When a Pressure line holds the Self line, even a light illness is hard to treat: it is surely hard to shake off. However light the whole image, it does not easily heal. Even if the Subject line has force and Output holds power, so that it can be cured for now, the root will surely not be cut later.

dispute.en: Whether it is 'illness' or 'one's own illness': the old commentary says that in divining illness Pressure holding the Self line is feared, taking in every illness; Wang Hongxu limits it to divining one's own illness.

title: 用壮有扶切恐太刚则折：占病不喜旺相，人在病中必衰弱，得时有气又遇生扶反是太刚则折，到生旺日必凶；有日辰动爻刑克则不嫌其旺

rule.yi: 别的占都喜欢旺相，只有占病不喜欢：人在病里一定衰弱，平时再强健的人这时也瘦了，哪来的旺？所以用爻得时有气、又遇到日辰、动爻来生扶，是「太刚则折」的兆头，到生旺的日子一定凶；如果有动爻、日辰来刑克它，就不嫌它旺。
rule.en: Every other divination likes strength, but divining illness does not: a person in illness is surely weak, and even one who is usually robust grows thin by then, so where is the strength? Hence a Subject line that is in season and has force and also meets generation or support from the Day or a moving line is a sign of 'too rigid, it snaps', and on the day of birth or strength it is surely unlucky; if a moving line or the Day punishes or controls it, its strength is not held against it.

dispute.yi: 什么样的旺才是「太刚则折」：旧注说凡是得时有气、又遇日辰动爻生扶的都是；王洪绪的条件更窄：用神要临月建，又得日辰生扶拱合，再遇动爻生扶，最怕原神也值月建。
dispute.en: What sort of strength is 'too rigid, it snaps': the old commentary says whatever is in season and has force and also meets generation or support from the Day or a moving line; Wang Hongxu's condition is narrower: the Subject must sit on the Month, get generation, support, embracing or combining from the Day, and then meet generation or support from a moving line, and most feared is the Support also ruling the Month.

note.yi: 「太刚则折」的意思是：太硬的东西容易折断。王洪绪引的「太过者损之斯成」，是说过头的东西要减掉一些才成。旧注说「至生旺日必凶」，书里没有说「生旺日」指哪些日子，按上下文是用爻长生、帝旺的日子。旧注这一条和 LY.ILL.HJC.48 是一对：这里说太旺要折，那里说太弱体虚。
note.en: 'Too rigid, it snaps' means that what is too hard breaks easily. Wang Hongxu's 'what is excessive is made complete by taking from it' says that a thing that has gone too far must be reduced before it is complete. The old commentary says 'on the day of birth or strength it is surely unlucky' and the book does not say which days these are; from the context they are the days on which the Subject line is at Birth or Peak. This entry and LY.ILL.HJC.48 are a pair: here too strong snaps, there too weak and the body frail.

title: 主空无救须防中道而殂：主象落空占病大忌，要有动爻日辰冲克才有救（冲空则实、克空为用）；王洪绪说不独指空，墓绝空破有救者无妨、无救者必死，救指生扶拱合

dispute.yi: 怎样才算「有救」：旧注说主象落空，要动爻、日辰来冲它、克它才有救（冲空则实，克空为用），不然必死；王洪绪说不光是落空，入墓、绝、被破也算，救是生、扶、拱、合。一个用冲克把它叫起来，一个用生扶合去帮它。
dispute.en: What counts as 'rescue': the old commentary says a Void main image is rescued only when a moving line or the Day clashes or controls it (clashing a Void line makes it real, controlling a Void line puts it to use), otherwise he surely dies; Wang Hongxu says the line speaks not of Void alone but of tomb, extinction and being broken as well, and rescue is generating, supporting, embracing and combining. One wakes the line by clash and control, the other helps it by generation, support and combination.

title: 禄系妻财、寿属父母：财是食禄、父母是寿命，卦中不可无、宜静不宜动；财空或无财不思饮食，父母动占病大忌（克制福神、官杀肆虐、服药不效、反促天年）；主象遇绝，财父入绝为禄绝、寿绝

rule.yi: 占病，妻财是食禄，父母是寿命，卦里不能没有，宜静不宜动。卦里没有财爻或者财爻落空，是不想吃东西；父母爻动是占病的大忌，因为它克制子孙（福神），官鬼这个凶煞就能肆意逞凶，吃药不见效、祷告不灵，所以说「反促天年」。旧注还说：主象遇到绝，或变到绝地，财爻遇到叫禄绝，父母爻遇到叫寿绝，整个卦象如果凶，这是死的兆头。
rule.en: In divining illness, Wealth is the food-emolument and Resource is the span of life; neither may be missing from the hexagram, and both should be still and not moving. If there is no Wealth line or it is Void, he has no wish to eat; a moving Resource line is a great taboo, because it controls Output (the spirit of fortune) and lets the Pressure killer run wild, so medicine has no effect and prayer is not answered, hence 'it shortens the span of life instead'. The old commentary adds: if the main image meets extinction or changes into a place of extinction, then Wealth meeting it is the emolument cut off and Resource meeting it the life span cut off, and if the whole image is bad this is a sign of death.

note.yi: 「占兄弟病反宜动也」这一句是王洪绪独有的，书里没有说道理。按六亲，父母生兄弟，占兄弟的病时父母爻是原神，它动起来反倒是帮忙，大概是这个缘故。「福神」是子孙爻的另一个叫法，「食禄」是口粮、吃的。旧注比王洪绪多讲了「禄绝」「寿绝」。
note.en: The sentence 'in divining a brother's illness moving is on the contrary right' is Wang Hongxu's alone, and the book gives no reason. By the six relations Resource generates Peer, so in divining a brother's illness the Resource line is the Support, and its moving is on the contrary a help; that is probably the reason. The 'spirit of fortune' is another name for the Output line, and 'food-emolument' is one's ration, what one eats. The old commentary speaks of the 'emolument cut off' and the 'life span cut off', which Wang Hongxu does not.

title: 主象伏藏则病迁延：用爻不上卦其病难安（旧注：生扶无处着落，病恍惚朦胧不爽快），要等它值日出露、或久病等它值年值月才愈（王洪绪）

rule.yi: 用爻不上卦，这病一定拖着难好：出现在卦里的爻，日辰、动爻才能生它、合它，不上卦，就算有生扶也没有地方落脚，这种病也是恍惚朦胧、不爽快的病。要等用爻值日露出来，或者久病等它值年、值月才好，所以说一定拖延日子和月份。
rule.en: A Subject line that is absent from the hexagram means the illness drags on and cannot settle: a line that appears can be generated and combined by the Day and moving lines, but if it is not in the hexagram, where would generation and support land? Such an illness is vague and hazy, one that never feels clear. One must wait until the Subject line rules the day and comes into the open, or in a long illness wait for the year or month that it rules, before it heals; hence it is said to drag on for days and months.

note.yi: 两家讲的是同一个卦象的两面：旧注讲这种病是什么样子（恍惚朦胧、不爽快），王洪绪讲它什么时候好（值日、值年、值月）。王洪绪引的经文是「迁延乎岁月」，而他自己的注里说「迁延日月」，和卜筮大全的「迁延乎日月」一致，「岁月」大概是印错了。
note.en: The two speak of two sides of the same image: the old commentary of what sort of illness this is (vague, hazy, never clear), Wang Hongxu of when it heals (on the day, year or month the line rules). The verse as Wang Hongxu quotes it reads 'dragging on through years and months', while his own note says 'dragging on through days and months', in agreement with the Bushi Daquan's 'days and months'; 'years' is probably a printing slip.
