zh: 鬼生卦身为父母，卦身生鬼为子孙；
鬼克卦身为冤仇，卦身克鬼为妻妾。
惟鬼克身，冤家债主之鬼，必难退遣。
yi: 这是按卦身来推。
鬼生卦身的是父母（父母爻），卦身生鬼的是子孙（子孙爻）；
鬼克卦身的是冤仇，卦身克鬼的是妻妾。
两者比和（五行相同）的，是兄弟朋友；
阴爻的，是妯娌、姊妹的鬼。
子孙，是小孩、晚辈的鬼。
父母，是长辈、祖宗的鬼。
财爻，是妻妾、女人的鬼。
只有鬼克卦身，是冤家债主的鬼，一定难以打发。
病也不容易好。
en: This is worked out by the Body.
A ghost that generates the Body is a parent (Resource); the Body generating the ghost is a descendant (Output);
a ghost controlling the Body is an enemy; the Body controlling the ghost is a wife or concubine.
Where the two are in harmony (the same element), it is Peer: brothers and friends;
a yin line is the ghost of a sister-in-law or a sister.
Output (descendants) means the ghosts of the young and juniors.
Resource (parents) means the ghosts of elders and ancestors.
The Wealth line means the ghosts of a wife, concubine or woman.
Only a ghost that controls the Body, the ghost of an enemy or creditor, is hard to be rid of.
The illness too will not easily settle.

zh: 鬼生卦身为父母，卦身生鬼为子孙，鬼克卦身为冤仇，卦身克鬼为妻妾，二者比合为兄弟朋友姊妹之鬼。
yi: 这是按卦身来推。
鬼生卦身的是父母，卦身生鬼的是子孙，鬼克卦身的是冤仇，卦身克鬼的是妻妾，两者比合的是兄弟朋友姊妹的鬼。
en: This is worked out by the Body.

A ghost that generates the Body is a parent (Resource), the Body generating the ghost is a descendant (Output), a ghost controlling the Body is an enemy, the Body controlling the ghost is a wife or concubine, and where the two are in harmony it is the ghost of a brother (Peer), friend or sister.

title: 鬼带刑爻必非善终之鬼：旧注按地支分辰压死、午汤火烫、酉刀箭、亥落水、寅虎噬、巳蛇伤、戌犬咬、丑牛触，旺则为神道；王洪绪说按五行所属推

rule.yi: 鬼带刑爻，一定是没有善终的鬼。怎么死的：旧注按鬼的地支分，辰是被墙壁压死，午是被热汤烈火烫死烧死，酉是被刀箭所伤，亥是投河落水，寅也许是被老虎咬死，巳是被蛇咬伤，戌是被狗咬，丑是被牛顶；旺相的成了神道，像刘郡王、猛将这样的神。王洪绪说要按鬼所属的五行去推是怎么死的。
rule.en: A ghost carrying a punishing line is surely one who did not die a good death. How he died: the old commentary goes by the ghost's branch — Chen, crushed by a wall; Wu, scalded or burned by hot water or fire; You, wounded by blade or arrow; Hai, threw himself into a river or fell into water; Yin, perhaps devoured by a tiger; Si, bitten by a snake; Xu, bitten by a dog; Chou, gored by an ox — and if strong it becomes a spirit-way, like the god Prince Liu, the Fierce General. Wang Hongxu says to work out the manner of death from the element the ghost belongs to.

dispute.yi: 怎么推是怎么死的：旧注按鬼爻的地支分（辰压死、午烫死、酉刀箭、亥落水、寅虎、巳蛇、戌犬、丑牛）；王洪绪说「当以五行所属推其何死鬼」，按五行推，不按地支。两种办法给出的名目不完全重合（例如增删卜易 LY.ILL.ZS.23 按五行说金是刀剑亡鬼、木是刑杖悬梁、水是水死、火是汤火焚烧、土是墙倒屋塌，和旧注的辰午酉亥有部分重合）。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: How to work out how the ghost died: the old commentary goes by the branch of the Pressure line (Chen crushed, Wu scalded, You blade and arrow, Hai water, Yin tiger, Si snake, Xu dog, Chou ox); Wang Hongxu says 'work out the manner of death from the element it belongs to', by element and not by branch. The two methods do not give exactly the same categories (for instance the Zengshan Buyi, LY.ILL.ZS.23, goes by element — Metal a ghost of blade and sword, Wood of the staff or the hanging beam, Water of drowning, Fire of hot water and burning, Earth of a collapsed wall — which overlaps in part with the old commentary's Chen, Wu, You and Hai). The books do not decide.

note.yi: 「刑爻」这里指带刑的爻，书里没有列出哪些是刑。「刘郡王猛将之神」是民间信奉的神，书里没有解释，按字面译作刘郡王、猛将。这一条的经文只有「刑不善终」四字，和下一条「绝则无祀」在王洪绪那里连成一段注。
note.en: 'A punishing line' means a line carrying punishment (xing); the book does not list which they are. 'Prince Liu, the Fierce General' is a spirit worshipped among the people and is not explained in the book, so is rendered literally. The verse here is only the four characters 'punishment, no good death', and in Wang Hongxu it forms one passage of commentary with the next entry, 'extinction, no one to sacrifice'.

yi: 鬼带刑，死得不好；
en: If it carries punishment, the death was not a good one;

zh: 鬼带刑爻，必非善终之鬼。
辰是墙壁压死鬼，午是汤火烧烫鬼，酉是刀箭所伤鬼，亥是投河落水鬼。
寅或虎噬，巳或蛇伤，戌或犬咬，丑或牛触。
旺则为神道，刘郡王猛将之神。
yi: 鬼带着刑爻，一定是没有善终的鬼。
辰是被墙壁压死的鬼，午是被开水和火烧烫死的鬼，酉是被刀箭伤死的鬼，亥是投河落水而死的鬼。
寅，也许是被老虎咬死；巳，也许是被蛇咬伤；戌，也许是被狗咬；丑，也许是被牛顶。
旺相的，就成了神道，像刘郡王、猛将这样的神。
en: A ghost carrying a punishing line is surely one who did not die a good death.
Chen is a ghost crushed by a wall, Wu a ghost scalded or burned by hot water or fire, You a ghost wounded by blade or arrow, Hai a ghost who threw himself into a river or fell into water.
Yin may be one devoured by a tiger, Si one bitten by a snake, Xu one bitten by a dog, Chou one gored by an ox.
If strong, it becomes a spirit-way, such as the god Prince Liu, the Fierce General.

zh: 鬼带刑爻，必非善终之鬼，当以五行所属推其何死鬼；
yi: 鬼带刑爻，一定是没有善终的鬼，要按它所属的五行推是怎么死的鬼；
en: A ghost carrying a punishing line is surely one who did not die a good death; work out what kind of death from the element it belongs to;

title: 鬼不上卦看它伏在哪一爻下：伏父母下是家先、伏子孙下是小口小儿、伏空下是无收管的孤魂野鬼，临绝爻是无祀之鬼

rule.yi: 鬼爻不上卦，就看它伏在哪一爻下面，便知道是什么鬼祟：伏在父母爻下，是家里已故的祖先；伏在子孙（福神）爻下，是小孩一类；伏在空亡的爻下，是没有人收管的鬼，是孤魂野鬼；如果临在绝爻上，是没有人祭祀的鬼。
rule.en: If the Pressure line is absent from the hexagram, see under which line it is hidden and you will know what kind of ghost it is: hidden under the Resource line, the family's forebears; under the Output (fortune spirit) line, children and the like; under a Void line, a ghost that no one keeps, a lonely wandering ghost; and if it meets an Extinction line, a ghost to whom no one sacrifices.

note.yi: 这一条经文只有「绝则无祀」四字；王洪绪把它和上一条「刑不善终」并成一段注，后半是「不上卦看伏何爻下」，和旧注相同。卜筮正宗后面的书中例（小畜卦）用的是伏鬼的看法：官鬼酉金伏在第三爻辰土下面，辰酉相合，又被戊辰日合住；但断「房中藏着神像」用的是「伏合是藏匿之象、酉金是正气之神、第三爻是房室」，不是上面旧注这条里的父母下是家先、子孙下是小儿。
note.en: The verse here is only the four characters 'extinction, no one to sacrifice'; Wang Hongxu joins it with the previous entry, 'punishment, no good death', into one passage of commentary, whose second half, 'if absent from the hexagram, see under which line it is hidden', is the same as the old commentary. The case that follows in the Bushi Zhengzong (Xiaoxu) uses the reading of a hidden ghost: the You Metal Pressure lies hidden beneath the third line, Chen Earth; Chen and You combine and the Wuchen day also holds it in combination; but the judgment 'a statue is hidden in the room' rests on 'hidden and combined is the image of concealment, You Metal is a spirit of proper energy, the third line is the bedroom', not on the old commentary's 'under Resource the family forebears, under Output children'.

yi: 鬼临绝，就是没有人祭祀的鬼。
en: If it meets Extinction, there is no one to make offerings to it.

zh: 鬼不上卦，看伏何爻下，便知是何鬼崇。
若伏空下，乃是无收管之鬼，是孤魂野鬼。
yi: 鬼爻不上卦，就看它伏在哪一爻下面，便知道是什么鬼崇。
如果伏在父母爻下，是家里已故的祖先。
伏在子孙（福神）爻下，是小孩这一类。
如果伏在空亡爻下，是没有人收管的鬼，是孤魂野鬼。
如果临在绝爻上，是没有人祭祀的鬼。
en: If the ghost is absent from the hexagram, look under which line it is hidden, and you will know what kind of ghostly influence it is.
If it is hidden under the Resource line, it is the family's forebears.
If hidden under the Output (fortune spirit) line, it is of the kind of small children.
If it is hidden under a Void line, it is a ghost with no one to keep it, a lonely wandering ghost.
If it meets an Extinction line, it is a ghost with no one to sacrifice to it.

zh: 不上卦看伏何爻下，便知是何鬼祟，如伏父下为家先，伏福下为小儿类。
yi: 鬼不上卦，看它伏在哪一爻下面，便知是什么鬼祟：伏在父母爻下是家先，伏在福神（子孙）下是小孩一类。
en: If it is absent from the hexagram, see under which line it is hidden and you will know what ghostly influence it is: hidden under the Resource line, the family's forebears; hidden under the Output (fortune spirit) line, children and the like.

zh: 寅月戊辰日，占病有何鬼神为祸，得小畜卦：
yi: 寅月戊辰日，占病人有什么鬼神作祸，得小畜卦：
en: In the Yin month, on the Wuchen day, he divined what ghost or spirit was making trouble in an illness, and obtained Xiaoxu:

zh: 断曰：凡卜鬼神以官爻为用，今官鬼伏辰爻之下，与飞神作合，又得日辰合住。
予想伏合乃藏匿之象，酉金是正气之神，第三爻为房室，即断曰：汝家房中藏有神像作祟。
彼曰：有铜达摩祖师在匣中。
命其送于寺内，其痛亦愈。
yi: 断说：凡是占鬼神，以官爻为用；现在官鬼伏在辰爻下面，和飞神合在一起，又被日辰合住。
我想，伏着又被合住，是藏起来的象；酉金是正气之神；第三爻是房室；就断说：你家房里藏着一尊神像在作祟。
他说：有一尊铜的达摩祖师像在匣子里。
叫他把像送到寺里去，他的病痛也好了。
en: Judgment: in all divining of ghosts and spirits the Pressure line is the Subject; now Pressure is hidden beneath the Chen line, combines with the flying line, and is further held by a combination with the Day.

I thought that being hidden and combined is the image of concealment; You Metal is a spirit of proper energy; the third line is the bedroom; so I judged: a statue of a spirit is hidden in a room of your house and is making trouble.
He said: there is a bronze figure of Patriarch Damo in a box.
I told him to send it to a temple, and his pain was cured as well.

title: 鬼临日月定然新死亡灵：卦无官鬼而日辰是鬼，必是新死的人为祸；日辰是鬼而卦中又有鬼，是近日新许的愿未酬

rule.yi: 鬼落在日辰上，一定是刚死不久的亡灵：卦里没有官鬼、日辰是鬼的，一定是刚死的人在作祸；日辰是鬼、卦里又有鬼的，是因为祈祷，近来新许下的愿还没有还。
rule.en: A ghost that falls on the Day is surely a newly dead spirit: if there is no Pressure in the hexagram and the Day is the ghost, a newly dead person is surely making trouble; if the Day is the ghost and the hexagram also has a ghost, it is because of a prayer: a vow newly made lately has not been paid.

note.yi: 经文说的是「日月」，旧注和王洪绪都只讲日辰是鬼，没有说月建是鬼怎么办。旧注比王洪绪多一层原因：「必因祈祷」。这一条和病体章里「日辰带鬼，亟为祈祷」（LY.ILL.HJC.49、LY.ILL.HJC.50）是同一个看法，那里讲怎样认是哪一路神。
note.en: The verse speaks of 'Day and Month', but both the old commentary and Wang Hongxu speak only of the Day being the ghost and do not say what to do when the Month is. The old commentary gives one more reason than Wang Hongxu: 'surely because of a prayer'. This entry is the same view as 'when the Day carries the ghost, pray urgently' in the chapter on the patient's condition (LY.ILL.HJC.49 and LY.ILL.HJC.50), where the question of which spirit it is is treated.

zh: 如临日月，定然新死亡灵；
yi: 如果鬼落在日、月上，一定是刚死不久的亡灵；
en: If the ghost falls on the Day or the Month, it is surely a newly dead spirit;

hits.text: 如临日月，定然新死亡灵
如临日月，定然新死亡灵

zh: 卦无官鬼，而日辰是鬼者，必然新死亡人为祸。
若日辰是鬼，而卦中又有鬼，必因祈祷，而近日新许之愿未酬。
yi: 卦里没有官鬼，而日辰是鬼的，一定是刚死的人在作祸。
如果日辰是鬼，而卦里又有鬼，一定是因为祈祷，近来新许下的愿还没有还。
en: If there is no Pressure in the hexagram but the Day is the ghost, a newly dead person is surely making trouble.
If the Day is the ghost and the hexagram also has a ghost, it is surely because of a prayer: a vow newly made lately has not been paid.

zh: 卦无官鬼而日辰是鬼者，必然新死亡灵为祸。
若日辰是鬼，而卦中又有鬼，是近日新许之愿未酬也。
yi: 卦里没有官鬼而日辰是鬼的，一定是刚死的亡灵在作祸。
如果日辰是鬼，而卦里又有鬼，是近来新许下的愿还没有还。
en: If there is no Pressure in the hexagram but the Day is the ghost, a newly dead spirit is surely making trouble.
If the Day is the ghost and the hexagram also has a ghost, it is a vow newly made lately that has not been paid.

title: 鬼自入墓刑决是狱中囚犯：未日占得木爻官鬼谓鬼自入墓，是死于囹圄的囚人之鬼，更带刑爻必死于非命；旺相发动则是庙神

rule.yi: 鬼自己入墓、带刑，一定是关在牢里的囚犯的鬼：比如在未日占卦，得到木爻的官鬼，叫做鬼自己入墓，一定是死在牢狱里的人的鬼；再带刑爻，一定是死于非命，或者死在坟墓之间；旺相又发动的，就是庙里的神。
rule.en: A ghost that enters its own tomb or is punished is surely the ghost of a prisoner in jail: if one divines on a Wei day and gets a Wood Pressure line, the ghost is said to enter its own tomb, and it is surely the ghost of one who died in prison; if it also carries a punishing line, he surely died an unnatural death or died among graves; and if strong and moving, it is a temple god.

note.yi: 「囹圄」是监狱（卜筮大全篇末生僻字注）。「自入墓」的例子是：未是木的墓，在未日占卦，得木爻官鬼，被日辰带进了墓。旧注多一句「更带刑爻，必死于非命，或死于坟墓间者」，王洪绪没有。
note.en: 'Lingyu' is a prison (the book's glossary at the end of the chapter). The example of 'entering its own tomb' is: Wei is the tomb of Wood, so on a Wei day, with a Wood Pressure line, the ghost is taken into its tomb by the Day. The old commentary has one more sentence, 'if it also carries a punishing line, he surely died an unnatural death or died among graves', which Wang Hongxu lacks.

zh: 自入墓刑，决是狱中囚犯。
yi: 鬼自己入墓、带刑，一定是关在牢里的囚犯。
en: If the ghost enters its own tomb or is punished, it is surely a prisoner in jail.

hits.text: 自入墓刑，决是狱中囚犯
自入墓刑，决是狱中囚犯

zh: 如未日占卦，得木爻官鬼，谓鬼自入墓。
必是死于囹圄囚人之鬼。
更带刑爻，必死于非命，或死于坟墓间者。
yi: 比如在未日占卦，得到木爻的官鬼，叫做鬼自己入墓。
一定是死在牢狱里的囚犯的鬼。
再带刑爻，一定是死于非命，或者死在坟墓之间的。
旺相又发动的，就是庙里的神。
en: For example, if one divines on a Wei day and gets a Wood Pressure line, the ghost is said to enter its own tomb.
It is surely the ghost of a prisoner who died in jail.
If it also carries a punishing line, he surely died an unnatural death, or died among graves.
If strong and moving, it is a temple god.

zh: 如未日占卦，得木爻官鬼入墓，必是死于囹圄囚狱之鬼；
yi: 比如在未日占卦，得到木爻官鬼入墓，一定是死在牢狱里的囚徒的鬼；
旺相发动的，就是庙神。
en: For example, if one divines on a Wei day and gets a Wood Pressure line entering its tomb, it is surely the ghost of one who died in prison;
if strong and moving, it is a temple god.

title: 傍爻财合必月下之情人、应位弟生乃社中好友：财爻动合鬼爻或财化鬼、鬼化财相合，是与病人私通之人为祸；被世克带玄武是因奸致死之鬼

rule.yi: 旁边的财爻来合鬼，一定是月下私会的情人；应爻位上的兄弟来生它，是同社的好友。财爻发动来合鬼爻，或者财变鬼、鬼变财，自己互相合在一起的，一定是和病人私通的人在作祸；如果被世爻克，又带玄武，是因为通奸而死的鬼。
rule.en: A Wealth line beside it combining with the ghost is surely a lover met under the moon; a Peer on the Other line generating it is a good friend of the village society. If a Wealth line moves and combines with the Pressure line, or Wealth changes into Pressure or Pressure into Wealth so that they combine with each other, it is surely a person who had an illicit affair with the patient who is making trouble; if it is controlled by the Self line and carries the Dark Tortoise, it is the ghost of one who died because of adultery.

note.yi: 经文两句，两家注都只讲了前一句（财合）；「应位弟生，乃社中之好友」这一句旧注和王洪绪都没有再解释。旧注比王洪绪多「被世克而带玄武，是因奸致死之鬼」一句。这条判断是古书里说的，写得很肯定（「必」），本库照抄，不替它加验证。
note.en: Of the verse's two lines, both commentaries explain only the first (Wealth combining); neither explains 'the Peer on the Other line generating it is a good friend of the society'. The old commentary adds 'if controlled by the Self line and carrying the Dark Tortoise, it is the ghost of one who died because of adultery', which Wang Hongxu lacks. The classic states this judgment with certainty ('surely'); the library copies it without adding any verification.

zh: 傍爻财合，必月下之情人；
应位弟生，乃社中之好友。
yi: 旁边的爻是财爻来合鬼，一定是月下私会的情人；
应爻位上的兄弟来生它，是同社的好友。
en: If a Wealth line beside it combines with the ghost, it is surely a lover met under the moon;
if a Peer on the Other line generates it, it is a good friend from the village society.

hits.text: 旁爻财合，必月下之情人
应位弟生，乃社中之好友
旁爻财合，必月下之情人
应位弟生，乃社中之好友

zh: 财爻动合鬼爻，或财化鬼，鬼化财，自相作合者，必与病人私通之人为祸。
若被世克，而带玄武，乃因奸致死之鬼。
yi: 财爻发动来合鬼爻，或者财爻变鬼、鬼爻变财，自己互相合在一起的，一定是和病人私通的人在作祸。
如果被世爻克，又带玄武，就是因为通奸而死的鬼。
其余照这个办法推。
en: If a Wealth line moves and combines with the Pressure line, or Wealth changes into Pressure or Pressure into Wealth, so that they combine with each other, it is surely a person who had an illicit affair with the patient who is making trouble.
If it is controlled by the Self line and carries the Dark Tortoise, it is the ghost of one who died because of adultery.
Follow this for the rest.

zh: 财爻动合鬼爻，或财化鬼、鬼化财，自相作合者，必与病人私通之人为祸。
yi: 财爻发动来合鬼爻，或者财爻变鬼、鬼变财，自己互相合在一起的，一定是和病人私通的人在作祸。
en: If a Wealth line moves and combines with the Pressure line, or Wealth changes into Pressure or Pressure into Wealth, so that they combine with each other, it is surely a person who had an illicit affair with the patient who is making trouble.

title: 鬼动化出六亲即以化出者断：化兄是朋友兄弟妯娌、化鬼加玄武是盗贼、化父母是伯叔、加螣蛇是匠人作魇魅；父化官虽非螣蛇亦是匠人作弊

rule.yi: 鬼爻发动，变出哪一个六亲，就按变出来的这个断：变成兄爻，是朋友、兄弟、妯娌、公婆这一类；变成鬼再加玄武，是盗贼；变成父母，是伯叔这些亲属，再加螣蛇，是他家屋里有工匠做了魇魅的手脚，使家里的人不得安宁；父母变成官，即使没有螣蛇，也是工匠作了弊。
rule.en: When the Pressure line moves and turns into one of the six relations, judge by what it turns into: into Peer, friends, brothers, sisters-in-law and parents-in-law; into Pressure with the Dark Tortoise, a thief; into Resource, uncles and other relatives, and with the Coiling Snake added, a craftsman in his house has worked a nightmare-spell so that the household is uneasy; if Resource changes into Pressure, even without the Coiling Snake, a craftsman has played a trick.

note.yi: 「穿窬」是穿墙洞、爬墙头去偷，指小偷。「魇魅」是用邪术暗中害人（卜筮大全篇末的生僻字注只分别解释了「魇」「魅」两个字）。「姑嫜」是丈夫的母亲和父亲（嫜，丈夫的父亲，见生僻字注）；王洪绪的名单里没有它。「匠人作魇魅」是古人的一种说法：工匠在造房子时暗中做手脚害主人，这条书里没有再解释。这一条的核心是：鬼动变出什么，就按变出来的那一类亲属去认。
note.en: 'Chuanyu' is to break through a wall or climb over it to steal, meaning a thief. 'Yanmei' is to harm someone secretly with evil arts (the book's glossary explains only the two characters separately). 'Gujiang' are the husband's mother and father (the glossary defines 'zhang' as the husband's father); Wang Hongxu's list lacks them. 'A craftsman worked a nightmare-spell' is an old way of saying that a craftsman secretly does something against the owner while building the house, which the book does not explain further. The heart of this entry is that whatever the moving ghost changes into decides which kind of relative it is.

zh: 化出鬼爻临玄武，则穿窬之鬼；
变成父母遇螣蛇，则魇魅之精。
yi: 变出鬼爻又带玄武，是穿墙行窃的小偷的鬼；
变成父母爻又遇螣蛇，是魇魅之类的精怪。
en: If a Pressure line is changed out and carries the Dark Tortoise, it is the ghost of a thief who broke through walls;
if it changes into Resource and meets the Coiling Snake, it is a nightmare-spell sprite.

hits.text: 化出鬼爻临玄武，则穿窬之鬼
变成父母遇螣蛇，则魇魅之精
化出鬼爻临玄武，则穿窬之鬼
变成父母遇螣蛇，则厌魅之精

zh: 鬼动，化出六亲，即以化出者断。
如化兄，为朋友兄弟，妯娌姑嫜类。
若化鬼，加玄武，必是盗贼。
加鰧蛇，乃是其家屋中，匠人作魇魅出现，以致人口不安。
父化官，虽非鰧蛇，亦是匠人作弊。
yi: 鬼爻发动，变出哪一个六亲，就按变出来的这个断。
比如变成兄爻，是朋友、兄弟、妯娌、公婆这一类。
如果变成鬼，再加玄武，一定是盗贼。
变成父母，是伯叔这些亲属；
再加螣蛇，是他家屋里，有工匠做了魇魅的手脚出现，使家里的人不得安宁。
父母变成官，即使没有螣蛇，也是工匠作了弊。
en: When the ghost moves and turns into one of the six relations, judge by what it turns into.
For example, changing into Peer means friends, brothers, sisters-in-law, parents-in-law and the like.
If it changes into Pressure and adds the Dark Tortoise, it is surely a thief.
Changing into Resource means uncles and other relatives;
with the Coiling Snake added, it is that in his house a craftsman has worked a nightmare-spell and it has appeared, so that the household is uneasy.
If Resource changes into Pressure, even without the Coiling Snake, a craftsman has played a trick.

zh: 鬼动化出六亲，即以化出者断，如化兄为朋友、兄弟、妯娌类。
若化鬼加玄武，必是盗贼；
加螣蛇，乃其家因匠人造作魇魅，以致人口不安；
父化官，虽非螣蛇，亦是匠人作弊。
yi: 鬼动变出六亲，就按变出来的断，比如变成兄爻，是朋友、兄弟、妯娌这一类。
如果变成鬼加玄武，一定是盗贼；
变成父母是伯叔一类的亲属；
再加螣蛇，是他家因为工匠造作魇魅，使家里的人不得安宁；
父母变成官，即使没有螣蛇，也是工匠作了弊。
en: When the ghost moves and turns into one of the six relations, judge by what it turns into; for example, changing into Peer means friends, brothers, sisters-in-law and the like.
if it changes into Pressure with the Dark Tortoise added, it is surely a thief;
changing into Resource means uncles and other relatives;
with the Coiling Snake added, it is that in his house a craftsman has worked a nightmare-spell, so that the household is uneasy;
if Resource changes into Pressure, even without the Coiling Snake, a craftsman has played a trick.

title: 太岁鬼临是祖传旧例、日辰官并是口许初心：太岁、日辰都带鬼，是眼下许下酬谢祖辈老规矩的愿还没办完

rule.yi: 太岁上带鬼，是祖辈传下来的老规矩；日辰上并着官，是当初口头许下的心愿。如果太岁、日辰都带鬼，就是眼下许下要酬谢祖辈老规矩的愿，还没有办完。
rule.en: A ghost on the Tai Sui is an old custom handed down from the ancestors; Pressure joined to the Day is the original intention of a spoken vow. If the Tai Sui and the Day both carry the ghost, then a vow has been made for now to repay the ancestral custom, and it is not yet completed.

note.yi: 经文两句是分开的：太岁带鬼是「祖传旧例」，日辰官并是「口许初心」。旧注和王洪绪都把它们合成一条，只讲太岁、日辰都带鬼的情形，没有分别讲各自的意思。「日下」旧注写作「日下」，王洪绪写作「目下」，是字形相近的两种写法，都译作眼下。
note.en: The verse's two lines are separate: the Tai Sui carrying the ghost is 'an ancestral custom', and Pressure joined to the Day is 'the original intention of a spoken vow'. The old commentary and Wang Hongxu both merge them into one entry and treat only the case of both the Tai Sui and the Day carrying the ghost, without explaining each separately. The old commentary writes 'ri xia' and Wang Hongxu 'mu xia', two close-looking forms, both rendered 'for now'.

zh: 太岁鬼临，乃祖传之旧例；
日辰官并，是口许之初心。
yi: 太岁上带鬼，是祖辈传下来的老规矩；
日辰上并着官，是口头许下的当初的心愿。
en: A ghost on the Tai Sui is an old custom handed down from the ancestors;
Pressure joined to the Day is the original intention of a spoken vow.

hits.text: 太岁鬼临，乃祖法之旧例
日辰官并，是口许之初心
太岁鬼临，乃祖传之旧例
日辰官并，是口许之初心

zh: 若太岁日辰俱带鬼，则日下许酬祖例，尚未完其事。
yi: 如果太岁、日辰都带鬼，就是眼下许下要酬谢祖辈老规矩的愿，还没有办完。
en: If the Tai Sui and the Day both carry the ghost, then a vow has been made for now to repay the ancestral custom, and the matter is not yet completed.

zh: 若太岁日辰俱官，则目下许酬祖先例未完。
yi: 如果太岁、日辰都是官，就是眼下许下要酬谢祖先老规矩的愿还没有办完。
en: If the Tai Sui and the Day are both Pressure, then a vow made for now to repay the custom of the ancestors has not been completed.

title: 鬼持世是旧愿未酬、鬼伏世下是有口无心、鬼化妻财是斋修不了、变财空亡是有头无尾

rule.yi: 鬼爻持世，不是祖传的老规矩，而是先前口头许过愿、没有还；卦里没有鬼、世爻下面却伏着本宫的鬼，也是旧欠的愿，是嘴上答应了却没放在心上，所以招来责罚；鬼爻变出妻财，一定是斋戒修行没有做完，或者欠土煞的愿、破了戒；变成的财落空亡，是许了愿却没有戒口，有头没尾。
rule.en: When the Pressure line holds the Self position, it is not an old custom but a spoken vow made earlier and not yet paid; if there is no ghost in the hexagram but the ghost of the home palace is hidden beneath the Self line, it too is an old debt, words without the heart in it, and so blame has come; if the Pressure line changes into Wealth, a fast or observance was surely not completed, a debt owed to the earth spirits, or a precept was broken; and if the Wealth it changes into is Void, one made the vow but did not keep the abstinence of the mouth: a head with no tail.

note.yi: 经文「持世则未酬旧愿」，王洪绪引作「持世则来酬旧愿」，「未」和「来」形近，按上下文应是「未」；他的注「有旧愿宜酬」也是这个意思。「心斋」按旧注的解释是斋戒修行，「土杀之欠」按字面译作欠土煞的愿。王洪绪的注只有一句，旧注讲了四种情形。
note.en: Where the verse says 'holding Self, the old vow is not yet paid' (wei chou), Wang Hongxu quotes 'holding Self, the old vow is to be paid' (lai chou); 'wei' and 'lai' look alike and by context 'wei' must be right, and his commentary 'an old vow that ought to be paid' means the same. 'Xinzhai', in the old commentary's explanation, is a fast or observance, and 'a debt owed to the earth-killing' is rendered literally as a debt to the earth spirits. Wang Hongxu's commentary is a single sentence, while the old commentary treats four cases.

zh: 持世则未酬旧愿，伏为有口无心；
变财乃不了心斋，空则有头无尾。
yi: 鬼持世，是旧愿没有还；伏着的，是嘴上答应了却不放在心上；
变成财，是斋戒没有做完；落空，就是有头没尾。
en: A ghost holding the Self position means an old vow has not been paid; if hidden, it is a spoken word without the heart in it;
changing into Wealth, the abstinence of the heart was not completed; if Void, it has a head but no tail.

hits.text: 持世则来酬旧愿，伏为有口无心
变财乃不了心斋，空则有头无尾
持世则未酬旧愿，伏为有口无心
变财乃不了心斋，空则有头无尾

zh: 鬼爻持世，亦非旧例，乃是先曾许过口愿，未得酬也。
若无鬼，世下却伏本宫之鬼，亦是旧欠。
但是有口无心，再不介意，故致愆责。
若鬼爻化出妻财，必斋修不了，土杀之欠，或破戒不净。
变财空亡，必虽许而口不戒，有头无尾也。
yi: 鬼爻持世，也不是祖传的老规矩，而是先前曾经口头许过愿，没有还。
如果卦里没有鬼，世爻下面却伏着本宫的鬼，也是旧欠的愿。
但是嘴上说说，心里不当回事，再也不放在心上，所以招来责罚。
如果鬼爻变出妻财，一定是斋戒修行没有做完，欠的是土煞的愿，或者破了戒、不清净。
变成的财落空亡，一定是嘴上许了愿，口却没有戒，有头没尾。
en: When the Pressure line holds the Self position, it is also not an old custom but a spoken vow made earlier and not yet paid.
If there is no ghost in the hexagram but the ghost of the home palace is hidden beneath the Self line, it too is an old debt.
But it was words without heart; it was never taken to heart again, and so blame has come.
If the Pressure line changes into Wealth, a fast or observance was surely not completed — a debt owed to the earth spirits — or a precept was broken and one is unclean.
If the Wealth it changes into is Void, one surely made the vow but did not keep the abstinence of the mouth: a head with no tail.

zh: 鬼爻持世，有旧愿宜酬类。
yi: 鬼爻持世，是有旧愿应该还的这一类。
en: The Pressure line holding the Self position is of the kind where there is an old vow that ought to be paid.

title: 鬼在宅中住居不稳、官临应上朝向不通：内卦第二爻是宅，动鬼临之宅不安常有病；应爻临鬼宅朝向不利宜改

rule.yi: 鬼在住宅的位置上，住得不安稳；官落在应爻上，房子的朝向不顺。内卦的第二爻是宅：发动的鬼落在这里，住宅不安，常常有病；应爻带着鬼，这座宅子的朝向不利，应该改；旧注还说冲克二爻的爻也是这样。
rule.en: A ghost in the house position means the dwelling is unsettled; Pressure on the Other line means the orientation of the house is blocked. The second line of the inner trigram is the house: if a moving ghost sits there, the dwelling is unsettled and there is often illness; if the Other line carries the ghost, the orientation of the house is unfavourable and should be changed; the old commentary adds that a line that clashes with or controls the second line does likewise.

note.yi: 旧注多出「冲克二爻的爻」一种情形，王洪绪没有。家宅本身怎么断，旧注说另有家宅章，这里只讲鬼和宅的关系。
note.en: The old commentary adds the case of a line that clashes with or controls the second line, which Wang Hongxu lacks. How to judge the household itself the old commentary leaves to the chapter on the household; here it treats only the relation of the ghost to the house.

yi: 鬼在住宅的位置上，住得不安稳；
官落在应爻上，房子的朝向不顺。
en: A ghost in the house position means the dwelling is unsettled;
Pressure on the Other line means the orientation of the house is blocked.

zh: 若动鬼临之，宅不安，常有病。
若冲克之爻，或应爻临鬼，其宅朝向不利，宜改。
yi: 内卦的第二爻是宅。
如果发动的鬼落在这里，住宅不安，常常有病。
如果是冲克它的爻，或者应爻带着鬼，这座宅子的朝向不利，应该改。
en: The second line of the inner trigram is the house.
If a moving ghost sits there, the house is unsettled and there is often illness.
If a line clashes with or controls it, or the Other line carries the ghost, the orientation of the house is unfavourable and should be changed.

zh: 内卦第二爻为宅若动鬼临之，住宅不安，常有疾病；
若应爻临鬼，其宅朝向不利，宜改作为喜。
yi: 内卦第二爻是宅，如果发动的鬼落在这里，住宅不安，常常有病；
如果应爻带着鬼，这座宅子的朝向不利，改动一下才好。
en: The second line of the inner trigram is the house; if a moving ghost sits there, the dwelling is unsettled and there is often illness;
if the Other line carries the ghost, the orientation of the house is unfavourable, and it is well to make changes.

title: 兑卦金龙干佛像：金鬼在兑宫是佛的善愿，带青龙勾陈是装塑、带螣蛇是图画、化父是描写、否则是经文、化财福是修舍

rule.yi: 金在兑卦里发动，涉及佛像：兑是西方的卦，佛又是金身，所以遇到兑宫的金鬼，神佛那里一定有善愿。带青龙、勾陈，是要装銮塑像；带螣蛇，是想画像；变成父母，是描摹；不是这些，就是经文；变成财或福，是想修建房舍。
rule.en: Metal moving in the Dui trigram concerns a Buddha image: Dui is a trigram of the west and a Buddha has a body of gold, so meeting a Metal ghost in the Dui palace, there is surely a good vow to a god or Buddha. With the Azure Dragon and Hook Earth, it is to mount and mould an image; with the Coiling Snake, to paint a picture; changing into Resource, to copy or delineate; otherwise, scripture; changing into Wealth or Output, to build or repair a hall.

note.yi: 经文「金龙」按旧注是兑宫金鬼带青龙，「干」是涉及、冒犯。王洪绪的注只有一句「金身佛像」，旧注按六神和变出的六亲分了装塑、图画、描写、经文、修舍五种。「舍」在这里指房舍、殿堂，旧注没有再解释。
note.en: By the old commentary, 'gold dragon' in the verse is a Metal ghost in the Dui palace carrying the Azure Dragon, and 'gan' means to concern or to offend. Wang Hongxu's commentary is the one phrase 'a Buddha image with a body of gold', while the old commentary divides by the six spirits and the relation it changes into: mounting and moulding, painting, copying, scripture, and building. 'She' here means a house or hall, and the old commentary does not explain further.

yi: 兑卦里金带青龙，涉及佛像；
en: In the Dui trigram, Metal with the Azure Dragon concerns a Buddha image;

zh: 兑西方卦，佛又金身，故遇兑宫金鬼，神佛中必有善愿。
yi: 兑是西方的卦，佛又是金身，所以遇到兑宫的金鬼，神佛那里一定有善愿。
带青龙、勾陈，是要装銮塑像；
带螣蛇，是想画像；
变成父母，是描摹；
不是这些，就是经文。
如果变成财或福，是想修建房舍。
en: Dui is a trigram of the west, and a Buddha has a body of gold, so meeting a Metal ghost in the Dui palace, there is surely a good vow to a god or Buddha.
With the Azure Dragon and Hook Earth, it is to mount and mould an image;
with the Coiling Snake, it is to paint a picture;
changing into Resource, it is to copy or delineate;
otherwise, it is scripture.
If it changes into Wealth or Output, it is to build or repair a hall.

zh: 金在兑宫发动，金身佛像；
yi: 金在兑宫发动，是金身的佛像；
en: Metal moving in the Dui palace: a Buddha image with a body of gold;

title: 坎宫木动犯划舟：木在坎宫发动是舟楫之象，必划龙船、上三相公见咎，送之则吉；艮巽卦中水鬼临青龙动及木化水、水化木皆是

rule.yi: 木在坎宫发动，冒犯了划船（龙船）的神：是船和桨的象，一定是划龙船的事，上三相公怪罪，把他们送走就吉利；在艮卦、巽卦里水鬼带青龙发动，以及木变水、水变木，鬼落在水上，也都是这个象。
rule.en: Wood moving in the Kan palace has offended the spirit of the rowed boat: it is the image of a boat and oars, surely a matter of rowing the dragon boat, and the Three Lords Above are displeased; seeing them off brings good fortune. In the Gen or Xun trigram, a Water ghost carrying the Azure Dragon and moving, or Wood changing into Water or Water into Wood, with the ghost on Water, is the same image.

note.yi: 「上三相公」是旧注提到的神，书里没有解释，按字面译作上面的三位相公。王洪绪把「舟楫」写作「舟辑」，字形相近，意思同。这一条和上一条（兑卦金龙）在王洪绪那里是同一段注的前后两句。
note.en: The 'Three Lords Above' are spirits the old commentary mentions but does not explain, and are rendered literally. Wang Hongxu writes 'boat and oars' with a variant character; the meaning is the same. This entry and the previous one (Metal and the Dragon in Dui) are the two halves of one passage in Wang Hongxu.

yi: 木在坎宫发动，冒犯了划船的神。
en: Wood moving in the Kan palace offends the spirit of the rowed boat.

zh: 木在坎宫发动，舟楫之象。
必划龙船，上三相公见咎。
若艮巽卦中，水鬼临青龙动，及木化水，水化木，鬼在水上皆是。
yi: 木在坎宫发动，是船和桨的象。
一定是划龙船的事，上三相公怪罪。
把他们送走就吉利。
如果在艮卦、巽卦里，水鬼带青龙发动，以及木变水，水变木，鬼落在水上，都是这个象。
en: Wood moving in the Kan palace is the image of a boat and oars.
It is surely a matter of rowing the dragon boat, and the Three Lords Above are displeased.
Seeing them off brings good fortune.
If in the Gen or Xun trigram a Water ghost carries the Azure Dragon and moves, or Wood changes into Water or Water into Wood, with the ghost on Water, all are this image.

zh: 木在坎宫发动，舟辑之象。
yi: 木在坎宫发动，是船桨的象。
en: Wood moving in the Kan palace is the image of a boat and oars.

title: 水土交加在乾宫是三元大帝、火金互动于兑卦为五道伤官：乾宫土化水水化土遇官爻是三官（天地水），兑宫火金互发遇官爻是五道刀剑之神

rule.yi: 水和土交错加在一起，在乾宫就是三元大帝（天官、地官、水官）：乾宫里土变水、水变土，又遇到官爻的，就是这个象；火和金互相发动，在兑卦就是五道伤官（五道是刀剑之神）：在兑宫里互相发动，又遇到官爻的，就是这个象。
rule.en: Water and Earth mingled together, in the Qian palace, are the Three Primes Great Emperor (the Officials of Heaven, Earth and Water): in the Qian palace, Earth changing into Water or Water into Earth and meeting a Pressure line is this image. Fire and Metal moving upon each other, in the Dui trigram, are the Five Paths and the Injuring Officer (the Five Paths are the spirit of blade and sword): moving upon each other in the Dui palace and meeting a Pressure line is this image.

note.yi: 经文和旧注在卜筮大全里写在同一行，中间只隔一个空格；本库按内容拆开。「三元大帝」旧注解作天、地、水三官。旧注和王洪绪都只解释了三官和五道，「伤官」没有再解释。王洪绪引经文时把「在乾宫」「于兑卦」的位置调到了句中，意思一样。
note.en: In the Bushi Daquan the verse and old commentary sit on one line separated by a single space; the library splits them by content. The old commentary explains the 'Three Primes Great Emperor' as the Three Officials of Heaven, Earth and Water. Both commentaries explain only the Three Officials and the Five Paths, and neither explains the 'Injuring Officer'. When Wang Hongxu quotes the verse he moves 'in Qian' and 'in Dui' to the middle of the line; the meaning is the same.

zh: 水土交加，在乾宫则三元大帝；
火金互动，于兑卦为五道伤官。
yi: 水和土交错加在一起，在乾宫就是三元大帝；
火和金互相发动，在兑卦就是五道伤官。
en: Water and Earth mingled together, in the Qian palace, are the Three Primes Great Emperor;
Fire and Metal moving upon each other, in the Dui trigram, are the Five Paths and the Injuring Officer.

hits.text: 水土交加在乾宫，则三元大帝
火金互动于兑卦，为五道伤官
水土交加，在乾宫则三官大帝
火金互动，于兑卦为五道伤官

zh: 乾宫土化水，水化土，而遇官爻者，是其象。
在兑宫互相发，而遇官爻者，是其象。
yi: 三官，就是天、地、水三官。
乾宫里土变水、水变土，又遇到官爻的，就是这个象。
五道是掌管刀剑的神。
在兑宫里（火和金）互相发动，又遇到官爻的，就是这个象。
en: The Three Officials are the Officials of Heaven, Earth and Water.
In the Qian palace, Earth changing into Water or Water into Earth, meeting a Pressure line, is this image.
The Five Paths are the spirit in charge of blade and sword.
In the Dui palace, (Fire and Metal) moving upon each other, meeting a Pressure line, is this image.

zh: 天地水三官，乾宫土水互化遇官爻者是也。
五道乃刀剑之神，在兑宫互相发动而遇官鬼者是也。
yi: 所谓三官；
就是天、地、水三官，乾宫里土和水互相变，又遇到官爻的就是。
五道是刀剑之神，在兑宫里（火和金）互相发动而遇到官鬼的就是。
en: The 'Three Officials';
are the Officials of Heaven, Earth and Water, and this is when in the Qian palace Earth and Water change into each other and meet a Pressure line.
The Five Paths are the spirit of blade and sword, and this is when in the Dui palace (Fire and Metal) move upon each other and meet Pressure.

title: 三空无香火之堂：占病遇第三爻空亡，象是不供香火的厅堂；动空化空似有若无，旺相空亡供器不全

rule.yi: 第三爻落空，就是没有供香火的厅堂：占病时遇到第三爻空亡，他家不供奉香火；动了又落空、变出来也是空，像有又像没有；旺相而落空亡，供奉的器物不齐全。
rule.en: A Void third line means a hall where no incense or fire is offered: in divining illness, when the third line is Void, his family does not offer incense and fire; if it moves into Void or changes into Void, it is as if there were something and as if there were nothing; if strong yet Void, the sacrificial vessels are incomplete.

note.yi: 经文两句「三空无香火之堂，怪动有不祥之祸」，王洪绪的注把两句连成一段，本库按句拆成这一条和下一条。旧注比王洪绪多了动空化空、旺相空亡两种细分。
note.en: The verse has two lines, 'a void third: no hall of incense; a strange line moving: inauspicious misfortune', and Wang Hongxu's commentary runs them into one passage; the library splits them by line into this entry and the next. The old commentary distinguishes two more cases than Wang Hongxu: moving into or changing into Void, and strong yet Void.

yi: 第三爻落空，就是没有供香火的厅堂；
en: A Void third line means a hall where no incense or fire is offered;

zh: 凡占病，遇三爻空亡者，其象不供香火之堂。
yi: 凡是占病，遇到第三爻空亡的，象是不供香火的厅堂。
动了又落空、变出来也是空，像有又像没有。
旺相而空亡，供奉的器物不齐全。
其余在家宅章里有。
en: In divining illness, when the third line is Void, the image is a hall where no incense or fire is offered.
If it moves into Void or changes into Void, it is as if there were something and as if there were nothing.
If strong yet Void, the sacrificial vessels are incomplete.
The rest is in the chapter on the household.

yi: 第三爻空，他家不供奉香火。
en: If the third line is Void, his family does not offer incense and fire.

title: 怪动有不祥之祸：怪爻依月份取位（旧注：季月初六爻、仲月二五爻、孟月三四爻），动了才成怪；临父母必有怪器、加玄武是盗人之物、螣蛇又动临鬼爻然后可言有怪

rule.yi: 怪动有不吉利的灾祸：怪爻按起卦的月份取，一定要动了才成怪，不动就没有；带父母，一定有怪异的器物；加玄武，是偷来的东西；遇到这一爻发动，即使不是鬼爻，也一定是怪事；螣蛇又发动、落在鬼爻上，然后才可以说有怪异。旧注取位是季月落在初爻和六爻，仲月二爻和五爻，孟月三爻和四爻。
rule.en: When the strange line moves there is inauspicious misfortune: the strange line is taken by the month of casting, and it becomes strange only when it moves — if still, there is none. With Resource there is a strange object; with the Dark Tortoise added, stolen goods; whenever this line moves, even if it is not the Pressure line, it is a strange matter; and only when the Coiling Snake also moves and sits on the Pressure line can one say there is something strange. The old commentary takes the position as the first and sixth lines in the Ji months, the second and fifth in the Zhong months, and the third and fourth in the Meng months.

dispute.yi: 怪爻按月份落在哪几爻：旧注的口诀是季月（辰戌丑未）在初、六爻，仲月（子午卯酉）在二、五爻，孟月（寅申巳亥）在三、四爻；王洪绪写「初六爻是仲月，二五爻是孟月，三四爻是季月」，把三对爻位和三种月份的配法错开了一位（初六配仲、二五配孟、三四配季）。两家对不上，书里没有说哪个是抄错的。
dispute.en: Which lines the strange line falls on by month: the old commentary's rhyme puts the Ji months (Chen, Xu, Chou, Wei) on the first and sixth lines, the Zhong months (Zi, Wu, Mao, You) on the second and fifth, and the Meng months (Yin, Shen, Si, Hai) on the third and fourth; Wang Hongxu writes 'the first and sixth lines are the Zhong months, the second and fifth the Meng months, the third and fourth the Ji months', which shifts the pairing of the three line-pairs and the three kinds of month by one place (first and sixth with Zhong, second and fifth with Meng, third and fourth with Ji). The two do not agree, and the books do not say which is a copying slip.

note.yi: 怪爻的月份口诀只见于旧注。另外旧注末句是「然后可言有怪」，王洪绪写作「然后可言妖怪」，前者说「有怪异」，后者说「有妖怪」，轻重略有不同。「季月」是辰戌丑未月，「仲月」是子午卯酉月，「孟月」是寅申巳亥月。
note.en: The rhyme for the months of the strange line is found only in the old commentary. The old commentary's last sentence is 'only then can one say there is something strange' and Wang Hongxu's 'only then can one speak of a monster'; the first says 'something strange', the second 'a monster', a slight difference of weight. The Ji months are those of Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, the Zhong months those of Zi, Wu, Mao and You, and the Meng months those of Yin, Shen, Si and Hai.

yi: 怪爻发动，有不吉利的灾祸。
en: When the strange line moves, there is inauspicious misfortune.

zh: 怪爻季是两头居，初与六爻是。
仲月逢之二五随，孟月只宜三四是。
凡遇此爻动，虽非鬼爻，必是怪事。
鰧蛇又动临鬼爻，然后可言有怪。
yi: 怪爻在季月落在两头，就是初爻和六爻。
仲月遇到，是二爻、五爻跟着；孟月只在三爻、四爻。
动爻才成怪，不动就没有。
带父母，一定有怪异的器物。
加玄武，是偷来的东西。
凡是遇到这一爻发动，即使不是鬼爻，也一定是怪事。
螣蛇又发动、落在鬼爻上，然后才可以说有怪异。
en: In the Ji months the strange line sits at the two ends, the first and sixth lines.
In the Zhong months it is followed by the second and fifth; in the Meng months it is only the third and fourth.
A moving line becomes strange; if still there is none.
With Resource, there is surely a strange object.
With the Dark Tortoise added, it is a thief's stolen goods.
Whenever this line moves, even if it is not the Pressure line, it is surely a strange matter.
Only when the Coiling Snake also moves and sits on the Pressure line can one say there is something strange.

zh: 怪爻四季月，初六爻是仲月，二五爻是孟月，三四爻是季月。
临父母必有怪器，加玄武是盗人之物，凡遇此爻动，虽非鬼爻，必是怪事。
螣蛇又动临鬼爻，然后可言妖怪。
yi: 怪爻在四季月，初、六爻是仲月，二、五爻是孟月，三、四爻是季月。
带父母一定有怪异的器物，加玄武是偷来的东西，凡是遇到这一爻发动，即使不是鬼爻，也一定是怪事。
螣蛇又发动、落在鬼爻上，然后才可以说有妖怪。
en: The strange line, in the four seasons' months: the first and sixth lines are the Zhong months, the second and fifth lines the Meng months, the third and fourth lines the Ji months.
With Resource there is surely a strange object; with the Dark Tortoise added, stolen goods; whenever this line moves, even if it is not the Pressure line, it is surely a strange matter.
Only when the Coiling Snake also moves and sits on the Pressure line can one speak of a monster.

title: 龙遇文书独发经文可断：占有何鬼神不专看鬼爻，独发之爻亦可推；父母独发是祖宗求祀，临青龙则有善愿经文；本宫鬼爻伏世下在胎养生旺是新死亡人讨求经忏荐度

rule.yi: 青龙遇到父母（文书）、一爻单独发动，可以断是经文：占有什么鬼神，不一定只看鬼爻，单独发动的那一爻也可以推。父母爻单独发动，是祖宗要求祭祀，带青龙就有善愿和经文；旧注还说，本宫的鬼爻伏在世爻下、又在胎、养、长生、帝旺的位置上，一定有刚死的人在讨要念经拜忏来超度，伏鬼属水的话棺材还暴露着，落空就不是。
rule.en: The Dragon meeting the document line, with a lone line moving, may be judged to mean scripture: in divining what ghost or spirit is involved, one need not rely only on the Pressure line, since a lone moving line can also be worked out. If Resource alone moves, the ancestors are asking for sacrifice, and with the Azure Dragon there is a good vow and scripture; the old commentary adds that if the Pressure line of the home palace is hidden beneath the Self line and stands at Womb, Nurture, Birth or Peak, a newly dead person is asking for scripture-chanting and rites of repentance to deliver him, and if the hidden ghost is Water the coffin is still exposed, and if it is Void it is not so.

note.yi: 经文说「龙遇文书」，旧注没有解「文书」，按上下文文书是父母爻。旧注多出两层：一层是「不持鬼爻断，独发之爻亦可推」的总原则，一层是本宫鬼爻伏世下、在胎养生旺的新死亡人，王洪绪只留了父母独发这一句。「荐度」是做法事超度亡灵。
note.en: The verse says 'the Dragon meeting the document line', and the old commentary does not gloss 'document'; by context it is the Resource line. The old commentary has two layers Wang Hongxu lacks: the general principle 'not relying on the Pressure line, a lone moving line may also be worked out', and the newly dead person when the Pressure line of the home palace is hidden beneath the Self line at Womb, Nurture, Birth or Peak. Wang Hongxu keeps only Resource moving alone. 'Jiandu' is to perform rites to deliver the spirit of the dead.

zh: 龙遇文书，独发经文可断；
yi: 青龙遇到文书，一爻单独发动，可以断是经文；
en: The Dragon meeting the document line, with a lone line moving, may be judged to mean scripture;

hits.text: 龙遇文书独发，经文可断
龙遇文书，独发经文可断

zh: 凡占有何鬼神，不持鬼爻断，独发之爻亦可推。
本宫鬼爻，又伏世下，而在胎养生旺之地者，必有新死亡人，讨求经忏荐度也。
伏鬼属水，棺尚暴露，空则不然。
yi: 凡是占有什么鬼神，不专靠鬼爻来断，单独发动的那一爻也可以推。
比如父母爻单独发动，是祖宗要求祭祀。
带青龙，就有善愿和经文。
本宫的鬼爻，又伏在世爻下面，而且在胎、养、长生、帝旺的位置上，一定有刚死的人，在讨要念经拜忏来超度。
伏着的鬼属水，棺材还暴露在外；如果落空就不是这样。
en: In divining what ghost or spirit is involved, one need not rely only on the Pressure line to judge; a lone moving line can also be worked out.
If Resource alone moves, the ancestors are asking for sacrifice.
With the Azure Dragon, there is a good vow and scripture.

If the Pressure line of the home palace is hidden beneath the Self line and stands at Womb, Nurture, Birth or Peak, there is surely a newly dead person asking for scripture-chanting and rites of repentance to deliver him.
If the hidden ghost is Water, the coffin is still exposed; if it is Void, it is not so.

zh: 如父母独发，乃祖宗求祀，临青龙则有善愿经文。
yi: 如果父母爻单独发动，是祖宗要求祭祀，带青龙就有善愿和经文。
en: If Resource alone moves, the ancestors are asking for sacrifice, and with the Azure Dragon there is a good vow and scripture.

title: 蛇逢官鬼属阴梦寐当推：鬼临螣蛇必有虚惊怪异，在阴宫阴象则有梦寐，冲克世爻用爻是梦中所见神祟，螣蛇临鬼动是吊死鬼

rule.yi: 螣蛇遇到官鬼、属阴的，梦里的事该推一推：鬼带螣蛇，一定有虚惊怪异；如果在阴宫、阴象，就有梦寐；冲克世爻、用爻的，一定是梦中见到的神祟；旧注还说螣蛇带着鬼发动，就是吊死鬼。
rule.en: The Snake meeting Pressure, of the yin kind: dreams should be worked out. A ghost on the Coiling Snake surely brings false alarms and strange things; in a yin palace and a yin image there are dreams; one that clashes with or controls the Self line or the Subject line is surely a spirit seen in a dream; and the old commentary adds that if the Coiling Snake moves with the ghost, it is a hanged ghost.

note.yi: 经文最后一个字，卜筮大全作「梦寐当推」，王洪绪引作「梦寐难当」：一个是「该推算」，一个是「难以承受」，字面不同，书里没有说哪个对。旧注比王洪绪多一句「螣蛇临鬼动，则是吊死鬼」。
note.en: The verse's ending in the Bushi Daquan is 'dreams should be worked out' (dang tui), and Wang Hongxu quotes 'dreams are hard to bear' (nan dang); the wording differs and the books do not say which is right. The old commentary has one more sentence than Wang Hongxu: 'if the Coiling Snake moves on the ghost, it is a hanged ghost'.

zh: 蛇逢官鬼，属阴梦寐当推。
yi: 螣蛇遇到官鬼、属阴的，梦里的事该推一推。
en: The Coiling Snake meeting Pressure, of the yin kind: dreams should be worked out.

hits.text: 蛇逢官鬼，属阴梦寐当推

zh: 鬼临鰧蛇，必有虚惊怪异。
若在阴宫阴象，则有梦寐。
冲克世爻用爻，必梦中所见神崇。
鰧蛇临鬼动，则是吊死鬼。
yi: 鬼带螣蛇，一定有虚惊怪异。
如果在阴宫、阴象，就有梦寐。
冲克世爻、用爻的，一定是梦中所见的神祟。
螣蛇带着鬼发动，就是吊死鬼。
en: A ghost on the Coiling Snake surely brings false alarms and strange things.
If it is in a yin palace and a yin image, there are dreams.
If it clashes with or controls the Self line or the Subject line, it is surely a spirit seen in a dream.
If the Coiling Snake moves with the ghost, it is a hanged ghost.

zh: 鬼临螣蛇，必有虚惊怪异，若在阴宫阴象则有梦寐，冲克世爻用爻，必梦中所见神祟。
yi: 鬼带螣蛇，一定有虚惊怪异；如果在阴宫、阴象，就有梦寐；冲克世爻、用爻的，一定是梦中见到的神祟。
en: A ghost on the Coiling Snake surely brings false alarms and strange things; if it is in a yin palace and a yin image, there are dreams; if it clashes with or controls the Self line or the Subject line, it is surely a spirit seen in a dream.

title: 动入空中值鬼恐失孝思之礼：官爻动空化空，主先亡中有失祀礼，或逢忌日不设祭；在他宫外卦则是眷属中曾有祀礼今取消不设其位

rule.yi: 鬼动了又落入空亡，恐怕丢了孝敬追思的礼数：官爻发动落空、或变出来空，都主先人亡故的人里有丢了祭祀礼数的，或者遇到忌日没有摆祭；如果在别的宫、外卦，就是亲属里曾经有过祭祀的礼，现在却取消了，不设他的牌位；或者曾经送过纸钱纸帛，现在没有了。
rule.en: A ghost that moves into Void: it is feared the rites of filial remembrance have been neglected. If the Pressure line moves into Void or changes into Void, it means that among the departed forebears some rites of sacrifice have been lost, or no offering was set out on the anniversary of a death; if it is in another palace or the outer trigram, it is that among the kin there was once a rite of sacrifice which has now been dropped and his place is no longer set, or paper offerings used to be sent and now none is.

note.yi: 「禴」是周礼里的一种春夏之祭。「褚帛」按旧注的用法是烧给亡人的纸钱纸帛，书里没有解释，按字面译。王洪绪没有忌日和纸钱两句；他的「眷中曾会祀礼不设其位」比旧注的「眷属中曾有祀礼，今却除之，不设其位」少了「今却除之」，语意不全，可能是传抄脱字，书里没有说明。
note.en: 'Yue' is a seasonal sacrifice in the Zhou rites, of spring or summer. 'Chubo' in the old commentary's usage is paper money and cloth burned for the dead; the book does not explain it and it is rendered literally. Wang Hongxu lacks the anniversary and paper-offering sentences; his 'among the kin a rite of sacrifice was once held, and his place is not set' lacks the old commentary's 'now dropped' and is incomplete in sense, perhaps a scribal omission, which the book does not explain.

zh: 动入空中值鬼，恐失孝思之礼；
yi: 鬼动了又落入空亡，恐怕丢了孝敬追思的礼数；
en: A ghost that moves into Void: it is feared that the rites of filial remembrance have been neglected;

hits.text: 动入空中值鬼，恐失孝思之礼
动入空中值鬼，恐失孝思之礼

zh: 官爻动空化空，皆主先亡中，有失禴祀，或逢忌日不设祭也。
若在他宫外卦，则是眷属中曾有祀礼，今却除之，不设其位。
yi: 官爻发动落空、或变出来空，都主先人亡故的人里，有失了禴祭的，或者遇到忌日没有摆祭。
如果在别的宫、外卦，就是亲属里曾经有过祭祀的礼，现在却取消了，不设他的牌位。
或者曾经送过纸钱纸帛，现在没有了。
都是这样的象。
en: If the Pressure line moves into Void or changes into Void, in each case it means that among the departed forebears some have lost the seasonal Yue sacrifice, or that no offering was set out on the anniversary of a death.
If it is in another palace or the outer trigram, it is that among the kin there was once a rite of sacrifice which has now been dropped, and his place is no longer set.
Or paper offerings used to be sent, and now none is.
All have this image.

zh: 官爻动空化空，皆主先亡中有失祀礼。
若在他宫外卦，则是眷中曾会祀礼不设其位。
yi: 官爻发动落空、或变出来空，都主先人亡故的人里有丢了祭祀礼数的。
如果在别的宫、外卦，就是亲属里曾经会过的祭祀礼，不再设他的位置。
en: If the Pressure line moves into Void or changes into Void, in each case it means that among the departed forebears some rites of sacrifice have been neglected.
If it is in another palace or the outer trigram, it is that among the kin a rite of sacrifice was once held, and his place is no longer set.

title: 静居宅上临木家停暴露之棺：木爻官鬼安静地落在二爻，或木鬼伏在父母爻下，其家必停灵柩，举之则安；衰弱的是座席，撤了家宅安泰

rule.yi: 鬼安静地落在宅位（二爻）上又是木，家里停着裸露的棺材：木爻的官鬼安静地落在二爻，或者木鬼伏在父母爻下面，这家一定停着灵柩，把它抬走就安宁了；衰弱的话是座席，撤掉它，家宅安泰；旧注说照这样断，万无一失。
rule.en: A still ghost on the house position (the second line), being Wood, means the family has a coffin lying exposed: if a Wood Pressure line sits still on the second line, or a Wood ghost is hidden beneath the Resource line, the family surely has a coffin lying in the hall, and once it is carried away there will be peace; if weak, it is a seat or mat, and once it is taken away the household is at peace. The old commentary says that judged this way nothing can go wrong.

note.yi: 「座席」旧注没有解释，按字面译作座位或席子。旧注末句「依此断，万无一失」是注者自己的保证，王洪绪没有，本库照抄注者的话，不替它担保。这一条是鬼神章的最后一条。
note.en: The old commentary does not explain 'zuoxi' (seat and mat), rendered literally as a seat or mat. The old commentary's last sentence, 'judge by this and nothing will go wrong', is the commentator's own guarantee, which Wang Hongxu lacks; the library copies the commentator's words and does not stand surety for them. This is the last entry of the chapter on ghosts and spirits.

zh: 静居宅上临木，家停暴露之棺。
yi: 鬼安静地坐在宅位上又是木，家里停着裸露着的棺材。
en: A still ghost sitting on the house position, being Wood, means the family has a coffin lying exposed.

hits.text: 静居宅上临木，家停暴露之棺
静居宅上临木，家停暴露之棺

zh: 木爻官鬼，静临二爻，或木鬼伏于父母下，其家必然停柩在堂，举之则安。
衰则座席，起之，家宅安泰。
yi: 木爻的官鬼，安静地落在二爻，或者木鬼伏在父母爻下面，这家一定停着灵柩在堂屋，把它抬走就安宁了。
衰弱的话，就是座席，撤掉它，家宅就安泰。
照这样断，万无一失。
en: If a Wood Pressure line sits still on the second line, or a Wood ghost is hidden beneath the Resource line, the family surely has a coffin lying in the hall, and once it is carried away there will be peace.
If weak, it is a mat or seat, and once it is taken away the household will be at peace.
Judge by this and nothing will go wrong.

zh: 木爻官鬼静临二爻，或木鬼伏于父母下，其家必然停柩不安。
yi: 木爻的官鬼安静地落在二爻，或者木鬼伏在父母爻下面，他家一定停着灵柩，不得安宁。
en: If a Wood Pressure line sits still on the second line, or a Wood ghost is hidden beneath the Resource line, the family surely has a coffin lying unburied and is uneasy.

title: 身命章·鬼爻持世，疾病缠绵（旧注：鬼为殃祸，遇之则一生疾病缠身，或带疾或常招官讼，贵人见之不以此断）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》身命章说：「鬼爻持世，疾病缠绵。」旧注解释：官鬼是殃祸，遇到它，一生疾病缠身，或者带着病，或者常常招来官司；如果是贵人遇到，就不这样断。王洪绪说：官是祸殃，遇到主带疾病、招官讼，贵人并临则贵。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on the person and fate says: 'With the ghost line holding the Self line, illness lingers.' The old commentary explains: Pressure is calamity, and meeting it means illness clinging to the body for a whole life, either carrying an illness or often drawing a lawsuit; if a person of rank meets it, it is not judged this way. Wang Hongxu says: Pressure is calamity, and meeting it means carrying illness or drawing a lawsuit, but if a noble star is on it as well, it means rank.

dispute.yi: 一生多病落在哪一爻持世上，两本说法不同。《黄金策》身命章是官鬼爻持世（这一条），卜筮全书的阐幽精要身命章是兄弟爻持世「疾病连绵」（LY.ILL.BSQS.24）；两处都说父母持世辛勤劳碌。诸爻持世诀里鬼爻持世是「占身不病也遭官」（LY.ILL.BSQS.04），和黄金策同在鬼爻上，只是没有说一生多病。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The books differ on which line holding the Self line brings a lifetime of illness. The Huangjin Ce's chapter on the person and fate has the Pressure line holding the Self line (this entry); the chapter on the person and life in the Chanyou Jingyao of the Bushi Quanshu has the Peer line holding the Self line, 'illness drags on' (LY.ILL.BSQS.24); both say that Resource holding the Self line means toil and labour. The verse on each line holding the Self line has, for the Pressure line holding the Self line, 'divining about oneself, even if not ill one meets an official case' (LY.ILL.BSQS.04), which agrees with the Huangjin Ce in being on the Pressure line but does not say lifelong illness. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这是《黄金策》身命章（占一个人一生）里「父母持身辛勤劳碌，鬼爻持世疾病缠绵，遇兄则财莫能聚，见子则身不犯刑」一联的第二句；婚姻域收过第三句（LY.MARRY.HJC.105）。「贵人见之不以此断」是说有官位、有贵人命的人遇到官鬼持世，官鬼是他的官，不当作灾病。「带疾」是带着病，指有慢性的、长期的病。
note.en: This is the second line of the couplet in the Huangjin Ce's chapter on the person and fate (on a person's whole life): 'Resource holding the Self line: toil and labour; Pressure holding the Self line: illness lingers; meeting Peer, wealth cannot gather; meeting Output, one does not run into punishment'; the third line was taken in the marriage domain (LY.MARRY.HJC.105). 'If a person of rank meets it, it is not judged this way' means that for a man with an official post or a noble fate, Pressure holding the Self line is his office and is not read as calamity or illness. 'Carrying an illness' means a long-standing, chronic illness.

yi: 鬼爻持世，疾病缠绵不断。
en: With the Pressure line holding the Self line, illness lingers.

zh: 鬼为殃祸，遇之，则一生疾病缠身；
yi: 官鬼是殃祸，遇到它（持世），这一生就疾病缠身；
或者主身上带着病，或者常常招来官司；
如果是贵人遇到它，就不这样断。
en: The ghost is calamity, and meeting it brings illness clinging to the body for a whole life;
either one carries an illness, or often draws a lawsuit;
if a person of rank meets it, it is not judged this way.

zh: 官为祸殃，遇之则主带疾病或招官讼，若贵人并临则贵。
yi: 官鬼是祸殃，遇到它，主带着疾病或者招来官司；如果贵人也同时临上，就是贵。
en: Pressure is calamity; meeting it means carrying illness or drawing a lawsuit, but if a noble star sits on it as well, it means rank.

title: 身命章·正内不利，李密髫龀迍邅（旧注：正卦内三爻乃初限，遇官鬼凶神克战主童年多病）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》身命章说：「正卦的内卦不利，李密儿童时期困顿坎坷。」旧注解释：正卦的内卦三爻是初限（早年）；如果遇到官鬼、凶神来克战，主童年多病，像李密九岁才能走路，是因为幼年多病。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on the person and fate says: 'With the inner trigram of the main hexagram unfavourable, Li Mi's childhood was one of hardship.' The old commentary explains: the inner three lines of the main hexagram are the first period of life; if Pressure or an ominous spirit attacks it, it means many illnesses in childhood, as Li Mi could walk only at nine because he was often ill in his early years.

note.yi: 身命章把一个人的一生分成三限：正卦内三爻是初限（约十五年），正卦外三爻加支卦内三爻是中限，支卦外三爻是末限（旧注 L6059）。这里讲初限遇官鬼凶神，童年多病。王洪绪对同一句的注是「正卦者，卜卦前之事」，把正卦读成卜卦之前的事，没有提到多病，所以没有收他的。李密是晋代人，字令伯，幼年多病，九岁才能走路，是旧注举的例子。
note.en: The chapter on the person and fate divides a person's life into three periods: the inner three lines of the main hexagram are the first period (about fifteen years), the outer three lines of the main hexagram with the inner three of the branch hexagram are the middle period, and the outer three lines of the branch hexagram the last period (the old commentary, line 6059). Here, Pressure or an ominous spirit in the first period means many illnesses in childhood. Wang Hongxu's note on the same line reads 'the main hexagram is what came before the divination' and takes the main hexagram as events before the divination, with no mention of illness, so his note is not taken. Li Mi, of the Jin, courtesy name Lingbo, was often ill as a child and could walk only at nine; he is the old commentary's example.

zh: 正内不利，李密髫龀迍邅；
yi: 正卦内卦不利，李密儿童时期困顿坎坷；
en: With the inner trigram of the main hexagram unfavourable, Li Mi's childhood was one of hardship;

hits.text: 正卦不利，李密髫龄迍邅
正内不利，李密髫龀迍邅

zh: 若逢官鬼凶神克战者，主童年多病。
如李密九岁方能行，盖幼年多疾故也。
yi: 正卦的内卦三爻，是初限（早年）。
如果遇到官鬼、凶神来克战，主童年多病。
比如李密九岁才能走路，是因为幼年多病的缘故。
en: The inner three lines of the main hexagram are the first period of life.
If Pressure or an ominous spirit attacks it, it means many illnesses in childhood.
As Li Mi could walk only at nine, because he was often ill in his early years.

title: 身命章·随官入墓未为有子有孙、助鬼伤身不免多灾多病（占婴孩：世身随官入墓必死、鬼伤克世身刑冲主象必多病、财助鬼大凶、鬼持世临身亦多病）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》身命章占婴孩的一联说：「随官入墓，不算有子有孙；助鬼伤身，免不了多灾多病。」旧注：世爻和身随着官鬼入墓，一定死；鬼伤克世、身，刑冲主象，一定多病，财爻再帮它，是大凶；鬼持世、临身，也主多病。王洪绪：子孙入墓或化官入墓、化官鬼，一定死；鬼伤克兄弟爻、使子孙爻没有根，一定多病难养；财动助鬼克兄，或鬼持世临身，也主多病。
rule.en: A couplet in the Huangjin Ce's chapter on the person and fate, on divining an infant, says: 'Following Pressure into the tomb, one cannot be said to have sons and grandsons; helping the ghost to harm the Body, one cannot escape many calamities and illnesses.' The old commentary: if the Self and Body follow Pressure into the tomb, one is sure to die; if a ghost harms and controls the Self or Body, punishing or clashing the principal image, there is sure to be much illness, and still worse if Wealth helps it; a ghost holding the Self line or sitting on the Body also means much illness. Wang Hongxu: Output entering the tomb, or turning into an officer and entering the tomb, or turning into Pressure, is sure death; a ghost harming and controlling Peer so that Output has no root means much illness and a child hard to raise; Wealth moving to help the ghost control Peer, or a ghost holding the Self line or sitting on the Body, also means much illness.

note.yi: 这一联在身命章里是占婴孩（小孩的造化）的一段，「有子有孙」是说这个孩子立得住、活得成。「随官入墓」「助鬼伤身」和通玄妙论里同名的两节是同一个说法：随官入墓见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.27，助鬼伤身见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.29（那两节讲的是占病）。旧注「刑冲主象」的主象是所占的那一爻，占婴孩时是子孙爻。「世身」是世爻和身。
note.en: This couplet is in a passage of the chapter on the person and fate that divines an infant (a child's fate), and 'having sons and grandsons' says that the child will stand and live. 'Following Pressure into the tomb' and 'helping the ghost to harm the Body' are the same sayings as the two sections of the same names in the Tongxuan Miaolun: following Pressure into the tomb is in LY.ILL.DYTJ.27 and helping the ghost to harm the Body in LY.ILL.DYTJ.29 (those two sections are about divining illness). The 'principal image' of the old commentary is the line being divined, which in divining an infant is the Output line. 'The Self and the Body' are the Self line and the Body.

zh: 随官入墓，未为有子有孙；
助鬼伤身，不免多灾多病。
yi: 随着官鬼入墓，不算有子有孙；
帮着鬼来伤身，免不了多灾多病。
en: Following Pressure into the tomb, one cannot be said to have sons and grandsons;
helping the ghost to harm the Body, one cannot escape many calamities and illnesses.

hits.text: 随官入墓，未为有子有孙
助鬼伤身，不免多灾多病
随官入墓，未为有子有孙
助鬼伤身，不免多灾多病

zh: 卦中若见世身随官入墓者，必死。
若遇鬼伤克世身，刑冲主象者，必然多病。
更逢财爻助之，大凶之兆。
若鬼持世临身，亦主多病。
yi: 卦里如果看到世爻、身随着官鬼入墓，一定死。
所以说：不算有子有孙。
如果遇到鬼爻伤克世爻、身，刑冲主象，一定多病。
再遇到财爻帮它，是大凶的征兆。
如果鬼爻持世、临在身上，也主多病。
en: If in the hexagram the Self and the Body are seen following Pressure into the tomb, one is sure to die.
Hence it says: 'one cannot be said to have sons and grandsons'.
If a ghost harms and controls the Self or the Body, punishing or clashing the principal image, there is sure to be much illness.
If a Wealth line helps it as well, it is a sign of great ill.
If a ghost holds the Self line or sits on the Body, it also means much illness.

zh: 若见子孙入墓，或化官入墓，或化官鬼，必死。
若遇鬼伤克兄弟爻，致子孙爻无根，必然多病难养。
财动助鬼克兄，或鬼持世临身，亦主多病。
yi: 如果看到子孙爻入墓，或者化出官爻入墓，或者化成官鬼，一定死。
所以说「不算有子有孙」。
如果遇到鬼爻伤克兄弟爻，使子孙爻没有根，一定多病、难养。
财爻发动帮助鬼爻去克兄，或者鬼持世、临身，也主多病。
en: If the Output line is seen entering the tomb, or turning into an officer and entering the tomb, or turning into Pressure, one is sure to die.
Hence it says 'one cannot be said to have sons and grandsons'.
If a ghost harms and controls the Peer line so that the Output line has no root, there is sure to be much illness and the child is hard to raise.
If Wealth moves to help the ghost control Peer, or a ghost holds the Self line or sits on the Body, it also means much illness.

title: 身命章·遇令星如风摇干、逢绝地似雨倾花（占婴孩：子孙得地健旺凶神克战无事，死绝之地决难生养）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》身命章占婴孩时说：「遇到令星，像风摇树干；逢到绝地，像雨打落花。」旧注：凡遇凶神来克战，子孙爻得地、健旺，一定无事，即使见一点小小的悔，也像微风摇树干，伤不了它；如果在死绝之地，一定难以生养，一有克战，就像暴雨打花，很少不残败的。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on the person and fate says, on divining an infant: 'Meeting the ruling star is like wind shaking a trunk; meeting a place of extinction is like rain beating down flowers.' The old commentary: whenever an ominous spirit attacks, if the Output line holds its ground and is strong, nothing will happen, and even with a slight regret it is like a light breeze shaking a trunk and cannot harm it; if it is in a place of death or extinction, it can hardly be reared, and once attacked it is like a sudden rain beating down flowers, and few escape ruin.

note.yi: 「令星」是月建（当令的那个支），所以「遇令星」是子孙爻值月建，得时。「风摇干」「雨倾花」是比喻：前者树干不动，后者花被打落。这一段在身命章占婴孩的几联之间，讲的是孩子养不养得活，所以放在疾病域的生死里。王洪绪的注加了一个条件：是父母发动克子孙的时候。
note.en: The 'ruling star' is the Month branch (the branch that rules the month), so 'meeting the ruling star' is the Output line standing on the Month branch, in season. 'Wind shaking a trunk' and 'rain beating down flowers' are comparisons: in the first the trunk does not move, in the second the flowers are beaten down. The passage stands among the couplets on divining an infant in the chapter on the person and fate and is about whether the child can be raised, which is why it is placed under life and death in the illness domain. Wang Hongxu's note adds a condition: it is when Resource moves to control Output.

yi: 遇到令星，像风摇树干；
逢到绝地，像雨打落花。
en: Meeting the ruling star is like wind shaking a trunk;
meeting a place of extinction is like rain beating down flowers.

zh: 凡遇凶神克战，若得子孙得地健旺，则必无事；
虽见小悔，犹微风摇干，必不能伤。
若在死绝之地，决难生养；
一有克战，则如骤雨倾花，鲜不残败。
yi: 凡是遇到凶神来克战，如果子孙爻得地、健旺，就一定没事；
即使见到一点小小的悔，也像微风摇动树干，一定伤不了它。
如果在死绝的地方，一定难以生养；
一旦有克战，就像暴雨打花，很少不残败的。
en: Whenever an ominous spirit attacks, if the Output line holds its ground and is strong, nothing will happen;
even if a slight regret appears, it is like a light breeze shaking a trunk and surely cannot harm it.
If it is in a place of death or extinction, it can hardly be reared;
once it is attacked, it is like a sudden rain beating down flowers, and few escape ruin.

zh: 凡父母动克子，若得子孙值日辰月建，虽见小晦，犹微风摇干无妨；
若逢墓绝有克战，如骤雨倾花有损。
yi: 凡是父母爻发动克子孙，如果子孙爻值着日辰、月建，即使见到一点小小的晦暗，也像微风摇动树干，没有妨碍；
如果遇到墓绝又有克战，就像暴雨打花，有损伤。
en: Whenever the Resource line moves to control Output, if Output holds the Day or the Month branch, even with a slight dimming it is like a light breeze shaking a trunk and does no harm;
if it meets tomb and extinction with attack besides, it is like a sudden rain beating down flowers, and there is damage.

title: 身命章·子孙化鬼，孝殇十月入冥途；禄贵临爻，拜住童年登相位（旧注：子化出鬼乃九死一生之兆，贵人禄马旺相则异日必贵）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》身命章占婴孩时说：「子孙化成鬼，像汉殇帝才十个月就走进了冥途；禄、贵人临在爻上，像元朝的拜住童年就登上相位。」旧注：子孙爻化出鬼爻，是九死一生的征兆；如果贵人、禄马一起临上、子孙又旺相，将来必定显贵；子孙遇凶而化鬼，是说孩子自己化成了鬼，所以凶，遇吉而化官，是化成了官，所以吉。王洪绪：子孙休囚，化鬼或化父母，都是死的征兆。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on the person and fate says, on divining an infant: 'Output turning into a ghost: Emperor Shang of Han went to the underworld at ten months; Salary and the Noble on the line: Baizhu rose to minister in childhood.' The old commentary: the Output line turning into a ghost line is a sign of nine deaths to one life; if the Noble, Salary and Horse all sit on it and Output is strong, he will surely be eminent one day; when Output meets ill and turns into a ghost, the child himself has turned into a ghost, hence ill, and when it meets good and turns into an officer, he has turned into an officer, hence good. Wang Hongxu: Output resting or confined and turning into a ghost or into Resource is a sign of death.

note.yi: 汉殇帝（刘隆）生后一百多天即位，不满一岁就死；拜住是元朝人，十四岁做了宰相。「九死一生」是九分死、一分生，不是必死；旧注接着讲了活的条件（贵人禄马交临、子孙旺相）。王洪绪的版本把「休囚」和「化父」也算进去：子孙休囚、化鬼或化父母，都是死的征兆；旺相又带贵人禄马才像拜住。两处说的是同一件事，条件讲得略有不同。
note.en: Emperor Shang of Han (Liu Long) took the throne a little over a hundred days after birth and died before he was a year old; Baizhu was a man of the Yuan who became minister at fourteen. 'Nine deaths to one life' is nine parts death and one part life, not certain death; the old commentary goes on to give the conditions for life (the Noble, Salary and Horse all on it, and Output strong). Wang Hongxu's version counts 'resting or confined' and 'turning into Resource' as well: Output resting or confined and turning into a ghost or into Resource are signs of death, and only when it is strong and carries the Noble, Salary and Horse is it like Baizhu. The two say the same thing with slightly different conditions.

zh: 子孙化鬼，孝殇十月入冥途；
禄贵临爻，拜住童年登相位。
yi: 子孙化成鬼，像汉殇帝才十个月就走进了冥途；
禄、贵人临在爻上，像元朝的拜住，童年就登上相位。
en: Output turning into a ghost: Emperor Shang of Han went down the road to the underworld at ten months;
Salary and the Noble on the line: Baizhu of the Yuan rose to be minister in childhood.

hits.text: 子孙化鬼，孝殇十月入冥途
禄贵临爻，拜住童年登相位
子孙化鬼，孝殇十月入冥途
禄贵临爻，拜住童年登相位

zh: 子化出鬼，乃九死一生之兆。
如汉殇帝，生才十月即死也。
子化出鬼，而贵人禄马交临，子又旺相，异日必贵。
如元拜住，年十四即为相也。
盖子逢凶而化鬼，谓身化为鬼，故凶；
子逢吉而化官，谓身化为官，故吉。
yi: 子孙爻化出鬼爻，是九死一生的征兆。
比如汉殇帝，生下来才十个月就死了。
子孙化出鬼爻，但是贵人、禄、马一同临上，子孙又旺相，将来一定显贵。
比如元朝的拜住，十四岁就做了宰相。
因为子孙遇凶而化成鬼，是说孩子自己化成了鬼，所以凶；
子孙遇吉而化成官，是说自己化成了官，所以吉。
en: The Output line turning into a ghost line is a sign of nine deaths to one life.
As Emperor Shang of Han, who died when barely ten months old.
If Output turns into a ghost line but the Noble, Salary and Horse all sit on it and Output is strong, he will surely become eminent.
As Baizhu of the Yuan, who became minister at fourteen.
For when Output meets ill and turns into a ghost, it means the child himself has turned into a ghost, hence ill;
when Output meets good and turns into an officer, it means he himself has turned into an officer, hence good.

zh: 子孙休囚化鬼化父，皆死之兆，似汉殇帝生才十月即亡；
若临贵人禄马旺相，如元拜住年十四即为相。
yi: 子孙爻休囚，又化成鬼爻或父母爻，都是死的征兆，像汉殇帝才生十个月就死了；
如果临着贵人、禄、马又旺相，就像元朝的拜住，十四岁就做了宰相。
en: Output resting or confined and turning into a ghost or into Resource, all are signs of death, like Emperor Shang of Han, who died when barely ten months old;
if it sits on the Noble, Salary and Horse and is strong, it is like Baizhu of the Yuan, who became minister at fourteen.

title: 家宅章·内三爻为宅、外三爻为人，宅去克人主病患连年、击括多端；人去克宅主修居创屋（王洪绪：内卦二爻克五爻谓宅去克人凶）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》家宅章说：「要看卦爻的内外，才能知道人和宅的兴衰。」旧注：内三爻是宅，外三爻是人；宅去克人，主病患连年，多有吵闹骚扰；人去克宅，主修缮住房、创建房屋、整旧更新。王洪绪：内卦第二爻克外卦第五爻，叫宅去克人，凶；外卦五爻克二爻，叫人来克宅，吉；内卦二爻生五爻，叫宅去生人，吉。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on the household says: 'Look at the inner and outer of the lines to know the rise and fall of the people and the house.' The old commentary: the inner three lines are the house and the outer three the people; when the house controls the people, it means years of illness and disturbances of many kinds; when the people control the house, it means repairing a dwelling or building a house, mending the old and renewing. Wang Hongxu: the second line of the inner trigram controlling the fifth line of the outer trigram is called the house controlling the people, ominous; the fifth line of the outer trigram controlling the second is called the people controlling the house, auspicious; the second line of the inner trigram generating the fifth is called the house generating the people, auspicious.

dispute.yi: 宅和人各取哪几爻，两家不一样。《黄金策》旧注是「内三爻为宅，外三爻为人」（整个内卦是宅、整个外卦是人）；王洪绪是「内卦第二爻为宅舍，外卦第五爻为人口」（各取一爻）。宅去克人，旧注点明是「病患连年」，王洪绪只说「凶」，没有点名是病。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The two commentaries take different lines for the house and the people. The old commentary of the Huangjin Ce has 'the inner three lines are the house and the outer three lines the people' (the whole inner trigram is the house and the whole outer trigram the people); Wang Hongxu has 'the second line of the inner trigram is the dwelling and the fifth line of the outer trigram is the household members' (one line each). On the house controlling the people, the old commentary names 'years of illness', while Wang Hongxu says only 'ominous' without naming illness. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 「击括」二字照原文，指吵闹、骚扰一类的事（柳神经里也有「家门括扰」），译文写作「disturbances」；这里不另作解释。同一章千金赋后面还有一联「丧门加白虎，须忧疾病丧亡」（LY.ILL.HJC.127）。
note.en: The two characters rendered 'disturbances' are kept as in the text and mean clamour and trouble of that kind (the Liushen Jing also has 'the gate of the house is troubled'); no further explanation is given here. A later couplet of the same rhapsody has 'the Mourning Gate with the White Tiger: beware of illness and death' (LY.ILL.HJC.127).

zh: 要察卦爻内外，可知人宅兴衰。
yi: 要看卦爻的内外，才能知道人和宅的兴衰。
en: Look at the inner and outer of the lines to know the rise and fall of the people and the house.

hits.text: 要察卦爻内外，可知人宅兴衰

zh: 内三爻为宅，外三爻为人。
宅去克人，主病患连年，击括多端；
人去克宅，主修居创屋，整旧更新。
yi: 内三爻是宅，外三爻是人。
宅去克人，主病患连年，吵闹骚扰多端；
人去克宅，主修缮住房、创建房屋，整治旧的、更新。
en: The inner three lines are the house, the outer three lines are the people.
When the house controls the people, it means years of illness and disturbances of many kinds;
when the people control the house, it means repairing a dwelling or building a house, mending the old and renewing.

zh: 凡内卦二爻克五爻，谓宅去克人，凶；
或外卦五爻克二爻，谓之人来克宅，吉。
或内卦二爻生五爻，谓宅去生人，吉。
yi: 凡是内卦第二爻克第五爻，叫宅去克人，凶；
或者外卦第五爻克第二爻，叫人来克宅，吉。
或者内卦第二爻生第五爻，叫宅去生人，吉。
en: When the second line of the inner trigram controls the fifth, it is called the house controlling the people, ominous;
or when the fifth line of the outer trigram controls the second, it is called the people controlling the house, auspicious.
or when the second line of the inner trigram generates the fifth, it is called the house generating the people, auspicious.

title: 家宅章·丧门加白虎，须忧疾病丧亡（旧注：丧门、白虎谓之四利三元，乃凶神，此爻动则病患连绵、丧亡叠至）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》家宅章说：「丧门星加上白虎星，要担忧疾病和丧亡。」旧注：丧门、白虎叫作「四利三元」，是凶神，见后面凶煞一节；如果见到这一爻发动，就有病患连绵、丧亡接连而来，种种不吉祥，要仔细审察。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on the household says: 'The Mourning Gate joined by the White Tiger: beware of illness and death.' The old commentary: the Mourning Gate and the White Tiger are called the 'Four Gains and Three Origins' and are ominous spirits, to be seen below among the ominous killings; if this line is seen moving, there is illness dragging on, deaths following one on another and all kinds of ill omens, to be examined with care.

note.yi: 「四利三元」这个名目也在断易天机里出现（LY.ILL.DYTJ.50），那里是一份十二位的流年神煞名单，丧门排第三、白虎排第九；旧注这里把丧门、白虎两颗叫作四利三元。这里的白虎是流年神煞里的白虎，不是六神里的白虎；卜筮全书的岁前神煞（LY.ILL.BSQS.51）里也有它（第九位）。经文这一联的前一半「月建会青龙，当主婚姻妊喜」讲喜事，不收。
note.en: The name 'Four Gains and Three Origins' also appears in the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.DYTJ.50), where it heads a list of twelve year-stars with the Mourning Gate third and the White Tiger ninth; the old commentary here calls the Mourning Gate and the White Tiger the Four Gains and Three Origins. The White Tiger here is the White Tiger among the year-stars, not the one among the six spirits; it is also in the stars before the Year in the Bushi Quanshu (LY.ILL.BSQS.51, the ninth place). The first half of this couplet in the text, 'the Month meeting the Azure Dragon: surely marriage and the joy of pregnancy', is about joy and is not taken.

zh: 丧门加白虎，须忧疾病丧亡。
yi: 丧门星加上白虎星，要担忧疾病和丧亡。
en: With the Mourning Gate joined by the White Tiger, one must worry about illness and death.

hits.text: 丧门加白虎，须优疾病丧亡

zh: 丧门、白虎：谓之四利三元，乃凶神。
若见此爻动者，则有病患连绵，丧亡叠至，种种不祥，自当细审。
yi: 丧门、白虎，叫作「四利三元」，是凶神。
见后面凶煞一节。
如果见到这一爻发动，就有病患连绵、丧亡接连而来、种种不吉祥，自然要仔细审察。
en: The Mourning Gate and the White Tiger are called the 'Four Gains and Three Origins' and are ominous spirits.
See below among the ominous killings.
If this line is seen moving, there is illness dragging on, deaths following one on another and all kinds of ill omens, to be examined with care.

title: 出行章·鬼临飞位未离门户费趦趄（旧注：鬼加白虎、丧门、吊客、死符、病符，恐有丧亡疾病之事）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》出行章说：「鬼临在飞爻的位置，还没离开门户就迟疑不前。」旧注解释：官鬼加上白虎、丧门、吊客、死符、病符这些星，恐怕有丧亡、疾病的事。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on travel says: 'With the ghost on the flying place, one has not yet left the door and hesitates.' The old commentary explains: Pressure joined by the White Tiger, Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, Death Tally or Sickness Tally may bring a death or an illness.

note.yi: 这是占出行（出远门）一章的旧注，说的是官鬼带着凶星时，出行的人可能遇到丧事或生病。白虎、丧门、吊客、死符、病符都是流年神煞（LY.ILL.DYTJ.50、LY.ILL.BSQS.51 里有名单）；「飞位」是飞神所在的位置。整段旧注的前后讲的是鬼持世、鬼带贵人、鬼加官符朱雀（官事牵连），这里只收讲病的一句。
note.en: This is an old commentary in the chapter on travel (going far from home), saying that when Pressure carries ominous stars the traveller may meet a death or fall ill. The White Tiger, Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, Death Tally and Sickness Tally are year-stars (they are listed in LY.ILL.DYTJ.50 and LY.ILL.BSQS.51); the 'flying place' is where the flying line stands. The passages before and after the old commentary are about the ghost holding the Self line, the ghost carrying a noble star and the ghost with the Official Tally and Vermilion Bird (entanglement in official matters); only the sentence on illness is taken here.

zh: 鬼临飞位，未离门户费趦趄。
yi: 鬼爻临在飞位，还没离开门户就迟疑不前。
en: With the ghost on the flying place, one has not yet left the door and hesitates.

hits.text: 鬼临飞位，未离门户费趔趄
鬼临飞位，未离门户费趔趄

zh: 鬼加白虎、丧门、吊客、死符、病符，恐有丧亡疾病之事。
yi: 官鬼加上白虎、丧门、吊客、死符、病符，恐怕有丧亡、疾病的事。
en: Pressure joined by the White Tiger, Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, Death Tally or Sickness Tally may bring a death or an illness.

title: 总断千金赋·化病兮伤损（旧注：病即长生对冲之神，主象化出病爻则凡事有损，占病未痊；王洪绪：十二长生里只有长生墓绝三件要紧，不可死守「病主伤损」）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》总断千金赋说：「化成病，就有伤损。」旧注：「病」是和长生相冲的那一位；所占的主象化出病爻，凡事都有损伤：占病，病没有好；占物，不合意；占药，无效；占文书，有破绽；占行人，没有回来；占身命，带着病；占妇人，一定不贞洁；占容貌，一定有破相；所以叫伤损。王洪绪提醒：十二长生里卦中只有长生、墓、绝三件要紧，其余各位都按生克冲合、进退神、伏吟反吟来论，不可死抱着「病主伤损」。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements says: 'Turning into Illness, there is damage.' The old commentary: 'Illness' is the spirit that clashes the Birth stage; when the principal image being divined turns into the Illness line, all affairs suffer damage: in divining illness, the illness is not cured; a thing, it is not right; medicine, it is ineffective; documents, there is a flaw; a traveller, he has not returned; one's person and fate, one carries illness; a woman, she is surely not chaste; looks, there is surely a blemish; hence it is called damage. Wang Hongxu cautions: of the twelve stages of life only Birth, Tomb and Extinction matter in a hexagram, and the others are all to be judged by generation, control, clash and combination, advancing and retreating spirit, Hidden Chant and Reversed Chant, so one must not cling to 'Illness means damage'.

dispute.yi: 「化病主伤损」能不能一概而论，两家看法不同。旧注把它当成通则：主象化出病（长生的对冲），凡事有损，占病未痊、占药无效、占行人未回等；王洪绪提醒：十二长生里，卦中只有长生、墓、绝三件要紧，其余各位（病在内）都要按生克冲合、进退神、伏吟反吟来论，不可死抱着「病主伤损」。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The two commentaries differ on whether 'turning into Illness means damage' holds in every case. The old commentary takes it as a general rule: the principal image turning into Illness (the clash of Birth) damages everything, with the illness not cured, medicine ineffective, the traveller not returned and so on; Wang Hongxu cautions that of the twelve stages of life only Birth, Tomb and Extinction matter in a hexagram, and the rest (Illness among them) must be judged by generation, control, clash and combination, advancing and retreating spirit, Hidden Chant and Reversed Chant, without clinging to 'Illness means damage'. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这里的「病」是十二长生里的一位（长生、沐浴、冠带、临官、帝旺、衰、病、死、墓、绝、胎、养），不是疾病；旧注说它是「长生对冲之神」，按十二长生的顺序，病正好在长生的对面。「化病」是动爻变出来的那个地支落在所占五行的「病」位上。占病只是旧注一连串应用里的一条（占病未痊），所以放在「动变」里。同一联的下一句「化胎兮勾连」与病无关，没有收。
note.en: The 'Illness' here is one stage of the twelve stages of life (Birth, Bathing, Capping, Official Post, Peak, Decline, Illness, Death, Tomb, Extinction, Womb, Nurture), not a disease; the old commentary calls it 'the spirit that clashes Birth', and in the order of the twelve stages Illness stands exactly opposite Birth. 'Turning into Illness' is the branch a moving line changes into falling on the Illness stage of the element being divined. Divining illness is only one of a run of applications in the old commentary (the illness is not cured), which is why it is placed under moving lines and what they turn into. The next line of the same couplet, 'turning into Womb: entanglement', has nothing to do with illness and is not taken.

yi: 化成「病」这一位，就有伤损，
en: Turning into the Illness stage, there is damage,

zh: 主象化出病爻，凡事有损。
yi: 「病」，就是和长生相冲的那位神。
所占的主象化出病爻，凡事都有损伤。
占病，病没有好；
占物，不合意；
占药，没有效；
占文书，有破绽；
占行人，还没有回来；
占身命，带着病；
占妇人，一定不贞洁；
占容貌，一定有破相。
所以说伤损。
en: 'Illness' is the spirit opposite, clashing, the Birth stage.
When the principal image being divined turns into the Illness line, all affairs suffer damage.
In divining illness, the illness is not cured;
in divining a thing, it is not right;
in divining medicine, it is ineffective;
in divining documents, there is a flaw;
in divining a traveller, he has not returned;
in divining one's person and fate, one carries illness;
in divining a woman, she is surely not chaste;
in divining looks, there is surely a blemish.
Hence it is called damage.

zh: 长生、沐浴、冠带、临官、帝旺、衰、病、死、墓、绝、胎、养，此十二神，卦中唯是长生、墓、绝三件，卦卦看，爻爻要查，其余沐浴、冠带、临官、帝旺、衰、病、死、胎、养各神，俱各有生克冲合、进神退神、伏吟反吟论，不可执疑于养主狐疑，病主伤损，胎主勾连。
《十八论》内已明论之，学者宜自详辨。
yi: 长生、沐浴、冠带、临官、帝旺、衰、病、死、墓、绝、胎、养，这十二位，卦中只有长生、墓、绝三件，每一卦都要看，每一爻都要查；其余沐浴、冠带、临官、帝旺、衰、病、死、胎、养各位，都各有生克冲合、进神退神、伏吟反吟的论法，不可以死抱着「养主狐疑，病主伤损，胎主勾连」不放。
《十八论》里已经讲明白了，学的人应当自己详细辨别。
en: Birth, Bathing, Capping, Official Post, Peak, Decline, Illness, Death, Tomb, Extinction, Womb and Nurture: of these twelve spirits only three matter in a hexagram, Birth, Tomb and Extinction, to be looked at in every hexagram and checked on every line; the others, Bathing, Capping, Official Post, Peak, Decline, Illness, Death, Womb and Nurture, are each discussed by generation, control, clash and combination, Advancing spirit and Retreating spirit, Hidden Chant and Reversed Chant, and one must not cling to 'Nurture means doubt, Illness means damage, Womb means entanglement'.
The Eighteen Discussions have already set it out plainly, and the student should tell them apart in detail himself.

title: 总断千金赋·刑害不宜临用（旧注：刑爻为主象占病病必死、占人人有疾；王洪绪：占病沉重、占人有病）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》总断千金赋说：「刑和害不适宜临在用爻上。」旧注：凡是刑爻成为主象，一定不利：占事，事不成；占物，物不好；占病，病一定死；占人，这个人有病；占妇人，一定不贞洁；占文书，一定有破绽；占官司，有利也一定有罪责；害爻成为主象，也一定坏事，大致和刑爻相似，化入的也一样，但要按衰旺分它的轻重。王洪绪：用神、身、世遇到日辰相刑，一定不利，占病是病沉重，占人是有病。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements says: 'Punishment and harm should not fall on the Subject.' The old commentary: whenever a punishing line becomes the principal image it is sure to be unfavourable: an affair does not come to completion, a thing is not good, in illness the illness is sure to be fatal, in divining a person the person is ill, a woman is surely not chaste, documents are sure to have a flaw, a lawsuit brings blame even with a gain; a harming line as the principal image surely spoils things too, much like a punishing line, and so too one that is changed into, but its weight must be told by strength and weakness. Wang Hongxu: when the Subject, Body or Self meets a Day branch that punishes it, it is sure to be unfavourable, in illness the illness is grave, and in divining a person he is ill.

dispute.yi: 刑爻为主象，占病断到什么程度，两家不同。旧注说「占病病必死」；王洪绪说「占病沉重」（病重，没有说死）。两处都说占人是「人有疾（有病）」，都要再按衰旺分轻重。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The two commentaries differ on how far to take illness when a punishing line is the principal image. The old commentary says 'in divining illness the illness is sure to be fatal'; Wang Hongxu says 'in divining illness the illness is grave' (grave, without saying death). Both say that in divining a person he is ill, and both say to tell the weight by strength and weakness. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 「主象」是所占的那一爻（占病时是用神）。「刑」是三刑一类的相刑，「害」是六害。王洪绪的这一句后面还有一句「死绝于日辰之爻临持世身用神者，诸占不利，变动化入」，原文到「变动化入」就断了，不收。原文写「刑害不宜临用」的下一句是「死绝岂可持身」，是另一联。
note.en: The 'principal image' is the line being divined (in divining illness, the Subject). 'Punishment' is the mutual punishment of the three-punishment kind, and 'harm' is the six harms. Wang Hongxu's text goes on with another sentence, 'a line of death or extinction by the Day branch sitting on the Self, Body or Subject: no divination is favourable, in moving and changing into', but the text breaks off at 'in moving and changing into' and it is not taken. The next line after 'punishment and harm should not fall on the Subject' in the text is 'death and extinction, how can they hold the Body', which is another couplet.

yi: 刑和害不适宜临在用爻上，
en: Punishment and harm should not fall on the Subject,

zh: 凡遇刑爻为主象，必主不利。
占事事不成，占物物不好，占病病必死，占人人有疾，占妇人必不贞洁，占文书必有破绽，占讼利必有罪责。
yi: 凡是遇到刑爻成为主象，一定主不利。
占事，事不成；占物，物不好；占病，病一定死；占人，这个人有病；占妇人，一定不贞洁；占文书，一定有破绽；占官司，有利也一定有罪责。
en: Whenever a punishing line becomes the principal image, it is sure to be unfavourable.

In divining an affair, it does not come to completion; a thing, it is not good; illness, the illness is sure to be fatal; a person, the person is ill; a woman, she is surely not chaste; documents, there is sure to be a flaw; a lawsuit, even a gain brings blame.

zh: 然又须以衰旺分其轻重详之。
yi: 害爻成为主象，一定坏事。
大致和刑爻相似。
（变）化入的也是这样。
但又必须按衰旺来分它的轻重，仔细审察。
en: A harming line as the principal image surely spoils things.
It is much like a punishing line.
So too one that is changed into.
But one must also tell its weight by strength and weakness, and examine it in detail.

zh: 凡用神、身、世遇日辰相刑，必主不利，占事不成，占物不好，占病沉重，占人有病，占妇不贞，占文卷必破绽，占讼有刑害。
动爻不过坏事，大概相仿，化者亦然，须推衰旺生克，分其轻重详之。
yi: 凡是用神、身、世遇到日辰相刑，一定主不利：占事，事不成；占物，物不好；占病，病沉重；占人，有病；占妇人，不贞；占文卷，必有破绽；占官司，有刑害。
动爻不过是坏事，大致相仿，（变）化出来的也一样，要推衰旺生克，分它的轻重，仔细审察。
en: Whenever the Subject, the Body or the Self meets a Day branch that punishes it, it is sure to be unfavourable: an affair does not come to completion, a thing is not good, in illness the illness is grave, in divining a person he is ill, a woman is unchaste, a document is sure to have a flaw, a lawsuit brings punishment and harm.
A moving line brings only spoilt affairs, much the same, and so does one that is changed into; one must reckon strength, weakness, generation and control, tell its weight, and examine it in detail.

title: 总断千金赋·疾病大宜天喜，若临凶杀必生悲（旧注：天喜吉星，占病遇之虽大象凶恶不以死断，临所忌之爻动则以为悲）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》总断千金赋说：「疾病最适宜见天喜，如果天喜临在凶杀上，一定生出悲伤。」旧注：天喜是吉星，占病遇到它，即使整个卦象凶恶，也不按死来断，因为它是喜神；如果它临在所忌的爻上发动，就认为是悲，不认为是喜。王洪绪的说法一样，把「所忌的爻」写成「忌神」。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements says: 'For illness the Tianxi star is greatly helpful, but if it sits on an ominous killing there is sure to be grief.' The old commentary: the Tianxi star is a lucky star, and in divining illness, meeting it, even if the whole image is ominous one does not judge death, because it is a spirit of joy; if it sits on a taboo line and moves, I take it as grief and not as joy. Wang Hongxu says the same, writing the 'taboo line' as the Adversary.

note.yi: 这一句是总断千金赋里一连串「神煞要看它临在哪一爻」的例子之一：同一联接着讲往亡（出行最怕往亡，如系吉神终获利）。旧注、王洪绪借它说明「神煞之权轻而五行之权重」：神煞吉凶要看它临的是喜爻还是忌爻。所以天喜对占病是好东西，但天喜临在忌神（克用神的那一类）上发动，反而是悲。原文「凶杀」「凶煞」是同一个字的两种写法。「天喜」这颗星婚姻域也出现过（LY.MARRY.HJC.107 里的天喜星）。
note.en: This sentence is one of a run of examples in the Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements of 'a spirit-star must be looked at for the line it sits on': the same couplet goes on to the Fleeing Death star (for travel the Fleeing Death star is feared most, but if it is a lucky spirit one finally gains). The old commentary and Wang Hongxu use it to show that 'the power of spirit-stars is light and that of the five elements heavy': whether a spirit-star is good or ill depends on whether it sits on a line one welcomes or one that is a taboo. So the Tianxi star is good for illness, but when it sits on the Adversary (the kind of line that controls the Subject) and moves, it is grief instead. 'Ominous killing' and 'ominous killing' are two writings of the same word in the text. The Tianxi star also appeared in the marriage domain (the Tianxi star in LY.MARRY.HJC.107).

en: Illness is greatly helped by the Tianxi star, but if it sits on an ominous killing there is sure to be grief;

title: 年时·更嫌值土，千门疫疠若符同（旧注：土鬼发动其年多瘟疫，生旺为甚，在艮宫动瘴气亦重，克世人多疫死，鬼带白虎亦是瘟疫之兆）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》年时章（占一年的事）说：「更嫌遇到土（鬼），千家万户的疫病就像符契一样相同。」旧注：土鬼发动，这一年多瘟疫，生旺的更厉害，休囚的稍轻；在艮宫发动，瘴气也重；克世爻，人多死于疫病，世爻克它就不妨；鬼带白虎，也是瘟疫的征兆。王洪绪：土鬼发动，或者临白虎，都主瘟疫，如果克世，人多病死，有制伏就不妨。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on the year (divining a whole year) says: 'Still worse if it meets Earth: the epidemics in a thousand households tally as one.' The old commentary: an Earth ghost moving, the year has many epidemics, worse if strong and thriving, lighter if resting or confined; moving in the Gen palace, the miasma is heavy too; controlling the Self line, many people die of the epidemic, but if the Self line controls it, it does no harm; a ghost carrying the White Tiger is also a sign of epidemic. Wang Hongxu: an Earth ghost moving, or sitting on the White Tiger, both mean epidemic; if it controls the Self line many people fall ill and die, but if it is restrained, no harm.

note.yi: 这是占流年（一年的吉凶）一章里讲时疫的一联，看的是这一年的气运，不是占一个人的病。「千门疫疠若符同」是千家万户的疫病像合符契一样一样。「瘴气」是南方山林湿热之地的恶气，艮宫（山）发动特别重。同一章里讲鬼的其他联（旱蝗、火灾、雷）不收。
note.en: This couplet in the chapter on divining the year speaks of epidemics, and what is read is the year's fortune, not a single person's illness. 'The epidemics in a thousand households tally as one' says the epidemics in thousands of households match like the two halves of a tally. 'Miasma' is the bad air of the hot, damp mountains and forests of the south, and it is particularly heavy when Gen (the mountain) moves. The other couplets on the ghost in the same chapter (drought and locusts, fire, thunder) are not taken.

en: Still worse if it meets Earth: the epidemics in a thousand households tally as one.
