zh: 大抵成卦之后，先看卦身现与不现；
与月建、日辰、动爻，有无干涉，则吉凶便见。
故卜易以身为最要，而不可不看者也。
且如占得困卦：身爻在午。
yi: 身，就是月卦身。
它的取法和口诀，见第一卷。
大致成卦以后，先看卦身出现不出现；
和月建、日辰、动爻有没有牵涉，吉凶就显出来了。
所以卜易以身为最要紧，不可不看。
比如占得困卦：身爻在午。
在兑宫里，午火是官鬼；
旺就是官非，衰就是疾病。
en: The Body is the Body of the month's hexagram.
Its method and rhyme are in the first volume.
In general, after the hexagram is formed, first see whether the Body appears or not;
and whether it bears on the Month, the Day or the moving lines; then good and ill show.
Therefore in divining the Changes the Body is the most important, and one must look at it.
For example, if the Kun (Confinement) hexagram is obtained: the Body line is at Wu.
In the Dui palace Wu Fire is Pressure;
if strong it means official trouble, if weak it means illness.

zh: 身即月卦身也，“阳世则从子月起，阴世还从午月生”，其法见《启蒙节要》篇内。
大抵成卦之后，看卦身现与不现，与月建、日辰、动爻有无干涉，则吉凶便知。
占事为事体，占为为人身，唯喜生扶拱合，不宜克害刑冲。
凡占向以身为占事之主，故曰“最要”也。
yi: 身就是月卦身，「阳世从子月起，阴世还从午月生」，它的取法见《启蒙节要》篇里。
大致成卦以后，看卦身出现不出现，和月建、日辰、动爻有没有牵涉，吉凶就知道了。
占事就是事体，占人就是人身，只喜欢生扶拱合，不适宜克害刑冲。
凡是占卜向来以身作为占事的主，所以说「最要」。
en: The Body is the Body of the month's hexagram: 'with a yang Self it starts from the Zi month, with a yin Self it again begins from the Wu month'; its method is in the 'Essentials of the Enlightenment' chapter.
In general, after the hexagram is formed, look at whether the Body appears and whether it bears on the Month, the Day or the moving lines, and good and ill are known.

In divining an affair it is the matter itself, in divining a person it is the person's body; it only welcomes generation, support, flanking and combination, and does not suit control, harm, punishment and clash.
In all divination the Body has always been taken as the master of the matter, and so it is called 'the most important'.

title: 总断千金赋·无故勿空（旧注：身世主象无故自落空亡大凶，占病必死；王洪绪：「故」是受伤，无故之空不可当真空，旧注误解）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》总断千金赋说「无故勿空」四个字，两家读法相反。旧注：旬里的空亡，有有缘故而空的、有没有缘故而空的；被日、月、动爻伤克而落在空亡，叫有缘故而空，避开它是可以的；如果没有刑冲克害、身世主象自己落了空亡，叫没有缘故而空，是大凶的兆头：占病必死，占事不成，占人有难，因为空了，即使有日辰、动爻也难以扶持救援。王洪绪：「故」是受伤的意思，「勿」要当「不」讲；旬空的爻若安静又被月建日辰克制，是有伤的空，到底是无用的空；若是没有被月建日辰克伤，或者发动、或得月日动爻生扶拱合冲起，这是无故之空，出旬、值日、得合的时候仍然能办事，不可当真空论；旧注把意思弄反了。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements has the four characters 'wu gu wu kong', which the two commentators read in opposite ways. The old commentary: of Void within the ten-day cycle some is Void with a cause and some Void without cause; a line hurt or controlled by the Day, the Month or a moving line and in Void is Void with a cause, and avoiding the harm in this way is acceptable; if there is no punishment, clash, control or harm and the Body, Self or principal image falls into Void by itself, it is Void without cause, a greatly ominous omen: in divining illness the sick will surely die, an affair does not come to completion, a person is in trouble, for when it is Void, even the Day and moving lines can hardly support or rescue. Wang Hongxu: 'cause' means being hurt, and 'do not' must be read as 'not'; a line in the ten-day Void that is still and controlled by the Month and Day is Void with injury, in the end a useless Void; one that has not been hurt by the Month or Day, or that moves, or is supported, flanked, combined or clashed into motion by the Month, Day or a moving line, is Void without cause, and when it comes out of the cycle, when the Day falls on it, or when it gets a combination, it can still do its work, and is not to be judged as truly Void; the old commentary has the sense backwards.

dispute.yi: 「无故勿空」四个字怎么读，旧注和王洪绪相反。旧注：没有被刑冲克害、身世主象自己落空的，是「无故而空」，是大凶，占病必死；被日月动爻伤克而落空的，是「有故而空」，是避凶，可以。王洪绪：「故」是受伤的意思，没有被月建日辰克伤的旬空，才是「无故之空」，它不能当真空论，出旬、值日、得合时仍然有用；被克伤的旬空才是无用的空；他明说旧注把意思弄反了。书里没有裁决，也就是说：一个不受伤、自己落空的主象，旧注断凶（占病必死），王洪绪断不算真空。
dispute.en: The old commentary and Wang Hongxu read the four characters 'wu gu wu kong' in opposite ways. The old commentary: a principal image that is not hurt by punishment, clash, control or harm and falls Void by itself is 'Void without cause', greatly ominous, and in divining illness the sick will surely die; one hurt or controlled by the Day, the Month or a moving line and then falling Void is 'Void with a cause', which is avoiding ill, and acceptable. Wang Hongxu: 'cause' means being hurt; only a ten-day Void not hurt by the Month and Day is 'Void without cause', which is not to be judged as truly Void and is still useful when it comes out of the cycle, when the Day falls on it or when it gets a combination; it is the ten-day Void that is hurt that is the useless Void; and he says outright that the old commentary has the sense backwards. The books do not decide: a principal image not hurt and Void by itself the old commentary judges ominous (in illness, death), and Wang Hongxu judges it not truly Void.

note.yi: 原文只有「无故勿空」四个字，没有标点以外的说明，所以两家的读法都说得通：旧注读成「没有缘故的空要不得」，王洪绪读成「没有缘故（没受伤）的空不算空」。经文翻成「Without cause， do not be Void」是照字面，保持两种读法都成立。「真空」「避凶而空」是旧注在紧接的「卦遇凶星，避之则吉」里的用语（LY.ILL.HJC.156）。「先天」指易的本来道理。「旬空」是起卦的那一旬里轮空的两个地支；三合局在王洪绪这里是来克的一方（会局克用神）。本库在疾病域收这一条，因为旧注给了「占病必死」这个断语；和天玄赋、易隐等讲「用空」的几条（LY.ILL.EL.11、ZS.04、ZS.05）互相照应。
note.en: The text has only the four characters 'wu gu wu kong' with no explanation, so both readings are possible: the old commentary reads it as 'Void without cause is not to be had', Wang Hongxu as 'Void without cause (not hurt) does not count as Void'. The line is translated literally as 'Without cause, do not be Void', so that both readings stand. 'True Void' and 'Void to avoid ill' are terms of the old commentary in the immediately following 'a hexagram that meets an ominous star: avoiding it is auspicious' (LY.ILL.HJC.156). 'The Former Heaven' means the original principle of the Changes. 'The ten-day Void' is the two branches left out of the ten-day cycle of the casting; in Wang Hongxu a three-harmony frame is the side that controls (a combined frame controlling the Subject). It is taken in the illness domain because the old commentary gives the verdict 'in divining illness the sick will surely die'; it answers the several entries that speak of the Subject Void (LY.ILL.EL.11, ZS.04, ZS.05).

yi: 无故勿空。
en: Without cause, do not be Void.

zh: 夫旬中空亡，有有故而空者，有无故而空者。
凡遇日月动爻伤克，而在空亡，谓有故而空，避之可也。
若无刑冲克害，而身世主象自落空亡，此为无故而空。
占病必死，占事不成，占人有难。
盖空则虽有日辰动爻，难以扶持救援之故也。
yi: 旬里的空亡，有有缘故而空的，有没有缘故而空的。
凡是遇到日、月、动爻伤克，而落在空亡，叫有缘故而空，避开它是可以的。
如果没有刑、冲、克、害，而身、世、主象自己落了空亡，这叫没有缘故而空。
是大凶的兆头。
占病，病人一定会死；占事，事情办不成；占人，这个人要遇灾难。
因为空了，即使有日辰、动爻，也难以扶持救援。
en: Of Void within the ten-day cycle, some is Void with a cause and some Void without cause.
When a line is hurt or controlled by the Day, the Month or a moving line and is in Void, it is called Void with a cause, and avoiding the harm in this way is acceptable.
If there is no punishment, clash, control or harm, and yet the Body, Self or principal image falls into Void by itself, this is Void without cause.
It is a greatly ominous omen.
In divining illness the sick will surely die, an affair does not come to completion, in divining a person he is in trouble.
For when it is Void, even if there are the Day and moving lines, it is hard for them to support and rescue.

zh: 故者，谓受伤的意思，“勿”字该当它“不”字解说。
大凡旬空之爻，安静又遇月建日辰克制，这是有过之空了，即使出旬值日，亦不能为吉为凶，这样旬空，到底无用之空矣。
若旬空之爻发动，或得月建日辰生扶拱合它，或日辰冲起它，或动爻生合它，这是无故之空，待其出旬值日得合之时，仍复能事，故曰无故之空爻，勿以为空也。
虽值旬空而没有受月建日辰克伤的，不可当它真空论。
又如用神化回头克，又见会局来克，来克太过，岂不是有伤了？
若是日月不伤它，用神一空则不受其克，亦称“无故”矣。
古有避凶之说，亦近乎无故之理。
旧注误以无伤克之爻不可空，日月二建克它又宜空，大失先天之妙旨，又失是篇之文理矣。
yi: 「故」，是受伤的意思，「勿」字应当按「不」字来解。
大凡旬空的爻，安静又遇到月建、日辰克制，这是有伤的空，即使出旬、值日，也不能成吉成凶，这样的旬空，到底是无用的空。
如果旬空的爻发动，或者得到月建、日辰生、扶、拱、合它，或者日辰冲起它，或者动爻生合它，这是没有缘故的空，等它出旬、值日、得到合的时候，仍然能办事，所以说，没有缘故的空爻，不要把它当作空。
虽然落在旬空、却没有被月建、日辰克伤的，不可以把它当作真空来论。
又比如用神化出回头克，又见三合局来克，克得太过，难道不是有伤了吗？
如果日月不伤它，用神一旦落空就不受它的克，也叫「无故」了。
古人有避凶的说法，也接近没有缘故（的空）的道理。
旧注错误地认为没有受伤克的爻不可以空、日月二建克它又适宜空，大大失去了先天的妙旨，又失去了这一篇的文理。
en: 'Cause' means being hurt, and the word 'do not' should be read as 'not'.

Generally a line in the ten-day Void that is still and meets control by the Month and the Day is Void with injury, and even when it comes out of the cycle or the Day falls on it, it can make neither good nor ill; such a Void is in the end a useless Void.

If a line in the ten-day Void moves, or is generated, supported, flanked or combined by the Month or the Day, or is clashed into motion by the Day, or is generated or combined by a moving line, this is Void without cause, and when it comes out of the cycle, when the Day falls on it, or when it gets a combination, it can still do its work; so it is said that a Void line without cause is not to be taken as Void.
A line that falls in the ten-day Void but is not hurt by the Month or the Day is not to be judged as truly Void.
Again, if the Subject turns into a line that controls it back, and is controlled by a three-harmony frame as well, the control being excessive, is it not hurt?
If the Day and Month do not hurt it, once the Subject falls Void it is not subject to that control, and this too is called 'without cause'.
The ancients' talk of avoiding ill is also close to the principle of Void without cause.

The old commentary wrongly takes it that a line not hurt or controlled must not be Void and that one controlled by the Day and Month is rightly Void, which greatly loses the subtle sense of the Former Heaven and loses the sense of this passage too.

title: 总断千金赋·用爻变动忌遭死墓绝空；用化用有用无用（旧注：占病逢死墓绝空必死无疑；用爻化用爻谓之化去占病尤忌；王洪绪：用化进神有用，化退神、伏吟无用）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》总断千金赋说：「用爻变动，忌遭死、墓、绝、空」，「用化用，有用无用」。旧注：死、墓、绝、空是陷阱一样的大凶之神，主象发动变入这几位，不管公私大小，都主不成；占病遇到，必死无疑；卦中既然有用爻，就不可再化出来，叫「化去」，别的爻化出（用爻）也不济事，所以和没有用爻一样，占病尤其忌讳。王洪绪：用神化用神有「有用的」「没用的」：化进神的有用，化退神和伏吟卦的没用；空爻安静就不能化空，动了就不算空，出旬有用。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements says: 'When the Subject line moves and changes, it fears meeting Death, Tomb, Extinction or Void'; 'the Subject changing into the Subject: useful or useless'. The old commentary: Death, Tomb, Extinction and Void are greatly ominous spirits like a pit; if the principal image moves and changes into them, public or private, great or small, nothing succeeds; in divining illness, meeting this, death is certain; when the hexagram already has the Subject line it must not change out again, which is called 'changing away', and another line changing out [a Subject line] does not help either, so it is the same as having no Subject line, and in divining illness this is especially feared. Wang Hongxu: a Subject changing into a Subject may be useful or useless: changing into an Advancing spirit is useful, changing into a Retreating spirit or into a Hidden Chant hexagram is useless; a Void line that is still cannot change into Void, and one that moves is not Void and is useful when it comes out of the cycle.

dispute.yi: 「用化用」是好是坏，旧注和王洪绪不同。旧注：卦中已经有用爻，不可以再化出来，叫「化去」，别的爻化出（用爻）也不济事，所以有用爻也同没有一样，占病尤其忌讳——只有「不可」，没有分情形；王洪绪：要分「有用」「无用」：用神化进神的有用，化退神和伏吟卦的没用。用爻变动遇死墓绝空，两家一致认为忌，旧注加了一句「占病逢之必死无疑」。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The old commentary and Wang Hongxu differ on whether 'the Subject changing into the Subject' is good or bad. The old commentary: when the hexagram already has the Subject line it must not change out again, which is called 'changing away', and another line changing out a Subject line does not help either, so having a Subject line is the same as having none, and in divining illness this is especially feared; there is only 'it must not', with no distinction of cases. Wang Hongxu: one must tell 'useful' from 'useless': a Subject changing into an Advancing spirit is useful, changing into a Retreating spirit or the Hidden Chant hexagram is useless. On the Subject line moving into Death, Tomb, Extinction or Void the two agree that it is feared, and the old commentary adds 'in divining illness, meeting it, death is certain'. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 「主象」就是所占的那一爻（用神）。「化去」是旧注的用词，意思是用爻变出来的又是用爻（化出同类），没有变出新东西。「进神」「退神」是同一五行往前、往后变（寅化卯是进神，卯化寅是退神）；「伏吟」是变出来的爻地支和原来一样。「空化空，虽空弗空」（旧注紧接着的一联）讲的是空，不涉及病，没有收。这一条里「必死无疑」「尤其忌讳」两句是占病的断语，和下面墓多暗昧（LY.ILL.HJC.153）、凶化长生（LY.ILL.HJC.154）几条合起来，是总断千金赋给占病的几个凶断。
note.en: The 'principal image' is the line being divined (the Subject). 'Changing away' is a term of the old commentary, meaning that what the Subject line changes into is again a Subject line (a change into its own kind), nothing new coming out of the change. 'Advancing spirit' and 'Retreating spirit' are a change forward or backward within the same element (Yin into Mao is advancing, Mao into Yin retreating); 'Hidden Chant' is when the branch changed into is the same as the original. 'Void into Void: though Void, not Void' (the couplet right after in the old commentary) is about Void and does not touch illness, and is not taken. The sentences 'in divining illness, meeting it, death is certain' and 'in divining illness it is especially feared' are verdicts for illness, and together with the entries on the tomb bringing obscurity (LY.ILL.HJC.153) and an ominous line changing into Birth (LY.ILL.HJC.154) they are the several ominous verdicts the Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements gives for illness.

zh: 用爻变动，忌遭死墓绝空。
yi: 用爻变动，忌讳遇到死、墓、绝、空。
en: When the Subject line moves and changes, it fears meeting Death, Tomb, Extinction or Void.

hits.text: 用爻变动，忌遭死墓绝空
用爻变动，忌遭死墓绝空
用爻变动，忌逢死墓绝空
用爻变动，忌遭死墓绝空

zh: 死墓绝空，乃陷井之地，大凶神也。
死不复生，绝不复续，入墓则不能出，堕空则不能起。
若主象发动而化入者，不问公私大小之事，皆主不成。
yi: 死、墓、绝、空，是陷阱一样的地方，是大凶的神。
死了不能再生，绝了不能再续，入了墓就出不来，落了空就起不来。
如果主象发动而变入这几位，不管公事私事、大事小事，都主不成。
占病遇到它，必死无疑。
en: Death, Tomb, Extinction and Void are a place like a pit, and are greatly ominous spirits.
What is dead cannot live again, what is extinct cannot continue, what has entered the tomb cannot come out, and what has fallen Void cannot rise.
If the principal image moves and changes into these, whether public or private, great or small, nothing will succeed.
In divining illness, meeting it, death is certain.

zh: 主象亦言用神也，如值休囚，已不能为事矣，岂可再见刑克？
如用神发动，犹人勇往直前，岂可自化墓绝？
yi: 主象也是说用神，如果碰上休囚，已经不能办事了，哪里还可以再遇到刑克？
如果用神发动，就像人勇往直前，哪里可以自己变化成墓、绝？
en: The principal image also means the Subject; if it is resting or trapped it already cannot do anything, so how can it meet punishment and control again?
If the Subject moves, it is like a man advancing boldly, so how can it turn itself into Tomb or Extinction?

yi: 用爻变出用爻，有用，也有没用。
en: The Subject line changing into a Subject line: useful, and also useless.

zh: 卦中既有用爻，不可再化出来，谓之化去。
且不独用爻自化，或旁爻化出，皆不济事。
故虽有用爻，此同无用爻之卦一般。
yi: 卦中既然已经有用爻，就不可以再化出来，叫做化去。
而且不只是用爻自己变化，即使别的爻化出（用爻），都不济事。
所以虽然有用爻，这就和没有用爻的卦一样。
占病尤其忌讳。
en: When the hexagram already has the Subject line, it must not change out again; this is called 'changing away'.
And not only the Subject line changing itself: even if another line changes out a Subject line, nothing is helped.
So although there is a Subject line, it is the same as a hexagram with no Subject line.
In divining illness it is especially feared.

zh: 用神化用神，有有用之用神，有无用之用神。
无用者，用神化退神并伏吟卦也，故以“有用无用”分别之。
空爻安静则不能化空，爻发动则能化，既发动，动不空也，化出之空亦因动而化。
凡动爻值空，或动爻变空，皆不作真空论，出旬有用矣。
yi: 用神变出用神，有有用的用神，有没有用的用神。
有用的，是用神化进神；
没有用的，是用神化退神，和伏吟卦，所以用「有用无用」来分别它。
空爻安静就不能化出空，爻发动才能化，既然发动，动了就不空，化出的空也是因为动才化出的。
凡是动爻落在空，或者动爻变成空，都不能当作真空来论，出了旬就有用了。
en: A Subject changing into a Subject may be a useful Subject or a useless Subject.
The useful one is the Subject changing into an Advancing spirit;
The useless one is the Subject changing into a Retreating spirit, and the Hidden Chant hexagram, which is why 'useful or useless' is used to tell them apart.
A Void line that is still cannot change into Void; only when the line moves can it change, and having moved it is not Void, and the Void it changes into comes about only because it moved.
Whenever a moving line is in Void or changes into Void, it is not to be judged as truly Void, and once it is out of the cycle it is useful.

title: 总断千金赋·墓多暗昧（旧注：凶爻要入墓，吉爻不要入墓；占病遇之九死一生；主象带刑动入墓者占病必死、占讼入狱）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》总断千金赋说：「墓多暗昧。」旧注：大致上凶爻要入墓，吉爻不要入墓；《金锁玄关》有人墓、事墓、鬼墓的分别，《天玄赋》有身、世、命随着鬼入墓的说法，都是大凶的兆头；占病遇到，九死一生；捕获遇到，深深躲藏难找；人物遇到，愚昧不振作；失脱遇到，暗暗藏着看不见；因为墓是滞塞的意思，是暗昧不明的象；卦中主象带着刑、发动、入了墓的，占病必死，占官司入狱。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements says: 'The tomb brings much obscurity.' The old commentary: in general an ominous line should enter the tomb and a lucky line should not; the Jinsuo Xuanguan distinguishes the person's tomb, the matter's tomb and the ghost's tomb, and the Tianxuan Fu has the saying of the Body, Self and natal line entering the tomb following the ghost, all greatly ominous omens; in divining illness, meeting it is nine deaths to one life; in a capture the quarry hides deep and is hard to find; in a person, he is dull and does not rouse himself; in a loss, it lies hidden and unseen; for the tomb means stagnation, the image of obscurity and unclarity; when the principal image in the hexagram carries punishment, moves and enters the tomb, in divining illness the sick will surely die and in a lawsuit one goes to prison.

note.yi: 这里的「墓」是十二长生里的墓位（入墓）。「人墓、事墓、鬼墓」是《金锁玄关》的分别，书里没有展开；「身、世、命随鬼入墓」是天玄赋的说法（LY.ILL.TXF.06）和断易天机的「随官入墓」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.27）是同一件事：占病遇到，断易天机写「十占九死」，这里写「九死一生」，两处意思相同。这一条只有「占病」「占讼」两句是断语，「捕获」「人物」「失脱」讲的是别的事，为了保持这一整段完整一并收在这里。王洪绪对这一联的评语是十二长生里只有长生、墓、绝要紧（LY.ILL.HJC.129 收过），这里没有专门的王洪绪段。「愚蒙」按字面是愚昧蒙昧。
note.en: The 'tomb' here is the Tomb stage of the twelve stages of life (entering the tomb). 'The person's tomb, the matter's tomb, the ghost's tomb' is the Jinsuo Xuanguan's distinction, not expanded in the book; 'the Body, Self and natal line entering the tomb following the ghost' is the Tianxuan Fu's saying (LY.ILL.TXF.06) and is the same thing as 'following Pressure into the tomb' in the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.DYTJ.27): for illness the Duanyi Tianji writes 'nine of ten divinations die', here it is 'nine deaths to one life', the same sense. Only the two sentences 'in divining illness' and 'in a lawsuit' are verdicts for our domain; 'a capture', 'a person' and 'a loss' are about other matters, and are kept here to keep the passage whole. Wang Hongxu's comment on this couplet is that of the twelve stages of life only Birth, Tomb and Extinction matter (taken in LY.ILL.HJC.129), and there is no separate Wang Hongxu passage here.

yi: 墓多暗昧。
en: The tomb brings much obscurity.

zh: 大抵凶爻要入墓，吉爻不要入墓。
《金锁玄关》有：人墓、事墓、鬼墓之别。
《天玄赋》有身、世、命，随鬼入墓之论。
卦中主象带刑动入墓者，占病必死，占讼入狱。
yi: 大致凶爻要入墓，吉爻不要入墓。
《金锁玄关》有：人墓、事墓、鬼墓的分别。
《天玄赋》有身、世、命，随着鬼入墓的说法。
都是大凶的兆头。
占病遇到它，九死一生；
捕获遇到它，深深躲藏难找；
人物遇到它，愚昧不振作；
失脱遇到它，暗暗藏着看不见。
因为墓，是滞塞的意思。
是暗昧不明的象。
卦中主象带着刑、发动、入了墓的，占病必死，占官司入狱。
en: In general an ominous line should enter the tomb and a lucky line should not.
The Jinsuo Xuanguan distinguishes the person's tomb, the matter's tomb and the ghost's tomb.
The Tianxuan Fu has the saying of the Body, the Self and the natal line entering the tomb following the ghost.
All are greatly ominous omens.
In divining illness, meeting it is nine deaths to one life;
in a capture, the quarry hides deep and is hard to find;
in a person, he is dull and does not rouse himself;
in a loss, it lies hidden and unseen.
For the tomb means stagnation.
It is the image of obscurity and unclarity.
When in the hexagram the principal image carries punishment, moves and enters the tomb, in divining illness the sick will surely die and in a lawsuit one goes to prison.

title: 总断千金赋·凶化长生炽而未散（旧注：占病福化长生日渐减可，鬼化长生日加沉重，直至墓绝日始杀其势；王洪绪：凶神化入长生祸根日渐增长，必待墓绝日始锄其势）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》总断千金赋说：「凶爻变成长生，祸势炽盛而没有散。」旧注：主事的爻化入长生都吉，只是成得迟；只有坏事的爻化入长生，祸根才刚萌发，一天天增长，凶恶的势头一定要到盛了才停；比如占病，福神（子孙）化成长生，病势一天天减轻就可以；鬼（官鬼）化成长生，病势一天比一天沉重，一直到墓、绝的日子才杀掉它的势头。王洪绪：用爻化入长生的吉；凶神化入长生，祸根日渐增长，一定等到墓、绝日才锄掉它的势头。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements says: 'An ominous line changing into Birth blazes and does not disperse.' The old commentary: when the line that governs the matter changes into Birth, all is auspicious, only the completion is late; only when the line of a bad matter changes into Birth does the root of its calamity just begin to sprout and grow day by day, and the ominous force does not stop until it has become full; for example in divining illness, if the Fortune line (Output) changes into Birth, the illness lessening day by day will do; if the ghost (Pressure) changes into Birth, the illness grows heavier day by day, until the Tomb or Extinction day, when its force is killed. Wang Hongxu: a Subject line changing into Birth is auspicious; an ominous spirit changing into Birth, the root of calamity grows day by day, and one must wait for the Tomb or Extinction day before its force is hoed out.

note.yi: 「长生」是十二长生的头一位。「福化长生」的「福」是福神（子孙），「鬼化长生」的「鬼」是官鬼；旧注的意思是：占病时，子孙（医药）化入长生，是医药一天天见效，病势一天天减；官鬼（病）化入长生，病就一天一天重下去，要等到官鬼的墓、绝日才压得下来。这是占病「看病势走向」的几条之一，和 LY.ILL.EL.17、ZS.35 等不同，它不看用神旺衰，只看动爻变入哪一位。旧注和王洪绪在这一联上一致，旧注多出占病的这一例。
note.en: 'Birth' is the first of the twelve stages of life. The 'Fortune' of 'the Fortune line changes into Birth' is the Fortune line (Output), and the 'ghost' of 'the ghost changes into Birth' is Pressure; the old commentary means: in divining illness, when Output (the medicine) changes into Birth, the medicine works more day by day and the illness lessens day by day; when Pressure (the illness) changes into Birth, the illness grows heavier day by day and is held down only on the Tomb or Extinction day of Pressure. This is one of the entries on 'reading the course of the illness', and unlike LY.ILL.EL.17 and ZS.35 and the like it does not look at the strength of the Subject but only at which stage the moving line changes into. The old commentary and Wang Hongxu agree on this couplet, and the old commentary adds this example on illness.

yi: 凶爻变成长生，祸势炽盛而没有散。
en: An ominous line changing into Birth blazes and does not disperse.

zh: 主事爻化入长生者，皆吉。
惟坏事之爻化入长生者，则其祸根始萌，日渐增长，凶恶之势，必盛而后已。
如占病，褔化长生，日渐减可；
yi: 所主事的爻化入长生，都吉。
只是成得迟一些罢了。
只有坏事的爻化入长生，它的祸根才刚刚萌发，一天天增长，凶恶的势头，一定要到盛了才停。
比如占病，福神（子孙）化成长生，病势一天天减轻就可以；
鬼（官鬼）化成长生，病势一天比一天沉重。
一直到墓、绝的日子，才杀掉它的势头。
en: When the line that governs the matter changes into Birth, all is auspicious.
It only comes to completion somewhat late.
Only when the line of a bad matter changes into Birth does the root of its calamity just begin to sprout and grow day by day, and the ominous force does not stop until it has become full.
In divining illness, if the Fortune line (Output) changes into Birth, the illness lessening day by day will do;
if the ghost (Pressure) changes into Birth, the illness grows heavier day by day.
It is not until the Tomb or Extinction day that its force is killed.

zh: 如凶神化入长生者，则其祸根始萌，日渐增长也，必待墓绝日始锄其势。
yi: 用爻化入长生的吉；
如果是凶神化入长生，它的祸根刚开始萌发，一天天增长，一定要等到墓、绝的日子，才锄掉它的势头。
en: A Subject line changing into Birth is auspicious;
but if an ominous spirit changes into Birth, the root of its calamity has only begun to sprout and grows day by day, and one must wait for the Tomb or Extinction day before its force is hoed out.

title: 总断千金赋·死绝岂可持身（旧注：死绝二爻临持世身主象必不利，占人有难、占病无救、占医无效、占事不济，变动化入亦然）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》总断千金赋说：「死、绝，怎么可以持身？」旧注：死、绝两爻，临在、持着世、身、主象上，一定不利：占人有灾难，占病没有救，占医没有效，占事不成；变动化入的也是这样。王洪绪的这一条评语只有半句，「死、绝于日辰的爻，临持世、身、用神的，各种占都不利，变动化入」，原文到这里就断了。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements says: 'Death and Extinction: how can they hold the Body?' The old commentary: when the Death and Extinction lines sit on or hold the Self, the Body or the principal image, it is sure to be unfavourable: in divining a person he is in difficulty, in divining illness there is no rescue, in divining a doctor he is ineffective, an affair does not succeed; so too when they are moved or changed into. Wang Hongxu's comment on this has only half a sentence, 'a line in Death or Extinction by the Day branch that sits on or holds the Self, the Body or the Subject: no divination is favourable, in moving and changing into', where the text breaks off.

note.yi: 这是「刑害不宜临用」那一联（LY.ILL.HJC.130）的下半句。「死绝」是十二长生里的死、绝两位，不是「死亡」。「占医无效」的「医」是请医生。王洪绪的评语在原书里印到「变动化入」就断了（是原书如此，不是本库截的），所以这里只有半句。「持身」的「身」书里连说「世、身、主象」，「身」应是卦身。
note.en: This is the second half of the couplet 'punishment and harm should not fall on the Subject' (LY.ILL.HJC.130). 'Death and Extinction' are two of the twelve stages of life and not 'death'. The 'doctor' of 'in divining a doctor' is calling in a physician. Wang Hongxu's comment is printed in the book up to 'in moving and changing into' and breaks off (this is how the book is, not cut by this library), so there is only half a sentence here. The 'Body' of 'hold the Body' is, as the text says 'the Self, the Body and the principal image' in a run, the hexagram's Body.

yi: 死、绝，怎么可以持身？
en: Death and Extinction: how can they hold the Body?

zh: 死绝二爻，临持世身主象者，必不利。
占人有难，占病无救，占医无效，占事不济。
yi: 死、绝两爻，临在、持着世、身、主象上，一定不利。
占人有灾难，占病没有救，占医没有效，占事不成。
变动化入的也是这样。
en: When the Death and Extinction lines sit on or hold the Self, the Body or the principal image, it is sure to be unfavourable.
In divining a person he is in difficulty, in divining illness there is no rescue, in divining a doctor he is ineffective, an affair does not succeed.
So too when they are moved or changed into.

zh: 死绝于日辰之爻临持世身用神者，诸占不利，变动化入
yi: 死、绝于日辰的爻，临持世、身、用神的，各种占都不利，变动化入
en: A line in Death or Extinction by the Day branch that sits on or holds the Self, the Body or the Subject: no divination is favourable, in moving and changing into

title: 总断千金赋·卦遇凶星避之则吉（旧注：凶星是刑冲克害，避之是落空；书中例：六月壬申日占子病得姤之大过，父母旺动用爻无气，喜用爻在空避之，至丙子日愈；王洪绪：凶星即忌神，用爻被月建日辰伤克则无处可避）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》总断千金赋说：「卦里遇到凶星，避开它就吉。」旧注：凶星，就是刑、冲、克、害；避开它，就是六甲空亡；用爻无缘无故自己落空是真空，万事不成；如果被日辰、动爻刑冲克害到用爻而用爻在空，这是避凶而空，就是《金锁玄关》说的「克空为用」，不会坏，只是眼下略有阻碍，过了旬就成。书中例：六月壬申日占儿子的病，得姤变大过，父母旺动、用爻无气，本是凶兆，喜得用爻落在空亡避开了它，果然到丙子日病好了。王洪绪：凶星就是忌神；用爻被月建日辰伤克，不论空伏，无处可避；如果没有月、日伤克、只是遇到忌神发动来伤，用爻值旬空伏藏而不受克，叫做避，等到冲克忌神的日子，凶就自己散了。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's Rhapsody of a Thousand Golden Judgements says: 'A hexagram that meets an ominous star: avoiding it is auspicious.' The old commentary: an ominous star is punishment, clash, control or harm; avoiding it is the Void of the six jia; a Subject line that falls Void by itself without cause is true Void and nothing succeeds; if the Subject line is punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by the Day or a moving line and is in Void, this is Void to avoid ill, which is what the Jinsuo Xuanguan calls 'Void under control is used', it will not spoil, only for the moment there is some obstruction, and once the cycle has passed it succeeds. A case: on a Renshen day in the sixth month a son's illness was divined and Gou changing to Daguo obtained; the Resource line was strong and moving and the Subject line had no qi, which would be an ominous omen, but fortunately the Subject line was in Void and so avoided it, and indeed on the Bingzi day the illness was cured. Wang Hongxu: an ominous star is the Adversary; when the Subject line is hurt or controlled by the Month or the Day, whether Void or hidden, it cannot be avoided; if there is no hurt from the Month or Day and it is only an Adversary that moves to harm it, then if the Subject line is in the ten-day Void or hidden and does not suffer the control, this is called avoiding, and when the day comes that clashes and controls the Adversary, the ill disperses of itself.

dispute.yi: 「凶星」是什么、怎么才算「避」，旧注和王洪绪的说法不同。旧注：凶星是刑冲克害，避就是落空亡；用爻被日辰、动爻刑冲克害而在空，就是避凶（「克空为用」）。王洪绪：凶星就是忌神；用爻被月建日辰伤克的，不论空伏，始终受制，无处可避；只有没有月日伤克、单被卦中忌神发动来伤的，用爻值旬空或伏藏，才叫避。旧注认为被日辰刑冲克害的用爻落空也是避，王洪绪认为被月建日辰克伤的就避不了。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The old commentary and Wang Hongxu differ on what the 'ominous star' is and what counts as 'avoiding'. The old commentary: the ominous star is punishment, clash, control and harm, and avoiding is falling into Void; a Subject line punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by the Day or a moving line and in Void is avoiding ill ('Void under control is used'). Wang Hongxu: the ominous star is the Adversary; a Subject line hurt or controlled by the Month or the Day, whether Void or hidden, is always held and cannot avoid it; only when there is no hurt from the Month and Day and it is solely an Adversary in the hexagram moving to harm it, and the Subject line is in the ten-day Void or hidden, is it called avoiding. The old commentary takes a Subject line punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by the Day to avoid it by falling Void, while Wang Hongxu holds that one hurt or controlled by the Month and Day cannot avoid it. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 书中例是旧注举的占病例子：壬申日在甲午旬（甲午、乙未、丙申、丁酉、戊戌、己亥、庚子、辛丑、壬寅……），原文没有写这个旬；「用爻无气」又落在空亡里避开了父母的克，所以「至丙子日愈」，旧注解释说丙子日时前面的旬已过、又遇用爻帝旺（帝旺是十二长生里最旺的一位）。「六甲」是六个甲（甲子、甲戌……）管的六个旬，「六甲空亡」就是旬空。「金锁玄关」是旧注引的另一部书。「先天」指易的本来道理。这条的主旨是「空」可以是避凶，所以和 LY.ILL.HJC.151（无故勿空）互相对照：同一部总断千金赋里，自己落空的用爻旧注断凶，被克伤而落空的又断为避。
note.en: The case is an illness example the old commentary gives: the Renshen day is in a ten-day cycle that begins at Jiawu (Jiawu, Yiwei, Bingshen, Dingyou, Wuxu, Jihai, Gengzi, Xinchou, Renyin ...), which the text does not state; the Subject line 'has no qi' and falls Void and so avoids the control of the Resource line, hence 'on the Bingzi day it was cured', and the old commentary explains that by the Bingzi day the earlier cycle had passed and the Subject line met its Peak (Peak is the strongest of the twelve stages of life). 'The six jia' are the six ten-day cycles governed by the six jia (Jiazi, Jiaxu and so on), and 'the Void of the six jia' is the ten-day Void. The 'Jinsuo Xuanguan' is another book that the old commentary cites. 'The Former Heaven' means the original principle of the Changes. The point of the entry is that Void can be avoiding ill, and so it is set against LY.ILL.HJC.151 (wu gu wu kong): in the same rhapsody the old commentary judges a Subject line that falls Void by itself ominous, and one hurt and then falling Void to be avoiding.

yi: 卦里遇到凶星，避开它就吉；
en: If the hexagram meets an ominous star, avoiding it is auspicious;

zh: 若执真空，便失先天之旨。
盖百物自空中来，无中生有，还归于空。
空中不受伤克，反有可成之机。
如六爻安静，用爻无故自空，此为真空，万事无成。
若被日辰动爻刑冲克害于用爻，而用爻在空，此为避凶而空。
《金锁玄关》所谓：克空为用是也。
即是不坏，但目下略阻，过旬即成。
yi: 凶星，就是刑、冲、克、害。
避开它，就是六甲空亡。
一个「空」字，极有玄妙；
如果死执着真空，就失去了先天的旨意。
因为万物从空中来，无中生有，又回归于空。
在空中不受伤克，反而有可以成事的机会。
比如六爻安静，用爻无缘无故自己落空，这是真空，万事不成。
如果被日辰、动爻刑冲克害到用爻，而用爻在空，这是避凶而空。
《金锁玄关》所说的「克空为用」就是这个。
就是不会坏，只是眼下稍微有些阻碍，过了旬就成。
en: An ominous star is punishment, clash, control or harm.
Avoiding it is the Void of the six jia.
The single word 'void' is profoundly subtle;
if one clings to true Void, one loses the Former Heaven's meaning.
For all things come from the void, something arises from nothing, and returns again to the void.
In the void one is not hurt or controlled, and on the contrary there is a chance for things to succeed.
For example, with the six lines still, if the Subject line falls Void by itself without cause, it is true Void and nothing succeeds.
If the Subject line is punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by the Day or a moving line and is in Void, this is Void to avoid ill.
What the Jinsuo Xuanguan calls 'Void under control is used' is this.
It is that it will not spoil, only that for the moment there is some obstruction, and once the cycle has passed it succeeds.

zh: 如六月壬申日，占子病，得姤之大过卦。
父母旺动，用爻无气，本为凶兆；
喜得用爻在空避之，果至丙子日愈。
盖至丙子，则前面已过，又遇用爻帝旺之地，故也。
yi: 如六月壬申日，占儿子的病，得到姤变大过卦。
父母旺相发动，用爻无气，本来是凶的兆头；
喜得用爻落在空亡里避开了它，果然到丙子日病好了。
因为到了丙子日，前面的旬已经过去，又遇到用爻帝旺的地方，所以如此。
en: For example, on a Renshen day in the sixth month, divining a son's illness, one obtains Gou changing to Daguo.
The Resource line is strong and moves, and the Subject line has no qi, which would be an ominous omen;
but fortunately the Subject line is in Void and so avoids it, and indeed on the Bingzi day the illness was cured.
This is because by the Bingzi day the earlier cycle had passed and the Subject line met its Peak stage.

zh: 凡用爻被月建日辰伤克，不论空伏，始终受制，无处可避。
如无月日伤克，独遇卦爻中忌神发动来伤，若用爻值旬空伏藏不受其克，谓之避，待冲克忌神之日，其凶自散也。
如用爻出现不空便受其毒，难免其伤也，故曰：“避之则吉”。
yi: 凶星就是忌神。
凡是用爻被月建、日辰伤克，不论空还是伏，始终受制，无处可避。
如果没有月、日伤克，只是遇到卦爻中的忌神发动来伤，如果用爻值旬空、伏藏而不受它的克，叫做避，等到冲克忌神的日子，它的凶就自己散了。
如果用爻出现、不空，就受到它的毒害，难免被伤，所以说「避之则吉」。
en: An ominous star is the Adversary.
Whenever the Subject line is hurt or controlled by the Month or the Day, whether it is Void or hidden it is always held, and there is nowhere to avoid it.

If there is no hurt or control from the Month or Day and it is only that an Adversary in the hexagram moves to harm it, then if the Subject line is in the ten-day Void or hidden and does not suffer its control, this is called avoiding, and when the day comes that clashes and controls the Adversary, its ill disperses of itself.
If the Subject line appears and is not Void, it suffers its poison and cannot escape harm, and so it is said 'avoiding it is auspicious'.

title: 占疾病·应药世身、若坐墓鬼病主昏沉；卦有三墓（宫墓、鬼墓、财墓），世爻逢墓鬼主自身合灾（暴病未可、久病必死）；应为药忌坐鬼、本宫墓鬼得之主无药；最怕申酉持世、木爻独发

rule.yi: 占疾病，应是药，世是身；世若坐在墓、鬼上，病主昏沉。卦有三墓（宫墓、鬼墓、财墓），以世为身，忌讳生鬼爻；本宫的墓、鬼落在世爻上，主自身该有灾：暴病还不能好，久病必死。以应为药，忌讳坐着鬼爻，旺相就凶；本宫的墓、鬼落在应上，主没有药，服药不见效。最怕申、酉爻持世，还有木爻独发、鬼爻旺相伏在世下、旺又动来克世。财墓是吉兆，占的是妇人时遇到它却要大忌；鬼旺伏在世下，是病跟着我，所以忌。
rule.en: In divining illness the Other is the medicine and the Self is the Body; if the Self sits on a tomb or a ghost the illness means stupor. A hexagram has three tombs (the palace tomb, the ghost's tomb and the Wealth tomb); taking the Self as the Body it is taboo to generate the Pressure line; when the own palace's tomb or ghost falls on the Self line the person is due a calamity: a sudden illness cannot yet recover and a long illness surely ends in death. Taking the Other as the medicine, it is taboo for it to sit on a Pressure line and if strong it is ominous; when the own palace's tomb or ghost falls on the Other there is no medicine and taking it has no effect. Most feared are a Shen or You line holding the Self, a Wood line moving alone, and the Pressure line strong and hidden under the Self, strong and also moving to control the Self. The Wealth tomb is a lucky sign, but when a woman is being divined for, meeting it is a great taboo; a strong ghost hidden under the Self is the illness following me, and so it is a taboo.

note.yi: 这一节是火珠林「占疾病」的头一部分：先是一副对句（凡占疾病，应药世身；若坐墓鬼，病主昏沉），然后一段一段地展开，末了是「或问……答曰」的问答。原文「封有三墓」的「封」是「卦」之误，「中孚封」同；「艮官属土」的「官」是「宫」之误；这里都按卦、宫译。「旁爻丑持世」的「旁爻」字面译作 the side line。三墓是宫墓（卦所属宫的五行的墓）、鬼墓（鬼爻五行的墓）、财墓（财爻五行的墓）：姤卦世爻丑，乾宫属金，金墓在丑，是宫墓；中孚世爻未，艮宫属土，以寅木为鬼，木墓在未，是鬼墓；泰卦世爻辰，坤宫属土，以亥水为财，水墓在辰，是财墓。「得之」是在世爻上遇到。对句里说「三墓」却只列宫基（宫墓）和鬼墓两个，第三个财墓在问答里补出；「本宫墓鬼得之」读作本宫的墓或鬼，原文没有拆开。这里说的世爻遇本宫墓、鬼，和天玄赋「不宜丘墓同宫」（LY.ILL.TXF.08）、断易天机「卦变墓乡」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.07）是同一类。
note.en: This section is the first part of the Huozhu Lin's 'divining illness': first a couplet ('In divining illness the Other is the medicine and the Self is the Body; if it sits on a tomb or a ghost the illness means stupor'), then a passage at a time, and at the end questions and answers ('someone asks... the answer'). The 'feng' of the original 'feng you san mu' is a miswriting of 'gua' (hexagram), and so is that of 'Zhongfu feng'; the 'guan' of 'Gen guan shu tu' is a miswriting of 'gong' (palace); all are rendered as hexagram and palace here. The 'pang yao' of 'the side line Chou holding the Self' is rendered literally as 'the side line'. The three tombs are the palace tomb (the tomb of the phase of the palace the hexagram belongs to), the ghost's tomb (the tomb of the phase of the ghost line) and the Wealth tomb (the tomb of the phase of the Wealth line): in Gou the Self line is Chou, the Qian palace belongs to Metal and the tomb of Metal is at Chou, the palace tomb; in Zhongfu the Self line is Wei, the Gen palace belongs to Earth, taking Yin Wood as the ghost, and the tomb of Wood is at Wei, the ghost's tomb; in Tai the Self line is Chen, the Kun palace belongs to Earth, taking Hai Water as Wealth, and the tomb of Water is at Chen, the Wealth tomb. 'Obtaining it' is meeting it on the Self line. The couplet says 'three tombs' but lists only the palace tomb and the ghost's tomb, and the third, the Wealth tomb, is supplied in the questions and answers; 'the own palace's tomb or ghost obtains it' is read as the own palace's tomb or ghost, and the original does not separate them. The Self line meeting the own palace's tomb or ghost here is of the same kind as the Tianxuan Fu's 'the mound and the tomb must not share a palace' (LY.ILL.TXF.08) and the Duanyi Tianji's 'the hexagram changing into the tomb quarter' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.07).

yi: 凡是占疾病，
应是药，世是身；
如果坐在墓、鬼上，
病主昏沉。
en: In divining illness,
the Other is the medicine and the Self is the Body;
if it sits on a tomb or a ghost,
the illness means stupor.

yi: 卦有三墓：
宫基（宫墓）、鬼墓，
以世作身，
忌讳生鬼爻。
本宫的墓、鬼得到它的，
主自身该有灾；
暴病还不能好，
久病必死。
en: A hexagram has three tombs:
the palace base (the palace tomb) and the ghost's tomb,
taking the Self as the Body,
it is taboo to generate the Pressure line.
When it is the own palace's tomb or ghost that obtains it,
the person himself is due a calamity;
in a sudden illness he cannot yet recover,
in a long illness he will surely die.

yi: 以应作药，
忌讳坐着鬼爻，
旺相就凶。
本宫的墓、鬼得到它，
主没有药，
服药不见效；
最怕申、酉爻持世，
占病尤其是大忌；
木爻独发，
鬼爻旺相、伏在世下，
旺而又动来克世。
en: Taking the Other as the medicine,
it is taboo for it to sit on a Pressure line;
if strong it is ominous.
When the own palace's tomb or ghost obtains it,
it means there is no medicine,
and taking medicine has no effect;
most feared is a Shen or You line holding the Self;
in divining illness it is a grave taboo;
a Wood line moving alone,
the Pressure line strong and hidden under the Self,
strong and also moving to control the Self.

zh: 或问：卦有三墓，何谓三墓？
答曰：如天风姤卦，旁爻丑持世，乾宫属金墓在丑，此是宫墓。
如中孚封，世持辛未，艮官属土，以寅木为鬼，木墓在未，此是鬼墓。
如泰卦，甲辰持世，坤宫属土，以亥水为财，水墓在辰，此是财墓。
曰：得之者，世爻上逢之也。
世为我身也，凡墓爻故主自身合灾也。
暴病未可者，墓滞也，故未可。
久病必死者，病久气衰，而又入墓，岂得不死？
yi: 有人问：卦有三墓，什么是三墓？
答：比如天风姤卦，旁爻丑持世，乾宫属金、金的墓在丑，这是宫墓。
又如中孚卦，世持辛未，艮宫属土，以寅木为鬼，木的墓在未，这是鬼墓。
又如泰卦，甲辰持世，坤宫属土，以亥水为财，水的墓在辰，这是财墓。
问：什么叫「得之」？
答：得到它，就是在世爻上遇到它。
世是我的身，凡是墓爻，所以主自身该有灾。
「暴病未可」，是墓有滞碍，所以还不能好。
「久病必死」，是病久了气衰，又入了墓，哪能不死？
en: Someone asks: a hexagram has three tombs, what are the three tombs?
The answer: take the hexagram Heaven over Wind, Gou, with the Chou line at the side holding the Self; the Qian palace belongs to Metal and the tomb of Metal is at Chou; this is the palace tomb.
Or take Zhongfu, with Xin Wei holding the Self; the Gen palace belongs to Earth and takes Yin Wood as the ghost, and the tomb of Wood is at Wei; this is the ghost's tomb.
Or take Tai, with Jia Chen holding the Self; the Kun palace belongs to Earth and takes Hai Water as Wealth, and the tomb of Water is at Chen; this is the Wealth tomb.
Asked: what is meant by 'obtaining it'?
The answer: obtaining it is meeting it on the Self line.
The Self is my body, and any tomb line therefore means the person himself is due a calamity.
'A sudden illness cannot yet recover' is because the tomb obstructs, so he cannot yet recover.
'A long illness surely dies' is because the qi is weak from the long illness and it also enters the tomb: how could he not die?

zh: 曰：财墓吉兆，故以财言之，
yi: 又问：为什么不说财墓？
答：财墓是吉兆，所以拿财来说它，
但占的是妇人，遇到这个就要大忌。
en: Asked again: why is the Wealth tomb not mentioned?
The answer: the Wealth tomb is a lucky sign, so it is spoken of in terms of Wealth,
but if a woman is being divined for, meeting this is a great taboo.

zh: 又问：鬼爻旺相伏世下何也？
曰：世为我身，鬼伏世下，是病随我，所以忌之。
yi: 又问：鬼爻旺相、伏在世下，是什么道理？
答：世是我的身，鬼伏在世下，是病跟着我，所以忌它。
en: Asked again: why is it that the Pressure line is strong and hidden under the Self?
The answer: the Self is my body; a ghost hidden under the Self is the illness following me, and so it is a taboo.

title: 占疾病·看鬼伏何爻下：伏父母忧心或动土、伏兄弟饥饱口舌、伏子孙牵惹欲事、伏财饮食买物、官鬼出现惊恐怪异；土下伏土疮肿、火下火手足、金见金闷乱、木下木寒热、水下水冷疾、金下火喘满；阳宫财动主吐阴宫财动主泻；鬼在内下受病外上受病

rule.yi: 看鬼伏在哪一爻下，再按金木水火土分辨：伏在父母下，是忧心得的病，或动了土、去修造的地方得的；伏兄弟下且动，是饥饱失节得的，或因口舌、生气得的；伏子孙下且动，是牵扯招惹得的，或欲事太过得的；伏财下，是饮食上得的，或买东西得的；官鬼出现，是惊恐怪异，或在寺观庙宇里得的。土下伏土生疮肿，火下伏火病在手足，金见金闷乱，木下木寒热，水下水冷疾，金下伏火喘满；阳宫财动主吐，阴宫财动主泻。鬼爻现在外、金鬼爻伏在里，主心腹病；鬼在内，下部受病；鬼在外而动，上部受病；用爻同。
rule.en: Look at which line the ghost is hidden under, and tell it apart by Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth. Hidden under Resource: caught through worry, or by disturbing the earth, or by going to a place of building and repair. Hidden under Peer and moving: caught through the lapse of hunger and fullness, or through quarrels and anger. Hidden under Output and moving: caught through entanglement, or through excess of desire. Hidden under Wealth: caught through food and drink, or through buying things. The Pressure line appearing: fright and strange things, or caught in a temple or monastery. Earth hidden under Earth: sores and swelling; Fire under Fire: the hands and feet; Metal meeting Metal: oppression and confusion; Wood under Wood: chills and fever; Water under Water: a cold illness; Metal under Fire: panting and fullness. In a yang palace Wealth moving means vomiting, in a yin palace Wealth moving means diarrhoea. With the Pressure line showing outside and the Metal Pressure line hidden inside, it is an illness of the heart and belly; a ghost inside, the lower part is ill; a ghost outside and moving, the upper part is ill; the Subject line is the same.

note.yi: 这一段和海底眼「鬼伏何爻下」一节（LY.ILL.HDY.04）、天玄赋「无鬼看伏鬼」（LY.ILL.TXF.10）是同一套，字句和顺序略有不同；这里多了「土下伏土疮肿……金下火喘满」一串五行相叠的症候。原文「寺观宙宇」的「宙」是「庙」之误，按庙宇译。「鬼在内地，下受病」的「内地」按「在内」译。「阳宫财动主吐，阴宫财动主泻」是说阳宫里财爻动主吐、阴宫里财爻动主泻，「阳宫」「阴宫」原文没有解释。「土下伏土」按「土鬼伏在土爻下」读。「用爻同」是说用爻的内外动也照这样看。原文中间隔了一个空行：「鬼伏兄弟」在一行的末尾，「动，失饥伤饱得」在下一行的开头，这里按连着读。
note.en: This passage is the same set as the Haidi Yan's section on which line the ghost is hidden under (LY.ILL.HDY.04) and the Tianxuan Fu's 'with no ghost look for the hidden ghost' (LY.ILL.TXF.10), with slightly different wording and order; here there is in addition the string of symptoms from phases stacked on each other, 'Earth hidden under Earth: sores and swelling ... Metal under Fire: panting and fullness'. The 'zhou' of 'si guan zhou yu' in the original is a miswriting of 'miao' (temple), rendered as temple or monastery. The 'inside the earth' of 'the ghost inside the earth, the lower part is ill' is rendered 'inside'. 'In a yang palace Wealth moving means vomiting, in a yin palace Wealth moving means diarrhoea' says that Wealth moving in a yang palace means vomiting and in a yin palace diarrhoea, and the original does not explain 'yang palace' and 'yin palace'. 'Earth hidden under Earth' is read as an Earth ghost hidden under an Earth line. 'The Subject line is the same' says that the Subject line's inside and outside moving is also looked at this way. In the original a blank line falls in the middle: 'the ghost hidden under Peer' is at the end of one line and 'moving, caught through the lapse of hunger and fullness' at the beginning of the next, and they are read here as continuous.

zh: 看鬼伏何爻下，于金木水火土分辨之，伏父母，忧心得，或动土得，或往修造处得。
鬼伏兄弟动，失饥伤饱得，或因口舌气上得。
鬼伏子孙动，因牵惹得，或欲事太过得。
鬼伏财，饮食得，或买物件得。
官鬼出现，惊恐怪异，或寺观宙宇中得。
土下伏土，疮肿；火下火，手足；金见金，闷乱；木下木，寒热；水下水，冷疾；金下火，喘满；阳宫财动主吐；阴宫财动主泻。
鬼爻现外，金鬼爻伏里，主心腹病。
yi: 看鬼伏在哪一爻下，再按金木水火土分辨：伏在父母下，是忧心得的，或是动了土得的，或是去修造的地方得的。
鬼伏在兄弟下且动，是饥饱失节得的，或因口舌、生气得的。
鬼伏在子孙下且动，是牵扯招惹得的，或是欲事太过得的。
鬼伏在财下，是饮食上得的，或是买东西得的。
官鬼出现，是惊恐怪异，或是在寺观庙宇里得的。
土下伏土，疮肿；火下伏火，手足；金见金，闷乱；木下木，寒热；水下水，冷疾；金下伏火，喘满；阳宫财动主吐；阴宫财动主泻。
鬼爻现在外、金鬼爻伏在里，主心腹病。
鬼在内地，下部受病。
鬼在外而动，上部受病。
用爻也是这样。
en: Look at which line the ghost is hidden under and tell it apart by Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth: hidden under Resource, caught through worry, or by disturbing the earth, or by going to a place of building and repair.
The ghost hidden under Peer and moving: caught through the lapse of hunger and fullness, or through quarrels and anger.
The ghost hidden under Output and moving: caught through entanglement, or through excess of desire.
The ghost hidden under Wealth: caught through food and drink, or through buying things.
The Pressure line appearing: fright and strange things, or caught in a temple or monastery.

Earth hidden under Earth: sores and swelling; Fire under Fire: the hands and feet; Metal meeting Metal: oppression and confusion; Wood under Wood: chills and fever; Water under Water: a cold illness; Metal under Fire: panting and fullness; in a yang palace Wealth moving means vomiting; in a yin palace Wealth moving means diarrhoea.
With the Pressure line showing outside and the Metal Pressure line hidden inside, it is an illness of the heart and belly.
A ghost inside: the lower part is ill.
A ghost outside and moving: the upper part is ill.
The Subject line is the same.

hits.text: 官鬼出现，惊恐怪异，或因寺观庙宇中得
上下伏土，疮肿。火下火，手足。金见金，问乱未下，大寒热。水下水，冷疾。金下金，喘咳。阳宫世动主吐，阴宫财动主泻

title: 占疾病·土动主泻、木动发寒、金动四肢满闷、火动发热；木足金头土胸腹火手目水耳肾；飞为化因伏为受病；世动在内下受病、应动在外上受病、间爻动胸膈病；《易镜》长男受病宜纯震不摇；大忌申酉持世木爻独发(申丧车酉丧服木棺椁)

rule.yi: 土动主泻，木动发寒，金动主四肢或满闷，火动发热。木主足，金主头，土主胸腹，火主手目，水主耳肾。飞伏都旺相时，飞是化出病的原因，以伏为受病的地方。又：世是动爻，在内则下部受病；应是动爻，在外则上部受病；间爻动，主胸膈的病。《易镜》说：长男受病，宜纯震卦不动；小女染病，宜兑卦不动。大忌申、酉持世，木爻独发，因为申是丧车，酉是丧服，木是棺椁。
rule.en: Earth moving means diarrhoea, Wood moving means chills, Metal moving means the four limbs or oppression, Fire moving means fever. Wood governs the feet, Metal the head, Earth the chest and belly, Fire the hands and eyes, Water the ears and kidneys. When the flying and the hidden are both strong, the flying is the cause the illness turns on and the hidden is where the illness is received. Again, the Self as the moving line, inside, the lower part receives the illness; the Other as the moving line, outside, the upper part receives it; a between line moving means an illness of the chest and diaphragm. The Yijing says: for a person of the eldest son to fall ill it is fitting that the pure Zhen hexagram does not move, and for the youngest daughter to be infected that the Dui hexagram does not move. It is greatly feared that Shen and You hold the Self and a Wood line moves alone, for Shen is the mourning cart, You the mourning dress and Wood the coffin.

note.yi: 这一段和海底眼的（LY.ILL.HDY.05）几乎一字不差：「土动主吐水动主泻……木主足金主头土主胸腹火主手水主脾肾，飞伏俱旺相飞为起因……」，以及「易镜云：且如长男受病，宜纯震之不摇，小女染病，则兑卦之不动」。两本书里哪一本抄哪一本，书里没有说。这里和海底眼有几处字不同：火珠林是「土动主泻」、海底眼是「土动主吐」；火珠林是「火主手目」、海底眼是「火主手」；火珠林是「水主耳肾」、海底眼是「水主脾肾」；火珠林是「飞为化因，以伏为受病」、海底眼是「飞为起因，以代为受病」。「化因」「起因」都按「病由之而起的原因」译。「《易镜》」是一部书名，这里译作 Yijing，不是《周易》。「长男」是震，「少女」（原文「小女」）是兑。申为丧车、酉为丧服、木为棺椁，是拿字面取象。
note.en: This passage is almost word for word the same as the Haidi Yan's (LY.ILL.HDY.05): 'Earth moving means vomiting, Water moving means diarrhoea ... Wood governs the feet, Metal the head, Earth the chest and belly, Fire the hands, Water the spleen and kidneys; the flying and the hidden both strong, the flying is the origin ...', and 'the Yijing says: for a person of the eldest son to fall ill it is fitting that the pure Zhen hexagram does not move; for the youngest daughter to be infected that the Dui hexagram does not move'. Which of the two books copied the other, the books do not say. There are a few differences in characters from the Haidi Yan: the Huozhu Lin has 'Earth moving means diarrhoea' where the Haidi Yan has 'Earth moving means vomiting'; 'Fire the hands and eyes' where the Haidi Yan has 'Fire the hands'; 'Water the ears and kidneys' where the Haidi Yan has 'Water the spleen and kidneys'; and 'the flying is the cause, the hidden is where the illness is received' where the Haidi Yan has 'the flying is the origin, the substitute is where the illness is received'. Both 'hua yin' and 'qi yin' are rendered 'the cause the illness arises from'. 'Yijing' is the title of a book, here rendered Yijing, and is not the Zhouyi. The eldest son is Zhen and the youngest daughter (in the original 'the small daughter') is Dui. Shen as the mourning cart, You as the mourning dress and Wood as the coffin are images taken from the wording.

zh: 土动主泻，木动发寒，金动四肢或满闷，火动发热。
木主足，金主头、土主胸腹，火主手目，水主耳肾。
飞伏俱旺相，飞为化因，以伏为受病。
又世为动爻，在内下受病，应为动爻，在外上受病，间爻动，主胸膈病症。
yi: 土动主泻，木动发寒，金动主四肢或满闷，火动发热。
木主足，金主头，土主胸腹，火主手目，水主耳肾。
飞伏都旺相时，飞是化出病的原因，以伏为受病的地方。
又：世是动爻，在内则下部受病；应是动爻，在外则上部受病；间爻动，主胸膈的病。
en: Earth moving means diarrhoea, Wood moving means chills, Metal moving means the four limbs or oppression, Fire moving means fever.
Wood governs the feet, Metal the head, Earth the chest and belly, Fire the hands and eyes, Water the ears and kidneys.
When the flying and the hidden are both strong, the flying is the cause the illness turns on and the hidden is where the illness is received.

Again: the Self as the moving line, inside, the lower part receives the illness; the Other as the moving line, outside, the upper part receives it; a between line moving means an illness of the chest and diaphragm.

大忌申酉持世，木爻独发者，申为丧车，酉为丧服，木为棺椁耳。

大忌申、酉持世，木爻独发，因为申是丧车，酉是丧服，木是棺椁。

It is greatly feared that Shen and You hold the Self and a Wood line moves alone, for Shen is the mourning cart, You the mourning dress and Wood the coffin.

title: 病忌官鬼·以财为禄、以鬼为祟；鬼爻旺相独发大忌；占妇人病喜子孙旺相持世安静、忌财伏鬼下兄弟持世独发；世克应内克外主吐、应克世外克内主泻

rule.yi: 以财为禄，以鬼为祟；鬼爻旺相、独发，大忌。占妇人病，喜子孙旺相、持世、安静；忌财伏在鬼下、兄弟持世、兄弟独发。世克应、内克外，主吐；应克世、外克内，主泻。问答：妇人病喜子孙旺相、世安，是用财而以子孙辅助的道理；忌财伏鬼、兄弟持世，是用财伏在兄弟下的道理。内克外为什么主吐？内是腹、外是口；外克内主泻。
rule.en: Take Wealth as the salary and the ghost as the curse; the Pressure line strong and moving alone is a great taboo. In divining a woman's illness, it is welcome for Output to be strong, holding the Self and still; the taboos are Wealth hidden under the ghost, Peer holding the Self and Peer moving alone. The Self controlling the Other, the inner controlling the outer, means vomiting; the Other controlling the Self, the outer controlling the inner, means diarrhoea. Questions and answers: that in a woman's illness Output strong and the Self at peace is welcome is the principle of taking Wealth as the Subject with Output to help it; that Wealth hidden under the ghost and Peer holding the Self are taboo is the principle of the Subject Wealth hidden under Peer. Why does the inner controlling the outer mean vomiting? The inner is the belly and the outer is the mouth; the outer controlling the inner means diarrhoea.

note.yi: 「以财为禄，以鬼为祟」是这一节的主句：财爻是禄命（生机），鬼爻是祟（病）。「用财」是用神取财爻，占妇人病时以财爻为用神，所以要子孙辅助财、忌财伏在鬼或兄弟之下。「世克应、内克外主吐；应克世、外克内主泻」和断易天机孙膑歌的「外克内应克世有药频频泻肚肠、内克外世克应无鬼爻多呕吐伤」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.04）、洞林秘诀「我克他先呕逆、他克我泻为伤」（LY.ILL.DYTJ.16）、天玄赋的医药一节是同一条说法；这里给了理由：「内为腹、外为口」。「问：妇人病占喜子孙旺相、世安何也」里，「世安」是世爻安静。
note.en: 'Take Wealth as the salary and the ghost as the curse' is the main line of this section: the Wealth line is the salary (the life force) and the Pressure line is the curse (the illness). 'Taking Wealth as the Subject' is taking the Wealth line as the Subject, because in divining a woman's illness the Wealth line is the Subject, and so Output must help Wealth, and Wealth hidden under the ghost or Peer is taboo. 'The Self controlling the Other, the inner controlling the outer means vomiting; the Other controlling the Self, the outer controlling the inner means diarrhoea' is the same saying as Sun Bin's song in the Duanyi Tianji, 'the outer controlling the inner, the Other controlling the Self: purging again and again; the inner controlling the outer, the Self controlling the Other, with no Pressure line: mostly vomiting' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.04), the Dongling Mijue's 'if I control him there is retching first, if he controls me purging is the harm' (LY.ILL.DYTJ.16) and the section on medicine in the Tianxuan Fu; here the reason is given: 'the inner is the belly and the outer is the mouth'. In 'why is Output strong and the Self at peace welcome in a woman's illness', 'the Self at peace' is the Self line still.

yi: 以财为禄，
以鬼为祟；
鬼爻旺相，
独发大忌。
en: Take Wealth as the salary
and the ghost as the curse;
the Pressure line strong
and moving alone is a great taboo.

zh: 忌财伏鬼下，兄弟持世，兄弟独发。
yi: 凡是占妇人的病，
喜欢子孙旺相、持世、安静；
忌讳财伏在鬼下、兄弟持世、兄弟独发。
世克应、内克外，主吐；
应克世、外克内，主泻。
en: In divining a woman's illness,
it is welcome for Output to be strong, holding the Self and still;
the taboos are Wealth hidden under the ghost, Peer holding the Self and Peer moving alone.
The Self controlling the Other, the inner controlling the outer, means vomiting;
the Other controlling the Self, the outer controlling the inner, means diarrhoea.

zh: 或问：妇人病占喜子孙旺相、世安何也？
答曰：此即用财以子孙辅之义。
忌财伏鬼、兄弟持世，即用财伏兄之义。
yi: 有人问：妇人病占，喜子孙旺相、世安，是什么道理？
答：这就是用财而以子孙辅助它的道理。
忌讳财伏在鬼下、兄弟持世，就是用财而财伏在兄弟下的道理。
en: Someone asks: in divining a woman's illness why is Output strong and the Self at peace welcome?
The answer: this is the principle of taking Wealth as the Subject with Output to help it.
The taboo of Wealth hidden under the ghost and Peer holding the Self is the principle of the Subject Wealth hidden under Peer.

zh: 曰：内为腹、外为口也，外克内主泻。
yi: 又问：内克外为什么主吐？
答：内是腹、外是口，外克内主泻。
en: Asked again: why does the inner controlling the outer mean vomiting?
The answer: the inner is the belly and the outer is the mouth; the outer controlling the inner means diarrhoea.

title: 病忌父兄·主爻伏鬼或伏兄弟或伏父母旺相大忌；乱动之卦只取主爻、休囚伏兄弟父母官鬼之下克世者死（兄无食、父母无药、官鬼真病）；八纯游魂卦病者沉重占小儿主死

rule.yi: 主爻伏在鬼下，或伏在兄弟下，或伏在父母下，旺相是大忌。卦乱动时只取主爻：大抵休囚、伏在兄弟、父母、官鬼之下、又克世的，会死；因为兄弟没有食、父母没有药、官鬼是真病。凡得八纯卦、游魂卦，病人一定沉重，占小儿主死。问答：主爻伏鬼、伏兄伏父之下，就是财伏兄、财伏父母、官伏兄的道理，举一隅而三隅反；八纯、游魂、归魂三种卦，世持父母、官鬼、兄弟，或子孙伏在父母下，占大人是病重，占小儿是病死。
rule.en: The Subject line hidden under the ghost, or under Peer, or under Resource: if strong it is a great taboo. When the hexagram moves confusedly take only the Subject line: mostly one that is resting or trapped, hidden under Peer, Resource or the Pressure line and also controlling the Self, will die; for Peer has no food, Resource has no medicine and the Pressure line is a real illness. Whoever gets a pure hexagram or a Wandering Soul hexagram, the sick person is surely heavy, and for a small child it means death. Questions and answers: the Subject line hidden under the ghost, under Peer or under Resource is the principle of Wealth hidden under Peer, Wealth hidden under Resource, the official hidden under Peer, and 'raise one corner and the other three come back'; in the three kinds of hexagram, pure, Wandering Soul and Returning Soul, with the Self holding Resource, the Pressure line or Peer, or Output hidden under Resource, divining an adult it is a heavy illness and divining a small child the illness ends in death.

note.yi: 「主爻」是这一卦里代表病人的那一爻（用爻）。「兄无食，父母无药，官鬼真病」是这一节的解释：兄弟克财（食），父母克子孙（药），官鬼是病本身。「财伏兄」「财伏父母」「官伏兄」是「伏神」被飞神克的三种情形。「举一隅则三隅反」是《论语》的话，意思是举一个例子，别的照这个类推。「八纯」是八个纯卦（乾坤震巽坎离艮兑）；「游魂」「归魂」是卦名。第二问答里「世持父母、官鬼、兄弟，或子孙伏父母下」是说这三种卦在什么情形下会病重：世爻落在父母、官鬼、兄弟上，或子孙伏在父母下。「八纯游魂卦病重、占小儿主死」和天玄赋、易冒等处的八纯卦说法（LY.ILL.YM.12 一带）是同一类。
note.en: The 'Subject line' is the line that stands for the sick person in the hexagram (the Subject line). 'Peer has no food, Resource has no medicine and the Pressure line is a real illness' is the explanation of this section: Peer controls Wealth (food), Resource controls Output (medicine), and the Pressure line is the illness itself. 'Wealth hidden under Peer', 'Wealth hidden under Resource' and 'the official hidden under Peer' are three cases of the hidden spirit being controlled by the flying spirit. 'Raise one corner and the other three come back' is a saying of the Analects, meaning that from one example the others follow by analogy. 'Pure' means the eight pure hexagrams (Qian, Kun, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Li, Gen, Dui); 'Wandering Soul' and 'Returning Soul' are names of hexagrams. The second question and answer, 'the Self holding Resource, the Pressure line or Peer, or Output hidden under Resource', says under what conditions these three kinds of hexagram are heavy: the Self line falling on Resource, the Pressure line or Peer, or Output hidden under Resource. 'A pure or Wandering Soul hexagram is a heavy illness, for a small child it means death' is the same kind of saying as the sayings on the pure hexagrams in the Tianxuan Fu, the Yi Mao and elsewhere (around LY.ILL.YM.12).

yi: 主爻伏在鬼下，
或伏在兄弟下；
或伏在父母下，
旺相是大忌。
en: The Subject line hidden under the ghost,
or under Peer;
or under Resource:
if strong it is a great taboo.

zh: 大抵休囚、伏兄弟、父母、官鬼之下，
yi: 乱动的卦，
只取主爻，
大抵休囚、伏在兄弟、父母、官鬼之下，
又克世的，会死。
因为兄弟没有食，
父母没有药，
官鬼是真病。
凡得八纯卦、游魂卦，
病人一定沉重，
占小儿主死。
en: When the hexagram moves confusedly,
take only the Subject line:
mostly one that is resting or trapped, hidden under Peer, Resource or the Pressure line,
and also controlling the Self, will die.
For Peer has no food,
Resource has no medicine,
and the Pressure line is a real illness.
Whoever gets a pure hexagram or a Wandering Soul hexagram,
the sick person is surely heavy,
and for a small child it means death.

zh: 或问：主爻伏鬼，伏兄、伏父之下？
曰：此即财伏兄，财伏父母，官伏兄之义，举一隅，则三隅反矣。
yi: 有人问：主爻伏鬼，伏在兄、伏在父之下，是什么道理？
答：这就是财伏兄、财伏父母、官伏兄的道理，举出一隅，另外三隅就反推过来了。
en: Someone asks: the Subject line hidden under the ghost, hidden under Peer or under Resource, what is the principle?
The answer: this is Wealth hidden under Peer, Wealth hidden under Resource, and the official hidden under Peer; raise one corner and the other three come back.

zh: 又问：八纯、游魂、归魂卦，占病沉重，占小儿主死，何也？
曰：此三卦，世持父母，官鬼，兄弟，或子孙伏父母下，占大人病重，占小儿病死。
yi: 又问：八纯、游魂、归魂卦，占病沉重，占小儿主死，为什么？
答：这三种卦，世持父母、官鬼、兄弟，或子孙伏在父母下，占大人是病重，占小儿是病死。
en: Asked again: in the pure, Wandering Soul and Returning Soul hexagrams, divining illness it is heavy and divining a small child it means death, why?

The answer: in these three kinds of hexagram, with the Self holding Resource, the Pressure line or Peer, or Output hidden under Resource, divining an adult it is a heavy illness and divining a small child the illness ends in death.

title: 占医药·以应为医以子为药、鬼爻旺相大忌独发；卦之疾病以用为主以鬼为病；金鬼肺腑喘嗽、木鬼四肢不遂肝胆、水鬼沉寒腰痛肾气吐泻、火鬼头痛发热加朱雀狂言、土鬼脾胃发胀黄肿瘟疫

rule.yi: 以应为医生，以子孙为药；鬼爻旺相，最忌独发。卦里的疾病，以用爻为主，以鬼为病。金鬼：肺腑病、喘嗽、气急、虚怯、瘦瘠，或疮疥、血光，或筋骨病；木鬼：四肢不遂，肝胆主病，右痪左瘫，口眼歪斜；水鬼：沉塞、痼冷、腰痛、肾气淋沥、遗精、白浊、吐泻；火鬼：头痛发热、心胸焦渴，加朱雀则狂言谵语，阳症、伤寒、嗝逆；土鬼：脾胃发胀，黄肿虚浮，瘟疫时气。
rule.en: Take the Other as the doctor and Output as the medicine; the Pressure line strong is most feared moving alone. The illness of the hexagram takes the Subject line as the main and the ghost as the illness. A Metal ghost: illness of the lungs and viscera, panting and coughing, shortness of breath, deficiency and timidity, emaciation, or sores and scabies, bleeding, or an illness of the sinews and bones; a Wood ghost: the four limbs do not obey, the liver and gallbladder govern the illness, paralysis right and left, mouth and eyes awry; a Water ghost: stoppage, obstinate cold, pain in the waist, dribbling of the kidney qi, seminal emission, turbid urine, vomiting and diarrhoea; a Fire ghost: headache and fever, parched heart and chest, with the Vermilion Bird raving and delirium, a yang pattern, cold damage, hiccups; an Earth ghost: distension of the spleen and stomach, yellow swelling and puffiness, epidemics and seasonal qi.

note.yi: 「以应为医，以子为药」的分工和天玄赋（LY.ILL.TXF.12）、阐奥歌章医药章（LY.ILL.CA.09：应爻及外为医者、内卦身爻是病人）是同一套，这里说医是应、药是子孙。五行鬼的症候是天玄赋疾病章那一段（LY.ILL.TXF.03）的另一份，字句略有出入：天玄赋是「金鬼：肺腑病，咳嗽气，或疮疖、血光，或筋骨疼痛」，这里是「金鬼，肺腑疾、喘嗽、气急、虚怯、瘦瘠、或疮疥、血光，或筋骨病」，多了气急、虚怯、瘦瘠几项；水鬼这里有「沉塞、痼冷、腰痛、肾气淋沥、遗精、白浊、吐泻」，天玄赋是「沉寒痼冷，遗精白浊，小便淋沥，吐泻呕逆」。「嗝逆」按「打嗝、气逆」译。「阳症」是中医的阳证。这是中医术语，按字面译。
note.en: The division of 'the Other as the doctor, Output as the medicine' is the same set as the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.12) and the Chan'ao Gezhang's chapter on medicine (LY.ILL.CA.09: the Other line and the outer trigram are the doctor, the inner trigram and the Body line are the sick person), except that here the doctor is the Other and the medicine is Output. The symptoms of the ghost of each phase are another copy of that passage of the Tianxuan Fu's chapter on illness (LY.ILL.TXF.03), with small differences in wording: the Tianxuan Fu has 'a Metal ghost: illness of the lungs and viscera, coughing and qi, or sores and boils, bleeding, or aching of the sinews and bones', and this has 'a Metal ghost, illness of the lungs and viscera, panting and coughing, shortness of breath, deficiency and timidity, emaciation, or sores and scabies, bleeding, or an illness of the sinews and bones', with shortness of breath, deficiency and timidity and emaciation added; for the Water ghost this has 'stoppage, obstinate cold, pain in the waist, dribbling of the kidney qi, seminal emission, turbid urine, vomiting and diarrhoea', where the Tianxuan Fu has 'deep cold and obstinate chill, seminal emission and turbid urine, dribbling urine, vomiting, diarrhoea and retching'. 'Ge ni' is rendered 'hiccups'. A 'yang pattern' is the traditional medical yang pattern. These are terms of Chinese medicine and are rendered literally.

yi: 以应为医生，
以子孙为药；
鬼爻旺相，
最忌独发。
en: Take the Other as the doctor
and Output as the medicine;
the Pressure line strong
is most feared moving alone.

yi: 卦里的疾病，
以用爻为主，
以鬼为病。
en: The illness of the hexagram
takes the Subject line as the main
and the ghost as the illness.

zh: 金鬼，肺腑疾、喘嗽、气急、虚怯、瘦瘠、或疮疥、血光，或筋骨病。
木鬼，四肢不遂。肝胆主病、右痪左瘫、口眼歪斜。
yi: 金鬼：肺腑病、喘嗽、气急、虚怯、瘦瘠，或者疮疥、血光，或者筋骨病。
木鬼：四肢不听使唤；肝胆主病，右侧偏瘫、左侧瘫痪，口眼歪斜。
en: A Metal ghost: illness of the lungs and viscera, panting and coughing, shortness of breath, deficiency and timidity, emaciation, or sores and scabies, bleeding, or an illness of the sinews and bones.
A Wood ghost: the four limbs do not obey; the liver and gallbladder govern the illness, paralysis right and left, mouth and eyes awry.

zh: 水鬼，沉塞、痼冷、腰痛、肾气淋沥、遗精、白浊、吐泻。
yi: 水鬼：阻塞不通、顽固的寒冷、腰痛、肾气不固而小便淋沥、遗精、小便浑浊、呕吐腹泻。
en: A Water ghost: stoppage, obstinate cold, pain in the waist, dribbling of the kidney qi, seminal emission, turbid urine, vomiting and diarrhoea.

zh: 火鬼，头痛发热、心胸焦渴、加朱雀狂言谵语、阳症、伤寒、嗝逆。
土鬼，脾胃发胀；黄肿虚浮、瘟疫时气。
yi: 火鬼：头痛发热、心胸焦渴，加上朱雀则狂言谵语，还有阳症、伤寒、打嗝气逆。
土鬼：脾胃胀满；发黄、浮肿、虚浮，还有瘟疫和时令的病气。
en: A Fire ghost: headache and fever, parched heart and chest, with the Vermilion Bird raving and delirium, a yang pattern, cold damage, hiccups.
An Earth ghost: distension of the spleen and stomach; yellow swelling and puffiness, epidemics and seasonal qi.

hits.text: 土鬼：乃脾胃发瘴，水肿虚浮，瘟疫时气
土鬼：乃脾胃发胀，水肿，虚浮，瘟疫时气

title: 占医药·占病必察用爻（占父母必要父母有气）；纵遇凶卦但主沉重不致丧亡、用爻空亡及不上卦更逢凶杀决主不起；用爻无气得旁爻动来生扶同生旺；凶杀临父母或父母空可言双亲有病；鬼爻持世沉重绝日轻可；鬼化鬼病进退；鬼带杀持世为瘵病

rule.yi: 占病一定要察看用爻，占父母就一定要父母有气。纵然遇到凶卦，也只主沉重，不致丧亡；若用爻空亡或不上卦，又遇凶杀，一定不起。用爻无气，若有旁爻动来生扶，就和生旺一样，决没有灾。若凶杀临在父母上，或父母空，就可以说双亲有病，别的爻也一样。鬼爻持世，沉重，绝日轻可。鬼化鬼，病忽进忽退，或有变病，或旧病再发，或症候驳杂，一卦有两个鬼也一样。鬼爻持世，病难除根；鬼带杀持世，是瘵病，难脱体，是养老的病。
rule.en: In divining illness one must look at the Subject line; divining a parent the Resource line must have qi. Even meeting an ominous hexagram it only means heaviness and does not lead to death; but if the Subject line is Void or not in the hexagram and meets a killing as well, he surely does not rise. A Subject line without qi, if another line moves to generate and support it, is the same as strong and there is surely no harm. If a killing sits on Resource, or Resource is Void, one can say a parent is ill, and the other lines are the same. The Pressure line holding the Self: heavy, and light on a day of Extinction. A ghost changing into a ghost: the illness advances and retreats, or there is a changed illness, or an old illness breaks out again, or the symptoms are mixed, and two ghosts in one hexagram is the same. The Pressure line holding the Self: the illness is hard to root out; a ghost bringing a killing and holding the Self is a wasting illness that is hard to shake off, the illness of old age.

note.yi: 这一段和天玄赋「决轻重存亡之兆专察鬼爻」后面的注（LY.ILL.TXF.02）、「杀临父母，当忧堂上之亲」的用爻表（LY.ILL.TXF.01）是同一套；「鬼化鬼其病进退……鬼爻持世病难除根，鬼带杀持世乃瘵疾」两句在天玄赋的注里几乎一字不差。「绝日轻可」的「绝日」是鬼爻绝的日子。「瘵病」是痨病、消耗性的病，「养老病」按字面译作 the illness of old age，原文没有解释。「用爻」译作 Subject line。
note.en: This passage is the same set as the note after the Tianxuan Fu's 'to decide light or heavy, life or death, look only at the Pressure line' (LY.ILL.TXF.02) and the table of the Subject line, 'a killing sitting on Resource: worry for the elder on the hall' (LY.ILL.TXF.01); the two sentences 'a ghost changing into a ghost, the illness advances and retreats ... the Pressure line holding the Self, the illness is hard to root out, a ghost bringing a killing and holding the Self is a wasting illness' are almost word for word the same in the Tianxuan Fu's note. The 'day of Extinction' of 'light on a day of Extinction' is a day on which the Pressure line is in Extinction. A 'wasting illness' is consumption, an illness that wears the body down, and 'the illness of old age' is rendered literally, and the original does not explain it. 'Yong yao' is rendered Subject line.

zh: 凡占病，必察用爻，占父母，必要父母有气。
纵遇凶卦，但主沉重，不致丧亡，若用爻空亡及不上卦，更逢凶杀，决主不起。
用爻无气，若得旁爻动来生扶，此同生旺，决无咎处。
若凶杀临父母，或父母空，便可言双亲有病，诸爻皆然。
鬼爻持世，沉重，绝日轻可。
鬼化鬼，其病进退，或有变病，或旧病再发，或症候驳杂，一卦二鬼亦然。
鬼爻持世，病难除根，鬼带杀持世，为瘵病难脱体，乃养老病矣。
yi: 占病一定要察看用爻，占父母就一定要父母有气。
纵然遇到凶卦，也只主沉重，不致丧亡；若用爻空亡或不上卦，又遇凶杀，一定不起。
用爻无气，若有旁爻动来生扶，就和生旺一样，决没有灾。
若凶杀临在父母上，或父母空，就可以说双亲有病，别的爻也一样。
鬼爻持世，病沉重；到鬼爻绝的日子就轻些，可以好转。
鬼化鬼，病忽进忽退，或有变病，或旧病再发，或症候驳杂，一卦有两个鬼也一样。
鬼爻持世，病难除根；鬼带杀持世，是瘵病，难脱体，是养老的病。
en: In divining illness one must look at the Subject line; divining a parent the Resource line must have qi.
Even meeting an ominous hexagram it only means heaviness and does not lead to death; but if the Subject line is Void or not in the hexagram and meets a killing as well, he surely does not rise.
A Subject line without qi, if another line moves to generate and support it, is the same as strong and there is surely no harm.
If a killing sits on Resource, or Resource is Void, one can say a parent is ill, and the other lines are the same.
The Pressure line holding the Self: heavy, and light on a day of Extinction.

A ghost changing into a ghost: the illness advances and retreats, or there is a changed illness, or an old illness breaks out again, or the symptoms are mixed, and two ghosts in one hexagram is the same.
The Pressure line holding the Self: the illness is hard to root out; a ghost bringing a killing and holding the Self is a wasting illness that is hard to shake off, the illness of old age.

title: 占医药·青龙临用爻或福德爻病重终可疗、青龙空亡卦无吉解病凶；白虎临父母当损、值财妻遭伤、子孙际遇终成否、兄弟逢之亦不昌、更并官爻临世上自身须忌灾殃

rule.yi: 青龙临在用爻或福德爻上，病虽重，终究可治；青龙空亡、卦里又没有吉的化解，病凶。白虎临父母，父母当受损；若落在财上，妻子遭伤；遇上子孙，终究成否难定；兄弟遇上它，也不昌盛。再加官爻临在世上，自己就要忌灾殃。
rule.en: With the Azure Dragon sitting on the Subject line or the Output line, the illness, though heavy, can in the end be treated; with the Azure Dragon Void and the hexagram having no lucky resolution, the illness is ominous. The White Tiger sitting on Resource harms it; if it falls on Wealth the wife is injured; meeting Output, success in the end is uncertain; and Peer meeting it does not flourish either. And with the Pressure line also sitting on the Self, one must guard against calamity for oneself.

note.yi: 这一段是天玄赋的注里引的「苍屏云」那首诗（LY.ILL.TXF.04）的另一份：「青龙空亡并福德，病人平日无阴骘……白虎加临主哭丧，临克父爻当有咎，并财妻位必遭伤。子孙际会终成否，兄弟相逢更不昌，更值官爻持世上，己身须恐有灾殃」——这里「白虎临父母当损，若值财上妻遭伤，子孙际遇终成否，兄弟逢之亦不昌，更并官爻临世上，自身须忌有灾殃」几句几乎一样，只是没有「苍屏云」三个字，也没有那一首前面的「青龙」几句。「终成否」按「终究成不成（难定）」译，原文没有说结果。「福德爻」译作 Output line。
note.en: This passage is another copy of the poem quoted in the Tianxuan Fu's note as 'Cangping says' (LY.ILL.TXF.04): 'the Azure Dragon Void together with Output, the sick person has no hidden merit in ordinary days ... the White Tiger added means mourning, controlling the Resource line there will be harm, joining the Wealth position the wife will surely be injured; Output meeting it, success in the end is uncertain, Peer meeting it flourishes even less, and if in addition the Pressure line holds the Self, one must fear calamity for oneself'. Here 'the White Tiger sitting on Resource harms it, if it falls on Wealth the wife is injured, Output meeting it, success in the end is uncertain, Peer meeting it does not flourish either, and with the Pressure line also sitting on the Self, one must guard against calamity for oneself' is almost the same, only without the words 'Cangping says' and without the Azure Dragon lines before it in that poem. 'Zhong cheng fou' is rendered 'success in the end is uncertain', and the original does not say the outcome. 'Fu de yao' is rendered the Output line.

yi: 青龙临在用爻或福德爻上，
病虽重，终究可治；
青龙空亡、卦里又没有吉的化解，
病情凶险。
en: With the Azure Dragon sitting on the Subject line or the Output line,
the illness, though heavy, can in the end be treated;
with the Azure Dragon Void and the hexagram having no lucky resolution,
the illness is ominous.

yi: 白虎临父母，父母当受损；
若落在财上，妻子遭伤。
子孙遇上它，终究成不成难定；
兄弟遇上它，也不昌盛。
再加官爻临在世上，
自己就要忌灾殃。
en: The White Tiger sitting on Resource harms it;
if it falls on Wealth the wife is injured.
Output meeting it, success in the end is uncertain;
and Peer meeting it does not flourish either.
And with the Pressure line also sitting on the Self,
one must guard against calamity for oneself.

title: 占医药·金鬼不宜针、木鬼不宜草木、水鬼不宜汤饮汤洗、火鬼不宜灸熨、土鬼不宜服丸药；金鬼可炙木鬼药方水鬼宜热剂土鬼宜木药；金鬼利南方木鬼利西方水鬼利土值火鬼利北方土鬼利东方求请医者；丑鬼不可食牛肉未子孙当食羊

rule.yi: 金鬼不宜针，木鬼不宜草木，水鬼不宜汤饮汤洗之类，火鬼不宜灸熨，土鬼不宜服丸药；金鬼可以炙，木鬼用药方，火鬼带服鬼剂，水鬼宜服热剂，土鬼宜服木药。金鬼利南方，木鬼利西方，水鬼利土值，火鬼利北方，土鬼利东方，去求请医生。又：丑鬼不可食牛肉，未是子孙就该吃羊肉。
rule.en: A Metal ghost must not be needled, a Wood ghost must not have grasses and woods, a Water ghost must not have hot drinks or hot washing and the like, a Fire ghost must not have moxibustion or hot compresses, an Earth ghost must not take pills; a Metal ghost can be burned with moxa, a Wood ghost takes a prescription, a Fire ghost takes ghost medicine along, a Water ghost should take a hot remedy, an Earth ghost should take Wood medicine. A Metal ghost is favoured by the south, a Wood ghost by the west, a Water ghost by the earth quarter, a Fire ghost by the north and an Earth ghost by the east, in seeking and inviting a doctor. Again: a Chou ghost must not eat beef, and where Wei is Output one should eat mutton.

dispute.yi: 治法和请医的方位，火珠林和天玄赋大体一致，有两处不同。一、土鬼：天玄赋（LY.ILL.TXF.13）是「土鬼宜锉散」，火珠林这里是「土鬼宜服木药」「土鬼不宜服丸药」；二、水鬼请医的方位：天玄赋是「水鬼利四散医人」，火珠林这里是「水鬼利土值」。增删卜易（LY.ILL.ZS.34）另有一说，请医的方位不看鬼的五行，看子孙和应爻的方位（见 TXF.13 的「打架」）。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The treatment and the direction of the doctor are broadly agreed between the Huozhu Lin and the Tianxuan Fu, with two differences. One, the Earth ghost: the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.13) has 'an Earth ghost is fit for cut powders', and the Huozhu Lin here has 'an Earth ghost should take Wood medicine' and 'an Earth ghost must not take pills'; two, the direction for a doctor for a Water ghost: the Tianxuan Fu has 'a Water ghost is favoured by a doctor from all quarters' and the Huozhu Lin here has 'a Water ghost by the earth quarter'. The Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.34) has yet another view, that the direction of the doctor is looked at not by the phase of the ghost but by the quarter of Output and the Other line (see the dispute in TXF.13). The books do not settle it.

note.yi: 这一段和天玄赋的医药一节（LY.ILL.TXF.13）相近：天玄赋是「火鬼宜凉剂，水鬼宜温剂或丸药，木鬼宜针，金鬼宜灸，土鬼宜锉散……金鬼利南方医人，木鬼利西方医人，水鬼利四散医人，火鬼利北方医人，土鬼利东方医人」。两处大部分一致（金宜灸不宜针、水宜热剂、请医的方位是克这一行的方位），不一致的是土鬼：天玄赋说宜锉散，这里说宜木药、不宜丸药；水鬼的方位，天玄赋是「四散」，这里是「土值」（字面译作 the earth quarter，「值」的意思原文没有解释，可能是「值土」）。「金鬼可炙，木鬼药方，火鬼带服鬼剂」中「带服鬼剂」的「鬼剂」不清楚，字面译作 ghost medicine。「丑鬼不可（食）牛肉」的「（食）」是原文里的圆括号。忌食鬼爻所属生肖的肉、宜食子孙所属生肖的肉，和洞林秘诀（LY.ILL.DYTJ.16）是同一个说法。
note.en: This passage is close to the Tianxuan Fu's section on medicine (LY.ILL.TXF.13): the Tianxuan Fu has 'a Fire ghost is fit for a cooling remedy, a Water ghost for a warm remedy or pills, a Wood ghost for the needle, a Metal ghost for moxa, an Earth ghost for cut powders ... a Metal ghost is favoured by a doctor from the south, a Wood ghost by one from the west, a Water ghost by one from all quarters, a Fire ghost by one from the north, an Earth ghost by one from the east'. They mostly agree (moxa for Metal and no needle, a hot remedy for Water, and the direction of the doctor being the direction that controls the phase); where they differ is the Earth ghost: the Tianxuan Fu says cut powders, this says Wood medicine and not pills; and for the Water ghost's direction the Tianxuan Fu has 'all quarters' and this has 'the earth quarter' (rendered literally, the original does not explain 'zhi' (rule, hold), which may be 'ruled by Earth'). The 'ghost medicine' of 'a Fire ghost takes ghost medicine along' is not clear and is rendered literally. The '(shi)' of 'a Chou ghost must not (eat) beef' is a round bracket in the original. Avoiding the meat of the animal of the ghost line and eating the meat of the animal of Output is the same saying as the Dongling Mijue (LY.ILL.DYTJ.16).

zh: 水鬼不宜汤饮汤洗之类，
yi: 金鬼不宜针，
木鬼不宜草木，
水鬼不宜用热汤饮用、热汤洗浴之类，
火鬼不宜灸熨，
土鬼不宜服丸药。
金鬼可以炙，
木鬼用药方，
火鬼带服鬼剂，
水鬼宜服热剂，
土鬼宜服木药。
en: A Metal ghost must not be needled,
a Wood ghost must not have grasses and woods,
a Water ghost must not have hot drinks or hot washing and the like,
a Fire ghost must not have moxibustion or hot compresses,
an Earth ghost must not take pills.
A Metal ghost can be burned with moxa,
a Wood ghost takes a prescription,
a Fire ghost takes ghost medicine along,
a Water ghost should take a hot remedy,
an Earth ghost should take Wood medicine.

yi: 金鬼利南方，
木鬼利西方，
水鬼利土值，
火鬼利北方，
土鬼利东方，去求请医生。
另外：
丑鬼不可（食）牛肉，
未子孙当食羊。
en: A Metal ghost is favoured by the south,
a Wood ghost by the west,
a Water ghost by the earth quarter,
a Fire ghost by the north,
and an Earth ghost by the east, in seeking and inviting a doctor.
Again:
a Chou ghost must not eat beef,
and where Wei is Output one should eat mutton.

title: 占医药·鬼爻在内病自内生、鬼在外灾自外至；火鬼必在南方、金鬼必在西方道路生灾主胸；金鬼病在肺家逢火作脓见木生风遇蛇虚闷

rule.yi: 鬼爻在内，病从里面生；鬼在外，灾从外面来。火鬼必在南方；金鬼必在西方，路上生灾，又主胸；金鬼则病在肺，逢火成脓，见木生风，遇螣蛇则虚闷。
rule.en: The Pressure line inside, the illness arises from within; the ghost outside, the calamity comes from outside. A Fire ghost must be in the south; a Metal ghost must be in the west, calamity arising on the road, and it governs the chest as well; a Metal ghost then has the illness in the lungs, meeting Fire it makes pus, seeing Wood it breeds wind, and meeting the Snake it is a deficient oppression.

note.yi: 「鬼爻在内，病自内生，鬼又在外，灾自外至」是内外分病的来处，和易林补遗「何处得病」（LY.ILL.EL.03）、天玄赋「六兽临官当分内外」（LY.ILL.TXF.09）是同一类说法。「遇蛇虚闷」的「蛇」是螣蛇；「又为主胸」一句读不确定，按「又主胸」译。「金鬼必在西方，道路生灾」是拿五行配方位（金在西）、又配「路上」取象。
note.en: 'The Pressure line inside, the illness arises from within; the ghost outside, the calamity comes from outside' is the division of where the illness comes from by inside and outside, of the same kind as the Yilin Buyi's 'where the illness was caught' (LY.ILL.EL.03) and the Tianxuan Fu's 'the six beasts on the official: tell inside from outside' (LY.ILL.TXF.09). The 'snake' of 'meeting the Snake' is the Coiling Snake; the line 'wei zhu xiong' (and it governs the chest) is not certain and is rendered 'and it governs the chest as well'. 'A Metal ghost must be in the west, calamity arising on the road' matches the phase to a quarter (Metal in the west) and takes the image of the road.

yi: 鬼爻在内，
病从里面生；
鬼又在外，
灾从外面来。
火鬼必在南方；
金鬼必在西方，
路上生灾，
而且又主胸部；
金鬼则病在肺，
遇火成脓，
见木生风，
遇蛇则虚闷。
en: The Pressure line inside,
the illness arises from within;
the ghost being outside,
the calamity comes from outside.
A Fire ghost must be in the south;
a Metal ghost must be in the west,
calamity arising on the road,
and it governs the chest as well;
a Metal ghost then has the illness in the lungs,
meeting Fire it makes pus,
seeing Wood it breeds wind,
and meeting the Snake it is a deficient oppression.

title: 占鬼神·休囚为鬼旺相为神、本象家亲他宫外人；六爻定体：六爻公婆家亲佛道、五爻父母口愿土神、四爻叔伯土神半天、三爻兄弟门户境神、二爻夫妻土地家神、初爻小口灶君司命

rule.yi: 休囚的是鬼，旺相的是神；在本象里的是家亲，在他宫里的是外人。六爻各有所主：六爻是公婆、家亲、佛道；五爻是父母、口愿、土神；四爻是叔伯、土神、半天；三爻是兄弟、门户、境神；二爻是夫妻、土地、家神；初爻是小口、灶君、司命。
rule.en: Resting or trapped it is a ghost, strong it is a spirit; in the own image it is the family ancestors, in another palace an outsider. The six lines each govern something: the sixth line the in-laws, the family ancestors and Buddhist and Daoist spirits; the fifth the parents, vows and the Earth spirit; the fourth uncles, the Earth spirit and the half-sky spirit; the third brothers, the doors and the district spirit; the second husband and wife, the Earth God and the household spirit; the first the children, the Hearth Lord and the Life-Governing Spirit.

dispute.yi: 爻位配鬼神，几本书的配法不同。火珠林这里：初爻小口、灶君、司命；二爻夫妻、土地、家神；三爻兄弟、门户、境神；四爻叔伯、土神、半天；五爻父母、口愿、土神；六爻公婆、家亲、佛道。卜筮全书的六位表（LY.ILL.BSQS.02）：初爻井神、二爻司命、三爻家先、四爻土地、五爻社司、六爻天神。易林补遗（LY.ILL.EL.37）是「六爻上仓至圣坟墓之神、五爻中界东岳、四爻右仪门将军、三爻家堂郡王府城隍、二爻县城隍灶神」这一路。同一位置配的神不同：二爻火珠林是土地、家神，卜筮全书是司命，易林补遗是灶神；初爻火珠林是灶君、司命，卜筮全书是井神；六爻火珠林是佛道，卜筮全书是天神，易林补遗是坟墓之神。各家按各地的习俗立说，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Books match line positions to ghosts and spirits differently. The Huozhu Lin here: first line the children, the Hearth Lord, the Life-Governing Spirit; second husband and wife, the Earth God, the household spirit; third brothers, the doors, the district spirit; fourth uncles, the Earth spirit, the half-sky spirit; fifth parents, vows, the Earth spirit; sixth in-laws, family ancestors, Buddhist and Daoist spirits. The table of the six positions in the Bushi Quanshu (LY.ILL.BSQS.02): first line the well spirit, second the Life-Governing Spirit, third the family ancestors, fourth the Earth God, fifth the village altar spirit, sixth the heavenly spirit. The Yilin Buyi (LY.ILL.EL.37) runs along the lines of 'the sixth line the spirit of the high granary and the sage's tomb, the fifth the Eastern Peak of the middle realm, the fourth the general of the right gate, the third the household shrine, the prince and the city god of the prefecture, the second the county city god and the Kitchen God'. The spirit matched to the same position differs: for the second line the Huozhu Lin has the Earth God and the household spirit, the Bushi Quanshu the Life-Governing Spirit and the Yilin Buyi the Kitchen God; for the first line the Huozhu Lin has the Hearth Lord and the Life-Governing Spirit and the Bushi Quanshu the well spirit; for the sixth line the Huozhu Lin has Buddhist and Daoist spirits, the Bushi Quanshu the heavenly spirit and the Yilin Buyi the spirits of the tombs. Each sets it up by the customs of its own place, and the books do not settle it.

note.yi: 这一节头两句是总纲：休囚的是鬼（作祟的死者），旺相的是神（正神）；鬼落在本象里是家里的先人（家亲），落在别的宫里是外人。「六爻定体」是一张按爻位配对象的表，原书是一格一格排的：每一爻三样，第一样像是六亲的位置（六爻公婆、五爻父母、四爻叔伯、三爻兄弟、二爻夫妻、初爻小口），后两样是鬼神（家亲、佛道；口愿、土神；土神、半天；门户、境神；土地、家神；灶君、司命），但书里没有说三样各是什么，这里只照原样列出，不分栏。「公婆」是丈夫的父母（或祖父母），「境神」是一方境内的神，「半天」是半天之神（取象于四爻在半空），原文没有解释，只是字面译。表末的「（2）五行鬼：」是下一节的小标题，连在同一行里，所以放在这一条的末尾。这一张表（初灶君司命、二土地家神、三门户境神……）和卜筮全书的六爻诸占定位里的鬼神一行（初井神、二司命、三家先、四土地、五社司、六天神，LY.ILL.BSQS.02）、易林补遗的按爻位断神鬼（LY.ILL.EL.37）是同一类，配法各家不同，见「打架」。
note.en: The first two sentences of this section are the general outline: resting or trapped it is a ghost (a dead person who brings a curse), strong it is a spirit (a proper god); a ghost falling in the own image is the family's ancestors (family ancestors), and falling in another palace it is an outsider. 'The six lines fix the body' is a table matching line positions to objects, laid out cell by cell in the original: three items to each line, the first seeming to be the position of a relation (the sixth line in-laws, the fifth parents, the fourth uncles, the third brothers, the second husband and wife, the first children), and the latter two being ghosts and spirits (family ancestors, Buddhist and Daoist; vows, the Earth spirit; the Earth spirit, the half-sky spirit; the doors, the district spirit; the Earth God, the household spirit; the Hearth Lord, the Life-Governing Spirit), but the book does not say what each of the three is, and here they are only listed as they stand without separating columns. 'Gong po' are the husband's parents (or grandparents), 'the district spirit' is the spirit of a territory, and 'the half-sky spirit' is the spirit of half-heaven (taking the image of the fourth line as being in mid-air), which the original does not explain, and they are rendered literally. The '(2) the ghosts of the five phases' at the end of the table is the small heading of the next section, run into the same line, and so it is placed at the end of this entry. This table (first Hearth Lord and Life-Governing Spirit, second Earth God and household spirit, third the doors and district spirit ...) is of the same kind as the row for spirits in the table of the positions of the lines in the Bushi Quanshu (first the well spirit, second the Life-Governing Spirit, third the family ancestors, fourth the Earth God, fifth the village altar spirit, sixth the heavenly spirit, LY.ILL.BSQS.02) and the Yilin Buyi's judging spirits by line position (LY.ILL.EL.37), and each puts the matching differently, see the dispute.

yi: 休囚的是鬼，旺相的是神；
在本象里的是家亲，在他宫里的是外人。
（1）六爻各自所定的所主之体：
六爻：公婆、家亲、佛道
五爻：父母、口愿、土神
四爻：叔伯、土神、半天
三爻：兄弟、门户、境神
二爻：夫妻、土地、家神
初爻：小口、灶君、司命
（2）五行的鬼：
en: Resting or trapped it is a ghost, strong it is a spirit;
in the own image it is the family ancestors, in another palace an outsider.
(1) What each of the six lines fixes as its body:
the sixth line: the in-laws, the family ancestors, Buddhist and Daoist spirits
the fifth line: the parents, vows, the Earth spirit
the fourth line: uncles, the Earth spirit, the half-sky spirit
the third line: brothers, the doors, the district spirit
the second line: husband and wife, the Earth God, the household spirit
the first line: the children, the Hearth Lord, the Life-Governing Spirit
(2) The ghosts of the five phases:

title: 占鬼神·五行鬼：金木横死、土时疫、火劳血、水落水；八纯卦：艮五圣、震天神、巽木神、离火神、乾功德、坤家将、坎落水、兑口愿

rule.yi: 五行的鬼：金、木是横死，土是时疫，火是劳血，水是落水。八个纯卦：艮是五圣，震是天神，巽是木神，离是火神，乾是功德，坤是家将，坎是落水，兑是口愿。
rule.en: The ghosts of the five phases: Metal and Wood are violent death, Earth an epidemic, Fire consumption with spitting blood, Water drowning.
