The eight pure hexagrams: Gen is the Five Sages, Zhen the heavenly spirit, Xun the tree spirit, Li the fire spirit, Qian merit, Kun the household generals, Kan drowning, Dui vows.

note.yi: 「五行鬼」是鬼爻属哪一行，就是哪一种死者：金木是横死（意外而死）、土是时疫（死于瘟疫）、火是劳血（劳伤吐血）、水是落水（淹死）。「八纯卦」是鬼落在八个纯卦里对应的神：艮五圣、震天神、巽木神、离火神、乾功德、坤家将、坎落水、兑口愿。「功德」是为功德而许的斋供，「家将」是家里供的将军神，「口愿」是口头许下的愿，这三处原文没有解释，是字面加常识的译法。五行鬼的分法和易林补遗的「金鬼配六兽」等（LY.ILL.EL.30 到 EL.34）、易冒的五行值鬼是同一类，各家说法大同小异：金鬼易林补遗说是「刀下之魂、喘咳横亡之鬼」，这里说是横死；火鬼易林补遗是「毒疮痨之魂、带血焚烧之鬼」，这里说是劳血；水鬼两处都是落水一类。
note.en: 'The ghosts of the five phases' says that whichever phase the ghost line belongs to is the kind of dead person: Metal and Wood a violent death (dying by accident), Earth an epidemic (dying of a plague), Fire consumption (wasting and spitting blood), Water drowning. 'The eight pure hexagrams' gives the spirit matched to a ghost falling in each of the eight pure hexagrams: Gen the Five Sages, Zhen the heavenly spirit, Xun the tree spirit, Li the fire spirit, Qian merit, Kun the household generals, Kan drowning, Dui vows. 'Merit' is a fast offering vowed for merit, the 'household generals' are the general spirits worshipped in the house, and 'vows' are vows spoken aloud; the original does not explain these three, and they are rendered literally with common sense. This way of dividing the ghosts by five phases is of the same kind as the Yilin Buyi's 'a Metal ghost matched to the six beasts' and so on (LY.ILL.EL.30 to EL.34) and the Yi Mao's ghost by five phases, and the books are much alike: for the Metal ghost the Yilin Buyi says 'the soul of one killed by a blade, the ghost of one who died of coughing and panting', where this says violent death; for the Fire ghost the Yilin Buyi says 'the soul of a poisonous sore or consumption, the ghost of burning with blood', where this says consumption with blood; for the Water ghost both say drowning.

yi: 金、木，是横死的鬼；
土，是时疫；
火，是劳伤吐血；
水，是落水。
八个纯卦：
艮，是五圣；
震，是天神；
巽，是木神；
离，是火神；
乾，是功德；
坤，是家将；
坎，是落水；
兑，是口愿。
en: Metal and Wood: a violent death;
Earth: an epidemic of the season;
Fire: consumption with spitting blood;
Water: drowning.
The eight pure hexagrams:
Gen: the Five Sages;
Zhen: the heavenly spirit;
Xun: the tree spirit;
Li: the fire spirit;
Qian: merit and virtue;
Kun: the household generals;
Kan: drowning;
Dui: vows.

title: 占鬼神·五乡独发克日克世取之：父母家先、子孙小儿、妻财妇婢、兄弟阳人、官鬼横恶；本象鬼动是家亲、旁爻鬼动是外人；土鬼是当处灵验之鬼、旺相为神休囚为鬼；《易林》察祸推其鬼处

rule.yi: 五种六亲独发，克日、克世的取它，各有两层意思：父母是家先，子孙是小儿，妻财是妇人婢女，兄弟是阳人（男人），官鬼是横恶，以上随爻取。本象里的鬼动是家亲，旁爻的鬼动是外人；比如乾卦壬午鬼动是家亲，大有卦己巳鬼动是外人。土鬼是当地灵验的鬼，俗称神：旺相是神，休囚是鬼；动爻克世克日，也可以取来断祟。《易林》说：察祸要推它的鬼在什么地方，再拿身去配六亲，相克招生，就看见祸的端的。
rule.en: When one of the five quarters moves alone, take the one that controls the Day or the Self; each has two senses: Resource is the ancestors of the house, Output the small children, Wealth women and maids, Peer men (yang people), the Pressure line violent evil; the above follow the line. A ghost moving in the own image is the family ancestors, a ghost moving on a side line is an outsider; for example, in Qian a ghost moving on Ren Wu is the family ancestors, and in Dayou a ghost moving on Ji Si is an outsider. An Earth ghost is a ghost efficacious in the place, commonly called a spirit: strong it is a spirit, resting or trapped it is a ghost; a moving line controlling the Self or the Day can also be taken to judge a curse. The Yilin says: to examine a calamity, work out where its ghost is, and then match the Body to the six relations; control brings generation, and the true beginning of the calamity is seen.

note.yi: 「五乡」指五种六亲（父母、子孙、妻财、兄弟、官鬼）这几个位置，「独发」是只有一爻动，「各有两义」是每一种六亲各有两层意思：一层是它本来的人物，一层是它作为鬼的样子（父母是家先，子孙是小儿，妻财是妇婢，兄弟是阳人，官鬼是横恶）。原文「他官外人」的「官」是「宫」之误，问答里同样，这里按「宫」译。「本象」是本卦本身，「他宫」是别的宫；乾卦的官鬼是午火，「壬午」是乾卦第四爻，鬼在本象里动，所以是家亲；大有卦（离宫）的鬼是亥水，「己巳」是巳火，和大有所属的宫（乾宫）相比是别宫的爻，所以是外人——原文没有把这层推理写出来，这一句我只按字面译。「《易林》」是书名，译作 Yilin。「身」是卦身。「相克招生」是被克的一方带来生机，原文没有解释。这一节和易林补遗的「六亲内外动断是谁的鬼」（LY.ILL.EL.40）是同一类。
note.en: The 'five quarters' are the five relations (Resource, Output, Wealth, Peer, the Pressure line), 'moving alone' is only one line moving, and 'each has two senses' is that each relation has two layers: the person it originally is, and how it looks as a ghost (Resource the ancestors of the house, Output small children, Wealth women and maids, Peer yang people, the Pressure line violent evil). The 'guan' of 'ta guan wai ren' in the original is a miswriting of 'gong' (palace), and so in the questions, and it is rendered palace here. The 'own image' is the hexagram itself and 'another palace' is a different palace; in the sentence about Qian and Dayou, the original does not spell out the reasoning behind 'Ren Wu' and 'Ji Si' and only the words are rendered here. The 'Yilin' is the title of a book. The 'Body' is the hexagram Body. 'Control brings generation' says that the one controlled brings a chance of life, and the original does not explain it. This section is of the same kind as the Yilin Buyi's 'which of the six relations moving inside or outside tells whose ghost it is' (LY.ILL.EL.40).

zh: 五乡独发，克日克世取之，各有两义：
父母家先，子孙小儿，妻财妇婢，兄弟阳人，官鬼横恶，以上随爻。
或问：本象家先，他官外人，何也？
答曰：本象鬼动是家亲，旁爻鬼动是外人。假如乾卦壬午鬼动是家亲；大有卦己巳鬼动，是外人也。
此乃当处灵验之鬼，俗谓之神者也，旺相为神，休囚为鬼，动爻克世克日，亦可取祟。
《易林》云：察祸推其鬼处，还将身配六亲，相克招生，便见祸之端的。
yi: 五种六亲独发，克日、克世的取它，各有两层意思：
父母是家先，子孙是小儿，妻财是妇人婢女，兄弟是阳人，官鬼是横恶，以上随爻取。
有人问：本象是家先、他宫是外人，是什么道理？
答：本象里的鬼动是家亲，旁爻的鬼动是外人；比如乾卦壬午鬼动是家亲，大有卦己巳鬼动是外人。
问：土鬼是什么？答：
这是当地灵验的鬼，俗称为神；旺相是神，休囚是鬼，动爻克世克日，也可以取来断祟。
《易林》说：察祸要推它的鬼在什么地方，再拿身去配六亲，相克招生，就看见祸的端的。
en: When one of the five quarters moves alone, take the one that controls the Day or the Self; each has two senses:
Resource is the ancestors of the house, Output the small children, Wealth women and maids, Peer men (yang people), the Pressure line violent evil; the above follow the line.
Someone asks: in the own image it is the ancestors of the house and in another palace an outsider, what is the principle?

The answer: a ghost moving in the own image is the family ancestors, a ghost moving on a side line is an outsider; for example, in Qian a ghost moving on Ren Wu is the family ancestors, and in Dayou a ghost moving on Ji Si is an outsider.
Asked: what is an Earth ghost? The answer:

this is a ghost efficacious in the place, commonly called a spirit: strong it is a spirit, resting or trapped it is a ghost; a moving line controlling the Self or the Day can also be taken to judge a curse.
The Yilin says: to examine a calamity, work out where its ghost is, and then match the Body to the six relations; control brings generation, and the true beginning of the calamity is seen.

hits.text: 易镜云：察祸推其鬼处，还将身配六亲，相克相生，便见祸之端

title: 占鬼神·附六神：青龙善恶经文蘸祀庙香、无气带刑自缢死；朱雀花幡口愿符命灶神、劳死鬼；勾陈天曹勅士、黄病路死鬼；螣蛇夜梦惊恐上许下保福、夜梦见鬼；白虎金刘神作犯白虎刀伤鬼；玄武上真北阴神、落水阴鬼

rule.yi: 附六神。青龙：善恶、经文、蘸祀、庙香；无气带刑，是自缢死的鬼。朱雀：花幡、口愿、符命、灶神；无气带刑，是劳死的鬼。勾陈：天曹、勅士；无气带刑，是黄病、路死的鬼。螣蛇：夜梦、惊恐、上许下保福；无气带刑，是夜梦见鬼。白虎：金刘神、作犯白虎、刀伤鬼；无气带刑，是刀伤鬼。玄武：上真、北阴神；无气带刑，是落水的阴鬼。
rule.en: Appended, the six spirits. The Azure Dragon: good and evil, scriptures, sacrificial rites, temple incense; without qi and bearing a punishment, a ghost of hanging. The Vermilion Bird: flower banners, spoken vows, talismans, the Kitchen God; without qi and bearing a punishment, a ghost who died of toil. Hook Earth: the Heavenly Bureau, the commissioned officers; without qi and bearing a punishment, a ghost of jaundice, or of dying on the road. The Coiling Snake: dreams at night, fright, vows made above and thanks given below; without qi and bearing a punishment, seeing ghosts in dreams at night. The White Tiger: the Jin Liu spirit, the offence-making White Tiger, the ghost of a blade wound; without qi and bearing a punishment, a ghost of a blade wound. The Dark Tortoise: the high true one, the North Yin spirit; without qi and bearing a punishment, a yin ghost of drowning.

note.yi: 这一节把六神各自的神和死鬼列出来：每一神前半是它管的神（青龙善恶、经文、蘸祀、庙香；朱雀花幡、口愿、符命、灶神……），后半「无气带刑」是这一神所临的爻无气又带刑时的鬼（青龙自缢死、朱雀劳死、勾陈黄病路死、螣蛇夜梦见鬼、白虎刀伤、玄武落水阴鬼）。「蘸祀」是醮祀，「上许下保福」是上面许愿、下面还愿保福，「金刘神」「作犯白虎」的意思原文没有解释，字面译。「上真」是高一级的真人，「北阴」是北方阴神。原文「六神」二字连在上一行「附：」的后面，又接在「青龙：」前面，所以「附」「六神」分成两个小句。这一节和易林补遗的「总论六神值诀」（LY.ILL.EL.47）是同一类，神名和鬼名各有出入。
note.en: This section lists for each of the six spirits its gods and its dead ghost: the first half of each is the gods it governs (the Azure Dragon good and evil, scriptures, sacrificial rites, temple incense; the Vermilion Bird flower banners, spoken vows, talismans, the Kitchen God ...), and the second half 'without qi and bearing a punishment' is the ghost when the line the spirit sits on is without qi and bears a punishment (the Azure Dragon a ghost of hanging, the Vermilion Bird died of toil, Hook Earth jaundice or dying on the road, the Coiling Snake seeing ghosts in dreams, the White Tiger a blade wound, the Dark Tortoise a yin ghost of drowning). 'Sacrificial rites' is a jiao offering, 'vows made above and thanks given below' is a vow made above and redeemed below to keep fortune, and what the 'Jin Liu spirit' and the 'offence-making White Tiger' mean the original does not explain, and they are rendered literally. The 'high true one' is a true one of a higher rank and the 'North Yin' is the yin spirit of the north. In the original the two characters for 'the six spirits' run on from 'appended' on the line before and run into 'the Azure Dragon:' after, so 'appended' and 'the six spirits' are made two small pieces. This section is of the same kind as the Yilin Buyi's 'general discussion of the six spirits on the ghost' (LY.ILL.EL.47), with differences in the names of gods and ghosts.

zh: 青龙：善恶、经文、蘸祀、庙香。无气带刑，自缢死。
朱雀：花幡、口愿、符命、灶神。无气带刑，劳死鬼。
勾陈：天曹、勅士。无气带刑，黄病路死鬼。
螣蛇：夜梦、惊恐、上许下保福。无气带刑，夜梦见鬼。
白虎：金刘神、作犯白虎、刀伤鬼。无气带刑，刀伤鬼。
玄武：上真、北阴神。无气带刑，落水阴鬼。
yi: 附带说明：
六神：
青龙：善恶、经文、蘸祀、庙香。无气带刑，是自缢死的鬼。
朱雀：花幡、口愿、符命、灶神。无气带刑，是劳死的鬼。
勾陈：天曹、勅士。无气带刑，是黄病、路死的鬼。
螣蛇：夜梦、惊恐、上许下保福。无气带刑，是夜梦见鬼。
白虎：金刘神、作犯白虎、刀伤鬼。无气带刑，是刀伤鬼。
玄武：上真、北阴神。无气带刑，是落水的阴鬼。
en: Appended:
the six spirits:
The Azure Dragon: good and evil, scriptures, sacrificial rites, temple incense; without qi and bearing a punishment, a ghost of hanging.
The Vermilion Bird: flower banners, spoken vows, talismans, the Kitchen God; without qi and bearing a punishment, a ghost who died of toil.
Hook Earth: the Heavenly Bureau, the commissioned officers; without qi and bearing a punishment, a ghost of jaundice, or of dying on the road.
The Coiling Snake: dreams at night, fright, vows made above and thanks given below; without qi and bearing a punishment, seeing ghosts in dreams at night.
The White Tiger: the Jin Liu spirit, the offence-making White Tiger, the ghost of a blade wound; without qi and bearing a punishment, a ghost of a blade wound.
The Dark Tortoise: the high true one, the North Yin spirit; without qi and bearing a punishment, a yin ghost of drowning.

title: 占鬼神·凡祭赛有三：祀上帝取藏爻中鬼神祗用月建、神堂家庙用日辰；皆要生合卦身不宜刑冲、不要动爻克害刑冲；合生福利而吉、带刑冲反招祸；卦爻中鬼自化入墓必有不了再牵之患

rule.yi: 祭赛（祭神还愿）有三种：祭上帝，就取伏藏的爻里的鬼神，要用月建；神堂家庙，要用日辰。都要生合卦身，不宜刑冲，也不要动爻来克害刑冲。若合而生，福利而吉；若带刑冲，反而招祸。卦爻中的鬼自己化入墓，必有了不完、再牵连的祸患。
rule.en: Offerings and thanksgiving are of three kinds: for sacrificing to the High God take the ghost or spirit in the hidden line and use the Month; for a shrine hall or a family temple use the Day. All must generate and combine with the Body of the hexagram, must not clash or punish, and a moving line must not attack, harm, punish or clash with it. If they combine and generate it is fortunate and lucky; if it bears punishment or clash it invites calamity instead. If the ghost in the hexagram lines itself changes into a tomb, there will surely be an unfinished matter that drags on again.

note.yi: 原文「凡祭赛有三」只列出两种（祀上帝、神堂家庙），第三种没有写出来，这里按原文译，不补。「藏爻中鬼神祗」是伏藏的爻里的鬼神，「祗」是地神；「当用月建」「当用日辰」是说祭上帝取月建为主、神堂家庙取日辰为主（月建管大，日辰管近）。「皆要生合卦身」的「卦身」译作 the Body of the hexagram。这一节讲还愿酬神时怎么看祭，和易林补遗的「还赛解厄」（LY.ILL.EL.57）、「解禳通用法」（LY.ILL.EL.54）是同一类；这里的判据是生合卦身则吉、刑冲则祸。
note.en: The original 'offerings and thanksgiving are of three kinds' lists only two (sacrificing to the High God, and the shrine hall and family temple), and the third is not written, and here it is rendered as the original and not filled in. 'The ghost or spirit in the hidden line' is the ghost or spirit in the concealed line, and 'zhi' is an earth deity; 'use the Month' and 'use the Day' says that sacrifice to the High God takes the Month as the main and the shrine hall and family temple take the Day (the Month rules the great, the Day the near). The 'Body' of 'must generate and combine with the Body of the hexagram' is rendered the Body of the hexagram. This section tells how to look at a sacrifice when paying a vow to the gods, and is of the same kind as the Yilin Buyi's 'giving thanks and resolving misfortune' (LY.ILL.EL.57) and 'the general method of ward-offs' (LY.ILL.EL.54); the criterion here is that generating and combining with the Body is lucky and punishment or clash is calamity.

zh: 凡祭赛有三，如祀上帝，即取藏爻中鬼神祗，当用月建；神堂家庙，当用日辰。
皆要生合卦身，不宜刑冲，亦不要动爻克害刑冲。
如合生，福利而吉；若带刑冲，反招祸。
卦爻中鬼自化入墓，必有不了再牵之患。
yi: 祭赛有三种：祭上帝，就取伏藏的爻里的鬼神，要用月建；神堂家庙，要用日辰。
都要生合卦身，不宜刑冲，也不要动爻来克害刑冲。
若合而生，福利而吉；若带刑冲，反而招祸。
卦爻中的鬼自己化入墓，必有了不完、再牵连的祸患。
en: Offerings and thanksgiving are of three kinds: for sacrificing to the High God take the ghost or spirit in the hidden line and use the Month; for a shrine hall or a family temple use the Day.
All must generate and combine with the Body of the hexagram, must not clash or punish, and a moving line must not attack, harm, punish or clash with it.
If they combine and generate it is fortunate and lucky; if it bears punishment or clash it invites calamity instead.
If the ghost in the hexagram lines itself changes into a tomb, there will surely be an unfinished matter that drags on again.

title: 占失物鬼祟(占祟)：阳鬼为男阴鬼为女、伏藏返对而取；占贼占祟以鬼阴阳为用；占祟鬼无正形但以支干取之、鬼动单为少阳拆为少阴重为太阳交为太阴、分老少何人看应爻最切

rule.yi: 阳鬼是男，阴鬼是女；若是伏藏，就反过来取。占贼、占祟，以鬼的阴阳为用，占定是男是女，要看得的是哪一个官（鬼）。占祟，鬼没有正形，只用地支天干来取：鬼动，单（阳）是少阳，拆（阴）是少阴，重是太阳，交是太阴；要分老少是什么人，只看应爻最切。书中举了一个占祟的例子：遁之姤卦，是子孙鬼，一男一女，和首饰之类的东西有牵连，坟墓在西北。
rule.en: A yang ghost is male, a yin ghost is female; if it is hidden, take it the other way round. In divining a thief or a curse take the yin or yang of the ghost as the Subject, and fix male or female by which official (ghost) is obtained. In divining a curse the ghost has no true form, and it is taken only by the branch and stem: a moving ghost, single (yang) is lesser yang, split (yin) lesser yin, double is greater yang and crossed is greater yin; to tell what person is old or young look only at the Other line, which is the closest fit. The book gives an example of divining a curse: the hexagram Dun changing to Gou is an Output ghost, one man and one woman, bound up with things such as hairpins and bracelets, and the grave in the northwest.

note.yi: 这一条前两段（L364—L365）是火珠林「占失物鬼祟」里占祟的那一半；前面「占贼」的那几句（阳宫鬼出现主男鬼、伏藏主女……）是占失物的，归失物那个问题域，这里不收。「以鬼阴阳为用，占主女男看得何官」的后半句意思读不确定，「得何官」是得到的是哪个官（鬼），字面译。「单」「拆」「重」「交」是四种爻的写法：单是阳爻不动（少阳）、拆是阴爻不动（少阴）、重是阳爻动（太阳）、交是阴爻动（太阴）。第三段是书里举的占祟的例子，出在全书前面「易中明义」一节里，按书中例收，原文里两行之间隔了一个空行，连着读。例里「一男丙午，一女辛亥」、「钗钏金」、「火绝在亥」等按原文译。「如二乾宫子孙」读不确定，字面译。
note.en: The first two passages of this entry (L364-L365) are the half of the Huozhu Lin's 'divining lost things and ghostly curses' that is about divining a curse; the earlier sentences about divining a thief ('a yang-palace ghost appearing means a male ghost, hidden means female ...') are about lost things and belong to that question domain, and are not taken here. The second half of 'take the yin or yang of the ghost as the Subject, fix male or female by which official is obtained' is not certain in sense, and 'which official is obtained' is rendered literally. 'Single', 'split', 'double' and 'crossed' are four ways of writing a line: single is a yang line still (lesser yang), split is a yin line still (lesser yin), double is a yang line moving (greater yang) and crossed is a yin line moving (greater yin). The third passage is an example of divining a curse given in the book, in the section 'What is made plain in the Changes' near the front of the whole book, and it is taken as a case from the book; in the original a blank line falls between two of its lines, and it is read as continuous. In the example 'the one man is Bing Wu and the one woman is Xin Hai', 'hairpin-and-bracelet Metal' and 'Fire is in extinction at Hai' are rendered as in the original. 'Like two Output lines of the Qian palace' is not certain and is rendered literally.

zh: 占贼占祟，以鬼阴阳为用，占主女男看得何官。
yi: 阳鬼是男，阴鬼是女；
若是伏藏，就反过来取。
占贼、占祟，以鬼的阴阳为用，占定是男是女，要看得的是哪一个官。
en: A yang ghost is male, a yin ghost is female;
if it is hidden, take it the other way round.
In divining a thief or a curse take the yin or yang of the ghost as the Subject, and fix male or female by which official (ghost) is obtained.

yi: 占祟的时候，
鬼没有正形，
只用地支天干来取。
鬼动，单（阳）是少阳，
拆（阴）是少阴，
重是太阳，
交是太阴。
要分老少是什么人，
只看应爻最切。
en: In divining a curse
the ghost has no true form,
and it is taken only by the branch and stem.
A moving ghost, single (yang) is lesser yang,
split (yin) is lesser yin,
double is greater yang
and crossed is greater yin.
To tell what person is old or young
look only at the Other line, which is the closest fit.

zh: 如遁之姤卦，此卦是子孙鬼，一男一女为钗钏等事物来沉滞，男儿赤，性燥，女儿洁白，性刚；其坟墓现在西北，恐有动犯，告之则吉。
曰：二爻丙午火是鬼，化辛亥水是子孙，丙午纳音属水，化辛亥又属水，如二乾宫子孙，故曰子孙鬼也；
火主赤，金主白，火燥金刚，皆以五行之性言之也；
为钗钏者，辛亥乃钗钏金也；
言坟墓在西北者，水墓在戌，又火绝在亥，亥，西北也；
墓有犯者，艮属土，化巽为木，木去克土山。
yi: 又请求占祟的例子来做样子，答：
比如遁之姤卦，这一卦是子孙鬼，一男一女，因为钗钏一类的东西来沉滞，男孩子赤色、性子燥，女孩子洁白、性子刚；他们的坟墓现在西北，恐怕有人动犯，告诉他们就吉。
问：凭什么知道？
答：二爻丙午火是鬼，化出辛亥水是子孙，丙午的纳音属水，化出的辛亥又属水，好像二个乾宫的子孙，所以叫子孙鬼；
一男是丙午，一女是辛亥；
火主赤，金主白，火燥金刚，都是按五行的性子来说的；
是钗钏，是因为辛亥是钗钏金；
说坟墓在西北，是因为水的墓在戌，又火绝在亥，亥是西北；
墓有人动犯，是因为艮属土，化出巽是木，木去克土山。
en: Asked again for an example of divining a curse to serve as a pattern, the answer:

Take the hexagram Dun changing to Gou: this hexagram is an Output ghost, one man and one woman, stalled because of things such as hairpins and bracelets, the boy red and of a dry temper, the girl white and of a firm temper; their grave is now in the northwest, and it is feared that someone has disturbed it, and if told of it there is luck.
Asked: how is it known?

The answer: the second line Bing Wu Fire is the ghost, changing out Xin Hai Water which is Output, the nayin of Bing Wu is Water and the Xin Hai it changes to is also Water, like two Output lines of the Qian palace, so it is called an Output ghost;
the one man is Bing Wu and the one woman is Xin Hai;
Fire governs red and Metal white, Fire is dry and Metal firm, all said by the nature of the five phases;
the hairpins and bracelets, because Xin Hai is hairpin-and-bracelet Metal;
the grave being in the northwest, because the tomb of Water is at Xu, and Fire is in extinction at Hai, and Hai is the northwest;
the grave being disturbed, because Gen belongs to Earth and Xun that it changes into is Wood, and Wood goes to control the mountain of Earth.

title: 官伏子孙：鬼伏子孙只宜散忧；若子孙旺相占看夫病即死

rule.yi: 鬼伏在子孙下，只宜散忧；若要取用官，须官鬼旺相、透出到值日的日辰才行。若子孙旺相，占看丈夫的病，就死。
rule.en: The ghost hidden under Output is only fit for dispelling worries; if the official is to be used, the Pressure line must be strong and come out on the ruling day. If Output is strong, divining a husband's illness, he dies.

note.yi: 这一节的标题是「官伏子孙」，头一句对句（鬼伏子孙，去路无门；官乘旺相，透出可分）不在这里收。占的是妻子问丈夫：官鬼代表丈夫，鬼伏在子孙下、子孙又旺相（子孙克官鬼），所以占丈夫的病是死。「若用宫」的「宫」是「官」之误，这里按「官」译。「直日辰」是值日的日辰，「透出」是伏藏的鬼在日辰上现出来。和阐奥歌章、断易天机的「妻占夫病」诗（LY.ILL.CA.07、LY.ILL.DYTJ.08）不是同一条，那两首讲的是鬼、财、兄、父的动静。
note.en: The heading of this section is 'the official hidden under Output', and its opening couplet ('the ghost hidden under Output, the road out has no door; the official riding strength, once it comes out it can be told apart') is not taken here. The case is a wife asking about her husband: the Pressure line stands for the husband, the ghost is hidden under Output and Output is also strong (Output controls the Pressure line), and so divining the husband's illness he dies. The 'gong' of 'ruo yong gong' is a miswriting of 'guan' (official), and is rendered official here. The 'ruling day' is the day that is on duty, and 'come out' is the hidden ghost appearing on the day branch. It is not the same entry as the poems 'a wife divining her husband's illness' in the Chan'ao Gezhang and the Duanyi Tianji (LY.ILL.CA.07, LY.ILL.DYTJ.08), which speak of the movement and stillness of the ghost, Wealth, Peer and Resource.

yi: 鬼伏在子孙下，
只宜散忧；
若要用官，
须是官鬼旺相，
透出到值日的日辰才行。
若子孙旺相，
占看丈夫的病，就死。
en: The ghost hidden under Output
is only fit for dispelling worries;
if the official is to be used,
the Pressure line must be strong
and come out on the ruling day.
If Output is strong,
divining a husband's illness, he dies.

title: 妻财独发：生鬼伤父，问病难瘳、占亲无路；财动克父亦能生鬼，然财爻宜旺不宜空、宜静不宜动

rule.yi: 妻财独发，生鬼、伤父；问病，难以痊愈，占亲人，没有出路。大抵财动克父，也能生鬼；但财爻要旺、不要空，要静、不要动。
rule.en: Wealth moving alone generates the ghost and injures the father; asking about illness, it is hard to be cured, and divining a relative, there is no way out. Broadly, Wealth moving controls the father and can also generate the ghost; but the Wealth line should be strong and not Void, still and not moving.

note.yi: 这一节的标题是「妻财独发」，头两句「妻财独发，生鬼伤父」说的是财爻一个人动：动了就克父母（伤父）、又生官鬼（鬼），所以问病难愈、占亲人无路。「大抵财动克父，亦能生鬼」是给这个道理的解释；「然财爻宜旺，不宜空；宜静、不宜动」一句是说财爻本身宜旺相、宜静，不是专门讲病的，这里连着收下来。下文讲占脱货、占婚姻、占讼的几句（惟占脱货要财爻发动……）不在病的范围，不收。「父」在这里是父母爻（Resource），「占亲」是占亲人。这和天玄赋「妻财独发」的说法，以及易冒等处的「财动克父」（LY.ILL.YM.42 一带）是同一类。
note.en: The heading of this section is 'Wealth moving alone', and its first two lines 'Wealth moving alone generates the ghost and injures the father' say that when the Wealth line alone moves it controls Resource (injuring the father) and also generates the Pressure line (the ghost), and so asking about illness it is hard to cure and divining a relative there is no way out. 'Broadly, Wealth moving controls the father and can also generate the ghost' is the explanation given for this; 'but the Wealth line should be strong and not Void, still and not moving' says the Wealth line itself should be strong and still, and is not about illness in particular, and is taken along here as it runs on. The following lines about divining the disposal of goods, marriage and lawsuits ('only in divining the disposal of goods must the Wealth line move ...') are outside illness and are not taken. The 'father' here is the Resource line, and 'divining a relative' is divining a relative. This is of the same kind as the Tianxuan Fu's saying on Wealth moving alone, and the 'Wealth moving controls the father' in the Yi Mao and elsewhere (around LY.ILL.YM.42).

zh: 妻财独发，生鬼伤父；问病难瘳，占亲无路。
大抵财动克父，亦能生鬼；
然财爻宜旺，不宜空；宜静、不宜动。
yi: 妻财独发，生鬼、伤父；问病，难以痊愈，占亲人，没有出路。
大抵财动克父，也能生鬼；
但财爻要旺、不要空，要静、不要动。
en: Wealth moving alone generates the ghost and injures the father; asking about illness, it is hard to be cured, and divining a relative, there is no way out.
Broadly, Wealth moving controls the father and can also generate the ghost;
but the Wealth line should be strong and not Void, still and not moving.

title: 占人口·有鬼无子多怪梦而绝嗣、有鬼无财主疾病以多端

rule.yi: 卦里有鬼没有子孙，多怪梦、并且绝嗣；有鬼没有财，主疾病多端。
rule.en: With a ghost and no Output, many strange dreams and no heir; with a ghost and no Wealth, illness in many forms.

note.yi: 这一句在火珠林「占人口」一节里，那一节讲的是家里几口人的命运（卦无父母占人寿命不延、爻无妻财兄伯贫穷……），这里只收有关疾病的一对句子。「有鬼无财」是卦里有官鬼、没有财爻（禄命）：财是禄命，没有财则鬼无制、病多。这和本文「以财为禄，以鬼为祟」（LY.ILL.HZL.04）是同一个道理。「以多端」按「多端」译。
note.en: This sentence is in the Huozhu Lin's section on 'divining household members', which is about the fortunes of the several people in a house (with no Resource in the hexagram, the person's lifespan does not extend, with no Wealth line the elder brother is poor ...), and here only the pair of lines about illness is taken. 'A ghost and no Wealth' is a Pressure line in the hexagram and no Wealth line (salary and life): Wealth is the salary and life, and without it the ghost is unchecked and the illness is many. This is the same principle as the text 'take Wealth as the salary and the ghost as the curse' (LY.ILL.HZL.04). 'Yi duo duan' is rendered 'in many forms'.

zh: 有鬼无子，多怪梦而绝嗣，
有鬼无财，主疾病以多端。
yi: 有鬼没有子孙，多怪梦、并且绝嗣；
有鬼没有财，主疾病多端。
en: With a ghost and no Output, many strange dreams and no heir;
with a ghost and no Wealth, illness in many forms.

title: (十八)占疾病：壬午火鬼正值九四爻、火鬼主热；若占父母九二木财发动必伤、幸九五金一制其病可痊但牵连未脱

rule.yi: （十八）占疾病：壬午火鬼，正好在九四爻，火鬼主热。若占父母，九二的木财发动必然伤（克父母），幸好九五的金一制，他的病可以痊愈，只是牵连着还没有脱身。其余照这个类推。
rule.en: (18) Divining illness: the Ren Wu Fire ghost falls exactly on the ninth in the fourth place, and a Fire ghost means heat. If a parent is divined for, the Wood Wealth on the ninth in the second place moving will surely injure (control Resource), but luckily the Metal on the ninth in the fifth place checks it, and his illness can be cured, only it is still tangled and has not yet shaken free. The rest follow by analogy.

note.yi: 这一节是火珠林后面「占卦例」一部分里的一条：那一部分用同一个卦逐项演示（十七占蚕、十八占疾病、十九占姓字……），所以「壬午火鬼」「九四爻」「九二木财」「九五金」指的是那一个卦上的爻（卦的排盘在这一节前面，原书用表格排，文件里排乱了，这里不收）。这一条本身能读出来的规矩是：火鬼主热；占父母病时，财爻发动克父母必伤，若有金爻制住木财，病就可以痊愈，但牵连着还没有脱身。「木财」是属木的财爻，「金一制」是金制木。「（十八）」是原文的编号。和「妻财独发，生鬼伤父；问病难瘳」（LY.ILL.HZL.18）是同一个道理，只是这里多了「有金制财」这一救。
note.en: This section is one entry in the part of the Huozhu Lin near the end on 'worked applications': that part works through item after item on one and the same hexagram (17 divining silkworms, 18 divining illness, 19 divining a name ...), and so 'Ren Wu Fire ghost', 'the ninth in the fourth place', 'the Wood Wealth on the ninth in the second place' and 'the Metal on the ninth in the fifth place' refer to the lines of that one hexagram (its layout is set out before this section, arranged as a table in the original and scrambled in the file, and is not taken here). What can be read out of this entry as a rule is: a Fire ghost means heat; divining a parent's illness, the Wealth line moving controls Resource and will surely injure, but if a Metal line checks the Wood Wealth the illness can be cured, only it is still tangled and has not shaken free. 'Wood Wealth' is a Wealth line belonging to Wood, and 'Metal checks it' is Metal controlling Wood. The '(18)' is the numbering of the original. It is the same principle as 'Wealth moving alone generates the ghost and injures the father; asking about illness it is hard to cure' (LY.ILL.HZL.18), only with the rescue of 'Metal checking Wealth' added here.

zh: 壬午火鬼，正值九四爻，火鬼主热。
若占父母，其九二木财发动必伤，幸九五金一制，其病可痊，但牵连末脱。
yi: （十八）占疾病
壬午火鬼，正好在九四爻，火鬼主热。
若占父母，九二的木财发动必然伤，幸好九五的金一制，他的病可以痊愈，只是牵连着还没有脱身。
其余照这个类推。
en: (18) Divining illness
the Ren Wu Fire ghost falls exactly on the ninth in the fourth place, and a Fire ghost means heat.

If a parent (the Resource line) is divined for, the Wood Wealth on the ninth in the second place moving will surely injure, but luckily the Metal on the ninth in the fifth place checks it, and his illness can be cured, only it is still tangled and has not yet shaken free.
The rest follow by analogy.

title: 疾病章总纲：养生非道终有疾病、请祷能占便见死生；杀临父母忧堂上之亲、空及妻财虑闺中之妇；占疾病先看来者何人——子占父母要父母上卦、妻占夫看鬼、夫占妻看财、父占子看子、占兄弟朋友看兄弟、占奴仆看子孙；用爻不上卦或空亡多凶少吉

rule.yi: 国家的治乱，靠的是风俗纪纲；人的寿夭，不在身体强弱。养生不得法，终究会有疾病；请祷能占卜，就能看出死生的决断。凶杀临在父母爻上，要为堂上的双亲担忧；妻财爻落空，要为闺中的妻子担心灾祸。注说：占疾病，先看来占的是什么人：儿子占父母，要父母爻上卦；妻子占丈夫看鬼爻；丈夫占妻子看财爻；父亲占儿子看子孙；占兄弟、占朋友都看兄弟爻；占奴仆也看子孙爻。用爻不上卦或空亡的，多凶少吉；哪一爻空亡、哪一爻受克，吉凶就照这个来断。
rule.en: That a state is in order or disorder is nothing but a matter of customs and discipline; whether a person's life is short or long is not argued from frailty or strength. If one does not nourish life in the proper way, in the end there will be illness; if prayers can be divined, life and death can be seen decided. A killing sitting on Resource: worry for the parents in the hall; Void reaching Wealth: fear calamity for the woman in the inner chamber. The commentary says: in divining illness, first look at who the person is who has come to divine: a son divining about his parents needs the Resource line in the hexagram; a wife divining about her husband looks at the ghost, a husband about his wife at Wealth, a father about his son at Output; in divining about a brother or a friend, look at the Peer line; in divining about a servant, also look at Output. If the Subject line is absent from the hexagram or Void, there is mostly ill and little good; whichever line is Void, whichever is controlled, good and ill are judged by this.

note.yi: 这是天玄赋「疾病章」的头三段：两句开场议论（治乱靠风俗纪纲、寿夭不看强弱，养生不得法总会生病），两句杀临父母、空及妻财的提醒，再是「占疾病看来者何人」的用爻表。用爻表和易林补遗「疾病用神」（LY.ILL.EL.09）、黄金策「取用神」一带是同一套：子占父母看父母爻、妻占夫看鬼、夫占妻看财、父占子看子孙、兄弟朋友看兄弟、奴仆看子孙。「尫羸」是瘦弱多病。这一章在卜筮大全里赋文和注文排成同样的行，分不出体例，这里按内容分：对偶的句子是赋，「凡……」「若……」起头的解释是注。断易天机和火珠林里同一章把注放在括号里，可以对照。卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: These are the first three passages of the Tianxuan Fu's chapter on illness: two lines of opening argument (order and disorder depend on customs and discipline, long or short life not on strength; if life is not nourished one will fall ill), two lines warning of a killing on Resource and Void reaching Wealth, and then the table 'in divining illness, look at who has come' for the Subject line. The table is the same set as the Yilin Buyi's 'the Subject line in illness' (LY.ILL.EL.09) and the Huangjin Ce's choosing of the Subject: a son divining about his parents looks at the Resource line, a wife about her husband at the ghost, a husband about his wife at Wealth, a father about his son at Output, a brother or friend at Peer, a servant at Output. 'Wang ying' is frail and often ill. In the Buyi Daquan this chapter sets the verse and the commentary in lines of the same kind, so the two cannot be told apart by form, and here they are divided by content: the paired sentences are the verse, and the explanations beginning 'whenever ...' or 'if ...' are the commentary. The Duanyi Tianji and the Huozhulin put the commentary of the same chapter in brackets, and can be compared. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 国家的治乱，
无非是风俗纪纲的事；
人的寿夭长短，
哪里能凭身体的瘦弱壮盛来论。
养生不得其道，
终究会有疾病存在；
请祷能占卜，
就能看出死生的决断了。
en: That a state is in order or disorder,
is nothing but a matter of customs and discipline;
that a person's life is short or long,
how could it be argued from being frail or thin or robust?
If one does not nourish life in the proper way,
in the end illness will be there;
if prayers can be divined,
life and death can be seen decided.

yi: 凶杀临在父母爻上，
应当为堂上的双亲担忧；
空亡涉及妻财，
要为闺中的妻子担心灾祸。
en: A killing sitting on Resource,
one should worry for the parents in the hall;
Void reaching Wealth,
one should fear calamity for the woman in the inner chamber.

yi: 凡是占疾病，看来占的是什么人。
儿子占父母，要父母爻上卦。
妻子占丈夫看鬼；
丈夫占妻子看财；
父亲占儿子看子孙；
占兄弟，看兄弟爻；
占朋友，也看兄弟爻；
占奴仆，也看子孙。
凡是用爻不上卦，
或者空亡的，
就多凶少吉。
凡占，哪一爻空亡，
哪一爻受克，
吉凶就照这个来断。
en: In divining illness, look at who the person is who has come to divine.
A son divining about his parents needs the Resource line in the hexagram.
a wife divining about her husband looks at the ghost;
a husband divining about his wife looks at Wealth;
a father divining about his son looks at Output;
in divining about a brother, look at the Peer line;
in divining about a friend, also look at the Peer line;
in divining about a servant, also look at Output.
Whenever the Subject line is absent from the hexagram,
or Void,
there is mostly ill and little good.
In every divination, whichever line is Void,
whichever line is controlled,
good and ill are judged by this.

title: 决轻重存亡专察鬼爻、定金木水火可分症候：鬼爻旺日沉重、库日困迍、绝日轻可；鬼化鬼病进退或有变症或旧病发；鬼持世难除根、鬼带杀持世是瘵疾；日辰旺是暴病、月建旺是经月之疾、鬼无气临身是久病；卦无鬼病难安、鬼动伤身症候急；旺鬼不死则易愈、衰鬼不死则难疗

rule.yi: 要断定病的轻重存亡，专门看鬼爻；要定金木水火各是哪个方位，可以分出症候。注说：鬼爻旺的日子病沉重，入库的日子困顿，绝的日子轻可。鬼化鬼，病时进时退，或者有变症，或者旧病再发，或者症候驳杂。鬼持世，病难除根；鬼爻带杀持世，是瘵疾。卦中鬼爻遇日辰旺，是暴病；月建旺，是过了整月的病；鬼爻无气临身的，是久病，很难痊可。卦里没有鬼，病难安；鬼动伤身，症候急。凡占，鬼旺而不死，病容易好；鬼衰而不死，病难治。
rule.en: To decide the light or heavy and the life or death, look only at the Pressure line; to fix the quarters of Metal, Wood, Water and Fire, one can distinguish the symptoms. The commentary says: on a day when the Pressure line is strong the illness is heavy, on its store day it is trapped and hard, on its Extinction day it is light and tolerable. The ghost changing into a ghost: the illness advances and retreats, or there is a change of symptoms, or an old illness flares, or the symptoms are mixed. The ghost holding the Self: the illness is hard to root out; the Pressure line carrying a killing and holding the Self is a wasting illness. If the Pressure line in the hexagram is strong on the Day, it is a sudden illness; if strong on the Month, an illness of a full month; a Pressure line without qi sitting on the body is a long illness that can hardly be cured at once. With no ghost in the hexagram the illness is hard to settle; the ghost moving and wounding the body, the symptoms are urgent. In every divination, a strong ghost that does not kill means an easy cure, a weak ghost that does not kill means an illness hard to treat.

note.yi: 赋文「专察鬼爻」是本章的总原则：病的轻重存亡看官鬼，症候看鬼的五行。注里分几个层次：①按日辰（鬼旺日重、入库日困、绝日轻）；②按鬼的变化（鬼化鬼是进退或变症，鬼持世难除根，带杀持世是瘵疾）；③按鬼旺在哪一层（日辰旺是暴病、月建旺是经月之病、无气临身是久病）；④卦无鬼病难安、鬼动伤身症候急；⑤旺鬼不死易愈、衰鬼不死难疗。这一段和黄金策的疾病章头几段（LY.ILL.HJC.01 到 HJC.14）是同一路，字句多有相同；卦无鬼「病难安」一处，黄金策旧注也有（见 LY.ILL.HJC.03）。「库日」是鬼爻入墓库的日子。「瘵疾」按拼音带出，是消耗性的病（古人常指肺痨）。「经月之疾」按「过了整月的病」译。「凡占，旺鬼不死则易愈；衰鬼不死其病难疗」的意思是：鬼旺时若没死，病好得快，因为鬼旺却不致命，说明用爻扛得住；鬼衰而没死，病反缠绵——原文没有解释，这里只译字面。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: The verse 'look only at the Pressure line' is this chapter's general principle: whether an illness is light or heavy, whether one lives or dies, is seen from the Pressure line, and the symptoms from the phase of the ghost. The commentary works on several levels: (1) by the day (strong Pressure day heavy, store day trapped, Extinction day light); (2) by what the ghost does (a ghost changing into a ghost is advance and retreat or a change of symptoms, a ghost holding the Self is hard to root out, with a killing and holding the Self it is a wasting illness); (3) by the level at which the ghost is strong (strong on the Day a sudden illness, strong on the Month an illness of a full month, without qi on the body a long illness); (4) with no ghost the illness is hard to settle, the ghost moving and wounding the body the symptoms are urgent; (5) a strong ghost that does not kill heals easily, a weak ghost that does not kill is hard to treat. This passage runs on the same road as the first paragraphs of the Huangjin Ce's chapter on illness (LY.ILL.HJC.01 to HJC.14) and its wording is often the same; 'with no ghost the illness is hard to settle' is also in the Huangjin Ce's old commentary (see LY.ILL.HJC.03). 'Store day' is the day on which the Pressure line enters its tomb or store. 'Zhai illness' is given by its pinyin and is a wasting illness (the ancients often meant consumption by it). 'An illness of a full month' is translated as 'an illness of a full month'. 'A strong ghost that does not kill means an easy cure; a weak ghost that does not kill means an illness hard to treat' means that if a strong ghost has not killed, the cure comes fast, because a ghost strong yet not fatal shows the Subject line can bear it, and if a weak ghost has not killed the illness on the contrary drags on — the original does not explain, and only the literal sense is translated. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 要决断轻重存亡的征兆，
专门察看鬼爻；
要定金木水火的方位，
就可以分出症候。
en: To decide the signs of light and heavy, of life and death,
look only at the Pressure line;
to fix the quarters of Metal, Wood, Water and Fire,
one can distinguish the symptoms.

yi: 鬼爻旺的日子病沉重，
入库的日子困顿，
绝的日子轻可。
鬼变化成鬼，
病时进时退，
或者有变症，
或者旧病再发，
或者症候驳杂。
鬼持了世爻，
病难除根；
鬼爻带杀持世，
这是瘵疾。
卦中鬼爻在日辰旺的时候，
这是暴病；
月建旺相，
是过了整月的病；
鬼爻无气而临在身上的，
这是久病，
很难一下痊可。
卦里没有鬼，病难安。
鬼动伤身，症候急。
en: On a day when the Pressure line is strong the illness is heavy,
on its store day it is trapped and hard,
on its Extinction day it is light and tolerable.
The ghost changing into a ghost:
the illness advances and retreats,
or there is a change of symptoms,
or an old illness flares,
or the symptoms are mixed.
The ghost holding the Self:
the illness is hard to root out;
the Pressure line carrying a killing and holding the Self
is a wasting illness (zhai).
If the Pressure line in the hexagram is strong on the Day,
it is a sudden illness;
if strong on the Month,
an illness of a full month;
a Pressure line without qi sitting on the body
is a long illness,
that can hardly be cured at once.
With no ghost in the hexagram the illness is hard to settle.
The ghost moving and wounding the body, the symptoms are urgent.

yi: 凡是占卜，
鬼旺而不死，
就容易好；
鬼衰而不死，
病难治疗。
en: In every divination,
a strong ghost that does not kill
means an easy cure;
a weak ghost that does not kill
means an illness hard to treat.

title: 欲定症候须看鬼临之五行：金鬼肺腑病咳嗽气喘或疮疖血光筋骨疼痛；木鬼四肢不利、风气肝胆、左瘫右痪口眼歪斜、头疼发热三焦口渴，加朱雀狂言乱语阳症伤寒；水鬼沉寒痼冷遗精白浊淋沥吐泻呕逆；火鬼寒热往来脾寒疟疾；土鬼脾胃发瘴水肿虚浮瘟疫时气；前卦火鬼后卦水鬼则服冷药过多变阴症

rule.yi: 要定症候，必须看鬼临着的五行。金鬼：肺腑的病，咳嗽气喘，或者疮疖、血光，或者筋骨疼痛。木鬼：四肢不利，风气、肝胆病，左瘫右痪，口眼歪斜，头疼发热，三焦口渴；加朱雀，说胡话、乱语，是阳症伤寒。水鬼：沉寒痼冷，遗精白浊，小便淋沥，吐泻呕逆。火鬼：寒热往来，脾寒疟疾。土鬼：脾胃发瘴，水肿虚浮，瘟疫时气。如果前一卦是火鬼、后一卦是水鬼，前面的症候一定是阳症，服冷药过多，变成了阴症；如果午时以前占，遇到这两个鬼，应当说不要服药；过了头，以后必有变化。这说的是在火旺的月日占卦的情形。
rule.en: To fix the symptoms, one must look at the phase the ghost sits on. A Metal ghost: illness of the lungs and viscera, coughing and wheezing, or sores and boils, or bleeding, or aching of the sinews and bones. A Wood ghost: the four limbs not free, wind-qi and illness of the liver and gall, left and right palsy, mouth and eyes awry, headache and fever, thirst in the Triple Burner; with the Vermilion Bird added, wild and confused speech, a yang cold-damage illness. A Water ghost: deep cold and chronic chill, seminal emission and turbid urine, dribbling urination, vomiting, diarrhoea and retching. A Fire ghost: alternate chills and fever, spleen chill and malaria. An Earth ghost: spleen and stomach miasma, water swelling and puffy weakness, epidemic and seasonal qi. If the earlier hexagram is a Fire ghost and the later a Water ghost, the earlier symptoms were surely yang, and taking too much cold medicine has turned them into a yin condition; if the divination is made before noon and these two ghosts are met, one should say do not take medicine; if it is overdone, there will surely be a change afterwards. This speaks of divining in a month or day when Fire is strong.

note.yi: 这一段和黄金策疾病章里的「五行症候」（LY.ILL.HJC.14 到 HJC.20 一带）、易隐「五行鬼各主之症」（LY.ILL.YY.13）是同一份名单，每种五行的具体病名略有不同：天玄赋的金鬼是「肺腑病、咳嗽气、疮疖、血光、筋骨疼痛」，木鬼里有「三焦口渴」和「加朱雀狂言乱语阳症伤寒」，火鬼只有「寒热往来、脾寒疟疾」（易隐的火鬼阴是心目之疾、阳是疮痍疖毒虐热），土鬼是「脾胃发瘴、水肿虚浮、瘟疫时气」。「遗精白浊」「淋沥」「痼冷」「脾寒疟疾」是医病名，照字面译；「三焦」是中医说的上中下三焦，不作解释。「前卦火鬼、后卦水鬼」说的是同一个人先后占了两卦：前面是火鬼阳症，若已服了太多冷药，后一卦水鬼就是变成了阴症。「若午前占，遇此两鬼，当言勿服药」的「午前」是午时以前；末一句说火鬼那一条指的是在火旺的月日占卦。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This passage is the same list as the 'symptoms by the five phases' in the Huangjin Ce's chapter on illness (LY.ILL.HJC.14 to HJC.20) and the Yi Yin's 'the symptoms each phase of ghost governs' (LY.ILL.YY.13), with the specific illness names differing a little for each phase: in the Tianxuan Fu the Metal ghost is 'illness of the lungs and viscera, coughing and wheezing, sores and boils, bleeding, aching sinews and bones'; the Wood ghost has 'thirst in the Triple Burner' and 'with the Vermilion Bird added, wild and confused speech, a yang cold-damage illness'; the Fire ghost has only 'alternate chills and fever, spleen chill and malaria' (the Yi Yin's Fire ghost is, if yin, illness of the heart and eyes, and if yang, sores, boils and hot malaria); and the Earth ghost is 'spleen and stomach miasma, water swelling and puffy weakness, epidemic and seasonal qi'. 'Seminal emission and turbid urine', 'dribbling urination', 'chronic chill' and 'spleen chill and malaria' are names of illnesses and are translated literally; the 'Triple Burner' is the upper, middle and lower burners of Chinese medicine and is not explained. 'The earlier hexagram a Fire ghost and the later a Water ghost' speaks of one person divining two hexagrams in succession: the earlier is a yang condition with the Fire ghost, and if too much cold medicine has already been taken, the Water ghost of the later hexagram is the change to a yin condition. 'If divined before noon and these two ghosts are met, say do not take medicine': the 'before noon' is before the Wu double-hour; the last sentence says that the Fire ghost's case refers to divining in a month or day when Fire is strong. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

zh: 欲定症候，须看鬼临之五行。
yi: 要断定症候，必须看鬼临着的五行。
如果是金鬼：
肺腑的病，
咳嗽气喘，
或者是疮疖、血光，
或者是筋骨疼痛。
如果是木鬼：
四肢不灵便，
风气、肝胆的病，
左瘫右痪，
口眼歪斜，
头疼发热，
三焦口渴；
加了朱雀，
说胡话、乱语，
是阳症伤寒。
en: To fix the symptoms, one must look at the phase the ghost sits on.
A Metal ghost:
illness of the lungs and viscera,
coughing and wheezing,
or sores and boils, or bleeding,
or aching of the sinews and bones.
A Wood ghost:
the four limbs not free,
wind-qi and illness of the liver and gall,
left and right palsy,
mouth and eyes awry,
headache and fever,
thirst in the Triple Burner;
with the Vermilion Bird added,
wild and confused speech,
a yang cold-damage illness.

yi: 如果是水鬼：
沉寒痼冷，
遗精、白浊，
小便淋沥，
吐泻呕逆。
如果是火鬼：
寒热往来，
脾寒疟疾。
如果是土鬼：
是脾胃发瘴，
水肿虚浮，
瘟疫时气。
en: A Water ghost:
deep cold and chronic chill,
seminal emission and turbid urine,
dribbling urination,
vomiting, diarrhoea and retching.
A Fire ghost:
alternate chills and fever,
spleen chill and malaria.
An Earth ghost:
spleen and stomach miasma,
water swelling and puffy weakness,
epidemic and seasonal qi.

zh: 火鬼于火旺月日占是也。
yi: 如果前一卦是火鬼、后一卦是水鬼，
前面的症候一定是阳症，
服冷药过多，
变成了阴症。
如果午时以前占，
遇到这两个鬼，
应当说不要服药；
过了头，
以后必定有变化。
这说的是在火旺的月日占卦的情形。
en: If the earlier hexagram is a Fire ghost and the later a Water ghost,
the earlier symptoms were surely yang,
and taking too much cold medicine
has turned them into a yin condition.
If the divination is made before noon,
and these two ghosts are met,
one should say do not take medicine;
if it is overdone,
there will surely be a change afterwards.
This speaks of divining in a month or day when Fire is strong.

title: 青龙得位终见安康、白虎伤身必成凶咎：青龙临子孙克世期日痊安、临应克世服药有效、临用爻发动纵凶险不伤、带鬼爻非凶恶发狂之病、三爻动香火为福；苍屏云青龙空亡并福德平日无阴骘、白虎加临主哭丧；白虎交重乃占病大咎——无气犹可旺相大凶、临丧门吊客死符丧车持克用爻决不起、得子孙旺动月解兴隆可回生

rule.yi: 青龙得位，终究见到安康；白虎伤身，必成凶咎。注说：青龙如果临着子孙又克世，到日期就痊愈安康；临在应爻上克世，服药有效；临在用爻上发动，纵有凶险也不受伤；带着鬼爻，也不是凶恶发狂的病；在三爻发动，香火是福。苍屏说：青龙空亡，和福德一起，病人平日没有阴德；遇土动、虎伤身，那一年一定有悲哭；你来占病断存亡，白虎加临主哭丧；临着、克着父爻，就有咎，妻财的位置一定受伤；子孙遇上它，终究不成，兄弟遇上更不昌；再逢官爻持世，自身要恐怕有灾殃。凡遇白虎交重，是占病的大咎，无气还可以，旺相大凶；如果临着丧门、吊客、死符、丧车、又持着或克着用爻，决定是不起的征兆；如果得到子孙旺相发动，月解兴隆，才可以回生。
rule.en: With the Azure Dragon in its place one sees peace and health at last; with the White Tiger wounding the body it becomes ill and blame. The commentary says: if the Azure Dragon sits on Output controlling the Self, recovery and peace come on the appointed day; if it sits on the Other line controlling the Self, taking medicine is effective; if it sits on the Subject line and moves, even if there is danger no harm is done; if it carries a Pressure line, it is still not a fierce and frenzied illness; if it moves on the third line, the incense fire is the blessing. Cangping says: the Azure Dragon Void, together with Output, the sick person had no hidden merit in ordinary life; meeting Earth moving, the Tiger wounds the body, and that year there will surely be weeping; you who come to divine an illness to decide life or death, the White Tiger added governs wailing and mourning; sitting on and controlling the Resource line there will be blame, and the Wealth and wife positions will surely be wounded; Output meeting it ends in failure, Peer meeting it is still less prosperous; and if the Pressure line holds the Self, one's own person should fear calamity. When the White Tiger crosses heavily it is the great misfortune of divining illness: without qi it is still tolerable, strong it is greatly ominous; if it sits on Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, Death Tally or Funeral Carriage and holds or controls the Subject line, it surely is a sign that he will not rise; if Output is strong and moves and Month Release thrives, there may be a return to life.

note.yi: 「苍屏」是天玄赋注里引的一位作者（或一部书），原文只写「苍屏云」，这里按字面译作 Cangping，不作认定；它的歌诀用韵，后四句「临克父爻当有咎，并财妻位必遭伤；子孙际会终成否，兄弟相逢更不昌」是说白虎临克父爻（父母）、财爻（妻财）、子孙、兄弟时各自的后果。「阴骘」是暗中积的德。「香火为福」按字面译，意思大概是三爻动时，祭祀香火是福神所在，原文没有说清。「丧门、吊客、死符、丧车」都是凶煞名，见易林补遗「总论星煞值鬼诀」（LY.ILL.EL.48 到 EL.52）、易隐（LY.ILL.YY.05）。这一段的判语和黄金策的青龙、白虎（LY.ILL.HJC.24、HJC.25 一带）一致。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: 'Cangping' is an author (or a book) quoted in the commentary on the Tianxuan Fu, of whom the original writes only 'Cangping says', and it is translated literally as Cangping, without identification; his rhyme's last four lines, 'sitting on and controlling the Resource line there will be blame, and the Wealth and wife positions will surely be wounded; Output meeting it ends in failure, Peer meeting it is still less prosperous', give the consequence when the White Tiger sits on and controls the Resource line, the Wealth line, Output and Peer in turn. 'Yin zhi' is merit stored up in secret. 'The incense fire is the blessing' is translated literally, and probably means that when the third line moves, the incense fire of the sacrifices is where the fortune spirit lies, which the original does not make clear. 'Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, Death Tally and Funeral Carriage' are names of malign stars, for which see the Yilin Buyi's 'general discourse on ghosts by the stars and killings' (LY.ILL.EL.48 to EL.52) and the Yi Yin (LY.ILL.YY.05). The verdicts of this passage agree with the Huangjin Ce's on the Azure Dragon and the White Tiger (LY.ILL.HJC.24, HJC.25 and around). After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 青龙得位，
终究见到安康；
白虎伤身，
必定成为凶咎。
en: With the Azure Dragon in its place,
one sees peace and health at last;
with the White Tiger wounding the body,
it surely becomes ill and blame.

yi: 青龙如果临着子孙又克世爻，
到日期就痊愈安康；
或者临在应爻上克世，
服药有效；
如果临着用爻发动，
纵然有凶险，
也不受伤；
如果带着鬼爻，
也不是凶恶发狂的病；
如果在三爻发动，
香火是福。
en: If the Azure Dragon sits on Output controlling the Self,
recovery and peace come on the appointed day;
or if it sits on the Other line controlling the Self,
taking medicine is effective;
if it sits on the Subject line and moves,
even if there is danger,
no harm is done;
if it carries a Pressure line,
it is still not a fierce and frenzied illness;
if it moves on the third line,
the incense fire is the blessing.

yi: 苍屏这样说：
「青龙空亡，和福德一起，
病人平日没有阴德；
遇上土动、虎伤身，
那一年一定有悲哭；
你来占病断存亡，
白虎加临主哭丧；
临着、克着父爻就有咎，
妻财的位置一定受伤；
子孙遇上它，终究不成；
兄弟遇上更不昌盛；
再逢官爻持世，
自身要恐怕有灾殃」。
en: Cangping says:
'The Azure Dragon Void, together with Output,
the sick person had no hidden merit in ordinary life;
meeting Earth moving, the Tiger wounds the body,
and that year there will surely be weeping;
you who come to divine an illness to decide life or death,
the White Tiger added governs wailing and mourning;
sitting on and controlling the Resource line there will be blame,
and the Wealth and wife positions will surely be wounded;
Output meeting it ends in failure;
Peer meeting it is still less prosperous;
and if the Pressure line holds the Self,
one's own person should fear calamity.'

zh: 若临丧门、吊客、死符、丧车、持克用爻者，
yi: 凡是遇到白虎交重，
是占病的大咎；
无气还可以，
旺相大凶。
如果临着丧门、吊客、死符、丧车，又持着或克着用爻的，
决定是不起的征兆。
如果得到子孙旺相发动，
月解兴隆，
才可以回生。
en: When one meets the White Tiger crossing heavily,
it is the great misfortune of divining illness;
without qi it is still tolerable,
strong it is greatly ominous.
if it sits on Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, Death Tally or Funeral Carriage and holds or controls the Subject line,
it surely is a sign that he will not rise.
If Output is strong and moves,
and Month Release thrives,
there may be a return to life.

title: 月解交重灾渐退、天医发动便回生：卦中得月解天医发动持世或持克用爻者虽重病不死；旺相最吉日下即愈、墓绝稍慢直待旺日方安；若值空亡其病难疗

rule.yi: 月解交重，灾祸渐渐退去；天医发动，当下就回生。注说：月解、天医见后面的吉神章。卦里如果得到它们发动、持世，或者持着、克着用爻，即使重病也不会死；旺相最吉，当天就好；墓绝的稍慢，要等到旺的日子才安；如果落空亡，病就难治。
rule.en: Month Release crossing heavily, calamity gradually retreats; Heavenly Doctor moving, one returns to life at once. The commentary says: Month Release and Heavenly Doctor are given in the later chapter on the lucky spirits. If the hexagram has them moving and holding the Self, or holding or controlling the Subject line, then even in a heavy illness the patient does not die; if strong it is most auspicious and the cure comes that very day; if in a tomb or Extinction it is a little slower, and one must wait for a strong day to be at peace; if it meets Void, the illness is hard to treat.

note.yi: 月解、天医是吉神，天玄赋自己说「见后吉神章」——本库还没有收吉神章。这一条的判语是：月解或天医发动、持世，或持克用爻的，重病也不死；和易隐「生死·愈」（LY.ILL.YY.04）「用爻遇龙福月解天医天喜生合即愈」一致；和易林补遗（LY.ILL.EL.13）里「月解天医同发而用爻已遭伤仍死」的例子不冲突——那是说用爻被伤时，月解天医也救不回。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: Month Release and Heavenly Doctor are lucky spirits, and the Tianxuan Fu itself says 'see the later chapter on the lucky spirits'; this library has not yet quoted that chapter. The verdict of this entry is that with Month Release or Heavenly Doctor moving and holding the Self, or holding or controlling the Subject line, even a heavy illness does not kill, which agrees with the Yi Yin's 'life and death: recovery' (LY.ILL.YY.04), 'the Subject line meeting the Dragon, Fortune, Month Release, Heavenly Doctor or Heavenly Joy and being generated or combined, he recovers at once'; and it does not conflict with the example in the Yilin Buyi (LY.ILL.EL.13) in which 'Month Release and Heavenly Doctor move together but the Subject line is already wounded and he still dies' — that says that when the Subject line is wounded even Month Release and Heavenly Doctor cannot bring it back. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 月解交重，灾祸渐渐退去；
天医发动，当下就回生。
en: Month Release crossing heavily, calamity gradually retreats;
Heavenly Doctor moving, one returns to life at once.

yi: 月解、天医，
见后面的吉神章。
en: Month Release and Heavenly Doctor:
see the later chapter on the lucky spirits.

yi: 卦里如果得到它们发动持世，
或者持着、克着用爻的，
即使重病也不会死；
旺相最吉，
当天就好；
墓绝的稍慢，
要等到旺的日子才安；
如果落空亡，
病就难治。
en: If the hexagram has them moving and holding the Self,
or holding or controlling the Subject line,
then even in a heavy illness the patient does not die;
if strong it is most auspicious,
and the cure comes that very day;
if in a tomb or Extinction it is a little slower,
and one must wait for a strong day to be at peace;
if it meets Void,
the illness is hard to treat.

title: 入墓卦：明夷观贲需临切忌世身入墓、大畜丰同蛊夬莫逢财鬼俱兴；怕身世随鬼入墓决不瘥（观二爻乙巳鬼身亦在二爻、贲初爻己卯鬼世亦在初爻）；苍屏云八宫化入墓——乾化艮父丧、坤化巽母亡、震化坤长男厄、巽化坤长女当、坎化巽中男厄、离化乾中女卒、艮化巽少男倾、兑化艮少女卒，十人得病九人故；乾化艮子占父谓之应题大凶；财鬼不动未必丧亡、财鬼空亡虽病不死

rule.yi: 明夷、观、贲、需、临，切忌世和身入墓；大畜、丰、同（人）、蛊、夬，不要遇到财和鬼一起兴动。注说：占病怕身、世跟着鬼入墓，一定治不好。比如风地观的二爻乙巳，鬼和身也在二爻，如果入了墓，就是身随鬼入墓；山火贲卦初爻己卯，鬼和世也在初爻，如果入了墓，就是世随鬼入墓；上面两卦举作例子，其余卦照这样仿。苍屏说：乾化入艮，父亲遭丧；坤化入巽，母亲忧亡；震化入坤，长男有厄；巽化入坤，长女当灾；坎化入巽，中男遭厄；离化入乾，中女暴卒；艮化入风（巽），少男倾倒；兑化入山（艮），少女暴卒；这是八宫化来入墓，十个人得病九个亡故。上面说的卦墓，不能单说乾化入艮墓只忧父亲的亡，而要看占病都不吉；假如儿子占父亲，遇到乾化艮，叫做应题，是大凶。大畜等五个卦，占病大忌；财和鬼不动，不一定死；财和鬼空亡，虽病也不死；必须把它的条理理清了，才可以断为全凶。上文所说的财鬼发动，也有吉凶的分别：比如雷火丰卦，鬼动忌占兄弟，财动忌占父母和自己本人；妻子占丈夫，终究没有凶；其余卦仿此。
rule.en: Mingyi, Guan, Bi (Adornment), Xu and Lin: most to be avoided is the Self and the Body entering a tomb; Daxu, Feng, Tong(ren), Gu and Guai: do not meet Wealth and the ghost both rising. The commentary says: in divining illness one fears the Body and the Self following the ghost into a tomb, and then there is surely no recovery. For example, in Feng-Di Guan the second line Yisi has the ghost and the Body also on the second line; if it enters a tomb, that is the Body following the ghost into a tomb; in the hexagram Bi (Adornment), Mountain over Fire, the first line Jimao has the ghost and the Self also on the first line, and if it enters a tomb, that is the Self following the ghost into a tomb; these two hexagrams are given as examples and the others follow. Cangping says: Qian changing into Gen, the father is in mourning; Kun changing into Xun, the mother worried to death; Zhen changing into Kun, calamity for the eldest son; Xun changing into Kun, the eldest daughter takes it; Kan changing into Xun, calamity for the middle son; Li changing into Qian, the middle daughter dies suddenly; Gen changing into the wind (Xun), the youngest son topples; Dui changing into the mountain (Gen), the youngest daughter dies suddenly; these are the eight palaces changing into a tomb, and of ten who fall ill nine die. As for the tomb hexagrams above, one may not take Qian changing into the Gen tomb as only a worry for the father's death, but must look at illness in all of them as inauspicious; suppose a son divines about his father and meets Qian changing into Gen: it is called 'answering the topic' and is greatly ominous. The five hexagrams such as Daxu are greatly to be avoided in divining illness; if Wealth and the ghost do not move, death is not certain; if Wealth and the ghost are Void, though ill he will not die; one must grasp its threads before judging it wholly ominous. The Wealth and ghost moving mentioned above also have a division of good and ill: for example in the hexagram Feng, Thunder over Fire, the ghost moving is to be avoided in divining about brothers, Wealth moving in divining about parents and oneself; a wife divining about her husband has in the end no ill; the other hexagrams follow this.

dispute.yi: 周易尚占和文王金钱课按卦名断病，对这里点名的几个卦说得相反或轻重不同：观，周易尚占说「财聚病痊」，文王金钱课说「占病即愈」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.02、WWJQ.03）；贲，周易尚占说「病安」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.03）；大畜，周易尚占说「病脱」，文王金钱课说「疾病口舌渐渐磨」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.02、WWJQ.03）；丰，文王金钱课说「疾病渐好」，周易尚占说「病人沉滞」（LY.ILL.WWJQ.03、ZSZ.04）；夬，周易尚占说「病讼迟延」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.04）；临，周易尚占说「病犯崇侵」，文王金钱课补录部分说「疾病即痊」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.07、WWJQ.05）。不过天玄赋这里说的是有条件的：观、贲、需、临是世身入墓才忌，大畜、丰、同、蛊、夬是财鬼俱兴才忌，不是见到卦名就凶。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The Zhouyi Shangzhan and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke judge illness by the name of the hexagram, and for several of the hexagrams named here they say the opposite, or a lighter thing: for Guan the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'wealth gathers and the illness is cured' and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says 'divining illness, it is cured at once' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.02, WWJQ.03); for Bi the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the illness is settled' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.03); for Daxu (Great Accumulation) the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the illness is shed' and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says 'illness and quarrels are gradually worn away' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.02, WWJQ.03); for Feng the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says 'the illness gradually gets better' and the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the sick are held fast' (LY.ILL.WWJQ.03, ZSZ.04); for Guai the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'illness and lawsuit are delayed' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.04); for Lin the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the illness offends a curse that attacks' and the Wenwang Jinqian Ke, in its supplementary part, says 'the illness is cured at once' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.07, WWJQ.05). The Tianxuan Fu here, however, speaks with a condition: Guan, Bi, Xu (Waiting) and Lin are to be feared only when the Self and the Body enter a tomb, and Daxu, Feng, Tongren, Gu and Guai only when Wealth and Pressure both rise, so that the name of the hexagram alone does not make it ominous. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这一节说的是「入墓卦」：两句赋点出十个卦（明夷、观、贲、需、临是「世身入墓」，大畜、丰、同、蛊、夬是「财鬼俱兴」），注里先举观、贲两例讲什么叫「身随鬼入墓」「世随鬼入墓」，再引苍屏的一首歌诀，讲八宫里各卦化入墓（乾化艮、坤化巽、震化坤、巽化坤、坎化巽、离化乾、艮化风、兑化山）对应家里的哪一位亲人有灾——「艮化风内」「兑化山中」的「风」是巽、「山」是艮。「应题」这里译作「answering the topic」，按字面，意思大概是卦象应了所问的人。「同」按上下文是同人。「条贯」是条理、头绪，「必须把其条贯」是说要把这些条件都对上了才可以断为全凶。这里用的是卦名代表一类：文字里提到的卦（观、贲、丰）是举例，「余卦仿此」。注末原文还有一段「虎易评注」，是今人加的，本库不引。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section is about the 'tomb hexagrams': two lines of verse name ten hexagrams (Mingyi, Guan, Bi, Xu and Lin as 'the Self and Body entering a tomb', and Daxu, Feng, Tong, Gu and Guai as 'Wealth and the ghost both rising'); the commentary first gives the examples of Guan and Bi to say what 'the Body following the ghost into a tomb' and 'the Self following the ghost into a tomb' mean, and then quotes a verse of Cangping's on which relative in the family is in calamity when each hexagram of the eight palaces changes into a tomb (Qian into Gen, Kun into Xun, Zhen into Kun, Xun into Kun, Kan into Xun, Li into Qian, Gen into the wind, Dui into the mountain) — the 'wind' of 'Gen changing into the wind' is Xun and the 'mountain' of 'Dui changing into the mountain' is Gen. 'Answering the topic' is translated literally, and probably means that the hexagram answers to the person asked about. 'Tong' is Tongren from the context. 'Tiao guan' is orderliness or thread, and 'one must grasp its threads' says that all these conditions must fit before it may be judged wholly ominous. The hexagram names stand for a kind here: the hexagrams mentioned in the text (Guan, Bi, Feng) are examples, and 'the other hexagrams follow this'. At the end of the commentary the original has a further passage, 'Huyi's commentary', added by a modern hand, which this library does not quote. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 明夷、观、贲、需、临这几个卦，
切忌世和身入墓；
大畜、丰、同（人）、蛊、夬，
不要遇到财和鬼一起兴动。
en: Mingyi, Guan, Bi (Adornment), Xu and Lin:
most to be avoided is the Self and the Body entering a tomb;
Daxu, Feng, Tong(ren), Gu and Guai:
do not meet Wealth and the ghost both rising.

yi: 凡是占病，
怕身、世跟着鬼入墓，
一定治不好。
比如风地观的二爻乙巳，
鬼和身也在二爻，
如果入了墓，
就是身随鬼入墓。
山火贲卦，
初爻己卯，
鬼和世也在初爻，
如果入了墓，
就是世随鬼入墓。
en: In divining illness,
one fears the Body and the Self following the ghost into a tomb,
and then there is surely no recovery.
For example, in Feng-Di Guan the second line Yisi,
with the ghost and the Body also on the second line,
if it enters a tomb,
that is the Body following the ghost into a tomb.
In the hexagram Bi (Adornment), Mountain over Fire,
the first line Jimao,
with the ghost and the Self also on the first line,
if it enters a tomb,
that is the Self following the ghost into a tomb.

yi: 上面两个卦，
举来作例子，
其余的卦照这样仿。
en: These two hexagrams
are given as examples,
and the other hexagrams follow this.

yi: 苍屏这样说：
「乾化入艮，父亲遭丧；
坤化入巽，母亲忧亡；
震化入坤，长男有厄；
巽化入坤，长女当灾。
坎化入巽，中男遭厄；
离化入乾，中女暴卒；
艮化入风（巽），少男倾倒；
兑化入山（艮），少女暴卒。
这是八宫化来入墓，
十个人得病九个亡故」。
en: Cangping says:
'Qian changing into Gen, the father is in mourning;
Kun changing into Xun, the mother worried to death;
Zhen changing into Kun, calamity for the eldest son;
Xun changing into Kun, the eldest daughter takes it.
Kan changing into Xun, calamity for the middle son;
Li changing into Qian, the middle daughter dies suddenly;
Gen changing into the wind (Xun), the youngest son topples;
Dui changing into the mountain (Gen), the youngest daughter dies suddenly.
These are the eight palaces changing into a tomb,
and of ten who fall ill nine die.'

yi: 上面说的卦墓，
不能把乾化入艮墓，
只当作忧父亲的亡故；
而要看占病都不吉。
假如儿子占父亲，
遇到乾化艮，
叫做应题，
这是大凶。
大畜等五个卦，
占病是大忌；
财和鬼不动，
不一定死；
财和鬼空亡，
虽然有病也不死；
必须把它的条理理清了，
才可以断为全凶。
上文所说的财鬼发动，
也有吉凶的分别。
比如雷火丰卦：
鬼动忌占兄弟，
财动忌占父母和自己本人；
妻子占丈夫，
终究没有凶；
其余的卦仿此。
en: As for the tomb hexagrams above,
one may not take Qian changing into the Gen tomb
as only a worry for the father's death;
but must look at illness in all of them as inauspicious.
Suppose a son divines about his father
and meets Qian changing into Gen:
it is called 'answering the topic',
and is greatly ominous.
The five hexagrams such as Daxu
are greatly to be avoided in divining illness;
if Wealth and the ghost do not move,
death is not certain;
if Wealth and the ghost are Void,
though ill he will not die;
one must grasp its threads,
and only then may one judge it wholly ominous.
The Wealth and ghost moving mentioned above
also have a division of good and ill.
For example in the hexagram Feng, Thunder over Fire:
the ghost moving is to be avoided in divining about brothers,
Wealth moving in divining about parents and oneself;
a wife divining about her husband
has in the end no ill;
the other hexagrams follow this.

title: 男怕长生兼怕未来之节、女嫌沐浴最嫌过去之辰：男子怕鬼爻长生日得病，卦无子孙青龙天医发动则鬼爻墓绝日死；寅日遇火鬼、巳日遇金鬼、申日水土鬼、亥日木鬼谓之长生鬼；先看鬼爻衰旺再论节气（男怕未来节、近节必重、过节无伤）；女人怕鬼爻沐浴日得病（卯日火鬼、午日金鬼、酉日水土鬼、子日木鬼），过节后必重

rule.yi: 男人怕长生，还怕未来的节气；女人嫌沐浴，最嫌过去的日子。注说：男子怕在鬼爻长生的日子得病，和鬼一起衰旺；卦里没有子孙、青龙、天医发动的，鬼爻墓绝的日子就死。又说：寅日遇火鬼、巳日遇金鬼、申日遇水土鬼、亥日遇木鬼，叫长生鬼；占的人遇上，大凶在后面，沉重才会来。凡决断安危，先按鬼爻的衰旺推断，再按节气来论：男人怕未来的节，临近节令必定加重，过了节就没有伤害；节前不重的，一定没有妨碍；如果是久病，应当以四季节候来论，比如木鬼忌秋天的节气，遇节不重，过节一定安。女人最忌在鬼爻沐浴的日子得病。又说：卯日遇火鬼、午日遇金鬼、酉日遇水土鬼、子日遇木鬼，叫沐浴鬼；遇上难痊愈，到后来反而加重；再看节后必定加重，不加重就没有伤害；女人极怕过后的节。
rule.en: A man fears the Birth stage and also fears the coming solar term; a woman dislikes the Bath stage and most dislikes the term that has passed. The commentary says: a man fears falling ill on a day when the Pressure line is at Birth, and it rises and falls with the ghost; if the hexagram has no Output, Azure Dragon or Heavenly Doctor moving, he dies on a day when the Pressure line is in a tomb or at Extinction. It says again: a Fire ghost met on a Yin day, a Metal ghost on a Si day, a Water or Earth ghost on a Shen day, a Wood ghost on a Hai day, is called a Birth ghost; one who meets it will have great ill afterwards, and the heaviness only comes later. To decide danger and safety, first judge by the strength of the Pressure line, and then by the solar term: a man fears the coming term, near the term it is surely heavier, and past the term there is no harm; if it is not heavy before the term, there is surely no obstruction; if it is a long illness, one should reason by the seasonal terms of the four seasons, for example a Wood ghost fears the autumn terms, and if on meeting the term it is not heavy, after the term it will surely be at peace. A woman most fears falling ill on a day when the Pressure line is at Bath. It says again: a Fire ghost met on a Mao day, a Metal ghost on a Wu day, a Water or Earth ghost on a You day, a Wood ghost on a Zi day, is called a Bath ghost; met, it is hard to cure, and it becomes heavier afterwards; look next at the term after, when it is surely heavier, and if it is not heavy there is no harm; a woman greatly fears the term that has passed.

note.yi: 这一节讲的是「长生鬼」和「沐浴鬼」：鬼爻长生的日子、沐浴的日子得病，加上节气的前后，判轻重。「长生」是十二长生的第一位（生），「沐浴」是第二位；寅日遇火鬼是火长生在寅，巳日遇金鬼是金长生在巳，申日遇水土鬼是水土长生在申，亥日遇木鬼是木长生在亥——所以叫长生鬼；沐浴鬼：卯日火鬼、午日金鬼、酉日水土鬼、子日木鬼，正是沐浴的位置。「未来之节」是还没到的节气，「过去之辰」是已过的日子/节气，男怕节前、女怕节后：男人在近节时必重、过节无伤；女人在节后必重。「四时节候」是二十四节气。这一段和易隐（LY.ILL.YY.10「男忌官鬼长生日得病，女忌官鬼沐浴日得病」）、黄金策（LY.ILL.HJC.05 一带）是同一说，只是这里多了节气的讲法。男女判轻重的方向是相反的，这是这本书的规定，没有解释。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section is about the 'Birth ghost' and the 'Bath ghost': falling ill on a day when the Pressure line is at Birth or at Bath, together with what comes before or after the solar term, decides light or heavy. 'Birth' is the first place of the twelve stages of growth, and 'Bath' the second; a Fire ghost on a Yin day is Fire's Birth at Yin, a Metal ghost on a Si day is Metal's Birth at Si, a Water or Earth ghost on a Shen day is Water and Earth's Birth at Shen, and a Wood ghost on a Hai day is Wood's Birth at Hai — hence 'Birth ghost'; the Bath ghost: Fire on Mao, Metal on Wu, Water and Earth on You, Wood on Zi, which are exactly the Bath places. 'The coming term' is the solar term not yet arrived, and 'the term that has passed' is the day or term that has gone by: a man fears before the term and a woman after: for a man near the term it is surely heavy and past the term there is no harm; for a woman after the term it is surely heavy. The 'seasonal terms of the four seasons' are the twenty-four solar terms. This passage says the same as the Yi Yin (LY.ILL.YY.10, 'a man should fear falling ill on the day the Pressure line is born, a woman on the day it is at Bath') and the Huangjin Ce (LY.ILL.HJC.05 and around), only with the added account of the solar terms. That the man's and the woman's directions of judging light and heavy are opposite is this book's rule and is not explained. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 男人怕长生，
还怕未来的节气；
女人嫌沐浴，
最嫌过去的日子。
en: A man fears the Birth stage,
and also fears the coming solar term;
a woman dislikes the Bath stage,
and most dislikes the term that has passed.

zh: 男子怕鬼爻长生日得病，
卦无子孙、青龙、天医发动，
yi: 男子怕在鬼爻长生的日子得病，
和鬼一起衰旺；
卦里没有子孙、青龙、天医发动的，
鬼爻墓绝的日子就死。
en: A man fears falling ill on a day when the Pressure line is at Birth,
and it rises and falls with the ghost;
if the hexagram has no Output, Azure Dragon or Heavenly Doctor moving,
he dies on a day when the Pressure line is in a tomb or at Extinction.

yi: 又说道：
寅日遇火鬼，
巳日遇金鬼，
申日遇水土鬼，
亥日遇木鬼，
叫做长生鬼；
占的人遇上它，
大凶在后面，
沉重才会来。
en: It says again:
a Fire ghost met on a Yin day,
a Metal ghost on a Si day,
a Water or Earth ghost on a Shen day,
a Wood ghost on a Hai day,
is called a Birth ghost;
one who meets it
will have great ill afterwards,
and the heaviness only comes later.

zh: 女人最忌鬼爻沐浴日得病。
yi: 凡是决断安危，
先按鬼爻的衰旺推断，
再按节气来论。
男人怕未来的节，
临近节令必定加重，
过了节就没有伤害；
节前不重的，
一定没有妨碍。
如果是久病，
应当以四季的节候来论。
比如木鬼忌讳秋天的节气，
遇到节不加重，
过了节一定安。
女人最忌在鬼爻沐浴的日子得病。
en: To decide danger and safety,
first judge by the strength of the Pressure line,
and then by the solar term.
A man fears the coming term;
near the term it is surely heavier,
and past the term there is no harm;
if it is not heavy before the term,
there is surely no obstruction.
If it is a long illness,
one should reason by the seasonal terms of the four seasons;
for example a Wood ghost fears the autumn terms,
and if on meeting the term it is not heavy,
after the term it will surely be at peace.
A woman most fears falling ill on a day when the Pressure line is at Bath.

yi: 又说道：
卯日遇火鬼，
午日遇金鬼，
酉日遇水土鬼，
子日遇木鬼，
叫做沐浴鬼；
遇上难痊愈，
到后来反而加重。
再看节后必定加重，
不加重就没有伤害；
女人极怕过后的节。
en: It says again:
a Fire ghost met on a Mao day,
a Metal ghost on a Wu day,
a Water or Earth ghost on a You day,
a Wood ghost on a Zi day,
is called a Bath ghost;
met, it is hard to cure,
and it becomes heavier afterwards.
look next at the term after, when it is surely heavier,
and if it is not heavy there is no harm;
a woman greatly fears the term that has passed.

title: 不宜丘墓同宫、安可雷风合卦：三丘五墓二杀俱动病人作福也难留；雷风是棺椁杀——震为棺、巽为椁、坤为墓、艮为冢，占病若全必死

rule.yi: 不适宜丘墓在同一宫，怎么能雷风合成一卦？注说：三丘、五墓都见后面。这两个煞一起发动，病人做福也留不住；雷风是棺椁杀，震是棺，巽是椁，坤是墓，艮是冢，占病如果都齐了，必死。
rule.en: It is not fitting for the Mounds and Tombs to be in the same palace; how can Thunder and Wind combine in one hexagram? The commentary says: the Three Mounds and Five Tombs are all given later. When the two killings move together, even if the sick person performs blessing rites he can hardly be kept; Thunder and Wind are the Coffin-and-Outer-Coffin killing, Zhen being the coffin, Xun the outer coffin, Kun the grave and Gen the tomb mound; if in divining an illness all are present, he surely dies.

note.yi: 「二杀」是三丘和五墓，书里说「俱见后」——后面的凶煞章。三丘五墓的排法（春丑夏辰秋未冬戌为三丘，对宫取五墓）见易林补遗「总论星煞值鬼诀」（LY.ILL.EL.51），「病人作福也难留」一句同是那首歌诀里的原话。「雷风」指震（雷）、巽（风）两卦：震为棺、巽为椁，和易冒、增删卜易里「风雷合卦、棺椁俱全」（LY.ILL.ZS.15）是同一个说法。「占病若全必死」的「全」是丘、墓、棺、椁几样都齐了。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: The 'two killings' are the Three Mounds and the Five Tombs, of which the book says 'all given later' — in the later chapter on malign killings. How the Three Mounds and Five Tombs are set (Chou in spring, Chen in summer, Wei in autumn and Xu in winter for the Three Mounds, the Five Tombs taken from the opposite palace) is in the Yilin Buyi's 'general discourse on ghosts by the stars and killings' (LY.ILL.EL.51), and 'even if the sick person performs blessing rites he can hardly be kept' is the very line of that verse. 'Thunder and Wind' are the Zhen (thunder) and Xun (wind) trigrams: Zhen is the coffin and Xun the outer coffin, the same saying as 'thunder and wind combining, coffin and outer coffin complete' in the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.15). The 'all' of 'if in divining illness all are present' is that the mound, the tomb, the coffin and the outer coffin are all there. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 不适宜丘墓在同一宫，
怎么能让雷风合成一卦？
en: It is not fitting for the Mounds and Tombs to be in the same palace;
how can Thunder and Wind combine in one hexagram?

yi: 三丘、五墓，
都见后面。
en: The Three Mounds and Five Tombs:
all are given later.

yi: 这两个煞一起发动，
病人做福也难留。
雷和风这两卦，
是棺椁杀。
震卦是棺，
巽卦是椁，
坤卦是墓，
艮卦是冢。
占病如果都齐了，必死。
en: When the two killings move together,
even if the sick person performs blessing rites he can hardly be kept.
Thunder and Wind
are the Coffin-and-Outer-Coffin killing.
Zhen is the coffin,
Xun is the outer coffin,
Kun is the grave,
Gen is the tomb mound.
If in divining an illness all are present, he surely dies.

title: 既论染灾之表里须言得病之因由：先断症候然后议病因；六兽临官分内外、八宫值鬼别阴阳；鬼临六神看在何爻——在内在家得病、在外他处招殃；青龙鬼酒色过度或因财有伤、妇人因喜有疾、鬼空堕胎；朱雀口舌咒咀（二爻灶下三爻当门或家堂神前、金鬼动敲锅铛）；勾陈饮食不节脾胃不调、临木鬼因修造动土；螣蛇事务萦心忧愁思虑虚惊怪异；白虎斗殴跌扑伤筋损骨或寒酸冲肺；玄武色欲过度伤饥冒雨

rule.yi: 已经讲了染灾的表里，还要说得病的因由。注说：占病，先断定症候，然后议论病因；能把这一章弄明白，才称得上通神的占卜。六兽临在官鬼上，要分内外；八宫值鬼，要分阴阳。注说：但凡鬼临着六神，就看它在哪一爻：在内，是在家里得病；在外，是在别处招来的灾殃。青龙鬼：酒色过度，或者因为财而有伤，妇人是因喜事有病；青龙鬼落空，有堕胎的忧患。朱雀鬼：口舌和咒骂，在二爻是在灶下咒骂，在三爻是当门咒骂，或者是家堂神前咒骂；如果朱雀临着金鬼发动，是敲着锅铛咒骂。勾陈鬼：饮食不节制，饥饱失常，脾胃不调；临着木鬼，是在修造动土的地方得的病。螣蛇鬼：事务缠心，忧愁思虑，或者虚惊怪异，因而得病，这一爻大多是心家受病。白虎鬼：斗殴、跌扑，伤筋损骨，或者是寒酸冲肺。玄武鬼：色欲过度，饥饱失常、冒雨。
rule.en: Having discussed the outside and inside of the infection, one must now speak of the cause of the illness. The commentary says: in divining illness, first settle the symptoms, and then discuss the cause; if one can understand this chapter, one may truly be called one whose divination reaches the gods. When the six beasts sit on the Pressure line one must distinguish inside and outside; when the ghost falls in the eight palaces one should tell yin from yang. The commentary says: whenever a ghost sits on one of the six spirits, look at which line it is on: inside, the illness was got at home; outside, calamity was brought on elsewhere. The Azure Dragon ghost: excess in wine and lust, or injury through wealth, and in a woman illness from a joyful event; the Azure Dragon ghost Void: the danger of miscarriage. The Vermilion Bird ghost: quarrels and cursing; on the second line, cursing beside the stove; on the third line, cursing at the door, or cursing before the household gods; if the Vermilion Bird sits on a Metal ghost that moves, cursing while banging pots and pans. The Hook Earth ghost: irregular eating, hunger and overeating, the spleen and stomach out of order; if it sits on a Wood ghost, the illness was got at a place of building and digging. The Coiling Snake ghost: affairs entangling the heart, worry and brooding, or a false fright and strangeness, and so the illness is contracted; this line is mostly an illness of the heart. The White Tiger ghost: brawls and falls, injury to sinews and bones, or cold and sourness striking the lungs. The Dark Tortoise ghost: excess of lust, hunger and overeating, and exposure to rain.

note.yi: 这一节接上一条（TXF.08）之后，是「先断症候、再议病因」的分界：赋文「既论染灾之表里，须言得病之因由」是上半章（症候、轻重、生死）到下半章（病因、医药）的转折句。「六兽临官」是官鬼临着哪一神，「八宫值鬼宜别阴阳」是鬼在哪一宫、阴爻还是阳爻，注文只详细写了六兽，没有展开八宫。六神鬼的病因和易隐「病因·六神」（LY.ILL.YY.17）、易林补遗「按六神论病由何得」（LY.ILL.EL.05）、黄金策六神病因是同一类办法，天玄赋这里还多了一层：朱雀鬼在二爻是灶下咒咀、三爻是当门咒咀，金鬼动是「敲锅铛咒咀」，这和易隐同条几乎一字不差（LY.ILL.YY.17「朱雀……二爻灶下、三爻当门、五爻香火道路、金鬼敲锅」），易隐还多了五爻。「寒酸冲肺」按字面译作「cold and sourness striking the lungs」。「妇人因喜有疾」是女人因喜事（生子、宴会）得病。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section follows the previous entry (TXF.08) and is the dividing line between 'first settle the symptoms, then discuss the cause': the verse 'having discussed the outside and inside of the infection, one must speak of the cause of the illness' is the turn from the first half of the chapter (symptoms, light and heavy, life and death) to the second (cause, medicine). 'The six beasts sit on the Pressure line' is which spirit the Pressure line sits on, and 'the ghost falls in the eight palaces, tell yin from yang' is which palace the ghost is in and whether the line is yin or yang, but the commentary sets out only the six beasts in detail and does not expand the eight palaces. The causes of illness by the six spirits are the same kind of method as the Yi Yin's 'cause of illness by the six spirits' (LY.ILL.YY.17), the Yilin Buyi's 'how the illness was contracted by the six spirits' (LY.ILL.EL.05) and the Huangjin Ce's causes by the six spirits, and here the Tianxuan Fu adds a further layer: the Vermilion Bird ghost on the second line is cursing beside the stove and on the third line cursing at the door, and a Metal ghost moving is 'cursing while banging pots and pans', which is almost word for word the same as the Yi Yin's same entry (LY.ILL.YY.17, 'the Vermilion Bird ... second line beside the stove, third line at the door, fifth line incense fire and roads, a Metal ghost banging pots'), the Yi Yin adding the fifth line. 'Cold and sourness striking the lungs' is rendered literally. 'In a woman illness from a joyful event' is a woman falling ill from a joyful event (a birth, a feast). After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 已经论过染灾的表里，
还须说到得病的因由。
en: Having discussed the outside and inside of the infection,
one must now speak of the cause of the illness.

yi: 凡是占病，
先断定症候的确切，
然后议论病因。
更能弄明白这一章，
确实可以称为通神的占卜了。
en: In divining illness,
first settle the symptoms precisely,
and then discuss the cause.
If one can further understand this chapter,
one may truly be called one whose divination reaches the gods.

yi: 六兽临在官上，
应当分内外；
八宫值鬼，
应当分阴阳。
en: When the six beasts sit on the Pressure line,
one must distinguish inside and outside;
when the ghost falls in the eight palaces,
one should tell yin from yang.

zh: 但逢鬼临六神，看在何爻。在内则在家得病，在外则他处招殃。
青龙鬼：是酒色过度，或因财有伤，妇人因喜有疾；
朱雀鬼：口舌及咒咀。在二爻，灶下咒咀；在三爻，当门咒咀；或家堂神前咒咀。
如朱雀临金鬼动，敲锅铛咒咀。
勾陈鬼：饮食不节，伤饥失饱，脾胃不调。临木鬼：因修造动土处得病。
螣蛇鬼：事务萦心，忧愁思虑，或虚惊怪异，因而染病。此爻多是心家受病。
白虎鬼：斗殴跌扑，伤筋损骨，或寒酸冲肺。
玄武鬼：色欲过度，伤饥冒雨。
yi: 但凡鬼临着六神，就看它在哪一爻。在内，是在家里得病；在外，是在别处招来的灾殃。
青龙鬼：是酒色过度，或者因为财有伤，妇人是因喜事有病；
青龙鬼落空，有堕胎的忧患。
朱雀鬼：口舌和咒骂；在二爻，是在灶下咒骂；在三爻，是当门咒骂；或者是家堂神前咒骂。
如果朱雀临着金鬼发动，是敲着锅铛咒骂。
勾陈鬼：饮食不节制，饥饱失常，脾胃不调；临着木鬼，是在修造动土的地方得的病。
螣蛇鬼：事务缠心，忧愁思虑，或者虚惊怪异，因而得病；这一爻大多是心家受病。
白虎鬼：斗殴、跌扑，伤筋损骨，或者是寒酸冲肺。
玄武鬼：色欲过度，饥饱失常、冒雨。
en: Whenever a ghost sits on one of the six spirits, look at which line it is on: inside, the illness was got at home; outside, calamity was brought on elsewhere.
The Azure Dragon ghost: excess in wine and lust, or injury through wealth, and in a woman illness from a joyful event;
the Azure Dragon ghost Void: the danger of miscarriage.
The Vermilion Bird ghost: quarrels and cursing; on the second line, cursing beside the stove; on the third line, cursing at the door; or cursing before the household gods.
If the Vermilion Bird sits on a Metal ghost that moves, cursing while banging pots and pans.
The Hook Earth ghost: irregular eating, hunger and overeating, the spleen and stomach out of order; if it sits on a Wood ghost, the illness was got at a place of building and digging.
The Coiling Snake ghost: affairs entangling the heart, worry and brooding, or a false fright and strangeness, and so the illness is contracted; this line is mostly an illness of the heart.
The White Tiger ghost: brawls and falls, injury to sinews and bones, or cold and sourness striking the lungs.
The Dark Tortoise ghost: excess of lust, hunger and overeating, and exposure to rain.

title: 卦若无鬼病难医症候难决：以克杀动者断、不动以克用爻者断、又以伏鬼断；鬼伏父母下忧心得病或穿衣过与不及（冬言衣单夏言衣重）、伏兄弟下赌博争财、伏子孙下外情牵惹、伏财下饮食太过、伏杀下旧病再发难除根；老人卦忌生旺、小儿卦忌休囚；最宜病人本命上卦；阴鬼夜重日轻、阳鬼夜轻日重

rule.yi: 卦里如果没有鬼，病就难医，症候也难决断。只能用克的杀发动的来断；不动的，就用克用爻的来断，再用伏着的鬼来断。如果鬼伏在父母爻下：忧心得的病，或者穿衣服得的病，穿得过多或不足，冬天就说衣服单薄，夏天就说衣服厚重。鬼伏在兄弟下：赌博争财；伏在子孙下：被外面的情事牵惹；伏在财下：饮食太过；伏在杀下：旧病再发，也难除根。老人的卦忌旺相，小孩的卦忌休囚。最好是病人的本命上卦，大吉。遇到阴鬼，夜里重白天轻；阳鬼，夜里轻白天重；阴阳各自依爻上来看。
rule.en: If there is no ghost in the hexagram, the illness is hard to treat and the symptoms hard to decide. One can only judge by the killing that controls and moves; if it does not move, judge by what controls the Subject line, and also judge by the hidden ghost. If the ghost is hidden under Resource: illness got from a worried heart, or from clothing, too much or too little: in winter say the clothes were thin, in summer say the clothes were heavy. The ghost hidden under Peer: gambling and quarrels over money; hidden under Output: entangled by an affair outside; hidden under Wealth: excess in food and drink; hidden under a killing: an old illness flares again, and it is also hard to root out. An old person's hexagram fears being strong, a child's hexagram fears being resting or trapped. Best is for the sick person's natal line to be in the hexagram, which is greatly auspicious. A yin ghost is heavy at night and light by day; a yang ghost is light at night and heavy by day; yin and yang are each read from the line.

dispute.yi: 病在昼夜哪一头重，几家的依据不同。天玄赋注（LY.ILL.TXF.10）是「阴鬼夜重日轻、阳鬼夜轻日重」，和易隐（LY.ILL.YY.15）一致，都按官鬼的阴阳分；海底眼（LY.ILL.HDY.02）、黄金策的旧注和王洪绪（LY.ILL.HJC.12）则按官鬼在内卦还是外卦分（内卦夜重、外卦白天重）。两个标准可以给出相反的结论，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Whether an illness is heavier by day or by night: the books use different criteria. The commentary on the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.10) has 'a yin ghost is heavy at night and light by day, a yang ghost light at night and heavy by day', which agrees with the Yi Yin (LY.ILL.YY.15) in dividing by the yin or yang of the Pressure line; the Haidi Yan (LY.ILL.HDY.02), the old commentary of the Huangjin Ce and Wang Hongxu (LY.ILL.HJC.12) divide instead by whether the Pressure line is in the inner or outer trigram (inner trigram heavy at night, outer trigram heavy by day). The two criteria can give opposite conclusions, and the books do not settle it.

note.yi: 这一节是「卦无鬼」时怎么办：没有官鬼，病难医、症候难决，就退而求其次——用「克杀动者」（克用爻的煞在动）断；它不动，用「克用爻者」断；再用「伏鬼」断，也就是官鬼伏在哪一爻下。伏鬼的六亲断法和海底眼（LY.ILL.HDY.04）、易冒的六亲（LY.ILL.YM.60 一带）是同一个路子：父母下是忧虑或穿衣、兄弟下是赌博争财、子孙下是外情牵惹、财下是饮食太过、杀下是旧病再发。「穿衣服得病，过与不及，冬言衣单，夏言衣重」是说冬天穿得少，夏天穿得多——按季节说得病是穿衣不当。「老人卦忌生旺，小儿卦忌休囚」和易隐（LY.ILL.YY.10）「少年卦忌死囚休废、老人卦忌旺相」同一句。「最宜病人本命上卦」的「本命」是病人的生年属相所在的爻（本命爻）。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section is about what to do when the hexagram has no ghost: with no Pressure line the illness is hard to treat and the symptoms hard to decide, and one falls back on the next best — judging by 'the killing that controls and moves' (the killing that controls the Subject line moving); if it does not move, judging by 'what controls the Subject line'; and further judging by the hidden ghost, that is, under which line the Pressure line hides. The six-relation reading of a hidden ghost is on the same road as the Haidi Yan (LY.ILL.HDY.04) and the Yi Mao's six relations (LY.ILL.YM.60 and around): under Resource, worry or clothing; under Peer, gambling and quarrels over money; under Output, entangled by an affair outside; under Wealth, excess in food and drink; under a killing, an old illness flares again. 'Illness from clothing, too much or too little; in winter say the clothes were thin, in summer say the clothes were heavy' says that a person who wore too little in winter or too much in summer fell ill from wearing the wrong clothing for the season. 'An old person's hexagram fears being strong, a child's hexagram fears being resting or trapped' is the same sentence as the Yi Yin's (LY.ILL.YY.10, 'a young person's hexagram fears Death, trapped, resting and abandoned, an old person's hexagram fears being strong'). The 'natal' of 'best is for the sick person's natal line to be in the hexagram' is the line where the sick person's birth animal falls (the natal line). After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

zh: 卦若无鬼，其病难医，症候难决。
但以克杀动者断之；不动，以克用爻者断，又以伏鬼断。
若鬼伏父母下：忧心得病，
过与不及，冬言衣单，夏言衣重。
鬼伏杀下：旧病再发，亦难除根。
老人卦忌生旺，小儿卦忌休囚。
最宜病人本命上卦，大吉也。
值阴鬼，夜重日轻；阳鬼，夜轻日重。
yi: 卦里如果没有鬼，病就难医，症候也难决断。
只能用克的杀发动的来断；不动的，就用克用爻的来断，再用伏着的鬼来断。
如果鬼伏在父母爻下：忧心得的病，
或者穿衣服得的病；
穿得过多或不足，冬天就说衣服单薄，夏天就说衣服厚重。
鬼伏在兄弟下：赌博争财；
鬼伏在子孙下：被外面的情事牵惹；
鬼伏在财下：饮食太过；
鬼伏在杀下：旧病再发，也难除根。
老人的卦忌旺相，小孩的卦忌休囚。
最好是病人的本命上卦，大吉。
遇到阴鬼，夜里重白天轻；阳鬼，夜里轻白天重。
阴阳各自依爻上来看。
en: If there is no ghost in the hexagram, the illness is hard to treat and the symptoms hard to decide.
One can only judge by the killing that controls and moves; if it does not move, judge by what controls the Subject line, and also judge by the hidden ghost.
If the ghost is hidden under Resource: illness got from a worried heart,
or from clothing;
too much or too little: in winter say the clothes were thin, in summer say the clothes were heavy.
The ghost hidden under Peer: gambling and quarrels over money;
hidden under Output: entangled by an affair outside;
hidden under Wealth: excess in food and drink;
hidden under a killing: an old illness flares again, and it is also hard to root out.
An old person's hexagram fears being strong, a child's hexagram fears being resting or trapped.
