Best is for the sick person's natal line to be in the hexagram, which is greatly auspicious.
A yin ghost is heavy at night and light by day; a yang ghost is light at night and heavy by day.
Yin and yang are each read from the line.

title: 世人有疾病者亦有贤愚之分：贤者以医药为重、愚者以祷告为先，占者要察其情状；鬼神儒家本不言、为患者之占不得不据理推详以为阴功默佑；木主东岳天齐圣帝等、水是河泊水府等、土是瘟蝗疫疠中央土府之神、金是衔刀五道飞廉白虎金神七杀等、火是南方火部赤睛朱发鹤神等，各连着相应的伤亡之鬼；二爻鬼为灶神、三爻鬼为香火神、子孙动为福神

rule.yi: 世上的人有了病，也有贤愚的分别：贤的把医药放在首位，愚的把祷告放在前头；占卜的人不能不察看他的情状，一眼看去就能知道高下，这样贤的愚的都可以和他说得上话，这门学问才能流传。至于鬼神，儒家本来不说这些，现在为病人占卜，不得不按道理推详，当作暗中的阴功和默佑。木鬼：是东岳天齐圣帝、七十二司、三十六案的神，还有自吊而亡的；水鬼：是河泊水府、沿江七十二庙的神，还有溺水而亡的；土鬼：是瘟蝗疫疠、中央土府的神，还有饥饿绝食而亡的；金鬼：是衔刀、五道、飞廉、白虎、金神、七杀、吟呻、三杀、九良星杀、丧殃、丧杀之神，还有自刎、被刑、阵亡，一切伤亡；火鬼：是南方火部、赤睛朱发的鹤神、毛头毒火之神，还有赴汤蹈火而亡的。如果二爻是鬼，就是灶神；三爻是鬼，是香火神；子孙动是福神。照这样推，万无一失。
rule.en: People with illness are also divided into the worthy and the foolish: the worthy put medicine first, the foolish put prayer first; the one who divines must not fail to observe his circumstances, and one look at the person shows high or low, so that worthy and foolish can both be spoken to and this way can circulate. As for ghosts and spirits, the Confucians did not speak of them originally; now, for divining for the sick, one cannot but reason it out from principle, taking it as hidden merit and silent protection. A Wood ghost: Tianqi, the Holy Emperor of the Eastern Peak, the seventy-two departments and the spirits of the thirty-six cases, and also those who hanged themselves; a Water ghost: the River Count and the Water Mansion, the spirits of the seventy-two temples along the river, and also the drowned; an Earth ghost: epidemic, locusts and plague, the spirits of the central Earth Mansion, and also those who died of hunger and starvation; a Metal ghost: the knife-bearing, the Five Roads, Feilian and the White Tiger, the Golden Spirit, the Seven Killings, Yinshen, the Three Killings, the Nine Good Star killings, the spirits of Mourning Calamity and the Mourning Killing, and also every wounding and death by cutting the throat, by execution or in battle; a Fire ghost: the southern Fire Department, the crane spirit with red eyes and vermilion hair, the shaggy-headed poison-fire spirit, and also those who died going into boiling water and fire. If the ghost is on the second line it is the Kitchen God; if on the third line it is the incense-fire spirit; Output moving is the fortune god. Reasoning from this, not one error in ten thousand.

note.yi: 这一节是天玄赋对「鬼神」的态度和名单。态度：「鬼神者，儒家本不言此」——本来不说，但因为病人占卜，不得不据理推详，当作「阴功默佑」；这和黄金策、易冒把神鬼只当大类看的态度接近，和易林补遗把神名逐个点出的做法不同。名单按五行给：木（东岳天齐圣帝等）、水（河泊水府）、土（瘟蝗疫疠、中央土府）、金（衔刀五道飞廉白虎金神七杀等）、火（南方火部、鹤神、毒火之神），每类还带着相应的死法。这一套和黄金策「五行推鬼神」（LY.ILL.HJC.97）、易隐「鬼崇·神与鬼的名目」（LY.ILL.YY.28）、易林补遗的五行诀（LY.ILL.EL.46）是同一类名单，野鹤则批评把金官指为关公岳公等具体神（LY.ILL.ZS.24）。「二爻鬼为灶神、三爻鬼为香火神、子孙动为福神」和易林补遗「按爻位断神鬼」（LY.ILL.EL.37）、黄金策「六爻推鬼神」（LY.ILL.HJC.101）一致。「吟呻」「三杀」「九良星杀」「丧殃」照字面译；「赤睛朱发鹤神」「毛头毒火之神」是形容火部神的样子，按字面译。「自吊」是上吊自尽。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。 这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This section is the Tianxuan Fu's attitude to and list of 'ghosts and spirits'. The attitude: 'as for ghosts and spirits, the Confucians did not speak of them' — they did not originally, but for the divining of the sick one cannot but reason it out from principle, taking it as 'hidden merit and silent protection'; this is close to the Huangjin Ce and the Yi Mao, which treat gods and ghosts only as broad kinds, and unlike the Yilin Buyi, which names the gods one by one. The list is given by the five phases: Wood (Tianqi, the Holy Emperor of the Eastern Peak and so on), Water (the River Count and the Water Mansion), Earth (epidemic, locusts and plague, the central Earth Mansion), Metal (the knife-bearing, the Five Roads, Feilian, the White Tiger, the Golden Spirit, the Seven Killings and so on) and Fire (the southern Fire Department, the crane spirit, the poison-fire spirit), each with its matching kind of death. This is the same kind of list as the Huangjin Ce's 'the five phases and the gods and ghosts' (LY.ILL.HJC.97), the Yi Yin's 'the names of gods and ghosts' (LY.ILL.YY.28) and the Yilin Buyi's verse on the five phases (LY.ILL.EL.46), while the Old Man of Yehe criticises pointing a Metal Pressure line at particular gods such as Guan Gong and Yue Gong (LY.ILL.ZS.24). 'A ghost on the second line is the Kitchen God, a ghost on the third line the incense-fire spirit, Output moving the fortune god' agrees with the Yilin Buyi's 'ghosts and spirits by line position' (LY.ILL.EL.37) and the Huangjin Ce's 'the six lines and gods and ghosts' (LY.ILL.HJC.101). 'Yinshen', 'the Three Killings', 'the Nine Good Star killings' and 'Mourning Calamity' are rendered literally; 'the crane spirit with red eyes and vermilion hair' and 'the shaggy-headed poison-fire spirit' describe how the gods of the Fire Department look, and are rendered literally. 'Zi diao' is hanging oneself. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; the book does not explain them, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

zh: 世人有疾病者，亦有贤愚之分。
贤者以医药为重，愚者以祷告为先。
一览其人，可知高下，庶几贤愚，皆可共语，其道方能流行。
yi: 世上的人有了疾病，也有贤愚的分别。
贤的把医药放在重要的位置，愚的把祷告放在前头。
占卜的人不可以不察看他的情状。
一眼看去这个人，就能知道高下，这样贤愚都可以和他说得上话，这门学问才能流传。
en: Among people with illness there are also the worthy and the foolish.
The worthy put medicine first, the foolish put prayer first.
The one who divines must not fail to observe his circumstances.
One look at the person shows high or low, so that worthy and foolish can both be spoken to, and only then can this way circulate.

yi: 说到鬼神：
儒家本来不说这些，
现在为患病的人占卜，
不得不按道理推详，
当作暗中的阴功和默佑。
en: As for ghosts and spirits:
the Confucians did not speak of them originally;
now, for divining for the sick,
one cannot but reason it out from principle,
taking it as hidden merit and silent protection.

zh: 木主东岳天齐圣帝，七十二司，三十六案之神，并自吊伤亡。
水是河泊水府，沿江七十二庙之神，并溺水伤亡。
土是瘟蝗疫疠，中央土府之神，并饥饿绝食伤亡。
金是衔刀、五道，飞廉、白虎，金神、七杀，吟呻、三杀，九良星杀，丧殃、丧杀之神，并自刎、被刑、阵亡，一应伤亡。
火是南方火部，赤睛朱发鹤神、毛头毒火之神，并赴汤蹈火伤亡。
若二爻鬼为灶神，三爻鬼为香火神，子孙动为福神。
yi: 木鬼：是东岳天齐圣帝、七十二司、三十六案的神，还有自吊而亡的。
水鬼：是河泊水府、沿江七十二庙的神，还有溺水而亡的。
土鬼：是瘟蝗疫疠、中央土府的神，还有饥饿绝食而亡的。
金鬼：是衔刀、五道、飞廉、白虎、金神、七杀、吟呻、三杀、九良星杀、丧殃、丧杀之神，还有自刎、被刑、阵亡，一切伤亡。
火鬼：是南方火部、赤睛朱发的鹤神、毛头毒火之神，还有赴汤蹈火而亡的。
如果二爻的鬼是灶神，三爻的鬼是香火神，子孙动是福神。
照这样推，万无一失。
en: A Wood ghost: Tianqi, the Holy Emperor of the Eastern Peak, the seventy-two departments and the spirits of the thirty-six cases, and also those who hanged themselves.
A Water ghost: the River Count and the Water Mansion, the spirits of the seventy-two temples along the river, and also the drowned.
An Earth ghost: epidemic, locusts and plague, the spirits of the central Earth Mansion, and also those who died of hunger and starvation.

A Metal ghost: the knife-bearing, the Five Roads, Feilian and the White Tiger, the Golden Spirit, the Seven Killings, Yinshen, the Three Killings, the Nine Good Star killings, the spirits of Mourning Calamity and the Mourning Killing, and also every wounding and death by cutting the throat, by execution or in battle.
A Fire ghost: the southern Fire Department, the crane spirit with red eyes and vermilion hair, the shaggy-headed poison-fire spirit, and also those who died going into boiling water and fire.
If the ghost on the second line is the Kitchen God, the ghost on the third line the incense-fire spirit, and Output moving the fortune god,
reasoning from this, not one error in ten thousand.

title: 医药：伏克飞爻药奏通神之效、子临应位医逢济世之才；世为病人、应及外卦为医药，药克病则愈、病克药则药无灵，外卦及应生世药虽对症作效迟；世动克药按五行（水鬼服药不纳、金鬼久病无效、木鬼犯条贯亦无益、火鬼不能止热、土鬼不对症），应加鬼克世误药损人；子孙为医药临应动克世必遇良医、卦无子孙服药无效、世应比和无子宜换医、子孙临应被世克虽遇良医病未疗、外卦及应克世无福德难安、虎杀临子孙动防医不精

rule.yi: 伏爻克飞爻，药奏神效；子孙临在应位，医生遇上济世之才。注说：世是病人，应和外卦是医药；药如果克病，病就好；病人克药，药就没有灵验；外卦和应生世，药虽然对症，见效迟。世动克药：如果是水鬼，服药不纳；金鬼无气、久病犯真（此处含混），服药无效；木鬼，病一定犯了条贯，即使有药也没有益处；火鬼旺相，症一定刚烈，药也止不住它的热；土鬼，病沉重，药不对症，不能治病；应爻加鬼克世，那就是误了药、损了人。占病以子孙为医药：临应发动克世，必遇良医，病马上痊愈；卦里没有子孙，服药无效；世应比和、卦里又没有子孙，宜换医生；子孙临应爻被世克，虽遇良医病也没有治；外卦和应虽克世，卦里没有福德也难安，可以说有药应当治，只恐怕良医没有缘；子孙虽克世，外爻和应却不克，虽有良医，药饵不中，终究没有大害；虎杀如果临着子孙发动，要防医生不精细。
rule.en: The hidden line controlling the flying line: the medicine works with wondrous effect; Output sitting on the Other's place: the doctor meets one of world-saving talent. The commentary says: the Self is the sick person, the Other line and the outer trigram are the doctor and the medicine; if the medicine controls the illness, the illness is cured at once; if the sick person controls the medicine, the medicine has no effect; if the outer trigram and the Other generate the Self, though the medicine suits the symptoms it takes effect slowly. The Self moving and controlling the medicine: if it is a Water ghost, the medicine taken is not kept down; a Metal ghost without qi, in a long illness that has offended 'the true' (the words are unclear), taking medicine is ineffective; a Wood ghost: the illness surely offends the regulations, and even medicine is of no benefit; a strong Fire ghost: the symptoms are surely fierce and even medicine cannot stop the heat; an Earth ghost: the illness is heavy, the medicine does not suit the symptoms and cannot treat the illness; the Other line with a ghost added controlling the Self is the wrong medicine harming the person. In divining illness Output is the medicine and doctor: sitting on the Other and moving to control the Self, one meets a good doctor and the illness is cured at once; with no Output in the hexagram, taking medicine is ineffective; with the Self and Other harmonious and no Output in the hexagram, one should change the doctor; Output on the Other line controlled by the Self, though one meets a good doctor the illness is not treated; the outer trigram and the Other though controlling the Self, if the hexagram has no Output (the fortune spirit) it is still hard to be at peace, and one may say there is medicine that should treat it but fear the good doctor has no affinity; Output though controlling the Self, if the outer line and the Other do not control it, though there is a good doctor and the medicine does not hit, in the end there is no great harm; if a Tiger killing sits on Output and moves, beware the doctor not being careful.

note.yi: 这一节是医药：「世为病人，应及外卦为医药」——世是病人、应和外卦（应爻和外卦）是医和药；药克病则愈、病克药则无灵、外卦及应生世则药对症但效迟。这个「应为医、世为病人、子孙为药」的三角和易隐「医药·药效」（LY.ILL.YY.21）、易林补遗「求医疗病」（LY.ILL.EL.26）、增删卜易（LY.ILL.ZS.29）一致；「子孙为医药」和易冒「占医药以子孙为用」（LY.ILL.YM.34）相同。五行鬼的一段（水鬼服药不纳、金鬼无效、木鬼犯条贯、火鬼刚症、土鬼沉重）和黄金策的医药（LY.ILL.HJC.7x 一带）对得上。「久病犯真」文字含混，按字面译并标出；「条贯」是条规，「病必犯条贯」按字面译作「the illness surely offends the regulations」（可能指病是犯了什么规矩得的，书里没有解释）；「虎杀」是白虎之类的凶煞，这里写「虎杀」而不写「白虎」，译作 Tiger killing。「误药损人」是药用错了，伤了人。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section is about medicine: 'the Self is the sick person, the Other and the outer trigram are the doctor and the medicine'; the medicine controlling the illness cures, the sick person controlling the medicine leaves it without effect, and the outer trigram and the Other generating the Self make the medicine suit the symptoms but act slowly. This triangle 'the Other is the doctor, the Self the sick person, Output the medicine' agrees with the Yi Yin's 'medicine: the effect of the medicine' (LY.ILL.YY.21), the Yilin Buyi's 'seeking a doctor to treat illness' (LY.ILL.EL.26) and the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.29); and 'Output is the medicine and doctor' is the same as the Yi Mao's 'divining medicine takes Output as the Subject' (LY.ILL.YM.34). The passage on the ghosts of the five phases (Water ghost the medicine not kept down, Metal ghost without effect, Wood ghost offending the regulations, Fire ghost a fierce condition, Earth ghost heavy) matches the Huangjin Ce's medicine passages (LY.ILL.HJC.7x and around). 'A long illness that has offended the true' is unclear, and is translated literally and marked; 'tiao guan' is regulation, and 'the illness surely offends the regulations' is rendered literally (it may mean that the illness was got by breaking some rule, which the book does not explain); 'Tiger killing' is a malign killing such as the White Tiger, and the text writes 'Tiger killing' and not 'White Tiger', so it is translated as Tiger killing. 'The wrong medicine harming the person' is medicine wrongly used and injuring the person. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 伏爻克了飞爻，
药起到通神的效果；
子孙临在应的位置上，
医生遇上济世的人才。
en: The hidden line controlling the flying line,
the medicine works with wondrous effect;
Output sitting on the Other's place,
the doctor meets one of world-saving talent.

zh: 世为病人，应及外卦为医药。
外卦及应生世，药虽对症，作效迟。
世动克药，若是水鬼，服药不纳；
金鬼无气，久病犯真，服药无效；
木鬼，其病必犯条贯，虽药亦无益；
火鬼旺相，其症必刚，虽药不能止其热；
土鬼，其病沉重，药不对症，不能疗病。
应爻加鬼克世，则误药损人矣。
yi: 世是病人，应和外卦是医药。
药如果克了病，病就好；
病人克了药，药没有灵验。
外卦和应生世，药虽然对症，见效迟。
世动克药：如果是水鬼，服药不纳；
金鬼无气，久病犯真（此处含混），服药无效；
木鬼，病一定犯了条贯，虽然有药也没有益处；
火鬼旺相，症一定刚烈，药也止不住它的热；
土鬼，病沉重，药不对症，不能治病。
应爻加鬼克世，那就是误了药、损了人。
en: The Self is the sick person; the Other line and the outer trigram are the doctor and the medicine.
If the medicine controls the illness, the illness is cured at once;
if the sick person controls the medicine, the medicine has no effect.
If the outer trigram and the Other generate the Self, though the medicine suits the symptoms it takes effect slowly.
The Self moving and controlling the medicine: if it is a Water ghost, the medicine taken is not kept down;
a Metal ghost without qi, in a long illness that has offended 'the true' (the words are unclear), taking medicine is ineffective;
a Wood ghost: the illness surely offends the regulations, and even medicine is of no benefit;
a strong Fire ghost: the symptoms are surely fierce and even medicine cannot stop the heat;
an Earth ghost: the illness is heavy, the medicine does not suit the symptoms and cannot treat the illness.
the Other line with a ghost added controlling the Self is the wrong medicine harming the person.

zh: 占病以子孙为医药，临应动克世，必遇良医，其病即痊。
世应比和，卦无子孙，宜换医人。
子孙临应被世克，虽遇良医病未疗。
外卦及应虽克世，卦无福德亦难安；可言有药须当疗，但恐良医未有缘。
子孙虽克世，外爻及应却不克，虽有良医，药饵不中，终无大害。
虎杀若临子孙动，须防医者不精详。
yi: 占病以子孙为医药：临应发动克世，必遇良医，病马上痊愈；
卦里没有子孙，服药无效；
世应比和、卦里又没有子孙，宜换医生；
子孙临应爻被世克，虽遇良医病也没有治；
外卦和应虽然克世，卦里没有福德也难安，可以说有药应当治，只恐怕良医没有缘；
子孙虽克世，外爻和应却不克，虽有良医，药饵不中，终究没有大害；
虎杀如果临着子孙发动，要防医生不精细。
en: In divining illness Output is the medicine and doctor: sitting on the Other and moving to control the Self, one meets a good doctor and the illness is cured at once;
with no Output in the hexagram, taking medicine is ineffective;
with the Self and Other harmonious and no Output in the hexagram, one should change the doctor;
Output on the Other line controlled by the Self, though one meets a good doctor the illness is not treated;

the outer trigram and the Other though controlling the Self, if the hexagram has no Output (the fortune spirit) it is still hard to be at peace, and one may say there is medicine that should treat it but fear the good doctor has no affinity;
Output though controlling the Self, if the outer line and the Other do not control it, though there is a good doctor and the medicine does not hit, in the end there is no great harm;
if a Tiger killing sits on Output and moves, beware the doctor not being careful.

title: 必须参究五行方可攻医万病：火鬼宜凉剂、水鬼宜温剂或丸药、木鬼宜针、金鬼宜灸、土鬼宜剉散（火鬼月建旺宜大寒之剂、无气不过清凉）；金鬼利南方医人、木鬼利西方、水鬼利四散、火鬼利北方、土鬼利东方；前卦水鬼后卦火鬼先须四散医治、终于北方医人收功

rule.yi: 必须钻研五行，才可以攻医各种病。注说：火鬼宜凉剂；水鬼宜温剂，或者丸药；木鬼宜针；金鬼宜灸；土鬼宜剉散。火鬼在月建旺的时候，宜大寒之剂；无气，不过用清凉的药。其余照这样推。金鬼利于请南方的医生，木鬼利西方的医生，水鬼利四散的医生，火鬼利北方的医生，土鬼利东方的医生。如果前一卦是水鬼、后一卦是火鬼，先要四散地医治，最后由北方的医生收功。
rule.en: One must study the five phases before one can attack and treat the myriad illnesses. The commentary says: a Fire ghost suits cooling remedies; a Water ghost suits warming remedies, or pills; a Wood ghost suits the needle; a Metal ghost suits moxa; an Earth ghost suits cut-and-ground powders. When a Fire ghost is strong on the Month, it suits very cold remedies; without qi, only cooling and clearing medicines; the rest follow this. A Metal ghost favours a doctor from the south, a Wood ghost a doctor from the west, a Water ghost doctors from all quarters, a Fire ghost a doctor from the north, an Earth ghost a doctor from the east. If the earlier hexagram is a Water ghost and the later a Fire ghost, one must first treat with doctors from all quarters, and the work is completed at the end by a doctor from the north.

dispute.yi: 请医生要往哪个方向请，几家不同。天玄赋注（LY.ILL.TXF.13）按鬼的五行取克它的方位：金鬼利南方（火克金）、木鬼利西方（金克木）、火鬼利北方（水克火）、土鬼利东方（木克土），水鬼利四散（土克水，土没有定方）；火珠林（见 LY.ILL.HZL.09）大体同此说，只有水鬼一项作「利土值」；增删卜易（LY.ILL.ZS.34）则是往「子孙」所在的方位请（午火子孙请南方的医生），子孙休囚空破时看应爻所在的方位，再有独发生用神的爻取那个爻的方位——一个按官鬼的克星取方位，一个按子孙或应爻取方位，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: In which direction to call the doctor, the books differ. The commentary on the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.13) takes the direction that controls the phase of the ghost: a Metal ghost favours the south (Fire controls Metal), a Wood ghost the west (Metal controls Wood), a Fire ghost the north (Water controls Fire), an Earth ghost the east (Wood controls Earth), and a Water ghost favours all quarters (Earth controls Water, and Earth has no fixed direction); the Huozhu Lin (see LY.ILL.HZL.09) says much the same, only for the Water ghost it has 'favoured by the earth quarter'; the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.34) calls the doctor from the direction of Output instead (Wu Fire Output, a doctor from the south), and when Output is resting, trapped, Void or broken looks at the direction of the Other line, and further takes the direction of a line that moves alone and generates the Subject — one takes the direction from what controls the ghost, the other from Output or the Other line, and the books do not settle it.

note.yi: 这一节是「五行用药」和「五行请医的方位」。用药：火鬼凉剂、水鬼温剂丸药、木鬼针、金鬼灸、土鬼剉散——和易隐「医药·治法与用药」（LY.ILL.YY.25：官鬼属金宜灸、属木宜针、属水宜温药丸药、属火宜凉药汤药、属土宜咬咀）一致，「剉散」和「咬咀」都是把药切碎捣散的剂型。「火鬼月建旺宜大寒之剂」的「月建旺」是火鬼旺在当月；这条和黄金策（LY.ILL.HJC.76）「火鬼生旺遇生扶用大寒药、休囚死绝用凉药」是同一句。请医方位：金鬼利南方、木鬼利西方、火鬼利北方、土鬼利东方，正是各自的克星方位；水鬼「利四散」是水的克星土没有固定方位（中央）。「前卦水鬼、后卦火鬼，先须四散医治，终于北方医人收功」是说两次占卜先水鬼（先请四面的医生），后火鬼（最后北方的医生才收功）。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section is 'medicine by the five phases' and 'the direction to call a doctor by the five phases'. Medicine: a Fire ghost cooling remedies, a Water ghost warming remedies and pills, a Wood ghost the needle, a Metal ghost moxa, an Earth ghost cut-and-ground powders — the same as the Yi Yin's 'medicine: treatment and the use of medicine' (LY.ILL.YY.25: a Metal Pressure line suits moxa, Wood the needle, Water warming medicine and pills, Fire cooling medicine and decoctions, Earth crushing and grinding); 'cut-and-ground powders' and 'crushing and grinding' are both forms of medicine cut fine and ground to a powder. The 'strong on the Month' of 'a Fire ghost strong on the Month suits very cold remedies' is the Fire ghost strong in the current month; this is the same sentence as the Huangjin Ce's (LY.ILL.HJC.76, 'a Fire ghost in a strong place and helped is treated with very cold medicines, resting, trapped, dead or in Extinction with cooling medicines'). The direction for calling a doctor: a Metal ghost favours the south, Wood the west, Fire the north, Earth the east, which is exactly the direction of what controls each; a Water ghost 'favours all quarters' because Earth, which controls Water, has no fixed direction (it is the centre). 'The earlier hexagram a Water ghost and the later a Fire ghost: first treat with doctors from all quarters, and the work is completed by a doctor from the north' says that of the two divinations the Water ghost comes first (call doctors from all sides first) and the Fire ghost after (a doctor from the north finally completes it). After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 必须参究五行，
才可以攻医各种病。
en: One must study the five phases,
and only then can one attack and treat the myriad illnesses.

zh: 火鬼月建旺，宜大寒之剂；
yi: 火鬼宜用凉剂；
水鬼宜用温剂，或者丸药；
木鬼宜用针；
金鬼宜用灸；
土鬼宜用剉散。
火鬼在月建旺的时候，宜用大寒的药剂；
无气的，不过用清凉的药。
其余照这样推。
en: A Fire ghost suits cooling remedies;
a Water ghost suits warming remedies, or pills;
a Wood ghost suits the needle;
a Metal ghost suits moxa;
an Earth ghost suits cut-and-ground powders.
When a Fire ghost is strong on the Month, it suits very cold remedies;
without qi, only cooling and clearing medicines.
The rest follow this.

yi: 金鬼利于请南方的医生，
木鬼利于请西方的医生，
水鬼利于请四散的医生，
火鬼利于请北方的医生，
土鬼利于请东方的医生。
如果前一卦是水鬼、后一卦是火鬼，
先要四散地医治，
最后由北方的医生收功。
en: A Metal ghost favours a doctor from the south,
a Wood ghost a doctor from the west,
a Water ghost doctors from all quarters,
a Fire ghost a doctor from the north,
an Earth ghost a doctor from the east.
If the earlier hexagram is a Water ghost and the later a Fire ghost,
one must first treat with doctors from all quarters,
and the work is completed at the end by a doctor from the north.

title: 卦爻安静为吉、土杀俱兴为凶：占病六爻安静其病可治，吉神常少凶杀常多、吉凶悔吝皆出乎动、动则成咎；六亲中子孙动者吉、六神中青龙动者吉，余者未必皆凶也不能为福，不如安静，有吉神当权自能为福；土杀即辰戌丑未，占病逢之多凶少吉；诸煞见后凶煞章，有一件动便成凶咎

rule.yi: 卦爻安静，重（zhòng）为济世之人；土杀一齐兴动，一定成了黄泉的客人。注说：占病，六爻安静就吉，病可以治；一卦之中凶杀常常多，而吉神常常少，吉凶悔吝都出自动，动就成咎。比如六亲之中，不过子孙动的吉；六神之中，不过青龙动的吉；其余的未必都是凶，也不能成为福，发动对我有什么益处呢？这是吉少凶多。不如卦爻安静，虽然有凶煞，终究没有遭到伤害；如果有吉神当权，自然能为福。土杀就是辰、戌、丑、未，交相变换，运行在四季之间，占病遇上它，多凶少吉。所有诸煞都见后面的凶煞章；如果有一件发动，就成了凶咎。
rule.en: With the hexagram and lines still, weighty is he who saves the world; with Earth and the killings both rising, he is sure to be a guest of the Yellow Springs. The commentary says: in divining illness, six lines still is auspicious and the illness can be treated; in a hexagram the malign killings are often many and the lucky spirits often few; good and ill, regret and shame all come out of movement, and movement makes blame. For example, among the six relations only Output moving is auspicious; among the six spirits only the Azure Dragon moving is auspicious; the rest are not all ominous but cannot make blessing either, and what use to me is their moving? That is little good and much ill. Better that the hexagram and lines be still: though there are malign killings, in the end no harm is done; if a lucky spirit holds power, it can of itself make blessing. The Earth killings are Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, changing in turn and moving through the four seasons; met in divining illness they are mostly ill and little good. All the killings are given in the later chapter on malign killings; if one of them moves, it makes blame.

note.yi: 这一节是天玄赋疾病章的收尾：占病「安静为吉」——因为「吉少凶多」，一发动多半成咎；吉神里只有子孙动、青龙动才算吉，其余动了未必凶但也不成福，所以不如静。「土杀」指辰戌丑未。「重为济世之人」的「重」按上下文读作重（zhòng，有分量、当得起），意思是六爻安静的病人，是尚能济世（活下去）的人，原文没有解释，这里按字面译作「weighty」；「土煞俱兴，定作黄泉之客」的「土」是丘墓之土（三丘五墓）还是辰戌丑未，注里说是后者（「土杀者，即辰戌丑未」）。这句赋在易冒里也被引过，写作「天元赋」（LY.ILL.YM.12），后面加了「土煞俱兴」的解释。「安静为吉」的说法和野鹤「六爻安静、卦吉可以调理」（LY.ILL.ZS.22）、易冒「卦爻皆静」是同一个判断；和阐奥歌章「疾病章」的「六爻安静尤难瘥」（LY.ILL.CA.03）相反——那里说安静反而难愈，书里没有裁决。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section closes the Tianxuan Fu's chapter on illness: in divining illness 'still is auspicious' — because 'there is little good and much ill', movement mostly makes blame; among lucky spirits only Output moving and the Azure Dragon moving count as auspicious, and the rest moving are not necessarily ominous but make no blessing, so it is better to be still. 'The Earth killings' are Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei. The 'zhong' of 'weighty is he who saves the world' is read from the context as zhong (weighty, worthy of the burden), and means that a sick person whose six lines are still is one who can still serve the world (live on), which the original does not explain, and it is rendered literally as 'weighty'; whether the 'Earth' of 'Earth and killings both rising, sure to be a guest of the Yellow Springs' is the earth of the mounds and tombs or Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, the commentary says the latter ('the Earth killings are Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei'). This verse is also quoted in the Yi Mao as 'the Tianyuan Fu' (LY.ILL.YM.12). 'Still is auspicious' is the same judgment as the Old Man of Yehe's 'with six lines still and the hexagram auspicious, it can be treated by nursing' (LY.ILL.ZS.22) and the Yi Mao's 'the hexagram and lines all still'; it is opposite to 'six lines still is harder still to cure' in the chapter on illness of the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.03), which says that stillness on the contrary makes it hard to cure, and the books do not settle it. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

yi: 卦爻安静，
重（zhòng）为济世之人；
土杀一起兴动，
一定成了黄泉的客人。
en: With the hexagram and lines still,
weighty is he who saves the world;
with Earth and the killings both rising,
he is sure to be a guest of the Yellow Springs.

yi: 凡是占病，
六爻安静为吉，
病可以治。
一卦之中凶杀常常多，
而吉神常常少；
吉凶悔吝，
都出自动，
动就成咎。
en: In divining illness,
six lines still is auspicious,
and the illness can be treated.
In a hexagram the malign killings are often many,
and the lucky spirits often few;
good and ill, regret and shame,
all come out of movement,
and movement makes blame.

zh: 且如六亲之中，不过子孙动者吉；
六神之中，不过青龙动者吉。
余者未必皆凶，亦不能为福，
不如卦爻安静，虽有凶煞，终未遭伤。
若有吉神当权，自能为福。
交相换易，行乎四时之间，
yi: 比如六亲之中，不过子孙动的吉；
六神之中，不过青龙动的吉。
其余的未必都是凶，也不能成为福，
发动对我有什么益处呢？
这是吉少凶多。
不如卦爻安静，虽然有凶煞，终究没有遭到伤害；
如果有吉神当权，自然能为福。
土杀就是辰、戌、丑、未，
交相变换，运行在四季之间，
占病遇上它，多凶少吉。
en: For example, among the six relations only Output moving is auspicious;
among the six spirits only the Azure Dragon moving is auspicious.
The rest are not all ominous but cannot make blessing either,
and what use to me is their moving?
That is little good and much ill.
Better that the hexagram and lines be still: though there are malign killings, in the end no harm is done;
if a lucky spirit holds power, it can of itself make blessing.
The Earth killings are Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei,
changing in turn and moving through the four seasons;
met in divining illness they are mostly ill and little good.

yi: 所有诸煞，
都见后面的凶煞章。
如果有一件发动，
就成了凶咎。
en: All the killings
are given in the later chapter on malign killings;
if one of them moves,
it makes blame.

title: 用神表·占医生、药物用子孙作用神：子孙即是福德之神，诸事见之为吉，占功名、词讼忌之

rule.yi: 文王金钱课的用神表说：占儿女、女婿、外甥、门徒、忠臣、医生、药物、僧道（原文写作「曾道」）、兵将、六畜、禽鸟，凡是占小辈的，都用子孙作用神；子孙就是福德之神，诸事见到它都吉利，只有占功名、词讼忌讳它。
rule.en: The table of the Subject in the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says: in divining children, a son-in-law, a sister's son, disciples, loyal ministers, doctors, medicines, monks and Daoists (written 'zeng dao' in the original), soldiers and officers, livestock and birds, and in general in divining those of the younger generation, use Output as the Subject; Output is the spirit of fortune and virtue and is auspicious to meet in everything, and is only feared in divining fame and rank and lawsuits.

note.yi: 这一行只管一件事：占医生、药物，用子孙当用神。「子孙为医药」在别的书里也是通例（阐奥歌章 LY.ILL.CA.08、天玄赋 LY.ILL.TXF.12、易林补遗 LY.ILL.EL.26、易隐 LY.ILL.YY.21），这里是用神表里的一项。「曾道」应是「僧道」的误写（「曾」「僧」同音），原文如此，译文按「僧道」译。这一部书的用神表里没有「占病」一项，占病该用什么爻，这部书没有说。括号里「子孙即是福德之神……」是这部书自己的小注。
note.en: This line is about one thing only: in divining doctors and medicines, Output is the Subject. 'Output is the medicine' is also a general rule in other books (the Chan'ao Gezhang LY.ILL.CA.08, the Tianxuan Fu LY.ILL.TXF.12, the Yilin Buyi LY.ILL.EL.26, the Yi Yin LY.ILL.YY.21), and here it is one item of the table of the Subject. The 'zeng dao' is probably a miswriting of 'monks and Daoists' (the two characters 'zeng' and 'monk' sound alike), as in the original, and the translation reads 'monks and Daoists'. The table of the Subject in this book has no entry for 'divining illness', and the book does not say which line to use for illness. The bracketed 'Output is the spirit of fortune and virtue ...' is the book's own small note.

zh: 占儿女、女婿、外甥、门徒、忠臣、医生、药物、曾道、兵将、六畜、禽鸟、凡占小辈使用子孙作用神。
yi: 占儿女、女婿、外甥、门徒、忠臣、医生、药物、僧道、兵将、六畜、禽鸟，凡是占小辈的，都用子孙作用神。
（子孙就是福德之神，
诸事见到它都吉利。
占功名、词讼忌讳它。）
en: In divining children, a son-in-law, a sister's son, disciples, loyal ministers, doctors, medicines, monks and Daoists, soldiers and officers, livestock and birds, and in general in divining those of the younger generation, use Output as the Subject.
(Output is the spirit of fortune and virtue,
and it is auspicious to meet in everything.
In divining fame and rank and lawsuits it is feared.)

title: 用神表·占邪崇、雷霆、鬼神用官鬼爻作用神

rule.yi: 文王金钱课的用神表说：占官、官府、功名、（妻占父）、乱臣、贼盗、邪崇、雷霆、鬼神、词讼，凡是以上这些，都用官鬼爻作用神。
rule.en: The table of the Subject in the Wenwang Jinqian Ke says: in divining officials, the authorities, fame and rank, (a wife divining the father), rebellious ministers, thieves and robbers, evil curses, thunder, ghosts and spirits, and lawsuits, in all of these use the Pressure line as the Subject.

note.yi: 这一行列了官鬼爻作用神的各件事，「邪崇」「雷霆」「鬼神」就是占病时的「鬼」：疾病由什么鬼神作祟，在别的书里也是看官鬼（LY.ILL.BSYG.01、LY.ILL.EL.29）。「妻占父」按上下文应是「妻占夫」（妻占丈夫以官鬼为用神），原文如此，译文照字面。「崇」是「祟」的写法，按「curse」译。
note.en: This line lists the matters for which the Pressure line is the Subject, and 'evil curses', 'thunder' and 'ghosts and spirits' are the 'ghost' of divining illness: what ghost or spirit afflicts an illness is also read from Pressure in other books (LY.ILL.BSYG.01, LY.ILL.EL.29). 'A wife divining the father' should from the context be 'a wife divining the husband' (a wife divining her husband takes Pressure as the Subject), as in the original, and the translation is literal. The character for 'curse' is written in its variant form, and is rendered 'curse'.

zh: 占官、官府、功名、妻占父、乱臣、贼盗、邪崇、雷霆、鬼神、词讼、凡以上俱官鬼爻为用神。
yi: 占官、官府、功名、（妻占父）、乱臣、贼盗、邪崇、雷霆、鬼神、词讼，凡是以上这些，都用官鬼爻作用神。
en: In divining officials, the authorities, fame and rank, a wife divining the father, rebellious ministers, thieves and robbers, evil curses, thunder, ghosts and spirits, and lawsuits, in all of the above use the Pressure line as the Subject.

title: 六十四卦课·占病逢乾、姤、观、节、革、丰、师、大畜、履、渐：病人痊愈、占病无妨、占病即愈、疾病皆除、疾病渐好、疾病大好、官司疾病皆无妨

rule.yi: 文王金钱课的六十四卦课（原有的二十六卦）里，这十个卦的断辞说病会好：乾「病人痊愈」，姤「占病无妨」，观「占病即愈、疾病皆除」，节「疾病口舌消除安」，革「官司疾病皆无妨」，丰「疾病渐好」，师「疾病大好」，大畜「疾病口舌渐渐磨」，履「疾病皆除」，渐「官司疾病俱无妨」。
rule.en: In the sixty-four hexagram readings of the Wenwang Jinqian Ke (the twenty-six that the book originally has), the verdicts of these ten hexagrams say that the illness will mend: Qian, 'the sick are cured'; Gou, 'divining illness: no harm'; Guan, 'divining illness: cured at once, all illness removed'; Jie, 'illness and quarrels are cleared and peace comes'; Ge, 'lawsuit and illness are both without harm'; Feng, 'illness gradually mends'; Shi, 'illness mends greatly'; Daxu, 'illness and quarrels are gradually worn away'; Lü, 'all illness is removed'; Jian, 'lawsuit and illness are both without harm'.

dispute.yi: 文王金钱课和周易尚占（LY.ILL.ZSZ.02 至 ZSZ.06）都是按卦名断病，可是同一个卦两本说的，有四个相反或相左：姤，周易尚占说「病者难安」，这里说「占病无妨」；丰，周易尚占说「病人沉滞」，这里说「疾病渐好」；师，周易尚占说「病人迟瘥」，这里说「疾病大好」；履，周易尚占说「弗占疾病」，这里说「疾病皆除」。乾、观、革、渐、大畜这五个两本一致说病会好；节，周易尚占没有讲病。另一方面，观、大畜在别的书的占病凶卦名单里（LY.ILL.CA.03、DYTJ.15、TXF.06 等），观卦两本都说病好，正好和那些名单相反（见 LY.ILL.ZSZ.02）。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The Wenwang Jinqian Ke and the Zhouyi Shangzhan (LY.ILL.ZSZ.02 to ZSZ.06) both judge illness by the name of the hexagram, but for the same hexagram the two say things that are opposed or at odds in four cases: Gou, the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the sick will find it hard to be at peace' while here it says 'divining illness: no harm'; Feng, the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the sick one is weighed down and lingering' while here 'illness gradually mends'; Shi, the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the sick recover late' while here 'illness mends greatly'; Lü, the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'do not divine illness' while here 'all illness is removed'. Qian, Guan, Ge, Jian and Daxu are five in which the two agree that the illness will mend; for Jie the Zhouyi Shangzhan does not speak of illness. On the other side, Guan and Daxu are in other books' lists of ominous hexagrams for illness (LY.ILL.CA.03, DYTJ.15, TXF.06 and so on), and for Guan both books say the illness mends, exactly against those lists (see LY.ILL.ZSZ.02). The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这部书原文只有二十六卦（乾宫、坎宫、艮宫各八卦，震宫两卦），每卦有「象曰」（七言四句）、「诗曰」（四言四句）、「断曰」（四言四句）三项，讲病的话有的在断曰里，有的在诗曰或象曰里；这里把含病话的那一两行收在一起，每一段的卦名写在引文标签上。每卦的题目是「卦名（课名）」，如「天山 遁（浓云蔽日）」。几处原文的写法：「天风垢」的「垢」是姤的误写，「天泽覆」的「覆」是履的误写，「风鸣歧山」按字面应是「凤鸣岐山」，原文如此，不改。「和课」（革、大畜、节、坎等处）应是「合伙」（补录部分同一位置写作「合伙」），译文按「partnership」译。「旱苗得雨芪堂堂」的「芪」意思不明，译文按上下文读作苗长得挺拔。「交易得魁」的「魁」是第一名。「疾病口舌渐渐磨」的「磨」是磨掉、慢慢消磨。这些卦的断辞每句都是四个字的断语，没有说用神、世应、动变。
note.en: In the original this book has only twenty-six hexagrams (eight each for the Qian, Kan and Gen palaces and two for the Zhen palace), each with three items, 'the image verse' (four lines of seven characters), 'the poem' (four phrases of four characters) and 'the verdict' (four phrases of four characters); the words on illness are in the verdict in some, and in the poem or the image verse in others, and here the one or two lines containing words on illness are taken together, with the name of the hexagram written on each quotation label. The heading of each hexagram is 'name of hexagram (name of reading)', as in 'Heaven over Mountain, Dun (Thick Clouds Hide the Sun)'. For some original spellings: the 'gou' of 'Heaven over Wind, Gou' is a miswriting of Gou, the 'fu' of 'Heaven over Marsh, Fu' is a miswriting of Lü, and 'the Wind Cries on Mount Qi' should literally be 'the Phoenix Cries on Mount Qi'; all are as in the original and are not changed. 'He ke' (in Ge, Daxu, Jie, Kan and elsewhere) should be 'partnership' (the supplemented part writes 'partnership' in the same place), and the translation reads 'partnership'. The 'qi' of 'parched seedlings get rain, qi stately' is not clear in sense, and the translation reads it from the context as the seedlings standing tall. The 'kui' of 'trade takes first place' is the first place. The 'worn away' of 'illness and quarrels are gradually worn away' is rubbed off, slowly ground down. In these hexagrams every sentence of the verdict is a four-character phrase, and nothing is said of the Subject, the Self and Other, or moving lines.

yi: 断语说：
官司和解，吉利，
病人痊愈，
功名有成，
求取谋划大吉。
en: The verdict says:
lawsuits are reconciled, auspicious,
the sick are cured,
fame and rank are achieved,
seeking and scheming are greatly auspicious.

yi: 断语说：
功名有成，
家宅平安，
失物能找到，
占病没有妨碍。
en: The verdict says:
fame and rank are achieved,
the household is at peace,
lost things are found,
divining illness: no harm.

yi: 诗里说：
失物能找到，
口舌是非消散，
疾病全都除去，
月令实在好。
断语说：
占官司，得理，
占病，马上痊愈，
占消息，能得到消息，
谋划事情得意。
en: The poem says:
lost things are found,
quarrels disperse,
all illness is removed,
the Month is truly good.
The verdict says:
divining a lawsuit: one is in the right,
divining illness: cured at once,
divining news: news is received,
plans meet with success.

yi: 诗里说：
姜太公封神，不是寻常事，
谋划求财，稳如山，
交易、合伙大吉大庆，
疾病、口舌消除而得安。
en: The poem says:
the Grand Duke confers divinity: no ordinary thing,
plans and the seeking of wealth are steady as a mountain,
trade and partnership are greatly auspicious and festive,
illness and quarrels are cleared and peace comes.

yi: 诗里说：
旱苗得了雨，长得堂堂正正，
交易、求财也相称，
婚姻、合伙都如意，
官司、疾病都没有妨碍。
en: The poem says:
parched seedlings get rain and stand tall and stately,
trade and the seeking of wealth are also fitting,
marriage and partnership are both as wished,
lawsuit and illness are both without harm.

yi: 断语说：
出行有益，
交易拔得头筹，
疾病渐渐好转，
求名必定如愿。
en: The verdict says:
travel brings gain,
trade takes first place,
illness gradually mends,
seeking fame will surely be achieved.

yi: 断语说：
疾病大为好转，
走失的能找回，
出门的人来信，
样样都凑得巧。
en: The verdict says:
illness mends greatly,
what was lost can be found,
the traveller sends word,
all things fall out luckily.

yi: 诗里说：
占到这一卦，带着六合，
疾病、口舌慢慢磨掉，
婚姻、合伙都如意，
谋划求财没有差错。
en: The poem says:
divining this hexagram, it carries the six combinations,
illness and quarrels are gradually worn away,
marriage and partnership are both as wished,
plans and the seeking of wealth have no error.

yi: 断语说：
出行有益，
求财一定有准，
疾病全都除去，
各样事情平稳。
en: The verdict says:
travel brings gain,
the seeking of wealth is sure,
all illness is removed,
all affairs are steady.

yi: 诗里说：
骏马出了笼，走万里路程，
交易、出行大吉大昌，
找人费力，逃难倒好，
官司、疾病都没有妨碍。
en: The poem says:
the fine horse leaves the stable for a journey of ten thousand li,
trade and travel are greatly auspicious and prosperous,
finding someone takes effort, fleeing calamity is good,
lawsuit and illness are both without harm.

title: 六十四卦课·占病逢遁、否、坎、屯、睽：占病不安、疾病口舌是牵连、疾病未愈、疾病未好、病不愈

rule.yi: 文王金钱课的六十四卦课（原有的二十六卦）里，这五个卦的断辞说病不好：遁「占病不安」，否「疾病口舌是牵连」，坎「疾病未愈」，屯「疾病未好」，睽「病不愈」。
rule.en: In the sixty-four hexagram readings of the Wenwang Jinqian Ke (the twenty-six that the book originally has), the verdicts of these five hexagrams say that the illness does not mend: Dun, 'divining illness: unsettled'; Pi, 'illness and quarrels are entangled with it'; Kan, 'illness is not yet cured'; Zhun, 'illness has not mended'; Kui, 'illness is not cured'.

note.yi: 这五个卦的说法都是「没好」「不安」，没有一个说死。否卦的病话在「象曰」里（「疾病口舌是牵连」），别的四卦在「断曰」里；「是牵连」是和病有牵扯的意思，书里没有说是病拖着还是病又牵出别的事，译文照字面。遁、坎、睽三卦周易尚占也说病不好（「病者迁延」「孕病皆凶」「问病有惊」，LY.ILL.ZSZ.04、ZSZ.05），两本一致。关于「和课」「垢」等写法，见 LY.ILL.WWJQ.03 的说明。
note.en: The wording for all five hexagrams is 'not mended' or 'unsettled', and none speaks of death. The words on illness in Pi are in the image verse ('illness and quarrels are entangled with it'), and in the other four in the verdict; 'entangled with it' means that illness is involved, and the book does not say whether the illness drags on or draws other matters after it, and the translation is literal. For Dun, Kan and Kui the Zhouyi Shangzhan also says that the illness does not mend ('the sick one drags on', 'pregnancy and illness are both ominous', 'asking about illness: there is a fright', LY.ILL.ZSZ.04, ZSZ.05), so the two books agree. For the spellings 'he ke', 'gou' and so on, see the notes of LY.ILL.WWJQ.03.

yi: 断语说：
占病，不安稳，
有官司要见官，
功名慢慢成就，
事情不能遂心。
en: The verdict says:
divining illness: unsettled,
a lawsuit means going before the officials,
fame and rank come slowly,
affairs do not go as the heart wishes.

yi: 象辞说：
老虎落进陷坑，苦得说不出，
往前进容易，往后退难，
谋划指望不能如愿，各人自己方便，
疾病、口舌都有牵连。
en: The image verse says:
the tiger falls into a pit, too wretched to tell,
to go forward is easy, to go back is hard,
plans and hopes do not come true, each as it suits oneself,
illness and quarrels are entangled with it.

yi: 断语说：
求名不能如愿，
疾病没有痊愈，
婚姻不成，
合伙不利。
en: The verdict says:
seeking fame is not achieved,
illness is not yet cured,
marriage is not made,
partnership is unfavourable.

yi: 断语说：
疾病没有好，
婚姻不凑巧，
口舌琐碎，
做事颠三倒四。
en: The verdict says:
illness has not mended,
marriage is unlucky,
quarrels are petty,
things are done upside down.

yi: 断语说：
名不顺利，
利也不全，
病不痊愈，
做事很难。
en: The verdict says:
fame is not favoured,
gain is not whole,
illness is not cured,
affairs are hard.

title: 【补录】六十四卦课·占病逢解、恒、升、随、巽、小畜、颐、离、坤、临、大壮、夬、兑、萃、咸：疾病大好、有病就好、疾病口舌皆除根、疾病痊愈、灾消病散、疾病即痊、疾病安宁

rule.yi: 文王金钱课文末补录的网上传本里，这十六个卦的卦辞或推断说病会好：解「疾病大好」，恒「有病就好」，升「疾病口舌皆除根」，随「疾病口舌保平安」，巽「疾病痊愈」，小畜「疾病口舌，交节安宁」，颐「疾病口舌可离身」，离「灾消病散」，坤「疾病见好」，临「疾病即痊」，大壮「疾病皆除」，夬「疾病除根」，兑「疾病痊愈」，萃「口舌疾病永无灾」，咸「疾病安宁」。
rule.en: In the internet copy that the library appended at the end of the Wenwang Jinqian Ke, the hexagram verse or judgment of these fifteen hexagrams says that the illness will mend: Xie, 'illness mends greatly'; Heng, 'if there is illness, it mends'; Sheng, 'illness and quarrels are all uprooted'; Sui, 'illness and quarrels are kept safe and peaceful'; Xun, 'illness is cured'; Xiaoxu, 'illness and quarrels: after the turn of the season, peace'; Yi (Nourishment), 'illness and quarrels can leave the body'; Li, 'calamity vanishes and illness disperses'; Kun, 'illness shows improvement'; Lin, 'illness is cured at once'; Dazhuang, 'all illness is removed'; Guai, 'illness is uprooted'; Dui, 'illness is cured'; Cui, 'quarrels and illness bring no calamity ever'; Xian, 'illness is at ease'.

dispute.yi: 补录的这些卦里，有几个和周易尚占（LY.ILL.ZSZ.03 至 ZSZ.07）说的相反或相左：巽，周易尚占说「金神为崇」，这里说「疾病痊愈」；离，周易尚占说「病重财轻」，这里说「灾消病散」；临，周易尚占说「病犯崇侵」，这里说「疾病即痊」；夬，周易尚占说「病讼迟延」，这里说「疾病除根」；大壮，周易尚占说「休占讼病」，这里说「疾病皆除」；恒，周易尚占说「病须疾治」（要赶快治），这里说「有病就好」。解、随、颐、兑、萃、咸这六个两本一致说病好；升、小畜、坤周易尚占没有讲病。（这几个卦在补录部分里，而补录部分的来历不明，见下面的说明。）书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Several of these supplemented hexagrams are opposed to or at odds with what the Zhouyi Shangzhan says (LY.ILL.ZSZ.03 to ZSZ.07): Xun, the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'a Metal spirit is the curse' while here it says 'illness is cured'; Li, the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'illness is heavy and wealth is light' while here 'calamity vanishes and illness disperses'; Lin, the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'illness meets the encroachment of a curse' while here 'illness is cured at once'; Guai, the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'illness and lawsuit are delayed' while here 'illness is uprooted'; Dazhuang, the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'do not divine lawsuits or illness' while here 'all illness is removed'; Heng, the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'illness must be treated quickly' while here 'if there is illness, it mends'. Xie, Sui, Yi (Nourishment), Dui, Cui and Xian are six in which the two books agree that the illness mends; for Sheng, Xiaoxu and Kun the Zhouyi Shangzhan does not speak of illness. (These hexagrams are in the supplemented part, whose origin is unknown; see the note below.) The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这个卦是库里「补录」的网上传本，不是这部书原文里有的（原文只有二十六卦）；库里的说明写：这份传本每卦只有「卦辞」（七言四句）和「推断」（四言四句）两项，没有课名、六亲、地支、世应，拿它和原有二十六卦对，十七卦两项都对得上，三卦卦辞对得上、推断有出入，另有三对卦的内容整个互换（风地观与山地剥、火泽睽与风泽中孚、天泽履与风山渐），所以补录部分个别卦也可能挂错了卦；卦名已按卦画订正；传本里没有风火家人。「疾病口舌」是疾病和口舌是非并说。「交节」是过了节气。「五关脱难」是过五关、脱了难。补录部分的卦名已按卦画订正，不是原帖的写法。
note.en: These hexagrams are from the 'supplemented' copy found on the internet that the library appended, and are not in the original text of this book (the original has only twenty-six hexagrams); the library's note says: this copy gives each hexagram only two items, the 'hexagram verse' (four lines of seven characters) and the 'judgment' (four phrases of four characters), with no name of the reading, no six relations, no branches, no Self and Other; compared with the twenty-six original hexagrams, seventeen agree in both items, three agree in the verse but differ in the judgment, and three pairs of hexagrams have their contents swapped wholesale (Guan and Bo, Kui and Zhongfu, Lü and Jian), so some of the supplemented hexagrams may also be hung on the wrong hexagram; the names of the hexagrams have been corrected from the hexagram figures; the copy lacks Jiaren. 'Illness and quarrels' names illness and quarrels together. 'The turn of the season' is the passing of a solar term. 'Passing the five gates, escaping hardship' is getting through the five passes and escaping hardship. The names of the hexagrams in the supplemented part have been corrected from the hexagram figures and are not the original post's spelling.

yi: 卦辞说：
过五关脱了难，运气抬头，
劝你应当去求财。
交易、出行有人帮助，
疾病、口舌不用发愁。
推断说：
疾病大为好转，
出门的人来得早，
谋划指望得以成全，
各样都凑巧。
en: The hexagram verse says:
passing the five gates and escaping hardship, fortune lifts its head,
I urge you to go and seek wealth.
trade and travel have someone's help,
illness and quarrels need not worry you.
The judgment says:
illness mends greatly,
the traveller comes early,
plans and hopes are fulfilled,
all things fall out luckily.

yi: 推断说：
出行凑巧，
有病就会好，
虽然有口舌，
自然就消掉了。
en: The judgment says:
travel falls out luckily,
if there is illness, it mends,
though there are quarrels,
they vanish of themselves.

yi: 卦辞说：
指日离开、上升，气象一新，
走失的、出门的人有音信。
功名、出行遂心而好，
疾病、口舌都除了根。
en: The hexagram verse says:
soon to leave and rise, the air is new,
what was lost and the traveller send word.
fame and travel go well to one's heart,
illness and quarrels are all uprooted.

yi: 卦辞说：
推车靠着堰，道路是干的，
谋划求财不费难。
婚姻、出行没有阻隔，
疾病、口舌保平安。
en: The hexagram verse says:
pushing a cart by the weir, the road is dry,
plans and the seeking of wealth are not hard.
marriage and travel have no obstruction,
illness and quarrels are kept safe and peaceful.

yi: 推断说：
功名称心如意，
求财得利，
交易能成，
疾病会痊愈。
en: The judgment says:
fame and rank please,
the seeking of wealth gains profit,
trade can be made,
illness is cured.

yi: 推断说：
月令中等平常，
忍耐、从容，
疾病、口舌，
过了节气就安宁。
en: The judgment says:
the Month is middling,
be patient and unhurried,
illness and quarrels:
after the turn of the season, peace.

yi: 卦辞说：
周文王在渭水边访求贤人，
谋划求财，事遂心愿。
交易、出行才如意，
疾病、口舌可以离开身子。
en: The hexagram verse says:
King Wen seeks a worthy man by the River Wei,
plans and the seeking of wealth go as the heart wishes.
trade and travel are then as wished,
illness and quarrels can leave the body.

yi: 推断说：
月令都好，
各样事情方便，
出门见到喜事，
灾祸消去，病散掉。
en: The judgment says:
the Month is all good,
affairs are convenient,
going out, one meets joy,
calamity vanishes and illness disperses.

yi: 推断说：
找人能见到，
走失的有消息，
疾病见好转，
凡事都顺。
en: The judgment says:
one finds the person sought,
what was lost has news,
illness shows improvement,
all matters go smoothly.

yi: 推断说：
口舌是非消散，
疾病马上痊愈，
求名称心，
家宅平安。
en: The judgment says:
quarrels disperse,
illness is cured at once,
seeking fame is to one's liking,
the household is at peace.

yi: 推断说：
出门吉利，
口舌远远避开，
疾病全都除去，
出门的人马上到。
en: The judgment says:
going out is auspicious,
quarrels are kept far off,
all illness is removed,
the traveller arrives at once.

yi: 推断说：
官司了结，
疾病除根，
求财到手，
任意而行，遂心如愿。
en: The judgment says:
the lawsuit is concluded,
illness is uprooted,
wealth sought is in hand,
do as one pleases and one's heart is satisfied.

yi: 推断说：
口舌是非消散，
疾病痊愈，
求财到手，
谋划事情遂了心愿。
en: The judgment says:
quarrels disperse,
illness is cured,
wealth sought is in hand,
plans go as the heart wishes.

yi: 卦辞说：
鲤鱼化成龙，喜气来了，
口舌、疾病永远没有灾。
忧愁疑虑从此都消散，
祸门关上，福门打开。
en: The hexagram verse says:
the carp turns into a dragon and joy comes,
quarrels and illness bring no calamity ever.
worry and doubt all disperse from now,
the door of misfortune closes and the door of blessing opens.

yi: 推断说：
谋划指望有成，
出门可以去，
走失的来了消息，
疾病得到安宁。
en: The judgment says:
plans and hopes succeed,
one may go out,
word comes of what was lost,
illness is at ease.

title: 【补录】六十四卦课·占病逢无妄：疾病忧犯口舌愁、疾病不宜

rule.yi: 文王金钱课文末补录的网上传本里，无妄卦的卦辞和推断都说病不好：卦辞「疾病忧犯口舌愁」（病是一件忧事，又添上口舌之愁），推断「疾病不宜」。
rule.en: In the internet copy that the library appended at the end of the Wenwang Jinqian Ke, both the hexagram verse and the judgment of Wuwang say that illness does not fare well: the verse 'illness is a worry, and the grief of quarrels is added', and the judgment 'illness: not fit'.

dispute.yi: 无妄卦，周易尚占说「病瘥讼和」（病好了、官司和解）（LY.ILL.ZSZ.02），这里补录的传本却说「疾病不宜」，两本相反；另外，增删卜易（LY.ILL.ZS.01）列的「断之必死」的十个卦里没有无妄。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: For Wuwang the Zhouyi Shangzhan says 'the illness is cured and the lawsuit settled' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.02), but this supplemented copy says 'illness: not fit', and the two are opposed; moreover, the ten hexagrams of 'judge death' reported in the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.01) do not include Wuwang. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这个卦是库里「补录」的网上传本，不是这部书原文里有的（原文只有二十六卦）；库里的说明写：这份传本每卦只有「卦辞」（七言四句）和「推断」（四言四句）两项，没有课名、六亲、地支、世应，拿它和原有二十六卦对，十七卦两项都对得上，三卦卦辞对得上、推断有出入，另有三对卦的内容整个互换（风地观与山地剥、火泽睽与风泽中孚、天泽履与风山渐），所以补录部分个别卦也可能挂错了卦；卦名已按卦画订正；传本里没有风火家人。「婚姻走失」只有四个字，没有断语，译文照字面写成「婚姻、走失」。「出门不遇」按字面译成「出门遇不到人」，书里没有说是遇不到什么人。「忧犯口舌愁」读作「病是忧，又添口舌之愁」。
note.en: These hexagrams are from the 'supplemented' copy found on the internet that the library appended, and are not in the original text of this book (the original has only twenty-six hexagrams); the library's note says: this copy gives each hexagram only two items, the 'hexagram verse' (four lines of seven characters) and the 'judgment' (four phrases of four characters), with no name of the reading, no six relations, no branches, no Self and Other; compared with the twenty-six original hexagrams, seventeen agree in both items, three agree in the verse but differ in the judgment, and three pairs of hexagrams have their contents swapped wholesale (Guan and Bo, Kui and Zhongfu, Lü and Jian), so some of the supplemented hexagrams may also be hung on the wrong hexagram; the names of the hexagrams have been corrected from the hexagram figures; the copy lacks Jiaren. 'Marriage, losses' is only four characters with no verdict, and is translated literally. 'Going out, one meets no one' is literal, and the book does not say whom one fails to meet. 'A worry, and the grief of quarrels is added' reads the line as 'illness is a worry, and the grief of quarrels is added'.

yi: 卦辞说：
鸟像在笼子里，难出头，
占到这一卦，不自由。
谋划求财没有定准，
疾病有忧，又犯口舌之愁。
推断说：
出门遇不到人，
求财不利，
婚姻、走失，
疾病不适宜。
en: The hexagram verse says:
like a bird in a cage that cannot put out its head,
divining this hexagram, one is not free.
plans and the seeking of wealth are not sure,
illness is a worry, and the grief of quarrels is added.
The judgment says:
going out, one meets no one,
the seeking of wealth is unfavourable,
marriage, losses:
illness: not fit.

title: 痘疹亦天灾，未花而问以鬼为信：鬼空根芽未萌、鬼静气机未动、鬼散虽流行而不及、破静而痘甲不拆、破动而病或殊、鬼绝则未生花

rule.yi: 痘疹也是天降的灾，叫做天花，也叫圣疮，一出就关系到孩子的性命。还没出花就来问的，拿鬼爻作凭据：鬼空，痘的根芽还没有萌发；鬼静，气机还没有动；鬼散，痘虽在流行也轮不到他；鬼破而安静，痘的壳不裂开；鬼破而发动，得的可能是别的病；鬼绝，还没有生花。
rule.en: Pox is also a calamity from heaven, called heavenly flowers and also the sacred sore, and once it stirs it bears on a child's life. If the question is asked before the flowers have come, take the ghost as the token: if the ghost is Void, the roots and shoots of the pox have not yet sprouted; if still, the working of qi has not yet stirred; if scattered, although the pox is going about it does not reach him; if broken and still, the husk does not split; if broken and moving, the illness may be a different one; if in Extinction, the flowers have not yet been born.

note.yi: 「鬼」在这一章里就是官鬼爻，本章通篇以它为痘的凭据。「癍麻疮毒」是斑疹、麻疹、疮毒一类的病，不是「正痘」。「甲」是痘的外壳或种子的壳，「甲不拆」是壳裂不开，意思是还没出。这一条和易隐的痘疹占（LY.ILL.YY.35：鬼不上卦、鬼化死墓绝胎空、被刑害克破者皆不出）是同一个判断。
note.en: In this chapter the 'ghost' is the Pressure line throughout, and it is the token for the pox. 'Spots, measles, sores and poison' are illnesses of the spotted, measly and sore kinds and not the 'true pox'. The 'husk' (jia) is the outer shell of the pox or the husk of a seed, and 'the husk does not split' means it has not yet come out. This entry is the same judgment as the Yi Yin's on divining pox (LY.ILL.YY.35: the ghost absent from the hexagram, changing into Death, tomb, Extinction, Womb or Void, or punished, harmed, controlled or broken, means it will not come out).

zh: 夫痘疹亦天灾也，是名天花，亦名圣疮，动关童命，敢忽神筮？
yi: 痘疹也是天降的灾，叫做天花，也叫圣疮，一出就关系到孩子的性命，怎敢轻忽神明的占筮？
en: Pox is also a calamity from heaven; it is called heavenly flowers and also the sacred sore, and once it stirs it bears on a child's life; how dare one make light of the divination of the spirits?

zh: 未花而问，以鬼为信，盖鬼空根芽未萌，鬼静气机未动，鬼散虽流行而不及也。
破静而甲不拆，破动而病或殊，鬼绝则未生花也。
yi: 还没出花就来问的，拿鬼作凭据：鬼空，痘的根芽还没有萌发；鬼静，气机还没有动；鬼散，痘虽在流行也轮不到他。
鬼破而安静的，痘的壳不裂开；鬼破而发动的，得的病可能是别的；鬼绝的，还没有生花。
en: If the question is asked before the flowers have come, take the ghost as the token: if the ghost is Void, the roots and shoots have not yet sprouted; if the ghost is still, the working of qi has not yet stirred; if the ghost is scattered, although the pox is going about it does not reach him.
If broken and still, the husk does not split; if broken and moving, the illness may be a different one; if the ghost is in Extinction, the flowers have not yet been born.

zh: 月破非应有痘，鬼动是当有病，乃或癍麻疮毒，未为正痘，故曰病殊。
yi: 鬼当作病，问痘就是问痘。
月破不该有痘，鬼动是该有病，但可能是癍、麻、疮、毒，不是正经的痘，所以说病不一样。
en: The ghost is taken as the illness, and asking about pox is asking about pox.
Month-break does not mean there should be pox; a moving ghost means there should be illness, but it may be spots, measles, sores or poison, not the true pox, hence 'the illness is different'.

zh: 内详见痘、趋避、疏密、出期、何人、大象六问
yi: 下文详细讲六个问题：见痘（出不出）、趋避、疏密、出期、何人、大象。
en: The text below treats six questions in detail: whether the pox appears, avoiding it, sparse or dense, the time of coming out, who, and the great image.

title: 鬼动将见、鬼冲将开、鬼旺将起，当月当日则是月是日而出：官鬼值日月当见，卯鬼发动应速、卯鬼安静应迟

rule.yi: 鬼动了，痘将要出现；鬼被冲了，痘将要开；鬼旺了，痘将要起；鬼当月、当日，就在这个月、这一天出痘。官鬼当值的日、月，痘就该出现：比如丑月乙卯日，占有没有花，得到履卦变同人卦，当天就见了标；另有一人也占，得履卦变睽卦，到第二年二月才出痘，因为卯鬼发动所以应得快，卯鬼安静所以应得迟。
rule.en: When the ghost moves the pox is about to show; when the ghost is clashed it is about to open; when the ghost is strong it is about to rise; when the ghost is on duty in the month or day, it comes out in that month or on that day. The day or month on which the Pressure line is on duty, the pox should appear: for example, in a Chou month on a Yimao day, someone divined whether the flowers would come and obtained Lu changing into Tongren, and the marks showed that same day; another person also divined and obtained Lu changing into Kui, and the pox began only in the second month of the following year, because the Mao ghost moved and so it answered quickly, and the Mao ghost was still and so it answered slowly.

note.yi: 「标」是痘刚出来的点。注里两个卦例，一个当天见标、一个拖到第二年二月，解释都是同一个卯鬼——发动就快，安静就迟；这和增删卜易「鬼动逢值逢合、鬼静逢值逢冲」（LY.ILL.ZS.19）的思路相近。
note.en: A 'mark' (biao) is the spot when the pox has just come out. Of the two cases in the note, one showed marks the same day and the other was put off to the second month of the next year, and the explanation for both is the same Mao ghost — moving, it is quick, and still, it is slow; this is close in thinking to the Zengshan Buyi's 'a still ghost on the day of duty or clash, a moving ghost on the day of duty or combination' (LY.ILL.ZS.19).

zh: 鬼动将见，鬼冲将开，鬼旺将起，当月当日，则是月是日而出也。
yi: 鬼动了，痘将要出现；鬼被冲了，痘将要开；鬼旺了，痘将要起；鬼当月、当日，就在这个月、这一天出痘。
en: When the ghost moves the pox is about to show; when the ghost is clashed it is about to open; when the ghost is strong it is about to rise; when the ghost is on duty in the month or day, it comes out in that month or on that day.

zh: 官鬼值日月当见，如丑建乙卯日，占有花得履之同人，当日见标，复一人亦占履之睽，及次年二月始痘，盖卯鬼发动故应速，卯鬼安静故应迟。
yi: 官鬼当值的日、月，痘就该出现：比如丑月乙卯日，占有没有花，得到履卦变同人卦，当天就见了标；另有一人也占，得履卦变睽卦，到第二年二月才出痘，因为卯鬼发动所以应得快，卯鬼安静所以应得迟。
en: The day or month on which the Pressure line is on duty, the pox should appear: for example, in a Chou month on a Yimao day, someone divined whether the flowers would come and obtained Lu changing into Tongren, and the marks showed that same day; another person also divined and obtained Lu changing into Kui, and the pox began only in the second month of the following year, because the Mao ghost moved and so it answered quickly, and the Mao ghost was still and so it answered slowly.

title: 当岁而索鬼象之得失：官鬼值太岁或遇空破休囚则言未出，不可以太岁为鬼而断当年应痘；卦有两鬼一空一动取其动、一强一弱取其强，皆应当出

rule.yi: 问哪一年出痘，要探究鬼象的得失；卦里有两个鬼时，要考察其中一爻的虚实。官鬼如果值太岁，或者遇到空、破、休、囚，就说还没出，后来即使日、月会合，也不能说就有：比如己亥年辰月辛未日，占有没有痘，得同人卦，亥鬼旬空，整年平安，可见不能因为太岁就是鬼就断当年应痘。如果卦里有两个鬼，一个空一个动，就取动的；一个强一个弱，就取强的，都应当出痘；这就是所说的考察一爻的虚实。
rule.en: For the year, seek the gain or loss of the ghost's image; where there are two ghosts, examine the emptiness or fullness of one line. If the Pressure line falls on the Tai Sui, or meets Void, breaking, resting or trapped, say it has not yet come out; even if later the Day and Month meet, one cannot say there is pox: for example, in the Jihai year, the Chen month, on the Xinwei day, someone divined whether there would be pox and obtained Tongren; the Hai ghost was in Void and all year long he was well and at peace, so one cannot take the Tai Sui being the ghost as meaning the pox answers that year. If the hexagram has two ghosts, one Void and one moving, take the moving one; if one strong and one weak, take the strong one; in each case the pox should come out; this is what 'examine the emptiness or fullness of one line' means.

zh: 当岁而索鬼象之得失，有二而考一爻之虚实。
yi: 问哪一年出痘，要探究鬼象的得失；卦里有两个鬼时，要考察其中一爻的虚实。
en: For the year, seek the gain or loss of the ghost's image; where there are two, examine the emptiness or fullness of one line.

zh: 官鬼若值太岁，或遇空破休囚，则言未出，后虽日月会同，亦未可言有，如己亥年辰建辛未日，占有痘得同人，亥鬼旬空，终岁康宁，则不可以太岁为鬼而当年应痘也。
如卦有两鬼，一空一动，则以其动，一强一弱，则以其强，皆应当出，乃谓考一爻虚实尔。
yi: 官鬼如果值太岁，或者遇到空、破、休、囚，就说还没出，后来即使日、月会合，也不能说就有；比如己亥年辰月辛未日，占有没有痘，得同人卦，亥鬼旬空，整年平安，可见不能因为太岁就是鬼就断当年应痘。
如果卦里有两个鬼，一个空一个动，就取动的；一个强一个弱，就取强的，都应当出痘；这就是所说的考察一爻的虚实。
en: If the Pressure line falls on the Tai Sui, or meets Void, breaking, resting or trapped, say it has not yet come out; even if later the Day and Month meet, one cannot say there is pox: for example, in the Jihai year, the Chen month, on the Xinwei day, someone divined whether there would be pox and obtained Tongren; the Hai ghost was in Void and all year long he was well and at peace, so one cannot take the Tai Sui being the ghost as meaning the pox answers that year.

If the hexagram has two ghosts, one Void and one moving, take the moving one; if one strong and one weak, take the strong one; in each case the pox should come out; this is what 'examine the emptiness or fullness of one line' means.

title: 出痘由己招还是由人召、本乡还是他处：鬼在世由己招、在应由人召，在内卦本乡行灾、外卦他处流祸；往避得痘游魂鬼摇、来归不得痘归魂鬼静；伏鬼有气亦见

rule.yi: 鬼落在世爻上，是自己招来的；落在应爻上，是别人招来的；在内卦，是本乡流行的灾，在外卦，是别处流传来的祸。出去躲避反而得了痘，是游魂卦、鬼发动；回来却没得痘，是归魂卦、鬼安静；伏着的鬼有气的，痘也会出现。官鬼一动，天花就开了：在世爻是单独发出来的，在应爻是被人传染缠上的，在六爻是童仆起的根，在三爻是弟兄接着种下的；内卦是本地，外卦是外乡；游魂是出去，归魂是回来。鬼在内卦空，本地没事；鬼在外卦空，到外乡可以躲过；鬼动而卦是归魂，回家有痘；鬼空而卦是游魂，出去就能免。大体上鬼爻旺相，即使伏藏也会萌发，鬼爻休囚，即使现出来也会平息。
rule.en: On the Self the pox is called down by oneself; on the Other, called by others; in the inner trigram it is a passing calamity of the home district, in the outer trigram a spreading misfortune from elsewhere. Going away to avoid it and yet catching the pox is a Wandering Soul hexagram with the ghost moving; coming home and not catching it is a Returning Soul hexagram with the ghost still; a hidden ghost that has force also shows. When the Pressure line moves the heavenly flowers open: on the Self it is a lone outbreak, on the Other it is caught by contagion, on the sixth line the root is from a servant boy, on the third line brothers sow it in succession; the inner is the home district and the outer another place; Wandering Soul is going away and Returning Soul is coming back. If the ghost is Void in the inner trigram the home district is safe; if Void in the outer trigram one can avoid it by going elsewhere; if the ghost moves in a Returning Soul hexagram, there is pox on returning home; if the ghost is Void in a Wandering Soul hexagram, going out escapes it. In general, if the Pressure line is strong, even hidden it will sprout; if it is resting or trapped, even openly present it will subside.

note.yi: 「行灾」是流行的灾，「流祸」是流传的祸，都是说痘是传染来的。「童仆起根」「弟兄继种」是注文的说法，按字面译：六爻是痘的根从童仆那里起，三爻是从弟兄那里接着传。游魂、归魂是八宫里每宫的第七、第八卦。
note.en: 'Passing calamity' and 'spreading misfortune' both say the pox comes by contagion. 'The root is from a servant boy' and 'brothers sow it in succession' are the note's wording, rendered literally: on the sixth line the root of the pox starts from a servant boy, and on the third it is passed on by brothers. Wandering Soul and Returning Soul are the seventh and eighth hexagrams of each of the eight palaces.

zh: 世由己招，应由人召，内为本乡之行灾，外为他处之流祸。
往避而得痘，游魂鬼摇，来归而不得痘，归魂鬼静。
yi: 落在世爻上是自己招来的，落在应爻上是别人招来的，内卦是本乡流行的灾，外卦是别处流传来的祸。
出去躲避反而得了痘，是游魂卦、鬼发动；回来却没得痘，是归魂卦、鬼安静。
伏着的鬼有气的，痘也会出现。
en: On the Self it is called down by oneself; on the Other, called by others; in the inner trigram it is a passing calamity of the home district, in the outer trigram a spreading misfortune from elsewhere.
Going away to avoid it and yet catching the pox is a Wandering Soul hexagram with the ghost moving; coming home and not catching it is a Returning Soul hexagram with the ghost still.
A hidden ghost that has force will also show.

zh: 官鬼动，而天花开矣，在世则为特发，在应则为缠染，在六爻童仆起根，在三爻弟兄继种，内为本境，外为他乡，游魂为往，归魂为来。
盖鬼空于内，本境无事，鬼空于外，他乡可避；
鬼动归魂，回家有痘，鬼空游魂，往外得免也。
大抵鬼爻旺相，虽伏亦萌，鬼爻休囚，虽现亦息。
yi: 官鬼一动，天花就开了：在世爻是单独发出来的，在应爻是被人传染缠上的，在六爻是童仆起的根，在三爻是弟兄接着种下的；内卦是本地，外卦是外乡；游魂是出去，归魂是回来。
因为鬼在内卦空，本地没事；鬼在外卦空，到外乡可以躲过；
鬼动而卦是归魂，回家有痘；鬼空而卦是游魂，出去就能免。
大体上，鬼爻旺相的，即使伏藏也会萌发；鬼爻休囚的，即使现出来也会平息。
en: When the Pressure line moves the heavenly flowers open: on the Self it is a lone outbreak, on the Other it is caught by contagion, on the sixth line the root is from a servant boy, on the third line brothers sow it in succession; the inner is the home district and the outer another place; Wandering Soul is going away and Returning Soul is coming back.
For if the ghost is Void in the inner trigram, the home district is safe; if the ghost is Void in the outer trigram, one can avoid it by going to another place;
if the ghost moves in a Returning Soul hexagram, there is pox on returning home; if the ghost is Void in a Wandering Soul hexagram, going out escapes it.
In general, if the Pressure line is strong, even hidden it will sprout; if the Pressure line is resting or trapped, even openly present it will subside.

title: 占花疏密、部位、颜色：鬼旺日月生扶花稠密、空破休囚死绝痘疏朗；鬼动何宫定花丛何处（艮手臂、兑口颊、坎离上身、震巽下身）、旺在初爻先于足、六爻发于面；火鬼红紫、金鬼虚白、水鬼黑陷、木杂细、土肿大；须论用神生死定吉凶

rule.yi: 占花的稀密，问鬼的旺衰，用八卦分手足，用六爻定身形，用五行定颜色。鬼临日、月，旺相又有生扶，花一定稠密；遇到空、破、休、囚、死、绝，痘一定疏朗。鬼在哪个宫发动，花就集中在哪里；不动的，就看哪一爻旺：发在艮宫的手臂上密，动在兑宫的口和脸颊上多，坎、离在上身，震、巽在下身；旺在初爻，先出在脚上，旺在六爻，开始发在脸上，五爻在胸背，二爻在腿膝，三、四爻在腰、大腿、心口、肚子。火鬼发的，颜色红紫；金鬼动的，虚白；水鬼发的，黑而塌陷；木是杂而细，土是肿而大。但是一定要论用神的生死才能定吉凶，所以水鬼动而主象旺的，痘出现黑钉，后来仍能收功。痘症多变，假如遇到用象破空，或者某个鬼发动，就变成那种病而死，比如未月甲辰日，占孩子的痘，得到屯卦变革卦，到戊申日变成脾病而治不好。
rule.en: To divine whether the flowers are sparse or dense, ask whether the ghost is strong or weak; the eight trigrams divide hands and feet, the six lines fix the parts of the body, the five elements bring out the colours. If the ghost sits on the Day or Month, is strong and supported, the flowers are surely dense; if it meets Void, breaking, resting, trapped, death or extinction, the pox is surely sparse and clear. Wherever the ghost moves, in which palace, that fixes where the flowers cluster; if it does not move, see which line is strong: from the Gen palace, dense on the arms; moving in the Dui palace, many on the mouth and cheeks; Kan and Li the upper body, Zhen and Xun the lower; strong on the first line, first on the feet; on the sixth line, starting on the face; the fifth the chest and back, the second the legs and knees, the third and fourth the waist, thighs, heart and belly. A Fire ghost gives red-purple, a Metal ghost hollow white, a Water ghost black and sunken; Wood is mixed and fine, Earth swollen and large. But one must judge whether the Subject lives or dies before fixing fortune, so when a Water ghost moves and the main image is strong, the pox shows black nails and yet comes to completion. Pox often changes: if the image of the Subject is broken or Void, or some ghost moves, it changes into that illness and he dies — for example, in the Wei month on the Jiachen day a child's pox was divined and Zhun changing into Ge obtained, and on the Wushen day it turned into a spleen illness that could not be cured.

dispute.yi: 痘长在哪里、颜色如何：易冒这里按鬼所在的宫（艮手臂、兑口颊、坎离上身、震巽下身）和鬼旺在哪一爻（初爻足、六爻面）来断，增删卜易也是这样（乾多生头、坤多腹、艮多手、兑多口、坎离上身、震巽下身，LY.ILL.ZS.20），两家一致，颜色也相同（火鬼紫红、金鬼虚白、水鬼黑陷、木杂细、土肿大）。卜筮正宗讲的是好了以后留下的毛病在哪里（LY.ILL.BSZZ.23–25），兑宫一说口、一说面，与这里说的口颊又有出入。
dispute.en: Where the pox grows and what colour: the Yi Mao judges here by the palace the ghost stands in (Gen the arms, Dui the mouth and cheeks, Kan and Li the upper body, Zhen and Xun the lower) and by which line the ghost is strong on (first line the feet, sixth line the face), and so does the Zengshan Buyi (Qian mostly on the head, Kun on the belly, Gen on the hands, Dui on the mouth, Kan and Li on the upper body, Zhen and Xun on the lower, LY.ILL.ZS.20); the two agree, and the colours are the same too (Fire ghost purple-red, Metal hollow white, Water black and sunken, Wood mixed and fine, Earth swollen and large). The Bushi Zhengzong speaks of where the ailment left after recovery lies (LY.ILL.BSZZ.23-25), and gives the Dui palace once as the mouth and once as the face, which again differs slightly from the mouth and cheeks here.

note.yi: 「五脢」是脊柱两旁的肉，「二腓」是两个小腿肚。「黑钉」是黑色的痘，一种险象。注的最后一个例（屯之革，戊申日变脾病）是说痘症会变成别的病而致命。这一条和易隐 LY.ILL.YY.35「鬼衰子旺则稀朗、鬼旺子衰则稠密」和卜筮正宗 LY.ILL.BSZZ.06「福旺则花必稀疏」方向一致。
note.en: 'The back' (wumei) is the flesh on either side of the spine and 'the two calves' (erfei) the two calf muscles. 'Black nails' are black pox, a dangerous sign. The last example in the note (Zhun into Ge, turning into a spleen illness on the Wushen day) says that pox may change into another illness and prove fatal. This entry is in the same direction as the Yi Yin's LY.ILL.YY.35 ('ghost weak and Output strong, sparse; ghost strong and Output weak, dense') and the Bushi Zhengzong's LY.ILL.BSZZ.06 ('Output strong and the flowers are sparse').

zh: 占花疏密，询鬼旺衰，以八卦而分手足，以六爻而定身形，以五行而著颜色，乾首坤腹，五脢二腓，金白火赤可类也。
yi: 占花的稀密，问鬼的旺衰，用八卦来分手足，用六爻来定身形，用五行来显颜色：乾是头，坤是腹，（还有）五脢、二腓，金是白、火是红，都可以类推。
en: To divine whether the flowers are sparse or dense, ask whether the ghost is strong or weak; the eight trigrams divide hands and feet, the six lines fix the parts of the body, and the five elements bring out the colours: Qian the head, Kun the belly, the back and the two calves, Metal white, Fire red, and so on by analogy.

zh: 盖鬼为痘，若临日月旺相生扶，花必绸密，如值空破休囚死绝，痘必疏朗。
凡鬼动何宫，则定花丛何处，如不动，审旺何爻，如发艮宫手臂密，如动兑宫口颊多，坎离上身，震巽下身；
旺在初爻，先有于足，旺在六爻，始发于面，五爻胸背，二爻腿膝，三四腰股心腹。
火鬼发其色红紫，金鬼动其色虚白，水鬼发其色黑陷，木为杂细，土为肿大。
然必论用神生死，而后定之吉凶，故水鬼动而主象旺者，痘见黑钉，后复收功。
然痘症多变，设遇用象破空，或值何鬼发动，则变此症而丧，如未建甲辰日，占子痘得屯之革，于戊申日乃变脾病而不治，余仿此。
yi: 因为鬼就是痘，如果临日、月旺相又有生扶，花一定稠密；如果遇到空、破、休、囚、死、绝，痘一定疏朗。
凡是鬼在哪个宫发动，就定花丛集在哪里，如果不动，就审哪一爻旺：发在艮宫的手臂上密，动在兑宫的口和脸颊上多，坎、离在上身，震、巽在下身；
旺在初爻，先出在脚上；旺在六爻，开始发在脸上；五爻在胸背，二爻在腿膝，三、四爻在腰、大腿、心口、肚子。
火鬼发的，颜色红紫；金鬼动的，颜色虚白；水鬼发的，颜色黑而塌陷；木是杂而细，土是肿而大。
但是一定要论用神的生死，然后才能定吉凶，所以水鬼动而主象旺的，痘出现黑钉，后来仍能收功。
痘症多变，假如遇到用象破空，或者某个鬼发动，就变成那种病而死；比如未月甲辰日，占孩子的痘，得到屯卦变革卦，到戊申日变成脾病而治不好，其余照此。
en: For the ghost is the pox: if it sits on the Day or Month, is strong and is supported, the flowers are surely dense; if it meets Void, breaking, resting, trapped, death or extinction, the pox is surely sparse and clear.

Wherever the ghost moves, in which palace, that fixes where the flowers cluster; if it does not move, see which line is strong: from the Gen palace, dense on the arms; moving in the Dui palace, many on the mouth and cheeks; Kan and Li the upper body, Zhen and Xun the lower body;

strong on the first line, first on the feet; strong on the sixth line, starting on the face; the fifth line the chest and back, the second the legs and knees, the third and fourth the waist, thighs, heart and belly.
A Fire ghost moving gives a red-purple colour, a Metal ghost a hollow white, a Water ghost a black, sunken colour; Wood is mixed and fine, Earth swollen and large.

But one must judge whether the Subject is alive or dying before fixing fortune, so when a Water ghost moves and the main image is strong, the pox shows black nails, yet afterwards comes to completion.

But pox often changes; if the image of the Subject is broken or Void, or some ghost moves, it changes into that illness and he dies: for example, in the Wei month on the Jiachen day a child's pox was divined and Zhun changing into Ge obtained, and on the Wushen day it turned into a spleen illness that could not be cured; the rest follow this.

title: 问痘见何人：鬼当本命、鬼化卦宫者应之；考六亲化鬼及鬼化六亲，必鬼旺动；官鬼值何人本命则是人有痘，鬼动艮宫少男、化离象中女、财爻化鬼奴仆、鬼化子孩提

rule.yi: 如果问是谁出痘，鬼爻正当他的本命的，或者鬼变成（某人所属的）卦宫的，就应在这个人身上。考察哪个六亲变出鬼、鬼变成哪个六亲，就知道出痘的是这个人；但也必须鬼旺又动才会发。一家之内，官鬼正当哪个人的本命，就说这个人有痘；又，鬼动在艮宫，是少男；鬼变成离象，是中女；财爻变鬼，是奴仆；鬼变成子孙，是幼儿；总之要在鬼爻旺又动的前提下才这样说。
rule.en: If asked who will have the pox, it answers on the one whose natal branch the ghost stands on, or on the person whose palace the ghost changes into. Examine which relation changes into the ghost and which relation the ghost changes into, and that is the person who has the pox; but the ghost must also be strong and moving before it breaks out. Within one household, whoever's natal branch the Pressure line stands on, say that person has the pox; again, a ghost moving in the Gen palace is the youngest son; a ghost changing into the Li image, the middle daughter; a Wealth line changing into a ghost, a servant; a ghost changing into Output, an infant; in general one says so only where the Pressure line is strong and moving.

note.yi: 「本命」是人生年的地支。易冒疾病章后面还有一条同样的说法，「占父病而鬼动于坤，其母随之而疾」（LY.ILL.YM.33），那里也是用鬼动在哪个宫来推还有谁会病。
note.en: The 'natal branch' is the earthly branch of a person's birth year. Later in the chapter on illness the Yi Mao has a similar saying, 'divining a father's illness with the ghost moving in Kun, his mother follows with the illness' (LY.ILL.YM.33), which likewise uses the palace in which the ghost moves to work out who else will fall ill.

zh: 如问痘见何人，鬼当本命，鬼化卦宫者应之。
考六亲之化鬼，及鬼化之六亲，则痘是人也，然亦必鬼旺动而发焉。
yi: 如果问是谁出痘，鬼正当他的本命的，或者鬼变成（某人所属的）卦宫的，就应在这个人身上。
考察哪个六亲变出鬼、鬼变成哪个六亲，就知道出痘的是这个人；但也必须鬼旺又动才会发。
en: If asked who will have the pox, it answers on the one whose natal branch the ghost stands on, or on the person whose palace the ghost changes into.
Examine which relation changes into the ghost and which relation the ghost changes into, and that is the person who has the pox; but the ghost must also be strong and moving before it breaks out.

zh: 一家之内，以官鬼值何人本命，则曰是人有痘。
又鬼动艮宫，则曰少男，鬼化离象，则曰中女，财爻化鬼，则曰奴仆，鬼象化子，则曰孩提，大抵务于鬼爻旺动而言也。
yi: 一家之内，官鬼正当哪个人的本命，就说这个人有痘。
又，鬼动在艮宫，就说是少男；鬼变成离象，就说是中女；财爻变鬼，就说是奴仆；鬼变成子孙，就说是幼儿；总之要在鬼爻旺又动的前提下才这样说。
en: Within one household, whoever's natal branch the Pressure line stands on, say that person has the pox.

Again, if the ghost moves in the Gen palace, say the youngest son; if the ghost changes into the Li image, the middle daughter; if the Wealth line changes into a ghost, a servant; if the ghost image changes into Output, an infant; in general one says so only where the Pressure line is strong and moving.

title: 问孩童何时见痘：官鬼当值及生旺官鬼的年月日；上下鬼填其虚、变伏鬼实其质；问岁以年计、问时以月计；两鬼一空一实以填补空鬼为期，卦无官而伏变爻有者以变伏之鬼所值为期

rule.yi: 如果问孩子什么时候出痘，是官鬼当值的年、月、日，以及生旺官鬼的年、月、日；上下的鬼填补它的空，变出的鬼、伏着的鬼落实它的实体。远近要分开占：问哪一岁就以年计，问什么时候就以月计，先看填实的时间，再看生旺的年月来断；如果卦里有两个鬼，一个空一个实，反而以填补空鬼的时间为期；卦里一个官也没有，而伏爻、变爻上有的，就以变出、伏着的鬼所值的时间为期。
rule.en: If asked when a child will have the pox, it is the year, month or day on which the Pressure line is on duty, and the year, month or day that strengthens the Pressure line; the ghosts above and below fill its emptiness, and the changed or hidden ghost makes its substance real. Far and near are divined separately: asking which year, count by years; asking when, count by months; first the time of filling the emptiness, then the years and months of strength; if the hexagram has two ghosts, one Void and one full, the time of filling the Void ghost is taken as the term instead; if the hexagram has no Pressure line at all but the hidden or changed lines have one, take the time held by the changed or hidden ghost as the term.

note.yi: 「填实」是空的爻等到它的地支值年、值月、值日，把空补上；「上下鬼」按注是卦里上、下两个鬼。这一条和增删卜易讲的出花之期（LY.ILL.ZS.19：鬼静逢值逢冲、鬼动逢值逢合、鬼空破在填实之时、鬼伏在出现之岁）是同一路，只是易冒多了两个鬼、无鬼时怎么取。
note.en: 'Filling' is a Void line waiting for the year, month or day of its own branch to fill it; the 'ghosts above and below' are, by the note, the two ghosts in the hexagram. This entry is on the same road as the Zengshan Buyi's time for the flowers to come out (LY.ILL.ZS.19: a still ghost on the day of duty or clash, a moving ghost on duty or combination, a Void or broken ghost at the time of filling, a hidden ghost in the year it appears); the Yi Mao adds only what to do with two ghosts and with none.

zh: 如问孩童何时见痘，当官鬼之年月日，及生旺官鬼之年月日则痘也。
上下鬼而填其虚，变伏鬼而实其质。
yi: 如果问孩子什么时候出痘，是官鬼当值的年、月、日，以及生旺官鬼的年、月、日，就出痘。
上下的鬼用来填补它的空，变出的鬼、伏着的鬼用来落实它的实体。
en: If asked when a child will have the pox, it is the year, month or day on which the Pressure line is on duty, and the year, month or day that strengthens the Pressure line.
The ghosts above and below fill its emptiness, and the changed or hidden ghost makes its substance real.

zh: 远近分卜，问何岁则以年计，问何时则以月计，先以填实，次以生旺年月断之。
若卦有两鬼，或一空一实，反以填补空鬼为期；
卦无一官，或伏爻变爻有者，当以变伏之鬼所值为期也。
yi: 远近要分开占：问哪一岁就以年来计，问什么时候就以月来计，先看填实的时间，再看生旺的年月来断。
如果卦里有两个鬼，一个空一个实，反而以填补空鬼的时间为期；
卦里一个官爻也没有，而伏爻、变爻上有的，就以变出、伏着的鬼所值的时间为期。
en: Far and near are divined separately: asking which year, count by years; asking when, count by months; first the time of filling the emptiness, then the years and months of strength.
If the hexagram has two ghosts, one Void and one full, the time of filling the Void ghost is taken as the term instead;
if the hexagram has no Pressure line at all but the hidden or changed lines have one, take the time held by the changed or hidden ghost as the term.

title: 既痘而筮大象：七日之内三冲是戒（花未开先谢）；卦属反伏墓绝与命随鬼墓虽用旺难治，四忌之外再考用神；鬼旺用旺花丛根固吉、鬼坏用坏花悴根枯凶；生旺用神之日有成、冲鬼象之辰有变；感不感在鬼、害不害在用，鬼化鬼痘后痍、交加动瘄痘相参

rule.yi: 已经出痘，再占整体的吉凶：七天之内，要戒备三冲，就是花还没开就先谢了。卦是反吟、伏吟、入墓、入绝的，和本命随鬼入墓的，即使用爻旺也难治；这四种忌讳之外，再考察用神。鬼旺而用爻旺，花丛茂盛、根牢固，是吉；鬼坏而用爻坏，花憔悴、根枯，是凶。生旺用神的日子是有成的时候，冲鬼象的时辰是有变的日期。大体上，感染不感染取决于鬼，有害没害取决于用爻；鬼变鬼的，痘后有疮痍；交错发动的，是瘄和痘掺杂。注说：这是专就用爻来说吉凶，不再论鬼的衰旺；如果用爻有生扶救助，鬼旺不过是花密；鬼爻被填实、被冲动，不过是要防变；鬼变鬼和用爻变鬼，不过是痘后余毒；鬼交错发动，或者有别的病夹杂，也没到大害的地步。
rule.en: Once the pox has come and one divines the great image's fortune, within seven days the three clashes are the thing to guard against, meaning the flower withers before it has opened. A hexagram that is Reversed, Hidden, in a tomb or in Extinction, and one where the natal branch follows the ghost into a tomb, are hard to treat even if the Subject line is strong; apart from these four taboos, then examine the Subject. If the ghost is strong and the Subject line strong, the flowers are luxuriant and the roots firm, which is auspicious; if the ghost is spoiled and the Subject line spoiled, the flowers droop and the roots wither, which is ominous. The day that strengthens the Subject is the time of completion, the hour that clashes the ghost image the time of change. In general whether the child catches it depends on the ghost, whether it does harm on the Subject line; a ghost changing into a ghost means sores after the pox; lines moving in tangles mean measles and pox mixed together. The note says: this speaks of fortune purely by the Subject line and no longer discusses whether the ghost is strong or weak; if the Subject line has generation, support and rescue, a strong ghost only means dense flowers; if the Pressure line is filled or stirred by a clash, it only means guarding against change; a ghost changing into a ghost, or the Subject line changing into a ghost, only means residual poison after the pox; ghosts moving in tangles, or another illness riding along, does not amount to great harm.

note.yi: 「四忌」是卦反（反吟）、卦伏（伏吟）、卦墓、卦绝，再加「命随鬼墓」这一项，书里合称「反伏墓绝与命随鬼墓」；「三冲」按易冒的用法是卦冲的三种情形。「瘄」是麻疹。注文里「痘后痍」「痘后余毒」都是痘好了以后留下的疮疡和余毒。这一条把吉凶全归到用爻（用神），与增删卜易讲痘的吉凶全在子孙爻（LY.ILL.ZS.21）相近，只是易冒的用神是所占那个人的爻，不专指子孙。
note.en: The 'four taboos' are the hexagram Reversed (Reversed Chant), Hidden (Hidden Chant), in a tomb and in Extinction, and the book adds 'the natal branch following the ghost into a tomb', naming them together as 'Reversed, Hidden, tomb, Extinction, and the natal branch following the ghost into a tomb'; the 'three clashes' in the Yi Mao's usage are the three cases of a hexagram in clash. 'Cu' is measles. 'Sores after the pox' and 'residual poison after the pox' are the sores and leftover poison after the pox has healed. This entry puts fortune wholly in the Subject line, close to the Zengshan Buyi's putting the fortune of pox wholly in the Output line (LY.ILL.ZS.21), except that the Yi Mao's Subject is the line of the person divined and not specifically Output.

zh: 既痘而筮大象之吉凶，七日之内，三冲是戒，谓花未开而先谢也。
卦属反伏墓绝，与命随鬼墓，虽用旺难治，四忌之外，再考用神。
盖鬼旺而用旺花丛而根固，乃吉，鬼坏而用坏，花悴而根枯，乃凶。
生旺用神之日，为有成时，当冲鬼象之辰，为有变期也。
大抵感不感务乎鬼，害不害务乎用，鬼化鬼者痘后痍，交加动者，瘄痘相参也。
yi: 已经出痘，再占整体的吉凶：七天之内，要戒备三冲，就是花还没开就先谢了。
卦是反吟、伏吟、入墓、入绝的，和本命随鬼入墓的，即使用爻旺也难治；这四种忌讳之外，再考察用神。
鬼旺而用爻旺，花丛茂盛、根牢固，是吉；鬼坏而用爻坏，花憔悴、根枯，是凶。
生旺用神的日子，是有成的时候；冲鬼象的时辰，是有变的日期。
大体上，感染不感染取决于鬼，有害没害取决于用爻；鬼变鬼的，痘后有疮痍；交错发动的，是瘄和痘掺杂。
en: Once the pox has come and one divines the great image's fortune, within seven days the three clashes are the thing to guard against, meaning the flower withers before it has opened.

A hexagram that is Reversed, Hidden, in a tomb or in Extinction, and one where the natal branch follows the ghost into a tomb, are hard to treat even if the Subject line is strong; apart from these four taboos, then examine the Subject.

If the ghost is strong and the Subject line strong, the flowers are luxuriant and the roots firm, which is auspicious; if the ghost is spoiled and the Subject line spoiled, the flowers droop and the roots wither, which is ominous.
The day that strengthens the Subject is the time of completion; the hour that clashes the ghost image is the time of change.

In general whether the child catches it depends on the ghost, whether it does harm on the Subject line; a ghost changing into a ghost means sores after the pox; lines moving in tangles mean measles and pox mixed together.

zh: 此专务用爻而言吉凶，不复论鬼衰旺。
若用爻有生扶救助，鬼旺无非花密，鬼爻填实冲动，无非防变，鬼化鬼及用化鬼，无非痘后余毒，交加鬼发，或别病相乘而已，未至大害也。
yi: 这是专就用爻来说吉凶，不再论鬼的衰旺。
如果用爻有生扶救助，鬼旺不过是花密；鬼爻被填实、被冲动，不过是要防变；鬼变鬼和用爻变鬼，不过是痘后余毒；鬼交错发动，或者有别的病夹杂，也没到大害的地步。
en: This speaks of fortune purely by the Subject line and no longer discusses whether the ghost is strong or weak.

If the Subject line has generation, support and rescue, a strong ghost only means dense flowers; if the Pressure line is filled or stirred by a clash, it only means guarding against change; a ghost changing into a ghost, or the Subject line changing into a ghost, only means residual poison after the pox; ghosts moving in tangles, or another illness riding along, does not amount to great harm.

title: 既疾必筮其吉凶而调剂之：慎于未病是君子之道；命随鬼墓是不治之疾（例：卦中子孙旺相病不死，亥命随官入墓，半年内溺水亡）

rule.yi: 生死有命，不是祈祷能改的；疾病在于人，不可以忽视；没生病之前就谨慎，是君子的做法。已经生了病，能不占问它的吉凶而加以调理吗？本命跟着鬼入了墓，是治不好的病。比如戌月甲辰日，占儿子的病，他生于己亥年，得同人卦，卦中子孙旺相、六爻安静，病应当不会死，但是亥命随官入了墓，按法大凶；后来他的病没有死，却不到半年溺水而死。
rule.en: Life and death have their appointed lot and cannot be prayed away; illness lies with the person and must not be neglected; to take care before falling ill is the way of the gentleman. Once ill, can one fail to divine its fortune and adjust the treatment? If the natal branch follows the ghost into a tomb, it is an untreatable illness. For example, in the Xu month on the Jiachen day, someone divined a son's illness; he was born in a Jihai year and the hexagram was Tongren, with Output strong and the six lines still, so the illness should not kill; but the Hai natal branch followed Pressure into a tomb, which by the method is a great ill omen; afterwards he did not die of the illness, but within half a year he drowned.

note.yi: 「命随鬼墓」的「命」是本命（出生年的地支），「随鬼入墓」是本命的地支跟着官鬼入墓。这一条例子里病人没有死于病却死于水，说明这个象断的是「命」不是「病」——和黄金策讲的「命入幽明两墓」（LY.ILL.HJC.54）、「世上临鬼不可随官入墓」（LY.ILL.HJC.41）、易隐的「用爻随鬼入墓者死」（LY.ILL.YY.05）是同一个象。
note.en: The 'destiny' of 'the destiny following the ghost into a tomb' is the natal branch (the branch of the birth year), and 'following the ghost into a tomb' is the natal branch entering a tomb along with the Pressure line. In the example the patient did not die of the illness but of water, which shows that this image judges the 'destiny' and not the 'illness' — it is the same image as the Huangjin Ce's 'the destiny entering the bright and dark tombs' (LY.ILL.HJC.54) and 'the Self holding Pressure must not follow Pressure into a tomb' (LY.ILL.HJC.41) and the Yi Yin's 'if the Subject line follows the ghost into a tomb, he dies' (LY.ILL.YY.05).

zh: 夫死生有命，不可祷也，疾病在人，不可忽也，慎于未病，君子之道也。
既疾，可不筮其吉凶而调剂之？
yi: 生死有命，不是祈祷能改的；疾病在于人，不可以忽视；没生病之前就谨慎，是君子的做法。
已经生了病，能不占问它的吉凶而加以调理吗？
本命跟着鬼入了墓，是治不好的病。
en: Life and death have their appointed lot and cannot be prayed away; illness lies with the person and must not be neglected; to take care before falling ill is the way of the gentleman.
Once ill, can one fail to divine its fortune and adjust the treatment?
If the natal branch follows the ghost into a tomb, it is an untreatable illness.

zh: 如戌建甲辰日占子病，生年己亥，得同人，卦中子孙旺相，六爻安静，病应不死，然亥命随官入墓，法主大凶。
后其疾不死，未半年溺水而亡。
yi: 比如戌月甲辰日，占儿子的病，他生于己亥年，得同人卦，卦中子孙旺相、六爻安静，病应当不会死，但是亥命随官入了墓，按法大凶。
后来他的病没有死，却不到半年溺水而死。
en: For example, in the Xu month on the Jiachen day, someone divined a son's illness; he was born in a Jihai year and the hexagram was Tongren, with Output strong and the six lines still, so the illness should not kill; but the Hai natal branch followed Pressure into a tomb, which by the method is a great ill omen.
Afterwards he did not die of the illness, but within half a year he drowned.

zh: 内详症候、防疫、真假、成疾、养病、避暑六问
yi: 下文详细讲六个问题：症候、防疫、真假、成疾、养病、避暑。
en: The text below treats six questions in detail: symptoms, guarding against epidemic, real or false, becoming a chronic ailment, convalescence, and summer retreat.

title: 卦属反伏墓绝亦不治；病未久三冲而愈、病已久三冲而亡，此三者不论用神衰旺；外此专重用神——动散、月破、克空、日破、受伤无援、脱气者危，日月动变有一能救则危而复安

rule.yi: 卦是反吟、伏吟、入墓、入绝的，也治不好，即使能治好也会落下病根。病没多久的，遇到三冲就好；病已经久了的，遇到三冲就死；这三种情形不论用神的衰旺。除此之外，就专门看重用神：遇到动散、月破、克空、日破、受伤没有救援、脱气的，危险；遇到日、月、动爻、变爻里有一个能救的，危险了又能转安。注里给了每一种的例子（七种情形都是大凶，得到日、月、动爻、变爻里有一个能救的，就要反过来看）。
rule.en: A hexagram that is Reversed, Hidden, in a tomb or in Extinction is likewise untreatable, and even if it can be treated, it becomes a lingering ailment. If the illness is not old, the three clashes cure it; if it is already long, the three clashes bring death; in these three cases the strength or weakness of the Subject is not considered.
