If someone divines whether a worry will become an illness, following into the tomb and helping to harm mean the illness has already formed;
if the Subject is spoiled, how can the illness be cured?
For one who divines convalescing away from home, following into the tomb, helping to harm, the Self broken and the ghost moving will not do.
for one escaping the summer heat here, it is the same.

zh: 官鬼空破散绝谓之虚，旺相生扶谓之实，用神空破绝散则成疾，旺相生扶则不成疾。
yi: 官鬼空、破、散、绝叫做虚，旺相、有生扶叫做实；用神空、破、绝、散就会成病，旺相有生扶就不会成病。
en: The Pressure line Void, broken, scattered or in Extinction is called empty, and thriving and strong, generated and supported, is called full; the Subject Void, broken, in Extinction or scattered, the illness forms, and thriving and strong, generated and supported, it does not form.

title: 鬼动为致祸之由、福动为远灾之要，福神可趋、祸神可避：鬼发坎莫贪酒食、发兑莫迷欲色、震忌登舟、巽忌入园、乾不好僧室、艮不悦山居、坤弗食牛、离因嗜炙；子孙发于是宫则反视

rule.yi: 所以鬼动是招来祸的缘由，福动是远离灾的要领；福神可以趋近，祸神可以躲开。于是鬼在坎宫发动，就不要贪酒食；在兑宫发动，就不要迷恋欲色；震宫忌坐船，巽宫忌进园子，乾宫不可以喜欢去僧房，艮宫不可以喜欢住山里，坤宫不吃牛，离宫是因为爱吃烤炙的东西。注说：如果是子孙在这一宫发动，这个地方反而有利有福，和前面说的正好相反；乾宫利于僧堂，坤宫利于田地，坎宫适合江海，艮宫适合山，离宫乐于文章，兑宫爱好酒，震宫喜欢舟车，巽宫喜欢园囿。
rule.en: So a moving ghost is the cause that brings misfortune, and a moving Output is the key to keeping calamity away: the fortune spirit can be sought and the misfortune spirit avoided. When the ghost moves in Kan, do not be greedy for wine and food; in Dui, do not be lost in desire and lust; for Zhen avoid boarding a boat, for Xun avoid entering a garden; for Qian one must not favour monks' rooms, for Gen one must not delight in mountain dwellings; for Kun do not eat beef, and for Li it is from a fondness for roasted food. The note says: if Output moves in the same palace, that place is advantageous and blessed, the reverse of what was said before; Qian favours the monks' hall and Kun the fields, Kan suits river and sea and Gen the mountain, Li delights in writing and Dui in wine, Zhen likes boats and carriages and Xun gardens and parks.

note.yi: 这一条是上一条（LY.ILL.YM.30）的反面：上一条从病因往回推，这一条向前讲怎么躲。同一个宫，鬼动时忌的东西，子孙动时反而是宜的东西——坎宫鬼动忌酒食，子孙动时宜江海；乾宫鬼动不可好僧室，子孙动时利僧堂。「福神可趋」的「福神」在这里是子孙（Output），「祸神」是鬼。「离因嗜炙」的「嗜炙」是爱吃烤炙的东西，取火象；「坤弗食牛」取坤为牛。
note.en: This entry is the reverse of the last (LY.ILL.YM.30): that reasons back from the cause of the illness, and this looks forward to how to avoid it. In the same palace, what is avoided when the ghost moves is what is favoured when Output moves: with the ghost moving in Kan wine and food are avoided, and with Output moving Kan suits river and sea; with the ghost moving in Qian one must not favour monks' rooms, and with Output moving Qian favours the monks' hall. The 'fortune spirit' in 'the fortune spirit can be sought' is Output, and the 'misfortune spirit' is the ghost. 'Fondness for roasted food' in Li takes the image of Fire, and 'do not eat beef' in Kun takes Kun as the ox.

zh: 故鬼动为致祸之由，福动为远灾之要，福神可趋，祸神可避。
是以发坎则莫贪于酒食，发兑则莫迷于欲色，震忌登舟，巽忌入园，乾不可以好僧室，艮不可以悦山居，坤弗食牛，离因嗜炙也。
yi: 所以鬼动是招来祸的缘由，福动是远离灾的要领；福神可以趋近，祸神可以躲避。
所以鬼在坎宫发动，就不要贪酒食；在兑宫发动，就不要迷恋欲色；震宫忌坐船，巽宫忌进园子，乾宫不可以喜欢去僧房，艮宫不可以喜欢住山里，坤宫不吃牛，离宫是因为爱吃烤炙的东西。
en: Therefore a moving ghost is the cause that brings misfortune, and a moving Output is the key to keeping calamity away; the Output (fortune) spirit can be sought and the misfortune spirit avoided.

So when it moves in Kan, do not be greedy for wine and food; in Dui, do not be lost in desire and lust; for Zhen avoid boarding a boat, for Xun avoid entering a garden; for Qian one must not favour monks' rooms, for Gen one must not delight in mountain dwellings; for Kun do not eat beef, and for Li it is from a fondness for roasted food.

zh: 若子孙发动于是宫，则此处利福，与前反视。
乾利僧堂坤利田，坎宜江海艮宜山，离乐文章兑嗜酒，震喜舟车巽囿园。
yi: 如果是子孙在这一宫发动，这个地方反而有利有福，和前面说的正好相反。
乾宫利于僧堂，坤宫利于田地，坎宫适合江海，艮宫适合山，离宫乐于文章，兑宫爱好酒，震宫喜欢舟车，巽宫喜欢园囿。
en: If Output moves in the same palace, then that place is advantageous and blessed, the reverse of what was said before.
Qian favours the monks' hall and Kun the fields; Kan suits river and sea and Gen suits the mountain; Li delights in writing and Dui in wine; Zhen likes boats and carriages and Xun gardens and parks.

title: 爻变之鬼亦然：占父病鬼动于坤其母随之而疾、占子病鬼化于巽其女继之而灾；何宫鬼动及鬼变何宫，言其人亦防灾病（例：辛酉日占女巽之涣、丙辰日占次女痘革之咸）；疾病之章不离用爻鬼象

rule.yi: 还有占父亲的病而鬼在坤宫发动，他的母亲跟着也生病；占儿子的病而鬼变到巽宫，他的女儿接着遭灾：这就是说，爻变出来的鬼也是同样。所以疾病这一章离不开用爻和鬼的象。注：鬼在哪一宫发动，以及鬼变到哪一宫，就说那一宫所代表的人也要提防灾病。举了三个例子：辛酉日占女儿的病，巽变涣，子孙遇长生，这个女儿不会死，但鬼动变入坎宫，次子接着生病，后来还死了；丙辰日占二女儿出痘，革变咸，子孙值月建，二女儿无事，但内卦变到艮，官鬼落在少男宫里，后来小儿子也出了痘。总之占疾病，生死靠用爻，趋避、变通、救治的门路，都在于详细考察鬼爻。
rule.en: Again, where a father's illness is divined and the ghost moves in Kun, his mother falls ill after him; where a son's illness is divined and the ghost changes into Xun, his daughter suffers calamity in turn: so the ghost that appears by change is also the same. So the chapter on illness never leaves the Subject line and the image of the ghost. The note says: whichever palace the ghost moves in, and whichever palace it changes into, say that the person that palace stands for should also guard against calamity and illness. It gives cases: on a Xinyou day a woman's illness was divined, Xun changing into Huan, Output met Birth and the woman did not die, but the ghost moved into the Kan palace and the middle son fell ill in succession and later died; on a Bingchen day the pox of a second daughter was divined, Ge changing into Xian, Output stood on the Month and the second daughter came to no harm, but the inner trigram changed into Gen, the Pressure line sat in the palace of the youngest son, and afterwards the youngest son also had the pox. In short, in divining illness life and death rest on the Subject line, and the gates of seeking and avoiding, altering and remedying all depend on a careful examination of the Pressure line.

note.yi: 这一条讲的是牵连：病的鬼落在哪一宫，那一宫代表的家人就会跟着有事——坤是母，巽是长女，坎是中男，艮是少男。与痘疹章「考六亲化鬼及鬼化六亲」（LY.ILL.YM.06）是同一路读法，只是那里是问谁会出痘，这里是问谁会跟着有病。注里第二例「及甲申旬化午子空」一句，原文的次序和断句都不清楚（甲申旬空的是午未，而不是子），这里按字面译，不改。「及甲寅旬……及甲申旬……」两个旬，说的是同一个鬼在两个旬里应验的情形不同：头一旬是有病，后一旬是死。
note.en: This entry is about knock-on effects: into whichever palace the ghost of the illness falls, the family member that palace stands for will be affected in turn — Kun is the mother, Xun the eldest daughter, Kan the middle son, Gen the youngest son. It reads in the same way as the chapter on pox's 'examine the relations that turn into ghosts and the ghosts that turn into relations' (LY.ILL.YM.06), except that there the question was who would have the pox and here it is who would fall ill in turn. In the note's second case, the sentence 'in the Jiashen decade changing into Wu with Zi Void' is unclear in both order and punctuation in the original (the Void branches of the Jiashen decade are Wu and Wei, not Zi), and is translated literally without correction. The two decades, Jiayin and Jiashen, show the same ghost coming true differently in each: illness in the first, death in the second.

zh: 犹有占父病而鬼动于坤，其母随之而疾，占子病而鬼化于巽，其女继之而灾，则爻变之鬼亦然也。
所以疾病之章，不离乎用爻鬼象。
yi: 还有占父亲的病而鬼在坤宫发动，他的母亲跟着也生病；占儿子的病而鬼变到巽宫，他的女儿接着遭灾，这就是说，爻变出来的鬼也是同样的道理。
所以疾病这一章，离不开用爻和鬼的象。
en: Again, where a father's illness is divined and the ghost moves in Kun, his mother falls ill after him; where a son's illness is divined and the ghost changes into Xun, his daughter suffers calamity in turn: so the ghost that appears by change is also the same.
So the chapter on illness never leaves the Subject line and the image of the ghost.

zh: 何宫鬼动，及鬼变何宫，则言其人亦防灾病。
如寅建辛酉日，占女身得巽之涣，子遇长生，其女不死；
然鬼动化入坎宫，甲寅旬中坎空，中男相继而病，及甲申旬化午子空，中男反亡；
卯建丙辰日，占次女痘，得革之咸，月建子孙，次女无事；
然内化艮，丙辰官鬼居少男宫，其后少男亦痘。
盖占疾病，生死凭于用爻，趋避变易救治之门，皆系鬼爻详察。
yi: 鬼在哪一宫发动，以及鬼变到哪一宫，就说那一宫所代表的人也要提防灾病。
比如寅月辛酉日，占一个女人的病，得巽卦变涣卦，子孙遇长生，这个女人不会死；
但是鬼动、变入坎宫，甲寅旬里坎宫落空，次子接着生病，到甲申旬变成午、子空，次子反而死了；
卯月丙辰日，占二女儿出痘，得革卦变咸卦，子孙值月建，二女儿无事；
但是内卦变到艮，丙辰的官鬼落在少男的宫里，后来小儿子也出了痘。
占疾病，生死靠用爻决定，趋避、变通、救治的门路，都在于详细考察鬼爻。
en: Whichever palace the ghost moves in, and whichever palace it changes into, say that the person that palace stands for should also guard against calamity and illness.
For example, in a Yin month on a Xinyou day, a woman's illness was divined and Xun changing into Huan was obtained; the Son line met Birth, and the woman did not die;

but the ghost moved and changed into the Kan palace; in the Jiayin decade Kan was Void and the middle son fell ill in succession, and in the Jiashen decade, changing into Wu with Zi Void, the middle son died instead;
in a Mao month on a Bingchen day, the pox of a second daughter was divined and Ge changing into Xian was obtained; Output stood on the Month and the second daughter came to no harm;
but the inner trigram changed into Gen, and the Bingchen Pressure line sat in the palace of the youngest son, and afterwards the youngest son also had the pox.
In divining illness, life and death rest on the Subject line, while the gates of seeking and avoiding, altering and remedying all depend on a careful examination of the Pressure line.

title: 医药章总纲：占医药以子孙为用，临日月为上、旺相次之、休囚为下、空破散绝为庸医；章内六问——占药、占医、治病、用药、往医、行道

rule.yi: 占医药的总纲：拿子孙爻当用。子孙临日、月是上等，旺相是次等，休囚是下等，空、破、散、绝就是庸医。这一章开头先说了几句话：得志的时候愿意做良相，不得志的时候愿意做良医；君子借医来施展志向，做儿子的要懂得医理，吉凶取舍能不慎重吗？章里分六问细讲：占药、占医、治病、用药、往医、行道；头两问是病家问，后四问（治病、用药、往医、行道）都是医生自己问。
rule.en: The outline for divining medicine and doctors: take Output as the one to use. Output sitting on the Day or Month is best, thriving and strong is next, resting and trapped is lowest, and Void, broken, scattered or in Extinction is a mediocre doctor. The chapter opens with a few remarks: when successful one wishes to be a good minister, when not, a good doctor; the gentleman carries out his will through medicine, and a son must know medicine, so how can one not be careful in choosing between fortune and misfortune? The chapter then treats six questions in detail: divining the medicine, divining the doctor, treating the illness, using the medicine, going to treat, and the doctor's practice; the first two are asked by the patient's family and the last four (treating, using, going, practising) are all asked by the doctor himself.

note.yi: 「用」在这里指取用，和「用神」是一回事：占医药不取病人的用神，取子孙爻。黄金策的医药章同样以子孙为药饵、应爻为医人（见 LY.ILL.HJC.58），下面第二条（LY.ILL.YM.36）也说应爻指医人。目录注里的「往医」「行道」是医生的问法（见后面 LY.ILL.YM.40、YM.41）：「往医」是医生上门去治，「行道」是医生行医的前程。这一条把原文里的目录注放在了最后。
note.en: 'Use' here means the one to take, the same thing as the Subject: in divining medicine one does not take the patient's Subject but the Output line. The Huangjin Ce's chapter on medicine likewise takes Output as the medicine and the Other as the doctor (see LY.ILL.HJC.58), and the second entry below (LY.ILL.YM.36) also says the Other stands for the doctor. 'Going to treat' and 'practising' in the contents note are the doctor's own questions (see LY.ILL.YM.40 and YM.41 below): 'going to treat' is the doctor visiting a patient, and 'practising' is the course of the doctor's practice. In this entry the contents note from the original is placed last.

zh: 闻之称贤曰：达则愿为良相，不达则愿为良医。
君子以之行志，人子教其须知，吉凶从违，可不慎与？
yi: 听到被称为贤人的人说过：得志的时候愿意做良相，不得志的时候愿意做良医。
君子借医来施展自己的志向，做儿子的要学会该知道的医理，吉凶的取舍，能不慎重吗？
en: I have heard one called a worthy say: if I succeed, I wish to be a good minister; if I do not, a good doctor.
The gentleman puts his will into practice through it, and a son is taught that he must know it; in following or avoiding fortune and misfortune, can one not be careful?

zh: 凡占医药，以子孙为用，临日月为上，旺相次之，休囚为下，空破散绝为庸医也。
yi: 凡是占医药，以子孙爻当用，子孙临日、月是上等，旺相是次等，休囚是下等，空、破、散、绝就是庸医。
en: In all divining of medicine and doctors, Output is the line to use: sitting on the Day or Month is best, thriving and strong is next, resting and trapped is lowest, and Void, broken, scattered or in Extinction is a mediocre doctor.

zh: 内详占药、占医、治病、用药、往医、行道六问
yi: 里面详细讲六个问题：占药、占医、治病、用药、往医、行道。
en: The chapter treats in detail six questions: divining the medicine, divining the doctor, treating the illness, using the medicine, going to treat, and the doctor's practice.

title: 子官强弱定药效：无子药不良、强官病不治；子强官弱如烈日销冰、子弱官强如铅刀攻玉；财动鬼静子动无功；伏鬼根不除、化鬼病传变、空鬼药老；世鬼病曲折、应鬼药跷蹊

rule.yi: 卦里没有子孙，药就不好；官鬼强，病就治不好。子孙强、官鬼弱，像烈日融冰；子孙弱、官鬼强，像用铅刀去攻玉。财爻动、鬼爻静，子孙动，都没有功效。鬼伏着，病根拔不掉；变出鬼，病会传变；鬼落空，药就是「老」药。鬼临世爻而兴旺，我的病就曲折反复；鬼临应爻而旺相，那副药就古怪蹊跷。注说：要审察子孙和官鬼的强弱，鬼当值日、月时，即使子孙得到生扶也不算完全好，要比较子孙能不能制住鬼，才是吉占；鬼落空是躲开了子孙，药打不中病，所以叫「老」；鬼在世，病难很快好，鬼在应，医生诡诈难信。
rule.en: Without Output the medicine is not good, and with a strong Pressure line the illness cannot be cured. Output strong and Pressure weak is a fierce sun melting ice; Output weak and Pressure strong is a lead knife attacking jade. With Wealth moving and the ghost still, or Output moving, there is no effect. A hidden ghost means the root is not removed; a change into a ghost means the illness passes on and changes; a Void ghost makes the medicine 'aged'. A ghost thriving on the Self makes my illness twist and turn, and a ghost strong on the Other makes that medicine dubious. The note says: one must examine the strength of Output and Pressure; when the ghost is on duty in the Day or Month, even if Output meets generation and support it is not wholly good, and one must compare whether Output can subdue the ghost before it is an auspicious divination; a Void ghost evades Output and so the medicine does not hit the illness, hence 'aged'; a ghost on the Self means the illness is hard to cure quickly, and a ghost on the Other means the doctor is deceitful and hard to trust.

note.yi: 经文里的「老医药」，注说是「鬼空避子，药不中病，故云老也」：「老」是指药不对症，像一味放老了的药。「财动鬼静，子动无功」这一句原文不带说明，注也没解；字面是财爻动、鬼爻静、子孙动的时候没有功效，和上一句「子强官弱」并不矛盾——财动是在生鬼（或冲克父母），子孙即使动，制鬼的力气也被财爻的生助抵掉了，这是推的，书里没有写。「传（转？）变」的「转？」是转录者自己标的疑字，这里照录，没有改。这一条与黄金策医药章「官旺福衰药饵轻而病重」（LY.ILL.HJC.61）、「福化忌爻误服杀身之恶剂」（HJC.66）是同一路读法。
note.en: For the text's 'aged medicine', the note says a Void ghost evades Output and the medicine does not hit the illness, hence it is called aged: 'aged' means the medicine does not fit the illness, like a herb left to go stale. The sentence 'Wealth moving, the ghost still, Output moving: no effect' comes without comment in the text and the note does not explain it; literally it says there is no effect when Wealth moves, the ghost is still and Output moves, and this does not conflict with 'Output strong and Pressure weak' just before, since Wealth moving feeds the ghost (or clashes the Resource line) and even a moving Output has its strength against the ghost cancelled by the Wealth's support, but this is inferred and not written in the book. The 'transforms?' after 'passes on' is the transcriber's own mark of doubt and is copied as it stands. This entry reads in the same way as the Huangjin Ce's medicine chapter, 'Pressure strong and Output weak, the medicine light and the illness heavy' (LY.ILL.HJC.61) and 'Output changing into an Adversary line, a bad draught that kills' (HJC.66).

zh: 无子而药不良，强官而病不治；
子强官弱，烈日销冰，子弱官强，铅刀攻玉，财动鬼静，子动无功也。
伏鬼根不除，化鬼病传（转？）变，空鬼老医药。
世鬼兴隆，则吾病曲折，应鬼旺相，则彼药跷蹊。
yi: 卦里没有子孙，药就不好；官鬼强，病就治不好；
子孙强、官鬼弱，像烈日融冰；子孙弱、官鬼强，像用铅刀去攻玉；财爻动、鬼爻静，子孙动，都没有功效。
鬼伏着，病根拔不掉；变出鬼，病会传变（「传」字后面转录者标了「转？」）；鬼落空，药就是「老」药。
鬼临世爻而兴旺，我的病就曲折反复；鬼临应爻而旺相，那副药就古怪蹊跷。
en: Without Output the medicine is not good, and with a strong Pressure line the illness cannot be cured;

Output strong and Pressure weak is a fierce sun melting ice; Output weak and Pressure strong is a lead knife attacking jade; with Wealth moving and the ghost still, or Output moving, there is no effect.

A hidden ghost means the root is not removed; a change into a ghost means the illness passes on and changes (the transcription marks 'transforms?' after 'passes on'); a Void ghost makes the medicine 'aged'.
A ghost thriving on the Self makes my illness twist and turn; a ghost strong on the Other makes that medicine queer and dubious.

zh: 当审子官强弱，如鬼值日月，虽子遇生扶，亦未尽善，必较子可服鬼，方是吉占。
鬼空避子，药不中病，故云老也。
世鬼病难速愈，应鬼医诈难信。
yi: 应当审察子孙和官鬼的强弱：如果鬼当值日、月，即使子孙得到生扶，也不算完全好，一定要比较子孙能不能制住鬼，才是吉占。
鬼落空是躲开了子孙，药打不中病，所以说「老」。
鬼在世爻，病很难快好；鬼在应爻，医生诡诈，难以相信。
en: One must examine the strength of Output and Pressure: if the ghost is on duty in the Day or Month, even though Output meets generation and support it is not wholly good; one must compare whether Output can subdue the ghost, and only then is it an auspicious divination.
A Void ghost evades Output, so the medicine does not hit the illness, hence it is called 'aged'.
A ghost on the Self, the illness is hard to cure quickly; a ghost on the Other, the doctor is deceitful and hard to trust.

title: 应指医人、非占克效：应空不得遇、应破不得专、应散识见反惑、应克世好利多诈、世应冲绝续不终

rule.yi: 应爻指的是医生，不是拿来占能不能克住病的：所以应落空，遇不上这个医生；应被冲破，医生不专心；应散，医生的见识反倒糊涂；应克世，医生爱财、多诈；世应相冲，治疗断断续续，做不到底。
rule.en: The Other stands for the doctor, and is not for divining whether the illness will be overcome: so with the Other Void, one cannot meet this doctor; broken, the doctor is not devoted; scattered, his insight is confused instead; the Other controlling the Self, the doctor loves profit and is full of deceit; Self and Other clashing, the treatment breaks off and is not carried to the end.

note.yi: 这一条把医生和药分开：药看子孙（LY.ILL.YM.34、YM.35），医生看应爻；问药灵不灵不取应，问医生可不可信不取子孙。黄金策同样以应爻为医人（LY.ILL.HJC.58、HJC.62），增删卜易也以应爻为医人，应爻不宜空破墓绝（LY.ILL.ZS.29）。「绝续不终」的「绝续」指治疗断了又续，始终不能了结。
note.en: This entry separates the doctor from the medicine: the medicine is read from Output (LY.ILL.YM.34, YM.35) and the doctor from the Other line; to ask whether a medicine works one does not take the Other, and to ask whether the doctor can be trusted one does not take Output. The Huangjin Ce likewise takes the Other as the doctor (LY.ILL.HJC.58, HJC.62), and the Zengshan Buyi also takes the Other as the doctor, who should not be Void, broken, in a tomb or in Extinction (LY.ILL.ZS.29). 'Breaks off and does not last to the end' means the treatment stops and resumes but is never concluded.

zh: 夫应指医人，非占克效，是故应空不得遇，应破不得专，应散则识见反惑，应克世则好利多诈，世应冲则绝续不终也。
yi: 应爻指的是医生，不是拿来占克住病的效验的，所以应落空，遇不上；应被冲破，医生不专心；应散，识见反倒糊涂；应克世，爱财、多诈；世应相冲，治疗断断续续，做不到底。
en: The Other stands for the doctor, and is not for divining the efficacy of overcoming the illness; therefore, with the Other Void, one cannot meet him; broken, he cannot be devoted; scattered, his insight is instead confused; the Other controlling the Self, he loves profit and is full of deceit; Self and Other clashing, the treatment breaks off and does not last to the end.

title: 占药占医取象：水子旺宜汤、土子旺宜丸、火灸金针木末；火鬼喜凉药、木鬼喜风药、土脾金肺水肾；占医考子孙之属，木东金西乾僧坤妇——注：子为药鬼为病，象只用来问何药何人，问吉凶仍看子孙衰旺

rule.yi: 占药：水属的子孙旺，宜用汤剂；土属的子孙旺，宜用丸药；火像艾灸，金像针，木像药末，以这些作象。火鬼喜欢凉药，木鬼喜欢祛风的药；土对应脾，金对应肺，水对应肾，也以这些作象。占医生：要考察子孙属于哪一类，木属东、金属西，乾是僧人、坤是妇人，也以这些作象。注说：子孙是药，鬼是病，占该用什么药、是什么病，就用这个办法；如果占的是这味药吉不吉，就看子孙的衰旺，不要死板地认为子孙属土就该用丸药。占该请哪个方位、哪种人当医生，也是这个办法；单独占医生好不好，还是用子孙的强弱，比如问请僧人当医生，得乾卦而子孙落空，怎么能说吉？
rule.en: Divining medicine: a strong Water Output suits a decoction, a strong Earth Output suits pills; Fire is moxibustion, Metal needles, Wood powders, taken as the images. A Fire ghost likes cooling medicine and a Wood ghost likes wind medicine; Earth is the spleen, Metal the lung and Water the kidney, also taken as images. Divining the doctor: examine what kind the Output belongs to; Wood is east and Metal west, Qian a monk and Kun a woman, again taken as images. The note says: Output is the medicine and the ghost is the illness, and to divine which medicine to use or what the illness is, use this method; but if what is divined is whether a medicine is auspicious, use the strength of Output, and do not rigidly hold that an Earth Output must mean pills. To divine which direction and which kind of person to use as doctor the method is the same; but to divine on its own whether the doctor is good, still use the strength of Output: for instance, if one asks about a monk-doctor and obtains Qian with Output Void, how could one call it auspicious?

dispute.yi: 用药要不要按五行来配：易冒把「水子旺宜汤、土子旺宜丸、火灸金针木末」「火鬼喜凉药、木鬼喜风药」当作象，但注马上限定，象只用来问「用何药、是何病」，问吉凶还是看子孙衰旺，不要认死「子孙属土就用丸药」；黄金策旧注、王洪绪和易隐把五行当作用药的依据（火鬼旺用大寒药、水鬼旺用大热药、金鬼宜灸、木鬼宜针，见 LY.ILL.HJC.76、HJC.81、HJC.84、YY.25）；增删卜易的李我平则批评这类说法拘泥，说子孙不是针灸之药、火鬼旺不一定该用大寒药（LY.ILL.ZS.40）。易冒站在中间：象可以用，但不作凭据。
dispute.en: Whether medicine should be matched by the phases: the Yi Mao takes 'a strong Water Output suits a decoction, an Earth Output pills, Fire moxibustion, Metal needles, Wood powders' and 'a Fire ghost likes cooling medicine, a Wood ghost wind medicine' as images, but the note at once limits them: images are used only for 'which medicine to use and what the illness is', while for whether it is auspicious one still reads the strength of Output and should not hold rigidly that 'an Earth Output means pills'; the old commentary and Wang Hongxu on the Huangjin Ce and the Yi Yin take the phases as the ground for the choice of medicine (a strong Fire ghost takes a very cold medicine, a strong Water ghost a very hot one, a Metal ghost moxibustion, a Wood ghost needles; see LY.ILL.HJC.76, HJC.81, HJC.84, YY.25); Li Woping of the Zengshan Buyi criticises such sayings as rigid, saying Output is not a medicine for needles and moxibustion and that a strong Fire ghost does not necessarily call for a very cold medicine (LY.ILL.ZS.40). The Yi Mao stands in the middle: the images may be used, but not as the ground.

note.yi: 「四败」是十二长生里的沐浴：金败在午、木败在子、火败在卯、水土败在酉（见卜筮大全，沐浴即四败）；例中辛酉日，土的败正在酉，所以说逢四败。「真空」在易冒旬空章里指被月建克住的那种空（春天的土、夏天的金、秋天的木、冬天的火，以及辰戌丑未月里的水），卯月里的未土正是春土，所以叫真空。「以为像」的「像」就是象。
note.en: 'The four Defeats' is Bath in the twelve life stages: Metal's Defeat is at Wu, Wood's at Zi, Fire's at Mao, and Water's and Earth's at You (see the Bushi Daquan, where Bath is the four Defeats); in the case the day is Xinyou, and Earth's Defeat is exactly at You, hence 'meets the four Defeats'. 'True Void' in the Yi Mao's chapter on Void means the Void of a line controlled by the Month (Earth in spring, Metal in summer, Wood in autumn, Fire in winter, and Water in the Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei months), and the Wei Earth in a Mao month is spring Earth, hence 'truly Void'. The 'xiang' in 'taken as images' is the image.

zh: 占药水子旺宜汤，土子旺宜丸，火灸、金针、木末、以为像。
火鬼喜凉药，木鬼喜风药，土脾、金肺、水肾，以为像。
占医也，考子孙之属，木东金西，乾僧坤妇，以为像。
yi: 占药：水属的子孙旺，宜用汤剂；土属的子孙旺，宜用丸药；火像艾灸，金像针，木像药末，以这些作象。
火鬼喜欢凉药，木鬼喜欢祛风的药；土对应脾，金对应肺，水对应肾，也以这些作象。
占医生，要考察子孙属于哪一类：木属东、金属西，乾是僧人、坤是妇人，以此作象。
en: In divining medicine: a strong Water Output suits a decoction, a strong Earth Output suits pills; Fire is moxibustion, Metal needles, Wood powders: these are the images.
A Fire ghost likes cooling medicine and a Wood ghost likes wind medicine; Earth is the spleen, Metal the lung and Water the kidney: these are the images.
In divining the doctor, examine what the Output belongs to: Wood is east and Metal west, Qian a monk and Kun a woman: these are the images.

zh: 子为药而鬼为病，卜用何药，卜是何病，则用此法，若卜是药吉凶，用子孙衰旺，无执子孙属土，宜用丸药。
如卯建辛酉日，占医得离之贲，未土子爻，真空四败，焉能丸药有功？
卜筮宜用何方何人，则用此法，若独占则用子孙，设问僧医，得乾而子空，岂可言吉？
yi: 子孙是药，鬼是病。占该用什么药、占是什么病，就用这个办法；如果占的是这味药吉不吉，就看子孙的衰旺，不要死板地认为子孙属土就该用丸药。
比如卯月辛酉日，占医生，得离卦变贲卦，未土子爻，是真空，又逢四败，怎么能说丸药有功效？
占该请哪个方位、哪种人当医生，就用这个办法；如果单独占医生好不好，就用子孙，假如问请僧人当医生，得乾卦而子孙落空，怎么能说吉？
en: Output is the medicine and the ghost is the illness. To divine which medicine to use, or what illness it is, use this method; but if what is divined is whether a medicine is auspicious, use the strength of Output, and do not rigidly hold that an Earth Output must mean pills.

For example, in a Mao month on a Xinyou day, a doctor was divined and Li changing into Bi (Adornment) was obtained; the Wei Earth Output was truly Void and met the four Defeats; how could pills be effective?

To divine which direction or which kind of person to use, apply this method; but if it is divined on its own, use Output: suppose one asks about a monk-doctor and obtains Qian with Output Void, how could one call it auspicious?

title: 医问疾可疗乎：以应为先务（应为病人），应坏、随墓则其病不治；若占六亲仍以用神为断

rule.yi: 医生问这个病能不能治，先看应爻，因为对医生来说应爻就是病人；应爻坏了、或随墓，这个病就治不好。如果占的是病人的某个亲属，仍然以用神来断。
rule.en: When a doctor asks whether an illness can be treated, the Other line comes first, for to him the Other is the patient; if the Other is spoiled or follows into the tomb, the illness cannot be cured. If what is divined is one of the patient's relations, judgment still goes by the Subject.

note.yi: 医生自己占的时候，对方（应）就是病人，所以头一个要看的是应爻；这和病家占病取世（自己）或取用神不同。「若占六亲」是说医生受托问的其实是病人的某个亲属，这时不再取应，回到用神。这是治病问的。
note.en: When the doctor himself divines, the other party (the Other) is the patient, so the first thing to read is the Other line; this differs from the patient's family, who take the Self (oneself) or the Subject. 'If what is divined is a relation' means the doctor is in fact asked about one of the patient's relations, and then the Other is no longer taken and judgment returns to the Subject. This entry answers the question of treating the illness.

zh: 医问疾可疗乎，以应为先务，盖应为病人，应坏随墓，其病不治；
若占六亲，仍以用神为断。
yi: 医生问这个病能不能治，先看应爻，因为对医生来说应爻就是病人，应爻坏了、随墓，这个病就治不好；
如果占的是病人的某个亲属，仍然以用神来断。
en: When a doctor asks whether an illness can be treated, the Other comes first, for to him the Other is the patient; if the Other is spoiled or follows into the tomb, the illness cannot be cured;
if what is divined is one of the patient's relations, judgment still goes by the Subject.

title: 医问是药奏功乎：亦以子孙为用，福强鬼弱而奏效、子虚鬼实而无功（与占药同）

rule.yi: 医生问这味药能不能奏效，也是拿子孙爻当用：子孙强、鬼弱，药就见效；子孙虚、鬼实，药就没有功效。注说：和占药一样。
rule.en: When a doctor asks whether a medicine will take effect, Output is again the line to use: with Output strong and the ghost weak it takes effect, and with Output empty and the ghost full it has no effect. The note says: it is the same as divining medicine.

note.yi: 这一条是用药问：医生已经开了某味药，问它灵不灵，取子孙的强弱，和病家占药一样（见 LY.ILL.YM.35、YM.37）。「福强鬼弱」的「福」是子孙，「子虚鬼实」的「虚」「实」用的是上面 LY.ILL.YM.31 里的意思：空破散绝叫虚，旺相有生扶叫实。
note.en: This entry is the question of using the medicine: the doctor has settled on a certain medicine and asks whether it will work, and takes the strength of Output, as the patient's family does in divining medicine (see LY.ILL.YM.35, YM.37). The 'fortune' in 'fortune strong, ghost weak' is Output, and 'empty' and 'full' in 'Output empty, ghost full' are used in the sense given in LY.ILL.YM.31 above: Void, broken, scattered or in Extinction is empty, and thriving and strong with generation and support is full.

zh: 医问是药奏功乎，亦以子孙为用，福强鬼弱而奏效也，子虚鬼实而无功。
yi: 医生问这味药能不能奏效，也是以子孙为用：子孙强、鬼弱，药就见效；子孙虚、鬼实，药就没有功效。
en: When a doctor asks whether a medicine will take effect, Output is again the line to use: with Output strong and the ghost weak it takes effect, and with Output empty and the ghost full it has no effect.

yi: 也和占药一样。
en: It is the same as divining medicine.

title: 医问往医利乎：以世应推——应克世者寡情、爻无财者薄赠、空有欺志、破无专心、散冲无终

rule.yi: 医生问上门去治病有没有利，就从世、应来推：应克世的，病家没有情义；卦里没有财爻的，酬谢微薄；落空的，有欺骗的心思；冲破的，没有专心；散了、冲了的，不会有个结果。
rule.en: When a doctor asks whether going to treat will be profitable, judge by the Self and the Other: the Other controlling the Self means little feeling; a hexagram with no Wealth line means a meagre gift; Void means an intent to deceive; broken, no wholehearted devotion; scattered or clashed, no end.

note.yi: 原文里「空有欺志，破无专心，散、冲无终」没有说是谁的空、破、散、冲；按上文「以世应而推」，这里译作世、应落空、冲破、散、冲时的情形，没有替它加主语。这是医生问的第三种（往医）。
note.en: The original does not say whose Void, breaking, scattering or clash it is in 'Void has intent to deceive, broken has no devotion, scattered or clashed has no end'; following 'judge by the Self and the Other' just before, it is rendered as the case when the Self and Other are Void, broken, scattered or clashed, and no subject has been added. This is the third of the doctor's questions (going to treat).

zh: 医问往医利乎，则以世应而推，应克世者寡情，爻无财者薄赠，空有欺志，破无专心，散、冲无终。
yi: 医生问上门去治病有没有利，就从世、应来推：应克世的，病家没有情义；卦里没有财爻的，酬谢微薄；落空的，有欺骗的心思；冲破的，没有专心；散了、冲了的，不会有个结果。
en: When a doctor asks whether going to treat will be profitable, judge by the Self and the Other: the Other controlling the Self means little feeling; a hexagram with no Wealth line means a meagre gift; Void means an intent to deceive; broken, no wholehearted devotion; scattered or clashed, no end.

title: 医问道行：财官强而利名遂；医药不精不足以利物、求医不慎不足以疗生，己弗误人亦弗自误

rule.yi: 医生问自己行医的前程：财爻、官爻强，名和利就能遂愿。所以医术不精，不足以造福万物；求医不谨慎，不足以救人性命；自己不耽误别人，也不耽误自己。
rule.en: When a doctor asks about the course of his practice, if the Wealth and Pressure lines are strong, profit and fame are achieved. So medicine that is not refined cannot benefit things, and seeking a doctor without care cannot heal life; if one does not mislead others, one does not mislead oneself.

note.yi: 「财官强而利名遂」是本条唯一的断法：财主利，官主名。后半句「故医药不精……」是章末的劝诫，对医生也对病家说：医生的技术不精，不能救人；病家选医生不小心，也救不了命。「财官」这里是财爻和官爻，原文没有写「妻财」「官鬼」，但意思相同。
note.en: 'Wealth and Pressure strong, profit and fame are achieved' is the only judgment in this entry: Wealth governs profit and Pressure governs fame. The second half, 'so medicine that is not refined...', is the chapter's closing admonition, addressed to the doctor and to the patient's family alike: a doctor whose skill is poor cannot save a life, and a family that chooses a doctor carelessly cannot save it either. 'Wealth and Pressure' here are the Wealth line and the Pressure line, written without 'wife-wealth' or 'official-ghost' but meaning the same.

zh: 医问道行，财官强而利名遂，故医药不精，不足以利物，求医不慎，不足以疗生，己弗误人，亦弗自误也。
yi: 医生问行医的前程，财爻、官爻强，名和利就能遂愿；所以医术不精，不足以造福万物，求医不谨慎，不足以救人性命，自己不耽误别人，也不耽误自己。
en: When a doctor asks about the course of his practice, if the Wealth and Pressure lines are strong, profit and fame are achieved; therefore, medicine that is not refined cannot benefit things, and seeking a doctor without care cannot heal life; if one does not mislead others, one does not mislead oneself.

title: 鬼神章总纲：欲知鬼神情状亦以筮而得之；天神地祗以官鬼类其象，不外二仪四象五行八卦及六神诸星；索鬼神之性（生前偏好）、司（上帝命司何事）、成（何因缘而成）

rule.yi: 古时候的祭祀，不是那位神的主祭人就不当「尸」，不是鬼的同类就不享用祭品，所以没有越位的祭祀、没有轻慢的祭祀。后来的人有祟就做禳解、求福就去祈祷，鬼神的名目就多起来了；虽然这样，吉事有神帮忙，凶事有鬼凭依，史书传记里记的，并不全是虚妄。想知道鬼神的情形，也可以用占筮得到。天神地祇，就用官鬼来归类它的象；取象、画出它的样子，离不开两仪、四象、五行、八卦，再加上六神、诸星来给它成形，用有无来衡量，用上下来定位。探求这位鬼神的性情、所掌管的事，以及它怎么成为鬼神的，就可以推断了。注解释这三样：「性」是生前偏爱的性情，「司」是上帝命它掌管什么事，「成」是因为什么缘由成为鬼神。
rule.en: In the sacrifices of old, one who was not the rightful master did not stand as the impersonator, and a ghost did not savour what was not of its kind, so there were no sacrifices beyond one's station and no profane offerings. Later ages exorcised when there was a haunting and prayed for blessing, and so ghosts and spirits multiplied; even so, good fortune has spirits to help and misfortune has ghosts to possess, and what the histories and traditions record is not all false. To learn the state of ghosts and spirits, this too can be obtained by divination. For heavenly spirits and earthly deities, the image is classified by the Pressure line; the image is taken and drawn, and it does not go beyond the two modes, the four images, the five phases and the eight trigrams, together with the six spirits and the various stars to give it form, presence or absence to measure it, and above or below to place it. Seek the nature of the ghost or spirit, what it governs, and how it came to be one, and it can be worked out. The note explains the three: 'nature' is the disposition it favoured in life, 'what it governs' is what the Supreme Lord appointed it to govern, and 'how it came to be' is by what cause it became a ghost or spirit.

note.yi: 「尸」是祭祀时代表神或亡者接受祭品的人。「二仪」指阴阳，「四象」是老阳、少阴、少阳、老阴一类的四象。这一章通篇的办法在这里立好了：鬼神只由官鬼爻来看，看的方法有五行、八卦（宫）、六神、诸星、六爻、六亲、十二支；要探的有三样，性、司、成，后面「金木水火土」各有一段，把这三样分开说。开头几句里作者的态度是，鬼神不是全然虚妄的，但也不主张一味祭祀，这一点到章末（LY.ILL.YM.63、YM.64）才收拢。
note.en: The 'impersonator' (shi) is the person who stands for the god or the dead in a sacrifice and receives the offerings. The 'two modes' are yin and yang, and the 'four images' are the four of old yang, young yin, young yang and old yin. The method of the whole chapter is set up here: ghosts and spirits are read only from the Pressure line, by the five phases, the eight trigrams (palaces), the six spirits, the stars, the six lines, the six relations and the twelve branches; there are three things to seek, nature, charge and origin, and the later paragraphs on Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth each speak of these three separately. In the opening lines the author's attitude is that ghosts and spirits are not wholly false, but he does not urge sacrifice on every occasion, and this is only drawn together at the end of the chapter (LY.ILL.YM.63, YM.64).

zh: 古之祀祭，非其主不尸，鬼非其类不馨，故无越祭、无渎祀也。
后世乃以有祟而禳福而祈者，而鬼神繁兴矣，虽然，吉有神相，凶有鬼凭，史传所载，非尽诬也。
欲知鬼神情状，则亦以筮而得之。
yi: 古时候的祭祀，不是那位神的主祭人就不当「尸」，不是鬼的同类就不享用祭品的香气，所以没有越位的祭祀、没有轻慢的祭祀。
后来的人因为有祟就做禳解、为求福就去祈祷，鬼神的名目就多起来了；虽然这样，吉事有神在帮忙，凶事有鬼在凭依，史书传记里记的，并不全是虚妄。
想知道鬼神是什么情形，也可以用占筮得到。
en: In the sacrifices of old, one who was not the rightful master did not stand as the impersonator, and a ghost did not savour what was not of its kind, so there were no sacrifices beyond one's station and no profane offerings.

Later ages exorcised when there was a haunting and prayed for blessing, and so ghosts and spirits multiplied; even so, good fortune has spirits to help and misfortune has ghosts to possess, and what the histories and traditions record is not all false.
To learn the state of ghosts and spirits, this too can be obtained by divination.

zh: 夫天神地祗，则以官鬼而类其象，象而像之，其不外乎二仪、四象、五行、八卦，及六神、诸星以形之，有无以度之，上下以位之。
yi: 天神地祇，就用官鬼来归类它的象；取象、画出它的样子，离不开两仪、四象、五行、八卦，再加上六神、诸星来给它成形，用有无来衡量它，用上下来定它的位置。
en: For heavenly spirits and earthly deities, the image is classified by the Pressure line; the image is taken and drawn, and it does not go beyond the two modes, the four images, the five phases and the eight trigrams, together with the six spirits and the various stars to give it form, presence or absence to measure it, and above or below to place it.

zh: 索其鬼神之性，鬼神之司，及鬼神所由成，而可推矣。
yi: 探求这位鬼神的性情、所掌管的事，以及它是怎么成为鬼神的，就可以推断了。
en: Seek the nature of the ghost or spirit, what it governs, and how it came to be one, and it can be worked out.

zh: 性，索其鬼神生前偏好之性；
司，索其鬼神上帝命司何事；
成，索其以何因缘而成鬼神也。
yi: 「性」，是探求这位鬼神生前偏爱的性情；
「司」，是探求上帝命这位鬼神掌管什么事；
「成」，是探求它因为什么缘由成为鬼神。
en: 'Nature' is seeking the disposition the ghost or spirit favoured in life;
'what it governs' is seeking what the Supreme Lord appointed the ghost or spirit to govern;
'how it came to be' is seeking by what cause and condition it became a ghost or spirit.

title: 官鬼属阳则阳神、属阴则阴神：阴神如王母、大悲、水母、太山、天妃、蚕母、子母、催生、太君娘娘之属，要因地（同神异名）、因神（男女）、因事（问蚕得阴官乃蚕母）而考

rule.yi: 官鬼爻属阳的，就是阳神；属阴的，就是阴神。属阴的官鬼，像王母、大悲、水母、太山、天妃、陈周、圣妃、蚕母、子母、催生、太君、娘娘这一类，也应当按地方、按人、按事去考察，这里只是举个大概。因为有的神是同一位而名字不同，这叫因地，比如在北方叫子母娘娘，在南方叫太君娘娘；男女有别叫因神，为什么事叫因事，比如问蚕的事，得到阴的官鬼，就是蚕母。
rule.en: A Pressure line that is yang is a yang spirit, and one that is yin is a yin spirit. Where the Pressure line is yin, as with the Queen Mother, the Great Compassionate, the Water Mother, Taishan, the Heavenly Consort, Chen and Zhou, the Holy Consort, the Silkworm Mother, the Child Mother, the Birth Hastener, the Grand Lady and the Ladies, one should also examine by place, by person and by matter; this only gives an outline. For there are spirits who are the same but named differently, which is 'by place': in the north she is the Lady of Child and Mother, in the south the Lady Grand Dame. Difference of man and woman is 'by spirit', and what the matter is about is 'by matter': for instance, when asking about silkworms, a yin Pressure line is the Silkworm Mother.

dispute.yi: 阴阳是分「神」和「鬼」，还是分男神女神：易冒说官鬼属阳是阳神、属阴是阴神，举的阴神是王母、天妃、蚕母这些女神，阴的仍是神，不是鬼；易隐说「阳鬼为神、阴官为鬼」，卜筮正宗的王洪绪说「阳为神为男，阴为鬼为女」（LY.ILL.YY.27、LY.ILL.HJC.94），阴就是鬼；黄金策旧注和增删卜易的觉子则按旺衰分，旺相是神、休囚是鬼（LY.ILL.HJC.94、LY.ILL.ZS.23）。易冒在这里分的是阳神和阴神，神与鬼另在后面「生前之性」几段里分（LY.ILL.YM.49 起）。
dispute.en: Whether yin and yang divide 'spirit' from 'ghost' or male deity from female: the Yi Mao says a yang Pressure line is a yang spirit and a yin one a yin spirit, and its yin examples are goddesses such as the Queen Mother, the Heavenly Consort and the Silkworm Mother, so yin is still a spirit and not a ghost; the Yi Yin says 'a yang ghost is a spirit, a yin Pressure is a ghost', and Wang Hongxu of the Bushi Zhengzong says 'yang is a spirit and male, yin is a ghost and female' (LY.ILL.YY.27, LY.ILL.HJC.94), so yin is a ghost; the old commentary on the Huangjin Ce and Jue Zi of the Zengshan Buyi divide by strength, strong being a spirit and resting or trapped a ghost (LY.ILL.HJC.94, LY.ILL.ZS.23). The Yi Mao here divides yang spirits from yin spirits, and divides spirit from ghost later, in the paragraphs on how each was in life (from LY.ILL.YM.49).

note.yi: 这一份名单里的神名，书里一个也没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定；「大悲」「太山」「陈周」也是照字面写。「因地、因神、因事」三样是考察同一位神的三个角度：同神异名靠地方分，男女靠神分，要问什么事靠事分。
note.en: Names of gods and goddesses in the lists are given by transliteration or by a plain rendering; the book does not explain any of them, and none is identified here beyond what the book says. 'Great Compassionate', 'Taishan' and 'Chen and Zhou' are likewise written as they stand. 'By place, by spirit, by matter' are three angles from which to examine the same deity: the same deity under different names is told by place, male and female by the spirit, and what is being asked by the matter.

zh: 夫官鬼之爻属阳，则阳神也，属阴，则阴神也。
yi: 官鬼爻属阳的，就是阳神；属阴的，就是阴神。
en: A Pressure line that is yang is a yang spirit, and one that is yin is a yin spirit.

zh: 官鬼属阴，如王母、大悲、水母、太山、天妃、陈周、圣妃、蚕母、子母、催生、太君、娘娘之属，亦当因地、因人、因事而考之，此则举其略尔。
盖有神同而名异，曰因地，如在北为子母娘娘，在南为太君娘娘；
男女相别曰因神，为何事曰因事，如问蚕，得阴官乃蚕母也。
yi: 官鬼属阴的，像王母、大悲、水母、太山、天妃、陈周、圣妃、蚕母、子母、催生、太君、娘娘这一类，也应当按地方、按人、按事去考察，这里只是举个大概。
因为有的神是同一位而名字不同，这叫因地，比如在北方叫子母娘娘，在南方叫太君娘娘；
男女有别叫因神，为什么事叫因事，比如问蚕的事，得到阴的官鬼，就是蚕母。
en: Where the Pressure line is yin, as with the Queen Mother, the Great Compassionate, the Water Mother, Taishan, the Heavenly Consort, Chen and Zhou, the Holy Consort, the Silkworm Mother, the Child Mother, the Birth Hastener, the Grand Lady and the Ladies, one should also examine by place, by person and by matter; this only gives an outline.
For there are spirits who are the same but named differently, which is 'by place': in the north she is the Lady of Child and Mother, in the south the Lady Grand Dame;
difference of man and woman is 'by spirit', and what the matter is about is 'by matter': for instance, when asking about silkworms, a yin Pressure line is the Silkworm Mother.

title: 官鬼属金则武神：天将、关帝、伍公、岳王、玄坛、总官、七煞、金刚、伤司、丧煞之属，及称元帅将军金甲神、威武斗勇成神者

rule.yi: 官鬼属金的，就是武神。像天将、关帝、伍公、岳王、玄坛、总官、七煞、金刚、伤司、丧煞这一类；有的地方称作元帅、将军、金甲神的，以及靠威武善斗成了神的，都可以类推。
rule.en: If the Pressure line is Metal, it is a martial spirit, as with the Heavenly Generals, Emperor Guan, Lord Wu, Prince Yue, the Dark Altar, the Chief Official, the Seven Killings, the Vajra, the Injuring Office and the Mourning Killing; and those locally called marshals, generals and golden-armoured spirits, and those who became spirits by martial might and fighting courage, can all be reasoned by analogy.

dispute.yi: 要不要把金鬼指成关帝、岳王这样的具体某位神：易冒举天将、关帝、伍公、岳王等作例子，但同一章的末尾说「必实指鬼神而泥之则诬」（LY.ILL.YM.63）；增删卜易的李我平点名批评《易冒》指定关岳（LY.ILL.ZS.25），觉子也认为金官指为关公岳公等武神不对，武神有封有未封、各地不同，要问病人许愿未酬的是哪座庙（LY.ILL.ZS.24）。易冒自己也只把这些当作例子，不当作定论。
dispute.en: Whether a Metal ghost should be pinned to a particular god such as Emperor Guan or Prince Yue: the Yi Mao gives the Heavenly Generals, Emperor Guan, Lord Wu, Prince Yue and the rest as examples, but at the end of the same chapter says 'to point insistently at a particular ghost or spirit and cling to it is to make a false claim' (LY.ILL.YM.63); Li Woping of the Zengshan Buyi names the Yi Mao in criticising the pinning to Guan and Yue (LY.ILL.ZS.25), and Jue Zi also holds that calling a Metal Pressure line Guan Gong or Yue Gong is wrong, since martial spirits are enfeoffed or not and differ from place to place, and one should ask which temple the patient vowed to without redeeming (LY.ILL.ZS.24). The Yi Mao itself takes these only as examples, not as conclusions.

note.yi: 「元坛」是「玄坛」避讳的写法，下面属火那一条里也有。这份名单里的神名，书里一个也没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。「方隅有称元帅将军金甲之神」是说各地方对武神的称呼不同，按当地的称呼归到金里。
note.en: 'Yuan Altar' is the taboo-avoiding form of 'Xuan Altar' (the Dark Altar), and appears again in the Fire list below. Names of gods and goddesses in the lists are given by transliteration or by a plain rendering; the book does not explain any of them, and none is identified here beyond what the book says. 'Locally called marshals, generals and golden-armoured spirits' means that the names given to martial spirits differ from place to place, and whatever the local name, it is filed under Metal.

yi: 属金的，就是武神。
en: If it is Metal, it is a martial spirit.

zh: 官鬼属金，如天将、关帝、伍公、岳王、元坛、总官、七煞、金刚、伤司、丧煞之属，盖方隅有称元帅将军金甲之神，及威武斗勇成神者，皆可类推。
yi: 官鬼属金的，像天将、关帝、伍公、岳王、元坛、总官、七煞、金刚、伤司、丧煞这一类；有的地方称作元帅、将军、金甲神的，以及靠威武斗勇成了神的，都可以类推。
en: Where the Pressure line is Metal, as with the Heavenly Generals, Emperor Guan, Lord Wu, Prince Yue, the Dark Altar, the Chief Official, the Seven Killings, the Vajra, the Injuring Office and the Mourning Killing, and those locally called marshals, generals and golden-armoured spirits, and those who became spirits by martial might and fighting courage, all can be reasoned by analogy.

title: 官鬼属水则河海江神：普陀、真武、云台、北斗、海神、龙王、河神、大王、杨将、施相、天妃、晏公、祠山、周王、汪公、水母、井神池神之属；各方水神随占人之民俗土风，漕河尊大王、东海尊天妃、南河尊周王

rule.yi: 官鬼属水的，就是河、海、江的神。像普陀、真武、云台、北斗、海神、龙王、河神、大王、杨将、施相、天妃、晏公、祠山、周王、汪公、水母、水圣、井神、池神、水伤神这一类，以及因水而成神的，都可以类推。九河百川，各个地方各有掌管的神，百姓的尊称各不相同，要随着占卜人所在的民俗和风土，用五行八卦、六神诸星去取象，才算射中靶心。大体上水神、火神灵验显赫的多，没法一一细说，各地不一样：漕河尊大王，东海尊天妃，南河尊周王，洞庭尊湘妃，鄱阳是小姑，长江是杨四将军，各有各的分管。
rule.en: If the Pressure line is Water, it is the spirits of river, sea and great river, as with Putuo, Zhenwu, Yuntai, the Dipper, the Sea God, the Dragon King, the River God, the Great King, General Yang, Lord Shi, the Heavenly Consort, Lord Yan, Cishan, Prince Zhou, Lord Wang, the Water Mother, the Water Sage, the Well God, the Pond God and the water-wound spirits, and those who became spirits through water. For the nine rivers and the hundred streams each place has its own governing spirit, and the honorifics the common people give differ from place to place; following the customs and local ways of the one who divines, take the image by the five phases, the eight trigrams, the six spirits and the various stars, and one hits the mark. In general the spirits of water and fire are often powerfully manifest and cannot be set out in detail, differing from place to place: the grain-transport canal honours the Great King, the Eastern Sea the Heavenly Consort, the southern river Prince Zhou, Dongting the Xiang Consort, Poyang has the Little Aunt, and the Yangtze General Yang the Fourth, each with its own domain.

note.yi: 神名的处理见 LY.ILL.YM.44 的注。这一条比别的四行多讲了一点道理：各地的水神名号不同，要随占卜人所在的地方风俗去取象，不是拿一张名单去对。「射的」是射中靶心。
note.en: Names are treated as in the note to LY.ILL.YM.44. This entry gives more of a reason than the other four phases: the names of water spirits differ from region to region, so the image is to be taken according to the customs of the place of the one who divines, and not by matching against a list. 'Hits the mark' is hitting the bull's-eye.

yi: 属水的，就是河、海、江的神。
en: If it is Water, it is the spirits of river, sea and great river.

zh: 官鬼属水，如普陀、真武、云台、北斗、海神、龙王、河神、大王、杨将、施相、天妃、晏公、祠山、周王、汪公、水母、水圣、井神、池神、水伤神之属，及由水成神可类。
盖九河百川，方隅各有所司之神，黎庶尊称，各有相别，随占人之民俗土风，以五行八卦、六神诸星，象而像之，则射的矣。
大抵水火之神，灵显者多，无能细陈，方隅各异，犹若漕河尊大王，东海尊天妃，南河尊周王，洞庭尊湘妃，鄱阳小姑，长江杨四将军，各有所分也。
yi: 官鬼属水的，像普陀、真武、云台、北斗、海神、龙王、河神、大王、杨将、施相、天妃、晏公、祠山、周王、汪公、水母、水圣、井神、池神、水伤神这一类，以及因水而成神的，都可以类推。
九河百川，各个地方各有掌管的神，百姓的尊称各不相同，要随着占卜人所在的民俗和风土，用五行八卦、六神诸星去取象，这样才是射中靶心。
大体上水神、火神灵验显赫的多，没法一一细说，各地方不一样，比如漕河尊大王，东海尊天妃，南河尊周王，洞庭湖尊湘妃，鄱阳湖是小姑，长江是杨四将军，各有各的分管。
en: Where the Pressure line is Water, as with Putuo, Zhenwu, Yuntai, the Dipper, the Sea God, the Dragon King, the River God, the Great King, General Yang, Lord Shi, the Heavenly Consort, Lord Yan, Cishan, Prince Zhou, Lord Wang, the Water Mother, the Water Sage, the Well God, the Pond God and the water-wound spirits, and those who became spirits through water, all can be reasoned by analogy.

For the nine rivers and the hundred streams each place has its own governing spirit, and the honorifics the common people give differ from place to place; following the customs and local ways of the one who divines, take the image by the five phases, the eight trigrams, the six spirits and the various stars, and one hits the mark.

In general, the spirits of water and fire are often powerfully manifest, and cannot be set out in detail, differing from place to place: for instance, the grain-transport canal honours the Great King, the Eastern Sea honours the Heavenly Consort, the southern river honours Prince Zhou, Dongting honours the Xiang Consort, Poyang has the Little Aunt, and the Yangtze has General Yang the Fourth, each with its own domain.

title: 官鬼属木则文神及倚草附木之妖：东岳、家堂、山神、树神、五圣、园神、九良、茶筵、三茅、九天、鲁班、花神、三郎、道君、文昌、南木神之属，及凭依山木树木器皿成神者

rule.yi: 官鬼属木的，就是文神，以及依托在草木上的精怪。像东岳、家堂、山神、树神、五圣、园神、九良、茶筵、三茅、九天、鲁班、花神、三郎、道君、文昌、南木神这一类，以及各地有依附山木、树木、器皿而成神的，都可以类推。
rule.en: If the Pressure line is Wood, it is a civil spirit, and the demons that lean on grass and cling to trees, as with the Eastern Peak, the household shrine, the Mountain God, the Tree God, the Five Sages, the Garden God, the Nine Good Ones, the Tea Feast, the Three Mao, the Nine Heavens, Lu Ban, the Flower God, the Third Lord, the Daoist Lord, Wenchang and the Southern Wood God, and those places where a spirit has arisen from a mountain, a tree or a vessel it clings to; all can be reasoned by analogy.

note.yi: 神名的处理见 LY.ILL.YM.44 的注。「文神」和金的「武神」相对（LY.ILL.YM.44）：文昌、鲁班是文事、工艺的神，东岳、家堂、山神、树神是草木土地一类的神，都算木。
note.en: Names are treated as in the note to LY.ILL.YM.44. 'Civil spirit' is the counterpart of the Metal 'martial spirit' (LY.ILL.YM.44): Wenchang and Lu Ban are spirits of letters and crafts, and the Eastern Peak, the household shrine, the Mountain God and the Tree God are spirits of plants and land, all counted as Wood.

zh: 属木，则文神也，及倚草附木之妖也。
yi: 属木的，就是文神，以及依托在草木上的精怪。
en: If it is Wood, it is a civil spirit, and the demons that lean on grass and cling to trees.

zh: 官鬼属木，如东岳、家堂、山神、树神、五圣、园神、九良、茶筵、三茅、九天、鲁班、花神、三郎、道君、文昌、南木神之属，及方隅有凭依山木、树木、器皿成神者，皆可类推。
yi: 官鬼属木的，像东岳、家堂、山神、树神、五圣、园神、九良、茶筵、三茅、九天、鲁班、花神、三郎、道君、文昌、南木神这一类，以及各地有依附山木、树木、器皿而成神的，都可以类推。
en: Where the Pressure line is Wood, as with the Eastern Peak, the household shrine, the Mountain God, the Tree God, the Five Sages, the Garden God, the Nine Good Ones, the Tea Feast, the Three Mao, the Nine Heavens, Lu Ban, the Flower God, the Third Lord, the Daoist Lord, Wenchang and the Southern Wood God, and those places where a spirit has arisen from a mountain, a tree or a vessel it clings to, all can be reasoned by analogy.

title: 官鬼属火则火神、生育雷电之司：离神、电神、南斗、火雷、韦陀、玄坛、华光、五神、五赫、三煞、灶神、炉神、炮神、香火、南堂、利市、生育神之属，及由火成神者

rule.yi: 官鬼属火的，就是火神，是掌管生育、雷电的。像离神、电神、南斗、火雷、韦陀、元坛、华光、五神、五赫、三煞、灶神、旗纛（？）、炉神、炮神、香火、南堂、利市、生育神这一类，以及因火而成神的，都可以类推。
rule.en: If the Pressure line is Fire, it is a fire spirit, in charge of childbirth, thunder and lightning, as with the Li spirit, the Lightning God, the Southern Dipper, Fire and Thunder, Weituo, the Dark Altar, Huaguang, the Five Spirits, the Five Blazes, the Three Killings, the Kitchen God, the banner-standard (?), the Furnace God, the Cannon God, the incense fire, the Southern Hall, the Market Luck and the birth-giving spirits, and those who became spirits through fire; all can be reasoned by analogy.

note.yi: 神名的处理见 LY.ILL.YM.44 的注。「旗纛？」后面的问号是转录者标的，表示对这两个字没有把握，这里照录、没有改；那个问号在原文里把这一句切成了两段，这里按一句译。
note.en: Names are treated as in the note to LY.ILL.YM.44. The question mark after 'banner-standard' is the transcriber's own, showing doubt about the two characters, and is copied as it stands; in the original it cuts this sentence into two, and it is translated here as one sentence.

zh: 属火，则火神也，生育雷电之司也。
yi: 属火的，就是火神，是掌管生育、雷电的。
en: If it is Fire, it is a fire spirit, in charge of childbirth, thunder and lightning.

zh: 官鬼属火，如离神、电神、南斗、火雷、韦陀、元坛、华光、五神、五赫、三煞、灶神、旗纛？、炉神、炮神、香火、南堂、利市、生育神之属，及由火成神可类。
yi: 官鬼属火的，像离神、电神、南斗、火雷、韦陀、元坛、华光、五神、五赫、三煞、灶神、旗纛（？）、炉神、炮神、香火、南堂、利市、生育神这一类，以及因火而成神的，可以类推。
en: Where the Pressure line is Fire, as with the Li spirit, the Lightning God, the Southern Dipper, Fire and Thunder, Weituo, the Dark Altar, Huaguang, the Five Spirits, the Five Blazes, the Three Killings, the Kitchen God, the banner-standard (?), the Furnace God, the Cannon God, the incense fire, the Southern Hall, the Market Luck and the birth-giving spirits, and those who became spirits through fire, can be reasoned by analogy.

title: 官鬼属土则土神及山川社稷之司：地祗、太岁、城隍、社稷、土神、庙神、宅神、伽蓝、皮肠、当境、本家土地之属；土部名号非一（飞游作犯斫伐坟墓坑厮金神吟神伏尸螣蛇天曹土），当以八宫六神诸星配辨；西北土厚知地祗、东南土薄多土曹

rule.yi: 官鬼属土的，就是土神，以及掌管山川社稷的。像地祇、太岁、城隍、社稷、土神、庙神、宅神、伽蓝、皮肠、当境、本家土地这一类，以及因为在当地有功绩而成神的，都是。土这一部的神灵，圣号、曹名不止一种，有飞游、作犯、斫伐、坟墓、坑厮、金神、吟神、伏尸、螣蛇、天曹土等称呼，要用八宫、六神、诸星配合起来辨别，比如白虎带土官，就断成金神七煞。大体上西北土地厚，只知道有地祇；东南土地薄，所以有很多土曹的名号。所以要因人、因地、因事，变通的方法很多。
rule.en: If the Pressure line is Earth, it is an earth spirit, and those in charge of mountains, rivers and the altars of soil and grain, as with the Earth Spirit, the Tai Sui, the City God, the Altars of Soil and Grain, earth gods, temple gods, house gods, the Sangharama, the Skin and Intestines, the Local Boundary God and the family's own Earth God, and those who became spirits through merit in a locality. The spirits of the Earth department have more than one holy title and office name, such as Flying Wanderer, Offence-maker, Felling, Grave, Pit Rascal, Golden Spirit, Chanting Spirit, Buried Corpse, Coiling Snake and Heavenly Bureau Earth; one must tell them apart by combining the eight palaces, the six spirits and the various stars, so that for example an Earth Pressure line with the White Tiger is judged the Golden Spirit or the Seven Killings. In general the earth of the northwest is thick and people know only the Earth Spirit, while the earth of the southeast is thin and so has many bureau titles of the earth. So one goes by person, place and matter, and the ways of adapting are many.

note.yi: 神名的处理见 LY.ILL.YM.44 的注。土部的称呼里「螣蛇」在这里是土部一个神煞的名字，不是六神里的螣蛇，原文没有再分；「土曹」是掌管土地的曹官。西北土厚、东南土薄的说法，和前面土鬼独发那一条（LY.ILL.YM.12）里东南土薄、犯土忌多、西北土厚不畏土禁，是同一个地理判断。
note.en: Names are treated as in the note to LY.ILL.YM.44. Among the titles of the Earth department 'Coiling Snake' is the name of one earth star here, not the Coiling Snake of the six spirits, and the original does not distinguish them further; 'bureau of the earth' is the office that governs the land. The saying that the northwest earth is thick and the southeast earth thin is the same geographical judgment as in the entry on an Earth ghost moving alone (LY.ILL.YM.12), where in the southeast the earth is thin and earth taboos are often broken, and in the northwest it is thick and earth prohibitions are not feared.

zh: 属土，则土神也，及山川社稷之司也。
yi: 属土的，就是土神，以及掌管山川社稷的。
en: If it is Earth, it is an earth spirit, and those in charge of mountains, rivers and the altars of soil and grain.

zh: 官鬼属土，如地祗、太岁、城隍、社稷、土神、庙神、宅神、伽蓝、皮肠、当境、本家土地之属，及由地方功勣为神俱是。
盖土部神灵、圣号、曹名非一，有飞游、作犯、斫伐、坟墓、坑厮、金神、吟神、伏尸、螣蛇、天曹土诸称，当以八宫、六神、诸星，配合辨别，若白虎土官，乃断金神七煞。
大凡西北土厚，惟知有地祗，东南土薄，故多土曹之号也。
所以因人、因地、因事、通变多端尔。
yi: 官鬼属土的，像地祇、太岁、城隍、社稷、土神、庙神、宅神、伽蓝、皮肠、当境、本家土地这一类，以及因为在当地有功绩而成神的，都是。
土这一部的神灵，圣号、曹名不止一种，有飞游、作犯、斫伐、坟墓、坑厮、金神、吟神、伏尸、螣蛇、天曹土等称呼，要用八宫、六神、诸星配合起来辨别，比如白虎带土官，就断成金神七煞。
大体上西北土地厚，只知道有地祇；东南土地薄，所以有很多土曹的名号。
所以要因人、因地、因事，变通的方法很多。
en: Where the Pressure line is Earth, as with the Earth Spirit, the Tai Sui, the City God, the Altars of Soil and Grain, earth gods, temple gods, house gods, the Sangharama, the Skin and Intestines, the Local Boundary God and the family's own Earth God, and those who became spirits through merit in a locality, all are included.

The spirits of the Earth department have more than one holy title and office name, such as Flying Wanderer, Offence-maker, Felling, Grave, Pit Rascal, Golden Spirit, Chanting Spirit, Buried Corpse, Coiling Snake and Heavenly Bureau Earth; one must tell them apart by combining the eight palaces, the six spirits and the various stars, so that for example an Earth Pressure line with the White Tiger is judged the Golden Spirit or the Seven Killings.
In general the earth of the northwest is thick and people know only the Earth Spirit, while the earth of the southeast is thin and so has many bureau titles of the earth.
So one goes by person, place and matter, and the ways of adapting are many.

title: 金鬼的来历：生前好勇（性属金），或亡于干戈锋镝、病丧于喉肺、为义为利，是成鬼之因；成鬼能善则上帝命其所司，位西方、权秋令、主兵事，按金象考

rule.yi: 生前好勇的鬼，是就它的性情说，所以属金；或者死在兵器锋镝之下，以及病死在喉、肺，为义、为利而死，这是就它怎样成鬼说，所以也归金类。成了鬼又能行善的，上帝命它掌管的事，如果位在西方、权在秋令、主管兵事，就按金象来考察。注说：这是察看鬼神的来历。金鬼一定生前好勇，就性情说，它死在刀兵之下；就它成为鬼神说，这位神掌管什么事，可能属水、属火、属土、属金、属木；就所掌管的属性说，比如关帝、岳王的神勇和义属金，七煞、丧煞，体属金、掌管杀伐，也属金。遁甲里的七煞是庚，这就叫体属金。
rule.en: A ghost who loved courage in life is Metal, speaking of its nature; or one who died under weapons and arrowheads, or of illness of the throat or lungs, or over righteousness or profit, is spoken of as how it became a ghost, and so is also classed as Metal. One who, having become a ghost, can do good, and whom the Supreme Lord has appointed to a charge, if its seat is in the west, its authority in the autumn season and its charge in military affairs, is examined by the Metal image. The note says: this is to examine where the ghost or spirit came from. A Metal ghost must have loved courage in life; by nature, that ghost died by blade and weapon; as to its becoming a ghost or spirit, what this spirit governs may be Water, Fire, Earth, Metal or Wood; as to what its charge belongs to, for example, the valour and righteousness of Guan and Yue belong to Metal, and the Seven Killings and the Mourning Killing, whose body is Metal and whose charge is killing, belong to Metal. The Seven Killings of the Dunjia is Geng, which is what is meant by a body of Metal.

note.yi: 这一条讲的是 LY.ILL.YM.42 里「性、司、成」三样怎么用。「性」是生前的性情（好勇），「成」是怎么成鬼的（死于刀兵），「司」是成神以后上帝派它管什么（西方、秋令、兵事）；三样各自可以属金，也可以三样属的不一样（注里说「所司」可以属水火土金木任何一行）。「体金」是本体属金：七煞在遁甲里是庚，庚是金，所以七煞体金；关、岳靠神勇与义归金，是靠所司的性质。
note.en: This entry shows how the three of 'nature, charge and origin' in LY.ILL.YM.42 are used. 'Nature' is the disposition in life (love of courage), 'origin' is how it became a ghost (died by blade), and 'charge' is what the Supreme Lord set it to govern after it became a spirit (the west, autumn, military affairs); each of the three can be Metal, or the three can belong to different phases (the note says the 'charge' may belong to any of Water, Fire, Earth, Metal or Wood). 'Body of Metal' means the substance is Metal: the Seven Killings in the Dunjia is Geng, and Geng is Metal, so the Seven Killings has a body of Metal, while Guan and Yue go under Metal through the nature of their charge, valour and righteousness.

zh: 生前好勇之鬼，言其性故属金，或亡于干戈锋镝之下，及病丧于喉、肺、义、利，言其成鬼，故金类之。
成鬼而能有善，上帝命其所司，若位于西方，权于秋令，主于兵事，则金象而考也。
yi: 生前好勇的鬼，是就它的性情说，所以属金；或者死在兵器锋镝之下，以及病死在喉、肺，为义、为利而死，这是就它怎样成鬼说，所以归入金类。
成了鬼又能行善的，上帝命它掌管的事，如果位在西方、权在秋令、主管兵事，就按金象来考察。
en: A ghost who loved courage in life is Metal, speaking of its nature; or one who died under weapons and arrowheads, or of illness of the throat or lungs, or over righteousness or profit, is spoken of as how it became a ghost, and so is classed as Metal.

One who, having become a ghost, can do good, and whom the Supreme Lord has appointed to a charge, if its seat is in the west, its authority in the autumn season and its charge in military affairs, is examined by the Metal image.

zh: 金鬼，其鬼必生前好勇，以性言之，其鬼亡于刀兵；
以成鬼神言之，其神所司何事，或水或火或土或金或木；
以所司属言之，如关岳神勇义属金，七煞丧煞，体金司煞属金也。
遁甲七煞乃庚，是谓体金。
yi: 这是察看鬼神是怎么来的。
金鬼，这个鬼生前一定好勇，就性情说，它死在刀兵之下；
就它成为鬼神说，这位神所掌管的是什么事，可能属水、属火、属土、属金、属木；
就所掌管的属性说，比如关帝、岳王的神勇和义属金，七煞、丧煞，体属金、掌管杀伐的也属金。
遁甲里的七煞就是庚，这就叫体属金。
en: This is to examine where the ghost or spirit came from.
A Metal ghost must have loved courage in life; by nature, that ghost died by blade and weapon;
as to its becoming a ghost or spirit, what this spirit governs may be Water, Fire, Earth, Metal or Wood;

as to what its charge belongs to, for example, the valour and righteousness of Guan and Yue belong to Metal, and the Seven Killings and the Mourning Killing, whose body is Metal and whose charge is killing, belong to Metal.
The Seven Killings of the Dunjia is Geng, which is what is meant by a body of Metal.

title: 水鬼的来历：生前谋利于水，或亡于江海风波汤卤，病丧于腰肾茶酒，凡司河泊舟楫，按水象考；出身显圣者亦可推而变化无穷

rule.yi: 生前靠水谋利的，或者死在江海风浪、开水卤水之中，以及病死在腰、肾，因茶、酒而死的，凡是掌管河泊舟船的，就按水象来考察。注说：凡是靠出身、来历显了圣的，也可以这样推，变化就无穷无尽了；大慈在南海显道，三官从龙神那里受生，都仿照这样。
rule.en: One who sought profit by water in life, or died in river and sea, wind and waves, or scalding water and brine, or of illness of the waist and kidneys, or over tea and wine, and whose charge is rivers, moorings, boats and oars, is examined by the Water image. The note says: those who manifested as holy beings from their origins can likewise be worked out, and then the variations are without end; Great Compassion manifested the Way in the Southern Sea, and the Three Officials received their birth from the Dragon Spirit; follow this.

note.yi: 「凡出身显圣」原文没有再解释，这里译成「凡是靠出身显了圣的」。「大慈」指大慈大悲的观世音；「三官生受龙神」的读法原文没有讲，这里按字面译。这一条和金的那一条（LY.ILL.YM.49）是平行的：性（谋利于水）、成（亡于江海风波）、司（河泊舟楫），最后一句提醒神的来历还有另一条路——靠出身显圣，那就没有一定之规了。
note.en: The original does not explain 'those who manifested as holy beings from their origins', and it is rendered as it stands. 'Great Compassion' is the Guanyin of great compassion and mercy; how 'the Three Officials received birth from the Dragon Spirit' is to be read is not stated, and it is translated literally. This entry runs parallel to the Metal one (LY.ILL.YM.49): nature (seeking profit by water), origin (dying in river and sea) and charge (rivers, moorings, boats); the last sentence warns that a spirit may also come by another road, manifesting from its origins, for which there is no fixed rule.

zh: 生前谋利于水，或亡于江海风波汤卤之中，及病丧于腰、肾、茶、酒，凡司河泊舟楫，则水象而考也。
yi: 生前靠水谋利的，或者死在江海风浪、开水卤水之中，以及病死在腰、肾，因茶、酒而死的，凡是掌管河泊舟船的，就按水象来考察。
en: One who sought profit by water in life, or died in river and sea, wind and waves, or scalding water and brine, or of illness of the waist and kidneys, or over tea and wine, and whose charge is rivers, moorings, boats and oars, is examined by the Water image.

zh: 凡出身显圣，亦可推之，则变化无穷矣。
大慈显道南海，三官生受龙神，仿此。
yi: 凡是靠出身显了圣的，也可以这样推，变化就无穷无尽了。
大慈在南海显道，三官从龙神那里受生，都仿照这样。
en: Those who manifested as holy beings from their origins can likewise be worked out, and then the variations are without end.
Great Compassion manifested the Way in the Southern Sea, and the Three Officials received their birth from the Dragon Spirit; follow this.

title: 木鬼的来历：生前陶情花乡、立业桑麻，或亡于笞杖树木之下、丧于捆缚疯癫，凡司栽植砍伐，按木象考；两可不能一见则审累重（南木神应水官者体木司水）

rule.yi: 生前在花乡里陶冶性情、靠桑麻立业的，或者死在笞杖、树木之下，死于捆绑、疯癫的，凡是掌管栽种砍伐的，就按木象来考察。注说：凡是两种都说得通、不能只取一种的，要审察哪种分量重，比如南木神对应水官的，是体属木、掌管水。
rule.en: One who in life took his pleasure in the land of flowers and made his living from mulberry and hemp, or died under the rod or beneath a tree, or by binding or madness, and whose charge is planting and felling, is examined by the Wood image. The note says: where either reading is possible and one cannot be settled on by a single look, one must weigh which carries more; for example, the Southern Wood God answering a Water Pressure line has a body of Wood and a charge of Water.

note.yi: 这一条的注比正文重要：它给了一条判别规则，当一位神的「体」（本身属哪一行）和它的「所司」（掌管的属哪一行）不是同一行，不能只取一个，要看哪个分量重；例是南木神，本身是木神，可是掌管水，所以官鬼是水时要按「体木司水」去读。这是对 LY.ILL.YM.49 里「性、司、成」三样可以各属一行的补充。
note.en: The note of this entry matters more than the text: it gives a rule of discrimination, that when a spirit's 'body' (which phase it is itself) and its 'charge' (which phase what it governs is) are not the same phase, one cannot take only one, and must weigh which carries more; the example is the Southern Wood God, a Wood spirit by nature yet governing water, so that when the Pressure line is Water it is read as 'body Wood, charge Water'. It supplements what LY.ILL.YM.49 says, that nature, charge and origin may each belong to a different phase.

zh: 生前陶情花乡，立业桑麻，或亡于笞杖树木之下，丧于捆缚、疯癫，凡司栽植砍伐，则木象而考也。
yi: 生前在花乡里陶冶性情、靠桑麻立业的，或者死在笞杖、树木之下，死于捆绑、疯癫的，凡是掌管栽种砍伐的，就按木象来考察。
en: One who in life took his pleasure in the land of flowers and made his living from mulberry and hemp, or died under the rod or beneath a tree, or by binding or madness, and whose charge is planting and felling, is examined by the Wood image.

zh: 凡两可不能一见，当审累重，如南木神应水官者，体木司水也。
yi: 凡是两种都说得通、不能只取一种的，应当审察哪种分量重，比如南木神对应水官的，是体属木、掌管水。
en: Where either reading is possible and one cannot be settled on by a single look, one must weigh which carries more; for example, the Southern Wood God answering a Water Pressure line has a body of Wood and a charge of Water.

title: 火鬼的来历：生为炉煅之事，死于烈焰疮痍血衂胎产，凡司鼎釜孕育，按火象考；宜推而广之

rule.yi: 生前做炉锻的事，死在烈火、疮痍、流血、胎产中的，凡是掌管鼎釜和孕育的，就按火象来考察。注说：应当推广开来，用五行、六神、诸星去配。
rule.en: One who in life worked at furnace and forge, or died in raging flame, sores and wounds, bleeding, or childbirth, and whose charge is cauldrons and pots and pregnancy, is examined by the Fire image. The note says: one should extend it further, matching it with the five phases, the six spirits and the various stars.

note.yi: 「血衂」的「衂」同「衄」，流血、鼻出血；这里译作流血。这一条和 LY.ILL.YM.49–LY.ILL.YM.51、YM.53 是平行的，只是火的注只有一句「宜推而广之」，没有像木那条一样给出判别规则。
note.en: 'Xue nu' (bleeding) uses a variant of the character for nosebleed and is rendered as bleeding. This entry runs parallel to LY.ILL.YM.49 to YM.51 and YM.53, except that the note on Fire has only the one sentence 'one should extend it further', and gives no rule of discrimination as the one on Wood does.

zh: 生为炉煅之事，死于烈焰疮痍，血衂胎产，凡司鼎釜孕育，则火象而考也。
yi: 生前做炉锻的事，死在烈火、疮痍、流血、胎产中的，凡是掌管鼎釜和孕育的，就按火象来考察。
en: One who in life worked at furnace and forge, or died in raging flame, sores and wounds, bleeding, or childbirth, and whose charge is cauldrons and pots and pregnancy, is examined by the Fire image.

zh: 宜推而广之，五行六神诸星配之。
yi: 应当推广开来，用五行、六神、诸星去配。
en: One should extend it further, matching it with the five phases, the six spirits and the various stars.

title: 土鬼的来历：生前土技农耕，死于瘟疫脾胃土石之难，凡司动作，按土象考；惟灵显东南

rule.yi: 生前做土工、务农耕作的，死在瘟疫、脾胃的病、土石之难中的，凡是掌管动土动作的，就按土象来考察。注说：只是灵验多显现在东南。
rule.en: One who in life had an earth craft or farmed, or died of epidemic, illness of the spleen and stomach, or the calamity of earth and stone, and whose charge is works and movement, is examined by the Earth image. The note says: only, its power is manifest chiefly in the southeast.

note.yi: 「惟灵显东南」承接土神那条（LY.ILL.YM.48）：东南土薄，土曹的名号多，土鬼的灵验也多显在东南。这一条和 LY.ILL.YM.49–LY.ILL.YM.52 合起来，是五行各自的「性、成、司」的一张表。
note.en: 'Only its power is manifest in the southeast' follows the entry on Earth spirits (LY.ILL.YM.48): in the southeast the earth is thin and the bureau titles are many, and the power of an Earth ghost is chiefly manifest there too. Together with LY.ILL.YM.49 to YM.52 this makes a table of the 'nature, origin and charge' of each of the five phases.

zh: 生前土技农耕，死于瘟疫脾胃土石之难，凡司动作，则土象而考也。
yi: 生前做土工、务农耕作的，死在瘟疫、脾胃的病、土石之难中的，凡是掌管动土动作的，就按土象来考察。
en: One who in life had an earth craft or farmed, or died of epidemic, illness of the spleen and stomach, or the calamity of earth and stone, and whose charge is works and movement, is examined by the Earth image.

yi: 只是灵验多显现在东南。
en: Only, its power is manifest chiefly in the southeast.

title: 以动爻当鬼、按数推：阳男阴女、午南子北；一动一鬼、三动三鬼；爻与鬼皆动，则以鬼所属之方为方、鬼所属之数为数（例：鬼动值土断五鬼）

rule.yi: 有一种办法是拿动爻当鬼：阳的是男、阴的是女，午来自南方、子来自北方；动一爻就是一个鬼，动三爻就是三个鬼；如果爻和鬼都动，就以鬼所属的方位为方位、鬼所属的数为数。注说：鬼静而别的爻动，考察动的爻；鬼动而别的爻也动，考察鬼爻；动的按爻数算，鬼按数算，比如鬼动而值土，就断成五鬼。
rule.en: There is a method of taking the moving lines as the ghosts: yang is male and yin female, Wu comes from the south and Zi from the north; one moving line is one ghost and three moving lines are three ghosts; if the lines and the ghost all move, take the direction the ghost belongs to as the direction and the number the ghost belongs to as the number. The note says: if the ghost is still and other lines move, examine the moving lines; if the ghost moves and other lines move too, examine the Pressure line; the moving ones are counted by lines and the ghost by number, so that if the ghost moves and falls on Earth it is judged five ghosts.

note.yi: 「一动一鬼，三动三鬼」数的是动爻的条数；「鬼所属之数」是五行的数，例子里土断五鬼，正是通常的生成数里土为五（水一、火二、木三、金四、土五），但这一段里书没有列出这张表。「午南子北」是把午配南、子配北，和 LY.ILL.YM.29 里离在南、坎在北是同一种配法。
note.en: 'One moving line, one ghost; three moving, three ghosts' counts the number of moving lines; 'the number the ghost belongs to' is the number of its phase, and in the example an Earth ghost is judged five, which matches the usual generating numbers in which Earth is five (Water one, Fire two, Wood three, Metal four, Earth five), though the book does not list these in this passage. 'Wu the south, Zi the north' assigns Wu to the south and Zi to the north, the same assignment as Li in the south and Kan in the north in LY.ILL.YM.29.

zh: 法有以动为鬼，阳男阴女之分，午南子北之来，一动一鬼，三动三鬼，爻以鬼皆动，则以鬼属之方为方，鬼属之数为数也。
yi: 有一种办法是拿动爻当鬼：阳的是男、阴的是女，午来自南方、子来自北方；动一爻就是一个鬼，动三爻就是三个鬼；如果爻和鬼都动，就以鬼所属的方位为方位、鬼所属的数为数。
en: There is a method of taking the moving lines as the ghosts: yang is male and yin female, Wu comes from the south and Zi from the north; one moving line is one ghost and three moving lines are three ghosts; if the lines and the ghost all move, take the direction the ghost belongs to as the direction and the number the ghost belongs to as the number.

zh: 鬼静爻动考动爻，鬼动爻动考鬼爻，动与爻计，鬼与数计，如鬼动值土，断五鬼也。
yi: 鬼静而别的爻动，就考察动爻；鬼动而别的爻也动，就考察鬼爻；动的按爻数算，鬼按数算，比如鬼动而值土，就断成五鬼。
en: If the ghost is still and other lines move, examine the moving lines; if the ghost moves and other lines move too, examine the Pressure line; the moving ones are counted by lines and the ghost by number, so that if the ghost moves and falls on Earth it is judged five ghosts.

title: 考鬼的四种情形：鬼爻发动考其宫、卦爻俱静求之外卦、无鬼索伏考其飞爻、伏鬼若空则无鬼祟惟修德；此专考鬼、非断神

rule.yi: 鬼爻发动，就考察它所在的宫；卦爻都静，就从外卦去找；卦里没有鬼，就去找伏着的鬼，考察它上面的飞爻；伏鬼如果又落空，就致力于修德。注说：鬼爻独发，用八宫来考察这个鬼；爻和鬼都静，用外卦来考察；鬼爻隐伏，用鬼上面的飞爻来考察；鬼伏着又落空，就是没有鬼祟，只要修德就行了。这一节是专门考察鬼，不是判断神。
rule.en: If the Pressure line moves, examine its palace; if the hexagram and lines are all still, seek it in the outer trigram; if there is no ghost, look for the hidden one and examine the flying line above it; if the hidden ghost is also Void, devote oneself to cultivating virtue. The note says: if the Pressure line moves alone, examine the ghost by the eight palaces; if the lines and the ghost are all still, examine it by the outer trigram; if the Pressure line is hidden, examine it by the flying line above the ghost; if the hidden ghost is again Void, there is no haunting by a ghost, and one need only cultivate virtue. This section is solely to examine the ghost, not to judge the spirit.

note.yi: 这一条和 LY.ILL.YM.29「病从何起」是同一套四步（动看宫、静看外卦、无鬼看伏鬼的飞爻），只是那里问的是病从哪个方向来，这里问的是作祟的是什么。第四步「伏鬼若空」得出的结论是没有鬼祟，只有修德，这是全章「祭祀莫善于解禳，解禳莫善于修身」（LY.ILL.YM.64）那个结论的一个具体出口。注里最后一句「此专考鬼，非断神」把这一节和下一节（LY.ILL.YM.56 讲专断神）分开：前者是找到那个鬼，后者是给它定神名。
note.en: This entry is the same four steps as LY.ILL.YM.29, 'where the illness rose from' (moving, look at the palace; still, look at the outer trigram; no ghost, look at the flying line above a hidden ghost), except that there the question was from what direction the illness came, and here it is what is doing the haunting. The conclusion of the fourth step, 'if the hidden ghost is also Void', is that there is no haunting and only virtue remains, which is one concrete outlet of the chapter's final conclusion, 'of sacrifice none is better than exorcism, and of exorcism none is better than cultivating oneself' (LY.ILL.YM.64). The note's last sentence, 'solely to examine the ghost, not to judge the spirit', separates this section from the next (LY.ILL.YM.56, which is solely for judging the spirit): the first finds the ghost and the second names the spirit.

zh: 鬼爻发动，考之宫也，卦爻俱静，求之外也，无鬼索伏，考之飞爻，伏鬼若空，务之修德也。
yi: 鬼爻发动，就考察它所在的宫；卦爻都静，就从外卦去找；卦里没有鬼，就去找伏着的鬼，考察它上面的飞爻；伏鬼如果又落空，就致力于修德。
en: If the Pressure line moves, examine its palace; if the hexagram and lines are all still, seek it in the outer trigram; if there is no ghost, look for the hidden one and examine the flying line above it; if the hidden ghost is also Void, devote oneself to cultivating virtue.

zh: 鬼爻独发，以八宫考鬼，爻与鬼皆静，以外卦考鬼，鬼爻隐伏，以鬼上飞爻考鬼，鬼伏复空，乃无鬼祟，惟修德而已。
yi: 鬼爻独自发动，用八宫来考察这个鬼；爻和鬼都静，用外卦来考察这个鬼；鬼爻隐伏，用鬼上面的飞爻来考察；鬼伏着又落空，就是没有鬼祟，只要修德就行了。
这一节是专门考察鬼，不是判断神。
en: If the Pressure line moves alone, examine the ghost by the eight palaces; if the lines and the ghost are all still, examine it by the outer trigram; if the Pressure line is hidden, examine it by the flying line above the ghost; if the hidden ghost is again Void, there is no haunting by a ghost, and one need only cultivate virtue.
This is solely to examine the ghost, not to judge the spirit.

title: 断神的五种专法：一官鬼专五行、二官鬼专六神、动官鬼专八卦、乱官鬼专诸星、世官鬼专六爻——卦有一官以五行、二官以六神（下临白虎为武神、上临青龙为树神）、动鬼以八宫（鬼动乾天神、鬼动坤地祗）、乱动以何星临官

rule.yi: 卦里只有一个官鬼，专门用五行来断；有两个官鬼，专门用六神来断；官鬼发动的，专门用八卦；官鬼乱动的，专门用诸星；官鬼在世爻上的，专门用六爻。注说：卦里有一个官，用五行取象；有两个官，用六神取象，比如下面的官临白虎，就说是武神，上面的官临青龙，就说是树神；有动的鬼，用八宫取象，比如鬼在乾宫动，就说是天神，鬼在坤宫动，就说是地祇；卦爻乱动、或者其中有官在动，就看哪颗星临在官上来取象。这一节是专门断神的。
rule.en: With one Pressure line, go by the five phases alone; with two Pressure lines, go by the six spirits alone; with a moving Pressure line, go by the eight trigrams alone; with Pressure lines moving in disorder, go by the various stars alone; with the Pressure line on the Self, go by the six lines alone. The note says: where the hexagram has one Pressure line, take the image by the five phases; where it has two, take the image by the six spirits, so that if the lower one carries the White Tiger it is called a martial spirit, and if the upper one carries the Azure Dragon it is called a tree spirit; where it has a moving ghost, take the image by the eight palaces, so that a ghost moving in Qian is called a heavenly spirit and in Kun an earthly deity; where the lines move in disorder, or a Pressure line among them moves, take the image by whichever star sits on the Pressure line. This section is solely for judging the spirit.

note.yi: 这一条给出了后面六段（LY.ILL.YM.57 到 YM.62）的分工：五行（前面 LY.ILL.YM.44–YM.48 已讲）、六神（LY.ILL.YM.59）、八宫（LY.ILL.YM.57）、诸星（LY.ILL.YM.62）、六爻（LY.ILL.YM.58）；六亲（LY.ILL.YM.60）和十二支（LY.ILL.YM.61）在这一条的总目里没有列出，但下面紧接着还有。「乱官鬼」的「乱」是乱动、多爻纷动。原文「世官鬼而专六爻」只说官鬼在世爻上，后面讲六爻（LY.ILL.YM.58）时又分了「现在何爻」和「世鬼居何象」两种。
note.en: This entry sets out the division of labour among the following sections (LY.ILL.YM.57 to YM.62): the five phases (already treated in LY.ILL.YM.44 to YM.48), the six spirits (LY.ILL.YM.59), the eight palaces (LY.ILL.YM.57), the various stars (LY.ILL.YM.62) and the six lines (LY.ILL.YM.58); the six relations (LY.ILL.YM.60) and the twelve branches (LY.ILL.YM.61) are not listed in this summary but follow immediately. 'Disorderly Pressure' means Pressure lines moving in confusion, many lines stirring at once. The text's 'the Pressure line on the Self, go by the six lines alone' says only that the Pressure line is on the Self, and the later treatment of the six lines (LY.ILL.YM.58) distinguishes 'which line it appears on' from 'in what image the ghost on the Self lies'.

zh: 夫一官鬼而专于五行，二官鬼而专于六神，动官鬼而专八卦，乱官鬼而专诸星，世官鬼而专六爻也。
yi: 卦里只有一个官鬼，专门用五行来断；有两个官鬼，专门用六神；官鬼发动的，专门用八卦；官鬼乱动的，专门用诸星；官鬼在世爻上的，专门用六爻。
en: With one Pressure line, go by the five phases alone; with two Pressure lines, go by the six spirits alone; with a moving Pressure line, go by the eight trigrams alone; with Pressure lines moving in disorder, go by the various stars alone; with the Pressure line on the Self, go by the six lines alone.

zh: 卦有二官，以六神像之，如下临白虎，则曰武神，上临青龙，则曰树神也。
卦有动鬼，以八宫像之，如鬼动乾，则曰天神，如鬼动坤，则曰地祗也。
卦爻乱动，或中有官动，以何星临官像之。
yi: 卦里有一个官，用五行取象。
卦里有两个官，用六神取象，比如下面的官临白虎，就说是武神，上面的官临青龙，就说是树神。
卦里有动的鬼，用八宫取象，比如鬼在乾宫动，就说是天神，鬼在坤宫动，就说是地祇。
卦爻乱动，或者其中有官在动，就看哪颗星临在官上来取象。
这一节是专门断神的。
en: Where the hexagram has one Pressure line, take the image by the five phases.

Where it has two, take the image by the six spirits: for example, if the lower one carries the White Tiger, call it a martial spirit, and if the upper one carries the Azure Dragon, call it a tree spirit.
Where the hexagram has a moving ghost, take the image by the eight palaces: for example, if the ghost moves in Qian, call it a heavenly spirit, and if in Kun, an earthly deity.
Where the lines move in disorder, or a Pressure line among them moves, take the image by whichever star sits on the Pressure line.
This is solely for judging the spirit.

title: 官鬼独发按八宫断神鬼：乾天神寺庙父老僧人王侯之灵；坤地祗坟墓母妪后妃；震九天之神蚕桑舟车辱身折足鬼雷火部；巽风波镇海花果园林长妇女；坎北斗北极百川四海；离荧惑香火灶中女；艮山神五岳荒塚童儿；兑释之宗咒咀尸祝师尼酒色

rule.yi: 神和鬼虽有分别，考察的办法却没有两样。所以官在乾宫发动，是触犯了天神，是冲犯了寺庙，是年老父辈、僧人的鬼，是王侯宫殿的灵；在坤宫动，是亵渎了地祇，是妨碍了坟墓，是母亲、老妇人的鬼，是皇后妃子的神；震是东方，是九天的神，是道的宗主，是掌管蚕桑舟车的，是受辱折了脚的鬼，是雷火部的威灵；巽是东南，是掌管风浪、镇守大海的神，是花果园林里作祟的，是长女、妇人的魂；坎是北方，在天是北斗，在地是北极，是百川、四海、恒河的灵，它的广大是这样，天下的水神火神，确实不能改易；离是火德，在星是荧惑，对读书人和百姓是香火，对一家是灶神，对骨肉亲人是中女的鬼；艮是山神，是五岳，是荒坟，以及童子的鬼；兑是西方，是佛家的宗主，是咒骂诅咒的孽，是巫祝的欺诳，是和尚尼姑的鬼，是酒色的邪。注说：这是官鬼独自发动、其他卦爻都静时，用八宫的象来断。
rule.en: Spirits and ghosts differ, but the way of examining them is not two. So when the Pressure line moves in Qian, a heavenly spirit has been offended, a temple has been struck against, and it is the ghost of an elder or a monk, the spirit of a prince or marquis and his great halls; moving in Kun, the earthly deity has been profaned and the graves obstructed, and it is the ghost of a mother or an old woman, the spirit of an empress or a consort; Zhen is the east: a spirit of the Nine Heavens, the head of the Way, in charge of silkworms and mulberries, boats and carts, the ghost of one who was disgraced or broke a leg, the awesome spirit of the Thunder and Fire department; Xun is the southeast: a spirit in charge of wind and waves and of pacifying the sea, a haunting of flowers, fruit, gardens and groves, the soul of an eldest daughter or a woman; Kan is the north: in heaven the Northern Dipper, on earth the North Pole, the spirit of the hundred rivers, the four seas and the Ganges, so vast is it, and the spirits of water and fire under heaven are firmly beyond change; Li is the virtue of Fire: among the stars Yinghuo, to gentry and commoners the incense fire, in the household the stove, and among kin the ghost of the middle daughter; Gen is the mountain spirit, the Five Peaks, a wild grave, and the ghost of a boy or child; Dui is the west, the head of the Buddhists: the baleful work of curses, the deceit of impersonator and invoker, the ghost of a monk or nun, the evil of wine and lust. The note says: this is judgment by the images of the eight palaces when the Pressure line moves alone and the other lines are all still.

dispute.yi: 八宫各配什么鬼神，黄金策（LY.ILL.HJC.95）和易冒大体同路，细目不同：乾都是天神一路；坤都有坟墓、地祇；坎、离都是水火之神。不同的地方——艮，黄金策是城隍、宅土，易冒是山神、五岳、荒坟、童子之鬼；巽，黄金策是缢死或颠仆的阴人，易冒是掌管风浪镇海的神、花果园林之祟、长女妇人之魄；兑，黄金策是口愿、伤神，易冒是佛家宗主、咒诅、巫祝之诳、僧尼之鬼、酒色之邪；震，黄金策是树神或杖死的男鬼，易冒是九天之神、蚕桑舟车之司、辱身折足之鬼、雷火部的威灵。两本书都没有说谁对谁错。
dispute.en: What each palace stands for among ghosts and spirits: the Huangjin Ce (LY.ILL.HJC.95) and the Yi Mao run roughly the same way, with differences of detail: in Qian both have the heavenly spirits; in Kun both have graves and the earthly deity; in Kan and Li both have the spirits of water and fire. Where they differ: for Gen, the Huangjin Ce has the City God and the earth of the house, the Yi Mao the mountain spirit, the Five Peaks, a wild grave and the ghost of a boy; for Xun, the Huangjin Ce has a woman who hanged herself or fell in a fit, the Yi Mao a spirit in charge of wind and waves and pacifying the sea, the haunting of flowers, fruit, gardens and groves, and the soul of an eldest daughter or a woman; for Dui, the Huangjin Ce has a spoken vow or an injuring spirit, the Yi Mao the head of the Buddhists, curses, the deceit of impersonators and invokers, the ghost of a monk or nun and the evil of wine and lust; for Zhen, the Huangjin Ce has a tree spirit or a male ghost beaten to death with a staff, the Yi Mao a spirit of the Nine Heavens, one in charge of silkworms, boats and carts, the ghost of one disgraced or with a broken leg, and the awesome spirit of the Thunder and Fire department. Neither book says which is right.

note.yi: 这一条原文里「官」是官鬼的省写；「干天神」的「干」是触犯。「荧惑」是火星，「九天」是九重天。「师尼」是和尚、尼姑一类的出家人。「盖天下水火之神，确乎其不可易也」承接坎（水）、离（火）两条，意思是水神、火神的名号大体是固定的。这一条与黄金策的八宫（LY.ILL.HJC.95）、易隐的鬼神名目（LY.ILL.YY.28）是同一件事。
note.en: In the original 'guan' (official) is short for the Pressure line. 'Gan' in 'offended a heavenly spirit' is to offend or infringe. 'Yinghuo' is the planet Mars, and the 'Nine Heavens' are the nine layers of heaven. 'Monks and nuns' covers those who have left the household life. 'The spirits of water and fire under heaven are firmly beyond change' follows the entries on Kan (Water) and Li (Fire) and means that the names of water and fire spirits are more or less fixed. This entry treats the same matter as the Huangjin Ce's eight palaces (LY.ILL.HJC.95) and the Yi Yin's names of spirits and ghosts (LY.ILL.YY.28).

zh: 神鬼有殊，考求无二，是故官动乎乾，谓干天神，谓冲寺庙，父老僧人之鬼，王侯都厦之灵也。
动乎坤，谓渎地祗，谓妨坟墓，母妪之鬼，后妃之神也。
震东方也，九天之神，道之宗，蚕桑舟车之司也，辱身折足之鬼，雷火部之威灵也。
巽东南也，其司风波镇海之神也，花果园林之祟，长妇女之魄也。
坎北方也，在天为北斗，在地为北极，百川四海恒河之灵，其广大也；
盖天下水火之神，确乎其不可易也。
离火德也，于星荧惑，于士庶曰香火，于家曰灶，于骨肉曰中女之鬼也。
艮为山神，为五岳，为荒塚，及童儿之鬼也。
兑为西方，释之宗也，咒咀之孽，尸祝之诳，师尼之鬼，酒色之邪也。
yi: 神和鬼虽有分别，考察的办法却没有两样。所以官在乾宫发动，是触犯了天神，是冲犯了寺庙，是年老父辈、僧人的鬼，是王侯宫殿的灵。
在坤宫动，是亵渎了地祇，是妨碍了坟墓，是母亲、老妇人的鬼，是皇后妃子的神。
震是东方，是九天的神，是道的宗主，是掌管蚕桑舟车的，是受辱折了脚的人的鬼，是雷火部的威灵。
巽是东南，是掌管风浪、镇守大海的神，是花果园林里作祟的，是长女、妇人的魂。
坎是北方，在天是北斗，在地是北极，是百川、四海、恒河的灵，它的广大是这样；
天下的水神、火神，确实不能改易。
离是火德，在星是荧惑，对读书人和百姓是香火，对一家是灶神，对骨肉亲人是中女的鬼。
艮是山神，是五岳，是荒坟，以及童子、小孩的鬼。
兑是西方，是佛家的宗主；是咒骂诅咒的孽，是巫祝的欺诳，是和尚尼姑的鬼，是酒色的邪。
en: Spirits and ghosts differ, but the way of examining them is not two. So when the Pressure line moves in Qian, a heavenly spirit has been offended, a temple has been struck against, and it is the ghost of an elder or a monk, the spirit of a prince or marquis and his great halls.
Moving in Kun, the earthly deity has been profaned and the graves obstructed; it is the ghost of a mother or an old woman, the spirit of an empress or a consort.

Zhen is the east: a spirit of the Nine Heavens, the head of the Way, in charge of silkworms and mulberries, boats and carts; the ghost of one who was disgraced or broke a leg, the awesome spirit of the Thunder and Fire department.
Xun is the southeast: a spirit in charge of wind and waves and of pacifying the sea; a haunting of flowers, fruit, gardens and groves, the soul of an eldest daughter or a woman.
Kan is the north: in heaven it is the Northern Dipper, on earth the North Pole, the spirit of the hundred rivers, the four seas and the Ganges, so vast is it;
for the spirits of water and fire under heaven are firmly beyond change.
Li is the virtue of Fire: among the stars it is Yinghuo, to gentry and commoners it is the incense fire, in the household it is the stove, and among kin it is the ghost of the middle daughter.
Gen is the mountain spirit, the Five Peaks, a wild grave, and the ghost of a boy or child.
Dui is the west, the head of the Buddhists: the baleful work of curses, the deceit of impersonator and invoker, the ghost of a monk or nun, the evil of wine and lust.

zh: 言官鬼独发，卦爻皆静，以八宫象断如此。
yi: 这是说官鬼独自发动、卦爻都静的时候，用八宫的象来断，是这样的。
en: This says that when the Pressure line moves alone and the hexagram's other lines are all still, judgment by the images of the eight palaces is as above.

title: 按爻位断神鬼：初爻井祟、二爻灶祟、三爻家堂之祟、四爻门户之祟、五爻道路之祟、六爻坟墓之祟；世在初为家神、二为土神、三为园神、四为五神、上为山神

rule.yi: 初爻，是井祟，是井里的鬼，是掌管居住的神；二爻，是灶祟，是灶下的亡魂，是掌管境内城邑的神；三爻，是家堂的祟，是闺房里的鬼，是掌管都郡桥埠的神；四爻，是门户的祟，是关隘的神；五爻，是道路的祟，是王侯的神；六爻，是坟墓的祟，是慈悲的尊神，是奴仆的亡魂。世在初爻的，是家神；世在二爻的，是土神；世在三爻，是园神；世在四爻，是五神；世在上爻，是山神。注说：这是卦里得一个鬼，现在哪一爻，以及世爻带鬼落在什么象上，用六爻的象来断。
rule.en: The first line: a haunting by the well, a ghost in the well, a spirit in charge of dwellings; the second: a haunting by the stove, one who died beside the stove, a spirit in charge of the district and its town; the third: a haunting of the household shrine, a ghost of the women's quarters, a spirit in charge of cities, prefectures, bridges and wharves; the fourth: a haunting of the doors, a spirit of passes and defiles; the fifth: a haunting of the road, a spirit of princes and marquises; the sixth: a haunting of the graves, a compassionate honoured one, one who died a servant. With the Self on the first line, a household spirit; on the second, an earth spirit; on the third, a garden spirit; on the fourth, the Five Spirits; on the top, a mountain spirit. The note says: where the hexagram has one ghost, on whichever line it appears, and in whatever image the ghost on the Self lies, judgment by the images of the six lines is as above.

note.yi: 这一条给两张表：一张是鬼落在哪一爻（六条），一张是世爻带鬼时世在哪一爻（五条，三个爻位之外的第五爻没有列）。第一张里「初井、二灶、三家堂、四门户、五道路、六坟墓」是一处住宅由内到外、由近到远的次序，和黄金策的六爻推鬼神（LY.ILL.HJC.101）前三条（井神、灶神/司命、家堂）相同，第五爻的道路也相同；第四爻黄金策讲的是出门撞见，这里是门户与关隘，着眼点不同。「五神」在第二张表里是第四爻的世，书里没有解释是哪五位神。
note.en: This entry gives two tables: one for the line the ghost falls on (six items), and one for which line the Self is on when the Self carries the ghost (five items, the fifth line not being listed).
