In the first, 'first the well, second the stove, third the household shrine, fourth the doors, fifth the road, sixth the graves' runs in order through a house from inside out and near to far, and agrees with the Huangjin Ce's reading by the six lines (LY.ILL.HJC.101) in its first three items (the well god, the stove god or Director of Fate, the household shrine) and in the road at the fifth line; for the fourth line the Huangjin Ce speaks of a meeting on going out, and here it is doors and passes, a different angle. The 'Five Spirits' for the Self on the fourth line in the second table are not explained in the book.

zh: 初爻井祟，井中之鬼，司居之神也；
二爻灶祟，灶下之亡，司境邑之神也；
三爻家堂之祟，闺壸之鬼，司都郡桥埠之神也；
四爻门户之祟，关隘之神；
五爻道路之祟，王侯之神；
六爻坟墓之祟，慈悲之尊，奴仆之亡也。
世于初者，家神也，世于二者，土神也，世于三，为园神，世于四，为五神，世于上，为山神也。
yi: 初爻，是井祟，是井里的鬼，是掌管居住的神；
二爻，是灶祟，是灶下的亡魂，是掌管境内城邑的神；
三爻，是家堂的祟，是闺房里的鬼，是掌管都郡桥埠的神；
四爻，是门户的祟，是关隘的神；
五爻，是道路的祟，是王侯的神；
六爻，是坟墓的祟，是慈悲的尊神，是奴仆的亡魂。
世在初爻的，是家神；世在二爻的，是土神；世在三爻，是园神；世在四爻，是五神；世在上爻，是山神。
en: The first line: a haunting by the well, a ghost in the well, a spirit in charge of dwellings;
the second: a haunting by the stove, one who died beside the stove, a spirit in charge of the district and its town;
the third: a haunting of the household shrine, a ghost of the women's quarters, a spirit in charge of cities, prefectures, bridges and wharves;
the fourth: a haunting of the doors, a spirit of passes and defiles;
the fifth: a haunting of the road, a spirit of princes and marquises;
the sixth: a haunting of the graves, a compassionate honoured one, one who died a servant.
With the Self on the first line, a household spirit; on the second, an earth spirit; on the third, a garden spirit; on the fourth, the Five Spirits; on the top, a mountain spirit.

zh: 言卦得一鬼，现在何爻，及世鬼居何象，以六爻象断如此。
yi: 这是说卦里得一个鬼，现在哪一爻，以及世爻带鬼落在什么象上，用六爻的象来断，是这样的。
en: This says that where the hexagram has one ghost, on whichever line it appears, and in whatever image the ghost on the Self lies, judgment by the images of the six lines is as above.

title: 按六神断神鬼：青龙喜庆财利之神桃李之妖胎产之鬼；朱雀离神词讼囹圄冤鬼；勾陈土神禾黍社稷工巧折跌之鬼；螣蛇妖邪怪异飞游砍伐绳结惊狂之鬼；白虎金甲之神丧服之祟；玄武强梁之神盗贼河井妓女之魄

rule.yi: 青龙的象，是掌管喜庆财利的神，东方的圣贤，文官班列里的师相；是桃李的精怪，是胎产而死的鬼。朱雀也是离的神，掌管词讼、纠察善恶，掌管交易，主管生育，守在端门，权衡中鼎；是言语触犯了天曹，或者是牢里被冤枉的鬼。勾陈是一位土神，掌管禾黍，主管社稷；是工匠巧人的亡魂，是摔断跌伤的鬼。螣蛇属火，是黄帝的左右；是妖邪怪异的骚扰，是飞游砍伐的神，是绳结、惊狂的鬼。白虎是金甲的神，是丧服的祟，是兵灾凶险、老虎横行，被称作元帅的就像它。北方的玄武，是强横的神，是盗贼的鬼，是河里井里死去的，是妓女的魂。注说：卦里有两个鬼，上面的鬼临哪个六神、下面的鬼临哪个六神，用六神的象来断，是这样的。
rule.en: The image of the Azure Dragon: a spirit in charge of festivity and gain, a sage of the east, a teacher-minister among the civil ranks; a demon of peach and plum, a ghost of childbirth. The Vermilion Bird is also a spirit of Li: it presides over suits, oversees good and evil, has charge of trade and governs birth, hunts at the Main Gate and weighs the central cauldron; a case of words offending the Heavenly Bureau, or a ghost wrongly imprisoned. Hook Earth is an earth spirit, in charge of millet and grain and governing the altars of soil and grain; the departed spirit of a craftsman, a ghost of breaks and falls. The Coiling Snake belongs to Fire and attends the Yellow Emperor; it is the disturbance of demons and oddities, a spirit of flying wanderers and felling, a ghost of knotted cords, fright and madness. The White Tiger is a golden-armoured spirit, a haunting of mourning dress, the disaster of weapons and the rampage of tigers; those called marshals are its image. The Dark Tortoise of the north is a violent spirit, a ghost of thieves and bandits, one who died in a river or well, the soul of a prostitute. The note says: where the hexagram has two ghosts, whichever spirit the upper one carries and whichever the lower one carries, judgment by the images of the six spirits is as above.

note.yi: 「元武」是「玄武」避讳的写法。朱雀那一句「狩端门，权中鼎」原文很简，「端门」是宫殿的正门，「中鼎」是中央的鼎，这里照字面译，没有加解释。与黄金策六神推鬼神（LY.ILL.HJC.96）、易隐鬼崇六神（LY.ILL.YY.17）是同一件事：白虎都是血、丧、兵一路，玄武都是盗贼、暗昧一路，青龙都是喜庆一路，细目不同。
note.en: 'Yuan wu' is the taboo-avoiding form of 'Xuan wu' (the Dark Tortoise). The Vermilion Bird's 'hunts at the Main Gate and weighs the central cauldron' is very terse in the original; the 'Main Gate' is the front gate of a palace and the 'central cauldron' the cauldron at the centre, and both are translated literally without explanation. It treats the same matter as the Huangjin Ce's reading by the six spirits (LY.ILL.HJC.96) and the Yi Yin's six spirits in haunting (LY.ILL.YY.17): the White Tiger is always of the blood, mourning and weapons kind, the Dark Tortoise of thieves and obscurity, the Azure Dragon of festivity, with details differing.

zh: 青龙之为象也，司喜庆财利之神，东方圣贤，文班之师相，为桃李之妖，胎产之鬼也。
朱雀亦离神也，司词讼、紏善恶，掌交易，主生育，狩端门，权中鼎，或言语之干天曹，或囹圄之妄冤鬼也。
勾陈一土神也，司禾黍，主社稷，为工巧之亡，折跌之鬼也。
螣蛇属火，黄帝之左右也，为妖邪怪异之扰，飞游砍伐之神，绳结惊狂之鬼也。
白虎为金甲之神，为丧服之祟，兵凶虎横，称呼元帅者像焉。
北方元武，强梁之神，盗贼之鬼，河井之亡，妓女之魄也。
yi: 青龙的象，是掌管喜庆财利的神，东方的圣贤，文官班列里的师相；是桃李的精怪，是胎产而死的鬼。
朱雀也是离的神，掌管词讼、纠察善恶，掌管交易，主管生育，守在端门，权衡中鼎；是言语触犯了天曹，或者是牢里被冤枉的鬼。
勾陈是一位土神，掌管禾黍，主管社稷；是工匠巧人的亡魂，是摔断跌伤的鬼。
螣蛇属火，是黄帝的左右；是妖邪怪异的骚扰，是飞游砍伐的神，是绳结、惊狂的鬼。
白虎是金甲的神，是丧服的祟，是兵灾凶险、老虎横行，被称作元帅的就像它。
北方的玄武，是强横的神，是盗贼的鬼，是河里井里死去的，是妓女的魂。
en: The image of the Azure Dragon: a spirit in charge of festivity and gain, a sage of the east, a teacher-minister among the civil ranks; a demon of peach and plum, a ghost of childbirth.

The Vermilion Bird is also a spirit of Li: it presides over suits, oversees good and evil, has charge of trade and governs birth, hunts at the Main Gate and weighs the central cauldron; a case of words offending the Heavenly Bureau, or a ghost wrongly imprisoned.
Hook Earth is an earth spirit, in charge of millet and grain and governing the altars of soil and grain; the departed spirit of a craftsman, a ghost of breaks and falls.
The Coiling Snake belongs to Fire and attends the Yellow Emperor; it is the disturbance of demons and oddities, a spirit of flying wanderers and felling, a ghost of knotted cords, fright and madness.
The White Tiger is a golden-armoured spirit, a haunting of mourning dress, the disaster of weapons and the rampage of tigers; those called marshals are its image.
The Dark Tortoise of the north is a violent spirit, a ghost of thieves and bandits, one who died in a river or well, the soul of a prostitute.

zh: 卦得二鬼，上临何神，下临何神，以六神像断如此。
yi: 卦里有两个鬼，上面的鬼临哪个六神、下面的鬼临哪个六神，用六神的象来断，是这样的。
en: Where the hexagram has two ghosts, whichever spirit the upper one carries and whichever the lower one carries, judgment by the images of the six spirits is as above.

title: 按六亲断神鬼：父母为祖先、妻财为臣妾、兄弟为手足之缠、子孙为儿女之孽，世是本宗、应是异姓；六亲有动以六亲象断，化鬼及独发者尤甚

rule.yi: 父母爻是祖先，妻财爻是臣妾，兄弟爻是手足纠缠，子孙爻是儿女带来的孽；世是本宗，应是异姓。注说：六亲有动的，用六亲的象来断；只有变出鬼的和独自发动的，尤其厉害；世是本家的鬼，应是别姓的亡魂。
rule.en: The Resource line is the ancestors, the Wealth line is servants and concubines, the Peer line is the entanglement of brothers and kin, and the Output line is the affliction of sons and daughters; the Self is the same lineage, and the Other is a different surname. The note says: where a relation line moves, judgment by the images of the six relations is as above; one that changes into a ghost or moves alone is especially severe; the Self is a ghost of one's own house, and the Other is the departed of another surname.

note.yi: 这一条的用法是：官鬼旁边的六亲爻在动，或者官鬼变成了某个六亲，就按那个六亲去认是谁的鬼。和黄金策「鬼动化出六亲即以化出者断」（LY.ILL.HJC.108）、易隐「鬼崇是谁的鬼」（LY.ILL.YY.30）是同一件事；易冒的写法更短，只列六亲各是谁（父母祖先、妻财臣妾、兄弟手足、子孙儿女），没有再分阴阳老少。注里的这一段夹在正文中间，原文的括号在「他姓亡也」处收尾，后面的「犯亥子……」仍是正文（见 LY.ILL.YM.61）。
note.en: The use is this: when a relation line beside the Pressure line moves, or the Pressure line changes into a certain relation, one identifies whose ghost it is by that relation. It is the same matter as the Huangjin Ce's 'a ghost moving into a relation is judged by what it turns into' (LY.ILL.HJC.108) and the Yi Yin's 'whose ghost it is' (LY.ILL.YY.30); the Yi Mao writes it more briefly, listing only who each relation is (Resource the ancestors, Wealth servants and concubines, Peer brothers and kin, Output sons and daughters), without going on to divide by yin and yang, old and young. The note in this passage sits in the middle of the running text, the original bracket closing at 'the departed of another surname', and the 'if it offends Hai and Zi...' that follows is still the text (see LY.ILL.YM.61).

zh: 父母为祖先，妻财为臣妾，兄弟为手足之缠，子孙为儿女之孽，世是本宗，应是异姓。
yi: 父母爻是祖先，妻财爻是臣妾，兄弟爻是手足纠缠，子孙爻是儿女带来的孽；世是本宗，应是异姓。
en: The Resource line is the ancestors, the Wealth line is servants and concubines, the Peer line is the entanglement of brothers and kin, and the Output line is the affliction of sons and daughters; the Self is the same lineage, and the Other is a different surname.

zh: 六亲有动，则以六亲像断如此。
世，本家鬼也，应，他姓亡也。
yi: 六亲有动的，就用六亲的象来断，是这样的。
只有变出鬼的和独自发动的，尤其厉害。
世是本家的鬼，应是别姓的亡魂。
en: Where a relation line moves, judgment by the images of the six relations is as above.
One that changes into a ghost or moves alone is especially severe.
The Self is a ghost of one's own house, and the Other is the departed of another surname.

title: 按十二支断神鬼：犯亥子则天将斗神可祷、犯巳午则火德财神可禳、树神东岳乃寅卯之官、佛氏丧车乃申酉之象、辰戌为处处之土神、丑未为家家之地鬼

rule.yi: 犯了亥、子，就是天将斗神，可以祷告；犯了巳、午，就是火德财神，可以禳解；树神、东岳，是寅、卯的官；佛家的丧车，是申、酉的象；辰、戌是处处都有的土神，丑、未是家家都有的地鬼。注说：十二支的神值在鬼上，就用十二支的象来断，是这样的。
rule.en: If it offends Hai and Zi, the Heavenly Generals and the spirit of the Dipper may be prayed to; if it offends Si and Wu, the Fire Virtue and the god of wealth may be exorcised; the tree spirit and the Eastern Peak are officials of Yin and Mao; the Buddhist funeral carriage is the image of Shen and You; Chen and Xu are the earth spirits found everywhere, and Chou and Wei the earth ghosts found in every house. The note says: where a spirit of the twelve branches sits on the ghost, judgment by the images of the twelve branches is as above.

note.yi: 原文里这一段跨了两行：第三句「树神东岳，乃寅卯之官，佛氏丧车，」在上一行结尾，「乃申酉之象；」在下一行开头，这里合起来读。「亥子」是北、水，配天将斗神；「巳午」是南、火，配火德财神；「寅卯」是东、木，配树神东岳；「申酉」是西、金，配佛家丧车。「辰戌」与「丑未」是四土，分成处处的土神和家家的地鬼。「可祷」「可禳」两个词分开用：亥子是神，可以向它祷告；巳午是火德财神，是可以禳解的。
note.en: In the original this passage runs over two lines: the third sentence, 'the tree spirit and the Eastern Peak are officials of Yin and Mao, the Buddhist funeral carriage', ends the first line and 'is the image of Shen and You' begins the next, and they are read here together. Hai and Zi are north and Water, matched with the Heavenly Generals and the spirit of the Dipper; Si and Wu are south and Fire, matched with the Fire Virtue and the god of wealth; Yin and Mao are east and Wood, matched with the tree spirit and the Eastern Peak; Shen and You are west and Metal, matched with the Buddhist funeral carriage. Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei are the four Earths, divided into the earth spirits found everywhere and the earth ghosts found in every house. 'May be prayed to' and 'may be exorcised' are used separately: with Hai and Zi it is a spirit that may be prayed to, and with Si and Wu it is the Fire Virtue and the god of wealth, which may be exorcised.

zh: 犯亥子，则天将斗神可祷也；
犯巳午，则火德财神可禳也；
树神东岳，乃寅卯之官，佛氏丧车，乃申酉之象；
辰戌为处处之土神，丑未为家家之地鬼。
yi: 犯了亥、子，就是天将斗神，可以祷告；
犯了巳、午，就是火德财神，可以禳解；
树神、东岳，是寅、卯的官；佛家的丧车，是申、酉的象；
辰、戌是处处都有的土神，丑、未是家家都有的地鬼。
en: If it offends Hai and Zi, the Heavenly Generals and the spirit of the Dipper may be prayed to;
if it offends Si and Wu, the Fire Virtue and the god of wealth may be exorcised;
the tree spirit and the Eastern Peak are officials of Yin and Mao; the Buddhist funeral carriage is the image of Shen and You;
Chen and Xu are the earth spirits found everywhere, and Chou and Wei the earth ghosts found in every house.

zh: 十二支神值鬼，则以十二支像断如此。
yi: 十二支的神值在鬼上，就用十二支的象来断，是这样的。
en: Where a spirit of the twelve branches sits on the ghost, judgment by the images of the twelve branches is as above.

title: 按诸星断神鬼：贵人冠冕之神、天喜利市吉庆、丧门丧服、天火火德天触灶司天贼强梁劫夺、天狱笞杖徒流、官符主讼、羊刃司兵、驿马商旅之冤、天河觉溺之屈、华盖僧道、咸池娼妓、暗金产妇、太岁土德、刀针斩绞、坵墓坟茔、丧车棺椁、浴盆婴童之溺、孤神绝嗣之鬼

rule.yi: 还有官鬼出现在贵人上的，是戴冠冕的神；天喜，是带来生意兴隆、吉庆的神；丧门，是丧服的神；天火、火德、天触、灶司、天贼，是强横劫夺而死的亡魂；天狱，是受笞刑、杖刑、徒刑、流放的鬼；官符主管诉讼，羊刃掌管兵刃，驿马是行商旅客的冤魂，天河是溺水者的冤屈；华盖是僧人道士，咸池是娼妓，暗金是产妇，血衂是血鬼；太岁是土德；刀针是被斩杀、绞死、受伤，坵墓是坟墓的咎，丧车是棺椁的殃，折煞是摔断跌伤的鬼；飞廉是游神，将星是武神，天医是医神，天马是被马踏的；浴盆是婴孩溺死，摧尸是伏尸的祸，孤神是断了后嗣的鬼；太阴、月德从王母那里受福，太阳、天德靠上帝保佑。注说：鬼临哪颗星宿，就用诸星的象来断；天河是水库，是天上浩大的府库，所以从辰起逐月顺行，刀针是金宿，正月应当从乾起，所以从亥起顺行；其余详见诸星章。
rule.en: Further, a Pressure line appearing on the Noble is a spirit in cap and robes of office; Heavenly Joy is a spirit of good trade and celebration; Mourning Gate is a spirit of mourning dress; Heavenly Fire, Fire Virtue, Heavenly Touch, Stove Official and Heavenly Thief are the departed of violence and robbery; Heavenly Prison is a ghost of flogging, beating, penal servitude and exile; Official Talisman presides over lawsuits, Goat Blade governs weapons, the Post Horse is the grievance of merchants and travellers, and Heavenly River is the wrong of the drowned; Huagai is monks and Daoists, Xianchi is courtesans, Hidden Metal is women in childbirth, and Bleeding is a blood ghost; the Tai Sui is the Earth Virtue; Blade and Needle is beheading, strangling and wounds, Mounds and Tombs is the fault of the graves, Funeral Carriage is the misfortune of coffins, and Breaking Killing is a ghost of breaks and falls; Feilian is the wandering spirit, the General Star is the martial spirit, Heavenly Doctor is the medicine spirit, and Heavenly Horse is trampling by a horse; Bath Basin is the drowning of infants, Corpse Breaker is the calamity of the buried corpse, and Lone Spirit is a ghost with no heir; Great Yin and Month Virtue receive blessing from the Queen Mother, the Sun and Heavenly Virtue depend on the protection of the Supreme Lord. The note says: whichever star the ghost falls on, judgment by the images of the various stars is as above; Heavenly River is a water store, the vast treasury of heaven, and so it runs forward month by month starting from Chen; Blade and Needle is a Metal lodge, and the first month should start from Qian, so it begins at Hai and runs forward; the rest is detailed in the chapter on the stars.

note.yi: 「天火、火德，天触、灶司、天贼，强梁劫夺之亡」这一句，谓语「强横劫夺而死的亡魂」管到哪几个星，原文的逗号并不清楚，这里照字面把它放在这一串的末尾。「天河为觉溺之屈」的「觉溺」原文没有解释，这里按字面译作「觉后溺水」，读法没有把握。星名的译名在本仓库各处保持一致：咸池 Xianchi、驿马 Post Horse、浴盆 Bath Basin、丧车 Funeral Carriage。这些星怎么查，详见易冒诸星章。
note.en: In 'Heavenly Fire, Fire Virtue, Heavenly Touch, Stove Official, Heavenly Thief: the departed of violence and robbery', it is not clear from the commas how many of the stars the predicate 'the departed of violence and robbery' extends to, and it is placed literally at the end of the run. The 'awake-drown' in 'Heavenly River is the wrong of those who wake to drown' is not explained in the original, and is translated literally as 'wake to drown', the reading being uncertain. Star names (Noble, Heavenly Joy, Mourning Gate, Heavenly Fire, Heavenly Prison, Official Talisman, Goat Blade, Post Horse, Heavenly River, Huagai, Xianchi and so on) keep the same renderings used elsewhere in this repository: Xianchi, Post Horse, Bath Basin, Funeral Carriage. How the stars and spirit-stars are found is set out in the Yi Mao's chapters on the stars.

zh: 犹有官鬼现于贵人者，冠冕之神也；
天喜者，利市吉庆之神也；
天火、火德，天触、灶司、天贼，强梁劫夺之亡；
官符主讼，羊刃司兵，驿马为商旅之冤，天河为觉溺之屈；
华盖，僧道也，咸池，娼妓也，暗金，产妇也，血衂，血鬼也；
刀针，斩绞伤也，坵墓，坟茔之咎，丧车，棺椁之殃，折煞，折跌之鬼；
飞廉，游神，将星，武神，天医，医神，天马，马踏；
浴盆，婴童之溺，摧尸，伏尸之祸，孤神，绝嗣之鬼；
太阴月德，受福于王母，太阳天德，赖祐于上帝也。
yi: 还有官鬼出现在贵人上的，是戴冠冕的神；
天喜，是带来生意兴隆、吉庆的神；
丧门，是丧服的神；
天火、火德、天触、灶司、天贼，是强横劫夺而死的亡魂；
天狱，是受笞刑、杖刑、徒刑、流放的鬼；
官符主管诉讼，羊刃掌管兵刃，驿马是行商旅客的冤魂，天河是觉后溺水的冤屈；
华盖是僧人道士，咸池是娼妓，暗金是产妇，血衂是血鬼；
太岁是土德；
刀针是被斩杀、绞死、受伤，坵墓是坟墓的咎，丧车是棺椁的殃，折煞是摔断跌伤的鬼；
飞廉是游神，将星是武神，天医是医神，天马是被马踏的；
浴盆是婴孩溺死，摧尸是伏尸的祸，孤神是断了后嗣的鬼；
太阴、月德从王母那里受福，太阳、天德靠上帝保佑。
en: Further, a Pressure line appearing on the Noble is a spirit in cap and robes of office;
Heavenly Joy is a spirit of good trade and celebration;
Mourning Gate is a spirit of mourning dress;
Heavenly Fire, Fire Virtue, Heavenly Touch, Stove Official and Heavenly Thief are the departed of violence, robbery and plunder;
Heavenly Prison is a ghost of flogging, beating, penal servitude and exile;
Official Talisman presides over lawsuits, Goat Blade governs weapons, the Post Horse is the grievance of merchants and travellers, and Heavenly River is the wrong of those who wake to drown;
Huagai is monks and Daoists, Xianchi is courtesans, Hidden Metal is women in childbirth, and Bleeding is a blood ghost;
the Tai Sui is the Earth Virtue;
Blade and Needle is beheading, strangling and wounds, Mounds and Tombs is the fault of the graves, Funeral Carriage is the misfortune of coffins, and Breaking Killing is a ghost of breaks and falls;
Feilian is the wandering spirit, the General Star is the martial spirit, Heavenly Doctor is the medicine spirit, and Heavenly Horse is trampling by a horse;
Bath Basin is the drowning of infants, Corpse Breaker is the calamity of the buried corpse, and Lone Spirit is a ghost with no heir;
Great Yin and Month Virtue receive blessing from the Queen Mother; the Sun and Heavenly Virtue depend on the protection of the Supreme Lord.

zh: 鬼值何宿，则以诸星像断如此。
天河水库，乃天之浩府，故正自辰逐月顺行，刀针金宿，正月当自乾起，故始亥顺行也。
yi: 鬼临哪颗星宿，就用诸星的象来断，是这样的。
天河是水库，是天上浩大的府库，所以从辰起，逐月顺行；刀针是金宿，正月应当从乾起，所以从亥起、顺着走。
其余详见诸星章。
en: Whichever star the ghost falls on, judgment by the images of the various stars is as above.

Heavenly River is a water store, the vast treasury of heaven, and so it runs forward month by month starting from Chen; Blade and Needle is a Metal lodge, and the first month should start from Qian, so it begins at Hai and runs forward.
The rest is detailed in the chapter on the stars.

title: 察鬼神但以五行八宫变化而像之，必实指鬼神而泥之则诬：四穹之内无处非鬼神，各乡所尊不同，千古之上未有之神何所知，千古之下再成之神何所拟

rule.yi: 天地四方之内，没有哪里没有鬼神，但各地方各有风俗所尊奉的，地水火风所掌管的，有的只显灵在一个乡，有的应验在一个国，很难一一细说。俗话说，千古以前还没有的神，怎么知道；千古以后再成的神，又拿什么去比拟。考察鬼神，只要用五行、八宫，变化着去取象，作为后学的规范，古今都能通用。如果一定要落实指定是哪位鬼神、还死抠着不放，那就是诬妄了。
rule.en: Within the four vaults of heaven there is no place without ghosts and spirits, yet each quarter has those its customs revere and those that earth, water, fire and wind govern, some manifest in a single village, some proving true over a whole country, hard to set out one by one. It is said: of spirits that did not exist a thousand ages ago, how can they be known; of spirits that will come to be a thousand ages hence, what can they be compared to. In examining ghosts and spirits, simply take the image by the five phases and the eight palaces with their changes, as a pattern for later learners, and it applies to past and present alike. To point insistently at a particular ghost or spirit and cling to it is to make a false claim.

dispute.yi: 要不要落实到某一位神：易冒在本章前面（LY.ILL.YM.44 到 YM.62）列了大量神名，这里却说「必实指鬼神而泥之，则诬矣」，前后的关系是：名单是举例，办法是用五行八宫去取象。增删卜易的觉子和李我平批评的是把名单当成定论，即金官就指关公岳公（LY.ILL.ZS.24、ZS.25），而且李我平点名批评了《易冒》指定关岳、并说本书疾病章讲鬼神是「从俗」；从这一段看，易冒自己在这里已经说了不能泥于某一位。黄金策（LY.ILL.HJC.93 到 HJC.104）和易隐（LY.ILL.YY.28）则直接给出神名和鬼的死因，没有这样的收束。
dispute.en: Whether to pin it to a particular god: the Yi Mao lists a large number of names earlier in the chapter (LY.ILL.YM.44 to YM.62), yet here says 'to point insistently at a particular ghost or spirit and cling to it is to make a false claim'; the relation between the two is that the lists are examples and the method is to take the image by the five phases and the eight palaces. What Jue Zi and Li Woping of the Zengshan Buyi criticise is taking the list as a conclusion, that is, naming Guan Gong or Yue Gong at once for a Metal Pressure line (LY.ILL.ZS.24, ZS.25), and Li Woping names the Yi Mao for pinning Guan and Yue and says its talk of ghosts and spirits in the illness chapter 'follows the common custom'; from this passage the Yi Mao itself already says here that one must not cling to a particular one. The Huangjin Ce (LY.ILL.HJC.93 to HJC.104) and the Yi Yin (LY.ILL.YY.28) give names of gods and the causes of death of ghosts directly, without such a closing qualification.

note.yi: 「地水火风」是佛家说的四大，这里指各地方由地、水、火、风所司的神。「千古而上，未有之神何所知」这句话的意思是，一个人死后成神，是后来的事；古书里没有的神，不能用古书去对。这一段在 LY.ILL.YM.42 总纲里埋下的「鬼神不是全然虚妄」和这里的「必实指而泥之则诬」合在一起，就是这一章的态度：承认有，但不为一个具体的名字负责。
note.en: 'Earth, water, fire and wind' are the four elements of the Buddhist teaching, here the spirits of each place that are governed by earth, water, fire and wind. 'Of spirits that did not exist a thousand ages ago, how can they be known' means that a person becoming a spirit after death is a later matter, and a spirit not found in the old books cannot be matched against the old books. What was planted in the outline (LY.ILL.YM.42), 'ghosts and spirits are not wholly false', together with this 'to point insistently and cling to it is to make a false claim', is the attitude of the chapter: to admit that they exist, but not to answer for any particular name.

zh: 夫四穹之内，无处而非鬼神，然有方隅风俗之所尊，地水火风之所司，或显一乡，或征一国，难以繁陈。
语谓千古而上，未有之神何所知，千古而下，再成之神何所拟。
察鬼神者，但以五行八宫，变化而像之，以为后学之范，虽今古可通也。
必实指鬼神而泥之，则诬矣。
yi: 天地四方之内，没有哪里没有鬼神，但各地方各有风俗所尊奉的，地水火风所掌管的，有的只显灵在一个乡，有的应验在一个国，很难一一细说。
俗话说，千古以前还没有的神，怎么知道；千古以后再成的神，又拿什么去比拟。
考察鬼神，只要用五行、八宫，变化着去取象，作为后学的规范，那么古今都能通用。
如果一定要落实指定是哪位鬼神、还死抠着不放，那就是诬妄了。
en: Within the four vaults of heaven there is no place without ghosts and spirits, yet each quarter has those its customs revere and those that earth, water, fire and wind govern, some manifest in a single village, some proving true over a whole country, hard to set out one by one.
It is said: of spirits that did not exist a thousand ages ago, how can they be known; of spirits that will come to be a thousand ages hence, what can they be compared to.
In examining ghosts and spirits, simply take the image by the five phases and the eight palaces with their changes, as a pattern for later learners, and it applies to past and present alike.
To point insistently at a particular ghost or spirit and cling to it is to make a false claim.

title: 神多为祐、鬼多为祟，灾病多因自孽：不洗心悔过而聚巫陈牲媚鬼神，鬼神未必享；炰杀生命以祈己命，益重其孽；祭祀莫善于解禳，解禳莫善于修身

rule.yi: 大体上神多半是保佑的，鬼多半是作祟的；灾病的到来，多半是自己造的孽。如果不洗心悔过、除掉孽的根本，只是聚集巫师、摆上牲畜去讨好鬼神，鬼神未必享用。何况宰杀生灵来为自己的性命祈祷，那是加重自己的罪孽。所以说：祭祀没有比解禳更好的，解禳没有比修身更好的，说的就是这个。我在鬼神这一章里，再三告诫。
rule.en: In general spirits mostly bless and ghosts mostly haunt; for calamity and illness mostly come from one's own doing, and if one does not cleanse the heart and repent to remove the root of the fault, but merely gathers shamans and lays out animal victims to please ghosts and spirits, the ghosts and spirits will not necessarily partake. How much more so to roast and slaughter living creatures to pray for my own life: that only makes the fault heavier. Hence it is said: of sacrifice none is better than exorcism, and of exorcism none is better than cultivating oneself; this is what it means. In this chapter on ghosts and spirits I have given warning again and again.

dispute.yi: 祭祀送鬼有没有用：易冒说灾病多因自孽，不修身而只靠巫祝牲牢献媚鬼神，鬼神未必享用，杀生祈命更是加重罪孽，祭祀最好不过解禳、解禳最好不过修身；增删卜易的野鹤同样反对靠杀牲救命（LY.ILL.ZS.25），但承认时灾瘟癖照法祭送屡验；黄金策（LY.ILL.HJC.93、HJC.50）和易隐（LY.ILL.YY.27、YY.31）则把祈禳的对象、祭品、方法一项项讲出来，把祭祀当作要认真做的事。三家不是互相否定，重点不同：易冒重修身，野鹤按病分，黄金策和易隐重办法。
dispute.en: Whether sacrifice and sending away ghosts is of use: the Yi Mao says calamity and illness mostly come from one's own doing, that without cultivating oneself, currying favour with ghosts and spirits by means of shamans and animal victims is not necessarily partaken of, that slaughtering to pray for life makes the fault heavier, and that of sacrifice none is better than exorcism and of exorcism none is better than cultivating oneself; the Old Man of Yehe in the Zengshan Buyi likewise opposes slaughter to save a life (LY.ILL.ZS.25), but admits that sacrifice and sending away by the method has been proved many times for seasonal calamities and abdominal masses; the Huangjin Ce (LY.ILL.HJC.93, HJC.50) and the Yi Yin (LY.ILL.YY.27, YY.31) set out object, offering and method of prayer and exorcism item by item and treat sacrifice as something to be done with care. The three do not deny one another; their emphasis differs: the Yi Mao stresses self-cultivation, the Old Man of Yehe distinguishes by illness, the Huangjin Ce and the Yi Yin stress procedure.

note.yi: 「炰杀生命」的「炰」是煮烤，「牲」是祭祀用的牲畜，「巫」是巫师。「吾于鬼神章，兽三致戒云」的「兽」字放在这里说不通，像是「再」「屡」一类字的误刻；「三致戒」是再三告诫，这一层意思是清楚的，这里译成「再三告诫」，没有替这个字定读音。「祭祀莫善于解禳，解禳莫善于修身」是作者引的成语（前面有「故曰」），书里没有说出处。这一句正是 LY.ILL.YM.55 里「伏鬼若空则无鬼祟，惟修德」的落点。
note.en: 'Roast and slaughter' (pao sha) is boiling and roasting, 'victims' are the animals used in sacrifice, and 'shamans' are wu. The 'shou' (beast) in 'in the chapter on ghosts and spirits I have given warning shou-three times' does not make sense here and looks like a miscarved form of a word such as 'again' or 'repeatedly'; that it means 'has given warning three times over', that is, again and again, is clear, and it is rendered 'again and again' without deciding what the character should be. 'Of sacrifice none is better than exorcism, and of exorcism none is better than cultivating oneself' is quoted by the author as a saying (it is introduced by 'hence it is said'), and the book gives no source. This sentence is where 'if the hidden ghost is also Void there is no haunting, and only cultivating virtue remains' in LY.ILL.YM.55 lands.

zh: 大抵神多为祐，鬼多为祟，盖灾病之来，多因自孽，若不洗心悔过，以除孽本，徒聚巫陈牲以媚鬼神，鬼神未必享也。
况炰杀生命，以祈我之命，是益重其孽也。
故曰：祭祀莫善于解禳，解禳莫善于修身，此之谓也。
吾于鬼神章，兽三致戒云。
yi: 大体上神多半是保佑的，鬼多半是作祟的；因为灾病的到来，多半是自己造的孽，如果不洗心悔过、除掉孽的根本，只是聚集巫师、摆上牲畜去讨好鬼神，鬼神未必享用。
何况宰杀生灵来为自己的性命祈祷，那是加重自己的罪孽。
所以说：祭祀没有比解禳更好的，解禳没有比修身更好的，说的就是这个。
我在鬼神这一章里，再三告诫。
en: In general spirits mostly bless and ghosts mostly haunt; for calamity and illness mostly come from one's own doing, and if one does not cleanse the heart and repent to remove the root of the fault, but merely gathers shamans and lays out animal victims to please ghosts and spirits, the ghosts and spirits will not necessarily partake.
How much more so to roast and slaughter living creatures to pray for my own life: that only makes the fault heavier.
Hence it is said: of sacrifice none is better than exorcism, and of exorcism none is better than cultivating oneself; this is what it means.
In this chapter on ghosts and spirits I have given warning again and again.

title: 占疾病要慎而详：大端有四——占死生、占病症、占医药、占鬼崇；病何日起、病何处得是疾病的附占（游南子）

rule.yi: 人不幸有了病来占，不可以不谨慎、不周详。大的方面有四件事：占他是死是活，占他是什么病症，占医和药，占有没有鬼崇；至于病是哪一天起的、在哪里得的，是疾病附带要占的事。
rule.en: When a person is unfortunate enough to fall ill and divines about it, one must be careful and thorough. There are four main heads: whether he will live or die, what the illness is, doctors and medicine, and ghostly influences; when the illness began and where it was caught are subsidiary matters of illness.

note.yi: 「病症」在这里是病是什么样的症候，「鬼崇」是鬼神作祟。易隐这一章正是按这四件事排的：二、生死；三、病症；六、医药；七、鬼崇，另有四、病因，五、饮食，八、病起何方，九、病起何年月日。增删卜易的李我平也把来问的事分成吉凶、犯了什么鬼神、病源三类（见 LY.ILL.ZS.39）。
note.en: 'Bingzheng' here is the pattern of symptoms the illness shows, and 'guisui' is ghosts and spirits making trouble. The chapter of the Yi Yin is arranged by just these heads: 2 life and death, 3 symptoms, 6 doctors and medicine, 7 ghostly influences, with 4 the cause of the illness, 5 food and drink, 8 where the illness arose and 9 when it arose in addition. Li Woping in the Zengshan Buyi likewise sorts the matters asked into fortune, which ghost or spirit was offended, and the source of the illness (see LY.ILL.ZS.39).

zh: 游南子曰，夫人不幸有疾而占之，不可不慎而详也。
然大端有四，占其死生，占其病症，占其医药，占其鬼崇而已。
若乃病何日起，病何处得，亦疾病之附占也。
yi: 游南子说：人不幸有了病来占，不可以不谨慎、不周详。
然而大的方面有四件：占他的死活，占他的病症，占他的医药，占有没有鬼崇，仅此而已。
至于病是哪一天起的、在哪里得的，也是疾病的附带占问。
en: Master Younan says: when a person is unfortunate enough to fall ill and divines about it, one cannot but be careful and thorough.
But the main heads are four: divine whether he lives or dies, divine the symptoms, divine the doctors and medicine, and divine the ghostly influences, and that is all.
As for what day the illness began and where it was caught, these too are subsidiary questions of illness.

title: 鬼谷分爻：六爻各配身体部位和一个吉凶名——六爻头脑黄泉、五爻心肺棺椁、四爻脾脏福德、三爻肝肾哭声、二爻腿股吊客、初爻足丧门

rule.yi: 鬼谷把六爻这样分：六爻是头脑，配黄泉；五爻是心肺，配棺椁；四爻是脾脏，配福德；三爻是肝肾，配哭声；二爻是腿和大腿，配吊客；初爻是足，配丧门。
rule.en: Guigu divides the six lines as follows: the sixth line is the head and brain, matched with the Yellow Springs; the fifth is the heart and lungs, with the Coffin; the fourth is the spleen, with Fortune; the third is the liver and kidneys, with Wailing; the second is the legs and thighs, with the Guest of Condolence; the first is the feet, with the Mourning Gate.

note.yi: 表是分两栏排的，书里没有说是从哪一爻排起。按后面「又分宫」一段（初爻是足，二爻股膝，三爻腹腰，四爻胸胃乳，五爻面项手，六爻头脑），头脑在六爻、足在初爻，可知表是从六爻往下排到初爻；右栏的黄泉、棺椁、福德、哭声、吊客、丧门书里没有解释，按字面译。「福德」在这里是这一爻配的名目，不是六亲里的子孙。
note.en: The table is set out in two columns and the book does not say which line it starts from. By the later passage 'again by the division of the lines' (first line the feet, second the thighs and knees, third the belly and waist, fourth the chest, stomach and breasts, fifth the face, neck and hands, sixth the head and brain), the head is on the sixth line and the feet on the first, so the table runs from the sixth line down to the first; the right column — Yellow Springs, Coffin, Fortune, Wailing, Guest of Condolence, Mourning Gate — is not explained in the book and is rendered literally. 'Fortune' (fude) here is the name matched to that line and is not the Output line of the six relations.

yi: 鬼谷分爻（表）：
头脑，黄泉；
心肺，棺椁；
脾脏，福德；
肝肾，哭声；
腿股，吊客；
足，丧门。
en: Guigu's division of the lines (table):
head and brain, the Yellow Springs;
heart and lungs, the Coffin;
spleen, Fortune;
liver and kidneys, Wailing;
legs and thighs, the Guest of Condolence;
feet, the Mourning Gate.

title: 占病取用爻：自占以世爻、身爻、命爻为用，代占以应爻为用；占家亲祖妣用官鬼、父兄妻子各以所属；五属不上卦从《黄金策》分爻取用；奴占家主用五爻、占主母用二爻

rule.yi: 占病取用爻：自己占，拿世爻、身爻、命爻做用；替别人占，拿应爻做用。占家里的亲人，祖父祖母用官鬼，父亲、兄弟、妻子、子女各用自己所属的那一类爻；这五类亲属如果不上卦，就按《黄金策》分爻的办法取用。奴仆丁口占家主，拿五爻做用；占主母，拿二爻做用。
rule.en: Taking the Subject line in divining illness: in divining for oneself, the Self line, the Body line and the destiny line are the Subject; in divining for another, the Other line is the Subject. In divining for kin of the household, grandfather and grandmother use the Pressure line, and father, brother, wife and child each use the relation to which they belong; if these five kinds of relative do not appear in the hexagram, take the Subject by the Huangjin Ce's division of the lines. A servant or hired hand divining for the master of the house takes the fifth line as the Subject, and for the mistress the second line.

dispute.yi: 代占取哪一爻：易隐说代占以应爻为用，但占家里的亲人又各用所属的六亲；黄金策的旧注和王洪绪对这一点也不一致，旧注说自占以世为主、代占以应为主，王洪绪说占夫用官、占妻用财、按所占的人取（见 LY.ILL.HJC.33）。增删卜易则按所占的人取用神，不取应爻。
dispute.en: Which line to take in divining for another: the Yi Yin says the Other line is the Subject in divining for another, yet for kin of the household it takes each relation as its own; the old commentary and Wang Hongxu on the Huangjin Ce also disagree on this, the old commentary saying the Self is the master in divining for oneself and the Other in divining for another, and Wang Hongxu taking Pressure for a husband and Wealth for a wife, by the person divined (see LY.ILL.HJC.33). The Zengshan Buyi takes the Subject by the person divined and does not take the Other line.

note.yi: 「五属」是父母、兄弟、妻财、子孙、官鬼这五类六亲；这里说的「黄金策分爻」是黄金策疾病章讲的按所占是谁取六亲的办法。「身爻」指卦身，「命爻」指本命所在的爻。
note.en: The 'five kinds' are the five relations Resource, Peer, Wealth, Output and Pressure; the 'Huangjin Ce division of the lines' is the way the Huangjin Ce's chapter on illness takes the relation according to who is divined. 'The Body line' means the hexagram Body and 'the destiny line' the line where the person's natal branch stands.

zh: 自占以世爻身爻命爻为用，代占以应爻为用。
占家亲，祖妣用官鬼，父兄妻子，以各属为用。
如五属不上卦者，则从黄金策分爻取用。
若奴丁占家主，以五爻为用。
yi: 自己占，拿世爻、身爻、命爻做用；替别人占，拿应爻做用。
占家里的亲人，祖父祖母用官鬼，父亲、兄弟、妻子、子女各用自己所属的那一类爻。
如果这五类亲属不上卦，就按《黄金策》分爻的办法取用。
如果奴仆丁口占家主，拿五爻做用。
占主母，拿二爻做用。
en: In divining for oneself, the Self line, the Body line and the destiny line are the Subject; in divining for another, the Other line is the Subject.
In divining for kin of the household, grandfather and grandmother use the Pressure line, and father, brother, wife and child each use the relation to which they belong.
If these five kinds of relative do not appear in the hexagram, take the Subject by the Huangjin Ce's division of the lines.
If a servant or hired hand divines for the master of the house, the fifth line is the Subject.
For the mistress of the house, the second line is the Subject.

title: 生死·愈：用爻遇龙福月解天医天喜生合即愈；鬼伤用者子孙生旺临值之日、子孙生合用爻之日、鬼被刑害克冲之日愈；用入胎墓者刑冲胎墓之日愈；死绝者生用之日愈；伏藏而元神旺忌神衰者用爻当值之日愈；可救者待鬼衰身旺世生之日愈

rule.yi: 用爻遇到青龙、福德、月解、天医、天喜这些吉神，临在它上面或者生它、合它，病就会好。鬼伤到用爻的，子孙生旺、当值的那天好，子孙来生用爻、合用爻的那天好，鬼被刑、害、克、冲的那天好。用爻入胎、入墓的，刑冲那个胎、墓的日子好；用爻死、绝的，生它的那天好；用爻在『病』位的，它生旺的那天好；用爻伏藏而原神旺、忌神衰的，用爻当值的那天好；用爻的墓遇空、绝遇生、克用的鬼遇克，都可以救，等鬼衰、身旺、世被生的那天好。
rule.en: If the Subject line meets the auspicious spirits Dragon, Fortune, Month Release, Heavenly Doctor or Heavenly Joy, sitting on it or generating or combining with it, he recovers. If the ghost harms the Subject line, he recovers on the day Output is strong and on duty, on the day Output generates or combines with the Subject line, and on the day the ghost is punished, harmed, controlled or clashed. If the Subject line enters Womb or a tomb, he recovers on the day that punishes or clashes the Womb or tomb; if it is in Death or Extinction, on the day that generates it; if it is at Sickness, on the day it is born or strong; if the Subject line is hidden but the Support is strong and the Adversary weak, on the day the Subject line comes on duty; and if its tomb meets Void, its Extinction meets generation, or the ghost that harms it meets control, he can be saved, and recovers on the day the ghost is weak, the Body strong and the Self generated.

note.yi: 「龙福月解天医天喜」是几个吉神：龙是青龙，福是福德，月解、天医、天喜是神煞，书里没有列表。「胎」是十二长生里的胎位。三个断例都在书末的「附断例」里，这里分别挂在它们验证的判断下：解之困（元神独发又化进神，申酉日愈）、革之困（忌神逢绝、官遇长生，戊申日愈）、履之小畜（财遇长生，甲申日愈）。
note.en: 'The Dragon, Fortune, Month Release, Heavenly Doctor and Heavenly Joy' are auspicious spirits: the Dragon is the Azure Dragon, Fortune is Fude, and Month Release, Heavenly Doctor and Heavenly Joy are spirit-stars, which the book does not list. 'Womb' is the Womb stage of the twelve life stages. The three cases are from the 'appended cases' at the end of the section and are hung here under the judgments they bear out: Xie into Kun (the Support moving alone and changing into an Advancing spirit, cured on a Shen or You day), Ge into Kun (the Adversary meeting Extinction and Pressure meeting Birth, cured on the Wushen day), and Lu into Xiaoxu (Wealth meeting Birth, cured on the Jiashen day).

zh: 用爻遇龙福月解天医天喜临持生合者，即愈也。
鬼伤用者，子孙生旺临值之日愈也，子孙生合用爻之日愈也，鬼被刑害克冲之日愈也。
用入胎墓者，刑冲胎墓之日愈也。
用爻死绝者，生用之日愈也。
用爻值病者，生旺之日愈也。
用爻伏藏而元神旺，忌神衰者，用爻临值之日愈也。
用墓逢空，用绝逢生，用鬼逢克者，可救也，待鬼衰身旺世生之日愈也。
yi: 用爻遇到青龙、福德、月解、天医、天喜这些吉神，临在它上面或者生它、合它的，就会好。
鬼爻伤到用爻的，子孙生旺、当值的那天好，子孙来生用爻、合用爻的那天好，鬼被刑、害、克、冲的那天好。
用爻入了胎、墓的，刑冲那个胎、墓的日子好。
用爻死、绝的，生它的那天好。
用爻正处在『病』位的，它生旺的那天好。
用爻伏藏，而原神旺、忌神衰的，用爻当值的那天好。
用爻的墓遇到空，用爻的绝遇到生，伤用爻的鬼遇到克，这些都可以救，等到鬼衰、身旺、世被生的那天好。
en: If the Subject line meets the Dragon, Fortune, Month Release, Heavenly Doctor or Heavenly Joy, sitting on it or generating or combining with it, he recovers at once.

If the ghost harms the Subject line, he recovers on the day Output is strong and on duty, on the day Output generates or combines with the Subject line, and on the day the ghost is punished, harmed, controlled or clashed.
If the Subject line enters Womb or a tomb, he recovers on the day that punishes or clashes the Womb or tomb.
If the Subject line is in Death or Extinction, he recovers on the day that generates it.
If the Subject line is at the stage of Sickness, he recovers on the day it is born or strong.
If the Subject line is hidden but the Support is strong and the Adversary weak, he recovers on the day the Subject line comes on duty.

If the Subject's tomb meets Void, its Extinction meets generation, or the ghost that harms it meets control, he can be saved, and recovers on the day the ghost is weak, the Body strong and the Self generated.

zh: 庚寅年戊寅月辛未日，子占父病，得解之困。
本宫子水父母，伏寅木之下，虽云泄气，喜申金，元神独发，又化进神，更得日辰生之，决能生父。
惟不宜土财持世，喜岁月与伏下寅木克之，果于申酉日愈也。
yi: 庚寅年戊寅月辛未日，儿子占父亲的病，得到解卦变困卦。
本宫的子水父母爻伏在寅木下面，虽然说被泄气，但喜有申金原神独自发动，又变出进神，再得日辰生它，一定能生扶父亲。
只是不适合土财爻持世，好在岁、月和伏在下面的寅木克制它，果然在申酉日好了。
en: In the Gengyin year, the Wuyin month, on the Xinwei day, a son divined about his father's illness and obtained Xie changing into Kun (Confinement).

The Zi Water Resource line of the home palace lies hidden beneath Yin Wood and, though drained, is fortunate that Shen Metal, the Support, moves alone and further changes into an Advancing spirit, and is generated by the Day as well: it will surely give life to the father.
Only it is unsuitable that an Earth Wealth line holds the Self position, but the Year, the Month and the Yin Wood hidden beneath control it, and indeed he recovered on a Shen or You day.

zh: 庚寅年癸未月戊戌日，妻占夫病，得革之困。
土用为神，丑土月破，化入辰墓，兄生子而子克官，人皆云凶。
岂知本宫辰土，得寅木动生午火相扶，后至戊申日，忌神逢绝，官遇长生而愈也。
yi: 庚寅年癸未月戊戌日，妻子占丈夫的病，得到革卦变困卦。
土是用神，丑土月破，变出去入了辰墓，兄爻生子孙、子孙克官爻，大家都说凶。
哪知道本宫的辰土得到寅木发动生午火来扶助，后来到戊申日，忌神遇到绝，官爻遇到长生，病就好了。
en: In the Gengyin year, the Guiwei month, on the Wuxu day, a wife divined about her husband's illness and obtained Ge changing into Kun (Confinement).
Earth is the Subject; Chou Earth is in Month-break and changes into the Chen tomb; Peer generates Output and Output controls Pressure; everyone said it was ominous.

But they did not know that Chen Earth of the home palace was helped by Yin Wood moving to generate Wu Fire, and later on the Wushen day the Adversary met Extinction and Pressure met Birth, and he recovered.

zh: 庚寅年甲申月癸酉日，夫占妻病，得履之小畜。
五爻财伏世下，飞上申金生之，三爻兄弟虽动，喜五爻子动，兄乃贪生忘克，而子得生气，生财愈有力矣。
后至甲申日，财遇长生而愈然也。
yi: 庚寅年甲申月癸酉日，丈夫占妻子的病，得到履卦变小畜卦。
五爻的财伏在世爻下面，飞神上的申金生它；三爻兄弟虽然发动，好在五爻子孙也动，兄爻贪着生子孙而忘了克财，子孙得到生气，再去生财就更有力了。
后来到甲申日，财爻遇到长生，病就好了。
en: In the Gengyin year, the Jiashen month, on the Guiyou day, a husband divined about his wife's illness and obtained Lu changing into Xiaoxu.

The Wealth on the fifth line is hidden beneath the Self line and Shen Metal, the flying line above it, generates it; though the Peer on the third line moves, it is fortunate that Output on the fifth line also moves, so Peer, greedy to generate, forgets to control, and Output, receiving the life force, generates Wealth with more strength.
Later, on the Jiashen day, Wealth met Birth and he recovered.

title: 生死·必死：用爻逢虎鬼与天刑飞廉大杀三坵五墓丧门吊客死炁死符丧车浴盆而动持动克必死；忌神动遇生忌之日死、静遇忌值之日死；用随鬼入墓、财动助鬼伤用、世应双空、财旺用空、鬼生命绝、鬼动化墓、月卦化墓、用化墓绝、用逢月绝皆死

rule.yi: 用爻遇到白虎、鬼，以及天刑、飞廉、大杀、三坵五墓、丧门、吊客、死炁、死符、丧车、浴盆这些凶煞，它们发动而临在用爻上或发动来克用爻，一定死。忌神发动的，遇到生忌神的那天死；忌神安静的，遇到忌神当值的那天死。此外用爻随鬼入墓、财爻发动帮鬼伤用、世应都落空、财旺而用爻落空、鬼旺而命爻绝、鬼动变入墓、月卦变入墓、用爻变入墓绝、用爻遇月绝，都是死。
rule.en: If the Subject line meets the Tiger, the ghost, and the malign stars Heavenly Punishment, Feilian, Great Killing, Three Mounds and Five Tombs, Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, Death Qi, Death Tally, Funeral Carriage and Bath Basin, and they move to sit on it or move to control it, he will surely die. If the Adversary moves, he dies on the day that generates the Adversary; if the Adversary is still, he dies on the day the Adversary is on duty. Besides, he dies if the Subject line follows the ghost into a tomb, Wealth moves to help the ghost and harm the Subject line, the Self and the Other are both Void, Wealth is strong and the Subject line Void, the ghost is in Birth and the destiny in Extinction, the ghost moves and changes into a tomb, the month-hexagram changes into a tomb, the Subject line changes into a tomb or Extinction, or the Subject line meets Extinction in the Month.

note.yi: 这一条是「生死」段里断死的爻象；下一条断死的卦象、再下一条断死日。「虎」是白虎，「鬼」是官鬼；天刑、飞廉、大杀、三坵五墓、丧门、吊客、死炁、死符、丧车、浴盆都是凶的神煞，书里没有再解释。「月卦」书里没有解释，按字面译作月卦（应是按月起的卦身一类的说法）。两个断例挂在这里：临之损（用爻化绝又岁月绝再遭日冲，木日死）、涣之姤（用爻伏藏值旬空，到乙亥日透出才受忌伤而死）。
note.en: This entry gives the line-images that judge death in the section on life and death; the next gives the hexagram-images and the one after the days of death. 'Tiger' is the White Tiger and 'ghost' the Pressure line; Heavenly Punishment, Feilian, Great Killing, Three Mounds and Five Tombs, Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, Death Qi, Death Tally, Funeral Carriage and Bath Basin are all malign spirit-stars which the book does not explain further. 'Month-hexagram' is not explained in the book and is rendered literally (probably something of the kind of the Body lines taken by the month). Two cases hang here: Lin into Sun (the Subject line changing into Extinction, in Extinction in the Year and Month as well, and clashed by the day, dying on a Wood day) and Huan into Gou (the Subject line hidden and in Void, coming out on the Yihai day, harmed by the Adversary and dying).

zh: 用爻逢虎鬼天刑飞廉大杀三坵五墓丧门吊客死炁死符丧车浴盆，动持动克者，必死也。
忌神动者，遇生忌之日死也。
忌神静者，遇忌值之日死也。
yi: 用爻遇到白虎、鬼，以及天刑、飞廉、大杀、三坵五墓、丧门、吊客、死炁、死符、丧车、浴盆这些凶煞，它们发动而临在用爻上，或发动来克用爻的，一定死。
忌神发动的，遇到生忌神的那天死。
忌神安静的，遇到忌神当值的那天死。
用爻跟着鬼入墓的，死。
财爻发动帮助鬼、伤到用爻的，死。
世爻、应爻都落空的，死。
财爻旺而用爻落空的，死。
鬼在长生而命爻绝的，死。
鬼动了变出墓的，死。
月卦变入墓的，死。
用爻变出墓、绝的，死。
用爻遇到月绝的，死。
en: If the Subject line meets the Tiger, the ghost, and the malign stars Heavenly Punishment, Feilian, Great Killing, Three Mounds and Five Tombs, Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, Death Qi, Death Tally, Funeral Carriage and Bath Basin, and they move to sit on it or move to control it, he will surely die.
If the Adversary moves, he dies on the day that generates the Adversary.
If the Adversary is still, he dies on the day the Adversary is on duty.
If the Subject line follows the ghost into a tomb, he dies.
If Wealth moves to help the ghost and harm the Subject line, he dies.
If the Self and the Other are both Void, he dies.
If Wealth is strong and the Subject line Void, he dies.
If the ghost is in Birth and the destiny line in Extinction, he dies.
If the ghost moves and changes into a tomb, he dies.
If the month-hexagram changes into a tomb, he dies.
If the Subject line changes into a tomb or Extinction, he dies.
If the Subject line meets Extinction in the Month, he dies.

zh: 庚寅年戊寅月丁卯日，父占子病，得临之损。
六爻酉金，子孙独发，化绝于寅，又绝于岁月建中，更加卯日冲破，果于木日死也。
yi: 庚寅年戊寅月丁卯日，父亲占儿子的病，得到临卦变损卦。
六爻上的酉金子孙独自发动，变出寅而绝，又在岁、月建里绝，再加上卯日冲破它，果然在木日死了。
en: In the Gengyin year, the Wuyin month, on the Dingmao day, a father divined about his son's illness and obtained Lin changing into Sun.

The You Metal Output line on the sixth line moved alone and changed into Yin, where it is in Extinction, and it was also in Extinction in the Year and the Month, and the Mao day further clashed and broke it; and indeed he died on a Wood day.

zh: 庚寅年庚辰月丁卯日，妻占夫病，得涣之姤。
鬼伏三爻下，值旬空，子为忌神，兄为讐神，二爻并发，独喜用爻伏藏耳。
至乙亥日，透出用爻，才受忌伤，而夫死也。
yi: 庚寅年庚辰月丁卯日，妻子占丈夫的病，得到涣卦变姤卦。
官鬼伏在三爻下面，遇到旬空；子孙是忌神，兄弟是仇神，两爻一起发动，只喜欢用爻伏藏着。
到乙亥日，用爻透出来，才受到忌神的伤害，丈夫就死了。
en: In the Gengyin year, the Gengchen month, on the Dingmao day, a wife divined about her husband's illness and obtained Huan changing into Gou.
The Pressure line hides beneath the third line and meets Void; Output is the Adversary and Peer the enemy spirit, and both lines move together; the only mercy is that the Subject line is hidden.
On the Yihai day the Subject line came out into view, and only then was it harmed by the Adversary, and the husband died.

title: 生死·死卦：卦身墓于世（损）、本宫外卦墓于内卦（遁豫升蛊井大有咸）、世坐本宫墓（噬嗑蒙泰归妹）、世坐鬼墓（乾丰中孚升家人旅）、世坐财墓（观解随益泰兑）、卦化墓绝、用逢月破者死

rule.yi: 从卦象断死：卦身入墓在世爻的（损卦）；本宫的外卦入墓在内卦的（遁、豫、升、蛊、井、大有、咸）；世爻坐在本宫的墓上的（噬嗑、蒙、泰、归妹）；世爻坐在鬼的墓上的（乾、丰、中孚、升、家人、旅）；世爻坐在财的墓上的（财是禄命，最忌刑、冲、墓、绝；观、解、随、益、泰、兑）；卦变入墓、绝的；用爻遇月破的，都是死。
rule.en: Death judged from the hexagram: the Body's tomb at the Self (the hexagram Sun); the outer trigram of the home palace having its tomb in the inner trigram (Dun, Yu, Sheng, Gu, Jing, Dayou, Xian); the Self sitting on the tomb of the home palace (Shihe, Meng, Tai, Guimei); the Self sitting on the ghost's tomb (Qian, Feng, Zhongfu, Sheng, Jiaren, Lü); the Self sitting on the tomb of Wealth (Wealth is the salary and destiny and fears punishment, clash, tomb and extinction; Guan, Xie, Sui, Yi, Tai, Dui); the hexagram changing into a tomb or Extinction; and the Subject line meeting Month-break: in each case he dies.

note.yi: 括号里的卦名是书里自己注的，指明哪几个卦有这个象。「卦化墓绝」那一句括号里的名单在原文里是「乾兑化艮坎，艮坤化巽离，化乾震巽化坤」：第三个「化乾」没有主语，书里没有说明，译文照写。「旅」是旅卦（Lü），「履」是履卦（Lu），两个卦不要混。「财为禄命」的意思是财爻代表食禄和命，所以怕刑冲墓绝。
note.en: The hexagram names in brackets are the book's own and show which hexagrams carry the image. In the bracket of the sentence on the hexagram changing into a tomb or extinction, the original list is 'Qian and Dui changing into Gen and Kan, Gen and Kun changing into Xun and Li, changing into Qian, Zhen and Xun changing into Kun': the third 'changing into Qian' has no subject, which the book does not explain, and the translation follows the text. 'Lü' is the hexagram Lü (Travel) and 'Lu' the hexagram Lu (Treading); the two are not to be confused. 'Wealth is salary and destiny' means the Wealth line stands for one's pay and one's life, so it fears punishment, clash, tomb and extinction.

zh: 卦身墓于世者死也(损卦)。
本宫外卦墓于内卦者死(遁豫升蛊井大有咸)。
世坐本宫墓者，死也(噬嗑蒙泰归妹)。
世坐鬼墓者死也(乾丰中孚升家人旅)。
世坐财墓者死也(财为禄命，忌刑冲墓绝，观解随益泰兑卦)。
卦化墓绝者死也(乾兑化艮坎，艮坤化巽离，化乾震巽化坤)。
yi: 卦身入墓在世爻的，死（损卦）。
本宫的外卦入墓在内卦的，死（遁、豫、升、蛊、井、大有、咸）。
世爻坐在本宫的墓上的，死（噬嗑、蒙、泰、归妹）。
世爻坐在鬼的墓上的，死（乾、丰、中孚、升、家人、旅）。
世爻坐在财的墓上的，死（财是禄命，最忌刑、冲、墓、绝；观、解、随、益、泰、兑卦）。
卦变入墓、绝的，死（乾、兑变艮、坎；艮、坤变巽、离；变乾；震、巽变坤）。
用爻遇到月破的，死。
en: If the Body's tomb lies at the Self, he dies (the hexagram Sun).
If the outer trigram of the home palace has its tomb in the inner trigram, he dies (Dun, Yu, Sheng, Gu, Jing, Dayou, Xian).
If the Self sits on the tomb of the home palace, he dies (Shihe, Meng, Tai, Guimei).
If the Self sits on the ghost's tomb, he dies (Qian, Feng, Zhongfu, Sheng, Jiaren, Lü).
If the Self sits on the tomb of Wealth, he dies (Wealth is the salary and destiny and fears punishment, clash, tomb and extinction; Guan, Xie, Sui, Yi, Tai, Dui).
If the hexagram changes into a tomb or Extinction, he dies (Qian and Dui changing into Gen and Kan; Gen and Kun changing into Xun and Li; changing into Qian; Zhen and Xun changing into Kun).
If the Subject line meets Month-break, he dies.

title: 生死·死日：忌神长生之日死（土用亥日、木用巳日、火用申日、水用巳午日、金用寅日）；土鬼动者鬼爻长生之日死；六冲卦用爻败死墓绝之日死；用空无气者元神绝忌神生之日死；用逢空冲者初病即愈久病难痊；土旺动克用者克用爻之日死；卦有三无救（无火无财无子）

rule.yi: 死的日子：忌神长生的那天死（土做用的，亥日死；木的，巳日死；火的，申日死；水的，巳日、午日死；金的，寅日死）；土鬼发动的，鬼爻长生的那天死；卦是六冲的，用爻败、死、墓、绝的那天死；用爻落空又没有气的，原神绝、忌神生的那天死；土旺盛发动克到用爻的，克用爻的那天死。用爻遇空又被冲，刚起的病马上会好，久病却难好。卦里有三种没有救的：没有火、没有财、没有子孙。
rule.en: The days of death: he dies on the day the Adversary is born (for Earth as the Subject, a Hai day; Wood, a Si day; Fire, a Shen day; Water, a Si or Wu day; Metal, a Yin day); if an Earth ghost moves, on the day the Pressure line is born; if the hexagram is Six-Clash, on a day when the Subject line is at ruin, death, tomb or Extinction; if the Subject line is Void and without force, on the day the Support is extinct and the Adversary is born; if strong moving Earth controls the Subject line, on the day that controls it. If the Subject line meets Void and is clashed, a recent illness is cured at once while a long illness is hard to cure. A hexagram has three kinds of no rescue: no Fire, no Wealth, no Output.

note.yi: 「三无救」的「财」「子」书里写得很简，按上下文是财爻和子孙爻；火是官鬼所怕的克，火能克金鬼，财能生官，子孙能制官，这里书里没有解释为什么这三样是救。「败」是十二长生里的沐浴位（又叫败地）。这一条讲死日，和增删卜易讲的「用神死绝生旺日」不同处见 LY.ILL.HJC.57。
note.en: In the 'three kinds of no rescue', 'Wealth' and 'Output' are written very briefly and by context are the Wealth and Output lines; the book does not explain why these three are what save. 'Ruin' (bai) is the Bath stage of the twelve life stages (also called the ruin ground). This entry gives the days of death; for how it differs from the days given elsewhere see LY.ILL.HJC.57.

zh: 又忌神长生之日死(土用亥日死，木用巳日死，火用申日死，水用巳午日死，金用寅日死)。
土鬼动者，鬼爻长生之日死。
卦六冲者，用爻败死墓绝之日死。
用空无气者，元神绝而忌神生之日死。
又用逢空冲者，初病即愈而久病难痊也。
土旺动持克用者，克用爻之日死也。
卦有三无救者，无火无财无子也。
yi: 又，忌神长生的那天死（土做用的，亥日死；木做用的，巳日死；火做用的，申日死；水做用的，巳日、午日死；金做用的，寅日死）。
土鬼发动的，鬼爻长生的那天死。
卦是六冲的，用爻败、死、墓、绝的那天死。
用爻落空又没有气的，原神绝、忌神生的那天死。
又，用爻遇到空又被冲的，刚起的病马上会好，久病却难好。
土旺盛、发动、克到用爻的，克用爻的那天死。
卦里有三种没有救的：没有火、没有财、没有子孙。
en: Also he dies on the day the Adversary is born (for Earth as the Subject, on a Hai day; Wood, a Si day; Fire, a Shen day; Water, a Si or Wu day; Metal, a Yin day).
If an Earth ghost moves, he dies on the day the Pressure line is born.
If the hexagram is Six-Clash, he dies on a day when the Subject line is at ruin, death, tomb or Extinction.
If the Subject line is Void and without force, he dies on the day the Support is extinct and the Adversary is born.
Also, if the Subject line meets Void and is clashed, a recent illness is cured at once, while a long illness is hard to cure.
If Earth is strong and moving and controls the Subject line, he dies on the day that controls the Subject line.
A hexagram is beyond rescue in three ways: no Fire, no Wealth, no Output.

title: 生死·凶卦：黄泉杀（春大畜小畜履井复、夏遁睽临、秋明夷蛊旅、冬遁既济明夷归妹）、四灭卦（春蒙夏蛊秋剥冬旅）、四没卦（春需夏观秋节冬临）、棺椁杀（恒与益），占病逢之死

rule.yi: 黄泉杀：春天是大畜、小畜、履、井、复，夏天是遁、睽、临，秋天是明夷、蛊、旅，冬天是遁、既济、明夷、归妹。四灭卦：春天蒙、夏天蛊、秋天剥、冬天旅。四没卦：春天需、夏天观、秋天节、冬天临。棺椁杀：恒和益。以上这些卦，占病的人逢到就会死。
rule.en: The Yellow Springs killer: in spring Daxu, Xiaoxu, Lu, Jing and Fu; in summer Dun, Kui and Lin; in autumn Mingyi, Gu and Lü; in winter Dun, Jiji, Mingyi and Guimei. The Four Extinguishing hexagrams: Meng in spring, Gu in summer, Bo in autumn, Lü in winter. The Four Submerging hexagrams: Xu in spring, Guan in summer, Jie in autumn, Lin in winter. The Coffin killer: Heng and Yi. One who divines about illness and meets any of these hexagrams dies.

note.yi: 「遁」在黄泉杀的夏和冬里各出现一次，原文如此。这几组卦名书里只列名单，没有说为什么；「四灭」「四没」是按季节各取一卦的名目。「旅」（Lü）和「履」（Lu）是两个卦。「已上诸卦占病者死」是书里对这一组的总结，是说占病遇到这些卦就是死，写得很绝对，本库照抄，不替它担保。
note.en: 'Dun' appears once in summer and once in winter in the Yellow Springs killer, as in the original. The book gives only the lists of hexagram names and no reasons; the 'Four Extinguishing' and 'Four Submerging' are names for one hexagram per season. 'Lü' and 'Lu' are two hexagrams. 'For all the hexagrams above, one who divines about illness dies' is the book's own summing up of the group and is stated absolutely; the library copies it and does not stand surety for it.

zh: 黄泉杀者，春则大畜小畜履井复也。
冬则遁既济明夷归妹也。
四灭卦者，春蒙夏蛊秋剥冬旅也。
四没卦者，春需夏观秋节冬临也。
棺椁杀者，恒与益也(已上诸卦占病者死)。
yi: 黄泉杀：春天是大畜、小畜、履、井、复这几卦。
夏天是遁、睽、临。
秋天是明夷、蛊、旅。
冬天是遁、既济、明夷、归妹。
四灭卦：春天蒙，夏天蛊，秋天剥，冬天旅。
四没卦：春天需，夏天观，秋天节，冬天临。
棺椁杀：是恒和益（以上这些卦，占病的人会死）。
en: The Yellow Springs killer: in spring it is Daxu, Xiaoxu, Lu, Jing and Fu.
In summer it is Dun, Kui and Lin.
In autumn it is Mingyi, Gu and Lü.
In winter it is Dun, Jiji, Mingyi and Guimei.
The Four Extinguishing hexagrams: spring Meng, summer Gu, autumn Bo, winter Lü.
The Four Submerging hexagrams: spring Xu, summer Guan, autumn Jie, winter Lin.
The Coffin killer: Heng and Yi (for all the hexagrams above, one who divines about illness dies).

title: 僧一行占病法：从八卦取用——父乾母坤、长男震次男坎三男艮、长女巽次女离三女兑；用卦不现或代占者按年龄：一至二十男艮女兑、二十一至四十男坎女离、四十一至六十男震女巽、六十以上男乾女坤；正卦无用象取伏卦；主象化死墓绝克破皆死

rule.yi: 僧一行占病的办法，从八卦里取用：父亲用乾，母亲用坤，长子用震，次子用坎，三子用艮，长女用巽，次女用离，三女用兑。如果所用的卦不出现，或者是替别人占，就按年龄：一岁到二十岁，男的用艮，女的用兑；二十一岁到四十岁，男的用坎，女的用离；四十一岁到六十岁，男的用震，女的用巽；六十岁以上，男的用乾，女的用坤。正卦里没有用的象，就取伏卦。主象变出死、墓、绝，或者变出克它、破它的，都主死。
rule.en: The monk Yixing's method of divining illness takes the Subject from the eight trigrams: father takes Qian, mother Kun, eldest son Zhen, second son Kan, third son Gen, eldest daughter Xun, second daughter Li, third daughter Dui. If the trigram to be used does not appear, or one is divining for another, go by age: from one to twenty, a male uses Gen and a female Dui; from twenty-one to forty, a male Kan and a female Li; from forty-one to sixty, a male Zhen and a female Xun; over sixty, a male Qian and a female Kun. If the main hexagram has no image to use, take the hidden hexagram. If the main image changes into Death, tomb or Extinction, or into what controls or breaks it, in every case it means death.

note.yi: 这是另一套办法：不在六爻里找六亲，而是拿八卦对家人（乾父坤母，震坎艮是三个儿子，巽离兑是三个女儿）。按年龄取卦是给「用卦不出现」和代占者用的备用办法。这一条和上面六爻取用（LY.ILL.YY.03）不是一回事，书里没有说两者冲突时怎么办。「僧一行」是唐代的一行和尚，书里没有另作介绍。
note.en: This is another method: instead of looking for the six relations among the lines, the eight trigrams are matched to the family (Qian father, Kun mother, Zhen, Kan and Gen the three sons, Xun, Li and Dui the three daughters). Taking the trigram by age is a fallback for when the trigram to be used does not appear and for divining for another. It is not the same as taking the Subject among the six lines (LY.ILL.YY.03), and the book does not say what to do when the two conflict. 'The monk Yixing' is the Tang monk Yixing, whom the book does not otherwise introduce.

zh: 又僧一行占病法，从八卦取用也。
父用乾，母用坤，长男用震，次男用坎，三男用艮，长女用巽，次女用离，三女用兑也。
若用卦不出现者与代他人占者，一岁至二十，男用艮，女用兑也。
二十一岁至四十，男用坎，女用离也。
四十一岁至六十，男用震，女用巽也。
六十以上者，男用乾，女用坤也。
若正卦无用象者，则取伏卦。
若主象化死墓绝，化克破者，皆主死也。
yi: 另有僧一行占病的办法，从八卦里取用。
父亲用乾，母亲用坤，长子用震，次子用坎，三子用艮，长女用巽，次女用离，三女用兑。
如果所用的卦不出现，或者是替别人占，一岁到二十岁，男的用艮，女的用兑。
二十一岁到四十岁，男的用坎，女的用离。
四十一岁到六十岁，男的用震，女的用巽。
六十岁以上，男的用乾，女的用坤。
如果正卦里没有用的象，就取伏卦。
如果主象变出死、墓、绝，或者变出克它、破它的，都主死。
en: There is also the monk Yixing's method of divining illness, which takes the Subject from the eight trigrams.
Father takes Qian, mother Kun, eldest son Zhen, second son Kan, third son Gen, eldest daughter Xun, second daughter Li, third daughter Dui.
If the trigram to be used does not appear, or one is divining for another, from age one to twenty a male uses Gen and a female Dui.
From twenty-one to forty, a male uses Kan and a female Li.
From forty-one to sixty, a male uses Zhen and a female Xun.
Over sixty, a male uses Qian and a female Kun.
If the main hexagram has no image to use, take the hidden hexagram.
If the main image changes into Death, tomb or Extinction, or into what controls or breaks it, in every case it means death.

title: 生死·男女老少之忌：男忌官鬼长生日得病、女忌官鬼沐浴日得病；无龙福月解天医来救则鬼爻墓绝日必死；晁以道：用爻命爻不上卦者死；男忌鬼空、女忌财空，少年卦忌死囚休废、老人卦忌旺相

rule.yi: 男的忌讳在官鬼长生的那天得病，女的忌讳在官鬼沐浴的那天得病。如果没有青龙、福德、月解、天医发动来生合用爻，鬼爻入墓、绝的那天一定死。晁以道说：用爻、命爻不上卦的，死。还有，男的忌讳鬼落空，女的忌讳财落空；少年占的卦忌讳死、囚、休、废，老人占的卦忌讳旺相。
rule.en: A man should fear falling ill on the day the Pressure line is born, and a woman on the day the Pressure line is at Bath. If none of the Dragon, Fortune, Month Release or Heavenly Doctor moves to generate or combine with the Subject line, he will surely die on the day the Pressure line is in its tomb or Extinction. Chao Yidao says: if the Subject line and the destiny line do not appear in the hexagram, he dies. Further, a man should fear the ghost being Void and a woman Wealth being Void; a young person's hexagram fears Death, trapped, resting and abandoned, and an old person's hexagram fears being strong.

note.yi: 这一条和黄金策讲的「主空无救」「用绝逢生」（LY.ILL.HJC.37、LY.ILL.HJC.47）相近，不同的是这里按男女、老少分了忌讳：男忌鬼空，女忌财空；少年怕死囚休废，老人怕旺相——老人怕旺相与黄金策「占病不喜旺相，太刚则折」（LY.ILL.HJC.36）同一个意思。「晁以道」是宋代人晁说之，书里只写了字。「死囚休废」是五行在季节里的四种无气状态。
note.en: This entry is close to the Huangjin Ce's 'the main image Void, no rescue' and 'Extinction meeting generation' (LY.ILL.HJC.37 and LY.ILL.HJC.47); the difference is that it divides the fears by sex and age: a man fears the ghost Void and a woman Wealth Void; the young fear Death, trapped, resting and abandoned and the old fear being strong — the old fearing strength agrees with the Huangjin Ce's 'in illness one does not like strength; too rigid, it snaps' (LY.ILL.HJC.36). 'Chao Yidao' is the Song man Chao Shuozhi, of whom the book gives only the style-name. 'Death, trapped, resting, abandoned' are the four forceless states of an element in a season.

zh: 又男忌官鬼长生日得病，女忌官鬼沐浴日得病。
若无龙福月解天医动来生合用爻者，鬼爻墓绝日必死也。
又晁以道曰，用爻命爻不上卦者死。
更男忌鬼空，女忌财空，少年卦忌死囚休废，老人卦忌旺相也。
yi: 又，男的忌讳在官鬼长生的那天得病，女的忌讳在官鬼沐浴的那天得病。
如果没有青龙、福德、月解、天医发动来生合用爻的，鬼爻墓、绝的那天一定死。
另外晁以道说：用爻、命爻不上卦的，死。
还有，男的忌讳鬼落空，女的忌讳财落空，少年占的卦忌讳死、囚、休、废，老人占的卦忌讳旺相。
en: Also a man should fear falling ill on the day the Pressure line is born, and a woman on the day the Pressure line is at Bath.
If none of the Dragon, Fortune, Month Release or Heavenly Doctor moves to generate or combine with the Subject line, he will surely die on the day the Pressure line is in its tomb or Extinction.
Chao Yidao also says: if the Subject line and the destiny line do not appear in the hexagram, he dies.
Further, a man should fear the ghost being Void and a woman Wealth being Void; a young person's hexagram fears Death, trapped, resting and abandoned, and an old person's hexagram fears being strong.

title: 病症以官鬼为凭：鬼持身世命用、鬼动来刑害克冲身世命用、官鬼伏其下、或身世命用化官鬼，各随五行断；鬼属阴在内卦金肺木肝胆水肾火心小肠土脾胃大肠，鬼属阳在外卦金四肢骨节牙齿右耳、木筋骨左耳、水口皮痰血汗、土鼻腹背肌肉、火目胸手心脚底；八卦乾首坤腹震足巽股坎耳离目艮背指兑口舌

rule.yi: 断病症以官鬼为凭据：鬼爻持在身、世、命爻、用爻上，或者鬼发动来刑、害、克、冲它们，或者官鬼伏在它们下面，或者它们发动变出官鬼，都各按官鬼的五行来断。鬼属阴爻、在内卦的：金是肺，木是肝胆，水是肾，子（水）是膀胱，火是心和小肠，土是脾、胃、大肠。鬼属阳爻、在外卦的：金是四肢、骨节、牙齿、右耳、小便，木是筋骨、左耳，水是口、嘴、皮、尿、痰涎、血、汗，土是鼻尖、腹背、肌肉，火是眼睛、胸、手心、脚底；另外辰、戌是头顶，丑、未是肩背。再按八卦：乾是头，坤是腹，震是脚，巽是大腿，坎是耳朵，离是眼睛，艮是背和手指，兑是口和舌头。
rule.en: The symptoms are judged by the Pressure line: if the Pressure line holds the Body, the Self, the destiny line or the Subject line; or the ghost moves to punish, harm, control or clash them; or the Pressure line is hidden beneath them; or they move and change into Pressure: in every case judge by the element of Pressure. If the ghost is yin and in the inner trigram: Metal is the lungs, Wood the liver and gallbladder, Water the kidneys and Zi the bladder, Fire the heart and small intestine, Earth the spleen, stomach and large intestine. If the ghost is yang and in the outer trigram: Metal is the limbs, bone joints, teeth, right ear and urine; Wood the sinews and bones and the left ear; Water the mouth, lips, skin, urine, phlegm and spittle, blood and sweat; Earth the tip of the nose, belly and back, and flesh; Fire the eyes, chest, palms and soles; Chen and Xu are the crown of the head and Chou and Wei the shoulders and back. And by the eight trigrams: Qian is the head, Kun the belly, Zhen the feet, Xun the thighs, Kan the ears, Li the eyes, Gen the back and fingers, and Dui the mouth and tongue.

note.yi: 这一条是易隐病症段的总纲，把五行、八卦、内外卦阴阳三套办法叠在一起：先看鬼在哪个五行，再看它属阴属阳、在内在外，得出是哪个脏腑或身体部位。黄金策讲同一件事的地方见 LY.ILL.HJC.02（五行定脏腑）、LY.ILL.HJC.04（八宫定病位）。「水为口嘴皮溺痰涎血汗」里的「溺」是尿，金那一栏的「小便」也是尿，原文两处都写。
note.en: This is the general outline of the Yi Yin's section on symptoms and lays three systems over one another — the five elements, the eight trigrams, and yin-yang with inner and outer trigrams: first see which element the ghost is, then whether it is yin or yang and inner or outer, to arrive at which viscus or part of the body. Where the Huangjin Ce treats the same thing see LY.ILL.HJC.02 (the element fixes the viscus) and LY.ILL.HJC.04 (the palace fixes the site of the illness). In 'Water is the mouth, lips, skin, urine ...' the 'ni' is urine, and 'xiaobian' in the Metal column is also urine; the original writes both.

zh: 如鬼爻持身世，命爻用爻或鬼动来刑害克冲身世命用爻者，或官鬼伏于身世命用爻下者，或身世命用动化官鬼者，各随五行断之也。
鬼属阴，在内卦，则金为肺，木为肝胆，水为肾，子膀胱，火为心小肠，土为脾胃大肠也。
鬼属阳，在外卦，则金为四肢骨节牙齿右耳小便也，木为筋骨左耳也，水为口嘴皮溺痰涎血汗也，土为鼻准腹背肌肉也，火为目胸手心脚底也，又辰戌为顶门，丑未为肩背也。
又八卦乾为首，坤为腹，震为足，巽为股，坎为耳，离为目，艮为背指，兑为口舌也。
yi: 断病症以官鬼为凭据。
比如鬼爻持在身、世、命爻、用爻上，或者鬼发动来刑、害、克、冲身、世、命、用爻，或者官鬼伏在身、世、命、用爻下面，或者身、世、命、用爻发动变出官鬼，都各按它的五行来断。
鬼属阴爻、在内卦的：金是肺，木是肝胆，水是肾，子（水）是膀胱，火是心和小肠，土是脾、胃、大肠。
鬼属阳爻、在外卦的：金是四肢、骨节、牙齿、右耳、小便，木是筋骨、左耳，水是口、嘴、皮、尿、痰涎、血、汗，土是鼻尖、腹背、肌肉，火是眼睛、胸、手心、脚底；另外辰、戌是头顶，丑、未是肩背。
又按八卦：乾是头，坤是腹，震是脚，巽是大腿，坎是耳朵，离是眼睛，艮是背和手指，兑是口和舌头。
en: The symptoms are judged by the Pressure line.

For example, if the Pressure line holds the Body, the Self, the destiny line or the Subject line; or the ghost moves to punish, harm, control or clash the Body, Self, destiny or Subject line; or the Pressure line is hidden beneath the Body, Self, destiny or Subject line; or the Body, Self, destiny or Subject line moves and changes into Pressure: in every case judge by its element.

If the ghost is yin and in the inner trigram: Metal is the lungs, Wood the liver and gallbladder, Water the kidneys and Zi the bladder, Fire the heart and small intestine, and Earth the spleen, stomach and large intestine.

If the ghost is yang and in the outer trigram: Metal is the limbs, bone joints, teeth, right ear and urine; Wood the sinews and bones and the left ear; Water the mouth, lips, skin, urine, phlegm and spittle, blood and sweat; Earth the tip of the nose, belly and back, and flesh; Fire the eyes, chest, palms and soles; and Chen and Xu are the crown of the head and Chou and Wei the shoulders and back.
Again by the eight trigrams: Qian is the head, Kun the belly, Zhen the feet, Xun the thighs, Kan the ears, Li the eyes, Gen the back and fingers, and Dui the mouth and tongue.

hits.text: 宫诸身乾为首，坤为腹，震为足，巽为股，坎为耳，离为目，艮为手，兑为口

title: 按爻位分身体：初爻足、二爻股膝、三爻腹小腹腰臀肛门小便、四爻胸胃乳、五爻面项手（水口火目土鼻水左耳金右耳）、六爻头脑；遇鬼伏、鬼化、鬼动来伤之处必带疾

rule.yi: 再按爻位来分：初爻是脚，二爻是大腿和膝，三爻是腹、小腹、腰、臀、肛门、小便，四爻是胸、胃、乳，五爻是脸、颈项、手（水是口，火是眼睛，土是鼻，水是左耳，金是右耳），六爻是头和脑。凡是哪一爻遇到鬼伏在下面、变出鬼、或者鬼发动来伤到它，那个部位一定留下毛病。
rule.en: Again by the position of the lines: the first line is the feet, the second the thighs and knees, the third the belly, lower belly, waist, buttocks, anus and urination, the fourth the chest, stomach and breasts, the fifth the face, neck and hands (Water the mouth, Fire the eyes, Earth the nose, Water the left ear, Metal the right ear), and the sixth the head and brain. Wherever a line has a ghost hidden beneath it, or changes into a ghost, or a ghost moves to harm it, that place will surely be left with an ailment.

dispute.yi: 左耳属哪一行：同一段里，上一条（LY.ILL.YY.11）说木是筋骨、左耳，这里说「水左耳，金右耳」，两处对左耳的五行不一致；书里没有说明，应是传抄的差异。易隐别处（第 1447 行讲相貌处）是「木聋左耳，金虎右耳」，与这里说水的一处不同。
dispute.en: Which element the left ear belongs to: within the same passage, the previous entry (LY.ILL.YY.11) says Wood is the sinews and bones and the left ear, and here it says 'Water the left ear, Metal the right ear', so the two disagree on the left ear's element; the book gives no explanation and it is likely a difference in transmission. Elsewhere the Yi Yin (line 1447, on appearance) has 'Wood deaf in the left ear, Metal and Tiger the right ear', which differs from this one place that says Water.

note.yi: 这里的分法是从初爻（脚）一路往上到六爻（头脑），和上面鬼谷分爻（LY.ILL.YY.02）的左栏一致。「水为口，火为目，土为鼻，水左耳，金右耳」是接在五爻（脸）后面的，讲脸上的五官各归哪一行。
note.en: The division here runs from the first line (feet) up to the sixth (head and brain) and agrees with the left column of Guigu's division of the lines (LY.ILL.YY.02). 'Water the mouth, Fire the eyes, Earth the nose, Water the left ear, Metal the right ear' follows the fifth line (the face) and assigns the features of the face to the elements.

zh: 三爻，腹小腹腰臀肛门小便也。
水为口，火为目，土为鼻，水左耳，金右耳也。
凡遇鬼伏鬼化鬼，或鬼动来伤者，必带疾也。
yi: 又按爻位来分：初爻是脚。
二爻是大腿和膝。
三爻是腹、小腹、腰、臀、肛门、小便。
四爻是胸、胃、乳。
五爻是脸、颈项、手。
水是口，火是眼睛，土是鼻，水是左耳，金是右耳。
六爻是头和脑。
凡是（这一爻）遇到伏着鬼、变出鬼，或者有鬼发动来伤它的，一定留下毛病。
en: Again by the position of the lines: the first line is the feet.
The second line is the thighs and knees.
The third line is the belly, lower belly, waist, buttocks, anus and urination.
The fourth line is the chest, stomach and breasts.
The fifth line is the face, neck and hands.
Water is the mouth, Fire the eyes, Earth the nose, Water the left ear and Metal the right ear.
The sixth line is the head and brain.
Whenever a line has a ghost hidden beneath it or changes into a ghost, or a ghost moves to harm it, it will surely be left with an ailment.

title: 五行鬼各主之症：金鬼阴肺腑之疾阳骨节疼痛脓血淋漓；木鬼阴肝胆之疾阳四肢风气酸疼口眼歪斜；水鬼阴遗精盗汗肾竭血枯经闭阳呕吐泄泻；火鬼阴心目之疾阳疮痍疖毒虐热；土鬼阴虚浮气喘水蛊脾泄阳瘟疫时气，辰咽喉肿塞戌腹痛胃伤丑气促痿痺未翻胃噎膈痨嗽

rule.yi: 用爻遇到金鬼：属阴是肺腑的病，属阳是骨节疼痛、脓血淋漓；金鬼旺，是泻肚子再带一样生僻的病；金鬼衰，是血里生脓。遇到木鬼：属阴是肝胆的病，属阳是四肢风气酸疼、口眼歪斜、头疼口干；木动的，阳的痒、阴的疼；木鬼旺，是风病带热；木鬼衰，是在同一个字的病上再生出风来。遇到水鬼：属阴是遗精、盗汗、肾气枯竭，女的是血枯闭经，属阳是呕吐泄泻；水鬼旺，是呕吐带咳嗽；水鬼衰，是受寒腹泻兼虚弱。遇到火鬼：属阴是心和眼睛的病，属阳是疮痍疖毒、疟热呻吟；火鬼旺，先冷后热；火鬼衰，先热后冷。遇到土鬼：属阴是虚浮气喘、水蛊、脾泄，属阳是瘟疫时气；辰鬼是咽喉肿塞，戌鬼是腹痛胃伤，丑鬼是气促痿痹，未鬼是翻胃、噎膈、痨病咳嗽。
rule.en: If the Subject line meets a Metal ghost: yin means a disease of the lungs and viscera, yang means aching bone joints and dripping pus and blood; a strong Metal ghost brings diarrhea together with a rare ailment, and a weak Metal ghost brings pus forming within the blood. Meeting a Wood ghost: yin means a disease of the liver and gallbladder, yang means wind-qi with aching limbs, a crooked mouth and eyes, headache and a dry mouth; when Wood moves, yang itches and yin aches; a strong Wood ghost brings wind sickness with heat, a weak one wind growing upon the same rare ailment. Meeting a Water ghost: yin means seminal emission, night sweats and exhausted kidneys, and in a woman dried-up blood and stopped menses; yang means vomiting and diarrhea; a strong Water ghost brings vomiting with cough, a weak one cold diarrhea with weakness. Meeting a Fire ghost: yin means a disease of the heart and eyes, yang means sores, boils and poison, malarial fever and groaning; a strong Fire ghost brings cold first and then heat, a weak one heat first and then cold. Meeting an Earth ghost: yin means puffy weakness and wheezing, water-swelling and spleen diarrhea, yang means epidemic and seasonal qi; a Chen ghost is a swollen blocked throat, a Xu ghost belly pain and a damaged stomach, a Chou ghost shortness of breath and limp numbness, and a Wei ghost regurgitation, choking in the gullet, consumption and cough.

note.yi: 原书里有两处写着「（此处之字上疒下去）」，是整理者的注：那个字上面是病字头、下面是「去」，一个生僻的病字，整理者没有打出来，病名不明，译文照写不猜。「虐热」应是疟热（疟疾发热），原书写作「虐」。「水蛊」是腹部胀水的病，「膈」「噎膈」是吞咽梗阻，「痿痺」是肢体软弱、麻木疼痛，都按字面。这一条和黄金策的五行症候（LY.ILL.HJC.02、LY.ILL.HJC.04）是同一个路子，但易隐更细：每一行分阴阳，又分旺衰，土另分辰戌丑未四种。
note.en: The original has two places marked '(the character here: sickness radical above, go below)', the transcriber's note: a rare character for an ailment which the transcriber could not enter, so the name of the ailment is unknown and the translation writes it as it stands and does not guess. 'Malarial fever' (nuere) is a writing of 'nue' with the wrong character in the original. 'Water-swelling' (shuigu) is a disease with a belly swollen with fluid, 'yege' is obstruction in swallowing, and 'weibi' is limpness of the limbs with numbness and pain, all rendered literally. This entry is on the same road as the Huangjin Ce's element symptoms (LY.ILL.HJC.02 and LY.ILL.HJC.04) but the Yi Yin is finer: each element is divided into yin and yang and into strong and weak, and Earth further into Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei.

zh: 用逢金鬼者，阴则肺腑之疾，阳则骨节疼痛，脓血淋漓也。
又金鬼旺，泻中带(此处之字上疒下去)。
用逢木鬼者，阴则肝胆之疾，阳则四肢疯气酸疼，口眼歪斜，头疼口燥也。
木官旺，疯中带热，木鬼衰(此处之字上疒下去)上生疯也。
用逢水鬼者，阴则遗精盗汗，肾竭，女为血枯经闭，阳则呕吐泄泻也。
用逢火鬼者，阴则心目之疾，阳则疮痍疖毒，虐热吟呻也。
又火鬼旺，先寒后热，火鬼衰先热后寒也。
用逢土鬼者，阴则虚浮气喘，水蛊脾泄，阳则瘟疫时气也。
未鬼则翻胃噎膈痨嗽也。
yi: 用爻遇到金鬼的，属阴就是肺腑一类的病，属阳就是骨节疼痛、脓血淋漓。
另外金鬼旺的，是泻肚子，还带着（此处原书有一个字，上面是病字头、下面是个「去」字，是个生僻的病字，书里没有解释）。
金鬼衰弱的，血里生脓。
用爻遇到木鬼的，属阴是肝胆的病，属阳是四肢风气酸疼、口眼歪斜、头疼口干。
另外木发动的，属阳的痒，属阴的疼。
木官旺的，是风病中带热；木鬼衰的，是在（又是那个上面病字头、下面「去」字的字）上再生出风来。
用爻遇到水鬼的，属阴是遗精、盗汗、肾气枯竭，女的是血枯、闭经，属阳是呕吐、泄泻。
另外水鬼旺的，呕吐中带着咳嗽。
水鬼衰弱的，是受寒腹泻再加虚弱。
用爻遇到火鬼的，属阴是心和眼睛的病，属阳是疮痍疖毒、疟热呻吟。
另外火鬼旺的，先冷后热；火鬼衰的，先热后冷。
用爻遇到土鬼的，属阴是虚浮气喘、水蛊、脾泄，属阳是瘟疫、时气。
另外辰鬼，是咽喉肿塞。
戌鬼，是腹痛、胃伤。
丑鬼，是气喘急促、痿痹。
未鬼是翻胃、噎膈、痨病咳嗽。
en: If the Subject line meets a Metal ghost, yin means a disease of the lungs and viscera, and yang means aching bone joints and dripping pus and blood.

Also a strong Metal ghost: diarrhea together with (here the book has a rare character for an ailment, written with the sickness radical above and the character for 'go' below, which the book does not explain).
A weak Metal ghost: pus forms within the blood.
If the Subject line meets a Wood ghost, yin means a disease of the liver and gallbladder, and yang means wind-qi with aching limbs, a crooked mouth and eyes, headache and a dry mouth.
Also when Wood moves, yang itches and yin aches.
A strong Wood Pressure line: wind sickness with heat; a weak Wood ghost: wind grows upon (the same rare ailment character, written with the sickness radical above and 'go' below).
If the Subject line meets a Water ghost, yin means seminal emission, night sweats and exhausted kidneys, and in a woman dried-up blood and stopped menses; yang means vomiting and diarrhea.
Also a strong Water ghost: vomiting together with cough.
A weak Water ghost: cold diarrhea together with weakness.
If the Subject line meets a Fire ghost, yin means a disease of the heart and eyes, and yang means sores, boils and poison, malarial fever and groaning.
Also a strong Fire ghost: cold first and then heat; a weak Fire ghost: heat first and then cold.
If the Subject line meets an Earth ghost, yin means puffy weakness and wheezing, water-swelling and spleen diarrhea, and yang means epidemic and seasonal qi.
Also a Chen ghost: a swollen, blocked throat.
A Xu ghost: belly pain and a damaged stomach.
A Chou ghost: shortness of breath, limpness and numbness.
A Wei ghost: regurgitation, choking in the gullet, consumption and cough.

title: 寒热与阴阳症：水鬼化火、火鬼化水是往来寒热；内鬼冲外、外鬼冲内是内外感伤；鬼内动下元之症、外动上焦之症；世鬼出现阳症、伏藏阴症；阴鬼化阳阴症变阳、阳鬼化阴阳症变阴

rule.yi: 水鬼变火、火鬼变水的，是忽冷忽热；内卦的鬼冲外卦、外卦的鬼冲内卦的，是内外都受了伤。鬼在内卦发动，是下元的病症；鬼在外卦发动，是上焦的病症。世爻上的鬼出现，是阳症；世爻上的鬼伏藏，是阴症。阴鬼变阳，阴症变成阳症；阳鬼变阴，阳症变成阴症。
rule.en: A Water ghost changing into Fire, or a Fire ghost into Water, means alternating chills and fever; an inner ghost clashing the outer, or an outer ghost the inner, means injury both within and without. A ghost moving in the inner trigram is a disorder of the lower origin; a ghost moving in the outer trigram is a disorder of the upper burner. A ghost at the Self appearing openly is a yang condition, and one at the Self hidden is a yin condition. A yin ghost changing into yang: a yin condition turns yang; a yang ghost changing into yin: a yang condition turns yin.

note.yi: 「下元」按字面是下部的根本，指下焦、肾一带；「上焦」是胸膈以上。这一条和黄金策讲的「水化火火化水往来寒热」（LY.ILL.HJC.14）、「上冲下下冲上内外感伤」（LY.ILL.HJC.15）是同一个说法，易隐再添了世鬼出现与伏藏分阳症阴症、阴阳互变两条。
note.en: 'Lower origin' is literally the root of the lower part and means the lower burner and the kidneys; the 'upper burner' is the region above the chest and diaphragm. This entry is the same saying as the Huangjin Ce's 'Water into Fire and Fire into Water: alternating chills and fever' (LY.ILL.HJC.14) and 'upper clashing lower and lower clashing upper: injury within and without' (LY.ILL.HJC.15); the Yi Yin adds two things: a ghost at the Self, open or hidden, marks a yang or yin condition, and yin and yang turning into each other.

zh: 水鬼化火，火鬼化水者，往来寒热也。
内鬼冲外，外鬼冲内者，内外感伤也。
yi: 水鬼变火、火鬼变水的，是忽冷忽热（寒热往来）。
内卦的鬼冲外卦、外卦的鬼冲内卦的，是内外都受了伤。
鬼在内卦发动，是下元的病症。
鬼在外卦发动，是上焦的病症。
世爻上的鬼出现，是阳症。
世爻上的鬼伏藏，是阴症。
阴鬼变阳，阴症变成阳症。
阳鬼变阴，阳症变成阴症。
en: A Water ghost changing into Fire, or a Fire ghost into Water, means alternating chills and fever.
An inner ghost clashing the outer, or an outer ghost the inner, means injury both within and without.
A ghost moving in the inner trigram is a disorder of the lower origin.
A ghost moving in the outer trigram is a disorder of the upper burner.
A ghost at the Self appearing openly is a yang condition.
A ghost at the Self hidden is a yin condition.
A yin ghost changing into yang: a yin condition turns yang.
A yang ghost changing into yin: a yang condition turns yin.

title: 昼夜与先后：鬼属阴日轻夜重、属阳日重夜轻；外鬼旺内鬼衰先轻后重；动爻克变爻生先重后轻；游魂鬼用言语恍惚、归魂鬼用昏闷不语

rule.yi: 鬼属阴的，白天轻、夜里重；鬼属阳的，白天重、夜里轻。外卦的鬼旺、内卦的鬼衰，先轻后重；动爻克、变爻生，先重后轻。游魂卦里鬼做用爻，说话恍惚；归魂卦里鬼做用爻，昏闷不说话。
rule.en: If the ghost is yin, the illness is lighter by day and heavier by night; if yang, heavier by day and lighter by night. If the outer ghost is strong and the inner weak: light at first, then heavy; if the moving line controls and the changed line generates: heavy at first, then light. A ghost taken as the Subject line in a Wandering Soul hexagram: speech is confused; in a Returning Soul hexagram: drowsy, oppressed and silent.

note.yi: 「游魂」「归魂」是八宫里的两个卦（每宫第七、第八卦）。鬼属阴在内卦、属阳在外卦（见 LY.ILL.YY.11），所以「鬼属阴日轻夜重」和黄金策的「鬼在内卦夜重、在外卦日重」（LY.ILL.HJC.12）是同一个意思；「动爻克而变爻生，先重后轻」和黄金策「动生变克，暮热朝凉」（LY.ILL.HJC.13）相对应，方向一致。
note.en: 'Wandering Soul' and 'Returning Soul' are two hexagrams in each of the eight palaces (the seventh and eighth of each). A ghost is yin in the inner trigram and yang in the outer (see LY.ILL.YY.11), so 'a yin ghost is lighter by day and heavier by night' means the same as the Huangjin Ce's 'a ghost in the inner trigram is heavy at night, in the outer trigram heavy by day' (LY.ILL.HJC.12); and 'the moving line controls and the changed line generates: heavy first, then light' corresponds to the Huangjin Ce's 'the moving line generates and the changed line controls: warm by evening, cool by morning' (LY.ILL.HJC.13), in the same direction.

zh: 外鬼旺而内鬼衰，先轻后重。
动爻克而变爻生，先重后轻。
yi: 鬼属阴的，白天轻、夜里重。
鬼属阳的，白天重、夜里轻。
外卦的鬼旺而内卦的鬼衰，先轻后重。
发动的爻克它、变出的爻生它的，病先重后轻。
游魂卦里鬼做用爻，说话恍惚。
归魂卦里鬼做用爻，昏闷不说话。
en: If the ghost is yin, the illness is lighter by day and heavier by night.
If the ghost is yang, it is heavier by day and lighter by night.
If the outer ghost is strong and the inner ghost weak: light at first, then heavy.
If the moving line controls and the changed line generates: heavy at first, then light.
A ghost taken as the Subject line in a Wandering Soul hexagram: speech is confused.
In a Returning Soul hexagram: drowsy, oppressed and silent.

title: 鬼伏鬼化与轻重之日：鬼伏藏病来不觉；鬼化鬼膏肓之疾；鬼伏鬼、鬼化鬼非变症则两病交作；鬼生旺日重、墓胎日困、死绝日轻；元神值日轻、忌神值日重；六冲乱动者重；用持龙福被动爻伤虽重不死；鬼动伤用而月日冲鬼者免

rule.yi: 鬼伏藏的，病来了不觉得；鬼变鬼的，是膏肓的重病；鬼伏在鬼下、鬼变出鬼的，不是病症有变，就是两种病同时发作；用爻下面伏着鬼的，鬼旺时复发。世爻持着子孙、下面伏着鬼的，子孙旺的那天病退，鬼旺的那天病重。鬼生旺的日子病重，鬼入墓、胎的日子病困，鬼死、绝的日子病轻；原神当值的日子一定轻，忌神当值的日子一定重；财爻入墓、绝的日子也重。卦是六冲又乱动的，重。用爻带着青龙、福德而被动爻伤到的，虽然重也不会死；鬼发动伤到用爻，而月、日冲鬼的，临到凶险也能免。
rule.en: If the ghost is hidden, the illness comes unnoticed; a ghost changing into a ghost is a disease lodged in the vitals; a ghost hidden beneath a ghost, or a ghost changing into a ghost, is either a change of symptoms or two illnesses at once; a ghost hidden beneath the Subject line makes it recur when the ghost is strong. If the Self holds Output with a ghost hidden beneath it, the illness retreats on the day Output is strong and worsens on the day the ghost is strong. It is heavy on days the ghost is born or strong, wearied on days the ghost is in a tomb or Womb, and light on days it is in Death or Extinction; on days when the Support is on duty it is surely light and when the Adversary is on duty surely heavy; it is also heavy on days when the Wealth line is in a tomb or Extinction. A Six-Clash hexagram with lines moving in disorder is heavy. If the Subject line carries the Dragon and Fortune and is harmed by a moving line, it is heavy but he does not die; if the ghost moves to harm the Subject line but the Month and Day clash the ghost, he escapes even at the brink of danger.

note.yi: 「膏肓」是心下膈上的深处，古人说病到膏肓无药可治，书里只说是「膏肓之疾」，没有再解释。「世持子伏鬼」的「子」是子孙爻。这一条的「元神值日必轻，忌神值日必重」和黄金策讲欲决病痊的日子（LY.ILL.HJC.57）是一路。
note.en: 'Gaohuang' is the deep region below the heart and above the diaphragm, of which the ancients said that an illness that reaches it cannot be treated; the book says only 'a disease of the gaohuang' and does not explain further. The 'zi' of 'the Self holds zi with a ghost hidden beneath' is the Output line. 'On days the Support is on duty it is light, on days the Adversary is on duty heavy' is on the same road as the Huangjin Ce's days for deciding recovery (LY.ILL.HJC.57).

zh: 又鬼伏鬼，与鬼化鬼者，非变症，则两病交作也。
世持子伏鬼者，子旺日病退，鬼旺日病重也。
又鬼生旺日病重，鬼墓胎日病困，鬼死绝日病轻也。
元神值日必轻，忌神值日必重也。
用持龙福，而被动爻伤者，虽重不死。
鬼动伤用，而月日冲鬼者，临凶得免也。
yi: 鬼伏藏的，病来了不觉得。
鬼变出鬼的，是膏肓一带的重病。
另外，鬼伏在鬼下，和鬼变出鬼的，不是病症有变，就是两种病同时发作。
用爻下面伏着鬼的，鬼旺的时候会复发。
世爻持着子孙、下面伏着鬼的，子孙旺的那天病退，鬼旺的那天病重。
又，鬼生旺的日子病重，鬼入墓、胎的日子病困，鬼死、绝的日子病轻。
原神当值的日子一定轻，忌神当值的日子一定重。
又，财爻入墓、绝的日子病重。
卦是六冲又乱动的，重。
用爻带着青龙、福德，而被动爻伤到的，虽然重也不会死。
鬼发动伤到用爻，而月、日冲鬼的，临到凶险也能免。
en: If the ghost is hidden, the illness comes unnoticed.
A ghost changing into a ghost is a disease lodged in the deep vitals (gaohuang).
Also a ghost hidden beneath a ghost, and a ghost changing into a ghost, are either a change of symptoms or two illnesses at once.
A ghost hidden beneath the Subject line: it recurs when the ghost is strong.
If the Self holds Output with a ghost hidden beneath it, the illness retreats on the day Output is strong and worsens on the day the ghost is strong.
Also the illness is heavy on days the ghost is born or strong, wearied on days the ghost is in a tomb or Womb, and light on days the ghost is in Death or Extinction.
On days when the Support is on duty it is surely light, and on days when the Adversary is on duty surely heavy.
Also the illness is heavy on days when the Wealth line is in a tomb or Extinction.
If the hexagram is Six-Clash with lines moving in disorder, it is heavy.
If the Subject line carries the Dragon and Fortune and is harmed by a moving line, it is heavy but he does not die.
If the ghost moves to harm the Subject line, but the Month and Day clash the ghost, he escapes even at the brink of danger.

title: 病因·六神：鬼加青龙动男酒色过度或探贵问亲因财而得、女因喜得疾、逢空堕胎；加朱雀动怒气口舌咒咀（二爻灶下、三爻当门、五爻香火道路、金鬼敲锅）；加勾陈动跌打伤失饥伤饱脾胃病（加木动因修造）；加螣蛇动忧愁惊怖思虑伤神或遇妖邪；加白虎动斗殴损伤或丧葬刀兵宰杀之场；加玄武动色欲过度忍饥冒雨或失物被盗

rule.yi: 看病是怎么得的，按鬼爻带的六神：带青龙发动，男的是酒色过度，或者去探望贵人、问候亲戚，因为钱财而得病，女的是因为喜事得病，遇空是堕胎；带朱雀发动，是生气、口舌，或者被人咒骂诅咒得病，在二爻的是灶边咒骂，在三爻的是当门咒骂，在五爻的是香火下、道路上咒骂，金鬼带朱雀发动的是敲着锅咒骂；带勾陈发动，是跌打损伤、饥饱失常，伤了脾胃，勾陈的鬼再加木发动，是因为修造得病；带螣蛇发动，是忧愁惊吓、思虑伤神，或者遇到妖邪得病；带白虎发动，是斗殴受伤，或者在丧葬、刀兵、宰杀的场合得病；带玄武发动，是色欲过度、忍饥冒雨，或者丢了东西被盗而得病。
rule.en: How the illness was caught, by the six spirits the ghost carries. With the Dragon and moving: in a man from excess of wine and women, or from visiting a noble or calling on kin, caught over money; in a woman from a joyful event, and if Void a miscarriage. With the Vermilion Bird and moving: from anger and quarrels, or from being cursed — on the second line, cursing at the stove; on the third, at the door; on the fifth, beneath the incense-fire or on the road; a Metal ghost with the Vermilion Bird, cursing while banging a pot. With the Hook Earth and moving: injury from falls and blows, hunger and overeating out of turn, an ailment of the spleen and stomach, and a Hook Earth ghost with Wood added and moving is caught from building work. With the Coiling Snake and moving: worry and fright, thought that harms the spirit, or meeting a demon or evil. With the Tiger and moving: injury from brawling, or caught at a funeral, in a scene of blades and weapons, or of slaughter. With the Dark Tortoise and moving: excess of lust, enduring hunger, braving rain, or losing things to theft.

note.yi: 经文的「加龙」「加雀」「加勾」「加蛇」「加虎」「加武」是加青龙、朱雀、勾陈、螣蛇、白虎、玄武。黄金策讲六神临鬼各主一症（LY.ILL.HJC.05：螣蛇心惊、青龙酒色过度、勾陈肿胀、朱雀言语颠狂、白虎损伤血崩血晕、玄武忧郁阴虚），那里讲的是症状，这里讲的是怎么得病的起因；青龙都是酒色，螣蛇都是惊怖，白虎都是损伤，是相通的。
note.en: The verse's 'adding the Dragon, the Bird, the Hook, the Snake, the Tiger and the Tortoise' is adding the Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, Hook Earth, Coiling Snake, White Tiger and Dark Tortoise. The Huangjin Ce treats the six spirits on the ghost as each governing a symptom (LY.ILL.HJC.05: Coiling Snake fright of heart, Azure Dragon excess of wine and women, Hook Earth swelling, Vermilion Bird raving speech, White Tiger injury and hemorrhage, Dark Tortoise gloom and yin deficiency); there it speaks of symptoms and here of the cause of catching the illness; the Dragon is wine and women in both, the Snake fright in both and the Tiger injury in both, so they are in accord.

zh: 鬼加龙动，男则酒色过度，或探贵问亲，因财而得。
鬼加雀动，怒气口舌，或被咒咀得病。
在五爻者，香火下道路上咒咀。
金鬼加雀动者，敲锅咒咀也。
鬼加勾动，跌打伤，失饥伤饱，脾胃病也。
勾鬼加木动，因修造得病也。
鬼加蛇动，忧愁惊怖，思虑伤神，或遇妖邪得病也。
鬼加虎动，斗殴损伤，或从丧葬，刀兵宰杀之场得病也。
鬼加武动，因色欲过度，忍饥冒雨，或失物被盗，得病也。
yi: 鬼带青龙发动，男的是酒色过度，或者去探望贵人、问候亲戚，因为钱财而得病。
女的是因为喜事得病。
遇到空，是堕胎。
鬼带朱雀发动，是生气、口舌，或者被人咒骂诅咒而得病。
在二爻的，是灶边咒骂诅咒。
在三爻的，是当着门咒骂诅咒。
在五爻的，是在香火下、道路上咒骂诅咒。
金鬼带朱雀发动的，是敲着锅咒骂诅咒。
鬼带勾陈发动，是跌打损伤、饥一顿饱一顿伤了身，是脾胃的病。
勾陈的鬼再加木发动，是因为修造得病。
鬼带螣蛇发动，是忧愁、惊吓，思虑伤神，或者遇到妖邪而得病。
鬼带白虎发动，是打架斗殴受伤，或者是在丧葬、刀兵、宰杀的场合得病。
鬼带玄武发动，是因为色欲过度、忍饥、冒雨，或者丢了东西被偷，而得病。
en: A ghost carrying the Dragon and moving: in a man it is from excess of wine and women, or from visiting a noble or calling on kin, caught over money.
In a woman it is caught from a joyful event.
If Void, it is a miscarriage.
A ghost carrying the Vermilion Bird and moving: from anger and quarrels, or from being cursed.
On the second line, cursing at the stove.
On the third line, cursing at the door.
On the fifth line, cursing beneath the incense-fire or on the road.
A Metal ghost carrying the Vermilion Bird and moving: cursing while banging a pot.
A ghost carrying the Hook Earth and moving: injury from falls and blows, hunger and overeating out of turn, an ailment of the spleen and stomach.
A Hook Earth ghost with Wood added and moving: the illness is caught from building work.
A ghost carrying the Coiling Snake and moving: worry and fright, thought that harms the spirit, or the illness is caught from meeting a demon or evil.
A ghost carrying the Tiger and moving: injury from brawling, or the illness is caught at a funeral, in a scene of blades and weapons, or of slaughter.
A ghost carrying the Dark Tortoise and moving: the illness comes from excess of lust, enduring hunger, braving rain, or from losing things to theft.

title: 病因·鬼伏六亲下或六亲化鬼：伏父或父动化鬼忧心得病、衣服寒暖失时；伏兄或兄动化鬼赌博争财；伏财或财动化鬼饮食不节，财在阳宫动主吐、阴宫动主泻、加土动吐、加水动泻；伏子或子动化鬼外情牵引酒色（加龙嗜酒、加武好色）；子爻空绝调理无资；间爻鬼动胸膈不宽

rule.yi: 鬼伏在父母爻下、或父母爻发动变出鬼的，是忧心得病，或者衣服冷暖穿脱不及时得病；鬼伏在兄爻下、或兄爻发动变出鬼的，是因为赌博争财得病；鬼伏在财爻下、或财爻发动变出鬼的，是饮食没有节制而起：财爻在阳宫发动主呕吐，在阴宫发动主泄泻，财带土发动的吐，财带水发动的泻；鬼伏在子孙爻下、或子孙发动变出鬼的，是被外面的情事牵引，或者酒色致病（带青龙是嗜酒，带玄武是好色）；子孙爻空亡、绝的，没有钱调理；间爻上的鬼发动，胸膈不舒畅。
