rule.en: A ghost hidden beneath the Resource line, or Resource moving and changing into a ghost: the illness is caught from anxiety of heart, or from clothing not changed in time for cold and warmth. Beneath the Peer line, or Peer moving and changing into a ghost: from gambling and quarrels over money. Beneath Wealth, or Wealth moving and changing into a ghost: from intemperate eating and drinking — Wealth moving in a yang palace means vomiting, in a yin palace diarrhea, Wealth with Earth and moving vomiting, Wealth with Water and moving diarrhea. Beneath Output, or Output moving and changing into a ghost: from being drawn away by outside affairs, or wine and women (with the Dragon a taste for drink, with the Dark Tortoise a love of women); if the Output line is Void or in Extinction there are no means for treatment and care; a ghost moving on a between line makes the chest and diaphragm tight.

dispute.yi: 财爻动，吐还是泻看什么：易隐说财在阳宫动主吐、在阴宫动主泻，又说财带土动吐、财带水动泻；黄金策说财爻动在上卦（外卦）主吐、动在下卦（内卦）主泻（LY.ILL.HJC.30）。一个看阴阳宫，一个看上下卦，两个分法不一样；书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: What decides vomiting or diarrhea when Wealth moves: the Yi Yin says Wealth moving in a yang palace means vomiting and in a yin palace diarrhea, and also Wealth with Earth vomiting and with Water diarrhea; the Huangjin Ce says Wealth moving in the upper (outer) trigram means vomiting and in the lower (inner) trigram diarrhea (LY.ILL.HJC.30). One looks at yang and yin palaces and the other at the upper and lower trigrams, so the two divide differently; the books do not decide.

note.yi: 「间爻」是世、应之间的两爻。黄金策讲伏鬼在六亲下的病因（LY.ILL.HJC.08：伏财伤饥失饱、伏子酒色、伏父劳心、伏兄口舌争竞）和这里大体一致；这里多了「六亲发动化出鬼」的情形，和 LY.ILL.HJC.10（鬼爻化出六亲各有得病之处）是反过来的一组。
note.en: The 'between lines' are the two lines between the Self and the Other. The Huangjin Ce's causes when the ghost is hidden beneath a relation (LY.ILL.HJC.08: beneath Wealth hurt by hunger and overeating, beneath Output wine and women, beneath Resource worry of mind, beneath Peer quarrels) are broadly the same; here there is in addition the case of a relation moving and changing into a ghost, the reverse of LY.ILL.HJC.10 (the Pressure line changing into a relation, each with its own place where the illness was caught).

zh: 又鬼伏父下，与父动化鬼者，忧心得病，或衣服寒暖失时得病也。
鬼伏兄下，与兄动化鬼者，因赌博争财得病也。
鬼伏财下，与财动化鬼者，饮食不节而起也。
财加土动者吐，财加水动者泻也。
鬼伏子下，与子动化鬼者，因外情牵引，或酒色致病也(加龙则嗜酒，加武则好色)。
子爻空绝者，调理无资也。
间爻鬼动者，胸膈不宽也。
yi: 又，鬼伏在父母爻下、和父母爻发动变出鬼的，是忧心而得病，或者衣服冷暖穿脱不及时而得病。
鬼伏在兄爻下、和兄爻发动变出鬼的，是因为赌博、争财而得病。
鬼伏在财爻下、和财爻发动变出鬼的，是饮食没有节制而起。
财爻在阳宫发动，主呕吐。
在阴宫发动，主泄泻。
财带土发动的吐，财带水发动的泻。
鬼伏在子孙爻下、和子孙发动变出鬼的，是被外面的情事牵引，或者酒色致病（带青龙就是嗜酒，带玄武就是好色）。
子孙爻空亡、绝的，是没有钱调理养病。
间爻上的鬼发动，胸膈不舒畅。
en: Also a ghost hidden beneath the Resource line, or Resource moving and changing into a ghost: the illness is caught from anxiety of heart, or from clothing not changed in time for cold and warmth.
A ghost hidden beneath the Peer line, or Peer moving and changing into a ghost: the illness is caught from gambling and quarrels over money.
A ghost hidden beneath Wealth, or Wealth moving and changing into a ghost: it arises from intemperate eating and drinking.
Wealth moving in a yang palace means vomiting.
Moving in a yin palace means diarrhea.
Wealth with Earth and moving: vomiting; Wealth with Water and moving: diarrhea.

A ghost hidden beneath Output, or Output moving and changing into a ghost: the illness comes from being drawn away by outside affairs, or from wine and women (with the Dragon, a taste for drink; with the Dark Tortoise, a love of women).
If the Output line is Void or in Extinction, there are no means for treatment and care.
A ghost moving on a between line: the chest and diaphragm feel tight.

title: 病的急缓久暴：鬼旺动伤用是急症；鬼临日辰动是暴病；临月建是经月之病；衰临太岁是经年之病；衰鬼持用动是久病难除

rule.yi: 鬼旺盛发动伤到用爻的，是急症；鬼临在日辰上又发动的，是暴病；临在月建上，是拖了一个月的病；衰弱的鬼临在太岁上，是拖了一年的病；又，衰弱的鬼持着用爻发动的，是久病，难以除根。
rule.en: A strong moving ghost that harms the Subject line: an acute condition. A moving ghost on the Day: a sudden illness. On the Month: an illness of a month's standing. A weak ghost on the Tai Sui: an illness of a year's standing. Also a weak ghost holding the Subject line and moving: a long illness, hard to root out.

note.yi: 经文在原书里跨了两行（3003 行末「鬼临日辰动」和 3005 行头「者，暴病也」），这里合在一起读。
note.en: In the original this passage runs across two lines (the end of line 3003, 'a ghost on the Day moving', and the start of line 3005, ', a sudden illness'), and is read together here.

zh: 又衰鬼持用动者，久病难除也。
yi: 鬼旺盛发动伤到用爻的，是急症。
鬼临在日辰上又发动的，是暴病。
临在月建上，是拖了一个月的病。
衰弱的鬼临在太岁上，是拖了一年的病。
又，衰弱的鬼持着用爻发动的，是久病，难以除根。
en: A strong moving ghost that harms the Subject line: an acute condition.
A moving ghost on the Day: a sudden illness.
On the Month: an illness of a month's standing.
A weak ghost on the Tai Sui: an illness of a year's standing.
Also a weak ghost holding the Subject line and moving: a long illness, hard to root out.

title: 饮食：卦内无财或财空绝或四墓持用饮食不纳；禄入绝乡不进食而死；鬼动化财饮食仍进；财化鬼兄因食增病；应动合用而化财伤用忌食馈来之物；丑鬼忌牛肉、卯兔、未羊、酉鸡、戌犬、亥猪；水鬼忌鱼腥冷咸、木鬼忌果核酸、金鬼忌葱蒜姜辣、火鬼忌煎炒苦、土鬼忌米面瓜蔬甘

rule.yi: 卦里没有财，或者财爻空、绝，或者四个墓库的爻持着用爻的，吃不下东西；禄（财）落入绝地的，吃不下饭而死；鬼发动变出财的，饮食还能吃；财变出鬼、兄的，是因为吃东西使病加重；应爻发动合用爻、又变出财来伤用爻的，忌讳吃人家送来的东西。忌口：丑鬼忌牛肉，卯鬼忌兔肉，未鬼忌羊肉，酉鬼忌鸡肉，戌鬼忌狗肉，亥鬼忌猪肉；水鬼忌鱼腥、冷的、咸的东西，木鬼忌带核的果子、酸的东西，金鬼忌葱、蒜、姜、辣的东西，火鬼忌煎炒烤炙、香味浓的、苦的东西，土鬼忌米面、茄子、芋头、瓜菜、甜的东西。
rule.en: If there is no Wealth in the hexagram, or Wealth is Void or in Extinction, or the four tombs hold the Subject line, food and drink are not taken in; if the emolument (Wealth) falls into a place of Extinction, he dies without taking food; if the ghost moves and changes into Wealth, food and drink can still be taken; if Wealth changes into a ghost or Peer, the illness worsens because of eating; if the Other line moves to combine with the Subject line and changes into Wealth that harms it, gifts of food sent over must be avoided. Foods to avoid: a Chou ghost must avoid beef, a Mao ghost rabbit, a Wei ghost mutton, a You ghost chicken, a Xu ghost dog, and a Hai ghost pork; a Water ghost must avoid fishy, cold and salty things, a Wood ghost fruit with stones and sour things, a Metal ghost onions, garlic, ginger and hot pungent things, a Fire ghost fried, roasted and strongly scented or bitter things, and an Earth ghost rice and wheat, aubergine, taro, melons and vegetables and sweet things.

note.yi: 「禄」在这里指财爻（前面讲死卦时说「财为禄命」，LY.ILL.YY.06）。「四墓」是辰戌丑未四个墓库的地支。忌口这一段是把五行、地支和食物对起来，书里没有另讲为什么。黄金策讲饮食的地方见 LY.ILL.HJC.21（卦内无财则饮食不纳）。
note.en: 'Emolument' (lu) here means the Wealth line (in the hexagram-images that judge death the book says 'Wealth is the salary and destiny', LY.ILL.YY.06). The 'four tombs' are the four branches Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, the tomb-storehouses. The passage on foods to avoid matches elements, branches and foods and the book does not say why. Where the Huangjin Ce treats food and drink see LY.ILL.HJC.21 ('no Wealth in the hexagram, food is not taken in').

zh: 卦内无财，或财空绝，或四墓持用者，饮食不纳也。
禄入绝乡者，不进食而死也。
鬼动化财者，饮食仍进也。
财化鬼兄者，因食增病也。
应动合用，而化财伤用者，忌食馈来之物也。
又丑鬼忌牛肉，卯鬼忌兔肉，未鬼忌羊肉，酉鬼忌鸡肉，戌鬼忌犬肉，亥鬼忌猪肉。
又水鬼忌鱼腥冷物咸物，木鬼忌果核酸物，金鬼忌葱蒜姜辣辛物，火鬼忌煿炙煎炒香味苦物，土鬼忌米面茄芋瓜蔬甘物也。
yi: 卦里没有财，或者财爻空、绝，或者辰戌丑未四个墓的爻持着用爻的，吃不下东西。
禄（财）落入绝地的，吃不下饭而死。
鬼发动变出财的，饮食还能吃。
财变出鬼、兄的，是因为吃东西使病加重。
应爻发动合用爻，又变出财来伤用爻的，忌讳吃人家送来的东西。
又，丑鬼忌牛肉，卯鬼忌兔肉，未鬼忌羊肉，酉鬼忌鸡肉，戌鬼忌狗肉，亥鬼忌猪肉。
又，水鬼忌鱼腥、冷的、咸的东西；木鬼忌带核的果子、酸的东西；金鬼忌葱、蒜、姜、辣的东西；火鬼忌煎炒烤炙、香味浓的、苦的东西；土鬼忌米面、茄子、芋头、瓜菜、甜的东西。
en: If there is no Wealth in the hexagram, or Wealth is Void or in Extinction, or the four tombs hold the Subject line, food and drink are not taken in.
If the emolument (Wealth) falls into a place of Extinction, he dies without taking food.
If the ghost moves and changes into Wealth, food and drink can still be taken.
If Wealth changes into a ghost or Peer, the illness worsens because of eating.
If the Other line moves to combine with the Subject line and changes into Wealth that harms it, gifts of food sent over must be avoided.
Also a Chou ghost must avoid beef, a Mao ghost rabbit, a Wei ghost mutton, a You ghost chicken, a Xu ghost dog, and a Hai ghost pork.

Also a Water ghost must avoid fishy, cold and salty things; a Wood ghost fruit with stones and sour things; a Metal ghost onions, garlic, ginger and hot pungent things; a Fire ghost fried, roasted and strongly scented or bitter things; and an Earth ghost rice and wheat, aubergine, taro, melons and vegetables and sweet things.

title: 医药·药效：内卦世爻用爻是病人、外卦应爻子孙是医药；外克内、应与子孙克世克用则药效；内克外则药不效；外生合内则药对症效迟；无子孙不遇良医；子孙两动换医而愈；鬼子俱空不治自愈；鬼子俱动医祷兼用；子财两动鬼得助病难治

rule.yi: 内卦的世爻、用爻是病人，外卦的应爻、子孙是医生和药。外卦克内卦，应爻和子孙克世、克用的，药有效；内卦克外卦，世爻、用爻克应、克子孙的，药没有效；外卦生合内卦，应爻和子孙生合世的，药对症但见效慢；外卦应爻克内卦世爻而卦里没有子孙的，遇不到好医生。应爻带子孙发动来克世的，药有效；世克应和子孙的，是名医但药没有效；子孙克世而外卦应爻不克内卦世爻的，药没效也没害。应爻带鬼发动、刑害克冲世爻的，是用错药伤了人；子孙落在辰午酉亥自刑之地的，用药有差错；日辰、动爻冲伤子孙的，药没有效；子孙变出父母或鬼的，药收不到功；子孙变出子孙的，药杂不精；子孙带白虎煞发动的，是庸医误人。世下伏官、遇子孙发动的，药虽好而病根除不掉；世持衰鬼的，病轻而药难治。世应比和而卦无子孙、或子孙空绝的，宜换药换医；子孙有两个都动的，换医就好；鬼和子孙都落空的，不治自愈；鬼和子孙都发动的，医药和祈祷一起用；子孙和财爻都动，鬼得到帮助，病难治。
rule.en: The Self line and Subject line in the inner trigram are the patient, and the Other line and Output in the outer trigram are the doctor and medicine. If the outer controls the inner, and the Other and Output control the Self and the Subject, the medicine is effective; if the inner controls the outer, and the Self and Subject control the Other and Output, it is not effective; if the outer generates and combines with the inner, and the Other and Output generate and combine with the Self, the medicine fits the illness but works slowly; if the Other in the outer trigram controls the Self in the inner and there is no Output in the hexagram, one does not meet a good doctor. If the Other line carries Output and moves to control the Self, the medicine is effective; if the Self controls the Other and Output, the doctor is famous but the medicine does not work; if Output controls the Self but the Other in the outer trigram does not control the Self, the medicine has no effect and does no harm. If the Other line carries the ghost and moves to punish, harm, control or clash the Self, wrong medicine harms the person; if Output stands on Chen, Wu, You or Hai, which punish themselves, the medicine is mistaken; if the Day or a moving line clashes with and wounds Output, it does not work; if Output changes into Resource or a ghost, it does not bring completion; if Output changes into Output, the medicines are mixed and not refined; if Output carries the Tiger and a killing star and moves, a mediocre doctor harms people. If Pressure is hidden beneath the Self and Output moves, the medicine is good but the root of the illness is not removed; if the Self holds a weak ghost, the illness is light but the medicine has difficulty curing it. If the Self and Other are in harmony and there is no Output, or Output is Void or in Extinction, change the medicine and doctor; if two Output lines both move, changing the doctor leads to recovery; if the ghost and Output are both Void, he recovers without treatment; if the ghost and Output both move, use doctors and prayers together; if Output and Wealth both move, the ghost is helped and the illness is hard to treat.

note.yi: 两个断例挂在这里：坎之蹇（应爻旺相本可服药，却变出申金冲刑寅木子孙，服药不效；子旺官衰，新病不死只是难痊）、震之豫（子孙是药而午自刑，用药差误，巳午日子旺生财病才退）。书里最后一句「若至日病加重」缺了是哪一日，译文按上下文译作「那一日」，不猜是哪天。「自刑」是辰午酉亥四个地支遇到自己（如午见午）。「六冲」的新病与久病的不同，见 LY.ILL.YY.07。「良医」「名医而药不效」这一组和黄金策讲医药（LY.ILL.HJC.58 起）、增删卜易讲延医（LY.ILL.ZS.26 起）是三家各说各的一套：黄金策以应爻为医、子孙为药，易隐同；增删卜易另有以子孙为忧神解药、应爻为医人的说法。
note.en: Two cases hang here: Kan into Jian (the Other line strong and so medicine should work, but it changes into Shen Metal which clashes with and punishes Yin Wood Output and the medicine fails; Output strong and Pressure weak, so a recent illness does not kill and is only hard to cure) and Zhen into Yu (Output is the medicine but Wu punishes itself, the medicine was mistaken, and the illness retreated only on a Si or Wu day when Output strong generated Wealth). The last sentence of the second case, 'if on reaching the day the illness grows heavier', lacks which day, and the translation renders it 'that day' without guessing. 'Self-punishment' (zixing) is the four branches Chen, Wu, You and Hai meeting themselves (Wu meeting Wu). For the difference between a recent illness and a long one under Six-Clash, see LY.ILL.YY.07. This group on the good doctor and 'famous doctor, ineffective medicine' is a set of its own beside the Huangjin Ce's treatment of medicine (from LY.ILL.HJC.58) and the Zengshan Buyi's on calling a doctor (from LY.ILL.ZS.26): the Huangjin Ce takes the Other line as the doctor and Output as the medicine, as the Yi Yin does; the Zengshan Buyi also has its own account of Output as the spirit that relieves worry and the Other line as the doctor.

zh: 内卦世爻用爻为病人，外卦应爻子孙为医药。
外克内应与子孙克世克用者，药效也。
内克外，世爻用爻克应克子孙者，药不效也。
外生合内，应与子孙生合世者，药对症而效迟也。
外应克内世，卦无子孙者，不遇良医也。
父兄俱动者，子叨生而医善也。
父官双静，而子临应动者，良医到也。
应加子动克世者，药有效也。
世克应子者，名医而药不效也。
子克世，而外应不克内世者，药不效而无害也。
应加鬼动刑害克冲世者，误药伤人也。
子孙值辰午酉亥自刑者，用药差误也。
日辰动爻冲伤子孙者，药不效也。
子化父鬼者，药不收功也。
子加虎杀动者，庸医误人也。
世下伏官，逢子动者，药虽好而病根不除也。
世持衰鬼者，病虽轻而药难疗也。
世应比而卦无子，或子空绝者，宜换药医。
子孙两动者，换医而愈也。
鬼子俱空者，不治自愈也。
鬼子俱动者，医祷兼用也。
子财两动，则鬼得助而病难治也。
yi: 内卦的世爻、用爻是病人，外卦的应爻、子孙是医生和药。
外卦克内卦，应和子孙克世、克用的，药有效。
内卦克外卦，世爻、用爻克应、克子孙的，药没有效。
外卦生合内卦，应和子孙生合世的，药对症，但见效慢。
外卦的应爻克内卦的世爻，而卦里没有子孙的，遇不到好医生。
父母爻、兄爻都发动的，子孙沾光得到生，医生就好。
父母爻、官爻都安静，而子孙临在应爻上发动的，好医生来了。
应爻带子孙发动来克世爻的，药有效。
世爻克应爻、克子孙的，是名医，但药没有效。
子孙克世爻，而外卦的应爻不克内卦的世爻的，药没有效，但也没有害。
应爻带鬼发动、刑害克冲世爻的，是用错了药，伤了人。
子孙落在辰、午、酉、亥这四个自刑的地支上，用药有差错。
日辰、动爻冲伤子孙的，药没有效。
子孙变出父母、鬼的，药收不到功效。
子孙变出子孙的，药杂而不精。
子孙带白虎、煞发动的，是庸医误人。
世爻下面伏着官，遇到子孙发动的，药虽好，病根却除不掉。
世爻持着衰弱的鬼的，病虽轻，药却难以治疗。
世爻、应爻比和，而卦里没有子孙，或者子孙空、绝的，应当换药换医生。
子孙有两个都发动的，换个医生就会好。
鬼和子孙都落空的，不治疗也会自己好。
鬼和子孙都发动的，医药和祈祷一起用。
子孙和财爻都动，鬼就得到帮助，病难治。
en: The Self line and Subject line in the inner trigram are the patient, and the Other line and Output in the outer trigram are the doctor and medicine.
If the outer controls the inner, and the Other and Output control the Self and the Subject, the medicine is effective.
If the inner controls the outer, and the Self and Subject lines control the Other and Output, the medicine is not effective.
If the outer generates and combines with the inner, and the Other and Output generate and combine with the Self, the medicine fits the illness but works slowly.
If the Other in the outer trigram controls the Self in the inner, and there is no Output in the hexagram, one does not meet a good doctor.
If Resource and Peer both move, Output gains from being generated and the doctor is good.
If Resource and Pressure are both still, and Output sits on the Other line and moves, a good doctor arrives.
If the Other line carries Output and moves to control the Self, the medicine is effective.
If the Self controls the Other and Output, the doctor is famous but the medicine is not effective.
If Output controls the Self but the Other in the outer trigram does not control the Self in the inner, the medicine has no effect but does no harm.
If the Other line carries the ghost and it moves to punish, harm, control or clash the Self, wrong medicine harms the person.
If Output stands on Chen, Wu, You or Hai, which punish themselves, the medicine is mistaken.
If the Day or a moving line clashes with and wounds Output, the medicine is not effective.
If Output changes into Resource or a ghost, the medicine does not bring completion.
If Output changes into Output, the medicines are mixed and not refined.
If Output carries the Tiger and a killing star and moves, a mediocre doctor harms people.
If Pressure is hidden beneath the Self and Output moves, the medicine is good but the root of the illness is not removed.
If the Self holds a weak ghost, the illness is light but the medicine has difficulty curing it.
If the Self and Other are in harmony and there is no Output in the hexagram, or Output is Void or in Extinction, the medicine and doctor should be changed.
If two Output lines both move, changing the doctor leads to recovery.
If the ghost and Output are both Void, he recovers without treatment.
If the ghost and Output both move, doctors and prayers should be used together.
If Output and Wealth both move, the ghost is helped and the illness is hard to treat.

zh: 庚寅年戊寅月己巳日，代占人病，得坎之蹇。
应爻相气，岁月生之，日辰比之，但嫌化出申金，冲刑寅木子孙，服药不效。
辰宫化午财，刑应上午，是以多进食而受伤也。
子旺官衰，卦虽六冲，新病不死，只是难痊耳。
yi: 庚寅年戊寅月己巳日，替别人占病，得到坎卦变蹇卦。
应爻旺相，岁、月生它，日辰扶它，只嫌变出申金，冲刑寅木子孙，所以服药没有效。
辰（土）变出午财，刑到应爻上的午，所以吃得多而受了伤。
官爻属土，是脾胃的病。
子孙旺、官爻衰，卦虽然是六冲，新病不会死，只是难以痊愈。
en: In the Gengyin year, the Wuyin month, on the Jisi day, someone divined for another's illness and obtained Kan changing into Jian.

The Other line is in season and is generated by the Year and Month and supported by the Day, but it is unfortunate that it changes into Shen Metal, which clashes with and punishes Yin Wood Output, so taking medicine had no effect.
The Chen line changes into Wu Wealth, which punishes the Wu on the Other line, and so he was harmed by eating too much.
The Pressure line is Earth: an ailment of the spleen and stomach.
Output is strong and Pressure weak; although the hexagram is Six-Clash, a recent illness does not kill, it is only hard to cure.

zh: 庚寅年甲申月乙丑日，夫占妻病，得震之豫。
世下戌财，正值旬空，日辰丑又刑戌，应爻辰财又自刑，初下子水动，化未土，与世下戌土又相刑，用爻受制，病必重也，子孙为药，午为自刑，用药差误，所以病剧也。
逢巳午日，子旺生财，始病退。
若至日病加重，必难疗也。
yi: 庚寅年甲申月乙丑日，丈夫占妻子的病，得到震卦变豫卦。
世爻下面的戌财，正好值旬空，日辰丑又刑戌；应爻的辰财又自刑；初爻下的子水发动，变出未土，和世爻下的戌土又相刑；用爻受制，病一定重；子孙是药，午是自刑，用药有差错，所以病加剧。
逢到巳日、午日，子孙旺相来生财，病才开始退。
如果到了（那一）日病加重，就一定难治。
en: In the Gengyin year, the Jiashen month, on the Yichou day, a husband divined about his wife's illness and obtained Zhen changing into Yu.

The Xu Wealth beneath the Self is exactly in Void, the Chou Day further punishes Xu, and the Chen Wealth on the Other line punishes itself; the Zi Water on the first line moves and changes into Wei Earth, which again punishes the Xu Earth beneath the Self; the Subject line is restrained, so the illness is surely heavy; Output is the medicine and Wu punishes itself, so the medicine was mistaken, and that is why the illness worsened.
On a Si or Wu day, Output is strong and generates Wealth, and only then does the illness retreat.
If on reaching that day the illness grows heavier, it will surely be hard to cure.

title: 医药·天医（《法法赋》）：天医生世是良医、克世是庸医；日辰克医医学不精、医克日辰用药不当；世爻用爻属金天医在巳、木在亥、火在寅、水土在申则效

rule.yi: 《法法赋》说：天医生世爻的，是好医生；天医克世爻的，是庸医；日辰克医生的，医术不精；医生克日辰的，用药不恰当。世爻、用爻属金的，天医在巳有效；属木的，天医在亥有效；属火的，天医在寅有效；属水、土的，天医在申有效。
rule.en: The Fafa Fu says: if the Heavenly Doctor generates the Self, he is a good doctor; if it controls the Self, a mediocre one; if the Day controls the doctor, his medical learning is not refined; if the doctor controls the Day, the medicine used is not fitting. If the Self line and Subject line are Metal, the Heavenly Doctor at Si is effective; if Wood, at Hai; if Fire, at Yin; if Water or Earth, at Shen.

note.yi: 「天医」是一颗神煞。这里的天医按世爻用爻的五行取，取的是那一行长生的地支（金长生在巳、木在亥、火在寅、水土在申）；易冒讲的天医是按月取（丁神），不是这一个（见易冒的天医，书里另有说明）。「法法赋」是易隐引的一部书，书里没有再介绍。
note.en: The 'Heavenly Doctor' is a spirit-star. Here it is taken by the element of the Self and Subject lines, using the branch where that element is born (Metal is born at Si, Wood at Hai, Fire at Yin, Water and Earth at Shen); the Heavenly Doctor the Yi Mao speaks of is taken by the month (the Ding spirit) and is not this one (the Yi Mao explains its own). The 'Fafa Fu' is a work the Yi Yin quotes and the book does not introduce.

zh: 法法赋曰，天医生世者，良医。
医克日辰者，用药不当也。
世爻用爻属金，天医在巳者效也。
属水土，天医在申者效也。
yi: 《法法赋》说：天医生世的，是好医生。
天医克世的，是庸医。
日辰克医生的，医术不精。
医生克日辰的，用药不恰当。
世爻、用爻属金的，天医在巳有效。
属木的，天医在亥有效。
属火的，天医在寅有效。
属水、土的，天医在申有效。
en: The Fafa Fu says: if the Heavenly Doctor generates the Self, he is a good doctor.
If the Heavenly Doctor controls the Self, a mediocre doctor.
If the Day controls the doctor, his medical learning is not refined.
If the doctor controls the Day, the medicine used is not fitting.
If the Self line and the Subject line are Metal, the Heavenly Doctor at Si is effective.
If Wood, the Heavenly Doctor at Hai is effective.
If Fire, the Heavenly Doctor at Yin is effective.
If Water or Earth, the Heavenly Doctor at Shen is effective.

title: 医药·脉（《董和筮秘》）：脉宜细察，身爻为主；月卦临金脉弦紧代革、临木洪长虚动、临水芤滑濡动、值火数大促短、值土沉实滞涩

rule.yi: 《董和筮秘》说：脉要仔细察，以身爻为主。月卦临在金上，脉一定是弦、紧、代、革；临在木上，脉一定是洪、长、虚、动；临在水上，脉一定是芤、滑、濡、动；值火，脉一定是数、大、促、短；值土，脉一定是沉、实、滞、涩。
rule.en: The Dong He Shimi says: the pulse should be examined carefully, with the Body line as the master. If the month-hexagram falls on Metal, the pulse is surely wiry, tight, intermittent and leathery; on Wood, surging, long, vacuous and stirring; on Water, hollow, slippery, soft and stirring; on Fire, rapid, large, hurried and short; on Earth, deep, full, sluggish and rough.

note.yi: 弦、紧、代、革、洪、长、虚、动、芤、滑、濡、数、大、促、短、沉、实、滞、涩都是中医脉名，译文用通行的英文脉名的字面。「身爻」「月卦」书里没有在这里解释（月卦身法，见 LY.ILL.HJC.35）。这一段是易隐引的《董和筮秘》，不是易隐自己的话。
note.en: Xian, jin, dai, ge, hong, chang, xu, dong, kou, hua, ru, shu, da, cu, duan, chen, shi, zhi and se are all names of pulses in Chinese medicine, rendered by the usual literal English pulse names. The 'Body line' and 'month-hexagram' are not explained here (for the month-body method see LY.ILL.HJC.35). This passage is the Dong He Shimi as quoted in the Yi Yin, not the Yi Yin's own words.

zh: 董和筮秘曰，脉宜细察，身爻为主。
月卦临金，脉必弦紧代革也。
yi: 《董和筮秘》说：脉要仔细察，以身爻为主。
月卦临在金上，脉一定是弦、紧、代、革。
临在木上，脉一定是洪、长、虚、动。
临在水上，脉一定是芤、滑、濡、动。
值火，脉一定是数、大、促、短。
值土，脉一定是沉、实、滞、涩。
en: The Dong He Shimi says: the pulse should be examined carefully, with the Body line as the master.
If the month-hexagram falls on Metal, the pulse is surely wiry, tight, intermittent and leathery.
On Wood, the pulse is surely surging, long, vacuous and stirring.
On Water, the pulse is surely hollow, slippery, soft and stirring.
On Fire, the pulse is surely rapid, large, hurried and short.
On Earth, the pulse is surely deep, full, sluggish and rough.

title: 医药·推医是何人：子孙为用，五行定方位姓氏——金宜西方金旁姓氏、木宜东方草木旁、水宜北方点水旁、火宜南方日火旁、土宜土旁及丹散医人；子孙带贵人宜有官职人、带华盖宜僧道

rule.yi: 推断请来的医生是什么样的人，拿子孙做用：子孙属金，适合西方的、姓氏带金字旁的人；属木，适合东方的、姓氏带草头或木字旁的人；属水，适合北方的、姓氏带三点水的人；属火，适合南方的、姓氏带日字旁或火字旁的人；属土，适合姓氏带土字旁的，以及用丹药散剂的医生。子孙带贵人，适合有官职的人；子孙带华盖，适合僧人道士。
rule.en: To work out what kind of person the doctor is, Output is the Subject: if Output is Metal, it suits the west, a person whose surname has the metal radical; if Wood, the east, a surname with the grass or wood radical; if Water, the north, a surname with the water radical; if Fire, the south, a surname with the sun or fire radical; if Earth, a surname with the earth radical, and a doctor who works with cinnabar and powders. If Output carries the Noble, a person holding an official post; if Output carries the Canopy, a monk or Daoist.

note.yi: 这一条和增删卜易讲的「延医于子孙之方，姓名按五行：水点水、火象火、木草头木旁、土有土」（LY.ILL.ZS.34）几乎一样，是同一个说法两本书都有。「华盖」是一颗神煞，主僧道孤高；「贵人」也是神煞，主有人扶助。
note.en: This entry is almost the same as the Zengshan Buyi's 'calling the doctor in the direction of Output, the surname by the element: Water with the water radical, Fire with the fire image, Wood with the grass or wood radical, Earth with earth' (LY.ILL.ZS.34); the two books have the same saying. The 'Canopy' (Huagai) is a spirit-star for monks and Daoists and the solitary and aloof; the 'Noble' is also a spirit-star, for help from others.

zh: 又推医是何人，子孙为用。
子孙属金，宜西方，金傍姓氏人也。
属木，宜东方，草木傍姓氏也。
属水，宜北方，点水傍姓氏人也。
属火，宜南方，日火傍姓氏人也。
属土，宜土傍姓氏，及丹散医人也。
子孙带贵人，宜有官职人。
yi: 又，推断请来的医生是什么样的人，拿子孙做用。
子孙属金，适合西方的、姓氏带金字旁的人。
属木，适合东方的、姓氏带草头或木字旁的人。
属水，适合北方的、姓氏带三点水的人。
属火，适合南方的、姓氏带日字旁或火字旁的人。
属土，适合姓氏带土字旁的，以及用丹药散剂的医生。
子孙带贵人，适合有官职的人。
子孙带华盖，适合僧人道士。
en: Again, to work out what kind of person the doctor is, Output is the Subject.
If Output is Metal, it suits the west, a person whose surname has the metal radical.
If Wood, the east, a person whose surname has the grass or wood radical.
If Water, the north, a person whose surname has the water radical.
If Fire, the south, a person whose surname has the sun or fire radical.
If Earth, a person whose surname has the earth radical, and a doctor who works with cinnabar and powders.
If Output carries the Noble, a person holding an official post.
If Output carries the Canopy, a monk or Daoist.

title: 医药·治法与用药：官鬼属金宜灸不宜丸药、属木宜针不宜汤药、属水宜温药丸药不宜针、属火宜凉药汤药不宜草头药饮片、属土宜咬咀不宜灸（取克鬼者、忌生鬼者）；鬼伤二间宜宽胸膈；财外动合用宜吐、内动宜泻；鬼在外卦宜外表、伏内卦宜内表

rule.yi: 用药不要轻易乱投。官鬼属金的，适合灸，不适合丸药（火能克金，土生金）；鬼属木的，适合针，不适合汤药（金能克木，水生木）；鬼属水的，适合温药、丸药，不适合针（土克水，金生水）；鬼属火的，适合凉药、汤药，不适合草头药和饮片（水克火，木生火）；鬼属土的，适合咬咀，不适合灸（木克土，火生土）。此外，鬼伤到两个间爻的，适合宽胸膈；世爻旺又有扶助的，不妨再进补；财爻在外卦发动合用爻的，适合吐法，在内卦发动合用爻的，适合泻法；用爻、鬼爻出现或在外卦的，适合治外表，伏藏在内卦的，适合治内。
rule.en: Medicine is not to be given lightly. If the Pressure line is Metal, moxibustion suits and pills do not (Fire can control Metal, while Earth generates Metal); if the ghost is Wood, acupuncture suits and decoctions do not (Metal can control Wood, while Water generates Wood); if Water, warm medicines and pills suit and acupuncture does not (Earth controls Water, while Metal generates Water); if Fire, cool medicines and decoctions suit and herbal medicines and sliced drugs do not (Water controls Fire, while Wood generates Fire); if Earth, crushed herbs suit and moxibustion does not (Wood controls Earth, while Fire generates Earth). Besides: if the ghost harms the two between lines, ease the chest and diaphragm; if the Self is strong and supported, there is no harm in tonics again; if Wealth moves in the outer trigram and combines with the Subject line, an emetic suits, and in the inner trigram, a purgative; if the Subject line and the Pressure line appear openly or are in the outer trigram, treat the exterior, and if hidden in the inner trigram, treat the interior.

dispute.yi: 治法与药性要不要按鬼的五行来选：易隐说得很具体——鬼属金宜灸、属木宜针、属水宜温药丸药、属火宜凉药汤药、属土宜咬咀，原则是用克鬼的、避开生鬼的；黄金策也有火鬼旺宜大寒药、水鬼旺宜大热药的说法（LY.ILL.HJC.82、LY.ILL.HJC.84），方向一致。增删卜易的李我平驳这些说法拘泥，说子孙不是针灸之药，胶柱鼓瑟会坑陷人命（LY.ILL.ZS.40）。三家意见不同，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Whether the way of treatment and the nature of the drug is chosen by the element of the ghost: the Yi Yin is very specific — Metal, moxibustion; Wood, acupuncture; Water, warm medicines and pills; Fire, cool medicines and decoctions; Earth, crushed herbs — the principle being to use what controls the ghost and avoid what generates it; the Huangjin Ce also has the sayings that a strong Fire ghost suits very cold medicine and a strong Water ghost very hot medicine (LY.ILL.HJC.82 and LY.ILL.HJC.84), in the same direction. Li Woping of the Zengshan Buyi rejects these as rigid, saying Output is not the medicine of acupuncture and moxibustion and that sticking to the letter pits and drowns lives (LY.ILL.ZS.40). The three differ and the books do not decide.

note.yi: 「君臣佐使」是配药时药的四种分工。「咬咀」（也写作㕮咀）是把药切碎或捣成粗末，用来煎汤。「表」是身体的表层，「外表」「内表」书里没有再解释，译文按字面译作治外表、治内。「二间」是世应之间的两爻（间爻）。括号里的话是书里自己的理由。
note.en: 'Sovereign, minister, assistant and envoy' are the four divisions of labour among the drugs in compounding. 'Yaozu' (also written fu zu) is cutting medicine up or pounding it into coarse powder for decoction. 'Biao' is the surface layer of the body, and 'outer biao' and 'inner biao' are not explained further and are rendered literally as treating the exterior and the interior. The 'two between' are the two lines between the Self and Other (the between lines). The words in brackets are the book's own reasons.

zh: 至于君臣佐使药莫轻投。
官鬼属金，宜灸，不宜丸药也(火可克金，土则生金)。
鬼属木，宜针，不宜汤药也(金能克木，水则生木)。
鬼属水，宜温药，丸药，不宜针也(土克水，金生水)。
鬼属火，宜凉药，汤药，不宜草头药，与饮片也(以水克火，而木生火)。
鬼属土，宜咬咀，不宜灸也(以木克土，而火生土)。
他若鬼伤二间者，宜宽胸膈也。
世旺有扶者，不妨再补也。
用爻鬼爻出现，与在外卦者，宜外表。
伏藏在内卦者，宜内表也。
yi: 至于君臣佐使这些配药的讲究，药不要轻易乱投。
官鬼属金的，适合灸，不适合丸药（火能克金，土生金）。
鬼属木的，适合针，不适合汤药（金能克木，水生木）。
鬼属水的，适合温药、丸药，不适合针（土克水，金生水）。
鬼属火的，适合凉药、汤药，不适合草头药和饮片（以水克火，而木生火）。
鬼属土的，适合咬咀，不适合灸（以木克土，而火生土）。
另外，鬼伤到两个间爻的，适合宽胸膈。
世爻旺又有扶助的，不妨再进补。
财爻在外卦发动合用爻的，适合吐法。
财爻在内卦发动合用爻的，适合泻法。
用爻和鬼爻出现，或者在外卦的，适合治外表。
伏藏在内卦的，适合治内。
en: As for the 'sovereign, minister, assistant and envoy' of compounding, medicine should not be given lightly.
If the Pressure line is Metal, moxibustion suits and pills do not (Fire can control Metal, while Earth generates Metal).
If the ghost is Wood, acupuncture suits and decoctions do not (Metal can control Wood, while Water generates Wood).
If the ghost is Water, warm medicines and pills suit and acupuncture does not (Earth controls Water, while Metal generates Water).
If the ghost is Fire, cool medicines and decoctions suit and herbal medicines and sliced drugs do not (Water controls Fire, while Wood generates Fire).
If the ghost is Earth, crushed herbs suit and moxibustion does not (Wood controls Earth, while Fire generates Earth).
Again, if the ghost harms the two between lines, ease the chest and diaphragm.
If the Self is strong and supported, there is no harm in tonics again.
If Wealth moves in the outer trigram and combines with the Subject line, an emetic suits.
If Wealth moves in the inner trigram and combines with the Subject line, a purgative suits.
If the Subject line and the Pressure line appear openly, or are in the outer trigram, treat the exterior.
If they are hidden in the inner trigram, treat the interior.

title: 医药·受病在此所治在彼（周杰）：金虎鬼冲伤用是肝受病然治肺不治肝，木虎鬼脾受病治肝，水虎鬼心受病治肾，火虎鬼肺受病治心，土虎鬼肾受病治脾；颗师：子孙动者误服药

rule.yi: 周杰说：有的病是在这里受的，该治的却在那里。比如金的虎鬼冲伤用爻，是肝经受了病（金来克木），但应当治肺，不能治肝（这就是所说的去掉害我的那一个，其余照这个办法推）；木的虎鬼冲伤用爻，是脾经受病（木来伤土），该治肝，不能治脾；水的虎鬼冲伤用爻，是心经受病（水来伤火），该治肾，不能治心；火的虎鬼冲伤用爻，是肺经受病（火来伤金），该治心，不能治肺；土的虎鬼冲伤用爻，是肾经受病（土来伤水），该治脾，不能治肾（出自《松径玄谈》）。颗师说：子孙发动的，是吃错了药。
rule.en: Zhou Jie says: in some cases the illness is received in one place while the treatment lies in another. For example, if a Metal Tiger ghost clashes with and wounds the Subject line, the liver channel has received the illness (Metal comes to control Wood), yet one may treat the lungs and must not treat the liver (this is what is meant by removing what harms me; the rest follow this); a Wood Tiger ghost wounding the Subject line: the spleen channel has received the illness (Wood comes to wound Earth), treat the liver, not the spleen; a Water Tiger ghost: the heart channel (Water wounds Fire), treat the kidneys, not the heart; a Fire Tiger ghost: the lung channel (Fire wounds Metal), treat the heart, not the lungs; an Earth Tiger ghost: the kidney channel (Earth wounds Water), treat the spleen, not the kidneys (from the Songjing Xuantan). Master Ke says: when Output moves, the wrong medicine has been taken.

dispute.yi: 子孙发动是好是坏：颗师说「子孙动者误服药」，子孙一动就是吃错了药，断例（剥之观）也照这个断，子孙发动冲克官爻、又变出巳绝，药不对症；黄金策、卜筮正宗、增删卜易都是另一个方向——子孙发动制鬼，是药能见效、甚至不药自愈（LY.ILL.HJC.32、LY.ILL.BSZZ.12、LY.ILL.ZS.30）。同一个爻象，两个相反的说法，书里没有裁决。周杰讲的「受病在此所治在彼」则是易隐这一组里独有的说法，别处没有。
dispute.en: Whether a moving Output line is good or bad: Master Ke says 'when Output moves, the wrong medicine has been taken', and the case (Bo into Guan) is judged the same way — Output moving to clash with and control Pressure and then changing into Si in Extinction, the medicine did not fit; the Huangjin Ce, the Bushi Zhengzong and the Zengshan Buyi go the other way — Output moving to restrain the ghost means the medicine will take effect, even that he recovers without medicine (LY.ILL.HJC.32, LY.ILL.BSZZ.12 and LY.ILL.ZS.30). The same line-image has two opposite sayings and the books do not decide. Zhou Jie's 'the illness is received here and the treatment lies there' is a saying peculiar to this group in the Yi Yin and is found nowhere else.

note.yi: 「虎鬼」是白虎带鬼。周杰讲的是一种间接的治法：病是某一行的鬼伤了用爻所在的那一脏引起的，治的却不是被伤的那一脏，而是「去掉那个害我的」，也就是鬼那一行自己所属的脏——金鬼伤木（肝），治肺；木鬼伤土（脾），治肝；水鬼伤火（心），治肾；火鬼伤金（肺），治心；土鬼伤水（肾），治脾。书里只给了这张对应表和一句「去其害我者，余仿此」，没有再解释。「颗师」「松径玄谈」都是易隐引的人名书名，书里没有再介绍。
note.en: The 'Tiger ghost' is the White Tiger carrying the ghost. Zhou Jie gives an indirect way of treatment: the illness is caused by a ghost of one element wounding the viscus that the Subject line stands for, yet what is treated is not the viscus wounded but 'what harms me is removed', that is, the viscus belonging to the ghost's own element — a Metal ghost wounding Wood (the liver), treat the lungs; a Wood ghost wounding Earth (the spleen), treat the liver; a Water ghost wounding Fire (the heart), treat the kidneys; a Fire ghost wounding Metal (the lungs), treat the heart; an Earth ghost wounding Water (the kidneys), treat the spleen. The book gives only this table and the phrase 'remove what harms me; the rest follow this' and no further explanation. 'Master Ke' and the 'Songjing Xuantan' are a person and a work the Yi Yin cites and the book does not introduce.

zh: 周杰曰，有受病在此，所治在彼者。
如金虎鬼冲伤用，乃肝经受病(金来克木)。
然可治肺，不可治肝也(所云去其害我者，余仿此)。
木虎鬼冲伤用，乃脾经受病(木来伤土)。
水虎鬼冲伤用，乃心经受病(水来伤火)。
火虎鬼冲伤用，乃肺经受病(火来伤金)。
土虎鬼冲伤用，乃肾经受病(土来伤水)。
然可治脾，不可治肾也(出松径玄谈)。
颗师曰，子孙动者误服药。
yi: 周杰说：有的病是在这里受的，该治的却在那里。
比如金的虎鬼冲伤用爻，是肝经受了病（金来克木）。
但是应当治肺，不能治肝（所说的去掉害我的那一个，其余照这个办法推）。
木的虎鬼冲伤用爻，是脾经受病（木来伤土）。
但是应当治肝，不能治脾。
水的虎鬼冲伤用爻，是心经受病（水来伤火）。
但是应当治肾，不能治心。
火的虎鬼冲伤用爻，是肺经受病（火来伤金）。
但是应当治心，不能治肺。
土的虎鬼冲伤用爻，是肾经受病（土来伤水）。
但是应当治脾，不能治肾（出自《松径玄谈》）。
颗师说：子孙发动的，是吃错了药。
en: Zhou Jie says: in some cases the illness is received in one place while the treatment lies in another.
For example, if a Metal Tiger ghost clashes with and wounds the Subject line, the liver channel has received the illness (Metal comes to control Wood).
But one may treat the lungs and must not treat the liver (this is what is meant by removing what harms me; the rest follow this).
If a Wood Tiger ghost clashes with and wounds the Subject line, the spleen channel has received the illness (Wood comes to wound Earth).
But one may treat the liver and must not treat the spleen.
If a Water Tiger ghost clashes with and wounds the Subject line, the heart channel has received the illness (Water comes to wound Fire).
But one may treat the kidneys and must not treat the heart.
If a Fire Tiger ghost clashes with and wounds the Subject line, the lung channel has received the illness (Fire comes to wound Metal).
But one may treat the heart and must not treat the lungs.
If an Earth Tiger ghost clashes with and wounds the Subject line, the kidney channel has received the illness (Earth comes to wound Water).
But one may treat the spleen and must not treat the kidneys (from the Songjing Xuantan).
Master Ke says: when Output moves, the wrong medicine has been taken.

zh: 庚寅年戊寅月戊寅日，妻占夫病，得剥之观。
官爻受三传生合，人皆云吉。
不知本宫午官自刑，伏墓戌土下，傍爻子动冲克官，极凶。
子又化绝于巳，必始因药不投而后不延医也。
只有三传生合官鬼，不过暂时少甦，至甲申日，元神绝而忌神生，果死也。
yi: 庚寅年戊寅月戊寅日，妻子占丈夫的病，得到剥卦变观卦。
官爻受到三传（年、月、日）的生、合，大家都说吉。
不知道本宫的午官自己刑自己，伏在墓上的戌土下面，旁边的子孙爻发动来冲克官爻，极凶。
子孙动，是吃错了药。
子孙又变出巳而绝，一定是起初因为药不对症，后来就不请医生了。
只有三传生合官鬼，不过让他暂时稍微苏醒一下；到甲申日，原神绝、忌神生，果然死了。
en: In the Gengyin year, the Wuyin month, on the Wuyin day, a wife divined about her husband's illness and obtained Bo changing into Guan.
The Pressure line was generated and combined by the three rulers (Year, Month and Day), and everyone said it was auspicious.

They did not know that the Wu Pressure of the home palace punishes itself and lies hidden beneath Xu Earth, its tomb, while the Output line beside it moves and clashes with and controls Pressure — extremely ominous.
Output moves: wrong medicine was taken.
Output further changes into Si, where it is in Extinction; surely at first the medicine did not fit, and afterwards no doctor was called.
Only the three rulers generating and combining with Pressure gave him a brief revival; on the Jiashen day the Support was extinct and the Adversary born, and he indeed died.

title: 鬼崇·祈禳：以官鬼为用，无鬼或鬼空绝则无鬼崇；官鬼生合世用宜祈祷、官持世用先祷后医、鬼动克世用而福动救助宜禳保、世用持财逢火鬼动宜众保；阳鬼为神、阴官为鬼、鬼带书贵为神

rule.yi: 以官鬼为用爻：卦里没有鬼，或者鬼遇到空、绝，就没有鬼崇。官鬼来生、合世爻和用爻的，适合祈祷；官爻持着世爻、用爻的，先祈祷后医治；鬼发动刑害克冲世爻、用爻，而有福神发动来救助的，适合禳解保佑；世爻、用爻持着财、又遇火鬼发动的，适合大家一起保祷。问祈禳的是哪一路神鬼：阳鬼是神，阴官是鬼；鬼带文书、贵人的，是神。
rule.en: The Pressure line is the Subject: if there is no ghost in the hexagram, or the ghost meets Void or Extinction, there are no ghostly influences. If the Pressure line generates or combines with the Self and the Subject, prayer is fitting; if Pressure holds the Self and Subject, pray first and treat afterwards; if the ghost moves to punish, harm, control or clash the Self and Subject and Fortune moves to rescue and help, exorcism and protection suit; if the Self and Subject hold Wealth and a Fire ghost moves, a communal rite of protection suits. To ask which spirit or ghost the prayer is for: a yang ghost is a spirit and a yin Pressure line is a ghost; a ghost carrying the Document and the Noble is a spirit.

dispute.yi: 怎么分神和鬼：易隐说「阳鬼为神，阴官为鬼」，按鬼爻是阴爻还是阳爻分；这和卜筮正宗的王洪绪「阳为神为男，阴为鬼为女」一致（LY.ILL.HJC.94），而黄金策的旧注和增删卜易的觉子都是按旺衰分——旺相是神、休囚是鬼（LY.ILL.HJC.94、LY.ILL.ZS.23），觉子还说鬼休囚或空破墓绝根本不是鬼神作祟。两种分法不同，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: How to tell a spirit from a ghost: the Yi Yin says 'a yang ghost is a spirit, a yin Pressure line is a ghost', by whether the Pressure line is a yin or a yang line; this agrees with Wang Hongxu of the Bushi Zhengzong, 'yang is a spirit and male, yin a ghost and female' (LY.ILL.HJC.94), while the old commentary of the Huangjin Ce and Juezi of the Zengshan Buyi both go by strength — strong is a spirit, resting or trapped a ghost (LY.ILL.HJC.94 and LY.ILL.ZS.23), and Juezi adds that if the ghost is resting, trapped, Void, broken, in a tomb or in Extinction it is not a ghost or spirit making trouble at all. The two divide differently and the books do not decide.

note.yi: 「祈祷」「禳保」「众保」是三种不同的仪式：祈祷是向神祈求，禳保是禳解并求保佑，众保是众人一起（如社里的会）保祷。「书贵」按字面是文书、贵人两颗星，书里没有再解释。
note.en: 'Qidao', 'rangbao' and 'zhongbao' are three different rites: prayer is asking a spirit, 'rangbao' is exorcism together with a request for protection, and 'zhongbao' is protection sought by many together (as in a village society). 'Shugui' is literally the Document and the Noble stars and the book does not explain further.

zh: 以官鬼为用，如卦无鬼及鬼逢空绝者，则无鬼崇也。
官鬼生合世用者，宜祈祷也。
官持世用者，先祷后医也。
鬼动刑害克冲世用，得福动来救助者，宜禳保也。
世用持财，逢火鬼动者，宜众保也。
问祈禳是何神鬼，则阳鬼为神，阴官为鬼也。
yi: 以官鬼为用爻；如果卦里没有鬼，或者鬼遇到空、绝，就没有鬼崇。
官鬼来生、合世爻和用爻的，适合祈祷。
官爻持着世爻、用爻的，先祈祷后医治。
鬼发动刑、害、克、冲世爻、用爻，而有福神发动来救助的，适合禳解保佑。
世爻、用爻持着财，又遇火鬼发动的，适合大家一起保祷。
问祈禳的是哪一路神鬼：阳鬼是神，阴官是鬼。
又，鬼带文书、贵人的，是神。
en: The Pressure line is the Subject; if there is no ghost in the hexagram, or the ghost meets Void or Extinction, there are no ghostly influences.
If the Pressure line generates or combines with the Self and the Subject, prayer is fitting.
If Pressure holds the Self and the Subject, pray first and treat afterwards.
If the ghost moves to punish, harm, control or clash the Self and Subject and Fortune moves to rescue and help, exorcism and protection suit.
If the Self and Subject hold Wealth and a Fire ghost moves, a communal rite of protection suits.
To ask which spirit or ghost the prayer and exorcism is for: a yang ghost is a spirit and a yin Pressure line is a ghost.
Also a ghost carrying the Document and the Noble is a spirit.

title: 鬼崇·神与鬼的名目：阳金鬼庵堂关圣（在虎为七煞）、阴金鬼刀伤自刎痨瘵喘嗽虎伤之魂；阳木鬼东岳五圣家先、阴木鬼自缢疯疾跌扑刑杖死；阳水鬼观音真武三官水神河泊、阴水鬼投河服卤呕血；阳火鬼玄坛五福火神灶司、阴火鬼疮毒痨疫带血心疼烧死；阳土鬼城隍土谷太岁皮场大王、阴土鬼瘟疫咽喉臌胀黄疸压死

rule.yi: 按五行和阴阳分神和鬼：阳金鬼是庵堂、关圣，带白虎的是七煞；阴金鬼是死于刀伤、自刎、痨病、喘嗽、虎伤的魂。阳木鬼是东岳、五圣、家先香火；阴木鬼是自缢、疯病、跌扑、被杖刑打死的魂。阳水鬼是观音、真武、三官、水神、张神、河泊、水官；阴水鬼是投河、喝卤水、呕血而死的魂。阳火鬼是玄坛、五福、火神、灶司的香火；阴火鬼是死于疮毒、痨病、瘟疫、带血、心痛、烧死的魂。阳土鬼是城隍、土谷、太岁、皮场大王和土神；阴土鬼是死于瘟疫、咽喉病、臌胀、黄疸、被压死的魂。
rule.en: Spirits and ghosts by element and by yin and yang: a yang Metal ghost is the temples and halls and Guan Sheng, and with the Tiger the Seven Killings; a yin Metal ghost is the souls of those who died of blade wounds, cutting their own throats, consumption, wheezing cough or a tiger's bite. A yang Wood ghost is the Eastern Peak, the Five Sages and the incense of family forebears; a yin Wood ghost the souls of those who hanged themselves or died of madness, falls and blows, or a beating with the rod. A yang Water ghost is Guanyin, Zhenwu, the Three Officials, the water spirits, the Zhang spirit, the Lord of the River and the Water Official; a yin Water ghost the souls of those who threw themselves into a river, drank brine or vomited blood. A yang Fire ghost is the incense of the Dark Altar, the Five Blessings, the Fire God and the Kitchen Official; a yin Fire ghost the souls of those who died of sores and poison, consumption, epidemic, bleeding, heart pain or burning. A yang Earth ghost is the City God, the Earth and Grain gods, the Tai Sui, the Great King of the Hide Market and earth spirits; a yin Earth ghost the souls of those who died of epidemic, throat disease, swelling, jaundice or being crushed.

dispute.yi: 要不要把五行落实到具体的神：易隐按阳鬼、阴鬼列了很具体的名目（阳金鬼是庵堂关圣，阳木鬼是东岳五圣，阳水鬼是观音真武三官……），黄金策的旧注也列过（灶君、伤司、河伯江神，LY.ILL.HJC.97）；增删卜易的觉子认为不必把金官指为关公岳公这样的神，要问病人心里疑的是哪位再占一卦（LY.ILL.ZS.24），李我平更批评《易冒》《易林补遗》指定关岳（LY.ILL.ZS.25）。指名派和不指名派，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Whether to fix the elements to particular named spirits: the Yi Yin gives very specific names by yang and yin ghost (a yang Metal ghost the temples and Guan Sheng, a yang Wood ghost the Eastern Peak and the Five Sages, a yang Water ghost Guanyin, Zhenwu and the Three Officials...), and the old commentary of the Huangjin Ce also lists names (the Kitchen God, the Injuring Office, the Lord of the River and river god, LY.ILL.HJC.97); Juezi of the Zengshan Buyi holds that one should not name Metal Pressure as Guan Gong, Yue Gong and the like but ask which spirit the patient has in mind and divine again (LY.ILL.ZS.24), and Li Woping criticises the Yi Mao and the Yilin Buyi for naming Guan and Yue (LY.ILL.ZS.25). The naming school and the non-naming school are not settled by the books.

note.yi: 阳鬼是神的一列（庙里的神），阴鬼是鬼的一列（死于什么的魂）。「关圣」是关帝（关羽），「玄坛」是赵公明（财神），「真武」是北方之神，「三官」是天、地、水三官，「五福」「五圣」「张神」「皮场大王」是民间信奉的神，书里没有一一解释，按字面译。「七煞」「在虎七煞」书里没有再解释。「滷」是卤水（盐卤，自尽用）。整理本在「阴火鬼」一句里也有那个生僻的病字的说明。
note.en: The yang ghosts are the column of spirits (the gods of the temples) and the yin ghosts the column of ghosts (the souls of those who died of one cause or another). 'Guan Sheng' is Emperor Guan (Guan Yu), 'Xuantan' is Zhao Gongming (god of wealth), 'Zhenwu' is the god of the north, the 'Three Officials' are the Officials of Heaven, Earth and Water, and the 'Five Blessings', 'Five Sages', 'Zhang spirit' and 'Great King of the Hide Market' are gods worshipped among the people whom the book does not explain one by one, rendered literally. The 'Seven Killings' and 'with the Tiger the Seven Killings' are not explained further. 'Lu' is brine (salt brine, used to end one's life). In the sentence on the yin Fire ghost the transcriber again notes the rare ailment character.

zh: 阳金鬼，庵堂关圣，在虎七煞也。
阴金鬼，则刀伤自刎痨瘵喘嗽虎伤之魂也。
阳木鬼，束岳五圣家先香火也。
阴木鬼，则自缢疯疾跌扑刑杖死之魂也。
阳水鬼，观音真武三官水神张神河泊水官也。
阴水鬼，则投河服滷呕血之魂也。
阳火鬼，玄坛五福火神灶司香火也。
阴火鬼，则疮毒痨(此处之字上疒下去)疫瘟带血心疼烧死之魂也。
阳土鬼，城隍土谷太岁皮场大王土神也。
阴土鬼，则瘟疫咽喉臌胀黄疸压死之魂也。
yi: 阳金鬼，是庵堂、关圣；带白虎的，是七煞。
阴金鬼，是死于刀伤、自刎、痨病、喘嗽、虎伤的魂。
阳木鬼，是东岳（原书写作「束岳」）、五圣、家先香火。
阴木鬼，是自缢、疯病、跌扑、被杖刑打死的魂。
阳水鬼，是观音、真武、三官、水神、张神、河泊、水官。
阴水鬼，是投河、喝卤水、呕血而死的魂。
阳火鬼，是玄坛、五福、火神、灶司的香火。
阴火鬼，是死于疮毒、痨病（此处原书有一个上面病字头、下面「去」字的生僻字）、疫瘟、带血、心疼、烧死的魂。
阳土鬼，是城隍、土谷、太岁、皮场大王和土神。
阴土鬼，是死于瘟疫、咽喉病、臌胀、黄疸、被压死的魂。
en: A yang Metal ghost is the temples and halls and Guan Sheng; with the Tiger, the Seven Killings.
A yin Metal ghost is the souls of those who died of blade wounds, cutting their own throats, consumption, wheezing cough or a tiger's bite.
A yang Wood ghost is the Eastern Peak (the book writes 'Shu Yue', probably a slip for 'Dong Yue'), the Five Sages and the incense of family forebears.
A yin Wood ghost is the souls of those who hanged themselves or died of madness, falls and blows, or a beating with the rod.
A yang Water ghost is Guanyin, Zhenwu, the Three Officials, the water spirits, the Zhang spirit, the Lord of the River and the Water Official.
A yin Water ghost is the souls of those who threw themselves into a river, drank brine or vomited blood.
A yang Fire ghost is the incense of the Dark Altar, the Five Blessings, the Fire God and the Kitchen Official.

A yin Fire ghost is the souls of those who died of sores and poison, consumption together with (a rare ailment character which the transcriber notes here, written with the sickness radical above and 'go' below), epidemic, bleeding, heart pain or burning.
A yang Earth ghost is the City God, the Earth and Grain gods, the Tai Sui, the Great King of the Hide Market and earth spirits.
A yin Earth ghost is the souls of those who died of epidemic, throat disease, swelling, jaundice or being crushed.

title: 鬼崇·鬼带的煞：加金虎刑杀死于非命、居游魂外卦客死他乡、加天火天烛独火烧死、天贼天盗劫杀因盗致死、沐浴咸池奸淫娼妓、木狼天缢缢死、风波浴盆浮沉溺死、羊刃刀砧屠刽鬼、暗金血刃产亡鬼、天刑天狱地狱牢狱入狱牢狱鬼、刀砧羊刃劫杀自刎鬼、华盖孤神僧道绝嗣鬼、螣蛇天怪精怪妖邪；鬼居太岁是当年岁君、居月日时是游野神

rule.yi: 看鬼带的煞：鬼带金、白虎、刑煞的，是死于非命；鬼落在游魂卦的外卦的，是客死他乡；带天火、天烛、独火煞的，是烧死；带天贼、天盗、劫煞的，是因盗致死；带沐浴、咸池煞的，是奸淫、娼妓；带木狼、天缢煞的，是缢死；带风波、浴盆、浮沉煞的，是溺死；带羊刃、刀砧煞的，是屠夫刽子手的鬼；带暗金、血刃煞的，是产亡的鬼；带天刑、天狱、地狱、牢狱、入狱煞的，是牢狱的鬼；带刀砧、羊刃、劫煞的，是自刎的鬼；带华盖、孤神的，是僧道、绝了后的鬼；带螣蛇、天怪煞的，是精怪妖邪。鬼落在太岁上的，是当年的岁君；落在月、日、时上的，是游荡在野外的神。
rule.en: By the stars the ghost carries: a ghost carrying Metal, the Tiger and punishing stars is one who died an unnatural death; a ghost in the outer trigram of a Wandering Soul hexagram, one who died a stranger in a far land; with Heavenly Fire, Heavenly Candle and Lone Fire, burned to death; with Heavenly Thief, Heavenly Robber and Robbery-Killing, dead through robbers; with Bath and Xianchi, adultery and prostitution; with Wood Wolf and Heavenly Hanging, hanged; with Wind-and-Waves, Bath Basin and Floating-Sinking, drowned; with Goat Blade and Chopping Block, a butcher or executioner ghost; with Hidden Metal and Blood Blade, a ghost who died in childbirth; with Heavenly Punishment, Heavenly Prison, Earthly Prison, Jail and Entering-Prison, a jail ghost; with Chopping Block, Goat Blade and Robbery-Killing, a ghost who cut his own throat; with Canopy and Lone Spirit, a monk or Daoist, one who left no heir; with the Coiling Snake and Heavenly Monster, a sprite, monster or evil. A ghost on the Tai Sui is the Year Lord of the year, and one on the Month, Day or hour a wandering field spirit.

note.yi: 天火、天烛、独火、天贼、天盗、劫煞、咸池、木狼、天缢、风波、浴盆、浮沉、羊刃、刀砧、暗金、血刃、天刑、天狱、地狱、牢狱、入狱、华盖、孤神、天怪都是神煞，书里只给了名目和它们指向的死因，没有解释每一颗从何而来。易冒有一套神煞起法（见易冒神煞章），但这里没有指明用哪一套。「岁君」就是太岁。「游魂」是八宫里每宫的第七卦。「刽」是刽子手，即行刑的人。
note.en: Heavenly Fire, Heavenly Candle, Lone Fire, Heavenly Thief, Heavenly Robber, Robbery-Killing, Xianchi, Wood Wolf, Heavenly Hanging, Wind-and-Waves, Bath Basin, Floating-Sinking, Goat Blade, Chopping Block, Hidden Metal, Blood Blade, Heavenly Punishment, Heavenly Prison, Earthly Prison, Jail, Entering-Prison, Canopy, Lone Spirit and Heavenly Monster are all spirit-stars; the book gives only the names and the causes of death they point to and does not explain where each comes from. The Yi Mao has a scheme for setting these stars (see its chapter on spirit-stars) but this passage does not say which scheme is meant. 'Year Lord' is the Tai Sui. 'Wandering Soul' is the seventh hexagram of each palace among the eight. A 'gui' is an executioner, one who carries out the punishment.

zh: 又鬼加金虎刑杀者，死于非命也。
鬼居游魂外卦者，客死他乡也。
鬼加天火天烛独火杀者，烧死也。
鬼加天贼天盗劫杀者，因盗致死也。
鬼加沐浴咸池杀者，奸淫娼妓也。
鬼加木狼，天缢杀者，缢死也。
鬼加风波浴盆浮沉杀者，溺死也。
鬼加羊刃刀砧杀者，屠刽鬼也。
鬼带暗金血刃杀者，产亡鬼也。
鬼带天刑天狱地狱牢狱入狱杀者，牢狱鬼也。
鬼加刀砧羊刃劫杀者，自刎鬼也。
鬼带华盖孤神者，僧道绝嗣鬼也。
鬼加螣蛇天怪杀者，精怪妖邪也。
鬼居太岁者，当年岁君也。
鬼居月日时上者，游野神也。
yi: 又，鬼带金、白虎、刑煞的，是死于非命。
鬼落在游魂卦的外卦里的，是客死他乡。
鬼带天火、天烛、独火煞的，是烧死。
鬼带天贼、天盗、劫煞的，是因为盗贼致死。
鬼带沐浴、咸池煞的，是奸淫、娼妓。
鬼带木狼、天缢煞的，是缢死。
鬼带风波、浴盆、浮沉煞的，是溺死。
鬼带羊刃、刀砧煞的，是屠夫、刽子手的鬼。
鬼带暗金、血刃煞的，是产亡的鬼。
鬼带天刑、天狱、地狱、牢狱、入狱煞的，是牢狱的鬼。
鬼带刀砧、羊刃、劫煞的，是自刎的鬼。
鬼带华盖、孤神的，是僧道、绝了后的鬼。
鬼带螣蛇、天怪煞的，是精怪妖邪。
鬼落在太岁上的，是当年的岁君。
鬼落在月、日、时上的，是游荡在野外的神。
en: Also a ghost carrying Metal, the Tiger and punishing stars: death by unnatural causes.
A ghost in the outer trigram of a Wandering Soul hexagram: one who died a stranger in a far land.
A ghost carrying Heavenly Fire, Heavenly Candle and Lone Fire: burned to death.
A ghost carrying Heavenly Thief, Heavenly Robber and Robbery-Killing: dead through robbers.
A ghost carrying Bath and Xianchi: adultery and prostitution.
A ghost carrying Wood Wolf and Heavenly Hanging: hanged.
A ghost carrying Wind-and-Waves, Bath Basin and Floating-Sinking: drowned.
A ghost carrying Goat Blade and Chopping Block: a butcher or executioner ghost.
A ghost carrying Hidden Metal and Blood Blade: a ghost who died in childbirth.
A ghost carrying Heavenly Punishment, Heavenly Prison, Earthly Prison, Jail and Entering-Prison: a jail ghost.
A ghost carrying Chopping Block, Goat Blade and Robbery-Killing: a ghost who cut his own throat.
A ghost carrying Canopy and Lone Spirit: a monk or Daoist, one who left no heir.
A ghost carrying the Coiling Snake and Heavenly Monster: a sprite, monster or evil.
A ghost on the Tai Sui: the Year Lord of the year.
A ghost on the Month, Day or hour: a wandering field spirit.

title: 鬼崇·是谁的鬼：父母伏鬼化鬼阳父阴母、兄弟阳兄弟阴姐妹、妻财阳妻奴阴妾婢、子孙阳男阴女；鬼在本宫内卦同姓、他宫外卦异姓；交重大鬼、单拆小鬼；衰墓老年旧鬼、生旺壮年新鬼、胎养孩童鬼；乾宫祖宗与父、坤宫祖妣与母、震坎艮男、巽离兑女；几个鬼按一水二火三木四金五土之数，旺相加倍、休如数、囚死减半

rule.yi: 看是谁的鬼：父母爻下伏着鬼、或变出鬼的，阳爻是父亲，阴爻是母亲；兄弟爻下伏鬼、变鬼的，阳爻是兄弟，阴爻是姐妹；妻财爻下伏鬼、变鬼的，阳爻是妻子和奴仆，阴爻是妾和婢女；子孙爻下伏鬼、变鬼的，阳爻是男的，阴爻是女的。鬼在本宫内卦的，是同姓的鬼；在别的宫、外卦的，是异姓的鬼。发动的是大鬼，不动的是小鬼；衰弱、入墓的是年老的旧鬼，生旺的是壮年的新鬼，胎、养是孩童的鬼（阳男阴女）。按八卦：乾宫的鬼是祖宗和父亲，坤宫的鬼是祖母和母亲，震、坎、艮宫的鬼是男的，巽、离、兑宫的鬼是女的。问有几个鬼，按一水、二火、三木、四金、五土的数来推，旺相的加倍，休的照原数，囚、死的减半。
rule.en: Whose ghost it is: Resource with a ghost hidden beneath it or changing into a ghost — yang is the father, yin the mother; Peer with a ghost hidden beneath or changing into one — yang brothers, yin sisters; Wealth with a ghost — yang a wife or manservant, yin a concubine or maid; Output with a ghost — yang male, yin female. A ghost in the inner trigram of the home palace is a ghost of the same surname, and one in the outer trigram of another palace a ghost of another surname. A moving ghost is a great ghost and a still one a small ghost; weak or in a tomb, an old ghost of long standing; born or strong, a ghost of the prime of life, newly dead; at Womb or Nurture, a child's ghost (yang a boy, yin a girl). By the eight trigrams: a ghost in the Qian palace is an ancestor or the father, in Kun a grandmother or the mother, in Zhen, Kan or Gen male, in Xun, Li or Dui female. To ask how many ghosts there are, work by the numbers Water one, Fire two, Wood three, Metal four, Earth five: if strong, double it; if resting, as given; if trapped or dead, halve it.

note.yi: 「交重」是发动的爻，「单拆」是不动的爻（单是阳爻、拆是阴爻）。「祖妣」是祖母。「坎」是中男，「艮」是少男，「巽」是长女，「离」是中女，「兑」是少女，这几宫的鬼按男女分。黄金策的旧注和王洪绪也有按长生、帝旺、衰弱、胎养分年龄、按乾巽分方位的说法（LY.ILL.HJC.94），这里多了按六亲、按本宫他宫分同姓异姓、按卦宫分男女和按五行之数推几个鬼几条；卦身推是谁的鬼见 LY.ILL.HJC.102。
note.en: 'Jiaozhong' is a moving line and 'danchai' a still line (dan a yang line, chai a yin line). 'Zubi' is the grandmother. Kan is the middle son, Gen the youngest son, Xun the eldest daughter, Li the middle daughter and Dui the youngest daughter, and the ghosts of these palaces are divided by sex. The old commentary and Wang Hongxu on the Huangjin Ce also have the age by Birth, Peak, decline, Womb and Nurture and the direction by Qian and Xun (LY.ILL.HJC.94); this adds telling by relation which ghost it is, the same or a different surname by home palace or another, sex by trigram, and the number of ghosts by the number of the element; for telling whose ghost it is by the Body see LY.ILL.HJC.102.

zh: 又父母伏鬼化鬼者，阳父阴母也。
兄弟伏鬼化鬼者，阳兄弟，阴姐妹也。
妻财伏鬼化鬼者，阳妻奴阴妾婢也。
子孙伏鬼化鬼者，阳男阴女也。
鬼在本宫内卦，同姓鬼也。
鬼在他宫外卦，异姓鬼也。
胎养，孩童鬼，阳男阴女也。
又八卦乾宫鬼，祖宗与父。
问有几鬼，以一水二火三木四金五土之数推之。
旺相加倍，休如数，囚死减半也。
yi: 又，父母爻下伏着鬼、或变出鬼的，阳爻是父亲，阴爻是母亲。
兄弟爻下伏着鬼、或变出鬼的，阳爻是兄弟，阴爻是姐妹。
妻财爻下伏着鬼、或变出鬼的，阳爻是妻子和奴仆，阴爻是妾和婢女。
子孙爻下伏着鬼、或变出鬼的，阳爻是男的，阴爻是女的。
鬼在本宫的内卦，是同姓的鬼。
鬼在别的宫、外卦，是异姓的鬼。
发动的，是大鬼。
不动的，是小鬼。
衰弱、入墓的，是年老的旧鬼。
生旺的，是壮年的新鬼。
胎、养，是孩童的鬼，阳爻是男孩，阴爻是女孩。
又按八卦：乾宫的鬼是祖宗和父亲。
坤宫的鬼是祖母和母亲。
震、坎、艮宫的鬼是男的。
巽、离、兑宫的鬼是女的。
问有几个鬼，按一水、二火、三木、四金、五土的数来推。
旺相的加倍，休的照原数，囚、死的减半。
en: Also Resource with a ghost hidden beneath it or changing into a ghost: yang is the father, yin the mother.
Peer with a ghost hidden beneath it or changing into a ghost: yang, brothers; yin, sisters.
Wealth with a ghost hidden beneath it or changing into a ghost: yang, a wife or manservant; yin, a concubine or maid.
Output with a ghost hidden beneath it or changing into a ghost: yang, male; yin, female.
A ghost in the inner trigram of the home palace: a ghost of the same surname.
A ghost in the outer trigram of another palace: a ghost of another surname.
Moving: a great ghost.
Still: a small ghost.
Weak or in a tomb: an old ghost of long standing.
Born or strong: a ghost of the prime of life, newly dead.
At Womb or Nurture: a child's ghost, yang a boy, yin a girl.
Again by the eight trigrams: a ghost in the Qian palace is an ancestor or the father.
A ghost in the Kun palace is a grandmother or the mother.
A ghost in the Zhen, Kan or Gen palace is male.
A ghost in the Xun, Li or Dui palace is female.
To ask how many ghosts there are, work by the numbers: Water one, Fire two, Wood three, Metal four, Earth five.
If strong, double it; if resting, as given; if trapped or dead, halve it.

title: 鬼崇·祭礼（曹子虚）：祈禳用何祭礼看鬼之食神；鬼属甲食在丙禄居巳宜炒鸡煎腐，乙食丁禄午宜干脯炒荳，丙食戊禄巳，丁食己禄午，戊食庚禄申宜三牲馒首果饼，己食辛禄酉宜鸡肉鱼馄饨，庚食壬禄亥宜猪首三牲，辛食癸禄子宜池鱼血羹麦面，壬食甲禄寅宜三牲时果新蔬，癸食乙禄卯宜鸡鹅鸭蔬果鸭蛋；送于何方以鬼爻支神定；子带龙雀素祭、带勾蛇虎武荤盘、伏化水鬼水父佛经、火鬼火父道醮、化财伏财福礼、化兄伏兄演戏众保

rule.yi: 曹子虚说：祈禳用什么祭品礼数，要看鬼的食神。鬼属甲，食神在丙，禄在巳，用炒鸡、煎豆腐、酒、礼、纸钱纸马送走；鬼属乙，食神在丁，禄在午，用干肉脯、炒豆、酒、礼、纸钱纸马；属丙，食神在戊，禄在巳，同属甲的祭品；属丁，食神在己，禄在午，同属乙的祭品；属戊，食神在庚，禄在申，用三牲、馒头、果饼、酒、礼、纸钱纸马；属己，食神在辛，禄在酉，用鸡肉、鱼、馄饨、酒、礼、纸钱纸马；属庚，食神在壬，禄在亥，用猪头、三牲、酒、礼、纸钱纸马；属辛，食神在癸，禄在子，用池里的鱼、血羹、麦面、酒、礼、纸钱纸马；属壬，食神在甲，禄在寅，用三牲、时鲜的果子、新蔬菜、酒、礼、纸钱纸马；属癸，食神在乙，禄在卯，用鸡、鹅、鸭、蔬果、鸭蛋、酒、礼、纸钱纸马。送到哪个方向，以鬼爻的地支来定。如果是神，祈祷的礼数把子孙当作福神：子孙带青龙、朱雀的，适合素祭；带勾陈、螣蛇、白虎、玄武的，适合荤盘；子孙伏在水鬼或水父母下、或变出水鬼水父母的，适合念佛经；伏在火鬼或火父母下、或变出火鬼火父母的，适合道教的醮；子孙变出财、或伏在财下的，适合福礼；变出兄、或伏在兄下的，适合演戏、大家一起保祷。这是祈禳的占法。
rule.en: Cao Zixu says: what sacrifice and rite to use for prayer and exorcism depends on the ghost's food-star. If the ghost belongs to Jia, the food-star is Bing and the emolument is at Si, and one sends it off with stir-fried chicken, fried bean curd, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses; Yi: food-star Ding, emolument at Wu, dried meat, fried beans, wine, gifts and paper money and horses; Bing: food-star Wu, emolument at Si, as for Jia; Ding: food-star Ji, emolument at Wu, as for Yi; Wu: food-star Geng, emolument at Shen, the three sacrificial animals, steamed buns, fruit cakes, wine and gifts; Ji: food-star Xin, emolument at You, chicken, fish, wonton, wine and gifts; Geng: food-star Ren, emolument at Hai, a pig's head, the three animals, wine and gifts; Xin: food-star Gui, emolument at Zi, pond fish, blood soup, wheat noodles, wine and gifts; Ren: food-star Jia, emolument at Yin, the three animals, seasonal fruit, fresh vegetables, wine and gifts; Gui: food-star Yi, emolument at Mao, chicken, goose, duck, vegetables and fruit, duck eggs, wine and gifts. The direction in which to send it is fixed by the branch of the Pressure line. If it is a spirit, in the rites of prayer Output is taken as the spirit of blessing: Output carrying the Dragon and the Bird, a vegetarian sacrifice; carrying the Hook, Snake, Tiger and Tortoise, a meat platter; hidden beneath a Water ghost or Water Resource, or changing into one, Buddhist scripture; beneath a Fire ghost or Fire Resource, or changing into one, a Daoist ritual; changing into or beneath Wealth, a blessing rite; changing into or beneath Peer, a staged play and communal protection. This is the divination of prayer and exorcism.

note.yi: 这一条在原书里跨了 3019、3021 两行。「食神」按字面是「鬼所属的天干所生的天干」（甲生丙、乙生丁……），「禄居某」是那个食神的禄位（丙禄在巳、丁禄在午、戊禄在巳、己禄在午、庚禄在申、辛禄在酉、壬禄在亥、癸禄在子、甲禄在寅、乙禄在卯）；书里没有另作解释，这里按上下文理解。「三牲」是牛、羊、猪（或猪、鸡、鱼），「财马」是纸钱纸马，「醮」是道教的法事。书里在这一段没有给出为什么某个天干配某种祭品。
note.en: In the original this entry runs across lines 3019 and 3021. The 'food-star' (shishen) is literally the stem generated by the stem the ghost belongs to (Jia generates Bing, Yi generates Ding ...), and 'emolument at' is that food-star's emolument seat (Bing at Si, Ding at Wu, Wu at Si, Ji at Wu, Geng at Shen, Xin at You, Ren at Hai, Gui at Zi, Jia at Yin, Yi at Mao); the book does not explain this separately and it is understood here by context. The 'three sacrificial animals' are ox, sheep and pig (or pig, chicken and fish), 'caima' is paper money and paper horses, and 'jiao' is a Daoist rite. The book gives no reason in this passage why a given stem is matched with a given offering.

zh: 曹子虚曰，祈禳用何祭礼，则视鬼之食神也。
如鬼属甲，则食在丙而禄居巳也。
宜用炒鸡煎腐酒礼财马送之也。
yi: 曹子虚说：祈禳用什么祭品礼数，就看鬼的食神。
比如鬼属甲，食神在丙，禄在巳。
适合用炒鸡、煎豆腐、酒和礼、纸钱纸马送走它。
en: Cao Zixu says: what sacrifice and rite to use for prayer and exorcism depends on the ghost's food-star.
For example, if the ghost belongs to Jia, its food-star is Bing and its emolument is at Si.
Send it off with stir-fried chicken, fried bean curd, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses.

zh: 鬼属乙，则食在丁而禄居午也，宜用干脯炒荳酒礼财马送之也。
鬼属丙，则食在戊而禄居巳也，宜用炒鸡煎腐酒礼财马送之也。
鬼属丁，则食在己而禄居午也，宜用干脯炒荳酒礼财马送之也。
鬼属戊，则食在庚而禄居申也，宜用三牲馒首果饼酒礼财马送之也。
鬼属己，则食在辛而禄居酉也，宜用鸡肉鱼馄饨酒礼财马送之也。
鬼属庚，则食在壬而禄居亥也，宜用猪首三牲酒礼财马送之也。
鬼属辛，则食在癸而禄居子也，宜用池鱼血羹麦面酒礼财马送之也。
鬼属壬，则食在甲而禄居寅也，宜用三牲时果新蔬酒礼财马送之也。
鬼属癸，则食在乙而禄居卯也，宜用鸡鹅鸭蔬果鸭蛋酒礼财马送之也。
若夫送于何方，则以鬼爻之支神定之也。
其在于神，则祈祷之礼，以子孙为福神也。
子带勾蛇虎武者，宜荤盘。
子伏水鬼水父下，或化水鬼水父者，宜佛经。
子伏火鬼火父下，或化火鬼火父者，宜道醮。
子化财伏财者，宜福礼，子化兄伏兄者，宜演戏众保也。
yi: 鬼属乙，食神在丁，禄在午，适合用干肉脯、炒豆子、酒和礼、纸钱纸马送走它。
鬼属丙，食神在戊，禄在巳，适合用炒鸡、煎豆腐、酒和礼、纸钱纸马送走它。
鬼属丁，食神在己，禄在午，适合用干肉脯、炒豆子、酒和礼、纸钱纸马送走它。
鬼属戊，食神在庚，禄在申，适合用三牲、馒头、果饼、酒和礼、纸钱纸马送走它。
鬼属己，食神在辛，禄在酉，适合用鸡肉、鱼、馄饨、酒和礼、纸钱纸马送走它。
鬼属庚，食神在壬，禄在亥，适合用猪头、三牲、酒和礼、纸钱纸马送走它。
鬼属辛，食神在癸，禄在子，适合用池里的鱼、血羹、麦面、酒和礼、纸钱纸马送走它。
鬼属壬，食神在甲，禄在寅，适合用三牲、时鲜果子、新蔬菜、酒和礼、纸钱纸马送走它。
鬼属癸，食神在乙，禄在卯，适合用鸡、鹅、鸭、蔬菜水果、鸭蛋、酒和礼、纸钱纸马送走它。
至于送到哪个方向，就以鬼爻的地支来定。
如果是神，祈祷的礼数，把子孙当作福神。
子孙带青龙、朱雀的，适合素祭。
子孙带勾陈、螣蛇、白虎、玄武的，适合荤盘。
子孙伏在水鬼或水父母下，或者变出水鬼水父母的，适合念佛经。
子孙伏在火鬼或火父母下，或者变出火鬼火父母的，适合道教的醮。
子孙变出财、或伏在财下的，适合福礼；子孙变出兄、或伏在兄下的，适合演戏、大家一起保祷。
这是祈禳的占法。
en: If the ghost belongs to Yi, its food-star is Ding and its emolument is at Wu; send it off with dried meat, fried beans, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses.
If the ghost belongs to Bing, its food-star is Wu and its emolument is at Si; send it off with stir-fried chicken, fried bean curd, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses.
If the ghost belongs to Ding, its food-star is Ji and its emolument is at Wu; send it off with dried meat, fried beans, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses.

If the ghost belongs to Wu, its food-star is Geng and its emolument is at Shen; send it off with the three sacrificial animals, steamed buns, fruit cakes, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses.
If the ghost belongs to Ji, its food-star is Xin and its emolument is at You; send it off with chicken, fish, wonton, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses.
If the ghost belongs to Geng, its food-star is Ren and its emolument is at Hai; send it off with a pig's head, the three sacrificial animals, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses.
If the ghost belongs to Xin, its food-star is Gui and its emolument is at Zi; send it off with pond fish, blood soup, wheat noodles, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses.

If the ghost belongs to Ren, its food-star is Jia and its emolument is at Yin; send it off with the three sacrificial animals, seasonal fruit, fresh vegetables, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses.
If the ghost belongs to Gui, its food-star is Yi and its emolument is at Mao; send it off with chicken, goose, duck, vegetables and fruit, duck eggs, wine, ritual gifts and paper money and horses.
As for the direction in which to send it, it is fixed by the branch of the Pressure line.
If it is a spirit, in the rites of prayer Output is taken as the spirit of blessing.
If Output carries the Dragon and the Bird, a vegetarian sacrifice suits.
If Output carries the Hook, Snake, Tiger and Tortoise, a meat platter suits.
If Output is hidden beneath a Water ghost or Water Resource, or changes into a Water ghost or Water Resource, Buddhist scripture suits.
If Output is hidden beneath a Fire ghost or Fire Resource, or changes into a Fire ghost or Fire Resource, a Daoist ritual suits.
If Output changes into Wealth or is hidden beneath Wealth, a blessing rite suits; if Output changes into Peer or is hidden beneath Peer, a staged play and communal protection suit.
This is the divination of prayer and exorcism.

title: 鬼崇·旧愿：子孙伏鬼下动克世用、或伏岁杀下动伤世用，必有旧愿未还；旺相愿大、休囚愿小；问因何许愿以官鬼为用——鬼伏世下用下是自己许、伏父母财子下是为父母妻子许、伏鬼下是因病讼许、伏兄下是因兄弟朋友争斗赌博许；六亲化出鬼亦然

rule.yi: 又有旧愿没还的：子孙伏在鬼下面、发动克世爻、用爻，或者子孙伏在岁煞下面、发动伤世爻、用爻的，一定是有旧愿没有还；旺相的愿大，休囚的愿小。问是因为什么许的愿，以官鬼为用：鬼伏在世爻下、用爻下的，是为自己许的愿；鬼伏在父母、财、子孙下的，是为父母、妻子、子女许的愿；鬼伏在鬼下的，是因为病、官司许的愿；鬼伏在兄下的，是为兄弟朋友、争斗赌博许的愿。六亲变出鬼的也是这样（出自《源髓诀》）。
rule.en: There is also an old vow not yet paid: Output hidden beneath the ghost and moving to control the Self and Subject, or Output hidden beneath the Year-killing star and moving to harm the Self and Subject, means surely an old vow is not yet paid; if strong the vow is large, if resting or trapped small. To ask why the vow was made, the Pressure line is the Subject: a ghost hidden beneath the Self or the Subject line, a vow made for oneself; hidden beneath Resource, Wealth or Output, made for parents, wife or children; hidden beneath a ghost, made over illness or lawsuit; hidden beneath Peer, made over brothers, friends, brawls or gambling. The same holds when a relation changes out into a ghost (from the Yuan Sui Jue).

note.yi: 「岁杀」按字面是岁上的煞，书里没有再解释。「出源髓诀」的「源髓诀」是易隐引的书名，书里没有再介绍。这一条和黄金策讲的「持世则未酬旧愿，伏为有口无心」（LY.ILL.HJC.110）是同一类判断：都是从鬼爻的位置看是不是有旧愿未还；黄金策看鬼是不是持世、伏世下，这里另看子孙伏在鬼下。
note.en: 'The Year-killing star' (suisha) is literally a killing star of the year and the book does not explain further. The 'Yuan Sui Jue' is a work the Yi Yin cites and the book does not introduce. This entry is a judgment of the same kind as the Huangjin Ce's 'holding the Self: the old vow is not paid; hidden: a spoken word with no heart in it' (LY.ILL.HJC.110): both tell from the position of the Pressure line whether an old vow is unpaid; the Huangjin Ce looks at whether the ghost holds the Self or is hidden beneath it, and this looks in addition at Output hidden beneath the ghost.

zh: 又有旧愿未还者，但子孙伏鬼下动克世用，或子孙伏岁杀下动伤世用者，必有旧愿未还也。
至问因何许愿，以官鬼为用也。
鬼伏世下用下者，因自己许也，鬼伏父母财子下，因父母妻子许，鬼伏鬼下因病讼许，鬼伏兄下因兄弟朋友争斗赌博许也。
六亲化出鬼者亦然(出源髓诀)。
yi: 又有旧愿没还的：子孙伏在鬼下面、发动克世爻、用爻，或者子孙伏在岁煞下面、发动伤世爻、用爻的，一定是有旧愿没有还。
旺相的愿大，休囚的愿小。
至于问是因为什么许的愿，以官鬼为用。
鬼伏在世爻下、用爻下的，是为自己许的愿；鬼伏在父母、财、子孙下的，是为父母、妻子、子女许的愿；鬼伏在鬼下，是因为病、官司许的愿；鬼伏在兄爻下，是为兄弟朋友、争斗赌博许的愿。
六亲变出鬼的也是这样（出自《源髓诀》）。
en: There is also an old vow not yet paid: Output hidden beneath the ghost and moving to control the Self and Subject, or Output hidden beneath the Year-killing star and moving to harm the Self and Subject: there is surely an old vow not yet paid.
If strong, the vow is large; if resting or trapped, small.
As for asking why the vow was made, the Pressure line is the Subject.

A ghost hidden beneath the Self or the Subject line: a vow made for oneself; hidden beneath Resource, Wealth or Output: made for parents, wife or children; hidden beneath a ghost: made over illness or lawsuit; hidden beneath Peer: made over brothers, friends, brawls or gambling.
The same holds when a relation changes out into a ghost (from the Yuan Sui Jue).

title: 病起何方：以动爻断——火南水北木东金西，不论鬼之有无；有鬼不动取外卦；卦安静无鬼看鬼伏何爻之下、以飞神定（伏子北、丑寅东北、卯东、辰巳东南、午南、未申西南、酉西、戌亥西北）；乱动而鬼动以鬼所居之卦断；官鬼独发以鬼爻所值之支断；鬼在本宫内卦是本地得病、他宫外卦是他方得病

rule.yi: 病是从哪个方向来的，以卦里的动爻来断：火是南，水是北，木是东，金是西，不管有没有鬼。卦里有鬼但不动的，就取外卦来断（乾西北、坤西南、巽东南、艮东北、离南、坎北、震东、兑西）。卦是安静的又没有鬼的，就看鬼伏在哪一爻下面，拿鬼上面的飞神来定灾祸的地方：伏在子下是北方，丑、寅下是东北，卯下是东，辰、巳下是东南，午下是南，未、申下是西南，酉下是西，戌、亥下是西北。卦乱动而鬼也动的，也拿鬼所在的卦来断；官鬼独自发动的，又拿鬼爻所值的地支来断。另外，鬼在本宫的内卦，就说是在本地得病；在别的宫、外卦，就说是在别处得病。
rule.en: Where the illness came from is judged by the moving lines in the hexagram: Fire is south, Water north, Wood east, Metal west, whether or not there is a ghost. If the hexagram has a ghost that does not move, judge by the outer trigram (Qian northwest, Kun southwest, Xun southeast, Gen northeast, Li south, Kan north, Zhen east, Dui west). If the hexagram is still and has no ghost, see under which line the ghost is hidden and use the flying line above the ghost to fix the place of the affliction: hidden beneath Zi, the north; beneath Chou or Yin, the northeast; beneath Mao, the east; beneath Chen or Si, the southeast; beneath Wu, the south; beneath Wei or Shen, the southwest; beneath You, the west; beneath Xu or Hai, the northwest. If the hexagram has lines moving in disorder and the ghost moves, judge by the trigram in which the ghost stands; if the Pressure line moves alone, judge by the branch that the Pressure line holds. Also a ghost in the inner trigram of the home palace: the illness was caught at home; in the outer trigram of another palace: caught elsewhere.

note.yi: 这一条的方位依据是五行方位（火南水北木东金西）和后天八卦方位（乾西北……兑西），「飞神」是鬼所伏那一爻上面的那一爻的地支。易林补遗的「何处得病章」（第 1240 行起）讲同一件事，有更细的分法，见易林补遗一批。
note.en: The directions rest on the element directions (Fire south, Water north, Wood east, Metal west) and the later-heaven trigram directions (Qian northwest ... Dui west), and the 'flying line' is the branch of the line above the one under which the ghost is hidden. The Yilin Buyi's chapter on where the illness was caught (from line 1240) treats the same matter with a finer division, and is taken with the Yilin Buyi batch.

zh: 火南水北木东金西，不论鬼之有无也。
如卦有鬼而不动者，则取外卦断之。
乾在西北，坤在西南，巽在东南，艮在东北，离南，坎北，震东，兑西，是也。
如卦安静，而无鬼者，则看鬼伏何爻之下，以鬼上飞神，定其灾处也。
若卦乱动而鬼动者，亦以鬼所居之卦断之也。
若官鬼独发者，又以鬼爻所值之支神断之也。
又鬼在本宫内卦，则言本地得病。
在他宫外卦，则言他方得病也。
yi: 以卦里的动爻来断。
火在南、水在北、木在东、金在西，不管有没有鬼。
如果卦里有鬼但不动，就取外卦来断。
乾在西北，坤在西南，巽在东南，艮在东北，离在南，坎在北，震在东，兑在西，就是这样。
如果卦是安静的、又没有鬼，就看鬼伏在哪一爻下面，拿鬼上面的飞神来定灾祸的地方。
如果鬼伏在子下面，就说是北方。
伏在丑、寅下面，就说是东北方。
伏在卯下面，是东方。
伏在辰、巳下面，就说是东南方。
伏在午下面，就说是南方。
伏在未、申下面，是西南方。
伏在酉下面，是西方。
伏在戌、亥下面，是西北方。
如果卦乱动而鬼也动，也拿鬼所在的卦来断。
如果官鬼独自发动，又拿鬼爻所值的地支来断。
又，鬼在本宫的内卦，就说是在本地得病。
在别的宫、外卦，就说是在别处得病。
en: Judge by the moving lines in the hexagram.
Fire is south, Water north, Wood east, Metal west, whether or not there is a ghost.
If the hexagram has a ghost that does not move, judge by the outer trigram.
Qian is northwest, Kun southwest, Xun southeast, Gen northeast, Li south, Kan north, Zhen east, Dui west, and that is how it is.
If the hexagram is still and has no ghost, see under which line the ghost is hidden and use the flying line above the ghost to fix the place of the affliction.
If the ghost is hidden beneath Zi, say the north.
Beneath Chou or Yin, say the northeast.
Beneath Mao, the east.
Beneath Chen or Si, say the southeast.
Beneath Wu, say the south.
Beneath Wei or Shen, the southwest.
Beneath You, the west.
Beneath Xu or Hai, the northwest.
If the hexagram has lines moving in disorder and the ghost moves, judge by the trigram in which the ghost stands.
If the Pressure line moves alone, judge by the branch that the Pressure line holds.
Also a ghost in the inner trigram of the home palace: the illness was caught at home.
In the outer trigram of another palace: the illness was caught elsewhere.

title: 病起何年月日：以鬼爻长生之年月日定；土鬼动火生土，午年五月午日得病；土长生在申，或申年七月申日；鬼临辰戌丑未上，辰戌丑未年月日得病；金木水火鬼仿此

rule.yi: 病是哪年哪月哪天得的，以鬼爻长生的年、月、日来定：比如土鬼发动、火生土，是午年、五月、午日得的病；土的长生在申，或者是申年、七月、申日得的病；鬼落在辰、戌、丑、未上，或者是辰、戌、丑、未的年、月、日得的病；其他金、木、水、火的鬼，都照这样推。
rule.en: When the illness was caught is fixed by the year, month or day in which the Pressure line is born: for example, if an Earth ghost moves and Fire generates Earth, the illness was caught in a Wu year, the fifth month, on a Wu day; Earth is born at Shen, or the illness was caught in a Shen year, the seventh month, on a Shen day; a ghost on Chen, Xu, Chou or Wei, the illness was caught in a year, month or day of Chen, Xu, Chou or Wei; for the Metal, Wood, Water and Fire ghosts, work by the same pattern.

note.yi: 原文举的例子里，土鬼「火生土」在午年五月午日：午是火的旺位，火生土，所以取午；「土长生在申」是按水土同宫的长生（申）。这一条是「附占」，不是易隐疾病占里的主要事项。
note.en: In the original's example the Earth ghost 'Fire generates Earth' falls in a Wu year, the fifth month, a Wu day: Wu is Fire's strong place and Fire generates Earth, so Wu is taken; 'Earth is born at Shen' follows the birth (Shen) of Water and Earth together. This entry is a subsidiary matter, not one of the main heads of the Yi Yin's section on illness.

zh: 以鬼爻长生之年月日定之也。
又如土鬼动，火生土，在午年五月午日得病也。
土长生在申，或申年七月申日得病也。
鬼临辰戌丑未上，或辰戌丑未年月日得病也。
其他金木水火鬼，皆仿此推之。
yi: 以鬼爻长生的年、月、日来定。
又比如土鬼发动，火生土，是在午年、五月、午日得的病。
土的长生在申，或者是申年、七月、申日得的病。
鬼落在辰、戌、丑、未上，或者是辰、戌、丑、未的年、月、日得的病。
其他金、木、水、火的鬼，都照这样推。
en: It is fixed by the year, month or day in which the Pressure line is born.
Again, for example, if an Earth ghost moves and Fire generates Earth, the illness was caught in a Wu year, the fifth month, on a Wu day.
Earth is born at Shen, or the illness was caught in a Shen year, the seventh month, on a Shen day.
A ghost on Chen, Xu, Chou or Wei: the illness was caught in a year, month or day of Chen, Xu, Chou or Wei.
For the Metal, Wood, Water and Fire ghosts, work by the same pattern.

title: 痘疹占：以官鬼为用，鬼不上卦或鬼化死墓绝胎空、被刑害克破者不出，鬼衰死而化生旺、无鬼而月建临官、鬼静而日当生旺、火鬼加蛇旺动者皆出；出期以官鬼生旺之年月日断；鬼衰子旺或子持身世必稀朗、鬼旺子衰或鬼持身世必稠密；父动者重、兄动者轻；福临空死墓绝胎或受刑害克冲者命难保

rule.yi: 以官鬼为用爻。鬼不上卦，或者鬼变出死、墓、绝、胎、空，以及被刑、害、克、破的，都不出痘。如果鬼虽然衰、死、受伤而变出生旺，或者没有鬼而月建临官，或者鬼安静而日正当生旺，以及火鬼带螣蛇旺盛发动的，都会出痘。想知道出痘疹的日期，以官鬼生旺的年、月、日来断。想知道痘疹的稀密：鬼衰、子孙旺，以及子孙持身、世的，一定稀疏明朗；鬼旺、子孙衰，以及鬼持身、世的，一定稠密。父母爻动的重，兄爻动的轻。福神临在空、死、墓、绝、胎上，以及受到刑、害、克、冲的，性命一定难保。
rule.en: The Pressure line is the Subject. If the ghost does not appear in the hexagram, or changes into Death, tomb, Extinction, Womb or Void, or is punished, harmed, controlled or broken, the pox will not come out. If the ghost is weak, dead or wounded but changes into Birth or strength, or there is no ghost but the Month stands at Office, or the ghost is still and the day is exactly its Birth or strength, or a Fire ghost with the Snake is strong and moving, the pox will come out. To know when the pox will come out, judge by the year, month or day in which the Pressure line is born or strong. To know whether it will be sparse or dense: if the ghost is weak and Output strong, or Output holds the Body or the Self, it will surely be sparse and clear; if the ghost is strong and Output weak, or the ghost holds the Body or the Self, it will surely be dense. If Resource moves it is heavy, if Peer moves it is light. If Fortune falls on Void, Death, tomb, Extinction or Womb, or is punished, harmed, controlled or clashed, his life can hardly be preserved.

dispute.yi: 痘的稀密看什么：易隐是「鬼衰子旺（或子持身世）则稀朗，鬼旺子衰（或鬼持身世）则稠密」，和卜筮正宗「官强而痘难开朗，福旺则花必稀疏」（LY.ILL.BSZZ.06）、增删卜易「鬼旺相临日月有生扶则花稠密，空破休囚墓绝则痘疏朗」（LY.ILL.ZS.20）是同一个方向，三家一致。取用的办法则不同：易隐以官鬼为用（出不出、何时出、稀密），吉凶另看子孙（福）是否受克；卜筮正宗按谁出花取用（兄弟取兄弟爻、子侄取子孙、妻奴取财），官鬼是痘花本身（LY.ILL.BSZZ.02）；增删卜易问何时出花以鬼为用、问吉凶全看子孙（LY.ILL.ZS.19、LY.ILL.ZS.21）。易隐这一条在取用上和增删卜易相近。「父动者重，兄动者轻」在另两家没有。
dispute.en: What decides whether the pox is sparse or dense: the Yi Yin says 'ghost weak and Output strong (or Output holding the Body or Self), sparse and clear; ghost strong and Output weak (or the ghost holding the Body or Self), dense', in the same direction as the Bushi Zhengzong's 'Pressure strong and the pox hardly clears; Output strong and the flowers are sparse' (LY.ILL.BSZZ.06) and the Zengshan Buyi's 'a strong Pressure line on the Day or Month with support brings dense flowers; Void, broken, resting, trapped, entombed or extinct, sparse pox' (LY.ILL.ZS.20); the three agree. The way of taking the Subject differs: the Yi Yin takes Pressure as the Subject (whether the pox comes out, when, sparse or dense) and looks separately at whether Output (Fortune) is controlled for fortune; the Bushi Zhengzong takes it by who has the pox (Peer for a brother, Output for a child, Wealth for a wife or servant) with Pressure the pox flowers themselves (LY.ILL.BSZZ.02); the Zengshan Buyi takes Pressure as the Subject for when the pox comes out and looks wholly at Output for fortune (LY.ILL.ZS.19 and LY.ILL.ZS.21). In taking the Subject the Yi Yin is close to the Zengshan Buyi. 'Resource moving is heavy, Peer moving light' is found in neither of the others.

note.yi: 原文「月建临官」的「官」是十二长生里的临官位，不是官鬼；「火鬼加蛇旺动」是火鬼带螣蛇旺盛发动（何知章里的「螣蛇入火」，LY.ILL.BSZZ.35，是同一个看法）。「福」是福神，即子孙。这一条在易隐里单独一节，题作《痘疹占》，在《小儿占》一类的后面。
note.en: The 'Office' of 'the Month stands at Office' is the Office stage of the twelve life stages, not the Pressure line; 'a Fire ghost with the Snake, strong and moving' is a Fire ghost carrying the Coiling Snake strong and moving (the 'Snake entering Fire' of the how-to-know rhyme, LY.ILL.BSZZ.35, is the same view). 'Fortune' is the spirit of blessing, that is Output. In the Yi Yin this is a section of its own, titled 'Divining pox', placed after the section on children.

zh: 鬼不上卦，与鬼化死墓绝胎空，及被刑害克破者，皆不出也。
若鬼虽衰死受伤，而化出生旺，无鬼而月建临官，鬼静而日当生旺，与火鬼加蛇旺动者，皆出也。
欲知出痘疹之期，以官鬼生旺之年月日断之。
欲知痘疹之稀密，但鬼衰子旺，与子持身世者必稀朗。
鬼旺子衰，与鬼持身世者，必稠密。
福临空死墓绝胎，与受刑害克冲者，命必难保也。
yi: 以官鬼为用爻。
鬼不上卦，或者鬼变出死、墓、绝、胎、空，以及被刑、害、克、破的，都不出痘。
如果鬼虽然衰、死、受伤而变出生旺，或者没有鬼而月建临官，或者鬼安静而日正当生旺，以及火鬼带螣蛇旺盛发动的，都会出痘。
想知道出痘疹的日期，以官鬼生旺的年、月、日来断。
想知道痘疹的稀密，只要鬼衰、子孙旺，以及子孙持身、世的，一定稀疏明朗。
鬼旺、子孙衰，以及鬼持身、世的，一定稠密。
父母爻动的重，兄爻动的轻。
福神临在空、死、墓、绝、胎上，以及受到刑、害、克、冲的，性命一定难保。
en: The Pressure line is the Subject.
If the ghost does not appear in the hexagram, or changes into Death, tomb, Extinction, Womb or Void, or is punished, harmed, controlled or broken, the pox will not come out.

If the ghost is weak, dead or wounded but changes into Birth or strength, or there is no ghost but the Month stands at Office, or the ghost is still and the day is exactly its Birth or strength, or a Fire ghost with the Snake is strong and moving, the pox will come out.
To know when the pox and eruptions will come out, judge by the year, month or day in which the Pressure line is born or strong.
To know whether the pox will be sparse or dense: if the ghost is weak and Output strong, or Output holds the Body or the Self, it will surely be sparse and clear.
If the ghost is strong and Output weak, or the ghost holds the Body or the Self, it will surely be dense.
If Resource moves it is heavy; if Peer moves it is light.
If Fortune falls on Void, Death, tomb, Extinction or Womb, or is punished, harmed, controlled or clashed, his life can hardly be preserved.

title: 十六变卦(京房)：外戒吉凶从外来、内戒祸福从内起；骸骨卦生则羸瘦死不葬埋；棺槨卦病必死亡；血脉卦主血疾漏下；绝命卦事多反复；游魂肌肉卦精神恍惚；归魂塚墓卦坟墓吉而事可成

rule.yi: 每一宫都有十六个变卦，占的人遇到变入本宫卦的，灾福应验十分。外戒卦，吉凶从外面来；内戒卦，祸福从里面起；骸骨卦，活着的人羸弱消瘦，死了的人不得埋葬；棺槨卦，病人必定死亡；血脉卦，主血疾和漏下；绝命卦，事情多反复，为人孤独、和世俗不合；游魂、肌肉卦，精神恍惚，像做梦、像痴呆；归魂、坟墓卦，坟墓吉，事可以成。
rule.en: Each palace has sixteen changed hexagrams, and when the diviner meets a change into a hexagram of the own palace, calamity and fortune are borne out to the full. An Outer Warning hexagram: good and ill come from outside; an Inner Warning hexagram: calamity and fortune arise from within; a Bones hexagram: the living are frail and thin, the dead are not buried; a Coffin hexagram: in illness the person surely dies; a Blood Vessels hexagram means blood disease and leakage from below; an End of Life hexagram: affairs mostly reverse and repeat, and the person is solitary and out of tune with the customs; a Wandering Soul or Flesh hexagram: the spirit is dazed, as in a dream or as if foolish; a Returning Soul or Grave hexagram: graves are auspicious and the matter can succeed.

note.yi: 这是京房的「十六变卦」：每一宫从本宫卦起，一爻一爻地变（「飞」就是变一爻），依次得到十六个卦，其中几个有专名（游魂、外戒、内戒、归魂、绝命、血脉、肌肉、骸骨、棺槨、坟墓）。头一段是乾宫的走法：乾变姤、遁、否、观、剥（五变），上爻不动；再从剥变第四爻得晋（游魂），变第三爻得旅（外戒），变第二爻得鼎（内戒），变初爻得大有（归魂）；再从大有变第二爻得离（绝命），变第三爻得噬嗑（血脉），变第四爻得颐（肌肉），变第五爻得益（骸骨），再变第四爻得无妄（棺槨），变第三爻得同人（坟墓），变第二爻回到乾。「自初至五不动」按「从初到五逐爻变、上爻不动」读，因为下文说「上爻为宗庙，永不变」。后一段是这些名称的断语，只有「棺槨卦，病必死亡」和「骸骨卦」「血脉卦」直接说到病；「游魂肌肉卦精神恍惚」和卜筮元龟的「游魂恍惚」是同一个说法。「塚墓」即冢墓，按 Grave 译。「遇变入本宫卦者」的「本宫卦」是本卦所属那一宫里的卦。断易天机里的卜筮元龟一段用了这些名称，见 LY.ILL.DYTJ.13。
note.en: This is Jing Fang's 'sixteen changed hexagrams': each palace, starting from the palace hexagram, changes one line at a time ('fei', flying, means changing one line) and gives sixteen hexagrams in turn, several of which have their own names (Wandering Soul, Outer Warning, Inner Warning, Returning Soul, End of Life, Blood Vessels, Flesh, Bones, Coffin, Grave). The first passage gives the walk for the Qian palace: Qian changes to Gou, Dun, Pi, Guan and Bo (five changes), the top line not moving; then from Bo changing the fourth line gives Jin (Wandering Soul), the third line Lü (Outer Warning), the second line Ding (Inner Warning), the first line Dayou (Returning Soul); then from Dayou changing the second line gives Li (End of Life), the third line Shihe (Blood Vessels), the fourth line Yi (Nourishment; Flesh), the fifth line Yi (Increase; Bones), then the fourth line again gives Wuwang (Coffin), the third line Tongren (Grave), and the second line returns to Qian. 'Zi chu zhi wu bu dong' is read as 'changing line by line from the first to the fifth, the top line not moving', because the text goes on to say 'the top line is the ancestral temple and never changes'. The second passage gives the judgments for these names, and only 'a Coffin hexagram: in illness the person surely dies', and the Bones and Blood Vessels hexagrams, speak of illness directly; 'a Wandering Soul or Flesh hexagram: the spirit is dazed' is the same saying as the 'Wandering Soul dazed' of the Bushi Yuangui. 'Zhong mu' (a tomb mound) is rendered Grave. The 'hexagram of the own palace' of 'a change into a hexagram of the own palace' is a hexagram in the palace to which the original hexagram belongs. The passage of the Bushi Yuangui in the Duanyi Tianji uses these names, see LY.ILL.DYTJ.13.

zh: 自初至五不动复下飞四往复用飞，
yi: 京房这样说：
从初爻变到五爻，上爻不动，再往下飞变第四爻，往复用「飞」的办法；
往上飞、往下飞，还回本体，
这便是十六变卦的规矩。
比如乾宫，一变是姤，
到五变是剥，
上爻是宗庙，
永远不变。
再下飞第四爻，晋是游魂；
下飞第三爻，旅是外戒；
下飞第二爻，鼎是内戒；
下飞初爻，大有是归魂。
再上飞第二爻，离是绝命；
再上飞第三爻，噬嗑是血脉；
上飞第四爻，颐是肌肉；
上飞第五爻，益是骸骨；
再下飞第四爻，无妄是棺槨；
下飞第三爻，同人是坟墓；
下飞第二爻，乾，又回到本体。
en: Jing Fang says:
changing from the first line to the fifth, the top line not moving, then flying down to change the fourth, going back and forth using the flying;
flying up and flying down, returning to the original body,
this is the rule of the sixteen changed hexagrams.
Take the Qian palace: the first change is Gou,
to the fifth change, Bo;
the top line is the ancestral temple,
and never changes.
then flying down to the fourth line, Jin is the Wandering Soul;
flying down to the third, Lü is the Outer Warning;
flying down to the second, Ding is the Inner Warning;
flying down to the first, Dayou is the Returning Soul.
then flying up to the second, Li is the End of Life;
then flying up to the third, Shihe is the Blood Vessels;
flying up to the fourth, Yi (Nourishment) is the Flesh;
flying up to the fifth, Yi (Increase) is the Bones;
then flying down to the fourth, Wuwang is the Coffin;
flying down to the third, Tongren is the Grave;
flying down to the second, Qian, back to the original body.

zh: 占者遇变入本宫卦者，灾福应十分。
骸骨卦，生则赢瘦，死不葬埋。
绝命卦，事多反复，为人孤独，不谐于俗。
游魂肌肉卦，精神恍惚，如梦如癡。
归魂塚墓卦，坟墓吉，而事可成也。
yi: 凡十六变，八个宫都照这样；
占的人遇到变入本宫卦的，灾福应验十分。
外戒卦，吉凶从外面来。
内戒卦，祸福从里面起。
骸骨卦，活着羸弱消瘦，死了不得埋葬。
棺槨卦，病人必定死亡。
血脉卦，主血疾和漏下。
绝命卦，事情多反复，为人孤独，和世俗不合。
游魂、肌肉卦，精神恍惚，像做梦、像痴呆。
归魂、坟墓卦，坟墓吉，事可以成。
en: The sixteen changes are made likewise in all eight palaces;
when the diviner meets a change into a hexagram of the own palace, calamity and fortune are borne out to the full.
An Outer Warning hexagram: good and ill come from outside.
An Inner Warning hexagram: calamity and fortune arise from within.
A Bones hexagram: alive, frail and thin; dead, not buried.
A Coffin hexagram: in illness the person surely dies.
A Blood Vessels hexagram means blood disease and leakage from below.
An End of Life hexagram: affairs mostly reverse and repeat, the person is solitary, and out of tune with the customs.
A Wandering Soul or Flesh hexagram: the spirit is dazed, as in a dream or as if foolish.
A Returning Soul or Grave hexagram: for graves, auspicious, and the matter can succeed.

title: 断病生死全凭用神：卦名、卦身世身兼用、本命丧门、蛇虎星煞都不验，只有卦变六冲例外

rule.yi: 断病的生死，全凭用神，别的都不验：只看卦名的（得明夷、大过、观、贲、蛊、夬、丰、同人、大畜、需就断必死），说本命临死气丧门、寿衣棺木要早备的，说螣蛇动主死、白虎动主丧的，都不灵。恶煞凶神就算临了身命，只要用神、世爻和身爻旺相，你说他是生是死？不看用神也能断生死的，只有卦变六冲一种。
rule.en: Life and death in an illness are judged from the Subject alone, and nothing else proves true: judging from the hexagram name alone (Mingyi, Daguo, Guan, Bi, Gu, Guai, Feng, Tongren, Daxu and Xu being called surely fatal), saying that a natal line on the death spirit or the mourning gate means shroud and coffin must be ready early, saying that a moving Coiling Snake means death and a moving White Tiger mourning: none of these is reliable. When fierce spirits and ill stars already sit on the body and the natal line, yet the Subject and the Self and body lines are strong, who is to say he lives or dies? The one case in which life and death may be judged without looking at the Subject is a hexagram changing into a Six-Clash hexagram.

dispute.yi: 断生死看什么：黄金策的病体章除了用神，还讲卦身、世爻、本命爻（LY.ILL.HJC.35、HJC.41、HJC.53、HJC.54）；野鹤说这些并用是舛错，断生死全凭用神，只有卦变六冲例外。
dispute.en: What to look at in judging life and death: besides the Subject the Huangjin Ce's chapter on the patient's condition also speaks of the hexagram Body, the Self line and the natal line (LY.ILL.HJC.35, HJC.41, HJC.53, HJC.54); the Old Man of Yehe says that using them together is error, that life and death rest wholly on the Subject, and that a hexagram changing into Six-Clash is the only exception.

note.yi: 野鹤这一段是对整个占病断法的总批评。他驳的是靠卦名、本命丧门、蛇虎星煞断生死的旧法；黄金策病体章断生死靠的是各爻的生克旺衰，不靠星煞。「衾棺」是入殓用的被和棺材。「明夷、大过、观、贲、蛊、夬、丰、同人、大畜、需」是那些书里断必死的十个卦名。
note.en: This passage is the Old Man's general criticism of the whole way of judging illness.
