A lawsuit ends in peace.

yi: 随，就是跟从。
阴一定跟从阳。
官员贵人顺从。
财禄荣昌。
婚姻和睦。
疾病平安康复。
凡是占自身和命运，
福寿没有边际。
en: Sui (Following) means following.
Yin must follow yang.
Officials and nobles comply.
Wealth and salary flourish.
Marriage is harmonious.
Illness is eased and health returns.
In all divining of the person and fate,
blessing and long life are without limit.

yi: 风火家人这一卦，
是成家的象。
婚姻和合。
人丁和财运兴旺。
病和官司都无忧。
田蚕有指望。
拜见贵人、求官，
得福无量。
en: Wind over Fire, Jiaren (the Household),
is the image of founding a household.
Marriage is in harmony.
People and wealth flourish.
Neither illness nor lawsuit brings worry.
Fields and silkworms hold promise.
Calling on nobles and seeking office,
one wins blessing beyond measure.

yi: 益，就是增益。
凡事有益。
利于合婚。
适合占自身和住宅。
词讼和病都平稳。
生财大吉。
适合自己，也有益于人。
乾坤合德。
en: Yi (Increase) means increase.
All matters bring benefit.
Favourable to joining in marriage.
Suits divining the person and dwelling.
Lawsuit and illness are both calm.
Making wealth is greatly auspicious.
Good for oneself and beneficial to others.
Heaven and Earth unite in virtue.

yi: 颐，就是养。
养要从正道。
谋划指望周到完满。
婚姻吉庆。
官司吉，病平安。
财荣，俸禄盛。
公事清平。
门庭安静。
en: Yi (Nourishment) means nourishment.
Nourishment should follow what is right.
Plans and hopes are complete.
Marriage is auspicious and festive.
The lawsuit is auspicious and the illness safe.
Wealth flourishes and salary is abundant.
Public affairs are clear and calm.
The household is quiet and at rest.

yi: 鼎，就是器物。
是烹煮饮食的器具。
求官十全十美。
生财百倍。
自身吉利，住宅荣耀。
婚事成，病有利。
求事要托人，
却要仔细。
en: Ding (the Cauldron) means a vessel.
It is a vessel for cooking.
Seeking office: complete in all ten parts.
Making wealth a hundredfold.
The person is fortunate and the dwelling flourishes.
Marriage is made and illness fares well.
Seeking a matter: entrust it to someone,
but be careful.

yi: 比，就是辅助。
阴来辅助阳。
官员贵人旺相。
自身和住宅平安健康。
官司和病解散。
婚姻吉祥。
一切谋划运作，
和顺才光明。
en: Bi (Union) means support.
Yin comes to support yang.
Officials and nobles are thriving and strong.
The person and dwelling are safe and sound.
Lawsuit and illness are dissolved.
Marriage is auspicious.
In all one plans and works,
harmony and accord bring brightness.

yi: 萃，就是聚集。
万物只在于自身要诚。
自身和钱财都吉。
福禄双双荣盛。
婚姻和合。
六畜繁衍。
病和官司终究吉。
田蚕晚成。
en: Cui (Gathering) means gathering.
Things depend only on sincerity in oneself.
The person and wealth are both auspicious.
Blessing and salary both flourish.
Marriage is in harmony.
The six domestic animals multiply.
Illness and lawsuit end auspiciously.
Fields and silkworms ripen late.

yi: 咸，就是感应。
有感就必有应。
官鬼爻周全。
住宅和自身有喜庆。
适合怀孕，适合婚姻。
利于官司，利于病。
咸的道理虽然通达，
更要贞正。
en: Xian (Influence) means influence.
Where there is influence there is response.
The Pressure line is complete.
The dwelling and the person have joy.
Pregnancy and marriage both suit.
Favourable to lawsuits and favourable to illness.
Though the way of Xian goes through,
it needs all the more uprightness.

title: 八卦断例·占病逢姤、遁、晋、丰、师、井、夬：病者难安、迁延、难瘥、沉滞、迟瘥、稽迟、迟延

rule.yi: 周易尚占八卦断例里，这七个卦的断辞说病难好、拖得久：姤「病者难安」，遁「病者迁延」，晋「病者难瘥」，丰「病人沉滞」，师「病人迟瘥」，井「问病稽迟」，夬「病讼迟延」。
rule.en: In the judgments by example of the Zhouyi Shangzhan the line of each of these seven hexagrams says that illness is hard to mend and drags on: Gou, 'the sick will find it hard to be at peace'; Dun, 'the sick one drags on'; Jin, 'the sick will find it hard to recover'; Feng, 'the sick one is weighed down and lingering'; Shi, 'the sick recover late'; Jing, 'asking about illness: delay and slowness'; Guai, 'illness and lawsuit are delayed'.

dispute.yi: 丰、夬两卦的轻重，几本书说得不一样。别的书把丰、夬列为占病的凶卦，甚至是「十死」：阐奥歌章第三首（LY.ILL.CA.03）、第五首（LY.ILL.CA.06）、卜筮元龟一段（LY.ILL.DYTJ.15）、天玄赋（LY.ILL.TXF.06）、增删卜易转述的十卦（LY.ILL.ZS.01）里都有丰和夬；周易尚占这里丰只是「病人沉滞」，夬只是「病讼迟延」，是病拖得久，没有说死。同样，丰在这里是「利官利贵、婚姻有成」的卦。程度不同，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: The books do not agree on how heavy Feng and Guai are. Other books list Feng and Guai among the ominous hexagrams for illness, even among the 'ten deaths': the third (LY.ILL.CA.03) and fifth (LY.ILL.CA.06) poems of the Chan'ao Gezhang, the passage of the Bushi Yuangui (LY.ILL.DYTJ.15), the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.06) and the ten hexagrams reported in the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.01) all have Feng and Guai; here in the Zhouyi Shangzhan Feng is only 'the sick one is weighed down and lingering' and Guai only 'illness and lawsuit are delayed', that is, illness that drags on, with no word of death. Likewise Feng is here a hexagram of 'favourable to office and to nobles, marriage is achieved'. The degree differs, and the books do not decide.

note.yi: 这七行的病句都是「拖」：难安、迁延、难瘥、沉滞、迟瘥、稽迟、迟延，没有一个说死；姤的「病者难安」最重（难得平安），夬是病和官司一起拖。「沉滞」是沉重、拖着不好，「稽迟」是拖延迟缓，「迁延」是一拖再拖。姤卦在原书里写作「媾」（「媾者遇也」），这里照原文；「卜筮行人 端的在路」是说占行人，他确实还在路上，和病无关。「求官谒贵」（井）这个词组只有事项、没有断语，原文如此。「财平稍平」（晋）意思不清，译文照字面。
note.en: The illness phrases of these seven lines all speak of dragging on: hard to be at peace, protracted, hard to recover, weighed down, late to recover, delay and slowness, delayed; none speaks of death. The heaviest is 'the sick will find it hard to be at peace' of Gou (hard to gain peace), and for Guai illness and the lawsuit drag on together. 'Weighed down and lingering' is heavy and not getting better, 'delay and slowness' is dragging and slow, and 'drags on' is delay upon delay. In the original book Gou is written with the 'union' character ('that character means meeting'), and the line is quoted as it stands; 'as for divining about a traveller, he is indeed on the road' is about a traveller and not about illness. The phrase 'seeking office, calling on nobles' (Jing) has an affair but no verdict, as in the original. 'Wealth is level, only slightly so' (Jin) is unclear in sense and is translated literally.

yi: 媾（姤），就是相遇。
谋事一定会有所遇。
求官，官位荣耀。
求财，财能如愿。
病人难得平安。
婚姻，不要娶。
占问出门在外的人，
的确还在路上。
en: Gou (Meeting) means to meet.
Any plan is sure to meet with an encounter.
Seeking office: the office is glorious.
Seeking wealth: the wealth comes as wished.
The sick will find it hard to be at peace.
Marriage: do not take the bride.
As for divining about a traveller,
he is indeed on the road.

yi: 遁，就是退。
凡事适合退让。
官司可以和解。
在外的人被阻滞。
问婚事，成不了。
求财，没有利。
病人拖延不愈。
田蚕收成微薄。
en: Dun (Retreat) means to withdraw.
In all matters, withdrawing suits.
A lawsuit can end in reconciliation.
The traveller is held up.
Asking about a betrothal: it will not come about.
Seeking wealth: no profit.
The sick one drags on.
Fields and silkworms yield very little.

yi: 晋，就是前进。
进就一定有升。
求进身一定如愿。
进取的事有成。
在外的人还没到。
官司不明朗。
病人难痊愈。
财运平平，只是稍微平顺一点。
en: Jin (Advance) means to go forward.
Advancing surely brings promotion.
Advancing oneself will surely be achieved.
Ventures that advance succeed.
The traveller has not yet arrived.
A lawsuit is unclear.
The sick will find it hard to recover.
Wealth is level, only slightly so.

yi: 丰，就是大。
利于求官，利于见贵人。
婚姻能成。
在外的人一定到。
怀孕，生女孩。
病人沉重拖延。
凡是占家宅，
一半明朗，一半昏暗。
en: Feng (Abundance) means great.
Favourable to office and favourable to nobles.
Marriage is achieved.
The traveller will surely arrive.
Pregnancy: a girl is born.
The sick one is weighed down and lingering.
In all divining of the household,
it is half bright and half dim.

yi: 师，就是众。
占自身不利。
求官虽然吉，
但见贵人会遭嗔怪。
不要占财帛。
不要问行人。
病人痊愈得迟。
家宅有灾祸困顿。
en: Shi (the Army) means the multitude.
Divining about oneself is unfavourable.
Seeking office is auspicious,
but seeing a noble draws his anger.
Do not divine about wealth.
Do not ask about the traveller.
The sick recover late.
The household has calamity and hardship.

yi: 井，就是静。
不宜乱作为。
求官、拜见贵人，
问病，拖延迟缓。
田蚕得一半。
在外的人没有回来。
占婚事，阻滞。
把本事藏起来，等待时机。
en: Jing (the Well) means stillness.
Rash action does not suit.
Seeking office, calling on nobles:
Asking about illness: delay and slowness.
Fields and silkworms yield half.
The traveller has not returned.
Asking about marriage: obstruction and delay.
Keep the tools hidden and wait for the time.

yi: 夬，就是决断。
有决断的心志。
交易称心。
生财如意。
婚事和怀孕吉利昌盛。
贵人和官职如愿。
病和官司拖延。
文书迟缓阻滞。
en: Guai (Resolution) means decision.
There is a resolute will.
Deals please.
Making wealth is as wished.
Marriage and pregnancy are auspicious and prosperous.
Nobles and office are achieved.
Illness and lawsuit are delayed.
Documents are slow and stuck.

title: 八卦断例·占病逢坎、噬嗑、蛊、离、困、睽、小过、明夷：病凶、病重、件件遭伤、有惊、有忧

rule.yi: 周易尚占八卦断例里，这八个卦的断辞说病凶险、沉重或有忧：坎「孕病皆凶」，噬嗑「病重讼凶」，蛊「孕吉病凶」，离「病重财轻」，困「宅身孕病件件遭伤」，睽「问病有惊」，小过「官阻病忧」，明夷「占家父病」。
rule.en: In the judgments by example of the Zhouyi Shangzhan the line of each of these eight hexagrams says that illness is ominous, heavy or a worry: Kan, 'pregnancy and illness are both ominous'; Shihe, 'illness is heavy and the lawsuit is ill'; Gu, 'pregnancy is auspicious, illness is ominous'; Li, 'illness is heavy and wealth is light'; Kun (Confinement), 'dwelling, person, pregnancy, illness: each one is hurt'; Kui, 'asking about illness: there is a fright'; Xiaoguo, 'office is blocked and illness is a worry'; Mingyi, 'divining the household: the father is ill'.

dispute.yi: 别的书的占病凶卦名单里，同人、需、剥、节、蒙在内，周易尚占对这几个卦的断辞里却没有讲病：同人是「婚孕皆成、所求皆至」，需是「不宜轻举、所谋不成」，剥是「退则获安、进则不利」，节是「身命不宁」，蒙是「却宜占病」（LY.ILL.ZSZ.06）。阐奥歌章第三首（LY.ILL.CA.03）、第五首（LY.ILL.CA.06）、卜筮元龟一段（LY.ILL.DYTJ.15）和增删卜易转述的十卦（LY.ILL.ZS.01）都有同人；需、剥、节见于卜筮元龟一段和阐奥歌章；蒙只见于卜筮全书疾病论（LY.ILL.BSQS.35）。没有说的不等于说了好，这几个卦占病吉凶，周易尚占这一行没有表态。反过来，这里的坎、噬嗑、蛊、离、困、睽、小过，别的凶卦名单里大多没有（只有蛊、困在），是周易尚占独有的断语。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Among the other books' lists of ominous hexagrams for illness are Tongren, Xu, Bo, Jie and Meng, yet the lines of the Zhouyi Shangzhan for these hexagrams do not speak of illness: Tongren is 'marriage and pregnancy both succeed, all that is sought arrives', Xu is 'rash moves do not suit, what is planned does not succeed', Bo is 'to withdraw is to gain safety, to advance is unfavourable', Jie is 'the person and fate are unsettled', and Meng is 'but it suits divining illness' (LY.ILL.ZSZ.06). Tongren is in the third (LY.ILL.CA.03) and fifth (LY.ILL.CA.06) poems of the Chan'ao Gezhang, in the passage of the Bushi Yuangui (LY.ILL.DYTJ.15) and in the ten hexagrams reported in the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.01); Xu, Bo and Jie are in the Bushi Yuangui passage and the Chan'ao Gezhang; Meng is only in the Bushi Quanshu's essay on illness (LY.ILL.BSQS.35). Not saying is not saying good: for the verdict on illness of these hexagrams the line of the Zhouyi Shangzhan takes no position. Conversely, of the hexagrams here, Kan, Shihe, Li, Kui and Xiaoguo are for the most part absent from the other lists of ominous hexagrams (only Gu and Kun (Confinement) are in them), so these verdicts are peculiar to the Zhouyi Shangzhan. The books do not decide.

note.yi: 这八行里，坎「孕病皆凶」、蛊「孕吉病凶」把病和怀孕并说，困是「宅身孕病」四件并说，都是一句话管几件事。明夷「占孕母忧，占家父病」两句对着读：占怀孕时母亲有忧，占家宅时父亲有病；「占家父病」只有四个字，这个读法是按上一句的格式推的。噬嗑一行的「求财且且」「惟道有者」两处意思不清，「道有者」读来像「有道者」的倒文，译文都照字面，没有改字。噬嗑的头两个词组「噬者啮也」「嗑者合也」都是在解释卦名。「婚寡」译作婚姻孤寡，「孕双」译作怀孕得双胎，都是字面的读法。
note.en: In these eight lines, Kan, 'pregnancy and illness are both ominous', and Gu, 'pregnancy is auspicious, illness is ominous', speak of illness and pregnancy together, and Kun (Confinement) names 'dwelling, person, pregnancy, illness' together, each a single phrase covering several matters. For Mingyi the two phrases 'divining pregnancy: the mother is in anxiety' and 'divining the household: the father is ill' are read in parallel: in divining pregnancy the mother is anxious, in divining the household the father is ill; 'divining the household: the father is ill' is only four characters in the book, and this reading is inferred from the pattern of the previous phrase. In the line of Shihe, 'seeking wealth: barely so' and 'only those who have the Way' are unclear in sense, and the second looks like an inverted form of 'those who have the Way'; both are translated literally and no character has been changed. The first two phrases of Shihe, 'Shi means to bite' and 'He means to close together', both explain the name of the hexagram. 'Marriage is lonely' translates the literal 'marriage widowed' and 'twins' of Li translates the literal 'pregnancy double'.

yi: 坎，就是陷。
什么事都行不通。
田蚕不利。
怀孕和生病都凶。
经营求财会遇到盗贼。
行船会遇到风。
只有诚、只有信，
走出险境才成功。
en: Kan (the Abyss) means falling in.
No matter goes through.
Fields and silkworms are unfavourable.
Pregnancy and illness are both ominous.
Seeking wealth in business meets robbers.
A boat on the way meets wind.
Only sincerity, only good faith:
coming out of danger, one succeeds.

yi: 噬，就是咬。
嗑，就是合。
谋划指望，放低才安稳。
求财，不过勉强而已。
病重，官司凶。
怀孕有忧，婚姻孤寡。
去除障碍，铲除奸邪。
只有有道的人。
en: Shi means to bite.
He means to close together.
Plans and hopes are safe when kept low.
Seeking wealth: barely so.
Illness is heavy and the lawsuit is ill.
Pregnancy is anxious and marriage is lonely.
Remove obstacles and eliminate the wicked:
only those who have the Way.

yi: 蛊，就是乱。
乱了一定会有治。
家宅纷乱。
自身暗昧不明。
官司拖延。
文书全都停滞。
怀孕吉，病凶。
婚事成，财有利。
en: Gu (Decay) means disorder.
Disorder will surely be followed by order.
The household is in turmoil.
The person is in obscurity.
A lawsuit drags on.
Documents are wholly stuck.
Pregnancy is auspicious; illness is ominous.
Marriage is made and wealth profits.

yi: 离，就是附丽。
凡事分明。
不宜占住宅。
婚事和官司九成能成。
怀孕得双胎，蚕收一半。
病重，财轻。
官员贵人有喜。
最利于在外的人。
en: Li (Fire) means clinging.
All matters are clear.
Divining the dwelling does not suit.
Marriage and lawsuit: nine parts in ten succeed.
Pregnancy: twins; silkworms: half.
Illness is heavy and wealth is light.
Officials and nobles have joy.
Most favourable to the traveller.

yi: 困，就是厄困。
阴掩盖阳。
住宅、自身、怀孕、疾病，
件件受伤。
生财，利少。
官司多有妨碍。
告诉占卜的人：
安分守常。
en: Kun (Confinement) means distress.
Yin covers yang.
Dwelling, person, pregnancy, illness:
each one is hurt.
Making wealth: profit is little.
A lawsuit meets many hindrances.
A word to the one who divines:
keep to one's lot and the ordinary.

yi: 睽，就是相异。
三体互相违背。
问病，有惊吓。
求财不宜。
婚姻不相配。
在外的人不回来。
小事虽然吉，
也要迟迟才应验。
en: Kui (Opposition) means difference.
The three bodies are at odds with one another.
Asking about illness: there is a fright.
Seeking wealth does not suit.
Marriage: the two are not matched.
The traveller does not return.
Small matters, though auspicious,
will still answer slowly.

yi: 小过，就是小有过越。
所过之处不远。
自身与住宅有小灾。
交易，钱财很少。
官路受阻，病有忧。
怀孕有惊，婚事免了。
凡是所占的一切，
全都浅浅薄薄。
en: Xiaoguo (Small Excess) means a small excess.
What is passed over is not far.
The person and dwelling have a small calamity.
Trade: wealth is scant.
Office is blocked and illness is a worry.
Pregnancy has a fright; marriage is to be avoided.
In all that is divined,
all is thin and shallow.

yi: 明夷，就是受伤。
凡事不顺。
婚姻不成。
官司有争竞。
占怀孕，母亲有忧。
占家宅，父亲有病。
一切行事做为，
务必谨慎。
en: Mingyi (Light Wounded) means being wounded.
Nothing goes smoothly.
Marriage is not achieved.
A lawsuit brings contention.
Divining pregnancy: the mother is in anxiety.
Divining the household: the father is ill.
In all one undertakes,
be sure to be careful.

title: 八卦断例·占病宜不宜：履「弗占疾病」、大壮「休占讼病」、蒙「却宜占病」；恒「病须疾治」

rule.yi: 周易尚占八卦断例里有四个卦对占病给的是劝告：履卦说不要占疾病，大壮卦说不要占官司和病，蒙卦说不要营谋、倒适合占病，恒卦说病要赶快治。
rule.en: In the judgments by example of the Zhouyi Shangzhan four hexagrams give advice about divining illness rather than a verdict: Lü (Treading) says do not divine illness, Dazhuang says do not divine lawsuits or illness, Meng says one cannot yet scheme but it suits divining illness, and Heng says illness must be treated quickly.

dispute.yi: 蒙卦这里说「却宜占病」，卜筮全书疾病论（LY.ILL.BSQS.35）却把蒙列进春天的十死卦。「宜占病」说的是适合拿这一卦来问病，没有说病会好，所以两处不一定正面冲突，合起来看蒙卦占病到底吉凶，书里没有定论。
dispute.en: Of Meng the line here says 'but it suits divining illness', whereas the Bushi Quanshu's essay on illness (LY.ILL.BSQS.35) puts Meng among the ten fatal hexagrams of spring. 'Suits divining illness' says that this hexagram is a fit one with which to ask about illness, and does not say the illness will mend, so the two places need not clash head on; taken together, the books do not settle whether Meng is auspicious or ominous for illness.

note.yi: 「弗占疾病」「休占讼病」是劝人不要占这件事，书里没有说是因为病凶，还是因为这一卦本身不适合问这类事；履卦同一行里还有「危中有救，险处无妨」。「却宜占病」的「却」是转折：上一个词组说「未可营谋」，这一个说倒适合占病。恒卦「病须疾治」里的「疾」是迅速、赶快，不是疾病。
note.en: 'Do not divine illness' and 'do not divine lawsuits or illness' advise against divining this matter, and the book does not say whether this is because illness is ominous or because the hexagram itself is not a fit one for such questions; the same line of Lü (Treading) also has 'in danger there is rescue, in a perilous place there is no harm'. The 'but' of 'but it suits divining illness' is a turn: the previous phrase says 'one cannot yet scheme', and this says that it nevertheless suits divining illness. The 'quickly' of 'illness must be treated quickly' in Heng is the word for swift, not the word for illness.

yi: 履，就是礼。
用柔去踩刚。
危险之中有救。
险处没有妨碍。
不要占疾病。
不要问官府的事。
一切谋划运作，
开头谨慎，经营才昌盛。
en: Lü (Treading) means ritual propriety.
The soft treads on the hard.
In danger there is rescue.
In a perilous place there is no harm.
Do not divine illness.
Do not ask about official business.
In all one plans and works,
be careful at the start and the venture will prosper.

yi: 大壮，就是强壮。
四个阳爻壮盛。
用强壮，灾就生。
用「罔」（不逞强），吉就应。
适合问婚姻。
不要占官司和病。
动就不合。
守就是正。
en: Dazhuang (Great Strength) means strength.
Four yang lines are strong and full.
Using force gives rise to calamity.
Using non-force, good fortune answers.
Suits asking about marriage.
Do not divine lawsuits or illness.
To move is not to hit the mark.
To hold still is to be upright.

yi: 蒙，就是蒙昧。
用蒙来养正。
还不可以营谋。
却适合占病。
失物要另外去找。
婚姻没有缘分。
一切求取谋划，
要靠人引荐。
en: Meng (Obscurity) means dimness.
Through dimness one nourishes what is right.
One cannot yet scheme.
But it suits divining illness.
Lost things must be sought elsewhere.
Marriage: there is no fated share.
In all seeking and scheming,
rely on someone to introduce.

yi: 恒，就是长久。
取长久恒常的意思。
自身和住宅都荣盛。
公事私事两利。
官司宜早点和解。
病要赶快治。
守旧就安和。
出行没有滞留。
en: Heng (Constancy) means lasting.
It carries the sense of long constancy.
The person and dwelling both flourish.
Public and private both profit.
A lawsuit is best settled early.
Illness must be treated quickly.
Keeping to the old way is peaceful and harmonious.
Travel meets no delay.

title: 八卦断例·占病逢巽、旅、临：金神为祟、病者祷禳、病犯祟侵

rule.yi: 周易尚占八卦断例里有三个卦的断辞把病和鬼神联在一起：巽卦「惟占病人，金神为崇」，占病人的时候是金神（白虎）在作祟；旅卦「病者祷禳」，病人要祷告、禳解；临卦「病犯崇侵」，病是撞上了鬼神作祟的侵扰。
rule.en: In the judgments by example of the Zhouyi Shangzhan three hexagrams link illness with spirits: Xun, 'only in divining a sick person: a Metal spirit (the White Tiger) is the curse'; Lü (the Traveller), 'the sick should pray and perform exorcism'; Lin, 'illness meets the encroachment of a curse'.

note.yi: 巽、临两处原文写的是「崇」（崇高的崇），按上下文是作祟的「祟」，译文按「祟」（鬼神降灾）译，书里没有标注。「金神」按这一部前面「十一、定六神」的「白虎金神」（第 461 行）是白虎，这里「金神为崇」是白虎作祟；别的书里金神常和七煞连称（LY.ILL.EL.34、EL.47），那是另一个意思，这里没有用。「祷禳」是祈祷、禳解（用仪式把灾禳除）。「病犯崇侵」读作病是触犯了、遇到了鬼神作祟的侵扰。三行里别的词组照录。
note.en: In Xun and Lin the original writes the character for 'lofty' where the context calls for the character for 'curse'; the translation reads it as 'curse' (harm sent by a spirit), and the book gives no mark. By 'Section 11: Fixing the Six Spirits' earlier in the same part ('the White Tiger is the Metal spirit', line 461) the 'Metal spirit' is the White Tiger, so 'a Metal spirit is the curse' here is the White Tiger afflicting; in other books the Golden Spirit is often named together with the Seven Killings (LY.ILL.EL.34, EL.47), which is another sense and is not used here. 'Pray and perform exorcism' is to pray and to dispel the calamity by rites. 'Illness meets the encroachment of a curse' reads the illness as having offended or run into the invasion of a curse sent by a spirit. The other phrases of the three lines are kept as they stand.

yi: 巽，就是顺。
顺着时势行事。
利于财、利于婚。
利于官、利于贵人。
自身安泰，官司和解。
田有收成，蚕如愿。
只有占病人，
是金神作祟。
en: Xun (Wind) means compliance.
Act in accord with the time.
Favourable to wealth and to marriage.
Favourable to office and to nobles.
The person is at ease and a lawsuit is settled.
Fields give harvest and silkworms thrive.
Only in divining a sick person:
a Metal spirit is the curse.

yi: 旅，就是羁旅在外。
是在旅途的象。
不利于守常。
运作谋划最好。
官司散去，婚事成。
怀孕得生，囚犯得放。
病人要祷告、禳解。
在外的人不要指望（归来）。
en: Lü (the Traveller) means sojourning.
It is the image of being on a journey.
Keeping to the usual is unfavourable.
Working and scheming is best.
The lawsuit disperses and marriage is made.
Pregnancy comes to birth and prisoners are freed.
The sick should pray and perform exorcism.
Do not look for the traveller.

yi: 临，就是大。
克制自己，面对别人。
适合占家宅。
利于问婚姻。
财、官都吉。
谋划指望，与同辈同步。
怀孕，生男孩。
病，遇到鬼神作祟的侵扰。
en: Lin (Approach) means great.
Master oneself to face others.
Suits divining the household.
Favourable to asking about marriage.
Wealth and office are both auspicious.
Plans and hopes are in step with one's peers.
Pregnancy: a boy is born.
Illness meets the encroachment of a curse.

title: 何知章·讼事与争竞的几句：讼事休是空亡官鬼又休囚，讼事多是朱雀白虎持世而鬼来扶，多争竞是朱雀兄弟推世应，小人生是玄武官鬼动临身，灾祸至是鬼临应爻来克世

rule.yi: 怎么知道人家的官司了结：官鬼落空亡又休囚。怎么知道人家官司多：朱雀、白虎持世，官鬼来扶助。怎么知道人家多争执：朱雀、兄弟推动世爻应爻。怎么知道人家有小人：玄武、官鬼发动临在身爻。怎么知道人家灾祸到：官鬼临在应爻来克世爻。
rule.en: How do we know a household's suit is over? Pressure is Void and also resting or trapped. How do we know a household has many suits? The Vermilion Bird or the White Tiger holds the Self and Pressure comes to support it. How do we know a household has many quarrels? The Vermilion Bird and the Peer line push on the Self and the Other. How do we know a petty person has appeared? The Dark Tortoise and Pressure move and sit on the Body. How do we know calamity is coming? Pressure sits on the Other line and comes to control the Self.

yi: 怎么知道人家的官司了结？
官鬼落空亡又休囚；
怎么知道人家官司多？
朱雀、白虎持世，官鬼来扶助；
en: How do we know a household's suit is over?
Pressure is Void and also resting or trapped;
How do we know a household has many suits?
The Vermilion Bird or the White Tiger holds the Self and Pressure comes to support it;

yi: 怎么知道人家多争执？
朱雀、兄弟推动世爻应爻；
怎么知道人家有小人？
玄武、官鬼发动临在身爻；
en: How do we know a household has many quarrels?
The Vermilion Bird and the Peer line push on the Self and the Other;
How do we know a petty person has appeared?
The Dark Tortoise and Pressure move and sit on the Body;

yi: 怎么知道人家灾祸到？
官鬼临在应爻来克世爻；
en: How do we know calamity is coming?
Pressure sits on the Other line and comes to control the Self;

chapter: 启蒙节要·三十三、诸爻持世诀
title: 诗诀·官讼和问讼的句子：子孙持世则官讼从今了便休，占官问讼宜财托而动变兄官万事凶

rule.yi: 子孙持世，官司从今了结就罢休；财爻持世，求官问讼适宜用财去托人，发动变出兄弟、官鬼，事事皆凶。
rule.en: With Output holding the Self, the lawsuit ends and rests from now on; with Wealth holding the Self, in seeking office or asking about a suit it is fit to entrust the matter with money, and if Peer or Pressure moves or changes out, everything is ill.

note.yi: 这两句出在诸爻持世诀的两联：官讼一句在「子孙持世」那一联，问讼一句在「财爻持世」那一联；每联开头的持世爻没有拆进引文里。
note.en: The two lines come from two couplets of the verse on lines holding the Self: the line on lawsuits is in the couplet for Output holding the Self, and the line on asking about a suit is in the couplet for Wealth holding the Self; the line named at the start of each couplet is not split into the quotation.

yi: 官司从今了结就罢休，
en: the lawsuit ends and rests from now on,

yi: 求官问讼适宜用财去托人，
发动变出兄弟、官鬼，事事皆凶。
en: in seeking office or asking about a suit it is fit to entrust the matter with money,
and if Peer or Pressure moves or changes out, everything is ill.

chapter: 十八问答·第二问·回头之克
title: 十八问答·第二问·书中例，占弟被讼：酉金兄弟为用神，午月克它、未日生它似可相敌，但动出午火月建相克是大凶象；问凶在何时，说今年辰年太岁相合无妨，化退神于申，恐危在午年申月，果然午年申月被重刑

rule.yi: 凡遇回头克的，彻底克尽。书中例：午月丁未日占弟弟被人告了吉凶如何，得困卦变恒卦：酉金兄弟爻为用神，午月克它，未日生它，似乎可以相抵；但是动出午火，和月建相克，是大凶之象；他问凶在什么时候，我说今年是辰年，太岁相合没有妨碍，化出退神于申，恐怕危险在午年申月；果然到午年申月被判重刑。
rule.en: Whatever meets a turning-back control is controlled through and through. Worked example: in the Wu month, on a Dingwei day, a man divined how things stood for his younger brother, who had been sued, and got Kun changing to Heng: the Peer line You-metal is the Subject, controlled by the Wu month and given life by the Wei day, which seems to set them even; but it moves out Wu-fire, which, controlled by the Month, is a sign of great ill. He asked when the ill would fall. I said: this year, a Chen year, Tai Sui combines with it and there is no harm, but it changes into a Retreating spirit at Shen, and I fear danger in the Shen month of a Wu year; indeed in the Shen month of the Wu year he was given a heavy punishment.

zh: 凡遇回头克者，彻底克尽。
原用二神遇之则凶，忌仇二神遇之反吉也。
yi: 凡遇回头克的，彻底克尽。
原用二神遇到它就凶，忌神仇神遇到它反而吉。
en: Whatever meets a turning-back control is controlled through and through.
The original two spirits (the Subject and its Support) are ill when they meet it, while the Adversary and the enemy spirit are lucky when they meet it.

zh: 午月丁未日，占弟被讼吉凶如何，得困之恒卦：
yi: 午月丁未日，占弟弟被人告了吉凶如何，得困卦变恒卦：
en: In the Wu month, on a Dingwei day, a man divined how things stood for his younger brother, who had been sued, and got Kun changing to Heng:

zh: 断曰：酉金兄弟为用神，午月克之，未日生之，似可相敌；
但动出午火月建相克，大凶之象。
答曰：今岁辰年太岁相合是无妨，化退神于申，恐危于午年申月。
果至午年申月而被重刑。
yi: 断曰：酉金兄弟爻为用神，午月克它，未日生它，似乎可以相抵；
但是动出午火和月建相克，是大凶之象。
他问：凶在什么时候？
我说：今年是辰年，太岁相合没有妨碍，化出退神于申，恐怕危险在午年申月。
果然到午年申月被判重刑。
en: Judgement: the Peer line You-metal is the Subject, controlled by the Wu month and given life by the Wei day, which seems to set them even;
but it moves out Wu-fire, which, controlled by the Month, is a sign of great ill.
He asked: when will the ill fall?
I said: this year, a Chen year, Tai Sui combines with it and there is no harm, but it changes into a Retreating spirit at Shen, and I fear danger in the Shen month of a Wu year.
Indeed in the Shen month of the Wu year he was given a heavy punishment.

chapter: 十八问答·第二问·回头之克
title: 十八问答·第二问·书中例，占父官事：外卦未土被卯月克，又会成亥卯未木局克它，全无救助，必至重罪，后来果然处斩（与《增删卜易》同一卦同一日，那边记为拟重罪被重刑）

rule.yi: 凡遇回头克的，彻底克尽。书中例：卯月戊辰日有人占父亲的官事，得萃卦变同人卦：断语说，外卦未土被卯月克它，何况土在春令气败，又会成亥卯未木局克它，全无救助，必定到重罪；后来果然被斩。
rule.en: Whatever meets a turning-back control is controlled through and through. Worked example: in the Mao month, on a Wuchen day, a man divined about his father's official matter and got Cui changing to Tongren: the Judgement said that the Wei-earth of the outer trigram is controlled by the Mao month, and moreover Earth is spent in the spring command and Hai, Mao and Wei combine into a Wood frame that controls it, with no rescue at all, so it must come to a grave charge; afterwards he was indeed beheaded.

note.yi: 《增删卜易》五行相克章收了同一个卦（卯月戊辰日，萃之同人），判词几乎一样，结局记为「果被重刑」；这里记为「后果斩」。
note.en: The chapter on the controlling cycle in the Zengshan Buyi records the same hexagram (the Mao month, a Wuchen day, Cui changing to Tongren) with almost the same judgement, but the outcome is given as "severely punished"; here it is "beheaded".

zh: 凡遇回头克者，彻底克尽。
原用二神遇之则凶，忌仇二神遇之反吉也。
yi: 凡遇回头克的，彻底克尽。
原用二神遇到它就凶，忌神仇神遇到它反而吉。
en: Whatever meets a turning-back control is controlled through and through.
The original two spirits (the Subject and its Support) are ill when they meet it, while the Adversary and the enemy spirit are lucky when they meet it.

zh: 卯月戊辰日，一人占父官事，得萃之同人卦：
yi: 卯月戊辰日，有人占父亲的官事，得萃卦变同人卦：
en: In the Mao month, on a Wuchen day, a man divined about his father's official matter and got Cui changing to Tongren:

zh: 断曰：外卦未土，卯月克之，况土值春令气败，又会成亥卯未木局克之，全无救助，必至重罪。
yi: 断语说：外卦未土，被卯月克它，何况土在春令气败，又会成亥卯未木局克它，全无救助，必定到重罪。
后来果然被斩。
en: The Judgement said: the Wei-earth of the outer trigram is controlled by the Mao month, and moreover Earth is spent in the spring command and Hai, Mao and Wei combine into a Wood frame that controls it, with no rescue at all, so it must come to a grave charge.
Afterwards he was indeed beheaded.

chapter: 十八问答·第八问·月破之爻
title: 十八问答·第八问·书中例，占讼事：爻逢六合官事必审，但戌月冲世是月破、卯日克世必输无疑，果然被杖责——应在日克月破

rule.yi: 月破的爻：神机显现在破；祸福的机缘根源在动，动而有生无克的破爻，有出破、填实、合破的办法；安静而有克无生的破爻，就是破了。书中例：戌月丁卯日占官司，得泰卦：卦里爻逢六合，官事必定要审；不适宜的是戌月冲世爻，这是月破，卯日又克世爻，必输无疑；果然被杖责。这是应在日克月破的缘故。
rule.en: On a line struck by the Month-break: the working of the spirits shows in the break; the root of luck and misfortune lies in movement, and a broken line that moves and has life without control has the ways of leaving the break, being filled, or being combined out of the break, while a still broken line with control and no life is broken. Worked example: in the Xu month, on a Dingmao day, a man divined about a lawsuit and got Tai: the lines meet six-combine, so the official matter must come to trial; what is unfit is the Xu month clashing the Self line, which is the Month-break, and the Mao day also controlling the Self, so he surely loses; indeed he was beaten with the rod. This answers because the Day controls the Month-break.

zh: 第八问：月破之爻，欲定其破为无用，却又应于破，欲谓其不破，却又到底破与无用，何也？
祸福之机本于动，动而有生无克之破爻，有出破、填实、合破之法；
安静有克无生之破爻，则破矣。
yi: 第八问：月破的爻，想认定它破了没有用，却又应在破上；想说它没有破，却又到底是破了没有用，是为什么？
回答说：神机显现在破。
祸福的机缘根源在动，动而有生无克的破爻，有出破、填实、合破的办法；
安静而有克无生的破爻，就是破了。
en: Question 8: a line struck by the Month-break; to hold that the break makes it useless, yet it answers on the break; to say it is not broken, yet in the end it is broken and useless; why?
Answer: the working of the spirits shows in the break.
The root of luck and misfortune lies in movement, and a broken line that moves and has life without control has the ways of leaving the break, being filled, or being combined out of the break;
a still broken line with control and no life is broken.

zh: 戌月丁卯日占讼事，得泰卦：
yi: 戌月丁卯日，占官司，得泰卦：
en: In the Xu month, on a Dingmao day, a man divined about a lawsuit and got Tai:

zh: 断曰：爻逢六合，官事必审，不宜戌建冲世，乃是月破，卯日克世必输无疑。
yi: 断语：卦里爻逢六合，官事必定要审，不适宜的是戌月冲世爻，这是月破，卯日又克世爻，必输无疑。
果然被杖责。
这是应在日克月破的缘故。
en: Judgement: the lines meet six-combine, so the official matter must come to trial; what is unfit is the Xu month clashing the Self line, which is the Month-break, and the Mao day also controlling the Self, so he surely loses.
Indeed he was beaten with the rod.
This answers because the Day controls the Month-break.

title: 词讼·小忿不惩必至争长竞短、大亏既负宁不诉枉申冤，欲定输赢须详世应：卦中世应就是状子里的原告被告，看它们就知两边胜负

rule.yi: 小的怨气不加惩戒，必然争长论短；大的亏已经吃了，怎能不告状申冤？要定输赢，必须详察世爻和应爻。卦中的世应，就是状纸上的原告和被告，详察它们，两边的胜负就可以知道。
rule.en: A small grievance not checked leads to quarrelling over who is greater; a great wrong already suffered, how can one not sue to set it right? To settle who wins and who loses, one must examine the Self and the Other. The Self and the Other in the hexagram are the plaintiff and the defendant in the plaint; by examining them one knows the success or failure of both sides.

yi: 小的怨气不加惩戒，
必然争长论短；
大的亏已经吃了，
怎能不告状申冤？
要定输赢，
必须详察世应
en: A small grievance not checked
leads to quarrelling over who is greater;
a great wrong already suffered,
how can one not sue to set it right?
To settle who wins and who loses,
one must examine the Self and the Other

zh: 卦中世应，即状中原被，详此则两边胜负可知。
yi: 卦中的世应，就是状纸上的原告和被告，详察它们，两边的胜负就可以知道。
en: The Self and the Other in the hexagram are the plaintiff and the defendant in the plaint; by examining them one knows the success or failure of both sides.

title: 词讼·应乃对头要休囚死绝、世为自己宜帝旺长生：不论原告被告，占的人以世爻为自己，应爻为对头；应旺世衰他强我弱，世旺应衰他弱我强

rule.yi: 应爻是对头，要休囚死绝才好；世爻是自己，适宜帝旺长生。不论原告被告，占的人都以世爻为自己，应爻为对头：应爻旺而世爻衰，他强我弱；世爻旺而应爻衰，他弱我强。
rule.en: The Other is the opponent, and it is best resting, trapped, dead or extinct; the Self is oneself, and it is fit for Emperor Strength or Long Life. Whether one is plaintiff or defendant, the questioner takes the Self as himself and the Other as the opponent: the Other strong and the Self weak, he is strong and I weak; the Self strong and the Other weak, he is weak and I strong.

yi: 应爻是对头，
要休囚死绝才好；
世爻是自己，
适宜帝旺长生。
en: The Other is the opponent,
and it is best resting, trapped, dead or extinct;
the Self is oneself,
and it is fit for Emperor Strength or Long Life.

zh: 不拘原被千，占以世为自己，应为对头。
应旺世衰，他强我弱，世旺应衰，他弱我强。
yi: 不论原告被告，占的人都以世爻为自己，应爻为对头。
应爻旺而世爻衰，他强我弱；世爻旺而应爻衰，他弱我强。
en: Whether one is plaintiff or defendant, the questioner takes the Self as himself and the Other as the opponent.
The Other strong and the Self weak, he is strong and I weak; the Self strong and the Other weak, he is weak and I strong.

title: 词讼·相冲相克乃是欺凌之象：世爻刑克应爻不一定是我胜，是欺他之象；必须鬼爻克应爻才是我胜，动爻和月建日辰克它也是一样

rule.yi: 相冲相克，是欺负凌辱的象。世爻刑克应爻，不算我胜，是欺负他的象；必须是官鬼爻克应爻，才算我胜，动爻和月建日辰克它也一样。
rule.en: Clash and control are the image of bullying and insult. The Self punishing or controlling the Other does not mean I win; it is the image of bullying him. Only if the Pressure line controls the Other does it mean I win, and so too if a moving line, the Month or the Day controls it.

yi: 相冲相克，
是欺负凌辱的象。
en: Clash and control,
are the image of bullying and insult.

zh: 世爻刑克应爻，未为我胜，乃是欺他之象。
必是鬼克应爻，方为我胜，动爻与月建日辰克之亦然。
yi: 世爻刑克应爻，不算我胜，是欺负他的象。
必须是官鬼爻克应爻，才算我胜，动爻和月建日辰克它也一样。
en: The Self punishing or controlling the Other does not mean I win; it is the image of bullying him.
Only if the Pressure line controls the Other does it mean I win, and so too if a moving line, the Month or the Day controls it.

title: 词讼·相生相合终成和好之情：世应相生相合，原被告有和解的意思；世生应是我想求和，应生世是他想求和；世应发动落空或化空，都是假意说和

rule.yi: 相生相合，最终成就和好的情意。世爻应爻相生相合，原告被告有和解的意思：世爻生应爻，是我想求和；应爻生世爻，是他想求和；应爻世爻发动落空或化空的，都是假意说和。
rule.en: Giving life and combining, they end in a feeling of reconciliation. The Self and the Other giving life to and combining with each other means the parties have a mind to settle: the Self giving life to the Other means I want peace; the Other giving life to the Self means he wants peace; the Other or the Self moving into the Void or changing into the Void means a false pretence of peace.

yi: 相生相合，
最终成就和好的情意。
en: Giving life and combining,
they end in a feeling of reconciliation.

zh: 世应生合，原被有和释之意。
应世动空化空者，俱是假意言和也。
yi: 世爻应爻相生相合，原告被告有和解的意思：
世爻生应爻，是我想求和；
应爻生世爻，是他想求和；
应爻世爻发动落空或化空的，都是假意说和。
en: The Self and the Other giving life to and combining with each other means the parties have a mind to settle:
the Self giving life to the Other means I want peace;
the Other giving life to the Self means he wants peace;
the Other or the Self moving into the Void or changing into the Void means a false pretence of peace.

title: 词讼·世应比和官鬼动恐公家捉打官司：世应比和是和解之象，若官鬼发动来克，则官府要办这场官司、不让和议；子孙也动才终成和议

rule.yi: 世应比和而官鬼发动，恐怕官府捉打这场官司。世应比和是和解的象，如果官鬼发动来克，就是官府要办这场官司，不愿意和议；子孙也发动，最终才能成就和议。
rule.en: With the Self and the Other in harmony but Pressure moving, I fear the authorities will take up the case and press it. The Self and the Other in harmony is the image of settlement, but if Pressure moves to control, the authorities will pursue the case and do not want a private settlement; only if Output also moves is a settlement in the end achieved.

yi: 世应比和而官鬼发动，
恐怕官府捉打这场官司。
en: With the Self and the Other in harmony but Pressure moving,
I fear the authorities will take up the case and press it.

zh: 世应比和是和释之象，倘官鬼动克，主官府捉打官司，不欲和议；
yi: 世应比和是和解的象，如果官鬼发动来克，就是官府要办这场官司，不愿意和议；
子孙也发动，最终才能成就和议。
en: The Self and the Other in harmony is the image of settlement, but if Pressure moves to control, the authorities will pursue the case and do not want a private settlement;
only if Output also moves is a settlement in the end achieved.

title: 词讼·卦爻安静子孙兴喜亲友劝和公事：六爻安静，世应虽不生合，而子孙发动，必有亲戚邻居出来劝和

rule.yi: 卦爻安静而子孙发动，喜得亲友劝和这件官事。六爻安静，世应虽然不相生合，但子孙发动，必定有亲戚邻居来劝和。
rule.en: With the lines still and Output moving, one is glad to have relatives and friends mediate the official matter. With all six lines still, though the Self and the Other do not give life to or combine with each other, if Output moves there will surely be relatives and neighbours who come to mediate.

yi: 卦爻安静而子孙发动，
喜得亲友劝和这件官事。
en: With the lines still and Output moving,
one is glad to have relatives and friends mediate the official matter.

zh: 六爻安静，世应虽不生合而子孙发动者，必有亲邻劝和也。
yi: 六爻安静，世应虽然不相生合，但子孙发动，必定有亲戚邻居来劝和。
en: With all six lines still, though the Self and the Other do not give life to or combine with each other, if Output moves there will surely be relatives and neighbours who come to mediate.

title: 词讼·世空则我欲息争：世空是我想息争，应空是他想息争，世应都空两边的怨气都消了

rule.yi: 世爻空，是我想平息争端。世爻空是我想平息争端，应爻空是他想平息争端，世爻应爻都空，双方的怨气都消了。
rule.en: If the Self is Void, I want to end the dispute. The Self Void means I want to end the dispute, the Other Void means he wants to end it, and both Void means the grievances on both sides are gone.

yi: 世爻空，是我想平息争端
en: If the Self is Void, I want to end the dispute

zh: 世空则我欲息争，应空则他欲息争，世应俱空，两怨销意。
yi: 世爻空是我想平息争端，应爻空是他想平息争端，世爻应爻都空，双方的怨气都消了。
en: The Self Void means I want to end the dispute, the Other Void means he wants to end it, and both Void means the grievances on both sides are gone.

title: 词讼·应动则他多机变：世动我必用心谋划，若化官鬼兄弟回头克制反为失计；应动他必有谋，加月建必有贵人依靠，克世则不吉

rule.yi: 应爻发动，他就多有机变。世爻发动，我必定用心谋划，如果化出官鬼或兄弟回头克制，反而失策；应爻发动，他必定有谋划，如果加上月建，必有贵人依靠，克世爻就不吉。
rule.en: If the Other moves, he has many tricks and changes. If the Self moves, I surely lay plans with care, but if it changes into Pressure or Peer that turns back to control it, the plan misfires; if the Other moves, he surely has a scheme, and if the Month is added he surely has a noble to lean on, and if it controls the Self it is unlucky.

yi: 应爻发动，他就多有机变
en: If the Other moves, he has many tricks and changes

zh: 世动，则我必使心用谋，若化官兄回头克制，反为失计；
应动，则他必有谋，若加月建，必有贵人依靠，克世则为不吉。
yi: 世爻发动，我必定用心谋划，如果化出官鬼或兄弟回头克制，反而失策；
应爻发动，他必定有谋划，如果加上月建，必有贵人依靠，克世爻就不吉。
en: If the Self moves, I surely lay plans with care, but if it changes into Pressure or Peer that turns back to control it, the plan misfires;
if the Other moves, he surely has a scheme, and if the Month is added he surely has a noble to lean on, and if it controls the Self it is unlucky.

title: 词讼·间伤世位须防硬证同谋、鬼克间爻且喜有司明见：间爻是中证人，生世合世向着我，生应合应向着他；与世冲克的与我有仇；若冲克我的爻反去生合应爻，要防证人同谋陷害；有鬼爻克制或日辰冲克，官府不听他的话，我无事；间爻受刑克中证必遭杖责

rule.yi: 间爻伤害世位，要防备硬证人同谋；鬼爻克间爻，还喜得官府看得明白。间爻是作中证的人：生世合世，必定向着我；生应合应，必定向着他；与世爻冲克，与我有仇；与应爻冲克，与他有隙。如果旺爻生应、衰爻合世，是帮他的有力、帮我的没有功效；或者应爻发动克世，是向着他的人，即使不上前怪我，偏偏会出面。如果冲克我的爻反去生应合应，须防证人同谋陷害；如果得到鬼爻克制或被日辰冲克，是官府不听他的话，我无事。间爻如果受刑克，作证的人必遭杖责；靠近世爻的必是我的干证，靠近应爻的是他的干证。
rule.en: If a between line injures the Self position, beware of hard witnesses in a plot; if Pressure controls the between line, one is glad that the court sees clearly. The between lines are the witnesses: one giving life to or combining with the Self surely favours me; one giving life to or combining with the Other surely favours him; one clashing or controlling the Self has a feud with me; one clashing or controlling the Other has a rift with him. If a strong line gives life to the Other and a weak line combines with the Self, those helping him are powerful and those helping me are ineffective; or if the Other moves to control the Self, those on his side, though they do not step forward to blame me, will come out in the open all the same. If a line that clashes or controls me instead gives life to or combines with the Other, beware of witnesses plotting together to frame me; if it is controlled by the Pressure line or clashed and controlled by the Day, the officials will not listen to its words and I come to no harm. If a between line is punished or controlled, the witness is surely beaten with the rod; the one near the Self is surely my witness, and the one near the Other is his witness.

yi: 间爻伤害世位，
要防备硬证人同谋；
鬼爻克间爻，
还喜得官府看得明白。
en: If a between line injures the Self position,
beware of hard witnesses in a plot;
if Pressure controls the between line,
one is glad that the court sees clearly.

zh: 间爻为中证之人，生世合世必然向我，生应合应必然向他；
与世冲克，与我有仇，与应冲克，与彼有隙。
若旺爻生应，衰爻合世，是助彼者有力，助我者无功；
或应动克世，是向彼者，虽不上前怪我，偏来出面。
若冲克我之爻反去生应合应，须证人同谋陷害；
若得鬼爻克制或被日辰冲克，是官府不听其言，我得无事。
间爻若受刑克，中证必遭杖责，近世必是我之干证，近应为彼之干证也。
yi: 间爻是作中证的人：生世合世，必定向着我；生应合应，必定向着他。
与世爻冲克，与我有仇；与应爻冲克，与他有隙。
如果旺爻生应、衰爻合世，是帮他的有力、帮我的没有功效；
或者应爻发动克世，是向着他的人，即使不上前怪我，偏偏会出面。
如果冲克我的爻反去生应合应，须防证人同谋陷害；
如果得到鬼爻克制或被日辰冲克，是官府不听他的话，我无事。
间爻如果受刑克，作证的人必遭杖责；靠近世爻的必是我的干证，靠近应爻的是他的干证。
en: The between lines are the witnesses: one giving life to or combining with the Self surely favours me; one giving life to or combining with the Other surely favours him.
One clashing or controlling the Self has a feud with me; one clashing or controlling the Other has a rift with him.
If a strong line gives life to the Other and a weak line combines with the Self, those helping him are powerful and those helping me are ineffective;
or if the Other moves to control the Self, those on his side, though they do not step forward to blame me, will come out in the open all the same.
If a line that clashes or controls me instead gives life to or combines with the Other, beware of witnesses plotting together to frame me;
if it is controlled by the Pressure line or clashed and controlled by the Day, the officials will not listen to its words and I come to no harm.
If a between line is punished or controlled, the witness is surely beaten with the rod; the one near the Self is surely my witness, and the one near the Other is his witness.

title: 词讼·身乃根因事体空则情虚：卦身是词讼的根由，旺则事大衰则事小，动则急静则缓；空伏都是编造的虚事，飞伏都没有就一点不实

rule.yi: 卦身是事情的根本缘由，落空就情节虚假。卦身关系到词讼的根由：旺，事大；衰，事小；动，事急；静，事缓；如果空或伏，都是编造的故事；飞神伏神都没有，一丝一毫都不是实情。
rule.en: The Body is the root cause and substance of the matter, and if it is Void the facts are false. The Body concerns the root of the lawsuit: strong, the matter is great; weak, small; moving, urgent; still, slow; if it is Void or hidden, it is a made-up story; if neither flying nor hidden spirit is present, not a hair of it is true.

yi: 卦身是事情的根本缘由，
落空就情节虚假。
en: The Body is the root cause and substance of the matter,
and if it is Void the facts are false.

zh: 卦身系词讼根由，旺则事大，衰则事小；
yi: 卦身关系到词讼的根由：旺，事大；衰，事小；
动，事急；静，事缓；
如果空或伏，都是编造的故事；
飞神伏神都没有，一丝一毫都不是实情。
en: The Body concerns the root of the lawsuit: strong, the matter is great; weak, small;
moving, urgent; still, slow;
if it is Void or hidden, it is a made-up story;
if neither flying nor hidden spirit is present, not a hair of it is true.

title: 词讼·父为案卷文书伏须未就：卦里没有父母爻，文书还没有写成；带刑临败病必有破绽，化财也一样；化兄会被驳回，月建作合，上司必定调卷，有冲就都不准许

rule.yi: 父母爻是案卷文书，伏藏着就一定还没有办成。卦里没有父母，文书未就；带刑、临败地和病地，必多破绽，化财也一样；化兄弟会被驳回，月建来合，上司必定调案卷，有冲的都不依允。
rule.en: The Resource line is the case file and papers, and if it is hidden they are surely not yet done. If the hexagram has no Resource, the papers are not done; if it carries punishment and sits on a place of decay or illness, there are many flaws, and likewise if it changes into Wealth; changing into Peer, it is rejected; if the Month combines it, the superior office will surely call up the file; if it is clashed, none of it is approved.

yi: 父母爻是案卷文书，
伏藏着就一定还没有办成。
en: The Resource line is the case file and papers,
and if it is hidden they are surely not yet done.

zh: 卦无父母，文书未就，带刑临败病，必多破绽，化财亦然。
化兄有驳，月建作合，上司必调卷，有冲皆不依允。
yi: 卦里没有父母，文书未就；带刑、临败地和病地，必多破绽，化财也一样。
化兄弟会被驳回，月建来合，上司必定调案卷，有冲的都不依允。
en: If the hexagram has no Resource, the papers are not done; if it carries punishment and sits on a place of decay or illness, there are many flaws, and likewise if it changes into Wealth.
Changing into Peer, it is rejected; if the Month combines it, the superior office will surely call up the file; if it is clashed, none of it is approved.

title: 词讼·鬼作问官克应则他遭杖责：官鬼是审案的官，动来克应爻，官司必定我胜；克世爻我败

rule.yi: 官鬼是审问的官，克应爻则他遭杖责。官鬼是审理词讼的官，发动去克应爻，官司必定我胜；克世爻，我败。
rule.en: Pressure is the examining magistrate; if it controls the Other, he is beaten with the rod. Pressure is the official who hears the case; if it moves to control the Other, I surely win the suit; if it controls the Self, I lose.

yi: 官鬼是审问的官，
克应爻则他遭杖责。
en: Pressure is the examining magistrate;
if it controls the Other, he is beaten with the rod.

zh: 鬼为听讼官，动去克应，讼必我胜，克世我败。
yi: 官鬼是审理词讼的官，发动去克应爻，官司必定我胜；克世爻，我败。
en: Pressure is the official who hears the case; if it moves to control the Other, I surely win the suit; if it controls the Self, I lose.

title: 词讼·日为书吏伤身则我受刑名：日辰既能救事也能坏事；鬼动克世自然有刑；得日辰制鬼冲鬼，必有旁人一句话解释，问官宽恕我

rule.yi: 日辰是书吏，伤了世身则我要受刑罚。日辰既能救事也能坏事，如果鬼发动克世，自然有刑罚；得到日辰制住鬼、冲掉鬼，必有旁人一句话来解释，问案的官必能宽恕我。
rule.en: The Day is the clerk, and if it injures the Self and Body I suffer punishment. The Day can both save and spoil a matter: if Pressure moves and controls the Self there is naturally punishment; if the Day restrains or clashes away Pressure, someone is sure to put in a word of explanation, and the magistrate will surely pardon me.

yi: 日辰是书吏，
伤了世身则我要受刑罚。
en: The Day is the clerk,
and if it injures the Self and Body I suffer punishment.

zh: 日辰能救事能坏事，如鬼动克世，自必有刑；
得日辰制鬼冲鬼，必得旁人一言解释，问官必能宽宥于我也。
yi: 日辰既能救事也能坏事，如果鬼发动克世，自然有刑罚；
得到日辰制住鬼、冲掉鬼，必有旁人一句话来解释，问案的官必能宽恕我。
en: The Day can both save and spoil a matter: if Pressure moves and controls the Self there is naturally punishment;
if the Day restrains or clashes away Pressure, someone is sure to put in a word of explanation, and the magistrate will surely pardon me.

title: 词讼·逢财则理直气壮：以财爻为理，临世我有理，临应他有理；鬼来刑害，虽有理官府也不听，兄弟动不容分辩；如果是下状，则财爻是忌神

rule.yi: 遇到财爻，就理直气壮。以财爻为道理：临在世爻，我有理；临在应爻，他有理；官鬼来刑害，虽然有理，官府不听，兄弟发动，不容分辩。如果是递状告人，财爻就是忌神。
rule.en: Meeting Wealth, one's reason is just and one's spirit bold. Wealth stands for being in the right: on the Self, I am in the right; on the Other, he is in the right; if Pressure comes to punish and harm, though one is in the right the officials do not listen, and if Peer moves, one is not allowed to argue. If one is lodging the plaint, Wealth is the Adversary.

yi: 遇到财爻，就理直气壮
en: Meeting Wealth, one's reason is just and one's spirit bold

zh: 以财为理，临世我有理，临应他有理；
鬼来刑害，虽有理而官府不听，兄动不容分辩。
yi: 以财爻为道理：临在世爻，我有理；临在应爻，他有理；
官鬼来刑害，虽然有理，官府不听，兄弟发动，不容分辩。
如果是递状告人，财爻就是忌神。
en: Wealth stands for being in the right: on the Self, I am in the right; on the Other, he is in the right;
if Pressure comes to punish and harm, though one is in the right the officials do not listen, and if Peer moves, one is not allowed to argue.
If one is lodging the plaint, Wealth is the Adversary.

title: 词讼·遇兄则财散人离：兄弟爻在世身爻上，事必牵连众人，发动则要广花钱财；加白虎必倾家荡产；临应爻则按赔偿来断

rule.yi: 遇到兄弟爻，就财散人离。兄弟爻如果在世爻身爻上，事情必然牵连众人，发动就要大量花费钱财；如果再加白虎，必定倾家荡产；临在应爻上，就按赔偿来断。
rule.en: Meeting a Peer line, wealth is scattered and people part. If the Peer line is on the Self or Body line, the matter surely involves many people, and if it moves a great deal of money will be spent; if the White Tiger is added, it surely means the ruin of the household; on the Other line, judge it as compensation.

yi: 遇到兄弟爻，就财散人离
en: Meeting a Peer line, wealth is scattered and people part

zh: 兄弟若在世身爻上，事必干众，动则广费资财；
或加白虎，必主倾家荡产。
yi: 兄弟爻如果在世爻身爻上，事情必然牵连众人，发动就要大量花费钱财；
如果再加白虎，必定倾家荡产；
临在应爻上，就按赔偿来断。
en: If the Peer line is on the Self or Body line, the matter surely involves many people, and if it moves a great deal of money will be spent;
if the White Tiger is added, it surely means the ruin of the household;
on the Other line, judge it as compensation.

title: 词讼·世入墓爻难免狱囚之系：世爻入墓、化墓或临鬼墓，卦象凶的必有牢狱之灾；临白虎，在狱中有病

rule.yi: 世爻入墓，难免被关进牢狱。世爻入墓、化墓，或临在鬼墓上，卦象凶的必有牢狱之灾；临白虎，在狱中生病。
rule.en: If the Self enters the tomb, imprisonment can hardly be avoided. The Self entering the tomb, changing into the tomb, or sitting on the tomb of Pressure, with an ill hexagram, surely means the calamity of prison; on the White Tiger, he falls ill in prison.

yi: 世爻入墓，
难免被关进牢狱。
en: If the Self enters the tomb,
imprisonment can hardly be avoided.

zh: 世爻入墓化墓或临鬼墓，卦象凶者必有牢狱之灾；
yi: 世爻入墓、化墓，或临在鬼墓上，卦象凶的必有牢狱之灾；
临白虎，在狱中生病。
en: The Self entering the tomb, changing into the tomb, or sitting on the tomb of Pressure, with an ill hexagram, surely means the calamity of prison;
on the White Tiger, he falls ill in prison.

title: 词讼·官逢太岁必非州县之词：官鬼在第五爻，若值太岁，这事必牵涉朝廷；遇月建必涉及台宪

rule.yi: 官鬼逢太岁，必定不是州县的案子。官鬼在第五爻，如果值太岁，这件事必定牵涉朝廷；遇月建，必定涉及台宪。
rule.en: Pressure meeting Tai Sui surely means this is not a case for a prefecture or county. If Pressure is on the fifth line and sits on Tai Sui, the matter surely concerns the court; meeting the Month, it surely involves the censorate and the provincial authorities.

yi: 官鬼逢太岁，
必定不是州县的案子。
en: Pressure meeting Tai Sui
surely means this is not a case for a prefecture or county.

zh: 官居第五爻，若值太岁，此事必干朝廷，逢月建必涉台宪。
yi: 官鬼在第五爻，如果值太岁，这件事必定牵涉朝廷；遇月建，必定涉及台宪。
en: If Pressure is on the fifth line and sits on Tai Sui, the matter surely concerns the court; meeting the Month, it surely involves the censorate and the provincial authorities.

title: 词讼·内外有官事涉一司终不了：官鬼不上卦就没有主事的官；内外卦都有官鬼，权不归一，事情反复，必经两个衙门才了结

rule.yi: 内外卦都有官鬼，事情牵涉一个衙门也终究了不了。官鬼不上卦，没有官员主张；内外都有官鬼，权力不归一人，主事情反复，必定经过两个衙门然后了事。
rule.en: With Pressure both inside and outside, a matter that touches one office cannot be finished in the end. If Pressure is not on the hexagram there is no official to take charge; with Pressure inside and outside, authority is not in one hand, which means the matter goes back and forth and must pass through two offices before it is settled.

yi: 内外卦都有官鬼，
事情牵涉一个衙门也终究了不了。
en: With Pressure both inside and outside,
a matter that touches one office cannot be finished in the end.

zh: 内外有官，权不归一，主事体反复，必经两司然后了事。
yi: 官鬼不上卦，没有官员主张；
内外都有官鬼，权力不归一人，主事情反复，必定经过两个衙门然后了事。
en: If Pressure is not on the hexagram there is no official to take charge;
with Pressure inside and outside, authority is not in one hand, which means the matter goes back and forth and must pass through two offices before it is settled.

title: 词讼·上下有父词兴两度始能成：官鬼和父母两爻不宜重复出现，主有转变不定的象，事情缠绵，最终难了结；占告状遇到这个象，必要再告一次才能成

rule.yi: 上下卦都有父母，状词要递两次才能成。官鬼、父母两爻不适宜重复出现，主有转变不定的象，事情一定缠绵，最终难以了结。比如占告状，遇到这个象，必定再告一次才成。
rule.en: With Resource in both upper and lower trigrams, the plaint must be lodged twice before it succeeds. The Pressure and Resource lines should not appear twice over, for that means an unsettled image of change; the matter will surely drag on and in the end be hard to finish. For example, in divining for lodging a complaint, meeting this image, it must be lodged once more before it succeeds.

yi: 上下卦都有父母，
状词要递两次才能成。
en: With Resource in both upper and lower trigrams,
the plaint must be lodged twice before it succeeds.

zh: 官父两爻不宜重见，主有转变不定之象，其事必主缠绵，卒难了结。
如占告诉，遇此象必再告之成也。
yi: 官鬼、父母两爻不适宜重复出现，主有转变不定的象，事情一定缠绵，最终难以了结。
比如占告状，遇到这个象，必定再告一次才成。
en: The Pressure and Resource lines should not appear twice over, for that means an unsettled image of change; the matter will surely drag on and in the end be hard to finish.
For example, in divining for lodging a complaint, meeting this image, it must be lodged once more before it succeeds.

title: 词讼·官父两强词讼表章皆准理、妻财一动申呈诉告总徒劳：凡是要上表、申奏、递状、告诉，官鬼和父母都要有气不空才准理；最怕财爻动伤父母，必不成

rule.yi: 官鬼和父母两爻都强，词讼和表章都能被受理；妻财一发动，申呈和诉告全是白费。凡是要上表、申奏、递呈子、告诉这类事，都要官鬼和父母两样齐全，有气不空，就能受理；最怕财爻动伤父母，一定不成。
rule.en: With Pressure and Resource both strong, lawsuits and memorials alike are accepted; once Wealth moves, petitions and complaints are all in vain. For anything such as presenting a memorial, submitting a report, lodging a petition or making a complaint, Pressure and Resource must both be present, with breath and not Void, and then it is accepted; most to be feared is Wealth moving to injure Resource, in which case it surely fails.

yi: 官鬼和父母两爻都强，
词讼和表章都能被受理；
妻财一发动，
申呈和诉告全是白费。
en: With Pressure and Resource both strong,
lawsuits and memorials alike are accepted;
once Wealth moves,
petitions and complaints are all in vain.

zh: 凡欲上表、申奏、申呈、告诉等事，皆要官父两全，有气不空，则能准理；
最怕财动伤父，必不可成。
yi: 凡是要上表、申奏、递呈子、告诉这类事，都要官鬼和父母两样齐全，有气不空，就能受理；
最怕财爻动伤父母，一定不成。
en: For anything such as presenting a memorial, submitting a report, lodging a petition or making a complaint, Pressure and Resource must both be present, with breath and not Void, and then it is accepted;
most to be feared is Wealth moving to injure Resource, in which case it surely fails.

title: 词讼·父旺官衰雀角鼠牙之讼：父母旺相、官鬼休囚，状词说得大、事实却小，是雀角鼠牙的小讼

rule.yi: 父母旺、官鬼衰，是雀角鼠牙的官司。父母旺相，官鬼休囚，状词说得大、事实很小，所以是雀角鼠牙之类的讼事。
rule.en: Resource strong and Pressure weak is a lawsuit of sparrow's horn and rat's tooth. With Resource strong and Pressure resting or trapped, the plaint talks big and the facts are small, so it is a petty suit of that kind.

yi: 父母旺、官鬼衰，
是雀角鼠牙的官司。
en: Resource strong and Pressure weak
is a lawsuit of sparrow's horn and rat's tooth.

zh: 父母旺相，官鬼休囚，情词若大，事实细，故乃雀角鼠牙之讼。
yi: 父母旺相，官鬼休囚，状词说得大、事实很小，所以是雀角鼠牙之类的讼事。
en: With Resource strong and Pressure resting or trapped, the plaint talks big and the facts are small, so it is a petty suit of that kind.

title: 词讼·变衰动旺虎头蛇尾之人：世应旺而发动像要吞并六国的气势；若变入墓绝空亡，是先强后弱、虎头蛇尾；世指自己，应指对方

rule.yi: 变成衰弱、发动时旺，是虎头蛇尾的人。凡是世爻应爻旺而发动，有并吞六国的气势；如果变入墓绝空亡，就是先强后弱、虎头蛇尾的象。世指自己说，应指对方说。
rule.en: Changing into weakness after moving strong is a man all tiger-head and snake-tail. Whenever the Self or the Other is strong and moves, it has the force to swallow up six states; if it changes into the tomb, extinction or Void, it is the image of strong first and weak after, tiger-head and snake-tail. The Self speaks of oneself, the Other of the opponent.

yi: 变成衰弱、发动时旺，
是虎头蛇尾的人。
en: Changing into weakness after moving strong
is a man all tiger-head and snake-tail.

zh: 凡世应旺动，是有并吞六国之势；
若变入墓绝空亡，乃先强后弱，虎头蛇尾之象。
yi: 凡是世爻应爻旺而发动，有并吞六国的气势；
如果变入墓绝空亡，就是先强后弱、虎头蛇尾的象。
世指自己说，应指对方说。
en: Whenever the Self or the Other is strong and moves, it has the force to swallow up six states;
if it changes into the tomb, extinction or Void, it is the image of strong first and weak after, tiger-head and snake-tail.
The Self speaks of oneself, the Other of the opponent.

title: 词讼·世若逢生当有贵人倚靠、应衰无助必无奸恶刁唆：世爻衰弱遇月建日辰动爻生合，必有贵人扶持，对方也无可奈何；应爻遇到这些则反过来

rule.yi: 世爻如果逢生，应当有贵人倚靠；应爻衰弱没有帮助，必定没有奸恶刁钻的人唆使。世爻衰弱，遇到月建、日辰、动爻生合，必定有贵人扶持，对方也无可奈何；应爻遇到这些则相反。
rule.en: If the Self meets life, there should be a noble to lean on; if the Other is weak and without help, there are surely no wicked and crafty men to egg him on. A weak Self that meets the Month, the Day or a moving line giving it life or combining with it surely has a noble to support it, and the opponent can do nothing; the Other meeting these is the reverse.

yi: 世爻如果逢生，
应当有贵人倚靠；
应爻衰弱没有帮助，
必定没有奸恶刁钻的人唆使。
en: If the Self meets life,
there should be a noble to lean on;
if the Other is weak and without help,
there are surely no wicked and crafty men to egg him on.

zh: 世爻衰弱，遇月建日辰动爻生合，必有贵人扶持，彼亦无可奈何。
yi: 世爻衰弱，遇到月建、日辰、动爻生合，必定有贵人扶持，对方也无可奈何；
应爻遇到这些则相反。
en: A weak Self that meets the Month, the Day or a moving line giving it life or combining with it surely has a noble to support it, and the opponent can do nothing;
the Other meeting these is the reverse.

title: 词讼·无合无生纵旺何如独脚虎、有刑有克逢空当效缩头龟：应爻旺动但没有生合，他虽刚强是独脚虎不足畏；世爻没有生合又遇日月动爻刑克，应当学缩头龟，暂且别和他对理

rule.yi: 没有合没有生，即使旺又怎么样，不过是独脚的老虎；有刑有克又逢空，应当学缩头的乌龟。应爻旺而发动、没有生合的，他虽然刚强，是独脚虎不值得怕；世爻没有生合，又遇到日月动爻刑克，应当学缩头龟，暂且不要和他对理。
rule.en: With no combination and no life, however strong, what is it but a one-legged tiger? With punishment and control, and also in the Void, one should act like a tortoise drawing in its head. An Other that is strong and moving but has no life or combination is, for all its hardness, a one-legged tiger not worth fearing; a Self with no life or combination that also meets punishment or control from the Month, the Day or a moving line should act like a tortoise drawing in its head and for the time being not argue the case with him.

yi: 没有合没有生，
即使旺又怎么样，不过是独脚的老虎；
有刑有克又逢空，
应当学缩头的乌龟。
en: With no combination and no life,
however strong, what is it but a one-legged tiger?
With punishment and control, and also in the Void,
one should act like a tortoise drawing in its head.

zh: 应爻旺动无生合者，彼虽刚强，是独脚虎不足畏；
世无生合，又遇日月动爻刑克，当效缩头龟，且勿与对理。
yi: 应爻旺而发动、没有生合的，他虽然刚强，是独脚虎不值得怕；
世爻没有生合，又遇到日月动爻刑克，应当学缩头龟，暂且不要和他对理。
en: An Other that is strong and moving but has no life or combination is, for all its hardness, a one-legged tiger not worth fearing;

a Self with no life or combination that also meets punishment or control from the Month, the Day or a moving line should act like a tortoise drawing in its head and for the time being not argue the case with him.

title: 词讼·兄在间中事必干众：兄弟爻在间爻，状词牵涉的人很多；发动则作证的人贪图贿赂，克应爻会索取赔偿的钱财，克世爻必须花钱托人才能安稳

rule.yi: 兄弟在间爻，事情必然牵涉众人。兄弟在间爻，状词里牵涉的人很多；发动，作证的人就会贪图索取贿赂；克应爻，会索取赔偿的钱财；克世爻，须用财物托人才能安稳。
rule.en: With a Peer line among the between lines, the matter surely involves many people. A Peer line among the between lines means many are implicated in the plaint; if it moves, the witnesses grasp at bribes; if it controls the Other, it demands compensation money; if it controls the Self, one must buy security by entrusting money to someone.

yi: 兄弟在间爻，
事情必然牵涉众人。
en: With a Peer line among the between lines,
the matter surely involves many people.

zh: 兄弟在间爻，词内干犯众多；
动则中证人贪索贿赂，克应索赔资财，克世须用财托为安。
yi: 兄弟在间爻，状词里牵涉的人很多；
发动，作证的人就会贪图索取贿赂，克应爻，会索取赔偿的钱财，克世爻，须用财物托人才能安稳。
en: A Peer line among the between lines means many are implicated in the plaint;
if it moves, the witnesses grasp at bribes; if it controls the Other, it demands compensation money; if it controls the Self, one must buy security by entrusting money to someone.

title: 词讼·父临应上彼欲兴词：父母是文书，临世是我想告理，临应是他想申诉；发动是要进行，安静就不会提起

rule.yi: 父母临在应爻上，他想要起诉。父母是文书，临在世爻上，是我想告理；临在应爻上，是他想申诉；发动是想要进行，安静就不会提起。
rule.en: With Resource on the Other, he wants to file a suit. Resource is the papers; on the Self, I want to lodge the case; on the Other, he wants to file his plea; moving, it is going ahead; still, it will not be raised.

yi: 父母临在应爻上，
他想要起诉。
en: With Resource on the Other,
he wants to file a suit.

zh: 父母为文书，临世我欲告理，临应他欲申诉；
yi: 父母是文书，临在世爻上，是我想告理；临在应爻上，是他想申诉；
发动是想要进行，安静就不会提起。
en: Resource is the papers; on the Self, I want to lodge the case; on the Other, he wants to file his plea;
moving, it is going ahead; still, it will not be raised.

title: 词讼·父动而官化福爻事将成而偶逢兜劝、父空而身临刑煞词未准而先被笞刑：占告状遇官父两动讼事可成；父有气或官化子孙，是人到公门将投状时有人劝止；父化空亡墓绝、官鬼刑克世爻或被日辰刑冲克害，状子不准先挨板子

rule.yi: 父母发动而官鬼化出福神，事情将成时偶然遇到有人拉着劝；父母落空而身爻临刑煞，状词还没批准就先挨笞刑。凡是占告状，遇到官鬼、父母两爻都动，官司可以成；如果父母有气，或官鬼化出子孙，就是人到公门将要投状，有人在旁边劝；如果父母化出空亡墓绝，官鬼刑克世爻，或者被日辰刑冲克害，状告不准，先遭杖责。
rule.en: With Resource moving and Pressure changing into Output, just as the matter is about to be done someone happens to pull one back and urge restraint; with Resource Void and the Body on a punishing star, the plaint is not yet accepted and one is beaten first. In divining for lodging a complaint, if Pressure and Resource both move, the suit can go ahead; if Resource has breath, or Pressure changes into Output, then when one reaches the court door about to submit the plaint someone persuades one against it; if Resource changes into the Void, tomb or extinction, Pressure punishes or controls the Self, or is punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by the Day, the complaint is not accepted and one is first beaten with the rod.

yi: 父母发动而官鬼化出福神，
事情将成时偶然遇到有人拉着劝；
父母落空而身爻临刑煞，
状词还没批准就先挨笞刑。
en: With Resource moving and Pressure changing into Output,
just as the matter is about to be done someone happens to pull one back and urge restraint;
with Resource Void and the Body on a punishing star,
the plaint is not yet accepted and one is beaten first.

zh: 凡占告诉，遇官父两动，讼事可成。
若父有气或官化子孙，则主身到公门将投词，而有人旁劝。
若父化空亡墓绝，官鬼刑克世爻，或被日辰刑冲克害，告状且不准，先遭杖责也。
yi: 凡是占告状，遇到官鬼、父母两爻都动，官司可以成；
如果父母有气，或官鬼化出子孙，就是人到公门将要投状，有人在旁边劝；
如果父母化出空亡墓绝，官鬼刑克世爻，或者被日辰刑冲克害，状告不准，先遭杖责。
en: In divining for lodging a complaint, if Pressure and Resource both move, the suit can go ahead;
if Resource has breath, or Pressure changes into Output, then when one reaches the court door about to submit the plaint someone persuades one against it;

if Resource changes into the Void, tomb or extinction, Pressure punishes or controls the Self, or is punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by the Day, the complaint is not accepted and one is first beaten with the rod.

title: 词讼·妻动生官须用赀财嘱托：官司已成而卦有财爻发动，必须花钱托人打点官府；如果遇到子孙冲官鬼，即使花钱也没有用

rule.yi: 妻财发动生官鬼，须用钱财嘱托。如果官司已经成立，卦里有财爻发动，必须用钱财去嘱托官府；如果遇到子孙冲官鬼，即使花钱也没有用。
rule.en: Wealth moving to give life to Pressure means money must be used to entrust the matter to someone. If the suit has already been brought and the hexagram has a moving Wealth line, money must be used to entrust the officials; if Output meets and clashes Pressure, spending money is useless.

yi: 妻财发动生官鬼，
须用钱财嘱托。
en: Wealth moving to give life to Pressure
means money must be used to entrust the matter to someone.

zh: 若讼已成，卦有财动，必须用财嘱托官府；
如遇子孙冲官，虽费赀财亦无益。
yi: 如果官司已经成立，卦里有财爻发动，必须用钱财去嘱托官府；
如果遇到子孙冲官鬼，即使花钱也没有用。
en: If the suit has already been brought and the hexagram has a moving Wealth line, money must be used to entrust the officials;
if Output meets and clashes Pressure, spending money is useless.

title: 词讼·世兴变鬼必因官讼亡身：世持鬼是我失理，应持鬼是他失理；世爻变鬼恐怕因为官事丧身，应爻变鬼就按对方来断

rule.yi: 世爻发动变成官鬼，必定因为官司丢了性命。世爻持鬼，是我失理；应爻持鬼，是他失理；世爻变鬼恐怕因官事丧身，应爻变鬼就按对方来断。
rule.en: The Self moving and changing into Pressure surely means losing one's life over the lawsuit. The Self holding Pressure means I am in the wrong; the Other holding Pressure means he is in the wrong; the Self changing into Pressure, I fear one may die from the official matter, and the Other changing into Pressure is judged for the opposite party.

yi: 世爻发动变成官鬼，
必定因为官司丢了性命。
en: The Self moving and changing into Pressure
surely means losing one's life over the lawsuit.

zh: 应持鬼他失理，世变鬼恐因官事而丧身，应变鬼以彼断之。
yi: 世爻持鬼，是我失理；
应爻持鬼，是他失理，世爻变鬼恐怕因官事丧身，应爻变鬼就按对方来断。
en: The Self holding Pressure means I am in the wrong;

the Other holding Pressure means he is in the wrong, the Self changing into Pressure, I fear one may die from the official matter, and the Other changing into Pressure is judged for the opposite party.

title: 词讼·子在身边到底不能结证、官伏世下讼根犹未芟除：卦身临福德出现发动，随即消散；怕官鬼伏在世爻下，讼根还在，眼下虽不成讼，到官鬼旺相透出时会被举发

rule.yi: 子孙在身边，到底不能结成证据；官鬼伏在世下，诉讼的根子还没有除掉。卦身临福德出现并发动，马上就会消散；只怕官鬼伏在世爻下，那么讼根常在，目前虽然不成讼，等官鬼旺相透出来时就会被举发。
rule.en: With Output beside the Body, a case can never be made into proof; with Pressure hidden under the Self, the root of the lawsuit has not been pulled out. The Body sitting on Output, appearing and moving, is scattered at once; the only fear is Pressure hidden under the Self, in which case the root of the suit is always there, and though no suit is formed for now, when Pressure is strong and comes out it will be brought up.

yi: 子孙在身边，
到底不能结成证据；
官鬼伏在世下，
诉讼的根子还没有除掉。
en: With Output beside the Body,
a case can never be made into proof;
with Pressure hidden under the Self,
the root of the lawsuit has not been pulled out.

zh: 卦身临福德出现发动，随即消散，唯怕官鬼伏世下，则讼根常在，目下虽不成讼，至官旺出透举发也。
yi: 卦身临福德出现并发动，马上就会消散；只怕官鬼伏在世爻下，那么讼根常在，目前虽然不成讼，等官鬼旺相透出来时就会被举发。
en: The Body sitting on Output, appearing and moving, is scattered at once; the only fear is Pressure hidden under the Self, in which case the root of the suit is always there, and though no suit is formed for now, when Pressure is strong and comes out it will be brought up.

title: 词讼·墓逢日德刑冲目下即当出狱、岁挈福神生合狱中必遇天恩：世墓、鬼墓动是入狱之象，得日辰刑冲克破眼下就出狱；狱中占卦最喜太岁生合世爻有天恩赦宥，月建生合上司审出，日辰生合有司饶恕，父母生合申诉得免

rule.yi: 墓逢日德和刑冲，眼下就该出狱；太岁带着福神来生合，狱中必遇天恩。世墓、鬼墓发动，都是入狱的象，如果得到日辰刑冲克破，眼下就该出狱。在狱中占卦，最喜太岁生合世爻，主有天恩赦免；月建生合，上司审出来；日辰生合，有关官员饶恕；父母爻生合，必须申诉才能免。
rule.en: The tomb meeting the Day's virtue and punishment or clash, he should leave prison at once; Tai Sui bringing Output to give life and combine, in prison he surely meets imperial grace. The tomb of the Self or of Pressure moving is the image of entering prison, and if the Day punishes, clashes, controls or breaks it, he should be out at once. Divining in prison, best of all is Tai Sui giving life to or combining with the Self, which means imperial pardon; the Month giving life or combining means the higher office trials him out; the Day giving life or combining, the officials spare him; Resource giving life or combining, he must plead to be let off.

yi: 墓逢日德和刑冲，
眼下就该出狱；
太岁带着福神来生合，
狱中必遇天恩。
en: The tomb meeting the Day's virtue and punishment or clash,
he should leave prison at once;
Tai Sui bringing Output to give life and combine,
in prison he surely meets imperial grace.

zh: 世墓、鬼墓爻动，皆是入狱之象，若得日辰刑冲克破，目下即当出狱。
在狱中占卦，最喜太岁生合世爻，主有天恩赦宥；
父母生合，必须申诉可得免也。
yi: 世墓、鬼墓发动，都是入狱的象，如果得到日辰刑冲克破，眼下就该出狱。
在狱中占卦，最喜太岁生合世爻，主有天恩赦免；
月建生合，上司审出来；
日辰生合，有关官员饶恕；
父母爻生合，必须申诉才能免。
en: The tomb of the Self or of Pressure moving is the image of entering prison, and if the Day punishes, clashes, controls or breaks it, he should be out at once.
Divining in prison, best of all is Tai Sui giving life to or combining with the Self, which means imperial pardon;
the Month giving life or combining means the higher office trials him out;
the Day giving life or combining, the officials spare him;
Resource giving life or combining, he must plead to be let off.

title: 词讼·若问罪名须详官鬼：卜罪名轻重看官鬼爻，旺则罪重衰则罪轻；加刑白虎旺动克世，火主极刑、金主充军、木主笞杖、水主从罪；要按衰旺和有制无制来断，不可拘泥

rule.yi: 如果问罪名，必须详察官鬼。凡是占罪名轻重，用官鬼爻来定：旺，罪重；衰，罪轻。再加刑、白虎、旺而发动克世爻，火主受极刑，金主充军，木主笞杖，水主从犯罪。要按衰旺、有制无制来断，不可拘泥。
rule.en: If asking about the charge, one must examine Pressure. In judging how heavy or light the charge is, fix it by the Pressure line: strong, the charge is heavy; weak, light. With punishment and the White Tiger added, strong and moving to control the Self, Fire means the extreme penalty, Metal means military exile, Wood means the cane or rod, Water means being an accessory. Judge by strength and weakness and whether it is held in check or not, and do not be rigid.

yi: 如果问罪名，
必须详察官鬼。
en: If asking about the charge,
one must examine Pressure.

zh: 凡卜罪名轻重，以官爻定之，旺则罪重，衰则罪轻。
加刑白虎旺动克世，火受极刑，金主充军，木主笞杖，水主从罪。
须以衰旺，有制无制断之，不可执滞。
yi: 凡是占罪名轻重，用官鬼爻来定：旺，罪重；衰，罪轻。
再加刑、白虎、旺而发动克世爻，火主受极刑，金主充军，木主笞杖，水主从犯罪。
要按衰旺、有制无制来断，不可拘泥。
en: In judging how heavy or light the charge is, fix it by the Pressure line: strong, the charge is heavy; weak, light.

With punishment and the White Tiger added, strong and moving to control the Self, Fire means the extreme penalty, Metal means military exile, Wood means the cane or rod, Water means being an accessory.
Judge by strength and weakness and whether it is held in check or not, and do not be rigid.

title: 词讼·要知消散当看子孙：福神发动官鬼安静，按生旺的日月断；官鬼发动福神安静，按官鬼入墓的日月断；卦象一成，胜负明明白白，一部讼庭的是非判得清清楚楚

rule.yi: 要知道怎样消散，应当看子孙。如果福神发动、官鬼安静，按生旺的日月断消散；官鬼发动、福神安静，按官鬼入墓的日月断消散。卦象既然成了，胜负明明白白；一部讼庭的是非，判得清清楚楚。
rule.en: To know how the matter will melt away, look at Output. If Output moves and Pressure is still, judge the day it melts by the months and days of life and strength; if Pressure moves and Output is still, judge it by the months and days when Pressure enters the tomb. Once the hexagram is formed, who wins and who loses is plain; the rights and wrongs of the whole lawcourt are decided clearly.

yi: 要知道怎样消散，
应当看子孙。
en: To know how the matter will melt away,
look at Output.

zh: 若福动鬼静，以生旺日月断；
鬼动福静，以官墓日月断。
卦象既成，胜负了然明白；
讼庭一部，是非判若昭彰。
yi: 如果福神发动、官鬼安静，按生旺的日月断消散；
官鬼发动、福神安静，按官鬼入墓的日月断消散。
卦象既然成了，胜负明明白白；
一部讼庭的是非，判得清清楚楚。
en: If Output moves and Pressure is still, judge the day it melts by the months and days of life and strength;
if Pressure moves and Output is still, judge it by the months and days when Pressure enters the tomb.
Once the hexagram is formed, who wins and who loses is plain;
the rights and wrongs of the whole lawcourt are decided clearly.

title: 防非避讼章·忧虑官司：喜官鬼空破，最宜子孙发动或持世则无非；鬼雀同动口舌难免，蛇鬼克世灾患相侵，玄武鬼必因盗贼阴人，白虎鬼必有伤痕见血；世动克应是我兴词，应克世爻是他有讼

rule.yi: 担心官司的，喜欢官鬼落在空亡或月破，最适宜子孙发动、子孙持世，就没有是非；官鬼和朱雀一起发动，口舌免不了；螣蛇官鬼克世，灾祸忧患相侵；玄武官鬼，必定因盗贼和阴人；白虎官鬼，必定有伤痕见血；世爻动而克应爻，是我兴词告人；应爻克世爻，是他有讼要告我。
rule.en: In worrying about a lawsuit, one is glad that Pressure is Void or broken, and most fit is Output moving or holding the Self, which means no trouble; Pressure and the Vermilion Bird moving together mean quarrels cannot be avoided; the Coiling Snake and Pressure controlling the Self mean calamity and distress press in; the Dark Tortoise and Pressure surely come from thieves and women; the White Tiger and Pressure surely mean wounds and blood; the Self moving to control the Other means I file a plaint; the Other controlling the Self means he has a suit against me.

zh: 忧虑官司，却喜官居空破，最宜子动、子孙持世，无非；
yi: 担心官司的，却喜欢官鬼落在空亡或月破，最适宜子孙发动、子孙持世，就没有是非；
官鬼和朱雀一起发动，口舌免不了；
螣蛇官鬼克世，灾祸忧患相侵；
玄武官鬼，必定因盗贼和阴人；
白虎官鬼，必定有伤痕见血；
世爻动而克应爻，是我兴词告人；
应爻克世爻，是他有讼要告我。
en: In worrying about a lawsuit, one is glad that Pressure is Void or broken, and most fit is Output moving or holding the Self, which means no trouble;
Pressure and the Vermilion Bird moving together mean quarrels cannot be avoided;
the Coiling Snake and Pressure controlling the Self mean calamity and distress press in;
the Dark Tortoise and Pressure surely come from thieves and women;
the White Tiger and Pressure surely mean wounds and blood;
the Self moving to control the Other means I file a plaint;
the Other controlling the Self means he has a suit against me.

title: 防非避讼章·子孙动或持世必不成非，鬼持世、鬼克世、应动克世定然成讼

rule.yi: 子孙发动、子孙持世，必定不成是非；官鬼持世、官鬼克世、应爻发动克世，一定成讼。
rule.en: Output moving or holding the Self surely means no trouble arises; Pressure holding the Self, Pressure controlling the Self, or the Other moving to control the Self surely means a suit arises.

zh: 子孙动、子孙持世，必不成非；
鬼持世、鬼克世、应动克世，定然成讼。
yi: 子孙发动、子孙持世，必定不成是非；
官鬼持世、官鬼克世、应爻发动克世，一定成讼。
en: Output moving or holding the Self surely means no trouble arises;
Pressure holding the Self, Pressure controlling the Self, or the Other moving to control the Self surely means a suit arises.

title: 斗殴争竞章·彼此相争看世应：不宜冲克，喜相生；日月克身我必受辱，动爻克应他必遭刑；应克世他胜，世克应我赢；世空世破世动化退我胆怯，应动应旺应化进神他得势；六冲必散，六合必成

rule.yi: 彼此相争，要看世爻应爻：不适宜冲克，喜欢相生；日月克身，我必定受辱；动爻克应爻，他必定遭刑；应爻克世爻他胜，世爻克应爻我赢。世爻空、世爻破、世爻动而化退，我心里胆怯；应爻动、应爻旺、应爻化进神，他得势了。卦遇六冲一定散，卦逢六合一定成。
rule.en: When the two sides contest, look to the Self and the Other: clash and control are not fit and giving life is welcome; if the Month or the Day controls the Body, I surely suffer insult; if a moving line controls the Other, he surely suffers punishment; the Other controlling the Self means he wins, the Self controlling the Other means I win. The Self Void, the Self broken, or the Self moving and changing into a Retreating spirit means I am timid at heart; the Other moving, the Other strong, or the Other changing into an Advancing spirit means he has the upper hand. A hexagram meeting six-clash surely breaks up; a hexagram meeting six-combine surely comes to terms.

zh: 彼此相争寻世应，不宜冲克喜相生，日月克身，我必受辱；
应克世他胜，世克应我赢。
世空世破、世动化退，我心怯焉；
应动应旺、应化进神，他得势矣。
卦遇六冲必散，卦逢六合必成。
yi: 彼此相争，要看世爻应爻：不适宜冲克，喜欢相生；日月克身，我必定受辱；
动爻克应爻，他必定遭刑；
应爻克世爻他胜，世爻克应爻我赢。
世爻空、世爻破、世爻动而化退，我心里胆怯；
应爻动、应爻旺、应爻化进神，他得势了。
卦遇六冲一定散，卦逢六合一定成。
en: When the two sides contest, look to the Self and the Other: clash and control are not fit and giving life is welcome; if the Month or the Day controls the Body, I surely suffer insult;
if a moving line controls the Other, he surely suffers punishment;
the Other controlling the Self means he wins, the Self controlling the Other means I win.
The Self Void, the Self broken, or the Self moving and changing into a Retreating spirit means I am timid at heart;
the Other moving, the Other strong, or the Other changing into an Advancing spirit means he has the upper hand.
A hexagram meeting six-clash surely breaks up; a hexagram meeting six-combine surely comes to terms.

title: 斗殴争竞章·总不离乎子孙爻：子孙发动、子孙持世，争斗不成；日月动爻宜克应不宜克世；世爻宜旺动克应及动而化吉，官事必赢

rule.yi: 总不离子孙爻：子孙发动、子孙持世，争斗打不起来；日月和动爻适宜克应爻，不适宜克世爻；世爻适宜旺相发动去克应爻，以及动而化出吉的，官事一定赢。
rule.en: It never leaves the Output line: Output moving or holding the Self means the fight does not come off; the Month, the Day and moving lines are fit to control the Other and unfit to control the Self; the Self is fit to be strong and moving to control the Other, or to move and change into something lucky, and then the official matter is surely won.

zh: 总不离乎子孙爻，子发动、子持世，争斗不成；
日月动爻宜于克应，不宜克世；
世宜旺动克应及动而化吉，官事必赢。
yi: 总不离子孙爻：子孙发动、子孙持世，争斗打不起来；
日月和动爻适宜克应爻，不适宜克世爻；
世爻适宜旺相发动去克应爻，以及动而化出吉的，官事一定赢。
en: It never leaves the Output line: Output moving or holding the Self means the fight does not come off;
the Month, the Day and moving lines are fit to control the Other and unfit to control the Self;
the Self is fit to be strong and moving to control the Other, or to move and change into something lucky, and then the official matter is surely won.

title: 兴词举讼章·官父同兴公庭有理、父官克世受屈含冤：世化退神、世空世破、卦变六冲、世被刑冲，终不成讼；财与子孙同动克破文书官鬼，也不成

rule.yi: 官鬼和父母同时发动，在公堂上有理；父母、官鬼克世爻，受屈含冤。世爻化退神、世爻空或破、卦变成六冲、世爻被刑冲，终究不成讼；财爻和子孙同时发动，克破文书和官鬼，也主不成。
rule.en: Pressure and Resource moving together, one is in the right in the public hall; Resource and Pressure controlling the Self, one suffers wrong and swallows the grievance. The Self changing into a Retreating spirit, the Self Void or broken, the hexagram changing into six-clash, or the Self punished or clashed, in the end no suit is brought; Wealth and Output moving together to control and break the papers and Pressure also means it is not brought.

zh: 官父同兴，公庭有理，父官克世，受屈含冤。
世化退神、世空世破、卦变六冲、世被刑冲，终不成讼；
财与子孙同动，克破文书官鬼，亦主不成。
yi: 官鬼和父母同时发动，在公堂上有理，父母、官鬼克世爻，受屈含冤。
世爻化退神、世爻空或破、卦变成六冲、世爻被刑冲，终究不成讼；
财爻和子孙同时发动，克破文书和官鬼，也主不成。
en: Pressure and Resource moving together, one is in the right in the public hall; Resource and Pressure controlling the Self, one suffers wrong and swallows the grievance.
The Self changing into a Retreating spirit, the Self Void or broken, the hexagram changing into six-clash, or the Self punished or clashed, in the end no suit is brought;
Wealth and Output moving together to control and break the papers and Pressure also means it is not brought.

title: 已定重罪章·福宜旺相最忌官兴：子孙持世、子孙发动，已赴法场终必赦免；官鬼克世或持世又被日月动爻冲克，或世动化凶，虽定轻罪也拘改重

rule.yi: 子孙适宜旺相，最忌官鬼兴盛。子孙持世、子孙发动，已经送到法场，终究会赦免；官鬼克世爻、或官鬼持世，又被日月动爻冲克，或者世爻发动化出凶的，虽然判的是轻罪也会拘押改判为重罪。
rule.en: Output should be strong, and Pressure flourishing is most feared. Output holding the Self or moving, even one already taken to the execution ground is in the end pardoned; Pressure controlling the Self or holding the Self and also clashed or controlled by the Month, the Day or a moving line, or the Self moving and changing into something ill, means that though a light sentence is fixed he is held and it is changed to a heavy one.

zh: 子孙持世，子孙发动，已赴法场，终必赦免。
官鬼克世、或官鬼持世，又被日月动爻冲克，或世动化凶，虽定轻罪拘改重。
yi: 子孙适宜旺相，最忌官鬼兴盛。
子孙持世、子孙发动，已经送到法场，终究会赦免；
官鬼克世爻、或官鬼持世，又被日月动爻冲克，或者世爻发动化出凶的，虽然判的是轻罪也会拘押改判为重罪。
en: Output should be strong, and Pressure flourishing is most feared.
Output holding the Self or moving, even one already taken to the execution ground is in the end pardoned;

Pressure controlling the Self or holding the Self and also clashed or controlled by the Month, the Day or a moving line, or the Self moving and changing into something ill, means that though a light sentence is fixed he is held and it is changed to a heavy one.

title: 趋避章·书中例，占定何罪：木鬼临白虎绞罪已定，但世临月建、木鬼虽动又被酉金回头之克、外卦反吟，事必反复，虽定绞罪终有改移；后来议绞罪，蒙驳审减轻

rule.yi: 蛇雀木鬼犯官刑，临火须防焚害；蛇木又言缢绞，勾陈土鬼牢狱。书中例：未月癸亥日占判定什么罪，得中孚卦变临卦：木鬼临白虎，绞罪是定了；但幸好世爻临月建，木鬼虽然发动，又被酉金回头之克，外卦反吟，事情一定反复，虽然定了绞罪，终究会有改动；果然议的是绞罪，后来蒙驳回重审减轻。
rule.en: The Coiling Snake or Vermilion Bird with Wood Pressure offends against the official penalty, and with Fire beware of burning; the Coiling Snake and Wood also speak of hanging or strangling, and the Hook Earth with Earth Pressure of jail. Worked example: in the Wei month, on a Guihai day, a man divined what charge would be fixed and got Zhongfu changing to Lin: Wood Pressure on the White Tiger means a sentence of strangulation is fixed; but fortunately the Self sits on the Month, and though the Wood Pressure moves it is controlled by a turning-back control from You-metal, and the outer trigram is Reversed Chant, so the matter will surely go back and forth; though strangulation is fixed there will in the end be a change; indeed strangulation was recommended, and later the case was sent back for retrial and the sentence reduced.

note.yi: 原文的小注「驳番拨活罪」是说驳回重审后拨作可以活命的罪名；这里译作驳回重审后减轻。
note.en: The original's small note says the case was sent back and reassigned to a charge that lets the man live; it is rendered as sent back for retrial and reduced.

zh: 蛇雀木鬼犯官刑，临火须防焚害；
蛇木又言缢绞，勾陈土鬼牢狱，
yi: 螣蛇、朱雀带着木鬼，会犯官府的刑罚；临到火，要提防被火烧。
蛇木又言缢绞，勾陈土鬼牢狱。
en: The Coiling Snake or Vermilion Bird with Wood Pressure offends against the official penalty, and with Fire beware of burning;
the Coiling Snake and Wood also speak of hanging or strangling, and the Hook Earth with Earth Pressure of jail.

zh: 如：未月癸亥日(旬空：子丑)，占定何罪，得“中孚之临”
yi: 如：未月癸亥日（旬空子、丑），占判定什么罪，得中孚卦变临卦。
en: For example: in the Wei month, on a Guihai day (Void: Zi and Chou), divining what charge would be fixed and getting Zhongfu changing to Lin.

zh: 但幸世临月建，木鬼虽动，又被酉金回头之克，外卦反吟，事必反复，虽定绞罪，终有改移。
果议绞罪，后蒙驳审从减（驳番拨活罪）。
yi: 木鬼临白虎，绞罪是定了！
但幸好世爻临月建，木鬼虽然发动，又被酉金回头之克，外卦反吟，事情一定反复，虽然定了绞罪，终究会有改动。
果然议的是绞罪，后来蒙驳回重审减轻。
en: Wood Pressure on the White Tiger means a sentence of strangulation is fixed!

But fortunately the Self sits on the Month, and though the Wood Pressure moves it is controlled by a turning-back control from You-metal, and the outer trigram is Reversed Chant, so the matter will surely go back and forth; though strangulation is fixed there will in the end be a change.
Indeed strangulation was recommended, and later the case was sent back for retrial and the sentence reduced.

title: 随鬼入墓章·占狱讼世旺脱离、占讼事世旺者得理：世旺的脱离牢狱，休囚空破的不免于凶；世旺的占讼得理，空破休囚被克的必遭刑狱

rule.yi: 占狱讼的，世爻旺相能够脱离，休囚空破的免不了凶；占讼事，世爻旺相的得理，空破休囚又被克的，必定遭受刑罚牢狱。
rule.en: In divining for prison and lawsuits, a strong Self can get free, while a resting, trapped, Void or broken Self cannot avoid ill; in divining for a suit, a strong Self is in the right, and a Void, broken, resting or trapped Self that is also controlled will surely suffer punishment and prison.

zh: 占狱讼者，世旺脱离，休囚空破者，不免于凶。
yi: 占狱讼的，世爻旺相能够脱离，休囚空破的免不了凶。
en: In divining for prison and lawsuits, a strong Self can get free, while a resting, trapped, Void or broken Self cannot avoid ill.

zh: 占讼事，世旺者得理，空破休囚被克者，必遭刑狱。
yi: 占讼事，世爻旺相的得理，空破休囚又被克的，必定遭受刑罚牢狱。
en: In divining for a suit, a strong Self is in the right, and a Void, broken, resting or trapped Self that is also controlled will surely suffer punishment and prison.

title: 随鬼入墓章·书中例，占已定重罪可蒙赦免否：世爻随鬼入动墓又动而化墓，古法断凶，作者断吉——日月生世、丑墓月破，破罗破网容易出来，断明年酉年蒙赦，果然次年辰月蒙赦而出；世爻入墓只验三种，旺相的不真，墓被日月动爻冲破的也不真

rule.yi: 我屡次验证而得验的，只有世爻入墓三种：一是世爻随鬼入日墓，一是世爻入动墓，一是世爻动而化墓。这三种墓，自占看世爻，世爻旺相的不是真；代占看用神，用神旺相的不是真；只有世爻、用爻休囚被克，又入墓的才是；墓神被日月动爻冲破的，也不是真。因为墓破就像破网，容易出来。书中例：未月戊辰日占已经判定的重罪能不能蒙赦免，得蛊卦变损卦：世爻随鬼入动墓，又动而化墓，古法认为凶，我断为吉：日月生世，丑墓被月破，破罗破网，容易出来，断明年酉年一定蒙赦；果然次年辰月蒙赦出来。
rule.en: What I have found borne out by repeated trial is that the Self entering the tomb is borne out in only three ways: the Self following Pressure into the tomb of the Day, the Self entering a moving tomb, and the Self moving and changing into the tomb. For these three tombs, in divining for oneself look at the Self, and a strong Self is not the real thing; in divining for someone else look at the Subject, and a strong Subject is not the real thing; it is real only when the Self or the Subject is resting, trapped or controlled and also enters the tomb; a tomb spirit clashed and broken by the Month or a moving line is not real either. For a broken tomb is like a broken net, and it is easy to get out. Worked example: in the Wei month, on a Wuchen day, a man divined whether a grave sentence already fixed could be pardoned, and got Gu changing to Sun: the Self follows Pressure into a moving tomb and also moves and changes into the tomb, which the old method calls ill, but I judged lucky: the Month and the Day give life to the Self, the Chou tomb is broken by the Month, a net broken is easy to leave, and I judged that next year, a You year, he would surely be pardoned; indeed in the Chen month of the next year he was pardoned and let out.

zh: 余因屡试而得验者，只验世爻入墓有三：一世爻随鬼入日墓，一世爻入动墓，一世爻动而化墓。
此三墓者，自占看世爻，世爻旺相者非真；
代占看用神，用神旺相者非真。
惟世爻、用爻休囚被克，而又入墓者为是也，墓神被日月动爻冲破者，亦不为真。
盖，墓破即如破网，容易而出也。
yi: 我屡次验证而得验的，只有世爻入墓三种：一是世爻随鬼入日墓，一是世爻入动墓，一是世爻动而化墓。
这三种墓，自占看世爻，世爻旺相的不是真；
代占看用神，用神旺相的不是真。
只有世爻、用爻休囚被克，又入墓的才是；墓神被日月动爻冲破的，也不是真。
因为墓破就像破网，容易出来。
en: What I have found borne out by repeated trial is that the Self entering the tomb is borne out in only three ways: the Self following Pressure into the tomb of the Day, the Self entering a moving tomb, and the Self moving and changing into the tomb.
For these three tombs, in divining for oneself look at the Self, and a strong Self is not the real thing;
in divining for someone else look at the Subject, and a strong Subject is not the real thing.
It is real only when the Self or the Subject is resting, trapped or controlled and also enters the tomb; a tomb spirit clashed and broken by the Month or a moving line is not real either.
For a broken tomb is like a broken net, and it is easy to get out.

zh: 又如：未月戊辰日(旬空：戌亥)，占已定重罪，可蒙赦免否？
yi: 又如：未月戊辰日（旬空戌、亥），占已经判定的重罪，能不能蒙赦免？
得蛊卦变损卦。
en: Another example: in the Wei month, on a Wuchen day (Void: Xu and Hai), divining whether a grave sentence already fixed could be pardoned:
the hexagram Gu changing to Sun.

zh: 世爻随鬼入动墓，又动而化墓，古以为凶，余以吉断。
日月生世，丑墓月破，破罗破网，容易而出，明岁酉年定蒙赦宥。
果于次年辰月，蒙赦而出。
yi: 世爻随鬼入动墓，又动而化墓，古法认为凶，我断为吉。
日月生世，丑墓遇月破，破罗破网，容易出来，断明年酉年一定蒙赦。
果然次年辰月蒙赦出来。
en: The Self follows Pressure into a moving tomb and also moves and changes into the tomb, which the old method calls ill, but I judged lucky.
The Month and the Day give life to the Self, the Chou tomb suffers the Month-break, a net broken is easy to leave, and I judged that next year, a You year, he would surely be pardoned.
Indeed in the Chen month of the next year he was pardoned and let out.

title: 五行相生章·书中例，弟占兄已得重罪母问能救否：兄弟爻为用神丑土兄动被日月克，明显大罪难脱，幸好丑土化出午火父母回头相生，化父母生兄爻相生为吉，断快快去办，后来蒙恩免死

rule.yi: 用神、元神，适宜逢生：有月建生、日建生、动爻生、动变回头生。书中例：卯月己卯日，弟弟占哥哥已经被判重罪，母亲来问能不能救，得复卦变震卦：兄弟爻为用神，丑土兄动，被日月克，明显大罪难脱，幸好兄爻丑土化出午火父母，回头相生；断说：赶快去办！化出父母去生兄爻，相生为吉，神灵告知得很明显，后来果然蒙恩免死。
