rule.en: The Subject and the Support should meet life: life from the Month, from the Day, from a moving line, or from a turning-back life by change. Worked example: in the Mao month, on a Jimao day, a younger brother divined for his elder brother, who had already been given a grave sentence, with the mother asking whether he could be saved, and got Fu changing to Zhen: the Peer line is the Subject, Chou-earth moves and is controlled by the Month and the Day, so it is plain that he cannot escape the great charge, but fortunately the Chou-earth Peer line changes into Wu-fire as Resource that turns back to give life; I judged: go and do it quickly! Resource changing out to give life to the Peer line, mutual life, is lucky and the spirits spoke clearly; afterwards he was indeed spared death by grace.

zh: 凡用神、元神，宜于逢生，有月建生、日建生、动爻生、动化回头生。
yi: 用神、元神，适宜逢生：有月建生、日建生、动爻生、动变回头生。
en: The Subject and the Support should meet life: life from the Month, from the Day, from a moving line, or from a turning-back life by change.

zh: 如：卯月己卯日(旬空：申酉)，弟占兄已得重罪，母叩问能救否？
yi: 如：卯月己卯日（旬空申、酉），弟弟占哥哥已经被判重罪，母亲来问能不能救？
得复卦变震卦。
en: For example: in the Mao month, on a Jimao day (Void: Shen and You), a younger brother divined for his elder brother, who had already been given a grave sentence, with the mother asking whether he could be saved:
the hexagram Fu changing to Zhen.

zh: 兄弟爻为用神，丑土兄动，日月克之，明现大罪难脱，幸兄爻丑土化午火父母回头相生。
化父母生兄爻，相生为吉，神告显然，后果蒙恩免死。
yi: 兄弟爻为用神，丑土兄动，被日月克，明显大罪难脱，幸好兄爻丑土化出午火父母，回头相生。
断说：赶快去办！
化出父母去生兄爻，相生为吉，神灵告知得很明显，后来果然蒙恩免死。
en: The Peer line is the Subject, Chou-earth moves and is controlled by the Month and the Day, so it is plain that he cannot escape the great charge, but fortunately the Chou-earth Peer line changes into Wu-fire as Resource that turns back to give life.
I judged: go and do it quickly!
Resource changing out to give life to the Peer line, mutual life, is lucky and the spirits spoke clearly; afterwards he was indeed spared death by grace.

title: 五行相克章·书中例，占父官事已拟重罪：外卦未土父母被卯月克，内卦亥卯未合成木局又克它，月克日刑全无救助，果然被重刑——有克无生

rule.yi: 忌神、仇神，适宜逢克：有月克、日克、动爻克、用神动化回头克。这四种，用神、元神只要逢一克，别处又见不到生扶的，就是凶兆；占吉事，乐极生悲；占凶事，须赶紧回避。书中例：卯月戊辰日占父亲的官事已经拟了重罪，得萃卦变同人卦：外卦未土父母，被卯月克它，内卦亥卯未合成木局又相克制，月克日刑，全无救助，果然被重刑。
rule.en: The Adversary and the enemy spirit should meet control: control by the Month, by the Day, by a moving line, or a turning-back control from the Subject's own change. In these four, if the Subject or the Support meets even one control and sees no life or support elsewhere, it is an ill sign; in divining for a lucky matter, joy brings sorrow; in divining for an ill matter, hurry to avoid it. Worked example: in the Mao month, on a Wuchen day, a man divined about his father's official matter, for which a grave sentence had already been drafted, and got Cui changing to Tongren: the Resource Wei-earth of the outer trigram is controlled by the Mao month, and the inner trigram Hai, Mao and Wei combine into a Wood frame that controls it again; controlled by the Month and punished by the Day, with no rescue at all, he was indeed severely punished.

zh: 有月克、日克、动爻克、用神动化回头克。
此四者，用神、元神但逢一克，他处不见生扶者，即为凶兆，占吉事，乐极生悲；
yi: 忌神、仇神，适宜逢克。
有月建克、日辰克、动爻克，以及用神动变出回头克。
这四种，用神、元神只要逢一克，别处又见不到生扶的，就是凶兆；占吉事，乐极生悲；
占凶事，须赶紧回避。
en: The Adversary and the enemy spirit should meet control.
Control by the Month, by the Day, by a moving line, or a turning-back control from the Subject's own change.
In these four, if the Subject or the Support meets even one control and sees no life or support elsewhere, it is an ill sign; in divining for a lucky matter, joy brings sorrow;
in divining for an ill matter, hurry to avoid it.

zh: 如：卯月戊辰日(旬空：戌亥)，占父官事，已拟重罪。
yi: 如：卯月戊辰日（旬空戌、亥），占父亲的官事已经拟了重罪。
得萃卦变同人卦。
en: For example: in the Mao month, on a Wuchen day (Void: Xu and Hai), divining about a father's official matter, for which a grave sentence had already been drafted.
The hexagram Cui changing to Tongren.

zh: 外卦未土父母，卯月克之，内卦亥卯未合成木局，又相克制，月克日刑，全无救助，果被重刑。
yi: 外卦未土父母，被卯月克它，内卦亥卯未合成木局又相克制，月克日刑，全无救助，果然被重刑。
en: The Resource Wei-earth of the outer trigram is controlled by the Mao month, and the inner trigram Hai, Mao and Wei combine into a Wood frame that controls it again; controlled by the Month and punished by the Day, with no rescue at all, he was indeed severely punished.

title: 五行相克章·书中例，妹占兄官事同前一案也拟重罪：申金兄弟爻为用神，巳火鬼动刑克申金，重罪定了；幸好辰日冲动戌土父母暗动生申，克处逢生，若有父母可以救他；后来因为父亲八十岁，援例告留免死——克处逢生

rule.yi: 同一天妹妹占哥哥的官事，和前一案一样，也拟了重罪，得否卦变讼卦：申金兄弟爻为用神，巳火官鬼发动，刑克申金，重罪是定了；幸好辰日冲动戌土父母，暗动去生申金，克处逢生，如果有父母，可以救他；后来因为他父亲八十岁了，援例告留，免了死罪。
rule.en: On the same day a younger sister divined about her elder brother's official matter, the same case as before, and a grave sentence had likewise been drafted; she got Pi changing to Song: the Peer line Shen-metal is the Subject, Pressure Si-fire moves and punishes or controls Shen-metal, so the grave charge is fixed; fortunately the Chen day clashes the Resource Xu-earth into secret motion, which gives life to Shen, life met within a control, and if there is a parent he can be saved; afterwards, because his father was eighty years old, an appeal for retention under the precedent saved him from death.

zh: 有月克、日克、动爻克、用神动化回头克。
此四者，用神、元神但逢一克，他处不见生扶者，即为凶兆，占吉事，乐极生悲；
yi: 忌神、仇神，适宜逢克。
有月建克、日辰克、动爻克，以及用神动变出回头克。
这四种，用神、元神只要逢一克，别处又见不到生扶的，就是凶兆；占吉事，乐极生悲；
占凶事，须赶紧回避。
en: The Adversary and the enemy spirit should meet control.
Control by the Month, by the Day, by a moving line, or a turning-back control from the Subject's own change.
In these four, if the Subject or the Support meets even one control and sees no life or support elsewhere, it is an ill sign; in divining for a lucky matter, joy brings sorrow;
in divining for an ill matter, hurry to avoid it.

zh: 同日（卯月戊辰日）妹占兄官事，同前一案，亦拟重罪。
yi: 同一天（卯月戊辰日），妹妹占哥哥的官事，和前一案一样，也拟了重罪。
得否卦变讼卦。
en: On the same day (the Mao month, a Wuchen day) a younger sister divined about her elder brother's official matter, the same case as before, and a grave sentence had likewise been drafted.
The hexagram Pi changing to Song.

zh: 申金兄弟爻为用神，巳火鬼动，刑克申金，重罪定矣。
幸喜辰日冲动戌土父母，暗动生申，克处逢生，若有父母，可以救之。
后因父年八旬，援例告留免死。
yi: 申金兄弟爻为用神，巳火官鬼发动，刑克申金，重罪是定了。
幸好辰日冲动戌土父母，暗动去生申金，克处逢生，如果有父母，可以救他。
后来因为他父亲八十岁了，援例告留，免了死罪。
en: The Peer line Shen-metal is the Subject, Pressure Si-fire moves and punishes or controls Shen-metal, so the grave charge is fixed.
Fortunately the Chen day clashes the Resource Xu-earth into secret motion, which gives life to Shen, life met within a control, and if there is a parent he can be saved.
Afterwards, because his father was eighty years old, an appeal for retention under the precedent saved him from death.

title: 何知章·失脱与盗贼的几句：遭贼是玄武临财而鬼旺有扶，见失脱是玄武带鬼而应爻发动，失衣裳是勾陈玄武入财乡，损六畜是白虎带鬼临所属，失牛是五爻丑鬼落空，失鸡是初爻带鬼玄武欺

rule.yi: 怎么知道人家遇上贼：玄武临在财爻，鬼爻又旺又有扶助。怎么知道人家丢了东西：玄武带着鬼爻，应爻发动。怎么知道人家丢了衣服：勾陈、玄武落在财的位置。怎么知道人家损了牲畜：白虎带着鬼爻，临在所属的位置。怎么知道人家丢了牛：五爻丑土鬼爻落空，令人发愁。怎么知道人家丢了鸡：初爻带鬼，又有玄武欺它。
rule.en: How do we know a household has met thieves? The Dark Tortoise sits on Wealth and Pressure is strong and supported. How do we know the household has lost things? The Dark Tortoise carries Pressure and the Other line moves. How do we know they have lost clothes? The Hook Earth and the Dark Tortoise enter the Wealth position. How do we know livestock will be lost? The White Tiger carries Pressure and sits on the line it belongs to. How do we know an ox is lost? The Pressure of the fifth line at Chou falls into the Void, and there is cause for worry. How do we know chickens are lost? The first line carries Pressure and the Dark Tortoise preys on it.

yi: 怎么知道人家遇上贼？
玄武临在财爻，鬼爻又旺又有扶助；
en: How do we know a household has met thieves?
The Dark Tortoise sits on Wealth and Pressure is strong and supported;

yi: 怎么知道人家丢了东西？
玄武带着鬼爻，应爻发动；
怎么知道人家丢了衣服？
勾陈、玄武落在财的位置；
怎么知道人家损了牲畜？
白虎带着鬼爻，临在所属的位置；
怎么知道人家丢了牛？
五爻丑土鬼爻落空，令人发愁；
怎么知道人家丢了鸡？
初爻带鬼，又有玄武欺它；
en: How do we know the household has lost things?
The Dark Tortoise carries Pressure and the Other line moves;
How do we know they have lost clothes?
The Hook Earth and the Dark Tortoise enter the Wealth position;
How do we know livestock will be lost?
The White Tiger carries Pressure and sits on the line it belongs to;
How do we know an ox is lost?
The Pressure of the fifth line at Chou falls into the Void, and there is cause for worry;
How do we know chickens are lost?
The first line carries Pressure and the Dark Tortoise preys on it;

chapter: 启蒙节要·四十六、六亲发动诀
title: 六亲发动诀、诸爻持世诀·失物句：父动失物逃亡要诉论，官鬼克兄弟失脱难寻多暗昧，财爻发动失物静安家未出，鬼爻持世财物时时忧失脱

rule.yi: 父母爻发动，丢了东西和逃走的人要靠告状追论；官鬼克兄弟，失脱的东西难找、多半说不清；财爻发动，失物安静不动，没有出家门；鬼爻持世，财物时常担忧失脱。
rule.en: When the Resource line moves, lost things and runaways must be pursued by lodging a complaint; when Pressure controls the Peer line, lost goods are hard to find and mostly murky; when the Wealth line moves and the lost thing is still and safe, it has not left the house; when Pressure holds the Self, one is forever worried about losing goods.

note.yi: 这四句分属两首诗：前三句出在「六亲发动诀」（父动、官鬼克兄弟、财爻发动三联），最后一句出在「诸爻持世诀」（鬼爻持世一联）。每句前面的六亲发动或持世是同一联的开头，没有拆进引文里。
note.en: These four lines come from two verses: the first three from the verse on the moving of the six relations (the couplets for Resource moving, Pressure controlling Peer, and Wealth moving) and the last from the verse on lines holding the Self (the couplet for Pressure holding the Self). The opening phrase naming the moving or holding relation in each couplet is not split into the quotation.

yi: 丢了东西和逃走的人要靠告状追论。
en: lost things and runaways must be pursued by lodging a complaint.

yi: 失脱的东西难找，多半说不清楚。
en: lost goods are hard to find and mostly murky.

yi: 失物安静不动，没有出家门，
en: the lost thing is still and safe, it has not left the house,

yi: 财物时常担忧失脱，
en: one is forever worried about losing goods,

chapter: 十八问答·第九问·用神不现
title: 十八问答·第九问·书中例，占逃仆：占仆以财爻为用神，卯木财伏在二爻午火之下，申金持世克制卯木故终不能逃，伏去生飞是泄气，盗去的财物都窝在炉火人家，断甲子日拿获，果然子日在窝赌的铁匠家申时拿获——应子日是冲克午火飞神、生起卯木伏神

rule.yi: 用神不上卦，看伏神在哪一爻之下，能出不能出，各有四种情形：日月生它、日月持它是一；飞神生伏神、动爻生它是二；日月动爻冲克飞神是三；飞神空破休囚、墓绝在日是四；这四种是有用的伏神。书中例：辰月丁巳日占逃走的仆人，得蹇卦：占仆人以财爻为用神，兑宫二爻卯木伏在本卦二爻午火之下，午火是飞神，卯木是伏神；现在申金持世克制卯木，终究不能逃走；但因为伏神去生飞神，叫做泄气，偷去的财物必定全窝在炉火人家，许他甲子日拿获；果然子日得到消息，在窝赌的铁匠家，申时拿到。应在子日，是冲克午火飞神、生起卯木伏神的缘故。《黄金策》说「伏无提挈终徒尔，飞不推开亦枉然」，这一卦的应验就是这样。
rule.en: When the Subject does not appear, look at which line the hidden spirit lies under; whether it can come out comes in four ways: the Month or the Day gives it life or holds it, which is one; the flying spirit gives life to the hidden one or a moving line gives it life, two; the Month, Day or a moving line clashes or controls the flying spirit, three; the flying spirit is Void, broken, resting, trapped, or in the tomb or extinct on the Day, four; these four are useful hidden spirits. Worked example: in the Chen month, on a Dingsi day, a man divined about a runaway servant and got Jian: in divining for a servant the Wealth line is the Subject; Mao-wood in the second line of the Dui palace is hidden under Wu-fire in the second line of the present hexagram, Wu-fire being the flying spirit and Mao-wood the hidden spirit; now Shen-metal holds the Self and controls Mao-wood, so he cannot in the end get away; but because the hidden spirit gives life to the flying one, which is called draining, the stolen goods are all harboured in a household with a furnace fire, and it was promised that he would be caught on the Jiazi day; indeed on the Zi day word came that he was at the house of a blacksmith who harboured gamblers, and he was taken in the Shen hour. It answered on the Zi day because Zi clashes and controls Wu-fire, the flying spirit, and raises up Mao-wood, the hidden spirit. The Huangjin Ce says "a hidden spirit without a lift is in vain in the end, and a flying spirit not pushed aside is futile all the same", and this hexagram bore it out.

note.yi: 「兑宫二爻卯木」指本卦所属宫（兑宫）的二爻，那一爻在本卦里伏在二爻午火之下；「窝」是窝藏，「炉火人家」按判词后文指铁匠。
note.en: "Mao-wood in the second line of the Dui palace" is the second line of the palace the hexagram belongs to, which in this hexagram lies hidden under the second-line Wu-fire; "harbour" is to shelter a criminal, and the household "with a furnace fire" is, as the later words of the judgement say, a blacksmith.

zh: 第九问：用神不现，看伏神在何爻之下，得出不得出，何以论之？
答曰：伏神得出者有四：盖日月生者、日月持之者一也；
飞神生伏、动爻生者二也；
日月动爻冲克飞神三也；
飞神空破休囚墓绝于日者四也。
yi: 第九问：用神不上卦，看伏神在哪一爻之下，能出不能出，怎么论？
回答说：伏神能出的有四种：日月生它、日月持它是第一种；
飞神生伏神、动爻生它是第二种；
日月动爻冲克飞神是第三种；
飞神空破休囚、墓绝在日是第四种。
这四种是有用的伏神。
en: Question 9: when the Subject does not appear, one looks at which line the hidden spirit lies under; how is it judged whether it can come out?
Answer: there are four ways a hidden spirit can come out: the Month or the Day gives it life or holds it, which is the first;
the flying spirit gives life to the hidden one or a moving line gives it life, the second;
the Month, Day or a moving line clashes or controls the flying spirit, the third;
the flying spirit is Void, broken, resting, trapped, or in the tomb or extinct on the Day, the fourth.
These four are useful hidden spirits.

hits.text: 飞神空破休囚墓绝者，六也

zh: 辰月丁巳日占逃仆，得蹇卦：
yi: 辰月丁巳日占逃走的仆人，得蹇卦：
en: In the Chen month, on a Dingsi day, a man divined about a runaway servant and got Jian:

zh: 断曰：占仆以财爻为用神，取兑卦二爻卯木伏于本卦二爻午火之下，午火为飞神，卯木为伏神。
今申金持世克制卯木，终不能逃；
但因伏去生飞名为泄气，盗去财物必尽窝于炉火之家，许甲子日拿获。
果于子日得信窝赌铁匠之家，申时拿获。
应子日者，冲克午火之飞神，生起卯木之伏神也。
yi: 断曰：占仆人以财爻为用神，兑宫二爻卯木伏在本卦二爻午火之下，午火是飞神，卯木是伏神。
现在申金持世克制卯木，终究不能逃走；
但因为伏神去生飞神，叫做泄气，偷去的财物必定全窝在炉火人家，许他甲子日拿获。
果然子日得到消息，在窝赌的铁匠家，申时拿到。
应在子日，是冲克午火飞神、生起卯木伏神的缘故。
en: Judgement: in divining for a servant the Wealth line is the Subject; Mao-wood in the second line of the Dui palace is hidden under Wu-fire in the second line of the present hexagram, Wu-fire being the flying spirit and Mao-wood the hidden spirit.
Now Shen-metal holds the Self and controls Mao-wood, so he cannot in the end get away;

but because the hidden spirit gives life to the flying one, which is called draining, the stolen goods are all harboured in a household with a furnace fire, and it was promised that he would be caught on the Jiazi day.
Indeed on the Zi day word came that he was at the house of a blacksmith who harboured gamblers, and he was taken in the Shen hour.
It answered on the Zi day because Zi clashes and controls Wu-fire, the flying spirit, and raises up Mao-wood, the hidden spirit.

zh: 《黄金策》云：“伏无提挈终徒尔，飞不推开亦枉然”，此卦应验是矣！
yi: 《黄金策》说：「伏无提挈终徒尔，飞不推开亦枉然」，这一卦的应验就是这样！
en: The Huangjin Ce says: "a hidden spirit without a lift is in vain in the end, and a flying spirit not pushed aside is futile all the same", and this hexagram bore it out!

chapter: 十八问答·第十一问·冲中逢合、合处逢冲
title: 十八问答·第十一问·书中例，占失银物可得复否：卦得六冲，未土财爻化午火回头生合，是失而复得之象；旁人说应爻持白虎金鬼、玄武临财难言复得，作者说应是他人、被午火回头克制，财为用神冲中逢合，日主合它，必得；应在巳火青龙原神旬空出空值日的乙巳日，果然得回

rule.yi: 合是聚、冲是散：冲中逢合，先散后聚，先失后得，先淡后浓；合处逢冲则相反。书中例：寅月戊戌日占丢失的银子和东西能不能失而复得，得巽卦变讼卦：卦得六冲，未土财爻化出午火，回头生合，是失而复得的象；旁人说，应爻持着白虎金鬼，玄武临在财爻，难说能得回；我说，应爻是他人，被午火回头克制，财爻是用神，冲中逢合，日辰又合它，管保一定得到；他问应在哪一天，我说，巳火青龙原神旬空，毛病在巳，必须等乙巳日原神出空值日，会得回；果然应验。
rule.en: A combination gathers and a clash scatters: a combination met within a clash first scatters and then gathers, first loses and then gains, first cool and then warm; a clash met at a combination is the reverse. Worked example: in the Yin month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined whether lost silver and goods could be recovered and got Xun changing to Song: the hexagram has six-clash, the Wealth Wei-earth changes into Wu-fire which gives life and combines in return, the image of lost and then regained; onlookers said that the Other holds the White Tiger and Metal Pressure and the Dark Tortoise sits on Wealth, so it is hard to say it will be recovered; I said that the Other is another person, controlled by Wu-fire in return, that Wealth is the Subject, met with a combination within a clash, with the Day also combining it, so it is bound to be had. He asked on what day, and I said: the Support, the Azure Dragon Si-fire, is Void, so the trouble lies in Si, and one must wait for the Yisi day when the Support comes out of the Void and rules; and indeed it was borne out.

zh: 第十一问：冲中逢合、合处逢冲，何以断其吉凶？
答曰：合者聚也，冲者散也，冲中逢合先散后聚，先失后得，先淡后浓；
yi: 第十一问：冲中逢合、合处逢冲，怎样断吉凶？
回答说：合是聚，冲是散，冲中逢合，先散后聚，先失后得，先淡后浓；
合处逢冲则相反。
en: Question 11: how are luck and ill judged for a combination within a clash and a clash within a combination?
Answer: a combination gathers and a clash scatters; a combination met within a clash first scatters and then gathers, first loses and then gains, first cool and then warm;
a clash met at a combination is the reverse.

zh: 寅月戊戌日，占失银物可得复否，得巽之讼卦：
yi: 寅月戊戌日，占丢失的银子和东西能不能失而复得，得巽卦变讼卦：
en: In the Yin month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined whether lost silver and goods could be recovered and got Xun changing to Song:

zh: 断曰：卦得六冲，未土财爻化午火回头生合，现失而复得之象。
旁人曰：应持白虎金鬼，玄武临财难言复得。
予曰：应是他人，被午火回头克制，财为用神，冲中逢合，日主合也，管许必得。
答曰：巳火青龙原神旬空，其病在巳，必待乙巳日原神出空值日，当许复得。
yi: 断语：卦得六冲，未土财爻化出午火，回头生合，是失而复得的象。
旁人说：应爻持着白虎金鬼，玄武临在财爻，难说能得回。
我说：应爻是他人，被午火回头克制，财爻是用神，冲中逢合，日辰又合它，管保一定得到。
他问：应在哪一天？
我说：巳火青龙原神旬空，毛病在巳，必须等乙巳日原神出空值日，会得回。
果然应验。
en: Judgement: the hexagram has six-clash, the Wealth Wei-earth changes into Wu-fire which gives life and combines in return, the image of lost and then regained.
Onlookers said: the Other holds the White Tiger and Metal Pressure and the Dark Tortoise sits on Wealth, so it is hard to say it will be recovered.
I said: the Other is another person, controlled by Wu-fire in return, Wealth is the Subject, met with a combination within a clash, with the Day also combining it, so it is bound to be had.
He asked: on what day?
I said: the Support, the Azure Dragon Si-fire, is Void, so the trouble lies in Si, and one must wait for the Yisi day when the Support comes out of the Void and rules, and it will be recovered.
And indeed it was borne out.

title: 逃亡·须察用爻方知实迹：占奴婢妻妾逃亡，用爻就是财爻，看它才知道人的实际去向

rule.yi: 宽容待人，众人会生出侮慢；严厉管人，逃亡就会发生，所以即使大圣人有容人的度量，也说小人难养。要知道逃走的人的实际去向，必须察看用爻。用爻，比如占奴仆、妻妾逃亡，就看财爻这一类。
rule.en: Treat people with leniency and the crowd turns insolent; manage them with severity and flight begins; hence even the great sage, for all his tolerance, said that petty people are hard to keep. To learn where the runaway has really gone, one must examine the Subject line; for example, in divining for the flight of a servant or a wife or concubine, one looks at the Wealth line and the like.

yi: 宽容地对待众人，轻慢侮辱就会加上来；
严厉地管人，逃亡就因此发生，
所以即使是大圣人有容人的度量，
还说小人难以养。
必须察看用爻，
才知道实际的踪迹。
en: Treat the crowd with leniency and insolence is added;
manage people with severity and flight arises from it,
so even the great sage, for all his tolerance,
said that petty people are hard to keep.
One must examine the Subject line,
and only then knows the true trail.

zh: 用爻者，如占奴卜妻妾逃亡，看财爻类也。
yi: 用爻，比如占奴仆、妻妾逃亡，就看财爻这一类。
en: The Subject line: for example, in divining for the flight of a servant or a wife or concubine, one looks at the Wealth line and the like.

title: 逃亡·若临午地必往南方、或化寅爻转移东北：用爻安静以所临之地定方向，用爻发动以变爻定方向

rule.yi: 用爻若落在午，逃的人必往南方；或者化出寅爻，就转移到东北。用爻安静，以它所临的地支作逃去的方向，所以说临午是南方；用爻发动，以变出的爻定方向；转移的意思是转往另一方，比如午变寅爻，一定先往正南，后往东北。
rule.en: If the Subject line sits on Wu, the runaway has gone south; or if it changes into a Yin line, he moves on to the northeast. A still Subject takes the branch it sits on as the direction of flight, hence Wu means south; a moving Subject takes the changed line to fix the direction; moving on means turning toward another quarter, so that Wu changing to Yin means he surely goes due south first and then to the northeast.

yi: 如果落在午地，
必定往南方；
或者化出寅爻，
就转移到东北。
en: If it sits on Wu,
he has surely gone south;
or if it changes into a Yin line,
he moves on to the northeast.

zh: 用爻安静，以所临之地为逃去之卦，故云临午是南方。
如用爻发动，以变爻定向；
转移者转往一方也，即如午变寅爻，定然先往正南，后往东北。
yi: 用爻安静，以它所临的地支作逃去的方向，所以说临午是南方。
如果用爻发动，以变出的爻定方向；
转移的意思是转往另一方，比如午变寅爻，一定先往正南，后往东北。
en: A still Subject line takes the branch it sits on as the direction of flight, hence "Wu means south".
If the Subject moves, the changed line fixes the direction;
moving on means turning toward another quarter, so that Wu changing to Yin means he surely goes due south first and then to the northeast.

title: 逃亡·木属震宫都邑京城之内、金居兑象庵观寺院之中：用爻临震宫木爻必在都邑，临九五必往京城，临兑宫金爻必躲在庵院寺观

rule.yi: 用爻属木、在震宫，人在都邑京城之内；属金、居兑宫，人在庵观寺院之中。用神如果临震宫木爻，必在都邑；如果临九五，必往京城；如果临兑宫金爻，必躲在庵院寺观之中。
rule.en: A Subject of Wood in the Zhen palace means he is in a city or the capital; of Metal in the Dui palace, in a nunnery, temple or monastery. If the Subject sits on a Wood line of the Zhen palace, he must be in a city; if it sits on the ninth in the fifth place, he must have gone to the capital; if it sits on a Metal line of the Dui palace, he must be hiding in a nunnery, temple or monastery.

yi: 木属震宫，
在都邑京城之内；
金居兑象，
在庵观寺院之中。
en: Wood belongs to the Zhen palace,
in a city or the capital;
Metal sits in the Dui image,
in a nunnery, temple or monastery.

zh: 用神如临震宫木爻，必在都邑；
如临九五，必往京城，如临兑宫金象，必避在庵院寺观之中。
yi: 用神如果临震宫木爻，必在都邑；
如果临九五，必往京城，如果临兑宫金象，必躲在庵院寺观之中。
en: If the Subject sits on a Wood line of the Zhen palace, he must be in a city;
if it sits on the ninth in the fifth place, he must have gone to the capital, and if it sits on a Metal image of the Dui palace, he must be hiding in a nunnery, temple or monastery.

title: 逃亡·鬼墓交重庙宇中间隐匿、休囚死绝坟陵左右潜藏：用爻持鬼墓必隐在庙宇，用爻临死绝必藏在坟墓左右

rule.yi: 用爻带着鬼墓、交重发动，人在庙宇中隐藏；用爻休囚死绝，人在坟陵左右潜藏。用爻持鬼墓，人必隐在庙宇之中；用爻临死绝，必藏身在坟墓左右。
rule.en: A Subject carrying the tomb of Pressure and moving means he hides within a temple; a Subject resting, trapped, dead or extinct means he lurks about the graves and mounds. A Subject holding the tomb of Pressure means he is hidden in a temple; a Subject on death or extinction means he is hiding by the graves.

yi: 鬼墓交重，
在庙宇中间隐藏；
休囚死绝，
在坟陵左右潜藏。
en: With the tomb of Pressure crowded with movement,
he hides within a temple;
resting, trapped, dead or extinct,
he lurks about the graves and mounds.

zh: 用持鬼墓，其人必隐庙宇之中；
用临死绝，必藏身于坟墓左右也。
yi: 用爻持鬼墓，人必隐在庙宇之中；
用爻临死绝，必藏身在坟墓左右。
en: A Subject holding the tomb of Pressure means he is hidden in a temple;
a Subject on death or extinction means he is hiding by the graves.

title: 逃亡·如逢四库当究五行：四库是辰戌丑未，辰是水土之库必在水边，戌是火库在寺庙旁，丑是金库在银铁匠家，未是木库在园林柴草间或木工竹匠家；遇墓爻要等冲破墓爻的日月才见得到

rule.yi: 如果遇到四库，要追究它的五行。四库就是辰戌丑未四个地支，用爻属木，卦里有未动一类。辰是水和土的库，人必在水边；戌是火库，在寺庙旁边；丑是金库，在银铁匠家；未是木库，在园林柴草之间，或木工竹匠家。凡是占逃亡盗贼，如果遇到墓爻，一定很难找到，要等冲破墓爻的日月才能见到。
rule.en: If the four storehouses are met, examine their element. The four storehouses are the branches Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei; the Subject line is of Wood, and the hexagram has something like an unmoved Wei. Chen is the storehouse of Water and Earth, and he must be by the water; Xu is the storehouse of Fire, by a temple; Chou is the storehouse of Metal, at the house of a silver or iron smith; Wei is the storehouse of Wood, among gardens, woods and brushwood, or at the house of a carpenter or bamboo worker. In divining for a runaway or a thief, if a tomb line is met he is surely hard to find, and he can be seen only in the month or day that clashes the tomb line open.

yi: 如果遇到四库，
应当追究五行。
en: If the four storehouses are met,
one should examine the element.

zh: 四库即辰戌丑未四支，用爻属木，卦有未动类。
如辰为水土库，必在水边；
未为木库，在园林柴草间，或木工蔑匠之家。
凡占逃亡盗贼，若遇墓爻，决难寻见，直待冲破墓爻日月，方可得见也。
yi: 四库就是辰戌丑未四个地支，用爻属木，卦里有未动一类。
辰是水和土的库，人必在水边；
戌是火库，在寺庙旁边；
丑是金库，在银铁匠家；
未是木库，在园林柴草之间，或木工竹匠家。
凡是占逃亡盗贼，如果遇到墓爻，一定很难找到，要等冲破墓爻的日月才能见到。
en: The four storehouses are the four branches Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei; the Subject line is of Wood, and the hexagram has something like an unmoved Wei.
Chen is the storehouse of Water and Earth, and he must be by the water;
Xu is the storehouse of Fire, by a temple;
Chou is the storehouse of Metal, at the house of a silver or iron smith;
Wei is the storehouse of Wood, among gardens, woods and brushwood, or at the house of a carpenter or bamboo worker.
In divining for a runaway or a thief, if a tomb line is met he is surely hard to find, and he can be seen only in the month or day that clashes the tomb line open.

title: 逃亡·倘伏五乡岂宜一类：卦里没有用神就看它伏在哪一爻之下，伏在鬼、父母、兄弟、财、子孙下，以及伏在鬼墓、财库下，各是不同的去处

rule.yi: 如果用神伏在五种六亲之下，怎么能一概而论。卦里没有用神，就要看它伏在哪一爻之下，才知道那个人在什么地方。伏在鬼爻下，在官仓官库之中，旺相又逢月建，在官户家，休囚无气，在公差吏役家；伏在父母下，在叔伯父母家，不然在手艺人家；伏在兄弟下，在兄弟姊妹和熟识朋友家；伏在财爻下，在奴婢妻妾家；伏在子孙下，在寺观和年幼辈那里。又比如伏在鬼墓之下，不在庙宇中就在寺庵内；伏在财库之下，不在仓库中，就在富豪家。
rule.en: If the Subject is hidden under one of the five relations, how can they all be judged alike? When the hexagram has no Subject, look at which line it is hidden under, and one learns where the person is. Hidden under Pressure, he is in a government granary or storehouse; if strong and also on the Month, in the house of an official family, if resting or without breath, in the house of a clerk or runner. Hidden under Resource, he is at the house of an uncle or parent, otherwise at a craftsman's. Hidden under Peer, he is at the house of brothers and sisters or of acquaintances and friends. Hidden under Wealth, he is at the house of servants, wives or concubines. Hidden under Output, he is at a temple or among the young. Again, hidden under the tomb of Pressure, he is either in a temple or in a nunnery; hidden under the storehouse of Wealth, he is either in a warehouse or at a wealthy family's.

yi: 倘若伏在五种六亲之下，
怎么能一概而论？
en: If it is hidden under one of the five relations,
how can they all be judged alike?

zh: 卦无用神，须看伏在何爻下，便知其人在于何处。
如伏鬼爻，在官仓官库之中，旺加月建在官户家，休囚无气在公吏家；
伏父母下，在叔伯父母家，不然在手艺人家；
伏兄下，在兄弟姊妹及相识朋友家；
伏子下在寺观及卑幼处也。
又如伏于鬼墓下，不在庙宇中则在寺庵内；
又如伏于财库下，不在仓库中，即在富豪家也。
yi: 卦里没有用神，就要看它伏在哪一爻之下，才知道那个人在什么地方。
伏在鬼爻下，在官仓官库之中，旺相又逢月建，在官户家，休囚无气，在公差吏役家；
伏在父母下，在叔伯父母家，不然在手艺人家；
伏在兄弟下，在兄弟姊妹和熟识朋友家；
伏在财爻下，在奴婢妻妾家；
伏在子孙下，在寺观和年幼辈那里。
又比如伏在鬼墓之下，不在庙宇中就在寺庵内；
又比如伏在财库之下，不在仓库中，就在富豪家。
en: When the hexagram has no Subject, look at which line it is hidden under, and one learns where the person is.

Hidden under Pressure, he is in a government granary or storehouse; if strong and also on the Month, in the house of an official family, if resting or without breath, in the house of a clerk or runner;
hidden under Resource, he is at the house of an uncle or parent, otherwise at a craftsman's;
hidden under Peer, he is at the house of brothers and sisters or of acquaintances and friends;
hidden under Wealth, he is at the house of servants, wives or concubines;
hidden under Output, he is at a temple or among the young.
Again, hidden under the tomb of Pressure, he is either in a temple or in a nunnery;
hidden under the storehouse of Wealth, he is either in a warehouse or at a wealthy family's.

title: 逃亡·木兴水象定乘舟楫而逃：用爻属木在坎宫发动必乘船逃去，木化水、水化木、木在水宫动、水在木宫动都是

rule.yi: 木发动而见水象，一定是乘船逃走。用爻属木在坎宫发动的，必定乘船逃去；木化水，水化木，或者木在水宫发动，水在木宫发动，都是这样。
rule.en: If Wood moves and a Water image appears, he has surely fled by boat. A Subject of Wood moving in the Kan palace means he has gone by boat; so too Wood changing to Water, Water changing to Wood, Wood moving in a Water palace, or Water moving in a Wood palace.

yi: 木发动而见水象，
一定是乘船逃走。
en: If Wood moves and a Water image appears,
he has surely fled by boat.

zh: 用爻属木在坎宫动者，必乘舟逃去；
木化水，水化木，或木在水宫动，水在木宫动者皆然。
yi: 用爻属木在坎宫发动的，必定乘船逃去；
木化水，水化木，或者木在水宫发动，水在木宫发动，都是这样。
en: A Subject of Wood moving in the Kan palace means he has gone by boat;
so too Wood changing to Water, Water changing to Wood, Wood moving in a Water palace, or Water moving in a Wood palace.

title: 逃亡·动合伏财必拐妇人而去：用爻发动去合本宫的财爻，那人必定拐带妇人逃走；财伏在世爻下是妻妾，伏在应爻下是邻家妇女

rule.yi: 用爻发动，去和伏着的财爻相合，一定是拐带妇人逃走。用爻发动来与本宫的财爻合，那人必定拐带妇人逃去；财爻如果伏在世爻之下，必是自己的妻妾；伏在应爻之下，是邻居家的妇女。
rule.en: If the Subject moves and combines with a hidden Wealth line, he has surely run off with a woman. A Subject that moves to combine with the Wealth line of its own palace means he has run off with a woman; if Wealth is hidden under the Self, it is surely his own wife or concubine, and if under the Other, a woman of a neighbouring family.

yi: 动而合伏着的财爻，
必定拐带妇人而去。
en: Moving to combine with a hidden Wealth line,
he has surely run off with a woman.

zh: 用爻动来与本宫财爻作合，其人必拐妇人逃去。
财若伏于世下，必是妻妾；
在应爻下，乃是邻家妇女。
yi: 用爻发动来与本宫的财爻合，那人必定拐带妇人逃去。
财爻如果伏在世爻之下，必是妻妾；
伏在应爻之下，是邻居家的妇女。
en: A Subject that moves to combine with the Wealth line of its own palace means he has run off with a woman.
If Wealth is hidden under the Self, it is surely a wife or concubine;
if under the Other, a woman of a neighbouring family.

title: 逃亡·内近外远生世则终有归期：用爻在本宫内卦人在本地，本宫外卦在别府别县，他宫内卦在外县交界，他宫外卦在他府外县，在六爻则去远方；最喜生合持世，人虽去，日后自己回来，寻也容易见到

rule.yi: 内卦近、外卦远；用爻生世爻，终究有回来的日子。用爻在本宫内卦，人在本地；在本宫外卦，在别的府县；在他宫内卦，在外县交界处；在他宫外卦，在他府外县；如果在上爻，已经去了远方。最喜欢用爻生合持世，那人虽然走了，日后会自己回来，去找也容易找到。
rule.en: The inner trigram is near and the outer far; if the Subject gives life to the Self, there is in the end a day of return. A Subject in the inner trigram of its own palace means he is still in the locality; in the outer trigram of its own palace, in another prefecture or county; in the inner trigram of another palace, at the border of another county; in the outer trigram of another palace, in another prefecture and county; if on the top line, he has gone far away. Best of all is the Subject giving life to or combining with the Self or holding the Self: though he has gone, he will come back of himself later, and a search finds him easily.

yi: 内卦近外卦远，
用爻生世爻，终究有回来的日子。
en: The inner trigram is near and the outer far,
and if the Subject gives life to the Self, there is in the end a day of return.

zh: 用爻在本宫卦内，人在本地；
在本宫外卦，在别府别县；
他宫内卦，在外县交界处；
最喜生合持世，其人虽去，日后当自归来，寻亦易见也。
yi: 用爻在本宫内卦，人在本地；
在本宫外卦，在别的府县；
在他宫内卦，在外县交界处；
在他宫外卦，在他府外县；
如果在上爻，已经去了远方。
最喜欢用爻生合持世，那人虽然走了，日后会自己回来，去找也容易找到。
en: A Subject in the inner trigram of its own palace means he is still in the locality;
in the outer trigram of its own palace, in another prefecture or county;
in the inner trigram of another palace, at the border of another county;
in the outer trigram of another palace, in another prefecture and county;
if on the top line, he has gone far away.
Best of all is the Subject giving life to or combining with the Self or holding the Self: though he has gone, he will come back of himself later, and a search finds him easily.

title: 逃亡·静易动难坐空则必无寻路：用爻不动人容易找，动了就迁移无常、指东说西或改名换姓，难找；落旬空则杳无踪迹

rule.yi: 用爻静容易找，动则难找；用爻落空就一定没有找的门路。用爻不动，那人容易找到；发动则迁移不定，指东说西，甚至改名换姓，必然难找。如果落了空亡，杳无踪迹。
rule.en: A still Subject is easy and a moving one hard; a Subject that falls into the Void leaves no way to search at all. If the Subject does not move, the man is easy to find; if it moves, he shifts about without fixed course, pointing east and saying west or even changing his name, and he is surely hard to find. If it falls into the Void, there is no trace of him.

yi: 用爻静容易找，动则难找；
落了空，则一定没有可找的路。
en: A still Subject is easy and a moving one hard;
if it falls into the Void, there is no way to search at all.

zh: 用爻不动，其人易寻，动则迁移无常，指东言西，或更改名姓，必难寻觅。
yi: 用爻不动，那人容易找到；发动则迁移不定，指东说西，甚至改名换姓，必然难找。
如果落了空亡，杳无踪迹。
en: If the Subject does not move, the man is easy to find; if it moves, he shifts about without fixed course, pointing east and saying west or even changing his name, and he is surely hard to find.
If it falls into the Void, there is no trace of him.

title: 逃亡·合起合住若非容隐即相留：用爻静逢合是合起、动逢合是合住，日辰动爻合起用神，必有窝藏容留的人，看合爻定是什么人，合爻与世冲克的决不会来报

rule.yi: 合起或合住，不是容留隐藏就是挽留他。用爻静遇合是合起，用爻动遇合是合住；如果日辰或动爻合起用神，必有窝藏容忍留住他的人。要知道留他的是什么人，用合爻来定，比如合爻在子孙是僧道，在父母是尊长一类。合爻与世爻冲克的，决不会来报信。
rule.en: Combined up or combined shut, either he is sheltered and hidden or he is held. A still Subject meeting a combination is combined up; a moving Subject meeting a combination is combined shut; if the Day or a moving line combines the Subject up, someone must be sheltering, tolerating and keeping him. To know who keeps him, fix it by the combining line: on Output it is a monk or Daoist, on Resource an elder, and so on. A combining line that clashes or controls the Self will never come to report.

yi: 合起合住，
不是容留隐藏就是挽留他。
en: Combined up or combined shut,
either he is sheltered and hidden or he is held.

zh: 用静逢合则合起，用动逢合则合住；
若日辰动爻合起用神，必有窝藏容忍相留。
要知相留容忍之人，以合爻定之，如在子孙为僧道，父母为尊长类。
合爻与世冲克，决不来报。
yi: 用爻静遇合是合起，用爻动遇合是合住；
如果日辰或动爻合起用神，必有窝藏容忍留住他的人。
要知道留他的是什么人，用合爻来定，比如合爻在子孙是僧道，在父母是尊长一类。
合爻与世爻冲克的，决不会来报信。
en: A still Subject meeting a combination is combined up; a moving Subject meeting a combination is combined shut;
if the Day or a moving line combines the Subject up, someone must be sheltering, tolerating and keeping him.
To know who keeps him, fix it by the combining line: on Output it is a monk or Daoist, on Resource an elder, and so on.
A combining line that clashes or controls the Self will never come to report.

title: 逃亡·冲动冲开不是使令当败露：静爻逢冲是冲动、动爻逢冲是冲开，用爻被动爻日辰冲动，家里必有人指使他逃，比如父母是尊长一类

rule.yi: 冲动或冲开，不是有人使唤他逃的，就是事情要败露。静爻遇冲是冲动，动爻遇冲是冲开。用爻被动爻或日辰冲动，家里必有人指使他逃亡，比如是父母，就是尊长一类。
rule.en: Clashed into motion or clashed open, either someone sent him off or the matter will be exposed. A still line meeting a clash is clashed into motion, and a moving line meeting a clash is clashed open. If the Subject is clashed into motion by a moving line or the Day, someone in the household must have put him up to running off; if it is Resource, an elder and the like.

yi: 冲动冲开，
不是有人使唤他逃的，就是事情要败露。
en: Clashed into motion or clashed open,
either someone sent him off or the matter will be exposed.

zh: 静爻逢冲为冲动，动爻逢冲为冲开。
用爻遇动爻日辰冲动，家中必有人使令逃亡者，如父母，是尊长类。
yi: 静爻遇冲是冲动，动爻遇冲是冲开。
用爻被动爻或日辰冲动，家里必有人指使他逃亡，比如是父母，就是尊长一类。
en: A still line meeting a clash is clashed into motion, and a moving line meeting a clash is clashed open.
If the Subject is clashed into motion by a moving line or the Day, someone in the household must have put him up to running off; if it is Resource, an elder and the like.

title: 逃亡·动爻刑克有人阻彼登程、日建生扶有伴纠他同去：用爻逢冲是被人喝破，遇克是被人捉住，有扶有并有生是有人约他同去；这些刑克之爻与世有情的必定来报信

rule.yi: 动爻刑克用爻，有人阻止他上路；日建生扶用爻，有同伴拉他一起走。用爻遇冲，是被人喝破；遇克，是被人捉住；有扶、有并、有生，是有人约他同去。以上这些刑克的爻如果和世爻有情，必定来告诉我。
rule.en: If a moving line punishes or controls the Subject, someone stops him from setting out; if the Day Branch gives life to or supports it, a companion draws him along. A Subject meeting a clash means he is shouted down; meeting control, he is caught; with support, with parity, or with life, someone invites him to go along. If the punishing and controlling lines above have feeling toward the Self, they will surely come to tell me.

yi: 动爻刑克用爻，
有人阻止他上路；
日建生扶用爻，
有同伴拉他一起走。
en: If a moving line punishes or controls the Subject,
someone stops him from setting out;
if the Day Branch gives life to or supports it,
a companion draws him along.

zh: 有扶有并有生，有人纠他同去。
以上刑克等爻与世有情，必来报我。
yi: 用爻遇冲，是被人喝破；
遇克，是被人捉住；
有扶、有并、有生，是有人约他同去。
以上这些刑克的爻如果和世爻有情，必定来告诉我。
en: A Subject meeting a clash means he is shouted down;
meeting control, he is caught;
with support, with parity, or with life, someone invites him to go along.
If the punishing and controlling lines above have feeling toward the Self, they will surely come to tell me.

title: 逃亡·间爻作合原中必定知情：间爻是原来的保人，没有保人就看邻里，间爻与用爻相合必知内情，再与世爻冲克，必是这个人诱他走的

rule.yi: 间爻与用爻相合，当初的中人必定知道内情。间爻是原来的保人，没有保人，就按邻居来断。间爻如果和用爻相合，必定知道内情；再和世爻冲克，一定是这个人把他诱走的。
rule.en: If a line between the Self and the Other combines with the Subject, the original go-between surely knows what happened. The between lines are the original guarantor; where there was no guarantor, judge by the neighbours. If a between line combines with the Subject, it surely knows the inside story; and if it also clashes or controls the Self, this person must be the one who lured him away.

yi: 间爻作合，
当初的中人必定知道内情。
en: If a between line forms a combination,
the original go-between surely knows what happened.

zh: 间爻为原保人，无保，以邻里断之。
如与用爻相合，必知其情，更与世爻冲克，必是此人诱去。
yi: 间爻是原来的保人，没有保人，就按邻居来断。
如果和用爻相合，必定知道内情，再和世爻冲克，一定是这个人把他诱走的。
en: The between lines are the original guarantor; where there was no guarantor, judge by the neighbours.
If one combines with the Subject, it surely knows the inside story; and if it also clashes or controls the Self, this person must be the one who lured him away.

title: 逃亡·世应相生路上须当撞见：世应都动而相冲，在路上撞见，用爻与世爻动冲也一样；世爻动克用爻或世旺应衰必然擒拿，应旺世衰或用爻克世，即使遇见也捉不住

rule.yi: 世爻和应爻相生，路上应当会撞见。世应都动而相冲，在路上撞见；用爻和世爻发动相冲也是这样。世爻动而克用爻，或者世旺应衰，必然擒获；应旺世衰，或者用爻克世，即使能遇见，也捉不住他。
rule.en: If the Self and the Other give life to each other, you should run into him on the road. Self and Other both moving and clashing: you meet on the road; so too when the Subject and the Self move and clash. If the Self moves and controls the Subject, or the Self is strong and the Other weak, he is surely seized; if the Other is strong and the Self weak, or the Subject controls the Self, though you may meet him you cannot catch him.

yi: 世爻和应爻相生，
路上应当会撞见。
en: If the Self and the Other give life to each other,
you should run into him on the road.

zh: 世应俱动相冲，在途撞见，用爻与世动冲亦然。
世爻动克用爻或世旺应衰，必然擒拿；
应旺世衰或用爻克世，虽能遇见，不能捕之。
yi: 世应都动而相冲，在路上撞见，用爻和世爻发动相冲也是这样。
世爻动而克用爻，或者世旺应衰，必然擒获；
应旺世衰，或者用爻克世，即使能遇见，也捉不住他。
en: Self and Other both moving and clashing: you meet on the road; so too when the Subject and the Self move and clash.
If the Self moves and controls the Subject, or the Self is strong and the Other weak, he is surely seized;
if the Other is strong and the Self weak, or the Subject controls the Self, though you may meet him you cannot catch him.

title: 逃亡·无冲无破居六位则一去不回、有克有生在五爻则半途仍走：用爻不受刑冲克害又不生合世爻、世爻也不克它，逃者不想回、找的人也见不到；动爻日辰克制用爻是可擒之兆，变出的爻反生合用爻则被捕后仍逃走

rule.yi: 用爻没有冲没有破、落在上爻，就一去不回；有克有生、在五爻，就半路上仍然会走。用爻不受刑冲克害，又不生合世爻，世爻也不克它，是逃的人不想念着回来、找的人见不到的象，是一去不回之象。如果动爻或日辰克制用爻，是能擒获的兆头；如果变出的爻反过来生合用爻，捕获之后仍会逃走。
rule.en: With no clash and no break and the Subject on the top line, he goes and never returns; with control and life and the Subject on the fifth line, he slips away again halfway. A Subject that suffers no punishment, clash, control or harm, gives no life or combination to the Self, and is not controlled by the Self, is the image of a runaway who does not think of returning and a searcher who cannot see him, the image of going and never coming back. If a moving line or the Day controls the Subject, it is a sign he can be seized; if a changed line gives life to or combines with the Subject, he escapes again even after being caught.

yi: 没有冲没有破，落在上爻，
就一去不回；
有克有生，在五爻，
就半路上仍然会走。
en: With no clash and no break, on the top line,
he goes and never returns;
with control and life, on the fifth line,
he slips away again halfway.

zh: 用爻不受刑冲克害，又不生合世爻，而世爻不克用爻者，是逃者不思妇，寻者不得见，乃一去不回之象。
若动爻日辰克制用爻，是可擒之兆；
若遇变出之爻反生合用爻者，诸生捕后仍被逃走。
yi: 用爻不受刑冲克害，又不生合世爻，世爻也不克它，是逃的人不想念着回来、找的人见不到的象，是一去不回之象。
如果动爻或日辰克制用爻，是能擒获的兆头；
如果变出的爻反过来生合用爻，捕获之后仍会逃走。
en: A Subject that suffers no punishment, clash, control or harm, gives no life or combination to the Self, and is not controlled by the Self, is the image of a runaway who does not think of returning and a searcher who cannot see him, the image of going and never coming back.
If a moving line or the Day controls the Subject, it is a sign he can be seized;
if a changed line gives life to or combines with the Subject, he escapes again even after being caught.

title: 逃亡·主象化出主象归亦难留：卦里有用爻不宜化退神，叫化去，难以捕获；被世爻、动爻、日辰克制，即使捉回来也留不久

rule.yi: 用神变出用神，就是回来也难留住。卦里有用爻，不宜化出退神，叫做化去，必定难以捕获；如果被世爻、动爻、日辰克制，即使捉回来之后也难以长久留住。
rule.en: If the Subject changes into the Subject, even if he returns he is hard to keep. When the hexagram has a Subject line, it should not change into a Retreating spirit, which is called changing away, and he is surely hard to catch; if it is controlled by the Self, a moving line or the Day, even after he is brought back he is hard to keep for long.

yi: 用神变出用神，
回来也难以留住。
en: If the Subject changes into the Subject,
even if he returns he is hard to keep.

zh: 卦有用爻，不宜化退神，谓之化去，必难捕获；
若被世爻、动爻、日辰克制，纵捉回之后亦难久留。
yi: 卦里有用爻，不宜化出退神，叫做化去，必定难以捕获；
如果被世爻、动爻、日辰克制，即使捉回来之后也难以长久留住。
en: When the hexagram has a Subject line, it should not change into a Retreating spirit, which is called changing away, and he is surely hard to catch;
if it is controlled by the Self, a moving line or the Day, even after he is brought back he is hard to keep for long.

title: 逃亡·本宫化入本宫去应不远：本宫卦变成本宫卦（如乾变姤、遁、否、观），人逃在本地，必不远走；用爻在他宫发动又化入他宫，是走远了又转了方向

rule.yi: 本宫变入本宫，逃去的地方应当不远。本宫仍然变成本宫的卦，比如乾卦变姤、遁、否、观等本宫卦，主那人逃在本地，必不会走远；如果用爻在他宫发动，又变入他宫，是远去之后又转了方向。
rule.en: If the palace changes into its own palace, the place he fled to should not be far. A palace changing into a hexagram of its own palace, for example Qian changing into Gou, Dun, Pi or Guan and the like, means the man fled within the locality and surely has not gone far; if the Subject moves in another palace and changes into yet another palace, he has gone far and then turned in another direction.

yi: 本宫变入本宫，
逃去的地方应当不远。
en: If the palace changes into its own palace,
the place he fled to should not be far.

zh: 本宫仍化本宫卦者，譬如乾卦化入姤、遵、否、观等本宫卦也，主其人逃在本处地方，必不远出；
若用爻在他宫动而又化入他宫者，远去又转方也。
yi: 本宫仍然变成本宫的卦，比如乾卦变姤、遁、否、观等本宫卦，主那人逃在本地，必不会走远；
如果用爻在他宫发动，又变入他宫，是远去之后又转了方向。
en: A palace changing into a hexagram of its own palace, for example Qian changing into Gou, Dun, Pi or Guan and the like, means the man fled within the locality and surely has not gone far;
if the Subject moves in another palace and changes into yet another palace, he has gone far and then turned in another direction.

title: 逃亡·归魂卦用遇生合不捕而自回、游魂卦应又交重能潜而会遁：得归魂卦他回家心切，生合世爻他自己会回来，寻也容易见；得游魂卦他没有回来的意思，能躲会逃，寻必难见

rule.yi: 归魂卦、用神遇到生合，不用捕他自己会回来；游魂卦、应爻又交重发动，他能潜伏，会逃遁。得归魂卦，他回来的心意急切，如果生合世爻，他一定自己回来，找他容易见到；遇到游魂卦，那人必定没有回来的意思，能潜伏会逃遁，找他必定难见。
rule.en: In a Returning Soul hexagram, if the Subject meets life or combination, he comes back by himself without being caught; in a Wandering Soul hexagram, with the Other also crowded with movement, he can lie low and slip away. In a Returning Soul hexagram his mind is eager to return, and if it gives life to or combines with the Self he surely comes back himself and is easily found; in a Wandering Soul hexagram the man surely has no mind to return, he can lie low and slip away, and a search for him is surely in vain.

yi: 归魂卦，用神遇到生合，
不用捕他自己会回来；
游魂卦，应爻又交重发动，
他能潜伏，会逃遁。
en: In a Returning Soul hexagram, if the Subject meets life or combination,
he comes back by himself without being caught;
in a Wandering Soul hexagram, with the Other also crowded with movement,
he can lie low and slip away.

zh: 得归魂卦，彼意归切，若生合世爻者，彼必自归，寻之易见；
遇游魂卦，其人必无归意，能潜会遁，寻必难见。
yi: 得归魂卦，他回来的心意急切，如果生合世爻，他一定自己回来，找他容易见到；
遇到游魂卦，那人必定没有回来的意思，能潜伏会逃遁，找他必定难见。
en: In a Returning Soul hexagram his mind is eager to return, and if it gives life to or combines with the Self he surely comes back himself and is easily found;
in a Wandering Soul hexagram the man surely has no mind to return, he can lie low and slip away, and a search for him is surely in vain.

title: 逃亡·父母空亡杳无音信：父母主音信，逢空就没有信，若动来生世合世，必有报信的人来

rule.yi: 父母爻落空亡，杳无音信。父母爻主音信，遇空就没有信息；如果父母发动来生世爻、合世爻，一定有报信的人来。
rule.en: If the Resource line falls into the Void, there is no word at all. The Resource line governs news, and meeting the Void it brings no news; if it moves to give life to or combine with the Self, someone will surely come to bring word.

yi: 父母爻落空亡，杳无音信
en: If the Resource line falls into the Void, there is no word at all

zh: 父母主信，逢空则无信，如动来生世合世，定有报信人来也。
yi: 父母爻主音信，遇空就没有信息；如果父母发动来生世爻、合世爻，一定有报信的人来。
en: The Resource line governs news, and meeting the Void it brings no news; if it moves to give life to or combine with the Self, someone will surely come to bring word.

title: 逃亡·子孙发动当有维持：子孙临身世，逃走自然顺利，得日辰生合世爻必有人维持，即使有逆事也不能为害——这是逃亡者自己占

rule.yi: 子孙发动，会有人维持。子孙临在身爻或世爻，逃去自然顺利；如果得到日辰生合世爻，必定有人维持，即使有不顺的事也不能为害。这是说逃亡的人自己占卜。
rule.en: When Output moves there will be support. Output on the Body or the Self means his flight goes smoothly of itself; if the Day gives life to or combines with the Self, someone will surely support him, and even adverse things cannot harm him. This speaks of the runaway divining for himself.

yi: 子孙爻发动，应当有人维持
en: When Output moves there should be someone to support him

zh: 子孙临身世，自然去必顺利；
如得日辰生合世爻，必有维持，纵有逆事不能为害。
yi: 子孙临在身爻或世爻，逃去自然顺利；
如果得到日辰生合世爻，必定有人维持，即使有不顺的事也不能为害。
这是说逃亡的人自己占卜。
en: Output on the Body or the Self means his flight goes smoothly of itself;
if the Day gives life to or combines with the Self, someone will surely support him, and even adverse things cannot harm him.
This speaks of the runaway divining for himself.

title: 逃亡·众煞伤身窃恐反遭刑辱：动爻、变爻、日月刑冲克害世爻是重煞伤身，反而遭受刑罚，不逃的好——逃亡者自己占

rule.yi: 许多凶煞伤害身，恐怕反而遭受刑罚和羞辱。动爻、变爻、日月刑冲克害世爻，叫做重煞伤身，反而遭受刑罚，不逃为吉。
rule.en: With many baleful influences injuring the Body, one fears he will instead suffer punishment and disgrace. When moving lines, changed lines, the Month and the Day punish, clash, control or harm the Self, it is called heavy baleful influences injuring the Body, and he will instead suffer punishment; it is lucky not to flee.

yi: 许多凶煞伤害身，
恐怕反而遭受刑罚和羞辱。
en: With many baleful influences injuring the Body,
one fears he will instead suffer punishment and disgrace.

zh: 动变日月刑冲克害世爻者，谓重煞伤身也，反遭刑，不逃者吉。
yi: 动爻、变爻、日月刑冲克害世爻，叫做重煞伤身，反而遭受刑罚，不逃为吉。
en: When moving lines, changed lines, the Month and the Day punish, clash, control or harm the Self, it is called heavy baleful influences injuring the Body, and he will instead suffer punishment; it is lucky not to flee.

title: 逃亡·动兄持世必然广费赀财：兄弟持世，费钱才能寻到、也要费钱才能逃；再加玄武旺而发动克世，要防有人劫骗

rule.yi: 兄弟动而持世，一定要花费很多钱财。兄弟持世，花钱可以找到，花钱可以逃走；如果再加上玄武旺而发动、克世爻，要防有人劫掠欺骗。
rule.en: If a Peer line moves and holds the Self, it will surely cost a great deal of money. With a Peer line holding the Self, spending money lets him be found and spending money lets him flee; if the Dark Tortoise is added, strong and moving to control the Self, beware of someone robbing or cheating.

yi: 兄弟动而持世，
一定要花费很多钱财。
en: A Peer line moving and holding the Self,
will surely cost a great deal of money.

zh: 兄弟持世，费财可寻，费财可逃。
若加玄武旺动克世，须防有人劫骗。
yi: 兄弟持世，花钱可以找到，花钱可以逃走；
如果再加上玄武旺而发动、克世爻，要防有人劫掠欺骗。
en: With a Peer line holding the Self, spending money lets him be found and spending money lets him flee;
if the Dark Tortoise is added, strong and moving to control the Self, beware of someone robbing or cheating.

title: 逃亡·父动变官必得公人捕捉：父母化官鬼、官鬼化父母，或官父都发动，必须写状子告官，差捕快才能捕获

rule.yi: 父母发动变出官鬼，一定要靠公差来捕捉。父母化官鬼、官鬼化父母，或者官鬼父母都发动，必须写状告官，差遣捕快才能捕获。
rule.en: If the Resource line moves and changes into Pressure, he must be caught by officers of the law. Resource changing into Pressure, Pressure changing into Resource, or Pressure and Resource both moving, require a complaint to be filed with the officials and constables sent, and then he can be caught.

yi: 父母发动变出官鬼，
一定要靠公差来捕捉。
en: If the Resource line moves and changes into Pressure,
he must be caught by officers of the law.

zh: 父化官、官化父，或官父俱动，必须兴词告官，差捕可获也。
yi: 父母化官鬼、官鬼化父母，或者官鬼父母都发动，必须写状告官，差遣捕快才能捕获。
en: Resource changing into Pressure, Pressure changing into Resource, or Pressure and Resource both moving, require a complaint to be filed with the officials and constables sent, and then he can be caught.

title: 逃亡·世投入墓须防窝主拘留：世爻入墓，反而被拘留人的运气拖住，或日后有灾病

rule.yi: 世爻自己入墓，要提防窝藏的人把你拘留住。凡是遇到世爻入墓，反而被扣留的人的运势拖住，或者后来有灾病。
rule.en: If the Self itself enters the tomb, beware of the harbourer detaining you. Whenever the Self enters the tomb, you are instead dragged down by the fortunes of the person held, or fall into calamity or illness later.

yi: 世爻自己入墓，
要提防窝藏的人把你拘留住。
en: If the Self itself enters the tomb,
beware of the harbourer detaining you.

zh: 凡遇世爻入墓者，反被拘留人之运，或后有灾病。
yi: 凡是遇到世爻入墓，反而被扣留的人的运势拖住，或者后来有灾病。
en: Whenever the Self enters the tomb, you are instead dragged down by the fortunes of the person held, or fall into calamity or illness later.

title: 逃亡·世应比和不空必潜于此：占逃的人在不在这里，要世应生合、比合用爻，用爻出现不落空，他就必定潜伏在此

rule.yi: 世应比和而且不空，他必定潜伏在这里。凡是占逃走的人在不在这里，必须世爻应爻生合、比合用爻，用爻出现而且不落空，他必然潜伏在这里。
rule.en: If the Self and the Other are in harmony and not Void, he is surely lying low here. In divining whether a runaway is at this place, the Self and the Other must give life to, combine with or match the Subject, and the Subject must appear and not fall into the Void; then he is surely lying low here.

yi: 世应比和而且不空，
他必定潜伏在这里。
en: If the Self and the Other are in harmony and not Void,
he is surely lying low here.

zh: 凡卜逃人在此处否，须得世应生合、比合用爻，出现不空，必然潜于此也。
yi: 凡是占逃走的人在不在这里，必须世应生合、比合用爻，用爻出现而且不落空，他必然潜伏在这里。
en: In divining whether a runaway is at this place, the Self and the Other must give life to, combine with or match the Subject, and the Subject must appear and not fall into the Void; then he is surely lying low here.

title: 逃亡·世应空亡独发徒费乎心：世空则去找的不紧，用空则找也找不到，世应都空必定白跑一趟；兄弟独发是虚假不实，也找不到

rule.yi: 世应都空亡、独自发动，是白费心思。世爻空，去找的人不上心；用爻空，找也找不到；世应都空，必定没有可找的地方，空回一趟。兄弟独自发动，是虚假不实，也找不到。
rule.en: With the Self and the Other both Void and one moving alone, it is a waste of effort. If the Self is Void, the searcher does not press the search; if the Subject is Void, he is not found however one searches; with both Void there is surely no place to search and he returns empty-handed. A Peer line moving alone means falsehood and nothing real, and he is not found either.

yi: 世应都空亡、独自发动，
是白费心思。
en: With the Self and the Other both Void and one moving alone,
it is a waste of effort.

zh: 世空则去寻不紧，用空则寻亦不见，世应俱空，必主无可寻处空回。
兄弟独发，虚诈不实，亦寻不见也。
yi: 世爻空，去找的人不上心；用爻空，找也找不到；世应都空，必定没有可找的地方，空回一趟。
兄弟独自发动，是虚假不实，也找不到。
en: If the Self is Void, the searcher does not press the search; if the Subject is Void, he is not found however one searches; with both Void there is surely no place to search and he returns empty-handed.
A Peer line moving alone means falsehood and nothing real, and he is not found either.

title: 失脱·要知失物得失须详妻财：财爻是所失之物的主象，冲中逢合所失必可得，合处逢冲既失不能复得

rule.yi: 百姓饥寒，常有翻墙钻洞的人，不要忘了检点约束，也多有遗失的忧虑。要知道其中的得失，必须详察卦上的妻财。财爻是所失之物的主象：如果得到冲中逢合，所失一定可以得回；如果是合处逢冲，既然失去就不能再得回了。
rule.en: Common people suffer hunger and cold, and there are often those who climb walls and dig through them; never forget to check and restrain, for there is also a worry of loss. To know the gain or loss in it, one must examine the Wealth line on the hexagram. The Wealth line is the principal image of the thing lost: if a combination is met within a clash, what is lost can surely be got back; if a clash is met at a combination, once lost it cannot be got back.

yi: 居民饥寒，
常有翻墙钻洞的人，
不要忘了检点约束，
也多有遗失的忧虑。
要知道其中的得失，
必须详察卦上的妻财
en: Common people suffer hunger and cold,
there are often those who climb walls and dig through them,
never forget to check and restrain,
for there is also a worry of loss.
To know the gain or loss in it,
one must examine the Wealth line on the hexagram

zh: 财爻为所失物之主，如得冲中逢合，失必可得，如合处逢冲，既失不能复得矣。
yi: 财爻是所失之物的主象：如果得到冲中逢合，所失一定可以得回；如果是合处逢冲，既然失去就不能再得回了。
en: The Wealth line is the principal image of the thing lost: if a combination is met within a clash, what is lost can surely be got back; if a clash is met at a combination, once lost it cannot be got back.

title: 失脱·自空化空皆当置而不问、日旺月旺总未散而可得：用爻自己落空或动而化空都难寻见；财爻值月令或在日辰生旺之地，物未散可寻

rule.yi: 用爻自己空、或变成空，都应当搁下不问；财爻日旺月旺，东西总是没有散失，可以得回。用爻自己落空，或发动而化空，都难找到；如果财爻值月令，或在日辰生旺之地，这件东西没有散失，可以找。
rule.en: A Subject that is Void itself or changes into the Void should be set aside and not pursued; a Wealth line strong on the Day and the Month means the thing has not been scattered and can be got back. A Subject that is Void itself, or moves and changes into the Void, is hard to find; if the Wealth line is on the Month command, or on a place of life and strength on the Day, the thing has not been scattered and can be sought.

yi: 用爻自己空、
或变成空，都应当搁下不问；
日旺月旺，
东西总是没有散失，可以得回。
en: A Subject that is Void itself,
or that changes into the Void, should be set aside and not pursued;
strong on the Day and strong on the Month,
the thing has not been scattered and can be got back.

zh: 用爻自空或动化空，皆难寻见；
若财值月令，或在日辰生旺之地，此物未散可寻也。
yi: 用爻自己落空，或发动而化空，都难找到；
如果财爻值月令，或在日辰生旺之地，这件东西没有散失，可以找。
en: A Subject that is Void itself, or moves and changes into the Void, is hard to find;
if the Wealth line is on the Month command, or on a place of life and strength on the Day, the thing has not been scattered and can be sought.

title: 失脱·内卦本宫搜索家庭可见、他宫外卦追来邻里能知：财在本宫内卦物未出家门，在他宫外卦物已出外难得，在间爻可到邻居家寻

rule.yi: 财在本宫内卦，在家里搜索可以找到；财在他宫外卦，到邻居那里追问能知道下落。财在本宫内卦，东西没有出家门，可以找到；财在他宫外卦，东西已经出外，难得回；财在间爻，邻居人家可以去找。
rule.en: With Wealth in the inner trigram of its own palace, a search of the household can find it; with Wealth in the outer trigram of another palace, inquiring among the neighbours can learn where it went. Wealth in the inner trigram of its own palace means the thing has not left the house and can be found; Wealth in the outer trigram of another palace means the thing has gone out and is hard to get back; Wealth on a between line means the neighbours' houses can be searched.

yi: 财在本宫内卦，
在家里搜索可以找到；
财在他宫外卦，
到邻居那里追问能知道下落。
en: With Wealth in the inner trigram of its own palace,
a search of the household can find it;
with Wealth in the outer trigram of another palace,
inquiring among the neighbours can learn where it went.

zh: 财在本宫内卦，其物未出家庭，可见；
财在他宫外卦，物已出外，难得；
yi: 财在本宫内卦，东西没有出家门，可以找到；
财在他宫外卦，东西已经出外，难得回；
财在间爻，邻居人家可以去找。
en: Wealth in the inner trigram of its own palace means the thing has not left the house and can be found;
Wealth in the outer trigram of another palace means the thing has gone out and is hard to get back;
Wealth on a between line means the neighbours' houses can be searched.

title: 失脱·五路四门、六乃栋梁阁上：这是大略的说法，用神在五爻到道路上找，在四爻到门户找，在上爻到梁上阁上找，不可拘泥

rule.yi: 五爻是道路，四爻是门，上爻是栋梁和阁楼上。这是就六爻说个大概：用神在五爻，要到道路上找；在四爻，到门户那里找；在上爻，到梁上、阁上找。学的人不可拘泥，应当灵活。
rule.en: The fifth line is the road and the fourth the door, and the top line is the beams and the loft. This speaks of the six lines in rough outline: with the Subject on the fifth line, search the road; on the fourth, the doors; on the top line, the beams and the loft. The student must not be rigid but should be flexible.

yi: 五爻是道路，四爻是门，
上爻是栋梁和阁楼上。
en: The fifth line is the road and the fourth the door,
and the top line is the beams and the loft.

zh: 学者不可执泥，宜当活泼。
yi: 这是就六爻说个大概。
用神在五爻，要到道路上找；
在四爻，到门户那里找；
在上爻，到梁上、阁上找。
学的人不可拘泥，应当灵活。
en: This speaks of the six lines in rough outline.
With the Subject on the fifth line, search the road;
on the fourth, the doors;
on the top line, the beams and the loft.
The student must not be rigid but should be flexible.

title: 失脱·初井二灶三为闺阃房中：用神临初爻子亥在水井中找，二爻在灶前找，三爻在房内找，伏在三爻鬼爻下在神堂内找

rule.yi: 初爻是水井，二爻是灶，三爻是内室房中。比如用神临初爻子、亥，可以在水井中找；在二爻，可以在灶前找；在三爻，可以在房内找；如果伏在三爻官鬼之下，可以在神堂内找。
rule.en: The first line is the well, the second the hearth, and the third the inner chamber. For example, a Subject on the first line at Zi or Hai can be sought in the well; on the second line, before the hearth; on the third, in the room; if hidden under the Pressure of the third line, in the shrine hall.

yi: 初爻是水井，二爻是灶，
三爻是内室房中。
en: The first line is the well, the second the hearth,
and the third the inner chamber.

zh: 如用临初爻子亥，水井中可寻；
如伏三爻官鬼下，神堂内可寻。
yi: 比如用神临初爻子、亥，可以在水井中找；
在二爻，可以在灶前找；
在三爻，可以在房内找；
如果伏在三爻官鬼之下，可以在神堂内找。
en: For example, a Subject on the first line at Zi or Hai can be sought in the well;
on the second line, before the hearth;
on the third, in the room;
if hidden under the Pressure of the third line, in the shrine hall.

title: 失脱·水失于池、木乃柴薪之内、土埋在地、金为砖石之间：财临水在池沼，临木在竹木柴薪内，临金旺相在铜锡铁器中、休囚在缸缺罐瓶内，外卦旺相在砖石内、休囚在瓦砾中

rule.yi: 属水的失在水池，属木的在柴薪之内，属土的埋在地里，属金的在砖石之间。财爻临水，东西在池沼；临木，在竹木树林柴薪内；临金旺相，在铜锡铁器中，休囚，在缸口破损的罐瓶内；外卦旺相，在砖石内，休囚，在瓦砾中，诸如此类。
rule.en: What is of Water is lost in a pool, what is of Wood is among firewood, what is of Earth is buried in the ground, and what is of Metal is between bricks and stones. Wealth on Water means the thing is in a pond or marsh; on Wood, among bamboo, timber, trees and firewood; on Metal, strong, among copper, tin and iron vessels, resting or trapped, in a chipped jar or bottle; in the outer trigram, strong, in bricks and stones, resting or trapped, in rubble and the like.

yi: 属水的失在水池，
属木的在柴薪之内，
属土的埋在地里，
属金的在砖石之间。
en: What is of Water is lost in a pool,
what is of Wood is among firewood,
what is of Earth is buried in the ground,
and what is of Metal is between bricks and stones.

zh: 财临木爻，竹木树林柴薪内；
财临金爻旺相，在铜锡铁器中，休囚，缸缺罐瓶内。
外卦旺相，砖石内，休囚，瓦砾中之类。
yi: 财爻临水，东西在池沼；
临木，在竹木树林柴薪内；
临金旺相，在铜锡铁器中，休囚，在缸口破损的罐瓶内。
外卦旺相，在砖石内，休囚，在瓦砾中，诸如此类。
en: Wealth on Water means the thing is in a pond or marsh;
on Wood, among bamboo, timber, trees and firewood;
on Metal, strong, among copper, tin and iron vessels, resting or trapped, in a chipped jar or bottle.
In the outer trigram, strong, in bricks and stones, resting or trapped, in rubble and the like.

title: 失脱·动入墓中财深藏而不见：用爻入墓、化墓或伏在墓下，东西必在器物中，要等冲开墓的日子才见

rule.yi: 用爻发动入墓中，财物深藏而看不见。如果用爻入墓、化墓，或伏在墓爻之下，东西必定在器物之中，想知道哪天找到，要等到冲开墓的日子。
rule.en: If the Subject moves into the tomb, the goods are deeply hidden and not seen. If the Subject enters the tomb, changes into the tomb, or is hidden under the tomb line, the thing is surely inside some container, and to know the day it turns up, wait for the day that clashes the tomb open.

yi: 发动入墓中，
财物深藏而看不见。
en: Moving into the tomb,
the goods are deeply hidden and not seen.

zh: 倘用爻入墓化墓，或伏墓下，必在器物中，要知何日见，待到冲墓之日。
yi: 如果用爻入墓、化墓，或伏在墓爻之下，东西必定在器物之中，想知道哪天找到，要等到冲开墓的日子。
en: If the Subject enters the tomb, changes into the tomb, or is hidden under the tomb line, the thing is surely inside some container, and to know the day it turns up, wait for the day that clashes the tomb open.

title: 失脱·静临世上物尚在而何妨：占失脱用爻不宜动，动就有变更；静而持世、生世、合世，东西都没有散，必容易找到，生旺不空更好

rule.yi: 安静而临在世爻上，东西还在，有什么妨碍。占失脱，用爻不适宜发动，发动就有更变；如果得到安静持世，生世合世，东西都主没有散失，必定容易找到，生旺不空尤其好。
rule.en: Still and sitting on the Self, the thing is still there, so what harm? In divining for lost goods the Subject should not move, for moving brings change; if it is still and holds the Self, or gives life to or combines with the Self, the thing is not scattered and is surely easy to find, and best of all if it is strong and not Void.

yi: 安静而临在世爻上，
东西还在，有什么妨碍。
en: Still and sitting on the Self,
the thing is still there, so what harm?

zh: 凡占失脱，用爻不宜动，动有更变。
若得安静持世，生世合世，其物皆主未散，必易寻得，生旺不空尤妙。
yi: 占失脱，用爻不适宜发动，发动就有更变。
如果得到安静持世，生世合世，东西都主没有散失，必定容易找到，生旺不空尤其好。
en: In divining for lost goods the Subject should not move, for moving brings change.
If it is still and holds the Self, or gives life to or combines with the Self, the thing is not scattered and is surely easy to find, and best of all if it is strong and not Void.

title: 失脱·鬼墓爻临必在坟边墓侧：用神临鬼墓，东西必在寺庙中，无气则在坟墓内，本宫内卦的在柩旁或座席上，加螣蛇恐在神图佛像之前，在三爻在香火堂中

rule.yi: 鬼爻的墓爻临上，东西必定在坟边墓侧。用神临鬼墓，东西必定在寺庙中，无气则在坟墓内，如果是本宫内卦，就在棺旁，或在座席上；再加螣蛇，恐怕在神像佛像之前；在三爻，在香火堂中之类。
rule.en: If the tomb line of Pressure appears, the thing is surely beside a grave or tomb. A Subject on the tomb of Pressure means the thing is in a temple, or if without breath, in a tomb; if it is in the inner trigram of its own palace, beside a coffin or on a seat; with the Coiling Snake added, perhaps before a picture of a god or a Buddha image; on the third line, in an incense hall and the like.

yi: 鬼爻的墓爻临上，
东西必定在坟边墓侧。
en: If the tomb line of Pressure appears,
the thing is surely beside a grave or tomb.

zh: 用临鬼墓，其物必在寺庙中，无气则在坟墓内，如系本宫内卦，则在柩旁，或在座席上。
更加螣蛇，恐在神图佛像之前。
yi: 用神临鬼墓，东西必定在寺庙中，无气则在坟墓内，如果是本宫内卦，就在棺旁，或在座席上。
再加螣蛇，恐怕在神像佛像之前。
在三爻，在香火堂中之类。
en: A Subject on the tomb of Pressure means the thing is in a temple, or if without breath, in a tomb; if it is in the inner trigram of its own palace, beside a coffin or on a seat.
With the Coiling Snake added, perhaps before a picture of a god or a Buddha image.
On the third line, in an incense hall and the like.

title: 失脱·日辰合住定然器掩遮藏：用爻发动遇日辰合住，必有东西遮盖藏着；冲中逢合必得，合处逢冲难寻

rule.yi: 日辰合住，东西一定被器物掩盖遮藏。用爻发动遇到日辰合住，必定有东西遮藏着；冲中逢合一定得到，合处逢冲难找。
rule.en: If the Day combines it shut, the thing is surely covered and hidden by some vessel. A Subject that moves and meets the Day combining it shut is surely covered and hidden by something; a combination met within a clash is surely got, a clash met at a combination is hard to find.

yi: 日辰合住，
东西一定被器物掩盖遮藏。
en: If the Day combines it shut,
the thing is surely covered and hidden by some vessel.

zh: 用爻发动遇日辰合住，必然有物遮藏，冲中逢合必得，合处逢冲难寻。
yi: 用爻发动遇到日辰合住，必定有东西遮藏着，冲中逢合一定得到，合处逢冲难找。
en: A Subject that moves and meets the Day combining it shut is surely covered and hidden by something; a combination met within a clash is surely got, a clash met at a combination is hard to find.

title: 失脱·子福变妻财须探鼠穴、酉地逢福德当检鸡栖：财化福、福化财，东西必在禽兽的窝巢里，子是老鼠衔去，寅是猫、丑是牛栏、午是马厩、未是羊圈、酉是鸡栖、亥是猪圈；有合在里面，没有合在旁边

rule.yi: 子孙变成妻财，要去探老鼠洞；酉地遇到福德，应当查看鸡窝。财化福、福化财，东西必定在禽兽的窝巢里：值子爻，是老鼠衔去，更在初爻，在地洞里；寅是猫衔走，丑在牛栏，午在马厩，未在羊圈，酉在鸡窝，亥在猪圈。有合，在里面；没有合，在旁边。
rule.en: Output changing into Wealth, one must probe the rat holes; Output meeting You ground, one should check the chicken roost. Wealth changing into Output, or Output changing into Wealth, means the thing is surely in the den or nest of some bird or beast: on Zi, a rat has carried it off, and still more on the first line, in a hole in the ground; Yin is a cat carrying it off, Chou the cattle pen, Wu the horse stall, Wei the sheep pen, You the chicken roost, Hai the pigsty. With a combination it is inside; without a combination it is nearby.

yi: 子孙变成妻财，
要去探老鼠洞；
酉地遇到福德，
应当查看鸡窝。
en: Output changing into Wealth,
one must probe the rat holes;
Output meeting You ground,
one should check the chicken roost.

zh: 财化福、福化财，其物必在禽兽巢窟中，如值子爻，是鼠衔去，更在初爻，在地穴。
寅是猫衔，丑在牛栏，午在马厩，未在羊牢，酉在鸡栖，亥在猪圈是也。
有合则在内，无合则在旁。
yi: 财化福、福化财，东西必定在禽兽的窝巢里：值子爻，是老鼠衔去，更在初爻，在地洞里。
寅是猫衔走，丑在牛栏，午在马厩，未在羊圈，酉在鸡窝，亥在猪圈。
有合，在里面；没有合，在旁边。
en: Wealth changing into Output, or Output changing into Wealth, means the thing is surely in the den or nest of some bird or beast: on Zi, a rat has carried it off, and still more on the first line, in a hole in the ground.
Yin is a cat carrying it off, Chou the cattle pen, Wu the horse stall, Wei the sheep pen, You the chicken roost, Hai the pigsty.
With a combination it is inside; without a combination it is nearby.

title: 失脱·鬼在空中世动则自家所失：卦里没有官鬼或官鬼落空，而世爻发动，是自己遗失的，不是被人偷去

rule.yi: 官鬼落空、世爻发动，就是自己家里丢失的。卦里没有官鬼或官鬼落空而世爻发动，是自己遗失，不是被人偷去。
rule.en: If Pressure falls into the Void and the Self moves, it is lost by oneself. When the hexagram has no Pressure or Pressure falls into the Void and the Self moves, one lost it oneself and it was not stolen by anyone.

yi: 官鬼落空、世爻发动，
就是自己家里丢失的。
en: With Pressure in the Void and the Self moving,
it is lost by oneself.

zh: 卦无官或落空而世爻动者，乃自遗失，非被人偷去也。
yi: 卦里没有官鬼或官鬼落空而世爻发动，是自己遗失，不是被人偷去。
en: When the hexagram has no Pressure or Pressure falls into the Void and the Self moves, one lost it oneself and it was not stolen by anyone.

title: 失脱·财伏应下世合则假贷于人：官鬼或空或伏或死绝不动，而财临应上或伏应下，是自己借给了别人；借给谁用应爻所临的六亲定

rule.yi: 财爻伏在应爻下、又与世爻合，是借给别人了。官鬼落空、或伏藏、或死绝不动，而财爻临在应爻上或伏在应爻下，就是自己借给别人的。要知道借给了谁，用应爻所临的六亲来定，比如临子孙，是年幼晚辈一类。
rule.en: If Wealth is hidden under the Other and combines with the Self, it has been lent to someone. If Pressure is Void, hidden, or dead or extinct and still, while Wealth sits on the Other or is hidden under it, one lent it to someone oneself. To know whom, fix it by the relation the Other sits on; on Output, for example, it is a younger person.

yi: 财爻伏在应爻下、
又与世爻合，是借给别人了。
en: With Wealth hidden under the Other,
and combining with the Self, it has been lent to someone.

zh: 官鬼或空或伏，或死绝不动，而财临应上或伏应下，乃自借于人也。
要知何人假借，以应临六亲定之，如临子为卑幼类。
yi: 官鬼落空、或伏藏、或死绝不动，而财爻临在应爻上或伏在应爻下，就是自己借给别人的。
要知道借给了谁，用应爻所临的六亲来定，比如临子孙，是年幼晚辈一类。
en: If Pressure is Void, hidden, or dead or extinct and still, while Wealth sits on the Other or is hidden under it, one lent it to someone oneself.
To know whom, fix it by the relation the Other sits on; on Output, for example, it is a younger person.

title: 失脱·若伏子孙当在僧房道院、如伏父母必遗衣笈书箱：用神不上卦就看它伏在哪里；伏子孙下在寺院或年幼者处，伏父母下在正屋或尊长处，没有合在衣服书卷中、有合在衣箱书箱内，伏兄弟下在兄弟姊妹或朋友处

rule.yi: 若伏在子孙之下，应当在僧房道院；如果伏在父母之下，必定遗落在衣箱书箱里。用神不上卦，就要找它伏在什么地方。伏在子孙爻下，东西在寺院或年幼者那里；伏在父母下，东西在正屋中，或在尊长那里，没有合在衣服书卷中，有合在衣箱书箱内；伏在兄弟下，在本宫是兄弟姊妹处，在他宫是熟识朋友处。
rule.en: If it is hidden under Output, it should be in a monk's cell or a Daoist temple; if it is hidden under Resource, it was surely left in a clothes trunk or a book box. When the Subject is not on the hexagram, find where it is hidden. Hidden under Output, the thing is at a temple or with the young; hidden under Resource, in the main house or with an elder, among clothes and books if without a combination, in a clothes trunk or a book box if with a combination; hidden under Peer, with brothers and sisters if in its own palace, with acquaintances and friends if in another palace.

yi: 若伏在子孙之下，
应当在僧房道院；
如果伏在父母之下，
必定遗落在衣箱书箱里。
en: If it is hidden under Output,
it should be in a monk's cell or a Daoist temple;
if it is hidden under Resource,
it was surely left in a clothes trunk or a book box.

zh: 用神不上卦，须寻伏于何处。
若伏子孙爻下，物在寺院或卑幼处。
如伏父母下，物在正屋中，或在尊长处。
无合衣服书卷中，有合衣箱书箱内。
若伏兄下，本宫兄弟姊妹处，他宫相识朋友处。
yi: 用神不上卦，就要找它伏在什么地方。
伏在子孙爻下，东西在寺院或年幼者那里；
伏在父母下，东西在正屋中，或在尊长那里。
没有合在衣服书卷中，有合在衣箱书箱内。
伏在兄弟下，在本宫是兄弟姊妹处，在他宫是熟识朋友处。
en: When the Subject is not on the hexagram, find where it is hidden.
Hidden under Output, the thing is at a temple or with the young;
hidden under Resource, in the main house or with an elder.
Among clothes and books if without a combination, in a clothes trunk or a book box if with a combination.
Hidden under Peer, with brothers and sisters if in its own palace, with acquaintances and friends if in another palace.

title: 失脱·在内则家中失脱、在外则他处遗亡：用爻在内卦，东西失在家中；在外卦，失在别处

rule.yi: 用神在内卦，是家中丢失；在外卦，是在别处遗失。
rule.en: A Subject in the inner trigram means it was lost at home; in the outer trigram, it was lost elsewhere.

yi: 在内卦，就是家中丢失，
在外卦，就是在别处遗失。
en: In the inner trigram, it was lost at home,
in the outer trigram, it was lost elsewhere.

yi: 用爻在卦内，失在家中；
在外卦，失在别处。
en: A Subject in the inner trigram means it was lost at home;
in the outer trigram, it was lost elsewhere.

title: 失脱·财伏逢冲必是移物动：财爻伏在卦中，遇动爻日辰暗冲，若鬼爻衰弱安静，是东西被人挪动了，不是被偷

rule.yi: 财伏遇冲，一定是东西被人挪动。财爻伏在卦中，遇到动爻或日辰暗中冲它，如果鬼爻衰弱安静，东西是被人移动了，不是人偷的。
rule.en: Wealth hidden and meeting a clash means the thing was surely moved by someone. If the Wealth line is hidden in the hexagram and is secretly clashed by a moving line or the Day, and the Pressure line is weak and still, the thing was moved by someone and not stolen.

yi: 财伏遇冲，
一定是东西被人挪动。
en: Wealth hidden and meeting a clash,
the thing was surely moved by someone.

zh: 财伏卦中，遇动爻日辰暗冲者，若鬼爻衰静，其物被人移动，非人偷也。
yi: 财爻伏在卦中，遇到动爻或日辰暗中冲它，如果鬼爻衰弱安静，东西是被人移动了，不是人偷的。
en: If the Wealth line is hidden in the hexagram and is secretly clashed by a moving line or the Day, and the Pressure line is weak and still, the thing was moved by someone and not stolen.

title: 失脱·鬼兴出现定为贼窃人偷：鬼不上卦或落空、衰绝不动都不是人偷，游魂卦多是忘记，鬼爻变动才是人偷

rule.yi: 官鬼发动出现，一定是贼偷人窃。官鬼不上卦或落了空亡，或衰绝不动，都不是人偷的；游魂卦，多半是忘记了；如果鬼爻变动，才是被人偷了。
rule.en: Pressure appearing and moving means it was surely stolen by a thief. If Pressure is not on the hexagram, falls into the Void, or is weak, extinct and still, it was not stolen; in a Wandering Soul hexagram it is mostly forgotten; only if the Pressure line changes and moves was it stolen by someone.

yi: 官鬼发动出现，
一定是贼偷人窃。
en: Pressure appearing and moving,
it was surely stolen by a thief.

zh: 鬼不上卦或落空亡，或衰绝不动，皆不是人偷；
yi: 官鬼不上卦或落了空亡，或衰绝不动，都不是人偷的；
游魂卦，多半是忘记了；
如果鬼爻变动，才是被人偷了。
en: If Pressure is not on the hexagram, falls into the Void, or is weak, extinct and still, it was not stolen;
in a Wandering Soul hexagram it is mostly forgotten;
only if the Pressure line changes and moves was it stolen by someone.

title: 失脱·阴女阳男内卦则家人可决、生壮墓老他宫则外贼无疑：鬼爻属阳男偷属阴女偷，生旺是壮年、墓绝是老人、胎养是小儿、带害是病人；本宫内卦是家人，他宫内卦是借住的人或异姓人，他宫是外贼

rule.yi: 阴是女、阳是男，在内卦，家里的人可以断定；生壮、墓老，在他宫，外贼无疑。鬼爻属阳，是男子偷；属阴，是女人偷；阴化阳，是女的偷给男的；阳化阴，是男的偷了寄给女的。生旺是壮年人，墓绝是老年人，胎养是小孩偷，带害是有病的人偷。本宫内卦是家中人偷，他宫内卦是住在宅上的借居人偷，或是家中异姓的人偷。
rule.en: Yin is female and Yang is male; in the inner trigram the person of the household can be decided; Life and strength, Tomb and age, in another palace, there is no doubt it is an outside thief. A Pressure line of Yang means a man stole it; of Yin, a woman; Yin changing to Yang, a woman stole it for a man; Yang changing to Yin, a man stole it and sent it to a woman. In life and strength it is a man in his prime, in tomb or extinction an old person, in the womb or nurture a child, and with harm a sick person. In the inner trigram of its own palace it is a person of the household; in the inner trigram of another palace, a lodger on the premises or a person of another surname in the household.

yi: 阴是女、阳是男，在内卦，
家里的人可以断定；
生壮、墓老，
在他宫，外贼无疑。
en: Yin is female and Yang is male, in the inner trigram,
the person of the household can be decided;
in life and strength, in tomb and age,
in another palace, there is no doubt it is an outside thief.

zh: 生旺壮年人，墓绝老年人，胎养小儿偷，带害有病人偷。
本宫内卦家中人偷，他宫内卦宅上之借居人偷，或家中异姓人偷。
yi: 鬼爻属阳，是男子偷；
属阴，是女人偷；
阴化阳，是女的偷给男的；
阳化阴，是男的偷了寄给女的。
生旺是壮年人，墓绝是老年人，胎养是小孩偷，带害是有病的人偷。
本宫内卦是家中人偷，他宫内卦是住在宅上的借居人偷，或是家中异姓的人偷。
en: A Pressure line of Yang means a man stole it;
of Yin, a woman;
Yin changing to Yang, a woman stole it for a man;
Yang changing to Yin, a man stole it and sent it to a woman.
In life and strength it is a man in his prime, in tomb or extinction an old person, in the womb or nurture a child, and with harm a sick person.
In the inner trigram of its own palace it is a person of the household; in the inner trigram of another palace, a lodger on the premises or a person of another surname in the household.

title: 失脱·乾宫鬼带螣蛇西北方瘦长男子、巽象官加白虎东南上肥胖阴人：八卦定方向，六神定贼的形貌；鬼在乾宫是西北方人，在巽宫是东南方人，带螣蛇身长而瘦，加白虎旺相贼必肥大、休囚瘦小

rule.yi: 乾宫的鬼爻带螣蛇，是西北方瘦长的男子；巽象的官鬼加白虎，是东南方肥胖的女人。这是用八卦定方向，用六神定贼的形貌。鬼爻在乾宫，是西北方的人；在巽宫，是东南方的人；带螣蛇身长而瘦，加白虎旺相贼必定肥大，休囚就瘦小；其余照这个类推。
rule.en: Pressure in the Qian palace with the Coiling Snake means a thin, tall man from the northwest; Pressure in the Xun image with the White Tiger means a fat woman from the southeast. This uses the eight trigrams to fix the direction and the six spirits to fix the thief's build. Pressure in the Qian palace is a person from the northwest; in the Xun palace, from the southeast; with the Coiling Snake he is long of body and thin, with the White Tiger, strong, the thief is surely big and fat, resting or trapped, small and thin; the rest follow this.

yi: 乾宫的鬼爻带螣蛇，
是西北方瘦长的男子；
巽象的官鬼加白虎，
是东南方肥胖的女人。
en: Pressure in the Qian palace with the Coiling Snake,
a thin, tall man from the northwest;
Pressure in the Xun image with the White Tiger,
a fat woman from the southeast.

zh: 此指八卦以定方向，六神以定贼形。
带螣蛇身长而瘦，加白虎旺相贼必肥大，休囚瘦小。
yi: 这是用八卦定方向，用六神定贼的形貌。
鬼爻在乾宫，是西北方的人；
在巽宫，是东南方的人；
带螣蛇身长而瘦，加白虎旺相贼必定肥大，休囚就瘦小。
其余照这个类推。
en: This uses the eight trigrams to fix the direction and the six spirits to fix the thief's build.
Pressure in the Qian palace is a person from the northwest;
in the Xun palace, from the southeast;
with the Coiling Snake he is long of body and thin, with the White Tiger, strong, the thief is surely big and fat, resting or trapped, small and thin.
The rest follow this.

title: 失脱·与世刑冲必是冤仇相聚、与福交变必然僧道同谋：鬼爻与世爻刑冲，贼是有仇怨的人；与世生合，是沾亲带故的人；鬼化子孙、子孙化鬼，必有僧道夹在其中

rule.yi: 鬼爻和世爻刑冲，必定是有冤仇的人聚在一起；和子孙互相交变，必定有僧人道士同谋。鬼爻和世爻刑冲，贼是有仇怨的人；和世爻生合，是有亲戚关系的人；鬼化子孙、子孙化鬼，必有僧人道士夹杂在里面。
rule.en: If the Pressure line punishes or clashes with the Self, it is surely people with a grudge gathered together; if it changes with Output and back, monks and Daoists have surely plotted together. Pressure punishing or clashing with the Self means the thief is someone with a grudge; giving life to or combining with the Self, someone related or acquainted; Pressure changing into Output or Output into Pressure, a monk or Daoist is surely mixed in.

yi: 鬼爻和世爻刑冲，
必定是有冤仇的人聚在一起；
和子孙互相交变，
必定有僧人道士同谋。
en: If the Pressure line punishes or clashes with the Self,
it is surely people with a grudge gathered together;
if it changes with Output and back,
monks and Daoists have surely plotted together.

zh: 鬼爻与世刑冲，其贼卦有仇隙者；
与世生合，乃是兼亲带故之人；
鬼化子、子化鬼，必有僧道杂在其中。
yi: 鬼爻和世爻刑冲，贼是有仇怨的人；
和世爻生合，是有亲戚关系的人；
鬼化子孙、子孙化鬼，必有僧人道士夹杂在里面。
en: Pressure punishing or clashing with the Self means the thief is someone with a grudge;
giving life to or combining with the Self, someone related or acquainted;
Pressure changing into Output or Output into Pressure, a monk or Daoist is surely mixed in.

title: 失脱·鬼遇生扶惯得中间滋味：鬼爻无气又临死绝，若遇动爻日辰扶起，这个贼是惯偷；带月建是强盗，加太岁是官贼

rule.yi: 鬼爻遇到生扶，这个贼惯于得到其中的好处。鬼爻无气又临死绝，如果遇到动爻日辰把它扶起来，这个贼是惯偷尝过甜头的；带月建是强盗，加太岁是官贼。
rule.en: If Pressure meets life and support, this thief is used to enjoying the taste of it. A Pressure line without breath and on death or extinction, if raised by a moving line or the Day, belongs to a thief long used to the taste of it; with the Month it is a robber, with Tai Sui an official thief.

yi: 鬼爻遇到生扶，
这个贼惯于得到其中的好处。
en: If Pressure meets life and support,
this thief is used to enjoying the taste of it.

zh: 鬼爻无气又临死绝，若遇动爻日辰扶起者，此贼惯得其中滋味；
带月建强盗，加太岁是官贼。
yi: 鬼爻无气又临死绝，如果遇到动爻日辰把它扶起来，这个贼是惯偷尝过甜头的；
带月建是强盗，加太岁是官贼。
en: A Pressure line without breath and on death or extinction, if raised by a moving line or the Day, belongs to a thief long used to the taste of it;
with the Month it is a robber, with Tai Sui an official thief.

title: 失脱·官兴上下须防内外勾连：卦有两个鬼爻，偷的不止一个人；都动是外勾里连，内动外静是家人偷了给外人，外动内静是家里有人知情

rule.yi: 官鬼在上下卦都发动，要提防内外勾结。卦里有两个鬼爻，偷东西的不止一个人；都发动，是外边勾结里面；内卦动外卦静，是家里人偷给外人；外卦动内卦静，是家里有人知情。
rule.en: With Pressure moving in both the upper and the lower trigram, beware of collusion between inside and outside. A hexagram with two Pressure lines means more than one person stole; both moving means the outside is in league with the inside; the inner moving and the outer still means a person of the household stole it for an outsider; the outer moving and the inner still means someone in the household knows of it.

yi: 官鬼在上下卦都发动，
要提防内外勾结。
en: With Pressure moving in both the upper and the lower trigram,
beware of collusion between inside and outside.

zh: 内动外静，是家人偷与外人；
外动内静，家中有人知情。
yi: 卦里有两个鬼爻，偷东西的不止一个人；
都发动，是外边勾结里面；
内卦动外卦静，是家里人偷给外人；
外卦动内卦静，是家里有人知情。
en: A hexagram with two Pressure lines means more than one person stole;
both moving means the outside is in league with the inside;
the inner moving and the outer still means a person of the household stole it for an outsider;
the outer moving and the inner still means someone in the household knows of it.

title: 失脱·木克六爻逾墙而入、金伤三位穿壁而来：看鬼爻五行克哪一处就知从哪里进来——木鬼克土逾墙掘洞、金鬼克木割壁穿篱、火鬼克金劈环开锁、水鬼克火灌水灭灯、土鬼克水涉渎跳涧、木火交化明火执仗；木鬼克上爻翻墙而入，克初爻后门掘洞

rule.yi: 木克上爻，是翻墙而入；金伤三爻，是穿壁而来。木鬼克土，翻墙挖洞；金鬼克木，割开板壁穿过篱笆；火鬼克金，劈开环扣、撬开锁；水鬼克火，泼水灭灯；土鬼克水，涉过水渠跳过山涧；木火交相变化，是明火执仗。要知道从哪里能进来，用鬼爻克到的地方来定：木鬼克上爻，翻墙而入；克初爻，从后门挖洞而进。
rule.en: Wood controlling the top line means he came in over the wall; Metal injuring the third place means he came through the partition. Wood Pressure controlling Earth: over the wall or through a dug hole; Metal Pressure controlling Wood: cutting through the planking or the hedge; Fire Pressure controlling Metal: splitting the ring and opening the lock; Water Pressure controlling Fire: dousing the lamp with water; Earth Pressure controlling Water: wading the channel or leaping the gully; Wood and Fire changing into each other: robbers with open torches. To know where he came in, fix it by where the Pressure controls: Wood Pressure controlling the top line, over the wall; controlling the first line, through a hole dug at the back door.

yi: 木克上爻，
是翻墙而入；
金伤三爻，
是穿壁而来。
en: Wood controlling the top line,
he came in over the wall;
Metal injuring the third place,
he came through the partition.

zh: 要知何处可进，以鬼克处定之，如木鬼克六爻，逾垣而入；
克初爻，后门掘洞而进也。
yi: 木鬼克土，翻墙挖洞；
金鬼克木，割开板壁穿过篱笆；
火鬼克金，劈开环扣、撬开锁；
水鬼克火，泼水灭灯；
土鬼克水，涉过水渠跳过山涧；
木火交相变化，是明火执仗。
要知道从哪里能进来，用鬼爻克到的地方来定，比如木鬼克上爻，翻墙而入；
克初爻，从后门挖洞而进。
en: Wood Pressure controlling Earth: over the wall or through a dug hole;
Metal Pressure controlling Wood: cutting through the planking or the hedge;
Fire Pressure controlling Metal: splitting the ring and opening the lock;
Water Pressure controlling Fire: dousing the lamp with water;
Earth Pressure controlling Water: wading the channel or leaping the gully;
Wood and Fire changing into each other: robbers with open torches.
To know where he came in, fix it by where the Pressure controls: Wood Pressure controlling the top line, over the wall;
controlling the first line, through a hole dug at the back door.

title: 失脱·世去冲官失主必会警觉：世爻冲鬼爻失主察觉，其他人冲鬼爻是别人察觉，旁边的爻冲鬼是旁人察觉

rule.yi: 世爻去冲官鬼，失主一定会警觉。世爻冲鬼爻，失主知觉；自己这边的爻去冲鬼爻，别人知觉；旁边的爻冲鬼爻，旁人知觉。
rule.en: If the Self goes to clash Pressure, the owner of the loss will surely be alerted. The Self clashing the Pressure line means the owner notices; a line of one's own side clashing Pressure means others notice; a line beside it clashing Pressure means bystanders notice.

yi: 世爻去冲官鬼，
失主一定会警觉。
en: If the Self goes to clash Pressure,
the owner of the loss will surely be alerted.

yi: 世爻冲鬼爻，失主知觉；
自己这边的爻去冲鬼爻，别人知觉；
旁边的爻冲鬼爻，旁人知觉。
en: The Self clashing the Pressure line means the owner notices;
a line of one's own side clashing Pressure means others notice;
a line beside it clashing Pressure means bystanders notice.

title: 失脱·日来克鬼贼心亦自惊疑：鬼爻被日辰或动爻刑克，这时贼心惊疑，贼必能捕获

rule.yi: 日辰来克鬼爻，贼的心里也自己惊疑。鬼爻被日辰、动爻刑克，这时贼心惊疑，贼一定能捕获。
rule.en: If the Day comes to control Pressure, the thief's own heart is startled and uneasy. A Pressure line punished or controlled by the Day or a moving line means the thief's heart is then startled and uneasy, and he can surely be caught.

yi: 日辰来克鬼爻，
贼的心里也自己惊疑。
en: If the Day comes to control Pressure,
the thief's own heart is startled and uneasy.

zh: 鬼被日辰动爻刑克，彼时贼心惊疑，贼必捕获得。
yi: 鬼爻被日辰、动爻刑克，这时贼心惊疑，贼一定能捕获。
en: A Pressure line punished or controlled by the Day or a moving line means the thief's heart is then startled and uneasy, and he can surely be caught.

title: 失脱·子动丑宫问牧童定知消息、福兴酉地是酒客可探情由：子孙发动，必有人撞见，问那人可知消息，看子孙所临的地支，分别问哪一种人

rule.yi: 子孙发动在丑宫，问牧童一定知道消息；子孙兴旺在酉地，是酒客可以打探到情由。子孙发动，必定有人撞见，问他可知消息。如果在子爻，可以问不戴帽子的男子或捕鱼人；在丑爻，问牧童、筑墙等人；在寅爻是木客、木匠、挑竹木器的人；在卯爻，问织席卖鞋的、挑柴砍草的人；在辰爻，问凿井的、傍河的、锄地的人；在巳爻，问穿红衣的女子，或耍蛇的乞丐；在午爻，问烧窑的、骑马的、讨火的、提灯的人；在未爻，问挑灰的、耕种的、放羊的人；在申爻，问铜铁匠或耍猴的人；在酉爻，问针线工、酒客、捉鸡的人；在戌爻，问挑泥的、锄地的、牵狗的人；在亥爻，问挑水的、踏水车的、洗衣的、洗澡的人。
rule.en: Output moving in the Chou palace: ask the herd boy and you will surely learn the news; Output flourishing on You ground: a drinker can be sounded out for the facts. When Output moves, someone surely saw it, and asking him will give news. On Zi, one can ask a bareheaded man or a fisherman; on Chou, herd boys, wall builders and the like; on Yin, woodsmen, carpenters, and people carrying bamboo and wooden things; on Mao, mat weavers, shoe sellers, those carrying firewood or cutting grass; on Chen, well diggers, people by the river, and those hoeing the ground; on Si, a woman in red or a snake-charming beggar; on Wu, kiln burners, riders, those begging a light or carrying a lamp; on Wei, those carrying ash, ploughing or herding sheep; on Shen, copper and iron smiths or monkey handlers; on You, needleworkers, drinkers and chicken catchers; on Xu, those carrying mud, hoeing, or leading a dog; on Hai, water carriers, those treading a water wheel, washing clothes or bathing.

yi: 子孙发动在丑宫，
问牧童一定知道消息；
子孙兴旺在酉地，
是酒客可以打探到情由。
en: Output moving in the Chou palace,
ask the herd boy and you will surely learn the news;
Output flourishing on You ground,
a drinker can be sounded out for the facts.

zh: 子动，必有人撞见，询之可知消息。
如在子爻，可问科头男子或捕鱼人；
在丑爻，可问牧童筑墙等人；
在寅爻是木客木匠、担竹木器等人；
在卯爻，问织席卖履、挑柴、砍草等人；
在辰爻问凿井、傍河、锄地等人；
在巳爻问穿红衣女子，或弄蛇乞丐人；
在午爻问烧窑、乘马、讨火、提灯等人；
在未爻问挑灰、耕种、牧羊者等人；
在申爻，问铜铁匠或弄猴人；
在酉爻，问针工、酒客、捉鸡等人；
在戌爻，问挑泥、锄地、牵狗等人；
在亥爻，问担水、踏车、洗衣、沐浴等人。
yi: 子孙发动，必定有人撞见，问他可知消息。
如果在子爻，可以问不戴帽子的男子或捕鱼人；
在丑爻，问牧童、筑墙等人；
在寅爻是木客、木匠、挑竹木器的人；
在卯爻，问织席卖鞋的、挑柴砍草的人；
在辰爻，问凿井的、傍河的、锄地的人；
在巳爻，问穿红衣的女子，或耍蛇的乞丐；
在午爻，问烧窑的、骑马的、讨火的、提灯的人；
在未爻，问挑灰的、耕种的、放羊的人；
在申爻，问铜铁匠或耍猴的人；
在酉爻，问针线工、酒客、捉鸡的人；
在戌爻，问挑泥的、锄地的、牵狗的人；
在亥爻，问挑水的、踏水车的、洗衣的、洗澡的人。
en: When Output moves, someone surely saw it, and asking him will give news.
On Zi, one can ask a bareheaded man or a fisherman;
on Chou, herd boys, wall builders and the like;
on Yin, woodsmen, carpenters, and people carrying bamboo and wooden things;
on Mao, mat weavers, shoe sellers, those carrying firewood or cutting grass;
on Chen, well diggers, people by the river, and those hoeing the ground;
on Si, a woman in red or a snake-charming beggar;
on Wu, kiln burners, riders, those begging a light or carrying a lamp;
on Wei, those carrying ash, ploughing or herding sheep;
on Shen, copper and iron smiths or monkey handlers;
on You, needleworkers, drinkers and chicken catchers;
on Xu, those carrying mud, hoeing, or leading a dog;
on Hai, water carriers, those treading a water wheel, washing clothes or bathing.

title: 失脱·兄动劫财若卜起赃无须觅：卜起赃和寻物，只要见到兄弟发动，财物都会失散，终究找不回来

rule.yi: 兄弟发动劫财，如果占起获赃物就不必去找了。占起赃和寻物，只要见兄弟发动，都主财物失散，终究难找。
rule.en: A Peer line moving robs Wealth; if one divines for recovering the stolen goods, there is no need to look. In divining for recovering stolen goods or searching for things, if a Peer line is seen moving, the goods are scattered and in the end hard to find.

yi: 兄弟发动劫财，
如果占起获赃物就不必去找了。
en: A Peer line moving robs Wealth;
if one divines for recovering the stolen goods, there is no need to look.

zh: 卜起赃及寻物，若见兄动，皆主财物失散，终难寻觅。
yi: 占起赃和寻物，只要见兄弟发动，都主财物失散，终究难找。
en: In divining for recovering stolen goods or searching for things, if a Peer line is seen moving, the goods are scattered and in the end hard to find.

title: 失脱·官兴克世如占捕盗必伤身：占捕盗要世旺鬼衰、世动鬼静，才容易捕获；鬼爻乘旺动来刑克世爻，要防反被他害

rule.yi: 官鬼发动克世，如果是占捕盗，一定会伤身。凡是占捕盗，要世爻旺、鬼爻衰，世爻动、鬼爻静，就容易捕获；如果鬼爻乘旺，动来刑克世爻，要防反被他所害。
