不宜空亡，空亡就难做丈夫；
又不宜发动，发动就为难兄弟；
也不宜衰弱，衰弱就招来不成器的丈夫，发不了福。
如果衰弱又没有一点生扶合助，还带着勾陈、螣蛇这些凶神，一定像朱淑真的丈夫，愚昧不正，人又矮小，所以她有断肠的诗。
en: In every reading of a woman's person, Pressure is the husband star.
It should not be Void, for Void makes it hard for him to be a husband;
it should not move, for moving is hard on the brothers (it controls the Peer line);
and it should not be weak, for weak brings a worthless husband who cannot bring fortune.

If it is weak with no support or help at all and carries Hook Earth, the Coiling Snake or another ill spirit, the husband is surely like Zhu Shuzhen's: stupid, improper and stunted, which is why she has her heartbroken poems.

zh: 凡女人身命，以鬼为夫星，不宜旬空，空则难为夫主；
又不宜弱，弱则招夫不肖。
若衰弱而无生扶合助，兼带勾陈螣蛇等煞者，必如朱淑贞之夫，愚蒙不正，人物侏儒，因有断肠之时。
yi: 凡是女人的身命，以官鬼为夫星，不宜旬空，空就难做丈夫；
又不宜衰弱，衰弱就招来不成器的丈夫。
如果衰弱又没有生扶合助，还带着勾陈、螣蛇这些煞，一定像朱淑贞的丈夫，愚昧不正，人又矮小，所以有断肠的时候。
en: In every woman's reading of her person, Pressure is the husband star; it should not be in a void ten-day cycle, for Void makes it hard for him to be a husband;
and it should not be weak, for weak brings a worthless husband.

If it is weak with no support or help and carries Hook Earth, the Coiling Snake or another ill star, the husband is surely like Zhu Shuzhen's: stupid, improper and stunted, hence the time of a broken heart.

title: 官强而又连龙福，吴孟子夫主贤明：鬼爻旺相更逢青龙福德、禄马贵人，主有贵显贤明之夫；衰而逢助亦有贤明之夫

rule.yi: 官鬼爻旺相，又碰上青龙、福德、禄马、贵人这些吉神，一定有显贵贤明的丈夫，像吴孟子嫁给鲁昭公；官鬼衰弱但得到生扶，也有贤明的丈夫。
rule.en: If the Pressure line is strong and also meets lucky spirits such as the Azure Dragon, Output, the Emolument and Horse stars and the Noble, she surely has an eminent, wise husband, like Wu Mengzi who married Duke Zhao of Lu; if Pressure is weak but supported, she also has a wise husband.

note.yi: 吴孟子是鲁昭公的夫人，吴国人，姓姬，因同姓不婚才不称「吴姬」而称「孟子」。卜筮正宗的「临量」疑是「临旺」之误，译文按「强」并照旺相解。
note.en: Wu Mengzi was the wife of Duke Zhao of Lu, from the state of Wu; she was of the Ji surname, and because marriage within a surname was avoided she was called 'Mengzi' and not 'Wu Ji'. The Zhengzong's 'lin liang' looks like a slip for 'lin wang' (sitting on strength), and is taken as 'strong'.

zh: 官强而又连龙福，吴孟子夫主贤明。
yi: 官鬼强而又连着青龙、福德，吴孟子的丈夫贤明。
en: Pressure strong and joined to the Azure Dragon and Output: Wu Mengzi's husband was wise.

hits.text: 官强而又连龙福，吴孟子夫主贤明
官强而又连龙福，吴孟子夫主贤明

zh: 若鬼爻旺相，更逢青龙福德、禄马贵人等吉神，必主有贵显贤明之夫。
如吴孟子得鲁昭公为夫也。
若衰而逢助，亦主有贤明之夫。
yi: 如果官鬼爻旺相，又碰上青龙、福德、禄马、贵人这些吉神，一定主有显贵贤明的丈夫。
就像吴孟子得到鲁昭公做丈夫。
如果衰弱但得到生扶，也主有贤明的丈夫。
en: If the Pressure line is strong and also meets lucky spirits such as the Azure Dragon, Output, the Emolument and Horse stars and the Noble, she surely has an eminent and wise husband.
Like Wu Mengzi, who had Duke Zhao of Lu for a husband.
If it is weak but meets support, she also has a wise husband.

zh: 若鬼爻临量，遇青龙、禄马、贵人，主有贵显贤明之夫，如吴孟子得鲁昭公为夫也。
yi: 如果官鬼爻强，遇到青龙、禄马、贵人，主有显贵贤明的丈夫，像吴孟子得到鲁昭公做丈夫。
如果衰弱但得到生扶，也是这样。
en: If the Pressure line is strong and meets the Azure Dragon, the Emolument and Horse stars and the Noble, she has an eminent and wise husband, like Wu Mengzi, who had Duke Zhao of Lu for a husband.
The same if it is weak but meets support.

title: 子死妻空，绝俗离尘之辈：占身以福为子、财为妻，二爻临死墓绝空之地是刑妻丧子之兆，小儿见之出家，僧道见之反吉

rule.yi: 占身命，子孙爻是儿子，财爻是妻子。这两个爻如果落在死、墓、绝、空的地方，是刑妻丧子的征兆。小孩子见到这种卦，一定超脱世俗、出家；僧人道士见到反而是吉兆，没有世俗的牵累。
rule.en: In divining one's person, the Output line is the son and the Wealth line the wife. If these two lines fall into Death, Tomb, Extinction or Void, it is the sign of a wife punished and a son lost. A child meeting this will surely leave the world and become a monk or nun; a monk or Taoist meeting it finds it lucky, with no worldly ties to hold him.

note.yi: 这一条是「占身命」里说的，不是专门占婚姻；收在这里是因为「刑妻」是婚姻的后果之一。卜筮大全在同一首赋的另一处（第 9617 行）重复了这一句。
note.en: This entry is said of divining one's person and not specially of marriage; it is included because a wife punished is one of the consequences of a marriage. The Quanshu repeats the line in another place in the same rhapsody (line 9617).

zh: 子死妻空，绝俗离尘之辈；
yi: 子孙死了、妻财落空，是绝俗离尘的人；
en: Output dead and Wealth void: one who cuts off worldly ties;

hits.text: 子死妻空，绝俗离尘之辈
子死妻空，绝俗离群之辈
子死妻空，绝俗离尘之辈

zh: 二爻若临死墓绝空之地，乃是刑妻丧子之兆。
小儿见之，必绝俗离尘，出家辈也。
若僧道见之，反为吉兆，必无俗累之牵惹矣。
yi: 占身命，以福德爻为儿子，以财爻为妻子。
这两爻如果落在死、墓、绝、空的地方，就是刑妻丧子的征兆。
小孩子见到，一定超脱世俗、出家的人。
如果是僧人道士见到，反而是吉兆，一定没有世俗的牵累。
en: In divining one's person, take the Output line as the son and the Wealth line as the wife.
If these two lines fall into Death, Tomb, Extinction or Void, it is the sign of a wife punished and a son lost.
A child meeting this will surely be one who leaves the world and becomes a monk or nun.
If a monk or Taoist meets it, on the contrary it is lucky, and surely he has no worldly ties to hold him.

zh: 以福为子，财为妻，二爻若临死墓绝空之地，乃是刑丧妻子之兆，必绝俗离尘辈也。
yi: 以福德爻为儿子，财爻为妻子，这两爻如果落在死、墓、绝、空的地方，是刑伤妻子、丧失儿子的征兆，一定是超脱世俗的人。
en: Take the Output line as the son and the Wealth line as the wife; if these two lines fall into Death, Tomb, Extinction or Void, it is the sign of a wife injured and a son lost, and he is surely one who leaves the world.

title: 刑合克合，终见乖淫：合中有刑有克，合而有克毕竟不和、合而有刑终成乖戾；午带自刑名刑合，占妻妾多不正；克合如丑子，占妻妾始合终背

rule.yi: 合是和合，凡占见到都吉利。但人不知道合里面还有刑有克：合而有克，终究不和；合而有刑，终究乖戾。比如财爻是未、福德是午，午和未合，但午带自刑，叫刑合；又如财爻是子，子和丑合，丑土能克子水，叫克合。占妻妾，遇到刑合、克合，旧注说「多不正」，王洪绪说「始合终背，诸事终乖戾」。
rule.en: A combination is a harmony and is lucky whenever it is seen in a divination. But people do not know that within a combination there are punishments and controls: a combination with a control is in the end not in accord; a combination with a punishment ends in perversity. For example, if Wealth is Wei and Output is Wu, Wu and Wei combine, but Wu carries self-punishment, which is called a punishing combination; or if Wealth is Zi, Zi and Chou combine, but Chou Earth can control Zi Water, which is called a controlling combination. In divining a wife or concubine, the old commentary says a punishing combination means she is 'mostly improper', and Wang Hongxu says a controlling combination means 'combined at first and turning against in the end, everything going perversely'.

dispute.yi: 同样的意思，旧注把「占妻妾多不正」说在刑合上，并且把例子里的午、未身份说反了（午火生未土，午应是福爻、未应是财爻）；王洪绪改对了身份，把「占妻妾始合终背」说在克合上。
dispute.en: The two notes attach the wife-or-concubine sentence to different cases: the old commentary puts 'mostly improper' on the punishing combination, and reverses the roles of Wu and Wei in its example (Wu Fire generates Wei Earth, so Wu should be Output and Wei Wealth); Wang Hongxu corrects the roles and puts 'combined at first and turning against in the end' on the controlling combination.

note.yi: 「自刑」是辰午酉亥各自相刑的那一类：午遇午就是自刑。旧注里的「褔」是「福」的异体字。这一条讲的是一般的合，占妻妾只是它的一个用处，收在这里是因为它给了合并非都吉的理由，可以和 LY.MARRY.DYTJ.03（合处逢冲）、LY.MARRY.BSZZ.02 一起读。
note.en: 'Self-punishment' is the kind in which Chen, Wu, You and Hai each punish themselves: Wu meeting Wu is self-punishment. The character used for 'fortune' in the old commentary is a variant form. This entry is about combinations in general, with the wife or concubine only one of its uses; it is included because it gives the reason a combination is not always lucky, and can be read with LY.MARRY.DYTJ.03 (a combination meeting a clash) and LY.MARRY.BSZZ.02.

yi: 刑合克合，终究会出现乖张和淫乱。
en: A punishing combination or a controlling combination ends in perversity and lewdness.

zh: 然人不知，合中有刑有克。
且如用午字为财爻，未字为褔爻，午与未合，然午带自刑，名为刑合。
占妻妾多不正，占财亦是不正之财也。
yi: 合是和合的意思。
凡是占卜见到它，没有不吉利的。
但是人不知道，合里面有刑，有克。
合了却带着克，毕竟不和；
合而有刑，终究成为乖戾。
比如用午字做财爻，未字做福爻，午和未合，但午带着自刑，叫做刑合。
占妻妾多半不正，占钱财也是不正当的钱财。
克合，就像丑和子这一类。
其余的都照上面这样。
en: 'Combination' means harmony.
Whenever it is seen in a divination it is always lucky.
But people do not know that within a combination there are punishments and controls.
A combination with a control is in the end not in accord;
a combination with a punishment ends in perversity.
For example, if Wu is taken as Wealth and Wei as Output, Wu and Wei combine, but Wu carries self-punishment, and this is called a punishing combination.
In divining a wife or concubine, she is mostly improper; in divining money, it is money improperly got.
A controlling combination is like Chou and Zi.
The rest follow this.

zh: 合者和合也，凡占见之无不吉利。
然人不知合中有刑有克；
合而有克，终见不和合，而有刑终见乖戾。
且如用神未字为财爻，午字为福爻，午与未合，然午带自刑，名为刑合。
又如子字为财爻，子与丑合，丑土能克子水，谓之克合。
如占妻妾，始合终背，诸事终乖戾也。
yi: 合是和合的意思，凡是占卜见到它，没有不吉利的。
但是人不知道合里面有刑有克；
合而有克，终究不能和合，合而有刑，终究乖戾。
比如用神未字做财爻，午字做福爻，午和未合，但午带着自刑，叫做刑合。
又比如子字做财爻，子和丑合，丑土能克子水，叫做克合。
如果占妻妾，先合后背离，诸事终究乖戾。
en: 'Combination' means harmony, and whenever it is seen in a divination it is always lucky.
But people do not know that within a combination there are punishments and controls;
a combination with a control ends in not being in accord, and a combination with a punishment ends in perversity.
For example, if the Subject Wei is Wealth and Wu is Output, Wu and Wei combine, but Wu carries self-punishment, and this is called a punishing combination.
Or if Zi is Wealth, Zi and Chou combine, but Chou Earth can control Zi Water, and this is called a controlling combination.
If divining a wife or concubine, combined at first and turning against in the end, everything goes perversely.

title: 占婚以间爻为媒，两个间爻要分主次：先看衰旺动静，俱静俱动或无旺衰取动爻而日辰冲之者为正，无冲看并起者，再无则看日辰生扶之爻，使事归于一

rule.yi: 占婚姻，以间爻为媒人。间爻有两个的时候，也照这个办法定主次：先分衰旺、辨动静——两爻都静，旺的在先；有动，动的为急。如果两个都静、都动，或者既不旺也不衰，就取动的爻，被日辰冲的那一个为正；没有被冲的，就看并起的爻为媒；又没有合并的，然后看日辰生扶的爻。这样事情就归于一个人，没有两头的疑惑。
rule.en: In divining a marriage, the between line is the go-betweens. When there are two between lines, decide which is primary in the same way: first tell strong from weak and moving from still; with both still, the strong one comes first, and with one moving, the moving one is urgent. If both are still, or both moving, or neither strong nor weak, take the moving line, the one clashed by the Day being the primary; if none is clashed, look at the line that arises together with the Day as the go-between; if there is no such combination or arising either, only then look at the line generated or supported by the Day. In this way the matter comes to one person and there is no doubt between two ends.

note.yi: 「并」是爻和日辰同一个地支；「并起」是爻本身发动、又和日辰同支。这一段是旧注对「别衰旺以明克合，辨动静以定刑冲」两句的发挥，只有第 5237 行谈到婚姻，前面的问答是它用的原则。
note.en: 'Arising together' means a line that has the same branch as the Day; 'arising' here is a line that moves and also shares the Day's branch. The passage is the old commentary's elaboration of the two lines 'tell strong from weak to make clear control and combination, tell moving from still to fix punishment and clash'; only line 5237 speaks of marriage, and the question and answer before it give the principle it uses.

zh: 别衰旺以明克合，辨动静以定刑冲。
yi: 要分辨衰旺来弄清克合，要辨别动静来定下刑冲。
en: Tell strong from weak to make clear the control and combination; tell moving from still to fix the punishment and clash.

hits.text: 别衰旺以明克合，辨动静以定刑冲
别旺衰以明克合，辨动静以定刑冲
别衰旺以明克合，辨动静以定刑冲
别衰旺以明克合，辨动静以定刑冲

zh: 或问：静与衰爻伤不得动与旺，若遇动爻反衰，静爻反旺，则如之何。
yi: 有人问：静的和衰的爻伤不了动的和旺的，如果遇到动的爻反而衰、静的爻反而旺，那该怎么办？
回答：两个爻都静，以旺的为先；
有动的，以动的为急。
因为动就像人站起来，
静就像人伏着。
那个爻虽然旺，有什么可怕的呢？
所以说：动爻急如火。
en: Someone asks: a still or weak line cannot harm a moving or strong one; what if the moving line is weak and the still line strong?
The answer: with both still, the strong one comes first;
if one moves, the moving one is urgent.
For moving is like a person standing up,
and stillness like a person lying down.
However strong that line is, what is there to fear?
So it is said: a moving line is urgent as fire.

zh: 间有两爻，亦当以此定之。
若俱静俱动，或无旺无衰，则当取动爻，日辰冲之者为正，无冲，则看并起者为媒也。
又无合并，然后看日辰生扶之爻。
如此，则事归于一，而无两端之疑也。
yi: 比如占婚姻，以间爻为媒人。
间爻有两个爻，也应当照这个办法来定。
如果两个都静、都动，或者没有旺没有衰，就应当取动的爻，被日辰冲的那个为正；没有冲的，就看并起的爻当媒人。
又没有合并的，然后看日辰生扶的爻。
这样，事情就归到一个人身上，没有两头的疑惑了。
en: For example, in divining a marriage, the between line is the go-between.
When there are two between lines, decide in the same way.

If both are still, or both moving, or neither strong nor weak, take the moving line, the one clashed by the Day being the primary; if none is clashed, look at the line that arises together with the Day as the go-between.
If there is no such combination or arising either, only then look at the line generated or supported by the Day.
In this way the matter comes to one person and there is no doubt between two ends.

title: 财鬼一同生合，庆及婚姻：财爻官鬼一同来生合，家里有婚姻的喜庆；兄弟爻两处见刑冲，灾祸牵连眷属

rule.yi: 财爻和官鬼一同来生合（世身），家里有婚姻的喜庆；兄弟爻在两处被刑冲，灾祸就牵连到家眷。
rule.en: If the Wealth line and the Pressure line together come to generate and combine (with the Self and Body), there is the joy of a marriage in the household; if the Peer line meets punishment and clash in two places, calamity extends to the family members.

note.yi: 这一句夹在一首家宅口诀里，前后没有注。原文没有说生合的是谁，按家宅口诀的惯例，是财、鬼一起生合世爻和宅爻（见同书家宅部分「财鬼二爻同动来生合世爻宅爻者，皆主婚姻之喜」），括号里的「世身」是译者补的。
note.en: The sentence is in a household rhyme with no note before or after. The text does not say what the Wealth and Pressure lines generate and combine with; by the convention of the household rhymes they generate and combine with the Self line and the household line (the Yiyin says in its household section that when the Wealth and Pressure lines move together to generate and combine with the Self and household lines, it always means the joy of a marriage), and 'Self and Body' in brackets is the translator's addition.

yi: 财爻、官鬼一同来生合，
家里有婚姻的喜庆；
兄弟爻两处见到刑冲，
灾祸牵连到家眷。
en: Wealth and Pressure together generating and combining,
there is the joy of a marriage in the household;
the Peer line meeting punishment and clash in two places,
calamity extends to the family members.

title: 子卯夫妻，日下当遭反目：子卯相刑，夫妻当天就反目；辰戌相冲，兄弟当月就阋墙

rule.yi: （夫妻两爻是）子和卯，互相刑，当天就会夫妻反目；（兄弟两爻是）辰和戌，互相冲，当月就一定兄弟争吵。
rule.en: If the husband and wife lines are Zi and Mao, punishing each other, husband and wife fall out that very day; if the brother lines are Chen and Xu, clashing each other, brothers surely quarrel within the month.

note.yi: 子卯相刑（无礼之刑）、辰戌相冲，是用地支之间的刑冲来断夫妻、兄弟不和；原文没有解释，也没有说「夫妻」「兄弟」在卦里是哪两爻，只能照字面译。「日下」是当日，「月中」是当月。
note.en: Zi and Mao punish each other (the punishment of rudeness) and Chen and Xu clash, so the branches' punishment and clash are used to judge discord between husband and wife and between brothers; the text does not explain this or say which two lines stand for husband and wife or for brothers in the hexagram, and is translated as written. 'Under the day' is that day and 'in the month' is that month.

yi: 子和卯做夫妻，
当天就会夫妻反目；
辰和戌做兄弟，
这个月里一定兄弟争吵。
en: Zi and Mao as husband and wife:
on that very day they fall out;
Chen and Xu as brothers (the Peer lines):
within the month they surely quarrel.

title: 用伏应财之下，身赘他家：出门在外的人，用爻伏在应爻的妻财下面，是入赘在别人家不想回来；财动生合世爻能带妻回家；财与伏神不相生合只是替人掌财，不是女婿

rule.yi: 问出门在外的人为什么不回来：他的用爻伏在应爻的妻财下面，就是入赘在别人家，不想回来了。如果妻财动来生合世爻，他会带着妻子回家；妻财如果和伏神不相生合，那只是替别人掌管钱财，或者依靠别人家，不是入赘的女婿。王洪绪补充：要伏在应位的阴爻财下面才是入赘；落在阳爻上、生合世爻或身爻的，是替别人掌财不回来。
rule.en: Asking why a traveller does not come home: if his Subject line is hidden beneath the Wealth line on the Other, he has married into another's house and does not think of returning. If Wealth moves and generates or combines with the Self line, he will bring his wife home; if Wealth does not generate or combine with the hidden spirit, he is only managing another's money or depending on another family, and is not a son-in-law by marriage. Wang Hongxu adds: it is marrying in only when he is hidden beneath the yin Wealth in the Other's place; if it falls on a yang line and generates or combines with Self or the Body, he is managing another's money and does not return.

note.yi: 这是《黄金策》行人章里的一联，问的是出门在外的人（用爻）在哪里、为什么不回来。旧注只要求用爻伏在应爻的妻财下面；王洪绪限定为伏在「应位阴财」之下才是入赘，落在阳爻上是替人掌财，两家说法有一点出入。《易隐》有一句相近的话。这一联收进婚姻域，是因为它讲「赘」；行人章的其他各联不收。
note.en: This couplet is in the Huangjin Ce's chapter on travellers and asks where the traveller (the Subject line) is and why he does not come home. The old commentary requires only that the Subject be hidden beneath the Wealth line on the Other; Wang Hongxu restricts it to 'beneath the yin Wealth in the Other's place' for marrying in, and says that on a yang line it means managing another's money, so the two differ a little. The Yi Yin has a similar sentence. The couplet is included in the marriage domain because it speaks of marrying into a house; the other couplets of the travellers chapter are not taken.

zh: 用伏应财之下，身赘他家；
yi: 用爻伏在应爻的财爻之下，自身就入赘到别人家；
en: The Subject hidden beneath the Wealth on the Other line: he has married into another's house;

hits.text: 用伏应财之下，身赘他家

zh: 用爻伏于应上，妻财之下，必然身赘他家，不思归也。
财动生合世爻，掣妇归家。
财爻若与伏神不相生合，乃是与人掌财，或是倚靠他家，非婚婿也。
yi: 用爻伏在应爻上、妻财爻下面，一定是自身入赘在别人家，不想回来了。
妻财爻动来生合世爻，他会带着妻子回家。
妻财爻如果和伏神不相生相合，那是替别人掌管钱财，或者是依靠别人家，不是入赘的女婿。
en: If the Subject is hidden on the Other line beneath the Wealth line, he has surely married into another's house and does not think of coming home.
If Wealth moves and generates or combines with the Self line, he will bring his wife back home.
If the Wealth line does not generate or combine with the hidden spirit, he is managing money for someone or depending on another family, and is not a son-in-law by marriage.

zh: 用爻伏于应位阴财之下，必赘他人；
若临阳象生合世身，必代他人掌财不返。
yi: 用爻伏在应位的阴爻财下面，一定入赘别人家；
如果落在阳爻上，生合世爻或身爻，一定是替别人掌管钱财，不回来。
en: If the Subject is hidden beneath the yin Wealth in the Other's place, he has surely married into another family;
if it falls on a yang line and generates or combines with Self or the Body, he is surely managing another's money and does not return.

zh: 用伏应爻财下者，身赘他乡也。
用入应爻财库者，踪羁富室也。
yi: 用爻伏在应爻的财爻下面的，自身入赘在他乡。
用爻进入应爻财爻的库里的，行踪被拘留在富户人家。
en: One whose Subject is hidden beneath the Wealth on the Other line has married into a house in another place.
One whose Subject enters the tomb of the Wealth on the Other line has his whereabouts held in a rich house.

title: 进人口·买宠妾以财爻为主：过继小孩用子孙；买婢、雇童仆、买宠妾、收留走失的人都用财爻；窝藏有难之人看他是谁

rule.yi: 《黄金策》「进人口」一章讲收养、买人、雇人。用神要另外占一卦来定：过继小孩用子孙爻；买婢女、雇童仆、买宠妾、收留走失的人，都用财爻；窝藏有难的人，看那个人是谁——朋友用兄弟爻、尊长用父母爻、妇人用妻财爻、官府中人用官鬼爻。买宠妾用的就是财爻。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on taking in persons covers adoption, buying people and hiring. The Subject is fixed by a separate divination: for adopting a child use the Output line; for buying a maid, hiring a servant boy, buying a favoured concubine or taking in a lost person use the Wealth line; for sheltering a person in trouble look at who he is: a friend the Peer line, an elder the Resource line, a woman the Wealth line, a man in office the Pressure line. Buying a favoured concubine uses the Wealth line.

note.yi: 原文的「宠妾」是「嬖」（受宠爱的侍妾）。「螟蛉」是过继的孩子，这一章开头的注解：老而无子叫独，过继别人的儿子叫螟蛉。这一章后面的各联都按这里定的用爻去断，「用爻」就是被收留、被买、被雇的那个人；本库只收其中讲到妻妾、妇人的几联。
note.en: 'Favoured concubine' in the original is 'bi', a concubine who is loved. 'Mingling' is an adopted child; the opening note of the chapter says that an old man with no son is called 'alone' and adopting another's son is called 'mingling'. The couplets that follow in the chapter are all judged from the Subject line fixed here, which is the person taken in, bought or hired; only the couplets that speak of wives, concubines and women are taken into this library.

yi: 要另外占一卦，才知道用神是哪一爻。
en: Divine it separately, and only then will the Subject be known.

zh: 买婢、雇童仆、买宠妾，及收留迷失之人，皆以财为主。
若窝藏有难之人，则看其人：与我相识朋友，以兄弟为主；
yi: 过继小孩，以子孙爻为主。
买婢女、雇童仆、买宠妾，以及收留走失的人，都以财爻为主。
如果是窝藏有难的人，就看这个人是谁：是和我相识的朋友，以兄弟爻为主；
是尊长，以父母爻为主；
是妇人，以妻财爻为主；
是官府中人，以官鬼爻为主。
en: For adopting a child, the Output line is the Subject.
For buying a maid, hiring a servant boy, buying a favoured concubine, or taking in a lost person, Wealth is the Subject.
If sheltering a person in trouble, look at who he is: an acquaintance of mine, the Peer line is the Subject;
an elder, the Resource line;
a woman, the Wealth line;
a man in office, the Pressure line.

title: 用不宜动，动必难留：买妾买婢雇人，用爻发动其人难托，遇游魂或化游魂日后逃窜，生合世爻则是吉兆

rule.yi: 买宠妾、买婢女、雇人，用爻（就是被买被雇的那个人）不宜发动，发动了就难留住。用爻发动，这个人靠不住；遇到游魂卦，或者化入游魂卦，日后会逃走；雇工、借住的人也待不长；但如果发动来生合世爻，那是吉兆，不是逃走或留不住。
rule.en: In buying a favoured concubine or a maid or hiring a person, the Subject line, the person bought or hired, should not move; moving, he or she is hard to keep. A moving Subject line means the person cannot be relied on; meeting a Wandering Soul hexagram or changing into one, he or she will run away in future; a hired hand or a lodger will not stay long; but if it moves to generate or combine with the Self line, that is a lucky sign, not fleeing or being hard to keep.

yi: 用爻不宜发动，动了一定难留；
en: The Subject should not move; moving, it is hard to keep;

zh: 若遇游魂，或化入游魂者，异日主逃窜。
若来生合世爻，则是吉兆，非逃与难留也。
yi: 用爻发动，这个人难以托付。
如果遇到游魂卦，或者化入游魂卦，日后主逃走。
即使是过继的小孩，也不会成为你的儿子。
雇工、借住的人，也待不长久。
如果发动来生合世爻，那是吉兆，不是逃走，也不是难留。
en: If the Subject line moves, the person cannot be relied on.
If it meets a Wandering Soul hexagram or changes into one, he or she will run away in future.
Even an adopted child will not become your son.
A hired hand or a lodger will not stay long.
If it comes to generate or combine with the Self line, that is a lucky sign, and not fleeing or hard to keep.

title: 动化空亡有始无终，蛇合官鬼多谋少德：用爻发动变入空亡有头无尾，临螣蛇动合官鬼奸诈不实，妇人见之不贞洁

rule.yi: 用爻发动变成空亡，这个人有头无尾；用爻临着螣蛇、动来合官鬼，这个人虽然多谋略，却奸诈不实、靠不住；是妇人遇到这种情形，就主不贞洁。
rule.en: If the Subject line moves and changes into Void, the person begins and does not finish; if it sits on the Coiling Snake and moves to combine with Pressure, the person, though full of schemes, is crafty and false and cannot be relied on; if a woman meets this, it means she is unchaste.

zh: 动化空亡，有始无终之辈；
蛇合官鬼，多谋少德之人。
yi: 动了化成空亡，是有始无终的人；
螣蛇和官鬼相合，是多谋略而缺德的人。
en: Moving and changing into Void: one who begins and does not finish;
the Coiling Snake combining with Pressure: a schemer with little virtue.

动化空亡，有始无终之辈
蛇合官鬼，多谋少德之人

zh: 用爻发动，变入空亡，主其人有头无尾。
若临螣蛇，动合官鬼，其人虽多谋，然奸诈不实，难凭。
yi: 用爻发动，变入空亡，主这个人有头无尾。

妇人遇到这种情形，就主不贞洁。
en: If the Subject line moves and changes into Void, the person begins and does not finish.
If it sits on the Coiling Snake and moves to combine with Pressure, the person, though full of schemes, is crafty and false and cannot be relied on.
If a woman meets this, it means she is unchaste.

title: 临玄武而化兄爻，门户须防出入：用爻临玄武动化兄弟，其人贪财好色，托以财物必窃取，且必淫乱，男女皆然

rule.yi: 用爻落在玄武上发动，化成兄弟爻：这个人贪财好色。把财物托付给他，他一定偷来自用，而且一定淫乱，男女都是这样，所以要防他在门户出入。
rule.en: If the Subject line sits on the Dark Tortoise, moves and changes into a Peer line, the person is greedy for money and lust. Entrust him with goods and he will surely steal them for his own use, and he will surely be dissolute, men and women alike; so guard the doors against his coming and going.

zh: 临玄武而化兄爻，门户须防出入；
yi: 落在玄武上而化成兄弟爻，要防他在门户出入；
en: Sitting on the Dark Tortoise and changing into a Peer line, guard the doors against his coming and going;

hits.text: 临玄武而化兄爻，门户须防出入
临玄武而化兄爻，门户须防出入

zh: 托以财物，则必窃取自用，且必淫乱；
yi: 用爻临着玄武发动，化成兄弟爻；
主这个人贪财好色。
把财物托付给他，他一定偷取自用，而且一定淫乱；
男女都是这样。
所以要防他在门户出入。
en: The Subject line sits on the Dark Tortoise, moves and changes into a Peer line;
the person is greedy for money and lust.
Entrust him with goods and he will surely steal them for his own use, and he will surely be dissolute;
this holds for men and women alike.
So guard the doors against his coming and going.

title: 用爻生合世爻必得其力，主象克冲身象难服其心：用爻生合世则可用、用心欢爱，刑冲克害世则不悦服，更旺动是奴婢欺主

rule.yi: 用爻生合世爻，这个人可以用，办事一定用心，即使是过继的小孩也一定对我欢喜爱戴，是大吉的兆头；最怕被合住、冲散、克坏。如果用爻刑冲克害世爻，这个人心里不服，难以使唤；再加旺相发动，就是奴婢欺主的象；再加应爻也刑克，日后必遭其祸。
rule.en: If the Subject line generates or combines with the Self line, the person can be used and will surely put his heart into the work; even an adopted child will be fond of me: a greatly lucky sign; what is most feared is being held by a combination, clashed apart or controlled and spoiled. If the Subject line punishes, clashes, controls or harms the Self line, the person is not content at heart and hard to command; if it is also strong and moving, that is the image of a servant cheating the master; if the Other line also punishes and controls, one will surely suffer from him in future.

note.yi: 第二段旧注跨了两行（第 6672 和 6673 行）。「主象」在这一章就是用爻。「卦身」译作 the Body。
note.en: The second commentary passage runs over two lines (lines 6672 and 6673). The 'Subject image' in this chapter is the Subject line. The 'hexagram Body' is translated as the Body.

zh: 用爻生合世爻，必得其力；
主象克冲身象，难服其心。
yi: 用爻生合世爻，一定得他的力；
主象克冲卦身，难以让他心服。
en: If the Subject line generates or combines with the Self line, one surely gets his help;
if the Subject image controls or clashes the Body, it is hard to win his heart.

hits.text: 用爻生合世爻，必得其力
主象克冲身象，难服其心
用爻生合世爻，必得其力
主象克冲身象，难服其心

zh: 用爻生合世爻，其人可用。
虽螟蛉，亦必欢爱于我，大吉之兆。
大怕合住冲散，及克坏之。
若用爻刑冲克害世爻，必主其人心不悦服，难以使令。
更加旺动，是乃奴婢欺主之象。
兼以应亦刑克，异日必遭其祸。
yi: 用爻生合世爻，这个人可以用。
凡有事情要办，他一定用心；
即使是过继的小孩，也一定对我欢喜爱戴，是大吉的兆头。
最怕被合住、冲散，以及被克坏。
如果用爻刑冲克害世爻，一定主这个人心里不服，难以使唤。
再加旺相发动，就是奴婢欺主的象。
再加上应爻也刑克，日后必遭其祸。
en: If the Subject line generates or combines with the Self line, the person may be used.
whenever there is a task he will surely put his heart into it;
even an adopted child will be fond of me: a greatly lucky sign.
What is most feared is being held by a combination, clashed apart or controlled and spoiled.
If the Subject line punishes, clashes, controls or harms the Self line, the person is surely not content at heart and hard to command.
If it is also strong and moving, that is the image of a servant cheating the master.
If the Other line also punishes and controls, one will surely suffer from him in future.

title: 财化子，携子偕来：占妻妾婢女财爻化出子孙必有小孩带来；财动生合世而化子反来刑克，其婢可使其子顽劣

rule.yi: 占妻妾、婢女，妻财爻化出子孙爻，一定有小孩带来。如果妻财动来生合世爻，而化出的子孙反来刑克它，那个婢女还可以使唤，她的孩子一定顽劣不听话。
rule.en: In divining for a wife, concubine or maid, when the Wealth line changes out an Output line there will surely be a small child brought along. If Wealth moves to generate or combine with the Self line but the Output it changes into turns to punish and control it, the maid can still be used, but her child will surely be unruly and disobedient.

yi: 妻财化出子孙，带着孩子一起来；
en: Wealth changing into Output: she comes and brings a child with her;

zh: 凡占妻妾婢女，财爻化出子孙，必有小儿带来。
若动财生合世爻，而化子反来刑克者，其婢则可使，其子必顽劣不驯也。
yi: 凡是占妻妾、婢女，妻财爻化出子孙爻，一定有小孩带来。
如果妻财动来生合世爻，而化出的子孙反来刑克它，那个婢女还可以使唤，她的孩子一定顽劣不听话。
en: In divining for a wife, concubine or maid, when the Wealth line changes out an Output line there will surely be a small child brought along.

If Wealth moves to generate or combine with the Self line but the Output it changes into turns to punish and control it, the maid can still be used, but her child will surely be unruly and disobedient.

title: 世合身，终身宠用：世爻生合卦身，其人必得宠用；世爻合财爻，其妇必通于家主

rule.yi: 世爻生合卦身，这个人一生受宠爱、被重用。不管是借房子、来投靠还是使唤婢女，只要世爻合了财爻，那个妇人一定和家主有私情。
rule.en: If the Self line generates or combines with the Body, the person is favoured and used for life. Whether borrowing a house, taking refuge or employing a maid, if Self combines with the Wealth line, the woman surely has an affair with the master of the house.

note.yi: 旧注里「古人为人之身」的「古人」大概是「占人」之误（占人才和「占事为事之体」对得上），译文按「占人」译。
note.en: 'Gu ren' in 'gu ren wei ren zhi shen' in the commentary is probably a slip for 'zhan ren' (divining a person), which matches the preceding 'zhan shi wei shi zhi ti' (divining a matter); it is translated as divining a person.

yi: 世爻合卦身，一生受宠爱、被重用。
en: Self combining with the Body: favoured and used for life.

zh: 卦身一爻，占事为事之体，古人为人之身。
若遇世爻生合，其人必得宠用。
不拘借房投靠使婢，若遇世合财爻，其妇必通于家主。
yi: 卦身这一爻，占事是事情的本体，占人是人的身体。
如果遇到世爻生合它，这个人一定得到宠爱重用。
不论是借房子、来投靠还是使唤婢女，只要世爻合了财爻，那个妇人一定和家主有私情。
en: The Body line: in divining a matter it is the substance of the matter, in divining a person it is the person's body.
If the Self line generates or combines with it, the person will surely be favoured and used.
Whether borrowing a house, taking refuge or employing a maid, if Self combines with the Wealth line, the woman surely has an affair with the master of the house.

title: 遇兄则财莫能聚（旧注：兄乃克剥破败阻滞之神，世或逢之，主克妻妾、破耗多端、一生不聚财物）

rule.yi: 《黄金策》身命章说：「遇到兄弟爻，钱财就聚不起来。」旧注解释：兄弟爻是克剥、破败、阻滞的神，世爻如果碰上它，主克妻妾，破耗多端，一辈子聚不起钱财。
rule.en: The Huangjin Ce's chapter on one's person and fate says: 'Meeting a Peer line, wealth cannot gather.' The old commentary explains: the Peer line is the spirit of stripping, ruin, breaking and blocking; if Self meets it, the wife and concubines are controlled, losses come in many ways, and wealth never gathers in a whole life.

dispute.yi: 这句旧注正是《增删卜易》批评的对象。野鹤（LY.MARRY.ZS.35）说：「既以为克妻，又以为破耗，照这样说，世上伤了妻子的人都是贫困的人。假使穷人白头偕老、富人断弦，又怎么解释？」所以主张分开占：占妻子占一卦、占钱财另占一卦，不能一卦断到底。
dispute.en: This commentary line is exactly what the Zengshan Buyi attacks. The Old Man of Yehe (LY.MARRY.ZS.35) says: 'Since it is taken both as harming the wife and as wasting wealth, by that reasoning all the people in the world who have lost a wife are poor. Suppose the poor grow old together while the rich lose their wives: how would that be explained?' So he argues for divining separately, one hexagram for the wife and another for wealth, and not judging everything from a single hexagram.

yi: 遇到兄弟爻，钱财就聚不起来；
en: Meeting a Peer line, wealth cannot gather;

zh: 至兄乃克剥破败阻滞之神。
世或逢之，主克妻妾，破耗多端，一生不聚财物。
yi: 至于兄弟爻，是克剥、破败、阻滞的神。
世爻要是碰上它，主克妻妾，破耗多端，一生聚不起钱财。
en: As for the Peer line, it is the spirit of stripping, ruin and blocking.
If Self meets it, it means the wife and concubines are controlled, losses come in many ways, and wealth never gathers in a whole life.

title: 家宅千金赋·父入子宫后娘来就、子临父位随母嫁人；阴兄化阳兄嫂赘晚夫、阴子变阳子女招婿；父化父外娘晚位、财化财当娶双妻

rule.yi: 讲一家人构成的几联里，和婚嫁有关的有：父母爻进入子孙的宫位，一定有继母来；子孙爻落在父母爻的位置，一定是随着母亲改嫁。阴爻兄弟化成阳爻兄弟，嫂子招赘晚夫、同住一处；阴爻子孙变成阳爻子孙，女儿招婿、同在一家。父母爻化成父母爻，是外来的继母；妻财爻化成妻财爻，当娶两位妻子。
rule.en: Among the couplets on how a household is made up, these concern marriage: the Resource line entering the Output's palace, a stepmother will surely come; the Output line sitting in the Resource's place, he or she will surely follow the mother when she remarries. A yin Peer line changing into a yang Peer line: the sister-in-law takes a later husband in, living under the same roof; a yin Output line changing into a yang Output line: the daughter takes a son-in-law and they live in the same house. Resource changing into Resource: a stepmother from outside; Wealth changing into Wealth: he will marry two wives.

note.yi: 这几联在《黄金策》家宅章的千金赋里，没有旧注。「晚夫」是后来的丈夫，「外娘晚位」是外面来的、位次在后的继母。原文夹在一大段讲家宅人口的话中间，和婚嫁无关的联（如「二姓同居必有两重兄弟」「兄化鬼以空亡」）没有收。《增删卜易》婚姻章里也说「财化财」未必两度婚（LY.MARRY.ZS.15），与这里的「当娶双妻」不同。
note.en: These couplets are in the household rhapsody of the Huangjin Ce and have no old commentary. 'A later husband' is a husband taken afterwards, and 'a second mother from outside, in a later place' is a stepmother who comes from outside and ranks later. In the original they are set in a long run of lines on the people of a household, and the couplets unrelated to marriage (such as 'two surnames living together must have two sets of brothers' and 'Peer turning to Pressure and Void') are not taken. The marriage chapter of the Zengshan Buyi also says that Wealth turning to Wealth is not necessarily two marriages (LY.MARRY.ZS.15), which differs from 'he will marry two wives' here.

zh: 父入子宫，必主后娘来就；
子临父位，定主随母嫁人。
yi: 父母爻进入子孙的宫位，一定有继母来；
子孙爻落在父母爻的位置，一定是随着母亲改嫁。
en: The Resource line entering the Output's palace: a stepmother will surely come;
the Output line sitting in the Resource's place: he or she will surely follow the mother when she remarries.

zh: 阴兄化入阳兄，嫂赘晚夫同舍；
阴子变入阳子，女招婿而同家。
yi: 阴爻兄弟化成阳爻兄弟，嫂子招赘晚夫，同住一处；
阴爻子孙变成阳爻子孙，女儿招婿，同在一家；
父母爻化成父母爻，是外来的继母，后来的位次；
妻财爻化成妻财爻，当娶两位妻子。
en: A yin Peer line changing into a yang Peer line: the sister-in-law takes a later husband in, living under the same roof;
a yin Output line changing into a yang Output line: the daughter takes a son-in-law and they live in the same house;
Resource changing into Resource: a second mother from outside, in a later place;
Wealth changing into Wealth: he will marry two wives.

title: 家宅千金赋·天喜星临必然嫁娶添丁；咸池入酉花酒生涯；财入咸池化鬼女多独守、子临寡宿化官男主孤虚

rule.yi: 天喜星临着，一定有嫁娶、添丁的事。咸池星落在酉上，一定过着花酒的生涯。妻财爻临着咸池而化成官鬼，女子多半独守空房；子孙爻临着寡宿而化成官鬼，男子多是孤独空虚。
rule.en: When the Tianxi star arrives there will surely be weddings and new births. The Xianchi star entering You means a life of flowers and wine. Wealth on the Xianchi star changing into Pressure: the woman is mostly left to keep alone; Output on the Widow star changing into Pressure: the man is lonely and empty.

note.yi: 「寡宿」是与「孤辰」相对的神煞，主孤独；「孤虚」是孤独空虚。原文在这里没有解释，也没有说「财」「子」是哪一爻（译文按上下文译作妻财爻、子孙爻）。同一行里讲丧门、披头、五鬼、羊刃的几联与婚姻无关，没有收。
note.en: The 'Widow star' is the star that pairs with the 'Lonely star' and rules solitude; 'lonely and empty' is solitary and hollow. The original does not explain it here or say which lines 'Wealth' and 'Output' are (the translation follows the context and takes them as the Wealth and Output lines). The couplets in the same line on the Mourning Gate, Dishevelled Hair, the Five Ghosts and the Sheep Blade have nothing to do with marriage and are not taken.

zh: 天喜星临，必然嫁娶添丁。
yi: 天喜星临着，一定有嫁娶、添丁的事。
en: When the Tianxi star arrives there will surely be weddings and new births.

zh: 咸池入酉，必然花酒生涯。
财入咸池化鬼，女多独守；
子临寡宿化官，男主孤虚。
yi: 咸池星落在酉上，一定过着花酒的生涯。
妻财爻临着咸池而化成官鬼，女子多半独守空房；
子孙爻临着寡宿而化成官鬼，男子多是孤独空虚。
en: The Xianchi star entering You means a life of flowers and wine, surely.
Wealth on the Xianchi star changing into Pressure: the woman is mostly left to keep alone;
Output on the Widow star changing into Pressure: the man is lonely and empty.

title: 喜合婚姻，世应宜静，财官旺相可成：男娶看财、女嫁看鬼，世夫应妇；占夫忌子孙动，占妻忌兄弟动；间爻为媒

rule.yi: 婚姻喜欢卦相合，世爻、应爻宜静，财爻、官爻旺相，婚姻就可以成。世应有动就不成。男家娶妻看财爻（代人占也一样），女家嫁丈夫用官鬼爻；用神忌讳动，出现时怕被冲；旺相可成，世应互相克则不长久。世爻代表丈夫，应爻代表妻子。还要看是谁占：占丈夫忌子孙爻发动，子孙持世就不成；占妻子忌兄弟爻发动，兄弟持世就不成。间爻是媒人，父母爻是三堂，子孙爻是子嗣，都宜静。卦里没有子孙爻，不欢喜。
rule.en: A marriage likes a hexagram that combines; the Self and Other lines should be still, and with Wealth and Pressure strong the marriage can be made. If the Self or Other line moves, it will not succeed. When the man's family takes a wife look at the Wealth line (the same for a divination on someone's behalf); when the woman's family marries her to a husband use the Pressure line. The Subject fears moving, and when it appears it fears being clashed; if strong it can be made, but if the Self and Other control each other it will not last. The Self line is the husband and the Other line the wife. Look also at who is divining: for a husband, fear a moving Output line, and an Output line on the Self means it will not succeed; for a wife, fear a moving Peer line, and a Peer line on the Self means it will not succeed. The between lines are the go-between, the Resource line is the 'three halls', the Output line is the heir; all should be still. A hexagram without an Output line is not a happy one.

note.yi: 开头的小标题「占婚姻」和第一句连在一起，这里从「喜合婚姻」起引。「三堂」在下一条问答里有解释（父母、兄弟、子孙三种爻）。
note.en: The heading 'divining marriage' runs into the first sentence in the text, so the quotation starts at 'a marriage likes a hexagram that combines'. The 'three halls' are explained in the question-and-answer in the next unit (the Resource, Peer and Output lines).

zh: 世应有动便不成，男家娶妻看财爻，代占同。
忌动出现，怕冲，若旺相可成，世应相克不久。
又看何人占之，占夫忌子孙发动，子孙持世不成，占妻忌兄弟发动，兄弟持世不成。
间爻为媒，父母为三堂，子孙为嗣，宜静。
yi: 婚姻喜欢卦相合，世爻应爻宜安静；
财爻、官爻旺相，婚姻可以成。
世应有动，就不成；男家娶妻看财爻，代人占也一样。
女家嫁丈夫用官鬼爻。
（用神）忌讳动，出现时怕被冲；如果旺相可以成，世应相克则不长久。
世爻代表丈夫，应爻代表妻子。
还要看是谁占的：占丈夫忌子孙爻发动，子孙持世不成；占妻子忌兄弟爻发动，兄弟持世不成。
间爻是媒人，父母爻是三堂，子孙爻是子嗣，都宜安静。
卦里没有子孙爻，不欢喜。
en: A marriage likes a hexagram that combines, and the Self and Other lines should be still;
with Wealth and Pressure strong, the marriage can be made.
If the Self or Other line moves it will not succeed; when the man's family takes a wife, look at the Wealth line, and it is the same for a divination on someone's behalf.
When the woman's family marries her to a husband, use the Pressure line.
The Subject fears moving, and when it appears it fears being clashed; if it is strong it can be made, but if the Self and Other control each other it will not last.
The Self line is the husband and the Other line the wife.

Look also at who is divining: for a husband, fear a moving Output line, and an Output line on the Self means it will not succeed; for a wife, fear a moving Peer line, and a Peer line on the Self means it will not succeed.
The between lines are the go-between, the Resource line is the 'three halls', the Output line is the heir; all should be still.
A hexagram without an Output line is not a happy one.

title: 世应有动便不成：世动男家进退，应动女家不肯，空亦然；所忌是财官两爻动；三堂是父母、兄弟、子孙

rule.yi: 为什么世应一动就不成？世爻动，男家进退不定；应爻动，女家不肯；世应逢空也一样。所忌的「二字动」，忌的是财、官两个爻动。「三堂」是父母、兄弟、子孙三种爻。
rule.en: Why does it fail if the Self or Other line moves? If the Self line moves, the man's family wavers; if the Other line moves, the woman's family will not agree; the same if the Self or Other line is Void. The 'two' whose moving is feared are the Wealth and Pressure lines. The 'three halls' are the Resource, Peer and Output lines.

zh: 或问：世应有动便不成何也？
答曰：世动男家进退，应动女家不肯，世应有空亦然。
问：忌二字动，忌何爻动也？
yi: 有人问：世应有动为什么就不成？
答：世爻动，男家进退不定；应爻动，女家不肯；世应有空也是这样。
问：忌讳「二字」动，是忌讳哪个爻动？
答：就是财、官这两个字（爻）。
什么是三堂？
就是父母爻、兄弟爻、子孙爻。
en: Someone asks: why does it fail if the Self or Other line moves?
The answer: if the Self line moves, the man's family wavers; if the Other line moves, the woman's family will not agree; the same if the Self or Other line is Void.
Asked: it fears the 'two' moving; which lines' moving is feared?
The answer: the two words 'Wealth' and 'Pressure'.
What are the 'three halls'?
They are the Resource, Peer and Output lines.

title: 财爻合兄弟妇不廉，五爻持鬼妇貌丑；财伏墓下生离死别，财伏鬼下妇带疾，财伏兄下妇淫荡，鬼伏兄下男赌博，身爻值鬼带暗疾

rule.yi: 看对方的品行、相貌和健康：财爻与兄弟爻相合，这个妇人不守妇道；第五爻持鬼爻，妇人相貌丑；财爻伏在墓爻下面，主生离死别；财爻伏在鬼爻下面，主妇人带病（兄弟爻伏在鬼爻下面也一样）；财爻伏在兄弟爻下面，主妇人淫荡；鬼爻伏在兄弟爻下面，主男子好赌博；身爻是鬼爻，主带暗病。
rule.en: Reading the other party's conduct, looks and health: when the Wealth line combines with a Peer line, the woman is not chaste; with Pressure on the fifth line, she is ugly; Wealth hidden beneath a tomb line means parting alive or by death; Wealth hidden beneath Pressure means the woman carries an illness (a Peer line hidden beneath Pressure is the same); Wealth hidden beneath a Peer line means she is licentious; Pressure hidden beneath a Peer line means the man gambles; if the Body line is Pressure, there is a hidden illness.

note.yi: 「廉」在这里指妇人操守，译作「不守妇道」是按上下文取的，没有别处可对。
note.en: 'Lian' (integrity) is applied here to a woman's conduct; 'not chaste' is taken from the context, with no other text to check it against.

zh: 凡财爻与兄弟合，此妇不廉；
财伏鬼下，主妇人带疾，兄伏鬼亦然。
身爻值鬼，主带暗疾，此又不传之妙。
yi: 凡是财爻与兄弟爻相合，这个妇人不守妇道；
第五爻持鬼爻，这个妇人相貌丑；
财爻伏在墓爻下面，主生离死别；
财爻伏在鬼爻下面，主妇人带病，兄弟爻伏在鬼爻下面也一样。
财爻伏在兄弟爻下面，主妇人淫荡；
鬼爻伏在兄弟爻下面，主男子好赌博；
身爻是鬼爻，主带暗病，这又是不外传的诀窍。
en: When the Wealth line combines with a Peer line, this woman is not chaste;
with Pressure on the fifth line, this woman is ugly;
Wealth hidden beneath a tomb line means parting alive or by death;
Wealth hidden beneath Pressure means the woman carries an illness, and a Peer line hidden beneath Pressure is the same.
Wealth hidden beneath a Peer line means the woman is licentious;
Pressure hidden beneath a Peer line means the man gambles;
If the Body line is Pressure, there is a hidden illness; this is one more unpublished secret.

title: 占妻看财爻、占夫看官爻，都宜静；阳宫端正阴宫丑陋；男占得震巽主再婚，女占得坎离主再嫁

rule.yi: 占妻子看财爻，占丈夫看官鬼爻，都宜安静。阳宫的人端正，阴宫的人丑陋：落在飞神上，应在头面四肢；落在伏神下，应在笨拙、不稳当。男子占得震卦、巽卦，主再婚；女子占得坎卦、离卦，主再嫁。
rule.en: For a wife look at the Wealth line and for a husband at the Pressure line; both should be still. A yang palace means upright looks and a yin palace ugly ones: on the flying spirit it answers in the head, face and limbs, and under it, in clumsiness and unsteadiness. A man who gets Zhen or Xun will marry again; a woman who gets Kan or Li will marry again.

note.yi: 「飞上」「飞下」里的「飞」指飞神（卦上现出的爻），「下」指它下面伏着的伏神；译文按这个读法，原文只有这三个字。
note.en: In 'on the flying' and 'under the flying', 'flying' means the flying spirit (the line shown in the hexagram), and 'under' its hidden spirit; the translation follows this reading, and the original has nothing more to check it against.

zh: 阳宫端正、阴宫丑陋，在飞上应头面四肢，在飞下应拙不稳。
yi: 占妻子看财爻，宜安静；
占丈夫看官爻，宜安静。
阳宫端正，阴宫丑陋，落在飞神上应在头面四肢，落在飞神下应在笨拙、不稳当。
男子占，得震卦、巽卦，主再婚；
女子占，得坎卦、离卦，主再嫁。
en: For a wife look at the Wealth line, which should be still;
for a husband look at the Pressure line, which should be still.
A yang palace means upright looks, a yin palace ugly ones; on the flying spirit it answers in the head, face and limbs, and under the flying spirit, in clumsiness and unsteadiness.
A man who gets Zhen or Xun will marry again;
a woman who gets Kan or Li will marry again.

title: 妻在间爻由女方亲人主婚，夫在间爻由男方亲人主婚，得时旺相皆许成；出现忌日冲，世动男不肯，应动女生疑；用神动成也分离；间动有阻隔

rule.yi: 妻子（财爻）在间爻上，女方有亲人做主婚人；丈夫（官鬼爻）在间爻上，男方有亲人做主婚人；只要得时旺相，都许可成。用神出现时怕被日辰冲；世爻动，男方不肯；应爻动，女方起疑。用神如果发动，即使成了也会分离。间爻动有阻隔，或者是媒人化作鬼爻；如果占的是女子的美丑，另看下一条。
rule.en: If the wife (Wealth) is on a between line, a relative of the woman's side presides at the marriage; if the husband (Pressure) is on a between line, a relative of the man's side presides; so long as it is in season and strong, all may be made. The Subject, when it appears, fears being clashed by the Day; if the Self line moves the man will not agree, if the Other line moves the woman grows doubtful. If the Subject moves, even if made it ends in separation. A moving between line means obstruction, or the go-between turning into Pressure; if the question is the woman's looks, see the next unit.

note.yi: 最后一句「如占女人妍丑」接着是下一条讲相貌的话，和前面阻隔的话并不相连；这里跟着原文标点一并收进。
note.en: The last clause 'as when divining whether the woman is fair or ugly' leads into the following talk of looks and is not connected to the talk of obstruction before it; it is taken in together with the original punctuation.

zh: 妻在间爻，女有亲为主婚；
夫在间爻、男有亲为主婚，但得时旺相，皆许成。
出现忌日冲，世动，男不肯，应动，女生疑。
用神如发动，成也见分离。
间动有阻隔，或是媒人作鬼，如占女人妍丑。
yi: 妻子在间爻，女方有亲人做主婚人；
丈夫在间爻，男方有亲人做主婚人，只要得时旺相，都许可成。
用神出现时怕被日辰冲，世爻动，男方不肯，应爻动，女方起疑。
用神如果发动，成了也见分离。
间爻动有阻隔，或者是媒人化作鬼爻，如占女人妍丑。
en: If the wife is on a between line, a relative of the woman's side presides at the marriage;
if the husband is on a between line, a relative of the man's side presides; so long as it is in season and strong, all may be made.
The Subject, when it appears, fears being clashed by the Day; if the Self line moves the man will not agree, if the Other line moves the woman grows doubtful.
If the Subject moves, even if made it ends in separation.
A moving between line means obstruction, or the go-between turning into Pressure; as when divining whether the woman is fair or ugly.

title: 第五爻为面部，财福旺相持之绝色，父母次之，兄弟持之貌丑；上六爻为头发，火坐之发焦黄；看脚专看初爻

rule.yi: 看女子的相貌：第五爻是面部，财爻、福德（子孙）爻旺相而持在这里，是绝色；父母爻次之；兄弟爻持在这里，相貌丑陋不好看。上六爻是头发，如果火爻坐在这里，主鬓发焦黄。看脚大小专看初爻：初爻是阳，主大脚；初爻是阴，主小脚（缠足）；重爻变化的拆开一半缠；交爻变化的先缠后放。
rule.en: Reading the woman's looks: the fifth line is the face; if a strong Wealth or Output line holds it, she is a rare beauty; the Resource line comes next; a Peer line holding it means an ugly, unlovely face. The top line is the hair; if a Fire line sits there, the hair is scorched yellow. To see whether the feet are large or small look only at the first line: a yang first line means large feet, a yin first line small feet (bound feet); a doubled line that changes is half-bound, and a crossed line that changes is bound first and released later.

note.yi: 「扎脚」「缠」指旧时女子缠足，「重」「交」是掷钱起卦时老阳、老阴的旧称。原文把「重」和「交」写得很省，译文照字面，没有多解释。
note.en: 'Binding' refers to the old practice of foot-binding, and 'doubled' and 'crossed' are old names for the moving yang and moving yin lines in coin-casting. The text is terse; it is translated literally without further explanation.

zh: 第五爻为面部，如财福旺相持之，绝色。
父母次之，兄弟持之，貌丑陋不妍。
上六爻为头发，如火坐之，主鬓发焦黄色。
看大脚小脚，专看初爻，初爻是阳，主大脚，初爻是阴，主小脚，重化拆半扎脚。
yi: 第五爻为面部，如果财爻、福德爻旺相持在这里，是绝色。
父母爻次之，兄弟爻持在这里，相貌丑陋不妍。
上六爻为头发，如果火爻坐在这里，主鬓发焦黄。
看大脚小脚，专看初爻，初爻是阳，主大脚，初爻是阴，主小脚，重爻变化的拆开一半缠。
交爻变化的先缠后放。
en: The fifth line is the face; if a strong Wealth or Output line holds it, she is a rare beauty.
The Resource line comes next; a Peer line holding it means an ugly, unlovely face.
The top line is the hair; if a Fire line sits there, the hair is scorched yellow.
To see whether the feet are large or small look only at the first line: a yang first line means large feet, a yin first line small feet; a doubled line that changes is half-bound.
A crossed line that changes is bound first and released later.

title: 占婢妾专以财爻为主象：财旺吉；动出官主病讼、动出兄主口舌；兄爻合财主外情；财化子善、化官带疾、化兄淫荡、化父老成；定妇人女子看财福二爻

rule.yi: 占婢妾：专以财爻为主要的象。财爻旺相就吉；动出官鬼爻，主生病、招官司；动出兄弟爻，主口舌。兄弟爻和财爻相合而合住，主有不正当的外情。有别的爻和财爻三刑六害，一定因此打官司。财化子孙，性善；财化官鬼，带病；财化兄弟，淫荡不良；财化父母，老成；财化子孙，性情迟缓不管事。分辨是妇人还是女子：看财、福两个爻，生扶身、世而没有冲克的是女子；财福去生官鬼、兄弟，或者官鬼、兄弟旺而动的是妇人。
rule.en: Divining a maid or concubine: take the Wealth line alone as the chief sign. Strong Wealth is auspicious; a Pressure line moving out means illness and a lawsuit; a Peer line moving out means quarrels. If a Peer line and the Wealth line combine and hold each other, there is an improper outside attachment. If any line forms a three-punishment or six-harm with the Wealth line, a lawsuit will surely arise from it. Wealth changing into Output: good-natured; into Pressure: carries an illness; into a Peer line: licentious and of bad conduct; into Resource: mature and steady; into Output: slow by nature and takes no responsibility. To tell a married woman from a maiden, look at the Wealth and Output lines: if they generate the Body and Self lines with no clash or control, she is a maiden; if Wealth and Output generate Pressure or a Peer line, or Pressure or a Peer line is strong and moving, she is a married woman.

note.yi: 「财化子」出现了两次，一次断「性善」，一次断「性迟缓不管事」，原文如此，没有替它改；第二处也许是别的爻之误，书里无从核对。小标题「附：占婢妾」和正文连在一起，这里从「专以财爻」起引。「妇人」「女子」在这里指已婚的和未嫁的，是按上下文取的。
note.en: 'Wealth changing into Output' appears twice, once judged 'good-natured' and once 'slow and takes no responsibility'. The text is left as it stands; the second may be a slip for another line, and there is nothing in the book to check it against. The heading 'Appendix: divining maids and concubines' runs into the first sentence, so the quotation starts at 'take the Wealth line alone'. 'Married woman' and 'maiden' are taken from the context.

zh: 专以财爻为主象，财爻旺相便吉，若动出官来，主生病招讼，动出兄来，主口舌；
若兄爻财爻合住，主有外情不良。
如有爻象与财爻三刑六害，必主因此成讼；
定妇人、女子，看财福二爻，生身世无冲克是女子，财福生官兄，或官兄旺动是妇人。
yi: 专以财爻为主要的象，财爻旺相便吉，如果动出官鬼爻来，主生病、招官司，动出兄弟爻来，主口舌；
如果兄弟爻和财爻相合而合住，主有不正当的外情。
如果有哪个爻和财爻三刑、六害，一定因此打官司；
财化成子孙，性情善良；
财化成官鬼，带病；
财化成兄弟，主淫荡不良；
财化成父母，老成稳重；
财化成子孙，性情迟缓、不管事。
要判断是妇人还是女子，看财、福两个爻：生扶身爻、世爻而没有冲克的是女子；财福去生官鬼、兄弟，或者官鬼、兄弟旺而动的是妇人。
en: Take the Wealth line alone as the chief sign; if the Wealth line is strong it is auspicious; if a Pressure line moves out, it means illness and a lawsuit, and if a Peer line moves out, quarrels;
if a Peer line and the Wealth line combine and hold each other, there is an improper outside attachment.
If any line forms a three-punishment or six-harm with the Wealth line, a lawsuit will surely arise from it;
Wealth changing into Output: good-natured;
into Pressure: carries an illness;
into a Peer line: licentious and of bad conduct;
into Resource: mature and steady;
into Output: slow by nature and takes no responsibility.

To tell a married woman from a maiden, look at the Wealth and Output lines: if they generate the Body and Self lines with no clash or control, she is a maiden; if Wealth and Output generate Pressure or a Peer line, or Pressure or a Peer line is strong and moving, she is a married woman.

title: 占雇取仆从亦用财爻：财不可太过也不可无财或空亡；子化财纯善、鬼化财带疾、兄化财不诚实、父化财稳重、财化兄淫荡；身爻是鬼有疾、是父识字、是兄说谎、是子慈善、是财最好

rule.yi: 雇用、聘取仆从，也以财爻为主要的象：财爻不能太过，也不能没有财爻或者落空亡，那样的仆人慵懒不上进。子孙化财，为人纯朴善良；鬼爻化财，带病；兄弟化财，不诚实，爱说谎、瞒骗别人；父母化财，性情稳重，做事稳当；财化兄弟，多淫荡，难以托付钱财。还要看身爻：身爻是鬼，主有病；是父母，主识字；是兄弟，多说谎；是子孙，主慈善；是财爻最好。如果化出鬼爻，主生病、招口舌；化出兄弟爻，主口舌、不稳当。
rule.en: For hiring or taking on a servant, too, take the Wealth line as the chief sign: it must be neither excessive nor absent or Void, or the servant is idle and unambitious. Output changing into Wealth: simple and kind; Pressure changing into Wealth: carries an illness; a Peer line changing into Wealth: dishonest, lies and cheats people; Resource changing into Wealth: steady in nature and reliable in work; Wealth changing into a Peer line: mostly licentious and cannot be trusted with money. Look also at the Body line: Pressure means illness, Resource means literacy, a Peer line means lying, Output means kindness and charity, and Wealth is best. If it changes out into Pressure, illness and quarrels; into a Peer line, quarrels and unreliability.

note.yi: 这一节是「占婢妾」的接续，讲雇用仆从，和婚姻本身关系不大；收在这里是因为它在《火珠林》「占婚姻」这一条里。
note.en: This part continues 'divining maids and concubines' and deals with hiring servants, which has little to do with marriage itself; it is included because it stands in the Huozhulin's 'divining marriage' entry.

zh: 凡占雇取仆从亦用财爻为主象。
财不可太过，又不可无财并空亡，若如此，慵懒不向前。
兄化财不诚实，多说谎瞒骗人家；
父化财，性重作事稳，财化兄，多淫荡难托财。
又看身爻，身是鬼主有疾；
身是兄，多说谎，身是子，主慈善。
如化出鬼，主生病、招口舌；
yi: 凡是占雇用、聘取仆从，也用财爻为主要的象。
财爻不能太过，又不能没有财爻或者落空亡，如果这样，（仆人）慵懒、不上进。
子孙化成财爻，为人纯朴善良；
鬼爻化成财爻，带病；
兄弟爻化成财爻，不诚实，爱说谎、瞒骗别人；
父母爻化成财爻，性情稳重、做事稳当；财化成兄弟，多淫荡，难以托付钱财。
还要看身爻：身爻是鬼，主有病；
身爻是父母，主识字；
身爻是兄弟，多说谎；身爻是子孙，主慈善。
身爻是财最好。
如果化出鬼爻，主生病、招口舌；
化出兄弟爻，主口舌、不稳当。
en: For hiring a servant too, take the Wealth line as the chief sign.
Wealth must be neither excessive nor absent or Void; if it is so, the servant is idle and unambitious.
Output changing into Wealth: the person is simple and kind;
Pressure changing into Wealth: carries an illness;
a Peer line changing into Wealth: dishonest, often lies and cheats people;
Resource changing into Wealth: steady in nature and reliable in work; Wealth changing into a Peer line: mostly licentious and cannot be trusted with money.
Look also at the Body line: if the Body is Pressure, there is illness;
if the Body is Resource, the person is literate;
if the Body is a Peer line, he often lies; if the Body is Output, he is kind and charitable.
The Body being Wealth is best.
If it changes out into Pressure, illness and quarrels;
if it changes out into a Peer line, quarrels and unreliability.

title: 内身阳鬼丈夫持，外应财阴总是妻：世应相生比和婚大吉；青龙六合扶、三合子孙临更奇；应动遇三刑、外交六害则害无疑

rule.yi: 内边（内卦、身）是阳、鬼爻是阳，丈夫就在这一边；外边（外卦、应）是阴、财爻是阴，总是妻子。世爻、应爻相生，婚姻大吉；世应比和，配成夫妻相宜。青龙、六合扶持就美，三合再加子孙爻临上更妙。应爻动而遇三刑，就是刑，不用再问；外卦交来六害，害是无疑的。
rule.en: With the inner side, the Body, yang and Pressure yang, the husband holds there; with the outer side, the Other line, yin and Wealth yin, that is always the wife. The Self and Other lines generating each other: the marriage is greatly auspicious; the Self and Other in accord, the pairing is fitting. Helped by the Azure Dragon and a Six-combine it is fair; a three-harmony with the Output line present is more wondrous still. If the Other line moves and meets a three-punishment, there is punishment, ask no further; if the outer side meets a six-harm, harm is beyond doubt.

note.yi: 「内身」「外应」的确切所指原文没有交代：可以读作内卦与身一边、外卦与应一边（译文取这个读法），也可以读作别的分法。同样的阴阳配法见《黄金策》第一条。
note.en: The text does not say exactly what 'inner Body' and 'outer Other' mean: they can be read as the inner trigram with the Body side and the outer trigram with the Other side (the reading taken here), or divided some other way. The same yin-yang pairing is in the first unit of the Huangjin Ce.

zh: 内身阳鬼丈夫持，外应财阴总是妻。
世应相生婚大吉，比和世应配相宜。
青龙六合扶为美，三合子孙临更奇。
应动三刑刑莫问，外交六害害无疑。
yi: 内边（内卦、身）是阳，鬼爻是阳，丈夫就在这一边；外边（外卦、应）是阴，财爻是阴，总是妻子。
世爻应爻相生，婚姻大吉；世应比和，配成夫妻相宜。
青龙、六合扶持就美，三合再加子孙爻临上更妙。
应爻动而遇三刑，就是刑，不用再问；外卦交来六害，害是无疑的。
en: With the inner side, the Body, yang and Pressure yang, the husband holds there; with the outer side, the Other line, yin and Wealth yin, that is always the wife.
The Self and Other lines generating each other: the marriage is greatly auspicious; the Self and Other in accord, the pairing is fitting.
Helped by the Azure Dragon and a Six-combine it is fair; a three-harmony with the Output line present is more wondrous still.
If the Other line moves and meets a three-punishment, there is punishment, ask no further; if the outer side meets a six-harm, harm is beyond doubt.

title: 三爻并偶生成少，六位纯阳养育稀

rule.yi: 三个爻并排全是偶（阴），生下的子女少；六个位置全是纯阳，养育的子女稀少。
rule.en: Three lines side by side all even (yin): few children are born; all six places pure yang: children are seldom raised.

title: 男女合同咸泰益，夫妻反目革睽离：夬宫阳壮妻难保，姤卦阴强家不齐；「不有躬」在蒙里断，「夫征不复」在渐中推

rule.yi: 男女同心合意，是咸、泰、益这些卦；夫妻反目，是革、睽、离这些卦。夬卦一宫阳气壮盛，妻子难保；姤卦阴气强，家里不齐整。「不有躬」到蒙卦里去判断，「夫征不复」到渐卦里去推算。
rule.en: Man and woman in agreement: hexagrams like Xian, Tai and Yi; husband and wife falling out: Ge, Kui and Li. In the palace of Guai, yang is strong and the wife is hard to keep; in the hexagram Gou, yin is strong and the household is not whole. 'Not to have a body' is judged in Meng; 'the husband goes on the expedition and does not return' is reckoned in Jian.

note.yi: 最后一联是《周易》爻辞：蒙卦六三「勿用取女，见金夫，不有躬」，渐卦九三「夫征不复，妇孕不育」。这是按卦名断的口诀，和《增删卜易》觉子反对拿卦名断婚的那一条（LY.MARRY.ZS.14）正好相反的一边。
note.en: The last couplet quotes the line texts of the Book of Changes: Meng, third line, 'do not take this woman; she sees a man of gold and does not keep herself', and Jian, third line, 'the husband goes on the expedition and does not return; the wife conceives but does not bear'. This is judging by the names of hexagrams, the opposite side from Juezi's argument against it in LY.MARRY.ZS.14.

zh: 男女合同咸泰益，夫妻反目革睽离。

yi: 男女同心合意，是咸、泰、益这些卦；夫妻反目，是革、睽、离这些卦。

title: 欲知女子如何性：坎聪艮静、兑柔巽恭、坤宽乾刚、离文明、震智慧；容貌：乾面大坤魁肥、艮小坎团圆、兑莹白、震端、巽如雪、离和润

rule.yi: 想知道女子是什么性情：坎卦主心思聪明，艮卦主沉静，兑卦温和柔顺，巽卦恭顺，坤爻宽厚，乾爻刚正；文雅明白的女子是因为遇到离卦，有智慧的男子是因为见到震卦。看容貌：乾宫面部又大又宽，坤主魁梧肥胖，艮卦身体小，坎爻脸团圆，兑家的女子晶莹白净，震位的妻子儿女奇特而端正，巽体的容颜像瑞雪，离宫温和润泽、好看。
rule.en: To know a woman's nature: Kan means a clever mind, Gen calm and stillness, Dui gentleness, Xun respect, a Kun line generosity and kindness, a Qian line firmness and uprightness; a cultured and bright woman is so because she meets Li, and a wise man because he sees Zhen. For looks: the Qian palace has a face large and broad, Kun a big, stout build, Gen a small body, a Kan line a round face; a woman of the Dui house is lustrous and fair, a wife or child of the Zhen position striking and upright, Xun's complexion is like auspicious snow, and the Li palace is mild, moist and pleasing to look at.

note.yi: 这一段是按八卦断性情容貌的口诀。《周易尚占》「八卦断例章」、《文王金钱课》里按卦名断事的句子，库里没有收（那是「某卦主某事」的口诀）；这里收，是因为它属于《火珠林》婚姻章本身，而且讲的是「对方是什么人」这一个问题。
note.en: This passage judges nature and looks by the eight trigrams. The lines that judge matters by hexagram name in the Zhouyi Shangzhan's chapter on the eight trigrams and in the Wenwang Jinqian Ke are not included in this library (they are 'this hexagram means that' rhymes); this one is included because it belongs to the Huozhulin's marriage chapter itself and answers one question, what the other party is like.

rule.en: A marriage divination needs yin with yang; when they move, moving together is also good. If the yang lines do not move and there is just one Wealth and one Pressure, with the Other line yin and the Self line yang, it is the most auspicious. Better still if the Self line sits in the inner trigram: man and woman are reunited and prosper for a hundred years.

note.yi: 「阳阳不动一财鬼」一句语法不清，可读作「阳爻都不动，只有一财一鬼」；译文取这个读法。
note.en: The phrase 'yang yang do not move, one Wealth and Pressure' is unclear in grammar; it is read as 'the yang lines do not move, and there is only one Wealth and one Pressure'.

zh: 占婚本要阴与阳，动时皆动且为良。
阳阳不动一财鬼，应阴世阳最吉祥。
更得世爻居内卦、团圆男女百年昌。
yi: 占婚原本要阴阳相配；动的时候，一起动也算好。
阳爻都不动，只有一个财爻、一个鬼爻，应爻是阴、世爻是阳，最吉祥。
再得世爻在内卦，男女团圆，百年昌盛。
en: For a marriage divination one needs yin with yang; when they move, moving together is also good.
If the yang lines do not move and there is just one Wealth and one Pressure, with the Other line yin and the Self line yang, it is the most auspicious.
Better still if the Self line sits in the inner trigram: man and woman are reunited and prosper for a hundred years.

hits.text: 占婚本要阴与阳，动时皆动且为良
阳阳不动一财鬼，应阴世阳最吉祥
更得世爻居内卦，团圆男女百年昌

title: 本宫无气财有气，妇舍虽贫女容媚；本宫旺相财囚死，妇舍虽贫女不美

rule.yi: 本宫没有气、财爻有气，女方家里虽然贫寒，女子容貌娇媚；本宫旺相、财爻囚死，女方家里虽然贫寒，女子也不漂亮。
rule.en: If the home palace lacks vigor but Wealth has vigor, although the woman's family is poor, the girl is charming; if the home palace is strong but Wealth is imprisoned or dead, the woman's family is poor and the girl is not beautiful.

zh: 本宫无气财有气，妇舍虽贫女容媚。
本宫旺相财囚死，妇舍虽贫女不美。
yi: 本宫没有气，财爻有气，女方家里虽然贫寒，女子容貌娇媚。
本宫旺相，财爻囚、死，女方家里虽然贫寒，女子也不漂亮。
en: The home palace lacks vigor but Wealth has vigor: although the woman's family is poor, the girl is charming.
The home palace strong but Wealth imprisoned or dead: the woman's family is poor and the girl is not beautiful.

hits.text: 本宫无气财有气，妇舍虽贫女容媚
本宫旺相财囚死，妇舍虽贫女不美

title: 妻财独发克父母：财爻宜旺不宜空、宜静不宜动，占婚姻财动必克翁姑；财鬼俱动则父有元神、翁姑不克

rule.yi: 妻财爻独自发动，会克父母爻，也会生官鬼爻。所以妻财爻宜旺、不宜空，宜静、不宜动；只有占脱手货物，才要妻财发动。占婚姻，妻财爻动，一定克公婆（父母爻代表翁姑）；如果妻财和官鬼一起动，父母爻有官鬼这个生它的元神，公婆就不受克。
rule.en: A Wealth line moving alone controls the Resource line and can also generate the Pressure line. So Wealth should be strong and not Void, still and not moving; only in selling goods is it wanted moving. In a marriage divination, if Wealth moves it must control the parents-in-law (the Resource line stands for them); but if Wealth and Pressure both move, Resource has its Support, Pressure, and the parents-in-law are not harmed.

dispute.yi: 《断易天机》说「妻财独发，损书伤父；若乘旺相，婚姻可成」（LY.MARRY.DYTJ.19）：同样是财动伤父，它说只要财乘旺相婚姻就可成；《火珠林》这里说的是财动必克公婆，要财鬼一起动才解。另外《海底眼》占妻看财爻要动（LY.MARRY.HDY.02），《火珠林》自己在婚姻里说占妻看财要静（LY.MARRY.HZL.04），财爻独发这一条和它是一致的。
dispute.en: The Duanyi Tianji says 'Wealth moving alone harms documents and injures the father; if it rides strength, the marriage can be made' (LY.MARRY.DYTJ.19): both agree that Wealth moving harms the Resource line, but that book says that with Wealth strong the marriage can be made, while the Huozhulin here says Wealth moving must control the parents-in-law and is resolved only if Pressure moves too. The Haidi Yan says the Wealth line in divining a wife should move (LY.MARRY.HDY.02); the Huozhulin says in its marriage section that it should be still (LY.MARRY.HZL.04), and this passage agrees with that.

note.yi: 「翁姑」是丈夫的父母，公公婆婆；书里没有说这里是男占还是女占。父母爻在婚姻里代表这一层长辈，妻财是妻子；财动克父母，就是妻子和长辈相克。同一段的头一句「妻财独发，生鬼伤父；问病难瘳，占亲无路」讲病和尊亲，与婚姻无关，没有收。书里的占例一节（第 768 行起，十五件事共用一个卦）里「占婚姻」一条只有这一句「兄动克妻，财动伤翁，不吉」，例卦没有另作说明。「元神」是生用神的那一爻：官鬼生父母，所以官鬼一起动，父母有了靠山。
note.en: 'Weng gu' means the husband's parents, the father- and mother-in-law; the book does not say whether the asker is a man or a woman. The Resource line in a marriage stands for this generation of elders, and Wealth is the wife; Wealth moving and controlling Resource means the wife and the elders clash. The first line of the same section, 'Wealth moving alone generates Pressure and harms the father; in illness hard to recover, in divining a parent no way out', speaks of illness and elders and has nothing to do with marriage and is not taken. In the book's worked-example section (from line 768, one hexagram read for fifteen matters) the entry 'divining a marriage' is only this sentence, 'a Peer line moving controls the wife, a Wealth line moving harms the father-in-law: not lucky', with no further comment on the example hexagram. The 'Support' (yuanshen) is the line that generates the Subject: Pressure generates Resource, so when Pressure moves together the Resource line has its backing.

zh: 大抵财动克父，亦能生鬼；
如占婚姻，财动必克翁姑；
占讼，主克文书，若财鬼俱动者，父有元神而翁姑不克，文书有成。
yi: 大体上妻财爻动就克父母爻，也能生官鬼爻；
不过妻财爻宜旺，不宜空；
要静止不动，不要发动。
只有占脱手货物，才要妻财爻发动。
如果占婚姻，妻财爻动，一定克公婆；
占官司，主克文书；如果妻财和官鬼一起动，父母爻有生它的元神，公婆就不被克，文书也能成。
en: In general a Wealth line moving controls the Resource line, and can also generate the Pressure line;
yet the Wealth line should be strong and not Void;
still and not moving.
Only in divining the selling of goods is the Wealth line wanted moving.
If divining a marriage, when Wealth moves it must control the parents-in-law;
in a lawsuit it controls the documents; but if Wealth and Pressure both move, the Resource line has its Support, the parents-in-law are not controlled, and the documents succeed.

zh: 兄动克妻，财动伤翁，不吉。
yi: 兄弟爻动克妻，妻财爻动伤公公，不吉。
en: A Peer line moving controls the wife, a Wealth line moving harms the father-in-law: not lucky.

title: 世为婚、应为姻，须要相生相合；鬼为夫、财为妇，最嫌相害相刑

rule.yi: 世爻代表男家，应爻代表女家，要相生相合；官鬼是丈夫，妻财是妻子，最怕互相害、互相刑。生合的地方要防冲克，恐怕快成了又被破坏；冲克的地方若得生扶，反而有人从中撮合。财、官都要旺相才吉，最怕三刑六害发动。
rule.en: The Self line stands for the man's family and the Other line for the woman's family, and they should generate and combine with each other; Pressure is the husband and Wealth is the wife, and what is most disliked is their harming and punishing each other. Where there is generation and combination guard against a clash, for fear that what is about to be made is broken up; where there is clash and control, if support comes, someone steps in to help the match along. Wealth and Pressure should both be strong to be lucky, and most disliked are the three punishments and six harms when they move.

note.yi: 这一章开头两句（「天命禀有生之初，非今可易」「夫妇乃人伦之大，自古为先」）是感慨，不是断法，本库没有收。「婚」「姻」按注文是男家、女家。
note.en: The two opening lines of the chapter ('fate is received at the start of life and cannot now be changed' and 'husband and wife are the greatest of human bonds, first since antiquity') are reflections and not rules, and are not included. By the note, 'hun' and 'yin' are the man's family and the woman's family.

yi: 世爻是婚，
应爻是姻，
要相生相合；
en: The Self line is the groom's side,
the Other line is the bride's side,
and they should generate and combine with each other;

zh: 相生相合，定有成就之象。
生合处，须防冲克，恐将成而被破阻。
冲克处，若得生扶，不成之际得人赞协矣。
yi: 世爻是男家，应爻是女家。
相生相合，一定有成就的象。
生合的地方，要防冲克，恐怕快成了又被破坏阻隔。
冲克的地方，如果得到生扶，在不成的时候会有人出来帮着说合。
en: The Self line is the man's family and the Other line the woman's family.
If they generate and combine, this is surely a sign of success.
Where there is generation and combination, guard against a clash or control, for fear that what is about to be made is broken up and blocked.
Where there is clash or control, if support comes, then at the moment of failing someone will step in to help it along.

yi: 官鬼是丈夫，
妻财是妻子，
最怕互相害、互相刑。
en: Pressure is the husband,
Wealth is the wife,
and what is most disliked is their harming and punishing each other.

zh: 财鬼皆要旺相为吉，最嫌三刑六害，发动成凶。
yi: 财、官都要旺相才吉，最怕三刑六害，发动就成凶。
en: Wealth and Pressure should both be strong to be lucky; most disliked are the three punishments and the six harms, which turn unlucky when they move.

title: 阴阳得位为佳、夫妇俱全协吉；占婚用爻首要财鬼，二者俱全大吉，不上卦或落空其婚难成

rule.yi: 阴阳各在其位为好，夫妻双方都在（财、官俱全）就和谐吉利。阴阳得位有两种：卦象外阴内阳，或者应爻阴、世爻阳。占婚以财、官为首要的用爻，俱全大吉；男占女以财为主，女占男以官鬼为主。财、官不上卦或落空，婚事难成，成了也不吉。
rule.en: Yin and yang each in its place is good, and husband and wife both present (Wealth and Pressure complete) is harmonious and lucky. Being in place takes two forms: a hexagram with yin outside and yang inside, or the Other line yin and the Self line yang. In a marriage divination Wealth and Pressure are the first Subject lines, and both present is very lucky; a man divining a woman takes Wealth as the main line, and a woman divining a man takes Pressure. If Wealth and Pressure are absent from the hexagram or fall Void, the marriage is hard to make, and even if made it is not lucky.

note.yi: 注里的「封象」多半是「卦象」之误，译文照卦象译。「纯阴纯阳之谓鬼」的「鬼」书里没有解释，照字面译作 ghost。
note.en: 'Feng xiang' in the note is most likely a slip for 'gua xiang', the hexagram image, and is translated so. The book does not explain 'ghost' in 'pure yin or pure yang is called a ghost', which is translated literally.

yi: 阴阳得位为好，
夫妇双全就和谐吉利。
en: Yin and yang each in its place is good,
and husband and wife both present is harmonious and lucky.

zh: 阴阳得位有两端：有封象外阴内阳，有应阴世阳，二者皆为得位。
一阴一阳之谓道，纯阴纯阳之谓鬼。
yi: 阴阳得位有两种：卦象外阴内阳，或者应爻阴、世爻阳，这两种都算得位。
一阴一阳叫做道，纯阴纯阳叫做鬼。
纯阴不能生，纯阳不能化。
一阴一阳，就是夫和妇。
en: Being in place has two forms: a hexagram image with yin outside and yang inside, or the Other line yin and the Self line yang; both count as being in place.
One yin and one yang is called the Way; pure yin or pure yang is called a ghost.
Pure yin does not give birth, pure yang does not transform.
One yin and one yang make husband and wife.

zh: 又曰：占婚用爻，首要财鬼。
一云：男占妇以财为主，女占夫以鬼为主，其理仿此。
yi: 又说：占婚的用爻，首要是财和官鬼。
两者俱全，称为大吉。
另一种说法：男占女以财爻为主，女占男以官鬼为主，道理相同。
en: It is also said: in a marriage divination the Subject lines are, first of all, Wealth and Pressure.
When both are present it is called very lucky.
Another version says: a man divining a wife takes Wealth as the main line, a woman divining a husband takes Pressure as the main line, and the reasoning is the same.

zh: 设或财鬼不上卦，或落空亡，其婚难成。
yi: 如果财、官不上卦，或者落空亡，这门婚事难成。
即使成了，也不吉利。
en: If Wealth and Pressure are absent from the hexagram, or fall Void, the marriage is hard to make.
Even if it is made, it is not lucky.

title: 世生应乃男求女，应生世乃女贪男；应生世逢墓绝尚在踌躇，世生应被日辰冲克男意被间阻

rule.yi: 世爻生应爻，是男方求女方；应爻生世爻，是女方贪男方。应虽然生世，但遇到墓、绝，女方还在犹豫；有动爻来生，要靠媒人出力。世爻生应，但世爻被日辰冲克，男方心意再浓，也会被人间阻，事情又难成。
rule.en: The Self line generating the Other line means the man seeks the woman; the Other line generating Self means the woman is keen on the man. Though the Other line generates Self, if it meets tomb or extinction she is still hesitating; if a moving line generates it, it must rely on the go-between's efforts. If Self generates Other but Self is clashed or controlled by the Day, then though the man's intent is strong he is blocked by someone, and the matter is again hard to make.

yi: 世爻生应爻，
是男方求女方；
应爻生世爻，
是女方贪男方。
en: The Self line generates the Other line,
so the man seeks the woman;
the Other line generates Self,
so the woman is keen on the man.

zh: 且如应虽生世，奈缘逢墓绝，虽然相贪，尚在踌躇之际。
若得动爻相生，必赖媒妁之力。
如世爻生应，奈世被日辰冲克，男意虽浓，被人间阻，事体又在难成也。
yi: 比如应爻虽然生世，但遇到墓、绝，虽然相贪，还在犹豫不决的时候。
如果有动爻来生它，必定要靠媒人出力。
又如世爻生应爻，但世爻被日辰冲克，男方心意虽然浓，却被人从中阻隔，事情又难成了。
en: Take the case where the Other line generates Self but meets tomb or extinction: though she is keen, she is still hesitating.
If a moving line generates it, it must rely on the go-between's efforts.
Or if the Self line generates the Other line but Self is clashed or controlled by the Day, then though the man's intent is strong he is blocked by someone, and the matter is again hard to make.

title: 世位逢空男心退悔，应爻有动女意更张；世空男悔、应空女悔，世应俱动必改张

rule.yi: 世爻落空，男方心意退缩后悔；应爻发动，女方心意就会更改。世空男悔，应空女悔，即使有吉神也难成。世应都发动，事情一定有更改；发动的爻若被日辰合住，不管愿不愿意也要成。
rule.en: Self meeting Void, the man's heart draws back in regret; the Other line moving, the woman's intent is sure to change. Self Void means the man regrets, Other Void means the woman regrets, and even with a lucky spirit it is hard to make. If Self and Other both move, the matter is sure to be altered; if the moving line is combined by the Day, whether or not you wish it, it will be made.

yi: 世爻逢到空，
就会看到男方心意退缩后悔；
应爻发动，
女方心意一定更改。
en: The Self position meeting Void,
one will see the man's heart draw back in regret;
the Other line moving,
the woman's intent is sure to change.

zh: 若世应俱发动，必然事有改张。
动处若逢日辰合，任君不愿也须成。
yi: 世爻空，男方后悔；应爻空，女方后悔。
即使有吉神，也难成。
如果世应都发动，事情一定有更改。
发动的爻若遇到日辰合，不管你愿不愿意也要成。
en: Self Void: the man regrets; Other Void: the woman regrets.
Even with a lucky spirit it is hard to make.
If Self and Other both move, the matter is sure to be altered.
If the moving line is combined by the Day, whether or not you wish it, it will be made.

title: 世应比和功全资于媒约，阴阳交错事亦系乎因缘：世应比和本无成理，须媒爻动合世应；阴阳交错世应不得位，大象可成亦当入赘

rule.yi: 世应比和（不生不克），本来没有成就的道理，要靠媒爻发动、合住世应才能成。阴阳交错，是世应没有得位；如果大势能成，也应当是入赘，否则夫妻互相欺凌。
rule.en: When Self and Other are in harmony as equals, with neither generating nor controlling, there is by itself no reason for success, and it needs the go-between line to move and combine with Self and Other. Yin and yang crossed means that Self and Other are not in their proper places; if the overall image allows it to be made, it should be a match in which the man enters the wife's household, or husband and wife will overbear each other.

yi: 世应比和，
成全要靠媒人的约定；
阴阳交错，
事情也系于因缘。
en: Self and Other in harmony as equals,
success depends on the go-between's arrangement;
yin and yang crossed,
the matter also hangs on fate's connection.

zh: 世应比和，本无成就之理。
若得媒爻动合世应，其事亦成。
阴阳交错，乃世应不得位也。
若大象可成，亦当入赘，不然，夫妇相凌也。
yi: 世应比和，本来没有成就的道理。
如果媒爻发动来合住世应，这件事也能成。
阴阳交错，是世应没有得位。
如果大势可以成，也应当是入赘；不然，夫妻会互相欺凌。
en: When Self and Other are in harmony as equals there is by itself no principle of success.
If the go-between line moves and combines with Self and Other, the matter can still be made.
Yin and yang crossed means that Self and Other are not in their proper places.
If the overall image allows it to be made, it should be a match where the man enters the wife's household; otherwise husband and wife will overbear each other.

title: 应旺则女室丰隆，世墓乃男家贫乏：夫占妇看应位月建、妇占夫看世爻，入墓休囚必贫，本宫旺而世鬼衰只是虚名

rule.yi: 应爻旺，女方家里富足；世爻入墓，男方家里贫乏。男占女，应爻在月建上旺，是富户，但日下休囚，就是近年略有衰退；女占男，世爻要旺相，男家才豪富，入墓、休囚必然贫乏；本宫虽然旺，但世爻和官鬼都衰，只是虚名。
rule.en: The Other line strong means the woman's household is abundant; Self in the tomb means the man's family is poor. When a husband divines a wife, if the Other line is strong in the Month, it is a wealthy family without office, but if it is resting and trapped under the Day, its wealth has slipped somewhat in recent years; when a wife divines a husband, Self must be strong for the man's family to be rich, and in the tomb or resting and trapped it means poverty; if the home palace is strong but Self and Pressure are both weak, it is only an empty name.

yi: 应爻旺，女方家里就富足丰隆；
世爻入墓，就是男方家里贫乏。
en: The Other line strong, the woman's household is abundant and prosperous;
Self in the tomb means the man's family is poor.

zh: 夫占妇，若应位月建旺，乃素封之家。
若月建虽旺，日下休囚，必近年稍退资财。
若妇占夫，要世爻旺相，则男家豪富；
本宫虽旺，而世鬼俱衰，止是虚名而已。
yi: 男占女，如果应爻在月建上旺，就是有钱而没有官位的富户。
如果月建上虽然旺，但在日辰下休囚，一定是近年来资财略有衰退。
女占男，要世爻旺相，男家才豪富；
入墓、休囚，必定贫乏。
本宫虽然旺，但世爻和官鬼都衰，只是虚名罢了。
en: When a husband divines a wife, if the Other line is strong in the Month, it is a wealthy family without office.
If it is strong in the Month but resting and trapped under the Day, its wealth has surely slipped somewhat in recent years.
When a wife divines a husband, Self must be strong for the man's family to be rich and powerful;
in the tomb, or resting and trapped, it surely means poverty.
If the home palace is strong but Self and Pressure are both weak, it is only an empty name.

title: 子孙发动中途必见伤夫，兄弟交重异日终须失妇：子孙宜静不宜动，动而带贵妻夺夫权，鬼旺不受克加天寡凶杀必伤夫；兄弟克财发动必丧偶

rule.yi: 子孙发动，中途会伤夫；兄弟交重，日后要丧妻。子孙是福德，卦里不能没有，宜静不宜动：动而带贵人、临吉神，是妻夺夫权；官鬼旺而不受克，再加天寡和凶煞，一定伤夫；旺相来得急，休囚来得缓。兄弟克财，发动必丧偶；有官鬼动，或者日辰冲破它，才能化解。
rule.en: When Output moves, the husband will surely be harmed midway; when Peer moves, the wife will be lost in the end. Output is fortune and virtue and cannot be absent from the hexagram, but it should be still and not move: moving with the Noble and a lucky spirit, it is the wife seizing the husband's authority; if Pressure is strong and uncontrolled and adds the Heavenly Widow star and fierce stars, it surely harms the husband; strong, it comes quickly, resting or trapped, slowly. Peer controls Wealth, and if it moves the spouse is surely lost; only if Pressure moves, or the Day clashes and breaks it, can it be resolved.

note.yi: 「天寡」是天寡杀，和「鳏寡杀」是一路的神煞，书里没有另外解释。
note.en: The Heavenly Widow star is the star of widowhood and loneliness; the book does not explain it further.

yi: 子孙发动，
中途一定会见到伤夫；
兄弟交重，
日后终究要失去妻子。
en: When Output moves,
the husband is sure to be harmed midway;
when Peer moves,
the wife will be lost in the end.

zh: 子孙为福德，卦中不可无，宜静不宜动。
若带贵临吉神动，乃妻夺夫权；
或鬼旺不受克，若加天寡及凶杀，必主伤夫。
兄弟为克财，若发动必丧其偶。
若得鬼动，及日辰冲破，庶可解。
yi: 子孙是福德，卦里不能没有，宜静不宜动。
如果带贵人、临吉神而动，就是妻子夺了丈夫的权；
或者官鬼旺而不受克，再加天寡和凶煞，一定伤夫。
旺相来得急，休囚来得缓。
兄弟克财，如果发动，一定丧偶。
如果官鬼发动，或者日辰冲破它，才可以化解。
en: Output is fortune and virtue; it must not be absent from the hexagram, and should be still rather than moving.
If it carries the Noble and moves with a lucky spirit, the wife seizes the husband's authority;
or if Pressure is strong and not controlled, and adds the Heavenly Widow star or fierce stars, it surely harms the husband.
Strong, it comes quickly; resting or trapped, slowly.
Peer controls Wealth; if it moves, the spouse is surely lost.
If Pressure moves, or the Day clashes and breaks it, it may be resolved.

title: 财空妻失、鬼空夫亡：财鬼空亡是占婚大忌，本非成就之象，若干支相合、世应相生尚可半世夫妻

rule.yi: 财爻空是妻子失去，官鬼空是丈夫亡故。财、官同时空亡是占婚的大忌，本来不是能成的象；但若干支相合、世应相生，还能做半辈子夫妻。
rule.en: Wealth Void, the wife is lost; Pressure Void, the husband dies. Wealth and Pressure both Void is a great taboo in a marriage divination and by itself is not an image of success; but if the branches combine and Self and Other generate each other, they can still be husband and wife for half a lifetime.

yi: 财爻空，妻子失去；
官鬼空，丈夫亡故。
en: Wealth Void, the wife is lost;
Pressure Void, the husband dies.

zh: 财鬼空亡，占婚大忌，本非成就之象。
若干支相合，世应相生，半世夫妻也。
yi: 财、官同时空亡，是占婚的大忌，本来不是能成就的象。
如果干支相合，世应相生，还能做半辈子夫妻。
en: Wealth and Pressure both Void is a great taboo in a marriage divination and by itself is not an image of success.
If the stems and branches combine and Self and Other generate each other, they can still be husband and wife for half a lifetime.

title: 男子两财逢二姓丝萝之好，阴人两鬼再一番桃李之鲜：一旺一空是再婚，两财不空带桃花一正一偏，两鬼旺不空遇刑冲克财是生离改嫁

rule.yi: 男占女见到两个财，是先后有过两姓的婚姻；女占男见到两个官鬼，是再有一次婚事。男占女见两财一旺一空，已经做过两次新郎；两财不空、只带桃花，一定是一正一偏。女占男见两鬼一旺一空，必定重婚再嫁；两鬼旺而不空，日辰刑冲财爻，或动爻克财，一定是生离改嫁。
rule.en: A man with two Wealth lines meets a marriage of two surnames; a woman with two Pressure lines has another fresh bloom of peach and plum. A man divining a woman who sees two Wealth lines, one strong and one Void, has been a bridegroom twice; if the two Wealth lines are not Void and merely carry the Peach Blossom star, there is surely one principal wife and one secondary. A woman divining a man who sees two Pressure lines, one strong and one Void, will surely marry again; if both Pressure lines are strong and not Void, and the Day punishes or clashes with Wealth, or a moving line controls Wealth, then there will surely be separation in life and remarriage.

yi: 男子有两个财，
遇到两姓联姻的缘分；
女子有两个官鬼，
又有一番桃李新鲜的婚事。
en: A man with two Wealth lines
meets the tie of two surnames;
a woman with two Pressure lines
has another fresh bloom of peach and plum.

zh: 男占女，见两财一旺一空，曾作两度新郎；
若两财不空，唯带桃花，必一正一偏。
女占男，见两鬼一旺一空，定主重婚再醮；
若两鬼旺不空，日辰刑冲财爻，或动爻克财，必是生离改嫁。
yi: 男占女，见到两个财一旺一空，已经做过两次新郎；
如果两个财都不空，只带桃花，一定是一正一偏。
女占男，见到两个官鬼一旺一空，必定重婚再嫁；
如果两个官鬼旺而不空，日辰刑冲财爻，或者动爻克财，一定是生离改嫁。
en: A man divining a woman who sees two Wealth lines, one strong and one Void, has been a bridegroom twice;
if the two Wealth lines are not Void and merely carry the Peach Blossom star, there is surely one principal wife and one secondary.
A woman divining a man who sees two Pressure lines, one strong and one Void, will surely marry again;
if both Pressure lines are strong and not Void, and the Day punishes or clashes with the Wealth line, or a moving line controls Wealth, then there will surely be separation in life and remarriage.

title: 财动则伤克翁姑，父兴则难为子息：财爻持世必不能奉事翁姑，静还可、动则刑伤；父母发动难于子嗣，带凶杀生后有损

rule.yi: 财爻发动会伤克公婆；财爻持世，一定不能侍奉公婆，静还可以，动就是刑伤。父母爻发动，子嗣艰难；带凶煞，生后有损伤，得救还可以，逢冲则无害。
rule.en: When Wealth moves it injures the parents-in-law: with the Wealth line on Self she surely cannot serve them; if still it may pass, and if it moves it means injury. When the Resource line moves, heirs come with difficulty; with a fierce star there is harm after the birth, which if rescued may pass, and if clashed does no harm.

yi: 财爻发动，就伤克公婆；
父母爻兴旺，就难有子息。
en: When Wealth moves it injures the parents-in-law;
when the Resource line thrives, children are hard to have.

zh: 财爻持世，必不能奉事翁姑。
安静犹可，若发动，则主刑伤也。
若带凶杀，主生后有损，遇救犹可，逢冲则主无害。
yi: 财爻持世，一定不能侍奉公婆。
安静还可以，如果发动，就主刑伤。
父母爻发动，主子嗣艰难。
如果带凶煞，主生了以后有损伤，得到救助还可以，逢冲则无害。
en: If the Wealth line holds Self, she surely cannot serve her parents-in-law.
If still, it may pass; if it moves, it means injury.
If the Resource line moves, it means difficulty with heirs.
If it carries a fierce star, it means harm after the birth; if rescued it may pass, and if clashed there is no harm.

title: 财鬼同居一卦必然亲上成亲，前后皆值六冲当见退后还退：财鬼共一卦易成，前卦六冲曾许聘复退、后卦又六冲成后又退，被日辰合住想退不得，前冲后合退后还就

rule.yi: 财、官同在一卦，是容易成的兆头；世应财官相生相合，一定是亲上加亲。前卦六冲，曾经许过聘又退了；后卦又六冲，成了以后还会退；被日辰合住的，想退悔也退不成；前卦冲而后卦合，退了以后又会回头。
rule.en: Wealth and Pressure together in one hexagram is a sign that it is easily made, and if Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure generate and combine with each other it is surely a marriage of relative to relative. If the earlier hexagram is a six-clash hexagram, a betrothal was once promised and then withdrawn; if the later hexagram is a six-clash again, after it is made it will again be withdrawn; if it is held by a Day combination, though one wants to withdraw it cannot be done; if the earlier hexagram clashes and the later one combines, there is a withdrawal and then a return to the match.

note.yi: 「前卦」「后卦」按上下文是本卦和变卦。
note.en: 'The earlier hexagram' and 'the later hexagram' are, from the context, the original hexagram and the changed hexagram.

yi: 财、官同在一个卦里，
必定是亲上加亲；
前后两卦都是六冲，
会见到退了又退。
en: Wealth and Pressure together in one hexagram,
it is surely a match of kin to kin;
if both the earlier and the later hexagram are six-clash,
there will be withdrawal after withdrawal.

zh: 财鬼共一卦中，此易成之兆。
若世应财鬼相生相合，必然亲上成亲。
前卦值六冲，必曾许聘复退。
后卦又六冲，成后又当见退。
若被日辰合住，虽欲退悔，不可得也。
前卦冲而后卦合，当见退后还就。
yi: 财、官同在一卦之中，是容易成的兆头。
如果世应财官相生相合，必定亲上加亲。
前卦是六冲，一定曾经许聘又退了。
后卦又是六冲，成了以后又会退。
如果被日辰合住，虽然想退悔，也不可能。
前卦冲而后卦合，会退了以后又回头成。
en: Wealth and Pressure together in one hexagram is a sign that it is easily made.
If Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure generate and combine with each other, it is surely a marriage of relative to relative.
If the earlier hexagram is a six-clash hexagram, a betrothal was surely once promised and then withdrawn.
If the later hexagram is a six-clash again, after it is made it will again be withdrawn.
If it is held by a Day combination, then though one wants to withdraw, it cannot be done.
If the earlier hexagram clashes and the later one combines, there will be a withdrawal and then a return to the match.

title: 日辰合世须逢贵客维持，恶杀冲身必被他人说破：日辰带天喜或贵人合世应必有权贵说合，日辰恶杀冲克身世必有小人破阻，动爻来救则无害

rule.yi: 日辰合世爻，会有贵人来维持；恶煞冲身，必被别人说破。日辰带天喜或贵人，合世爻、应爻，一定有权贵的人前来维持说合；日辰带恶煞，冲克身世，一定有小人破坏阻拦；有动爻来救，就没有害处。
rule.en: The Day combining with Self, a person of standing will come to support it; a fierce star clashing with the Body, it is sure to be broken up by others. If the Day carries the Heavenly Joy star or the Noble and combines with Self and Other, some person of standing will surely come to support and arrange the match; if the Day carries a fierce star and clashes or controls the Body and Self, some mean person will surely break it up and block it; if a moving line comes to the rescue, there is no harm.

yi: 日辰合世爻，
必定遇到贵客来维持；
恶煞冲身，
必定被别人说破。
en: The Day combining with Self,
one is sure to meet a person of standing who will support it;
a fierce star clashing with the Body,
it is sure to be broken up by others.

zh: 日辰临天喜，或贵人，合世应，必有权贵之人，前来维持说合。
若日辰恶杀，冲克身世，必有小人破阻。
若得动爻来救，则无害也。
yi: 日辰带天喜，或者贵人，合世应，一定有权贵的人前来维持说合。
如果日辰带恶煞，冲克身世，一定有小人破坏阻拦。
如果有动爻来救，就没有害处。
en: If the Day carries the Heavenly Joy star or the Noble and combines with Self and Other, some person of standing will surely come to support and arrange the match.
If the Day carries a fierce star and clashes or controls the Body and Self, some mean person will surely break it up and block it.
If a moving line comes to the rescue, there is no harm.

title: 卦无父母则应无雁币迎门，财值青龙则会见鸾妆耀目：父母爻是主婚又是聘仪，卦中无父母必无聘礼；财与青龙会合妆奁丰盛夺目

rule.yi: 卦里没有父母爻，就没有雁币迎门的聘礼：父母爻是主婚人，又是聘礼。财爻遇青龙，嫁妆丰盛，光彩夺目。
rule.en: If the hexagram has no Resource line there are no wild-goose-and-silk gifts to greet at the door: the Resource line is the presider at the wedding and also the betrothal gifts. Wealth meeting the Azure Dragon means a rich trousseau, dazzling to the eye.

note.yi: 「雁币」是古时聘礼：雁和币帛。两句注文末尾原书没有句号。
note.en: 'Wild-goose-and-silk' are the traditional betrothal gifts, a goose and bolts of silk. The book's note has no full stop at the end of the two sentences on the gifts.

yi: 卦里没有父母爻，
就没有雁币迎门的聘礼
en: If the hexagram has no Resource line,
there are no wild-goose-and-silk gifts to greet at the door

zh: 卦中无父母，必无雁币之礼
yi: 父母爻是主婚人，又是聘礼。
卦中没有父母爻，一定没有雁币的礼仪
en: The Resource line is the presider at the wedding, and also the betrothal gifts.
If there is no Resource line in the hexagram, there is surely no wild-goose-and-silk gift ceremony

yi: 财爻遇到青龙，
会看到鸾妆耀眼。
en: Wealth with the Azure Dragon,
one will see the phoenix-adorned trousseau dazzle the eye.

zh: 财与青龙会合，必妆奁之资茂盛，绚彩夺目。
yi: 财爻和青龙会合，一定是嫁妆的资财丰盛，色彩华丽夺目。
en: Wealth meeting the Azure Dragon means the trousseau will be abundant, its bright colors dazzling.

title: 鬼化鬼终须反复，兄化兄见阻方成：官鬼是动爻不宜再变，静化还可动化不宜，主事体反复迟滞；兄弟是阻隔之神，兄化兄而大象不吉婚难成

rule.yi: 官鬼化官鬼，终究反复；兄弟化兄弟，受阻才成。官鬼本来是动爻，不宜再变动，静化还行、动化不宜，必定事情反复迟滞；兄弟是阻隔之神，兄弟又化兄弟，如果大象不吉，婚事难成。
rule.en: Pressure changing into Pressure ends in going back and forth; Peer changing into Peer is made only after obstruction. Pressure is a moving line to begin with and should not change further; changing from stillness may pass, changing while moving is unsuitable, and the matter surely goes back and forth and is delayed. Peer is the spirit of obstruction; if Peer changes into Peer and the overall image is not lucky, the marriage is hard to make.

note.yi: 「鬼本动爻」「静化」「动化」书里没有再解释，照字面译：静化是静爻变，动化是动爻变。
