yi: 独静独发不过是看事情成败的快慢，至于吉凶要推用神，如果舍掉用神去决断，迂腐而且错误。
en: Sole still and sole moving only show how fast or slow the matter succeeds or fails; luck and ill must be reckoned from the Subject, and to decide while setting the Subject aside is pedantic and wrong.

zh: 寅月甲辰日，占父远出何日回，得遁之归妹卦：
yi: 寅月甲辰日，占父亲远出哪天回，得遁卦变归妹卦：
en: In the Yin month, on a Jiachen day, a man divined on what day his father, gone on a long journey, would return, and got Dun changing to Guimei:

zh: 断曰：外卦伏吟，在外有忧愁之象。
答曰：内卦辰土父母化巳火回头之生，世爻午火化卯木助火生之，并无有害；
第四爻午火独静，五月必归也。
后三四月乃父在湖广生理，不料省城兵乱，五月方归。
yi: 断语：外卦是伏吟，在外面有忧愁的迹象。
他问：没有害吗？
我说：内卦辰土父母化出巳火回头之生，世爻午火化出卯木助火生它，并无害处；
第四爻午火独静，五月必定回来。
后来三、四月父亲在湖广做生意，不料省城兵乱，五月才回。
en: Judgement: the outer trigram is in Hidden Chant, a sign of worry abroad.
He asked: is there no harm?
I said: the Resource Chen-earth of the inner trigram changes into Si-fire, a turning-back life, and the Self Wu-fire changes into Mao-wood which helps the fire and gives it life, so there is no harm;
the fourth line Wu-fire is alone still, so he will surely come back in the fifth month.
Afterwards, in the third and fourth months the father was trading in Huguang, and unexpectedly the provincial capital fell into mutiny, and he came back only in the fifth month.

chapter: 十八问答·第十八问·诚明不验
title: 十八问答·第十八问·书中例，占伯父何日回：用神伏藏受克而不来，若问平安则父母卯木被日月动爻冲克必不安，问来不来不能这样断；后来果然不来，在外平安（与《增删卜易》同一卦，被占的人是母亲）

rule.yi: 书中例：酉月戊申日占伯父哪天回来，得旅卦变艮卦：这一卦如果问伯父平安与否，卯木父母伏而不现，被日月动爻冲克，必定不平安；现在问的是回不回来，不这样断，只能断用神伏藏受克所以不来；后来果然没有来，他在外面平安。
rule.en: Worked example: in the You month, on a Wushen day, a man divined on what day his uncle would come back and got Lü (the Traveller) changing to Gen: had this hexagram been asked about the uncle's safety, the Resource Mao-wood is hidden and does not appear, clashed and controlled by the Month, the Day and the moving lines, and he would surely be unwell; but the question is whether he comes back, so it is not judged that way, and one can only judge that the Subject is hidden and controlled and so does not come; in the end he did not come, and he was safe abroad.

note.yi: 同一个卦、同一个日子、同样的判词，《增删卜易》行人章记的是占「母」在外何时来，这里记的是占「伯父」何日回——两本书对被占的人说法不同，判词一字不差地相同。
note.en: The same hexagram, the same date and the same judgement are recorded in the chapter on travellers in the Zengshan Buyi as divining when a mother abroad would come; here it is an uncle. The two books name a different person, with the judgement word for word the same.

zh: 第十八问：卜者心诚，断者精明，亦有验，何也？
答曰：此其故在卜者而不在断者，乃卜者之意虽诚，或密事难以语人，或问此而意别有在也，所以有不验之故耳。
yi: 第十八问：卜者心诚，断者精明，也有不验的，为什么？
回答说：原因在卜的人不在断的人，是卜的人心意虽然诚，但有的是秘密的事难以对人说，或者问的是这件事、心里想的却是别的事，所以才有不验的缘故。
en: Question 18: when the diviner is sincere and the judge shrewd, it may still not be borne out; why?

Answer: the reason lies with the one who divines and not the one who judges: though his intent is sincere, either it is a secret matter he cannot tell, or he asks about this while his mind is on something else, and so it is not borne out.

zh: 酉月戊申日，占伯父何日回，得旅之艮卦：
yi: 酉月戊申日，占伯父哪天回来，得旅卦变艮卦：
en: In the You month, on a Wushen day, a man divined on what day his uncle would come back, and got Lü (the Traveller) changing to Gen:

zh: 此卦若问伯父平安否，卯木父母伏而不现，被日月动爻克冲，必不安矣；
今问其回来否，不以此断，只可断用神伏藏受克不来。
yi: 这一卦如果问伯父平安与否，卯木父母伏而不现，被日月动爻冲克，必定不平安；
现在问的是回不回来，不这样断，只能断用神伏藏受克所以不来。
后来果然没有来，他在外面平安。
en: Had this hexagram been asked about the uncle's safety, the Resource Mao-wood is hidden and does not appear, clashed and controlled by the Month, the Day and the moving lines, and he would surely be unwell;
but the question now is whether he comes back, so it is not judged that way, and one can only judge that the Subject is hidden and controlled and so does not come.
In the end he did not come, and he was safe abroad.

title: 总断千金赋·出行最怕往亡，如系吉神终获利：往亡是凶煞，出行遇到它即使大象吉利也断凶是因为它主死，但它若临所喜之爻、发动生扶拱合世身用爻，就当利不当害——神煞的分量轻，五行的分量重

rule.yi: 出行最怕往亡，但如果往亡落在吉神上，终究获利。往亡是凶煞，出行遇到它，即使整个卦象吉利，也断为凶，因为它主死；但如果它落在所喜的爻上、发动来生扶拱合世身和用爻，我一定认为有利而不认为有害。因为神煞的权重轻、五行的权重重。
rule.en: Setting out most fears Wangwang, but if it sits on an auspicious spirit one gains in the end. Wangwang is a baleful star: when setting out meets it, even if the whole hexagram looks lucky it is judged ill, because it speaks of death; but if it sits on a welcome line and moves to give life to, support, embrace or combine with the Self, the Body and the Subject, I must take it as profit and not as harm, because the weight of the stars is light and the weight of the five elements is heavy.

note.yi: 这一联的前半是「虎兴而遇吉神……疾病大宜天喜，若临凶煞必生悲」，这里只取出行一句；「往亡」是旧时选日用的凶煞，主出行不利。
note.en: The first half of the couplet speaks of the White Tiger, the Dragon, the Dark Tortoise, the Vermilion Bird and the Tianxi star for illness; only the line on setting out is taken here. Wangwang is a baleful star of the old day-selection lore, held to make setting out unfavourable.

yi: 出行最怕往亡，
如果是吉神终究获利。
en: Setting out most fears Wangwang,
but if it is an auspicious spirit one gains in the end.

zh: 往亡，凶煞也，出行遇之，虽大象吉利，竟断其凶，因死之故也，若临所喜之爻动来生扶拱合世身用爻者，吾必以为利而不以为害也。
yi: 往亡是凶煞，出行遇到它，即使整个卦象吉利，也断为凶，因为它主死；但如果它落在所喜的爻上、发动来生扶拱合世身和用爻，我一定认为有利而不认为有害。
en: Wangwang is a baleful star: when setting out meets it, even if the whole hexagram looks lucky it is judged ill, because it speaks of death; but if it sits on a welcome line and moves to give life to, support, embrace or combine with the Self, the Body and the Subject, I must take it as profit and not as harm.

title: 出行·父为行李带刑则破损不中、妻作盘缠生旺则丰盈足用：出行以父母爻为行李，妻财爻为盘缠

rule.yi: 占出行，父母爻是行李：旺相就多，休囚就少，带着刑害就是破损的旧东西；妻财爻是盘缠（路费、本钱）：旺相就丰足，休囚就微少，从兄弟爻变出来的是合伙的本钱或借来的。为名为利出门免不了奔波，路上的休咎，神灵能给准信。
rule.en: In divining for a journey the Resource line is the baggage — much if strong, little if resting or trapped, worn and damaged things if it carries punishment or harm — and the Wealth line is the travelling money and capital — full if strong, slight if resting or trapped, and a joint stake or borrowed money if it comes out of the Peer line by change. One who goes out for fame or gain cannot avoid the roads, and the spirits give a sure report of good and ill on the way.

yi: 人不是富贵的人，
怎么能够坐着享受荣华？
只要是为了名利，
哪里能避免在道路上奔波？
可是有时路程远隔千里，
哪里是一天就能跋涉到的？
路上的吉凶，
有谁能够知道？
其中的灾祸和吉祥，
神灵是准确的。
父母爻是行李，
带着刑，就是破损不中用；
妻财爻是盘缠，
生旺就丰足够用
en: Unless a man is rich and honoured,
how can he sit and enjoy glory?
If it is for fame and gain,
how can he avoid hurrying along the roads?
Yet at times the way is a thousand li away,
and it is not to be trudged in a single morning.
The good and ill on the road —
who can know them?
The calamity and blessing within —
the spirits are accurate.
the Resource line is the baggage,
and if it carries punishment it is damaged and unfit;
the Wealth line is the travelling money,
and if strong it is plentiful and enough to use

zh: 出行以父母为行李，旺相多休囚少类，旺空虽有而不多，带刑害破损旧物。
妻财为财物本钱类，旺相充满，休囚微少；
若从兄弟化出必合本，或是借来非已之物也。
yi: 出行以父母爻为行李：旺相就多，休囚就少；旺相而落空，虽有也不多；带着刑害，就是破损的旧东西。
妻财爻是财物、本钱一类：旺相就充足，休囚就微少；
如果是从兄弟爻变出来的，必定是合伙的本钱，或者是借来的、不是自己的东西。
en: In travelling the Resource line is the baggage: strong, there is much; resting or trapped, little; strong but Void, there is some but not much; carrying punishment or harm, it is worn and damaged old things.
The Wealth line is goods and capital: strong, it is full; resting or trapped, it is slight;
if it comes out of the Peer line by change, it is a joint stake, or something borrowed that is not one's own.

title: 出行·世若衰弱哪堪水宿风餐：世为自己，生旺则健，休囚则倦

rule.yi: 世爻代表出门的自己：世爻生旺，身体健壮；世爻衰弱（休囚），人就经不起路上风餐水宿的劳苦。
rule.en: The Self line is the traveller himself: if it is strong he is robust; if it is weak (resting or trapped) he cannot bear the toil of eating in the wind and sleeping on the water.

yi: 世爻如果衰弱，
哪里经受得起露宿水上、风里吃饭
en: If the Self is weak,
how can one bear lodging on the water and eating in the wind

zh: 世为自己，生旺则健，休囚则倦，所以不堪劳碌于风霜中也。
yi: 世爻是自己：生旺就健壮，休囚就疲倦，所以经不起在风霜里劳碌。
en: The Self is oneself: strong, one is robust; resting or trapped, one is weary; therefore one cannot bear toil in wind and frost.

title: 出行·应若空亡难望谋成事就：应爻是所去的地方，最怕空亡，主地头寂寞、谋事难成

rule.yi: 应爻代表所去的地方，最怕落空亡：空了，那个地方冷落寂寞，谋事难成，不能称心如意地回来。
rule.en: The Other line is the place one goes to and most fears Void: if it is Void the place is desolate and quiet, the plan is hard to make good, and one cannot return satisfied.

yi: 应爻如果落空亡，
就难指望谋事成功
en: If the Other is Void,
it is hard to hope that the plan will be made good

zh: 应爻为所往之所，最怕空亡，主地头寂寞，谋事难成，不能得意而回。
yi: 应爻是所去的地方，最怕空亡，主那个地方冷落寂寞，谋事难成，不能称心如意地回来。
en: The Other line is the place one goes to and most fears Void, which means the place is desolate and quiet, the plan is hard to make good, and one cannot return satisfied.

title: 出行·间爻安静往来一路平安：间爻是往来经过的地方，动则途中阻滞，安静则平安无阻

rule.yi: 间爻代表往来经过的地方：动了，途中有阻滞；安静，往来平安没有阻碍；间爻临着财爻或福神发动，途中谋求的反比到了地头还好。
rule.en: The between lines are the places passed through going and coming: if they move there is obstruction on the way; if they are still, the going and coming is safe and unobstructed; if a between line carrying Wealth or Output moves, what is sought on the road is better than at the destination.

yi: 间爻安静，
往来一路平安
en: If the between lines are still,
the going and coming is safe all the way

zh: 间爻为往来经历所在，动则途中阻滞；
若得安静，则往来平安无阻。
临财福动，途中谋望胜于地头。
yi: 间爻是往来经过的地方，动了就是途中受阻滞；
如果安静，往来就平安没有阻碍。
间爻临着财爻或福神发动，途中谋求的比在地头还好。
en: The between lines are the places passed through going and coming; if they move, there is obstruction on the way;
if they are still, the going and coming is safe and unobstructed.
If a between line carrying Wealth or Output moves, what is sought on the road is better than at the destination.

title: 出行·太岁克冲行止终年挠括：太岁发动冲克世爻，出外终年不利，再加白虎更非吉兆

rule.yi: 太岁发动，冲克世爻，这个人出外一年到头不顺利；再加上白虎这样的凶煞，更不是吉兆。
rule.en: If the Tai Sui moves and clashes with or controls the Self, the man abroad has ill fortune the whole year; with the White Tiger, a baleful star, added, it is the more inauspicious.

note.yi: 「挠括」是受阻碍、被束缚的意思。《增删卜易》的千金赋一节讲太岁时说，太岁只在占官事、年运、乡会试、仕宦等几类事里才要紧，出行不在其内（LY.EXAM.ZS.59）；这里却把太岁克冲世爻当作出外终年不利的信号。
note.en: "Hampered" translates a word meaning being obstructed and bound. The Zengshan Buyi, in its section on the Thousand-Gold Rhapsody, says the Tai Sui matters only in a few kinds of divination — official affairs, the fortune of the year, the examinations, taking office — and travel is not among them (LY.EXAM.ZS.59); here the Tai Sui clashing with or controlling the Self is taken as a sign of ill fortune abroad all year.

yi: 太岁冲克世爻，
走动和停留一年到头都受阻碍
en: If the Tai Sui clashes with or controls the Self,
going and staying are hampered all year

zh: 太岁发动冲克世爻，其人出外终年不利，更加白虎凶煞，尤非吉兆也。
yi: 太岁发动冲克世爻，这个人出外一年到头不顺利；再加上白虎这样的凶煞，尤其不是吉兆。
en: If the Tai Sui moves and clashes with or controls the Self, the man abroad has ill fortune the whole year; with the White Tiger, a baleful star, added, it is the more inauspicious.

title: 出行·世伤应位不拘远近总宜行、应克世爻无问公私皆不利：世克应则所向通达，应克世则所向闭塞

rule.yi: 世爻克应位，是我制住对方，所去的方向通达，去了没有阻隔，不论远近都适宜出行；应爻克世爻，所去的方向闭塞，不论公事私事都不利，再遇到动爻、日辰刑克，更不吉利。
rule.en: The Self controlling the Other position is my controlling the other side: the way I go is open and I go without hindrance, and it is fit to set out however far or near; the Other controlling the Self closes the way I go and is unfavourable for public and private business alike, and with a moving line or the Day punishing or controlling as well it is the more inauspicious.

yi: 世爻克伤应位，
不论远近都适宜出行；
应克世爻，
不论公事私事都不利
en: If the Self injures the Other position,
it is fit to go however far or near;
if the Other controls the Self,
it is unfavourable whether on public or private business

zh: 世克应，是我制他，所向通达，去无阻节；
应克世，所向闭塞，更遇动爻日辰刑克，更不吉利。
yi: 世克应，是我制住他，所去的方向通达，去了没有阻隔；
应克世，所去的方向闭塞，再遇到动爻、日辰刑克，更不吉利。
en: The Self controlling the Other is my controlling him: the way I go is open and I go without hindrance;
the Other controlling the Self closes the way I go, and with a moving line or the Day punishing or controlling as well, it is the more inauspicious.

title: 出行·八纯乱动到处皆凶：八纯卦就是六冲卦，六爻不和又乱动，没有吉

rule.yi: 八纯卦就是六冲卦，六爻不和，再碰上乱动，到处都凶。
rule.en: A pure-palace hexagram is a six-clash hexagram, its six lines at odds, and with disorderly movement besides, everywhere is ill.

note.yi: 「八纯」是八个纯卦（乾为天、坤为地、震为雷、巽为风、坎为水、离为火、艮为山、兑为泽），上下卦相同，都是六冲卦。
note.en: The "eight pure" hexagrams are the eight hexagrams doubled from one trigram (Qian, Kun, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Li, Gen, Dui), whose upper and lower trigrams are the same; all are six-clash hexagrams.

yi: 八纯卦六爻乱动，到处都凶
en: In a pure-palace hexagram with the lines moving in disorder, everywhere is ill

zh: 八纯乃六冲之卦，六爻不和又遇乱动，何吉之有？
yi: 八纯卦就是六冲卦，六爻不和，又碰上乱动，哪里还有吉？
en: A pure-palace hexagram is a six-clash hexagram, its six lines at odds, and meeting disorderly movement besides, where is the luck?

title: 出行·两间齐空独行则吉：间爻代表同伴，两间都落旬空，宜自己单独走

rule.yi: 间爻如果空，主途中没有阻滞；间爻又代表同伴，两个间爻都落旬空，宜自己单独走，免得被同伴拖累。
rule.en: If a between line is Void there is no obstruction on the way; the between lines also stand for companions, and if both are in the Void of their ten-day period it is fit to travel alone, so as to escape being burdened by companions.

yi: 两个间爻都空，独自一人走就吉
en: If the two between lines are both Void, travelling alone is lucky

zh: 间爻若空，主无阻滞，又为伴侣，若二爻皆值旬空，宜自独行，庶免同伴之累。
yi: 间爻如果空，主没有阻滞；间爻又代表同伴，如果两爻都在旬空，宜自己单独走，才免得被同伴拖累。
en: If a between line is Void there is no obstruction; the between lines also stand for companions, and if both are in the Void of their ten-day period it is fit to travel alone, so as to escape being burdened by companions.

title: 出行·世动订期变鬼则自投罗网、官临畏宿化福则终脱樊笼：世动则行期已定，变鬼爻去后遭祸，鬼持世是想走不走，鬼化子孙虽有灾不足畏

rule.yi: 世爻发动，行期就定了；世爻、应爻都动宜赶快走；世爻动而变出鬼爻，去后必遭祸患，等于自投罗网；鬼爻持世，是犹豫畏缩、想走又不走的样子；鬼爻化出子孙，即使有灾患也不足畏惧，最终能脱身。
rule.en: When the Self moves the date of departure is fixed; if the Self and the Other both move it is fit to set out quickly; if the Self moves and changes into a Pressure line, one meets misfortune after going and walks into the net oneself; Pressure holding the Self is the look of hesitation and shrinking, wanting to go and not going; and if Pressure changes into Output, though there is calamity it is not to be feared, and one at last escapes.

yi: 世爻发动，行期就定了，
如果变出鬼爻，就是自投罗网；
官鬼临在世上，是畏缩不前的星宿，
如果化出福神，最后能脱出牢笼
en: When the Self moves the date of departure is fixed;
if it changes into a Pressure line, one walks into the net oneself;
when Pressure sits on the Self it is a star of shrinking back,
and if it changes into Output, one at last escapes the cage

zh: 世爻不动行期不定，动则期已定矣。
若世动变出鬼爻，去后必遭祸患。
或鬼持世，乃是逡巡畏缩，欲行不行之象。
鬼化子孙，虽有灾患不足畏也。
yi: 世爻不动，行期不定；动了，日期就已经定了。
世爻、应爻都动，宜赶快出行。
如果世爻动而变出鬼爻，去了之后必遭祸患。
或者鬼爻持世，就是犹豫畏缩、想走又不走的样子。
鬼爻化出子孙，虽然有灾患也不足畏惧。
en: If the Self does not move the date of departure is not fixed; if it moves the date is already fixed.
If the Self and the Other both move, it is fit to set out quickly.
If the Self moves and changes into a Pressure line, one will surely meet misfortune after going.
Or if a Pressure line holds the Self, it is the look of hesitation and shrinking, wanting to go and not going.
If Pressure changes into Output, though there is calamity it is not to be feared.

title: 出行·静遇日冲必为他人而去、动逢间合定因同伴而留：世静被日冲是替别人去，世动被合住是有牵绊，间爻合住才是同伴挽留

rule.yi: 世爻安静而被日辰、动爻暗冲，是别人托他去的，不是为自己谋事；世爻发动而被日辰、动爻合住，是将走而有牵绊，不能起程，只有间爻合住才是同伴把他留住。要断起程的日期，要逢到冲开的日子。
rule.en: If the Self is still and is stirred in secret by the clash of the Day or a moving line, someone else has asked him to go and it is not for his own business; if the Self moves and is held by a combination from the Day or a moving line, he is about to go but is tied down and cannot set out, and only when a between line holds it is a companion keeping him back. To fix the day of departure one must wait for the day that clashes it open.

yi: 世爻安静而遇日辰冲，
一定是为了别人而去；
世爻发动而遇到间爻合住，
一定是因为同伴而留下
en: If the Self is still and meets the clash of the Day,
one goes for another's sake;
if the Self moves and meets a combination from a between line,
one stays because of a companion

zh: 世爻安静，遇日辰动爻暗冲者，他人浼去，非为自己谋也，日辰并起合起皆然。
若世爻发动，遇日辰动爻合住者，是将行而有羁绊，未能起程；
yi: 世爻安静，被日辰、动爻暗中冲动的，是别人托他去的，不是为自己谋事；日辰把它冲起、合起的都是这样。
如果世爻发动，被日辰、动爻合住，是将要走而有牵绊，不能起程；
只有间爻合住，才是同伴把他留住。
要断起程的日期，要逢到冲开的日子。
en: If the Self is still and is stirred in secret by the clash of the Day or a moving line, someone else has asked him to go and it is not for his own business; the same holds when the Day rouses it by clash or by combination.
If the Self moves and is held by a combination from the Day or a moving line, he is about to go but is tied down and cannot set out;
only when a between line holds it is a companion keeping him back.
To fix the day of departure, one must wait for the day that clashes it open.

title: 出行·世爻逢空最利九流出往：世空去不成，强去难得意，只有九流、艺术、公门之人空手问利反吉

rule.yi: 世爻逢空，出行去不成，勉强去了也终究难以得意，白白奔波；只有九流、技艺和公门里的人，空着手去求利，反而吉。
rule.en: If the Self meets Void the journey cannot be made, and going by force one still finds it hard to succeed and runs about in vain; only for people of the nine trades, arts and crafts, and the yamen, going empty-handed to seek profit, is it on the contrary lucky.

note.yi: 「也右」两字在这个本子里是「世爻」的误写（注文接着说「世空去不成」），译文按「世爻」翻。「九流」本指儒、道、阴阳、法、名、墨、纵横、杂、农九家，旧时也泛指各行各业靠本事、手艺谋生的人；这是通行的说法，不是本书的定义。
note.en: The two characters "also right" in this edition are a miswriting of "the Self line" (the note goes on "if the Self is Void the journey cannot be made"), and the translation follows that. The "nine trades" originally meant the nine schools (Confucian, Daoist, yin-yang, legalist, logician, Mohist, diplomatic, eclectic, agrarian) and in old usage also loosely all those who live by skill or craft; this is the usual sense, not a definition given in this book.

yi: 世爻逢空（原文此处误作「也右」），
最有利于九流、技艺的人出外
en: If the Self meets Void (the text here has two garbled characters),
it is most favourable to people of the nine trades and the arts going out

zh: 世空去不成，强去终难得意，徒劳奔走。
若九流艺术及公门等人，是空拳问利，反吉。
yi: 世爻空，去不成；勉强去了也终究难以得意，白白奔波。
如果是九流、艺术和公门里的人，是空手去求利，反而吉。
en: If the Self is Void the journey cannot be made; going by force one still finds it hard to succeed and runs about in vain.
But for people of the nine trades, arts and crafts, and the yamen, it is going empty-handed to seek profit, and so is lucky.

title: 出行·土如遇福偏宜陆地行程：卦中火土爻是陆路，水木爻是水路，临财福则吉、临兄鬼则凶

rule.yi: 卦中火爻、土爻是陆路，水爻、木爻是水路；走哪条路，要看那条路上的爻：临着财爻、福神就吉，临着兄弟、官鬼就凶。土爻遇到福神，特别适宜走陆路。
rule.en: In the hexagram the Fire and Earth lines are the land road and the Water and Wood lines the water road; which road to take depends on the lines on it: if they carry Wealth or Output it is lucky, if Peer or Pressure it is ill. Earth meeting Output is especially fit for going by land.

yi: 土（爻）如果遇到福神，
特别适宜走陆路
en: If Earth meets Output,
it is especially fit to go by land

zh: 卦中火土爻乃是陆路，水木爻是水路。
yi: 卦中火爻、土爻是陆路，水爻、木爻是水路。
如果临着财爻、福神就吉，临着兄弟、官鬼就凶。
en: In the hexagram the Fire and Earth lines are the land road and the Water and Wood lines the water road.
If they carry Wealth or Output it is lucky, if Peer or Pressure it is ill.

title: 出行·鬼地墓乡岂宜践履、财方父向动可登临：官鬼所在方位和它的墓方、世的墓方、克世的方位是凶方不可去，宜去财福所在的方位

rule.yi: 自己占出行，方位都从世爻所在的位置说：官鬼所在的方位，鬼爻的墓方、世爻的墓方，以及克世的方位，都是凶方，不可去踏足；应当去财爻、福神所在的方位，大吉利。
rule.en: In one's own divination for a journey the quarters are all spoken of from the position of the Self: the quarter of Pressure, the quarter of Pressure's tomb, the quarter of the Self's tomb and the quarter that controls the Self are ill quarters where one must not tread; it is fit to go to the quarter of Wealth and Output, which is greatly auspicious.

note.yi: 注文第一句里「木乡」应是「墓乡」（正文是「鬼地墓乡」），译文按「墓乡」翻。这里的方位是按八卦、五行、地支定的方向，书里没有再列方位表。
note.en: In the first sentence of the note "Wood quarter" should be "tomb quarter" (the couplet reads "the ground of Pressure and the home of its tomb"), and the translation follows that. The quarters are those fixed by trigram, element and branch, and the book gives no table of them here.

yi: 官鬼所在的地方和它的墓乡，怎么适宜去踩踏？
财爻所在的方向、父母所向的方位，可以动身去登临
en: How is it fit to tread on the ground of Pressure and the home of its tomb?
The direction of Wealth and the quarter faced by Resource: one may set out and climb there

zh: 鬼地木乡，财方父向，如自占卜，皆以世位而言。
官鬼之方及鬼之墓方、世之墓方并克世之方，此等凶方不可践履；
宜往财福之方，为大吉利也。
yi: 鬼地、墓乡（原文作「木乡」）、财方、父向，如果是自己占，都是就世爻所在的位置说的。
官鬼所在的方位，以及鬼的墓方、世的墓方，还有克世的方位，这些凶方不可去踏足；
宜去财爻、福神所在的方位，最吉利。
en: The ground of Pressure, the tomb quarter (the text has "Wood quarter"), the quarter of Wealth and the facing of Resource are all, in one's own divination, spoken of from the position of the Self.
The quarter of Pressure, the quarter of Pressure's tomb, the quarter of the Self's tomb and the quarter that controls the Self are ill quarters where one must not tread;
it is fit to go to the quarter of Wealth and Output, which is greatly auspicious.

title: 出行·官挈玄爻刑克盗贼惊忧：官鬼临玄武本是盗贼，与世爻刑克则为盗贼担忧

rule.yi: 官鬼临着玄武，本来就是盗贼；如果和世爻相刑克，免不了为盗贼担惊受忧。
rule.en: Pressure on the Dark Tortoise is by nature thieves; if it punishes or controls the Self, one cannot escape fright and worry over thieves.

yi: 官鬼带着玄武，又刑克（世爻），
要为盗贼担惊受忧
en: If Pressure carries the Dark Tortoise and punishes or controls the Self,
one will be frightened and troubled by thieves

zh: 官鬼临玄武本是盗贼，若与世爻刑克，不免盗贼之忧。
yi: 官鬼临玄武本来就是盗贼，如果和世爻刑克，免不了为盗贼担忧。
en: Pressure on the Dark Tortoise is by nature thieves; if it punishes or controls the Self, one cannot escape worry over thieves.

title: 出行·兄乘虎煞交重风波险阻：兄弟加白虎或忌神发动，或鬼在巽宫发动克世，都有风波险阻

rule.yi: 兄弟爻加上白虎、或忌神发动，或者鬼爻在巽宫发动来克世，都有风波险阻。
rule.en: If Peer with the White Tiger, or an Adversary, moves, or if Pressure in the Xun palace moves and controls the Self, there are storms and perilous obstruction.

note.yi: 巽为风，所以鬼爻在巽宫发动被当作风波的信号。
note.en: Xun is wind, which is why Pressure moving in the Xun palace is taken as a sign of storm.

yi: 兄弟爻乘着白虎凶煞、发动，
会有风波险阻
en: If Peer rides the White Tiger, a baleful star, and moves,
there will be storms and perilous obstruction

zh: 兄加白虎及忌神动，或鬼在巽宫，动来克世，皆有风波险阻。
yi: 兄弟爻加上白虎以及忌神发动，或者鬼爻在巽宫、发动来克世，都有风波险阻。
en: If Peer with the White Tiger, or an Adversary, moves, or if Pressure in the Xun palace moves and controls the Self, there are storms and perilous obstruction.

title: 出行·妻来克世莫贪无义之财、财合变官勿恋有情之妇：财动克世恐因财致祸，世财相合而财变鬼克恐因色致殃

rule.yi: 财爻发动刑克世爻，恐怕因财招祸，所以说不要贪不义之财；如果世爻和财爻相合，而财爻变出鬼爻来刑克，恐怕因女色招灾，所以说不要留恋有情的女人；不贪不恋就可以免祸，最终吉利。
rule.en: If Wealth moves and punishes or controls the Self, one fears coming to grief over money, hence "do not covet unrighteous wealth"; if the Self combines with Wealth and Wealth changes into Pressure that punishes or controls, one fears disaster through a woman, hence "do not cling to a woman of feeling"; by not coveting and not clinging one escapes, and it ends well.

yi: 财爻来克世爻，
不要贪不义之财；
财爻与世合又变出官鬼，
不要留恋有情的女人
en: If Wealth comes to control the Self,
do not covet wealth gained unrighteously;
if Wealth combines with the Self and then changes into Pressure,
do not cling to a woman of feeling

zh: 财动刑克世爻，恐因财致祸；
若世与财爻相合，而财爻变出鬼来刑克者，恐因色致殃。
故言“勿贪无义之财”，勿恋可免，于终吉利也。
yi: 财爻发动刑克世爻，恐怕因财招祸；
如果世爻与财爻相合，而财爻变出鬼爻来刑克，恐怕因女色招灾。
所以说「不要贪不义之财」，不留恋就可以免祸，最终吉利。
en: If Wealth moves and punishes or controls the Self, one fears coming to grief over money;
if the Self combines with the Wealth line and the Wealth line changes into Pressure that punishes or controls, one fears disaster through a woman.
Hence the saying "do not covet unrighteous wealth": by not clinging one can escape, and it ends well.

title: 出行·父遭风雨之淋漓舟行尤忌：父母爻是辛劳之神又代表船，动来刑克世爻，必被风雨所阻，坐船尤其忌

rule.yi: 父母爻是辛勤劳苦的神，动了就要跋涉路程、不能安稳；刑克世爻，必定被风雨阻住；父母爻又代表船，克世，行船不利，所以坐船出行尤其忌讳。
rule.en: The Resource line is the spirit of toil and hardship; if it moves one must trudge the road and cannot be at ease; if it punishes or controls the Self, one will surely be stopped by wind and rain; the Resource line is also the boat, and controlling the Self makes travel by boat unfavourable, so it is especially to be avoided when travelling by boat.

yi: 父母爻遭遇风雨淋漓，
坐船行路尤其忌讳
en: The Resource line meeting drenching wind and rain
is especially to be avoided when travelling by boat

zh: 父为辛勤劳苦之神，动则跋涉程途，不能安利；
刑克世爻，必遭风雨所阻。
父为舟，克世行船不利，故尤忌。
yi: 父母爻是辛勤劳苦的神，动了就要跋涉路程，不能安稳顺利；
刑克世爻，必定被风雨阻住。
父母爻又代表船，克世，行船不利，所以尤其忌讳。
en: The Resource line is the spirit of toil and hardship; if it moves one must trudge the road and cannot be at ease;
if it punishes or controls the Self, one will surely be stopped by wind and rain.
The Resource line is also the boat; controlling the Self, travelling by boat is unfavourable, so it is especially to be avoided.

title: 出行·福遇和同之伴侣谒贵反凶：子孙持世最吉，遇好同伴路上平安；但为谒贵而出行则不宜，子动伤官反不利

rule.yi: 子孙爻持世最吉，主碰上好同伴，路上平安；但如果是为了拜见贵人而出行就不适宜，因为子孙发动叫伤官，反而不利。
rule.en: Output holding the Self is the best omen: one meets good companions and the road is safe; but if one travels to call on a patron it is unfit, since Output moving is called wounding the official and is on the contrary unfavourable.

yi: 福神遇到和睦同心的同伴，
去拜见贵人反而凶
en: Output meeting a harmonious companion
is ill for calling on a patron

zh: 子孙持世最吉，主逢好侣，行路平安；
若为谒贵而出行则不宜。
子动谓之伤官，反不利矣。
yi: 子孙持世最吉，主碰上好同伴，路上平安；
如果是为了拜见贵人而出行就不适宜。
子孙发动叫做伤官，反而不利。
en: Output holding the Self is the best omen: one meets good companions and the road is safe;
but if one travels to call on a patron it is unfit.
Output moving is called wounding the official, and is on the contrary unfavourable.

title: 出行·艮宫鬼坐寅爻虎狼仔细：艮为山、寅属虎，艮宫见寅木鬼爻是虎狼，不伤世无害，伤应则伤别人

rule.yi: 艮是山，寅属虎，如果在艮宫见到寅木的鬼爻，就是虎狼；它如果不伤世爻，对我没有害处，如果伤到应爻，就是伤到别人。
rule.en: Gen is the mountain and Yin belongs to the tiger; if Pressure on Yin is seen in the Gen palace it means tigers and wolves; if it does not injure the Self it does me no harm, but if it injures the Other it injures someone else.

yi: 艮宫的鬼爻坐在寅爻上，
要仔细提防虎狼
en: If Pressure of the Gen palace sits on the Yin line,
beware carefully of tigers and wolves

zh: 艮为山，寅属虎，若艮宫见寅鬼，是虎狼也，若不伤世，与我无害，倘或伤应，即伤他人。
yi: 艮是山，寅属虎，如果艮宫见到寅木鬼爻，就是虎狼；如果不伤世，对我没有害处，如果伤到应，就是伤到别人。
en: Gen is the mountain and Yin belongs to the tiger; if Pressure on Yin is seen in the Gen palace it means tigers and wolves; if it does not injure the Self, it does me no harm, but if it injures the Other it injures someone else.

title: 出行·卦见兄逢蛇煞光棍宜防：兄弟爻主劫财，加螣蛇发动必有光棍劫损财物，无制宜防、有制无妨

rule.yi: 兄弟爻主劫财，如果加上螣蛇又发动，必有光棍抢劫、损耗财物；没有制伏要提防，有制伏就无妨。
rule.en: Peer governs robbery of wealth; if with the Coiling Snake it moves, rogues will surely rob and damage one's goods; without restraint be on guard, with restraint there is no harm.

yi: 卦里见到兄弟爻遇到螣蛇凶煞，
要提防光棍
en: If the hexagram shows Peer meeting the Coiling Snake, a baleful star,
guard against rogues

zh: 兄主劫财，若加螣蛇动，必有光棍劫损财物，无制宜防，有制无妨。
yi: 兄弟爻主劫财，如果加上螣蛇又发动，必有光棍抢劫损耗财物；没有制伏要提防，有制伏就无妨。
en: Peer governs robbery of wealth; if with the Coiling Snake it moves, rogues will surely rob and damage one's goods; without restraint be on guard, with restraint there is no harm.

title: 出行·鬼动间中不谐同侣：鬼爻在间爻发动，不是同伴不和，就是同伴里有人生病，克世则自己会后悔

rule.yi: 鬼爻在间爻上发动，不是同伴之间不和，就是同伴里有人生病；如果克世，自己会后悔。
rule.en: If Pressure moves on a between line, either the companions are at odds or one of them is ill; if it controls the Self, one will regret it.

yi: 鬼爻在间爻上发动，与同伴不和谐
en: Pressure moving on a between line: no harmony with one's companions

zh: 鬼在间爻动，若非伴侣不和，即是伴中有病，克世主自有悔。
yi: 鬼爻在间爻上发动，如果不是同伴不和，就是同伴里有人生病；克世的话，自己会后悔。
en: If Pressure moves on a between line, either the companions are at odds or one of them is ill; if it controls the Self, one will regret it.

title: 出行·兄兴世上我费盘缠：兄弟爻主耗费钱财，持世多半白白花费，不在世上而从别人发动则是损耗我

rule.yi: 兄弟爻主耗费钱财：持世，多半是白白花费；不在世位上、从别人那里发动，是损耗我的钱。
rule.en: The Peer line governs the wasting of money: holding the Self it means mostly useless expense; if it is not on the Self but moves from another place, it wastes my money.

yi: 兄弟爻在世位上兴旺发动，我要多花路费
en: With Peer thriving on the Self, I spend more on travelling money

zh: 兄弟爻主耗费赀财，持世则多虚费；
不临世上，动自他人，损耗我也。
yi: 兄弟爻主耗费钱财，持世就多半是白白花费；
不在世位上，从别人那里发动，是损耗我的钱。
en: The Peer line governs the wasting of money; holding the Self it means mostly useless expense;
if it is not on the Self but moves from another place, it wastes my money.

title: 出行·一卦如无鬼煞方得如心：官鬼主祸灾，不宜见到；即使出现，安静或有制伏，也无妨

rule.yi: 官鬼主祸灾，所以整个卦最好没有鬼煞；即使出现了，只要安静或者有制伏，见到也无妨。
rule.en: Pressure governs calamity, so the best hexagram has no baleful Pressure at all; even if it appears, if it is still or restrained there is no harm in seeing it.

yi: 整个卦如果没有鬼煞，
才能称心如意
en: If the whole hexagram has no baleful Pressure,
only then will it go as one wishes

zh: 官鬼主祸灾，故不宜见之；
即如出现，或得安静或有制伏，纵见无妨。
yi: 官鬼主祸灾，所以不宜见到；
即使出现了，只要安静或者有制伏，见到也无妨。
en: Pressure governs calamity, so it is unfit to see it;
even if it appears, if it is still or restrained, there is no harm in seeing it.

title: 出行·六爻不见福神焉能称意：子孙是福德又是解神，不上卦或落空亡就制不住鬼，鬼煞专权恐有灾祸

rule.yi: 子孙爻是福德，又是解除灾祸的神；如果不上卦，或者落空亡，就制不住鬼，鬼煞专权，恐怕有灾祸，所以出行六爻里不见子孙就难以称心。
rule.en: The Output line is virtue and fortune and also the spirit that loosens calamity; if it is not in the hexagram or falls into Void it cannot control Pressure, then the baleful Pressure holds sole power and one fears calamity, so a journey whose six lines show no Output can hardly go as one wishes.

note.yi: 这一联的注文在原书里分在两行，「鬼煞」后面断开，「专权，恐有灾祸」接在下一行，这里合起来引。
note.en: In the book the note to this couplet is split over two lines, breaking after "baleful Pressure", with "holds sole power, one fears calamity" on the next line; the two are quoted together here.

yi: 六爻里不见福神，
怎么能称心如意？
en: If no Output is seen among the six lines,
how can things go as wished?

zh: 子为福德，又为解神，若不上卦或落空亡，不能制鬼，则鬼煞专权，恐有灾祸。
yi: 子孙是福德，又是解神，如果不上卦或者落空亡，就不能制住鬼，鬼煞就专权，恐怕有灾祸。
en: Output is virtue and fortune and also the loosening spirit; if it is not in the hexagram or falls into Void it cannot control Pressure, then the baleful Pressure holds sole power and one fears calamity.

title: 出行·主人动遇空亡半途而返：隔手来占要看谁出行，用神发动遇空亡，走到半路又回来，动化退神也是这样

rule.yi: 别人替人占出行，要看是谁出行：占子孙就看子孙爻，出行的人（主人）就是用神；用神发动遇到空亡，走到半路又回来，发动化出退神也是这样。
rule.en: If someone divines on another's behalf one must see who is setting out: for a child look at the Output line, and the one who goes (the principal) is the Subject; if the Subject moves and meets Void, he goes halfway and returns, and moving and changing into a Retreating spirit is the same.

yi: 主人（用神）发动遇到空亡，
走到半路就回来
en: If the principal (the Subject) moves and meets Void,
he turns back halfway

zh: 隔手来占，须看何人出行，如卜子孙则看子孙，主人者用神也，余仿此。
如动遇空亡，行至半路复回；
yi: 隔手（别人代）来占，要看是谁出行：如果占子孙就看子孙爻，「主人」就是用神，其余仿此。
如果发动遇到空亡，走到半路又回来；
发动化出退神也是这样。
en: If someone divines on another's behalf, one must see who is setting out: if it is a child, look at the Output line; the "principal" is the Subject, and the rest follow this.
if it moves and meets Void, he goes halfway and returns;
moving and changing into a Retreating spirit is the same.

title: 出行·财旺临月建满载而归：财爻旺相临月建，生合持世、不受刑克，必定满载回家

rule.yi: 出行如果财爻旺相、临在月建上，生合持世爻，又不受刑克，一定满载而归；只要能趋吉避凶，就不必担心登高涉险。
rule.en: In travelling, if the Wealth line is strong and stands on the Month, gives life to or combines with the Self, and is not punished or controlled, one will surely return home with a full load; if one can seek the lucky and avoid the ill, there is no need to fear climbing high or crossing danger.

yi: 财爻旺相，又临在月建上，
满载而归
en: If Wealth is strong and stands on the Month,
one returns with a full load

zh: 出行若得财爻旺临月建，生合持世，不受刑克，定主满载回家。
但能趋吉避凶，何虑登高涉险。
yi: 出行如果财爻旺相、临在月建上，生合持世，不受刑克，一定满载回家。
只要能趋吉避凶，还担心什么登高涉险？
en: In travelling, if the Wealth line is strong and stands on the Month, gives life to or combines with the Self, and is not punished or controlled, one will surely return home with a full load.
If one can seek the lucky and avoid the ill, why worry about climbing high or crossing danger?

title: 行人·要决归期但寻主象：主象就是用神——官员看官爻，晚辈看子孙爻，妻奴看财爻，兄弟朋友看兄爻，尊长看父爻，不在六亲里的看应爻

rule.yi: 占行人（在外的人），先找主象，也就是用神：占官员看官爻，占晚辈看子孙爻，占妻子、奴仆看财爻，占兄弟朋友看兄爻，占尊长看父爻，不在六亲之中的人看应爻；要决断他的归期，就看这个主象。
rule.en: In divining for an absent traveller one first finds the principal image, which is the Subject: for an official look at the Pressure line, for the young at the Output line, for a wife or servant at the Wealth line, for brothers and friends at the Peer line, for elders at the Resource line, and for anyone outside the six relations at the Other line; to decide his day of return one looks at this principal image.

yi: 人为了名利，
把故乡生长之处的欢乐都忘了；
家里没有音信，
全靠《周易》的卦来推断。
要决断归期，
只要找主象
en: A man for fame and gain
forgets the joys of his native place;
when the home has no news,
it relies wholly on the hexagram of the Zhouyi to work it out.
To decide the day of return,
one need only look for the principal image

zh: 主象者用神也，卜官员看官爻，幼辈看子孙爻，妻奴看财爻，兄弟朋友看兄爻，尊长看父爻，不在六亲之中者看应爻。
yi: 主象就是用神：占官员看官爻，占晚辈看子孙爻，占妻子、奴仆看财爻，占兄弟朋友看兄爻，占尊长看父爻，不在六亲之中的人看应爻。
en: The principal image is the Subject: for an official look at the Pressure line, for the young at the Output line, for a wife or servant at the Wealth line, for brothers and friends at the Peer line, for elders at the Resource line, and for anyone outside the six relations at the Other line.

title: 行人·主象交重身已动、用爻安静未思归：主象发动行人已动身，用爻安静又无冲并则安居异乡还没想回家

rule.yi: 主象（用爻）发动，行人已经动身；用爻安静，又没有日辰、动爻来冲来并，他就安居在异乡，还没起回家的念头。
rule.en: If the principal image (the Subject line) moves, the traveller has already set out; if the Subject line is still and no Day or moving line comes to clash or join it, he is settled in a strange land and has not thought of going home.

yi: 主象发动，人已经动身；
用爻安静，还没想回来
en: If the principal image moves, the man has already set out;
if the Subject line is still, he has not thought of returning

zh: 主象即用爻也，动则行人已行；
如用爻安静又无日辰动爻冲并者，安居异乡未起归念。
yi: 主象就是用爻，动了，行人已经动身；
如果用爻安静，又没有日辰、动爻来冲、并，就是安居在异乡、还没起回家的念头。
en: The principal image is the Subject line; if it moves, the traveller has already set out;
if the Subject line is still and no Day or moving line comes to clash or join it, he is settled in a strange land and has not thought of going home.

title: 行人·克速生迟、我若制他难见面：用爻克世或世落空亡人很快到，生合世爻回得迟，最忌世爻动克用爻

rule.yi: 用爻发动克世爻，或者世爻落空亡，人一定很快就到；用爻生合世爻，人回得迟；最忌世爻发动去克用爻，那是回不来。
rule.en: If the Subject moves and controls the Self, or the Self falls into Void, the man will surely arrive soon; if the Subject gives life to or combines with the Self, he returns late; most to be feared is the Self moving to control the Subject line, which means he cannot come back.

note.yi: 这一联和十八问答「第一问」前后的行人卦例是配套的；增删卜易行人章开头也说「世克用兮人未动，用爻克世必然归」，是同一个意思（见 LY.TRAVEL 增删卜易行人章）。
note.en: This couplet goes with the travellers' cases around the first of the eighteen questions; the Zengshan Buyi's chapter on absent travellers opens with "when the Self controls the Subject the man has not moved, when the Subject controls the Self he surely comes home", which says the same thing (see its chapter on absent travellers in LY.TRAVEL).

yi: （用爻）克世则快，生世则迟，
我如果制住他，就难以见面
en: Controlling means quick, generating means late;
if I control him, it is hard to meet him

zh: 用动克世或世落空亡，人必速至；
最忌世爻动克用爻，乃未能归也。
yi: 用爻发动克世，或者世爻落空亡，人一定很快就到；
生合世爻，人一定回得迟；
最忌世爻发动克用爻，那是不能回来。
en: If the Subject moves and controls the Self, or the Self falls into Void, the man will surely arrive soon;
if it gives life to or combines with the Self, the man will return late;
most to be feared is the Self moving to control the Subject line, which means he cannot come back.

title: 行人·三门四户用如合世即回家：三、四爻是门户，用爻临在上面发动则归程已近，又无制伏、来生合世爻则可立而待

rule.yi: 三爻、四爻是门户，用爻临在上面发动，归程已经近了；用爻又没有被制伏、发动来生合世爻，就可以站着等他到。
rule.en: The third and fourth lines are the doors and gates; if the Subject stands there and moves, his homeward road is already near; and if the Subject line is not restrained and moves to give life to or combine with the Self, one may stand and wait for him.

yi: 三爻是门，四爻是户，
用爻如果合世，就回家了
en: The third is the door and the fourth the gate;
if the Subject combines with the Self, he comes home

zh: 三四爻为门户，临用爻动，归程已近；
而用爻又无制伏，动来生合世爻者，可立而待也。
yi: 三、四爻是门户，用爻临在上面发动，归程已经近了；
而且用爻又没有被制伏，发动来生合世爻，就可以站着等他到了。
en: The third and fourth lines are the doors and gates; if the Subject stands there and moves, his homeward road is already near;
and if the Subject line is not restrained and moves to give life to or combine with the Self, one may stand and wait for him.

title: 行人·动化退神人既来而复返：用爻化进神行人急回不日望，化退神行人虽来仍返或又往别处

rule.yi: 用爻如果化出进神，行人很快就回，不久可望；化出退神，行人虽然来了仍会返回，或者又去别处；「既来而复返」总的是说回不来。
rule.en: If the Subject line changes into an Advancing spirit, the traveller hurries home and may be looked for before long; if it changes into a Retreating spirit, though the traveller comes he goes back again, or goes elsewhere; "comes and goes back again" says in sum that he cannot come home.

yi: 发动化出退神，
人已经来了却又会返回去
en: If it moves and changes into a Retreating spirit,
the man comes and then goes back again

zh: 用爻若化进神，行人急回不日望；
化退神，行人虽来仍返，或又往处。
既来而复返者，总言不能归也。
yi: 用爻如果化出进神，行人很快就回，不久可望；
化出退神，行人虽然来了仍会返回，或者又去别处。
「既来而复返」，总的是说回不来。
en: If the Subject line changes into an Advancing spirit, the traveller hurries home and may be looked for before long;
if it changes into a Retreating spirit, though the traveller comes he goes back again, or goes elsewhere.
"Comes and goes back again" says in sum that he cannot come home.

title: 行人·静生世位身未动而怀归：六爻安静人不思归，用爻生合世爻则人虽未动身已起归意

rule.yi: 六爻安静，人不想回家；如果用爻生合世爻，人虽然还没动身，已经起了回家的念头。
rule.en: With the six lines still the man does not think of returning; if the Subject gives life to or combines with the Self, though he has not set out the thought of going home has arisen.

yi: 用爻安静而生世位，
人还没动身，心里已想着回来
en: If the Subject is still and gives life to the Self position,
the man has not set out but his heart is set on returning

zh: 六爻安静人不思归，若用爻生合世爻，身虽未动已起归意。
yi: 六爻安静，人不想回；如果用爻生合世爻，人虽然没动身，已经起了回家的念头。
en: With the six lines still the man does not think of returning; if the Subject gives life to or combines with the Self, though he has not set out the thought of going home has arisen.

title: 行人·若遇暗冲睹物起伤情之客况：用爻安静本无归意，遇日辰冲动则睹物思乡将欲回家，月建动爻克之也难起程

rule.yi: 用爻安静，本来没有回家的意思；如果遇到日辰冲动，必定看见东西就想起家乡，将要回家；如果月建、动爻来克它，也难以起程。
rule.en: If the Subject line is still he has no thought of returning; if the Day clashes it into movement, he is sure to be reminded of home by what he sees and is about to go back; but if the Month or a moving line comes to control it, he can hardly set out either.

note.yi: 这一联的注文在原书里分在两行，「将」字后面断开，「欲回家」接在下一行，这里合起来引。
note.en: In the book the note to this couplet is split over two lines, breaking after one character, with "about to go back" on the next line; the two are quoted together here.

yi: 如果遇到暗中冲动，
看见旧物就想起旅居在外的伤情
en: If it meets a hidden clash,
seeing familiar things he is moved by the sorrow of his sojourn

zh: 用爻安静，本无归意，若遇日辰冲动，必然睹物思乡，将欲回家。
倘月建动爻克之，亦难起程也。
yi: 用爻安静，本来没有回家的意思；如果遇到日辰冲动，必定看见东西就想起家乡，将要回家。
倘若月建、动爻克它，也难以起程。
en: If the Subject line is still he has no thought of returning; if the Day clashes it into movement, he is sure to be reminded of home by what he sees and is about to go back.
But if the Month or a moving line controls it, he can hardly set out either.

title: 行人·如逢合住临行有尘事之羁身：用神发动本是归象，被动爻日辰合住则被事绊住，要等月日冲开才到

rule.yi: 用神发动本来是回家的象；如果被动爻、日辰合住，就被事情绊住不能回来，要等月、日冲开它才能到；远的断年月，近的断日时。
rule.en: The Subject moving is by nature the image of returning; if a moving line or the Day combines with it, he is held by some affair and cannot return, and must wait for the Month or Day to clash it open; for far, judge by year and month, for near, by day and hour.

yi: 如果遇到合住，
临到要走时有俗事缠身
en: If it meets a combination that holds it,
just as he is about to leave worldly affairs hold him back

zh: 用神发动本是归象，若遇动爻日辰合之，因事绊住不得归来，须待月日冲之可到，远断年月，近断日时。
yi: 用神发动本来是回家的象，如果遇到动爻、日辰合住它，就被事情绊住不能回来，要等月、日冲开它才能到；远的断年月，近的断日时。
en: The Subject moving is by nature the image of returning; if a moving line or the Day combines with it, he is held by some affair and cannot return, and must wait for the Month or Day to clash it open; for far, judge by year and month, for near, by day and hour.

title: 行人·世克用而俱动转往他方：不宜世克用爻，用爻安静受克仍在旧处，用爻发动人已起程，世动克它而用爻也动则转往别处

rule.yi: 不宜世爻克用爻：用爻安静受克，人还在原来的地方；用爻发动，人已经起程；被发动的世爻克它而用爻也动，就转往别处。
rule.en: It is unfit for the Self to control the Subject line: if the Subject is still and controlled, the man is still in the old place; if it moves, he has already set out; if a moving Self controls it and the Subject also moves, he turns and goes elsewhere.

yi: 世爻克用爻而两边都动，
就转到别处去
en: If the Self controls the Subject and both move,
he turns and goes elsewhere

zh: 不宜世克用爻，若安静受克者，原在旧处；
如被动世克之，而用爻亦动者，则转往他处。
yi: 不宜世克用爻；如果用爻安静受克，还在原来的地方；
如果发动，人已经起程；
如果被发动的世克它，而用爻也发动，就转往别处。
en: It is unfit for the Self to control the Subject line; if the Subject is still and controlled, he is still in the old place;
if it moves, he has already set out;
if a moving Self controls it and the Subject also moves, he turns and goes elsewhere.

title: 行人·用比世皆空难归故里：世爻落旬空人速至，但用爻也落旬空，即使世空也来不了，不可一概而论

rule.yi: 世爻落旬空，人很快就到；但如果用爻也落旬空，即使世爻空，他也来不了；不能一概而论，所以说「用爻和世爻都空，难回故乡」。
rule.en: If the Self is Void in its ten-day period the man arrives soon; but if the Subject line is also Void in its ten-day period, then even though the Self is Void he cannot come; it cannot be said as a blanket rule, hence "if the Subject and the Self are both Void, it is hard to return to his native place".

yi: 用爻和世爻都空，
难以回到故乡
en: If the Subject and the Self are both Void,
it is hard to return to his home village

zh: 世爻旬空者速至，如用爻亦值旬空，纵世空而不能来也。
不可一概而言，故曰“用比世而皆空，难归故里”。
yi: 世爻落旬空，人很快就到；如果用爻也落旬空，即使世空，他也来不了。
不能一概而论，所以说「用爻和世爻都空，难回故乡」。
en: If the Self is Void in its ten-day period he arrives soon; if the Subject line is also Void in its ten-day period, then even though the Self is Void he cannot come.
It cannot be said as a blanket rule, hence "if the Subject and the Self are both Void, it is hard to return to his native place".

title: 行人·远行最怕用爻伤、尤嫌入墓：用神出现不受伤克、不落旬空月破则在外吉利归迟无妨，遇墓绝及日月动爻变刑克皆不吉

rule.yi: 占远行，用神出现、不受伤克、不落旬空月破，主他在外吉利，回来迟也无妨；如果遇到墓、绝，或者日月、动爻、变爻的刑克，都主不吉。
rule.en: In divining a distant journey, if the Subject appears, is not injured or controlled, and is not in the Void of its ten-day period or under a Month-break, he does well abroad and there is no harm if his return is late; if it meets the tomb or extinction, or the punishment or control of the Day, the Month, a moving line or a changed line, all are inauspicious.

yi: 远行最怕用爻受伤，
尤其嫌它入墓
en: On a distant journey one most fears injury to the Subject line,
and above all dislikes its entering the tomb

zh: 凡卜远行，若用神出现不受伤克，不值旬空月破，主在外吉利，归迟无妨；
若逢墓绝及日月动爻变刑克，皆主不吉。
yi: 凡是占远行，如果用神出现、不受伤克，不落旬空、月破，主在外吉利，回来迟也无妨；
如果遇到墓、绝，以及日月、动爻、变爻的刑克，都主不吉。
en: In divining a distant journey, if the Subject appears, is not injured or controlled, and is not in the Void of its ten-day period or under a Month-break, he does well abroad and there is no harm if his return is late;
if it meets the tomb or extinction, or the punishment or control of the Day, the Month, a moving line or a changed line, all are inauspicious.

title: 行人·近出何妨主象伏、偏利逢冲：近出用爻伏藏必因事故不归，值日便到；安静则冲动日到；旬空安静则出旬逢冲日到

rule.yi: 近处出行，用爻伏藏，必定是因为有事故不回，到它值日那天便到；如果安静，到冲动它的那天到；如果旬空而安静，到出旬、遇到冲的那天到。
rule.en: On a near outing, if the Subject line is hidden he is surely kept back by some affair, and he arrives on the day it rules; if it is still, he arrives on the day that clashes it into movement; if it is Void in its ten-day period and still, he arrives on the day that comes out of the period and meets a clash.

yi: 近处出行，主象伏藏有什么妨碍，
反而利于遇到冲
en: For a near outing, what harm if the principal image is hidden,
it is the more favourable if it meets a clash

zh: 近出若用爻伏藏，必因事故不归，值日便到；
如旬空安静，至出旬逢冲日到。
yi: 近处出行，如果用爻伏藏，一定是因为有事故不回，到它值日那天便到；
如果安静，到冲动它的那天到；
如果旬空而安静，到出旬、遇到冲的那天到。
en: On a near outing, if the Subject line is hidden he is surely kept back by some affair, and he arrives on the day it rules;
if it is still, he arrives on the day that clashes it into movement;
if it is Void in its ten-day period and still, he arrives on the day that comes out of the period and meets a clash.

title: 行人·若伏空乡须究卦中之六合：用神伏在不空的飞爻下，等冲飞之日来；伏在空爻下，得日辰动爻合它即出，快则当日、慢则值日

rule.yi: 用神伏在不落空的飞爻下面，要等冲开飞爻的那天才能来；如果伏在落空的爻下面，得日辰、动爻合它就出来；快的当天来，慢的到值日那天到。
rule.en: If the Subject is hidden under a flying line that is not Void, he must wait for the day that clashes the flying line before he can come; if it is hidden under a Void line, it comes out as soon as the Day or a moving line combines with it; at the quickest he comes that very day, at the slowest he arrives on the ruling day.

yi: 如果伏在落空的地方，
要查看卦中的六合
en: If it is hidden in a Void place,
one must look into the combinations in the hexagram

zh: 用神若伏不空之飞爻下，须待冲飞之日可来；
如伏空爻之下，得日辰动爻合之即出。
速则当日来，迟则值日到。
yi: 用神如果伏在不空的飞爻下面，要等冲开飞爻的那天才能来；
如果伏在落空的爻下面，得日辰、动爻合它就出来。
快的当天来，慢的到值日那天到。
en: If the Subject is hidden under a flying line that is not Void, he must wait for the day that clashes the flying line before he can come;
if it is hidden under a Void line, it comes out as soon as the Day or a moving line combines with it.
At the quickest he comes that very day, at the slowest he arrives on the ruling day.

title: 行人·如藏官下当参飞上之六神：用爻伏在官爻下必被凶事拘住，临勾陈跌扑、螣蛇惊恐、白虎或土鬼卧病、玄武盗贼或贪色

rule.yi: 用爻伏在官爻下面，必定被凶事拘住：飞爻临勾陈，是跌扑损伤；临螣蛇，是牵连惊恐；临白虎，或者官鬼属土，是卧病不能回；临玄武，是被盗贼阻住，或者贪恋女色不回。
rule.en: If the Subject line is hidden under the Pressure line, he is surely held by some ill event: with Hook Earth on the flying line, a fall and injury; with the Coiling Snake, entanglement and fright; with the White Tiger, or with Pressure of the Earth element, lying sick and unable to return; with the Dark Tortoise, stopped by thieves, or kept by love of women.

yi: （用爻）如果藏在官鬼之下，
要参看飞爻上面的六神
en: If it is hidden under Pressure,
look to the six spirits on the flying line above

zh: 用爻伏于官爻下，必为凶事所羁，临勾陈跌仆损伤，临螣蛇勾连惊恐，临白虎或官鬼属土卧病不归，临玄武盗贼所阻，或贪色不归。
yi: 用爻伏在官爻下面，必定被凶事拘住：临勾陈，是跌扑损伤；临螣蛇，是牵连惊恐；临白虎或者官鬼属土，是卧病不能回；临玄武，是被盗贼阻住，或者贪恋女色不回。
其余的在下文引证，可以类推。
en: If the Subject line is hidden under the Pressure line, he is surely held by some ill event: with Hook Earth, a fall and injury; with the Coiling Snake, entanglement and fright; with the White Tiger, or with Pressure of the Earth element, lying sick and unable to return; with the Dark Tortoise, stopped by thieves, or kept by love of women.
The rest are cited below and can be reasoned out by analogy.

title: 行人·兄弟遮藏缘是非而不返：用爻伏在兄弟爻下必因赌博，加朱雀是口舌争斗，临白虎为风波所阻

rule.yi: 用爻伏在兄弟爻下面，必定是因为赌博；加朱雀，是口舌争斗；临白虎，是被风波阻住。
rule.en: If the Subject line is hidden under Peer, it is surely because of gambling; with the Vermilion Bird, it is wrangling and fighting; with the White Tiger, he is stopped by storms.

yi: （用爻）被兄弟爻遮藏，
因为是非纠纷而不回来
en: If it is covered and hidden by Peer,
he does not return because of quarrels

zh: 用爻伏于兄弟下，必因赌博，加朱雀是口舌争斗，临白虎为风波所阻。
yi: 用爻伏在兄弟爻下，必定因为赌博，加朱雀是口舌争斗，临白虎为风波所阻。
en: If the Subject line is hidden under Peer, it is surely because of gambling; with the Vermilion Bird, it is wrangling and fighting; with the White Tiger, he is stopped by storms.

title: 行人·子孙把持由乐酒而忘归：用爻伏在子孙爻下必为游乐饮酒，不然被僧道、六畜或晚辈所阻

rule.yi: 用爻伏在子孙爻下面，必定是游乐饮酒；不然就是被僧道、六畜或子孙晚辈阻住，不能回来。
rule.en: If the Subject line is hidden under Output, he is surely amusing himself and drinking; if not, he is held back by monks or Daoists, by livestock, or by his descendants and the young, and cannot return.

yi: （用爻）被子孙爻把持住，
因为贪酒作乐而忘了回家
en: If it is held fast by Output,
he forgets to return for pleasure and wine

zh: 用爻伏于子孙下，必为游乐饮酒，不然因僧道，或六畜，或子孙幼辈之阻，不得归也。
yi: 用爻伏在子孙爻下，必定是游乐饮酒；不然就是被僧道、六畜或子孙晚辈阻住，不能回来。
en: If the Subject line is hidden under Output, he is surely amusing himself and drinking; if not, he is held back by monks or Daoists, by livestock, or by his descendants and the young, and cannot return.

title: 行人·父为文书之阻滞：用爻伏在父母爻下必被文书阻隔，或被尊长、手艺人扣留

rule.yi: 用爻伏在父母爻下面，必定是被文书阻隔，或者被尊长、手艺人扣留。
rule.en: If the Subject line is hidden under the Resource line, he is surely blocked by documents, or detained by an elder or a craftsman.

yi: 父母爻是文书，（用爻伏在它下面）就被文书阻滞
en: Resource is documents: he is held up by documents

zh: 用爻伏于父爻下，必为文书阻节，或因尊长、手艺人拘留。
yi: 用爻伏在父爻下面，必定是被文书阻隔，或者被尊长、手艺人扣留。
en: If the Subject line is hidden under the Resource line, he is surely blocked by documents, or detained by an elder or a craftsman.

title: 行人·财因买卖之牵连：用爻伏在旺财下必为经营买卖得利忘家，财空或遇兄动多折本，加咸池恋色忘归

rule.yi: 用爻伏在旺相的财爻下面，必定是经营买卖得了利而忘了家；财如果空亡或遇兄弟发动，多半是亏了本；如果加上咸池，一定是恋着女色而忘了回家。
rule.en: If the Subject line is hidden under a strong Wealth line, he is surely so pleased with profit from trade that he forgets his home; if Wealth is Void or meets a moving Peer, it is mostly because he has lost his capital; if the Xianchi star is added, he surely lingers over women and forgets to return.

yi: 财爻（下面），是因为买卖而牵连
en: Under Wealth, he is tied up in trade

zh: 用爻伏于旺财下，必为经营买卖得利忘家；
财若空亡或遇兄动，多因折本；
若加咸池，定然恋色而忘归。
yi: 用爻伏在旺相的财爻下面，必定是经营买卖得了利而忘了家；
财如果空亡或者遇到兄弟发动，多半是亏了本；
如果加上咸池，一定是恋着女色而忘了回家。
en: If the Subject line is hidden under a strong Wealth line, he is surely so pleased with profit from trade that he forgets his home;
if Wealth is Void or meets a moving Peer, it is mostly because he has lost his capital;
if the Xianchi star is added, he surely lingers over women and forgets to return.

title: 行人·用伏应财之下身赘他人：用爻伏在应位阴财爻下必入赘他人，若临阳象生合世身则必替别人掌财不回

rule.yi: 用爻伏在应位的阴财爻下面，必定是入赘到别人家；如果临阳象、生合世身，必定是替别人掌管财物、不回来。
rule.en: If the Subject line is hidden under a yin Wealth line at the Other position, he has surely entered another's house as a son-in-law; if it stands on a yang image and gives life to or combines with the Self and Body, he is surely managing another's wealth and does not return.

yi: 用爻伏在应位的财爻下面，
人是入赘到别人家了
en: If the Subject line is hidden under the Wealth line at the Other position,
he has gone as a son-in-law into another's house

zh: 用爻伏于应位阴财之下，必赘他人；
若临阳象生合世身，必代他人掌财不返。
yi: 用爻伏在应位的阴财爻下面，必定是入赘别人家；
如果临阳象生合世身，必定是替别人掌管财物不回来。
en: If the Subject line is hidden under a yin Wealth line at the Other position, he has surely entered another's house as a son-in-law;
if it stands on a yang image and gives life to or combines with the Self and Body, he is surely managing another's wealth and does not return.

title: 行人·主投财库之中名留富室：用爻伏在财库下，其人必在富家掌财；伏神遇墓绝则只是依傍度日

rule.yi: 用爻伏在财库下面，这个人必定在富家掌管财物；伏神如果遇到墓、绝，就只是依靠别人过日子罢了。
rule.en: If the Subject line is hidden under the treasury of Wealth, the man is surely managing wealth in a rich family; if the hidden line meets the tomb or extinction, he is merely living in dependence on others.

yi: 用爻投入财库之中，
名字留在富户人家
en: If the Subject has fallen into the treasury of Wealth,
his name is left in a rich house

zh: 用爻伏于财库下，其人必在富家掌财；
伏神如遇墓绝，则是依傍度日耳。
yi: 用爻伏在财库下面，这个人必定在富家掌管财物；
伏神如果遇到墓、绝，就只是依靠别人过日子罢了。
en: If the Subject line is hidden under the treasury of Wealth, the man is surely managing wealth in a rich family;
if the hidden line meets the tomb or extinction, he is merely living in dependence on others.

title: 行人·五爻有鬼皆因途路之不通：用爻伏在五爻官鬼之下，必因关津不通而被阻

rule.yi: 用爻伏在第五爻的官鬼下面，必定是因为关口、渡口不通而被阻住。
rule.en: If the Subject line is hidden under the Pressure line in the fifth place, he is surely stopped because the passes and ferries are closed.

note.yi: 原书这一行把两联写在了一起（「五爻有鬼……」「一卦无财……」），这里按联拆成两条，各取各的注。
note.en: The book writes two couplets together on this line ("Pressure in the fifth place ..." and "no Wealth in the hexagram ..."); they are split here into two entries, each with its own note.

yi: 第五爻上有官鬼，
都是因为路途不通
en: If there is Pressure on the fifth line,
it is all because the road is blocked

zh: 用爻伏于五爻官鬼之下，必因关津不通而阻也。
yi: 用爻伏在五爻的官鬼下面，必定因关口渡口不通而被阻。
en: If the Subject line is hidden under the Pressure line in the fifth place, he is surely stopped because the passes and ferries are closed.

title: 行人·一卦无财只为盘缠之缺乏：卦中动、变、日月都没有财爻，是没有路费所以不回

rule.yi: 卦中动爻、变爻、日月都没有财爻的，是没有路费，所以不回来。
rule.en: If neither the moving lines, the changed lines, nor the Day and Month show a Wealth line, he does not return for lack of travelling money.

yi: 整个卦没有财爻，
只是因为路费缺乏
en: If the whole hexagram has no Wealth,
it is only for lack of travelling money

zh: 卦中动变日月皆无财爻者，为无路费不归。
yi: 卦中动、变、日月都没有财爻的，是没有路费所以不回。
en: If neither the moving lines, the changed lines, nor the Day and Month show a Wealth line, he does not return for lack of travelling money.

title: 行人·墓持墓动必然卧病呻吟：用爻墓化墓、持鬼墓、伏鬼墓爻下都主卧病不回；伏官爻下或临白虎则是在狱中，不是病

rule.yi: 用爻如果墓化墓，或者持着鬼的墓，或者伏在鬼墓爻下面，都主卧病不能回；如果伏在官爻下面、或临白虎，必定是在监狱里，不是生病。
rule.en: If the Subject line goes from a tomb to a tomb, or holds the tomb of Pressure, or is hidden under the tomb line of Pressure, he lies sick and does not return; if it is hidden under the Pressure line or stands on the White Tiger, he is surely in prison and not sick.

yi: 持着墓、墓发动，
必定卧病呻吟
en: With the tomb held and the tomb moving,
he is surely lying sick and groaning

zh: 用爻如墓化墓，或持鬼墓，或伏于鬼墓爻下者，皆主卧病不回；
若伏官爻下或临白虎，必在狱中，非病也。
yi: 用爻如果墓化墓，或者持着鬼的墓，或者伏在鬼墓爻下面，都主卧病不回；
如果伏在官爻下面或临白虎，必定是在监狱里，不是生病。
en: If the Subject line goes from a tomb to a tomb, or holds the tomb of Pressure, or is hidden under the tomb line of Pressure, he lies sick and does not return;
if it is hidden under the Pressure line or stands on the White Tiger, he is surely in prison and not sick.

title: 行人·世合世冲须用遣人寻觅：用爻安静而世爻发动冲起合起它，或用爻伏藏世去提起、用爻入墓世去破墓，都宜自己去寻找他才回来

rule.yi: 用爻安静而世爻发动把它冲起、合起，或者用爻伏藏、世爻去把它提起，或者用爻入墓、世爻去冲破墓，都应当自己去寻找，他才会回来。
rule.en: If the Subject line is still and a moving Self rouses it by clash or combination, or if the Subject is hidden and the Self draws it out, or if the Subject has entered a tomb and the Self breaks the tomb open, one should go and look for him oneself, and then he returns.

yi: 世爻合它、世爻冲它，
就要派人去寻找
en: If the Self combines with it or clashes it,
one must send someone to look for him

zh: 用爻安静而世动冲起之，合起之，用爻伏藏世去提起，若用爻入墓世去破墓，皆宜自去寻觅方回。
yi: 用爻安静而世动冲起它、合起它，用爻伏藏世去提起它，或者用爻入墓世去破墓，都宜自己去寻找才回来。
en: If the Subject line is still and a moving Self rouses it by clash or combination, or if the Subject is hidden and the Self draws it out, or if the Subject has entered a tomb and the Self breaks the tomb open, one should go and look for him oneself, and then he returns.

title: 行人·合逢玄武昏迷酒色不思乡：用爻临玄武被财爻合住，或伏在玄武财爻下，都是贪花恋色不想家；伏玄武鬼爻下而财不合，是在外做了贼

rule.yi: 用爻临玄武发动而被财爻合住，或者用爻伏在玄武临的财爻下面，都是贪花恋色、不想家乡，要等冲破合住它的爻才可能回来；如果用爻伏在玄武临的鬼爻下面，而财爻不来合，这个人在外面做了贼，没有回来。
rule.en: If the Subject line stands on the Dark Tortoise and moves and is held by a combination from a Wealth line, or is hidden under a Wealth line on the Dark Tortoise, it means indulging in dissipation and not thinking of home, and he can return only when the combining line is clashed or broken; if the Subject line is hidden under a Pressure line on the Dark Tortoise and the Wealth line does not combine with it, the man has become a thief abroad and has not returned.

yi: （用爻）被合又逢玄武，
沉迷酒色而不想家乡
en: If the Subject is held by a combination and meets the Dark Tortoise,
he is lost in wine and women and does not think of home

zh: 或用临玄武动而遇财爻合住，或用伏玄武财下，皆主贪花恋色不思乡也。
若用伏玄武鬼下，而财爻不相合者，其人在外为贼未归也。
yi: 或者用爻临玄武发动而被财爻合住，或者用爻伏在玄武临的财爻下面，都主贪花恋色、不想家乡。
要等冲破合住它的爻，才可能回来；
如果用爻伏在玄武临的鬼爻下面，而财爻不来合，这个人在外面做了贼，没有回来。
en: If the Subject line stands on the Dark Tortoise and moves and is held by a combination from a Wealth line, or is hidden under a Wealth line on the Dark Tortoise, it means indulging in dissipation and not thinking of home.
he can return only when the combining line is clashed or broken;
if the Subject line is hidden under a Pressure line on the Dark Tortoise and the Wealth line does not combine with it, the man has become a thief abroad and has not returned.

title: 行人·卦得游魂漂泊他乡无定迹：游魂卦用爻发动行人东奔西走，游魂化游魂行踪不定，游魂化归魂游遍才回

rule.yi: 游魂卦里用爻发动，行人东奔西走，不在一个地方；游魂卦变游魂卦，行踪不定；游魂卦变归魂卦，走遍各处才回来。
rule.en: In a Wandering Soul hexagram, if the Subject line moves the traveller hurries east and west and is not in one place; a Wandering Soul hexagram changing into a Wandering Soul hexagram means his whereabouts are not fixed; a Wandering Soul hexagram changing into a Returning Soul hexagram means he returns only after wandering everywhere.

yi: 卦得游魂，
漂泊在他乡，没有固定的行踪
en: If the hexagram is a Wandering Soul,
he drifts in a strange land with no fixed trace

zh: 游魂卦用爻发动，行人东奔西走不在一方；
yi: 游魂卦用爻发动，行人东奔西走，不在一个地方；
游魂卦变游魂卦，行踪不定；
游魂卦变归魂卦，走遍各处才回来。
en: In a Wandering Soul hexagram, if the Subject line moves the traveller hurries east and west and is not in one place;
a Wandering Soul hexagram changing into a Wandering Soul hexagram means his whereabouts are not fixed;
a Wandering Soul hexagram changing into a Returning Soul hexagram means he returns only after wandering everywhere.

title: 行人·日并忌兴休望到、身临用发必然归：忌神临身世或日辰克用都主不归，用爻临身世、出现发动或持世动则立可望归

rule.yi: 忌神临在身、世上，或者日辰克用爻，都主他不回来；如果用爻临在身、世上，出现发动，或者持世而动，立刻可以盼他回来。
rule.en: If the Adversary stands on the Body or the Self, or the Day controls the Subject line, he does not return; if the Subject stands on the Body or the Self, appears and moves, or holds the Self and moves, he may be looked for at once.

yi: 日辰与忌神同旺，就别指望他到，
用爻临在身、世上并且发动，他必定回来
en: If the Day joins with a flourishing Adversary, do not hope for his arrival;
if the Subject stands on the Body or the Self and moves, he will surely return

zh: 忌神临身世或日辰克用，皆主不归；
若得用临身世，出现发动或持世动，立可望归。
yi: 忌神临在身、世上，或者日辰克用爻，都主不回；
如果用爻临在身、世上，出现发动，或者持世而动，立刻可望他回来。
en: If the Adversary stands on the Body or the Self, or the Day controls the Subject line, he does not return;
if the Subject stands on the Body or the Self, appears and moves, or holds the Self and moves, he may be looked for at once.

title: 行人·父动卦中当有鱼书之寄：占书信，卦中父母爻发动，主有音信寄来

rule.yi: 占书信，卦里有父母爻发动，主有音信寄来。
rule.en: In divining for a letter, if a Resource line moves in the hexagram a letter will be sent.

note.yi: 「鱼书」是书信的雅称，出自旧时鲤鱼传书的说法。
note.en: "Fish letter" is an elegant name for a letter, from the old tale of a letter carried in a carp.

yi: 父母爻在卦中发动，
应当有书信寄来
en: If the Resource line moves in the hexagram,
a letter should be sent

zh: 凡占书信，卦有父母爻动，主有音信寄来。
yi: 凡是占书信，卦里有父母爻发动，主有音信寄来。
en: In divining for a letter, if a Resource line moves in the hexagram a letter will be sent.

title: 行人·财兴世上应无信之来：单占书信以父母爻为用神，世爻持财发动则克父母，所以没有书信到来

rule.yi: 单独占书信，以父母爻为用神；如果世爻带着财爻发动，就克了父母，所以没有书信到来。
rule.en: In divining for a letter alone, the Resource line is the Subject; if the Self carries a moving Wealth line it controls Resource, so no letter comes.

yi: 财爻在世位上兴旺发动，
应该没有书信到来
en: If Wealth flourishes and moves on the Self,
no letter should come

zh: 独占书信，以父母爻为用神，若世持财动则克父矣，故无雁信之来也。
yi: 单独占书信，以父母爻为用神，如果世爻带着财爻发动就克了父母，所以没有书信到来。
en: In divining for a letter alone, the Resource line is the Subject; if the Self carries a moving Wealth line it controls Resource, so no letter comes.

title: 行人·欲决归期之远近须详主象之兴衰：断归期全在合待冲、冲待合、空待出旬、破待补合、绝待逢生、墓待冲开；远近兼看兴衰

rule.yi: 断归期，要用这些方法推详：被合住的等冲、被冲的等合、空的等出旬、破的等补合、绝的等逢生、入墓的等冲开；远近还要兼看主象的兴衰。
rule.en: To judge the return, work it out by these methods: a combined line waits for a clash, a clashed line waits for a combination, a Void line waits for the end of the ten-day period, a broken line waits for repair or combination, an extinct line waits for life, and a tombed line waits to be clashed open; whether it is far or near is also judged by the rise and fall of the principal image.

yi: 要决断归期的远近，
要详察主象的兴衰
en: To decide whether the return is far or near,
one must examine the rise and fall of the principal image

zh: 断归期，全在合待冲、冲待合、空待出旬、破待补合、绝待逢生、墓待冲开等法，当以如是推详。
yi: 断归期，全在合住的等冲、被冲的等合、空的等出旬、破的等补合、绝的等逢生、入墓的等冲开这些方法，应当这样推详。
要知道远近，还要兼看（主象的）兴衰。
en: To judge the return, everything lies in such methods as: a combined line waits for a clash, a clashed line waits for a combination, a Void line waits for the end of the ten-day period, a broken line waits for repair or combination, an extinct line waits for life, and a tombed line waits to be clashed open; one should work it out so.
To know far or near, one must judge also by strength and weakness.

title: 舟船·凡卜买船断同船户：买船和雇船断法相同；船家自己占，要按船家的家宅来断，不用这个断法

rule.yi: 占买船和雇船，断法相同，按船户（船的主人）的办法断；如果是船家自己占，就要按船家的家宅来断，不是这里的断法。
rule.en: Divining the buying of a boat and the hiring of one are judged in the same way, as for the boat's household; if the boatman divines for himself, it should be judged as for the boat family's household, which is not the method given here.

yi: 凡是占买船，
按船户（船的主人）的办法断
en: In divining the buying of a boat,
judge it as for the boat's household

zh: 凡卜买船与雇船，断法相同；
如舟子自卜，当以船家宅断之，又非此断法也。
yi: 凡是占买船和雇船，断法相同；
如果是船夫自己占，应当按船家的家宅来断，不是这里的断法。
en: Divining the buying and the hiring of a boat are judged in the same way;
if the boatman divines for himself, it should be judged as for the boat family's household, which is not the method given here.

title: 舟船·六亲持世可推新旧之由：看船新旧用六亲持世——财福是新，父母是旧，兄弟半新半旧，官鬼多灾惊；兼看衰旺

rule.yi: 推断船的新旧，看哪一个六亲持世：财爻、福神持世是新船，父母爻持世是旧船，兄弟爻持世是半新半旧，官鬼持世则多灾多惊；还要兼看衰旺。
rule.en: To tell whether a boat is new or old, see which of the six relations holds the Self: Wealth or Output is new, Resource is old, Peer is half new and half old, and Pressure means many calamities and frights; strength and weakness are also taken into account.

yi: 六亲持世，
可以推断船新旧的缘由
en: By which of the six relations holds the Self,
one can work out the reasons for the boat being new or old

zh: 凡推船之新旧，当以六亲持世决之，财福是新，父母是旧，兄弟是半新旧，官鬼多灾惊。
yi: 凡是推断船的新旧，应当用六亲持世来决断：财福是新，父母是旧，兄弟是半新半旧，官鬼多灾多惊。
还要兼看衰旺来决断。
en: In judging whether a boat is new or old, decide by which of the six relations holds the Self: Wealth and Output are new, Resource is old, Peer is half new and half old, and Pressure means many calamities and frights.
Decide also by strength and weakness.

title: 舟船·诸鬼动临可识节病之处：金鬼钉少，土鬼灰少，木鬼有缝，水鬼有漏，火鬼有燥裂——船的毛病看哪一行的鬼爻发动

rule.yi: 船的毛病看是哪一行的鬼爻发动：金鬼是钉子少，土鬼是灰（油灰）少，木鬼是板缝，水鬼是漏水，火鬼是木头干燥裂开。
rule.en: The boat's faults are read from the element of the moving Pressure line: Metal Pressure means too few nails, Earth Pressure too little putty, Wood Pressure seams, Water Pressure leaks, and Fire Pressure dry cracks.

note.yi: 「节病」是船体各节、各处的毛病；「灰」指填船缝用的油灰。这一句按鬼爻所属五行断船的毛病，和疾病章按鬼爻五行断病位是同一种取法。
note.en: "Faults" here are the defects in the parts and joints of the hull, and "putty" is the caulking used to fill the seams. Reading a boat's faults by the element of Pressure is the same kind of reading as judging the seat of an illness by the element of Pressure in the chapters on illness.

yi: 各种鬼爻发动临到（船上），
可以知道毛病所在的地方
en: When the various Pressure lines move and arrive,
one can tell where the faults lie

zh: 金鬼钉少，土鬼灰少，木鬼有缝，水鬼有漏，火鬼有燥裂。
yi: 金鬼是钉子少，土鬼是灰少，木鬼有缝，水鬼有漏，火鬼有干燥裂开。
en: Metal Pressure means too few nails, Earth Pressure too little putty, Wood Pressure has seams, Water Pressure leaks, and Fire Pressure dry cracks.

title: 舟船·初二爻为前仓要持财福、五六爻为后舵怕见官兄：初二爻前仓，三四爻中仓，五六爻后舵

rule.yi: 初爻、二爻是船的前舱，最好是财爻、福神；五爻、六爻是船的后舵，怕见官鬼、兄弟；三爻、四爻是中舱。
rule.en: The first and second lines are the fore hold of the boat and are best carrying Wealth or Output; the fifth and sixth lines are the stern rudder and fear Pressure or Peer; the third and fourth lines are the middle hold.

yi: 初爻、二爻是前舱，
要有财爻、福神；
五爻、六爻是后舵，
怕见官鬼、兄弟
en: The first and second lines are the fore hold,
and want Wealth or Output;
the fifth and sixth lines are the stern rudder,
and fear to see Pressure or Peer

zh: 初二爻为前仓，三四爻为中仓，五六爻为后舵。
yi: 初、二爻是前舱，三、四爻是中舱，五、六爻是后舵。
en: The first and second lines are the fore hold, the third and fourth the middle hold, and the fifth and sixth the stern rudder.

title: 舟船·爻作梢公不宜伤克：占船以父母爻为舟船，占雇撑船的人以父母爻为梢公；要旺相、生合世爻，发动伤克世爻为凶

rule.yi: 占船，以父母爻代表船；占雇撑船的人，以父母爻代表船夫（梢公）；要旺相、生合世爻才吉，如果发动去伤克世爻就凶。
rule.en: In divining for a boat the Resource line stands for the boat, and in divining for the man hired to pole it the Resource line stands for the boatman; it is lucky if it is strong and gives life to or combines with the Self, and ill if it moves to injure or control the Self.

yi: 爻代表船夫（梢公），
不宜被伤克
en: The line stands for the boatman,
and should not be injured or controlled

zh: 卜船以父母为舟船，卜驾撑以父母爻为梢公。
要旺相生合世爻为吉，如发动伤克世爻，为凶。
yi: 占船以父母爻为舟船，占雇人驾船撑船以父母爻为梢公。
要旺相、生合世爻为吉，如果发动伤克世爻，为凶。
en: In divining for a boat the Resource line is the boat, and in divining for a man hired to steer and pole it the Resource line is the boatman.
It is lucky if it is strong and gives life to or combines with the Self, and ill if it moves to injure or control the Self.

title: 舟船·龙为舟尾岂可空刑：青龙是船尾，临财爻旺相发动、持世生合世爻，都主有利称意

rule.yi: 青龙代表船尾；临着财爻、旺相发动，或者持世、生合世爻，都主有利益、称心；不可落空或带刑。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon stands for the stern of the boat; carrying Wealth, strong and moving, or holding the Self or giving life to or combining with the Self, it brings profit and satisfaction; it must not be Void or carry punishment.

yi: 青龙是船尾，
怎么可以落空或带刑？
en: The Azure Dragon is the stern,
and how can it be Void or carry punishment?

zh: 青龙为船尾，临财旺动，持世生合世，皆主利益称意。
yi: 青龙是船尾，临着财爻旺相发动，持世、生合世爻，都主利益称意。
en: The Azure Dragon is the stern; carrying a strong moving Wealth line, or holding the Self or giving life to or combining with the Self, it brings profit and satisfaction.

title: 舟船·螣蛇辨索缆之坚牢：螣蛇是缆绳，休囚落旬空则枯烂，旺相带吉神则坚牢

rule.yi: 螣蛇代表缆绳：休囚或落旬空，缆绳枯烂；旺相而带吉神，缆绳坚牢。
rule.en: The Coiling Snake stands for the mooring rope: resting or trapped, or Void in its ten-day period, the rope is rotten; strong and carrying an auspicious spirit, the rope is firm.

yi: 螣蛇用来辨别缆绳是否坚牢
en: The Coiling Snake tells whether the mooring rope is firm

zh: 螣蛇为索缆，休囚值旬空则枯烂，旺相持吉神则坚牢。
yi: 螣蛇是缆绳，休囚、落旬空就枯烂，旺相、带吉神就坚牢。
en: The Coiling Snake is the rope; resting or trapped, or Void in its ten-day period, it is rotten; strong and carrying an auspicious spirit, it is firm.

title: 舟船·白虎为帆樯之顺利：白虎属风，取为风帆，生旺带财福吉神、持世生合身世则帆好风顺，带凶鬼恶煞克害世身或卦得反吟则有失风倾覆之患

rule.yi: 白虎属风，所以取它代表风帆：生旺、带财爻福神等吉神、发动持世或生合身世，船就有好帆，风顺而快；白虎带着凶鬼恶煞、旺而发动克害世爻和身，或者卦是反吟，会遭遇失风、倾覆的祸患。
rule.en: The White Tiger belongs to wind and so stands for the sail: if it is strong and carries Wealth, Output or other auspicious spirits, and moves to hold or give life to or combine with the Self and Body, the boat has a good sail and the wind is fair and quick; if the White Tiger carries baleful Pressure and evil stars, strong and moving to harm or control the Self and Body, or the hexagram is Reversed Chant, there is the danger of losing the wind and capsizing.

yi: 白虎代表风帆桅杆是否顺利
en: The White Tiger tells whether the sail and mast go well

zh: 白虎属风，故取为风帆，若生旺带财福吉神，动持生合身世，则船有好帆，使风顺快；
若白虎带凶鬼恶煞，旺动克害世身，或卦得反吟，主遭失风倾覆之患。
yi: 白虎属风，所以取它做风帆，如果生旺、带财爻福神等吉神，发动持世或生合身世，那么船有好帆，风顺而快；
如果白虎带着凶鬼恶煞，旺相发动克害世身，或者卦得反吟，主遭遇失风、倾覆的祸患。
en: The White Tiger belongs to wind and is taken for the sail; if it is strong and carries Wealth, Output or other auspicious spirits, and moves to hold or give life to or combine with the Self and Body, the boat has a good sail and the wind is fair and quick;

if the White Tiger carries baleful Pressure and evil stars, strong and moving to harm or control the Self and Body, or the hexagram is Reversed Chant, there is the danger of losing the wind and capsizing.

title: 舟船·六爻皆吉不伤身四海遨游无阻滞：六爻生合财福吉神，又生旺持世持身，动爻不来伤克，则无往不吉

rule.yi: 六爻都生合财爻、福神这样的吉神，又生旺、持世持身，发动的爻也不来伤克，就无往不吉，即使远游五湖四海也都顺利。
rule.en: If the six lines all give life to or combine with auspicious spirits such as Wealth and Output, are strong and hold the Self and Body, and no moving line comes to injure or control, then nothing goes amiss, and even a far voyage over the lakes and seas goes smoothly.

yi: 六爻都吉，没有伤到（世）身，
四海遨游都没有阻滞
en: If the six lines are all auspicious and do not harm the Self and Body,
one may roam the four seas without hindrance

zh: 六爻生合财福吉神，又生旺持世持身，动爻又不来伤克，则无往不吉，虽远游于五湖四海，亦皆顺利也。
yi: 六爻生合财爻、福神这样的吉神，又生旺、持世持身，动爻又不来伤克，就无往不吉，即使远游五湖四海，也都顺利。
en: If the six lines give life to or combine with auspicious spirits such as Wealth and Output, are strong and hold the Self and Body, and no moving line comes to injure or control, then nothing goes amiss, and even a far voyage over the lakes and seas goes smoothly.

title: 避乱·总旨：官鬼所在的方位和官鬼所克的地方不要去，子孙所在的方位和生我的地方适宜去；留守原处时子孙独发生我只是惊恐一场

rule.yi: 避乱的大旨：官鬼所在的方位，以及官鬼所克的地方，不要去；子孙所在的方位，以及生我的地方，适宜去。如果占的是留守原处，得子孙独自发动生我，只是惊恐一场；占要去的地方也是这样。
rule.en: The main purport of fleeing disorder: do not go to the quarter of Pressure or to the places Pressure controls; it is fit to go to the quarter of Output and to the places that give life to me. If one divines about staying in the old place, and Output alone moves to give life to me, it ends in a fright only; the same holds for divining about a place one is going to.

yi: 人有穷有通，
世道有否有泰。
自己哀叹命薄，
恰好碰上离乱的年头，
每每叹息走投无路，
姑且推演谋求变通的《易》。
于是记录下已经验证过的卦爻，
用来决断当今的贼寇
en: Men have their poverty and their success,
and the world its stagnation and its prosperity.
Lamenting my thin fortune,
I met the season of disorder,
and often sighed at the end of the road,
so I tried working out the Yi for a way of change.
Thus I record the hexagram lines already tested
to decide about the bandits of the present

zh: 官鬼之方并官鬼所克之处，休往；
子孙之方并生我之处，宜去。
如占守旧处，得子孙独发生我，止于惊恐，占往处亦然。
yi: 官鬼所在的方位，以及官鬼所克的地方，不要去；
子孙所在的方位，以及生我的地方，适宜去。
如果占的是留守原处，得子孙独自发动生我，只是惊恐一场；占要去的地方也是这样。
这是这一篇的大旨。
en: Do not go to the quarter of Pressure or to the places Pressure controls;
it is fit to go to the quarter of Output and to the places that give life to me.
If one divines about staying in the old place, and Output alone moves to give life to me, it ends in a fright only; the same holds for divining about a place one is going to.
This is the main purport of the whole chapter.

title: 避乱·鬼位兴隆贼势必然猖獗、官爻墓绝人心始得安康：官鬼旺相发动则贼必猖獗，休囚安静又有日辰动爻制它才能安卧无惊

rule.yi: 官鬼旺相发动，贼寇必定猖獗；官鬼休囚安静，再有日辰、动爻制住它，人心才安，可以安睡没有惊扰。
rule.en: If Pressure is strong and moves, the bandits will surely be rampant; if Pressure is resting or trapped and still, and the Day or a moving line controls it, people's hearts are at peace and one can sleep without alarm.

yi: 鬼爻的位置兴旺，
贼寇的势头必然猖獗；
官爻入墓、绝，
人心才能安康
en: If the Pressure position flourishes,
the bandits' strength will surely be rampant;
if the Pressure line is in the tomb or extinction,
then people's hearts find peace

zh: 官鬼旺相发动，贼必猖獗；
若得休囚安静，日辰动爻制它，则安卧无惊。
yi: 官鬼旺相发动，贼必定猖獗；
如果官鬼休囚安静，又有日辰、动爻制住它，就可以安睡没有惊扰。
en: If Pressure is strong and moves, the bandits will surely be rampant;
if Pressure is resting or trapped and still, and the Day or a moving line controls it, one can sleep in peace without alarm.

title: 避乱·路上如逢休出外、宅中如遇勿归家：内卦是宅，外卦是路，鬼在外卦动则出外必遇、宜守家，鬼在内卦动则宜躲到外面

rule.yi: 内卦代表家宅，外卦代表道路：鬼爻在外卦发动，出去必定遇到贼寇，宜守在家里；鬼爻在内卦发动，宜躲到外面去。
rule.en: The inner trigram is the house and the outer trigram the road: if Pressure moves in the outer trigram one will surely meet the bandits when going out and should stay at home; if it moves in the inner trigram it is fit to hide outside.

yi: 路上如果遇到（鬼爻发动），就不要出外；
家里如果遇到（鬼爻发动），就不要回家
en: If one meets it on the road, do not go out;
if one meets it in the house, do not go home

zh: 内卦为宅，外卦为路，鬼在外动，出外必遇，宜守家中；
yi: 内卦代表家宅，外卦代表道路；鬼爻在外卦发动，出外必定遇到，宜守在家中；
如果在内卦发动，宜躲到外面去。
en: The inner trigram is the house and the outer trigram the road; if Pressure moves in the outer trigram, one will surely meet them when going out, and should stay at home;
if it moves in the inner trigram, it is fit to hide outside.

title: 避乱·动来刑害总教智慧也难逃、变入空亡若被勾留犹可脱：鬼动不伤世任它猖獗也不遭祸，被刑冲克害必难逃，官爻变入死墓空绝是虎头蛇尾

rule.yi: 鬼爻发动但不伤世，任凭它猖獗也不遭祸；如果被它刑冲克害，必定难逃；如果官爻变入死、墓、空、绝，就是虎头蛇尾，虽有凶，却是没有灾咎的征兆，即使被拘留也还有可能脱身。
rule.en: If Pressure moves without injuring the Self, however rampant it is one meets no disaster; if one is punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by it, escape is surely hard; if the Pressure line changes into death, tomb, Void or extinction, it is a tiger's head and a snake's tail: there is ill, but it is a sign of no blame, and even if one is detained there is still the chance to get free.

yi: （鬼爻）发动来刑害（世爻），
纵然智慧过人也难逃脱；
变入空亡，
如果只是被拘留，还有可能脱身
en: If it moves to punish or harm the Self,
even the wisest cannot escape;
if it changes into Void,
then if one is only detained, there is still the chance to get free

zh: 若鬼动不伤世，任彼猖獗，不遭其祸；
如被刑冲克害，必难逃避；
若官爻变入死墓空绝，则是虎头蛇尾，虽有凶无咎之兆。
yi: 如果鬼爻发动不伤世，任凭他们猖獗，也不会遭到灾祸；
如果被刑冲克害，必定难以逃避；
如果官爻变入死、墓、空、绝，就是虎头蛇尾，虽有凶，却是没有灾咎的征兆。
en: If Pressure moves without injuring the Self, however rampant they are one will not meet the disaster;
if one is punished, clashed, controlled or harmed, escape is surely hard;
if the Pressure line changes into death, tomb, Void or extinction, it is a tiger's head and a snake's tail: there is ill, but it is a sign of no blame.

title: 避乱·日辰制伏何妨卦里刑伤、月建临持勿谓爻中隐伏：鬼动克世但有日辰动爻克制冲散则有救，怕的是月建日辰带鬼刑克世爻，卦中无鬼也难免

rule.yi: 官鬼发动来刑克世爻，固然是凶兆，但如果有日辰、动爻克制、冲散它，都叫有救，必定不至于受害；只怕月建、日辰带着鬼来刑克世爻，即使卦中没有鬼，也免不了遭害。
rule.en: Pressure moving to punish or control the Self is of course an ill omen, but if the Day or a moving line restrains, controls or clashes it apart, all that is called rescue, and one will surely not be harmed; what is to be feared is the Month or the Day carrying Pressure and punishing or controlling the Self: even if the hexagram has no Pressure, one cannot escape harm.

note.yi: 注文第一句末尾的「必不为守」，按文意应是「必不为害」，译文按「必不至于受害」翻。
note.en: The words at the end of the note's first sentence, "surely not be keeping", should by the sense be "surely not be harmful", and the translation follows that.

yi: 有日辰制伏（鬼爻），
哪怕卦里有刑伤也无妨；
月建临在它上、持着（鬼爻），
就别说它在爻中隐伏
en: If the Day restrains it,
what matter if the hexagram has punishment and injury;
if the Month stands on it and holds it,
do not say it lies hidden in the lines

zh: 官鬼动来刑克世爻，固是凶兆，若得日辰动爻克制冲散之，皆谓有救，必不为守。
唯怕月建日辰带鬼刑克世爻，虽卦中无鬼，不免遭害。
yi: 官鬼发动来刑克世爻，固然是凶兆，但如果有日辰、动爻克制、冲散它，都叫有救，一定不至于受害。
只怕月建、日辰带着鬼来刑克世爻，即使卦中没有鬼，也免不了遭害。
en: Pressure moving to punish or control the Self is of course an ill omen, but if the Day or a moving line restrains, controls or clashes it apart, all that is called rescue, and one will surely not be harmed.
What is to be feared is the Month or the Day carrying Pressure and punishing or controlling the Self: even if the hexagram has no Pressure, one cannot escape harm.

title: 避乱·所恶者提起之神、所赖者死亡之地：鬼爻伏藏本吉，但被动爻日辰冲开、飞神提起仍被其害，只有鬼爻真空真破才许无灾

rule.yi: 鬼爻伏藏固然吉，但如果被动爻、日辰冲开，或者被飞神提起，伏神仍然受它的害；只有鬼爻是真空、真破，才许说没有灾。
rule.en: A hidden Pressure line is of course lucky, but if a moving line or the Day clashes it open, or the flying line raises it, the hidden line is still harmed by it; only if the Pressure line is truly Void or truly broken may one say there is no calamity.

yi: 所厌恶的是被提起的神（鬼），
所依赖的是它死亡的地方
en: What is feared is the spirit that gets raised up,
what is relied on is the place where it dies

zh: 鬼爻伏藏固吉，若被动爻日辰冲开，飞神提起，伏神仍被其害；
如鬼爻真空真破，方许无灾。
yi: 鬼爻伏藏固然吉，但如果被动爻、日辰冲开，飞神提起，伏神仍然被它所害；
如果鬼爻是真空、真破，才许说没有灾。
en: A hidden Pressure line is of course lucky, but if a moving line or the Day clashes it open, or the flying line raises it, the hidden line is still harmed by it;
only if the Pressure line is truly Void or truly broken may one say there is no calamity.

title: 避乱·自持鬼墓坟中不可潜藏、或值水神舟内犹当仔细：官鬼墓库的爻动来刑克或持世，不可躲坟墓；木鬼不躲草丛，水鬼不躲舟船，金鬼不躲寺观，火鬼不躲窑冶

rule.yi: 官鬼墓库的爻发动来刑克，或者持世，不可躲在坟墓里；木鬼不可躲在草丛里，水鬼不可躲在船里，金鬼不可躲在寺观里，火鬼不可躲在窑冶里。
rule.en: If the tomb line of Pressure moves to punish or control, or holds the Self, one must not hide inside a tomb; with Wood Pressure one must not hide in thickets, with Water Pressure in a boat, with Metal Pressure in a temple, with Fire Pressure in a kiln or smithy.

yi: 自己持着鬼的墓，
坟墓中不可潜藏；
或者逢到水神（鬼），
在船里还应当仔细
en: If the Self itself holds the tomb of Pressure,
one must not hide in a grave;
or if it meets a Water spirit,
one should still take care in a boat

zh: 官鬼墓库之爻动来刑克或持世是也，凡遇此象，不可避于坟墓内；
水鬼不可避于舟船，金鬼不可避于寺观，火鬼不可避于窑冶而已。
yi: 官鬼墓库的爻发动来刑克，或者持世，就是这样；凡遇到这个象，不可躲在坟墓里；
木鬼不可躲在草丛里；
水鬼不可躲在船里，金鬼不可躲在寺观里，火鬼不可躲在窑冶里，如此而已。
en: This is so when the tomb line of Pressure moves to punish or control, or holds the Self; whenever this image appears, one must not hide inside a tomb;
with Wood Pressure one must not hide in thickets;
with Water Pressure one must not hide in a boat, with Metal Pressure in a temple, with Fire Pressure in a kiln or smithy, and that is all.

title: 避乱·子爻福德北宜行、午象官爻南勿往：官鬼所临的方位是寇贼出入之处，宜避；子孙所临的地方是贼不到之处，宜往

rule.yi: 官鬼所临的方位，是寇贼出入的地方，应当躲开；子孙所临的地方，是贼不到的地方，适宜去。
rule.en: The quarter where Pressure stands is where the bandits come and go, and should be avoided; the place where Output stands is where the bandits do not come, and it is fit to go there.

note.yi: 这一联是举例：子在北方、午在南方，子爻是福德就往北，午象是官鬼就别往南；换了别的卦，就换成别的方位。
note.en: This couplet is an example: Zi lies in the north and Wu in the south, so if the Zi line is Output go north, and if the Wu image is Pressure do not go south; in another hexagram the quarters change.

yi: 子爻是福德，北方适宜去；
午象官爻在南，南方不要去
en: The Zi line is Output, and the north is fit to go to;
the Wu image is Pressure, and one must not go south

zh: 官鬼所临之方，乃寇出入之墟，宜避之；
子孙所临之地，乃贼不到之处，宜往之。
yi: 官鬼所临的方位，是寇贼出入的地方，应当躲开；
子孙所临的地方，是贼不到的地方，适宜去。
en: The quarter where Pressure stands is where the bandits come and go, and should be avoided;
the place where Output stands is where the bandits do not come, and it is fit to go there.

title: 避乱·鬼逢冲散何须克制之乡、福遇空亡莫若生扶之地：子孙之方固吉；福静官动而卦内有冲散官爻者取冲散之方；子孙空伏衰静受制又无冲散者取生世合世之方

rule.yi: 子孙所在的方位固然吉，因为它能制鬼，发动就取它；如果福静官动，而卦里有冲散官爻的，就以冲散它的方位为吉；如果子孙空亡、伏藏、衰弱安静受制，而鬼爻又没有被冲散，宜取生世、合世的方位为吉。
rule.en: The quarter of Output is of course lucky because it controls Pressure, and if it moves one takes it; if Output is still and Pressure moves, and something in the hexagram clashes the Pressure line apart, take the quarter that clashes it apart as lucky; if Output is Void, hidden, weak and still and controlled, and the Pressure line is not clashed apart, take the quarter that gives life to or combines with the Self as lucky.

yi: 鬼爻被冲散，
何必再去克制它的那个方位；
福神遇到空亡，
不如去生扶（世）的地方
en: If Pressure is clashed apart,
why need one go to the quarter that controls it;
if Output meets Void,
better to go to the place that gives life and support

zh: 子孙之方固吉，以其制鬼故也，若发动则取之可也。
若福静官动，而卦内有冲散官爻者，即以冲散之方为吉，其为得用之神故也。
若子孙空伏，衰静受制，而鬼爻又无冲散者，宜取生世合世之方为吉。
yi: 子孙所在的方位固然吉，因为它能制住鬼，如果它发动就取这个方位就可以；
如果福静而官动，而卦里有冲散官爻的，就以冲散它的那个方位为吉，因为它是得用的神；
如果子孙空亡、伏藏、衰弱安静受制，而鬼爻又没有被冲散，宜取生世、合世的方位为吉。
en: The quarter of Output is of course lucky because it controls Pressure, and if it moves one may take that quarter;
if Output is still and Pressure moves, and something in the hexagram clashes the Pressure line apart, take the quarter that clashes it apart as lucky, since that is the spirit put to use;
if Output is Void, hidden, weak and still and controlled, and the Pressure line is not clashed apart, take the quarter that gives life to or combines with the Self as lucky.

title: 避乱·旺相内卦终来本境横行：占贼寇来不来本境，官鬼在本宫内卦发动必来，在他宫外卦则不侵境；持世临内卦直到我家，临外卦持应虽来不入我室；卦身也忌临

rule.yi: 占贼寇会不会来我的地界：官鬼在本宫、在内卦发动，必定来；在别的宫、在外卦，就不侵入地界。持世、临在内卦，直接到我家；临在外卦、持应，虽然来也不进我的屋室。卦身也忌讳官鬼临在上面。
rule.en: In divining whether bandits will come into my district: if Pressure moves in its own palace and in the inner trigram, they will surely come; in another palace or in the outer trigram, they do not enter the district. If it holds the Self and stands in the inner trigram, they come straight to my house; standing in the outer trigram and holding the Other, though they come they do not enter my rooms. The Body also fears Pressure standing on it.

yi: （鬼爻）旺相在内卦，
终究会来到本地横行
en: If Pressure is strong in the inner trigram,
in the end they come into one's own district and run riot

zh: 凡占贼寇来我境否，若官在本宫内卦发动，必来；
在他宫外卦，则不侵境也。
若持世临内卦，直到我家；
临外卦持应，虽来不入我室。
yi: 凡是占贼寇会不会来我的地界，如果官鬼在本宫、在内卦发动，必定来；
在别的宫、在外卦，就不侵入地界。
如果持世、临在内卦，直接到我家；
临在外卦、持应，虽然来也不进我的屋室。
卦身也忌讳官鬼临在它上。
en: In divining whether bandits will come into my district, if Pressure moves in its own palace and in the inner trigram, they will surely come;
in another palace or in the outer trigram, they do not enter the district.
If it holds the Self and stands in the inner trigram, they come straight to my house;
standing in the outer trigram and holding the Other, though they come they do not enter my rooms.
The Body also fears Pressure standing on it.

title: 避乱·动化退神必往他乡剽掠：官爻发动化退神则贼将往他处劫掠，化进神则寇必速到，宜急避

rule.yi: 官爻发动，如果化出退神，贼将到别处劫掠；如果化出进神，贼寇必定很快就到，应该赶快躲避。
rule.en: If the Pressure line moves and changes into a Retreating spirit, the bandits are going to plunder elsewhere; if it changes into an Advancing spirit, the bandits will surely arrive quickly and one should hurry to hide.

yi: （鬼爻）发动化出退神，
必定去别处抢掠
en: If it moves and changes into a Retreating spirit,
they will surely go to plunder elsewhere

zh: 官爻发动，若化退神，将往他处劫掠也；
如化进神，寇必速到，宜急避之。
yi: 官爻发动，如果化出退神，将要到别处劫掠；
如果化出进神，贼寇必定很快就到，应该赶快躲避。
en: If the Pressure line moves and changes into a Retreating spirit, they are going to plunder elsewhere;
if it changes into an Advancing spirit, the bandits will surely arrive quickly and one should hurry to hide.

title: 避乱·官连旺福合生身反凶为吉：官爻发动克世本遭毒手，若化出子孙制鬼，或发动的子孙、财爻反来生合世身，必因祸得福

rule.yi: 官爻发动克世，本来要遭毒手；如果得到化出子孙制住鬼，或者发动的子孙、财爻反来生合世身，必定因祸得福。
rule.en: If the Pressure line moves and controls the Self, one would fall into cruel hands; but if it changes into Output that controls Pressure, or a moving Output or Wealth line comes instead to give life to or combine with the Self and Body, one will surely turn disaster into blessing.

yi: 官鬼连着旺相的福神，合住并生到（世）身，
反而变凶为吉
en: If Pressure joined to a strong Output combines with and gives life to the Self,
ill turns to luck

zh: 官爻发动克世，必遭毒手，若得化出子孙制鬼，或动子财反来生合世身者，必然因祸致福。
yi: 官爻发动克世，必定遭到毒手；如果得到化出子孙制住鬼，或者发动的子孙、财爻反来生合世身，必定因祸得福。
