en: If the Pressure line moves and controls the Self, one will surely fall into cruel hands; but if it changes into Output that controls Pressure, or a moving Output or Wealth line comes instead to give life to or combine with the Self and Body, one will surely turn disaster into blessing.

title: 避乱·阳化阴财刑克世弄假成真：官爻发动本不伤世，而发动的财爻反来伤世，必因贪得财物惹祸

rule.yi: 官爻发动，没有伤到世爻，而发动的财爻反过来伤到世爻，必定因为贪得财物而惹祸。
rule.en: If the Pressure line moves without injuring the Self, but a moving Wealth line comes instead to injure the Self, one will surely bring on trouble through greed for goods.

yi: 阳爻化出阴爻的财爻来刑克世，
就是弄假成真
en: If a yang line changes into a yin Wealth line that punishes or controls the Self,
what was pretence turns into earnest

zh: 官爻发动不伤世爻，而被动财反伤世爻者，必因贪得财物而惹祸也。
yi: 官爻发动，没有伤到世爻，而被动的财爻反过来伤到世爻，必定因为贪得财物而惹祸。
en: If the Pressure line moves without injuring the Self, but a moving Wealth line comes instead to injure the Self, one will surely bring on trouble through greed for goods.

title: 避乱·贼兴三合爻中必投陷井：最怕鬼动会成鬼局，贼寇四面合来，前遭后遇不能脱；两鬼俱动克世亦然；三合兄局失财物，父局防小儿，财局生合世则父母失散，子孙局克鬼最吉

rule.yi: 最怕发动的爻会成鬼局，贼寇从四面合围而来，想躲避也前遭后遇，不能脱身；卦里有两个鬼爻都发动克世也是这样。三合成兄弟局，人没事但财物失散；三合成父母局，要仔细照看小孩；三合成财局生合世爻，主父母失散；三合成子孙局而克制鬼爻，最吉。
rule.en: Most to be feared is a moving line meeting into a Pressure frame, so that the bandits close in from all sides and, however one wants to hide, one is met in front and caught behind and cannot get free; two Pressure lines both moving to control the Self is the same. A three-harmony Peer frame leaves the person unharmed but his goods scattered; a three-harmony Resource frame calls for care of the small children; a three-harmony Wealth frame giving life to or combining with the Self means the parents are scattered; a three-harmony Output frame that controls the Pressure line is the most auspicious.

note.yi: 注文里的「兄局」「父局」是兄弟局、父母局的简称；「身虽无事，财物失散」说的是人没事、东西丢了。
note.en: In the note "Peer frame" and "Resource frame" are short for the frames of Peer and Resource lines; "the person is unharmed but his goods scattered" means the man comes through but his things are lost.

yi: 贼寇在三合的爻中兴起，
必定落入陷阱
en: If the bandits rise in a three-harmony frame,
one will surely fall into the pit

zh: 最怕动会鬼局，必主贼寇四边合来，虽欲避之，前遭后遇不能脱离。
卦有两鬼俱动克世，亦然三合兄局，身虽无事，财物失散；
三合财局生合世爻，则主父母失散；
三合子孙局克制鬼爻，为最吉也。
yi: 最怕发动会成鬼局，必定主贼寇从四面合拢而来，虽然想躲避，前面遭遇后面碰上，不能脱离。
卦里有两个鬼爻都发动克世，也是这样；三合成兄弟局，人虽然没事，财物会失散；
三合成父母局，要仔细照看小孩；
三合成财局，生合世爻，就主父母失散；
三合成子孙局，克制鬼爻，最吉。
en: Most to be feared is a moving line meeting into a Pressure frame, which means the bandits close in from all four sides: though one wishes to avoid them, one is met in front and caught behind and cannot get free.
If the hexagram has two Pressure lines both moving to control the Self, it is the same; a three-harmony Peer frame leaves the person unharmed but his goods scattered and lost;
a three-harmony Resource frame calls for care of the small children;
a three-harmony Wealth frame giving life to or combining with the Self means the parents are scattered;
a three-harmony Output frame that controls the Pressure line is the most auspicious.

title: 避乱·身在六旬空处终脱樊笼：身、世落空亡，躲避为吉

rule.yi: 身爻、世爻落在空亡，躲避就吉，最终能脱出牢笼。
rule.en: If the Body and the Self fall into Void, hiding is lucky, and one at last escapes the cage.

yi: 身落在六旬的空处，
终究能脱出牢笼
en: If the Body falls in a Void place among the six decades,
one at last escapes the cage

yi: 身、世落空亡，躲避就吉。
en: If the Body and the Self fall into Void, hiding is lucky.

title: 避乱·官鬼临身任尔潜踪犹撞见：官爻持世就是寇贼临身，无法躲避；被捉去以后才占也脱不了

rule.yi: 官爻持世，就是寇贼已经临到自己身上，怎么能躲避？如果是被捉去以后才占的，也不能脱离他们回来。
rule.en: A Pressure line holding the Self is the bandits at one's very person; how can one hide? If one divines after being seized, one still cannot get away from them and return.

yi: 官鬼临在身上，
任你隐藏行踪也还是会撞见
en: If Pressure stands on the Self,
however you hide your tracks you will still run into them

zh: 官爻持世乃是寇贼临身，如何可避？
如至捉去而占，亦不能脱彼而回。
yi: 官爻持世，就是寇贼临身，怎么能躲避？
如果是被抓去以后才占的，也不能脱离他们回来。
en: A Pressure line holding the Self is the bandits at one's very person; how can one hide?
If one divines after being seized, one still cannot get away from them and return.

title: 避乱·子孙持世纵然对面不相逢：子孙持世不动也吉发动更妙，临月建、带日辰或在旁爻旺动都吉，卦中虽有鬼动也不足畏

rule.yi: 子孙持世，不动也吉，发动更妙；如果临月建，或者带日辰，或者在旁边的爻旺相发动，都吉；卦中即使有鬼爻发动，也不足畏惧，纵然面对面也碰不上。
rule.en: Output holding the Self is lucky even if still, and better still if it moves; if it stands on the Month or carries the Day, or is strong and moving in another line, all is lucky; even if Pressure moves in the hexagram it is not to be feared, and even face to face they will not meet.

yi: 子孙持世，
纵然面对面也碰不上
en: If Output holds the Self,
even face to face they will not meet

zh: 子孙持世，不动亦吉，发动尤妙。
若临月建或带日辰，或在旁爻旺动，皆吉，卦中虽有鬼动，不足畏也。
yi: 子孙持世，不动也吉，发动更妙。
如果临月建，或者带日辰，或者在旁边的爻旺相发动，都吉，卦中即使有鬼爻发动，也不足畏惧。
en: Output holding the Self is lucky even if still, and better still if it moves.
If it stands on the Month or carries the Day, or is strong and moving in another line, all is lucky; even if Pressure moves in the hexagram it is not to be feared.

title: 避乱·兄变官爻窃恐乡人劫掠：卦中无鬼而兄弟发动变出鬼爻，要防邻人乘机劫盗，不是真贼寇；兄在内卦是近邻，在外卦是远方人

rule.yi: 卦中没有鬼爻，而遇到兄弟发动变出鬼爻来，要提防邻居趁机劫盗财物，并不是真的贼寇；兄弟在内卦是近邻，在外卦是远方的人。
rule.en: If the hexagram has no Pressure but a moving Peer line changes into a Pressure line, guard against neighbours seizing the chance to rob and steal goods, and not true bandits; Peer in the inner trigram is a near neighbour, in the outer trigram a person from afar.

yi: 兄弟爻变出官鬼爻，
恐怕有同乡的人来劫掠
en: If Peer changes into a Pressure line,
I fear fellow villagers will come to plunder

zh: 卦中无鬼而遇兄动变出者，须防邻人乘机劫盗财物，非真贼寇也；
兄在内卦，是近邻，在外卦，远方人也。
yi: 卦中没有鬼，而遇到兄弟发动变出鬼来，要提防邻居趁机劫盗财物，并不是真的贼寇；
兄弟在内卦，是近邻；在外卦，是远方的人。
en: If the hexagram has no Pressure but a moving Peer changes into it, guard against neighbours seizing the chance to rob and steal goods, and not true bandits;
Peer in the inner trigram is a near neighbour; in the outer trigram, a person from afar.

title: 避乱·财连鬼煞须防臧获私藏：卦中无鬼而财爻变出官爻，是奴婢假冒盗贼劫物，或乱中被藏匿；在外卦是邻居的妇人

rule.yi: 卦中没有鬼，财爻变出官爻的，是奴婢假冒盗贼劫物，或者在乱中被他们藏匿了东西；如果在外卦，是邻居的妇人。
rule.en: If the hexagram has no Pressure and Wealth changes into a Pressure line, it is servants posing as thieves to carry things off, or things hidden away by them in the confusion; if it is in the outer trigram, it is a woman of the neighbourhood.

yi: 财爻连着鬼煞，
要提防奴婢私自藏匿
en: If Wealth is linked with baleful Pressure,
guard against slaves and maids secretly hiding things

zh: 卦中无鬼，财变官爻者，是奴婢假盗贼劫物，或在乱中被其其藏匿也；
yi: 卦中没有鬼，财爻变出官爻的，是奴婢假冒盗贼劫物，或者在乱中被他们藏匿了东西；
如果在外卦，是邻居的妇人。
en: If the hexagram has no Pressure and Wealth changes into a Pressure line, it is servants posing as thieves to carry things off, or things hidden away by them in the confusion;
if it is in the outer trigram, it is a woman of the neighbourhood.

title: 避乱·日辰冲克财爻妻孥失散、动象刑伤福德儿女拋离：官动必有惊险，日辰动爻伤到的地方不太平，冲克财爻则妻孥失散，冲克子孙则儿女被抛离

rule.yi: 官鬼发动必定有惊险，不论日辰、动爻，被它伤到的地方就不太平：如果冲克财爻，主妻子儿女失散；如果冲克子孙，必定儿女被抛离。
rule.en: If Pressure moves there is surely alarm and danger, and whatever the Day or a moving line, the place it injures is unsettled: if it clashes with or controls the Wealth line, wife and children are scattered; if it clashes with or controls Output, the sons and daughters are surely cast away.

yi: 日辰冲克财爻，
妻子儿女失散；
动象刑伤福德，
儿女被抛离
en: If the Day clashes with or controls the Wealth line,
wife and children are scattered;
if a moving image punishes or injures Output,
the sons and daughters are cast away

zh: 官动必有惊险，不拘日辰动爻被其伤处即不太平。
如冲克财爻，主妻孥失散；
冲克子孙，必主儿女抛离。
yi: 官鬼发动必定有惊险，不论日辰、动爻，被它伤到的地方就不太平。
如果冲克财爻，主妻子儿女失散；
冲克子孙，必定儿女被抛离。
en: If Pressure moves there is surely alarm and danger, and whatever the Day or a moving line, the place it injures is unsettled.
if it clashes with or controls the Wealth line, wife and children are scattered;
if it clashes with or controls Output, the sons and daughters are surely cast away.

title: 避乱·火动克身恐有燎毛之苦、水兴伤世必成灭顶之灾：火鬼发动克世主火烧之祸，水鬼克世主水患

rule.yi: 卦中火鬼发动来克世，主有火烧的祸；水鬼克世，主有水患。
rule.en: If a Fire Pressure line in the hexagram moves to control the Self, there is the calamity of fire; if a Water Pressure line controls the Self, there is the danger of water.

yi: 火鬼发动克身，
恐怕有火烧毛发的苦；
水鬼兴旺伤世，
必定酿成灭顶之灾
en: If a Fire Pressure line moves to control the Self,
I fear the pain of singed hair;
if a Water Pressure line flourishes and injures the Self,
it will surely become the calamity of going under the water

zh: 卦中火鬼动来克世，主有火烧之祸；
yi: 卦中火鬼发动来克世，主有火烧的祸；
如果是水鬼克世，主有水患。
en: If a Fire Pressure line in the hexagram moves to control the Self, there is the calamity of fire;
if a Water Pressure line controls the Self, there is the danger of water.

title: 避乱·父若空亡包裹须防失脱、妻如落陷财物当虑遗亡：父爻空亡防包裹失脱及父母有不测，财空防失财物否则妻妾有殃，子孙空忧小口

rule.yi: 父爻空亡，不只是包裹会丢失，还要提防父母有意想不到的忧患；财爻空了，要提防丢失财物，否则妻妾有灾；子孙空，就担忧小孩。
rule.en: If the Resource line is Void, not only may the baggage be lost but one must guard against some unforeseen worry for the parents; if Wealth is Void, guard against losing goods, or else wife and concubines meet trouble; if Output is Void, there is worry for the small children.

note.yi: 注文最后一句原文作「惧推之」，按文意应是「类推之」，译文按「类推」翻。
note.en: The last sentence of the note reads "fear it" in the text, which by the sense should be "reason it out by analogy", and the translation follows that.

yi: 父母爻如果空亡，
行李包裹要提防遗失；
妻财如果落入陷地，
财物应当担心遗失
en: If the Resource line is Void,
guard against losing baggage and parcels;
if Wealth falls into a pit,
one should fear the loss of goods

zh: 父爻空亡，非包裹失脱，须防父母有不测之忧；
财空防失财物，否则妻妾有殃；
yi: 父爻空亡，不只是包裹会丢失，还要提防父母有意想不到的忧患；
财爻空了，要提防丢失财物，否则妻妾有灾；
子孙空，就担忧小孩。
其余照此类推。
en: If the Resource line is Void, not only may the baggage be lost but one must guard against some unforeseen worry for the parents;
if Wealth is Void, guard against losing goods, or else wife and concubines meet trouble;
if Output is Void, there is worry for the small children.
The rest follow by analogy.

title: 避乱·五位交重两处身家无下落：五爻发动东奔西走避乱不暇，再遇日辰动爻冲散世爻，必无安身之所

rule.yi: 第五爻发动，就东奔西走，躲避战乱都来不及，人和家宅两处；再遇到日辰、动爻冲散世爻，必定没有安身的地方。
rule.en: When the fifth line moves, one runs east and west with no time even to flee the disorder, for both person and house; if the Day or a moving line also clashes the Self apart, one will surely have no place to settle.

yi: 第五爻交重发动，
人和家两处都没有着落
en: If the fifth line moves,
neither the person nor the household has a place to settle

zh: 凡遇五爻发动，东奔西走，避乱不暇，身宅两处，更遇日辰动爻冲散世爻，必无安身下落之所。
yi: 凡是遇到五爻发动，就东奔西走，躲避战乱都来不及，人和家宅两处，再遇到日辰、动爻冲散世爻，必定没有安身的地方。
en: Whenever the fifth line moves, one runs east and west with no time even to flee the disorder; for both person and house, if the Day or a moving line also clashes the Self apart, one will surely have no place to settle.

title: 避乱·六爻乱动一家骨肉各西东：六冲卦及六爻乱动，父母冲散，兄弟夫妇骨肉各自逃命，不能聚在一处

rule.yi: 六冲卦以及六爻乱动的，主父母被冲散，兄弟、夫妇、骨肉各自逃命，不能聚在一处。
rule.en: A six-clash hexagram or one with the six lines moving in disorder means the parents are scattered, and brothers, husband and wife, and kin each flee for their lives and cannot gather in one place.

yi: 六爻乱动，
一家骨肉各自东西分散
en: If the six lines move in disorder,
the whole family, flesh and blood, scatters east and west

zh: 六冲卦及六爻乱动者，主父母冲散，兄弟夫妇骨肉各自逃命，不能聚于一处。
yi: 六冲卦以及六爻乱动的，主父母被冲散，兄弟、夫妇、骨肉各自逃命，不能聚在一处。
en: A six-clash hexagram or one with the six lines moving in disorder means the parents are scattered, and brothers, husband and wife, and kin each flee for their lives and cannot gather in one place.

title: 避乱·福德鬼位刑冲带煞则官兵不道：子孙发动本吉，若带刑害虎蛇又变出官鬼，是官兵乘乱劫掠

rule.yi: 子孙发动固然是吉兆，但如果带着刑害、白虎螣蛇，又变出官鬼，就是官兵趁乱劫掠。
rule.en: Output moving is of course an auspicious sign, but if it carries punishment and harm, the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake, and also changes into Pressure, it is government soldiers plundering in the disorder.

yi: 福德和鬼的位置带着刑、冲、煞，
就是官兵不守规矩
en: If Output and the Pressure position carry punishment, clash and a baleful star,
then the government soldiers behave lawlessly

zh: 子动固是吉兆，若带刑害虎蛇而又变出官鬼者，乃是官兵乘乱劫掠。
yi: 子孙发动固然是吉兆，若带着刑害、虎蛇而又变出官鬼，就是官兵趁乱劫掠。
en: Output moving is of course an auspicious sign, but if it carries punishment and harm, the Tiger or the Snake, and also changes into Pressure, it is government soldiers plundering in the disorder.

title: 避乱·官变兄爻克合伤财则妻妾遭淫：官动刑克世爻、合住财爻则身被擒妻遭淫污；不伤世只合财爻则自身无事妻被辱；更化兄爻被奸难放回

rule.yi: 官鬼发动刑克世爻、合住财爻，那么本人被擒，妻子遭到淫辱；如果不伤世而只是合住财爻，自己虽然没事，妻子会被侮辱；再化出兄爻，被奸污之后难望放回。
rule.en: If Pressure moves to punish or control the Self and combines with the Wealth line, the person is seized and his wife is defiled; if it does not injure the Self but only combines with the Wealth line, though he is unharmed his wife is outraged; if it further changes into a Peer line, once she is violated there is little hope that she will be let go.

yi: 官鬼变出兄爻，克合并伤到财爻，
妻妾就会遭到淫辱
en: If Pressure changes into a Peer line that controls, combines with and injures Wealth,
wife and concubines will suffer rape

zh: 官动刑克世爻，合住财爻，则身被擒，妻遭淫污；
如不伤世而但合财爻者，自身虽无事，妻被辱也；
更化兄爻，被奸而难望放回。
yi: 官鬼发动刑克世爻，合住财爻，那么本人被擒，妻子遭到淫辱；
如果不伤世而只是合住财爻，自己虽然没事，妻子会被侮辱；
再化出兄爻，被奸污之后难望放回。
en: If Pressure moves to punish or control the Self and combines with the Wealth line, the person is seized and his wife is defiled;
if it does not injure the Self but only combines with the Wealth line, though he is unharmed his wife is outraged;
if it further changes into a Peer line, once she is violated there is little hope that she will be let go.

title: 避乱·妻去生扶只为贪财翻作祸：鬼动最喜衰绝，若有财动去生扶它，必因贪财惹祸；世指自己这一方，应指别人那一方

rule.yi: 鬼爻发动最喜欢衰、绝，如果有财爻发动去生扶它，必定因为贪财惹祸；世指自己这一方，应指别人那一方。
rule.en: Pressure moving is best when it is weak or extinct; if a moving Wealth line comes to give it life and support, one will surely bring trouble on oneself through greed; the Self is my own side, the Other the other people's side.

yi: 财爻去生扶（鬼爻），
只是因为贪财反而成了祸
en: If Wealth goes to give life and support to Pressure,
it is only greed for goods turning into disaster

zh: 鬼动最喜衰绝，若有财动生扶，必因贪财惹祸。
yi: 鬼爻发动最喜欢衰、绝，如果有财爻发动去生扶它，必定因为贪财惹祸。
世指自己这一方，应指别人那一方。
en: Pressure moving is best when it is weak or extinct; if a moving Wealth line comes to give it life and support, one will surely bring trouble on oneself through greed.
The Self is my own side, the Other the other people's side.

title: 避乱·子来冲动皆因儿哭惹成灾：鬼爻安静最吉，若被子孙冲动，必有小孩啼叫被发觉而受害；福神旺相官鬼衰弱则无妨

rule.yi: 鬼爻安静最吉，如果被子孙冲动，必定有小孩啼哭叫喊，因此被发觉，遭到他们的害；如果福神旺相、官鬼衰弱，就无妨。
rule.en: Pressure still is the best; if Output clashes it into movement, a small child will surely cry out, and so the hiders are discovered and harmed by them; if Output is strong and Pressure weak, there is no harm.

yi: 子孙来冲动（鬼爻），
都是因为小孩哭闹惹成灾祸
en: If Output comes to clash Pressure into movement,
it is all a child's crying that brings on the disaster

zh: 鬼静最吉，若被子孙冲动，必有小儿啼叫，因而知觉，乃被其害，福旺官衰不妨。
yi: 鬼爻安静最吉，如果被子孙冲动，必定有小孩啼哭叫喊，因此被发觉，遭到他们的害；福神旺相、官鬼衰弱就无妨。
en: Pressure still is the best; if Output clashes it into movement, a small child will surely cry out, and so the hiders are discovered and harmed by them; if Output is strong and Pressure weak, there is no harm.

title: 避乱·得值六亲生旺虽险何妨、如临四绝刑伤逢屯即死：用爻遭克必有灾，受伤的爻生旺不致伤命只怕落绝地，衰弱则一克即倒必致丧命

rule.yi: 用爻遭克必定有灾咎；如果受伤的爻正值生旺，不至于伤命，只怕它落在绝地；如果遇到衰弱，一克就倒，必定丧命。
rule.en: If the Subject line is controlled there is surely calamity; if the injured line is in a strong, thriving place it will not cost the life, and what is feared is only its falling in extinction; if it is weak, one control knocks it down and the life is surely lost.

yi: 遇到六亲生旺，
虽然险也无妨；
如果临到四绝、又遭刑伤，
一遇到困厄就会死
en: If one meets the six relations strong and thriving,
though it is perilous there is no harm;
if one is on the four extinctions and punished and injured,
meeting adversity one dies

zh: 若受伤之爻如值生旺，不致伤命，唯怕临于绝地；
若遇衰弱，一克即倒，而必致丧命也。
yi: 用爻遭克必定有灾咎。
如果受伤的爻正值生旺，不至于伤命，只怕它落在绝地；
如果遇到衰弱，一克就倒，必定丧命。
en: If the Subject line is controlled there is surely calamity.
If the injured line is in a strong, thriving place it will not cost the life, and what is feared is only its falling in extinction;
if it is weak, one control knocks it down and the life is surely lost.

title: 避乱·世遇乱离既已逐爻而决、时遭患难亦当随象以推：刑罚、官府捉拿、仇家报复、无妄之灾也要占避害，大概与避乱相似，所以并附列

rule.yi: 除了避乱，还有避害的占：有刑罚加身、户役牵累，或官府捉拿、仇家报复，或祸从无辜的事上起、灾殃从意外中生，不躲避终究要被害；这类占大概与避乱相似，所以附在这里，按同样的办法逐爻、随象推断。
rule.en: Besides fleeing disorder there is divination for avoiding harm: when punishment is laid on one, or household duties drag one in, or the authorities come to seize one, or an enemy takes revenge, or calamity springs from nothing one has done and misfortune from the unforeseen, one is harmed in the end if one does not avoid it; such divinations are much like fleeing disorder, so they are appended here and judged by the same method, line by line and following the images.

note.yi: 「户役」是按户摊派的差役、徭役。从这里往下的几联，说的多半是避祸（躲官府、仇家、差役），不限于兵乱。
note.en: "Household duties" are the corvée and services levied on each household. From here on the couplets mostly concern avoiding harm (hiding from the authorities, enemies and runners) and are not limited to war and banditry.

yi: 世人遇到乱离，
已经逐爻来决断了；
时世遭到患难，
也该顺着卦象来推断
en: When a man meets disorder and dispersal,
it has already been decided line by line;
when the times bring affliction,
it should likewise be reasoned out by following the images

zh: 或刑罚所加，户投所累，或官府捉拿，仇家报复，或祸起于无辜，殃生于不测，苟不避之，终为所害，是以不能无避害之占也。
然大概与避乱相似，故并附列之。
yi: 平常安居没事，哪有空占卜？
或者是刑罚加身、户役牵累，或者官府来捉拿、仇家来报复，或者祸从无辜的事上起、灾殃从意外中生，如果不躲避它，终究要被它害，所以不能没有避害的占卜。
不过大概和避乱相似，所以一并附在这里。
en: Living at ease with nothing amiss, who has time to divine?

Or punishment is laid on one, or household duties drag one in, or the authorities come to seize one, or an enemy takes revenge, or calamity springs from nothing one has done and misfortune from the unforeseen: if one does not avoid it one is harmed in the end, so one cannot do without divination for avoiding harm.
But in general it is much like fleeing disorder, so it is appended together here.

title: 避乱·最怕官爻克世则必难回避：脱祸避祸遇鬼动伤世都不能避，鬼持世也一样；鬼空绝静或伏在世下，当前无事，将来当令恐怕又被发觉

rule.yi: 脱祸、避祸的占，遇到鬼爻发动伤世，都不能躲避，鬼爻持世也一样；如果鬼爻空绝安静，或者伏在世爻下面，眼下没事，后来当令时恐怕又被发觉。
rule.en: In escaping or avoiding calamity, if Pressure moves and injures the Self one cannot avoid it, and the same is true when Pressure holds the Self; if the Pressure line is Void or extinct and still, or hidden under the Self, there is no trouble for now, but when it comes into season later one fears it will be discovered again.

yi: 最怕官爻克世，
那就一定难以回避
en: Most to be feared is the Pressure line controlling the Self,
and then it surely cannot be avoided

zh: 凡脱祸避祸，遇鬼动伤世，皆不能避，持世亦然。
若鬼空绝静，如伏于世下者，日下无事，后当令恐复发觉。
yi: 凡是脱祸、避祸，遇到鬼发动伤世，都不能躲避，鬼持世也是这样。
如果鬼空绝安静，或者伏在世爻下面，眼下没事，后来当令时恐怕又被发觉。
en: In escaping or avoiding calamity, if Pressure moves and injures the Self one cannot avoid it, and the same is true when Pressure holds the Self.
If Pressure is Void or extinct and still, or hidden under the Self, there is no trouble for now, but when it comes into season later one fears it will be discovered again.

title: 避乱·大宜福德临身则终可逃生：子孙能制鬼，是解神，临身世、或在旁爻发动、或值月建日辰，即使遇官鬼也无妨，大怕落空亡墓绝受制

rule.yi: 子孙能制住鬼，是解神；如果临在身、世上，或者在旁边的爻发动，或者值月建、日辰，即使遇到官鬼也无妨，最终可以逃生；最怕子孙落空亡、入墓绝或受制。
rule.en: Output can control Pressure and is the loosening spirit; if it stands on the Body or the Self, or moves in another line, or stands on the Month or the Day, there is no harm even when Pressure appears, and one can in the end escape with one's life; what is feared most is its falling into Void, the tomb or extinction, or being controlled.

yi: 最适宜福德临在身上，
那样终究可以逃生
en: It is most fitting for Output to stand on the Self,
and then one can in the end escape with one's life

zh: 子孙能制鬼，为解神，若临身世或在旁爻发动，或值月建日辰，虽遇官鬼亦不妨事，大怕空亡墓绝受制。
yi: 子孙能制住鬼，是解神；如果临在身、世上，或者在旁边的爻发动，或者值月建、日辰，即使遇到官鬼也无妨，最怕空亡、墓绝、受制。
en: Output can control Pressure and is the loosening spirit; if it stands on the Body or the Self, or moves in another line, or stands on the Month or the Day, there is no harm even when Pressure appears; what is feared most is its falling into Void, the tomb or extinction, or being controlled.

title: 避乱·官化父冲必有文书挨捕：旺爻发动名已入册或有官批在外，鬼爻也动则事紧急，父化官、官化父刑克世爻必着公差搜捕

rule.yi: 旺相的爻发动，名字已经入了册，或者官府的批文已经在外；鬼爻也发动，事情紧急；父母化官、官鬼化父母，刑克世爻的，必定派公差来搜捕。
rule.en: A strong line moves: the name is already entered in the register, or there is an official order out; if the Pressure line also moves, the matter is urgent; if Resource changes into Pressure or Pressure into Resource and punishes or controls the Self, officers will surely be sent to hunt one down.

yi: 官鬼化出父母（文书）来冲，
必定有文书来搜捕
en: If Pressure changes into the document line and clashes,
there will surely be a warrant to hunt them down

zh: 旺爻发动，名已入册，或有官批在外。
父化官、官化父刑克世爻者，必着公差挨捕。
yi: 旺相的爻发动，名字已经入了册，或者有官府的批文在外；
鬼爻也发动，事情紧急；
父化官、官化父，刑克世爻的，必定派公差来搜捕。
en: A strong line moves: the name is already entered in the register, or there is an official order out;
if the Pressure line also moves, the matter is urgent;
if Resource changes into Pressure or Pressure into Resource and punishes or controls the Self, officers will surely be sent to hunt one down.

title: 避乱·日冲官散必多亲友维持：官动固难逃避，若有日辰动爻冲散克制它，必有心腹亲友替我周旋解释

rule.yi: 官鬼发动固然难以逃避，但如果有日辰、动爻冲散、克制它，必定有心腹亲友替我周旋、解释。
rule.en: Pressure moving is of course hard to escape, but if the Day or a moving line clashes it apart or controls it, there will surely be trusted relatives and friends to negotiate and explain for me.

yi: 日辰冲散官鬼，
必定有很多亲友出力维持
en: If the Day clashes Pressure apart,
many relatives and friends will surely help to see one through

zh: 官动固难逃避，若得日辰动爻冲散克制之，必有心腹亲友与我周旋解释。
yi: 官动固然难以逃避，但如果有日辰、动爻冲散、克制它，必定有心腹亲友替我周旋、解释。
en: Pressure moving is of course hard to escape, but if the Day or a moving line clashes it apart or controls it, there will surely be trusted relatives and friends to negotiate and explain for me.

title: 避乱·鬼伏而兄弟冲提祸由骨肉：官鬼伏藏而被兄弟冲开飞神提起，或兄弟冲动官鬼来刑克，是自家骨肉搜踪捕迹，难逃

rule.yi: 官鬼伏藏而被兄弟爻冲开飞神、提拔出来的，或者兄弟冲动官鬼来刑克的，是自家骨肉在搜踪捕迹，恐怕难以逃避。
rule.en: If hidden Pressure is raised out by Peer clashing the flying line, or Peer clashes Pressure into movement and it comes to punish or control, it is one's own flesh and blood tracking one down, and escape is likely hard.

yi: 鬼爻伏藏而被兄弟爻冲出提起，
祸是出自骨肉亲人
en: If Pressure is hidden and Peer clashes it out and raises it,
the disaster comes from one's own flesh and blood

zh: 官伏而被兄弟冲飞提拔者，或兄弟冲动官鬼来刑克者，是自家骨肉搜踪捕迹，恐难逃避也。
yi: 官鬼伏藏而被兄弟冲开飞神、提拔出来的，或者兄弟冲动官鬼来刑克的，是自家骨肉在搜踪捕迹，恐怕难以逃避。
en: If hidden Pressure is raised out by Peer clashing the flying line, or Peer clashes Pressure into movement and it comes to punish or control, it is one's own flesh and blood tracking one down, and escape is likely hard.

title: 避乱·官静而旁爻刑克事出吏书：鬼爻安静而卦中爻动刑克世爻，是衙役和仇家陷害；化出兄爻则想敲诈财物

rule.yi: 鬼爻安静，而卦中有爻发动刑克世爻的，是衙役和仇家陷害；如果化出兄爻，他们是想敲诈财物。
rule.en: If Pressure is still but a moving line in the hexagram punishes or controls the Self, it is yamen runners and enemies framing one; if it changes into a Peer line, they want to extort money.

yi: 官鬼安静而旁边的爻来刑克，
事情是出自吏员书办
en: If Pressure is still and another line comes to punish or control,
the matter comes from clerks and scribes

zh: 鬼静而卦中爻动刑克世爻者，乃是下役及仇家陷害也；
若化兄爻，彼欲索诈财物。
yi: 鬼爻安静，而卦中有爻发动刑克世爻的，是衙役及仇家陷害；
如果化出兄爻，他们是想敲诈财物。
en: If Pressure is still but a moving line in the hexagram punishes or controls the Self, it is yamen runners and enemies framing one;
if it changes into a Peer line, they want to extort money.

title: 避乱·应若遭伤当累众：官鬼伤克应爻必然连累别人，月建日辰伤克应爻也一样

rule.yi: 官鬼伤克应爻，必定连累别人；月建、日辰伤克应爻也是这样。
rule.en: If Pressure injures or controls the Other line, others will surely be dragged in; the same holds when the Month or the Day does it.

note.yi: 原书这一行把两联写在一起（「应若遭伤当累众……」「妻如受克定伤财……」），这里按联拆成两条。
note.en: The book writes two couplets together on this line ("if the Other is injured, others are dragged in ..." and "if Wealth is controlled, money is surely lost ..."); they are split here into two entries.

yi: 应爻如果遭到伤害就会连累众人
en: If the Other is injured, others will be dragged in

zh: 官鬼伤克应爻，必然累及他人，月建日辰亦然。
yi: 官鬼伤克应爻，必定连累别人；月建、日辰伤克应爻也是这样。
en: If Pressure injures or controls the Other line, others will surely be dragged in; the same holds when the Month or the Day does it.

title: 避乱·妻如受克定伤财：财爻受克一定伤财，再遇兄弟发动必定破费财物

rule.yi: 财爻如果受克，一定要伤财；如果又遇到兄弟发动，必定破费钱财。
rule.en: If the Wealth line is controlled, money is surely lost; if a Peer line also moves, there will surely be expense and loss of money.

yi: 妻财如果受克，一定伤财
en: If Wealth is controlled, money is surely lost

zh: 如遇兄动，必主破费财物。
yi: 如果遇到兄弟发动，必定要破费钱财。
en: If a Peer line moves as well, there will surely be expense and loss of money.

title: 避乱·偏喜六爻安静：六爻不动、官爻没有被冲并的，患难可以躲过，户役可以脱免

rule.yi: 六爻不动，官爻没有被冲、并的，患难可以躲过，户役可以脱免。
rule.en: If the six lines do not move and the Pressure line is neither clashed nor joined, trouble can be avoided and household duties escaped.

note.yi: 原书这一行也把两联写在一起（「偏喜六爻安静……」「又宜一卦无官……」），这里按联拆成两条。
note.en: The book also writes two couplets together on this line ("it is especially welcome that the six lines are still ..." and "it is also fitting that the hexagram has no Pressure ..."); they are split here into two entries.

yi: 特别喜欢六爻安静
en: It is especially welcome that the six lines are still

zh: 六爻不动，官爻无冲并者，患难可避，户役可脱。
yi: 六爻不动，官爻没有被冲、并的，患难可以躲过，户役可以脱免。
en: If the six lines do not move and the Pressure line is neither clashed nor joined, trouble can be avoided and household duties escaped.

title: 避乱·又宜一卦无官：没有官鬼，事情必定平安，官鬼空亡也吉

rule.yi: 整个卦里没有官鬼，事情必定平安；官鬼空亡也吉。
rule.en: With no Pressure in the whole hexagram the matter is surely safe; Pressure Void is also lucky.

yi: 又适宜整个卦里没有官鬼
en: It is also fitting for the whole hexagram to have no Pressure

zh: 无官鬼则主事必平安，空亡亦吉。
yi: 没有官鬼，事情必定平安；官鬼空亡也吉。
en: With no Pressure the matter is surely safe; Pressure Void is also lucky.

title: 避乱·或身世之逢空：世、身落空亡，百事消散，即使有鬼动也无妨

rule.yi: 世爻、身落在空亡，百事消散，即使有鬼爻发动也无妨。
rule.en: If the Self and Body are Void, all things melt away, and even if Pressure moves there is no harm.

yi: 或者身、世遇到空亡
en: Or if the Body and the Self meet Void

zh: 世身空亡，百事消散，虽有鬼动亦不妨事。
yi: 世、身落空亡，百事消散，即使有鬼爻发动也无妨。
en: If the Self and Body are Void, all things melt away, and even if Pressure moves there is no harm.

title: 避乱·或用神之得地：用神旺相而没有刑冲克害，又不化死墓空绝，都是吉兆

rule.yi: 用神旺相而没有刑冲克害，又不化出死、墓、空、绝，都是吉兆。
rule.en: If the Subject is strong and free of punishment, clash, control and harm, and does not change into death, tomb, Void or extinction, all are auspicious signs.

yi: 或者用神得地
en: Or if the Subject is well placed

zh: 用神旺相而无刑冲克害，不化死墓空绝，皆为吉兆。
yi: 用神旺相而没有刑冲克害，不化出死、墓、空、绝，都是吉兆。
en: If the Subject is strong and free of punishment, clash, control and harm, and does not change into death, tomb, Void or extinction, all are auspicious signs.

title: 避乱·天来大事也无妨、海样深仇何足虑：总括上面四节，卦中只要有一个吉神，决然无事

rule.yi: 这两句总括上面四节：卦中只要有一个吉神，决然无事，天大的事也无妨，海一样深的仇怨也不必忧虑。
rule.en: These two lines sum up the four sections above: so long as the hexagram has one auspicious spirit, there will certainly be no trouble; even a matter as great as heaven does no harm, and a grudge as deep as the sea is nothing to worry over.

note.yi: 这一章最后的一段（第 1647 行）是对读者的话——「事有百端，理无二致」，要融会贯通，不是判断规则，没有收。
note.en: The last paragraph of the chapter (line 1647) is advice to the reader — "affairs are hundredfold but the principle is one" — to master it all and reason from principle; it is not a rule of judgement and is not included.

yi: 天大的事也无妨，
海一样深的仇怨又何必忧虑
en: Even a matter as great as heaven does no harm,
and a grudge as deep as the sea is nothing to worry over

zh: 此二句总上文四节，总结而言，卦中有一吉神，决然无事也。
yi: 这两句总括上面四节，总结起来说，卦中只要有一个吉神，就决然无事。
en: These two lines sum up the four sections above: in sum, so long as the hexagram has one auspicious spirit, there will certainly be no trouble.

title: 出行章·世爻旺相宜行、应若空亡且止：世是出行的人，生旺有气则吉，动而化吉或化子孙更吉，休囚空破、动而化凶则不宜行；应是地头与依傍之人，空破墓绝或变鬼变绝回头克，去也无益

rule.yi: 世爻是出行的人，旺相有气就适宜出行；发动化出吉的爻、化出子孙更吉；休囚空破，或者发动化出凶的，就不宜出行。应爻是目的地，又是依傍的人，应爻空亡就该停下；应爻空破墓绝，或者发动变鬼、变绝、化出回头克，去了也没有益处。
rule.en: The Self line is the one who goes: if it is strong and has breath it is fit to set out, it is better still if it moves and changes into something lucky or into Output, and it is unfit to set out if it is resting or trapped, Void or broken, or moves and changes into something ill. The Other line is the destination and also the person one leans on: if the Other is Void one should stop, and if it is Void, broken, in the tomb or extinct, or moves and changes into Pressure, into extinction or into a line that turns back to control it, going is of no use.

zh: 人为名利奔驰，道路风波不测。
yi: 人为了名利奔波，道路上的风波难以预料。
占卜应当在先。
en: Men rush about for fame and gain, and the storms of the road cannot be foreseen.
Divination should come first.

zh: 世爻旺相宜行，应若空亡且止。
世为出行之人，生旺有气则吉，动而化吉，及化子孙者，更吉；
如休囚空破、动而化凶，则不宜行也。
应为地头，又为傍倚之人，若空破墓绝，或动而变鬼、变绝、化回头之克，去亦无益。
yi: 世爻旺相适宜出行，应爻如果空亡就该停下。
世是出行的人：生旺有气就吉，发动化出吉的、以及化出子孙的，更吉；
如果休囚空破、发动化出凶的，就不宜出行。
应是目的地，又是依傍的人，如果空破墓绝，或者发动变鬼、变绝、化出回头克，去了也没有益处。
en: With the Self strong it is fit to set out; if the Other is Void one should stop.
The Self is the one who goes: strong and with breath it is lucky, and moving and changing into something lucky, or into Output, it is better still;
if it is resting or trapped, Void or broken, or moves and changes into something ill, it is unfit to set out.

The Other is the destination and also the person one leans on; if it is Void, broken, in the tomb or extinct, or moves and changes into Pressure, into extinction, or into a line that turns back to control it, going is of no use.

title: 出行章·世伤应位不拘远近皆宜、应克世爻公私皆主不利：我去克他则所向通达，应来刑冲克世则不可行

rule.yi: 世爻克伤应位，不论远近都适宜出行；应爻克世爻，公事私事都主不利。我去克他，所去的方向通达；应来刑冲克世，不可出行。
rule.en: The Self injuring the Other position is fit whether the journey is far or near; the Other controlling the Self is unfavourable for public and private business alike. My going to control him means the way I go is open; if the Other comes to punish, clash or control the Self, one must not go.

zh: 世伤应位，不拘远近皆宜；
应克世爻，公私皆主不利。
应来刑冲克世，不可行也。
yi: 世爻克伤应位，不论远近都适宜；
应爻克世爻，公事私事都主不利。
我去克他，所去的方向通达；
应来刑冲克世，不可出行。
en: The Self injuring the Other position is fit whether the journey is far or near;
the Other controlling the Self is unfavourable for public and private business alike.
My going to control him means the way I go is open;
if the Other comes to punish, clash or control the Self, one must not go.

title: 出行章·八纯乱动在处皆凶、两间齐空独行则吉；六冲卦及动变冲、世爻休囚被克者终不能去，有始无终，去亦诸般不就

rule.yi: 八纯卦乱动，到处都凶；两个间爻同时空，一个人走才吉。六冲卦，以及发动变成冲的、世爻休囚被克的，终究去不成，有始无终，去了也诸事不成。
rule.en: A pure-palace hexagram moving in disorder is ill everywhere; if the two between lines are both Void, travelling alone is lucky. A six-clash hexagram, or one that moves and changes into a clash, or one whose Self is resting or trapped and controlled, in the end cannot go; it begins and does not finish, and even if one goes nothing comes to pass.

zh: 六冲卦，及动而变冲、世爻休囚被克者，终不能去，有始无终，去亦诸般不就。
yi: 八纯卦乱动，到处都凶；
两个间爻同时空，一个人走才吉。
六冲卦，以及发动变成冲的、世爻休囚被克的，终究去不成，有始无终，去了也诸事不成。
en: A pure-palace hexagram moving in disorder is ill everywhere;
if the two between lines are both Void, travelling alone is lucky.

A six-clash hexagram, or one that moves and changes into a clash, or one whose Self is resting or trapped and controlled, in the end cannot go; it begins and does not finish, and even if one goes nothing comes to pass.

title: 出行章·两间爻是同行附载之人：发动克世必遭其害，动临兄爻必破我财，生合我者吉；两间齐空则不是中途梗阻就是无伴单行

rule.yi: 两个间爻是同行、搭载的人：发动克世，一定遭他们的害；发动临着兄爻，一定破我的财；生合我的就吉；如果两个间爻同时空，不是中途受阻，就一定没有伴、一个人走。
rule.en: The two between lines are the people who travel with one or are carried along: moving to control the Self, they surely do one harm; moving with a Peer line, they surely cost me money; those that give me life or combine with me are lucky; and if both between lines are Void, either one is obstructed on the road or one travels alone without company.

zh: 两间爻，乃同行附载之人，动而克世，定遭其害；
倘两间齐空，若非中途梗阻，定然无伴单行。
yi: 两个间爻，是同行、搭载的人，发动克世，一定遭他们的害；
发动临着兄爻，一定破我的财；
生合我的就吉。
如果两个间爻同时空，不是中途受阻，就一定没有伴、一个人走。
en: The two between lines are the people who travel with one or are carried along; moving to control the Self, one is surely harmed by them;
moving with a Peer line, they surely cost me money;
those that give me life or combine with me are lucky.
If both between lines are Void, either one is obstructed on the road or one travels alone without company.

title: 出行章·静遇日冲必去、动逢合住而留：世爻暗动必去，世旺静逢冲之日必去，世爻动而化合或被日月动爻合住必有事故阻滞（觉子：也有应在冲开之日才走的）

rule.yi: 世爻安静而遇到日冲，一定去；发动而被合住，就留下。世爻暗中发动的，一定去；世爻旺相而安静的，逢到冲的日子一定去；世爻发动而化出合，或者被日、月、动爻合住的，必有事故，被阻滞不能走。觉子说：我曾试验过，也有应验在冲开的那天才走的。
rule.en: If the Self is still and meets the clash of the Day, one surely goes; if it moves and is held by a combination, one stays. If the Self moves in secret, one surely goes; if the Self is strong and still, one surely goes on the day that clashes it; if the Self moves and changes into a combination, or is held by a combination from the Day, the Month or a moving line, there is surely some affair, and one is obstructed and does not go. Juezi says: I have tried it and found that it sometimes answers by going on the day that clashes it open.

zh: 静遇日冲必去，动逢合住而畱。
世旺静者，逢冲之日必去；
世爻动而化合，或被日月动爻合者，必有事故，阻滞不行。
yi: 世爻安静而遇到日冲就一定去，发动而逢到合住就留下。
世爻暗中发动的，一定去；
世爻旺相而安静的，逢到冲的日子一定去；
世爻发动而化出合，或者被日月、动爻合住的，必有事故，被阻滞不能走。
en: Still and meeting the clash of the Day, one surely goes; moving and meeting a combination that holds it, one stays.
if the Self moves in secret, one surely goes;
if the Self is strong and still, one surely goes on the day that clashes it;
if the Self moves and changes into a combination, or is held by a combination from the Day, the Month or a moving line, there is surely some affair, and one is obstructed and does not go.

zh: 觉子曰：予尝得验，亦有应在冲开之日而行者。
yi: 觉子说：我曾试验过，也有应验在冲开的那天才走的。
en: Juezi says: I have tried it and found that it sometimes answers by going on the day that clashes it open.

title: 出行章·官鬼交重灾祸重：武鬼忧盗贼、朱鬼防讼非、虎鬼疾病淹缠、蛇鬼风波惊险、勾鬼事勾连、青鬼戒嫖赌；鬼发震乾车马患，兑坎虑风波，坤艮山岭逢殃，离巽炎厂林窖被难

rule.yi: 官鬼发动重叠，灾祸就重：带玄武动，担忧盗贼；带朱雀发动，提防官司口舌；带白虎，疾病缠身；带螣蛇，风波惊险；带勾陈发动，事情牵连纠缠；带青龙发动，要戒嫖赌。鬼爻发在震、乾，有车马之患；发在兑、坎，要虑风波；坤、艮的鬼爻，在山间岭野遇灾殃；离、巽的官爻，在炉场、树林、窑窖里遭难。
rule.en: Pressure moving in force means heavy calamity: with the Dark Tortoise moving, worry about thieves; with the Vermilion Bird, guard against lawsuits and quarrels; with the White Tiger, illness that lingers; with the Coiling Snake, storms and frightening danger; with Hook Earth moving, entanglement in others' affairs; with the Azure Dragon moving, beware of whoring and gambling. Pressure moving in Zhen or Qian brings the danger of carts and horses, moving in Dui or Kan, think of storms; Pressure in Kun or Gen means calamity on mountain and ridge; Pressure in Li or Xun means disaster in forge-yards, woods and kilns.

note.yi: 「趋避章」是增删卜易讲怎样趋吉避凶的一章，里面讲避难、避贼、避大罪的几节在本库里分别收进「出行」「失物」「官非」。「炎厂」按文意是炉火作坊一类的场所。
note.en: The "chapter on avoiding" is the Zengshan Buyi's chapter on how to seek the lucky and avoid the ill, whose sections on escaping disorder, avoiding thieves and avoiding a heavy sentence are taken into this library under Travel, Lost goods and Lawsuits respectively. The "flame yard" is by the sense a place of furnaces and workshops.

zh: 武鬼动，忧盗贼，朱鬼发，防讼非；
鬼发震乾，车马患，鬼发兑坎，虑风波；
坤艮之鬼，山间岭野逢殃；
离巽之官，炎厂林窖被难。
yi: 官鬼发动重叠，灾祸就重。
玄武鬼爻动，要担忧盗贼；朱雀鬼爻发动，要提防官司口舌；
白虎鬼爻，疾病缠身；
螣蛇鬼爻，风波惊险；
勾陈鬼爻发动，事情牵连纠缠；
青龙鬼爻发动，要戒嫖赌。
鬼爻发在震、乾，有车马的祸患；鬼爻发在兑、坎，要虑风波；
坤、艮的鬼爻，在山间岭野遇灾殃；
离、巽的官爻，在炉场、树林、窑窖里遭难。
其余详见趋避章。
en: Pressure moving in force means heavy calamity.
with the Dark Tortoise on the moving Pressure line, worry about thieves; with the Vermilion Bird, guard against lawsuits and quarrels;
with the White Tiger on Pressure, illness that lingers;
with the Coiling Snake, storms and frightening danger;
with Hook Earth on moving Pressure, entanglement in others' affairs;
with the Azure Dragon on moving Pressure, beware of whoring and gambling.
Pressure moving in Zhen or Qian brings the danger of carts and horses; moving in Dui or Kan, think of storms;
Pressure in Kun or Gen means calamity on mountain and ridge;
Pressure in Li or Xun means disaster in forge-yards, woods and kilns.
The rest is set out in detail in the chapter on avoiding.

title: 出行章·福神发动患殃消：子孙发动、子孙持世、世化子孙，万里程途百祸潜消；子孙克世也吉

rule.yi: 福神发动，祸患灾殃就消散。出行时，遇到子孙发动、子孙持世、世爻化出子孙，走万里路程，百种祸患都暗中消散；子孙克世的也吉。
rule.en: When Output moves, misfortune and calamity melt away. In travelling, if Output moves, Output holds the Self, or the Self changes into Output, then through a journey of ten thousand li a hundred misfortunes quietly vanish; Output controlling the Self is also lucky.

zh: 出行，得遇子孙发动、子孙持世、世化子孙，程途万里，百祸潜消。
yi: 福神发动，祸患灾殃就消散。
出行，遇到子孙发动、子孙持世、世爻化出子孙，走万里路程，百种祸患都暗中消散。
子孙克世的也吉。
en: Output moving, misfortune and calamity melt away.
In travelling, if Output moves, Output holds the Self, or the Self changes into Output, then through a journey of ten thousand li a hundred misfortunes quietly vanish.
Output controlling the Self is also lucky.

title: 出行章·父克世爻风雨舟车行李：父母持世而动、或父动冲克世爻，应舟车行李之累和淋漓风雨之愁，世旺者无妨，最怕休囚而化凶

rule.yi: 父母爻持世而发动，或者发动的父爻冲克世爻，验证过的，有的应在舟车、行李的劳累，有的应在淋漓风雨的忧愁；世爻旺相的无妨，最怕世爻休囚又化出凶。
rule.en: If the Resource line holds the Self and moves, or a moving Resource line clashes with or controls the Self, as I have tested it, it answers sometimes in the burden of boats, carts and baggage and sometimes in the misery of being drenched by wind and rain; if the Self is strong there is no harm, and what is feared most is the Self resting or trapped and changing into something ill.

zh: 父克世爻，风雨舟车行李。
父母持世而动，或被父动冲克世爻，余得验者，有应舟车行李之累，有应淋漓风雨之愁，世旺者无妨，最怕休囚而化凶也。
yi: 父爻克世爻，有风雨、舟车、行李的烦恼。
父母爻持世而发动，或者被发动的父爻冲克世爻，我验证过的，有的应在舟车行李的劳累，有的应在淋漓风雨的忧愁；世爻旺相的无妨，最怕休囚而化出凶。
en: The Resource line controlling the Self brings the troubles of wind and rain, boats and carts, and baggage.

If the Resource line holds the Self and moves, or a moving Resource line clashes with or controls the Self, as I have tested it, it answers sometimes in the burden of boats, carts and baggage and sometimes in the misery of being drenched by wind and rain; if the Self is strong there is no harm, and what is feared most is its being resting or trapped and changing into something ill.

title: 出行章·兄冲世位花月耗破灾非：财持世而兄爻冲克，有的应在月夕花朝无端浪费，有的应在奸徒小辈暗骗明欺，酿成灾非，破耗百出

rule.yi: 兄弟爻冲克世位，主在花前月下耗费钱财、引来灾非：财爻持世而被兄爻冲克的，有的应在月夜花朝无缘无故地浪费，有的应在奸诈之徒、小人暗骗明欺，以致酿成灾非，破耗百出。
rule.en: A Peer line clashing with or controlling the Self position means money wasted amid flowers and moonlight and trouble brought on: when Wealth holds the Self and a Peer line clashes with or controls it, it sometimes answers in pointless waste on moonlit nights and flowery mornings, and sometimes in treacherous rogues and petty men cheating in secret and deceiving openly, so that trouble is brewed and losses of every kind appear.

zh: 兄冲世位，花月耗破灾非。
财持世，兄爻冲克者，有应月夕花朝，无端浪费；
有应奸徒小辈，暗骗明欺，以致酿成灾非，破耗百出。
yi: 兄爻冲世位，在花前月下耗费钱财、有灾非。
财爻持世，而兄爻冲克它的，有的应在月夜花朝无缘无故地浪费；
有的应在奸诈之徒、小人暗骗明欺，以致酿成灾非，破耗百出。
en: A Peer line clashing the Self position brings money wasted amid flowers and moonlight, and trouble.
When Wealth holds the Self and a Peer line clashes with or controls it, it sometimes answers in pointless waste on moonlit nights and flowery mornings;
sometimes in treacherous rogues and petty men cheating in secret and deceiving openly, so that trouble is brewed and losses of every kind appear.

title: 出行章·反吟化退中途返、六冲随墓始终凶：伏吟世动冲开之月日必行，反吟去到中途亦返，世逢冲克大凶，六冲卦世静世空断不能行，随鬼入墓世休囚是不返之兆

rule.yi: 反吟、化退神的，中途返回；六冲、随鬼入墓的，始终凶。卦得伏吟，世爻发动的，到冲开的月日一定出行；卦得反吟，走到半路也要返回；世遇冲克，大凶；六冲卦，世爻安静或空，断定不能出行；随鬼入墓，世爻休囚，是不回来的征兆。
rule.en: Reversed Chant, or changing into a Retreating spirit, means turning back on the road; six-clash, or entering the tomb with Pressure, is ill from start to finish. If the hexagram is Hidden Chant and the Self moves, one surely sets out in the month or on the day that clashes it open; if it is Reversed Chant, even on getting halfway one turns back; the Self meeting clash and control is greatly ill; in a six-clash hexagram with the Self still or Void it is judged that one cannot go; entering the tomb with Pressure, if the Self is resting or trapped, is the sign of not returning.

zh: 反吟化退中途返，六冲随墓始终凶。
卦得伏吟，世动者，冲开之月日必行；
卦得反吟，去到中途亦返；
六冲卦，世静世空，断不能行；
随鬼入墓，世若休囚，不返之兆。
yi: 反吟、化退神的，中途返回；六冲、随鬼入墓的，始终凶。
卦得伏吟，世爻发动的，到冲开的月日一定出行；
卦得反吟，走到半路也要返回；
世遇到冲克，大凶；
六冲卦，世爻安静或空，断定不能出行；
随鬼入墓，世爻休囚，是不回来的征兆。
en: Reversed Chant, or changing into a Retreating spirit, means turning back on the road; six-clash, or entering the tomb with Pressure, is ill from start to finish.
If the hexagram is Hidden Chant and the Self moves, one surely sets out in the month or on the day that clashes it open;
if it is Reversed Chant, even on getting halfway one turns back;
the Self meeting clash and control is greatly ill;
in a six-clash hexagram with the Self still or Void it is judged that one cannot go;
entering the tomb with Pressure, if the Self is resting or trapped, is the sign of not returning.

title: 出行章·六合化冲不吉、六冲化合方亨：六合卦变六冲及卦变克绝，在家也恐凶危

rule.yi: 六合卦变成冲不吉，六冲卦变成合才亨通；六合卦变成六冲卦，以及卦变到克、绝的，就是待在家里也恐怕有凶险。
rule.en: A six-combine hexagram changing into a clash is not lucky, and a six-clash hexagram changing into a combination is smooth; a six-combine hexagram changing into a six-clash hexagram, or one changing into control or extinction, is dangerous even at home.

zh: 六合化冲不吉，六冲化合方亨。
六合卦变六冲，及卦变克绝者，在家亦恐凶危。
yi: 六合卦变成冲不吉，六冲卦变成合才亨通。
六合卦变成六冲卦，以及卦变到克、绝的，就是待在家里也恐怕有凶险。
en: A six-combine hexagram changing into a clash is not lucky, and a six-clash hexagram changing into a combination is smooth.
A six-combine hexagram changing into a six-clash hexagram, or one changing into control or extinction, is dangerous even at home.

title: 舟行章·登舟问何日到：世爻发动，合日、值日而到；子孙持世或子孙他爻发动，值日而到；世化退及反吟卦，中途而返

rule.yi: 上船问哪天到：世爻发动，在合的日子或值日那天到；子孙持世，或者子孙在别的爻发动，值日那天到；世爻化退神，以及反吟卦，中途返回。
rule.en: Boarding and asking on what day one arrives: if the Self moves, one arrives on the combining day or the ruling day; if Output holds the Self, or Output moves in another line, one arrives on the ruling day; if the Self changes into a Retreating spirit, or the hexagram is Reversed Chant, one turns back on the way.

zh: 登舟问何日到者，世爻发动，合日、值日而到；
若得子孙持世，及子孙他爻发动者，值日而到；
世化退，及反吟卦，中途而返。
yi: 上船问哪天到的：世爻发动，在合的日子、值日那天到；
如果子孙持世，以及子孙在别的爻发动的，值日那天到；
世爻化退神，以及反吟卦，中途返回。
en: Boarding and asking on what day one arrives: if the Self moves, one arrives on the combining day or the ruling day;
if Output holds the Self, or Output moves in another line, one arrives on the ruling day;
if the Self changes into a Retreating spirit, or the hexagram is Reversed Chant, one turns back on the way.

title: 舟行章·舟行问平安：子孙持世、克世、生世、合世则一路无虞，官鬼持世忧郁惊恐，官鬼冲克世爻灾非必见，兄动破财

rule.yi: 乘船问平安与否：子孙持世、克世、生世、合世，一路没有忧患；官鬼持世，忧愁惊恐；官鬼冲克世爻，必定见灾非；兄爻发动，破财。
rule.en: On a boat, asking whether it will be safe: if Output holds, controls, gives life to or combines with the Self, the whole road is free of trouble; if Pressure holds the Self, worry and fright; if Pressure clashes with or controls the Self, calamity and trouble will surely be seen; a moving Peer line costs money.

zh: 舟行问平安否，子孙持世、克世、生世、合世，一路无虞；
官鬼冲克世爻，灾非必见；
yi: 乘船问平安与否：子孙持世、克世、生世、合世，一路没有忧患；
官鬼持世，忧愁惊恐；
官鬼冲克世爻，必定见灾非；
兄爻发动，破财。
en: On a boat, asking whether it will be safe: if Output holds, controls, gives life to or combines with the Self, the whole road is free of trouble;
if Pressure holds the Self, worry and fright;
if Pressure clashes with or controls the Self, calamity and trouble will surely be seen;
a moving Peer line costs money.

title: 舟行章·舟行风阻：不拿兄弟爻当风云，要拿子孙爻当顺风；动的逢合、逢值之日，静的逢冲之日，空的逢冲实之日（顺风），都与天时章阴晴同断

rule.yi: 乘船遇到风阻的，不要拿兄弟爻当风云，而要拿子孙爻当顺风：发动的遇到合、值的日子，安静的遇到冲的日子，空的遇到冲实的日子（顺风），都和天时章里断阴晴的办法相同。
rule.en: For a boat held up by wind, do not take the Peer line as wind and cloud but take Output as the fair wind: it comes on the day when a moving one meets a combination or the ruling day, on the day when a still one meets a clash, and on the day when a Void one meets the clash that fills it, all judged in the same way as fine and cloudy weather in the chapter on the weather.

note.yi: 天时章（占晴雨风云）不属于「出行」，本库没有收；这里只引它说的办法：动的逢合逢值、静的逢冲、空的逢冲实。
note.en: The chapter on the weather (fine, rain, wind and cloud) is outside Travel and is not taken into this library; only its method is cited here: a moving line by the combining or ruling day, a still line by the clashing day, a Void line by the day that clashes it solid.

zh: 舟行风阻者，勿以兄弟为风云，乃以子孙为顺风，动而逢合逢值之日，静而逢冲之日，空逢冲实之日，皆与天时章阴晴同断。
yi: 乘船遇到风阻的，不要拿兄弟爻当风云，而要拿子孙爻当顺风；发动的遇到合、值的日子，安静的遇到冲的日子，空的遇到冲实的日子，都和天时章里断阴晴的办法相同。
en: For a boat held up by wind, do not take the Peer line as wind and cloud but take Output as the fair wind; it comes on the day when a moving one meets a combination or the ruling day, on the day when a still one meets a clash, and on the day when a Void one meets the clash that fills it, all judged in the same way as fine and cloudy weather in the chapter on the weather.

title: 同舟共行章·同行共处应为尊、同路同舟一样论：应伤世位遭他害，只宜生合相扶助；三合同途皆遂意、六冲半路便灰心；占他人以应为用，占亲戚看所用用神，不宜兄鬼动克世

rule.yi: 同行、同住，以应爻为尊，同路、同船一样论：应爻伤了世位，会遭他的害；应爻入墓、空、绝、破，是辜负我的恩情；只适宜生合、互相扶助，永远靠他维持，像至亲一样。三合同路，事事遂意；六冲，走到半路就灰心。日常起居为害，看兄弟、官鬼发动；水路和睦清平，看子孙发动。占别人，以应为用；占亲戚，看所属的用神；不宜兄、鬼发动克世，最宜相合相生。
rule.en: For those who travel and stay together, the Other is the honoured one, and those on the same road or in the same boat are judged alike: if the Other injures the Self position, one suffers harm from him; if the Other is in the tomb, Void, extinct or broken, he is ungrateful for my kindness; it is fit only that they give life, combine and support each other, so that one can always rely on his help as on one's own kin. Three-harmony on the same road, everything goes as wished; six-clash, one loses heart halfway. For harm in daily life and lodging, look to a moving Peer or Pressure; for peace and harmony on the water, look to a moving Output. In divining for another person, the Other is the Subject; for a relative, look at that relative's own Subject; it is unfit for Peer or Pressure to move and control the Self, and best when they combine and generate.

note.yi: 这一章前面是一首四言六句的诗（「同行共处应为尊……」），后面两句是散文补充；诗里的「兄鬼」是兄弟爻和官鬼爻的简称。
note.en: The chapter is a short verse (beginning "for those travelling and staying together the Other is honoured") followed by a prose supplement; "Peer and Pressure" in the verse stands for the Peer and Pressure lines.

zh: 同行共处应为尊，同路同舟一样论。
应伤世位遭他害，墓空绝破负吾恩。
只宜生合相扶助，永赖维持如至亲。
三合同途皆遂意，六冲半路便灰心。
起居为害摇兄鬼，水睦清平动子孙。
yi: 同行共处，以应爻为尊，同路、同船一样论。
应爻伤了世位，会遭他的害；应爻入墓、空、绝、破，是辜负我的恩情。
只适宜生合、互相扶助，永远靠他维持，像至亲一样。
三合同路，事事遂意；六冲，走到半路就灰心。
日常起居为害，看兄弟、官鬼发动；水路和睦清平，看子孙发动。
en: For those travelling and staying together, the Other is the honoured one, and those on the same road and in the same boat are judged alike.
If the Other injures the Self position, one suffers harm from him; if the Other is in the tomb, Void, extinct or broken, he is ungrateful for my kindness.
It is fit only that they give life, combine and support each other, so that one can always rely on his help as on one's own kin.
Three-harmony on the same road, everything goes as wished; six-clash, one loses heart halfway.
For harm in daily life and lodging, look to a moving Peer or Pressure; for peace and harmony on the water, look to a moving Output.

zh: 不宜兄鬼动而克世，最宜相合相生。
yi: 占别人，以应爻为用神；
占亲戚，看所属的用神。
不宜兄爻、鬼爻发动而克世，最宜相合相生。
en: In divining for another person, the Other is the Subject;
for a relative, look at that relative's own Subject.
It is unfit for Peer or Pressure to move and control the Self, and best when they combine and generate.

title: 行人章·问归期有远有近：近则应日、远则应月，去久而眼下当归的只用日断；问平安与否要另占一卦，不可一卦兼断

rule.yi: 问行人什么时候回来，有远有近：近的应在日，远的应在月；也有离开很久、眼下就该回来的，只用日来断。问行人平安与否，要另外占一卦，不可以一卦兼断。
rule.en: In asking when a traveller will return, some returns are far and some near: a near one falls on a day, a far one on a month; there are also those who have long been away and are due back very soon, and these too are judged by the day alone. In asking whether the traveller is faring well or ill, divine separately; do not judge both from a single hexagram.

zh: 问行人之归期，有远有近，近则应日，远则应月；
亦有去久，目下当归者，又止以日断之。
问行人之否泰，宜另占，不可一卦兼断。
yi: 问行人什么时候回来，有远有近：近的应在日，远的应在月；
也有离开很久、眼下就该回来的，只用日来断。
问行人平安与否，要另外占一卦，不可以一卦兼断。
en: In asking when a traveller will return, some returns are far and some near: a near one falls on a day, a far one on a month;
there are also those who have long been away and are due back very soon, and these too are judged by the day alone.
In asking whether the traveller is faring well or ill, divine separately; do not judge both from a single hexagram.

title: 行人章·世克用则人未动、用克世必然归：占亲人看所属用神，疏远的以应爻为用神；世克用且无归志，用克世指日回家（作者说试过果验）

rule.yi: 世爻克用神，人还没有动身；用神克世爻，一定会回来。占亲人，看所属的用神；关系疏远的，拿应爻当用神。世爻克用神，他还没有回来的心思；用神克世爻，不久就回家。作者说：我试过，果然应验。
rule.en: When the Self controls the Subject, the man has not yet moved; when the Subject controls the Self, he will surely return. In divining for a kinsman, look at that kinsman's own Subject; for a distant person, take the Other line as the Subject. If the Self controls the Subject, he has no mind to return; if the Subject controls the Self, he will be home within days. The author says: I have tried it, and it was indeed borne out.

zh: 世克用兮人未动，用爻克世必然归。
yi: 世爻克用神，人还没有动身；用神克世爻，一定会回来。
占亲人，看所属的用神；
关系疏远的，拿应爻当用神。
世爻克用神，他还没有回来的心思；
用神克世爻，不久就回家。
我试过，果然应验。
en: When the Self controls the Subject, the man has not yet moved; when the Subject controls the Self, he will surely return.
In divining for a kinsman, look at that kinsman's own Subject;
for a distant person, take the Other line as the Subject.
If the Self controls the Subject, he has no mind to return;
if the Subject controls the Self, he will be home within days.
I have tried it, and it was indeed borne out.

title: 行人章·用神墓绝空破则音信杳然、暗动明摇则归鞭已发：用神伏藏的在出现之日回，发动的在逢合之日回

rule.yi: 用神入墓、绝、空、破，回来的消息杳无音信；用神暗动（安静而日辰冲动它）或明动（自己发动），就是出发回家了。用神伏藏的，在它出现的日子回来；用神发动的，在逢合的日子回来。
rule.en: When the Subject is in the tomb, extinct, Void or broken, no word of a return comes; when it is stirred in secret (still but moved by the clashing day) or moves in the open, the whip is already raised for home. A hidden Subject returns on the day it appears; a moving one returns on the day it meets a combination.

note.yi: 「暗动」是用神安静、被日辰冲起来；「明摇」是用神自己发动。这里把二者并说，都当作要动身的信号。
note.en: "Stirred in secret" means the Subject is still and moved by the clashing day; "moving in the open" means the Subject moves on its own. Both are taken here as signs that he is about to set out.

yi: 用神入墓、绝、空、破，回来的消息杳无音信；
用神暗动、明动，就是出发回家了。
伏藏的，在它出现的日子回来；
发动的，在逢合的日子回来。
en: When the Subject is in the tomb, extinct, Void or broken, no word of a return comes;
when the Subject is stirred in secret or moves in the open, the whip is already raised for home.
A hidden one returns on the day it appears;
a moving one returns on the day it meets a combination.

title: 行人章·用神动化进神不返、化退神必归，动逢合有事阻隔、动化鬼在外危灾：最忌动而化克，还防卦变反吟

rule.yi: 用神发动化出进神，不回来；用神发动化出退神，一定回来。发动遇到合，有事阻隔在外；发动化出官鬼，在外有危险灾祸。最怕发动而化出克它的爻，还要提防卦变成反吟。
rule.en: A Subject that moves and changes into an Advancing spirit does not return; one that changes into a Retreating spirit surely returns. A moving Subject that meets a combination is held up by some affair; one that changes into Pressure meets danger and calamity abroad. Most to be feared is a movement that changes into a controlling line, and beware too of the hexagram changing into Reversed Chant.

dispute.yi: 《黄金策》说用爻化进神，行人很快就回，化退神则来了又返回或又去别处（见黄金策·行人）；这里相反：化进神不回，化退神必回。两书对进退神的读法正好相反，没有哪一本交代理由。
dispute.en: The Huangjin Ce says that a Subject changing into an Advancing spirit means the traveller hurries home, and changing into a Retreating spirit means he comes and then goes back or goes elsewhere (see the Huangjin Ce on travellers); this chapter says the opposite, that an Advancing change does not return and a Retreating change surely returns. The two books read Advancing and Retreating in opposite ways, and neither gives its reason.

zh: 动化进神不返，用神化退必归；
最忌动而化克，还防卦变反吟。
yi: 动化进神不返，用神化退神必定回来；
发动遇到合，有事阻隔；
发动化出官鬼，在外有危险灾祸。
最怕发动而化出克它的爻，还要提防卦变成反吟。
en: A moving Subject that changes into an Advancing spirit does not return, and one that changes into a Retreating spirit surely returns;
a moving Subject that meets a combination is held up by some affair;
one that changes into Pressure meets danger and calamity abroad.
Most to be feared is a movement that changes into a controlling line, and beware too of the hexagram changing into Reversed Chant.

title: 行人章·世爻空者行人即至、用神静逢休囚空破者且不思回：动空、旺空的在冲实、冲空的月日回来，卦变克绝、反吟、用神被冲克的难望其回

rule.yi: 世爻空的，行人马上就到；用神安静，又遇到休囚空破的，还没有回来的念头。发动而空、旺而空的，在填实或冲开空亡的月日回来；就怕卦变到克、绝，或变成反吟，或用神被冲被克，这些都很难盼到他回来。
rule.en: When the Self is Void, the traveller is arriving at once; when the Subject is still and meets resting, trapped, Void or broken, he does not yet think of returning. A Void line that moves, or one that is strong yet Void, brings him back in a month or day that fills it or clashes the Void open; but if the hexagram changes into control or extinction, or into Reversed Chant, or the Subject is clashed or controlled, there is little hope of his return.

zh: 用神静，逢休囚空破者，且不思回。
动空旺空者，归于实空冲空之月日，惟恐卦变克绝，及反吟、用神被冲被克者，皆难望其回也。
yi: 世爻空的，行人马上就到；
用神安静，又遇到休囚空破的，还没有回来的念头。
发动而空、旺而空的，在填实或冲开空亡的月日回来；就怕卦变到克、绝，或变成反吟，或用神被冲被克，这些都很难盼到他回来。
en: When the Self is Void, the traveller is arriving at once;
when the Subject is still and meets resting, trapped, Void or broken, he does not yet think of returning.

A Void line that moves, or one that is strong yet Void, brings him back in a month or day that fills it or clashes the Void open; but if the hexagram changes into control or extinction, or into Reversed Chant, or the Subject is clashed or controlled, there is little hope of his return.

title: 行人章·用神三合则冲开之月日来、六冲则行人无定而不返：用爻静的冲动之日来，墓的开墓之期来

rule.yi: 用神三合，在冲开三合的月日回来；卦遇六冲，行人去向不定，不会回来。用爻安静的，在冲动它的日子回来；用爻入墓的，在开墓的时候回来。
rule.en: When the Subject is in a three-harmony, he returns in a month or day that clashes the harmony open; when the hexagram meets six-clash, the traveller's course is unsettled and he does not return. A still Subject returns on the day that clashes it into motion; a Subject in the tomb returns at the time the tomb is opened.

zh: 用神三合，冲开之月日而来；
卦逢六冲，行人无定而不返。
yi: 用神三合，在冲开三合的月日回来；
卦遇六冲，行人去向不定，不会回来。
用爻安静的，在冲动它的日子回来；
用爻入墓的，在开墓的时候回来。
en: When the Subject is in a three-harmony, he returns in a month or day that clashes the harmony open;
when the hexagram meets six-clash, the traveller's course is unsettled and he does not return.
A still Subject returns on the day that clashes it into motion;
a Subject in the tomb returns at the time the tomb is opened.

title: 行人章·用爻无病可断归期、有病则在外不安：野鹤说用神墓绝空破受伤才叫有病；问平安要看有病无病，问归期只看来与不来

rule.yi: 用爻没有病，可以断回来的日期；用爻有病，他在外面不安。野鹤说：用神入墓、绝、空、破、受伤，叫做有病。来人问行人在外平安与否，要看用神有病没病；如果问回来的日期，只看卦象来断来不来。
rule.en: If the Subject line is free of illness, the day of return can be judged; if it is ill, he is uneasy abroad. Yehe says: a Subject in the tomb, extinct, Void, broken or injured is called ill. When a visitor asks whether the traveller is well abroad, look at whether the Subject is ill; if asked when he will return, look only at the hexagram to judge whether he comes or not.

yi: 用爻没有病，可以断回来的日期；
用爻有病，他在外面不安。
en: If the Subject line is free of illness, the day of return can be judged;
if it is ill, he is uneasy abroad.

zh: 野鹤曰：用神墓绝空破受伤，谓之有病。
来人问行人在外平安否？
若问归期，只看卦象而断来与不来也。
yi: 野鹤说：用神入墓、绝、空、破、受伤，叫做有病。
来人问行人在外平安与否？
要看用神有病没病；
如果问回来的日期，只看卦象来断来不来。
en: Yehe says: a Subject in the tomb, extinct, Void, broken or injured is called ill.
When a visitor asks whether the traveller is well abroad,
look at whether the Subject is ill;
if asked when he will return, look only at the hexagram to judge whether he comes or not.

title: 行人章·书中例，占母在外何时来：用神伏藏受克而不来，六合卦变成冲也不来；若问平安，父母被日月动爻冲克则必不安，问来不来不能这样断

rule.yi: 问行人在外平安与否，要看用神有没有病；问回来的日期，只看卦象断来不来。用神被冲被克、卦变克绝的，难盼其回。书中例：酉月戊申日占母亲在外面什么时候来，得旅卦变艮卦：这一卦如果问母亲平安与否，父母卯木被日月和动爻冲克，必定不平安；现在问的是来不来，不这样断，只能断用神伏藏又受克所以不来，六合卦变成六冲也不来，后来果然没有来，她在外面平安。
rule.en: In asking whether a traveller is well abroad, look at whether the Subject is ill; in asking the day of return, judge from the hexagram alone whether he comes or not. A Subject that is clashed or controlled, or a hexagram that changes into control or extinction, gives little hope of return. Worked example: in the You month, on a Wushen day, a man divined when his mother abroad would come and got Lü (the Traveller) changing to Gen. Had the question been her safety, the Resource Mao-wood, clashed and controlled by the Month, the Day and the moving lines, would surely have meant she was unwell; but the question was whether she would come, so it is not judged that way: the Subject is hidden and controlled, so she does not come, and a six-combine hexagram changing into a clash also does not come; in the end she did not come, and she was safe abroad.

zh: 来人问行人在外平安否？
若问归期，只看卦象而断来与不来也。
yi: 来人问行人在外平安与否？
要看用神有病没病；
如果问回来的日期，只看卦象来断来不来。
en: When a visitor asks whether the traveller is well abroad,
look at whether the Subject is ill;
if asked when he will return, look only at the hexagram to judge whether he comes or not.

zh: 惟恐卦变克绝，及反吟、用神被冲被克者，皆难望其回也。
yi: 就怕卦变到克、绝，或变成反吟，或用神被冲被克，这些都很难盼到他回来。
en: but if the hexagram changes into control or extinction, or into Reversed Chant, or the Subject is clashed or controlled, there is little hope of his return.

zh: 如：酉月戊申日(旬空：寅卯)，占母在外何时来？
yi: 如：酉月戊申日（旬空寅、卯），占母亲在外面什么时候来？
得旅卦变艮卦。
en: For example: in the You month, on a Wushen day (Void: Yin and Mao), divining when a mother abroad would come:
the hexagram Lü (the Traveller) changing to Gen.

zh: 此卦若问母平安否，父母卯木日月动爻冲克，必不安矣！
今问来否，不以此断，只可断用神伏藏受克而不来，六合变冲亦不来，后果不来，在外平安。
yi: 这一卦如果问母亲平安与否，父母卯木被日月和动爻冲克，一定不平安！
现在问的是来不来，不这样断，只能断用神伏藏又受克所以不来，六合卦变成冲也不来，后来果然没有来，她在外面平安。
en: Had this hexagram been asked about the mother's safety, the Resource Mao-wood, clashed and controlled by the Month, the Day and the moving lines, would surely have meant she was unwell!

But the question now is whether she comes, so it is not judged that way: one can only judge that the Subject is hidden and controlled and so does not come, and a six-combine hexagram changing into a clash also does not come; in the end she did not come, and she was safe abroad.

title: 行人章·书中例，占仆人何日回：世爻空者速至，应在冲空之日；若问仆人在外吉凶，用神财爻伏藏又被日月克，必不回，但问归期不以此断

rule.yi: 世爻空的，行人马上就到，应在冲开空亡的日子。书中例：亥月甲子日占仆人哪天回来，得革卦变夬卦：如果问仆人在外面吉凶，午火财爻伏藏又被日月克，一定不回来；现在问的是回来的日期，不这样断，断为世爻空，速到，这个人来了，己巳日必到；应在巳日，是冲开空亡的日子，巳火又正是财爻，果然在巳日到。
rule.en: When the Self is Void the traveller arrives at once, on the day that clashes the Void open. Worked example: in the Hai month, on a Jiazi day, a man divined on what day his servant would return and got Ge changing to Guai. Had the question been the servant's fortune abroad, the Wealth Wu-fire is hidden and controlled by the Month and the Day, so he would surely not return; but the question was the day of return, so it was not judged so: the Self is Void, so he comes quickly and will surely arrive on the Jisi day, which is the day that clashes the Void open, and Si-fire is also Wealth; he did arrive on the Si day.

yi: 世爻空的，行人马上就到；
en: When the Self is Void, the traveller is arriving at once;

zh: 又如：亥月甲子日(旬空：戌亥)，占仆人何日回？
yi: 又如：亥月甲子日（旬空戌、亥），占仆人哪天回来？
得革卦变夬卦。
en: Another example: in the Hai month, on a Jiazi day (Void: Xu and Hai), divining on what day a servant would return:
the hexagram Ge changing to Guai.

zh: 此卦若问仆人在外吉凶，必不归矣！
午火财爻伏而被日月之克也。
今问归期，不以此断，断曰：世空者速至，此人来矣，己巳日必到。
应巳日者，冲空之日也，巳火又是财爻，果到于巳日。
yi: 这一卦如果问仆人在外面的吉凶，一定不回来了！
为什么？
午火财爻伏藏，又被日月克。
现在问的是回来的日期，不这样断，断为：世爻空的速到，这个人来了，己巳日必到。
应在巳日，是冲开空亡的日子，巳火又是财爻，果然在巳日到。
en: Had this hexagram been asked about the servant's fortune abroad, he would surely not return!
Why?
The Wealth Wu-fire is hidden and controlled by the Month and the Day.
But the question now is the day of return, so it is not judged that way: it is judged that a Void Self means quick arrival, this man has come, and he will surely arrive on the Jisi day.
It answers on the Si day because that is the day that clashes the Void open, and Si-fire is also Wealth; he did arrive on the Si day.

title: 行人章·书中例，占伯何日来：父母为用神、克世者速至，断七月必到，实际亥月才到，应在父母化出之爻

rule.yi: 用神克世爻，他一定回来。书中例：未月戊戌日占伯父哪天来，得屯卦变随卦：父母为用神，克世爻的，到得快，断为七月必到；后来在亥月才到，应在亥月，是因为父母化出来的爻在亥。
rule.en: When the Subject controls the Self he will surely return. Worked example: in the Wei month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined on what day his uncle would come and got Zhun changing to Sui: the Resource is the Subject and controls the Self, which means a quick arrival, and it was judged that he would surely arrive in the seventh month; he came only in the Hai month, which answered because the line the Resource changed into is in Hai.

zh: 世克用兮人未动，用爻克世必然归。
yi: 世爻克用神，人还没有动身；用神克世爻，一定会回来。
占亲人，看所属的用神；
en: When the Self controls the Subject, the man has not yet moved; when the Subject controls the Self, he will surely return.
In divining for a kinsman, look at that kinsman's own Subject;

zh: 又如：未月戊戌日(旬空：辰巳)，占伯何日来，得“屯之随”
yi: 又如：未月戊戌日（旬空辰、巳），占伯父哪天来，得屯卦变随卦
en: Another example: in the Wei month, on a Wuxu day (Void: Chen and Si), divining on what day an uncle would come, the hexagram Zhun changing to Sui:

zh: 父母为用神，克世者速至，七月必到。
后于亥月方到，应亥月者，父母化出之爻也。
yi: 父母为用神，克世爻的到得快，七月必到。
后来在亥月才到，应在亥月，是父母化出来的爻。
en: The Resource is the Subject and controls the Self, so he arrives quickly and will surely come in the seventh month.
He came only in the Hai month, and it answered in the Hai month because that is the line the Resource changed into.

title: 行人章·书中例，占父远行何日始回：午火父母克世，本日午日必到，果然当日申时到

rule.yi: 用神克世爻，一定回来。书中例：丑月庚午日占父亲远行哪天才回来，得履卦：今天正是午日，午火父母克世爻，今天一定到；果然当天申时到。
rule.en: When the Subject controls the Self he will surely return. Worked example: in the Chou month, on a Gengwu day, a man divined on what day his father, gone on a long journey, would first come back and got Lü (Treading): today is a Wu day, and the Resource Wu-fire controls the Self, so he will surely arrive today; he did arrive that day, in the Shen hour.

zh: 世克用兮人未动，用爻克世必然归。
yi: 世爻克用神，人还没有动身；用神克世爻，一定会回来。
en: When the Self controls the Subject, the man has not yet moved; when the Subject controls the Self, he will surely return.

zh: 又如：丑月庚午日(旬空：戌亥)，占父远行何日始回？
yi: 又如：丑月庚午日（旬空戌、亥），占父亲远行哪天才回？
得到履卦。
en: Another example: in the Chou month, on a Gengwu day (Void: Xu and Hai), divining on what day a father gone on a long journey would first come back:
the hexagram Lü (Treading).

zh: 今日是午日，午火为父母克世，今日必到。
yi: 今天是午日，午火父母克世爻，今天一定到。
果然当天申时到。
en: Today is a Wu day, and the Resource Wu-fire controls the Self, so he will surely arrive today.
He did arrive that day, in the Shen hour.

title: 行人章·书中例，仆占主人何日回：仆占主人以父母为用神，子水财爻化出巳火父爻，动爻不克变爻，巳日必到

rule.yi: 占亲人，看所属的用神；发动的在逢合的日子回来，伏藏的在出现的日子回来。书中例：寅月癸亥日仆人占主人哪天回，得大畜卦变小畜卦：仆人占主人，以父母爻为用神，这一卦子水财爻发动，化出巳火父母爻，动爻不克变爻，断巳日必到；果然在巳日到。
rule.en: In divining for a kinsman, look at that kinsman's own Subject; a moving one returns on the day it meets a combination, and a hidden one on the day it appears. Worked example: in the Yin month, on a Guihai day, a servant divined on what day his master would return and got Daxu changing to Xiaoxu: a servant divining for his master takes the Resource line as the Subject; here the Wealth Zi-water moves and changes into the Resource Si-fire, and the moving line does not control the changed line, so he will surely arrive on the Si day; he did arrive on the Si day.

yi: 占亲人，看所属的用神；
en: In divining for a kinsman, look at that kinsman's own Subject;

yi: 伏藏的，在它出现的日子回来；
发动的，在逢合的日子回来。
en: A hidden one returns on the day it appears;
a moving one returns on the day it meets a combination.

zh: 如：寅月癸亥日(旬空：子丑)，占主人何日回？
yi: 如：寅月癸亥日（旬空子、丑），占主人哪天回？
得大畜卦变小畜卦。
en: For example: in the Yin month, on a Guihai day (Void: Zi and Chou), divining on what day a master would return:
the hexagram Daxu changing to Xiaoxu.

zh: 仆占主人，以父母为用神，此卦子水财爻化出巳火父爻，动爻不克变爻，巳日必到。
yi: 仆人占主人，以父母爻为用神，这一卦子水财爻化出巳火父母爻，动爻不克变爻，巳日必到。
果然在巳日到。
en: A servant divining for his master takes the Resource line as the Subject; in this hexagram the Wealth Zi-water changes into the Resource Si-fire, and the moving line does not control the changed line, so he will surely arrive on the Si day.
He did arrive on the Si day.

title: 行人章·书中例，占父何时来：初爻丑父与子合、五爻未父化进神，皆不来，须午年方来，果然午年戌月到

rule.yi: 用神发动化进神，不回来；发动的遇合则被事绊住，逢合之年才来。书中例：辰年未月丁丑日占父亲什么时候来，得大有卦变井卦：初爻丑土父母与子水相合，不来；五爻未土父母化出进神，不来；必须到午年才来；果然午年戌月到。应在午年，是因为未爻的父母发动，午年合它，正是发动的爻逢合之年；又因为初爻子水与丑土相合，合住要冲开，午年冲开了它。
rule.en: A Subject that moves and changes into an Advancing spirit does not return; a moving one that meets a combination is held up, and comes in the year it meets the combination. Worked example: in a Chen year, in the Wei month, on a Dingchou day, a man divined when his father would come and got Dayou changing to Jing: the Resource Chou-earth in the first line is combined with Zi-water, so he does not come; the Resource Wei-earth in the fifth line changes into an Advancing spirit, so he does not come; he must come only in a Wu year; and he arrived in a Wu year, in the Xu month. It answered in the Wu year because the Wei-line Resource moves and the Wu year combines it, the year in which a moving line meets a combination; and also because Zi in the first line combines with Chou, and a combination must be clashed open, which the Wu year does.

dispute.yi: 这一例的断法是「化进神不来、等逢合之年才来」，与《黄金策》行人章「用爻化进神行人急回」相反；两书各有书中例，没有交代谁错。
dispute.en: This example judges that a change into an Advancing spirit means he does not come and arrives only in the year of the combination, which is the opposite of the Huangjin Ce on travellers, where a Subject changing into an Advancing spirit means a quick return; each book has worked examples, and neither says which is wrong.

zh: 动化进神不返，用神化退必归；
yi: 发动的，在逢合的日子回来；
动化进神不返，用神化退神必定回来；
en: a moving one returns on the day it meets a combination;
a moving Subject that changes into an Advancing spirit does not return, and one that changes into a Retreating spirit surely returns;

zh: 又如：辰年未月丁丑日(旬空：申酉)，占父何时来？
yi: 又如：辰年未月丁丑日（旬空申、酉），占父亲什么时候来？
得大有卦变井卦。
en: Another example: in a Chen year, in the Wei month, on a Dingchou day (Void: Shen and You), divining when a father would come:
the hexagram Dayou changing to Jing.

zh: 初爻丑父与子作合，不来；
应午年者，未爻父动，午岁合之，动而逢合之年也。
又因初爻子与丑作合，合要冲开，午年以冲开也。
yi: 初爻丑土父母与子水相合，不来；
五爻未土父母化出进神，不来；
必须午年才来。
果然午年戌月到。
应在午年，是未爻的父母发动，午年合它，正是发动的爻逢合之年。
又因为初爻子水与丑土相合，合住要冲开，午年冲开了它。
en: The Resource Chou-earth in the first line is combined with Zi-water, so he does not come;
the Resource Wei-earth in the fifth line changes into an Advancing spirit, so he does not come;
he must come only in a Wu year.
He arrived in a Wu year, in the Xu month.
It answered in the Wu year because the Wei-line Resource moves and the Wu year combines it, the year in which a moving line meets a combination.
And also because Zi in the first line combines with Chou, and a combination must be clashed open, which the Wu year does.

title: 行人章·书中例，占主人往楚平安否、迁往他省否：连占三卦，前两卦用神真空是凶亡之兆，报的是未年之死，第三卦申父生世才报眼前所问（四月必归）；野鹤：占远应近、占近应远，不能一卦竟断

rule.yi: 用神入墓、绝、空、破，回来的消息杳无音信。书中例：寅月庚寅日仆人占主人往楚地平安与否、是否迁往别省，得观卦：父母遇真空，是不祥之兆，不敢直接断，再叫亲人占；同日占兄长，得中孚卦变临卦：前一卦仆人占主人，父母为用神，父母真空；这一卦弟弟占兄长，兄弟为用神，又落真空，是大凶之兆；再叫亲人占；次日辛卯日家人又占，得坎卦变困卦，作者说：得这一卦，现在可以替你放心了——前两卦用神真空是凶亡的兆头，这一卦申金父母生世爻，四月必归；问前面父、兄真空是为什么，是因为此公寿数无多，神灵报的是未年的死，没有说眼下的事；未年死的根据是占主人时父母临未土、占兄长时兄临未土，都被日月克害，因为在旬空所以暂时没有灾祸，未年出空，被日月伤，岂能不危险。辰年占的，果然未年死。野鹤说：连占两卦都报的是没有问的事，第三卦才报眼前所问，所以感叹前人用一卦竟断吉凶，不知道把「占远应近、占近应远」的卦错断了这么多。
rule.en: A Subject in the tomb, extinct, Void or broken gives no word of a return. Worked example: in the Yin month, on a Gengyin day, a servant divined whether his master, gone to Chu, was safe and whether he would move to another province, and got Guan: the Resource met true Void, an ominous sign, and I did not dare judge outright, so the household was told to divine again; the same day, divining for the elder brother, they got Zhongfu changing to Lin: in the former hexagram the servant divined for the master with the Resource as the Subject, and the Resource was truly Void; in this one the younger brother divined for the elder with the Peer as the Subject, and it too fell into true Void, a sign of great ill; so they were told to divine again; the next day, a Xinmao day, the family divined once more and got Kan changing to Kun. I said: with this hexagram I can set your mind at ease. The Subject in the first two was truly Void, a sign of death; in this one the Resource Shen-metal gives life to the Self, and he will surely return in the fourth month. When asked why the Resource and the Peer were truly Void before, I said: because this gentleman has not long to live, the spirits report his death in a Wei year and do not speak of what is before us. When asked how I knew it was a Wei year, I said: in divining for the master the Resource sits on Wei-earth, and in divining for the brother the Peer sits on Wei-earth, both controlled and harmed by the Month and the Day; being in the Void they cause no harm for now, but in the Wei year they come out of Void and are injured by the Month and Day, and how could that not be dangerous? Divined in a Chen year, he did die in the Wei year. Yehe says: two hexagrams in a row reported what had not been asked, and only the third reported the present question; hence I sigh that the former worthies judged luck and ill-luck from a single hexagram, not knowing how many hexagrams of "far matter answered near, near matter answered far" they have misjudged.

note.yi: 「真空」指用神落在旬空、又没有被冲被填的空，是凶象；连着三卦的前两卦用神真空报的是远应（未年的死），第三卦才答眼前的归期，这一例是野鹤「占远应近、占近应远」的出处。
note.en: "True Void" means a Subject in the ten-day Void that is neither clashed nor filled, an ill sign. The first two hexagrams, with the Subject truly Void, reported a far event (a death in a Wei year); only the third answered the present question of return. This example is the source of Yehe's remark that a far matter may be answered near, and a near matter answered far.

yi: 用神入墓、绝、空、破，回来的消息杳无音信；
en: When the Subject is in the tomb, extinct, Void or broken, no word of a return comes;

zh: 又如：寅月庚寅日(旬空：午未)，占主人往楚平安否？
yi: 又如：寅月庚寅日（旬空午、未），占主人往楚地平安与否？
是否迁往别省？
得到观卦。
en: Another example: in the Yin month, on a Gengyin day (Void: Wu and Wei), divining whether a master gone to Chu was safe:
and whether he would move to another province:
the hexagram Guan.

zh: 父母遇真空，不详之兆，不敢竟断，再令亲人卜之。
于：同日，占兄得“中孚之临”
yi: 父母遇到真空，是不祥之兆，不敢直接断，再叫亲人占。
同一天，占兄长，得中孚卦变临卦。
en: The Resource met true Void, an ominous sign, and I did not dare judge outright, so the household was told to divine again.
The same day, divining for the elder brother, they got Zhongfu changing to Lin.

zh: 前卦仆占主，父母为用神，父母真空；
此卦弟占兄，兄弟为用神，又落真空，大凶之兆。
yi: 前一卦仆人占主人，父母为用神，父母真空；
这一卦弟弟占兄长，兄弟为用神，又落真空，是大凶之兆。
再叫亲人占。
en: In the former hexagram the servant divined for the master with the Resource as the Subject, and the Resource was truly Void;
in this one the younger brother divined for the elder with the Peer as the Subject, and it too fell into true Void, a sign of great ill.
So they were told to divine again.

zh: 于：次日辛卯(旬空：午未)，家人又占，得“坎之困”
yi: 第二天辛卯日（旬空午、未），家人又占，得坎卦变困卦。
en: The next day, a Xinmao day (Void: Wu and Wei), the family divined once more and got Kan changing to Kun.

zh: 余曰：得此卦，今为尔释然矣。
余曰：前两卦用神真空，乃凶亡之兆，今此卦申父生世，四月必归。
彼问：若此，则前父兄真空何也？
余曰：因此公大寿无多，故神报未年之死，不言目下之事耳。
彼又问：何以知死未年也？
占兄，兄临未土，俱被日月克害，因在旬空，所以无祸，未年出空，被日月之伤，得不危乎？
yi: 我说：得这一卦，现在可以替你放心了。
他问：为什么？
我说：前两卦用神真空，是凶亡的兆头，这一卦申金父母生世爻，四月必归。
他问：这样的话，前面父母、兄弟真空又是为什么？
我说：因为此公寿数无多，所以神灵报的是未年的死，没有说眼下的事。
他又问：凭什么知道死在未年？
我说：占主人，父母临未土；
占兄长，兄弟临未土，都被日月克害，因为在旬空所以没有灾祸，未年出空，被日月所伤，岂能不危险？
辰年占的，果然未年死。
en: I said: with this hexagram I can now set your mind at ease.
He asked: why?
I said: in the first two hexagrams the Subject was truly Void, a sign of death; in this one the Resource Shen-metal gives life to the Self, and he will surely return in the fourth month.
He asked: if so, why were the Resource and the Peer truly Void before?
I said: because this gentleman has not long to live, the spirits report his death in a Wei year and do not speak of what is before us.
He asked again: how do you know it is a Wei year?
I said: in divining for the master, the Resource sits on Wei-earth;

in divining for the brother, the Peer sits on Wei-earth, both controlled and harmed by the Month and the Day; because they are in the Void they cause no harm for now, but in the Wei year they come out of Void and are injured by the Month and the Day, and how could that not be dangerous?
Divined in a Chen year, he did die in the Wei year.

zh: 野鹤曰：连占两卦，俱报未问之事，第三卦方报目前所问，因叹前贤以一卦竟断吉凶，不知将此占远应近、占近应远之卦错断如许矣。
既不能悟出，尚牵强辨论，留作后人这法，何哉？
yi: 野鹤说：连占两卦，报的都是没有问的事，第三卦才报眼前所问，所以感叹前人用一卦竟断吉凶，不知道把「占远应近、占近应远」的卦错断了这么多。
既然不能悟出，还牵强辩论，把这样的办法留给后人，是为什么呢？
en: Yehe says: two hexagrams in a row reported what had not been asked, and only the third reported the present question; hence I sigh that the former worthies judged luck and ill-luck from a single hexagram, not knowing how many hexagrams of "far matter answered near, near matter answered far" they have misjudged.
Since they could not grasp it and still argued with strained reasons, why leave such a method to later men?

title: 行人章·书中例，妻占夫还往他省去否：官为用神、申金动克寅木，夫爻受克则不往他处，日月生官官生世则有归志，应在合住申金的巳日；或曰用爻有病莫问归期，答：问平安则断不利，问去不去断法不同

rule.yi: 用爻有病，在外不安；问归期，只看卦象断来不来。书中例：亥月甲子日妻子占丈夫在外还会不会去别省，得大壮卦变大过卦：妻子占丈夫，官鬼为用神，申金发动克它，寅木夫爻受克，不会往别处去了，眼下一定回来；日月生官鬼，官鬼生世爻，必有归意；巳日必到，应在巳日，是合住申金的日子，果然在巳日到。有人说用爻有病就不要问归期，这一卦申金化进神克寅木，怎么还说回来？答：他若问平安就断不利，现在问的是往不往别处去，夫爻受克就不往别处去，断卦的人各有各的取用。
rule.en: If the Subject line is ill, he is uneasy abroad; in asking the day of return, look only at the hexagram to judge whether he comes. Worked example: in the Hai month, on a Jiazi day, a wife divined whether her husband abroad would go on to another province and got Dazhuang changing to Daguo: a wife divining for her husband takes Pressure as the Subject; Shen-metal moves and controls it, so the husband's Yin-wood is controlled and he will not go elsewhere, and he will surely come back soon; the Month and the Day give life to Pressure and Pressure gives life to the Self, so he must have a mind to return; he will surely arrive on the Si day, which answers because it is the day that combines Shen-metal shut, and he arrived on the Si day. Someone objected: if the Subject line is ill, do not ask the day of return, and here Shen-metal changes into an Advancing spirit to control Yin-wood, so how can you allow his return? I said: had they asked about his safety I would have judged it unfavourable, but now they ask whether he goes elsewhere, and when the husband's line is controlled he does not go elsewhere; those who judge hexagrams each take what they need.

yi: 用爻没有病，可以断回来的日期；
用爻有病，他在外面不安。
en: If the Subject line is free of illness, the day of return can be judged;
if it is ill, he is uneasy abroad.

zh: 亥月甲子日(旬空：戌亥)，占夫在外，还往他省去否？
yi: 亥月甲子日（旬空戌、亥），妻子占丈夫在外还会不会去别省？
得大壮卦变大过卦。
en: In the Hai month, on a Jiazi day (Void: Xu and Hai), a wife divined whether her husband abroad would go on to another province:
the hexagram Dazhuang changing to Daguo.

zh: 妻占夫，官为用神，申动克之，寅木夫爻受克，不往他处矣，目下必回。
余曰：日月生官，官生世爻，必有归志。
应巳日者，合住申金之日也，果于巳日到。
yi: 妻子占丈夫，官鬼为用神，申金发动克它，寅木夫爻受克，不会往别处去了，眼下一定回来。
他问：怎么知道他会回来？
我说：日月生官鬼，官鬼生世爻，必有回来的心意。
她问：应在哪天到？
我说：巳日必到。
应在巳日，是合住申金的日子，果然在巳日到。
en: A wife divining for her husband takes Pressure as the Subject; Shen-metal moves and controls it, so the husband's Yin-wood is controlled and he will not go elsewhere, and he will surely come back soon.
She asked: how do you know he will come back?
I said: the Month and the Day give life to Pressure and Pressure gives life to the Self, so he must have a mind to return.
She asked: on what day will he arrive?
I said: he will surely arrive on the Si day.
It answers on the Si day because that is the day that combines Shen-metal shut; he did arrive on the Si day.

zh: 或曰：用爻有病，莫问归期，此卦申金化进，以克寅木，如何许回？
余曰：彼问平安，则断以不利，今问往他处否？
夫爻受克，不往他乡，断卦者各有取用耳。
yi: 有人说：用爻有病就不要问归期，这一卦申金化进神克寅木，怎么还说回来？
我说：他若问平安，就断为不利，现在问的是往不往别处去？
夫爻受克，就不往别处去，断卦的人各有各的取用罢了。
en: Someone said: if the Subject line is ill, do not ask the day of return, and in this hexagram Shen-metal changes into an Advancing spirit to control Yin-wood, so how can you still say he returns?
I said: had they asked about his safety I would have judged it unfavourable, but now they ask whether he goes elsewhere;
when the husband's line is controlled he does not go elsewhere; those who judge hexagrams each take what they need.

title: 行人章·书中例，占差家人取书得否、何日回：人今日酉时必到，书得不到——父母化回头之克；世爻化卯鬼人不到必有忧，酉时冲去卯木则无忧

rule.yi: 动爻化出克它的爻最凶；文书以父母爻为用神，化出回头克就得不到书。书中例：辰月丙申日占派家人去取书能不能取到、哪天回来，得渐卦变剥卦：仆人今天酉时必到，书得不到。问怎么知道的，我说：巳火父母化出回头之克，所以得不到书；甲子持世化出卯木官鬼，人不到必有忧虑，今天酉时冲去卯木，就没有忧了；果然酉时到了，而书没有取到。
rule.en: A movement that changes into a controlling line is the most ill; a document is read from the Resource line, and if it changes into a turning-back control the document is not obtained. Worked example: in the Chen month, on a Bingshen day, a man divined whether a household servant sent to fetch a book would get it and on what day he would return, and got Jian changing to Bo: the servant will surely arrive this day in the You hour, but the book will not be had. Asked how I knew, I said: the Resource Si-fire changes into a turning-back control, so the book is not obtained; Jiazi holds the Self and changes into the Pressure Mao-wood, so if he did not arrive there would surely be worry, but this day in the You hour the clash removes the Mao-wood, so there is no worry. He did arrive in the You hour, and the book was not got.

zh: 最忌动而化克，还防卦变反吟。
yi: 发动化出官鬼，在外有危险灾祸。
最怕发动而化出克它的爻，还要提防卦变成反吟。
en: one that changes into Pressure meets danger and calamity abroad.
Most to be feared is a movement that changes into a controlling line, and beware too of the hexagram changing into Reversed Chant.

zh: 辰月丙申日(旬空：辰巳)，占差家人取书得否？
yi: 辰月丙申日（旬空辰、巳），占派家人去取书能不能取到？
哪天回来？
得渐卦变剥卦。
en: In the Chen month, on a Bingshen day (Void: Chen and Si), divining whether a household servant sent to fetch a book would get it:
and on what day he would return:
the hexagram Jian changing to Bo.

zh: 仆人今日酉时必到，书不得。
余曰：巳父化回头之克，不得书矣。
甲子持世化卯鬼，人不到，必有忧，今日酉时冲去卯木，则无忧也。
yi: 仆人今天酉时必到，书取不到。
他问：怎么知道的？
我说：巳火父母化出回头之克，所以取不到书。
甲子持世化出卯木官鬼，人不到必有忧，今天酉时冲去卯木，就没有忧了。
果然酉时到了，而书没有取到。
en: The servant will surely arrive this day in the You hour, but the book will not be had.
He asked: how do you know?
I said: the Resource Si-fire changes into a turning-back control, so the book is not obtained.
Jiazi holds the Self and changes into the Pressure Mao-wood, so if he did not arrive there would surely be worry, but this day in the You hour the clash removes the Mao-wood, so there is no worry.
He did arrive in the You hour, and the book was not got.

title: 行人章·书中例，占兄何日回：用神旺相而空，出空之日必至，子孙持世而动生合世爻皆是喜悦之神；觉子：寻常占风以兄爻为风，唯舟行占风以子孙为风，子孙发动之日就是顺风之日

rule.yi: 发动而空、旺而空的，在填实或冲开空亡的月日回来。书中例：酉月癸酉日占兄长哪天回，得师卦变临卦：亥水兄爻旺相而空，出空的日子必到；来问的人说，后天就是卯日，前面有信约好今天起身，可是两千多里，三天怎么能到？作者说：不只是亥日出空，凡是卦中子孙持世、以及发动而生合世爻的，都是喜悦之神；答应亥日到的，是因为寅与亥相合，又是合起子孙的日子，亥日必归无疑；哪知道走水路遇到顺风，日夜兼程，竟然在亥日到了。觉子说：一般占风，兄爻发动为风，木发动生风；只有行船占风，以子孙为风——行船风逆我就忧愁，子孙发动的日子就得顺风，风顺我就无忧了，这也是没有传下来的秘诀。
rule.en: A Void line that moves, or one that is strong yet Void, returns in a month or day that fills it or clashes the Void open. Worked example: in the You month, on a Guiyou day, a man divined on what day his elder brother would return and got Shi changing to Lin: the Subject, the Hai-water Peer line, is strong yet Void, and on the day it comes out of the Void he will surely arrive. The questioner said: the day after tomorrow is a Mao day, and a letter before had said he would set out today, but it is over two thousand li; how can he arrive in three days? I said: it is not only that Hai comes out of the Void; whenever Output holds the Self in a hexagram, or moves and gives life to or combines with the Self, that is a spirit of joy; I promised the Hai day because Yin combines with Hai, which is also the day that combines Output awake, so he would surely return on the Hai day. Who would have thought that he came by water, met a fair wind, and travelled day and night, arriving on the Hai day after all. Juezi says: in ordinary divination of wind, a moving Peer line is wind, and moving Wood gives rise to wind; but for a boat in motion, Output is the wind. When the wind is foul for a boat, I am worried; on the day Output moves one gets a fair wind, and with a fair wind I have no worry. This too is a secret that was never handed down.

note.yi: 「寅与亥合」指地支六合，寅亥合木；这里的意思是卦里有子孙在寅，寅日出现、亥日合起它，所以亥日既是出空之日，又是合起子孙（顺风之神）的日子，走水路得顺风就能三天赶两千里。
note.en: The "combination of Yin and Hai" is the earthly-branch six combination, Yin and Hai together making Wood. The point made is that the Hai day is both the day the Void line comes out of the Void and the day that combines the Output (the fair-wind spirit), so travelling by water with a fair wind he covers two thousand li in three days.

zh: 动空旺空者，归于实空冲空之月日，惟恐卦变克绝，及反吟、用神被冲被克者，皆难望其回也。
yi: 发动而空、旺而空的，在填实或冲开空亡的月日回来；就怕卦变到克、绝，或变成反吟，或用神被冲被克，这些都很难盼到他回来。
