en: A Void line that moves, or one that is strong yet Void, brings him back in a month or day that fills it or clashes the Void open; but if the hexagram changes into control or extinction, or into Reversed Chant, or the Subject is clashed or controlled, there is little hope of his return.

zh: 酉月癸酉日(旬空：戌亥)，占兄何日回？
yi: 酉月癸酉日（旬空戌、亥），占兄长哪天回？
得师卦变临卦。
en: In the You month, on a Guiyou day (Void: Xu and Hai), divining on what day an elder brother would return:
the hexagram Shi changing to Lin.

zh: 亥兄旺相而空，出空之日必至。
彼曰：后日即是卯日，前有信，约今日起身，但二千余里，三日如何能到？
余曰：不独亥日出空，凡卦中子孙持世，及动而生合世爻，皆是喜悦之神，许亥日归者，寅与亥合，又是合起子孙之日也，亥日必归无疑。
岂料由水路，遇顺风，日夜行，竟归于亥日。
yi: 亥水兄爻旺相而空，出空的日子必到。
来问的人说：后天就是卯日，前面有信约好今天起身，可是两千多里，三天怎么能到？
我说：不只是亥日出空，凡是卦中子孙持世、以及发动而生合世爻的，都是喜悦之神；答应亥日到的，是因为寅与亥相合，又是合起子孙的日子，亥日必归无疑。
哪知道走水路遇到顺风，日夜兼程，竟然在亥日到了。
en: The Subject, the Hai-water Peer line, is strong yet Void, and on the day it comes out of the Void he will surely arrive.
The questioner said: the day after tomorrow is a Mao day, and a letter before had said he would set out today, but it is over two thousand li; how can he arrive in three days?

I said: it is not only that Hai comes out of the Void; whenever Output holds the Self in a hexagram, or moves and gives life to or combines with the Self, that is a spirit of joy; I promised the Hai day because Yin combines with Hai, which is also the day that combines Output awake, so he would surely return on the Hai day.
Who would have thought that he came by water, met a fair wind, and travelled day and night, arriving on the Hai day after all.

zh: 觉子曰：泛常占风，兄动为风，木动生风，唯舟行占风，以子孙为风。
盖行舟风逆，我心忧也，子孙发动之日，乃得顺风之日，风顺，我无忧矣，此亦未传之秘。
yi: 觉子说：一般占风，兄爻发动为风，木发动生风；只有行船占风，以子孙为风。
行船风逆我就忧愁，子孙发动的日子，就是得到顺风的日子，风顺，我就无忧了，这也是没有传下来的秘诀。
en: Juezi says: in ordinary divination of wind, a moving Peer line is wind, and moving Wood gives rise to wind; but for a boat in motion, Output is the wind.
When the wind is foul for a boat I am worried; the day Output moves is the day one gets a fair wind, and with a fair wind I have no worry. This too is a secret that was never handed down.

title: 行人章·书中例，由江右登舟占一路平安否：酉金官鬼持世本是忧疑之象，实应风阻；子水父母发动是子日的风雨，化出巳火子孙则巳日方晴，从此悟到子孙乃行舟之顺风

rule.yi: 乘船遇到风阻的，不要拿兄弟爻当风云，要拿子孙爻当顺风。书中例：戌月丙戌日作者从江右上船，占一路平安与否，得蛊卦变巽卦：我怀疑酉金官鬼持世，是一路忧虑猜疑之象，起初不知道是应在风阻上；等到戊子日，风雨大作，船停在南康，才明白这一卦子水父母发动，是子日的风雨；看到它化出巳火子孙，就知道巳日才放晴；结果船停了五天，巳日天开，得到顺风；从此才领悟子孙就是行船的顺风。
rule.en: For a boat held up by wind, do not take the Peer line as wind and cloud but take Output as the fair wind. Worked example: in the Xu month, on a Bingxu day, the author boarded a boat at Jiangyou and divined whether the whole road would be safe, and got Gu changing to Xun: I suspected that Pressure You-metal holding the Self was a sign of worry and doubt on the road, not knowing at first that it answered in the wind holding us up; when the Wuzi day came, wind and rain broke out and the boat moored at Nankang, and only then did I understand that in this hexagram the Resource Zi-water moves, which is the wind and rain of the Zi day; and seeing that it changes into Output Si-fire, I knew the sky would clear on the Si day. The boat lay for five days, the sky opened on the Si day, and a fair wind came. From then on I understood that Output is the fair wind for a boat.

zh: 舟行风阻者，勿以兄弟为风云，乃以子孙为顺风，动而逢合逢值之日，静而逢冲之日，空逢冲实之日，皆与天时章阴晴同断。
yi: 乘船遇到风阻的，不要拿兄弟爻当风云，而要拿子孙爻当顺风；发动的遇到合、值的日子，安静的遇到冲的日子，空的遇到冲实的日子，都和天时章里断阴晴的办法相同。
en: For a boat held up by wind, do not take the Peer line as wind and cloud but take Output as the fair wind; it comes on the day when a moving one meets a combination or the ruling day, on the day when a still one meets a clash, and on the day when a Void one meets the clash that fills it, all judged in the same way as fine and cloudy weather in the chapter on the weather.

zh: 余曾于：戌月丙戌日(旬空：午未)，由江右登舟，占一路平安否，得“蛊之巽”
yi: 我曾在戌月丙戌日（旬空午、未），从江右上船，占一路平安与否，得蛊卦变巽卦。
en: Once, in the Xu month, on a Bingxu day (Void: Wu and Wei), boarding a boat at Jiangyou, I divined whether the whole road would be safe and got Gu changing to Xun.

zh: 余疑酉金鬼爻持世，一路忧疑之象，初不知应风阻也，及至戊子日，风雨大作，舟泊南康，始悟此卦子水父动，子日之风雨也，见其化出巳火子孙，即知巳日方晴。
果舟停五日，巳日天开，得顺风矣，自此始悟子孙乃行舟之顺风也。
yi: 我怀疑酉金官鬼持世，是一路忧虑猜疑之象，起初不知道是应在风阻上，等到戊子日，风雨大作，船停在南康，才明白这一卦子水父母发动，是子日的风雨，看到它化出巳火子孙，就知道巳日才放晴。
结果船停了五天，巳日天开，得到顺风，从此才领悟子孙就是行船的顺风。
en: I suspected that Pressure You-metal holding the Self was a sign of worry and doubt on the road, not knowing at first that it answered in the wind holding us up; when the Wuzi day came, wind and rain broke out and the boat moored at Nankang, and only then did I understand that in this hexagram the Resource Zi-water moves, which is the wind and rain of the Zi day; and seeing that it changes into Output Si-fire, I knew the sky would clear on the Si day.
The boat lay for five days, the sky opened on the Si day, and a fair wind came; from then on I understood that Output is the fair wind for a boat.

title: 行人章·书中例，行舟占顺风：午火子孙回头生世，今日午时必得顺风，嫌当日是戌日、午火子孙入墓之日，风必不久，午时扬帆，未时风止

rule.yi: 行船以子孙为顺风：子孙发动回头生世，当日就得顺风；子孙入墓则风不久。书中例：辰月甲戌日行船占顺风，得升卦变恒卦：午火子孙回头生世爻，今天午时必得顺风，只嫌今天是戌日，是午火子孙入墓的日子，风必定不长久；果然午时子孙当令，顺风扬帆，到未时风就停了。
rule.en: For a boat, Output is the fair wind: when Output moves and turns back to give life to the Self, a fair wind comes that day, and if Output enters the tomb the wind does not last. Worked example: in the Chen month, on a Jiaxu day, a man divined for a fair wind on a boat and got Sheng changing to Heng: the Output Wu-fire turns back to give life to the Self, so a fair wind will surely come at the Wu hour today, only that today is a Xu day, the day when Wu-fire Output enters the tomb, so the wind will not last; indeed at the Wu hour Output was in command and the sail was hoisted in a fair wind, and by the Wei hour the wind had dropped.

zh: 舟行风阻者，勿以兄弟为风云，乃以子孙为顺风，动而逢合逢值之日，静而逢冲之日，空逢冲实之日，皆与天时章阴晴同断。
yi: 乘船遇到风阻的，不要拿兄弟爻当风云，而要拿子孙爻当顺风；发动的遇到合、值的日子，安静的遇到冲的日子，空的遇到冲实的日子，都和天时章里断阴晴的办法相同。
en: For a boat held up by wind, do not take the Peer line as wind and cloud but take Output as the fair wind; it comes on the day when a moving one meets a combination or the ruling day, on the day when a still one meets a clash, and on the day when a Void one meets the clash that fills it, all judged in the same way as fine and cloudy weather in the chapter on the weather.

zh: 又于：辰月甲戌日(旬空：申酉)，行舟占顺风，得“升之恒”
yi: 又在辰月甲戌日（旬空申、酉），行船占顺风，得升卦变恒卦。
en: Again, in the Chen month, on a Jiaxu day (Void: Shen and You), on a boat, divining for a fair wind and getting Sheng changing to Heng.

zh: 午子回头生世，今日午时，必得顺风，但嫌今日戌日，午火子孙入墓之日，风必不久。
果于午时子孙当令，顺风扬帆，至未时而风止矣。
yi: 午火子孙回头生世，今天午时必得顺风，只嫌今天是戌日，是午火子孙入墓的日子，风必定不长久。
果然午时子孙当令，顺风扬帆，到未时风就停了。
en: The Output Wu-fire turns back to give life to the Self, so a fair wind will surely come at the Wu hour today, only that today is a Xu day, the day when Wu-fire Output enters the tomb, so the wind will not last.
Indeed at the Wu hour Output was in command and the sail was hoisted in a fair wind, and by the Wei hour the wind had dropped.

title: 行人章·书中例，命船家占风：变爻寅木子孙克制丑土之鬼，必到寅日得顺风，戊寅日寅时果然开船

rule.yi: 子孙发动变出子孙，是顺风之神：变爻寅木子孙克制丑土官鬼，必到寅日得顺风；果然在戊寅日寅时得到顺风开船。书中例：次日乙亥日叫船家占风，得丰卦变大壮卦。
rule.en: When Output moves and changes into Output, it is the fair-wind spirit: the changed line, Yin-wood Output, controls the Chou-earth Pressure, so a fair wind will surely come on the Yin day; indeed on the Wuyin day, in the Yin hour, a fair wind came and the boat set out. Worked example: the next day, a Yihai day, the boatman was told to divine for the wind and got Feng changing to Dazhuang.

zh: 舟行风阻者，勿以兄弟为风云，乃以子孙为顺风，动而逢合逢值之日，静而逢冲之日，空逢冲实之日，皆与天时章阴晴同断。
yi: 乘船遇到风阻的，不要拿兄弟爻当风云，而要拿子孙爻当顺风；发动的遇到合、值的日子，安静的遇到冲的日子，空的遇到冲实的日子，都和天时章里断阴晴的办法相同。
en: For a boat held up by wind, do not take the Peer line as wind and cloud but take Output as the fair wind; it comes on the day when a moving one meets a combination or the ruling day, on the day when a still one meets a clash, and on the day when a Void one meets the clash that fills it, all judged in the same way as fine and cloudy weather in the chapter on the weather.

zh: 至：次日乙亥日(旬空：申酉)，命船家占风，得“丰之大壮”
yi: 第二天乙亥日（旬空申、酉），叫船家占风，得丰卦变大壮卦。
en: The next day, a Yihai day (Void: Shen and You), the boatman was told to divine for the wind and got Feng changing to Dazhuang.

zh: 变爻寅木子孙，克制丑土之鬼，必至寅日而得顺风。
已于戊寅日寅时，果得顺风而开舟矣。
yi: 变爻寅木子孙，克制丑土官鬼，必到寅日得顺风。
已在戊寅日寅时，果然得到顺风，开船了。
en: The changed line, Yin-wood Output, controls the Chou-earth Pressure, so a fair wind will surely come on the Yin day.
Indeed on the Wuyin day, in the Yin hour, a fair wind came and the boat set out.

title: 行人章·书中例，由淮回扬附载登舟占风：二爻辰土子孙是得顺风之喜，四爻戌土子孙是到家之喜，断明日辰时顺风、戌时抵扬

rule.yi: 子孙发动是顺风；子孙落在哪一爻、临哪个时辰，就应在哪一个时辰有风。书中例：亥月癸亥日占顺风，得未济卦变艮卦：有人从淮安回扬州，我搭他的船，上船后他就占风，我说：明天辰时得顺风，戌时就能到扬州。他问：怎么这么快？我说：二爻辰土子孙，是得顺风的喜悦；四爻戌土子孙，是到家的喜悦。结果和所占的一样。
rule.en: Output moving is the fair wind; the hour answers on whichever line Output sits and whichever hour it rules. Worked example: in the Hai month, on a Guihai day, a man divined for a fair wind and got Weiji changing to Gen: someone was going back from Huai to Yang and I took passage with him; on boarding he divined for the wind at once, and I said: tomorrow at the Chen hour a fair wind will come, and at the Xu hour we will reach Yang. He asked: why so fast? I said: the Output Chen-earth in the second line is the joy of getting a fair wind; the Output Xu-earth in the fourth line is the joy of getting home. It came out as divined.

note.yi: 原文「余附载之，登州」中的「登州」疑是「登舟」之误（上船）；这里按「上船」译。「杨」即扬州。
note.en: The original has the place-name "Dengzhou" after "I took passage with him"; it is probably a slip for the phrase meaning "boarding the boat", which sounds the same, and it is translated as "boarding". "Yang" is Yangzhou.

zh: 舟行风阻者，勿以兄弟为风云，乃以子孙为顺风，动而逢合逢值之日，静而逢冲之日，空逢冲实之日，皆与天时章阴晴同断。
yi: 乘船遇到风阻的，不要拿兄弟爻当风云，而要拿子孙爻当顺风；发动的遇到合、值的日子，安静的遇到冲的日子，空的遇到冲实的日子，都和天时章里断阴晴的办法相同。
en: For a boat held up by wind, do not take the Peer line as wind and cloud but take Output as the fair wind; it comes on the day when a moving one meets a combination or the ruling day, on the day when a still one meets a clash, and on the day when a Void one meets the clash that fills it, all judged in the same way as fine and cloudy weather in the chapter on the weather.

zh: 又如：亥月癸亥日(旬空：子丑)，占顺风，得“未济之艮”
yi: 又如：亥月癸亥日（旬空子、丑），占顺风，得未济卦变艮卦。
en: Another example: in the Hai month, on a Guihai day (Void: Zi and Chou), divining for a fair wind and getting Weiji changing to Gen.

zh: 有由淮回杨者，余附载之，登州，彼即占风，余曰：明日辰时，得顺风，戌时即抵杨矣。
余曰：二爻辰土子孙，乃得顺风之喜悦也；
四爻戌土子孙，到家之喜悦也。
yi: 有人从淮安回扬州，我搭他的船，上船后他就占风，我说：明天辰时得顺风，戌时就到扬州了。
他问：怎么这么快？
我说：二爻辰土子孙，是得顺风的喜悦；
四爻戌土子孙，是到家的喜悦。
结果和所占的一样。
en: Someone was going back from Huai to Yang and I took passage with him; on boarding he divined for the wind at once, and I said: tomorrow at the Chen hour a fair wind will come, and at the Xu hour we will reach Yang.
He asked: why so fast?
I said: the Output Chen-earth in the second line is the joy of getting a fair wind;
the Output Xu-earth in the fourth line is the joy of getting home.
It came out as divined.

title: 行人章·书中例，舟中占风、次日再占：酉金子孙持世安静，应在静而逢冲之日，卯日必有顺风；次日再占仍是酉金子孙持世，果然卯日风顺

rule.yi: 子孙安静，在逢冲的日子有顺风。书中例：戌月戊子日在船上占风，得坤卦变震卦：酉金子孙持世，必应在安静而逢冲的日子，卯日必有顺风；第二天己丑日又占，得夬卦，仍是酉金子孙持世，果然到卯日风顺。
rule.en: A still Output brings a fair wind on the day that clashes it. Worked example: in the Xu month, on a Wuzi day, a man divined for the wind on a boat and got Kun changing to Zhen: Output You-metal holds the Self, and it must answer on the day when a still line meets a clash, so a fair wind will surely come on the Mao day; the next day, a Jichou day, he divined again and got Guai, again with Output You-metal holding the Self, and indeed on the Mao day the wind was fair.

zh: 舟行风阻者，勿以兄弟为风云，乃以子孙为顺风，动而逢合逢值之日，静而逢冲之日，空逢冲实之日，皆与天时章阴晴同断。
yi: 乘船遇到风阻的，不要拿兄弟爻当风云，而要拿子孙爻当顺风；发动的遇到合、值的日子，安静的遇到冲的日子，空的遇到冲实的日子，都和天时章里断阴晴的办法相同。
en: For a boat held up by wind, do not take the Peer line as wind and cloud but take Output as the fair wind; it comes on the day when a moving one meets a combination or the ruling day, on the day when a still one meets a clash, and on the day when a Void one meets the clash that fills it, all judged in the same way as fine and cloudy weather in the chapter on the weather.

zh: 又余于：戌月戊子日(旬空：午未)，舟中占风，得“坤之震”
yi: 又在戌月戊子日（旬空午、未），船中占风，得坤卦变震卦。
en: Again, in the Xu month, on a Wuzi day (Void: Wu and Wei), divining for the wind on a boat and getting Kun changing to Zhen.

zh: 酉子持世，必应静而逢冲之日，卯日必有顺风。
yi: 酉金子孙持世，必应在安静而逢冲的日子，卯日必有顺风。
en: Output You-metal holds the Self, and it must answer on the day when a still line meets a clash, so a fair wind will surely come on the Mao day.

zh: 至：次日己丑日(旬空：午未)，又占，得“泽天夬”
yi: 第二天己丑日（旬空午、未），又占，得夬卦。
en: The next day, a Jichou day (Void: Wu and Wei), he divined again and got the hexagram Guai.

zh: 仍是酉金子孙持世，果至卯日风顺。
yi: 仍是酉金子孙持世，果然到卯日风顺。
en: It was again Output You-metal holding the Self, and indeed on the Mao day the wind was fair.

title: 行人章·书中例，连日占风：上爻寅鬼化酉金子孙则明日酉时有风；次日再占不再报，因为已知；子水子孙与世爻相合若被合住须冲破，明日午时顺风必大，舟行三百余里

rule.yi: 子孙发动化出子孙，这一天有风；子孙与世爻相合，被合住要冲开才成。书中例：戌月壬辰日占风，得大畜卦变泰卦：上爻寅木官鬼化出酉金子孙，明天酉时有风；第二天癸巳日又占风，得姤卦变小畜卦。有人问：昨天说今天酉时有风，今天的卦为什么不显现？我说：神灵以为我已经知道了，不再报；然而今天酉时固然有风，但一定不大，神灵报的是明天的大风，因为子水子孙与世爻相合，如果被合住，必须冲破才成功，明天午时，顺风必大；果然第二天风顺帆饱，船行三百多里。
rule.en: When Output moves, that day has wind; when Output combines with the Self and is held fast, it needs to be clashed open to succeed. Worked example: in the Xu month, on a Renchen day, a man divined for the wind and got Daxu changing to Tai: the Pressure Yin-wood in the top line changes into Output You-metal, so tomorrow at the You hour there will be wind; the next day, a Guisi day, he divined for the wind again and got Gou changing to Xiaoxu. Someone asked: you said yesterday there would be wind at the You hour today, so why does today's hexagram not show it? I said: the spirits take it that I already know, and do not report it again. There will indeed be wind at the You hour today, but it will certainly not be strong; what the spirits report is tomorrow's great wind. Output Zi-water combines with the Self, and when it is held fast by a combination it must be clashed open before it succeeds; tomorrow at the Wu hour the fair wind will certainly be strong. Indeed the next day the wind was fair and the sail full, and the boat made over three hundred li.

zh: 舟行风阻者，勿以兄弟为风云，乃以子孙为顺风，动而逢合逢值之日，静而逢冲之日，空逢冲实之日，皆与天时章阴晴同断。
yi: 乘船遇到风阻的，不要拿兄弟爻当风云，而要拿子孙爻当顺风；发动的遇到合、值的日子，安静的遇到冲的日子，空的遇到冲实的日子，都和天时章里断阴晴的办法相同。
en: For a boat held up by wind, do not take the Peer line as wind and cloud but take Output as the fair wind; it comes on the day when a moving one meets a combination or the ruling day, on the day when a still one meets a clash, and on the day when a Void one meets the clash that fills it, all judged in the same way as fine and cloudy weather in the chapter on the weather.

zh: 又：戌月壬辰日(旬空：午未)，占风，得“大畜之泰”
yi: 又在戌月壬辰日（旬空午、未），占风，得大畜卦变泰卦。
en: Again, in the Xu month, on a Renchen day (Void: Wu and Wei), divining for the wind and getting Daxu changing to Tai.

zh: 上爻寅鬼化出酉金子孙，明日酉时有风。
yi: 上爻寅木官鬼化出酉金子孙，明天酉时有风。
en: The Pressure Yin-wood in the top line changes into Output You-metal, so tomorrow at the You hour there will be wind.

zh: 至：次日癸巳日(旬空：午未)，又占风，得“姤之小畜”
yi: 第二天癸巳日（旬空午、未），又占风，得姤卦变小畜卦。
en: The next day, a Guisi day (Void: Wu and Wei), he divined for the wind again and got Gou changing to Xiaoxu.

zh: 或问：昨说今日酉时有风，而今日之卦如何不现？
余曰：神谓我已知矣，不再报也。
然今日酉时固然有风，而必不大。
盖子水子孙与世爻相合，若逢和住，须冲破以成功。
果于次日风顺帆饱，舟行三百余里。
yi: 有人问：昨天说今天酉时有风，今天的卦为什么不显现？
我说：神灵以为我已经知道了，不再报了。
然而今天酉时固然有风，但一定不大。
神灵报的是明天的大风。
因为子水子孙与世爻相合，如果被合住，必须冲破才成功。
明天午时，顺风必定很大。
果然第二天风顺帆饱，船行三百多里。
en: Someone asked: you said yesterday there would be wind at the You hour today, so why does today's hexagram not show it?
I said: the spirits take it that I already know, and do not report it again.
There will indeed be wind at the You hour today, but it will certainly not be strong.
What the spirits report is tomorrow's great wind.
Output Zi-water combines with the Self, and when it is held fast by a combination it must be clashed open before it succeeds.
Tomorrow at the Wu hour the fair wind will certainly be strong.
Indeed the next day the wind was fair and the sail full, and the boat made over three hundred li.

title: 趋避章·克神在内卦宜出外避、克神在外卦宜在家避：世与忌神都在外卦不可出行、宜家居，都在内卦不可家居、宜出外；与出行章「路上有官休出外，宅中有鬼莫家居」同意

rule.yi: 克世的神在内卦，动了来克世爻，宜出外去避；克世的神在外卦，动了来克世爻，宜待在家里避。世爻和忌神都在外卦的，不可出行，宜在家居住来避；世爻和忌神都在内卦的，不可在家居住，宜出外去避。出行章说「路上有官休出外，宅中有鬼莫家居」，是同一个意思。
rule.en: If the controlling spirit is in the inner trigram and moves to control the Self, it is fit to go out and avoid it; if the controlling spirit is in the outer trigram and moves to control the Self, it is fit to stay at home and avoid it. When the Self and the Adversary are both in the outer trigram one must not set out and should stay at home to avoid harm; when both are in the inner trigram one must not stay at home and should go out to avoid harm. The chapter on setting out says "if there is an official on the road, do not go out; if there is Pressure in the house, do not stay at home", which is the same idea.

zh: 克神若在内卦，动而克世，宜出外避之。
克神若在外卦，动而克世，宜在家避之。
yi: 克世的神如果在内卦，动了来克世爻，宜出外去避；
克世的神如果在外卦，动了来克世爻，宜待在家里避。
en: If the controlling spirit is in the inner trigram and moves to control the Self, it is fit to go out and avoid it;
if the controlling spirit is in the outer trigram and moves to control the Self, it is fit to stay at home and avoid it.

zh: 世在外，克在外，宜于家居。
世爻与忌神皆在外卦者，不可出行，宜家居可避；
世爻与忌神皆在内卦者，不可家居，宜出外可避。
yi: 世爻在外卦，克世的也在外卦，宜在家居住。
世爻与忌神都在外卦的，不可出行，宜在家居住来避；
世爻与忌神都在内卦的，不可在家居住，宜出外来避。
en: When the Self is in the outer trigram and what controls it is also in the outer trigram, it is fit to stay at home.
When the Self and the Adversary are both in the outer trigram one must not set out and should stay at home to avoid harm;
when the Self and the Adversary are both in the inner trigram one must not stay at home and should go out to avoid harm.

zh: 出行章云：路上有官休出外，宅中有鬼莫家居。
yi: 出行章说：路上有官休出外，宅中有鬼莫家居。
也是同一个意思。
en: The chapter on setting out says: if there is an official on the road, do not go out; if there is Pressure in the house, do not stay at home.
It is the same idea.

title: 趋避章·书中例，占流年：寅木动爻临月建化进神克世，六七月木衰墓时防土木之厄，宜出外避；目下去宜往西，六七月去反宜往东；此人七月初八往东，二十八地震房塌，独他得免

rule.yi: 克世的神动了，宜出外避；去的方向要看克世的神旺衰：它旺的时候去西，它衰的时候反而宜往东。书中例：寅月丁卯日占流年，得噬嗑卦变睽卦：寅木动爻临月建，化出进神克世爻，这时木盛、贪着自己的旺，不来克世；六、七月是木衰墓的时候，防土木之灾；问可不可以避，宜出外才能避；问往哪个方向吉，目下去的宜往西，六、七月去的宜往东，因为六七月木衰，反而宜东。这个人竟没有出门，拖到七月初七又做了凶梦，初八就往东去了，二十八日地震房塌，人口受伤，只有他幸免。
rule.en: When the controlling spirit moves, it is fit to go out to avoid it; the direction depends on that spirit's strength: while it is strong go west, while it is weak go east instead. Worked example: in the Yin month, on a Dingmao day, a man divined the year ahead and got Shihe changing to Kui: the moving Yin-wood line sits on the Month and changes into an Advancing spirit that controls the Self; at this time the Wood is thriving and greedy for its own flourishing, so it does not come to control the Self, but in the sixth and seventh months, when Wood is weak and in the tomb, beware calamity from earth and timber. Asked whether it could be avoided, I said it could, only by going out; asked which direction was lucky, I said: if you go now, go west; if you go in the sixth or seventh month, go east, because in those months Wood is weak and east becomes the fit direction. The man did not leave and put it off until the seventh day of the seventh month, when he had an ill dream again; on the eighth he went east, and on the twenty-eighth there was an earthquake, the house fell and people were hurt, and he alone escaped.

note.yi: 旬空「戍亥」的「戍」是「戌」的刻误，原文如此。书中夹的「注」（版本校勘说明）是整理者写的，不是原书，没有收。
note.en: The Void pair written "Xu-Hai" in the original has a slip in the first character (a look-alike for Xu); the original is kept. The bracketed editor's note on editions inside the text is not part of the book and is not taken in.

zh: 克神若在内卦，动而克世，宜出外避之。
克神若在外卦，动而克世，宜在家避之。
yi: 克世的神如果在内卦，动了来克世爻，宜出外去避；
克世的神如果在外卦，动了来克世爻，宜待在家里避。
en: If the controlling spirit is in the inner trigram and moves to control the Self, it is fit to go out and avoid it;
if the controlling spirit is in the outer trigram and moves to control the Self, it is fit to stay at home and avoid it.

zh: 如：寅月丁卯日(旬空：戍亥)，占流年，得“噬嗑之睽”
yi: 如：寅月丁卯日（旬空戍、亥），占流年，得噬嗑卦变睽卦。
en: For example: in the Yin month, on a Dingmao day (Void: Xu and Hai), divining the year ahead and getting Shihe changing to Kui.

zh: 余曰：寅木动爻临月建，化进神克世，此时木盛贪荣，不来克世，六、七月衰墓之时，防土木之厄。
余曰：目下去者，宜往西方，六、七月去者，宜往东方。
六七月木衰矣，所以反宜于东。
此人竟未出门，捱至七月初七，又得凶梦，初八即往东行，二十八，地震房塌，人口被伤，独伊得免。
yi: 我说：寅木动爻临月建，化出进神克世爻，这时木盛、贪着自己的旺，不来克世；六、七月是木衰墓的时候，防土木之灾。
他问：可以避吗？
我说：宜出外才能避。
又问：往哪个方向吉？
我说：目下去的宜往西，六、七月去的宜往东。
为什么？
六、七月木衰，所以反而宜东。
这个人竟然没有出门，拖到七月初七又做了凶梦，初八就往东去了，二十八日地震房塌，人口受伤，只有他幸免。
en: I said: the moving Yin-wood line sits on the Month and changes into an Advancing spirit that controls the Self; at this time the Wood is thriving and greedy for its own flourishing, so it does not come to control the Self, but in the sixth and seventh months, when Wood is weak and in the tomb, beware calamity from earth and timber.
He asked: can it be avoided?
I said: it can, only by going out.
He asked again: which direction is lucky?
I said: if you go now, go west; if you go in the sixth or seventh month, go east.
Why?
In the sixth and seventh months Wood is weak, so east becomes the fit direction instead.

The man did not leave and put it off until the seventh day of the seventh month, when he had an ill dream again; on the eighth he went east, and on the twenty-eighth there was an earthquake, the house fell and people were hurt, and he alone escaped.

title: 趋避章·书中例，占仆人能为祸否：防患只看忌神不看财，世临辰土被两重寅木伤，未月木墓、七月木绝是他败露之月，宜出外避；主人往坟庄住半月，两仆果然逃走

rule.yi: 防患的占卜只看忌神，不看财；克世的神在你这一方就宜出外避。书中例：未月丙子日占仆人能不能为祸，得解卦变震卦：这位主人知道仆人变了心，想处置他，还没有实迹，所以占；这一卦如果把仆人当财就错了，因为他既是防患，只看忌神；现在世爻临辰土，被两重寅木伤克。我说：不止这一个人，还有跟随的人。他问：怎么处置？我说：他确实没有实迹，怎么处置？只是未月是木的墓、七月是木的绝，这两个月是他们败露的月份，你宜出外去避，自然能免祸。他果然照做，到坟庄上住了半个月，家中两个仆人逃走了，一个妇人跟着去，一个没有去；没去的妇人说：那两个人本来想害主人才逃，因为主人出外，不能下手，计谋泄露才逃的。
rule.en: In divining to guard against harm, look only at the Adversary and not at Wealth; where the controlling spirit presses on one's own side, it is fit to go out and avoid it. Worked example: in the Wei month, on a Bingzi day, a man divined whether his servant could do him harm and got Jie changing to Zhen: the master knew the servants had changed their hearts and wished to deal with them but had no proof, so he divined; if one took the servant as Wealth in this hexagram one would be mistaken, since he is guarding against harm and only looks at the Adversary; here the Self sits on Chen-earth and is injured by two Yin-wood lines. I said: it is not only this man, there are followers too. He asked how to deal with them. I said: he has really left no trace, how can you deal with him? But the Wei month is the tomb of Wood and the seventh month is its extinction, and these two months are when they will be exposed; you should go out and avoid them, and you will be free of harm. He did as told, stayed half a month at the tomb farm, and two servants at home ran away, one woman following them and one not; the woman who stayed said: those two had meant to harm the master and ran; because the master went out they could not harm him, and the plot leaked, so they fled.

zh: 世爻与忌神皆在外卦者，不可出行，宜家居可避；
世爻与忌神皆在内卦者，不可家居，宜出外可避。
yi: 世爻与忌神都在外卦的，不可出行，宜在家居住来避；
世爻与忌神都在内卦的，不可在家居住，宜出外来避。
en: When the Self and the Adversary are both in the outer trigram one must not set out and should stay at home to avoid harm;
when the Self and the Adversary are both in the inner trigram one must not stay at home and should go out to avoid harm.

zh: 如：未月丙子日(旬空：申酉)，占仆人能为祸否？
yi: 如：未月丙子日（旬空申、酉），占仆人能不能为祸？
得解卦变震卦。
en: For example: in the Wei month, on a Bingzi day (Void: Shen and You), divining whether a servant could do harm:
the hexagram Jie changing to Zhen.

zh: 此公知仆役变心，意欲处治，尚无实迹，故占之。
此卦若执奴仆为财则愚矣。
盖彼既防患，只看忌神，今世临辰土，两重寅木伤之。
余曰：不独此人，还有附从者。
余曰：彼实无迹，如何处之？
但未月乃木之墓，七月乃木之绝，此两月是彼败露之月也，公宜出外避之，自能免祸。
果依数而行，往坟庄上住过半月，家中两仆逃矣，一妇随去，一妇未去。
未去之妇曰：彼二人原欲害主而逃，今因主出外，不能相害。
yi: 这位主人知道仆人变了心，想处置他，还没有实迹，所以占。
这一卦如果把仆人当财就错了。
因为他既是防患，只看忌神，现在世爻临辰土，被两重寅木伤克。
我说：不止这一个人，还有跟随的人。
他问：怎么处置？
我说：他确实没有实迹，怎么处置？
只是未月是木的墓，七月是木的绝，这两个月是他们败露的月份，你宜出外去避，自然能免祸。
他果然照做，到坟庄上住了半个月，家中两个仆人逃走了，一个妇人跟着去，一个没有去。
没去的妇人说：那两个人本来想害主人才逃，因为主人出外，不能下手。
所以计谋泄露才逃走的。
en: The master knew the servants had changed their hearts and wished to deal with them but had no proof, so he divined.
It would be a mistake to take the servant as Wealth in this hexagram.
For he is guarding against harm and so looks only at the Adversary; here the Self sits on Chen-earth and is injured by two Yin-wood lines.
I said: it is not only this man, there are followers too.
He asked: how should I deal with them?
I said: he has really left no trace, how can you deal with him?
But the Wei month is the tomb of Wood and the seventh month is its extinction, and these two months are when they will be exposed; you should go out and avoid them, and you will be free of harm.
He did as told, stayed half a month at the tomb farm, and two servants at home ran away, one woman following them and one not.
The woman who stayed said: those two had meant to harm the master and ran; because the master went out, they could not harm him.
So the plot leaked and they fled.

title: 趋避章·避患于生世之方、趋吉于福神之地：避兵、避盗、避瘟、养病、避是非，都宜避到「生世」之方和「子孙」之方；子孙若在卦中发动，不论克世、生世、持世都吉

rule.yi: 避祸要避到生助世爻的那个方向，求吉要去福神所在的地方。凡是避兵、避盗、避瘟疫、养病、避是非，都适宜避到「生世」的方向和「子孙」的方向才吉。子孙如果在卦中发动，不论克世、生世还是持世，都吉。
rule.en: To avoid harm, go to the direction that gives life to the Self; to seek luck, go to the place of Output. In avoiding soldiers, avoiding thieves, avoiding plague, recuperating from illness and avoiding quarrels alike, it is lucky to avoid to the direction that gives life to the Self and the direction of Output. If Output moves in the hexagram, it is lucky whether it controls, gives life to or holds the Self.

zh: 避患于生世之方，趋吉于福神之地。
凡避兵、避盗、避瘟、养病、避是非，皆宜避于“生世”之方及“子孙”之方为吉。
子孙若发动于卦中，不拘克世、生世、持世俱吉。
yi: 避祸要避到生助世爻的那个方向，求吉要去福神所在的地方。
凡是避兵、避盗、避瘟疫、养病、避是非，都适宜避到「生世」的方向和「子孙」的方向才吉。
子孙如果在卦中发动，不论克世、生世还是持世，都吉。
en: To avoid harm, go to the direction that gives life to the Self; to seek luck, go to the place of Output.

In avoiding soldiers, avoiding thieves, avoiding plague, recuperating from illness and avoiding quarrels alike, it is lucky to avoid to the direction that gives life to the Self and the direction of Output.
If Output moves in the hexagram, it is lucky whether it controls, gives life to or holds the Self.

title: 趋避章·书中例，占防流兵能为我害否：巳酉丑合金局克世、世临蛇鬼，看似在劫难逃；作者断子孙合成金局克去身边之鬼，反而无忧，酉金得丑辰二土生，不能论克；后来屡遇兵变皆有惊无险

rule.yi: 避祸要避到生世的方向、子孙的方向；子孙如果发动，不拘克世、生世、持世都吉。书中例：巳月戊辰日占防流兵能不能害我，得临卦变睽卦：当时流兵为害，到处遭殃，有个懂易的人占得这一卦，整天焦虑；我问他这一卦为什么发愁，他说巳酉丑合成金局克世爻，世爻又临螣蛇官鬼，命数在劫难中，万万逃不掉。我笑着说：你和兵贼同住，保你没事。他问为什么，我说：子孙合成金局，克去身边的鬼，还担心什么？他说：酉金子孙在巳月旺，又化出巳火，论克，怎么论生？我说：酉金得丑、辰两个土来生它，怎么论克？结果屡次遇到兵变，这个人有时避、有时不避，都是有惊无险。从癸未年占得这一卦，直到庚寅年地方大定，他对我说：子孙是福神，确实灵验；世上看书不到、论理不透，把吉当凶、把凶当吉的，不只我一个人。
rule.en: Avoid to the direction that gives life to the Self and the direction of Output; if Output moves, it is lucky whether it controls, gives life to or holds the Self. Worked example: in the Si month, on a Wuchen day, a man divined whether roving soldiers could harm him and got Lin changing to Kui. At that time roving soldiers were doing harm and bringing calamity everywhere, and a man who knew the Changes, having got this hexagram, was anxious all day. I asked what worried him in it. He said: Si, You and Chou combine into a Metal frame that controls the Self, and the Self sits on a Coiling Snake and Pressure; my fate is in the calamity and I can never escape. I laughed and said: you live with the soldiers and thieves, and I guarantee you will be fine. He asked why. I said: Output combines into the Metal frame and controls away the Pressure beside you; what is there to fear? He said: You-metal Output is strong in the Si month and also changes into Si-fire; if it is control, how can it be life? I said: You-metal is given life by the two earths Chou and Chen; how can it be called control? In the end he met mutinies of soldiers again and again; sometimes he avoided and sometimes not, but it was always a fright with no harm. From the Guiwei year when he got this hexagram until the Gengyin year when the region was at peace, he said to me: Output is the spirit of fortune and it is truly borne out; those in the world who do not read deeply or reason thoroughly and take the lucky for ill and the ill for lucky are not only myself.

zh: 子孙若发动于卦中，不拘克世、生世、持世俱吉。
yi: 子孙如果在卦中发动，不论克世、生世还是持世，都吉。
en: If Output moves in the hexagram, it is lucky whether it controls, gives life to or holds the Self.

zh: 如：巳月戊辰日(旬空：戌亥)，占防流兵能为我害否？
yi: 如：巳月戊辰日（旬空戌、亥），占防流兵能不能害我？
得临卦变睽卦。
en: For example: in the Si month, on a Wuchen day (Void: Xu and Hai), divining whether roving soldiers could harm me:
the hexagram Lin changing to Kui.

zh: 彼时流兵为害，到处遭殃，有知易者，占得此卦，终日焦虑。
彼曰：巳酉丑合成金局而克世，世爻又临蛇鬼，数在劫中，万万莫能逃矣。
余笑曰：尔与兵贼同居，保尔无事。
余曰：子孙合成金局，克去身边之鬼，夫复何忧？
彼曰：酉金子孙，旺于巳月，又化巳火，论克，如何论生？
余曰：酉金得丑辰二土以相生，如何论克？
果屡次遇兵变，此人或避，或不避，皆有惊无险。
自癸未年占得此卦，直至庚寅年地方大定，向余曰：子孙为福神，信乎有验，世之看书不到，论理不彻，以吉为凶，以凶为吉者，不独我一人而已。
yi: 当时流兵为害，到处遭殃，有个懂易的人占得这一卦，整天焦虑。
我问：这一卦为什么发愁？
他说：巳酉丑合成金局克世爻，世爻又临螣蛇官鬼，命数在劫难中，万万逃不掉。
我笑着说：你和兵贼同住，保你没事。
他问：为什么？
我说：子孙合成金局，克去身边的鬼，还担心什么？
他说：酉金子孙在巳月旺，又化出巳火，论克，怎么论生？
我说：酉金得丑、辰两个土来生它，怎么论克？
结果屡次遇到兵变，这个人有时避、有时不避，都是有惊无险。
从癸未年占得这一卦，直到庚寅年地方大定，他对我说：子孙是福神，确实灵验；世上看书不到、论理不透，把吉当凶、把凶当吉的，不只我一个人。
en: At that time roving soldiers were doing harm and bringing calamity everywhere, and a man who knew the Changes, having got this hexagram, was anxious all day.
I asked: what worries you in this hexagram?
He said: Si, You and Chou combine into a Metal frame that controls the Self, and the Self sits on a Coiling Snake and Pressure; my fate is in the calamity and I can never escape.
I laughed and said: you live with the soldiers and thieves, and I guarantee you will be fine.
He asked: why?
I said: Output combines into the Metal frame and controls away the Pressure beside you; what is there to fear?
He said: You-metal Output is strong in the Si month and also changes into Si-fire; if it is control, how can it be life?
I said: You-metal is given life by the two earths Chou and Chen; how can it be called control?
In the end he met mutinies of soldiers again and again; sometimes he avoided and sometimes not, but it was always a fright with no harm.

From the Guiwei year when he got this hexagram until the Gengyin year when the region was at peace, he said to me: Output is the spirit of fortune and it is truly borne out; those in the world who do not read deeply or reason thoroughly and take the lucky for ill and the ill for lucky are not only myself.

title: 趋避章·书中例，同乡占避乱往哪个方向：众人以子孙属水、金动生之，主往北；作者断兄动化进神是破财之象，午火得令生世，往南避为吉；众人从南避，后来贼从北来放火烧村，所以生方为吉，子孙之方亦吉，要以旺衰分别

rule.yi: 避乱要避到生世的方向和子孙的方向，还要按旺衰来分辨。书中例：巳月丙戌日同乡的人占避乱，得乾卦变大有卦：众人认为子孙属水，有金动来生它，北方为吉。我说：不对。兄爻动化出进神，是破财之象；午火当令，生助世爻，往南避才吉。众人信了我的话，都往南避。后来贼果然从北边来，放火把村子烧光，房屋稻谷都成了灰烬，这是申金兄爻发动破财的缘故。所以生世的方向吉，子孙的方向也吉；又要用旺衰来分别，火虽然是鬼的方向，生我又有什么妨碍。
rule.en: In avoiding disorder, go to the direction that gives life to the Self and the direction of Output, and tell them apart by strength and weakness. Worked example: in the Si month, on a Bingxu day, men of the same village divined which way to flee the disorder and got Qian changing to Dayou. The company held that Output belongs to Water, and Metal moves to give it life, so the north is lucky. I said: no. The Peer line moves and changes into an Advancing spirit, which is a sign of losing wealth; Wu-fire is in command and gives life to the Self, so it is lucky to flee south. They believed me and all fled south. Afterwards the bandits did come from the north, set fire to the village and left, and the houses and the rice were all ashes, which was the loss of wealth from the moving Shen-metal Peer. So the direction that gives life to the Self is lucky, and the direction of Output is also lucky; and one must also distinguish by strength and weakness: though Fire is the direction of Pressure, what harm is there in its giving life to me.

zh: 避患于生世之方，趋吉于福神之地。
yi: 避祸要避到生助世爻的那个方向，求吉要去福神所在的地方。
en: To avoid harm, go to the direction that gives life to the Self; to seek luck, go to the place of Output.

zh: 如通乡于：巳月丙戌日(旬空：午未)，占避乱，得“乾之大有”
yi: 同乡的人在巳月丙戌日（旬空午、未），占避乱，得乾卦变大有卦。
en: In the Si month, on a Bingxu day (Void: Wu and Wei), men of the same village divined about fleeing disorder, getting Qian changing to Dayou.

zh: 众以子孙属水，金动生之，北方为吉。
兄动化进神，乃破财之象，午火得令而生世，往南避之为吉。
后果贼从北来，放火烧村而去，房屋稻谷尽成灰烬，乃申金兄动破财之故耳。
所以生方为吉，子孙之方亦吉。
又当以旺衰分别，火虽鬼方，生我何碍。
yi: 众人认为子孙属水，有金动来生它，北方为吉。
我说：不对。
兄爻动化出进神，是破财之象，午火当令，生助世爻，往南避才吉。
众人信了我的话，都往南避。
后来贼果然从北边来，放火把村子烧光，房屋稻谷都成了灰烬，这是申金兄爻发动破财的缘故。
所以生世的方向吉，子孙的方向也吉。
又要用旺衰来分别，火虽然是鬼的方向，生我又有什么妨碍。
en: The company held that Output belongs to Water, and Metal moves to give it life, so the north is lucky.
I said: no.
The Peer line moves and changes into an Advancing spirit, which is a sign of losing wealth; Wu-fire is in command and gives life to the Self, so it is lucky to flee south.
They believed me and all fled south.
Afterwards the bandits did come from the north, set fire to the village and left, and the houses and the rice were all ashes, which was the loss of wealth from the moving Shen-metal Peer.
So the direction that gives life to the Self is lucky, and the direction of Output is also lucky.
And one must also distinguish by strength and weakness: though Fire is the direction of Pressure, what harm is there in its giving life to me.

title: 千金赋·速则动而克世、缓则静而生身：只有占行人才用；用神动而克世行人回得快，用神静而生世行人回得慢；父母动而克世的，答应他立刻就回

rule.yi: 用神发动来克世爻，回得快；用神安静而生世爻，回得慢。这一条只有占行人才用，别的占不用。用神动而克世的，行人回得快；用神静而生世的，行人回得慢。比如占父母什么时候回，以父母爻为用神，父母爻动而克世的，许他立刻就回；其余照此推。
rule.en: A Subject that moves and controls the Self returns quickly; a Subject that is still and gives life to the Self returns slowly. This is used only in divining for a traveller and not in other divinations. A Subject that moves and controls the Self means a quick return; one that is still and gives life to the Self means a slow return. For example, in divining when a parent will return, the Resource line is the Subject, and if the Resource moves and controls the Self he is promised to return at once; the rest follow this.

zh: 速则动而克世，缓则静而生身。
yi: 快的是发动而克世爻，慢的是安静而生身。
en: The quick is that which moves and controls the Self, the slow that which is still and gives life to the Body.

hits.text: 速则动而克世，缓则静而生身
速则动而克世，缓则静而生身
速则动而克世，缓则静而生身
速则动而克世，缓则静而生身

zh: 此独占行人用之，他占不用。
yi: 这一条只有占行人才用，别的占不用。
en: This is used only in divining for a traveller and not in other divinations.

zh: 野鹤曰：用神动而克世者，行人回速也；
用神静而生世者，行人归缓也。
以父母为用神，父母动而克世者，许之即归。
yi: 野鹤说：用神发动而克世的，行人回得快；
用神安静而生世的，行人回得慢。
比如占父母什么时候回？
以父母爻为用神，父母爻动而克世的，许他立刻就回。
其余照这个类推。
en: Yehe says: a Subject that moves and controls the Self means a quick return;
a Subject that is still and gives life to the Self means a slow return.
For example, in divining when a parent will return:
the Resource line is the Subject, and if the Resource moves and controls the Self, he is promised to return at once.
The rest follow this.

title: 千金赋注·觉子论用克世：旧注说用神克世不作凶看、是事来就我，觉子以为不尽然——求财财爻克世必得、行人用神克世即归、医药子孙克世即愈，其余各占都不宜用神克世，占功名官鬼克世更是非祸即灾

rule.yi: 用克世就是用神来克世爻。旧注说不要当凶看，因为主事的爻动来克世，是这件事来就我，事必易成，我虽被克又有什么妨碍，所以说克世的不算凶。觉子认为这个说法不完全对。他验证过的：占求财，财爻克世一定得到；占行人，用神克世马上回来；占医药，子孙克世即愈。除了这几种占，其他都不宜用神克世。如果占功名，官鬼克世，不是祸就是灾，不能一概说不要当凶看。
rule.en: "The Subject controls the Self" means the Subject comes to control the Self. The old commentary says not to take it as ill: the line that rules the matter moves to control the Self, which means the matter comes to me and will easily be done, so what harm is there in my being controlled? Hence it is said that a controller of the Self is not taken as ill. Juezi thinks this is not entirely right. What he has found borne out is this: in divining for wealth, a Wealth line that controls the Self is surely gained; in divining for a traveller, a Subject that controls the Self returns at once; in divining for medicine, Output controlling the Self means a cure. Apart from these few divinations, the Subject controlling the Self is unfit in all others. If one divines for office, Pressure controlling the Self is not misfortune but calamity, and it cannot be said across the board not to take it as ill.

dispute.yi: 旧注：用神来克世是「事来就我」，不当凶看；觉子：只有求财、行人、医药这几种占才是好的，其余都不宜，功名占官鬼克世非祸即灾。
dispute.en: The old commentary holds that the Subject coming to control the Self is the matter coming to me and is not ill; Juezi holds that this is good only in divining for wealth, a traveller and medicine, that it is unfit in the rest, and that in divining for office Pressure controlling the Self is calamity.

zh: 觉子曰：用克世，乃用神来克世也。
勿作凶看者，据旧注：主事爻动来克世，乃为是事来就我，事必易成，我虽见克，亦何伤哉？
余之得验者，如占求财，财为用神，财爻克世者必得；
占行人，用神克世者即归；
占医药，子孙为用神，子孙克世者即愈。
外此数占，俱不宜用神而克世也。
若占功名，官鬼克世，非祸即灾，不得概曰勿作凶看也。
yi: 觉子说：用克世，就是用神来克世爻。
不要当凶看，据旧注：主事的爻动来克世，是这件事来就我，事必容易成，我虽然被克，又有什么妨碍？
所以说克世的不当凶。
我认为这个说法不完全对。
我验证过的：占求财，财是用神，财爻克世一定得到；
占行人，用神克世马上回来；
占医药，子孙是用神，子孙克世就好。
除了这几种占，都不宜用神克世。
如果占功名，官鬼克世，不是祸就是灾，不能一概说不要当凶看。
en: Juezi says: "the Subject controls the Self" means the Subject comes to control the Self.

Not to be taken as ill, according to the old commentary: the line that rules the matter moves to control the Self, which means the matter comes to me and will surely be done easily, so what harm is there in my being controlled?
Hence it is said that a controller of the Self is not taken as ill.
I think this view is not entirely right.
What I have found borne out: in divining for wealth, Wealth is the Subject, and a Wealth line that controls the Self is surely gained;
in divining for a traveller, a Subject that controls the Self returns at once;
in divining for medicine, Output is the Subject, and Output controlling the Self means a cure.
Apart from these few divinations, the Subject controlling the Self is unfit in all the others.
If one divines for office, Pressure controlling the Self is not misfortune but calamity, and it cannot be said across the board not to take it as ill.

title: 归魂游魂章·游魂卦占出行行止无定、占行人游遍他乡，归魂卦不出疆、诸事拘泥不行：野鹤——要先以用神为主，舍用神而执此断是错的

rule.yi: 游魂卦是各宫的第七卦，归魂卦是各宫的第八卦。古人认为游魂可以走千里，我做这件事想要久的，游魂却不能久，心里没有定向，迁改不常：占身命，一生没有安家乐业的地方；占行人，游遍他乡；占出行，行止没有定准；占家宅，搬迁变动不常；占坟茔，亡灵不能安妥。野鹤说：必须以用神为主，然后拿这个来参考；如果舍掉用神、执着这个来断，就错了。归魂卦不出疆界，诸事拘泥不行，与游魂卦相反来断就可以。
rule.en: A Wandering Soul hexagram is the seventh hexagram of each palace and a Returning Soul hexagram the eighth. The ancients held that a Wandering Soul can travel a thousand li, but if I am undertaking something that I want to last, the Wandering Soul cannot last; the heart has no settled direction and changes are frequent. In divining for one's life, there is no place to settle and thrive all one's life; for a traveller, he roams other lands; for setting out, going and stopping are unfixed; for the house, moves and changes are frequent; for a tomb, the spirits of the dead cannot be at rest. Yehe says: take the Subject as the main thing first and then use this as a reference; to set the Subject aside and judge by this alone is a mistake. A Returning Soul hexagram does not leave the border and things are stuck and do not go; judge it as the opposite of a Wandering Soul hexagram.

zh: 游魂卦为各宫之第七卦。
如乾宫中之火地晋，坤宫中之水天需。
归魂卦为各宫之第八卦。
如乾宫中之火天大有，坤宫中之水地比。
yi: 游魂卦是各宫的第七卦。
比如乾宫里的火地晋，坤宫里的水天需。
其余照这个类推。
归魂卦是各宫的第八卦。
比如乾宫里的火天大有，坤宫里的水地比。
其余照这个类推。
en: A Wandering Soul hexagram is the seventh hexagram of each palace.
For example Jin (Fire over Earth) in the palace of Qian, and Xu (Water over Heaven) in the palace of Kun.
The rest follow this.
A Returning Soul hexagram is the eighth hexagram of each palace.
For example Dayou (Fire over Heaven) in the palace of Qian, and Bi (Water over Earth) in the palace of Kun.
The rest follow this.

zh: 古以游魂行千里，我行此事而欲久者，游魂而不能久，心无定向，迁改不常。
占身命，一生无安家乐业之所；
yi: 古人认为游魂可以走千里，我做这件事想要久的，游魂却不能久，心里没有定向，迁改不常。
占身命，一生没有安家乐业的地方；
占行人，会游遍他乡；
占出行，行止没有定准；
占家宅，搬迁变动不常；
占坟茔，先人的亡灵不得安稳。
en: The ancients held that a Wandering Soul can travel a thousand li, but if I am undertaking something that I want to last, the Wandering Soul cannot last; the heart has no settled direction and changes are frequent.
In divining for one's life, there is no place to settle and thrive all one's life;
for a traveller, he roams other lands;
for setting out, going and stopping are unfixed;
for the house, moves and changes are frequent;
for a tomb, the spirits of the dead cannot be at rest.

zh: 野鹤曰：须以用神为主，然后以此参之。
若舍用神，执此而断者，谬也。
归魂不出疆，诸事拘泥不行，与游魂卦相反而断之可也。
yi: 野鹤说：必须以用神为主，然后拿这个来参考。
如果舍掉用神、执着这个来断，就错了。
归魂卦不出疆界，诸事拘泥不行，与游魂卦相反来断就可以。
en: Yehe says: take the Subject as the main thing first and then use this as a reference.
To set the Subject aside and judge by this alone is a mistake.
A Returning Soul hexagram does not leave the border and things are stuck and do not go; judge it as the opposite of a Wandering Soul hexagram.

title: 三合章·占出行用神在三合之内则被合而留，占行人用神在三合之内则被合不返

rule.yi: 占出行，用神在三合局之内，会被合住而留下来；占行人，用神在三合局之内，被合住不回来。同一章里，占功名三合官局生世利于我、生应利于他，占财财局生世利于我、生应利于他，也是同一个看法。
rule.en: In divining for setting out, a Subject inside a three-harmony frame is combined shut and stays; in divining for a traveller, a Subject inside a three-harmony frame is combined shut and does not return. In the same chapter, in divining for office a Pressure frame giving life to the Self is good for me and giving life to the Other is good for him, and a Wealth frame in divining for wealth is read the same way.

zh: 更有当知者：如占功名，三合官局而生世者，利于我；
占出行，用神在三合之内，被合而留。
占行人，用神在三合之内，被合不返。
yi: 还有应当知道的：占功名，三合官局生世的，对我有利；
生应的，对他有利。
占财，财局生世，对我有利；
财局生应，对他有利。
占出行，用神在三合之内，被合住而留下。
占行人，用神在三合之内，被合住不回。
en: There is more that should be known: in divining for office, a Pressure frame in three-harmony that gives life to the Self is good for me;
one that gives life to the Other is good for him.
In divining for wealth, a Wealth frame that gives life to the Self is good for me;
one that gives life to the Other is good for him.
In divining for setting out, a Subject inside the three-harmony is combined shut and stays.
In divining for a traveller, a Subject inside the three-harmony is combined shut and does not return.

title: 随鬼入墓章·占出仕出行世旺得地则冲开墓库之月日遂心，世空破休囚多去而不返；占行人用神化墓或入动墓，用神旺必归，用神空破休囚非病于他乡就是流落异境

rule.yi: 占出仕、出行，世爻旺相得地，冲开墓库的月日遂心；世爻如果空破休囚，多半是去了不回来。占行人，用神化墓，或入动墓的，用神旺相的一定回来；用神空破休囚的，不是病在他乡，就是流落在异地。
rule.en: In divining for taking office or setting out, if the Self is strong and well placed, matters go as wished in the month or day that clashes the tomb open; if the Self is Void, broken, resting or trapped, he mostly goes and does not return. In divining for a traveller, a Subject that changes into a tomb or enters a moving tomb returns for certain if it is strong; if it is Void, broken, resting or trapped, he is either ill in a strange land or adrift in a foreign place.

zh: 占出仕出行，世旺得地，冲开墓库之月日遂心，世若空破休囚，多见去而不返。
yi: 占出仕、出行，世爻旺相得地，冲开墓库的月日遂心，世爻如果空破休囚，多半是去了不回来。
en: In divining for taking office or setting out, if the Self is strong and well placed, matters go as wished in the month or day that clashes the tomb open; if the Self is Void, broken, resting or trapped, he mostly goes and does not return.

zh: 占行人，用神化墓，或入动墓者，用神旺必归；
用神空破休囚，非病于他乡，即流落于异境。
yi: 占行人，用神化墓，或入动墓的，用神旺相的一定回来；
用神空破休囚的，不是病在他乡，就是流落在异地。
en: In divining for a traveller, a Subject that changes into a tomb or enters a moving tomb returns for certain if it is strong;
if the Subject is Void, broken, resting or trapped, he is either ill in a strange land or adrift in a foreign place.

title: 进神退神章·书中例，占出行：世临寅木动化进神，合当就行，因月破目下未必能行，出月才可，后来亥月（破而逢合之月）方行，由燕至粤，次年八月归；子孙化进神知其平安

rule.yi: 动爻化进神是好事：世爻临寅木发动化出进神，按理应当就走，但因为月破，眼下未必能走，要出了这个月才行。书中例：申月乙卯日占出行，得屯卦变节卦：后来到亥月才动身，由燕地到粤地，第二年八月回来。我问：路上平安吗？他说：来去都托庇平安。我是因为子孙化进神，知道他平安，所以才问。应在亥月出行，是月破逢合的月份，这是动爻被月破、又化出日辰，怎么能说它不能进呢？
rule.en: A moving line changing into an Advancing spirit is a good thing: the Self sits on Yin-wood and moves and changes into an Advancing spirit, so by rights he should go at once, but because of the Month-break he may not be able to go now and can go only after the month is out. Worked example: in the Shen month, on a Yimao day, a man divined about setting out and got Zhun changing to Jie: he set out only in the Hai month, going from Yan to Yue, and came back in the eighth month of the next year. I asked: was the road safe? He said: coming and going I was sheltered and safe. I asked only because Output changes into an Advancing spirit, and I knew he would be safe. That it answered in the Hai month is the month in which a broken line meets a combination; this is a moving line broken by the Month and changing into the Day, so how can one say it cannot advance?

zh: 进退神者，爻之动而化也，化进化退，吉凶祸福，有喜忌之分。
yi: 进神、退神，是爻发动后变化出来的，化进化退，吉凶祸福，有所喜和所忌的分别。
所喜的，宜于化进神；
所忌的，宜于化退神。
en: Advancing and Retreating spirits come from a line moving and changing; changing into an Advancing or a Retreating spirit makes luck and misfortune, with what is welcome and what is feared.
What is welcome should change into an Advancing spirit;
what is feared should change into a Retreating spirit.

zh: 又如：申月乙卯日(旬空：子丑)，占出行，得“屯之节”
yi: 又如：申月乙卯日（旬空子、丑），占出行，得屯卦变节卦。
en: Another example: in the Shen month, on a Yimao day (Void: Zi and Chou), divining about setting out and getting Zhun changing to Jie.

zh: 世临寅木动而化进神，合当就行，因系月破，目下未必能行，出月方可。
后至亥月方行，由燕至粤，次年八月归来。
余以子孙化进神，知其平安，故问之耳。
夫应亥月出行者，破而逢合之月也。
此乃动破化日辰，岂可谓之不能进耶？
yi: 世爻临寅木发动化出进神，按理应当就走，但因为月破，眼下未必能走，要出了这个月才行。
后来到亥月才动身，由燕地到粤地，第二年八月回来。
我问：路上平安吗？
他说：来去都托庇平安。
我是因为子孙化进神，知道他平安，所以才问。
应在亥月出行，是月破逢合的月份。
这是动爻被月破、又化出日辰，怎么能说它不能进呢？
en: The Self sits on Yin-wood and moves and changes into an Advancing spirit, so by rights he should go at once, but because of the Month-break he may not be able to go now and can go only after the month is out.
He set out only in the Hai month, going from Yan to Yue, and came back in the eighth month of the next year.
I asked: was the road safe?
He said: coming and going I was sheltered and safe.
I asked only because Output changes into an Advancing spirit, and I knew he would be safe.
That it answered in the Hai month is the month in which a broken line meets a combination.
This is a moving line broken by the Month and changing into the Day, so how can one say it cannot advance?

title: 进神退神章·书中例，占兄归期：兄爻动化退神已有归志，但戌逢月破在外诸事未遂，断六月可望，后来戌月才回——应在实破之月，是动破而变日月，不能说退不及

rule.yi: 动爻化退神已有归意；动爻遇月破的，要等到填实破的月份才应。书中例：辰月己未日占兄长什么时候归，得履卦变兑卦：兄爻动化退神，已经有了回来的心，但是戌土逢月破，在外面诸事没有如意，六月可以盼回；后来到戌月才回来，是应在实破之月——填实月破的月份。这是动爻破而又变到日月，怎么能说是退神不及呢？
rule.en: A moving line changing into a Retreating spirit already has the mind to return; a moving line that meets the Month-break answers only when the break is filled. Worked example: in the Chen month, on a Jiwei day, a man divined when his elder brother would return and got Lü (Treading) changing to Dui: the Peer line moves and changes into a Retreating spirit, so he already has a mind to return, but Xu-earth meets the Month-break and nothing abroad has gone as he wished, so he can be hoped for in the sixth month; in the end he came back in the Xu month, answering in the month that fills the break. This is a moving line that is broken and changes into the Month and the Day; how can one say a Retreating spirit falls short?

zh: 进退神者，爻之动而化也，化进化退，吉凶祸福，有喜忌之分。
yi: 进神、退神，是爻发动后变化出来的，化进化退，吉凶祸福，有所喜和所忌的分别。
所喜的，宜于化进神；
所忌的，宜于化退神。
en: Advancing and Retreating spirits come from a line moving and changing; changing into an Advancing or a Retreating spirit makes luck and misfortune, with what is welcome and what is feared.
What is welcome should change into an Advancing spirit;
what is feared should change into a Retreating spirit.

zh: 又如：辰月己未日(旬空：子丑)，占兄归期，得“履之兑”
yi: 又如：辰月己未日（旬空子、丑），占兄长归期，得履卦变兑卦。
en: Another example: in the Chen month, on a Jiwei day (Void: Zi and Chou), divining when an elder brother would return and getting Lü (Treading) changing to Dui.

zh: 兄动化退，已有归志，但因戌逢月破，在外诸事未遂，六月可望。
后至戌月方回，乃应实破之月也。
此乃动破而变日月，岂可谓之退不及耶？
yi: 兄爻动化退神，已经有了回来的心，但是戌土逢月破，在外面诸事没有如意，六月可以盼回。
后来到戌月才回来，是应在实破之月。
这是动爻破而又变到日月，怎么能说是退神不及呢？
en: The Peer line moves and changes into a Retreating spirit, so he already has a mind to return, but Xu-earth meets the Month-break and nothing abroad has gone as he wished, so he can be hoped for in the sixth month.
In the end he came back in the Xu month, answering in the month that fills the break.
This is a moving line that is broken and changes into the Month and the Day; how can one say a Retreating spirit falls short?

title: 动散章·书中例，占父出外一载无音：卯木父爻动而生世、又化子水回头生，断在外平安、世空者速至、交春即归；果于二月回——卯动被酉日冲也没有冲散

rule.yi: 古人以日辰冲动爻叫做冲散，又以动爻冲爻也能冲散。作者屡次试验，旺相的、有气的，冲它不散；只有休囚的间或冲散，也是千百中的一二。原因是神灵的兆示机缘在动，动必有因，即使今天受制，后来逢到值日就不散。书中例：丑月丁酉日占父亲出外一年没有音信，得涣卦变坎卦：卯木父爻发动生世，又化出子水回头生，答应他在外平安，世爻空的行人速到，交春就回；果然二月，称心而回——这不是卯木动、被酉日冲吗，哪里散了？
rule.en: The ancients called a moving line clashed by the Day "scattered", and also said a moving line clashing another line can scatter it. The author has tried this repeatedly: a strong line or one with breath is not scattered by a clash; only a resting or trapped one is now and then scattered, and that is one or two in a thousand. Why? Because the spirits give their sign in the moving, and every movement has a cause: even if the line is checked today, when the ruling day comes it is not scattered. Worked example: in the Chou month, on a Dingyou day, a man divined about his father who had gone abroad and sent no word for a year, and got Huan changing to Kan: the Resource Mao-wood moves and gives life to the Self, and changes into Zi-water that turns back to give life, so he was promised that his father was safe abroad, that a Void Self means a quick arrival, and that he would return at the turn of spring. Indeed in the second month he came back content. Is this not Mao moving and being clashed by the You day? Where was the scattering?

zh: 古以日辰冲动爻，谓之冲散，又以爻动冲爻，亦能冲散。
余屡试之，旺相者，冲之不散；
休囚者，间有冲散，亦千百中之一二耳。
盖神兆机于动，动必有因，虽则今日受制，后逢值日而不散也。
yi: 古人以日辰冲动爻，叫做冲散，又以动爻冲爻，也能冲散。
我屡次试验，旺相的，冲它不散；
有气的，冲它不散；
休囚的间或冲散，也是千百中的一二。
原因是什么？
因为神灵的兆示机缘在动，动必有因，即使今天受制，后来逢到值日就不散。
en: The ancients called a moving line clashed by the Day "scattered", and also said a moving line clashing another line can scatter it.
I have tried this repeatedly: a strong line is not scattered by a clash;
one with breath is not scattered by a clash;
a resting or trapped one is now and then scattered, and that is one or two in a thousand.
Why?
Because the spirits give their sign in the moving, and every movement has a cause: even if the line is checked today, when the ruling day comes it is not scattered.

zh: 如：丑月丁酉日(旬空：辰巳)，占父出外，一载无音，得“涣之坎”
yi: 如：丑月丁酉日（旬空辰、巳），占父亲出外一年没有音信，得涣卦变坎卦。
en: For example: in the Chou month, on a Dingyou day (Void: Chen and Si), divining about a father who had gone abroad and sent no word for a year, getting Huan changing to Kan.

zh: 卯木父爻，动而生世，又化子水回头生，许之在外平安，世空者速至，交春即归。
yi: 卯木父爻发动生世，又化出子水回头生，答应他在外平安，世爻空的行人速到，交春就回。
果然二月，称心而回。
这不是卯木动、被酉日冲吗？
哪里散了？
en: The Resource Mao-wood moves and gives life to the Self, and changes into Zi-water that turns back to give life, so he was promised that his father was safe abroad, that a Void Self means a quick arrival, and that he would return at the turn of spring.
Indeed in the second month he came back content.
Is this not Mao moving and being clashed by the You day?
Where was the scattering?

title: 求财交易以财为主，发动临身必取；卦无财或落空，一切营谋不行

rule.yi: 求财做买卖，以财为主；财发动而临身，钱财一定拿得到；卦里没有财，或者财落空，一切谋求都靠不住。
rule.en: In seeking wealth and trade Wealth is the chief; Wealth moving and on the Body, the money is sure to be taken; if the hexagram has no Wealth, or Wealth falls void, no scheme of any kind can be relied on.

yi: 求财做买卖，以财为主；
财发动而临身，钱财一定拿得到；
卦里如果没有财，或者财落空，
一切谋求都靠不住。
en: In seeking wealth and trade, Wealth is the chief;
Wealth moving and on the Body, the money is sure to be taken;
if the hexagram has no Wealth, or Wealth falls void,
no scheme of any kind can be relied on.

title: 财爻持世或克世，一买一卖利百倍；克身又得青龙扶，积玉堆金

rule.yi: 财爻持世，或克世，一买一卖，利润百倍；克身又有青龙扶助，金玉堆积得算不清。
rule.en: Wealth on the Self or controlling it brings a hundredfold profit on one purchase and one sale; controlling the Body as well and supported by the Azure Dragon, gold and jade pile up beyond counting.

yi: 财爻持世，或克世，
一买一卖，利润百倍；
克身又得青龙扶助，
堆金积玉，怎么算得清。
en: Wealth on the Self, or controlling it:
one purchase and one sale, a hundredfold profit;
controlling the Body as well and supported by the Azure Dragon:
heaped gold and jade beyond counting.

title: 财爻外动较难，财在内兴人送至；外生内、应生世，财轻也容易

rule.yi: 财爻在外卦发动，比较艰难；财在内卦兴旺，人会把钱送上门；外卦生内卦、应生世，即使财轻也容易。
rule.en: A Wealth line moving in the outer trigram is harder; Wealth thriving in the inner trigram, people bring the money to you; the outer generating the inner and the Other generating the Self, even if Wealth is light it is easy.

yi: 财爻在外卦发动，比较艰难；
财在内卦兴旺，人会把钱送上门；
外卦生内卦、应生世，
即使财轻也容易。
en: A Wealth line moving in the outer trigram is harder;
Wealth thriving in the inner trigram, people bring the money to you;
the outer generating the inner and the Other generating the Self:
even if Wealth is light, it is easy.

title: 应克世、世克身，有财难成；世应比和身安，资财平稳无忧滞

rule.yi: 应克世、世克身，就算有财，终究难以成就；世应比和、卦身又安稳，资财平稳，没有忧愁阻滞。
rule.en: The Other controlling the Self and the Self controlling the Body: even with Wealth it is hard to bring about in the end; Self and Other in harmony and the Body at ease: the funds are steady, with no worry or delay.

yi: 应克世、世克身，
就算有财，终究难以成就；
世应比和、卦身又安稳，
资财平稳，没有忧愁阻滞。
en: The Other controlling the Self and the Self controlling the Body:
even with Wealth it is hard to bring about in the end;
Self and Other in harmony and the Body at ease:
the funds are steady, with no worry or delay.

title: 财生库旺聚钱财；财休囚货贱如尘宜措置，财旺相货贵如金宜乘早弃

rule.yi: 财得生、库又旺，钱财聚拢；子孙动、青龙交，正称心意。财爻落在废、休、囚，货贱如尘土，宜于买进；财爻旺相，货贵如金，有货必须趁早出手。
rule.en: Wealth generated and its store strong, money gathers; Output moving and the Dragon joining, all as one wishes. The Wealth line abandoned, resting or trapped, the goods are as cheap as dust and right to buy in; the Wealth line strong, the goods are as dear as gold and whoever has goods must sell early.

note.yi: 「宜措置」按字面读作适合置办（买进），《火珠林》此句作「应措置」。
note.en: 'Fit to arrange' is read as fit to stock up (buy in); the Huozhu Lin has 'should arrange' here.

yi: 财得生、库又旺，钱财聚拢；
子孙动、青龙交，正合心意；
财爻如果落在废、休、囚，
货贱得像尘土，宜于买进；
财爻旺相，货贵如金，
有货必须趁早出手。
en: Wealth generated and its store strong, money gathers;
Output moving and the Dragon joining, all as one wishes;
if the Wealth line is abandoned, resting or trapped,
the goods are as cheap as dust and right to buy in;
the Wealth line strong, the goods are dear as gold,
and whoever has goods must sell early.

title: 财爻不动平安，遇杀逢空破费；外鬼牵玄武，官灾盗贼；劫杀临身克身，忌暗昧

rule.yi: 财爻不动，钱财平安；遇凶杀、逢空，终究破费。外卦的官鬼把玄武牵来，官灾、盗贼，重重后悔。劫杀临身又克身，暗昧私下的事必须忌讳。
rule.en: Wealth still, the money is safe; meeting an ill star or void, in the end it is spent. A Pressure outside bringing in the Dark Tortoise: official trouble and thieves, regrets on regrets. The Robbery star on the Body and controlling it: secret and shady dealings must be avoided.

yi: 财爻不动，钱财平安；
遇凶杀、逢空，终究破费；
外卦的官鬼把玄武牵来，
官灾、盗贼，重重后悔；
劫杀临身、又克身，
暗昧私下的事，一定要忌讳。
en: Wealth still, the money is safe;
meeting an ill star or void, in the end it is spent;
a Pressure outside bringing in the Dark Tortoise:
official trouble and thieves, regrets on regrets;
the Robbery star on the Body and controlling it:
secret and shady dealings must be avoided.

title: 财爻驿马木神扶，成交遇贵；兄弟螣蛇是悔神；忌朱雀当头

rule.yi: 财爻带驿马、又有木神扶助，买卖成交，还能遇到贵人；兄弟和螣蛇是招悔的神，财怕散失，身怕不顺；不要再让朱雀当头，官司口舌就会牵连上来。
rule.en: Wealth on the Post Horse and helped by a Wood spirit: the deal is made and a noble is met besides; Peer and the Coiling Snake are spirits of regret, Wealth fearing to be scattered and lost and the Body fearing distress; do not let the Vermilion Bird head it, or lawsuits and quarrels follow.

yi: 财爻带驿马、又有木神扶助，
买卖成交，还能遇到贵人；
兄弟和螣蛇是招悔的神，
财怕散失，身怕不顺；
不要再让朱雀当头，
官司口舌就会牵连上来。
en: Wealth on the Post Horse and helped by a Wood spirit:
the deal is made and a noble is met besides;
Peer and the Coiling Snake are spirits of regret:
Wealth fears being scattered and lost, the Body fears distress;
and do not let the Vermilion Bird head it,
or lawsuits and quarrels follow.

title: 兄弟化财须防圈套；妻财化兄弟折本伤财；子孙化财、财化子孙利多；青龙水上来登山涉海饶利

rule.yi: 兄弟化成财，虽有财，要忌落入别人的圈套；折本伤财，只因妻财化成兄弟；子孙化成财，利润宜多，财化成子孙更不是小利；青龙落在水上，登山涉海多得利润。
rule.en: Peer turning into Wealth, though there is money, take care not to fall into another's trap; capital and money are lost only because Wealth turned into Peer; Output turning into Wealth brings large profit, and Wealth turning into Output is better still; with the Azure Dragon on Water, climbing mountains and crossing seas brings much profit.

note.yi: 「圈圆」是「圈圈」（圈套）的另一种写法，周易尚占作「圈圚」。「水上来」译作落在水爻上，是照字面取的读法。
note.en: 'Quan yuan' is another way of writing the word for a trap; the Zhouyi Shangzhan has yet another variant. 'Comes upon Water' is read literally as falling on a Water line.

yi: 兄弟化成财，虽然有财，
千万要忌讳落入别人的圈套；
折本伤财是为什么？
只因为妻财化成了兄弟；
子孙化成财，利润宜多；
财化成子孙，更不是小利；
又有青龙在水上来，
登山渡海多得利润。
en: Peer turning into Wealth, though there is money,
take great care not to fall into another's trap;
why are capital and money lost?
only because Wealth turned into Peer;
Output turning into Wealth, profit should be large;
Wealth turning into Output is better still;
and if the Azure Dragon comes upon Water,
climbing mountains and crossing seas brings much profit.

title: 勾陈交鬼必淹留，行货临官被贼偷；妻财化官鬼获利被官收；行商坐贾忌官爻临本库

rule.yi: 勾陈、官鬼发动，必被耽搁滞留；运货时官鬼临身，货被贼偷；妻财忽然化成官鬼，虽然获利，却被官府收去；行商坐贾经营钱财，切忌官爻落在本库上，不是官司送来祸事，就一定被贼偷走。
rule.en: Hook Earth and Pressure moving, you are surely held up; carrying goods with Pressure on it, thieves steal them; Wealth suddenly turning into Pressure, though profit is made the officials take it; for travelling merchants and shopkeepers, the Pressure line falling on its own store is above all to be avoided: it is either a lawsuit bringing trouble or thieves who surely steal it away.

yi: 勾陈、官鬼发动，必定被耽搁滞留；
运货时官鬼临身，货被贼偷；
en: Hook Earth and Pressure moving, you are surely held up;
carrying goods with Pressure on it, thieves steal them;

yi: 忽然妻财化成官鬼，
虽然获利，却被官府收去；
行商坐贾经营钱财，
切忌官爻落在本库上；
en: If Wealth suddenly turns into Pressure,
though profit is made the officials take it;
travelling merchants and shopkeepers who deal in money
must beware of the Pressure line falling on its own store;

yi: 不是官司送来祸事，
就一定被贼偷走。
en: if it is not a lawsuit bringing trouble,
then thieves surely steal it away.

title: 地头克身，事未周全，阴爻主女人滞留；身爻克地头，满载荣归

rule.yi: 地头（所到之地）克身，事情没办周全，阴爻则是女人把你留住；身爻克地头，就能满船载宝、荣耀而归。
rule.en: The place you go to controlling the Body, matters are not fully done, and a yin line means a woman keeps you; the Body line controlling the place brings you home in glory with a boat full of treasure.

note.yi: 「世未周」的「世」，《周易尚占》作「事未周」，读作事情没办周全。
note.en: The Zhouyi Shangzhan has 'matters not fully done' where this text has 'the Self not fully done'; it is read as matters not fully done.

yi: 地头克身，事情没办周全；
如果是阴爻，一定是女人把你留住；
en: The place controlling the Body, matters are not fully done;
if it is a yin line, it is surely a woman who keeps you;

yi: 满船载着宝物荣耀而归的，
是因为身爻克了地头。
en: Those who come home in glory with a boat full of treasure
do so because the Body line controls the place.

title: 何日得钱财：应在身、财生旺之日；如乾以木为财，亥卯日为准

rule.yi: 想问钱财哪一天得到：应在卦身和财爻生旺的日子；比如乾宫以木为财，就以亥、卯的日子为准。
rule.en: To ask on what day the money is got: it answers on a day when the Body and Wealth are born or strong; for instance, if the Qian palace takes Wood as its Wealth, the days Hai and Mao are the standard.

yi: 想问钱财哪一天得到？
应在卦身和财爻生旺的日子；
比如乾宫以木为财，
就以亥、卯的日子为准。
en: To ask on what day the money is got:
it answers on a day when the Body and Wealth are born or strong;
for instance, if the Qian palace takes Wood as its Wealth,
the days Hai and Mao are the standard.

title: 世应是财求易得，卦无财少准凭；财化鬼凶、鬼化财吉；财落空亡难把捉，遇二杀贼侵

rule.yi: 世应是财，求就容易得到；卦里没有财，就少有把握。财爻化成官鬼是凶象，官鬼化成财一定是吉神。财落在空亡，难以把握；再遇二杀（劫杀、天贼杀），贼来相侵。
rule.en: The Self or the Other being Wealth, seeking is easily rewarded; with no Wealth in the hexagram there is little to go on. Wealth turning into Pressure is an ill sign, and Pressure turning into Wealth is surely an auspicious spirit. Wealth fallen into Void is hard to seize, and if the two killers (the Robbery star and the Heavenly Thief star) are also met, thieves encroach.

note.yi: 「二杀」这一句小注，《卜筮大全》直接排在诗后，《火珠林》排成括号里的注；这里按注文处理，归在旧注名下（注者不详）。
note.en: The small note on the 'two killers' is set straight after the verse in the Bushi Daquan and in brackets in the Huozhu Lin; here it is treated as commentary and attributed to the old commentary (author unknown).

yi: 世应是财，求就容易得到；
卦里如果没有财，就少有把握。
财爻化成官鬼是凶象；
官鬼化成财，一定是吉神。
财落在空亡，难以把握；
如果再遇二杀，贼来相侵。
en: The Self or the Other being Wealth, seeking is easily rewarded;
if the hexagram has no Wealth, there is little to go on.
Wealth turning into Pressure is an ill sign;
Pressure turning into Wealth is surely an auspicious spirit.
Wealth fallen into Void is hard to seize;
and if the two killers are also met, thieves encroach.

yi: 「二杀」是说：
就是劫杀和天贼杀。
en: The two killers:
are the Robbery star and the Heavenly Thief star.

title: 财爻在外动难求，在内兴易觅；世克财休开口，财来克世得千金

rule.yi: 难求的，怕财爻在外卦发动；容易求到的，是财在内卦兴旺。世如果克财，别开口去求；财来克世，能得千金。
rule.en: Hard to get is a Wealth line moving in the outer trigram; easy to find is Wealth thriving in the inner; if the Self controls Wealth, do not open your mouth to ask; Wealth coming to control the Self brings a thousand gold.

yi: 难求的，怕财爻在外卦发动；
容易求到的，是财在内卦兴旺；
世如果克财，别开口去求；
财来克世，能得千金。
en: Hard to get, when the Wealth line moves in the outer trigram;
easy to find, when Wealth thrives in the inner;
if the Self controls Wealth, do not open your mouth to ask;
Wealth coming to control the Self brings a thousand gold.

title: 诸爻无财象，子动龙交亦可寻；世应合最吉，子孙合为福德；月德月建相扶，求财数倍

rule.yi: 各爻都没有财的象，子孙动、青龙交，也能求到；世应相合最吉，子孙来合就是福德；月德、月建来相扶，求财终究能得数倍。
rule.en: If none of the lines shows the image of Wealth, Output moving and the Dragon joining still lets you seek it; Self and Other combining is most auspicious, and Output combining is fortune and virtue; the Month's Virtue and the Month supporting it, seeking wealth surely brings several times the sum.

yi: 各爻如果都没有财的象，
子孙动、青龙交，也能求到；
世应如果相合，最吉；
子孙来合，就是福德；
月德、月建要来相扶，
求财终究能得数倍。
en: If none of the lines shows the image of Wealth,
Output moving and the Dragon joining still lets you seek it;
Self and Other combining is most auspicious;
Output combining is fortune and virtue;
the Month's Virtue and the Month should support it,
and seeking wealth surely brings several times the sum.

title: 内为人、外为地头：人克地头有淹留；地头克人兼旺相，求财数倍收

rule.yi: 内卦是人，外卦是地头（去的地方）：人克地头，会被耽搁滞留；地头克人又旺相，若是求财，能收数倍。
rule.en: The inner is the person and the outer the place: the person controlling the place is held up; the place controlling the person and strong too, seeking wealth reaps several times.

yi: 内卦是人，外卦是地头（去的地方）；
人克地头，会被耽搁滞留；
地头克人又旺相，
若是求财，能收数倍。
en: The inner is the person and the outer the place;
the person controlling the place is held up;
the place controlling the person and strong too,
seeking wealth reaps several times.

title: 日辰克身货出手，财克地头贼相守；青龙发动最佳，阴阳得位财必有

rule.yi: 日辰克身，货可以出手；财克地头，有贼守着；青龙发动最好，阴阳爻得位，财一定有。
rule.en: The Day controlling the Body, the goods go out; Wealth controlling the place, thieves lie in wait; the Azure Dragon moving is best, and with yin and yang lines in their right places Wealth is sure to be had.

yi: 日辰克身，货可出手；
财克地头，有贼守着；
青龙发动最好，
阴阳爻得位，财一定有。
en: The Day controlling the Body, the goods go out;
Wealth controlling the place, thieves lie in wait;
the Azure Dragon moving is best;
with yin and yang lines in their right places, Wealth is sure to be had.

title: 外爻无气应克身、遇空亡忧病；土爻持世有阻隔，阴爻持世女人淹滞

rule.yi: 外卦的爻没有气、应又克身，若再遇空亡，要担心生病；土爻持世，怎么离得开；阴爻持世，主是阴人（女人）。小注：土爻持世主有阻隔，阴爻持世主被女人耽搁滞留。
rule.en: The outer lines without breath and the Other controlling the Body, and if void besides, fear illness; an Earth line on the Self, how can you get away; a yin line on the Self points to a woman. The note: an Earth line on the Self means obstruction, a yin line on the Self means being held up by a woman.

yi: 外卦的爻没有气、应又克身，
若再遇空亡，要担心生病；
土爻持世，怎么离得开？
阴爻持世，主是阴人（女人）。
en: The outer lines without breath and the Other controlling the Body,
and if void besides, fear illness;
an Earth line on the Self: how can you get away?
a yin line on the Self points to a woman.

yi: 土爻持世，
主有阻隔，
阴爻持世，
主为女人淹滞也。
en: An Earth line on the Self
means obstruction;
a yin line on the Self
means being held up by a woman.

title: 求财四句：父动艰难，鬼动灾；子旺财明得利，兄兴迟滞是非

rule.yi: 凡占卦问求财：父母动就艰难，官鬼动就有灾；子孙旺、财明现，一定得利；兄弟兴旺，迟滞和是非就来。
rule.en: Whoever casts to ask about money: Resource moving means hardship and Pressure moving means disaster; Output strong and Wealth showing, profit is sure; Peer rising, delay and quarrels come.

yi: 凡是占卦问求财，
父母动就艰难，官鬼动就有灾；
子孙旺、财明现，一定得利；
兄弟兴旺，迟滞、是非就来。
en: Whoever casts to ask about money:
Resource moving means hardship, Pressure moving means disaster;
Output strong and Wealth showing, profit is sure;
Peer rising, delay and quarrels come.

chapter: 求财买卖章 附添人口
title: 添人口：财明子旺可成；父发兄摇难永远；鬼爻发动祸相亲

rule.yi: 添人进口（买人）：要财明现，子孙旺、财兴旺，就可以成；父母发动、兄弟动摇，难以长久；官鬼发动，祸事相近。
rule.en: Taking in a person: Wealth must show; Output strong and Wealth thriving, it can be done; Resource or Peer moving, it will not last; Pressure moving, disaster draws near.

yi: 添人进口，要财明现；
子孙旺、财兴旺，就可以成；
父母发动、兄弟动摇，难以长久；
官鬼发动，祸事相近。
en: To take in a person, Wealth must show;
Output strong and Wealth thriving, it can be done;
Resource or Peer moving, it will not last;
Pressure moving, disaster draws near.

chapter: 求财买卖章 附交易
title: 交易：子动财明大吉；兄鬼爻摇合不成；父兴费尽力气

rule.yi: 买卖和交易：子孙动、财明现，最吉；兄弟、官鬼爻动摇，合不成；父母兴旺，费尽千钧之力也办不成。
rule.en: For trade and dealings: Output moving and Wealth showing is greatly auspicious; Peer or Pressure lines stirring, the deal cannot be joined; Resource rising, all one's strength is spent for nothing.

yi: 凡占买卖和交易，
子孙动、财明现，最吉；
兄弟、官鬼爻动摇，合不成；
父母兴旺，费尽千钧之力。
en: For trade and dealings,
Output moving and Wealth showing is greatly auspicious;
Peer or Pressure lines stirring, the deal cannot be joined;
Resource rising, all one's strength is spent for nothing.

title: 求财六爻各主一样：初己身、二伴侣、三行李、四车门、五道路、六店舍

rule.yi: 求财占里，六个爻各代表一样：初爻是自己，二爻是同伴，三爻是行李，四爻是车门，五爻是道路，上爻是店舍。
rule.en: In a wealth divination each of the six lines stands for one thing: the first for oneself, the second for a companion, the third for baggage, the fourth for the carriage door, the fifth for the road, the top for the lodging.

note.yi: 这一对只是一张对照表，书里没有说怎么用；本库不替它编用法。同一本书在买卖章另有一张（见 DYTJ.11），两张不一样。
note.en: This is only a look-up list; the book does not say how to use it, and this library does not invent a use. The chapter on buying and selling has a second list (see DYTJ.11), and the two differ.

zh: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
己身伴侣行李车门道路店舍
yi: 第一爻、第二爻、第三爻、第四爻、第五爻、第六爻，依次是：
自己、同伴、行李、车门、道路、店舍。
en: The first line, the second, the third, the fourth, the fifth, the sixth, in order, are:
oneself, a companion, baggage, the carriage door, the road, the lodging.

hits.text: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
己身伴侣行李车马道路店舍

title: 辨君子小人求财：小人求财得乾卦，心里无良，行劫害之事

rule.yi: 辨君子和小人求财：小人求财，占到乾卦，心里没有善念，做的是抢夺伤害人的事。后面几句按巳酉丑、寅午戌、申子辰三组，说泰卦里的劫杀和驿马。
rule.en: On telling a gentleman from a petty person seeking wealth: a petty person who gets Qian has no goodness in the heart and does robbery and harm. The remaining lines take the three groups Si-You-Chou, Yin-Wu-Xu and Shen-Zi-Chen and speak of the Robbery star and the Post Horse in Tai.

note.yi: 这首歌诀省得很厉害，后四句怎么读，书里没有解释。整理本后面有今人写的注，把最后一句读作「贵人求财」；那段注文不是古籍，本库不引，也不跟着下结论，只照字译。原文里的「（1）」是整理本给那段注文编的号。
note.en: The verse is very terse and the book does not explain its last four lines. The transcription appends a modern note that reads the last line as a nobleman seeking wealth; that note is not a classic, so this library neither cites it nor draws the conclusion, and only translates the words. The '(1)' in the Chinese is the number the transcription gave to that note.

yi: 小人求财，占到乾卦，
心里没有善念，做的是抢夺伤害人的事。
逢巳、酉、丑而占到泰卦，
逢寅、午、戌，劫杀带来祸害；
逢申、子、辰，驿马在寅；
财与寅，在亥上六合。
en: A petty person seeking wealth who gets the Qian hexagram:
no goodness in the heart, he does robbery and harm.
Meeting Si, You and Chou and getting Tai:
meeting Yin, Wu and Xu, the Robbery star brings harm;
meeting Shen, Zi and Chen, the Post Horse is at Yin;
Wealth and Yin form a six-harmony at Hai.

title: 有意还财否：世应相生、外生内卦、子孙财爻动生世，他有还意；相克又无财，再去也白去

rule.yi: 对方有没有还钱的意思：世应相生、外卦生内卦、子孙和财爻发动生世，他心里是想还的；世应相克又没有财，再去讨也白讨。
rule.en: Whether the other side means to repay: Self and Other generating each other, the outer trigram generating the inner, or Output and the Wealth line moving to generate the Self, all show that he means to pay; Self and Other controlling each other with no Wealth, to go again is in vain.

note.yi: 原文里的（2）（3）（4）是整理本给今人注文编的号，那些注文本库不引。
note.en: The (2), (3) and (4) in the Chinese are numbers the transcription gave to modern notes, which this library does not cite.

yi: 世应相生，对方有还钱的意思，
嘴上说没有钱，其实常在筹划；
外卦生内卦，有还钱的心；
内外卦比和，终究有好处。
子孙和财爻发动生世，
他自己心里本来就有还的意思；
世应相生而卦里没有财，仍是想还；
世应相克而卦里没有财，再去也是白去。
en: Self and Other generating each other: he has the will to repay,
and though he says there is no money, he is often making ready;
the outer trigram generating the inner trigram: a heart to repay;
inner and outer trigrams in harmony: in the end there is benefit.
Output and the Wealth line moving to generate the Self:
in his own heart he already has the will to repay;
Self and Other generating each other with no Wealth, he still wants to repay;
Self and Other controlling each other with no Wealth, to go again is in vain.

title: 求财何日得：死财等财生的日月，生财不要拿财合当日期；空亡加退度，说得再多也要迟疑

rule.yi: 求财哪天到手：财爻衰死的，等财逢长生的日月才得；财爻得令的，不要拿合日当日期。上下相生的，可以取相克的时候；内克外的，白说合日；再遇空亡、退度，怎么说能得，也要迟疑。
rule.en: On which day the money arrives: for a dead Wealth, the day or month that gives it life; for a living Wealth, do not take the combining day as the date. When above and below generate each other one may take a time of control; when the inner controls the outer it is idle to speak of a combining day; with Void and a retreating degree added, however much one says it will come, hesitate.

dispute.yi: 《天玄赋》说「财合日辰，方能入手」，合日是入手的条件；这里说生财「财合莫为期」，合日不能当日期。两处不好并成一说：一处讲财与日辰合，一处讲财自己得令时的合日。整理本后面今人注把「财合」读成「入墓」，原文写的是「合」，本库照原文，不改。
dispute.en: The Tianxuan Fu says that when Wealth combines with the Day the money can be taken in hand, making the combining day a condition; this verse says that for a living Wealth 'Wealth combining' is not to be taken as the date. The two do not merge into one statement. A modern note in the transcription reads 'combining' as 'entering the tomb'; the original says 'combining', and this library follows the original.

note.yi: 「上下相生可克时」一句，字面很难落实；这里照字译，不加解释。原文里的（5）（6）是整理本给今人注文编的号。
note.en: The line about 'above and below generate each other, a time of control is possible' is hard to pin down from its words; it is translated literally here without explanation. The (5) and (6) in the Chinese are numbers the transcription gave to modern notes.

yi: 凡是占求财哪天能得，
死财，等财逢生的日月能得；
生财，财合的日子不要当日期，
照这样推，一定没有疑惑。
上下相生的，可以取相克的时候；
克外的，白白说相合的日期；
再想到空亡，加上退度，
怎么说能得，也要迟疑。
en: Whenever you divine on which day the money will come,
a dead Wealth comes on the day or month that gives it life;
a living Wealth: do not take the combining day as the date;
reasoned this way, there will be no doubt.
When above and below generate each other, the time of control may be taken;
when the inner controls the outer, it is idle to name the day of combining;
and think further of Void together with a retreating degree:
however one says it will come, still hesitate.

title: 出入财：内阴、外阴，财也阴的吉；纯阳的多散失

rule.yi: 看钱进钱出：内卦阳、财空、又变阳，不宜进财，多散失；内卦阴、财爻也变阴，如期变吉；外卦阴、财阴，出钱吉；外卦阳、财阳，宜藏好；总之逢阴为好，纯阳多散失。
rule.en: Money coming in and going out: an inner yang with Wealth void and changing to yang is no good for taking money in and mostly scatters; an inner yin whose Wealth line changes to yin turns auspicious on time; an outer yin with yin Wealth is good for spending; an outer yang with yang Wealth should be stored away; yin is always the good sign, pure yang mostly loses.

note.yi: 「财空还变阳」的断句，有的读作「财空、还变阳」，有的读作「财空还，变阳」；这里取前一种。原文里的（7）是整理本给今人注文编的号。
note.en: The phrase about Wealth void 'and again changing to yang' can be punctuated in more than one way; this entry takes the first. The (7) in the Chinese is a number the transcription gave to a modern note.

yi: 内卦是阳，财空，又变成阳，
不宜进财，多半散失；
内卦是阴，财爻也变成阴，
如期变吉，不必犹豫。
外卦阴、财也阴，出钱吉；
外卦阳、财也阳，宜藏好；
只要是阴就好，吉无疑；
若是纯阳，多半散失。
en: An inner trigram of yang, its Wealth void and changing to yang:
not fit for taking money in, it mostly scatters;
an inner trigram of yin, its Wealth line also changing to yin:
it turns auspicious on time, and there is no need to hesitate.
An outer yin with yin Wealth: spending is good;
an outer yang with yang Wealth: store it away;
as long as it is yin it is good, and auspicious without doubt;
if it is pure yang, most of it is lost.

title: 财库：入财时财库化成鬼，是折财耗害；如坎卦以火为财，火墓在戌

rule.yi: 进财时，财的库（墓）化成了鬼，是折本耗损之象；比如坎卦以火为财，火墓在戌，就是这个例子。
rule.en: When money is coming in but the store of Wealth turns into Pressure, that is loss of capital and wasting harm; take the Kan trigram, whose Wealth is Fire and whose Fire tomb is at Xu, as the example.

yi: 进财的时候，财的库化成了鬼，
这就是折本耗损。
比如坎卦，火是它的财，
火的墓在戌，就是这个例子。
en: When money is coming in and the store of Wealth turns into Pressure,
this is loss of capital and wasting harm.
Take the Kan trigram, whose Wealth is Fire:
the tomb of Fire is at Xu, and that is the case.

title: 海底眼：财旺相喜持世，有生扶可乘势；卖货要用神兴，开店要财爻安静

rule.yi: 海底眼说：占财，财旺相，喜欢它持世；财出现在卦上又有生扶，可以乘势而为；卖货求财要用神兴旺；开店要财爻安静才有利。
rule.en: The Eye at the Bottom of the Sea says: when divining for wealth, Wealth thriving is best when it holds the Self; Wealth showing and supported may be ridden while it lasts; for selling goods the Subject must be thriving; for opening a shop the Wealth line should be quiet.

note.yi: 这几句在《海底眼》原书里也有（见 HDY.01），第二句字面不同：这里作「出现生扶可乘势」，原书作「出现生扶司秉劳」。
note.en: These lines also stand in the Haidi Yan itself (see HDY.01), where the second line reads differently: here 'showing and supported one may ride the moment', there 'showing and supported it takes charge and does the work'.

yi: 占财，财旺相，喜欢它持世；
财出现在卦上又有生扶，可以乘势；
卖货求财，要用神兴旺；
开店，财爻安静的有利。
en: Divining for wealth, Wealth thriving, it is glad to hold the Self;
Wealth showing and supported may be ridden while it lasts;
to sell goods for money the Subject must thrive;
for a shop, the one whose Wealth line is quiet profits.

title: 海底眼：财逢月破空亡不可凭，伏财被飞爻克制白留意；最后两句只看财生不生命

rule.yi: 财遇月破、空亡，不可凭信；伏着的财被飞爻克制，白白留意；最后「争困撼钱财」几个字含义不明，只能读出：看财有没有生到命上。
rule.en: Wealth meeting Month-break or Void cannot be relied on; a hidden Wealth controlled by its flying line is attended to in vain; the last two lines, with their unclear words about contending, being pressed and shaking money, can only be read as: look at whether Wealth generates the natal line.

note.yi: 「争困撼钱财」四个字，「撼钱」在本书别处（六爻俱静类）和「赌斗」放在一起，可能指赌斗得来的钱；「争」「困」两字含义不明。这里照字译，不解释。「命」按本书「随官入墓」一节里「命随鬼入墓」的用法，指问卜人生年地支所在的爻。
note.en: The words about contending, being pressed and shaking loose money are unclear. 'Shaking money' stands beside 'gambling and contests' elsewhere in this book (the section on six quiet lines) and may mean money won in contests; the other two words are unclear. They are translated literally without explanation. 'The natal line' follows the sense of 'the natal line following Pressure into the tomb' elsewhere in this book: the line of the asker's birth-year branch.

yi: 财逢月破、空亡，不能凭信；
伏着的财被飞爻克制，白白留意；
如果是求争、困、撼一类的钱财，
只看财有没有生到命上就是了。
en: Wealth meeting Month-break or Void cannot be relied on;
a hidden Wealth controlled by the flying line is attended to in vain;
if the money sought is of the sort called contending, pressed or shaken loose,
look only at whether Wealth generates the natal line.

title: 博戏求财以财为本：子孙出现、世临它，再旺相无刑克，称心而归

rule.yi: 赌博求财，以财为本；子孙出现在卦上、世临着它，再加旺相、没有刑克，保管高高兴兴、称心而归。
rule.en: In gambling for wealth Wealth is the stake; with Output showing and the Self sitting on it, and thriving with no punishment or control, you will surely come home glad and satisfied.

yi: 赌博求财，财是本钱；
子孙出现，世临着它；
再加旺相、没有刑克，
保管欢欢喜喜、称心而回。
en: Gambling for wealth, Wealth is the stake;
Output showing and the Self sitting on it;
thriving as well, with no punishment or control:
you will come home glad and satisfied.

title: 博戏又云：世上出现鬼、被应爻克，纵有财神也输；福德休囚陷伏，白费功夫

rule.yi: 赌博的另一首：世爻上见鬼、又被应爻克，纵然有财也是输；福德休囚、又都陷伏，来回白下功夫。
rule.en: Another verse on gambling: the Self showing Pressure and controlled by the Other loses even with Wealth present; Output weak and hidden everywhere, one goes back and forth and works in vain.

yi: 书里又有一首说：
世上出现鬼，被应爻克，
纵然有财神也是输；
福德休囚，又都陷伏，
来来往往白下功夫。
en: The book also has another verse, which says:
with Pressure showing on the Self and controlled by the Other,
even with Wealth present you lose;
Output weak and all of it sunk or hidden:
coming and going, you work in vain.

title: 买卖六爻各主一样：初货物、二己身、三伴侣、四中途、五店舍、六地头

rule.yi: 买卖占里六个爻各代表一样：初爻是货物，二爻是自己，三爻是同伴，四爻是半路，五爻是店舍，上爻是买卖的地方。
rule.en: In a divination on buying and selling the six lines each stand for one thing: the first for goods, the second for oneself, the third for a companion, the fourth for the road midway, the fifth for the lodging, the top for the place of the trade.

note.yi: 「地头」是买卖发生的那个地方。《阐奥歌章》求财买卖章里，外卦是「地头」，内卦是「人」（见 CA.15）。
note.en: 'The local ground' is the place where the trade happens. In the Chan'ao Gezhang's verse on seeking wealth and trade the outer trigram is 'the local ground' and the inner is 'the person' (see CA.15).

zh: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
货物己身伴侣中途店舍地头
yi: 第一爻、第二爻、第三爻、第四爻、第五爻、第六爻，依次是：
货物、自己、同伴、半路、店舍、地头。
en: The first line, the second, the third, the fourth, the fifth, the sixth, in order, are:
goods, oneself, a companion, the road midway, the lodging, the local ground.

hits.text: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
货己身伴侣中途店舍地头

title: 郭璞论买卖：财爻克世最好，身旺相与财并、无煞不空；贞旺悔囚先赢，悔旺贞休后赢

rule.yi: 贩运买卖，财爻克世最好；卦身旺相又与财并，再没有凶煞，不落空亡，就能成；贞旺悔囚，起初买卖就赢，悔旺贞休，要后来才赢；卦里上下互相刑克，即使有财爻，也只是空有名声。「贞」「悔」指内外卦还是本卦之卦，见「打架」。
rule.en: For trading goods, a Wealth line controlling the Self is best; the Body thriving and joined with Wealth, with no baleful stars and not falling Void, it succeeds; Zhen thriving and Hui imprisoned, the first trades win, Hui thriving and Zhen resting, the win comes later; if above and below punish and control each other, even with a Wealth line it is only a name. Whether Zhen and Hui mean the inner and outer trigrams or the original and resulting hexagrams: see the dispute.

dispute.yi: 这首歌里的「贞」「悔」，有两种读法。一种是内卦为贞、外卦为悔；一种是本卦为贞、之卦为悔。《易林补遗》两种都记：有动爻时，本卦是贞、之卦是悔；爻都静、没有之卦时，才取内卦为贞、外卦为悔，并且「以贞为始，以悔为终」。歌诀自己没有说是哪一种。「贞旺悔囚初买卖，悔旺贞休后始赢」里的「初」和「后」有先后，和「以贞为始，以悔为终」对得上；但这不是歌诀的明文，本库不裁。
dispute.en: 'Zhen' and 'Hui' in this verse can be read in two ways: the inner trigram as Zhen and the outer as Hui, or the original hexagram as Zhen and the resulting hexagram as Hui. The Yilin Buyi records both: when there is a moving line, the original hexagram is Zhen and the resulting hexagram is Hui; only when all lines are still and there is no resulting hexagram does it take the inner trigram as Zhen and the outer as Hui, and 'Zhen is the beginning and Hui is the end.' The verse itself does not say which. The words 'first' and 'later' in 'Zhen thriving and Hui imprisoned, the first trades; Hui thriving and Zhen resting, only later a win' have a before and after that fits 'Zhen is the beginning, Hui the end'; but that is not the verse's own statement, and this library does not decide.

note.yi: 「更看役此无诸煞」的「役此」字义不明，可能有讹字；这里照字面译作「这件事上」，不确定。
note.en: The words 'yi ci' in the third line are unclear and may be miscopied; they are translated loosely as 'in this matter', without certainty.

yi: 贩运买卖，财爻克世最好；
卦身旺相，又和财并在一起；
再看这件事上有没有各种凶煞；
不落空亡，就有成就。
贞旺、悔囚，起初的买卖有利；
悔旺、贞休，后来才赢；
卦中上下互相刑克，
纵有财爻，也只是空有名声。
en: In trading goods, a Wealth line controlling the Self is best;
the Body thriving and joined with Wealth;
then see whether any baleful stars attend the matter;
not falling Void, there is success.
Zhen thriving and Hui imprisoned: the first trades profit;
Hui thriving and Zhen resting: the win comes later;
if above and below in the hexagram punish and control each other,
even with a Wealth line there is only a name and no substance.

zh: 凡爻静无之者，便取内卦为贞，外卦为悔，
yi: 凡是有动爻，就有之卦；
以本卦为贞，之卦为悔；
凡是爻都静、没有之卦的，就取内卦为贞、外卦为悔；
以贞为开始，以悔为终结。
en: Wherever there is a moving line, there is a resulting hexagram;
the original hexagram is Zhen, the resulting hexagram is Hui;
where the lines are all still and there is no resulting hexagram, the inner trigram is Zhen and the outer trigram is Hui;
Zhen is the beginning and Hui is the end.
